8e4873cf90c612910dab7ea1d1750f977d51a686.text: 精英 降咒魔法。 闇影 瞄準敵人。在 1…6…7 秒內，此敵人移動 66% 的速度變慢。

3d2adc1e69b305885c55a083a8016004754efe0c.source: Elite Hex Spell. Your non-Assassin skills are disabled for 3 seconds. For 1…8…10 seconds, target foe moves 50% slower. When this hex ends that foe is Crippled for 1…12…15 seconds.
3d2adc1e69b305885c55a083a8016004754efe0c.text: 精英 降咒魔法。您的非 暗殺者 技能將會停用 3 秒。在 1…8…10 秒內，目標敵人移動 50% 的速度變慢。當這個十六進位結束時，敵人處於 殘癈 狀態，持續 1…12…15 秒。

f5da9026c04b7ff6b134b7eedcce4e6e65d689fb.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Shadow Step to target other ally. When you stop maintaining this Enchantment, you return to your original location.
f5da9026c04b7ff6b134b7eedcce4e6e65d689fb.text: 精英 加持魔法。 闇影 瞄準其他盟友。當您停止維護此 加持魔法 時，您將返回原來的位置。

9cc5ee784c62c8ed8ebb1929fcecb12bf3658cbc.source: Bow Attack. Shoot 3 arrows simultaneously at target foe. These arrows deal 40…25% less damage.
9cc5ee784c62c8ed8ebb1929fcecb12bf3658cbc.text: 弓術技能 。射擊 3 同時向目標敵人發射箭。這些箭頭處理 40…25% 傷害較小。

f192f465b8de951f16c52bc452747f82e5456505.source: Elite Axe Attack. You lose all adrenaline and all Energy. This attack is unblockable, you deal +5…65…80 damage and cause a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds. This attack is always critical and if foe is killed, nearby foes are Weakened for 8 seconds.
f192f465b8de951f16c52bc452747f82e5456505.text: 精英 斧術技能。您將失去所有腎上腺素和所有 能量。此攻擊無法阻擋，您會造成 +5…65…80 傷害並造成 重傷 持續 5…17…20 秒。此攻擊始終至關重要，如果敵人被殺死，附近的敵人就會被削弱 8 秒。

e8bdfe99da7c586082a0e013849f17d0ed4b940e.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is knocked down. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
e8bdfe99da7c586082a0e013849f17d0ed4b940e.text: 精英 鎚術技能。如果這次攻擊命中，目標敵人就會被擊倒。如果你的目標受到結界的影響，則該攻擊無法被阻擋。

e51f770639d5cd2c7a2dcb4c296cc4090d5e0d7e.source: Elite Stance. For 1…8…10 seconds, you run 33% faster. Your next successful melee hit does +10…74…90 damage and this stance ends. This stance ends if you use a skill.
e51f770639d5cd2c7a2dcb4c296cc4090d5e0d7e.text: 精英 態勢。在 1…8…10 秒內，您可以更快地執行 33%。你的下一個成功的近戰攻擊會造成 +10…74…90 傷害，並且該姿態結束。如果你使用了技能，這個姿勢就會結束。

f1e1f173eab8cfd5d646ab5e51ec4c87f72ba90a.source: Elite Skill. Target touched foe takes 40…88…100 damage. You are Dazed for 10 seconds.
f1e1f173eab8cfd5d646ab5e51ec4c87f72ba90a.text: 精英 技能。 目標 接觸的敵人會受到 40…88…100 傷害。您處於 暈眩 狀態，持續 10 秒。

7da2b369ab666a878033db9fa1b33bd67339568e.source: Elite Melee Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for +7…21…25 damage. If your target is under the effects of an enchantment, this attack cannot be blocked.
7da2b369ab666a878033db9fa1b33bd67339568e.text: 精英 近身攻擊技能。如果這次攻擊命中，你會受到 +7…21…25 傷害。如果你的目標受到結界的影響，則該攻擊無法被阻擋。

608fcf38a2131bebdab31ae17c1b63e6d782803d.source: Elite Skill. Gain 1…6…7 strikes of adrenaline. For 8 seconds, whenever you use an adrenal skill, that skill recharges for 3 seconds.
608fcf38a2131bebdab31ae17c1b63e6d782803d.text: 精英 技能。獲得 1…6…7 的腎上腺素衝擊。在 8 秒內，每當您使用腎上腺技能時，技能就會重新充電 3 秒。

3cfe7cfd31792fe7c408e92e88a079a799dd4c28.source: Elite Sword Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Crippled for 5…13…15 seconds and begins Bleeding for 10…22…25 seconds.
3cfe7cfd31792fe7c408e92e88a079a799dd4c28.text: 精英 劍術技能。如果此攻擊命中，目標敵人將處於 殘癈 狀態，持續 5…13…15 秒，並開始 流血 持續 10…22…25 秒。

f32a5afac51656e222b19af18167007ab5ee8ac9.source: Elite Stance. For 5…13…15 seconds, you have a 75% chance to block. You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
f32a5afac51656e222b19af18167007ab5ee8ac9.text: 精英 態勢。在 5…13…15 秒內，您有 75% 機會進行封鎖。在喊叫或聖歌的影響下，你可以更快地攻擊 33%。

9145db69be0592faf42c3e2357d04acf1a0493ce.source: Elite Stance. For 10 seconds, the next time you would be knocked down, you gain 1…3…4 strikes of adrenaline and 1…6…7 Energy instead.
9145db69be0592faf42c3e2357d04acf1a0493ce.text: 精英 態勢。在 10 秒內，下次您被擊倒時，您會獲得 1…3…4 腎上腺素攻擊和 1…6…7 能量。

1d71cad9b8b5744846333a8d7cf1e7d0a0db4067.source: Elite Shout. If target foe isn't near an ally, that foe suffers from Cripple and Weakness for 8 seconds.
1d71cad9b8b5744846333a8d7cf1e7d0a0db4067.text: 精英 戰嚎。如果目標敵人不在盟友附近，則該敵人會受到癱瘓和 虛弱 的影響，持續 8 秒。

f353561e33a4934a21f452df5f456b453cf4c629.source: Elite Skill. For 3…13…15 seconds, both you and your animal companion attack 33% faster and run 25% faster.
f353561e33a4934a21f452df5f456b453cf4c629.text: 精英 技能。在 3…13…15 秒內，您和您的動物夥伴攻擊 33% 的速度更快，並且執行 25% 的速度更快。

0e24b9efbdb450142844a035f65dc36596958b0d.source: Elite Shout. Your animal companion instantly moves to your target and causes Bleeding for 5…13…15 seconds with its next attack. The next time you hit with an attack, target foe is Crippled for 5…13…15 seconds.
0e24b9efbdb450142844a035f65dc36596958b0d.text: 精英 戰嚎。你的動物夥伴立即移動到你的目標，並在下次攻擊時造成 流血 持續 5…13…15 秒。下次進行攻擊時，目標敵人將處於 殘癈 狀態，持續 5…13…15 秒。

7785e9326694940dab6f5ba73157cbc5c38c2c38.source: Elite Stance. For 1…16…20 seconds, you attack 33% faster and your Marksmanship attribute is increased by 2.
7785e9326694940dab6f5ba73157cbc5c38c2c38.text: 精英 態勢。在 1…16…20 秒內，您攻擊 33% 的速度會更快，而您的 弓術精通 屬性會增加 2。

75a3aeee7b8fd84fefc1c7957ab1331250a5f304.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range gain adrenaline twice as fast. This spirit dies after 30…102…120 seconds.
75a3aeee7b8fd84fefc1c7957ab1331250a5f304.text: 精英 自然儀式。打造1…8…10水平精神。在其範圍內的非靈體生物獲得腎上腺素的速度是其兩倍。該靈魂會在 30…102…120 秒後死亡。

13c49eb0e571cab7e4d7dc7b18a3a90b88b0d13d.source: Elite Skill. Shadow Step to target foe. If target foe is not using a skill, that foe is knocked down. All of your non-dagger attack skills are disabled for 10 seconds.
13c49eb0e571cab7e4d7dc7b18a3a90b88b0d13d.text: 精英 技能。 闇影 瞄準敵人。如果目標敵人沒有使用技能，該敵人就會被擊倒。你的所有非匕首攻擊技能都會被停用 10 秒。

59bec8dc74410068a2b36160dc923e92ef993758.source: Elite Spell. Target foe is struck for 20…72…85 lightning damage. If you are holding an item, you gain 7 Energy and 5…41…50 Health.
59bec8dc74410068a2b36160dc923e92ef993758.text: 精英 咒文魔法。 目標 敵人受到 20…72…85 閃電傷害。如果您持有物品，您將獲得 7 能量 和 5…41…50 體力。

b20396028d84fe23bc1550a9acdde81e6a158ad5.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30…54…60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 20% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15…71…85 lightning damage.
b20396028d84fe23bc1550a9acdde81e6a158ad5.text: 精英 物品 咒文魔法。保留 Glaive 的骨灰最多 30…54…60 秒。當你拿著她的骨灰時，所有 祭祀者 技能都有 20% 護甲穿透力。當你撒下她的骨灰時，該區域的所有敵人都會受到 15…71…85 閃電傷害。

1e1e6b2b445ad1fcdf352747a4cb4b58c8a0f819.source: Elite Spell. Gain 8…15…17 Energy. If any spirits are within earshot, you do not sacrifice Health.
1e1e6b2b445ad1fcdf352747a4cb4b58c8a0f819.text: 精英 咒文魔法。獲得 8…15…17 能量。如果有任何鬼魂在聽力範圍內，你就不會犧牲 體力。

3044b7cb1ead75bda661fee6efdd59854732be71.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target ally gains 100% more adrenaline and 1 Energy whenever that ally successfully hits with an attack.
3044b7cb1ead75bda661fee6efdd59854732be71.text: 精英 武器 咒文魔法。在 5…17…20 秒內，目標盟友獲得 100% 較多的腎上腺素，並在該盟友成功攻擊時獲得 1 能量。

6609e25d969b8684c9f8d75ac8ad146b6e21e869.source: Elite Signet. For 5…17…20 seconds, all spirits you control within earshot attack 33% faster and deal 5…9…10 additional damage.
6609e25d969b8684c9f8d75ac8ad146b6e21e869.text: 精英 紋章。在 5…17…20 秒內，你控制的所有在聽力範圍內的靈魂會更快地攻擊 33% 並造成 5…9…10 額外傷害。

e1ed8bb5a3de174acf3bf85c229a32a09bf17519.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage from a foe that damage is limited to 5% of that ally's max Health and that ally steals up to 20…68…80 Health from that foe.
e1ed8bb5a3de174acf3bf85c229a32a09bf17519.text: 精英 武器 咒文魔法。在 8 秒內，下一個目標盟友受到敵人傷害時，此傷害僅限於該盟友最大 體力 的 5%，並且該盟友從該敵人竊取最多 20…68…80 體力。

1814fc5cafadb221a178586641ae566034f67588.source: Elite Weapon Spell. For 8 seconds, the next time target ally takes damage or life steal from a foe, that ally steals up to 20…68…80 Health from that foe and loses 2 conditions.
1814fc5cafadb221a178586641ae566034f67588.text: 精英 武器 咒文魔法。在 8 秒內，下一個目標盟友受到敵人傷害或生命竊取時，該盟友會從該敵人竊取最多 20…68…80 體力 並失去 2 條件。

b15c5e3893df9393988b85ccce6f36afe47c2f9d.source: Elite Spell. All of your Spirits die. You gain 5…17…20 Energy and all of your Binding Rituals are recharged if a Spirit died in this way.
b15c5e3893df9393988b85ccce6f36afe47c2f9d.text: 精英 咒文魔法。你所有的靈魂都會死。如果靈魂以這種方式死亡，你將獲得 5…17…20 能量 並且你的所有繫結儀式都會重新充電。

0f5084e7f7022ca6a2dcb70bdf86822fc79b4359.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15…51…60 seconds, your attacks deal 5…29…35 more damage while under the effects of a weapon spell.
0f5084e7f7022ca6a2dcb70bdf86822fc79b4359.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 15…51…60 秒內，你的攻擊在受到武器法術影響時會造成 5…29…35 額外傷害。

a7980abba64e777207de0c1648915d7b28078af8.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…34…40 seconds, whenever you cast a Weapon Spell on an ally, you gain 1…4…5 Energy.
a7980abba64e777207de0c1648915d7b28078af8.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 10…34…40 秒內，每當您對盟友施放 武器 咒文魔法 時，您都會獲得 1…4…5 能量。

c6714f819b5c9cc17293c9181f5c0bf1108177dd.source: Elite Shout. For 4…9…10 seconds, all allies within earshot move 33% faster, and gain 5…13…15 Health while moving.
c6714f819b5c9cc17293c9181f5c0bf1108177dd.text: 精英 戰嚎。在 4…9…10 秒內，所有聽力範圍內的盟友都會更快地移動 33%，並在移動時獲得 5…13…15 體力。

4dea285b3789126ee2f1dc4264ea3325bd1f85f4.source: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each party member within earshot cannot be blocked.
4dea285b3789126ee2f1dc4264ea3325bd1f85f4.text: 精英 聖歌。在 10 秒內，聽力範圍內的每位隊員所使用的下一個攻擊技巧都無法被阻擋。

84d332909e1b5546ad4f895f68dbe1eb42c487cc.source: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next attack skill used by each ally within earshot causes Crippling for 5…13…15 seconds.
84d332909e1b5546ad4f895f68dbe1eb42c487cc.text: 精英 聖歌。在 10 秒內，聽力範圍內的每個盟友使用的下一個攻擊技能會導致 致殘 持續 5…13…15 秒。

db771979867a766148a96a771ce32d11635c86fd.source: Elite Skill. For 10 seconds, the next time an ally within earshot would take fatal damage, that damage is negated and that ally is healed for 20…164…200 Health. Angelic Bond ends on all other allies.
db771979867a766148a96a771ce32d11635c86fd.text: 精英 技能。在 10 秒內，下一次聽力範圍內的盟友受到致命傷害時，該傷害將被抵消，並且該盟友將在 20…164…200 體力 內得到治療。 天使連結 對所有其他盟友結束。

e944f208f953e61a8773f605009f0342baf13079.source: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, all party members within earshot gain 2…4…5 strikes of adrenaline the next time they use an attack skill.
e944f208f953e61a8773f605009f0342baf13079.text: 精英 聖歌。在 10 秒內，所有在聽力範圍內的隊員在下次使用攻擊技能時都會獲得 2…4…5 腎上腺素攻擊。

28f21086986e9b85ac47090c48f71720302ba08e.source: Elite Chant. For 4…9…10 seconds, each party member within earshot has a 50% chance to block incoming attacks. This chant ends if that party member hits with an attack skill.
28f21086986e9b85ac47090c48f71720302ba08e.text: 精英 聖歌。在 4…9…10 秒內，聽力範圍內的每個隊伍成員都有 50% 機會阻止傳入攻擊。如果該隊員使用攻擊技能命中，則此吟唱結束。

73077b84a6daa606ff4001b899e11822b61259fc.source: Elite Skill. For 45 seconds, you gain 0…120…150% more adrenaline.
73077b84a6daa606ff4001b899e11822b61259fc.text: 精英 技能。在 45 秒內，您會獲得更多 0…120…150% 腎上腺素。

740533d1340fcb4840cd1daf05440ad140540320.source: Elite Echo. For 10…30…35 seconds, if you are under the effects of a chant or a shout, you attack 33% faster and gain 33% more adrenaline, but you have -20 armor.
740533d1340fcb4840cd1daf05440ad140540320.text: 精英 迴響。在 10…30…35 秒內，如果您受到聖歌或喊叫的影響，您會更快地攻擊 33% 並獲得 33% 更多腎上腺素，但您擁有 -20 護甲。

45895a22d66556fcc9cf76d9a623e84b9ec0c03b.source: Elite Shout. Target other ally loses all conditions. If a condition was removed in this way, that ally moves 25% faster for 1…8…10 seconds.
45895a22d66556fcc9cf76d9a623e84b9ec0c03b.text: 精英 戰嚎。 目標 其他盟友失去所有條件。如果以這種方式消除了某個條件，則該盟友會在 1…8…10 秒內更快地移動 25%。

c2afe318155fd18be135b9dd30b4e3386b0dd60b.source: Elite Shout. For 2…4…4 seconds, all allies within earshot gain 1…2…2 Energy regeneration.
c2afe318155fd18be135b9dd30b4e3386b0dd60b.text: 精英 戰嚎。在 2…4…4 秒內，所有聽力範圍內的盟友都會獲得 1…2…2 能量再生。

3fd094fb664c29944fc434d58f5f72e8ab90f701.source: Elite Chant. For 20 seconds, the next 1…5…6 skills used by each ally within earshot remove 1 condition from that ally.
3fd094fb664c29944fc434d58f5f72e8ab90f701.text: 精英 聖歌。在 20 秒內，每個盟友在聽力範圍內使用的下一個 1…5…6 技能會消除該盟友的 1 狀態。

edaf1c26b7bde5e5e12ddd6e98f95d4e032df49c.source: Elite Chant. For 10 seconds, the next time each party member within earshot uses a skill, that party member gains 45…97…110 Health.
edaf1c26b7bde5e5e12ddd6e98f95d4e032df49c.text: 精英 聖歌。在 10 秒內，下次每位在聽力範圍內的隊伍成員使用技能時，該隊伍成員將獲得 45…97…110 體力。

58a284ecd8263b3e0041330b822c8ee03d576777.source: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…42…50 damage. If it hits a non-moving target, you inflict a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
58a284ecd8263b3e0041330b822c8ee03d576777.text: 精英 矛 攻擊。如果這次攻擊命中，你會造成 +10…42…50 傷害。如果它會擊中不移動的目標，則會造成 重傷 持續 5…17…20 秒。

4203243c33fe9bcd7ce1b3dc6a4d062580dc9ef8.source: Elite Spear Attack. If this attack hits, you deal +10…42…50 damage. If it hits a foe suffering from a condition, that foe is also Dazed for 4…9…10 seconds.
4203243c33fe9bcd7ce1b3dc6a4d062580dc9ef8.text: 精英 矛 攻擊。如果這次攻擊命中，你會造成 +10…42…50 傷害。如果它擊中患有某種病症的敵人，該敵人也會受到 暈眩 的影響，持續 4…9…10 秒。

d12be323eb11aa4f8f9ef1d4cf9bf5fb533ce107.source: Elite Signet. All party members lose all conditions. You are set on Fire "Fire" is capitalized, unlike other descriptions which state "set on fire" for 1 second for each condition removed in this way.
d12be323eb11aa4f8f9ef1d4cf9bf5fb533ce107.text: 精英 紋章。所有黨員失去一切條件。你著火了 「Fire」是大寫的，與其他描述不同的是，以這種方式刪除的每個條件，「著火」為 1 秒。

d55f2b3058ca41f916aa36b13426470a2589ca71.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. When you cast this enchantment, all nearby foes are Blinded for 1…6…7 seconds. For 30 seconds, if you are wielding an earth weapon, your melee attacks deal +3…25…30 earth damage. When this enchantment ends, you are cured of Blindness.
d55f2b3058ca41f916aa36b13426470a2589ca71.text: 精英 快閃記憶體 加持魔法。當你施放此結界時，附近的所有敵人都會被致盲 1…6…7 秒。在 30 秒內，如果你使用土系武器，你的近戰攻擊會造成 +3…25…30 土系傷害。當這個結界結束時，你的失明就被治癒了。

ed28eaefa51df9258bef6fe24ce2eb7f7f34cd61.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack a foe with your scythe, you deal 10…22…25 slashing damage to all adjacent foes.
ed28eaefa51df9258bef6fe24ce2eb7f7f34cd61.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 15 秒內，每當你用鐮刀攻擊敵人時，你都會對所有相鄰敵人造成 10…22…25 切割傷害。

5138ded7e7229f20cf30d27539883f8e609d4824.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever you cast a spell, you gain 2 Energy for each enchantment on you (maximum 2…6…7 Energy).
5138ded7e7229f20cf30d27539883f8e609d4824.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 10 秒內，每當你施展法術時，你身上的每個結界都會獲得 2 能量（最多 2…6…7 能量）。

f17bea99fa6a18565e70d359f7c94cd08e59ecce.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you gain +20 armor against physical damage, you gain adrenaline 25% faster, your attacks deal holy damage, and whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, nearby foes are set on fire for 1…3…3 seconds. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
f17bea99fa6a18565e70d359f7c94cd08e59ecce.text: 精英 表格。在 10…74…90 秒內，你獲得 +20 防禦物理傷害的護甲，你更快地獲得腎上腺素 25%，你的攻擊造成神聖傷害，每當你失去 神喚使 結界時，附近的敵人就會著火，持續 1…3…3 秒。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

3dff4943a26f57c0f00b34c2c070c145b529c2a4.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all allies in earshot are healed for 5…41…50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
3dff4943a26f57c0f00b34c2c070c145b529c2a4.text: 精英 表格。在 10…74…90 秒內，你的攻擊會造成神聖傷害。每當您使用 神喚使 攻擊技能時，就會失去 1 十六進位。每當你失去 神喚使 結界時，所有聽力範圍內的盟友都會受到 5…41…50 體力 的治療。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

fc1b47c75418d335238aaf7fd6711f13aeb37d4e.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your scythe attacks deal dark damage, and steal 0…10…12 Health. You are immune to Disease, and inflict Disease on all adjacent foes for 3 seconds whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
fc1b47c75418d335238aaf7fd6711f13aeb37d4e.text: 精英 表格。在 10…74…90 秒內，你的鐮刀攻擊會造成黑暗傷害，並竊取 0…10…12 體力。你對疾病免疫，每當你失去 神喚使 結界時，就會對所有鄰近的敵人造成疾病，持續 3 秒。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

607f554e04b72ad829bb29e4f586a1d073142e84.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your Dervish enchantments recharge 50% faster and your attacks deal chaos damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, steal 1 Energy from all nearby foes. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
607f554e04b72ad829bb29e4f586a1d073142e84.text: 精英 表格。在 10…74…90 秒內，您的 神喚使 結界會更快地充能 50%，而您的攻擊會造成混亂傷害。每當你失去 神喚使 結界時，就會從附近所有敵人身上偷取 1 能量。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

a02226ea324062af947a8a941adbe926b49bc1fd.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you have +150 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, all party members in earshot lose 1 condition. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
a02226ea324062af947a8a941adbe926b49bc1fd.text: 精英 表格。在 10…74…90 秒內，你擁有 +150、體力、+30 元素護甲，並且你的攻擊會造成土壤屬性傷害。每當您失去 神喚使 結界時，所有聽力範圍內的黨員都會失去 1 狀態。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

8797ef2fbc20c51e8169083a4425cd73467b8e39.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, nothing happens. When this enchantment ends, Pious Renewal is recharged and you gain 0…4…5 Energy and 0…24…30 Health.
8797ef2fbc20c51e8169083a4425cd73467b8e39.text: 精英 快閃記憶體 加持魔法。在 8 秒內，沒有任何反應。當此結界結束時，神性修補 會重新充電，並且您會獲得 0…4…5 能量 和 0…24…30 體力。

306d1cd79169060c28a406bac6b3ac0a598a41ae.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…9…10 seconds, you cannot be the target of spells, and you cannot cast spells.
306d1cd79169060c28a406bac6b3ac0a598a41ae.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 5…9…10 秒內，你不能成為法術的目標，也不能施展法術。

d579b74cddff5b5d0043f08386490624c5b66341.source: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you Cripple your target for 3…13…15 seconds. You lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment was removed, this attack knocks down for 2…3…3 seconds.
d579b74cddff5b5d0043f08386490624c5b66341.text: 精英 鐮刀 攻擊。如果這次攻擊命中，你會讓目標癱瘓 3…13…15 秒。您失去 1 神喚使 結界。如果結界被移除，此攻擊會擊倒 2…3…3 秒。

574e28238b73b15c01e69988e5903e352349db00.source: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, you do +5…17…20 damage, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
574e28238b73b15c01e69988e5903e352349db00.text: 精英 鐮刀 攻擊。如果這次攻擊擊中，你會造成 +5…17…20 傷害，目標敵人會受到 流血 的影響，持續 5…17…20 秒，你會失去 1 神喚使 結界。如果結界被移除，目標敵人也會受到 重傷 的影響，持續 5…17…20 秒。

bf10c328f0418c7532e350fac10a24a8198a984b.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, your attack skills also Cripple that foe for 1…9…11 seconds and you transfer 1…3…3 conditions from yourself to that foe.
bf10c328f0418c7532e350fac10a24a8198a984b.text: 精英 快閃記憶體 加持魔法。在 20 秒內，你的攻擊技能也會使該敵人癱瘓 1…9…11 秒，並且你將 1…3…3 狀態從自己轉移到該敵人身上。

b37c772b98d954be72788220f2c1badd3540a842.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, you attack, move and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
b37c772b98d954be72788220f2c1badd3540a842.text: 精英 快閃記憶體 加持魔法。在 3…13…15 秒內，您可以更快地攻擊、移動並獲得腎上腺素 25%。

154ef9cf1b31f5ae1d9c1129d1c3e3c91fe7f288.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20 seconds, you have -2 Energy regeneration, and you gain 1…5…6 Energy every time you hit with an attack.
154ef9cf1b31f5ae1d9c1129d1c3e3c91fe7f288.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 20 秒內，您擁有 -2 能量再生，並且每次攻擊時都會獲得 1…5…6 能量。

4acb6df194ae7af85ff81b0890a62c2d3c820124.source: Signet. If you are within the area of a demonic servant of Abaddon, you gain 4…5 strikes of adrenaline and 22…24 Energy.
4acb6df194ae7af85ff81b0890a62c2d3c820124.text: 紋章。如果您處於 亞霸頓 惡魔僕人的區域內，您將獲得 4…5 腎上腺素打擊和 22…24 能量。

5234ffeecf40cb068f385332d98c66b6a334bd9c.source: Elite Skill. Spit a projectile at target foe. It strikes for 400 earth damage and knocks down target foe if it hits. This skill cannot be used on nearby foes.
5234ffeecf40cb068f385332d98c66b6a334bd9c.text: 精英 技能。向目標敵人吐出彈頭。它會造成 400 地球傷害，並在擊中時擊倒目標敵人。此技能不能對附近的敵人使用。

6589332c6f617167d8cdba55749aa07fb092097f.source: Elite Echo. For 3…13…15 seconds, target non-spirit ally gains +1…3…3 to all attributes. This echo is reapplied every time a chant or shout ends on that ally. PvE Skill
6589332c6f617167d8cdba55749aa07fb092097f.text: 精英 迴響。在 3…13…15 秒內，目標非精神盟友的所有屬性獲得 +1…3…3。每當該盟友的吟唱或喊叫結束時，都會重新應用此迴聲。 PvE 技能

8cb86a98c5b92d06de4aad04e5f6a1aa5bf12f00.source: Elite Melee Attack. Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13…27…30 Holy damage for most skills, the "h" of holy is lowercase and knocks down attacking foes. PvE Skill
8cb86a98c5b92d06de4aad04e5f6a1aa5bf12f00.text: 精英 近身攻擊技能。攻擊目標和鄰近的敵人。對於大多數技能來說，每次攻擊都會造成 +13…27…30 神聖傷害，holy 的「h」是小寫的，可以擊倒攻擊的敵人。 PvE 技能

7fb7745fbe60667bf828475b3a695bfce8f5f6d5.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3…9…10 seconds, you have +1…5…6 energy regeneration. This skill reapplies itself every time you use a non-Dervish skill. PvE Skill
7fb7745fbe60667bf828475b3a695bfce8f5f6d5.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 3…9…10 秒內，您可以進行 +1…5…6 能量再生。每次您使用非 神喚使 技能時，此技能都會重新套用。 PvE 技能

5a85162371ca2cbe8d6ef6d71ad8e2c593f70bc2.source: Enchantment Spell. For 4 seconds and 1 second for each rank of Critical Strikes, you attack 33% faster and gain +15…25 armor. This skill reapplies itself every time you land a critical hit.
5a85162371ca2cbe8d6ef6d71ad8e2c593f70bc2.text: 加持魔法。對於 致命攻擊 的每個等級，在 4 秒和 1 秒內，您可以更快地攻擊 33% 並獲得 +15…25 護甲。每次你受到重擊時，該技能都會重新應用。

437ddaa9a4aae0bb6ac93057acc439de32ba6ebc.source: Spell. Interrupt target foe's skill. If that foe was suffering from a Mesmer hex, that foe and all foes in the area take 25…50 damage and have 3…5 Health degeneration for 10 seconds.
437ddaa9a4aae0bb6ac93057acc439de32ba6ebc.text: 咒文魔法。 中斷 目標敵人的技能。如果該敵人受到 幻術師 六角形的影響，則該敵人和該區域中的所有敵人都會受到 25…50 傷害，並在 10 秒內受到 3…5 體力衰減效果 的傷害。

e3c9f764866292138ca4556f8d25c6be7cd4dc5d.source: Enchantment Spell. You have +100 max Health. When this enchantment ends, all party members in the area are resurrected with 40…50% Health and 20…30% Energy.
e3c9f764866292138ca4556f8d25c6be7cd4dc5d.text: 加持魔法。您擁有 +100 最大 體力。當此結界結束時，該區域中的所有小隊成員都會透過 40…50% 體力 和 20…30% 能量 復活。

a812e27c9ef27c1513540d303ccd53b01ccb3e7a.source: Skill. For 10 seconds, the next time you deal elemental damage with a spell to a target, you deal 60…70% of that damage to all other foes in the area.
a812e27c9ef27c1513540d303ccd53b01ccb3e7a.text: 技能。在 10 秒內，下次你用法術對目標造成元素傷害時，你會對區域內的所有其他敵人造成 60…70% 傷害。

b0ad3504a1ff68008f87c62f7f6f86ad99eff16b.source: Skill. If target foe is suffering from a condition or hex, that foe suffers 60…90 damage.
b0ad3504a1ff68008f87c62f7f6f86ad99eff16b.text: 技能。如果目標敵人患有某種狀況或妖術，則該敵人會受到 60…90 傷害。

7d0d8db7aa990bf3d6ff1c877e67e80408211f65.source: Skill. For 18…25 seconds, you and your pet attack 25% faster and have +1…3 Health regeneration.
7d0d8db7aa990bf3d6ff1c877e67e80408211f65.text: 技能。在 18…25 秒內，您和您的寵物可以更快地攻擊 25%，並擁有 +1…3 體力再生。

f3146e24f2e6ce3700c6c5d707e5e0ed50cd5657.source: Enchantment Spell. For 2…5 seconds, whenever target other ally takes damage, all party members are healed for 2 Health for each rank in Divine Favor.
f3146e24f2e6ce3700c6c5d707e5e0ed50cd5657.text: 加持魔法。在 2…5 秒內，每當目標其他盟友受到傷害時，所有團隊成員都會獲得 2 體力 的治療，對應 神恩 中的每個等級。

76ada81400241d87421d31dcbb0cbb249ff8e596.source: Binding Ritual. Create a level 4…14 spirit that dies after 75…150 seconds. Attacks by this spirit steal up to 10…20 Health, and you are healed for 10…20 Health.
76ada81400241d87421d31dcbb0cbb249ff8e596.text: 繫結儀式。創造一個等級為 4…14 的精魂，該精魂會在 75…150 秒後死亡。此精魂的攻擊會偷取最多 10…20 體力，並且您會獲得 10…20 體力 的治療效果。

6c6e63a158cea9277ce9d230b81d5ed1a7c3a468.source: Melee Attack. Attack target and adjacent foes. Each attack that hits deals +13…20 damage.
6c6e63a158cea9277ce9d230b81d5ed1a7c3a468.text: 近身攻擊技能。攻擊目標和鄰近的敵人。每次攻擊都會造成 +13…20 傷害。

069cf455d292ccfc107a7ff8ab49e500e45411f5.source: Shout. For 4 seconds and 1 second for every 2 ranks in Leadership, all party members within earshot take 20…35% less damage. Affected party members are healed for 35…60 Health when this shout ends.
069cf455d292ccfc107a7ff8ab49e500e45411f5.text: 戰嚎。對於 領導 中的每個 2 等級，在 4 秒和 1 秒內，所有在聽力範圍內的隊伍成員都會受到較少的 20…35% 傷害。當此喊聲結束時，受影響的隊員會在 35…60 體力 內得到治療。

e9291aee30fa1e4087ae78a5d7420309ff03babf.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the raven. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health, and a 20…30% chance to block, All your attributes are set to 0 and raven attacks replace your skills.
e9291aee30fa1e4087ae78a5d7420309ff03babf.text: 精英 表格。你失去了所有效果並呈現出烏鴉的樣子。在 60 秒內，你擁有 80 護甲、660…700 體力 和 20…30% 格擋機會，你的所有屬性都設定為 0，烏鴉攻擊取代你的技能。

4d7cc482f7095574f2ea7935c263abb0c6446476.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the bear. For 60 seconds, you have 100 armor and 750…790…800 Health. All your attributes are set to 0 and bear attacks replace your skills.
4d7cc482f7095574f2ea7935c263abb0c6446476.text: 精英 表格。你失去所有效果並呈現出熊的樣子。在 60 秒內，您擁有 100 裝甲和 750…790…800 體力。你的所有屬性都設定為 0，熊攻擊取代了你的技能。

8e3d08cc5278b119e768f137e546e84f4b655b42.source: Elite Form. You lose all effects and take on the aspect of the wolf. For 60 seconds, you have 80 armor, 660…700 Health, and 2…4 Health regeneration. All your attributes are set to 0 and wolf attacks replace your skills.
8e3d08cc5278b119e768f137e546e84f4b655b42.text: 精英 表格。你失去所有效果並呈現出狼的樣子。在 60 秒內，您擁有 80 裝甲、660…700 體力 和 2…4 體力再生。你的所有屬性都設定為 0，狼攻擊取代了你的技能。

15fe3b74429fb8a104343ed845bc121914bb1f98.source: Skill. For 20…30 seconds you gain a random Asura benefit every time you earn experience from killing an enemy.
15fe3b74429fb8a104343ed845bc121914bb1f98.text: 技能。在 20…30 秒內，每次您透過殺死敵人獲得經驗時，您都會獲得隨機的 阿蘇拉 收益。

28369b4c50e63ff90bde4a7892d070484c52be07.source: Hex Spell. For 9…12 seconds your attacks cannot miss target foe. Killing a foe hexed with Asuran Scan removes 5% Death Penalty.
28369b4c50e63ff90bde4a7892d070484c52be07.text: 降咒魔法。在 9…12 秒內，你的攻擊不會錯過目標敵人。殺死被阿蘇蘭掃描施咒的敵人可消除 5% 死刑。

612946ae81d7a5854327f44714f044eb45c56638.source: Enchantment Spell. For 5…11 seconds you have a 50% chance to block attacks. This Enchantment is reapplied every time an enemy strikes you.
612946ae81d7a5854327f44714f044eb45c56638.text: 加持魔法。在 5…11 秒內，您有 50% 機會阻止攻擊。每次敵人攻擊您時，都會重新套用此 加持魔法。

bfef17386da17b2b412fa0dd17bce988726c5cee.source: Enchantment Spell. For 10…16 seconds, you move 20…33% faster and your Spells take 20% less time to cast.
bfef17386da17b2b412fa0dd17bce988726c5cee.text: 加持魔法。在 10…16 秒內，您可以更快地移動 20…33%，並且您的法術施展所需的時間會更少 20%。

91a92b7a2dbda5c3c4afdc1ef36915c6948e8dbd.source: Hex Spell. For 6…10 seconds, every time target foe deals damage that foe takes 100…140% of the damage it causes (maximum 80 damage).
91a92b7a2dbda5c3c4afdc1ef36915c6948e8dbd.text: 降咒魔法。在 6…10 秒內，每次目標敵人造成傷害時，敵人都會承受其造成的 100…140% 傷害（最大 80 傷害）。

b630bfb4e8251f40f6e02d595f99d423aa2134c2.source: Ward Spell. For 5 seconds, foes in the area have -4…6 Health degeneration. When the portal ends, foes in the area are Diseased for 12…20 seconds.
b630bfb4e8251f40f6e02d595f99d423aa2134c2.text: 病房 咒文魔法。在 5 秒內，該區域內的敵人具有 -4…6 體力衰減效果。當傳送門結束時，該區域的敵人會處於疾病狀態，持續 12…20 秒。

e95b45177b1142d929e99b1adb133063e85a3909.source: Spell. For 10…20 seconds, one random spell is disabled for target foe and Smooth Criminal is replaced by that spell. You gain 5…10 Energy.
e95b45177b1142d929e99b1adb133063e85a3909.text: 咒文魔法。在 10…20 秒內，目標敵人會停用隨機法術，犯罪高手會被該法術​​取代。您將獲得 5…10 能量。

1e7297038a86107ff53bd6e3004da556f0bbe14e.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ice Imp that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Ice Spikes. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
1e7297038a86107ff53bd6e3004da556f0bbe14e.text: 咒文魔法。召喚一個等級 14…20 冰小惡魔，其生存時間為 40…60 秒並具有 冰之尖刺。一次只能啟動 1 阿蘇拉 召喚。

ff27dcb89a2019c2cd3b5f74ab99d7de8e49869b.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Mursaat that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Enervating Charge. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
ff27dcb89a2019c2cd3b5f74ab99d7de8e49869b.text: 咒文魔法。召喚一個等級 14…20 馬賽特，其生存時間為 40…60 秒並具有 衰弱電擊。一次只能啟動 1 阿蘇拉 召喚。

a43b3292412fc5f263059d99bd4f70dcb3a1b6ef.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Naga Shaman that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Stoning. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active a time.
a43b3292412fc5f263059d99bd4f70dcb3a1b6ef.text: 咒文魔法。召喚一個等級為 14…20 納迦 的薩滿，其生命為 40…60 秒並擁有 石箭。一次只能啟動 1 阿蘇拉 召喚。

b80f2793f8566228b4a0e9743f49f5d2fc0c1195.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ruby Djinn that lives for 40…60 seconds and has Immolate. Only 1 Asura Summon can be active at a time.
b80f2793f8566228b4a0e9743f49f5d2fc0c1195.text: 咒文魔法。召喚一個等級 14…20 紅寶石巨靈，其生存時間為 40…60 秒並具有 火焰焚身。一次只能啟動 1 阿蘇拉 召喚。

bc9a583f8f929fd931940e1b9a2ad936c693e025.source: Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes are struck for 30…40 damage. If target foe is not a boss, that foe and all adjacent foes are Dazed for 3…5 seconds.
bc9a583f8f929fd931940e1b9a2ad936c693e025.text: 咒文魔法。 目標 敵人和所有鄰近敵人都會受到 30…40 傷害。如果目標敵人不是 Boss，則該敵人和所有相鄰敵人將處於 暈眩 狀態，持續 3…5 秒。

4291706ce7558de58e671c0861dd6f5ce226b600.source: Spell. Throw Alkar's Alchemical Acid at target foe. Target and adjacent foes are struck for 40…50 damage. Destroyers take an additional 45…70 damage and they have Cracked Armor for 14…20 seconds.
4291706ce7558de58e671c0861dd6f5ce226b600.text: 咒文魔法。向目標敵人投擲阿爾卡的煉金酸。 目標 和鄰近的敵人會受到 40…50 傷害。驅逐艦會受到額外的 45…70 傷害，它們會破解 防禦 持續 14…20 秒。

c0c18552763f59660709c3117e40211f1bc686a1.source: Trap. When Black Powder Mine is triggered, all nearby foes are struck for 20…30 damage, become Blinded, and begin Bleeding for 7…10 seconds. Black Powder Mine ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
c0c18552763f59660709c3117e40211f1bc686a1.text: 陷阱。當黑火藥地雷被觸發時，附近的所有敵人都會受到 20…30 傷害，變得失明，並開始 流血 持續 7…10 秒。黑火藥地雷在 90 秒後結束。啟動該技能時，你很容易被打斷。

d2e9f167428f48e1f73f283d778b223592911708.source: Skill. You headbutt target touched foe dealing 45…70 damage and knocking down that foe if it hits.
d2e9f167428f48e1f73f283d778b223592911708.text: 技能。你用頭撞目標所觸及的敵人，造成 45…70 傷害，並擊倒該敵人（如果擊中）。

682fe61748a92bd2d3ff6dc6bb9566eac3137b79.source: Spell. All party members are relieved of Burning and are healed for 50…60 Health.
682fe61748a92bd2d3ff6dc6bb9566eac3137b79.text: 咒文魔法。所有隊員都解除了燃燒狀態，並為 50…60 體力 治癒。

c640ae101fa62c07d3c8772f88ad08b8f9cded4e.source: Stance. For 72…90 seconds, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 10…15%. If you are drunk while activating this skill, your movement and attack speeds are increased by 25…33% instead.
c640ae101fa62c07d3c8772f88ad08b8f9cded4e.text: 態勢。在 72…90 秒內，你的移動和攻擊速度會增加 10…15%。如果你在啟動此技能時喝醉了，你的移動和攻擊速度會增加 25…33%。

cef48a7816ee1744e688f250c635eac0333489a5.source: Enchantment Spell. For 24…30 seconds, your stances last 55…100% longer. If you activated this skill while drunk, you cannot be knocked down.
cef48a7816ee1744e688f250c635eac0333489a5.text: 加持魔法。對於 24…30 秒，您的姿勢持續 55…100% 的時間較長。如果你在醉酒狀態下發動這個技能，你就不會被擊倒。

c2345fcad6002b28dfdea1ed6f786f2c7eca2c9d.source: Skill. Target touched foe takes 50…70 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 15…25 seconds.
c2345fcad6002b28dfdea1ed6f786f2c7eca2c9d.text: 技能。 目標 接觸的敵人會受到 50…70 穿刺傷害，並開始 流血 持續 15…25 秒。

806222b1c2ccdf2b41ede5008b3418d0c69f7209.source: Weapon Spell. For 20 seconds, target other ally's weapon strikes for +15…20 damage and has a 28…40% chance to cause knock down.
806222b1c2ccdf2b41ede5008b3418d0c69f7209.text: 武器 咒文魔法。在 20 秒內，瞄準其他盟友的武器攻擊造成 +15…20 傷害，並有 28…40% 機率造成擊倒。

ec80ef3135966d8175b12af98209195fef6558df.source: Spell. All foes in the area are struck for 55…80 holy damage. The location of hidden objects are briefly indicated on your Compass. Any hidden objects in the area are revealed.
ec80ef3135966d8175b12af98209195fef6558df.text: 咒文魔法。該區域內的所有敵人都會受到 55…80 神聖傷害。指南針上會簡單指示隱藏物體的位置。該區域中的任何隱藏物體都會被揭露。

445183a8f74b758baf40f7ab14f9d7450de134d7.source: Spell. Create a Snow Storm at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, foes adjacent to that location are struck for 30…40 cold damage each second.
445183a8f74b758baf40f7ab14f9d7450de134d7.text: 咒文魔法。在目標敵人的位置製造暴風雪。在 5 秒內，鄰近該位置的敵人每秒鐘都會受到 30…40 寒冷傷害。

d69a0dc48cd30e7ede28a490cb7558f131cbc4b0.source: Ranged Attack. If this attack hits, target foe takes 18…30 damage. If that foe has Cracked Armor, it begins Bleeding for 18…30 seconds.
d69a0dc48cd30e7ede28a490cb7558f131cbc4b0.text: 遠距 攻擊。如果此攻擊命中，目標敵人會受到 18…30 傷害。如果該敵人已破解 防禦，則會開始 流血，持續 18…30 秒。

3a192aa551fbe4cf3cfda844cd4a7a5587e4d44f.source: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Honor at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area strike for +8…15 damage and an additional +7…10 vs. Charr.
3a192aa551fbe4cf3cfda844cd4a7a5587e4d44f.text: 病房 咒文魔法。您在目前位置放置了 黑檀 榮譽戰旗。在 14…20 秒內，該區域內的非靈魂盟友會攻擊 +8…15 傷害並造成額外的 +7…10 對抗 夏爾 傷害。

87b9ee16daaeac0a010f4bf6ae3e52f7a2d6c512.source: Spell. Shadow Step to target other ally. You and that other ally are healed for 70…110 health.
87b9ee16daaeac0a010f4bf6ae3e52f7a2d6c512.text: 咒文魔法。 闇影 瞄準其他盟友。您和其他盟友的 70…110 健康狀況已治癒。

0a40750d18dff9ab798c4663263c3e4664cf1e74.source: Spell. Target foe is struck for 54…90 piercing damage and begins Bleeding for 5…25 seconds. This attack has a 10% chance of doing an additional +540…900 piercing damage. If this attack hits a Charr it has a 25% chance of doing an additional +540…900 piercing damage.
0a40750d18dff9ab798c4663263c3e4664cf1e74.text: 咒文魔法。 目標 敵人受到 54…90 穿刺傷害並開始 流血 持續 5…25 秒。此攻擊有 10% 機率造成額外的 +540…900 穿刺傷害。如果此攻擊擊中 夏爾，則有 25% 機率造成額外的 +540…900 穿刺傷害。

bbffc5269352d0c549e19461072aafed1250640d.source: Signet. For 14…20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes move and attack 23…40% slower.
bbffc5269352d0c549e19461072aafed1250640d.text: 紋章。在 14…20 秒內，目標敵人和所有相鄰敵人移動和攻擊 23…40% 的速度會變慢。

85f49948b8db3e0be73cdbed010a133a14cdebb7.source: Trap. When Weakness Trap is triggered, all nearby foes are Weakened for 10…20 seconds and take 24…50 lightning damage. All Charr are knocked down. Weakness Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.
85f49948b8db3e0be73cdbed010a133a14cdebb7.text: 陷阱。當觸發 虛弱 陷阱 時，附近所有敵人都會被削弱 10…20 秒，並受到 24…50 閃電傷害。所有 夏爾 均被擊倒。 虛弱 陷阱 在 90 秒後結束。啟動該技能時，你很容易被打斷。

54b890d2c357a7509c32333f36e3ee9d315a8bd1.source: Ebon Vanguard Ritual. Create a level 4…10 Spirit. All foes within its range have 15% chance to miss with ranged attacks. This spirit dies after 54…90 seconds.
54b890d2c357a7509c32333f36e3ee9d315a8bd1.text: 黑檀 儀式。創造一個等級 4…10 精神。其範圍內的所有敵人都有 15% 機會錯過遠端攻擊。該靈魂會在 54…90 秒後死亡。

0f136b9027b5a1f5e3cd685fc635526885d3917f.source: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Courage at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor and an additional +24 armor against Charr.
0f136b9027b5a1f5e3cd685fc635526885d3917f.text: 病房 咒文魔法。您在目前位置放置了一面 黑檀 勇氣戰旗。在 14…20 秒內，該區域的非靈魂盟友獲得 +24 護甲和額外的 +24 護甲來對抗 夏爾。

2118d3cdc5bcaf5ec2ef63dedad06279564661ea.source: Ward Spell. You plant an Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom at your current location. For 14…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 44…60% chance to halve skill recharge of spells they cast.
2118d3cdc5bcaf5ec2ef63dedad06279564661ea.text: 病房 咒文魔法。您在目前位置放置了 黑檀 智慧者 戰旗。在 14…20 秒內，該區域的非靈魂盟友有 44…60% 機會將他們施展的法術的技能回復減半。

771afda49804ae4f3ba9e2e3a7a1b29398ddb7de.source: Spell. Summon a level 14…20 Ebon Vanguard Assassin that has Iron Palm, Fox Fangs, and Nine Tail Strike. This summoned Assassin Shadow Steps to target foe. If that foe is a Charr, the Assassin lives for 24…30 seconds. If target foe is not a Charr, the Assassin lives for 12…15 seconds.
771afda49804ae4f3ba9e2e3a7a1b29398ddb7de.text: 咒文魔法。召喚一個包含 鐵掌、狐狸尖牙 和 九尾狙殺 的關卡 14…20 黑檀 暗殺者。這會召喚 暗殺者 闇影 步驟來瞄準敵人。如果該敵人是 夏爾，則 暗殺者 的存活時間為 24…30 秒。如果目標敵人不是 夏爾，則 暗殺者 的存活時間為 12…15 秒。

614f34587c588c93fc39fd32cfeda9e3d7b5055d.source: Signet. If target foe is Bleeding, that foe is Diseased for 13…20 seconds.
614f34587c588c93fc39fd32cfeda9e3d7b5055d.text: 紋章。如果目標敵人是 流血，則該敵人處於疾病狀態，持續 13…20 秒。

18a7eae07cc7692487336af82344184ada7c7f32.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, target foe is Blinded for 5…8 seconds. This attack counts as a lead attack.
18a7eae07cc7692487336af82344184ada7c7f32.text: 近身攻擊技能。如果此攻擊命中，目標敵人將被致盲 5…8 秒。這次攻擊算是主導攻擊。

59686aa5915c36ddc6dc0672f3de90aa28a1eff3.source: Hex Spell. Target touched foe takes 44…80 damage. If target foe was knocked down, that foe cannot attack for 5…8 seconds.
59686aa5915c36ddc6dc0672f3de90aa28a1eff3.text: 降咒魔法。 目標 接觸的敵人會受到 44…80 傷害。如果目標敵人被擊倒，則該敵人在 5…8 秒內無法攻擊。

00e74ad05a4b733b3c575e30156d46bb5867688f.source: Melee Attack. If this attack hits, it deals +6…9 damage for each adjacent foe (maximum 60 damage). If target foe is non-human it is knocked down.
00e74ad05a4b733b3c575e30156d46bb5867688f.text: 近身攻擊技能。如果此攻擊命中，則會對每個相鄰敵人造成 +6…9 傷害（最大 60 傷害）。如果目標敵人是非人類，它就會被擊倒。

ead1b5f12c66f05f0df33cb41fddbf9ae7f7bb76.source: Shout. For 16…20 seconds, your next attack cannot be blocked and does +14…20 damage.
ead1b5f12c66f05f0df33cb41fddbf9ae7f7bb76.text: 戰嚎。在 16…20 秒內，你的下一個攻擊無法被格擋並造成 +14…20 傷害。

10510cbdc025b2e4077eba6a2e1c2ce0923898dc.source: Shout. Your next 5…8 attacks do an additional +14…20 damage.
10510cbdc025b2e4077eba6a2e1c2ce0923898dc.text: 戰嚎。您的下一個 5…8 攻擊會造成額外的 +14…20 傷害。

bd2dd21cd5e63e9d496546c03858ad65f371456d.source: Shout. For 16…20 seconds, you have +24 armor and cannot be knocked down or Crippled.
bd2dd21cd5e63e9d496546c03858ad65f371456d.text: 戰嚎。在 16…20 秒內，你擁有 +24 護甲且無法被擊倒或 殘癈。

93cebe473555584f6d71f0b0167152d2e494a9a1.source: Shout. Target foe and foes adjacent to target are Weakened for 8…12 seconds.
93cebe473555584f6d71f0b0167152d2e494a9a1.text: 戰嚎。 目標 敵人和目標附近的敵人被削弱 8…12 秒。

beca406b511998357a3d598657a9219b07835992.source: Shout. Target foe is knocked down and takes 44…80 damage. That foe is also Crippled for 8…15 seconds.
beca406b511998357a3d598657a9219b07835992.text: 戰嚎。 目標 敵人被擊倒並受到 44…80 傷害。此敵人也是 殘癈 持續 8…15 秒。

4a5ab2dde39042aab32f7deb3e82ae1124457728.source: Elite Shout. For 3…13…15 seconds, all party members near you or near your pet deal +5…13…15 additional damage with attacks and gain +1…6…7 Health regeneration. PvE Skill
4a5ab2dde39042aab32f7deb3e82ae1124457728.text: 精英 戰嚎。在 3…13…15 秒內，您或寵物附近的所有隊伍成員都會透過攻擊造成 +5…13…15 額外傷害，並獲得 +1…6…7 體力再生 效果。 PvE 技能

c89e53c40e1eba5c47e8668b398bf1b6773c13be.source: Elite Ward Spell. You create a Time Ward at your location. For 6…17…20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area cast spells 15…19…20% faster and recharge skills 15…19…20% faster. PvE Skill
c89e53c40e1eba5c47e8668b398bf1b6773c13be.text: 精英 病房 咒文魔法。您在您所在的位置建立一個時間守衛。在 6…17…20 秒內，該區域內的非靈魂盟友可以更快地施放法術 15…19…20%，並更快地恢復技能 15…19…20%。 PvE 技能

f8d7c8efb2d41020f5db6e9b682985eee3e62662.source: Pei's Blades are non-max unique daggers dropped by Pei the Skull Blade, a boss who can be found in Panjiang Peninsula.
f8d7c8efb2d41020f5db6e9b682985eee3e62662.text: 沛之雙刃 是由骷髏刀佩 (Pei the Skull Blade) 所掉落的非最大獨特匕首，這是一個可以在 班讓半島 中找到的 Boss。

1ef0934ebf8b0572d64451f6b2fd473dd96cd07c.source: Tahkayun's Pincers are unique daggers dropped by Tahkayun Tsi, a boss who can be found in Kinya Province.
1ef0934ebf8b0572d64451f6b2fd473dd96cd07c.text: 高永之鉗 是由 Tahkayun Tsi 掉落的獨特匕首，Tahkayun Tsi 是 欣彌領地 中的 Boss。

ba8c45c3bb1dff04f769bb1dc8883c2d87cf810e.source: Auri's Wand is a unique wand dropped by Auri the Skull Wand, a boss who can be found in Kinya Province.
ba8c45c3bb1dff04f769bb1dc8883c2d87cf810e.text: 奧裡的魔杖 是由骷髏奧裡 手杖 掉落的獨特魔杖，手杖 是 欣彌領地 中的 Boss。

80bb0864ad21627b3eb73cc75d81d8921a196526.source: Sanhan's Staff is a unique staff dropped by Sanhan Tall Earth, a boss who can be found in Jaya Bluffs.
80bb0864ad21627b3eb73cc75d81d8921a196526.text: Sanhan 的 法杖 是由 Sanhan Tall Earth 掉落的獨特法杖，Sanhan Tall Earth 是一個可以在 蛇野斷崖 中找到的 Boss。

8a7f78f68edea3b1334efab95d35eb488404ac4c.source: Baozo's Wand is a unique wand dropped by Baozo Evilbranch, a boss who can be found in Haiju Lagoon.
8a7f78f68edea3b1334efab95d35eb488404ac4c.text: 包澤的魔杖 是一根獨特的魔杖，由 海幽潟湖 中的 Boss Baozo Evilbranch 掉落。

3a2f4016e1062e55af6ec12700479c63bc888f0e.source: Sulmeng's Staff is a unique staff dropped by Sulmeng the Skull Staff and Chae Plan, bosses who can be found in Kinya Province.
3a2f4016e1062e55af6ec12700479c63bc888f0e.text: 蘇門的法仗 是由骷髏蘇蒙 法杖 和 Chae Plan 掉落的獨特員工，這些老闆可以在 欣彌領地 中找到。

8dd664a9e4231026f473d36b627916f843b71a71.source: Feng's Focus is a unique focus item dropped by Feng the Skull Symbol, a boss who can be found in Panjiang Peninsula.
8dd664a9e4231026f473d36b627916f843b71a71.text: 芬的集中器 是由骷髏符號馮掉落的獨特焦點物品，骷髏符號馮是 班讓半島 中的 Boss。

fa3eef5c6d17d9dd5c269e1adc7048220cf1541c.source: Ziinjuu's Sanctuary is a unique staff dropped by Ziinjuu Life Crawler, a boss who can be found in Sunqua Vale.
fa3eef5c6d17d9dd5c269e1adc7048220cf1541c.text: 孜英銖的聖殿 是 Ziinjuu 生命 Crawler 掉落的獨特員工，Ziinjuu 生命 Crawler 是 桑泉谷 中的 Boss。

c83b4413269db31fedafd12c0235ba0fc04ef800.source: The Deathkeeper is a unique wand dropped by Yunlai Deathkeeper, a boss who can be found in Sunqua Vale.
c83b4413269db31fedafd12c0235ba0fc04ef800.text: 死亡守護者是由雲來死亡守護者掉落的獨特魔杖，雲來死亡守護者是 桑泉谷 中的 Boss。

9e81bfbfa00df07f3722d9198669464b4e3cf1e8.source: Yingko's Claw is a unique wand dropped by Yingko the Skull Claw, a boss found in Sunqua Vale.
9e81bfbfa00df07f3722d9198669464b4e3cf1e8.text: 影勾之爪 是一根獨特的魔杖，由 桑泉谷 中的 Boss 骷髏爪英科掉落。

b8c31390b5f02df0c28b352f126d641e68fa9f89.source: Ahvha's Longbow is a unique bow dropped by Ahvha Sankii, a boss who can be found in Jaya Bluffs.
b8c31390b5f02df0c28b352f126d641e68fa9f89.text: Ahvha 的 長弓 是由 Ahvha Sankii 掉落的獨特弓，Ahvha Sankii 是 蛇野斷崖 中的 Boss。

691c708fc2777263a7252aed8cf834fefe6f1844.source: Jin's Hornbow is a unique bow dropped by Jin the Skull Bow, a boss who can be found in Sunqua Vale.
691c708fc2777263a7252aed8cf834fefe6f1844.text: 貞之角弓 是由骷髏金 弓 掉落的獨特弓，弓 是 桑泉谷 中的 Boss。

7e5f4bead22f119ec515281a2a5386bbfb47d5d1.source: Miki's Staff is a unique staff dropped by Miki the Skull Spirit, a boss who can be found in Haiju Lagoon.
7e5f4bead22f119ec515281a2a5386bbfb47d5d1.text: Miki 的 法杖 是由骷髏精靈 Miki 掉落的獨特法杖，骷髏精靈是 海幽潟湖 中的 Boss。

f1eb055a5feee1375f8aa54e3c688dedc9f2782a.source: Tin Dao's Staff is a unique staff dropped by Tin Dao Kaineng, a boss who can be found in Haiju Lagoon.
f1eb055a5feee1375f8aa54e3c688dedc9f2782a.text: 丁道的法杖 是 Tin Dao Kaineng 掉落的獨特員工，Tin Dao Kaineng 是 海幽潟湖 中的 Boss。

f871ea2801cce213f0fa5d974b4b36d08c221f9c.source: Cho Wei's Axe is a unique axe dropped by Cho Wei the Skull Axe, a boss who can be found in Panjiang Peninsula. It is also dropped by Captain Quimang during the quest Quimang's Last Stand, and Pah Pei during the quest The Knights Who Say Nian (part of the Canthan New Year).
f871ea2801cce213f0fa5d974b4b36d08c221f9c.text: 周維的斧 是由骷髏 斧 曹偉掉落的獨特斧頭，斧 是 班讓半島 中的 Boss。它也由 Quimang 隊長在任務 Quimang 的背水一戰中掉落，以及 Pah Pei 在任務說年的騎士（Canthan 新年的一部分）期間掉落。

6a80d7f47fdb8d02f6f1604de4ba1c847448070b.source: Hanjuu's Bludgeoner is a unique hammer dropped by Hanjuu Towerfist, a boss who can be found in Jaya Bluffs.
6a80d7f47fdb8d02f6f1604de4ba1c847448070b.text: Hanjuu 的 巨頭鎚 是 Hanjuu Towerfist 掉落的獨特錘子，Hanjuu Towerfist 是 蛇野斷崖 中的 Boss。

034a673dcb312d3c423e153904c68b054d1a9d70.source: Urkal's Kamas are unique daggers dropped by Urkal the Ambusher and Maximole, bosses who can be found in Ferndale.
034a673dcb312d3c423e153904c68b054d1a9d70.text: 烏爾卡爾的卡馬斯是伏擊者烏爾卡爾和馬克西莫爾掉落的獨特匕首，這兩個 Boss 可以在 蕨谷 中找到。

6ab3aa4efe87ea0cbda128e1db3bcfd2b72bddc6.source: Shreader's Talons are unique daggers dropped by Shreader Sharptongue, a boss who can be found in Xaquang Skyway.
6ab3aa4efe87ea0cbda128e1db3bcfd2b72bddc6.text: 利舌的魔爪 是由撕碎者尖舌掉落的獨特匕首，這是一個可以在 夏安便道 中找到的 Boss。

a5687bbdb3afd8463078b7b0a297c2eb287803ec.source: Ungues of the Oni are unique daggers dropped by Oni found in Rhea's Crater.

d11bde999de444ef8a11a2d0ee570ccb3446e477.source: Arneh's Fury is a unique shield dropped by Arneh the Vigorous, a boss who can be found in Joko's Domain.
d11bde999de444ef8a11a2d0ee570ccb3446e477.text: 阿納之怒是由活力阿納掉落的獨特盾牌，阿納是一個可以在 傑格領地 中找到的 Boss。

5e20a1ebc6a274f806a215958ea8233e1fadbabd.source: Churkeh's Defiance is a unique shield dropped by Churkeh the Defiant, a boss who can be found in The Alkali Pan.

cf740cf52b1ff480a85a087a8fc40cbc38f2dd5f.source: Tureksin's Spear is a unique spear dropped by Tureksin the Delegator, a boss who can be found in The Ruptured Heart.

b4737f43cec4e82c2ab2d96376bd6542176775a1.source: Stygian Spear is a unique spear dropped by the mesmer Stygian Lord, monk Stygian Lord and necromancer Stygian Lord who can be found in Stygian Veil. It is currently unknown if any other Stygian Lords also drop this weapon.
b4737f43cec4e82c2ab2d96376bd6542176775a1.text: 斯泰吉亞 矛 是一把獨特的長矛，由催眠師斯泰吉亞領主、僧侶斯泰吉亞領主和死靈法師斯泰吉亞領主掉落，可以在斯泰吉亞面紗中找到。目前尚不清楚其他冥河領主是否也掉落了這把武器。

15c36b3e439739390032d8f538a52a95c7793d45.source: The Stygian Aegis is a unique shield dropped by both the mesmer Stygian Lord and the necromancer Stygian Lord, who can be found in Stygian Veil.
15c36b3e439739390032d8f538a52a95c7793d45.text: 斯泰吉亞 神賜之盾 是由催眠師斯泰吉亞領主和死靈法師斯泰吉亞領主掉落的獨特盾牌，可以在斯泰吉亞面紗中找到。

ec699de9a888ac9552b1e0aa9b52f830be61ead7.source: Nihil's Daggers are unique daggers dropped by a Fury Titan in The Foundry of Failed Creations, a subsection of the Domain of Anguish.
ec699de9a888ac9552b1e0aa9b52f830be61ead7.text: Nihil 的 匕首 是由失敗創造鑄造廠（悲難之門 的一部分）中的憤怒 泰坦 掉落的獨特匕首。

35a047ec0e952fcdf35e13fe76d967435618bf81.source: Menzes' Influence is a unique wand dropped by Curses of Darkness, foes who can be found in Ravenheart Gloom or Stygian Veil.
35a047ec0e952fcdf35e13fe76d967435618bf81.text: 門澤斯的影響力是一根獨特的魔杖，由黑暗的 詛咒 掉落，這些敵人可以在鴉心幽暗或冥河面紗中找到。

eb2171e57234e1847d4f530cdb44649277102bbb.source: Menzes' Ambition is a unique wand dropped by Chill of Darknesses, foes who can be found in Ravenheart Gloom or Stygian Veil.
eb2171e57234e1847d4f530cdb44649277102bbb.text: 門澤斯的野心是一根獨特的魔杖，由黑暗之寒掉落，這些敵人可以在鴉心幽暗或冥河面紗中找到。

c89bd49fbfa5cba31b5b30e1c276b60aeddacbd3.source: Aegis of Aaaaarrrrrrggghhh is a unique shield dropped by The Black Beast of Arrgh, a boss-like foe who can be found in the Domain of Anguish.
c89bd49fbfa5cba31b5b30e1c276b60aeddacbd3.text: Aaaaarrrrrggghhh 的 神賜之盾 是 黑色野獸 阿爾古 掉落的獨特護盾，黑色野獸 阿爾古 是一個可以在 悲難之門 中找到的類似 Boss 的敵人。

50b9ae6e29043c5348320e25e77e7ecf12fb53e3.source: The Inspired Ghostly Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Fury and Guardians of Komalie, foes in The Foundry of Failed Creations.
50b9ae6e29043c5348320e25e77e7ecf12fb53e3.text: 靈感幽靈 法杖 是一把獨特的法杖，由失敗造物鑄造廠中的敵人「科瑪利亞之怒」和「守護者」掉落。

f2996abda5cef94451d3dfe2a86e126a34ef1430.source: The Everlasting Ghostly Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Fury and both Guardians of Komalie, foes who can be found in The Foundry of Failed Creations.
f2996abda5cef94451d3dfe2a86e126a34ef1430.text: 永恆的幽靈 法杖 是由狂怒者和科瑪利亞守護者掉落的獨特法杖，這兩個敵人可以在失敗造物的鑄造廠中找到。

96ab52d20f6887936a4bd111f4103fa2a192a601.source: Divine Ghostly Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Fury and Guardians of Komalie, foes in The Foundry of Failed Creations.
96ab52d20f6887936a4bd111f4103fa2a192a601.text: 神聖幽靈 法杖 是一把獨特的法杖，由失敗造物鑄造廠中的敵人科瑪麗之怒和守護者掉落。

3143fa3c24532a2df1ac2bc5b21da33a9f6bdd3f.source: Grim Ghostly Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Fury and Guardians of Komalie, foes in The Foundry of Failed Creations.

b6d131deedaf265cb1b869bc83a1cd0fdb8b4e85.source: The Ritualistic Ghostly Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Fury and both versions of the Guardians of Komalie, foes in The Foundry of Failed Creations.
b6d131deedaf265cb1b869bc83a1cd0fdb8b4e85.text: 儀式幽靈 法杖 是一把獨特的法杖，由狂怒者和兩個版本的科瑪利守護者掉落，它們是失敗創造鑄造廠中的敵人。

fec6372d2303f334c2c59eb233c420a92a687ac7.text: 馬裡克斯的衝突是從城堡 寶箱 獲得的獨特長矛，在馬裡克斯烏木城堡中擊敗不屈的馬裡克斯後生成。

68edcf46e4f354c7584a0d6d6490cf00a711db8f.source: Mallyx's Supremacy is a unique item shield obtained from the Citadel Chest, which spawns after Mallyx the Unyielding is defeated in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.
68edcf46e4f354c7584a0d6d6490cf00a711db8f.text: 馬裡克斯的至高無上是從 Citadel 寶箱 獲得的獨特物品護盾，在馬裡克斯烏木城堡中擊敗不屈的馬裡克斯後生成。

34543686578e001a755821a32d9f1a2215f5e44e.source: Mallyx's Whim is a unique wand obtained from the Citadel Chest, which spawns after Mallyx the Unyielding is defeated in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.
34543686578e001a755821a32d9f1a2215f5e44e.text: 馬裡克斯的突發奇想是從 Citadel 寶箱 獲得的獨特魔杖，在馬裡克斯烏木城堡中擊敗不屈的馬裡克斯後生成。

96d8d6d20b6dbe9e2b70efc329f56fb1fb8bb910.source: Mallyx's Zeal are unique daggers obtained from the Citadel chest that spawns after defeating Mallyx the Unyielding, a boss who can be found in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.
96d8d6d20b6dbe9e2b70efc329f56fb1fb8bb910.text: 馬裡克斯的熱忱是從擊敗不屈的馬裡克斯後生成的城堡寶箱中獲得的獨特匕首，這是一個可以在馬裡克斯烏木城堡中找到的 Boss。

880079d1dc5347a90598cff38c13c858e68a40f7.source: Yammirvu's Scepter is a unique wand dropped by Yammirvu, Ether Guardian, a boss who can be found in The Hidden City of Ahdashim.
880079d1dc5347a90598cff38c13c858e68a40f7.text: Yammirvu 的權杖是由 Yammirvu，Ether 守護者 掉落的獨特魔杖，這是一個可以在 Ahdashim 的隱藏 城市 中找到的 Boss。

fceae50b80978d4a138621c970d45f61c1d73e8e.source: Haioss' Blessing is a unique Scythe dropped by Haioss, Blessed Wind, a boss who can be found in Fahranur, The First City.
fceae50b80978d4a138621c970d45f61c1d73e8e.text: Haioss 的 祝福 是 Haioss、祝福之風掉落的獨特 鐮刀，這是一個可以在 舊城 法蘭努爾 中找到的 Boss。

aa0c4a3c29802a21be7927a27bf5d21bb504051f.source: Aegis of Terror is a unique shield dropped by Flesh Tormentors during Deathbringer Company, and also by The Greater Darkness, which are boss-like foes who can be found in Ravenheart Gloom.
aa0c4a3c29802a21be7927a27bf5d21bb504051f.text: 恐怖的 神賜之盾 是死亡使者連隊期間血肉折磨者以及 巨大暗影 掉落的獨特護盾，巨大暗影 是可以在鴉心幽暗中找到的類似 Boss 的敵人。

d17f82efaa3c9ce67083738e4e56fe76b754f709.source: The Divine Shadow Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Greater Darkness, a boss in Ravenheart Gloom.
d17f82efaa3c9ce67083738e4e56fe76b754f709.text: 神聖 闇影 法杖 是鴉心幽暗中的 Boss 巨大暗影 掉落的獨特法杖。

6eb9c1a8abec08f9ffc7d86ae12ac82119e82695.source: The Everlasting Shadow Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Greater Darkness, a boss in Ravenheart Gloom.
6eb9c1a8abec08f9ffc7d86ae12ac82119e82695.text: 永恆的 闇影 法杖 是鴉心幽暗中的 Boss 巨大暗影 掉落的獨特法杖。

7edd089345183927270b2f571da0d8a91c88eb0c.source: Grim Shadow Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Greater Darkness, a foe who can be found in Ravenheart Gloom.
7edd089345183927270b2f571da0d8a91c88eb0c.text: Grim 闇影 法杖 是由 巨大暗影 掉落的獨特法杖，巨大暗影 是可以在鴉心幽暗中找到的敵人。

d7c62a23ef6b56161e810799aa9bda0fdefc8483.source: The Inspired Shadow Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Greater Darkness, a boss in Ravenheart Gloom.
d7c62a23ef6b56161e810799aa9bda0fdefc8483.text: 靈感 闇影 法杖 是鴉心憂鬱中的 Boss 巨大暗影 掉落的獨特法杖。

c02f494cb3d9bea11daee7f7f0e4c7019995fe33.source: The Ritualistic Shadow Staff is a unique staff dropped by The Greater Darkness, a boss in Ravenheart Gloom.
c02f494cb3d9bea11daee7f7f0e4c7019995fe33.text: 儀式 闇影 法杖 是鴉心幽暗中的 Boss 巨大暗影 掉落的獨特法杖。

5d486b18f967d1f2e855f779681a44005b931513.source: Stygian Recurve Bow is a unique bow dropped by the Stygian Underlord (ranger), a boss that can be found in the Stygian Veil.
5d486b18f967d1f2e855f779681a44005b931513.text: 斯泰吉亞 反曲弓 是斯泰吉亞霸主（遊俠）掉落的獨特弓，這是一個可以在斯泰吉亞面紗中找到的 Boss。

5ff7fd705b3992d7f1ce18fff6bde3d16c55627c.source: Stygian Scythe is a unique scythe dropped by dervish Stygian Underlord, a foe who can be found in Stygian Veil.
5ff7fd705b3992d7f1ce18fff6bde3d16c55627c.text: Stygian 鐮刀 是一把獨特的鐮刀，由苦行僧 Stygian Underlord 掉落，Stygian Underlord 是一個可以在 Stygian Veil 中找到的敵人。

bce606e2c166b153d9cb8c09570df478c5def06c.source: Scythe of Corruption is a unique scythe dropped by Earth Tormentors, foes who can be found in Ravenheart Gloom.
bce606e2c166b153d9cb8c09570df478c5def06c.text: 鐮刀 of Corruption 是一把由大地折磨者掉落的獨特鐮刀，這些敵人可以在鴉心幽暗中找到。

5e2d446417e4a9591daa09f3f28a438d786aff4b.source: Turep's Spear is a unique spear dropped by Turep, Maker of Orphans, a boss who can be found in City of Torc'qua.
5e2d446417e4a9591daa09f3f28a438d786aff4b.text: 圖雷普的 矛 是一把獨特的長矛，由孤兒製造者圖雷普掉落，他是托克誇的 城市 中的 Boss。

38e6dc8764856c672f16ba4d51fab3841de18a05.source: Shaunur's Scepter is a unique wand dropped by Shaunur the Divine, a boss in The City of Torc'qua.
38e6dc8764856c672f16ba4d51fab3841de18a05.text: 肖努爾的權杖是托克誇 城市 中的 Boss 神聖肖努爾掉落的獨特魔杖。

2879c1356b6c8e1fb86d1871ced603b2bacbf5ec.source: The Bloodspear is a unique spear dropped by Lord Jadoth, a boss who can be found in the City of Torc'qua.
2879c1356b6c8e1fb86d1871ced603b2bacbf5ec.text: 血矛是由 霸王 賈多司 掉落的獨特矛，霸王 賈多司 是托克誇的 城市 中的 Boss。

cc870423bc1be3b87ba18ed3b326f50b4cec8556.source: Stygian Scepter is a unique wand dropped by Smothering Tendrils, foes in Stygian Veil.
cc870423bc1be3b87ba18ed3b326f50b4cec8556.text: 斯泰吉亞權杖是一根獨特的魔杖，由斯泰吉亞面紗中的敵人窒息卷鬚掉落。

c09564554c9dc08b37313f26b47d65e1c736309d.source: Stygian Daggers are unique daggers dropped by Smothering Tendrils, a foe who can be found in Stygian Veil.
c09564554c9dc08b37313f26b47d65e1c736309d.text: 斯泰吉亞 匕首 是由窒息卷鬚掉落的獨特匕首，窒息卷鬚是可以在斯泰吉亞面紗中找到的敵人。

6101aebdc432a26764691eb8ac2e7cadf1b36eed.source: Stygian Wand is a unique wand dropped by Smothering Tendrils, a boss in Stygian Veil.
6101aebdc432a26764691eb8ac2e7cadf1b36eed.text: 斯泰吉亞 手杖 是一根獨特的魔杖，由斯泰吉亞面紗中的 Boss 窒息卷鬚掉落。

f3e64dcf072df8c68fba0456e46ada473c45642f.source: The Stygian Defender is a unique shield dropped by both the monk Stygian Lord and the elementalist Stygian Lord, who can be found in Stygian Veil. It is currently not known if it can be dropped by the other two types of Stygian Lords.
f3e64dcf072df8c68fba0456e46ada473c45642f.text: 斯泰吉亞 守護者之盾 是由僧侶斯泰吉亞領主和元素師斯泰吉亞領主掉落的獨特盾牌，可以在斯泰吉亞面紗中找到。目前尚不清楚其他兩種型別的斯泰吉亞領主是否會掉落。

76a8ad7cc93a7a580bb84e30dc0f13d198dc4da5.source: Leilon's Vow is a unique scythe dropped by Leilon, Tranquil Water, a boss who can be found in The Hidden City of Ahdashim.
76a8ad7cc93a7a580bb84e30dc0f13d198dc4da5.text: 雷隆的誓言是一把獨特的鐮刀，由寧靜之水雷隆掉落，雷隆是一個可以在阿達希姆的隱藏 城市 中找到的 Boss。

91e171477a5ba0db406cbb6370adcc509bad9260.source: Mallyx's Edge is a unique sword obtained from the Citadel Chest, which spawns after defeating Mallyx the Unyielding in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.

bc03d398ccca83be869d9345b87a4cc831195834.source: Mallyx's Divinity is a unique focus item obtained from the Citadel Chest that spawns after Mallyx the Unyielding is defeated in the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.
bc03d398ccca83be869d9345b87a4cc831195834.text: 馬裡克斯的神性是從馬裡克斯烏木城堡中擊敗不屈者馬裡克斯後生成的城堡 寶箱 中獲得的獨特焦點物品。

5852cd5641de3ee7542f056125c849e5c6558a02.source: Mallyx's Defense is a unique shield obtained from the Citadel Chest that spawns after defeating Mallyx the Unyielding in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.

c284b654274db6f6a3a845f57076ad3110fb0b7b.text: 馬裡克斯的殘酷是從 Citadel 寶箱 獲得的獨特長矛，在馬裡克斯烏木城堡中擊敗不屈的馬裡克斯後生成。

2b3f6c7310d4287cf9d210476e7f639917851b66.source: Mallyx's Creation is a unique focus item obtained from the Citadel Chest which spawns after Mallyx the Unyielding is defeated in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.
2b3f6c7310d4287cf9d210476e7f639917851b66.text: 馬萊克斯的創造 是從 Citadel 寶箱 獲得的獨特焦點物品，寶箱 在 Mallyx the Unyielding 被擊敗後在 Mallyx 的 Ebony Citadel 中被擊敗後生成。

a511f7344cd640296b2d74cf0b84b40d05f45304.source: Mallyx's Courage is a unique shield obtained from the Citadel Chest, which spawns after defeating Mallyx the Unyielding in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.

e87f5a9370b909eaff768fd16a4699ddc8a3cba3.source: Mallyx's Endurance is a unique wand obtained from the Citadel Chest, which spawns after Mallyx the Unyielding is defeated in The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.

404ce390a890c474fa99192dcc3175e7ee0e891a.text: 馬裡克斯的仇恨是一把獨特的鐮刀，可從城堡寶箱中獲得，擊敗不屈的馬裡克斯後生成，後者是馬裡克斯烏木城堡中的首領。

f560374e9564284742d96b51db6a0cd8312ba1ae.text: 馬萊克斯的反曲弓 是從 Citadel 寶箱 獲得的獨特弓，它在擊敗不屈的馬裡克斯後生成，這是一個可以在馬裡克斯烏木城堡中找到的 Boss。

ca5a90f11bfc87196ff4ee9d093dc8f6846af08a.source: The Axe of the Kinslayer is a unique axe obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which spawns after defeating Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
ca5a90f11bfc87196ff4ee9d093dc8f6846af08a.text: Kinslayer 的 斧 是從 Burrows 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特斧頭，它在 凍霜地道 中擊敗 凍擊 弒族者 後生成。

9d101dd5bcf1747985184d2f436c66b1c91fe8e2.source: The Sword of the Kinslayer is a unique sword obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which spawns after slaying Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
9d101dd5bcf1747985184d2f436c66b1c91fe8e2.text: 親族殺手的 劍 是一把從布羅斯的 寶箱 獲得的獨特劍，它在 凍霜地道 中殺死 凍擊 弒族者 後生成。

e99c6fa1491175ef79738ab423abf856c0b7f021.source: Maul of the Kinslayer is a unique hammer obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which spawns after deafeating Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
e99c6fa1491175ef79738ab423abf856c0b7f021.text: 弒親者之槌是從布羅斯的 寶箱 獲得的獨特錘子，它在 凍霜地道 中擊倒 凍擊 弒族者 後生成。

d606547756685be19eb180a1f00d7d083b1a962c.source: Shield of the Kinslayer is a unique shield obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which spawns after defeating Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows
d606547756685be19eb180a1f00d7d083b1a962c.text: Kinslayer 的 盾 是從 Burrows 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特盾牌，它在 凍霜地道 中擊敗 凍擊 弒族者 後生成

07a128a6aeec4db289a4252b730ebe5664c4a3b4.source: Bow of the Kinslayer is a unique recurve bow obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which appears after killing Frostmaw the Kinslayer, a boss who can be found in Frostmaw's Burrows.
07a128a6aeec4db289a4252b730ebe5664c4a3b4.text: 親族殺手的 弓 是從布羅斯的 寶箱 獲得的獨特反曲弓，它在殺死 凍擊 弒族者（可在 凍霜地道 中找到的 Boss）後出現。

52f7828f1e92fef9e7e0beeba4a1a8299a9456fa.source: Scepter of the Kinslayer is a unique wand obtained from the Chest of Burrows after killing Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
52f7828f1e92fef9e7e0beeba4a1a8299a9456fa.text: 親族殺手權杖是在 凍霜地道 中殺死 凍擊 弒族者 後從布羅斯的 寶箱 取得的獨特魔杖。

1bf1acf52f791c2296ccb154ec2fa2744e2c995c.source: Heart of the Kinslayer is a unique focus item obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which appears after defeating Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
1bf1acf52f791c2296ccb154ec2fa2744e2c995c.text: 親族殺手之心是從布羅斯的 寶箱 獲得的獨特焦點物品，在 凍霜地道 中擊敗 凍擊 弒族者 後出現。

437843b747a7bd89b02aeef2e9284322c16350c6.source: Staff of the Kinslayer is a unique staff obtained from the Chest of Burrows after defeating Frostmaw the Kinslayer in the Frostmaw's Burrows.
437843b747a7bd89b02aeef2e9284322c16350c6.text: 親族殺手的 法杖 是在 凍霜地道 中擊敗 凍擊 弒族者 後從布羅斯的 寶箱 取得的獨特法杖。

a295ddb593f4bc4d663b8e0550d7db0e4a19746d.source: Claws of the Kinslayer is a unique dagger found in the Chest of Burrows after killing Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
a295ddb593f4bc4d663b8e0550d7db0e4a19746d.text: 弒親者之爪是在 凍霜地道 中殺死 凍擊 弒族者 後在布羅斯的 寶箱 中發現的獨特匕首。

7d991e402e5c58e29a1f78047232db1ae7b23623.source: Spear of the Kinslayer is a unique spear obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which appears after killing Frostmaw the Kinslayer, a boss in Frostmaw's Burrows.
7d991e402e5c58e29a1f78047232db1ae7b23623.text: 親族殺手的 矛 是從布羅斯的 寶箱 獲得的獨特長矛，在殺死 凍霜地道 中的 Boss 凍擊 弒族者 後出現。

dea44ed654f633ec76676d58a91a0bf8e5ed863b.source: Scythe of the Kinslayer is a unique scythe obtained from the Chest of Burrows, which appears after killing Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
dea44ed654f633ec76676d58a91a0bf8e5ed863b.text: 親族殺手的 鐮刀 是從布羅斯的 寶箱 獲得的獨特鐮刀，在 凍霜地道 中殺死 凍擊 弒族者 後出現。

64f1ed0a5520b4c296a1c38bd50128c24a772c23.source: The Aegis of the Condemned is a unique shield obtained from Vraxx the Condemned, a boss who spawns on the second level of Cathedral of Flames.
64f1ed0a5520b4c296a1c38bd50128c24a772c23.text: 被譴責者的 神賜之盾 是從被譴責者 Vraxx 處獲得的獨特護盾，Vraxx 是在 火焰大教堂 第二層產生的 Boss。

81c472697e161b1bc82213d95737ccaff5582dad.source: The Notched Blade is a sword that ends in two points.
81c472697e161b1bc82213d95737ccaff5582dad.text: 缺口刀片是一把末端有兩點的劍。

1b012d9b59459e0dcc19902fc3d57592616d7b53.source: This piece drops as a reward from the Chest of Burrows and Murakai's Chest.
1b012d9b59459e0dcc19902fc3d57592616d7b53.text: 作品作為 Burrows 的 寶箱 和 Murakai 的 寶箱 的獎勵掉落。

edfb1cdf87ebb68ddced98991d4d473d32504fe3.source: This piece drops as a reward from Murakai's Chest, Hidesplitter's Chest and Chest of Kathandrax.
edfb1cdf87ebb68ddced98991d4d473d32504fe3.text: 作品作為 Kathandrax 的 Murakai 的 寶箱、Hidesplitter 的 寶箱 和 寶箱 的獎勵掉落。

87f76a1a4fcbe89a434ff51f2c739aed851eb973.source: Murakai's Blade is a unique sword obtained from Murakai's Chest, which spawns after defeating Murakai, Lady of the Night in Cathedral of Flames.
87f76a1a4fcbe89a434ff51f2c739aed851eb973.text: 村井之刃是從村井的 寶箱 中獲得的一把獨特的劍，它在 火焰大教堂 中擊敗 夜之女 幕蘭凱 後生成。

18348754b0947b6313d2be282e06f747649472ce.source: Murakai's Maul is a unique hammer obtained from Murakai's Chest, which spawns after defeating Murakai, Lady of the Night in Cathedral of Flames.
18348754b0947b6313d2be282e06f747649472ce.text: 村井之槌是從村井的 寶箱 中獲得的獨特錘子，它在 火焰大教堂 中擊敗 夜之女 幕蘭凱 後生成。

16ad411417ad54c2ecd5f18f594e72d575236224.source: Murakai's Reaver is a unique axe obtained from Murakai's Chest, which spawns after defeating Murakai, Lady of the Night in the Cathedral of Flames.
16ad411417ad54c2ecd5f18f594e72d575236224.text: 村井的掠奪者是從村井的 寶箱 中獲得的獨特斧頭，它在 火焰大教堂 中擊敗 夜之女 幕蘭凱 後生成。

6e78f6daed9508259b178852d7f29aced41f790f.source: The Scepter of the Keeper is a unique wand dropped by The Keeper, a boss in Cathedral of Flames.
6e78f6daed9508259b178852d7f29aced41f790f.text: 守護者權杖是 火焰大教堂 中的 Boss 守護者掉落的獨特魔杖。

172cd374a220831833bbe7176e2f787acc48c320.source: Focus of the Master is a unique focus item dropped by The Master, a boss who can be found in Cathedral of Flames.
172cd374a220831833bbe7176e2f787acc48c320.text: 大師的 聚能器 是大師掉落的獨特焦點物品，大師是可以在 火焰大教堂 中找到的 Boss。

b55fd50bddb4aa73472e1c16782fcb7c474bb6aa.source: The Magekiller is a unique Staff dropped by Faze Magekiller, a boss who can be found in the first level of the Cathedral of Flames.
b55fd50bddb4aa73472e1c16782fcb7c474bb6aa.text: Magekiller 是 Faze Magekiller 掉落的獨特 法杖，Faze Magekiller 是 火焰大教堂 第一層中的 Boss。

e0e8aaeca01455485804f3237adb10fdfb02d540.source: Crystal Core Maul is a unique hammer dropped by the Malfunctioning Shield Golem in Oola's Lab.
e0e8aaeca01455485804f3237adb10fdfb02d540.text: 水晶 核心 Maul 是 Oola 實驗室中故障的 盾 布偶掉落的獨特鐵鎚。

07ef1f00b583118fb62d11d8cec7c23ab66df272.source: The Destructive Blade is a unique sword obtained from the Destroyer Chest, which spawns after defeating the Plague of Destruction in Raven's Point.
07ef1f00b583118fb62d11d8cec7c23ab66df272.text: 毀滅之刃是一把從毀滅者 寶箱 獲得的獨特劍，它在 渡鴉岬角 中擊敗 疫之破壞者 後生成。

8ea41122fec30239c5c17123abdf605a42fdbc01.source: The Destructive Shield is a unique shield obtained from the Destroyer Chest, which spawns after defeating the Plague of Destruction in Raven's Point.
8ea41122fec30239c5c17123abdf605a42fdbc01.text: 破壞性 盾 是從毀滅者 寶箱 獲得的獨特護盾，它在 渡鴉岬角 中擊敗 疫之破壞者 後生成。

50d1ecd79078071851d9642fedf48e6c2bde1ca4.source: The Destructive Focus is a unique focus item obtained from the Destroyer Chest that appears after killing Plague of Destruction in Raven's Point.
50d1ecd79078071851d9642fedf48e6c2bde1ca4.text: 破壞性 聚能器 是從 渡鴉岬角 中殺死 疫之破壞者 後出現的毀滅者 寶箱 獲得的獨特焦點物品。

078b0234dcd1ece24edcafe975ad2c9acbae2f08.source: Droknar's Hornbow is a unique bow obtained from the Ranger's Chest at the Epilogue.
078b0234dcd1ece24edcafe975ad2c9acbae2f08.text: 卓克納爾的角弓是從尾聲的 遊俠 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特弓。

2c2f02960c9053ca377f4207c987f9ba7a262c2b.source: Droknar's Longbow is a unique bow obtained from the Ranger's Chest in the Epilogue.
2c2f02960c9053ca377f4207c987f9ba7a262c2b.text: 卓克納爾的 長弓 是從尾聲中的 遊俠 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特弓。

e9f0884b1f29906f0beeacf9ad0fc633226a791f.source: Droknar's Recurve Bow is a unique bow obtained from the Ranger's Chest in the Epilogue.
e9f0884b1f29906f0beeacf9ad0fc633226a791f.text: 卓克納爾的 反曲弓 是從尾聲中的 遊俠 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特弓。

96314b5f6d3036f452403d01c4c0acdcdf994ca5.source: Droknar's Shortbow is a unique bow obtained from the Ranger's Chest in the Epilogue.
96314b5f6d3036f452403d01c4c0acdcdf994ca5.text: 卓克納爾的短弓是從尾聲中的 遊俠 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特弓。

2f3772ac739d9947f5221d2821845eeafe1e0fa7.source: Droknar's Focus is a unique focus obtained from the Elementalist's Chest, Necromancer's Chest, Ritualist's Chest, Monk's Chest or Mesmer's Chest in the Epilogue.
2f3772ac739d9947f5221d2821845eeafe1e0fa7.text: Droknar的聚能器是從尾聲中的元素使的寶箱、死靈法師的寶箱、祭祀者的寶箱、僧侶的寶箱或幻術師的寶箱獲得的獨特焦點。

678cbe0cecef2172bf538d6927c7437cb99c5d82.source: Droknar's Scepter is a unique wand obtained from the Elementalist's Chest, Necromancer's Chest, Ritualist's Chest, Monk's Chest or Mesmer's Chest in the Epilogue. Droknar's Key is needed to open the chest.
678cbe0cecef2172bf538d6927c7437cb99c5d82.text: 卓克納爾的權杖是從尾聲的元素使的寶箱、死靈法師的寶箱、祭祀者的寶箱、僧侶的寶箱或幻術師的寶箱END獲得的獨特魔杖。開啟寶箱需要卓克納爾的 鑰匙。

62ba017c1fff71eaa97ef2d539ce4c2f23fe8cbf.source: Droknar's Staff is a unique staff obtained from the Elementalist's Chest, Necromancer's Chest, Ritualist's Chest, Monk's Chest or Mesmer's Chest in the Epilogue.
62ba017c1fff71eaa97ef2d539ce4c2f23fe8cbf.text: Droknar的法杖是從尾聲中的元素使的寶箱、死靈法師的寶箱、祭祀者的寶箱、僧侶的寶箱或幻術師的寶箱獲得的獨特光譜表。

e88983d879eb4c9bca807ca0241758a8cf6ca269.source: Droknar's Blades are unique daggers obtained from the Assassin's Chest at the Epilogue.
e88983d879eb4c9bca807ca0241758a8cf6ca269.text: 卓克納爾之刃是從尾聲中的 暗殺者 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特匕首。

af2891f17db51b2df649a0d558809d1950e573bc.source: Droknar's Daggers are unique daggers obtained from the Assassin's Chest at the Epilogue.
af2891f17db51b2df649a0d558809d1950e573bc.text: Droknar 的 匕首 是從尾聲中的 暗殺者 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特匕首。

4c09abeff64cd6c4140d8659cf8a68a420330206.source: Droknar's Knives are unique daggers obtained from the Assassin's Chest at the Epilogue.
4c09abeff64cd6c4140d8659cf8a68a420330206.text: 卓克納爾的刀是從尾聲的 暗殺者 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特匕首。

e83d962d33d22b214229bf1d364ac20b941d4e08.source: Droknar's Courage is a unique spear obtained from the Paragon's Chest during the Epilogue.
e83d962d33d22b214229bf1d364ac20b941d4e08.text: 卓克納爾的勇氣是在尾聲中從 聖言者 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特長矛。

8f18492f7425c4453d8d72bbdb4f081115cbebae.source: Droknar's Spear is a unique spear obtained from the Paragon's Chest in the Epilogue.
8f18492f7425c4453d8d72bbdb4f081115cbebae.text: 卓克納爾的 矛 是從尾聲中的 聖言者 的 寶箱 取得的獨特矛。

55448894d34d7ebbc27b1c0e0ce5a7836a92d7b4.source: Droknar's Strength is a unique spear obtained from the Paragon's Chest in the Epilogue.
55448894d34d7ebbc27b1c0e0ce5a7836a92d7b4.text: 卓克納爾的 力量 是從尾聲中的 聖言者 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特矛。

0119aae375cd6e8bc3dfbdca4e2d2daf0a685d9a.source: Droknar's Edge is a unique scythe obtained from the Dervish's Chest in the Epilogue.
0119aae375cd6e8bc3dfbdca4e2d2daf0a685d9a.text: 卓克納爾之刃是從尾聲的 神喚使 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特鐮刀。

4cb8be3acd55ff5d86e43b982b4bbb8cfc242a42.source: Droknar's Reaper is a unique scythe obtained from the Dervish's Chest in the Epilogue.
4cb8be3acd55ff5d86e43b982b4bbb8cfc242a42.text: 卓克納爾的收割者是從尾聲的 神喚使 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特鐮刀。

d36545ad6a86b98053694b0d223feef745e9aa05.source: Droknar's Scythe is a unique scythe obtained from the Dervish's Chest in the Epilogue.
d36545ad6a86b98053694b0d223feef745e9aa05.text: 卓克納爾的 鐮刀 是從尾聲中的 神喚使 的 寶箱 獲得的獨特鐮刀。

a44aa8bd4d7bf877548d10e03b4fdee03c349330.source: Chaelse's Staff is a unique staff dropped by Chaelse Flameshielder, a boss in Grothmar Wardowns.
a44aa8bd4d7bf877548d10e03b4fdee03c349330.text: Chaelse 的 法杖 是由 Chaelse Flameshielder（Grothmar Wardowns 中的 Boss）掉落的獨特法杖。

c4b99309775a3d57d6c11f652c8f87d9adb2cc4f.source: Iceblood's Warstaff is a unique staff dropped by Spafrod Iceblood, a boss who can be found in Sacnoth Valley.
c4b99309775a3d57d6c11f652c8f87d9adb2cc4f.text: Iceblood 的戰杖是由 Spafrod Iceblood 掉落的獨特法杖，後者是 聖諾谷 中的 Boss。

db067a85b211c4b7773ee382066f842d230e9258.source: The Axe of the Hierophant is a unique axe obtained from the Hierophant's Chest, which spawns after defeating Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
db067a85b211c4b7773ee382066f842d230e9258.text: 聖職的 斧 是從聖職的 寶箱 中獲得的獨特斧頭，它在 奴隸商人放逐地 中擊敗 黑色 唐肯 後生成。

9b8abd41985ccc506704813783c0822029720156.source: Blade of the Hierophant is a unique sword obtained from the Hierophant's Chest, which spawns after defeating Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
9b8abd41985ccc506704813783c0822029720156.text: 聖職之刃是一把從聖職人員的 寶箱 中獲得的獨特劍，它在 奴隸商人放逐地 中擊敗 黑色 唐肯 後生成。

df52189c9a3e483b51ebf5cb5876d9dc3df65ffc.source: Shield of the Hierophant is a unique shield obtained from the Hierophant's Chest, which spawns after defeating Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
df52189c9a3e483b51ebf5cb5876d9dc3df65ffc.text: 聖職的 盾 是從聖職的 寶箱 獲得的獨特護盾，它在 奴隸商人放逐地 中擊敗 黑色 唐肯 後生成。

bd1735a502fe2e1e331c6357859c868994d68612.source: Maul of the Hierophant is a unique hammer obtained from the Hierophant's Chest, which spawns after defeating Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
bd1735a502fe2e1e331c6357859c868994d68612.text: 聖職者之槌是從聖職者的 寶箱 中獲得的獨特錘子，它在 奴隸商人放逐地 中擊敗 黑色 唐肯 後生成。

14490321bdfb08cda28ee2d1373b679339cb7818.source: Bow of the Hierophant is a unique bow obtained from the Hierophant's Chest, which appears after defeating Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
14490321bdfb08cda28ee2d1373b679339cb7818.text: 聖職的弓是從聖職人員的寶箱取得的獨特弓，在奴隸商人放逐地中擊敗黑色 唐肯後出現。

ca9cfe47e93513b7c5bb94f59dc5f93d4a7a5c13.source: The Focus of the Hierophant is a unique focus item obtained from Hierophant's Chest in Slavers' Exile, after defeating Duncan the Black.
ca9cfe47e93513b7c5bb94f59dc5f93d4a7a5c13.text: 聖職的聚能器是擊敗黑色 唐肯後，從奴隸商人放逐地中聖職者的寶箱取得的獨特焦點物品。

f0863114593637a0c58d4eccf83eec2b823c64e8.source: Staff of the Hierophant is a unique staff obtained from Hierophant's Chest in Slavers' Exile, after beating Duncan the Black.
f0863114593637a0c58d4eccf83eec2b823c64e8.text: 聖職的法杖是在奴隸商人放逐地中擊敗黑色 唐肯後從聖職者的寶箱取得的獨特法杖。

0a7062d071b55e50fa96400873724c1e940f2d32.source: Daggers of the Hierophant are unique daggers obtained from the Hierophant's Chest, which appears after defeating Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
0a7062d071b55e50fa96400873724c1e940f2d32.text: 聖職的匕首是從聖職人員的寶箱取得的獨特匕首，寶箱在奴隸商人放逐地中擊敗黑色 唐肯後出現。

6fffa4df963201a3c2c67246f6537a5d897b342d.source: Durgon's Maul is a unique hammer dropped by Taskmaster Durgon, a boss who can be found in Vloxen Excavations.
6fffa4df963201a3c2c67246f6537a5d897b342d.text: 杜爾貢之槌是模仿大師杜爾貢掉落的獨特錘子，杜爾貢是 弗洛森古蹟 中的 Boss。

9dbbdadf4ea63022cd8b519e9bf56b0b4badfebb.source: Xalnax's Destiny is a unique bow dropped by Zalnax, a boss in the Vloxen Excavations.
9dbbdadf4ea63022cd8b519e9bf56b0b4badfebb.text: Xalnax 的命運是一把獨特的弓，由 弗洛森古蹟 中的 Boss Zalnax 掉落。

692046fe84ecf87aa02aea910963ae12e8aee880.source: Bellok's Staff is a unique staff dropped by Taskmaster Bellok, a boss who can be found in Vloxen Excavations.
692046fe84ecf87aa02aea910963ae12e8aee880.text: 貝洛克的 法杖 是模仿大師貝洛克掉落的獨特法杖，模仿大師貝洛克是一個可以在 弗洛森古蹟 中找到的 Boss。

aa10913bf435f8125bef3183fc85e8fe8f7b6e17.source: Zoldark's Focus is a unique focus item obtained from the treasure chest after defeating Zoldark The Unholy in Vloxen Excavations.
aa10913bf435f8125bef3183fc85e8fe8f7b6e17.text: 佐爾達克的 聚能器 是在 弗洛森古蹟 中擊敗邪惡佐爾達克後從寶箱中獲得的獨特焦點物品。

61cfb4cf1c0079654d65a3bb115f6aa78acbbeb0.source: Zoldark's Rod is a unique wand dropped by Zoldark's Chest, a chest that spawns after defeating the Dungeon Boss Zoldark The Unholy in the Vloxen Excavations.
61cfb4cf1c0079654d65a3bb115f6aa78acbbeb0.text: 佐爾達克的魔杖是佐爾達克的 寶箱 掉落的獨特魔杖，這是擊敗 地監 頭目 中的 弗洛森古蹟 中的邪惡佐爾達克後生成的箱子。

2ab575dd52d4ba48e70cca4a28e4cc3c8c122f01.source: Zoldark's Staff is a unique staff obtained from Zoldark's Chest, which spawns after defeating Zoldark The Unholy in Vloxen Excavations.
2ab575dd52d4ba48e70cca4a28e4cc3c8c122f01.text: 佐爾達克的 法杖 是從佐爾達克的 寶箱 獲得的獨特法杖，它在 弗洛森古蹟 中擊敗邪惡佐爾達克後生成。

4c41dfd47a28d25b9ac3a4c644e6aa2904cf6427.source: Kurg's Focus is a unique focus item dropped by Taskmaster Kurg, a boss in Vloxen Excavations.
4c41dfd47a28d25b9ac3a4c644e6aa2904cf6427.text: 庫爾格的 聚能器 是由模仿大師庫爾格（弗洛森古蹟 中的 Boss）掉落的獨特焦點物品。

Description: A Charr Bag is an equippable item that provides 10 additional inventory spaces. Because they already hold 10 items, they cannot be upgraded by using a Rune of Holding. A Superior Rune of Holding can be applied to it after leaving Pre-Searing and make it hold 15 items. A character may wear up to 2 bags at one time. Bags are not visible to other players.

Charr Bags are most commonly used by players in Pre-Searing who, without access to storage, have little inventory space.

夏爾 套件是 崩壞前 中玩家最常使用的物品，他們無法使用儲存空間，庫存空間也很小。

They look and work the same as Expert Salvage Kits; however, they have only five uses and they can only be obtained as drops from one of the Charr bosses or Maz's Chest.

bdcd9142124d4d81981585545ae0598b11c607fc.source:
Wiki notes: * This kit used to be the only means of salvaging equipment modifiers while in pre-Searing Ascalon, including weapon upgrades, Runes, or Insignias. With the introduction of The Purveyor players are able to obtain the Infinite Superior Salvage Kit in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* As with any kit, its value will decrease proportionally as it is used.
* Although it is gold, identifying it will not contribute to the Wisdom title track (however it will increase the value of the kit if sold to a merchant).
* These kits can be used to salvage rare crafting materials, but there is no point in doing so: rare materials cannot be used in pre-Searing Ascalon.
* The base chance, before the Wisdom and Treasure Hunter bonuses, of breaking an item upon salvaging an upgrade is 50%.
bdcd9142124d4d81981585545ae0598b11c607fc.text:
維基註解： * 此套件曾經是在 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 之前搶救裝備修飾符的唯一方法，包括武器升級、符文或徽章。隨著 The Purveyor 的推出，玩家能夠在 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 之前獲得無限 高階拆解工具。
* 與任何套件一樣，其價值會隨著使用而按比例減少。
* 雖然它是金色的，但識別它不會對 智慧者 主打歌做出貢獻（但如果出售給商人，它會增加套件的價值）。
* 這些套件可用於搶救稀有製作材料，但這樣做沒有意義：稀有材料不能在 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 之前使用。
* 在 智慧者 和 寶箱獵人 獎勵之前，搶救升級時破壞物品的基本機率為 50%。

654b8f65e8f1d6355af550dae41b852688767bba.source: The opening does not require a key or locking tool; the coins directly add to the role backpack and the articles fall on the ground.
654b8f65e8f1d6355af550dae41b852688767bba.text: 開啟不需要鑰匙或鎖定工具；金幣直接新增到角色背包中，物品掉落在地上。

aa4482ab77602725f868b16d4be096d7f01710ee.source: The quality of the incentives will decrease permanently as the number of times a role opens up its treasures; it is not expected that the initial rewards will be restored in full time.
aa4482ab77602725f868b16d4be096d7f01710ee.text: 隨著角色開啟寶藏的次數的增加，獎勵的品質會永久下降；預計初始獎勵不會全部恢復。

630c601eaec964c5db43e888035d6021f50ed00b.source: Reopen interval in Wiki Still estimated, about 30  Days, premature attempts or opening of other treasures may affect the waiting time; this tool records dates only and does not guarantee a re-counting of countdowns.
630c601eaec964c5db43e888035d6021f50ed00b.text: Wiki中的重新開啟間隔仍估計，大約為30天，過早嘗試或開啟其他寶物可能會影響等待時間；該工具僅記錄日期，並不保證重新計算倒數計時。

* If doing Dwarven brawling only, for best results, apply the following modifications to increase the damage substantially (along with other benefits):
** Inscription: Brawn over Brains (+15% damage; the -5 energy is irrelevant, since the loss of energy is negated by Dwarven Brawling).

72bd27d3cc943a3e514e9b6a8cd15fd4644b7e7f.source: Description: This sword shares a similar shape with the Violet Edge and Emerald Edge. Three things distinguish these oddly shaped swords from one another; the first and most noticeable is the color. The Violet Edge is purple in color, the Emerald Edge is green, and the Cerulean Edge is a light blue. Secondly, the small golden orb located above the grip in the first curve of the blade is held in place by braces; on the Violet Edge, one brace holds it in place, on the Emerald, two settings hold it, and on the Cerulean Edge, three braces securely fasten it. Lastly, the three Edges differ slightly in size, with the Violet being the smallest, the Emerald being slightly longer, and the Cerulean being the largest.
72bd27d3cc943a3e514e9b6a8cd15fd4644b7e7f.text: 說明：這把劍與紫羅蘭之刃和翡翠之刃具有相似的形狀。這些形狀怪異的劍有以下三點區別：第一個也是最引人注目的是顏色。紫羅蘭邊緣是紫色，翡翠邊緣是綠色，天藍邊緣是淺藍色。其次，位於刀片第一曲線握把上方的金色小球體透過支架固定到位；在紫羅蘭色邊緣上，一個支架將其固定到位；在祖母綠邊緣上，有兩個支架將其固定；在天藍色邊緣上，三個支架將其牢固固定。最後，三個邊緣的大小略有不同，紫羅蘭色最小，祖母綠稍長，天藍色最大。

b77235fb68e10f2028b0395f29c8ad184bec80ef.source: Old copy tag not checked, does not meanTreasure Chest Place on the map. For reward.Treasure Chestin Frostmaw's Burrows;see conditions for completion.
b77235fb68e10f2028b0395f29c8ad184bec80ef.text: 舊副本標籤未選中，並不表示寶藏 寶箱 放置在地圖上。獎勵。寶箱 凍霜地道；請參閱完成條件。

24033193a063f5218ad8eb03b754f79476460873.source: Old copy tag not checked, does not meanTreasure Chest Place on the map. For reward.Treasure Chestin Darkrime Delves;see conditions for completion.
24033193a063f5218ad8eb03b754f79476460873.text: 舊副本標籤未選中，並不表示寶藏 寶箱 放置在地圖上。獎勵。寶箱 黑霜洞穴；請參閱完成條件。

6b51d653e11266dcc709ff5479175afc715fbda9.source:
To find the Rainbow Phoenix in the Hall of Monuments, a character must satisfy the following conditions:
- Having all four Monumental Tapestries added to his/her Hall of Monuments.
- Having achieved the second tier of the maxed titles track, "People Know Me", or greater.
- Entering the area alone. No other players, no heroes, no henchmen.
6b51d653e11266dcc709ff5479175afc715fbda9.text:
要在 史蹟殿堂 中找到彩虹 火鳳凰，角色必須滿足以下條件：
- 將全部四個紀念掛毯新增到他/她的 史蹟殿堂 中。 
- 已達到最大標題曲目的第二層「人們認識我」或更高。 
- 獨自進入該區域。沒有其他玩家，沒有英雄，沒有追隨者。

429d88313bce7db13d1fc66dce3d8da2d99eb01e.text: 快閃記憶體 加持魔法

0fd1b6454f7c489bd7b987827ec0e92e2231e868.source: Elite Axe Attack. Deals +10…34…40 damage and hits 1…2…2 adjacent foes for 10…34…40 slashing damage.
0fd1b6454f7c489bd7b987827ec0e92e2231e868.text: 精英 斧術技能。造成 +10…34…40 傷害並對 1…2…2 鄰近敵人造成 10…34…40 揮砍傷害。

9480e3e2454b78d11018a105653a753d55c38dcc.source: Elite Hammer Attack. Causes knock-down. Inflicts Weakness condition (5…17…20 seconds).
9480e3e2454b78d11018a105653a753d55c38dcc.text: 精英 鎚術技能。導致擊倒。造成 虛弱 條件（5…17…20 秒）。

66a8be4822527f131beba914e7ca02da67ad2548.source: Elite Stance. (5…17…20 seconds.) You move 33% faster and gain double adrenaline from your attacks. Ends if you use any non-adrenal skills.
66a8be4822527f131beba914e7ca02da67ad2548.text: 精英 態勢。 （5…17…20 秒。）您移動 33% 的速度更快，並從攻擊中獲得雙倍的腎上腺素。如果您使用任何非腎上腺技能，則結束。

fc23dfd9f8235df501310f9ad283e0e6e060cbea.source: Elite Skill. (15 seconds.) Deals 10…30…35 slashing damage to all adjacent foes whenever you attack with a sword.
fc23dfd9f8235df501310f9ad283e0e6e060cbea.text: 精英 技能。 （15 秒。）每當您用劍攻擊時，都會對所有相鄰敵人造成 10…30…35 削減傷害。

9ba8c447ba352818b838ad058fcf1f4f791856da.source: Elite Shout. (5…11…13 seconds.) Allies in earshot move 33% faster. Initial effect: these allies lose the Crippled condition.
9ba8c447ba352818b838ad058fcf1f4f791856da.text: 精英 戰嚎。 （5…11…13 秒。）聽力範圍內的盟友 移動 33% 的速度更快。初始效果：這些盟友失去 殘癈 狀態。

b804199ed2be60d21581b4c10c9cc82f9eee6a41.source: Elite Pet Attack. Deals +13…25…28 damage. You gain adrenaline and 3…9…10 energy.
b804199ed2be60d21581b4c10c9cc82f9eee6a41.text: 精英 寵物攻擊。造成 +13…25…28 傷害。您將獲得腎上腺素和 3…9…10 能量。

442a1dfc188b182501729852b369486f3eb7e244.source: Elite Stance. (1…7…8 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 75% chance to block.
442a1dfc188b182501729852b369486f3eb7e244.text: 精英 態勢。 （1…7…8 秒。）您移動 33% 的速度更快，並且有 75% 的機會​​進行阻擋。

e1348c48e2af00a293b2dd2df1b9791783545160.source: Elite Bow Attack. Deals +5…17…20 damage. Hits 5 foes adjacent to your target. All your preparations are removed.
e1348c48e2af00a293b2dd2df1b9791783545160.text: 精英 弓術技能。造成 +5…17…20 傷害。攻擊目標附近的 5 敵人。你所有的準備工作都被刪除了。

01a443b5f270f3dd3462caa0344ebf9bb4d6fc09.source: Elite Trap. (90 seconds.) Affects nearby foes. Every second, (for 2 seconds), this trap deals 10…34…40 piercing damage, causes knockdown, and inflicts Crippled condition (3…21…25 seconds). Easily interrupted.
01a443b5f270f3dd3462caa0344ebf9bb4d6fc09.text: 精英 陷阱。 （90 秒。）影響附近的敵人。每秒（2 秒），此陷阱都會造成 10…34…40 穿刺傷害，造成擊倒，並造成 殘癈 狀態（3…21…25 秒）。很容易被打斷。

836511e397cdbbb3aace31b6325f9f5bcd45ff82.source: Elite Bow Attack. You shoot an arrow that moves twice as fast.
836511e397cdbbb3aace31b6325f9f5bcd45ff82.text: 精英 弓術技能。你射出的箭的移動速度是原來的兩倍。

f4f3aee4efab2b14f42b83a6d2a6e22dea5089dd.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…15…17 seconds.) Target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.
f4f3aee4efab2b14f42b83a6d2a6e22dea5089dd.text: 精英 加持魔法。 （5…15…17 秒。）目標 盟友不能成為敵方法的目標。

12fc0921309e7a29f980424a6897ab45ac0207da.source: Elite Spell. Heals for 5…81…100. Heals for 30…98…115 more if target ally is below 50% Health.
12fc0921309e7a29f980424a6897ab45ac0207da.text: 精英 咒文魔法。 5…81…100 的治療。如果目標盟友低於 50% 體力，則 30…98…115 的治療量會增加。

e0b24fdfc55a33d0be9b41af5dfee28473e1b9e0.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…11…13 seconds.) +3…9…10 Health regeneration and +20…40…45 armor.

41ffd29419b836615f234f4f520a15cf96919b4a.source: Elite Signet. Knocks down target. Deals 15…63…75 holy damage to target and adjacent foes.
41ffd29419b836615f234f4f520a15cf96919b4a.text: 精英 紋章。擊倒目標。對目標和鄰近敵人造成 15…63…75 神聖傷害。

5df7a2adef5186e47e4aa07ab531020289d399c2.source: Elite Spell. Transfer all conditions from all allies to you.
5df7a2adef5186e47e4aa07ab531020289d399c2.text: 精英 咒文魔法。將所有盟友的所有條件轉移給你。

3deca6ccb8b0d03ea6e096df9abd829e64576a62.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) +3…5…6 Energy regeneration. Cannot self-target.
3deca6ccb8b0d03ea6e096df9abd829e64576a62.text: 精英 加持魔法。 （10 秒。） +3…5…6 能量再生。無法自我定位。

c5b02dee466d8a9474101af2289371b96acfe77d.source: Elite Hex Spell. (6…25…30 seconds.) Target and nearby foes have -1…3…4 Health degeneration and receive 25% less benefit from healing.
c5b02dee466d8a9474101af2289371b96acfe77d.text: 精英 降咒魔法。 （6…25…30 秒。）目標 和附近的敵人具有 -1…3…4 體力衰減效果，且從治療中獲得的 25% 效益較少。

41c0d5e5e30e0e41227458d3b90bf52753eb8abd.source: Elite Signet. Transfers all conditions with 100…180…200% of their remaining durations from yourself to target foe. 50% failure chance unless Curses 5 or more.
41c0d5e5e30e0e41227458d3b90bf52753eb8abd.text: 精英 紋章。使用 100…180…200% 將所有狀態的剩餘持續時間從您自己轉移到目標敵人。 50% 失敗的機會除非 詛咒 5 或更多。

fe4977ff29bc7bd871c4853feeb0ef7f887bef6e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (20…39…44 seconds.) Foes who hit allies in the area in melee become Diseased (3…13…15 seconds); this ally is immune to Disease.
fe4977ff29bc7bd871c4853feeb0ef7f887bef6e.text: 精英 加持魔法。 （20…39…44 秒。）在近戰中擊中該區域盟友的敵人會變得患病（3…13…15 秒）；該盟友對疾病免疫。
