9d74cb06afbe028b4c7a8f7b9011349d58a50e00.source: Applying or reapplying the hex on a target suffering from one or more condition(s) will trigger the Dazed effect.
9d74cb06afbe028b4c7a8f7b9011349d58a50e00.text: 對患有一種或多種病症的目標應用或重新應用十六進位制將觸發 暈眩 效果。

31d8180a4919e73bd393a77fa342f5ebe22f0a0b.source: The Dazed caused by this hex is always spread to foes in the area, even if the target was already Dazed.
31d8180a4919e73bd393a77fa342f5ebe22f0a0b.text: 由該十六進位制引起的 暈眩 始終會傳播到該區域內的敵人，即使目標已經是 暈眩。

254fcad209b5c68eeab14c4c77e96deab2d39f03.source: The Dazed caused by this hex triggers Fragility twice upon application on the target (but not on surrounding foes).
254fcad209b5c68eeab14c4c77e96deab2d39f03.text: 由該十六進位制引起的 暈眩 在應用於目標（但不適用於周圍的敵人）時會觸發 脆弱 兩次。

624ce3123ec3e62938df11fe35aaa2cd97ee7a1d.source: If two foes hexed with Fevered Dreams are next to each other and one of them starts suffering from a new condition, both will be Dazed.
624ce3123ec3e62938df11fe35aaa2cd97ee7a1d.text: 如果兩個被 惡夢傳染 咒語的敵人彼此相鄰，並且其中一個開始患有新的病症，則兩人都將成為 暈眩。

d335955d9966f1f8b3cca9cfa409ef7bf4cd8c46.source: Similarly to "I Am Unstoppable!" and Mantra of Signets, the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.
d335955d9966f1f8b3cca9cfa409ef7bf4cd8c46.text: 類似於“我勢不可擋！”而紋章頌歌，該技能提供的護甲僅在護甲計算結束時應用。因此，它不計入 +25 的額外護甲上限，也不會被 防禦穿透 減少。

efa10daa96eb30ecc485a0a5049aef3cea414d4e.source: Similar to Deadly Paradox, Migraine does not affect attack skill activation times.
efa10daa96eb30ecc485a0a5049aef3cea414d4e.text: 與暗殺者之舞類似，頭痛不影響攻擊技能的啟動次數。

4ecb74f6c8e9c3b5e2059611bb36a6b1a3ddde24.source: Monsters won't cast Migraine on you when at least five of your skills are recharging.
4ecb74f6c8e9c3b5e2059611bb36a6b1a3ddde24.text: 當你至少有五個技能正在充電時，怪物不會對你施放 頭痛。

f70a4ab9f7005d8d102e9b730552eaa51c308f3e.source: Some non-English descriptions incorrectly expand the area of effect beyond adjacent foes: the French full description adds nearby foes and the German concise description adds the target.
f70a4ab9f7005d8d102e9b730552eaa51c308f3e.text: 一些非英語描述錯誤地將影響範圍擴大到相鄰敵人之外：法語完整描述添加了附近的敵人，而德語簡明描述則添加了目標。

a5aa336ac82e9153dcbec63c6040ab8a83e0a00e.source: At ranks 0-1 Fast Casting, all signets activated within the duration will deal damage and interrupt foes.
a5aa336ac82e9153dcbec63c6040ab8a83e0a00e.text: 在等級 0-1 快速施法 中，在持續時間內啟動的所有圖章都會造成傷害並打斷敵人。

9a80da82a024585d5084f0f29f0330dd7356683e.source: The concise description fails to specify the duration of the Blind condition
9a80da82a024585d5084f0f29f0330dd7356683e.text: 簡潔的描述未能指定盲態的持續時間

acab6cbd3b81a68d757996a61f94b60c89765ee3.source: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Glimmering Mark does not cause AI to scatter.
acab6cbd3b81a68d757996a61f94b60c89765ee3.text: 與大多數隨時間推移造成區域傷害的技能不同，閃光印記 不會導致 AI 分散。

5ef90b56e8f9ec1b5a45ed376bc1e825e14fefc8.source: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
5ef90b56e8f9ec1b5a45ed376bc1e825e14fefc8.text: 與描述相反，該技能會帶來治療效果，但不會增加生命值。

46992bea498d037b942d0cdaedbde323cae484ef.source: This skill does not actually become disabled, as it can be instantly recharged by Glyph of Renewal, and the recharge reduced by Glyph of Swiftness.
46992bea498d037b942d0cdaedbde323cae484ef.text: 此技能其實不會失效，因為它可以透過再生符號立即充能，並且透過迅捷的符號減少充能。

bd15db3706dd67e1d75b02588edd40094fd8080d.source: The health sacrifice does not appear on the damage monitor.
bd15db3706dd67e1d75b02588edd40094fd8080d.text: 健康犧牲不會出現在傷害監視器上。

fd0ff645ee950c18460167efcd4b9c8e0acf4046.source: The concise description incorrectly implies a single attack hitting multiple targets.
fd0ff645ee950c18460167efcd4b9c8e0acf4046.text: 簡潔的描述錯誤地暗示一次攻擊擊中了多個目標。

b31ff98d484d21df214952c5eabceb89c1686d18.source: This skill has no aftercast delay.
b31ff98d484d21df214952c5eabceb89c1686d18.text: 該技能沒有施法後延遲。

96a31b7eb2586e84cc90db3ebac1e2f612bcc067.source: This skill does not increase the amount of time a target is burning from Glyph of Immolation nor Mark of Rodgort.
96a31b7eb2586e84cc90db3ebac1e2f612bcc067.text: 此技能不會增加目標因獻祭的 符號 或 洛葛特的印記 而燃燒的時間。

5cdab8dceddf6e528104438028739b0b35285fd0.source: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing in earshot and not health gain.
5cdab8dceddf6e528104438028739b0b35285fd0.text: 與描述相反，該技能會導致聽力範圍內的治療，而不是健康增益。

f344934aa4337a54dbf1384ee95cd3d028e0002b.source: Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
f344934aa4337a54dbf1384ee95cd3d028e0002b.text: 與完整描述相反，該技能會帶來治療效果，但不會增加生命值。

88c218c555396434535277a6d790b0fd87c1fdb9.source: Unlike other recurring ground AOE skills, AI units often will not try to leave until the effect is nearly expired.
88c218c555396434535277a6d790b0fd87c1fdb9.text: 與其他反覆出現的地面 AOE 技能不同，AI 單位通常不會在效果快要過期之前嘗試離開。

2f641f6b31bff60d16952473d1c6ee9d112cd2e8.source: Unlike other healing skills, this spell can target spirits to remove burning. However, Empathic Removal will not heal the spirits.
2f641f6b31bff60d16952473d1c6ee9d112cd2e8.text: 與其他治療技能不同，該法術可以針對靈魂來消除燃燒。然而，情感移除 不會治癒靈魂。

6b7a1c20b8a9358ed0b1dfb2643378abb4894195.source: Causes bleeding when non-fleshy creatures, such as Shadow Vaettirs, cast Necromancer spells.
6b7a1c20b8a9358ed0b1dfb2643378abb4894195.text: 當非肉質生物（例如 闇影 Vaettirs）施放 死靈法師 法術時會導致流血。

6e3cbd0b78fd83afadffef0d89674a7efdf18a6d.source: Similar to other enchantments that target a foe, foes affected by Well of the Profane or spirits cannot be targeted by this enchantment.
6e3cbd0b78fd83afadffef0d89674a7efdf18a6d.text: 與其他以敵人為目標的結界類似，受 褻瀆之池 或精魂影響的敵人不能成為此結界的目標。

3e6bf0bce8259872b1f209b2a006e3f45b0e9ee0.source: On some very rare occasions, living NPCs will spawn rather than corpses when the golem dies.
3e6bf0bce8259872b1f209b2a006e3f45b0e9ee0.text: 在一些非常罕見的情況下，當傀儡死亡時，會生成活著的 NPC 而不是屍體。

ddf763360f2f1b34ae611b2f401656d7338e7055.source: Contrary to the concise description, the interrupt does not need to succeed for the skill to become disabled.
ddf763360f2f1b34ae611b2f401656d7338e7055.text: 與簡潔的描述相反，中斷不需要成功即可使技能被停用。

dea25782bc92fa8c81dd5a569a224701c3694c2f.source: The skill description implies that Blind covers Cracked Armor which covers Weakness, while in actuality Blind covers Weakness which covers Cracked Armor.
dea25782bc92fa8c81dd5a569a224701c3694c2f.text: 技能描述暗示盲注覆蓋了破解的 防禦，後者覆蓋了 虛弱，而實際上盲注覆蓋了 虛弱，後者覆蓋了破解的 防禦。

07abebba594ebaed814286e19374a06bfddeb7ce.source: The Hunting of the Charr (Sacnoth Valley)
07abebba594ebaed814286e19374a06bfddeb7ce.text: 夏爾 的狩獵 (聖諾谷)

d3c2acc81d173e8e4eac97e9ef187109a8b70de6.text: 最後一輪：戰鬥！ （甘拿的佔領地）

96ca4b8308cc8e3bebe6df405ee691bb2668543a.text: 男士熊俱樂部 (維拉戛陣地)

31cc39490bf6acfe2eb4a7a821734fea790232d7.text: 擊敗母熊(公熊) (尤拉夫之地)

161edb673e0502480fecf3821b17d2aba407ecc3.text: 真實追尋者 (甘拿的佔領地)

1345887e7bbb3b00a75576931d0bfd1919cd6b86.source: Prenuptial Disagreement (Olaf Olafson in Olafstead or Olrun Olafdottir in Varajar Fells)
1345887e7bbb3b00a75576931d0bfd1919cd6b86.text: 破碎的婚約（尤拉夫之地 中的 尤拉夫 尤拉夫森 或 維拉戛陣地 中的 歐朗 尤拉多得）

abab97f83b522b8eb028bdc7340c5c6d86d42910.source: Worthy Deeds (Done Dirt Cheap) (from Sif Shadowhunter in Sifhalla)
abab97f83b522b8eb028bdc7340c5c6d86d42910.text: 有價值的行為（便宜完成）（來自 獵影者 希夫 中的 襲哈拉）

f64809697a1fbe8e7cc9c8bcaf6c157ece50fa59.source: Fureyst Sharpsight (Sacnoth Valley) (requires a party member to be carrying a Proof of Triumph)
f64809697a1fbe8e7cc9c8bcaf6c157ece50fa59.text: Fureyst Sharpsight (聖諾谷)（請隊員攜帶 凱旋憑證）

80ccf7b55e0dccfd3399ee210d82e51343c8ba06.source: Contrary to the descriptions, damage is dealt to an additional 2…3…3 foes.
80ccf7b55e0dccfd3399ee210d82e51343c8ba06.text: 與描述相反，會對額外的 2…3…3 敵人造成傷害。

c978f1e398d4fdfa9390f7fbb0d788f19c749d7a.source: Heroes will spam this skill on allies with heavy overcast, regardless of what percentage of energy the ally has.
c978f1e398d4fdfa9390f7fbb0d788f19c749d7a.text: 英雄會向陰雲密佈的盟友傳送此技能，無論盟友的能量百分比是多少。

ed35057683beaff31279dab601ce21e119f04721.source: Although this is a PBAoE skill with an effect centered around the caster, it still needs an allied target and you will run towards that target if not in cast range. Similar to Hex Eater Signet, the target won't be affected if it is not in range.
ed35057683beaff31279dab601ce21e119f04721.text: 雖然這是一個 PBAoE 技能，效果以施法者為中心，但它仍然需要一個盟友目標，如果不在施法範圍內，你就會跑向該目標。與 噬咒紋章 類似，如果目標不在範圍內，則不會受到影響。

d4fd97b3d38de4808f4ed6c953b0009ea3d6b6ff.source: Because it is a targeted enchantment spell, it will always trigger Shame and Mark of Subversion. If standing in a Well of the Profane, you will be able to cast this enchantment if you pick any ally in cast range that is not inside the well.
d4fd97b3d38de4808f4ed6c953b0009ea3d6b6ff.text: 因為它是一個有針對性的結界法術，所以它總是會觸發 羞愧 和 破壞印記。如果站在 褻瀆之池 中，如果您選擇施法範圍內不在井內的任何盟友，您將能夠施放此結界。

e2f73d0fd00c9763d78883a8d6471d9befe1497b.source: The concise description omits the fact that your health gain (and your target's health loss) is capped by your maximum health.
e2f73d0fd00c9763d78883a8d6471d9befe1497b.text: 簡潔的描述忽略了一個事實：你的健康增益（以及你的目標的健康損失）受到你的最大生命值的限制。

2ff48629f0a593a7f13ba629b7dd2ee4ebd2e177.source: Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy a Signet of Capture and itself.
2ff48629f0a593a7f13ba629b7dd2ee4ebd2e177.text: 迴響 的描述忽略了它不能複製 捕捉紋章 及其自身的事實。

843d86eea322e4f24aae048bcb3e3463358cf128.source: The armor bonus from this skill only applies to physical damage.
843d86eea322e4f24aae048bcb3e3463358cf128.text: 此技能的護甲加值僅適用於物理傷害。

db331f87d1e98a669c8afe7406f28f4f3f8131e9.source: This skill checks the energy condition independently for each target hit.
db331f87d1e98a669c8afe7406f28f4f3f8131e9.text: 此技能獨立檢查每個擊中目標的能量狀況。

18b509b45c4f149e5bbc5e300f6541f05acda8ec.source: Unlike Winter this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.
18b509b45c4f149e5bbc5e300f6541f05acda8ec.text: 與 寒冬 不同，此技能要求攻擊者處於精神效果區域內。

38008bc4dbaa9c8200e1dc14e93f92ce4bb0390e.source: Does not properly convert the physical damage of certain skills (notably: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support and Veil of Thorns). As a result, the skill chain will not trigger the conditional effects of other skills that depend on fire damage (in particular, for Intensity).
38008bc4dbaa9c8200e1dc14e93f92ce4bb0390e.text: 無法正確轉換某些技能的物理傷害（特別是：黑檀 狙擊支援和 荊棘遮罩）。因此，技能鏈不會觸發其他依賴火焰傷害的技能的條件效果（特別是強度）。

5b8252d0eff97de3c88cc05a0fed1c19c8ca9ae8.source: Contrary to the description, Peace and Harmony doesn't cause conditions and hexes to expire 90% faster. Instead, all new conditions and hexes, applied during the enchantment, will have their duration reduced by 90%.
5b8252d0eff97de3c88cc05a0fed1c19c8ca9ae8.text: 與描述相反，平靜與和諧 不會導致條件和十六進位更快地過期 90%。相反，在結界期間應用的所有新條件和六角形的持續時間都會因 90% 而減少。

874a54468c596ddc37d9336cf42dfee162b9412e.source: The tiny delay between the target being teleported to the casters location and being resurrected is long enough for an AI to possibly use "We Shall Return!", which takes place before UA's resurrecting effect.
874a54468c596ddc37d9336cf42dfee162b9412e.text: 目標被傳送到施法者位置和復活之間的微小延遲足以讓 AI 可能使用“我們將 影返！”，該延遲發生在 UA 復活效果之前。

c7ef444a7f50c4da14bf7ace1be6ef45c0395c27.source: The "random" resurrected party member is almost always the one closest to the caster when the skill is cancelled. You can therefor pick which target to rez by moving on top of the corpse before cancelling.
c7ef444a7f50c4da14bf7ace1be6ef45c0395c27.text: 當技能取消時，「隨機」復活的隊員幾乎總是距離施法者最近的隊員一個。因此，您可以在取消之前透過在屍體頂部移動來選擇要調整的目標。

37eb489aef5fbd8e843c6dba19045c74b03fa589.source: If you are moving when it ends, the resurrected party member will be teleported to where you started running or where you last changed direction, not to your current position.
37eb489aef5fbd8e843c6dba19045c74b03fa589.text: 如果你在結束時移動，復活的隊員將被傳送到你開始奔跑的地方或你最後改變方向的地方，而不是你目前的位置。

926a3db9907fd59761a06e91cff69c0823324060.source: Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
926a3db9907fd59761a06e91cff69c0823324060.text: 與描述相反，該技能會增加生命值而不是治療。

d4acfbede5fe92e5cd323ec39fb100cfa45e28ba.source: Contrary to the description, this skill causes health gain and not healing.
d4acfbede5fe92e5cd323ec39fb100cfa45e28ba.text: 與描述相反，該技能會增加生命值而不是治療。

3a1a0b18668306d53df076b655c005e8e815e44b.source: Shield of Judgment will not be listed in the damage monitor if its damage is reduced to 0.
3a1a0b18668306d53df076b655c005e8e815e44b.text: 如果 審判之盾 的損壞減少到 0，則 審判之盾 將不會列在損壞監視器中。

a1ab9fff4a21a2415b0a6d6520fc9b0d7c16aa22.source: The concise description states that foes attacking target ally will be knocked down and suffer damage; however, this effect only occurs when the target ally is successfully hit.
a1ab9fff4a21a2415b0a6d6520fc9b0d7c16aa22.text: 簡潔的描述表明，攻擊目標盟友的敵人會被擊倒並受到傷害；然而，此效果僅在成功擊中目標盟友時才會發生。

47125ffbb3dd5e290039bbc59e1c990055a2bd40.source: Changing your maximum energy lower than what it was when this was cast on you, will lower your health bonus accordingly to your new energy, however swapping back to higher energy will not bring it back up and it will remain at the lower amount, even if recast on you at higher energy before its duration ends.
47125ffbb3dd5e290039bbc59e1c990055a2bd40.text: 將你的最大能量更改為低於施放於你身上時的值，會根據你的新能量相應地降低你的健康加值，但是換回更高的能量不會將其恢復，並且它將保持在較低的數量，即使在其持續時間結束之前以更高的能量重新施放給你。

3776cf6b86157b47829e0997ce8bba7ca934f591.source: If a foe with a spell targeting prevention skill is targeted, Double Dragon will fail, despite the enchantment applying to the ally nearest to the target foe.
3776cf6b86157b47829e0997ce8bba7ca934f591.text: 如果目標敵人具有法術鎖定預防技能，則 雙龍 將會失敗，儘管該結界適用於距離目標敵人最近的盟友。

2232c30a3dc9b391a9f590ddcae792a7d6707dc9.source: Whenever a target under the effects of Double Dragon is interrupted, the animation restarts.
2232c30a3dc9b391a9f590ddcae792a7d6707dc9.text: 每當處於 雙龍 效果下的目標中斷時，動畫就會重新開始。

b519be848447233fa70488cf413cb2806a8d3917.source: Unlike most area damage over time skills, Double Dragon does not cause AI to scatter.
b519be848447233fa70488cf413cb2806a8d3917.text: 與大多數隨時間推移造成區域傷害的技能不同，雙龍 不會導致 AI 分散。

e0b9235a56d8727dfe62c4f802778e3ddcbc76e2.source: In the Polish translation, description was not updated when skill functionality changed. It still says: You lose 5 Energy if more than one foe is struck.
e0b9235a56d8727dfe62c4f802778e3ddcbc76e2.text: 在波蘭語翻譯中，當技能功能發生變化時，描述不會更新。它仍然說：如果超過一個敵人被擊中，你就會失去 5 能量。

c9da773583e334f33df6476828956f6b4d10f75a.source: The non-concise description is wrong, attacks blocked by another blocking source while under the effects of this skill and while attacking will still trigger the damage.
c9da773583e334f33df6476828956f6b4d10f75a.text: 不簡潔的描述是錯誤的，在該技能的效果下，攻擊被另一個阻擋來源阻擋後，攻擊時仍然會觸發傷害。

b3b7e0277680ab66462214296ef4337ff5790fb5.source: The -5 damage reduction is active for the expected duration of each enchantment, not its actual duration. Refreshing an Assassin enchantment before it ends reduces the received damage by an additional -5.
b3b7e0277680ab66462214296ef4337ff5790fb5.text: -5 傷害減免在每個結界的預期持續時間內有效，而不是其實際持續時間。在 暗殺者 結界結束前重新整理它會減少額外的 -5 所受到的傷害。

959c0db56a18fa5600313c2dab1d691f552cf42d.source: Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.
959c0db56a18fa5600313c2dab1d691f552cf42d.text: 與簡潔的描述相反，該技能的條件效果會導致生命值增加而不是治療。

12e0cd0216305005f4058025491fa2d83ae4770c.source: Ritual Lord will only increase the skill progression of a skill, and not inherent effects from Spawning Power.
12e0cd0216305005f4058025491fa2d83ae4770c.text: 祭祀之主 只會增加技能的技能進度，而非 召喚 的固有效果。

70888c908ea6429631d82aca3045484dec1daa26.source: With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), an instance of this skill's damage will trigger for each Dervish enchantment except for Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, or Vow of Revolution. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Aura of Holy Might (plus Aura of Holy Might itself).
70888c908ea6429631d82aca3045484dec1daa26.text: 對於移除「所有結界」的技能（例如 純淨的冥想），除了永恆光環、盾 力量、古蘭斯 光環或革命誓言之外，每個 神喚使 結界都會觸發該技能的傷害例項。相較之下，如果特定數量的結界被移除（例如透過 粉碎加持 或 神喚使 拆卸），則對於哪些 神喚使 結界將觸發傷害沒有限制，只要它們覆蓋聖能光環（加上聖能光環本身）即可。

c1b5586fadb93423b6192e7fdc78bcdfb5c29780.source: Contrary to descriptions, this skill inflicts -5…8 Health degeneration in the area over 10 seconds regardless of the amount of energy lost.
c1b5586fadb93423b6192e7fdc78bcdfb5c29780.text: 與描述相反，無論損失多少能量，技能都會在 10 秒內的區域內造成 -5…8 體力衰減效果。

28cacb876d172c1fd50b24d53865a0dfb67c4aac.source: When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Factions skill.
28cacb876d172c1fd50b24d53865a0dfb67c4aac.text: 當以活動方式對技能進行排序時，它會列在 核心 下，儘管它是 盟與敵 技能。

ad8e75284ae547dce8fcd884e3a5b3e219acf486.source: The skill descriptions omit that only party members within earshot are affected.
ad8e75284ae547dce8fcd884e3a5b3e219acf486.text: 技能描述忽略了只有在聽力範圍內的黨員才會受到影響。

5298cc1784e73b1dd66e2d6916801b01271ffc66.source: The base attack damage from this skill is 50...35% less damage rather than the 40...25% stated.
5298cc1784e73b1dd66e2d6916801b01271ffc66.text: 此技能的基本攻擊傷害為 50...35% 傷害，而非規定的 40...25%。

dd421a90b678124a1191a65481d9ec97b41eaa58.source: The concise description fails to mention that the attack is unblockable
dd421a90b678124a1191a65481d9ec97b41eaa58.text: 簡潔的描述並沒有提到攻擊是不可阻擋的

b954bb53e4cecda375034ada5107e0b59838fed8.source: Against unenchanted targets this skill causes block bypassing effects such as Asuran Scan or Warrior's Cunning to be ignored.
b954bb53e4cecda375034ada5107e0b59838fed8.text: 對抗未附魔的目標時，技能會導致繞過格擋的效果（例如阿蘇蘭掃描或 戰士的靈巧）被忽略。

439f1fda1dc263a695b3d55d112cf7a39097261d.source: The full description omits that this skill needs your pet to be alive to activate.
439f1fda1dc263a695b3d55d112cf7a39097261d.text: 完整的描述忽略了該技能需要你的寵物活著才能啟動。

b582c84e247fdcc318e732b153dcd0d8042aa7fc.source: Targeting yourself or an ally will sometimes cause your pet to stop moving. It will unfreeze when an opponent enters your aggro bubble or attacks it. This is exploited to perform the portal jumping technique known as a SaO chain.
b582c84e247fdcc318e732b153dcd0d8042aa7fc.text: 以你自己或盟友為目標有時會導致你的寵物停止移動。當對手進入你的仇恨氣泡或攻擊它時，它會解凍。這被用來執行稱為 SaO 鏈的門戶跳躍技術。

fad936a348749400f80bea1016f8f7b72d5061a3.source: Strike as One's description omits the fact that it has a limited duration of 30 seconds.
fad936a348749400f80bea1016f8f7b72d5061a3.text: 衝擊合一 的描述忽略了它的持續時間有限為 30 秒這一事實。

eb8d6a106f6130036a3bca9dc01fac83fe1405fe.source: The French description of the skill mention an "enemy target" for the shadow step despite the fact that the skill can target either foe or friend
eb8d6a106f6130036a3bca9dc01fac83fe1405fe.text: 法語對該技能的描述提到了暗影步的“敵人目標”，儘管該技能可以瞄準敵人或朋友

f919d15cebf490a2808f2706e81705f5eb035faa.source: Does not double adrenaline gain from all sources as stated, but rather gives one additional strike of adrenaline per attack. Despite this, it still does not stack with other skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain, such as "For Great Justice!" or Weapon of Fury, but stacks additively with Mark of Fury or Dark Fury.
f919d15cebf490a2808f2706e81705f5eb035faa.text: 不會使所有來源的腎上腺素增益加倍，而是每次攻擊都會額外增加一次腎上腺素。儘管如此，它仍然不能與其他增加腎上腺素獲得率的技能疊加，例如「為了偉大的正義！」或 狂暴武裝，但與 狂暴印記 或 暗黑憤怒 堆疊在一起。

97bf177bd22cc0038988a8ca36a7c40bca0a7fe0.source: Doesn't work against Psychic Instability or Tremor.
97bf177bd22cc0038988a8ca36a7c40bca0a7fe0.text: 對 精神失衡 或顫抖不起作用。

2391ed6c8a3dfb274b8d51869ffc10880cf68644.source: Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Dolyak Signet) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
2391ed6c8a3dfb274b8d51869ffc10880cf68644.text: 儘管沒有啟動時間，但該圖章（類似於 石犛牛紋章）在被擊倒或執行動作時無法使用。

09e3287b42989a924cc2e835e68a034f2a8226c6.source: After being resurrected, if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.
09e3287b42989a924cc2e835e68a034f2a8226c6.text: 復活後，如果玩家在站立動畫中間使用該技能，他們將不會開始流血。

8a821732a0b930f9b7bf8ccde5eb65f654dc16a7.source: The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.
8a821732a0b930f9b7bf8ccde5eb65f654dc16a7.text: 描述中沒有提及鋸齒恐怖造成的流血持續時間。

4b5e700ed6f770d0b8aecf109a3e7fee65e4b893.source: This skill can not be cast if you are targeting someone under Spell Breaker, Vow of Silence etc. and triggers the spell Mistrust, acting like a target foe spell.
4b5e700ed6f770d0b8aecf109a3e7fee65e4b893.text: 如果您以 魔法粉碎、沉靜誓約 等條件下的某人為目標並觸發法術 疑惑，則無法施展該技能，就像目標敵人法術一樣。

555f7f26c0484f4974d036e6ecb0bcf6b6415330.source: If an enchantment duration is reduced below 1 second, it behaves as if it was not applied.
555f7f26c0484f4974d036e6ecb0bcf6b6415330.text: 如果結界持續時間減少到 1 秒以下，則其行為就像未應用一樣。

37ef2145ecbe95dd9f510844d5d8db810a27cddc.source: Although the description says "150…270…300% faster", the actual behavior is "at 150…270…300% the normal rate", which is only 50…170…200% faster.

6dee6d23e33b7f84400beb1d2ab097635ec04eea.source: Items that grant a 20% chance of adding +1 to Illusion Magic do not affect spells cast while this signet is active. For example, you cannot use "Master of My Domain" to obtain rank 21 in the table above. Instead, spells will use the unmodified Illusion rank.
6dee6d23e33b7f84400beb1d2ab097635ec04eea.text: 授予 20% 機會將 +1 加入 幻術魔法 的物品不會影響此圖章處於活動狀態時施展的法術。例如，您無法使用「Master of My Domain」來獲得上表中的排名 21。相反，法術將使用未經修改的幻像等級。

47ea4c64caa60b5bb3e572ba374427a4a1c288c7.source: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Sandstorm and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
47ea4c64caa60b5bb3e572ba374427a4a1c288c7.text: 與所有其他同時造成傷害和額外傷害的 元素使 技能（沙塵暴 和 邸內之風 除外）不同，此技能的額外傷害不會在單獨的資料包中造成。

8cf6dad053f6b14c5ae68b9a22d06e5b42db6835.source: Invoke Lightning's animation shows strikes on all possible targets, not just the three that are actually hit.
8cf6dad053f6b14c5ae68b9a22d06e5b42db6835.text: 閃電祈禱 的動畫顯示了對所有可能目標的攻擊，而不僅僅是實際被擊中的三個目標。

67f1be65f21cd09a03b76152aff96e156266fdab.source: Unlike all other Elementalist skills that deal both damage and additional damage (except Blinding Surge and Teinai's Wind), this skill's additional damage is not dealt in a separate packet.
67f1be65f21cd09a03b76152aff96e156266fdab.text: 與所有其他同時造成傷害和額外傷害的 元素使 技能（盲目震盪 和 邸內之風 除外）不同，此技能的額外傷害不會在單獨的資料包中造成。

5f4c8315ccee4b2e2dd310a77ebed77045556017.source: While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.
5f4c8315ccee4b2e2dd310a77ebed77045556017.text: 在魔法大師的作用下，元素等級屬性點被削弱，會導致元素等級降低1。沒有屬性點的元素生物屬性不會因為1而降低。

320e52922515704aeb8089a37a24eb98d8a74110.source: This skill replaces your dagger's attack damage with the stated damage, which is non-armor-ignoring damage (unlike other attack skills such as Distracting Shot and Needling Shot). This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.
320e52922515704aeb8089a37a24eb98d8a74110.text: 此技能將匕首的攻擊傷害替換為指定傷害，這是非護甲無視傷害（與其他攻擊技能如 震暈之箭 和 刺針射擊 不同）。此傷害受到 匕首精通、爆擊、護甲穿透、銘文和銘文等效武器傷害加值以及目標護甲等級的影響，但不受益於自訂傷害加值。

602c42c3ab36a166b75451e90cac42e7cee59d1e.source: The concise description fails to mention that only daze will not have effect if not enchanted (the attack will not fail).
602c42c3ab36a166b75451e90cac42e7cee59d1e.text: 簡潔的描述並沒有提到只有發呆如果沒有附魔的話不會有效果（攻擊不會失敗）。

4fde7ee025078ee118ca54a43b19dd50cc266c0d.source: Crippling modifiers on weapons do not extend the duration of cripple caused by the end effect.
4fde7ee025078ee118ca54a43b19dd50cc266c0d.text: 武器上的 致殘 修飾符不會延長最終效果造成的癱瘓的持續時間。

e5febc13c7dd96ade688ce1bcdd65a7ab76d055b.source: This spell does not have an aftercast delay.

66a4f868c639f1e6a04b41cd3aa418309fae029f.source: When dropped, the chat log notes your dropping the ashes as "You drop a Destructive was Glaive." When most ashes from an item spell are dropped, the chat log notes this as "You drop an Ashes of..." followed by the name of the item spell. Example: "You drop an Ashes of Grasping Kuurong."
66a4f868c639f1e6a04b41cd3aa418309fae029f.text: 掉落時，聊天記錄會記錄您掉落的骨灰「您掉落了 毀滅者葛雷薇」。當物品法術的大部分灰燼被掉落時，聊天日誌會將此記錄為“你掉落了…的灰燼”，後跟物品法術的名稱。例：“你掉落了抓握枯榮的灰燼。”

4418337cd316c13efd60d5c4846c6a8d1ed254af.source: If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.
4418337cd316c13efd60d5c4846c6a8d1ed254af.text: 如果僅在一次攻擊中受到多個來源的傷害時使用，治療武裝 將觸發多次。例如，如果被 荊棘 施咒的敵人受到物理傷害，治療武裝 將同時觸發物理傷害和 荊棘 傷害。

682bc66881c288a3e8b2484d2c29d9e03804d430.source: The skill states it will end on all other allies, however, it will only end on party members of the ally that it triggers on, not all allies.
682bc66881c288a3e8b2484d2c29d9e03804d430.text: 該技能宣告它將在所有其他盟友上結束，但是，它只會在其觸發的盟友的黨員上結束，而不是在所有盟友上結束。

cab0baf4a0b89a183d3bd5f41c8ca042780cc73b.source: Despite the skill descriptions, this skill triggers with health degeneration, health loss, life stealing, and health sacrifice, not just damage.
cab0baf4a0b89a183d3bd5f41c8ca042780cc73b.text: 儘管有技能描述，但該技能會觸發健康退化、健康損失、生命竊取和健康犧牲，而不僅僅是傷害。

623165e38995084f23ca1a8fa34774019d179b71.source: Unlike most skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier, this increases all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.
623165e38995084f23ca1a8fa34774019d179b71.text: 與大多數透過乘數增加腎上腺素獲得率的技能不同，這會增加所有非乘數來源的腎上腺素，而不僅僅是進行攻擊時的基本 1 打擊。

2df4f5c3c904dc574b809a260bea6e8831b7174d.source: Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
2df4f5c3c904dc574b809a260bea6e8831b7174d.text: 與破解防禦類似，如果你的「核心」護甲等級低於60，該技能不會將你的護甲等級降低到60以下或你的「核心」護甲等級。

3db90ebe3f52303140f14d389041c8ae55b987fa.source: If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that grant +46 or more armor rating, Soldier's Fury's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
3db90ebe3f52303140f14d389041c8ae55b987fa.text: 如果您使用授予 +46 或更高護甲等級的技能或技能和效果組合，則 士兵的狂暴 的護甲減損不起作用。另請參見護甲計算。

b7bd106bb96086e4295ddfce89ad1838d1e14d40.source: If a condition is removed, Leadership will restore energy as if it affected two targets, requiring minimum 8 Leadership to receive the doubled benefit. This causes it to have a net cost of 1 energy.
b7bd106bb96086e4295ddfce89ad1838d1e14d40.text: 如果某個條件被移除，領導 將恢復能量，就好像它影響了兩個目標一樣，需要最少的 8 領導 才能獲得雙倍的效果。這導致它具有 1 能源的淨成本。

a290cc83fc842f136321455207707ac802fd2497.source: Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.
a290cc83fc842f136321455207707ac802fd2497.text: 重新申請不會重置剩餘的使用次數，直到原始申請結束為止。它似乎會計算兩個應用程式的任何技能使用情況，如果原始應用程式剩餘的使用次數達到 0，則吟唱將結束。

f68cada8fc7574a65da2972cad7fa2c69111034b.source: Although the effect extends beyond party range, the AI only considers allies within the expected range.
f68cada8fc7574a65da2972cad7fa2c69111034b.text: 儘管效果超出了隊伍範圍，但人工智慧僅考慮預期範圍內的盟友。

b51d95b19d2503e610ff39acf5ece8c420a873f3.source: This skill currently only grants 1 energy per enchantment
b51d95b19d2503e610ff39acf5ece8c420a873f3.text: 此技能目前僅為每個結界提供 1 能量

9603f48c6ff62749769477652972006b1998dbff.source: Despite the full description, a Dervish enchantment is removed even if this attack fails to hit.
9603f48c6ff62749769477652972006b1998dbff.text: 儘管有完整的描述，即使此攻擊未能命中，神喚使 結界也會被移除。

8ff28552c8159e8ef16df58ea124b22ceb229731.source: This is the only skill that has health degeneration shown with positive value in the description.
8ff28552c8159e8ef16df58ea124b22ceb229731.text: 這是描述中唯一顯示健康退化並具有正面價值的技能。

1883b9a292e0a79236033b076704b7dbac60777f.source: This enchantment can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.
1883b9a292e0a79236033b076704b7dbac60777f.text: 此結界可以在 凍土 的效果下施展。

f2916b74c46f882e46e4e4214c08c23af0eb620e.source: When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Nightfall skill.
f2916b74c46f882e46e4e4214c08c23af0eb620e.text: 當以活動方式對技能進行排序時，它會列在 核心 下，儘管它是 黑暗逆襲 技能。

db2ca43cbffec8c5aad8239fceb422a7e13b41b5.source: If two people cast this spell on one target, both will take effect; however, only one enchantment will show on the effects monitor.
db2ca43cbffec8c5aad8239fceb422a7e13b41b5.text: 如果兩個人對一個目標施放此法術，則雙方都會生效；然而，效果監視器上只會顯示一個結界。

9af9d6cb044e97977fe9e8a644895a62e0aad549.source: The heal amount is based on your rank of Divine Favor at the time of each hit rather than at the initial casting, i.e. if your attributes are increased/decreased while the enchantment is in effect, the heal amount will change accordingly.
9af9d6cb044e97977fe9e8a644895a62e0aad549.text: 治療量取決於每次攻擊時您的 神恩 等級，而不是初始施法時的等級，即，如果您的屬性在結界生效時增加/減少，治療量將相應變化。

3c92682f10cb142745d8106ab051d16f521e779a.source: This skill actually causes health gain.
3c92682f10cb142745d8106ab051d16f521e779a.text: 這項技能實際上會帶來健康增益。

44b5d5edc0c0f973aff0dce99a31445a94e50296.source: Contrary to the description, the healing from this skill is gained through life stealing rather than a heal. Therefore, the heal is unaffected by hexes that reduce healing such as Lingering Curse or Defile Flesh, and the spirit will not take damage from healer-punishing hexes such as Scourge Healing or Soul Bind.
44b5d5edc0c0f973aff0dce99a31445a94e50296.text: 與描述相反，該技能的治療是透過生命竊取而不是治療獲得的。因此，治療不會受到減少治療的咒語（例如 強力詛咒 或 肉體敗壞）的影響，並且靈魂也不會受到懲罰治療者的咒語（例如 災禍治癒 或 靈魂束縛）的傷害。

6842f1d4449d41725fa8252182b62905452381da.source: The distance of healing is much greater than spirit range and it seems that healing covers all the current location.
6842f1d4449d41725fa8252182b62905452381da.text: 治療的距離遠大於精神範圍，似乎治療涵蓋了目前的所有位置。

3092f1779a21bccc143b832d3c623a5bd73e9a55.source: If you obtain a new skill (as a quest reward) you may equip it in any of the free slots and use it. After turning back to human form, you keep the skill but cannot use it until you swap it with another skill.
3092f1779a21bccc143b832d3c623a5bd73e9a55.text: 如果您獲得新技能（作為任務獎勵），您可以將其裝備在任何免費插槽中並使用它。變回人類 型態 後，您會保留該技能，但無法使用它，直到您將其交換為其他技能。

a1d728cdf5572eb5778cc6e358561f347729e962.source: Unlike other skills without an activation time, this skill has the standard aftercast delay of 0.75 second and cannot be used while moving or activating another skill.
a1d728cdf5572eb5778cc6e358561f347729e962.text: 與其他沒有啟動時間的技能不同，此技能具有 0.75 秒的標準施法延遲，且在移動或啟動其他技能時無法使用。

d1d6ce8c6c6c86800483cbf030615c7692a4b23d.source: Foes affected by this skill cannot miss.
d1d6ce8c6c6c86800483cbf030615c7692a4b23d.text: 受此技能影響的敵人不會失手。

3272ef02e29d0c403644382093673ebdd5a95bf8.source: While target foe is hexed, you cannot miss other foes.
3272ef02e29d0c403644382093673ebdd5a95bf8.text: 當目標敵人被施咒時，你不會錯過其他敵人。

7a4fd63f51e6ff5a0cac7daf0131d650789d6525.source: This hex also prevents the target from blocking your attacks.
7a4fd63f51e6ff5a0cac7daf0131d650789d6525.text: 這個六角形還可以防止目標阻擋你的攻擊。

5a942e3bd5db408d4b38b857373c6074034b946e.source: Unlike most enchantments, Mental Block does not show a cloudy white ring around the caster.
5a942e3bd5db408d4b38b857373c6074034b946e.text: 與大多數結界不同，精神方塊不會在施法者周圍顯示出渾濁的白色環。

687101e8fc7ea23097805954bdc04b880cc345fc.source: The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
687101e8fc7ea23097805954bdc04b880cc345fc.text: 這個描述具有誤導性：每個玩家可以擁有一個活躍的 阿蘇拉 召喚。

6b7304cfa5f88bab85aa41c4c90db98d8e13af4f.source: Unlike regular Ruby Djinn, the creature summoned by this skill is fleshy.
6b7304cfa5f88bab85aa41c4c90db98d8e13af4f.text: 與常規的 紅寶石巨靈 不同，此技能召喚的生物是肉質的。

c7fff498dc7393139ae47b1174d02d7133f5a2ff.source: Exception: this skill will not daze Murakai, Lady of the Night, a boss-like foe.
c7fff498dc7393139ae47b1174d02d7133f5a2ff.text: 例外：此技能不會使 夜之女 幕蘭凱（一個類似 Boss 的敵人）暈眩。

d8faefafdffb984bfc4b2fd5ce60213961dfef09.source: Technobabble's damage respects armor, even though it deals untyped damage.
d8faefafdffb984bfc4b2fd5ce60213961dfef09.text: 技術巴布的傷害與護甲有關，儘管它會造成無型別傷害。

b99fde7c84217a381c2176cfdfbe6bfba31baaf1.source: This skill deals fire damage that does not ignore armor.
b99fde7c84217a381c2176cfdfbe6bfba31baaf1.text: 此技能造成的火焰傷害不會忽略護甲。

15786e22c6d32698f17047f1bfbadbc8ff53dbbe.source: If recast before the duration ends, Dwarven Stability will end before being reapplied, triggering Meditation and other relevant skills.
15786e22c6d32698f17047f1bfbadbc8ff53dbbe.text: 如果在持續時間結束之前重鑄，矮人穩定性將在重新施加之前結束，觸發 冥想 和其他相關技能。

d683e39003e8e0a643950864b6696206ebe17247.source: This attack is not affected by Favourable Winds extra damage even when used wielding a bow, unlike similar flat armor ignoring damage attack skills like Needling Shot or Power Shot.
d683e39003e8e0a643950864b6696206ebe17247.text: 即使使用弓箭，此攻擊也不會受到順風額外傷害的影響，這與 刺針射擊 或 強力之箭 等類似的無視傷害攻擊技能的平甲不同。

5b2f34ba04975ae1ff415f5ca03d8254a1e20a3f.source: Attack skills that deal entirely armor-ignoring damage, such as Banishing Strike, are still increased.
5b2f34ba04975ae1ff415f5ca03d8254a1e20a3f.text: 造成完全無視護甲傷害的攻擊技能（例如 驅逐攻擊）仍然會增加。

c20759218f2aef8498948df7c62c4cedec518df1.source: The armor bonus while fighting Charr is calculated as two sources, the initial +24 armor and then the +24 armor against Charr. The armor bonus is therefore capped at +25 armor due to effect stacking (giving a 35.2% damage reduction bonus).
c20759218f2aef8498948df7c62c4cedec518df1.text: 與 夏爾 戰鬥時的護甲加值以兩個來源計算，即初始 +24 護甲，然後是針對 夏爾 的 +24 護甲。因此，由於效果疊加，護甲加值上限為 +25 護甲（給予 35.2% 傷害減免加值）。

7cee8f65bf403aca0cc62d4aa0f22b1a9c0fcf99.source: The Assassin doesn't shadow step; it is spawned directly next to the target.
7cee8f65bf403aca0cc62d4aa0f22b1a9c0fcf99.text: 暗殺者 不隱藏步驟；它直接在目標旁邊產生。

a0c0204ad249ead82d7eabb8942a89a17fd87e26.source: The Assassin is counted as a created creature for Spirit's Gift, Explosive Growth, and Boon of Creation. However, it does not count as a summoned creature and is not affected by Spawning Power. Despite this classification, it is not affected by sulfur.
a0c0204ad249ead82d7eabb8942a89a17fd87e26.text: 暗殺者 被視為 生靈天賦、爆發增長 和 創物者恩賜 的建立生物。然而，它不算作召喚生物，也不受 召喚 的影響。儘管有這樣的分類，但它不受硫的影響。

cee682eb73c102449ec0366abafaa120bc087dba.source: Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.
cee682eb73c102449ec0366abafaa120bc087dba.text: 雖然 暗殺者 不計入小兵上限，但召喚一個會導致遊戲檢查玩家的小兵控制限制，可能會摧毀任何超過限制的小兵。

a1d012c6ffc1060cbd8cbdd1340ddc87f9af6aa8.source: The Assassin does not always target the foe targeted by the caster, but instead targets the foe closest to its creation point.
a1d012c6ffc1060cbd8cbdd1340ddc87f9af6aa8.text: 暗殺者並非總是瞄準施法者瞄準的敵人，而是瞄準最接近其創造點的敵人。

ccdff004e790b9982d0bddb8597b6bca7d9edaba.source: Very rarely, the assassin may survive indefinitely. This can occur if resurrected by an enemy-created Restoration spirit, as by Reborn Irukandji.
ccdff004e790b9982d0bddb8597b6bca7d9edaba.text: 在極少數情況下，刺客可能會無限期地生存。如果被敵人創造的 復甦 靈魂復活，例如由 Reborn 毒水母 復活，就會發生這種情況。

1f4a7cdb3263747da4bd1e8f120aa585138d646c.source: When sorting skills by type in the Skills and Attributes Panel, this skill is under its own "Melee Attack" category, while all the other melee attacks are in a separate "Melee Attack" category.
1f4a7cdb3263747da4bd1e8f120aa585138d646c.text: 在技能和屬性面板中按型別對技能進行排序時，該技能位於其自己的“近身攻擊技能”類別下，而所有其他近戰攻擊位於單獨的“近身攻擊技能”類別下。

92e45e020f7003d58c4aebee58c82c382afc5ed6.source: This skill ignores the effects of skills that provide health bonuses, such as Endure Pain, when calculating 50% of the health; the target's health needs to be 50% of what it would be without the bonus.
92e45e020f7003d58c4aebee58c82c382afc5ed6.text: 此技能在計算生命值50%時，會忽略提供生命值加成的技能的效果，例如忍耐痛苦；目標的健康狀況需要比沒有獎勵時的健康狀況高出 50%。

b41813e615f9e596be03bbc57728afc8a3cca141.source: Unlike most shouts, "I Am the Strongest!" ends if it's reapplied before it expires, triggering the effects of echoes.
b41813e615f9e596be03bbc57728afc8a3cca141.text: 與大多數人的喊叫不同，「我是最強的！」如果在過期之前重新應用，則會結束，從而觸發迴聲效果。

abe4a54da27b099ae4c1bd65a789bc19cbfbd0cc.source: Similarly to Illusionary Weaponry and Mantra of Signets, the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.
abe4a54da27b099ae4c1bd65a789bc19cbfbd0cc.text: 與幻象武器和紋章頌歌類似，此技能提供的護甲僅在護甲運算結束時套用。因此，它不計入 +25 的額外護甲上限，也不會被 防禦穿透 減少。

ee68d18c4b3ba090eece9320dc6c71bfb61bc80c.source: Elite Skill. For 15 seconds, whenever you attack with a sword, all adjacent foes take 10…26…30 slashing damage.
ee68d18c4b3ba090eece9320dc6c71bfb61bc80c.text: 精英 技能。在 15 秒內，每當你用劍攻擊時，所有相鄰的敵人都會受到 10…26…30 的切割傷害。

fa80e657ae6550a642c6e6775248701c8ac7d394.source: Elite Stance. For 1…7…8 seconds, you move 33% faster and have a 75% chance to block attacks. Escape ends if you make a melee attack.
fa80e657ae6550a642c6e6775248701c8ac7d394.text: 精英 態勢。在 1…7…8 秒內，您可以更快地移動 33%，並有 75% 機會阻止攻擊。如果您進行近戰攻擊，脫逃 就會結束。

efdc7e180839b49e2c6cf68d4722a0ef542e40f3.source: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 5…41…50 holy damage. This signet has half the normal range.
efdc7e180839b49e2c6cf68d4722a0ef542e40f3.text: 精英 紋章。 目標 敵人被擊倒。該敵人和所有鄰近的敵人都會受到 5…41…50 神聖傷害。此圖章的範圍是正常範圍的一半。

3235314c4f21fdaec046775e71687119be7ee100.source: The description omits to mention that all pets in the party are affected as well.
3235314c4f21fdaec046775e71687119be7ee100.text: 描述中沒有提及隊伍中的所有寵物也會受到影響。

84a1b9f408006a253f42c1422dd86a3b066d2a9c.source: The concise description omits that the additional damage only applies to attacks.
84a1b9f408006a253f42c1422dd86a3b066d2a9c.text: 簡潔的描述省略了額外傷害僅適用於攻擊。

93bb0156fb41e42c9606cb9e80dfcccc164a5cb1.source: The actual range is in the area.
93bb0156fb41e42c9606cb9e80dfcccc164a5cb1.text: 實際範圍是在該區域內。

db30bda8ceea7fc852a7ee91386a74af08ff80da.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target moves 50% slower and suffers -2…5…6 Health degeneration.
db30bda8ceea7fc852a7ee91386a74af08ff80da.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒內，目標移動 50% 的速度變慢並遭受 -2…5…6 體力衰減效果 的影響。

4dc0ce1ca119177f80f28b21fbae5fd092c61fac.source: Elite Stance. For 20 seconds you have an additional 90…258…300 Health and an additional 20 armor.
4dc0ce1ca119177f80f28b21fbae5fd092c61fac.text: 精英 態勢。在 20 秒內，您擁有額外的 90…258…300 體力 和額外的 20 裝甲。

85ecb6e947517593acab39e6dbd57028e3aa3350.source: Elite Stance. For 5…29…35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. Warrior's Endurance cannot raise your Energy above 10…22…25.
85ecb6e947517593acab39e6dbd57028e3aa3350.text: 精英 態勢。在 5…29…35 秒內，每次近戰攻擊命中時，您都會獲得 3 能量。 戰士忍耐態勢 無法將 能量 提升至高於 10…22…25。

a0aa5369b3056651ee3e81b0cc35be94083ebd70.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0…3…4 conditions and hex[es]. For 1…3…3 seconds, conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
a0aa5369b3056651ee3e81b0cc35be94083ebd70.text: 精英 加持魔法。 目標 盟友失去 0…3…4 條件和十六進位[es]。對於 1…3…3 秒，該盟友的條件和咒語會更快到期 90%。您的所有 懲戒祈禱 都會停用 20 秒。

084129c3c4ee98f110749f65186dfbc1478c2a5b.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. If you stop maintaining this enchantment or if this enchantment is removed, that party member dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Deaths while enchanted with Unyielding Aura do not incur a death penalty. (50% failure chance with Divine Favor 4 or less.)
084129c3c4ee98f110749f65186dfbc1478c2a5b.text: 精英 加持魔法。在完整的 體力 和完整的 能量 下使目標死去的隊員復活。如果你停止維持這個結界或如果這個結界被移除，該隊員就會死亡並留下一具被剝削的屍體。被 堅毅靈氣 附魔時死亡不會導致死刑。 （50% 失敗機率與 神恩 4 或更少。）

7795d3a7eb1f91240d23938ecd9d3a763fce9625.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe suffers from a new condition, all foes in the area suffer from that condition as well.
7795d3a7eb1f91240d23938ecd9d3a763fce9625.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 5…13…15 秒內，每當目標敵人遭受新狀況時，該區域中的所有敵人也會遭受該狀況。

cb36b625695923c671c80d4458f641a1602dd6dd.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit. Instead, Illusionary Weaponry deals 20…52…60 damage to your targets for each melee attack.
cb36b625695923c671c80d4458f641a1602dd6dd.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 30 秒內，你的近戰攻擊既沒有擊中也沒有擊中。相反，幻象武器 每次近戰攻擊都會對目標造成 20…52…60 傷害。

39b2b6021b623cb6acbd00bd757aa86a867b052d.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 4…14…16 seconds, target foe suffers -1…7…8 Health degeneration and takes 100% longer to activate skills.
39b2b6021b623cb6acbd00bd757aa86a867b052d.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 4…14…16 秒內，目標敵人會受到 -1…7…8 體力衰減效果 的影響，並需要 100% 更長的時間來啟動技能。

34a096ba954ef4735bae1e0a51245595374e922f.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10 seconds, each time you cast a spell, you gain 1…3…3 Energy and 5…17…20 Health for each enchantment on you.
34a096ba954ef4735bae1e0a51245595374e922f.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 10 秒內，每次施放法術時，身上的每個結界都會獲得 1…3…3 能量 和 5…17…20 體力 。

9d013eddd14a893bffb6f3b1f81839e77a963e1e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 10…38…45 seconds, you take 33% less damage from foes under the effects of Water Magic hexes. Whenever you cast an elemental spell, all non-spirit allies in earshot are healed for 50…210…250% of the Energy cost of the spell. This spell does not heal allies above 80% Health.
9d013eddd14a893bffb6f3b1f81839e77a963e1e.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 10…38…45 秒內，您在 水系魔法 六角形效果下受到的敵人傷害會減少 33%。每當你施展元素法術時，聽力範圍內的所有非靈魂盟友都會受到該法術 能量 費用的 50…210…250% 治療。此法術不會治癒 80% 體力 以上的盟友。

31c1846b9183934b7dfa8f20320cf1e6f94320ac.source: Elite Ward Spell. Create a Ward Against Harm at this location. For 5…13…15 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have +1…3…3 health regeneration, +12…22…24 armor, and an additional +12…22…24 armor against elemental damage. This spell is disabled for 30 seconds.
31c1846b9183934b7dfa8f20320cf1e6f94320ac.text: 精英 病房 咒文魔法。在此位置建立 守護結界。在 5…13…15 秒內，該區域的非精神盟友擁有 +1…3…3 生命恢復、+12…22…24 護甲以及額外的 +12…22…24 護甲來抵禦元素傷害。此法術將會停用 30 秒。

767cd1d257ba7f79453d4d71a6f4fb20ed2b3e58.source: Elite Hammer Attack. If Enraged Smash hits, you gain 1…3…3 strikes of adrenaline. If you hit a moving foe, you strike for +10…34…40 damage, and target foe is knocked down.
767cd1d257ba7f79453d4d71a6f4fb20ed2b3e58.text: 精英 鎚術技能。如果 憤怒猛擊 命中，您將獲得 1…3…3 的腎上腺素打擊。如果你擊中移動的敵人，你會造成 +10…34…40 傷害，目標敵人會被擊倒。

893bf49f527fb27ac9dc4fc660f1357b3bac301f.source: Elite Stance. For 1…7…9 seconds, you attack 33% faster and move 33% faster, but you take 200…160…150% damage .
893bf49f527fb27ac9dc4fc660f1357b3bac301f.text: 精英 態勢。在 1…7…9 秒內，您可以更快地攻擊 33% 並更快地移動 33%，但您會受到 200…160…150% 傷害。

73bce4eb23733169713a24aab73d62f43c7c32ea.source: Elite Pet Attack. Your animal companion attempts an Enraged Lunge that deals +3…19…23 damage (maximum bonus 60) for each recharging Beast Mastery skill.
73bce4eb23733169713a24aab73d62f43c7c32ea.text: 精英 寵物攻擊。您的動物夥伴嘗試使用 暴怒衝刺，每次充電 野獸支配 技能都會造成 +3…19…23 傷害（最大獎勵 60）。

0bdf362e7b1de88c2dbdb1c44b6e8164c03184e5.source: Elite Skill. If you or your animal companion are below 75% Health, you are both healed for 25…121…145 Health. If your companion is dead, it is resurrected with 50% Health.
0bdf362e7b1de88c2dbdb1c44b6e8164c03184e5.text: 精英 技能。如果您或您的動物伴侶低於 75% 體力，則您都會獲得 25…121…145 體力 的療癒。如果你的同伴死了，它會透過 50% 體力 復活。

ae6d50fd7693103ee35f372045439c20f4f4d5d2.source: Elite Preparation. For 10…30…35 seconds, your arrows strike for +6…16…18 damage if they hit and cause Bleeding for 10…18…20 seconds if they are blocked.
ae6d50fd7693103ee35f372045439c20f4f4d5d2.text: 精英 準備技能。在 10…30…35 秒內，如果你的箭頭擊中目標，會造成 +6…16…18 傷害；如果被阻擋，則會造成 流血 持續 10…18…20 秒。

ff54387e518f08693e209042cae778dc4005a230.source: The Spirit of Vampirism's attack skill is a monster skill independent of the Sunspear rank. Unlike the progression of other Sunspear skills after the May 17, 2012 update, Vampirism's life stealing continues to follow the progression prior to that update (i.e. maximum effectiveness is reached at Sunspear rank 10 instead of 5) even though the descriptions display 20 life stealing from rank 5 to 9.
ff54387e518f08693e209042cae778dc4005a230.text: 吸血鬼之魂的攻擊技能是一個獨立於怪物的技能。 日戟 。與五月之後其他陽矛技能的進展不同 17 , 2012 更新後，吸血鬼主義的生命竊取將繼續遵循該更新之前的進度（即達到最大效果） 日戟   10 而不是 5 ）即使描述顯示 20 從等級中竊取生命 5 到 9 。

90cfce552065a49f73e8fce72dd3e39d891a8b20.source: Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
90cfce552065a49f73e8fce72dd3e39d891a8b20.text: 雖然被歸類為形態，但施法者的外觀不會改變。

49bde38683d5362008e9a161a14476efb392c02e.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, your attacks deal holy damage. Whenever you use a Dervish attack skill, you lose 1 hex. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment, you are healed for 5…41…50 Health. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
49bde38683d5362008e9a161a14476efb392c02e.text: 精英 表格。在 10…74…90 秒內，你的攻擊會造成神聖傷害。每當您使用 神喚使 攻擊技能時，就會失去 1 十六進位。每當你失去 神喚使 結界時，就會獲得 5…41…50 體力 的治療。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

d5c4c97bb08775fc3e8a0aa303d2db7ef30bd099.source: Elite Form. For 10…74…90 seconds, you have +100 Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment you lose 2 conditions. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
d5c4c97bb08775fc3e8a0aa303d2db7ef30bd099.text: 精英 表格。在 10…74…90 秒內，你擁有 +100、體力、+30 元素護甲，並且你的攻擊會造成土壤屬性傷害。每當您失去 神喚使 結界時，就會失去 2 條件。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

7ae5d84696415982f795531f749619e7853f9b0c.source: Elite Scythe Attack. If this attack hits, target foe suffers from Bleeding for 5…17…20 seconds, and you lose 1 Dervish enchantment. If an enchantment is removed, target foe also suffers from a Deep Wound for 5…17…20 seconds.
7ae5d84696415982f795531f749619e7853f9b0c.text: 精英 鐮刀 攻擊。如果這次攻擊是命中，目標敵人會受到 流血 的影響，持續 5…17…20 秒，你會失去 1 神喚使 結界。如果結界被移除，目標敵人也會受到 重傷 的影響，持續 5…17…20 秒。

211dabba5c370bd89a1e43a30c92ffe293d25855.source: Elite Flash Enchantment Spell. For 2…7…8 seconds, you attack and gain adrenaline 25% faster.
211dabba5c370bd89a1e43a30c92ffe293d25855.text: 精英 快閃記憶體 加持魔法。在 2…7…8 秒內，您可以更快地攻擊並獲得腎上腺素 25%。

b5e9b968c6dfc374bfac1f93c68a435577272bdf.source: Elite Skill. (15 seconds.) Deals 10…26…30 slashing damage to all adjacent foes whenever you attack with a sword.
b5e9b968c6dfc374bfac1f93c68a435577272bdf.text: 精英 技能。 （15 秒。）每當您用劍攻擊時，都會對所有相鄰敵人造成 10…26…30 削減傷害。

c556b79edb58d23ec333f05b20a694e787da6038.source: Elite Stance. (1…7…8 seconds.) You move 33% faster and have 75% chance to block. Ends if you make a melee attack.
c556b79edb58d23ec333f05b20a694e787da6038.text: 精英 態勢。 （1…7…8 秒。）您移動 33% 的速度更快，並且有 75% 的機會​​進行阻擋。如果您進行近戰攻擊，則結束。

321dcabead761efa3bf347f56f76622ce1047635.source: Elite Half Range Signet. Knocks down target. Deals 5…41…50 holy damage to target and adjacent foes.
321dcabead761efa3bf347f56f76622ce1047635.text: 精英 一半 攻擊距離 紋章。擊倒目標。對目標和鄰近敵人造成 5…41…50 神聖傷害。

9ec486aab4c6e2c0f91dc9697ef511a67c85ebf7.source: Elite Hex Spell. (5…17…20 seconds.) Target foe moves 50% slower and has -2…5…6 Health degeneration.
9ec486aab4c6e2c0f91dc9697ef511a67c85ebf7.text: 精英 降咒魔法。 （5…17…20 秒。） 目標 敵人移動 50% 的速度較慢，並且擁有 -2…5…6 體力衰減效果。

a9c0e90cf0d004ccd31651981a4f07ee569e342e.source: Elite Stance. (20 seconds.) You have +90…258…300 maximum Health and +20 armor.
a9c0e90cf0d004ccd31651981a4f07ee569e342e.text: 精英 態勢。 （20 秒。）您擁有 +90…258…300 最大 體力 和 +20 裝甲。

d215f894477b6a391aaa51999091b0e94471a3a2.source: Elite Stance. (5…29…35 seconds.) You gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. No Energy gain if you have more than 10…22…25 Energy.
d215f894477b6a391aaa51999091b0e94471a3a2.text: 精英 態勢。 （5…29…35 秒。）每次近戰攻擊命中時，您都會獲得 3 能量。如果您有超過 10…22…25 能量，則沒有 能量 增益。

b9c31b12170bc9e602b37af6fd87e76dd5cc3554.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Target ally loses 0…3…4 conditions and hex[es]. Conditions and hexes expire 90% faster on that ally (1…3…3 seconds). Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).
b9c31b12170bc9e602b37af6fd87e76dd5cc3554.text: 精英 加持魔法。 目標 盟友失去 0…3…4 條件和十六進位[es]。此盟友的條件和十六進位到期 90% 更快（1…3…3 秒）。停用 懲戒祈禱（20 秒）。

16ed370984ac42331c6a600ff46ed05b32238224.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. Resurrects target party member (full Health, full Energy). End effect: this ally dies and leaves an exploited corpse. Does not incur a death penalty. 50% failure chance unless Divine Favor 5 or more.
16ed370984ac42331c6a600ff46ed05b32238224.text: 精英 加持魔法。復活目標隊伍成員（完整的 體力、完整的 能量）。最終效果：該盟友死亡並留下一具被剝削的屍體。不會判處死刑。 50% 失敗的機會除非 神恩 5 或更多。

89a128302ff6dd7a3d62bfb6e28e5889455d3b35.source: Elite Hex Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) Foes in the area also have any new conditions that target foe acquires.
89a128302ff6dd7a3d62bfb6e28e5889455d3b35.text: 精英 降咒魔法。 （5…13…15 秒。）該區域中的敵人還具有目標敵人獲得的任何新條件。

4fe271c1b1840ed9af898aad56a54e58bdb9df94.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (30 seconds.) Deals 20…52…60 damage to foes in place of other damage or effects from melee attacks. Your melee attacks neither hit nor fail to hit.
4fe271c1b1840ed9af898aad56a54e58bdb9df94.text: 精英 加持魔法。 （30 秒。）對敵人造成 20…52…60 傷害，取代近戰攻擊的其他傷害或效果。你的近戰攻擊既沒有擊中也沒有擊中。

4dc7120d1a642fec2f3cad0912f4882fcf75daed.source: Elite Hex Spell. (4…14…16 seconds.) Causes -1…7…8 Health degeneration and doubles skill activation time.
4dc7120d1a642fec2f3cad0912f4882fcf75daed.text: 精英 降咒魔法。 （4…14…16 秒。） 導致 -1…7…8 體力衰減效果 並使技能啟動時間加倍。

d323e0c6e1e501e79054b31ba1ad931ad6c55c87.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) Each time you cast a spell, you gain 1…3…3 Energy and 5…17…20 Health for each enchantment on you.
d323e0c6e1e501e79054b31ba1ad931ad6c55c87.text: 精英 加持魔法。 （10秒。）每次你施展法術，你身上的每個結界都會獲得1…3…3 能量和5…17…20 體力。

eb3d7b212f84398f398fd20a6567f067e4d75a40.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10…38…45 seconds.) Take 33% less damage from foes hexed with Water Magic. Heals non-spirit allies in earshot for 50…210…250% of the energy cost of your elemental spells. Does not heal allies above 80% Health.
eb3d7b212f84398f398fd20a6567f067e4d75a40.text: 精英 加持魔法。 （10…38…45 秒。）受到 水系魔法 施咒的敵人造成的 33% 傷害減少。治療聽力範圍內的非精神盟友，花費 50…210…250% 的元素法術能量消耗。不會治癒 80% 體力 以上的盟友。

a10786af54aec26332ccf65ee4a8f10661df746d.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 3…13…15 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or casts a spell on a creature with less Health that foe loses 15…63…75 Health.
a10786af54aec26332ccf65ee4a8f10661df746d.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 3…13…15 秒內，每當目標敵人攻擊 體力 較少的生物或對其施法時，敵人就會失去 15…63…75 體力。

3fbe1dce50286f828020a04c4ba83d34eddb0955.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts the target foe's action. If that action is a skill, that foe and all adjacent foes are knocked down for 2…3…3 seconds. (50% failure chance with Fast Casting 4 or less.)
3fbe1dce50286f828020a04c4ba83d34eddb0955.text: 精英 咒文魔法。打斷目標敵人的行動。如果該動作是技能，則該敵人和所有鄰近的敵人都會被擊倒 2…3…3 秒。 （50% 失敗機率與 快速施法 4 或更少。）

66fc27742199703ac23f365e07d751ee15f5ec3b.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 1…8…10 seconds, spells cast by the target foe and all adjacent foes take 100% longer to cast. Spells you cast that target these foes take 50% less time to cast.
66fc27742199703ac23f365e07d751ee15f5ec3b.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 1…8…10 秒內，目標敵人和所有相鄰敵人施放的法術需要 100% 更長的時間來施放。你施放針對這些敵人的法術需要 50% 更少的施法時間。

bf2b79394347dafb969e5102fefc7941bffd629c.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 5…17…20 seconds, target foe and all foes in the area attack, cast spells, and move 33% slower.
bf2b79394347dafb969e5102fefc7941bffd629c.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 5…17…20 秒內，目標敵人和區域內的所有敵人進行攻擊、施法並減慢 33% 的移動速度。

cdaf7af495d06b8f878ea70f2a3cc80499fed03e.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5…13…15 seconds, all hostile spells that target you fail and all attacks against you miss. When Shadow Form ends, lose all but 5…41…50 Health.
cdaf7af495d06b8f878ea70f2a3cc80499fed03e.text: 精英 加持魔法。在 5…13…15 秒內，所有以你為目標的敵對法術都會失敗，所有針對你的攻擊都會失敗。當 暗影形態 結束時，遺失除 5…41…50 體力 之外的所有內容。

0f54b6b28bf6bce7aa1331b599279a066e1f8612.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 2…6…7 seconds, target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.
0f54b6b28bf6bce7aa1331b599279a066e1f8612.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 2…6…7 秒內，目標敵人不能成為結界的目標。

5622eb90e429086831c2c3e70fbcf7e8afffabb0.source: Elite Signet. You gain 3…10…12 Energy if you are within earshot of a spirit.
5622eb90e429086831c2c3e70fbcf7e8afffabb0.text: 精英 紋章。如果您位於靈魂的聽力範圍內，您將獲得 3…10…12 能量。

181fcc47cb97ab516c8badd84f6b2881eb538533.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…7…8 spirit. Whenever this spirit's attack hits a stationary foe, that foe is knocked down and the spirit loses 70…54…50 Health. This spirit dies after 30…54…60 seconds.
181fcc47cb97ab516c8badd84f6b2881eb538533.text: 精英 繫結儀式。打造1…7…8等級的精神。每當該精魂的攻擊擊中靜止的敵人時，該敵人就會被擊倒，並且該精魂會失去 70…54…50 體力。該靈魂會在 30…54…60 秒後死亡。

e60c9ba351a6345161fd92dfc2ca9464752891a4.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Every 4 seconds, this spirit heals one non-spirit ally in the area for 10…94…115 Health. This spirit dies after 90 seconds.
e60c9ba351a6345161fd92dfc2ca9464752891a4.text: 精英 繫結儀式。打造1…8…10等級的精神。每隔 4 秒，該精魂會治癒該區域內的一名非精魂盟友，持續 10…94…115 體力。該靈魂會在 90 秒後死亡。

7112baa9a47fe3a9ef4f1dfedb9fed235ec8d901.source: Elite Skill. For 5…37…45 seconds, your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge 25…45…50% faster. Soul Twisting ends after 1…3…3 Binding Rituals.
7112baa9a47fe3a9ef4f1dfedb9fed235ec8d901.text: 精英 技能。對於 5…37…45 秒，您的繫結儀式花費 15 較少的 能量（最低 5）並且充電 25…45…50% 更快。 生靈扭轉 在 1…3…3 繫結儀式後結束。

a37e4b1d2115147d3838aba8189ea39eb7d2605d.source: Elite Stance. For 1…8…10 seconds, you run 33% faster. Your next successful melee hit does +10…66…80 damage and this stance ends. This stance ends if you use a skill.
a37e4b1d2115147d3838aba8189ea39eb7d2605d.text: 精英 態勢。在 1…8…10 秒內，您可以更快地執行 33%。你的下一個成功的近戰攻擊會造成 +10…66…80 傷害，並且該姿態結束。如果你使用了技能，這個姿勢就會結束。

653a4cfe09711f69e99dee2ed464a597e519a2a4.source: Elite Stance. For 4…9…10 seconds, you attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
653a4cfe09711f69e99dee2ed464a597e519a2a4.text: 精英 態勢。在 4…9…10 秒內，您在喊叫或聖歌的影響下可以更快地攻擊 33%。

28b6eacc0a056c0855ebb21f4dfb6dbc77436f67.source: Elite Stance. For 1…16…20 seconds, you attack 15% faster and your Marksmanship attribute is increased by 1.
28b6eacc0a056c0855ebb21f4dfb6dbc77436f67.text: 精英 態勢。在 1…16…20 秒內，您攻擊 15% 的速度會更快，而您的 弓術精通 屬性會增加 1。

247a11a65e81336eb65aed2b29b7f8ee54a9be69.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Create a level 1…8…10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within its range gain adrenaline 33…59…66% as fast. This spirit dies after 30…102…120 seconds.
247a11a65e81336eb65aed2b29b7f8ee54a9be69.text: 精英 自然儀式。打造1…8…10水平精神。其範圍內的非靈體生物獲得腎上腺素 33…59…66% 的速度同樣快。該靈魂會在 30…102…120 秒後死亡。

b7528c856ef2f5dac061b32e4da0b0d0d55b4147.source: Elite Spell. All party members are healed for 5…57…70 Health. All your Smiting Prayers are disabled for 20 seconds.
b7528c856ef2f5dac061b32e4da0b0d0d55b4147.text: 精英 咒文魔法。所有隊伍成員都已為 5…57…70 體力 治癒。您的所有 懲戒祈禱 都會停用 20 秒。

3e9fa898ef5823ac2eaa654349f2b200abfef303.source: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, target foe and adjacent foes take 10…26…30 damage whenever they use a skill and 5…33…40 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
3e9fa898ef5823ac2eaa654349f2b200abfef303.text: 精英 降咒魔法。在 10 秒內，目標敵人和鄰近敵人在使用技能時會受到 10…26…30 傷害，如果沒有受到另一個 幻術師 十六進位的影響，則會受到 5…33…40 額外傷害。

0c37f4102b61670851ab59150c3a1bbac93fd88f.source: Elite Item Spell. Hold Glaive's ashes for up to 30…54…60 seconds. While you hold her ashes, all Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. When you drop her ashes, all foes in the area are struck for 15…71…85 lightning damage.
0c37f4102b61670851ab59150c3a1bbac93fd88f.text: 精英 物品 咒文魔法。保留 Glaive 的骨灰最多 30…54…60 秒。當你拿著她的骨灰時，所有 祭祀者 技能都有 10% 護甲穿透力。當你撒下她的骨灰時，該區域的所有敵人都會受到 15…71…85 閃電傷害。

3dd89f76563d9946f7ea0d7b873164ccd269105c.source: Elite Signet. Target allied summoned creature's attacks deal 5…29…35 more damage. After 10 seconds, that creature is destroyed.
3dd89f76563d9946f7ea0d7b873164ccd269105c.text: 精英 紋章。 目標 友軍召喚生物的攻擊造成 5…29…35 額外傷害。 10 秒後，該生物被消滅。

9ec66a75b2a9f4b339338b56bb99a99499cb035c.source: Elite Ward Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) Allies in this ward have +1…3…3 Health regeneration, +12…22…24 armor, and +12…22…24 additional armor against elemental damage. Spirits are unaffected. This spell is disabled for 30 seconds.
9ec66a75b2a9f4b339338b56bb99a99499cb035c.text: 精英 病房 咒文魔法。 （5…13…15 秒。）此病房中的盟友擁有 +1…3…3 體力再生、+12…22…24 護甲和 +12…22…24 額外護甲以抵禦元素傷害。精神不受影響。此法術將會停用 30 秒。

f6576884dad71fe3e53e7c23cfd10062cf98acc4.source: Elite Hammer Attack. Gives you 1…3…3 strikes of adrenaline if you hit. Deals +10…34…40 damage and causes knockdown if target foe was moving.
f6576884dad71fe3e53e7c23cfd10062cf98acc4.text: 精英 鎚術技能。如果你擊中，會給你 1…3…3 的腎上腺素衝擊。如果目標敵人正在移動，則會造成 +10…34…40 傷害並導致擊倒。

93a14ff0d3b993590864fd03116ddf88dca4d861.source: Elite Stance. (1…7…9 seconds.) You attack 33% faster and move 33% faster. You take 200…160…150% damage.
93a14ff0d3b993590864fd03116ddf88dca4d861.text: 精英 態勢。 （1…7…9 秒。）您攻擊 33% 的速度更快，移動 33% 的速度更快。您受到 200…160…150% 傷害。

11b544fea45d09fc5f01bbe0224e02faf348556b.source: Elite Pet Attack. Deals +3…19…23 damage (maximum 60) for each of your recharging Beast Mastery skills.
11b544fea45d09fc5f01bbe0224e02faf348556b.text: 精英 寵物攻擊。每個充電 野獸支配 技能都會造成 +3…19…23 傷害（最大 60）。

5f5426cc2c491fd8f8a0db18ae77443c6a28b8fc.source: Elite Skill. Heals you and your pet for 25…121…145. If your pet is dead, it is resurrected with 50% Health. No effect if neither you nor your pet are below 75% Health.
5f5426cc2c491fd8f8a0db18ae77443c6a28b8fc.text: 精英 技能。為 25…121…145 治癒您和您的寵物。如果你的寵物死了，它會透過 50% 體力 復活。如果您和您的寵物都不低於 75% 體力，則無效。

6d47bdb795e55b92bf088aadde9f17ad3da24354.source: Elite Preparation. (10…30…35 seconds.) Your arrows deal +6…16…18 damage. Inflicts Bleeding condition if blocked (10…18…20 seconds).
6d47bdb795e55b92bf088aadde9f17ad3da24354.text: 精英 準備技能。 （10…30…35 秒。）你的箭造成 +6…16…18 傷害。如果被封鎖（10…18…20 秒），則會造成 流血 條件。

5f94488cf11e8b092406bd9486763fad194cfef7.source: Elite Hex Spell. (3…13…15 seconds.) Causes 15…63…75 Health loss whenever target foe attacks or casts spells on a creature with less Health.
5f94488cf11e8b092406bd9486763fad194cfef7.text: 精英 降咒魔法。 （3…13…15 秒。）每當目標敵人攻擊 體力 較少的生物或對 體力 較少的生物施法時，都會導致 15…63…75 體力 損失。

731132e8ad8c8446a92a0ea7d15bc53fbb3c4f58.source: Elite Spell. Interrupts an action. Interruption effect: if the action is a skill, causes knockdown for 2…3…3 seconds on target foe and all adjacent foes. 50% failure chance unless Fast Casting 5 or higher.
731132e8ad8c8446a92a0ea7d15bc53fbb3c4f58.text: 精英 咒文魔法。打斷一個動作。打斷效果：如果該動作是技能，則對目標敵人和所有相鄰敵人造成 2…3…3 秒的擊倒。 50% 失敗的機會，除非 快速施法 5 或更高。

99c52b86fb2be06d1b1754557c15ce77127d4356.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes adjacent foes (1…8…10 seconds). Doubles spell casting time. Spells you cast on hexed foes have -50% casting time.
99c52b86fb2be06d1b1754557c15ce77127d4356.text: 精英 降咒魔法。也會對鄰近的敵人施咒（1…8…10 秒）。施法時間加倍。你對被詛咒的敵人施展的法術有 -50% 施法時間。

b4c7dd8504b6bffd256b08dedbc64d9690ea75de.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes in the area of your target (5…17…20 seconds). These foes attack, cast spells, and move 33% slower.
b4c7dd8504b6bffd256b08dedbc64d9690ea75de.text: 精英 降咒魔法。也會對目標區域內的敵人施咒（5…17…20 秒）。這些敵人會攻擊、施法並移動 33% 的速度變慢。

349cef0296aab8f898444b52f255a856faa4b989.source: Elite Enchantment Spell. (5…13…15 seconds.) Hostile spells targeting you fail, and attacks against you miss. End effect: lose all but 5…41…50 Health.
349cef0296aab8f898444b52f255a856faa4b989.text: 精英 加持魔法。 （5…13…15秒。）針對你的敵對法術失敗，針對你的攻擊失敗。最終效果：遺失除 5…41…50 體力 之外的所有內容。

fe2b78e2bec14ec5ab493ff999c26a374362b16b.source: Elite Hex Spell. (2…6…7 seconds.) Target foe cannot be the target of enchantments.
fe2b78e2bec14ec5ab493ff999c26a374362b16b.text: 精英 降咒魔法。 （2…6…7 秒。）目標 敵人不能成為結界的目標。

8b81beb1ea7160f15ae5f513dc7305a4fe0cdf34.source: Elite Signet. You gain 3…10…12 Energy. No effect unless you are within earshot of a spirit.
8b81beb1ea7160f15ae5f513dc7305a4fe0cdf34.text: 精英 紋章。您將獲得 3…10…12 能量。除非你在靈魂的聽力範圍內，否則沒有任何效果。

161f74f14c036e98954e09fa36fd6ffb52eb83a5.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…7…8 spirit (30…54…60 second lifespan). Its attacks against stationary foes cause knock-down. Knock-down cost: this spirit loses 70…54…50 Health.
161f74f14c036e98954e09fa36fd6ffb52eb83a5.text: 精英 繫結儀式。創造1…7…8級精神（30…54…60第二壽命）。它對靜止的敵人的攻擊會導致擊倒。擊倒費用：此戰魂失去70…54…50 體力。

097218ee8830d77a8803f99586c144dceea4186e.source: Elite Binding Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 Spirit (90 second lifespan). Every 4 seconds this spirit heals one non-spirit ally for 10…94…115.
097218ee8830d77a8803f99586c144dceea4186e.text: 精英 繫結儀式。創造1…8…10級精神（90第二壽命）。每隔 4 秒，該精魂就會為 10…94…115 治癒一名非精魂盟友。

93e97df92039469ec575784bec73cd5eae527493.source: Elite Skill. (5…37…45 seconds.) Your Binding Rituals cost 15 less Energy (minimum 5) and recharge 25…45…50% faster. Ends after 1…3…3 Binding Rituals.
93e97df92039469ec575784bec73cd5eae527493.text: 精英 技能。 （5…37…45 秒。）您的繫結儀式花費 15 減少 能量（最低 5）並且更快地充值 25…45…50%。在 1…3…3 繫結儀式後結束。

c0e4fce5120cb159309ca33c65be2a48af36facf.source: Elite Stance. (1…8…10 seconds.) You move 33% faster and deal +10…66…80 damage with your next melee hit. Ends when you hit or if you use a skill.
c0e4fce5120cb159309ca33c65be2a48af36facf.text: 精英 態勢。 （1…8…10 秒。）您移動 33% 的速度更快，並在下一次近戰攻擊中造成 +10…66…80 傷害。當你擊中或使用技能時結束。

402404ae3514e663f37108667c0709034972f8cb.source: Elite Stance. (4…9…10 seconds.) You attack 33% faster while under the effects of a shout or chant.
402404ae3514e663f37108667c0709034972f8cb.text: 精英 態勢。 （4…9…10 秒。）在喊叫或聖歌的影響下，您可以更快地攻擊 33%。

e8ec174346fed4f60e32c61482a4369631d44d09.source: Elite Stance. (1…16…20 seconds.) You attack 15% faster and you gain +1 to your Marksmanship attribute.
e8ec174346fed4f60e32c61482a4369631d44d09.text: 精英 態勢。 （1…16…20 秒。）您攻擊 15% 的速度更快，並且您的 弓術精通 屬性獲得 +1。

48c2121499f7125d14af26c6af940fecfc570cb7.source: Elite Nature Ritual. Creates a level 1…8…10 spirit (30…102…120 second lifespan). Adrenaline gain increases by 33…59…66% for creatures in range.
48c2121499f7125d14af26c6af940fecfc570cb7.text: 精英 自然儀式。創造1…8…10級精神（30…102…120第二壽命）。對於範圍內的生物，怒氣 增益增加 33…59…66%。

b457d58cd3d9fa538315f71e13b88d2026345eb5.source: Elite Spell. Heals entire party for 5…57…70. Disables your Smiting Prayers (20 seconds).
b457d58cd3d9fa538315f71e13b88d2026345eb5.text: 精英 咒文魔法。為 5…57…70 治癒整個隊伍。停用 懲戒祈禱（20 秒）。

67a5465e3f7b5da132ed8b82446cd4fd3c8fb184.source: Elite Hex Spell. Also hexes foes adjacent to target (10 seconds). These foes take 10…26…30 damage whenever they use a skill and 5…33…40 additional damage if not under the effects of another Mesmer hex.
67a5465e3f7b5da132ed8b82446cd4fd3c8fb184.text: 精英 降咒魔法。也會對目標附近的敵人施咒（10 秒）。這些敵人在使用技能時會受到 10…26…30 傷害，若沒有再受到另一個 幻術師 六角形的影響，會受到 5…33…40 額外傷害。

6df892941bed7bb4d1ae998393a52adc2dfa4f24.source: Elite Item Spell. (30…54…60 seconds.) Your Ritualist skills have 10% armor penetration. Drop effect: deals 15…71…85 lightning damage to all foes in the area.
6df892941bed7bb4d1ae998393a52adc2dfa4f24.text: 精英 物品 咒文魔法。 （30…54…60 秒。）您的 祭祀者 技能具有 10% 護甲穿透力。掉落效果：對區域內所有敵人造成 15…71…85 閃電傷害。

0d9843b2854c1d9b9789a733fbb32af8d1504155.source: Elite Signet. Target allied summoned creature deals +5…29…35 damage. That creature is destroyed after 10 seconds.
0d9843b2854c1d9b9789a733fbb32af8d1504155.text: 精英 紋章。 目標 盟方召喚生物造成 +5…29…35 傷害。該生物會在 10 秒後被消滅。

9d286410fd4b9b130e6b2269efcfc0563d1a1311.source: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) Deal holy damage. You lose 1 hex whenever you use a Dervish attack skill. Heal yourself for 5…41…50 Health whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
9d286410fd4b9b130e6b2269efcfc0563d1a1311.text: 精英 表格。 （10…74…90 秒。）造成神聖傷害。每當您使用 神喚使 攻擊技能時，您都會失去 1 十六進位。每當您失去 神喚使 結界時，請為 5…41…50 體力 治療自己。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

97d187e39d588c836e9431b5a2cf4db42894bfca.source: Elite Form. (10…74…90 seconds.) You have +100 maximum Health, +30 elemental armor, and your attacks deal earth damage. Cure 2 conditions from yourself whenever you lose a Dervish enchantment. This skill is disabled for 45 seconds.
97d187e39d588c836e9431b5a2cf4db42894bfca.text: 精英 表格。 （10…74…90 秒。）你擁有 +100 最大 體力、+30 元素護甲，並且你的攻擊會造成土屬性傷害。每當您失去 神喚使 結界時，即可治癒您自己的 2 狀況。此技能將被停用 45 秒。

87030dc8ef6ce157158cf705544c7dcaf8e4b9ba.source: Elite Scythe Attack. Inflicts Bleeding condition (5…17…20 seconds). Removes 1 Dervish enchantment. Removal effect: inflicts Deep Wound condition (5…17…20 seconds).
87030dc8ef6ce157158cf705544c7dcaf8e4b9ba.text: 精英 鐮刀 攻擊。造成 流血 條件（5…17…20 秒）。移除 1 神喚使 結界。移除效果：造成 重傷 條件（5…17…20 秒）。

30c29ec346ff98db91ca41c9892fb1d9e3a1372b.source:
*Unlike other scarabs, she is a ranged attacker.
*Sometimes she is hidden at first and won't pop up until a party member approaches her spawn point. 
*She is surrounded by several Scarab Nest Builders who use lots of traps. Melee characters should be especially careful.
*The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range.
*Kepkhet can be pulled and won't return to the nest if at least one of the Scarab Nest Builders has been killed.
*If she casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity which will remove Mark of Protection.
*Aurek the Scarab Hunter in Augury Rock (outpost) tells you of her existence and that he has been hunting her.
30c29ec346ff98db91ca41c9892fb1d9e3a1372b.text:
*與其他聖甲蟲不同，她是遠端攻擊者。
*有時她一開始是隱藏的，直到隊伍成員接近她的重生點時才會出現。 
*她周圍有幾個使用大量陷阱的聖甲蟲築巢者。 肉搏 字元要特別小心。
*如果受到平弓或長弓射程的攻擊，凱普凱特周圍的聖甲蟲巢穴建造者將不會移動。
*如果至少有一名聖甲蟲築巢者被殺死，凱普赫特可以被拉走並且不會返回巢穴。
*如果她對自己施放 守護印記，應用條件或十六進位將導致她使用 純淨的冥想，從而移除 守護印記。
*占卜之石（前哨站）中的聖甲蟲獵人歐列克告訴您她的存在以及他一直在追捕她。

Custodian Hulgar is erroneously referred to as Kesskah Shissh in Thirsty River's mission objectives.
9185b2c16a23d6c86d4839ed603f6f4e3e51bab5.text:
與大多數附魔盔甲不同，這個 Boss 被認為是肉質的。

在 乾枯河流 的任務目標中，監護人 Hulgar 被錯誤地稱為 Kesskah Shissh。

ab3f23a790d437496902c492e1bad8bd90700374.source: Unlike most enchanted armor, this boss is considered fleshy.
ab3f23a790d437496902c492e1bad8bd90700374.text: 與大多數附魔盔甲不同，這個 Boss 被認為是肉質的。

05df0df4e2abcb41bef3fb5eb5b3654a59fab5f5.source: This boss will occasionally run around in circles at an incredible pace.
05df0df4e2abcb41bef3fb5eb5b3654a59fab5f5.text: 這個boss偶爾會以令人難以置信的速度原地打轉。

a8d443c327102b6a248dd0ec90833c906cb5787c.source: * This Facet is guarded by Forgotten Arcanist and Crystal Guardians.
a8d443c327102b6a248dd0ec90833c906cb5787c.text: * 此方面由 被遺忘的秘術士 和水晶守護者守護。

5e136276bafb2d9d58d1d33a1148e6ddae10ef91.source: *Attacks in melee, despite being a Mesmer.
5e136276bafb2d9d58d1d33a1148e6ddae10ef91.text: *儘管是 幻術師，但仍會進行近戰攻擊。

4461ee28d7d8861d08f89d252e8d3c0332bd869e.source:
* Quickroot can be most easily found by entering Lornar's Pass from Beacon's Perch. He will be just off-radar to the left, on top of the hill. He shares this spawning location with Clobberhusk, Poisonbough, and non-boss Pinesouls, so it may be necessary to zone a few times in order to find him. It might be a good idea to check the two topmost spawnpoints each time you enter Lornar's Pass.
* He is hard to kill with the low level henchmen from Beacon's Perch, so it is recommended that you bring heroes or have a friend with heroes help you.
4461ee28d7d8861d08f89d252e8d3c0332bd869e.text:
* 透過從 畢肯高地 輸入 洛拿斯通道 可以最輕鬆地找到 敏捷之根。他將位於山頂上，位於雷達不到的左側。他與 Clobberhusk、Poisonbough 和非 Boss Pinesouls 共享這個生成位置，因此可能需要分割槽幾次才能找到他。每次進入 洛拿斯通道 時檢查兩個最上面的生成點可能是個好主意。
* 畢肯高地的低等級追隨者很難殺死他，所以建議你帶英雄或是有英雄的朋友來幫助你。

da8d422f0bff12a12054629ff0cb449eb701631b.source: * This boss might not spawn; he shares a spawn point with Erzek Runebreaker and Chunk Clumpfoot .
da8d422f0bff12a12054629ff0cb449eb701631b.text: * 這個 Boss 可能不會生成；他與 Erzek Runebreaker 和 Chunk Clumpfoot 共享一個重生點。

17e6d1d870bb7ea22f3c386e07a99d12e8f93914.source:
*Clobberhusk can be most easily found by entering Lornar's Pass from Beacon's Perch. He will be just off-radar to the left, on top of the hill. He shares this spawning location with Quickroot and Poisonbough, so it may be necessary to zone a few times in order to find him.
*Not only does he share three spawn locations with two other bosses, he also shares them with regular Pinesouls, so there may not be a boss present at one location at all.
17e6d1d870bb7ea22f3c386e07a99d12e8f93914.text:
*透過從 畢肯高地 輸入 洛拿斯通道 可以最輕鬆地找到 Clobberhusk。他將位於山頂上，位於雷達不到的左側。他與 敏捷之根 和 Poisonbough 共享這個生成位置，因此可能需要分割槽幾次才能找到他。
*他不僅與另外兩個 Boss 共享三個重生位置，還與普通松魂共享這些位置，因此一個位置上可能根本沒有 Boss。

dbfb47c6e80243919c12647128520effde5206d1.source: * This boss shares a spawn point with Tonfor Copperblood.
dbfb47c6e80243919c12647128520effde5206d1.text: * 該 Boss 與 Tonfor Copperblood 共享一個生成點。

20ef868ee9d6dbf97272cc951753bd1eec3f3bb8.source: * Brrrr Windburn has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
20ef868ee9d6dbf97272cc951753bd1eec3f3bb8.text: * 火焰牙布勒 在 碎石坡道 中具有三個可能的生成位置，他與其他三個 夢魘 Boss 分享這些位置。

6ede5fffe9c36406248823cddcecfc2a1c443dbd.source: * Seear Windlash has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses (Nighh SpineChill, Frostbite and Brrrr Windburn). The easiest way to obtain this skill is walking just outside of Camp Rankor. If he is not there, re-zone and repeat until he spawns.
6ede5fffe9c36406248823cddcecfc2a1c443dbd.text: * 疾風牙西爾 在 碎石坡道 中具有三個可能的生成位置，他與其他三個 夢魘 Boss（Nighh SpineChill、凍霜 和 火焰牙布勒）共享這些位置。獲得此技能的最簡單方法是在 藍口營地 外面行走。如果他不在那裡，請重新分割並重複，直到他生成。

6a09818738e4270e318323b73b95754b55b369b0.source:
* Nighh SpineChill has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him is to repeatedly zone from Camp Rankor until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* This boss spawns with a couple of Azure Shadows, thus it is wise to take skills that prevent knock down because of Signet of Judgment.
6a09818738e4270e318323b73b95754b55b369b0.text:
* Nighh SpineChill 在 碎石坡道 中有三個可能的重生位置，他與其他三個 夢魘 Boss 分享這些位置。
* 找到他最簡單的方法是從 藍口營地 重複區域，直到他在最近的位置生成，這樣可以輕鬆找到他。
* 這個 Boss 生成時帶有幾個 Azure Shadows，因此明智的做法是採用可以防止因 制裁紋章 而被擊倒的技能。

55c075cebd074db069486788c9efd8626e7916d8.source: * If left alone, the Mursaat will kill Bladestone easily as they move along the path.
55c075cebd074db069486788c9efd8626e7916d8.text: * 如果放任不管，馬賽特 會在 Bladestone 沿著路徑移動時輕鬆殺死它們。

4e397b31e50801665d4825ee25e637d20cff3792.source: * He can always be found right after the siege, which usually kills all of the remaining Mursaat Elementalists.
4e397b31e50801665d4825ee25e637d20cff3792.text: * 在圍攻之後，他總是可以被發現，圍攻通常會殺死所有剩餘的 馬賽特 元素師。

2e87a8110c30cb9d24d08a893748da72feb0720b.source: * Sniik Hungrymind is also close to Maak Frostfriend.
2e87a8110c30cb9d24d08a893748da72feb0720b.text: * 飢餓的斯尼克 也靠近 Maak Frostfriend。

5391d4e28caf423776f36901b66c2ff5acff31b1.source: * Gambol Headrainer has two possible spawn locations in the Ice Floe, which he shares with Skitt Skizzle.
5391d4e28caf423776f36901b66c2ff5acff31b1.text: * 精神混亂者根布 在 浮冰 中有兩個可能的生成位置，與 斯克史奇梭 共用。

df8c42d2120200b5765ac7a295f478637d7ab1d9.source: * Skitt Skizzle has two possible spawn locations in the Ice Floe, which he shares with Gambol Headrainer.
df8c42d2120200b5765ac7a295f478637d7ab1d9.text: * 斯克史奇梭 在 浮冰 中有兩個可能的生成位置，與 精神混亂者根布 共用。

a5b3c2bfa2679d4571d48a561e02dd7123e1d1df.source: * He has four possible spawn locations in the Ice Floe which he shares with five other Mursaat bosses, so he will not always be present.
a5b3c2bfa2679d4571d48a561e02dd7123e1d1df.text: * 他在 浮冰 中有四個可能的重生位置，與其他五個 馬賽特 Boss 共享，因此他不會總是出現。

c49d48ce0ced030964d7eda5a81f986af022f0e0.source: *He shares his spawning points in the Ice Floe with Mursaat Elementalist (boss), Mursaat Mesmer (boss), Jade Armor (boss), Mursaat Necromancer (boss) and Jade Bow (boss). However, there are only four spawning points, so it is possible that this boss will not spawn.
c49d48ce0ced030964d7eda5a81f986af022f0e0.text: *他與 馬賽特元素師 (boss)、馬賽特幻術師 (boss)、翡翠戰士 (boss)、馬賽特死靈法師 (boss) 和 翡翠弓手 (boss) 分享 浮冰 中的生成點。不過，生成點只有四個，所以這個頭目有可能不會生成。

0e33641eb05a21b10c5bf7b229150960a804dd15.source: * This boss shares his spawning points in Thunderhead Keep with Fuury Stonewrath‎, The Judge, Bolis Hillshaker, Ulhar Stonehound, and Riine Windrot.
0e33641eb05a21b10c5bf7b229150960a804dd15.text: * 此 Boss 在 雷雲要塞 中與 Fuury Stonewrath‎、審判者、Bolis Hillshaker、靈魂荊棘烏洛 和 腐爛氣息裡內 分享其產生點。

8c7013a73445ab94e6c02d89cabb38a1e361c726.source: * Perfected Armor shares his spawning location in the Thunderhead Keep Mission with Demetrios the Enduring, Pantheras The Deceiver, Chrysos the Magnetic, Perfected Cloak and Argyris the Scoundrel.
8c7013a73445ab94e6c02d89cabb38a1e361c726.text: * 完美盔甲 在 雷雲要塞 主線任務 中與不朽的 Demetrios、欺騙者 Pantheras、磁力 Chrysos、完美斗篷 和惡棍 Argyris 共享其生成位置。

72758871d54ca41d09767d7e7d1683d88222b8d6.source: * Perfected Cloak shares its spawning location in the Thunderhead Keep Mission with Demetrios the Enduring, Pantheras The Deceiver, Chrysos the Magnetic, Perfected Armor, and Argyris the Scoundrel.
72758871d54ca41d09767d7e7d1683d88222b8d6.text: * 完美斗篷 在 雷雲要塞 主線任務 中與不朽的德米特里奧斯、欺騙者黑豹、磁性者克里索斯、完美盔甲 和惡棍阿吉里斯共享其生成位置。

f5f1270f25efcfe76298c61dc77d587628c40f6d.source:
*It consistently spawns in Dreadnought's Drift, but rarely in the other areas.
*This boss spawns randomly, so you may or may not encounter it at any of its designated locations above.
*While fighting this boss, it is wise to spread apart so you can avoid its AoE spells.
*If you kill this boss while he is underground, for example by degeneration, he will not leave a corpse and thus you will not be able to capture his elite.
f5f1270f25efcfe76298c61dc77d587628c40f6d.text:
*它始終在 無懼者之丘 中生成，但很少在其他區域中生成。
*這個 Boss 是隨機產生的，所以你可能會也可能不會在上面的任何指定位置遇到它。
*在與這個 Boss 戰鬥時，明智的做法是分散開，這樣你就可以避免它的 範圍性 法術。
*如果你在這個boss在地下時殺死他，例如通過墮落，他不會留下屍體，因此你將無法捕獲他的精英。

310c6752a5bfc62c13b0ef684590d88939b81626.source:
*Attacks at melee range unlike Tundra Giants.
*Does not always spawn. To avoid starting from the beginning you can exit to Dreadnought's Drift then zone back to respawn bosses.
*Shares spawn locations with Thul Boulderrain.
310c6752a5bfc62c13b0ef684590d88939b81626.text:
*與苔原巨人不同，近戰範圍內的攻擊。
*並不總是產生。為了避免從頭開始，您可以退出到 無懼者之丘，然後回到重生 Boss。
*與 石冰雹修勒 共用生成位置。

a60f2d6662d699615c09dc81e1d5fa2a8831ba16.source: * His location is shared with two other bosses and therefore may not spawn.
a60f2d6662d699615c09dc81e1d5fa2a8831ba16.text: * 他的位置與另外兩個 Boss 共享，因此可能不會生成。

e2cf96b92789fb2426aedce9ffa8d10b0cb81607.source:
*Does not always spawn. To avoid starting from the beginning you can exit to Dreadnought's Drift then zone back to respawn bosses.
*Shares the same spawn locations with Kor Stonewrath.

Sometimes his death animation is repeated infinitely.
e2cf96b92789fb2426aedce9ffa8d10b0cb81607.text:
*並不總是產生。為了避免從頭開始，您可以退出到 無懼者之丘，然後回到重生 Boss。
*與 巖怒考爾 共用相同的生成位置。

有時他的死亡動畫會無限重複。

a9c1d2d9d1665689f26eff158812c246f577a9fc.source:
* It is easier to kill Marnta Doomspeaker if you first kill Cry Darkday, with whom she is always found; the other boss otherwise provides her with almost unlimited energy. 
* She is one of the few enemies in the game who does not have a conventional attack; she wields only an off-hand item.
* Unlike most bosses in the region, Marnta Doomspeaker is always found in the same location — a small cirque or corner near Camp Rankor.
a9c1d2d9d1665689f26eff158812c246f577a9fc.text:
* 如果你先殺死 死亡悲鳴，那麼殺死 厄運之言麻勒塔 會更容易，因為她總是和 死亡悲鳴 在一起；另一個頭目則為她提供了幾乎無限的能量。 
* 她是遊戲中少數沒有常規攻擊的敵人之一；她只使用一件副手物品。
* 與該地區的大多數 Boss 不同，厄運之言麻勒塔 總是出現在同一位置 - 藍口營地 附近的一個小圓環或角落。

7628dce1e563c618eb0fa52b1d89e6065496cb57.source: * Shares its three spawn locations with Old Red Claw and Featherclaw.
7628dce1e563c618eb0fa52b1d89e6065496cb57.text: * 與 古老的血爪 和 利爪培得 共用三個生成位置。

d4b1db7801bf4b11bef4a9e33643de0cb2772a54.source: * Fawl Driftstalker appears in one of four random spawn points that it shares with Didn Hopestealer, Sapph Blacktracker, and Sala Chillbringer.
d4b1db7801bf4b11bef4a9e33643de0cb2772a54.text: * 漂流惡魔帕窩爾 出現在與 希望竊賊迪得恩、黑暗追蹤者紗璞 和 刺骨惡魔紗拉 共用的四個隨機產生點之一。

e99eba45eda2de6f375a673aa18e0654894e68ce.source: * Unlike most Prophecies bosses, Cry Darkday is always found in the same location in Snake Dance - a small cirque or corner near Camp Rankor.
e99eba45eda2de6f375a673aa18e0654894e68ce.text: * 與大多數 阿斯卡隆戰記 Boss 不同，死亡悲鳴 始終位於 蛇舞 的相同位置 - 藍口營地 附近的小環或角落。

74c4c3eff1ab8f347f7ab8822a93be3d2fd2f346.source: * Sapph Blacktracker appears in one of four random spawn points that it shares with Didn Hopestealer, Fawl Driftstalker, and Sala Chillbringer.
74c4c3eff1ab8f347f7ab8822a93be3d2fd2f346.text: * 黑暗追蹤者紗璞 出現在與 希望竊賊迪得恩、漂流惡魔帕窩爾 和 刺骨惡魔紗拉 共用的四個隨機產生點之一。

862df3052f18052b419e1dbe575058e22a4ef877.source: * Didn Hopestealer appears in one of four random spawn points that it shares with Sapph Blacktracker, Fawl Driftstalker, and Sala Chillbringer.
862df3052f18052b419e1dbe575058e22a4ef877.text: * 希望竊賊迪得恩 出現在與 黑暗追蹤者紗璞、漂流惡魔帕窩爾 和 刺骨惡魔紗拉 共用的四個隨機產生點之一。

6337cdb8e42a90fc0d712c9f23f97de11d168a7a.source: * Featherclaw shares 3 spawn locations with Raptorhawk and Old Red Claw
6337cdb8e42a90fc0d712c9f23f97de11d168a7a.text: * 利爪培得 與 兇猛之鷹 和 古老的血爪 共用 3 產生位置

ef73cd3c7caba553e50c8dab04fee4034b976cbe.source:
* Old Red Claw shares 3 spawn locations with Raptorhawk and Featherclaw
* An easy way to get to this boss is to zone from Camp Rankor out to Snake Dance and head west.
ef73cd3c7caba553e50c8dab04fee4034b976cbe.text:
* 古老的血爪 與 兇猛之鷹 和 利爪培得 共用 3 產生位置
* 到達這個 Boss 的一個簡單方法是從 藍口營地 區域到 蛇舞 並向西走。

2f5a19af3938ce966aa1fe0ec87591402eb306d8.source: * Sala Chillbringer appears in one of four random spawn points that it shares with Didn Hopestealer, Fawl Driftstalker, and Sapph Blacktracker.
2f5a19af3938ce966aa1fe0ec87591402eb306d8.text: * 刺骨惡魔紗拉 出現在與 希望竊賊迪得恩、漂流惡魔帕窩爾 和 黑暗追蹤者紗璞 共用的四個隨機產生點之一。

117cac9d8fcf2564adf8f081a373685eb71f8735.source: * Gargash Thornbeard was named by Anastasios Kontostergios through the 2005 Brand The Boss contest.
117cac9d8fcf2564adf8f081a373685eb71f8735.text: * 刺鬍子格蓋須 由 Anastasios Kontostergios 在 2005 品牌 頭目 競賽中命名。

d447757f2e6a3d839b439e6d38ab4023eb6dc94b.source: * Morgriff Shadestone was named by Tamira Silverleaf through the 2005 Brand The Boss contest.
d447757f2e6a3d839b439e6d38ab4023eb6dc94b.text: * 暗石摩格力夫 由 Tamira Silverleaf 在 2005 品牌 頭目 競賽中命名。

7f74070cf59f6c3b05ca7627aed849ff77dc2da1.source:
* Frostbite has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him in Talus Chute is to repeatedly zone from Camp Rankor until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* He hardly ever spawns in the Ice Floe. On the other hand, be aware that he will only appear once you approach his location, which is near the tree in the center of the small area enclosed by a low wall right outside the gate of Thunderhead Keep. When Frostbite appears, 12 Azure Shadows will pop up from the ground and they can kill your whole party with a Signet of Judgment spike, so spread out.
7f74070cf59f6c3b05ca7627aed849ff77dc2da1.text:
* 凍霜 在 碎石坡道 中具有三個可能的生成位置，他與其他三個 夢魘 Boss 分享這些位置。
* 在 碎石坡道 中找到他最簡單的方法是從 藍口營地 重複區域，直到他在最近的位置生成，這樣可以輕鬆找到他。
* 他幾乎不會在 浮冰 中生成。另一方面，請注意，只有當您接近他的位置時，他才會出現，該位置位於 雷雲要塞 大門外被矮牆包圍的小區域中心的樹附近。當 凍霜 出現時，12 Azure Shadows 將從地面彈出，它們可以用 制裁紋章 尖刺殺死你的整個隊伍，所以分散開來。

6789301bf1f79cb5aa3d6f3b625b4ee733cb457a.source:
* Demetrios the Enduring has powerful healing skills which can make him fairly hard to kill. However he has little damage potential, so he can be ignored until the rest of his group is taken out.
* Interrupting Orison of Healing, disabling his skills, applying long-lasting daze or using punishment skills like Backfire greatly help getting him down.
* This boss has a one in six chance of spawning.
6789301bf1f79cb5aa3d6f3b625b4ee733cb457a.text:
* 不朽的德米特里奧斯擁有強大的治療技能，這使得他很難被殺死。然而他的傷害潛力很小，因此可以忽略他，直到他的團隊的其他成員被消滅為止。
* 打斷 治癒祈禱、停用他的技巧、施加持久的眩暈或使用 魔力反噬 等懲罰技能都有助於打倒他。
* 這個 Boss 有六分之一的機率生成。

e5f48da52f76f283d7cfd118135d4ca9fbe421ea.source: * Chrysos the Magnetic shares his spawning location in the Thunderhead Keep Mission with Argyris the Scoundrel, Demetrios the Enduring, Pantheras The Deceiver, Perfected Armor, and Perfected Cloak.
e5f48da52f76f283d7cfd118135d4ca9fbe421ea.text: * 磁力 Chrysos 在 雷雲要塞 主線任務 中與惡棍阿吉里斯、持久者德米特里奧斯、欺騙者黑豹、完美盔甲 和 完美斗篷 共享其生成位置。

f6287c890ad4e109f2fa01f7d898929fef7a4191.source: * This boss has a 1 in 6 chance of spawning, the other bosses that may spawn are Demetrios the Enduring, Perfected Cloak, Chrysos the Magnetic, Perfected Armor, and Argyris the Scoundrel.

e24be0f6d1d7699ca3cec80281ef1220dc127734.text:

Sometimes when this boss spawns in the north-east it will become stuck inside a wall.

e7da89523f113436f3207a432c16c95729a45692.text:
有時，當這個 Boss 在東北方生成時，它會被卡在牆內。

* This boss can appear in any of the three possible spawn locations, which he shares with two other Drake bosses.
