d05b274c94b0650ac7bc4424fb4ccdfd9047c2a4.source:
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible spawn locations, which he shares with Nayl Klaw Tuthan and Rwek Khawl Mawl.
* Does not always spawn, if he is not at the four locations above, rezone and try again.
* Immediately upon zoning into Perdition Rock, you can turn left and check one of his spawn locations without having to fight anything. You can keep rezoning until he does show up. 
* In hard mode, without some form of dedicated interrupt, this boss can be very difficult to defeat, especially with the Hydras that it is grouped with. A Wurm may also spawn in this area and make the battle even harder.
* This boss attacks with a hammer, even though its profession is Monk.
d05b274c94b0650ac7bc4424fb4ccdfd9047c2a4.text:
* 這個 Boss 可以出現在四個可能的生成位置中的任何一個，他與 尼爾可威圖單 和 魯克可威摩 分享這些位置。
* 並不總是出現，如果他不在上面的四個位置，請重新分割槽並重試。
* 進入 破滅石 後，您可以立即左轉並檢查他的重生位置之一，而無需進行任何戰鬥。你可以繼續重新分割槽，直到他出現。 
* 在困難模式下，如果沒有一些 型態 的專用中斷，這個 Boss 可能很難被擊敗，尤其是與它分組的九頭蛇。 地蟲 也可能會在該區域生成，使戰鬥變得更加困難。
* 這個boss用錘子攻擊，儘管它的職業是僧侶。

fead3204efbc714261a845aaf6149a4269858ef2.source:
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible spawn locations. It shares these locations with Nayl Klaw Tuthan and Rull Browbeater.
* Unlike other Hydras, this foe is susceptible to being knocked down.
fead3204efbc714261a845aaf6149a4269858ef2.text:
* 這個 Boss 可以出現在四個可能的生成位置中的任何一個。它與 尼爾可威圖單 和 恫嚇者勒爾 共用這些位置。
* 與其他九頭蛇不同，這個敵人很容易被擊倒。

faa2bd847fd2de47223379bfd1120e60c77da3c6.source:
* This boss can appear in any of the four possible spawn locations. It shares these locations with Rull Browbeater and Rwek Khawl Mawl.
* When capturing Glyph of Renewal, the easiest method to kill this boss is to turn left (west) as soon as you enter Perdition Rock and walk towards the wall while holding the hotkey to highlight foes. If Nayl Klaw Tuthan has spawned at the southernmost location you will be able to see it. Rezone until it shows, then fight your way there.
* Unlike other Hydras, this foe is susceptible to being knocked down.
faa2bd847fd2de47223379bfd1120e60c77da3c6.text:
* 這個 Boss 可以出現在四個可能的生成位置中的任何一個。它與 恫嚇者勒爾 和 魯克可威摩 共用這些位置。
* 佔領再生符號時，殺死該頭目最簡單的方法是進入破滅石後立即向左（西）轉，然後按住熱鍵突出顯示敵人，並向牆壁走去。如果 尼爾可威圖單 在最南端的位置生成，您將能夠看到它。重新劃定區域，直到出現為止，然後奮力前進。
* 與其他九頭蛇不同，這個敵人很容易被擊倒。

f57a5818b64be68dc245be1de1d4cc2e3ac10fd0.source:
* Once a player gets in radar range of his location, Harn Coldstone will spawn and begin his patrol around the island. He moves through many enemy mobs, which can make catching up with him complicated; be careful to not aggro too many enemies accidentally. See Harn and Maxine Coldstone (Zaishen quest) for additional strategies.
* He shares his spawn point with Maxine Coldstone, so only one of them can be present at one time. If you see Maxine, then Harn won't be on the map, and vice-versa.
* Harn is less likely to spawn than Maxine.
* He is the only Enchanted boss without the word Custodian in his name, and who is not located in the Crystal Desert.
*Unlike other Elementalists, he attacks at melee range.
Unlike most Enchanted, this boss is considered fleshy.
f57a5818b64be68dc245be1de1d4cc2e3ac10fd0.text:
* 一旦玩家進入其所在位置的雷達範圍內，冰石哈壬 將產生並開始在島嶼周圍巡邏。他會穿過許多敵人小怪，這會讓追上他變得很複雜；小心不要意外激怒太多敵人。有關其他策略，請參閱 冰石哈恩/麥辛（Zaishen 任務）。
* 他與 冰石邁申 共用出生點，因此一次只能出現其中一個。如果您看到 Maxine，則 Harn 將不會出現在地圖上，反之亦然。
* 哈恩比瑪克辛生成的可能性更小。
* 他是唯一名字中沒有「保管人」一詞的 附魔 老闆，並且不在 水晶沙漠 中。
*與其他元素使不同，他在近戰範圍內攻擊。
與大多數 附魔 不同，這個 Boss 被認為是肉質的。

790a8795de341e28c0528809e04d94b788f8d573.source:
* Once a player gets in radar range of her location, Maxine Coldstone will spawn and begin her patrol around the island. She moves through many enemy mobs, which can make catching up with her complicated; be careful to not aggro too many enemies accidentally. See Harn and Maxine Coldstone (Zaishen quest) for additional strategies.
* She shares her spawn point with Harn Coldstone, so only one of them can be present at one time. If you see Harn, then Maxine won't be on the map, and vice-versa.
* Maxine is more likely to spawn than Harn.
790a8795de341e28c0528809e04d94b788f8d573.text:
* 一旦玩家進入其所在位置的雷達範圍內，冰石邁申 將產生並開始在島嶼周圍巡邏。她穿過許多敵人小怪，這使得追上她變得很複雜；小心不要意外激怒太多敵人。有關其他策略，請參閱 冰石哈恩/麥辛（Zaishen 任務）。
* 她與 冰石哈壬 分享她的重生點，因此一次只能出現其中一個。如果您看到 Harn，那麼 Maxine 將不會出現在地圖上，反之亦然。
* 瑪克辛比哈恩更有可能生成。

add74f9502271f982b28b551a9858229c06d6e20.source:
*Obrhit Barkwood has five possible spawn locations in the Frozen Forest, which it shares with four other Pinesoul bosses - Afrhul Deeproot, Arkhel Havenwood, Esnhal Hardwood, and Unthet Rotwood.
*Every Pinesoul boss is accompanied by 3 Ice Imps.
*Sometimes one of these bosses doesn't even spawn at all.
add74f9502271f982b28b551a9858229c06d6e20.text:

*每個 松木怪 boss 都伴隨著 3 冰小惡魔。
*有時這些 Boss 之一甚至根本不會生成。

* Every Pinesoul boss is accompanied by 3 Ice Imps.
57616883223f82cb987d6aa7b94460a177960987.text:
* 硬木艾斯那 在 冰凍森林 中有五個可能的生成位置，它與其他四個 松木怪 Boss 共用 - 深根亞甫胡、精神木阿勒克爾、粗糙木奧布立特 和 腐爛木恩邪。
* 每個 松木怪 boss 都伴隨著 3 冰小惡魔。

2dedc3fd770f2e54323973d71c03e504139ff2d0.source:
* Unthet Rotwood has five possible spawn locations in the Frozen Forest, which it shares with four other Pinesoul bosses - Afrhul Deeproot, Arkhel Havenwood, Esnhal Hardwood, and Obrhit Barkwood.
* Every Pinesoul boss is accompanied by 3 Ice Imps.

Unlike most Pinesoul, this boss is non-fleshy (and thus his corpse cannot be exploited and he is immune to disease, bleeding, and poison). This may be intentional, as it is the only necromancer plant in prophecies, with a name "Rotwood" that suggest that it is an undead tree.
2dedc3fd770f2e54323973d71c03e504139ff2d0.text:
* 腐爛木恩邪 在 冰凍森林 中有五個可能的生成位置，它與其他四個 松木怪 Boss 共用 - 深根亞甫胡、精神木阿勒克爾、硬木艾斯那 和 粗糙木奧布立特。
* 每個 松木怪 boss 都伴隨著 3 冰小惡魔。

與大多數 松木怪 不同，這個 Boss 是非肉體的（因此他的屍體無法被利用，並且他對疾病、流血和毒藥免疫）。這可能是故意的，因為它是預言中唯一的死靈法師植物，其名稱“Rotwood”表明它是一棵不死樹。

f38682f89f81659dd218f33918ca7fb508df2bbd.source:

* 每個 松木怪 boss 都伴隨著 3 冰小惡魔。

31dcaa26c8ea4b418f3234f0da5940c97222ce8c.source: * Martigris shares his spawn points with Hilios the Dutiful, Feodor the Baneful, Balasi the Arcane, and Kratos the Foul and may not spawn.
31dcaa26c8ea4b418f3234f0da5940c97222ce8c.text: * Martigris 與 墮落射手荷立奧斯、邪惡術士斐奧多、奧術巴拉西和惡棍奎托斯共享出生點，並且可能不會產生。

fac1c5fb9321d875083ae6688f96131a970df277.source: * Kratos does not always spawn in the same location. All the possible spawn points are shared with Martigris the Stalwart, Hilios the Dutiful, Feodor the Baneful, and Balasi the Arcane.
fac1c5fb9321d875083ae6688f96131a970df277.text: * 奎托斯並不總是在同一位置生成。所有可能的生成點均與 墮落戰士馬蒂哥立斯、墮落射手荷立奧斯、邪惡術士斐奧多 和奧術巴拉西共用。

e7db38ab1f0462cf41cf7b8802ef83b95574fd4a.source: * Hilios does not always spawn in the same location. All the possible spawn points are shared with Martigris the Stalwart, Feodor the Baneful, Balasi the Arcane, and Kratos the Foul.
e7db38ab1f0462cf41cf7b8802ef83b95574fd4a.text: * 希利奧斯並不總是在同一位置生成。所有可能的生成點均與 墮落戰士馬蒂哥立斯、邪惡術士斐奧多、奧術巴拉西和惡棍奎托斯共享。

e6ebc6d414808e1392e671d344558cb401f7c617.source: * Feodor does not always spawn in the same location; all the possible spawn points are shared with Martigris the Stalwart, Hilios the Dutiful, Balasi the Arcane, and Kratos the Foul.
e6ebc6d414808e1392e671d344558cb401f7c617.text: * 費奧多並不總是在同一位置產生；所有可能的生成點均與 墮落戰士馬蒂哥立斯、墮落射手荷立奧斯、奧術巴拉西和惡棍奎托斯共享。

d8beba52abf642bca72d6dfd4d4394c14c2a46bf.source: * Balasi does not always spawn in the same location. All the possible spawn points are shared with Martigris the Stalwart, Hilios the Dutiful, Feodor the Baneful, and Kratos the Foul.
d8beba52abf642bca72d6dfd4d4394c14c2a46bf.text: * Balasi並不總是在同一位置生成。所有可能的生成點均與 墮落戰士馬蒂哥立斯、墮落射手荷立奧斯、邪惡術士斐奧多 和犯規者奎托斯共用。

ffb34e2e4da32ae258bee0126cbb516be0cbdf4a.source:
* Balt Duskstrider does not always appear. It shares its two possible spawn points with Ceru Gloomrunner and Digo Murkstalker.
* He seems to spawn most often by himself just inside the mouth of the Eidolon's cave.
ffb34e2e4da32ae258bee0126cbb516be0cbdf4a.text:
* 巴爾特·暮行者並不總是出現。它與 Ceru Gloomrunner 和 黑暗潛行者戴高 共享兩個可能的生成點。
* 他似乎最常在 艾多倫 的洞穴口內獨自生成。

a2d13f74f7dd66324bc3673b7e01d19d9ac7f10a.source:
* Digo Murkstalker does not always appear. It shares its two possible spawn points with Balt Duskstrider and Ceru Gloomrunner.
* Has 1280 health in normal mode.
a2d13f74f7dd66324bc3673b7e01d19d9ac7f10a.text:
* 黑暗潛行者戴高 並非總是出現。它與巴爾特·暮行者和塞魯·幽暗行者共享兩個可能的生成點。
* 在正常模式下具有 1280 健康狀況。

33e3ec131e4195a6e9e4a1570a36d6c6bd38f340.source: * He is in charge of interrogations and can read minds.
33e3ec131e4195a6e9e4a1570a36d6c6bd38f340.text: * 他負責審訊並能讀心術。

1f8e2a19f9757bf7996db736878f73a29a06fe35.source:
*Unlike Phantoms, Eidolons are fleshy.
*On the Ring of Fire islands, they drop Shiverpeak Key instead of Darkstone Key.
1f8e2a19f9757bf7996db736878f73a29a06fe35.text:
*與幻影不同，夜靈是肉質的。
*在 火環群島 島嶼上，他們會掉落 席娃山脈鑰匙 而不是 暗石鑰匙。

0236fbe045cabbdc28b65e0f9ecb56644ae0b617.source:
* After Markis dies, two additional Jade Armors spawn, and the mission will not end until those are dead as well, giving players time to capture Barrage.
** Alternatively if the aim is to capture Barrage, a member of the party can use Heart of Shadow (or Viper's Defense) to shadow step from the first bridge onto the level below, and the team can then use additional shadow steps to get to that party member. Avoiding crossing the end of the first bridge means that Markis does not begin running towards the end of the mission, and so the groups up to him can then be cleared out at the team's leisure.
* There is a spelling error in his dialogue. He says "vengence" instead of "vengeance".
0236fbe045cabbdc28b65e0f9ecb56644ae0b617.text:
* 瑪基思 死亡後，會產生另外兩件翡翠鎧甲，並且直到它們也死亡後任務才會結束，讓玩家有時間捕獲 齊射。
** 或者，如果目標是佔領 齊射，則隊伍成員可以使用 暗影之心（或 毒蛇防禦）從第一座橋到下方的暗影步，然後團隊可以使用額外的暗影步到達該隊員。避免越過第一座橋的末端意味著 瑪基思 不會在任務結束時開始奔跑，因此可以在團隊閒暇時清除他之前的隊伍。
* 他的對話中有拼字錯誤。他說的是「復仇」而不是「復仇」。

a040032321fd8d3ee8aa3440d542a54f97c9baf3.source: * It can be shutdown entirely by skills such as Ignorance because it only uses signets.
a040032321fd8d3ee8aa3440d542a54f97c9baf3.text: * 它可以透過 無知 等技能完全關閉，因為它只使用圖章。

f74a102c7fe9ac527f46a3eab884fdfac26b72f1.source:
*Unlike most other bosses with a monster skill version of Charm Animal, the regular version can't be captured from Thul The Bull.
*Thul The Bull spawns close to a level 15 Elder Wolf and can charm it if one of the nearby Stone Summit Rangers doesn't charm it first. He's unable to use his pet attacks without a pet.
f74a102c7fe9ac527f46a3eab884fdfac26b72f1.text:
*與大多數其他擁有 迷魅動物 怪物技能版本的 Boss 不同，常規版本無法從 公牛休爾 中擷取。
*公牛休爾 產生接近 15 長老 狼 的等級，並且如果附近的 石峰矮人 遊騎兵之一沒有先對它施展魅力，則可以對它施展魅力。如果沒有寵物，他就無法使用寵物攻擊。

c6d781732551af46d69808ac13474da5e8bb694c.source: * Syr Honorcrest has six possible spawn points in Mineral Springs, which he shares with five other Avicara bosses: Ryk Arrowwing, Myd Springclaw, Nhy Darkclaw, Wyt Sharpfeather, and Hyl Thunderwing.
c6d781732551af46d69808ac13474da5e8bb694c.text: * 光榮鬃毛西勒 在 礦物泉源 中有六個可能的生成點，他與其他五個 阿畢卡拉 Boss 分享這些生成點：箭翼裡克、鐵爪米德、黑爪恩亥、銳翅維特 和 雷翼合爾。

cfc18d160bb2d310becd9349d9eaf84bfaa1cc4f.source: * Ryk Arrowwing has six possible spawn points in Mineral Springs, which he shares with five other Avicara bosses: Wyt Sharpfeather, Myd Springclaw, Nhy Darkclaw, Syr Honorcrest, and Hyl Thunderwing.
cfc18d160bb2d310becd9349d9eaf84bfaa1cc4f.text: * 箭翼裡克 在 礦物泉源 中有六個可能的生成點，他與其他五個 阿畢卡拉 Boss 分享這些生成點：銳翅維特、鐵爪米德、黑爪恩亥、光榮鬃毛西勒 和 雷翼合爾。

5f0e613f8801bd5906aa6692174ac3d44d8e698c.source: * Hyl Thunderwing has six possible spawn points in Mineral Springs, which he shares with five other Avicara bosses: Ryk Arrowwing, Myd Springclaw, Nhy Darkclaw, Syr Honorcrest, and Wyt Sharpfeather. This doesn't apply while the quest Defend Droknar's Forge is active. Instead, he and all the Avicara bosses have a fixed location.
5f0e613f8801bd5906aa6692174ac3d44d8e698c.text: * 雷翼合爾 在 礦物泉源 中有六個可能的生成點，他與其他五個 阿畢卡拉 Boss 分享這些生成點：箭翼裡克、鐵爪米德、黑爪恩亥、光榮鬃毛西勒 和 銳翅維特。當任務 保衛卓克納熔爐 處於活動狀態時，這不適用。相反，他和所有 阿畢卡拉 老闆都有固定的位置。

4f2536d5719990b38f6fa181bb0b6e307fec5754.source:
*Unlike Phantoms, but like Eidolons, the Ice Beast is fleshy.
* South of the Ice Beast's location there is a Seer who can infuse any armor worn by the players in exchange for the Spectral Essence that the Ice Beast drops.
* Azure Shadows spawn around the Ice Beast.
* Does not spawn during the quest Defend Droknar's Forge. The Seer does not spawn either.
4f2536d5719990b38f6fa181bb0b6e307fec5754.text:
*與 Phantoms 不同，但與 Eidolons 一樣，冰獸 是肉質的。
* 冰獸 位置南邊有一個 預言者，它可以注入玩家所穿的任何盔甲，以換取 冰獸 掉落的光譜 模板:Reclaim Essence。
* Azure Shadows 在 冰獸 周圍產生。
* 不會在任務 保衛卓克納熔爐 期間產生。 預言者 也不會產生。

6dd98d87f35ecee03fbcd436e803e70810ecb41d.source:
* This boss can appear in any of the five possible spawn locations, which it shares with seven other Abomination and Phantom bosses. Keep in mind that there can be up to two bosses at each spawn location. There is also a chance that it doesn't spawn at all.
** When trying to find it for capturing its elite skill, it may be less frustrating to just run within compass range of the first spawn point, and if the boss is not there, teleport back to the outpost and try again, rather than fight through hordes of enemies on the way to the other spawn points.
6dd98d87f35ecee03fbcd436e803e70810ecb41d.text:
* 此 Boss 可以出現在五個可能的生成位置中的任何一個，它與其他七個 Abomination 和 幽靈 Boss 共用。請記住，每個生成位置最多可以有兩個 Boss。也有可能它根本不生成。
** 當試圖找到它來捕獲其精英技能時，在第一個重生點的羅盤範圍內執行可能不會那麼令人沮喪，如果老闆不在那裡，請傳送回前哨站並重試，而不是在前往其他重生點的途中與成群的敵人戰鬥。

102817202233689bb4b3fe7e1a4687cb630e7262.source:
* Shares his spawn point with Valetudo Rubor, Maligo Libens, Moles Quibus and Scelus Prosum.
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown. The two western locations is really one large area with three bosses. The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.
102817202233689bb4b3fe7e1a4687cb630e7262.text:
* 與 瓦雷修朵 魯巴、馬力哥 利本斯、摩雷 庫泊斯 和 賽勒斯 普洛桑 分享其產生點。
* 所有五個 Boss 都會在所示的四個位置產生。西部的兩個地點確實是一大片區域，三個boss。另外兩個重生點各有一個 Boss。
* 在西部重生點，可以看到一個 Boss 正在巡邏，而另外兩個 Boss 將在大約 5 分鐘後從熔岩中重生。

8822ffc1d97504e9a5deb5c1a093a1246cec5ee4.source:

* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.
8822ffc1d97504e9a5deb5c1a093a1246cec5ee4.text:
* 儘管是 遊俠，這個 Boss 仍使用近戰攻擊。
* 與 Tortitudo Probo、馬力哥 利本斯、摩雷 庫泊斯 和 賽勒斯 普洛桑 分享他的重生點。
* 所有五個 Boss 都會在所示的四個位置產生。西部的兩個地點確實是一大片區域，三個boss。另外兩個重生點各有一個 Boss。

* 所有五個 Boss 都會在所示的四個位置產生。西部的兩個地點確實是一大片區域，三個boss。另外兩個重生點各有一個 Boss。

c3472950c954f7368ad48e9c6323399e47b00596.text:
* 與 Tortitudo Probo、瓦雷修朵 魯巴、馬力哥 利本斯 和 賽勒斯 普洛桑 分享他的重生點。
* 所有五個 Boss 都會在所示的四個位置產生。西部的兩個地點確實是一大片區域，三個boss。另外兩個重生點各有一個 Boss。

66dd161f5097da10cc8c1cfa63aef31b7622d99c.source:
* Despite being an Elementalist, he runs up to opponents to use melee attacks and Inferno.
* Shares his spawn point with Tortitudo Probo, Valetudo Rubor, Maligo Libens, and Moles Quibus.
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown. The two western locations is really one large area with three bosses. The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.
66dd161f5097da10cc8c1cfa63aef31b7622d99c.text:
* 儘管是 元素使，他還是跑向對手使用近戰攻擊和 地獄火。
* 與 Tortitudo Probo、瓦雷修朵 魯巴、馬力哥 利本斯 和 摩雷 庫泊斯 分享他的生成點。
* 所有五個 Boss 都會在所示的四個位置產生。西部的兩個地點確實是一大片區域，三個boss。另外兩個重生點各有一個 Boss。

307119e52068ade2e700ff09bd7ec52dc529ba17.source:
Unlike most other Prophecies bosses, Undead Prince Rurik does not have Natural Resistance.
*Although Prince Rurik is undead in this form, holy damage does not deal extra damage to him, though the use of Deathbane weapons does affect him.
*This NPC has a miniature version.
*Undead Prince Rurik has a tonic form.
307119e52068ade2e700ff09bd7ec52dc529ba17.text:
與大多數其他 阿斯卡隆戰記 Boss 不同，不死族盧瑞克王子 沒有自然抗性。
*雖然盧瑞克王子在這個型態中是不死生物，但神聖傷害不會對他造成額外傷害，儘管使用Deathbane武器確實會影響他。
*這個NPC有一個縮小版。
*不死族盧瑞克王子 具有補品 型態。

529e095c937001a2d98e31c1d57d779d034d4510.source: * He shares his spawning point in Abaddon's Mouth mission with Cairn the Destroyer, Willa the Unpleasant, Sarlic the Judge, Mercia the Smug, and Optimus Caliph.
529e095c937001a2d98e31c1d57d779d034d4510.text: * 他在 地獄隘口 任務中與 破壞者凱恩、討厭的威拉、判官沙立克、驕傲的莫西亞 和 卡利發奧普利斯 分享其產生點。

f3b1f6e625262605b71f652f82c1ff677a80d766.source: * He shares his spawn point in the Abaddon's Mouth mission with Cairn the Relentless, Mercia the Smug, Optimus Caliph, Sarlic the Judge and Willa the Unpleasant. One of these bosses will always spawn alongside Cairn the Destroyer.
f3b1f6e625262605b71f652f82c1ff677a80d766.text: * 他在 地獄隘口 任務中與 無情的凱恩、驕傲的莫西亞、卡利發奧普利斯、判官沙立克 和 討厭的威拉 分享其出生點。這些 Boss 之一將始終與 破壞者凱恩 一起產生。

3b9af33c50e4484502c6d0ba89220bb6fe485497.source:
* Optimus shares his spawn point in the Abaddon's Mouth mission with Cairn the Destroyer, Cairn the Relentless, Mercia the Smug, Sarlic the Judge, and Willa the Unpleasant. One of these bosses will always spawn alongside Optimus.
* As his name translates to "highest ruler" (as described below) and because he acts as the leader of Mercia the Smug and Lazarus the Dire in Rise of the White Mantle, it is possible he is the leader of the Mursaat.
3b9af33c50e4484502c6d0ba89220bb6fe485497.text:
* 擎天柱在 地獄隘口 任務中與 破壞者凱恩、無情的凱恩、驕傲的莫西亞、判官沙立克 和 討厭的威拉 分享其產生點。這些 Boss 之一總是會與擎天柱一起生成。
* 由於他的名字翻譯為「最高統治者」（如下所述），並且因為他在 白斗篷 的崛起中擔任 驕傲的莫西亞 和 Lazarus the 兇暴的 的領導者，所以他有可能是 馬賽特 的領導者。

5ae5fe757509571aed655be4a5a3bc7c8bc26ca7.source:
*Shares 12 spawn locations with the other bosses in Sorrow's Furnace.
*Grognard Gravelhead may not spawn during some To Sorrow's Furnace quests.[Source claim needs verification]
5ae5fe757509571aed655be4a5a3bc7c8bc26ca7.text:

f7e42f9b3a3efcb84009de633b256182b0953c01.source:
* Strategy: After killing the two Chaos Wurms, head to the left side and kill the popups (there is no need to go to the right side (unless farming for ecto)). From the left side stairway, target the nearest Terrorweb Dryder and pull with a bow. That will pull the Darknesses as well, but if you back up enough the Darknesses will return, and the Dryders will still follow you. Do not retreat too far or the Dryders will break aggro and return.
** This pull usually only works once, once the Dryders return they cannot be pulled away again. Kill the Dryders and then the Darknesses will be alone. This is a good strategy for players that solo farm the Tomb of the Primeval Kings.
f7e42f9b3a3efcb84009de633b256182b0953c01.text:
* 攻略：殺死兩隻混沌亞龍後，前往左側擊殺彈出視窗（無需前往右側（除非種地外））。從左側樓梯，瞄準最近的恐怖網烘乾機並用弓拉。這也會拉動黑暗，但如果你備份得夠多，黑暗就會捲土重來，而乾燥者仍然會跟著你。不要撤退太遠，否則乾燥者會打破仇恨並返回。
** 這種拉力通常只能作用一次，一旦烘乾機返回，它們就無法再次被拉走。殺死乾燥者，黑暗就會孤獨。對於單獨耕種 先王之墓 的玩家來說，這是一個很好的策略。

20e33a3db80359c164caf54fd889e6eb2e52cbdf.text: *荊棘 穴居人可以在 碎石坡道 的東北部地區找到成對或三對的痕跡。

bafc398649ad37ab935682d9276b4d3ee5198314.source:
* Willa shares a spawn point in the Abaddon's Mouth mission with Cairn the Destroyer, Cairn the Relentless, Mercia the Smug, Optimus Caliph or Sarlic the Judge. One of these bosses will always spawn alongside Willa. All of these spawn points must be passed (but not necessarily defeated) in order to complete the Abaddon's Mouth mission.
* Willa can prove difficult to unprepared players, especially those with only Prophecies skills. Due to the quick activation times of Willa's skills Daze and Interrupt do not have much effect. Instead, try skills such as Backfire.
bafc398649ad37ab935682d9276b4d3ee5198314.text:
* Willa 在 地獄隘口 任務中與 破壞者凱恩、無情的凱恩、驕傲的莫西亞、卡利發奧普利斯 或 判官沙立克 共享一個生成點。這些 Boss 之一總是會與威拉一起生成。為了完成 地獄隘口 任務，必須通過所有這些重生點（但不一定被擊敗）。
* 對於沒有準備的玩家來說，威拉可能會很困難，尤其是那些只有 阿斯卡隆戰記 技能的玩家。由於威拉的技能 Daze 和 中斷 的啟用時間很快，所以沒有太大的效果。相反，請嘗試諸如 魔力反噬 之類的技能。

2199480dec5bdab57bd7fe66c47196af411e7c29.source: * Although only the two bosses Ferk Mallet and Vulg Painbrain share the two spawn locations, sometimes one of those locations is vacant and only one of those two bosses is present. 2199480dec5bdab57bd7fe66c47196af411e7c29.text: * 雖然只有兩個 Boss 巨鎚坡克 和 大力士弗格 共用兩個生成位置，但有時其中一個位置是空的，而這兩個 Boss 中只有一個存在。請注意，在南部位置產卵的 Boss 通常會在玩家進入雷達範圍後立即開始移動，如果玩家緩慢前進，則可能會在玩家在常規任務路徑上前進時從後面伏擊玩家。

7f7f7f6f1d4629c340c57c453d65147811390836.source:
* Despite being a Warrior, Root Behemoths can attack from bow range.
* The Life Pods popup when you get close to the Root Behemoths. Be careful approaching clustered Root Behemoths in Hard mode, since it can be very difficult to kill more than three or four Life Pods at once. If this happens, break aggro and attempt to pull the different groups apart.
7f7f7f6f1d4629c340c57c453d65147811390836.text:
* 儘管是 戰士，根巨獸仍可在弓箭範圍內攻擊。
* 當您靠近 Root Behemoths 時，生命 Pod 會彈出。在 困難模式 中接近叢集的根巨獸時要小心，因為一次殺死超過三到四個 生命 Pod 可能非常困難。如果發生這種情況，請打破仇恨並嘗試將不同的群體分開。

c03c8de382c656228a60ad25063b59b21f786168.source:
* Unlike other zombies, it does not take double damage from holy damage.
* Rotscale has 17700 health in Hard Mode. It's accompanied by two Damned Clerics, a Necrid Horseman, four Rotting Dragons, and three Skeleton Bowmasters.
* Five Smoke Phantoms popup at the bridge leading to Rotscale while fighting Rotscale and its group.
* Certain areas past the bridge around Rotscale periodically inflicts poison on party members and allies.
* You can pay for two buffs after summoning a Champion of Balthazar at the statue of Balthazar near the bridge to Rotscale:
** Morale Boost for {{cost|100}}: the usual +2% Morale Boost.
** Holy Blessing for {{cost|50}}: +25 maximum health and +3 health regeneration.
* While Rotscale can be killed during A Vengeance of Blades, doing so will not complete the related Zaishen Bounty.
* Rotscale is one of the few non-boss creatures that drops a unique weapon. Because it is not a boss, you cannot use a Signet of Capture on it.
c03c8de382c656228a60ad25063b59b21f786168.text:
* 與其他殭屍不同，它不會受到神聖傷害的雙倍傷害。
* 惡臭骨龍 在困難模式下具有 17700 健康狀況。它伴隨著兩名該死的牧師、一名 那奎德騎師、四名腐龍和三名 骷髏 弓箭手。
* 與 惡臭骨龍 及其團隊戰鬥時，通往 惡臭骨龍 的橋上會彈出五個煙霧幻影。
* 惡臭骨龍 周圍橋梁的某些區域會定期對黨員和盟友造成毒害。
* 在橋附近的巴薩澤雕像召喚勇士(公會戰頭銜)或巴薩澤後，您可以支付兩個增益效果到惡臭骨龍：
** {{cost|100}} 計程車氣提升：通常的 +2% 士氣提升。
** 神聖的 祝福 {{cost|50}}：+25 最大生命值與 +3 生命值復原。
* 雖然 惡臭骨龍 可以在 Blades 的 復仇意志 期間被殺死，但這樣做不會完成相關的 戰承懸賞。
* 惡臭骨龍 是少數掉落獨特武器的非 Boss 生物之一。因為它不是 Boss，所以不能對它使用 捕捉紋章。

943aad8a7f60fcd353f85fcad07c46322b84761b.source:
* Slaying Desnas will complete the above quest, regardless of whether the other Titans with it are still alive or not.
* Slaying Desnas in the hard mode quest will spawn two Wild Growths, unlike the normal version or Rotting Titans which spawn none and one respectively.
943aad8a7f60fcd353f85fcad07c46322b84761b.text:
* 殺死戴斯納斯將完成上述任務，無論其他泰坦是否還活著。
* 在困難模式任務中殺死戴斯納斯將產生兩個野生生長物，這與普通版本或腐爛泰坦不同，它們分別不產生一個和一個。

998a2a1174e7fa96039e444654b25e47a32735f3.source: * Shares his spawn point in Dragon's Gullet with Druul the Untamed, Lugg the Malignant and Staggh the Fervid.
998a2a1174e7fa96039e444654b25e47a32735f3.text: * 在 巨龍峽灣 中與狂野德魯爾、惡毒者拉格和狂熱者斯塔格分享他的重生點。

c39927d31812072b9ac524480750a644daf4ead4.source: * Shares his spawn point in Dragon's Gullet with Druul the Untamed, Lugg the Malignant and Phlog the Indomitable.
c39927d31812072b9ac524480750a644daf4ead4.text: * 在 巨龍峽灣 中與狂野的德魯爾、惡毒的拉格和不屈的弗洛格分享他的重生點。

d2af9c76df93f284a3e2d4d9cf3948c3e86ac816.source: * Shares his spawn point in Dragon's Gullet with Druul the Untamed, Phlog the Indomitable and Staggh the Fervid.
d2af9c76df93f284a3e2d4d9cf3948c3e86ac816.text: * 在 巨龍峽灣 中與狂野的德魯爾、不屈的弗洛格和狂熱的斯塔格分享他的重生點。

786eef5a7d12f9c4ab734147c36faca811e095d6.source: * Shares his spawn point in Dragon's Gullet with Lugg the Malignant, Phlog the Indomitable and Staggh the Fervid.
786eef5a7d12f9c4ab734147c36faca811e095d6.text: * 在 巨龍峽灣 中與惡毒者拉格、不屈者弗洛格和狂熱者斯塔格分享他的重生點。

448b2ee8d1e61c5ba4d5a402f331fef6a59108b4.source: * Ludo Ossidi roughly translates to 'I play with bones' in Latin.
448b2ee8d1e61c5ba4d5a402f331fef6a59108b4.text: * Ludo Ossidi 在拉丁語中大致翻譯為“我玩骨頭”。

40e99d654cdd67748e9b4b5b3e6263e6561113c7.source: * Custodian Fidius shares his spawn point with Ayassah Hess, Byssha Hisst, Custodian Kora, Cyss Gresshla and Dassk Arossyss. He may not spawn.
40e99d654cdd67748e9b4b5b3e6263e6561113c7.text: * 監護人 Fidius 與 苟斯艾歷士、Byssha Hisst、監護人 Kora、Cyss Gresshla 和 Dassk Arossyss 共享出生點。他可能不會產卵。

b358d5e97ba16cb3248555029b83719810eab903.source:
* It shares its spawning points in the Ice Floe with Mursaat Elementalist (boss), Mursaat Mesmer (boss), Mursaat Monk (boss), Mursaat Necromancer (boss), and Jade Armor (boss).
* You can walk from Thunderhead Keep and look round the corner to see if it has spawned.
b358d5e97ba16cb3248555029b83719810eab903.text:
* 它與 馬賽特元素師 (boss)、馬賽特幻術師 (boss)、馬賽特僧侶 (boss)、馬賽特死靈法師 (boss) 和 翡翠戰士 (boss) 共用 浮冰 中的生成點。
* 你可以從 雷雲要塞 走到角落看看它是否已經產生。

c69a53d273ebed13078d3ad39739ea2ff1f165ce.source: On the Dragons Throat Challenge Mission bosses may not be present at the points shown in green on the map and may require you kill the mobs in the area to trigger the boss spawn near the area marked on the map.
c69a53d273ebed13078d3ad39739ea2ff1f165ce.text: 在龍喉 挑戰任務 上，地圖上以綠色顯示的點可能不會出現 Boss，並且可能需要您殺死該區域中的小怪才能在地圖上標記的區域附近觸發 Boss 生成。

397a84eecd85176ab4be86108acfdfea7ef1bde4.source:
* The Afflicted Cho will spawn after The Afflicted Huu has spawned in this area.
* On the Dragons Throat Challenge Mission bosses may not be present at the points shown in green on the map and may require you kill the mobs in the area to trigger the boss spawn near the area marked on the map.
397a84eecd85176ab4be86108acfdfea7ef1bde4.text:
* 受影響的 Cho 將會在受影響的 Huu 在此區域產生後產生。
* 在龍喉 挑戰任務 上，地圖上以綠色顯示的點可能不會出現頭目，並且可能需要您殺死該區域中的小怪才能在地圖上標記的區域附近觸發頭目生成。

b48db46c9455233dd5cbf68aed3e0e7d9e9fd946.source: * This boss appears in two locations during Dragon's Throat.
b48db46c9455233dd5cbf68aed3e0e7d9e9fd946.text: * 此 Boss 在 龍喉 (挑戰任務) 期間出現在兩個位置。

a0b9e0ba999e7375c48e93f60668d9e327ebd16a.source: * On the Dragons Throat Challenge Mission bosses may not be present at the points shown in green on the map and may require you kill the mobs in the area to trigger the boss spawn near the area marked on the map.
a0b9e0ba999e7375c48e93f60668d9e327ebd16a.text: * 在龍喉 挑戰任務 上，地圖上以綠色顯示的點可能不會出現頭目，並且可能需要您殺死該區域中的小怪才能在地圖上標記的區域附近觸發頭目生成。

da8f8e7a392eadd51f98bd33786bd8347dd92ad1.source:
* Wing will not spawn in Bukdek Byway if the quest Chasing Zenmai appears in your quest log
* He is an ally during Deactivating P.O.X.
** The easiest way to capture Triple Chop is to let him die during the quest and capture it afterwards. 
** Alternatively, after he turns hostile, you can lure him down the stairs and past the peasants; once you force him to break aggro, he will be left stuck against a wall.

He sometimes gets trapped in the walls, preventing you from reaching any drops once he is killed.
da8f8e7a392eadd51f98bd33786bd8347dd92ad1.text:
* 如果你的任務日誌中出現了追逐 Zenmai 的任務，Wing 將不會在 巴德克小徑 中生成
* 他是停用 P.O.X 期間的盟友。
** 捕捉 三重砍擊 最簡單的方法是讓他在任務期間死亡，然後再捕獲。 
** 或者，當他變得敵對後，你可以引誘他下樓梯並經過農民；一旦你強迫他打破仇恨，他就會被困在牆上。

他有時會被困在牆壁裡，一旦他被殺，你就無法到達任何掉落物。

e708ec05f146929e994574ab697d07ed9541bf1b.source: * Jin, the Purifier will not spawn in Bukdek Byway if the quest Chasing Zenmai is active.
e708ec05f146929e994574ab697d07ed9541bf1b.text: * Jin，如果追逐 Zenmai 任務處於活動狀態，淨化器不會在 巴德克小徑 中產生。

45895cf6f16b1b1eb77edebc98ec94d59d37c7ad.source:
* Chung and two groups of Am Fah ambush the party as a player character approaches the spawning location marked on the map. 
* Chung's damage output is unusually high.
45895cf6f16b1b1eb77edebc98ec94d59d37c7ad.text:
* 當一名玩家角色接近地圖上標記的產卵位置時，Chung 和兩組 安費 伏擊隊伍。 
* 鄭的傷害輸出異常高。

fe5ad346f3f6c2d12259f11e7aa705c913df1236.source:
*Kenshi Steelhand will not spawn in Bukdek Byway if Chasing Zenmai is active.
*Kenshi Steelhand will spawn twice in Bukdek Byway if Eliminate the Jade Brotherhood is active.
fe5ad346f3f6c2d12259f11e7aa705c913df1236.text:
*如果「Chasing Zenmai」處於活動狀態，Kenshi Steelhand 將不會在 巴德克小徑 中產生。
*如果消除 翡翠兄弟會 處於活動狀態，Kenshi Steelhand 將在 巴德克小徑 中產生兩次。

82cfb1de0c227b0efcf37cb27e7fa01a8d68d612.source:
* She does not spawn in Wajjun Bazaar during Closer to the Stars.
* She appears as an ally during Deactivating P.O.X. (as Lian, Dragon Petal) and the Trial of Zinn.
** Since she is an ally during Deactivating P.O.X., an easy way to capture Double Dragon is to let her die in the quest and capture then.
* Does not spawn if The Gangs of Kaineng is active.
82cfb1de0c227b0efcf37cb27e7fa01a8d68d612.text:
* 她不會在靠近星星期間在 瓦江市場 中生成。
* 在停用 P.O.X 期間，她以盟友出現。 （如蓮，龍瓣）和津恩的試煉。
** 由於她是停用 P.O.X. 期間的盟友，捕獲 雙龍 的簡單方法是讓她在任務中死亡，然後捕獲。
* 如果凱能幫處於活躍狀態，則不會產生。

401512d28fdb3410800bb164ae89a77909631745.source: * Though Quufu has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns in the quest Straight to the Top.
401512d28fdb3410800bb164ae89a77909631745.text: * 雖然 Quufu 具有女性化的外觀，但在任務 分裂翡翠兄弟會 中，他被用男性代名詞指涉。

44548545813d893676df91d0980fe03aefd2ce79.source: * If you've completed the quest The Search for a Cure, you must begin (and complete) the Seek out Brother Tosai quest and all follow ups. Until you do, all of the Am Fah in the zone will remain friendly and he won't spawn until you finish the quest chain. If you choose the Refuse to Drink chain, Sun will spawn sooner, during A Monstrous Revelation.
44548545813d893676df91d0980fe03aefd2ce79.text: * 如果您已完成任務“尋找治療方法”，您必須開始（並完成）“尋找東齋兄弟”任務和所有後續任務。在您這樣做之前，該區域中的所有 安費 都將保持友好狀態，並且在您完成任務鏈之前他不會生成。如果您選擇「拒絕飲酒」鏈，「太陽」會在「可怕的啟示」期間更快生成。

ac04ac393bb900b9b2ea740c0d92d0099d6d6982.source:
* At first she seems alone in the Undercity, but once players approach her location a large group of Afflicted will popup. If they aren't aggroed the group will patrol away, leaving The Afflicted Miju alone again.
* She does not always spawn in the Undercity if the quest The Shadow Blades is active.
* She will not spawn after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her during Chasing Zenmai.
* During Winds of Change, Ming the Judgment, or later Dimsur Cheefai, spawns in place of The Afflicted Miju.
ac04ac393bb900b9b2ea740c0d92d0099d6d6982.text:
* 起初她似乎獨自一人在幽暗城，但一旦玩家接近她的位置，就會出現一大群受折磨者。如果他們沒有被激怒，這群人就會巡邏走開，讓受苦的 Miju 再次獨自一人。
* 如果任務 闇影 Blades 處於活動狀態，她並不總是在幽暗城中生成。
* 在 巴德克小徑 中與 Zenmai 交談，然後在追逐 Zenmai 期間與她一起進入幽暗城後，她不會生成。
* 在 變幻之風 期間，明審判或後來的 Dimsur Cheefai 會取代受折磨的 Miju 生成。

5b5b7683079a48e00ba6d44f6db699b51cf8e02d.source:
* He does not spawn during Chasing Zenmai, after you speak to Zenmai and entering the Undercity.
* He will also not spawn during Winds of Change.
5b5b7683079a48e00ba6d44f6db699b51cf8e02d.text:
* 在你與 Zenmai 交談並進入幽暗城後，他不會在追逐 Zenmai 期間生成。
* 他也不會在 變幻之風 期間生成。

f5116e25e9a4c59046aa9128a97cea27d498b380.source:
* If you go near him, he will walk all the way to the south-eastern corner of the Undercity, near Mina Shatter Storm.
* He will not spawn after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her during Chasing Zenmai.
f5116e25e9a4c59046aa9128a97cea27d498b380.text:
* 如果你靠近他，他會一路走到幽暗城的東南角，靠近米娜 粉碎風暴。
* 在 巴德克小徑 中與 Zenmai 交談，然後在追逐 Zenmai 期間與她一起進入幽暗城後，他不會生成。

c6419063861dfc7d266c22c4b46ec6f7260001e0.source:
* Before you aggro his group, he's clapping and laughing at three female Canthan Peasants, dancing for their Am Fah oppressors.
* He will not spawn after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her during Chasing Zenmai.
c6419063861dfc7d266c22c4b46ec6f7260001e0.text:
* 在你激怒他的團隊之前，他正在向三名女性 Canthan 農民鼓掌和大笑，為她們的 安費 壓迫者跳舞。
* 在 巴德克小徑 中與 Zenmai 交談，然後在追逐 Zenmai 期間與她一起進入幽暗城後，他不會生成。

39551ecce20cf58600e5dad122144fdc0b08bfa8.source: * He appears to be an exact copy of Lou, of the Knives.
39551ecce20cf58600e5dad122144fdc0b08bfa8.text: * 他似乎是 Knives 樂團 Lou 的翻版。

494b7add9d83beb5d2b2f1249ce4582432da004b.source: * After completing Cleansing Bukdek Byway, Tuila the Club spawns in the same location (and carries the same elite skill).
494b7add9d83beb5d2b2f1249ce4582432da004b.text: * 完成清潔 巴德克小徑 後，圖伊拉俱樂部會在同一位置產生（並具有相同的精英技能）。

aa96dad3c13c38442d5d83f433b763f4e29ad4bf.source:
* Replaced by the Am Fah boss Zu Jin the Quick after Cleansing the Sunjiang District.
* Rangers planning to capture Broad Head Arrow might wish to equip two Signets of Capture to obtain Equinox from Ranger's Construct who is a little further on the route.
aa96dad3c13c38442d5d83f433b763f4e29ad4bf.text:
* 清理 孫江行政區 後，由 安費 boss 快手祖金取代。
* 計劃捕捉 闊首箭 的遊騎兵可能希望裝備兩個捕獲徽記，以便從路線上稍遠一點的 遊俠 的構造體那裡獲取 晝夜。

7244922e2ff73e33f327ab3b437b10b5d5d3e46a.source:
*This boss will not appear until you approach the hole in the ground, at which point Li Yun and several Afflicted will popup.
*After Cleansing Shenzun Tunnels, she is replaced by Rai Zhon the Manipulator in Shenzun Tunnels. Rai Zhon spawns just northeast of Li Yun's spawn point.
7244922e2ff73e33f327ab3b437b10b5d5d3e46a.text:
*直到你接近地面上的洞時這個頭目才會出現，此時李雲和幾個受折磨的人會彈出。
*清理 申贊通道 後，她在 申贊通道 中被機械手 Rai Zhon 取代。雷忠在李雲的生成點東北方生成。

90af39b9ec875e268ac88f4cfd2ab5aee97d55fa.source:
* He will not appear in Sunjiang District if The Count's Daughter quest is active.
* He may be replaced by Fah Yu the Shadow's Eye after the first part of the Winds of Change, although Fah Yu spawns south of the "s" in Sunjiang.
90af39b9ec875e268ac88f4cfd2ab5aee97d55fa.text:
* 如果伯爵的女兒任務處於活動狀態，他將不會出現在 孫江行政區 中。
* 在 變幻之風 的第一部分之後，他可能會被 闇影 之眼 Fah Yu 取代，儘管 Fah Yu 在孫江的“s”以南生成。

51577952b074a7f7a1b152741a06b65f3863647e.source: * This boss is replaced by Uris Tong of Ash after completion of Cleansing Bukdek Byway.
51577952b074a7f7a1b152741a06b65f3863647e.text: * 清潔 巴德克小徑 完成後，該 Boss 被艾許的尤里斯唐 (Uris Tong) 取代。

40c33ed4b2f1b7d63d078c84e7a259c474a81738.source:
* Unlike the other Celestial bosses, his name is spelled the same in the cinematic after talking to Loud Kou.
* While in the mission and facing Adept Nai, the portal on the far right (southernmost) leads to this boss.
40c33ed4b2f1b7d63d078c84e7a259c474a81738.text:
* 與其他天界 Boss 不同，在與 Loud Kou 交談後，他的名字在動畫中拼寫相同。
* 在任務中面對 Nai 大師時，最右邊（最南端）的傳送門通往這個 Boss。

8bd0e128dcc6e3bc3c6b407ad16d61f0213c3653.source:
* In the cinematic after talking to Loud Kou, the name is written as "Tah Mu".
* While in the mission and facing Adept Nai, the portal up the right ramp leads to this boss.
8bd0e128dcc6e3bc3c6b407ad16d61f0213c3653.text:
* 在與Loud Kou對話後的動畫中，名字寫為「Tah Mu」。
* 在任務中面對 Nai 大師時，右側坡道上的傳送門通往這個 Boss。

1dd345973e2902b8959c1a0638009607f833289f.source:
* In the cinematic after talking to Loud Kou, the name is written as "Quon Sang".
* While in the mission and facing Adept Nai, the portal up the left ramp leads to this boss.
1dd345973e2902b8959c1a0638009607f833289f.text:
* 在與Loud Kou對話後的動畫中，名字寫為「Quon Sang」。
* 在任務中面對奈大師時，左側坡道上的傳送門通往這個 Boss。

82f9690c34443cf6dec14bd98d4e430847501a29.source:
* In the cinematic after talking to Loud Kou, the name is written as "Kai Jun Don".
* While in the mission and facing Adept Nai, the portal on the far left (eastern most) leads to this boss.
82f9690c34443cf6dec14bd98d4e430847501a29.text:
* 在與Loud Kou對話後的動畫中，名字寫為「Kai Jun Don」。
* 在任務中面對 Nai 大師時，最左邊（最東邊）的傳送門通往這個 Boss。

bec2440376b8bd8094ac5b5b54b83773e94e11e1.source:
* He will charm a nearby level 15 Elder Crane.
* Even though he uses a monster skill form of Charm Animal, you can only capture the regular version from him.
bec2440376b8bd8094ac5b5b54b83773e94e11e1.text:
* 他會迷住附近關卡 15 的老鶴。
* 即使他使用了型態或迷魅動物的怪物技能，你也只能從他那裡捕捉普通版本。

bf6059d925898f97f256f21ac540e2f25d48f074.source:
* Players would be wise to take out Ziinfaun first as he is quite effective at both healing and protecting.
* Several mantids popup when Ziinfaun is aggroed.
bf6059d925898f97f256f21ac540e2f25d48f074.text:
* 玩家最好先幹掉 Ziinfaun，因為他在治療和保護方面都非常有效。
* 當 Ziinfaun 受到攻擊時，會彈出幾隻螳螂。

a8977c1e94d6787bea9c6081941e80301d525a5d.source:
* Orosen will start running towards you when you reach the middle of the bridge (about twice the range of your aggro circle), followed by the rest of his group. This is useful because it can be used to pull him and his group onto the bridge where two Canthan Guards will engage him and they will be standing together so area of effect skills affect most of them, possibly making the fight easier.
** Even if you approach from the north, Orosen and his group runs to the Senji's Corner portal as soon as you enter compass range of their initial location. They start fighting the Canthan Guards around the portal when you get in compass range of their new location.
* It is highly advisable to pre-apply protection and keep your party spread out, because of Orosen's potentially high spike damage.
a8977c1e94d6787bea9c6081941e80301d525a5d.text:
* 當你到達橋中間時（大約是仇恨圈範圍的兩倍），奧羅森將開始向你跑來，後面跟著他的團隊的其他成員。這很有用，因為它可以用來將他和他的團隊拉到橋上，在那裡兩個凱森守衛將與他交戰，他們將站在一起，因此區域效果技能會影響他們中的大多數人，可能會使戰鬥變得更容易。
** 即使您從北方接近，一旦您進入他們初始位置的羅盤範圍，Orosen 和他的團隊就會跑向 山吉之街 門戶。當你進入他們新位置的指南針範圍內時，他們就會開始與傳送門周圍的凱珊守衛戰鬥。
* 強烈建議預先施加保護並讓你的隊伍分散開，因為奧羅森可能會造成很高的尖峰傷害。

8ad2059bf10cf5a54335cf37507a9466c32025ab.source: *As Kaolai was slain in such ancient times, his Construct form speaks an archaic dialect of Canthan speech, in the mission Tahnnakai Temple, instead of "common", the language shared across the world of Tyria.
8ad2059bf10cf5a54335cf37507a9466c32025ab.text: *由於考萊在如此古老的時代被殺，他的構造體 型態 在任務 譚納凱神殿 中講的是一種古老的凱珊語方言，而不是 泰瑞亞 世界共享的「通用」語言。

23c6d94a7e514ab23a2e869a1b5b350ea7540ac1.source: *To capture Shroud of Silence, Bound Vizu will need to be killed before the rest of the Afflicted on the center platform as slaying all of them triggers a cutscene and ends the mission.
23c6d94a7e514ab23a2e869a1b5b350ea7540ac1.text: *要捕捉 寂靜遮蔽，Bound Vizu 需要在中心平臺上的其他受影響者之前被殺死，因為殺死他們所有人會觸發過場動畫並結束任務。

ee57aee1030f75d641aa563f8e2a47fb8f5729e6.source:
* He has the same skills as Waeng and the two do not appear in the same instance of a zone.
* In Bukdek Byway and Shenzun Tunnels, this boss does not spawn until approaching his location.
** As with other areas in the game near bridges and tunnels, you might not be able to see his animated form until you get closer to him (especially in Shenzun Tunnels).
*Although he might seem to appear earlier, you can only kill him in his true spawning location, which can be identified by following the quest starburst or the maps on this page.
ee57aee1030f75d641aa563f8e2a47fb8f5729e6.text:
* 他與Waeng具有相同的技能，並且兩者不會出現在同一區域的例項中。
* 在 巴德克小徑 和 申贊通道 中，這個 Boss 在接近他的位置之前不會產生。
** 就像遊戲中橋梁和隧道附近的其他區域一樣，您可能無法看到他的動畫 型態，除非您靠近他（尤其是在 申贊通道 中）。
*雖然他看起來可能出現得更早，但你只能在他真正的產卵位置殺死他，這可以透過任務星爆或本頁上的地圖來識別。

a4c8ff98d39d9d8771851c663c1a7609d00e2bcf.source:
* Unreachable in the Sunjiang District explorable area until the Sunjiang District mission is completed.
* In the Sunjiang District mission, Shiro Tagachi can be seen floating out of the Warrior's Construct when it has been defeated.
a4c8ff98d39d9d8771851c663c1a7609d00e2bcf.text:
* 在 孫江行政區 任務完成之前，無法到達 孫江行政區 可探索區域。
* 在 孫江行政區 任務中，當 戰士 被擊敗時，可以看到 樣版:Shiro Tagachi 漂浮在 戰士 的構造體之外。

1c934dc500d84b584fda2eed445ff1c7878ecb0a.source:
* Players can capture Equinox from this boss prior to completing the Sunjiang District mission by waiting at the gate in the south west for it to patrol into flatbow range and pulling it.
* Rangers planning to capture Equinox might wish to equip two Signet of Capture to obtain Broad Head Arrow from The Afflicted Huan (ranger) who is on the way.
1c934dc500d84b584fda2eed445ff1c7878ecb0a.text:
* 玩家可以在完成 孫江行政區 任務之前從這個 Boss 捕捉 晝夜，方法是在西南大門等待它巡邏到平弓射程並拉動它。
* 計劃捕捉 晝夜 的遊騎兵可能希望裝備兩個 捕捉紋章，以便從路上的受折磨的胡安（遊騎兵）那裡獲得 闊首箭。

1a20ce17ccc19a903b1f949b0590518931bed4ec.source: * Unreachable in the Sunjiang District explorable area until the Sunjiang District mission is completed.
1a20ce17ccc19a903b1f949b0590518931bed4ec.text: * 在 孫江行政區 任務完成之前，無法到達 孫江行政區 可探索區域。

ef9ddb044695fa814cfd6daed20c3b783c261bfd.source:
* Unreachable in the Sunjiang District explorable area until the Sunjiang District mission is completed.
* If you are seeking to capture all elite skills, you may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture to capture Life Sheath from the Monk's Construct that you must pass on the way.
ef9ddb044695fa814cfd6daed20c3b783c261bfd.text:
* 在 孫江行政區 任務完成之前，無法到達 孫江行政區 可探索區域。
* 如果您想要獲得所有精英技能，您可能想要攜帶第二個 捕捉紋章，以從您必須通過的 僧侶 構造體中捕獲 生命保護。

1a50b70f9f56fb45b44767e8bb9e80ce0d494fe5.source: *After completion of Winds of Change, this boss appears alone in the Silent Surf.
1a50b70f9f56fb45b44767e8bb9e80ce0d494fe5.text: *變幻之風完成後，該頭目會單獨出現在寂靜之浪中。

68c958146a15ddee6e1f9ac79706f717b7ce8455.source: * During Return of the Yeti, Arrahhsh Mountainclub also appears in Mount Qinkai. You cannot obtain the Golden Lantern from his usual spawn in Pongmei Valley. That quest item can only be found in his Mount Qinkai spawn.
68c958146a15ddee6e1f9ac79706f717b7ce8455.text: * 在 Yeti 的 影返 期間，Arrahhsh Mountainclub 也出現在 今凱山 中。您無法從 朋美谷 中常見的生成點取得金燈籠。這個任務專案只能在他的 今凱山 生成中找到。

c957442eb9e95a49c38548eecb2f16ca72aa0b89.source: * He will only spawn when you get to the location on the map.
c957442eb9e95a49c38548eecb2f16ca72aa0b89.text: * 只有當你到達地圖上的位置時他才會出現。

a8ee7ac1b96404691f1afa38132660e84ab85ef3.source:
* Be careful when you approach Xuekao, as several Am Fah will drop down from the ceiling including in close proximity to him. 
** If you approach from Maatu Keep you can avoid most of the mobs, primarily the Jade Brotherhood.
** The remaining Jade Brotherhood will swarm to Xuekao's location and engage the Am Fah.
a8ee7ac1b96404691f1afa38132660e84ab85ef3.text:
* 當你接近雪考時要小心，因為幾個 安費 會從天花板掉下來，包括在他附近的地方。 
** 如果您從 麻都堡壘 接近，您可以避免大多數小怪，主要是 翡翠兄弟會。
** 剩餘的 翡翠兄弟會 將湧向雪考的位置並與 安費 交戰。

40f558a3add64adc3b670dab65fc126667bd5d13.source: * Be aware of his Star Burst, as the high damage from the skill is doubled and can be very deadly against grouped party members.
40f558a3add64adc3b670dab65fc126667bd5d13.text: * 注意他的 星爆，因為該技能的高傷害會加倍，並且對成群結隊的隊員來說非常致命。

32512fd2dc98dda7e0c315b90f6f87e7348da369.source: * Has an appearance similar to a Naga. Its name also suggests that the bound soul may be that of a Naga.
32512fd2dc98dda7e0c315b90f6f87e7348da369.text: * 外觀與 納迦 類似。它的名字也表明，被束縛的靈魂可能是 納迦 的靈魂。

2cc996ed39f46d020ed4bc8b0a7aaf9e095ed76c.source:
* Does not always appear in the Arborstone mission. It shares its one possible spawn point with Milefaun Mindflayer.
* Does not always appear if the quest Song and Stone is active.
2cc996ed39f46d020ed4bc8b0a7aaf9e095ed76c.text:
* 並不總是出現在 Arborstone 任務中。它與米勒法恩奪心魔共享一個可能的生成點。
* 如果歌曲和石頭任務處於活動狀態，則不會總是出現。

d7bfc30497af252c868f6e7b67fad6e345bed1ed.source: * Sometimes Dark Fang spawns inside the wall.
d7bfc30497af252c868f6e7b67fad6e345bed1ed.text: * 有時，黑暗之牙會在牆內生成。

715bbad1e848ce3778a7e1f4d4974f1a23e41161.source: * When going to capture Vampiric Spirit consider bringing another Signet of Capture as Craw Stonereap is along the way with Lingering Curse.
715bbad1e848ce3778a7e1f4d4974f1a23e41161.text: * 去捕捉 吸血之靈 時，請考慮帶另一個 捕捉紋章，因為 Craw Stonereap 與 強力詛咒 一路同行。

34daa05eb481c3f951fc3eedcff8baed7701d83a.source: *Frontliners should note that Shockwave can kill instantly without protection.
34daa05eb481c3f951fc3eedcff8baed7701d83a.text: *前線人員應注意，衝擊波 可以在沒有保護的情況下立即殺死。

ab71c618e8b021b03ee26ed93e588d9c06872bca.source: * The easiest way to capture this boss' Elite Skill is to start the mission and wait at the starting point until the timer reaches 8 minutes.
ab71c618e8b021b03ee26ed93e588d9c06872bca.text: * 捕捉該頭目的精英 技能最簡單的方法是開始任務並在起點等待，直到計時器達到8分鐘。

59dbacf080aec339ecf37606db1437143cf8cc69.source: * The easiest way to capture this boss' Elite Skill is to start the mission, go to her spawning point, and wait until the timer reaches 8:30 minutes.
59dbacf080aec339ecf37606db1437143cf8cc69.text: * 捕捉該 Boss 的 精英 技能 最簡單的方法是開始任務，前往她的重生點，然後等待計時器達到 8:30 分鐘。

f33821d08fe1d18127bd6cd2b28dc45f8d82e9cc.source: * Froth Stonereap is found just inside Altrumm Ruins when fewer than 9 minutes remain. It spawns in the northeast corner.
f33821d08fe1d18127bd6cd2b28dc45f8d82e9cc.text: * 當剩餘時間少於 9 分鐘時，可以在 奧楚蘭廢墟 內找到 Froth Stonereap。它在東北角生成。

ff3bf70dfcecff3759964e02d697b7187cfa9a95.source:
* The boss spawns with another Dredge Gardener and can be very hard to kill.
* Scourge Healing and Scourge Enchantment help to turn the battle in your favor.
* It is recommended to bring skills that punish and/or remove enchantments or skills like Backfire, Visions of Regret and Spirit Shackles to lower his energy and health fast.
* This boss is found in an area with lots of patrolling groups of Dredge. Be sure to clear these groups out individually before engaging this boss, as these patrols can quickly stack numbers against you.
ff3bf70dfcecff3759964e02d697b7187cfa9a95.text:
* Boss 與另一個 挖掘者 園丁一起生成，並且很難殺死。
* 災禍治癒 和 災禍加持 有助於扭轉戰局。
* 建議攜帶懲罰和/或移除結界的技能或 魔力反噬、懊悔幻想 和 精神束縛 等技能，以快速降低他的能量和生命值。
* 此 Boss 位於有大量 挖掘者 巡邏隊的區域。在與這個 Boss 交戰之前，一定要單獨清除這些隊伍，因為這些巡邏隊可以快速聚集人數來對付你。

e23fd804226d310e88a6bbf3772695038dba1667.source: * His Plague Signet sometimes fails in Normal Mode since his Curses level is not higher than 4 (Unknown in Hard Mode).
e23fd804226d310e88a6bbf3772695038dba1667.text: * 他的 疫病紋章 有時會在普通模式下失敗，因為他的 詛咒 等級不高於 4（在困難模式下未知）。

ed8c5f6b19305255353b2d76d98ff2f05316c2b9.source: * He can be pulled away from the group of Dredge he spawns in.
ed8c5f6b19305255353b2d76d98ff2f05316c2b9.text: * 可以將他從他生成的 挖掘者 群體中拉開。

431e6a97dacd1a3a1b7b5d03709b0a94557ba01b.source: * Falaharn Mistwarden uses the same skills.
431e6a97dacd1a3a1b7b5d03709b0a94557ba01b.text: * Falaharn Mistwarden 使用相同的技能。

6802070f524819270999db71da9e0bf7adf333d2.source:
* Chkkr Thousand Tail will fight with the nearby Warden patrols.
* Oni will sometimes spawn near Chkkr before you reach him, and kill him.
* Occasionally, his group will not spawn when you enter the bosses range. Instead, they will spawn when you spawn either Bezzr Wingstorms or Bazzr Icewings group. This can be confusing when vanquishing.
* There are a few monsters with very similar names, possibly a family name within the game.
** Chkkr Brightclaw
** Chkkr Ironclaw
** Chkkr Locust Lord
6802070f524819270999db71da9e0bf7adf333d2.text:
* Chkkr千尾將與附近的守望者巡邏隊戰鬥。
* Oni 有時會在你到達 Chkkr 之前在 Chkkr 附近生成並殺死他。
* 有時，當你進入頭目範圍時，他的隊伍不會出現。相反，當您產生 Bezzr Wingstorms 或 Bazzr Icewings 群組時，它們就會產生。這在征服時可能會造成混亂。
* 有一些怪物的名字非常相似，可能是遊戲中的一個姓氏。
** 檢查 光爪
** Chkkr 鐵爪
** Chkkr 蝗蟲領主

694967c3e9f8d715ed244bfb1d7b563bf53848ba.source: * Bazzr Icewing appears to be alone, but several Mantis will popup when you aggro it. However, it is possible to pull him away from a distance to avoid them.
694967c3e9f8d715ed244bfb1d7b563bf53848ba.text: * 巴茲冰翼似乎是孤獨的，但當你攻擊它時，會出現幾隻螳螂。不過，可以將他拉到遠處，避開他們。

c7134a4c9bc69ed124ed09a85f278bd860c2546a.source:
* Bezzr Wingstorm appears to be alone, but several Mantises will popup when you approach; the boss can be pulled with a longbow or flatbow. 
* The easiest route is from the Eternal Grove, but it will always be through Kurzick territory.
* Although Wingstorm requires 9 Domination Magic, Bezzr does not use skills of that attribute. 
* Some players consider the 200 wanding damage done by this Mesmer boss in Hard mode to be abnormally strong.
c7134a4c9bc69ed124ed09a85f278bd860c2546a.text:
* Bezzr 風暴 看起來很孤獨，但當你靠近時會彈出幾隻螳螂； Boss可以用長弓或平弓拉動。 
* 最簡單的路線是從永恆叢林出發，但總是會經過 庫茲柯 領地。
* 雖然風暴需要9 支配魔法，但Bezzr不使用該屬性的技能。 
* 有些玩家認為 困難模式 中 幻術師 boss 造成的 200 魔杖傷害異常強大。

c31f7a16b46011c78a881b8c7e39bb75b8b63201.source: *Since this boss spawns alongside another ritualist boss called The Pain Eater, it is advisable to bring two capture signets when skill hunting.
c31f7a16b46011c78a881b8c7e39bb75b8b63201.text: *由於該 Boss 與另一個名為 苦痛 Eater 的儀式 Boss 一起生成，因此建議在技能狩獵時攜帶兩個捕獲印章。

369f1a671b3f3af53630dd5f67f3b09f3029749f.source: * Since this boss spawns alongside another ritualist boss called The Skill Eater, it is advisable to bring two capture signets when skill hunting.
369f1a671b3f3af53630dd5f67f3b09f3029749f.text: * 由於該 Boss 與另一個名為 技能 Eater 的儀式 Boss 一起生成，因此建議在技能狩獵時攜帶兩個捕獲印章。

2a07df6074184eb8086645da7f62f0461d42e8ea.source:
* He is accompanied by Rot Foulbelly.
* He patrols a circular path in a clockwise direction, as indicated on the location map.
2a07df6074184eb8086645da7f62f0461d42e8ea.text:
* 他由 Rot Foulbelly 陪同。
* 他沿著順時針方向巡邏圓形路徑，如位置地圖所示。

8f1402c454c7432172e2b6002001fcfe419892aa.source: * He will be patrolling an area in a clockwise direction, accompanied by Nundak the Archer.
8f1402c454c7432172e2b6002001fcfe419892aa.text: * 他將在 射手傭兵 Nundak 的陪同下以順時針方向巡邏一個區域。

c153c6c111004e07b73fa87a8ce460550211c6c6.source:
*Upon the player or their party members moving into the alcove containing Byzzr Wingmender, several mantids will popup. These can be avoided by aggroing the boss from a sufficient distance.
*Against an armor rating of 70 in Hard mode, Byzzr Wingmender can easily hit for 150 wand damage, so strong healing or damage reduction is recommended.
c153c6c111004e07b73fa87a8ce460550211c6c6.text:
*當玩家或其隊伍成員進入包含拜茲護翼者的凹室時，將會彈出幾個螳螂。這些可以透過在足夠遠的距離攻擊 Boss 來避免。
*針對 困難模式 中 70 的護甲等級，Byzzr Wingmender 可以輕鬆擊中 150 魔杖傷害，因此建議強力治療或減少傷害。

2f335733ba72618cb9ea638bdcabff11328a0a96.source:
* He will charm a nearby level 15 Elder White Tiger.
* Even though he uses a monster skill form of Charm Animal, you can only capture the regular version from him.
2f335733ba72618cb9ea638bdcabff11328a0a96.text:
* 他會迷住附近等級的 15 長老 白銀之虎。
* 即使他使用了型態或迷魅動物的怪物技能，你也只能從他那裡捕捉普通版本。

df4ce7641859c922252ddfb4785c205995e7c178.source:
* When attempting to capture Locust's Fury, it should be noted that Chkkr is in a group all to himself. Every other group can be pulled away in small numbers.
* There are a few monsters with very similar names, possibly a family name within the game.
** Chkkr Brightclaw
** Chkkr Ironclaw
** Chkkr Thousand Tail
df4ce7641859c922252ddfb4785c205995e7c178.text:
* 當嘗試捕捉 蝗蟲暴怒 時，應注意 Chkkr 獨自一人在一個群組中。其他每組都可以少量撤走。
* 有一些怪物的名字非常相似，可能是遊戲中的一個姓氏。
** 檢查 光爪
** Chkkr 鐵爪
** Chkkr 千尾

70a46275d54b20f2847ee42a608f584f0fce18d8.source:
* If vanquishing this area, the mantids that spawn around Chkkr are easily avoided. If you stand at the top of the stairs located near this boss and attack him with a longbow, you can actually pull him to the top of the stairs to be safely killed away from his group.
* There are a few monsters with very similar names, possibly a family name within the game.
** Chkkr Ironclaw
** Chkkr Locust Lord
** Chkkr Thousand Tail
70a46275d54b20f2847ee42a608f584f0fce18d8.text:
* 如果征服了這個區域，Chkkr 周圍生成的螳螂就可以輕鬆避開。如果你站在靠近這個 Boss 的樓梯頂部並用長弓攻擊他，你實際上可以將他拉到樓梯頂部，然後安全地從他的隊伍中殺死他。
* 有一些怪物的名字非常相似，可能是遊戲中的一個姓氏。
** Chkkr 鐵爪
** Chkkr 蝗蟲領主
** Chkkr 千尾

ec382d0acfe067bfedf254aed0bd98fce370ea2f.source: * Tembarr can be pulled away from his Warden group.
ec382d0acfe067bfedf254aed0bd98fce370ea2f.text: * Tembarr 可以從他的守望者隊伍中被拉走。

0cd1025f656504bf788593df2b454837c11321a9.source: *When you go to capture his elite skill, take a second signet of capture, Healing Burst is on your way.
0cd1025f656504bf788593df2b454837c11321a9.text: *當你去捕獲他的精英技能時，獲得第二個捕獲印章，爆發治癒 正在路上。

e37079628523ddfb16136ff80146241fdba39005.source:
*Be cautious of its Dancing Daggers, as it can hit for up to 300 earth damage.
*Although this boss is close to the The Eternal Grove outpost, you must leave from Vasburg Armory as the doors leading outside from The Eternal Grove are closed.
e37079628523ddfb16136ff80146241fdba39005.text:
*請小心其 飛舞匕首，因為它可能會造成高達 300 的地球損壞。
*雖然這個 Boss 靠近永恆叢林前哨站，但你必須從 維思柏兵營 離開，因為通往永恆叢林外面的門已關閉。

1f726c8d8712cfee06088c0880d5d6dec01d4e40.source:
*It seems to be alone when encountered, but the moment the party approaches, around 8 other Wardens will drop down behind it.
*This boss' staff attack animation looks like it is attacking with a sword, even though it's a Ritualist.
1f726c8d8712cfee06088c0880d5d6dec01d4e40.text:
*遇到時它看起來很孤獨，但當隊伍接近時，8周圍的其他守望者會落在它後面。
*這個boss的員工攻擊動畫看起來像是用劍攻擊，儘管它是祭祀者。

2adf4985533562fc124b89a44ffc5bb5d271e5fb.source: * This boss will sometimes be killed by surrounding Afflicted.
2adf4985533562fc124b89a44ffc5bb5d271e5fb.text: * 這個頭目有時會被周圍的受影響者殺死。

f30c45859d818814a95cf817f71062d7077243c5.source:
* Be careful when fighting him, as he is accompanied by several groups of enemies. These groups, however, can be pulled away from his own group.
* He is also located near Falaharn Mistwarden, who will spawn if you go far enough into the area.
f30c45859d818814a95cf817f71062d7077243c5.text:
* 與他戰鬥時要小心，因為他身邊有幾組敵人。然而，這些群體可以從他自己的群體中抽離。
* 他也位於 Falaharn Mistwarden 附近，如果你進入該區域足夠遠，他就會生成。

0906710f200bb5bc663de95c9f02c5bf3584dd17.source: * If capturing Cultist's Fervor you may want to take another signet of capture as Tainted Flesh is nearby.
0906710f200bb5bc663de95c9f02c5bf3584dd17.text: * 如果捕獲 異教儀式，您可能需要再取得一個捕獲印章，因為 腐敗肉體 就在附近。

bb10106e4720722f3ae7dcbdca5541597f944f63.source: * If capturing Tainted Flesh you may want to take another signet of capture as Cultist's Fervor is nearby.
bb10106e4720722f3ae7dcbdca5541597f944f63.text: * 如果捕獲 腐敗肉體，您可能需要再取得一個捕獲印章，因為 異教儀式 就在附近。

9077ea6f92ec43e79b2e71b89a10837d4c012bb2.source:
* Even though he appears to be alone, six Warden of Seasons will popup when you get close to him. However, you can pull him aside while he's alone and the Warden of Seasons will only spawn if one of your allies go within earshot of Arbor's spawn location.
* The Warden of Seasons can also be pulled one at a time away from this boss if you prefer or they already spawned. Be sure to clear parts of the area around them though so you have a safe place to run to when needed.
* In hard mode, spread out the party before approaching this boss. The damage from Churning Earth and Shockwave can easily wipe the whole party.
9077ea6f92ec43e79b2e71b89a10837d4c012bb2.text:
* 儘管他看起來很孤獨，但當你靠近他時，會彈出六位季節守望者。然而，你可以在他獨自一人時將他拉到一邊，只有當你的一位盟友進入阿伯出生位置的聽力範圍內時，季節守望者才會出現。
* 如果您願意或季節守護者已經生成，也可以將其從該 Boss 身邊一次拉出一個。不過，請務必清理它們周圍的部分割槽域，以便在需要時有一個安全的地方可以逃脫。
* 在困難模式下，在接近這個頭目之前分散隊伍。 渦流大地 和 衝擊波 造成的傷害可以輕鬆消滅整個隊伍。

791759ad20ef7be58142a5784c34dbf2cd38d97b.source:
*Falaharn Mistwarden will only appear when the players approach his location on the map.
*He is located near Sunreach Warmaker, and drops down out of the branches nearby.
* Warden of Saprophytes uses the same skills.
791759ad20ef7be58142a5784c34dbf2cd38d97b.text:
*Falaharn Mistwarden 僅當玩家接近他在地圖上的位置時才會出現。
*他位於Sunreach Warmaker附近，並從附近的樹枝中掉下來。
*腐生守望者使用相同的技能。

c55a82dca44cab95be20fe8000227e7e3d06aae9.source:
* There are a few monsters with very similar names, possibly a family name within the game.
** Chkkr Brightclaw
** Chkkr Locust Lord
** Chkkr Thousand Tail
c55a82dca44cab95be20fe8000227e7e3d06aae9.text:
* 有一些怪物的名字非常相似，可能是遊戲中的一個姓氏。
** 檢查 光爪
** Chkkr 蝗蟲領主
** Chkkr 千尾

12a2c4b14eacc08f8d7d4632a28bfeb3937f26bf.source:
* Those wanting to capture Recurring Insecurity from him may consider bringing an extra Signet of Capture as Deeproot Sorrow with Shared Burden is a short distance away.
* Xisni does not appear during the quest Norn Catering.
12a2c4b14eacc08f8d7d4632a28bfeb3937f26bf.text:
* 想要從他手中奪取 危險迴圈 的人可以考慮多帶一個 捕捉紋章，因為有 共享負荷 的 Deeproot Sorrow 就在不遠處。
* Xisni 在任務 諾恩 餐飲期間不會出現。

705c3d22402152bd9f0f893a0b3d47a447aaaea7.source:
* Often attacked by patroling Mantids.
* Those wanting to capture Shared Burden from him may consider bringing an extra Signet of Capture as Xisni Dream Haunt with Recurring Insecurity is a short distance away.
705c3d22402152bd9f0f893a0b3d47a447aaaea7.text:
* 經常被巡邏的螳螂攻擊。
* 想要從他手中奪取 共享負荷 的人可以考慮多帶一個 捕捉紋章，因為有 危險迴圈 的 Xisni Dream Haunt 就在不遠的地方。

1f50554a126d0bfc255783985fde6637e185b74c.source: * Does not always appear in Arborstone. It shares its one possible spawn point with Ryver Mossplanter.
1f50554a126d0bfc255783985fde6637e185b74c.text: * 並不總是出現在 Arborstone 中。它與 Ryver Mossplanter 共享一個可能的生成點。

459f95beaf526aedb141d231bce822197796fe9a.source:
*All three Luxon seaguard henchmen have unique-looking armor. Eli's armor is unique among the three in that it does not resemble any armor that players can acquire.
*He wields a Dadao Sword and a Gothic Defender.
459f95beaf526aedb141d231bce822197796fe9a.text:
*所有三位 勒克森 海衛追隨者都擁有外觀獨特的盔甲。 Eli的盔甲在這三者中是獨一無二的，因為它與玩家可以獲得的任何盔甲都不相同。
*他使用大道劍和哥德守護者之盾。

c0963f71712afd9e832d31dce9bd1ba6134af5b4.source: * She is wearing a slightly modified version of the Ranger Luxon armor.
c0963f71712afd9e832d31dce9bd1ba6134af5b4.text: * 她穿著稍微修改版的 勒克森。

b4e25f5dce9da310aae842a575d66d705d57bf98.source:
*He wields a Longbow.
*His armor is slightly modified Ranger Elite Luxon armor.
*As a henchman, he is labeled as an "Interrupt Henchman."
In Divine Path he is shown as Daemen.
b4e25f5dce9da310aae842a575d66d705d57bf98.text:
*他揮舞著 長弓。
*他的裝甲略修改精英勒克森。
*作為一個追隨者，他被標記為“中斷 追隨者”。
在 神聖之路 中，他被顯示為 Daemen。

f1d5eb731e7924ea839200f334572271bebea845.source:
* She wields a Holy Staff.
* She wears a very slightly modified version of Monk Luxon armor.
f1d5eb731e7924ea839200f334572271bebea845.text:
* 她揮舞著 神聖法杖。
* 她穿著 勒克森 的略微修改版。

ad40a37fbf7ab936d3f5b34d0c3649376322c4ad.source:
*Argo is one of the disguises in the Costume Brawl.
*He is labeled as a Mage Henchman.
*Argo uses warrior emotes.
ad40a37fbf7ab936d3f5b34d0c3649376322c4ad.text:
*艾高 是服裝亂鬥中的偽裝之一。
*他被標記為 法師傭兵 追隨者。
*艾高 使用戰士表情。

aba449ad0433368b3da1ffdde06c59d19c27c44b.source:
* Cultist Milthuran sometimes uses a Wicked Blade or a Deadly Cesta instead of his staff. This is usually when he is attacked by melee.
* If you are attacking him, he will often retreat.
aba449ad0433368b3da1ffdde06c59d19c27c44b.text:
* 咒術士傭兵 米爾圖蘭有時會使用邪惡之刃或 致命短棒 來取代他的法杖。這通常是當他受到近戰攻擊時。
* 如果你攻擊他，他往往會撤退。

109bb2e1eb2db7918032a6e9732cce33fd74b559.source: * When it spawns (which includes Rockhide and Saltspray Dragons), its group begins to move along the road from The Aurios Mines to Seafarer's Rest.
109bb2e1eb2db7918032a6e9732cce33fd74b559.text: * 當它生成時（包括巖皮龍和鹽霧龍），它的隊伍開始沿著道路從 奧裡歐斯礦坑 移動到 航海者休憩處。

4e8cc20f7eb14671213dc712934e79cec081076a.source: *This boss is sometimes ganked by mobs and will be killed. A free morale boost can be obtained this way just by watching the show near the area.
4e8cc20f7eb14671213dc712934e79cec081076a.text: *這個頭目有時會被小怪攻擊並被殺死。透過這種方式，只需在該地區附近觀看演出即可獲得免費計程車氣提升。

2a0953b8ecc6a74352c5f43046499df11762dd95.source:
*Delic will only spawn once you get close to her location.
*There are very few foes to fight if coming via Gyala Hatchery (explorable) when heading North from Leviathan Pits.
2a0953b8ecc6a74352c5f43046499df11762dd95.text:
*只有當你靠近她的位置時，Delic 才會出現。
*從 利拜亞森礦場 向北行駛時，如果經過 蓋拉孵化所（可探索），則需要戰鬥的敵人很少。

b461e69dd0979b3526122a66b6cb1bba4beaa4d5.source: * If you're looking to capture Quick Shot from this boss, you can let the Outcasts do the work for you.
b461e69dd0979b3526122a66b6cb1bba4beaa4d5.text: * 如果您想從這個 Boss 手中奪取 風速之箭，您可以讓流亡者為您完成這項工作。

51a214a3dd87f4394c729039f2d7ec140e19ac2c.source: * This boss does not spawn during the quest Cleansing the Silent Surf.
51a214a3dd87f4394c729039f2d7ec140e19ac2c.text: * 此 Boss 不會在任務清理 寂靜之浪 期間產生。

30c2aa869e21b097b4a7cf56dd0d5471deaa4806.source:
* Amadis patrols a circuitous route counterclockwise around the central island.
* He will engage the local wildlife with his mob of outcasts, and he can lose these fights if he lures too many mobs, especially if one of them contains another boss. Although he will not drop loot if he is killed by the wildlife, his elite skill can still be captured.
30c2aa869e21b097b4a7cf56dd0d5471deaa4806.text:
* 阿瑪迪斯沿著中心島逆時針迂迴路線巡邏。
* 他會與當地的野生動物和他的被遺棄的暴徒交戰，如果他引誘太多的暴徒，他可能會輸掉這些戰鬥，特別是如果其中一個包含另一個老闆。雖然被野生動物殺死不會掉落戰利品，但他的精英技能仍然可以被捕獲。

48e73dfd876fb662bbf67518b01b5a9761c1e865.source:
* The Whispering Ritual Lord does not spawn if The Dragon Hunter is active. This is evident by the presence of Turimachus directly outside the portal to Leviathan Pits, or the presence of Saltspray Dragon Eggs in the vicinity of where Whispering Ritual Lord should be.
* Whispering Ritual Lord patrols in a large area without a mob. However, due to the number of mobs in that area, it is advisable to clear some before engaging him, as it would be easy to accidentally aggro more than one mob when fighting.
* In hard mode, Ritual Lord does not increase its Communing rank, since attributes are capped at rank 20.
48e73dfd876fb662bbf67518b01b5a9761c1e865.text:
* 如果龍獵人處於活動狀態，則低語 祭祀之主 不會產生。這可以透過在 利拜亞森礦場 的傳送門外直接出現 Turimachus，或在低語 祭祀之主 所在位置附近出現 鹽霧之龍 蛋來證明。
*低聲祭祀之主在沒有生物的大範圍內巡邏。然而，由於該地區的小怪數量較多，建議在與他交戰之前先清除一些小怪，因為在戰鬥時很容易意外地激怒多個小怪。
* 在困難模式下，祭祀之主 不會增加其 神諭 等級，因為屬性的上限為 20。

651eba9d45266bc086af691217b052fe00ce2978.source: * Unlike most non-afflicted Factions bosses, Chazek does not drop a unique item.
651eba9d45266bc086af691217b052fe00ce2978.text: * 與大多數未受影響的 盟與敵 Boss 不同，Chazek 不會掉落獨特的物品。

7e6858015469c1c6e57b3b5a59163fa80b01a1e7.source:
* As with most Elementalist bosses, the AoE damage done by this boss, combined with the additional damage provided by the two to three other Saltspray Dragons that patrol with Kunvie, can easily wipe an unprepared party.
* Keep in mind that due to the map that this boss is on, if you do not pass a Resurrection Shrine or have access to a resurrection shrine (i.e. if the area is owned by the faction you have less unspent faction of) while attempting to kill this boss, and you die, you will have to restart the map completely.
* If not engaged in melee, it is possible to lure Kunvie and their group to an extent where the boss and the rest only use attacks and do not use spells.
7e6858015469c1c6e57b3b5a59163fa80b01a1e7.text:
* 與大多數 元素使 Boss 一樣，該 Boss 造成的 範圍性 傷害，再加上與 Kunvie 一起巡邏的兩到三隻鹽噴霧龍提供的額外傷害，可以輕鬆消滅毫無準備的隊伍。
* 請記住，由於該 Boss 所在的地圖，如果您在嘗試殺死該 Boss 時沒有通過 復活祭壇 或無法訪問復活神社（即，如果該區域屬於 陣營值，則您的未使用 陣營值 較少），並且您死亡，則必須完全重新啟動地圖。
* 如果不進行近戰，有可能將Kunvie等人引誘到boss等人只使用攻擊而不使用法術的程度。

ef5916473a5b6553e65adf031c24d7c51f62ebd2.source:
* Does not spawn post-Winds of Change cleansing.
* Although the Focus of Hanaku drops a unique item, it is not a boss; thus its death neither gives a morale boost nor recharges skills.
* The name of this creature suggests it may be a minion or relation of the mighty Kraken Zhu Hanuku.
This creature deals double damage even though it is not actually a boss.
ef5916473a5b6553e65adf031c24d7c51f62ebd2.text:
* 不會在 變幻之風 清潔後產生。
* 雖然 Hanaku 的 聚能器 掉落了一個獨特的物品，但它不是 Boss；因此，它的死亡既不能鼓舞士氣，也不能恢復技能。
* 這種生物的名字表明它可能是強大的 Kraken Zhu Hanuku 的爪牙或親戚。
儘管該生物實際上並不是 Boss，但它仍會造成雙倍傷害。

8b49103c60dfb40ce42cc57f6a3cf9c20aeaca6b.source:
*An Oni ally can be summoned using a Demonic Summoning Stone or a Mysterious Summoning Stone.
*The Oni's idle emote is an unusual beckoning or stretching gesture, easily observed by summoning friendly Oni.
*There is a rare miniature version of these creatures.
*In addition to the Oni weapons listed above, Oni in Echovald Forest and The Jade Sea can drop weapons that only Echovald Forest wildlife and The Jade Sea wildlife can drop (e.g. Amber weapons and Jade weapons), respectively.
8b49103c60dfb40ce42cc57f6a3cf9c20aeaca6b.text:
*可以使用惡魔召喚石或神秘召喚石來召喚鬼盟友。
*鬼的閒置表情是一種不尋常的招手或伸展手勢，透過召喚友善的鬼可以輕鬆觀察到。
*這些生物有一個罕見的微型版本。
*除了上面列出的鬼武器外，科凡德森林和碧玉海中的鬼可以分別掉落只有科凡德森林野生動物和碧玉海野生動物可以掉落的武器（例如硬玉武器和翡翠武器）。

202d98540f46ffc0d78c4ec8135248d970bbc7d1.source:
*If capturing his elite, consider bringing 2 Signets of Capture for Dragon Slash which can be captured from Sskai, Dragon's Birth, not too far away from Geoffer.
* If you wait, his group will engage a Naga group nearby, usually leading to his death.
202d98540f46ffc0d78c4ec8135248d970bbc7d1.text:
*如果捕獲他的精英，請考慮攜帶 龍斬 的 2 捕獲徽章，該徽章可以從距離 Geoffer 不遠的龍之誕生 Sskai 捕獲。
* 如果你等待，他的隊伍將與附近的 納迦 隊伍交戰，通常會導致他死亡。

d2c0fc32a72e82542820b9c1e81e176b6be85e74.source:
* Sskai does not share aggro with his group. They can be pulled away from him separately, making the fight with Sskai himself much easier.
* Dragon Slash is his only adrenal skill, limiting its usefulness.
d2c0fc32a72e82542820b9c1e81e176b6be85e74.text:
* Sskai 不會與他的團隊分享仇恨。它們可以單獨從他身上拉開，使與斯凱本人的戰鬥變得更加容易。
* 龍斬 是他唯一的腎上腺技能，限制了它的用途。

b7e9d5b2de2a0b241fc1f106fce53d504dd55570.source:
* He will charm a nearby level 15 Elder Crab (a Reef Lurker).
* Even though he uses a monster skill form of Charm Animal, you can only capture the regular version from him.
b7e9d5b2de2a0b241fc1f106fce53d504dd55570.text:
* 他會迷住附近等級 15 的老蟹（礁石潛伏者）。
* 即使他使用了型態或迷魅動物的怪物技能，你也只能從他那裡捕捉普通版本。

c373de7c840eb7ebe805dee859116ca2daad4620.source: * If the Halcyon Job isn't active another assassin boss can be found at Senkai's location, Ilidus of the Empty Palm, who also has Way of the Empty Palm as his elite skill.
c373de7c840eb7ebe805dee859116ca2daad4620.text: * 如果翡翠工作沒有啟用，可以在戰海的位置找到另一個刺客頭目，空掌的伊利杜斯，他也有 無道 作為他的精英技能。

4e5fb6c1fd3ceff5c7e4a73bdf6db74b0262a449.source: * Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna is nearby, so players wishing to capture Healing Light from this boss may wish to bring another Signet of Capture to cap Blessed Light from Ssuns.
4e5fb6c1fd3ceff5c7e4a73bdf6db74b0262a449.text: * 薇娜的祝福 桑斯 就在附近，因此希望從該 Boss 處捕獲治療之光的玩家可能希望攜帶另一個 捕捉紋章 來限制 Ssuns 的 祝福聖光。

5f1dd1c1f46eaee782523303317545ae97d05396.source: *If going to capture Blessed Light, consider bringing another Signet of Capture as KaySey Stormray is on the way from Cavalon with Healing Light.
5f1dd1c1f46eaee782523303317545ae97d05396.text: *如果要捕獲 祝福聖光，請考慮攜帶另一個 捕捉紋章，因為 KaySey Stormray 正在從 卡瓦隆 帶著治癒之光出發。

8a74ee2c21ead8d7811aef3ddcb83182dd58f448.source:
* Elementalists capturing Second Wind may want to choose Ritualist as their secondary profession, and capture Grasping Was Kuurong from Ssyn Coiled Grasp, whom you have to pass on the road to Snapjaw Windshell. The converse applies for Ritualists.
* Interrupts are very helpful in killing his group.
8a74ee2c21ead8d7811aef3ddcb83182dd58f448.text:
* 捕獲援助之風的元素師可能會選擇祭祀者作為他們的次要職業，並從Ssyn Coiled Grasp手中捕獲貪婪者古朗，您必須在通往Snapjaw Windshell的路上經過它。對於儀式主義者來說，情況正好相反。
* 打斷對於殺掉他的隊伍很有幫助。

e376a62a6eacfd661a7f0ec574a3d761c6815a27.source: * In close vicinity, Snapjaw Windshell can be found, the only boss with the elite skill Second Wind.
e376a62a6eacfd661a7f0ec574a3d761c6815a27.text: * 在附近可以找到鉗嘴風殼，它是唯一擁有精英技能 援助之風 的 Boss。

97095856a91f371f84a90497e193d9158e0ff3aa.source:
*Stsou Swiftscale will not spawn if the quest Attack the Kurzicks! is active.
*He and his group are hostile to other Naga.
97095856a91f371f84a90497e193d9158e0ff3aa.text:
*如果任務“攻擊庫茲克”，Stsou Swiftscale 將不會生成。是活躍的。
*他和他的團隊對其他 納迦 懷有敵意。

85b26f20ccc30c539da5c5abd90899d970f90f19.source:
* The boss can easily be pulled apart from nearby foes, by drawing their aggro and breaking it.
* The nearby Island Guardian can resurrect him.
85b26f20ccc30c539da5c5abd90899d970f90f19.text:
* 透過吸引並打破附近敵人的仇恨，可以輕鬆地將 Boss 與附近的敵人拉開。
* 附近的島嶼守護者可以復活他。

d90f8735cb33e2553f1549bf05df9816cef58381.source:
*Ssaresh will not appear during the Stolen Eggs quest.
*Due to fighting with other mobs in the area, it is possible for Ssaresh Rattler to die without having to engage him. Be careful not to kill the mobs north of his marked location if you want him to get killed in this way.
d90f8735cb33e2553f1549bf05df9816cef58381.text:
*Ssaresh不會出現在偷蛋任務中。
*由於與該地區的其他生物戰鬥，Ssaresh Rattler 有可能在不與他交戰的情況下死亡。如果你想讓他以這種方式被殺死，請小心不要殺死他標記位置以北的小怪。

830e6b551f1692a8b0a95d59eafc9250a82b5242.source:
* Reefclaw is on its own and not part of any party around it.
* Reefclaw will usually engage the nearby group of outcasts (which contains Jacqui The Reaver, another warrior boss), most likely leading to his death.
830e6b551f1692a8b0a95d59eafc9250a82b5242.text:
* Reefclaw 是獨立的，不屬於周圍任何一方。
* 礁爪通常會與附近的一群流亡者（其中包括另一個戰士首領掠奪者傑奎）交戰，這很可能導致他的死亡。

3794f3af281cabc38e69fc918cc82371478fac41.source: *Jacqui's group usually engages and kills Reefclaw Ragebound, another warrior boss. Occasionally Jacqui can get killed in these fights instead. If he survives Reefclaw, he might get in a fight with Whyk Steelshell's group, and get killed by them.
3794f3af281cabc38e69fc918cc82371478fac41.text: *傑奎的隊伍通常會與另一個戰士首領礁爪狂暴交戰並殺死它。有時，傑奎也會在這些戰鬥中被殺。如果他在礁爪中倖存下來，他可能會與 Whyk Steelshell 的團隊發生戰鬥，並被他們殺死。

7aaf1512766c3dae88e6dd9079be9670f28c7d69.source: * Mohby is not part of any of the parties surrounding it.
7aaf1512766c3dae88e6dd9079be9670f28c7d69.text: * Mohby 不屬於任何相關方。

4a73b5ef4e5232b03e4ce6a38d9b03f9ad488607.source:
* Pain Inverter works well against this boss due to the packeted nature of much of his damage.
* His Churning Earth does a large amount of AoE damage so if you have heroes and/or henchmen in the party you should prepare to flag them out of it or interrupt.
* He typically uses Ward of Stability followed by Churning Earth, if the party is near each other (heroes and henchmen).
4a73b5ef4e5232b03e4ce6a38d9b03f9ad488607.text:
* 苦痛 逆變器可以很好地對抗這個 Boss，因為他的傷害大部分都是集中的。
* 他的 渦流大地 會造成大量 範圍性 傷害，因此如果你的隊伍中有英雄和/或追隨者，你應該準備好將他們標記出隊伍或打斷他們。
* 如果隊伍彼此靠近（英雄和追隨者），他通常會使用 穩定結界，然後使用 渦流大地。

904a237a3649dc27fe63239d7cbc3addf5553a12.source: * Whyk's group might get in a fight with Jacqui The Reaver's group if the latter survives his fight with Reefclaw Ragebound.
904a237a3649dc27fe63239d7cbc3addf5553a12.text: * 如果掠奪者傑奎在與礁爪狂暴者的戰鬥中倖存下來，懷克的隊伍可能會與掠奪者傑奎的隊伍發生戰鬥。

b5866a1034d2700075e5545019aaebfdf22810d8.source: *In hard mode, he's very dangerous due to Spirit Rift. Without proper flagging of heroes, he can wipe your party in seconds. Consider bringing Pain Inverter to quickly dispatch this boss. He is sometimes not visible because he is perched on his mountain.
b5866a1034d2700075e5545019aaebfdf22810d8.text: *在困難模式下，由於 生靈裂縫，他非常危險。如果沒有適當地標記英雄，他可以在幾秒鐘內消滅你的隊伍。考慮帶上苦痛逆變器來快速解決這個boss。有時人們看不到他，因為他棲息在山上。

694d1c07e5d8093b2ccd37e25331d89a61316019.source: * If you have the quest The Captured Son active when you seek Miki the Skull Spirit, the number of Crimson Skulls surrounding her is vastly increased.
694d1c07e5d8093b2ccd37e25331d89a61316019.text: * 如果你在尋找骷髏精靈米琪時啟動了「被俘虜的兒子」任務，她周圍的猩紅骷髏數量會大大增加。

784ceb90912b91c62e166fee2201d37eb7255eca.source:
*Removing or interrupting her Shroud of Distress not only denies her a strong defensive effect but also prevents her from using Golden Phoenix Strike and Blades of Steel.
** She will only use the skill if her health drops below 25%, so you can also try to spike her before she activates it. Unblockable attacks (e.g. Fox Fangs or Leviathan's Sweep) can help finish her off too.
784ceb90912b91c62e166fee2201d37eb7255eca.text:
*移除或打斷她的危難遮蔽不僅會剝奪她強大的防禦效果，還會阻止她使用火鳳凰狙殺和鋼鐵之刃。
** 只有當她的生命值低於 25% 時，她才會使用該技能，因此您也可以嘗試在她啟動技能之前秒殺她。不可阻擋的攻擊（例如 狐狸尖牙 或 海獸掃蕩）也可以幫助消滅她。

ae6fa40d089f6e6dece3e3286a26c223ff459f64.source: *This boss is located on a small slope somewhat close to a group of Sensali Tengu. They may kill this boss before you can reach it.
ae6fa40d089f6e6dece3e3286a26c223ff459f64.text: *這個頭目位於一個小斜坡上，距離一群聖沙利天狗 天狗有點近。他們可能會在你到達之前殺死這個老闆。

0996c979a2ce644ba0a21f41f1945fa60d162819.source: * Does not spawn during A Strange Request.
0996c979a2ce644ba0a21f41f1945fa60d162819.text: * 不會在奇怪的請求期間產生。

4818a52f6d813c408b026d59a964c1ae46023ad2.source: * Does not spawn during A Strange Request, Track Down Lo Sha or Lo Sha's Gift.
4818a52f6d813c408b026d59a964c1ae46023ad2.text: * 不會在奇怪的請求、追蹤 羅夏 或 羅夏 的禮物期間產生。

4809558445da5b2d3db63c264311a8cca1297418.source:
* It is located in the area where there are two Mantid Hatchlings, but does not always spawn. Killing the two Mantid Hatchlings will cause two Mantid Drones to popup and attack. Killing both the Mantid Drones will cause another three mantids to popup - a Mantid Monitor, a Mantid Drone, and either Yunlai Deathkeeper or a Mantid Darkwing.
* As noted above, this boss may or may not spawn. If it does not spawn, a level 6 Mantid Darkwing will spawn instead, so just map travel back to the Minister Cho's Estate oupost and make the journey again until Yunlai spawns.
* Yunlai will always spawn if you adhere strictly to the following approach. When entering the temple and before killing any mantids, go immediately to the left chamber. There you will find a Mantid Monitor: kill it. Next, kill the two Mantid Drone Hatchlings. Two Mantid Drones will popup: kill them, and two Mantid Drones and Yunlai will popup. Killing any other mantid other than the ones mentioned, may prevent Yunlai from appearing.
4809558445da5b2d3db63c264311a8cca1297418.text:
* 它位於有兩隻螳螂幼體的區域，但並非總是產卵。殺死兩隻螳螂幼崽會導致兩隻螳螂無人機彈出並進行攻擊。殺死兩臺螳螂無人機將導致另外三隻螳螂彈出——一臺螳螂監視器、一臺螳螂無人機以及雲來死亡守護者或 螳螂黑翼。
* 如上所述，該 Boss 可能會生成，也可能不會生成。如果它沒有生成，則會生成一個關卡 6 螳螂黑翼，因此只需在地圖上返回 Cho 部長的莊園前哨站並再次進行旅程，直到 Yunlai 生成。
* 如果你嚴格遵守以下方法，雲來總是會生成。進入寺廟並在殺死任何螳螂之前，請立即前往左側的房間。在那裡你會發現一隻螳螂監視器：殺死它。接下來，殺死兩隻螳螂無人機幼體。會彈出兩臺螳螂無人機：殺死它們，然後會彈出兩臺螳螂無人機和雲來。殺死上述以外的任何其他螳螂妖，可能會阻止雲來出現。

ad88a0e6540093fde3b889eae575178706f8dec5.source:
* Be careful when approaching this boss. The paths of three patrol groups will cross the area where he is.
* Also, when Yingko is attacked, three other Crimson Skull enemies will appear to defend Yingko.
ad88a0e6540093fde3b889eae575178706f8dec5.text:
* 接近這個頭目時要小心。三個巡邏隊的路徑將穿過他所在的區域。
* 此外，當英寇受到攻擊時，另外三名 紅顱 敵人會出現保衛英寇。

d739507eb2d819cff2c2a64d0d119dd4188ceb9a.source: * Players will most likely encounter this boss while completing the quest Free the Fur.
d739507eb2d819cff2c2a64d0d119dd4188ceb9a.text: * 玩家在完成「釋放毛皮」任務時很可能會遇到這個 Boss。

a25092289fa273f4cda7018ff3925ac029190157.source: * Feng is a formidable foe to new, inexperienced players; caution is advised.
a25092289fa273f4cda7018ff3925ac029190157.text: * 對於新手、沒有經驗的玩家來說，馮是個可怕的敵人；建議謹慎。

b33253f4e328eee1ee4a1d25e8ef377ac6deaccd.source:
* She appears to be alone as you approach. Once attacked, a Crimson Skull Raider and a Crimson Skull Hunter drop down from the trees to attack.
* Does not spawn during the Dragon Festival quest A Strange Request.
* Because Jin is very close to the portal to Kinya Province it is easy to farm her for experience or drops. For a Ranger farmer, a longbow is recommended to make sure the Crimson Skull Raider and the Crimson Skull Hunter aren't aggro'ed.
b33253f4e328eee1ee4a1d25e8ef377ac6deaccd.text:
* 當你走近時，她似乎獨自一人。一旦受到攻擊，一名 紅顱 攻擊者和一名 紅顱 獵人會從樹上跳下來攻擊。
* 不會在龍節任務「奇怪的請求」期間產生。
* 因為 Jin 距離 欣彌領地 的門戶非常近，所以很容易培養她以獲得經驗或掉落物。對於 遊俠 農民，建議使用長弓，以確保 紅顱 攻擊者和 紅顱 獵人不會被仇恨。

b5008dd13783101b0ed54ece2a5c6bf18986b8e9.source: * There are two mobs of Sensali Tengu to the north and west that are very near this boss. The mobs often aggro and kill this boss even before you get to the area.
b5008dd13783101b0ed54ece2a5c6bf18986b8e9.text: * 北部和西部有兩隻 聖沙利天狗 天狗 怪物非常靠近這個 Boss。甚至在你到達該地區之前，小怪經常會仇恨並殺死這個老闆。

acf98d1c594a0df2c6771662157053eefabf1656.source: * After defeating Captain Quimang in Quimang's Last Stand, you may experience difficulty finding Cho Wei at the spawn point.
acf98d1c594a0df2c6771662157053eefabf1656.text: * 在 Quimang 的背水一戰中擊敗 Quimang 船長後，您可能會在重生點很難找到 Cho Wei。

905c18f19d934a01a528a9c0b3be6334534bfdc0.source: *When it is aggroed, Mandragor Imps will popup.
905c18f19d934a01a528a9c0b3be6334534bfdc0.text: *當它被仇恨時，曼德拉戈小鬼會彈出。

e6d0fe46f4621f9c3da25e4d3b378dc5b79a34f9.source:
* He will charm a nearby level 15 Elder Crocodile.
* Even though he uses a monster skill form of Charm Animal, you can only capture the regular version from him.
e6d0fe46f4621f9c3da25e4d3b378dc5b79a34f9.text:
* 他會迷惑附近的 15 等級鱷魚長老。
* 即使他使用了型態或迷魅動物的怪物技能，你也只能從他那裡捕捉普通版本。

54ce86a5cce866ebf5c0099ef5d654e49061dafc.source: * Churrta the Rock will not spawn if the quest Eavesdropping is active.
54ce86a5cce866ebf5c0099ef5d654e49061dafc.text: * 如果竊聽任務處於活動狀態，岩石楚爾塔將不會產生。

bff169bd7652d1ce378fa2c0599affa0df23728c.source: *He spawns very close to several other bosses. Players working on their Skill Hunter title may wish to bring several Signets of Capture with them.
bff169bd7652d1ce378fa2c0599affa0df23728c.text: *他生成時距離其他幾個 Boss 非常近。開發 技能獵人 遊戲的玩家可能會想要隨身攜帶幾枚 Capture Signets。

c19b05d8054d0535ec958e33ba0130dd0adafb9d.source: *He spawns very close to Riseh the Harmless and Wandalz the Angry. Monk and Paragon secondaries (or any combination) may wish to bring 2 Signets of Capture.
c19b05d8054d0535ec958e33ba0130dd0adafb9d.text: *他生成的位置離無害瑞瑟和憤怒者萬達爾茲非常近。 僧侶 和 聖言者 輔助裝置（或任何組合）可能想要攜帶 2 Capture 標誌。

338a94fff3a4490875d2de06afed64ab272bce2b.source: * This boss is hidden and only appears once you're close to him.
338a94fff3a4490875d2de06afed64ab272bce2b.text: * 這個頭目是隱藏的，只有當你靠近他時才會出現。

ed73c25059da07cdada73f09b3bac037184046c5.source: * Killing this boss will cause you to fail Masters for the mission, so you may want to go back and capture the elite skill after completing the mission or you can capture it from Chidehkir, Light of the Blind in Marga Coast.
ed73c25059da07cdada73f09b3bac037184046c5.text: * 殺死這個頭目會導致你在任務中失敗，所以你可能想在完成任務後返回並獲取精英技能，或者你可以從馬加海岸中的盲人之光Chidehkir那裡獲取它。

004c07edd4776d5aa3f50ff0ad0b9e79621f326c.source: Though Lumanda has a feminine appearance, he is referred to with male pronouns in the mission dialogue.
004c07edd4776d5aa3f50ff0ad0b9e79621f326c.text: 儘管盧曼達有著女性化的外表，但在任務對話中他卻被男性代名詞提及。

32057c763fc17379e1fa5cdae31129ea40383cb1.source: This boss does not spawn. The solution to this bug [{{fullurl:Feedback_talk:Emily_Diehl|diff=1967523}} was known by ArenaNet], but was never implemented.
32057c763fc17379e1fa5cdae31129ea40383cb1.text: 該 Boss 不會產生。 A社 已知此錯誤的解決方案 [{{fullurl:Feedback_talk:Emily_Diehl|diff=1967523}}，但從未實施。

fbae3b37ebad394354c2365fc74536e79f207a60.source:
* Elementalists capping the skill may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture, as an Elementalist boss with Master of Magic is along the way.
* This boss deals heavy damage in Hard mode. Consider bringing damage reduction skills such as Protective Spirit or "Save Yourselves!", or caster shutdown methods in form of interrupts or dazed. Spreading out before engaging Lushivahr will also prevent Invoke Lightning from hitting multiple party members.
fbae3b37ebad394354c2365fc74536e79f207a60.text:
* 限制技能的元素主義者可能會想要帶第二個 捕捉紋章，因為 元素使 Boss 和 魔法大師 就在路上。
* 這個 Boss 在 困難模式 中會造成嚴重傷害。考慮引入減少傷害的技能，例如精神守護或“拯救自己！”，或型態中的施法者關閉方法，如打斷或發呆。在與 Lushivahr 交戰之前分散開來還可以防止 閃電祈禱 攻擊多個隊伍成員。

29f6df67f74a57993b672654d86d588ddba87272.source:
* In hard mode, Master of Magic does not increase nor decrease its rank 16 Earth Magic, since rank 20 Energy Storage causes Master of Magic to set elemental attribute ranks to 16.
* Elementalists capping Master of Magic may wish to bring a second Signet of Capture, as an Elementalist boss with Invoke Lightning is in the area.
29f6df67f74a57993b672654d86d588ddba87272.text:
* 在困難模式下，魔法大師 不會增加或減少其等級 16 地系魔法，因為等級 20 能量儲存 會導致 魔法大師 將元素屬性等級設為 16。
* 封頂 魔法大師 的元素主義者可能會想要帶第二個 捕捉紋章，因為該區域有一個帶有 閃電祈禱 的 元素使 Boss。

0da9e458bc05fa378a5e9f2cf1f277d3078cea61.source:
* Be extremely careful of this boss' Spirit Rift. In Normal Mode, the amount of damage this skill can do is already high, but in Hard mode, it is capable of dealing 500+ damage to each character, easily killing all of a clumped group. When he uses Spirit Rift you have 3 seconds to flag your heroes away.
* Bohdalz the Furious spawns near Jarimiya the Unmerciful. If seeking the least amount of foes possible, see the path on Jarimiya the Unmerciful's page.
0da9e458bc05fa378a5e9f2cf1f277d3078cea61.text:
* 要格外小心這個老闆的 生靈裂縫。在普通模式下，此技能可以造成的傷害已經很高，但在困難模式中，它能夠對每個角色造成500+傷害，輕鬆殺死一群人。當他使用 生靈裂縫 時，您有 3 秒的時間來標記您的英雄。
* 狂怒 博赫達爾茲在無情者賈裡米亞附近生成。如果尋求盡可能少的敵人，請參閱無情者賈裡米亞頁面上的路徑。

2323182fe67bff634fbc7c2cb16d8ef6c4b9649d.source:
* This boss always drops one Bottle of Vabbian Wine when it dies, although it can be assigned to NPCs, such as henchmen, heroes or Vabbian Guards (in which case you will not see the drop).
** All enemy groups between the portal to Forum Highlands and Jarimiya can be pulled towards the nearby groups of Vabbian Guards for extra help when solo farming; this includes the group of Bohdalz the Furious.
2323182fe67bff634fbc7c2cb16d8ef6c4b9649d.text:
* 這個 Boss 在死亡時總是會掉落一個 瓦貝紅酒，儘管它可以分配給 NPC，例如追隨者、英雄或瓦比安守衛（在這種情況下你將看不到掉落）。
** 通往 高地廣場 和 Jarimiya 的門戶之間的所有敵人團體都可以被拉向附近的瓦比亞守衛團體，以在單獨耕作時獲得額外幫助；其中包括 Bohdalz the 狂怒 團隊。

c3a750e94a6543f650c38df9a7b438c6ac43cdcb.source: * The boss is located near a "Do Not Touch" treasure. Be sure to kill off her group before going for that treasure.
c3a750e94a6543f650c38df9a7b438c6ac43cdcb.text: * Boss 位於「請勿觸控」寶藏附近。在去尋找寶藏之前一定要殺掉她的隊伍。

60e384c35dfbdbd9cc075a036317d2b9a726bab3.source: *Tenezel the Quick does not appear when the quest The Search for Enlightenment is active
60e384c35dfbdbd9cc075a036317d2b9a726bab3.text: *當任務「尋找啟蒙」處於活動狀態時，「敏捷者」特內澤爾不會出現

a5a74f7ce979b0640cf957697ed4129492d4e040.source:
* Conditions and elemental damage are ineffective against this boss when it uses Avatar of Melandru. 
** Keep her interrupted - she is much easier to kill if her form is not active.
** Kill the guards and healers before attempting to take on the boss.
** In hard mode, applying Hexes will make things much easier.
* Party wide protection skills like Aegis work well.
* Consider bringing two Signets of Capture since Bubahl Icehands is just south of this boss.
a5a74f7ce979b0640cf957697ed4129492d4e040.text:
* 當使用 梅蘭朵化身 時，條件和元素傷害對該 Boss 無效。 
** 打斷她 - 如果她的 型態 未啟用，她會更容易被殺死。
** 在嘗試對抗 Boss 之前殺死守衛和治療師。
** 在困難模式下，應用十六進位制將使事情變得更加容易。
* 隊伍 廣泛的保護技能（如 神賜之盾）效果很好。
* 考慮帶兩個捕獲徽記，因為布巴爾冰手就在這個 Boss 的南面。

a35366ecd76070abebd21a012d6c1bc23db12db8.source: * It is accompanied by several Blood Cowl Hekets.

288e7911cdccb24fcfa7ae1d2472b8c337b818b9.source:
* It is easier to reach this boss travelling south from Venta Cemetery. Travelling north from the Command Post you will come across Mandragor spawns.
* This boss may not spawn while you have Building the Base: Prisoners of War active.
* Consider bringing another Signet of Capture to get Avatar of Lyssa from the nearby boss.
288e7911cdccb24fcfa7ae1d2472b8c337b818b9.text:
* 從文塔公墓向南行駛更容易到達這個頭目。從 指揮所 向北行駛，您會遇到曼德拉戈 (Mandragor) 生成點。
