* 當您啟動「建造基地：戰俘」時，該 Boss 可能不會生成。
* 考慮帶另一個 捕捉紋章 從附近的 Boss 取得 麗莎化身。

78416909abc625f995c60f665dfc0978c4649fdd.source:
*Protective Spirit and similar enchantments can help with the damage reduction.
*Enchantment removal will counter Twin Moon Sweep.
*Consider bringing another Signet of Capture to get Reaper's Sweep from Dabineh Deathbringer.
78416909abc625f995c60f665dfc0978c4649fdd.text:
*精神守護 和類似的附魔可以幫助減少傷害。
*加持魔法 刪除將對抗 雙月掃蕩。
*考慮帶另一個 捕捉紋章 從 Dabineh Deathbringer 獲得 收割者掃蕩。

c0f0276c34251abef71afb37d68cc6642f301d10.source:
* In Hard mode, Korr can easily wipe an entire party due to fire damage as high as 400 from Searing Flames. Consider using an interrupt such as Signet of Humility, Power Block, or Complicate to disable Searing Flames. 
* Alternately, you can reduce damage with Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm and use Pain Inverter to quickly dispatch the boss. This method is particularly useful when the party has a minion master or spirit spammer.
c0f0276c34251abef71afb37d68cc6642f301d10.text:
* 在 困難模式 中，由於 爆裂火焰 造成的火焰傷害高達 400，科爾可以輕鬆消滅整個隊伍。考慮使用 謙卑紋章、強力封鎖 或 糾纏 等中斷來停用 爆裂火焰。 
* 或者，您可以使用元素結界或守護結界減少傷害，並使用苦痛逆變器快速消滅Boss。當隊伍有隨從大師或靈魂垃圾郵件傳送者時，此方法特別有用。

4901b088c9ddd588c364e98b6a324cc89233355d.source: * This boss may not spawn when the quest Weird Waters is active. However, if he does spawn, his group will attack the heket groups that are related to the aforementioned quest.
4901b088c9ddd588c364e98b6a324cc89233355d.text: * 當任務怪異水域啟動時，這個 Boss 可能不會出現。然而，如果他確實出現，他的隊伍將攻擊與上述任務相關的赫克特隊伍。

e640dd1951576711ff3ecaff6400823bc5c0510b.source: * Commander Noss is inaccessible during the quest To Kill a Demon
e640dd1951576711ff3ecaff6400823bc5c0510b.text: * 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) 在任務「殺死 惡魔」期間無法存取 Noss

2cc3953ab74588f576934c625d6bd6c488250629.source:
*If you have not completed the quest Drakes on the Plain yet, make sure you don't include Koss in your party, otherwise Zelnehlun Fastfoot will not spawn.
*To trigger Zelnehlun Fastfoot and his mob, walk towards the resurrection shrine near the fortress.
2cc3953ab74588f576934c625d6bd6c488250629.text:
*如果您尚未完成任務 平原龍獸，請確保您的隊伍中沒有包含 寇斯，否則 Zelnehlun Fastfoot 將不會產生。
*要觸發Zelnehlun Fastfoot和他的暴民，請走向堡壘附近的復活神殿。

83fa4bff035aae696c2314e16ae75cfdfc04fccb.source:
* Jerneh Nightbringer, together with a large mob, will only appear once the players have approached his location.
* Curiously, Jerneh's ambush consists of both skale and heket.
83fa4bff035aae696c2314e16ae75cfdfc04fccb.text:
* Jerneh Nightbringer和一大群暴徒只有在玩家接近他的位置後才會出現。
* 奇怪的是，Jerneh 的伏擊由 skale 和 heket 組成。

cf420895fc8729da2bc7308558a8c8834f10735e.source:
* The Drought is a non-demonic servant of Abaddon; Lightbringer's Gaze is useless against it.
* The following tactics are effective in dealing with the Drought:
** Winter will negate the bonuses from earth damage.
** The Drought can be shutdown by daze, Power Block or knock downs. 
** Pain Inverter is even more effective using a minion master to exploit Sandstorm's area of effect damage — the more minions that get hit, the more damage there is to invert.
** Protective Spirit is effective, since the Drought almost always hits for over 200 damage.
** Shelter provides enough party-wide protection to kill the Drought using the Pain Inverter strategy (it generally will not survive more than one Sandstorm).
cf420895fc8729da2bc7308558a8c8834f10735e.text:
* 乾旱是 亞霸頓 的非惡魔僕人；光明使者的凝視對它毫無用處。
* 以下策略可有效應對乾旱：
** 寒冬 將抵消地球傷害帶來的獎勵。
** 乾旱可以透過發呆、強力封鎖 或擊倒來關閉。 
** 苦痛 反轉器使用小兵大師來利用 沙塵暴 的效果傷害區域會更有效 - 被擊中的小兵越多，反轉的傷害就越大。
** 精神守護 非常有效，因為乾旱幾乎總是造成超過 200 的傷害。
** 庇護 使用 苦痛 逆變器策略提供足夠的全黨保護來消除乾旱（它通常無法在超過一個 沙塵暴 中倖存下來）。

333e19b17afc84fa581a6fd7a004c8afa0112bf9.source:
* This boss can hit for large amounts of damage. It is recommended to spread your team to avoid its area of effect attacks.
* This boss relies almost entirely on physical damage, so blocking and causing its attacks to miss are effective ways to prevent damage.
333e19b17afc84fa581a6fd7a004c8afa0112bf9.text:
* 這個 Boss 可以造成大量傷害。建議分散您的團隊以避免其影響範圍的攻擊。
* 該頭目幾乎完全依賴物理傷害，因此格擋和使其攻擊落空是防止傷害的有效方法。

8ad2946facb9fbe27dcea7db59ec1d7002f76a1c.source:
* Yammiron, Ether Lord will not appear in the Mirror of Lyss if The Search for Survivors is active.
* The Roaring Ethers can resurrect him; consider taking them out first.
* In Hard mode, Yammiron and his group can wipe a party with Energy Surge spikes. Keep spread out and try to prevent them from launching coordinated attacks. It helps to bring AoE skills such as interrupts (e.g. Panic or Psychic Instability), knock downs (e.g. Meteor), or daze (e.g. Broad Head Arrow).
8ad2946facb9fbe27dcea7db59ec1d7002f76a1c.text:
* 如果「搜尋倖存者」處於活動狀態，Yammiron、精神支配 將不會出現在利斯之鏡中。
* 咆哮以太可以復活他；考慮先把它們拿出來。
* 在 困難模式 中，Yammiron 和他的團隊可以用 能量震盪 尖峰消滅一支隊伍。保持分散並盡力阻止他們發動協同攻擊。它有助於帶來 範圍性 技能，例如中斷（例如 恐慌 或 精神失衡）、擊倒（例如 隕石）或發呆（例如 闊首箭）。

5b9ed3ba5ff0f58a029e60e78a1cf7c993405269.source:
* Shezel will not spawn if the Search for Survivors is active.
* There is Buried Treasure on the island where Shezel is located.
5b9ed3ba5ff0f58a029e60e78a1cf7c993405269.text:
* 如果「搜尋倖存者」處於活動狀態，則謝澤爾不會產生。
* 謝澤爾所在的島嶼有埋藏的寶藏。

43bbc8408a89e57f9ecaf0eb68186ce141953271.source: *If Briahn is accompanied by a Kournan Bowman, his group will trail Spirits of Infuriating Heat behind. Attacking one will cause the entire group to rush back toward you until the spirit dies.
43bbc8408a89e57f9ecaf0eb68186ce141953271.text: *如果 Briahn 有 Kournan Bowman 陪同，他的隊伍將落後於 Spirits of 怒火。攻擊一個會導致整個團隊衝向你，直到該靈魂死亡。

6f9bf363b80a2236621efa4b2e5c7ec8b90a23f5.source:
* This boss will not appear in Resplendent Makuun during the quest The Search for Survivors.
* Even though he is a Paragon, he attacks in melee.
6f9bf363b80a2236621efa4b2e5c7ec8b90a23f5.text:
* 在任務「尋找倖存者」期間，該 Boss 不會出現在輝煌的馬庫恩中。
* 儘管他是 聖言者，但他會進行近戰攻擊。

936d30f3806e4bc870703444c196a4d25e6c5015.source: *In Dasha Vestibule, Kormab deals a large amount of damage when Searing Flames hits. Mass condition removal such as Cautery Signet, Martyr or Extinguish may be useful.
936d30f3806e4bc870703444c196a4d25e6c5015.text: *在達沙走廊中，當爆裂火焰命中時，Kormab會造成大量傷害。品質條件移除（例如 淨潔紋章、殉教 或 熄滅）可能有用。

1d3bb397eac2847c04ac42e0810cfdab2efcc67f.source:
* He can spawn in a team with 1-2 Skree Griffins.
* Healer's Boon makes this a hard boss to defeat, though standard caster counters work wonders on him (daze, knockdowns, enchantment removal, interrupts, etc).
* If a Skree Singer spawns in the group they can resurrect Josinq the Whisperer using "We Shall Return!". This can make killing him difficult as he will use his Renew Life to resurrect the Singer if it is killed nearby. Consider Frozen Soil.
* Any nearby monster spawns should be wiped to prevent fighting two groups at the same time (the monsters spawning with Josinq, as well as heroes and henchmen, are likely to run into aggro range of nearby groups).
* He does not spawn with quest "Til Death Do Us Part..." active.
1d3bb397eac2847c04ac42e0810cfdab2efcc67f.text:
* 他可以與 1-2 鳥妖 獅鷲組隊生成。
* 治癒者恩賜 使其成為一個難以擊敗的 Boss，儘管標準的施法計數器對他有奇效（眩暈、擊倒、移除結界、打斷等）。
* 如果 鳥妖 歌手在隊伍中出現，他們可以使用「我們將 影返！」復活低語者 Josinq。這會讓殺死他變得困難，因為如果歌手在附近被殺，他將使用 更新生命 來復活歌手。考慮 凍土。
* 任何附近的怪物生成都應該被清除，以防止同時與兩個群體戰鬥（與 Josinq 一起生成的怪物，以及英雄和追隨者，很可能會進入附近群體的仇恨範圍）。
* 他不會在任務「直到死亡將我們分開...」啟動時產生。

4c04d6989c6b8e71d5873d22c939b0b46f67c298.source:
* This boss does not spawn until after completion of the quest Extinction.
* The group this boss is tied to is particularly dangerous due to the high number of resurrection skills they carry, including the boss and at least one Skree Singer with "We Shall Return!".
This boss has been observed to throw shields.
4c04d6989c6b8e71d5873d22c939b0b46f67c298.text:
* 這個 Boss 在完成任務「滅絕」後才會出現。
* 這個 Boss 所屬的團體特別危險，因為他們擁有大量復活技能，其中包括 Boss 和至少一名帶有“我們將 影返！”的 鳥妖 歌手。
據觀察，該 Boss 會投擲盾牌。

134321f2634da94f276f27b61b679467a41deda4.source:
*When Screecher and her group are killed, another group of elite skree will spawn. Shortly after spawning, the group will flee to the Resplendent Makuun portal and disappear.
* If Scratcher is still alive, the harpies near her will remain until she also is defeated.
134321f2634da94f276f27b61b679467a41deda4.text:
*當尖叫者和她的隊伍被殺死時，另一群精英斯克雷將會生成。產卵後不久，這群人就會逃到輝煌的馬庫恩傳送門並消失。
* 如果 Scratcher 還活著，她附近的鷹身女妖將會留下來，直到她也被擊敗。

78d0a5d93d152aa679e4b7e1475d32786c80cc87.source: *When Scratcher and her group are killed, another group of elite skree will spawn and begin to attack you. However, after just one of these skree is killed, the rest will flee to the Resplendent Makuun portal and disappear.
78d0a5d93d152aa679e4b7e1475d32786c80cc87.text: *當 Scratcher 和她的團隊被殺死時，另一群精英斯克雷將會出現並開始攻擊你。然而，只要其中一隻斯克雷被殺死，其餘的就會逃到輝煌的馬庫斯傳送門並消失。

7d24fcd46cffcb8218005ba5015733d52208c078.source: * Frozen Soil is particularly useful against this boss as members of his group carry multiple hard res skills including Renew Life and "We Shall Return!".
7d24fcd46cffcb8218005ba5015733d52208c078.text: * 凍土 對抗這個 Boss 特別有用，因為他的團隊成員擁有多種硬資源技能，包括 更新生命 和「我們將 影返！」。

ead8cafd16fbed244e7869d6fcf791e0b68155e9.source: A Dervish boss named Marobeh Sharptail strangely drops Eshekibeh's Scythe. The names are likely unintentionally swapped.
ead8cafd16fbed244e7869d6fcf791e0b68155e9.text: 一個名叫 Marobeh Sharptail 的 神喚使 Boss 奇怪地掉落了 Eshekibeh 的 鐮刀。這些名字很可能是無意間交換的。

2d9547cfee0a712432f9fe8e5698664712e6cf77.source: * This boss does not spawn in the Nightfallen Garden.
2d9547cfee0a712432f9fe8e5698664712e6cf77.text: * 該 Boss 不會在墮夜花園中生成。

15ae65a77b27391a8f86853f8cbf6d9b04a281f5.source: "Heardheart" may be an unintentional typo of "Hardheart" which would make more sense for this necromancer boss.
15ae65a77b27391a8f86853f8cbf6d9b04a281f5.text: “Heardheart”可能是“Hardheart”的無意拼寫錯誤，這對這個死靈法師老闆來說更有意義。

a2148963d12e022ec15b8e80bc82690c65bf24a6.source: * The djinn does not actually drop an essence that needs to be picked up. Killing it will immediately update the quest.
a2148963d12e022ec15b8e80bc82690c65bf24a6.text: * 神靈實際上不會掉落需要拾取的精華。殺死它會立即更新任務。

5044cbb175c11561e072b83e242698c2fcffa377.source: * If you intend to capture a skill from Shakor Firespear during the Dasha Vestibule mission, make sure to not kill him last as doing so will cause the mission to end.
5044cbb175c11561e072b83e242698c2fcffa377.text: * 如果您打算在 達沙走廊 任務期間獲得 Shakor Firespear 的技能，請確保不要最後殺死他，因為這樣做會導致任務結束。

c10f7e870506194fd19d221afe789e7e54ed8e5c.source: A necromancer boss named Eshekibeh Longneck strangely drops Marobeh's Chill. The names are likely unintentionally swapped.
c10f7e870506194fd19d221afe789e7e54ed8e5c.text: 一個名叫埃什基貝·長頸的死靈法師頭目奇怪地掉落了馬羅貝的寒意。這些名字很可能是無意間交換的。

7d45bf8024fdf3542df12e48d949aa04af237397.source: *This boss may not spawn if the quest Coffer of Joko has not been completed, and Master of Whispers is in your party. See the talk page for more information.
7d45bf8024fdf3542df12e48d949aa04af237397.text: *如果喬科保險箱任務尚未完成，並且密語大師在你的隊伍中，則該 Boss 可能不會生成。請參閱討論頁以獲取更多資訊。

4d817b7f7994b734ed14db4287687f13f32ba84c.source: * He wields a Crenellated Scythe, but his weapon drop is a Bronze Scythe.
4d817b7f7994b734ed14db4287687f13f32ba84c.text: * 他揮舞著鋸齒形 鐮刀，但他掉落的武器是青銅 鐮刀。

6498a3a0fde69755d2b4cf9baa8094b8f269dcc8.source: * This boss is very close to the entrance to the Lair of the Forgotten. A Wurm Spoor is nearby, making it very easy to farm Dunshek and his entire group in Junundu form.
6498a3a0fde69755d2b4cf9baa8094b8f269dcc8.text: * 這個boss距離被遺忘者的巢穴的入口非常近。 地蟲 Spoor 就在附近，因此可以輕鬆地在 Junundu 型態 中耕種 Dunshek 和他的整個團隊。

df51deafa36ee93812b8d1ce62ee9774977f59e5.source: * If traveling to Saushali to capture Magebane Shot, one might consider taking another signet of capture as Uhiwi the Smoky with Smoke Trap is along the route.
df51deafa36ee93812b8d1ce62ee9774977f59e5.text: * 如果前往 Saushali 捕獲 馬格班射擊，您可能會考慮獲取另一個捕獲印章，因為攜帶 煙霧陷阱 的烏希維 (Uhiwi the Smoky) 就在沿途。

f2329e7915bd05f7d83ebd0989d2faf82f8aef1b.source:
*Easily farmed while in Junundu form. Starting from the Lair of the Forgotten, it takes about 4 minutes to reach and kill him. 
*Saushali the Frustrating with Magebane Shot and Koahm the Weary with Quicksand are also in the area (unless Horde of Darkness is active).
f2329e7915bd05f7d83ebd0989d2faf82f8aef1b.text:
*在 Junundu 型態 中輕鬆耕種。從 被遺忘者的巢穴 開始，大約需要 4 分鐘才能到達並殺死他。 
*使用 馬格班射擊 的令人沮喪的 Saushali 和使用 流沙 的疲憊者 Koahm 也在該區域（除非黑暗部落處於活動狀態）。

b720339e97f8378d0b58c6d1f2734ba222d1e1ce.source: * Uhiwi the Smoky with Smoke Trap is also in the area.
b720339e97f8378d0b58c6d1f2734ba222d1e1ce.text: * Uhiwi the Smoky 和 煙霧陷阱 也在該區域。

ea2584e9e0629ea151169a1ec2d634e37cddcc0a.source: * Sometimes this boss might not spawn if the quests Under New Management or The Scourge of Vabbi are active.
ea2584e9e0629ea151169a1ec2d634e37cddcc0a.text: * 有時，如果「新管理」或「瓦貝 之災」任務處於活動狀態，則該 Boss 可能不會出現。

f50f6907f4d44a3913ad45223d5f64a69969ac2d.source: *Occasionally two Desert Wurms will spawn in the group surrounding this boss. If this occurs, taking out the Desert Wurms first will make killing the rest of the group easier.
f50f6907f4d44a3913ad45223d5f64a69969ac2d.text: *偶爾會在該 Boss 周圍的群體中生成兩隻沙漠亞龍。如果發生這種情況，首先消滅沙漠亞龍將使殺死該群體的其他成員變得更容易。

c8df0029830e31cb9b457441cda09a062b7b6619.source: * If you run a spirits build you may consider Vanquishing this zone when capping the skill as it works extremely well with Signet of Spirits.
c8df0029830e31cb9b457441cda09a062b7b6619.text: * 如果您執行烈酒構建，您可以考慮在限制技能時征服此區域，因為它與 縛靈紋章 配合得非常好。

ecacf070ef8ceeb6c1700d54e07edb51515719b4.source: * Droajam, Mage of the Sands is also present in the explorable and though it's a fair trek it may be useful to take two Signets of Capture for the other Elementalist elite (Sandstorm).
ecacf070ef8ceeb6c1700d54e07edb51515719b4.text: * 沙之法師 卓加姆 也存在於探索中，雖然這是一次公平的長途跋涉，但為其他 元素使 精英 (沙塵暴) 獲取兩個捕獲徽記可能會很有用。

8aa775aafb6440c0c0fcd97a39785e88977431e3.source:
*Consider bringing two Signets of Capture, as Mekir the Prismatic, the boss carrying Ether Prism, is in this area.
*You may wish to start from The Mouth of Torment, as it's a shorter walk.
8aa775aafb6440c0c0fcd97a39785e88977431e3.text:
*考慮帶兩個捕獲徽記，因為攜帶 精神稜鏡 的 Boss 稜柱梅基爾就在這個區域。
*您可能希望從 苦痛之地隘口 出發，因為步行時間較短。

91ba29c94aa3575f958b2ee4bb595092f2d78bf2.source:
Hassin and the group of insects around him don't try to attack you or come towards you if you attack them with a ranged weapon. They will also not attack your pet either if your pet goes and attacks them while you are attacking them with the ranged weapon.

Hassin and the group will not scatter when you use AoE skills, for example Fire Storm, if you are right on the edge of your range and don't attack them with your weapon.
91ba29c94aa3575f958b2ee4bb595092f2d78bf2.text:
如果你用遠端武器攻擊哈辛和他周圍的昆蟲群，他們不會試圖攻擊你或朝你靠近。如果您的寵物在您使用遠端武器攻擊它們時攻擊它們，它們也不會攻擊您的寵物。

當您使用 範圍性 技能（例如 火焰風暴）時，如果您位於射程邊緣並且不使用武器攻擊他們，哈辛和團隊將不會分散。

d71e2615bd3e1a0c9e969e2b13b72a8fb2a16fe3.source: * Several Istani Cultists can be found around it. They will attack if you approach.
d71e2615bd3e1a0c9e969e2b13b72a8fb2a16fe3.text: * 在它周圍可以找到幾個伊斯坦尼教徒。如果你靠近，他們就會攻擊。

f07188951f0d0a2f3cb32e9d593015af883ef0f9.source: *If seeking to capture this boss' elite skill, consider bringing along an extra Signet of Capture, as Faveo Aggredior is nearby and is the only boss who carries Assault Enchantments.
f07188951f0d0a2f3cb32e9d593015af883ef0f9.text: *如果想要獲得該 Boss 的精英技能，請考慮攜帶額外的 捕捉紋章，因為 Faveo Aggredior 就在附近，並且是唯一攜帶 加持衝擊 的 Boss。

487ab2f52ba0db9e8cce063af90f3dce8fe1327d.source: * He is initially friendly and turns hostile a few seconds after finishing his dialogue.
487ab2f52ba0db9e8cce063af90f3dce8fe1327d.text: * 他最初是友好的，但在完成對話幾秒鐘後就變得充滿敵意。

7083cff1af45adbb8957ac26803a95d93609f32f.source:
* When this boss's group is killed, an additional smaller group comes forward.
* Directly behind this bosses' spawn location is a treasure chest.
7083cff1af45adbb8957ac26803a95d93609f32f.text:
* 當這個 Boss 的隊伍被殺死時，會有另外一個較小的隊伍出現。
* 首領出生位置的正後方是一個寶箱。

24a9af265116c033fdad54bed115490eeb5eaac5.source: *If seeking to capture this boss' elite skill, consider bringing along an extra Signet of Capture, as Chimor the Lightblooded is nearby and is the only boss who carries Mark of Insecurity.
24a9af265116c033fdad54bed115490eeb5eaac5.text: *如果想要獲得該 Boss 的精英技能，請考慮攜帶額外的 捕捉紋章，因為光血奇莫就在附近，並且是唯一帶有不安全印記的 Boss。

d3c0e0d3164c491e6418c22c7bb78c41c801ac67.source:
* Saevio Proelium is mentioned in the quests A Brief Introduction and Between a Rock...
* He usually spawns with 3-5 Pain Titans.
d3c0e0d3164c491e6418c22c7bb78c41c801ac67.text:
* Saevio Proelium 在任務「簡介」和「岩石之間」中被提及...
* 他通常與 3-5 苦痛 泰坦產生。

10d1c3e599760f8cd1761986edcd0db8cbc1f772.source: * The Margonites that are grouped with this boss are flanked by two groups of Torment creatures. Careful separation of the mobs is recommended.
10d1c3e599760f8cd1761986edcd0db8cbc1f772.text: * 與該 Boss 分組的瑪貢尼特兩側是兩組折磨生物。建議小心地將小怪分開。

aab63dc809abd3bb796b12dd89bc73a5206fcd2c.source:
* Because Soul Torture has a very long activation time without technically doing anything, consider waiting until the Tortureweb Dryder begins activating it before entering its aggro and engaging it. Avoid using interrupt skills or attacking it with weapons (because Soul Torture is easily interruptible) during this time.
* Make sure to spread out to prevent heavy area of effect damage from Liquid Flame and Fireball, which could overwhelm healers if not careful.
aab63dc809abd3bb796b12dd89bc73a5206fcd2c.text:
* 由於靈魂折磨的啟用時間非常長，而且從技術上講不做任何事情，因此請考慮等到折磨網烘乾機開始啟用它，然後再進入其仇恨並與其交戰。在此期間避免使用打斷技能或使用武器攻擊它（因為靈魂折磨很容易被打斷）。
* 確保分散開來，以防止 液態火焰 和 火球 造成大範圍的效果傷害，如果不小心，可能會壓垮治療者。

5310e60213d1899270189a5e49dd4988ec825642.source: *This boss uses ranged attacks instead of its dagger attack skills.
5310e60213d1899270189a5e49dd4988ec825642.text: *這個boss使用遠端攻擊而不是匕首攻擊技能。

263bdcb8e73c25d01e6ec5c6a0d9946c7015d24f.source: * Master of Misery's group moves in a patrol path from the initial location indicated on the map to near the entrance of the temple, and then back again.
263bdcb8e73c25d01e6ec5c6a0d9946c7015d24f.text: * 苦難大師的隊伍沿著巡邏路徑從地圖上指示的初始位置移動到寺廟入口附近，然後再返回。

4a545fe5c253064981d3b67db33145714902f42a.source:
* He will not appear in Arkjok Ward if the quest The Great Escape is active; Commander Kubeh (a ranger boss, with Barrage as his elite skill) will appear at his location instead.
* He and his group will start patrolling as you near his position.
4a545fe5c253064981d3b67db33145714902f42a.text:
* 如果任務 大逃亡 處於活動狀態，他將不會出現在 阿爾科監禁區 中； 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Kubeh（遊俠老闆，以 齊射 作為他的精英技能）將出現在他的位置。
* 當你靠近他的位置時，他和他的團隊將開始巡邏。

45bf6c20dab0a62f647a8121d3acd082a20dc973.source:
* If you can, prevent the acolyte from invoking the form, e.g. by interrupting.
* In hard mode, applying Daze and Weakness will make things much easier.
* Kill the guards and healers before attempting to take on the boss.
45bf6c20dab0a62f647a8121d3acd082a20dc973.text:
* 如果可以的話，阻止助手呼叫 型態，例如透過打斷。
* 在困難模式下，應用 Daze 和 虛弱 將使事情變得更加容易。
* 在嘗試對抗 Boss 之前殺死守衛和治療師。

a29c34a3a5c87d2072ce51299d59f5c1b8b7b4a5.source: * Be extremely careful of this boss' Spirit Rift. In Normal Mode, the amount of damage this skill can do is already high, but in Hard mode, it is capable of dealing 500+ damage to each character, easily killing all of a clumped group. When he uses Spirit Rift you have 3 seconds to flag your heroes away.
a29c34a3a5c87d2072ce51299d59f5c1b8b7b4a5.text: * 要格外小心這個老闆的 生靈裂縫。在普通模式下，此技能可以造成的傷害已經很高，但在困難模式中，它能夠對每個角色造成500+傷害，輕鬆殺死一群人。當他使用 生靈裂縫 時，您有 3 秒的時間來標記您的英雄。

96d42aeabd97680f9c422743abc9811fb1b214c2.source:
* He does not have an item spell to benefit from Renewing Memories. 
* He is located right next to two other groups containing bosses, use caution when approaching him.
96d42aeabd97680f9c422743abc9811fb1b214c2.text:
* 他沒有可以從 復原記憶 中受益的物品法術。 
* 他位於另外兩個包含 Boss 的小組旁邊，接近他時要小心。

df1e863d5234bd1ae7f910c5d8cc78a110145a71.source: * Be careful not to over-aggro; the area he's in is swarmed with many different types of creatures, including two other groups with bosses. The group Mhedi travels with is also rather large, which makes it a challenge to get the skill capture.
df1e863d5234bd1ae7f910c5d8cc78a110145a71.text: * 注意不要過度仇恨；他所在的區域擠滿了許多不同型別的生物，其中包括另外兩個有 Boss 的群體。 Mhedi 隨行的隊伍也相當龐大，這使得技能捕捉成為一個挑戰。

dff67ca28efc92b5947c5a2014e0e3684679baaf.source: * Regardless of whether or not he is killed during the mission, he will appear later in Vabbi as Lieutenant Vanahk with the same appearance and skills.
dff67ca28efc92b5947c5a2014e0e3684679baaf.text: * 無論他是否在任務中被殺，他稍後都會以瓦納克中尉的身份出現在 瓦貝 中，具有相同的外觀和技能。

366b78127c8682fbe5d708c8c67f6343ab6a0639.source: *Regardless of whether or not she is killed during the mission, she will appear later in Vabbi as Commander Sadi-Belai with the same appearance and skills.
366b78127c8682fbe5d708c8c67f6343ab6a0639.text: *無論她是否在任務中被殺死，她稍後都會以指揮軍‧沙帝-貝萊的形式出現在瓦貝中，並具有相同的外觀和技能。

ea8364d158d44defb38e8ddeb71ffc1b67f5f834.source: * Regardless of whether or not she is killed during the mission, she will appear later in Vabbi as Corporal Suli with the same appearance and skills.
ea8364d158d44defb38e8ddeb71ffc1b67f5f834.text: * 無論她是否在任務中被殺，她稍後都會在 瓦貝 中以蘇利下士的身份出現，具有相同的外觀和技能。

72dbef12de63c472be821bb4b3e17a926a06d70d.source: * Some Ibogas patrol through Lunto and his group's path.
72dbef12de63c472be821bb4b3e17a926a06d70d.text: * 一些伊博加人在倫托和他的團隊的路徑上巡邏。

0c448d1c5a0a6c1b8a50fb6b512997e9d40a1ddf.source: * Consider bringing two Signets of Capture when capturing Grenth's Grasp since Acolyte of Melandru is just north of this boss.
0c448d1c5a0a6c1b8a50fb6b512997e9d40a1ddf.text: * 捕捉 古蘭斯之爪 時考慮帶兩個捕獲徽記，因為 梅蘭朵 的侍僧在這個 Boss 的北邊。

30e890185b434d493923d19759be39bb94eaf8c4.source: *Caution while engaging this foe is advised, as fighting will most likely take place on said bridge, leaving less space to maneuver but exalting the tactical value of a Ranger's traps at the same time.
30e890185b434d493923d19759be39bb94eaf8c4.text: *建議在與這個敵人交戰時要小心，因為戰鬥很可能發生在所述橋上，留下的機動空間較小，但同時提升了 遊俠 陷阱的戰術價值。

ede24c7aed2fad467804b1e10abdc9ae18f1a544.source:
*Sometimes Exuro Flatus will become passive (stop attacking or casting offensive spells) for short periods of time.
*Exuro Flatus cannot attack.

*If leaving from the Gate of Madness, beware as you can immediately aggro a group of Shadow Army foes.
*A group of Shadow Army foes can walk within Exuro's area, making farming difficult.
ede24c7aed2fad467804b1e10abdc9ae18f1a544.text:
*有時，Exuro Flatus 會在短時間內變得被動（停止攻擊或施放攻擊性法術）。
*Exuro Flatus無法攻擊。

*如果您從 瘋狂之門 離開，請小心，因為您可能會立即激怒一群 暗影軍團 敵人。
*一群 暗影軍團 敵人可以在 Exuro 的區域內行走，使耕作變得困難。

fe98c95616845f4958cee7dc04f96d2e81fff674.source:
* You may find it quicker and easier to enter from the Gate of Madness - it is possible to avoid all the titans on your way to this boss.
* Be cautious when bringing any highly damaging elite skill as the boss will copy it and wipe your party if given the chance.
fe98c95616845f4958cee7dc04f96d2e81fff674.text:
* 您可能會發現從 瘋狂之門 進入更快更容易 - 可以在通往這個 Boss 的路上避開所有泰坦。
* 在使用任何高傷害精英技能時要小心，因為如果有機會，老闆會複製它並消滅你的隊伍。

198dd9bc92cdc55cb3fec50456924e8d365f857c.source:
* Razakel was one of the demons that helped Abaddon cause the Cataclysm.
* Razakel is also a common name used for a demon in many games and stories.
198dd9bc92cdc55cb3fec50456924e8d365f857c.text:
* 拉扎克爾是幫助 亞霸頓 引發大災變的惡魔之一。
* Razakel 也是許多遊戲和故事中惡魔的常用名稱。

4484abdcbb35b441abc00afd893e77f6fdd731df.source:
*When slain, the enemies that spawn after it may not necessarily appear immediately. If they do not, move closer to where the Greater Darkness was defeated.
*A Spirit of Truth will spawn near the reward chest after the death of the Greater Darkness, all his spawned and accompanying Darknesses, as well as the Earth Tormentors they spawn.
4484abdcbb35b441abc00afd893e77f6fdd731df.text:
*被殺死後，隨後出現的敵人不一定會立即出現。如果他們不這樣做，請靠近更大黑暗被擊敗的地方。
*在大黑暗、他所產生的所有黑暗和伴隨的黑暗，以及它們所產生的地球折磨者死亡後，真理之靈將在獎勵箱附近產生。

1dd55c946daf6cda8db79b3da8ed230ca6bb6759.source: *This Monster looks like a Flesh Golem created by the Necromancer skill Animate Flesh Golem.
1dd55c946daf6cda8db79b3da8ed230ca6bb6759.text: *此 怪物 看起來像是由 死靈法師 技能 操縱血肉高崙 所創造的 鮮血高崙。

6098b94deb619badc3e0e92a4f5d2e74bd9dd1b6.source:
* To make the fight easier draw him away from his spawn point towards the City of Torc'qua. Putting your casters behind the fortress wall will allow them to cast spells in relative safety (Jadoth and his ranged allies will be unable to hit them).
** Alternatively there is a cliff on the other side of the fortress. Hiding your casters beneath that cliff will yield similar results.
* Jadoth's group has two monks, make sure to take enough anti-healing skills.
* He is very powerful and will make short work of parties approaching him when allowing him to cast his Storm of Judgment too often. Soothing Images and Diversion are effective counters.
* A Spirit of Truth will spawn near to the reward Chest after his death.
* To get the Torc'qua Chest, all Margonites must be killed. You may find that a couple hide beyond the hill towards The Stygian Veil. Approaching this area will cause them to come toward you.
6098b94deb619badc3e0e92a4f5d2e74bd9dd1b6.text:
* 為了讓戰鬥更容易，把他從出生點拉向托克誇的 城市。將你的施法者放在要塞牆後面將使他們能夠相對安全地施放法術（賈多斯和他的遠端盟友將無法擊中他們）。
** 另外，堡壘的另一面有懸崖。將腳輪隱藏在懸崖下方也會產生類似的結果。
* 賈多斯的隊伍有兩位武僧，一定要帶足夠的反治療技巧。
* 他非常強大，當他經常施放審判風暴時，他會很快解決接近他的各方。 意念平靜 和 牽制 是有效計數器。
* 真理之靈在死亡後會在獎勵 寶箱 附近生成。
* 要獲得Torc'qua 寶箱，必須殺死所有瑪貢尼特。您可能會發現一對夫婦躲在山那邊，朝向冥河面紗。接近這個區域會讓他們朝你走來。

51a55979c2330706ca1b298b23751f9b42fdc59d.source: *A large number of Stygian demons and Torment Claws are spawned following the death of each Smothering Tendril, potentially overwhelming an over-enthusiastic party.
51a55979c2330706ca1b298b23751f9b42fdc59d.text: *每個窒息卷鬚死亡後都會產生大量的斯泰吉亞惡魔和折磨之爪，這可能會壓倒過度熱情的隊伍。

f76731b450fb351ca52f0503a91b8238674d1bf0.source:
*There is a miniature version of this NPC.
*One of the Mysterious Tonic's forms.
*One of the Mysterious Summoning Stone's summons.
*Despite being a dervish, its unique drop is a shield.
f76731b450fb351ca52f0503a91b8238674d1bf0.text:
*這個NPC有一個縮小版。
*神秘滋補劑的一種形式。
*神秘召喚石的召喚之一。
*儘管是苦行僧，但其獨特的掉落物是盾牌。

4df09f7f252ef53c36814d27309af51364c68f6b.source: * He spawns with Hauseh the Defiler, Tanmahk the Arcane, and several Graven Monoliths when the first Abaddon Shrine on the right is destroyed.
4df09f7f252ef53c36814d27309af51364c68f6b.text: * 當右側第一個 亞霸頓 神殿被摧毀時，他會與汙染者豪斯、奧術坦瑪克和幾塊墓碑一起出現。

6545d896c75acd6f01a7ba297f6510abe5c7b9a4.source:
* Even though his type is Mummy, holy damage does not do double damage to him.
* He wields a hammer.
6545d896c75acd6f01a7ba297f6510abe5c7b9a4.text:
* 儘管他的型別是木乃伊，但神聖傷害不會對他造成雙倍傷害。
* 他揮舞著一把錘子。

70dcfd81ee27ccdc20a2fa46fb2297ad75ff4bee.source:
* Pikin was accidently removed after the "International Talk like a Pirate Day" event. He was put back in a later update
* Shares the skill Shatter Enchantment with Libeh and the skill Empowerment with Shiloh, making him one of only a few hero skill trainers that teaches the same skill as another hero skill trainer. The only other two hero skill trainers with this trait are the aforementioned Libeh and Shiloh.
70dcfd81ee27ccdc20a2fa46fb2297ad75ff4bee.text:
* 派金 在「像海盜一樣的國際對話日」活動後意外刪除。他在稍後的更新中被放回
* 與利貝共享技能加持粉碎，以及與席隆共享技能活化，使他成為少數與另一位英雄技能訓練師教授相同技能的英雄技能訓練師之一。僅有的另外兩位具有此特徵的英雄技能訓練師是前面提到的利貝和席隆。

034e6cbdf14ced5e40bea07aa33a641458450113.source: * Johon the Oxflinger was named by Jonathan Aiken through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.
034e6cbdf14ced5e40bea07aa33a641458450113.text: * Johon the Oxflinger 是由 Jonathan Aiken 在 2007 品牌 頭目 競賽中命名的。

516181519a933160128ec05387143884996327f6.source: * This boss has a large patrol path in the northwestern section of the area. His group travels either in a clockwise or counter-clockwise manner, which can make encountering them difficult.
516181519a933160128ec05387143884996327f6.text: * 這個boss在該地區的西北部有一條大的巡邏路徑。他的團隊以順時針或逆時針的方式行進，這可能會導致遇到他們變得困難。

69fd17645067e5feddcec11248e4825bce4cdacd.source:
* While he uses predominantly warrior skills (including his elite), he has a paragon aura and will drop paragon tomes.
* The cave where this boss is located serves to farm Archaic Maul in regular quantities, it's one of the common items that the Kveldulf can drop.
69fd17645067e5feddcec11248e4825bce4cdacd.text:
* 雖然他主要使用戰士技能（包括他的精英技能），但他擁有典範光環並且會掉落典範書籍。
* 這個 Boss 所在的洞穴可以定期種植遠古之槌，它是克維爾杜夫可以掉落的常見物品之一。

5e30378283e6a7b46be5df69fb3319de0b4ad56d.source: * You do not have to kill him to complete the quest In the Service of Revenge.
5e30378283e6a7b46be5df69fb3319de0b4ad56d.text: * 你不必殺死他來完成任務 以眼還眼。

54110f12008582496b673a9f57b236b5e4d6eb56.source: * Unlike many bosses in Eye of the North, he does not possess Natural Resistance.
54110f12008582496b673a9f57b236b5e4d6eb56.text: * 與 極地之眼 中的許多 Boss 不同，他不具備自然抵抗力。

f7787194c35c52571d19f6e55c72fa8d455cd5c2.source:
* Jormungand spawns alongside two Frost Wurms.
* If the boss does not appear, a solitary Frozen Elemental or Frost Wurm will sometimes spawn instead.
** Some players believe that the appearance of these other foes at any potential spawning location means that Jormungand will not appear in the current instance. However, no one has published sufficient research to confirm or deny this theory.
f7787194c35c52571d19f6e55c72fa8d455cd5c2.text:
* 耶夢加德與兩隻冰霜亞龍一起生成。
* 如果 Boss 沒有出現，有時會產生單獨的 冰元素 或冰霜 地蟲。
** 有些玩家認為，這些其他敵人出現在任何潛在的生成位置意味著耶夢加得不會出現在當前例項中。然而，沒有人發表足夠的研究來證實或否認這個理論。

d279f63aad25da58b1309b41d178b2f8b079ab69.source:
*Often he is found in one of the patrol groups that go either clockwise or counterclockwise around the lake instead of staying in one place.
*Sometimes, Koren and his group will be killed by other monsters in the area, making it seem as if they never spawned. This will not update the quest.
d279f63aad25da58b1309b41d178b2f8b079ab69.text:
*經常發現他在巡邏隊之一中，沿著湖順時針或逆時針方向行駛，而不是停留在一個地方。
*有時，科倫和他的團隊會被該地區的其他怪物殺死，讓他們看起來好像從未出現過。這不會更新任務。

adb0bef820e4b5e2238728c8710c761b71888a7b.source:
* Approaching or flagging a hero to Nulfastu's tree will lead to spawning all enemies, some of which will remain level 5 rabbits.
* On the Notorious Foe signpost and in all linked quests his name has a comma: Nulfastu, Earthbound. However, the name of the NPC himself does not contain a comma.
adb0bef820e4b5e2238728c8710c761b71888a7b.text:
* 接近或標記英雄到 Nulfastu 的樹上將導致所有敵人生成，其中一些敵人將保持 5 等級的兔子。
* 在臭名昭著的敵人路標上和所有連結的任務中，他的名字都有一個逗號：地縛 納法斯圖。然而，NPC本人的名字中不包含逗號。

acc3103c420f442469bf22a01a021a903805531b.source:
* She doesn't use her own scythe, but an Asuran Scythe.
* Myish, Lady Of The Lake is at the center of Drakkar Lake, surrounded by groups of Frozen Elementals and Chilling Wisps with wide patrol paths. Consider dispatching the patrols with careful pulling before confronting the boss.
* The frozen lake around Myish causes Icy Ground, however she may be lured to a little island to the southwest, therefore negating the environmental effect.
acc3103c420f442469bf22a01a021a903805531b.text:
* 她使用的不是自己的鐮刀，而是阿蘇蘭 鐮刀。
* Myish，Lady Of The Lake 位於 卓卡湖 的中心，周圍有成群的冰凍元素和寒冷小精靈，巡邏路徑很寬。在面對 Boss 之前，請考慮小心地派遣巡邏隊。
* Myish 周圍結冰的湖泊會導致 冰凍 地面，但她可能會被引誘到西南部的一個小島上，從而消除環境影響。

8359a0ea66646b27e0e443de159aa281b56b0979.source: * He will spawn from the start, but not become hostile until all other points in the quest have been cleared.
8359a0ea66646b27e0e443de159aa281b56b0979.text: * 他會從一開始就出現，但在任務中的所有其他點都被清除之前不會變得敵對。

a2677df0807642292bd458124cf0f83bc767f8b4.source: * In normal mode, it takes him 8-10 minutes to patrol his route. In hard mode, he will run his route in 2 minutes.
a2677df0807642292bd458124cf0f83bc767f8b4.text: * 在正常模式下，他需要 8-10 分鐘來巡邏他的路線。在困難模式下，他將在 2 分鐘內跑完路線。

306167c80503ad48ba2bc4b20a8968d499d0cb30.source:
* Upon coming within range of the Stone Summit Gnashers, they will begin a dialogue to "summon" Lord Glacius.
** If you attack the group before the summoning is complete, they may end their dialogue early. The summoning process will still complete when the dialogue would have finished as long as one of the Gnashers is alive. If you kill all of the Gnashers before they complete the summoning, Lord Glacius the Eternal will not appear.
306167c80503ad48ba2bc4b20a8968d499d0cb30.text:
* 當進入 石峰矮人 咬牙者的攻擊範圍內時，他們將開始對話以「召喚」格拉修斯勳爵。
** 如果你在召喚完成之前攻擊該小組，他們可能會提前結束對話。只要其中一名咬人還活著，對話結束時召喚過程仍然會完成。如果你在咬人完成召喚之前殺死所有咬人，永恆領主格拉修斯將不會出現。

b855df96464438a1ae88ed8524b3f3dd8a8b6327.source: * In the German language version they are called "Lissah der Rudelführer" which would indicate they are male (otherwise it would be "Lissah die Rudelführerin").
b855df96464438a1ae88ed8524b3f3dd8a8b6327.text: * 在德語版本中，他們被稱為“Lissah der Rudelführer”，這表明他們是男性（否則將是“Lissah die Rudelführerin”）。

ec23dd0ec1d8cac973a68c61a3ec6166d3e6aeb4.source:
*He is a warrior in Jaga Moraine and uses the Stone Summit Herder model.
*He is a monk in Sorrow's Furnace and uses a Stone Summit Taskmaster model
**He is an ally due to Chains of Enslavement.
ec23dd0ec1d8cac973a68c61a3ec6166d3e6aeb4.text:
*他是Jaga Moraine的戰士並使用石鋒巨大牧者模型。
*他是 悲傷熔爐 中的修士並使用 石峰矮人 Taskmaster 模型
**由於奴役之鏈，他是盟友。

7d28942f6e4d8fed8355b2d4d1c1ea9c0773e4ed.source:
* He is one of the bosses to be killed for the quest Anything You Can Do. When you approach him a number of Bone Fiends will appear. These Bone Fiends are not minions, thus he can't use Taste of Death on them and his Dark Bond won't work either. Also, Verata's Aura and Verata's Gaze cannot gain control of these creatures. 
* Although he is a Norn, he does not use Bear Form because he fell from the grace of the Bear Spirit.
* Despite this being an 8 person area, it is possible to take the route shown, defeating very few mobs along the way, to reach and defeat this boss with a 4 person team. That can help improve the odds of receiving the unique weapon drop.
7d28942f6e4d8fed8355b2d4d1c1ea9c0773e4ed.text:
* 他是因任務「無所不能」而被殺死的 Boss 之一。當你接近他時，會出現許多骨魔。這些骨魔不是僕從，因此他不能對它們使用 死亡滋味，他的 暗黑連結 也不行。此外，芙瑞達的靈氣 和 芙瑞達的凝視 無法控制這些生物。 
*雖然他是諾恩，但他沒有使用熊形態，因為他從熊靈的恩典中墮落了。
* 儘管這是一個 8 人區域，但可以按照所示路線，擊敗沿途很少的小怪，與 4 人團隊一起到達並擊敗這個 Boss。這有助於提高獲得獨特武器掉落的機率。

6fe7c7df635d8fcda0f4a4f6491f0d407f51ef59.source:
* Whiteout resides at the top of a steep rise, on a narrow path. 
** Beware of tumbling boulders that can instantly kill anyone in their path. 
** If you are using heroes and/or henchmen, flag them at the bottom of the rise, the walk up the path to trigger the boulders so that you can more easily dodge them.
* Whiteout is accompanied by an Avalanche and two Ice Elementals, but is very vulnerable to fire damage.
** Focus everyone's attack on Whiteout and he will go down quickly. After killing him your party will be able to take out the rest of the enemies.
** To farm this boss, rezone at the nearby Frostmaw's Burrows dungeon portal.
6fe7c7df635d8fcda0f4a4f6491f0d407f51ef59.text:
* Whiteout 位於陡峭山坡的頂部，位於一條狹窄的道路上。 
** 小心翻滾的巨石，它們會立即殺死路上的任何人。 
** 如果您使用英雄和/或追隨者，請在上升的底部標記他們，沿著路徑向上走以觸發巨石，以便您可以更輕鬆地躲避它們。
* 白化伴隨著雪崩和兩個冰元素，但容易受到火焰傷害。
** 聚能器 大家對 Whiteout 的攻擊，他會很快倒下。殺死他後，你的隊伍將能夠消滅其餘的敵人。
** 要耕種該 Boss，請在附近的 凍霜地道 地下城門戶重新分割槽。

9f89fde593e37bf84d1464e693dad6b19ab89632.source: *Try to take out the patrols nearby before you attempt to kill him or you might find yourself overwhelmed.
9f89fde593e37bf84d1464e693dad6b19ab89632.text: *在你試圖殺死他之前，試著幹掉附近的巡邏隊，否則你可能會發現自己不知所措。

d3375c7418e5c1b92548890a44f34b8eb5332427.source:
* When close to the edge of the player's compass, Molotov Rocktail will begin a patrol to the north east and continue a short way into the forest.
* His Devourer Siege can easily wipe out a party that is not spread out; flag heroes and henchmen around or underneath him and either interrupt or blind him, preventing both his Devourer Siege and Power Attack.
* You can tank Rocktail using the nearby Siege Devourer: since it rarely uses Devourer Siege once in melee, you can use the durability of the Siege Devourer to approach it alone and lock it in melee safely, even in hard mode.
* Molotov Rocktail has an extended aggro range, much like Kournan Spotters.
* Due to Devourer Siege, Pain Inverter is very effective, since it reflects damage from your minions, spirits, summons, and animal companions.
d3375c7418e5c1b92548890a44f34b8eb5332427.text:
* 當接近玩家指南針邊緣時，石尾 摩洛托夫 將開始向東北方向巡邏，並繼續一小段距離進入森林。
* 他的 蠍 Siege 可以輕鬆消滅未分散的隊伍；在他周圍或下方標記英雄和追隨者，並打斷他或致盲他，從而阻止他的 蠍 Siege 和 強力攻擊。
* 你可以使用附近的 Siege 蠍 來坦克 Rocktail：因為它很少在近戰中使用 蠍 Siege，所以你可以利用 Siege 蠍 的耐用性單獨接近它，並將其安全地鎖定在近戰中，即使在困難模式下也是如此。
* 石尾 摩洛托夫 有擴充套件的仇恨範圍，很像 Kournan Spotters。
* 由於 蠍 Siege，苦痛 Inverter 非常有效，因為它反映了來自您的僕從、靈魂、召喚物和動物夥伴的傷害。

e057b8c668c35d1bfde5def91e88d3537546825e.source: * The Flaming Scepter Mages replace Hodat and the accompanying group of Stone Furies before completion of Forgotten Relics.
e057b8c668c35d1bfde5def91e88d3537546825e.text: * 在完成 被遺忘者 Relics 之前，火焰權杖法師取代了 Hodat 和隨行的石之怒火隊伍。

4b9be6abc0f6197cfafe16efc90420daf6f6be05.source: *Groknar Weazlewortz was named by You Will Know Fear through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.
4b9be6abc0f6197cfafe16efc90420daf6f6be05.text: *Groknar Weazlewortz 是由 You Will Know Fear 在 2007 品牌 頭目 競賽中命名的。

aa24529a45d93d5ca52cbe34ffcdcc144e2f2b8b.source: *It is possible that Gordam Griefgiver is from the same Warband as Blazefiend Griefblade.
aa24529a45d93d5ca52cbe34ffcdcc144e2f2b8b.text: *Gordam Griefgiver 可能與 Blazefiend Griefblade 來自同一個幫派。

3c757aea89abd9e962e76132b3efe5692890cbcf.source:
* Gallow Nooseknitter was named by Will Bonner (Hustler Warrior) through the 2007 Brand The Boss contest.
* If you're farming this boss, you can use the portal just southeast of it to rezone and come back.
3c757aea89abd9e962e76132b3efe5692890cbcf.text:
* Gallow Nooseknitter 是由 Will Bonner (Hustler 戰士) 在 2007 品牌 頭目 競賽中命名的。
* 如果你正在耕種這個boss，你可以使用它東南方的傳送門重新分割槽並返回。

f611becc7f94d5a012956c24852715c363323bbc.source:
*The Facet of Existence has a random spawn location in Riven Earth. Known spawn locations:
*#Northwest of the Golem Foundry.
*#Directly east from Rata Sum, before the second resurrection shrine.
*#Up the hill slightly southwest of the center resurrection shrine.
*#Northeast of center, northeast of the short bridge north of center, between the northern and northeastern resurrection shrines (see map).
*#Southeast corner, in the raised area overlooking the waterfall from the north.
*As the first spawn point is so close to Rata Sum, it may be worth reloading the map until you get this spawn. It can be reached without combat.
f611becc7f94d5a012956c24852715c363323bbc.text:
*存在的面在 撕裂大地 中有一個隨機產生位置。已知的產卵地點：
*#傀儡鑄造廠的西北方。
*#洛達頂點 正東方向，第二個復活神殿之前。
*#在中心復活神殿稍西南的山上。
*#中心東北部，中心以北短橋東北部，北部和東北復活神殿之間（參見地圖）。
*#東南角，位於從北面俯瞰瀑布的凸起區域。
*由於第一個生成點非常接近 洛達頂點，因此可能值得重新載入地圖，直到您獲得此生成點。無需戰鬥即可到達。

680e1f1100046e53ec79abf264a19d066ef7a9cc.source:
* He can hit hard, so it is advised to take some interrupt skills.
* Spoil Victor and Pain Inverter are very effective against Joffs. Enchantment removal will also help by removing his protective spells.
* Due to the nature of the damage from Shockwave, it is advisable to space out your party as best as you possibly can to avoid a devastating spike which could very well kill your entire party.
* After killing the surrounding enemies, it is possible to lure Joffs to the southeast past a large rock/hill, where he will become stuck as he tries to get back to his spawn. It is then possible to defeat him with minimal casualties as he will simply walk back and forth as you attack him.
680e1f1100046e53ec79abf264a19d066ef7a9cc.text:
* 他的攻擊力很強，所以建議帶點打斷技能。
* 勝者的掠奪 和 苦痛 逆變器對於對抗 Joffs 非常有效。 加持魔法 移除也將有助於移除他的保護咒語。
* 由於 衝擊波 造成的損害的性質，建議儘可能分散您的隊伍，以避免毀滅性的峰值，這很可能會殺死您的整個隊伍。
*殺死周圍的敵人後，可以將喬夫斯引誘到東南方，經過一塊大岩石/山丘，當他試圖返回他的出生地時，他會被困在那裡。然後就可以以最小的傷亡擊敗他，因為當你攻擊他時他只會來回走動。

a3ab95c3ad1368201bbfd6caf25a7cec83d1c576.source:
* The Broodmother's cave is just south of the northern exit in Rata Sum. Not far from her spawn point, you can find a Jar of Invigoration; when dropped, it provides 30 energy to all nearby creatures.
* The cave is filled with three large groups of level 15 Raptor Nestlings. Although they deal relatively little damage, they spam Disrupting Stab, preventing your team from using skills effectively. Rekoff herself deals large amounts of damage. Bring a team that can deal effectively with significant amounts of melee and bring interruption counter-tactics.
* Since the cave is so close to Rata Sum, her group is used to farm Asura reputation points and festival trophy drops. The popularity of the farm also means that Claws of the Broodmother are very common and do not trade at a premium.
a3ab95c3ad1368201bbfd6caf25a7cec83d1c576.text:
* 育母洞穴位於 洛達頂點 北出口的南邊。離她的重生點不遠，你可以找到一罐活力罐；當掉落時，它會為附近的所有生物提供 30 能量。
* 洞穴裡充滿了三大組 15 毒瑞克斯 雛鳥。儘管它們造成的傷害相對較小，但它們會向 幹擾刺擊 傳送垃圾郵件，阻止您的團隊有效地使用技能。雷科夫本人造成了大量傷害。組建一支能夠有效應對大量混戰並實施幹擾反擊戰術的團隊。
* 由於洞穴距離 洛達頂點 非常近，她的團隊被用來種植 阿蘇拉 聲望點和節日獎盃掉落。農場的受歡迎程度也意味著育母之爪非常常見，並且不會以溢價進行交易。

3454ef7afb512f8fa6eea7b225180e523a59a0d9.source:
* You can counter Mobrin's heavy damage with skills that cause weakness or blindness.
* Compared to a regular Tyrannus, Mobrin trades out the anti-block knockdown of Leviathan's Sweep for the cleaving potential of Sweeping Strikes.
3454ef7afb512f8fa6eea7b225180e523a59a0d9.text:
* 你可以用導致虛弱或失明的技能來對抗莫布林的嚴重傷害。
* 與普通 Tyrannus 相比，Mobrin 以 海獸掃蕩 的反格擊擊倒能力換取了 Sweeping Strikes 的劈砍潛力。

1ecd17553c463803b9c898a8d9665b989d6a29c9.source:
* They have the usual golden warrior boss aura, with an additional purple circular inscription aura about the height of their chest.
* Despite being Ettins, they drop Jotun items.
* They appear to be functionally identical to Inscribed Sentries.
1ecd17553c463803b9c898a8d9665b989d6a29c9.text:
* 他們擁有通常的金色戰士首領光環，還有一個大約胸部高度的紫色圓形銘文光環。
* 儘管是埃丁人，他們還是會掉落佐敦物品。
* 它們在功能上似乎與銘刻哨兵相同。

aee3d48d7cb008e9886cdc1c4fba57a71d13739d.source:
* The Facet of Death has a random spawn location in Sparkfly Swamp. Known spawn locations:
*# Eastern edge of the central clearing, up the hill to the south of the easternmost edge of the swamp. 
*# Southeast of center, at the three way crossroads north of the resurrection shrine.
*# In the center of the Agari territory.
*# Northeast of center, at the three way crossroads between the resurrection shrine at the eastern edge of the swamp and Brynn Earthporter's alcove.
aee3d48d7cb008e9886cdc1c4fba57a71d13739d.text:
* 死亡面在 火星蠅沼澤 中有一個隨機產生位置。已知的產卵地點：
*# 中央空地的東邊，沼澤最東邊以南的山上。 
*# 中心東南部，復活神殿以北的三路十字路口。
*# 在阿加里領地的中心。
*# 中心東北部，位於沼澤東部邊緣的復活神殿和布林·地球搬運者的壁龕之間的三路十字路口。

b790d27d78941d5da52f7965bcc3553c160d1de9.source:
* Care must be taken with this group (and the other groups of Burning Spirits), as they have a wide patrol range and can quickly ambush and wipe your group while fighting other enemies. They are also highly resistant to fire damage and immune to burning, so other categories of elemental spells should be used against them. 
* Consider bringing AoE interrupts such as Cry of Frustration, Tease, or a ranger with Choking Gas. 
:* The interrupt Complicate, when used on Searing Flames, is particularly effective as it will shut down the entire mob's main source of damage.
* Hex Eater Vortex and Shatter Hex can also be useful in removing Mark of Rodgort from melee characters and dealing large armor-ignoring damage to nearby foes. 
* Pre-interrupts such as Guilt and Mistrust can help in interrupting the multiple copies of Searing Flames.
* Winter will prevent Mark of Rodgort and the spike damage from Searing Flames from triggering and significantly boost damage from your elemental sources.
* Elementalists should consider bringing Frigid Armor to effectively prevent any damage from Searing Flames.
b790d27d78941d5da52f7965bcc3553c160d1de9.text:
* 必須小心這個隊伍（以及其他燃燒之靈隊伍），因為他們的巡邏範圍很廣，可以在與其他敵人戰鬥時快速伏擊和消滅你的隊伍。它們對火焰傷害也有很強的抵抗力並且免疫燃燒，因此應該使用其他類別的元素法術來對付它們。 
* 考慮引入 範圍性 中斷，例如 挫折哭喊、嘲弄 或帶有 窒息毒氣 的 Ranger。 
:* 中斷 糾纏 在 爆裂火焰 上使用時特別有效，因為它將關閉整個生物的主要傷害源。
* 食咒渦流 和 降咒粉碎 也可用於從近戰角色中移除 洛葛特的印記 並對附近的敵人造成大量無視護甲的傷害。 
* 內疚 和 疑惑 等預先中斷可以協助中斷 爆裂火焰 的多個副本。
* 寒冬 將防止 洛葛特的印記 和 爆裂火焰 的尖峰傷害觸發，並顯著增強元素來源的傷害。
* 元素師應考慮攜帶冰凍護甲，以有效防止爆裂火焰造成的任何傷害。

9c1cfe956d09ccafb801af5c4e2eaf4318a592ce.source:
*You need to have done the Assault on the Stronghold mission before you will be able to reach him.
*He will not spawn if you have the quest Forbidden Fruit active.
9c1cfe956d09ccafb801af5c4e2eaf4318a592ce.text:
*您需要先完成 襲擊根據地 任務才能聯絡他。
*如果您啟動了任務 禁果，他將不會產生。

a9711730e9a459343a70506aaafbc4694429244a.source:
* As a hammer warrior, he can be handled with any anti-melee build.
* As with Borrguus Blisterbark, it is a good idea to kill the roving patrols of Burning Spirits before you take him and his group on, otherwise it is very likely that you will get ambushed and likely wiped out.
* Ignus is the only Titan boss who does not follow the typical naming convention of Titan bosses of two pseudo-Latin words.
a9711730e9a459343a70506aaafbc4694429244a.text:
* 作為一名錘子戰士，他可以用任何反近戰構建來應對。
* 與 風吼 柏格斯 一樣，在攻擊 Burning Spirits 和他的團隊之前，最好先殺死他的巡邏隊，否則你很可能會遭到伏擊並被消滅。
* Ignus 是唯一一個不遵循兩個偽拉丁字 泰坦 boss 典型命名約定的 泰坦 boss。

9fa912c41245fb23b2ffe01189de5ba869e73406.source:
* The fight is made difficult by the large number of both Grawl Champions and Grawl Dark Priests which surround him. Approaching him from the south, four of the closest Grawl Champions can be pulled away from the group, but all the others attack cohesively along with the boss.
* Area-of-effect anti-melee hexes such as Meekness and Enfeebling Blood are very useful, along with wards such as Ward Against Melee and Ebon Battle Standard of Courage. As always, a minion master can greatly help redirect damage from the team.
9fa912c41245fb23b2ffe01189de5ba869e73406.text:
* 由於周圍有大量 穴居人 冠軍和 穴居人 黑暗牧師，戰鬥變得困難。從南邊接近他時，可以將四名最近的 穴居人 冠軍從隊伍中拉開，但所有其他人都會與 Boss 一起攻擊。
* 區域效果反近戰六角形（例如 溫順 和 血之衰弱）非常有用，以及病房（例如 迴避結界 和 黑檀 勇氣戰旗）。一如既往，隨從大師可以大大幫助轉移團隊的傷害。

96dd82ad4382023639b76cd8ccbc4ee4d35af1d7.text: * 夏爾 雕像一旦被仇恨就會生成。

61bc78d834d49052ccc514ef27984969d461cdcb.source:
* His route is approximately 5 minutes in length, varying in direction and path per spawn. It patrols around the edge of the northeastern lagoon more often than the south route.
* Flannuss usually becomes stuck on a cliff almost directly south of Vlox's Falls, at the northernmost tip of the land jutting into the river delta - marked with the monk icon on the wiki map. The quickest way to locate the boss should be to travel clockwise on the red path. Alternatively, wait in the spot where it may get stuck - both patrol routes overlap here.
* An easy (but repetitive) method for killing Flannuss is to zone into Arbor Bay from Vlox's Falls head forward, killing the first two groups of Krait and heading left along the cliff tops. If he is not there, he will likely be there in two minutes - otherwise he is on the other route, so rezone and try again.
61bc78d834d49052ccc514ef27984969d461cdcb.text:
* 他的路線長度約為 5 分鐘，每次生成的方向和路徑各不相同。它在東北潟湖邊緣巡邏的次數比在南線巡邏的次數多。
* 弗蘭努斯通常會被困在弗洛克斯瀑布正南方的懸崖上，位於伸入河流三角洲的土地最北端 - 在維基地圖上標有僧侶圖示。找到 Boss 最快的方法應該是沿著紅色路徑順時針移動。或者，在可能被卡住的地方等待——兩條巡邏路線在這裡重疊。
* 殺死 Flannuss 的一個簡單（但重複）的方法是從 Vlox's Falls 向前分割槽進入 Arbor Bay，殺死前兩組 環蛇，然後沿著懸崖頂部向左移動。如果他不在那裡，他很可能會在兩分鐘內到達 - 否則他在另一條路線上，所以重新劃線並重試。

44330771adaf8b06ff7852782e7aac150c8c6be9.source:
* A Siege Devourer can be used to easily take down the large mob that accompanies Fureyst Sharpsight, making the battle considerably easier. 
** It is possible to acquire one early directly to the south of Doomlore Shrine in Dalada Uplands. Take then the portal to Grothmar Wardowns then go south to Sacnoth Valley for a slightly faster route.
** In Hard Mode, a Siege Devourer will spawn near Fureyst Sharpsight. With a runner it is possible to quickly reach Rragar's Menagerie, zone there, then reenter Sacnoth Valley, take the devourer and proceed from there. The runner can still be useful in combat by mounting the devourer themselves.
44330771adaf8b06ff7852782e7aac150c8c6be9.text:
* 攻城 蠍 可用於輕鬆消滅伴隨 Fureyst Sharpsight 的大型暴徒，使戰鬥變得更加容易。 
** 可以提前在 達拉達山地 的 末日傳說神殿 正南方向直接取得一個。然後走通往 Grothmar Wardowns 的傳送門，然後向南走到 聖諾谷 以獲得稍微更快的路線。
** 在困難模式中，Siege 蠍 將在Fureyst Sharpsight 附近產生。奔跑者可以快速到達 拉喀的牢籠，在那裡區域，然後重新進入 聖諾谷，拿走吞噬者並從那裡繼續前進。透過安裝吞噬者，奔跑者仍然可以在戰鬥中發揮作用。

1888ffe41e952703dc65765057e2f64b4d1e873b.text: 永恆叢林（可探索區域）和甲拉孵化場（可探索區域）是替代路線；主線的延續並不需要依序完成兩個營地。

cef4bf910b8b2f2caa3056dc6cc02d43bbe01ca8.source: Pogahn Passage with Rilohn Refuge It's an alternative route. Separate requests. Margrid the Sly with Master of Whispers。Consulate Docks and Moddok Crevice Request Dunkoro；Venta Cemetery Request Koss；Kodonur Crossroads Request Zhed Shadowhoof。
cef4bf910b8b2f2caa3056dc6cc02d43bbe01ca8.text: 波甘驛站 與 Rilohn Refuge 這是一條替代路線。單獨的請求。狡猾的瑪格麗特與密語大師。領事館碼頭和 摩多克裂縫 請求 Dunkoro；文塔墓園請求 寇斯；科登諾入口 要求 Zhed Shadowhoof。

e23d1c766047ba5987051e9dbdbee4c0ee53a9a2.text: 達沙走廊 / 薩崗諾稜堡 兩個或一個；Jennur's Horde / 納度灣 您也可以單獨檢查。瑪格麗德 / 密語大師、寇斯 / 梅隆妮 (a) 隨附的請求；Sebelkeh 大法院請求 Tahlkora。

718bc126543e76fe887b53ff8a9a14a0f15a41a0.source:
Warrior Ancient armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign. This armor is crafted by Palmod in the Bone Palace.

There is no standard version of Ancient armor.



* The leggings of this Armor Set are a reskin of the Istani Armor Set leggings.
718bc126543e76fe887b53ff8a9a14a0f15a41a0.text:
古代 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。該盔甲由 Palmod 在 白骨宮殿 中製作。

fa20ce94e3dac4a63750cc805f054164c3264fac.source:
Warrior Ascalon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor and it is also available in the Factions campaign. It can only be crafted up to armor rating 59 in Prophecies, but can be crafted in Factions up to max armor rating. The helm is only available without attribute bonus in Prophecies, but with any warrior attribute in Factions.

There is no prestige version of Ascalon armor.

Note: The starter helm is named "Recruit's Cap" and the rest of the starter pieces are named "Ringmail".
fa20ce94e3dac4a63750cc805f054164c3264fac.text:
阿斯卡隆 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 戰役中作為入門盔甲引入的藝術型別，它也可在 盟與敵 戰役中使用。它只能在 阿斯卡隆戰記 中製作到最高裝甲等級 59，但可以在 盟與敵 中製作到最高裝甲等級。此安全帽僅在 阿斯卡隆戰記 中沒有屬性加成時可用，但在 盟與敵 中具有任何戰士屬性。

阿斯卡隆 裝甲沒有進階版本。

注意：起始頭盔被命名為“新兵帽”，其餘起始件被命名為“環甲”。

279cd0d174e2bf45591ddcc63d6234cad7613d24.source:

279cd0d174e2bf45591ddcc63d6234cad7613d24.text:

* 除了頭盔略有改造外，裝甲與 精英庫茲柯 有一些相似之處。

Note: Ranger Krytan armor uses a unique mask art in Factions, not available in Prophecies.

There is no prestige version of Krytan armor.



*Ranger Monument armor uses an adaptation of the vest for male rangers
The male version of the armor has clipping issues when in various animations.
Has clipping issues with capes.
612318e568aea4d57d944fc0dc91c2cf6a0b27ad.text:
科瑞塔 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中作為收藏盔甲引入的藝術類型，也可在 盟與敵 活動中用於製作。

注意：科瑞塔 使用 盟與敵 中獨特的遮罩藝術，而 阿斯卡隆戰記 中不可用。

科瑞塔 沒有進階版本。



*紀念碑 採用男性護林員背心的改良版
男性版本的盔甲在各種動畫中都存在剪下問題。
斗篷有剪裁問題。

8591cd7b4a41d4099408f4cb5e2a46f7f5c7367b.source:
Ranger Kurzick armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Ranger Elite Kurzick armor.
8591cd7b4a41d4099408f4cb5e2a46f7f5c7367b.text:
庫茲柯 是 盟與敵 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英庫茲柯。

697344f3c218174e9a77326e5891beba9e668be3.source:
Ranger Leather Long Coat is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



* This armor piece is a reskin of the Ancient coat .
In some types of gloves the left hand seems to pierce through the coat.
When equipped with Primeval Boots, the Horns stick through the long coat.
When equipped with Primeval Leggings, the back piece sticks through the long coat.
697344f3c218174e9a77326e5891beba9e668be3.text:
皮製長袍 是 極地之眼 擴充包中的高階盔甲。您需要在 戴爾狄摩 標題曲中至少達到 5（大膽探索者）的等級才能製作此盔甲。



* 這件盔甲是古代外套的重新設計。
在某些型別的手套中，左手似乎會刺穿外套。
當裝備原始靴子時，角會刺穿長外套。
裝備原始護腿時，後背會穿過長外套。

7dc7664a737335d3783a77ab4ee2ae4e09414dac.source:
Ranger Luxon armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Ranger Elite Luxon armor.
7dc7664a737335d3783a77ab4ee2ae4e09414dac.text:
勒克森 是 盟與敵 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英勒克森。

be4e74f805e171a9151b815ccde2eaed0aab0ef9.source:
Warrior Monument armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Shadow Agent) in the Ebon Vanguard title track to be able to craft this armor.



* The symbol on the chest of the male version is known as the Celtic Wheel of Being.
* The individual armor components are very similar in structure to components from previously released armor sets.

dac5b4a79407d142626b764ef43813d1772d4fb7.source: Warrior Norn armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the Norn title track to be able to craft this armor.
dac5b4a79407d142626b764ef43813d1772d4fb7.text: 諾恩 是 極地之眼 擴充包中提供的聲望藝術型別。您需要在 諾恩 標題曲中至少達到 5（Wurms 殺手）等級才能製作這款盔甲。

0f52701b07c534a7ceaa3c1071f93e501072580d.source:
Warrior Obsidian armor is a prestige art type available to players from all campaigns.



* In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in The Fissure of Woe, players must complete the following quests:
** The Eternal Forgemaster
** Defend the Temple of War
** Restore the Temple of War
0f52701b07c534a7ceaa3c1071f93e501072580d.text:
戰士 黑曜石盔甲是一種聲望藝術型別，可供所有戰役中的玩家使用。



* 為了讓 永生的鍛造大師 出現在 災難裂痕 中，玩家必須完成下列任務：
** 永生的鍛造大師
** 保衛戰爭神殿
** 恢復戰爭神殿

9180bfb422b2000053cf447421929e2f553b4508.source:
Warrior Platemail armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Warrior Elite Platemail armor.
9180bfb422b2000053cf447421929e2f553b4508.text:
金屬板 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英金屬板。

605862177090737ec9b80cfa67dd728d43f3c22f.source:
Warrior Primeval armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign. 

This armor is only available in the Throne of Secrets, an explorable area only accessible by completing the final mission in Nightfall. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

There is no standard version of Primeval armor.



* This armor has clipping issues with most shields.
* Female version of this armor has clipping issues with capes.
* The Helmet has clipping issues when the warrior talks during a cut-scene.
605862177090737ec9b80cfa67dd728d43f3c22f.text:
太古 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。 

此裝甲僅在 神秘王座 中可用，這是一個只能透過完成 黑暗逆襲 中的最終任務才能進入的可探索區域。如果您打算購買這件盔甲，請確保您帶上任務所需的所有製作材料和金錢，因為該區域沒有迅來特工、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

太古 沒有標準版。



* 該盔甲與大多數盾牌都存在剪下問題。
* 該盔甲的女性版本有斗篷剪裁問題。
* 當戰士在過場動畫中說話時，頭盔會出現剪裁問題。

caf2979829e06009c758e5bb9c344c8a261cec93.source:
Warrior Shing Jea armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign, as starter armor (named Recruit's armor), collector armor for the region of Shing Jea Island, and as regular craftable armor.

There is no prestige version of Shing Jea armor.
caf2979829e06009c758e5bb9c344c8a261cec93.text:
星岬 是 盟與敵 戰役中可用的藝術型別，可用作入門盔甲（稱為新兵盔甲）、星岬島 區域的收藏盔甲以及常規可製作盔甲。

Shing Jea 盔甲沒有高階版本。

68290ec0d8554507c6a62ae55917f3f86ea78832.source:
Warrior Stalwart Leggings is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*The female model is a reskinned regular Templar leggings, and the male one is regular Kurzick.
68290ec0d8554507c6a62ae55917f3f86ea78832.text:
英勇護腿 是 極地之眼 擴充包中的高階盔甲。您需要在 戴爾狄摩 標題曲中至少達到 5（大膽探索者）的等級才能製作此盔甲。



*女款是重新換皮的常規聖殿騎士護腿，男款是常規 庫茲柯。

d6ea443c061a3059dd43ef8cadd25fff75caed55.source:
Ranger Traveler Mask is a mask art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This mask is available with a Wilderness Survival attribute bonus for all masks with lower than max armor rating. At max armor rating this mask can be crafted with all ranger attribute bonuses. 



* This mask is available for ranger PvP-only characters to create as starter armor with +1 Wilderness Survival, and is also available as a Basic PvP reward for +1 of any ranger attribute.
* This mask clips with several male ranger hairstyles.
d6ea443c061a3059dd43ef8cadd25fff75caed55.text:
遊俠 旅行者面具是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中引入的面具藝術型別，也可在 盟與敵 活動和 極地之眼 擴充功能中使用。對於所有低於最大護甲等級的面具，此面具均具有 求生 屬性加成。在最大護甲等級下，面具可以用所有遊俠屬性加成來製作。 



* 此面具可供遊俠 PvP 專用角色使用 +1 求生 建立為入門盔甲，也可作為任何遊俠屬性的 +1 的基本 PvP 獎勵。
* 這款面具可夾多種男性護林員髮型。

4f17ec2abdcd6d20f837412df957fbaaa8122905.source:
Ranger Tyrian armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign, but which is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. The armor is labelled as Tyrian armor when the armor provides 70 armor rating, otherwise it is called Leather armor.

Note: Ranger Tyrian armor does not have headgear, but Ranger Tamer Mask and Ranger Traveler Mask are available from the same crafter in Factions and Eye of the North. Pictures and crafting details are available on those pages.

There is no prestige version of Tyrian armor.



*There is a small clipping issue on the female top, making the character's shoulder visible through it.
*Dyes do not seem to affect the female glove.
4f17ec2abdcd6d20f837412df957fbaaa8122905.text:
泰瑞亞 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中引入的藝術型別，但也可在 盟與敵 活動和 極地之眼 擴充功能中使用。當盔甲提供70盔甲等級時，該盔甲被標記為泰瑞安盔甲，否則稱為皮甲盔甲。

注意：泰瑞亞 沒有頭套，但 遊俠 Tamer Mask 和 遊俠 Traveler Mask 可以從 盟與敵 和 極地之眼 的相同工匠處取得。這些頁面上提供了圖片和製作細節。

泰瑞亞盔甲沒有高階版本。



*女性上衣有一個小的剪裁問題，使角色的肩膀透過它可見。
*染料似乎不會影響女用手套。

fa8304bf3dee09414b5953b114274ef2f155c446.source:
Ranger Vabbian armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

There is no standard version of Vabbian armor.



The material holding the front-most dagger on the pants does not dye properly, staying its original color while the material holding the other daggers changes to the color you dyed the pants.
A large section of the skirt portion of the leg armor will clip through the left leg while walking.
fa8304bf3dee09414b5953b114274ef2f155c446.text:
瓦貝 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

瓦貝 沒有標準版。



褲子上固定最前面的匕首的材質無法正確染色，保持其原始顏色，而固定其他匕首的材質會變成你給褲子染色的顏色。
行走時腿甲裙部的很大一部分會夾住左腿。

237187eaa07d2c51b6e8dcf55fc2dd229e9388b4.source:
Monk Adorned Handwraps is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*Female armor part is a reskin of Monk Kurzick armor handwraps. 
*Male armor part is a reskin of Monk Elite Canthan armor handwraps.
237187eaa07d2c51b6e8dcf55fc2dd229e9388b4.text:
裝飾手纏 是 極地之眼 擴充包中的高階盔甲。您需要在 戴爾狄摩 標題曲中至少達到 5（大膽探索者）的等級才能製作此盔甲。



*女性盔甲部分是庫茲柯包巾的重新皮膚。 
*男性盔甲部分是精英凱珊裹手的換膚品。

671ddb9f75bba156db933e373abb5d15a422e7a6.source:
Monk Ancient armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

There is no standard version of Ancient armor.
671ddb9f75bba156db933e373abb5d15a422e7a6.text:
古代 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

古代 沒有標準版。

b05cdfb024e8f000f58d3e859ca21da91df61319.source:
Monk Ascalon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor (named Roughspun) and is also available in the Factions campaign.

Note: Monk Ascalon armor does not have headgear, but the Dragon Scalp Design is available from the same armorer in Factions. Pictures and crafting details are available on that page.

There is no prestige version of this armor.



This armor (female) has clipping issues during the walking animation.
b05cdfb024e8f000f58d3e859ca21da91df61319.text:
阿斯卡隆 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 戰役中作為入門盔甲引入的藝術型別（名為 Roughspun），也可在 盟與敵 戰役中使用。

注意：阿斯卡隆 沒有頭飾，但龍頭皮設計可從 盟與敵 中的相同裝甲師處取得。該頁面上提供了圖片和製作詳細資訊。

該盔甲沒有高階版本。



該盔甲（女性）在行走動畫期間有剪下問題。

a1c38f0ecf771c08360244a1ed0b1f303609bb88.source: Monk Asuran armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the Asura title track to be able to craft this armor.
a1c38f0ecf771c08360244a1ed0b1f303609bb88.text: 阿蘇拉 是 極地之眼 擴充包中提供的聲望藝術型別。您需要在 阿蘇拉 標題曲中至少達到 5（不太煩人）的等級才能製作這件盔甲。

ffc7b76b38999611cc4d20f1b2bef813c3c63267.source:
Monk Aureate Pants is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*Female armor part is a reskin of Monk Elite Canthan armor pants. 
*Male armor part appears to be a reskin of the Monk Elite Kurzick armor pants.
These pants have clipping issues on male monks while wielding some types of shields and focuses.
ffc7b76b38999611cc4d20f1b2bef813c3c63267.text:
燦爛短褲 是 極地之眼 擴充包中的高階盔甲。您需要在 戴爾狄摩 標題曲中至少達到 5（大膽探索者）的等級才能製作此盔甲。



*女性裝甲部分是精英凱珊褲子的重新設計。 
*男性裝甲部分似乎是 精英庫茲柯 褲子的重新設計。
這些褲子對男性僧侶在揮舞某些型別的盾牌和焦點時存在剪裁問題。

d31b657e24c5bdcc3116317b1c04fa6fa17d0799.source:
Monk Canthan armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign both as crafted armor and as collector armor for the region of Kaineng City.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Canthan armor.
d31b657e24c5bdcc3116317b1c04fa6fa17d0799.text:
凱珊 是 盟與敵 戰役中的藝術型別，既可以作為 凱寧城 地區的精製盔甲，也可以作為收藏盔甲。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英凱珊。

4e0e17487d1e63992da9e0faded136b00c9ccc1f.source:
Monk Censor armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign. It is known as PvP Militant armor for PvP characters.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Judge armor.
4e0e17487d1e63992da9e0faded136b00c9ccc1f.text:
評論者 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的藝術型別。它被稱為 PvP 角色的 PvP 戰鬥盔甲。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英審判者。

0244d4a436367dd2ed251a5000a1fa6f29de3594.source:
Monk Dragon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and the scalp design from this set is also available as a collector reward in Prophecies and from armorers in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. In Prophecies only headgear with an armor rating higher than 15 has an attribute bonus.

There is another variant of this armor art named Monk Star armor.

The prestige versions of this armor are Monk Flowing armor and Monk Labyrinthine armor.
0244d4a436367dd2ed251a5000a1fa6f29de3594.text:
巨龍的紋身 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中引入的藝術型別，該套裝中的頭皮設計也可作為 阿斯卡隆戰記 中的收藏家獎勵以及 盟與敵 活動和 極地之眼 擴充套件中的裝甲師提供。在阿斯卡隆戰記中，只有護甲等級高於15的頭飾才有屬性加成。

這款盔甲藝術還有另一種變體，名為 繁星的紋身。

此裝甲的進階版是 漂流的紋身 和 謎樣。

40b2348d3c1898724f4ae5e183442577a1dd5110.source:
Monk Elite Canthan armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

This armor is only available in the Divine Path, an explorable area only accessible by completing Imperial Sanctum. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Canthan armor.
40b2348d3c1898724f4ae5e183442577a1dd5110.text:
精英凱珊 是 盟與敵 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

此盔甲僅在 神聖之路 中可用，這是一個只能透過完成 帝國聖所 進入的探索區域。如果您打算購買這件盔甲，請確保您帶上任務所需的所有製作材料和金錢，因為該區域沒有迅來特工、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

此裝甲的標準版本是凱珊。

025265789c9f2770c99b4c5a60c7dcb206ec887d.source:
Monk Elite Judge armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Censor armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Ascended Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
025265789c9f2770c99b4c5a60c7dcb206ec887d.text:
精英審判者 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

此裝甲的標準版本是評論者。



* 該盔甲在 史蹟殿堂 的「韌性」紀念碑中標記為 Granite Citadel Ascended 防禦。

b938914e773c1edff9f123a90d61c0211f41430a.source:
Monk Elite Kurzick armor is a prestige armor art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Kurzick armor.
b938914e773c1edff9f123a90d61c0211f41430a.text:
精英庫茲柯 是 盟與敵 戰役中提供的聲望護甲藝術型別。

此裝甲的標準版本是庫茲柯。

1e5824a9e03df62804e2574d951e897ed427e94f.source:
Monk Elite Luxon armor is a prestige art type available in the Factions campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Luxon armor.



Guild capes, if displayed, have a clipping issue with the pants. The tip of the cape clips through and "flaps" while in the bugged clipping
1e5824a9e03df62804e2574d951e897ed427e94f.text:
精英勒克森 是 盟與敵 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

此裝甲的標準版本是勒克森。



公會 斗篷（若顯示）與褲子有剪裁問題。在有竊聽器的剪輯中，斗篷的尖端會穿過並“拍打”

e13adaf953e7d75c26c0de84a96b634b35cfb4a2.source:
Monk Elite Saintly armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

This armor is a reskin of the Monk Krytan armor, but the standard version of this armor is actually Monk Sacred armor.



* This armor is labeled Marhan's Grotto Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* The bands on the upper arms are linked to the chest piece, not the handwraps.
e13adaf953e7d75c26c0de84a96b634b35cfb4a2.text:
精英聖徒 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

該盔甲是科瑞塔的重新設計，但該盔甲的標準版本實際上是神聖。



* 此裝甲在 史蹟殿堂 的「韌性」紀念碑中標示為 馬翰洞穴 精英 防禦。
* 上臂上的帶子與胸件相連，而不是與裹手相連。

c9ff7291cddf87d06935b057260383b57b5c74db.source:
Monk Elite Woven armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Woven armor.



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Exclusive Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
c9ff7291cddf87d06935b057260383b57b5c74db.text:
精英流浪者 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

此裝甲的標準版本是流浪者。



* 該盔甲在 史蹟殿堂 的「韌性」紀念碑中標記為 Granite Citadel Exclusive 防禦。

7483dd355d675734a801f5df395be8d06aa9effe.source:
Monk Flowing armor is a prestige art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The standard versions of this armor are Monk Dragon armor and Monk Star armor. 



* This armor is labeled Granite Citadel Elite Armor in the "Resilience" monument in the Hall of Monuments.
* The female armor waist has some animation issues when running.
* There is a variant of this armor called Monk Labyrinthine armor.
7483dd355d675734a801f5df395be8d06aa9effe.text:
漂流的紋身 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

此裝甲的標準版本是巨龍的紋身和繁星的紋身。 



* 此護甲在 史蹟殿堂 的「韌性」紀念碑中標示為 Granite Citadel 精英 防禦。
* 女性鎧甲腰部在奔跑時存在一些動畫問題。
* 此裝甲有一個變體，稱為 謎樣。

6e3be78149ac793ab5af59b6697f57ce788ef8c8.source:
Monk Gilded Vestments is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*Female armor part is a reskin of Monk Elite Woven vestments.
*Male armor part is a reskin of Monk Sacred Vestments.
6e3be78149ac793ab5af59b6697f57ce788ef8c8.text:
鍍金祭衣 是 極地之眼 擴充包中的高階盔甲。您需要在 戴爾狄摩 標題曲中至少達到 5（大膽探索者）的等級才能製作此盔甲。



*女性盔甲部分是 僧侶 精英 編織法衣的重新皮膚。
*男性盔甲部分是僧侶神聖法衣的重新皮膚。

b2b3952109c2e9991dbee72ba4162ab900515497.source:
Monk Istani armor is an art type available in the Nightfall campaign as starter armor, as collector armor for the region of Istan and as regular crafted armor. The collector headgear is only available with a Divine Favor +1 bonus. 

There is no prestige version of Istani armor.
b2b3952109c2e9991dbee72ba4162ab900515497.text:
艾斯坦 是 黑暗逆襲 戰役中的藝術型別，可作為入門盔甲、艾斯坦 地區的收藏盔甲以及常規製作的盔甲。收藏家頭飾僅適用於 神恩 +1 獎勵。 

艾斯坦 沒有進階版本。

cad8f7c1cbccb2ce2b6201bfb414fbb4674f202c.source:
Monk Krytan armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as collector armor and is also available in the Factions campaign.

Note: Monk Krytan armor art does not have headgear. The Dragon Scalp Design is used as collector scalp design in Prophecies and it is also available from Oroku in Factions. Pictures, crafting and collecting details are available on that page.

There is no prestige version of Krytan armor (although Elite Saintly armor uses the same model).

This armor set dyes lighter if acquired from Factions.
cad8f7c1cbccb2ce2b6201bfb414fbb4674f202c.text:
科瑞塔 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中作為收藏盔甲引入的藝術型別，也可在 盟與敵 活動中使用。

注意：科瑞塔 art 沒有安全帽。龍頭皮設計在 阿斯卡隆戰記 中用作收藏家頭皮設計，並且在 盟與敵 中也可以從 Oroku 取得。該頁面提供圖片、製作和收集詳細資訊。

科瑞塔 沒有尊享版（儘管 精英 聖甲使用相同機種）。

如果從 盟與敵 取得，該裝甲套裝的顏色會變淺。

11a12daa95029b53d6c7ecdf52b3b2463acaf868.source:
Monk Kurzick armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Kurzick armor.
11a12daa95029b53d6c7ecdf52b3b2463acaf868.text:
庫茲柯 是 盟與敵 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英庫茲柯。

cb87e0ee2185ceb503badbd9835967f48d473f54.source:
Monk Luxon armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Luxon armor.
cb87e0ee2185ceb503badbd9835967f48d473f54.text:
勒克森 是 盟與敵 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英勒克森。

55b2f8ff6285d426ec34d61e3f2b0770003ba4a2.source:
Monk Primeval armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

This armor is only available in the Throne of Secrets, an explorable area only accessible by completing the final mission in Nightfall. If you plan on buying this armor make sure you take all of the required crafting materials and money into the mission with you, as there are no Xunlai Agents, material traders, or rare material traders available in the zone.

There is no standard version of Primeval armor.



* Male chest piece has clipping issues with capes
55b2f8ff6285d426ec34d61e3f2b0770003ba4a2.text:
太古 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

此裝甲僅在 神秘王座 中可用，這是一個只能透過完成 黑暗逆襲 中的最終任務才能進入的可探索區域。如果您打算購買這件盔甲，請確保您帶上任務所需的所有製作材料和金錢，因為該區域沒有迅來特工、材料商人或稀有材料商人。

太古 沒有標準版。



* 男性胸衣與斗篷的剪裁問題

34f956a301e9b2586b3ba017dad0c10346220194.source:
Monk Sacred armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign. 

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Saintly armor.
34f956a301e9b2586b3ba017dad0c10346220194.text:
神聖 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的藝術型別。 

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英聖徒。

8c70e0c341701435b8c7b65e5ea6cccbcaae27a7.source:
Monk Shing Jea armor is an art type available in the Factions campaign as starter armor (named Vassal's armor), as collector armor for the region of Shing Jea Island and as regular crafted armor. 

There is no prestige version of Shing Jea armor.
8c70e0c341701435b8c7b65e5ea6cccbcaae27a7.text:
星岬 是 盟與敵 戰役中的藝術型別，可作為入門盔甲（稱為 Vassal 盔甲）、星岬島 地區的收藏盔甲以及常規製作的盔甲。 

Shing Jea 盔甲沒有高階版本。

2d5d63436abd7fb149fc2688d51200966c08432d.source:
Monk Star armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

There is another variant of this armor art named Monk Dragon armor. 

The prestige versions of this armor are Monk Flowing armor and Monk Labyrinthine armor.

Note: The Star Scalp Design is only available without attribute bonus until Droknar's Forge (maximum armor rating). In Droknar's Forge it's available with all attribute bonuses for monks.
2d5d63436abd7fb149fc2688d51200966c08432d.text:
繁星的紋身 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這種盔甲藝術還有另一種變體，名為 巨龍的紋身。 

此裝甲的進階版是 漂流的紋身 和 謎樣。

注意：星形頭皮設計僅在 卓克納熔爐（最大護甲等級）之前不提供屬性加成。在 卓克納熔爐 中，它可以提供僧侶所有屬性加成。

8bac05c70217131ef947462d2b4bd35db25d3380.source:
Monk Sunspear armor is an art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Sunspear armor.



* The male chest piece has a clipping error with the guild cape.
* The female top, when viewed from the back has a clipping error where the arm can be seen through it.
* The shoes disappear in water, and are not visually affected by dyes.
8bac05c70217131ef947462d2b4bd35db25d3380.text:
日戟 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英日戟。



* 男性胸甲與公會披風的剪裁錯誤。
* 從背面看時，女上衣有剪裁錯誤，可以透過它看到手臂。
* 鞋子在水中會消失，不會受到染料的視覺影響。

e80f50b2ac0b7971a83655e3f7c6ce5298200c90.source:
Monk Elite Sunspear armor is a prestige art type introduced in the Nightfall campaign.

The standard version of this armor is Monk Sunspear armor.
e80f50b2ac0b7971a83655e3f7c6ce5298200c90.text:
精英日戟 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中引入的聲望藝術型別。

此裝甲的標準版本是日戟。

8f869aad34beacebbfc0ba31bddee537fd0a12c7.source:
Monk Tyrian armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. This armor is called Monk armor up to maximum armor level in Droknar's Forge where it is instead called Tyrian armor.

Note: Monk Tyrian armor does not have headgear, but the Dragon Scalp Design is available from the same armorer in Factions and Eye of the North. Pictures and crafting details are available on that page.

There is no prestige version of Tyrian armor.
8f869aad34beacebbfc0ba31bddee537fd0a12c7.text:
僧侶 泰瑞安盔甲是 阿斯卡隆戰記 戰役中引入的藝術型別，也可在 盟與敵 戰役和 極地之眼 擴充包中使用。該盔甲被稱為 僧侶 盔甲，最高可達 卓克納熔爐 中的最大盔甲級別，而在 卓克納熔爐 中它被稱為泰瑞安盔甲。

注意：僧侶 泰瑞亞盔甲沒有頭飾，但龍頭皮設計可從 盟與敵 和 極地之眼 中的相同盔甲師處取得。該頁面上提供了圖片和製作詳細資訊。

泰瑞亞盔甲沒有高階版本。

7dd4e49195f443eea46ae83cb96f32b1edef3a13.source:
Monk Vabbian armor is a prestige art type available in the Nightfall campaign.

There is no standard version of Vabbian armor.
7dd4e49195f443eea46ae83cb96f32b1edef3a13.text:
瓦貝 是 黑暗逆襲 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

瓦貝 沒有標準版。

d528796cd664f03dd3bc8ab7e489cb3ea350331b.source:
Monk Woven armor is an art type available in the Prophecies campaign.

The prestige version of this armor is Monk Elite Woven armor.



*Although it is possible to dye the female handwraps, there are no visible changes; thus, dying the handwraps may be wasteful.
d528796cd664f03dd3bc8ab7e489cb3ea350331b.text:
流浪者 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的藝術型別。

這款盔甲的尊貴版本是 精英流浪者。



*雖然可以對女性裹手進行染色，但沒有明顯的變化；因此，對裹手進行染色可能會造成浪費。

460b31e7f12de2f95481fded221da3a7cb3680b3.source:
Necromancer Ancient armor is a prestige armor art available in the Nightfall campaign.

There is no standard version of Ancient armor.
460b31e7f12de2f95481fded221da3a7cb3680b3.text:
古代 是 黑暗逆襲 戰役中提供的聲望護甲藝術。

古代 沒有標準版。

663b61c04a776302a2ddd0a8cdfe4c1626f5ad9d.source:
Necromancer Ascalon armor is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor (named Initiate's) and is also available in the Factions campaign.

Note: Necromancer Ascalon armor art does not have headgear, but the Necromancer Ragged Scar Pattern art is available from the same armorer in Factions. Pictures and crafting details are available on that page.

There is no prestige version of this armor.
663b61c04a776302a2ddd0a8cdfe4c1626f5ad9d.text:
阿斯卡隆 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 戰役中作為入門盔甲（名為 Initiate）引入的藝術型別，也可在 盟與敵 戰役中使用。

注意：阿斯卡隆 藝術品沒有頭飾，但 死靈法師 粗糙的疤痕 藝術品可從 盟與敵 中的相同裝甲師處取得。該頁面上提供了圖片和製作詳細資訊。

該盔甲沒有高階版本。

91f7c876229dbb1bc96ee7259feb54a50553a741.source:
Monk Monument armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Shadow Agent) in the Ebon Vanguard title track to be able to craft this armor.



* The individual armor components are similar to components from previously released armor sets.

91f7c876229dbb1bc96ee7259feb54a50553a741.text:
紀念碑 是一種享有盛譽的藝術型別 極地之眼 擴張。您至少需要達到等級 5 （ 闇影 代理）在 黑檀 能夠製作這件盔甲的標題曲。



* 各個裝甲元件與先前發布的裝甲套件中的元件類似。

* 此盔甲套裝的男涼鞋可以染色，但沒有效果。

721875b65e264034d17ebfe9962bb04bc65ba541.source: Monk Norn armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Slayer of Wurms) in the Norn title track to be able to craft this armor.
721875b65e264034d17ebfe9962bb04bc65ba541.text: 諾恩 是 極地之眼 擴充包中提供的聲望藝術型別。您需要在 諾恩 標題曲中至少達到 5（Wurms 殺手）等級才能製作這款盔甲。

078edca359ff0f7798a571a408fc5bb91df87f76.source:
Monk Obsidian armor is a prestige art type available to players from all campaigns. There is no Obsidian headgear for monks.



* In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in The Fissure of Woe, players must complete the following quests:
** The Eternal Forgemaster
** Defend the Temple of War
** Restore the Temple of War
078edca359ff0f7798a571a408fc5bb91df87f76.text:
黑曜石 是一種聲望藝術型別，可供所有戰役的玩家使用。僧侶沒有黑曜石頭飾。



* 為了讓 永生的鍛造大師 出現在 災難裂痕 中，玩家必須完成下列任務：
** 永生的鍛造大師
** 保衛戰爭神殿
** 恢復戰爭神殿

be966bdf89bfaf9095c1b063eb59d21281e94546.source:
Monk Ocher Sandals is a prestige armor piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.



*The female sandals are similar to the Vabbian sandals. 
*The male sandals are similar to the Elite Canthan sandals.
be966bdf89bfaf9095c1b063eb59d21281e94546.text:
赭石綁帶鞋 是 極地之眼 擴充包中的高階盔甲。您需要在 戴爾狄摩 標題曲中至少達到 5（大膽探索者）的等級才能製作此盔甲。



*女式涼鞋與 Vabbian 涼鞋類似。 
*男士涼鞋與 精英 Canthan 涼鞋類似。

7b11a028d73126b772851874a2a07c238e669689.source:
Ranger Monument armor is a prestige art type available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Shadow Agent) in the Ebon Vanguard title track to be able to craft this armor.



* The individual armor components are similar to components from previously released armor sets.

* 各個裝甲元件與先前發布的裝甲套件中的元件類似。

d824025c355bcc249cf2b0dbc3fecc161a22df84.source:
Necromancer Asuran armor is a prestige armor art piece available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Not Too Annoying) in the Asura title track to be able to craft this armor.



* This armor is similar to Elite Luxon armor. 
* When dyed Black, some parts, lines, stay messy red.
d824025c355bcc249cf2b0dbc3fecc161a22df84.text:
阿蘇拉 是 極地之眼 擴充套件包中的一件著名盔甲藝術品。您需要在 阿蘇拉 標題曲中至少達到 5（不太煩人）的等級才能製作這件盔甲。



* 此裝甲類似 精英 勒克森 裝甲。 
* 染成黑色後，某些部位、線條會保持雜亂的紅色。

8015cf1d441f72727e7d8f0b01e77898c7ab6815.text:

f5f4d5b35ad180888cd64f063553c45bd1c06647.source:

*Any dye applied onto the female hose (leg piece) is somewhat redundant as it gets obscured by the attire (chest piece).

f5f4d5b35ad180888cd64f063553c45bd1c06647.text:
精英附魔 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中提供的聲望藝術型別。

9a2b674c629555905f27dee5178d1691e11dd646.source:

9a2b674c629555905f27dee5178d1691e11dd646.text:

13cfbec1c9e08be92a0a06ea7738b8fffd512a67.text:

e83ca1028ba3f86d19ef072b18c50bfb13832006.source: The Mesmer Imposing Mask is an art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign and is also available in the Factions campaign and Eye of the North expansion. 141b628068738e9dc46c1452bfe87ab6654df4a9.source:

141b628068738e9dc46c1452bfe87ab6654df4a9.text:

53f88bc39f604661324391624495c1e2b706d8e4.source:

* The female Mask has clipping issues with some hairstyles.
53f88bc39f604661324391624495c1e2b706d8e4.text:
幻術師 獸皮面罩 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中引入的藝術型別，也可在 盟與敵 活動和 極地之眼 擴充中使用。對於所有低於最大護甲等級的面具，此面具均具有 靈感魔法 屬性加成。在最大護甲等級下，面具可以用所有幻術師屬性加成來製作。

86e52edb40fffd3a2e2431d1157f94979a240686.source:
Mesmer Ascalon armor is an armor art type introduced in the Prophecies campaign as starter armor (called Dilettante's armor) and is also available in the Factions campaign.

Note: The art for Mesmer Ascalon armor does not include headgear, but the Discreet, Animal, Costume, Imposing and Sleek masks are available from the same armorers in Factions. In Prophecies an otherwise unnamed mask like the Discreet Mask is used with the Dilettante's set.

There is no prestige version of Ascalon armor.



The texture for the male's attire (chest armor) replaces the character model's actual skin texture. When sitting down, there will be a transparent gap between the attire and the hose (leg armor).
86e52edb40fffd3a2e2431d1157f94979a240686.text:
阿斯卡隆 是 阿斯卡隆戰記 戰役中作為入門盔甲（稱為 Dilettante 盔甲）引入的盔甲藝術型別，也可在 盟與敵 戰役中使用。

注意：阿斯卡隆 的美術不包括頭飾，但 Discreet、動物、Costume、Impose 和 Sleek 面具可從 盟與敵 中的相同盔甲商處取得。在 阿斯卡隆戰記 中，像 慎重面罩 這樣的未命名面具與 Dilettante 套裝一起使用。

阿斯卡隆 裝甲沒有進階版本。



男性服裝（胸甲）的紋理取代了角色模型的實際皮膚紋理。坐下時，服裝和軟管（腿甲）之間會有一個透明的間隙。

a8d18f7721715c330126765cafd90fce5fa21965.source:

a8d18f7721715c330126765cafd90fce5fa21965.text:

* 女性盔甲上的耳環在某些髮型上有剪裁問題。
* 這款盔甲的女性版本似乎是女性 精英貴族 的重新設計。男性似乎是 幻術士傭兵 盔甲的重製版。

Paragon Elonian armor is an art type available in the Nightfall campaign as collector armor for the region of Istan and as regular crafted armor. It is also available in the Eye of the North expansion.

The crests that can be crafted at most armor crafters in Nightfall are named Elonian crests and are therefore considered part of this armor set.

There is no prestige version of Elonian armor.



*The raiment tends to clip with most long hairstyles while running and some while standing.
*Most of the female armor, except the grey-white sparkly part of the leggings, disappears underwater, leaving the character with large gaps, as her skin does not appear instead.
*The leggings on the male armor disappear underwater, leaving the character with gaps where no skin is visible.
60bd27512d97571f50fb69da72b4516cb346d641.text:

大多數盔甲工匠可以在 黑暗逆襲 中製作的徽章被稱為 Elonian 徽章，因此被視為該盔甲套裝的一部分。

埃隆盔甲沒有高階版本。



*跑步時和站立時，衣服往往會夾住大多數長髮型。
*除了緊身褲灰白色閃閃發光的部分外，大部分女性盔甲都會消失在水下，給角色留下很大的間隙，因為她的皮膚沒有出現。

The Bandana is a prestige headgear art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor. It has an Item's Attribute +1 bonus.

There are clipping issues with the Bandana and three different male armors: warrior monument, necromancer asuran, and mesmer norn. In addition, there are stretching errors with the necromancer dance emote.
3dd8cecceb3f58b7be40d44b610b8f6f4f7f5ed6.text:
