* 有時，頭巾的繫帶會與頸部盔甲發生夾斷問題。

頭巾和三種不同的男性盔甲有剪裁問題：戰士紀念碑、死靈法師阿蘇蘭和幻術師諾恩。此外，死靈法師舞蹈表情也存在伸展錯誤。

67615c36c9c19192abcbe6f2297b01573c608945.source:
Chaos Gloves are a prestige glove art available in the Eye of the North expansion. You need to be at least rank 5 (Bold Delver) in the Deldrimor title track to be able to craft this armor.




* Similar to all Mesmer gloves, the Mesmer Chaos Gloves only come up to the wrist.
* If you use an Expert Salvage Kit on the gloves, they will salvage into one of the following:
** 30-40 Piles of Glittering Dust, 2-3 Globs of Ectoplasm
** 25-39 Globs of Ectoplasm
** Piles of Glittering Dust.

=== Coloring notes ===
* When dyed certain colors, there is an extension of the glow from the hand for some female characters.
* Part of the glow is generated through post-processing effects, which many people turn off (either because their system performs better or to avoid changes to the screen as a result being drunk).
* Black (and to a lesser extent silver) dye can dim the glow of the gloves by decreasing the distance of the colored aura from the arm (the color of the arm does not change).
When Chaos Gloves are viewed through a semi-transparent surface, such as in water or under an Ooze, they disappear, making your character appear to not have hands.
If a character cycles between their chaos gloves and another pair of gloves at a semi-fast rate, the chaos gloves will appear with an orange shaded-in box around them for a few milliseconds.
67615c36c9c19192abcbe6f2297b01573c608945.text:
混沌手套是 極地之眼 擴充包中提供的高階手套藝術。您需要在 戴爾狄摩 標題曲中至少達到 5（大膽探索者）的等級才能製作此盔甲。




* 與所有 幻術師 手套類似，幻術師 Chaos 手套僅到達手腕。
* 如果您在手套上使用 專業拆解工具，它們將變成以下之一：
** 30-40 一堆閃閃發光的灰塵，2-3 靈球
** 25-39 靈團
** 成堆的閃閃發光的灰塵。

=== 著色筆記 ===
* 染上某些顏色後，某些女性角色的手部光芒會延長。
* 部分發光是透過後處理效果產生的，許多人將其關閉（要麼是因為他們的系統效能更好，要麼是為了避免因喝醉而導致螢幕發生變化）。
* 黑色（以及較小程度的銀色）染料可以透過減少彩色光環與手臂的距離來使手套的發光變暗（手臂的顏色不會改變）。
當透過半透明表面（例如在水中或軟泥下）檢視混沌手套時，它們會消失，使您的角色看起來沒有手。
如果一個角色以半快的速度在混沌手套和另一副手套之間迴圈，混沌手套周圍會出現一個橙色陰影框，持續幾毫秒。

__NOTOC__
The Eternal Forgemaster crafts prestige armor for all professions. All armor is crafted with an empty insignia slot. In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to appear in the Fissure of Woe players must finish the following quest:
*The Eternal Forgemaster
In order for the Eternal Forgemaster to craft armor for players, the following quests must be completed as well:
*Defend the Temple of War
*Restore the Temple of War
*If he dies, your team will be kicked from the Fissure of Woe. He will not be threatened by new spawns after completion of Defend the Temple of War, however nearby mobs could be accidentally lured towards him.
*This NPC has a miniature version.
79c72334885f363dbaf24283be16f6840cd01b1b.text:
__NOTOC__
永生的鍛造大師 為所有職業打造威望盔甲。所有盔甲均附有空徽章槽。為了讓 永生的鍛造大師 出現在悲傷裂縫中，玩家必須完成以下任務：
*永生的鍛造大師
為了讓 永生的鍛造大師 為玩家製作盔甲，還必須完成以下任務：
*保衛戰爭神殿
*修復戰爭神殿
*如果他死了，你的隊伍將會被踢出痛苦裂縫。完成保衛戰爭神殿後，他不會受到新生成的威脅，但附近的怪物可能會被意外引誘到他身邊。
*這個NPC有一個縮小版。

4ea0dea9aaa90bd42fec11b4af07829ea9b2535f.source:
* Defeat your Doppelganger at Augury Rock.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 10 minutes (2 minutes in Hard Mode).
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
4ea0dea9aaa90bd42fec11b4af07829ea9b2535f.text:
* 在 占卜之石 擊敗你的分身。
* *獎勵* 在 10 分鐘內完成任務（困難模式為 2 分鐘）。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

65a8357c372bc0fea5f679da999d2ebaac9e4f87.source:
* Take Tahlkora and close the torment rifts in the Sebelkeh Basilica.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 6 minutes (12 minutes in Hard Mode).
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
65a8357c372bc0fea5f679da999d2ebaac9e4f87.text:
* 佔領Tahlkora並關閉Sebelkeh Basilica的折磨裂縫。
* *獎勵* 在 6 分鐘內完成任務（困難模式為 12 分鐘）。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

1f72975573e6870e0232e636707aceb198ff1ff7.source:
* Free the rebel leaders imprisoned in the Ice Caves of Sorrow.
* *BONUS* Relay news of Deldrimor's spy to the dwarves.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
1f72975573e6870e0232e636707aceb198ff1ff7.text:
* 釋放被囚禁在 悲傷冰谷 中的反抗軍領導人。
* *獎勵* 將 戴爾狄摩 間諜的訊息傳遞給矮人。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

11ae68019523c2570d2aa36eac5308c1aafb354a.source:
* Protect Emperor Kisu from Shiro'ken.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes (26 minutes in Hard Mode).
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
11ae68019523c2570d2aa36eac5308c1aafb354a.text:
* 保護 基肅皇帝 免受 白影軍團 的影響。
* *獎勵* 在 20 分鐘內完成任務（困難模式為 26 分鐘）。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

0f749ea76b5cf1f3408e78eb339756d234792759.source:
* Tame Queen Aijundu to travel across The Desolation.
* *BONUS* Save three young Junundu.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
0f749ea76b5cf1f3408e78eb339756d234792759.text:
* 馴服艾君杜女王穿越 荒蕪之地。
* *獎勵* 拯救三位年輕的朱南杜。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

9733c1977cb0975fe3818e079bc257bf9a2c2f62.source:
*Annihilate the six opposing enemy teams.
* *BONUS* Cleanse the area before King Khimaar's spirit leaves.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
9733c1977cb0975fe3818e079bc257bf9a2c2f62.text:
*消滅六支敵方隊伍。
* *獎勵* 在希瑪爾國王的靈魂離開之前淨化該區域。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

45adfe3a819b2e747119333396319001a59dac25.source:
* Take Tahlkora and stop the general from making a deal with the Corsairs in Blacktide Den.
* *BONUS* Kill five Rinkhal Monitors.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
45adfe3a819b2e747119333396319001a59dac25.text:
* 佔領塔爾科拉並阻止將軍與黑潮巢穴的海盜們做交易。
* *獎勵* 殺死五名 Rinkhal Monitor。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

686493b89acbd84b28ba1389a6d3c3a3b3feff15.source:
* Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
686493b89acbd84b28ba1389a6d3c3a3b3feff15.text:
* 在 夏爾 家園中搜尋 黑檀。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

d7f37db8ae1c31cd2d607f9985627c106b5f8e77.source:
* Open the Door of Komalie on the Ring of Fire Islands.
* *BONUS* Guide the spirit of Leah Stone to her rest.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
d7f37db8ae1c31cd2d607f9985627c106b5f8e77.text:
* 開啟 火環群島地域 上的 Komalie 之門。
* *獎勵* 引導利亞·斯通的靈魂安息。
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

0d968592ba98644b771fe552cfaee2f3a5046c84.source:
* Take Melonni and defend the village of Ronjok. 
* *BONUS* Defeat two additional Harbingers of Nightfall. 
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode. 
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
0d968592ba98644b771fe552cfaee2f3a5046c84.text:
* 拿下梅隆妮並保衛羅鳩村的村莊。 
* *獎勵* 擊敗另外兩位 黑暗逆襲 先驅者。 
* *獎勵* 在困難模式下完成任務。 
* 獎勵請見Zehchu【再神挑戰】。

44cf6594bf7ee16e51e04dfa58ef872698624d57.source:
*Deliver the Eye of Janthir to Loamhurst.
* *BONUS* Find and deliver five Chosen to Loamhurst.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in Hard Mode.
* See Zehnchu [Zaishen Challenge] for your reward.
44cf6594bf7ee16e51e04dfa58ef872698624d57.text:
*將詹瑟爾之眼交給 沃土森林。

From Senji's Corner, walk out the southern exit into Nahpui Quarter (explorable area). Follow the path as indicated on the map. (Directly under the Q in "Nahpui Quarter" on the map, be careful for an over-aggro of Jade Brotherhood, especially if using heroes and henchmen.) When fighting Royen, you may want to move up on the hill above him to remove his damage bonus due to his elevation, but, his skills are all pet based so the elevation bonus only applies to his auto-attacks.

Vengeful Aatxe are impervious to virtually all forms of damage and cannot be targeted by skills or attacks, but are killed automatically upon the death of their Keeper of Souls. As such, for practical purposes, the quest calls for the killing of a Keeper of Souls.

See Unwanted Guests for a walkthrough of the quest.

It is possible, but tedious and difficult, to kill one through a combination of life stealing. See Invulnerability for more information.
* This quest was first offered on 11th May 2009
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
5cd54e9e812310f4a25ba99b60cbd4b2f19f15c7.text:

請參閱不受歡迎的客人以瞭解任務的演練。

透過結合奪命來殺死一個人是可能的，但乏味且困難。有關更多資訊，請參閱無敵性。
* 此任務首次於 11 五月 2009 提供

ee6695e1352f53edb253afddf42f80ad6ef1aefd.source:
Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.

=== Skill recommendations ===

; Countering Searing Flames
There are several techniques to effectively counter Searing Flames:
* Bring skills that interrupt or inflict Dazed.
* Use Frigid Armor to prevent being set on fire. 
* Signet of Humility will prevent Searing Flames from being cast; Diversion will disable it for an extended period.
* The boss will quickly kill itself while hexed with either Pain Inverter or Spoil Victor.

; Other skills

* Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm will reduce the elemental damage.
* Winter converts all elemental damage to cold damage, which deals more damage to Ruby Djinns.
* Extinguish and Breath of the Great Dwarf remove Burning from all party members.
* Frozen Soil will prevent the Roaring Ethers from using Resurrection Signet.
* The ethers are the only fleshy foes in Korshek's group, so it does not help much to bring skills that cause Bleeding, Disease, or Poison; similarly, skills that exploit corpses are ineffective for this battle.
* Consider going to open the Do Not Touch Treasure in Forum Highlands after killing Korshek the Immolated, which is near the boss' location.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
ee6695e1352f53edb253afddf42f80ad6ef1aefd.text:
Korshek 的團隊包括幾個 Roaring Ethers 和至少一個其他 巨靈怪。還有多達三個衛星組，每個衛星組由更多的 巨靈怪 和 Roaring Ethers 組成。在困難模式下，紅寶石巨靈 可以使用 液態火焰 進行非常猛烈的攻擊（超過 200 傷害），而 Korshek 則使用 爆裂火焰，它可以對 60 裝甲等級角色造成超過 250 的傷害。這意味著，即使沒有死刑，整個隊伍也可以在兩到三擊中被消滅，因為這些都是 範圍性 攻擊。考慮從提哈克果園外的 梅蘭朵 守望者那裡獲得遮蔽樹枝的祝福，以減少 Korshek 和 紅寶石巨靈 造成的傷害。

=== 技能 建議 ===

;對抗 爆裂火焰
有多種技術可以有效對抗 爆裂火焰：
* 帶來打斷或造成 暈眩 的技能。
* 使用 冰凍護甲 防止起火。 
* 謙卑紋章 將阻止 爆裂火焰 被施放； 牽制 將長時間停用它。
* 當使用 苦痛 變頻器或 勝者的掠奪 施咒時，Boss 會快速自殺。

;其他技能

* 元素結界或守護結界將減少元素傷害。
* 寒冬 將所有元素傷害轉化為寒冷傷害，這對紅寶石魔靈造成更多傷害。
* 熄滅 和 偉大矮人 的呼吸消除了所有隊伍成員的燃燒。
* 凍土 將阻止咆哮以太使用 復活紋章。
* 以太是Korshek團隊中唯一的肉質敵人，因此帶來導致流血、疾病或中毒的技能並沒有多大幫助；同樣的，利用屍體的技能對於這場戰鬥也是無效的。
* 殺死靠近boss位置的宰殺者 科薛克後，考慮開啟高地廣場中的請勿觸控寶藏。

The recommended way to reach Jedeh is to start from the Mouth of Torment. Take the western exit to the Ruptured Heart and make your way to the portal to Crystal Overlook. There will be a few mobs of Graven Monoliths, Margonites and Giants to defeat or avoid. Once you reach the Overlook, the most direct route to Jedeh is indicated by the blue line on the map. However, this will take you through several groups of Djinn, who can be tough to fight especially in Hard Mode. An alternative that is more time-consuming but less lethal is to turn left after entering the map, and board a Junundu. Go through the sulfurous area in the middle of the map and approach Jedeh from the east rather than the northeast. All the mobs you meet along the way should be small and easily disposed of.

56e21d60e2ac064f55acef6219f4e1488060a106.source:
The route from Cavalon doesn't require you to fight Ssyn Coiled Grasp. Exit into the Archipelagos and head east, dispatching the first mob of fish that you encounter, then continue until you reach the edge of the map and head south. Now head for the boss, killing the patroling Naga and the two stationary Naga mobs in front of the boss. Engage and kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna to complete the bounty. 

If taking the route from Jade Flats (Luxon), your party will only encounter Naga Warriors, Naga Archers, Naga Ritualists, Ssyn Coiled Grasp, and a few Kappa. Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party does not contain any allies that require attacks and attack skills to deal damage, since your party will only encounter a total of two Kappas who use Blurred Vision and Shatterstone (whose end effect triggers even if the hex is removed). Consider not bringing blocking skills, since they can be bypassed by Naga Warriors and Archers. Naga Warriors and Archers can also interrupt with Distracting Blow and Concussion Shot, so consider skills that can prevent interrupts, inflict blind or cause misses. Consider Signet of Binding for Destruction spirits created by Naga Ritualists and Ssyn Coiled Grasp.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.

如果從玉石灘（勒克森）出發，你的隊伍只會遇到納迦戰士、納迦弓箭手、納迦儀式者、Ssyn捲握和一些河童。如果你的隊伍不包含任何需要攻擊和攻擊技能來造成傷害的盟友，則不需要妖術去除技能，因為你的隊伍只會遇到總共兩個使用模糊視線和碎裂冰石的卡帕（即使妖術被去除，其最終效果也會觸發）。考慮不要帶阻擋技能，因為它們可以被 納迦 戰士和弓箭手繞過。 納迦 戰士和弓箭手也可以用 虛晃打擊 和 迷惑之箭 打斷，因此請考慮可以防止打斷、造成失明或導致失誤的技能。請考慮使用 束縛紋章 來搭配由 納迦 Ritualists 和 Ssyn Coiled Grasp 打造的 毀滅 烈酒。

If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Marrow Scarabs, Minotaurs, Rockshot Devourers, and Scarab Nest Builders on your way to Kepkhet Marrowfeast. Hex removal skills are unnecessary, as the aforementioned foes do not cast hexes.

Avoid using condition-inflicting skills on Marrow Scarabs, as they will use Plague Touch and then Virulence. Marrow Scarabs use Well of the Profane, so either interrupt its activation, avoid bringing enchantments with long recharge times, and/or move away from corpses before they are exploited to create a Well of the Profane.

Rockshot Devourers and Scarab Nest Builders use Distracting Shot, so skills that block, inflict the blind condition, cause misses, or prevent interruption can be helpful. They also use numerous traps, so it may be a good idea to have one party member walk ahead of the party to trigger the traps and prevent the entire party from taking damage.

Sometimes Kepkhet Marrowfeast is hidden at first and won't popup until a party member approaches her spawn point. The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet Marrowfeast won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range, so you can cause Kepkhet Marrowfeast to deplete her energy by healing and protecting the Scarab Nest Builder prior to your party engaging Kepkhet Marrowfeast. When you go near Kepkhet Marrowfeast, several Marrow Scarabs will popup. If Kepkhet Marrowfeast casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity and remove Mark of Protection.
* Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Family Soul quest, since it also requires you to kill her.

Head north through the Tahnnakai Temple explorable area from Zin Ku Corridor. Be prepared for area of effect fire damage from the Temple Guardians around him. If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Temple Guardians on your way to Quansong Spiritspeak. 

===Skill recommendations===
* You will not encounter any physical attackers, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here; however, Temple Guardians have Stun on Critical Hit.
* Quansong Spiritspeak and Temple Guardians are not fleshy creatures, so skills that exploit corpses and inflict bleeding, disease, or poison are ineffective against them.
* You will only encounter spellcaster mobs, so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the Temple Guardians (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, and Winnowing).
* Temple Guardians have less armor rating against cold damage, so consider bringing Winter or skills that deal cold damage. Consider bringing Water Magic hex spells that snare and deal cold damage (i.e. Deep Freeze, Ice Spikes, Mind Freeze, and Shard Storm), which will slow their movement speed and can help in preventing them from reaching your midline/backline and dealing point blank area of effect damage from Temple Guardians' Double Dragon and Quansong Spiritspeak's Ancestors' Rage.
* Temple Guardians have less armor rating against blunt damage, so consider using a weapon that deals blunt damage.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.

=== 技能 推薦===
* 你不會遇到任何物理攻擊者，因此格擋、失手、致盲的技能在這裡效果較差；然而，聖殿守護者在暴擊時會暈眩。
* 通靈者 魁嵩 神殿守護者不是肉質生物，因此利用屍體並造成流血、疾病或中毒的技能對他們無效。
*你只會遇到施法者小怪，所以考慮帶上反施法者技能和/或各種 遊俠 可以使你的隊伍受益但不能使神殿守護者受益的自然儀式（例如 順風 , 怒火 , 和 吹拂之風 ）。
* 神殿守護者對寒冷傷害的護甲等級較低，所以考慮帶上 寒冬 或造成寒冷傷害的技能。考慮帶 水系魔法 誘捕並造成寒冷傷害的十六進製法術（即 強力凍結 , 冰之尖刺 , 心靈凍結 , 和 冰風暴 ），這會減慢他們的移動速度，並有助於防止他們到達你的中線/後線並造成聖殿守護者的空白區域效果傷害 雙龍 和 通靈者 魁嵩 的 先人的盛怒 。
* 聖殿守衛針對鈍器傷害的護甲等級較低，因此請考慮使用造成鈍器傷害的武器。

4156d0cac4f6220a22a4a87c675980f5e880d0f7.source:
Once a player gets in radar range of the spawn point location, either Harn or Maxine will spawn and begin patrolling around the island. The boss will go counter-clockwise on its patrol path, so it is best to go clockwise through its patrol path as the boss will move toward you when it spawns and you avoid needing to chase the boss through numerous mobs. If you go clockwise through its patrol path, there are mobs of Flesh Golems and Mahgo Hydras that patrol in a circle outside of Ember Light Camp. Your party can stay near the Resurrection Shrine and pull each mob.

===Skill recommendations===
*If you go clockwise through its patrol path:
**You will only encounter spellcaster mobs (Dark Flame Dryders, Drakes, Flesh Golems, Mahgo Hydras, and Phantoms), so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the enemy spellcasters (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, Toxicity since Dark Flame Dryders use Chilblains, and Winnowing).
**The only physical attackers will be the Bone Minions created by the Flesh Golems via Animate Bone Minions, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here.
*This quest was first offered on April 25, 2009.
*If you go clockwise through the boss' patrol path, you can take this opportunity to obtain a Volcanic Rock.
*It's possible for Harn or Maxine to spawn at the beach on the north part of their path
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
4156d0cac4f6220a22a4a87c675980f5e880d0f7.text:
一旦玩家進入重生點位置的雷達範圍，哈恩或瑪克辛就會重生並開始在島嶼周圍巡邏。 Boss 會在其巡邏路徑上逆時針行走，因此最好順時針行走其巡邏路徑，因為 Boss 在生成時會向您移動，並且您無需在眾多小怪中追逐 Boss。如果你順時針穿過它的巡邏路徑，就會有血肉傀儡和瑪戈九頭蛇的小怪在外面一圈巡邏。 殘火營地 。您的聚會可以住在附近 復活祭壇 並拉動每個小怪。

=== 技能 推薦===
*如果你順時針穿過它的巡邏路徑：
**你只會遇到施法者小怪（暗焰乾燥者、龍、肉傀儡、瑪戈九頭蛇和幻影），所以考慮帶上反施法者技能和/或各種 遊俠 可以使你的隊伍受益但不能使敵方施法者受益的自然儀式（例如 順風 , 怒火 , 毒性 自從暗焰乾燥機使用以來 凍傷 , 和 吹拂之風 ）。
**唯一的物理攻擊者將是由血肉傀儡通過 操縱骸骨爪牙 ，因此格擋、造成失誤或造成失明狀態的技能在這裡效果較差。
*此任務於四月首次提供 25 , 2009 。
*如果你順時針穿過boss的巡邏路徑，你可以藉此機會獲得 火山岩 。
*哈恩或瑪克辛有可能在其路徑北部的海灘上生成

428e0f3f388e33ee577aaeb9f027b5a227bb8908.source:
*Nicholas sometimes fails to appear in his expected location:
**Active quests can alter spawns in the area. To fix this, complete or abandon the local quests before returning. Alternatively, visit the area with a different character without the relevant quests.
**Some areas have variable spawns (e.g. Pockmark Flats); rezoning a few times will address this.
**He has sometimes failed to spawn due to the War in Kryta (e.g. in Kessex Peak (War in Kryta)); if not previously fixed by ArenaNet, you can work around this by using a character who has not started WiK or dropping any relevant bounties for characters that have finished WiK.
**Winds of Change might have a similar effect. For example, for the week of Putrid Cysts, you must not have Winds of Change active. To temporarily undo Winds of Change, take Memories of Purity from the Herald of Purity in Kaineng Center (requires completion of Cleansing Morostav Trail).
*Nicholas does not exchange items for gifts in two situations:
**If you enter an area before Nick's scheduled move time, but do not reach him until afterward, Nick will not speak to you at all.
**He attends The Wedding as a guest of Gwen, but not as a collector.
*Nicholas has occasionally been found facing a random object, obstructive landscape, or a wall.
*Nicksets are commonly traded in Kamadan or near the outpost where Nicholas is currently located. A nickset represents the exact quantity of an item required to obtain all 5 weekly Gifts of the Traveler. For example, if Nicholas requires 3 of an item per gift, a nickset consists of 15 of that item (3 × 5).
**Trading nicksets is generally beneficial for the buyer, as 5 Gifts of the Traveler are typically worth more than the nickset itself. The seller benefits from the convenience of not having to locate Nicholas in an explorable area. Note that prices are subject to fluctuation and may reach a point where Gifts of the Traveler are worth less than a nickset, making the trade unfavorable for the buyer.
Sometimes his greeting and/or reward text is not translated into one or more non-English languages. Please report any issues at the localization bug feedback pages so that they can be quickly resolved.

428e0f3f388e33ee577aaeb9f027b5a227bb8908.text:
*尼可拉斯有時無法出現在他預期的位置：
**主動任務可以改變該區域的生成點。若要解決此問題，請在返回之前完成或放棄本機任務。或者，訪問具有不同角色的區域而不執行相關任務。
**某些區域有可變的生成點（例如 麻點平原）；重新分割槽幾次就能解決這個問題。
**他有時會因為 科瑞塔戰爭 而無法生成（例如在 凱席斯山峰 (科瑞塔戰爭) 中）；如果 A社 之前沒有修復，您可以通過使用尚未開始 WiK 的角色或為已完成 WiK 的角色放棄任何相關賞金來解決此問題。
**變幻之風 可能有類似的效果。例如，在腐爛囊腫發生的那一週，您不得啟動 變幻之風。若要暫時撤銷 變幻之風，請從 凱寧中心 中的純潔先驅處取得純潔記憶（需要完成 摩洛神秘通道 淨化）。
*尼古拉斯在兩種情況下不會用物品交換禮物：
**如果您在尼克預定的搬家時間之前進入某個區域，但直到之後才聯絡到他，尼克根本不會和您說話。
**他以 關 的嘉賓身分參加婚禮，但不是作為收藏家。
*尼古拉斯偶爾會被發現面對隨機物體、阻礙性景觀或牆壁。
*尼克套通常在卡馬丹或尼古拉斯目前所在的前哨站附近交易。暱稱代表獲得旅行者的所有 5 每週禮物所需的物品的確切數量。例如，如果 Nicholas 要求每件禮物的某個專案為 3，則暱稱集由該專案的 15 (3 × 5) 組成。
**交易暱稱通常對買家有利，因為 5 旅行者的禮物通常比暱稱本身更有價值。賣方受益於不必將尼古拉斯定位在可探索區域的便利性。請注意，價格可能會波動，並且可能會達到旅行者禮物的價值低於尼克集的程度，從而使交易對買家不利。
有時，他的問候和/或獎勵文本不會翻譯成一種或多種非英語語言。請在本地化錯誤回饋頁面回報任何問題，以便快速解決。

078147ccb7e26c1c439f07c33707436f45854ec5.source: To get to the Fissure of Woe, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). Players must then either use a Passage Scroll to the Fissure of Woe (in Embark Beach or any of the following locations below), or pay 1000 gold to the Champion of Balthazar at a Statue of Balthazar in any of the following locations:
078147ccb7e26c1c439f07c33707436f45854ec5.text: 要到達悲痛裂縫，隊伍中的所有玩家都必須是飛升者或 Weh no Su（埃洛尼亞角色可能會完成任務「獵殺！」）。然後，玩家必須使用通道 卷軸 前往悲痛裂縫（在 征途海灘 或以下任何以下位置），或在以下任何位置的 雕像 或 巴薩澤 處向 勇士(公會戰頭銜) 或 巴薩澤 支付 1000 金幣：

67460328c4cf5edc0b1df861083e59f0bb31e37e.source: Your party has completed # of 11 quests.
67460328c4cf5edc0b1df861083e59f0bb31e37e.text: 你的隊伍已完成 # 個 11 任務。

ba58d164d21f0a8ab653a33e18ba552578bdd7f9.source: Balthazar has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the forge in the Temple of War to claim your reward.
ba58d164d21f0a8ab653a33e18ba552578bdd7f9.text: 巴薩澤 承認您所做的偉大事蹟。 影返 前往戰爭神殿的熔爐領取獎勵。

94c630fded4ed4d34d8ecfa5b32cc9d3712e8aa9.source: Only party members who are Ascended, Weh no Su or characters created in Guild Wars Nightfall who have completed Hunted! may enter the Fissure of Woe: Heroes may enter, but Henchmen may not.
94c630fded4ed4d34d8ecfa5b32cc9d3712e8aa9.text: 只有已完成狩獵的飛升、Weh no Su 或 公會 戰爭 黑暗逆襲 中建立的角色的隊伍成員！可能會進入悲痛裂縫：英雄可能會進入，但 傭兵 可能不會。

a1ea7b641ab8ef1d56dc925736dd3271a633c9e9.source: This area is one of the few locations where certain items drop:
a1ea7b641ab8ef1d56dc925736dd3271a633c9e9.text: 該區域是少數會掉落某些物品的位置之一：

c816107b0e3a097414d51d994409cc60f2a0e4ea.source: Shadow weapons (The only other locations are in Nightfall: the Nightfallen Garden and the Domain of Anguish.)
c816107b0e3a097414d51d994409cc60f2a0e4ea.text: 闇影 武器（黑暗逆襲 中唯一的其他地點：墮夜花園和 悲難之門。）

ed8671c687484784e8cabdd763defec6e00d61df.source: Obsidian Shards. (Although there is one Obsidian Furnace Drake in Nightfall that also drops them.)
ed8671c687484784e8cabdd763defec6e00d61df.text: 黑曜石碎片。 （儘管 黑暗逆襲 中有一個黑曜石熔爐 龍獸 也會掉落它們。）

8ba5913f8d6d87743cc883bef2e72d290f8babd6.source: Globs of Ectoplasm can, very rarely, drop from the Banshees that spawn after taking The Wailing Lord.
8ba5913f8d6d87743cc883bef2e72d290f8babd6.text: 在極少數情況下，捕獲哀嚎領主後生成的女妖會掉落靈質球。

c216336dd50fd697421ddee828ece62b77ff9a71.source: The Fissure of Woe is where players can craft Obsidian Armor.
c216336dd50fd697421ddee828ece62b77ff9a71.text: 災難裂痕 是玩家可以製作黑曜石 防禦 的地方。

3cc4ebc56f957999fdfb1a3169adc0d660013830.source: You can repeat the area's quests each time you enter the Fissure of Woe. After completing all eleven,
3cc4ebc56f957999fdfb1a3169adc0d660013830.text: 每次進入悲傷裂縫時，您都可以重複該區域的任務。全部十一點完成後，

60a16818ad7bd2cbfd3c8466a0b87cd806029faf.source: You will see the message, "Balthazar has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the forge in the Temple of War to claim your reward".
60a16818ad7bd2cbfd3c8466a0b87cd806029faf.text: 您將看到以下訊息：「巴薩澤 已認可您所做的偉大事蹟。影返 前往戰爭神殿的熔爐領取獎勵」。

9d975884703944da0d590448b926984613ee03b7.source: A Chest of Woe will spawn near the Eternal Forgemaster.
9d975884703944da0d590448b926984613ee03b7.text: 寶箱 的禍將在 永生的鍛造大師 附近產生。

0ff4f2bae31fb4cf9774606db945c1114fa398bb.source: After the first time, you can add the Eternal Conqueror of The Fissure of Woe statue to your "Honor" monument.
0ff4f2bae31fb4cf9774606db945c1114fa398bb.text: 第一次之後，您可以將 災難裂痕 的永恆征服者雕像新增到您的「榮譽」紀念碑中。

9edcc91a1607437e15061e724edb3862d0d2602e.text: 戰鬥深淵 或中央傳送室

71e173be5830aefd88c1510797540e682b0bc406.source: Gate of Fear or Gate of Pain
71e173be5830aefd88c1510797540e682b0bc406.text: 恐懼之門或 懲罰之門

e30c50c125f37ecc49da0d54cfaf43eaad8d1e2a.text: 凱寧中心 或 地下城

e7005636339cc8ed85a6694f302765deb187f267.source: Plains of Jarin or Sun Docks
e7005636339cc8ed85a6694f302765deb187f267.text: 賈林平原 或 Sun Dock

35f7ce640568b4c9aab2fb326b27f86010ce24cb.text:
尤拉夫之地 或
分別為 維拉戛陣地

56a87c59da230c9ff7022735f83dfc9b88247a7a.source: Talking to her again before completing the Bonus
56a87c59da230c9ff7022735f83dfc9b88247a7a.text: 在完成 額外獎勵 之前再次與她交談

4d7f10396208a515135a4322804c84c5bd877b74.source: Talking to her after completing the Bonus
4d7f10396208a515135a4322804c84c5bd877b74.text: 完成 額外獎勵 後與她交談

cf8f56aa0b716b9512c3d1ff61eec6fd0b1ceab7.source: The Eternal Forgemaster will buy items in your inventory when he returns to the forge, after you keep it safe from attack.
cf8f56aa0b716b9512c3d1ff61eec6fd0b1ceab7.text: 在您確保其免受攻擊後，永生的鍛造大師 返回熔爐時會購買您庫存中的物品。

55d3b41e6f5eb497cb934f6ad4bef008e10ff1a6.source: The Fissure of Woe area does not count towards any Cartographer title.
55d3b41e6f5eb497cb934f6ad4bef008e10ff1a6.text: 災難裂痕 區域不計入任何 版圖 標題。

7b8d1ccd661a6c0f9079a3dc879fbdf3c042aee7.source: You can get kicked out of the area in three situations:
7b8d1ccd661a6c0f9079a3dc879fbdf3c042aee7.text: 在三種情況下，您可能會被踢出該區域：

915fa3b9631dcf999839e948dd9b1898cf7930c4.source: If all members of your party die; there are no resurrection shrines, so a wipe results in mission failure.
915fa3b9631dcf999839e948dd9b1898cf7930c4.text: 如果你的隊伍的所有成員都死了；沒有復活神殿，所以擦除會導致任務失敗。

4ec016428614359757f4e5ba897a6dde66fe9f61.source: In Hard mode, if everyone in the party has a Death Penalty of 60%.
4ec016428614359757f4e5ba897a6dde66fe9f61.text: 在 困難模式 中，如果隊伍中的每個人都有 60% 的死刑。

4e330ac71c3e65e905eb4b8e935d24b40fec558d.source: If you allow any of your allies to die. (Be sure to clear any nearby patrols to prevent this.)
4e330ac71c3e65e905eb4b8e935d24b40fec558d.text: 如果你允許你的任何盟友死亡。 （請務必清除附近的巡邏隊以防止這種情況發生。）

deb8eb7e1c9cb986fe82a1377f7a404b28488a1d.source: The sole exception to this is Eternal Lord Taeres. However, should he die before you take his quest, Tower of Strength, you will be unable to spawn the Chest of Woe.
deb8eb7e1c9cb986fe82a1377f7a404b28488a1d.text: 唯一的例外是永恆領主泰雷斯。然而，如果他在你接受他的任務 力量 之塔之前就死了，你將無法產生 Woe 的 寶箱。

676237eb2eee9c4494de47c4156d8afac1f68eff.source: The following Zaishen Quests take place here:
676237eb2eee9c4494de47c4156d8afac1f68eff.text: 下面的再申 任務 發生在這裡：

7f34be8b842add2ad937502cb76bdbcecd47c81e.source: Be sure to obtain the quest for the Miniature Ceratadon from Merrise, Sworn to Seas, at embark beach if attempting to do this dungeon in Hard Mode for the first time since the 2025 anniversary update.
7f34be8b842add2ad937502cb76bdbcecd47c81e.text: 如果自 2025 週年更新以來第一次嘗試在困難模式下完成這個地下城，請務必在登船海灘上從宣誓海洋的梅里斯那裡獲得微型角龍的任務。

31e84c22e9eb8c1d64fbc437c0aea5c81df4bcfe.source: The lava in the Fissure of Woe is harmless. On rare occasions, a Shadow Ranger will spawn inside the Tower of Courage, preventing quest completion unless your party can kill it without having a line of sight.
31e84c22e9eb8c1d64fbc437c0aea5c81df4bcfe.text: 禍禍裂縫中的熔岩是無害的。在極少數情況下，闇影 遊俠 會在勇氣之塔內生成，從而阻止任務完成，除非你的隊伍可以在視線之外殺死它。

a541ba91a5d167fb52fd161be72a9aee226f598e.text: 前往黑曜石 防具商人

ef3f7ca4381fd8305e6bf05bf0377e1aa686ebb8.source: 0: spawn point. Beware of patrolling mobs near this spot as it is easy to over aggro the nearby mobs. Do NOT take the quest from Rastigan yet.
ef3f7ca4381fd8305e6bf05bf0377e1aa686ebb8.text: 0：生成點。小心這個地點附近巡邏的小怪，因為很容易過度激怒附近的怪物。暫時不要接受拉斯蒂根的任務。

bae1d22abdebad34501fedbe26642c0d59c1fde7.source: 1: clear mobs north and mainly south of your spawn point without aggroing any Abyssal or Shadow Ranger or Rastigan will run forward and probably die which will kill the party.
bae1d22abdebad34501fedbe26642c0d59c1fde7.text: 1：清除產卵點以北和主要以南的小怪，而不會激怒任何深淵或闇影 遊俠或拉斯蒂根將向前奔跑並可能死亡，從而殺死隊伍。

be5a8091a6dc56059713fad351a0fd8aa092085a.source: 2: clear the remaining groups around the Tower of Courage. Rastigan will join the fight but you should be able to protect him now. Rastigan will open the tower gate and mobs will spawn in it. Take the quest Tower of Courage that should now be completed (quest 1) and take the follow-up quest for later.
be5a8091a6dc56059713fad351a0fd8aa092085a.text: 2：清除勇氣之塔周圍的剩餘群體。拉斯蒂根將加入戰鬥，但你現在應該能夠保護他。拉斯蒂根將開啟塔門，小怪將在其中生成。接受現在應該完成的任務「勇氣之塔」（任務1）並稍後接受後續任務。

45abcb67b734349c23cc274b77def6651e1b4ce7.source: 3*: (optional) head north to the Great Battle Field and clear it from patrolling mobs from east to west. Beware of regular pop up enemies. You may want to trigger some mobs pop on Priest of Menzies location while he hasn't spawned yet.
45abcb67b734349c23cc274b77def6651e1b4ce7.text: 3*：（可選）向北前往大戰場並清除從東到西巡邏的小怪。小心經常出現的敵人。您可能想要在 曼席斯的祭司 位置尚未產生時觸發一些小怪。

6528d275de6517056c2510004e1448ee63d0d73a.source: 4: West of the Great Battle Field, clear the shadow mob camp. Clearing it spawns NPCs. Take the quests Army of Darkness from Kromril the Eternal (for later) and The Eternal Forgemaster from Eternal Weaponsmith.
6528d275de6517056c2510004e1448ee63d0d73a.text: 4：偉大戰場以西，清除暗影生物營地。清除它會產生 NPC。接受永恆克羅姆瑞爾的黑暗軍團任務（稍後）和 永生的武器工匠 的 永生的鍛造大師。

9344530074e9f44750efa0c358d84a25a05cf1b4.source: 5: move towards Temple of War. Clear the mob in front of the gate and beware of the incoming mobs behind you (fight them or rush in the temple ignoring them). Enter the temple and carefully clear groups on the first floor all around, then clear the last foes on the top of the temple to complete the quest (quest 2). The Eternal Forgemaster will appear.
9344530074e9f44750efa0c358d84a25a05cf1b4.text: 5：前往戰爭神殿。清除門前的小怪，並提防身後的小怪（與他們戰鬥或衝進寺廟而忽略他們）。進入神殿並小心地清除一樓周圍的群體，然後清除神殿頂部的最後敵人以完成任務（任務2）。將出現 永生的鍛造大師。

7a5e3ee930d6761d0391cd0db70b9dad4450244b.source: 6: take the quest Defend the Temple of War. Enemies come to the upper platform in pairs so no need to rush. They may take their time to move. The Eternal Forgemaster must survive. Once done (quest 3), other allied NPC's will in the temple. The south gate of temple is now open, you can defeat the group on this side and take care of incoming group right after just as for the north entrance.
7a5e3ee930d6761d0391cd0db70b9dad4450244b.text: 6：接受任務「保衛戰爭神殿」。敵人成對來到上層平臺，所以無需著急。他們可能需要一些時間才能搬家。 永生的鍛造大師 必須生存。一旦完成（任務 3），其他盟軍 NPC 將在神殿中。現在寺廟的南門已經開啟，可以打敗這邊的隊伍，然後像北門一樣處理後面進來的隊伍。

1e006e2274192abc8c0a1586f99f61a42b428862.source: 7*: (optional) you may want to head south toward the Spider Cave to clear it in advance to make next step a bit easier. Move carefully as many spiders will often pop up. Make your way up to the waterfall bordering the Fissure Shore. Beware at this spot as many groups will spawn.
1e006e2274192abc8c0a1586f99f61a42b428862.text: 7*：（選購）您可能需要向南前往 蜘蛛 洞穴，提前清除它，以使下一步更容易。小心移動，因為經常會出現許多蜘蛛。前往與裂縫海岸接壤的瀑布。小心這個地方，因為許多群體會產卵。

3e7dc491202a28e515acd8e808589a52106556ae.source: 8: in the Temple, take both quests from Forgemaster and the one from Eternal Lord Taeres. You will focus on quest Restore the Temple of War first.
3e7dc491202a28e515acd8e808589a52106556ae.text: 8：在神殿中，接受鍛造大師的兩個任務和永恆領主泰雷斯的任務。您將首先專注於恢復戰爭神廟任務。

c20bd4f5134ce12a66370e81c116f883abf1a205.source: 9: take quest The Hunt from Nimros the Hunter: Shard Wolves will spawn at different location in the area, you will kill them while doing the other quests. A first spawn in right behind you.
c20bd4f5134ce12a66370e81c116f883abf1a205.text: 9：接受獵人尼姆羅斯的狩獵任務：碎片狼會在該區域的不同位置產卵，你將在執行其他任務時殺死它們。第一個重生點就在你身後。

54e8015f6d580f3fcb2b4a6d10367970dcda242e.source: 10: clear the Spider Cave from Seeds of Corruption that spawn with the Forgemaster's quest (quest 4). Sneak to the Shore to kill the second Shard Wolf there.
54e8015f6d580f3fcb2b4a6d10367970dcda242e.text: 10：清除 蜘蛛 洞穴中隨鍛造大師任務（任務 4）產生的腐化種子。潛入海岸殺死那裡的第二個碎片 狼。

3fbd3cbecc6a927ed59eb0fa4231a0624bfb7072.source: At this point: return to the Forgemaster to complete the quest. He will offer Obsidian armor crafting.
3fbd3cbecc6a927ed59eb0fa4231a0624bfb7072.text: 此時：返回鍛造大師處完成任務。他將提供黑曜石盔甲的製作。

916a8092a47896efa35e9f02a3b63962526771ad.source: 11: head north toward the Tower of Strengh for the associated quest. Cautiously clear the zone up to the tower, you'll find multiple patrols overlaping and spawns. Be sure to kill the 5 Shadow Patrols. A third Shard Wolf will be there as well. Go back toward Temple of War to trigger the Tower Mage route, that will wait for you before the tower.
916a8092a47896efa35e9f02a3b63962526771ad.text: 11：向北前往力量之塔進行相關任務。小心地清理直到塔樓的區域，你會發現多個巡邏隊重疊並產生。一定要殺死 5 闇影 巡邏隊。第三個 Shard 狼 也將在那裡。返回戰神殿觸發塔樓法師傭兵路線，該路線將在塔樓前等你。

3f2b7373c95e256d9fff13d8ae7aeaaf5788bd50.source: 12: in the meantime, move south-east to the Lake of Fire for the Khobay the Betrayer quest. You can pull Khobay's group (or hopefully boss only) away from the last wurm if needed. Killing him will complete the quest (quest 5).
3f2b7373c95e256d9fff13d8ae7aeaaf5788bd50.text: 12：同時，向東南方移動到火湖，進行背叛者霍貝任務。如果需要的話，你可以將科貝伊的隊伍（或希望只是老闆）從最後一隻亞龍身邊拉開。殺死他將完成任務（任務5）。

f53b782a8d4f37849a594d7c34a79acf42ac2016.source: 13: go back to Tower of Strength. After the NPC opens the tower, kill the last mob that will spawn inside to complete the quest (quest 6).
f53b782a8d4f37849a594d7c34a79acf42ac2016.text: 13：返回力量之塔。 NPC 開啟塔後，殺死裡面產生的最後一個生物來完成任務（任務 6）。

4b0cbbec201f283f267edabf0f8dd55d3a2b906b.source: 14: move north to find Miko the Unchained and clear patrol that are wandering here.
4b0cbbec201f283f267edabf0f8dd55d3a2b906b.text: 14：向北移動，尋找無束縛的米科並清除在這裡徘徊的巡邏隊。

c9c472dc674fca8ce2054df7a626fc610578b30b.source: 15*: (optional) without Miko's quest, cautiously clear the Burning Forest, at least the main path to the end of the zone. There are multiple patrols overlapping, and any seemingly isolated mob is actually grouped with mixed foes. A fourth Shard Wolf is found here.
c9c472dc674fca8ce2054df7a626fc610578b30b.text: 15*：（可選）在沒有 Miko 任務的情況下，小心地清理燃燒森林，至少是通往區域盡頭的主要路徑。有多個巡邏隊重疊，任何看似孤立的暴民實際上都與混合的敵人組合在一起。此處找到第四個碎片 狼。

b230e482f43fc23000e9e1e25683f895324df081.source: 16: get back to Miko and take his quest, then kill the 4 groups that appeared at the back of the Forest (quest 7). If you did not clear the zone, you may sneak to the right but do not forgot the fourth Shard Wolf.
b230e482f43fc23000e9e1e25683f895324df081.text: 16：回到Miko並接受他的任務，然後殺死出現在森林後面的4團體（任務7）。如果您沒有清除該區域，您可以潛入右側，但不要忘記第四個碎片 狼。

4ead213b95e562dad91315fe8e850c200e1f19a6.source: 17: head west, back to the Great Battle Field. Go north to complete the quest you took at point 3 by killing the Priest of Menzies. You may pull its surrounding groups away first then engage the lonely boss, or possibly pull the boss directly from below the cliff. He will drop a quest item you need to give back to the NPC (quest 8). On your way, you'll find a fifth Shard Wolf to kill.
4ead213b95e562dad91315fe8e850c200e1f19a6.text: 17：向西走，回到偉大的戰場。往北走，殺死 曼席斯的祭司，完成您在 3 點接受的任務。你可以先把周圍的隊伍拉開，然後再與孤獨的boss交戰，或者可以直接從懸崖下面拉boss。他會掉落一個你需要回饋給 NPC 的任務物品（任務 8）。在路上，您會發現第五個碎片 狼 需要殺死。

716b9392c367a9ce3e5d4eff6c6a15a9e4833ddc.source: 18: move west toward the Forest of the Wailing Lord for The Wailing Lord quest you received at point 2. Note that the zone will include an seemingly hostile foe, the Wailing Lord, but he must NOT be harmed. Clear the zone, without crossing the bridge leading to the Wailing Lord. A sixth Shard Wolf can be killed here, in north part, that could be pulled from main path. Be sure to clean the main path and south part, north is not needed.
716b9392c367a9ce3e5d4eff6c6a15a9e4833ddc.text: 18：向西向 悲鳴領主區 移動，以完成您在 2 點收到的哀嚎領主任務。請注意，該區域將包括一個看似敵對的敵人，即哀嚎領主，但他一定不能受到傷害。清理該區域，但不要穿過通往哀嚎領主的橋梁。第六個碎片 狼 可以在這裡殺死，在北部，可以從主路拉出來。一定要清理主幹道和南邊部分，北邊不需要。

ab3b8cc9e166f9d900b68d5017364122b404aba8.source: 19: Carefully pull Banshees across the bridge, without harming the Wailing Lord. You can enter in Wailing Lord aggro zone, he will not attack you, but beware to have heroes flagged further. Try to pull out skeletons across the bridge as well. After you kill them all, the Wailing Lord will turn friendly and Shadow Beasts will spawns. You can validate the quest (quest 9) and take A Gift of Griffons. For this one you'll need to escort Griffons to Tower of Courage.
ab3b8cc9e166f9d900b68d5017364122b404aba8.text: 19：小心地將女妖拉過橋，不要傷害哀嚎領主。你可以進入哀嚎領主仇恨區，他不會攻擊你，但要小心英雄被進一步標記。也嘗試把橋上的骷髏拉出來。當你把它們全部殺死後，哀嚎領主將變得友好，並且 闇影 野獸將會生成。您可以驗證任務（任務 9）並獲得獅鷲的禮物。對於這項任務，您需要護送獅鷲前往勇氣之塔。

a733f8a31eca988fe89671a194a5551bc3d1a4e3.source: 20*: (optional) as Griffons may be killed easily, you may want to make your way to Tower of Courage without them and quietly fight the hostile groups that appeared with this quest. This is safer but take a little bit more time. Griffons should stand still until you approach them but sometimes they rush to you right away. In this case, you may need to flag your heroes forward and let them deal with the fights, while you keep Griffons safe.
a733f8a31eca988fe89671a194a5551bc3d1a4e3.text: 20*：（可選）由於獅鷲可能很容易被殺死，你可能想在沒有獅鷲的情況下前往勇氣之塔，並悄悄地與此任務中出現的敵對團體作戰。這更安全，但需要更多時間。獅鷲應該站著不動，直到你接近它們，但有時它們會立即衝向你。在這種情況下，你可能需要標記你的英雄前進並讓他們處理戰鬥，同時確保獅鷲的安全。

57fff79d5453992ef94df523f555a9f374b197e3.source: 21: approach the Griffons so they start following you. Lead them to Rastigan to complete the quest (quest 10).
57fff79d5453992ef94df523f555a9f374b197e3.text: 21：接近獅鷲，讓他們開始追蹤你。帶領他們前往拉斯蒂根完成任務（任務 10）。

011f9153030eea958bee5f842eb4bac88f942f0b.source: 22: the seventh and last Shard Wolf will be found just south of the tower. Kill him to complete the last quest (quest 11).
011f9153030eea958bee5f842eb4bac88f942f0b.text: 22：第七個也是最後一個碎片 狼 將位於塔的南邊。殺死他以完成最後一個任務（任務11）。

f1fb7311aafd22f8ff5ce9211a39ac2b40b45a8f.source: At this point, even without getting quests rewards yet, The Fissure of Woe is completed! Make your way back to Temple of War to open the Chest of Woe. You can pick up quests rewards and resign to leave.
f1fb7311aafd22f8ff5ce9211a39ac2b40b45a8f.text: 至此，即使還沒有獲得任務獎勵，災難裂痕也已經完成了！返回戰爭神殿，開啟哀傷的 寶箱。您可以領取任務獎勵並辭職離開。

6d47e61bc8cdd922b32d1faa77acb652100110d6.source: Relive the events of the Canthan plague.

7c836ed135896e6a8b4b3730c3f30c2b16677b38.source: Once you have completed Cleansing Morostav Trail, you can take this quest to restore default spawns in Cantha, except in an area affected by any other Winds of Change quest.
7c836ed135896e6a8b4b3730c3f30c2b16677b38.text: 完成清理 摩洛神秘通道 後，您可以執行此任務以還原 Cantha 中的預設產生點，但受任何其他 變幻之風 任務影響的區域除外。

77756dcdd63f7c83bc6501457a91e695267d325e.source: This allows you to continue the Winds of Change storyline without abandoning Memories of Purity.
77756dcdd63f7c83bc6501457a91e695267d325e.text: 這使您可以繼續 變幻之風 故事情節，而無需放棄純粹的記憶。

264a14f31f5e3a4710874e845df874f2c783c63e.source: In areas with an active Winds of Change quest, you are likely to see the original spawns, in addition to those foes that spawn due to the quest.
264a14f31f5e3a4710874e845df874f2c783c63e.text: 在具有活躍 變幻之風 任務的區域中，除了因任務而產生的敵人之外，您還可能會看到原始的產生。

181eba1679c455f4657b989e04d7c3f0578cd78b.source: The quest doesn't stop Winds of Change related dialogues between NPCs from happening.
181eba1679c455f4657b989e04d7c3f0578cd78b.text: 此任務不會阻止 NPC 之間發生與 變幻之風 相關的對話。

62eb8d6b0415d074b1f701d24a90edca831a3b16.source: To return to the Winds of Change spawns, abandon the quest from your log.
62eb8d6b0415d074b1f701d24a90edca831a3b16.text: 若要返回 變幻之風 產生點，請放棄日誌中的任務。

1b313b94b1eb847399fbd048cdee7a94cf1674ca.source: [Flashback Quest]: While this quest is in your Quest Log, the lands of Cantha will revisit the time of the Afflicted.
1b313b94b1eb847399fbd048cdee7a94cf1674ca.text: [閃回 任務]：當此任務位於您的 任務 日誌中時，凱珊的土地將重溫受難者的時代。

315a7601e085d194e21f0c581f397c2322dabed7.source: "Greetings, citizen! Have you heard the news? Thanks to the tireless efforts of Cantha's people, led by the Ministry of Purity, the plague that has cursed our great nation has finally been driven out."
315a7601e085d194e21f0c581f397c2322dabed7.text: 「你好，公民！你聽到這個訊息了嗎？在純潔部領導下的凱珊人民的不懈努力下，詛咒我們偉大國家的瘟疫終於被趕走了。”

2e957514dd03ea2c8fbacb09ee8b948e6a43b6e4.source: "Allow me to share with you the story of these struggles, that we may honor the sacrifices of those who have fallen in this noble task."
2e957514dd03ea2c8fbacb09ee8b948e6a43b6e4.text: “請允許我與你們分享這些鬥爭的故事，以便我們紀念那些在這項崇高任務中犧牲的人們。”

e78d0d454d97bcc822370dbcf48cab14b97c5174.source: To get to the Underworld, all players of the party must be Ascended or Weh no Su (Elonian characters may instead complete the quest Hunted!). The party must be in one of the locations below and have a player either use a Passage Scroll to the Underworld or pay 1000 gold to the Voice of Grenth at a Statue of Grenth.
e78d0d454d97bcc822370dbcf48cab14b97c5174.text: 要到達地獄，隊伍中的所有玩家都必須是飛升者或 Weh no Su（Elonian 角色可能會完成任務「獵殺」！）。隊伍必須位於以下地點之一，並且讓玩家使用通往地獄的通道 卷軸 或在 古蘭斯 的 雕像 處向 古蘭斯 的聲音支付 1000 金幣。

db452cfddbdb159795a5f6a8bbc53b04054af1dc.text: 征途海灘（無雕像，僅捲軸）

23f9ed9f7ddf8885460149809c75742606361baf.source: Southeast corner of Lornar's Pass (Statue only, no scroll)
23f9ed9f7ddf8885460149809c75742606361baf.text: 洛拿斯通道 東南角（僅限 雕像，無滾動）

7b2d88e5f1e131791f3b96b428875313b617751e.source: Your party has completed [0...10] of 10 quests.
7b2d88e5f1e131791f3b96b428875313b617751e.text: 你的隊伍已完成 [0...10] 個 10 任務。

bd3ffb5f037524dd10fbb3af758c52b43150e4e3.source: Grenth has acknowledged the great deeds you have performed. Return to the Hall of Judgement to claim your reward.
bd3ffb5f037524dd10fbb3af758c52b43150e4e3.text: 古蘭斯 承認您所做的偉大事蹟。 影返 前往審判大廳領取獎勵。

5364054351c4a92a3a8d29e702ff48b10d9559e1.source: If your party wipes, you will be kicked out of the area. This will also happen if certain allies die.
5364054351c4a92a3a8d29e702ff48b10d9559e1.text: 如果你的隊伍被消滅，你將被踢出該區域。如果某些盟友死亡，也會發生這種情況。

8fd9f6e2d0093fa96662fecf88288ac878dce8e8.source: Heroes can enter, but henchmen are not allowed.
8fd9f6e2d0093fa96662fecf88288ac878dce8e8.text: 英雄可以進，但追隨者不能進。

cfa3191e3db1f8ee0f696091b0b3371a0effacfd.source: Successfully completing all of the quests in a single session once will unlock the quest The Nightman Cometh from King Frozenwind. After taking this quest players can go inside the Hall of Judgement. When every player is inside the Hall of Judgement, Dhuum, who resides there, will become aggressive and players can defeat him. Defeating Dhuum will unlock a statue in the Hall of Monuments and allow each party member to open the Underworld Chest once.
cfa3191e3db1f8ee0f696091b0b3371a0effacfd.text: 在一次會話中成功完成所有任務將解鎖冰風國王的夜行者任務。完成此任務後玩家可以進入審判大廳。當所有玩家都進入審判大廳時，居住在那裡的多姆會變得具有攻擊性，玩家可以擊敗他。擊敗 多姆 將解鎖 史蹟殿堂 中的雕像，並允許每個隊伍成員開啟地下世界 寶箱 一次。

cdde258fb8effbbd48480c86b581970c5a014cc2.source: The Underworld is home to the Black Widow, which can only be found there and only after completing certain quests.
cdde258fb8effbbd48480c86b581970c5a014cc2.text: 地下世界 是 黑寡婦 的所在地，只有在完成某些任務後才能在那裡找到它。

f032c10ede906fe9e5d2bbe131fd07a45d7c019e.source: This area is popular for farming Globs of Ectoplasm.
f032c10ede906fe9e5d2bbe131fd07a45d7c019e.text: 該地區以種植靈質球而聞名。

5a16b2d8afb965cf1b830b29b7dafb39d4c1fff7.source: Approximately 50 Skeletons of Dhuum, which can be farmed throughout the year for Every Bit Helps if you stockpiled Everlasting Mobstoppers, spawn in the Underworld without quests. From quests, there are additional spawns:
5a16b2d8afb965cf1b830b29b7dafb39d4c1fff7.text: 大約 50 多姆 的骷髏，可以全年養殖，如果您儲存了永恆的暴徒，則可以在沒有任務的情況下在地獄中生成。從任務中，還有額外的生成點：

ee74a390515b862a84ed47656e576615e91c47f1.text: 不速之客會產生九個骷髏。

f3b19b888337d8000a279d3e396318b4ed10c4e9.text: 恐怖網女王會生成六隻骷髏。

1baeae3b6bc010f6f956aaec553735c612cc10f7.source: Servants of Grenth spawns nine Skeletons.Best guess per walkthrough of quest which is ambiguous
1baeae3b6bc010f6f956aaec553735c612cc10f7.text: 古蘭斯 的僕人產生九個骷髏。每個任務演練的最佳猜測是不明確的

9b22a4292620fe3e886d6d955f0ceb2f2547a25c.text: 被囚禁的靈魂會產生三個骷髏。

ff284488f4047ac8a983204f584b98e019641fb1.source: The Four Horsemen spawns four Skeletons. Off of memory, being either one or two skeletons per horseman
ff284488f4047ac8a983204f584b98e019641fb1.text: 多姆四騎士 產生四個骷髏。不記得了，每個騎兵不是一具，就是兩具骷髏

530c5026b04d5f74c6e985cba919d62eb18e814e.source: If Gwen is a member of your party, you will see a conversation between her and her mother, Sarah. Yet another dialogue will be triggered if both Gwen and Keiran Thackeray are present.
530c5026b04d5f74c6e985cba919d62eb18e814e.text: 如果 關 是您隊伍的成員，您將看到她和她的母親莎拉之間的對話。如果 關 和 Keiran Thackeray 都在場，則會觸發另一個對話。

7820ab0e1aa98caba17869b3e8199d090628ed45.source: Dhuum will not become active until all players are present and can enter the hall together: be sure to bring skills or items to resurrect any dead party members and ensure that none of the others walk away from the computer too soon.
7820ab0e1aa98caba17869b3e8199d090628ed45.text: 直到所有玩家都在場並可以一起進入大廳後，多姆 才會啟動：請務必攜帶技能或物品來復活任何死去的隊伍成員，並確保其他人不會過早離開電腦。

701da15a17090a2c80c6af933d3bb37c9dfc5468.source: When planning to complete this area in hard mode, it can be a good idea to first obtain the quest Miniature Companion: The Underworld from Merrise, Sworn to Seas in Embark Beach. This quest rewards 2025 experience, 2006 gold and the Miniature Mad King's Guard.
701da15a17090a2c80c6af933d3bb37c9dfc5468.text: 當計劃在困難模式下完成此區域時，最好先從 征途海灘 中向海洋宣誓的 Merrise 處獲得任務微型伴侶：地下世界。此任務獎勵 2025 經驗、2006 金幣和微型瘋王守衛。

edcc92e47ffd62753f8fea951e73ec250262d599.source: Allies created by summoning stones are not teleported with the party when talking to a Reaper. This can cause wipes on certain quests. One example is getting the Reaper of the Labyrinth killed during The Unwanted Guests. If your party begins the fight with Dhuum before King Frozenwind walks past the gate, he will be stuck outside. About a minute after your party defeats Dhuum, King Frozenwind and the Ice Elementals will spawn inside the Hall of Judgment. Sometimes King Frozenwind will not appear once Dhuum dies and the chest will not appear as a result.
edcc92e47ffd62753f8fea951e73ec250262d599.text: 與收割者交談時，透過召喚石創造的盟友不會與隊伍一起傳送。這可能會導致某些任務被擦除。一個例子是在“不受歡迎的客人”中殺死迷宮收割者。如果你的隊伍在冰風國王走過大門之前開始使用 多姆 進行戰鬥，他將被困在外面。在你的隊伍擊敗 多姆 後大約一分鐘，冰風王和冰元素將在 審判殿堂 內生成。有時，一旦 多姆 死亡，冰風之王就不會出現，因此寶箱也不會出現。

e8fbfe6cb08cb9bd527a554bf3eb741c673fa8ed.source: Important note: This quest is a legendary death trap for players new to the Underworld. It is important to advise these players not to take the quest before entering to avoid any problems caused by the groups of Grasping Darknesses spawned by this quest. Clearing the area of all Bladed Aatxes before taking this quest is beneficial. However, aggroing a number of Aatxes and Grasping Darknesses at the same time may serve as a stress test for the party, and show whether it is up to the challenges of The Underworld.
e8fbfe6cb08cb9bd527a554bf3eb741c673fa8ed.text: 重要提示：對於剛接觸地獄的玩家來說，這個任務是一個傳奇的死亡陷阱。重要的是建議這些玩家在進入之前不要接受任務，以避免由該任務產生的黑暗吞噬群體造成任何問題。在接受此任務之前清除所有劍刃 Aatxes 區域是有益的。然而，同時攻擊多個 Aatx 和掌握黑暗可以作為對隊伍的壓力測試，並顯示其是否能夠應對 地下世界 的挑戰。

9723696d4404d8bae6c1bc4a2bfb4b78dc92a770.source: When a player accepts this quest three groups of Grasping Darknesses spawn nearby. Two of the groups spawn on the upper level of the beginning area and begin patrolling there. The third group spawns further away and will patrol from that point to the upper level of the beginning area and back. If the players stay on the lower area they will remain out of aggro range. The groups consist of three or four Darknesses each and aren't difficult to defeat for a prepared party.
9723696d4404d8bae6c1bc4a2bfb4b78dc92a770.text: 當玩家接受此任務時，附近會生成三組黑暗之握。其中兩個小組在起始區域的上層產卵並開始在那裡巡邏。第三組在更遠的地方生成，並將從該點巡邏到起始區域的上層並返回。如果玩家留在較低區域，他們將保持在仇恨範圍之外。每個團體由三到四個黑暗者組成，對於有準備的隊伍來說並不難擊敗。

7851243c46921dd406ef18bac5decda953771ebd.source: Note: Before taking this quest you should clear the entire Labyrinth and free the Reapers of Forgotten Vale and Ice Wastes so that you can use the teleport function to attack the Keeper of Souls from behind. The quest Escort of Souls should not be taken at the same time.
7851243c46921dd406ef18bac5decda953771ebd.text: 注意：在接受這個任務之前，你應該清理整個迷宮並釋放被遺忘者谷和冰荒地的收割者，這樣你就可以使用傳送功能從背後攻擊靈魂守護者。靈魂護送任務不應同時進行。

01b81f8cacac7acfbc644e680386d2794711d8a6.source: Once you accept the quest, six clusters of foes spawn throughout the Labyrinth. Each cluster consists of one Keeper of Souls, two groups of three Terrorweb Dryders, three groupless Skeletons of Dhuum and two groups of three Vengeful Aatxes. The Vengeful Aatxes are invulnerable, but they do less damage than Bladed Aatxes. In each cluster, the Aatxes and Dryders die immediately when the Keeper of Souls of the same cluster is killed. To complete the quest you need to kill all six Keepers of Souls.
01b81f8cacac7acfbc644e680386d2794711d8a6.text: 一旦你接受任務，迷宮中就會出現六群敵人。每個叢集由一名靈魂守護者、兩組三隻恐網烘乾機、三組無組的 多姆 骷髏和兩組三隻復仇 Aatx 組成。復仇 Aatx 刀槍不入，但它們造成的傷害比刃劍 Aatx 低。在每個叢集中，當同一群集的靈魂守護者被殺死時，Aatxes 和 Dryder 會立即死亡。要完成任務，你需要殺死所有六名靈魂守護者。

8e170940c076189c44762ed4180788c6de4eb134.source: In some cases when you approach a cluster from behind you can kill all Terrorweb Dryders without aggroing the Aatxes or the Keeper. After killing them you will sometimes have a clear path to the Keeper of Souls and sometimes you will be required to aggro the Vengeful Aatxes on the way. The Keeper of Souls is easy to kill, but if you have to aggro the Aatxes you might have a tough time depending on your party. If possible someone should tank the Aatxes while the rest of the party kills the Keeper or the Dryders. You can also utilize traps which will knock down and cripple the otherwise invulnerable Aatxes.
8e170940c076189c44762ed4180788c6de4eb134.text: 在某些情況下，當你從後面接近叢集時，你可以殺死所有恐網乾燥者，而不會激怒 Aatxes 或守護者。殺死他們後，有時你會找到一條通往靈魂守護者的清晰道路，有時你會被要求在路上攻擊復仇的 Aatxes。靈魂守護者很容易被殺死，但如果你必須攻擊 Aatxes，你可能會遇到困難，這取決於你的隊伍。如果可能的話，應該有人坦克 Aatxes，而隊伍的其他人則殺死 Keeper 或 Dryders。你也可以利用陷阱來擊倒並削弱原本刀槍不入的 Aatxes。

ef85f6ebb5dc100115749802a17a19f9859a542e.source: After clearing all of the groups you can return to the Reaper of the Labyrinth to get your reward.
ef85f6ebb5dc100115749802a17a19f9859a542e.text: 清除所有小組後，您可以返回迷宮收割者處獲取獎勵。

d4c5d182ea0b971479ebb656ea2ce6b9fc1586d6.source: Completing this quest will require you to travel the whole Underworld, killing groups of three Terrorweb Dryders at the six other monuments of Grenth. Upon accepting the quest one group of Terrorwebs will spawn next to each of the monuments. When your party kills one of the groups the corresponding Reaper is spawned next to the monument.
d4c5d182ea0b971479ebb656ea2ce6b9fc1586d6.text: 完成這個任務需要你遊遍整個地獄，在 古蘭斯 的其他六個紀念碑處殺死三名恐怖網乾燥者。接受任務後，每個紀念碑旁邊都會生成一組恐怖網。當你的隊伍殺死其中一組時，相應的收割者就會在紀念碑旁邊生成。

78af305403e423c24a0534af9dc9856a9bd16889.source: Pay extra caution at the monuments of Forgotten Vale, Twin Serpent Mountains and Spawning Pools. Kill the surrounding monsters before the Terrorweb Dryders, because otherwise they might attack the Reaper and cause your party to be taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld.
78af305403e423c24a0534af9dc9856a9bd16889.text: 在 被遺忘者 谷、雙蛇山和產卵池的紀念碑處要格外小心。在恐怖網烘乾機之前殺死周圍的怪物，否則它們可能會攻擊收割者並導致你的隊伍被帶回你進入地獄的前哨站。

b93d33b6828b4215b64ec45448a4dfc82c10fd25.source: As the quest suggests, once a Reaper is freed, you will be able to speak to him and he can teleport you to any other Reaper that you have freed. The Reapers also have quests to offer, but be aware that taking any quests without consulting the party is unwise as they tend to spawn dangerous groups and might cause a party wipe if the party isn't prepared.
b93d33b6828b4215b64ec45448a4dfc82c10fd25.text: 如任務所示，一旦收割者被釋放，你就可以與他交談，他可以將你傳送到你釋放的任何其他收割者處。收割者也有任務要提供，但要注意，在沒有諮詢隊伍的情況下接受任何任務是不明智的，因為它們往往會產生危險的群體，如果隊伍沒有做好準備，可能會導致隊伍被消滅。

a6f0917d8af0af658986b12322ac5cfc873155fb.source: Note: Although it is very tempting to take the quest immediately after completing the preceding quest or soon after clearing one or two nearby areas due to the offered teleportation possibility, it might be wise to clear the furthermost problematic monuments before accepting the quest to avoid having to fight against the Terrorwebs and the other enemies surrounding the monuments at the same time.
a6f0917d8af0af658986b12322ac5cfc873155fb.text: 注意：儘管由於提供了傳送的可能性，在完成前面的任務後或在清理一兩個附近區域後不久就很容易接受任務，但在接受任務之前清理最遠的有問題的紀念碑可能是明智的，以避免同時與恐怖網和紀念碑周圍的其他敵人作戰。

196a75cb69f8c208ade2c12251405b5f23e35786.source: It is highly advisable to have only one player take the quest while the rest of the party waits near the Bone Pit, where a group of four Tortured Spirits will spawn one by one as soon as the quest is taken. If any of these spirits are killed, you will be forced to go back to the outpost, so make sure that your team protects them. These spirits will attack foes, and actively run to enemies if they come within aggro range.
196a75cb69f8c208ade2c12251405b5f23e35786.text: 強烈建議只有一名玩家接受任務，而隊伍的其他成員則在骨坑附近等待，一旦接受任務，就會一一生成一組四個受折磨的靈魂。如果這些靈魂中的任何一個被殺死，你將被迫返回前哨站，所以請確保你的團隊保護他們。這些靈魂會攻擊敵人，如果敵人進入仇恨範圍，它們會主動跑向敵人。

3b88f2a98e3471995278f7a5fbbb6833ddbba414.source: After eliminating all three groups the doors out of the beginning area will open, revealing the paths to the rest of the Underworld. There are two paths which take you to the next target of the quest, the Terrorweb Dryders. The north-western path is shorter, but leads the party to a tight passage which leads to the destination chamber filled with enemy groups. When approaching from this direction it is hard to pull enemies one group at a time. The north-eastern route is a bit longer and has some small enemy groups in it, but pulling of the groups in the chamber is a lot easier from this side.
3b88f2a98e3471995278f7a5fbbb6833ddbba414.text: 消滅所有三組後，起始區域的門將會開啟，露出通往地獄其他地方的路徑。有兩條路徑可以帶你到達任務的下一個目標，恐怖網烘乾機。西北方向的路徑較短，但引導隊伍進入一條狹窄的通道，通往充滿敵人的目標房間。當從這個方向接近時，很難一次拉一組敵人。東北方向的路線有點長，裡面有一些小股敵人，但從這一邊拉動房間裡的隊伍要容易得多。

8c48aa8817cc1319183220684aca45177dadf43a.source: Be sure to kill all other enemy groups before attacking the Terrorwebs, because after you kill them a Reaper of the Labyrinth will spawn near the statue of Grenth in the chamber. If there are any enemies left at this point they might attack the Reaper and kill it, causing the party to be taken back to to the outpost from which they left to the Underworld. Speak to the Reaper to receive the quest reward. You might also want to save the quest reward for later on so that you can remove Death Penalty with it.
8c48aa8817cc1319183220684aca45177dadf43a.text: 請務必在攻擊恐怖網之前殺死所有其他敵方隊伍，因為在殺死他們後，迷宮收割者將在房間內的 古蘭斯 雕像附近生成。如果此時還剩下任何敵人，他們可能會攻擊收割者並殺死它，導致隊伍被帶回他們離開地獄的前哨站。與死神交談以獲得任務獎勵。您可能還想儲存任務獎勵以供日後使用，以便可以用它來消除死刑。

6aa01e9f67a0eab5fa54254bfab486367ffc9638.source: Important note: Advise all players to not take any further quests from the Reaper. Each of the quests offered spawn additional enemies, which might be hard to fight without extra preparations such as clearing certain areas of their regular enemy groups. Also, the quests Escort of Souls and Unwanted Guests are almost impossible to complete at the same time, because in Escort of Souls you need to protect a group of New Souls following your party and in the other you will face the nearly invincible Vengeful Aatxes.
6aa01e9f67a0eab5fa54254bfab486367ffc9638.text: 重要提示：建議所有玩家不要接受死神的任何進一步任務。提供的每個任務都會產生額外的敵人，如果沒有額外的準備（例如清除常規敵人群體的某些區域），這些敵人可能很難戰鬥。另外，「護送靈魂」和「不速之客」任務幾乎不可能同時完成，因為在「護送靈魂」中你需要保護一群跟隨你的隊伍的新靈魂，而在另一個任務中你將面對幾乎無敵的複仇阿特克斯。

95601d5ef3e8023aed775241df61fbecd22c43f8.source: The safest way to do this quest is to clear all the way to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale before taking any quests from the Reaper of the Labyrinth. There should be one or two pairs of Bladed Aatxes and four groups of Grasping Darknesses along the way. There is also a group of Coldfire Nights and Stalking Nights that patrols near the statue of Grenth in Forgotten Vale.
95601d5ef3e8023aed775241df61fbecd22c43f8.text: 完成此任務最安全的方法是先清除通往 被遺忘者 谷收割者的所有道路，然後再接受迷宮收割者的任何任務。沿途應該有一對或兩對利刃劍和四組黑暗之握。還有一群冷火之夜和追蹤之夜在 被遺忘者 谷的 古蘭斯 雕像附近巡邏。

7ba020c57b4814636864b4b9615c2846901dbbaf.source: Take the quest Restoring Grenth's Monuments from the Reaper of the Labyrinth which will spawn three Terrorweb Dryders at the monument of Forgotten Vale. Destroy the Terrorwebs and speak to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale which appears after this. Have him teleport you back to the Reaper of the Labyrinth and take the Escort of Souls. After accepting this quest a group of six New Souls will spawn and start to walk to the vale. At the same time, four groups of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn, one in the starting point of the Underworld,didnt have this happen just now, talk comment from 2015 asks the same, rng or hm only group? one in the wide hallway that connects the Labyrinth to the Vale, at the gate between that hall and the vale, and finally one group of 6 Mindblade Spectres will spawn between Mayor Alegheri and the bridge to the Labyrinth.
7ba020c57b4814636864b4b9615c2846901dbbaf.text: 接受從迷宮收割者那裡恢復 古蘭斯 紀念碑的任務，這將在 被遺忘者 谷的紀念碑處生成三個恐怖網烘乾機。摧毀恐怖網並與隨後出現的 被遺忘者 谷的收割者交談。讓他將你傳送回迷宮收割者並乘坐靈魂護衛隊。接受此任務後，將出現一組六個新靈魂並開始步行前往山谷。同時會產生四組6 Mindblade Specters，一組在地獄的起點，剛才沒有發生這種情況，2015的評論問同樣的，rng還是hm組？在連線迷宮和山谷的寬闊走廊上，在大廳和山谷之間的大門處，最後一組 6 Mindblade 幽靈將在阿萊格里市長和通往迷宮的橋梁之間產卵。

ede8841daa13d1bfb082adbe57c3d544bb125069.source: Do not teleport back to the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale, which leaves the New Souls to walk to the first group of Mindblade Spectres. Instead, have one group member start the quest while the rest of the group stands at first spawning point and kills the group before the New Souls arrive. Try to stay ahead of the group of New Souls or have a good watchful monk.
ede8841daa13d1bfb082adbe57c3d544bb125069.text: 不要傳送回 被遺忘者 谷的收割者，這會讓新靈魂走向第一組心刃幽靈。相反，讓一名小組成員開始任務，而小組的其餘成員則站在第一個生成點並在新靈魂到達之前殺死小組。盡量保持在新靈魂隊伍的前面，或有一個很好的警惕僧侶。

1c2a6257aeb75968a9e6793cf5ce008ad177024c.source: Note: New Souls will walk towards Vale and will die before you can finish backtracking.
1c2a6257aeb75968a9e6793cf5ce008ad177024c.text: 注意：新靈魂會走向山谷，並在你完成原路返回之前死亡。

d1adff4c00f1f6d47432c550eeeb71058658595b.source: Almost immediately upon taking the quest, three Skeletons of Dhuum will spawn, one at each spawn point. Shortly after, a group of Terrorweb Dryders (both standard and silver) will spawn to the south (near the bridge), followed by another smaller group spawning to the northeast (by the small hooked pathway). It is important to position your party more or less on the spawns, so that the dryders do not more forward and aggro the Spirits. A third group of three Terrorweb Dryders will spawn near the bridge, further south than the first, about a minute after the quest begins. If your group is fast enough with DPS, both other groups will be dead by the time they spawn. If the Tortured Spirits hadn't taken any aggro, they will have already begun moving towards the Reaper.
d1adff4c00f1f6d47432c550eeeb71058658595b.text: 幾乎在接受任務後，三個 多姆 骷髏就會生成，每個生成點各有一個。不久之後，一群恐網乾燥者（標準和銀色）將在南邊（靠近橋梁）產卵，隨後另一小群恐網乾燥者將在東北部（小鉤狀通道旁）產卵。將你的隊伍或多或少地定位在重生點上很重要，這樣乾燥者就不會更向前並激怒靈魂。任務開始後大約一分鐘，第三組三隻恐網烘乾機會在橋附近產卵，比第一組更南。如果你的隊伍的 DPS 夠快，那麼其他隊伍在生成時就會死亡。如果折磨之靈沒有受到任何仇恨，他們早就開始向死神移動了。

6ccc4d13838a3c364521128b2a21e3f556732505.source: Once you've killed the dryders and skeletons the spirits will walk to the Reaper and the quest will be completed.
6ccc4d13838a3c364521128b2a21e3f556732505.text: 一旦你殺死了乾燥者和骷髏，靈魂就會走向收割者，任務就會完成。

091fe772e6c4de1a2e06a6a3ec532996226e10fa.source: After accepting this quest, the four horsemen begin their approach toward the Reaper from the middle section of the Chaos Planes. The horsemen, accompanied by several Terrorweb Dryders, split into two groups approaching from separate sides. The groups will attempt to eliminate the Reaper, returning the party to the outpost from which they entered the Underworld.
091fe772e6c4de1a2e06a6a3ec532996226e10fa.text: 接受這個任務後，四名騎士開始從混沌位面中部接近死神。騎兵在數名恐網乾燥者的陪同下分成兩隊，從不同的方向逼近。這些團體將試圖消滅收割者，將隊伍送回他們進入地獄的前哨基地。

18cf8cfc1187fc4319858e25b265fe29483e30a0.source: This quest is arguably the most difficult in the underworld, requiring a good strategy to survive.
18cf8cfc1187fc4319858e25b265fe29483e30a0.text: 這個任務可以說是地下世界中最困難的任務，需要好的策略才能生存。

55b800f6a05fb7b58517d0a9adf0f45cb68a2cfc.source: Spread out around the Reaper and make your stand there. Keep your distance to each other and to the Reaper to mitigate the Dryders' AoE spells - flag your heroes if you brought any.
55b800f6a05fb7b58517d0a9adf0f45cb68a2cfc.text: 分散到收割者周圍並站在那裡。保持彼此之間以及與收割者的距離，以減輕乾燥者的 範圍性 法術 - 如果你帶了英雄，請標記你的英雄。

b45257b97b3310746e83bf388d22ad5a8101cff9.source: Your healers' priority should be to keep the Reaper alive. Everyone else must focus on dispatching or disabling the incoming foes. With a sufficiently strong party, you will outlast the waves, completing the quest.
b45257b97b3310746e83bf388d22ad5a8101cff9.text: 你的治療者的首要任務應該是讓收割者保持活力。其他人都必須集中精力消滅或消滅即將到來的敵人。有了足夠強大的隊伍，你就能戰勝海浪，完成任務。

3db3d9a0138e48d2552e5fb764db4ffc11681bf6.source: This works well in normal mode and can be done with a 7-hero-team. In hard mode, more elaborate strategies are needed.
3db3d9a0138e48d2552e5fb764db4ffc11681bf6.text: 這在正常模式下效果很好，並且可以透過 7-hero-team 來完成。在困難模式下，需要更精細的策略。

75fb19274a0a603364827a51520c3873f13b8b39.source: Use one or two party members to delay one side while everyone else kills the other.
75fb19274a0a603364827a51520c3873f13b8b39.text: 使用一到兩名隊員來拖延一方，而其他人則殺死另一方。

3306f9935c499df4301313840e95674d5afedf0d.source: This strategy needs a dedicated tank to draw aggro and block the foes on one side. A tank with permanent spell targeting prevention should be able to do it alone, otherwise help from a healer may be needed. The tank will last longer with knockdown prevention, Mantra of Flame and anything that boosts armor. The healer must be very careful not to draw aggro, keeping out of range, only approaching the tank when needed.
3306f9935c499df4301313840e95674d5afedf0d.text: 這種策略需要一個專門的坦克來吸引仇恨並阻擋一側的敵人。具有永久法術目標預防功能的坦克應該能夠單獨完成，否則可能需要治療師的幫助。透過防擊倒、火焰頌歌 和任何增強裝甲的措施，坦克的使用壽命會更長。治療師必須非常小心，不要吸引仇恨，保持在範圍之外，只在需要時才接近坦克。

dd7a83050d5ff3b7e8e1eef47d61b6d992c6a2b9.source: When the tank is ready, the other party members can accept the quest and intercept all spawns from the other side. Running as far as possible towards the spawns results in earlier kills, reducing the time your tank needs to hold out. On the other hand, staying closer to the reaper allows you to take measures should the tank fall.
dd7a83050d5ff3b7e8e1eef47d61b6d992c6a2b9.text: 當坦克準備好後，其他隊員就可以接受任務並攔截來自另一方的所有生成。盡可能地跑向重生點會導致更早的殺戮，從而減少你的坦克需要堅持的時間。另一方面，靠近收割者可以讓你在坦克掉落時採取措施。

b551a517290c083e15d26a6139b583e0329701ac.source: You should clear the closest patrolling groups of Coldfire Nights and Stalking Nights before taking the quest. When you take the quest, five groups of three hostile Tortured Spirits spawn nearby. Four of the groups spawn in the village in the midst of the allied Tortured Spirits and start attacking them. The last group will spawn on the nearby hill and can be ignored until the other groups have been handled.
b551a517290c083e15d26a6139b583e0329701ac.text: 在接受任務之前，你應該清除最近的冷火之夜和潛行之夜的巡邏隊。當你接受任務時，附近會出現五組，每組三個敵對的折磨靈魂。其中四支隊伍在村莊中的受折磨之靈聯盟中重生，並開始攻擊他們。最後一組將在附近的山上生成，可以忽略，直到處理完其他組。

7ffd53ed0757c666fe8cf9e85ee343c3436e98fd.source: Killing the hostile Tortured Spirits isn't as simple as killing a regular level 15 enemy. They use Illusionary Weaponry with a high level of Illusion Magic, inflicting 40 points of armor ignoring damage per hit. A full group of three spirits will therefore cause a very high amount of damage if they gang up on a single target.
7ffd53ed0757c666fe8cf9e85ee343c3436e98fd.text: 殺死敵對的折磨靈魂並不像殺死普通等級的 15 敵人那麼簡單。他們將 幻象武器 與高水準的 幻術魔法 結合使用，造成 40 點護甲，忽略每次攻擊造成的傷害。因此，如果三個靈魂聯合起來攻擊一個目標，就會造成非常高的傷害。

3131d9e27349ac620f9cbaf0ca4243be84352158.source: In addition to having to cope with the enemy, you need to protect the allied spirits. If all of them die your quest will fail. In addition, the hostile spirits will attack Mayor Alegheri and the Reaper after killing all other spirits. If the mayor or reaper die your party will be returned to the outpost from which you left to the Underworld. The allied spirits far away will most likely die before you can reach them, so make sure to protect atleast one of the nearest allied spirits. Even one survivor is enough. If possible a monk should concentrate on healing one of the spirits, but you can also use traps, AoE and interruption.
3131d9e27349ac620f9cbaf0ca4243be84352158.text: 除了要對付敵人之外，你還需要保護盟友的靈魂。如果他們全部死亡，你的任務就會失敗。此外，敵對靈魂在殺死所有其他靈魂後會攻擊阿萊格里市長和收割者。如果市長或收割者死亡，你的隊伍將被返回到你離開地獄的前哨站。遠處的友軍很可能會在你到達之前就死去，所以一定要保護至少一個最近的友軍。就算只有一個倖存者就夠了。如果可能的話，僧侶應該集中精力治療其中一個靈魂，但你也可以使用陷阱、範圍性 和中斷。

c5da61dae4fda538c703a2b93418336f5b552c49.source: After defeating the hostile spirits in the village you can take out the last group on the hill. Then talk to the Reaper to receive your reward.
c5da61dae4fda538c703a2b93418336f5b552c49.text: 擊敗村莊裡的敵對靈魂後，你可以消滅山上的最後一組。然後與收割者交談以獲得獎勵。

ffdc8c1cd61dcccb030a74ae55cfabf99ea5a58a.source: Completing the quest will spawn an unlocked chest and a Black Widow next to the monument of Grenth, allowing a party member to charm it. If charming the pet, remember to ask the others not to attack it when it turns hostile. The chest will drop a random purple or gold item to one random member of the party.
ffdc8c1cd61dcccb030a74ae55cfabf99ea5a58a.text: 完成任務將在 古蘭斯 紀念碑旁產生一個解鎖的箱子和一個 黑寡婦，允許黨員對其進行魅惑。如果對寵物進行迷惑，請記得要求其他人在它變得敵對時不要攻擊它。箱子會隨機向隊伍中的一名成員掉落一件紫色或金色物品。

c00688eee2bfc7044a2f3163235b6b7556d42467.source: Tip: There is a trick to avoid the possibility of failing the quest. The friendly spirits you need to protect will spawn to the area after you kill the Grasping Darknesses near Mayor Alegheri. If you leave the first Darkness group alive, some of the spirits will not spawn making it so you cannot fail the quest. Just remember to avoid aggroing the darknesses when fighting the Wrathful Spirits. After you have cleared the area of most of the Wrathful Spirits you can kill the Grasping Darknesses.
c00688eee2bfc7044a2f3163235b6b7556d42467.text: 提示：有一個技巧可以避免任務失敗的可能性。當你殺死阿萊格里市長附近的黑暗之手後，你需要保護的友好靈魂將會出現在該地區。如果你讓第一個黑暗小組活著，有些靈魂將不會產生，所以你不會失敗任務。只要記得在與憤怒之靈戰鬥時避免攻擊黑暗力量即可。當你清除了該區域的大部分憤怒之靈後，你就可以殺死黑暗之握了。

f920e3186074f0c745a4825bde02fde567820054.source: Once this quest is activated, groups of enemies will start spawning northeast. Each wave consists of separate groups of two yellow Terrorweb Dryders, one or two silver Terrorweb Dryders, and one Skeleton of Dhuum. One group will head towards King Frozenwind, while the other heads toward the Reaper of the Ice Wastes (see the map). A total of three waves will spawn within a short span of time. King Frozenwind has four level 28 Ice Elementals to assist him, but they will fall quickly to the fire spells of the dryders. You must protect both King Frozenwind and the Reaper. If either of them dies, your party is taken back to the outpost from which you entered the Underworld. You can either split your team into two groups which take one group of foes at a time or you can take all foes as a whole group if you aggro them at their spawn-point. Note that the following waves spawn quickly, so you will need to take them down quickly.
f920e3186074f0c745a4825bde02fde567820054.text: 一旦啟動此任務，成群的敵人將開始在東北方生成。每波由兩個單獨的黃色 Terrorweb Dryders、一兩個銀色 Terrorweb Dryders 和一個 骷髏 或 多姆 組成。一組將前往冰風國王，而另一組將前往冰荒收割者（參見地圖）。短時間內總共會產生三波。冰風國王有四個 28 等級的冰元素來協助他，但它們很快就會被烘乾機的火焰法術擊倒。你必須保護冰風國王和死神。如果他們中的任何一個人死亡，你的隊伍就會被帶回你進入地獄的前哨站。你可以將你的團隊分成兩組，一次帶走一組敵人，或者如果你在他們的重生點聚集他們，你也可以將所有敵人作為一個整體。請注意，後續波浪會快速產生，因此您需要快速將其擊落。

d6aa748686b0ae31757fdbd0036f7a61cc8ef062.source: King Frozenwind and his allies can take down a group of 4 Terrorweb Dryders, thanks to his Ward Against Harm. This can lighten the load on your team if you position yourselves to primarily defend the Reaper, who is practically defenseless.
d6aa748686b0ae31757fdbd0036f7a61cc8ef062.text: 透過 守護結界，冰風國王和他的盟友可以擊落一群 4 恐怖網乾燥機。如果你把自己定位為主要防守幾乎毫無防禦能力的收割者，這可以減輕你團隊的負擔。

965916df75e7e18dd8e48de0955ae61b853b1c7b.source: The Terrorweb Queen spawns in a small passageway accompanied by four Obsidian Guardians. Four Obsidian Guardians, three Skeletons of Dhuum, and four Terrorweb Dryders also spawn on each side of her room, so make sure to take caution when attacking these enemies. The Obsidian Guardians' regular attacks can sometimes knock down foes and they will use wards to defend themselves and the Terrorweb Queen. It is possible to first kill the enemies on one side, then to teleport to a Reaper on the other side of by talking to the Reaper so that it would be easier to defeat the queen when all of her guardians are dead.
965916df75e7e18dd8e48de0955ae61b853b1c7b.text: 恐怖網女王在四名黑曜石守護者的陪伴下在一條小通道中生成。四個黑曜石守護者、三個 多姆 骷髏和四個恐怖網烘乾機也會在她房間的每一側生成，所以在攻擊這些敵人時一定要小心。黑曜石守護者的定期攻擊有時可以擊倒敵人，他們會使用守衛來保護自己和恐怖網女王。可以先殺死一側的敵人，然後透過與收割者交談來傳送到另一側的收割者，這樣當女王的所有守護者都死了時，就可以更容易地擊敗女王。

c2f6304771146d79ef43df3cd161b4ff33afae7b.source: It is also possible to simply pull the queen away from the guardians and to complete the quest from one side. She can attack from a long distance so the puller may need to back up further than usual to get her out of the defensive wards.
c2f6304771146d79ef43df3cd161b4ff33afae7b.text: 也可以簡單地將女王從守護者身邊拉開並從一側完成任務。她可以從很遠的距離攻擊，因此拉車者可能需要比平常更遠的距離才能讓她脫離防禦區。

0c46b90d047fe274bcb1da0d51052cd59136aba5.source: As soon as you take the quest the Slayer will spawn at the bottom of the hill and will move slowly towards the Reaper whom you need to defend. As there is enough room to maneuvre, make sure to do all fighting away from the Reaper. The Slayer itself should pose no threat, however after it will spawn four Keepers of Souls, four yellow Terrorweb Dryders and four silver Terrorweb Dryders. These groups will slowly advance to the Reaper simultaneously. It is possible to pull the Keepers of Souls forward to buy some time, but due to the close proximity of the groups this may instead cause all 12 dryders to follow.
0c46b90d047fe274bcb1da0d51052cd59136aba5.text: 一旦你接受任務，殺手就會在山腳下出現，並緩慢地向你需要防守的收割者移動。由於有足夠的機動空間，請確保所有戰鬥都遠離收割者。毀滅者本身不會構成威脅，但它會生成四個靈魂守護者、四個黃色恐網乾燥器和四個銀色恐網乾燥器。這些團體將同時緩慢地向死神前進。可以將靈魂守護者拉向前來爭取一些時間，但由於各組距離很近，這可能會導致所有 12 乾燥機跟隨。

5408deb49a28da602f42bad2cfc226d5b3dc8eeb.source: In order to survive it is essential to spread the party out and negate the danger from AoE damage. The key to victory lies in the clustering of the dryders, where they easy to keep in check with AoE damage and skills like Panic. Due to the sheer number of dryders perfect clusters are hard to force, so deal with the situation as it develops and focus on dryders that are near each other.
5408deb49a28da602f42bad2cfc226d5b3dc8eeb.text: 為了生存，必須分散隊伍並消除 範圍性 傷害帶來的危險。勝利的關鍵在於乾燥者的叢集，他們可以輕鬆控制 範圍性 的傷害和 恐慌 等技能。由於乾燥機數量眾多，很難強制形成完美的叢集，因此要隨著情況的發展而處理，並專注於彼此靠近的乾燥機。

fc89cdb71e369259274ea277637637adac981a0e.source: It is possible to accept the quest reward after the death of the Slayer, but make sure you take out the groups of Keepers of Souls and Terrorweb Dryders before leaving. Otherwise, they will destroy the Reaper, causing your removal from the Underworld.
fc89cdb71e369259274ea277637637adac981a0e.text: 殺手死後可以接受任務獎勵，但在離開前一定要幹掉靈魂守護者和恐怖網乾燥者的隊伍。否則，他們會摧毀收割者，導致你被逐出地獄。

d167b1381788fa5ae4bc308ea2caf35fd43fb13a.source: While facing Dhuum, if you die or your death penalty hits 60%, you will be moved next to Mayor Alegheri in the Forgotten Vale and turned into Spirit Form. Players must talk to the Mayor to return to the battle; heroes are returned automatically. Consumables that remove death penalty or grant a Morale Boost can prevent this.
d167b1381788fa5ae4bc308ea2caf35fd43fb13a.text: 當面對多姆時，如果你死了或你的死亡懲罰擊中了60%，你將被移到被遺忘者谷的市長阿萊蓋裡旁邊，並變成靈魂形態。玩家必須與市長對話才能重返戰鬥；英雄會自動返回。消除死刑或提高士氣的消耗品可以防止這種情況發生。

ea636a4c11e38f7927facef0d817c855a9ebb217.source: Death in Spirit Form is supposed to be permanent, since the Curse of Dhuum prevents the use of resurrection skills during this battle. But resurrection scrolls and "By Ural's Hammer!" still work, as does pre-casting delayed resurrection skills like Unyielding Aura before entering the room.
ea636a4c11e38f7927facef0d817c855a9ebb217.text: 靈魂形態的死亡應該是永久性的，因為 多姆的詛咒 阻止在這場戰鬥中使用復活技能。但是復活捲軸和「烏拉爾的 鎚！」仍然有效，就像在進入房間之前預先施延遲復活技能（例如 堅毅靈氣）一樣。

4eedc33e628efd02c52582f50f6ae3f08b52eaeb.source: There are two goals in this battle. One is to fill the Dhuum's Rest bar, which is achieved gradually with the skill Dhuum's Rest used by the Reapers and by players in Spirit Form. The other is to damage Dhuum directly, bringing him below 25% health. When both goals are met, the fight is over and you can collect the reward from King Frozenwind.
4eedc33e628efd02c52582f50f6ae3f08b52eaeb.text: 這場戰鬥有兩個目標。一是填滿多姆的休息欄，這是透過收割者和精神型態玩家所使用的技能多姆的休息逐漸實現的。另一種是直接傷害 多姆，使其生命值低於 25%。當兩個目標都達到時，戰鬥就結束了，你可以從冰風國王那裡領取獎勵。

ba036e6bb6a8f1e1e3f56272837f7a4feccae193.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Morostav Trail, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn. The Ritualist's Construct also disappears after completion of this quest, which makes Soul Twisting much more time-consuming to capture without Memories of Purity active.
ba036e6bb6a8f1e1e3f56272837f7a4feccae193.text: 完成此任務會改變 摩洛神秘通道 中出現的敵人，具體來說，受苦者將不再生成。 祭祀者 的構造體也會在完成此任務後消失，這使得在沒有啟動純粹記憶的情況下捕捉 生靈扭轉 會更耗時。

ce615c9c05ba868138aa775c47849d3d5187074a.source: Leave from Durheim Archives and head west-north-west. You will fight through a few groups before arriving at a circular clearing filled with afflicted. There are 8 groups, each with its own boss representing one of the factions professions. Work your way around the circle, either clockwise or counter clockwise. Try to only engage one group at a time.
ce615c9c05ba868138aa775c47849d3d5187074a.text: 從 杜漢姆卷藏室 出發，向西北偏西方向行駛。在到達充滿受折磨者的圓形空地之前，你將與幾組戰鬥。有 8 團體，每個團體都有自己的老闆，代表其中一個派系職業。順時針或逆時針繞圓圈工作。嘗試一次只參與一組。

69d75b345cc94bce49a4f64d72b0397c209a9e1b.source: With the exception of Initiate Zei Ri, all ministry allies do not resurrect if they are killed.
69d75b345cc94bce49a4f64d72b0397c209a9e1b.text: 除了入門者 Zei Ri 之外，所有神職盟友在被殺後都不會復活。

cf17240189d777ad752eb10da3c0be41c39b7ee6.text: 泰瑞安 (阿斯卡隆戰記) 角色

47f1511b3f668f9e08a83959bb3f5b123ca86880.text: 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 之前的角色

330a24e65f1f5fbf8520dca3822209dbbd95ede3.source: Meet up with your profession trainer outside the city gate. Complete their test.
330a24e65f1f5fbf8520dca3822209dbbd95ede3.text: 在城門外與您的職業培訓師會面。完成他們的測試。

a41b0f82b31d3ac92ce35bb58cf6d87d618ab84b.source: Meet up with Devona and complete her task.
a41b0f82b31d3ac92ce35bb58cf6d87d618ab84b.text: 與 德佛娜 會面並完成她的任務。

7c292714585b4663c69df63f459f6b407360eb65.source: Choose a secondary profession. Visit trainers to try out different skills from each profession. Once decided, return to Armin Saberlin.
7c292714585b4663c69df63f459f6b407360eb65.text: 選擇第二職業。拜訪培訓師，嘗試每個職業的不同技能。一旦決定，返回 阿明 沙貝林。

5f1d1de7c47ead73bd64b6f26595e12fb7a7a19b.source: Speak with Sir Tydus when you are ready to proceed.
5f1d1de7c47ead73bd64b6f26595e12fb7a7a19b.text: 當您準備好繼續時，請與 泰德閣下 聯絡。

7f53836655a45a3524c86fea75a819f421163822.source: Speak with any Town Crier to receive your reward.
7f53836655a45a3524c86fea75a819f421163822.text: 與任何 城鎮傳令 交談即可獲得獎勵。

1e1589e4cbe24e43d18b9f9b67933d267c92eadf.source: Step out of the gates of Ascalon City into the idyllic meadows of Lakeside County. Your first task is to master the fundamentals of your chosen Primary Profession. Depending on your chosen profession, the available quest will vary:
1e1589e4cbe24e43d18b9f9b67933d267c92eadf.text: 走出 阿斯卡隆城 的大門，進入 湖畔郡 田園詩般的草地。您的首要任務是掌握您選擇的主要 職業 的基礎知識。根據您選擇的職業，可用的任務會有所不同：

9d0342d6c5902f1ae557d5e64a40e7fafe28ee33.text: 無 死靈法師的考驗

56a26fc4f6947a1d2e5cea7298ba9afd9d40cee0.text: 幻術師 幻術師的考驗

873e44d56d9c2e040f854d1cb153f8937760dc20.text: 元素使 元素使的考驗

51ceb25b80266814334f44bca0b74a2d0f27db80.source: Accept your respective quest and complete it. Once you have proven your basic competence, travel southwest along the road to the village of Ashford to meet with Devona. She will task you with investigating some Unsettling Rumors.
51ceb25b80266814334f44bca0b74a2d0f27db80.text: 接受你各自的任務並完成它。一旦您證明瞭自己的基本能力，就可以沿著公路向西南行駛，前往阿什福德村與 德佛娜 會面。她會讓你調查一些 不安的傳聞。

dba602221710de41dae9039c44047af670b680c3.source: After you finish that quest, you must expand your horizons by selecting a secondary profession. Caution: Your choice of a secondary profession cannot be changed until much later in the game; therefore, it is advised not to lock in your choice until you are done with adventuring in this area.
dba602221710de41dae9039c44047af670b680c3.text: 完成該任務後，您必須透過選擇第二個職業來擴大視野。注意：你對次要職業的選擇要到遊戲後期才能改變；因此，建議您在完成該地區的冒險之前不要鎖定您的選擇。

4a2d04649a9ad563904ee43524af9c1a351839e8.source: The following quests unlock a secondary profession:
4a2d04649a9ad563904ee43524af9c1a351839e8.text: 以下任務解鎖次要職業：

189f45d22a27655711b4a9a38e571fbb01a9da8c.text: 無 死靈法師的新成員

e6d96b772f0880ad96df10ab818aab6eabe258f3.text: 幻術師 幻術師的重任

745ef800fe8c41752297f68888f4c1c827d51bcf.text: 元素使 元素使的實驗

a9de97f2f8b63993fecc9bf2dbcbf189ed7abcdd.source: After you have firmly locked in your secondary profession, return to Ascalon City and speak to Armin Saberlin. Accept the quest A Second Profession from him (if you haven't already done so) and accept the reward from that quest to proceed. Then speak to a Town Crier for your reward.
a9de97f2f8b63993fecc9bf2dbcbf189ed7abcdd.text: 當你牢牢鎖定你的第二個職業後，回到 阿斯卡隆城 並與 阿明 沙貝林 交談。接受他的任務 副職業修練（如果您還沒有這樣做）並接受該任務的獎勵以繼續。然後與 城鎮傳令 聯絡以獲得獎勵。

af3a892823a04fc07de2abdaf89e53f6d3283e3e.source: If you accept this quest after completing A Second Profession, the objective to speak with a Town Crier will not appear and you will be unable to obtain the reward.
af3a892823a04fc07de2abdaf89e53f6d3283e3e.text: 如果您在完成副職業修練後接受此任務，與城鎮傳令對話的目標將不會出現，您將無法獲得獎勵。

bbe61fdee698bd7f65d45a1da8c8dc80f20e6424.source: Help the Dwarves locate and flee through the Asuran Gate.
bbe61fdee698bd7f65d45a1da8c8dc80f20e6424.text: 幫助矮人找到並逃離阿蘇蘭之門。

b47e9129a16448c171d09dfdf4e5a953dc83534e.source: A timer will appear showing "Time remaining to escape", giving you 3 minutes. The easiest way to complete this quest is to click on Burol Ironfist or Kodan on the way in to the meeting. After the meeting is over (or you and your party members click the "skip" button), just press the space bar to follow them. Your character will follow them, trying to catch up as they run their way to the Asura Gate, possibly catching up to them once or twice on the run. If this happens, just hit the space bar again. A lot of Destroyers will spawn behind your party and chase after. They can be ignored, and it is best to do so as fighting them will eat up time. As you approach the gate, be prepared for your character to stop moving when the NPC you were following enters the gate. Using this strategy, you reach the gate with roughly 1 minute left — provided you didn't stop to fight.
