b47e9129a16448c171d09dfdf4e5a953dc83534e.text: 將出現一個計時器，顯示“逃脫剩餘時間”，為您提供 3 分鐘。完成此任務的最簡單方法是在參加會議時點選布羅爾鐵拳或克丹。會議結束後（或您和您的團隊成員點選「跳過」按鈕），只需按空白鍵即可關注他們。你的角色將跟隨他們，試圖在他們跑向 阿蘇拉 門時追上他們，可能會在逃跑過程中追上他們一兩次。如果發生這種情況，只需再次按下空白鍵即可。許多驅逐艦會在你的隊伍後面生成並追趕。可以忽略它們，最好這樣做，因為與它們戰鬥會消耗時間。當您接近大門時，請做好準備，當您跟隨的 NPC 進入大門時，您的角色會停止移動。使用此策略，您在大約剩下 1 分鐘時到達大門 - 前提是您沒有停下來戰鬥。

7099ca8059e7b62c7d8115e8217cfd612d2b6745.source: This quest is automatically added to the Quest Log upon completion of the Encounter in the Depths cinematic of any one of the preceding quests. This quest is also automatically completed and removed upon entering the Asura Gate, and the follow-up quest, Against the Destroyers is automatically added.
7099ca8059e7b62c7d8115e8217cfd612d2b6745.text: 完成前述任一任務的「深淵遭遇」過場動畫後，該任務將自動加入 任務 日誌中。該任務也會在進入 阿蘇拉 門後自動完成並刪除，並自動新增後續任務「對抗毀滅者」。

aa96c5268e0dfbde42b0c38961b4f20bdf2b301a.source: The Quest Log says the quest is given in the Tunnels Below Cantha regardless of which continent you came from.
aa96c5268e0dfbde42b0c38961b4f20bdf2b301a.text: 任務 日誌顯示，無論您來自哪個大陸，任務都會在 Cantha 下方的隧道中給出。

baa5d30b9c76b00412fb7fbaadf34e611b341d69.source: Trying to fight the Destroyers is a bad idea: the chance of winning is slim and it takes a great part of your time. Also, you can easily go to the gate without a speed boost and without any combat.
baa5d30b9c76b00412fb7fbaadf34e611b341d69.text: 試圖與毀滅者戰鬥是一個壞主意：獲勝的機會很小，而且會佔用你大量的時間。此外，你可以輕鬆地到達大門，無需速度提升，也無需任何戰鬥。

e1b0a56314a564649e2b7a9d3b43919f01a9c5dc.source: If you do decide to fight the destroyers, some things to consider are:
e1b0a56314a564649e2b7a9d3b43919f01a9c5dc.text: 如果您決定與驅逐艦作戰，需要考慮以下事項：

fb97085227c9c153713fd73466074b886f73b3d0.source: All destroyers during this mission are warriors, making them vulnerable to Blindness, Weakness and skills that can disable the attacks of multiple enemies, such as Clumsiness.
fb97085227c9c153713fd73466074b886f73b3d0.text: 此任務中的所有驅逐艦都是戰士，因此它們很容易受到失明、虛弱 和可以停用多個敵人攻擊的技能（例如 笨拙）的影響。

faae1952e09f3fc8dd487a11977c6fc87ca87d79.source: The fact that they are all melee-fighters opens up for the possibility of clumping them up and knocking them down with area knockdowns like Meteor, Earth Shaker and Grasping Was Kuurong.
faae1952e09f3fc8dd487a11977c6fc87ca87d79.text: 事實上，他們都是近戰戰士，因此有可能將他們聚集在一起，並透過 隕石、震動大地 和 貪婪者古朗 等區域擊倒來擊倒他們。

2c574b1d2717b5db3566b4fcfb2304cf46a3f22c.source: Due to the time limitation, it is unlikely that you will have time to defeat all destroyers if fought individually; Consider running to the end of the mission and fight them all there.
2c574b1d2717b5db3566b4fcfb2304cf46a3f22c.text: 由於時間限制，如果單打獨鬥，你不太可能有時間擊敗所有驅逐艦；考慮跑到任務的終點並在那裡與他們戰鬥。

c8e14bbb9e359450094ba7b997be4d44b6f826ee.source: Also see the Destroyer-page for general weaknesses of destroyers.
c8e14bbb9e359450094ba7b997be4d44b6f826ee.text: 另請參閱驅逐艦頁面以瞭解驅逐艦的一般弱點。

42d7282f54ff27730a362ceb8b5743d239f69550.source: During the quest, the Guild Wars Eye of the North overture (from the login screen and character selection screen) plays.
42d7282f54ff27730a362ceb8b5743d239f69550.text: 在任務過程中，會播放 公會 戰爭 極地之眼 序曲（來自登入畫面和角色選擇畫面）。

9083d4a78ad29f837f9edcb81383193ee970f7d8.source: Going through the portal will send you to the Into the North cinematic.
9083d4a78ad29f837f9edcb81383193ee970f7d8.text: 透過門戶將帶您進入電影《走進北方》。

a215adf11e4c62014aecf7f6330973be7a2d7892.source: When "Time remaining to escape" runs out, your party automatically dies and a "QUEST FAILED: Your group did not escape from the dungeon in time." message appears.
a215adf11e4c62014aecf7f6330973be7a2d7892.text: 當「逃脫剩餘時間」耗盡時，你的隊伍會自動死亡，並顯示「任務失敗：你的隊伍沒有及時逃離地牢」。出現訊息。

ee00ac62df228b54ae34753f731e262c6760c7ed.text: Tyrian (阿斯卡隆戰記) 或 Elonian (黑暗逆襲) 字元

dbecf0b79c08d91dd8b74bf8125cab3726e77dc4.source: Speak with Brother Mhenlo in Bukdek Byway.
dbecf0b79c08d91dd8b74bf8125cab3726e77dc4.text: 與 巴德克小徑 中的 涵洛教友 交談。

e5c386db3038522e4286da5529c451dd1bd921c9.source: Travel with Brother Mhenlo to find his old teacher, Master Togo.
e5c386db3038522e4286da5529c451dd1bd921c9.text: 與 涵洛教友 一起旅行尋找他的老師 藤吾大師。

f3b5f9ffc741a216b159d17350e2ac03ca8e2f6a.source: Throughout the battle, make sure to kill all of the Minions of Dhuum and Champions of Dhuum that Dhuum periodically summons; if you don't kill them, they'll swarm your team. Because of the amount of skeletons and the easiness of killing them, Edge of Extinction is a good tool for keeping their numbers down. Avoid using the spirit form skill Encase Skeletal, since it prevents the target from taking damage; as more and more come it gets harder to keep them all in check and easier for them to swarm.
f3b5f9ffc741a216b159d17350e2ac03ca8e2f6a.text: 在整個戰鬥中，確保殺死 多姆 定期召喚的所有 多姆 小兵和 多姆 冠軍；如果你不殺掉他們，他們就會蜂擁而至你的隊伍。由於骷髏數量眾多且容易殺死它們，滅絕之地 是減少骷髏數量的好工具。避免使用精神型態技能包裹骷髏，因為它可以防止目標受到傷害；隨著越來越多的人到來，控制它們變得越來越困難，而且它們更容易蜂擁而至。

4520a41fb4059320c94a13054aed7f596c18ada9.source: Go to North Kryta Province and follow the road to the fort in the D'Alessio Seaboard. Once there, report your presence to Mantle Knight Karriya.
4520a41fb4059320c94a13054aed7f596c18ada9.text: 前往 科瑞塔北部，然後沿著路前往 達雷西海濱 中的堡壘。到達那裡後，向斗篷騎士卡里亞報告您的存在。

8875e55b61c31b90d2c0dc6455e9d4f601127aaa.source: Exit Lion's Arch into North Kryta Province and head west to D'Alessio Seaboard. Enter the outpost and talk with Mantle Knight Karriya to complete the quest. It's a short trip; however, a few Fire Imps may cause trouble for low level characters. Bring sufficient healing.
8875e55b61c31b90d2c0dc6455e9d4f601127aaa.text: 從 獅子拱門 出口駛入 科瑞塔北部，然後往西前往 達雷西海濱。進入前哨站並與斗篷騎士卡里亞交談以完成任務。這是一趟短途旅行；然而，有些火小鬼可能會給低等級的角色帶來麻煩。帶來足夠的療癒力。

e3adb9cba101866157a5e9a6b972e131e1ac5969.text: Tyrian (阿斯卡隆戰記) 或 Canthan (盟與敵) 字元

f5805d4993baef41e7924980257169ef23eb3552.source: Speak to First Spear Dehvad to gain entrance to the Training Area.
f5805d4993baef41e7924980257169ef23eb3552.text: 與第一名 矛 Dehvad 交談以進入訓練區。

0b3849a5390192a77e7632458b05ece1a7fd6427.text: 完成 命令 培訓。

89eb3224d18f692b295f743e0bbcccf9ea71301b.source: Report to Castellan Puuba in the Sunspear Great Hall for further orders.
89eb3224d18f692b295f743e0bbcccf9ea71301b.text: 向 日戟大會堂 中的 Castellan Puuba 報告以取得進一步訂單。

a18133924c2731dc649e40f32386f85539e3aaf6.source: Koss, Dunkoro, Melonni, and Tahlkora are unlocked after talking to Kormir. They will all be level 15, rather than the level they have during the quest.
a18133924c2731dc649e40f32386f85539e3aaf6.text: 寇斯、Dunkoro、梅隆妮 和 Tahlkora 在與 Kormir 交談後解鎖。他們的等級都是 15，而不是他們在任務期間的等級。

5b78a9ace94fab44073820901bf0e6fc6d9a0155.source: At the same time you will be given an extra copy of the weapons these heroes come with. These weapons are more powerful than the ones they're currently equipped with, and more adapted to their (higher) level.
5b78a9ace94fab44073820901bf0e6fc6d9a0155.text: 同時，您將獲得這些英雄附帶的武器的額外副本。這些武器比他們目前裝備的武器更強大，並且更適合他們的（更高）等級。

86e315835162d5654ea0e49dd431fcfa4b921600.source: See Guardsman Chow for your reward.
86e315835162d5654ea0e49dd431fcfa4b921600.text: 請見衛兵週以獲得獎勵。

7df7832b2bf820fdac7d93752a38a4422d872823.source: After leaving Kaineng Center, speak with Mhenlo right outside. Then follow the marker to Emi and Chiyo in a large courtyard area. After Mhenlo and the twins talk for a moment, the quest will update and you, Mhenlo, and his gang will travel to the Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) entrance, where Guardsman Chow will let you enter Vizunah Square.
7df7832b2bf820fdac7d93752a38a4422d872823.text: 離開 凱寧中心 後，在外面與 涵洛 交談。然後沿著標記前往大庭院中的惠美和千代。 涵洛 和雙胞胎交談了一會兒後，任務將會更新，您、涵洛 和他的幫派將前往 薇茹廣場（外國區）入口，守衛週將讓您進入 薇茹廣場。

9ce59e9eb304166f7bf04dde14433c7fc3697b13.source: If you keep this quest active, all the quest NPCs will travel and fight with you in Bukdek Byway.
9ce59e9eb304166f7bf04dde14433c7fc3697b13.text: 如果您保持此任務處於活動狀態，所有任務 NPC 都會在 巴德克小徑 中與您一起旅行和戰鬥。

552a548d59bfcd7fad19f2079c356d62f495aa88.source: The Quest Log displays "Dockhand Quangnai (Kaineng Docks)" even though Bejunkan Pier is where Dockhand Quangnai is located and the quest is acquired.
552a548d59bfcd7fad19f2079c356d62f495aa88.text: 任務 日誌顯示“Dockhand Quangnai (凱寧船塢)”，即使 君瞰碼頭 是 Dockhand Quangnai 所在的位置並且已取得任務。

eece10f001c327a023917d42d0ea0a3c503e2d51.source: Investigate the Eye of the North.

78d6511de6bf3827321862ccc17a5d2edfb7f3c9.source: Seek assistance from the Asura. (The Knowledgeable Asura)
78d6511de6bf3827321862ccc17a5d2edfb7f3c9.text: 向 阿蘇拉 尋求協助。 （知識淵博的 阿蘇拉）

dbc94e366dc4a114f49917981545666b7455c38f.source: Gain the Norn as allies. (Northern Allies)
dbc94e366dc4a114f49917981545666b7455c38f.text: 獲得 諾恩 作為盟友。 （北方同盟國）

f2e8d77f958c24f00adff8dd89b70edab661d3df.source: Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands. (The Missing Vanguard)
f2e8d77f958c24f00adff8dd89b70edab661d3df.text: 在 夏爾 家鄉尋找 黑檀。 （失蹤的先鋒隊）

43873bec859eff61d5896f178e8c9c71415863df.source: Look into the scrying pool at the Eye of the North.
43873bec859eff61d5896f178e8c9c71415863df.text: 檢視 極地之眼 的占卜池。

c8d4e8232fa56cc2d77967f0b283aac0f7031fbd.source: Eliminate the Destroyers. (A Time for Heroes)
c8d4e8232fa56cc2d77967f0b283aac0f7031fbd.text: 消滅破壞者。 （英雄的光彩年代）

6a8f32d6bf909ebb0bdab78cbd2bf1089da57e7c.text: 前往卓克納爾領取獎勵。

5fc043e485a1fab0baca6143abe963ff70a788bb.source: Leave Boreal Station and talk to Jora outside. Follow the quest marker north and into the Eye of the North. Once there, you will be directed into the Hall of Monuments. Speak with Gwen and look into the Scrying Pool. Choose to keep your eyes open to receive The First Vision and three primary quests:
5fc043e485a1fab0baca6143abe963ff70a788bb.text: 離開北方車站並與外面的 喬拉 交談。沿著任務標記向北前進，進入 極地之眼。到達那裡後，您將被引導至 史蹟殿堂。與 關 交談並檢視占卜池。選擇睜大眼睛接受第一次願景和三個主要任務：

7162bf83c41fe61e0b3d24d7b361a1d2ace01fdd.source: These three quests can be done in any order. When all three are completed, look into the Scrying Pool once more. Select "Look Deep into the Pool" to activate The Final Vision.
7162bf83c41fe61e0b3d24d7b361a1d2ace01fdd.text: 這三個任務可以用任何順序完成。當這三個都完成後，再次檢視占卜池。選擇“深入池中”以啟動“最終願景”。

b58e2b1d9833fb19cd8fc222cf5af06f0bfea2fb.source: Upon completion, Jalis will give you the quest Destruction's Depths. While this is not part of the quest objectives, it is needed to reach the Central Transfer Chamber where the final task awaits.
b58e2b1d9833fb19cd8fc222cf5af06f0bfea2fb.text: 完成後，賈利斯會給你任務 破壞的深淵。雖然這不是任務目標的一部分，但需要到達中央傳送室，那裡等待最終的任務。

f472f5b99906f7956f824e06353c6292e79c0166.source: Once inside the Central Transfer Chamber, talk to High Priest Alkar to receive the final quest, A Time for Heroes. Finishing it marks the end of Eye of the North's storyline and sends you to the Epilogue, where you can receive the quest reward and a Droknar's Key from Droknar.
f472f5b99906f7956f824e06353c6292e79c0166.text: 進入中央傳送室後，與 高等祭司 阿爾卡 交談以接受最終任務 英雄的光彩年代。完成它標誌著 極地之眼 故事情節的結束，並將您帶到尾聲，在那裡您可以從 Droknar 那裡獲得任務獎勵和 Droknar 的 鑰匙。

a6f92677a21c78f169a791ea93bcc66aff1ccc18.source: Even if the quest objectives, markers and exclamation marks update properly at the scrying pool, the First Vision will not be available until you talk to Jora in Ice Cliff Chasms.
a6f92677a21c78f169a791ea93bcc66aff1ccc18.text: 即使探知池中的任務目標、標記和感嘆號正確更新，在您與 冰崖裂口 中的 喬拉 交談之前，第一個願景也將不可用。

e38a3715f4da88fd67dc861e9d1d72941e8f7831.source: This quest is automatically added to the quest log upon completion of the preceding quest. Unlike most quests, it cannot be abandoned. This is due to not being able to reacquire it.
e38a3715f4da88fd67dc861e9d1d72941e8f7831.text: 完成前面的任務後，該任務會自動加入任務日誌。與大多數任務不同，它不能被放棄。這是由於無法重新獲得它。

afebb593d307bf2833ef36b3f97672f44ef6e0fd.source: Once you leave Boreal Station and talk to Jora outside, you can either walk back or map travel back to the station, leave again, and collect the Norn Bounty at the resurrection shrine. If you continue on directly to the Eye of the North, you cannot get it until further along the path.
afebb593d307bf2833ef36b3f97672f44ef6e0fd.text: 一旦你離開北方車站並與外面的 喬拉 交談，你可以步行返回或繪製地圖回到車站，再次離開，並在復活神社收集 諾恩 賞金。如果您繼續直接前往 極地之眼，則必須沿著路徑繼續前進才能獲得它。

dfba0fe6ef0e190bcaf2f5261b554dcea323d575.text: 埃洛尼安 (黑暗逆襲) 角色

55cf770b347e841c7e07afb6ded78d6c55161219.source: Travel to the Sunspear watch post.

e6e4de79dd7bc8fd2205f80b0765c9b46ce10982.source: Start the Tutorial by speaking to Kormir. She will explain how to walk and how to interact with other characters. Go to the chest behind you, open it, and pick up the weapon. then go into your Inventory and equip it (either by double-clicking it, or dragging it to your weapon slot). Speak to Kormir once again to continue. She will then explain Quests and how to use the Compass. Follow her toward the gate, where she explains how Loot Drops work.
e6e4de79dd7bc8fd2205f80b0765c9b46ce10982.text: 透過與科米爾交談來開始教程。她將解釋如何行走以及如何與其他角色互動。走到你身後的箱子前，開啟它，然後拿起武器。然後進入您的 物品欄 並裝備它（雙擊它，或將其拖曳到您的武器槽中）。再次與科米爾交談以繼續。然後她將解釋 任務 以及如何使用指南針。跟著她走向大門，在那裡她解釋 寶 Drops 的工作原理。

a7d08517bc38504787af37ab1fefdb8ad911d5ac.source: Now you have to kill 3 Corsair Spies; just attack them and they will die quickly. Afterward, proceed towards the resurrection shrine…where you will die quickly (as Kormir explains Death and the Death Penalty). There you will also learn your first 3 skills and she will explain how to use them.
a7d08517bc38504787af37ab1fefdb8ad911d5ac.text: 現在你必須殺死 3 海盜 間諜；只要攻擊他們，他們很快就會死。然後，前往復活神殿…在那裡你會很快死去（正如科米爾解釋的死亡和死刑）。在那裡您還將學習您的第一個 3 技能，她將解釋如何使用它們。

e4248b8ebefe0824acab28c26f3fd4620488bf29.source: Proceed to the next two groups of corsairs and kill them. While running, listen as Kormir explains the Aggro Range Circle on your compass. Speak to Kormir again to get your reward. She will explain what Attribute Points and Skill Points are. Speak to her again to get your next primary quest.
e4248b8ebefe0824acab28c26f3fd4620488bf29.text: 繼續前往接下來的兩組海盜並殺死他們。跑步時，聽 Kormir 在指南針上解釋 Aggro 攻擊距離 Circle。再次與科米爾交談以獲得獎勵。她將解釋 屬性 積分和 技能 積分是什麼。再次與她交談以獲得你的下一個主要任務。

d4f45f8ddf47cba4eae031a663361cafb402ffd9.source: Dying during the tutorial explanation of the resurrection shrine does not increase the number of deaths you have taken (see /deaths).
d4f45f8ddf47cba4eae031a663361cafb402ffd9.text: 在復活神殿的教程解釋中死亡不會增加你的死亡次數（參見/deaths）。

f0b6584071f261709fa01f998d1f4dcd6be32036.source: Kneeling at the resurrection shrine will summon the Avatar of Dwayna, but she will not talk to you nor offer any blessings.
f0b6584071f261709fa01f998d1f4dcd6be32036.text: 跪在復活神殿前會召喚 薇娜化身，但她不會跟你說話，也不會提供任何祝福。

56b46449e51aed86bef840477739784268bcf530.source: Before talking to Kormir and beginning the tutorial, obtain your weapon from the Weapons Chest and scrape the entire area, which will add 0.5% toward the Elonian Cartographer title (as well as some experience and treasure from killing the Corsairs in the water -- you might have to engage in tactical retreats from the Corsair Healer, who is the same level as you, but who apparently cannot heal). After talking to Kormir and completing the tutorial, you should have a total of 0.8% toward the Elonian Cartographer title.
56b46449e51aed86bef840477739784268bcf530.text: 在與 Kormir 交談並開始教程之前，從武器 寶箱 中獲取你的武器並刮擦整個區域，這會將 0.5% 新增到 Elonian 版圖 標題中（以及在水中殺死海盜的一些經驗和寶藏 - 你可能必須從 海盜 醫治傭兵 進行戰術撤退，海盜 醫治傭兵 與你水平相同，但顯然無法治癒）。與 Kormir 交談並完成教學課程後，您應該總共獲得 0.8% 並獲得 Elonian 版圖 標題。

de586b1af1c1f926cfebb91a14fd48de0c4117c2.source: This quest will stay in your Quest Log when leaving the zone (such as when entering the Guild Hall or resigning), but will be automatically removed upon re-entry to the Island of Shehkah instance.
de586b1af1c1f926cfebb91a14fd48de0c4117c2.text: 當離開該區域時（例如進入 公會大廳 或辭職時），此任務將保留在您的 任務 日誌中，但在重新進入謝卡島例項時將自動刪除。

5dfd63b74db2449391196a072a34a1fb9ec096c9.text: 與第一名 矛 Jahdugar 交談。

f360ac560f3e8d7def6e1efb7f6307a200ce8d9b.source: See First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.
f360ac560f3e8d7def6e1efb7f6307a200ce8d9b.text: 請參閱第一個 矛 Jahdugar 以獲得獎勵。

db8debdee299a31be810c34b22a6d828c918b1c6.text: 寇斯 加入您的隊伍。

38863481e9720a388e6c5e8cacec98061c97d1fa.source: Walk to First Spear Jahdugar and speak with him. Choose to enter. That's it.
38863481e9720a388e6c5e8cacec98061c97d1fa.text: 走到 First 矛 Jahdugar 並與他交談。選擇進入。就是這樣。

c3db20e5b22128d8bba3c83cb9e5d4666d4daa3c.source: Resigning after accepting this quest will cause you to move to the outpost even if you haven't talked to First Spear Jahdugar.
c3db20e5b22128d8bba3c83cb9e5d4666d4daa3c.text: 接受此任務後辭職將導致你移動到前哨站，即使你還沒有與第一名 矛 Jahdugar 交談過。

646bdaafc6c2ed85628638f98976357e39b5df3e.source: Meet Instructor Ng at the gate.

cc1d41c155293afbb238db8eabc6de2ba9068180.text: 擊敗 [18..0] 更多螳螂幼體。

4fb7faf7f3b2273c3c38dc4c7343c89aa1c05aac.source: See Instructor Ng for your reward.

2962cb6dc8ad7c06f0a09a847fbb3f21fc3ab813.source: Follow Instructor Ng and speak to him each time he requests. Kill all the mantids on the way. After you are resurrected at the resurrection shrine, you receive two skills.
2962cb6dc8ad7c06f0a09a847fbb3f21fc3ab813.text: 跟隨吳教練並在每次他提出要求時與他交談。殺死路上所有的螳螂。在復活神殿復活後，你將獲得兩個技能。

438cf2eb816c397e66383cc84680d829ba36bcbe.source: Despite Instructor Ng implying he has given Kisai and Mai two skills each, they actually both possess their full starting henchman skill bars, and use them against the two hatchlings before the resurrection shrine as well.
438cf2eb816c397e66383cc84680d829ba36bcbe.text: 儘管吳教練暗示他已經給了基西和麥兩個技能，但他們實際上都擁有完整的起始追隨者技能條，並在復活神社前用它們對抗兩隻幼體。

36b5f6bbb664a77d2caaa5de4e674f9e19cc39cf.source: Mai also uses Viper's Defense despite usually only gaining that skill at level 10.
36b5f6bbb664a77d2caaa5de4e674f9e19cc39cf.text: Mai 也使用 毒蛇防禦，儘管通常只能在 10 等級取得該技能。

fa2e7968468ace6df3093c9c66729309d783e910.source: If you resign while in the area the Krytan loading screen will be seen briefly, then quickly change to the Shing Jea loading screen.
fa2e7968468ace6df3093c9c66729309d783e910.text: 如果您在該區域辭職，將會短暫看到 Krytan 載入螢幕，然後快速切換到 Shing Jea 載入螢幕。

d5fa73d2ab746d61628ac6a120e3b05ee6fd8b42.source: Go to the town square in Ascalon City. Talk to Sir Tydus.
d5fa73d2ab746d61628ac6a120e3b05ee6fd8b42.text: 前往 阿斯卡隆城 的城鎮廣場。與 泰德閣下 交談。

6fb82f7722c635980f302149a5ad879bcbfd2f41.source: Head north from the Town Crier, crossing the stone bridge. You will find Sir Tydus on a podium just in front of the gate to the Ascalon Academy. Speak to him to claim your reward and learn of his news.
6fb82f7722c635980f302149a5ad879bcbfd2f41.text: 從 城鎮傳令 向北行駛，穿過石橋。您會在 阿斯卡隆學院 大門前的平臺上找到 泰德閣下。與他交談以領取獎勵並瞭解他的訊息。

26d775ae502c81aeace64df9b165ac4192979cef.source: While it acts as an introduction to the questing system, this quest is entirely optional. You can proceed directly to Sir Tydus to begin War Preparations. The only thing you will miss is a small amount of gold and experience.
26d775ae502c81aeace64df9b165ac4192979cef.text: 雖然它作為任務系統的介紹，但該任務完全是可選的。您可以直接進入泰德閣下開始戰爭準備。你唯一會錯過的是少量的金幣和經驗。

f360a965c9b55d8dd3be7fb3029140b547d471b4.text: 向 阿蘇拉 尋求協助。

21402e673b707e3a06955a6f1a6b7a751ca9326a.source: Speak to Vekk in the Hall of Monuments.
21402e673b707e3a06955a6f1a6b7a751ca9326a.text: 在 史蹟殿堂 中與 Vekk 交談。

166381da387400a92c9c2b360783de097c69df91.source: Journey through the Asura Gate in the Vloxen Excavations.
166381da387400a92c9c2b360783de097c69df91.text: 穿過 弗洛森古蹟 中的 阿蘇拉 門。

959f86505934821108d35fc9ff5ef0d1ce06ab5d.source: Assemble a krewe for project G.O.L.E.M.
959f86505934821108d35fc9ff5ef0d1ce06ab5d.text: 為 G.O.L.E.M. 專案組裝一個克魯。

f2719e30fa44775d355d5c9394e59c94ff19cd0f.source: Recruit Gadd to help with the project. (Finding the Bloodstone)
f2719e30fa44775d355d5c9394e59c94ff19cd0f.text: 招募加德來幫助完成這個專案。 （尋找血石）

94f125407f25c0edf3bb4891d118a3a0f4863edc.source: Enlist Oola to help with the project. (The Elusive Golemancer)
94f125407f25c0edf3bb4891d118a3a0f4863edc.text: 讓 Oola 幫助完成該專案。 （烏拉的實驗室）

4d709cd3ef3875b6d97efb4c180b480dcd679608.source: Acquire Renk's help with the project.
4d709cd3ef3875b6d97efb4c180b480dcd679608.text: 獲得倫克對專案的幫助。

ea560870e6780dafca106836cc834cdc8820e115.source: Protect the golem foundry from the Destroyers. (Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation)
ea560870e6780dafca106836cc834cdc8820e115.text: 保護傀儡鑄造廠免受毀滅者的侵害。 （天才操作生活附魔錶現）

3102c4f3c097b315fb04cd7706f5f4266dc996b1.text: 請參閱 Mamp 獲取獎勵。

2ceff8eab16800b7a53cfc250723c7b66d335f56.source: If starting from Olafstead, journey south-west through Varajar Fells to Verdant Cascades. Continue traveling west to Umbral Grotto.
2ceff8eab16800b7a53cfc250723c7b66d335f56.text: 如果從 尤拉夫之地 出發，往西南行進，穿過 維拉戛陣地 到達 Verdant Cascades。繼續向西行駛至 陰影石穴。

16e90528e37af460863d40f8085242a8538108ff.source: For new characters starting from the Eye of the North, you can travel west into Battledepths then follow the northern route to reach Varajar Fells. The mini map will display where the exit is.
16e90528e37af460863d40f8085242a8538108ff.text: 對於從 極地之眼 開始的新角色，您可以向西進入 戰鬥深淵，然後沿著北部路線到達 維拉戛陣地。小地圖上會顯示出口的位置。

182abfe3b52dab0df60b417ed61799a00780e6f9.source: From Umbral Grotto, travel through the dungeon Vloxen Excavations to the south western exit on level 1. Be wary of rolling boulders, they will instantly kill anything in their path.
182abfe3b52dab0df60b417ed61799a00780e6f9.text: 從 陰影石穴 出發，穿過地牢 弗洛森古蹟 到達 1 層的西南方出口。小心滾動的巨石，它們會立即殺死路上的任何東西。

e61260c2998f6559607d22cf7282dae81bd015a9.source: After the cinematic, adventurers will find themselves in Vlox's Falls. From here on, the story branches into three separate quest chains.
e61260c2998f6559607d22cf7282dae81bd015a9.text: 電影結束後，冒險家們會發現自己身處在弗洛克斯瀑布。從這裡開始，故事分成三個獨立的任務鏈。

29b95e8ba8bc84fc1dc9bee4de720d241ad8b502.source: Take the quest Finding Gadd from Livia. Upon completion, you are offered the quest Finding the Bloodstone. Finish it to recruit Gadd.
29b95e8ba8bc84fc1dc9bee4de720d241ad8b502.text: 從 莉薇亞 接取任務 尋找蓋德。完成後，您將收到任務 尋找血石。完成它來招募加德。

968d65448b3934b239cf20c06b1eea7adbd0f008.source: When Nightfall was released, the 4 heroes were recruited at the same level that they were recruited in the Nightfall campaign (Koss at level 2, Dunkoro at level 6, Melonni at level 8 and Tahlkora at level 12). This was changed later, probably due to the fact that foreign characters were very soon faced with the Consulate Docks mission where all foes are level 20 (thus, rendering the heroes quite useless). At that time, Securing Champion's Dawn and A Land of Heroes didn't exist.
968d65448b3934b239cf20c06b1eea7adbd0f008.text: 當 黑暗逆襲 被釋放後， 4 英雄的招募等級與他們在同一級別中的招募等級相同。 黑暗逆襲 活動（ 寇斯 處於水平 2 , Dunkoro 水平 6 , 梅隆妮 處於水平 8 和塔爾科拉處於同一水平 12 ）。後來這一點被改變了，可能是因為外國角色很快就面臨了所有敵人都是水平的領事館碼頭任務 20 （因此，使英雄變得毫無用處）。那時，保 勇士曙光 和 英雄之地 不存在。

ef5ea8a5dece71a2139563ca27fb7c49653b6f2d.source: Characters who obtained heroes under level 15 are stuck with them, even if they have not yet completed this quest:
ef5ea8a5dece71a2139563ca27fb7c49653b6f2d.text: 獲得 15 以下英雄的角色將被困在其中，即使他們尚未完成此任務：

d32498e17c5ae4034be5c939b7351ddb61396d0a.source: Abandoning the quest and retaking it will not fix their levels. (the levels were set when the heroes were first unlocked)
d32498e17c5ae4034be5c939b7351ddb61396d0a.text: 放棄任務並重新接受任務不會修復他們的等級。 （等級是在英雄首次解鎖時設定的）

8705f480c5e7503a8a36361a03481bcd8421933a.source: It is not possible to delete the heroes via support request.
8705f480c5e7503a8a36361a03481bcd8421933a.text: 無法透過支援請求刪除英雄。

86cb761232a61de8990ac03d7b0903382a8994a0.source: You must be the foreign recruits Kormir told me to expect. It's good to see so many heroes from beyond these shores coming to our aid. Spearmarshal Kormir is awaiting for you in the Plains of Jarin. You should hurry and catch up to her; she seems even more driven than normal these days and probably won't wait around long.
86cb761232a61de8990ac03d7b0903382a8994a0.text: 你一定就是科米爾告訴我的外籍新兵。很高興看到這麼多來自海外的英雄來幫助我們。科米爾矛元帥正在 賈林平原 等待著您。你應該快點追上她；這些天她似乎比平常更有動力，可能不會等太久。

c0a6850b0734d7feb96cd0ff03df696e1173a553.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Morostav Trail.
c0a6850b0734d7feb96cd0ff03df696e1173a553.text: 在 摩洛神秘通道 中擊敗受影響者。

7eb2ba6c3a3dc80ebef2fcdd5164d03bb9061ea8.source: See Initiate Zei Ri for your reward.
7eb2ba6c3a3dc80ebef2fcdd5164d03bb9061ea8.text: 請參閱啟蒙 Zei Ri 以獲得獎勵。

a891e9c17e9693f14288b9a4fa42cd2a3b1aca58.source: Take the quest Lab Space from Lork. It will lead you to Rata Sum. On your way there, consider making a little detour to advance Renk's quest chain (see below) or to unlock Tarnished Haven. Either way, completing Lab Space will directly lead to The Elusive Golemancer, gaining the support from Oola.
a891e9c17e9693f14288b9a4fa42cd2a3b1aca58.text: 從 Lork 接受任務 工廠空間。它將引導您進入 洛達頂點。在前往那裡的路上，考慮繞道推進 Renk 的任務鏈（見下文）或解鎖 灰暗避難所。不管怎樣，完成工廠空間將直接通往烏拉的實驗室，獲得Oola的支援。

f6d5cadc8f0b1b0fe76de6617a37a16ecb3e42d6.source: Take the quest A Little Help from Plaxx. As mentioned above, the first objective can be completed on your way to Rata Sum. The remaining objectives can only be completed after recruiting the other two Asura, making Renk the final addition to your krewe.
f6d5cadc8f0b1b0fe76de6617a37a16ecb3e42d6.text: 接受 Plaxx 的任務「一點幫助」。如上所述，第一個目標可以在通往 洛達頂點 的途中完成。剩下的目標只有在招募另外兩個 阿蘇拉 後才能完成，讓 Renk 成為你的 krewe 的最後一個補充。

b8631b73bd9e8da55433b2972ead7aaf2d63c42f.source: When turning in the last quest at Mamp, pick the follow-up quest, Genius Operated Living Enchanted Manifestation, and complete it.
b8631b73bd9e8da55433b2972ead7aaf2d63c42f.text: 在 Mamp 上交最後一個任務時，選擇後續任務“天才操作的生活 附魔 表現”，並完成它。

1d41245769c5e94dd7e5c02ab290e0c2a68b1bb1.source: Talk to Mamp again to finish the asuran storyline and claim your reward.
1d41245769c5e94dd7e5c02ab290e0c2a68b1bb1.text: 再次與曼普交談以完成阿蘇蘭故事情節並領取獎勵。

6ab25bf1fef1c0a820d98d2a35e1239449e3f954.source: Upon completion of the quest, you are automatically under the effect of Call of the Eye.
6ab25bf1fef1c0a820d98d2a35e1239449e3f954.text: 完成任務後，你會自動受到眼睛召喚的影響。

e819ef78ca8c55b04c4fb4be021102f32ab5e0f9.source: Despite the third objective asking the player to journey through the Asura Gate in the Vloxen Excavations, the objective is considered complete and the cinematic will begin if the player is able to enter Vlox's Falls from Arbor Bay.
e819ef78ca8c55b04c4fb4be021102f32ab5e0f9.text: 儘管第三個目標要求玩家穿過 弗洛森古蹟 中的 阿蘇拉 門，但如果玩家能夠從阿伯灣進入 Vlox 瀑布，則該目標被視為完成，並且電影將開始。

94e44642c7391b5f8e6ef467fe01eab7f8214ef1.source: Head southeast to the Shards of Orr. Use the Asura Gate inside the entrance to gain access to Gadd's Encampment. Rendezvous there with Bartholos.
94e44642c7391b5f8e6ef467fe01eab7f8214ef1.text: 向東南方向前往 歐爾殘跡。使用入口內的 阿蘇拉 門進入 蓋德營區。在那裡與巴塞洛斯會合。

2acc8c8694e6912afbc5c2ead03d6fa919a09736.source: Join Livia and Gadd in Sparkfly Swamp.
2acc8c8694e6912afbc5c2ead03d6fa919a09736.text: 在 火星蠅沼澤 中加入 莉薇亞 和 Gadd。

16139da35fd29e18a19036e043f44b1c72a19780.source: Assist Livia with collecting inscriptions from the inscribed ettins. You have collected [0...3] of 3 inscriptions.
16139da35fd29e18a19036e043f44b1c72a19780.text: 協助 莉薇亞 從銘文埃廷收集銘文。您已經收集了 [0...3] 的 3 銘文。

7349fdd42deb541c98a654deb733783329179486.source: Return to the entrance of the Bloodstone Caves.
7349fdd42deb541c98a654deb733783329179486.text: 影返 到 血石洞 的入口。

13fdd13f9cd14c241042b3837a2a01ad7b6f9eb8.source: Activate the inscription and gain entrance to the Bloodstone Caves.
13fdd13f9cd14c241042b3837a2a01ad7b6f9eb8.text: 啟動銘文並進入 血石洞。

4015633cf7b4bd51c45bdec0c46fbfb8e4948a7c.source: This is a fairly long quest and you should have around fifty minutes devoted to do it. To get to the Shards of Orr dungeon, start at Vlox's Falls and head southeast. The Krait along the way should be relatively easy.
4015633cf7b4bd51c45bdec0c46fbfb8e4948a7c.text: 這是一個相當長的任務，你應該有大約五十分鐘的時間來完成它。要到達 歐爾殘跡 地牢，請從 Vlox's Falls 開始，然後向東南方向前進。 環蛇 一路走來應該相對容易。

9953fa31217a439250a3cfcb7df6bdf6e6e0d814.source: Once inside the dungeon, it is very helpful to take your time with the skeletons and zombies. Two groups at once will be very dangerous to the party. Holy damage is effective, while physical attackers will have trouble due to the many blinding skills. One method is to bring seven heroes with "Charge!"/"Incoming!" and/or "Fall Back!" and stagger their uses in order to run right past the enemies. If the party racks up too much Death Penalty, the zombie groups can be impossible to kill. It's sometimes possible to get past them by creative flagging of henchmen/heroes. Flag your healers off to the sides and a strong tank in front of the first group. Flag the rest of your henchmen on the second group, off to the side so they don't get tangled up in the first group. An alternate way is to take the north side when you reach the breach halfway through the map, because there are only two groups up there and no healers (however there are more warriors to do heavy damage). After half a dozen tries you should be able to pass them and activate the next Resurrection Shrine. Once you activate the second shrine, you can follow the path on the quest map to avoid the remaining mobs all together.
9953fa31217a439250a3cfcb7df6bdf6e6e0d814.text: 一旦進入地牢，花點時間與骷髏和殭屍相處是非常有幫助的。兩個團體同時出現對隊伍來說將是非常危險的。 神聖傷害 是有效的，而實體攻擊者會因為許多致盲技能而遇到麻煩。一種方法是帶七個英雄一起「衝鋒！」/「來襲！」和/或「撤退！」並錯開它們的使用，以便從敵人身邊跑過。如果隊伍被判過多的死刑，那麼殭屍群就不可能被殺。有時可以透過創造性地標記追隨者/英雄來繞過它們。將你的治療師標記到兩側，並在第一組前面放置一個強大的坦克。將你的其他追隨者標記為第二組，放在一邊，這樣他們就不會與第一組糾纏在一起。另一種方法是當你到達地圖中途的缺口時佔領北側，因為那裡只有兩個小組並且沒有治療者（但有更多的戰士可以造成嚴重傷害）。經過六次嘗試後，您應該能夠通過它們並啟動下一個 復活祭壇。一旦你啟動了第二個神殿，你就可以沿著任務地圖上的路徑前進，以避免剩下的小怪。

535dafbec1f13bd0912a9dad5ac3145e85e03275.source: Once Gadd's Encampment is reached, talk to Bartholos. Head outside and to the right towards the Bloodstone Caves to meet Gadd and Livia at point L on the quest map. At first you cannot enter the Bloodstone Caves, but Gadd will be able to lift the seal by deciphering inscriptions that are tattooed on nearby Inscribed Ettins. Follow the quest markers to each of the three Ettins marked 1-3 on the quest map to the right. After killing them, make sure Livia gets close enough to extract the inscriptions. There are many roaming Raptor groups in this area, you may want to take care of them before engaging the Ettins. Return to the cave entrance at point L to let Gadd decipher the inscriptions and collect your reward from the Inscription Stone.
535dafbec1f13bd0912a9dad5ac3145e85e03275.text: 到達 蓋德營區 後，與 Bartholos 交談。向外向右朝 血石洞 方向前進，在任務地圖上的 L 點與 Gadd 和 莉薇亞 會面。起初你無法進入 血石洞，但加德將能夠透過破解附近刻有銘文的埃廷斯上的銘文來解除封印。沿著任務標記前往右側任務地圖上標記為 1-3 的三個埃廷斯。殺死他們後，確保 莉薇亞 足夠接近以提取銘文。該地區有許多漫遊的 毒瑞克斯 團體，您可能需要在與埃廷人交戰之前先解決掉他們。 影返 到 L 點的洞穴入口，讓 Gadd 破解銘文並從 鑄印 石頭中領取獎勵。

ffbfdad4b7f59ceba355ed10a5f727ca6d9c69dd.source: You may wish to avoid bringing minion masters on this quest since there are many wandering groups around the Ettins that the minions will aggro. As a result, you will find yourself defending against more groups than you intended to fight.
ffbfdad4b7f59ceba355ed10a5f727ca6d9c69dd.text: 你可能希望避免在這個任務中帶隨從大師，因為埃廷斯周圍有許多流浪團體，隨從會聚集這些群體。結果，你會發現自己正在防禦的群體比你原本打算對抗的群體還要多。

381c1d005112ec0d310e7894e009ff2808d79ff6.source: If you have not recruited Hayda, with Frogstomp active, you can meet her and either do that quest first, or just let her help you with the Sparkfly Swamp phase of the Gadd/Bloodstone quest.
381c1d005112ec0d310e7894e009ff2808d79ff6.text: 如果您尚未招募 海妲，並且 Frogstomp 處於活動狀態，您可以與她見面並先完成該任務，或者只是讓她幫助您完成 Gadd/血石 任務的 火星蠅沼澤 階段。

c9dffc4647f4bac66b46036a114f75f13b6c2ccb.source: Leaving the area of Sparkfly Swamp at any part of the quest will reset it and make you repeat, including when you enter the Bloodstone Caves before Gadd completed deciphering the inscriptions.
c9dffc4647f4bac66b46036a114f75f13b6c2ccb.text: 在任務的任何部分離開 火星蠅沼澤 區域都會重置它並讓你重複，包括當你在 Gadd 完成破解銘文之前進入 血石洞 時。

14e53dcf8c15b8845ebe69f365249959940a393e.source: Gadd and Livia do not attack or use any skills that exploit corpses (Well of Blood) or target foes, but they do bodyblock allies and foes. They can only be harmed by area of effect skills because foes cannot directly target them.
14e53dcf8c15b8845ebe69f365249959940a393e.text: Gadd 和 莉薇亞 不會攻擊或使用任何利用屍體 (血之池) 或目標敵人的技能，但它們會對盟友和敵人進行身體阻擋。他們只能受到範圍技能的傷害，因為敵人無法直接瞄準他們。

1390d8a5bc4c346e65cda2378aace0515d2c0726.source: If you have the Lost Souls quest, abandon it or the portal will be blocked by an angry mob.
1390d8a5bc4c346e65cda2378aace0515d2c0726.text: 如果您有「失落的靈魂」任務，請放棄它，否則傳送門將被憤怒的暴徒封鎖。

370091ce4d59ad2d019e2f85967450a672b888d7.source: Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
370091ce4d59ad2d019e2f85967450a672b888d7.text: 與盧多交談即可進入修道院。

1fa1a7942fdd4a91c6741670a4b638bb40f0f7ac.source: Seek out Headmaster Zhan in the monastery.

130d52dbb2495f0f4049a85a8c4f154695042941.source: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the skills once you load into the Monastery.
130d52dbb2495f0f4049a85a8c4f154695042941.text: 與 星岬寺 入口處的 Ludo 交談即可進入。如果您跳過了螳螂幼體教程，您將在載入到修道院後學習技能。

04812de0d137771b12374b6098e35efb71afea56.source: If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
04812de0d137771b12374b6098e35efb71afea56.text: 如果放棄該任務，則無法重新接受，但可以立即接受以下任務。

8a2c6521e466606afe05a7057dbddd419648f8f4.source: Make your way to Chahbek Village.

c616dfe8b689713629b072b1badfa95d6d663015.text: 與第一名 矛 賈杜加爾交談。

de39cbb3da9ff7ea57f81037160602840c6abc26.source: Escort Kormir, Koss and 3 Sunspear Recruits to First Spear Jahdugar just outside Chahbek Village. Along the way, 2 Corsairs will popup, however they are easily defeated.
de39cbb3da9ff7ea57f81037160602840c6abc26.text: 護送 Kormir、寇斯 和 3 Sunspear 新兵前往 Chahbek 村外的第一個 矛 Jahdugar。一路上，2 海盜會彈出，但他們很容易被擊敗。

126a9e36025d0008f4841ba91fd91f63f5329093.source: Accepting the quest unlocks three skills for the character to use.
126a9e36025d0008f4841ba91fd91f63f5329093.text: 接受任務會解鎖三種技能供角色使用。

c999efe6a68d4dd7e806354968ec8fbfd8978e92.source: Resurrection Signet, and 2 profession skills as follows:
c999efe6a68d4dd7e806354968ec8fbfd8978e92.text: 復活紋章和2職業技能如下：

32fddfd7313a21b97e24429be48d5a46a2378e42.source: Re-entering the Island of Shehkah zone by any means after accepting this quest will cause you to move to the outpost even if you haven't completed any of the objectives.
32fddfd7313a21b97e24429be48d5a46a2378e42.text: 接受此任務後以任何方式重新進入謝卡島區域都會導致你移動到前哨站，即使你還沒有完成任何目標。

94d002113034a09950020e19ab2a8691456c31ee.source: Primary profession test (elementalist, mesmer, monk, necromancer, ranger, or warrior) not completed.
94d002113034a09950020e19ab2a8691456c31ee.text: 主職 測驗（元素師、幻術師、武僧、死靈法師、遊俠或戰士）未完成。

0027dc6b0a5360b07786777d4f159fcd7bb9bfca.source: Go out the gate to Lakeside County and talk to .
0027dc6b0a5360b07786777d4f159fcd7bb9bfca.text: 走出大門，前往 湖畔郡 並與 交談。

eb92bf95a1e1fc90352005f34b1b541539a8a506.source: Go through the Lakeside County gate to the northwest and leave Ascalon City. Your profession trainer will be standing directly outside. Speak to them to complete the quest.
eb92bf95a1e1fc90352005f34b1b541539a8a506.text: 穿過 湖畔郡 門向西北方向離開 阿斯卡隆城。您的專業培訓師將直接站在外面。與他們交談以完成任務。

2713b74622081f9fcd012599dc1e10c5f669a25c.source: Though this is a primary quest, it can actually be skipped. You can proceed directly to the profession trainer outside the city in Lakeside County. The only thing you will miss is the experience reward. This quest will then be unavailable upon completion of the Test quest.
2713b74622081f9fcd012599dc1e10c5f669a25c.text: 雖然這是一個主要任務，但實際上可以跳過。您可以直接前往湖畔郡城外的職業培訓師處。你唯一會錯過的就是經驗獎勵。完成測試任務後，該任務將無法使用。

f2e52b3980fa30f36a348ec20c9c3a21e4de468f.source: This is marked as a Primary Quest but is not required to leave pre-Searing.
f2e52b3980fa30f36a348ec20c9c3a21e4de468f.text: 這被標記為主要 任務，但不需要離開預 崩壞。

f1c75de9739d3fee946ec201d4b92d899be20c38.source: To start the mission, Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Into Chahbek Village or Take the Shortcut (Skip Tutorial). However, they can be ferried into the mission by another character, and will receive full credit for mission completion.
f1c75de9739d3fee946ec201d4b92d899be20c38.text: 要開始任務，黑暗逆襲 角色必須接受進入 Chahbek 村或走捷徑（跳過教學）的獎勵。然而，他們可以由另一個角色運送到任務中，並會因任務完成而獲得全額積分。

bbd8d44dba94ce4db85d6c1d51b63ef61f3dc039.source: Characters from other campaigns should talk to Historian Laharo, in the southeast corner of Churrhir Fields.
bbd8d44dba94ce4db85d6c1d51b63ef61f3dc039.text: 其他戰役中的角色應該與丘裡爾平原東南角的歷史學家拉哈羅交談。

e6c36df5f45d85c842568d66a7b0b7258c242598.source: Koss must be present in the party.
e6c36df5f45d85c842568d66a7b0b7258c242598.text: 寇斯 必須出現在聚會中。

484f0f419c0b77a74232e4d4168c1999510fc0c1.source: Destroy the corsairs occupying the village.

af846ef0548fa6a414fb06fe5e40186f6336a6ff.source: Sink the corsair ship on the north side of the village.
af846ef0548fa6a414fb06fe5e40186f6336a6ff.text: 擊沉村莊北側的海盜船。

f9fafadfbadf39408358b7900d6566c228afb496.source: Sink the corsair ship on the south side of the village.
f9fafadfbadf39408358b7900d6566c228afb496.text: 擊沉村莊南側的海盜船。

2fdd17323e8c076e374d1c36b1e35f8051788fce.source: *BONUS* Keep as many Sunspear Recruits alive as possible.
2fdd17323e8c076e374d1c36b1e35f8051788fce.text: *獎勵* 盡可能保住陽矛新兵的生命。

629afc9d919e33d72cb20a04667333419140fb6d.source: Bring condition removal skills, since nearly all foes inflict some condition.
629afc9d919e33d72cb20a04667333419140fb6d.text: 帶上條件消除技能，因為幾乎所有敵人都會造成一些條件。

fdc8544015402e1172ff6c5ff56d5668a20cb126.source: In normal mode, non-boss foes do not use any skills. In hard mode, all foes only use one skill, so you can easily disable them. This makes Wastrel's Demise and Worry effective in both modes.
fdc8544015402e1172ff6c5ff56d5668a20cb126.text: 在普通模式下，非boss敵人不會使用任何技能。在困難模式下，所有敵人僅使用一種技能，因此您可以輕鬆停用它們。這使得 瓦斯崔之死 和 Worry 在兩種模式下都有效。

32060c0dca575d147445b244ce37c869f274ab8e.source: None of the foes carry hex spells or hex removal skills.
32060c0dca575d147445b244ce37c869f274ab8e.text: 沒有一個敵人攜帶妖術或妖術去除技能。

475ef7d07ef04692223081fbf6e95760c5761397.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 0.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
475ef7d07ef04692223081fbf6e95760c5761397.text: 對此領域的完整探索將為 Elonian 版圖 主打歌帶來 0.2% 的成果。

970f8773268be4e0f8376e3040edceea97b4ad5d.source: The boss (Midshipman Bennis) has Natural Resistance, unlike most in Elona. Consider bringing along Wastrel's Worry for damage as often as you can afford to cast it, or Lightning Surge, for an almost-instant knockdown.
970f8773268be4e0f8376e3040edceea97b4ad5d.text: 與伊洛娜中的大多數人不同，老闆（海軍見習官班尼斯）具有自然抵抗力。考慮盡可能頻繁地使用 瓦思崔的憂慮 來造成傷害，或使用 閃電震盪 幾乎立即擊倒。

a2ecb77a80fcf402b5f082cf77f9c25037108c5d.source: It is possible for a new paragon to acquire Harrier's Toss from the boss (instead of waiting to reach the skill trainer that has the skill for unlocking) if they visit their guild hall first and buy a Signet of Capture.
a2ecb77a80fcf402b5f082cf77f9c25037108c5d.text: 如果新的典範先參觀他們的公會大廳併購買捕捉紋章，則有可能從老闆那裡獲得獵捕者投擲（而不是等待擁有解鎖技能的技能訓練師）。

e32163b23f2b9a3eda8ab591c419287477e3c35c.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Churrhir Fields.
e32163b23f2b9a3eda8ab591c419287477e3c35c.text: 完成此任務後，你的隊伍將被傳送到丘裡爾平原。

d1428dc8d602025e3e633ccc7910359f3d51ab8c.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #11 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
d1428dc8d602025e3e633ccc7910359f3d51ab8c.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#11 頁。

cdd6d47dfed6c42206ab43fc5e152955a664d20c.source: Locate the laboratory of Oola, the Asuran master golemancer.
cdd6d47dfed6c42206ab43fc5e152955a664d20c.text: 找到阿蘇拉傀儡師大師烏拉的實驗室。

668af063cc8cf8ea0a5432d0abc9765bf5c601f5.source: Find Oola's former assistant, Blimm, in Rata Sum.
668af063cc8cf8ea0a5432d0abc9765bf5c601f5.text: 在 洛達頂點 中找出 Oola 的前助手 布林姆。

ac45c7ebee60d1fcb0f8fc43a8df7b7ec972c4dd.text: 在 Magus Stones 中認識 布林姆。

c52f94c9baa0cfa0f21bdbe0dddb24831565bb20.source: Travel with Blimm to the secret entrance to Oola's Lab in Magus Stones.
c52f94c9baa0cfa0f21bdbe0dddb24831565bb20.text: 與 布林姆 一起前往位於魔法石的 Oola 實驗室的秘密入口。

a774f22a07ce84cfea016167a34b2514f767750c.source: Defeat the timberland guardian and pick a vine seed from its remains to open the bridge to Oola's Lab.
a774f22a07ce84cfea016167a34b2514f767750c.text: 擊敗林地守護者並從其遺骸中採摘一顆藤蔓種子，以開啟通往烏拉實驗室的橋梁。

0bf563fba18e2286a68e7b8407ab002b966a2d08.source: Speak to Blimm about the secret entrance to Oola's Lab.
0bf563fba18e2286a68e7b8407ab002b966a2d08.text: 與 布林姆 討論 Oola 實驗室的秘密入口。

124a11c9932085a5c54dce8497a8e439c0d23a97.source: Start off by talking to Blimm in Rata Sum to update the quest. Meet him in Magus Stones (right outside Rata Sum) with the party you will need for The Elusive Golemancer (follows on). Fight your way through Magus Stones taking care about patrols of Wind Riders. Wind Riders move quickly and aggroing several mobs at once can easily result in healers being overwhelmed. The actual Timberland Guardian is very weak since it's on its own.
124a11c9932085a5c54dce8497a8e439c0d23a97.text: 首先與 洛達頂點 中的 布林姆 交談以更新任務。在 Magus Stones（就在 洛達頂點 外面）與他會面，並與您參加 烏拉的實驗室 所需的隊伍（隨後）會面。在魔法石中殺出一條血路，同時照顧風騎者的巡邏隊。駕馭風者移動速度很快，同時攻擊多個小怪很容易導致治療者被壓垮。實際的 Timberland 守護者 非常弱，因為它是獨立的。

473d6cabd026eed0a1451e75c05cfa28f945542e.source: Oola didn't fire me. I quit. She moved my desk into the cellar and stopped paying me. After a couple of months, I left. I think she took my staff, too...that's why I left. I loved that staff. Someday I'm going to burn her lab down if I don't get it back. Oh yes! Well anyway, you'll find Oola's lab below all the traps. Good luck disarming them. If I had my staff I'd help you. When you're ready to enter, speak to me and I'll use this vine seed to open the path to Oola's Lab.
473d6cabd026eed0a1451e75c05cfa28f945542e.text: 烏拉沒有解僱我。我不幹了。她把我的桌子搬進了地窖，並停止付錢給我。幾個月後，我離開了。我想她也帶走了我的手杖……這就是我離開的原因。我喜歡那個工作人員。如果我不把她的實驗室拿回來，有一天我就會燒毀她的實驗室。哦是的！無論如何，你會在所有陷阱下面找到烏拉的實驗室。祝你好運，解除他們的武裝。如果我有我的員工，我會幫助你。當你準備好進入時，跟我說話，我會用這顆藤蔓種子開啟通往烏拉實驗室的道路。

219c9778aff3f402ae154191118e9bd8e641a5f1.source: If someone in your party has the quest The Elusive Golemancer, he can teleport you across Magus Stones leading directly to Timberland Guardian by talking to Blimm a short distance west from the entrance of Rata Sum.
219c9778aff3f402ae154191118e9bd8e641a5f1.text: 如果你的隊伍中有人有任務 烏拉的實驗室，他可以透過與 洛達頂點 入口以西不遠的 布林姆 交談，將你傳送到 Magus Stones，直接到達 Timberland 守護者。

af6c468f8a2bfae493dbba3bb1c3b5e727c96d25.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Talon Silverwing.
af6c468f8a2bfae493dbba3bb1c3b5e727c96d25.text: 搜尋 桑泉谷 尋找利爪銀翼。

1f2c41d9e167b2b89df504c73466919d22020451.source: Talon is in the northwest of the vale.
1f2c41d9e167b2b89df504c73466919d22020451.text: 泰隆位於山谷的西北部。

268600d32e204eb6fb30d3d2b756c78d7c77b7bb.source: Go southwest along the road to find the skale. Clear the river of skale.
268600d32e204eb6fb30d3d2b756c78d7c77b7bb.text: 沿著路向西南走可以找到skale。清理斯卡萊河。

200b82d3e963d1612a9612702dd6283346f632f9.source: Return to Van the Warrior for your reward.
200b82d3e963d1612a9612702dd6283346f632f9.text: 影返 至 戰士凡 以獲得獎勵。

213a464d63d36c4d1a466516ac743f0cbb260821.source: Follow your compass marker and kill the three skale in the area. Then return back to Van the Warrior.
213a464d63d36c4d1a466516ac743f0cbb260821.text: 跟著你的指南針標記並殺死該地區的三個骷髏。然後返回到 戰士凡。

74f0d29a19493b9c18416578a77ec63fa5c00d18.source: Seek Renk in Riven Earth and recruit him for the project.
74f0d29a19493b9c18416578a77ec63fa5c00d18.text: 在 撕裂大地 中尋找 Renk 並招募他參與此專案。

bb9d4dc651f97e9b349ccabe245ff93dd3f01ab6.source: Meet Renk at his laboratory in Alcazia Tangle once you've recruited Gadd and Oola.
bb9d4dc651f97e9b349ccabe245ff93dd3f01ab6.text: 一旦你招募了加德和烏拉，就可以在倫克位於阿爾卡齊亞坦格爾的實驗室與他會面。

31f12ed215916f78cbee6c60c6c6b78226e74a58.source: Invoke the inscription stone in Sparkfly Swamp to unlock the path to the Bloodstone.
31f12ed215916f78cbee6c60c6c6b78226e74a58.text: 呼叫火星蠅沼澤中的銘文石來解鎖通往血石的路徑。

668bf1b78c2d85dce478cfc50550b36a0cf12968.source: Help Gadd and Livia reach the Bloodstone in the depths below.
668bf1b78c2d85dce478cfc50550b36a0cf12968.text: 幫助 Gadd 和 莉薇亞 到達下方深處的 血石。

2f4de38b5bd1fa8068d379257ec8612337ea894c.source: Defeat Inscribed Sentries and decipher their inscriptions to open passageways.
2f4de38b5bd1fa8068d379257ec8612337ea894c.text: 擊敗銘文哨兵並破譯他們的銘文以開啟通道。

aa00ce171ea0b6035bd1eb7ed8e8d194ea43c0d0.source: Destroy the Inscribed Guardian protecting the Bloodstone.
aa00ce171ea0b6035bd1eb7ed8e8d194ea43c0d0.text: 摧毀保護 血石 的銘刻 守護者。

de7b18e02ec472c881e55d6e127952f6664510d2.text: 莉薇亞 加入您的隊伍。

c8a3cd2ed833eb2d7a1225213ecf94501a0f4826.source: During the quest, all creatures will be under the effect of the Aura of the Bloodstone: all nearby creatures (including spirits) will be healed each time any other creature dies (by 20 on the first level and 20 more on each successive level). Proceed slowly; there are numerous popups along the way. Most enemies throughout the mission are in relatively small groups and thus are not very dangerous. However, there is a major exception to this in the form of the several, large pop-up groups of Incubi throughout Levels 1 and 2 which can easily remove protective Enchantments while the many Stormcloud Incubus will use their Mind Shock to Knockdown and spike down players and heroes to death.
c8a3cd2ed833eb2d7a1225213ecf94501a0f4826.text: 在任務期間，所有生物都將受到 血石 光環的影響：每次任何其他生物死亡時，所有附近的生物（包括靈魂）都將得到治療（第一級透過 20 治療，每個後續等級則透過 20 治療）。慢慢地進行；一路上有很多彈出視窗。整個任務中的大多數敵人都是相對較小的群體，因此不是很危險。然而，在 型態 中，有一個重大例外，即在 1 和 2 關卡中的幾個大型彈出式夢魘組，它們可以輕鬆移除保護性結界，而許多 Stormcloud Incubus 將使用其 心靈震暴 至 擊倒 並將玩家和英雄秒殺。

7f7bfae07a3724658cc0b61fa13c4e69798f39cd.source: Level 1: Walk down into the bigger area first. Gadd will then comment about an inscribed creature to the south-east. Walk to the east first, then, when he says so, to the south. Finish off the Inscribed Sentry and wait for the quest log to update (indicating that Livia has extracted its essence). Then, head north to the portal; wait for Gadd to open it.
7f7bfae07a3724658cc0b61fa13c4e69798f39cd.text: 1 關卡：先走進更大的區域。然後加德將對東南部的一個銘文生物發表評論。先向東走，然後聽他說，再向南走。完成銘刻哨兵並等待任務日誌更新（表明莉薇亞已提取其本質）。然後，向北前往傳送門；等待加德開啟它。

2eda7698c4a8302f56ec77c358dac9a594234e42.source: There are several pop-up groups along the suggested path: on the way east from the starting point there are 3 small pop-up groups of 3 Arachnids each, and on the later, southern path there are 2 large pop-up groups of Incubi, the first at the bottom of the first stairs and then a second one at the bottom of the stairs just to the west/right of the first stairs.
2eda7698c4a8302f56ec77c358dac9a594234e42.text: 沿著建議的路徑有幾個彈出組：在從起點向東的路上，每個都有 3 小型彈出組的 3 蜘蛛，而在後來的南邊路徑上，有 2 大型彈出組的夢魘，第一個在第一個樓梯的底部，然後第二個在樓梯底部，就在第一個樓梯的西/右。

59d6e03b13928f5415ccf4efc6c856959d987805.source: The Incubi pop-up groups on this level are composed entirely of the dangerous Mind Shock-using Stormclouds, making heavy protection and anti-spell shutdown essential for surviving.
59d6e03b13928f5415ccf4efc6c856959d987805.text: 此等級的 Incubi 彈出群組完全由危險的使用 心靈震暴 的 Stormcloud 組成，因此重度防護和反法術關閉對於生存至關重要。

e30ae8af755f4e3df0c5c12f4d82b8cca618a691.source: The second pop-up of Incubi can be avoided by keeping to the left, though this will often force a fight with a smaller, non-pop-up group of Incubi that patrols in the area.
e30ae8af755f4e3df0c5c12f4d82b8cca618a691.text: 透過保持向左行駛可以避免第二次彈出的夢魘，儘管這通常會迫使與在該地區巡邏的較小的、非彈出的夢魘群體發生戰鬥。

7430c240cb91bcad309ab7c0aa53722be12164d0.source: Eliminate all of the corsairs attacking the village, including those on the boats on the right and left sides of the map. You are aided in your efforts by the presence of a level 20 Kormir and a handful of Sunspear recruits.
7430c240cb91bcad309ab7c0aa53722be12164d0.text: 消滅所有攻擊村莊的海盜，包括地圖左右兩側船上的海盜。等級 20 Kormir 和少數陽矛新兵的存在會為你的努力提供幫助。

cc2c8b4058d8c0fcff0222fe243a4aee5e6ac993.source: After killing the corsairs near the village's entrance, you have a choice: follow Kormir's advice and sink the two vessels using Istani Fire Oil fired from the catapults or kill the ship-based corsairs using ranged attacks. If you choose the first method, make your way to the fire oil and carry it to one of the catapults: click once to load the weapon and click again to fire it. Each ship you sink will provide a morale boost. Kill the boss next and then clear out the remainder of the corsairs.
cc2c8b4058d8c0fcff0222fe243a4aee5e6ac993.text: 殺死村莊入口附近的海盜後，你有一個選擇：聽從科米爾的建議，使用彈射器發射的伊斯坦尼火油擊沉兩艘船，或者使用遠端攻擊殺死船上的海盜。如果您選擇第一種方法，請前往火油處並將其帶到其中一個彈射器：單擊一次以裝載武器，然後再次單擊以發射它。你擊沉的每艘船都會鼓舞士氣。接下來殺死老闆，然後清除剩餘的海盜。

7dd62a04d35f109075d96ba5cc6cdf7c5aa3a31e.source: You can speed things up by flagging koss and any henchmen to kill corsairs while you sink the ships.
7dd62a04d35f109075d96ba5cc6cdf7c5aa3a31e.text: 你可以透過標記科斯和任何追隨者來殺死海盜，同時擊沉船隻，從而加快速度。

3b557b61b1f8ba6c02c4252c3cff60f1abd2ece5.source: The recruits sometimes are slow to engage mobs. If this happens, step closer to the enemy so that foes are within aggro range of the sunspears.
3b557b61b1f8ba6c02c4252c3cff60f1abd2ece5.text: 新兵有時會很慢地與暴徒交戰。如果發生這種情況，請靠近敵人，使敵人處於陽矛的仇恨範圍內。

2e196601917c8832bebd4b56ae4ccacc3d5de9a5.source: Keep as many of the Sunspear recruits alive as possible. If you confront one group at a time, there is almost no risk to losing any to the corsairs, especially if you sink the ships early.
2e196601917c8832bebd4b56ae4ccacc3d5de9a5.text: 盡可能保住陽矛新兵的生命。如果你一次面對一組，那麼幾乎沒有失去任何一個海盜的風險，特別是如果你儘早擊沉船隻。

519bbd1a8e7ec2338707c6a603f782b400adc6ef.source: In hard mode, there are only two risky spots: attacking the boss (who can manage to kill one of the recruits) and confronting the 3-4 mobs of corsairs in the upper right. However, you can easily succeed with any balanced group that can deal some damage and heal the recruits as well as party members. When engaging groups, take out the Corsair Healers first and any of their spellcasters next. Take advantage of the morale boosts you get for sinking the ships and go after the boss before tackling the overlapping groups.
519bbd1a8e7ec2338707c6a603f782b400adc6ef.text: 在困難模式下，只有兩個危險點：攻擊老闆（他可以殺死一名新兵）和麵對右上角的 3-4 海盜小怪。然而，你可以輕鬆地在任何可以造成一定傷害並治癒新兵和黨員的平衡團隊中取得成功。當與團體交戰時，首先消滅 海盜 治療者，然後消滅他們的施法者。利用擊沉船隻所獲得計程車氣提升，在解決重疊的群體之前追擊 Boss。

99da5a5ce0aa0adc18a7d9a0b5e8e56f92dced3d.source: Talk to Mamp in Rata Sum regarding the G.O.L.E.M. project.
99da5a5ce0aa0adc18a7d9a0b5e8e56f92dced3d.text: 在 洛達頂點 中與 Mamp 討論 G.O.L.E.M.專案。

c4fbbefeb2b0e2e0adebeacaf2d1424f7dac9789.source: This is a 3 part quest that begins with finding Renk, recruiting both Gadd and Oola (each requiring two more quests), and meeting up again with Renk.
c4fbbefeb2b0e2e0adebeacaf2d1424f7dac9789.text: 這是一個 3 部分任務，首先找到倫克，招募加德和烏拉（每個任務還需要兩個任務），然後再次與倫克會面。

84db0e9458eb240d8ea9e8dc2edf21066cd521b8.source: Part 1: The quest begins after speaking with Plaxx in Vlox's Falls. Map travel to Rata Sum and either follow the quest marker east (map 1) or taking the alternative route with fewer foes (map 1a). You will find Renk by the base of the great waterfalls.
84db0e9458eb240d8ea9e8dc2edf21066cd521b8.text: 1 部分：任務在與 Vlox 瀑布的 Plaxx 交談後開始。地圖前往 洛達頂點，然後沿著任務標記向東（地圖 1）或選擇敵人較少的替代路線（地圖 1a）。您會在大瀑布的底部找到倫克。

c189dc1b7b45d2db4ca04d1e8d04f25cceec4e7a.source: Part 2: Next, you recruit both Gadd and Oola (in any order): Gadd requires completion of Finding Gadd and Finding the Bloodstone; Oola's recruitment requires Lab Space and The Elusive Golemancer.
c189dc1b7b45d2db4ca04d1e8d04f25cceec4e7a.text: 2 部分：接下來，您招募 Gadd 和 Oola（以任何順序）：Gadd 要求完成 尋找蓋德 和 尋找血石；Oola 的招募需要 工廠空間 和 烏拉的實驗室。

d99733ca9d701c4707c64da672c1cbb2c9a144f1.source: Part 3: Return to Rata Sum and exit into Magus Stones, follow quest map 2. Along the way, you will encounter 24 spiders (rangers, paragons, and monks); there are five groups, two of which are popups. You can directly zone into Alcazia Tangle or considering first killing the nearby group of Krait to obtain an additional Asura rank bonus.
d99733ca9d701c4707c64da672c1cbb2c9a144f1.text: 3 部分：影返 到 洛達頂點 並進入 Magus Stones，跟隨任務地圖 2。一路上，你會遇到 24 蜘蛛（遊俠、典範和僧侶）；有五個組，其中兩個是彈出視窗。您可以直接進入Alcazia Tangle或考慮先殺死附近的環蛇群組以獲得額外的阿蘇拉排名獎勵。

e841d9a7731b6ede4f27442f199399c143194844.source: From the portal in Alcazia Tangle, cross the bridge and head south to southeast. This area is populated with Dinosaurs, the first of which you'll meet is 3 dervish Ferothrax on a patrol. The second patrol group you'll encounter is a Raptor group with the assassin boss, Pywatt the Swift.
e841d9a7731b6ede4f27442f199399c143194844.text: 從阿爾卡齊亞坦格爾的傳送門過橋，向南向東南方向前進。該地區棲息著大量恐龍，您首先會遇到的是正在巡邏的 3 苦行僧 Ferothrax。您將遇到的第二個巡邏隊是 毒瑞克斯 小組，其中有刺客老闆 迅捷 派維特。

f07a6024fc7741735ded6b5db47bed5d4b3c09cc.source: From here, take the lower southern path. Hug the right stone wall and be wary of patrolling Raptors. After a short distance, turn right into a passage littered with Asuran corpses. Renk is here with a group of 4 Destroyers. Although your foes will also target Renk, you can safely ignore him because he will self-resurrect.
f07a6024fc7741735ded6b5db47bed5d4b3c09cc.text: 從這裡出發，走較低的南邊小路。擁抱右邊的石牆並提防巡邏的猛龍。走了一小段路後，右轉進入一條散落著阿修羅屍體的通道。 Renk 和一群 4 驅逐艦在這裡。雖然你的敵人也會瞄準倫克，但你可以放心地忽略他，因為他會自我復活。

d3c3c3c8bfdbe813f50a5b096083a2e2f5bc94c2.source: Alternatively, you can map to Tarnished Haven and follow the alternative route (map 2a) to Renk.
d3c3c3c8bfdbe813f50a5b096083a2e2f5bc94c2.text: 或者，您可以對應到 灰暗避難所，然後沿著替代路線（地圖 2a）前往 Renk。

751fb9cf4018ef2512a5bd1565c7154a15f8ca1b.source: Speak with Renk one last time, then travel to Rata Sum and speak to Mamp for your reward.
751fb9cf4018ef2512a5bd1565c7154a15f8ca1b.text: 最後一次與 Renk 交談，然後前往 洛達頂點 並與 Mamp 交談以獲得獎勵。

401f5a7c63e80c1530b5a12907bbf4c291d8618f.source: You can actually complete Finding the Bloodstone and The Elusive Golemancer before initiating A Little Help. However, the story is written with the intent that A Little Help is initiated first.
401f5a7c63e80c1530b5a12907bbf4c291d8618f.text: 實際上，您可以在啟動“一點幫助”之前完成 尋找血石 和 烏拉的實驗室。然而，寫這個故事的目的是先發起一點幫助。

3f9fd62208f2bad7221e0548c0bb6352b4bdcad1.source: Find the river skale queen and slay her.
3f9fd62208f2bad7221e0548c0bb6352b4bdcad1.text: 找到河流斯卡萊女王並殺死她。

2f7da1d9b934a8a58d41e66c360325045698cb8a.source: Return to Artemis the Ranger for your reward.
2f7da1d9b934a8a58d41e66c360325045698cb8a.text: 影返 至 遊俠阿緹蜜絲 以獲得獎勵。

48e04eb4499c2b81cfd21fc93b1927655e1dca72.source: Head south towards the river. The River Skale Queen should be on the other side of it. You can use the Control key (Ctrl) to see the name of any foes within the range of the radar. They will appear in red on your screen.
48e04eb4499c2b81cfd21fc93b1927655e1dca72.text: 向南朝河邊走去。 河鱗怪 女王應該在它的另一邊。您可以使用 Control 鍵 (Ctrl) 檢視雷達範圍內任何敵人的名稱。它們將在您的螢幕上顯示為紅色。

45bee3656de48748d25837cc0b68745a92c03b6b.source: Speak with Talon again when you are ready to begin the duel.
45bee3656de48748d25837cc0b68745a92c03b6b.text: 當你準備好開始決鬥時，再次與泰隆交談。

089b0e6eccbabbeb0ccf8f4f6c9a0cff5881ba46.text: 在戰鬥中擊敗利爪銀翼。

3cb58d839ffb4df9544e384a31358750e2f49412.source: See Talon Silverwing for your reward.
3cb58d839ffb4df9544e384a31358750e2f49412.text: 前往利爪銀翼領取獎勵。

8824d502699844f5660aabd510584a33909d43fe.source: Talon teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
8824d502699844f5660aabd510584a33909d43fe.text: 當你接受這個任務時，泰隆會教你以下技能：

af9df2798a1e7edbc39319a1d2261a3f57d56b22.source: After accepting this quest talk to Talon Silverwing once again to start the duel, he will attack you as soon as you talk to him again so be prepared.
af9df2798a1e7edbc39319a1d2261a3f57d56b22.text: 接受這個任務後，再次與銀翼鷹對話開始決鬥，一旦你再次與他對話，他就會攻擊你，所以要做好準備。

4a27a915d177bd29dcc132c2987bd3987abdb1a3.source: Right as he is about to die he turns friendly and you can turn in the quest.
4a27a915d177bd29dcc132c2987bd3987abdb1a3.text: 當他快要死時，他變得友好，你可以交任務。

2e3de924af3ef6e5de6b38f542a3e4f005e46e13.source: Talon Silverwing is very weak against earth damage, use this to your advantage if you need help.
2e3de924af3ef6e5de6b38f542a3e4f005e46e13.text: 利爪銀翼對抗地球傷害非常弱，如果你需要幫助，請利用這一點。

91566e34aaa594fdc76a2fa271b406426ced154f.source: Talon will not use any skills.
91566e34aaa594fdc76a2fa271b406426ced154f.text: 泰隆不會使用任何技能。

51d0cf37096f0e20c86f63a4b169c59135267486.source: All party members must have received the reward for Finding Gadd.
51d0cf37096f0e20c86f63a4b169c59135267486.text: 所有隊伍成員必須已收到 尋找蓋德 的獎勵。

70c3fae6ea3b4c4befd331e5394eb8305cec3f25.source: It is possible to enter the mission with just one person meeting the requirement, but anyone else will not receive any credit for mission completion.
70c3fae6ea3b4c4befd331e5394eb8305cec3f25.text: 只有一個人滿足要求即可進入任務，但其他人不會獲得任務完成的任何積分。

8f5b5a7a76f956244ee6c13fc6b4788cae2aa8c3.source: Level 3: Go west, eventually reaching a cavern, at the center of which is the Inscribed Guardian guarded by several Enchanted weapons. There will also be four Enchanted Scythes farther from the center; although these are initially friendly, they will turn hostile after you aggro the Guardian. Once it dies, the quest is completed (so you need not bother with the other foes, if you can kill it fast enough).
8f5b5a7a76f956244ee6c13fc6b4788cae2aa8c3.text: 3 關卡：往西走，最終到達一個洞穴，其中心是刻有 守護者 的銘文，由數件 附魔 武器守護著。距離中心較遠的地方還將有四把 附魔 Scythes；儘管它們最初是友好的，但在您攻擊 守護者 後它們會變得敵對。一旦它死了，任務就完成了（所以你不需要打擾其他敵人，如果你能足夠快地殺死它的話）。

5c6a8a98484b88f47e9a5d94cc255419d14c7c05.source: The only real danger here is that the Enchanted Scythes will attack groups that don't pull the Guardian from a distance in the back.
5c6a8a98484b88f47e9a5d94cc255419d14c7c05.text: 這裡唯一真正的危險是 附魔 鐮刀會攻擊那些不會從後面遠處拉動 守護者 的團體。

c4bbecfcfd3d299cc17e5497658fe6bf3faa447b.source: The many Enchanted Shields surrounding the Guardian will make it difficult to attack it initially due to Protector's Defense and by Body blocking the path to it. However, it is fairly easy to get them to drop the skill by walking around the boss to make them move.
c4bbecfcfd3d299cc17e5497658fe6bf3faa447b.text: 由於 保護者態勢 和身體阻擋了通往 守護者 的路徑，圍繞 守護者 的許多 附魔 護盾將使最初攻擊它變得困難。然而，繞著 Boss 走動讓他們移動，讓他們放棄技能是相當容易的。

f0c97483c2ea68ed2ce1095ff86ca70cafbe772c.source: Due to the heavy Enchantment Removal from the Incubi's Soulrending Shriek throughout most of the areas it is generally good to use something else for protection, such as Binding Rituals.
f0c97483c2ea68ed2ce1095ff86ca70cafbe772c.text: 由於 加持魔法 移除了大部分割槽域的夢魘裂魂尖叫，因此通常最好使用其他東西來保護，例如束縛儀式。

878358bca79d5db6d6f5d099350eb5b31a345435.source: The Necromancer Skelks will quickly spread Disease throughout groups, making party-wide Condition Removal, such as Extinguish, potentially useful.
878358bca79d5db6d6f5d099350eb5b31a345435.text: 死靈法師 骷髏會迅速在整個群體中傳播疾病，使得全隊範圍內的疾病消除（例如 熄滅）可能有用。

c68de18574ae9957ac8348aec20f57459520d206.source: The ability to either provide Blocking towards all party members or Blind to several enemies is useful for neutralizing the massive group of Skeletal Hounds on Level 2, which can otherwise be a danger.
c68de18574ae9957ac8348aec20f57459520d206.text: 對所有隊伍成員提供阻擋或對多個敵人進行致盲的能力對於消滅 2 層上的大量骷髏獵犬非常有用，否則可能會構成危險。

ab07c7ae0fa49431e7b3225a74ac9b41fdd88aa6.source: If you gained Death penalty on your way to this mission or accumulated too much DP while in this mission, you can simply resign to eliminate your death penalty before talking to the inscription stone again to restart the mission.
ab07c7ae0fa49431e7b3225a74ac9b41fdd88aa6.text: 如果你在執行此任務的過程中獲得了死亡懲罰，或者在此任務中積累了過多的DP，你可以簡單地辭職以消除死亡懲罰，然後再次與銘文石對話以重新開始任務。

5cc6109079cff8d95d312d9a85234ab95fd917d4.source: This mission takes place in a zone with an identical layout as the Bloodstone Caves in the Depths of Tyria; however, this area is considered to be Asura territory (Tarnished Coast), so Edification will grant its bonus.
5cc6109079cff8d95d312d9a85234ab95fd917d4.text: 任務發生在與 泰瑞亞深處 中的 血石洞 佈局相同的區域中；然而，該區域被認為是 阿蘇拉 領土 (灰暗沿岸)，因此 Edification 將給予其獎勵。

cc306c8b74049a0188141cc75571e1a17cb771f4.source: After defeating the Inscribed Sentries, wait for Livia to extract the inscriptions before proceeding; Gadd cannot open the gates until she has done so. You can check that she has managed this by ensuring that the quest log has updated. However, the dialogue will continue whether Livia has succeeded or not.
cc306c8b74049a0188141cc75571e1a17cb771f4.text: 擊敗銘文哨兵後，等待莉薇亞提取銘文後再繼續；在她開啟大門之前，加德無法開啟大門。您可以透過確保任務日誌已更新來檢查她是否已完成此操作。然而，無論 莉薇亞 是否成功，對話都會持續。

44437bb26e0e38b0bbc8c1a579beabec32e8f974.source: At the beginning of the 2nd level, Livia or Gadd can get stuck at the bottom of the stairs in the corner. As with any NPC allies, watch that they stay with the party to avoid backtracking later.
44437bb26e0e38b0bbc8c1a579beabec32e8f974.text: 在 2nd 關卡開始時，莉薇亞 或 Gadd 可能會卡在角落的樓梯底部。與任何 NPC 盟友一樣，注意他們留在隊伍中，以免日後反悔。

7abee26967e112496587f9b6ac1dad93468c4dc5.source: When repeating this quest, you can travel directly to the Inscription Stone outside Bloodstone Caves. (You could also visit the Scrying Pool first to obtain the quest, but this is not necessary.) Once you approach the site, the gate may open and if you zone in without clicking the Inscription Stone, Gadd and Livia will not join your party as you will be starting the dungeon instead.
7abee26967e112496587f9b6ac1dad93468c4dc5.text: 重複此任務時，您可以直接前往 血石洞 外的 鑄印 石頭。 （你也可以先訪問占卜池來獲得任務，但這不是必需的。）一旦你接近該地點，大門可能會開啟，如果你在沒有點選 鑄印 石頭的情況下進入區域，Gadd 和 莉薇亞 將不會加入你的隊伍，因為你將開始地下城。

0442cf3db61b2492a858781a801a1a80fe602f40.source: When repeating this quest, if you have already unlocked Livia, you will still receive the notification that you've unlocked her.
0442cf3db61b2492a858781a801a1a80fe602f40.text: 重複此任務時，如果您已經解鎖了 莉薇亞，您仍會收到已解鎖她的通知。

95ae92b46cf3e88434dbcc4353ca153655a6aecf.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #12 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
95ae92b46cf3e88434dbcc4353ca153655a6aecf.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#12 頁。

f97078db64d1cfd76a6e52d64c27e6e0c39a7d24.source: Similar to Curse of the Nornbear with Jora, if a Livia hero is in your party, you will have two Livias in your party instead of the Livia hero being renamed "Shining Blade Necromancer".
f97078db64d1cfd76a6e52d64c27e6e0c39a7d24.text: 與 諾恩熊的詛咒 和 喬拉 類似，如果您的隊伍中有 莉薇亞 英雄，您的隊伍中將有兩個莉維亞，而不是 莉薇亞 英雄被重新命名為“光刃公會 死靈法師”。

72937f95e4b3723bd2299891f4d068d1cba43615.source: Go southwest up the road until you find skale. Cross the river and find the missing girl Gwen.
72937f95e4b3723bd2299891f4d068d1cba43615.text: 沿著路向西南走，直到找到斯凱勒。過河找失蹤的女孩 關。

47c1731172b122f642e5bfb55015fe7ce294c7d8.source: Lead Gwen back to Ciglo the Monk. Gwen will not move as long as the skale are in the way.
47c1731172b122f642e5bfb55015fe7ce294c7d8.text: 將 關 引回 僧侶西格羅。只要地殼擋住了路，關 就不會移動。

3bedcf600c31712ba8d78290596797ca926c4676.source: Cross the river to the south of Ciglo the Monk and find Gwen. Once you find her, kill the three River Skale Tads that are in the river near her. Once you kill the skale, lead her back towards Ciglo and talk to him to receive your reward.
3bedcf600c31712ba8d78290596797ca926c4676.text: 過河到 僧侶西格羅 的南面，找出 關。找到她後，殺死她附近河裡的三個 河鱗怪 Tad。殺死斯凱爾後，將她帶回西格洛並與他交談以獲得獎勵。

c60d2afaefaac381c1877ddd178c0c4098525d65.source: Travel to the Sunspear encampment near Chahbek Village.
c60d2afaefaac381c1877ddd178c0c4098525d65.text: 前往查貝克村附近的烈陽之矛營地。

2c9ce3f09b99ff317e70289a88df4dae315cd27a.source: Speak to at least one expert .

5a067818405ab83bd810e9ee5f8d0c1ff046dfca.source: See First Spear Dehvad for your reward.
5a067818405ab83bd810e9ee5f8d0c1ff046dfca.text: 請參閱 First 矛 Dehvad 以獲得獎勵。

13a7ebb5b6cacbd4a1359d0cda7393557dbf9b05.source: Speak to at least one expert of your character's profession. They will teach you some skills. Return to First Spear Dehvad. He will teach you all the other skills the experts offer for your profession, so you do not have to speak to all of them.
13a7ebb5b6cacbd4a1359d0cda7393557dbf9b05.text: 與至少一位你的角色所在職業的專家交談。他們會教你一些技能。 影返 到第一個 矛 Dehvad。他會教您專家為您的職業提供的所有其他技能，因此您不必與所有專家交談。

1f41769a1cec844442ba90cc9bfca736a89fb05a.source: Accepting the reward as a Ranger teaches Pin Down, even though none of the expert rangers offer the skill.
1f41769a1cec844442ba90cc9bfca736a89fb05a.text: 身為 遊俠 接受獎勵會教導 射足，即使沒有專家護林員提供此技能。

c2af14b0e8699af2c14d3c14eb10ff3baea9b928.source: Look for Weng Gha in Panjiang Peninsula.
c2af14b0e8699af2c14d3c14eb10ff3baea9b928.text: 在 班讓半島 中尋找 Weng Gha。

aa242d2595c63d62f40c9dd6b3c6f5c30ce26a50.source: Travel southwest until you reach Tsumei Village. Enter, and exit to the south. Weng Gha is close by, westwards.
aa242d2595c63d62f40c9dd6b3c6f5c30ce26a50.text: 向西南行駛，直至到達 蘇梅村。進入，出站向南。 Weng Gha 就在附近，向西。

553f3063f65f7c3afef39304c8f2b93867de9d0c.source: Speak to Second Spear Binah to enter Kamadan.
553f3063f65f7c3afef39304c8f2b93867de9d0c.text: 與第二個 矛 Binah 交談以進入卡馬丹。

a2bd176796013a6ea5b550798261ee7d2f342fab.source: Hone your skills by reaching level 5.
a2bd176796013a6ea5b550798261ee7d2f342fab.text: 達到 5 級別，磨練您的技能。

5395ea76fb66786936a435610f1acdca0ce4d0aa.source: Complete quests or defeat enemies until you reach level 5. Talk to First Spear Dehvad for your reward.
5395ea76fb66786936a435610f1acdca0ce4d0aa.text: 完成任務或擊敗敵人，直到達到 5 等級。與 First 矛 Dehvad 交談以獲得獎勵。

7c262a63d7fcb39f417aa6206a559aaec7f54212.source: If you map travel to Kamadan or if you received the quest from First Spear Dehvad in Kamadan, your compass will have a starburst to talk to Binah in Kamadan, to go into Churrhir Fields and then talk to Binah again to go back into Kamadan. Your world map will also say to go back into Churrhir Fields.
7c262a63d7fcb39f417aa6206a559aaec7f54212.text: 如果你地圖旅行到卡馬丹，或者如果你收到來自卡馬丹的 First 矛 Dehvad 的任務，你的指南針將會有一個星爆，可以與卡馬丹的 Binah 交談，進入 Churrir Fields，然後再次與 Binah 交談以返回卡馬丹。你的世界地圖也會說要返回丘裡爾平原。

9d47537c41284cdad626d0f0cf4d3fcceeddce36.source: Go south to the river. Slay a skale so that Verata can make use of its corpse.
9d47537c41284cdad626d0f0cf4d3fcceeddce36.text: 向南走到河邊。殺死一隻骷髏，以便 芙瑞達 可以利用它的屍體。

23995815e4f2fe9f80fc71bf6201dfac34c8e07b.source: Return to Verata the Necromancer for your reward.
23995815e4f2fe9f80fc71bf6201dfac34c8e07b.text: 影返 至 死靈法師 芙瑞達 以獲得獎勵。

7b4f8b103df7ec1a55b6840831b5ad8ab29b6355.source: After you obtain the quest, Verata will start following you. Follow the road and kill one of the River Skale Tads. Wait for Verata to animate a Bone Horror and collect the reward.
7b4f8b103df7ec1a55b6840831b5ad8ab29b6355.text: 獲得任務後，芙瑞達將開始追蹤您。沿著路走，殺死一個 河鱗怪 Tad。等待 芙瑞達 製作骨頭恐怖動畫並領取獎勵。

31ce6431e84df7150a44ea38e382d0bc481c3222.source: Killing anything that can provide an exploitable corpse, not just a skale, will fulfil the quest requirements.
31ce6431e84df7150a44ea38e382d0bc481c3222.text: 殺死任何可以提供可利用屍體的東西，而不僅僅是骷髏，都可以滿足任務要求。

62139b4d156284a6e897f895c8505c680c9ece7a.source: Prevent the thieves from stealing crops from the field.
62139b4d156284a6e897f895c8505c680c9ece7a.text: 防止小偷竊田裡的農作物。

38aa4d1ac10fb4bc01d221b82736281a8ebf8973.source: See Weng Gha for your reward.
38aa4d1ac10fb4bc01d221b82736281a8ebf8973.text: 前往翁嘎 (Weng Gha) 領取獎勵。

a45b899861664cb694d077345b466ce6e63ee58a.source: Weng Gha teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
a45b899861664cb694d077345b466ce6e63ee58a.text: 當你接受這個任務時，Weng Gha 會教你以下技能：

eb2f01aed335e2e88f337f110a1925eab4f351f5.source: After you accept this quest, follow the path leading to Tsumei Village. When you near the marked spot on the mini-map 3 Crop Thieves dressed like the Crimson Skull appear. Kill them and then return to Weng Gha.
eb2f01aed335e2e88f337f110a1925eab4f351f5.text: 接受此任務後，沿著通往 蘇梅村 的路徑前進。當您靠近小地圖上的標記點 3 時，就會出現打扮成 紅顱 的作物盜賊。殺死他們然後返回翁加。

24aef2bdec2d3526843e676fe13c61cadd1bf581.source: This quest will sometimes register as completed before all the thieves have been defeated.
24aef2bdec2d3526843e676fe13c61cadd1bf581.text: 有時，在擊敗所有盜賊之前，此任務會被註冊為已完成。

857f1c0ccf1433bcec31b258fa1caefba2dc334a.source: Level 2: Walk to the south-east. Eventually you will come to a huge chamber guarded by Skeletal Hounds. When you enter the room, the nearby Skeletons will start off friendly. Pull the patroling sentry away from them and kill him; once he dies, all the skeletons (except the neutral ones right next to the walls) will disappear. Should you get too close, they will become hostile, but you should still be able to pull the sentry away. Again, wait for Livia to extract the essence, then proceed to the portal and wait for Gadd to open it.
857f1c0ccf1433bcec31b258fa1caefba2dc334a.text: 等級 2 : 向東南方向走。最終你會來到一個由骷髏獵犬守護的巨大房間。當你進入房間時，附近的骷髏會開始友善。 拉出 巡邏的哨兵遠離他們，殺了他；一旦他死了，所有的骷髏（除了牆邊的中立骷髏）都會消失。如果你離得太近，他們會變得充滿敵意，但你仍然應該能夠把哨兵拉開。再次，等待 莉薇亞 提取精華，然後前往傳送門並等待加德開啟它。

8903767182648397a28a3d369ef3cc5c8e034345.source: There are 3 mixed pop-up groups of Incubi throughout the level. The first one is after the initial groups of Skelk, near the bottom of an incline after a stone portal. The second one is on the path to the left of the central stone pillar, which can be avoided by keeping to the right and fighting the 2 Skelk there. The third one is just after the Resurrection Shrine at the top of the second incline, before the large group of Skeletal Hounds.
8903767182648397a28a3d369ef3cc5c8e034345.text: 整個關卡中有 3 混合彈出式 Incubi 群組。第一個是在最初的斯凱爾克群體之後，靠近石頭傳送門後的斜坡底部。第二個位於中央石柱左側的道路上，可以透過保持右側並在那裡與 2 Skelk 戰鬥來避免。第三處就在第二個斜坡頂部的 復活祭壇 之後，在一大群骷髏獵犬之前。

c51b556aefc968b847e2e9f2d842f8332c97cf44.source: All party members must have received the reward for Lab Space.
c51b556aefc968b847e2e9f2d842f8332c97cf44.text: 所有隊伍成員必須已收到 工廠空間 的獎勵。

41c99c1da90aecf784ff818d7ca094b0b41bd300.source: Find Oola's workshop in the depths below and convince her to help with Mamp's project.
41c99c1da90aecf784ff818d7ca094b0b41bd300.text: 在下面的深處找到 Oola 的工作室並說服她幫助 Mamp 的專案。

d900aae8d2eeff3c8122e7c712ce20707fc50446.source: Find a golem to circumvent the security system.
d900aae8d2eeff3c8122e7c712ce20707fc50446.text: 找到一個傀儡來繞過安全系統。

ef611d467e3a387d3dee5de89621603d5cf52ffe.source: Discover a way to access the next laboratory level.
ef611d467e3a387d3dee5de89621603d5cf52ffe.text: 探索進入下一個實驗室等級的方法。

51fd1a857a6bc7bff6ec761d3fc5eb1217885fa8.source: Search the room for a passage leading further into the laboratory.
51fd1a857a6bc7bff6ec761d3fc5eb1217885fa8.text: 在房間裡搜尋一條通往實驗室的通道。

78d1b4458451b5be54be38c84274202f403f7dff.text: 在熾熱的挑戰中生存下來。

025db486895b648b7ec9b93b719966d9def43557.source: You begin this mission in a room filled with worker Sentry Golems. None of them are hostile at this point. There are two Worker Golems at the entrance followed by a line of 3 more workers. Click on the one to the far left of the first line and tell it to, "Go pull that lever." It will slowly walk to the other end of the cavern to flip the switch. At the same time, the sentries will become hostile and will attack both the party and the Worker Golem; if the worker dies, go back and select another and repeat. However, simply taking the sentries one or two at a time should be sufficient even in Hard mode.
025db486895b648b7ec9b93b719966d9def43557.text: 你在一個充滿工人哨兵傀儡的房間裡開始這個任務。此時他們都沒有敵意。入口處有兩個工人傀儡，後面跟著一排 3 工人。點選第一行最左側的一個並告訴它“拉動那個控制桿”。它會慢慢走到洞穴的另一端開啟開關。同時，哨兵會變得敵對，並會攻擊隊伍和工人傀儡；如果該工人死亡，請返回並選擇另一個工人並重複。然而，即使在 困難模式 中，一次簡單地控制一兩個哨兵就足夠了。

fa0cc9e2afde22372f45c5faaeb84173025a57a2.source: Occasionally, Worker Golem will fail to pull the lever; it will say "Invalid Command" when spoken to. (This seems to happen if you talk to it after activation but before it reaches the lever.) Should this happen, restart by typing the /resign emote; this returns you to Blimm (outside the dungeon) and allows you to start over without having to travel from Rata Sum.
fa0cc9e2afde22372f45c5faaeb84173025a57a2.text: 有時，工人傀儡無法拉動控制桿；當與它對話時，它會說「無效的 命令」。 （如果您在啟動後但在它到達控制桿之前與它交談，似乎會發生這種情況。）如果發生這種情況，請透過輸入 /resign 表情重新啟動；這將使您返回到 布林姆（地牢外）並允許您重新開始，而無需從 洛達頂點 出發。

7f8ef89c89943d7a94e96caca2c53f417038c5ac.source: When you enter the second room, a mysterious voice warns against "pulling the lever" (at the far corner of the room). There is no choice, however, since the lever unlocks the exit to Level 2. It also activates the Sentry Golems. Make your way to the new exit, dispatching Sentry Golems as you go. (Again, only aggro as many as you can handle.)
7f8ef89c89943d7a94e96caca2c53f417038c5ac.text: 當您進入第二個房間時，一個神秘的聲音警告不要「拉動控制桿」（在房間的最遠角落）。然而，別無選擇，因為控制桿解鎖了 2 層的出口。它還會啟用哨兵傀儡。前往新出口，一路上派遣哨兵傀儡。 （再次強調，只能恨盡可能多的人。）

02e7e3081405ceda61c81017fc1f28362e45d10c.source: There are two mystical keyholders: one near you when you enter and the other around the corner. Use the first device to receive a Crystalline Key. The sentries are hostile and active when you hold this bundle; dropping it deactivates them. These golems respawn indefinitely until the bundle is placed in the second mystical keyholder, at which point they deactivate completely.
02e7e3081405ceda61c81017fc1f28362e45d10c.text: 有兩個神秘的鑰匙圈：一個在您進入時就在您附近，另一個則在轉角處。使用第一臺裝置接收 Crystalline 鑰匙。當你拿著這個包裹時，哨兵會表現出敵意和活躍；放下它會使它們失效。這些傀儡會無限期地重生，直到捆綁包被放置在第二個神秘鑰匙圈中，此時它們會完全停用。

c4598793adb2d08b008d4df55b238a4532cb3577.source: One way of dealing with this is to flag all heroes and henchmen to the far keyholder and having a well-armored character carry the key. If things get hairy, drop the key, get healed, and repeat. This method avoids letting the sentries body block party members when they deactivate; if they are blocked, the only way to free them is to reach the next level.
c4598793adb2d08b008d4df55b238a4532cb3577.text: 解決這個問題的一種方法是將所有英雄和追隨者標記為遠處的鑰匙持有者，並讓一個全副武裝的角色攜帶鑰匙。如果事情變得棘手，放下鑰匙，治癒，然後重複。此方法可以避免讓哨兵身體在隊伍成員停用時對其進行阻擋；如果它們被阻止，釋放它們的唯一方法就是到達下一個級別。

d6eb54c16499f65b096a5e61965a3c7a4d2ebb05.source: When working with heroes and henchmen, the player can be surrounded by Golems and be unable to move or fight after picking up the crystal. If this happens, try to have your heroes kill the golem or golems trapping you, and then escape quickly because new golems will respawn. If this strategy fails, the only solution is to restart the quest. Another strategy is to use the key while flagging your heroes farther North towards the other keystone and lead all the golems together to body block you in a line so you can run around them after you drop the stone. Then move your heroes to body block the golems while you pick up the key and run it to the other keystone. No deaths or well armored units required. Just ensure your body block of the golems doesn't put them in the archway or you will have to pick it up and pull them back and may die from the attempt. (Again, typing /resign will result in being taken to Blimm in Magus Stones, giving you the chance to start again.)
d6eb54c16499f65b096a5e61965a3c7a4d2ebb05.text: 當與英雄和追隨者合作時，玩家可能會被傀儡包圍，並且在拾取水晶後無法移動或戰鬥。如果發生這種情況，請嘗試讓你的英雄殺死困住你的魔像，然後迅速逃脫，因為新的魔像會重生。如果這個策略失敗了，唯一的解決方法就是重新開始任務。另一個策略是使用鑰匙，同時標記你的英雄向北前往另一個基石，並帶領所有傀儡一起用身體擋住你，這樣你就可以在扔下石頭後繞著他們跑。然後移動你的英雄以身體阻擋傀儡，同時你拿起鑰匙並將其執行到另一個梯形石上。不需要死亡或裝備精良的部隊。只要確保你的傀儡身體塊不會將它們放入拱門中，否則你將不得不撿起它並將它們拉回來，並且可能會因嘗試而死亡。 （再次，輸入 /resign 將導致進入 Magus Stones 中的 布林姆，讓您有機會重新開始。）

c5ea74eea7ef63d50df6b4bec2aab08eebe2e1f5.source: The next challenge is a room filled with Fire Darts, Sentry Golems, and another Worker Golem. Some of the Sentry Golems are already hostile, and others will become hostile as you approach them. The mysterious voice will taunt you again. The sole Worker Golem has a fire protection aura that will protect your party against the Fire Darts. The Worker Golem will slowly walk back and forth from your end of the room to the other. The intent is that your entire party stay in its shielded area, which protects against damage and burning. This becomes difficult to do as you encounter Sentry Golems in your path. Body blocking can halt the worker's progression temporarily, giving you time to fight.
c5ea74eea7ef63d50df6b4bec2aab08eebe2e1f5.text: 下一個挑戰是一個充滿火鏢、哨兵傀儡和另一個工人傀儡的房間。一些哨兵傀儡已經具有敵意，而另一些則在您接近它們時變得敵對。神秘的聲音會再次嘲笑你。唯一的工人傀儡具有防火光環，可以保護您的隊伍免受火鏢的傷害。工人傀儡會慢慢地從房間的一端走到另一端。目的是讓你的整個隊伍留在其遮蔽區域，以防止損壞和燃燒。當你在路上遇到哨兵傀儡時，這變得很難做到。身體阻擋可以暫時阻止工人的前進，讓你有時間戰鬥。

082b2ca3378ea8f751d551238fbee02f8705781d.source: The golem stops a few steps short of safety so your party will have to run a few steps under dart attacks. It is not possible to disable the Fire Dart machines. If part of your party is left behind, the Worker Golem will be back.
082b2ca3378ea8f751d551238fbee02f8705781d.text: 魔像會在距離安全區幾步之遙處停下來，因此你的隊伍將不得不在飛鏢攻擊下跑幾步。無法停用 Fire Dart 機器。如果你的隊伍中有一部分人被拋在後面，工人傀儡就會回來。

cb1c0f81015fd2da491db31ae763b057d6b3c195.source: The Worker Golem can sometimes get stuck and stop moving. When this happens, the Golem Fire Shield will lose sync with the Worker Golem and continue to progress forward. If this happens, follow the shield, not the Golem, and advance like normal. Sometimes the Golem continues and the shield stops; stay with the shield, not the Golem.
cb1c0f81015fd2da491db31ae763b057d6b3c195.text: 工人傀儡有時會被卡住並停止移動。當這種情況發生時，火傀儡 盾 將與工人傀儡失去同步並繼續前進。如果發生這種情況，請跟隨盾牌，而不是傀儡，然後像平常一樣前進。有時傀儡會繼續而護盾會停止；留在盾牌旁，而不是魔像身邊。

bcce3a190d94f828e1cb6fb20a3f8d0fd5ec1189.source: Up some stairs will be a large room with many golem bodies, Sentry Golems, and three Worker Golems. Some are hostile, some will become hostile when you approach them. The mysterious voice will, again, encourage you to give up. The objective here is to activate the Worker Golems ("follow mode engaged") and lead them to three touchplates near the door to the next room. They should "engage stationary mode" once on top of the touchplates. If not, activating the golem again should do so. One Worker Golem is already placed for you.
bcce3a190d94f828e1cb6fb20a3f8d0fd5ec1189.text: 爬上一些樓梯，會出現一個大房間，裡面有許多傀儡屍體、哨兵傀儡和三個工人傀儡。有些是敵對的，有些是當你接近他們時就會變得敵對。神秘的聲音會再次鼓勵你放棄。這裡的目標是啟動工人傀儡（「啟用跟隨模式」）並將它們引導到下一個房間門附近的三個觸控板。一旦到達觸控板頂部，它們就應該「進入靜止模式」。如果沒有，再次啟動傀儡應該可以。已經為您放置了一個工人傀儡。

4659bd332913aa5bea97f6dae07f2bf69275c0e5.source: In the last room of level 2 will be an Indestructible Golem, a bundle item (Flux Matrix) and an interactive Unstable Magical Energy Storage. The golem will not take damage from any normal means; but spells that cause life stealing and some forms of health degeneration work. This is not advised as the golem has a large amount of health.
4659bd332913aa5bea97f6dae07f2bf69275c0e5.text: 2 關卡的最後一個房間將有一個堅不可摧的傀儡、一個捆綁包物品（流量 矩陣）和一個互動式不穩定魔法 能量儲存。傀儡不會受到任何正常方式的傷害；但導致生命竊取和某些形式的健康退化的法術卻起作用。不建議這樣做，因為傀儡有大量生命值。

40e812e03c753068762cda82acc14e2dcb5e8dce.source: Run past the Indestructible Golem (it's usually best to circle around to the left) and pick up the Flux Matrix. Click on the Unstable Magical Energy Source to charge the bundle item. Drop it beside the Indestructible Golem to cause 1337 damage. Repeat the procedure and refill the bundle item at the Unstable Magical Energy Source after each drop. It will take 2 drops to destroy the golem.
40e812e03c753068762cda82acc14e2dcb5e8dce.text: 跑過 經過堅不可摧的布偶（通常最好繞到左邊）並拿起 流量 矩陣。點選 Unstable Magical 能量 Source 為捆綁包專案充電。將其扔到堅不可摧的傀儡旁邊會造成 1337 傷害。重複此過程，並在每次掉落後在不穩定的魔法 能量 來源處重新填充捆綁物品。需要 2 滴才能摧毀傀儡。

c68e3dd9513f01da63b03d97ba4b524fb979d731.source: The final level is filled with Sentry Golems and Golem Sentries. Only the Golem Sentries can become hostile. Oola is at the end of the room. As you approach her, a cinematic will trigger. You do not actually need to fight anything in this room as running to Oola will end the quest.
c68e3dd9513f01da63b03d97ba4b524fb979d731.text: 最終關卡充滿了哨兵傀儡和傀儡哨兵。只有傀儡哨兵可以變得敵對。烏拉在房間的盡頭。當你接近她時，就會觸發電影。實際上你不需要在這個房間裡與任何東西戰鬥，因為跑到烏拉就會結束任務。

6fa5c78540a2b1c0973cde346909ab109239ed98.source: Though there are no Hexes inside of the mission itself, there are quite a few Wind Riders on the path there and those carry quite a few. The prevention of most healing through Shame and shutdown of Adrenaline-reliant builds through Soothing Images are of especially heavy concern.
6fa5c78540a2b1c0973cde346909ab109239ed98.text: 雖然任務本身沒有妖術，但那裡的道路上有不少乘風者，而且它們攜帶著不少。透過 羞愧 阻止大多數修復以及透過 意念平靜 關閉依賴 怒氣 的建置尤其值得關注。

497e9fd9cf16ef71743cc34e076b1ca8580c5bca.source: Most of the damage comes from the melee golems, so sources of Block is very useful.
497e9fd9cf16ef71743cc34e076b1ca8580c5bca.text: 大部分傷害來自近戰魔像，因此格擋來源非常有用。

a0229d18c802f64c7c6f0a183009a55edd52e116.source: Conditions are relatively unimportant outside and inside of the mission, with really only the Blind from the Elementalist Golems being important if the team is reliant on a martial attacker.
a0229d18c802f64c7c6f0a183009a55edd52e116.text: 任務外部和內部的條件相對不重要，如果團隊依賴軍事攻擊者，實際上只有 元素使 傀儡的盲人才是重要的。

72f8a28d1be3fae01142c38d142a05835badcac4.source: Most of the Conditions can be prevented via blocking or Blinding.
72f8a28d1be3fae01142c38d142a05835badcac4.text: 大多數情況可以透過阻止或致盲來預防。

c2380086ed89f00819c9ff5529b348da1764cbc5.source: If your party gained Death Penalty on your way to this mission or accumulated too much Death Penalty while in this mission, you can simply resign in the mission dungeon, which causes your party to spawn next to Blimm and eliminate the Death Penalty. Talk to Blimm again to restart the mission.
c2380086ed89f00819c9ff5529b348da1764cbc5.text: 如果你的隊伍在執行此任務的途中獲得了死刑，或者在此任務中積累了太多的死刑，你可以簡單地在任務地牢中辭職，這會使你的隊伍在 布林姆 旁邊生成並消除死刑。再次與 布林姆 對話以重新啟動任務。

faaf669aa8120cd74692fbe6774a9f7f3d77c563.source: None of the foes in this quest are fleshy, so skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here. However, those skills can still be useful for reaching Blimm in Magus Stones to obtain this quest.
faaf669aa8120cd74692fbe6774a9f7f3d77c563.text: 此任務中的敵人都不是肉質的，因此造成 流血、疾病或 中毒 或需要屍體的技能在這裡效果較差。然而，這些技能對於在 Magus Stones 中達到 布林姆 以獲得此任務仍然有用。

cc8b63bd4c1b0c25594dee7b7032540a6059bff2.source: None of the foes in this quest use hex spells, so hex removal skills are less effective here. However, those skills can still be useful for reaching Blimm in Magus Stones to obtain this quest.
