cc8b63bd4c1b0c25594dee7b7032540a6059bff2.text: 此任務中的敵人都沒有使用十六進製法術，因此去除十六進位制的技能在這裡效果較差。然而，這些技能對於在魔法石中達到 布林姆 以獲得此任務仍然有用。

8be94c02d73c0711c0174496c74fd8452514e7bf.source: In Level 3, the Golems that you need to fight are named Golem Sentry; the stationary ones are named Sentry Golems.
8be94c02d73c0711c0174496c74fd8452514e7bf.text: 在3關卡中，你需要對抗的傀儡被命名為傀儡哨兵；固定的被稱為哨兵傀儡。

79744c9552d11fb6bb27fdf6aff798038ca3b38c.source: A Shadow Form or Vow of Silence runner can run most of the mission for a significant time saving, most notably all the way through Magus Stones. The few occasions when fighting is unavoidable can be easily handled by the rest of the party.
79744c9552d11fb6bb27fdf6aff798038ca3b38c.text: 暗影形態 或 沉靜誓約 跑者可以執行大部分任務，從而節省大量時間，尤其是一路通過魔法石。少數不可避免的戰鬥情況可以由隊伍的其他成員輕鬆處理。

977cb8a7916de0b446edf29ac49aa6280499f2c6.source: The endlessly respawning golems on level two do not give experience (which prevents them from being used as an AFK farm).
977cb8a7916de0b446edf29ac49aa6280499f2c6.text: 第二層不斷重生的傀儡不會提供經驗（這會阻止它們被用作 AFK 農場）。

3eddedf6a7da2edf64475ef5800ae9377a8ccaa5.source: This quest (and all primary repeatable Eye of the North quests) may also be obtained from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments after completing it once.
3eddedf6a7da2edf64475ef5800ae9377a8ccaa5.text: 該任務（以及所有主要可重複的 極地之眼 任務）也可以在完成一次後從 史蹟殿堂 中的占卜池中獲得。

6a39488626aae466cd5186de6ce2ca7dfd8b9e18.source: The Asuran Skill Pain Inverter also works against the Indestructible Golem.
6a39488626aae466cd5186de6ce2ca7dfd8b9e18.text: 阿蘇蘭 技能 苦痛 逆變器也可以對抗堅不可摧的布偶。

47356b66a4a827a3cf964e69ebd942a510b73fe4.source: This is not the TPS Regulator Golem quest. For that quest (Little Workshop of Horrors) talk with Blimm in Rata Sum, not in Magus Stones.
47356b66a4a827a3cf964e69ebd942a510b73fe4.text: 這不是 TPS調節高輪 任務。對於此任務（恐怖小工坊），請在 洛達頂點 中與 布林姆 交談，而不是在 Magus Stones 中。

ac6113d47f3721204e6c35e2300b00f3610cc51f.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
ac6113d47f3721204e6c35e2300b00f3610cc51f.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#11 頁。

d1d942a8c85a27112ad9e0f556dae0cb7587f742.source: The Edification energy boost is granted in this area, unlike most zones in the Depths of Tyria below Asuran territory.
d1d942a8c85a27112ad9e0f556dae0cb7587f742.text: 與阿蘇拉領地以下的 泰瑞亞深處 中的大多數區域不同，該區域獲得了教育能量提升。

a42b3ca0ed8d71ca572971ec06bb8ff9d64dc408.source: The Hero's Handbook lists this mission as Oola's Laboratory.
a42b3ca0ed8d71ca572971ec06bb8ff9d64dc408.text: 英雄 的手冊將此任務列為 Oola 實驗室。

069fa5348d2517411448ee73453ed909dbfa89c8.source: Seek out Master Togo in Linnok Courtyard.
069fa5348d2517411448ee73453ed909dbfa89c8.text: 在 裡諾庭園 中尋找 藤吾大師。

ccfbf6414fc70792588ee2825a2346f54bf82cf6.source: Open your world map (default: "M"), and click on Shing Jea Monastery. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into Linnok Courtyard. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it.
ccfbf6414fc70792588ee2825a2346f54bf82cf6.text: 開啟您的世界地圖（預設值：“M”），然後點選 星岬寺。選擇旅行。現在向東退出，進入 裡諾庭園。 藤吾大師 可以在其中找到。

52c6875235a6b500df1e134ca3b30f722bec1b2f.source: The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one player, once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the followup quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.
52c6875235a6b500df1e134ca3b30f722bec1b2f.text: 此任務的獎勵可由一名玩家獲得八次，每個職業一次。第一次將是你職業的主要追求。其他七次只是在選擇第二職業之前與每個職業的校長交談即可。完成他們的任務以及後續任務，最終將其放入您的任務日誌中。

5b69b822d0b65a10d5a3fce57c2678ba3a7e6a97.source: Follow the road southwest until you find skale. Clear the road of skale.
5b69b822d0b65a10d5a3fce57c2678ba3a7e6a97.text: 沿著路向西南方向行駛，直到找到斯凱勒。清理斯卡萊的道路。

2ae6d5d628cb0ae463013c8ad3ce632dcababb11.source: Return to Sebedoh the Mesmer for your reward.
2ae6d5d628cb0ae463013c8ad3ce632dcababb11.text: 影返 至 幻術師瑟貝朵 以獲得獎勵。

26eb16e8bfc62ccddee55a10004f252e92dbb1a1.source: Haversdan appears in front of the gate to Ascalon City, while Sebedoh leaves and can no longer be found pre-Searing.
26eb16e8bfc62ccddee55a10004f252e92dbb1a1.text: 哈伯斯丹 出現在 阿斯卡隆城 的大門前，而 Sebedoh 則在 崩壞 之前離開並且不再被發現。

1db982a741c4e674ebf79d9d572f64955aa88d33.source: The 4 River Skale Tads will no longer spawn on the road. Instead, creatures around the river will begin spawning as normal, with different low-level skale as well as devourers appearing in the eastern section of Lakeside County.
1db982a741c4e674ebf79d9d572f64955aa88d33.text: 4 河鱗怪 Tad 將不再在道路上產生。相反，河流周圍的生物將開始正常生成，不同的低階骷髏以及吞噬者會出現在 湖畔郡 的東部。

6a16fc847ed51d34e8faf7f449779afef40e3150.source: Follow the road southwest until you come upon the 4 skale. Killing either of the two closest to the city triggers the rest of the pack to start fleeing toward the river, completing the quest condition. Killing either of the other two has no effect on the quest and does not trigger any reaction from the remaining skale, but is a quick source of a little extra XP.
6a16fc847ed51d34e8faf7f449779afef40e3150.text: 沿著道路向西南方向行駛，直到到達 4 地角。殺死距離城市最近的兩個中的任何一個都會觸發狼群的其餘部分開始逃向河流，從而完成任務條件。殺死另外兩個人中的任何一個人對任務沒有任何影響，也不會觸發剩餘斯卡萊的任何反應，但可以快速獲得一點額外的經驗值。

df70c40999edce86580b0dd77691de2f8c0d3912.source: Speak to at least one non-[primary profession] expert.
df70c40999edce86580b0dd77691de2f8c0d3912.text: 與至少一位非[主要職業]專家交談。

a962185f4397ac79e842c0febc63cf21754f4b9e.source: See First Spear Devhad for your reward.
a962185f4397ac79e842c0febc63cf21754f4b9e.text: 請參閱 First 矛 Devhad 以獲得獎勵。

1d9bd6c3fe1eccde6dc1c8b471493c56a116cbed.source: Good to see you again, . Today must be my lucky day! I won 200 gold on a bet with First Spear Jahdugar and then you show up just when I need to talk to you. Looks like it's time for you to begin learning about secondary professions. Why don't you head back to the encampment near Chahbek Village and speak to a few of the experts there. They can tell you all about life in the professions.
1d9bd6c3fe1eccde6dc1c8b471493c56a116cbed.text: 很高興再次見到你，。今天一定是我的幸運日！我透過與 First 矛 Jahdugar 打賭贏得了 200 金牌，然後當我需要與你交談時你出現了。看來你是時候開始學習第二職業了。為什麼不回到查貝克村附近的營地並與那裡的一些專家交談呢？他們可以告訴您有關職業生活的所有資訊。

29ce168eb2f35d41e1b5fa89dce6d3e5b3375c99.source: Having M.O.X. in the party. (Doesn't have to be in the party during the three quests.)
29ce168eb2f35d41e1b5fa89dce6d3e5b3375c99.text: 擁有 M.O.X.在聚會中。 （三個任務期間不必在隊伍中。）

df58422b638d62bc75fee579c3e9f9f5a22d00ac.text: 取回 R.O.X. 的能量水晶。

7759a6d0dbc59b99284b3956b475b871c6519fcc.text: 取回 N.O.X. 的能量水晶。

69331a17a3fdd240b191b72810aa5cf74df2b15e.text: 取回 P.O.X. 的能量水晶。

e1b7ee441ad2d351ec39fddf0ecd60e9eb2541c7.source: Zinn's Secret Underground Lair can be found in the explorable area The Falls. It is at the westernmost end, where the waterfall displayed on the last page of the golem manual is located. A person with M.O.X in their party must interact with "The Falls" in order to achieve entrance to the secret lair. The closest town to start from is Ventari's Refuge and you must pass through two other areas with a maximum party size of six members to reach it.
e1b7ee441ad2d351ec39fddf0ecd60e9eb2541c7.text: Zinn 的秘密地下巢穴位於可探索區域 陷落區。它位於最西端，也就是傀儡手冊最後一頁上顯示的瀑布所在的地方。隊伍中有 M.O.X 的人必須與「陷落區」互動才能進入秘密巢穴。出發地點最近的城鎮是 凡特里避難所，您必須穿過另外兩個區域（隊伍人數上限為六人）才能到達。

c80c2ffe205e8b718902763e5632967064db9978.source: MOX must be in your party in order to reach Zinn's lair; only the player bringing the golem hero can speak with Zinn to continue the quest.
c80c2ffe205e8b718902763e5632967064db9978.text: MOX 必須在你的隊伍中才能到達 Zinn 的巢穴；只有攜帶傀儡英雄的玩家才能與辛恩交談以繼續任務。

a68b87679e965aeec3dc7021eb61c8e57803522a.source: Parties who haven't completed the quest will be returned to Ventari's Refuge, after Zinn's dialogue.
a68b87679e965aeec3dc7021eb61c8e57803522a.text: 在 Zinn 對話後，未完成任務的各方將返回 凡特里避難所。

619073eaae606637eae7bf1aff9880a9b9d23759.source: Be careful in the area right before the secret lair, as it is easy to aggro the nearby Wind Riders (and their elementalist boss).
619073eaae606637eae7bf1aff9880a9b9d23759.text: 在秘密巢穴之前的區域要小心，因為很容易激怒附近的風騎者（以及他們的元素師老闆）。

399125f923165cdea30e0ae6e423d13e6973ce03.source: While in Zinn's Secret Lair, the map displays as if the party is beneath Oola's Lab; however, the Lair is northwest of that location. Page 5 of the manual says, "bring M.O.X. with you, as he will be able to bypass the security protocols;" however, the quest log fails to make this requirement clear.
399125f923165cdea30e0ae6e423d13e6973ce03.text: 在 Zinn 的秘密巢穴中時，地圖顯示隊伍就好像在 Oola 的實驗室下面；然而，巢穴位於該位置的西北部。手冊的 5 頁說：「隨身攜帶 M.O.X.，因為他將能夠繞過安全協議；」然而，任務日誌未能明確這項要求。

ca66cfb0f0cf3821a6f7bb14c65e6f8198c99235.source: Accepting the reward as a secondary ranger teaches Pin Down, which is not taught by any of the expert rangers during the previous quest, instead of Power Shot, which is offered by Rakanja. You can abandon this quest after choosing your secondary and before accepting the quest reward and will get a new choice to choose your secondary. However, this will have no effect — your secondary profession has already been locked.
ca66cfb0f0cf3821a6f7bb14c65e6f8198c99235.text: 作為二級遊俠接受獎勵會教授 射足，而先前的任務中沒有任何專家遊俠教授 射足，而不是由 Rakanja 提供的 強力之箭。在選擇你的次要之後、接受任務獎勵之前，你可以放棄這個任務，並會得到一個新的選擇來選擇你的次要。然而，這不會有任何影響——你的第二職業已經被鎖定了。

4310ba7bd15c60205ee76d35d66d9c37b9e2e983.source: Now that you have learned more about the other professions, it's time to make a choice. Think carefully, now. Once you decide, you won't be able to change your mind for some time.
4310ba7bd15c60205ee76d35d66d9c37b9e2e983.text: 現在您已經對其他職業有了更多瞭解，是時候做出選擇了。現在仔細想想。一旦你決定了，在一段時間內你將無法改變主意。

051f1258a89a0c78f41cd6e4f10fe26b8781ab75.source: Which secondary profession would you like to choose? (primary profession omited from list)
051f1258a89a0c78f41cd6e4f10fe26b8781ab75.text: 您想選擇哪個第二職業？ （清單中省略了主要職業）

5f727c8e794988f11e782a9d5f302d5c9cd1d701.source: Yes I wish to take Mesmer as my secondary profession.
5f727c8e794988f11e782a9d5f302d5c9cd1d701.text: 是的，我希望將 幻術師 作為我的第二職業。

9a2a91a9287c25d0b98447f70d5d8990249a1141.source: Yes I wish to take Necromancer as my secondary profession.
9a2a91a9287c25d0b98447f70d5d8990249a1141.text: 是的，我希望將 死靈法師 作為我的第二職業。

fd2b05bcda2e78e301fe7e86fcbfe8487e6abf83.source: Yes I wish to take Elementalist as my secondary profession.
fd2b05bcda2e78e301fe7e86fcbfe8487e6abf83.text: 是的，我希望將 元素使 作為我的第二職業。

52a0cb466480f37a0d2efdc2758123649e7a9550.source: Yes I wish to take Monk as my secondary profession.
52a0cb466480f37a0d2efdc2758123649e7a9550.text: 是的，我希望將 僧侶 作為我的第二職業。

2d8a1276c76d5ddae2ae7d06eb8f0e4277f7dd6c.source: Yes I wish to take Warrior as my secondary profession.
2d8a1276c76d5ddae2ae7d06eb8f0e4277f7dd6c.text: 是的，我希望將 戰士 作為我的第二職業。

d7e11826337a82a6057711b5a1099be8e7fadcb3.source: Yes I wish to take Ranger as my secondary profession.
d7e11826337a82a6057711b5a1099be8e7fadcb3.text: 是的，我希望將 遊俠 作為我的第二職業。

f19915f8bc8e40b4f01603161a4757a85f790567.source: Yes I wish to take Dervish as my secondary profession.
f19915f8bc8e40b4f01603161a4757a85f790567.text: 是的，我希望將 神喚使 作為我的第二職業。

fa5b68bda544ed2e4e6be3958688e198b80ec962.source: Yes I wish to take Paragon as my secondary profession.
fa5b68bda544ed2e4e6be3958688e198b80ec962.text: 是的，我希望將 聖言者 作為我的第二職業。

dc7e8cd9ad6a36644446cba2435efe38686bec13.source: No I am not ready to choose.

91d5c7cde0754ddd0804425118ea27c20d4b2916.source: Kill the skale along the road southwest. Acquire a shimmering scale.
91d5c7cde0754ddd0804425118ea27c20d4b2916.text: 沿著西南方向的路殺掉斯凱爾。獲得一個閃閃發光的秤。

39b27e9384887e257a8c539aff7e6085d5ebd6cd.source: Return to Howland the Elementalist for your reward.
39b27e9384887e257a8c539aff7e6085d5ebd6cd.text: 影返 至 元素使哈吾連德 以獲得獎勵。

f0d1e294ee1824fe7c572acd601ce44abafc95ad.source: After obtaining the quest, follow the road southwest and kill the skale along the road or the river nearby to acquire a shimmering scale. Present it to Howland the Elementalist for your reward.
f0d1e294ee1824fe7c572acd601ce44abafc95ad.text: 獲得任務後，沿著西南方向的道路，擊殺沿路或附近河流的斯凱爾即可獲得閃光鱗片。將其交給 元素使哈吾連德 即可獲得獎勵。

357adc7d7376efd5c9bc1dd18bd4f5b78b22be03.source: All party members must have received the reward for A Little Help.
357adc7d7376efd5c9bc1dd18bd4f5b78b22be03.text: 所有小隊成員都必須獲得「一點幫助」的獎勵。

ebb1d164ec4bb94ad49f2a9303c1c5dd370862ea.source: Mamp in Rata Sum will brief you on the defenses.
ebb1d164ec4bb94ad49f2a9303c1c5dd370862ea.text: 洛達頂點 中的 Mamp 將向您介紹防禦措施。

10867c0e4e2f3aab200b1b69aa01a1b90700814b.source: Protect each golem kiln as it heats up.
10867c0e4e2f3aab200b1b69aa01a1b90700814b.text: 在每個傀儡窯變熱時保護它。

2c6776e9de744d193731196addd32dbe174413d1.source: Learn how to deploy golems into battle.
2c6776e9de744d193731196addd32dbe174413d1.text: 瞭解如何在戰鬥中部署傀儡。

282543f99f99d6300f4271a4538aa23ccfc56994.source: Drop an Asuran beacon obtained from Sokka to summon golem reinforcements.
282543f99f99d6300f4271a4538aa23ccfc56994.text: 掉落從索卡獲得的阿蘇蘭信標來召喚魔像增援。

6eb8768e7b0cd673dc3ad972cf9fd6000fb98fb3.source: Defeat the Bringers of Destruction protecting the hive.
6eb8768e7b0cd673dc3ad972cf9fd6000fb98fb3.text: 擊敗保護蜂巢的 毀滅 使者。

7961f8461cc9c718c25e778c313626a94e1a6f60.source: The mission is divided into three main parts: (1) defend a set of golem-producing kilns while Sokka makes them fully operational; (2) fight your way to the Destroyer spawning grounds (a burnt out area near the top of the map); and (3) defeat the Bringers of Destruction.
7961f8461cc9c718c25e778c313626a94e1a6f60.text: 任務分為三個主要部分： (1) 保衛一組魔像生產窯爐，同時 Sokka 讓它們全面運作； (2) 一路殺到毀滅者產卵場（地圖頂部附近的燒毀區域）; (3) 擊敗 毀滅 的使者。

e786c151a1f158574db46bbf69f684fcc6d46e2e.source: If you only have heroes and henchmen, the second and third techniques below are more reliable.
e786c151a1f158574db46bbf69f684fcc6d46e2e.text: 如果你只有英雄和追隨者，下面的第二個和第三個技術更可靠。

c6b8d17053a3ba86b1ad0d0793d81aaaf2e9c18d.source: Oola and Gadd will each help support one kiln; you must decide whether to split up your group or run back and forth between the kilns.
c6b8d17053a3ba86b1ad0d0793d81aaaf2e9c18d.text: Oola 和 Gadd 將各資助一座窯爐；你必須決定分散隊伍或在窯爐之間來回奔跑。

5f2868d61b3705f503efff7d92140d53754e3d38.source: Split: stay behind the bridge to take full advantage of the NPCs. The Destroyers stop attacking after a kiln is heated; you can regroup then. Using heroes and henchmen, flag the henchmen to the eastern kiln and the heroes at the northern one. You can run between them as required by the situation. As long as you include a healer in each group, you should not have much trouble in normal mode; this will work in hard mode, albeit more slowly. Recommended henchmen are: Devona, Lo Sha, Mhenlo, and Talon.
5f2868d61b3705f503efff7d92140d53754e3d38.text: 分裂：留在橋後面充分利用 NPC。窯爐加熱後，毀滅者停止攻擊；然後你就可以重新組合了。使用英雄和追隨者，將追隨者標記到東窯，將英雄標記到北窯。您可以根據情況需要在它們之間執行。只要你每組都有一個治療者，在正常模式下就不會有太大麻煩；這將在困難模式下工作，儘管速度較慢。推薦的追蹤者是：德佛娜、羅夏、涵洛 和 Talon。

ec1bca2f4a3b42493c69ecfe73c9513ab0564f03.source: Back and forth: Ignore Oola and Gadd, who will respawn when no other enemies are in their range. Run between the kilns, defending whichever is most vulnerable.
ec1bca2f4a3b42493c69ecfe73c9513ab0564f03.text: 來回：忽略 Oola 和 Gadd，當他們的範圍內沒有其他敵人時，他們會重生。 跑過 在各個窯爐之間，保護最脆弱的一方。

0bedd41e6576dba45b6b515e517650b2f295b620.source: After both kilns are ready, talk with Sokka so that he will follow you and offer you Asuran Beacons, which produce a pair of G.O.L.E.M. 1.0s. These golems will follow you, so you can start moving right away. Talk to a golem to switch it between wait- and follow-modes; drop a beacon to replace your golems.
0bedd41e6576dba45b6b515e517650b2f295b620.text: 兩個窯爐準備好後，與索卡交談，以便他跟隨你並向你提供阿蘇蘭信標，它會生產一對 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0。這些傀儡會跟著你，所以你可以立即開始移動。與傀儡交談以在等待和跟隨模式之間切換；放下一個信標來替換你的傀儡。

22dd552a19ff52babb454819b1fd7f77d5a464c3.source: Fight your way to the spawning grounds and defeat the Bringer of Destruction pair; defeating them completes the mission (you do not have to kill the other Destroyers in that area).
22dd552a19ff52babb454819b1fd7f77d5a464c3.text: 殺出一條血路，到達產卵場並擊敗 毀滅 配對的使者；擊敗他們即可完成任務（您不必殺死該區域的其他驅逐艦）。

bf4dd97e57cc5cea7ccc106b0250ba6bd0a432e7.source: At start, you need to avoid Sokka; turn left, staying in the grass. Cross the tree-trunk bridge by the left kiln and clear the Destroyers occupying the hill including the group waiting to go down to the Eastern kiln. Once you have cleared the green area, you can leave your party just below the last tree on the green side of the hilltop at the edge of the burnt-out spawning grounds. One player must return to Sokka to trigger the kilns, then return to the party to confront the Destroyer spawns that occur within the spawning grounds. Finally, two Bringers of Destruction will appear with assorted other Destroyers. The party should move away and lose aggro at this time; the Destroyers will stay near their spawn point and not chase the party. Defeating the Bringers of Destruction at this point can trigger bugs that make the mission impossible to complete. You can then go talk with Sokka so that he will follow you and offer you Asuran Beacons, which produce a pair of G.O.L.E.M. 1.0s. These golems will follow you, so you can start moving right away. Talk to a golem to switch it between wait- and follow-modes; drop a beacon to replace your golems.
bf4dd97e57cc5cea7ccc106b0250ba6bd0a432e7.text: 一開始，你需要避開Sokka；左轉，留在草地上。穿過左側窯爐旁的樹幹橋，清除佔據山頭的破壞者，包括等待下東窯爐的隊伍。一旦你清理了綠色區域，你就可以把你的隊伍留在燒毀的產卵場邊緣山頂綠色一側的最後一棵樹下方。一名玩家必須返回索卡觸發窯爐，然後返回隊伍以對抗在產卵場內出現的毀滅者產卵。最後，兩位 毀滅 帶來者將與其他各種驅逐艦一起出現。此時隊伍應該離開並失去仇恨；驅逐艦將停留在其重生點附近，不會追趕隊伍。此時擊敗 毀滅 的使者可能會觸發錯誤，使任務無法完成。然後你可以去與索卡交談，這樣他就會跟著你並向你提供阿蘇蘭信標，它會產生一對 G.O.L.E.M. 1.0。這些傀儡會跟著你，所以你可以立即開始移動。與傀儡交談以在等待和跟隨模式之間切換；放下一個信標來替換你的傀儡。

c0d87527569134aeebe930683423c1464e44bae3.source: Go back to the spawning grounds and defeat the Bringers; defeating them completes the mission (you do not have to kill the other Destroyers in that area).
c0d87527569134aeebe930683423c1464e44bae3.text: 返回產卵場並擊敗使者；擊敗他們即可完成任務（您不必殺死該區域的其他驅逐艦）。

268ba882a6c29fee4a9bfb4d9a8f7eb3d2c9b9ec.source: If you have trouble with either of the above techniques, then return to the kilns with the entire party after clearing the area between the NPCs and the spawning groups ("Skipping the kilns" method.) The waves of Destroyers that come in afterwards should be easy to dispatch: the mobs are smaller and arrive less frequently. Spark up the Golems and bring them with you to tackle the spawning grounds.
268ba882a6c29fee4a9bfb4d9a8f7eb3d2c9b9ec.text: 如果您對上述任一技術有困難，請在清理 NPC 和產卵組之間的區域後與整個隊伍返回窯爐（「跳過窯爐」方法）。之後出現的一波毀滅者應該很容易派遣：怪物較小且到達頻率較低。激發傀儡並帶著它們去探索產卵場。

46114cd7b181c90ba951561155ab90f9c0384eb1.source: You can finish the mission in about seven minutes using this technique. At least one player must equip Recall.
46114cd7b181c90ba951561155ab90f9c0384eb1.text: 使用這種技術，您可以在大約七分鐘內完成任務。至少一名玩家必須裝備 回歸。

118e0d215703d2d573ac6878da4bacc9516684ba.source: Start the countdown timer by flagging heroes and henchmen between the two sets of stairs. Circle backwards and around to the left, but remaining out of compass range of the eastern kiln. Continue along this path and stop near the chasm, with the northern kiln on the edge of your compass; this allows you to trigger just that one kiln, so that you do not have to defend the other.
118e0d215703d2d573ac6878da4bacc9516684ba.text: 透過在兩組樓梯之間標記英雄和追隨者來啟動倒數計時器。向後並向左繞一圈，但保持在東窯的羅盤範圍之外。繼續沿著這條路走，在峽谷附近停下來，北窯就在你指南針的邊緣；這允許你只觸發一個窯爐，這樣你就不必保衛另一個窯爐。

258c881e7f4dcbba18bebdb05f6c4f674f654c7c.source: While you are circling around and as soon as the mission text starts appearing, flag all but one of your party just across from the left-hand side bridge. Send the remaining hero across from your eventual position across the chasm; when that hero is close enough, cast Recall on them and then flag them back with the rest of the party (you might need to micromanage their pathing; they can get stuck on corners). Once the hero is with everyone else, cancel Recall so that you can teleport to the northern kiln (without having triggered the eastern one).
258c881e7f4dcbba18bebdb05f6c4f674f654c7c.text: 當你繞圈時，一旦任務文字開始出現，就在左側橋對面標記你的隊伍中除了一個人之外的所有人。將剩下的英雄從你最終的位置送過鴻溝；當該英雄足夠接近時，對他們施放 回歸，然後將他們與隊伍的其他成員一起標記回來（你可能需要對他們的路徑進行微觀管理；他們可能會卡在角落裡）。一旦英雄和其他人在一起，取消回歸，這樣你就可以傳送到北窯（而不觸發東窯）。

71cbd9639e36ebd54c5310a683062f0803e0f5c7.source: While the kiln heats up, take the party to clear the route to the blackened area as usual. Wait until the kiln is ready before crossing the crest of the hill. Kill the Bringers to complete the mission.
71cbd9639e36ebd54c5310a683062f0803e0f5c7.text: 當窯爐升溫時，像往常一樣帶領隊伍清理通往黑色區域的路線。等到窯準備好了再翻過山頂。殺死使者以完成任務。

b69157090af855159bcdf5ad4ddfdd59add6c9e2.source: Alternatively, if your party has enough anti physical (weakness, Ineptitude, Wandering Eye, etc.), a minion master and a spirit spammer (bring Shadowsong), you can flag your heroes on top of the hill, run for the kilns and go AFK until all spawns are dead and the kilns are ready. Go back to your party and finish the mission.
b69157090af855159bcdf5ad4ddfdd59add6c9e2.text: 或者，如果你的隊伍有足夠的反物理（弱點、愚蠢、徘徊之眼等）、一個小兵大師和一個精神垃圾郵件傳送者（帶上闇影共鳴），你可以在山頂上標記你的英雄，跑向窯爐並掛機，直到所有生成都死了並且窯爐準備就緒。返回你的隊伍並完成任務。

30662b85ad57b8d37cbb9c9ba28f5ab4e9e12593.source: The relevant quest may be obtained directly from Mamp (who will also take you into the mission). Alternatively, after completing it once, it may also be obtained from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments (like any quest from the Hero's Handbook).
30662b85ad57b8d37cbb9c9ba28f5ab4e9e12593.text: 相關任務可以直接從Mamp那裡獲得（他也會帶你進入任務）。或者，完成一次後，也可以從 史蹟殿堂 的占卜池中取得（就像 英雄 手冊中的任何任務）。

244b04ef52b1a575e383de4b6a01f17774a5877e.source: Those wishing to scrape the area can do so easily: follow the alternative walkthrough and postpone the activation of the kilns; the area will be free of foes.
244b04ef52b1a575e383de4b6a01f17774a5877e.text: 那些希望清理該區域的人可以輕鬆做到這一點：按照替代演練並推遲窯爐的啟用；該地區將沒有敵人。

ba79b5c267120d7ae243f5cb4c1cc718ee326ef8.source: This mission presents a good opportunity to farm Destroyers.
ba79b5c267120d7ae243f5cb4c1cc718ee326ef8.text: 這個任務提供了一個刷驅逐艦的好機會。

84ef5fc7fc4e62054397f29d090191d03470d863.source: Destroyers are immune to burning, resistant to fire damage, and vulnerable to cold damage. A common approach is to combine Winter with any elemental damage.
84ef5fc7fc4e62054397f29d090191d03470d863.text: 驅逐艦免疫燃燒，抵抗火焰傷害，容易受到寒冷傷害。常見的方法是將 寒冬 與任何元素傷害結合。

7d65b8a11b20b36b9d17e627e9422c24f6fd907c.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #13 in the Hero's Handbook storybook.
7d65b8a11b20b36b9d17e627e9422c24f6fd907c.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書中的#13 頁。

b7ef31baad4f3ecedbfd604d9da07b89fcc7e599.source: Unlike previous campaigns where missions are contained in outposts with visually distinct map icons and can be started from an NPC with a rotating green icon, the way in which this quest can be started is by going to Rata Sum and talking to Mamp which is marked in game with a green, rotating, shield-like icon, akin to the one of Mission NPCs.
b7ef31baad4f3ecedbfd604d9da07b89fcc7e599.text: 與先前的戰役不同，任務包含在具有視覺上不同的地圖圖示的前哨站中，並且可以從具有旋轉綠色圖示的 NPC 開始，該任務的啟動方式是前往 洛達頂點 並與 Mamp 交談，Mamp 在遊戲中標記為綠色、旋轉、盾牌狀圖示，類似於 主線任務 NPC 之一。

9f71e506e8c5a2eac7970545694b472f0249721c.source: Sometimes a G.O.L.E.M. spawns with unlimited health.
9f71e506e8c5a2eac7970545694b472f0249721c.text: 有時是 G.O.L.E.M.生成時具有無限生命值。

8ca1bee93376fef3128b3e94a3c0b1464e633352.source: There is a delay between when the Bringers spawn and the task to defeat them is added to the quest. A sufficiently powerful group camped on their spawn location can kill them before the task is added, making it impossible to finish the quest.
8ca1bee93376fef3128b3e94a3c0b1464e633352.text: 使者出現和擊敗它們的任務新增到任務之間有一段延遲。一個足夠強大的團體紮營在他們的重生位置可以在任務新增之前殺死他們，從而使任務無法完成。

28e26f4cf4bb26f83c53dd6fc7d8929222b16d85.source: You can accidentally prevent the game from registering the completion of the mission if you kill the Bringers of Destruction before triggering their protectors. To avoid this, refrain from killing the two bosses until the very last objective (for a total of five objectives) appears in your quest log, i.e. even after you are told to kill the Bringers of Destruction.
28e26f4cf4bb26f83c53dd6fc7d8929222b16d85.text: 如果您在觸發 毀滅 的使者保護者之前殺死他們，您可能會意外地阻止遊戲註冊任務的完成。為了避免這種情況，請不要殺死這兩個 Boss，直到最後一個目標（總共五個目標）出現在您的任務日誌中，即使在您被告知要殺死 毀滅 的使者之後。

e204a6ec259f9833437b5547087134781ab4f620.source: Seek out Headmaster Greico in the monastery.
e204a6ec259f9833437b5547087134781ab4f620.text: 在修道院裡尋找格雷科校長。

bd38aa7b539127dd032a233ab849a690d8b69da2.source: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the skills
bd38aa7b539127dd032a233ab849a690d8b69da2.text: 與 星岬寺 入口處的 Ludo 交談即可進入。如果您跳過了螳螂幼體教程，您將學習技能

c3404ec378bb48c321feeadd2de7a8a4d3c5f916.source: Follow the road southwest from town to Ashford. Talk to Devona.
c3404ec378bb48c321feeadd2de7a8a4d3c5f916.text: 沿著從城鎮向西南方向行駛的道路前往阿什福德。與 德佛娜 交談。

f50e18d281bbe18a146234496cc74d5af4d52d17.source: From Ascalon City, follow the road going southwest. As you approach Ashford Abbey, turn south and follow the quest marker to Devona.
f50e18d281bbe18a146234496cc74d5af4d52d17.text: 從 阿斯卡隆城 出發，沿路向西南方向行駛。當您接近 灰色淺灘修道院 時，轉向南並沿著任務標記前往 德佛娜。

8b73337eeb5ec934cb8a6af886617f52f204be4b.source: Despite being a primary quest, completing it is not necessary for receiving Unsettling Rumors or A Second Profession from Armin Saberlin and continuing with the story. Both quests can be obtained as soon as you complete your primary profession test.
8b73337eeb5ec934cb8a6af886617f52f204be4b.text: 儘管是主要任務，完成它並不是從 阿明 沙貝林 接收 不安的傳聞 或 副職業修練 並繼續故事的必要條件。完成初級職業測試後即可獲得這兩個任務。

962ac5417509a5fb7d69248ee0501cd95e480ce8.source: Talk with Quarrymaster Bohanna about manning the excavation.
962ac5417509a5fb7d69248ee0501cd95e480ce8.text: 與採石場管理員博哈納討論挖掘工作的人員安排。

7fa3175c47987069cbf3dc3e8e445fafc950b308.source: Meet with Dunkoro on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
7fa3175c47987069cbf3dc3e8e445fafc950b308.text: 在 杜夏懸崖 上與 Dunkoro 會面。

3bc7e493789fcd1dff371cfbe2951df80c1effa5.source: Explain the plan to Hamar and start the assault.
3bc7e493789fcd1dff371cfbe2951df80c1effa5.text: 向哈馬爾解釋計劃並開始攻擊。

ec47332a2cf13ae5dbfe3e6efbfb58f39b57f896.source: Lead Hamar against the skree harpies holding Dohjok quarry. [5...0] of 5 harpy groups remaining.
ec47332a2cf13ae5dbfe3e6efbfb58f39b57f896.text: 帶領哈馬爾對抗佔據多赫約克採石場的斯克雷鷹身女妖。剩餘 5 鷹身女妖組的 [5...0]。

340ae0142becba176a4c41fb815af4a0baac97ad.source: See Digmaster Gatah for your reward.
340ae0142becba176a4c41fb815af4a0baac97ad.text: 請參閱 Digmaster Gatah 以獲得獎勵。

8f6d9010a2467ecd048c6f98fe514c0b995e0709.source: Head to Champion's Dawn to talk to Quarrymaster Bohanna. She will tell you to locate Dunkoro. Just follow the quest marker into Cliffs of Dohjok and find Dunkoro to continue the quest. Dunkoro will provide new information on the situation and inform you to join up with Hamar, the quarry supervisor. Just keep following the quest marker until you get to Hamar and a group of Diggers. Talking to Hamar will have them all follow your party as allies.
8f6d9010a2467ecd048c6f98fe514c0b995e0709.text: 前往 勇士曙光 與採石場大師 Bohanna 交談。她會告訴你找到鄧科羅。只需按照任務標記進入 杜夏懸崖 並找到 Dunkoro 即可繼續任務。 Dunkoro 將提供有關情況的新資訊，並通知您與採石場主管 Hamar 會合。繼續跟隨任務標記，直到到達哈馬爾和一群挖掘者。與哈馬爾交談將使他們都作為盟友追隨你的政黨。

52f113814ce7fdf1be3350e6430038533f4e06e2.source: The next part of the quest involves clearing out the groups of Skree harpies from the quarry area. There are about five groups in total. Remember to grab the Skree Battle bounty from the nearby resurrection shrine before proceeding. Follow the quest marker down a slope towards the lower quarry area.
52f113814ce7fdf1be3350e6430038533f4e06e2.text: 任務的下一部分涉及清除採石場區域的 鳥妖 鷹身女妖群。總共大約有五組。請記得在繼續之前從附近的復活神殿獲取 鳥妖 戰鬥賞金。沿著任務標記走下斜坡，前往較低的採石場區域。

bca7f3c66c6d3c5b220ce664bf14ee9431bbd47c.source: The first group of harpies is on the bridge along the downward path. With all the allies with you, the fighting will be relatively quick and easy. Beyond the first group, the second and third group are somewhat close together. Be wary of attracting too much attention. Each group of harpies consists of about 3 or 4 harpies of mixed professions. Once all five groups are cleared, the quest will update and you can head to Jokanur Diggings for your reward.
bca7f3c66c6d3c5b220ce664bf14ee9431bbd47c.text: 第一組鷹身女妖位於下行路徑的橋上。有了所有盟友的陪伴，戰鬥將會相對快速和輕鬆。除了第一組之外，第二組和第三組的距離也有些接近。小心不要吸引過多的注意力。每組鷹身女妖由大約 3 或 4 混合職業的鷹身女妖組成。一旦所有五個小組都被清除，任務就會更新，你可以前往喬卡努爾礦區領取獎勵。

924828233178afcf4f5c7a2525bcaa50c47790d6.source: This quest can be done at the same time with a part of Identity Theft and Scholarly Affairs.
924828233178afcf4f5c7a2525bcaa50c47790d6.text: 該任務可以與身分盜竊和學術事務的一部分同時完成。

429c94b2fe4c1d047a4773646ab8ae7c252bf477.source: Dunkoro's potential death does not lead to failure.
429c94b2fe4c1d047a4773646ab8ae7c252bf477.text: 鄧科羅的潛在死亡並不意味著失敗。

fadabb91bbae13b3a2736f9f10256a2515bd1517.text: 搜尋 桑泉谷 尋找 Sujun。

2510fcd3634b37126c8531fc75154a2e0eb8bc59.source: Sujun can be found near the middle of Sunqua Vale.
2510fcd3634b37126c8531fc75154a2e0eb8bc59.text: Sujun 位於 桑泉谷 中部附近。

accc0bd8ec91d5bae0118e313260a971f7ebcaa3.source: Search for the Ebon Vanguard in the Charr homelands.
accc0bd8ec91d5bae0118e313260a971f7ebcaa3.text: 在 夏爾 家鄉尋找 黑檀。

647903ae9cdc158f5ca441f4d5b12b07c802928e.source: Speak to Gwen in the Hall of Monuments.
647903ae9cdc158f5ca441f4d5b12b07c802928e.text: 與 史蹟殿堂 中的 關 交談。

914578484e259ed12807bf7bbcd2db0e49695456.source: Travel to Longeye's Ledge and search for clues about the Vanguard. (Against the Charr)
914578484e259ed12807bf7bbcd2db0e49695456.text: 前往 長眼巖脈 並尋找有關先鋒隊的線索。 （對抗夏爾）

2397dc0eae7cb6d8a2f3415c94f0777774f369c3.source: Free Pyre's warband and gain their aid. (Warband of Brothers)
2397dc0eae7cb6d8a2f3415c94f0777774f369c3.text: 釋放柴堆的戰幫並獲得他們的援助。 （兄弟戰隊）

8b8e1ae71d9903ce6dbcd41fdca59ee9ec02f99e.source: Free the remaining Ebon Vanguard from the stronghold of Hierophant Burntsoul. (Assault on the Stronghold)
8b8e1ae71d9903ce6dbcd41fdca59ee9ec02f99e.text: 從 Hierophant Burntsoul 的據點釋放剩餘的 黑檀。 （襲擊根據地）

5c3d2fea1dade9ebec189c9545346e5f5d697664.source: See Captain Langmar for your reward.
5c3d2fea1dade9ebec189c9545346e5f5d697664.text: 請參閱 隊長連瑪 以取得獎勵。

d0d06d5e96ad9f48fb024eaba5958f4dafe03c33.source: [Incomplete source section] Travel to Longeye's Ledge, and speak to Olfun Longeye. Then follow the quest chain which starts with Search for the Ebon Vanguard. See the walkthroughs for the individual quests in the chain for further details.
d0d06d5e96ad9f48fb024eaba5958f4dafe03c33.text: [不完整的來源部分] 前往 長眼巖脈，並與 Olfun Longeye 交談。然後按照從搜尋 黑檀 開始的任務鏈進行操作。有關更多詳細資訊，請參閱鏈中各個任務的演練。

efcd9344b9d8c86ccf321ca04470db941c1a68ff.source: Upon completion of the quest, you will be under the effect of Call of the Eye the next time you enter a non-outpost instance.
efcd9344b9d8c86ccf321ca04470db941c1a68ff.text: 完成任務後，下次進入非前哨基地時，你將受到眼睛召喚的影響。

66e151520164df49bbb75e1491c6441a5521fdb5.source: Speak to Sujun once you are ready to go rescue the rabbits.
66e151520164df49bbb75e1491c6441a5521fdb5.text: 準備好去救兔子後，與蘇俊交談。

cfcb65bef0b6815cf95f35f1812e8bfd51cea4b0.source: Release all the rabbits from the traps. 3..0 of 3 rabbits still trapped.
cfcb65bef0b6815cf95f35f1812e8bfd51cea4b0.text: 將所有兔子從陷阱中釋放出來。 3..0 的 3 兔子仍然被困住。

d895eaddac7a0ea3a8fc2251e824a0c4b7bfa477.source: After accepting the quest, simply follow Sujun to each of the Rabbit Cages. Click on each of them to free the rabbits held inside. After freeing the second rabbit, a level 6 Hungry Kappa will show up. It must be defeated. With Sujun helping, it shouldn't be difficult. After three rabbits are freed, the quest is complete.
d895eaddac7a0ea3a8fc2251e824a0c4b7bfa477.text: 接受任務後，跟隨蘇俊前往各個兔籠即可。點選它們中的每一個來釋放裡面的兔子。釋放第二隻兔子後，將會出現 6 飢餓河童關卡。它必須被擊敗。有蘇俊幫忙，應該不難。當三隻兔子被釋放後，任務就完成了。

30455150c038c3a0742a9be249670fc629317c8a.source: Killing the Hungry Kappa is not mentioned as a quest objective, yet the quest cannot be completed without first killing it, even after opening the three cages. It is a good idea to wait at the second cage for this monster to show up, and kill it then.
30455150c038c3a0742a9be249670fc629317c8a.text: 任務目標中沒有提到殺死飢餓的河童，但如果不先殺死它，即使開啟了三個籠子，任務也無法完成。最好在第二個籠子裡等待這個怪物出現，然後殺死它。

aa87b5937ad8826f58851380f5bd3adb07c17075.source: Sujun needs to survive, or the quest can't be completed.
aa87b5937ad8826f58851380f5bd3adb07c17075.text: 蘇俊需要活下去，否則任務就無法完成。

ba90debaaa16d34f1f3965cc8254830da631a3bd.source: Discover the fate of the Ebon Vanguard.
ba90debaaa16d34f1f3965cc8254830da631a3bd.text: 瞭解 黑檀 的命運。

37f37ba7fd2d579f8c41894cc202ae18292128c3.source: Search Grothmar Wardowns for signs of the Vanguard.
37f37ba7fd2d579f8c41894cc202ae18292128c3.text: 搜尋格羅斯瑪戰區尋找先鋒隊的跡象。

d5798a1bfe2a0390a79a5a1640f40cea7c0121ad.source: After exiting Longeye's Ledge, head southeast down the path to find the Vanguard Helmet. Examine it to complete the quest.
d5798a1bfe2a0390a79a5a1640f40cea7c0121ad.text: 退出 長眼巖脈 後，沿著小路往東南方向行駛，找到先鋒頭盔。檢查它以完成任務。

61fd7428044738be957d2d29c4882e475bf3bc40.source: If you instead see the Tattered Vanguard Clothing, head south from there to find the Vanguard Helmet; alternatively if you find the Old Campfire, head east instead. Interacting with either the clothing or the campfire are not necessary to complete the quest.
61fd7428044738be957d2d29c4882e475bf3bc40.text: 如果您看到破爛的先鋒服裝，請從那裡向南尋找先鋒頭盔；或者，如果您找到了舊篝火，請向東行駛。完成任務不需要與衣服或營火互動。

df5ef07cbe561a34d62e5c803cb03b129ec15938.source: Be sure to let each member of your team complete the quest before you begin the next step or they will not receive credit for the mini mission.
df5ef07cbe561a34d62e5c803cb03b129ec15938.text: 請務必讓團隊中的每個成員在開始下一步之前完成任務，否則他們將不會獲得迷你任務的積分。

aeff2c2706a49e77ea46072d3382bd819932b345.source: If you do examine the helmet more closely, you will automatically start the next primary quest in the Ebon Vanguard chain, Against the Charr.
aeff2c2706a49e77ea46072d3382bd819932b345.text: 如果您更仔細地檢查頭盔，您將自動開始 黑檀 鏈中的下一個主要任務 對抗夏爾。

4f989b3b308a948e9ae1f208afa74dc14a26d78e.source: Gain the rank of First Spear or Level 12.
4f989b3b308a948e9ae1f208afa74dc14a26d78e.text: 獲得第一個 矛 等級或 12 等級。

c68b67ad4a8835db1fb230e793fbe310edab319c.text: 與 摩根將軍 交談。

949b1ac5d7079dc2035efb5f0035539986e86904.source: See Emissary Dajmir for your reward.
949b1ac5d7079dc2035efb5f0035539986e86904.text: 請見達吉米爾使者以獲得獎勵。

e969030f69412dd75cbd8bef629a8472673e09ae.source: You will need to first acquire the necessary Sunspear rank. If you haven't already, talk to Runduk in the Sunspear Great Hall for two quests with similar aims of gaining Sunspear points.
e969030f69412dd75cbd8bef629a8472673e09ae.text: 您需要先取得必要的 日戟。如果您還沒有這樣做，請在 日戟大會堂 中與 Runduk 交談，完成兩個具有類似目標的任務，以獲得陽矛點數。

b55411c86407f38d0132c852209d020536dac25a.source: After that, look for General Morgahn and talk to him to begin the "fight". Your party will face off against five similarly-named (but different professions) Kournan Guards in a manner similar to a PvP fight. The kill count and the timer will appear on screen when the fight starts. Defeating them requires a good coordination among your party members (or good hero management) to both attacking their monks and protecting yourselves from the warriors. You win when all the Kournans are dead or if you scored better when the timer ends. If you lose, just leave the area and come back in to try again.
b55411c86407f38d0132c852209d020536dac25a.text: 之後，尋找摩根將軍並與他交談以開始「戰鬥」。你的隊伍將以類似於 PvP 戰鬥的方式對抗五個名稱相似（但職業不同）的庫南守衛。戰鬥開始時，擊殺數和計時器將出現在螢幕上。擊敗他們需要你的隊伍成員之間的良好協調（或良好的英雄管理），以攻擊他們的僧侶並保護自己免受戰士的傷害。當所有庫南人都死了或計時器結束時你得分更高時，你就贏了。如果你輸了，只需離開該區域並返回再試一次。

70e0e965174acb63c44917a8ba62977c1731bdfd.source: When the timer ends, it appears that even if you draw with the Kournans, you will still be considered to have "won". As such, it is possible to complete this quest by simply not aggroing the Kournans when the timer starts, and then waiting for the timer to end.
70e0e965174acb63c44917a8ba62977c1731bdfd.text: 當計時器結束時，即使您與 Kournans 平局，您仍然會被視為“贏了”。因此，只要在計時器開始時不騷擾庫南人，然後等待計時器結束，就可以完成此任務。

eea727f0edcb593b0a70cc26b06b39a308626d35.source: You do not have to meet the requirement to trigger the NPCs' spawning in the area and the dialogue starting, but if you have not met the requirements you will not be able to fight the Kournan Guards.
eea727f0edcb593b0a70cc26b06b39a308626d35.text: 你不必滿足觸發該區域 NPC 生成和對話開始的要求，但如果你沒有滿足要求，你將無法與庫爾南守衛作戰。

3ff0f3b04398a4fd31dd1436b76c6f454c19566e.source: Related quest Rising in the Ranks: First Spear
3ff0f3b04398a4fd31dd1436b76c6f454c19566e.text: 相關任務 排名上升：第一個 矛

359e1806c2f2526170dd0d02e94602663a661ed6.source: Varesh Ossa walks into The Astralarium after completing her conversation with General Morghann.
359e1806c2f2526170dd0d02e94602663a661ed6.text: 瓦雷什·奧薩 (Varesh Ossa) 與摩根將軍交談完畢後走進星宮。

3c8268148e67664497a0d2873d9228ebbdf12595.source: Speak with Meerak the Scribe in Ashford Abbey.
3c8268148e67664497a0d2873d9228ebbdf12595.text: 與 灰色淺灘修道院 中的抄寫員米拉克交談。

59b95b8df82022a64a663e97f097b1eeacafd156.source: Deliver the message to Armin Saberlin. Use your map to travel to Ascalon City quickly.
59b95b8df82022a64a663e97f097b1eeacafd156.text: 將訊息傳送至 阿明 沙貝林。使用地圖快速前往 阿斯卡隆城。

2ccac4916c691bf77ff7eaeb4642db66bbd6ec25.text: 防禦 +5（而 體力 高於 50%）

47dd50157e2348bc35dda9232a0a6f4ea94072ee.source: Head through the portal for Ashford Abbey to the northwest of Devona and speak with Meerak. He will advise you to use your map to travel to Ascalon City. Press the "M" key and a map of the area will appear. Double-click on the icon for Ascalon City on the map and you will travel directly there.
47dd50157e2348bc35dda9232a0a6f4ea94072ee.text: 穿過 灰色淺灘修道院 的傳送門前往 德佛娜 的西北部，並與 Meerak 交談。他會建議您使用地圖前往 阿斯卡隆城。按下“M”鍵，將出現該區域的地圖。雙擊地圖上的 阿斯卡隆城 圖示即可直接前往那裡。

723f91bb211f9a11925f797bca3c7a8bfe54aa7e.source: Despite being a primary quest, completing it is not necessary to receive A Second Profession from Armin Saberlin and continue with the story. You can obtain A Second Profession as soon as you complete your primary profession test.
723f91bb211f9a11925f797bca3c7a8bfe54aa7e.text: 儘管這是一個主要任務，但完成它並不需要從 阿明 沙貝林 接收 副職業修練 並繼續故事。完成初級職業測試後，您即可獲得 副職業修練。

6d66f27477342e6d1ad7d06eeb9eb6ddecf8a0f7.source: The Tall Shield rewarded by this quest has a unique skin when compared to the normal Tall Shield.
6d66f27477342e6d1ad7d06eeb9eb6ddecf8a0f7.text: 與普通的 巨盾 相比，此任務獎勵的 巨盾 具有獨特的皮膚。

eafcc02f259aed26db2923b42b3d97cf9bfe02da.source: To take Warrior as your second profession, follow the road northwest from town, continue along the road as it turns to Green Hills County, and talk to Warmaster Grast.
eafcc02f259aed26db2923b42b3d97cf9bfe02da.text: 要將戰士作為你的第二職業，請沿著城鎮西北方向的道路行駛，繼續沿著道路轉向綠丘郡，然後與戰鬥教官葛拉斯特交談。

223763284931e6fc2e4d852de9cabfc7e890aec0.source: To take Ranger as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town. Turn south at the bridge and follow the signs to Regent Valley. Talk to Master Ranger Nente.
223763284931e6fc2e4d852de9cabfc7e890aec0.text: 要將 遊俠 作為你的第二職業，請沿著城鎮西南方的道路行駛。在橋處往南轉，然後依照路標前往 統治者之谷。與 遊俠大師涅特 交談。

3049cda8e28ce7d287c9880046e6706156b5e659.source: To take Monk as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town, enter Ashford Abbey, and talk to Brother Mhenlo.
3049cda8e28ce7d287c9880046e6706156b5e659.text: 要將僧侶作為你的第二職業，請沿著城鎮西南方向的道路，進入灰色淺灘修道院，然後與涵洛教友交談。

e223b359167d6d1137d03686a71f8e8df0692baf.source: To take Elementalist as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town, continue past Ashford up into Wizard's Folly, and talk to Elementalist Aziure.
e223b359167d6d1137d03686a71f8e8df0692baf.text: 要將 元素使 作為你的第二職業，請沿著城鎮西南方向的道路行駛，繼續經過阿什福德進入 巫師的怪異建築，然後與 元素使艾西兒 交談。

6006462f73e263e85cf5cb6f51fbeea84afc6c97.source: To take Necromancer as your second profession, follow the road southwest from town, pass through Ashford Abbey into the catacombs, and talk to Mistress Munne.
6006462f73e263e85cf5cb6f51fbeea84afc6c97.text: 要將死靈法師作為你的第二職業，沿著城鎮西南方向的道路，穿過灰色淺灘修道院進入地下墓穴，並與穆妮女主人交談。

763840f6c188c8f62f7b196028a5c89bb6fd9c67.source: To take Mesmer as your second profession, follow the road northwest from town to the theatre, and talk to Lady Althea.
763840f6c188c8f62f7b196028a5c89bb6fd9c67.text: 要將 幻術師 作為你的第二職業，請沿著城鎮西北方向的道路前往劇院，並與 奧瑟雅小姐 交談。

a83e4795e76a65438bd05cc441f68439647a9356.source: Return to Armin Saberlin for your reward.
a83e4795e76a65438bd05cc441f68439647a9356.text: 影返 至 阿明 沙貝林 以獲得獎勵。

f997b86e2b5c66adf03013eb9f27697e2ab7db66.text: 戰士 第二個 職業 — 戰士

e81d5655639617bb2f486bd08ed0ccd06e15dcc6.source: Head northwest along the path from Ascalon City, past the theatre and the gate, to Green Hills County. Here, talk to Warmaster Grast and complete Grawl Invasion to be able to become a secondary Warrior.
e81d5655639617bb2f486bd08ed0ccd06e15dcc6.text: 沿著 阿斯卡隆城 的路徑向西北行駛，經過劇院和大門，到達 綠丘郡。在這裡，與 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特 交談並完成 穴居人入侵 即可成為輔助 戰士。

6604b46caac3023f44049a2ab9fb8c1813fcc492.text: 遊俠 第二個 職業 — 遊俠

732d2df905b8095a9cea58b2cedb592c440c10ae.source: From Ashford Abbey, head southeast over a bridge, and into Regent Valley. Follow the path southeast past the devourers until you encounter Master Ranger Nente. Complete The Ranger's Companion to be able to become a secondary Ranger.
732d2df905b8095a9cea58b2cedb592c440c10ae.text: 從 灰色淺灘修道院 出發，往東南方向行駛，過一座橋，進入 統治者之谷。沿著東南方向經過吞噬者，直到遇到 遊俠大師涅特。完成 遊俠的夥伴 即可成為輔助 遊俠。

7dfbf38e20e70be8719e31db21897b4b2f5d312d.text: 僧侶 第二個 職業 — 僧侶

508e24747f6459fcf21880826647ced05ca66364.source: In Ashford Abbey, talk to Brother Mhenlo. Complete A Monk's Mission to be able to become a secondary Monk.
508e24747f6459fcf21880826647ced05ca66364.text: 在 灰色淺灘修道院 中，與 涵洛教友 交談。完成 僧侶任務 即可成為輔助 僧侶。

4b6b1a60f07d6cf256f3d601d248bad6e08c080e.text: 沒有第二個 職業 — 死靈法師

d5a781241fd7daae05af0acb73874cdbf15346ac.source: From Ashford Abbey, leave through the west exit to enter the catacombs. Head north and talk to Necromancer Munne. Complete The Necromancer's Novice to be able to be come a secondary Necromancer.
d5a781241fd7daae05af0acb73874cdbf15346ac.text: 從 灰色淺灘修道院 出發，經由西出口進入地下墓穴。往北走並與 死靈法師繆涅 交談。完成 死靈法師的新成員 即可成為輔助 死靈法師。

82ed9ba0f45fbfe4ee586cb29c7fd8263083d175.text: 幻術師 第二個 職業 — 幻術師

73290c5dfa2e154260a51e073f897d9a8aa6006d.source: Head northwest along the path from Ascalon City to the theatre. Talk to Lady Althea and complete A Mesmer's Burden to be able to become a secondary Mesmer.
73290c5dfa2e154260a51e073f897d9a8aa6006d.text: 沿著 阿斯卡隆城 的路徑向西北前往劇院。與 奧瑟雅小姐 交談並完成 幻術師的重任，即可成為輔助 幻術師。

7a2a26d75b4ca951d31528f3540bf04bc1eb2880.text: 元素使 第二個 職業 — 元素使

18255cff59d5040460aa73b60ee278b0786ac1dc.source: From Ashford Abbey, take the east exit then head southwest to Wizard's Folly. Follow the path through the mountains until you find Elementalist Aziure. Complete The Elementalist Experiment to be able to become a secondary Elementalist.
18255cff59d5040460aa73b60ee278b0786ac1dc.text: 從 灰色淺灘修道院 出發，走東出口，然後往西南方向行駛至 巫師的怪異建築。沿著小路穿過山脈，直到找到 元素使艾西兒。完成 元素使的實驗 即可成為輔助 元素使。

502490f3ae732a0ddf4830ca83b7b4f7669dec46.source: This quest becomes available as soon as you complete your primary profession test. Completing Further Adventures or Unsettling Rumors is not required.
502490f3ae732a0ddf4830ca83b7b4f7669dec46.text: 一旦你完成初級職業測試，這個任務就變得可用。不需要完成 進一步的冒險 或 不安的傳聞。

0414bad45e2538c10571de5eac490e9274d92398.source: You cannot progress past pre-Searing without taking on a second profession. However, you do not need to accept A Second Profession to obtain one; simply completing the respective trainer's quest will allow you to do this.
0414bad45e2538c10571de5eac490e9274d92398.text: 如果不從事第二職業，您就無法超越 崩壞 之前的階段。但是，您無需接受 副職業修練 即可獲得；只需完成相應訓練師的任務即可讓您做到這一點。

e1fe50f5a2f92657d22a7ed558560e26437a0c66.source: Caution: Your choice of secondary profession cannot be changed until much later in the game. Explore the different possibilities and choose wisely.
e1fe50f5a2f92657d22a7ed558560e26437a0c66.text: 注意：你對次要職業的選擇要到遊戲後期才能改變。探索不同的可能性並做出明智的選擇。

0b50dd947be9f2807d8edcfb960a455c308d4d0c.source: All party members must have received the reward for Search for the Ebon Vanguard.
0b50dd947be9f2807d8edcfb960a455c308d4d0c.text: 所有隊伍成員必須已獲得搜尋 黑檀 的獎勵。

f1fd6263692c98fad1a2297c388a45b40f6e2b37.source: Search the Charr camp to the east for signs of the Vanguard captives.
f1fd6263692c98fad1a2297c388a45b40f6e2b37.text: 搜尋東部的 夏爾 營地，尋找先鋒隊俘虜的蹤跡。

d434571afde0e5404be9af880716e3274e15b248.source: *OPTIONAL* Find ways to weaken the Charr garrison.
d434571afde0e5404be9af880716e3274e15b248.text: *可選*尋找削弱 夏爾 駐軍的方法。

4db478227f6b9caed16aa41fff706f8d5f14bd34.source: *OPTIONAL* Intercept the Charr supply caravan. Use Charr Explosive charges to disable it.
4db478227f6b9caed16aa41fff706f8d5f14bd34.text: *選用* 攔截 夏爾 補給車隊。使用 夏爾 爆炸裝藥將其停用。

05a69af964263e681e2b3ab8a06ee6061d71c829.source: *OPTIONAL* Destroy the watchtowers with explosive charges. [0...2] of 2 destroyed.
05a69af964263e681e2b3ab8a06ee6061d71c829.text: *可選*用炸藥摧毀瞭望塔。 2 的 [0...2] 已損壞。

dd5d99fa3484cc886adcd5b3bba1e01ea73697f6.source: *OPTIONAL* Employ the siege devourers to fire explosive charges at the garrison. [0...2] of 2 fired.
dd5d99fa3484cc886adcd5b3bba1e01ea73697f6.text: *可選*使用攻城吞噬者向要塞發射炸藥。 2 的 [0...2] 已觸發。

2375a1f3bd8aaa046cb53e96e25ed6e81c148b77.source: Start the quest by interacting with the Vanguard Helmet. Shortly after the cinematic, your party will be attacked by a small group of Charr. Dispatch them, then move on. Your party has the choice of assaulting the Charr garrison, or participating in optional objectives to weaken the garrison. The optional objectives are not difficult as long as you don't get overwhelmed by the roaming patrols, otherwise, the quest is truly easy, fast and simple. Interrupting Firereigners should be a priority.
2375a1f3bd8aaa046cb53e96e25ed6e81c148b77.text: 透過與先鋒頭盔互動來開始任務。過場動畫結束後不久，您的隊伍將受到一小群 夏爾 的攻擊。派遣他們，然後繼續前進。你的隊伍可以選擇攻擊 夏爾 駐軍，或是參與選用目標來削弱駐軍。可選目標並不困難，只要你不被漫遊巡邏隊壓垮，否則，任務真的很容易、快速和簡單。打斷Firereigners應該是首要任務。

1ed2ed47e19ba73291363548f919fe02ad64177c.source: Charr Firereigners drop explosive charges after they are defeated. These charges are used to destroy the supply caravan (optional objective 1), destroy the watchtowers (optional objective 2), and launched by the siege devourers at the garrison (optional objective 3). Either have a spellcaster in your party carry the charges, or wait until you are ready to use them. Once the charge is placed on the ground, it detonates.
1ed2ed47e19ba73291363548f919fe02ad64177c.text: 夏爾 火焰統治者被擊敗後會掉落炸藥。這些炸藥用於摧毀補給商隊（選購目標 1）、摧毀瞭望塔（選用目標 2），並由駐軍的攻城吞噬者發射（選購目標 3）。要麼讓你隊伍中的施法者攜帶這些費用，要麼等到你準備好使用它們。一旦電荷被放置在地面上，它就會爆炸。

875cc6d5b2507b59e6b69a222aaf90cd70e4c7c0.source: The supply caravan is guarded by a few groups of Charr. Dispatch them, and then use an explosive charge to destroy the caravan. The siege devourers are guarded by one or two groups of Charr. Dispatch them, then feed an explosive charge to the devourer. Shortly after the devourer launches a charge, he will be bombarded and killed. The watchtowers are guarded by one or two groups of Charr. Again, dispatch them and destroy the tower.
875cc6d5b2507b59e6b69a222aaf90cd70e4c7c0.text: 補給車隊由幾組 夏爾 守護。消滅他們，然後使用炸藥摧毀商隊。攻城吞噬者由一組或兩組 夏爾 守護。消滅他們，然後向吞噬者投擲炸藥。吞噬者發動衝鋒後不久，他就會被轟擊而死。瞭望塔由一組或兩組 夏爾 守護。再次派遣他們並摧毀塔樓。

459499170a031194be07238bbf7c6cf26ee42bf3.source: The garrison consists of several groups of Charr in a small area. Use normal pulling strategies to separate the groups and dispatch them accordingly. Then, move in and destroy Harvest Soulreign. This will lead to a cinematic and begin The Dawn of Rebellion.
459499170a031194be07238bbf7c6cf26ee42bf3.text: 駐軍在一個小區域內由多個 夏爾 小組組成。使用正常的拉動策略來分開群組並相應地排程它們。然後，進入並摧毀收割靈魂統治。這將導致電影的出現並開始叛亂的黎明。

9f16d19254fca3309692af5c9fd0ac86ae604381.source: Having completed the quest once, you may want to rush through the mission when repeating it for your Hero's Handbook. If so, run to the Vanguard Helmet in Grothmar Wardowns to get the mission and:
9f16d19254fca3309692af5c9fd0ac86ae604381.text: 完成一次任務後，您可能會想要在為 英雄 手冊重複該任務時快速完成任務。如果是這樣，請跑到 Grothmar Wardowns 中的先鋒頭盔處獲取任務並：

277b50de1c5d20c114c22298ff7bce597fbe7e97.source: As soon as the mission starts, set off to the southeast - the group approaching from the northeast will not follow you.
277b50de1c5d20c114c22298ff7bce597fbe7e97.text: 任務一開始，就往東南方向出發──從東北方向過來的隊伍不會跟著你。

a73fbb9a0cd459ebea670c8c7ff40ec1bd693151.source: Cross the bridge, waiting for the two groups of Charr to separate before attacking them.
a73fbb9a0cd459ebea670c8c7ff40ec1bd693151.text: 過橋，等待兩組夏爾分開後再攻擊他們。

dbc14398c94693410723632dd5ef2bd023ec5873.source: Head east along the bottom of the area, avoiding the few groups of Charr nearby. When you reach a cliff, you will need to kill two more groups on the road.
dbc14398c94693410723632dd5ef2bd023ec5873.text: 沿著該區域底部向東前進，避開附近的幾組 夏爾。當你到達懸崖時，你需要在路上再殺死兩個群體。

2b770a676cbfe3d3ff57ddec2b0d4393b0957c3b.source: Head straight to the stronghold. If you wait just south of the mission objective star, a devourer catapult will come towards you separately from its group, making it easier to kill.
2b770a676cbfe3d3ff57ddec2b0d4393b0957c3b.text: 直奔要塞。如果你在任務目標星的南邊等待，吞噬者彈射器將與它的群體分開向你飛來，使其更容易被殺死。

39e5eb411e837ef7353e7057523042044e3dd8e9.source: Kill the Charr in the fort. Be careful, as there will be more enemies than you might have previously encountered here (this is because you have not completed the optional objectives).
39e5eb411e837ef7353e7057523042044e3dd8e9.text: 殺死要塞中的 夏爾。請小心，因為這裡的敵人會比您之前遇到的還要多（這是因為您尚未完成可選目標）。

0dc3ddd1984d20394ee4553a9d078116a8192be8.source: If you follow the repeat map, from the moment you exit Longeye's Ledge until you finish the quest, it shouldn't take you more than 15 minutes.
0dc3ddd1984d20394ee4553a9d078116a8192be8.text: 如果您按照重複地圖操作，從退出 長眼巖脈 到完成任務，花費的時間不會超過 15 分鐘。

e9de0d65783c213c6a5d7c4e3744d2aaab5142a0.source: Take a running build yourself. Build the rest of the party to be able to take out the two end bosses.
e9de0d65783c213c6a5d7c4e3744d2aaab5142a0.text: 自己進行執行建置。組成隊伍的其餘成員，以消滅兩個末端首領。

d845f9de21093e52d55c79d79c105fc8f52c318d.source: Run to, and activate, the helmet. After the cinematic, flag your heroes and henchmen back up the hill you ran down towards the helmet (about half-way up), then run yourself in the opposite direction just to the edge of the burnt area. Your team will probably get hit a little by the incoming Charr, but they will survive. Once the Charr have gathered at the helmet, flag your party (using the Mission Map) across the bridge and along the road a bit.
d845f9de21093e52d55c79d79c105fc8f52c318d.text: 跑過 並啟動安全帽。電影結束後，標記你的英雄和追隨者回到你跑向頭盔的山上（大約一半的高度），然後你自己朝相反的方向跑到燒毀區域的邊緣。您的團隊可能會受到即將到來的 夏爾 的一點打擊，但他們會生存下來。一旦 夏爾 聚集到頭盔處，標記您的隊伍（使用 主線任務 地圖）過橋並沿路行駛一段時間。

77b266191b6e0b33235f25f7b8dabbd93342d4a9.source: Keep flagging them a bit further along the road (at about 10 second intervals) till they get to the northern tower (at which stage you will get some dialogue). Continue to flag them south past the second tower, and then east into the Charr camp and onto the green star. A second dialogue will appear about now. Finally flag them into the mouth of the area with the two bosses.
77b266191b6e0b33235f25f7b8dabbd93342d4a9.text: 沿著路繼續標記他們（大約以 10 秒為間隔），直到他們到達北塔（在這個階段你會聽到一些對話）。繼續向南標記他們經過第二座塔，然後向東進入 夏爾 營地並到達綠色星星。現在將出現第二個對話。最後用兩個boss標記他們進入該區域的入口。

8e03f7298a582c9be1d9017bee1de701826cc30c.source: If you don't mind dying, you can get yourself killed by the Charr at the start, which makes it easier to flag. But with practice it isn't necessary.
8e03f7298a582c9be1d9017bee1de701826cc30c.text: 如果你不介意死亡，你可以在一開始就被 夏爾 殺死，這樣比較容易被標記。但透過練習就沒有必要了。

142effdcf632f9aa1ed3ef47988106ed44def218.source: During this mission Charr Firereigners drop Charr Explosives when killed.
142effdcf632f9aa1ed3ef47988106ed44def218.text: 在這個任務中，夏爾 Firereigners 被殺死時會掉落 夏爾 炸藥。

04ff279cac2b426dd4f70b510424f2ad6d6a612a.source: It is difficult to capture skills from Harvest Soulreign, since the end cinematic triggers immediately after his death.
04ff279cac2b426dd4f70b510424f2ad6d6a612a.text: 捕捉收割靈魂統治的技能很困難，因為結束動畫會在他死後立即觸發。

19c37261dc20dc966d2a1216486bc42301b6a169.source: Completing this quest triggers The Charr Prisoner cinematic and returns players to Grothmar Wardowns.
19c37261dc20dc966d2a1216486bc42301b6a169.text: 完成此任務會觸發 夏爾 囚犯過場動畫，並使玩家返回格羅斯瑪戰事。

ae90ed3ea69b64e614ef75e67709cd46a82b7e02.source: If Plan A quest is active, players will appear in the middle of the Charr camp, surrounded by about 8 groups of Charr.
ae90ed3ea69b64e614ef75e67709cd46a82b7e02.text: 如果 A計畫 任務處於活動狀態，玩家將出現在 夏爾 營地的中間，周圍是大約 8 群組的 夏爾。

5cea63ca4d007023c88f65f2fbf15cf337a01392.source: However if Failure to Communicate quest is active, the Charr camp will be devoid except for a single group. Which makes it easier to complete this quest.
5cea63ca4d007023c88f65f2fbf15cf337a01392.text: 然而，如果「溝通失敗」任務處於活動狀態，則 夏爾 營隊將只剩下一個小組。這使得完成這個任務變得更容易。

3366f74369e2e998463e17ba1a17bf70563e2081.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #3 in the Hero's Handbook storybook.
3366f74369e2e998463e17ba1a17bf70563e2081.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書中的#3 頁。

e825f26ed671681c3c5ef3b7b531504ce6d55cb0.source: Unlike previous campaigns where missions are contained in outposts with visually distinct map icons and started from an NPC with a rotating green icon, the way in which this quest can be started is by going to Longeye's Ledge, forming a party, exiting the outpost and navigating towards the Vanguard Helmet which is marked in game with a green, rotating, shield-like icon, akin to the one of Mission NPCs.
e825f26ed671681c3c5ef3b7b531504ce6d55cb0.text: 與先前的戰役不同，任務包含在具有視覺上不同的地圖圖示的前哨站中，並從帶有旋轉綠色圖示的 NPC 開始，該任務的啟動方式是前往 長眼巖脈，組建隊伍，退出前哨站並導航至先鋒頭盔，該頭盔在遊戲中標有綠色、旋轉、盾牌狀的圖示，類似於 主線任務 NPC 的圖示。

e83fcee4d1841956e58a27962625bc5478513fa6.source: Groups with more than one player can assign two out of the three to carry the tablets, preferably caster professions.
e83fcee4d1841956e58a27962625bc5478513fa6.text: 超過一名玩家的團體可以指定三人中的兩人攜帶平板電腦，最好是施法者職業。

657331c356e3f9a17375c451fe21db3b1b733358.source: Be careful of the fire and cripple causing flame jets, especially with Kormir as she can die if standing next to one, failing the mission.
657331c356e3f9a17375c451fe21db3b1b733358.text: 小心火焰噴射器引起的火災和致殘，尤其是科米爾，因為如果站在火焰噴射器旁邊，她可能會死亡，導致任務失敗。

caf84039d0b6a8a24b9e2dcb15989caf10a66433.source: In the third area, another ghost named Kahdash will be holding a tablet. But this time he will carry it to the pedestal for you, asking for protection from the undead. If Kahdash dies, he will respawn at his original location and begin again.
caf84039d0b6a8a24b9e2dcb15989caf10a66433.text: 在第三個區域，另一個名叫卡達什的鬼魂將拿著一塊平板電腦。但這次他會為你把它帶到基座上，請求保護你免受不死族的侵害。如果卡達什死亡，他會在原來的位置重生並重新開始。

9e597a64126c365170327287ab50498014f62d74.source: Finally at the sealed chamber, kill the Skeletons as you head down towards the Apocrypha, the final boss. The Apocrypha changes professions periodically between Mesmer, Dervish and Paragon by activating Reform Carvings.
9e597a64126c365170327287ab50498014f62d74.text: 最後，在密封室中，殺死骷髏，然後前往最終的 Boss Apocrypha。 Apocrypha 透過啟動改革雕刻，在 幻術師、神喚使 和 聖言者 之間定期改變職業。

0d0aeb08f9a345ed53fa806c52c691924a90db05.source: To gain the bonus, players have to complete the sequence in section two without harming the Sunspear Ghosts. By "not harming", the game means not killing them. (These NPCs can still sustain small amounts of damage, e.g. from Kormir's spear attacks.) Since Kormir will follow your party leader, pulling her away prevents her killing the ghosts. Abstain from summoning mindless allies (e.g. minions, spirits, NPCs from summoning stones, etc.) when nearby the Sunspear Ghosts. Also be careful when target calling, since henchmen and heroes can easily spike the ghosts - set heroes to Avoid Combat mode and disable aggressive skills when in the second room. Whilst the fire jets can harm other enemies, the ghosts are invulnerable to them. To get the Master's Reward, you must also prevent Kahdash from being killed.
0d0aeb08f9a345ed53fa806c52c691924a90db05.text: 為了獲得獎勵，玩家必須在不傷害陽矛幽靈的情況下完成第二部分中的序列。遊戲中的「不傷害」意味著不殺死他們。 （這些 NPC 仍然可以承受少量傷害，例如科米爾的長矛攻擊。）由於科米爾會跟隨你的隊伍領袖，將她拉開可以防止她殺死鬼魂。在陽矛幽靈附近時，避免召喚無意識的盟友（例如爪牙、精魂、召喚石的 NPC 等）。呼叫目標時也要小心，因為追隨者和英雄可以輕鬆地秒殺幽靈 - 將英雄設定為避免戰鬥模式並在第二個房間時停用攻擊性技能。雖然火焰噴射器可以傷害其他敵人，但幽靈對它們無懈可擊。為了獲得Master的任務獎勵，你還必須防止Kahdash被殺死。

5520e6097ed4492ff4fb411e694690b228f36346.source: The hazards in this mission will pressure the party healer. Luckily the required hero is Melonni and dervishes can perform roles other than just damage. (There is nothing to stop you from bringing more than one healer.)
5520e6097ed4492ff4fb411e694690b228f36346.text: 此任務中的危險會對隊伍治療師造成壓力。幸運的是，所需的英雄是 梅隆妮，托缽修行者還可以執行除傷害之外的其他角色。 （沒有什麼可以阻止你帶上不只一位治療師。）

a6acb57e7cee99d858980091d5cf71949d0b1b15.source: It is unlikely that the players running tablets will be able to evade the undead without support due to tougher and more dogged opponents.
a6acb57e7cee99d858980091d5cf71949d0b1b15.text: 由於對手更強硬、更頑強，執行平板電腦的玩家在沒有支援的情況下不太可能躲避亡靈。

58e0fd8e568c0986fe6f1ba68dbffcdebd771835.source: The undead's corpses do not disappear, and they resurrect after 2 and a half minutes. If more time is needed in an area with undead, consider killing them in a remote location so that when they resurrect you will be out of aggro.
58e0fd8e568c0986fe6f1ba68dbffcdebd771835.text: 不死族的屍體不會消失，並會在2半分鐘後復活。如果在有不死生物的區域需要更多時間，請考慮在遠端位置殺死他們，這樣當他們復活時你就會擺脫仇恨。

62b43b19915b5a922ffbff823ffcc7ef036a4aee.source: Holy damage skills to easily fight the undead.
62b43b19915b5a922ffbff823ffcc7ef036a4aee.text: 神聖傷害技能輕鬆對抗不死族。

5cb4d554a2deef92a3a1f204a46e358ba7707094.source: In Hard mode, the undead use Tainted Flesh, bring appropriate counters.
5cb4d554a2deef92a3a1f204a46e358ba7707094.text: 在困難模式中，不死族使用腐敗肉體，帶上適當的計數器。

3f8db91e95401dde3a88df0466090030b81eb174.source: Dying from being crushed by the falling crushers does not cause Death Penalty or count as a death against the Survivor title track.
3f8db91e95401dde3a88df0466090030b81eb174.text: 被墜落的破碎機壓死不會導致死刑，也不算 生存者 主打歌的死亡。

6a2738905e91655a3fae1fec78593f9b66f91271.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan.
6a2738905e91655a3fae1fec78593f9b66f91271.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽。

939301bf48a8703cad9eec372eaa0e88f22c12de.source: Even though General Morgahn only appears during a cinematic, if there are General Morgahn heroes in your party, they all will be renamed as "Kournan Paragon".
939301bf48a8703cad9eec372eaa0e88f22c12de.text: 儘管 摩根將軍 僅出現在過場動畫中，但如果您的隊伍中有 摩根將軍 英雄，他們都將被重新命名為「Kournan 聖言者」。

8d6aa7f347b7bc24447830b5ce504f302bdca8fb.source: If the respawning undead are killed on one of the flame jets, they will continuously spawn and die to the jets as long as you stay away from them.
8d6aa7f347b7bc24447830b5ce504f302bdca8fb.text: 如果重生的不死生物被其中一架火焰噴射器殺死，只要你遠離它們，它們就會不斷地生成並死於噴射器中。

d68d86d92d8f435bdb5060f9eb5358ccd348af14.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #12 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
d68d86d92d8f435bdb5060f9eb5358ccd348af14.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#12 頁。

6f7e61c24ec1cd4bb7cc6474c84a29cc7662f5a2.source: If the player activates the Trial of Perseverance then runs back and stays in the area of the Trial of Fire, Kahdash will finish placing the Stone Tablet on the pedestal but will die immediately after the cinematic. This counts as a Sunspear Ghost death towards the bonus objective.
6f7e61c24ec1cd4bb7cc6474c84a29cc7662f5a2.text: 如果玩家啟動了毅力試煉，然後跑回來並留在烈火試煉區域，卡達什將完成將石碑放在基座上，但會在過場動畫結束後立即死亡。這算是陽矛幽靈在獎勵目標中的死亡。

1dc126a8080f64a15d0d85c1bfdff8bcd2bf6534.source: Kill the Charr Shaman, Scorch Maulclaw, at Doomlore Shrine.
1dc126a8080f64a15d0d85c1bfdff8bcd2bf6534.text: 殺死 末日傳說神殿 處的 夏爾巫醫，焦土大爪。

ede420f10a50db11cd0fa537c94ab9b69b4816d6.source: Clear the entrance to the Cathedral of Flames.
ede420f10a50db11cd0fa537c94ab9b69b4816d6.text: 清理 火焰大教堂 的入口。

10fa5213034337733a3adf08fff64a12f1b141b7.source: See Gron Fierceclaw [Merchant] for your reward.
10fa5213034337733a3adf08fff64a12f1b141b7.text: 請參閱烈爪戈隆 [雜貨商人] 以獲得獎勵。

d45b685fff7d04d3a9d2e88b1d71578002e01ebe.source: If you enter this mission while riding a Siege Devourer you will not earn credit for completing it. If a certain quest (or quests) are active, Pyre Fierceshot will appear outside Longeye's Ledge before you have started this quest, and will help your party attack the roving bands of Charr, despite that a goal/part of this quest is freeing him.
d45b685fff7d04d3a9d2e88b1d71578002e01ebe.text: 如果您在騎乘 Siege 蠍 時進入此任務，您將不會因完成該任務而獲得積分。如果某個任務（或多個任務）處於活動狀態，Pyre Fierceshot 將在您開始此任務之前出現在 長眼巖脈 之外，並將幫助您的隊伍攻擊 夏爾 的流浪樂隊，儘管此任務的目標/部分是釋放他。

493c62c86cb22ab73b13616b766f1bd95ef7f965.source: Koss must be present to continue.
493c62c86cb22ab73b13616b766f1bd95ef7f965.text: 寇斯 必須存在才能繼續。

36056d0e8520e3a727b87741faaeb3f0bed05abb.source: Take Koss and meet Emissary Dajmir in Zehlon Reach.
36056d0e8520e3a727b87741faaeb3f0bed05abb.text: 搭乘 寇斯 並在澤隆河段與達吉米爾使者會面。

e4d13c921a78a5a57cf7058d2dd099d406d2c8f7.text: 尋找 梅隆妮 並與其交談。

5b699c4e453676d5bd1eff88faf850e58d4ca76b.source: Travel with Melonni to meet Kormir.
5b699c4e453676d5bd1eff88faf850e58d4ca76b.text: 與 梅隆妮 一起旅行去見科米爾。

176ca2cf90606700afa264805bab5455ae98cf56.text: 梅隆妮 加入您的隊伍。

e7dc0d417d89837d2a56d765ec7d543e29cf133c.source: Head out from The Astralarium into Zehlon Reach with at least Koss in your party. Get the nearby insect hunt bounty and head west and south a bit until you reach Melonni. A cutscene occurs when you talk to her, followed by another walk to just outside Jokanur Diggings and another cutscene.
e7dc0d417d89837d2a56d765ec7d543e29cf133c.text: 隊伍中至少有 寇斯，從星辰館前往 Zehlon Reach。獲得附近的昆蟲狩獵賞金，然後向西和向南行駛一點，直到到達 梅隆妮。當你和她說話時會出現一個過場動畫，然後又走到喬卡努爾挖掘場外面，然後出現另一個過場動畫。

f4129f84f3f657508df36fac789ffa6d2a71e25f.source: If you map travel at any point during this quest, you will have to start it from the beginning when you leave that outpost.
f4129f84f3f657508df36fac789ffa6d2a71e25f.text: 如果您在此任務期間的任何時刻繪製旅行地圖，則必須在離開該前哨站時從頭開始。

17a7882c99f92c2834a967619256e2f136ce6866.source: This quests removes the spawn of a Sunspear Scout at the resurrection shrine near where you first meet Melonni.
17a7882c99f92c2834a967619256e2f136ce6866.text: 此任務會移除您第一次遇到 梅隆妮 附近的復活神殿中的陽矛偵察兵的生成點。

004c8687319ffce6936f1246c9bc8ef47ae6067e.source: Search for Zho in Kinya Province.
004c8687319ffce6936f1246c9bc8ef47ae6067e.text: 在 欣彌領地 中搜尋 若。

73b25606727779b83a8300ca4cfc6d21d452f257.source: Travel northwest from Sujun through the mountains until you reach Kinya Province. Once there, go a short distance northwest and you will find Zho
73b25606727779b83a8300ca4cfc6d21d452f257.text: 從Sujun 向西北行駛，穿過山脈，直至到達欣彌領地。到達那裡後，往西北方向走一小段距離，您會發現 若

66420d34eb083e25d245d55ed831529b702da43f.source: All Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Signs and Portents.
66420d34eb083e25d245d55ed831529b702da43f.text: 所有 黑暗逆襲 角色必須接受徵兆獎勵。

07629b7d41cd75de5f60154ac5ececaabc9e4020.source: Melonni must be present in the party.
07629b7d41cd75de5f60154ac5ececaabc9e4020.text: 梅隆妮 必須出現在聚會中。

72c2a1c70ef91716b22881a752a82d7dcd6e7dd5.source: Travel to the ancient Istani ruins.
72c2a1c70ef91716b22881a752a82d7dcd6e7dd5.text: 前往古老的伊斯坦尼遺址。

f9ba78cce367fa9a900e23970ccb34077ce06cdc.source: Obtain the tablet from Darehk and place it on the stone pedestal.
f9ba78cce367fa9a900e23970ccb34077ce06cdc.text: 從達雷克處獲得石碑並將其放在石座上。

67641f5e81c3ae2c4927cc0afb9d4a00f751d528.source: Place the two tablets on the pedestals.
67641f5e81c3ae2c4927cc0afb9d4a00f751d528.text: 將兩塊平板電腦放在基座上。

166c61cc923123a3b96ef1a84727bd4f6d4479e1.source: Guard Kahdash while he places the tablet on the pedestal.
166c61cc923123a3b96ef1a84727bd4f6d4479e1.text: 當卡達什將平板電腦放在基座上時，看守他。

027c4fd0ab0d63dd1af0999d13ed08b0819c6d5a.source: *BONUS* Do not harm any Sunspear Ghosts.
027c4fd0ab0d63dd1af0999d13ed08b0819c6d5a.text: *獎勵* 不要傷害任何陽矛幽靈。

5e3d6e2af0105debeeba4893742f48805668e913.source: Taking a Siege Devourer with you (from Grothmar Wardowns) will make killing Scorch Maulclaw a great deal easier, as his mob can wipe an inexperienced party fairly quickly.
5e3d6e2af0105debeeba4893742f48805668e913.text: 隨身攜帶圍攻蠍（來自格羅斯瑪戰爭）將使殺死焦土大槌變得更加容易，因為他的暴民可以相當快地消滅沒有經驗的隊伍。

16aeaa48c3b953313888c8af411f682313e2ac6d.source: After completing Against the Charr make your way through the band of Charr and mantids to Dalada Uplands. Enter Dalada Uplands and make your way through a band of Charr Seekers to the entrance of Doomlore Shrine, which is closed with Charr Lock. Defeat the group of Charr guards and the hunter that appears there. Then, have Pyre Fierceshot open the lock to Doomlore Shrine. He can die, and if he does, zone back to Grothmar Wardowns and he'll reappear again. Defeat the three parties of Charr, including the final party boss, Scorch Maulclaw, to complete the quest.
16aeaa48c3b953313888c8af411f682313e2ac6d.text: 完成 對抗夏爾 後，穿過 夏爾 和螳螂群組到達 達拉達山地。進入 達拉達山地，穿過一群 夏爾 搜尋者到達 末日傳說神殿 的入口，該入口被 夏爾 鎖定關閉。擊敗 夏爾 守衛組和出現在那裡的獵人。然後，讓 Pyre Fierceshot 開啟 末日傳說神殿 的鎖。他可能會死，如果死了，請回到格羅斯瑪戰區，他會再次出現。擊敗 夏爾 的三個隊伍，包括最終的隊伍首領 Scorch Maulclaw，以完成任務。

9b7844fd037a5a4c02ac0d3fc5fdb4f8183064ca.source: For characters that have been run to Doomlore Shrine, it is possible to just map travel there as soon as you take the quest. This saves you the hassle of fighting/running there; once you map travel, just walk out of the town to continue with the quest. However, keep in mind that when you zone outside, you will be on top of all the Charr protecting the entrance. Defeating Scorch Maulclaw will end the quest, so focus on killing him.
9b7844fd037a5a4c02ac0d3fc5fdb4f8183064ca.text: 對於已經跑到 末日傳說神殿 的角色，可以在接受任務後立即繪製前往那裡的地圖。這樣就省去了你在那裡戰鬥/奔跑的麻煩；一旦你繪製了旅行地圖，只需走出城鎮即可繼續任務。但是，請記住，當您在戶外區域時，您將位於保護入口的所有 夏爾 之上。擊敗焦灼之爪將結束任務，所以集中精力殺死他。

21f37afefcb06bb33bd09a50be72768b76a86cd5.source: Pyre will join your party as an ally when you accept this quest.
21f37afefcb06bb33bd09a50be72768b76a86cd5.text: 當您接受此任務時，柴堆將作為盟友加入您的隊伍。

5abb3dd5fa7f47636ea50e7b09e2293d858154fe.source:
Pyre may not open the gate, or you might find it closed if you take too long to cross it. You may be able to get Pyre to open the gate by clicking on the Charr lock (switch) in front of the gate.
If you find yourself locked outside, rezone and try again.
5abb3dd5fa7f47636ea50e7b09e2293d858154fe.text:
柴堆可能不會開啟大門，或者如果您花太長時間穿過它，您可能會發現它已關閉。您可以點選門前的 夏爾 鎖（開關）讓 Pyre 開啟門。
如果您發現自己被鎖在外面，請重新分割槽並重試。

880007fe1c2e94a36f41a7b763e9b676b552fd5c.text: 副職業修練 已完成

6a145e7c231b0d4f256ff3ff660d6b6580484aef.source: Go to Ascalon City to speak to Sir Tydus.
6a145e7c231b0d4f256ff3ff660d6b6580484aef.text: 前往 阿斯卡隆城 與 泰德閣下 對話。

69ab22ce2d996d6b53e4f95360bea7b964bfd706.source: Sir Tydus is only a few steps to the left from the quest giver. Simply walk over and speak to him to complete the objective.
69ab22ce2d996d6b53e4f95360bea7b964bfd706.text: 泰德閣下 距離任務給予者左側僅幾步之遙。只需走過去與他交談即可完成目標。

7749e49dd4042fb95bd0f55d88b8c1de6da80f99.source: Caution: The follow-up mini-mission initiates the Searing, an irreversible point of no return for your character. You can safely claim this quest's reward, but do not accept the next one from Sir Tydus until you are absolutely ready to leave pre-Searing Ascalon behind.
7749e49dd4042fb95bd0f55d88b8c1de6da80f99.text: 注意：後續的迷你任務會啟動 崩壞，這是你的角色不可逆轉的不歸路。您可以安全地領取此任務的獎勵，但在您完全準備好將 崩壞 之前的 阿斯卡隆 拋在腦後之前，請勿接受 泰德閣下 的下一個獎勵。

10bc77007522711ec1ceb4f3f9e8004d02e6477e.source: Completing either Prophecies or Eye of the North (primary)
10bc77007522711ec1ceb4f3f9e8004d02e6477e.text: 完成 阿斯卡隆戰記 或 極地之眼（主）

cad9f1798ea3b1fe52a0e0ac84fec5b4792e66bf.source: Completing either Zinn's Task or The Knowledgeable Asura (secondary)
cad9f1798ea3b1fe52a0e0ac84fec5b4792e66bf.text: 完成 Zinn 的任務或知識豐富的 阿蘇拉（次要）

2fc1b96a83799581d57aa179a619452e5aac6297.source: Not having completed The Battle for Lion's Arch
2fc1b96a83799581d57aa179a619452e5aac6297.text: 尚未完成 科瑞塔戰爭主線任務

85f667a9598316d959730206d9b93b03267c9c26.source: Find the Shining Blade Camp in Talmark Wilderness.
85f667a9598316d959730206d9b93b03267c9c26.text: 在 突馬克荒地 中尋找 光刃公會 營地。

7662cdcf90d9a8e015443905731e2fa9f0fe2992.source: Enlist the aid of the Asura. (Asuran Allies)
7662cdcf90d9a8e015443905731e2fa9f0fe2992.text: 尋求 阿蘇拉 的協助。 （阿蘇蘭盟友）

b85c5e503d4949817068c25c3a52bfbb2797e6fc.source: Enlist the aid of the Ebon Vanguard. (Ebon Vanguard Allies)
b85c5e503d4949817068c25c3a52bfbb2797e6fc.text: 尋求 黑檀 的協助。 （黑檀 盟友）

dddfdb7bd1370a360d904c27dc87dbc11165cb27.source: Defeat the Inquisitors of the White Mantle: Lashona, Bauer, and Lovisa.
dddfdb7bd1370a360d904c27dc87dbc11165cb27.text: 擊敗 白斗篷 的審判官：拉肖納、鮑爾和洛維薩。

73e1011b182370d2d0c2fc6a8775cc43581acea9.source: Defeat the three Mursaat to give hope to the people: Willem the Demeaning, Aily the Innocent, and Koril the Malignant.
73e1011b182370d2d0c2fc6a8775cc43581acea9.text: 擊敗三名 馬賽特 給人民帶來希望：卑鄙者威廉、無辜者艾利和惡毒者科裡爾。

e1cbb5a7e042f0bdec116c1893e2e52bfc636890.source: Locate the Shining Blade's allies, and gather them at Lion's Arch.
e1cbb5a7e042f0bdec116c1893e2e52bfc636890.text: 尋找 光刃公會 的盟友，並將他們聚集到 獅子拱門。

59991c98d4ac7a6d046858f8926a8dd10f66e504.source: Return to Salma for your congratulatory message.
59991c98d4ac7a6d046858f8926a8dd10f66e504.text: 影返 向 Salma 致賀信。

8d3eaf32d74e4f8ccd69715a05b64adc14038493.source: Take the “War in Kryta” quest from Murro in Lions Arch
8d3eaf32d74e4f8ccd69715a05b64adc14038493.text: 接受獅子拱門 穆羅 中的「科瑞塔戰爭」任務

7d519258338c60365d69ab2c48ad55fc3fde768e.source: Locate the Shining Blade camp, which you will find in the southwest corner of Talmark Wilderness (just south of the westernmost bridge across the river).
7d519258338c60365d69ab2c48ad55fc3fde768e.text: 求 光刃營地，它位於 突馬克荒地 的西南角（位於河對岸最西邊的橋梁的南邊）。

be61a00f6a4881ae9800a4175562bf6cb533ee5d.source: Complete Asuran Allies and Ebon Vanguard Allies.
be61a00f6a4881ae9800a4175562bf6cb533ee5d.text: 完成阿蘇蘭盟友和 黑檀 盟友。

99b3bd300f82ecbbc7a5fff2dfa7ec432dae30ee.text: 重新訪問 光刃營地。

be3b2706ae12675e075b6f354e1db4e8fd562881.source: Take (and complete) the 3 inquisitor Wanted quests (Inquisitor Lashona, Bauer, and Lovisa) from the signpost in Lion's Arch Keep.
be3b2706ae12675e075b6f354e1db4e8fd562881.text: 從 獅子拱門要塞 的路標接受（並完成）3 審判官通緝任務（審判官拉肖納、鮑爾和洛維薩）。

7f6e7e37152fdda7c629e4fff06516296b5d2403.source: Follow and complete the storyline by going to Lion's Arch Keep and taking the quests offered by Princess Salma:
7f6e7e37152fdda7c629e4fff06516296b5d2403.text: 前往 獅子拱門要塞 並接受薩爾瑪公主提供的任務，跟隨並完成故事情節：

44f86f5fa82f510796965dd7630d017cf3df511e.source: Lead Prince Rurik into the cave, killing the Grawl along the way, until you reach Vatlaaw Doomtooth. Prince Rurik is strong enough to easily defeat all enemies on his own. As such, if your party includes henchmen, consider placing a Hero flag to leave the henchmen at the starting point, since this will allow you to keep all experience and loot from the enemies.
44f86f5fa82f510796965dd7630d017cf3df511e.text: 帶領 盧瑞克王子 進入洞穴，一路殺死 穴居人，直到到達 Vatlaaw Doomtooth。 盧瑞克王子 足夠強大，可以以一己之力輕鬆擊敗所有敵人。因此，如果你的隊伍中有追隨者，請考慮放置一個 英雄 標誌，將追隨者留在起點，因為這將允許你保留敵人的所有經驗和戰利品。

3a6cd76509de9ef1c2b4c5443721e6dc70511489.source: Completing this mission will trigger the Searing and take you to post-Searing Ascalon.
3a6cd76509de9ef1c2b4c5443721e6dc70511489.text: 完成此任務將觸發 崩壞 並帶您進入 崩壞 後的 阿斯卡隆。

8df971d2300dc58d4f9ff644e8e653db9d6dffa2.source: Mechanically, this area is an explorable area, however it acts the same as a mission.
8df971d2300dc58d4f9ff644e8e653db9d6dffa2.text: 從機制上講，該區域是一個可探索區域，但它的作用與任務相同。

d321848a2da433cc95ac3d2ea5b283cfc268ff7c.source: While waiting for the mission to start, your character will be teleported away from any portal you approach.
d321848a2da433cc95ac3d2ea5b283cfc268ff7c.text: 在等待任務開始時，您的角色將被傳送遠離您接近的任何門戶。

593b1d3d938d0866389b35f93d361d083d9550bc.source: During the briefing, you cannot pass the Ascalonian Guards at the top of the stairs; they will body block you.
593b1d3d938d0866389b35f93d361d083d9550bc.text: 在簡報期間，你無法通過樓梯頂部的阿斯卡隆衛兵；他們會用身體阻止你。

5d68af2578a85a2360daba229e28926b1f988f86.source: Once this mission has started, your character will no longer be able to return to pre-Searing Ascalon; if you resign or logout/login, you will restart the mission. Likewise, you cannot fail the mission.
5d68af2578a85a2360daba229e28926b1f988f86.text: 此任務開始後，您的角色將無法再返回 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 之前的狀態；如果您辭職或登出/登入，您將重新開始任務。同樣，你也不能失敗任務。

b80548a464e670bd86861c72fbe7c0ef7301d725.source: While this is still a pre-searing area, the level 4 grawl warriors here are the post-searing version.
b80548a464e670bd86861c72fbe7c0ef7301d725.text: 雖然這仍然是預灼熱區域，但這裡的 4 穴居戰士關卡是灼熱後版本。

2d9a89deb89cbb304b872c41e296c83341ba9cc5.source: Should Prince Rurik die, the mission will not fail; instead a resurrection notice with a countdown of 3 seconds pops up, with no end effect. Reforged Mode (effect) is active in this mission for players not opted into Reforged Mode.
2d9a89deb89cbb304b872c41e296c83341ba9cc5.text: 如果 盧瑞克王子 死亡，任務不會失敗；相反，會彈出倒數計時為 3 秒的復活通知，但沒有最終效果。對於未選擇進入重鑄模式的玩家，重鑄模式（效果）在此任務中處於活動狀態。

31fdf69b9ca68294fdf001046cc8599f4240d6e5.source: You do not need to unlock M.O.X. or include him in your party to access to this area, even though Chark's dialogue suggests otherwise.
31fdf69b9ca68294fdf001046cc8599f4240d6e5.text: 您不需要解鎖 M.O.X。或將他納入你的隊伍中以進入該區域，即使查克的對話另有暗示。

2e0ab1dbe2d7a00b791f98c14023c2e421b076a2.source: It is possible to enter into areas not otherwise accessible. Return or similar Shadow Steps work well for this.
2e0ab1dbe2d7a00b791f98c14023c2e421b076a2.text: 可以進入其他方式無法進入的區域。 影返 或類似的 闇影 步驟對此非常有效。

52ea5d0502b0a7d158ad6d6e20f85fbab36199f4.source: You can explore Arbor Bay by jumping past the Golem sentries, allowing you to uncover areas near the portals to Shards of Orr, Alcazia Tangle, and Riven Earth. (You can use the same method to go beyond the portal to Vloxen Excavation, but this area can be uncovered through normal game play.)
52ea5d0502b0a7d158ad6d6e20f85fbab36199f4.text: 您可以跳過傀儡哨兵來探索喬木灣，從而發現 歐爾殘跡、Alcazia Tangle 和 撕裂大地 的傳送門附近的區域。 （你可以用同樣的方法越過傳送門到達 Vloxen Excavation，但這個區域可以透過正常的遊戲來發現。）

32ae4155dceba90e639adeceff2e1a287ae53974.source: You can reach the platform where the trial takes place.
32ae4155dceba90e639adeceff2e1a287ae53974.text: 您可以到達進行審判的平臺。

36d5205496f4be7ee6f469a119986c5eadc7a6f9.source: Your character can return to this version of Vlox's Falls by joining a party that includes those witnessing the trial for the first time.
36d5205496f4be7ee6f469a119986c5eadc7a6f9.text: 你的角色可以透過加入一個包括首次目睹審判的人的隊伍來返回這個版本的弗洛克斯瀑布。

d2bbb3bdcc7c177a3b3e177da4447c16abf7e671.source: All Heroes and Henchmen, as well as Ranger pets will be removed from the party for the duration of the trial, but once you return to town, the ranger pet will return.
d2bbb3bdcc7c177a3b3e177da4447c16abf7e671.text: 在試用期間，所有英雄和 傭兵 以及 遊俠 寵物都將從隊伍中移除，但一旦您返回城鎮，遊俠寵物就會返回。

101d73ee417576ae05e91f1cd98a1bae35d2a42f.source: The Trial of Zinn is one part of the Guild Wars Beyond content. It takes place in an alternate version of Vlox's Falls. Speak with Chark outside Vlox's Falls to attend.
101d73ee417576ae05e91f1cd98a1bae35d2a42f.text: Zinn 的審判是 激戰Beyond 內容的一部分。它發生在 Vlox 瀑布的另一個版本中。與弗洛克斯瀑布外的查克交談以參加。

0a57d5e02c77d2222d2a2808660c7152c45faf2b.source: Access to this trial requires completion of the quest Zinn's Task or completion of The Knowledgeable Asura portion of the Eye of the North campaign. You may also join the party of a player who has met those requirements.
0a57d5e02c77d2222d2a2808660c7152c45faf2b.text: 存取此試用版需要完成任務 Zinn's Task 或完成 極地之眼 活動的知識淵博的 阿蘇拉 部分。您也可以加入符合這些要求的玩家的隊伍。

88f38f37cb074adfbb9ba26d5b5ea6a26f2fe5c0.source: Chark: "You're finally here, bookah. Per Asuran custom, no one may speak to the council, defense, or persecution for the duration of the trial. So, quickly conclude any business you have with them, and step into the witness area when you are ready for us to begin."
88f38f37cb074adfbb9ba26d5b5ea6a26f2fe5c0.text: 查克：“你終於來了，布卡。按照阿蘇拉的習俗，在審判期間，任何人都不得與議會、辯護方或迫害者交談。所以，盡快結束你與他們之間的所有事務，並在你準備好讓我們開始時進入證人區。”

f651d86acb25f3d7dbb2ccb0bff288b8de4940f9.source: All party members must have received the reward for The Dawn of Rebellion.
f651d86acb25f3d7dbb2ccb0bff288b8de4940f9.text: 所有黨員都必須獲得《叛逆黎明》的獎勵。

1e36902f4addc2e110817e042f7f42e6f64aec60.source: Rescue each member of Pyre Fierceshot's warband from the Cathedral of Flames.
1e36902f4addc2e110817e042f7f42e6f64aec60.text: 從 火焰大教堂 手中救出 Pyre Fierceshot 戰隊的每位成員。

2252ad2be8cb3b75b1a965fa3c05a54f6a76e604.source: Riverside Assassination, A Little Help From Above, Temple of the Intolerable, Mustering a Response, and The Battle for Lion's Arch.
2252ad2be8cb3b75b1a965fa3c05a54f6a76e604.text: 科瑞塔戰爭主線任務、科瑞塔戰爭主線任務、科瑞塔戰爭主線任務、科瑞塔戰爭主線任務 與 科瑞塔戰爭主線任務。

697be86383a0f74c0d1d65b770c8769e8d2c6072.source: Sometimes, after accepting a quest reward, you will have to exit Lion's Arch Keep and return to progress the storyline.
697be86383a0f74c0d1d65b770c8769e8d2c6072.text: 有時，在接受任務獎勵後，您將必須退出 獅子拱門要塞 並返回以推進故事情節。

f1a2e09e1656488409b2cb4308bb4b2ae88b0034.source: See Queen Salma for your final reward and congratulatory message.
f1a2e09e1656488409b2cb4308bb4b2ae88b0034.text: 向薩爾瑪女王尋求最終的獎勵和祝賀。

66e40ce4a519cdbb8abe19bfa85c7e4df18509ad.source: It is possible to acquire this quest and witness Dialog 2 - Search for Allies without owning Guild Wars Eye of the North, however you cannot complete Asuran Allies or Ebon Vanguard Allies since travel to the Far Shiverpeaks and Tarnished Coast is impossible.
66e40ce4a519cdbb8abe19bfa85c7e4df18509ad.text: 可以在沒有 公會 戰爭 極地之眼 的情況下完成此任務並見證對話方塊 2 - 搜尋盟友，但您無法完成阿蘇蘭盟友或 黑檀 盟友，因為前往 北部席娃山脈 和 灰暗沿岸 是不可能的。

76ab5197af7a688985647724c61d2fc0b3945d83.source: Even though these quests cannot be completed, there will still be a change in spawns in the areas of Kryta.
76ab5197af7a688985647724c61d2fc0b3945d83.text: 即使這些任務無法完成，科瑞塔 區域的生成點仍然會變更。

c5638329c053cb36b757870fc0e06663730ca4fb.source: Sometimes Dialog 2 will play out without first talking to Murro to acquire this quest. If the dialogue completes, then the change in spawns will occur even without having the quest in your quest log.
c5638329c053cb36b757870fc0e06663730ca4fb.text: 有時對話 2 會在沒有先與 穆羅 對話來完成此任務的情況下播放。如果對話完成，那麼即使您的任務日誌中沒有該任務，產生的變化也會發生。

ac59c0f8bd3fb25e5a7ff8daf24c27069f268704.source: As alternative to following this quest, the War in Kryta content can be completed by following the self-guided walkthrough; however, this quest reduces the amount of dialogue and rezoning required to complete the War in Kryta.
ac59c0f8bd3fb25e5a7ff8daf24c27069f268704.text: 作為執行此任務的替代方案，科瑞塔戰爭 內容可以透過遵循自助演練來完成；然而，這個任務減少了完成 科瑞塔戰爭 所需的對話和重新分割槽的數量。

c30905635c947664f9a95422e463ebde02d3a8af.source: During the War (including bounties and missions), henchmen can be as low as level 10 while Peacekeeper and White Mantle foes are level 20 and above.
c30905635c947664f9a95422e463ebde02d3a8af.text: 在戰爭期間（包括賞金和任務），追隨者的等級可以低至 10，而和平衛士和 白斗篷 敵人的等級則為 20 及以上。

a6edad3c411e6e924926f02ba319eced492163d5.source: If you have fewer than seven heroes unlocked, consider playing in hard mode, which raises the henchmen to level 20.
a6edad3c411e6e924926f02ba319eced492163d5.text: 如果您解鎖的英雄少於七個，請考慮玩困難模式，這會將追隨者提升到 20 等級。

6e098c3a171a16c46a1bf3df0d32db61ce92b82d.source: For other suggestions, see the individual walkthroughs.
6e098c3a171a16c46a1bf3df0d32db61ce92b82d.text: 有關其他建議，請參閱單獨的演練。

3ac81817fea940765d9c9207eb547bce8feeecbb.source: If you begin the War in Kryta right after completion of Eye of the North storyline and with lack of progression in Prophecies, note that you will meet foes with Spectral Agony. It's highly advised to get the character's armor infused before exploring the War in Kryta areas and doing the storyline quests.
3ac81817fea940765d9c9207eb547bce8feeecbb.text: 如果您在 極地之眼 故事情節完成後立即開始 科瑞塔戰爭，並且 阿斯卡隆戰記 缺乏進展，請注意，您將遇到帶有幽靈痛苦的敵人。強烈建議在探索 科瑞塔戰爭 區域和執行故事情節任務之前先為角色注入盔甲。

51034bcdcdefc65f58b9c3bbd3f51b38b48fa004.source: Players have reported irregular spawns when the party is composed of 2 or more players at different points in the War in Kryta storyline, notably in Talmark Wilderness. The dialogue when asking about the quest is the same as Murro's default dialogue before completing the quest.
51034bcdcdefc65f58b9c3bbd3f51b38b48fa004.text: 玩家報告稱，當隊伍由 2 或更多玩家組成時，在 科瑞塔戰爭 故事情節的不同點（特別是在 突馬克荒地 中）出現不規則的生成。詢問任務時的對話與完成任務前穆羅的預設對話相同。

2a5a46c8730c48804f0b2f24966f0e61d5df58c1.source: Speak to Zho again when you are ready to begin hunting the Yeti.
2a5a46c8730c48804f0b2f24966f0e61d5df58c1.text: 當您準備好開始狩獵雪人時，再次與 若 交談。

7874320f81a5c85c5c93b6273ad46f5871116c94.source: Help Zho hunt down and kill the Yeti.
7874320f81a5c85c5c93b6273ad46f5871116c94.text: 幫助 若 追捕並殺死雪人。

7178e207baf9dbc8d901882c59451e16f0d1d9b5.text: 請參閱 若 以取得獎勵。

2bcc76ebb07c7264c45239b1305fe674bd62a2d3.source: Talk with Zho, then follow her south to the yeti. It's level 10 but alone, so should be an easy kill for a full party. You won't have enough time to put down more than one trap, so don't be bothered really.
2bcc76ebb07c7264c45239b1305fe674bd62a2d3.text: 與 若 交談，然後跟著她往南到達雪人。它的等級為 10，但單獨的，所以對於一個完整的隊伍來說應該很容易殺死。你沒有足夠的時間來放置多個陷阱，所以不用擔心。

3897bfcd2041de9fdefcd73031235e81e56914b1.source: Dragon Festival quests have been known to interfere with the yeti spawning.
3897bfcd2041de9fdefcd73031235e81e56914b1.text: 眾所周知，龍節任務會幹擾雪人的產卵。
