2b31339ea7f6e718a056966b088fcd35fbd0bf39.source: The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one player. Once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession, whatever that may be. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the quests given by the characters you are sent to in these quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.
2b31339ea7f6e718a056966b088fcd35fbd0bf39.text: 一名玩家可以領取該任務的獎勵八次。每個職業一次。第一次將是你對職業的主要追求，無論是什麼。其他七次只是在選擇第二職業之前與每個職業的校長交談即可。完成他們的任務，以及這些任務中你被送到的角色給予的任務，最終會將其放入你的任務日誌中。

8b2abf2ba3f1964641917bc48a55b689f9c05457.source: Listen to the briefing given by Sir Tydus and Prince Rurik.
8b2abf2ba3f1964641917bc48a55b689f9c05457.text: 聆聽泰德閣下和盧瑞克王子的介紹。

b35ebc54393781a2a86869773fadb385446b2c7f.source: ADDED: Journey to the old bunker with Prince Rurik and defeat Vatlaaw Doomtooth and his minions.
b35ebc54393781a2a86869773fadb385446b2c7f.text: 新增：使用 盧瑞克王子 前往舊地堡並擊敗 Vatlaaw Doomtooth 和他的爪牙。

1f6a0cafd04f4e05a360dc0f3aa90eea7ab3c809.source: The rewards are based on how many Sunspear Ghosts (including Kahdash) were killed during the mission. Nightfall Sunspear Sunspear Ghosts that died 2 - 3 1 0 2 - 3 1 0 5 5 5 50 50 50
1f6a0cafd04f4e05a360dc0f3aa90eea7ab3c809.text: 獎勵取決於任務期間殺死的烈陽之矛幽靈（包括卡達什）的數量。 黑暗逆襲 已死亡的陽戟 陽戟幽靈 2 - 3   1   0   2 - 3   1   0   5   5   5   50   50   50

54fce6045adaee0072dfe5401c66121f9eeaeab9.source: Make your way west to the ruins of Fahranur, The First City. The building has two crushing devices which can be detected by the noises and marks on the ground. Avoid death by walking under them when the weight is lifting - you have 13 seconds to do so. There are also traps that fire Madness Darts (first section) and Burning (second section) at the party.
54fce6045adaee0072dfe5401c66121f9eeaeab9.text: 向西前往 舊城 法蘭努爾 廢墟。該建築物有兩個破碎裝置，可以透過地面上的噪音和痕跡來檢測。當重物舉起時，在它們下面行走可以避免死亡 - 您有 13 秒的時間來這樣做。派對上還有發射瘋狂飛鏢（第一部分）和燃燒（第二部）的陷阱。

62737313e9b17ae3544771baa984f8088368a255.source: Beyond the first crusher awaits Darehk the Quick, who is carrying a tablet. Kill him, retrieve the tablet and place it on the stone pedestal to enter the next area. Your party gains a morale boost each time a gate is opened. The undead will resurrect after a while, so do not stay in any one area too long.
62737313e9b17ae3544771baa984f8088368a255.text: 第一個破碎機後面等待著攜帶平板電腦的「敏捷者」達雷克。殺死他，取回牌匾並將其放在石座上，進入下一個區域。每次開啟大門時，你的隊伍就會士氣提升。不死族過一段時間就會復活，所以不要在任何一個區域停留太久。

2f85c3e2c8e627187734e828212e0aa89c4464c4.source: The second area has two tablets which have to be placed on the pedestals together, as the Sunspear Ghosts will attempt to take them back.
2f85c3e2c8e627187734e828212e0aa89c4464c4.text: 第二個區域有兩塊石板，必須將它們一起放置在基座上，因為陽矛幽靈會試圖將它們奪回。

9e764196640e03e8916cb0954e9a5e4a8270ceb9.source: Single players have to leave the first tablet on the ground (drop it near, but not on the pedestal) somewhere near the third gate and head east to pick up the second tablet, place it, and then re-take the one that was left on the floor on the second pedastal.
9e764196640e03e8916cb0954e9a5e4a8270ceb9.text: 單人玩家必須將第一塊石碑留在第三個門附近的地面上（將其放在附近，但不要放在基座上），然後向東拾取第二塊石碑，放置它，然後重新拿起留在第二個基座地板上的石碑。

2eb50238b7eac13fa19d7d6dc08c1d2b4d7f0dab.text: 火葬烈火加入你的隊伍

1200c5a0dc124c76feedddc106de323b24609bed.source: Most of this dungeon will be fairly simple and straightforward to progress through. Watch out for Charr Flameshielders and their area of effect spells, especially if your party is composed of heroes and henchmen. Also be warned that Charr warriors carry Resurrection Signets and Charr Dominators have Resurrection Chant.
1200c5a0dc124c76feedddc106de323b24609bed.text: 這個地牢的大部分內容都相當簡單且易於通過。留意 夏爾 火焰護盾及其效果範圍法術，特別是當您的隊伍由英雄和追隨者組成時。另請注意，夏爾 戰士攜帶復活徽記，夏爾 統治者攜帶 復活聖歌。

1361d3df496d618dba3b1c62ca45e8ceccf579b8.source: Head along the hallway until you come to what looks like a dining room with several small groups of Charr. Take them out and look for the Charr Prison Guard or Charr Prison Lock. The Charr Prison Guard holds the key that you need to unlock the door. While trying to kill it, the Charr Prison Guard may attempt to run to other groups of Charr counter-clockwise, so progressing clockwise in the room to meet him is advised. Crippling skills or body blocking will speed things up. Once you have the key, unlock the gate to find the first of Pyre's warband brothers, Seer Fiercereign. Head to the other door on this level and down into the next level.
1361d3df496d618dba3b1c62ca45e8ceccf579b8.text: 沿著走廊走，直到看到一個看起來像餐廳的地方，裡面有幾小群 夏爾。將它們取出並尋找 夏爾 監獄警衛或 夏爾 監獄鎖。 夏爾 監獄守衛持有您開門所需的鑰匙。在嘗試殺死它時，夏爾 監獄看守可能會嘗試逆時針跑向其他 夏爾 組，因此建議在房間內順時針前進以與他會面。 致殘 技能或身體阻擋會加快速度。拿到鑰匙後，開啟大門即可找到 Pyre 的第一個戰幫兄弟 預言者 Fiercereign。前往這一層的另一扇門，然後進入下一層。

daf4cee209f7aac398496e4a4c7d4d23a9cde670.source: The second level has only slightly larger groups of Charr. Follow in the general direction of the quest marker and you'll soon see a lone Charr Prison Guard but behind a large group of Charr. Use a bow to draw out the Charr in small groups making it easier to attack them rather than a rush that almost certainly will end in death. He will attempt to run away. Just kill it and grab the key. Follow the path around and towards the next prison. Unlock it to find Cowl Fiercetongue inside, an elementalist. The quest marker will update and point to the exit to the next level. Head towards it. When you start seeing Bloodweavers, be careful. There are several hidden groups of spiders in the chamber with the exit which drop down. A group of spiders will approach when you are close to the exit portal.
daf4cee209f7aac398496e4a4c7d4d23a9cde670.text: 第二層僅具有稍大的 夏爾 群組。沿著任務標記的大致方向，您很快就會看到一個孤獨的 夏爾 監獄守衛，但在一大群 夏爾 後面。使用弓將 夏爾 拉成小群，這樣更容易攻擊它們，而不是衝過去幾乎肯定會導致死亡。他會試圖逃跑。殺掉它然後拿到鑰匙就可以了。沿著小路繞過並前往下一個監獄。 解除 找出裡面的 Cowl Fiercetongue，一個元素師。任務標記將更新並指向下一個層級的出口。朝它走去。當你開始看到織血者時，要小心。房間裡有幾組隱藏的蜘蛛，出口是下降的。當您靠近出口時，一群蜘蛛就會接近。

8c9fa28ad169df14697c5549b0ab73981c16895a.source: On the final level, it is more or less the same. The third Charr Prison Guard is easy to spot. Take it out and grab the third key to free the monk Roan Fierceheart. One more Charr Prison Guard holds the key to the inner temple where Flamemaster Maultooth is located.
8c9fa28ad169df14697c5549b0ab73981c16895a.text: 在最終層面上，或多或少都是相同的。第三個 夏爾 監獄守衛很容易被發現。拿出它並抓住第三把鑰匙來釋放僧侶Roan Fierceheart。另外一名 夏爾 監獄守衛掌握著火焰大師 Maultooth 所在的內部神殿的鑰匙。

4fdd1d1af4481b16022d5c086483fc52fe48fc68.source: When you reach the central chamber of the inner temple, it is wise to kill off the 5 paired groups of warriors that surround the chamber, as they will run to join the fighting later. Maultooth will activate a pair of Charr Effigies. They are dangerous elementalists and lethal against unprepared parties, it is easier to kill them with Pain Inverter. Try to pull them from the side so that the two of them won't activate their highly damaging skills at the same time. Once pulled one at a time, the party can focus on one of the two sides of Charr, and then finally go for the center. Be aware that two Charr Flameshielders and two Charr Axemasters may also join the fray. Maultooth's group of two other Charr can be kept out of the fight with careful pulling. Take them on only after killing the Charr Effigies' group. Focus on Maultooth and interrupt his skills and he will go down quickly.
4fdd1d1af4481b16022d5c086483fc52fe48fc68.text: 當你到達內殿的中央房間時，明智的做法是殺死圍繞房間的 5 成對的戰士群體，因為他們稍後會跑去參加戰鬥。 Maultooth 將啟動一對 夏爾 雕像。他們是危險的元素主義者，對於毫無準備的隊伍來說是致命的，使用 苦痛 逆變器更容易殺死他們。盡量從側面拉他們，這樣他們兩個就不會同時發動高傷害技能。一旦一次拉動一個，隊伍就可以專注於 夏爾 兩側的其中一側，然後最終前往中心。請注意，兩個 夏爾 Flameshielders 和兩個 夏爾 Axemasters 也可能加入戰鬥。 Maultooth 的另外兩個 夏爾 小組可以透過小心拉動來避免戰鬥。只有在殺死 夏爾 雕像小隊後才能與他們對抗。 聚能器 放在 Maultooth 上並打斷他的技能，他很快就會倒下。

e1296d8fd67f3038107d32202ecd64cdc76f6b39.source: Try to move inside Cowl Fiercetongue's Ward Against Harm every time you are attacked by Charr Effigies or Maultooth.
e1296d8fd67f3038107d32202ecd64cdc76f6b39.text: 每次受到 夏爾 雕像或魔牙攻擊時，請嘗試移入 Cowl Fiercetongue 的 守護結界 內。

15210bff4244e0efeb3665a1790c39f8804b9985.source: If your party wipes multiple times and you rack up Death Penalty, try approaching from the right and pulling the Effigies aside. Then when you die, go around the left side, killing Charr and not aggroing the Effigies, and take out Maultooth.
15210bff4244e0efeb3665a1790c39f8804b9985.text: 如果你的隊伍多次擦拭並且你受到了死刑，請嘗試從右側接近並將雕像拉到一邊。然後當你死後，繞到左側，殺死 夏爾 並且不要攻擊雕像，然後幹掉 Maultooth。

d04b971a625bf9a8462d91a0b0a8a5479fc9eb8e.source: If you'd like the final battle to be more on the easy and manageable side, just bring a longbow and equip it in your alternate weapon set. The Charr Flameshielders, each Effigy, and the Axemasters are all separate pulls. Park your party about 2.5 Danger Zone ranges away and pull separate creatures in nice, bite-sized chunks. Interrupts help against the Effigies. Daze also works to good effect.
d04b971a625bf9a8462d91a0b0a8a5479fc9eb8e.text: 如果您希望最終的戰鬥更加輕鬆且易於管理，只需帶一把長弓並將其裝備在您的備用武器組中即可。 夏爾 火焰護盾、每個雕像和 Axemaster 都是單獨的拉力。將您的隊伍停在遠離 2.5 危險區域的範圍內，並將單獨的生物拉成一口大小的小塊。中斷有助於對抗肖像。發呆也有很好的效果。

0c2fe43850e9961b2c9a0f387ad4e8d031329d0e.source: Alternative: There is a very easy way to deal with the final battle. Flag your heroes and henchmen just in front of the stairs, and quickly run with them, continuing up the stairs until you can't go any further. Then turn around, equip your bow, and using Ignite Arrows, fire shot upon shot at Maultooth. He won't attack you, even if your entire party has died, making him totally vulnerable to your attacks.
0c2fe43850e9961b2c9a0f387ad4e8d031329d0e.text: 替代方案：有一個非常簡單的方法來應對最後的戰鬥。在樓梯前標記你的英雄和追隨者，然後快速與他們一起奔跑，繼續上樓梯，直到你無法再進一步為止。然後轉身，裝備你的弓，並使用 爆烈箭，向 Maultooth 連續射擊。即使你的整個隊伍都死了，他也不會攻擊你，這使他完全容易受到你的攻擊。

af3df1b2858bab0c866718610e78eed4c2cd21c7.source: You could rush up the stairs taking the Effigy with you. They will stay at the top of the stairs even if you die. Then just come down the stairs and finish Maultooth off.
af3df1b2858bab0c866718610e78eed4c2cd21c7.text: 你可以帶著雕像衝上樓梯。即使你死了，他們也會留在樓梯頂部。然後下樓幹掉Maultooth。

150fd9e5a138b785125e690fdf71ec013237c575.source: Alternative 2: If you have a strong party that can deal a good amount of damage, rush to Maultooth and focus all damage on him. The mission ends when he is killed and the Effigies take a few seconds to activate and aggro to you, so if you are quick in dispatching Maultooth you can end this quest quickly.
150fd9e5a138b785125e690fdf71ec013237c575.text: 另類2：如果你有一支強大的隊伍，可以造成大量傷害，衝向Maultooth並將所有傷害集中在他身上。當他被殺時任務結束，雕像需要幾秒鐘的時間來啟動並攻擊你，所以如果你能快速消滅毛牙，你可以很快結束這個任務。

8b201f3dbcc911c084d8f23b1701fbb6dd8e8567.source: Consider bringing a snare for the Prison Guards; otherwise, they will run around calling the mobs that you just evaded.
8b201f3dbcc911c084d8f23b1701fbb6dd8e8567.text: 考慮為監獄看守帶來一個陷阱；否則，他們會到處跑，召喚你剛剛躲避的小怪。

f5bf0d569ac712241a89328d012695c4c5e667a5.source: A minion master will prove extremely useful in this quest. If carefully combined with Pain Inverter, a group of minions can cause the Charr Effigies to die in seconds.
f5bf0d569ac712241a89328d012695c4c5e667a5.text: 僕從大師在這個任務中將非常有用。如果與 苦痛 逆變器仔細結合，一群小兵可以導致 夏爾 雕像在幾秒鐘內死亡。

9c8cae1141a70612ff7e69a66751dbcb4a746fef.source: Consider bringing skills that protect against elemental damage since 10 of the 22 types of foes during this quest have skills that cause elemental damage.
9c8cae1141a70612ff7e69a66751dbcb4a746fef.text: 考慮攜帶可以防止元素傷害的技能，因為在此任務中 22 型別的敵人的 10 擁有會造成元素傷害的技能。

6c793d2de7dbf06954d21b19c87136c2bebcbee7.source: Consider bringing Mantra of Flame, since 8 of the 22 types of foes during this quest have skills that cause fire damage.
6c793d2de7dbf06954d21b19c87136c2bebcbee7.text: 考慮帶上 火焰頌歌，因為在此任務中 22 型別的敵人的 8 擁有造成火焰傷害的技能。

62fa25e696646a97a9fa46199bd2f3c8ffc15f99.source: The Ascalon Aegis will grant +25 armor against most forms of damage here.
62fa25e696646a97a9fa46199bd2f3c8ffc15f99.text: 阿斯卡隆神盾 將賦予 +25 護甲以抵禦大多數形式的傷害。

ac5e1f359362fcaf21bbd6d593f4ccea159a26d7.source: Cowl Fiercetongue uses Ward Against Harm, so it is not necessary for a party member to bring it.
ac5e1f359362fcaf21bbd6d593f4ccea159a26d7.text: Cowl Fiercetongue使用守護結界，因此黨員不需要攜帶它。

a25085dcfef7746f0619d533295b478d18f1fc9f.source: Avoid bringing Bloodsong, since Seer Fiercereign uses it.
a25085dcfef7746f0619d533295b478d18f1fc9f.text: 避免攜帶血歌，因為 預言者 Fiercereign 使用它。

0684591fb9ff8bd1c8c6dd34c31fb500321ad168.source: A Charr Prison Guard will drop a Prison Key every time it is killed even if it is resurrected. When you pick up the multiple keys, the notification box and quest log will register the extras, but using a key will use all of them (even though the log will still show you as having some).
0684591fb9ff8bd1c8c6dd34c31fb500321ad168.text: 夏爾 監獄守衛每次被殺死時都會掉落監獄 鑰匙，即使它復活了。當你拿起多個鑰匙時，通知框和任務日誌將註冊額外的東西，但使用鑰匙將使用所有這些鑰匙（即使日誌仍會顯示你擁有一些）。

9d1cfb243a1874fd04abe6733b5d743768448ccf.source: There are Charr corpses on the third level that can be exploited.
9d1cfb243a1874fd04abe6733b5d743768448ccf.text: 第三層有夏爾屍體可以利用。

ad28dfc5720ce7c596f4aba7c7c39a18f34249d2.source: Exterminate nearby enemies to avoid being mobbed before you fight Maultooth.
ad28dfc5720ce7c596f4aba7c7c39a18f34249d2.text: 在與毛牙作戰之前消滅附近的敵人以避免被圍攻。

d18e36e43ab2d9e54d69786821e268320a52f3ea.source: This mission-like quest takes place in an alternative version of Cathedral of Flames that is located in the Charr Homelands.
d18e36e43ab2d9e54d69786821e268320a52f3ea.text: 這個類似任務的任務發生在 火焰大教堂 的另一個版本中，該版本位於 夏爾家園區 中。

5c7ea79bb144addecc27d95af38ec970d06090bc.source: You will be sent to Questions and Answers 20 seconds after completing this quest.
5c7ea79bb144addecc27d95af38ec970d06090bc.text: 完成此任務後，您將被傳送到問題與解答 20 秒。

63f9aece10ddca3b7fcc76db54ac2d5bbea01f70.source: You have 15 seconds to capture Maultooth's elite skill, since his death triggers the end-quest cinematic.
63f9aece10ddca3b7fcc76db54ac2d5bbea01f70.text: 你有 15 秒的時間來捕捉 Maultooth 的精英技能，因為他的死亡會觸發最終任務過場動畫。

bce808a1a6c9a0759e63ca7e9d85ad2997737c8a.source: Warband Training is a mission where your party must defeat Bonwor Fierceblade, Roan Fierceheart, Cowl Fiercetongue, Gron Fierceclaw, and Seer Fiercereign. The object is to call targets one at a time to defeat the group. You should first focus on the monk Roan Fierceheart, then Cowl Fiercetongue. Finally deal with the melee foes one at a time. Note because the group is balled up together, area of effect skills are especially effective and can end the fight quickly. Traps and spirits can be put in place before the Charr turn hostile.
bce808a1a6c9a0759e63ca7e9d85ad2997737c8a.text: 戰隊訓練是一項任務，您的隊伍必須擊敗 Bonwor Fierceblade、Roan Fierceheart、Cowl Fiercetongue、Gron Fierceclaw 和 預言者 Fiercereign。目標是一次呼叫一個目標來擊敗該群體。你應該先關注武僧Roan Fierceheart，然後是Cowl Fiercetongue。最後一次對付一個近戰敵人。請注意，因為團隊是聚集在一起的，所以區域效果技能特別有效，可以快速結束戰鬥。可以在 夏爾 變得敵對之前設定陷阱和烈酒。

17a88bfb2468953767b6e0807facaa7403439cbf.source: Once you complete Warband Training, you are returned to Doomlore Shrine. Talk to Bonwor Fierceblade to finish the quest.
17a88bfb2468953767b6e0807facaa7403439cbf.text: 完成戰隊訓練後，您將返回 末日傳說神殿。與 Bonwor Fierceblade 交談以完成任務。

1e2cef8fbae607fa7e5ea40ddf0077597e10dcc5.source: Alternatively, you can complete this quest by skipping the first three objectives and going to tame the Armored Saurus, followed by Warband Training.
1e2cef8fbae607fa7e5ea40ddf0077597e10dcc5.text: 或者，您可以透過跳過前三個目標並馴服服裝甲蜥蜴，然後進行戰隊訓練來完成此任務。

f9a293408277b7072c23b309468d49c6919f2678.source: Occasionally, the Siege Devourer will become stuck as it follows you. Keep an eye on it to ensure it is following you or you might have to backtrack to find it.
f9a293408277b7072c23b309468d49c6919f2678.text: 有時，Siege 蠍 會在跟隨您時卡住。密切注意它以確保它跟隨您，否則您可能需要原路返回才能找到它。

b7a1b5635c1e63877fce0fec5c03f1a8c70a9d3c.source: Although you can enter Assault on the Stronghold as a party member before this quest, you must complete this quest or the Assault on the Stronghold will not show as completed.
b7a1b5635c1e63877fce0fec5c03f1a8c70a9d3c.text: 雖然在此任務之前您可以作為隊伍成員進入 襲擊根據地，但您必須完成此任務，否則 襲擊根據地 將不會顯示已完成。

cce11d5b1beea12cf152a7a8993079d62d348306.source: All party members must have received the reward for What Must Be Done.
cce11d5b1beea12cf152a7a8993079d62d348306.text: 所有黨員都必須收到「必須完成的任務」的獎勵。

50eb7e2582621abb65e084c76a8310e09b766b38.source: Roan Fierceheart in Dalada Uplands will prepare you for the assault.
50eb7e2582621abb65e084c76a8310e09b766b38.text: 達拉達山地 中的 Roan Fierceheart 將為您做好攻擊準備。

da618eb58e8586277b945178a52f2f3929cffcac.source: Invade the hierophant's stronghold and rescue the Ebon Vanguard.
da618eb58e8586277b945178a52f2f3929cffcac.text: 入侵聖職者的據點並營救 黑檀。

5daf9852877cc0036aee47935233eae4b82f8098.source: Defeat the Charr guards and gain control of the siege devourers.
5daf9852877cc0036aee47935233eae4b82f8098.text: 擊敗 夏爾 守衛並控制攻城吞噬者。

7a6cf66be0ac68dcab8e869a135954fa56114706.source: Target archer groups with siege devourers to cover the armored saurus while it breaks down the front gates.
7a6cf66be0ac68dcab8e869a135954fa56114706.text: 目標 弓箭手與攻城吞噬者組隊，在裝甲蜥蜴攻破前門時進行掩護。

f69b1c3ee798afc8be5543f8c565469049da8166.source: Free the Ebon Vanguard held captive within the fortress.
f69b1c3ee798afc8be5543f8c565469049da8166.text: 釋放被困在要塞中的 黑檀。

b0e493cdafe8b3a091bb77d460e1da1112ba742c.source: Defeat Hierophant Burntsoul and all hostile forces.
b0e493cdafe8b3a091bb77d460e1da1112ba742c.text: 擊敗大祭司燒魂和所有敵對勢力。

f22142c8abdbc00e4093b61babf530e8a86a0db8.source: Walk out of Doomlore Shrine to see Roan Fierceheart at the top of a small hill. Speak with him to witness a cut-scene and be transported to the starting area in Dalada Uplands. Roan Fierceheart and the rest of the warband will be on the hill above a field. You will see one of two Siege Devourers just below and another off to the left; the warband will offer to take care of the closer one while your group handles the one farther away. You can leave your allies alone at the right side until you break down the gate.
f22142c8abdbc00e4093b61babf530e8a86a0db8.text: 走出末日傳說神殿，就能看到小山頂上的Roan Fierceheart。與他交談以見證過場動畫並被傳送到 達拉達山地 的起始區域。羅恩·烈心和戰隊的其他成員將在田野上方的山上。您將在下方看到兩個 Siege 蠍 之一，另一個位於左側；戰隊會主動照顧較近的人，而你的團隊則負責照顧較遠的人。你可以把你的盟友留在右邊，直到你打破大門。

866ec4511812a7d996d2e4f3703e2db4ddebe564.source: There are places in the map where your melee party can get stuck inbetween multiple enemies. This will cause them to run in circles and not attacking anything.
866ec4511812a7d996d2e4f3703e2db4ddebe564.text: 地圖上的某些地方，你的近戰隊伍可能會陷入多個敵人之間。這會讓它們原地打轉，不會攻擊任何東西。

419a0068471733ef09d5ad648610e6edc22409d3.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #4 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
419a0068471733ef09d5ad648610e6edc22409d3.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#4 頁。

b46ae1ad8da12110ee2600c7228f5bd1732b5d11.source: Cowl Fiercetongue will not attack nor use skills that target a foe until the party reaches the last level. He will still be targeted by foes.
b46ae1ad8da12110ee2600c7228f5bd1732b5d11.text: 斗篷猛舌不會攻擊或使用針對敵人的技能，直到隊伍達到最後一個等級。他仍然會成為敵人的目標。

aefa57ff7b3d06a78c6c4a0683149f8451e7760b.source: Hunt down the undead that escaped from the First City. They are drawn to human settlements.
aefa57ff7b3d06a78c6c4a0683149f8451e7760b.text: 追捕從 First 城市 逃脫的亡靈。他們被人類住區所吸引。

8116b651e803a8cccb9e02b8792d3f76e8b51622.source: Clear the ancient undead from Issnur Isles. You have [4..0] of 4 groups remaining.
8116b651e803a8cccb9e02b8792d3f76e8b51622.text: 清除 伊斯諾島 中的古代不死生物。您還剩下 [4..0] 個 4 群組。

4a918c6e0727232f28ea7b57908d25fb4f8fb251.source: Purge the ancient undead from Mehtani Keys. You have [3..0] of 3 groups remaining.
4a918c6e0727232f28ea7b57908d25fb4f8fb251.text: 從 梅坦尼之鑰 中清除遠古不死生物。您還剩下 [3..0] 個 3 群組。

f92e9a30995db05476415b629dc12d52a5eb5cbf.source: Head out southwest from Champions Dawn to the Cliffs of Dohjok and help Nerashi, Lonai and Ahtok fend off two groups of Ancient Undead who will already be engaging them when the party arrives. Once they are finished, speak with Nerashi and make way to Beknur Harbor.
f92e9a30995db05476415b629dc12d52a5eb5cbf.text: 從冠軍黎明向西南方向前往 杜夏懸崖，幫助 Nerashi、Lonai 和 Ahtok 擊退兩群遠古 不死系，當隊伍到達時，他們已經與他們交戰了。完成後，與奈拉什交談並前往貝克努爾港。

b425b9ad3293012509685d8fab3b50cc39254881.source: You should increase your party size. Go through the outpost out into the Issnur Isles, kill the 4 groups of undead as indicated on the map to the right. Then head to the Mehtani Keys, where 3 more groups of undead await.
b425b9ad3293012509685d8fab3b50cc39254881.text: 你應該增加聚會規模。穿過前哨站進入 伊斯諾島，殺死 4 的不死族，如右側地圖所示。然後前往 梅坦尼之鑰，3 還有更多不死族群等著您。

cfe044ecad84aae19ee08838041d46f806566c52.source: Seek out Headmaster Amara in the monastery.
cfe044ecad84aae19ee08838041d46f806566c52.text: 到修道院尋找阿瑪拉校長。

5ca37bbb31a4323b0aea2d1598fcc40320976e42.source: Seek Seer Fiercereign in Dalada Uplands to learn how to safely use the Charr siege devourer.
5ca37bbb31a4323b0aea2d1598fcc40320976e42.text: 在 達拉達山地 中尋找 預言者 Fiercereign，瞭解如何安全使用 夏爾 攻城吞噬者。

80ee006d11ee250902dec5c1bab1850662bcee5e.source: Destroy the Shaman scout patrol using the Charr siege devourer.
80ee006d11ee250902dec5c1bab1850662bcee5e.text: 使用 夏爾 攻城吞噬者摧毀薩滿斥候巡邏隊。

caa6f4df18b84432028f136345df76cba3488da2.source: Meet Gron Fierceclaw in Dalada Uplands.
caa6f4df18b84432028f136345df76cba3488da2.text: 在 達拉達山地 中認識烈爪戈隆。

4159f4b89be54f848d58b803f0074abfe2b09b03.source: Hunt down and tame an armored saurus in the southwest fields of Dalada Uplands.
4159f4b89be54f848d58b803f0074abfe2b09b03.text: 在 達拉達山地 的西南原野追捕並馴服裝甲蜥蜴。

26803677bfbc749f5c16b73ce43b0b37e59d7d62.source: Report to Bonwor Fierceblade in Doomlore Shrine for combat training.
26803677bfbc749f5c16b73ce43b0b37e59d7d62.text: 向 末日傳說神殿 中的 Bonwor Fierceblade 報到進行戰鬥訓練。

1fc1bcf1542de8c0ae2da538c824e390f1fac25e.source: Learn to overcome the Charr warband formation.
1fc1bcf1542de8c0ae2da538c824e390f1fac25e.text: 學習克服 夏爾 戰隊編隊。

9ec7f5b464653c30e181be89f0f74de7ea454072.source: See Bonwor Fierceblade for your reward.
9ec7f5b464653c30e181be89f0f74de7ea454072.text: 請參閱 Bonwor Fierceblade 以獲得獎勵。

111be4f3dbca3b6c9b9fc50af4f167d0ab7ee86c.source: Walk to the first location indicated on your compass. You can easily avoid the groups of Charr by going into the forest to fight Mantids, who are vastly easier foes - albeit vastly more annoying. Speak to Seer and then speak to the Siege Devourer and tell it to follow you. It moves slowly, but if it comes close to enemies they won't attack it.
111be4f3dbca3b6c9b9fc50af4f167d0ab7ee86c.text: 走到指南針上指示的第一個位置。你可以透過進入森林對抗螳螂來輕鬆避開 夏爾 群體，螳螂是更容易對付的敵人 - 儘管也更煩人。與 預言者 交談，然後與 Siege 蠍 交談並讓它跟隨您。它移動緩慢，但如果它靠近敵人，它們就不會攻擊它。

267c8c7f4cbabe088e722a7cd8a1b6ea51bd92b9.source: Once you reach the second location on your compass, tell the Devourer to go into Siege Mode and it will start bombarding enemies, which will come and attack you.
267c8c7f4cbabe088e722a7cd8a1b6ea51bd92b9.text: 一旦你到達指南針上的第二個位置，告訴 蠍 進入攻城模式，它就會開始轟炸敵人，敵人就會過來攻擊你。

be26be51570b0171151f4a4b53292b618fe1f5c9.source: Heading to the third location to Gron Fierceclaw, watch out for Molotov Rocktail along the way, a gigantic Devourer with his own mob of Rockshot Devourers that causes huge damage. Killing it will give you bonus morale and 50 Vanguard reputation points. Gron is nearby. There is also a second, smaller Siege Devourer that you can tame and mount, though this isn't necessary.
be26be51570b0171151f4a4b53292b618fe1f5c9.text: 前往第三個地點 Gron Fierceclaw，沿途留意 石尾 摩洛托夫，一個巨大的 蠍 和他自己的 Rockshot 蠍 暴徒會造成巨大的傷害。殺死它會給你額外計程車氣和 50 先鋒聲譽點。格隆就在附近。還有第二個較小的 Siege 蠍，您可以馴服和安裝它，儘管這不是必需的。

4f760212298dd7d20ff6bf3245672b377ecdb19f.source: Finally, head South to the fourth location where there is an Armored Saurus, which you must tame. It uses many Earth Magic defensive skills that render it immune to damage, but these can be easily bypassed by activating your Siege Devourer nearby. Once done, you can return to Doomlore Shrine and speak with Bonwor to begin the last part of the mission: Warband Training.
4f760212298dd7d20ff6bf3245672b377ecdb19f.text: 最後，向南前往第四個位置，那裡有一頭裝甲蜥蜴，你必須馴服它。它使用許多 地系魔法 防禦技能，使其免受傷害，但可以透過啟動附近的 Siege 蠍 輕鬆繞過這些技能。完成後，您可以返回 末日傳說神殿 並與 Bonwor 交談以開始任務的最後部分：戰隊訓練。

422593802a9a526fc757b9108614763c42a9f8fc.source: Once the Charr in the immediate vicinity of a Devourer are defeated by either you or the warband, you will have captured it; you can then command it to attack the Rangers (Charr Seekers) at either the bluff or the ones at the gate on its side (left/right) of the central path into the stronghold. There are four Seekers at each of these two points whom it will then attack; that makes for a total of four groups of four seekers each. Around every 10 seconds, three melee Charr will spawn at the teleporters located below the seekers at the bluffs on either side and proceed to move to the Devourer on their side and attack it. Should these Charr destroy a Devourer, you will be able to reactivate it in place by defeating the Charr near it; you would then instruct it again to attack the Rangers on its side at either the bluffs or the gate. You can keep the mission at a steady and unchanging state - even in Hard Mode - for so long as your team can keep the Charr at bay on the left side and you have the Devourers on either side attacking the Rangers. Should the Charr on the right side overwhelm the warband (especially in Hard Mode) you should be able to defeat the Charr on that side with your team; that will reactive that Devourer and resurrect the warband members in place and ready to resume defending the Devourer. Trying to take on the Rangers at any of the four positions is unnecessary and suicidal.
422593802a9a526fc757b9108614763c42a9f8fc.text: 一旦 蠍 附近的 夏爾 被您或戰隊擊敗，您將捕獲它；然後您可以命令它攻擊懸崖上的遊騎兵（夏爾 探索者），或者攻擊進入要塞的中央路徑的一側（左/右）大門處的遊騎兵。這兩個點各有四個搜尋者，然後它會攻擊他們；這樣一來，總共分成四組，每組四名探索者。大約每隔 10 秒，三名近戰 夏爾 就會在兩側懸崖處的引導者下方的傳送器處生成，並繼續移動到自己一側的 蠍 並攻擊它。如果這些 夏爾 摧毀了 蠍，您將能夠透過擊敗附近的 夏爾 來重新啟動它；然後您會再次指示它在懸崖或大門處攻擊其一側的遊騎兵。只要您的團隊能夠將 夏爾 擋在左側，並且兩側都有 蠍 攻擊遊騎兵，您就可以將任務保持在穩定且不變的狀態（即使在困難模式下）。如果右側的 夏爾 壓倒了戰隊（尤其是在困難模式下），您應該能夠與您的團隊一起擊敗該側的 夏爾；這將對 蠍 做出反應，並復活戰隊成員，準備繼續保衛 蠍。試圖在四個位置上的任何一個位置對抗流浪者隊都是不必要的，而且是自殺行為。

254c262648548581cca6bf4f7968eb2f0c274e41.source: An Armored Saurus will move to the gate in an attempt to break it. With all of the 16 Charr Seekers alive (two groups of 4 on each side of the gate), the saurus will be unable to come close to the gate. If it dies, another one will spawn shortly thereafter and give it another try. The seekers also have their numbers maintained by spawning. Turn your attention to the Saurus after you've established a steady state as described in the previous section; there is no pressure to hurry that process along or to panic.
254c262648548581cca6bf4f7968eb2f0c274e41.text: 裝甲蜥蜴會移動到大門處並試圖打破它。當所有 16 夏爾 探索者都活著（大門兩側各有兩組 4），蜥蜴將無法靠近大門。如果它死了，不久後就會產生另一隻並再試一次。探索者的數量也透過產卵來維持。當你按照上一節所述建立穩定狀態後，將注意力轉向蜥蜴；沒有壓力加快這一程序或恐慌。

ca8ac42d114bc0d79ff26d168aabf132bf84ccab.source: The hardest part of the mission is making sure that a Saurus survives long enough to batter down the gate, allowing you to enter the camp itself. You are hindered in this attempt by the seeker groups on the cliffs around you; party and warband members that stray within range of these foes can be killed within seconds. Regardless of how you proceed, the following points are important in getting through the gate:
ca8ac42d114bc0d79ff26d168aabf132bf84ccab.text: 任務中最困難的部分是確保蜥蜴能夠存活足夠長的時間來擊破大門，讓你進入營地本身。在這次嘗試中，你會受到周圍懸崖上的探索者團體的阻礙；徘徊在這些敵人範圍內的隊伍和戰隊成員可以在幾秒鐘內被殺死。無論您如何進行，以下幾點對於順利通過大門非常重要：

de88a138f1d35f87aa11a6f0768ace3f299dae50.source: The stone arch over the gate will provide some protection - not much - to the party (including the Saurus).
de88a138f1d35f87aa11a6f0768ace3f299dae50.text: 大門上方的石拱門將為隊伍（包括蜥人）提供一些保護——但不多。

49defb5b07a4c743394211fd8cafeb3a5f99f4bd.source: The Siege Devourers cannot be relied upon to completely clear the stronghold defenses on their own until after the gate is battered down.
49defb5b07a4c743394211fd8cafeb3a5f99f4bd.text: 在城門被攻破之前，不能指望 蠍 自行完全清除要塞防禦。

09b70b5b7284120e9c9c14940fb800a6c257bd41.source: Once the gate is broken, the defenders around the gate areas will cease to spawn.
09b70b5b7284120e9c9c14940fb800a6c257bd41.text: 一旦大門被打破，大門區域周圍的防禦者將停止生成。

7c313eee447243ffb601602957a706c43fe43c2b.source: If a Siege Devourer is destroyed, seekers will cease to spawn on that side of the entrance area.
7c313eee447243ffb601602957a706c43fe43c2b.text: 如果圍攻 蠍 被摧毀，搜尋者將停止在入口區域的那一側產生。

a24fdbe6e483307de7d992445468868698748f1b.text: 策略：圍攻 蠍、遊騎兵、蜥人

8752e3c921d8a89584750de77c7a616740ff9805.source: There are a variety of techniques that you can use (including many on the talk page), which fall roughly into two categories:
8752e3c921d8a89584750de77c7a616740ff9805.text: 您可以使用多種技術（包括討論頁面上的許多技術），大致分為兩類：

ee538add09fe5ee2dc71916d92a291c7301c0270.source: Keep the cliffs cleared of seekers;

5394a8478eb82814adc46987817e3a2a81789d1c.source: Protect the saurus and party members;

1962e5a72a9c69931210f9122423dd45cdf0af2d.source: As soon as you claim the Siege Devourers, target each of them to fire at the Bluffs. Fight off the first wave of ground reinforcements, then head towards the gate, scraping the edge of the bluffs on the right; this puts you out of reach of left-side Rangers and provides some protection from those on the right. From the protection of the arch, use area of effect (AoE) skills to take down the right-side Rangers closest to the gate, followed by any remaining bluff Rangers, and then repeat for the left side. By the time you are done, the Saurus should have been able to take down the gate; if not, keep killing the seekers as they respawn until the gate is finally destroyed.
1962e5a72a9c69931210f9122423dd45cdf0af2d.text: 一旦你佔領了圍攻 蠍，就瞄準他們每個人向懸崖開火。擊退第一波地面增援部隊，然後朝大門前進，刮擦右側懸崖的邊緣；這會讓你遠離左側遊騎兵的攻擊範圍，並為右側遊騎兵提供一些保護。從拱門的保護中，使用效果範圍（範圍性）技能擊倒最靠近大門的右側遊騎兵，然後是剩餘的虛張聲勢遊騎兵，然後對左側重複。當你完成的時候，蜥人應該已經能夠摧毀大門了；如果沒有，請在探索者重生時繼續殺死他們，直到大門最終被摧毀。

a1b2d292c91e72bf9b7b57cf80ec2201559bce90.source: Alternately, you can have the Devourers clear most of the Rangers in a just-in-time fashion to let the Saurus barely survive and do its job. If playing with multiple players, have one each positioned at the Devourers; if playing with a single player, stay at the left Devourers. All other players, Heroes, and Henchmen should stay at the left Devourer and deal with continuously spawning melee Charr. As soon as both Devourers are active, set them to attack the Rangers at the buffs on their respective sides; a solo player would do this at the left Devourer and run to the right Devourer to do it on that side. The Devourers should nearly clear out the buffs just in time for the Saurus to appear in the Allies list. As soon as that happens, set the Devourers to attack the Rangers near the gate on their respective sides. This should create a small time window with very few surviving Rangers but long enough to let the Saurus pass through and break down the gate. Once that happens, the Rangers will stop respawning and you can command the Devourers to change targets till all remaining Rangers are defeated at all four locations; the warband will pitch in as well. Since the Devourers can be reactivated and there is an unlimited supply of Sauruses, there is never a need to panic or be in a hurry. This will work in Hard Mode as well.
a1b2d292c91e72bf9b7b57cf80ec2201559bce90.text: 或者，您可以讓 蠍 及時清除大部分遊騎兵，讓 Saurus 勉強生存並完成其工作。若與多位玩家一起玩，請在 蠍 處各安排一位玩家；若與單人一起玩，請留在左側 蠍。所有其他玩家、英雄和 傭兵 應留在左側 蠍 並應對不斷產生的近戰 夏爾。一旦兩個 蠍 都處於活動狀態，將它們設定為攻擊各自側面的遊騎兵；單人玩家會在左側 蠍 執行此操作，然後跑到右側 蠍 在該側執行此操作。 蠍 應該幾乎能及時清除增益，讓 Saurus 出現在盟友清單中。一旦發生這種情況，設定 蠍 攻擊流浪者各自兩側的大門附近。這應該會創造一個很小的時間視窗，只有很少的遊騎兵倖存，但足夠長的時間讓蜥人通過並打破大門。一旦發生這種情況，遊騎兵將停止重生，您可以命令 蠍 改變目標，直到所有四個地點的剩餘遊騎兵都被擊敗；戰隊也會參與其中。由於 蠍 可以重新啟用，並且 Saurus 的供應是無限的，因此永遠不需要驚慌或著急。這也適用於困難模式。

015dd74d4196bbb17b207153ba830963c5533c8e.source: Use strong protection skills to limit damage on the saurus as it approaches the gate (a bonder works well; see below for other skill suggestions). While the tank is moving, alternate the targets of both siege devourers from bluffs to gate and back until the beast reaches the gate, then point the siege units at the Charr at the gate. Until the gate is broken, leave the party (and the warband) back to defend the devourers (and the party members responsible for protection).
015dd74d4196bbb17b207153ba830963c5533c8e.text: 當蜥蜴接近大門時，使用強大的保護技能來限制對它的傷害（黏合器效果很好；請參閱下面的其他技能建議）。當坦克移動時，將兩個攻城吞噬者的目標交替從懸崖到大門然後返回，直到野獸到達大門，然後將攻城單位指向大門處的 夏爾。在大門被攻破之前，讓隊伍（和戰隊）回去保衛吞噬者（以及負責保護的隊伍成員）。

a4a8a21037df2c79f2b07664040ab931bc00bfdf.source: Once the gate is broken and you enter the stronghold proper, you will find several groups of Charr waiting for you. All but two of the groups will retreat as you approach; finish them off and then have the bulk of your party wait while one player heads up the stairs. As you come close to the ceremonial center (and the Charr hordes), Hierophant Burntsoul will command the Destroyers to be released. Move just close enough to trigger them and then retreat. (If there are multiple players in the party, make sure that those further back keep moving, to prevent the warband from approaching the center area too soon.)
a4a8a21037df2c79f2b07664040ab931bc00bfdf.text: 一旦大門被打破並進入要塞本身，你會發現幾組 夏爾 正在等著你。當你接近時，除了兩個以外的所有群體都會撤退；幹掉他們，然後讓你的大部分隊伍等待一名玩家上樓梯。當您接近儀式中心（和 夏爾 部落）時，主教 Burntsoul 將命令釋放毀滅者。移動到足夠近以觸發它們，然後撤退。 （如果隊伍中有多名玩家，請確保後面的玩家繼續移動，以防止戰隊過早接近中心區域。）

44d734b3e660a30034a655bcda97fa2475764929.source: The Destroyers and Charr will be hostile to each other; lean back and watch them destroy each other. Once they are finished, quickly jump in to finish off the remaining Destroyers while they are still damaged.
44d734b3e660a30034a655bcda97fa2475764929.text: 驅逐艦和 夏爾 將互相敵對；向後靠去，看著他們互相摧毀。當他們完成後，迅速跳進去消滅剩下的驅逐艦，趁他們還受傷的時候。

d79adc83ba4e9ad6d5ad413339fa4ae53f389952.source: The techniques are basically the same, but there is less room for error: protections need to be strong (for the party and saurus) and/or you need to be able to defeat the Charr quickly on the field. With heroes and henchmen, it can be difficult to defend both devourers, so ignore the left-side one and focus your attention on the right, where you have the warband to assist. Although one of the siege units will be lost, the left-side ground forces will also stop spawning, making defense of the remaining unit much easier. Wait for the Armored Saurus to appear and proceed as in Normal mode.
d79adc83ba4e9ad6d5ad413339fa4ae53f389952.text: 技術基本上相同，但犯錯的空間較小：保護需要很強（對於隊伍和蜥蜴）和/或您需要能夠在場上快速擊敗 夏爾。對於英雄和追隨者來說，防禦兩個吞噬者可能會很困難，所以忽略左側的吞噬者，將注意力集中在右側，那裡有戰隊來協助。雖然其中一支攻城單位會損失，但左側地面部隊也會停止生成，使剩下的單位的防禦變得更加容易。等待裝甲蜥出現並按照 普通模式 中的方式進行。

9a9aba27b5b33e7d94ba0418c7cd3bb61cb18af8.source: The remainder of the mission can be done following standard techniques: move forward slowly, pull groups individually, and keep spread out to avoid AoE damage (especially from the Elementalist boss).
9a9aba27b5b33e7d94ba0418c7cd3bb61cb18af8.text: 任務的其餘部分可以按照標準技術完成：緩慢前進，單獨拉動小組，並保持分散以避免 範圍性 傷害（尤其是來自 元素使 boss 的傷害）。

a484a50dc67e502461a4a05fc9ab5bcdc2772d21.source: Use damage reduction or health regeneration skills, e.g. Spirit Bond, Protective Spirit, Shield of Absorption, or Life Bond. Consider using Life Bond with Shield of Deflection and 1 well timed Healing Seed/Seed of Life. Protection spirits are also helpful, e.g. Union and Shelter.
a484a50dc67e502461a4a05fc9ab5bcdc2772d21.text: 使用傷害減少或生命復原技能，例如精神連結、精神守護、吸收盾 或 生命連結。考慮將 生命連結 與 迴避之盾 和 1 適時使用 治癒種子/生命 種子。保護精神也有幫助，例如聯合 和 庇護。

6b315cedd9d67bc9f773a9f892a78bb046a68bb8.source: In Normal mode, Life Barrier is probably sufficient. (When using a hero, disable the skill, target the saurus, and then manually force the hero to use the skill). The bond should protect the first Armored Saurus, allowing for a quick completion of the mission.
6b315cedd9d67bc9f773a9f892a78bb046a68bb8.text: 在 普通模式 中，生命屏障 可能就夠了。 （使用英雄時，停用技能，瞄準蜥蜴，然後手動強迫英雄使用技能）。該債券應該保護第一輛裝甲蜥蜴，以便快速完成任務。

77669bf47dbe2cc3843d13809606e0e064100788.source: Another way is to have a monk with Healing Prayers cast Healing Hands and Healing Breeze on the Armored Saurus with both devourers targeted on the gates. Restful Breeze also works well because when breaking the gates, Saurus doesn't use attacks or skills. The healing and health regeneration should be enough to keep the saurus alive long enough to break the gates even in Hard mode.
77669bf47dbe2cc3843d13809606e0e064100788.text: 另一種方法是讓擁有 治療祈禱 的武士對裝甲蜥蜴施放 治癒之手 和 治癒之風，兩位吞噬者都瞄準大門。 平靜微風 也很有效，因為在打破大門時，Saurus 不會使用攻擊或技能。即使在 困難模式 中，治療和健康再生也應該足以讓蜥蜴存活足夠長的時間來打破大門。

d0dae7cece0bd5b9fbb67c5b160ea80d0de0f59d.source: Ebon title track skills are useful as always against Charr, especially Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support. AoE and skills that do not require line of sight are required to take down the rangers on the bluffs, allowing you to avoid their attacks by staying close to the cliffs.
d0dae7cece0bd5b9fbb67c5b160ea80d0de0f59d.text: 黑檀 標題曲目技能在對抗 夏爾 時一如既往地有用，尤其是 黑檀 暗殺者 支援。需要 範圍性 和不需要視線的技能來擊倒懸崖上的遊俠，讓你可以靠近懸崖來躲避他們的攻擊。

9b78f59344d8d029be6926699f10a282f75d1de7.source: The Charr rangers can deal significant damage to balled-up groups and there is little time to flag heroes or henchmen apart. Ignite Arrows provides a particular threat due to the sheer number of bows directed towards the party. There are several ways to counter this:
9b78f59344d8d029be6926699f10a282f75d1de7.text: 夏爾 遊騎兵可以對集結的隊伍造成巨大傷害，而且幾乎沒有時間來標記英雄或追隨者。由於大量的弓箭指向隊伍，爆烈箭 提供了特殊的威脅。有幾種方法可以解決這個問題：

0b5492f1c67472b08537388e68feaba0814b2218.source: Healing Seed will mitigate each damage packet, sometimes outhealing the damage dealt.
0b5492f1c67472b08537388e68feaba0814b2218.text: 治癒種子 將減輕每個傷害包，有時甚至可以治癒所造成的傷害。

8c406e3f49fb50d44135e079bce838eb1236137b.source: Take cover, using obstacles such as bluffs and crevices to cutoff your enemy's line of sight.
8c406e3f49fb50d44135e079bce838eb1236137b.text: 尋找掩護，利用懸崖和裂縫等障礙物來切斷敵人的視線。

a19f41b837c7b700fad7432edc1f285df6a4deba.source: Use party-wide protections, e.g. Union or Shelter.
a19f41b837c7b700fad7432edc1f285df6a4deba.text: 使用全黨範圍的保護措施，例如聯合 或 庇護。

41ee838bef6e441f14d7bf93d6f83b550fa89238.source: "Shields Up!" can reduce the damage from projectile attacks.
41ee838bef6e441f14d7bf93d6f83b550fa89238.text: 「護盾升起！」可以減少彈體攻擊的傷害。

ec7f9758618759c6e0d0862179544eb4eb64d9ec.source: Winds, for once, might prove to be useful.
ec7f9758618759c6e0d0862179544eb4eb64d9ec.text: 這一次，風可能會被證明是有用的。

7e737f8aab34a41c8d230e30fb80b3ff3f4c3ece.source: Minion masters help during the beginning and end of the mission to stall approaching foes and to soak up aggro.
7e737f8aab34a41c8d230e30fb80b3ff3f4c3ece.text: 小兵大師在任務開始和結束時提供幫助，阻止接近的敵人並吸收仇恨。

1783d41dc0f3b719561e080fd6de79c5b138d882.source: Wards are useful for defending the devourers, for protecting the party as it kills the bluff rangers, and inside the stronghold as you pull Charr towards the stairway.
1783d41dc0f3b719561e080fd6de79c5b138d882.text: 守衛對於保衛吞噬者、在隊伍殺死虛張聲勢遊俠時以及在要塞內將 夏爾 拉向樓梯時都非常有用。

e8cd9e4fed2391e04f463224766888c024d483ff.source: A Spiritmaster can drop his offensive spirits next to the warband devourer and then put them in play again at the left devourer.
e8cd9e4fed2391e04f463224766888c024d483ff.text: 魂師可以將他的進攻精神放在戰隊吞噬者旁邊，然後將它們再次放在左邊的吞噬者身上。

02bbd3c0d0d1a2c638843334c1da1e86011df475.source: This quest is automatically added to the Quest Log upon receiving the reward of the preceding quest, What Must Be Done.
02bbd3c0d0d1a2c638843334c1da1e86011df475.text: 在收到前一個任務「必須完成的任務」的獎勵後，該任務會自動加入 任務 日誌中。

9176e9147d2f8d48bb531ba6c358a26176bd11b4.source: Sometimes the Fierce Warband doesn't go right. In this case, it becomes a bit harder to finish.
9176e9147d2f8d48bb531ba6c358a26176bd11b4.text: 有時，激烈戰隊的進展並不順利。在這種情況下，想要完成就變得有些困難了。

63e303741bfd2b5abe3ce934a22e51d8d00814fd.source: The Charr attacking the Devourers do not award experience to prevent the farming of them with heroes.
63e303741bfd2b5abe3ce934a22e51d8d00814fd.text: 夏爾 攻擊 蠍 不會獎勵經驗，以防止他們與英雄一起耕種。

6470b66c07cf21dbc80754ce8923c0deb39c6564.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
6470b66c07cf21dbc80754ce8923c0deb39c6564.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#5 頁。

8b6d178c447d6aaa1b3f3c2b0231d21b1a910532.source: Defend Kamadan by closing the ruptures. You have [3...0] remaining.
8b6d178c447d6aaa1b3f3c2b0231d21b1a910532.text: 透過閉合裂縫來保衛卡馬丹。您還剩 [3...0]。

1533421a2974fe51c1ea6804f8a290c9c2f7169c.source: After obtaining the quest from First Spear Dehvad, gather your heroes and go through the portal into the Sun Docks and talk with General Yurukaro to be transported to an explorable version of Kamadan, Jewel of Istan. Defeat all of the tormented creatures to close all 3 Chaos Rifts. Then wait until the dialog completes and when a timer ends you will be transported back to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan, where you can collect your reward from First Spear Dehvad.
1533421a2974fe51c1ea6804f8a290c9c2f7169c.text: 從 First 矛 Dehvad 那裡獲得任務後，聚集您的英雄，通過傳送門進入太陽碼頭，並與 Yurukaro 將軍交談，以傳送到 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽 的探索版本。擊敗所有受折磨的生物以關閉所有 3 混沌裂縫。然後等待對話完成，當計時器結束時，您將被傳送回 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽，在那裡您可以從 First 矛 Dehvad 領取獎勵。

d35abd1a93265d0bf0a8bc5a3bfb543a2b839390.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Sister Tai.
d35abd1a93265d0bf0a8bc5a3bfb543a2b839390.text: 搜尋桑泉谷尋找太姊妹。

ffffb7b4ae8fb298685ce7d0960be47a8c6594e9.source: You receive a Starter Holy Rod and the following skills after accepting this quest:
ffffb7b4ae8fb298685ce7d0960be47a8c6594e9.text: 接受此任務後，您將獲得入門版 神聖手杖 和以下技能：

3a307263435fb2dd3f931c51ad186613a5a1c752.source: You may already have Bane Signet and Orison of Healing if your primary profession is monk.
3a307263435fb2dd3f931c51ad186613a5a1c752.text: 如果您的主要職業是僧侶，您可能已經擁有 天懲紋章 和 治癒祈禱。

fb6349379299f71aea7cb1e47a9223775c21f5c0.source: Exit Shing Jea Monastery and head Northwest in Sunqua Vale until you reach Yundin Circle. You will encounter Mantid Drones on the way, but they will not attack unless you attack them first. Speak to Sister Tai to receive your reward.
fb6349379299f71aea7cb1e47a9223775c21f5c0.text: 從 星岬寺 出口駛出，然後沿著 桑泉谷 向西北方向行駛，直到到達雲丁圓環 (Yundin Circle)。途中你會遇到螳螂無人機，但除非你先攻擊它們，否則它們不會攻擊。與泰姐交談以獲得獎勵。

4fdcba7e98b6d77bbf2c5371ffd514dd3cb8b7ff.text: 阿斯卡隆學院 已完成

4a2eed05613661b8908a35336782e3c97eb88591.source: Return to Ascalon City and speak to Warmaster Tydus.
4a2eed05613661b8908a35336782e3c97eb88591.text: 影返 至 阿斯卡隆城 並與 戰鬥教官泰德 通話。

b5a61194c9d1679b633f76826e5b1fd04a71000b.source: Head north across the bridge. You should see a gate guard outside the entrance to Ascalon City. Go inside and seek out Warmaster Tydus near a fountain on a hill northwest of the entrance.
b5a61194c9d1679b633f76826e5b1fd04a71000b.text: 過橋往北走。您應該在 阿斯卡隆城 入口外看到一個門衛。走進去，在入口西北邊一座小山上的噴泉附近尋找 戰鬥教官泰德。

7e5c5a8a1a235673a807f818db4f898dec800978.source: This quest is immediately available after you complete the mission Ascalon Academy. If you do not grab this quest before you or a party member enter the city, then you do not get another chance to get the quest.
7e5c5a8a1a235673a807f818db4f898dec800978.text: 完成任務 阿斯卡隆學院 後，此任務立即可用。如果你在你或隊友進入城市之前沒有接受這個任務，那麼你就沒有機會再接受這個任務。

67f6e3ecda97aaa59b07d7a3c56b950d7335dad3.source: Convince the Norn to ally with you.
67f6e3ecda97aaa59b07d7a3c56b950d7335dad3.text: 說服 諾恩 與您結盟。

ac7d8cd6ee48c13f59b05d2557c6a4b6545cfcce.source: Speak to Ogden Stonehealer in the Hall of Monuments.
ac7d8cd6ee48c13f59b05d2557c6a4b6545cfcce.text: 與 史蹟殿堂 中的奧格登石療者交談。

32a457c7616c1d876464c555c6d79936ced0cbe4.source: Seek out Jora near the Eye of the North.
32a457c7616c1d876464c555c6d79936ced0cbe4.text: 在 極地之眼 附近尋找 喬拉。

9abd7bbf9d9cfdb35f2fde839dd180dbc28c4f96.source: Help Jora track the Nornbear in the Far Shiverpeaks. (Tracking the Nornbear)
9abd7bbf9d9cfdb35f2fde839dd180dbc28c4f96.text: 幫助 喬拉 追蹤 北部席娃山脈 中的 Nornbear。 （追蹤諾熊）

985c00ffd08b4e4294547d5655bbf70663dbc9bd.source: Assist Jora, despite her reservations, in her hunt. Gain her friendship. (Curse of the Nornbear)
985c00ffd08b4e4294547d5655bbf70663dbc9bd.text: 儘管 喬拉 有所保留，仍協助她進行狩獵。贏得她的友誼。 （諾恩熊的詛咒）

543e680b428e745aca331e58a9769435b3c4d06c.source: OPTIONAL: Go to Sifhalla. Ask Sif for information on Olaf Olafson and Egil Fireteller.
543e680b428e745aca331e58a9769435b3c4d06c.text: 選用：前往 襲哈拉。請向 Sif 詢問有關 尤拉夫 尤拉夫森 和 Egil Fireteller 的資訊。

1b749d2d8b72894eb620b04612bb28740062966c.source: Speak with Olaf Olafson in Olafstead. Help Ogden gain allies among the Norn. (A Gate Too Far)
1b749d2d8b72894eb620b04612bb28740062966c.text: 與 尤拉夫之地 中的 尤拉夫 尤拉夫森 交談。幫助奧格登在 諾恩 中贏得盟友。 （一道過遠的門）

740a84c4ced94e1bbd9c17cd2ba09d2a6b49f57b.source: Speak with Egil Fireteller in Jaga Moraine. Help Jora regain her honor among the Norn. (Blood Washes Blood)
740a84c4ced94e1bbd9c17cd2ba09d2a6b49f57b.text: 與賈加冰磧的埃吉爾消防員交談。幫助 喬拉 在 諾恩 中重新獲得榮譽。 （血債血償）

8a8cdf2bef6a90e39eca04e66a7a967bcb751c02.source: See Jalis Ironhammer for your reward.
8a8cdf2bef6a90e39eca04e66a7a967bcb751c02.text: 請見賈利斯·鐵鎚以獲得獎勵。

1c9356068408868d6f9ba5745b8e50a3b65c4275.source: This quest is basically an "umbrella" for the three primary quests of Curse of the Nornbear, Blood Washes Blood, and A Gate Too Far, leading towards gaining the Norn as your allies. The first step is talking with Jora outside the Eye and accepting her quest; it ends with you entering the dwarven region and speaking to Jalis Ironhammer for your reward.
1c9356068408868d6f9ba5745b8e50a3b65c4275.text: 任務基本上是 諾恩熊的詛咒、血債血償 和 一道過遠的門 三個主要任務的“保護傘”，從而使 諾恩 成為您的盟友。第一步是與眼外的 喬拉 交談並接受她的任務；最後你進入矮人地區並與賈利斯·鐵鎚交談以獲得獎勵。

e6ed65457bcd107d11b6884da67bdf77523c430f.source: Upon completion of the quest, you are automatically under the effect of Call of the Eye after you rezone.
e6ed65457bcd107d11b6884da67bdf77523c430f.text: 完成任務後，你在重新區域後會自動受到眼睛召喚的影響。

e056ed7f02bb4858da156aeb1fd4219270e65363.source: Tell Field General Hayao to deploy the Zaishen.
e056ed7f02bb4858da156aeb1fd4219270e65363.text: 告訴隼雄野戰將軍部署再神號。

4352c3b73ffca847d5666b19fdfb6b8d90e321b5.source: Talk to Castellan Puuba about Jerek.
4352c3b73ffca847d5666b19fdfb6b8d90e321b5.text: 與卡斯特蘭普巴談論傑瑞克的事。

d8ac233577ceb02960000b895768d438628cc2de.source: See Castellan Puuba for your reward.
d8ac233577ceb02960000b895768d438628cc2de.text: 前往卡斯特蘭普烏巴領取獎勵。

a34546533fb394562acaa7f0a4a031ff7d105254.source: Head over to the Sun Docks, talk to Field General Hayao. Once done, map travel to the Sunspear Great Hall to talk to Castellan Puuba.
a34546533fb394562acaa7f0a4a031ff7d105254.text: 前往太陽碼頭，與陸軍將軍隼雄交談。完成後，在地圖上前往 日戟大會堂 與 Castellan Puuba 交談。

c656eee6e675f3ae0d2da902c2f30d1c2eae03ee.source: Starting from Kodlonu Hamlet, head west into the Issnur Isles to find Jerek - it is closer than travelling from Beknur Harbor and there are no foes to fight. Pacify Jerek when he turns aggressive.
c656eee6e675f3ae0d2da902c2f30d1c2eae03ee.text: 從 Kodlonu Hamlet 出發，向西進入 伊斯諾島 尋找 Jerek - 這比從 Beknur 港口出發更近，而且沒有敵人可以戰鬥。當傑瑞克變得咄咄逼人時安撫他。

5eee3ba2612dde65c9de7d0fb05cdac9c42db77a.source: Speak to Sister Tai when you are ready to begin your challenge.
5eee3ba2612dde65c9de7d0fb05cdac9c42db77a.text: 當你準備好開始挑戰時，與泰姐交談。

a7e12c5828773a71a5eba9d4ee8d97cf9c888923.source: Select a Monk Student to relieve.
a7e12c5828773a71a5eba9d4ee8d97cf9c888923.text: 選擇要替補的 僧侶 學生。

bacf6efddf9ac75a9ddd149435e024831a1f3894.source: Keep your assigned Warrior Student alive while they train.
bacf6efddf9ac75a9ddd149435e024831a1f3894.text: 讓指定的 戰士 學生在訓練時保持活力。

6fc354120eeddd7dbf86f9f92fb7befe3f34b1b0.source: See Sister Tai for your reward after the training time is up.
6fc354120eeddd7dbf86f9f92fb7befe3f34b1b0.text: 訓練時間到了就去找太姐領取獎勵吧。

0ce02e993450c29304afe93887f1246bdc682c8d.source: Sister Tai will give you the following skills on accepting the quest:
0ce02e993450c29304afe93887f1246bdc682c8d.text: 接受任務後，泰姐會給你以下技能：

17e9c2f63d333e65711acb69cdcdee607aff4420.source: In theory you should complete this quest through the correct application of healing and protection spells. However, the easiest way to complete the quest is to simply aggro the enemy warrior yourself. Sister Tai will heal you from the warrior's attacks and you can simply wait out the timer. This method is especially useful for Warriors taking a Monk Secondary, as they have less energy and less energy regeneration.
17e9c2f63d333e65711acb69cdcdee607aff4420.text: 理論上，你應該透過正確應用治療和保護法術來完成這個任務。然而，完成任務最簡單的方法就是親自攻擊敵方戰士。泰姐姐會治癒你免受戰士攻擊的傷害，你只需等待計時器結束即可。此方法對於採用 僧侶 輔助的戰士特別有用，因為他們的能量較少，能量再生也較少。

31cda9947a847248af0aaecf449758615b6c9624.source: You can also complete the quest by dealing enough damage to the hostile Warrior Student so that he turns non-hostile. An easier way for warriors would be to simply attack the enemy monk student until he is no longer hostile.
31cda9947a847248af0aaecf449758615b6c9624.text: 您還可以透過對敵對的 戰士 學生造成足夠的傷害，使他不再具有敵意來完成任務。對於戰士來說，一個更簡單的方法是簡單地攻擊敵方僧侶學生，直到他不再有敵意為止。

7c74c68e590d276d0848e2ccb82ff20db01cbdbb.source: If you kill any Mantids in range of the Monk Students after completing the quest, they will sometimes resurrect them.
7c74c68e590d276d0848e2ccb82ff20db01cbdbb.text: 如果您在完成任務後殺死 僧侶 學生範圍內的任何螳螂，他們有時會復活它們。

cbbed9e3c9795b8c9b6b804224aa014f257da362.source: If you kill the hostile Warrior Student with spike damage the Monk Student will resurrect him. The warrior will remain hostile in this case.
cbbed9e3c9795b8c9b6b804224aa014f257da362.text: 如果您以尖峰傷害殺死敵對的 戰士 學生，僧侶 學生將復活他。在這種情況下，戰士將保持敵意。

6826fbf78d90d86ec684e328623e1e670d05f3bc.source: Sometimes neither the warriors nor the monk students will appear, so there is nothing to heal. No solution known.
6826fbf78d90d86ec684e328623e1e670d05f3bc.text: 有時武者和僧侶都不會出現，所以沒有什麼可以治癒的。沒有已知的解決方案。

98a08e2b7c464b54fda3155e650e457411bcdccb.source: Talk to Squire Zachery at the Great Northern Wall.
98a08e2b7c464b54fda3155e650e457411bcdccb.text: 與北長城的鄉紳札切裡交談。

1216b1464a24cf77836e8b2cf5b52cbd7521312d.source: This is a straightforward, transitional quest designed to guide you toward the first cooperative mission of the Prophecies campaign after the Searing.
1216b1464a24cf77836e8b2cf5b52cbd7521312d.text: 這是一個簡單的過渡性任務，旨在引導您完成 崩壞 之後 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動的第一個合作任務。

0cb38cb3b52d24e03229813c5b121a974111b60e.source: Walk up the stairs north of Warmaster Tydus and head northeast until you see the exit for the Great Northern Wall. Inside the outpost, speak with Squire Zachery to redeem the quest reward.
0cb38cb3b52d24e03229813c5b121a974111b60e.text: 沿著戰鬥教官泰德北面的樓梯往上走，然後往東北方向走，直到看到北長城的出口。在前哨站內，與鄉紳扎切裡交談以兌換任務獎勵。

7f78e9648d47535415290a187fbd7ceff2e9d532.source: Seek out Brother Pe Wan in Kinya Province.
7f78e9648d47535415290a187fbd7ceff2e9d532.text: 在 欣彌領地 中尋找 Pe Wan 弟兄。

4c0bb465d962b9ba3ce0ce4671247b85c35ec51f.source: Pe Wan can be found just on the other side of the portal from Sunqua Vale.
4c0bb465d962b9ba3ce0ce4671247b85c35ec51f.text: Pe Wan 位於 桑泉谷 門戶的另一側。

4ed57fd12116afe20a5f92d8f09b1ca2b2b2509f.source: Help Jora track the Nornbear in the Far Shiverpeaks
4ed57fd12116afe20a5f92d8f09b1ca2b2b2509f.text: 幫助 喬拉 追蹤 北部席娃山脈 中的 Nornbear

ad319c2c6dc2b0bfb794d433b33867a907bfebd7.source: Seek out Gunnar Poundfist in Gunnar's Hold.
ad319c2c6dc2b0bfb794d433b33867a907bfebd7.text: 在 甘拿的佔領地 中尋找 拳擊 甘拿。

4553074f762ae1f18b02511800ba818a03248d23.text: 在 襲哈拉 中找到 Sif。

a7139fbed7161a29e73679d9ee7e2226dea4b1b7.source: See Sif Shadowhunter for your reward.
a7139fbed7161a29e73679d9ee7e2226dea4b1b7.text: 請參閱 獵影者 希夫 以取得獎勵。

cda891686b83fb8250016867f6df8569d46f7d4f.source: Head out from Eye of the North into Ice Cliff Chasms to find Jora standing outside. Talk to her to find out how Ogden may be able to gain her help. After the exchange, head north towards Norrhart Domains. Upon arrival, your party will encounter the Savage Nornbear. Defeat it and it will flee. There's nothing else you can do so head northeast towards Gunnar's Hold to talk to Gunnar Poundfist.
cda891686b83fb8250016867f6df8569d46f7d4f.text: 從 極地之眼 前往 冰崖裂口，發現 喬拉 站在外面。與她交談，瞭解奧格登如何獲得她的幫助。交換完畢後，向北前往諾拉特領地。抵達後，您的隊伍將遇到野蠻諾恩熊。打敗它，它就會逃跑。您無能為力，因此請向東北方向前往 甘拿的佔領地 與 拳擊 甘拿 交談。

f913e486b1b9fbc4e197bb6ec942f6f39a31481f.source: Gunnar will direct you to look for Sif Shadowhunter. Head back into Norrhart Domains and head northwest this time, towards Drakkar Lake. When you arrive at Drakkar Lake, your party will encounter the Savage Nornbear again. Defeat it and it will flee yet again. Head straight north to the northeastern corner to reach Sifhalla. There, Sif will ask your party to help defend Sifhalla from the Savage Nornbear's raid. You will be transported into an explorable version of Sifhalla where the Savage Nornbear will spawn momentarily. Just defeat it and watch a cutscene. After that, you will be brought back to Sifhalla and you can claim your reward and the follow-up quest (added automatically).
f913e486b1b9fbc4e197bb6ec942f6f39a31481f.text: Gunnar 將引導您尋找 獵影者 希夫。返回諾拉特域並向西北方向行駛，前往 卓卡湖。當您到達 卓卡湖 時，您的隊伍將再次遇到野蠻諾恩熊。打敗它，它就會再次逃跑。一直往北前往東北角即可到達 襲哈拉。在那裡，希芙會要求你的隊伍幫助保衛 襲哈拉 免受野蠻諾恩熊的襲擊。您將被傳送到 襲哈拉 的可探索版本，在那裡野蠻諾恩熊將立即生成。只要擊敗它並觀看過場動畫即可。之後，您將被帶回 襲哈拉，您可以領取獎勵和後續任務（自動新增）。

6983171b1dc1480b86196cca7d23f04f95ab92bb.source: You are sent to Attack of the Nornbear towards the end of the quest.
6983171b1dc1480b86196cca7d23f04f95ab92bb.text: 在任務接近尾聲時，你將被送到諾恩熊的攻擊。

00748bca474e7fcf94a2102f97c5e7eb4d33c021.source: The dialogue for Drakkar Lake will activate at every entrance to Drakkar Lake, should one go near them. Sometimes the Nornbear doesn't flee when it's supposed to. In these cases whenever its health reaches 0, it instantly goes back to 25%. To break this bug, flag your heroes/henchmen well away from it.
00748bca474e7fcf94a2102f97c5e7eb4d33c021.text: 如果有人靠近 卓卡湖 的每個入口，卓卡湖 的對話就會啟動。有時，諾熊在該逃跑的時候卻沒有逃跑。在這些情況下，只要其運作狀況達到 0，它就會立即回到 25%。要打破這個錯誤，請將你的英雄/追隨者標記為遠離它。

6d4d495d49df7caf98d1135caec8fb95d50d1863.source: All party members must have received the reward for Tracking the Nornbear.
6d4d495d49df7caf98d1135caec8fb95d50d1863.text: 所有小隊成員都必須獲得追蹤諾恩熊的獎勵。

309a00715b4975cf1cedd68d067fc129e5f4f025.source: Speak to Sif in Sifhalla to begin the hunt. (disappears from Quest Log after entering Mission)
309a00715b4975cf1cedd68d067fc129e5f4f025.text: 與 襲哈拉 中的 Sif 交談以開始狩獵。 （進入 主線任務 後從 任務 日誌中消失）

0dcae3bfa89d758f2f1c4c1c39f12b94c34f46d9.source: Join Jora and Sif. Get the Volfen Blessing from the Shrine of the Wolf Spirit.
0dcae3bfa89d758f2f1c4c1c39f12b94c34f46d9.text: 加入 喬拉 和 Sif。從 狼 精神神殿取得 Volfen 祝福。

83f1ec7efa3f7ade63d065594e468f4211436f21.source: Invoke the Volfen Blessing to receive the abilities of the wolf spirit.
83f1ec7efa3f7ade63d065594e468f4211436f21.text: 呼叫沃爾芬 祝福 即可獲得狼靈的能力。

3267dcf697aff30eb816d611a7f83ebf6d5c5755.text: 從 Sif 接收 Volfen 祝福。

06296e34bfb0f4d1ce81b0696fa1f72828a70b3f.source: Use the skill Volfen Bloodlust to follow the scent of the Nornbear.
06296e34bfb0f4d1ce81b0696fa1f72828a70b3f.text: 使用沃爾芬嗜血技能來追蹤諾恩熊的氣味。

203d8dfac2f33cee24e8501f26e0ae658513efe4.text: 繼續追蹤斯瓦尼爾的蹤跡。

0b4ec2373974f35bd09f76164496d93678951f2c.source: Pursue Svanir. Don't let him escape.
0b4ec2373974f35bd09f76164496d93678951f2c.text: 追擊斯瓦尼爾。別讓他逃走。

55a84f3d1560438585ba634095466426a28b1cfa.text: 喬拉 加入您的隊伍

d156d97c98128ef62551c00a3ef1961699a2cf54.source: The war with the Charr is at Ascalon's gates. Report to Warmaster Tydus to join the battle.
d156d97c98128ef62551c00a3ef1961699a2cf54.text: 戰爭與 夏爾 位於 阿斯卡隆 的大門。報告至 戰鬥教官泰德 加入戰鬥。

0120c65fc80d18460896133d618afa17014e947c.source: Since this quest is a simple breadcrumb to point in the direction of the next primary quest, it is marked as completed upon accepting it. Return to Warmaster Tydus in Ascalon City to accept the reward.
0120c65fc80d18460896133d618afa17014e947c.text: 由於此任務是一個簡單的麵包屑，指向下一個主要任務的方向，因此在接受它後將其標記為已完成。 阿斯卡隆城 中的 影返 到 戰鬥教官泰德 以接受獎勵。

9c59bc8ddd1f894ea360baaa97e2897343bc8499.source: Unlike other Ascalon quests, this quest is available to characters from other campaigns, despite chronologically coming before the Ascalonians' departure from Ascalon.
9c59bc8ddd1f894ea360baaa97e2897343bc8499.text: 與其他 阿斯卡隆 任務不同，此任務可供其他戰役中的角色使用，儘管按時間順序是在阿斯卡隆人離開 阿斯卡隆 之前進行的。

22a3950e34745d3e40699a0cde37140cada9c950.source: Travel to the Mehtani Keys and investigate Tahlkora's allegations.
22a3950e34745d3e40699a0cde37140cada9c950.text: 前往 梅坦尼之鑰 並調查 Tahlkora 的指控。

0616477a8d961d580b95134f3d19cba2d8b5e464.text: 塔爾科拉加入你的隊伍。

658b60ea0e65a51c5f1d7014458d2e2c1f162dd5.source: Head outside the Sunspear Great Hall to talk to Jerek. Then travel to Kodlonu Hamlet and head out into Mehtani Keys. Tahlkora will follow your party. Simply follow the quest marker (be wary of mandragor popups along the way) to find a Cryptic Scroll Piece and Bag of Kournan Coins. Pick up the scroll piece and report back to Jerek.
658b60ea0e65a51c5f1d7014458d2e2c1f162dd5.text: 前往 日戟大會堂 外面與 Jerek 交談。然後前往 Kodlonu Hamlet 並前往 梅坦尼之鑰。塔爾科拉將跟隨您的隊伍。只需跟隨任務標記（小心沿途的曼德拉戈彈出視窗）即可找到神秘的 卷軸 碎片和 袋子 庫南硬幣。拿起捲軸並向傑裡克報告。

11ff7bf6d4851657c0df1ba3b0247d0cd51b81d3.source: You may wish to visit the Treasure Chest on the island to the south of where the clues were found.
11ff7bf6d4851657c0df1ba3b0247d0cd51b81d3.text: 您可能希望參觀線索發現處南邊島嶼上的寶藏 寶箱。

f736a14f30ace524635ea3e430f5c9f3e71a2361.source: A Cryptic Scroll Piece and a Bag of Kournan Coins spawn in Mehtani Keys as part of this quest. While they can, and should, be picked up, they will not appear in inventory.
f736a14f30ace524635ea3e430f5c9f3e71a2361.text: 作為此任務的一部分，一個神秘的 卷軸 碎片和一個 袋子 庫南硬幣會在 梅坦尼之鑰 中產生。雖然它們可以而且應該被拾取，但它們不會出現在庫存中。

aaf7648ff6d4fc885c33ac901c58c8d9d391ec8b.source: If you follow Tahlkora after the dialogue ends, she will run into the Champion's Dawn portal.
aaf7648ff6d4fc885c33ac901c58c8d9d391ec8b.text: 如果你在對話結束後關注塔爾科拉，她會遇到 勇士曙光 門戶。

09df2c6b432cea5505d1eb2151baeda74a98c5cf.source: Tahlkora will heal and enchant foes while this quest is active.
09df2c6b432cea5505d1eb2151baeda74a98c5cf.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，塔爾科拉將治癒並迷惑敵人。

83d7d37d48d39bcbfd5d9c6306d4dc0755ba98aa.source: You have [1...6] of 6 pieces in your possession.

8979bb58ed8edfb6af7f0ad172e4f20322c0a971.source: Get the last piece of the Cryptic Scroll from Captain Mindhebeh on the Cliffs of Dohjok.
8979bb58ed8edfb6af7f0ad172e4f20322c0a971.text: 從 杜夏懸崖 上的 Mindhebeh 船長處取得最後一塊神秘 卷軸。

3aed575997e9fdd5a8fef538fca33b003920d00d.source: See Savage Nunbe for your reward.
3aed575997e9fdd5a8fef538fca33b003920d00d.text: 見野蠻人努貝以獲得獎勵。

50abd75abccf96b6d5f655a8bb9dfb81f67db18a.source: Enter Cliffs of Dohjok with Tahlkora in your party, the first marking is outside Champion's Dawn. Walk to each marker and kill the corsair bosses there, they will drop a Cryptic Scroll Piece if you do, after you do this 4 times walk to Captain Mindhebeh and he will teleport you to Blacktide Den. There Savage Nunbe will give you the last piece. The bosses spawn with protection but they can be pulled separately.
50abd75abccf96b6d5f655a8bb9dfb81f67db18a.text: 輸入 杜夏懸崖，Tahlkora 在您的隊伍中，第一個標記位於 勇士曙光 之外。走到每個標記處並殺死那裡的海盜頭目，如果你這樣做，他們會掉落一個神秘的 卷軸 碎片，在你完成此 4 次後，走到 Mindhebeh 船長那裡，他會將你傳送到 Blacktide Den。 Savage Nunbe 會給你最後一塊。 Boss 生成時受到保護，但可以單獨拉動。

506239f277cd83404454bc89e604c1cc4811ce57.source: This quest can be pretty hard due to the bosses, a good strategy is to start from Beknur Harbor or Blacktide Den since that allows you to have a party of 8 instead of 4.
506239f277cd83404454bc89e604c1cc4811ce57.text: 由於老闆的原因，這個任務可能相當困難，一個好的策略是從 Beknur Harbour 或 Blacktide Den 開始，因為這可以讓你擁有一支 8 而不是 4 的隊伍。

1bcc6eecc6ddf6e4ba8f45e9228d56d9e90aeb3b.source: Tahlkora does not need to survive to complete this quest.
1bcc6eecc6ddf6e4ba8f45e9228d56d9e90aeb3b.text: 塔爾科拉不需要生存來完成這個任務。

0f8d92c091bfcd96d02e4dcd5fb3038fd70ad4e8.source: Although your character is the one picking up the map pieces, the text dialogue shows you handing the pieces to Tahlkora.
0f8d92c091bfcd96d02e4dcd5fb3038fd70ad4e8.text: 雖然你的角色是撿起地圖碎片的人，但文字對話顯示你將碎片交給了塔爾科拉。

9278c066a86512e31f711135ea9bd2741b2ac4c9.source: Zoning out of the Cliffs of Dohjok before completing the quest causes it to be reset. Although your quest log will show you having collected 1 of the 6 scroll pieces, this is the piece acquired earlier during Big News, Small Package.
9278c066a86512e31f711135ea9bd2741b2ac4c9.text: 在完成任務之前劃出 杜夏懸崖 會導致其重設。雖然你的任務日誌會顯示你已經收集了 6 捲軸碎片中的 1，但這是先前在大 最新訊息 小包裝期間獲得的碎片。

262d283b6073273279baab534924a833238d947e.source: Find the 2 ingredients needed to make an antidote for the coming sickness, nong berries and tai ling buds. You have found [0..2] of 2 ingredients.
262d283b6073273279baab534924a833238d947e.text: 找到製作即將到來的疾病解毒劑所需的 2 成分、農漿果和尾靈芽。您已找到 2 成分的 [0..2]。

3af19fb8f50f54d9b71b9cb9492fe538ad0d68cc.source: Return to Brother Pe Wan for your reward.
3af19fb8f50f54d9b71b9cb9492fe538ad0d68cc.text: 影返 送給 Pe Wan 弟兄，作為獎勵。

ac5b7ef88ca4fb0bc9feabadf7daeb36cef87d5b.source: On accepting the quest, Brother Pe Wan gives you the following skills:
ac5b7ef88ca4fb0bc9feabadf7daeb36cef87d5b.text: 接受任務後，佩萬弟兄會給你以下技能：

ec0688a1abe8ada3d85ad2b33b5bb642ebaa074a.source: The two ingredients are shown by compass markers just north of where you start. There are a few low-level enemies you might encounter on the way, but you only need to bring the quest items to Brother Pe Wan. The items must be collected in order, and can only be collected after receiving the quest. The Nong Berries are located just across the bridge from the Tomaat Pass sign; the Tai Ling Buds are located near a sign for Seijun Woods.
ec0688a1abe8ada3d85ad2b33b5bb642ebaa074a.text: 這兩種成分由指南針標記顯示在您開始的地方以北。途中可能會遇到一些低階敵人，但你只需要將任務物品帶給佩萬哥。物品必須依序領取，且只有接到任務後才能領取。 Nong Berries 位於 Tomaat Pass 標誌的橋對面； Tai Ling Buds 位於 Seijun Woods 標誌附近。

a766e78aada709fccc38a87e9f244bcbc7a8fbc8.source: During the Dragon Festival, taking the quest The Rampaging Yetis stops you from being able to find the Nong Berry Bush and the Tai Ling Vine, and they will not be visible on the map. Complete the offending quest and re-zone to fix this.
a766e78aada709fccc38a87e9f244bcbc7a8fbc8.text: 在端午節期間，接任務「狂暴的雪人」會讓你無法找到農漿果叢和太靈藤，而且它們在地圖上也不會可見。完成有問題的任務並重新分割以解決此問題。

0d6cb0cf69697e4f6cfb43e3d1879b28d93e9c61.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Ascalon City and start the mission.
0d6cb0cf69697e4f6cfb43e3d1879b28d93e9c61.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 阿斯卡隆城 走進前哨站並開始任務。

d9a29dc29214c9521c8508e779c95059b5fb6c9f.source: Scout for Bonfaaz Burntfur's Charr forces.
d9a29dc29214c9521c8508e779c95059b5fb6c9f.text: 偵察 Bonfaaz Burntfur 的 夏爾 部隊。

be73d7673de6f6ccb63b9db1081c7126d6657dca.source: Search north of the Wall to find the Charr army.
be73d7673de6f6ccb63b9db1081c7126d6657dca.text: 在長城以北搜尋，找到 夏爾 軍隊。

a534c7c3b2b2e6a1a27fdee67ae908da5c84a8c4.source: Report your findings to Captain Calhaan.
a534c7c3b2b2e6a1a27fdee67ae908da5c84a8c4.text: 向卡爾漢船長報告你的發現。

6c740f2a057d47cfa38fdc944f045765b874a75c.source: ADDED: Find a new way back. Run to the Wall.
6c740f2a057d47cfa38fdc944f045765b874a75c.text: 補充：尋找新的返回方式。 跑過 到牆上。

7d47166f0ebf2d7ae6017c3ecca2e5dfd9437284.source: *BONUS* Recover the four pieces of Kilnn Testibrie's armor and return them to his tomb.
7d47166f0ebf2d7ae6017c3ecca2e5dfd9437284.text: *獎勵* 找回 Kilnn Testibrie 的四件盔甲並將它們放回他的墳墓。

49b2c63951fce493d300bb123f9fc01366ae82a3.source: Non-Prophecies characters will not receive any reward for completing this mission on normal mode.
49b2c63951fce493d300bb123f9fc01366ae82a3.text: 非 阿斯卡隆戰記 角色在正常模式下完成此任務不會獲得任何獎勵。

4a76668c89e047a73e38d042526c4a9a67e207b7.source: Talk to Captain Calhaan to open the first gate.
4a76668c89e047a73e38d042526c4a9a67e207b7.text: 與卡爾漢隊長交談以開啟第一扇門。

ff568dbb7e0b403768f2e87f925c77fc18795b8c.source: Head outside the gate and travel to the northwest. Eventually you will reach a gate, opened by the lever next to it.
ff568dbb7e0b403768f2e87f925c77fc18795b8c.text: 出了門，向西北行去。最終你會到達一扇門，由旁邊的槓桿開啟。

01b4faecc5709b9c89670e9f6df6944858b29f8d.source: Continue along the path to a fork, where you will see a pile of wreckage. Interact with this and pick up Kilnn Testibrie's Crest - all 4 pieces of his armor are needed for the bonus.
01b4faecc5709b9c89670e9f6df6944858b29f8d.text: 繼續沿著小路走到岔路口，你會看到一堆殘骸。與此互動並拾取 Kilnn Testibrie 的紋章 - 需要他的所有 4 盔甲才能獲得獎勵。

7342c6554b911401bd8b186493b2e8775d43d892.source: Follow the eastern path to another pile of wreckage, where you will find Cuisse.
7342c6554b911401bd8b186493b2e8775d43d892.text: 沿著東邊的小路前往另一堆殘骸，在那裡你會找到奎斯。

d73abdd4f4852bfc64ef445649e70b990242bbcb.source: Head into the cave with Jora and Sif after dispatching of the mandragor patrol and the enemies therein. Head to the center isle at the Shrine of the Wolf Spirit (point 1) surrounded by friendly Stonewolves who quickly turn on you. Finish the giant guarding the shrine and collect the Volfen Blessing from it. When you activate it, your skill bar will be replaced by a different set of 5 skills. By using one of these skills, Volfen Bloodlust, you can "detect the presence of Svanir". This means that his location will show up on the Mission Map as long as the skill is active. He will appear at points 2 and 3 on the map, where he will flee after you have brought his health down to about 50%. At point 4, kill it and you have completed the mission. After the cinematic you will be taken back to Sifhalla and Jora will be unlocked as a hero for you.
d73abdd4f4852bfc64ef445649e70b990242bbcb.text: 消滅曼陀羅巡邏隊和其中的敵人後，與 喬拉 和 Sif 一起前往洞穴。前往 狼 精神神殿（1 點）的中心島，周圍有友善的石狼，它們會迅速攻擊您。完成守衛神社的巨人並從中收集 Volfen 祝福。當您啟動它時，您的技能欄將被另一組 5 技能取代。透過使用這些技能之一，沃爾芬嗜血，你可以「檢測到斯瓦尼爾的存在」。這意味著只要技能處於活動狀態，他的位置就會顯示在 主線任務 地圖上。他將出現在地圖上的 2 和 3 點，當你將他的生命值降至大約 50% 後，他將逃離那裡。在 4 點殺死它，你就完成了任務。電影結束後，您將被帶回 襲哈拉，喬拉 將為您解鎖為英雄。

8fbd4840cd7ca4ca62dc302d4e73c20c998fbb50.source: You can use the following shortcut, which is especially useful for speed booking:
8fbd4840cd7ca4ca62dc302d4e73c20c998fbb50.text: 您可以使用以下快捷方式，這對於快速預訂特別有用：

775a91b23936bfdee336a77555af44fb17f08cde.source: Ignore the quest markers and head straight for the spawn points. As soon as the Nornbear spawns, head for the next one; do not fight him.
775a91b23936bfdee336a77555af44fb17f08cde.text: 忽略任務標記並徑直前往重生點。一旦諾恩熊出現，就前往下一個；不要打他。

aae263c4c91314b048958378db7a2629c230205c.source: The quest will not update (and the starburst will not move), but your target will keep respawning at the correct locations. At the third location, kill him.
aae263c4c91314b048958378db7a2629c230205c.text: 任務不會更新（星爆也不會移動），但你的目標將繼續在正確的位置重生。到了第三個地點，殺了他。

80af9110970759eb993e037fb78506875a168e49.source: You do not need to bring Volfen Blessing (or visit the Wolf Shrine).
80af9110970759eb993e037fb78506875a168e49.text: 您不需要攜帶Volfen 祝福（或參觀狼神社）。

3aa8c87658aa087bdcdcf69cc6e909cfbb96155f.source: Consider bringing skills that require or benefit from Bleeding, since Jora (Sever Artery) and Sif Shadowhunter (Melandru's Shot) can inflict Bleeding.
3aa8c87658aa087bdcdcf69cc6e909cfbb96155f.text: 考慮引入需要 流血 或從 流血 中受益的技能，因為 喬拉 (動脈切割) 和 獵影者 希夫 (梅蘭朵射擊) 可能會造成 流血。

baf50e38cb98ed52d4859becf50239cb898f586f.source: The Nornbear cinematic plays at the end of the quest. You will then be returned to Sifhalla.
baf50e38cb98ed52d4859becf50239cb898f586f.text: 諾恩熊電影在任務結束時播放。然後您將返回 襲哈拉。

18a6d048ba124658f47963b452f97b02258b7168.source: Sif Shadowhunter allows players already using Volfen Bloodlust to re-equip the skill (thus effectively making it maintainable).
18a6d048ba124658f47963b452f97b02258b7168.text: 獵影者 希夫 允許已經使用 Volfen Bloodlust 的玩家重新裝備此技能（從而有效地使其可維護）。

6b05487a9a3c8f7999e0aa9ab51f62ac0e3093ce.source: The Volfen Blessing is an optional skill that is not needed to complete this mission.
6b05487a9a3c8f7999e0aa9ab51f62ac0e3093ce.text: Volfen 祝福 是一項選用技能，完成此任務不需要。

ea807b86b8210ed4e2df799a1c14afd6e3384aaa.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #7 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
ea807b86b8210ed4e2df799a1c14afd6e3384aaa.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#7 頁。

0f47f21e63ebe607e204354f5fdf60893e2777c1.source: If you completed this quest during GW:EN test weekend, you do not gain any credit for it in your Hero's Handbook but can have it inserted in your book by paying one of the NPCs that collects books.
0f47f21e63ebe607e204354f5fdf60893e2777c1.text: 如果您在 GW:EN 測試週末期間完成了此任務，您不會在 英雄 的手冊中獲得任何學分，但可以透過向收集書籍的 NPC 之一付費將其插入您的書中。

846edc7d7997a77c822b793ab50fa2ed999f576e.source: Sometimes Volfen Bloodlust will not work and you will be unable to see the location of Svanir. Sometimes the Nornbear doesn't flee when it's supposed to. In these cases whenever its health reaches 0, it instantly goes back to 25%. To break this bug, flag your heroes/henchmen well away from it. Similar to Finding the Bloodstone with Livia, if a Jora hero is in your party, you will have two Joras in your party instead of the Jora hero being renamed "Norn Warrior". If you skip receiving Volfen Blessing from the shrine, Jora's dialogue will not appear for the rest of the mission.
846edc7d7997a77c822b793ab50fa2ed999f576e.text: 有時沃爾芬嗜血不起作用，你將無法看到斯瓦尼爾的位置。有時，諾熊在該逃跑的時候卻沒有逃跑。在這些情況下，只要其運作狀況達到 0，它就會立即回到 25%。要打破這個錯誤，請將你的英雄/追隨者標記為遠離它。與 尋找血石 和 莉薇亞 類似，如果您的隊伍中有 喬拉 英雄，您的隊伍中將有兩個喬拉，而不是 喬拉 英雄被重新命名為“諾恩 戰士”。如果您跳過從神社接收沃爾芬 祝福，則在任務的其餘部分中將不會出現 喬拉 的對話。

91cd90f04b26ccd6cf454a4420bd08aa3c4bf792.source: Explore the Cliffs of Dohjok with Tahlkora.
91cd90f04b26ccd6cf454a4420bd08aa3c4bf792.text: 與 Tahlkora 一起探索 杜夏懸崖。

8ccaba5f9cb6ed20c7377cad29247576bff8efcc.source: Kill the corsair captains to gain more pieces of the Cryptic Scroll.
8ccaba5f9cb6ed20c7377cad29247576bff8efcc.text: 殺死海盜船長以獲得更多 Cryptic 卷軸 碎片。

45d117e4e1206b2d4929905bd910b8b8e26e8031.source: To the north, a large group of Gargoyles is fighting some Grawl. You can wait until the fight is over, attack immediately, or simply run past them. If you run past, beware that the Shatter Gargoyles have Imagined Burden, and in Hard Mode, Crippling Anguish.
45d117e4e1206b2d4929905bd910b8b8e26e8031.text: 在北邊，一大群石像鬼正在與一些 穴居人 戰鬥。你可以等到戰鬥結束，立即攻擊，或直接跑過去。如果你跑過去，請注意粉碎石像鬼有 意念負荷，在困難模式下有 致殘 苦惱。

3ab12d8fbb68b1a4d7a2b7d27dca4885bba2ff93.source: After the bridge, take the left path to find Greaves. Then turn back and head north-east to find Pauldron. Continue along this path to meet Kilnn Testibrie, and give him his armor to complete the bonus.
3ab12d8fbb68b1a4d7a2b7d27dca4885bba2ff93.text: 過了橋，走左邊的路去找格里夫斯。然後轉身向東北方向尋找肩甲。繼續沿著這條路去見 Kilnn Testibrie，並給他他的盔甲以完成獎勵。

d28b32d3d0d9acf4db5e98d2b018c38e85d84bc4.source: Return to the south-west path, and after a group of Charr with a boss, there is a cinematic. After the cinematic many Charr will be chasing you. Run south to the wall and inform (talk to) the Captain of the incoming invasion. Do not stop at all along the way, or you will be giving the Charr time to catch up to you. If the Charr do get close, just keep running - only one player needs to reach the Captain.
d28b32d3d0d9acf4db5e98d2b018c38e85d84bc4.text: 影返往西南方向走，和一群夏爾帶boss後，有一個過場動畫。電影結束後，許多 夏爾 會追著你。 跑過 向南到牆並通知（與）隊長即將到來的入侵。一路上不要停下來，否則 夏爾 將有時間追上您。如果 夏爾 確實接近了，請繼續奔跑 - 只有一個玩家需要到達隊長身邊。

0fcd15678ba0d465d2f638e637caecaa7751f18d.source: Skip the cinematic and use a movement speed increasing skill (such as Fall Back!) or a speed boost consumable. In hard mode enemies move 33-50% faster, so with default running speed the second group of Charr catches up with you before you reach the soldiers. If you run with heroes/henchmen, flag them in the path of the Charr so that their sacrifice can earn you a bit more time.
0fcd15678ba0d465d2f638e637caecaa7751f18d.text: 跳過過場動畫並使用提高移動速度的技能（例如後退！）或速度提升消耗品。在困難模式下，敵人的 33-50% 移動速度更快，因此在預設執行速度下，第二組 夏爾 會在您到達士兵之前追上您。如果您與英雄/追隨者一起奔跑，請在 夏爾 的路徑上標記他們，以便他們的犧牲可以為您贏得更多時間。

4d69c990f81f42f7798cc6527c5f59c10c1fd3dc.source: After completing this mission, the party will appear in Fort Ranik.
4d69c990f81f42f7798cc6527c5f59c10c1fd3dc.text: 完成此任務後，隊伍將出現在拉尼克堡。

ed305069a67c449035f11c360e298ac3ee232693.source: Purple-pink waterish liquid inflicts negative environmental effect Tar.
ed305069a67c449035f11c360e298ac3ee232693.text: 紫粉色水樣液體會對環境造成負面影響 瀝青。

d688e8214b44a4c9cfc740903a05d45a47180a8f.source: After the first cinematic, take care to stay on the correct path (i.e. the bridges). If by choosing the wrong one, you will not know until you are just opposite the gate, and by then, it is too late - the Charr will have beaten you there.
d688e8214b44a4c9cfc740903a05d45a47180a8f.text: 第一個動畫結束後，請注意保持正確的路徑（即橋梁）。如果您選擇錯誤，直到您走到大門對面時您才會知道，到那時就為時已晚 - 夏爾 會搶在您前面。

2aec42d6edca6f400c23728d6a5ecb9460978499.source: Unlike other quest items, Testibrie's items can be salvaged and sold.
2aec42d6edca6f400c23728d6a5ecb9460978499.text: 與其他任務物品不同，泰斯布里的物品可以被回收和出售。

7e06f8ff63586cb4ecfdf8b55b3a16dce6369c9a.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #2 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
7e06f8ff63586cb4ecfdf8b55b3a16dce6369c9a.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#2 頁。

824cfad7a6e4ac74ebbea94c1deb3750df1ac741.source: Since no foes are required to be killed, this mission and the bonus can be completed by running.
824cfad7a6e4ac74ebbea94c1deb3750df1ac741.text: 由於不需要殺死敵人，所以這個任務和獎勵可以透過跑步來完成。

1562d4143d717122d56e6d7bc9cdb1f1ec917ac8.source: High-level parties can fight through the mob of Charr instead of running; however, the mission timer will still tick down and eventually kill the party, thus having failed the mission.
1562d4143d717122d56e6d7bc9cdb1f1ec917ac8.text: 高等級隊伍可以透過夏爾的怪物進行戰鬥，而不是逃跑；然而，任務計時器仍然會滴答作響並最終殺死該方，從而導致任務失敗。

1a2d9efa7b56f6a9d6a1202526d54f897e025f09.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 0.9% to the Cartographer title.
1a2d9efa7b56f6a9d6a1202526d54f897e025f09.text: 對此任務的完整探索為 版圖 標題貢獻了約 0.9%。

e3dae438b3c294151c0cfc58d84ffdada28506e6.source: Large areas of the map can be uncovered by heading towards the source of Charr instead of running from them. There are two main sections in that regard, north (where the Charr can be seen during the cutscene) and west (the various paths where charr groups come from when chasing you).
e3dae438b3c294151c0cfc58d84ffdada28506e6.text: 透過前往 夏爾 的源頭而不是逃離它們，可以發現地圖的大片區域。在這方面有兩個主要部分，北部（在過場動畫中可以看到 夏爾）和西部（夏爾隊伍追趕你時來自的不同路徑）。

f091aadabbf32271e1006db73d454a62b273ff08.source: To reach the northern area run past the attacking Charr after the cinematic. The area is easy to explore.
f091aadabbf32271e1006db73d454a62b273ff08.text: 要到達北部地區，請在電影結束後穿過進攻的 夏爾。該地區很容易探索。

c0602d93d8b23ca1bbb11296ba60a198ed2dc8f7.source: To reach the western area follow the mission path after the cinematic until you see a group of Charr running towards you from the right. Follow that path. It will lead you to uncover a large southwestern area of the map. A running skill or a speed boost, e.g. Birthday Cupcake, etc. is recommended for finishing this section on the first try.
c0602d93d8b23ca1bbb11296ba60a198ed2dc8f7.text: 要到達西部區域，請沿著電影結束後的任務路徑前進，直到您看到一群 夏爾 從右側向您跑來。沿著那條路走。它將引導您發現地圖的西南大片區域。跑步技巧或速度提升，例如建議使用生日紙杯蛋糕等一次完成此部分。

95e7bd2350a64fcfcec3bb95f83197e0f88a825a.source: All Nightfall characters must have accepted the reward for Following the Trail.
95e7bd2350a64fcfcec3bb95f83197e0f88a825a.text: 所有 黑暗逆襲 角色都必須接受「追隨蹤跡」的獎勵。

6cf3a2545ea943fe976ade7432e3f4b1470160e5.source: Tahlkora must be present in the party.
6cf3a2545ea943fe976ade7432e3f4b1470160e5.text: 塔爾科拉必須出席聚會。

65e81cebb404ab7c2940a2031bc99a39e812f7bd.source: Find General Kahyet. Prevent her from striking a deal with Ironfist, the corsair captain.
65e81cebb404ab7c2940a2031bc99a39e812f7bd.text: 找到卡耶特將軍。阻止她與海盜船長鐵拳達成交易。

b94e078d65079e939d7610c63e2e84538982baa6.source: ADDED: Eliminate Ironfist's envoy and crew.
b94e078d65079e939d7610c63e2e84538982baa6.text: 增加：消滅鐵拳的特使和船員。

5a14e200919316581051159eee93830cfae9c209.source: ADDED: Pass through the Kournan check point.
5a14e200919316581051159eee93830cfae9c209.text: 新增：透過 Kournan 檢查站。

bd253566700ab1aaf9fc3d992a5d859de356fba9.source: ADDED: Follow Captain Besuz to the meeting with Kahyet.
bd253566700ab1aaf9fc3d992a5d859de356fba9.text: 新增：跟隨 Besuz 隊長去與 Kahyet 會面。

73bb24a319876cb777c0503962b6b9a9c5f25697.source: *BONUS* Clear Lahtenda Bog of rinkhal monitors.
73bb24a319876cb777c0503962b6b9a9c5f25697.text: *獎勵* 清除 rinkhal 監視器的 洛天帝沼澤。

bf57d9eb0f4892682db4d89bbd3bdff26c0763de.source: You have [5...0] of 5 rinkhal monitors remaining.
bf57d9eb0f4892682db4d89bbd3bdff26c0763de.text: 您還剩餘 [5...0] 個 5 rinkhal 監視器。

d74dc4271bceb8e448f1216914079bdad1501c82.source: Mapping the mission area (Lahtenda Bog) will contribute ~2.5% towards the Elona cartographer title.
d74dc4271bceb8e448f1216914079bdad1501c82.text: 繪製任務區 (洛天帝沼澤) 將為 ~2.5% 獲得 Elona 製圖師頭銜做出貢獻。

114fc2522d96ee997ebb9bb8d6a01208e88e168a.source: Your party will consist of its leader, the required hero (Tahlkora), and up to six others: players, heroes (maximum of 3 per player will be teleported), or henchmen (however, only Kihm, Herta, Sogolon, and Gehraz will show up; the other henchmen do not appear in the great hall).
114fc2522d96ee997ebb9bb8d6a01208e88e168a.text: 你的隊伍將由其領導者、所需的英雄 (Tahlkora) 和最多六名其他人組成：玩家、英雄（每個玩家最多傳送 3）或追隨者（但是，只有 Kihm、Herta、Sogolon 和 傑洛斯 會出現；其他追隨者不會出現在大廳中）。

7754bf76493a58d3d5178b7ab18c9f62a4fb3e2f.source: An easier solution is to ask Dockmaster Dimedeh to teleport your party of 8 from Dajkah Inlet to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan and vanquish from there.
7754bf76493a58d3d5178b7ab18c9f62a4fb3e2f.text: 一個更簡單的解決方案是要求碼頭管理員 Dimedeh 將您的 8 隊伍從 Dajkah Inlet 傳送到 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽 並從那裡擊敗。

0c59b14caac65db56261e948cf905a39681b45c8.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #13 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
0c59b14caac65db56261e948cf905a39681b45c8.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#13 頁。

4d0855437f196bc352febdf18e8ad800c39e6017.source: Mercenary Heroes will always transform into a male corsair even if they are female. It is possible to pass through some of the Kournan Guard barriers before speaking to Captain Besuz. There is no benefit in doing so and requires more time than finishing the mission normally.
4d0855437f196bc352febdf18e8ad800c39e6017.text: 傭兵英雄即使是女性，也總是會變身為男性海盜。在與貝蘇茲隊長交談之前，可以穿過一些庫爾南守衛的屏障。這樣做沒有任何好處，而且比正常完成任務需要更多的時間。

000f3fe7a2af2bac137e270052eed1f5f146e5e9.source: Occasionally, General Kahyet and her group will appear, but fail to turn hostile. There is no work-around; you must restart the mission.
000f3fe7a2af2bac137e270052eed1f5f146e5e9.text: 偶爾，卡耶特將軍和她的團隊會出現，但不會轉為敵對。沒有解決方法；你必須重新開始任務。

d9fc611535d464df5053068882d83daeb9c6c4c9.source: Travel to the sacred altar and light the spiritual flame to summon the bear spirit.
d9fc611535d464df5053068882d83daeb9c6c4c9.text: 前往神聖祭壇，點燃精神火焰來召喚熊靈。

a59185764b35ed112dea6b2d171ade7678d636a5.source: Prevent the arctic nightmares from consuming the spiritual flame.
a59185764b35ed112dea6b2d171ade7678d636a5.text: 防止北極夢魘吞噬精神火焰。

7ea96c93021635a249ef5ffcaa2def7d704370fb.source: See Egil Fireteller for your reward.
7ea96c93021635a249ef5ffcaa2def7d704370fb.text: 前往埃吉爾消防員領取獎勵。

f56b355c243b680802deeacc34d7dd5c0561a3ec.source: Lead Egil Fireteller and your party through Jaga Moraine to the Bear Spirit's altar. Fight off the invading Arctic Nightmares, and try to interrupt their Consume Flames skill. When all the invading waves are killed, Bear Spirit appears and Egil Fireteller gives you the reward. Fire damage is useful against most of the foes going to the sacred altar.
f56b355c243b680802deeacc34d7dd5c0561a3ec.text: 帶領埃吉爾·消防員和你的隊伍穿過賈加冰磧到達熊靈的祭壇。擊退入侵的北極夢魘，並嘗試打斷他們的消耗火焰技能。當所有入侵的浪潮被消滅後，熊靈就會出現，埃吉爾消防者會給你獎勵。 火焰傷害 對於大多數前往神聖祭壇的敵人很有用。

5b30d1a13a8e630f821d61dab0a812f494cbbd73.source: Upon accepting the quest reward, you also accept the quest Blood Washes Blood.
5b30d1a13a8e630f821d61dab0a812f494cbbd73.text: 接受任務獎勵後，您也接受了任務 血債血償。

9288a3e87c1029aea1fe62f37e1b6a89a71799e1.source: If you leave the map after completing only the first part of this quest (capturing the altar), you will have to re-capture the altar by standing near it. If this doesn't work, you may have to abandon and redo the quest.
9288a3e87c1029aea1fe62f37e1b6a89a71799e1.text: 如果您在完成此任務的第一部分（佔領祭壇）後離開地圖，您將必須站在祭壇附近重新佔領祭壇。如果這不起作用，您可能必須放棄並重做任務。

ec7f995da883f233cb2102719b4798e0ab3c0f1c.source: Arctic Nightmares do not drop loot, yield experience, or count for Norn Hunting Party; ANet has confirmed this to be intentional.
ec7f995da883f233cb2102719b4798e0ab3c0f1c.text: 北極夢魘不會掉落戰利品，不會產生經驗，也不計入 諾恩 狩獵 隊伍；ANet 已證實這是故意的。

b979786661969369308dc69de1d4b6c3e7e3714d.source: The nightmares at the altar do not cease to spawn, which can be problematic for parties lacking enough means to deal with them. In this case (if party protection and healing permits) a player can disable all damage skills equipped on healers, set all heroes to Avoid Combat and flag the party near Jarnskeggi. From there, pull the six spawn Arctic Nightmares into the team area. While the team resists the Arctic Nightmares attacks, a player should have enough time to move to the altar, with Egil Fireteller following them, and capture it successfully.
b979786661969369308dc69de1d4b6c3e7e3714d.text: 祭壇上的噩夢不會停止出現，這對於缺乏足夠手段來應對它們的各方來說可能是個問題。在這種情況下（如果隊伍保護和治療允許），玩家可以停用治療師裝備的所有傷害技能，將所有英雄設定為避免戰鬥，並在 Jarnskeggi 附近標記隊伍。從那裡，將六個生成的北極夢魘拖入團隊區域。當團隊抵抗北極夢魘的攻擊時，玩家應該有足夠的時間移動到祭壇，並在埃吉爾傳火者的跟隨下成功佔領祭壇。

5209793dd76a5e0b16dd604f41d76bd2fea044ce.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Regent Valley and start the mission. Completing The Great Northern Wall also brings the party here.
