5209793dd76a5e0b16dd604f41d76bd2fea044ce.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 統治者之谷 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 北方長城 也將聚會帶到這裡。

c8fc2755bd10f3bb02bc9a2b1ef56b3ebdb97f7a.source: Push back the invading Charr army.
c8fc2755bd10f3bb02bc9a2b1ef56b3ebdb97f7a.text: 擊退入侵的 夏爾 軍隊。

5501ea76b6488577d955aac7c770b199080f086d.source: ADDED: Locate the RESTRAINING BOLT text is displayed fully capitalized and return it to Siegemaster Lormar.
5501ea76b6488577d955aac7c770b199080f086d.text: 新增：找到完全大寫顯示的“限制螺栓”文字並將其返回給攻城大師洛瑪。

db819d676e0ce75af7ea670a470e0a23d92f541d.source: ADDED: Locate the ARMING CRANK text is displayed fully capitalized and return it to Siegemaster Lormar.
db819d676e0ce75af7ea670a470e0a23d92f541d.text: 新增：找到完全大寫顯示的武裝曲柄文字並將其返回給攻城大師洛瑪。

399d2aab4e4dde2f103f7e605d09d184d644ad27.source: ADDED: Locate the RELEASE LEVER text is displayed fully capitalized and return it to Siegemaster Lormar.
399d2aab4e4dde2f103f7e605d09d184d644ad27.text: 新增：找到完全大寫顯示的釋放桿文字並將其返回給攻城大師洛瑪。

42448e328602dd671cd1be305c1a813493ca1168.source: *BONUS* Rescue Deeter Saberlin from his Charr imprisonment.
42448e328602dd671cd1be305c1a813493ca1168.text: *獎勵* 將 Deeter Saberlin 從 夏爾 監禁中解救出來。

71631f30e62e912ec40e35ddc2ee9e5b7f02fd42.source: Your party must help the guards to retake the Great Northern Wall by pushing the Charr invasion back. Proceed forward until you sight the wall. Eventually, you will meet Siegemaster Lormar who will brief you how to recover and use trebuchets.
71631f30e62e912ec40e35ddc2ee9e5b7f02fd42.text: 你的隊伍必須幫助衛兵擊退 夏爾 的入侵，奪回北方長城。繼續前進，直到看到牆壁。最終，你會遇到攻城大師洛瑪，他會向你介紹如何恢復和使用投石機。

7f91a41964991bf415f92d7df7f93d58c3c134a1.source: To make the siege mechanisms operable again, you need to salvage other Wrecked Catapults and use their parts to fix the one near Lormar. Each of the needed pieces are indicated in the wiki-map. Use the ALT key to search for Wrecked Catapults and click on them to obtain a usable part. Pick them up one by one and deliver them to Lormar by talking to him.
7f91a41964991bf415f92d7df7f93d58c3c134a1.text: 為了讓攻城機制再次可用，你需要打撈其他失事的投石車，並使用它們的零件修復洛瑪附近的投石車。維基地圖中標示了每個所需的部分。使用 ALT 鍵搜尋失事彈射器並點選它們以獲得可用的零件。將它們一一撿起來，並透過與洛瑪交談將它們交給他。

6a3712a4a452e3def534f4bedc5d32096dc73a3a.source: Once the trebuchet is fixed, use the lever once to charge it first and a second time to fire it. Repairing the trebuchet is not required to complete the mission, so high level players can skip this step and charge in.
6a3712a4a452e3def534f4bedc5d32096dc73a3a.text: 一旦投石機固定好，請使用槓桿第一次為其充電，然後使用第二次為其發射。完成任務不需要修理投石機，因此高等級玩家可以跳過這一步直接衝鋒。

b9eea1f921f3041d1db7759341ac6a36fbce92b6.source: Continue ahead and you will find another trebuchet - this one doesn't need repairing and aims towards a large crater, which Charr patrol out of. Players may find no use for this tool until foes get closer. (If the player is quick enough, they can quickly activate the trebuchet and kill the final Charr boss to complete the mission, before the Charr run away). Shortly after the player approaches the trebuchet, all enemies will scatter from the blast point.
b9eea1f921f3041d1db7759341ac6a36fbce92b6.text: 繼續前進，你會發現另一臺投石機 - 這臺投石機不需要修理，其目標是一個大隕石坑，夏爾 就是從那裡巡邏的。在敵人靠近之前，玩家可能會發現這個工具沒有任何用處。 （如果玩家夠快，他們可以在 夏爾 逃跑前快速啟動投石機並殺死最後的 夏爾 boss 以完成任務）。當玩家接近投石機後不久，所有敵人都會從爆炸點四散開來。

6dbc4ab2b9c706f24edf4a116f20c325f09491ec.source: Charr that survive the impact can be left alone as long as they don't interfere with the path leading to the boss and its group. Killing the boss and its group completes the mission.
6dbc4ab2b9c706f24edf4a116f20c325f09491ec.text: 存活下來的 夏爾 可以不受幹擾，只要它們不幹擾通往 Boss 及其團隊的路徑即可。殺死boss及其團隊即可完成任務。

75d0219520f55d11cbe915795881525b4b05e81f.source: To gain the bonus, your task is to find Trooper Deeter Saberlin, who can be seen while proceeding with the mission's main objectives and only takes a minor detour (point 2).
75d0219520f55d11cbe915795881525b4b05e81f.text: 為了獲得獎勵，你的任務是找到士兵 Deeter Saberlin，在執行任務的主要目標時可以看到他，並且只走了一小段彎路（點 2）。

c44bd84144ec8452731c0f76fee9c5377a15184a.source: Master Armin Saberlin is the NPC that provides this task, he joins your party early in the mission (point 1A) and will follow you up to the large ruined wall (point 1B). After clearing the mob with the boss, you can talk to him to activate the bonus if he is still alive; however, it actually does not matter if he survives or not - performing the task is enough to complete the bonus.
c44bd84144ec8452731c0f76fee9c5377a15184a.text: 阿明 沙貝林 大師是提供此任務的 NPC，他會在任務早期加入您的隊伍（點 1A），並會跟隨您到達大型廢墟牆（點 1B）。和boss清完怪後，如果他還活著，可以和他說話啟用獎勵；然而，實際上他是否生存並不重要——執行任務就足以完成獎勵。

e049e1e1a965508d4de1195d832f1c190703bd86.source: At the start, the weak NPCs will be under attack from several groups of Charr. There is always a visible stationary group, but two other patrol groups far behind them. Those who naively engage the standing group may get overwhelmed by the additional forces. To avoid this, send a lure character (or, even better Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support) as bait and finish the stationary group far from its spawn point. Then move slowly to face the patrols which are scripted to push forward with the invasion.
e049e1e1a965508d4de1195d832f1c190703bd86.text: 一開始，實力較弱的 NPC 會受到多組 夏爾 的攻擊。總有一個可見的固定小組，但另外兩個巡邏小組遠遠落後於他們。那些天真地與常備部隊交戰的人可能會被額外的力量壓垮。為了避免這種情況，請傳送一個誘餌角色（或更好的 黑檀 暗殺者 支援）作為誘餌，並在遠離其重生點的地方完成固定組。然後緩慢移動，面對按計畫推進入侵的巡邏隊。

7a43dc93c6852a4062b85edc41714b5262b55452.source: When facing the Charr Stalkers, use walls to obstruct projectiles - minimizing damage against your party from Ignite Arrows, and spread out if attacked in open areas.
7a43dc93c6852a4062b85edc41714b5262b55452.text: 當面對 夏爾 潛行者時，使用牆壁阻擋彈丸 - 最大限度地減少 爆烈箭 對你的隊伍造成的傷害，如果在空曠區域受到攻擊，請分散開來。

aafec5559aa4929e258b3404e15ef74395b50cbd.source: At the second half while repairing the trebuchets, there will be groups with two Charr Fire Callers. Once again use a lure so they cast Meteor Shower away from your backliners and only then engage.
aafec5559aa4929e258b3404e15ef74395b50cbd.text: 下半場修理投石機時，將有兩個 夏爾 火力召喚者組成的小組。再次使用誘餌，讓他們將 隕石雨 遠離你的後排，然後才進行交戰。

55814dba318f5870ec4a493726133de7547bc487.source: When facing the final boss after repairing and using the trebuchet, be very careful with engaging the boss's group. Many other groups surround them, and it's very easy to get overwhelmed here if you don't carefully pull them.
55814dba318f5870ec4a493726133de7547bc487.text: 在修復並使用投石機後面對最終 Boss 時，與 Boss 的隊伍交戰時要非常小心。他們周圍還有很多其他團體，如果不小心拉動的話，很容易就被淹沒在這裡。

0ce4817161bc8839b39d57147d893b746722e3e2.source: The party size is only 4 so:

3e955f55b0ed565e96c63ea69ec8cc100aa27279.source: Party healing such as Heal Party or Protective Was Kaolai might be advisable to counter the degeneration from Lingering Curse and Faintheartedness (if your team cannot bring hex removal).
3e955f55b0ed565e96c63ea69ec8cc100aa27279.text: 隊伍 修復（例如 治癒隊伍 或 護衛者高萊）可能有助於對抗 強力詛咒 和 懦弱 的退化（如果您的團隊無法移除六角形）。

7cc79fc585e167606e8a1343b97f8413e06aeb3f.source: The canyon walls will block your line of sight; Do not take projectile skills. Since you encounter small groups of foes, area of effect skills are not particularly effective.
7cc79fc585e167606e8a1343b97f8413e06aeb3f.text: 峽谷壁會擋住你的視線；不要使用投射技能。由於你遇到的是小群敵人，區域效果技能並不是特別有效。

57f3f7579f14fe234c460a3a186c53c990ac0e71.source: Consider bringing an enchantment removal skill to remove Shield of Judgment from the Charr Martyrs and Overseers if your team depends on martial professions.
57f3f7579f14fe234c460a3a186c53c990ac0e71.text: 如果您的團隊依賴武術職業，請考慮使用結界移除技能來從 夏爾 殉道者和督軍中移除 審判之盾。

f785afb42ecb0ba0d321a664460c92fc4e8f1ef0.source: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support is especially useful here, as it can be used to distract charr groups that overlook the party from hard to reach locations and can keep martyrs busy.
f785afb42ecb0ba0d321a664460c92fc4e8f1ef0.text: 黑檀 暗殺者 支援在這裡特別有用，因為它可以用來分散夏爾團體的注意力，這些夏爾團體從難以到達的地點俯瞰隊伍，並且可以讓烈士忙碌。

c585f570fde510f64b76cc5b793df31dcc3caa7c.source: There is a quest within this mission, called "Deliver a Message to My Wife", which can be taken by talking to Gurn Blanston (green dot on the wiki-map).
c585f570fde510f64b76cc5b793df31dcc3caa7c.text: 此任務中有一個任務，稱為“給妻子的訊息”，可以透過與 古爾布蘭斯通（維基地圖上的綠點）交談來完成。

22ff4730f8137131a69cdfefcf570d2194efa089.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Frontier Gate.
22ff4730f8137131a69cdfefcf570d2194efa089.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 邊境關所。

84e6764b8e50aefecd6e9bc3852c056774a6167d.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 0.8% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
84e6764b8e50aefecd6e9bc3852c056774a6167d.text: 完成此任務的探索大約為 Tyrian 版圖 標題貢獻了 0.8%。

1d0e0c4ffb4b4e583a718b80396e96c4a42b00a9.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #3 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
1d0e0c4ffb4b4e583a718b80396e96c4a42b00a9.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#3 頁。

96eaa5db21e76b2397f261bc80d70cea5ca280a3.source: If the boss and its mob (that are encountered at point 1B on the map) are not killed, the remaining allied NPCs (Ascalonian Warriors, Master Armin Saberlin, Ascalon Militia, Ascalonian Rangers) will continue to follow the party leader through the entire mission and Master Armin Saberlin will not offer the bonus objective (which is not required to complete the bonus). This makes the mission easier, since the NPCs will continue to fight alongside your party instead of stopping at point 1B. Sometimes the soldier that is captured with Trooper Deeter Saberlin is stuck in the entry of the prison, preventing you from talking to Deeter Saberlin to complete the bonus.
96eaa5db21e76b2397f261bc80d70cea5ca280a3.text: 如果 Boss 及其生物（在地圖上的 1B 點遇到的）沒有被殺死，則剩餘的盟軍 NPC（阿斯卡隆戰士、大師 阿明 沙貝林、阿斯卡隆 民兵、阿斯卡隆遊騎兵）將繼續跟隨隊伍領袖完成整個任務，並且大師 阿明 沙貝林 將不會提供獎勵目標（這不是完成獎勵所必需的）。這使得任務變得更容易，因為 NPC 將繼續與你的隊伍並肩作戰，而不是停在 1B 點。有時，與士兵迪特·薩伯林 (Deeter Saberlin) 一起俘獲計程車兵會被困在監獄入口處，導致你無法與迪特·薩伯林 (Deeter Saberlin) 交談來完成獎勵。

9bdbb660480654b0f53e05f5d54034cbf890c8ba.source: de:Fort Ranik (Mission) fr:Fort Ranik (Mission en mode coopératif)
9bdbb660480654b0f53e05f5d54034cbf890c8ba.text: de:拉尼克堡 (主線任務) fr:拉尼克堡 (主線任務 en mode coopératif)

948923ca1d89e0c543b36567692aa7cfa62a9589.source: Go north of the Wall in the Eastern Frontier and follow the road to Surmia.
948923ca1d89e0c543b36567692aa7cfa62a9589.text: 前往 東方邊境 中的長城以北，然後沿著道路前往 蘇米亞。

a70eed6b963d05f0eed752bebc92683ca2478949.text: 暗 Dmg：4-7（需 3 死亡魔法）

bd83648296ff5831a09ce0011d478c175c951565.source: This quest will lead you to the next mission following Fort Ranik. After accepting the quest from Warmaster Riga at the Frontier Gate, head out into the Eastern Frontier and proceed north up the road. There is a sizable force of Grawl shortly up the road, as well as several smaller groups further up ahead. You may either fight them or run past. Follow the road until you reach Surmia. Speak to Captain Miken to accept the quest reward.
bd83648296ff5831a09ce0011d478c175c951565.text: 該任務將引導您前往拉尼克堡之後的下一個任務。在 邊境關所 處接受 戰鬥教官萊加 的任務後，前往 東方邊境 並沿著道路向北行駛。不久之後，穴居人 的一支相當大的部隊就在前方，前方還有幾個較小的團體。你可以和他們戰鬥或跑過去。沿著道路行駛，直到到達 蘇米亞。與麥肯船長交談以接受任務獎勵。

43e8c650de41f7d5acf0a5d10f48a299ad946912.source: Even though this quest is part of the main quest chain, it's shown under the Ascalon Quests tab, not under Primary Quests tab.
43e8c650de41f7d5acf0a5d10f48a299ad946912.text: 儘管此任務是主任務鏈的一部分，但它顯示在 阿斯卡隆 任務 標籤下，而不是顯示在主要 任務 標籤下。

bbefade049d5104249153e5447aca25482a93ac6.source: Seek out Headmaster Kuju in the monastery.
bbefade049d5104249153e5447aca25482a93ac6.text: 在寺院中尋找久久校長。

e2bf9856a38eca6a941360e2cb9d133b03348ec0.source: See Olaf Olafson for your reward.
e2bf9856a38eca6a941360e2cb9d133b03348ec0.text: 請參閱 尤拉夫 尤拉夫森 以取得獎勵。

aed453612d6a4fd4cbc845428a482065400c910c.source: Lahtenda Bog is a maze but Captain Besuz will show you the way once you find him. Turn right at the first opportunity to find Ironfist's Envoy - kill the corsair group to take their clothes as a disguise. Head southeast until you find Captain Besuz's roadblock. Talk to the captain to continue, he will now lead you to the rendezvous point with General Kahyet. Follow him and defeat the various groups of Skale on your path. You will soon see a camp and a narrow path where a stampede of Skale will run through, use it as a choke point. As you get closer to the ruins, a group of Harpies will spawn too. Once you reach the rendezvous, General Kahyet will arrive and trigger a brief conversation; kill her to complete the mission.
aed453612d6a4fd4cbc845428a482065400c910c.text: 洛天帝沼澤 是一個迷宮，但一旦您找到他，Besuz 隊長就會為您指明道路。一有機會就右轉找到鐵拳的特使——殺死海盜團，拿走他們的衣服作為偽裝。向東南方向行駛，直到找到貝蘇茲隊長的路障。與船長交談繼續，他現在將帶領你前往與卡耶特將軍的會合點。跟著他並擊敗路上的 鱗怪 各個組織。很快你就會看到一個營地和一條狹窄的小路，鱗怪 的踩踏事件將穿過這裡，將其用作阻塞點。當你靠近廢墟時，一群鷹身女妖也會出現。一旦您到達集合地點，卡耶特將軍就會到達並引發簡短的對話；殺死她來完成任務。

bda1e45360250d2f5664acd9f61f73fc06bb9822.source: The bonus requires the party to kill 5 Rinkhal Monitors, a simple but time consuming task.
bda1e45360250d2f5664acd9f61f73fc06bb9822.text: 獎勵要求隊伍殺死 5 Rinkhal 監視器，這是一項簡單但耗時的任務。

513dfeec2c225917ba2a22aa7678b1b77116b31f.source: The first is south of Ironfist's Envoy.
513dfeec2c225917ba2a22aa7678b1b77116b31f.text: 第一個位於鐵拳特使以南。

c17cb41928ad91e9dced043958ef1914e34cf6fd.source: The second is after Captain Besuz's roadblock and to the east, inside a natural cave with ancient relics.
c17cb41928ad91e9dced043958ef1914e34cf6fd.text: 第二個是在 Besuz 船長的路障之後，向東，在一個擁有古代遺跡的天然洞穴內。

7eef5144b2ec1a420577dbb19696b033ae5489a3.source: The third is very close to the second, just northeast of it.
7eef5144b2ec1a420577dbb19696b033ae5489a3.text: 第三個距離第二個非常近，就在它的東北方。

e6c55f74f98407afc73c3c5046ce4a30c482a243.source: Now return to Besuz who will wait for you to proceed. Follow him until you pass the three named corsairs and then when Besuz turns left, you turn right instead to find the last two Rinkhal Monitors.
e6c55f74f98407afc73c3c5046ce4a30c482a243.text: 現在回到貝蘇茲那裡，他會等你繼續。跟著他，直到你經過三個命名的海盜船，然後當 Besuz 向左轉時，你向右轉，找到最後兩個 Rinkhal 監視器。

402947a9a83b78fe63f3133216ae036d6b370856.source: On the North side of the swamp.

9ad905dbef1d5692ac1f73f5548a931319b687c1.source: North from target 4 surrounded by Mandragor and Skale.
9ad905dbef1d5692ac1f73f5548a931319b687c1.text: 從目標 4 向北，被 Mandragor 和 鱗怪 包圍。

1d54277cfca932da676dca50544d2ae006a9b4ed.source: Finally backtrack to rejoin Besuz and finish the mission.
1d54277cfca932da676dca50544d2ae006a9b4ed.text: 最後原路返回，重新加入Besuz並完成任務。

ba71ce45a521b0263af298946b98d6afc6a8cdaf.source: Condition-removal skills since foes cause disease frequently (e.g. Extinguish). In Hard mode, the Motivation Henchman Sogolon has Cautery Signet.
ba71ce45a521b0263af298946b98d6afc6a8cdaf.text: 條件去除技能，因為敵人經常引起疾病（例如 熄滅）。在 困難模式 中，激勵 Henchman Sogolon 擁有 淨潔紋章。

5209cca8d843dd6a5c9ed4dca57128a088c63614.source: Area of effect damage is useful during the Skale stampede.
5209cca8d843dd6a5c9ed4dca57128a088c63614.text: 範圍傷害在 鱗怪 踩踏期間非常有用。

0773832d0461a01a036b3e56d750d4aec460bd06.source: When you reach the Corsair camp, use the top of the hill to flag heroes/henchmen before the Skale stampede begins, this provides height advantage. The Skale mob partially separates making them easier to kill.
0773832d0461a01a036b3e56d750d4aec460bd06.text: 當您到達 海盜 營地時，在 鱗怪 踩踏開始之前使用山頂標記英雄/追隨者，這提供了高度優勢。 鱗怪 生物部分分離，使它們更容易被殺死。

edb5b0b08b1ede6449450a8973583139b41bb248.source: Alternatively it is possible to head northwest before encountering the Skale stampede, followed by heading south and carefully pulling the two separate groups apart with a long or flatbow.
edb5b0b08b1ede6449450a8973583139b41bb248.text: 或者，也可以在遇到 鱗怪 踩踏之前向西北行駛，然後向南行駛，用長弓或扁弓小心地將兩個單獨的群體拉開。

8f9e1a6f9e61daacc01690682cff1f5fb8121878.source: Non-human party members will not be disguised after killing Ironfist's Envoys, but this has no impact on mission progress.
8f9e1a6f9e61daacc01690682cff1f5fb8121878.text: 非人類黨員在殺死鐵拳特使後不會偽裝，但這對任務進度沒有影響。

e7a147c14d2c1fcdd79725877e2cdcf8cf99ce40.source: The Corsair disguise is actually a transformation as you will have another face and skin color than your own.
e7a147c14d2c1fcdd79725877e2cdcf8cf99ce40.text: 海盜 偽裝實際上是一種轉變，因為您將擁有與自己不同的臉和膚色。

22da989e8c904cf52334897ad8813df8a4156a73.source: If you talk to One-Eyed Rugger (one of the 3 corsair NPCs), you will become drunk.
22da989e8c904cf52334897ad8813df8a4156a73.text: 如果您與獨眼魯格（3 海盜船 NPC 之一）交談，您就會喝醉。

65f0f6add61b90d81b86a94b708baf08dc9050e8.source: The warped-screen effect persists until you complete the mission; it does not contribute to the Drunkard title nor contribute towards skills that benefit from being drunk.
65f0f6add61b90d81b86a94b708baf08dc9050e8.text: 扭曲的螢幕效果會持續到你完成任務為止；它不會對 酒鬼 頭銜做出貢獻，也不會對從醉酒中受益的技能做出貢獻。

e422c5bd8ac0fa37b320709b61c9ded637363cd5.source: You can remove the screen-warping by disabling the "Enable post-process effects" in the options panel.
e422c5bd8ac0fa37b320709b61c9ded637363cd5.text: 您可以透過停用選項面板中的「啟用後製效果」來消除螢幕扭曲。

7381afb36f0363d1c309ddcc25df83e2fd2de281.source: Don't move after crossing the portal to Jaga Moraine. Use the mission map to flag one or more heroes or henches to the Sacred Altar (quest objective) to claim it without a fight. Alternatively, when doing the mission without heroes, stand near the edge of the shrine but do NOT cross the quest marker as it will spawn foes. Wait a few minutes until you get a morale boost then run to the bear spirit.
7381afb36f0363d1c309ddcc25df83e2fd2de281.text: 穿過通往 Jaga Moraine 的傳送門後不要移動。使用任務地圖將一名或多名英雄或追隨者標記到神聖祭壇（任務目標），以不戰而屈人之兵。或者，在沒有英雄的情況下執行任務時，站在神社邊緣附近，但不要穿過任務標記，因為它會產生敵人。等待幾分鐘，直到你計程車氣提升，然後跑向熊靈。

baf45ec8497a840faaa5363c549f8a86b73798d6.source: Talk to the Bear Spirit and return to Bjora, but skip the Shrine of the Bear Spirit
baf45ec8497a840faaa5363c549f8a86b73798d6.text: 與熊精交談並返回比約拉，但跳過熊精神殿

05412dcbbf4fcda5576a01a35b8bf992f157e0a6.source: Instead, head South towards the Mandragors (avoiding them or not).
05412dcbbf4fcda5576a01a35b8bf992f157e0a6.text: 相反，向南前往曼陀羅（無論是否避開它們）。

40617b87a7d3a773fbea28e5393feefecd2b3c95.source: Go East, towards the southern-most barricade; use Ursan Force to break through it.
40617b87a7d3a773fbea28e5393feefecd2b3c95.text: 向東走，走向最南端的路障；使用Ursan力量來突破它。

b00403f87d6cfb428445db50cabb8f65a311c16c.source: Head to the final enclosure (marked with a flag) and kill the groups required to complete the mission.
b00403f87d6cfb428445db50cabb8f65a311c16c.text: 前往最後的圍欄（標有旗幟）並殺死完成任務所需的團體。

e44f8518dd20f26548e4d0bf3f6a24d40d41597b.source: These tips are generally useful if repeating the quest:
e44f8518dd20f26548e4d0bf3f6a24d40d41597b.text: 如果重複任務，這些提示通常很有用：

d66a247b6c41be8aee695f870096ce6882a0014e.source: Taking Ursan Blessing allows you to skip claiming the Bear Spirit Shrine; it isn't as powerful as Ursan Aura, but it is sufficient.
d66a247b6c41be8aee695f870096ce6882a0014e.text: 取得Ursan 祝福可以讓你跳過佔領熊靈神殿；雖然不如烏桑光環那麼強大，但也足夠了。

398a3ed35f03e73e73dc58886f827c6e9f43806b.source: There's no need to speak to Egil or to kill Arctic Nightmares; you can go straight to the Sacred Shrine to speak with the Bear Spirit.
398a3ed35f03e73e73dc58886f827c6e9f43806b.text: 無需與埃吉爾交談或殺死北極夢魘；可以直接去聖殿與熊靈對話。

26a5d9c2f2858a696ef75af29cc3bc965f296d53.source: You need one of the Ursan skills to break through the barricades, but you only need to kill the Charr in the final enclosure, which is closest to the southern-most barricade.
26a5d9c2f2858a696ef75af29cc3bc965f296d53.text: 你需要Ursan技能之一來突破路障，但你只需要殺死最後一個圍欄中的夏爾，這是最南端的路障。

49a9941c40f25bb3a52d3802970a2c213aef92f5.source: You have to rid the Sacred Altar of Arctic Nightmares to be able to capture it. Capturing the shrine works just like control points in Alliance Battles. When taken, you will gain a morale boost and the Bear Spirit will appear. She will offer you the quest.
49a9941c40f25bb3a52d3802970a2c213aef92f5.text: 你必須清除神聖祭壇上的北極夢魘才能佔領它。佔領神社的工作方式就像 同盟戰 中的控制點。服用後，你計程車氣將會提升，熊靈也會出現。她會給你提供任務。

7225b5ba6d9792f97e06dc8e38b8533b97079e7d.source: If you're hero/henching this quest in HM, after pulling and defeating a few vaettir groups, the sacred altar can be captured in 2-3 min by a single character.
7225b5ba6d9792f97e06dc8e38b8533b97079e7d.text: 如果你是 HM 中的英雄/支援這個任務，在拉動並擊敗一些 vaettir 團體後，單一角色可以在 2-3 分鐘內佔領神聖祭壇。

1d417f5ef7173b0648ab4d10310f45a74ba48629.source: When you zone into Bjora Marches, you will be teleported to the middle of the area to begin the quest.
1d417f5ef7173b0648ab4d10310f45a74ba48629.text: 當您進入 碧拉邊境 區域時，您將被傳送到該區域的中間以開始任務。

b0e35d7a1c5a28a6eccf56aeeefd33f3ad901a7a.source: You can use Ursan Blessing instead of Ursan Aura, allowing you to bypass the visit to bear's shrine in Bjora Marches. See Walkthrough for details.
b0e35d7a1c5a28a6eccf56aeeefd33f3ad901a7a.text: 您可以使用 Ursan 祝福 取代 Ursan Aura，這樣您就可以繞過 碧拉邊境 中參觀熊的神社。有關詳細資訊，請參閱 詳細攻略。

8f471974b4e5cb80702a43ee324c964516de0f50.source: Rebel Yell offers a +2 energy bonus from killing Charr, which is helpful in maintaining Ursan Aura; Heart of the Norn offers the usual health bonus available in Norn territories.
8f471974b4e5cb80702a43ee324c964516de0f50.text: Rebel Yell 透過殺死 夏爾 提供 +2 能量加成，有助於維持 Ursan 光環； 諾恩 之心提供 諾恩 地區常見的健康獎勵。

b03295fbabca6fa7223e73bbbb5fb467aea15dd7.source: If you resign or get kicked in Hard mode (due to party-wide death penalty of 60%), you will be teleported back to Jarnskeggi's resurrection shrine in Jaga Moraine instead. All DP will be removed and you can re-enter Bjora Marches from the nearby portal.
b03295fbabca6fa7223e73bbbb5fb467aea15dd7.text: 如果你在 困難模式 中辭職或被踢（由於 60% 的全黨死亡懲罰），你將被傳送回 Jarnskeggi 在 Jaga Moraine 的複活神殿。所有 DP 將被刪除，您可以從附近的入口網站重新進入 碧拉邊境。

63ebc89869707abf9d09c5e3f4b3c57857611fb4.source: After completion, you will be returned to Gunnar's Hold.
63ebc89869707abf9d09c5e3f4b3c57857611fb4.text: 完成後，您將返回 甘拿的佔領地。

dd3da5444c3afd1659aeb93e48d20a22a36474bf.source: This quest may also be obtained from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments after completing it once (along with any other primary Eye of the North quests).
dd3da5444c3afd1659aeb93e48d20a22a36474bf.text: 該任務也可以在完成一次後從 史蹟殿堂 中的占卜池獲得（以及任何其他主要 極地之眼 任務）。

3c4eb93436ccb27812ffc0602341f8ae0f5190ee.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #9 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
3c4eb93436ccb27812ffc0602341f8ae0f5190ee.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#9 頁。

6654983278973ebcda74085081a8277457268420.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Reng Ku.
6654983278973ebcda74085081a8277457268420.text: 搜尋 Reng Ku 的 桑泉谷。

5fd67a50456f008b665df39713e5d19699387dd3.source: After accepting this quest, you will receive the following:
5fd67a50456f008b665df39713e5d19699387dd3.text: 接受此任務後，您將收到以下內容：

2517f05a61877fb8858f81164d72dde085ae8492.source: Simply walk from Shing Jea Monastery into Sunqua Vale and speak to Reng Ku in the north.
2517f05a61877fb8858f81164d72dde085ae8492.text: 只要從 星岬寺 走到 桑泉谷 並與北部的 Reng Ku 交談即可。

992e5961f92598cd81911de227245e4f90d985eb.source: Primary necromancers would have already received Deadly Swarm, Vampiric Gaze, and the Starter Truncheon from either Mantid Hatchlings or Seek Out Headmaster Kuju.
992e5961f92598cd81911de227245e4f90d985eb.text: 初級死靈法師已經從螳螂幼體或尋找校長 Kuju 那裡收到了致命群體、吸血鬼凝視 和入門版 戰儀杖。

5fe2a10b78e2186391a5682d381b3d3bcd54d9f3.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Eastern Frontier and start the mission.
5fe2a10b78e2186391a5682d381b3d3bcd54d9f3.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 東方邊境 走進前哨站並開始任務。

866f4dacd82d4dfd97c5a3e8c252441d3d71fac8.source: Rescue the soldiers taken prisoner by the Charr.
866f4dacd82d4dfd97c5a3e8c252441d3d71fac8.text: 營救被 夏爾 俘虜計程車兵。

c135c36cf1f2631d9948be334ead79d2049fed72.text: 保護 盧瑞克王子 的生命。

08084edb1a3c0aa82182fb4401e88ae649f23916.source: Speak to Olaf, near the entrance to Raven's Point in Varajar Fells. When you're ready to "discuss", Olaf, Olrun and the four guards will attack you. You must defeat all of them to progress. Each Norn will become friendly at 20% health.
08084edb1a3c0aa82182fb4401e88ae649f23916.text: 與 維拉戛陣地 中 渡鴉岬角 入口附近的奧拉夫交談。當你準備好「討論」時，奧拉夫、奧爾倫和四個守衛就會攻擊你。你必須擊敗所有人才能進步。每個 諾恩 都會在 20% 健康方面變得友善。

a3a4c432daf424e7c21d24a6b07134fa3bed4ddc.source: Afterwards two small groups of Destroyers will attack you. With the help of the Norn (and a Resurrection Shrine nearby), they shouldn't be much of a problem.
a3a4c432daf424e7c21d24a6b07134fa3bed4ddc.text: 之後兩小群毀滅者會攻擊你。在 諾恩（以及附近的 復活祭壇）的幫助下，它們應該不成問題。

80d17354416c7e62deb53664c7a8442e2b814312.source: Talk to Olaf for your reward. You can start the follow-up quest right there, or you can return to Olaf in Olafstead at a later time.
80d17354416c7e62deb53664c7a8442e2b814312.text: 與奧拉夫交談以獲得獎勵。您可以立即開始後續任務，也可以稍後再回到 尤拉夫之地 中的奧拉夫。

c1b379910273c725b0c71794eb72870cc5e88705.source: The Sign of the Raven cinematic plays after killing the Destroyers.
c1b379910273c725b0c71794eb72870cc5e88705.text: 殺死毀滅者後會播放烏鴉印記的電影。

b9baeeace5e23aaee84530d61b21a81e9a75c97d.source: This quest prevents Dazehl Brainfreezer and the imps in the southwest corner of the northwestern lake from spawning.
b9baeeace5e23aaee84530d61b21a81e9a75c97d.text: 該任務可防止達澤爾冰凍者和西北湖西南角的小惡魔產卵。

abc974845325e653958b6987ff3b1c8fffbb4ee2.source: All party members must have received the reward for Flames of the Bear Spirit.
abc974845325e653958b6987ff3b1c8fffbb4ee2.text: 所有小隊成員都必須獲得熊靈之炎的獎勵。

a4392228f34c6d36704c0619eb5aff066acd06d6.source: Light the sacred altar. Lead the bear spirit into Bjora Marches to cleanse Jora's homestead.
a4392228f34c6d36704c0619eb5aff066acd06d6.text: 點燃神聖的祭壇。將熊靈引入 碧拉邊境 來淨化 喬拉 的家。

7df141e8637fcb57be8b4bbab30aa462faaf67d5.source: Accompany Bear on the mountain pilgrimage to the Shrine of the Bear Spirit.
7df141e8637fcb57be8b4bbab30aa462faaf67d5.text: 陪熊上山去熊神祠朝聖。

18312282ea0f0a818bf1d442bfc910d5d3a6a83e.source: Defeat the Charr forces surrounding the Shrine of the Bear Spirit.
18312282ea0f0a818bf1d442bfc910d5d3a6a83e.text: 擊敗熊靈神殿周圍的 夏爾 勢力。

d3185856d1545b6c7c85fabdece5d9d46fb8028a.source: Receive the Ursan Blessing the skill received is Ursan Aura from the Shrine of the Bear Spirit.
d3185856d1545b6c7c85fabdece5d9d46fb8028a.text: 接收Ursan 祝福，收到的技能是來自熊靈神殿的Ursan Aura。

03f084fcab5ecdf8efd674d6da92dd7d51f5e00a.source: Use the bear spirit skill, Ursan Force, to break down the Charr barricades.
03f084fcab5ecdf8efd674d6da92dd7d51f5e00a.text: 使用熊靈技能「Ursan Force」來打破 夏爾 路障。

8bff3218a90df202322f82ecee9fc22228be2337.source: Kill the Charr in Jora's homestead. [5...0] groups remaining.
8bff3218a90df202322f82ecee9fc22228be2337.text: 殺死 喬拉 家園中的 夏爾。剩餘 [5...0] 群組。

54f6fa6ecdd776bbfb29f84e74e402df18582d77.text: 從 Egil 接收 Ursan 祝福。

b29d6141d59cfe1b663691ad68482bbe05bd9a7f.source: The map shows the starting point as the entrance to Bjora Marches from Jaga Moraine. Go to Jaga Moraine (shortest is if you leave from Sifhalla) and meet Egil Fireteller in his small home in the center of the area. From there, lead him to the Sacred Altar in the southern part. When you arrive at the altar, you will be ordered to capture it. You do this by having more allies at the altar than enemies (just like Control points in Hero Tutorial). The capturing process is made harder by the swarms of Arctic Nightmares that storm the shrine, but as they deal no damage to the party, they should be easy to get rid of. Once you have captured the altar (the bar has completely filled with blue), the Bear Spirit will appear. Talk to her and she will direct you to go through the portal to the Bjora Marches for the next part of the quest.
b29d6141d59cfe1b663691ad68482bbe05bd9a7f.text: 地圖顯示的起點是 Jaga Moraine 通往 碧拉邊境 的入口。前往 Jaga Moraine（如果您從 襲哈拉 出發，最短時間）並在該地區中心的小家中與 Egil Fireteller 會面。從那裡，帶領他前往南方的聖壇。當你到達祭壇時，你會被命令佔領它。你可以透過在祭壇上擁有比敵人更多的盟友來做到這一點（就像 英雄 教學中的控制點一樣）。大量北極夢魘襲擊神殿，使得捕獲過程變得更加困難，但由於它們不會對隊伍造成任何傷害，所以應該很容易擺脫它們。一旦你佔領了祭壇（酒吧已經完全充滿藍色），熊靈就會出現。與她交談，她將引導您透過門戶進入 碧拉邊境 進行下一部分的任務。

278858c846530ea04446e5caedf6d428c2e95171.source: Fight your way to the Shrine of the Bear Spirit and kill the 3 Charr groups around it.
278858c846530ea04446e5caedf6d428c2e95171.text: 殺出一條血路，到達熊靈神殿並消滅周圍的 3 夏爾 隊伍。

b9562fec5e63181c6203d73470bb69958c7b8209.source: Talk to the Shrine of the Bear Spirit to get Ursan Aura.
b9562fec5e63181c6203d73470bb69958c7b8209.text: 與熊靈神殿交談以獲得烏爾桑光環。

1ec1112872d9941b2334619b3e6fa770106847d3.source: Fight your way to one of the three barricade paths.
1ec1112872d9941b2334619b3e6fa770106847d3.text: 殺出一條血路，到達三條路障路徑之一。

7be6d7330197769d4118d09e1116f12a2a070ee6.source: Use Ursan Force to break through barricades.
7be6d7330197769d4118d09e1116f12a2a070ee6.text: 使用烏山之力突破路障。

175d1d8f54d75d10c20bc569f3b062bfeec0fabb.source: Kill the Charr groups on Jora's homeland.
175d1d8f54d75d10c20bc569f3b062bfeec0fabb.text: 消滅 喬拉 家鄉的 夏爾 團體。

f058ea58277106a5ee3c5a765038adb472d52f76.source: To add the quest to your log, talk to either:
f058ea58277106a5ee3c5a765038adb472d52f76.text: 若要將任務新增至您的日誌中，請與下列任一者交談：

7f6fc25034a7b184ce65666d761e75b91eb87f50.source: The Bear Spirit in Jaga Moraine (after capturing the sacred altar)
7f6fc25034a7b184ce65666d761e75b91eb87f50.text: 賈加冰磧的熊靈（佔領神聖祭壇後）

eb79c67ad51cd0205c254cc2ec42eed6fcbd937f.source: The Scrying Pool in Hall of Monuments (select I seek guidance option)
eb79c67ad51cd0205c254cc2ec42eed6fcbd937f.text: 史蹟殿堂 中的占卜池（選擇「我尋求指導」選項）

36484091205aa2ff9fc84572e872aa3f15cfb827.source: You can skip some steps after the first time your character completes the quest. The following route is the most efficient:
36484091205aa2ff9fc84572e872aa3f15cfb827.text: 您的角色第一次完成任務後，您可以跳過一些步驟。以下路線是最有效的：

cd4bda5b7b9b068a79511efde6232e1452c300be.source: Have someone in your party equip Ursan Blessing.
cd4bda5b7b9b068a79511efde6232e1452c300be.text: 讓你的隊伍中有人裝備 Ursan 祝福。

43b3c78cb9b4f3ff3f50e88399246d362babd2e5.text: 從 長眼巖脈 出發。

e1825f0e3cf5c6f51cc0be4390065e4736b9995b.source: Run to Jaga Moraine, avoiding aggro there and in Bjora Marches.
e1825f0e3cf5c6f51cc0be4390065e4736b9995b.text: 跑過 到 Jaga Moraine，避免那裡和 碧拉邊境 中的仇恨。

1f5f9ebe0a7d7804e01e31b5a2f6c047fba8439d.text: 釋放所有 阿斯卡隆 俘虜。

7267bb297632d34da2c13f71c2171a6a1c0784e3.source: Get to the obelisks inside the ruined academy.
7267bb297632d34da2c13f71c2171a6a1c0784e3.text: 到達廢棄學院內的方尖碑。

a814a217a69f2e479742856ae2a09385a6a48f5a.source: ADDED: Cross the ravine and open the drawbridge for Rurik and Erol. (Only appears in the Mission Objectives after it is completed.)
a814a217a69f2e479742856ae2a09385a6a48f5a.text: 新增：穿過峽谷，為魯裡克和埃羅爾開啟吊橋。 （僅在 主線任務 任務目標 完成後出現。）

8dcaebf9965d82ad5b53949aa2ff74db7ccfcdf3.source: *BONUS* Follow the Flame Keepers at a distance to gain entrance to the Flame Temple. Extinguish the Flame Temple once inside.
8dcaebf9965d82ad5b53949aa2ff74db7ccfcdf3.text: *獎勵* 遠遠跟隨火焰守護者即可進入火焰神殿。進入後，熄滅 火焰神殿。

eb133747ceb93295b461f4979d5aa0f021074124.source: The goal of this mission is to rescue Ascalon captives while ensuring Rurik's survival (who only uses Defensive Stance). The Prince's scripted AI has two behaviors. He will run ahead to direct characters across the area. But also remain passive and follow the player once on course.
eb133747ceb93295b461f4979d5aa0f021074124.text: 此任務的目標是營救 阿斯卡隆 俘虜，同時確保魯裡克（只使用 防禦態勢）的生存。王子的指令碼人工智慧有兩種行為。他會跑到前面指揮角色穿過該區域。但也要保持被動並在球員進入球場後跟隨球員。

3498eb7bb71084527a26b8d9d0ba557d2c2718dc.source: The mission has three stages: Before the drawbridge, opening it and the last stand with the obelisks:
3498eb7bb71084527a26b8d9d0ba557d2c2718dc.text: 任務分為三個階段：吊橋前、開啟吊橋、最後一個有方尖碑的看臺：

7222daabed22488bad9e5ca7154e07c906c6737b.source: The first part has many hidden devourers pop-ups. Take it slowly. Even if Prince Rurik rushes forwards, it is still possible to control the pace of the mission. Consider letting Rurik fight with little support when enemies are few and weak to give your party some time to regenerate health and energy (Rurik will continue ahead once the foes are defeated). Soon, you will rescue Erol (a cinematic will trigger) who joins your party and uses Flare. His survival is not required and is not involved in the bonus either.
7222daabed22488bad9e5ca7154e07c906c6737b.text: 第一部分有許多隱藏的吞噬者彈出視窗。慢慢來。即使盧瑞克王子衝上前，仍然可以控制任務的節奏。當敵人稀少且虛弱時，考慮讓留裡克在沒有太多支援的情況下戰鬥，以便給你的隊伍一些時間來恢復生命值和能量（一旦敵人被擊敗，留裡克將繼續前進）。很快，您將營救加入您的隊伍並使用 火花 的埃羅爾（將觸發過場動畫）。他的生存不是必需的，也不參與獎金。

b893319a9b47bac055b583d5f641b135b84e0ba0.source: During the second part, you are ordered to open the drawbridge while Rurik and Erol wait behind it. The lever for it is just on the opposite side of the tar river. To reach it, follow the tar river counter-clockwise, looping around beneath the drawbridge and north into an area crawling with Charr. Cross the wall as soon as possible and head south to the lever to allow Rurik and Erol to rejoin your party.
b893319a9b47bac055b583d5f641b135b84e0ba0.text: 在第二部分中，你被命令開啟吊橋，而魯裡克和埃羅爾則在吊橋後面等待。它的控制桿就在焦油河的對面。要到達它，請逆時針沿著焦油河行駛，在吊橋下方繞一圈，向北進入遍佈 夏爾 的區域。盡快越過牆壁，向南走到控制桿處，讓魯裡克和埃羅爾重新加入你的隊伍。

4c9990d02a9dff91b50ce76b277eb1544bc2351f.source: At the beginning of the third part, following Rurik north along the eastern edge will take your party to a Charr group with a boss. Be warned that Rurik will not take the straight path and will circle to the left and will likely aggro a group or two of Charr that you thought were safely away from the main path. Once Erol reaches the boss location a wave of four Charr will run at your group from the southwest. Defeating them will free three Mages. Once liberated, these NPCs will run toward the obelisks inside the ruined academy and attempt to fend off Charr parties while Rurik attempts to open the gate (talking to the Mages will let you hold them closer to you instead). The prince will use a skill called Knock which will only complete when the waves of Charr are defeated. The final cinematic will trigger once Knock is activated.
4c9990d02a9dff91b50ce76b277eb1544bc2351f.text: 在第三部分開始時，沿著東部邊緣跟隨魯裡克（Rurik）向北，您的團隊將到達帶有老闆的 夏爾 小組。請注意，Rurik 不會走直線路徑，而是向左繞圈，並且可能會攻擊您認為安全遠離主路徑的一兩個 夏爾 隊伍。一旦埃羅爾到達 Boss 位置，一波四架 夏爾 將從西南方向您的隊伍發動攻擊。擊敗他們將釋放三名法師。一旦被解放，這些 NPC 就會跑向被毀壞的學院內的方尖碑，並試圖擊退 夏爾 隊伍，而魯裡克則試圖開啟大門（與法師交談會讓你把他們拉得更近）。王子將使用一種名為「敲擊」的技能，該技能只有在 夏爾 的浪潮被擊敗後才會完成。一旦啟動敲門，就會觸發最終的過場動畫。

5fbedb26833e48f0b0e7825be2ed8a4122e50500.source: An alternative - and safer - approach for players who find the last two stages challenging consists of clearing all the Charr before letting Rurik and Erol through the drawbridge. Approach the end counter-clockwise, enter the ending area, then go back east to free the mages from behind. You can also go to the end normally, then kill groups of Charr visible from the ruins. These changes drastically reduce the risk of Rurik's death as he may rush towards the ruins full of Charr in the middle and commit suicide with over-aggro.
5fbedb26833e48f0b0e7825be2ed8a4122e50500.text: 對於發現最後兩個階段具有挑戰性的玩家來說，另一種更安全的方法是在讓魯裡克和埃羅爾通過吊橋之前清除所有 夏爾。逆時針接近終點，進入終點區域，然後向東返回以釋放後面的法師。你也可以正常走到盡頭，然後殺死從廢墟中可見的夏爾群。這些變化大大降低了留裡克的死亡風險，因為他可能會衝向中間充滿夏爾的廢墟，並因過度仇恨而自殺。

c5d1a44c2bbc70a07fcf0502f74b1b3b0dc965fa.source: Prince Rurik can sometimes get obstructed by a chest spawn or get stuck on the stairs before the tar area. If this happens, you'll have to restart the mission and try again. If you approach the imprisoned Mages before opening the drawbridge, sometimes one of them will run straight through the closed door and follow you around until he is killed or brought within range of an obelisk. Sometimes a charr can spawn underground near the imprisoned mages gate.
c5d1a44c2bbc70a07fcf0502f74b1b3b0dc965fa.text: 盧瑞克王子 有時會被箱子生成物阻擋或卡在焦油區域之前的樓梯上。如果發生這種情況，您將必須重新啟動任務並重試。如果你在開啟吊橋之前接近被囚禁的法師，有時他們中的一個會徑直穿過關閉的門並跟隨你，直到他被殺死或帶到方尖碑的範圍內。有時夏爾會在被囚禁的法師門附近的地下生成。

509e6cd4f93d805d42a52a3f470b9a386a63af6c.source: The bonus can be started by talking to Breena Stavinson (point 2 on the wiki map) who is captive and guarded by a Charr boss. She will inform you about the Flame Keeper Charrs's ritual which consist of transferring their Sacred Flame towards a Flame Temple nearby. The objective is to gain entrance past a locked gate (point 4) by following the Charr (without attacking them) and waiting for them to open it. Once the gate is open you can kill the Ember Bearers. Go extinguish the Flame Temple by killing the four Flame Keepers guarding the Cauldron of Cataclysm to complete the bonus (point 3). It is a lot faster to exit the back gate clockwise to meet up with the main path than it is to go all the way back and follow the non-bonus path counter-clockwise, past where Breena was.
509e6cd4f93d805d42a52a3f470b9a386a63af6c.text: 獎勵可以透過與 Breena Stavinson（維基地圖上的 2 點）交談來開始，她被 夏爾 老闆俘虜並看守。她會告訴你火焰守護者查爾斯的儀式，其中包括將他們的神聖火焰轉移到附近的火焰神殿。目標是跟著 夏爾（不攻擊他們）並等待他們開啟門，進入上鎖的門（點 4）。一旦大門開啟，你就可以殺死灰燼持有者。殺死守衛大災變大鍋的四名火焰守護者來撲滅火焰神殿，完成獎勵（點 3）。順時針退出後門與主路匯合比一路返回並逆時針沿著非獎勵路徑（經過 Breena 所在的地方）要快得多。

a999b1d369bfe95eb05bba9bafcfffa9a9ac1b09.source: Note that the Quest Log indicates to "follow the Flame Keepers", but the name of the Charr the party must follow is "Ember Bearer". Sometimes Breena doesn't appear at point 2, possibly killed by the Charr boss near her. When this happens, you'll have to restart the mission and try again. The Flame that the Ember Bearers carry can get stuck on the wall of the tar pit or any minions, the Ember Bearers will carry on but when they get to the gate it doesn't open. However, if you pull them near The Flame and run off it will begin to follow them again. Sometimes the Ember Bearers will get caught at the gate they enter through and prevent the exit gate from being opened. The bonus is still completable as long as the entrance gate opens, but you will not be able to use the exit gate as a shortcut.
a999b1d369bfe95eb05bba9bafcfffa9a9ac1b09.text: 請注意，任務 日誌指示“跟隨火焰守護者”，但該方必須跟隨的 夏爾 的名稱是“夏爾火焰搬運者”。有時，Breena 不會出現在 2 點，可能是被她附近的 夏爾 boss 殺死的。發生這種情況時，您必須重新啟動任務並重試。灰燼持有者攜帶的火焰可能會卡在焦油坑的牆上或任何小兵上，灰燼持有者會繼續前進，但當他們到達大門時，門不會開啟。然而，如果你把它們拉到火焰附近並逃跑，它會再次開始跟隨它們。有時，灰燼持有者會在他們進入的大門處被抓住，並阻止出口大門開啟。只要入口門開啟，獎勵仍然可以完成，但你將無法使用出口門作為捷徑。

777cb0c42df0f12dc237c8f260f3e210dfc7a9f8.source: Be careful when facing Charr Elementalists, as their multiple Meteor Showers can easily cause a wipe.
777cb0c42df0f12dc237c8f260f3e210dfc7a9f8.text: 面對夏爾元素師時要小心，因為他們的多次隕石淋浴很容易造成擦拭。

78e435f28370f7c3b23db3a3b81f1b598b7d11d9.source: Beware the Charr Mesmers who use Power Block which can shutdown your party's casters.
78e435f28370f7c3b23db3a3b81f1b598b7d11d9.text: 小心 夏爾 幻術師，他們使用 強力封鎖 來關閉你隊伍的腳輪。

625ee39929f8d86ceeae728e0f1ff732de77545b.source: Be especially careful before letting Rurik into the ruins of Surmia after the drawbridge. Clearing out all Charr is highly advisable.
625ee39929f8d86ceeae728e0f1ff732de77545b.text: 在讓留裡克進入吊橋後的 蘇米亞 廢墟之前要特別小心。強烈建議清除所有 夏爾。

be2f0998b4862dc409a73913253de01853e02e9a.source: Bond skills (if possible on other than the healer) to ensure Prince Rurik's survival, especially when he rushes ahead of the party and aggros several foes.
be2f0998b4862dc409a73913253de01853e02e9a.text: 結合技能（如果可能的話，除了治療師以外）可以確保 盧瑞克王子 的生存，特別是當他衝在隊伍前面並激怒幾個敵人時。

8086598efb3af8832f81dfc354988c6a3d01fc72.source: Minions and/or binding rituals as meat shields to prevent Rurik taking all of the damage.
8086598efb3af8832f81dfc354988c6a3d01fc72.text: 僕從和/或繫結儀式作為肉盾，以防止魯裡克承受所有傷害。

642143d60ea41c1669f9db118933f4bd0af5b001.source: The quest Cities of Ascalon requires playing through about two-thirds of this mission to reach the Historical Monument of Surmia.
642143d60ea41c1669f9db118933f4bd0af5b001.text: 任務 阿斯卡隆的城市 需要完成任務的大約三分之二才能到達 蘇米亞 的歷史紀念碑。

9e9bf28193c3494ac90cc671ee8dfd88caabfad0.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 1.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. There are some hard to get areas in the northern tar pit that most players usually miss. They can be reached by following the bonus route and exploring after the Ember Bearers open the gate barring the way to the Flame Temple. Finally, explore the northwest part of the map from the outside of the fortress before opening the drawbridge.
9e9bf28193c3494ac90cc671ee8dfd88caabfad0.text: 完成此任務的探索大約為 Tyrian 版圖 標題貢獻了 1.1%。北部焦油坑中有一些難以到達的區域，大多數玩家通常都會錯過。在灰燼持有者開啟通往火焰神殿的大門後，沿著獎勵路線探索即可到達它們。最後，在開啟吊橋之前，先從要塞外部探索地圖的西北部。

2a208c5774aea02e36c9c599861a53fa9dee4125.source: After completing this mission, your party will appear in Nolani Academy.
2a208c5774aea02e36c9c599861a53fa9dee4125.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將出現在 若拉尼學院 中。

d15d7cae2fb26577a6d2b0a4485e70a6e34b41d0.source: It's possible that if you do not keep the Ember Bearers in sight on your compass, they will leave the Flame Brazier behind, causing it to get stuck, and the gate to not open. The only options here if you want the bonus is to glitch through the gate or restart.
d15d7cae2fb26577a6d2b0a4485e70a6e34b41d0.text: 如果你沒有讓餘燼持有者保持在指南針的視野範圍內，他們可能會將火焰火盆拋在後面，導致火盆被卡住，大門也打不開。如果你想要獎金，唯一的選擇就是闖過大門或重新啟動。

f356d05782ea59da8d23e2aace1b1f3573e86e83.source: If using a skill such as Cyclone Axe while fighting the ember bearers, you will probably notice an additional packet of 0 damage. This shows that the Flame is actually an untargetable invulnerable NPC.
f356d05782ea59da8d23e2aace1b1f3573e86e83.text: 如果在與餘燼持有者戰鬥時使用諸如 旋風斧 之類的技能，您可能會注意到額外的 0 傷害。這說明，火焰其實是個無法瞄準、刀槍不入的NPC。

3b413090b36f4052338f71fb8fa9babcc4f8a04a.source: On the third level, you start at the top of the map shown; hug the wall to the right and head straight to the group on that side. As soon as you aggro them, the group from the left will move to the middle of the room where a hidden Destroyer Tremor waits, so be careful. Proceed south slowly. There is another hidden Destroyer Tremor just after of the next group of Destroyers. After defeating them, head into the southwest room. You will see the Asura Gate ahead of you, but there are a number of Destroyers and 2 hidden Destroyer Tremors in between, one about halfway into the room and the other just in front of the gate.
3b413090b36f4052338f71fb8fa9babcc4f8a04a.text: 在第三層，您從所示地圖的頂部開始；抱住右邊的牆，徑直走向那邊的隊伍。一旦你攻擊了他們，左邊的隊伍就會移動到房間中間，那裡有一個隱藏的毀滅者震顫正在等待，所以要小心。緩慢向南行駛。在下一批驅逐艦之後，還有另一艘隱藏的驅逐艦震顫。擊敗他們後，前往西南房間。你會看到前面有 阿蘇拉 門，但中間有許多驅逐艦和 2 隱藏的驅逐艦震顫，其中一個大約進入房間的一半，另一個就在門前。

92e4c2c66394e88900d3e1e0c735eeec94da4e9f.source: After clearing the room, head to the gate. Once you kill the Tremor in front of it, Destroyers will start spawning from the gate, one at a time. You can try to kill the Asura Gate while holding off the Destroyers, or the slower but much easier method is to ignore the gate and kill each Destroyer as it spawns. You should have plenty of time to kill one before the next shows up. After about the 10th Destroyer, they'll stop spawning and you can kill the Asura Gate at your leisure. Or you can completely ignore the mobs that spawn and just attack the gate, it goes down pretty fast and you should get it without dying. Alternatively, if you are having trouble with the Destroyers that spawn in the gate, you can try to pull them right. You can run back to the entrance of the room and they should stay there. Then simply hug the wall and go to the gate and destroy it.
92e4c2c66394e88900d3e1e0c735eeec94da4e9f.text: 清理完房間後，前往大門。一旦你殺死了前面的震顫，驅逐艦就會開始從大門中生成，一次一個。你可以嘗試在阻止驅逐艦的同時殺死 阿蘇拉 門，或者更慢但更簡單的方法是忽略門並在每個驅逐艦生成時殺死它。在下一個出現之前，你應該有足夠的時間殺死一個。在大約第 10 驅逐艦之後，它們將停止生成，您可以在閒暇時殺死 阿蘇拉 門。或者你可以完全忽略生成的小怪，只攻擊大門，它下降得很快，你應該在不死的情況下得到它。或者，如果您在處理大門中生成的毀滅者時遇到麻煩，您可以嘗試將它們拉到正確的位置。你可以跑回房間入口，他們應該留在那裡。然後簡單地抱住牆壁，走到大門處並摧毀它。

71a71737d70d5213e7dc3f9db0a3772cfd4f8264.source: This mission-like quest uses the same maps as Raven's Point and is even referred to as a dungeon when it loads.
71a71737d70d5213e7dc3f9db0a3772cfd4f8264.text: 這個類似任務的任務使用與 渡鴉岬角 相同的地圖，甚至在載入時稱為地下城。

a04b26ae7428c47f669fb1f54acc9a955ac43fca.source: After destroying the Asura Gate, you will view the cinematic, Olaf and Ogden, after which you will be returned to Olafstead.
a04b26ae7428c47f669fb1f54acc9a955ac43fca.text: 摧毀 阿蘇拉 門後，您將觀看動畫《奧拉夫和奧格登》，之後您將返回 尤拉夫之地。

04f80b3f43b76ad64706eb6b0ff1a4b92bca67c0.source: As you enter each level, you will lose the Raven Blessing; talk to Olaf if you wish to receive it again.
04f80b3f43b76ad64706eb6b0ff1a4b92bca67c0.text: 當您進入每個關卡時，您將失去Raven 祝福；如果您想再次收到它，請與奧拉夫交談。

525e500f1cece890cb67f0925df5c76bc4df9b9d.source: To reach the second level, you need only to defeat the final group of Destroyers in front of the exit; the rest of the enemies after the shrine morale boost can be skipped.
525e500f1cece890cb67f0925df5c76bc4df9b9d.text: 想要到達第二關，只需要擊敗出口前的最後一組毀滅者即可；神殿士氣提升後的其餘敵人可以跳過。

c63b8b6c54f1c312ccb3e95fa7b7166b670a0d98.source: Olaf and the Norn guards will resurrect themselves whenever there are no nearby enemies.
c63b8b6c54f1c312ccb3e95fa7b7166b670a0d98.text: 只要附近沒有敵人，奧拉夫和 諾恩 守衛就會復活。

5377e2f44dc09154167f75622f59b2a785196662.source: During this mission, you can make use of the Heart of the Norn for extra health or Stout-Hearted against Destroyers.
5377e2f44dc09154167f75622f59b2a785196662.text: 在這個任務期間，您可以使用 諾恩 之心來獲得額外生命值或對抗毀滅者。

dc33416eda43ed785a7f1158afc9a4815b6af62b.source: The Destroyers are hostile to the other foes in this mission, including Chromatic Drakes and Shattered Elementals.
dc33416eda43ed785a7f1158afc9a4815b6af62b.text: 毀滅者與本次任務中的其他敵人敵對，包括彩色幼龍和破碎元素。

66a1c276f77f4d61ee0fa92fe31bf71dbce4941e.source: Destroyers are vulnerable to cold damage. You can convert most damage into cold damage by combining Greater Conflagration (turns physical into fire damage) and Winter (turns elemental into cold damage).
66a1c276f77f4d61ee0fa92fe31bf71dbce4941e.text: 驅逐艦容易受到寒冷傷害。您可以透過組合更強的 火靈（將物理傷害轉化為火焰傷害）和 寒冬（將元素傷害轉化為寒冷傷害），將大部分傷害轉化為寒冷傷害。

3877dae28032f6b3f12be49ad043c73a71cc383a.source: Other useful skills include interrupts, damage reduction skills, and Pain Inverter.
3877dae28032f6b3f12be49ad043c73a71cc383a.text: 其他有用的技能包括中斷、傷害減少技能和 苦痛 逆變器。

b3c13fb1b01f7ba3ccd2ac56ff86d8c1e10f58b8.source: Martial characters could use anti-knock down to stand against tremor used by Destroyer Tremor and skills that prevent or punish blocking to face Destroyer of Deeds and Destroyer of Hordes who use Lightning Reflexes.
b3c13fb1b01f7ba3ccd2ac56ff86d8c1e10f58b8.text: 武術角色可以使用抗擊倒來對抗毀滅者震顫所使用的震顫，以及防止或懲罰阻擋的技能來面對使用閃電迴避的行動毀滅者和部落毀滅者。

618c063d8c8f799fd39e2f5244b44a92d0c93181.source: The Asura Gate is not a fleshy foe, but it can be knocked down.
618c063d8c8f799fd39e2f5244b44a92d0c93181.text: 阿蘇拉 門不是肉體敵人，但可以被擊倒。

8b308ded631fc6d5ff9af849f4ee48ed242c8a26.source: Like all repeatable primary Eye of the North quests, after completing it once, you can obtain it again from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments.
8b308ded631fc6d5ff9af849f4ee48ed242c8a26.text: 就像所有可重複的主要 極地之眼 任務一樣，完成一次後，您可以從 史蹟殿堂 的占卜池中再次獲得它。

9d80cacf0daa15ef5ac59c47f2dd113cad694aa4.source: Your character will not get credit if Vision of the Raven Spirit was not completed before completing this quest.
9d80cacf0daa15ef5ac59c47f2dd113cad694aa4.text: 如果在完成此任務之前未完成烏鴉之靈的幻象，你的角色將不會獲得積分。

60eb5545d2aca1d44a511031eef108be8a7d65ac.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #8 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
60eb5545d2aca1d44a511031eef108be8a7d65ac.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#8 頁。

f3ff08a05e8b13c1c7f138eeeeb3340c240808e9.source: If using Heroes, make sure you wait for any spirits summoned in the path of the Flame Bearers to expire before talking to Breena. If your spirits aggro the Flame Bearers, they will follow up to you.
f3ff08a05e8b13c1c7f138eeeeb3340c240808e9.text: 如果使用英雄，請確保在與布蕾娜交談之前等待火焰攜帶者路徑中召喚的所有靈魂都消失。如果你的靈魂激怒了火焰攜帶者，他們就會跟隨你。

e22ee8100eb2530b4973fcc9ace6d2342a417aa3.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #4 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
e22ee8100eb2530b4973fcc9ace6d2342a417aa3.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#4 頁。

23df225dc7b8cbb47999b6eb69a9b80f9d43c9a1.source: de:Ruinen von Surmia (Mission) fr:Ruines de Surmia (Mission en mode coopératif)
23df225dc7b8cbb47999b6eb69a9b80f9d43c9a1.text: de:Ruinen von 蘇米亞 (主線任務) fr:Ruines de 蘇米亞 (主線任務 en mode coopératif)

c8bf07a3bc71282259a4c61983097eade6d78ed2.source: Exit Sunspear Great Hall into Plains of Jarin and talk to Jerek. Map travel to Blacktide Den and talk to Savage Nunbe.
c8bf07a3bc71282259a4c61983097eade6d78ed2.text: 退出 日戟大會堂 進入 賈林平原 並與 Jerek 交談。地圖前往黑潮巢穴並與 Savage Nunbe 交談。

3758b5ad080d78eb42f7f3d1234a1f7a7ffcdb8b.source: Map travel to Kodlonu Hamlet and get your team ready, then enter the portal into Mehtani Keys.
3758b5ad080d78eb42f7f3d1234a1f7a7ffcdb8b.text: 繪製前往 Kodlonu Hamlet 的地圖並讓您的團隊做好準備，然後進入 梅坦尼之鑰 的門戶。

f80b033b39f60aa0a30aa5a4561f73f7108dc453.source: Stick to the islands and mind the pop-ups of Mandragors. Follow the route on the map for optimum speed. After beating Ironfist down to 25% health he becomes friendly. Map travel back to Sunspear Great Hall and go back outside to talk to Jerek for the reward.
f80b033b39f60aa0a30aa5a4561f73f7108dc453.text: 留在島嶼上並注意突然出現的曼德拉戈。按照地圖上的路線行駛，以獲得最佳速度。將鐵拳擊敗至 25% 生命值後，他變得友善。地圖返回 日戟大會堂，然後回到外面與 Jerek 交談以獲得獎勵。

89e166f10603fd8bc50394abb605ea75bcb5a1b9.source: All party members must have received the reward for Vision of the Raven Spirit.
89e166f10603fd8bc50394abb605ea75bcb5a1b9.text: 所有黨員都必須獲得烏鴉之靈幻象的獎勵。

911f8e797574c6ec77cdd9bd228f3a721dbfe176.source: Speak to Olaf Olafson to journey to Raven's Point. (disappears from Quest Log after entering Mission)
911f8e797574c6ec77cdd9bd228f3a721dbfe176.text: 與 尤拉夫 尤拉夫森 交談即可前往 渡鴉岬角。 （進入 主線任務 後從 任務 日誌中消失）

71d57bde2d8ca56fa2536f65bad5d889706bcc77.source: Help Olaf cleanse the Shrine of the Raven Spirit.
71d57bde2d8ca56fa2536f65bad5d889706bcc77.text: 幫助奧拉夫淨化烏鴉之靈神殿。

7e68e0660284bfd42afaf122e03a17f7fa4e50b1.source: Receive the Raven Blessing from the shrine.
7e68e0660284bfd42afaf122e03a17f7fa4e50b1.text: 從神社領取 Raven 祝福。

fd8f3e66d77ebbf717a9b6f4de6c4bc1c3256cfb.source: Follow the Destroyer Tremor trail to its source.
fd8f3e66d77ebbf717a9b6f4de6c4bc1c3256cfb.text: 沿著毀滅者震顫蹤跡找到它的源頭。

66f49873e3a81114dc373bff582c4e9f32e4938a.source: Destroy the Asura Gate to halt the Destroyer influx.
66f49873e3a81114dc373bff582c4e9f32e4938a.text: 摧毀 阿蘇拉 門以阻止毀滅者湧入。

ad6e679b3761d4c38925d36722dd42967b280b9b.source: Use Raven's Flight to protect you from the Destroyer Tremors.
ad6e679b3761d4c38925d36722dd42967b280b9b.text: 使用烏鴉飛行來保護你免受毀滅者震顫的傷害。

b41ee5084908103b65639589cb2da195f08c08e2.source: Receive Unlike the previous objective, there is no "the" here Raven Blessing from Olaf.
b41ee5084908103b65639589cb2da195f08c08e2.text: 接收 與先前的目標不同，這裡沒有來自 Olaf 的 Raven 祝福。

d284b7ef6aa238116f76d9cda69b40937bf31a2c.source: Speak to Olaf Olafson in Olafstead, who will take you to Raven's Point.
d284b7ef6aa238116f76d9cda69b40937bf31a2c.text: 與 尤拉夫之地 中的 尤拉夫 尤拉夫森 交談，他將帶您前往 渡鴉岬角。

597b0bfcae1411add4ee16698a74fa115425a0f5.source: On the first level, you start at the bottom of the map shown; go Northwest and turn East and then North to a gate which will open for you. You will see the Shrine of the Raven Spirit ahead of you, but as you approach, a Destroyer Tremor will pop up in front of it, and two more Destroyers spawn from the northeast. After you defeat them, 2 more Destroyers will spawn to the west, then the southwest corner, then the southeast corner of the room. After defeating the last group, you gain a morale boost, and can receive Raven Blessing from the shrine or from Olaf. You don't need to take the blessing; it is optional.
597b0bfcae1411add4ee16698a74fa115425a0f5.text: 在第一層，您從所示地圖的底部開始；向西北走，然後向東轉，然後向北到達一扇將為您開啟的大門。你會在你前面看到烏鴉之靈神殿，但當你接近時，它前面會彈出一個毀滅者震顫，並且另外兩個毀滅者會從東北方生成。擊敗它們後，2更多的驅逐艦將在房間的西邊、西南角、東南角生成。擊敗最後一組後，你計程車氣將會提升，並且可以從神殿或奧拉夫那裡獲得烏鴉 祝福。你不需要接受祝福；它是可選的。

407d88800fbecc73fac39c6b0ee6095f57393ca1.source: Heading back south out of the room, you will see groups of Destroyers, each with a Destroyer Tremor and two other Destroyers. Aim for the Tremors first, interrupting if possible, and follow the path from one group of Destroyers to the next to find the portal to the next level.
407d88800fbecc73fac39c6b0ee6095f57393ca1.text: 走出房間往南走，你會看到成群的驅逐艦，每艘驅逐艦都有一艘震顫驅逐艦和另外兩艘驅逐艦。首先瞄準震顫，如果可能的話打斷，然後沿著一組毀滅者到下一組的路徑找到通往下一層的傳送門。

1b6e4f6e2fb7b37e54ac9e42118a9ef97fd8bfc7.source: On the second level, you start at the bottom of the map shown; head straight North around the first group of Vaettirs, then West through the doorway. Destroyers will kill off any other groups of Vaettirs you come by when you go near them, but you can head North then West again to avoid them and reach the portal to the third level. It is easily possible to avoid contact with any foes on this level.
1b6e4f6e2fb7b37e54ac9e42118a9ef97fd8bfc7.text: 在第二層，您從所示地圖的底部開始；繞過第一組 Vaettirs 一直向北走，然後穿過門口向西走。當你靠近驅逐艦時，它們會殺死你遇到的任何其他維提爾群體，但你可以再次向北然後向西行駛以避免他們並到達第三層的傳送門。在這個級別上，很容易避免與任何敵人接觸。

a1a5f150466844277d0af4b5dc2f639243d3bb69.source: On the second level, if you do not take Raven blessing, sometimes you will encounter the default mobs instead of Destroyers. On the third level, the Destroyers sometimes do not spawn until you reach the final area that has the Asura Gate. On the third level, if the first Destroyer Tremor isn't attacked by the party the 3 Destroyers that are supposed to protect the second Tremor will almost always remain inactive at their spawn point a bit behind it until they are attacked. If the rest of your party wipes and Ogden and/or Vekk are in the party, they will resurrect where they died, as soon as the final dialogue begins (as you enter the last room).
a1a5f150466844277d0af4b5dc2f639243d3bb69.text: 在第二層，如果你不接受烏鴉祝福，有時你會遇到預設的小怪而不是毀滅者。在第三層，驅逐艦有時不會生成，直到您到達具有 阿蘇拉 門的最終區域。在第三層，如果第一個驅逐艦震顫沒有受到隊伍的攻擊，那麼應該保護第二個震顫的 3 驅逐艦幾乎總是在其後面一點的產卵點保持不活動狀態，直到它們受到攻擊。如果你的隊伍中的其他人抹掉了，並且奧格登和/或維克在隊伍中，那麼一旦最後的對話開始（當你進入最後一個房間時），他們就會在死亡的地方復活。

2bb0044d6a79468770c4bebc1e76508c9e82b1a6.source: Travel through the Zhengjo Temple and eliminate the mantids.
2bb0044d6a79468770c4bebc1e76508c9e82b1a6.text: 穿越 徵臼神殿 並消滅螳螂。

94c4b37f685e5c930487cc3047bd1efdd2de92a2.source: See Reng Ku for your reward
94c4b37f685e5c930487cc3047bd1efdd2de92a2.text: 見 Reng Ku 領取獎勵

0c52d7600e7e77994b88c83c6864469f7c1345dd.source: On accepting the quest, Reng Ku gives you the following skills:
0c52d7600e7e77994b88c83c6864469f7c1345dd.text: 接受任務後，Reng Ku 會給你以下技能：

5fb5df41c15e858b8df8c29dc008f0d0b1275852.source: The entrance to the temple is east from Reng Ku's location. Inside there will be two mantids. Killing a mantid will cause another to spawn. After five mantids have been killed, the Queen Mantid will drop down. Kill it and return to Reng Ku for your reward.
5fb5df41c15e858b8df8c29dc008f0d0b1275852.text: 寺廟的入口位於仁庫所在地的東邊。裡面會有兩隻螳螂。殺死一隻螳螂會導致另一隻螳螂生成。殺死五隻螳螂後，螳螂女王就會掉落。殺死它並返回Reng Ku領取獎勵。

ba95afc1d127e43c81b61187f256696c636f508b.source: If this quest is accepted while the Festival Event Quest A Strange Request is active, the quest marker will not appear in the minimap and progress will be halted. Finish or abandon the Festival Event Quest first prior to attempting this quest.
ba95afc1d127e43c81b61187f256696c636f508b.text: 如果在節日活動 任務 奇怪的請求處於活動狀態時接受此任務，任務標記將不會出現在小地圖中，進度將停止。在嘗試此任務之前，請先完成或放棄節日活動 任務。

22a4c92b659f8c83f1113fe3edf08940e3a22f7d.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Diessa Lowlands and start the mission. Completing Ruins of Surmia also brings the party here.
22a4c92b659f8c83f1113fe3edf08940e3a22f7d.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 底耶沙低地 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 蘇米亞廢墟 也將聚會帶到這裡。

7f3cd1de4230a58cf4624f82039a051bb0de9801.source: Return Prince Rurik south of the Wall to safety.
7f3cd1de4230a58cf4624f82039a051bb0de9801.text: 影返 盧瑞克王子 位於隔離牆以南的安全地帶。

8de18cfd8e5214910a4f1d2dd1e86f87694c1ead.source: Sneak out and ambush the Charr forces besieging the academy.
8de18cfd8e5214910a4f1d2dd1e86f87694c1ead.text: 潛行並伏擊包圍學院的 夏爾 部隊。

00d249f22aaa994fca399499264b083c20898907.source: Return to the Nolani Academy to rendezvous with the prince.
00d249f22aaa994fca399499264b083c20898907.text: 影返 到 若拉尼學院 與王子會合。

8dbf0643dfe3148e89fd775516bb73e58167f6fd.source: Defend Prince Rurik on the way back to the capital city of Rin.
8dbf0643dfe3148e89fd775516bb73e58167f6fd.text: 在返回瑞恩首都的途中保衛盧瑞克王子。

88bcf9cfcc3d8473fc40025d9a5d75c18957312f.source: *BONUS* Return the Tome of the Fallen.
88bcf9cfcc3d8473fc40025d9a5d75c18957312f.text: *獎勵* 影返 墮落者之書。

4ee04268e6560ca4b63bbea6292a2feec117fa8b.source: ADDED: Take Stormcaller to Horn Hill.
4ee04268e6560ca4b63bbea6292a2feec117fa8b.text: 新增：將風暴召喚者帶到霍恩山。

b6d864f5297d9bdabd192da7fe77d511314760c4.source: The goal of this mission is to return south of the Wall, back to the safety of Rin, beyond the Charr horde waiting both in the passage in front of Nolani Academy and behind the Wall. Prince Rurik will remain behind the gate in the starting area while players sneak out through the back door and ambush the Charr forces from behind. To perform this task, players will head south to the Wall and then loop back to Nolani Academy again. (Technically the lever could be used to open the gate, but that would give access to Nolani Academy to the Charr army and it's not recommended. High-level teams, however, can save a substantial amount of time.)
b6d864f5297d9bdabd192da7fe77d511314760c4.text: 任務的目標是返回長城以南，回到 瑞恩 的安全地帶，超越在 若拉尼學院 前面和長城後面的通道中等待的 夏爾 部落。 盧瑞克王子 將留在起始區域的大門後面，而玩家則從後門溜出去，從後面伏擊 夏爾 部隊。為了執行此任務，玩家將向南前往長城，然後再次迴圈回到 若拉尼學院。 （從技術上講，槓桿可以用來開啟大門，但這將使 夏爾 軍隊能夠存取 若拉尼學院，因此不建議這樣做。但是，高階團隊可以節省大量時間。）

c600361a67b07b1e228e953f46920f453960d1af.source: There is a lone Flaming Scepter Mage at the start of the mission, talk to him and he will follow and help you out. On your way to the Wall, you will also encounter allies (with Dual Shot), Warmaster Casana with an Ascalonian Ranger plus another three Lost Soldiers on the opposite side of the passage, near the Charr forces.
c600361a67b07b1e228e953f46920f453960d1af.text: 任務開始時有一個孤獨的火焰權杖法師傭兵，與他交談，他會跟隨並幫助你。在前往長城的路上，您還會遇到盟友（與 雙重箭 一起）、戰帥卡薩納與阿斯卡隆 遊俠 以及通道另一側靠近 夏爾 部隊的另外三名迷失士兵。

e12b08f1f51050b5cec885126e10f681cc922213.source: Clear the passage of Charr forces and Rurik will open the gate of Nolani and proceed to the Wall. Once there, a cinematic will trigger.
e12b08f1f51050b5cec885126e10f681cc922213.text: 清除 夏爾 部隊的通道，魯裡克將開啟 若拉尼 的大門並前往長城。一旦到達那裡，就會觸發電影。

fad47ea344776c08dc444938084b6b93ec387e9e.source: On the other side, Rin is found under attack. The only way to save the city now is by reaching Horn Hill and make use of the recently acquired Stormcaller. A second cinematic will trigger once there. Immediately afterwards, Rurik will rush forward in a desperate attempt to rescue Rin from several Charr invaders. Remember the Prince's death will cause mission failure. If you manage to save the Ascalon Prisoners, talk to them and they will follow you. The elementalist Charr boss Bonfaaz Burntfur will be standing at the very back of the ruins, kill him to complete the mission.
fad47ea344776c08dc444938084b6b93ec387e9e.text: 另一方面，瑞恩 被發現受到攻擊。現在拯救城市的唯一方法是到達霍恩山並利用最近獲得的風​​暴召喚者。一旦到達就會觸發第二個動畫。緊接著，留裡克將拼命衝上前去，試圖從幾個夏爾入侵者手中拯救瑞恩。記住王子的死會導致任務失敗。如果您設法拯救 阿斯卡隆 囚犯，請與他們交談，他們會跟隨您。元素師夏爾 Boss Bonfaaz Burntfur將站在廢墟的最後面，殺死他即可完成任務。

571685c43c1cdd75fee93685b4bde3fc64beb7a2.source: A high-level player with a hybrid running/fighting build can whizz through the mission in about 12-15 minutes. Simply bring a speed boost or two and a high-damage combo (preferably AoE) - the only necessary killing is the group immediately outside the Academy (pull the lever) and Bonfaaz Burntfur. Note that you have to go out the sneaky back exit for the bonus because Rurik is on a pre-programmed route and will not wait up - he will go to the Wall and activate the cinematic, then to Rin and activate Stormcaller.
571685c43c1cdd75fee93685b4bde3fc64beb7a2.text: 具有混合跑步/戰鬥體型的高水準玩家可以在大約 12-15 分鐘內快速完成任務。只需帶上一兩個速度提升和一個高傷害組合（最好是 範圍性） - 唯一需要殺死的就是學院外的那群人（拉動控制桿）和 Bonfaaz Burntfur。請注意，你必須從偷偷摸摸的後出口出去才能獲得獎金，因為魯裡克在預先程式設計的路線上並且不會等待 - 他將前往長城並啟用過場動畫，然後前往 瑞恩 並啟用風暴召喚者。

c1d531ae2ce7f9e96760342d0d09dddcbcbea9c3.source: The final battle against the Charr forces often results in Rurik's death (especially in Hard mode), mainly due to the large number of foes and the prince's suicidal tendencies. To avoid such a fate at the very end of the mission, players can use an alternative path that is completely clear of Charr and leads straight towards the last Charr boss Bonfaaz Burntfur, whose death grants mission completion.
c1d531ae2ce7f9e96760342d0d09dddcbcbea9c3.text: 與夏爾部隊的最終戰鬥經常導致留裡克的死亡（尤其是在困難模式中），這主要是由於敵人數量眾多和王子的自殺傾向。為了避免在任務最後出現這樣的命運，玩家可以使用一條完全避開 夏爾 的替代路徑，並直接通往最後一個 夏爾 首領 Bonfaaz Burntfur，他的死亡使任務完成。

b24a8099fa24a167faf00771949dbb055daef6ba.source: The strategy consists of reaching the final boss before Rurik triggers Stormcaller's cinematic. After the first cinematic, instead of following him, turn west (right) and run south along the clear path (see wiki-map).
b24a8099fa24a167faf00771949dbb055daef6ba.text: 該策略包括在魯裡克觸發風暴召喚者的過場動畫之前到達最終首領。第一部電影結束後，不要跟著他，而是向西（右）轉向，沿著清晰的路徑向南跑（參見維基地圖）。

5db0db1b6e4937ea14741b0da3f75d0bb0ce5ba7.source: Avoid aggroing the mobs within the ruins of Rin and rescue the two Ascalon Prisoners under attack (just past the archway). Climb up the stairway and kill Bonfaaz Burntfur as fast as possible to complete the mission.
5db0db1b6e4937ea14741b0da3f75d0bb0ce5ba7.text: 避免激怒 瑞恩 廢墟中的怪物，並營救兩名受到攻擊的 阿斯卡隆 囚犯（就在拱門後面）。爬上樓梯並儘快殺死邦法茲·燒毛即可完成任務。

7686139c4379ed2beca59725fc7c7ded0f693b7a.source: The bonus consists of returning the Tome of the Fallen (point 1 on the wiki-map) back to its pedestal at the graveyard (point 2 on the wiki-map), and can be performed before freeing the way for Rurik. Slightly close to the Wall, you will spot Watchman Pramas on your radar, who will then ask that you take the tome back to where it belongs.
7686139c4379ed2beca59725fc7c7ded0f693b7a.text: 獎勵包括將墮落者之書（維基地圖上的 1 點）放回墓地的底座（維基地圖上的 2 點），並且可以在為魯裡克騰出道路之前執行。距離長城稍近一點，你會在雷達上發現守望者普拉馬斯，然後他會要求你將這本書帶回它所屬的地方。

18d0abd06a25008906fd93f2eb80230bc2ea2242.source: Proceed to the Wall but instead of heading north towards Nolani Academy, head westwards and across the broken steps to find the graveyard filled with hostile Spirits of the Fallen. Do not engage too many at once since there are hidden devourer pop-ups on the cliff above. At the furthest west side of the graveyard, place the tome on the tome pedestal. An Old Ascalon Spirit will then appear; talk to him and do not leave his compass range until the bonus is marked as complete.
18d0abd06a25008906fd93f2eb80230bc2ea2242.text: 繼續前往長城，但不要向北前往 若拉尼學院，而是向西走，穿過破碎的臺階，找到充滿敵意的墮落者靈魂的墓地。不要一次與太多人交戰，因為上面的懸崖上有隱藏的吞噬者彈出視窗。在墓地的最西側，將書放在書本基座上。然後，舊阿斯卡隆 靈魂就會出現；與他交談，並且在獎勵標記為完成之前不要離開他的羅盤範圍。

aee58f1708ad6ab59c653c1225af9f932069ddde.source: The party size is only four:

2a10e593b3bb68e94c7ea6905e0c01e0a94c4d12.source: Bond skills e.g. Life Bond to ensure Rurik's survival.
2a10e593b3bb68e94c7ea6905e0c01e0a94c4d12.text: 債券技能，例如生命連結 確保魯裡克的生存。

d24b47cf1a581178956dd6d1b85ed8c921304528.source: Helps to bring minions and/or binding rituals.
d24b47cf1a581178956dd6d1b85ed8c921304528.text: 有助於帶來僕從和/或繫結儀式。

3e6f1073f3b786c6e0b53651667b0ab24e253484.source: Watch for Charr Blade Storms who can remove your stances with Wild Blow.
3e6f1073f3b786c6e0b53651667b0ab24e253484.text: 留意 夏爾 劍刃風暴，他們可以使用 狂暴一擊 消除你的姿態。

7edf4d20ac55462bf137960c9f935483c6430209.source: Consider having everyone in the party bring resurrection skills.
7edf4d20ac55462bf137960c9f935483c6430209.text: 考慮讓隊伍中的每個人都帶上復活技能。

2c2e1bd87a4b1b2bfa11b5a8c869ef30094d93bb.source: Players with access to the EoTN expansion can use both the Rebel Yell title effect and Ebon Vanguard skills to their advantage.
2c2e1bd87a4b1b2bfa11b5a8c869ef30094d93bb.text: 有權存取 EoTN 擴充包的玩家可以使用 Rebel Yell 標題效果和 黑檀 技能來發揮自己的優勢。

77d8c840f471fa16aa59cc1cc582b6f86d807b70.source: Pulling the lever at the start will almost certainly cause your party to die due to Meteor Shower and the AoE from Cyclone Axe, Hundred Blades and Ignite Arrows. Use the back route.
77d8c840f471fa16aa59cc1cc582b6f86d807b70.text: 在開始時拉動控制桿幾乎肯定會導致您的隊伍死亡，因為 隕石雨 和 旋風斧、快速劍 和 爆烈箭 中的 範圍性。使用回程路線。

a63f74ada4a7d356c26fa2b91364e1d0c985e624.source: Watch out for Skull Crack from the Spirits of the Fallen in the bonus graveyard area.
a63f74ada4a7d356c26fa2b91364e1d0c985e624.text: 在獎勵墓園區域留意來自墮落者之魂的 碎顎。

4c7d17c437c898125985e9a7e9d8c202d4c52f4d.source: Some of the bosses are separate to the groups of enemies nearby, and can be aggro'd separately.
4c7d17c437c898125985e9a7e9d8c202d4c52f4d.text: 有些 Boss 與附近的敵人群體是分開的，可以單獨進行仇恨。

83ef23712bb77aef5b35b91a38021e278e57fe6c.source: If your party is powerful enough, you can pull the lever to open the front gate and fight the Charr that swarm in; however, this is only recommended for characters with high levels.
83ef23712bb77aef5b35b91a38021e278e57fe6c.text: 如果你的隊伍夠強大，你可以拉動槓桿開啟前門，與蜂擁而至的夏爾戰鬥；然而，這僅建議用於高等級的角色。

6a6815b75de8bc90bd635a8906da2e0bfef881b5.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 1.0% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. Take Rurik all the way to Bonfaaz Burntfur, where Rurik will stop running, giving you the time needed to explore.
6a6815b75de8bc90bd635a8906da2e0bfef881b5.text: 完成此任務的探索大約為 Tyrian 版圖 標題貢獻了 1.0%。帶著魯裡克一路前往邦法茲本特弗，魯裡克將在那裡停止奔跑，為您提供探索所需的時間。

86c922e4d3df154b5d79b76518b9069f4cb9736c.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Yak's Bend.
86c922e4d3df154b5d79b76518b9069f4cb9736c.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 犛牛村。

d083557e107126ef9c7768e221b96a64dbf8d40a.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #5 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
d083557e107126ef9c7768e221b96a64dbf8d40a.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#5 頁。

a7701d4d4555db86e416669d10e6896d157e5b0d.source: If you choose to open the gate at the beginning of the mission, there is a small chance that
a7701d4d4555db86e416669d10e6896d157e5b0d.text: 如果您選擇在任務開始時開啟大門，則有很小的機會

0e6b62c0d499143da787414b5d6e571be14936ff.source: The nearby Charr will vanish or
0e6b62c0d499143da787414b5d6e571be14936ff.text: 附近的 夏爾 將會消失或

9401a9672448fe37f7432fc71a4cf4ea92430692.source: Some groups of Charr will attempt to invade the academy from the back.
9401a9672448fe37f7432fc71a4cf4ea92430692.text: 夏爾 的某些組織將試圖從後方入侵學院。

d11ed62a07d20a53634bcf49d48973ecb6b724a8.source: Prince Rurik will freeze, forcing you to restart the mission (i.e. if you open the gate before he finishes speaking).
d11ed62a07d20a53634bcf49d48973ecb6b724a8.text: 盧瑞克王子 將凍結，迫使您重新啟動任務（即，如果您在他說完之前開啟門）。

8214be474c110c7470e857aae278710b9eb4295d.source: If you choose not to follow Rurik after opening the gate to Rin, he will avoid the Elementals and skip to cinematic 2. If Bonfaaz Burntfur dies during cinematic 2 (e.g. due to degeneration), the mission will not end and your party will not be taken to Yak's Bend. The mission will register as completed, however (the map icon will update and you will get credit for your storybook). Additionally, if you wipe, you will not receive an option to return to the outpost, you will have to re-zone manually.
8214be474c110c7470e857aae278710b9eb4295d.text: 如果您在開啟 瑞恩 大門後選擇不跟隨 Rurik，他將避免元素並跳至影片 2。如果 Bonfaaz Burntfur 在電影 2 期間死亡（例如因退化），任務將不會結束，您的隊伍也不會被帶到 犛牛村。不過，任務將註冊為已完成（地圖圖示將更新，您將獲得故事書的積分）。此外，如果您進行擦除，您將不會收到返回前哨站的選項，您將必須手動重新分割槽。

72e26e75d0dc04821df045844cf5f65e1391b263.source: At the start of the mission, if a party member gets too close to the boss (and its group's spawning location), the starting gate will open after that group dies. Any remaining Charr near the gate will rush Prince Rurik, risking his death (and mission failure). To avoid this, avoid the spawn-point by pulling the boss group away, giving you a chance to kill the other two groups of Charr.
72e26e75d0dc04821df045844cf5f65e1391b263.text: 在任務開始時，如果隊伍成員距離 Boss（及其隊伍的生成位置）太近，起始門將在該隊伍死亡後開啟。大門附近剩餘的任何 夏爾 都會衝向 盧瑞克王子，冒著死亡（和任務失敗）的風險。為了避免這種情況，請透過將 Boss 組拉開來避開重生點，這樣您就有機會殺死 夏爾 的其他兩組。

f65a1e8c3cf7decaffebcb25ee20f02e673f2624.text: 對 高楠 提出指控。

fa2d86fcbb22c0e66757ea0d577dc264654c4c9e.source: Speak to Jerek to let him know you are ready to go to trial. He will separate you from your party and send you to the Tribunal, which takes place in the Consulate.
fa2d86fcbb22c0e66757ea0d577dc264654c4c9e.text: 與傑瑞克交談，讓他知道您已準備好接受審判。他會將您與您的隊伍分開，並將您送往在領事館進行的法庭。

d3cdba0a4d5dd6902df5d33e5ee694ebb1406219.source: Your witnesses will be already in place (including Ironfist and the various heroes acquired to-date, except for Tahlkora). You speak to Elder Suhl to start things off, choose a witness, and then respond to General Morgahn's questions. Your goal is to convince the panel of 11 Kournan Nobles and 11 Istani Nobles that Varesh is behind the recent episodes that have threatened Istan. Each time you present a witness, your score might go up or down; each time you answer a question, it will decrease.
d3cdba0a4d5dd6902df5d33e5ee694ebb1406219.text: 你的見證人已經就位（包括鐵拳和迄今為止獲得的各種英雄，除了塔爾科拉）。你與蘇爾長老交談以開始事情，選擇一名證人，然後回答 摩根將軍 的問題。您的目標是讓 11 Kournan Nobles 和 11 Istani Nobles 小組相信 Varesh 是近期威脅 艾斯坦 事件的幕後黑手。每次你出示證人時，你的分數可能會上升或下降；每回答一個問題，它就會減少。

6c44af7bf0e1354e1df8da5a8ecbfa021cb82711.source: However, your choices have no effect on the outcome of the trial, the campaign, or any rewards that you receive: Morgahn will have the same reaction, Tahlkora will show up late with Kormir, and she will demand that Varesh be tried directly. This completes the quest; you must map out and return to Puuba for your reward.
6c44af7bf0e1354e1df8da5a8ecbfa021cb82711.text: 然而，你的選擇不會影響審判、戰役或你收到的任何獎勵的結果：摩根會有同樣的反應，塔爾科拉會和科米爾一起遲到，她會要求直接審判瓦雷什。這樣就完成了任務；你必須制定計劃並返回普烏巴以獲得獎勵。

8408a8649493711b14c63468936f7b94f31f3a04.source: Regardless, should you wish to sway as many of the 22 jurists as possible, you will want to introduce witnesses that coincide with the question that Morgahn is about to ask. This maximizes the value of witnesses and minimizes the negative impact of your answers. Since this is impossible without having witnessed the trial before, you can follow the steps below:
8408a8649493711b14c63468936f7b94f31f3a04.text: 無論如何，如果您希望影響盡可能多的 22 法學家，您將需要介紹與摩根即將提出的問題相符的證人。這可以最大限度地發揮證人的價值，並最大限度地減少你的答案的負面影響。由於之前沒有目睹審判，這是不可能的，因此您可以按照以下步驟操作：

28b6bbdd2ab9ae1c44a41c9bdc09d85bf950e296.source: Call Dunkoro as your first witness.
28b6bbdd2ab9ae1c44a41c9bdc09d85bf950e296.text: 傳喚鄧科羅為你的第一位證人。

59b03f43be7f1d07c44797969ecaf226fd82d157.source: Give the second answer to General Morgahn's first question.
59b03f43be7f1d07c44797969ecaf226fd82d157.text: 給出 摩根將軍 第一個問題的第二個答案。

6ef97fb2ad0bcd781964a204863cf3580c5c96f5.source: Choose the first answer to Morgahn's question.
6ef97fb2ad0bcd781964a204863cf3580c5c96f5.text: 選擇摩根問題的第一個答案。

9ad637e2a3e7fa867b7c6192f77c973133cb4cbf.source: Call either Melonni or Koss as your third witness.
9ad637e2a3e7fa867b7c6192f77c973133cb4cbf.text: 打電話給 梅隆妮 或 寇斯 作為您的第三個證人。

a7aa41ca1386f9ec37fe6c5638fce47e850889a9.source: Give the first answer to the General's last question.
a7aa41ca1386f9ec37fe6c5638fce47e850889a9.text: 首先回答將軍最後一個問題。

7407fecf0f78c9c68658bddf0a817cf78361b0c6.source: Wandering over to the jury area behind General Morgahn and Elder Suhl may permanently trap you at the bottom of the left staircase between the female Kournan Noble at ground level and the male Kournan Noble on the staircase itself near the bottom. If any quest objectives remain, you will be unable to complete the quest and must restart.
7407fecf0f78c9c68658bddf0a817cf78361b0c6.text: 徘徊到 摩根將軍 和蘇爾長老後面的陪審團區域可能會將您永久困在左側樓梯的底部，位於地面的女性 Kournan 貴族和靠近底部的樓梯本身的男性 Kournan 貴族之間。如果仍有任何任務目標，您將無法完成任務，必須重新開始。

53c38373517899c0d279ab3f1b0fb6b8d59cd763.source: Retrieve the Hammer of the Great Dwarf from deep within the mountain caverns.
53c38373517899c0d279ab3f1b0fb6b8d59cd763.text: 從洞穴深處取回 偉大矮人 的 鎚。

37523dc6c26ef0330abca56569a86f0233ce9360.source: Use Dwarven powder kegs to remove obstacles.
37523dc6c26ef0330abca56569a86f0233ce9360.text: 使用矮人火藥桶清除障礙物。

5f86eb69d29174c0f63b5b4c5f74a737f6e1ddaf.source: The main difficulty of this quest is encountered on the third level of the dungeon, where players must defeat Cyndr the Mountain Heart - which can be extremely difficult for single players and it is recommended to team-up with others, as the party will need to drop three kegs on the Wurm to enable it to be damaged.
5f86eb69d29174c0f63b5b4c5f74a737f6e1ddaf.text: 任務的主要困難發生在地牢的第三層，玩家必須擊敗山之心 Cyndr - 這對單人玩家來說非常困難，建議與其他玩家組隊，因為隊伍需要在 地蟲 上扔下三個小桶才能損壞它。

c1fbe92176cdd3c75823977b0bce6e021ce92fca.source: Start from Eye of the North (outpost), head west and use the portal to Battledepths. Head along the north tunnel to the Dwarves' encampment and talk to King Jalis Ironhammer (point K on the wiki-map) to pick-up the quest. Cross the hall, and head east to avoid the Chromatic Drakes - kill the two groups of Djinn and then follow the wall to the Asura Gate to the dungeon entrance.
c1fbe92176cdd3c75823977b0bce6e021ce92fca.text: 從 極地之眼（前哨站）出發，向西行進並使用傳送門前往 戰鬥深淵。沿著北隧道前往矮人的營地，並與 亞理斯 艾倫海默國王（維基地圖上的 K 點）交談以接受任務。穿過大廳，向東走，避開彩色龍 - 殺死兩組 巨靈怪，然後沿著牆壁到達 阿蘇拉 地牢入口的大門。

80618259bb5fb5e697dfd2b35f192e94ef588e7d.source: It is also possible to enter this area from the first level of the Bogroot Growths dungeon as long as the quest has been obtained, but the route is difficult and long.
80618259bb5fb5e697dfd2b35f192e94ef588e7d.text: 只要獲得任務，也可以從泥塘根源地地下城的第一層進入該區域，但路線艱難且漫長。

63ed88a2e3ccc0319c16cb0b29a99e8b8be80847.source: Head either south or northwest upon entry and then head in a southerly direction past the resurrection shrine.
63ed88a2e3ccc0319c16cb0b29a99e8b8be80847.text: 進入後朝南或西北方向行駛，然後朝南方向經過復活神殿。

4c182e71fb97de9798255b0cfb08baa8ad11f208.source: The south route only has Undead to fight (but is probably easier for groups unable to take down multiple healers).
4c182e71fb97de9798255b0cfb08baa8ad11f208.text: 南線只有不死系可以戰鬥（但對於無法擊倒多個治療者的團體來說可能更容易）。

3ee196b71cf4cf1f0dd83650b790eee5f4e151a4.source: The northwest route has spiders (the Lifeweavers can be difficult to kill), regular undead and a massive room of traps and Chained Clerics (which can be avoided by running through with an organised party).
3ee196b71cf4cf1f0dd83650b790eee5f4e151a4.text: 西北路線有蜘蛛（織生者很難殺死），普通的不死生物和一個巨大的房間，裡面佈滿了陷阱和鎖鏈牧師（可以透過有組織的隊伍跑過去來避免）。

4c3da78d4be6904a28d5b133bc0f5eb1631ee930.source: Find Budger Blackpowder at any of his possible spawn points (marked with green dots on the wiki-map) - he gives you some free Aged Dwarven Ale. He will follow you through the entire dungeon, providing you with Dwarven Powder Kegs which can be used to breach Cracked Walls - as well as knocking down and causing 50 damage to foes when dropped. Pull foes to avoid over-aggro.
4c3da78d4be6904a28d5b133bc0f5eb1631ee930.text: 在任何可能的生成點（在維基地圖上用綠點標記）找到 巴哲黑火藥 - 他會給你一些免費的老化 矮人啤酒。他將跟隨你穿過整個地牢，為你提供矮人火藥桶，可用於突破裂牆 - 以及擊倒敵人並在掉落時對敵人造成 50 傷害。 拉出 敵人以避免過度仇恨。

9b965cfc2d62eb1f38ed970410416beae655db17.source: Once at the Cracked Wall, talk to Budger to receive a Dwarven Powder Keg. Drop the item in front of the obstacle to destroy it and proceed forward.
9b965cfc2d62eb1f38ed970410416beae655db17.text: 到達裂牆後，與巴傑交談即可獲得矮人火藥桶。將物品扔到障礙物前面以將其摧毀並繼續前進。

60efa56ed5719497afee09417fccb173562e0c25.source: This level can be completed by only fighting two/three groups. By quickly heading north at the start you can avoid aggroing a slowly patrolling group of Skelk. Destroy the wall with a Powder Keg. Once at the portal eliminate the Skelk group to open it.
60efa56ed5719497afee09417fccb173562e0c25.text: 此等級只需與兩/三組戰鬥即可完成。透過一開始就快速向北行駛，你可以避免騷擾緩慢巡邏的斯凱爾克群組。用火藥桶摧毀牆壁。一旦到達傳送門，消滅斯凱爾克小組即可開啟它。

6606f37e440d2edbec4bc9135cc0ab8fb0559542.source: This is the final level. There is an Area Map immediately after the entrance, which will reveal the locations of two Cracked Walls and the chamber where Cyndr the Mountain Heart resides.
6606f37e440d2edbec4bc9135cc0ab8fb0559542.text: 這是最終級別。入口後有一張區域地圖，其中會顯示兩堵裂牆的位置以及山心辛德爾所在的房間。

610af175612bffc0a53bdcadda8db459372c251f.source: There are Aggressive Oozes, Flowstone Elementals, Magma Blisters and Burning Spirits along the way. Be careful with these last ones when turning left to blast the second wall as there will not be much space to avoid their area of effect attacks.
610af175612bffc0a53bdcadda8db459372c251f.text: 沿途有 侵略的 軟泥怪、流石元素、巖漿水泡和燃燒之靈。當向左轉炸第二堵牆時要小心這些最後的敵人，因為沒有足夠的空間來躲避它們的攻擊範圍。

6807b7aad10c4aa10a31070d77f140ea641714e3.source: After breaching the second wall, an apparently empty room awaits. Enter the room slowly and beware of Cyndr the Mountain Heart that appears. It cannot be damaged at all while protected by the "Mountain Heart Carapace". To destroy its Carapace, the player(s) must drop three Dwarven Powder Kegs close to it. A blue progression bar will indicate when the wurm is vulnerable, after which it turns red and regenerates its Carapace (additional keg blasts can deal 50 of damage points). Depending on the party's overall firepower, it is possible to defeat Cyndr in one single attempt.
6807b7aad10c4aa10a31070d77f140ea641714e3.text: 突破第二面牆後，等待的是一個顯然空蕩蕩的房間。慢慢進入房間，小心出現的山心辛德爾。在「山心甲殼」的保護下，根本無法受到傷害。為了摧毀它的甲殼，玩家必須在它附近扔下三個矮人火藥桶。藍色進度條將指示亞龍何時易受攻擊，之後它會變成紅色並重新生成其甲殼（額外的桶爆炸可以造成 50 的傷害點）。根據隊伍的整體火力，有可能一次擊敗 Cyndr。

042328f34a306092b7a577a508b1af212541eeb1.source: Cyndr can deal a high amount of damage to bunched up teams (such as heroes) while also destroying kegs with Pyroclastic Shot, and its Flame Burst can kill a low armor character (such as a caster) in one hit. The lava on the ground also inflicts burning. As such, it is extremely difficult to take the wurm down the normal way if you're the only player character of your team.
042328f34a306092b7a577a508b1af212541eeb1.text: Cyndr 可以對聚集的隊伍（例如英雄）造成大量傷害，同時還可以使用火山碎屑射擊摧毀小桶，並且其 火焰爆裂 可以一擊殺死低護甲角色（例如施法者）。地面上的熔岩也會造成燃燒。因此，如果你是團隊中唯一的玩家角色，那麼以正常方式擊倒亞龍是極其困難的。

4b7e30b7f92ef9e5612853388607d10c8a221d0d.source: One possible tactic is to lure Cyndr close to the tunnel's entrance and use life stealing skills which can bypass its carapace while being protected from its attacks inside the tunnel. Your party must be positioned away from the entrance to lure effectively.
4b7e30b7f92ef9e5612853388607d10c8a221d0d.text: 一種可能的策略是引誘 Cyndr 靠近隧道入口，並使用生命竊取技能，該技能可以繞過其甲殼，同時保護其免受隧道內的攻擊。您的隊伍必須遠離入口才能有效吸引。

120ae3c427afac53c99750e51f46786ddf97e2c2.source: For more details on how to kill Cyndr, refer to this boss-like foe's page.
120ae3c427afac53c99750e51f46786ddf97e2c2.text: 有關如何殺死 Cyndr 的更多詳細資訊，請參閱這個類似 Boss 的敵人的頁面。

1c186dd9651572bed6d09bb0ed66d8b1b55aed57.source: Once the boss is killed and the Hammer of the Great Dwarf retrieved from the Stone Pedestal, a Mountain Heart Chest will spawn which grants every player a reward. Wait for the three minutes countdown timer to expire to be returned next to King Jalis to claim the quest reward and take the next quest.
1c186dd9651572bed6d09bb0ed66d8b1b55aed57.text: 一旦 Boss 被殺死，並且從石基座上取回 偉大矮人 的 鎚，山心 寶箱 就會生成，為每個玩家提供獎勵。等待三分鐘倒數結束，回到賈利斯國王旁邊領取任務獎勵並接受下一個任務。

4b31af7cf476fb83271fbdfd713be2c4c9df9192.source: Life stealing skills and skills that inflict bleeding, poison and/or disease ignore the damage immunity of the wurm.
4b31af7cf476fb83271fbdfd713be2c4c9df9192.text: 偷取生命 技能和造成流血、中毒和/或疾病的技能會忽略亞龍的傷害免疫。

007a8d637053d147dc87381dcd40297420b6a2bd.source: Ward Against Elements and Ward Against Harm.
007a8d637053d147dc87381dcd40297420b6a2bd.text: 元素結界 和 守護結界。

5c2052d547a9a0b28e61dbf467f0dfc312858ebc.source: Protective Spirit to protect the runner(s), who should also have a speed boost skill.
5c2052d547a9a0b28e61dbf467f0dfc312858ebc.text: 精神守護 保護跑者，跑者也應該具備速度提陞技能。

b81d55fc498e05bc8acd0a607f323feb240253d2.source: Cracked Walls do not block line of sight; you can use ranged attacks to take down foes on the other side.
b81d55fc498e05bc8acd0a607f323feb240253d2.text: 開裂的牆壁不會阻擋視線；你可以使用遠端攻擊來消滅另一邊的敵人。

4245f5c914ef9a1433495fb9ca28b284f5bdbe4e.source: Look for Su in Panjiang Peninsula
4245f5c914ef9a1433495fb9ca28b284f5bdbe4e.text: 在 班讓半島 中尋找 Su

90d3806cf6c0f41b2370c71cc8f357b0f6396c9f.source: Su is in the south of Panjiang Peninsula, outside Raiyan Cave.
90d3806cf6c0f41b2370c71cc8f357b0f6396c9f.text: 蘇在班讓半島的南面，雷巖洞外。

8ed7f7ce36453cbaf5224b7a9fa1f76bfdafac4c.source: Kneel at the Sunspear Crypt to summon the original Sunspear Guard.
8ed7f7ce36453cbaf5224b7a9fa1f76bfdafac4c.text: 跪在陽矛墓穴前召喚最初的陽矛守衛。

4bdfd51b73f2a23d6b8f90279882fcdcc89c8a5f.source: From Blacktide Den, head east and then south (following the path outlined by the map). You'll encounter some hidden groups of mandragor that popup as you walk along, so make sure you take the mandragor bounty as soon as you enter the zone.
4bdfd51b73f2a23d6b8f90279882fcdcc89c8a5f.text: 從黑潮巢穴出發，向東然後向南（沿著地圖上勾勒的路徑）。當你走路時，你會遇到一些隱藏的曼陀羅群體，所以確保你一進入該區域就獲得曼陀羅賞金。

fce18dcaf1f16f79c6409154cc8cb5071a80a09a.source: When you reach the Tomb of the Three Worthies, use the /kneel emote. Kojolin the Conciliator, First Spear Janah, and Sogolon the Protector will appear and turn hostile. Take out Kojolin first, followed by Sogolon and Janah. When they're reduced to a sliver of health, they'll stop fighting and become neutral towards you. When they're all defeated, Sogolon will have something to say. Listen to what he has to say, and then travel back to the Sunspear Great Hall to speak with Castellan Puuba to get your reward.
fce18dcaf1f16f79c6409154cc8cb5071a80a09a.text: 當您到達三賢墓時，使用 /kneel 表情。調解者 Kojolin、First 矛 Janah 和 守護者 Sogolon 將出現並轉為敵對。首先乾掉科喬林，然後是索戈隆和賈納。當他們的生命值減少到一點點時，他們就會停止戰鬥並對你保持中立。當他們全部被擊敗時，索戈隆就會有話要說。聽聽他要說的話，然後回到 日戟大會堂 與 Castellan Puuba 交談以獲得獎勵。
