de0bf46a7395117a8724b6715dc5951b2e8cb938.source: However, completing the mission does grant all players access to Central Transfer Chamber, making this a popular exploit for players who want Chaos Gloves without having to play through Eye of the North.
de0bf46a7395117a8724b6715dc5951b2e8cb938.text: 然而，完成任務確實可以讓所有玩家進入中央傳送室，這對於那些想要混沌手套而無需玩 極地之眼 的玩家來說很受歡迎。

ab77707782eb87a0218d07f1e5b2b9570d80d09d.source: Speak to Jalis Ironhammer when you are ready to face this evil. (disappears after entering the mission)
ab77707782eb87a0218d07f1e5b2b9570d80d09d.text: 當你準備好面對邪惡時，與加利斯·鐵鎚交談。 （進入任務後消失）

e524c9ab3ecd1f02882e3e6093c5f18e5b1d98d2.source: Find and reclaim the Central Transfer Chamber
e524c9ab3ecd1f02882e3e6093c5f18e5b1d98d2.text: 找到並奪回中央傳送室

31a51954dedd96527db36ce2cba503604a6e45f5.source: Take command of the golems and find the missing Asuran patrol.
31a51954dedd96527db36ce2cba503604a6e45f5.text: 指揮傀儡並找到失蹤的阿蘇蘭巡邏隊。

bb03266e75a8aef903f6f8e41127333c881c5d62.source: Clear a path into the depths with the Ebon Vanguard.
bb03266e75a8aef903f6f8e41127333c881c5d62.text: 使用 黑檀 清理一條通往深處的路徑。

bde65273ec4653cd182a38e67d1310c3554e99cc.source: Fight beside the Norn as they hold off the Destroyers.
bde65273ec4653cd182a38e67d1310c3554e99cc.text: 與 諾恩 並肩作戰，抵擋毀滅者。

100f01a5cb99b1687928a8f0be7b7b4a698c056c.source: Travel to the Central Transfer Chamber via the Asura Gate.
100f01a5cb99b1687928a8f0be7b7b4a698c056c.text: 透過 阿蘇拉 門前往中央傳送室。

fb205ca0e23a83c805760f8a63f3cdf611e96975.source: Clear the Central Transfer Chamber of Destroyers.
fb205ca0e23a83c805760f8a63f3cdf611e96975.text: 清除驅逐艦中央傳送室。

f0fed5376c3bbe2effac387b348508e3931cea23.source: The quest begins when you speak to Jalis Ironhammer outside the Central Transfer Chamber, who teleports you to the Depths of Tyria.
f0fed5376c3bbe2effac387b348508e3931cea23.text: 當你在中央傳送室外與賈利斯·鐵鎚交談時，任務開始，他會將你傳送到 泰瑞亞深處。

387c29bd0319e22d1f9b257124a68a4b8063ec65.source: Level 1: Upon entering, you'll notice three G.O.L.E.M. 2.0s along the wall with Oola. Activating each one requires a player to expend 15 energy. Once activated, a player may interact with one to switch its mode to Attack, Defense, or Ranged.
387c29bd0319e22d1f9b257124a68a4b8063ec65.text: 1 關卡：進入後，您會注意到三個 G.O.L.E.M. 2.0s 沿著牆壁與 Oola 一起。啟動每項都需要玩家消耗 15 能量。一旦被啟用，玩家可以與其中一個互動，將其模式切換為攻擊、防禦或 遠距。

6a52a3b335bf6c5508e0276d2494052bcb0a6215.source: Plow your way through some basic cave critters to make your way to Renk and Sokka then fend off the nearby destroyers. Oola will alert the party of a missing Vanguard group nearby. You'll find Captain Langmar a short way away accompanied by Chance Redding and Jenn Valefield. Continuing west, you'll see a number of Vanguard groups engaged with destroyers. You can try to save them, but the destroyers will likely kill them. South, you'll see a large battle between the Vanguard and destroyers. Again, the odds are stacked in favor of the destroyers, so it's often best to simply rush to the zone on the other side of the room while the Vanguard have the Destroyers occupied.
6a52a3b335bf6c5508e0276d2494052bcb0a6215.text: 穿過一些基本的洞穴生物，到達倫克和索卡，然後擊退附近的驅逐艦。烏拉將向隊伍發出附近失蹤先鋒隊的警報。您會發現 隊長連瑪 就在不遠處，由 Chance Redding 和 Jenn Valefield 陪同。繼續向西，你會看到許多先鋒隊與驅逐艦交戰。你可以嘗試拯救他們，但毀滅者很可能會殺死他們。在南方，你會看到先鋒隊和驅逐艦之間的一場大規模戰鬥。同樣，驅逐艦的勝算很大，因此通常最好在先鋒隊佔領驅逐艦時衝到房間另一側的區域。

64d30f57454bdad31855eb869a1a819cc23a7339.source: Level 2: Here, you'll have to reactivate the golems. A short way outside, you'll see dryders and destroyers. These groups will battle if they come within aggro range of each other. Try to run by the second group of dryders on your way to the Norn. Once at the Norn, Destroyers will start coming in from multiple fronts. Taking them all on at the same time may be tricky, but if you position yourself away from the center (where the quest marker is), you can avoid aggro with half the assault group until you're ready for them. Another tactic is to let the golems die along the bridge, blocking the path, and thus protecting you from the Destroyers' deadly warriors and dervishes while you attack with arrows and spells. Once the assault is over, follow Olaf Olafson to where he will open a door. Follow this path, fight a few more Destroyers, and enter the portal by the Stone Dwarves into the Central Transfer Chamber. Don't spend too much time with Dwarves, or you will be caught up with large swarm of Destroyers which have followed your trails.
64d30f57454bdad31855eb869a1a819cc23a7339.text: 2 關卡：在這裡，您必須重新啟動傀儡。外面不遠的地方，您會看到乾燥機和驅逐艦。如果這些團體進入彼此的仇恨範圍內，就會發生戰鬥。嘗試在前往 諾恩 的途中經過第二組乾燥機。一旦到達 諾恩，驅逐艦將開始從多條前線進攻。同時對付他們可能會很棘手，但如果你將自己放置在遠離中心（任務標記所在的地方）的位置，你可以避免與一半的突擊隊發生仇恨，直到你準備好對付他們。另一個策略是讓傀儡沿著橋死去，擋住道路，從而在你用箭和法術攻擊時保護你免受毀滅者致命的戰士和托缽僧的傷害。攻擊結束後，跟著 尤拉夫 尤拉夫森 到他會開門的地方。沿著這條路，與更多的毀滅者戰鬥，然後通過石矮人進入中央傳送室的傳送門。不要在矮人身上花太多時間，否則你會被一大群追隨你蹤跡的毀滅者追上。

55b3a3ed9ae23e7de6fb1885816abb90c8869df2.source: Level 3: Once in the chamber, activate the golems again. This room is not very big, and the goal is simple: defeat all the Destroyers there. Clear the nearest groups then pull the Disc of Chaos up the stairs (or just leave it for last), as its devastating, powerful attacks are much easier to suppress when it is by itself. Most of its attacks are point-blank, so standard tanking procedures should be sufficient until it is defeated. Setting the golems to ranged may keep them active longer. Alternatively, having the golems set to defensive and staying within their range is viable if you are having trouble keeping your party alive. Because the disc is an Elementalist, assigning one character to daze it and attack it with a weapon will nearly eliminate the threat it poses.
55b3a3ed9ae23e7de6fb1885816abb90c8869df2.text: 3 關卡：進入房間後，再次啟動傀儡。這個房間不是很大，目標很簡單：擊敗那裡所有的毀滅者。清除最近的群體，然後將混沌圓盤拉上樓梯（或將其留到最後），因為當它單獨存在時，其毀滅性的、強大的攻擊更容易被壓制。它的大多數攻擊都是直擊的，所以標準的坦克程式應該足夠了，直到它被擊敗。將魔像設定為遠端可以讓它們保持更長時間的活躍狀態。或者，如果你難以保證隊伍的生存，將傀儡設定為防禦狀態並留在其射程內也是可行的。因為該光碟是 元素使，所以指定一個角色來迷惑它並用武器攻擊它幾乎可以消除它所造成的威脅。

1a5668f4581de95a03b3083f73606c6209e9a544.source: As Destroyers only gain 2 levels in hard mode their health isn't significantly increased. However, their damage is much higher. As such it is highly recommended to go to the ice bridge and let the golems body block it, as stated above, to protect your party on level 2. It is also much more important to not aggro more than one group, and not to ball up as the melee destroyers have highly effective area of effect damage that is boosted enough in hard mode to be able to quickly wipe an unprepared party.
1a5668f4581de95a03b3083f73606c6209e9a544.text: 由於驅逐艦僅在困難模式下獲得 2 等級，因此它們的生命值並未顯著增加。然而，他們的傷害要高得多。因此，強烈建議前往冰橋並讓傀儡身體阻擋它，如上所述，以保護 2 關卡中的隊伍。更重要的是，不要聚集超過一組，也不要聚集在一起，因為近戰驅逐艦具有高效的傷害範圍，在困難模式下，這種傷害會得到足夠的增強，能夠快速消滅毫無準備的隊伍。

f129304623e08ada8a5e3ca2f9d5537ae00263f7.source: The bodies of inactive Golems may be used to form choke points if you can get them to die at narrow passage openings.
f129304623e08ada8a5e3ca2f9d5537ae00263f7.text: 如果你能讓不活動的魔像死在狹窄的通道開口處，它們的身體就可以用來保護 型態 的咽喉要道。

fa755223a2896caa683f02494cb60a8cfc2cf47f.source: In addition to the Disc of Chaos, all foes in the last map zone must be defeated to complete the quest.
fa755223a2896caa683f02494cb60a8cfc2cf47f.text: 除了混沌圓盤之外，還必須擊敗最後一個地圖區域中的所有敵人才能完成任務。

5d426c0d20f8fa393bb1732eca1ee96cc8a926e8.source: Upon completion of this quest, players will be brought to the Central Transfer Chamber.
5d426c0d20f8fa393bb1732eca1ee96cc8a926e8.text: 完成此任務後，玩家將被帶到中央傳送室。

e508890bb50c10d4df67cb7847e958424f4456d9.source: King Jalis is directly outside the Central Transfer Chamber; it is possible to start from there when repeating this quest.
e508890bb50c10d4df67cb7847e958424f4456d9.text: 賈利斯國王就位於中央傳送室外；重複此任務時可以從那裡開始。

c25f8b21fe92d280aaa314100828c5e0359a3122.source: This quest (and all primary repeatable Eye of the North quests) may also be obtained from the Scrying Pool in the Hall of Monuments after the initial completion.
c25f8b21fe92d280aaa314100828c5e0359a3122.text: 此任務（以及所有主要可重複的 極地之眼 任務）也可在初次完成後從 史蹟殿堂 中的占卜池中取得。

1af37c9ae697e316839e3ce4c619b816e720d165.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #15 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
1af37c9ae697e316839e3ce4c619b816e720d165.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#15 頁。

09d1907159f46d7837338cb320c8ff78cc06cd09.source: The Vanguard Warriors and monks will often turn hostile when they take damage, in the same way charmable animals do. See the screenshot at right. When you skip the introduction cinematic, your party may be attacked by a Fire Storm and Incendiary Bonds.
09d1907159f46d7837338cb320c8ff78cc06cd09.text: 先鋒戰士和武僧在受到傷害時通常會變得充滿敵意，就像迷人的動物一樣。請參閱右側的螢幕截圖。當您跳過介紹動畫時，您的隊伍可能會受到 火焰風暴 和 燃燒連結 的攻擊。

ac595146f100e5eda6d0f2cf1db4ccd68791dff0.source: Speak with Su again when you are ready to eliminate the Naga.
ac595146f100e5eda6d0f2cf1db4ccd68791dff0.text: 當你準備好消滅 納迦 時，再次與 Su 交談。

e4a0ef36b462d1c600a509befe405f707cb565b0.source: Escort Su through the cave and destroy any Naga you find.
e4a0ef36b462d1c600a509befe405f707cb565b0.text: 護送蘇穿過洞穴並摧毀你發現的任何 納迦。

33624070bdcc076ef7c26810435daa7b2dec6ddb.source: On accepting the quest, Su teaches you the following skills:
33624070bdcc076ef7c26810435daa7b2dec6ddb.text: 接受任務後，蘇會教你以下技能：

ac3bc41d22d1907879d126273ac9f7f52690059d.source: Follow Su through Raiyan Cave and help kill all the Naga. Li Yun and Soon Kim, two other necromancer students, will assist you as allies. Be warned, several Naga will cast Spirit Rift, which may be deadly to your party if you do not move out of its range. Also, avoid running ahead and aggroing more Naga than you can handle. In fact, it may be safer to let Su led the way, the better to demonstrate her Powers.
ac3bc41d22d1907879d126273ac9f7f52690059d.text: 跟隨蘇穿過雷巖洞並幫助殺死所有 納迦。另外兩位死靈法師學生李雲和金順將作為盟友協助你。請注意，多個 納迦 會施放 生靈裂縫，如果您不移出其範圍，這可能會對您的隊伍致命。另外，請避免跑在前面並惹惱超出您處理能力的 納迦。事實上，讓蘇帶路也許更安全，也能更好地展現她的力量。

e265289be6d03b0c57f11976671e3b816933298e.source: Su may become stuck behind a Shing Jea Chest, causing you to have to restart the quest
e265289be6d03b0c57f11976671e3b816933298e.text: Su可能會被困在Shing Jea 寶箱後面，導致你必須重新開始任務

b95f16a6bbc19830f467a5f5f99ec14cab899715.source: Clear the Stone Summit blocking the entrance to Borlis Pass.
b95f16a6bbc19830f467a5f5f99ec14cab899715.text: 清除阻塞 柏里斯通道 入口的 石峰矮人。

bd416b3c73f539fa51626e5323d2926123f93bea.source: See Beccum Reedly for your reward.
bd416b3c73f539fa51626e5323d2926123f93bea.text: 請參閱 碧肯 麗德里 以取得獎勵。

ac420bd66f3627d328a470ffdd1bb624f4371b46.source: All you need to do to complete this quest is kill the Stone Summit mesmer boss Inar Frostbite, who is at the very far end of the road to Borlis Pass in Traveler's Vale. If you have already been to Borlis Pass, it is quickest to start from there; otherwise, travel south from Yak's Bend.
ac420bd66f3627d328a470ffdd1bb624f4371b46.text: 要完成這個任務，您所需要做的就是殺死 石峰矮人 幻術師 Boss Inar 凍霜，他位於 旅人谷 中通往 柏里斯通道 之路的最遠端。如果您已經去過柏里斯通道，那麼從那裡開始是最快的；否則，從 犛牛村 向南行駛。

235121e3bc0ba336e461c6c4c62fdc74d756d2c1.source: The most direct route from Yak's Bend is populated with Snow Ettins, and if you also have the quests Shiverpeak Stragglers and/or The Road to Borlis Pass active, there will be large numbers of Stone Summit dwarves on the road. To avoid them, you can simply skirt around via the east road that goes towards the Ascalon Foothills entrance, as shown on the map to the right. Otherwise, pull carefully when multiple groups are close to each other and be wary of any patrols in the area. You can also take advantage of the Caravan Guards that sometimes travel through the area.
235121e3bc0ba336e461c6c4c62fdc74d756d2c1.text: 從 犛牛村 出發最直接的路線上佈滿了雪艾廷斯，如果您也啟動了 掃蕩席娃山脈 和/或 往柏里斯通道的路 任務，那麼路上將會有大量 石峰矮人 矮人。為了避開它們，您可以簡單地繞過通往 阿斯卡隆丘陵 入口的東路，如右圖所示。否則，當多個團體彼此靠近時，請小心拉動，並警惕該地區的任何巡邏人員。您還可以利用有時穿越該地區的商隊守衛的優勢。

f17b3b6275c1aa2ab40106bfdb3e4bd522cd745f.source: Inar Frostbite spawns with two Summit Axe Wielders, but can be pulled away from them. As with other Stone Summit mesmers, be prepared for Empathy and Shatter Enchantment. After killing Inar, continue on through the Shiverpeak centaurs to Borlis Pass and claim the reward from Beccum Reedly.
f17b3b6275c1aa2ab40106bfdb3e4bd522cd745f.text: Inar 凍霜 與兩位高峰會 斧 持有者一起生成，但可以將其從他們身邊拉開。與其他 石峰矮人 催眠器一樣，請為 自虐 和 加持粉碎 做好準備。殺死伊納爾後，繼續穿過席瓦峰半人馬到達 柏里斯通道 並領取 碧肯 麗德里 的獎勵。

b05e0594771da1569fcb412c8608c19b0fdfba04.source: Due to the large amount of additional foes this quest spawns in Traveler's Vale, it is not uncommon for runners to request players to abandon this quest before running from Yak's Bend.
b05e0594771da1569fcb412c8608c19b0fdfba04.text: 由於此任務在 旅人谷 中產生大量額外敵人，因此跑者要求玩家在從 犛牛村 跑步之前放棄此任務的情況並不罕見。

64b5716ae8134db672db22df614a2ecd87294cb1.source: Speak with Kormir on the Plains of Jarin.
64b5716ae8134db672db22df614a2ecd87294cb1.text: 在 賈林平原 上與 Kormir 交談。

43dfa637fa921694895e6ddd42c2d95774ced898.source: Help Nerashi train the new recruits.
43dfa637fa921694895e6ddd42c2d95774ced898.text: 幫助 Nerashi 訓練新兵。

1c6c96b4d6b8e40a96a99e88f29e466a01c5006b.source: Enter the Plains of Jarin from Kamadan. Entering from here will bring you the closest to the NPCs to whom you must talk. Talk to Kormir and then to Nerashi to acquire the recruits. Take them to the skale southwest from your position. Kill all the skale there and walk back to Ahtok. Speak to him and then Rojis to complete the quest.
1c6c96b4d6b8e40a96a99e88f29e466a01c5006b.text: 輸入來自 Kamadan 的 賈林平原。從這裡進入將使您距離必須與之交談的 NPC 最近。與科米爾交談，然後與奈拉什交談以獲取新兵。將他們帶到你所在位置西南方的斯卡萊。殺死那裡所有的骷髏然後走回阿托克。與他交談，然後與羅吉斯交談以完成任務。

fe4de4414f5b9b25c5811f6d2ab3771eab07c9cd.source: All party members must have completed Destruction's Depths.
fe4de4414f5b9b25c5811f6d2ab3771eab07c9cd.text: 所有隊伍成員必須完成 破壞的深淵。

66979e5d56b58c879aa903c519f1ffd382c524e2.source: The Great Destroyer uses the following skills:
66979e5d56b58c879aa903c519f1ffd382c524e2.text: 偉大毀滅者使用以下技能：

26546fb0ddbd0ad17c21c8c96d9e3ce0af44c952.source: A successful method to complete this quest is to stay on the shore while killing the three Destroyer of Lives in the three pools nearby the entrance, then have everyone move back to the shore. Wait there until the Great Destroyer uses Lava Ground enough to dry the lava pool where the furthest Destroyer of Lives was (a player will need to move to the closest pool to trigger the Great Destroyer's skills). Once the pool dries have everyone run up to the pool and fight there.
26546fb0ddbd0ad17c21c8c96d9e3ce0af44c952.text: 成功完成此任務的方法是留在岸上，同時殺死入口附近三個水池中的三個生命毀滅者，然後讓所有人移回岸邊。在那裡等待，直到大毀滅者使用足夠的熔岩地面來乾燥最遠的生命毀滅者所在的熔岩池（玩家需要移動到最近的熔岩池才能觸發大毀滅者的技能）。一旦水池乾了，每個人都跑到水池裡並在那裡戰鬥。

aade94343220b887ba0da8fd3ec7349cf1ed3df7.source: Searing Breath can deal major damage to low-armor rating party members. To prevent this, have a member with higher armor rating engage the Great Destroyer and turn him so he is facing away from the rest of the party. This way only one member is affected by this skill.
aade94343220b887ba0da8fd3ec7349cf1ed3df7.text: 崩壞 呼吸可以對低護甲等級的隊員造成重大傷害。為了防止這種情況發生，請讓一名裝甲等級較高的成員與大毀滅者交戰，然後將他轉向，讓他背對隊伍的其他成員。這樣只有一名成員會受到該技能的影響。

e78f17aff65ef14d031f0a0e849ba3d77627b752.source: Be careful when bringing interrupts due to Enraged Blast's. Call of Destruction and Lava Ground are worth interrupting due to the damage you can suffer by not doing so. Enraged Blast has a quick cast time and is actually interruptable too, but interrupting Enraged Blast will result in another Enraged Blast.
e78f17aff65ef14d031f0a0e849ba3d77627b752.text: 由於激怒衝擊造成中斷時要小心。 毀滅 的召喚和熔岩地面值得打斷，因為不這樣做可能會造成傷害。激怒衝擊的施法時間很快，而且實際上也可以打斷，但打斷激怒衝擊會導致另一次激怒衝擊。

033c5075b8396539b19eceb129e75f5f37c6b0c4.source: Aggravate the Great Destroyer so he will attack your party on this plate. If it uses Lava Wave turn your attention temporarily to other Destroyers until it rises back up. Continue until the Great Destroyer is defeated.
033c5075b8396539b19eceb129e75f5f37c6b0c4.text: 激怒偉大的毀滅者，這樣他就會攻擊你在這個盤子上的隊伍。如果它使用熔岩波，請將你的注意力暫時轉移到其他驅逐艦上，直到它重新崛起。繼續下去，直到打敗偉大的毀滅者。

ac6d2eb232d461c87980e3c01e75f970e8b06e4f.source: Pain Inverter, if effectively used, will do massive damage, causing the great Destroyer to lose half or more health in one shot. Bring spirits and summoned allies to increase the number of targets. Interrupting the Great Destroyer is actually a good idea in this case, as Enraged Blast will also backfire.
ac6d2eb232d461c87980e3c01e75f970e8b06e4f.text: 苦痛 逆變器如果有效使用，將造成巨大傷害，導致偉大的毀滅者一擊失去一半或更多生命值。帶來靈魂並召喚盟友以增加目標數量。在這種情況下，打斷偉大毀滅者實際上是一個好主意，因為憤怒衝擊也會適得其反。

5b998e175175ad4a2a40e08c7617bf6904f52c97.source: Destroyer of Lives, Lava Wave and Searing Breath inflict fire damage, so consider bringing skills that protect against fire damage or elemental damage
5b998e175175ad4a2a40e08c7617bf6904f52c97.text: 生命毀滅者、熔岩波和 崩壞 呼吸會造成火焰傷害，因此請考慮攜帶能夠抵禦火焰傷害或元素傷害的技能

e898cefb146632d2fabb9660e7da60d5f5ad0098.source: Your party will be in lava that inflicts Burning throughout the quest. Consider bringing Frigid Armor, Extinguish, and/or Breath of the Great Dwarf.
e898cefb146632d2fabb9660e7da60d5f5ad0098.text: 你的隊伍將處於熔岩中，在整個任務中造成燃燒。考慮攜帶 冰凍護甲、熄滅 和/或 偉大矮人 的呼吸。

f14dd35fa3dd312cf185b089fb67b413c958007d.source: Having skills to prevent knock downs (e.g. Ward of Stability or Fleeting Stability) may be useful to prevent knock downs from Lava Blast and Enraged Blast at inopportune moments.
f14dd35fa3dd312cf185b089fb67b413c958007d.text: 擁有防止擊倒的技能（例如 穩定結界 或 短促穩定）可能有助於防止在不合時宜的時刻被熔岩爆炸和憤怒爆炸擊倒。

d6db8aa6269e513a7bfbca93141f323b6ede3f38.source: Alkar's Alchemical Acid is useful against all the foes in this mission.
d6db8aa6269e513a7bfbca93141f323b6ede3f38.text: 阿爾卡的煉金酸對本次任務中的所有敵人都很有用。

1e09a9353640e2f80a5e663d816b4747b4bda84e.source: Life stealing by touch rangers (and others) will bypass Lava Wave.
1e09a9353640e2f80a5e663d816b4747b4bda84e.text: Touch Ranger（和其他人）的 偷取生命 將繞過 Lava Wave。

c63bf088e3f5c5059e89b2bd7f79636b609549a7.source: When fighting the Great Destroyer, speed can be important due to the fairly constant damage and health degeneration.
c63bf088e3f5c5059e89b2bd7f79636b609549a7.text: 當與偉大毀滅者戰鬥時，由於相當持續的傷害和健康退化，速度可能很重要。

22a6ff258de6d2ec34ec8411bc6b5d25096b4aab.source: Lava Ground will eventually make the entire area unsafe to stand in; interrupt this if you are able.
22a6ff258de6d2ec34ec8411bc6b5d25096b4aab.text: 熔岩地面最終將使整個區域變得不安全；如果可以的話，請中斷此操作。

68ac715dbdaec4d0f439b605a83d50cbc9d6cd07.source: All of the Great Destroyer skills are untyped skills, so only skills that interrupt actions or skills will interrupt its skills and trigger Enraged Blast.
68ac715dbdaec4d0f439b605a83d50cbc9d6cd07.text: 所有大毀滅者技能都是無型別技能，因此只有打斷行動的技能或技能才會打斷其技能並觸發憤怒衝擊。

64b961b4d1aeb9607a5c6e576d494d19d094c409.source: A hero with skills that only interrupt spells can be useful against the Destroyer spellcasters and prevent the hero from interrupting the Great Destroyer and triggering Enraged Blast.
64b961b4d1aeb9607a5c6e576d494d19d094c409.text: 擁有隻能打斷法術技能的英雄可以在對抗毀滅者施法者時發揮作用，並防止英雄打斷大毀滅者並觸發憤怒衝擊。

ec037c9f4c0e7632c4a366445c1b158b2691e6cb.source: Confusing Images and Migraine can cause the Great Destroyer to activate skills slower, which will lower the Great Destroyer's damage per second and make it easier to continuously interrupt Enraged Blast.
ec037c9f4c0e7632c4a366445c1b158b2691e6cb.text: 混亂影像和頭痛會導致大毀滅者釋放技能的速度變慢，這會降低大毀滅者的每秒傷害，並且更容易連續打斷憤怒衝擊。

d449d6c2e198ae9fe96ec8b56161dfe94ba5eb4b.source: 55 Monks are extremely effective here as long as no Destroyer of Deeds spawn as they will cause mass interruption.
d449d6c2e198ae9fe96ec8b56161dfe94ba5eb4b.text: 55 只要沒有毀滅者生成，僧侶在這裡就非常有效，因為它們會造成大規模幹擾。

5293852626175618a2b4fd55c4b018b669d4bb68.source: Disabling (or even simply interrupting) Lava Wave can prevent the Great Destroyer from healing itself.
5293852626175618a2b4fd55c4b018b669d4bb68.text: 停用（甚至簡單地中斷）熔岩波可以阻止偉大毀滅者自我修復。

4c84c04df2ccab053ea4910fab52333b6e2ef9e2.source: On completion of Destruction's Depths for the first time on a character, A Time for Heroes will be added to your Quest Log automatically.
4c84c04df2ccab053ea4910fab52333b6e2ef9e2.text: 當角色第一次完成 破壞的深淵 時，英雄的光彩年代 會自動加入您的 任務 日誌。

d8bad10d8505c34908f726620abe4702c990c812.source: After completing this quest, your party will be taken to Epilogue.
d8bad10d8505c34908f726620abe4702c990c812.text: 完成此任務後，你的隊伍將被帶到尾聲。

a1bcd4a30c9387aa6e0350f4f1b4f0e083692c15.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #16 of the Hero's Handbook storybook.
a1bcd4a30c9387aa6e0350f4f1b4f0e083692c15.text: 完成此任務將填寫 英雄 手冊故事書的#16 頁。

c1041db5e53902034574a26cfed39b5a64a4d299.source: Unlike previous campaigns where missions are contained in outposts with visually distinct map icons and can be started from an NPC with a rotating green icon, the way in which this quest can be started is by going to Central Transfer Chamber and talking to High Priest Alkar which is marked in game with a green, rotating, shield-like icon, akin to the one of Mission NPCs.
c1041db5e53902034574a26cfed39b5a64a4d299.text: 與先前的戰役不同，任務包含在具有視覺上不同的地圖圖示的前哨站中，並且可以從具有旋轉綠色圖示的 NPC 開始，該任務的啟動方式是前往中央傳送室並與 高等祭司 阿爾卡 交談，高等祭司 阿爾卡 在遊戲中標記為綠色、旋轉、盾牌狀圖示，類似於 主線任務 NPC 之一。

46d73df5891dc8eaef6c9e0c79d2256c60045698.source: The lava in this mission does not cause the Crippled condition.
46d73df5891dc8eaef6c9e0c79d2256c60045698.text: 此任務中的熔岩不會導致 殘癈 狀況。

6627a51e1c12a712177393f200d1305f20935959.source: While A Time for Heroes is in your quest log, you will keep receiving an announcement each time you go the Central Transfer Chamber, "Quest Added: A Time For Heroes". This continues until you complete the quest.
6627a51e1c12a712177393f200d1305f20935959.text: 當 英雄的光彩年代 存在於您的任務日誌中時，您每次前往中央傳送室時都會收到一則公告，「任務 已新增：英雄時刻」。這將持續到您完成任務為止。

eb5dada5399c693b5dd0e27fb6b975e3254b6c10.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Traveler's Vale and start the mission.
eb5dada5399c693b5dd0e27fb6b975e3254b6c10.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 旅人谷 走進前哨站並開始任務。

2392409675f569afc19db65a70ec2fcab79aa3b6.source: Negotiate passage to Grooble's Gulch and shelter for the Ascalon refugees.
2392409675f569afc19db65a70ec2fcab79aa3b6.text: 協商通往 歌路波峽谷 的通道並為 阿斯卡隆 難民提供庇護所。

c292b29d861f2dc1ae000a12f6ce50830f629508.source: Ignite all the storm beacons to light the way through the storm.
c292b29d861f2dc1ae000a12f6ce50830f629508.text: 點燃所有風暴燈塔，照亮風暴中的道路。

16a85985351ace50fd364dff86f8e93add42b410.source: Find out what happened to Prince Rurik's negotiations with Dwarf king Jalis Ironhammer.
16a85985351ace50fd364dff86f8e93add42b410.text: 瞭解 盧瑞克王子 與 矮人 國王 Jalis Ironhammer 的談判結果如何。

8787a5df362264bbc180bb888a918626a0d95894.source: ADDED: Break through the locked gate into Maladar's Fort.
8787a5df362264bbc180bb888a918626a0d95894.text: 新增：突破鎖定的門進入 梅拉達要塞。

24858caa80dfe9a1e94b4304416a6f4234473aa5.source: ADDED: Bring an end to the siege of Krok's Hollow. Destroy the ballistae and the forces outside the gates.
24858caa80dfe9a1e94b4304416a6f4234473aa5.text: 新增：結束對 客洛克峽谷 的圍攻。摧毀弩砲和門外的部隊。

ccbb3d5e74c27d0dbda87fbc111010cfd114b888.source: ADDED: Light the magical signal beacons.

bc359412e9030b4be834b03c4decd8320d2c25e5.source: The first part of the Borlis Pass mission is fairly straightforward. Talk to Ascalon Guard Hayden at the beginning of the mission, he will hand you a torch and tell you to light the Storm Beacons along the road so the Ascalon refugees can find their way through the mountains while the storm rages. Follow the path and light all beacons on the way, the centaur patrols shouldn't be too hard to deal with. There are a total of seven beacons, with the last being guarded by a centaur boss.
bc359412e9030b4be834b03c4decd8320d2c25e5.text: 柏里斯通道 任務的第一部分相當簡單。在任務開始時與 阿斯卡隆警衛 海登 交談，他會給你一把火把，並告訴你點燃沿路的風暴信標，以便 阿斯卡隆 難民能夠在風暴肆虐時找到穿過山脈的路。沿著路徑走，點亮路上所有的信標，半人馬巡邏隊應該不會太難對付。總共有七個信標，最後一個由半人馬老大守衛。

3fa57bc46cb0aef9920967620f521f121a22a3f3.source: Ascalon Guard Tolis will be standing a short distance from the last beacon, guarding a large iron gate, hand him the torch when you have lit all the beacons and he'll grant you passage as well as your next objective, destroying the gate to Maladar's Fort.
3fa57bc46cb0aef9920967620f521f121a22a3f3.text: 阿斯卡隆警衛 托理斯 將站在距離最後一個信標不遠的地方，守衛一扇大鐵門，當你點燃所有信標時，將火炬交給他，他會允許你通過並允許你的下一個目標，摧毀 梅拉達要塞 的大門。

54e0066009b30d6dc82c221db5924fe2a130f71e.source: Follow the path once again and obtain a Dwarven Powder Keg from the nearby Dwarven Powder Keg Station which you will use to blow open the gate once you reach it. The gate is easy to find, a boss guards the entrance, defeat him and any nearby enemies and blow open the gate by dropping the powder keg close to it.
54e0066009b30d6dc82c221db5924fe2a130f71e.text: 再次沿著這條路走，從附近的矮人火藥桶站獲得一個矮人火藥桶，到達後你可以用它來炸開大門。大門很容易找到，老闆守衛著入口，擊敗他和附近的任何敵人，然後通過將火藥桶扔到附近來炸開大門。

b63b56cbe2d1a5d8cae39944b0324726690657a9.source: A new objective has now been added to your quest log, destroying the ballistae and ending the siege of Krok's Hollow.
b63b56cbe2d1a5d8cae39944b0324726690657a9.text: 一個新的目標現在已新增到您的任務日誌中，摧毀弩砲並結束 客洛克峽谷 的圍攻。

6abaf5fcb8ee46fbc3ed634db5fbed16d2fd39d1.source: Continue on through the destroyed gate and you'll quickly spot the first two ballistae, with a boss near them. Defeat him and the two Stone Summit Engineers to destroy the ballistae. Once you have done this continue down the path left of the ballistae and you'll come across another closed gate with a single mob in front of it. Defeat them and open the gate by using the lever nearby.
6abaf5fcb8ee46fbc3ed634db5fbed16d2fd39d1.text: 繼續穿過被摧毀的大門，你很快就會發現前兩個弩砲，它們附近有一個 Boss。擊敗他和兩名 石峰矮人 工程師以摧毀弩砲。完成此操作後，繼續沿著弩砲左側的路徑前進，您將遇到另一扇關閉的大門，前面有一個暴徒。擊敗他們並使用附近的槓桿開啟大門。

6fb545d40d5f7007e0eed8d855e1df9e3658973e.source: Note: To complete the bonus mission you will need to head past the gate and spring Rornak Stonesledge free from his prison, more information on the bonus can be found in the bonus section.
6fb545d40d5f7007e0eed8d855e1df9e3658973e.text: 注意：要完成獎勵任務，您需要穿過大門並從 洛奈科斯通萊基 的監獄中釋放出來，有關獎勵的更多資訊可以在獎勵部分找到。

97e21c746cb4e498d3cefb1b34e685ecde6bf7ed.source: After opening the gate, continue on the path and defeat any enemies you come across. You'll end up before the gates to Krok's Hollow, which will only open once all Stone Summit and Ice Golems nearby have been defeated. The groups are particularly close to each other in this area, so proper pulling is very important to avoid overaggro. Beware of two Ice Golem patrols that may seem to be stationary due to the long time they take to move. In Hard mode, it advisable to leave the two Stone Summit Engineers for last as they are easily dispatched and provide a Morale Boost that will recharge your signets if needed.
97e21c746cb4e498d3cefb1b34e685ecde6bf7ed.text: 開啟大門後，繼續前進並擊敗遇到的所有敵人。你最終會到達 客洛克峽谷 的大門，只有當附近所有 石峰矮人 和冰布傀儡都被擊敗後，大門才會開啟。在這個區域，各個群體彼此之間特別接近，因此適當的拉動對於避免過度仇恨非常重要。請注意兩個 冰高崙 巡邏隊，由於移動時間較長，它們看起來可能是靜止的。在 困難模式 中，建議將兩名 石峰矮人 工程師留在最後，因為他們很容易被派遣，並提供士氣提升，可以在需要時為您的印章充電。

57f9c29aca96bd1a3f9601810f949ddaaa6c50b3.source: Once the gates open, head inside and speak with Prince Rurik; a short movie will be played.
57f9c29aca96bd1a3f9601810f949ddaaa6c50b3.text: 大門開啟後，走進去並與 盧瑞克王子 交談；將播放一部短片。

d8ceaf79d892c351fd08a94a9b5f079fbb6381d3.source: King Jalis Ironhammer will have given you an Enchanted Torch during the movie that you'll need to use to light the beacon outside Grooble's Gulch. Cross the bridge and follow the path. The group of allied dwarves nearby will help you defeat any Stone Summit enemies you encounter along the way.
d8ceaf79d892c351fd08a94a9b5f079fbb6381d3.text: 亞理斯 艾倫海默國王 會在影片中給你一個 附魔 火炬，你需要用它來點亮 歌路波峽谷 外面的信標。過橋並沿著小路走。附近的矮人聯盟將幫助您擊敗沿途遇到的任何 石峰矮人 敵人。

19a7e5498acb7b03447854aeff2b96ee01717b66.source: At the point where the path splits, taking a right is usually preferable: moving carefully, it is possible to avoid combat and completely ignore the two Stone Summit groups that patrol the other side; however, it may result in a party wipe if your party aggros both groups when attempting to sneak past them. They can be especially difficult in hard mode due to the fact that each group contains a Dolyak Rider. Another method is to stay back and wait for the one group that will patrol north towards your party, kill them and sneak past the second group.
19a7e5498acb7b03447854aeff2b96ee01717b66.text: 在路徑分岔的地方，通常最好向右轉：小心移動，可以避免戰鬥並完全忽略另一側巡邏的兩個 石峰矮人 小組；然而，如果你的隊伍在試圖偷偷溜過去時激怒了這兩個群體，則可能會導致隊伍被消滅。由於每個組別都包含 石犛牛騎士，因此在困難模式下它們可能特別困難。另一種方法是留在後面等待一組向北巡邏到你的隊伍，殺死他們並偷偷溜過第二組。

aad9c80bd0f5c1e5e2f2b0579168f697afa13553.source: At the end of the path, you will encounter the last boss of this mission. The three beacons you need to light stand a short distance behind him, protected by three Stone Summit Beastmasters that can be engaged separately and should be easily managed. Defeat them all and light the beacons, a movie will play and you will have completed the mission.
aad9c80bd0f5c1e5e2f2b0579168f697afa13553.text: 在路徑的盡頭，你會遇到這個任務的最後一個頭目。您需要點亮的三個信標位於他身後不遠的地方，由三個 石峰野獸馴養者 保護，這些信標可以單獨使用並且應該易於管理。擊敗他們所有人並點亮信標，將播放一部電影，您就完成了任務。

5b0d277fa3fb36c35d133ab1b9a7448bdeae970a.source: The bonus objective is obtained by speaking to Rornak Stonesledge, who stands behind a gate that you need to blow up with a Dwarven Powder Keg from the nearby station. After talking to Rornak, fetch another keg and place it inside the wood and chains directly behind him to destroy the wall of snow blocking the cave entrance. Place the keg around the front half of the pile, as placing it against the wall of snow itself will have no effect. Inside the cave, at the end, is an Ice Drake that you need to kill to complete the bonus.
5b0d277fa3fb36c35d133ab1b9a7448bdeae970a.text: 獎勵目標是透過與 洛奈科斯通萊基 交談來獲得的，洛奈科斯通萊基 站在一扇門後面，你需要從附近的車站用矮人火藥桶將其炸毀。與羅納克交談後，拿另一個小桶，將其放在他身後的木頭和鏈條內，以摧毀阻擋洞穴入口的雪牆。將小桶放在雪堆的前半部周圍，因為將其靠在雪牆上本身不會產生任何效果。在洞穴的最後，有一個冰 龍獸，你需要殺死它才能完成獎勵。

507822ab09846dec0d5d411dd723b0a07d1b8de6.source: The path to the Ice Drake is populated with several small groups of Frostfire Dryders that tend to cast Suffering on the party.
507822ab09846dec0d5d411dd723b0a07d1b8de6.text: 通往冰雪 龍獸 的道路上佈滿了幾小群霜火乾燥者，他們傾向於對隊伍施放 苦難。

6c9fccca350ea867d19bf2a305cd42f45eef0af8.source: Tactics for Hard Mode are no different to that of normal mode. Slower pacing and luring enemies in smaller groups helps. Some of the bosses near to enemy groups are separate to those groups, and can be lured on their own. Dryders in the Bonus Cave are Necromancers (Curses and Blood magic), so can be tricky if you are not prepared for the health degen effects.
6c9fccca350ea867d19bf2a305cd42f45eef0af8.text: 硬模式的 戰術 與普通模式沒有什麼不同。放慢節奏並以較小的群體引誘敵人會有所幫助。一些靠近敵方群體的 Boss 與這些群體是分開的，可以單獨引誘。 額外獎勵 洞穴中的乾燥者是死靈法師（詛咒 和血魔法），因此如果您沒有準備好應對健康惡化效果，那麼可能會很棘手。

a7fbd42fd64b6dc7febfbdbf340fa1a6a92d3840.source: In Hard mode, enchantment removal skills should prove invaluable by stripping the Dolyak Riders of their Mark of Protection enchantment. Skills that inflict the dazed condition will help in interrupting and preventing the Dolyak Riders from casting Mark of Protection.
a7fbd42fd64b6dc7febfbdbf340fa1a6a92d3840.text: 在 困難模式 中，結界移除技能可以透過剝奪 Dolyak Riders 的 守護印記 結界來證明其價值。造成眩暈狀態的技巧將有助於打斷和阻止多利亞克騎士施放 守護印記。

0032feda2b8ccaca75ccb0f990f39db751590d35.source: Enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to enchantment removal by Stone Summit Howlers and Sages.
0032feda2b8ccaca75ccb0f990f39db751590d35.text: 基於 加持魔法 的建置很容易被 石峰矮人 咆哮者和賢者移除結界。

c358e75c4a1cc1131536e09c3285c12760dd6445.source: Complete exploration of the mission area contributes approximately 1.5% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
c358e75c4a1cc1131536e09c3285c12760dd6445.text: 對任務區域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 頭銜做出了約 1.5% 的貢獻。

0814fd365cf6083c29aacdede134be1ff66c09af.source: The Stone Summit do not appear to be allied with the Ice Golems, as the Dolyak Riders do not appear to heal the Ice Golems, even when in range
0814fd365cf6083c29aacdede134be1ff66c09af.text: 石峰矮人 似乎不會與冰傀儡結盟，因為多利亞克騎士似乎不會治癒冰傀儡，即使在範圍內

ea9539ca00b32aba0172e9eefff74bd9f6ef8a5d.source: If the door just before Rurik does not open, yet you have killed off the local enemies, you will have to backtrack and find the Boss and engineers you did not kill. This has previously been misinterpreted as a bug.
ea9539ca00b32aba0172e9eefff74bd9f6ef8a5d.text: 如果Rurik前面的門沒有開啟，但你已經殺死了當地的敵人，你將不得不原路返回並找到你沒有殺死的頭目和工程師。此前，這被誤解為錯誤。

d6957c8981911d0450d6a7657070ab6070991cea.source: Just using the kegs to access and kill the Ice Drake is enough for the bonus, Rornak Stonesledge doesn't need to be talked to at all.
d6957c8981911d0450d6a7657070ab6070991cea.text: 只需使用小桶存取並殺死冰塊 龍獸 就足以獲得獎勵，洛奈科斯通萊基 根本不需要與之交談。

e007de745142601d09f61f2c4ba30eda2af969bc.source: The gate lever can accidentally be pulled twice while moving. Closing it on your party and trapping the player on the inside alone. Henchmen and heroes cannot operate the lever and the player can no longer reach it from the inside.
e007de745142601d09f61f2c4ba30eda2af969bc.text: 移動時門桿可能會意外拉動兩次。將其封閉在你的隊伍中並將玩家單獨困在裡面。 傭兵 和英雄無法操作控制桿，玩家也無法再從內部觸及它。

280a0300c5bd03c9d73c34ab7083c688e5ea67f4.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to The Frost Gate.
280a0300c5bd03c9d73c34ab7083c688e5ea67f4.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將會傳送到 寒霜之門(地區)。

e0ecc7535cf9ae29b8784339f5df707a7231ca39.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #6 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
e0ecc7535cf9ae29b8784339f5df707a7231ca39.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#6 頁。

991789c33da5b1da92ccf8199e4a64ef7780a74a.source: The Dwarven Soldier mentions being safe in Droknar's Forge, but that town is not reached until later in the Prophecies' storyline. The gate to Krok's Hollow may not open if any of the four Stone Summit Engineers are killed by a minion or other non-party NPC. Sometimes if the gate leading to the drake is destroyed with a powder keg while the lever is being used at the same time, the door will appear open but cannot be pass through and the bonus cannot be completed. Sometimes players can get stuck and become trapped within the Storm Beacon area, unable to leave.
991789c33da5b1da92ccf8199e4a64ef7780a74a.text: 矮人士兵提到 卓克納熔爐 很安全，但直到 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事情節的後期才到達城鎮。如果四名 石峰矮人 工程師中的任何一個被小兵或其他非隊伍 NPC 殺死，則 客洛克峽谷 的大門可能無法開啟。有時，如果在使用槓桿的同時用火藥桶摧毀通往龍的大門，門會顯示為開啟，但無法通過，並且無法完成獎勵。有時玩家可能會被困在風暴燈塔區域內而​​無法離開。

f4fdd8da5e0738786f88aa48c38b025f1ffaa891.source: Sometimes Whiskar Featherstorm spawns instead of Ice Drake. Killing Whiskar Featherstorm will still complete the bonus objective. The two Frostfire Dryders that accompany the Ice Drake/Whiskar Featherstorm also have to be killed to complete the bonus objective.
f4fdd8da5e0738786f88aa48c38b025f1ffaa891.text: 有時會產生 羽風暴威斯卡，而不是冰 龍獸。殺死 羽風暴威斯卡 仍將完成獎勵目標。伴隨冰 龍獸/羽風暴威斯卡 的兩臺霜火烘乾機也必須被殺死才能完成獎勵目標。

1d19c8dc0fa2760ff1623f3ef2e5a5735837f7ef.source: de:Borlispass (Mission) fr:Passage de Borlis (Mission en mode coopératif)
1d19c8dc0fa2760ff1623f3ef2e5a5735837f7ef.text: de:Borlispass (主線任務) fr:Passage de Borlis (主線任務 en mode coopératif)

8c6db3457fab9661a57488a3931becea642a1c62.source: Defend the sailors as they complete the ceremony.
8c6db3457fab9661a57488a3931becea642a1c62.text: 在水手們完成儀式時保護他們。

3a085eebc70975ef22c038c015b8bba3399b5da8.source: Receive the blessings of the wind and water.

a4cab645ea02b2cb52bde575519aa4fce9b2c92d.source: When you enter Mehtani Keys, there will be a group of sailors standing in front of a shrine-like structure on the first small island southeast of the exit into Kodlonu Hamlet. When you approach them, they will join your party as allies and begin their ritual. Soon, three Water Djinn will spawn and attack. Defend the sailors from harm. The second wave and third wave consists of three and five Djinn respectively. It is not difficult at all to keep the sailors alive. Once the three waves have been defeated, Kinya Kela will appear to hand you the Blessing of Wind and Water. Consider clearing out the nearby Skale before triggering the quest, as the skale may attack the sailors and make it more difficult to defend them. Return to Castellan Puuba for your reward.
a4cab645ea02b2cb52bde575519aa4fce9b2c92d.text: 當你進入 梅坦尼之鑰 時，會有一群水手站在科德洛努哈姆雷特出口東南方第一個小島上一座神殿般的建築前。當你接近他們時，他們會作為盟友加入你的隊伍並開始他們的儀式。很快，三隻 水巨靈 就會出現並發動攻擊。保護水手免受傷害。第二波和第三波分別由三個和五個巨靈怪組成。讓水手們活下來一點也不困難。一旦三波被擊敗，Kinya Kela 就會出現並交給你風和水的 祝福。考慮在觸發任務之前清除附近的 鱗怪，因為斯卡萊可能會攻擊水手並使其更難防禦。 影返 送給 Castellan Puuba，以獲得獎勵。

261a329d0682a881eca2c3d3f06b37bd15b17e8b.source: If you keep the quest active, the groups of Water Djinns can be farmed for Piles of Glittering Dust and Water Djinn Essences.
261a329d0682a881eca2c3d3f06b37bd15b17e8b.text: 如果你保持任務活躍，可以養殖成群的水精靈以獲得一堆閃閃發光的灰塵和水巨靈精華。

eae242abc210f0de1118aca17ece68c0c88330c0.source: Seek out Headmaster Kaa in the monastery.
eae242abc210f0de1118aca17ece68c0c88330c0.text: 到修道院尋找卡阿校長。

b1765d0bf605b9d2ad3099df7bae9ac81bb40570.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Anvil Rock and start the mission. Completing Borlis Pass also brings the party here.
b1765d0bf605b9d2ad3099df7bae9ac81bb40570.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 鐵砧石 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 柏里斯通道 也將聚會帶到這裡。

e39d85c1447bd41a22a8a20aae10d6f84b7874f2.source: Destroy the ballistae to secure safe passage for Rurik and the Ascalon refugees.
e39d85c1447bd41a22a8a20aae10d6f84b7874f2.text: 摧毀弩砲以確保魯裡克和 阿斯卡隆 難民的安全通道。

39e04031f5d5ba473cf8b7ef41a9ef8280ceb7e8.source: Retrieve the Gear Lever from the Dwarven fort to open the Frost Gate.
39e04031f5d5ba473cf8b7ef41a9ef8280ceb7e8.text: 從矮人堡壘取回 齒輪拉桿 以開啟 寒霜之門。

18b9d717a48c6f1b51c1c7f27d45383ac14bf793.source: ADDED: Use the Gear Lever on the Lever Mechanism to reach the Frost Gate.
18b9d717a48c6f1b51c1c7f27d45383ac14bf793.text: 新增：使用槓桿機構上的 齒輪拉桿 來到達 寒霜之門。

98f9a4de3509856a2881602facf2513e1943071b.source: *BONUS* Steal the Stone Summit's secret plans for a powerful siege weapon.
98f9a4de3509856a2881602facf2513e1943071b.text: *獎勵* 竊取 石峰矮人 的秘密計劃，以獲得強大的攻城武器。

4fd8c6a15c1a385c0fd665b06894ed4e08c31d1a.source: ADDED: Activate the three Frost Gate Lever Mechanisms before the Stone Summit overwhelms Rurik.
4fd8c6a15c1a385c0fd665b06894ed4e08c31d1a.text: 新增：在 石峰矮人 壓倒 Rurik 之前啟動三個 寒霜之門 槓桿機構。

780b709f61073adb60aedb6161a22bc29889ff41.source: Your party is taking the higher path clearing obstacles so Rurik and refugees can make progress on the lower path. The party cannot reach the lower path nor interact with Rurik.
780b709f61073adb60aedb6161a22bc29889ff41.text: 你的隊伍正在走更高的道路，清除障礙，以便魯裡克和難民能夠在更低的道路上取得進展。該隊伍無法到達下層路徑，也無法與留裡克互動。

2d9805cb0f753915e7b4387762522f8e13be0f0e.source: Follow the pass in a general southerly direction while searching for the ballistae (marked in green on the wiki map). Two can be found somewhat west of the normal path. Kill the Stone Summit Engineers next to them. Continue on, following the red path on the wiki map. After destroying all four ballistae, a cinematic will play, a gate will open and your party can head down a hill to pick up the gear lever. Use it on the nearby gear mechanism (blue point 1 on the wiki map) to open the gate just beyond. The mechanism will cause the lever to drop after several seconds. Pick it back up and wait patiently for the gate to open.
2d9805cb0f753915e7b4387762522f8e13be0f0e.text: 沿著山口大致向南的方向前進，同時尋找弩砲（在維基地圖上以綠色標示）。兩個可以在正常路徑的西邊找到。殺死旁邊的 石峰矮人 工程師。沿著維基地圖上的紅色路徑繼續前進。摧毀所有四個弩砲後，會播放一段電影，一扇門會開啟，你的隊伍可以下山拿起變速桿。在附近的齒輪機構（維基地圖上的藍點 1）上使用它來開啟遠處的門。該機制將導致槓桿在幾秒鐘後下降。把它撿起來，耐心等待大門開啟。

41a3dbd58ca08524c41163ccee449003000356a2.source: Next, enter the area behind the gate. From here you can see two of the three additional mechanisms needed to be triggered by the lever. The third one is below and in front of the other two. Using the gear lever on any of the three mechanisms causes a nearby gate to open, allowing additional enemies to spill out and attack your party. It is recommended to completely clear the area of foes before activating any of these gates, thus lessening the impact of the extra enemies. Shortly (but not immediately) after having used the gear lever on the third mechanism (in that grouping, fourth mechanism overall), the final cinematic is shown, ending the mission.
41a3dbd58ca08524c41163ccee449003000356a2.text: 接下來，進入大門後方的區域。從這裡您可以看到槓桿需要觸發的三個附加機制中的兩個。第三個位於另外兩個的下方和前面。使用三個機制中任何一個上的變速桿都會導致附近的大門開啟，讓更多的敵人湧出並攻擊你的隊伍。建議在啟動任何這些門之前完全清除該區域的敵人，從而減少額外敵人的影響。在使用第三個機構（在該組中，第四個機構）上的變速桿後不久（但不是立即），顯示了最終的動畫，結束了任務。

c941a32cdd87b18a4b1fe70aa5591361dfc82cc2.source: Since Rornak must survive to complete the bonus, consider first clearing the path to yellow point 2 before leading him there. Yellow point 2 houses two mobs of two Dolyak Riders and several Stone Summit. Luring some of these foes away from the Riders and their considerable healing potential may prove a worthy tactic. Be cautious in your attempts to lure the enemies, especially in Hard mode or with henchmen, as the Dolyak Riders will follow as soon as you attack any member of the mob. Consider spreading the enemy lines to accomplish this task with the use of bodyblocking on the road nearby the start of the yellow line that leads to yellow point 2. With the party correctly positioned, pull the enemies into your waiting ambush and crush them with impunity.
c941a32cdd87b18a4b1fe70aa5591361dfc82cc2.text: 由於 Rornak 必須生存才能完成獎勵，因此請考慮先清理通往黃點 2 的路徑，然後再帶他去那裡。黃點 2 容納了兩個小怪，其中包括兩名 Dolyak Rider 和數名 石峰矮人。將其中一些敵人引離騎手及其巨大的治療潛力可能是一個有價值的策略。在嘗試引誘敵人時要小心，尤其是在 困難模式 中或與追隨者一起時，因為一旦您攻擊任何暴徒成員，多利亞克騎士就會跟隨。考慮分散敵人的防線來完成這項任務，在黃線起點附近的道路上使用身體阻擋，通往黃點 2。隊伍正確定位後，將敵人拉入你等待的埋伏中，並將他們碾壓而不受懲罰。

7524b96b06f5f76dd4c4645306e5942f1025a524.source: Another difficult fight with a random Stone Summit boss awaits the party just beyond the place where the path to yellow point 3 departs from the usual mission route. Another Dolyak Rider in the mob presents an ample challenge in Hard mode; however, be aware that killing the boss and the mob will trigger a cinematic, moving the party forward. Although it is still possible to complete the bonus after the cinematic by backtracking, it is advisable to leave this mob until the bonus is done.
7524b96b06f5f76dd4c4645306e5942f1025a524.text: 另一場與隨機 石峰矮人 boss 的艱難戰鬥等待著隊伍，就在通往黃點 3 的路徑偏離通常任務路線的地方。 困難模式 中的另一個 石犛牛騎士 為 困難模式 帶來了巨大的挑戰；然而，請注意，殺死老闆和暴徒會觸發過場動畫，推動隊伍前進。雖然在過場動畫之後仍然可以透過回溯來完成獎勵，但建議在獎勵完成之前離開生物。

b417c57696c087db811dc8101439c023564082c4.source: Dolyak Riders can remove hexes, but not conditions; however, Stone Summit Howlers have Plague Touch, so avoid inflicting conditions on the Howlers.
b417c57696c087db811dc8101439c023564082c4.text: 多利亞克騎士可以移除六角形，但不能移除條件；然而，石峰矮人 咆哮者有 疫病之觸，所以請避免對咆哮者造成影響。

1e5289800fdcbdc65ecf6c1ccdcdf1525ff68a01.source: Heroes and henchmen sometimes get stuck on the Lever Mechanisms. To avoid this, flag them away so they don't follow you when you go to use a Gear Lever on a Lever Mechanism.
1e5289800fdcbdc65ecf6c1ccdcdf1525ff68a01.text: 英雄和追隨者有時會被槓桿機制卡住。為了避免這種情況，請將它們標記為遠離，這樣當您在槓桿機構上使用 齒輪拉桿 時，它們就不會跟隨您。

ceebdf3cd4da253bf8b2d188c745ddf4506656f0.source: The two Snow Ettins will sometimes attack the Stone Summit Engineers near the third and fourth ballistae.
ceebdf3cd4da253bf8b2d188c745ddf4506656f0.text: 兩架 Snow Ettins 有時會攻擊第三個和第四個弩砲附近的 石峰矮人 工程師。

6db0ea4e270e134450b73b184a6ae85733ffcc08.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Beacon's Perch.
6db0ea4e270e134450b73b184a6ae85733ffcc08.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將會傳送到 畢肯高地。

73dde9cba2bd9c058e80ad009ae71d966d5344f4.source: Complete exploration of the mission area adds approximately 1.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
73dde9cba2bd9c058e80ad009ae71d966d5344f4.text: 對任務區域的完整探索將大約 1.4% 加入到 Tyrian 版圖 標題中。

4fb6dfb3b63bebfc6c76a2e617c648d1957138b8.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #7 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
4fb6dfb3b63bebfc6c76a2e617c648d1957138b8.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#7 頁。

153742e25fa8a3b76b577e31a6100e8701b56978.source: Contrary to the mission objective, the mission will continue even if Prince Rurik dies before all 3 Lever Mechanisms have been activated. Sometimes a Chest/Locked Chest will spawn on the path (that cannot be reached by players) taken by Prince Rurik and the Ascalon Soldiers.
153742e25fa8a3b76b577e31a6100e8701b56978.text: 與任務目標相反，即使 盧瑞克王子 在所有 3 槓桿機構啟動之前死亡，任務仍將繼續。有時，寶箱/鎖定的寶箱會在盧瑞克王子和阿斯卡隆士兵所走的路徑（玩家無法到達）上產生。

04f195e243bae44f94c46b421b623abf3eac9f78.source: Gain the rank of Sunspear Captain or Level 17. (For Nightfall characters only.)
04f195e243bae44f94c46b421b623abf3eac9f78.text: 獲得烈陽之矛隊長軍階或 17 等級。 （僅適用於 黑暗逆襲 字元。）

2fac3513f0a9cc2c14ebf609b026ab5632167a64.source: Rally the Sunspears in Churrhir Fields.
2fac3513f0a9cc2c14ebf609b026ab5632167a64.text: 在丘裡爾原野集結陽矛軍。

1da916514399969fd2f303ba1803d07223885cc6.source: Speak with Assistant Hahnna to gain an audience with Elder Suhl.
1da916514399969fd2f303ba1803d07223885cc6.text: 與哈納助理交談，拜見蘇爾長老。

2b7aea7cf8a3b6f236107f005c4cb7fc7c27a127.source: See Raidmarshal Mehdara for your reward.
2b7aea7cf8a3b6f236107f005c4cb7fc7c27a127.text: 前往Raidmarshal Mehdara 領取獎勵。

ebc140c086003119595545cf9655d911330e5125.source: Once you meet the requirements to continue the quest, speak to Second Spear Binah to enter Churrhir Fields. Head to the area on your minimap as marked by the green quest Indicator. Wait for Kormir to rally the troops. After Kormir has completed her speech, speak to her, then Map Travel to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan and enter the Consulate portal. Talk to Assistant Hahnna to begin the cutscene. Talk to Raidmarshal Mehdara for the reward.
ebc140c086003119595545cf9655d911330e5125.text: 一旦滿足繼續任務的要求，請與第二個 矛 Binah 交談以進入 Churrir Fields。前往小地圖上綠色任務指示器標記的區域。等待科米爾集結部隊。科米爾完成演講後，與她交談，然後將旅行對映到 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽 並進入領事館門戶。與助理哈納交談以開始過場動畫。與 Raidmarshal Mehdara 交談以獲得獎勵。

89fb1aa1780c42dc1c0edc3528c1d3dee764a575.source: This quest is sometimes used to ferry people to Consulate Docks, to help low-level characters get access to max armor and other campaigns.
89fb1aa1780c42dc1c0edc3528c1d3dee764a575.text: 此任務有時用於將人們運送到領事館碼頭，以幫助低階角色獲得最大護甲和其他活動。

558631a51cc49c15d1090656c9df49a7738b0190.source: Internally, there are two separate quests of this name, one for Elonians and one for foreigners. The German localization has distinct names for the two.
558631a51cc49c15d1090656c9df49a7738b0190.text: 在內部，有兩個獨立的同名任務，一個針對埃洛尼亞人，一個針對外國人。兩者的德語本地化名稱不同。

4937d8a10ffaba35927a07c421dd9e50330ab27d.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Mei Ling.
4937d8a10ffaba35927a07c421dd9e50330ab27d.text: 搜尋 桑泉谷 尋找美玲。

b64179980d2b4fc977c1b04607bafbe8a64d6a7e.source: You receive the following skills after accepting this quest:
b64179980d2b4fc977c1b04607bafbe8a64d6a7e.text: 接受此任務後您將獲得以下技能：

32dfa0f2f49ffd78e5ccaf9ed443da808cff71a0.source: Mei Ling can be found at the center of Sunqua Vale, standing at the closest ramp towards the snowy mountains from Shing Jea Monastery.
32dfa0f2f49ffd78e5ccaf9ed443da808cff71a0.text: 美玲位於桑泉谷的中心，站在距離星岬寺最近的通往雪山的坡道上。

57e2b0df9a1ccbf51abae2211ca5a35c62aa5c8a.source: Eliminate the [6...0] remaining Centaur patrols along the main road.
57e2b0df9a1ccbf51abae2211ca5a35c62aa5c8a.text: 消滅沿著主幹道剩餘的 [6...0] 支 半人馬 巡邏隊。

f20bf2150c3d66961f78c866059b889b713bb3a1.source: See Ranger Olson for your reward.
f20bf2150c3d66961f78c866059b889b713bb3a1.text: 請參閱 遊俠 Olson 以獲得獎勵。

c0c80130a5b4e344a4157543ad7007f0995b2aa4.source: Refugees will continue to spawn in Deldrimor Bowl after completing the quest.
c0c80130a5b4e344a4157543ad7007f0995b2aa4.text: 完成任務後，難民將繼續在 戴爾狄摩盆地 中產生。

6253dabaa4140994a025d27ac1616dc4245cfd84.source: The centaur groups killed for this quest, specifically those directly on the refugees' path, will no longer spawn.
6253dabaa4140994a025d27ac1616dc4245cfd84.text: 因該任務而被殺的半人馬群體，特別是直接位於難民道路上的半人馬群體，將不再生成。

289b17e140a4766c9fce06b473ccca9da71ccb77.source: Exit Beacon's Perch into Deldrimor Bowl and follow the quest markers westwards, killing the centaur groups you encounter along the way. The groups you are required to kill for the quest might not be precisely at the quest markers, but they will be close enough to find simply by following the southern path. You will meet numerous refugees along the way who will fight the centaurs with you; they are individually quite weak and likely to die, but there is no requirement to keep them alive, only to kill the centaurs.
289b17e140a4766c9fce06b473ccca9da71ccb77.text: 從 畢肯高地 退出進入 戴爾狄摩盆地，然後沿著任務標記向西前進，殺死沿途遇到的半人馬群體。你需要為任務殺死的群體可能並不精確地位於任務標記處，但它們將足夠接近，只需沿著南部的路徑即可找到。一路上你會遇到無數的難民，他們會和你一起對抗半人馬；他們個體都很弱，很可能會死，但沒有要求讓他們活下去，只需要殺死半人馬。

15ec6b81fdcf2f11b7a6af8cfd76b3a0461a2ce9.source: After you have killed the six groups indicated by the quest markers, speak to Ranger Olson, who will be nearby at the start of the path leading to Griffon's Mouth.
15ec6b81fdcf2f11b7a6af8cfd76b3a0461a2ce9.text: 殺死任務標記指示的六個小組後，與 遊俠 Olson 交談，他將在通往 獅鷲獸隘口 的路徑起點附近。

73bfa92b323009385a0bfc2b131192152223f93e.source: The next quest in the line isn't given by Ranger Olson, but by Master Seeker Nathaniel in Griffon's Mouth.
73bfa92b323009385a0bfc2b131192152223f93e.text: 此行中的下一個任務不是由 遊俠 Olson 給予的，而是由 獅鷲獸隘口 中的 搜尋大師撒尼爾 給予的。

3087ab6ac975f0785b89c15894c3f26454aae355.source: The quests Hungry Devourer and The Deserters will give you additional allies, with those added by The Deserters being significantly stronger.
3087ab6ac975f0785b89c15894c3f26454aae355.text: 任務 饑餓的蠍子 和 叛徒 將為您提供額外的盟友，其中 叛徒 新增的盟友要強大得多。

61daa5f8996747f183cc2f8a90ec0a2e2fe49e78.source: Although this quest chronologically follows The Frost Gate, completion of that mission is not required.
61daa5f8996747f183cc2f8a90ec0a2e2fe49e78.text: 雖然此任務依時間順序位於 寒霜之門(地區) 之後，但並不需要完成此任務。

fb32a6f98bb30929621747f007831d99c857df0c.source: Travel to the Shrine of Maat.

d9576a497dc31690e8f8bfeea8b687b697d0507e.source: Cure Brother Sitai of his affliction and restore order at the Shrine of Maat.
d9576a497dc31690e8f8bfeea8b687b697d0507e.text: 治癒西泰兄弟的病痛並恢復瑪特神殿的秩序。

db09bec5978af60b3958393fa0d614e8d4972fd3.source: See Mei Ling for your reward.

cdcebb8f7df62fa2239ac19a6ce4fcd1ca8725da.source: Follow the quest arrow to the Shrine of Maat and kill any enemies that attack your party on the way. You'll know you're at the Shrine if you see a couple of NPCs outside of the temple talking about Brother Sitai. Brother Sitai is located in the Shrine of Maat itself, and you'll notice he has a hex on him. Simply target Brother Sitai and use a hex removal skill on him, and the quest will be completed.
cdcebb8f7df62fa2239ac19a6ce4fcd1ca8725da.text: 依照任務箭頭前往瑪特神殿，殺死途中攻擊你隊伍的任何敵人。如果你看到神殿外有幾個 NPC 談論四太兄弟，你就知道你到了神殿。西泰兄弟位於瑪特神殿內，你會注意到他身上有咒語。只要瞄準四泰兄，對他使用除妖技能，任務就完成了。

79ff179a4e891af17ec912fa57939257d624ef9a.source: Keep in mind that any member of your party can remove the hex and the quest will be successful, and also that Taya carries the skill Remove Hex and will use it to complete the quest for you.
79ff179a4e891af17ec912fa57939257d624ef9a.text: 請記住，您隊伍中的任何成員都可以移除十六進位制，並且任務將會成功，而且塔亞擁有技能 降咒消除 並將使用它來為您完成任務。

75b6690dfc37d2a092ed2d43c64eade7b875a96b.source: It is not known exactly what hex Brother Sitai was hexed with.
75b6690dfc37d2a092ed2d43c64eade7b875a96b.text: 目前尚不清楚四太兄到底被施了什麼咒。

9132e5302d863d260bb5ad354f68a4ada73c308c.source: Sometimes Brother Sitai will not be hexed from the start, and you will have to re-zone and do it again.
9132e5302d863d260bb5ad354f68a4ada73c308c.text: 有時四泰兄弟不會從一開始就被詛咒，你將不得不重新分割槽並再次執行。

a9df5d9d182b3e0f6fceed8998634b7196b4f4ef.source: Holy Veil can not be used to remove the hex for some reason, you will have to re-zone and bring a different hex removal
a9df5d9d182b3e0f6fceed8998634b7196b4f4ef.text: 由於某種原因，神聖遮罩 無法用於刪除十六進位制，您將必須重新分割並帶來不同的十六進位刪除

443c5d78dcb7d6fd5a15d28ad64003d3935483d0.source: Rally the Sunspear Scouts. Brief Elite Scout Zusoh on the situation.
443c5d78dcb7d6fd5a15d28ad64003d3935483d0.text: 集結烈陽之矛斥候。 精英 Scout Zusoh 簡單介紹了情況。

f8fc640fd83f505921607a3a6aa2f7bf9acd8df7.source: See Quarrymaster Bohanna for your reward.
f8fc640fd83f505921607a3a6aa2f7bf9acd8df7.text: 前往採石場大師博哈納 (Bohanna) 處領取獎勵。

0af5223209afab885f6f61de220499ba7c69403f.source: A very simple quest where you just need to follow the quest marker out of the Sunspear Great Hall and head towards Champion's Dawn in the southwest. You will meet up with some Sunspears and you just need to talk to them before entering the outpost proper and claiming your reward. Alternatively, if you have Champion's Dawn mapped already, you can simply map travel there and talk to the Sunspears right outside the north exit.
0af5223209afab885f6f61de220499ba7c69403f.text: 這是一個非常簡單的任務，你只需要跟著任務標記走出 日戟大會堂，然後前往西南方的 勇士曙光。你會遇到一些陽矛戰士，你只需要在進入前哨站並領取獎勵之前與他們交談即可。或者，如果您已經繪製了 勇士曙光 地圖，您可以簡單地繪製那裡的旅行地圖並與北出口外的陽矛隊交談。

cf3cf5d1e50223b1b53cbb9a533eed23c2a9c1e7.source: Follow Aidan's markers through the Ice Cave.
cf3cf5d1e50223b1b53cbb9a533eed23c2a9c1e7.text: 跟著 艾登 的標記穿過冰洞。

1066c5cd061bb97046b9e59bf88659e01c9c955a.text: 請參閱 艾登 以取得獎勵。

ba632d9a0730916ff5653bb546f623edf7a52146.source: When you accept the quest, Snow will immediately start running into the cave, pausing for a short time at each Mark of Aidan. You do not have to keep up with Snow or pick up the Marks of Aidan; your only task is to reach Aidan at the other end of the cave. Along the way, you will encounter numerous Snow Ettins; they inflict Weakness and have a high physical damage output for their level, so consider pulling if you run into too many at once. Two White Mantle members will also be walking the same path more slowly, so you can follow them and fight with them as long as they survive. If all else fails, simply follow the right wall of the cave.
ba632d9a0730916ff5653bb546f623edf7a52146.text: 當您接受任務時，斯諾將立即開始跑進洞穴，並在每個 艾登 標記處暫停一小會兒。您不必跟上 Snow 的步伐，也不必獲得 艾登 的標記；您唯一的任務是到達洞穴另一端的 艾登。一路上，你會遇到無數的雪艾丁；它們會造成 虛弱 並在其等級中具有很高的物理傷害輸出，因此如果您同時遇到太多，請考慮拉動。兩位 白斗篷 成員也會以較慢的速度走在同一條路上，所以只要他們還活著，你就可以跟隨他們並與他們戰鬥。如果一切都失敗了，只需沿著洞穴的右壁走即可。

173ef4facf86c1cd31978f5c5b633f360d475cc3.source: Snow and the Marks of Aidan lead around the outer edge of the cave, where the ettin groups are more predictable but are not guaranteed to be smaller. To save time, you can instead abandon your allies and cut across the middle of the zone, taking a more direct route to get to Aidan. Regardless, when you are at the end of the cave, talk to Aidan to receive the quest reward.
173ef4facf86c1cd31978f5c5b633f360d475cc3.text: 雪和 艾登 的標記引導著洞穴的外緣，那裡的埃丁群更容易預測，但不能保證更小。為了節省時間，您可以放棄盟友並穿過區域中間，採取更直接的路線到達 艾登。無論如何，當您到達洞穴盡頭時，與 艾登 交談即可獲得任務獎勵。

38aadab8e8a11b326e35fe0f877b1a61c87e282c.source: Aidan can sometimes die to nearby enemies. If this happens, simply continue into Scoundrel's Rise, then re-enter Griffon's Mouth to complete the quest.
38aadab8e8a11b326e35fe0f877b1a61c87e282c.text: 艾登 有時會被附近的敵人殺死。如果發生這種情況，只需繼續進入 惡漢山丘，然後重新輸入 獅鷲獸隘口 即可完成任務。

964c1c6ba31dd6d656f6cf6cb640ef827ce36f38.source: Although this quest chronologically follows To Kryta: Refugees, it does not require completion of that quest.
964c1c6ba31dd6d656f6cf6cb640ef827ce36f38.text: 儘管此任務按時間順序位於 往科瑞塔:難民們 之後，但它並不需要完成該任務。

02ea8ac3b561c0a4734aec6f1f4c91ce3cf596b7.source: Champion's Dawn must not fall to the corsairs.
02ea8ac3b561c0a4734aec6f1f4c91ce3cf596b7.text: 勇士曙光 絕不能落入海盜之手。

8ecaa3c8e2565e33682218e6a621b13fc9e2d4ad.source: Speak to Quarrymaster Bohanna when all members of your party are ready to defend Champion's Dawn!
8ecaa3c8e2565e33682218e6a621b13fc9e2d4ad.text: 當你的隊伍的所有成員都準備好保衛 勇士曙光 時，與採石場大師博哈納交談！

d5874248ee9c1438130d48f55fb64fa013d26cff.source: Hold off the initial assault against Champion's Dawn.
d5874248ee9c1438130d48f55fb64fa013d26cff.text: 阻止對 勇士曙光 的最初攻擊。

519042380eb58369c48026f4491fcc512f437076.source: Your party is engaged in a mini-mission. If your party dies during this quest you will not be resurrected at a resurrection shrine.
519042380eb58369c48026f4491fcc512f437076.text: 你的隊伍正在執行一項小型任務。如果你的隊伍在此任務中死亡，你將不會在復活神社復活。

205477e220a7476dfdf620205890b4d6315acea0.source: Destroy the corsair chain of command by striking back at their war camps.
205477e220a7476dfdf620205890b4d6315acea0.text: 透過反擊海盜的戰爭營地來摧毀他們的指揮系統。

06d5548aabee14ff331a7db7900dee6d486edbca.source: You do not have to defend against the initial assault at all. It is possible to simply walk around to the quarry's north entrance, clear the two camps (the landing points are not necessary) and win.
06d5548aabee14ff331a7db7900dee6d486edbca.text: 你根本不需要防禦最初的攻擊。可以簡單地走到採石場的北入口，清除兩個營地（不需要著陸點）並獲勝。

b146fdf1c2102b86ff162b7a9ec7e7ef43889da7.source: The first part of the quest requires your party to defend against 6 Corsair and Kournan groups. Each group contains a random set of profession with 3 or 4 members. They come from two different sides, one from the west and the other from the southwest towards the beaches. Each group comes individually. At the end of the sequence, the final group will be led by a level 18 boss, Midshipman Beraidun. This phase is easy.
b146fdf1c2102b86ff162b7a9ec7e7ef43889da7.text: 任務的第一部分要求你的隊伍防禦 6 海盜 和 Kournan 團體。每個組別包含一組隨機的職業，其中包含 3 或 4 成員。他們來自兩個不同的方向，一個來自西方，另一個來自西南方的海灘。每個小組都是單獨來的。在序列結束時，最後一組將由 18 級 Boss 海軍軍官候補生 Beraidun 領導。這個階段很容易。

e07c8c383e0e215422dea70c47e973afa9c4c4f6.source: Afterwards, your party will move southwest to the beach of the Cliffs of Dohjok. There will be 4 "landing points" your party needs to take control of. Each location will have two or three groups of Corsairs and Kournans. Unless you are very powerful, wait for each enemy group to move away from the landing points and then pull them towards you. Use standard PvE caution, draw mobs and watch the patrols. Two of the landing points are led by bosses, Lieutenant Mahrik and Ensign Jahan (whose AoE damage output can be dangerous if you let the party clump up).
e07c8c383e0e215422dea70c47e973afa9c4c4f6.text: 之後，您的隊伍將向西南方向移動到 杜夏懸崖 的海灘。您的隊伍需要控制 4「著陸點」。每個地點都會有兩到三組海盜和庫南。除非你非常強大，否則請等待每個敵人群體遠離著陸點，然後將他們拉向你。使用標準的 PvE 謹慎，吸引小怪並觀察巡邏。其中兩個著陸點由 Boss Mahrik 中尉和 Jahan 少尉領導（如果你讓隊伍聚集在一起，他們的 範圍性 傷害輸出可能會很危險）。

65b1665d863d56d7167ae06985b8e17220214adb.source: In Hard mode, the end part can be overwhelming. An alternative strategy to completing this mission is to first kill the two mobs at the mechanisms, then trigger the mechanism at blue point 2 and defeat the two mobs that will run into the mechanism area. This next part can be done with one player character, to prevent a party wipe, while the rest of the party waits in the safety of the area where the Gear Lever originally appeared (blue point 1): trigger the mechanism at blue point 3 and, as soon as the Gear Lever is available again, go trigger the mechanism at blue point 4, which can be done before the mob that was triggered by the mechanism at blue point 3 arrives. This strategy is quicker and prevents the chance of a party wipe, since your party can avoid aggroing and having to fight the mobs that appear after triggering the last 2 mechanisms.
65b1665d863d56d7167ae06985b8e17220214adb.text: 在 困難模式 ，結尾部分可能會讓人不知所措。完成此任務的另一種策略是先殺宕機制處的兩個小怪，然後在藍點觸發機制 2 並擊敗將進入機制區域的兩個小怪。下一部分可以由一個玩家角色完成，以防止隊伍被消滅，而隊伍的其餘成員則在安全區域等待 齒輪拉桿 最初出現（藍點 1 )：在藍點觸發機制 3 並且，一旦 齒輪拉桿 再次可用，去觸發藍點處的機制 4 ，可以在藍點機制觸發的生物之前完成 3 到達。這種策略更快，並且可以防止隊伍被消滅的機會，因為你的隊伍可以避免仇恨並必須與觸發最後一個後出現的小怪戰鬥。 2 機制。

cf72dfce91b38c97cf4d3beb0c428e678430af5d.source: With heroes and henchmen, you can use a speed boost so that you can start both mechanisms, then run to blue point 1 and let your team aggro the remaining foes. Generally, the Summit mobs will not follow you outside the gate; even if they do, you can run away, let your heroes and henchmen absorb damage, and wait out the clock.
cf72dfce91b38c97cf4d3beb0c428e678430af5d.text: 對於英雄和追隨者，您可以使用速度提升，以便啟動兩種機制，然後跑到藍點 1 並讓您的團隊激怒剩餘的敵人。一般來說，峰會小怪不會跟著你到門外；即使他們這樣做了，你也可以逃跑，讓你的英雄和追隨者吸收傷害，然後等待時間結束。

4448e3b7818a317c11fa6bbad8b70abfbeb9021d.source: This strategy is especially useful for additional XP and Cartographer. If the other strategies are too stressful, it is possible to simply skip the intermediate cutscene towards the beginning by clicking the "Skip" button. This tactic ultimately leaves Rurik on the other side of the inaccessible area but unable to move, which prevents the timer from functioning. This will allow you to explore the other portions of the map that are otherwise difficult to reach within the allotted time frame. Upon entering the final section, you will notice that, on the path that Rurik would normally take, the Ascalon Refugees and Ascalon Soldiers that spawn will still be killed, but there will be no mission failure as a result. In order to access the hostile areas, you must first use the Gear Lever on two of three Lever Mechanisms. From there, simply pull the enemies to make exploration simpler. To end the mission, use the Gear Lever on the third and final Lever Mechanism as you normally would.
4448e3b7818a317c11fa6bbad8b70abfbeb9021d.text: 此策略對於額外的 XP 和 版圖 特別有用。如果其他策略壓力太大，可以透過點選「跳過」按鈕簡單地跳過開頭的中間過場動畫。這種策略最終使留裡克在無法進入區域的另一側但無法移動，導致計時器無法運作。這將使您能夠探索地圖上難以在指定時間範圍內到達的其他部分。進入最後一段後，你會注意到，在留裡克通常走的路徑上，生成的阿斯卡隆難民和阿斯卡隆士兵仍然會被殺死，但不會因此而導致任務失敗。為了進入敵對區域，您必須先在三個槓桿機構中的兩個上使用 齒輪拉桿。從那裡，只需拉動敵人即可使探索變得更簡單。要結束任務，請像平常一樣在第三個也是最後一個槓桿機構上使用 齒輪拉桿。

ce7404e67a12829ed9e14a8a5c4f3816041dd364.source: You need to free Rornak Stonesledge at yellow point 1 on the wiki map
ce7404e67a12829ed9e14a8a5c4f3816041dd364.text: 您需要在維基地圖上的黃點1處釋放洛奈科斯通萊基

9852d8d1f7d31c34330b5ff035faf81b2a109dc9.source: Lead him to the ballista at yellow point 2
9852d8d1f7d31c34330b5ff035faf81b2a109dc9.text: 把他帶到黃點的弩砲處 2

a2e0bf86f24a441f1ee487840d6c642e0460bf26.source: Use the ballista to blast open the door that leads to yellow point 3
a2e0bf86f24a441f1ee487840d6c642e0460bf26.text: 使用弩砲炸開通往黃點 3 的門

1cb30d4d03675b585cc15024ce7b07c34ac88ce6.source: Obtain the Secret Siege Weapon Plans from a chest at yellow point 3 and deliver them back to Rornak at the ballista (yellow point 2)
1cb30d4d03675b585cc15024ce7b07c34ac88ce6.text: 從黃點 3 處的箱子中取得秘密圍攻 武器 計劃，並將其送回弩砲處的羅納克（黃點 2）

2aae996b8894c6f08a9e6427ce4513c042661787.source: After the landing points are taken your party will be tasked with taking out two Corsair camps in the quarry. Each camp contains 3 Corsair groups of about 3 each. Additionally, each camp will have a single boss: Commander Bahreht at the east camp and Captain Shehnahr at the west camp. Once again, separate the groups and pull them back to your party. After both camps have been taken the mini-mission will end and a timer will count down from 30 seconds and return your party to Sunspear Great Hall.
2aae996b8894c6f08a9e6427ce4513c042661787.text: 佔領登陸點後，您的隊伍將會接到任務，消滅採石場中的兩個 海盜 營地。每個營地包含 3 海盜 群組，每組大約是 3。此外，每個營地都有一個 Boss：東營地的 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Bahreht 和西營地的 Captain Shehnahr。再次將各組分開並將他們拉回您的隊伍中。佔領兩個營地後，迷你任務將結束，計時器將從 30 秒開始倒數計時，並將您的隊伍返回 日戟大會堂。

7b7c33da298a29383a57d88ebbc2e58e275d9e15.source: Kormir will not attack an enemy unless a player attacks.
7b7c33da298a29383a57d88ebbc2e58e275d9e15.text: 除非玩家攻擊，否則科米爾不會攻擊敵人。

00b4e8f74cdeb9f6d6bf44e71270877c9fcc3802.source: There are no exits from the zone. Completing the objectives starts a 30 second countdown, after which you will be transported to the Sunspear Great Hall.
00b4e8f74cdeb9f6d6bf44e71270877c9fcc3802.text: 該區域沒有出口。完成目標後，將開始 30 秒倒數計時，之後您將會傳送到 日戟大會堂。

7ea67dd3966be0901b03d7fd05723bc230b35ad4.source: There are five elite skills available for capture during this mini-mission. Since these skills are only normally available later on in the game, new created native-born Elonian characters may find it advantageous to join a foreign-born party intent on completing this quest.
7ea67dd3966be0901b03d7fd05723bc230b35ad4.text: 在這個迷你任務中，有五種精英技能可供捕獲。由於這些技能通常只能在遊戲後期才能使用，因此新建立的本土出生的埃隆尼亞角色可能會發現加入旨在完成此任務的外國出生的隊伍是有利的。

5b8cebf6a1a8eb71cd7fbe4b4ca4f93bc3e15a47.source: You also receive 20 points for each boss killed and 50 points for each of the three main objectives (holding off the initial assault, seizing all the landing points, and capturing the war camps). (These bonuses are not documented in the objectives.)
5b8cebf6a1a8eb71cd7fbe4b4ca4f93bc3e15a47.text: 您還可以為每個被殺死的 Boss 獲得 20 積分，並為三個主要目標（阻止最初的攻擊、奪取所有登陸點以及佔領戰爭營地）中的每一個目標獲得 50 積分。 （這些獎金沒有記錄在目標中。）

fcb8571039331acdde1b76834d8ff0e7b65ae0da.source: Gates of Kryta mission not complete
fcb8571039331acdde1b76834d8ff0e7b65ae0da.text: 科瑞塔關所 任務未完成

4dae799088bdce330cce7c89cd6f332e49985eb5.source: Note: This quest is available to all nationalities, not just Tyria Tyrian (Prophecies) characters
4dae799088bdce330cce7c89cd6f332e49985eb5.text: 注意：此任務適用於所有國籍，而不僅僅是 泰瑞亞 Tyrian (阿斯卡隆戰記) 角色

07c10bb589fa4fb791aea52675b85ef0f6c69db4.source: Deliver the letter to Ambassador Braun.

8eca0e91ae99bcb13b8745c988f2fd8c2e14a6af.source: See Witness Casori for your reward.
8eca0e91ae99bcb13b8745c988f2fd8c2e14a6af.text: 見證人卡索裡以獲得獎勵。

ab2a6fb0f4d8eeeac1e46c16963fa1d740ca2dc8.source: After accepting the quest from Aidan, proceed through the portal to Scoundrel's Rise. Deliver Aidan's letter to Ambassador Braun, who will be waiting for you right outside, and he will direct you to the Gates of Kryta.
ab2a6fb0f4d8eeeac1e46c16963fa1d740ca2dc8.text: 接受 艾登 的任務後，透過傳送門前往 惡漢山丘。將 艾登 的信交給布勞恩大使，他將在外面等您，他將帶您前往 科瑞塔關所。

ce25b5b4e41851277e68cdcf9360254ce243b462.source: Several undead creatures will be scattered throughout Scoundrel's Rise, replacing many of its usual Mergoyle and Skale spawns. Stick to the southeastern side of the map as you head for the Gates of Kryta outpost, and you will only have to deal with single Zombie Warlocks and hidden groups of Grasping Ghouls, which should pose little threat to a party capable of fighting through Griffon's Mouth. Advance cautiously, since the ghouls often try to surprise you while you are engaging a different foe, and their Crippling Attack makes it difficult to retreat. Prioritize killing the Warlocks to prevent them from casting Death Nova and to avoid providing them with ghoul corpses to raise as minions. Illusion of Haste is a useful skill for mesmers trying to disengage from the ghouls, and other forms of condition removal are worth bringing.
ce25b5b4e41851277e68cdcf9360254ce243b462.text: 有些不死生物會分散在整個 惡漢山丘 中，取代許多常見的 石像魔 和 鱗怪 生成點。當你前往 科瑞塔關所 前哨站時，堅持地圖的東南側，你只需要對付單個殭屍術士和隱藏的抓握食屍鬼群體，這對有能力通過 獅鷲獸隘口 戰鬥的隊伍幾乎不構成威脅。小心前進，因為當你與不同的敵人交戰時，食屍鬼經常試圖給你一個驚喜，而他們的 致殘 攻擊讓你很難撤退。優先殺死術士，以防止他們施放 死亡新星，並避擴音供他們食屍鬼屍體培養小兵。 迅速幻象 對於試圖擺脫食屍鬼的催眠師來說是一項有用的技能，其他形式的狀態移除也值得攜帶。

e4b99d6e8c1996f6d3cb9339515f42d12468a482.source: Alternatively, you can enter Scoundrel's Rise, deliver the letter to Ambassador Braun, and immediately use the Griffon's Mouth portal to re-zone, eliminating the quest spawns from Scoundrel's Rise. This will mean that most of the enemies between you and the Gates of Kryta outpost will be groups of Mergoyle Wavebreakers, so be prepared to deal with Deep Freeze. This version of Scoundrel's Rise has no hidden foes.
e4b99d6e8c1996f6d3cb9339515f42d12468a482.text: 或者，您可以輸入 惡漢山丘，將信函交給布勞恩大使，然後立即使用 獅鷲獸隘口 入口網站重新分割槽，消除 惡漢山丘 中的任務產生。這意味著您和 科瑞塔關所 前哨站之間的大多數敵人將是 石像魔 破波者群，因此請做好應對 強力凍結 的準備。此版的 惡漢山丘 沒有隱藏的敵人。

d4c3e302f9a2a9c02ccae977d805dfc9354f179c.source: When you reach the Gates of Kryta, talk to Witness Casori to claim the reward.
d4c3e302f9a2a9c02ccae977d805dfc9354f179c.text: 當您到達 科瑞塔關所 時，與證人 Casori 交談以領取獎勵。

9c2866ce718d9699641458a8b17ead0313413837.source: Even though Ambassador Braun's dialogue suggests that he takes the letter and hands it back again, the item is not returned to your inventory. Simply talk to Witness Casori to complete the quest.
9c2866ce718d9699641458a8b17ead0313413837.text: 儘管布勞恩大使的對話表明他拿走了這封信並再次將其交還，但該物品不會返回到您的庫存中。只需與證人卡索裡交談即可完成任務。

12f965134d70f3c416b408bae51429ecf2caa7dc.source: Completing the preceding quest, To Kryta: The Ice Cave, is not required to take this quest, even for native characters. Unlike other Northern Shiverpeaks quests, this quest is available to characters from other campaigns, despite chronologically coming before the Ascalonians' arrival in Lion's Arch. Despite Braun's claims to hate the undead, he will heal any injured undead that come near him.
12f965134d70f3c416b408bae51429ecf2caa7dc.text: 即使是原生角色，也不需要完成前面的任務 往科瑞塔: 冰穴 來接受此任務。與其他 北席娃山脈 任務不同，此任務可供其他戰役中的角色使用，儘管按時間順序是在阿斯卡隆人到達 獅子拱門 之前進行的。儘管布勞恩聲稱憎恨不死生物，但他會治癒任何靠近他的受傷不死生物。

b550868cdfb9c027da4b66877ce0fa2577ad4fc0.source: Look for Lo Sha in Kinya Province.
b550868cdfb9c027da4b66877ce0fa2577ad4fc0.text: 在 欣彌領地 中尋找 羅夏。

42083a9fc47c3db98018aa24a1a9b3c49efb7b59.source: Travel northwest from Sujun through the mountains until you reach Kinya Province. Once there, go a short distance southwest and you will find Lo Sha.
42083a9fc47c3db98018aa24a1a9b3c49efb7b59.text: 從Sujun 向西北行駛，穿過山脈，直至到達欣彌領地。到達那裡後，向西南方向走一小段距離，您會發現 羅夏。

0ac677b5c4dee8ffc034f5def4ec3f559c56f580.text: 取回 羅夏 被偷的禮物。

539d49360f03c64b9f3059dd6d9b14200e4d5d95.source: See Lo Sha for your reward.
539d49360f03c64b9f3059dd6d9b14200e4d5d95.text: 請參閱 羅夏 以取得獎勵。

d21618868359087692a546701dd60990aa642469.source: Follow the marker to the camp, it's just south of the exit to Sunqua Vale. Kill all Crimson Skull, make sure to bring a full party for this purpose, henchmen will do. Open the chest. No key required. Then just bring back the box.
d21618868359087692a546701dd60990aa642469.text: 沿著標記前往營地，它位於 桑泉谷 出口的南邊。殺死所有 紅顱，確保為此目的帶上完整的隊伍，追隨者就可以了。開啟胸部。無需鑰匙。然後把盒子帶回來就好了。

f0b46b063b98d0f3dd97c7c28d0fd4234b3372af.source: Dragon Festival quests have been known to interfere with the completion of this quest.
f0b46b063b98d0f3dd97c7c28d0fd4234b3372af.text: 已知端午節任務會幹擾該任務的完成。

3d5394d084ab0995e6326856a5457cff2df8b705.source: Open your World Map (default: "M"), and click on Shing Jea Monastery. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into Linnok Courtyard. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it.
3d5394d084ab0995e6326856a5457cff2df8b705.text: 開啟您的世界地圖（預設值：“M”），然後點選 星岬寺。選擇旅行。現在向東退出，進入 裡諾庭園。 藤吾大師 可以在其中找到。

8d33735bf14ac39f3ff3825591ce8f612c1df733.source: The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one character. Once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession, whatever that may be. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the quests given by the characters you are sent to in these quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.
8d33735bf14ac39f3ff3825591ce8f612c1df733.text: 角色可以領取該任務的獎勵八次。每個職業一次。第一次將是你對職業的主要追求，無論是什麼。其他七次只是在選擇第二職業之前與每個職業的校長交談即可。完成他們的任務，以及這些任務中你被送到的角色給予的任務，最終會將其放入你的任務日誌中。

c33dc8e6b85270f0cd5298d8006581c07b0f250b.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Scoundrel's Rise and start the mission.
c33dc8e6b85270f0cd5298d8006581c07b0f250b.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 惡漢山丘 走進前哨站並開始任務。

ab9390ccd0206ac4e138542adad89d1c6db66bb8.source: Secure a safe place for your people to settle.
ab9390ccd0206ac4e138542adad89d1c6db66bb8.text: 為您的人民提供一個安全的定居點。

76ba5a0beb958bff3e40f817a397a817efd6e4c0.source: Make contact with the local authorities at Lion's Arch.
76ba5a0beb958bff3e40f817a397a817efd6e4c0.text: 請透過 獅子拱門 與地方政府聯絡。

3ef38d86be8bb8cb7f6d0aeef4dffe9a0845a955.source: Head south across the beach to find Justiciar Hablion.
3ef38d86be8bb8cb7f6d0aeef4dffe9a0845a955.text: 向南穿過海灘即可找到 判官哈布里恩。

98f1ec4d33d42c47f521869cf7a65321769097b0.source: Help Justiciar Hablion clear the swamp of undead.
98f1ec4d33d42c47f521869cf7a65321769097b0.text: 幫助 判官哈布里恩 清除不死生物沼澤。

881fae31b98ef4a7605225f32bf8dfe280e36b8b.source: *BONUS* Retrieve the Orrian text and have it translated.
881fae31b98ef4a7605225f32bf8dfe280e36b8b.text: *獎勵* 檢索 Orrian 文字並進行翻譯。

cbf6dfb7835cea04d62d49031d182fb01af1f984.source: Head south until you reach the village (point 2). To open the gate, you must defeat all the undead in the open area along the route. Once inside, speak to Justiciar Toriimo to open the southern exit from the village and head over the bridge at the beach.
cbf6dfb7835cea04d62d49031d182fb01af1f984.text: 向南行駛，直至到達村莊（點 2）。要開啟大門，你必須擊敗沿途空曠區域的所有不死生物。進入後，與Justiciar Toriimo交談，開啟村莊的南面出口，然後越過海灘上的橋。

285fe64202d1943bc77c30a32da8568c4c9e34b6.source: Follow the shore to the east and talk to Justiciar Hablion to trigger the first cinematic. Immediately afterwards, the White Mantle will rush forward to fight the undead. Players must ensure Hablion's survival or the mission will fail. After a while Hablion splits from the White Mantle troops, but the player must follow the group and keep killing the undead. Once all foes have been cleared, the second/final cinematic will trigger.
285fe64202d1943bc77c30a32da8568c4c9e34b6.text: 沿著海岸向東走，與 判官哈布里恩 交談以觸發第一個動畫。緊接著，白斗篷就會衝上前去與不死族戰鬥。玩家必須確保 Hablion 的生存，否則任務就會失敗。過了一會兒，哈布利恩從 白斗篷 部隊中分裂出來，但玩家必須跟隨這支部隊並繼續殺死不死生物。一旦所有敵人都被清除，第二個/最後一個過場動畫就會觸發。

7bc60ff163e93bf3b19a3854c0a07b00d8133e19.source: To increase the chance of success in keeping Hablion alive, you can simply not talk to him since you can complete the mission without him. While at it, if your party nearly wipes except for one player, that single survivor can return to Hablion; talking to him will trigger the first cinematic and result in your party's entire resurrection (at his location) which grants a second chance with the White Mantle reinforcements.
7bc60ff163e93bf3b19a3854c0a07b00d8133e19.text: 為了增加成功讓哈比利恩存活的機會，你可以簡單地不與他交談，因為沒有他你也可以完成任務。在此過程中，如果你的隊伍除了一名玩家之外幾乎全軍覆沒，那麼該倖存者可以返回哈布利恩；與他交談將觸發第一個動畫並導致你的隊伍完全復活（在他的位置），從而獲得 白斗篷 增援的第二次機會。

1b508957477533994fb68ce8000233dee17f9a4f.source: Alternatively you can take the "backway" in and finish the mission without triggering the cinematic and without risking Hablion getting killed. Coming back from retrieving the bonus Text and before leaving the beach (to the right), send one person back to collect bonus and the others stay left a little ways up the beach and then exit and up the ramp on the left. Join the main path and continue north and finish the mission.
1b508957477533994fb68ce8000233dee17f9a4f.text: 或者，你可以走「後路」並完成任務，而不會觸發過場動畫，也不會冒哈布利恩被殺的風險。取回獎金文字後，在離開海灘（右側）之前，派一個人回來收集獎金，其他人留在海灘上靠左一點的地方，然後退出並爬上左側的坡道。加入主路繼續向北完成任務。

0cc87cf3d5a7cc221554e6143aa222d034199387.source: Talk to the pig named Oink (point 1) to get it to follow you; lead it back to Cheswick (the owner) (point 2). Follow the water north from the beach until you find a chest (point 3) that contains the Orrian Text. Picking up the book will popup several Smoke Phantoms: these should only present a problem for lower-level parties. Along the way, you will encounter several more trigger points; again, fight rather than run. You get credit for the bonus when you return the text to the Orrian Historian McClain (point 2).
0cc87cf3d5a7cc221554e6143aa222d034199387.text: 與名叫 Oink 的豬（點 1）交談，讓它跟隨你；將其帶回 Cheswick（所有者）（點 2）。從海灘向北順水前進，直到找到一個包含 Orrian 文本的箱子（點 3）。拿起這本書會彈出幾個煙霧幻影：這些只會給較低階別的隊伍帶來問題。一路上，你會遇到更多的觸發點；再次，戰鬥而不是逃跑。當您將文字傳回 Orrian Historian McClain 時（點 2），您將獲得獎金。

51159ecbd1771b8ba64d59eb4a9cfca3f29e7e59.source: Alternatively, you can go straight to the chest (point 3) after getting Oink to follow you, bypassing both McClain and Cheswick. Oink will tank your enemies, allowing you to easily defeat them (the pig's damage output is next to nothing, but it is invincible to your enemies). (You could retrieve the book without Oink, but (a) he must be with you to get credit for the bonus and (b) you would lose his help along the way.) If Oink is not with your party, Orrian Historian McClain will still take the Orrian text; you have to return again with the pig to get credit.
51159ecbd1771b8ba64d59eb4a9cfca3f29e7e59.text: 或者，你可以在讓 Oink 跟隨你後直接前往寶箱（點 3），繞過 McClain 和 Cheswick。奧因克會坦克你的敵人，讓你輕鬆擊敗他們（豬的傷害輸出幾乎為零，但它對你的敵人來說是無敵的）。 （你可以在沒有奧因克的情況下取回這本書，但是（a）他必須和你在一起才能獲得獎金，（b）你會一路失去他的幫助。）如果奧因克不在你的隊伍中，奧裡安歷史學家麥克萊恩仍然會帶走奧裡安文本；你必須帶著豬再次返回才能獲得積分。

a8b2723521db39e11303fd4e1b93d0c82c5d569a.source: The White Mantle NPCs will die very quickly, so it is wiser to run ahead of them and clear a path to ensure Justiciar Hablion's survival.
a8b2723521db39e11303fd4e1b93d0c82c5d569a.text: 白斗篷 NPC 會很快死亡，因此明智的做法是跑在他們前面並清理道路以確保 判官哈布里恩 的生存。

e98c1571c88e3606acfc8673dae6159ff27d6e1b.source: Phantoms and skeletons are not fleshy, so they don't leave exploitable corpses and are immune to bleeding, disease, and poison.
e98c1571c88e3606acfc8673dae6159ff27d6e1b.text: 幻影和骷髏不是肉質的，因此它們不會留下可利用的屍體，並且免疫流血、疾病和毒藥。

1ea417a0d05518e8a9ce6b7b41fabeb1a3192d26.source: Most foes are undead and take double damage from Holy damage skills.
1ea417a0d05518e8a9ce6b7b41fabeb1a3192d26.text: 大多數敵人都是不死生物，會受到 神聖傷害 技能的雙倍傷害。

be3e849b4d110457b65cbc330c9b245406b3d85c.source: Heart of Holy Flame and Judge's Insight can make attacks deal holy damage.
be3e849b4d110457b65cbc330c9b245406b3d85c.text: 聖火之心 和 神之洞察 可以使攻擊造成神聖傷害。

82628d08c3c804a54a8c4c223179721f2b6848ac.source: Condition removal and hex removal skills, to counter Skeleton Mesmer's Ineptitude and Fragility.
82628d08c3c804a54a8c4c223179721f2b6848ac.text: 條件移除和十六進位移除技能，對抗骷髏幻術師的愚蠢和脆弱。

ba494d494c6f85d9448936675692a9340f2e5e05.source: Solo farming the entire Gates of Kryta mission is extremely popular for amassing large quantities of bones, dust, gold, runes, insignias, weapon upgrades, dye, and Decayed Orr Emblems (which have special collectors during Halloween and Wintersday), and to Power level.
ba494d494c6f85d9448936675692a9340f2e5e05.text: 單獨耕種整個 科瑞塔關所 任務非常受歡迎，因為可以累積大量骨頭、灰塵、黃金、符文、徽章、武器升級、染料和腐爛的 歐爾 徽章（在 激戰萬聖節 和 Wintersday 期間有特殊的收集器），並達到能量等級。

9a6145e7af799f93d9d4d4584f3f2ee9d49e9ebf.source: Behind the house where you find Oink, there's a small hidden path that leads up a hill then goes back down. There's a lone Hellhound but once you get closer a few popups Grasping Ghouls will spawn near it. Also, attacking the hellhound and killing it will cause more undead to appear.
9a6145e7af799f93d9d4d4584f3f2ee9d49e9ebf.text: 在你找到奧因克的房子後面，有一條隱藏的小路，通往一座小山，然後又往下走。有一個單獨的 地獄犬，但一旦你靠近，一些彈出視窗就會在它附近生成。另外，攻擊地獄犬並殺死它會導致更多的亡靈出現。

93e36cf020ec4f64955c026dd7adb398927045c3.source: If you take Oink with you, you can run back and the undead will crowd around Oink, but be stuck unable to attack him, allowing you to easily kill them in the meantime.
93e36cf020ec4f64955c026dd7adb398927045c3.text: 如果你帶著奧因克，你可以跑回去，不死生物會聚集在奧因克周圍，但無法攻擊他，讓你同時輕鬆殺死他們。

7881a40ff809f8cd40d304b34e611e0ee40ea089.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Lion's Arch.
7881a40ff809f8cd40d304b34e611e0ee40ea089.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 獅子拱門。

a567cea14bcb57fab634be02414e090e37fe8eaa.source: Though it is implied, it is not explicitly stated that the mission is failed if Justiciar Hablion dies.
a567cea14bcb57fab634be02414e090e37fe8eaa.text: 雖然是暗示的，但並沒有明確指出如果 判官哈布里恩 死亡，任務就會失敗。

257d4ad6c33b71596d6539e0ac39efb2257e560f.source: If you are having trouble keeping Hablion alive, you can bypass his dialogue and avoid activating him; travel via the water up the other side.
257d4ad6c33b71596d6539e0ac39efb2257e560f.text: 如果你無法讓哈比利恩存活，你可以繞過他的對話並避免啟動他；透過水到達另一邊。

b07e81f3ce685ec3924b6dd10b1f524b0b391c26.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 1.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
b07e81f3ce685ec3924b6dd10b1f524b0b391c26.text: 完成此任務的探索大約為 Tyrian 版圖 標題貢獻了 1.4%。

f1cf1a1e5d0d8ec0941c3b902fb84a5dd58572f1.source: Players looking for the cartographer title can find a hidden path behind the house where Oink is found.
f1cf1a1e5d0d8ec0941c3b902fb84a5dd58572f1.text: 尋找製圖師頭銜的玩家可以在發現奧因克的房子後面找到一條隱藏的小路。

fe983da60860e5a11f68ed27ee5ec829edebf71a.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #8 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
fe983da60860e5a11f68ed27ee5ec829edebf71a.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#8 頁。

e4a2e886f904acf5e3be53bf8fbb100fa237879a.source: In their dialogue, Josephine repeats the Merchant's last line. Some elements of the dialogue in the White Mantle encampment seem to happen in the wrong order, with one character lagging behind the other. After you return Oink to Cheswick, Orrian Historian McClain will tell you that there is a shipwreck to the southwest, even though it is northeast.
e4a2e886f904acf5e3be53bf8fbb100fa237879a.text: 在他們的對話中，約瑟芬重複了 雜貨商人 的最後一行。 白斗篷 營地中的某些對話元素似乎以錯誤的順序發生，一個角色落後於另一個角色。當你將奧因克送回切西克後，奧裡安歷史學家麥克萊恩會告訴你西南方向有一艘沉船，儘管它是在東北方向。

d6e335bca51a273447c8d457383089dff9fa1a96.source: de:Tore von Kryta (Mission) fr:Portes de Kryte (Mission en mode coopératif)
d6e335bca51a273447c8d457383089dff9fa1a96.text: de:Tore von 科瑞塔 (主線任務) fr:Portes de Kryte (主線任務 en mode coopératif)

2cfbc37162208a808ef0f8a456a6742913c35de7.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh.
2cfbc37162208a808ef0f8a456a6742913c35de7.text: 所有黨員都必須接受《時辰臨近》的獎勵。

a109bef659d7d28b8f4d4682d94a7260ad8ad0a3.source: Dunkoro must be present in the party.

c40e97ac2bf53964d8015f3c2b702f398d704ada.source: Unite the western and southern attack fronts.
c40e97ac2bf53964d8015f3c2b702f398d704ada.text: 聯合西部和南部進攻戰線。

7f6234fbe3050f6b96fb6003ea5bac123d1488a0.source: ADDED: Defeat the Kournan Gate Captain to prevent him from summoning Kournan troops.
7f6234fbe3050f6b96fb6003ea5bac123d1488a0.text: 新增：擊敗庫爾南門隊長以阻止他召喚庫爾南軍隊。

4833bfe9bae58b8d02e949ee7d285472bf0f9bb3.source: ADDED: Kill the siege engineers manning the firespitters to clear the way for the southern attack front.
4833bfe9bae58b8d02e949ee7d285472bf0f9bb3.text: 補充：殺死操縱噴火者的攻城工兵，為南部進攻前線掃清道路。

b3aa21f143f62088f790d1c2eb9a826181ad826a.source: ADDED: Capture the Kournan bombard to gain entrance to the heart of Gandara.
