b3aa21f143f62088f790d1c2eb9a826181ad826a.text: 新增：捕獲庫南轟炸機以進入甘達拉的中心。

f36d197a248fe87326cdc4c880b14ce5ee5d6c13.source: ADDED: Rally the attack force outside the Plaza of the Five Gods.
f36d197a248fe87326cdc4c880b14ce5ee5d6c13.text: 新增：在五神廣場外集結攻擊力量。

03a175a1c2be0ecf9533357789a90fb2f901884b.source: *BONUS* Eliminate the Kournan field marshal groups.
03a175a1c2be0ecf9533357789a90fb2f901884b.text: *獎勵*消滅庫爾南陸軍元帥小組。

c1ec64a11d560047dbf0f640611bda4d126b9cf8.source: You have [3...0] of 3 Kournan field marshal groups remaining.
c1ec64a11d560047dbf0f640611bda4d126b9cf8.text: 您還剩下 [3...0] 個 3 Kournan 元帥組。

c948abfc9e65c6c2d8153739338dd5bbd1999015.source: To gain the bonus rewards, your party has to kill three additional Kournan Field Commanders and their groups. These Commanders make use of a skill called Kournan Siege, which deals massive damage and also interrupts actions.
c948abfc9e65c6c2d8153739338dd5bbd1999015.text: 為了獲得額外獎勵，你的隊伍必須殺死另外三名庫爾南戰地指揮官及其團隊。這些指揮官使用一種名為“庫爾南圍攻”的技能，該技能會造成巨大傷害並打斷行動。

549a95163d11b20181ae9f7a388529ebdc810af8.source: The first is near mission start, at the top left stairs and before Captain Lumanda.
549a95163d11b20181ae9f7a388529ebdc810af8.text: 第一個是在任務開始附近，在左上方樓梯處，盧曼達隊長之前。

428d0394e2e5e3e65c75bf6230ddce48f1131bb7.source: The second is situated past the Kournan bombard weapon and can be found after the cinematic but before Captain Mwende.
428d0394e2e5e3e65c75bf6230ddce48f1131bb7.text: 第二個位於庫南（Kournan）轟炸武器後面，可以在過場動畫之後、姆文德上尉之前找到。

831f86a63464d3f86247210be1d51b15d9dd16c4.source: The third and final is after Captain Mwende but before the Plaza of the Five Gods. Do not proceed to engage Varesh; instead, detour northeast to find them, otherwise you might accidentally finish the mission before you're able to complete the bonus.
831f86a63464d3f86247210be1d51b15d9dd16c4.text: 第三個也是最後一個是在姆文德船長之後、五神廣場之前。不要繼續與 Varesh 交戰；相反，繞道東北去找他們，否則你可能會在完成獎勵之前意外完成任務。

fd3e6cb706c3b3fcf54021bb971b6df9e61c33a8.source: The first Field Commander or the Kournan Spotter may spawn beyond the closed gate. If you do not have any ranged spell attacks, you may need to restart the mission to get the Master's reward. You can also try to kill it if he is next to the closed gate (leave the area then return).
fd3e6cb706c3b3fcf54021bb971b6df9e61c33a8.text: 第一個 Field 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) 或 Kournan Spotter 可能會在關閉的大門之外產生。如果你沒有任何遠端法術攻擊，你可能需要重新開始任務才能獲得大師的獎勵。如果他在關閉的門旁邊，你也可以嘗試殺死它（離開該區域然後返回）。

134e6f2f1e0285d4e6c72361ac0708f36a6c602a.source: Avoid over-aggro especially around the main gate and third Field Commander.
134e6f2f1e0285d4e6c72361ac0708f36a6c602a.text: 避免過度仇恨，尤其是在主門和第三場 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) 周圍。

02af4e214b7ab8e79c9b0569656154cb3572653f.source: Skills that remove stances, bypass blocking or punish blocking to counter the Whirling Defense skill used by the Kournan Bowmen.
02af4e214b7ab8e79c9b0569656154cb3572653f.text: 移除姿態、繞過格擋或懲罰格擋的技能，以對抗庫南弓箭手使用的 旋風防禦 技能。

17a8e37537755de551e8e86c1dbf48b48c5a9bc4.source: Skills which defend against ranged attacks (e.g., "Shields Up!"), or provide damage reduction over time (e.g., Shielding Hands).
17a8e37537755de551e8e86c1dbf48b48c5a9bc4.text: 防禦遠端攻擊的技能（例如，“護盾！”），或隨著時間的推移提供傷害減少（例如，防禦之手）。

9d412c95006776ad6fb0d51cae9715d5b5bcc0f1.source: All foes are fleshy, so there will be many corpses for minion masters; Lonai is also a minion master.
9d412c95006776ad6fb0d51cae9715d5b5bcc0f1.text: 所有敵人都是肉質的，所以小兵大師的屍體會很多；洛奈也是一名隨從大師。

7734317bbfc93aae5ce90f6081476708addfc244.source: Enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to enchantment removal by Kournan Oppressors and Seers.
7734317bbfc93aae5ce90f6081476708addfc244.text: 基於 加持魔法 的建置很容易被庫南壓迫者和先知移除結界。

e8a5415c56efd3dd0eb4170b182de862311285ac.source: Hex removal skills could be unnecessary; the only hex spells your party will encounter are Enchanter's Conundrum (the hex that is applied has no impact if your party does not use enchantments) and Life Siphon (ends when its caster dies).
e8a5415c56efd3dd0eb4170b182de862311285ac.text: 去除六角形的技能可能是不必要的；你的隊伍將遇到的唯一十六進位制咒語是附魔者之謎（如果你的隊伍不使用結界，則應用的十六進位制沒有影響）和吸取生命（當其施法者死亡時結束）。

d7546c7506631546d254de73d1e41ac75245e72c.source: Kormir follows the party leader, never attacks and rarely uses skills except for "Incoming!". Foes cannot target her but she does take damage from area of effect skills.
d7546c7506631546d254de73d1e41ac75245e72c.text: 科米爾跟隨隊伍領袖，從不攻擊，也很少使用除“來襲！”之外的技能。敵人無法瞄準她，但她確實會受到範圍技能的傷害。

ee000c4be274c21650ec1ee917700c55a4ee44dc.source: Firespitters will kill allies immediately, but it does not count as a death.
ee000c4be274c21650ec1ee917700c55a4ee44dc.text: 噴火者會立即殺死盟友，但這不算死亡。

d892d13d929fbc7403fd5dcc3b749f9959ceb7fa.source: As mentioned in the walkthrough, if you attempt to take the narrow passage between the firespitters and the wall, Nerashi, Rojis, and Lonai can become stuck and not follow you. This can be indicated by their names becoming gray in your Party Members list when you've run too far away. If this is the case, go back, regroup with them, and take the path around the wall.
d892d13d929fbc7403fd5dcc3b749f9959ceb7fa.text: 正如演練中提到的，如果你試圖通過噴火者和牆壁之間的狹窄通道，奈拉什、羅吉斯和洛奈可能會被卡住而無法跟隨你。當您跑得太遠時，他們的名字在您的 隊伍 成員列表中會變成灰色，這表明了這一點。如果是這樣的話，就回去和他們重新集合，沿著圍牆的小路走。

8eafaeb720a5c3ad11b79b6db5a60455ea879399.source: After this mission, nearly every single enemy has an elite skill.
8eafaeb720a5c3ad11b79b6db5a60455ea879399.text: 在這次任務之後，幾乎每個敵人都擁有了精英技能。

c2ba9a8f9197afed219f7d589539458588ee2cd1.source: After the completion of this mission for the first time, Koss will become unavailable until the completion of The Great Escape quest.
c2ba9a8f9197afed219f7d589539458588ee2cd1.text: 第一次完成此任務後，寇斯 將變得無法使用，直到 大逃亡 任務完成為止。

c7fbf2f8f15b1a2bd40950db9b9b5c107f570487.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Yohlon Haven.
c7fbf2f8f15b1a2bd40950db9b9b5c107f570487.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 猶朗避難所。

a5c29f5cafa1bfae442bf342e146ba84c67b9ed8.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #1 in the Night Falls storybook.
a5c29f5cafa1bfae442bf342e146ba84c67b9ed8.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#1 頁。

4b4a479ef83db16a44dd0656acfe6f5862a94e71.source: Seek out Headmaster Vhang in the monastery.
4b4a479ef83db16a44dd0656acfe6f5862a94e71.text: 在修道院裡尋找 Vhang 校長。

d6cb46d0744fb91216b0f533f1ea4faf9549b115.text: 搜尋 桑泉谷 以尋找 Ronsu。

b3032f797914c246e1720aa2c97d0bbf81731213.source: Headmaster Vhang teaches you the following skills upon accepting the quest:
b3032f797914c246e1720aa2c97d0bbf81731213.text: Vhang校長在接受任務後會教你以下技能：

b70bdfcd79b92ffb0ab7dccd44e367dd1be6b9fa.source: Ronsu can be found in the southern parts of Sunqua Vale, not far from the water.
b70bdfcd79b92ffb0ab7dccd44e367dd1be6b9fa.text: Ronsu 位於 桑泉谷 的南部，離水不遠。

5e398dcd5bf8d2094231fe02219b7aaea978dd83.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from North Kryta Province and start the mission.
5e398dcd5bf8d2094231fe02219b7aaea978dd83.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 科瑞塔北部 走進前哨站並開始任務。

d8cd9f77b04abd0f3accc3bfeb756b1c74727bbf.source: Lend aid to the White Mantle in their fight against the undead.
d8cd9f77b04abd0f3accc3bfeb756b1c74727bbf.text: 為 白斗篷 提供援助，幫助他們對抗不死族。

065beebfe4079fd1835d5700ae98e5e954711d09.source: Hurry to the Temple of Tolerance.

d38f0fb45b4910ab544335bea3d9332f95937768.source: Discuss the undead menace with Confessor Dorian.
d38f0fb45b4910ab544335bea3d9332f95937768.text: 與 大主教多利安 討論不死族的威脅。

78da5361a18a820e3cb336280036ce0a8a76367d.source: ADDED: Clear out the undead from the village of Hakewood.
78da5361a18a820e3cb336280036ce0a8a76367d.text: 新增：清除哈克伍德村的亡靈。

129cf64b6d418dfb9b42bc0ff41de6bdbf6e0063.source: ADDED: Protect Confessor Dorian from the undead.
129cf64b6d418dfb9b42bc0ff41de6bdbf6e0063.text: 新增：保護 大主教多利安 免受不死生物的侵害。

e2b8632a4aa1fca1570390b60b2c757d507e9cd2.source: ADDED: Head to the southwest. Locate Dinas and the Scepter of Orr.
e2b8632a4aa1fca1570390b60b2c757d507e9cd2.text: 補充：前往西南方向。找出 戴納斯 和 歐爾 的權杖。

5658b6e732a6c9358a9954b7918daf810d4af14f.source: *BONUS* Deliver the village's offering intact to the statue of Melandru.
5658b6e732a6c9358a9954b7918daf810d4af14f.text: *獎勵* 將村莊的祭品完好無損地送到 梅蘭朵 的雕像上。

370e112f233cb59910d57418dfb37a10f7a22aaf.source: Follow the path until the nearby village (point 1 on the map) and eliminate all the undead there. You do not need to save any of the villagers, but a morale boost is gained each time you do. If you wish to complete the bonus, Benji Makala must survive.
370e112f233cb59910d57418dfb37a10f7a22aaf.text: 沿著路徑一直走到附近的村莊（地圖上的1點）並消滅那裡的所有亡靈。你不需要拯救任何村民，但每次你這樣做都會鼓舞士氣。如果你想完成獎勵，本吉·馬卡拉必須活下來。

ecf41b769f01d5745301c025b132284e54672239.source: If ignoring the bonus, simply speak to the Gate Guard then travel through the swamp to the west.
ecf41b769f01d5745301c025b132284e54672239.text: 如果忽略獎勵，只需與門衛交談，然後穿過沼澤向西行進。

bd4cba3fbba4e4528b35280b94ee2ca9a753c77e.source: If going for the bonus, you have to take the path north instead (yellow on the map), behind Gate Guard Makala, and open the lever-operated door at the end to catch up with the initial path to the Temple of Tolerance (point A).
bd4cba3fbba4e4528b35280b94ee2ca9a753c77e.text: 如果要獲得獎勵，你必須走北邊的路徑（地圖上的黃色），在門衛馬卡拉後面，開啟末端的槓桿門，趕上通往寬容神廟的最初路徑（A點）。

51c38c160413017e5563dee9310081c6997a34ac.source: Upon arrival, Confessor Dorian is added to your party and the battle will begin against several waves of undead. There is a Shrine of Mending that provides +3 health regeneration to living creatures in its area of effect. After waves of skeletons and ghouls, a quest marker appears above Dorian, and one final wave of enemies will spawn 3–4 minutes later. Dorian instructs the player to retrieve the Scepter of Orr from his scribe Dinas, located further to the west. However, Dorian may still die if left alone, causing mission failure. It is highly recommended to stay and protect him from that final wave before heading to Dinas (and/or doing the bonus).
51c38c160413017e5563dee9310081c6997a34ac.text: 抵達後，大主教多利安 將被新增到您的隊伍中，戰鬥將開始對抗幾波不死生物。有一個 癒合 神殿，可以為其影響區域內的生物提供 +3 健康再生。在一波又一波的骷髏和食屍鬼之後，多利安上方會出現一個任務標記，最後一波敵人將在幾分鐘後生成 3–4。 Dorian 指示玩家從位於較西邊的抄寫員 戴納斯 取回 歐爾 的權杖。然而，如果任由多里安獨自一人的話，仍有可能死亡，導致任務失敗。強烈建議在前往 戴納斯（和/或進行獎勵）之前留下來保護他免受最後一波攻擊。

cf87e4374d1d22b1640f6e795558e20eb26d9888.source: Follow the ettin infested path to Dinas (who might be fighting a boss) and speak to him to end the mission.
cf87e4374d1d22b1640f6e795558e20eb26d9888.text: 沿著埃丁出沒的道路前往 戴納斯（他可能正在與 Boss 戰鬥）並與他交談以結束任務。

d67fed831719d260343996e57fe1ef8bb867ba80.source: The bonus involves carrying the Offering to Melandru (point 3) to the offering stand (point 4). Since the bridge from the pick-up point to the drop-off point is broken, you have to go the long way around it, through the temple.
d67fed831719d260343996e57fe1ef8bb867ba80.text: 獎金涉及將產品運送到 梅蘭朵（點 3）到產品攤位（點 4）。由於從上車點到下車點的橋都壞了，你必須繞橋繞很長一段路，穿過寺廟。

ca0d30206cea3ccfc998ea4c1bbd28c3af317c9c.source: First at the settlement, ensure Benji survives from the boss that spawns near him. Run straight towards him once he is added as ally to the party window.
ca0d30206cea3ccfc998ea4c1bbd28c3af317c9c.text: 首先在定居點，確保本吉從他附近生成的 Boss 中倖存下來。一旦他被加入為隊伍視窗的盟友，跑過 就會直接朝他走去。

7cebfc48dc0bab7836b5b20835010e7d3c71e797.source: If having troubles, consider using a speed boost or alternatively flag heroes or henchmen ahead, as the boss will only start attacking the NPC when a player enters compass range. Note that this technique can be used for the bonus in the following mission (Divinity Coast) as well.
7cebfc48dc0bab7836b5b20835010e7d3c71e797.text: 如果遇到麻煩，請考慮使用速度提升，或標記前方的英雄或追隨者，因為只有當玩家進入羅盤範圍時，Boss 才會開始攻擊 NPC。請注意，此技術也可用於以下任務（神聖海岸）中的獎勵。

46ecf840d8849e4822fb21a8d23afc2a1b4c0cfb.source: After the boss is killed, you can trigger the bonus from Benji immediately (a green marker appears above his head), however you still have to ensure he survives the entire assault, protecting him again on his way to the Shrine of Mending, as Gate Guard Makala (point 2) will not let you pass through the north gate until the village is cleared and his brother safe. Be careful not to overaggro, especially Zombie Warlocks and their minions.
46ecf840d8849e4822fb21a8d23afc2a1b4c0cfb.text: Boss被殺死後，你可以立即觸發Benji的獎勵（他的頭頂上會出現一個綠色標記），但是你仍然必須確保他在整個攻擊中倖存，並在他前往癒合神殿的途中再次保護他，因為門衛Makala（點2）不會讓你通過北門，直到村莊被清理乾淨並且他的兄弟安全為止。小心不要過度仇恨，尤其是殭屍術士和他們的爪牙。

2fc43725a951bd33af582f49bce96c8a3f87d5d0.source: At the end of the northern path (yellow on the map), a swamp populated by undead, you will reach the Offering and a door operated by a lever that connects to the main path.
2fc43725a951bd33af582f49bce96c8a3f87d5d0.text: 在北邊小路的盡頭（地圖上的黃色），這是一片充滿不死生物的沼澤，你將到達祭品和一扇由連線到主路的槓桿操作的門。

c9b1da5f0dca0645a3203c5a3789eedb7239cb5d.source: The offering in itself is a bundle item. As such, it will slow you down and prevent you from using your weapons while carried. If dropped, the offering will break, requiring you to return and retrieve another one.
c9b1da5f0dca0645a3203c5a3789eedb7239cb5d.text: 該產品本身就是一個捆綁專案。因此，它會減慢你的速度並阻止你在攜帶時使用武器。如果掉落，該產品將會損壞，需要您返回並取回另一件。

671a9720765e1d3ff673cd2facd19340f00b0e87.text: 黑暗逆襲 烈陽之矛元帥集團被擊敗 0 - 1   2   3   0 - 1   2   3   10   10   10   60   60   60

cb024b4b1c8cf400a205bceda1a43bf289bbbcdc.source: For this mission only, all party members will be buffed with Sunspear Battle Call, which increases maximum health and armor (but not attribute points) to the equivalent of a level 20 character. An effect that helps low level characters/heroes to get through the mission more easily.
cb024b4b1c8cf400a205bceda1a43bf289bbbcdc.text: 僅對於此任務，所有隊伍成員都將獲得陽矛戰鬥召喚的增益，這會將最大生命值和護甲值（但不是屬性點）提高到相當於 20 角色等級。幫助低等級角色/英雄更輕鬆完成任務的效果。

e05bfc690b3fb6a5a16b32fbc0348e3902025133.source: Leave the boat and start to attack. You will encounter several Kournan Bowmen, who tend to focus their arrows on one single target, making them deadly to unprepared players. Spellcaster characters should try to attack them from behind walls to cover from their projectiles.
e05bfc690b3fb6a5a16b32fbc0348e3902025133.text: 離開船開始攻擊。你會遇到幾名庫南弓箭手，他們傾向於將箭集中在一個目標上，這對於毫無準備的玩家來說是致命的。施法者角色應該嘗試從牆後攻擊他們，以躲避他們的彈頭。

0e5b2200ffa99463d04fe2bdd01c2532e4a9dfa1.source: Once you've killed the archers, go down to the western gate guarded by Captain Lumanda who is able to call in reinforcements and get rid of him to prevent additional Kournan soldier spawns.
0e5b2200ffa99463d04fe2bdd01c2532e4a9dfa1.text: 殺死弓箭手後，前往由盧曼達隊長守衛的西門，他可以呼叫增援並除掉他，以防止出現更多的庫南士兵。

f98501210340a9f8139166387921ad55cc59b62f.source: In the next area, your reinforcements will be obstructed by two firespitters. Kill the Kournan Engineers and their groups to turn them off and reform the army by speaking to Nerashi. Make sure your allies do not remain stuck behind ground obstacles (or you will lose offense).
f98501210340a9f8139166387921ad55cc59b62f.text: 在下一個區域，你的援軍將被兩個噴火者阻擋。殺死庫南工程師和他們的團隊，讓他們失望，並透過與奈拉什交談來改革軍隊。確保你的盟友不會被困在地面障礙物後面（否則你將失去進攻能力）。

d089584607f58ec69e5604f445768c2aeac255c3.source: Continue forward, killing Kournans to capture the bombard which can be used to breach the fortress. Captain Mwende and four Elite Kournans will be stationed behind the gate.
d089584607f58ec69e5604f445768c2aeac255c3.text: 繼續前進，殺死庫爾南斯以奪取可用於攻破堡壘的砲彈。 Mwende 隊長和四名 精英 Kournan 人員將駐紮在大門後面。

079bce8269776456e38c71871e60eed386b5aee8.source: Climb the stairs to reach the Plaza of the Five Gods, where Varesh is trapped by the invasion to finish the mission.
079bce8269776456e38c71871e60eed386b5aee8.text: 爬上樓梯到達五神廣場，瓦雷什被困在那裡完成任務。

ce9b0d4e88a17af6e4c136d7e57056784b96dc2b.source: At this point you have to make a choice. You can choose to take the offering first, ignoring its drawbacks, or proceed with the mission objectives first, clear the path and come back to the Offering later. The first choice is usually faster since you avoid backtracking, while the second choice is safer.
ce9b0d4e88a17af6e4c136d7e57056784b96dc2b.text: 此時你必須做出選擇。你可以選擇先接受奉獻，忽略其缺點，或先完成任務目標，掃清道路，稍後再回到奉獻。第一個選擇通常會更快，因為您可以避免回溯，而第二個選擇則更安全。

0062e6e4868d077b15269af40b2c546af44dd94f.source: Many foes will gather around Dorian before you have time to reach him. It is recommended to proceed directly to the temple and protect him first (ignoring the Grasping Ghouls; they will stop to fight the White Mantle Guard).
0062e6e4868d077b15269af40b2c546af44dd94f.text: 在你有時間接近多里安之前，許多敵人就會聚集在他周圍。建議直接前往寺廟並先保護他（忽略抓握食屍鬼；他們會停下來與白斗篷守衛戰鬥）。

995557ad909562ed52bbbb9bcb268a0f818b2f30.source: Holy damage is doubled against undead.
995557ad909562ed52bbbb9bcb268a0f818b2f30.text: 神聖傷害 對抗不死生物時加倍。

a1a0b732f5d8eb048d2fcf4a9b796021f5986520.source: Smiting Prayers skills dealing such damage, notably Ray of Judgment, Signet of Judgment, Smite Hex and Smite Condition, are effective.
a1a0b732f5d8eb048d2fcf4a9b796021f5986520.text: 造成此類傷害的 懲戒祈禱 技能，特別是 制裁目光、制裁紋章、降咒懲戒 和 懲戒 條件，是有效的。

7497c207dc5a5273da7f29eb8c5b5fcc7bc1e056.source: Judge's Insight and Heart of Holy Flame can temporarily change attacks' damage type to holy.
7497c207dc5a5273da7f29eb8c5b5fcc7bc1e056.text: 神之洞察和聖火之心可以暫時將攻擊的傷害型別改為神聖。

c09199a8de98f1821c6c712659f3c0d97751e39d.source: The undead's strategy revolves around conditions to trigger Fragility and "Victory is Mine!". Condition removal is effective as well as skills that benefit from conditions. Here are the details of conditions :
c09199a8de98f1821c6c712659f3c0d97751e39d.text: 亡靈的策略圍繞著觸發 脆弱 和「勝利是我的！」的條件。條件去除和受益於條件的技能一樣有效。以下是條件詳情：

f341e0173fa6cfb70d7afd0e71f023c244032f7f.source: Skeleton Rangers can inflict bleeding and poison;
f341e0173fa6cfb70d7afd0e71f023c244032f7f.text: 骷髏 遊騎兵可以造成流血和中毒；

5682d7102d8c6c155e8abfbc62f43fc9969d360a.source: Skeleton Sorcerers can inflict blind and cracked Armor;
5682d7102d8c6c155e8abfbc62f43fc9969d360a.text: 骷髏 巫師可以造成失明和破碎的 防禦；

ded511afb1d396428a874323b89b7d833d5b6dba.text: 殭屍術士可以造成毒害；

9478331302984e2c95de11cd90fac8cde1b8fb92.source: Skeleton Mesmers can inflict deep wound and blind (only in Hard Mode);
9478331302984e2c95de11cd90fac8cde1b8fb92.text: 骷髏 幻術師可造成深傷和失明（僅在困難模式下）；

736b4fd1f06e8f20c3b8fbbb3f1c21f3cdfff1bc.text: 抓握食屍鬼會造成殘廢。

e429cb736d7f9aa51b416969a486bdf1746669bd.source: Corpse control is effective against Zombie Warlocks. Well of Silence works well as it denies the use of "Victory is Mine!".
e429cb736d7f9aa51b416969a486bdf1746669bd.text: 屍體控制對殭屍術士有效。 靜寂之池 效果很好，因為它拒絕使用「勝利是我的！」。

75f949a7129f04239508c02c0a078f7835c7208c.source: Wells, notably Well of Power and Well of Blood, and Wards, notably Ward Against Elements and Ward Against Harm, are helpful when defending Dorian.
75f949a7129f04239508c02c0a078f7835c7208c.text: Wells，尤其是 魔力之池 和 血之池，以及 Ward，特別是 元素結界 和 守護結界，在防守 Dorian 時很有幫助。

afeb34dccf677b12a319d8f1179fe98d65efff00.source: The Skeleton Sorcerers are the biggest threat with their ability to inflict blind, their high AoE damage and knockdown. In addition to the aforementioned wards, Ward of Stability can be used to protect against Earthquake, while "Can't Touch This!" can be used against Lightning Touch. Interrupts work well too.
afeb34dccf677b12a319d8f1179fe98d65efff00.text: 骷髏 巫師是最大的威脅，因為他們能夠造成致盲、範圍性 高傷害和擊倒。除了上述防護之外，穩定結界 還可用於防禦 地震，而「Can't Touch This!」則可用於防禦 地震。可用來對抗 閃電之觸。中斷也能很好地工作。

b9ef8e00c5fec0d2c0a984c6825831a6d680b55f.source: Enchantment removal can be effective to remove Death Nova and Vengeance.
b9ef8e00c5fec0d2c0a984c6825831a6d680b55f.text: 加持魔法 刪除可以有效刪除 死亡新星 和 復仇意志。

3fc6cfec34312dba74f119bb44055e2e2a0d92fb.source: Hex removal against the skeleton mesmers and skales.
3fc6cfec34312dba74f119bb44055e2e2a0d92fb.text: 針對骷髏催眠師和骷髏的六角移除。

b9ae7c32456f04b2b5a7aca259789402153b9414.source: Hexes are less effective as Skeleton Mesmers and Monks carry Shatter Hex and Smite Hex respectively. On the opposite, none of the foes carry condition removal, so conditions are effective.
b9ae7c32456f04b2b5a7aca259789402153b9414.text: 由於 骷髏 幻術師和武士分別攜帶 降咒粉碎 和 降咒懲戒，因此十六進位效果較差。相反，沒有一個敵人具有條件移除功能，因此條件有效。

fa5196245ca4946f2f5f09b3d757644160717212.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.47% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. (This area can be explored without interference by foes after completing the War in Kryta and speaking to Jiaju Tai in Lion's Arch. This only works if you have no Wanted quests in your quest log.)
fa5196245ca4946f2f5f09b3d757644160717212.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.47% 的貢獻。 （完成 科瑞塔戰爭 並在 獅子拱門 中與 加貝泰 對話後，可以在不受敵人幹擾的情況下探索該區域。只有當您的任務日誌中沒有通緝任務時，這才有效。）

754b3408ebeb9a046c095aa140941342171d0e1e.source: If you pull aggro to the Gate Guard and he dies, the gate will automatically open without needing to kill the undead. However, the enemies still need to be cleared if you want to complete the bonus.
754b3408ebeb9a046c095aa140941342171d0e1e.text: 如果你將仇恨拉向門衛並且他死了，門會自動開啟，不需要殺死不死生物。然而，如果你想完成獎勵，仍然需要清除敵人。

866c5713313adcadcae7c85fc0be6a8fc06b9898.source: Unlike other statues of Melandru, the statue of Melandru in this mission doesn't appear differently with Favor of the Gods active.
866c5713313adcadcae7c85fc0be6a8fc06b9898.text: 與其他 梅蘭朵 雕像不同，此任務中的 梅蘭朵 雕像在眾神的眷顧啟動時看起來並沒有什麼不同。

7034465493e3123cf1f35fc678b00666fa0c69a6.source: In rare cases, a Lynx can spawn on the broken bridge.
7034465493e3123cf1f35fc678b00666fa0c69a6.text: 在極少數情況下，山貓 可能會在斷橋上產生。

1b4ef7a827dbd048b6eeb2b3bbbc6b4ddd397bb8.source: Contrary to the mission objective, it is not necessary to speak to Confessor Dorian. Keeping him alive and speaking to Dinas is sufficient to complete the mission.
1b4ef7a827dbd048b6eeb2b3bbbc6b4ddd397bb8.text: 與任務目標相反，沒有必要與 大主教多利安 對話。讓他活著並與 戴納斯 交談就足以完成任務。

3248b0c7578678d54ea12f5fe88b11ba36cebf18.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #1 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
3248b0c7578678d54ea12f5fe88b11ba36cebf18.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#1 頁。

eaf90df8745cee0081c2bd5ee77fc7b441127dea.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Divinity Coast.
eaf90df8745cee0081c2bd5ee77fc7b441127dea.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 神聖海岸。

f4363d28111fbb719f71bcf4df3d590a5ac20955.source: Talk to Zudash Dejarin about a place for the Sunspears to hide.
f4363d28111fbb719f71bcf4df3d590a5ac20955.text: 與祖達什·德賈林討論烈陽之矛隊的藏身之處。

c952a969188fc2b1d6426d6926cb6c5f1259eed1.source: Journey to Ronjok and ask Elder Jonah about a sanctuary for the sundered Sunspears.
c952a969188fc2b1d6426d6926cb6c5f1259eed1.text: 前往 羅鳩村 並向喬納長老詢問有關為四分五裂的烈陽之矛隊建造避難所的資訊。

f4897867c4499076e758a89c32590c24e8b5b085.source: Speak with Guardsman Bahsi to gain access to the underground complex.
f4897867c4499076e758a89c32590c24e8b5b085.text: 與衛兵巴西交談以進入地下建築群。

c3f938ac83afa3ccbe0ef17308c4036ce96dbb2c.source: Clear the area of monsters and establish a Sunspear Command Post.
c3f938ac83afa3ccbe0ef17308c4036ce96dbb2c.text: 清除區域內的怪物並建立陽矛 指揮所。

a929809ef80a756a8e0b4516e53c7d60ba55517f.source: After talking to Zudash Dejarin, enter Marga Coast and head towards the village of Ronjok. Follow the quest marker to Elder Jonah (point J on the quest map). He will instruct you to speak with Guardsman Bahsi (point B). Speak to Guardsman Bahsi in order to enter Secure the Refuge, a mini-mission version of the Sunspear Sanctuary. Inside, you must kill the 5 groups of insects to trigger the cutscene and finish the quest. There are a few Bladed Veldt Termite patrols running around, but you are not required to kill them. After defeating the insects, speak to Lonai in the Sunspear Sanctuary to accept the quest reward.
a929809ef80a756a8e0b4516e53c7d60ba55517f.text: 與 Zudash Dejarin 交談後，進入 馬加海岸 並前往 羅鳩村 村莊。依照任務標記找到喬納長老（任務地圖上的 J 點）。他會指示你與衛兵巴西（B點）交談。與衛兵巴西交談以進入“保護避難所”，這是 日戟避難所 的迷你任務版本。在裡面，你必須殺死 5 的昆蟲群才能觸發過場動畫並完成任務。有一些刀鋒白蟻巡邏隊在周圍奔跑，但你不需要殺死它們。擊敗昆蟲後，與 日戟避難所 中的洛奈交談以接受任務獎勵。

ca196752fe19ea9ab8cd8d21803512cc55154b13.source: The quest log lists Zudash Dejarin as quest giver.
ca196752fe19ea9ab8cd8d21803512cc55154b13.text: 任務日誌將 Zudash Dejarin 列為任務提供者。

68b8db4b942d0c9264bafaa44d679f0d9830554c.source: Upon completion, Nightfall characters will be able to change their secondary professions (at any profession changer) and gain the same non-exclusive benefits as Ascension in the Prophecies campaign or becoming Weh no Su in the Factions campaign.
68b8db4b942d0c9264bafaa44d679f0d9830554c.text: 完成後，黑暗逆襲 角色將能夠改變他們的第二職業（在任何職業變更者處），並獲得與 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動中的 超越之路 相同的非專有利益，或在 盟與敵 活動中成為 Weh no Su。

13b22e0f3f1d0fbc647e629784a5268037d3ec5c.source: Go to the beach and find a Stone of the Elements.

8a835ab082101a96f6dcbc3992b4b286ef7d0cfe.source: Defeat Huan to claim ownership of the Stone of the Elements.
8a835ab082101a96f6dcbc3992b4b286ef7d0cfe.text: 擊敗胡安，取得元素之石的所有權。

03389e001f0706c37636570d9b50576bc7fcab21.text: 去找 Ronsu 領取獎勵。

dbca80e6906b08ea1cc99497e02e5ab8a0e799b5.source: Ronsu teaches you the following skills when you accept this quest:
dbca80e6906b08ea1cc99497e02e5ab8a0e799b5.text: 當你接受這個任務時，隆蘇會教你以下技能：

96dc8564024033547b5c4313b6146077960cca36.source: Just go south to the sea, and out the pier. Huan should not be difficult, and if he is, fetch some allies from Shing Jea Monastery to help. Henchmen should do fine.
96dc8564024033547b5c4313b6146077960cca36.text: 往南走到海邊，出碼頭就可以了。 Huan 應該不難，如果他很難的話，請從 星岬寺 那裡找一些盟友來幫忙。 傭兵 應該沒問題。

fc6c42b111a3deed9bb25a456202025202e3629d.source: Dragon Festival quests have been known to interfere with completion of this quest.
fc6c42b111a3deed9bb25a456202025202e3629d.text: 已知端午節任務會幹擾該任務的完成。

2b6e57e0e0c3f9b6540ab95e9b9ca6ef40e521fe.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Watchtower Coast and start the mission. Completing D'Alessio Seaboard also brings the party here.
2b6e57e0e0c3f9b6540ab95e9b9ca6ef40e521fe.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 瞭望塔海岸 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 達雷西海濱 也將聚會帶到這裡。

caa2a5f19e3fe8afec6a248e957552885b120593.source: Administer the Test of the Chosen.

f0ab43c2a01fa4b7dd31103b1f7c4311a3d230e7.source: Retrieve the Eye of Janthir from Justiciar Hablion in the upper courtyard of Shaemoor.
f0ab43c2a01fa4b7dd31103b1f7c4311a3d230e7.text: 從 夏恩摩 上層庭院的 判官哈布里恩 取回詹瑟爾之眼。

786c41c9b575060b7c2b3194d4aa4b859c967ec1.source: Deliver the Eye to the coastal city of Loamhurst.
786c41c9b575060b7c2b3194d4aa4b859c967ec1.text: 將眼睛送到沿海城市 沃土森林。

d7fd0ae6d9ab46743fb286286228348e3b52fbbe.source: ADDED: Cleanse yourself in the Fountain of Truth on the hill to the southeast.
d7fd0ae6d9ab46743fb286286228348e3b52fbbe.text: 新增：在東南山上的真理之泉淨化自己。

eace06d80a33f066acc5f4c485ee0119c36f18e4.source: *BONUS* Find and escort all the chosen to Loamhurst.
eace06d80a33f066acc5f4c485ee0119c36f18e4.text: *獎勵* 找到並護送所有被選中的人前往 沃土森林。

215ff7e67bb29b99dbf94073aef0e3ae5b56369d.source: There is an additional reward for saving the Chosen villagers. The whole party shares (100 gold * number of Chosen saved * number of human players). (I.e. a party of 6 humans saving 5 Chosen shares 3000 gold, and a party of 1 human + 5 heroes shares 500 gold.)
215ff7e67bb29b99dbf94073aef0e3ae5b56369d.text: 拯救被選中的村民還有額外獎勵。全隊共享（100 金幣 * 被儲存的選民數量 * 人類玩家數）。 （即，一群 6 人類拯救 5 選民分享 3000 金幣，一組 1 人類 + 5 英雄分享 500 金幣。）

a3ed2af9531d6380fc9dcf27aaa8c5c734d7c8e1.source: Shaemoor is a short trip ahead from the start point. Justiciar Hablion will be waiting for you there, and speaking to him will trigger a cinematic which points you towards the Fountain of Truth where you will cleanse yourself by simply standing on it to receive the cleansed effect. Return to Hablion and acquire the Eye of Janthir. The eye will follow any cleansed party members and help you distinguish the Chosen from amongst the villagers. Those villagers who pass the test will now follow you to Loamhurst.
a3ed2af9531d6380fc9dcf27aaa8c5c734d7c8e1.text: 夏恩摩 距離起點還有一小段路程。 判官哈布里恩 將在那裡等你，與他交談將觸發一段動畫，將你引向真理之泉，在那裡你只需站在真理之泉上即可獲得淨化效果，從而淨化自己。 影返 到 Hablion 並獲得 Janthir 之眼。眼睛將追蹤任何被淨化的黨員，並幫助您將選民與村民區分開來。通過測試的村民現在將跟隨您前往 沃土森林。

46faaabfdeb3f2b0bd43f9bf075bb2737ebd9e4f.source: Head to the western gate in Shaemoor to continue. Head southwest to the bridge. While engaging foes, the Eye will assist by inflicting an area of effect knockdown using Janthir's Gaze.
46faaabfdeb3f2b0bd43f9bf075bb2737ebd9e4f.text: 前往 夏恩摩 的西門繼續。向西南方向前往橋。在與敵人交戰時，之眼將透過使用詹瑟爾的凝視造成一定範圍的效果擊倒來提供幫助。

b4b15f491e1a14fba2c1c5b666c060ec2afa698d.source: After crossing the high bridge, you'll find a caravan of merchants under attack. If you save the merchants, each one rescued will grant your party a 2% morale boost. (The villagers that appear in the party list are involved in the bonus task and do not give morale boosts.)
b4b15f491e1a14fba2c1c5b666c060ec2afa698d.text: 穿過高橋後，你會發現一支商隊受到攻擊。如果您拯救了商人，每個被拯救的商人都會為您的隊伍帶來 2% 士氣提升。 （出現在隊伍名單中的村民參與了獎勵任務，並且不會提升士氣。）

4bdf75ae772a33509728a7e63ad4a146913c3822.source: Keep walking west until you reach the second Tengu boss on the border of the swamp, and then head north through the Undead until you reach Loamhurst. Before taking the Eye to the pedestal, talking to Lionguard Minah will reward your party for any Chosen delivered to him.
4bdf75ae772a33509728a7e63ad4a146913c3822.text: 繼續往西走，直到到達沼澤邊界的第二個 天狗 Boss，然後向北穿過 不死系，直到到達 沃土森林。在將之眼放到基座上之前，與獅子衛士米納交談將為你的隊伍獎勵任何交付給他的神選者。

a52f8601a4fea927f5efb05bc1bb5f98f26c0ff0.source: To complete the bonus you need to rescue all five of the Chosen and escort them to Loamhurst unharmed. Chosen villagers will be added to the bottom of your party list as allies, which will help you tell which ones need to be saved. The second and fifth Chosen will be under attack by tengu immediately upon entering compass range, and the third and fourth will be dangerously close to wandering foes as well. Players should bring skills to assist in quickly killing the attackers or saving the Chosen with heals. Skills that hinder enemies at a distance (such as Ineptitude) are useful, as are speed boosts. Moving into close range to take advantage of Janthir's Gaze can significantly reduce the enemy's damage output. While fighting, don't forget about the Chosen you have already saved, since they can be attacked as you rush to the defence of the new Chosen.
a52f8601a4fea927f5efb05bc1bb5f98f26c0ff0.text: 要完成獎勵，您需要營救所有五名選民並護送他們毫髮無傷地到達 沃土森林。選定的村民將作為盟友新增到您的隊伍清單底部，這將幫助您判斷哪些村民需要被拯救。第二名和第五名選民在進入羅盤範圍後將立即受到天狗的攻擊，而第三名和第四名選民也將危險地接近徘徊的敵人。玩家應該攜帶技能來協助快速殺死攻擊者或透過治療來拯救選民。遠距離阻礙敵人的技能（例如 愚蠢）非常有用，速度提升也很有用。進入近距離利用詹瑟爾的凝視可以顯著減少敵人的傷害輸出。在戰鬥時，不要忘記你已經拯救的選民，因為當你衝過去保護新的選民時，他們可能會受到攻擊。

692ef995e0a9ba478aa45dc4f7020ada859cec30.source: The Chosen villagers and merchants are only added to the party list once a player enters compass range. Because of this, flagging heroes and henchmen to the locations of the Chosen using the Mission Map before the player enters compass range provides a very easy way to ensure survival of the Chosen. Moreover, the already saved Chosen will stay with the player and therefore be less vulnerable.
692ef995e0a9ba478aa45dc4f7020ada859cec30.text: 只有當玩家進入羅盤範圍後，被選中的村民和商人才會被加入隊伍清單。因此，在玩家進入羅盤範圍之前使用 主線任務 地圖將英雄和追隨者標記到選民的位置提供了一種非常簡單的方法來確保選民的生存。此外，已經儲存的選民將留在玩家身邊，因此不易受到攻擊。

77fc8c2d0a7bf69ef8914661dfd64b84b2ead0b9.source: After saving the Chosen, the party leader must get close to them to make them follow; it is not enough just to have the Eye of Janthir reveal them as Chosen. The second Chosen also will not follow the party until he has been spoken to and the bonus objective has been displayed.
77fc8c2d0a7bf69ef8914661dfd64b84b2ead0b9.text: 拯救選民後，黨魁必須接近他們，讓他們跟隨；僅僅讓詹瑟爾之眼揭示他們是被選中的人是不夠的。第二位選民也不會跟隨隊伍，直到與他交談並且獎勵目標已顯示。

68243a53ea780cac6244a068f3b4522bf27db49c.source: Once all five have been secured, there will still be a short trip towards Loamhurst through an area with poisoned water and undead; avoid letting the Chosen step in the swamp water. Finally, you must talk to Lionguard Minah or else you will lose the bonus by skipping to the end of the mission. Make sure all five are with you or the game will consider you have lost one during your way towards the bonus claim. The names of Chosen in the party window will become greyed out if they have been left behind.
68243a53ea780cac6244a068f3b4522bf27db49c.text: 一旦所有五個人都得到保護，仍然會有一段短途旅程，穿過充滿毒水和亡靈的區域，前往 沃土森林；避免讓選民踏入沼澤水中。最後，你必須與獅子衛士米納交談，否則你將因跳到任務結束而失去獎勵。確保所有五個都在你身邊，否則遊戲會認為你在領取獎金的過程中失去了一個。如果被遺忘，隊伍視窗中的選民姓名將變灰。

4bab3597ae687a53cf19dd8500e3c55de2a319f3.source: The Chosen lose health in Hard mode much faster and getting to them in time may pose a problem. Consider bringing skills that increase the party's movement speed, as well as niche skills such as Ebon Escape. As all the Chosen will primarily be targeted by melee attacks, also consider skills as Gust and Withering Aura that can keep these targets from dying. Finally, a decent healer is most likely crucial to keep the Chosen alive throughout the mission. Taking an AoE skill will cause the enemies to scatter and change targets, which can help protect the Chosen.
4bab3597ae687a53cf19dd8500e3c55de2a319f3.text: 在 困難模式 中，選民失去生命值的速度要快得多，及時找到他們可能會帶來問題。考慮攜帶提高隊伍移動速度的技能，以及諸如 黑檀 脫逃 之類的利基技能。由於所有選民將主要成為近戰攻擊的目標，​​因此也要考慮使用 噴發 和凋零光環等技能來防止這些目標死亡。最後，一個體面的治療師對於讓選民在整個任務中保持活力很可能至關重要。使用 範圍性 技能將使敵人分散並改變目標，這有助於保護選民。

d936fc8e53e91111fddbab4f3c967732112ba83b.source: If you can successfully rescue the Chosen from their initial attackers but struggle to keep them alive during the rest of the journey, you can avoid approaching them as the party leader so that they will not follow the party, then double back to collect them once the road to Loamhurst is clear. Remember that the first Chosen in Shaemoor is very close to the Eye's initial location, so you will need to keep to the left as you descend the stairs if you intend to use this strategy.
d936fc8e53e91111fddbab4f3c967732112ba83b.text: 如果你能成功地從最初的攻擊者手中救出選民，但在剩下的旅程中努力讓他們活下去，你可以避免以隊伍領袖的身份接近他們，這樣他們就不會跟隨隊伍，然後在通往 沃土森林 的道路暢通後折回收集他們。請記住，夏恩摩 中的第一個選擇者非常接近眼睛的初始位置，因此如果您打算使用此策略，則在下樓梯時需要保持向左行駛。

25bb774a3c9e3f7500d8f1a53e6793c359f77cec.source: Complete exploration of this mission contributes approximately 1.0% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
25bb774a3c9e3f7500d8f1a53e6793c359f77cec.text: 完成此任務的探索大約為 Tyrian 版圖 標題貢獻了 1.0%。

1cb498947c355c501acff2aec1d0963497986f44.source: Crossing the river without using the bridge can jeopardise the bonus objective, since the additional tengu foes on alternative routes might block you from rescuing a vulnerable Chosen villager.
1cb498947c355c501acff2aec1d0963497986f44.text: 不使用橋梁過河可能會危及獎勵目標，因為其他路線上的額外天狗敵人可能會阻止你拯救脆弱的選民村民。

8d70f1b9a3c3df9600e01c772b3c87d2ac15823f.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Druid's Overlook.
8d70f1b9a3c3df9600e01c772b3c87d2ac15823f.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 德魯伊高地。

709f6884e41ec38c4f44881adbe67956bf6e8140.source: When approaching the Fountain of Truth, the soundtrack Droknar's Forge will play in place of the usual Krytan soundtracks.
709f6884e41ec38c4f44881adbe67956bf6e8140.text: 當接近真理之泉時，配樂 卓克納熔爐 將代替通常的 Krytan 配樂播放。

0ad640ea07db1dc09591c065e421c5c178c054b9.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #2 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
0ad640ea07db1dc09591c065e421c5c178c054b9.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#2 頁。

3ea8c4c469ef0fbfc1c2e8ff4116e835b3cd7e54.source: The objectives fail to state that one must talk to Lionguard Minah to complete the bonus. Sometimes the Eye will disappear if you separate too far from a human companion you're running the mission with.
3ea8c4c469ef0fbfc1c2e8ff4116e835b3cd7e54.text: 目標沒有規定必須與雄獅衛士米納交談才能完成獎勵。有時，如果你與一起執行任務的人類同伴距離太遠，眼睛就會消失。

94c54107a1005c9e90c35bd2ab2ce51d3d28749d.source: When fighting the Mergoyle Wavebreakers at the cleansing fountain, a White Mantle Abbot, assumed to be running around panicking about the Mergoyles, will intentionally heal them with Heal Other. While up to five chosen are saved during the mission, the end cutscene only has four. The first chosen Villager becomes an ally before acquiring the Eye. Skipping the initial cutscene while the camera is focused on the Fountain of Truth will move Justicar Hablion from his position near the Eye of Janthir to stand by the fountain.
94c54107a1005c9e90c35bd2ab2ce51d3d28749d.text: 當在淨化噴泉處與 石像魔 破波者戰鬥時，假定因擔心 Mergoyles 而到處亂跑的 白斗篷修道者 會故意用 治癒他人 治療它們。雖然在任務期間最多可以儲存五個被選中的人，但最終的過場動畫只有四個。第一個被選中的村民在獲得眼睛之前成為盟友。當鏡頭聚焦在真理之泉時跳過最初的過場動畫會將正義卡哈布利恩從詹瑟爾之眼附近的位置移動到噴泉邊。

8cc063e502bbde99c6ee2908851e850c5d307ec4.source: Get the location of Koss and the captured Sunspears from Nerashi in Arkjok Ward.
8cc063e502bbde99c6ee2908851e850c5d307ec4.text: 取得 寇斯 的位置以及從 阿爾科監禁區 的 Nerashi 處捕獲的烈陽之矛。

1917ba5ebaad90689d96791490b652691f67cde5.source: Rescue Koss and the captured Sunspears.
1917ba5ebaad90689d96791490b652691f67cde5.text: 營救 寇斯 和被俘虜的烈陽之矛。

9f05df9a65742b85802e2707deed4608b2a9e523.source: Eliminate the Kournan scout patrols around the perimeter of the garrison.
9f05df9a65742b85802e2707deed4608b2a9e523.text: 消滅要塞周邊的庫爾南偵察兵巡邏隊。

ef4ccaca66a105a66dc2787ed33bfdbc4b9d25fc.source: Kill Commander Kubeh and his elite guards.
ef4ccaca66a105a66dc2787ed33bfdbc4b9d25fc.text: 殺死 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Kubeh 和他的精銳守衛。

41f4658d909b22ead75f2a88e409f538bc73eff4.source: Acolyte of Grenth and Captain Chichor will not spawn in Arkjok Ward while this quest is active.
41f4658d909b22ead75f2a88e409f538bc73eff4.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，古蘭斯 的侍僧和 Chichor 隊長不會在 阿爾科監禁區 中生成。

5b1fd226b755e72147b85dbccca27ca4fdc8b6ef.source: Koss will spawn in Command Post after killing Commander Kubeh.
5b1fd226b755e72147b85dbccca27ca4fdc8b6ef.text: 寇斯 會在殺死 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Kubeh 後在 指揮所 中產生。

f16af832342f12a437da9d1bd93c6584048631eb.source: Talk to Nerashi just outside the Command Post in Arkjok Ward. Follow her directions to the garrison where Koss is being held. You need to eliminate 3 groups of Kournans outside of the garrison, the doors will then open. Once inside you need to kill the group with Commander Kubeh. Talk to Koss then and head back to Lonai to get the reward.
f16af832342f12a437da9d1bd93c6584048631eb.text: 在 阿爾科監禁區 的 指揮所 外與 Nerashi 交談。按照她的指示前往舉行 寇斯 的駐軍。你需要消滅要塞外的 3 群 Kournans，然後大門就會開啟。一旦進入，你需要用 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Kubeh 殺死這群人。然後與 寇斯 交談並返回洛奈以獲得獎勵。

ee9f2923d4ecae11f49ec6016fe35a49fd6d6328.source: It is not actually necessary to talk to Nerashi, you can go straight to Koss (and from a closer outpost, as well), and free him.
ee9f2923d4ecae11f49ec6016fe35a49fd6d6328.text: 實際上沒有必要與 Nerashi 交談，你可以直接前往 寇斯（也可以從更近的前哨站）並釋放他。

ca3171bfb30b2f121238beda4aea7279fee92a5a.source: Koss is level 2 and has no skills in this quest.
ca3171bfb30b2f121238beda4aea7279fee92a5a.text: 寇斯 的等級為 2，並且在此任務中沒有技能。

98d13785e4302d538dbd296cb65cd2dd717c15ca.source: Once freed, Koss will start dancing and the Sunspear Refugees will do the cheer emote.
98d13785e4302d538dbd296cb65cd2dd717c15ca.text: 獲釋後，寇斯 將開始跳舞，陽矛難民將做出歡呼表情。

9edf83329ea406dfe99ffb3179d5c97a7b569739.source: After receiving the reward for this quest, Koss will become available again.
9edf83329ea406dfe99ffb3179d5c97a7b569739.text: 收到此任務的獎勵後，寇斯 將再次可用。

e610991d28c2c12a531443efbe8fdf99138be635.source: Exiting the east gate after talking to Koss leads to another small group of Kournans and the entrance to Pogahn Passage. You can take this opportunity to unlock this outpost.
e610991d28c2c12a531443efbe8fdf99138be635.text: 與 寇斯 交談後離開東門會到達另一小群 Kournan 和 波甘驛站 的入口。你可以藉此機會解鎖這個前哨站。

96c2f3fcacf051ee5e1bb85cfa8d4b9954d6c4ea.source: Search for Kai Ying in Panjiang Peninsula.
96c2f3fcacf051ee5e1bb85cfa8d4b9954d6c4ea.text: 在 班讓半島 中搜尋 凱英。

2de725454a7e34d125a5b8b3da47852088efa10e.source: Kai Ying can be found just south of Kaitan Village.
2de725454a7e34d125a5b8b3da47852088efa10e.text: 凱英 位於凱坦村以南。

97cfbea8aa5ae2d68d0309a455494ebdaf86fb29.source: Speak to Koss in the Command Post at the Sunspear Sanctuary.
97cfbea8aa5ae2d68d0309a455494ebdaf86fb29.text: 在 指揮所 和 日戟避難所 中與 寇斯 交談。

f4ffa83d6a1b437fa604579d512c3c8a5b9f1393.text: 營救剩餘的烈陽之矛部隊。

59ac6108f8af586d43673c3047210411d3355f6e.source: Watch out for long-range Kournan spotters.
59ac6108f8af586d43673c3047210411d3355f6e.text: 留意遠距離的庫南觀察員。

cb727f74259b2993fc2dbacfe679d17942b4ac1b.text: 與 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) 蘇哈交談。

cc2395d5939a8c45804847af64c57752c74fc990.source: You can also refer to the Guide to farming Sunspear promotion points if you are short a few hundred points.
cc2395d5939a8c45804847af64c57752c74fc990.text: 如果你還缺少幾百點，也可以參考《陽矛升級指南》的耕作指南。

c973a96aa05ad28914dda2082461fb3ec4d2cec4.text: 與 寇斯 一起旅行

caaea51fe52283d83554a050c7b3e3a9a78b8409.source: Take Koss as one hero and go into the Sunward Marches. You will see the first pair of Sunspears. Defeat the Kournan Guards to rescue them. Go northwest and afterwards straight north to rescue the next two pairs. Watch out for sentry traps as they will cause 100 armor-ignoring damage to anyone in the area every 5 seconds. Talk to Commander Suha in the northeast to gain access to Venta Cemetery.
caaea51fe52283d83554a050c7b3e3a9a78b8409.text: 以寇斯為英雄，進入向陽邊境。您將看到第一對陽矛。擊敗庫爾南守衛來營救他們。向西北走，然後一直向北去營救接下來的兩對。小心哨兵陷阱，因為它們每隔 5 秒就會對該區域內的任何人造成 100 無視護甲傷害。與東北部的 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Suha 交談以進入文塔公墓。

28d6df4ed82960d928e9b95b8e4c11c661fa4702.source: Only one Captured Sunspear has to survive to complete the quest.
28d6df4ed82960d928e9b95b8e4c11c661fa4702.text: 只有一名被俘獲的烈陽之矛必須存活下來才能完成任務。

cf112b67e88b65fa69e9274dfba57711e03fff05.source: A Nightfall character can complete this quest without the rank of Sunspear General if that character is in a party with another character who also has the quest and has the rank of Sunspear General or is a Factions or Prophecies character. Both characters are teleported to Rojis in Venta Cemetery to accept the reward.
cf112b67e88b65fa69e9274dfba57711e03fff05.text: 如果 黑暗逆襲 角色與另一個也有該任務且具有陽矛將軍軍銜的角色在隊伍中，或者是 盟與敵 或 阿斯卡隆戰記 角色，則該角色無需陽矛將軍軍銜即可完成此任務。兩個角色都被傳送到文塔公墓的羅吉斯接受獎勵。

4de258831ceb1c681491529f8013d7d010506a7b.source: During the stage at which Nightfall characters must obtain the rank of Sunspear General, the quest marker will point to the Sunspear Great Hall, despite there being nothing there which will help with the objective.
4de258831ceb1c681491529f8013d7d010506a7b.text: 在黑暗逆襲角色必須獲得陽矛將軍軍銜的階段，任務標記將指向日戟大會堂，儘管那裡沒有任何有助於實現目標的東西。

c53e9c5d1d8590821d346fb8127b469ef8650249.source: Can be be completed at the same time as Building the Base: Prisoners of War.
c53e9c5d1d8590821d346fb8127b469ef8650249.text: 可以與建造基地：戰俘同時完成。

65eb5dd126e7a40ff5a62b34e3bf511473939e29.source: See Kai Ying for your reward.
65eb5dd126e7a40ff5a62b34e3bf511473939e29.text: 請參閱 凱英 以取得獎勵。

7b226473d465a770a8901cdfa3c01ed5bf1ca52d.source: The combat is direct, and the only objective is to kill. If you have difficulty, nothing prevents you from bringing a full party to help you with this 'duel'.
7b226473d465a770a8901cdfa3c01ed5bf1ca52d.text: 戰鬥是直接的，唯一的目標就是殺人。如果你遇到困難，沒有什麼可以阻止你帶上完整的隊伍來幫助你進行這場「決鬥」。

969facdaa2d27cfe1d388fd19e6bd3930b80726e.text: 與 司法官 湯米茲 交談。

113e960240ed72ee28f42a81546a37f689f3a529.text: 與 遊俠 阿蒙家族交談。

bc57e65bdb8e8184ea124051ffc2c07dae78c9eb.text: 與 遊俠 拉納爾特家族交談。

9d12b55e66140872096da4ac6e77f317fc0370f8.text: 與 遊俠 裡奧內爾家族交談。

8d9418175f10d15a69377d9dd9b663d9547176fb.source: See Witness Giselle for your reward.
8d9418175f10d15a69377d9dd9b663d9547176fb.text: 見證人吉賽兒以獲得獎勵。

61dbcef0d28427116d2b8d2dc034e7e7c5b7fd31.text: 有毒的長弓（死亡之弓皮膚）

535eb2d0ba9ee9e753175e5ca40dfbf26ff94580.text: 穿刺傷害：14-26（需 8 弓術精通）

74a85a334fe7dd11128711c1889ec17fa8768a03.text: 將法術的技能恢復減半（機會：5%）

1b3e74bb0bc756abe1632c5554f272eba34b832a.source: Exit Druid's Overlook into Sage Lands and speak with Justiciar Thommis. The quest markers will then lead you to each of his rangers in turn as you travel northwest. Speak with each of them to continue the quest. After speaking with Rionel, continue on to Witness Giselle in The Wilds; you may map travel straight there if you have already been to the outpost. Near the entrance of the outpost, Saidra and the Chosen Villagers will appear on the radar and as allies in the party window. Follow them into the outpost.
1b3e74bb0bc756abe1632c5554f272eba34b832a.text: 退出 德魯伊高地 進入 賢者領地 並與 司法官 湯米茲 通話。當你向西北行進時，任務標記將依次引導你找到他的每個遊俠。與他們每個人交談以繼續任務。與 Rionel 交談後，繼續前往 荒原 中見證 Giselle；如果您已經去過前哨站，您可以直接在那裡繪製旅行地圖。在前哨站入口附近，賽德拉和被選中的村民將出現在雷達上，並作為盟友出現在隊伍視窗中。跟著他們進入前哨站。

d55b7a38de213ab94c20d44e6b4415ba3381d46c.source: Having this quest active but not completed and entering the area from The Wilds (outpost), you can meet Saidra. If you have the assassin skill Recall equipped you can get past the zone into the outpost. After a short jog, Saidra and the chosen disappear.
d55b7a38de213ab94c20d44e6b4415ba3381d46c.text: 啟動此任務但未完成並從 荒原（前哨站）進入該區域，您可以見到 Saidra。如果你裝備了刺客技能 回歸，你就可以穿過該區域進入前哨站。短暫的慢跑後，賽德拉和被選中的人消失了。

96edb6e31c5efbcafda76b7ec05801263c6dd402.source: The Longbow from this quest reward is itself not salvageable, but the Poisonous Bowstring on it can be salvaged. Not to mention the Longbow is actually a Flatbow unlike the namesake, which can lead to some confusion if you miss reading the weapon type info.
96edb6e31c5efbcafda76b7ec05801263c6dd402.text: 此任務獎勵中的 長弓 本身無法回收，但其上的毒弓弦可回收。更不用說 長弓 實際上是 平底弓，與同名的不同，如果您錯過閱讀武器型別資訊，可能會導致一些混亂。

8b4d78f7afc82d2ce6efec96762099cbd7490b09.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for And a Hero Shall Lead Them.
8b4d78f7afc82d2ce6efec96762099cbd7490b09.text: 所有黨員必須接受獎勵，並由 英雄 領導他們。

ffb2cf577e0fd6bb3652860321e55598d9695c78.source: Lead the Sunspear Evacuees to Dajkah Inlet without being discovered by the garrison.
ffb2cf577e0fd6bb3652860321e55598d9695c78.text: 帶領烈陽之矛撤離者在不被駐軍發現的情況下前往達吉卡灣。

14918ab164771098a6bb70e42842347f8a9facf0.source: Kill all the guards at the garrison posts before they sound an alert and blow your cover.
14918ab164771098a6bb70e42842347f8a9facf0.text: 在他們發出警報並揭穿你的掩護之前殺死駐軍哨所的所有守衛。

b509d2807a0091482a4f7e99f40c0f39b6eeb834.source: Disarm the sentry traps before they discharge.
b509d2807a0091482a4f7e99f40c0f39b6eeb834.text: 在哨兵陷阱發射前解除它們的武裝。

2876b096037634eaa912e65096ec4f2ccc9318fd.source: Start negotiations with Margrid the Sly.
2876b096037634eaa912e65096ec4f2ccc9318fd.text: 開始與狡猾的瑪格麗德談判。

3b860f4e31fa50fcf78e29fd7f6cecc36433f6ab.source: Morzek Garrison is the fort in the middle of the area; it is marked on the map by a red door. Moving too close will prompt a warning to avoid moving closer; if ignored, your team will be targeted by a massive siege attack, resulting in at least 600 area of effect (AoE) damage and almost certain loss of your evacuees (and consequently, mission failure). (You will not receive a warning if you have turned off Mission Progress via the Interface tab of the options panel.) The rest of the mission is fairly straight-forward. It is this mechanism that can cause players to have to repeatedly restart the mission as the warning does not give enough time to leave the attack range.
3b860f4e31fa50fcf78e29fd7f6cecc36433f6ab.text: 莫澤克要塞是該地區中部的堡壘；它在地圖上被一扇紅色的門標記。距離太近會提示警告，避免靠近；如果忽視，您的團隊將成為大規模圍攻攻擊的目標，​​造成至少 600 效果區域 (範圍性) 的傷害，並且幾乎肯定會造成撤離人員的損失（因此任務失敗）。 （如果您透過選項面板的「介面」標籤關閉了 主線任務 Progress，則不會收到警告。）任務的其餘部分相當簡單。正是這種機制可能會導致玩家必須反覆重新啟動任務，因為警告沒有給玩家足夠的時間離開攻擊範圍。

0991896f6a34fecfd2f9e6c05aec138dbb1538db.source: The fastest and safest route is to go along the the northern wall of the area and proceed west until you cannot go any farther, reaching the northwest corner of the map. From there, head south until you find Margrid the Sly. Talk to her to complete the mission.
0991896f6a34fecfd2f9e6c05aec138dbb1538db.text: 最快、最安全的路線是沿著該地區的北牆向西行進，直到無法再往前走，到達地圖的西北角。從那裡向南走，直到找到狡猾的瑪格麗特。與她對話即可完成任務。

046a6ac91ae988f3199cfd2b50ee634281098969.source: Skipping the bonus reduces the length of the mission by 66% (e.g. less than ten minutes instead of 30 minutes).
046a6ac91ae988f3199cfd2b50ee634281098969.text: 跳過獎勵會使任務長度減少 66%（例如，少於十分鐘，而不是 30 分鐘）。

4fcb8a12719ddd710747298895a6c819190e6092.source: The bonus is straight-forward but time-consuming: follow the suggested route to neutralize each of the 12 guard posts, periodically reviewing the mission map (default key: [U]) to ensure that each post's flag has turned gray. You get credit for the bonus regardless of whether you neutralize a post before or after they call for a siege attack, although obviously it is safer to avoid the extra AoE damage.
4fcb8a12719ddd710747298895a6c819190e6092.text: 獎勵很簡單，但很耗時：按照建議的路線消滅每個 12 哨所，定期檢查任務地圖（預設鍵：[U]）以確保每個哨所的旗幟變成灰色。無論您是在發動圍攻攻擊之前還是之後壓制帖子，您都會獲得獎勵，儘管顯然避免額外的 範圍性 傷害會更安全。

e3f059a4811a015d3ae253f9c0d5455ad2b61f7c.source: The only difference for hard mode is that it can be fatal to over-aggro, especially near the guard towers. Be sure to avoid or destroy nearby patrols before approaching the towers.
e3f059a4811a015d3ae253f9c0d5455ad2b61f7c.text: 困難模式的唯一區別是過度仇恨可能是致命的，尤其是在守衛塔附近。在接近塔樓之前，請務必避開或摧毀附近的巡邏隊。

ee6ca843876b83978eaf1d2421d327043a6860ce.source: Area damage over time against guard posts, as mobs tend to stay bunched together.
ee6ca843876b83978eaf1d2421d327043a6860ce.text: 隨著時間的推移，對哨所的區域造成損害，因為暴民往往聚集在一起。

efcf3c60d69e35d7002d9dfd595c2ad813c85aa9.source: There are enough corpses for 3 (or more) minion masters.
efcf3c60d69e35d7002d9dfd595c2ad813c85aa9.text: 有足夠的屍體供 3（或更多）小兵大師使用。

367bac4c918c295450bc2b6e4dd5caa546bdf8eb.source: Kournan Bowmen use Infuriating Heat and Whirling Defense; bring stance-removal skills, skills that bypass blocking, or skills that punish blocking. You are unlikely to need Skills that increase adrenaline gain.
367bac4c918c295450bc2b6e4dd5caa546bdf8eb.text: Kournan Bowmen 使用 怒火 和 旋風防禦；帶來移除姿態的技能、繞過阻擋的技能或懲罰阻擋的技能。您不太可能需要增加腎上腺素增益的技能。

6bcd6690a6a42d16a706829190fdadd808567fd5.source: The evacuees are all minor healers; consider bringing less healing and more damage, control, or utility skills.
6bcd6690a6a42d16a706829190fdadd808567fd5.text: 撤離者都是小治療師；考慮減少治療量並增加傷害、控製或實用技能。

cf6a1e211cbbd226f70863ed0e5f18e71a0ed5cf.source: Since the evacuees all wield staves, their attacks will trigger the many Kournan Bowmen's Whirling Defense, potentially causing heavy damage to melee attackers on your team.
cf6a1e211cbbd226f70863ed0e5f18e71a0ed5cf.text: 由於撤離者都揮舞著法杖，他們的攻擊將觸發許多庫南弓箭手的 旋風防禦，可能會對你團隊中的近戰攻擊者造成嚴重傷害。

4a5007eb63ea2c8006d7077da7286f50664019ef.source: Speed boosts reduce the amount of time spent wandering, especially when keeping evacuees out of harm's way.
4a5007eb63ea2c8006d7077da7286f50664019ef.text: 速度提升可以減少徘徊的時間，尤其是在讓疏散人員免受傷害時。

4e5cabaf5f91eeadd2ac48c9ff8a107cf5ac525b.source: Since it's not necessary to clear the guard posts, you can complete the mission without any fighting, and only receive a Standard reward.
4e5cabaf5f91eeadd2ac48c9ff8a107cf5ac525b.text: 由於不需要清除崗哨，所以無需任何戰鬥即可完成任務，並且只獲得標準獎勵。

c502bf2e7ce48591d92e2b7b6e4c95cd250c0d01.source: It is possible to clear the guard posts without starting the detection timer. Just set your melee Heroes to avoid combat, or flag them away and pull the Kournans with a Longbow.
c502bf2e7ce48591d92e2b7b6e4c95cd250c0d01.text: 可以在不啟動偵測計時器的情況下清除哨所。只要讓你的近戰英雄避免戰鬥，或標記他們並用 長弓 拉開 Kournans。

fe438b99b445823cc1962a0c928263773f26cbbf.source: Talk to Dockmaster Ahlaro for your next primary quest.
fe438b99b445823cc1962a0c928263773f26cbbf.text: 與碼頭管理員阿赫拉羅交談以完成你的下一個主要任務。

fe7c0777be7f6ebdc0d206f5967fba6cc00be79b.source: After the completion of this mission, you can arrive at Kamadan, Jewel of Istan with a party larger than that allowed in that outpost (i.e. 4). See Kamadan, Jewel of Istan notes for details.
fe7c0777be7f6ebdc0d206f5967fba6cc00be79b.text: 完成此任務後，您可以帶著比該前哨所允許的人數更多的隊伍到達 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽（即 4）。有關詳細資訊，請參閱 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽 註釋。

33acc6bf6a83022e1e4b391e0fffc482a843fb03.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #2 in the Night Falls storybook.
33acc6bf6a83022e1e4b391e0fffc482a843fb03.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#2 頁。

f98f9106a573dba6f18c649ee0a00f063c7bcf52.source: If you fail to neutralize a guard post before your position is given away, the map marker will not change color. However, your quest log will still count it as neutralized. Guard Post Commanders may fail to spawn at guard posts. When all other enemies are slain it still counts as neutralized, but the timer will run out and incoming siege attacks strike the area after a short delay. Players have reported losing progress towards the Survivor title after dying due to a siege attack (from the fort), even though this type of death is not supposed to count.
f98f9106a573dba6f18c649ee0a00f063c7bcf52.text: 如果你在你的位置被洩露之前未能摧毀崗哨，地圖示記將不會改變顏色。然而，你的任務日誌仍會將其視為無效。哨所指揮官可能無法在哨所產生。當所有其他敵人都被殺死時，它仍然算作中和，但計時器將耗盡，傳入的圍攻攻擊會在短暫的延遲後襲擊該區域。玩家報告稱，由於（來自堡壘的）圍攻攻擊而死亡後，他們失去了 生存者 頭銜的進度，儘管這種型別的死亡不應該被計算在內。

ce8dd3b1bab4b032127872fb80fe9a6422af0cc2.source: Talk to Ludo to gain entrance into the monastery.
ce8dd3b1bab4b032127872fb80fe9a6422af0cc2.text: 與盧多交談即可進入修道院。

962f31ff322c7ee82f874fc073503c95651136b2.source: Seek out Headmaster Lee in the monastery.

a2f1ccef4727197554316471d52f87a4dec4f47a.source: Give your report of the assault to the consulate.
a2f1ccef4727197554316471d52f87a4dec4f47a.text: 向領事館報告攻擊事件。

f0302f139c137df0bc55fe4fa8e9ba1fc829b9bc.source: Give your report to Elder Nahlo.
f0302f139c137df0bc55fe4fa8e9ba1fc829b9bc.text: 將你的報告交給納洛長老。

cf322e7fa352304ee6587274150286a6c9e8b168.source: Find Elder Dahut and make your report.
cf322e7fa352304ee6587274150286a6c9e8b168.text: 找到達胡特長老並進行報告。

69dcf859a22f5e0bfe318bc74f7fbed70958e64a.source: See Elder Suhl for your reward.

47ee69c54f1581639830973b7774432d3542929e.source: Walk through the portal into the Consulate and talk to each of the three elders.
47ee69c54f1581639830973b7774432d3542929e.text: 穿過傳送門進入領事館，與三位長老分別交談。

b8e0fab7a143027dcb06a7bb5da0db037de931a1.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Sage Lands and start the mission.
b8e0fab7a143027dcb06a7bb5da0db037de931a1.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 賢者領地 走進前哨站並開始任務。

03475c10a26c9583f543c0099b820d2710f45dd0.source: Hunt down the Shining Blade kidnappers, and rescue the Chosen they have taken hostage.
03475c10a26c9583f543c0099b820d2710f45dd0.text: 追捕 光刃公會 綁匪，並救出被他們扣為人質的選民。

2aefb1008299abf28656d907edd85c87345548e0.text: 追趕逃跑的 光刃公會。

b1daaec4a0983d02f0c20d8b41a7fa1f24cab817.source: Discover how the Shining Blade navigates the jungle.
b1daaec4a0983d02f0c20d8b41a7fa1f24cab817.text: 瞭解 光刃公會 如何在叢林中航行。

7f6870f53eba47cb8fbae4cee228e825813d0f71.text: *獎勵* 擊敗兩個 半人馬 酋長。

c675dafadc86e72cae34805750a7eeb3d7b798b8.source: This mission is one long trek through the jungle, with confusing branching paths and a wide variety of enemies along the way. Start out heading north and join a pair of White Mantle Knights heading into a clearing. Here you will meet the first of several Entangling Roots. When approached, these creatures will trigger the appearance of a gate of vines at each entrance to the clearing, cutting off your retreat and potentially stranding party members outside. They are also surrounded by hidden spawns including multiple Life Pods, which can make killing them a chore even with the White Mantle's help. Consider keeping back any warriors in the group to avoid triggering all of the popups at once. The vine gate does not block line of sight, and is not triggered by pets, minions, or your White Mantle allies. All gates disappear as soon as the Entangling Roots is killed.
c675dafadc86e72cae34805750a7eeb3d7b798b8.text: 這項任務是穿越叢林的長途跋涉，沿途有令人困惑的分支路徑和各種各樣的敵人。開始向北行駛，與一對 白斗篷 騎士一起前往一片空地。在這裡你會遇到幾個糾纏根中的第一個。當接近時，這些生物會在空地的每個入口處觸發藤蔓門的出現，切斷你的退路，並可能將隊伍成員困在外面。它們也被隱藏的生成點包圍，其中包括多個 生命 Pod，即使有 白斗篷 的幫助，殺死它們也變得一件苦差事。考慮保留隊伍中的任何戰士，以避免同時觸發所有彈出視窗。藤蔓門不會阻擋視線，也不會被寵物、小兵或您的 白斗篷 盟友觸發。一旦纏結根被殺死，所有的門就會消失。

53eacf30c90973b26dd405f13e0f87e3451fecfd.source: As soon as everything is dead, the White Mantle will continue into the next clearing to the west, where there are multiple exits and converging patrols of Moss Scarabs. You might notice a Shining Blade Scout shouting and running deeper into the jungle; you do not have to catch these scouts, but take note of them, as they will always indicate the correct route to take. When in doubt, follow the map. Take the middle westward road along with any surviving White Mantle Knights; all three paths lead to an Entangling Roots, but on the correct path you will also see a boss ahead on the far side, which also has some hidden scarabs around it. Past the boss, you will come to an overlook where a cutscene will trigger, showing a Shining Blade Scout on another path creating a vine bridge to cross the gorge.
53eacf30c90973b26dd405f13e0f87e3451fecfd.text: 一旦一切都消失了，白斗篷 將繼續進入西邊的下一個空地，那裡有多個出口和苔蘚聖甲蟲的巡邏隊。您可能會注意到 光刃公會 偵察兵大喊著跑進叢林深處；你不必抓住這些偵察兵，但要記下他們，因為他們總是會指示正確的路線。如有疑問，請依照地圖操作。與倖存的 白斗篷 騎士一起走中西路；所有三個路徑都通往糾纏根，但在正確的路徑上，你還會​​在遠端看到一個 Boss，它周圍也有一些隱藏的聖甲蟲。經過 Boss，你會來到一個觀景臺，在那裡會觸發一個過場動畫，顯示一個 光刃公會 偵察兵在另一條路上建造了一座跨越峽谷的藤橋。

6cddba218fda7bac5c48dc0abefe2a7ab1160e48.source: The White Mantle Knights will give up here, but continue north and you will find numerous Centaurs ahead. The Shining Blade Scouts will indicate a path to the left, and you can cut across here, but pay attention to the Centaur patrols, some of which move quite fast and can easily catch your party from behind. Their rangers also leave Flame Traps and spirits of Symbiosis while moving; triggering the traps or attacking the spirit will aggro the group. It may be safer and easier to continue northeast a way before turning back to the west, especially if you are attempting the bonus.
6cddba218fda7bac5c48dc0abefe2a7ab1160e48.text: 白斗篷 騎士團將在這裡放棄，但繼續向北，您會發現前面有許多半人馬。 光刃公會 偵察兵會向左指示一條路徑，您可以從這裡抄近路，但請注意 半人馬 巡邏隊，其中一些巡邏隊移動速度相當快，可以輕鬆從後面追上您的隊伍。他們的遊騎兵在移動時也會留下火焰陷阱和 共生 的靈魂；觸發陷阱或攻擊靈魂會激怒團隊。在返回西邊之前繼續向東北走一段路可能會更安全、更容易，尤其是當您嘗試獲得獎勵時。

78aa6c651cff3045dcd0f0ced5f9eb00362c5ce8.source: You will reach the bridge created by the Shining Blade before, and on the far side the enemies will change again, with Wind Riders and Jungle Trolls becoming prevalent. The path forks ahead, with two paths in front and a bridge behind; take the right path ahead, and it will lead you to the last Entangling Roots. This time there are no hidden foes, but numerous visible ones which should be pulled out of the clearing before you engage. Turn sharply northeast and you will soon reach the water. From here on, you will be encountering hidden Maguuma Spiders frequently. Follow the Shining Blade Scouts down the southward turn of the stream, and when you encounter one last random boss, turn to the west.
78aa6c651cff3045dcd0f0ced5f9eb00362c5ce8.text: 你將到達先前由 光刃公會 建立的橋梁，而在遠端，敵人將再次發生變化，風騎士和叢林巨魔將變得普遍。前方有岔路，前有兩條路，後有一座橋；走正確的路，它會帶你到最後的糾纏根。這次沒有隱藏的敵人，而是許多可見的敵人，在交戰之前應該將它們從空地上拉出來。急轉向東北，很快就會到達水面。從現在開始，您將經常遇到隱藏的 梅古瑪 蜘蛛。跟著 光刃公會 偵察兵沿著溪流向南轉彎，當你遇到最後一個隨機 Boss 時，轉向西邊。

05aadea3631f9b28a5ae6c6cabb2bb53a4e62cc9.source: After a short journey, you will see the Chosen under attack by spiders, so move in and fight through several spider waves culminating in the boss Kezra Spindleweb. They are not very threatening, and Evennia will be healing you from the overlook, so you should have little trouble. As soon as the spiders are all dead, the mission is complete.
05aadea3631f9b28a5ae6c6cabb2bb53a4e62cc9.text: 短暫的旅程後，你會看到選民受到蜘蛛的攻擊，因此進入並與幾波蜘蛛戰鬥，最終在 Boss Kezra Spindleweb 中達到高潮。它們並沒有太大的威脅，伊凡妮雅 會從忽視中治癒你，所以你應該不會遇到什麼麻煩。一旦蜘蛛全部死亡，任務就完成了。

acbde2b35b20ea4392f82510bf6c42882c479a4c.source: The bonus requires that you defeat two Centaur bosses. Instead of following the White Mantle, head south after proceeding past the first Entangling Root. You will find two Centaurs talking to each other (point 1), do not attack them yet; doing so will cause the bonus objective to be incompletable. To initiate the bonus, you have to eavesdrop on their conversation. After their dialogue finishes with the line "I will guard Ramtha Brokenhoof and Horm Frostrider with my life.", kill them. Pick up the Vine Seed that eventually appears by the glowing plants, which is needed to reach the two Centaur chieftains. You can drop the Vine Seed during combat; it will grow branches, knocking down adjacent foes and dealing 20 damage, and finally it will return to bundle form. Carry this item and backtrack to the middle road again.
acbde2b35b20ea4392f82510bf6c42882c479a4c.text: 獎勵要求您擊敗兩個 半人馬 頭目。不要沿著 白斗篷 走，而是在經過第一個纏繞根部後向南行駛。你會發現兩個半人馬正在互相交談（指向1），先不要攻擊他們；這樣做會導致獎勵目標無法完成。要啟動獎金，你必須竊聽他們的談話。當他們的對話結束並說出「我將用我的生命守護拉姆薩·斷蹄和霍姆·霜行者」時，殺死他們。拾取最終出現在發光植物旁邊的藤蔓種子，這是到達兩位 半人馬 酋長處所必需的。你可以在戰鬥中掉落藤蔓種子；它會長出樹枝，擊倒相鄰的敵人並造成 20 傷害，最後它會回到捆綁 型態。攜帶此物品並再次原路返回中路。

b935315c6adda615c1b798807163e2ffcfff6c39.source: Your goal is simple: bring at least one of the eight Sunspear Evacuees to the coast at the opposite side of the map for evacuation. You can do this by avoiding or removing threats along the way. Since each of the evacuees is a monk, they are generally capable of healing themselves, although you should keep an eye on their health.
b935315c6adda615c1b798807163e2ffcfff6c39.text: 你的目標很簡單：將八名烈陽之矛撤離者中的至少一名帶到地圖另一側的海岸進行疏散。您可以透過避免或消除一路上的威脅來做到這一點。由於每個撤離者都是僧侶，因此他們通常能夠自我治癒，但您應該留意他們的健康狀況。

7230f40e1f6d4339ac4c47aa3c4e911a08423cea.source: Your task is complicated by four factors: patrols, Sentry Traps, guard posts, and the garrison:
7230f40e1f6d4339ac4c47aa3c4e911a08423cea.text: 你的任務因四個因素而變得複雜：巡邏、哨兵陷阱、哨所和駐軍：

362e012b87bf87dd3bc92f608c2de2cd49066a1a.source: Patrols: The area is littered with Kournan military patrols. Avoid over-aggroing them, especially in hard mode.
362e012b87bf87dd3bc92f608c2de2cd49066a1a.text: 巡邏隊：該地區遍佈 高楠士兵 巡邏隊。避免過度攻擊他們，尤其是在困難模式下。

fba0ebf69b92c5c72c7d7e126bcf6f72e984f7ea.source: Sentry Traps dot the area (there is one close to nearly every guard post). As you approach, a bar timer appears to indicate a 5-second window within which you can use the Disarm Trap skill to disable it. If it activates, it will inflict 100 damage to all your allies in its area. Since the skill is easily interrupted, make sure that the Kournan rangers are targeted other members of the party before attempting to activate it. Anybody in the party - not just a player - can activate it. Activating the Disarm Trap skill while the timer is still running is enough to successfully deactivate the trap, unless Disarm Trap is interrupted.
fba0ebf69b92c5c72c7d7e126bcf6f72e984f7ea.text: 哨兵陷阱遍佈該區域（幾乎每個哨所附近都有一個）。當您接近時，會出現一個條形計時器，指示 5 秒視窗，您可以在其中使用解除 陷阱 技能來停用它。如果它被啟用，它將對其區域內的所有盟友造成 100 傷害。由於該技能很容易被打斷，因此在嘗試啟用該技能之前，請確保庫南遊騎兵已瞄準隊伍中的其他成員。隊伍中的任何人 - 不僅僅是玩家 - 都可以啟動它。在計時器仍在運作時啟動解除 陷阱 技能足以成功解除陷阱，除非解除 陷阱 被中斷。

c7ccfe0e18a2282b9c6fc6db43756102f8dacf3f.source: You will be told to find Bloodstone on your own after speaking with Blade Scout Ryder (point D) or after creating the vine bridge at the location where the bonus path (blue) merges back with the mission path. Eventually the party will find itself at the Bloodstone, and must engage Justiciar Hablion upon the stone itself.
c7ccfe0e18a2282b9c6fc6db43756102f8dacf3f.text: 與 光刃公會斥候萊德（D 點）交談後或在獎勵路徑（藍色）與任務路徑合併的位置建立藤橋後，您將被告知自行找到 血石。最終隊伍會發現自己處於 血石 處，並且必須與石頭本身交戰 判官哈布里恩。

b9ae73c361da7da43fa0d96b969ec4b5770adfe4.source: Each Vine Seed Plant produces only one Vine Seed and, when taken, Moss Scarabs popup. The number of Vine Seed Flowers at a location is a good indication of about how many Vine Seeds the party will need to pick up. If your party has fewer than three players, you will have to re-trace ground sometimes. There is a second cluster of Vine Seed Flowers (point C) that is closer to the last bridge. Mobs encountered include Wind Riders, Jungle Trolls, and Moss Scarabs in medium-sized groups so be prepared for Hexes, Conditions, and Melee damage.
b9ae73c361da7da43fa0d96b969ec4b5770adfe4.text: 每個藤蔓種子 植物 只會產生一顆藤蔓種子，並且服用後會彈出苔蘚聖甲蟲。一個地點的藤蔓種子花的數量可以很好地表明該隊伍需要收集多少藤蔓種子。如果你的隊伍少於三名玩家，有時你將不得不重新追蹤地面。還有第二簇藤籽花（C 點），更靠近最後一座橋。遇到的生物包括中等規模的駕馭風者、叢林巨魔和苔蘚聖甲蟲，因此要做好應對六角形、條件和 肉搏 傷害的準備。

21edbf3049b11b1fd2265f64350cf17cc642c1d0.source: This mission is not all that difficult if you keep one or two things in mind while completing the main objectives and the bonus. The beginning of the mission follows the formatted run, just kill all foes in your path. Once you reach the Bloodstone, the Curse of the Bloodstone slows the casting of Resurrection skills on allies who perish on the Bloodstone's surface. Instead of charging into the fray, scurry to one side of the stone. Take out the White Mantle Abbot and the fellow with him. Then, run over to the other side of the stone (without going past Justiciar Hablion) and defeat that White Mantle Abbot and his companion. It will make taking out Justiciar Hablion much easier!
21edbf3049b11b1fd2265f64350cf17cc642c1d0.text: 如果您在完成主要目標和獎勵時牢記一兩件事，那麼這個任務並不是那麼困難。任務的開始遵循格式化的執行，只需殺死你路徑上的所有敵人即可。一旦您到達 血石，血石的詛咒 就會減慢對在 血石 表面死亡的盟友施放復活技能的速度。不要衝入戰鬥，而是跑到石頭的一側。幹掉 白斗篷修道者 和他的同伴。然後，跑到石頭的另一邊（不要越過判官哈布里恩）並擊敗白斗篷修道者和他的同伴。這將使取出 判官哈布里恩 變得更加容易！

ff33423a21fbd31530a26231045d7bcf1801b5c7.source: The bonus for this mission is to use Vine Seeds to awaken four Druids so that they, in turn, may awaken the Elder Druid. This must be done without killing any of the Jungle Guardians who protect the sleeping Druids: if even one guardian dies, the bonus is failed and Ravagers are summoned instead. Guardians can easily be killed by accident due to heroes, henchmen, or other NPC allies in the party. Players can use several tactics to manage these allies:
ff33423a21fbd31530a26231045d7bcf1801b5c7.text: 此任務的獎勵是使用藤蔓種子喚醒四個德魯伊，以便他們反過來喚醒長老德魯依。必須在不殺死任何保護沉睡的德魯伊的叢林守護者的情況下完成此操作：即使只有一名守護者死亡，獎勵也會失敗，並且會召喚掠奪者。守護者很容易因為隊伍中的英雄、追隨者或其他 NPC 盟友而意外殺死。玩家可以使用多種策略來管理這些盟友：

6c77b86b4b85195e486416d1207b437b49257873.source: Do not use summoning stones during the mission until the bonus has been completed.
6c77b86b4b85195e486416d1207b437b49257873.text: 在獎勵完成之前，請勿在任務期間使用召喚石。

6c774463abf1f16ff90a27030cec58e1131fa4c5.source: Set heroes to Avoid Combat and pets to Heel.
6c774463abf1f16ff90a27030cec58e1131fa4c5.text: 將英雄設定為避免戰鬥，將寵物設定為跟隨。

f4c1a5e21015e4b2c9645bce9b9545187c7fe480.source: Disable hero skills that create minions or offensive binding ritual spirits.
f4c1a5e21015e4b2c9645bce9b9545187c7fe480.text: 停用創造僕從或攻擊性繫結儀式靈魂的英雄技能。

39a918a28e50169d4f3fa425110663055dbe2efe.source: Flag henchmen using the compass to ensure that they run clear of any guardians.
39a918a28e50169d4f3fa425110663055dbe2efe.text: 使用指南針標記追隨者，以確保他們避開任何監護人。

d98ad0de2f1574f4d878efd896d40e0851074a6a.source: The bonus is triggered when the party awakens the first Druid (1 on the map) by dropping a Vine Seed on the glowing circle. The first Druid speaks, creates a Vine Bridge and slowly walks across it. The first Druid stops where the Elder Druid is to be summoned (point 4 on the map). Players will find other Vine Seed Plants (2 on the map) near this spot that they can use to awaken the other three Druids (marked 3 on the map). Several Moss Scarabs will also spawn in and around the areas where the druids are to be awakened; these (unlike the Guardians) can safely be killed without endangering the bonus.
d98ad0de2f1574f4d878efd896d40e0851074a6a.text: 當隊伍透過將藤蔓種子丟到發光圓圈上喚醒第一個 德魯依（地圖上的 1）時，就會觸發獎勵。第一款 德魯依 說話，創造一座藤橋並慢慢走過它。第一個 德魯依 停在長老 德魯依 被召喚的地方（地圖上的 4 點）。玩家會在這個地點附近找到其他藤蔓植物（地圖上的 2），他們可以用它們來喚醒其他三個德魯伊（地圖上標記為 3）。一些苔蘚聖甲蟲也會在德魯伊被喚醒的區域及其周圍生成；這些（與守護者不同）可以安全地被殺死，而不會危及獎金。

b1403fa8c87fac341526ad3f2465ab6eca495d84.source: The guardians won't chase very far and they deal low amount of damage. It is relatively safe to simply run past them, which also poses the least risk of accidentally killing them. There is always a nearby "safe" area where the guardians will not pursue, so you can stop and recover without risking a battle with them, although Moss Scarabs will tend to pop up in these areas. The path to the farthest druid in the north has a safe spot by a tree in the western edge. In hard mode, bring a speed boost and projectile protection or your NPCs will get caught in the crossfire from two groups.
b1403fa8c87fac341526ad3f2465ab6eca495d84.text: 守護者不會追得很遠，而且造成的傷害也很低。從他們身邊跑過去是相對安全的，這樣意外殺死他們的風險也最小。附近總有一個「安全」區域，守護者不會追擊，因此您可以停下來恢復，而不必冒與他們戰鬥的風險，儘管苔蘚聖甲蟲往往會出現在這些區域。通往北方最遠的德魯伊的道路在西邊的一棵樹旁有一個安全的地方。在困難模式下，請提高速度並提供彈體保護，否則您的 NPC 將陷入兩支隊伍的交火中。

e46f8edff3e18ab08f234dd2ad90015bf6c8f292.source: Once all four Druids have been awakened the Elder Druid will appear. Killing the Jungle Guardians after their appearance no longer affects the bonus, but will still trigger the Ravagers (which are now relatively easy to kill, should you want the experience). Speak to the Elder Druid to complete the bonus. After completing the bonus, the Jungle Guardians will no longer be aggressive (although they will fight back if you attack them).
e46f8edff3e18ab08f234dd2ad90015bf6c8f292.text: 一旦所有四個德魯伊都被喚醒，長老德魯依就會出現。在叢林守護者出現後殺死他們不再影響獎勵，但仍然會觸發掠奪者（如果你想要體驗的話，現在相對容易殺死它們）。與長者 德魯依 交談以完成獎勵。完成獎勵後，叢林守護者將不再具有攻擊性（儘管如果你攻擊他們，他們會反擊）。

d2da1e31fed57b58ecff8f462321efc8753d68ac.source: If going via the back route after the bonus (blue on the map), it is not necessary to talk to Blade Scout Ryder to complete the mission.
d2da1e31fed57b58ecff8f462321efc8753d68ac.text: 如果在獎勵後走後路（地圖上的藍色），則無需與 光刃公會斥候萊德 對話即可完成任務。

c4a157888d8ed527ae730632af23c1e8aa2cf9c1.source: The first Druid can get stuck on the first pair of Jungle Guardians, a bad chest spawn, or a boulder. You can attempt to free the Druid from the Guardians by pulling them a short distance to the side, until the Druid can pass.
c4a157888d8ed527ae730632af23c1e8aa2cf9c1.text: 第一款 德魯依 可能會卡在第一對叢林守護者、壞箱或巨石上。您可以嘗試將 德魯依 拉到側面一小段距離，將其從守護者手中釋放出來，直到 德魯依 可以通過。

5710f3d8173063a96b3e5064d451c3a44f5139c1.source: A Druid can get stuck on one of the spirits summoned by the Guardians. You can kill the spirits without failing the bonus.
5710f3d8173063a96b3e5064d451c3a44f5139c1.text: 德魯依 可能會被守護者召喚的靈魂之一卡住。你可以在不失敗獎勵的情況下殺死靈魂。

c1d38c42d78445092eba8f3f0d22cabf8cd830e7.source: The bonus objective can still be completed by talking to the Elder Druid as long as all four Druids have been spawned prior to the death of any Jungle Guardian, despite notification of the bonus objective having been failed.
c1d38c42d78445092eba8f3f0d22cabf8cd830e7.text: 只要在任何叢林 守護者 死亡之前產生所有四個德魯伊，獎勵目標仍然可以透過與長老 德魯依 交談來完成，儘管通知獎勵目標已失敗。

4fda8b231ab84708090b2fc8887cc499197a4b4f.source: You do not have to talk to Blade Scout Ryder as it states in the mission objectives — the mission can still be completed if you ignore him.
4fda8b231ab84708090b2fc8887cc499197a4b4f.text: 你不必與 光刃公會斥候萊德 交談，因為它在任務目標中規定 - 如果你忽略他，任務仍然可以完成。

36a2f9fc360421e83994454eb0c9c015ab1aefae.source: If you drop the Vine Seeds in the wrong location, they will try to sprout a bridge, fail, and then return to their original state. (Picking them up a second time will not generate Moss Scarabs.)
36a2f9fc360421e83994454eb0c9c015ab1aefae.text: 如果你將藤蔓種子丟到錯誤的位置，它們會嘗試長出一座橋，失敗，然後恢復到原來的狀態。 （第二次拾取它們不會生成苔蘚聖甲蟲。）

91a4c270f95deff67b21525d45b5ede1551b9f58.source: When a Vine Seed sprouts, it deals 20 damage to adjacent foes and knocks them down. The extra Vine Seeds throughout the mission can be kept to be used for combat in this manner.
91a4c270f95deff67b21525d45b5ede1551b9f58.text: 當藤蔓種子發芽時，它會對鄰近的敵人造成 20 傷害並將他們擊倒。整個任務中多餘的藤蔓種子可以透過這種方式保留下來用於戰鬥。

3fb4b174238a29585751489b06d3d7dc0e737d39.source: To make it slightly easier to navigate, you can drop an item on either side of the bridge. When you want to return to the bridge (to gather more seeds, for example), target the item (default key: ;) and follow (default key: space); the game will take you on the most efficient route to the item.
3fb4b174238a29585751489b06d3d7dc0e737d39.text: 為了使導航更容易一些，您可以將一個專案放在橋的兩側。當您想要返回橋時（例如，收集更多種子），請瞄準該專案（預設鍵：;）並跟隨（預設鍵：空格）；遊戲將帶您走上獲取物品的最有效路線。

c9ccbb67f938fd944f823abddd70e18b56f1d42f.source: Complete exploration of this mission, including the bonus, contributes approximately 1.35% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. To fully explore the area before the final cinematic, first follow the White Mantle Abbot and White Mantle Knight on each side, as noted above, but then run past Justiciar Hablion to the rear of the Bloodstone and follow the trail until it ends, then return and dispatch Hablion.
c9ccbb67f938fd944f823abddd70e18b56f1d42f.text: 完成此任務的探索（包括獎勵）將為 Tyrian 版圖 頭銜貢獻約 1.35%。要在最終過場動畫之前充分探索該區域，請先沿著每一側的 白斗篷修道者 和 白斗篷騎士 前進（如上所述），但然後跑過 判官哈布里恩 到 血石 的後面，沿著小路直到盡頭，然後返回並派遣 Hablion。

68bcd14697397dd1ff834c43dd3489f3a1deb995.source: There is an area on the northern end of the Bloodstone, near the right side of the trail mentioned above, where you can climb up the wall a ways.
68bcd14697397dd1ff834c43dd3489f3a1deb995.text: 血石 的北端有一個區域，靠近上述步道的右側，您可以在那裡爬上一段牆。

704a52887525cf8d8ed3890c108a7c2f8095a720.source: The Vine Seed Flower at point A yields 3 Vine Seeds: 2 for mission path continuation, 1 for yellow bonus path. The Vine Seed Flower near point 4 yields 5 Vine Seeds.
704a52887525cf8d8ed3890c108a7c2f8095a720.text: A 點的藤蔓種子花會產生 3 藤蔓種子：2 用於任務路徑延續，1 用於黃色獎勵路徑。 4 點附近的藤蔓種子花會產生 5 藤蔓種子。

3c5ac4c77c148f2fe2798fec8eb94998813df63f.source: In the last cinematic, you see the back of Markis, who is presumed to be the person who informed Confessor Dorian of Justiciar Hablion's demise.
3c5ac4c77c148f2fe2798fec8eb94998813df63f.text: 在上一部電影中，您可以看到 瑪基思 的背影，他被認為是向 大主教多利安 通報 判官哈布里恩 死亡的人。

b521a3019b3716b5a6b36343f87bc48e78e87f16.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #4 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
b521a3019b3716b5a6b36343f87bc48e78e87f16.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#4 頁。

ea02fb53d58d76bb932834202046ad01380b9111.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Quarrel Falls.
ea02fb53d58d76bb932834202046ad01380b9111.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將會傳送到 怨言瀑布。

a7b545594455f6fdb91c8eabef1d68c1e48e8b45.text: 搜尋 桑泉谷 尋找 Jinzo。

704d0ef86c806335baf4a46a7728caef7edf9d07.source: Headmaster Lee will teach you the following skills upon accepting the quest:
704d0ef86c806335baf4a46a7728caef7edf9d07.text: 接受任務後，李校長將教你以下技能：

739f7586433ffe7c7dcc9d76e22161900432cebb.source: Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and speak with Headmaster Lee to obtain the quest. Exit Shing Jea Monastery and run north towards Sunqua Vale. You will find Jinzo standing in front of a large stone wall by the side of the road.
739f7586433ffe7c7dcc9d76e22161900432cebb.text: 地圖旅行到 星岬寺 並與李校長交談以獲得任務。退出 星岬寺 並向北朝 桑泉谷 方向行駛。你會發現金藏站在路邊的一堵大石牆前。

06280bb750ed9d8c2c4154a96abdc3d4656c0d9f.source: Consult with Dunkoro at the Command Post in Kourna to find a way to Vabbi.
06280bb750ed9d8c2c4154a96abdc3d4656c0d9f.text: 請洽詢 高楠 中 指揮所 的 Dunkoro，找出 瓦貝 的方法。

810ce42400c2891190e7a294b6c233be59f8f48c.source: Scout with Nerashi to find passage through Jahai.
810ce42400c2891190e7a294b6c233be59f8f48c.text: 與奈拉什一起偵察，尋找穿越賈海的通道。

efd65829e31dc36389c8097f3719b64665ad3af2.text: 讓庫爾南巡邏隊保持沉默。

5700f04b4bbfa583be0871e37994fa923eb724ba.source: Simply follow the checkpoints through the Jahai Bluffs until you reach the Kournan patrol. Kill them and map travel back to Sunspear Sanctuary for your reward.
5700f04b4bbfa583be0871e37994fa923eb724ba.text: 只需沿著檢查站穿過 夏亥峭壁 即可到達 Kournan 巡邏隊。殺死他們並在地圖上返回 日戟避難所 以獲得獎勵。

67687c1ff032953448dc4329aac047ffc6ef5efc.source: Note that the quest will reset if changing zones before completion.
67687c1ff032953448dc4329aac047ffc6ef5efc.text: 請注意，如果在完成之前更改區域，任務將重置。

13b167f9d041e60675b25fd834e7e777f3077c39.source: Walking to the Kodonur Crossroads outpost after the quest has ended is mostly a waste of time as the follow-up quest also leads to it.
13b167f9d041e60675b25fd834e7e777f3077c39.text: 任務結束後步行到 科登諾入口 前哨站基本上是浪費時間，因為後續任務也會通往它。

3444e734fb6f15c945b45879f3ff5f67f9696222.source: Nerashi won't attack and cannot be targeted or damaged by foes, making it impossible to capture any of her elite skills.
3444e734fb6f15c945b45879f3ff5f67f9696222.text: 奈拉什不會攻擊，也不會被敵人瞄準或傷害，因此無法捕獲她的任何精英技能。

a6cd346d49a80e547ba7f3070bfc176902aec980.source: Must have access to Lion's Arch Keep, see flowchart for details.
a6cd346d49a80e547ba7f3070bfc176902aec980.text: 必須有權存取 獅子拱門要塞，請參閱流程圖以瞭解詳細資訊。

88d3297a3e09f07edec4b381292b3d8255c84ce7.source: Kill Inquisitor Lashona in North Kryta Province
88d3297a3e09f07edec4b381292b3d8255c84ce7.text: 在 科瑞塔北部 中殺死審判官拉修納

c0a5622319b648acd3cec512eb459c42d9a15d51.source: *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Lashona in Hard Mode
c0a5622319b648acd3cec512eb459c42d9a15d51.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死審判官拉索納

df066572dc71d394d7d56d2561feae134f8cf686.source: See Princess Salma for your reward
df066572dc71d394d7d56d2561feae134f8cf686.text: 見薩爾瑪公主領取獎勵

6e1368646756ea00bf928e598a2777ceeff47e36.source: Complete the Base Objective for 20 War Supplies
6e1368646756ea00bf928e598a2777ceeff47e36.text: 完成 20 戰備物資 的基礎 任務目標

7ff7a566bb63586b9c890411e477a6f9a8fe5868.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 10 War Supplies
7ff7a566bb63586b9c890411e477a6f9a8fe5868.text: 完成*獎勵* 任務目標 以獲得額外的 10 戰備物資

a6b901e90a870352c19b5b4e21e00faefcf34588.source: Follow the road from Lion's Arch to the Ascalon Settlement. Inquisitor Lashona is found talking to Captain Greywind. Once he is dead, you can map out or resign, as killing his minions is not part of the quest.
a6b901e90a870352c19b5b4e21e00faefcf34588.text: 沿著從 獅子拱門 到 阿斯卡隆移民區 的道路行駛。審判官拉肖納被發現正在與 格雷溫軍官 交談。一旦他死了，你就可以計劃或辭職，因為殺死他的爪牙不是任務的一部分。

c55c5a424492ff315fbfb04561469f241b00e1b9.source: It is also possible (and easier) to travel from Bergen Hot Springs.
c55c5a424492ff315fbfb04561469f241b00e1b9.text: 也可以（而且比較容易）從 卑爾根溫泉 出發。

5c00cdd84d5452c16af5337676c45206b31aa6e6.source: Lashona will not spawn if Evil Residents (the Halloween quest) is active.
5c00cdd84d5452c16af5337676c45206b31aa6e6.text: 如果邪惡居民（激戰萬聖節 任務）處於活動狀態，拉紹納將不會產生。

bcf40cb9822570791081a8cdae528b8e3af7cf5e.source: This quest cannot be combined with Merchant's Plea and only under certain circumstances with Defend North Kryta Province; Captain Greywind refuses to talk about shipment.
bcf40cb9822570791081a8cdae528b8e3af7cf5e.text: 此任務不能與 商人的請求 結合使用，僅在某些情況下與保衛 科瑞塔北部 結合使用； 格雷溫軍官 拒絕談論出貨事宜。

77fe583111bfc6a1da6df69ba81638f2b82b7391.source: This quest was available again for some characters, after completion of the first two quests of the Thackeray's Missions in Hearts of the North campaign.
77fe583111bfc6a1da6df69ba81638f2b82b7391.text: 在完成 極地之心 戰役中薩克雷任務的前兩個任務後，某些角色可以再次執行此任務。

adec95272fcbff21356c76d940972d9153698f96.source: This quest refers to Salma as queen before she becomes queen.
adec95272fcbff21356c76d940972d9153698f96.text: 任務指的是薩爾瑪在成為女王之前就已經是女王了。

bc7a857bc6ae0452cfc549ab4c5160d72290ef01.source: Speak with the Centaur in the Command Post at the Sunspear Sanctuary.
bc7a857bc6ae0452cfc549ab4c5160d72290ef01.text: 在 指揮所 和 日戟避難所 中與 半人馬 交談。

d80afcc095e751ec83cc4479ac5824d9e83307a3.source: Journey to the Jahai Bluffs and meet with Zhed Shadowhoof and his informant.
d80afcc095e751ec83cc4479ac5824d9e83307a3.text: 前往 夏亥峭壁 並與哲德影蹄和他的線人會面。

e3dd3d2c074f02bc5626c161549ac06bf9eaf6b5.source: Talk to the Master of Whispers.

9b31ede8d6820263614ce9e98ce6d813ba259d7c.source: Make your way toward Kodonur Crossroads and speak to Haroj Firemane.
9b31ede8d6820263614ce9e98ce6d813ba259d7c.text: 前往 科登諾入口 並與 Haroj Firemane 交談。

3b4d8ecafb28365293382c9b2ad664703db0e1c8.source: See Estate Guard Rikesh for your reward.
3b4d8ecafb28365293382c9b2ad664703db0e1c8.text: 向莊園警衛 Rikesh 尋求獎勵。

cfca7cb83182fad6039712c3dad48162ad36a41a.text: 傑德·影蹄加入你的隊伍。

ac15abeb8fa8c00c8be8ee6607498a28e0710b15.source: Zhed needs to stay alive, and he is very squishy. If he dies while you are traveling to Kodonur, the quest log will be updated with the message that the quest failed. You will need to map travel to an outpost and re-enter the area to trigger the quest again.
ac15abeb8fa8c00c8be8ee6607498a28e0710b15.text: 哲德需要活下去，而他非常脆弱。如果他在你前往科多努爾時死亡，任務日誌將更新為任務失敗的訊息。您需要將旅行對映到前哨站並重新進入該區域以再次觸發任務。

0696f95c69c20395c7f9b869f14b90f40dcc3ee2.source: Two suggestions to handle this issue -
0696f95c69c20395c7f9b869f14b90f40dcc3ee2.text: 處理這個問題的兩個建議 -

90ddf65c150b0c690095b871dc568de29c110320.source: Work backwards starting from Kodonur Crossroads; once you clear the road to Zhed you can walk back without fighting
90ddf65c150b0c690095b871dc568de29c110320.text: 從 科登諾入口 開始向後工作；一旦你清理了通往哲德的道路，你就可以不戰而回了

01336046f7e22a473e4fcd1bd050dc70ffa941e8.source: Use the peasant fort and bodyblock Zhed in there until you have killed the Mandragor boss, then go back and get him. If you are having issues bodyblocking him, bring a few pets.
01336046f7e22a473e4fcd1bd050dc70ffa941e8.text: 使用農民堡壘並在那裡阻擋哲德，直到殺死曼德拉戈爾老闆，然後回去抓住他。如果您在身體阻擋他時遇到問題，請帶幾隻寵物。

29e2c5f8f5e3a36d6a2315ce2cbf0450ed64f42f.source: Remember to allow dialogue between the centaurs; talk to Haroj before entering the town.
29e2c5f8f5e3a36d6a2315ce2cbf0450ed64f42f.text: 記住允許半人馬之間對話；在進入城鎮之前與 Haroj 交談。

481fd5b2fe7624e9bbdbcd326afce8df3a4e132f.source: Talk to Jinzo again when you are ready to kill the target minions.
481fd5b2fe7624e9bbdbcd326afce8df3a4e132f.text: 當你準備好殺死目標小兵時，再次與 Jinzo 交談。

3c37b8cb7b988e2648c18bbaaa72989eb41c2c8b.source: Kill 5 target minions. [5..0] target minions remaining.
3c37b8cb7b988e2648c18bbaaa72989eb41c2c8b.text: 殺死 5 目標小兵。 [5..0] 剩餘的目標兵。

29bfc8290aae05ca70099a787b0a0afc8d83050b.source: Jinzo will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
29bfc8290aae05ca70099a787b0a0afc8d83050b.text: 當你接受任務時，金藏會教你以下技能：

f61a0f1ad26e57af769fed7f64223f80a8e57271.source: Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Headmaster Lee. Walk outside Shing Jea Monastery to Sunqua Vale. Then head up north, and walk for about 1 minute to reach Jinzo. Talk to Jinzo again to start the quest proper. Simply kill the five Bone Horrors as they appear to complete the quest. Vun Ying, your fellow student, will help you out.
