f61a0f1ad26e57af769fed7f64223f80a8e57271.text: 將旅行地圖對映到 星岬寺 並與李校長交談。走出 星岬寺 前往 桑泉谷。然後往北走，步行約 1 分鐘即可到達神藏。再次與 Jinzo 交談以正確開始任務。只要在五個骸骨怪物出現時殺死它們即可完成任務。你的同學 Vun Ying 會幫助你。

dc28b5e3519310bdcfb23ddacb98e2da15f49214.source: Kill Inquisitor Bauer in Scoundrel's Rise
dc28b5e3519310bdcfb23ddacb98e2da15f49214.text: 在 惡漢山丘 中殺死審判官鮑爾

ef91513dbff543e4b635584a87c9c8c823b030b2.source: *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Bauer in Hard Mode
ef91513dbff543e4b635584a87c9c8c823b030b2.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死審判官鮑爾

9c34cd113e2a91faf32ae161f4753176ee0d2318.source: Start from Gates of Kryta (outpost) and fight through three groups of mergoyles. As you arrive to the wider area, Bauer's dialogue will trigger. Make sure you don't aggro surrounding groups or pull his group with a bow. Kill him and return to Salma for your rewards.
9c34cd113e2a91faf32ae161f4753176ee0d2318.text: 從 科瑞塔關所（前哨站）開始，對抗三組水滴怪。當你到達更廣闊的區域時，鮑爾的對話就會觸發。確保你不會激怒周圍的隊伍或用弓拉他的隊伍。殺死他並返回薩爾瑪那裡領取獎勵。

6d9474377db321958559451938c37b3447e7fafa.source: Some players find it easy to vanquish the area with this quest active: by the time you have killed Bauer, a large portion of the total number of foes have already been defeated.
6d9474377db321958559451938c37b3447e7fafa.text: 有些玩家發現啟動此任務後很容易征服該地區：當你殺死鮑爾時，敵人總數的很大一部分已經被擊敗。

92e0ee5f05095e6375bb3409394476336bf2f2c5.source: You can also kill Joh the Hostile who is nearby. If you are a warrior or a necromancer and capturing elite skills, consider capturing both of these elites in the same run.
92e0ee5f05095e6375bb3409394476336bf2f2c5.text: 你也可以殺死附近的敵對喬。如果您是戰士或死靈法師並掌握了精英技能，請考慮在同一回合中捕獲這兩種精英。

039fec42dd74e2104ba017fb81d08fbd0393dcd6.source: Bauer will not spawn if Heirlooms of the Mad King (the Halloween quest) is active.
039fec42dd74e2104ba017fb81d08fbd0393dcd6.text: 如果瘋狂國王的傳家寶（激戰萬聖節 任務）處於活動狀態，鮑爾將不會生成。

bef3a2ddf05693e123f3c335335c4c9de56942e1.source: Destroy the three groups of White Mantle vanguard marching to Quarrel Falls.
bef3a2ddf05693e123f3c335335c4c9de56942e1.text: 消滅三組 怨言瀑布 進軍的 白斗篷 先鋒隊。

c08e190757fcec12a68919908526b21a2990ff3f.source: See Councilor Vaylor for your reward.
c08e190757fcec12a68919908526b21a2990ff3f.text: 請參閱 維勒委員 以取得獎勵。

5cdc41f282afc7b822e5bc21e62b83829de90107.source:
Chaos Dmg: 9-16 (Requires 5 Domination Magic)
Health +10
Health +10 (while Hexed)
Health +10 (while Enchanted)
5cdc41f282afc7b822e5bc21e62b83829de90107.text:
混沌 Dmg：9-16（需 5 支配魔法）
體力 +10
體力 +10（十六進位時）
體力 +10（同時 附魔）

a4fe7e4a2c4111f1dc694f49634be4be72363886.source: This quest is quite straightforward: walk into Silverwood and kill the three groups of White Mantle located where the quest markers indicate. Each group consists of two White Mantle Knights and a White Mantle Sycophant. The final group is located very close to the entrance to Ettin's Back. Dispatch them and then head into Ettin's Back to locate Councilor Vaylor for the reward. Councilor Vaylor is located right outside the entrance to Ventari's Refuge.
a4fe7e4a2c4111f1dc694f49634be4be72363886.text: 這個任務非常簡單：走進銀樹並殺死任務標記指示的三組白斗篷。每組由兩名 白斗篷 騎士和一名 白斗篷追隨者 組成。最後一組非常靠近 雙頭怪隱匿地 的入口。派遣他們，然後前往 雙頭怪隱匿地 找到 維勒委員 以獲得獎勵。 維勒委員 位於 凡特里避難所 入口外。

830807a8f22fb028c46e22aa4c0b1d7a25e88fa8.source: The Cane awarded has the Deadly Cesta skin. The stats on that wand cannot be replicated, since there are no Wand Wrappings nor Inscriptions that increase maximum health.
830807a8f22fb028c46e22aa4c0b1d7a25e88fa8.text: 授予的 藤杖 具有 致命短棒 皮膚。此魔杖上的統計資料無法複製，因為沒有 手杖 包裹物或銘文可以增加最大生命值。

0f5cf9b63407b9e1c7188a1c6c227641351c1c82.source: Additional White Mantle groups will spawn in Ettin's Back, but they are likely to be attacked by Centaurs, and do not have to be fought for the quest.
0f5cf9b63407b9e1c7188a1c6c227641351c1c82.text: 額外的 白斗篷 小組將在 雙頭怪隱匿地 中生成，但他們很可能會受到半人馬的攻擊，並且不必為任務而戰鬥。

cd0e0c08067ce2afbd3d1d93bdd127a0ad208ff3.source: After fighting the roaming Centaurs, take a detour again to the east (point 2). Place the Vine Seed over the round mark to form a bridge. Head South to where you will find the two Centaur chieftains (point 3): Ramtha Brokenhoof and Horm Frostrider. You can use the high-ground advantage of the entry slope to pull separate groups of Centaurs. Two other centaur bosses will spawn close to your objective bosses, so be careful not to mix them up. After killing Ramtha and Horm, the bonus completion message will display.
cd0e0c08067ce2afbd3d1d93bdd127a0ad208ff3.text: 與漫遊的半人馬戰鬥後，再次繞道向東（點 2 ）。將藤蔓種子放在圓形標記上 型態 一座橋。向南走去你會發現兩個人的地方 半人馬 酋長（點 3 )：拉姆薩斷蹄和霍姆霜行者。你可以利用入口斜坡的高地優勢來拉動單獨的半人馬群。另外兩個半人馬 Boss 會在你的目標 Boss 附近生成，所以要小心不要把它們搞混。殺死拉姆薩和霍姆後，將顯示獎勵完成訊息。

b387ae4af298efd6ee8476fa355490af4eee95fa.source: Moss Scarabs use Vampiric Touch, take skills that protect against life stealing (e. g. Shielding Hands).
b387ae4af298efd6ee8476fa355490af4eee95fa.text: 苔蘚聖甲蟲使用 吸血鬼之觸，採取防止生命竊取的技能（例如 防禦之手）。

5a98277a030e66c2e0d6c6e90d4fe23cbb828606.source: Life Pods spawn together and heal each other, use anti-caster skills (e. g. Backfire).
5a98277a030e66c2e0d6c6e90d4fe23cbb828606.text: 生命 Pod 一起產生並互相治療，使用反施法者技巧（例如 魔力反噬）。

03c9c9398738ff691155404afe60f26f1101d17c.source: Enchantment-heavy parties will benefit from the Centaurs' Symbiosis, but be aware that Wind Riders have Shatter Enchantment.
03c9c9398738ff691155404afe60f26f1101d17c.text: 重視 加持魔法 的各方將從半人馬的 共生 中受益，但請注意，風騎者擁有 加持粉碎。

1550c8a04828c153a45cac8b2e3dba88476a557e.source: Favor slashing and fire damage, since Plants (Life Pods and Entangling Roots) are weak to it, and avoid cold damage, as Centaurs have bonus resistance against it.
1550c8a04828c153a45cac8b2e3dba88476a557e.text: 優先選擇砍伐和火焰傷害，因為植物（生命 Pods 和纏繞根）對此較弱，並避免寒冷傷害，因為半人馬對它有額外的抵抗力。

2696ad77088584b69d43ff51dd71d1eb43c7208e.source: Early in the mission, Moss Scarabs with Verata's Gaze present difficulty to a minion master, but you will not encounter any more after the first bridge. Maguuma Enchanters with Blackout, Wind Riders with Arcane Conundrum, and Maguuma Spiders with Punishing Shot threaten healers.
2696ad77088584b69d43ff51dd71d1eb43c7208e.text: 在任務初期，帶有 芙瑞達的凝視 的苔蘚聖甲蟲會給小兵大師帶來困難，但在第一座橋之後你將不會再遇到任何困難。 梅古瑪 附魔者使用 意識喪失，駕馭者使用 思緒混亂，梅古瑪 蜘蛛使用 懲罰之箭 威脅治療師。

e6fb6b9b2a15c75f66d30f849b83cf8eaeefdf1a.source: Runic stones are found around the north-east lake.
e6fb6b9b2a15c75f66d30f849b83cf8eaeefdf1a.text: 在東北湖周圍發現了符文石。

5a7894392330818602aab50ac96b242282ab5d40.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #3 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
5a7894392330818602aab50ac96b242282ab5d40.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#3 頁。

0f09d6fb9527ae6f5f1798fa2cf6cccc8fad32e3.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Bloodstone Fen.
0f09d6fb9527ae6f5f1798fa2cf6cccc8fad32e3.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 血石沼澤。

48c778c31c6586f27a0623029ae6b4137311c287.source: In the line "The leaders of the two strongest Centaur tribes are on the verge of an agreement." the word "verge" is sometimes censored by the game's chat filter. It is possible that after destroying an Entangling Roots, the vine wall will vanish but still be impassable, preventing you from progressing with the mission. It is suspected this happens when the Entangling Roots is killed (by other creatures or from a distance) before the wall appears. It is possible that killing both Centaur chieftains will not give credit for completion of the bonus objective. The bonus will have to be repeated in this case, although the mission can still be completed as normal.
48c778c31c6586f27a0623029ae6b4137311c287.text: 在「兩個最強大的 半人馬 部落的領導人即將達成協議」這一行中。 「邊緣」這個詞有時會被遊戲的聊天過濾器審查。摧毀纏繞樹根後，藤蔓牆可能會消失，但仍然無法通行，從而阻止你完成任務。人們懷疑，當纏繞之根在牆壁出現之前被殺死（被其他生物或從遠處殺死）時，就會發生這種情況。殺死兩個 半人馬 酋長可能不會獎勵完成獎勵目標。在這種情況下，儘管任務仍然可以正常完成，但必須重複獎勵。

b09fba721018450a5839af175d3f7937ea8c9eb6.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Silverwood and start the mission. Completing The Wilds also brings the party here.
b09fba721018450a5839af175d3f7937ea8c9eb6.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 銀樹 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 荒原 也將聚會帶到這裡。

f94af1824feda43d4a1414101392598c135dd03c.source: Seek the truth about the White Mantle.
f94af1824feda43d4a1414101392598c135dd03c.text: 尋求有關 白斗篷 的真相。

3653256b2b48b50c6d5a584be95d3a48b45a7ba3.source: Locate Blade Scout Ryder. He'll take you to the Bloodstone.
3653256b2b48b50c6d5a584be95d3a48b45a7ba3.text: 找到 光刃公會斥候萊德。他將帶您前往 血石。

962f67e385d8812904dcd995df642cdf073153ef.source: Use the vine bridges to traverse the jungle.

7370a43ac73beb5d9cf76e34bd32d6657e8962cc.source: ADDED: Travel on to the Bloodstone on your own.
7370a43ac73beb5d9cf76e34bd32d6657e8962cc.text: 新增：自行前往 血石。

1487d2d42754c530343e217470c840b3b263726d.source: ADDED: Avenge the chosen by killing Justiciar Hablion and his personal guards.
1487d2d42754c530343e217470c840b3b263726d.text: 新增：殺死 判官哈布里恩 和他的私人守衛，為選民報仇。

3c39ae1fc88f39e627a21e2f94e28862c1fef83b.source: *BONUS* Awaken the Druids while preserving their guardians.
3c39ae1fc88f39e627a21e2f94e28862c1fef83b.text: *獎勵* 喚醒德魯伊，同時保護他們的守護者。

7b14cd0d29da5300e407f05018e1a714a4be282c.source: This quest may be taken prematurely if the player follows the quests Mysterious Message and The Price of Steel to Quarrel Falls. In doing so, the player could miss the storyline of The Wilds and Bloodstone Fen, which precedes White Mantle Wrath: Demagogue's Vanguard, as indicated by the quest's dialogue. There's a chance of Centaurs spawning and attacking the last group of White Mantle. If they kill any White Mantle before the player, the quest might not update, forcing the player to restart from Quarrel Falls.
7b14cd0d29da5300e407f05018e1a714a4be282c.text: 如果玩家執行任務 機密資訊 和 鋼鐵的價值 到 怨言瀑布，則該任務可能會提前進行。這樣做時，玩家可能會錯過 荒原 和 血石沼澤 的故事情節，後者先於 白斗篷公會的復仇：煽動者的先鋒隊，如任務對話所示。半人馬有機會生成並攻擊最後一組 白斗篷。如果他們在玩家之前殺死任何 白斗篷，任務可能不會更新，迫使玩家從 怨言瀑布 重新啟動。

befdd643d0daf1115c7f12de5440a8a32eb86143.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Centaur Blackmail.
befdd643d0daf1115c7f12de5440a8a32eb86143.text: 所有黨員必須接受 半人馬 勒索的獎勵。

65da9f1326c0f382ca652ca0d81c68fd7d4492f9.source: Zhed Shadowhoof must be present in the party.
65da9f1326c0f382ca652ca0d81c68fd7d4492f9.text: 傑德·影蹄必須出現在隊伍中。

131328dc1292cbaf10fa7beaa36f634a1e8854d4.source: Rescue Mirza Veldrunner from the Kournans.
131328dc1292cbaf10fa7beaa36f634a1e8854d4.text: 從庫南家族手中救出米爾扎·維德倫納。

c37068c423952d09419ccd885078be512b768272.source: Defeat Kournan Taskmasters to get cell keys.
c37068c423952d09419ccd885078be512b768272.text: 擊敗庫爾南模仿者以獲得細胞鑰匙。

bb12ee8a511270727c73d2f150ab66ec8497ce4e.source: Your party has [0...6] cell keys. Use a cell key to open a cell.
bb12ee8a511270727c73d2f150ab66ec8497ce4e.text: 您的隊伍擁有 [0...6] 手機金鑰。使用單元鍵開啟單元。

d47bbafb18c80ce17a6a12e9dd3ecf641e05a97d.source: Free additional Veldrunner Centaurs to build a resistance force. You have [6...0] more cells to unlock.
d47bbafb18c80ce17a6a12e9dd3ecf641e05a97d.text: 釋放更多的 Veldrunner 半人馬來建立抵抗力量。您還有 [6...0] 個單元格需要解鎖。

6ad57168adbbe30d976ea4024994f0bcf3d029b5.source: Defeat Overseer Boktek and Overseer Haubeh.
6ad57168adbbe30d976ea4024994f0bcf3d029b5.text: 擊敗督軍博克泰克和督軍豪貝。

7fe79c7edd24dc4244617aac3cafb51f30e69593.source: You have [3...0] of 3 cruel Taskmasters remaining.
7fe79c7edd24dc4244617aac3cafb51f30e69593.text: 您還剩下 [3...0] 個 3 殘忍的監工。

149cab4a73e4060bb8cc77204e9b7327a3fc88c7.source: After being freed, avoid the first group and go directly east to take out Taskmaster Suli. Make your way counter-clockwise across the estate killing the remaining Bonus Taskmasters. Since the fortress forces only spawn after all 6 centaurs have been freed, one can walk near the fortress without much concern.
149cab4a73e4060bb8cc77204e9b7327a3fc88c7.text: 獲釋後，避開第一組，直接向東去幹掉模仿大師蘇力。逆時針穿過莊園，殺死剩餘的 額外獎勵 工頭。由於要塞部隊僅在所有 6 半人馬釋放後才會生成，因此人們可以在要塞附近行走而無需擔心。

36eb342b9088a90d1aa50a9e33dd7f046731a3f2.source: The bonus is to find and kill 3 cruel Taskmasters and their groups before the fort assault.
36eb342b9088a90d1aa50a9e33dd7f046731a3f2.text: 獎勵是在攻擊堡壘之前找到並殺死 3 殘忍的監工及其團體。

ede8f741c88b218e434418c6de3c3b03a25e3ca1.source: Taskmaster Sadi-Belai, is to the east just past the eastern most cell. This boss spams Zealous Benediction which makes her difficult to overcome, engage her only after getting rid of the approaching patrol.
ede8f741c88b218e434418c6de3c3b03a25e3ca1.text: 監工薩迪-貝萊 (Sadi-Belai) 位於東邊，剛剛經過最東邊的牢房。這個老闆向 狂熱祝福 傳送垃圾郵件，這使得她很難克服，只有在擺脫逼近的巡邏隊後才能與她交戰。

1ad21e05ebd65e2f2c1ff80b2ff61479f110bdaa.source: Taskmaster Vanahk is on the small island at the east.
1ad21e05ebd65e2f2c1ff80b2ff61479f110bdaa.text: 監工瓦納克就在東部的小島上。

76c26ca487bfda86279fa418005633e5e658b7bc.source: Taskmaster Suli is south of the fort.

8a713c2aed2290e2a716346b3d2d18cf54273d7d.source: The final groups of foes within the fortress are primarily tightly packed casters. Panic and other AoE denial will have great impact on them.
8a713c2aed2290e2a716346b3d2d18cf54273d7d.text: 要塞內的最後一批敵人主要是緊密擁擠的腳輪。 恐慌 和其他 範圍性 的拒絕將對他們產生很大的影響。

4d280fcf6261a411c26d11186948fecd421bf6bd.source: If you let the level 24 Veldrunner Centaur (boss) die, you can capture the elite skill Smoke Trap from him.
4d280fcf6261a411c26d11186948fecd421bf6bd.text: 如果你讓關卡24 Veldrunner 半人馬（頭目）死亡，你可以從他那裡奪取精英技能煙霧陷阱。

070e26ac118425242b7ba4e41e0d239be42e3fa1.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Sunspear Sanctuary.
070e26ac118425242b7ba4e41e0d239be42e3fa1.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 日戟避難所。

869d317d86d2f587a52561797c7e32d43f69bf96.source: Sometimes when the mission is finished, The Hunger will appear briefly, presumably for the cinematic's sake.
869d317d86d2f587a52561797c7e32d43f69bf96.text: 有時，當任務完成時，飢餓會短暫出現，大概是為了電影的緣故。

c7c7def6e4d5e6b60d33771d2b7b59bb7541d64d.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #3 in the Night Falls storybook.
c7c7def6e4d5e6b60d33771d2b7b59bb7541d64d.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#3 頁。

138eace87352b85c7a5097f04f7a4766dc8498e0.source: Unlike the other Veldrunner Centaurs, the Veldrunner Centaur boss does not appear in the party window and gives the party a morale boost if killed by enemies. It is sometimes possible for NPCs to walk through the final gate while it is still closed. This is most likely to happen to the Kournan Priests inside, as they try to heal enemies outside. Because the Veldrunner Centaur and Haroj Firemane allies only follow the party leader and do not follow Hero/Henchmen "flag" move commands, it is possible to get permanently boxed into corners by these allied NPCs with no escape, forcing the player to resign or quit.
138eace87352b85c7a5097f04f7a4766dc8498e0.text: 與其他 Veldrunner 半人馬不同，Veldrunner 半人馬 Boss 不會出現在隊伍視窗中，並且如果被敵人殺死，會給隊伍帶來士氣提升。有時，NPC 有可能在最後一道門仍關閉時穿過它。這最有可能發生在內部的庫爾南祭司身上，因為他們試圖治癒外部的敵人。由於 Veldrunner 半人馬 和 Haroj Firemane 盟友只跟隨隊伍領袖，而不遵循 英雄/傭兵「旗幟」移動命令，因此有可能被這些盟友 NPC 永久困在角落裡而無法逃脫，迫使玩家辭職或退出。

e6dfdbcab833f2e3b3cde3c3fa2fababe6d61127.source: Seek out Panaku in Kinya Province.
e6dfdbcab833f2e3b3cde3c3fa2fababe6d61127.text: 在 欣彌領地 中尋找帕納庫。

8c4faacd293c90936d3d94c9513a66a4c2f23190.source: After completing the Opening Strike quest, speak with Jinzo at point A on the map. After accepting this quest, take the path to the north-west, then west through the courtyard of Minister Cho's Estate. Just past the courtyard you will encounter a group of 2-3 Crimson Skull. You'll find two more groups further down the path, along with a boss, Yingko the Skull Claw. You will likely not be high enough level to take him on, so simply continue through Tomaat Pass to Kinya Province; following the path on the map until you reach Panaku.
8c4faacd293c90936d3d94c9513a66a4c2f23190.text: 完成開局打擊任務後，與地圖上A點的金藏交談。接受這個任務後，沿著小路向西北走，然後向西穿過趙部長莊園的庭院。剛過庭院，就會遇到一群 2-3 紅顱。沿著這條路，你會發現另外兩個小組，還有一個 Boss，骷髏爪英科。您的等級可能不夠高，無法與他較量，因此只需繼續穿過 Tomaat Pass 到達 欣彌領地；沿著地圖上的路徑行駛，直到您到達帕納庫。

2f67dade5e3ac85e39b342b9f2c4be39fbdafdfb.source: Kill Inquisitor Lovisa in Watchtower Coast
2f67dade5e3ac85e39b342b9f2c4be39fbdafdfb.text: 在 瞭望塔海岸 中殺死審判官洛維薩

55078cd3b1577934367b6c3c14cd07414f6649d7.source: *BONUS* Kill Inquisitor Lovisa in Hard Mode
55078cd3b1577934367b6c3c14cd07414f6649d7.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死審判官洛維薩

995020a23f1c2a2641ac383498a610d7a831f0e1.source: Carefully clear the surrounding groups before engaging Lovisa's. Pull her group out of range of the Missing Children's Adoration. It is possible to lure all other White Mantle units away from Lovisa.
995020a23f1c2a2641ac383498a610d7a831f0e1.text: 在與洛維薩的隊伍交戰之前，請小心清除周圍的隊伍。 拉出 她的團隊脫離了失蹤兒童崇拜的範圍。可以將所有其他 白斗篷 單位引誘遠離 Lovisa。

73806bdc17bfe70454e3561e036011c94b67027e.source: Lovisa refers to the spell Adoration when she tells the Missing Children to "give me your strength".
73806bdc17bfe70454e3561e036011c94b67027e.text: 當洛維薩告訴失蹤兒童“給我你的力量”時，她提到了崇拜咒語。

1799fa4470742d36fa5bc12c8f2320f5c4f869fd.source: If The Undead Hordes is active, waves of undead will engage the Mantle on the northeast route from Beetletun towards the beach.
1799fa4470742d36fa5bc12c8f2320f5c4f869fd.text: 如果 不死族群 處於活動狀態，不死生物的浪潮將從 甲蟲鎮 到海灘的東北路線上與地幔交戰。

784d86f8b1e8335f0a58381fc3a77acd7426062b.source: Lovisa might not spawn if Riverside Assassination is active for one or more party members.
784d86f8b1e8335f0a58381fc3a77acd7426062b.text: 如果一名或多名隊伍成員的 科瑞塔戰爭主線任務 處於活動狀態，洛維薩可能不會產生。

654abde6143ec2102955ec7a1d24f788dd4bdb5a.source: If a White Mantle Ritualist appears with Lovisa, the spirits it summons will be allied with you but you do not receive any benefits from them, nor can you attack them.
654abde6143ec2102955ec7a1d24f788dd4bdb5a.text: 如果白斗篷祭祀者與Lovisa一起出現，它召喚的靈魂將與你結盟，但你不會從他們那裡得到任何好處，也不能攻擊他們。

12e5a24e2b6631f43ab12f53e5c1a400794436db.source: This quest was available again for some characters, after completion of the first three Hearts of the North missions.
12e5a24e2b6631f43ab12f53e5c1a400794436db.text: 在完成前三個 極地之心 任務後，某些角色可以再次使用此任務。

cac3383c56a92a14b8143ecb6752d3152e183a48.text: 與 凡特里 交談

3e53feedf7dca9fba78c75700bca0151d81ca7be.source: Defeat the forces surrounding Ventari's Refuge.
3e53feedf7dca9fba78c75700bca0151d81ca7be.text: 擊敗 凡特里避難所 周圍的勢力。

a53f0085020c0846ed3a400564f3c807cabff46d.source: Return to Councilor Vaylor for your reward.
a53f0085020c0846ed3a400564f3c807cabff46d.text: 影返 至 維勒委員 以獲得獎勵。

aec889cd166fafe0fab52fe33895f858ec34ae0c.source: The Shining Blade allies outside Ventari's Refuge remain present after the quest is completed.
aec889cd166fafe0fab52fe33895f858ec34ae0c.text: 任務完成後，凡特里避難所 以外的 光刃公會 盟友仍然存在。

ea822337a96dd61c237383c95521b63f2c54ed43.source: Go into Ventari's Refuge and speak with Ventari. He is an old centaur who has become a pacifist, and will offer no help in fighting the White Mantle or anything else. Return outside and fight off the three groups of Mantle that have caught up with you.
ea822337a96dd61c237383c95521b63f2c54ed43.text: 進入 凡特里避難所 並與 凡特里 交談。他是一個已成為和平主義者的老半人馬，不會在對抗 白斗篷 或其他任何東西方面提供任何幫助。 影返 到外面並擊退追上你的三組 Mantle。

66b334493321080466ae1a5b73ef2412bc1ec72b.source: All three groups consist of 2 White Mantle Knights and 1 White Mantle Sycophant. You will also get help from 3 groups of Shining Blade, each consisting of a Shining Blade Elementalist, a Shining Blade Mesmer, and a Shining Blade Necromancer. Once the White Mantle are defeated, return to Councilor Vaylor and claim the reward.
66b334493321080466ae1a5b73ef2412bc1ec72b.text: 所有三個組別均由 2 白斗篷 Knights 和 1 白斗篷追隨者 組成。您還將獲得 光刃公會 的 3 群組的協助，每個群組由 光刃公會 元素使、光刃公會 幻術師 和 光刃公會 死靈法師 組成。一旦 白斗篷 被擊敗，請返回 維勒委員 並領取獎勵。

02f721b14265171176d874e6c6dba817129ab448.source: Speak with Panaku again when you are ready to go to the Tengu village.
02f721b14265171176d874e6c6dba817129ab448.text: 當您準備好前往 天狗 村莊時，再次與帕納庫交談。

c1cf72d9716d4671257b39df435987589bb56971.source: Travel with Panaku to the Tengu village of Aerie and assassinate Swift Honorclaw.
c1cf72d9716d4671257b39df435987589bb56971.text: 與帕納庫一起前往艾利的 天狗 村莊並暗殺 史威夫 榮譽爪。

b198dbfb78e84c2cb26d18a520c7901111afb793.source: Panaku will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
b198dbfb78e84c2cb26d18a520c7901111afb793.text: 當你接受任務時，帕納庫會教你以下技能：

512dc719eeff14345bd9712c0633a668992365ee.source: After setting your new skills in your skillbar, talk to Panaku at point A on the map and go west towards the beach. At the beach turn right (north). You will see a group of Naga there, kill those and continue by following the road on your right hand (going east at first then north again). Here Panaku will speak again twice. As you approach Swift Honorclaw he will taunt you and then turn hostile. Kill him and speak to Panaku to collect your reward.
512dc719eeff14345bd9712c0633a668992365ee.text: 在技能欄中設定新技能後，與地圖上 A 點的帕納庫交談，然後向西前往海灘。在海灘右轉（向北）。你會在那裡看到一群 納迦，殺死它們並繼續沿著右手邊的路走（先向東，然後再向北）。這裡帕納庫又要講兩次。當你接近 史威夫 Honorclaw 時，他會嘲笑你，然後變得充滿敵意。殺死他並與帕納庫交談以領取獎勵。

5521fa1de08e22ca390eb8a4903b1c8748682bd4.source: Your target doesn't spawn until you tell Panaku to start the assassination. Dragon Festival quests will interfere with the completion of this quest.
5521fa1de08e22ca390eb8a4903b1c8748682bd4.text: 在你告訴帕納庫開始暗殺之前，你的目標不會出現。端午節任務會幹擾該任務的完成。

188d136c736db4404497a6d31da4fd9bfa4e9fe5.text: 與格雷琴的偵察兵會面。

23545cd6cc76d1af7a7e996b6a46c5a5155a0211.source: See Elder Gretchen for your reward.
23545cd6cc76d1af7a7e996b6a46c5a5155a0211.text: 請參閱 長老格雷琴 以取得獎勵。

83a22a2571080b4f56bd2d55a875d666a77d2241.text: 削減傷害：6-25（需要8 精通斧術）

e18bcf1cad8b16839f9279e2505ef0d83310ca8b.source: This quest is very straightforward: journey your way towards Snakebite, then head northeast to Aurora Glade, and speak to Elder Gretchen for your reward.
e18bcf1cad8b16839f9279e2505ef0d83310ca8b.text: 這個任務非常簡單：一路前往蛇咬，然後向東北方向前往 歐若拉林地，並與 長老格雷琴 交談以獲得獎勵。

2fff811ec5200ef55be4b37df47dbe8477f316aa.source: Originally, the Battle Axe given as a reward had lower maximum damage and different modifiers, those being "Energy +3 (while Enchanted)" and "Energy +5 (while Hexed)". It is unknown in which update this was modified.
2fff811ec5200ef55be4b37df47dbe8477f316aa.text: 最初，作為獎勵給予的 戰斧 具有較低的最大傷害和不同的修飾符，即「能量 +3（當 附魔）」和「能量 +5（當 Hexed）」。目前尚不清楚這是在哪個更新中修改的。

f791c29564fb6c265c21e118f771d5a3936f34b7.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Ettin's Back and start the mission.
f791c29564fb6c265c21e118f771d5a3936f34b7.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 雙頭怪隱匿地 走進前哨站並開始任務。

3e1d46b5e37c5e8157bf8f425d0f2b9d98aca006.source: Gain access to the Henge of Denravi.

aa743068e1ef7554ca7e019393c25a457f213eab.text: 前往 丹拉維聖地傳送門。

46ebcf4835f8057c52df479f1e72f5b44a10db71.source: Attune the Henge Portal before the White Mantle do.
46ebcf4835f8057c52df479f1e72f5b44a10db71.text: 在 白斗篷 之前調節 丹拉維聖地傳送門。

a1cd80f37884b546ea31bb30dc048a1c97ef232b.source: ADDED: Attune the thorn pedestal to clear the vine gate.
a1cd80f37884b546ea31bb30dc048a1c97ef232b.text: 新增：調整荊棘基座以清除藤蔓門。

d1421ea868bf6e409482d3a0df95feb758e69cfe.source: ADDED: Attune both thorn pedestals to clear the vine gate.
d1421ea868bf6e409482d3a0df95feb758e69cfe.text: 新增：調整兩個荊棘基座以清除藤蔓門。

a1d055e841e0f688a1e58912303c4086ad35cd51.source: Players start the mission looking for Blade Scout Ryder and his party. Saidra informs the party that Ryder has gone ahead and drops a Vine Seed. Drop the seed on the designated spot to create a vine bridge. Along the way there are 3 more Vine Seed Flowers (points A and C) which, when clicked, yield a Vine Seed to create bridges at spots marked by a glowing circle on the jungle floor (several of which are marked B on the map).
a1d055e841e0f688a1e58912303c4086ad35cd51.text: 玩家開始任務尋找 光刃公會斥候萊德 和他的政黨。賽德拉通知隊伍，萊德已經繼續前進，並掉落了一顆藤蔓種子。將種子撒在指定地點，形成一座藤橋。一路上有 3 更多藤蔓種子花（點 A 和 C），單擊時會產生藤蔓種子，可在叢林地面上以發光圓圈標記的地點（其中幾個在地圖上標記為 B）處建立橋梁。

90315d3ddabadcced6e779b61474ad0c985e71c4.text: 新增：殺死 聖地守護者。

b68ddee681ed2f3af6be5738ad591c07bba924bb.source: The first part of this mission is typical: hack and slash through the usual Maguuma Jungle foes and bosses. Things change drastically when you reach the Druids.
b68ddee681ed2f3af6be5738ad591c07bba924bb.text: 任務的第一部分很典型：砍殺常見的 梅古瑪叢林 敵人和頭目。當你到達德魯伊時，事情就會發生巨大的變化。

ef0ed03a9bbcc32e8c07076a8d476d9e0be97c8f.source: The goal of the mission is to attune a set of three thorn pedestals simultaneously, while preventing the White Mantle from doing the same thing. Attuning the set clears the Vine Gate, giving your party access to the Henge Guardian; defeating it completes the mission.
ef0ed03a9bbcc32e8c07076a8d476d9e0be97c8f.text: 這個任務的目標是同時調整一組三個荊棘基座，同時防止 白斗篷 做同樣的事情。調整裝置可清除藤門，讓您的隊伍能夠存取 聖地守護者；打敗它就完成了任務。

004b784529a0e590842bcdda40522b6f21d3ea4b.source: There are two types of pedestals:

73a8521ab8221bf30a242ae4d01b3c29341fb809.source: Spawn-pedestals are attended by a single Druid. Talk to the Druid once to enable the pedestal to produce crystals; click on the pedestal to get a crystal. That pedestal will not produce a crystal until the currently-carried one is dropped or used.
73a8521ab8221bf30a242ae4d01b3c29341fb809.text: 生成基座由一個 德魯依 負責。與德魯依對話一次，讓底座產生水晶；點選底座即可獲得水晶。在目前攜帶的水晶被掉落或使用之前，該底座不會產生水晶。

4733582b095178390a814d17667757f9c82a0900.source: Attunement-pedestals are empty until your party or the Mantle add a crystal; they also have a beam of light pointing upwards. The light is white when the pedestal is empty; it changes to blue when your team claims it; and it becomes red when the Mantle attune it.
4733582b095178390a814d17667757f9c82a0900.text: 協調基座是空的，直到您的隊伍或斗篷新增水晶為止；它們還有一束指向上方的光束。當基座空時，燈為白色；當你的團隊認領它時，它會變成藍色；當地幔對其進行調諧時，它會變成紅色。

b29e7b992a8905fbf50e57287aeaea6b109be4de.source: If you drop a crystal, it will break and you must grab a new one (and you will drop it anytime you switch weapons or shadowstep). As with any bundle, while carrying crystals, you do not gain the benefit of any of your weapon mods.
b29e7b992a8905fbf50e57287aeaea6b109be4de.text: 如果你掉落了一顆水晶，它就會破碎，你必須抓住一個新的（並且每當你切換武器或暗影步時你都會掉落它）。與任何捆綁包一樣，攜帶水晶時，您不會獲得任何武器模組的好處。

901ab41871cc853f12f671d0dc9cfea8c0795933.source: When you attune the southernmost pedestal, it opens a vine-gate allowing you to proceed northward. (The Mantle do not attempt to attune this pedestal.) After following the path, you will find Less Longbow: dispose of his attackers and talk to him to unlock the Bonus.
901ab41871cc853f12f671d0dc9cfea8c0795933.text: 當你調整最南端的基座時，它會開啟一扇藤門，讓你可以向北前進。 （斗篷不會嘗試調整這個基座。）沿著路徑走後，你會發現 長弓雷斯：處理掉他的攻擊者並與他交談以解鎖 額外獎勵。

0bcce0dbec98641feabbd0aed64d911c65d6dd80.source: East of Less is another area with three thorn-pedestals. One is a spawn-pedestal, one attunement-pedestal has already been claimed by the Mantle, and the third will be unclaimed. There are several ways to proceed at this point. Generally, you want to defeat the two groups of Mantle (including a Boss), visit the spawn-pedestal, talk to the Druid, grab a crystal, claim the right attunement-pedestal and eventually claim the leftmost pedestal, which opens another vine-gate at the eastern end of the area.
0bcce0dbec98641feabbd0aed64d911c65d6dd80.text: 萊斯東邊是另一個擁有三個荊棘基座的區域。一個是生成基座，一個協調基座已被地函認領，第三個將無人認領。此時有幾種方法可以繼續。一般來說，你想擊敗兩組地幔（包括 頭目），訪問產卵基座，與 德魯依 交談，抓住水晶，佔領右側的協調基座，並最終佔領最左邊的基座，這會在該區域的東端開啟另一個藤蔓門。

adbb88ef2ead376655a13ac881e07b9609388466.source: Once this gate opens, the race is on between your team and the White Mantle to claim the three pedestals in the large area to the East. A group of White Mantle will be escorting a single runner around the map to capture the pedestals, the crystal carrier will not engage in combat while the escorts will. There are several ways you can proceed at this point.
adbb88ef2ead376655a13ac881e07b9609388466.text: 一旦這扇門開啟，您的團隊和 白斗篷 之間的競賽就開始了，爭奪東部大片區域的三個基座。一群 白斗篷 將護送一名跑者在地圖上繞行以佔領基座，水晶運輸者不會參與戰鬥，而護送者則會參與戰鬥。此時您可以透過多種方式繼續操作。

f084d4810948d801a19af41291b9fd7927984456.source: Method 1: Kill all the Mantle at the left shrine
f084d4810948d801a19af41291b9fd7927984456.text: 方法1：殺死左側神殿的所有斗篷

0e99f47383cd6718fb5f90ba154d66225d4fc6cd.source: Your goal is to rescue the leader of the last free Centaur pride in Elona with the aid of other captive members. There are six Centaurs to liberate before assaulting the fort where Mirza Veldrunner is imprisoned. Each of their cells can be unlocked by obtaining a key from six taskmasters. These keys can be used by any party member to open any cell, but one at a time. Keep in mind that opening the cell in the middle, as well as the one closest to the fort, will trigger one patrol each to rush to the location.
0e99f47383cd6718fb5f90ba154d66225d4fc6cd.text: 您的目標是在其他俘虜成員的幫助下營救伊洛納最後一支自由 半人馬 獅群的首領。在攻擊囚禁米爾扎·維德倫納的堡壘之前，有六隻半人馬需要解放。他們的每個牢房都可以透過從六名監工那裡獲得一把鑰匙來解鎖。任何黨員都可以使用這些鑰匙開啟任何單元格，但一次只能開啟一個。請記住，開啟中間的牢房以及最靠近堡壘的牢房，將觸發每個巡邏隊趕往該位置。

bbe78e6e2aa6db6645d4acf9465f3db6fb973dac.source: Open your Mission Map (U) to pick a course and take care of patrols without engaging multiple groups at the same time. The far eastern cell holds a level 24 Veldrunner Centaur (boss) while the rest are level 20 regulars. It will not join the party window but will follow and help you fight. Haroj Firemane on the other hand, doesn't engage ever.
bbe78e6e2aa6db6645d4acf9465f3db6fb973dac.text: 開啟您的 主線任務 地圖 (U) 選擇路線並進行巡邏，而無需同時與多個團體進行交戰。遠東牢房擁有 24 等級的 Veldrunner 半人馬（頭目），而其餘的則是 20 等級的常客。它不會加入隊伍視窗，但會跟隨並幫助你戰鬥。另一方面，Haroj Firemane 則永遠不會參與。

297126148a84f66193cb3e1fd9cb467e56a16ca8.source: Once all Veldrunner Centaurs are freed, use these new trapper allies to rescue their leader.
297126148a84f66193cb3e1fd9cb467e56a16ca8.text: 一旦所有 Veldrunner 半人馬被釋放，請使用這些新的捕獵者盟友來營救他們的領導者。

15b705c736ce8a001c059eb5f20604dff6467242.source: Since the endeavour is time-consuming, it is wise to ensure the last step success by:
15b705c736ce8a001c059eb5f20604dff6467242.text: 由於這項工作非常耗時，因此明智的做法是透過以下方式確保最後一步成功：

8db1e49b8e8602e3babb2cf9e01148d7ee223ce0.source: Clearing both guarding groups at each side stairs before pressing to the main gate.
8db1e49b8e8602e3babb2cf9e01148d7ee223ce0.text: 在衝向大門之前，先清除兩側樓梯上的兩個守衛組。

571d33c85f1eeb672fd0e0228056246590b63b45.source: With a lot of casters in the player group, it is possible to eliminate many of the enemies inside beforehand (only the final 2 Overseers and the few mobs right next to them are unreachable). Keep in mind that this is only possible before freeing all 6 captive centaurs, and that the gate and walls will block projectile-based attacks.
571d33c85f1eeb672fd0e0228056246590b63b45.text: 玩家群中有很多施法者，可以提前消滅掉裡面的許多敵人（只有最後的2督軍和他們旁邊的幾個小怪是無法到達的）。請記住，這隻有在釋放所有 6 俘虜半人馬之前才有可能，並且大門和牆壁將阻止基於投射物的攻擊。

d07cd976986e41f662a8c50b1d74604f0726e576.source: The main gate itself will blast open and a few extra enemies will instantly spawn inside the fort, but only when a player approaches. It is possible to flag heroes/henchmen at the stairs (Centaur allies may follow a player) and once it opens, rush back to the stairs and then use one hero to lure enemies out of the fort. This method secures outnumbering the enemies and not the other way around.
d07cd976986e41f662a8c50b1d74604f0726e576.text: 主門本身會炸開，一些額外的敵人會立即在堡壘內產生，但只有當玩家接近時。可以在樓梯上標記英雄/追隨者（半人馬盟友可能會跟隨玩家），一旦開啟，衝回樓梯，然後使用一名英雄將敵人引出堡壘。這種方法可以確保在數量上超過敵人，而不是相反。

1dc6f5045c9d8bf76ed991804fed99789e08d6a7.source: Finally, eliminate the remaining forces plus the two Overseers (Boktek and Haubeh) to complete the mission.
1dc6f5045c9d8bf76ed991804fed99789e08d6a7.text: 最後，消滅剩餘部隊加上兩名督軍（Boktek 和 Haubeh）即可完成任務。

008994072fb18feaaf38c1be1262395ca1a06bb6.source: This works with a single player. Pick up a crystal and go to the left-most (east) pedestal; ignoring the shrine near the gate. You should arrive as the Mantle are leaving after capturing it. Do not engage at this point. Attune the pedestal, then flag your party around it. As the Mantle return to reclaim this pedestal first, go back to the entrance to grab another crystal, and then go to the pedestal at the far right (south-west) side and attune it. Alternate between claiming the left and right pedestals, as the Mantle will usually succeed in capturing your AI-held pedestal; however, if you have a good team, your party will kill the runner's escort each time. Because you never attuned the top right pedestal, the Mantle will never attempt to get it back, so you can focus on cycling between the other two pedestals without worrying about that one. An added benefit of leaving that pedestal is that even if the Mantle are slightly faster than you and hold both pedestals for a few seconds, you will not fail the mission since they never control all three. Eventually the only Mantle left will be the runner. You will know this when you no longer see your party taking damage. (Be careful not to capture all of the pedestals at once!) Rejoin your party and kill the runner, either by using snare/spike skills if you have them, or by positioning your team in the runner's path as they head to a pedestal. Kill the Demagogue (who will now be standing alone in the Mantle camp) and claim any remaining pedestals.
008994072fb18feaaf38c1be1262395ca1a06bb6.text: 這適用於單人玩家。拿起一個水晶並前往最左邊（東）的基座；忽略了大門附近的神社。你應該在捕獲地幔後離開時到達。此時請勿參與。調整基座，然後在其周圍標記您的隊伍。當當地幔返回並首先收回這個基座時，回到入口處獲取另一個水晶，然後前往最右側（西南）側的基座並調整它。交替佔領左右基座，因為斗篷通常會成功佔領你的人工智慧所持有的基座；但是，如果你有一支優秀的團隊，你的隊伍每次都會殺死跑步者的護衛。因為您從未調整過右上方的基座，所以地幔永遠不會嘗試將其恢復，因此您可以專注於在其他兩個基座之間騎行，而不必擔心那個基座。離開該基座的另一個好處是，即使地幔比你稍快並保持兩個基座幾秒鐘，你也不會失敗任務，因為他們永遠不會控制所有三個基座。最終剩下的唯一的地幔將是跑步者。當你不再看到你的隊伍受到傷害時你就會知道這一點。 （小心不要一次佔領所有基座！）重新加入你的隊伍並殺死跑步者，可以使用圈套​​/尖刺技能（如果有的話），或者在跑步者前往基座時將你的團隊定位在跑步者的路徑上。殺死 煽動者（他現在將獨自站在地函營地中）並奪取所有剩餘的基座。

e603f57c8f37ab2cf8578857981c60730ede9435.source: Remember that killing the runner gives the Mantle an advantage: a living runner will have to return to grab a crystal, while reinforcement runners spawn near their team's crystal-supply pedestal. It also means that you might have to confront two teams of Mantle (the original escorts and the new runner's team).
e603f57c8f37ab2cf8578857981c60730ede9435.text: 請記住，殺死奔跑者會給斗篷帶來優勢：活著的跑步者將必須返回以獲取水晶，而增援奔跑者會在其團隊的水晶供應基座附近產卵。這也意味著你可能要面對兩支曼特爾隊伍（原來的護衛隊和新的跑者）。

3f2fc94bf74f22774c34ce3ee18d37c6b99aa302.source: Your build should include a Speed Boost (or you could use a Birthday Cupcake or Rock Candy) for the first part and one of the following: a Snare, crippling skill or a Spike for dealing with the White Knight runner. Signet of Spirits is an ideal choice, since it distracts your opponents while doing noticeable damage.
3f2fc94bf74f22774c34ce3ee18d37c6b99aa302.text: 你的構建應該包括第一部分的速度提升（或者你可以使用生日蛋糕或冰糖）和以下之一：圈套、致殘技能或用於對付白騎士跑者的尖刺。 縛靈紋章 是一個理想的選擇，因為它會分散對手的注意力，同時造成明顯的傷害。

ca5b1b8e14ed871f804093597fde59129a623152.source: If using heroes and/or henchmen, position their flags such that they are, behind the left-most pedestal (towards the Druid) but still in range of it; this way the number of White Mantle encountered at once will not overwhelm them (especially true in Hard mode). After the heroes/henchmen fight off the first wave, spread their flags out.
ca5b1b8e14ed871f804093597fde59129a623152.text: 如果使用英雄和/或追隨者，請將其旗幟放置在最左側基座後面（朝向 德魯依），但仍在其範圍內；這樣，一次遇到的 白斗篷 的數量就不會壓倒它們（尤其是在 困難模式 中）。英雄/追隨者擊退第一波後，展開旗幟。

2224e58c334c9cb0ce7b4d6b6054c68773447267.source: A frequently successful variation is to attune the bottom (west) pedestal (closest to the crystal spawn point) and the pedestal at the far right (south-west) side alternately while having the party flagged slightly west of the center. Alternatively, particularly in Hard Mode when the runner moves faster, you could flag your party in Guard mode along the runner's return route from the left (east) pedestal in order to body block them without killing them, and give you more time to capture the remaining pedestals.
2224e58c334c9cb0ce7b4d6b6054c68773447267.text: 一個經常成功的變化是交替調整底部（西）基座（最接近水晶生成點）和最右側（西南）側的基座，同時讓隊伍在中心稍微西邊標記。或者，特別是在困難模式下，當跑步者移動速度更快時，你可以在守衛模式下沿著跑步者從左側（東）基座返回的路線標記你的隊伍，以便用身體阻擋他們而不殺死他們，並給你更多的時間來佔領剩餘的基座。

a92f3490144da6b17791f30b3701051a12546666.source: This approach needs at least two human players in the party, with three players being preferred. Using this method, you can complete this objective without engaging the White Mantle contingent at all (excepting the Demagogue for the bonus). Simply run a crystal to each of the three pedestals. You should have some speed boosts in your skillbar to allow you to outrun the White Mantle teams; each time they claim a pedestal, another team immediately heads out to claim the next.
a92f3490144da6b17791f30b3701051a12546666.text: 這種方法需要隊伍中至少有兩名人類玩家，最好是三名玩家。使用此方法，您無需與 白斗篷 特遣隊交戰即可完成此目標（獎勵 煽動者 除外）。只需在三個基座上各放置一顆水晶即可。您的技能欄中應該有一些速度提升，以便您能夠超越 白斗篷 團隊；每當他們獲得一個基座時，另一支隊伍就會立即出發去獲得下一個基座。

729bfe34ff5ead2f4dfd1b689f041686c16435aa.source: Just remember to keep at least one pedestal claimed to avoid failing the mission.
729bfe34ff5ead2f4dfd1b689f041686c16435aa.text: 請記得至少保留一個聲稱的基座，以避免任務失敗。

da8153d5ffc6dd2733b1fb2381a95edff857aa77.source: Just before you enter the area with the three pedestals, you will see a Shining Blade warrior named Less Longbow near two White Mantle Knights. As you approach (to within 2 aggro circles), the Mantle will engage him in combat if Less is close enough. You will have to join the fight and save Less. If Less dies the bonus cannot be completed. To avoid this, it is possible to flag heroes/henchmen ahead; use the mission map to position them before triggering. After the two Knights are dead, speak to Less to trigger the bonus. Note: to receive credit for the bonus, you must speak to this NPC before you kill the Demagogue. Less must complete the dialogue before the Demagogue is killed to receive the bonus. (However, once you have done so, you will receive credit even if he dies later.)
da8153d5ffc6dd2733b1fb2381a95edff857aa77.text: 就在您進入具有三個基座的區域之前，您會看到一個名為 長弓雷斯 的 光刃公會 戰士靠近兩個 白斗篷 騎士。當你接近（在 2 仇恨圈內）時，如果 Less 夠近，斗篷將會與他交戰。你必須加入戰鬥並節省更少的錢。如果Less死亡，獎金就無法完成。為了避免這種情況，可以在前面標記英雄/追隨者；在觸發之前使用任務地圖來定位它們。兩名騎士死亡後，與Less交談即可觸發獎勵。注意：要獲得獎勵，您必須在殺死 煽動者 之前與該 NPC 交談。 Less 必須在 煽動者 被殺死之前完成對話才能獲得獎勵。 （但是，一旦你這樣做了，即使他稍後去世，你也會獲得積分。）

209e4dd2e7b9ed96610c4e9f99cee1cb781a9083.source: Less will start attacking the White Mantle Knights once he is within compass range; however, the knights themselves will not do anything until the player gets close. If the player stays far outside aggro range, Less will kill both of the knights without risk to himself.
209e4dd2e7b9ed96610c4e9f99cee1cb781a9083.text: 一旦進入羅盤範圍，Less 就會開始攻擊 白斗篷 騎士；然而，在玩家靠近之前，騎士本身不會採取任何行動。如果玩家遠離仇恨範圍，Less 會殺死兩名騎士，而不會危及自​​己。

d35a7f782fe3c17c34c593bdc52c4d35df1dc8b0.source: The Demagogue is located in the White Mantle starting area, on the other side of the arena with the three pedestals. You must kill him before placing the last crystal in the pedestal. The troops stationed here are also the ones that will run the crystals out to claim the pedestals, so if you killed them all previously using Method 1 described above, he will be alone. Otherwise, you will need to deal with them in addition to the Demagogue himself.
d35a7f782fe3c17c34c593bdc52c4d35df1dc8b0.text: 煽動者 位於 白斗篷 起始區域，位於帶有三個基座的競技場的另一側。你必須在將最後一塊水晶放入基座之前殺死他。駐紮在這裡的部隊也會消耗水晶來奪取基座，所以如果你之前使用上述方法 1 將他們全部殺死，他將獨自一人。否則，除了 煽動者 本身之外，您還需要處理它們。

89b5f710d034f9d8f7bb3fcf238cdb636dfdfe09.source: If you do not want to fight all of them, in fact any of them, one approach is to head to the pedestal on the far right from the entrance, where you will find a path that leads past the bulk of his forces. From there, provided you hug the side furthest from them you can eliminate the Demagogue and if you are lucky, his troops will not aggro. Tread mindfully near the wall to make sure following Heroes and Henchmen stay close. The Demagogue group might as well take a crystal and attune the right pedestal on their way.
89b5f710d034f9d8f7bb3fcf238cdb636dfdfe09.text: 如果你不想與他們所有人戰鬥，實際上是他們中的任何一個，一種方法是前往入口最右側的基座，在那裡你會找到一條穿過他的大部分部隊的路徑。從那裡開始，只要你擁抱離他們最遠的一側，你就可以消滅 煽動者，如果你幸運的話，他的部隊將不會發生仇恨。小心地靠近牆壁行走，以確保 follow Heroes 和 傭兵 保持在附近。 煽動者 組不妨攜帶一塊水晶，並在途中調整正確的基座。

150332a4c415d87b74432e67de67b0851458fd9c.source: If you are having trouble holding the pedestals, one method is to keep your heroes/henchmen at one pedestal (preferably the one to the far right) and then capture 2 and keep 2 at all times, that way when the runners capture one you will still have another and can easily regain it until all the White Mantle are dead.
150332a4c415d87b74432e67de67b0851458fd9c.text: 如果你在守住基座時遇到困難，一種方法是將你的英雄/追隨者保持在一個基座上（最好是最右邊的那個），然後捕獲 2 並始終保持 2，這樣當跑腿者捕獲一個時，你仍然擁有另一個，並且可以輕鬆地重新獲得它，直到所有 白斗篷 都死了。

2dbb6e234b9ccbccf966bfb2cc764603648ed7b9.source: If you are only going for the bonus, you can effectively skip the shuffling and take the back route directly to the Demagogue. The following method works very well even with hero/henchmen parties, especially in hard mode: Grab the crystal from the Thorn Pedestal, and place it in the center shrine's pedestal. Run back and grab another crystal, and take it to the one on the far right. Without running skills, you will still have a few seconds to spare. Taking the back route, avoid the rest of the troops and go straight to the Demagogue. You will be able to kill him with just enough time to spare; you will fail the mission, but you will get the bonus. This is a very simple and reliable method. It works even better if you bring party-wide speed boosts (such as "Fall Back!") and interrupts or knock downs to prevent him from activating Healing Signet.
2dbb6e234b9ccbccf966bfb2cc764603648ed7b9.text: 如果您只是為了獎金，您可以有效地跳過洗牌並直接走後路到 煽動者。即使是英雄/追隨者隊伍，以下方法也非常有效，尤其是在困難模式下：從荊棘基座上抓住水晶，並將其放置在中央神殿的基座上。 跑過 回來並抓住另一塊水晶，並將其帶到最右邊的水晶處。如果沒有跑步技巧，你還有幾秒鐘的空閒時間。走後路，避開其餘部隊，直奔煽動者。你只要有足夠的時間就可以殺死他；你會失敗任務，但你會得到獎金。這是一種非常簡單且可靠的方法。如果你帶來全隊範圍的速度提升（例如「後退！」）並打斷或擊倒以防止他啟動 治療紋章，效果會更好。

0a5b4c72d785ec9983735d0b2a7580e57f285cc7.source: Snares help considerably in slowing down the runners (although many players report success without them).
0a5b4c72d785ec9983735d0b2a7580e57f285cc7.text: 圈套對於減緩跑者的速度有很大幫助（儘管許多玩家報告說沒有它們也能成功）。

45959063388e87e221a16667468d7e6e5d4886f3.source: Area of effect skills come in handy, as White Mantle groups tend to clump. They can also be used against the Henge Guardian and his Behemoths.
45959063388e87e221a16667468d7e6e5d4886f3.text: 區域效果技能會派上用場，因為 白斗篷 群體往往會聚集在一起。它們也可以用來對抗 聖地守護者 和他的巨獸。

68a77bd3d19e7e06f1aab1f20deb1a4b79eafb3d.source: After accepting the quest reward for this quest, both Master of Whispers and Margrid will offer their follow-up quest. Do note that these quests are mutually exclusive and accepting one will cancel the other. Player characters who accept the quests leading to obtaining one hero will not be able to participate in another PC's mission (although they will be able to participate in the quests) to obtain the other hero until their own mission is complete. Each of their branches eventually lead to your character unlocking the hero you selected.
68a77bd3d19e7e06f1aab1f20deb1a4b79eafb3d.text: 在接受該任務的任務獎勵後，低語大師和瑪格麗德都會提供後續任務。請注意，這些任務是相互排斥的，接受一個任務將取消另一個任務。接受導致獲得一名英雄的任務的玩家角色將無法參與另一臺電腦的任務（儘管他們能夠參與任務）以獲得另一名英雄，直到他們自己的任務完成。他們的每個分支最終都會導致你的角色解鎖你選擇的英雄。

6a6f7cbb6ed00ed29beb29728e5c38daac1dbda4.source: When multiple players are in the party, once a player accepts one of the follow-up quests, the quest exclamation mark will no longer show above that corresponding hero's head. This is just a graphical issue; that hero will still offer their quest to players who have not selected. All players in the party can make their own choice about which quest to take.
6a6f7cbb6ed00ed29beb29728e5c38daac1dbda4.text: 當隊伍中有多名玩家時，一旦有玩家接受其中一個後續任務，對應英雄頭上將不再顯示任務感嘆號。這只是一個圖形問題；該英雄仍然會向未選擇的玩家提供任務。隊伍中的所有玩家都可以自行選擇接受哪個任務。

11841950e888c9535f0e44805608885340955850.source: Speak with Blade Operative Paulina in Sanctum Cay to garner passage to Riverside Province.
11841950e888c9535f0e44805608885340955850.text: 與 神聖沙灘 中的刀鋒特工寶琳娜交談，獲得前往 河畔地帶 的通道。

f9c0f3e93c660c4ab34cae37428c20efa698bb5d.source: Kill Willem the Demeaning, currently residing in the Temple of the Unseen, located in Riverside Province
f9c0f3e93c660c4ab34cae37428c20efa698bb5d.text: 殺死卑鄙的威廉，目前居住在位於 河畔地帶 的看不見的神殿中

012cfa4fd188b60000f5a19d4fa526bd0ac62f46.source: Speak with Blade Operative Paulina to be briefed on the temple's defenses.
012cfa4fd188b60000f5a19d4fa526bd0ac62f46.text: 與刀鋒寶琳娜探員交談，瞭解神殿防禦的簡報。

03aed4e29ad4c79397b272971a5fcb0473df141b.source: Gain access to the heart of the Temple of the Unseen, either by assaulting the front gate or acquiring the keys to the rear entrance.
03aed4e29ad4c79397b272971a5fcb0473df141b.text: 透過攻擊前門或取得後門的鑰匙，進入隱形神殿的中心。

b4b8c658dfa61cf05282e6aa50ec8f8c923d3238.source: Defeat Ven the Conservator to acquire the blue key.
b4b8c658dfa61cf05282e6aa50ec8f8c923d3238.text: 擊敗管理員文恩以獲得藍色鑰匙。

0d13bd9f10fbbbd2ec87d5ac3342b903ed3a35f5.source: Defeat Degaz the Cynical to acquire the red key.
0d13bd9f10fbbbd2ec87d5ac3342b903ed3a35f5.text: 擊敗憤世嫉俗者德加茲以獲得紅色鑰匙。

6eff23015f7ef4b6dc980e3bfdaeeb8589c90cf7.source: See Princess Salma for your reward.
6eff23015f7ef4b6dc980e3bfdaeeb8589c90cf7.text: 去找薩爾瑪公主領取獎勵。

c3aae2c33818bf9b2dbfec90c8ed73fb945b9bea.source: Speak to Blade Operative Paulina (in Sanctum Cay) to get started; she will transport you via sea to Riverside Province. (Your transport vessel also serves as the only resurrection in the area; if you wipe, you will have to retrace your steps.)
c3aae2c33818bf9b2dbfec90c8ed73fb945b9bea.text: 與 Blade 特工 Paulina（在 神聖沙灘 中）交談即可開始；她將透過海運將您送往 河畔地帶。 （你的運輸船也是該地區唯一的復活點；如果你抹掉了，你將不得不折回你的腳步。）

d4d6185f5f38c31058cd82ca3ac45c832b934962.source: Head north across the beach, killing the White Mantle opposing your progress. Beware of the Jade Cloaks who attack you from the safety of their towers; they can can be avoided by moving out of casting range.
d4d6185f5f38c31058cd82ca3ac45c832b934962.text: 往北穿過海灘，殺死阻礙你前進的 白斗篷。小心玉袍人，他們會從安全的塔樓裡攻擊你；可以透過移出施法範圍來避免它們。

c13bdd7c44a6217344fd839a2838fdc78423fc3f.source: Proceed south-west until you come to the passage heading off to the North. Before you attack the group in front of the gate, be sure to eliminate the two White Mantle who try to sneak up on you from the open ground. Head around the bend until you can see the main entrance to the Temple of the Unseen. Try to pull the Mantle and Jade mobs out of the Mursaat tower effect separately (the Jade all possess high armor ratings meaning they die slower than the rest and pose more of a risk). After you have killed the mobs in the entrance, kill the Ether Seal producing the Ether Tower effect. The tower will quickly reduce your energy level to zero, making it hard to attack or heal with spells. Alternatively, kill the mobs nearby and then run past the seal; its effect does not reach into the next room.
c13bdd7c44a6217344fd839a2838fdc78423fc3f.text: 繼續向西南方向行駛，直到到達通往北方的通道。在你攻擊門前的隊伍之前，一定要消滅掉試圖從空地上偷襲你的兩個 白斗篷。繞過轉彎處，直到您可以看到隱形神殿的主入口。試著將 Mantle 和 Jade 生物分別從 馬賽特 塔效果中拉出來（Jade 生物都擁有很高的裝甲等級，這意味著它們比其他生物死得慢，並且構成更大的風險）。殺死入口處的小怪後，殺死產生以太塔效果的 結界封印。塔會迅速將你的能量水平降至零，使其難以攻擊或用法術治療。或者，殺死附近的小怪，然後跑過封印；它的影響不會到達隔壁房間。

312ad496c56faf8e19d359b466d71cfa4649ded8.source: Continue across the courtyard to the gate, either pulling the White Mantle group or avoid them completely by using the Eastern side. Pull the Jade Bow, Cloak & Armor away from the mesmer boss. Finally kill Willem the Demeaning to complete the quest.
312ad496c56faf8e19d359b466d71cfa4649ded8.text: 繼續穿過庭院到達大門，要麼拉動 白斗篷 小組，要麼使用東側完全避開他們。 拉出、翡翠弓手、斗篷和 防禦 遠離幻術師 Boss。最後殺死卑鄙的威廉來完成任務。

865b4c2fcc0943ca5bfda6d0434fc03b34e9735c.source: If you want to avoid the Ether Seal, you can take 30 extra minutes by going the long way around. Kill the two other bosses marked on the map, pick up their keys, then head for the green gate, which leads to your target.
865b4c2fcc0943ca5bfda6d0434fc03b34e9735c.text: 如果您想避免 結界封印，可以繞很遠的路，多花 30 分鐘的時間。殺死地圖上標記的另外兩個頭目，拿起他們的鑰匙，然後前往通往目標的綠色大門。

130fae2886a144b908a765cab417cfe479464d5d.source: Signet of Spirits builds on player character allows for damage dealing at the same time as running.
130fae2886a144b908a765cab417cfe479464d5d.text: 縛靈紋章 以玩家角色為基礎，允許在奔跑的同時造成傷害。

f8ca08f906fcc388bed953bf3364a3857331b4c3.source: White Mantle Seekers use Dryder's Defenses to block attacks. This can make it difficult to hit them with attacks if they are carrying the crystals. Use stance removal skills to end it or non-attack skills.
f8ca08f906fcc388bed953bf3364a3857331b4c3.text: 白斗篷 搜尋者使用 蛛化精靈防禦 來阻止攻擊。如果他們攜帶水晶，這會使攻擊變得困難。使用姿態消除技能來結束它或非攻擊技能。

624060fe0471163229828daef21e195453b6c2fd.source: Spread your team out to avoid standing in Energy Surge and Searing Heat, and deal with the White Mantle Sycophants and Savants first in enemy groups.
624060fe0471163229828daef21e195453b6c2fd.text: 將您的團隊分散開，避免站在 能量震盪 和 灼熱氣息 中，並先對付敵方隊伍中的 白斗篷 諂媚者和學者。

a9555495efbeb26b14691b101cc7260e7b050498.source: If there's a White Mantle Abbot in the group, consider dealing with them first while merely disabling the Sycophants and Savants until then. Searing Heat especially is easy to interrupt due to its long and somewhat distinct casting animation.
a9555495efbeb26b14691b101cc7260e7b050498.text: 如果團隊中有 白斗篷修道者，請考慮先處理他們，然後在此之前只停用阿諛奉承者和學者。 灼熱氣息 由於其較長且有些明顯的投射動畫而特別容易被中斷。

e399f098f28088bfeaab5aff6fadca48220466c2.source: Before and after the Henge Portal section the only enemies that should be particularly hard with a competent team are the Moss Scarabs, due to their large groups.
e399f098f28088bfeaab5aff6fadca48220466c2.text: 在 丹拉維聖地傳送門 部分之前和之後，對於一支有能力的團隊來說，唯一應該特別難對付的敵人是苔蘚聖甲蟲，因為它們的群體很大。

5dd8aab9b899f1df5fe8aa783fb1091522443bbe.source: The large amounts of White Mantle foes at the Henge Portal and their increased movement speed makes capturing the shrines without killing them all significantly more difficult.
5dd8aab9b899f1df5fe8aa783fb1091522443bbe.text: 丹拉維聖地傳送門 中大量的 白斗篷 敵人及其增加的移動速度使得在不殺死所有神殿的情況下捕捉它們變得更加困難。

69a55a3b3c5f9271f57c55aea9471230c951e543.source: To prevent them from overwhelming the party do not kill the runner, instead snare them and try to kill a few of the White Mantle accompanying them, withdrawing with the whole party after the runner gets out of Earshot to get a new crystal yourself. When only two or fewer enemies accompany the runner it should be safe to kill the runner and the rest, and then the Demagogue and also attune the shrines.
69a55a3b3c5f9271f57c55aea9471230c951e543.text: 為了防止他們壓倒隊伍，不要殺死逃跑者，而是誘捕他們並嘗試殺死一些陪伴他們的白斗篷，在逃跑者離開耳朵後與整個隊伍一起撤退，自己獲得新的水晶。當只有兩個或更少的敵人陪伴跑步者時，應該可以安全地殺死跑步者和其他人，然後使用 煽動者 並調整神社。

fcbb66b36394bf88a3771a49ab672de8b71ba5ff.source: Sometimes Less Longbow will not be under attack when you find him. When he is under attack, preventing his death will give you a Morale Boost.
fcbb66b36394bf88a3771a49ab672de8b71ba5ff.text: 有時，當您找到 長弓雷斯 時，他不會受到攻擊。當他受到攻擊時，阻止他死亡會給你帶來士氣提升。

8c45c70b48abca9dad549c63b066565dfa5cc697.source: This is one of only a few Morale Boosts that also apply to Animal companions.
8c45c70b48abca9dad549c63b066565dfa5cc697.text: 這是少數也適用於 動物 同伴計程車氣提升之一。

a588bd54fba83a745b7dfd27045fd613d92edee9.source: You can also use the crystals located near the Demagogue.
a588bd54fba83a745b7dfd27045fd613d92edee9.text: 您也可以使用位於 煽動者 附近的晶體。

3a37f0f448f6ff4ffae77c6254803076a89e30b8.source: Complete exploration of the mission area will add approximately 1.0% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. The first 0.7% can be explored before the cinematic that teleports you to the last bit of the mission, leaving 0.3% to be explored before you kill the Henge Guardian.
3a37f0f448f6ff4ffae77c6254803076a89e30b8.text: 對任務區域的完整探索將為 Tyrian 版圖 標題增加約 1.0%。第一款 0.7% 可以在將您傳送到任務最後一部分的過場動畫之前探索，而在殺死 聖地守護者 之前可以探索 0.3%。

05e210bb826445b58f248dae3c9cc277fe967cdf.source: Placing all crystals before killing the Demagogue will start the end cinematic, preventing bonus completion.
05e210bb826445b58f248dae3c9cc277fe967cdf.text: 在殺死 煽動者 之前放置所有水晶將開始結束動畫，從而阻止獎勵完成。

5192452ce56570e05e678ac56df13ae3ea723f41.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Henge of Denravi.
5192452ce56570e05e678ac56df13ae3ea723f41.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將會傳送到 丹拉維聖地。

e9251975e90dc5cae901067253443780d775ef45.source: Although Less Longbow refers to him as a champion, the Demagogue is not a boss: he does not give a morale boost when killed and you cannot cap skills from him.
e9251975e90dc5cae901067253443780d775ef45.text: 雖然 長弓雷斯 將他稱為冠軍，但 煽動者 並不是 Boss：他被殺時不會提高士氣，而且你無法限制他的技能。

655a1e47a0104d4ec1460fa7e637a0ccf082ecce.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
655a1e47a0104d4ec1460fa7e637a0ccf082ecce.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#5 頁。

5e9afbda5f1af37457b62863365db4f9460ee58b.source: Travel to the rendezvous point on the Jahai Bluffs to discover the origin of the mysterious message.
5e9afbda5f1af37457b62863365db4f9460ee58b.text: 前往 夏亥峭壁 上的集合點，找出神秘訊息的來源。

d1c6ed850c0fd9baf49bcaa55dc4a073c5b851d9.source: See Whispers Adept for your reward.
d1c6ed850c0fd9baf49bcaa55dc4a073c5b851d9.text: 請參閱低語專家以獲得獎勵。

3d262b31f106792e124932be1221fd97cc77b092.source: To obtain this quest talk to Lonai. Then go out to Jahai Bluffs and speak to the Whispers Adept for the reward. Margrid the Sly and the Master of Whispers will each offer a quest. These two quests are mutually exclusive, meaning you can choose only one of them. You now have to decide if you prefer Margrid or the Master of Whispers as a hero until you complete the campaign.
3d262b31f106792e124932be1221fd97cc77b092.text: 要獲得此任務，請與洛奈交談。然後前往 夏亥峭壁 與低語專家交談以獲得獎勵。狡猾的瑪格麗特和密語大師將各自提供一個任務。這兩個任務是互斥的，這意味著你只能選擇其中一個。現在你必須決定你是否喜歡瑪格麗特或低語大師作為英雄，直到你完成戰役。

cef9f911c8a478724dc70785644f32af2304cd73.source: You should have two or three players standing by the druid and the crystals. One player should pick up a crystal and run to the nearest thorn pedestal. As soon as it is set in place, a new crystal will spawn, which the second player should grab and head to the next pedestal. If you only have two runners, the first runner should return to the crystal spawn point while the second runner is out. Either way, once the crystal spawns again, repeat the process. If this is coordinated properly, you should have no trouble at all.
cef9f911c8a478724dc70785644f32af2304cd73.text: 你應該有兩到三名玩家站在德魯伊和水晶旁邊。一名玩家應該撿起一顆水晶並跑到最近的荊棘基座。一旦放置到位，就會產生一個新的水晶，第二個玩家應該抓住它並前往下一個基座。如果您只有兩個跑步者，則第一個跑步者應該返回水晶生成點，而第二個跑步者則退出。不管怎樣，一旦水晶再次產生，就重複這個過程。如果協調得當，你應該不會有任何麻煩。

275a953d4b99bc760d756423100d7c929e48695b.source: To make sure the White Mantle do not capture any pedestals, you can station the balance of your party (including any heroes/henchmen) at the chokepoint in the center pathway.
275a953d4b99bc760d756423100d7c929e48695b.text: 為了確保 白斗篷 不會佔領任何基座，您可以將您隊伍的其餘部分（包括任何英雄/追隨者）駐紮在中央通道的阻塞點。

7a5f36cb9b32b405ba08ccea2ffd04a7c2a0ceaa.source: Note that this method can be used, with slight modification, to easily gain mission and bonus. Have two people run crystals, the second waiting by the crystal spawn point to pick it up the moment the other has attuned a pedestal. It is important that these two do not attune the last pedestal until the bonus is gained. A third person, or the rest of the party, kills the Demagogue. This can easily be done by following the south wall, you should not need to kill any White Mantle other than him if you take this path. Now the most important part: do not aggro the White Mantle runners. Two non-buffed runners can easily keep the portals attuned without hindering the White Mantle. If a third human player is not present, then this method can be done using only two. The Demagogue slayer (with the bulk of the team) retraces steps and becomes the second runner after the bonus has been gained.
7a5f36cb9b32b405ba08ccea2ffd04a7c2a0ceaa.text: 請注意，此方法只需稍加修改即可輕鬆獲得任務和獎勵。讓兩個人跑水晶，第二個在水晶產卵點等待，當另一個人調整了底座時撿起它。重要的是，在獲得獎金之前，這兩個人不要調整最後一個基座。第三人或隊伍的其他成員殺死了 煽動者。這可以透過沿著南牆輕鬆完成，如果你走這條路，你不需要殺死除他之外的任何 白斗篷。現在最重要的部分是：不要激怒 白斗篷 跑者。兩位未拋光的跑者可以輕鬆地保持門戶協調，而不會妨礙 白斗篷。如果第三個人玩家不存在，則可以僅使用兩個人來完成此方法。 煽動者 殺手（與團隊的大部分成員）在獲得獎金後折返並成為第二名跑者。

4cf350eb761010e1baefab1eb33523123018bfef.source: It can be accomplished with a single 33% speed-boosted runner while the bulk of the team circles counter clockwise, keeping right arm against the outer wall, to kill the Damagogue. Do not engage or aggro any of the other White Mantle. The runner attunes the nearby shrine, then the team grabs the next crystal and attunes the far right shrine on its way around. The Runner then attunes the left shrine, comes back, and attunes whatever shrine has been recaptured. It is unlikely but possible the runner can outrace the team killing the Demogogue, make sure not to cap the last shrine until the bonus is complete.
4cf350eb761010e1baefab1eb33523123018bfef.text: 只需一名 33% 加速跑者即可完成此任務，同時大部分團隊逆時針旋轉，將右臂靠在外牆上，以殺死達馬古格。請勿與任何其他 白斗篷 交戰或激怒。跑者調整附近的神殿，然後團隊抓住下一個水晶並在周圍調整最右邊的神殿。然後，奔跑者調整左邊的神殿，回來，調整任何被奪回的神殿。跑步者不太可能但有可能超過殺死演示者的團隊，請確保在獎金完成之前不要限制最後一個神殿。

4c2d0c4836219f100b3a25bbb6580eab252015c8.source: Alternatively: Push The White Mantle Garrison
4c2d0c4836219f100b3a25bbb6580eab252015c8.text: 或：推動 白斗篷 駐軍

7b5f77b7dda1825842f1cc728b0327e0e31cdae3.source: Proceed to the White Mantle garrison (where the Demagogue is located) directly Southeast off the main entrance of the Henge Portal - Defeat the whole White Mantle army coming from the garrison, then proceed with the Thorn Pedestal and attune the Henge Portal with no White Mantle taking the Rune Crystal from you. (It is a bonus objective as well which is a plus)
7b5f77b7dda1825842f1cc728b0327e0e31cdae3.text: 直接前往 丹拉維聖地傳送門 主入口東南方向的 白斗篷 駐軍（煽動者 所在位置） - 擊敗來自駐軍的整個 白斗篷 軍隊，然後繼續使用荊棘基座並調整 丹拉維聖地傳送門，且 白斗篷 不會從您手中奪走 符文 水晶。 （這也是一個獎勵目標，這是一個優點）

975c29c2681a0c8e074a6a8eb5b3f5f51a065c35.source: Summoned creatures will not be teleported with the party. Allies from summoning stones will remain alive and cannot be re-summoned in the next area.
975c29c2681a0c8e074a6a8eb5b3f5f51a065c35.text: 被召喚的生物不會隨隊伍傳送。召喚石的盟友將保持活著，並且無法在下一個區域重新召喚。

d6290036e5b973d777df672f69208230fbb2d9c7.source: Regardless of which of the above methods you use, when you finally claim all three pedestals, a cinematic will play showing your party being teleported to the Henge. Make your way through the token resistance there to confront the Henge Guardian. He is flanked by two Root Behemoths that can wear down your party if they are not eliminated quickly. When you take out all three of them, the mission ends. The best way of killing them is by using damage over time spells such as Fire Storm, as the enemies are stationary.
d6290036e5b973d777df672f69208230fbb2d9c7.text: 無論您使用上述哪種方法，當您最終獲得所有三個基座時，都會播放一部電影，顯示您的隊伍被傳送到巨石陣。穿過那裡的象徵性抵抗，對抗 聖地守護者。他的兩側是兩隻根部巨獸，如果不盡快消滅它們，它們可能會削弱你的隊伍。當你把他們三個都幹掉後，任務就結束了。殺死他們的最佳方法是使用持續傷害法術，例如 火焰風暴，因為敵人是靜止的。

05269b2019362b7f86c78d88b8087ae4f15da3b5.source: 15 seconds after killing Willem, the party will be returned to Sanctum Cay.
05269b2019362b7f86c78d88b8087ae4f15da3b5.text: 殺死威廉後 15 秒，隊伍將會回到 神聖沙灘。

6132cbdd439796c34591edd36ea85a9b608af6b2.source: Frozen Soil can be helpful, to suppress the Mantle's hard resurrection skills (usually carried by at least one foe in each group).
6132cbdd439796c34591edd36ea85a9b608af6b2.text: 凍土 可以幫助抑制斗篷的硬復活技能（通常由每組至少一個敵人攜帶）。

36ef151f2566ecfc0deaa61cd7405d98ab87691a.source: You can take down the Ether Seal quickly by placing attack spirits just outside of its spell range.
36ef151f2566ecfc0deaa61cd7405d98ab87691a.text: 你可以透過將攻擊精靈放置在 結界封印 的法術範圍之外來快速擊倒 結界封印。

416c95db29fea59718451f3332ca12bb323a538f.source: Remember to switch back into normal mode; unlike the previous three assassinations, there are no extra rewards for completing the quest in hard mode.
416c95db29fea59718451f3332ca12bb323a538f.text: 記得切換回正常模式；與前三場刺殺不同的是，在困難模式下完成任務沒有額外的獎勵。

d1bcc29a09ba9b7c01f9e06c2d6c2ccb6830a61f.source: Travel to the Asuran Lab via the Secret River Passage in Talmark Wilderness
d1bcc29a09ba9b7c01f9e06c2d6c2ccb6830a61f.text: 透過 突馬克荒地 中的秘密河道前往阿蘇蘭實驗室

fa85f3b3c2b415d48dafb0eeb883aa1bb257ef56.source: Speak with Livia to plan your raid on Shaemoor
fa85f3b3c2b415d48dafb0eeb883aa1bb257ef56.text: 與 莉薇亞 交談以規劃對 夏恩摩 的突襲

2d4947de14dedf6019bb9cc2fbdf9d6f4d0334f7.source: Acquire the Key to the Fountain of Truth by killing Cairn the Berserker in Loamhurst
2d4947de14dedf6019bb9cc2fbdf9d6f4d0334f7.text: 在 沃土森林 中殺死狂戰士凱恩，獲得真理之泉的 鑰匙

75ef06a2ddf6fdca15ffd8fbd9c3082034ba428a.source: Speak with Zinn to find out what weapons he has prepared for you.
75ef06a2ddf6fdca15ffd8fbd9c3082034ba428a.text: 與津交談，瞭解祂為你準備了哪些武器。

60a9a2ef488406ca5d2ac28102b75bb4db13e85b.source: Clear the way to the Fountain of Truth by defeating Justiciar Sevaan and his forces in Shaemoor. [10...0] of 10 groups remaining.
60a9a2ef488406ca5d2ac28102b75bb4db13e85b.text: 在 夏恩摩 中擊敗正義塞瓦安和他的軍隊，掃清通往真理之泉的道路。剩餘 10 群組中的 [10...0]。

63b8904819314a027c2777e715e9dd115f76cd06.source: Open the gate to the Fountain of Truth, and kill Aily the Innocent.
63b8904819314a027c2777e715e9dd115f76cd06.text: 開啟真理之泉的大門，殺死無辜者艾莉。

7d4126db7f5ec0567ef2022889a73b12f70c1db3.source: Return to Princess Salma for a reward.
7d4126db7f5ec0567ef2022889a73b12f70c1db3.text: 影返 向薩爾瑪公主索取獎勵。

bc5090bb2f1e89850a95302b2d6c7a542adea290.source: Begin at the Temple of the Ages and head west into the Talmark Wilderness. Once there, hug the east wall to reach the Secret River Passage which takes you to the Divinity Coast (1). Head west to Zinn's laboratory to receive further instructions from Livia (2). Zinn's lab (4) will also function as a resurrection shrine should your party wipe.
bc5090bb2f1e89850a95302b2d6c7a542adea290.text: 從 世紀神殿 開始，向西進入 突馬克荒地。到達那裡後，沿著東牆到達秘密河道，將您帶到 神聖海岸 (1)。向西前往 Zinn 的實驗室，接受 莉薇亞 (2) 的進一步指示。如果你的隊伍被消滅，Zinn 的實驗室 (4) 也將扮演復活神殿。

2e07ad9c98e8322e4ea8ba2ab52c0f7b26cf6ab0.source: Next, head to Loamhurst (west of 3) on the northern part of the map (this is the destination for the Chosen during Divinity Coast). As before, you have to traverse through the western swamps while battling Peacekeeper groups. Avoid fighting in the water, which inflicts poison. Cairn the Berserker waits at the drawbridge to Loamhurst's small fort (3) and can be pulled away from his allies. Vess the Disputant is inside the fort itself, but killing Cairn is enough to update the quest.
2e07ad9c98e8322e4ea8ba2ab52c0f7b26cf6ab0.text: 接下來，前往地圖北部的沃土森林（3以西）（這是神聖海岸期間天選者的目的地）。和以前一樣，你必須穿越西部沼澤，同時與維和人員戰鬥。避免在水中打架，否則會造成中毒。狂戰士凱恩在 沃土森林 的小堡壘 (3) 的吊橋處等待，可以將其從盟友身邊拉開。爭論者維斯就在堡壘內部，但殺死凱恩就足以更新任務。

e4fd7d3c4e11a732e15d50c4b05f890c437045ce.source: Once Cairn is dead, head back to Zinn's lab (4). Unfortunately, you will get ambushed 10 times along the return route until reaching the Villagers again. The hidden groups are random assortments of 4–5 White Mantles and possibly a Jade construct. These groups can be avoided by wiping and rezzing at Zinn's lab.
e4fd7d3c4e11a732e15d50c4b05f890c437045ce.text: 凱恩死後，返回津恩的實驗室 (4)。不幸的是，您將在返迴路線上遭到 10 次伏擊，直到您再次到達村民為止。隱藏組是 4–5 白斗篷的隨機分類，也可能是 Jade 構造體。可以透過在 Zinn 實驗室擦拭和重新調整來避免這些群體。

56c30fcea1f4a040494209dcf48dd9fddea85bab.source: When you get back to Zinn, he will give you an Asuran Beacon to carry. When it is dropped, it summons three Fire Bit Golems to your location that self-destruct using Bit Golem Crash, damaging all nearby enemies. (Zinn will keep supplying beacons as long as you need them, but you have to return to his lab to get them.) Take a beacon with you to clear Shaemoor (near 5) of the White Mantle presence. Follow the road east and across the long bridge, taking out enemy forces along the way. The gate is heavily guarded, so pull carefully.
56c30fcea1f4a040494209dcf48dd9fddea85bab.text: 當你回到辛恩時，他會給你一個阿蘇蘭信標供你攜帶。當它掉落時，它會召喚三個火位元傀儡到您的位置，並使用位元傀儡崩潰來自毀，對附近的所有敵人造成傷害。 （只要你需要信標，Zinn 就會持續提供信標，但你必須返回他的實驗室才能獲取它們。） 隨身攜帶信標，以清除 夏恩摩（靠近 5）的 白斗篷 存在。沿著道路向東，穿過長橋，消滅沿途的敵軍。大門戒備森嚴，小心拉動。

6b720546bb390bf369fa5fcbfbefc1fc319f1263.source: After removing foes from the gate area, you have to clear out 10 enemy groups from the area. Seven are within Shaemoor proper, including Justiciar Sevaan's (5). The other three groups spawn outside the city and charge in later; pay attention to avoid getting pinned. Once all 10 groups are defeated, use the lever to raise the gate, and head up to the fountain to kill Aily the Innocent (6). Aily is guarded by 4 other Jade constructs and is a potent healer. However, dropping an Asuran Beacon at his feet will damage him enough to make him a quick kill. Any remaining Jade constructs die the moment Aily dies, so focus your attention on him. The party will automatically be brought to the western end of Talmark Wilderness 15 seconds after Aily dies.
6b720546bb390bf369fa5fcbfbefc1fc319f1263.text: 從大門區域清除敵人後，您必須從該區域清除 10 敵人群體。七個屬於 夏恩摩 範圍內，其中包括 Justiciar Sevaan 的 (5)。其他三支隊伍在城外產卵，稍後衝鋒；注意避免被壓住。一旦所有 10 隊伍被擊敗，使用槓桿升起大門，前往噴泉殺死無辜者艾莉 (6)。艾莉受到 4 其他 Jade 構造的保護，是一位有效的治療者。然而，將阿蘇蘭信標扔在他的腳下將會對他造成足夠的傷害，足以讓他被快速殺死。艾莉死亡後，任何剩餘的翡翠構造體都會死亡，因此請將注意力集中在他身上。艾莉死亡後幾秒，隊伍將自動被帶到 突馬克荒地 15 的西端。

1772861178cff94ccb6110e4294161b8800edf96.text: 標準 科瑞塔戰爭 提示

a61d245befc131a0004a11a5b12d6cbe85c8351a.source: Frozen Soil suppresses resurrection, which is carried by almost every type of White Mantle and Peacekeeper.
a61d245befc131a0004a11a5b12d6cbe85c8351a.text: 凍土 抑制復活，幾乎所有型別的 白斗篷 和 Peacekeeper 都帶有復活功能。

8c950c48a78469b0836e7f77ec0de181041fa0fc.source: Proper pulling is critical; make sure that the enemy runs to you, so that they waste their first strike and their preparatory skills.
8c950c48a78469b0836e7f77ec0de181041fa0fc.text: 正確的拉動至關重要；確保敵人跑向你，這樣他們就浪費了第一擊和準備技能。

26d2896374dfc0d4110492ee780bdc374f3256ce.source: Target healers, unless you can quickly spike-kill key combatants.
26d2896374dfc0d4110492ee780bdc374f3256ce.text: 目標 治療師，除非你能快速秒殺關鍵戰鬥人員。

8f19594f423bb6f072054fa5c1ba3a2a644c8341.source: Keep the party spread out; the enemies have lots of dangerous AoE skills.
8f19594f423bb6f072054fa5c1ba3a2a644c8341.text: 保持聚會分散；敵人有很多危險的 範圍性 技能。

26a8d5f0a29f49d15fa6c48beb98e7c49797b637.source: Infusion helps, but is essential if you are having any trouble in the presence of Mursaat or Jade Constructs.
26a8d5f0a29f49d15fa6c48beb98e7c49797b637.text: 灌注魔力 會有所幫助，但如果您在 馬賽特 或 Jade Constructs 的存在下遇到任何問題，則這是必不可少的。

54e93385a555f6e681bd2e0382c54360e52dc5e8.source: Retreat quickly if the tide of battle turns against you.
54e93385a555f6e681bd2e0382c54360e52dc5e8.text: 如果戰局對你不利，請迅速撤退。

57d6d4608ed26bb3b68c0fc2ca241c2c900182e1.source: Take advantage of the environment: use choke points to increase the effectiveness of AoE skills (and slow down the enemy); use terrain to protect you from ranged martial attacks.
57d6d4608ed26bb3b68c0fc2ca241c2c900182e1.text: 利用環境：利用阻塞點來提高 範圍性 技能的有效性（並減慢敵人的速度）；利用地形來保護你免受遠端軍事攻擊。

c6d201cf0f7bd42629e27e8b41e9e5c8c27099aa.source: Tips for the 5 most difficult points

6ba8e9474cf2075dfb11b3c3c0d30c7b4588cda8.source: These are tips to getting through the 5 most difficult points of the quest:
6ba8e9474cf2075dfb11b3c3c0d30c7b4588cda8.text: 以下是完成 5 任務中最困難點的提示：

b0eed52625300018377b9dae172b66450c4b3fd2.source: Two large groups overlap this area: one just in front of the gate to Loamhurst, one just behind it. Unless you can unleash extreme AoE damage (thus killing most of them at once) you must successfully pull them apart. Station/flag the group apart just around the corner (closer to the gate than to the last bridge along the route). Use a long- or flatbow and ensure that only the puller approaches. If your troops turn the corner too soon, you risk attracting the attention of the second group.
b0eed52625300018377b9dae172b66450c4b3fd2.text: 兩個大組別與該區域重疊：一組位於 沃土森林 大門的前面，另一組位於 沃土森林 大門的後方。除非你能釋放出極端的 範圍性 傷害（從而一次性殺死大部分敵人），否則你必須成功地將他們拉開。在轉角處駐站/標記小組分開（距離大門比沿路線的最後一座橋更近）。使用長弓或平弓，並確保只有拉弓者靠近。如果你的部隊過早扭轉局勢，你就有可能吸引第二批人的注意。

da12da281ab8506c6271e1c82679d78c56c5c9aa.source: Vess' group patrols close to the castle bridge, so they can easily be within aggro distance of Cairn's. Accordingly, pull Cairn's group away from the castle gate; they should go down quickly. If need be, you can pull Cairn's allies away from Cairn (or vice-versa). If you need to, use the gate area as a choke point to use AoE skills on Vess' team.
da12da281ab8506c6271e1c82679d78c56c5c9aa.text: 維斯的小隊在城堡橋附近巡邏，因此他們可以輕鬆地進入凱恩的小隊的仇恨範圍內。因此，將凱恩的隊伍拉離城堡大門；他們應該很快就會下去。如果需要，您可以將凱恩的盟友從凱恩拉開（反之亦然）。如果需要，可以使用大門區域作為阻塞點，對 Vess 的團隊使用 範圍性 技能。

e267be6493b689a7d0fcd75a3edd9a71c2adab65.source: There are 10 groups along the way, but you can skip them all by allowing your team to die; you will resurrect at the lab. (Remember to flag those heroes without resurrection skills away, so they do not end up with death penalty.) You are not required to pick-up Asuran Beacons to complete the quest, but they are very helpful. However, if you are doing this using only heroes and henchmen, hold off on grabbing one so that it does not slow you down; once you have cleared Shaemoor, you can return to Zinn.
e267be6493b689a7d0fcd75a3edd9a71c2adab65.text: 一路上有 10 小組，但你可以透過讓你的團隊死亡來跳過它們；你將在實驗室復活。 （記得標記那些沒有復活技能的英雄，這樣他們就不會被判處死刑。） 你不需要拿起阿蘇蘭信標來完成任務，但它們非常有幫助。然而，如果你只使用英雄和追隨者來做到這一點，請推遲抓住一個，這樣它就不會減慢你的速度；一旦你清除了 夏恩摩，你就可以返回 Zinn。

5f55f55eb777f7ed1d8659388733ef018cdc12dc.source: Shaemoor can be difficult to clear for two reasons: (1) there are overlapping patrols and (2) reinforcements spawn right on top of you. Start out by making sure that you clear the patrols from the west gate into the village, lest they return before you have occupied that area. Next, take advantage of the terrain: the gate is an excellent choke point and it is also elevated from the surrounding area. Station your troops outside the village, so that they can pound the enemy as it comes up the hill and through the gate. By carefully pulling one group at a time, you should be able to clear 2-3 groups from this spot.
5f55f55eb777f7ed1d8659388733ef018cdc12dc.text: 夏恩摩 可能難以清除，原因有二：（1）有重疊的巡邏隊和（2）增援部隊就在你的上方生成。首先確保清除從西門進入村莊的巡邏隊，以免他們在你佔領該區域之前返回。接下來，利用地形：大門是一個極好的咽喉要道，而且它也比周圍區域高。將你的部隊駐紮在村莊外，這樣他們就可以在敵人上山並穿過大門時對其進行打擊。透過一次小心地拉動一組，您應該能夠從該位置清除 2-3 組。

3f0976daa9695b9fe2b1fd5c575d02acd5e7e9da.source: Just across from the gate is a set of stairs with a group that spawns out of reach of the gate; take them out. Now, clear the lowest level, hugging the western wall, so that you do not attract aggro from other groups. Defeat the guards at the remaining open gate and then use this gate to defend against the reinforcements that will approach from outside the village. You will not need a bow to attract these groups; just take a few steps outside the gate and they should approach you. After clearing them out, you should be able to defeat all but the boss group from either this spot or the stairway nearest the western gate.
3f0976daa9695b9fe2b1fd5c575d02acd5e7e9da.text: 大門對面是一組樓梯，其中有一群人在大門夠不到的地方產生；把他們拿出來。現在，清除最低層，緊靠西牆，這樣你就不會吸引其他團體的仇恨。擊敗剩下的開啟的門處的守衛，然後利用這個門來防禦從村外逼近的援軍。你不需要弓箭來吸引這些群體；只要向門外走幾步，他們就會接近您。清除掉他們後，你應該能夠從這個地點或最靠近西門的樓梯擊敗除了頭目組之外的所有人。

ade4e10f3ae6cdaeafcd7294d2aae5c442cf02f9.source: The boss group should not be much harder than any of the others, but if you have trouble, you can use one of the stairways as a choke point and pull the group down the stairs.
ade4e10f3ae6cdaeafcd7294d2aae5c442cf02f9.text: Boss組應該不會比其他組難多少，但如果你遇到麻煩，你可以使用其中一個樓梯作為阻塞點，將組拉下樓梯。

2bc1aa0c456760dd7ba42e5a70c7489e1dcf9d89.source: Players that are not infused are at risk and should take a back seat to heroes, henchmen, and players that are infused. If you need to, it is worth the time for each player to return to the lab and grab an Asuran Beacon.
2bc1aa0c456760dd7ba42e5a70c7489e1dcf9d89.text: 未註入的玩家面臨風險，應該讓位給英雄、追隨者和已註入的玩家。如果需要的話，每個玩家都值得花時間返回實驗室並獲得阿蘇蘭信標。

5cd34df0e0879859f0592b1aced64150e9ff8563.source: Avoid going up the stairs: it is all too easy for the party to get snared together and be easy pickings for the final group's AoE. Instead, take a left before the stairs and head up the path. Position the team as you turn the corner, well away from aggro range. This position gives your team full view of the approaching enemies and requires them to waste time walking to you, which costs them initiative and some of their buffs.
5cd34df0e0879859f0592b1aced64150e9ff8563.text: 避免上樓梯：隊伍很容易被困在一起，並且很容易被最後一組的 範圍性 選取。相反，請在樓梯前左轉，然後沿著小路走。當你轉彎時，將團隊定位在遠離仇恨範圍的地方。這個位置讓你的團隊可以全面看到正在逼近的敵人，並要求他們浪費時間走到你身邊，這會損失他們的主動性和一些增益。

37ca88d01376d4007983775681d835ae28c43f52.source: From this position, pull Aily's group by using a non-line-of-sight skill; you might need a bow to maintain aggro, so that they continue towards you after rounding the corner. Wait until they reach range for all party members before dropping any beacons (any sooner, and you lose initiative and waste some of the beacon power as your team moves in). You do not need to defeat Aily's allies, so concentrate all power on the boss. If things go well, 1-2 beacons should weaken him enough that you can kill him. On the other hand, if any of his teammates are near death, kill them and retreat quickly; Aily alone is not much of a threat (if you have made it this far).
37ca88d01376d4007983775681d835ae28c43f52.text: 從這個位置，使用非視距技能拉動艾莉一行人；你可能需要一把弓來保持仇恨，以便他們在拐過拐角後繼續向你靠近。等到他們到達所有隊伍成員的範圍後再放下任何信標（如果太早，你就會失去主動性，並在你的團隊進入時浪費一些信標能量）。你不需要打敗艾莉的盟友，所以把所有的力量都集中在老闆身上。如果一切順利，1-2 信標應該會削弱他，讓你可以殺死他。另一方面，如果隊友瀕臨死亡，則擊殺他們並迅速撤退；艾莉一個人並不算太大的威脅（如果你已經做到了這一步）。

26f3db521e5b077d8ab6db76c0859b40f34b4457.source: After completing the quest, the party will be returned to Talmark Wilderness, by the portal to Majesty's Rest.
26f3db521e5b077d8ab6db76c0859b40f34b4457.text: 完成任務後，隊伍將透過傳送門返回突馬克荒地，到達王者安息處。

ee7d379136490486581ae6735bbe99b5390b1844.source: Cairn the Berserker will not appear unless you talk to Livia first.
ee7d379136490486581ae6735bbe99b5390b1844.text: 除非你先與 莉薇亞 交談，否則狂戰士凱恩不會出現。

8f4f6afab37fc0d89b15c36d4d0fa978d14dda6e.source: The lever does not open the gate until you have killed all the 10 groups within Shaemoor (the monitor will show that you possess the key).
8f4f6afab37fc0d89b15c36d4d0fa978d14dda6e.text: 在您殺死 夏恩摩 中的所有 10 群組之前，槓桿不會開啟門（監視器將顯示您擁有鑰匙）。

457e43e4875725307718f9dd838f54748875dab8.source: Be careful at the main gate to Shaemoor; it is possible to aggro several small groups from inside the town creating a 20-foe mob. Should this happen (often after a party wipe), it can appear to be difficult to pull the groups apart. Take advantage of the gate as a natural choke point for blocking and using AoE skills.
457e43e4875725307718f9dd838f54748875dab8.text: 在 夏恩摩 的大門處要小心；可以從城鎮內部聚集幾個小團體，建立 20-foe 暴民。如果發生這種情況（通常是在聚會結束後），似乎很難將團體分開。利用大門作為阻擋的天然阻塞點並使用 範圍性 技能。

a3eadd63c3a9b9f1ad08fba0f8a595ef01704b02.source: In Russian, Italian, Spanish and French translations, the number of groups remaining is not posted. Some of the tablets of Janthir are on hills or sloping terrain; they appear to float above the ground (this is most easily observed before the main bridge to Shaemoor).
a3eadd63c3a9b9f1ad08fba0f8a595ef01704b02.text: 在俄語、義大利語、西班牙語和法語翻譯中，未公佈剩餘組數。詹瑟爾的一些石碑位於山丘或斜坡上；它們似乎漂浮在地面之上（這在通往 夏恩摩 的主橋之前最容易觀察到）。

fc1219599b75fef29688609a4fdde8547f179b6e.source: Talk to Old Joness to gain passage down the Ullen River.
fc1219599b75fef29688609a4fdde8547f179b6e.text: 與 老瓊斯 交談以取得通往 烏崙河 的通道。

cf956b9f5f1890f80d32889581f3a4055529765a.source: Deliver Evennia's message to Derrikk Deathblade.
cf956b9f5f1890f80d32889581f3a4055529765a.text: 將 伊凡妮雅 的訊息傳遞給 Derrikk Deathblade。

d7334151e8cbaf2ca7faaf519af7e02701b4e66e.source: Follow Carlotta right after exiting Henge of Denravi. Along the way are many groups of Jungle Trolls and Moss Scarabs, with the odd Life Pod thrown in for good measure. Stopping to fight these groups will not cause Carlotta to pause in her trek towards Old Joness, but this doesn't matter as the spider drops Marking Webs every so often to mark the path as the group continues onward. Follow these (there is no need to pick them up) and eventually Old Joness will be located. Carlotta will not be attacked by aggressive mobs in the area, but you cannot auto-follow her either.
d7334151e8cbaf2ca7faaf519af7e02701b4e66e.text: 退出 丹拉維聖地 後立即依照 卡羅塔 操作。沿途有許多叢林巨魔和苔蘚聖甲蟲，還有奇怪的 生命豆莢。停止與這些群體戰鬥不會導致 卡羅塔 暫停向 老瓊斯 的旅程，但這並不重要，因為隨著群體繼續前進，蜘蛛會不時掉落標記網來標記路徑。按照這些（無需拿起它們）最終將找到 老瓊斯。 卡羅塔 不會受到該地區侵略性生物的攻擊，但你也不能自動跟隨她。

65c3dd720d58590c35c83b5f38087d6d7e985c0b.source: It should be noted that you do not have to wait for Carlotta to reach Old Joness in order to speak with him.
65c3dd720d58590c35c83b5f38087d6d7e985c0b.text: 應該注意的是，您不必等待 卡羅塔 到達 老瓊斯 才能與他交談。

dfe751cbf3a6a5009bb9d1d714b1e3145925abeb.source: When speaking with Old Joness, follow the dialogue tree that is indicated by Shadow when taking the quest: speak about his son, the White Mantle, and he will eventually take you to Riverside Province (outpost) to get the quest reward by delivering Evennia's Secret Orders to Blade Warrior Derikk.
dfe751cbf3a6a5009bb9d1d714b1e3145925abeb.text: 與老瓊斯交談時，按照闇影在接受任務時指示的對話樹進行操作：談論他的兒子白斗篷，他最終會帶你到河畔地帶（前哨站），透過將伊凡妮雅的秘密指令傳遞給光刃戰士德利克來獲得任務獎勵。

f0c12d1e263a99496bffdcb1a84f0249f13afa95.source: Alternatively, if you already have Riverside Province on your map, you can simply map travel there and collect your reward.
f0c12d1e263a99496bffdcb1a84f0249f13afa95.text: 或者，如果您的地圖上已經有 河畔地帶，您可以簡單地繪製那裡的旅行地圖並獲得獎勵。

616fcef8c9764733b4274d156d339e62819cdbcb.source: Seek out Headmaster Quin in the monastery.
616fcef8c9764733b4274d156d339e62819cdbcb.text: 在修道院裡尋找奎因校長。

8c5039722cb9c98960bcaab219109862080ae1a2.source: Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial Mantid Hatchlings, you will learn the following skills:
8c5039722cb9c98960bcaab219109862080ae1a2.text: 與 星岬寺 入口處的 Ludo 交談即可進入。如果您跳過了螳螂幼體教程，您將學到以下技能：

9da95f207de7e546fdab45979fee9b4e1eb08347.source: Search Sunqua Vale for Professor Gai.
9da95f207de7e546fdab45979fee9b4e1eb08347.text: 搜尋 桑泉谷 尋找蓋教授。

72b9feb7b5ace23bbbc3298451c188548d5742c1.source: Gai can be found in Sunqua Vale, southwest of the exit from the monastery. Look for Kaabo Cemetery if you have trouble finding him.
72b9feb7b5ace23bbbc3298451c188548d5742c1.text: Gai 位於 桑泉谷，修道院出口西南側。如果您找不到他，請前往卡博公墓。

83d985d3eba1303cc34b2b80ce4f5f660024ccf9.text: 竊取 歐爾 的權杖。

f21ceb76d99321909cc37018e88c2bcfd71cd27e.source: Avoid detection on your way to the temple.
f21ceb76d99321909cc37018e88c2bcfd71cd27e.text: 在前往寺廟的途中避免被發現。

ad90d0039156f8e7bf9af759e2aef20a69c6ed1b.source: Talk to Dinas to get the scepter.
ad90d0039156f8e7bf9af759e2aef20a69c6ed1b.text: 與 戴納斯 交談以獲得權杖。

b2bb284a5337735cf4bc91b8c96e7e4cedf8ed9e.source: Escape to the bridge to the northeast.
b2bb284a5337735cf4bc91b8c96e7e4cedf8ed9e.text: 脫逃 到東北方的橋。

eaaa7b140942aee9b245e555769fcb2471b5fde5.source: *BONUS* Take out the Watchman at each tower, so Saidra can get the weapons through.
eaaa7b140942aee9b245e555769fcb2471b5fde5.text: *獎勵*幹掉每座塔樓的守望者，這樣 Saidra 就可以拿到武器了。

526fc52d462d9dbdbfa4c851f7176c142f83e460.source: This mission can be done without fighting much of anything by avoiding enemies or running past them. The first half is guarded by undead for the most part. All nine of the towers can be completely avoided by having one person walk up close. This will have the effect of the watchtower guards calling the other troops in, allowing your party to sneak by on the outside. When you reach Dinas you will get the Scepter of Orr and there will be a cut-scene. Open the nearby door and follow the path to the northeast. Eventually you will reach a boss blocking a bridge. In theory you are supposed to kill it and run the Scepter of Orr across the bridge, but you can walk to the left of him and the cutscene will activate anyway.
526fc52d462d9dbdbfa4c851f7176c142f83e460.text: 透過避開敵人或跑過他們，可以在不進行任何戰鬥的情況下完成此任務。前半部大部分都是由不死族守衛。一個人走近就能完全避開九座塔。這將產生瞭望塔守衛呼叫其他部隊的效果，讓你的隊伍可以從外面溜過去。當你到達戴納斯時，你將獲得歐爾的權杖，並且會有過場動畫。開啟附近的門，沿著小路往東北方向走。最終你會遇到一個阻擋橋梁的boss。理論上你應該殺死它並執行 歐爾 的權杖過橋，但你可以走到他的左邊，無論如何過場動畫都會啟動。

310db49554aba8233487df46e788fea326476d79.source: The bonus is quite a different story. Instead of sneaking around the entire White Mantle, the bonus requires defeating the guards in the towers. First, you need to defeat the enemies on the first tower (1). Then head southwest and talk to Saidra (2). She will speak of a need to allow supply trains to slip through the area, which requires the towers be neutralized. There are nine towers in all (positions 1 and 3), each with about a dozen White Mantle guarding it.
310db49554aba8233487df46e788fea326476d79.text: 獎金則完全是另一回事。獎勵不需要在整個 白斗篷 周圍潛行，而是需要擊敗塔中的守衛。首先，您需要擊敗第一座塔（1）上的敵人。然後向西南方向前進並與 Saidra (2) 交談。她將談到需要允許補給列車穿過該地區，這需要摧毀塔樓。總共有九座塔（位置 1 和 3），每個塔大約有十幾個 白斗篷 守衛。

d8fa1d05a4bbc1c1db752ff61d853e9efe1d8001.source: There are a couple of stationary enemies in front of each tower, but the watchtower guard will sound the alarm as you approach, causing all nearby White Mantle to return to the tower. To counter the reinforcements, start by setting your team back from the tower (e.g. by flagging party NPCs). Next, send in just one character to trigger the mantle, back away a bit, and wait for the troops to begin dispersing. Pull just a few mantle at a time, defeat them, and repeat until you are left with just the stationary troops.
d8fa1d05a4bbc1c1db752ff61d853e9efe1d8001.text: 每個塔樓前都有幾個靜止的敵人，但當您接近時，瞭望塔守衛會發出警報，導致附近的所有 白斗篷 返回塔樓。為了對抗援軍，首先讓你的隊伍離開塔樓（例如標記隊伍 NPC）。接下來，只派出一個角色來觸發斗篷，後退一點，等待部隊開始分散。 拉出 一次只需幾個斗篷，擊敗他們，然後重複，直到只剩下駐紮的部隊。

8068d32685c6535838fd5074f58df14fba4e2aa4.source: The guards are not within your line of sight, so you usually cannot hit them with projectiles or projectile-based spells.
