Melee characters can sometimes attack the guards through the doors of the tower; however, they are easy prey to non-projectile damage (e.g. via many caster skills): while you hurt them with health degeneration or non-projectile skills, they will have trouble doing any damage to your party.
8068d32685c6535838fd5074f58df14fba4e2aa4.text: 守衛不在你的視線範圍內，所以你通常無法用射彈或基於彈頭的法術擊中他們。 肉搏 角色有時可以透過塔門攻擊守衛；然而，他們很容易受到非投射傷害（例如透過許多施法者技能）：當你用健康退化或非投射技能傷害他們時，他們將很難對你的隊伍造成任何傷害。

82c40448d28286917da77f436eb6eb673b65fa5b.source: Do not cross the bridge with the Scepter until you receive notice that the bonus has been completed.
82c40448d28286917da77f436eb6eb673b65fa5b.text: 在您收到獎金已完成的通知之前，請勿攜帶權杖過橋。

9bdc96703c3c5d29724a2fc7e0aa764b49568644.source: Consider completing the bonus before going to collect the sceptre, as it leaves you with a very clear run to the bridge.
9bdc96703c3c5d29724a2fc7e0aa764b49568644.text: 考慮在去收集權杖之前完成獎勵，因為它可以讓你非常清楚地跑到橋上。

92bc482f30b8d11fa35a0c80c2580da92a9ff5ac.source: Area of effect spells are helpful in clearing the towers.
92bc482f30b8d11fa35a0c80c2580da92a9ff5ac.text: 範圍法術有助於清除塔樓。

d2bfda31ec246308700c0e8f4c243f1e69803468.source: Consider bringing skills that benefit from holding a bundle on the character that carries the Scepter.
d2bfda31ec246308700c0e8f4c243f1e69803468.text: 考慮為攜帶權杖的角色帶來可以受益的技能。

3007a3702380377479ef98ec82497b3e77f07d9f.source: Anti-caster skills to counter White Mantle Savant's Searing Heat and Ward Against Elements.
3007a3702380377479ef98ec82497b3e77f07d9f.text: 反施法者技能可對抗 白斗篷學者 的 灼熱氣息 和 元素結界。

15374a0c1f2f1d76ec335a098d46522b12efd9c3.source: If your party has physical attackers, stance removal skills are useful to end White Mantle Seekers's Dryder's Defenses.
15374a0c1f2f1d76ec335a098d46522b12efd9c3.text: 如果你的隊伍有物理攻擊者，姿態移除技能對於結束 白斗篷 探索者的 蛛化精靈防禦 非常有用。

f5620950bf18ff672e042a8e67791dd102c0212d.source: Saidra: "You must be more discreet. If the Mantle see you talking to me, they may become suspicious."
f5620950bf18ff672e042a8e67791dd102c0212d.text: Saidra：“你必須更加謹慎。如果地幔看到你在跟我說話，他們可能會起疑心。”

5511ba86185f6b5672456b5301522649807c2949.source: Saidra: "Well done. Now go finish what you were sent here for, and I'll rendezvous with you on the other side."
5511ba86185f6b5672456b5301522649807c2949.text: Saidra：“幹得好。現在去完成你被派到這裡的任務，我會在另一邊與你會合。”

75d0b9db41ea4be2b0283d345c7691f0430a59b5.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "Listen up, there's talk of raiders on the prowl. If you see any, they are to be terminated on sight"
75d0b9db41ea4be2b0283d345c7691f0430a59b5.text: 白斗篷判官：“聽著，有傳言說襲擊者正在潛行。如果你看到任何人，他們就會被處決”

3a00678957b9fd8ef6961f0d732fb435222560f9.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "The Unseen Ones are awfully quiet tonight."
3a00678957b9fd8ef6961f0d732fb435222560f9.text: 白斗篷判官 (1)：“隱形存在們今晚非常安靜。”

1be892bbedf80a4cd5576f0e229e13b04d192b8e.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "When have they ever been noisy?"
1be892bbedf80a4cd5576f0e229e13b04d192b8e.text: 白斗篷判官 (2)：“他們什麼時候吵過？”

0de26417e186cd859080bb7922afaab67bac1745.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "You know what I mean."
0de26417e186cd859080bb7922afaab67bac1745.text: 白斗篷判官 (1)：“你知道我的意思。”

e6aa05ccfca9e7ad11dbc2da5343bc9f0204a0c1.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "Yeah, you're right. I wonder what's up?"
e6aa05ccfca9e7ad11dbc2da5343bc9f0204a0c1.text: 白斗篷判官 (2)：“是的，你說得對。我想知道發生了什麼事？”

3c78b57dd97c9aa77ee6b4d735b36d2c492e693c.source: White Mantle Knight (1): "Last night I saw a bone dragon."
3c78b57dd97c9aa77ee6b4d735b36d2c492e693c.text: 白斗篷騎士 (1)：“昨晚我看到一條骨龍。”

d08a1818e629510836878672a321957329644767.source: White Mantle Knight (2): "A bone dragon? Really? Where?"
d08a1818e629510836878672a321957329644767.text: 白斗篷騎士 (2)：“骨龍？真的嗎？在哪裡？”

6e70ab8a4329db518ed9046469a5f0749c01cdc8.source: White Mantle Knight (1): "Down in the swamp. A couple of ghouls were leading it around on a leash."
6e70ab8a4329db518ed9046469a5f0749c01cdc8.text: 白斗篷騎士 (1)：“在沼澤裡。幾個食屍鬼用皮帶牽著它。”

4313a347246b131f8ce9ccb051a25b86524297c4.source: South of Temple of the Unseen

0a2eb341c62542b290d3d7dc3756586ef9585732.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "The prophecies of the Unseen Ones talk about the coming of the undead."
0a2eb341c62542b290d3d7dc3756586ef9585732.text: 白斗篷判官 (1)：“隱形者的預言談到了不死族的到來。”

31ca0b7063e88793217d5924a12226e6e17a1b1c.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "You really believe that stuff?"
31ca0b7063e88793217d5924a12226e6e17a1b1c.text: 白斗篷判官 (2)：“你真的相信那些東西？”

1de689a48fa08ed4bdebbc78081a9e873c631cdf.source: White Mantle Justiciar (1): "Yeah, and you should too!"
1de689a48fa08ed4bdebbc78081a9e873c631cdf.text: 白斗篷判官 (1)：“是的，你也應該這樣做！”

65737434175eb940cbe013f4c411664465d10936.source: White Mantle Justiciar (2): "All right. All right. Don't blow your top."
65737434175eb940cbe013f4c411664465d10936.text: 白斗篷判官 (2)：“好。好。別發脾氣。”

82a4110b450fbaaefc2a0137f0b45306229f7bb2.text: 喬納斯和格里姆納爾特

e78bef17e9d491d6333a8cb2fef7ab9489cb03d5.source: Jonas: "What's all this talk about a scepter?"
e78bef17e9d491d6333a8cb2fef7ab9489cb03d5.text: 喬納斯：“這麼多關於權杖的討論是什麼？”

4be030104e640c2c8473823035cedd7cca6cd63a.source: Grimnalt: "I don't know, but it's got the White Mantle all in a huff."
4be030104e640c2c8473823035cedd7cca6cd63a.text: Grimnalt：“我不知道，但它對 白斗篷 非常憤怒。”

0ee4cdb7dedfbcd08b90bc35609d684b93b17a77.source: Jonas: "You don't think it could be the famed Scepter of Orr, do you?"
0ee4cdb7dedfbcd08b90bc35609d684b93b17a77.text: 喬納斯：“你認為這不會是著名的 歐爾 權杖，對嗎？”

71d85d15ae85c22e662d9f8aa84b2d60f9be3c92.source: Grimnalt: "Bah, don't be silly. That's just a legend, nothing but an old wives' tale."
71d85d15ae85c22e662d9f8aa84b2d60f9be3c92.text: 格里姆納爾特：“呸，別傻了。這只是一個傳說，只不過是一個老太太的故事。”

005da4d224e899efca31ba93eb8e54a1fa51cfac.source: Jonas: "Well, there was such a place as Orr, I visited there when I was a little boy."
005da4d224e899efca31ba93eb8e54a1fa51cfac.text: 喬納斯：“嗯，有一個像 歐爾 這樣的地方，我小時候去過那裡。”

14baaf1a45ebdb47a1c4e24e3c245931d8953a9e.source: Grimnalt: "I wasn't sayin' there wasn't a place called Orr."
14baaf1a45ebdb47a1c4e24e3c245931d8953a9e.text: Grimnalt：“我並不是說沒有一個叫 歐爾 的地方。”

8d1931ccc6cd6149cfeb56873348279ab52a5f5c.text: 喬納斯：“那你剛才說什麼？”

cd236ac8d30b820c55cd9c966c4c2b89dc1f350d.source: Grimnalt: "I was sayin' their ain't no magical scepter, that's all."
cd236ac8d30b820c55cd9c966c4c2b89dc1f350d.text: 格里姆納爾特：“我只是說他們不是魔法權杖，僅此而已。”

98c2902a89a7447e1c0a560be9a72808fb46578d.source: Jonas: "And I says there is a magical scepter."
98c2902a89a7447e1c0a560be9a72808fb46578d.text: 喬納斯：“我說有一根神奇的權杖。”

7c0159dd77c8e0cd7749cbafd11caaf687a2f012.source: Grimnalt: "Well, then you'd be as dumb as an ox then wouldn't ya be?"
7c0159dd77c8e0cd7749cbafd11caaf687a2f012.text: Grimnalt：“好吧，那你就傻得像頭牛了，不是嗎？”

246745916b6e28691cf4c0c5cefcf39473c41c87.text: 喬納斯：“我？笨得像頭牛嗎？”

6e040eaacaf3707e0b4749e79562d05b7568ed2a.text: 格里姆納爾特：“我就是這麼說的。”

3699d07018de0ba226f9fd4f07ae61062b62a33b.text: 河畔地帶（影片） 戴納斯

8256f5bcf1af9098f6a7b7cc0d8e49a11c627115.source: "My friends, it is good to see you again."
8256f5bcf1af9098f6a7b7cc0d8e49a11c627115.text: “我的朋友們，很高興再次見到你們。”

d1a7f32ad2c20d3b25988703e3750283a7042bd8.source: "I didn't think when we met off in D'Alessio Seaboard that I would be giving you the Scepter of Orr."
d1a7f32ad2c20d3b25988703e3750283a7042bd8.text: “我沒想到當我們在 達雷西海濱 見面時，我會把 歐爾 權杖送給你。”

8e566c7fc031d76c681bd86f1efcb230ef0f16fc.source: "Come, you must not linger here.The Zealots will be back soon."
8e566c7fc031d76c681bd86f1efcb230ef0f16fc.text: 「走吧，你不能在這裡逗留，狂熱者很快就會回來。”

4997a2959a292c72eece16ce0f5e15926366a63f.source: "I will show you the quickest escape route."
4997a2959a292c72eece16ce0f5e15926366a63f.text: “我會告訴你最快的逃生路線。”

c494a3e2acb9b2344f1c6ca024eae5f231a93a8d.source: "To the east is a bridge that will take you over the Ullen River to safety."
c494a3e2acb9b2344f1c6ca024eae5f231a93a8d.text: “東邊有一座橋，可以帶你越過 烏崙河 到達安全地帶。”

00d953c7befc1f9b62f1b09e9f88cf6ea6e6726c.source: "Stay off the beaten path, and whatever you do, avoid the watchtowers!"
00d953c7befc1f9b62f1b09e9f88cf6ea6e6726c.text: “遠離人跡罕至的地方，無論你做什麼，都要避開瞭望塔！”

4507dd9485cb90b17e1fd3c03a285c715169d376.source: "Many men have died for this. Guard it with your life."
4507dd9485cb90b17e1fd3c03a285c715169d376.text: “很多人為此而死。用你的生命來守護它。”

e1ac9ec39ebe3b405bbff128a5922e4d20c8ac47.source: White Mantle Knight: "The Scepter of Orr. It's been stolen,"
e1ac9ec39ebe3b405bbff128a5922e4d20c8ac47.text: 白斗篷騎士：“歐爾 的權杖。它被偷了。”

09d47f520a610bc68107fd8809b4047c77189eb2.source: White Mantle Knight: "The thieves are heading east, toward the Ullen River."
09d47f520a610bc68107fd8809b4047c77189eb2.text: 白斗篷騎士：“盜賊正在向東行進，前往 烏崙河。”

07c4c753bb747fd95d10ffb1b8879f8aa3737d4b.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "They won't get far."
07c4c753bb747fd95d10ffb1b8879f8aa3737d4b.text: 白斗篷判官：“他們不會走多遠的。”

a5fc00bdc05df88ea6b414f3aed6a6078cccde95.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "There are two watchtowers between here and the river. If they try to go past, they will be caught. If they stop to ponder a way around, we will catch them."
a5fc00bdc05df88ea6b414f3aed6a6078cccde95.text: 白斗篷判官：“這裡和河流之間有兩座瞭望塔。如果他們試圖過去，就會被抓住。如果他們停下來想辦法繞過去，我們就會抓住他們。”

6bf7a337b19099917b9bb7d0cc1caee35dbe8f69.source: White Mantle Justiciar: "No one who steals from the White Mantle lives long enough to enjoy the spoils."
6bf7a337b19099917b9bb7d0cc1caee35dbe8f69.text: 白斗篷判官：“從 白斗篷 偷竊的人都沒有活得足夠長的時間來享受戰利品。”

a1d8d3c1aee56df090290e4fd240c1f781ff9334.text: 伊凡妮雅：“啊，歐爾 的權杖。”

fbbc7cab9554737c548f583c38fe11e97e034302.source: Evennia: "The time for retribution against our oppressors has finally arrived."
fbbc7cab9554737c548f583c38fe11e97e034302.text: 伊凡妮雅：“對我們的壓迫者進行報復的時刻終於到來了。”

1c5779c52af040ea5be4dd36de46239b2931b6cc.source: : "I thought the point of stealing the Scepter was to keep it from the Mantle."
1c5779c52af040ea5be4dd36de46239b2931b6cc.text: ：“我認為偷走權杖的目的是為了讓它遠離斗篷。”

b842052b25c2b6ccac2f92c08d7434c02a715f6b.source: : "How are we going to use it?"

c70a89c8f5a6547cb9be7a7046f8ae28ab6a3a58.source: Evennia: "We can't, but Vizier Khilbron can."
c70a89c8f5a6547cb9be7a7046f8ae28ab6a3a58.text: 伊凡妮雅：“我們不能，但 基卜倫元老 可以。”

dd567474fee9c62aafae1ceab4122191183e2890.source: Evennia: "I negotiated a treaty with the former adviser to the King of Orr."
dd567474fee9c62aafae1ceab4122191183e2890.text: 伊凡妮雅：“我與 歐爾 國王的前顧問談判了一項條約。”

c9ced23f85356c2cc86c653287adb8798d1fde9e.source: Evennia: "In exchange for the Scepter, the good vizier has agreed to aid us in our fight against the Mantle."
c9ced23f85356c2cc86c653287adb8798d1fde9e.text: 伊凡妮雅：“作為權杖的交換，善良的維齊爾同意幫助我們對抗地幔。”

4e972c030dfb03e0e0a543f9dd3f2cafa5e2ea99.source: : "Vizier Khilbron? What can one man do for us that we can't do for ourselves?"
4e972c030dfb03e0e0a543f9dd3f2cafa5e2ea99.text: ：“基卜倫元老？有什麼事情是一個人能為我們做而我們自己卻做不到的呢？”

76b3c130dba7fef929a9d6d411f71b8bb335e374.source: Evennia: "The Vizier is a very powerful mage. He can show us the path that will lead to our victory."
76b3c130dba7fef929a9d6d411f71b8bb335e374.text: 伊凡妮雅：“維齊爾是一位非常強大的法師。他可以向我們展示通往勝利的道路。”

e2472d8a3964eb13799e15c1401ab43dc8558ade.source: Evennia: "Come now. The sun will be rising soon, and we must prepare for our journey to meet the vizier."
e2472d8a3964eb13799e15c1401ab43dc8558ade.text: 伊凡妮雅：“來吧。太陽很快就會升起，我們必須準備好迎接維齊爾的旅程。”

ce49d422bc84c92d0cf1981e0465b09542ed3ac3.text: Saidra：“瑪基思 有什麼訊息嗎？”

7d28897cfcc35c5d34a6a7b1cc5eb5877d5a0c64.source: : "Markis? Why would we have news of him?"
7d28897cfcc35c5d34a6a7b1cc5eb5877d5a0c64.text: ：“瑪基思？為什麼我們會得到他的訊息？”

90fc148391e3af281cdcf936ec2a6aff6233784a.source: Saidra: "He didn't meet you outside the Temple?"
90fc148391e3af281cdcf936ec2a6aff6233784a.text: Saidra：“他沒有在聖殿外遇見你？”

7bc7d8b29d028f2a3500421b3fbdcddc53c09ae0.source: : "No. We knew of no such plan."
7bc7d8b29d028f2a3500421b3fbdcddc53c09ae0.text: ：“不。我們不知道有這樣的計劃。”

d5aafa55f634297a76172fe2341a45a6fdfaa323.source: Saidra: "Hmm. Maybe he'll catch up with us at the docks."
d5aafa55f634297a76172fe2341a45a6fdfaa323.text: Saidra：“嗯。也許他會在碼頭追上我們。”

9e0b4b9233110ff6232f43fb23dedaa51680bdbe.source: Saidra: "Let's go. Even the Mantle are smart enough to find their way across that river."
9e0b4b9233110ff6232f43fb23dedaa51680bdbe.text: Saidra：“我們走吧。即使是地幔人也足夠聰明，能夠找到穿過那條河的路。”

ed791ae577ea83bf803defc0f63d15784eec6a1e.source: Saidra: "We'd best not be here when they do."
ed791ae577ea83bf803defc0f63d15784eec6a1e.text: Saidra：“他們來的時候我們最好不要在這裡。”

b64e87bf66348ffbe6c5c9ec5fc32e51ac406d0c.source: All watchtowers seems to share the same alert trigger, at the very least the last two towers. If you get into range of one of those, enemies will also gather at the other.
b64e87bf66348ffbe6c5c9ec5fc32e51ac406d0c.text: 所有瞭望塔似乎都共用相同的警報觸發器，至少最後兩座瞭望塔是如此。如果你進入其中一個的範圍，敵人也會聚集到另一個。

ce2d7a004e544fb63054e8d1e9890fc684cac788.source: If you talk to Dinas after you get the scepter he will follow you; he doesn't use any skills.
ce2d7a004e544fb63054e8d1e9890fc684cac788.text: 如果你在獲得權杖後與 戴納斯 交談，他會跟隨你；他不使用任何技能。

7e1c7199249a52ccad5dfb3863ba13ed341680f7.source: You are not required to carry the Scepter at all times: you can drop it at any time and return to pick it up later. For example, you can drop it before each battle or drop it near Dinas, defeat all the guards, and then return to pick it up and run it back to the bridge.
7e1c7199249a52ccad5dfb3863ba13ed341680f7.text: 你不需要一直攜帶權杖：你可以隨時放下它，然後稍後再回來取。例如，你可以在每次戰鬥前將其掉落，或者將其掉落在 戴納斯 附近，擊敗所有守衛，然後返回撿起並將其跑回橋上。

85d15cd13152437836dde0bbc504dd4a6a7f293d.source: The White Mantle and the undead are hostile to each other, you can sometimes lure one group into fighting another.
85d15cd13152437836dde0bbc504dd4a6a7f293d.text: 白斗篷 和不死族彼此敵對，有時你可以引誘一組與另一組戰鬥。

638aa74f1a885d78aebc54a2f3c455fbd0b1a4ac.source: Complete exploration of the mission area contributes 1.8% to the Tyrian Cartographer title. The easiest way to do this is to completely clear the entire area as you scrape, thus securing the bonus as well. Be careful at the bridges near the final boss, lest you prematurely trigger the mission's end. Drop the Scepter of Orr before fighting the boss and continue exploring past the bridge. Then, return for the Scepter and take it back to the bridge to get credit for the mission.
638aa74f1a885d78aebc54a2f3c455fbd0b1a4ac.text: 對任務區域的完整探索為 1.8% 貢獻了 Tyrian 版圖 頭銜。最簡單的方法是在刮擦時完全清理整個區域，從而確保獎金。小心最終boss附近的橋梁，以免過早觸發任務結束。在與 Boss 戰鬥之前放下 歐爾 的權杖，然後繼續探索橋梁。然後，返回權杖並將其帶回艦橋以獲得任務獎勵。

1edd4890cebe810af2447f0706bb94c2ef8e1c15.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #6 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
1edd4890cebe810af2447f0706bb94c2ef8e1c15.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#6 頁。

74beab7943be8fa5c7cabb4885788646b7260eac.source: After completing this mission, your party will appear in Sanctum Cay.
74beab7943be8fa5c7cabb4885788646b7260eac.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將出現在 神聖沙灘 中。

8ed82c02e67c37e3761cd2a6e6bd46159015b3d6.source: Unlike other Prophecies missions, chests do not appear during this mission. To complete the bonus objective, only the Seekers in the towers need to be killed even though the bonus text suggests that the Watchtower Guards must be defeated.
8ed82c02e67c37e3761cd2a6e6bd46159015b3d6.text: 與其他 阿斯卡隆戰記 任務不同，此任務期間不會出現寶箱。要完成獎勵目標，只需要殺死塔中的探索者，即使獎勵文本表明必須擊敗瞭望塔守衛。

7942877c3012114a2def9eacfb8faaa9309f39aa.source: Speak with Jiaju Tai and arrange passage to D'Alessio Seaboard
7942877c3012114a2def9eacfb8faaa9309f39aa.text: 與 加貝泰 交談並安排前往 達雷西海濱 的通道

4a4fe306662507b8f2e060a815c54137a2fb3479.text: 尋找哈克伍德的 戴納斯。

5efddc485f63ca3d5ec63a589cc485ef751a0b3e.source: Fight your way to the Temple of Tolerance.

af1749c5cd5510aabf9dd991ec2bddcca916fee4.source: Jiaju Tai (at the pier, in Lion's Arch) takes you to the beach. From there, head to Hakewood to speak with Dinas. After he opens the gate, travel towards Temple of Tolerance. Inside the temple, you will face multiple groups of mantles from both entrances. Clear out the groups on the platforms below Koril the Malignant, to give you room to maneuver and a place to retreat. Koril calls in reinforcements when his health drops, one time each at 75%, 50%, 25% and even 10% health. Since the April 28, 2026 update, Koril will often use Well of Blood when engaged, dropping his health and immediately summoning reinforcements.
af1749c5cd5510aabf9dd991ec2bddcca916fee4.text: 加貝泰（位於碼頭的 獅子拱門）帶您前往海灘。從那裡前往哈克伍德與 戴納斯 交談。開啟大門後，前往寬容寺。在寺廟內部，您將在兩個入口處看到多組披風。清除惡毒者科裡爾下面平臺上的隊伍，給你迴旋的空間和撤退的地方。當 Koril 的生命值下降時，他會呼叫增援，在 75%、50%、25% 甚至 10% 生命值各一次。自四月 28、2026 更新以來，Koril 在交戰時經常使用 血之池，降低生命值並立即召喚援軍。

11ed7fe69d1504bd161d7f061abe1b3bc52db7c7.source: When attacking Koril, flag heroes and hench at his location so as not to lure Patrols accidentally. If a patrol comes during the fight against Koril, retreat and deal with the patrol, then return. If more than one appears, pull them apart first. Like his reinforcements, once killed, these patrols do not return. Alternatively, kill most of the patrols and then pull Koril away from his spawn point towards the entrance stairs. Koril's reinforcements spawn at his original position, so this makes the fight much easier.
11ed7fe69d1504bd161d7f061abe1b3bc52db7c7.text: 攻擊科裡爾時，標記英雄並在他的位置駐守，以免意外引誘巡邏隊。如果在與科裡爾的戰鬥中出現巡邏隊，請撤退並解決巡邏隊，然後返回。如果出現多個，請先將它們分開。就像他的援軍一樣，一旦被殺，這些巡邏隊就不會回來。或者，殺死大部分巡邏隊，然後將科裡爾從他的重生點拉向入口樓梯。科裡爾的援軍會在他原來的位置出現，因此這使得戰鬥變得更加容易。

b64c6a1227fe6c3c31ff3d5c137f95314e63ea8a.source: Once Koril dies, the quest is complete, and a 15-second countdown will start, automatically sending the party back to Lion's Arch upon its conclusion.
b64c6a1227fe6c3c31ff3d5c137f95314e63ea8a.text: Koril 死亡後，任務即完成，15 秒倒數計時將開始，結束後自動將隊伍送回 獅子拱門。

62cd7415eea9f05d09af8b7e1a9a5dcdbc7e34fe.source: Flag your party at edge of the balcony where Koril stands. Next, Pull (and kill) Koril's allies. Finally, pull and kill Koril. This allows you to avoid any patrols and reinforcements (since the latter spawn only on/near the altar).
62cd7415eea9f05d09af8b7e1a9a5dcdbc7e34fe.text: 在科裡爾所在的陽臺邊緣標記你的隊伍。接下來，拉出（並殺死）科裡爾的盟友。最後，拉並殺死科裡爾。這可以讓你避免任何巡邏和增援（因為後者只在祭壇上/附近產生）。

fb9b1b8f2b7c6e6a4b9491652171bc5843ad3975.source: There are plenty of corpses to power minion masters. However, use caution against Koril; the minions can easily over-aggro patrols or otherwise undermine your efforts to pull Koril separately.
fb9b1b8f2b7c6e6a4b9491652171bc5843ad3975.text: 有大量的屍體可以為小兵大師提供能量。然而，要謹慎對待 Koril；小兵很容易過度仇恨巡邏，或以其他方式破壞你單獨拉動科裡爾的努力。

6219690272bf3ebf08d5e7a9826d1c0c1b9fd95e.source: Interrupts shorten the fight by preventing Koril from using life stealing skills.
6219690272bf3ebf08d5e7a9826d1c0c1b9fd95e.text: 打斷可以阻止科裡爾使用生命竊取技能，從而縮短戰鬥時間。

14c74ecec986316c32340f378ff3951123913a41.source: Manage your team carefully: pull groups, flag your team apart, and avoid accidentally aggroing the wrong groups. For this mission, the caster and ranger henchmen are easier to control.
14c74ecec986316c32340f378ff3951123913a41.text: 小心管理您的團隊：拉動小組，標記您的團隊，並避免意外地激怒錯誤的小組。對於這個任務，施法者和遊俠追隨者更容易控制。

4959d1fa89bdf12f8abb5da02a500a6940a6a922.source: There is a resurrect point that shares the spawn point for this quest.
4959d1fa89bdf12f8abb5da02a500a6940a6a922.text: 有一個復活點與該任務共享重生點。

cd36f7aaa7f326ca3cae8d9bb081b79afd595c30.source: It is possible to walk onto a Mursaat tower inside the temple.
cd36f7aaa7f326ca3cae8d9bb081b79afd595c30.text: 可以步行到寺廟內的 馬賽特 塔。

dad0d536d42e239f40ec4353b245355697c5b82d.source: The Shining Blade bounties for Justiciar Kasandra and Zaln the Jaded can be completed at the same time as this mission.
dad0d536d42e239f40ec4353b245355697c5b82d.text: 正義卡桑德拉和玉質扎恩的 光刃公會 賞金可以同時完成任務。

126ad109492eb03e34996405676605032d802886.source: Speak with Professor Gai when you are ready to begin your test.
126ad109492eb03e34996405676605032d802886.text: 當您準備好開始測試時，請與蓋教授交談。

dcd536bdae6e62a1bddbf71d9f3b92dfdf819936.source: Destroy the wild minions in the mausoleum. [5...0] minions remaining.
dcd536bdae6e62a1bddbf71d9f3b92dfdf819936.text: 消滅陵墓中的野生爪牙。剩餘 [5...0] 小兵。

e7bb430d5f0e94a38261509e3c6d6bb30183eefa.source: See Professor Gai for your reward.

25fe44a820b2d8e034e1d453c12b83025096e645.source: Professor Gai will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
25fe44a820b2d8e034e1d453c12b83025096e645.text: 當你接受任務時，蓋教授將教你以下技能：

5e41ac2c322bc7ee9853af7c4a49d31c34f99a31.source: When you talk to Professor Gai again, a level 3 Wild Minion will appear nearby for you to kill, another after the first dies, and so on until you have killed all 5.
5e41ac2c322bc7ee9853af7c4a49d31c34f99a31.text: 當你再次與蓋教授交談時，附近會出現一個級別的 3 野生小兵供你殺死，第一個死亡後會出現另一個，依此類推，直到你殺死所有 5。

38cabdb3ca1dc859cf38e865ef9641508d7216db.source: Enter the Lion's Arch Keep and approach Princess Salma. A dialogue will begin between her and the spy Dinas. After the dialogue concludes, the quest will become available from Salma.
38cabdb3ca1dc859cf38e865ef9641508d7216db.text: 進入 獅子拱門要塞 並接近薩爾瑪公主。她和間諜 戴納斯 之間將開始對話。對話結束後，薩爾瑪即可完成任務。

3be1642cb8c365a66274b02a1787fe0ae17306fc.source: Hurry to Dakutu Camp in Talmark Wilderness, and bring word to Bartholos of the impending attack on Lion's Arch.
3be1642cb8c365a66274b02a1787fe0ae17306fc.text: 趕緊前往 突馬克荒地 的達庫圖營地，並向巴索洛斯通報 獅子拱門 即將遭受的襲擊。

cf9bbf19e07519597e161a31969d98d9bd932f74.source: Take the Secret River Passage to Divinity Coast, and order Livia to bring the Asuran weapon to Lion's Arch.
cf9bbf19e07519597e161a31969d98d9bd932f74.text: 沿著秘密河道前往神聖海岸，然後命令莉薇亞將阿蘇拉武器帶到獅子拱門。

8b0adcfe8093d14af4085bed639e967467c0481f.source: Warn Elder Hezron in Beetletun of the armies marching south.
8b0adcfe8093d14af4085bed639e967467c0481f.text: 警告 甲蟲鎮 中的 長老赫茲倫 軍隊向南進軍。

5b3e02914f34d2456cdc64dbadcd9e3f230bea73.source: Meet Livia, Zinn, and Blimm outside Beetletun, and protect them while they travel with you to North Kryta Province. They must all survive the journey.
5b3e02914f34d2456cdc64dbadcd9e3f230bea73.text: 在 甲蟲鎮 外與 莉薇亞、Zinn 和 布林姆 會面，並在他們與您一起前往 科瑞塔北部 時保護他們。他們必須在旅途中倖存下來。

4a1f83ef59b64b0b4e288a68a6f8dacabaf73bc0.source: Warn Elder Sobel of the coming attack, and advise her to evacuate Nebo Village.
4a1f83ef59b64b0b4e288a68a6f8dacabaf73bc0.text: 警告索貝爾長老即將到來的襲擊，並建議她撤離尼波村。

5b3c98f19ca6bf5492cdf877bc6dbac6438c308f.source: Meet Livia, Zinn and Blimm in North Kryta Province, and continue protecting them on the journey to Lion's Arch. They must all reach Lion's Arch safely.
5b3c98f19ca6bf5492cdf877bc6dbac6438c308f.text: 在 科瑞塔北部 中認識 莉薇亞、Zinn 和 布林姆，並在通往 獅子拱門 的旅程中繼續保護他們。他們必須全部安全到達 獅子拱門。

4b2e12554db099b167c1acd3a0623d80969cb9d6.source: Convince Captain Greywind to evacuate the Ascalon Settlement.
4b2e12554db099b167c1acd3a0623d80969cb9d6.text: 說服 格雷溫軍官 撤離 阿斯卡隆移民區。

07523937fd779881872b9643a66698667eb84562.source: Protect the Ascalonian Settlers on their way to take refuge in Lion's Arch. Do not let them all die.
07523937fd779881872b9643a66698667eb84562.text: 保護前往 獅子拱門 避難的阿斯卡隆定居者。不要讓他們全部死去。

23d73c9fe74d7521868c6b98808473fff696f31d.source: Your goal is to gather all of Kryta's allies to prepare for the impending Battle for Lion's Arch. Since this requires running rather than fighting, bring lots of shouts or other skills without activation times.
23d73c9fe74d7521868c6b98808473fff696f31d.text: 您的目標是聚集 科瑞塔 的所有盟友，為即將到來的 獅子拱門 之戰做好準備。由於這需要奔跑而不是戰鬥，因此請帶上大量的喊叫或其他無需啟用時間的技能。

099349811b31bddcbb23130034d8cd1cec72a140.source: Start from Temple of the Ages, cross the portal to the Talmark Wilderness, make your way to the Shining Blade Camp, and speak to Bartholos. Next, head to Zinn's laboratory via the Secret River Passage; once there, speak to Livia. (Single-player teams should map back to the Temple; multiple-player teams can split up when they cross into Talmark and have one person wait by the passage.) Resign and map to Beetletun to speak with Elder Hezron.
099349811b31bddcbb23130034d8cd1cec72a140.text: 從 世紀神殿 出發，穿過傳送門到達 突馬克荒地，前往 光刃公會 營地，並與 Bartholos 交談。接下來，透過秘密河道前往津恩的實驗室；到達那裡後，請與 莉薇亞 聯絡。 （單人團隊應該映射回聖殿；多人團隊可以在進入塔爾馬克時分開，並讓一個人在通道旁等待。）辭職並對映到 甲蟲鎮 與 長老赫茲倫 交談。

e5e3896574b0cf65528bcbe826efaefa25d2c6b0.source: The next set of activities involve escorting various NPCs towards various stops along the way to Lion's Arch, while being pursued by various groups of White Mantle. Instead of trying to fight the mobs, concentrate on boosting everyone's speed with shouts such as "Charge!", "Fall Back!", and/or "Incoming!". Also bring spirits and traps to distract or slow your foes: anytime foes start closing in, drop a spirit or trap and/or sacrifice a hero (by flagging them near the mobs).
e5e3896574b0cf65528bcbe826efaefa25d2c6b0.text: 下一組活動包括護送各個 NPC 前往 獅子拱門 沿途的各個站點，同時受到 白斗篷 各群體的追擊。不要試圖與小怪戰鬥，而是專注於透過喊聲「衝鋒！」、「後退！」和/或「來襲！」來提高每個人的速度。也要帶著靈魂和陷阱來分散敵人的注意力或減慢敵人的速度：每當敵人開始逼近時，就扔下靈魂或陷阱和/或犧牲英雄（透過在小怪附近標記他們）。

c2e5c91cebd1102d1837e00a574a0dd270f4235f.source: First, accompany Livia, Zinn, and Blimm from Beetletun to Lion's Arch (with several stops). Head east into Nebo Terrace and wait for the dialogue to complete. When the NPCs begin running, follow them to Nebo Village and speak to Elder Sobel. Next, head to North Kryta Province, but wait outside the portal until the quest updates. (The Mantle will not catch you here, even if you forgot to bring party-wide speed boosts.)
c2e5c91cebd1102d1837e00a574a0dd270f4235f.text: 首先，陪伴 莉薇亞、Zinn 和 布林姆 從 甲蟲鎮 到 獅子拱門（經過幾站）。向東進入 尼伯山丘 並等待對話完成。當 NPC 開始奔跑時，跟隨他們前往尼波村並與索貝爾長老交談。接下來，前往 科瑞塔北部，但在門戶外等待，直到任務更新。 （即使你忘記帶全隊速度提升，斗篷也不會在這裡抓住你。）

72990ed9d929814e8eceb450e1c42a31d2cfe138.source: After entering North Kryta Province, speak to Captain Greywind and, again, wait for the dialogue to finish. Some Ascalonian Settlers will join your caravan. The Mantle will start pursuing you in earnest as you enter the narrow passage to the south. This time, you must use the speed boosts and delaying tactics to ensure that the relevant NPCs (Blimm, Livia, Zinn, and at least one of the settlers) make it safely to LA. Using heroes, flag them ahead of your route and stay behind to help stragglers get unstuck or to delay the enemy; with multiple players, have at least one keep ahead of the group while the other brings up the rear. As long as you are careful, you should have little trouble making it to LA safely.
72990ed9d929814e8eceb450e1c42a31d2cfe138.text: 輸入 科瑞塔北部 後，與 格雷溫軍官 對話，然後再次等待對話完成。一些阿斯卡隆定居者將加入你的商隊。當你進入南面的狹窄通道時，地幔將開始認真追擊你。這次，您必須使用加速和拖延戰術來確保相關 NPC（布林姆、莉薇亞、Zinn 和至少有一位定居者）安全抵達洛杉磯。使用英雄，在你的路線前面標記他們，並留在後面幫助掉隊的人擺脫困境或拖延敵人；當有多名玩家時，至少讓一個人保持在隊伍的前面，而另一個則在後面。只要小心，安全抵達洛杉磯應該不會有什麼困難。

505b3bd9a4a6f100ae2a6b697ff21cdedac2fd4e.source: Once you reach LA, do not enter until your allies are removed from the party window. (There is no danger once you are within compass distance of the portal.)
505b3bd9a4a6f100ae2a6b697ff21cdedac2fd4e.text: 一旦你到達洛杉磯，在你的盟友被從隊伍視窗中移除之前不要進入。 （一旦您處於傳送門的羅盤距離內，就不會有危險。）

24bf8b495d90e0182c59b590a3e8e7200bc74c9c.source: Cross the poisonous swamp with the Bone Dragons and find a gate lever - pull it once to open the gate. Continue up the hill to meet Vizier Khilbron (point A), and a cinematic will trigger. He will summon undead allies to aid the party. The party leader can talk to the Smoke Phantoms so that they follow the party, instead of running off on their own (and soon thereafter die to the White Mantle).
24bf8b495d90e0182c59b590a3e8e7200bc74c9c.text: 與骨龍一起穿越有毒沼澤，找到門桿 - 拉動一次即可開啟門。繼續往山上走到達 基卜倫元老（A 點），然後會觸發動畫。他將召喚亡靈盟友來協助隊伍。隊伍領袖可以與煙霧幻影交談，以便他們跟隨隊伍，而不是自己逃跑（不久之後就會死於 白斗篷）。

af8334c1655b05f7d565477e8b7a9be83622cf23.source: Escape to the eastern shore defeating the White Mantle on the way. Find the docks (point B) and the Vizier will appear again. Protect the Vizier while he summons a ship. White Mantle groups will then approach from both sides. Finish each group before the next wave comes or the party may be overwhelmed. When the boat appears, any one player boarding it will end the mission. Sending heroes or henchmen onto it will not end the mission.
af8334c1655b05f7d565477e8b7a9be83622cf23.text: 脫逃 前往東岸，途中擊敗 白斗篷。找到碼頭（B點），維齊爾將再次出現。在維齊爾召喚一艘船時保護他。然後，白斗篷 小組將從兩側接近。在下一波浪潮到來之前完成每一組，否則隊伍可能會被淹沒。當船出現時，任何登上它的玩家都會結束任務。派遣英雄或追隨者登上它並不會結束任務。

8f6513fd4d81318b19aed1381df9faffa6d6d410.source: The bonus requires that the party escorts a Restless Spirit to his final resting place. Although it is invulnerable to damage, the bonus can be tricky because (a) the spirit can get stuck on fixed objects or body blocked by allied spirits or minions, (b) it changes its following mechanic midway through the mission, (c) it lags behind the party, and (d) it is not necessarily affected by party-wide speed boosts.
8f6513fd4d81318b19aed1381df9faffa6d6d410.text: 獎勵要求隊伍護送不安的靈魂到他最後的安息之地。雖然它不會受到傷害，但獎勵可能會很棘手，因為（a）靈魂可能會卡在固定物體或被盟軍靈魂或小兵阻擋的身體上，（b）它在任務中途改變其跟隨機制，（c）它落後於團隊，並且（d）它不一定受到團隊範圍內速度提升的影響。

480625ac4b448a69b66030534b5e93d254e2b868.source: The spirit can be found after getting past the Fire Imps, at the end of the Lightning Drake beach (point 1). Have the scepter-bearer speak to it once and it will follow the scepter around, depending on who is carrying it. Once the party reaches the lever of the fort where the Vizier awaits, make sure that the spirit follows inside (and is not lagging behind); after the Vizier takes the scepter the cinematic is triggered, the gate will be locked, and the spirit will be stuck outside (preventing completion of the bonus).
480625ac4b448a69b66030534b5e93d254e2b868.text: 經過火小惡魔後，可以在 閃光龍獸 海灘的盡頭（點 1）找到靈魂。讓權杖持有者對它說話一次，它就會跟著權杖四處走動，這取決於誰攜帶它。一旦隊伍到達維齊爾等待的堡壘槓桿處，請確保靈魂跟隨進入（並且不落後）；維齊爾拿走權杖後，過場動畫被觸發，大門將被鎖定，靈魂將被困在外面（阻止獎勵的完成）。

d3780afb11b60453935ddc234cb58afa51eca28a.source: After talking to Khilbron, speak to the spirit again so that it begins following the party. Without the scepter, the spirit will usually follow the nearest player, but (as with any ally or follower), it might instead move towards the nearest player in motion (and within compass range). Keep an eye on the spirit at all times to make sure it remains close to the party.
d3780afb11b60453935ddc234cb58afa51eca28a.text: 與基爾布倫交談後，再次與靈魂交談，以便它開始跟隨隊伍。如果沒有權杖，靈魂通常會跟隨最近的玩家，但是（與任何盟友或追隨者一樣），它可能會移向最近的移動玩家（並且在羅盤範圍內）。時刻關注精神，確保它與黨保持密切聯絡。

1d9ffb01e7a9a8f7f4f2674c16023095a710ede1.source: The bonus only requires a slight detour from the docks to reach the cemetery (point 2), which can be done by hugging the cliffs. The event will not trigger until you get close to the docks. Alternatively, head for the docks first, defend the Vizier and exterminate all opponents and then lead the spirit to its resting place before getting on the boat.
1d9ffb01e7a9a8f7f4f2674c16023095a710ede1.text: 獎勵只需要稍微繞道從碼頭到達墓地（點2），這可以透過擁抱懸崖來完成。在您靠近碼頭之前，該事件不會觸發。或者，先前往碼頭，保衛維齊爾並消滅所有對手，然後將靈魂帶到安息之地，然後再上船。

8d1aef52560e4f05719e56862bcb90cfc1cc1646.source: Consider anti-caster skills against the Inferno Imps who use Rodgort's Invocation.
8d1aef52560e4f05719e56862bcb90cfc1cc1646.text: 考慮針對使用 洛葛特的魔咒 的 地獄火 小鬼的反施法者技能。

caa100aee1cc42e817beba8ff78b1508de6d80cc.source: Be wary of Lightning Drakes spiking with Mind Shock and Lightning Orb.
caa100aee1cc42e817beba8ff78b1508de6d80cc.text: 警惕使用 心靈震暴 和 閃電球 的 Lightning Drakes 尖峰。

4dcd821cadb84bd9a67afee948e278eae6e3d67b.source: Hugging the rocks "walls" both north and west of the docks will not trigger the Vizier on the docks. Hugging the northernmost rocks will spawn the White Mantle enemies that would otherwise spawn while the Vizier performs his ritual. This allows the party to dispatch them without having to worry about protecting an NPC. When the waves from the east have stopped spawning, the waves from the south will have stopped and be standing on the pier. To avoid spawning the Vizier next to them, use a longbow or flatbow from the raised platform directly west of the docks to draw enemies away. This allows a safe pull, as well as a nicely balled up group of enemies. It's not recommended though, because Vizier sometimes spawns and gets oneshoted.
4dcd821cadb84bd9a67afee948e278eae6e3d67b.text: 擁抱碼頭北部和西部的岩石“牆”不會觸發碼頭上的維齊爾。擁抱最北端的岩石會生成 白斗篷 敵人，否則這些敵人會在維齊爾執行儀式時生成。這使得隊伍可以派遣他們而不必擔心保護 NPC。當來自東方的波浪停止產生時，來自南方的波浪也將停止並站在碼頭上。為了避免在他們旁邊產生維齊爾，請從碼頭正西的凸起平臺上使用長弓或扁弓來吸引敵人。這樣可以安全地拉動，也可以很好地聚集一群敵人。但不建議這樣做，因為維齊爾有時會生成並被單射。

fd3ce78f411ccd3074ce70dd8b1076d46a0b9454.source: During the Nebo Terrace and North Krytan Province sections of this quest, Gwen is listed as Vanguard Mesmer.
fd3ce78f411ccd3074ce70dd8b1076d46a0b9454.text: 在此任務的 尼伯山丘 和北克里坦省部分，關 被列為先鋒 幻術師。

c171c5a437295401d1dc1987bdbeb5faf55473e5.source: Upon claiming the reward for the preceding quest Temple of the Intolerable, you might have to rezone to allow Dinas to spawn and talk with Princess Salma.
c171c5a437295401d1dc1987bdbeb5faf55473e5.text: 在領取前一個任務 科瑞塔戰爭主線任務 的獎勵後，您可能需要重新分割槽以允許 戴納斯 生成並與薩爾瑪公主交談。

0fa8dc2a2f8f6302078c0d22ecbac8bec0964e04.source: During the last leg of this quest, you can zone to Lion's Arch and go back to North Kryta Province to find that there are substantially less foes making a vanquish of North Kryta Province easier. Just do not talk to Captain Greywind as that will trigger the quest. This essentially empties the northwest field of Tengu and the pathway to Nebo Terrace.
0fa8dc2a2f8f6302078c0d22ecbac8bec0964e04.text: 在此任務的最後一段中，您可以區域到 獅子拱門，然後返回 科瑞塔北部，發現敵人明顯減少，從而更容易擊敗 科瑞塔北部。只是不要與 格雷溫軍官 交談，因為這會觸發任務。這基本上清空了 天狗 的西北區域和通往 尼伯山丘 的路徑。

c077b07ff1a9cf726bb975e4f72ce4df837ec465.source: Starting the last leg of the quest in Lion's Arch and running north to the dialogue point (few or no enemies along the way) has the added benefit of activating the resurrection shrine along the way, allowing the possibility of still completing the mission if your party wipes.
c077b07ff1a9cf726bb975e4f72ce4df837ec465.text: 在 獅子拱門 中開始任務的最後一段，並向北跑到對話點（沿途很少或沒有敵人）還有一個額外的好處，那就是沿途啟用復活神殿，這樣即使你的隊伍被消滅，仍有可能完成任務。

94545672fcf549428affb5dc6cc0d2c85e7ac32d.source: Although the dialogue for this quest will be triggered upon entering Lion's Arch Keep, you must first accept any rewards for completed Wanted quests before Princess Salma will give you this quest.
94545672fcf549428affb5dc6cc0d2c85e7ac32d.text: 雖然進入 獅子拱門要塞 時會觸發此任務的對話，但您必須先接受完成通緝任務的任何獎勵，然後薩爾瑪公主才會給您此任務。

3cc8a8414aa7af4ee9a4a5fd904ebdad1e5951e9.source: In Nebo Terrace, 6 groups of White Mantle will spawn, each consisting of 4 White Mantle and 1-3 jade constructs. The first three will spawn one at a time as you reach the point where the NPCs pause and wait for you, and the last three will spawn simultaneously once you enter the open plain, then march towards the exit to North Kryta Province where they will spread away from each other and stop.
3cc8a8414aa7af4ee9a4a5fd904ebdad1e5951e9.text: 在 尼伯山丘 中，將生成 白斗篷 的 6 組，每個組由 4 白斗篷 和 1-3 玉結構組成。當你到達 NPC 停下來等待你的地方時，前三個會一次生成一個，而一旦你進入開闊的平原，後三個就會同時生成，然後向 科瑞塔北部 的出口前進，在那裡它們會彼此分散並停止。

f6fad389f76dcbb13f9a8e20fbe5ae14571f6570.source: After talking with Captain Greywind, about 8 or more groups of 3 White Mantle and 2 jade constructs each will rapidly spawn beyond the portal to Nebo Terrace and start marching towards Lions Arch along the main road. Two of these groups will split off where Captain Grewyind stood and head north further into Ascalon Settlement. Once you get into compass range of Sarnia the Red-Handed, she and the nearby White Mantle will join the chase against the settlers.
f6fad389f76dcbb13f9a8e20fbe5ae14571f6570.text: 與 格雷溫軍官 交談後，大約 8 或多組 3、白斗篷 和 2 玉石構造體將迅速在通往 尼伯山丘 的傳送門之外生成，並開始沿著主路向獅子拱門行進。其中兩支隊伍將在格魯因德船長站立的地方分開，向北進一步進入 阿斯卡隆移民區。一旦您進入“赤手”薩尼亞的指南針範圍，她和附近的 白斗篷 將加入對定居者的追捕。

3737ca8af945bda52f5e41fa269f5240c4902d89.source: The chasing White Mantle do not drop any loot.
3737ca8af945bda52f5e41fa269f5240c4902d89.text: 追逐的 白斗篷 不會掉落任何戰利品。

c7e52e48a8094e2e08e2f59b3470966fd188c831.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Stingray Strand and start the mission. Completing Riverside Province also brings the party here.
c7e52e48a8094e2e08e2f59b3470966fd188c831.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 魟魚湖濱 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 河畔地帶 也將聚會帶到這裡。

6c9e92cf8cfe180c09a4871a80e748f141c927ea.source: Deliver the Scepter of Orr to Vizier Khilbron and rendezvous with Evennia on the other side of the island.
6c9e92cf8cfe180c09a4871a80e748f141c927ea.text: 將 歐爾 的權杖交給 基卜倫元老，並在島的另一邊與 伊凡妮雅 會合。

3684e6841e097f4e7ddca8a91e0bd195eed26808.source: Locate the Vizier and deliver the Scepter.
3684e6841e097f4e7ddca8a91e0bd195eed26808.text: 找到維齊爾並交出權杖。

cde374d3678976f0483cdadfb3412b047f63151b.source: Make your way to the docks on the opposite side of the island.

70641753efcd22f5b39dbfb26afaeffbe055f500.source: *BONUS* Help the Restless Spirit find his final resting place.
70641753efcd22f5b39dbfb26afaeffbe055f500.text: *獎勵*幫助不安的靈魂找到他最後的安息之地。

1c410a085098cfb742658783d4df0f1d67f7293f.source: ADDED: You have been betrayed! Evennia has been taken. Meet the Vizier at the docks to make your escape.
1c410a085098cfb742658783d4df0f1d67f7293f.text: 補充：你被背叛了！ 伊凡妮雅 已被佔用。在碼頭與維齊爾會面以逃脫。

ba3d307e1aabd850681ba1629930534a157cf232.source: ADDED: Defend the Vizier while he summons a ship for your escape. Get on the boat when he is done.
ba3d307e1aabd850681ba1629930534a157cf232.text: 新增：當維齊爾召喚一艘船幫助你逃跑時，保衛他。等他忙完了就上船。

fb30773f6be1f47a0b16c981bbdf0c704cea9d2e.source: Talk to Evennia and get the Scepter of Orr. Holding it grants +1 energy regeneration, and when dropped it increases the maximum energy of nearby allies by 10.
fb30773f6be1f47a0b16c981bbdf0c704cea9d2e.text: 與 伊凡妮雅 對話並取得 歐爾 的權杖。持有它可以使 +1 能量再生，當掉落時，它可以使附近盟友的最大能量增加 10。

093e704b6c0921a60123a831024cab9a5f58799a.source: Head south past the Inferno Imps onto the beach with Lightning Drakes, then follow the river north. There are undead patrols at the bridge; consider pulling the mobs apart for safety.
093e704b6c0921a60123a831024cab9a5f58799a.text: 與 Lightning Drakes 一起向南經過 地獄火 Imps 到達海灘，然後沿著河流向北行駛。橋上有亡靈巡邏隊；為了安全起見，考慮將小怪分開。

2fd65c201e29fa41b28f34f718ae88146bddb28f.source: Defend Princess Salma with your life. Her death is your defeat.
2fd65c201e29fa41b28f34f718ae88146bddb28f.text: 用你的生命保衛薩爾瑪公主。她的死就是你的失敗。

9efa9a8b9b15b34a3f90415b98b889dbbffd9e0d.source: After the completion of this quest, explorable areas in Kryta will return to their pre-War in Kryta versions. However, if you have any active Wanted bounty, every Krytan zone will include the WiK foes. Dropping the bounties (or accepting the reward for their completion) will restore the original spawns.
9efa9a8b9b15b34a3f90415b98b889dbbffd9e0d.text: 完成此任務後，科瑞塔 中的可探索區域將會回到 科瑞塔戰爭 之前的版本。然而，如果你有任何活躍的通緝賞金，每個科瑞塔區域都會包括 WiK 敵人。放棄賞金（或接受完成獎勵）將恢復原來的生成。

afae9ef2845a5a3e32f460d9c69bbbc2accf5093.source: You can continue to accept Wanted bounties.
afae9ef2845a5a3e32f460d9c69bbbc2accf5093.text: 您可以繼續接受通緝賞金。

d6ba6d21c5a561a84b7dee27778c1ec66b0fa955.source: Enter Lion's Arch Keep and talk to Bartholos to be transported into a new instance and begin the quest. Once there, the front gate will not open until you speak to Sergio; this gives you time to familiarize your team with the area and discuss strategy. If Princess Salma dies at any point, you will fail the mission. However, you will succeed if you can efficiently defend the various choke points along the path to the Keep.
d6ba6d21c5a561a84b7dee27778c1ec66b0fa955.text: 輸入 獅子拱門要塞 並與 Bartholos 交談以傳送到新例項並開始任務。到達那裡後，除非您與塞爾吉奧交談，否則前門不會開啟；這讓您有時間讓您的團隊熟悉該領域並討論策略。如果薩爾瑪公主在任何時候死亡，你的任務就會失敗。然而，如果你能有效地防守通往要塞的道路上的各個阻塞點，你就會成功。

7f7f5e8afba224953fe520e809975515fa9d3905.source: After Sergio opens the gate, White Mantle groups will approach the city. Throughout the mission, enemy mobs will travel down a set path, making their way towards Salma.
7f7f5e8afba224953fe520e809975515fa9d3905.text: 在塞爾吉奧開啟大門後，白斗篷 小組將接近這座城市。在整個任務過程中，敵方暴徒將沿著設定的路徑行進，前往薩爾瑪。

7e769adc55e71ef3e9e1b0ea5516d35ba1577d86.source: The first few groups will be made up of White Mantle only, beginning with a mix of martial classes. After a number of waves, High Inquisitor Toriimo will launch his attack, reinforced by spellcaster groups.
7e769adc55e71ef3e9e1b0ea5516d35ba1577d86.text: 前幾組將僅由 白斗篷 組成，從混合武術課程開始。經過幾輪攻擊後，高階審判官托里莫將在施法者隊伍的增援下發動攻擊。

3a8fc07c205f29305be6cecf0fe494ad0b167285.source: After a couple more waves, Confessor Isaiah's troops will arrive, attacking primarily using ranged attacks. His group also includes the first Jade Construct (the only foe in the first phase that can cast Spectral Agony).
3a8fc07c205f29305be6cecf0fe494ad0b167285.text: 再過幾波之後，懺悔者以賽亞的部隊就會到達，主要使用遠端攻擊。他的隊伍還包括第一個翡翠構造體（第一階段中唯一可以施放幽靈痛苦的敵人）。

9de9771d77720011ce7b7ca162ff1d93ec318441.source: After the Mantle bosses die, the mobs will start to include more Jade constructs and fewer humans. As this happens, Blimm will activate their secret weapon which gives all allies in Lion's Arch (including spirits and minions) Spectral Infusion, an effect that protects them from Spectral Agony and reflects back some damage. This shield lasts for a set duration and will not affect allies created after it is initially used.
9de9771d77720011ce7b7ca162ff1d93ec318441.text: 地幔首領死亡後，暴徒將開始包含更多的翡翠構造體和更少的人類。當這種情況發生時，布林姆 將啟動他們的秘密武器，為 獅子拱門 中的所有盟友（包括靈魂和小兵）提供光譜 灌注魔力，該效果可以保護他們免受光譜痛苦並反射一些傷害。此護盾會持續一定的時間，並且不會影響最初使用後建立的盟友。

8ca6d9f6aac3dd13424c9fcc7edf2ebdd0f66378.source: Jade Armors and Jade Bows will begin to replace the White Mantle mobs until only Jade constructs spawn. A Perfected Armor and Perfected Cloak will spawn in different waves, one before and one after Lucent the Spectral's wave.
8ca6d9f6aac3dd13424c9fcc7edf2ebdd0f66378.text: 翡翠盔甲和翡翠弓將開始取代 白斗篷 生物，直到只有翡翠構造體生成。 完美盔甲 和 完美斗篷 將在不同的波中生成，一波在光譜朗訊的波之前，一波在之後。

39961868fcbed1d5996922cf7966580669609f76.source: Oizys the Miserable and the two Cairns
39961868fcbed1d5996922cf7966580669609f76.text: 悲慘者奧伊茲和兩個凱恩斯

57e8dd1a496fc648e582d524f5703944aa280fc7.source: Jade Cloaks will begin to spawn in addition to the Armors and the Bows. After a couple waves Oizys the Miserable and the two Bow constructs, Cairn the Malignant and Cairn the Vengeful, will spawn.
57e8dd1a496fc648e582d524f5703944aa280fc7.text: 除了盔甲和弓之外，翡翠斗篷也將開始生成。幾波之後，悲慘者 Oizys 和兩個 弓 構造體，惡毒者凱恩和復仇者凱恩將會生成。

40d4126073e543656d3b9c07f64cff0a0ec49807.source: Ambrillus the Guardian and Talios the Resplendent
40d4126073e543656d3b9c07f64cff0a0ec49807.text: 守護者 安布里洛斯與輝煌塔利奧斯

40f0eff19ee520fb04e505411f96465787a3467b.source: A few more groups will spawn, with the second to the last consisting of mainly Jade Cloaks and a Perfected Aegis. The final wave will include Ambrillus the Guardian, Talios the Resplendent, six Jade Cloaks, four Jade Armors, and four Jade Bows. Once they are defeated, a one minute timer will begin before the entire party is transported to a post-battle Lion's Arch.
40f0eff19ee520fb04e505411f96465787a3467b.text: 將會出現更多的隊伍，倒數第二個隊伍主要由翡翠斗篷和完美的 神賜之盾 組成。最後一波將包括 守護者 安布里魯斯、輝煌塔利奧斯、六件翡翠斗篷、四件翡翠盔甲和四把翡翠弓。一旦他們被擊敗，在整個隊伍被傳送到戰後 獅子拱門 之前，一分鐘計時器將會開始。

a33b86d9a8e7bbba1016bca2d445554fcb4b301a.source: If your party wipes, it will resurrect next to Princess Salma.
a33b86d9a8e7bbba1016bca2d445554fcb4b301a.text: 如果你的隊伍被消滅，它將在薩爾瑪公主旁邊復活。

9ef94320dc419cdf0a2a11a8f41c66eea7559e95.source: Since the foes do not take advantage of this, if you lose more than 2-3 party members, it is usually more efficient to completely wipe and resurrect rather than try to use a reduced team to fight.
9ef94320dc419cdf0a2a11a8f41c66eea7559e95.text: 由於敵人不會利用這一點，因此如果您損失了超過 2-3 的隊伍成員，那麼完全消滅並復活通常比嘗試使用減少的團隊進行戰鬥更有效。

36679e6e8d1be80dbd5a811c4597ebf25b3bf81e.source: If the party is worried that the charging waves may be overwhelming, consider clearing the areas south and east of the docks first. Just out of sight north of the beach in the east is a narrow pathway, at the end of which is the location of all the foes that will charge the docks. The path is a great bottleneck for skills such as Panic, and Psychic Instability. The foes that charge the docks from the south side are not already present on the map and must be cleared once spawned.Searching the entire south area for hidden areas, these foes seem to materialize out of thin air once triggered. This will greatly reduce pressure and the party can focus on clearing only waves from the south.
36679e6e8d1be80dbd5a811c4597ebf25b3bf81e.text: 如果該方擔心充電波可能會勢不可擋，請考慮先清理碼頭以南和以東的區域。東部海灘以北的視線之外有一條狹窄的小路，小路的盡頭是所有衝鋒碼頭的敵人的所在地。這條路徑對於 恐慌 和 精神失衡 等技能來說是一個很大的瓶頸。從南側衝鋒的敵人尚未出現在地圖上，一旦產生就必須清除。在整個南部地區尋找隱藏區域，這些敵人一旦被觸發，似乎會憑空出現。這將大大減輕壓力，黨可以集中精力清除來自南方的波浪。

6fea1c5f73e530b82181b7fa6dabe16966d8508a.source: Anti-caster skills to counter White Mantle Savant's Searing Heat and Ward Against Elements, as well as most other enemies encountered during this mission.
6fea1c5f73e530b82181b7fa6dabe16966d8508a.text: 反施法者技能對抗 白斗篷學者 的 灼熱氣息 和 元素結界，以及此任務中遇到的其他大多數敵人。

959d8ec13101ca7ce3c7faee8d21599d1c9a9ae7.source: It takes approximately 2 minutes and 20 seconds to summon the boat.
959d8ec13101ca7ce3c7faee8d21599d1c9a9ae7.text: 召喚船隻大約需要 2 分鐘和 20 秒。

70d85c01990b320daaca9dfd2bd676dc09506d09.source: This time can be speed up by casting Time Ward in range of Vizier Khilbron.
70d85c01990b320daaca9dfd2bd676dc09506d09.text: 這個時間可以透過在 基卜倫元老 範圍內施放時間結界來加速。

9a86a1983bcfd4b370a82eecef1c5a5039ff9dde.source: The Restless Spirit will follow the party onto the boat if the bonus was not completed before the cinematic triggers.
9a86a1983bcfd4b370a82eecef1c5a5039ff9dde.text: 如果獎勵在電影觸發前未完成，不安的靈魂將跟隨隊伍上船。

2e12e21152c627e9ff6491eed8a5516ba316ea8a.source: Despite the objectives and Vizier's dialogue stating that Evennia has been taken by the White Mantle, she remains in her initial spawn point for the entirety of the mission.
2e12e21152c627e9ff6491eed8a5516ba316ea8a.text: 儘管目標和 Vizier 的對話表明 伊凡妮雅 已被 白斗篷 佔領，但她在整個任務中仍停留在最初的重生點。

b9c79bbfa3caf85bf2e6bbad1a3ee80dbc762cfd.source: Complete exploration of the mission area contributes 1.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
b9c79bbfa3caf85bf2e6bbad1a3ee80dbc762cfd.text: 對任務區域的完整探索為 1.4% 貢獻了 Tyrian 版圖 頭銜。

604c664c6e55f20475c1b188ce932207e6c5a56d.source: This includes a large chunk of the ocean, which is cleared by viewing the end-cinematic.
604c664c6e55f20475c1b188ce932207e6c5a56d.text: 這包括一大片海洋，透過觀看片尾動畫即可清除。

27ccd15a76cd3f2d26ad525d942b3877a4c59e0f.source: Hug the cliffs while passing the docks to avoid summoning the Vizier, otherwise mantle will likely spawn near the docks and will instantly kill the Vizier when he appears (failing the mission).
27ccd15a76cd3f2d26ad525d942b3877a4c59e0f.text: 經過碼頭時擁抱懸崖以避免召喚維齊爾，否則地幔很可能會在碼頭附近生成，並在維齊爾出現時立即殺死他（任務失敗）。

cbc29a22fdb5544d572b5b2c4407524d5ab4b3e2.source: Alternatively, stand with the Vizier and outlast the foe spawns, without loading onto the boat when he tells you to. You may explore once there are no more waves incoming, and move onto the boat when you are ready to complete the mission.
cbc29a22fdb5544d572b5b2c4407524d5ab4b3e2.text: 或者，與維齊爾站在一起，在敵人出現後存活下來，但不要在他告訴你的時候裝上船。一旦不再有海浪襲來，您就可以進行探索，並在準備好完成任務時上船。

0adc2108450a46950b6a9ca7d4663a37c7286d41.source: After completing this mission, the party will be moved to The Amnoon Oasis.
0adc2108450a46950b6a9ca7d4663a37c7286d41.text: 完成此任務後，隊伍將轉移至 安奴綠洲。

280f56848a3bc12c18aea5b3de2e19e8c85c33ec.source: As with all enemies spawned by triggers or skills, the group of White Mantle that approaches the docks from the south can be pulled away from the docks and when aggro is subsequently broken, these enemies will attempt to run back to the pier in a straight line. This can cause them get stuck on walls or other obstructions, splitting up the large group into smaller, more manageable groups.
280f56848a3bc12c18aea5b3de2e19e8c85c33ec.text: 與所有由觸發器或技能產生的敵人一樣，從南邊接近碼頭的 白斗篷 群體可以被拉離碼頭，當仇恨隨後被打破時，這些敵人將嘗試直線跑回碼頭。這可能會導致它們卡在牆壁或其他障礙物上，將大組分成更小、更易於管理的群組。

e4294d2200d69396439683b87637e18df35e6832.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #7 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
e4294d2200d69396439683b87637e18df35e6832.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#7 頁。

765268f265d8eb11eab9cdd1c09ede4d75f23278.source: Even before the first cinematic, Vizier Khilbron holds the Scepter of Orr despite the fact that it was not yet given to him. When pulled away from the pier in their final location, the White Mantle from the south side of the docks can run off in a straight line away from the pier and get stuck on the first obstacle they run into. These foes will not return to the pier afterwards, but will still attack any opponent that enters their range.
765268f265d8eb11eab9cdd1c09ede4d75f23278.text: 甚至在第一部電影之前，基卜倫元老 就擁有 歐爾 的權杖，儘管事實上它尚未授予他。當在最終位置離開碼頭時，碼頭南側的 白斗篷 可以沿著直線跑離碼頭，並卡在遇到的第一個障礙物上。這些敵人之後不會返回碼頭，但仍會攻擊任何進入其範圍的對手。

f727561694f46c761a1b00de10763a9643593265.source: Speak with Bartholos in Lion's Arch Keep to assist with defending the city.
f727561694f46c761a1b00de10763a9643593265.text: 與 獅子拱門要塞 中的巴索洛斯交談，協助保衛城市。

94fab25e26fbf3dde2fd5dfbf57faa0b2733b56a.source: Order Firstwatch Sergio to open the front gates.
94fab25e26fbf3dde2fd5dfbf57faa0b2733b56a.text: 指令 警衛隊長薩吉歐 開啟前門。

58c10a1adefc4ff212c9546b850d419e971a4cd4.source: Defend Lion's Arch from the White Mantle onslaught pouring into the city.
58c10a1adefc4ff212c9546b850d419e971a4cd4.text: 保衛 獅子拱門 免於 白斗篷 湧入城市的攻擊。

20ed82a72b203530271cc4cad760f47c24d29ee3.source: Kill High Inquisitor Toriimo and his men.
20ed82a72b203530271cc4cad760f47c24d29ee3.text: 殺死大審判官托里莫和他的部下。

b63e9a88b299ab840221be2119c543d6336d8077.source: Kill Confessor Isaiah and his followers.
b63e9a88b299ab840221be2119c543d6336d8077.text: 殺死懺悔者以賽亞和他的追隨者。

4b2f4079cde9bacf68f463e7aee52dfe0f2fe046.source: Kill Oizys the Miserable and the two Cairns.
4b2f4079cde9bacf68f463e7aee52dfe0f2fe046.text: 殺死悲慘者奧伊茲和兩個凱恩。

c743e03c6ba7d7805b3ac60436b3b9d4461bedb7.source: Kill Ambrillus the Guardian and Talios the Resplendent.
c743e03c6ba7d7805b3ac60436b3b9d4461bedb7.text: 殺死 守護者 安布里魯斯和輝煌塔利奧斯。

7338adc66bf99c303b7ac8bc70c9f4209266b836.source: Once the quest is over, take time to do additional exploration of a small ledge past the lighthouse (south) for the Tyrian Cartographer title. If you forgot to do so, you can gate glitch the southern gate in Lion's Arch Keep to get there.
7338adc66bf99c303b7ac8bc70c9f4209266b836.text: 任務結束後，花點時間對燈塔（南邊）後面的一個小壁架進行額外的探索，以獲得 Tyrian 版圖 標題。如果您忘記這樣做，您可以透過 獅子拱門要塞 中的南門來到達那裡。

0045d395490fa9c9ef048efe954eb109a28fa482.source: Completing this stage of The War in Kryta before this stage appears in your quest log can make it difficult to proceed with the intermediary quests. If this happens, you can work around the issue by either following the manual walkthrough or by completing any of the available wanted quests and waiting to accept its reward until you have completed all the intermediary quests and The Battle for Lion's Arch.
0045d395490fa9c9ef048efe954eb109a28fa482.text: 在該階段出現在任務日誌中之前完成 科瑞塔戰爭 的這個階段可能會導致中間任務難以繼續。如果發生這種情況，您可以按照手動演練或完成任何可用的通緝任務並等待接受其獎勵，直到完成所有中間任務和 科瑞塔戰爭主線任務 來解決問題。

ed4f59fc30d53e084527e055a17b6cf26611aa7b.source: Find Ang the Ephemeral in Panjiang Peninsula.
ed4f59fc30d53e084527e055a17b6cf26611aa7b.text: 在 班讓半島 中找到短暫的 Ang。

d61921dfeb2ce81b0740e9c0b5972fe4862151b6.source: Ang is located near Qi Falls. To get there, make your way to Tsumei Village. Exit the town heading south west, then west until you get to the spirit.
d61921dfeb2ce81b0740e9c0b5972fe4862151b6.text: Ang位於Qi Falls附近。要到達那裡，請前往 蘇梅村。離開城鎮，向西南方向行駛，然後向西行駛，直到到達精靈。

7466d5f355e16580c237bfc83d717f2e7e88d2d8.source: Secrets in the Shadow neither active nor completed
7466d5f355e16580c237bfc83d717f2e7e88d2d8.text: 闇影 中的秘密既未啟動也未完成

6a518acb1f0f6ed67df7adc7007c1b2e698bc674.source: Meet Margrid the Sly on the Marga Coast.
6a518acb1f0f6ed67df7adc7007c1b2e698bc674.text: 在 馬加海岸 上認識狡猾的瑪格麗特。

31bc72a2cc2de203d3f15e2e927efce8ba8abf20.source: Collect the map of Gandara from Unlucky Simon.
31bc72a2cc2de203d3f15e2e927efce8ba8abf20.text: 從不幸的西蒙那裡收集甘達拉地圖。

c066ef6921988aee026c4697f0a3a8b40c124840.source: Strong-arm Shifty Lem until he gives up the map.
c066ef6921988aee026c4697f0a3a8b40c124840.text: 對 Shifty Lem 施以強力，直到他交出地圖。

59acb6e089916a159943b617961a11f50e0dd650.source: See Margrid the Sly for your reward.
59acb6e089916a159943b617961a11f50e0dd650.text: 去見狡猾的瑪格麗德以獲得獎勵。

07539c53dc5231b68f3c8235e8edf45d9bcec1dc.source: Margrid the Sly is outside of Yohlon Haven. Take her to Unlucky Simon, who tells her that the map was taken by Shifty Lem. Go westward and talk to him. He will become hostile, so defeat him and his party. Shifty Lem will turn friendly again and you can complete the quest.
07539c53dc5231b68f3c8235e8edf45d9bcec1dc.text: 狡猾的瑪格麗德位於 猶朗避難所 之外。帶她去看倒楣的西蒙，後者告訴她地圖被狡猾的萊姆拿走了。向西走去和他說話。他會變得充滿敵意，所以擊敗他和他的隊伍。狡猾的萊姆將再次變得友好，你可以完成任務。

685ed27b7e984fca46a9f0d7adc9300fb0f99002.source: Mutually exclusive with Secrets in the Shadow.
685ed27b7e984fca46a9f0d7adc9300fb0f99002.text: 與 闇影 中的 Secrets 互斥。

42f8822acfe5d7cbd6c3bd7ae0a2b534a7f7bf2a.source: If you leave the map while doing the quest you will have to start at the beginning.
42f8822acfe5d7cbd6c3bd7ae0a2b534a7f7bf2a.text: 如果您在執行任務時離開地圖，則必須從頭開始。

0cd49e9ea0c7928434624832b9cd30416fa6e82e.source: If, however, you leave after completion Margrid will wait for you in Marga Coast in front of Yohlon Haven where you first picked her up.
0cd49e9ea0c7928434624832b9cd30416fa6e82e.text: 但是，如果您在完成後離開，Margrid 將在您第一次接她的 馬加海岸 前面的 猶朗避難所 處等您。

439762a427fab6a75862baeae8422bc4c647d72f.source: Speak to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut.
439762a427fab6a75862baeae8422bc4c647d72f.text: 與 儀式大祭司撒穆特 交談。

1ed39dc48c4bc95febb4c08f2c9d69c8bbd5c6d6.source: Travel to Augury Rock, or go on foot from The Amnoon Oasis. In case of the latter, fight or run up to the teleporter in the southeast. The teleporter is activated by standing in the circle and turning back to view the switches. These will light up in a sequence and the player must touch them in the same order. Use the activated teleporter to cross the canyon and move on. From there, follow the monoliths up to Augury Rock.
1ed39dc48c4bc95febb4c08f2c9d69c8bbd5c6d6.text: 前往 占卜之石，或從 安奴綠洲 步行前往。如果是後者，請戰鬥或跑到東南方的傳送器處。站在圓圈中並回頭檢視開關即可啟動傳送器。這些將按順序亮起，玩家必須以相同的順序觸控它們。使用啟用的傳送器穿過峽谷並繼續前進。從那裡開始，沿著巨石走到 占卜之石。

ad60ccf29d250f1dd38ed74ec82656cd7f3ae89a.source: This quest is not necessary for the completion of the Augury Rock mission.
ad60ccf29d250f1dd38ed74ec82656cd7f3ae89a.text: 此任務對於完成 占卜之石 任務並不是必要的。

83343a6412834054b657f0968dc93ae5bc8eb699.source: Despite not being a primary quest or a requirement to progress, new players will do well to take this quest as it leads them to Augury Rock, where the next events in the storyline unfold.
83343a6412834054b657f0968dc93ae5bc8eb699.text: 儘管不是主要任務或進步的要求，但新玩家最好接受這個任務，因為它會引導他們到達 占卜之石，故事情節中的下一個事件將在此展開。

1d0eb3ddd3d98bb033670ffe06f6f492304d4446.source: There are no quests following this quest that lead players to the three mission outposts.
1d0eb3ddd3d98bb033670ffe06f6f492304d4446.text: 此任務之後沒有任何任務可以引導玩家前往三個任務前哨站。

9534df6b654be949a1ad462ebf49c1d23c8fd949.source: This quest does not show up as a primary quest in the quest log, though it is similar to other primary quests.
9534df6b654be949a1ad462ebf49c1d23c8fd949.text: 儘管該任務與其他主要任務類似，但它不會在任務日誌中顯示為主要任務。

eaec4bfe6c087999926d40f94cf749f1131d91e2.source: Speak with Ang again to begin eliminating the shackled spirits.
eaec4bfe6c087999926d40f94cf749f1131d91e2.text: 再次與昂交談，開始消除被束縛的靈魂。

b684f040a5b2cfb94736991856ac6bdb02c5334e.source: Defeat the 5 shackled spirits. You have [5...0] shackled spirits remaining.
b684f040a5b2cfb94736991856ac6bdb02c5334e.text: 擊敗 5 被束縛的靈魂。你還剩下[5...0]個被束縛的靈魂。

7149fd7cebc3347a459a0af785a7aedfcb041b87.source: See Ang the Ephemeral for your reward.
7149fd7cebc3347a459a0af785a7aedfcb041b87.text: 去見短暫的安格以獲得獎勵。

9c6059d4497d54f13488817399f065d73fdc00a5.source: Ang the Ephemeral will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
9c6059d4497d54f13488817399f065d73fdc00a5.text: 當你接受任務時，短暫的安會教你以下技能：

e2ba2706ec3ba1e1cce738b7bf880a563641799b.source: Follow the green markers and open the Soul Keepers, disposing of each spirit before moving on to the next. The spirits are fairly harmless, and Ang will heal you if needed. Even though they are spirits, they are able to move so it's possible to click the Soul Keepers and move to the next immediately.
e2ba2706ec3ba1e1cce738b7bf880a563641799b.text: 依照綠色標記開啟靈魂守護者，處理掉每個靈魂，然後再繼續下一個。這些靈魂相當無害，如果需要的話，安會治癒你。儘管它們是靈魂，但它們能夠移動，因此可以點選靈魂守護者並立即移動到下一個。

2697e7ddbde5284057dea6d0237971cd10b24377.source: Show the Map of Gandara to Jack of Truths in Pogahn Passage.
2697e7ddbde5284057dea6d0237971cd10b24377.text: 在 波甘驛站 中向 Jack of Truths 展示甘達拉地圖。

a4e9ea74bd4cf9379720cac4c912454164d67673.source: As soon as you spawn, return quickly to the fight; the more distance you can keep between Salma and your opponents, the safer she will be.
a4e9ea74bd4cf9379720cac4c912454164d67673.text: 一旦出現，就迅速返回戰鬥；薩爾瑪和對手之間保持的距離越遠，她就越安全。

fc8ee64260f7d49eacac1b06158fa11d91dddc23.source: Party-wide and area of effect (AoE) skills are especially effective for both you and the besieging forces; make sure you ball them up and keep your own team spread out.
fc8ee64260f7d49eacac1b06158fa11d91dddc23.text: 隊伍 範圍和範圍（範圍性）技能對你和圍攻部隊都特別有效；確保你把他們聚集起來並讓你自己的團隊分散開來。

308f1185dcfd05178b573fd80c47a2ed52f44b3a.source: The design of Lion's Arch lends itself well to Rangers: from the bluffs, they can use a flat- or longbow to do large amounts of damage before mobs reach the first staircase.
308f1185dcfd05178b573fd80c47a2ed52f44b3a.text: 獅子拱門 的設計非常適合遊騎兵：從懸崖上，他們可以在怪物到達第一個樓梯之前使用平弓或長弓造成大量傷害。

ad7cbfba0e71c353a8b614b907dbca9aef83dbff.source: Minion masters have plenty of fleshy enemies from which to summon allies, even during the middle waves of mostly Jade constructs (when allied NPCs are dying fast enough to fodder).
ad7cbfba0e71c353a8b614b907dbca9aef83dbff.text: 小兵大師有大量的肉質敵人可以召喚盟友，即使是在主要是翡翠建築的中波期間（當盟友 NPC 死亡速度足夠快時）也是如此。

3eaa61dc8f3d2b7c6cbb6714029857a76fc27403.source: Take advantage of the areas natural choke points: the main gate and the stairways.
3eaa61dc8f3d2b7c6cbb6714029857a76fc27403.text: 利用該地區的天然咽喉要道：正門和樓梯。

acd719f1c86b6d141ac6e645390644437a928ec9.source: Tanks can keep mobs at choke points (or elsewhere), forcing them to ball up; this maximizes the effectiveness of AoE skills, especially with other team members applying defensive skills, e.g. from a Bonder.
acd719f1c86b6d141ac6e645390644437a928ec9.text: 坦克可以將怪物困在阻塞點（或其他地方），迫使他們聚集在一起；這可以最大限度地發揮 範圍性 技能的有效性，尤其是在其他團隊成員應用防禦技能的情況下，例如：來自邦德。

ee5ea050c277a86cb79a7d2e69e4e462106eb9cd.source: Minion and spirit walls are effective at blocking incoming mobs.
ee5ea050c277a86cb79a7d2e69e4e462106eb9cd.text: 小兵牆和靈魂牆可以有效阻擋傳入的小怪。

ef9b5f5921d01786ecaf3f4d697adabcce35df87.source: Combine walls and/or tanks with snares, slowing down the enemy and getting to focus on the renewable defenses (walls) or well-armored ones (tanks), e.g. Grasping Earth, Ward Against Foes, or Tryptophan Signet, or "Save Yourselves!".
ef9b5f5921d01786ecaf3f4d697adabcce35df87.text: 將牆壁和/或坦克與圈套結合起來，減慢敵人的速度，並專注於可再生的防禦（牆壁）或裝甲良好的防禦（坦克），例如地之束縛、束縛結界 或色胺酸 紋章，或「救救自己！」。

9f527faf7962c701ecfabea352c77ea3356a51c6.source: AoE skills like Panic, Spiteful Spirit, Ancestors' Rage, and Barrage with Splinter Weapon are very useful due to the large mobs players will face.
9f527faf7962c701ecfabea352c77ea3356a51c6.text: 範圍性 技能（如 恐慌、惡靈附身、先人的盛怒 和 齊射 與 爆刺武裝）非常有用，因為玩家將面對大量怪物。

a8688646dc90dc7b03bf733167aad7def7230c05.source: Defensive skills which limit damage taken are especially helpful to tanks, e.g. Defy Pain, Dervish avatars, or various Weapon Spells.
a8688646dc90dc7b03bf733167aad7def7230c05.text: 防衛 限制所受傷害的技能對坦克特別有幫助，例如無視痛苦、神喚使 化身或各種 武器 法術。

6d5f36a92039f714751ef0667d03b370bd13b1f7.source: Armor of Unfeeling helps to maintain spirit walls.
6d5f36a92039f714751ef0667d03b370bd13b1f7.text: 無情護甲 有助於維護精神牆。

bc8b8d5491d35ed7731f29180ffcc9ebca5cc529.source: Since you remain stationary for long periods of times, ward spells are useful for protecting and buffing your allies.
bc8b8d5491d35ed7731f29180ffcc9ebca5cc529.text: 由於你長時間保持靜止，守衛法術對於保護和增強你的盟友非常有用。

3332203ee2b61665ab48dc2713ec13fcbd833fde.source: Traps are very effective at the choke points, notably the main gate and the staircases. Using Trapper's Focus enables you to plant traps before and during combat.
3332203ee2b61665ab48dc2713ec13fcbd833fde.text: 陷阱在阻塞點非常有效，尤其是大門和樓梯。使用 設陷者的專注 可以讓您在戰鬥前和戰鬥中設定陷阱。

6193440da93fee8b3aab5b9f3d4067d749d00007.source: Bosses have Natural Resistance and are especially susceptible to hexes with an effect on end, e.g. Wastrel's Worry.
6193440da93fee8b3aab5b9f3d4067d749d00007.text: Boss 具有自然抵抗力，並且特別容易受到對末端有影響的六角形的影響，例如瓦思崔的憂慮。

4f3cd8c903e88b6b6f7e62fe16ce2d5d86475970.source: After completing the battle, you will have an extra minute to pick up drops. Grab the gold, because any nearby/assigned items will be made available to you after zoning (via the Unclaimed Items window). You might also want to pick up valuables as the battle progresses — it lasts longer than 10 minutes, which is enough time for drops to become unassigned.
4f3cd8c903e88b6b6f7e62fe16ce2d5d86475970.text: 完成戰鬥後，你將有額外的一分鐘時間來拾取掉落物。抓住黃金，因為任何附近/指定的物品都將在分割槽後提供給您（透過「無人認領的物品」視窗）。隨著戰鬥的進行，您可能還想拾取貴重物品 - 戰鬥持續時間超過 10 分鐘，這足以讓掉落物變為未分配狀態。

4aed471c2424ab8a12c1b090359e79692b484ce8.source: The NPC counterparts of two heroes have roles during the battle and their names will appear differently in the party window:
4aed471c2424ab8a12c1b090359e79692b484ce8.text: 兩位英雄的 NPC 對應角色在戰鬥中各有角色，他們的名字在隊伍視窗中的顯示方式會有所不同：

8bf1d146ace82dd3e5ed0a508c3e2ea34153d3ce.source: Gwen will display as Vanguard Mesmer, signifying that she remains stationed at the Eye of the North in Captain Langmar's absence.
8bf1d146ace82dd3e5ed0a508c3e2ea34153d3ce.text: 關 將顯示為先鋒 幻術師，表示在 隊長連瑪 缺席時她仍駐紮在 極地之眼。

e2e3da25af0bf68d98736c12a2bcc28c30b36602.source: Livia appears as Shining Blade Necromancer, since she is present as an NPC near the Keep's entrance.
e2e3da25af0bf68d98736c12a2bcc28c30b36602.text: 莉薇亞 顯示為 光刃公會 死靈法師，因為她以 NPC 出現在要塞入口附近。

92027f8387f2179021532bed397031f7ee9c7baf.source: You can leave your Medals of Honor in storage: they can be exchanged later in Lion's Arch Keep for War in Kryta related weapons. You may also exchange them in Lion's Arch immediately after the battle.
92027f8387f2179021532bed397031f7ee9c7baf.text: 您可以將榮譽勳章留在儲存空間中：稍後可以在 獅子拱門要塞 中將其兌換為 科瑞塔戰爭 相關武器。您也可以在戰鬥結束後立即在 獅子拱門 中交換它們。

977daf57d72386feb51fffbf6136553a67774d8c.source: Some players have used this mission to capture the 12 elite skills, via "Rinse and Repeat" of mission.
977daf57d72386feb51fffbf6136553a67774d8c.text: 一些玩家已經使用此任務透過「沖洗並重複」任務來捕獲 12 精英技能。

1509593d64eed6bda06ce037892a39c1a9a805b8.source: Waylay a squad of Kournan guards and "borrow" their armor.
1509593d64eed6bda06ce037892a39c1a9a805b8.text: 伏擊一隊庫爾南守衛並「借用」他們的盔甲。

c2128386fbea92cac3c787418083e02ba3b5fd07.source: See Jack of Truths for your reward.
c2128386fbea92cac3c787418083e02ba3b5fd07.text: 請參閱真相傑克以獲得獎勵。

b700fab3a6904b216d546075211443067ca2f632.source: Margrid the Sly joins your party.
b700fab3a6904b216d546075211443067ca2f632.text: 狡猾的瑪格麗特加入你的隊伍。

beb28e60a88bfa7daf0a09ca6c8066631546f704.source: Just walk from Yohlon Haven to the east through the Arkjok Ward. When walking through the fortress, be careful not to aggro the Acolyte of Grenth. When you reach Pogahn Passage, you will find the doors shut. Just walk north a bit and you will find the entrance. At the other end of Pogahn Passage, you will find Jack of Truths. Follow the quest-marker in Pogahn Passage through the water and out to Gandara. Kill the Kournans and pick up the Sets of Kournan Armor. As soon as you "put them on", the cinematic starts. Talk to Jack of Truths for your reward.
beb28e60a88bfa7daf0a09ca6c8066631546f704.text: 只需從 猶朗避難所 向東步行穿過 阿爾科監禁區 即可。穿過要塞時，小心不要激怒 古蘭斯 的侍僧。當您到達 波甘驛站 時，您會發現門關閉了。往北走一點就可以找到入口。在 波甘驛站 的另一端，您會找到 Jack of Truths。跟隨 波甘驛站 中的任務標記穿過水域，到達甘達拉。殺死 Kournan 並拾取 Kournan 防禦 套裝。一旦你“穿上它們”，電影就開始了。與真相傑克交談以獲得獎勵。

ea645c8d311b4b47e9a6c0d71ef17fa881b363aa.source: Should you abandon the quest, Margrid can be found in Marga Coast just outside Yohlon Haven, where she will offer you the quest again.
ea645c8d311b4b47e9a6c0d71ef17fa881b363aa.text: 如果您放棄任務，瑪格麗德可以在 猶朗避難所 外的 馬加海岸 中找到，她將在那裡再次為您提供任務。

a5ebdbae4d0bb0314ef0cf1c8b90d300271d8250.source: If you have already been to Pogahn Passage you can travel there directly by map. You can alternatively start in Kodonur Crossroads, but you will have to defeat many more enemies.
a5ebdbae4d0bb0314ef0cf1c8b90d300271d8250.text: 如果您已經去過波甘驛站，您可以透過地圖直接前往那裡。您也可以從 科登諾入口 開始，但您必須擊敗更多的敵人。

f660aafa6207999179e5d457e4707c47e1ca40c4.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Vulture Drifts and start the mission.
f660aafa6207999179e5d457e4707c47e1ca40c4.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 禿鷹沙丘 走進前哨站並開始任務。

dcb4f81749708d4a442c4c7fdc110a6a50efb044.source: Help the Ghostly Hero reclaim his throne.
dcb4f81749708d4a442c4c7fdc110a6a50efb044.text: 幫助 英雄之魂 奪回王位。

cbd922caea729bf246f25dd586d0c456e3fa191c.source: Escort the Ghostly Hero to the Temple of Ascension.
cbd922caea729bf246f25dd586d0c456e3fa191c.text: 護送 英雄之魂 至 超越之路神殿。

0bfdfc204a30ffad982b4e0d579fc9382f9ec296.text: 擊敗敵人 英雄之魂。

2f775096d4fc2552f87299d1c59b4fccaccebb5a.source: Hold out while the Ghostly Hero performs his ritual.
2f775096d4fc2552f87299d1c59b4fccaccebb5a.text: 當 英雄之魂 執行他的儀式時，請堅持下去。

835295006fb41546892361350c06f9ed082480ea.source: *BONUS* Gain more glory by defeating the three forgotten generals and their minions within their forts.
835295006fb41546892361350c06f9ed082480ea.text: *獎勵*透過擊敗三位被遺忘的將軍及其堡壘內的爪牙來獲得更多榮耀。

1805dcc8fc80a028a100e3b18593e9ad5dfae239.source: At the beginning, you meet the Ghostly Hero who asks you to help him reclaim his throne. During the mission, he will use Claim Resource to open any drawbridge gates. Speaking to him toggles his movement behavior between following and staying put: he will follow the player who spoke to him when he was in stay-mode and continue doing so until that player speaks to him again.
1805dcc8fc80a028a100e3b18593e9ad5dfae239.text: 一開始，你遇到了 英雄之魂，他請求你幫他奪回王位。在任務期間，他將使用索取資源來開啟任何吊橋大門。對他說話會在跟隨和原地不動之間切換他的移動行為：他會跟隨在停留模式下與他說話的玩家，並繼續這樣做，直到該玩家再次與他說話。

a9e36abebe5ac4dcd225d411242ee8cbe2477bcc.source: After he lowers the first bridge, cross the gorge. At the other side, you can continue south with the mission killing the mesmer boss Goss Aleessh and his cohorts to trigger a cinematic, or detour west to gain the Slow Totem (an optional tool) and come back. When dropped, this item creates a ward effect that slows movement of any foe passing through.
a9e36abebe5ac4dcd225d411242ee8cbe2477bcc.text: 當他放下第一座橋後，穿過峽谷。在另一邊，你可以繼續向南執行任務，殺死幻術師老大 苟斯艾歷士 和他的同夥以觸發過場動畫，或者繞道向西獲得緩慢圖騰（可選工具）並返回。掉落時，該物品會產生結界效果，減緩任何經過的敵人的移動。

985bb44035f88d2bdf6e21f64fa3c25622a3e799.source: Aleessh's death triggers a cinematic, placing you near the next drawbridge; again, use the Ghostly Hero to lower it. You will now be attacked by Enchanted armors. To protect your ally, lead the Ghostly Hero back from the bridge and use the gateway as a choke point to fend off the incoming foes. If you have the Slow Totem, drop it slightly ahead of where the party is waiting. Now, the only foe left in sight should be the enemy Ghostly Hero at the Throne. Defeat him and have your Ghostly Hero approach to capture it and begin the last stage of the mission. You will have to protect him for the next ten minutes.
985bb44035f88d2bdf6e21f64fa3c25622a3e799.text: 阿利斯什的死觸發了一個過場動畫，讓你靠近下一座吊橋；再次使用 英雄之魂 將其降低。您現在將受到 附魔 裝甲的攻擊。為了保護你的盟友，將 英雄之魂 從橋上引回來，並使用閘道器作為阻塞點來抵禦來襲的敵人。如果你有慢速圖騰，請將其稍微放在隊伍等待的地方之前。現在，視野中唯一剩下的敵人應該是王座上的敵人 英雄之魂。擊敗他並使用 英雄之魂 方法捕捉它並開始任務的最後階段。接下來的十分鐘你必須保護他。

7f28f8fe82581949329024cc6fc1d705c5ed6a20.source: Again, if you have the Slow Totem, drop it in front of the Ghostly Hero to delay melee foes. Now, Forgotten Arcanists will come in pairs from the West, East and South. Afterwards, a Siege Wurm will start to attack your party from the East. It is possible to kill the wurm after the Arcanists are dead and before the first melee group approaches, but you can simply heal your allies and ignore it.
7f28f8fe82581949329024cc6fc1d705c5ed6a20.text: 再次強調，如果您有緩慢圖騰，請將其放在 英雄之魂 前面以延遲近戰敵人。現在，被遺忘者 奧術師將成對來自西方、東方和南方。之後，Siege 地蟲 將開始從東部攻擊您的隊伍。在奧術師死後和第一個近戰團體接近之前殺死亞龍是可能的，但你可以簡單地治癒你的盟友並忽略它。

64dc264c6045c1a0aa6fd094a2af858326c9e30b.source: At the five or six minute mark, more groups of Forgotten and a boss will approach the altar. Another pair of siege wurms will appear on the West, and then on the South. If you defeat the Forgotten, there will be no more groups attacking the altar, and you can use the remaining time to kill off the wurms. When the timer reaches zero and the ghostly hero is still alive, the mission will complete.
64dc264c6045c1a0aa6fd094a2af858326c9e30b.text: 在五到六分鐘時，更多的 被遺忘者 和一個 Boss 將接近祭壇。另一對攻城亞龍將出現在西部，然後出現在南部。如果你擊敗了被遺忘者，就不會再有團體攻擊祭壇，你可以利用剩餘的時間殺死亞龍。當計時器歸零並且幽靈英雄還活著時，任務就會完成。

63a1e0a326b642385112962a751b1e3cffa44265.source: To complete the mission, you need tools to deal with the Arcanists (i.e. interrupts). The rest of the defence is spent doing more or less nothing - you can kill the wurms quickly if you have the right skills. The bonus is another matter.
63a1e0a326b642385112962a751b1e3cffa44265.text: 為了完成任務，你需要一些工具來對付奧術師（即中斷）。其餘的防禦幾乎什麼都不做——如果你有正確的技能，你可以快速殺死亞龍。獎金是另一回事。

45f2fd4ebb2ae4ed7e476a062c3b8c9d650a90df.source: You must protect the Ghostly Hero for 10 minutes, during which time:
45f2fd4ebb2ae4ed7e476a062c3b8c9d650a90df.text: 您必須保護 英雄之魂 10 分鐘，在此期間：

32661f3c3ee86e59f303d0e8528c781b6cbe1c31.source: Four pairs of Forgotten Arcanists appear: from the East → West → South → East (again).
32661f3c3ee86e59f303d0e8528c781b6cbe1c31.text: 四對 被遺忘者 奧術師出現：從東→西→南→東（再次）。

bcc165698de986070227a7cbc6d42b866fcadfc1.source: Two pairs of Enchanted bows: South → West → West (again, with a boss)
bcc165698de986070227a7cbc6d42b866fcadfc1.text: 兩對 附魔 弓：南→西→西（同樣，有老闆）

2044a7a94842cc7263196316af3b003223b17f2c.source: Siege Wurms appear at fixed times:
2044a7a94842cc7263196316af3b003223b17f2c.text: 攻城亞龍會在固定時間出現：

e05be2803e7bc7ef7436c53b595ae710a483f177.source: Players consider this bonus to be one of the most difficult in the game: you have a limited amount of time (some of which must be spent unlocking the bonus area), you need to split your group to protect an Ally (threatened by increasing numbers of foes), and your party is limited to six characters.
e05be2803e7bc7ef7436c53b595ae710a483f177.text: 玩家認為這個獎勵是遊戲中最困難的獎勵之一：你的時間有限（其中一些必須用來解鎖獎勵區域），你需要分裂你的團隊來保護盟友（受到越來越多的敵人的威脅），並且你的隊伍最多隻能有六個角色。

73fefae6fdf93be52f4fb7beb0829ea4c2ae8cde.source: During the final siege where you defend the Ghostly Hero, you must kill three bosses and their groups located south of the fortress without letting the hero die and before the ten minute timer hits zero. The first boss is to the south behind the drawbridge. The second and third bosses are in the building behind the first boss. As you kill each general, a small group of Forgotten spawn outside the southern temple and head directly towards the Ghostly Hero.
73fefae6fdf93be52f4fb7beb0829ea4c2ae8cde.text: 在保衛 英雄之魂 的最後圍攻中，您必須在十分鐘計時器歸零之前殺死位於要塞以南的三個 Boss 及其團隊，並且不讓英雄死亡。第一個 Boss 位於吊橋後方的南邊。第二個和第三個boss位於第一個boss後面的建築物。當您殺死每位將軍時，一小群 被遺忘者 會在南部神殿外生成，並直接前往 英雄之魂。

0c385258aa55e25c431cfa9ede4af6ed65cf613d.source: You will get credit for the bonus as long as you kill all three generals, even if the ghostly hero dies later (which would cause you to lose the mission).
0c385258aa55e25c431cfa9ede4af6ed65cf613d.text: 只要你殺死所有三名將軍，你就會獲得獎勵，即使幽靈英雄稍後死亡（這會導致你失去任務）。

985f00da37b2a102dd5368620309bb8e70380527.source: Method one: Focus first on the mission
985f00da37b2a102dd5368620309bb8e70380527.text: 方法一：聚能器先上任務

cab3ab2a7d5580363a7119a21f095c76db01d007.source: The simplest method is to focus first on eliminating the foes attacking the Hero before going for the bonus. Wait until the Forgotten Boss attacks from the west gate. If all goes well, you should have nearly five minutes in which to complete the bonus.
cab3ab2a7d5580363a7119a21f095c76db01d007.text: 最簡單的方法是先專注於消滅攻擊 英雄 的敵人，然後再獲得獎勵。等到被遺忘者 頭目從西門發動攻擊。如果一切順利，您應該有近五分鐘的時間來完成獎金。

7d11033ec23c485a20540417c1f4220e502ef641.source: To maximize the time, be sure to aggro the first group of reinforcements that spawn after killing the first general to prevent them from going after the Ghostly Hero. You can ignore the group that spawns after killing the second general until you have defeated the third, which completes the bonus.
7d11033ec23c485a20540417c1f4220e502ef641.text: 為了最大限度地延長時間，請務必聚集在殺死第一個將軍後生成的第一組增援部隊，以防止他們追擊 英雄之魂。你可以忽略殺死第二個將軍後生成的隊伍，直到你擊敗第三個將軍，這完成了獎勵。

e2860d317a8ff77b65768789c3633344bf7801ab.source: If you still need to complete the mission, stop the last group of reinforcements from reaching the Ghostly Hero as you return to the altar. When you arrive back at the Ghostly Hero, the Forgotten spawn that you left from the death of the second general will arrive. Even if left alone this group often has no time remaining to destroy the Ghostly Hero.
e2860d317a8ff77b65768789c3633344bf7801ab.text: 如果您仍需要完成任務，請在返回祭壇時阻止最後一組援軍到達 英雄之魂。當您返回 英雄之魂 時，您因第二位將軍死亡而留下的 被遺忘者 生成點將會到達。即使是單獨留下，該組織通常也沒有時間摧毀 英雄之魂。

4c5b2585dcc541202fbf446510e97a718676df07.source: Method two: Take advantage of the pause

9463b90e8a1d5efd948a1b6ae8cd7eba3979a190.source: After clearing the Arcanists, you have some time before the Forgotten attack the altar again. Instead of attacking the siege wurms, head south to rush the generals. You will need extremely high damage output and a speed boost is nearly essential. Take out as many of the generals (and their reinforcements) as possible before heading back to the altar to defend the Ghostly Hero. You can give yourself some extra time by leaving a healer to protect your ally, e.g. a bonder or a spirit spammer.
9463b90e8a1d5efd948a1b6ae8cd7eba3979a190.text: 清除奧術師後，被遺忘者 再次攻擊祭壇前還有一段時間。與其攻擊攻城亞龍，不如南下衝去將軍們。你將需要極高的傷害輸出，而速度提升幾乎是必不可少的。在返回祭壇保衛 英雄之魂 之前，消滅盡可能多的將軍（及其援軍）。你可以給自己一些額外的時間，留下一個治療者來保護你的盟友，例如契約者或精神垃圾郵件傳送者。

eca72a654eb530f057cce97f71987a1514e242d3.source: If you are worried about the timing, killing even just one general during this pause is enormously helpful. Head back to the altar afterwards and then proceed as if you are using method one.
eca72a654eb530f057cce97f71987a1514e242d3.text: 如果你擔心時機，那麼在這段暫停期間即使只殺死一名將軍也會非常有幫助。之後返回祭壇，然後像使用方法一一樣繼續進行。

a5c9f44a6f34abf074cbd4092b2a01584df7ddaf.source: With heroes/henchmen, it's sometimes easiest to simply do the bonus, letting the Ghostly Hero die and then re-do the mission.
a5c9f44a6f34abf074cbd4092b2a01584df7ddaf.text: 對於英雄/追隨者，有時最簡單的方法是簡單地執行獎勵，讓 英雄之魂 死亡，然後重新執行任務。

dbd7b1235a716d1dd3c1350bf86246e7aadafc75.source: The Forgotten and Enchanted will resume attacking with around 6:05 minutes on the clock. The Ghostly Hero can endure the Siege Wurms and the first wave of Forgotten; he can't endure the rest of them. You need to be back at the Ghostly Hero at 4:50 to ensure his survival. You can get away with it at 4:30 if you (the player) have spells that can rapidly heal the Hero - a speed boost is necessary.
dbd7b1235a716d1dd3c1350bf86246e7aadafc75.text: 被遺忘者 和 附魔 將在 6:05 分鐘左右恢復攻擊。 英雄之魂可以承受攻城亞龍和被遺忘者的第一波攻擊；他無法忍受其他人。您需要在 4:50 回到 英雄之魂 以確保他的生存。如果您（玩家）擁有可以快速治癒 英雄 的咒語，那麼您可以在 4:30 中僥倖逃脫 - 速度提升是必要的。

c39913e3f068b0bf9c5bcae103c10c55875a4ef8.source: Method three: Signet of Spirits solo
c39913e3f068b0bf9c5bcae103c10c55875a4ef8.text: 方法三：縛靈紋章 獨奏

46b2868126577851dfcbc7ec4948a47c1c954a31.source: A spirit spammer can solo the bosses while the rest of the party stays back and defends the fort. The build should include a self-heal, e.g. Mend Body and Soul or Spirit Light. Set up the spirits, pull the boss groups one at a time, and repeat.
46b2868126577851dfcbc7ec4948a47c1c954a31.text: 精神垃圾郵件傳送者可以單獨對付 Boss，而隊伍的其他成員則留在後面保衛堡壘。建置應該包括自我修復，例如魂體治癒 或 縛靈之光。設定好精神，一次拉一個boss組，然後重複。

e9f91482e8444affe135c7318749f124b0f76d4e.source: Alternatively, if you leave a Signet of Spirits hero with the Ghostly Hero, they will both survive until you come back in to visual range of the Hero. This allows you to charge the three bosses.
e9f91482e8444affe135c7318749f124b0f76d4e.text: 或者，如果您將 縛靈紋章 英雄與 英雄之魂 一起留下，他們都會存活，直到您返回 英雄 的視覺範圍。這允許你向三個老闆收費。

bba8c04b9ba4bbdde553da78c6003fe2a4293670.source: Method four: Kill Goss Aleessh's group after starting the timer
bba8c04b9ba4bbdde553da78c6003fe2a4293670.text: 方法四：啟動定時器後殺死苟斯艾歷士的群組

838b9bfae268ff750160ec5b7f230db76c242a5e.source: This method takes advantage of quirks in the game's mechanics, the first moves the Ghostly Hero to a safe spot after watching the mid-mission cinematic and the second is that the foes target the throne not the Ghostly Hero.
838b9bfae268ff750160ec5b7f230db76c242a5e.text: 這種方法利用了遊戲機制中的怪癖，第一個是在觀看任務中期動畫後將 英雄之魂 移動到安全位置，第二個是敵人瞄準王座而不是 英雄之魂。

9d253c46d24b8963843bd9fb9385bbd3651b041d.source: Killing all three members of Goss Aleessh's group will trigger a cutscene, where all allies including the Hero are teleported to where Aleessh originally patrols. Have your team utilize the slow totem to lure the last remaining member away from the bridge and enter the fortress. Once inside, before making the Ghostly Hero claim the altar, flag your H/H outside the fortress in preparation to kill Aleessh's team's remaining foe. Once the Hero begins to claim the altar and the timer begins, kill the remaining team member as quickly as possible before the enemies begin to surround the Ghostly Hero at the altar. Doing so will teleport the Ghostly Hero outside the fortress via the cutscene trick. Once outside the fortress, talk to the Hero to make him stay (safe spot). Now you have over nine minutes to complete the bonus while ensuring mission completion at the same time. The Ghostly Hero can remain alone and will be completely safe because the mission script sends the foes to the altar, not to the Hero.
9d253c46d24b8963843bd9fb9385bbd3651b041d.text: 殺死 苟斯艾歷士 隊伍的所有三名成員將觸發過場動畫，其中包括 英雄 在內的所有盟友都會傳送到 Aleessh 最初巡邏的地方。讓你的團隊利用緩慢的圖騰來引誘最後剩下的成員離開橋梁並進入堡壘。進入內部後，在讓 英雄之魂 佔領祭壇之前，在要塞外標記你的 H/H，準備殺死 Aleessh 團隊的剩餘敵人。一旦 英雄 開始佔領祭壇並且計時器開始計時，請在敵人開始包圍祭壇處的 英雄之魂 之前盡快殺死剩餘的團隊成員。這樣做將透過過場動畫技巧將 英雄之魂 傳送到要塞之外。出了堡壘後，與 英雄 交談以讓他留下來（安全點）。現在您有超過九分鐘的時間來完成獎勵，同時確保任務完成。 英雄之魂 可以保持獨立且完全安全，因為任務指令碼會將敵人送到祭壇，而不是 英雄。

f390820076e8d70ec6d8ba132fd7adc19f48e6b1.source: You don't actually need the slow totem. One team member can lure Aleessh's entire team to one side letting the rest of the party sneak into the temple from the other. That team member with Spirits and Summon Spirits can lure and escape easily.
f390820076e8d70ec6d8ba132fd7adc19f48e6b1.text: 你其實並不需要緩慢圖騰。一名團隊成員可以將阿利斯什的整個團隊引誘到一側，讓團隊的其他成員從另一側潛入神廟。擁有武魂和召喚武魂的隊員可以輕鬆引誘和逃跑。

e1dfc70d9c9677379388fdbae20500d3f5fe3e41.source: There are several points where the party should take special care:
e1dfc70d9c9677379388fdbae20500d3f5fe3e41.text: 有幾點需要黨特別注意：

f7cebc5fa49cd1ef5214add0fd6784768c146a53.source: Passing Goss Aleessh: to prevent this boss' group from following, use the Slow Totem or distract them with minions or spirits.
f7cebc5fa49cd1ef5214add0fd6784768c146a53.text: 透過 苟斯艾歷士：為了防止這個 Boss 的隊伍跟隨，使用緩慢圖騰或用小兵或靈魂分散他們的注意力。

2f99dc102aadd5f0d551ffc988f81acb0ece6206.source: Single-player teams can use heroes and henchmen to draw his aggro, while the player sneaks the Ghostly Hero to a safe spot just before the bridge.
2f99dc102aadd5f0d551ffc988f81acb0ece6206.text: 單人團隊可以使用英雄和追隨者來吸引他的仇恨，而玩家則將 英雄之魂 偷偷帶到橋前的安全地點。

3f725afba3dcad17e8a8c716792d91623925b66c.source: Multiple-player teams can choose to have one player pull Goss Aleessh's group northeast, safely out of the way.
3f725afba3dcad17e8a8c716792d91623925b66c.text: 多人團隊可以選擇讓一名玩家將 苟斯艾歷士 的隊伍拉到東北方，安全地讓開。

688c481097ebe176a239d642a7be53ed626bc0f1.source: Be careful to avoid popping up the Jade Scarabs southwest of the fortress' entrance ramp. Also, try to avoid letting the hero lower the bridge before you are ready.
688c481097ebe176a239d642a7be53ed626bc0f1.text: 小心避免翡翠聖甲蟲出現在要塞入口坡道的西南方。另外，盡量避免在你準備好之前讓英雄放下橋。

cdfe80ac822d411a2055affbcffe2868e6466e14.source: Entering the fortress: as with the other methods, use the drawbridge gate as a choke-point against the first few groups of Enchanted Hammers and Swords.
cdfe80ac822d411a2055affbcffe2868e6466e14.text: 進入堡壘：與其他方法一樣，使用吊橋門作為對抗前幾組 附魔 錘子和劍的阻塞點。

0baadc4a4cb3d78aeca51388822ef558d9c2a78d.source: Re-entering the fortress: you are likely to find a mob (including a re-incarnated Enemy Ghostly Hero) waiting for you at the shrine after the post-Aleessh cinematic. Again, use the entrance gate as a choke-point and pull the easily-separable mobs towards your party. Take your time; at worst, you will still have over seven minutes to complete the bonus.
0baadc4a4cb3d78aeca51388822ef558d9c2a78d.text: 重新進入堡壘：在後 Aleessh 電影結束後，你可能會發現一群暴民（包括轉世的敵人 英雄之魂）在神社等著你。再次，使用入口門作為阻塞點，將容易分開的小怪拉向你的隊伍。慢慢來;在最壞的情況下，您仍然有超過七分鐘的時間來完成獎金。

b3b27c8464fbaa76f1d9be935d59fa5a8da4f2f4.source: Warning to Survivors: During the end scene you will see the swarm of Enchanted & Forgotten which has been completely avoided, those foes will still be attacking the party who "appear" to be invulnerable. However, behind the cinematic, the party actually wipes but still successfully completes the mission and bonus, and is therefore sent to Augury Rock.
b3b27c8464fbaa76f1d9be935d59fa5a8da4f2f4.text: 倖存者警告：在最後場景中，您將看到 附魔 和 被遺忘者 的蜂群已被完全避開，這些敵人仍然會攻擊「看起來」無懈可擊的隊伍。然而，在過場動畫後面，該隊伍實際上消滅了，但仍然成功完成了任務和獎勵，因此被傳送到 占卜之石。
