56fa3a8dea3562c4537fc62a0c9efed0b1856e01.source: If the Ghostly Hero dies after capturing the shrine but before the party manages to trigger the cutscene, and Goss dies at the same time or shortly after the party is wiped, the cutscene will still trigger. After the cutscene the party and the Hero will be resurrected, but the party leader will have a "return to outpost"-prompt. The party can still continue the mission as long as the prompt is not hit, and even the mission timer will keep counting. The bonus objective can even be completed as normal when using this approach, but once the timer hits zero, the mission itself will not complete. However, a Zaishen Mission will update for both normal and bonus objectives.
56fa3a8dea3562c4537fc62a0c9efed0b1856e01.text: 如果 英雄之魂 在佔領神殿後、隊伍觸發過場動畫之前死亡，而 Goss 在隊伍被消滅的同時或不久後死亡，過場動畫仍會觸發。過場動畫結束後，小隊和 英雄 將復活，但小隊領袖會有「返回前哨」的提示。只要不點選提示，隊伍仍然可以繼續任務，甚至任務計時器也會繼續計時。使用這種方法時，獎勵目標甚至可以正常完成，但一旦計時器為零，任務本身將無法完成。然而，戰承主線 將會針對正常目標和獎勵目標進行更新。

5bd06632db9fedcc84381866460f356686156c26.source: Each of these tricks can be used in combination with any of the methods above.
5bd06632db9fedcc84381866460f356686156c26.text: 這些技巧中的每一個都可以與上述任何方法結合使用。

bf0bcd1503835ba55da2a855436daa65c3a84e5d.source: Partial completion before the timer begins: You can sometimes kill the first general before the timer begins by forcing the Ghostly Hero to wait outside the fortress before capturing the altar. Head to the southern part of the compound and use distance attacks to aggro the general's group and kill them.
bf0bcd1503835ba55da2a855436daa65c3a84e5d.text: 計時器開始前部分完成：有時，您可以透過強制 英雄之魂 在佔領祭壇之前在要塞外等待，在計時器開始前殺死第一個將軍。前往大院的南部，使用遠端攻擊來攻擊將軍的隊伍並殺死他們。

637bf99699bdcdf581c4bcf8a983a5f9c4028192.source: Ignore less-threatening wurms: You can avoid spending time on the siege wurms that do not threaten the Ghostly Hero; they only begin attacking if you get within aggro range or attack them.
637bf99699bdcdf581c4bcf8a983a5f9c4028192.text: 忽略威脅較小的亞龍：您可以避免在不威脅 英雄之魂 的攻城亞龍上花費時間；只有當你進入仇恨範圍或攻擊他們時，他們才會開始攻擊。

d1667a54d1fdc1a69b1567844149e3600428f1b7.source: All of the techniques above work in hard mode, however there is less room for error.
d1667a54d1fdc1a69b1567844149e3600428f1b7.text: 上述所有技術都適用於困難模式，但出錯的空間較小。

34c044e954879ead68a7d032412cf3390706241f.source: Backfire or Visions of Regret helps to counter the spellcasting bosses.
34c044e954879ead68a7d032412cf3390706241f.text: 魔力反噬 或 懊悔幻想 有助於對抗施法的 Boss。

ede16b123533b30690f712c74a2a40c30488c6b6.source: The wurms can be defeated using Pain Inverter or a combination of Wastrel's Worry/Wastrel's Demise, Power Drain, and Leech Signet.
ede16b123533b30690f712c74a2a40c30488c6b6.text: 可以使用 苦痛 逆變器或 瓦思崔的憂慮/瓦斯崔之死、強力吸收 和 搾取紋章 的組合來擊敗亞龍。

d441c032203cdf8fd774f98495c3286f10593ac2.source: Signet of Spirits spirit spammer-builds can solo the bonus bosses or defend the altar.
d441c032203cdf8fd774f98495c3286f10593ac2.text: 縛靈紋章 精神垃圾郵件製造者可以單獨對抗獎勵 Boss 或保衛祭壇。

9e9b7a16546b7efce4191b1792e03b8c19f005ff.source: To protect the Ghostly Hero, bring a bonder or spirit spammer. The safest spot for the bonder is in the north doorway (where you entered); only go closer to cast heals. Be wary in hard mode, since the Forgotten Cursebearers have Strip Enchantment.
9e9b7a16546b7efce4191b1792e03b8c19f005ff.text: 為了保護 英雄之魂，請攜帶黏合劑或酒精垃圾郵件傳送器。對於繫結者來說，最安全的位置是北門口（您進入的地方）；只有靠近才能施放治療。在困難模式下要小心，因為 被遺忘者 詛咒者有 剝奪加持。

904ea6c35f02ac12f84bad5d6a54b1cdffd68ad4.source: Bring condition removal to remove blindness caused by Enchanted Bows (especially during the bonus).
904ea6c35f02ac12f84bad5d6a54b1cdffd68ad4.text: 帶來條件移除以消除 附魔 弓造成的失明（特別是在獎勵期間）。

dfe47bbb7098e97294e1a7632137e462aa5d2f14.source: There is a large amount of desert to uncover for the cartographer title beyond and around the fort. The large area amounts to approximately 0.7% of Tyria. To access it all a player must run across at least one invisible bridge (never lowers graphically) into the South West fortress.
dfe47bbb7098e97294e1a7632137e462aa5d2f14.text: 堡壘之外和周圍有大量的沙漠等待製圖師的稱號。此大面積約為 0.7% 或 泰瑞亞。要訪問這一切，玩家必須跑過至少一座看不見的橋（永遠不會以圖形方式降低）進入西南堡壘。

c458bf535c8ad5751a0ee53050ce57f843af911a.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #8 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
c458bf535c8ad5751a0ee53050ce57f843af911a.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#8 頁。

b085fa8d1dea2c366f0d6bce128d1a8a9bf8991f.source: The bridge will still fall if you talk to the Ghostly Hero before he uses Claim Resource at the start of the mission. The third bridge leading to the altar will sometimes not lower even if the Ghostly Hero has used Claim Resource. Occasionally the Ghostly Hero will become stuck while under attack by the first Siege Wurm or Goss Aleessh, in which case he will not activate Claim Resource to lower the bridge and stops following the player. He won't continue onward until you slay the enemy that is distracting him. It is possible to enter the buildings to the southwest and southeast of the Throne of Pellentia even when the bridges appear to be up.
b085fa8d1dea2c366f0d6bce128d1a8a9bf8991f.text: 如果您在 英雄之魂 在任務開始時使用宣告資源之前與他交談，橋梁仍然會倒塌。即使 英雄之魂 使用了宣告資源，通往祭壇的第三座橋有時也不會降低。有時，英雄之魂 在受到第一個圍攻 地蟲 或 苟斯艾歷士 的攻擊時會被卡住，在這種情況下，他不會啟動索取資源來降低橋梁並停止跟隨玩家。在你殺死分散他注意力的敵人之前，他不會繼續前進。即使橋梁看起來已經升起，也可以進入佩倫蒂亞王座西南部和東南部的建築物。

dbcfdceda67c7588dbc50250fe5d1ccaed5313ae.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Augury Rock.
dbcfdceda67c7588dbc50250fe5d1ccaed5313ae.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 占卜之石。

6ba1a1290cdc8d32c1c0edb1866095a38b1eedec.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for No Me, No Kormir or To Kill a Demon.
6ba1a1290cdc8d32c1c0edb1866095a38b1eedec.text: 所有隊伍成員必須接受「No Me」、「No Kormir」或「To Kill a 惡魔」的獎勵。

32cec98e9534fefae934b93ae1fd23637186a7bd.source: Margrid the Sly must be present in the party.
32cec98e9534fefae934b93ae1fd23637186a7bd.text: 狡猾的瑪格麗德必須出席聚會。

8929cbe240c8e65560b23187cfb980a59a81826f.text: 從甘達拉手中救出柯米爾。

c6d8ae5c1c45507f95f089150bcfb87305378e98.source: Escort Margrid to the Gandaran treasure vault to retrieve the Diadem of Lady Glaive.
c6d8ae5c1c45507f95f089150bcfb87305378e98.text: 護送瑪格麗德前往甘達拉寶藏，取回格萊夫人王冠。

67c877310d5273fdb1bf5c731bfd270938327f08.source: Free Kormir from the Kournan prison.
67c877310d5273fdb1bf5c731bfd270938327f08.text: 將科米爾從庫南監獄中解救出來。

8eeed734e26d36cdffbb37e990c8690ca17bd7e6.source: Escape from Gandara with Kormir and Shahai.
8eeed734e26d36cdffbb37e990c8690ca17bd7e6.text: 來自 Gandara 的 脫逃 與 Kormir 和 Shahai。

ccbe8b477a61705abda186b14d59f2e30dd4d1fb.source: Optional: Escort the Sunspear prisoners to the prison.
ccbe8b477a61705abda186b14d59f2e30dd4d1fb.text: 可選：護送烈陽之矛囚犯到監獄。

158cf594af224111f4442e2b8dff379651a67256.source: Optional: Obtain the prison code for entry into the prison.
158cf594af224111f4442e2b8dff379651a67256.text: 可選：取得進入監獄的監獄程式碼。

095a84f5e6cb6aabdcc8f7bea19863aff348dca4.source: Optional: The demon is out of control! You can either help the guards or stand aside and let them fight on their own.
095a84f5e6cb6aabdcc8f7bea19863aff348dca4.text: 可選：惡魔失控了！你可以幫助守衛，也可以站在一旁讓他們自己戰鬥。

a21846644e114c623e1645e0e13cbbf7e11a98d1.source: Optional: Take over gate duty for some guards.
a21846644e114c623e1645e0e13cbbf7e11a98d1.text: 可選：接管一些警衛的門禁職責。

ccd272468843d35b8d36a92f97efacf605dc399e.source: The second and third Kournan groups after crossing back the bridge: Players will find the second group to be small and static, but a third larger group is on its way towards the bridge. Instead of engaging the second group, wait until the third climbs the stairs and move far ahead from the second group. This will help avoid over-aggroing and having to fight a large mob with two Kournan Priests healing each other. Since Margrid the Sly is a required hero, she can be used to lure the third group (flag and un-flag), because if a player attempts to pull, Kormir and Shahai will follow, risking mission failure.
ccd272468843d35b8d36a92f97efacf605dc399e.text: 過橋後的第二組和第三組 Kournan 組：玩家會發現第二組規模較小且靜止，但第三組較大的組正在朝橋走去。不要與第二組交戰，而是等到第三組爬上樓梯並遠離第二組。這將有助於避免過度仇恨和不得不與兩名庫南牧師互相治療的大群怪物戰鬥。由於狡猾的瑪格麗特是必需的英雄，她可以用來引誘第三組（標記和取消標記），因為如果玩家試圖拉動，科米爾和沙海就會跟隨，冒著任務失敗的風險。

d075c884093d19efa8a001cd4d0eab9f7438e1f6.source: After dispatching these groups, you may either travel north through the fort or south along the docks, both paths rejoin at the dock.
d075c884093d19efa8a001cd4d0eab9f7438e1f6.text: 派遣完這些隊伍後，你可以向北穿過堡壘，也可以沿著碼頭向南行駛，兩條路都會在碼頭匯合。

557e1b7fcf15cd3dda37f98b884a7877c0683941.source: The final battle at the docks has four static guards and another group behind them lead by Captain Nebo, a powerful elementalist boss capable of dealing massive area damage with Fire Magic spells. Lure the four guards first to reduce enemies and only then engage the last group.
557e1b7fcf15cd3dda37f98b884a7877c0683941.text: 碼頭的最後一場戰鬥有四名靜態守衛，他們身後的另一組由尼波船長領導，尼波船長是一位強大的元素首領，能夠使用 火系魔法 法術造成大規模區域傷害。先引誘四名守衛減少敵人，再與最後一組守衛交戰。

a59c1dab923faeffb0033455b5b6530a135b6094.source: Finally, walk to the end of the dock to complete the mission.
a59c1dab923faeffb0033455b5b6530a135b6094.text: 最後走到碼頭盡頭即可完成任務。

f523d9910d77ed970dfb76b6eb45f30b91976e02.source: These are four tasks that need to be accomplished before Kormir and Shahai's cinematic:
f523d9910d77ed970dfb76b6eb45f30b91976e02.text: 在科米爾和沙海的電影製作之前需要完成以下四項任務：

d6983534f5bf32537e2c9f9b1abd28ffbce6b722.source: Talk to Guard Captain Kahturin to obtain the prison code.
d6983534f5bf32537e2c9f9b1abd28ffbce6b722.text: 與警衛隊長卡圖林交談以獲取監獄密碼。

79481de4378e3f4a661fe64727279cd53d02422e.source: Talk to Captain Nahnkos to escort Sunspear Prisoners, who will assist in battles but are not required to survive.
79481de4378e3f4a661fe64727279cd53d02422e.text: 與納科斯隊長交談以護送烈陽之矛囚犯，他們將協助戰鬥，但不需要生存。

654b888a5719fb2e1ef5bfc24946375d4058728c.source: Trigger the Kourna Guards dialogue involving the Demon Spawn, either helping them or not will count as done.
654b888a5719fb2e1ef5bfc24946375d4058728c.text: 觸發涉及 惡魔 Spawn 的 高楠 守衛對話，不論說明是否都算完成。

be38fda8b1d669ae3582af5d6e22eb3147b321ef.source: Talk to Guard Linko to take over gate duty. You don't need to watch them leave nor stay, just continue with the mission.
be38fda8b1d669ae3582af5d6e22eb3147b321ef.text: 與守衛林科交談以接手登機口職責。你不需要看著他們離開，也不需要留下來，只要繼續執行任務。

6ee97edf16fc5e07685168d89fdf834c15a1c570.source: If your party has anyone that deals damage via attacks, consider bringing skills that remove stances, bypass blocking or punish blocking to use against the Kournan Bowman, who use Whirling Defense.
6ee97edf16fc5e07685168d89fdf834c15a1c570.text: 如果你的隊伍中有任何人透過攻擊造成傷害，請考慮使用移除姿態、繞過阻擋或懲罰阻擋的技能來對抗使用 旋風防禦 的庫南鮑曼。

24b34b4a646f2065382ced43ebfef5c19bc6a233.source: The final elementalist boss is dangerous to the NPCs you must keep alive.
24b34b4a646f2065382ced43ebfef5c19bc6a233.text: 最終的元素首領對您必須保證存活的 NPC 來說非常危險。

f58328f5473eb9869b9d71cde6fe25962b138719.source: Ward Against Harm and/or Ward Against Elements help reduce the damage, until they move outside the wards. Shelter and Union will also help keep the NPCs alive
f58328f5473eb9869b9d71cde6fe25962b138719.text: 守護結界 和/或 元素結界 有助於減少傷害，直到他們移出守衛。 庇護 和 聯合 也將有助於維持 NPC 的存活

ae10d5dacc9f77bb7516a100b825c4e427ca8182.source: Interrupts also help against the boss. Since Margrid is required for the mission, equip her with Distracting Shot and/or Savage Shot and lock her on the boss to help suppress damage.
ae10d5dacc9f77bb7516a100b825c4e427ca8182.text: 打斷也有助於對抗頭目。由於任務需要瑪格麗德，為她配備 震暈之箭 和/或 野性之箭 並將她鎖定在 Boss 上以幫助抑制傷害。

4856f7a9b6dc28ba8f6e412562a9608526087d08.source: Occasionally, Kormir and/or Shahai may get stuck in the prison around the bridge. Make sure they are following as they are required to reach the docks to complete the mission.
4856f7a9b6dc28ba8f6e412562a9608526087d08.text: 有時，科米爾和/或沙海可能會被困在橋周圍的監獄裡。確保他們跟隨，因為他們需要到達碼頭才能完成任務。

2093f1220baa12296e05a8f824141eb5a327d26e.source: Before entering the fortress gate, you can explore the Gandara, the Moon Fortress area, which is completely free of foes.
2093f1220baa12296e05a8f824141eb5a327d26e.text: 在進入要塞大門之前，您可以探索完全沒有敵人的弦月要塞 幹達拉區域。

93825d9a5f20b2a0113c2d3c3d0440643c854233.source: There is a dialogue sequence between a Kournan Guard and a Kournan Captain that seems to be reversed, that is, the Guard speaks the Captain's lines, and the Captain, the Guard's.
93825d9a5f20b2a0113c2d3c3d0440643c854233.text: 庫爾南守衛和庫爾南上尉之間的對話順序似乎顛倒了，即守衛說上尉的臺詞，而上尉則說守衛的臺詞。

2e05bf068bf8f65c5ece3bf620a73374d11e906d.source: Using your keyboard to move around during the end mission cinematic will contribute about 0.1% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
2e05bf068bf8f65c5ece3bf620a73374d11e906d.text: 在最終任務過場動畫中使用鍵盤四處移動將為 Elonian 版圖 標題貢獻約 0.1% 的內容。

28b2c49414c262638285dfa6c772cc8b3baed6ec.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Moddok Crevice.
28b2c49414c262638285dfa6c772cc8b3baed6ec.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 摩多克裂縫。

9961424414f2cb9995709dc15a71d305c02c92c6.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 in the Night Falls storybook.
9961424414f2cb9995709dc15a71d305c02c92c6.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#5 頁。

17bad5c7f65f834589add154f35d7a7450fe0e14.source: Sometimes Guard Linko will not show up. In that case you will have to re-do the mission for the bonus. Mercenary Heroes will always transform into a male Kournan soldier even if they are female. For some characters the map will not be uncovered during the cinematic, even after moving using the keyboard. Sometimes the mission will fail when encountering the last group of enemies even without Kormir / Shahai dying and with time still available. Of the two groups that have to be killed to free Kormir, the northern one will sometimes spawn inside of a prison cell, out of reach of melee attacks for both them and players.
17bad5c7f65f834589add154f35d7a7450fe0e14.text: 有時守衛林科不會出現。在這種情況下，您將不得不重新執行任務以獲得獎金。僱用英雄即使是女性，也總是會變身為男性庫爾南士兵。對於某些角色來說，即使在使用鍵盤移動後，地圖也不會在過場動畫中被發現。有時，即使科米爾/沙海沒有死亡並且還有時間，遇到最後一批敵人時任務也會失敗。在必須殺死才能釋放科米爾的兩個群體中，北方的一個有時會在牢房內生成，他們和玩家都無法受到近戰攻擊。

38a61ee90c40ccccb19b403d3251f960e485f4fe.text: 主職 不是 戰士

8323ec51f8a5851be58bb8560c0ca815d6ac7e54.source: Speak with Headmaster Zhan in the monastery

ec96b9acc8893e034802865d6b6a69991521ff9b.source: Go to southeastern Shing Jea Monastery. The headmasters are gathered in one place.
ec96b9acc8893e034802865d6b6a69991521ff9b.text: 前往東南部 星岬寺。校長們都聚集在一處。

5f06d3cb03982e9362928b3c10b069f6725138a9.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from The Scar and start the mission.
5f06d3cb03982e9362928b3c10b069f6725138a9.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 斷崖 走進前哨站並開始任務。

15da7f85a12af83de7bb7483b732857bde39b626.text: 擊敗 苟斯艾歷士 的團隊。

27f9741fa181e430a47804ba32db5dfb59d5bbce.text: 擊敗 依沙席 的團隊。

48e65bb89d77eefa5079903435eb46bb2779b67f.text: 擊敗赫斯珀·薩索的隊伍。

66cab502847b92a359ca41b780f3dff92894682a.text: 擊敗喬索·埃舍爾的隊伍。

a3d24ccc36a84cd9d8e4b01f848f1277c01d74f8.text: 擊敗凱斯卡·希什的隊伍。

e3fad1173d056b6db4ae6545a9cff0c03fea04c0.source: *BONUS* Cleanse the area before King Khimaar's spirit is driven away.
e3fad1173d056b6db4ae6545a9cff0c03fea04c0.text: *獎勵* 在希瑪爾國王的靈魂被驅走之前淨化該地區。

7a4a2040a0c19754bc7a1b2005afe667cd8e29f1.source: Before you fight the six teams mentioned in the objectives, there is an opportunity to gain Morale Boosts by killing the five Sand Giants which grant a 2% boost each. These Sand Giants are not mission critical.
7a4a2040a0c19754bc7a1b2005afe667cd8e29f1.text: 在與目標中提到的六支隊伍戰鬥之前，有機會透過殺死五個沙巨人來獲得士氣提升，每個沙巨人都會給予 2% 提升。這些沙巨人並不是關鍵任務。

7905759174b7548e9d3732a75646c583b3a1eb3e.source: The bonus requires keeping King Khimaar alive in the third (and final) area. This is complicated by three factors that can cause you to fail the bonus: first, as soon as you enter the area, Custodian Hulgar's group will start attacking him. If he survives, he is also at risk from other foes in the area, especially if you draw them away from their original locations. Finally, if you take more than ten minutes to clear the area, the king will leave (usually at least one 2 minute cycle is needed per group, leaving only two possible extra cycles).
7905759174b7548e9d3732a75646c583b3a1eb3e.text: 獎勵要求讓基馬爾國王在第三個（也是最後一個）區域存活。這會因為三個因素而變得複雜，這些因素可能會導致你無法獲得獎勵：首先，一旦你進入該區域，禁軍赫爾加爾的隊伍就會開始攻擊他。如果他倖存下來，他也會面臨來自該地區其他敵人的風險，特別是如果你將他們從原來的位置引走的話。最後，如果你花了十分鐘以上清理該區域，國王就會離開（通常每組至少需要一個 2 分鐘週期，只留下兩個可能的額外週期）。

9443136719dc68a11a5ba5064711aa72cba43b06.source: Accordingly, immediately send your party to protect the king (e.g. by flagging heroes and henchmen) and clear the central area of all foes before going after any of the other groups. Be prepared to return to protect the king if any foes respawn and head in his direction.
9443136719dc68a11a5ba5064711aa72cba43b06.text: 因此，立即派你的隊伍去保護國王（例如，透過標記英雄和追隨者）並清除中心區域的所有敵人，然後再追擊任何其他隊伍。如果有任何敵人重生並朝他的方向前進，請準備好返回保護國王。

06a7ac09e1c87210a12d3ea5470957ec66a4ef89.source: Besides increasing the level of all foes, Hard mode also adds a few skills to all non-boss enemies. In the Sand Giant section the Devourers will add effective area damage through Barrage while the Sand Giants become a bit more tanky through Vampiric Touch.
06a7ac09e1c87210a12d3ea5470957ec66a4ef89.text: 除了提高所有敵人的等級外，困難模式 還為所有非 Boss 敵人增加了一些技能。在 沙巨人 部分，蠍 將透過 齊射 增加有效區域傷害，而沙巨人則透過 吸血鬼之觸 變得更加坦克。

6b6aab0ef519914c4ff49ff8ad1671a03aa1ce4d.source: For the Forgotten section, the Mesmers gain Power Drain to interrupt while the Necromancers can remove enchantments due to Strip Enchantment. For the Bonus, it becomes much more important to avoid drawing foes to Khimaar and to protect him quickly. Not only can they kill him much quicker, but their increased movement speed means that one of the patrols from either the Ranger boss or the Monk boss area will very likely encounter the backline of the party if they haven't moved forwards.
6b6aab0ef519914c4ff49ff8ad1671a03aa1ce4d.text: 對於 被遺忘者 部分，幻術師獲得 強力吸收 來打斷，而死靈法師則可以透過 剝奪加持 移除結界。對於 額外獎勵 來說，避免將敵人吸引到 Khimaar 並快速保護他變得更加重要。他們不僅可以更快地殺死他，而且移動速度的提高意味著來自 遊俠 Boss 或 僧侶 Boss 區域的一支巡邏隊如果不向前移動，很可能會遇到隊伍的後線。

987e1e4287c94d206284d89c86b24602f459376b.source: Area of effect skills as all sections are tight.
987e1e4287c94d206284d89c86b24602f459376b.text: 由於所有部分都很緊張，所以影響技能範圍。

2c9a2b5d9ac2cc648e8725e42d827721e59c4277.source: Anti-caster skills, such as Scourge Healing, Backfire, and Broad Head Arrow.
2c9a2b5d9ac2cc648e8725e42d827721e59c4277.text: 反腳輪技能，例如 災禍治癒、魔力反噬 和 闊首箭。

159383d1b2fde91980cb4099745d20a192908062.source: Technobabble can prove useful to daze both the Priest and the boss at once (if used properly).
159383d1b2fde91980cb4099745d20a192908062.text: 事實證明，科技語言可以有效地同時迷惑牧師和老闆（如果使用得當）。

4b8bef13aa7ee58f2971c366b40aa8e617abbf03.source: A minion master helps corpse control as enemies use Consume Corpse to heal themselves and dodge players attacks.
4b8bef13aa7ee58f2971c366b40aa8e617abbf03.text: 當敵人使用 屍體吸收 治療自己並躲避玩家攻擊時，小兵大師可以幫助控制屍體。

0410351658e999212c7c24f7d4175e494f283741.source: Blind skills to use against warriors and rangers but not versus Sand Giants as they use Plague Touch.
0410351658e999212c7c24f7d4175e494f283741.text: 盲目技能可用於對抗戰士和遊俠，但不能用於對抗沙巨人，因為他們使用 疫病之觸。

a20ebd5b5be05d0a6b3a62e0caa49d13ed8fd0dc.source: Spike Builds can be especially good to quickly kill Enemy Priest such as Star Burst, Mind Blast, Lightning Surge Nuker, Moebius Strike, Way of the Assassin Dagger Spam, Strike as One Packmaster
a20ebd5b5be05d0a6b3a62e0caa49d13ed8fd0dc.text: Spike Builds 特別適合快速殺死敵方牧師，例如 星爆、心靈轟擊、閃電震盪 Nuker、莫比斯狙殺、暗殺者 Dagger Spam、衝擊合一 Packmaster

fc99bdb773b797890bd229a1e40549b7ac0266f0.source: The groups led by the different bosses are hostile toward each other, and it is possible to have two enemy teams engage in combat if pulled correctly.
fc99bdb773b797890bd229a1e40549b7ac0266f0.text: 不同boss領導的隊伍彼此敵對，如果拉動得當，有可能讓兩支敵方隊伍交戰。

94eb85a0c569b2d238abeb918068397374e2cd57.source: Lyssha Suss and Kesskah Shissh are not present in the mission. Their teams are actually headed by Custodian Phebus and Custodian Hulgar, respectively.
94eb85a0c569b2d238abeb918068397374e2cd57.text: Lyssha Suss 和 Kesskah Shissh 沒有參加這項任務。他們的團隊實際上分別由監護人菲布斯和監護人赫爾加領導。

6121d6143ba39130fb49eafe0cd550647174fee9.source: Consistent with the rest of the game, respawning enemies do not yield any experience or drops. However, they do leave exploitable corpses.
6121d6143ba39130fb49eafe0cd550647174fee9.text: 與遊戲的其他部分一致，重生的敵人不會產生任何經驗或掉落物。然而，他們確實留下了可利用的屍體。

110067568e070ca57ea42deee1891a959f328f20.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #9 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
110067568e070ca57ea42deee1891a959f328f20.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#9 頁。

95dd6d0f6d45a9ee5ef291e76f0ebd88ced86544.source: The Morale Boost granted upon killing a Sand Giant also affects animal companions. In the last round, Lyssha Suss's (Custodian Phebus's) team may be tagged as Defeated without even having been engaged. If this happens, the player can ignore this group and finish the mission by just killing the other two teams. Sometimes, a chest will spawn at the entrance to Issah Sshay's chamber which the Ghostly Hero may become stuck on. If this happens the team must resign and begin the mission again. If you pull enemies to the Ghostly Hero before he opens the first gate, he may spend too long fighting them and never open the gate.
95dd6d0f6d45a9ee5ef291e76f0ebd88ced86544.text: 殺死 沙巨人 後獲得計程車氣提升也會影響動物夥伴。在最後一輪中，萊莎·蘇斯（Lyssha Suss）（守護者菲比斯）的隊伍甚至可能在沒有交戰的情況下就被標記為「擊敗」。如果發生這種情況，玩家可以忽略這支隊伍，只需殺死另外兩支隊伍即可完成任務。有時，依沙席 房間的入口處會產生一個箱子，英雄之魂 可能會卡在上面。如果發生這種情況，團隊必須辭職並重新開始任務。如果你在敵人開啟第一道門之前將敵人拉到 英雄之魂，他可能會花太長時間與他們戰鬥而永遠不會開啟門。

2ddb0b50aecd61fb395a2b468fd9a90769a8bb48.source: Your party starts under the Kournan Guardsman effect, disguised as Kournan guards to avoid early confrontations. During this time, players can accomplish the bonus objectives which are very simple.
2ddb0b50aecd61fb395a2b468fd9a90769a8bb48.text: 你的隊伍在庫南衛兵效應下開始，偽裝成庫南守衛以避免早期對抗。在此期間，玩家可以完成非常簡單的獎勵目標。

30b3f40a23e637e8336ce95a412e08c3faafc191.source: Proceed to the treasure vault (point 5) to trigger Margrid's dialogue to retrieve the Diadem of Lady Glaive and now head to the prison gate (point 6). Prison Keeper Shelkesh will ask the code to clear passage.
30b3f40a23e637e8336ce95a412e08c3faafc191.text: 前往寶庫（點 5）觸發瑪格麗德的對話，取回格萊夫人王冠，然後前往監獄大門（點 6）。監獄看守謝爾凱什會要求輸入密碼才能通行。

e7df8710ec8e7402eed96437fc1ed197925a1673.source: If you acquired the password from the guard at the entrance of the fort, you can pass through unobstructed.
e7df8710ec8e7402eed96437fc1ed197925a1673.text: 如果你從要塞入口處的守衛那裡得到了密碼，你就可以暢通無阻地通過。

1ce7ffc994ff831a8b8cc897c71cadf8dd6818a1.source: However, should you not have the password or choose the option to give the wrong password, the 3 hostile Kournans will spawn, and Shelkesh will turn hostile, although he will not move or attack. The gate will open when all 4 foes are dead.
1ce7ffc994ff831a8b8cc897c71cadf8dd6818a1.text: 然而，如果您沒有密碼或選擇提供錯誤密碼的選項，3 敵對的 Kournans 將會生成，而 Shelkesh 將變得敵對，儘管他不會移動或攻擊。當所有 4 敵人死亡時，大門將會開啟。

7a8d7e2eba3028e0c16acdabac201477157fe236.source: Upon reaching the prison, kill Jailer Gahanni and the other guards and a cinematic will start (point 7).
7a8d7e2eba3028e0c16acdabac201477157fe236.text: 到達監獄後，殺死獄卒加漢尼和其他守衛，電影就會開始（點 7）。

d95bf3ff10dedf7ab8254b94592b46d4b4b7d188.source: Now, you have fifteen minutes to escape by reaching the docks with Kormir and Shahai. The exit can be found in only half the counter's time so there is no need to rush through as the clock may imply. There are two deadly spots:
d95bf3ff10dedf7ab8254b94592b46d4b4b7d188.text: 現在，你有十五分鐘的時間與科米爾和沙海一起到達碼頭來逃脫。只需櫃檯一半的時間就可以找到出口，因此無需像時鐘所暗示的那樣匆忙通過。有兩個致命點：

304c7ea80c2ad7507eb5955a2c7a8255aa50cb03.source: Complete exploration during this mission contributes approximately 0.7% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
304c7ea80c2ad7507eb5955a2c7a8255aa50cb03.text: 在此任務期間完成的探索大約為 Tyrian 版圖 頭銜貢獻了 0.7%。

63da0ff1cf92f9839476a8200360fb196b1307a8.source: This mission can be used for levelling up your character or your heroes. A Scroll of Hunter's Insight will increase the experience gained as you will be killing bosses on a regular basis.
63da0ff1cf92f9839476a8200360fb196b1307a8.text: 此任務可用於升級您的角色或英雄。獵人洞察力的 卷軸 將增加您獲得的經驗，因為您將定期殺死 Boss。

d4913eab7e7b7f49304842e32bd8f744a64b729b.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Diviner's Ascent and start the mission.
d4913eab7e7b7f49304842e32bd8f744a64b729b.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 預言者之坡 走進前哨站並開始任務。

dc3150e50e1a86b6d9207790e9eb5b592bf8d691.source: Help the Ghostly Hero complete the ritual that will combine the three pieces of the Vision Crystal.
dc3150e50e1a86b6d9207790e9eb5b592bf8d691.text: 幫助 英雄之魂 完成將 幻影水晶 的三塊結合在一起的儀式。

5198c01bbb8a2848ba11330935efb44dae736c4e.source: Return Crystal Shard 1 to the Ghostly Hero.
5198c01bbb8a2848ba11330935efb44dae736c4e.text: 影返 水晶碎片 1 到 英雄之魂。

ec750762d8e5312f1fd285a3e70e2b5d52c09a00.source: Return Crystal Shard 2 to the Ghostly Hero.
ec750762d8e5312f1fd285a3e70e2b5d52c09a00.text: 影返 水晶碎片 2 到 英雄之魂。

42ca6818c1ae471cfff7a4fdadaab883c4ce871a.source: Return Crystal Shard 3 to the Ghostly Hero.
42ca6818c1ae471cfff7a4fdadaab883c4ce871a.text: 影返 水晶碎片 3 到 英雄之魂。

f4bd0b7f96c603bf80f0d0062c76bd84c034df96.source: *BONUS* Use the Crystal Shards to awaken the three Ritual Priests of Elona.
f4bd0b7f96c603bf80f0d0062c76bd84c034df96.text: *獎勵* 使用水晶碎片喚醒伊洛娜的三個 儀式祭司。

92e90c382136780ab670256e8786626ccb4eb143.source: This mission is split into two parts. The first part is to take the first Crystal Shard from the Ghostly Priest to the Ghostly Hero (Warrior on the article map). He can be found northwest of the starting location. In the valley, beware of the large Minotaur patrol and the Dune Burrowers.
92e90c382136780ab670256e8786626ccb4eb143.text: 任務分為兩部分。第一部分是把第一位水晶碎片從幽靈牧師那裡拿到英雄之魂（文章圖上的戰士）。他可以在起始位置的西北方找到。在山谷中，請提防大型 牛頭怪 巡邏隊和沙丘穴居者。

258d59f447364b5332427b6102b3dff41a43886c.source: Watch out for the Splinter Mines spread throughout the mission. When any party member triggers it, a ward briefly appears and after a few seconds, it causes crippled and bleeding to anyone within the area. The mine will continue to do this unless its core is removed by touching it. The core becomes a bundle and the mine will no longer activate once picked up (although it will finish its current cycle, often inflicting those conditions to the player who picked up the bundle unless they move away fast). Furthermore, the core can be dropped and cause the same conditions to nearby foes after a few seconds. It has one use only.
258d59f447364b5332427b6102b3dff41a43886c.text: 留意整個任務中傳播的 爆裂藤。當任何隊員觸發它時，一個守衛會短暫出現，幾秒鐘後，它會導致該區域內的任何人癱瘓和流血。地雷將繼續這樣做，除非透過接觸它的核心來移除它。核心變成了一個捆綁包，地雷一旦被拾起就不再啟用（儘管它會完成當前的迴圈，通常會對拾起捆綁包的玩家造成這些情況，除非他們快速離開）。此外，核心可能會掉落，並在幾秒鐘後對附近的敵人造成相同的情況。它只有一種用途。

6befc5d6391320dd43650f096ad21f58177f003e.source: When a player hands the Crystal Shard to the Ghostly Hero, a cinematic triggers and the second part of the mission begins. The party has now 30 minutes to find and deliver the last two Crystal Shards to the Ghostly Hero (who will now remain close to the Vision Crystal). There is plenty of time to move carefully and pull groups, even for the bonus and in Hard Mode. South of the Ghostly Hero lies two gates. These provide access to a large area home to another two crystals. It is recommended to use the more southerly gate since it avoids the potential aggro of two patrols.
6befc5d6391320dd43650f096ad21f58177f003e.text: 當玩家將 水晶碎片 交給 英雄之魂 時，會觸發影片並開始任務的第二部分。該隊伍現在有 30 分鐘的時間來找到最後兩個水晶碎片並將其交付給 英雄之魂（現在將保持在 幻影水晶 附近）。即使在困難模式下，也有足夠的時間小心移動和拉隊。 英雄之魂 的南面有兩個大門。這些提供了通往另外兩個晶體的大面積區域的通道。建議使用更南邊的大門，因為它可以避免兩個巡邏隊潛在的仇恨。

2f466d9f89cedcbfc52640396b1c63116585f43b.source: There is a crystal to the east, past the bridge and two bosses. Retrieve this crystal and either: take it back to the ghostly hero, or take it to the remains of the nearby Ritual Priest as per the bonus objectives.
2f466d9f89cedcbfc52640396b1c63116585f43b.text: 東邊有一個水晶，過了橋和兩個 Boss。取回這顆水晶，然後：將其帶回給幽靈英雄，或根據獎勵目標將其帶到附近儀式牧師的遺骸處。

c1e52ebdc4c3bfe6f2026ba1ead51c67e3688dfb.source: If the party contains more than one player, then the team can continue westward to the last crystal. If alone, the player can take the first crystal back to the ghostly hero and return. The last crystal is again located behind a random boss. Picking up the crystal will cause the spawn of an additional two groups of forgotten. Taking this crystal back to the Ghostly Hero will complete the mission.
c1e52ebdc4c3bfe6f2026ba1ead51c67e3688dfb.text: 如果隊伍中有不只一位玩家，那麼隊伍可以繼續往西到達最後一顆水晶。如果獨自一人，玩家可以將第一個水晶帶回給幽靈英雄並返回。最後一顆水晶再次位於隨機 Boss 後方。撿起水晶會導致另外兩組被遺忘者的產生。將這塊水晶帶回 英雄之魂 即可完成任務。

92fa504aacb8a1d36519d14403d3188211ca6a04.source: To achieve the bonus, players must prompt the appearance of three ghosts at their gravesites (Elementalist on the article map) by using the Crystal Shards, before delivering all of them to the Ghostly Hero. These awakened ghosts will walk towards the Ghostly Hero without following the party and fight foes but their survival is not required.
92fa504aacb8a1d36519d14403d3188211ca6a04.text: 為了獲得獎勵，玩家必須使用水晶碎片促使三個鬼魂出現在他們的墳墓（文章地圖上的 元素使），然後將它們全部傳送到 英雄之魂。這些覺醒的鬼魂將走向 英雄之魂，而不跟隨隊伍並與敵人戰鬥，但他們的生存不是必需的。

9efe7f2e9f084fb109ffd29979f01686a6077870.source: The first gravesite is east of the starting location, behind two Dune Burrowers.
9efe7f2e9f084fb109ffd29979f01686a6077870.text: 第一個墓地位於起始位置以東，在兩個沙丘挖掘者後面。

a4eb471be719c890a327dee025436c5a9c3c971d.source: The second gravesite is behind the boulder. Use the hidden path to travel between the second and third crystal sites.
a4eb471be719c890a327dee025436c5a9c3c971d.text: 第二個墓地位於巨石後方。使用隱藏路徑在第二個和第三個水晶站點之間移動。

0d979e408bafb3f3f78105feb6ed9a3ec04ecddf.source: Your only objective is to defeat the Doppelganger; you meet the bonus objective by killing it within 10 minutes (2 minutes on Hard mode).
0d979e408bafb3f3f78105feb6ed9a3ec04ecddf.text: 你唯一的目標就是打敗分身；您可以在 10 分鐘內殺死它（困難模式 上的 2 分鐘），從而達到獎勵目標。

c258e2a47993b026cbadae132a5f7c6cc8d19e65.source: To reach your opponent's location, speak to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut, who will take you to the area with the ghosts you met during the previous three missions. Walk past them and step on each of the three stones marked with ascension runes (the order does not matter). After a brief cinematic (showing the rock break open), you will be face to face with the doppel.
c258e2a47993b026cbadae132a5f7c6cc8d19e65.text: 要到達對手的位置，請與 儀式大祭司撒穆特 交談，他將帶您前往前三個任務中遇到的幽靈所在的區域。走過它們，踩上三塊標有提升符文的石頭（順序無關緊要）。在一段簡短的電影（顯示岩石破裂）之後，您將與分身面對面。

fdd4566dfc24501544644783bedf8f1bef8971bc.source: This mission is one of the few missions a player can walk out of. By standing on the teleporter in the beginning, players are teleported back to the Augury Rock outpost.
fdd4566dfc24501544644783bedf8f1bef8971bc.text: 該任務是玩家可以退出的少數任務之一。透過一開始站在傳送器上，玩家會被傳送回 占卜之石 前哨站。

f886a539530d4180e626a851955ea1a6a4fcea3b.source: Consumables, such as Candy Apples, can be used during the fight; however, summoning stones cannot.
f886a539530d4180e626a851955ea1a6a4fcea3b.text: 戰鬥中可以使用糖蘋果等消耗品；然而，召喚石卻不能。

cf6515f7ac3307babb5b8dfc0712c8358798a6fc.source: The mission area includes several landmarks: The Divine Fire shrine holding the assembled Vision Crystal, the three ascension runes, and the Mesa.
cf6515f7ac3307babb5b8dfc0712c8358798a6fc.text: 任務區域包括幾個地標：持有組裝好的 幻影水晶 的神火神殿、三個提升符文和 巖山。

0d9daf734fe3a696fabbe858448627e085d07c89.source: After completing this mission, your character will be taken to The Dragon's Lair.
0d9daf734fe3a696fabbe858448627e085d07c89.text: 完成此任務後，您的角色將被帶到 龍穴。

660323bd5559900889edf556a0c08b5e393dc761.source: None of the walls in the mesa block line of sight; projectiles will travel through them.
660323bd5559900889edf556a0c08b5e393dc761.text: 檯面上沒有任何牆壁阻擋視線；彈體將穿過它們。

1e8793c53ac88fdc9e3817d5bb40e5e4c5a5956c.source: If you and the Doppelganger both die, you will get credit for the mission.
1e8793c53ac88fdc9e3817d5bb40e5e4c5a5956c.text: 如果你和分身都死了，你就會獲得任務的榮譽。

ed180de55d48e9342954d8a087eb00cd124ccf50.source: If you die first, you will get credit for the mission but may not trigger the cutscene or move on to The Dragon's Lair.
ed180de55d48e9342954d8a087eb00cd124ccf50.text: 如果你先死，你將獲得任務獎勵，但可能不會觸發過場動畫或繼續進行 龍穴。

4f426f3fa56ce57a64e2e8ee11d5b3ee8bc429d1.source: If the doppelganger dies first, you will be resurrected for the cinematic, and will move on normally).
4f426f3fa56ce57a64e2e8ee11d5b3ee8bc429d1.text: 如果分身先死，你將在過場動畫中復活，並正常繼續前進）。

df55b54085f51a2941bfbf7b65c62440c83fe7c9.source: If you disconnect during the mission, you will not get credit (and will find yourself in either the Dragon's Lair or Augury Rock outposts).
df55b54085f51a2941bfbf7b65c62440c83fe7c9.text: 如果您在任務期間斷開連線，您將不會獲得積分（並且會發現自己處於龍穴或 占卜之石 前哨站）。

cc65896e3eec1baf0293b8511682ed2d5950e38a.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
cc65896e3eec1baf0293b8511682ed2d5950e38a.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#11 頁。

22dc67839e6eec210395b9bd968f7e410d6d9943.source: Meet the Master of Whispers in the Floodplain of Mahnkelon.
22dc67839e6eec210395b9bd968f7e410d6d9943.text: 在馬恩科隆的洪氾平原遇見低語大師。

276c23ca27a4f956cad57836e8008059a3159a79.source: Weaken the Drought by killing the droughtlings at the Floodplain of Mahnkelon, outside the Waterworks. [5...0] of 5 groups remain.
276c23ca27a4f956cad57836e8008059a3159a79.text: 透過殺死水廠外馬恩科隆洪氾區的旱生物來減弱乾旱。 5 群組的 [5...0] 保留。

e4a76619e7cf4ecbe2a8f4338874a76526f3aab1.source: Report to Dehjah for further instructions.
e4a76619e7cf4ecbe2a8f4338874a76526f3aab1.text: 向 Dehjah 報告以獲取進一步指示。

5624e8c2de6b1845dfb285fec719e3a5c0a2c351.source: Master of Whispers joins your party.
5624e8c2de6b1845dfb285fec719e3a5c0a2c351.text: 密語大師加入你的隊伍。

59adec9038080f6411d7fd605d6ded10ef130273.source: From Kodonur Crossroads exit into The Floodplain of Mahnkelon. Talk to the Master of Whispers who can be found next to the resurrection shrine. Make your way northeast to the water's edge where you will find the 5 groups of Droughtlings. Each group will contain 3 Droughtlings each and in total all 15 must be killed to advance the quest. The groups can be killed in any order. Just be aware that there are large groups of Heket in the area, so try not to aggro these or pull the Droughtlings to make the job easier.
59adec9038080f6411d7fd605d6ded10ef130273.text: 從 科登諾入口 出口進入 Mahnkelon 洪氾區。與復活神殿旁的低語大師交談。往東北方向走到水邊，您會發現 5 成群的旱苗。每個組別將包含 3 旱生物，並且總共必須殺死所有 15 才能推進任務。這些群體可以以任何順序被殺死。請注意，該地區有大群 青蛙族群，因此請盡量不要攻擊它們或拉出旱生物，以使工作變得更容易。

bae10ec59aab89f8ad36fdc425a162735140c2d9.source: Once all 5 groups have been killed, talk to Dehjah who is standing on a small hill to the west. Once you are ready, she will take you to the mission outpost Rilohn Refuge. Talk to her again here (note that she is now disguised as a human) for your reward.
bae10ec59aab89f8ad36fdc425a162735140c2d9.text: 當所有 5 小組都被殺死後，與站在西邊一座小山上的 Dehjah 交談。一旦你準備好了，她就會帶你去任務前哨站裡洛恩避難所。在這裡再次與她交談（注意她現在偽裝成人類）以獲得獎勵。

489d693313e67b0be88a29208b12f2e3fcafa33a.source: Bring skills that deal massive damage to break through Stoneflesh Aura or enchantment removal skills to remove Stoneflesh Aura.
489d693313e67b0be88a29208b12f2e3fcafa33a.text: 使用造成大量傷害的技能來突破 石體靈氣 或結界移除技能來移除 石體靈氣。

656e1fd0211ce76f57f701fa39bf04dcdf458c08.source: Interruption skills are also a viable option.
656e1fd0211ce76f57f701fa39bf04dcdf458c08.text: 打斷技能也是一個可行的選擇。

7f7bcce89202d7af2019831f7996080bffb249b0.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Bukdek Byway
7f7bcce89202d7af2019831f7996080bffb249b0.text: 在 巴德克小徑 中擊敗受影響者

ec230184e7346a625ea75be2d2823c6c016f5600.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Bukdek Byway, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
ec230184e7346a625ea75be2d2823c6c016f5600.text: 完成此任務會改變 巴德克小徑 中出現的敵人，具體來說，受苦者將不再生成。

3f2ddbacaf92ad4447411e9d911fe7a9fecd4d11.source: The third gravesite is north of the western crystal, thus northwest of the courtyard.
3f2ddbacaf92ad4447411e9d911fe7a9fecd4d11.text: 第三個墓地位於西水晶以北，即庭院的西北方。

49eafd9a306030c13385500a9aded9564394f76c.source: Note that the ghosts can be awakened by any shard, although awakening the third priest before collecting the third shard is a slower route unless your party consists of atleast 2 players.
49eafd9a306030c13385500a9aded9564394f76c.text: 請注意，鬼魂可以被任何碎片喚醒，儘管在收集第三個碎片之前喚醒第三個牧師是一個較慢的路線，除非你的隊伍至少由 2 玩家組成。

12f1fa1896b131d84a07aa39b2ba603ac1089832.source: Cripple removal to ease trouble from the Splinter Mines and Hamstring.
12f1fa1896b131d84a07aa39b2ba603ac1089832.text: 消除癱瘓以減輕 爆裂藤 和 斷腿攻擊 的困擾。

3d8f9dfb0b1f3537fff7d07e544e2a16d50ee167.source: Anti-caster skills to dispatch Sages faster.
3d8f9dfb0b1f3537fff7d07e544e2a16d50ee167.text: 反施法者技能可以更快派遣賢者。

b31e0aa2894ce7f3aea6b8011b2c90b876ddd8dd.source: A running skill to speed up the delivery of the vision crystals.
b31e0aa2894ce7f3aea6b8011b2c90b876ddd8dd.text: 加速傳送異象結晶的奔跑技能。

2a4d99d3f7f7037d9edf231216e8a3e89047ca07.source: This mission can be run by a solo character:
2a4d99d3f7f7037d9edf231216e8a3e89047ca07.text: 此任務可以由單人角色執行：

5da756e179dc4855e3d92a91e9b9a1b3ca412d25.source: Crippled counters such as "I Am Unstoppable!".
5da756e179dc4855e3d92a91e9b9a1b3ca412d25.text: 殘癈 計數器如「我勢不可擋！」。

56217655ff7d49baddecaf6e9015b2c44c84df4a.source: Shadow stepping will cause you to drop the crystals (so avoid using these skills while carrying them).
56217655ff7d49baddecaf6e9015b2c44c84df4a.text: 闇影 步進會導致你掉落水晶（因此避免在攜帶水晶時使用這些技能）。

6f915bf3239fccaabf138e29aa31c5e589a21dbc.source: Complete exploration during this mission contributes approximately 0.2% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
6f915bf3239fccaabf138e29aa31c5e589a21dbc.text: 在此任務期間完成的探索大約為 Tyrian 版圖 頭銜貢獻了 0.2%。

bf632fec8feb5891ec60614973db5effec08b996.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #10 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
bf632fec8feb5891ec60614973db5effec08b996.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#10 頁。

c08397b2c56ff6c935542c5b6c326d28c66fb129.source: The mission can be failed if the Ghostly Hero dies. This can happen occasionally if enemies spawn inside the complex near to his location.
c08397b2c56ff6c935542c5b6c326d28c66fb129.text: 如果 英雄之魂 死亡，任務可能會失敗。如果敵人在靠近他的位置的建築群內生成，這種情況偶爾會發生。

f01857d0a5faaa8aa514762da37eff10db4a2121.source: For a Price neither active nor completed
f01857d0a5faaa8aa514762da37eff10db4a2121.text: 對於既不活躍也不完成的價格

a7e1a642cb03fc48a07e023e448d3f3c0a6dfb4d.source: Meet with Dehjah, an ally of the Master of Whispers.
a7e1a642cb03fc48a07e023e448d3f3c0a6dfb4d.text: 與低語大師的盟友德賈會面。

ad22d58c22430d521c075ca8aba7fe305fb83e30.source: Destroy the demons from the earth. [3...0] of 3 groups remain.
ad22d58c22430d521c075ca8aba7fe305fb83e30.text: 消滅地球上的惡魔。 3 群組的 [3...0] 保留。

8f9e91f872d62b95fb90d5da13b75a5a86f541a3.source: See Master of Whispers for your reward.
8f9e91f872d62b95fb90d5da13b75a5a86f541a3.text: 請參閱密語大師以獲得獎勵。

230cb8fd0b6cea067e75dbfae915250442394f71.source: Dehjah and Water Djinn will no longer spawn in Dejarin Estate after this quest is completed.
230cb8fd0b6cea067e75dbfae915250442394f71.text: 此任務完成後，Dehjah 和 水巨靈 將不再在 Dejarin Estate 中產生。

757cfc2e4cc6671b16e205d08d0a7c78b501615e.source: Secrets in the Shadow is offered right after completion of the Mysterious Message quest, together with a mutually exclusive primary quest For a Price. Note: Secrets in the Shadow leads to the recruitment of Master of Whispers and For a Price leads to the recruitment of Margrid the Sly.
757cfc2e4cc6671b16e205d08d0a7c78b501615e.text: 闇影 中的秘密在完成 機密資訊 任務後立即提供，同時還有一個互斥的主要任務（有價）。注意：闇影 中的秘密會導致招募低語大師，有價會導致招募狡猾的瑪格麗特。

536e148af5a2c1e8b87793cd75ae3c6933417a5d.source: Travel to Kodonur Crossroads then leave through the portal there into Dejarin Estate. Head to the marker and speak with Dehjah. She will summon 3 groups of Droughtlings that will converge on Dehjah's location. It is advisable to move away immediately after you have talked with Dehjah to avoid being attacked by all 3 groups of Droughtlings simultaneously - doing this allows you to engage each group separately. Defeat them and talk to Master of Whispers to collect the reward.
536e148af5a2c1e8b87793cd75ae3c6933417a5d.text: 前往 科登諾入口，然後通過那裡的傳送門進入德賈林莊園。前往標記處並與 Dehjah 交談。她將召喚 3 一群旱生物，它們將聚集到 Dehjah 的位置。建議您在與 Dehjah 交談後立即離開，以避免同時受到所有 3 乾旱群體的攻擊 - 這樣做可以讓您分別與每個群體交戰。擊敗他們並與密語大師交談以領取獎勵。

2746c2411514b10cc11c268cba832ad56160acf2.source: Mutually exclusive with For a Price.

7ca44a1a015ca875fc43245ecd239546334c0757.source: Some have claimed that the Master of Whispers will not give out the reward if one party member is dead on completion of the quest. As such, make sure that all party members are alive before talking to the Master of Whispers.
7ca44a1a015ca875fc43245ecd239546334c0757.text: 有些人聲稱，如果任務完成後一名隊員死亡，低語大師將不會發放獎勵。因此，在與低語大師交談之前，請確保所有隊員都還活著。

c13777e8e2a1bb99b3dfbce517dac9e02b76efbd.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Prophet's Path or Skyward Reach and talk to Great Ritual Priest Zahmut to start the mission. Completing Dunes of Despair, Thirsty River, or Elona Reach also brings the party here.
c13777e8e2a1bb99b3dfbce517dac9e02b76efbd.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 先知之路 或 天際流域 走進前哨站並與 儀式大祭司撒穆特 交談以開始任務。完成 絕望沙丘、乾枯河流 或 伊洛那流域 也會將聚會帶到這裡。

f78047a5b1f0769d7eb683eda2febf154745d4d4.source: Although it is possible to enter the mission without completing Dunes of Despair, Thirsty River, or Elona Reach, you do need to complete these to activate the ascension glyphs, which is necessary to complete Augury Rock.
f78047a5b1f0769d7eb683eda2febf154745d4d4.text: 儘管可以在不完成 絕望沙丘、乾枯河流 或 伊洛那流域 的情況下進入任務，但您確實需要完成這些任務才能啟動提升字形，這是完成 占卜之石 所必需的。

dbd7245a2e6c99fb82b1f1ff76a2c9514aae2fe7.source: *BONUS* Defeat the Doppelganger in under 10 minutes. (In Normal mode.)
dbd7245a2e6c99fb82b1f1ff76a2c9514aae2fe7.text: *獎勵* 在 10 分鐘內擊敗分身。 （在 普通模式 中。）

05f1ca63deb0a4f7c670d0cf95313963a711e39e.source: *BONUS* Defeat the Doppelganger in under 2 minutes. (In Hard mode.)
05f1ca63deb0a4f7c670d0cf95313963a711e39e.text: *獎勵* 在 2 分鐘內擊敗分身。 （在 困難模式 中。）

8ba6c09b4c6c811c4ed730f46be1f48faa734e82.source: 1 Only for first time character ascension.
8ba6c09b4c6c811c4ed730f46be1f48faa734e82.text: 1 僅適用於第一次角色提升。

55400e0f95dfa5083e641c539932a6b80460d16f.source: Augury Rock/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
55400e0f95dfa5083e641c539932a6b80460d16f.text: 占卜之石/詳細演練指南

b7c1f5e093a57fdc833554da1230ea6dad9fd3bd.source: The mission has three more sections, each with some Forgotten, a boss and a priest. A timer starts and at every two minutes mark, if the priest of a group is still alive, all defeated foes are resurrected; thus timing is highly important. Focus your firepower on the Priest first but if your party shows difficulty, pull back to prevent being instantly swarmed by the respawned foes. Defeating all foes opens the gate to the next section. Between sections, the timer stops and will reset when the next gate is opened, allowing enough time to regenerate and recharge before tackling the next area. Remember that if the Ghostly Hero dies, the mission is over. If you're unsure whether your healers can keep him alive, leave him behind the gate by talking to him once.
b7c1f5e093a57fdc833554da1230ea6dad9fd3bd.text: 任務還有另外三個部分，每個部分都有一些 被遺忘者 ，一個老闆和一個牧師。計時器開始計時，每兩分鐘，如果隊伍的牧師還活著，所有被擊敗的敵人都會復活；因此，時機非常重要。 聚能器 首先用火力攻擊牧師，但如果你的隊伍表現出困難，請向後撤退，以防止立即被重生的敵人包圍。擊敗所有敵人將開啟通往下一部分的大門。在各個部分之間，計時器會停止，並在下一個門開啟時重置，以便在處理下一個區域之前有足夠的時間進行再生和充電。請記住，如果 英雄之魂 死了，任務就結束了。如果你不確定你的治療師能否讓他活下去，請與他交談一次，將他留在門後。

d18f530bba41830124cabfa57ee80860ef296217.source: Talk to the Ghostly Hero and enter the first section which has a single group led by Goss Aleessh. Be wary of the Forgotten's Chaos Storms, as it tends to confuse Hero and Henchmen AI, making them run in-and-out of the effect repeatedly.
d18f530bba41830124cabfa57ee80860ef296217.text: 與 英雄之魂 交談並進入第一部分，其中有一個由 苟斯艾歷士 領導的小組。警惕 被遺忘者 的混沌風暴，因為它往往會混淆 英雄 和 傭兵 AI，使它們重複執行進出效果。

520fc7f35fd31f7ef161a70bce62cd2beef602db.source: Section two has two groups, one headed by Issah Sshay and the other by Hessper Sasso. Finish off one group at a time. After defeating the first boss, wait until the 2 minute timer mark has passed, then continue. There is little space to fight so instead of rushing ahead, wait by the recently opened gate as both groups have patrols headed towards it. In particular, sticking to the left wall can let one avoid the groups connected to Hesper Sasso entirely, making it easier to kill the Elementalist groups undisturbed.
520fc7f35fd31f7ef161a70bce62cd2beef602db.text: 第二部分有兩個小組，一組由 依沙席 領導，另一組由 Hessper Sasso 領導。一次完成一組。擊敗第一個 Boss 後，等待 2 分鐘計時器標記過去，然後繼續。戰鬥的空間很小，所以不要衝在前面，而是在最近開啟的大門前等待，因為兩支隊伍都有巡邏隊朝它走去。特別是，貼在左邊的牆上可以讓人們完全避免與Hesper Sasso有關的團體，更容易不受幹擾地殺死元素使團體。

a5f9739427b1bfda097876aab3da42a923888735.source: The third section has three groups. Custodian Hulgar is to the right, Josso Essher to the left, and Custodian Phebus in between. In this section the right group will attack King Khimaar. Of the six groups, Josso's (Word of Healing) is the most difficult as you will be facing two monks. Only groups from Custodian Hulgar will enter the center as long as no one wanders too close to the other groups.
a5f9739427b1bfda097876aab3da42a923888735.text: 第三部分分為三組。監護人赫爾加在右邊，喬索·埃舍爾在左邊，監護人費比斯在中間。在本節中，右邊隊伍將攻擊希瑪爾國王。在六個組別中，Josso 的（治癒文字）是最困難的，因為你將面對兩位僧侶。只要沒有人離其他團體太近，只有監護人赫爾加的團體才會進入中心。

83c2956ce6a7e90c38b5787f34e6f2d7a7d3bf74.source: Start from Kaineng Center and follow the quest markers through Bukdek Byway, and destroy three groups of Afflicted. Non-Dervishes should avoid bringing enchantments, or be prepared to deal with an over-abundance of enchantment removal skills.
83c2956ce6a7e90c38b5787f34e6f2d7a7d3bf74.text: 從凱寧中心開始，沿著任務標記穿過巴德克小徑，消滅三組受折磨者。非苦行僧應該避免攜帶結界，或準備好應付過多的結界移除技能。

ce449bf0ffb02c5300e6cde2ed877a77504e5210.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for To Kill a Demon or No Me, No Kormir.
ce449bf0ffb02c5300e6cde2ed877a77504e5210.text: 所有隊伍成員必須接受「殺死 惡魔」或「不准我不準科米爾」的獎勵。

320392c58d3e6c3edb17a0c896eafbb8cdeb8e7a.source: Master of Whispers must be present in the party.
320392c58d3e6c3edb17a0c896eafbb8cdeb8e7a.text: 密語大師必須出席聚會。

de6c8183f3c95ebf3ef31141543ade5301c45d70.source: Protect Dehjah until she opens the entrance to the Mahnkelon Waterworks.
de6c8183f3c95ebf3ef31141543ade5301c45d70.text: 保護 Dehjah，直到她開啟 Mahnkelon 水廠的入口。

2dc5c532235411a56c1bf6e48e5b065aebd43f61.source: Make your way to the central reservoir.

50f587c5077f5c029c21143b5132b7bd4837b6e1.source: Weaken the Drought by shutting off the water pumps. [5...0] of 5 remain active.
50f587c5077f5c029c21143b5132b7bd4837b6e1.text: 透過關閉水泵來減輕乾旱。 5 的 [5...0] 保持活動狀態。

bc8b9238c6ef704311b1a83bffb148b4f0c5841f.source: *BONUS* Defeat the Drought without shutting down water pumps.
bc8b9238c6ef704311b1a83bffb148b4f0c5841f.text: *獎勵* 在不關閉水泵的情況下戰勝乾旱。

21212212c3b2c8fc60d1fdd434d8876249578638.source: Bring anti-caster skills for the Drought and Droughtlings. Examples would be skills which cause daze, spell interrupts, shutdown (such as Panic or Power Block) or hexes which cause damage to spellcasters (such as Backfire).
21212212c3b2c8fc60d1fdd434d8876249578638.text: 為乾旱和乾旱生物帶來抗施法技能。例如，導致眩暈、法術中斷、關閉的技能（例如 恐慌 或 強力封鎖）或對施法者造成傷害的巫術（例如 魔力反噬）。

d5385cfa78789c3e8c3c6fe1a8e5387f153cb040.source: Pain Inverter is especially useful if you bring lots of minions - the Drought will kill itself very quickly.
d5385cfa78789c3e8c3c6fe1a8e5387f153cb040.text: 如果您帶了很多小兵，苦痛 逆變器特別有用 - 乾旱很快就會自殺。

f10b69bb7e77f846bb3cf6e5853cbb8ed2100150.source: The Thirst of the Drought environmental effect increases earth damage taken by your party by up to 50%:
f10b69bb7e77f846bb3cf6e5853cbb8ed2100150.text: 乾旱之渴環境效果使你的隊伍受到的地球傷害增加最多 50%：

18d6f026ac96246a88134bbc3938a25b9a88f619.text: 避免攜帶 石之打擊。

2c8319ba2cbeee2be4745bbb2de3bf9f12c01104.source: Winter can be used to change the Drought's earth damage to cold damage, negating the Thirst of the Drought effect.
2c8319ba2cbeee2be4745bbb2de3bf9f12c01104.text: 寒冬可用來將乾旱的土傷害改為冷傷害，消除乾旱的渴望效果。

0ae65e59458fc13c3bb0da3e62b54c44de58c35b.source: Bring skills that protect against earth or elemental damage.
0ae65e59458fc13c3bb0da3e62b54c44de58c35b.text: 帶來抵禦土或元素傷害的技能。

3a59a6fbcdd2d931b83a4ac84b3a833b7b8c10fe.source: Damage reduction can be helpful, e.g. Protective Spirit or Shelter.
3a59a6fbcdd2d931b83a4ac84b3a833b7b8c10fe.text: 傷害 減少可能會有所幫助，例如精神守護 或 庇護。

0a1153496c38399bdc1cee2713e36c2b2b8ec0cc.source: The Mesmer skill Aneurysm can be used as a spike against the Droughtlings.
0a1153496c38399bdc1cee2713e36c2b2b8ec0cc.text: 幻術師 技能動脈瘤可用作對抗乾旱幼蟲的尖峰。

f0647620ac149975bd104d1553d00a5ab970d1f6.source: Restoration helps to prevent wipes, especially during the boss battle.
f0647620ac149975bd104d1553d00a5ab970d1f6.text: 復甦 有助於防止擦除，尤其是在 Boss 戰期間。

116d6fbe646a48fe65c34967d1ffbdffa94b48a5.source: Since you gain the standard reward if you switch off any more than one pump, the only practical benefit for skipping pumps after turning off two is that it will make the mission slightly faster.
116d6fbe646a48fe65c34967d1ffbdffa94b48a5.text: 由於如果您關閉超過一個泵，您將獲得標準獎勵，因此在關閉兩個泵後跳過泵的唯一實際好處是，它將使任務稍微快一些。

ffd1ad03a7451ff4acc0079bb3cecb4401fdcdb2.source: To capture Sandstorm from the Drought, ensure it is killed before the two Droughtlings adjacent to it.
ffd1ad03a7451ff4acc0079bb3cecb4401fdcdb2.text: 要從乾旱中捕獲 沙塵暴，請確保它在鄰近的兩個乾旱生物之前被殺死。

59d1a063006488d8d440b00e3a0947ed1250812c.source: If you are having trouble keeping Dehjah alive to open the gate, do not approach her as you start the mission. Stay tight into the shadow of the cliffs, and clear the route to the gate. Then have a party member run back to trigger Dehjah.
59d1a063006488d8d440b00e3a0947ed1250812c.text: 如果你很難讓德賈活著來開啟大門，請不要在任務開始時接近她。緊緊地躲在懸崖的陰影裡，清理通往大門的道路。然後請一名隊員跑回去觸發 Dehjah。

cba8b010f5467297f78fe984c0822c8335793c71.source: Survivors beware, for even in Normal mode, the Drought could kill a player in a single hit when going for the Master's reward.
cba8b010f5467297f78fe984c0822c8335793c71.text: 倖存者要小心，因為即使在 普通模式 中，當玩家尋求大師的獎勵時，乾旱也可能會在一擊中殺死玩家。

3bf39275d72d28b733e8893cf1135fd4eaa2bbef.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Moddok Crevice.
3bf39275d72d28b733e8893cf1135fd4eaa2bbef.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將會傳送到 摩多克裂縫。

88fa17a1a999474c6772ad20840dc50560d464d8.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #4 in the Night Falls storybook.
88fa17a1a999474c6772ad20840dc50560d464d8.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#4 頁。

b3a0ca2ff7f3519c8bb499379a0868ea28e26705.source: This mission is not required to complete the campaign.
b3a0ca2ff7f3519c8bb499379a0868ea28e26705.text: 完成戰役不需要此任務。

9da6c76478402b389b7a67e9753b1786b1bc626a.source: Completing Augury Rock brings you here.
9da6c76478402b389b7a67e9753b1786b1bc626a.text: 完成 占卜之石 即可到達此處。

67c8f3e1dcbe0e4ba0535e520915610403d2a8b0.source: Gain audience with the prophet Glint.
67c8f3e1dcbe0e4ba0535e520915610403d2a8b0.text: 拜見先知 葛林特先知。

6f5e01bbc8290d5a107289d072085ac4ad2d59f2.source: To reach Glint, you must pass through six chambers, each representing one of the core professions. Four of these rooms have a global environmental effects to hinder players from reaching the Facet at the opposite end of the chamber. Each Facet represents one profession, and when defeated opens a portal to the next chamber. The order of the chambers is always the same. The portal to the first Facet's chamber is opened after a player talks with the Forgotten Gate Keeper.
6f5e01bbc8290d5a107289d072085ac4ad2d59f2.text: 要到達 葛林特先知，您必須穿過六個房間，每個房間代表一種核心職業。其中四個房間具有全域性環境影響，阻礙玩家到達房間另一端的 Facet。每個方面代表一種職業，當被擊敗時，會開啟通往下一個房間的門戶。腔室的順序始終相同。玩家與 遺忘的城門守護者 交談後，第一個 Facet 房間的門戶就會開啟。

3522b5ad2387325c4e0d0432b520b4392eb70dc8.source: Note: Each gate has a brief cinematic that shows your party being teleported. Most people skip these, but be warned: the last cinematic also contains your conversation with Glint. If you wish to see this conversation do not skip the teleportation cinematic after the Facet of Strength.
3522b5ad2387325c4e0d0432b520b4392eb70dc8.text: 注意：每個門都有一個簡短的動畫，顯示您的隊伍被傳送。大多數人都會跳過這些，但請注意：最後一個動畫還包含您與 葛林特先知 的對話。如果您想觀看此對話，請不要跳過 力量之分身 之後的傳送動畫。

c406bd23a6a97c22dcc8be3ddd5619798e2d898d.source: The environmental effects in this room are limited to inside the wards throughout the area. Try not to stand in these wards while fighting. Crystal Guardians guard the halls here and carry a nasty Shock/Aftershock combo. Luckily, they rarely use the combo in the correct sequence. Forgotten Arcanists will often be in side rooms, intercepting players in the main corridor as they pass by. Defeat the Facet of Elements at the back to proceed to the last Facet.
c406bd23a6a97c22dcc8be3ddd5619798e2d898d.text: 該房間的環境影響僅限於整個區域的病房內部。戰鬥時盡量不要站在這些守衛中。水晶守護者守護著這裡的大廳，並帶著令人討厭的 電擊/餘震 組合。幸運的是，他們很少以正確的順序使用組合。 被遺忘者 奧術師通常會在側室中，在主走廊上攔截經過的玩家。擊敗後面的 元素之分身，前往最後一個 Facet。

699141e46246dfa218b46706a0d6ad685f38c5db.source: Every 25 seconds, all players are knocked down for 5 seconds. Skills such as "I Am Unstoppable!", "Don't Trip!", Ward of Stability, Balanced Stance and Dolyak Signet will prevent the knock down. Your foes are mostly Sword/Hammer pairs, although you may run into groups with a Crystal Spider and Crystal Guardian. Kill the Guardians first, as Aftershock is more likely to deal its extra damage while the healers are helpless on the ground; this is especially true in Hard Mode. Defeat the Facet of Strength to finally meet Glint.
699141e46246dfa218b46706a0d6ad685f38c5db.text: 每 25 秒，所有玩家都會被擊倒 5 秒。 “我勢不可擋！”、“別絆倒！”、穩定結界、平衡態勢 和 石犛牛紋章 等技能將防止被擊倒。你的敵人大多是 劍/鎚 對，儘管你可能會遇到 水晶蜘蛛 和 水晶守護者 的群體。首先殺死守護者，因為當治療者在地面上無能為力時，餘震 更有可能造成額外傷害；在困難模式下尤其如此。擊敗 力量之分身，最終見到 葛林特先知。

0c972d598c0a7d5255dc44d308daef00a74d3843.source: To gain the bonus you need to defeat Glint. Instead of using the portal opened during the cinematic, pick up one of her Dragon Eggs and she will turn hostile. This bonus is unique in that even if the entire party wipes while attempting it, they will still receive credit for the mission and continue to Droknar's Forge.
0c972d598c0a7d5255dc44d308daef00a74d3843.text: 要獲得獎勵，您需要擊敗 葛林特先知。不要使用電影中開啟的傳送門，而是拿起她的一顆龍蛋，她就會變得敵對。此獎勵的獨特之處在於，即使整個隊伍在嘗試時進行擦除，他們仍將獲得任務積分並繼續 卓克納熔爐。

5ff355865d0e58646c1f1e8034ae9cc40703c546.source: Since Glint is friendly until the eggs are touched, set up traps and spirits before she turns hostile.
5ff355865d0e58646c1f1e8034ae9cc40703c546.text: 由於 葛林特先知 在接觸蛋之前都是友好的，因此在她變得敵對之前請設定陷阱和靈魂。

746748dfb714ba62bfacf3e892cf31dbea48a52a.text: 葛林特先知 使用四種技能：

48873cf40f73a7e43a60667a0bf700e4ab69af46.source: Crystal Haze - An AoE hex that can render casters useless, spread before the battle. Revealed Hex/Inspired Hex are optimal counters as with all monster skill hexes, they are not replaced and recharge instantly. For those using henchmen/heroes, set the heroes to avoid combat and block healing skills for the duration of this dangerous hex.
48873cf40f73a7e43a60667a0bf700e4ab69af46.text: 水晶迷霧 - 可以讓腳輪變得無用的 範圍性 六角形，在戰鬥前傳播。 降咒顯露/降咒吸收 是與所有怪物技能六角形一樣的最佳計數器，它們不會被替換並立即充電。對於那些使用追隨者/英雄的人，請設定英雄在這個危險的六角形期間避免戰鬥並阻止治療技能。

e870e43558f8ab0dbd453474b3c49ac787dc8d3c.source: Jagged Crystal Skin - A stance that causes massive damage to melee attackers since it triggers on physical damage. Use elemental weapons, or skills that convert your damage types e.g.: Judge's Insight, Heart of Holy Flame and/or Greater Conflagration to negate its effects.
e870e43558f8ab0dbd453474b3c49ac787dc8d3c.text: 鋸齒水晶外皮 - 這種姿態會對近戰攻擊者造成巨大傷害，因為它會在物理傷害時觸發。使用元素武器或技能來轉換你的傷害型別，例如：神之洞察、聖火之心 和/或更大的 火靈 來抵消其效果。

706dca073c09dca0f667f8e34f8bf0802c7c870a.source: Crystal Bonds - A hex spell that removes and prevents enchantments to target but doesn't apply to self-enchantments (dervish) nor party wide spells e.g. Aegis. It only inhibits protection monks.
706dca073c09dca0f667f8e34f8bf0802c7c870a.text: 水晶債券 - 一種十六進製法術，可以消除並防止目標結界，但不適用於自我結界（托缽僧）或派對範圍的法術，例如神賜之盾。只抑制防護修士。

aceb4d9d5da8e58aa058c2f32165764c5673c27e.source: Crystal Hibernation - Used at half way through the battle. Grants her health regeneration and converts taken damage to heals. But takes five second to activate, leaving it vulnerable to interrupts.
aceb4d9d5da8e58aa058c2f32165764c5673c27e.text: 水晶冬眠 - 在戰鬥進行到一半時使用。使她恢復健康並將受到的傷害轉化為治療效果。但需要五秒鐘才能啟用，因此很容易受到中斷。

3c22f80fdb40df23f8c81bee2b01cb4611d911e0.source: If using henchmen/heroes, avoid melee characters since they tend to die very fast under the effects of Jagged Crystal Skin. Ranged attacks put less stress on your healers. Flag the non-melee away from the dragon to avoid Jagged Crystal Skin.
3c22f80fdb40df23f8c81bee2b01cb4611d911e0.text: 如果使用追隨者/英雄，請避免近戰角色，因為他們在 鋸齒水晶外皮 的影響下往往會很快死亡。 遠距 攻擊可以減輕治療者的壓力。將非近戰標記遠離龍以避免 鋸齒水晶外皮。

28e8faf9a3e4fedc6754ae9ad384a5a7421a1d5c.source: Party wide healing skills such as Heal Party, Protective Was Kaolai or Heaven's Delight.
28e8faf9a3e4fedc6754ae9ad384a5a7421a1d5c.text: 隊伍 廣泛的治療技能，例如 治癒隊伍、護衛者高萊 或 天堂喜悅。

24c04dcc5825c0874d5432d9e738170dba904750.source: Skill interrupts such as Cry of Frustration, Cry of Pain or Leech Signet.
24c04dcc5825c0874d5432d9e738170dba904750.text: 技能 中斷，例如 挫折哭喊、苦痛 或 搾取紋章 的 Cry。

5379e95f0a7284d536d86d49f44ad8a45c2ebb05.source: Stance removal. It is also useful versus the Facets of Nature and Strength as well as removing Jagged Crystal Skin on Glint.
5379e95f0a7284d536d86d49f44ad8a45c2ebb05.text: 態勢 刪除。它對於 Facets of Nature 和 力量 以及在 葛林特先知 上刪除 鋸齒水晶外皮 也很有用。

6aae38f92b4bcf54f3bc3811943f143efa5737b4.source: Spoil Victor - effective due to her high health.
6aae38f92b4bcf54f3bc3811943f143efa5737b4.text: 勝者的掠奪 - 由於她的健康狀況良好而有效。

e8299cd9095e23da42228a705c72b2ae36e2107d.source: Wastrel's Worry - effective because hexes expire twice as fast, leading to a very high damage rate.
e8299cd9095e23da42228a705c72b2ae36e2107d.text: 瓦思崔的憂慮 - 有效，因為六角形的失效速度是原來的兩倍，導致非常高的損壞率。

383eb21f606af703591995b4b1dbea37877e7390.source: Pain Inverter - particularly effective versus Jagged Crystal Skin. Also useful against Crystal Guardians due to their AoE damage.
383eb21f606af703591995b4b1dbea37877e7390.text: 苦痛 逆變器 - 與 鋸齒水晶外皮 相比特別有效。由於其 範圍性 傷害，也可用於對抗水晶守護者。

7fa2e4ae3631a65bbdba10512dc01b99e82e3bfc.source: Domain of Health Draining - While you are in this area you suffer from -3 Health degeneration.
7fa2e4ae3631a65bbdba10512dc01b99e82e3bfc.text: 體力 領域 排水 - 當您處於該區域時，您會遭受 -3 體力衰減效果 的困擾。

bd5159589b841bbb6e2ad201d480ee58ec9d3c14.source: As a result of the environmental effect healers will be constantly active, and group-healing spells such as Heal Party are helpful to combat the effect. Luckily, the foes you face in this room are not difficult. As with the desert missions, Forgotten Sages should be the priority target. You'll also fight Enchanted Sword and Hammer pairs. Typically, players follow the western edge of the room, sometimes avoiding a few foes. Try to kill off the groups before engaging the Facet of Light boss. It uses Shield of Regeneration and Guardian as its primary defense. Enchantment removal, knock down or simply overwhelming damage per second should kill it quickly, opening the portal to the next room. Before the slope down towards the Facet's chamber, there is a small area where the Domain of Health Draining does not work. This might be used to prepare and regenerate.
bd5159589b841bbb6e2ad201d480ee58ec9d3c14.text: 由於環境影響，治療者將持續活躍，而諸如 治癒隊伍 之類的團體治療法術有助於對抗這種影響。幸運的是，你在這個房間裡面對的敵人並不困難。與沙漠任務一樣，被遺忘者 Sages 應該是優先目標。您還將與 附魔長劍兵 和 鎚 對戰。通常，玩家會沿著房間的西邊移動，有時會避開一些敵人。在與 光之分身 首領交戰之前，試著消滅這些群體。它使用 回復之盾 和 守護者 作為其主要防禦。 加持魔法 移除、擊倒或只是每秒壓倒性的傷害應該會迅速殺死它，開啟通往下一個房間的傳送門。在朝向 Facet 室的斜坡之前，有一個小區域，體力 排水域不起作用。這可用於準備和再生。

e90802cc5ccf2fb8d3cf9abb99efb566297adcff.source: Domain of Slow - While you are in this area your movement is slowed.
e90802cc5ccf2fb8d3cf9abb99efb566297adcff.text: 緩慢領域 - 當您處於該區域時，您的移動速度會減慢。

acefae385e023a8d53812f7a35f59244de82f3e7.source: In this room, you'll fight numerous Enchanted Bows, many of which start up on ledges. However, a long/flatbow shot usually will cause them to run around to lower ground. Again, it is common for players to hug the left wall when going through this room to attempt to avoid a group or two. The Facet of Nature uses Melandru's Resilience, so either avoid using weak hexes/conditions or have a player prepared with a stance removing skill (which is useful to bring along for the bonus anyway).
acefae385e023a8d53812f7a35f59244de82f3e7.text: 在這個房間中，您將與眾多 附魔 弓戰鬥，其中許多弓是從壁架上開始的。然而，長弓/扁弓射擊通常會導致他們跑到較低的地面。同樣，玩家在穿過這個房間時通常會緊貼左牆以試圖避開一兩個人。 自然之分身 使用 梅蘭朵的元氣，因此要麼避免使用較弱的六角形/條件，要麼讓玩家準備好姿勢移除技能（無論如何，攜帶該技能對於獲得獎勵很有用）。

49f463262beccdd3eb9a40f1d04fc3e5596e2243.source: This room has no environmental effect. Instead, you'll fight swarms of Crystal Spiders, with Forgotten Illusionists backing them up. The spiders spam Shatter Enchantment and Hex Breaker, so be wary of hex and enchantment usage. Some of the Illusionists hide behind solid crystal walls that do not hinder their indirect spells, but which shield them from melee and projectile assault. As such, a few strong indirect spells of your own are useful here, but be sure to watch out for their Chaos Storm. It's worth taking the time to destroy them with spells before engaging new groups of spiders, because together these opponents can present a tough battle, especially in hard mode. The back of the room has a twisted path leading to the Facet of Chaos. Pairs of Illusionists will cast across the low walls of the path, but projectile attacks can reach them.
49f463262beccdd3eb9a40f1d04fc3e5596e2243.text: 該房間對環境沒有影響。相反，您將與成群的水晶蜘蛛作戰，並有 被遺忘者 幻術師作為後盾。蜘蛛會傳送 加持粉碎 和 破咒頌歌 垃圾郵件，因此請警惕十六進位和結界的使用。有些幻術師隱藏在堅固的水晶牆後面，這不會妨礙他們的間接法術，但可以保護他們免受近戰和投射物攻擊。因此，你自己的一些強大的間接咒語在這裡很有用，但一定要注意它們的 混沌風暴。在與新的蜘蛛群交戰之前，值得花時間用法術消滅它們，因為這些對手在一起可以帶來一場艱苦的戰鬥，尤其是在困難模式下。房間後面有一條蜿蜒的小路通往 渾沌之分身。成對的幻術師會穿過道路的矮牆施法，但投射物攻擊可以到達他們。

ded091c67a8e08253e018e11f9b2e1f2e53fbdcd.source: Domain of Energy Draining - While you are in this area you suffer from -1 Energy degeneration.
ded091c67a8e08253e018e11f9b2e1f2e53fbdcd.text: 能量 排水領域 - 當您處於該區域時，您會遭受 -1 能量 退化的困擾。

7fbcda7e1551fa0b2bc9f2e6a8157b7d138e1b23.source: In addition to the environmental effect, both allies and foes alike are kept enchanted under a low powered Death Nova that deals 26 damage and poisons for 15 seconds. The Rock-Eater Scarabs like to use Frenzy, and die easily because of it. If many die at once, the damage from the Death Novas can add up quickly. Also, Forgotten Cursebearers will use the corpses to heal, but they shouldn't pose much of a threat. Thanks to the constant Death Nova, minion armies can make this room very quick. The Facet of Darkness at the back is quite easy.
7fbcda7e1551fa0b2bc9f2e6a8157b7d138e1b23.text: 除了環境效果之外，盟友和敵人都在低功率 死亡新星 的作用下保持著魔狀態，造成 26 傷害和毒藥，持續 15 秒。食巖聖甲蟲喜歡使用 狂暴，而且很容易因此而死亡。如果許多人同時死亡，死亡新星造成的傷害會迅速增加。此外，被遺忘者 詛咒者會使用屍體進行治療，但它們不會構成太大的威脅。多虧了不斷的死亡新星，小兵軍隊可以很快地佔領這個房間。後面的 黑暗之分身 非常簡單。

de6899fe22f5e2ca2614e755eb36ad4b740654bc.source: Domain of Elements - While you are in this area you are the target of chaotic natural forces, specifically environmental versions of Fire Storm, Maelstrom, Chain Lightning and Eruption
de6899fe22f5e2ca2614e755eb36ad4b740654bc.text: 元素領域 - 當您處於該區域時，您將成為混亂自然力量的目標，特別是 火焰風暴、水漩渦、連鎖閃電 和 火山爆發 的環境版本

45729b61203bc7e94905accafedf42ea6aab2f6e.source: Hex removal such as Inspired Hex or Revealed Hex to counter Crystal Haze. The overcast this hex causes will quickly shut down spellcasters if it is not removed.
45729b61203bc7e94905accafedf42ea6aab2f6e.text: 十六進位刪除，例如 降咒吸收 或 降咒顯露 以對抗 水晶迷霧。如果不將其移除，該巫術造成的陰霾將很快使施法者停止活動。

c2dd5f355725232d5dcf9f2416bcc54ab4dc8f8d.source: Two of the Facets have elite skills that cannot be captured anywhere else in Prophecies: Gladiator's Defense and Shield of Regeneration.
c2dd5f355725232d5dcf9f2416bcc54ab4dc8f8d.text: 其中兩個 Facet 擁有 阿斯卡隆戰記 中其他任何地方無法獲得的精英技能：鬥士防禦態勢 和 回復之盾。

b0b5ae8fc5786d3741d69e2ef72ffe8d79e51f0c.source: After killing each Facet, a player must cross a portal-like gate that triggers a cinematic. When it concludes, party members are teleported to another enclosed domain within the area, leaving behind miniatures, spirits, allies from summoning stones, and Heroes of players that have left the area or disconnected. Minions are brought along with the party however.
b0b5ae8fc5786d3741d69e2ef72ffe8d79e51f0c.text: 殺死每個 Facet 後，玩家必須穿過一個類似傳送門的大門，從而觸發過場動畫。當它結束時，隊伍成員會被傳送到該區域內的另一個封閉區域，留下模型、靈魂、召喚石的盟友以及離開該區域或斷開連線的玩家的英雄。然而，小小兵是隨隊伍一起來的。

1d94a65152fef1d28cf406123404830ed01dee9c.source: This mission will be completed after reaching Glint. A final portal will appear, and going through it will take the entire party to Droknar's Forge. Make sure you warn other party members not to cross that portal, if you want to attempt the bonus objective.
1d94a65152fef1d28cf406123404830ed01dee9c.text: 該任務將在到達 葛林特先知 後完成。最終的傳送門將會出現，透過它，整個團隊將到達 卓克納熔爐。如果您想嘗試獎勵目標，請確保警告其他黨員不要穿過該門戶。

32b62d90170ea135c637b82faabafeaa2954a0e3.source: Looking up in the sky towards the center of the area, players will see a crystal pillar with 6 crystal rings around it. They show the progress in the area by changing from crystal rings to rings of light.
32b62d90170ea135c637b82faabafeaa2954a0e3.text: 抬頭望向區域中心的天空，玩家會看到一根水晶柱，周圍有 6 水晶環。他們透過從水晶環變為光環來展示該領域的進展。

fb7990f7ce29910459c2b03f37d48499f11c754a.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #12 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
fb7990f7ce29910459c2b03f37d48499f11c754a.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#12 頁。

c1e27844fe068cafd9186068e04b1e24a4fe747a.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Shadow's Passage.
c1e27844fe068cafd9186068e04b1e24a4fe747a.text: 在 陰暗通道 中擊敗受影響者。

34dd25131622a93c7b3de3a613c7a25b31561943.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Shadow's Passage, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
34dd25131622a93c7b3de3a613c7a25b31561943.text: 完成此任務會改變 陰暗通道 中出現的敵人，具體來說，受苦者將不再生成。

8d8f8078ebec45b9fd57c2170ae81a0762dd1199.source: Start from Dragon's Throat and follow the quest markers and eliminate three groups of Afflicted. Just before the third, a small group of Jade Brotherhood will pop up; they are hostile to the Afflicted, so if you maneuver carefully, they can do some of your work for you.
8d8f8078ebec45b9fd57c2170ae81a0762dd1199.text: 從 龍喉 (挑戰任務) 開始，依照任務標記消滅三組受折磨者。就在第三個之前，一小群 翡翠兄弟會 會彈出；他們對受苦者懷有敵意，所以如果你小心操作，他們可以為你做一些工作。

afe3a6d8c2d0afb403740e64bd3af7865c1100c0.source: Pogahn Passage or Rilohn Refuge mission completed
afe3a6d8c2d0afb403740e64bd3af7865c1100c0.text: 波甘驛站 或 Rilohn 避難所任務已完成

505542d293fc0709308c728c7a76d50adcfcb484.source: Travel through the Bahdok Caverns to escape to Vabbi.
505542d293fc0709308c728c7a76d50adcfcb484.text: 穿過 巴多克洞穴 逃往 瓦貝。

91984344fc3b4bc2ca6cea43a9c55e12b7946384.source: ADDED: Defeat Bayel and the Hunger to open the passage to Vabbi.
91984344fc3b4bc2ca6cea43a9c55e12b7946384.text: 新增：擊敗巴耶爾和飢餓以開啟通往 瓦貝 的通道。

96503190ee0eb60a79bc92d0c7a5855ca85fb1d3.text: *額外獎勵* 遵循 Dunkoro 的其餘建議。

4e118ec4423c0612d469ac45e37090e5378740bb.source: You have followed [0...4] of Dunkoro's 4 remaining suggestions.
4e118ec4423c0612d469ac45e37090e5378740bb.text: 您已遵循 Dunkoro 的 4 剩餘建議中的 [0...4]。

38aaec79a6ae5e251ad93adcb0b6205bad13a124.text: 黑暗逆襲 Sunspear 幫浦已關閉 2 - 5   1   0   2 - 5   1   0   20   20   20   70   70   70

f15e83ea4bf6fc570c13618cc829e6703e45e31c.source: At the beginning of the mission you follow Dehjah as she leads the way to an entrance of the waterworks. She seems to be in a hurry to get rid of the Drought, as she tends to run ahead as soon as each group of enemies is eliminated. Be very careful as she turns left off the land to head to the fort as you can be detained by the group of Kournans whom she will often not aggro. This almost always results in her being killed by the Steelfang Drakes. She will be overwhelmed if you don't keep up, so stick with her. Do not waste any time looting after each encounter as she will not wait. If she dies the mission is over.
f15e83ea4bf6fc570c13618cc829e6703e45e31c.text: 在任務開始時，你跟著 Dehjah，她帶路前往自來水廠的入口。她似乎急於擺脫乾旱，每當敵人被消滅後，她就會跑到前面。當她左轉離開陸地前往堡壘時要非常小心，因為你可能會被一群庫南人拘留，而她通常不會激怒他們。這幾乎總是導致她被鋼牙龍殺死。如果你不跟上，她會不知所措，所以堅持下去。每次遭遇後不要浪費時間搶劫，因為她不會等待。如果她死了，任務就結束了。

4b4a857efd7b8b926e341d8d56b17b7efb70383d.source: Dehjah is the only one who can open the gates to the waterworks. If you miss this by chance, by straying off fighting, you'll be frustrated when you get back to the main gate and it remains locked (even if Dehjah is still alive). If you miss her opening the door just resign and start over because you cannot get in.
4b4a857efd7b8b926e341d8d56b17b7efb70383d.text: Dehjah 是唯一能夠開啟自來水廠大門的人。如果你偶然錯過了這一點，因為偏離了戰鬥，當你回到大門並且門仍然鎖著時你會感到沮喪（即使德賈還活著）。如果你錯過了她開門的機會，那就辭職重新開始吧，因為你進不去。

bba7da827fe054d995420ccdf033e5c7ec5ab9b6.source: Dehjah leaves you at the entrance to the waterworks. There is an environmental effect in this area, Thirst of the Drought, which increases the damage you take from earth damage by 50%. This can make fighting Droughtlings more annoying, but really becomes a problem against the Drought itself who is an elementalist boss specializing in Earth Magic. You can get rid of this effect by turning off each of the pumps in the waterworks, of which there are 5 in total. Each pump gives a 2% morale boost and reduces the environmental effect by 10% until there is no effect at all; however, turning off a pump will cause your party to not gain the Master's Reward.
bba7da827fe054d995420ccdf033e5c7ec5ab9b6.text: Dehjah 將您留在自來水廠入口處。該區域有一種環境效應，即乾旱之渴，它會增加 50% 對地球造成的傷害。這可能會讓與乾旱生物的戰鬥變得更加煩人，但對抗乾旱本身確實會成為一個問題，因為乾旱是專門從事 地系魔法 的元素主義 Boss。您可以透過關閉自來水廠中的每個水泵（總共有 5）來消除這種影響。每個幫浦都會為 2% 帶來士氣提升，並透過 10% 減少對環境的影響，直到完全沒有影響；但是，關閉幫浦將導致您的隊伍無法獲得大師的 任務獎勵。

90e6c1c549c53de983633d70c3e0588992f4ef86.source: Travel to each pump indicated by the flags on the area map, killing anything which gets in your way. Switch off as many pumps as you feel is necessary as you make your way inwards to the Drought.
90e6c1c549c53de983633d70c3e0588992f4ef86.text: 前往區域地圖上旗幟指示的每個泵，殺死任何擋道的東西。當您進入乾旱地區時，請關閉您認為有必要的盡可能多的泵浦。

1d714cee35b57f3f2beec78b9dcb1b2b2480593a.source: The Drought is accompanied by two Droughtlings and there are several more groups of Droughtlings in the area. Take care of any Droughtling groups you think will get in the way first. Then utilize the skills recommended below when you take on the Drought and stay spread out watching for Sandstorm. Kill the Drought and the Droughtlings in its group to finish the mission.
1d714cee35b57f3f2beec78b9dcb1b2b2480593a.text: 乾旱伴隨著兩群乾旱，並且該地區還有幾群乾旱。先處理掉任何你認為會妨礙的乾旱群體。然後，當您應對乾旱時，請利用下面推薦的技能，並分散注意 沙塵暴。殺死乾旱和其群體中的乾旱幼蟲以完成任務。

c8db9926c6086727aa6450fb1926364775eac655.source: This is one of the few missions where you must do less, rather than more, to achieve the bonus. Take the most direct route, forgetting the water pumps, and head straight to the Drought. Make sure that you can handle its increased damage output; preprotting, interrupting and/or dazing are all recommended.
c8db9926c6086727aa6450fb1926364775eac655.text: 這是為數不多的任務之一，您必須少做而不是多做才能獲得獎勵。走最直接的路線，忘記水泵，直奔乾旱之地。確保你能夠承受其增加的傷害輸出；建議預先保護、打斷和/或眩暈。

613046f679b18ec6022dcb8bc0d66cc134b989cd.source: If you choose to ignore Dunkoro, the mission is pretty straight-forward. From the area where you kill the ambushing Corsairs there are two exits which head to the north. Head up the one which will take you west, you'll meet a group of Corsairs coming down. Follow the river here until you get to an open area and follow the wall running perpendicular to the river, that is, turn right. After following this you'll come to another exit to the right. Walk into this area. You should see two Corsair Runners. Head up to where they are and follow the runner which goes straight north - the one that doesn't run through the insects. Additional Corsairs will arrive. Continue the way the Corsair was running after finishing this group and follow the path as it goes downwards.
613046f679b18ec6022dcb8bc0d66cc134b989cd.text: 如果你選擇忽略鄧科羅，任務就非常簡單。從你殺死伏擊的海盜的區域有兩個通往北方的出口。前往將帶您向西的那條船，您會遇到一群海盜正在降落。沿著這裡的河流，直到到達一片空曠的地方，沿著垂直於河流的牆走，即右轉。沿著這條路走後，您將到達右側的另一個出口。走進這個區域。您應該會看到兩位 海盜 跑者。前往它們所在的地方，跟隨直接向北的跑步者——不會穿過昆蟲的跑步者。更多海盜將會抵達。完成該組後，繼續 海盜 的執行方式，並沿著其向下的路徑進行操作。

54131aa5a2ed1394337228bb4ba1a24af3ec2dda.source: You will come to where the Kournan forces are. General Bayel and the Hunger are on the other side of a narrow bridge which is well protected by several Kournan Bowman with an excellent height advantage and are difficult for melee party members to get to. Rather than trying to eliminate the Kournan Bowmen from the bridge, run right under the bridge and use it to shelter the party from the bow attacks. You can now either use non-projectile skills to kill the Kournan Bowmen or ignore them and make sure that any melee party members are protected while they attack in the open. The simplest option is to stay under the bridge with the Kournan Bowmen above you and hence obstructed. It is possible to aggro only General Bayel from a set position under the bridge. It will take some time, but if you're not too focused on melee damage, you should be able to take him out and safely pull the Hunger towards you. Kill both General Bayel and then the Hunger to end the mission. Alternatively if you run across the second bridge, past both General Bayel and the Hunger, the Hunger will follow your party to almost across the bridge. Attack him near the end of the second bridge and you will be fighting him alone. If he starts to almost die, he will try to go back to General Bayel. If you cripple him, you should be able to kill him before the General has the chance to heal him.
54131aa5a2ed1394337228bb4ba1a24af3ec2dda.text: 你會來到庫南部隊所在的地方。巴耶爾將軍和飢餓者在一座窄橋的另一邊，橋上有幾名庫南弓箭手保護得很好，具有極好的高度優勢，近戰黨員很難到達。不要試圖從橋上消滅庫南弓箭手，而是直接跑到橋下並用它來保護隊伍免受弓箭攻擊。現在，您可以使用非投射技能殺死庫南弓箭手，也可以忽略他們並確保任何近戰隊員在公開攻擊時受到保護。最簡單的選擇是呆在橋下，庫南弓箭手在你上方，因此受到阻礙。可以從橋下的固定位置僅攻擊巴耶爾將軍。這需要一些時間，但如果你不太關注近戰傷害，你應該能夠幹掉他並安全地將飢餓拉向你。殺死巴耶爾將軍和飢餓來結束任務。或者，如果你跑過第二座橋，經過巴耶爾將軍和飢餓，飢餓將跟隨你的隊伍幾乎穿過橋。在第二座橋的盡頭攻擊他，你將獨自對抗他。如果他快要死了，他會嘗試回到巴耶爾將軍身邊。如果你削弱了他，你應該能夠在將軍有機會治癒他之前殺死他。

f8a1cd978da6ce32795b77bf2321eda985ab73c5.source: The bonus is to follow the advice that Dunkoro offers at various points through the mission. There are 4 suggestions, the notification of which sometimes comes quite late and the update of the success of the objective is sometimes a long way after you followed the suggestion.
f8a1cd978da6ce32795b77bf2321eda985ab73c5.text: 好處是遵循 Dunkoro 在任務中各個階段提供的建議。有 4 建議，其通知有時會很晚，並且目標成功的更新有時會在您遵循建議之後很長一段時間。

ead15ab174b40db67a35a482e3581ac50a667b57.source: Head towards (1) on the map and you will see a path leading up with Mandragors patrolling down. After reaching the path Dunkoro will suggest you go to the western exit. Do not walk on the path at all as this can mean the failure of the objective, this applies to minions, heroes and henchmen. If the Mandragors are patrolling down when you reach the path, wait for them to make it to the water before engaging them to ensure safety of this bonus. The success of this suggestion is often confirmed when you reach the waterfall. You do not have to actually hear this suggestion to get credit for it, so feel free to simply head past the waterfall to begin with; however, if the suggestion does not update, you may have to go back over to the path to get Dunkoro to suggest anyway, just flag your party under the waterfall and go and get the suggestion yourself to risk no mistakes.
ead15ab174b40db67a35a482e3581ac50a667b57.text: 朝地圖上的 (1) 方向前進，您將看到一條通往上方的道路，曼陀羅正在下方巡邏。到達小徑後，Dunkoro 會建議您前往西出口。根本不要走在這條路上，因為這可能意味著目標的失敗，這適用於小兵、英雄和追隨者。如果當你到達路徑時曼陀羅正在巡邏，請等待它們到達水中後再與它們交戰，以確保此獎勵的安全。當你到達瀑布時，往往會證實這個建議的成功。您不必真正聽到這個建議才能獲得認可，所以請隨意簡單地從瀑布開始；然而，如果建議沒有更新，你可能必須返回到讓 Dunkoro 提出建議的路徑，只需在瀑布下標記你的隊伍，然後自己去獲取建議，以免出錯。

ca0124fc353c223ee4f0982f2db6b84f5847ad54.source: As you pass the waterfall and head up the western entrance, Corsairs at the top of the hill will begin patrolling toward you. Part way up the slope, Dunkoro will suggest you hide your presence from this group by falling back to the spot near the waterfall. It is best actually not to wait for this suggestion, because it can put you in an awkward situation. Kill Mandragor groups at the bottom of the waterfall before approaching the path. Station your party at the bottom of the waterfall and send one member on the path. As soon as this party member starts on the path, the Corsairs will start toward you, so you can move back to a safe distance without risking walking up the path.
ca0124fc353c223ee4f0982f2db6b84f5847ad54.text: 當您經過瀑布並前往西入口時，山頂的海盜將開始向您巡邏。在爬上斜坡的途中，鄧科羅會建議你退回到瀑布附近的地方，以躲避這群人。實際上最好不要等待這個建議，因為它會讓你陷入尷尬的境地。在接近小路之前，先殺死瀑布底部的曼德拉戈群體。將你的隊伍駐紮在瀑布底部，並派一名成員走在路上。一旦隊員開始走上這條路，海盜就會開始向你駛來，這樣你就可以回到安全距離，而不必冒險走上這條路。

32aba4f3ff1761d197f5587573f7216a11c23fbe.source: The Corsairs will continue patrolling north and east. Sneak back unnoticed onto the western path to get credit for the suggestion. Keep in mind you will only be notified of your success after you complete the third suggestion. Also, if henchmen and heroes are caught by the Corsairs you won't be able to obtain this objective. When running back to the path, with only henchmen and heroes, disable any spirits and flag them to the top of the path so they won't stop with the Toxicity spirit in aggro range - they may attack it. If there are minions in your party, wait for the spirit to expire and die before starting suggestion two.
32aba4f3ff1761d197f5587573f7216a11c23fbe.text: 海盜船將繼續在北部和東部巡邏。不被注意地偷偷溜回西邊的小路上，以獲得建議的榮譽。請記住，只有在完成第三個建議後，您才會收到成功通知。此外，如果追隨者和英雄被海盜抓住，你將無法實現此目標。當跑迴路上時，只有追隨者和英雄，停用任何靈魂並將它們標記到路徑的頂部，這樣它們就不會因為 毒性 靈魂在仇恨範圍內而停止 - 他們可能會攻擊它。如果你的隊伍中有小兵，請等待靈魂耗盡並死亡後再開始建議二。

2f54ca74d933c34f5312b381fca50d5e35bcef7a.source: It should be noted that attacking the Spirit of Toxicity, and subsequently aggroing the group of Corsairs does not fail this second suggestion, if they are aggroed after they reach the water. In Hard mode, it is often impossible not to aggro this spirit, especially with minions. Because you do not get credit for this achievement for a little while, it is easy to assume failure, when the party has not actually failed.
2f54ca74d933c34f5312b381fca50d5e35bcef7a.text: 應該注意的是，攻擊 毒性 的靈魂，然後攻擊這群海盜並不會失敗第二個建議，如果他們在到達水後被攻擊的話。在 困難模式 中，通常不可能不激怒這種精神，尤其是對小兵來說。因為你暫時不會因為這項成就而獲得榮譽，所以當一方實際上並沒有失敗時，很容易假設失敗。

fca87f7ff2e40813bf09ac7da9ec4dd8cdf34384.source: Dunkoro suggests you follow the eastern wall to keep away from the Corsair camps. As this is the most efficient route through, this shouldn't be a problem. You will receive credit for this suggestion (along with credit for the previous one) when you reach the area where the next one is triggered. Do not continue following the eastern wall past the point where you need to pursue the runners or you will fail the bonus.
fca87f7ff2e40813bf09ac7da9ec4dd8cdf34384.text: Dunkoro 建議您沿著東牆走，遠離 海盜 營地。由於這是最有效的路線，因此這應該不成問題。當您到達觸發下一個建議的區域時，您將獲得此建議的積分（以及上一個建議的積分）。不要繼續沿著東牆越過你需要追趕跑者的點，否則你將無法獲得獎勵。

68f76e6d8e6c132581f787f150f547f6d86bee81.source: The last suggestion is the most difficult to complete. Dunkoro suggests that you stop the Corsair Runners from warning the Corsairs that you are coming. There are two Corsair Runners and true to their name, once you get close enough they run... in different directions. The fourth suggestion has a short delay before triggering - it follows the notification that you have completed the previous three. Don't wait for this, because by this time the Corsairs will be already on the move.
68f76e6d8e6c132581f787f150f547f6d86bee81.text: 最後一個建議是最難完成的。 Dunkoro 建議你阻止 海盜 跑者警告海盜你即將到來。有兩位 海盜 跑者，正如他們的名字一樣，一旦你夠接近，他們就會跑向不同的方向。第四個建議在觸發前有短暫的延遲 - 它遵循您已完成前三個建議的通知。不要等這個，因為這個時候海盜們已經開始行動了。

9da5fd14518590e9fae76a8ad32b051d6648b5b9.source: If possible split and take on both runners at once. Use snares and speed boosts to make sure you can kill them before they reach their destination. By inflicting conditions on the Corsair Runners, you can cause them to stop running for a moment to activate Antidote Signet.
9da5fd14518590e9fae76a8ad32b051d6648b5b9.text: 如果可能的話，分開並同時與兩名參賽者較量。使用陷阱和速度提升來確保你可以在他們到達目的地之前殺死他們。透過對 海盜 跑者施加條件，您可以使其停止執行一段時間以啟動 解毒紋章。

47eb60d04aafb75841de217d35ca801fe5eb7df9.source: The runners take a few seconds to start moving which you could use to your advantage. If you are playing with heroes, lock them on the runner which is closest to you before you reach the open area where they stand. Then proceed forward to attack the other one, starting with a snare. The heroes will probably kill the first runner even before it has a chance to start moving. The henchmen will follow you and help you kill the one you snared.
47eb60d04aafb75841de217d35ca801fe5eb7df9.text: 跑步者需要幾秒鐘的時間才能開始移動，您可以利用這一點來發揮自己的優勢。如果您正在與英雄一起玩，請在到達他們所在的開放區域之前將他們鎖定在您最近的跑步者身上。然後繼續向前攻擊另一隻，從陷阱開始。英雄們可能會在第一個奔跑者有機會開始移動之前就殺死它。追隨者會跟隨你並幫助你殺死你捕獲的人。

844b1292bfa455a52550526f6243a8c9fd485380.source: Once the last suggestion is completed continue on and finish the mission.
844b1292bfa455a52550526f6243a8c9fd485380.text: 一旦最後的建議完成，繼續並完成任務。

2ce476bc80dba4ac7df3abe11d14cbc6146f9c4e.source: At the start of the mission you are blocked in by some Corsairs, who claim to be your guides.
