Eventually their leader, Captain Bohseda, gets a quest marker and you can talk to him. You have two options, either to trust him or to not trust him. If you trust him, he will lead you up the corridor then he and the rest of the Corsairs will turn on the party and you will be ambushed by more Corsairs. If you don't trust him, he and the rest of the Corsairs turn hostile straight away and you can fight them and the ambushing group of Corsairs separately. Otherwise the choice has no impact on the rest of the mission or the bonus.
2ce476bc80dba4ac7df3abe11d14cbc6146f9c4e.text: 在任務開始時，你會被一些自稱是你的嚮導的海盜攔住。最終，他們的領袖博赫塞達隊長獲得了一個任務標記，你可以與他交談。你有兩個選擇，要嘛信任他，要嘛不信任他。如果你信任他，他會帶領你穿過走廊，然後他和其他海盜將攻擊隊伍，你將遭到更多海盜的伏擊。如果你不信任他，他和其他海盜會立即轉為敵對，你可以分別與他們和伏擊的海盜團戰鬥。否則，該選擇不會影響任務的其餘部分或獎金。

b12265962a2b51b3fb40aa3fff86b03e8bdcef56.source: The above tactics work just as well in Hard mode as in normal. The runners at suggestion 4 are tougher due to them running faster, and more powerful snares such as Mind Freeze may be needed in addition to other snares. In addition, the Kournan Bowmen at the end of the mission may be difficult to fight because of their increased damage output. The tactic of sheltering under the bridge is recommended.
b12265962a2b51b3fb40aa3fff86b03e8bdcef56.text: 上述策略在 困難模式 中與正常情況下一樣有效。建議 4 中的跑者因為跑得更快而更強硬，除了其他小鼓之外，可能還需要更強大的軍鼓，例如 心靈凍結。此外，任務結束時的庫南弓箭手可能會因為傷害輸出增加而難以戰鬥。建議採用橋下躲避的策略。

698e0883ba83071728f710153b4eaa0dd36ed9b5.source: Alternatively, if using heroes and/or henchmen, flag them directly under the bridge. The bridge will obstruct the Kournan Bowmen while allowing you to attack the Hunger.
698e0883ba83071728f710153b4eaa0dd36ed9b5.text: 或者，如果使用英雄和/或追隨者，請將他們直接標記在橋下。這座橋會阻礙庫南弓箭手，同時讓你攻擊飢餓。

11028950dd48f3411bb9a19fc5cd38b72cccc608.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in the Undercity, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
11028950dd48f3411bb9a19fc5cd38b72cccc608.text: 完成此任務會改變出現在幽暗城中的敵人，特別是，受苦者將不再生成。

1c8dab1d2b48c88d43d3dcf13421aa3bcdba7c25.source: If you have access to Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) you can begin this quest from there and head directly to the Undercity. If you don't have access to Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), then start in the Marketplace, exit to either Bukdek Byway or Wajjun Bazaar, and enter the Undercity from there.
1c8dab1d2b48c88d43d3dcf13421aa3bcdba7c25.text: 如果您有權訪問 薇茹廣場（本地區），您可以從那裡開始此任務並直接前往幽暗城。如果您無權訪問 薇茹廣場（本地街區），請從市場開始，退出到 巴德克小徑 或 瓦江市場，然後從那裡進入幽暗城。

2d501be21ea104b2c71c7885fee64b889c011c9f.source: Once in the Undercity, just follow the quest markers to eliminate the five groups of Afflicted. The Am Fah shouldn't be a challenge and are hostile to the Afflicted; take advantage of this. If patient, the Kappa will be eliminated, reducing needless distractions to your heroes, minions, etc. For two of the final three groups, you can make use of the Am Fah to weaken the Afflicted.
2d501be21ea104b2c71c7885fee64b889c011c9f.text: 進入幽暗城後，只需依照任務標記即可消滅五組受折磨者。 安費 不應該是一個挑戰，也不應該對受災者懷有敵意；利用這一點。如果有耐心，河童將會被消滅，減少對你的英雄、小兵等的不必要的幹擾。對於最後三組中的兩組，你可以利用 安費 來削弱受影響者。

0838d67c44db7b84da4297b58261bc7de9ebaaec.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Talus Chute and start the mission.
0838d67c44db7b84da4297b58261bc7de9ebaaec.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 碎石坡道 走進前哨站並開始任務。

8a8b79be283d3e85834a85f1cb9c5b3e702810aa.text: 救援 伊凡妮雅 月經缺失

15165545af3da2d59fd9980c64d6a20a9d27ef8f.source: Find a way into the holding area.
15165545af3da2d59fd9980c64d6a20a9d27ef8f.text: 找到進入等待區域的方法。

ee2faba72e40d8d1e94d9e5aeef71add911783ac.source: Break Evennia out of her cell.
ee2faba72e40d8d1e94d9e5aeef71add911783ac.text: 將 伊凡妮雅 逐出牢房。

69d8b4ccc0c3372f77479c08ac8f05d005f5b7e7.source: Escape with Evennia to the awaiting ice ship.
69d8b4ccc0c3372f77479c08ac8f05d005f5b7e7.text: 脫逃 和 伊凡妮雅 前往等待的冰船。

482688e79d866b86220792259a080f6c21f6ed90.source: *BONUS* Return news of Rornak Stonesledge to Hamdor Grandaxe.
482688e79d866b86220792259a080f6c21f6ed90.text: *獎勵* 影返 洛奈科斯通萊基 給 Hamdor Grandaxe 的訊息。

3961bebba874a795cf30bc7a2a6ca5ccf0476e3b.source: The goal of this mission is to rescue Evennia by fighting your way through Stone Summit, White Mantle, and Mursaat forces. Players will encounter the Mursaat and their Jade constructs for the first time here. These creatures use a skill called Spectral Agony which causes massive damage. Their threat can be countered by infusing a character's armor, a feature that becomes available later. In the meantime, use a tank to draw all their attacks away from the rest of the team. Better yet, they all can be avoided excepting one group when doing the bonus.
3961bebba874a795cf30bc7a2a6ca5ccf0476e3b.text: 此任務的目標是透過與 石峰矮人、白斗篷 和 馬賽特 部隊的戰鬥來營救 伊凡妮雅。玩家將在這裡第一次遇到 馬賽特 和他們的 Jade 構造。這些生物使用一種名為「幽靈痛苦」的技能，會造成巨大傷害。他們的威脅可以透過注入角色的盔甲來應對，這項功能稍後會提供。同時，使用坦克將他們的所有攻擊從團隊其他成員身上轉移開。更好的是，除了一組在獲得獎金時外，所有這些都可以避免。

8f1ddb756a787a631671d246bb8c8a44fd02f1a7.source: At the beginning, you will be under siege from the Stone Summit's catapults. The first two are firing from a frozen river. Killing their Engineer will stop their attacks and provide a Morale Boost. Using the firing lever of the second catapult will then trigger an optional cinematic, provoking a Dolyak stampede that destroys the White Mantle's ballistae and kills all of the enemies gathered around them on the other side of the bridge.
8f1ddb756a787a631671d246bb8c8a44fd02f1a7.text: 一開始，你會受到 石峰矮人 彈射器的圍攻。前兩發是從結冰的河流中發射的。殺死他們的工程師將阻止他們的攻擊並提供士氣提升。然後使用第二個彈射器的發射桿將觸發一個可選的過場動畫，引發多利亞克踩踏，摧毀 白斗篷 的弩砲並殺死橋另一側聚集在他們周圍的所有敵人。

66096087c4b1e0215a68a9eae4ac01c443e9b82a.source: Head north, and you will find a closed gate that can be destroyed by dropping a powder keg from the Dwarven Powder Keg Station, clearing a way to the caves. There are four exits: west, south-west, south-east, and east. The second one takes you to the bonus, while the last two continue the mission. Once out of the caves, you will find an open area with Mursaat Elementalists patrolling. The cell holding Evennia and Saidra is located south of this place, with another keg station nearby. Clear the area of hostiles or bypass most of them through a cave on your left, and use another keg to free the Shining Blade allies. Saidra will sacrifice herself to allow the party escape with Evennia. Evennia must survive the rest of the mission. Take another powder keg to destroy the gate and escape to a short cave that leads to the frozen lake.
66096087c4b1e0215a68a9eae4ac01c443e9b82a.text: 向北走，你會發現一扇關閉的大門，可以通過從矮人火藥桶站扔下一個火藥桶來摧毀它，從而清理出一條通往洞穴的道路。有四個出口：西、西南、東南、東。第二個將帶您獲得獎金，而最後兩個則繼續任務。走出洞穴後，您會發現一片空地，有 馬賽特 元素師在巡邏。 伊凡妮雅 和 Saidra 所在的牢房位於該地點的南部，附近還有另一個桶站。清除區域內的敵人，或透過左側的洞穴繞過大部分敵人，然後使用另一個桶子來釋放 光刃公會 盟友。 Saidra 將犧牲自己來讓 伊凡妮雅 隊伍逃脫。 伊凡妮雅 必須在剩下的任務中存活下來。拿另一個火藥桶摧毀大門，然後逃到一個通往冰凍湖的矮洞裡。

35e16d52debed846cd985159c20397ad38bca48e.source: Once you leave the cave, two large groups of Mursaat Elementalists will start to move towards you together with the intent of chasing you along the winding path across the lake. They move slowly, but you will be hindered along the way by groups of Stone Summit and White Mantle. It is not recommended that you fight the Mursaat, as there are 12 of them and they are powerful spikers even without Spectral Agony. Furthermore, Evennia is not infused, and her death will result in mission failure.
35e16d52debed846cd985159c20397ad38bca48e.text: 一旦你離開洞穴，兩大群馬賽特元素師就會開始向你靠近，意圖沿著湖畔蜿蜒的小路追趕你。他們移動緩慢，但一路上您會受到 石峰矮人 和 白斗篷 群體的阻礙。不建議您與 馬賽特 戰鬥，因為它們還有 12，即使沒有光譜痛苦，它們也是強大的尖峰。此外，伊凡妮雅沒有被注入，她的死亡將導致任務失敗。

0d14564579330a6863d2e544e4a4881f2c87d8fb.source: Leave from either Maatu Keep or Sunjiang District (outpost) and follow the starburst towards the center of the map (north from Maatu, west from Sunjiang). Choosing Maatu Keep will mean that you will end up fighting Rai Zhon the Manipulator, whilst the selection of Sunjiang District means that you will fight 3 mobs instead of 2 en route to the quest marker, but don't have to face any bosses provided that you hug the wall when passing by Xi Lin of the Flames.
0d14564579330a6863d2e544e4a4881f2c87d8fb.text: 從 麻都堡壘 或 孫江行政區（前哨站）出發，沿著星暴走向地圖中心（馬圖以北，孫江以西）。選擇麻都堡壘意味著你最終將與操縱者Rai Zhon戰鬥，而選擇孫江行政區意味著你將在前往任務標記的途中與3小怪戰鬥，而不是2，但只要你在經過烈焰的西林時緊貼牆壁，就不必面對任何Boss。

6fb62898f7e479bec4a105fdb867ca85fcd41e64.source: At the starburst you will meet the five Initiates and the dialogue will begin. After the first bit of dialogue, groups of Afflicted will head towards where the starbust now is - within the middle of sewage water, just north of the initiates. From here you can take multiple actions:
6fb62898f7e479bec4a105fdb867ca85fcd41e64.text: 在星爆時，您將遇到五位入門者，對話將開始。在第一段對話之後，一群受折磨的人將前往現在星象所在的地方——汙水中間，就在起始者的北邊。從這裡您可以執行多項操作：

ec2f8ed54ae0f0707dafa377fe99dcef7e6b2d14.source: Head west to where the first group will come from and kill the groups from this area first. From here, they will come one right after the other from two directions and it is easy to avoid half of the mobs. After killing the waves that come from the west, you can head back to the center and pull those that remain away.
ec2f8ed54ae0f0707dafa377fe99dcef7e6b2d14.text: 向西前往第一支隊伍的來源地並首先殺死來自該地區的隊伍。從這裡開始，他們會從兩個方向一前一後而來，很容易就能避開一半的小怪。在消滅了來自西方的海浪後，你可以回到中心並把剩下的海浪拉開。

4545db6eb654867475bfa7e10a712c17d32451f9.source: You can retreat to the way you came from and deal with fewer groups and more pulling up a closer ramp, allowing better ranged damage. After four or so groups approach down the other ramps, a group will turn up behind you.
4545db6eb654867475bfa7e10a712c17d32451f9.text: 你可以退回原來的路，對付更少的隊伍和更多的人，拉上更近的坡道，允許更大的範圍傷害。當大約四組人走下其他坡道後，一組人會出現在您身後。

427d32169eb05752d9e752fab938f5f8711c8afc.source: Stay in the middle and brace yourself. Doing this will most likely end in a wipe, but you won't fail the quest and can simply return to the spot to finish what remains.
427d32169eb05752d9e752fab938f5f8711c8afc.text: 留在中間並做好準備。這樣做很可能會導致任務失敗，但你不會失敗任務，只需返回該地點即可完成剩下的任務。

befeb156c9095275b08d4e2a7be8e1c422ea2e90.source: After killing the waves, the party leader character will state that there's one more group left - this group will pop up in the center of the sewage water. Killing them will complete the quest.
befeb156c9095275b08d4e2a7be8e1c422ea2e90.text: 消滅波浪後，黨魁角色會說剩下一組 - 該組將出現在汙水中心。殺死他們即可完成任務。

47590afedce3f750a1f00a6a50780eef17d910d4.source: Killing the last group of Afflicted will complete the quest even if foes from previous groups remain.
47590afedce3f750a1f00a6a50780eef17d910d4.text: 即使之前的敵人仍然存在，殺死最後一批受折磨者也會完成任務。

84737e5895b6164ea4d27c4ea35bc2f0848e28ba.source: Among your allies, only Zei Ri self-resurrects (the other remain dead once they lose all their health once).
84737e5895b6164ea4d27c4ea35bc2f0848e28ba.text: 在你的盟友中，只有澤裡會自我復活（其他人一旦失去所有生命值就會保持死亡狀態）。

785461a788e6a4aad836fa1887370e4436d293c9.source: If Zei Ri fails to resurrect after a death, you will be unable to complete the quest; you must rezone and start over.
785461a788e6a4aad836fa1887370e4436d293c9.text: 如果澤裡死後無法復活，你將無法完成任務；你必須重新分割槽並重新開始。

685fa46ab82ee40ce24ed716ee667d69bfa5282d.source: The final wave of Afflicted can spawn even if there are foes remaining from previous waves. If this happens, you need only defeat the final group to receive credit for quest completion.
685fa46ab82ee40ce24ed716ee667d69bfa5282d.text: 即使前一波還剩下敵人，最後一波受折磨者也會生成。如果發生這種情況，您只需擊敗最後一組即可獲得完成任務的積分。

f7e00e22e24eb8a80d65aa8dba506cf865592bf4.text: 與 冰腳奎格 交談。

5feeefc5738e4e4216ad40cee10abaa26eb93ff6.source: Speak with Onar Ironblood Missing a period
5feeefc5738e4e4216ad40cee10abaa26eb93ff6.text: 與 冷血的奧納樂 交談 缺少句號

42974975980825f3aafbc33d6d368b4aa90fc900.source: See Blade Scout Shelby for your reward.
42974975980825f3aafbc33d6d368b4aa90fc900.text: 前往刀鋒偵察兵謝爾比處領取獎勵。

42d7e7038f329b61e9f7a15505e0828c96c5dc7d.source: While following the quest marker, the player will come across Korg Snowfoot. Korg will be attacked by Stone Summit dwarves as soon as he is in range. If he survives, speak to him to complete part of the quest (it remains completed as long as the player does not zone out of the area, or until the next objective is completed).
42d7e7038f329b61e9f7a15505e0828c96c5dc7d.text: 在跟隨任務標記時，玩家會遇到科格·雪足。一旦進入射程，Korg 就會受到 石峰矮人 矮人的攻擊。如果他倖存下來，與他交談以完成部分任務（只要玩家不離開該區域，或直到完成下一個目標，任務就會保持完成）。

05a5a5226a4bbdc88eaaa5a5d23b0216f3872316.source: Follow the new quest marker to locate and speak with Onar Ironblood. Follow the final quest marker to arrive at Ice Caves of Sorrow. Speak to Blade Scout Shelby to finish the quest.
05a5a5226a4bbdc88eaaa5a5d23b0216f3872316.text: 依照新的任務標記找到 冷血的奧納樂 並與其交談。跟著最終任務標記到達 悲傷冰谷。與刀刃斥候謝爾比交談以完成任務。

60a1b0f1b65863ad10adfd7dd5700edfc18cf5e9.source: This does not show up in the Quest Log as a primary quest, but behaves as one: it is the quest leading to the next mission (Ice Caves of Sorrow).
60a1b0f1b65863ad10adfd7dd5700edfc18cf5e9.text: 這不會作為主要任務出現在 任務 日誌中，但表現為一個：它是導致下一個任務 (悲傷冰谷) 的任務。

e1ebd1487b9a38dcf8b100b3bb06fdc4dda5093d.source: Although the NPC's involved in this quest refer to the Seer as male, Seers are considered genderless.
e1ebd1487b9a38dcf8b100b3bb06fdc4dda5093d.text: 雖然參與此任務的 NPC 將 預言者 稱為男性，但先知被認為是無性別的。

943d617df3e1bb01a220c3f15ba94b19111d4762.source: Captain Hugo Bronzebeard states that "The Mursaat have taken Thunderhead Keep!", but in the mission, it is in fact held by the Stone Summit.
943d617df3e1bb01a220c3f15ba94b19111d4762.text: 副隊長大鬍子修格 宣告“馬賽特 已經佔領了 雷雲要塞！”，但在任務中，它實際上是由 石峰矮人 持有的。

b81989d3484b1a2e84289e6d9b5d3d0d95835589.source: Unlike other quest names, "The" in this quest's name is capitalized.
b81989d3484b1a2e84289e6d9b5d3d0d95835589.text: 與其他任務名稱不同，此任務名稱中的“The”是大寫的。

431664e7797ecb9f5a40296a196efd792edbc21a.source: Defeat the Afflicted in the Undercity.
431664e7797ecb9f5a40296a196efd792edbc21a.text: 擊敗幽暗城中的受折磨者。

07ff0e903c71b5c55bad586ca8c4a20aa94efbaa.source: A safer alternative is to retreat back to the cave exit until the Mursaat patrol has moved ahead of your party, follow them at a safe distance to avoid combat as they clear out the Stone Summit on the road. The Mursaat will split up at the first fork in the path, half the patrol will head east to engage Virag Bladestone, while the other half goes west, crossing a section of the road under catapult fire. Siege damage won't kill the Mursaat as they keep moving, but you can send in a hero or use a long-range weapon to kite the Mursaat, keeping them in the fire zone so the catapults can quickly finish them off for you. Repeat this process with the remaining Mursaat patrol when they reach the next area under catapult fire. Try to wait until they are well within the fire zone before you pull, if you do it too soon, they will follow you before the catapults can finish them, risking Evennie to be killed and failing the mission.
07ff0e903c71b5c55bad586ca8c4a20aa94efbaa.text: 更安全的選擇是撤退到洞穴出口，直到 馬賽特 巡邏隊移動到您的隊伍前面，在安全距離內跟隨他們，以避免在他們清除路上的 石峰矮人 時發生戰鬥。 馬賽特 將在路徑的第一個岔路口分開，一半巡邏隊將向東與 刃巖畢拉克 交戰，而另一半則向西，在彈射器火力下穿過一段路。攻城傷害不會殺死 馬賽特，因為它們會繼續移動，但您可以派出英雄或使用遠端武器風箏 馬賽特，將它們保持在火力區域，以便彈射器可以快速為您消滅它們。當剩餘的 馬賽特 巡邏隊到達彈射器火力下的下一個區域時，重複此過程。嘗試等到他們完全進入火力區域後再拉，如果你拉得太早，他們會在彈射器完成他們之前跟隨你，冒著埃文尼被殺和任務失敗的風險。

7549a7a5fd6a597e899e3e748fe129bf0e817aef.source: Whichever strategy is used, follow the path until you reach the Deldrimor Dwarves' ice ship. The mission completes as soon as Evennia boards.
7549a7a5fd6a597e899e3e748fe129bf0e817aef.text: 無論使用哪種策略，請沿著路徑前進，直到您到達 戴爾狄摩矮人 的冰船。 伊凡妮雅 登板後任務即告完成。

6c87aeee2e2ea60e2c0812becda37e1e3cc4e1d4.source: The bonus is straightforward: free Rornak Stonesledge (1 on the map) from his prison and carry a verbal message from him to Hamdor Grandaxe (2 on the map). You can initiate the bonus by talking to either NPC first. Also make sure that you blow open the right door, there is a door guarded by Mursaat before the actual door where the Bonus starts. Furthermore there are two main complications:
6c87aeee2e2ea60e2c0812becda37e1e3cc4e1d4.text: 獎勵很簡單：將 洛奈科斯通萊基（地圖上的 1）從他的監獄中釋放出來，並將他的口頭資訊傳遞給 Hamdor Grandaxe（地圖上的 2）。您可以先與任一 NPC 交談來啟動獎勵。也要確保您吹開右門，在 額外獎勵 啟動的實際門之前有一扇由 馬賽特 守護的門。此外，還有兩個主要的併發症：

8ced3fd1aaedc30b6d26212c9cd602054d1be394.source: You need two extra powder kegs to blast your way open, which is tedious for single-player teams. (Even with an individual speed boost, this takes an extra minute or three.)
8ced3fd1aaedc30b6d26212c9cd602054d1be394.text: 你需要兩個額外的火藥桶來炸開道路，這對單人團隊來說是乏味的。 （即使單獨提高速度，這也需要額外一到三分鐘的時間。）

0da682a92600241f7f8987a3baa061ecabb198ec.source: The bonus route requires dealing with Jade Constructs (near Rornak's cell) and Mursaat Elementalists (in front of Hamdor's cave): their Spectral Agony can quickly kill unprotected characters (characters without infused armor). Therefore it is wise to send in a Hero to tank the spectral agony for you since they take the damage as if they were infused.
0da682a92600241f7f8987a3baa061ecabb198ec.text: 獎勵路線需要對付翡翠構造體（Rornak 的牢房附近）和 馬賽特 元素師（哈姆多的洞穴前）：他們的幽靈痛苦可以快速殺死未受保護的角色（沒有注入盔甲的角色）。因此，明智的做法是派出 英雄 來為你承受光譜痛苦，因為它們會像被注入一樣承受傷害。

afb043f95db949baa017b1685d1fd56be05946b4.source: The first group of constructs blocking the route to Rornak must be dealt with. There are several approaches for a single player, none of which are entirely reliable for characters tackling Prophecies for the first time:
afb043f95db949baa017b1685d1fd56be05946b4.text: 必須處理第一組阻擋通往羅納克路線的構造體。對於單一玩家來說，有幾種方法，但對於第一次處理 阿斯卡隆戰記 的角色來說，沒有一種方法是完全可靠的：

bb4fcb3f39940871d341d479c4c2b5df68e102c9.source: Go directly into the fight and be willing to absorb a few deaths on the team. (You can recharge resurrection signets by killing the last remaining Stone Summit Engineer.)
bb4fcb3f39940871d341d479c4c2b5df68e102c9.text: 直接投入戰鬥並願意吸收團隊中的一些死亡。 （你可以透過殺死最後剩下的 石峰矮人工程師 來充值復活印章。）

d450d95297eab7d19d472fef6848545ab38218ff.source: Use a party member to tank the constructs; with enough healing, they can survive Spectral Agony's direct damage and health degeneration.
d450d95297eab7d19d472fef6848545ab38218ff.text: 使用一名黨員來坦克建築；只要有足夠的治療能力，他們就可以在光譜痛苦的直接傷害和健康退化中倖存下來。

23a3e4b728a8b35306ef033f76f526b7337bdacf.source: Carefully pull the constructs away from each other and spike one at a time. With enough damage, you can take down one of the constructs and (if needed) retreat to heal before returning for the others.
23a3e4b728a8b35306ef033f76f526b7337bdacf.text: 小心地將結構彼此拉開，並一次釘入一個。有了足夠的傷害，你就可以摧毀其中一個構造體，並（如果需要）撤退以治療其他構造體，然後再返回其他構造體。

e9584b36f7959d6f5609195f3535919130565b72.source: Several members of the party should bring snares (such as "You Move Like a Dwarf!", Tryptophan Signet, Summon Ice Imp, Deep Freeze, Ethereal Burden/Kitah's Burden, and Imagined Burden) or other methods to slow the Corsair Runners, unless one party member brings a build specifically for it.
e9584b36f7959d6f5609195f3535919130565b72.text: 隊伍中的幾名成員應該帶上圈套（例如“你像一個 矮人 ！ ”，色胺酸 紋章 , 召喚 冰小惡魔 , 強力凍結 , 幻影負荷 / 吉塔的負荷 , 和 意念負荷 ）或其他減慢速度的方法 海盜 跑步者，除非一名黨員專門為其帶來了構建。

83afd72c284db7ef58687dce657a3126312e152e.text: 類似 圈套 的策略也有效：

30665541ba65c79eb98c38790d03a836dbfeae5a.source: Conditions work as snares here, because the runners stop running to activate Antidote Signet. If inflicting cripple, interrupt Antidote Signet to prevent it from being removed.
30665541ba65c79eb98c38790d03a836dbfeae5a.text: 這裡的條件就像圈套一樣，因為跑者停止跑步以啟動 解毒紋章。如果造成癱瘓，請中斷 解毒紋章 以防止移除。

da92ea20a73d4b91ef7187685000e82acef0f4ca.source: Skills which cause knock down are also very effective against the runners (such as "You Move Like a Dwarf!", which can also snare the runner).
da92ea20a73d4b91ef7187685000e82acef0f4ca.text: 導致擊倒的技能對奔跑者也非常有效（例如“You Move Like a 矮人！”，這也可以誘捕奔跑者）。

96f0565709f49ae5e883d3aa7b1aba69fc6eac80.source: If you have heroes and/or animal companions, use them to defeat the constructs, since their armor is always infused.
96f0565709f49ae5e883d3aa7b1aba69fc6eac80.text: 如果你有英雄和/或動物夥伴，用他們來擊敗構裝體，因為他們的盔甲總是被注入的。

55f0633bca8bdbd448f5f2cc8cb866bff36b442d.source: For the bonus, the second group of Mursaat Elementalist can be easily avoided by briefly stepping out of the cave to Hamdor's west, retreating south, and then waiting for the Mursaat to pass by; this leaves the route to Hamdor free of enemies and letting you complete the bonus objective without more complications. If you still need to complete the main mission, The Mursaat Elementalist must be dealt with. To do so, consider the following:
55f0633bca8bdbd448f5f2cc8cb866bff36b442d.text: 額外的好處是，第二組馬賽特元素師可以輕鬆避開，只需短暫走出洞穴到哈姆多的西邊，向南撤退，然後等待馬賽特經過即可；這使得通往哈姆多的路線沒有敵人，讓你可以在沒有更多複雜性的情況下完成獎勵目標。如果你還需要完成主線任務，就必須處理馬賽特元素師。為此，請考慮以下事項：

8f5b27a24c341ac2a84c1bac2942eeb56261bfe5.source: Make use of the Stone Summit catapults to get the Mursaat killed without direct confrontation, as detailed previously.
8f5b27a24c341ac2a84c1bac2942eeb56261bfe5.text: 如前所述，利用 石峰矮人 彈射器在不直接對抗的情況下殺死 馬賽特。

ffb4d70f31177ea699d166ec7190fddd9b6235fc.source: If you rather face the mursaat, keep in mind they will split up into two groups shortly after the first battle between White Mantle and Stone Summit, around the large rock where Virag Bladestone guards one route and a catapult guards the other. The group facing Virag will most likely waste the initial cast of their dangerous Thunderclap but are unlikely to take much damage before the battle, while the catapult group will end up softened by the raining projectiles but will have all their skills ready
ffb4d70f31177ea699d166ec7190fddd9b6235fc.text: 如果您更願意麵對陸生生物，請記住，在 白斗篷 和 石峰矮人 之間的第一次戰鬥後不久，它們會在大岩石周圍分成兩組，刃巖畢拉克 守衛一條路線，而彈射器守衛另一條路線。面對維拉格的隊伍很可能會浪費他們危險的 雷鳴 的初始施法，但在戰鬥前不太可能受到太大傷害，而彈射器隊伍最終會被雨點般的射彈軟化，但他們會準備好所有技能

757934c1152f79519fdc5f7f3dfe40df5915b905.source: Reaching Rornak is the only section of the mission that requires exposing you to Spectral Agony. If none of the above strategies work for you to overcome that part of the mission, you can finish the main quest and return for the bonus after getting your armor infused during the next mission.
757934c1152f79519fdc5f7f3dfe40df5915b905.text: 到達羅納克是任務中唯一需要讓你經歷幽靈痛苦的部分。如果上述策略都無法幫助您完成該部分任務，您可以完成主線任務，並在下一個任務中註入護甲後返回以獲得獎勵。

bf8cad5f7df454d1a187ff502581a88ebf9b28c1.source: Anti-caster skills to counter Mursaat Elementalists.
bf8cad5f7df454d1a187ff502581a88ebf9b28c1.text: 對抗 馬賽特 元素師的反施法者技能。

76e6536c925e4811413dfa0e087e54aefa68cc6e.source: Interrupts, especially to stop Spectral Agony.
76e6536c925e4811413dfa0e087e54aefa68cc6e.text: 中斷，尤其是停止幽靈痛苦。

3fa2ff9e778eb2eebe523297a61a86155aae2574.source: Minions and Spirits ease battles versus two or more groups.
3fa2ff9e778eb2eebe523297a61a86155aae2574.text: 小兵和靈魂可以緩解兩個或更多團體的戰鬥。

a803e53a1ae18019b426dc8deec8107ae1b70a96.source: During Saidra and Evennia's rescue, blast the back gate before breaking their cell; the cave can provide a safe place for your party if it has not been cleared yet. Also, if you are struggling to keep Evennia alive at the frozen lake, you can clear the path including the Mursaat Elementalists before freeing her from her cell. This method only adds a few minutes to the mission time, but more or less guarantees Evennia's survival.
a803e53a1ae18019b426dc8deec8107ae1b70a96.text: 在 Saidra 和 伊凡妮雅 的救援過程中，在破壞他們的牢房之前炸毀後門；如果洞穴尚未被清理乾淨，它可以為你的隊伍提供一個安全的地方。另外，如果您在結冰的湖面上努力保住 伊凡妮雅 的生命，您可以先清理道路，包括 馬賽特 元素師，然後再將她從牢房中釋放出來。這種方法只增加了幾分鐘的任務時間，但或多或​​少保證了伊凡妮雅的生存。

b6dc7ed66a4bea2daa4e74bde1d0af29b72c17cc.source: You cannot save Saidra; if you manage to kill off her attackers, she will run off and disappear.
b6dc7ed66a4bea2daa4e74bde1d0af29b72c17cc.text: 你無法拯救賽德拉；如果你成功殺死了襲擊她的人，她就會逃跑並消失。

51572ba1d96fd10fa2f780ecae6402d912535ba5.source: You can infuse your armor even before this mission by trekking up to Mineral Springs and killing the Ice Beast, then giving the Spectral Essence it drops to the Seer immediately south of it.
51572ba1d96fd10fa2f780ecae6402d912535ba5.text: 您甚至可以在執行此任務之前透過長途跋涉到達 礦物泉源 並殺死 冰獸，然後將光譜 模板:Reclaim Essence 提供給緊鄰其南邊的 預言者 來注入您的盔甲。

7af7655ca62a0efc8debd344aac3fb099c0ba653.source: This mission adds approximately 1.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title track.
7af7655ca62a0efc8debd344aac3fb099c0ba653.text: 此任務將大約 1.1% 加入 Tyrian 版圖 主打歌。

24c840753a92b2083b2ec30120115e0a465dbf8d.source: Non-human heroes will not bow during the final cinematic; they apparently lack the animation.
24c840753a92b2083b2ec30120115e0a465dbf8d.text: 非人類英雄不會在最後的過場動畫中鞠躬；他們顯然缺乏動畫。

e8f6f3613b2e8b67f9e8c8753779a92fefdac6c2.source: When reaching Rornak, for the bonus, there are two gates leading off from the caves: if you try to blow up the wrong one, it won’t be destroyed and may appear to be bugged. Double-check the map: the gate you are trying to blow up is in the southern blue patch of the mountain and should turn a corner off the main path before the gate.
e8f6f3613b2e8b67f9e8c8753779a92fefdac6c2.text: 當到達羅納克時，為了獎勵，有兩扇門通往洞穴：如果你試圖炸毀錯誤的一扇門，它不會被摧毀，而且可能看起來被竊聽了。仔細檢查地圖：你要炸毀的大門位於山脈南部的藍色區域，應該在大門前從主路拐一個彎。

a822b0d5fa4504b50f0b675cea0c4d36e8e9b93b.source: When letting the Mursaat go in front of your party at the frozen lake, you have to stay in compass range of them if you want them to clear the Stone Summit along the path for you.
a822b0d5fa4504b50f0b675cea0c4d36e8e9b93b.text: 當讓 馬賽特 在結冰的湖面走在你的隊伍前面時，如果你想讓他們為你清理沿途的 石峰矮人，你必須保持在他們的羅盤範圍內。

786a74e9aa8c750fadb591d8f8b50e26c8e80e76.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #13 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
786a74e9aa8c750fadb591d8f8b50e26c8e80e76.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#13 頁。

f28f864d457e3f4ea0a0e7d1c772653df58f38ec.source: After completing this mission, your party appears in Iron Mines of Moladune.
f28f864d457e3f4ea0a0e7d1c772653df58f38ec.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍會出現在 莫拉登礦山 中。

dd8e483994bd77c57ed7e5743c3b3ccf68d22c9e.source: A little while after the first Stone Summit group the mob of Mursaat passes on the frozen lake, there is a Shiverpeak Chest which the Mursaat sometimes will get stuck on and stop moving. If this happens, you will have to retry the mission or attempt to have an infused player pull them away from it. The Mursaat stops after the stone bridge. Sometimes Evennia will not follow you; sometimes she may follow Saidra and gets killed by Mursaat; you must restart the mission if this happens. Sometimes Rornak Stonesledge will not be at his location, making it impossible to claim the bonus without restarting the mission. Occasionally, a stray barrage from the siege weapons will land near the spawn of Virag Bladestone, harming the party. The Mursaat are not hostile to Darda Goldenchief's group. Sometimes, a Shiverpeak Chest will spawn in an unreachable location near the ice boat siege engines.
dd8e483994bd77c57ed7e5743c3b3ccf68d22c9e.text: 在第一個 石峰矮人 組後不久，馬賽特 的暴徒經過結冰的湖面，有一個 Shiverpeak 寶箱，馬賽特 有時會被卡住並停止移動。如果發生這種情況，你將不得不重試任務或嘗試讓已註入的玩家將他們拉離任務。 馬賽特 在石橋後停了下來。有時 伊凡妮雅 不會跟隨您；有時她可能會跟隨 Saidra 並被 馬賽特 殺死；如果發生這種情況，您必須重新啟動任務。有時 洛奈科斯通萊基 不會在他的位置，因此無法在不重新啟動任務的情況下領取獎金。有時，攻城武器的雜散彈幕會落在 刃巖畢拉克 的產卵點附近，對隊伍造成傷害。 馬賽特 對 金首達勒塔 的組織並無敵意。有時，席瓦峰 寶箱 會在冰船攻城引擎附近無法到達的位置產生。

69fa55e2311cf94385b6cb19c5de74c86079a740.source: Travel to Yatendi Canyons and find Kehanni Nutu, priestess of Lyssa.
69fa55e2311cf94385b6cb19c5de74c86079a740.text: 前往 亞天帝峽谷 並尋找 麗莎 的女祭司 Kehanni Nutu。

6d9eb3d04b0c97d736af9cc94bebe8ee1633a842.source: Meet with the Seeker of Whispers.

cc235fd95a88c7ea21a016cf1f452e5d3fb897a2.source: Meet Kehanni in Vehtendi Valley. Obtain an invitation to the Festival of Lyss.
cc235fd95a88c7ea21a016cf1f452e5d3fb897a2.text: 在 巍天帝峽谷 中認識 Kehanni。獲得利斯節的邀請。

0b5cee60da656abc23aeb033156fa8256012b885.source: Travel through the Forum Highlands. Meet Priestess Haila.
0b5cee60da656abc23aeb033156fa8256012b885.text: 穿越 高地廣場。認識女祭司海拉。

18367611151843733f3db00af60a82aea69c9e36.source: Wash the dirt, grime, and heket blood from your armor and gear in the Font of Lyss.
18367611151843733f3db00af60a82aea69c9e36.text: 在利斯之泉中清洗盔甲和裝備上的汙垢、汙垢和血跡。

7bcc154ff8c82bd11e3bcc19f3a9aa04ed08faff.source: Speak with Priestess Haila to gain a sneak peek at the party.
7bcc154ff8c82bd11e3bcc19f3a9aa04ed08faff.text: 與女祭司海拉交談，搶先一睹派對的風採。

bdee797ef4a7429688d323d8af4031bebbab46d8.source: See Event Planner Kazsha for your reward.
bdee797ef4a7429688d323d8af4031bebbab46d8.text: 請參閱活動策劃者 Kazsha 以獲得獎勵。

afcbd1bcca11eb4b590ddb4ab4c9e910931fc42b.source: While this quest is active, the bosses Bohdalz the Furious and Jarimiya the Unmerciful do not spawn in Vehtendi Valley.
afcbd1bcca11eb4b590ddb4ab4c9e910931fc42b.text: 當這個任務處於活動狀態時，BOSS 狂怒 博赫達爾茲和無情者賈裡米亞不會在 巍天帝峽谷 中產生。

0daa0bd0381886a8b5c9331a531781534befa8e0.source: Start in Wehhan Terraces. Follow the path in the map to point 1 and talk to Kehanni. Follow the path to Chantry of Secrets, and talk to the Seeker of Whispers inside (point 2). Follow the path into and through Vehtendi Valley to point 3, where the quest will update. Follow either the green (through Forum Highlands) or the red path (via the Kodash Bazaar) to Priestess Haila outside the Kodash Bazaar. If you wish to enter the Kodash Bazaar, you can also follow the green path and then continue into the Bazaar before talking to the priestess. There you can wash yourself in the Font of Lyss and she will send you into Tihark Orchard.
0daa0bd0381886a8b5c9331a531781534befa8e0.text: 從 薇恩平臺 開始。沿著地圖上的路徑指向 1 並與 Kehanni 交談。沿著路徑前往 隱密教堂，並與裡面的低語探索者交談（指向 2）。沿著路徑進入並穿過 巍天帝峽谷 到達 3，任務將在此處更新。沿著綠色路徑（穿過 高地廣場）或紅色路徑（穿過 Kodash Bazaar）前往 Kodash Bazaar 外的女祭司 Haila。如果你想進入Kodash集市，也可以沿著綠色小路繼續進入集市，然後與女祭司交談。在那裡，你可以在里斯之泉中沐浴，她會送你進入提哈克果園。

f1eec64422ef197837748d2e219d4695fc00a214.source: If you already have the Kodash Bazaar unlocked, you can skip most of this quest by starting from the objective that requires using the Font of Lyss.
f1eec64422ef197837748d2e219d4695fc00a214.text: 如果您已經解鎖了 Kodash Bazaar，則可以從需要使用 Lyss 字型的目標開始，跳過此任務的大部分內容。

c52ab7e8eef8ecb95ca1800bde67fc93af7daf85.source: After completion of Tihark Orchard you will find yourself in Kodash Bazaar. The only point in going there before you complete the Tihark Orchard mission is to unlock it a little bit earlier.
c52ab7e8eef8ecb95ca1800bde67fc93af7daf85.text: 完成 Tihark Orchard 後，您將發現自己身處 Kodash Bazaar。在完成提哈克果園任務之前去那裡的唯一一點是提前解鎖它。

ec5af1de9022b5c85d774323a00b3d1693a0d4a8.source: If you accept the quest reward for this quest with a full inventory, you will not receive the trade contracts and you might not be able to continue the primary quest line.
ec5af1de9022b5c85d774323a00b3d1693a0d4a8.text: 如果您在庫存已滿的情況下接受此任務的任務獎勵，您將不會收到貿易合同，並且您可能無法繼續主要任務線。

9c0a3430c04f8c383a75f472558970b0978f8c1e.text: 主職 不是 遊俠

110b93e17d695e6da16b92f2f797c6f2ea942504.source: Speak with Headmaster Greico in the Shing Jea Monastery.
110b93e17d695e6da16b92f2f797c6f2ea942504.text: 在 星岬寺 中與校長格雷科交談。

b466830313d3f5c993d9ca7bd109d46adec45438.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Sunjiang District.
b466830313d3f5c993d9ca7bd109d46adec45438.text: 在 孫江行政區 中擊敗受影響者。

d3ee6477135bf76e4df2dc6996cab445ab78edc6.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Sunjiang District; specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
d3ee6477135bf76e4df2dc6996cab445ab78edc6.text: 完成此任務會改變 孫江行政區 中出現的敵人；具體來說，受苦者將不再生成。

a5e5a232d88ed0c19e6370220751a8012fdff49a.source: To complete this quest, your character must have successfully completed the missions: Boreas Seabed, Arborstone, and Sunjiang District, otherwise a gate will block the path to the last group of Afflicted that must be defeated.
a5e5a232d88ed0c19e6370220751a8012fdff49a.text: 要完成此任務，你的角色必須成功完成任務：Boreas Seabed、Arborstone 和 孫江行政區，否則一扇門將擋住通往最後一組必須擊敗的受折磨者的道路。

72bc2ba764c7e4374728c29659da09a04fc207e8.source: Start from Zin Ku Corridor and head south into the Sunjiang District. The Am Fah encountered on the way to the first quest marker do not use Winds of Change builds and so are trivial to defeat. Follow the quest markers and kill off the Afflicted groups.
72bc2ba764c7e4374728c29659da09a04fc207e8.text: 從 辛庫走廊 出發，往南進入 孫江行政區。在前往第一個任務標記的路上遇到的 安費 不使用 變幻之風 構建，因此很容易擊敗。跟隨任務標記並殺死受折磨的群體。

1bfbb8a6108af0773120003bb060609f089f1de4.source: While it might look like an equidistant route to approach this quest from the south, the Am Fah in Pongmei Valley do use the Winds of Change builds and so are much more difficult than the Zin Ku Corridor route.
1bfbb8a6108af0773120003bb060609f089f1de4.text: 雖然它看起來像是從南方接近此任務的等距路線，但 朋美谷 中的 安費 確實使用 變幻之風 構建，因此比 辛庫走廊 路線困難得多。

7cd484e3d89f705bd20377031717921b77e7416f.source: The final group spawns very near the fourth group, namely near the Ranger's Construct boss. There's a risk of aggro before recuperating from the previous fight; consider pulling the fourth group further away from the tunnel, and then pulling the final group away from the Shiro'ken.
7cd484e3d89f705bd20377031717921b77e7416f.text: 最後一組在第四組附近生成，即靠近 遊俠 的構造 Boss。在從先前的戰鬥中恢復過來之前，存在仇恨的風險；考慮將第四組拉離隧道更遠，然後將最後一組拉離 白影軍團。

7c2663cf8159cb625bf8182b8bfb1d0a9c3d372f.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Frozen Forest and start the mission. Completing Ice Caves of Sorrow also brings the party here.
7c2663cf8159cb625bf8182b8bfb1d0a9c3d372f.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 冰凍森林 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 悲傷冰谷 也將聚會帶到這裡。

0ae8a4ade0cf73d84b2afc2b873930975e7e52f0.source: Kill Markis and his Jade Armor guards.
0ae8a4ade0cf73d84b2afc2b873930975e7e52f0.text: 殺死 瑪基思 和他的 翡翠戰士 守衛。

62ccc3de3efec6104787c53930c05edb0eed59ba.source: ADDED: Deliver the Spectral Essence to the Seer to infuse your armor.
62ccc3de3efec6104787c53930c05edb0eed59ba.text: 新增：將 Spectral 模板:Reclaim Essence 傳送到 預言者 以注入你的盔甲。

7b5a84fed5a9ac5d75ffa87f783971c7483b01e5.source: *BONUS* Defeat The Inquisitor before he leaves with the information about the Shining Blade.
7b5a84fed5a9ac5d75ffa87f783971c7483b01e5.text: *獎勵* 在審判官帶著有關 光刃公會 的資訊離開之前擊敗他。

93583adeeb91b6de8157e81ebf44a8aefc046619.source: The goal of this mission is to kill Markis at the point marked M on the map. To do so the players first have to meet with the Seer at the point marked S, who will offer to infuse players armor to protect them against Spectral Agony.
93583adeeb91b6de8157e81ebf44a8aefc046619.text: 任務的目標是在地圖上標記為M的地點殺死瑪基思。為此，玩家首先必須在標記為 S 的地點與 預言者 會面，後者將主動為玩家注入護甲以保護他們免受幽靈痛苦的傷害。

b71c83262224f0ede33711bd590e95d5943af69f.source: Maximum-stat armor (e.g. from Droknar's Forge) is strongly advised for this mission, not only because it gives an edge in the fights, but also because infusion will only be applied to the armor set players are currently wearing. As you encounter the Mursaat throughout the rest of the campaign, you want to make sure that you are protected against their most deadly attack. Should you miss the opportunity, you will need to repeat the first part of the mission or alternatively infuse another set later in the game in Mineral Springs, or the Ring of Fire or Abaddon's Mouth missions.
b71c83262224f0ede33711bd590e95d5943af69f.text: 強烈建議在此任務中使用最大屬性盔甲（例如來自 卓克納熔爐），不僅因為它在戰鬥中具有優勢，而且因為輸注只會應用於玩家目前穿著的盔甲套裝。當您在剩餘的戰役中遇到 馬賽特 時，您需要確保自己免受其最致命的攻擊。如果您錯過了這個機會，您將需要重複任務的第一部分，或者稍後在遊戲中的 礦物泉源、火環群島 或 地獄隘口 任務中註入另一組任務。

5b6913da23beeece9f6314b3b45b9e742312c72e.source: Do not engage the Mursaat in combat until your armor is infused, or use an infused tank, such as any hero or pet (henchmen are not infused), to draw attacks away from the rest of the team.
5b6913da23beeece9f6314b3b45b9e742312c72e.text: 在你的護甲被注入之前，不要讓 馬賽特 參與戰鬥，或使用被注入的坦克，例如任何英雄或寵物（不被注入的追隨者），來吸引團隊其他成員的攻擊。

8e52dd2a5011695fc128aeeb2d18f7e99c5e4558.source: At the beginning, there's a battle between the Stone Summit and White Mantle. You can ignore them and simply run past them. Head along the frozen river and then keep heading north. Again you will sight a very large group of Stone Summit and White Mantle in combat, head east to avoid it since there is no need to fight them.
8e52dd2a5011695fc128aeeb2d18f7e99c5e4558.text: 一開始，石峰矮人 和 白斗篷 之間發生了一場戰鬥。您可以忽略它們並直接跑過去。沿著結冰的河流前進，然後繼續向北行駛。你會再次看到一大群 石峰矮人 和 白斗篷 正在戰鬥，向東走以避免它們，因為沒有必要與他們戰鬥。

a404ae076ae3c7ca5c3fbb43e4f449d3d8892608.source: At this point you will hear Shining Blade Scout Ryder calling out for help but safe from harm. She gives the bonus objective but her rescue is not needed to complete the mission. In any case, ignore her for the time being.
a404ae076ae3c7ca5c3fbb43e4f449d3d8892608.text: 此時，您會聽到 光刃公會 Scout Ryder 大聲呼救，但避免受到傷害。她給了獎勵目標，但完成任務不需要她的救援。無論如何，暫時不理她吧。

4379ae10c9ca5939fe5a6e3b0f98b61b8fe31777.source: Cross another bridge and keep traveling north-west until you reach the snowfields populated by Azure Shadows. Kill them and proceed to the Seer (marked S on the map above).
4379ae10c9ca5939fe5a6e3b0f98b61b8fe31777.text: 穿過另一座橋，繼續向西北行駛，直到到達蔚藍陰影居住的雪地。殺死他們並前往 預言者（上圖示示為 S）。

c806246d9e3a7f468b66a48443fd4772a66278b6.source: Approaching the Seer will trigger a cutscene where players are instructed to kill the Eidolon (at point E) and obtain its Spectral Essence to infuse your armor. The Eidolon is not difficult to defeat and once killed will drop the Spectral Essence as a bundle that you have to carry back to the Seer. Once done, talk to the Seer to have your armor infused with the essence.
c806246d9e3a7f468b66a48443fd4772a66278b6.text: 接近 預言者 將觸發過場動畫，玩家被指示殺死 艾多倫（在 E 點）並獲取其光譜 模板:Reclaim Essence 來注入你的盔甲。 艾多倫 並不難擊敗，一旦被殺死，Spectral 模板:Reclaim Essence 就會被當作捆綁包掉落，您必須將其帶回 預言者。完成後，與 預言者 對話，讓你的盔甲注入精華。

b04ebb6512706d80b83d69b190ad0969f3198eeb.source: Follow then the passage north of the Seer to reach Markis' location.
b04ebb6512706d80b83d69b190ad0969f3198eeb.text: 然後沿著 預言者 以北的通道到達 瑪基思 的位置。

e7a7377388ec3c2e4f7aad1c882b551419313317.source: Assassins bringing Spike builds using Shadow Prison together with Skills such as Iron Palm, Black Mantis Thrust can quickly shadowstep to the Runners and burst them down.
e7a7377388ec3c2e4f7aad1c882b551419313317.text: 刺客帶來 Spike 構建使用 暗影拘禁 連同以下的技能 鐵掌 , 黑螳螂刺擊 可以快速暗影步攻擊奔跑者並擊倒他們。

d4ac73dbe5e12097583312186107823a9b4e3a55.source: Bringing skills which boost speed can also be useful.
d4ac73dbe5e12097583312186107823a9b4e3a55.text: 帶來提高速度的技能也很有用。

fa3d68f39a42ac98f7c9c18e763ecfab502704a3.source: Ranged attacks and skills can be useful in taking down the runners and during the fight against General Bayel and the Hunger if you take refuge under the bridge to hide from the Kournan Bowmen.
fa3d68f39a42ac98f7c9c18e763ecfab502704a3.text: 如果您在橋下避難以躲避庫南弓箭手，遠距 攻擊和技能可以在擊倒逃跑者以及對抗巴耶爾將軍和飢餓者的戰鬥中發揮作用。

81fe15b6e0d5834dfa3a1987bda86ea07f2fada6.source: A Mesmer with Clumsiness and Wandering Eye will make short work of both the Kournan Bowmen on the bridge and the Hunger.
81fe15b6e0d5834dfa3a1987bda86ea07f2fada6.text: 幻術師 搭配 笨拙 和流浪之眼很快就會解決橋上的庫南弓箭手和飢餓者。

b0bc549d7008f87cd7d4c647222a49d84aa46d47.source: Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party members do not have signets or enchantments equipped. The only hex spells you will encounter are Rust (Corsair Wind Master), Defender's Zeal and Scourge Enchantment (General Bayel).
b0bc549d7008f87cd7d4c647222a49d84aa46d47.text: 如果你的隊伍成員沒有裝備圖章或結界，則不需要去除六角形技能。您將遇到的唯一十六進位制咒語是 紋章鏽蝕（海盜 風大師）、防禦者狂熱 和 災禍加持（巴耶爾將軍）。

4163d8e1adac6b1d98f9f007801d8edf249c60cc.source: As with any underground location, the area is represented on the world map with a slightly larger, inset version of the mission map.
4163d8e1adac6b1d98f9f007801d8edf249c60cc.text: 與任何地下地點一樣，該區域在世界地圖上以稍大的插入版本的任務地圖表示。

7505febe50565d980c45a32acd0c7fc8f28594fc.source: You can use Return on the friendly Corsairs at the beginning, allowing you to shadow step towards your original spawning location after being betrayed.
7505febe50565d980c45a32acd0c7fc8f28594fc.text: 您可以在開始時對友好的海盜使用 影返，這樣您就可以在被背叛後向原來的生成位置暗步。

db389991f9b5724b045938ff078033aa5cbba8be.source: If you are going for the bonus don't kill any of the insect bosses. Even if you have already achieved all 4 suggestions, the game mechanics will "think" that you haven't followed the first suggestion and all the work you've done will be lost.
db389991f9b5724b045938ff078033aa5cbba8be.text: 如果你想獲得獎金，請不要殺死任何昆蟲首領。即使您已經實現了所有 4 建議，遊戲機制也會「認為」您沒有遵循第一個建議，並且您所做的所有工作都將丟失。

33e95261edbb2b9a7b2223f9992f5bc477a224e2.source: You cannot capture any of General Bayel's skills during the mission; he is not considered a boss.
33e95261edbb2b9a7b2223f9992f5bc477a224e2.text: 任務期間你無法捕捉巴耶爾將軍的任何技能；他不被視為老闆。

b16213bfa31bc1c84f23d46fe1a5fa7a395e4dc8.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Wehhan Terraces.
b16213bfa31bc1c84f23d46fe1a5fa7a395e4dc8.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將會傳送到 薇恩平臺。

abc813f09d3c6a772b9e97c8499239517a63eed9.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #6 in the Night Falls storybook.
abc813f09d3c6a772b9e97c8499239517a63eed9.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#6 頁。

3ff8a75f725077fe3c29e30d5502de0e7d2cb78e.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Shenzun Tunnels.
3ff8a75f725077fe3c29e30d5502de0e7d2cb78e.text: 在 申贊通道 中擊敗受影響者。

4d0bea96f360cd872f39c23da02c45a023caad2e.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Shenzun Tunnels, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
4d0bea96f360cd872f39c23da02c45a023caad2e.text: 完成此任務會改變 申贊通道 中出現的敵人，具體來說，受苦者將不再生成。

51def6151ec70583350674f7f4b0e6b5a856cbb1.source: You can either immediately kill him and his Jade guards to complete the mission or ignore him for now and proceed south to do the bonus.
51def6151ec70583350674f7f4b0e6b5a856cbb1.text: 你可以立即殺死他和他的玉衛來完成任務，也可以暫時忽略他並繼續向南以獲得獎勵。

c2fb364055df6da230abd761b13addbe3de29e8c.text: 前往 瑪基思 的替代路線

a97ceb99ab61c29542d827083b1bb297bfe5b407.source: Talking to the Seer is not necessary to finish the mission. If players are already infused against Spectral Agony, do not follow the river north. Instead, follow Markis northeast through the Mursaat stronghold to save time. This path is marked in green and yellow on the map above, and you will encounter the bonus NPC Shining Blade Scout Ryder along the way.
a97ceb99ab61c29542d827083b1bb297bfe5b407.text: 無需與 預言者 對話即可完成任務。如果玩家已經注入了對抗幽靈痛苦的能力，請不要沿著河流向北行駛。相反，請沿著 瑪基思 向東北方向穿過 馬賽特 要塞以節省時間。這條路徑在上面的地圖上有綠色和黃色標記，沿途你會遇到獎勵 NPC 光刃公會 Scout Ryder。

ba07b666d505804affcea985da634974f30561fc.source: Shining Blade Scout Ryder, found at point B on the map, urges players to kill The Inquisitor before it escapes with intelligence. Accepting the bonus will spawn the mentioned boss and a few Mursaat, which will move north towards the Mursaat teleporter.
ba07b666d505804affcea985da634974f30561fc.text: 光刃公會 偵察兵萊德（Scout Ryder）位於地圖上的 B 點，他敦促玩家在審判官攜帶情報逃跑之前將其殺死。接受獎勵將產生上述 Boss 和一些 馬賽特，它們將向北移向 馬賽特 傳送器。

cbd58899ba45297b92fd42076a9695a2db6d9962.source: To get to Ryder in the first place, head south of Markis and kill the Mursaat you encounter. Alternatively if you followed the green path above, kill the Mursaat up to the next bridge.
cbd58899ba45297b92fd42076a9695a2db6d9962.text: 首先，要到達萊德，請前往 瑪基思 以南並殺死你遇到的 馬賽特。或者，如果您沿著上面的綠色路徑走，則殺死 馬賽特 直到下一個橋。

8a42555ce5f140c1ac38f5fc26bcdef1767bc031.source: Clear out the surrounding mobs between Ryder and the bridge before talking to Ryder to avoid over-aggro. Send only one player to Ryder while the rest of the party awaits at the Inquisitor spawn point (which is just outside the gates, a little up the hill).
8a42555ce5f140c1ac38f5fc26bcdef1767bc031.text: 在與萊德交談之前先清除萊德和橋之間的周圍小怪，以避免過度仇恨。只派一名玩家前往萊德，而其他人則在審判官重生點等待（就在大門外，在山上一點點）。

b973d145675d09527b9adf2d927a9205b57c69d0.source: Although the foes are notably tougher in hard mode, the basic strategies are the same.
b973d145675d09527b9adf2d927a9205b57c69d0.text: 儘管困難模式的敵人明顯更強悍，但基本策略是相同的。

f1a77493317bae8335f5dc7a33dd3c2c82f4f936.source: Snares and knockdowns to prevent The Inquisitor from running away.
f1a77493317bae8335f5dc7a33dd3c2c82f4f936.text: 用陷阱和擊倒來防止審判官逃跑。

19682f6b2cc8c7ee0980621b5ccef0712c3eb62b.source: Anti-caster skills for players without infused armor.
19682f6b2cc8c7ee0980621b5ccef0712c3eb62b.text: 沒有註入護甲的玩家的反施法者技能。

d4b6799d1dd2d9541a9921ad1f84ae1cdfb9c42f.source: Despite being mentioned in the mission objectives, it is not necessary to visit the Seer in order to finish the mission.
d4b6799d1dd2d9541a9921ad1f84ae1cdfb9c42f.text: 儘管任務目標中提到了，但沒有必要存取 預言者 來完成任務。

522b1b2c8ed749129a25ce942dbee2c6dfae7b03.source: Shining Blade Scout Ryder can die, preventing you from beginning the bonus.
522b1b2c8ed749129a25ce942dbee2c6dfae7b03.text: 光刃公會 偵察兵萊德可能會死亡，阻止您開始獎勵。

a6873c54739e647081d5aff81b31801912f2d810.source: Henchmen are not infused at the beginning of mission and become infused only after delivering the Spectral Essence to the Seer.
a6873c54739e647081d5aff81b31801912f2d810.text: 傭兵 在任務開始時不會被注入，只有在將 Spectral 模板:Reclaim Essence 交付給 預言者 後才會被注入。

ce395a9dce8fc3eb078d5bf6bed87af8e94e7d35.source: The popular "Infusion run" follows the red path on the map above to only trigger the Seer cinematic.
ce395a9dce8fc3eb078d5bf6bed87af8e94e7d35.text: 流行的「灌注魔力 奔跑」沿著上面地圖上的紅色路徑，僅觸發 預言者 過場動畫。

c766a4767bb38f0cccd0bfbf034a04b4b4e459d3.source: Players wanting to capture Barrage from Markis need to kill him before finishing off the four Jade Armor guards or the mission will end.
c766a4767bb38f0cccd0bfbf034a04b4b4e459d3.text: 想要從 瑪基思 手中奪取 齊射 的玩家需要在消滅四個 翡翠戰士 守衛之前殺死他，否則任務就會結束。

9a7347684e9c41b2489f840dd3ab620e84bcbe89.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #14 in The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
9a7347684e9c41b2489f840dd3ab620e84bcbe89.text: 完成此任務將填入「Flameseeker 阿斯卡隆戰記」故事書中的#14 頁。

fcdbe964190407e72a80bd331d1bd0c6a0c2cfb9.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Thunderhead Keep.
fcdbe964190407e72a80bd331d1bd0c6a0c2cfb9.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 雷雲要塞。

6364cb2968320a6d43c72925796ba32aa22a71ef.source: Sometimes, Markis will get stuck in a chest and will not arrive to the fortress. Players will have to backtrack his route from the original spawning location to find him.
6364cb2968320a6d43c72925796ba32aa22a71ef.text: 有時，瑪基思 會卡在箱子裡而無法到達堡壘。玩家必須從最初的生成位置原路返回才能找到他。

0b3b1f6ffb99a5d919a862848a7d3c0e71be33bb.source: Rally The Princes primary quest completed
0b3b1f6ffb99a5d919a862848a7d3c0e71be33bb.text: 集結王子主要任務已完成

8d84e7ddde6a56dc53461dc32b52847dc68ff07f.source: Convince the three Princes of Vabbi to join the fight against Varesh.
8d84e7ddde6a56dc53461dc32b52847dc68ff07f.text: 說服 瓦貝 的三位王子加入對抗瓦雷什的戰鬥。

e14f49cad70d2b7878b4b3af31c7aacd1b618b58.source: Recruit Prince Mehtu the Wise for your war against Varesh.
e14f49cad70d2b7878b4b3af31c7aacd1b618b58.text: 招募智者梅圖王子來對抗瓦雷什。

6d21bdbfc17e2e5f018737e220f4f754ecda2c6d.source: Persuade Prince Bokka the Magnificent to join the Sunspears in the struggle against Warmarshal Varesh.
6d21bdbfc17e2e5f018737e220f4f754ecda2c6d.text: 說服偉大的博卡王子加入陽矛軍團對抗瓦雷什元帥。

7b8120c0d8d10376293eb4ef3dbf6a28e5a09fd9.source: Coerce Prince Ahmtur the Mighty to rally against Warmarshal Varesh.
7b8120c0d8d10376293eb4ef3dbf6a28e5a09fd9.text: 強迫強大的阿姆圖爾王子集結起來對抗戰帥瓦雷什。

01543deccbe8cf8f59f6264f4f314e719b867d0c.source: Prince Ahmtur the Mighty wishes to speak with you again. Find out what he has to say.
01543deccbe8cf8f59f6264f4f314e719b867d0c.text: 強大的阿姆圖爾王子希望再次與您交談。找出他要說的話。

5579a2978c6fe25685a73be1568a22480bbe9e12.source: Defend the garden and its guests by slaying the harpies.
5579a2978c6fe25685a73be1568a22480bbe9e12.text: 殺死鷹身女妖，保衛花園及其賓客。

a9ddae3dbcaa25624bba24c13c97595aab8cfa5a.source: *Bonus* Participate in the Festival of Lyss.

9593f19a18884af9ebe3705e14e8659f45380b97.source: You have participated in [0...5] of 5 festivities.
9593f19a18884af9ebe3705e14e8659f45380b97.text: 您曾參加 5 慶祝活動的 [0...5]。

0e896bc6b015dfe6471bcd587ceee5e09794a87f.source: The aim of this mission is to try to convince the three Vabbian princes that they should join the fight against Varesh. However, to gain an audience with them, you must participate in some of the festival's mini-games. Although this can be done without any fighting, gaining the master's reward requires that you defeat at least one foe. Towards the end of the mission, you must also help the guards defeat several mobs of harpies. This means you need to bring a build that includes some damage and some self-healing.
0e896bc6b015dfe6471bcd587ceee5e09794a87f.text: 這次任務的目的是試圖說服三位瓦比亞王子加入對抗瓦雷什的戰鬥。然而，要獲得他們的觀眾，您必須參加節日的一些小遊戲。雖然這可以在不進行任何戰鬥的情況下完成，但獲得大師的獎勵需要你擊敗至少一個敵人。在任務結束時，你還必須幫助守衛擊敗幾隻鳥身女妖。這意味著你需要帶來一個包含一些損壞和一些自我修復的建置。

6d8b0a6f384ad02bd8417e54df1f6052a0bb764d.source: The quickest way to get permission to speak to the princes is:
6d8b0a6f384ad02bd8417e54df1f6052a0bb764d.text: 與王子交談的許可的最快方法是：

5d3d8ee373092dae7008a17b3ebc2ee467764d89.source: Prince Mehtu the Wise: (One of the following)
5d3d8ee373092dae7008a17b3ebc2ee467764d89.text: 智者梅圖王子：（以下之一）

ec7e564b39595ec4931f8ced83b82469a9bbe429.source: Teach his niece or nephew to dance by using the /dance emote after speaking to Dende (female characters) or Mina (male characters). This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
ec7e564b39595ec4931f8ced83b82469a9bbe429.text: 與 Dende（女性角色）或 Mina（男性角色）交談後，使用 /dance 表情教導他的侄女或侄子跳舞。這算是獎金的慶祝活動之一。

221900d2f23faa32941d55a6d273d1d4772f49a7.source: Win the Mime Duel against Lumo the Mime. This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
221900d2f23faa32941d55a6d273d1d4772f49a7.text: 贏得與默劇魯莫的默劇決鬥。這算是獎金的慶祝活動之一。

65b539b3522bd80755824b1320433f66b6f91140.source: Prince Bokka the Magnificent: (One of the following)
65b539b3522bd80755824b1320433f66b6f91140.text: 偉大的博卡王子：（以下之一）

307342fd8cb60585911a2b76391be91d3c00c77f.source: Present Royal Finance Minister Oluda with a gift of the Rare Antique Elonian Vase, obtained from Jejumba via one of the following methods. This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
307342fd8cb60585911a2b76391be91d3c00c77f.text: 向皇家財政部長奧魯達贈送稀有古董埃洛尼安花瓶作為禮物，該花瓶是透過以下方法之一從 Jejumba 獲得的。這算是獎金的慶祝活動之一。

e980f6c0f6ae11a67e53f2a5dc4115ba0cf2c9a5.source: Obtain the Golden Phoenix Feather from the Royal Guard Captain, located in the eastern corridor, by defeating him.
e980f6c0f6ae11a67e53f2a5dc4115ba0cf2c9a5.text: 擊敗位於東部走廊的皇家衛隊隊長，獲得金色 火鳳凰 羽毛。

156c629b53d2daf45fde871fdf9f00800b68b57e.source: Bribe Royal Finance Minister Oluda (cost: 5000 gold) If done after presenting the gift, this counts as another one of the festivities for the bonus as well.
156c629b53d2daf45fde871fdf9f00800b68b57e.text: 賄賂皇家財政部長奧魯達（費用：5000 金幣） 如果在贈送禮物後完成，這也算是獎金的另一項慶祝活動。

bbd701b2bb5aa0a6347f3fdefc9bbc09161d740c.source: Prince Ahmtur the Mighty: (One of the following)
bbd701b2bb5aa0a6347f3fdefc9bbc09161d740c.text: 強大的阿姆圖爾王子：（以下之一）

d52446bdd2164c0255ecf846dec764254a2e6e00.source: Defeat "Palawa Joko" in the re-enactment of the Battle of Jahai (requires fighting). This counts as one of the festivities for the bonus.
d52446bdd2164c0255ecf846dec764254a2e6e00.text: 在賈海戰役的重演中擊敗“帕勒瓦‧傑格”（需要戰鬥）。這算是獎金的慶祝活動之一。

1ea3658a5e1b45240c1f5ac1762eec7624a46980.source: Beat Zilo the Drunkard in a drinking contest (does not require combat). This counts as another one of the festivities for the bonus as well.
1ea3658a5e1b45240c1f5ac1762eec7624a46980.text: 在飲酒比賽中擊敗 酒鬼 Zilo（不需要戰鬥）。這也算是獎金的另一項慶祝活動。

11ab5841b0fdf06d77e48df6219bae252a23ca0f.source: Speak to each prince in turn, after which Ahmtur will request that you speak with him again, triggering a cinematic of a harpy invasion of the event. You will need to complete the bonus before doing this.
11ab5841b0fdf06d77e48df6219bae252a23ca0f.text: 依序與每位王子交談，之後阿姆圖爾會要求你再次與他交談，從而觸發該事件的鷹身女妖入侵的電影。在執行此操作之前，您需要完成獎金。

61f103945714d7f7eeb114df5fedc6b82402769b.source: Tihark Orchard/Guide for a detailed walkthrough To obtain the Master's Reward, you have to participate in five festival events, which in practical terms means just two more mini-games than the minimum you need to complete the primary mission. The two optional activities listed above will meet the requirements for the bonus; it is usually a choice between dueling the mime (not required for the primary mission) or spending 5000 gold on the bribe.
61f103945714d7f7eeb114df5fedc6b82402769b.text: 提哈克果園/詳細攻略指南 要獲得大師的 任務獎勵，您必須參加五個節日活動，這實際上意味著只比完成主要任務所需的最少遊戲多兩個迷你遊戲。上面列出的兩項可選活動將滿足獎金要求；通常是在與啞劇決鬥（主要任務不需要）或花費 5000 金幣進行賄賂之間做出選擇。

91368e78e4030b785d3e7c25b630213f12d4ff78.source: The mini-games work the same in hard or normal mode; only the harpy fight is different. However, in either case, you have enough support from the various guards and NPCs in the area that you just need to stay alive while leading your allies to the harpies (or pulling the foes towards your allies).
91368e78e4030b785d3e7c25b630213f12d4ff78.text: 迷你遊戲在困難或普通模式下的工作方式相同；只是鷹身女妖的戰鬥有所不同。然而，無論哪種情況，你都會從該地區的各種守衛和 NPC 獲得足夠的支援，你只需要在帶領你的盟友走向鷹身女妖（或將敵人拉向你的盟友）的同時保持活力即可。

31c98f7157f61790474b3be62a2556abcedb01e2.source: Four groups of skree will invade the orchard: one near the battle re-enactment, one at the bottom of the main stairwells, and the last near Dende and Mina's original location. To confront the invasion, you will be joined by two Palace Guards and two Vabbi Guard Captains. In addition, various NPCs will also attack the harpies, although many will flee. Even in hard mode, these allies are strong enough to defeat the skree invaders: lead the guards to each of the groups of harpies, step back a bit until the mob is killed, and repeat until the last group is killed.
31c98f7157f61790474b3be62a2556abcedb01e2.text: 四組斯克裡魚將入侵果園：一組在戰鬥重演地點附近，一組在主樓梯井的底部，最後一組在丹德和米娜原來的位置附近。為了對抗入侵，兩名宮殿守衛和兩名 瓦貝 守衛隊長將加入您的行列。此外，各種 NPC 也會攻擊鷹身女妖，儘管許多人會逃跑。即使在困難模式下，這些盟友也足夠強大，足以擊敗斯克裡入侵者：帶領守衛找到每組鷹身女妖，後退一步直到怪物被殺死，然後重複直到最後一組被殺死。

072066bade8801e550995977908942a1ad24f7b3.source: Tihark Orchard/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
072066bade8801e550995977908942a1ad24f7b3.text: 蒂哈克果園/詳細演練指南

bc75a58f6f5091677783ad716d57c8956a7f1950.source: This is a solo mission, so you need to bring some Self-healing skills.
bc75a58f6f5091677783ad716d57c8956a7f1950.text: 這是一個單人任務，所以你需要帶一些自癒技能。

f7ecd2da0eb301ad2afd760219895f302b058f22.source: Although the mission can be completed without damage-dealing skills, it goes more quickly if you bring a few.
f7ecd2da0eb301ad2afd760219895f302b058f22.text: 雖然任務可以在沒有傷害處理技能的情況下完成，但如果你帶一些技能的話，任務會完成得更快。

2d71de43454eb0dc0062c259074d5002dd0b9124.source: A spirit spammer can easily win all the fights, including the mini-games (you can typically create the spirits and proceed to the next game while these spirits kill any foes).
2d71de43454eb0dc0062c259074d5002dd0b9124.text: 精神垃圾郵件傳送者可以輕鬆贏得所有戰鬥，包括迷你遊戲（您通常可以建立精神並繼續下一場遊戲，同時這些精神殺死任何敵人）。

b525dc958787738c2a62d5df3521084dd6bbeed7.source: Speed boosts help you move quickly between the mini-games, which are spread far apart. You can also use shadow steps to jump between floors.
b525dc958787738c2a62d5df3521084dd6bbeed7.text: 速度提升可幫助您在相距較遠的迷你遊戲之間快速移動。您也可以使用影子步在樓層之間跳躍。

4abaaff844bc40ee51c2677bbb9b7a7ea4e834d8.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
4abaaff844bc40ee51c2677bbb9b7a7ea4e834d8.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Elonian 版圖 標題做出了大約 3.2% 的貢獻。

f210e9c142fa9619bdffc0fb1a8cfa1a56889d3d.source: If you let the guards by the north stairwell fall to the Harpies and leave the Harpies on the south balcony (near Dende and Mina), you can take the north stairwell to explore the entire orchard area for the Elonian Cartographer title. You can come back to the south Harpies to finish the mission after you have finished exploring. Exploring the whole map this way takes about 25 minutes with speed boosts.
f210e9c142fa9619bdffc0fb1a8cfa1a56889d3d.text: 如果你讓北樓梯井的守衛落到鷹身女妖身上，並將鷹身女妖留在南方陽臺（靠近丹德和米娜），你就可以走北樓梯井探索整個果園區域，獲得埃洛尼安 版圖 頭銜。探索完成後可以回到南鷹身女妖那裡完成任務。以這種方式探索整個地圖大約需要 25 分鐘，速度會有所提升。

318b7476c34dbdf14136cea7d5fa338169c09b14.source: Alternatively, bring Death's Retreat, Return, Heart of Shadow or Ebon Escape and shadow step past the guards (e.g. by using the skill on a dropped item).
318b7476c34dbdf14136cea7d5fa338169c09b14.text: 或者，將 致命撤退、影返、暗影之心 或 黑檀 脫逃 和暗影步帶過守衛（例如，透過對掉落的物品使用技能）。

6200e3daad6cee703d8548e88d201c52816e4316.source: Looting a Food or Drink tray before the final Harpies are killed by the guards will cause your character to be holding it in the final cinematic. This has no impact on the story.
6200e3daad6cee703d8548e88d201c52816e4316.text: 在最終的鷹身女妖被守衛殺死之前搶劫食物或飲料托盤將導致你的角色在最終的過場動畫中拿著它。這對故事沒有影響。

f7c20ef7f4488b33519a6666b9fa6f5429a7b839.source: If you leave the Harpies be and take the north-eastern way to the back of the garden, you will see the princes, Norgu, Goren, Talhkora and Vabbi Guards standing ready for the final cinematic.
f7c20ef7f4488b33519a6666b9fa6f5429a7b839.text: 如果你離開鷹身女妖並沿著東北方向到達花園後面，你會看到王子、諾爾古、高恩、塔爾科拉和 瓦貝 守衛已經準備好迎接最後的過場動畫。

46743895bd8e322145006200d099b174ad7f2170.source: Tahlkora appears in the mission as a level 12 Monk, wearing her own armor and weapons (wand and focus item).
46743895bd8e322145006200d099b174ad7f2170.text: 塔爾科拉在任務中以 12 僧侶 的身份出現，穿著她自己的盔甲和武器（魔杖和焦點物品）。

f7163b05181e0913661be0ba384f13129122562c.source: Death during this mission will cause a note to come up saying "MISSION FAILED: You died during the party. Drink responsibly next time!"
f7163b05181e0913661be0ba384f13129122562c.text: 在此任務期間死亡將導致出現一條提示，上面寫著“任務失敗：你在聚會期間死亡。下次請負責任地飲酒！”

6d7153bcbf1da59de3c0118fb29518f75c9c21f1.source: You can participate in six festival activities: the dance, the mime duel, the re-enactment, the drinking duel, obtaining the vase, and bribing the finance minister. To obtain Master's Reward, you only need to participate in five.
6d7153bcbf1da59de3c0118fb29518f75c9c21f1.text: 你可以參加六種節慶活動：舞蹈、默劇決鬥、重演、飲酒決鬥、獲得花瓶、賄賂財政部長。想要拿到Master的任務獎勵，只需要參加五個。

5e77f58a5a4828c0b24010288a3ef484698671ec.source: After completing this mission, your character will be taken to The Kodash Bazaar.
5e77f58a5a4828c0b24010288a3ef484698671ec.text: 完成此任務後，您的角色將被帶到 庫丹西市集廣場。

300871379b75e3ce7967ea8e18e8e7ca883cef77.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #7 in the Night Falls storybook.
300871379b75e3ce7967ea8e18e8e7ca883cef77.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#7 頁。

67bcd71f1c713e3f09fca5948ef8b313f232eaa2.source: Unlike Augury Rock, you can use summoning stones during this mission. As with Margrid in "No Me, No Kormir", Morgahn will call you an Istani even if you are a Prophecies or Factions character.
67bcd71f1c713e3f09fca5948ef8b313f232eaa2.text: 與 占卜之石 不同，您可以在此任務中使用召喚石。就像《No Me, No Kormir》中的 Margrid 一樣，即使您是 阿斯卡隆戰記 或 盟與敵 角色，Morgahn 也會稱您為 Istani。

75542f8f34b45d2012009bd19f586ec8761a5057.source: Meet Kehanni in the the Mirror of Lyss.
75542f8f34b45d2012009bd19f586ec8761a5057.text: 在利斯之鏡中遇見科漢尼。

0a2499fd7a1a41b764a3e557f4798428786afbd7.source: Schmooze with Bokka the Magnificent at his palace in Resplendent Makuun.
0a2499fd7a1a41b764a3e557f4798428786afbd7.text: 與博卡大帝在輝煌馬庫恩的宮殿裡閒聊。

92614801c378a71cf603ead6a0674cf90c0a5273.source: Hobnob with Vaughn the Venerable at the Bokka Amphitheatre.
92614801c378a71cf603ead6a0674cf90c0a5273.text: 在博卡露天劇場與尊者 魏嘉斯 交談。

98c39173f412e054699067ae0204fdb8cf31a69f.source: It's a trap! Defeat the Kournan elite forces.
98c39173f412e054699067ae0204fdb8cf31a69f.text: 這是一個陷阱！擊敗庫爾南精銳部隊。

77c42b8e022826a66da7e5b0e0fbbb59d9406518.source: See Royal Finance Minister Oluda for your reward.
77c42b8e022826a66da7e5b0e0fbbb59d9406518.text: 前往皇家財政部長奧魯達領取獎勵。

27725f3f638a9718b2693e6598215d57471b7e24.source: After accepting the quest from Rendu, head North out of the Kodash Bazaar through The Mirror of Lyss and follow the map to Kehanni, who is just outside of the Grand Court of Sebelkeh. Before continuing, enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh to save traveling time later.
27725f3f638a9718b2693e6598215d57471b7e24.text: 接受 Rendu 的任務後，透過 麗之鏡湖 從 Kodash Bazaar 向北走，按照地圖到達 Sebelkeh 大法院外面的 Kehanni。在繼續之前，請先進入 Sebelkeh 大法院，以節省稍後的旅行時間。

998b29b9a5349db73d2ca1b5e93fdb94677a1424.source: Exit back into The Mirror of Lyss and head southeast to enter the Honur Hill outpost.
998b29b9a5349db73d2ca1b5e93fdb94677a1424.text: 返回 麗之鏡湖 出口，然後向東南方進入 霍奴爾丘陵 前哨站。

ba077962e1c93d136bf282880a402a3c622e4640.source: Follow the map through Resplendent Makuun to talk to Prince Bokka the Magnificent, and then follow the quest marker which leads to Bokka Amphitheatre. Head through the portal and watch the play until Ernald the Exact says "This is my favorite part." - at which point the actors reveal themselves to be a Kournan ambush.
ba077962e1c93d136bf282880a402a3c622e4640.text: 沿著地圖穿過輝煌的馬庫恩與宏偉的博卡王子交談，然後按照任務標記前往博卡露天劇場。穿過傳送門觀看比賽，直到埃納德說「這是我最喜歡的部分」。 - 此時，演員們發現自己是庫南的伏擊者。

904dd67fe505015d5b9c3b3c5446ebcbaa320724.source: Once you have defeated the Kournans, travel back to Honur Hill and talk to Royal Finance Minister Oluda for your reward and the next quest (if you want to see a cinematic, approach the exit to Resplendent Makuun before map travel).
904dd67fe505015d5b9c3b3c5446ebcbaa320724.text: 一旦你擊敗了 Kournans，就回到 霍奴爾丘陵 並與皇家財政部長 Oluda 交談以獲得獎勵和下一個任務（如果你想看電影，請在地圖旅行之前接近 Resplendent Makuun 的出口）。

f3f1e31e863a7fe54468a25a12b2d57cfaaaf579.source: It is advisable, after talking to Kehanni, to proceed past her (to the northeast) and enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh. This outpost will make later exploration, quests and missions easier to complete if you can map travel to this location. Outposts exist at each corner of The Mirror of Lyss and all are important to the storyline.
f3f1e31e863a7fe54468a25a12b2d57cfaaaf579.text: 與凱漢妮交談後，建議經過她（向東北方）進入塞貝爾克大庭院。如果您可以繪製前往該位置的旅行地圖，該前哨將使以後的探索、任務和任務更容易完成。 麗之鏡湖 的每個角落都有前哨站，所有這些對故事情節都很重要。

4ec4297c7118fd2def1e746dc8b58559c24f0975.source: Tyrian players will recognize the play as a loosely told story of the events of Prophecies leading up to the refugees' arrival in Kryta
4ec4297c7118fd2def1e746dc8b58559c24f0975.text: 泰瑞亞玩家會認為該劇是一個鬆散的故事，講述了 阿斯卡隆戰記 中導致難民抵達 科瑞塔 的事件

c0c4f65f8d1a08d5eeeae122799f83f30d930ecf.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Pongmei Valley.
c0c4f65f8d1a08d5eeeae122799f83f30d930ecf.text: 在 朋美谷 中擊敗受影響者。

2273907b736599ee572caf75b2614244f229ffec.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Pongmei Valley, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
2273907b736599ee572caf75b2614244f229ffec.text: 完成此任務會改變 朋美谷 中出現的敵人，具體來說，受苦者將不再生成。

ca2b7e6354bb5b4f37d774665317e193de6826b9.source: Leave from Boreas Seabed or Maatu Keep. Follow the quest marker to an Afflicted group with an abnormally large Afflicted warrior boss; use melee counters (such as Empathy and Soothing Images). Avoid applying conditions to the boss, as it will use its only heal. You must kill all the Afflicted there, so it pays to focus on the healers first and leave the boss until the end.
ca2b7e6354bb5b4f37d774665317e193de6826b9.text: 從北風之神海底或 麻都堡壘 出發。跟隨任務標記到達一個受苦群體，那裡有一個異常龐大的受苦戰士首領；使用近戰計數器（例如自虐和意念平靜）。避免對 Boss 施加條件，因為它會使用唯一的治療。你必須殺死那裡所有的受折磨者，所以首先集中精力治療治療者並離開老闆直到最後是值得的。

855090fb9d0c97adcda8b392ae0635ab9b4f655d.source: If you wait a short while after defeating the Afflicted, you will see a Ministry Captain approach and initiate a dialogue.
855090fb9d0c97adcda8b392ae0635ab9b4f655d.text: 如果你在擊敗受折磨者後稍等片刻，你會看到部會隊長走近並發起對話。

b9bd2f07b7d023a6cdfa940fd67388478c34457e.source: Any character can simply walk into the outpost from Ice Floe and start the mission. Completing Iron Mines of Moladune also brings the party here.
b9bd2f07b7d023a6cdfa940fd67388478c34457e.text: 任何角色都可以簡單地從 浮冰 走進前哨站並開始任務。完成 莫拉登礦山 也將聚會帶到這裡。

d192cdd1b7c2e328ff674c454b6674c1938b21b3.text: 殺死達格納爾·斯通佩特。

8bf959be9c48c6aa461ac0572f73b2855a0b3581.source: Help King Jalis Ironhammer hold Thunderhead Keep.
8bf959be9c48c6aa461ac0572f73b2855a0b3581.text: 幫助 亞理斯 艾倫海默國王 按住 雷雲要塞。

187b4b5ab54ac1be0cfb2ed482ee0dd680ece689.text: 與 亞理斯 艾倫海默國王 交談。

7d53a1768ab96234594064112e3cd269b02518d4.source: *BONUS* Light the beacons to draw additional Mursaat forces into Thunderhead Keep.
7d53a1768ab96234594064112e3cd269b02518d4.text: *獎勵* 點亮信標，將額外的 馬賽特 部隊吸引到 雷雲要塞 中。

8ba5d8d544d07f9fd6ced8df62e4b740f731b7af.source: The goal is to recover the Deldrimor Dwarves' capital city and fort while protecting King Jalis Ironhammer. The mission is divided into four stages: getting to the capital, clearing it of foes, breaching the fort, and then defending it against a siege.
8ba5d8d544d07f9fd6ced8df62e4b740f731b7af.text: 目標是收復 戴爾狄摩矮人 的首都和要塞，同時保護 亞理斯 艾倫海默國王。任務分為四個階段：到達首都、清除敵人、攻破堡壘、然後防禦圍攻。

3582087f453a6200e4befc6ea65950cd3a67efb2.source: Reaching the city is straightforward: talk to King Jalis Ironhammer to open the first gate; he will then follow whichever party member talked to him first - he will follow that player until the cutscene. Cross the bridge and then head north-west. There is an incoming patrol at the end of this bridge, so pull the first mob towards the bridge and kill them before the other one arrives.
3582087f453a6200e4befc6ea65950cd3a67efb2.text: 到達城市非常簡單：與 亞理斯 艾倫海默國王 對話以開啟第一扇門；然後他將跟隨第一個與他交談的黨員 - 他將跟隨該玩家直到過場動畫。過橋，然後向西北方向行駛。這座橋的盡頭有一支巡邏隊即將到來，因此將第一批暴徒拉向橋並在另一隻暴徒到達之前殺死他們。

b1ad26dc1478f4e2a496a4605addde2ff638bc3d.source: Once inside the city, bring Jalis to the gate at the eastern side of the city and he will open it with Claim Resource. The mission objective says to clear the groups inside the city, but this is not required. Now follow the path leading to the fort.
b1ad26dc1478f4e2a496a4605addde2ff638bc3d.text: 進入城市後，將賈利斯帶到城市東側的大門，他將透過索取資源開啟大門。任務目標是清除城市內的團體，但這不是必要的。現在沿著通往堡壘的小路走。

7fb13e9ffb7c8e095a4cfa1c804eec1b618ed709.source: Defeat the Stone Summit led by Dagnar Stonepate inside the fort. When the western groups are killed, Jalis will say "Deldrimor declares war!". Killing all the fort groups triggers a cutscene, teleporting Jalis to the top of the fort; he will no longer follow the party.
7fb13e9ffb7c8e095a4cfa1c804eec1b618ed709.text: 擊敗堡壘內達格納爾·斯通佩特領導的 石峰矮人。當西方團體被殺時，賈利斯會說「戴爾狄摩 宣戰！」。殺死所有堡壘群體會觸發過場動畫，將賈利斯傳送到堡壘頂部；他將不再追隨黨。

bb9ce9a183dd5642a38c306c037029af8d0f603b.source: When Deldrimor declares war, waves of Stone Summit and Jade constructs start spawning and approaching the fort. After 2 minutes and 15 seconds, a Stone Summit boss group spawns. When this entire group dies, Jalis says "The Mantle followed you! Stand fast friends! This will be our finest hour!". Waves of White Mantle start spawning to the north of the fort, and Jade constructs near the teleporter further to the north. After exactly 3 minutes, a Mursaat boss group spawns. When this entire group dies, Jalis says "Be on your guard. The left hand of Grenth himself comes for us.". Waves of Mursaat start spawning near the teleporter. After 9 minutes and 40 seconds, Confessor Dorian and a group of White Mantle spawn near the teleporter. They take a strange route to the fort, stopping for a while to the north-east before turning back and entering through the west. Kill this entire group and then talk to Jalis to complete the mission.
bb9ce9a183dd5642a38c306c037029af8d0f603b.text: 當 戴爾狄摩 宣戰時，一波又一波的 石峰矮人 和 Jade 構造體開始生成並接近堡壘。 2 分鐘和 15 秒後，會產生 石峰矮人 Boss 群組。當整個團隊死去時，賈利斯說：「斗篷追隨你！朋友們，堅守住！這將是我們最美好的時刻！」。一波又一波的 白斗篷 開始在堡壘北邊生成，而 Jade 在更北邊的傳送器附近建造了建築。正好 3 分鐘後，馬賽特 Boss 群組就會產生。當整個團隊死亡時，賈利斯說「保持警惕。古蘭斯 的左手會來找我們。」。一波波 馬賽特 開始在傳送器附近產生。 9 分鐘和 40 秒後，大主教多利安 和一群 白斗篷 在傳送器附近產卵。他們沿著一條奇怪的路線到達堡壘，在東北方停留了一會兒，然後折回並從西邊進入。殺死整個隊伍，然後與賈利斯交談以完成任務。

90b9ffa7b3aaef0454ccd2ff024319181905883f.source: It is possible to interact with the Firing Levers to harm the waves of enemies as they approach the fort.
90b9ffa7b3aaef0454ccd2ff024319181905883f.text: 當敵人接近堡壘時，可以與發射桿互動來傷害他們。

991c8b562c8b0ecfc14846ed217c4837b02e8766.source: The bonus requires the party to prevent the death of Dwarven allies located outside the fort by lighting two Storm Beacons with Enchanted Torches that spawn after the cutscene, which draw enemies to the fort and away from the unprotected Dwarves. Both beacons are on opposite sides of the fort, on the east and west walls.
991c8b562c8b0ecfc14846ed217c4837b02e8766.text: 獎勵要求隊伍透過在過場動畫後生成的 附魔 火把點燃兩個風暴信標來防止位於堡壘外的矮人盟友死亡，這會將敵人吸引到堡壘並遠離未受保護的矮人。兩個信標分別位於堡壘的兩側、東牆上和西牆上。

ba342ecee8379e6a00f2c64ca9191fafc1d79391.source: The bonus fails if the beacons are not lit within about a minute of Deldrimor declaring war. There is enough time for a single player without speed boosts to light both beacons. Do not try to carry a torch between the beacons; otherwise the bundle will slow the runner down too much. There is a torch at either beacon, allowing the player to drop and leave the torch at the lit beacons. With more players in the party, both beacons can be lit simultaneously.
ba342ecee8379e6a00f2c64ca9191fafc1d79391.text: 如果 戴爾狄摩 宣戰後約一分鐘內信標未點亮，則獎勵失敗。對於沒有速度提升的單一玩家來說，有足夠的時間點亮兩個信標。不要試圖在信標之間攜帶火炬；否則捆綁包會使跑步者減慢太多。兩個信標處都有一個火炬，允許玩家將火炬放下並留在點亮的信標處。隨著隊伍中玩家的增多，兩個信標可以同時點亮。

10f76db03b67d6f3820a2aef15b02f8a04e489e7.source: Unfortunately, the quest log does not update on the Dwarves' survival. The only indication the bonus was failed is if the Dwarves cry out, "The end is here! Great Dwarf save us!" If that text does not appear in party chat, it is an indirect confirmation of success.
10f76db03b67d6f3820a2aef15b02f8a04e489e7.text: 不幸的是，任務日誌沒有更新矮人的生存情況。獎金失敗的唯一跡像是矮人喊道：「末日來了！偉大矮人 救救我們！」如果該文字沒有出現在群組聊天中，則間接確認成功。

6e920364728c8f9c2ec029384bd31982ef5428dd.source: Once the last attacker dies, the quest log will update, and a quest marker will appear over Ironhammer's head. Speaking with him concludes the mission. The bonus will be awarded at that point, if it was completed successfully.
6e920364728c8f9c2ec029384bd31982ef5428dd.text: 一旦最後一個攻擊者死亡，任務日誌就會更新，並且任務標記將出現在鐵鎚的頭上。與他交談就結束了任務。如果成功完成，獎金將在此時頒發。

5f764fc74a61c1fafb45dfdb0d1bfbb6d159ad23.source: Split the party into two groups to block each gate; this keeps the King safely away. The courtyard's width prevents the two groups from working together, but they will be close enough that one or two members can run back and forth to assist. Ranged characters can fight from atop the walls. Use the ballistae to weaken foes before they reach a gate.
5f764fc74a61c1fafb45dfdb0d1bfbb6d159ad23.text: 將隊伍分成兩組，封鎖每個大門；這可以讓國王安全地遠離。庭院的寬度阻止了兩個小組一起工作，但他們足夠近，一兩個成員可以來回跑來幫忙。 遠距 角色可以在城牆上進行戰鬥。在敵人到達大門之前使用弩砲削弱敵人。

549e3e3657d84ed3be1262508b1044525f88b073.source: Pro: The King is never at risk.
549e3e3657d84ed3be1262508b1044525f88b073.text: 優點：國王永遠不會面臨風險。

7ed20e74e7ee647c86912e343c45fad0cb641146.source: Con: The split groups are weak against strong assaults.
7ed20e74e7ee647c86912e343c45fad0cb641146.text: 缺點：分裂的群體對於強力攻擊來說很弱。

cfd9a1a785f8882a6ad18b445705d800986d8e4b.source: Hold your ground between the center beacon and the King. Regardless from which gate these small mobs enter, they always converge at the top of the stairs. However, if enemies enter the King's aggro area, he will join the fight, which makes him difficult to protect as he will not move back.
cfd9a1a785f8882a6ad18b445705d800986d8e4b.text: 堅守在中心燈塔和國王之間。這些小怪物無論從哪扇門進入，總是會聚集在樓梯頂上。然而，如果敵人進入國王的仇恨區域，他就會加入戰鬥，這使得他很難保護，因為他不會後退。

b6c0fec10dba47287b8cf6f77b107f7ef43ccb36.source: Pro: The party outnumbers enemies. Easier to manage with heroes and henchmen.
b6c0fec10dba47287b8cf6f77b107f7ef43ccb36.text: 優點：黨的數量多於敵人。更容易管理英雄和追隨者。

cd2a312489403cdedb5ea7d210ec211330b65ed4.source: Con: The King will be at risk. Also, the King will run after enemies if they get in his range and may take some time to return to his normal position.
cd2a312489403cdedb5ea7d210ec211330b65ed4.text: 缺點：國王將面臨危險。此外，如果敵人進入他的射程，國王會追趕敵人，並且可能需要一些時間才能恢復正常位置。

9ebbe6f0e169c11314c70efdacc578e4c72d6cda.source: Parties with strong firepower can push back the incoming waves to their spawn point to the north since they all pass through a choke point. Players will stand at full force while keeping the King completely away from battle. Jades along the way (not the ones that spawn) can be ignored, as they are part of the bonus and will not attack the King. Single foes that split during this procedure can be killed by Smoke Phantom allies.
9ebbe6f0e169c11314c70efdacc578e4c72d6cda.text: 擁有強大火力的隊伍可以將來襲的海浪推回其北部的重生點，因為它們都會經過阻塞點。玩家將全力站立，同時讓國王完全遠離戰鬥。沿途的玉石（不是生成的玉石）可以忽略，因為它們是獎勵的一部分，不會攻擊國王。過程中分裂的單一敵人可以被 灰色幽靈 盟友殺死。

e37f4711a24e4a12e767404f7cf362922f14c10a.source: Pro: Allows the party to be at full strength.
e37f4711a24e4a12e767404f7cf362922f14c10a.text: 優點：讓隊伍處於全力狀態。

12072076860853f5a97d10ca97db0b1fcea06bae.source: Con: Difficult in Hard mode to reach the Mursaat teleporter or to regroup if any foe slips.
12072076860853f5a97d10ca97db0b1fcea06bae.text: 缺點：在 困難模式 中很難到達 馬賽特 傳送器，或在任何敵人滑倒時很難重新集結。

c5f3743b5dced55e0d35ff6a30df2e488e66b9f7.source: Although the foes are considerably more difficult in hard mode, the techniques are the same. Keep a more careful eye on the king's health throughout the mission.
c5f3743b5dced55e0d35ff6a30df2e488e66b9f7.text: 儘管困難模式的敵人要困難得多，但技術是相同的。在整個任務過程中要更密切地關注國王的健康狀況。

efa7272285797c6fba57dea48f888ea32d8b2225.source: Ward of Stability to counter Summit Giant Herders's Giant Stomp.
efa7272285797c6fba57dea48f888ea32d8b2225.text: 穩定結界 對抗高峰會 馴服的霜巨人 牧民的 重踩。

0ccce97e01b51a37d3b8f3a4a6499400896fa86a.text: 僕從/靈魂數量超過敵人。

11ab58fd4b696d862dc210a5259a0f853ef33179.source: AoE skills, especially if using the defend the king method.
11ab58fd4b696d862dc210a5259a0f853ef33179.text: 範圍性技能，尤其是使用守王法時。

4a0e311f2c1c624c70632adcb0e0138603c103d8.source: Hex removal skills, or the king will often die from hex overload.
4a0e311f2c1c624c70632adcb0e0138603c103d8.text: 去除妖術的技能，否則國王經常會因妖術過載而死亡。

be453a06a41da10a91b58d9917d8aac309be002a.source: When facing Dagnar there are two walls which each hold two ballistae. The ballista on the left can be fired to kill a mob of eight enemies before killing Dagnar, giving you fewer enemies to fight in the siege.
be453a06a41da10a91b58d9917d8aac309be002a.text: 當面對達格納爾時，有兩面牆，每面牆都有兩把弩砲。在殺死達格納爾之前，可以發射左側的弩砲來殺死八名敵人，從而減少圍攻中需要戰鬥的敵人。

63ec208d2118d39b0c110199fd29e488690e4774.source: The siege portion of the mission can be managed (even in hard mode) without effort by a player with 7 heroes/henchmen (i.e. while AFK):
63ec208d2118d39b0c110199fd29e488690e4774.text: 任務的攻城部分可以由擁有 7 英雄/追隨者的玩家輕鬆管理（即使在困難模式下）（即 AFK 時）：

5b882359e7016253a19d2e3edf0151da4ef789d6.source: Flag heroes at the top of the stairs, somewhat apart.
5b882359e7016253a19d2e3edf0151da4ef789d6.text: 在樓梯頂部標記英雄，稍稍分開。

ec9cf72e2f0b9b3829bb84bab7dfca759d454fbb.text: 將他們的模式更改為戰鬥。

2d3d6901fc4509e8d1fc891de03886e391e44f8b.source: Ensure you have a balanced party.
2d3d6901fc4509e8d1fc891de03886e391e44f8b.text: 確保你有一個平衡的聚會。

2f6310d8462df2a8639658fd5c02608a77342abd.source: This is the first of only four missions required to reach the end of the Prophecies storyline.
2f6310d8462df2a8639658fd5c02608a77342abd.text: 這是到達 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事情節結尾所需的四個任務中的第一個。

58126e77be9b31361d6931a73bba734f6cbd984f.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
58126e77be9b31361d6931a73bba734f6cbd984f.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.1% 的貢獻。

b52c7866f00c4e88209541e1c7a70c19ecddcdef.source: You can easily explore the north part of the map after Confessor Dorian has been killed. No more mobs will spawn after him, and the mission will not end until you speak to King Jalis.
b52c7866f00c4e88209541e1c7a70c19ecddcdef.text: 大主教多利安 被殺死後，您可以輕鬆探索地圖的北部部分。在他之後不會再出現任何小怪，並且在您與賈利斯國王交談之前任務不會結束。

3a6f0c537b97f8f01738d2ed140d4b3f979514e7.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #15 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
3a6f0c537b97f8f01738d2ed140d4b3f979514e7.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#15 頁。

60e0f935884e78cc34cfc6322c5f0926836dbc1b.source: After completing this mission, your party travels to Ember Light Camp using the Mursaat teleporter.
60e0f935884e78cc34cfc6322c5f0926836dbc1b.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍使用 馬賽特 傳送器前往 殘火營地。

a1228c97fd9eeb65ac2448647d36d4e879ecc2ed.source: Sometimes King Jalis Ironhammer will get stuck on a hill near the beginning of the mission. If this occurs, you must restart the mission, and try again. Sometimes if you take the bonus the first boss will stay outside the walls. Even if you kill that mob the spawns will stop. If this occurs, you must restart the mission, and try again. King Jalis may open the gates to the fort before killing all the mobs of city foes. After you clear the fort, the first objective will be counted as completed and you can complete the mission with remaining foes in the city. The extra foes sent to the fort from the Bonus are hostile towards all other enemies, even of the same kind. The bonus timer can be started before the cutscene depending on which foes you kill first. This will cause you to easily fail the bonus due to not enough time. The White Mantle and Mursaat foes that are supposedly spawned from the portal at the northernmost point of the mission actually appear in the clearing just south of the portal before running up to it and then starting their patrol route.
a1228c97fd9eeb65ac2448647d36d4e879ecc2ed.text: 有時，亞理斯 艾倫海默國王 會在任務開始時被困在一座小山上。如果發生這種情況，您必須重新啟動任務，然後再試一次。有時，如果你拿了獎金，第一個老闆會留在牆外。即使你殺死了那個怪物，生成也會停止。如果發生這種情況，您必須重新啟動任務，然後再試一次。賈利斯國王可能會在殺死所有城市敵人之前開啟堡壘的大門。清除堡壘後，第一個目標將被視為已完成，您可以與城市中剩餘的敵人一起完成任務。從 額外獎勵 傳送到堡壘的額外敵人對所有其他敵人充滿敵意，即使是同類敵人也是如此。獎勵計時器可以在過場動畫之前啟動，這取決於您首先殺死的敵人。這會導致你很容易因為時間不夠而無法獲得獎金。據稱是從任務最北端的傳送門生成的 白斗篷 和 馬賽特 敵人實際上出現在傳送門南邊的空地中，然後跑到傳送門並開始巡邏路線。

64902fef63b0a06b94b116661c28896450f992e8.source: During the ending cinematic, the Undead Lich and Spoiler-related boss can be seen near a cave to the north guarded by some jade.
64902fef63b0a06b94b116661c28896450f992e8.text: 在結尾動畫中，可以在北部的一個洞穴附近看到 不死系 巫妖和劇透相關的 Boss，該洞穴由一些玉石守衛。

e4ee273d5a5ffb1c1405fac535537280b6d26b31.source: Completion of Minister Cho's Estate mission to gain access to Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area).
e4ee273d5a5ffb1c1405fac535537280b6d26b31.text: 完成趙部長莊園任務，進入趙部長莊園（可探索區域）。

48537dace98dea3036d1afa82af09230d00d1194.source: Search for survivors at Minister Cho's Estate.
48537dace98dea3036d1afa82af09230d00d1194.text: 在趙部長的莊園尋找倖存者。

96c6d2808fbf2de2709179f44380d57440395b21.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Minister Cho's Estate. Afflicted will no longer spawn, being replaced by Scavengers.
96c6d2808fbf2de2709179f44380d57440395b21.text: 完成此任務會改變出現在趙部長莊園中的敵人。受折磨的生物將不再生成，取而代之的是拾荒者。

1db71b6ac4ef7f952600d39320672381cff15fb4.source: Start from Ran Musu Gardens and take the northern exit. There are three peasants whom you have to save: one is in the Menagerie, one is in the Foh Wing, and one is on the island to the northeast. You must kill all the mobs near each peasant for the quest to progress - if you don't get the update dialogue, keep hunting.
1db71b6ac4ef7f952600d39320672381cff15fb4.text: 從 嵐穆蘇花園 出發，從北出口走。你必須拯救三位農夫：一位在動物園，一位在福翼，一位在東北部的島上。你必須殺死每個農民附近的所有小怪才能取得進展 - 如果你沒有收到更新對話，請繼續狩獵。

238b8bbaca0f3b957a20fe7b3d770f77b361272b.source: Most Afflicted mobs in this area are groups of four and can be taken down by a moderately powerful party, but the mobs are close together and their patrol patterns can overlap. Careful pulling is essential to avoid being overwhelmed, especially for the first few groups near the start.
238b8bbaca0f3b957a20fe7b3d770f77b361272b.text: 該地區大多數受影響的生物都是四人一組，可以被中等實力的隊伍擊倒，但這些生物距離很近，巡邏模式可能會重疊。小心拉動對於避免被淹沒至關重要，特別是對於開始時的前幾組。

1d3def71dc36a97296d69a23bb8cbedbee95f35e.source: After rescuing the first peasant the player can choose between two paths on the way to the second peasant: The short northern path or the longer and more difficult southern path.
1d3def71dc36a97296d69a23bb8cbedbee95f35e.text: 在拯救第一個農民後，玩家可以在前往第二個農民的兩條路徑之間進行選擇：較短的北方路徑或較長且更困難的南方路徑。

f94f5e8c083ef8518b301c1d2bbef75ab16c46be.source: The shorter northern path is filled with yet more Sickened animals.
f94f5e8c083ef8518b301c1d2bbef75ab16c46be.text: 較短的北邊小路充滿了更多生病的動物。

a09acc9a1b47c066bf096b0c0712ddeed2c034f1.source: The longer southern path, which heads south before U-turning back up north, is filled with Afflicted, which are tougher than the animals with more diverse skills.
a09acc9a1b47c066bf096b0c0712ddeed2c034f1.text: 較長的南部道路向南延伸，然後掉頭返回北方，充滿了受折磨的動物，它們比具有更多樣化技能的動物更堅韌。

baad622ed1f91803264b7bb4d36f7844d34174e9.source: The player should pick the path that is easiest for their party's design. After saving the second peasant, the player has two options when saving the last peasant: the beach path and the island path.
baad622ed1f91803264b7bb4d36f7844d34174e9.text: 玩家應該選擇最適合其隊伍設計的路徑。在拯救第二個農民後，玩家在拯救最後一個農民時有兩個選擇：海灘路徑和島嶼路徑。

738d1aeb473924b49fa813498ed99adcce2980c0.source: Eliminate any Assassins first - they will likely shadow step to your party and away from their allies.
738d1aeb473924b49fa813498ed99adcce2980c0.text: 首先消滅所有刺客——他們可能會暗步到你的隊伍中並遠離他們的盟友。

6e7079f35f192425b8f188830c416f2be166204e.source: Pull each group of Afflicted, this will assist in moving any Ritualists away from their spirits and can help avoid over-aggro due to close placement of Afflicted groups.
6e7079f35f192425b8f188830c416f2be166204e.text: 拉出 每組受影響者，這將有助於使任何儀式者遠離他們的精神，並有助於避免因受影響者群體的緊密放置而導致過度仇恨。

6700adaa255cacac4cfa149917615daf5ad4226f.source: Spirit spammers and minion masters are very helpful, since you are limited to four party members.
6700adaa255cacac4cfa149917615daf5ad4226f.text: 精神垃圾郵件傳送者和僕從大師非常有幫助，因為你的隊伍成員僅限於四名。

37d23b418250cfa0a7cbf0ca369a4ddcbcfc7764.source: Proceed slowly. If using spirits, wait for them to recharge so you can setup spirit walls.
37d23b418250cfa0a7cbf0ca369a4ddcbcfc7764.text: 慢慢地進行。如果使用靈魂，請等待它們充電，以便您可以設定靈魂牆。

c27039320ada39c0a5ee8f2bd0ec13e7eaf734c8.source: If using heros, follow the yellow path - the other route has points where the heroes will not listen to flags.
c27039320ada39c0a5ee8f2bd0ec13e7eaf734c8.text: 如果使用英雄，請沿著黃色路徑走 - 另一條路線有英雄不會聽旗幟的點。
