7bb1b6db97eac6fbecf22e61589ded5c8c6d06bd.source: Consider consumables such as Death Penalty removal and/or summoning stones.
7bb1b6db97eac6fbecf22e61589ded5c8c6d06bd.text: 考慮消耗品，例如消除死刑和/或召喚石。

e4e48854e24a2b6c542e25ada443f3af1883bd84.source: Quest markers do not display the peasants' locations. The final dialogue "our work here is done" can be shown and the quest can still fail. This happens when you lure Afflicted far away from the last peasant and kill this group of Afflicted when the peasant is outside the party area.
e4e48854e24a2b6c542e25ada443f3af1883bd84.text: 任務 標記不顯示農民的位置。可以顯示最終對話“我們的工作已經完成”，但任務仍然可能失敗。當你將受苦者引誘到遠離最後一個農民並在農民位於聚會區域之外時殺死這群受苦者時，就會發生這種情況。

2e074799ad1b65a0bd5a184e211740f38de0dab1.text: 警告科漢尼瓦雷什的軍隊。

f103bdca6e67a6b20da01dd7a1adc50fbf20a7c7.source: Destroy the vanguard assaulting the temple.
f103bdca6e67a6b20da01dd7a1adc50fbf20a7c7.text: 消滅襲擊聖殿的先鋒隊。

6bdabc313926460690758d5d667e08b4ee31c8a4.source: See Head Priest Vahmani for your reward.
6bdabc313926460690758d5d667e08b4ee31c8a4.text: 去見祭司長瓦赫瑪尼以獲得獎勵。

318c36761965590e9193aa758840fe3096f38d67.source: This quest will lead you to Grand Court of Sebelkeh if you don't already have it on your World Map. If you do have it, map travel to it, exit west into the Mirror of Lyss and follow the quest arrow to meet Kehanni nearby.
318c36761965590e9193aa758840fe3096f38d67.text: 如果你的世界地圖上還沒有塞貝爾克大庭院，這個任務將引導你前往它。如果你確實擁有它，請在地圖上前往它，向西退出進入利斯之鏡，然後按照任務箭頭在附近與凱漢尼會面。

f249cec85544bf2812eb48a390830180f7d78a6a.source: A mob of Margonites led by the Paragon boss, Overseer Juntahk, are also nearby and as you approach Kehanni, they will start to advance towards her. Defeat the Margonites to continue the quest. It's worth noting that Kehanni is accompanied by three level 20 Lyssan Priests who are monks, staying near them and allowing the Margonites to approach instead, ensures the party can remain fully healed throughout the fight.
f249cec85544bf2812eb48a390830180f7d78a6a.text: 由 聖言者 首領、督軍 Juntahk 領導的一群瑪貢教徒也在附近，當你接近 Kehanni 時，他們將開始向她前進。擊敗瑪貢尼特以繼續任務。值得注意的是，Kehanni 身邊有三名 20 Lyssan 牧師，他們是僧侶，留在他們附近並允許 Margonites 接近，確保隊伍在整個戰鬥中保持完全治癒。

475f1885b933ac6c5a39acb15e21c857988e7c37.text: 殺死內部議會成員阿蓋爾。

7030c4e3dba92e99341e110dbacfeac076b78094.text: 殺死內部委員會成員玻利瓦爾。

ab6936d11977ef152b48fe4a955efcb7757f1d09.text: 殺死內部議會成員卡斯伯特。

d66ef29bf11e848d9d33819f30b316a5181d773a.source: See Fogard Axemighty for your reward.
d66ef29bf11e848d9d33819f30b316a5181d773a.text: 請參閱 Fogard Axemighty 以獲得獎勵。

350b46b0b32f9b5b6f0dee62ea6e0074ac160b75.source: After accepting this quest's reward, the Inner Council Members (Argyle, Bolivar, and Cuthbert) and White Mantle will no longer spawn in Perdition Rock.
350b46b0b32f9b5b6f0dee62ea6e0074ac160b75.text: 接受此任務的獎勵後，內部議會成員（阿蓋爾、玻利瓦爾和卡斯伯特）和 白斗篷 將不再在 破滅石 中產生。

be32f511f9b7c45558b193fc306151c4b79a65c7.source: This quest may prove difficult for players discovering Perdition Rock for the first time due to the high density of foes and patrols that can easily cause aggro.
be32f511f9b7c45558b193fc306151c4b79a65c7.text: 對於第一次發現 破滅石 的玩家來說，這個任務可能會很困難，因為敵人和巡邏隊的密度很高，很容易引起仇恨。

e017bf2335149253bbec8cf3c1c02e3e1ab81ab2.source: Exit Ember Light Camp into Perdition Rock. The first area has many patrols of Mahgo Hydras, Flesh Golems and Dark Flame Dryders that will gather in front of you, then go counterclockwise around the central pit of lava.
e017bf2335149253bbec8cf3c1c02e3e1ab81ab2.text: 從 殘火營地 退出到 破滅石。第一個區域有許多馬戈九頭蛇、血肉傀儡和暗焰烘乾機的巡邏隊，它們會聚集在你面前，然後繞著中央熔岩坑逆時針移動。

0e7abfc0c04e95e0785af171ea2c59d643030218.source: It is possible to follow them and clear them one by one, but it is faster to wait until after the last patrol of Flesh Golems is gone and head north, with only a lone hydra that may spawn along the way.
0e7abfc0c04e95e0785af171ea2c59d643030218.text: 可以追蹤它們並一一清除它們，但等到最後一批血肉魔像消失後向北前進會更快，因為沿途可能會生成一隻孤獨的九頭蛇。

825c8a9c2964914d63d9993c86bfcc2329c94971.source: Be careful around the Mahgo Hydras, as they possess Meteor Shower. Either spread your team, or interrupt the skill, but note that their elite Glyph of Renewal may cause it to recharge instantly.
825c8a9c2964914d63d9993c86bfcc2329c94971.text: 小心 Mahgo Hydra，因為它們擁有 隕石雨。要麼分散你的團隊，要麼中斷技能，但請注意他們的精英 再生符號 可能會導致其立即充電。

cf247db6b4d0fc5e4f416bdf6bcef70197c780c7.source: You should arrive at your first Ether Seal. It is an Air Magic elementalist foe that is a massive annoyance to spellcasters due to its ward effect Mursaat Tower causing high energy denial and enchantment removal. You should try to deal as much damage as possible and as quickly as possible. Martial professions are at an advantage; a Ranger with a longbow or flatbow can do significant damage to the seal without needing to enter the ward, by standing on the promontory, and a warrior can rely on adrenaline skills to get damage through. Some Jade Bows and another group of foes are also in the vicinity, but it is generally possible to engage the Ether Seal without aggroing them.
cf247db6b4d0fc5e4f416bdf6bcef70197c780c7.text: 您應該到達第一個 結界封印。它是一個 風系魔法 元素敵人，對施法者來說是一個巨大的煩惱，因為它的守衛效果 馬賽特 塔會導致高能量拒絕和結界移除。你應該嘗試盡可能快地造成盡可能多的傷害。武術職業有優勢；長弓或扁弓的 遊俠 無需進入防護區，站在海角上即可對海豹造成重大傷害，而戰士可以依靠腎上腺素技能來獲得傷害。一些玉弓和另一群敵人也在附近，但通常可以在不攻擊他們的情況下與 結界封印 交戰。

a03123738c6101d17d89346c49ea84c28204cd25.source: Then take the central road to the northwest, defeating the members of the White Mantle along the way. Aside from a few Breeze Keepers, most of the wildlife of Perdition Rock can be avoided.
a03123738c6101d17d89346c49ea84c28204cd25.text: 然後沿著中央路向西北走，一路擊敗白斗篷的成員。除了少數微風守護者外，破滅石 的野生動物大多可以避開。

d1405038648281f5ac6bda136e0ed6eebc4a18e4.source: Eventually you should arrive at the docks, with the three members of the inner council, one Warrior and two Mesmer bosses, atop a shrine guarded by two pull-able groups of White Mantle. The bosses are not part of the surrounding groups, so you can safely clear the area before running up the steps and take on the bosses.
d1405038648281f5ac6bda136e0ed6eebc4a18e4.text: 最終你應該到達碼頭，與內部議會的三名成員（一名 戰士 和兩名 幻術師 首領）一起到達由兩支可拉動的 白斗篷 小組守衛的神殿頂部。首領不屬於周圍群體，因此您可以安全地清理該區域，然後跑上臺階並對抗首領。

9eb575b6cae26d5b64e73574d91665fc2a266e2f.source: After the fight, talk to Captain Grumby who will send the party directly to the Ring of Fire.
9eb575b6cae26d5b64e73574d91665fc2a266e2f.text: 戰鬥結束後，與格魯比隊長交談，他將直接將隊伍送往 火環群島。

8251bc65833e4b06757248c24172861f0685c63d.source: If you have killed the council but keep the quest in your Quest Log without accepting the reward, then the council and the White Mantle will still spawn when you revisit Perdition Rock but you don't need to kill them again in order to have Captain Grumby send you to the Ring of Fire.
8251bc65833e4b06757248c24172861f0685c63d.text: 如果您殺死了議會，但將任務保留在 任務 日誌中而不接受獎勵，那麼當您重新訪問 破滅石 時，議會和 白斗篷 仍會生成，但您不需要再次殺死它們，以便讓格魯比船長將您送至 火環群島。

88b654ba3aad493e223ea34886c2b2505d920351.source: You must have chosen Margrid the Sly during Mysterious Message.
88b654ba3aad493e223ea34886c2b2505d920351.text: 您必須在 機密資訊 期間選擇了狡猾的瑪格麗特。

1a62c801bf524219478c0972fb854d6782d3727c.source: Search the Halls of Chokhin with Margrid. Look for information on the Hidden City.
1a62c801bf524219478c0972fb854d6782d3727c.text: 與瑪格麗特一起搜尋喬欣大廳。尋找有關隱藏 城市 的資訊。

ca50bffbd5230e01d85a1254d566531ad6d21b57.source: Pick up and examine the "Duality of Lyssa."
ca50bffbd5230e01d85a1254d566531ad6d21b57.text: 拿起並檢查「麗莎 的二元性」。

9c5f8126ba057631d120345d1ce7e066499ee90b.source: Find Goren in the Mirror of Lyss.
9c5f8126ba057631d120345d1ce7e066499ee90b.text: 在里斯之鏡中找到 高恩。

33b492716cafc4dab2438099ac414ad91848be59.source: Do the magic dance to gain entrance to the Hidden City of Ahdashim. (Use the /dance emote near the spot marked by Goren.)
33b492716cafc4dab2438099ac414ad91848be59.text: 跳魔法舞蹈，進入 Ahdashim 的隱藏 城市。 （在 高恩 標記的位置附近使用 /dance 表情。）

b703222fe370296e8d11777b1792a68a4ae6ffbd.source: Speak to the Lock of Ahdashim.

9ae5638a4b12f0950662d6333e6c9efad8d50bcf.source: See Lock of Ahdashim for your reward.
9ae5638a4b12f0950662d6333e6c9efad8d50bcf.text: 前往艾哈達希姆之鎖獲取獎勵。

094a842eb84131213bcd8c39e0508fe504df8416.source: Start from the Grand Court of Sebelkeh outpost, and head north west through Mihanu Township into the Holdings of Chokhin. Once there, follow the quest pointer to "explore" for clues, then head into the Halls of Chokhin to pick up and examine the Duality of Lyssa.
094a842eb84131213bcd8c39e0508fe504df8416.text: 從 Sebelkeh 前哨站的大庭院出發，往西北方向穿過 米哈努小鎮 進入 舟克辛卷藏室。到達那裡後，請按照任務指標「探索」線索，然後前往 Chokhin 大廳，拿起並檢查 麗莎 的二元性。

7464c0ec49eb02e3bf1155d4b08d77e427f91013.source: Clicking on the Duality will spawn the library defenses in the form of several Djinn, of which the fire elementalist Ruby Djinn are probably the most dangerous and should be defeated first. Since the djinn only spawn when the Duality is examined, your party can setup or prepare skills first. After defeating the library defenses, Goren will direct you to meet him in the Mirror of Lyss explorable zone. Although the conversation between Margrid and Goren is triggered by picking up the book and will suggest the party proceed immediately to the Mirror of Lyss, the player must talk to Goren to update the quest after the conversation and prior to leaving Holdings of Chokhin.
7464c0ec49eb02e3bf1155d4b08d77e427f91013.text: 點選 Duality 會在幾個 巨靈怪 的 型態 中產生庫防禦，其中火元素師 紅寶石巨靈 可能是最危險的，應該先擊敗。由於巨靈僅在檢查二元性時產生，因此您的隊伍可以先設定或準備技能。擊敗圖書館防禦後，高恩 將引導您在里斯之鏡探索區與他會面。雖然瑪格麗特和 高恩 之間的對話是透過拿起這本書觸發的，並且會建議隊伍立即前往裡斯之鏡，但玩家必須在對話之後和離開 舟克辛卷藏室 之前與 高恩 交談以更新任務。

7414735de7786ad3ea78d4f39d7fb86b71b0a6cb.source: On meeting Goren, perform a magic dance (use the /dance emote) to summon the Lock of Ahdashim and open the way into the Dasha Vestibule outpost to collect your reward.
7414735de7786ad3ea78d4f39d7fb86b71b0a6cb.text: 當您遇到 高恩 時，表演一段魔法舞蹈（使用 /dance 表情）來召喚阿達希姆之鎖，開啟進入 達沙走廊 前哨站的道路來領取獎勵。

c90ff5c7b21275154c2ea0f915426a597bc0d509.source: A cinematic between Varesh and General Morgahn will be triggered after speaking to the Lock of Ahdashim.
c90ff5c7b21275154c2ea0f915426a597bc0d509.text: 與艾哈達希姆之鎖交談後，將會觸發瓦雷什和 摩根將軍 之間的過場動畫。

2496050a35e6b8d7662985c64aa19e9276f0ff59.source: The quest pointer will not be present if you do not have the hero Margrid the Sly present in your party.
2496050a35e6b8d7662985c64aa19e9276f0ff59.text: 如果你的隊伍中沒有英雄狡猾的瑪格麗特，任務指標就不會出現。

5994f55c92fb01b4a5bae7699452e7004b628c7d.source: The Vabbian Scout just outside Mihanu Township gives a plant hunt blessing, which is quite useful since the route to the first objective is patrolled by several plant creatures.
5994f55c92fb01b4a5bae7699452e7004b628c7d.text: 米哈努小鎮 外的瓦比安偵察兵給予植物狩獵祝福，這非常有用，因為通往第一個目標的路線有幾個植物生物巡邏。

bf6f87b3226c9b774106a1ae84d660b9ccc3d1ba.source: In Halls of Chokhin, you can also take a quest Botanical Research from Librarian Kahnu just near the Duality of Lyssa.
bf6f87b3226c9b774106a1ae84d660b9ccc3d1ba.text: 在 Chokhin 大廳中，您還可以從 麗莎 的二元性附近的圖書館員卡努那裡接取植物研究任務。

388f209dd7a2be41bfdd1cb5a285104c08fcd127.source: When going to meet Goren to have the secret entrance revealed, Honur Hill is the closest outpost to proceed from, which you will almost certainly have passed through earlier during the All's Well That Ends Well primary quest.
388f209dd7a2be41bfdd1cb5a285104c08fcd127.text: 當前往與 高恩 會面以揭開秘密入口時，霍奴爾丘陵 是最近的前哨站，您幾乎肯定會在「一切順利，結局順利」主線任務中早先經過這裡。

5b750801091e067cebded95dd3f0b949f0b23a60.source: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is through Final Blow.
5b750801091e067cebded95dd3f0b949f0b23a60.text: 進入任務沒有任何要求，但訪問前哨站的唯一方法是透過 最後一擊。

388ef3ab1043cb3e0e5080ba017a117c0e826d6d.source: Establish a foothold on the Ring of Fire Island Chain
388ef3ab1043cb3e0e5080ba017a117c0e826d6d.text: 在 火環群島 島鏈上建立立足點

2b23091050bcd6f9940322bb5152ed1b66e0a8a6.source: Gain access to the Citadel Guardhouse

1f3dd9d37274af7adc874e5791e41eeac5029916.source: To activate the bonus, speak to the Ancient Seer found by the northern turn of the first fork. The Ancient Seer tells you to bring the Spectral Essence from an Eidolon who will appear once the four towers of the Citadel Guardhouse are deactivated. Take the Spectral Essence to the Ancient Seer to complete the bonus. This Ancient Seer will infuse your armor.
1f3dd9d37274af7adc874e5791e41eeac5029916.text: 要啟動獎勵，請與第一個岔路口北轉處發現的遠古 預言者 交談。古代 預言者 告訴您要從 艾多倫 取得光譜 模板:Reclaim Essence，一旦城堡警衛室的四座塔被停用，艾多倫 就會出現。將Spectral 模板:Reclaim Essence帶到Ancient 預言者即可完成獎勵。這款古老的 預言者 將注入您的盔甲。

faf04be998405aff9a8106a76af4365a5a506b10.source: When players pick up the Spectral Essence, the quest log will update to say the bonus is complete. However, players will not receive credit for bonus until the party member carrying the Essence takes it to the Ancient Seer.
faf04be998405aff9a8106a76af4365a5a506b10.text: 當玩家拿起 Spectral 模板:Reclaim Essence 時，任務日誌將更新以表示獎勵已完成。然而，在攜帶 模板:Reclaim Essence 的隊伍成員將其帶到古代 預言者 之前，玩家不會收到獎勵積分。

ab75572fa8023c8eac58bd67dedc5f304c093c6d.source: To counter the Mursaat Towers energy drain, use Glyph of Lesser Energy, signets and adrenaline-based damage. Healers can stand out of range and use party healing spells. A Signet of Spirits-based build can be used to destroy the Ether Seals without the need of staying inside the energy drain radius.
ab75572fa8023c8eac58bd67dedc5f304c093c6d.text: 若要對抗 馬賽特 塔的能量消耗，請使用 微能符號、印章和基於腎上腺素的傷害。治療師可以站在射程之外並使用隊伍治療法術。基於 縛靈紋章 的建置可用於摧毀以太封印，而無需停留在能量消耗半徑內。

f36129f63ea4d4857117c3e35cb7469d8593952b.source: Stance breaker skills e.g. Wild Blow to remove Dryder's Defenses from Lava Spitters (if taking the back road), Whirling Defense from Jade Bows, and Physical Resistance/Mantra of Flame from Mursaat Mesmers.
f36129f63ea4d4857117c3e35cb7469d8593952b.text: 態勢 斷路器技能，例如狂暴一擊 從熔岩噴射器中移除 蛛化精靈防禦（如果走後路），從 Jade Bows 移除 旋風防禦，以及從 馬賽特 幻術師移除 物理抵抗/火焰頌歌。

11914354b450f95689aa975a38717f2caa2fd33e.source: The four Mursaat and two Jade bosses will always appear during the mission in one of the six shared spawn points.
11914354b450f95689aa975a38717f2caa2fd33e.text: 任務期間，四個 馬賽特 和兩個 Jade Boss 將始終出現在六個共享重生點之一。

977c0fe6686cc8347670574a861146e2c16333ac.source: The two Ettin bosses will appear at one of the two shared spawn points.
977c0fe6686cc8347670574a861146e2c16333ac.text: 兩個 雙頭巨人 Boss 將出現在兩個共享生成點之一。

18e04b14cd5d7b6abc8abc40358669042597b1e3.source: The mission ends once you kill the last boss and the small Mursaat group. If you want to capture the elite skill of this boss, kill it before the group so that you have enough time to activate the Signet of Capture.
18e04b14cd5d7b6abc8abc40358669042597b1e3.text: 一旦你殺死了最後一個 Boss 和 馬賽特 小組，任務就結束了。如果你想奪取這個boss的精英技能，請在團前擊殺牠，這樣你就有足夠的時間來啟動捕捉紋章。

15c0ab94b275ac122f55c2a66b5bfdd0d1a43a91.source: Despite the Seer's words that the Eidolon will spawn after destroying the Mursaat towers, you need to accept the bonus objective from the Seer as well. Otherwise the Eidolon will not spawn.
15c0ab94b275ac122f55c2a66b5bfdd0d1a43a91.text: 儘管 預言者 說 艾多倫 會在摧毀 馬賽特 塔後生成，但您也需要接受來自 預言者 的獎勵目標。否則 艾多倫 將不會產生。

b191c6f2856ac3691489cfeb18da6bc5a70b86e5.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #16 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
b191c6f2856ac3691489cfeb18da6bc5a70b86e5.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#16 頁。

92e1de4586a8045ef12dfdb05fccc9b46a519dcb.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Abaddon's Mouth.
92e1de4586a8045ef12dfdb05fccc9b46a519dcb.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 地獄隘口。

6daede9a1a8b171dd9862336bb20f9e331fad9f8.source: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is by completing Ring of Fire.
6daede9a1a8b171dd9862336bb20f9e331fad9f8.text: 進入任務沒有任何要求，但訪問前哨站的唯一方法是完成 火環群島。

8e3bd1ebf6abc0525a32bb1ae2bca7df4501fcbd.source: Disable the seals to power down the Onyx Gate.
8e3bd1ebf6abc0525a32bb1ae2bca7df4501fcbd.text: 停用密封件以關閉瑪瑙門。

6c91c0d2a8cb505b566299459dde16ce76cad898.source: Climb the path into Abaddon's Mouth.
6c91c0d2a8cb505b566299459dde16ce76cad898.text: 爬上路徑進入 地獄隘口。

4985c95ee91fd076bb6b6788d9dfd1a18c769c61.source: Break the magical seals holding closed the Door of Komalie.
4985c95ee91fd076bb6b6788d9dfd1a18c769c61.text: 打破關閉科瑪利亞之門的魔法封印。

2364303a73640063d304d640888ec522e1e561d1.source: *BONUS* Escort the spirit of Leah Stone to its final resting place.
2364303a73640063d304d640888ec522e1e561d1.text: *獎勵* 護送利亞·斯通的靈魂到最後的安息之地。

1185c5e4df1a7362efbb5b1247e9a48952f25ca8.source: This mission requires you to break through a Mursaat fortress by powering down the Onyx Gate to finally reach the Door of Komalie. Vizier Khilbron will periodically enchant the party with Chimera of Intensity, but this only lasts two minutes so is little help overall. The complex includes many gates that prevent access to the fortress; destroy each gate's Ether Seal to open them. Some of the gates are close to nearby groups of foes and guarded by Jade Bows; it is unwise to fight them together. You can spike the seal first or pull the jade away from it.
1185c5e4df1a7362efbb5b1247e9a48952f25ca8.text: 任務要求您關閉瑪瑙之門，突破 馬賽特 堡壘，最終到達科馬利之門。 基卜倫元老 會定期用強度奇美拉迷惑隊伍，但這只能持續兩分鐘，所以整體來說沒什麼幫助。建築群包括許多阻止進入堡壘的大門；摧毀每個門的 結界封印 以開啟它們。有些大門靠近附近的敵人群，並由玉弓把守；有些則靠近敵人。一起對抗他們是不明智的。你可以先釘住封印，或是把玉石從封印上拉開。

887b4126c70d8b83f710ec4018d67cf0d81a001e.source: You will start outside the Mursaat fortress; the vizier will enchant you when you get close to the main entrance. Before targeting the first Ether Seal, dispatch the side guards on top of the wall. All the Mursaat troops are stationed close to each other, so pull them apart to avoid over-aggro. Destroy the Ether Seals on either side of the Onyx Gate to open it. Leave through the Onyx Gate to continue with the mission.
887b4126c70d8b83f710ec4018d67cf0d81a001e.text: 你將從 馬賽特 堡壘外開始；當您靠近主入口時，維齊爾會讓您著迷。在瞄準第一個 結界封印 之前，先派遣牆頂上的側衛。所有 馬賽特 部隊都駐紮得很近，因此請將他們分開以避免過度仇恨。摧毀瑪瑙門兩側的以太封印以開啟它。通過瑪瑙門離開繼續執行任務。

70eeb10cd84e09a66d93d0d38d70be65f1d9c0a8.source: Open the main gate to the Citadel Guardhouse
70eeb10cd84e09a66d93d0d38d70be65f1d9c0a8.text: 開啟城堡警衛室的大門

8d581e0da4f7e1421243e49b1b460b825a984d73.text: 清除 馬賽特 的警衛室

8c76bfb9bc2dd73bab0bf847b00c748e1d155b4c.source: At the beginning, Brechnar Ironhammer sacrifices his life to buy time and open the field by luring the Mursaat away. You cannot save him, he is scripted to die once he reaches his destination (even without being attacked and regardless of his health). Head north, engage the Mursaat patrols carefully to avoid over-aggro.
8c76bfb9bc2dd73bab0bf847b00c748e1d155b4c.text: 一開始，佈雷奇納爾·鐵鎚犧牲了自己的生命，透過引走馬賽特來贏得時間並開啟場地。你無法拯救他，一旦他到達目的地，他就會死亡（即使沒有受到攻擊，無論他的健康狀況如何）。向北前進，小心地與 馬賽特 巡邏隊交戰，以避免過度仇恨。

3554e136db845b95e11bdd0d3e383ba01f6e56fb.source: From here onwards players will encounter Mursaat towers. These structures will remove your team's enchantments and also drain energy fast. Destroy its Ether Seal to turn the effects off. The towers are always guarded by Jade Bows, and it is unwise to fight them together. Either use a long/flat bow to pull the Jade away from the tower, or spike the seal first. Sometimes Nightmares spawn around the tower.
3554e136db845b95e11bdd0d3e383ba01f6e56fb.text: 從這裡開始，玩家將會遇到 馬賽特 塔。這些結構會消除你團隊的魔力並快速消耗能量。摧毀它的 結界封印 以關閉效果。塔樓總是由玉弓守衛，一起戰鬥是不明智的。要麼使用長/扁弓將玉從塔上拉開，要麼先釘住封印。有時惡夢會在塔周圍生成。

2af71f01aa22afa95a08bf1fb031163f42d25526.source: Following the north-west path from the first tower you will encounter an Ettin boss followed by a fork in the road: the northern path leads to the bonus giver and the southern proceeds with the mission.
2af71f01aa22afa95a08bf1fb031163f42d25526.text: 從第一個塔樓沿著西北路徑走，你會遇到一個 雙頭巨人 Boss，然後是一個岔路：北邊的路徑通往獎勵提供者，南邊的路徑繼續執行任務。

4454da4780d92be6a20be2a62909bab269cd10da.source: The area also features lava pools with ettins on the other side. Choose between either pulling the ettins across the lava or rushing out of it to the other side to battle them. Avoid standing in the lava while fighting the Ettins.
4454da4780d92be6a20be2a62909bab269cd10da.text: 該地區還設有熔岩池，另一側有埃廷斯。選擇是拉著埃廷人穿過熔岩還是衝出熔岩到另一邊與他們戰鬥。與埃廷人戰鬥時避免站在熔岩中。

29e4a42a49e85e22a0b95e9cb410cda7cd39def3.source: Vizier Khilbron will appear after the first lava pool to warn the party and suggest an alternative route. Despite his advice, most players find the front gate easier than the back route. The choice is up to you.
29e4a42a49e85e22a0b95e9cb410cda7cd39def3.text: 基卜倫元老 將出現在第一個熔岩池之後，以警告隊伍並建議替代路線。儘管有他的建議，大多數玩家還是發現前門比後門更容易。選擇權取決於您。

344dd83743f124a8eee7a884238656f5409cd0bf.source: The front gate is heavily guarded by the Mursaat and four towers, two outside the gate and two inside. Pull the Mursaat away from the towers first and then take out the two outer towers. You can clear the Mursaat patrols behind the gate with spells before destroying the seals to open it.
344dd83743f124a8eee7a884238656f5409cd0bf.text: 前門由 馬賽特 和四座塔樓嚴密把守，其中兩座在門外，兩座在門內。先將拉出和馬賽特遠離塔，然後取出兩個外塔。你可以用法術清除門後的 馬賽特 巡邏隊，然後摧毀封印以開啟門。

6768439b55ac0237f5565e54526b8927b68fd4c8.source: The two inner towers effects radii overlap just past the stairs making it hard to turn them off. Clear the patrols by pulling them to the stairs. The Ether Seals of these two towers face away from the gate, so the safest way to destroy them is to run past them first and start the attack from the opposite side. But beware of the Mursaat at the back, you will have to dispatch them first.
6768439b55ac0237f5565e54526b8927b68fd4c8.text: 兩個內塔的效果半徑在樓梯上方重疊，因此很難關閉。把巡邏隊拉到樓梯上來清除他們。這兩座塔的以太封印背向大門，所以摧毀它們最安全的方法就是先跑過去，從對面開始攻擊。但要小心後面的馬賽特，你必須先派遣他們。

29e6ff230b83d8a3ca5479ff5db2eb96b3e6defb.source: Now break the seal to access the lever of the main gate and defeat the boss guarding it. Touch the lever to open the main gate. Cross the jade bridge and defeat the last Mursaat boss to complete this mission.
29e6ff230b83d8a3ca5479ff5db2eb96b3e6defb.text: 現在打破封印，進入大門的槓桿並擊敗守衛大門的頭目。觸控控制桿即可開啟大門。穿過玉橋並擊敗最後一個 馬賽特 Boss 即可完成此任務。

aec35f8f74d6fd7aa8bc686b786c8cc61012c2de.source: Back road (blue way on the wikimap)
aec35f8f74d6fd7aa8bc686b786c8cc61012c2de.text: 後路（維基地圖上的藍路）

7677f7613c37d33f19708c8f49358aba8bc40c95.source: Is a large and dangerous circular detour on an area inhabitated by Lava Spitters and numerous Lava Imps with strong nuking capabilities, especially in groups (Meteor Showers). The last tend to cluster, so make use of AoE interrupt skills (e.g. Cry of Frustration, Maelstrom).
7677f7613c37d33f19708c8f49358aba8bc40c95.text: 是一個大型且危險的環形繞道，位於熔岩噴吐者和眾多具有強大核武能力的熔岩小鬼居住的區域，尤其是在群體中（隕石 陣雨）。最後一個傾向於叢集，因此請利用 範圍性 中斷技能（例如 挫折哭喊、水漩渦）。

6b5d721872f629e1d359c9f50e1576af230f9e46.source: There is an Ether Seal at the back of the Citadel Guardhouse, destroy it to enter. Clear the area of Mursaat, break the seal to access the lever of the main gate and defeat the boss guarding it. Touch the lever to open the main gate. Cross the jade bridge and defeat the last Mursaat boss to complete this mission.
6b5d721872f629e1d359c9f50e1576af230f9e46.text: 城堡警衛室後面有一個結界封印，摧毀它即可進入。清理 馬賽特 的區域，打破封印，進入大門的槓桿並擊敗守衛它的 Boss。觸控控制桿即可開啟大門。穿過玉橋並擊敗最後一個 馬賽特 boss 以完成此任務。

ee6f7d8132d00bfce2e1625c5a4ef80b45ced96e.source: Intermediately after leaving the Onyx Gate, the Vizier will re-enchant the party. You have to destroy three more gates; the two pairs of bosses between them can be easily defeated, if you keep them away from the seals.
ee6f7d8132d00bfce2e1625c5a4ef80b45ced96e.text: 離開瑪瑙之門後，維齊爾將重新為隊伍附魔。你必須再摧毀三扇門；如果你讓他們遠離海豹，他們之間的兩對 Boss 很容易被擊敗。

00698decfa9ccbb8aaaab60b30aeac50137e8585.source: After entering the caldera, Khilbron will aid you for a third and last time. Players arrive to a platform with six seals that lock the Door of Komalie and must be destroyed.
00698decfa9ccbb8aaaab60b30aeac50137e8585.text: 進入火山口後，基爾布隆將第三次也是最後一次幫助你。玩家到達一個有六個封印的平臺，這些封印鎖住了科瑪利亞之門，必須將其摧毀。

1e07b47b2af68d5caf96a65f7b1d6af7dd6fafe8.source: Each time you destroy a singular seal, four level-10 (lvl 20 in Hard Mode) Seal Guards will spawn while Mursaat Guardians will join the battle from the north and south. Clear the area of the current crop of foes before destroying another seal, otherwise you will get overwhelmed. As with other similar missions, patience is the key to success.
1e07b47b2af68d5caf96a65f7b1d6af7dd6fafe8.text: 每次你摧毀單一的封印時，四個等級的-10（困難模式中的20等級）封印守衛就會產生，而馬賽特守衛將從北方和南方加入戰鬥。在摧毀另一個封印之前，先清除目前區域的敵人，否則你會不知所措。與其他類似任務一樣，耐心是成功的關鍵。

dae1793b769000835543d40da7535827817afbda.source: After the last seal is destroyed, a cinematic will trigger, then a Burning Titan will spawn at the center of the bloodstone. Defeat it to complete the mission.
dae1793b769000835543d40da7535827817afbda.text: 最後一個封印被摧毀後，會觸發一個過場動畫，然後 燃燒泰坦 會在雞血石的中心產生。擊敗它即可完成任務。

f7c2f5a5a5ec874777dda49479a9adaaef3871cb.source: Your goal is to escort the spirit of Leah Stone from the fortress to a small island in the west. She only appears once the Ether Seal at the docks near her spawn point is defeated. The main difficulty is that this NPC is fragile and can be easily killed. She stops moving if you move out of compass range; and she slows down once she leaves the fortress. Finally, she is affected by burning from the lava, requiring you to stop frequently and wait for her to regenerate her health.
f7c2f5a5a5ec874777dda49479a9adaaef3871cb.text: 你的目標是護送利亞·斯通的靈魂從堡壘到西部的一個小島。只有在她重生點附近的碼頭上的 結界封印 被擊敗後，她才會出現。主要的困難是這個NPC很脆弱，很容易被殺死。如果您超出指南針範圍，她就會停止移動；離開堡壘後她就放慢了速度。最後，她會受到熔岩燃燒的影響，需要你經常停下來等待她恢復健康。

534702596717201f7d472f2a9a53bb83dbb8955f.source: In hard mode, your best bet is to clear the path of foes before releasing her spirit; she takes the largest coast road bordering the island from north to west. Be sure to trigger any pop-ups in the area past the Eidolon and remove the dryders, Crag Behemoths, wurms and possibly Snyk the Hundred Tongue, any of which can kill her. Once you have removed these threats, return to the fortress, kill the nearby boss, and then lead her back towards the island. Note that if you clear the path first, then free her, that she will stop after the lava if unescorted (no players in compass range).
534702596717201f7d472f2a9a53bb83dbb8955f.text: 在困難模式下，你最好的選擇是在釋放她的靈魂之前清除敵人的道路；她走的是從北到西與島嶼接壤的最大的海岸公路。一定要觸發 艾多倫 附近區域的任何彈出視窗，並移除烘乾機、峭壁巨獸、亞龍和可能的 百舌斯尼科，其中任何一個都可以殺死她。一旦你消除了這些威脅，返回要塞，殺死附近的頭目，然後帶她回到島上。請注意，如果您先清理道路，然後釋放她，如果無人護送，她將在熔岩後停下來（羅盤範圍內沒有玩家）。

82c42a0cd967657368b82bdb11535f956afe29f4.source: In normal mode, if you are confident of your team's strength, you can trigger her appearance earlier, which will save you from retracing your steps.
82c42a0cd967657368b82bdb11535f956afe29f4.text: 在普通模式下，如果你對自己隊伍的實力有信心，可以提前觸發她的出現，這樣你就不用走回頭路了。

68b0b2485b223a40603176dbbf55f1194ba289b4.source: If you let Leah Stone run ahead of you, and out of your compass range, it is possible for her to make it to her resting place unharmed, successfully granting you bonus.
68b0b2485b223a40603176dbbf55f1194ba289b4.text: 如果你讓利亞·斯通跑在你前面，並且超出你的羅盤範圍，她有可能毫髮無傷地到達她的安息之地，成功地為你提供獎勵。

a794f0c23bccd8b6b41969a5fc771e0d867fadb7.source: Area damage over time skills to kill the Ether Seals since they cannot flee.
a794f0c23bccd8b6b41969a5fc771e0d867fadb7.text: 隨著時間的推移，區域傷害技能可以殺死以太封印，因為它們無法逃脫。

18315fea264bc9c09b1c065ec4e07d7ceebf7569.source: Damage reduction, e.g. Protective Spirit, to negate some of the Ether Seal's spike.
18315fea264bc9c09b1c065ec4e07d7ceebf7569.text: 傷害 減少，例如精神守護，抵消一些 結界封印 的尖峰。

928a79c58fcb3da890a528ed458248accaa813a7.source: Interrupts and Daze are useful against the hydras and some of the bosses.
928a79c58fcb3da890a528ed458248accaa813a7.text: 打斷和發呆對於對付九頭蛇和一些 Boss 非常有用。

c9d4900a036838b3e66dce0da87a93678f66452e.source: Party-wide speed boosts help reduce the time spent backtracking during the bonus.
c9d4900a036838b3e66dce0da87a93678f66452e.text: 隊伍 範圍內的速度提升有助於減少獎勵期間回溯所花費的時間。

16fc78c8e8ac628d55aa46598f37feaf9808a39f.source: Sometimes, chests spawn in Leah Stone's scripted path, making the bonus impossible. Checking her route before attempting bonus might therefore save a lot of time.
16fc78c8e8ac628d55aa46598f37feaf9808a39f.text: 有時，箱子會在莉婭·斯通的指令碼路徑中生成，使獎勵變得不可能。因此，在嘗試獎勵之前檢查她的路線可能會節省大量時間。

75ee8a34b0dd500f334e743b715237c40395ad5e.source: Occasionally, if you kill the Burning Titan at the end too quickly, the mission will fail. Give it a couple of seconds after the last cut scene.
75ee8a34b0dd500f334e743b715237c40395ad5e.text: 有時，如果你在最後太快殺死 燃燒泰坦，任務就會失敗。在最後一個過場動畫結束後等待幾秒鐘。

23718cdf1a4e42d538508dea9414fd93d09b40b4.source: The Ancient Seer stands on the south western coast of the island. Give him the Eidolon's Spectral Essence to infuse your armor together with any other player who talks to him. This is a good opportunity to infuse a second set of armor.
23718cdf1a4e42d538508dea9414fd93d09b40b4.text: 古老的 預言者 矗立在島上的西南海岸。給他 艾多倫 的光譜 模板:Reclaim Essence，將你的盔甲與任何與他交談的其他玩家一起注入。這是注入第二套盔甲的好機會。

43abc7f88c43563cd39bcad3f9234271d7fed44d.source: Some of the elite skills found in this mission cannot be captured anywhere else. If attempting the bonus, it may be wise to bring a Signet of Capture.
43abc7f88c43563cd39bcad3f9234271d7fed44d.text: 在這次任務中發現的一些精英技能是其他地方無法獲得的。如果嘗試獲得獎金，最好帶上 捕捉紋章。

1dcfeb686e03f0f678004a04a71a47fbfa9e05f5.source: The Jade and Mursaat bosses share 3 spawn points. 2 of the six bosses will spawn at each point.
1dcfeb686e03f0f678004a04a71a47fbfa9e05f5.text: Jade 和 馬賽特 Boss 分享 3 生成點。六個 Boss 中的 2 將在每個點產生。

2f0e1361867b4beab1f3e488f4465a7515d82e35.source: The Dryder bosses share 4 spawn points.
2f0e1361867b4beab1f3e488f4465a7515d82e35.text: Dryder Boss 共享 4 生成點。

bae89ff64b36ad34f077a1133f6f7a87c66c3bb5.source: Complete exploration of this mission adds about 1.3% to the Tyrian Explorer title.
bae89ff64b36ad34f077a1133f6f7a87c66c3bb5.text: 完成此任務的探索將 1.3% 加入 Tyrian Explorer 標題中。

e0db9df312401d7bec782b06f66120aa113bf60b.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #17 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
e0db9df312401d7bec782b06f66120aa113bf60b.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#17 頁。

be076ffbbdf49e440296655ec01cec5524baad97.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Hell's Precipice.
be076ffbbdf49e440296655ec01cec5524baad97.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 地獄懸崖。

f7897213ffb559ac64356349dcd5b090e736c267.source: Dryder bosses may not spawn at all. If the western Ether Seal is fighting Dryders and isn't allowed to finish them off, its gate will not open after being killed.
f7897213ffb559ac64356349dcd5b090e736c267.text: 烘乾機 Boss 可能根本不會產生。如果西部的 結界封印 正在與 Dryders 戰鬥並且不被允許消滅他們，那麼它的大門在被殺死後將不會開啟。

850f85002ab849176420ff3c3f16fe6117ce90b1.source: Travel to Haiju Lagoon with Initiate Tsuriai.
850f85002ab849176420ff3c3f16fe6117ce90b1.text: 與起始者 Tsuriai 一起前往 海幽潟湖。

355508938659418bfd2dc4a1f1ad39a145932dff.source: Protect Initiate Tsuriai while she cleanses the lagoon.
355508938659418bfd2dc4a1f1ad39a145932dff.text: 在新兵 Tsuriai 清理潟湖時保護她。

bc66a663c20be7980d2a6ecc855370fa3ea3cdea.source: See Initiate Tsuriai for your reward.
bc66a663c20be7980d2a6ecc855370fa3ea3cdea.text: 請參閱啟動 Tsuriai 以獲得獎勵。

18ef8b8ca8d0d7ed723ad5afe2ac5c6445f4959b.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Haiju Lagoon; specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn but are replaced by Scavengers.
18ef8b8ca8d0d7ed723ad5afe2ac5c6445f4959b.text: 完成此任務會改變 海幽潟湖 中出現的敵人；具體來說，受折磨者將不再生成，而是被拾荒者取代。

7d0cd17ed2b741e9db5d9a0f649bf63d8fd29634.source: Cleansing Haiju Lagoon/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
7d0cd17ed2b741e9db5d9a0f649bf63d8fd29634.text: 清潔 海幽潟湖/詳細演練指南

6c8938f56135f47b2c4f6987c7cbcd83fdb9c5b7.source: Your goal is to protect Tsuriai while she stands in the lagoon to conduct her cleansing ritual. Several groups of Afflicted will attack her from three directions (west, south, and east). After completing the ritual, any remaining Afflicted will disappear. If she dies, the quest fails and you must rezone to try again.
6c8938f56135f47b2c4f6987c7cbcd83fdb9c5b7.text: 你的目標是在 Tsuriai 站在潟湖中進行清潔儀式時保護她。幾群受折磨者將從三個方向（西、南、東）攻擊她。完成儀式後，任何剩餘的受折磨者都會消失。如果她死了，任務就會失敗，你必須重新分配區域才能重試。

a75bc0a2c399d4baff866176a88ddd8a437b1131.source: Head northwest from Zen Daijun to meet up with Tsuriai then head north to the starburst on the map. After she begins her chanting you have a few moments to organize your party before being confronted by the Afflicted. Keep her alive for the minute or two she needs; you do not actually have to kill any of the foes (although this will obviously make keeping her alive easier).
a75bc0a2c399d4baff866176a88ddd8a437b1131.text: 從 禎臺郡 向西北方向與 Tsuriai 會合，然後向北前往地圖上的星爆點。在她開始吟唱之後，在面對受折磨者之前，你有一些時間來組織你的隊伍。讓她活一兩分鐘；你實際上不必殺死任何敵人（儘管這顯然會讓她更容易活下去）。

4f7a59ffc0cb2071812778b053a397630402c586.source: While standing in the water you will be under the Corrupted Haiju Lagoon Water effect until the ritual is complete.
4f7a59ffc0cb2071812778b053a397630402c586.text: 站在水中時，您將處於腐化的 海幽潟湖 水效果之下，直到儀式完成。

16c59677074dd156da5c2ecf927040922dc489e9.source: As Initiate Tsuriai is compelled to healing the player, she can be pulled out of the aggro-range of the enemies by using life-sacrificing skills and moving to the other side of the island.
16c59677074dd156da5c2ecf927040922dc489e9.text: 當新手 Tsuriai 被迫治療玩家時，可以透過使用犧牲生命的技能並將她拉出敵人的仇恨範圍並移動到島的另一邊。

14cf6ec32b291b357c8cebda638ca15dc65b2ab4.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Greed and Regret or Calling the Order.
14cf6ec32b291b357c8cebda638ca15dc65b2ab4.text: 所有黨員必須接受「貪婪與遺憾」或「命令」的獎勵。

7ef1c155bcdde6569b3624e87c2b80a99b191e52.source: Gain access to the vault's inner sanctum and rescue the two princes.
7ef1c155bcdde6569b3624e87c2b80a99b191e52.text: 進入金庫的內部密室並救出兩位王子。

dbe5e31694ead3269e0a02098c50bcc0d3d187f4.source: Complete the trial in each chamber to open the way into the inner sanctum. [0...3] of 3 trials completed.
dbe5e31694ead3269e0a02098c50bcc0d3d187f4.text: 完成每個房間的試煉，開啟進入內部密室的道路。 [0...3] 的 3 試驗已完成。

5578009f8e345af078c981230a15f688540154f9.source: Defeat the Eternal Guardians to complete the Trial of Eternity.
5578009f8e345af078c981230a15f688540154f9.text: 擊敗永恆守護者以完成永恆試煉。

08ef70e7ca246c68a4b7afeb16c33cc765771021.source: Answer the riddles posed by the Divine Djinn to pass the Trial of Divinity.
08ef70e7ca246c68a4b7afeb16c33cc765771021.text: 回答神聖 巨靈怪 提出的謎語，以透過神性試煉。

93773c20d954a1e8497f954c8f30147fe5e1a7db.source: Solve the crystal key puzzle to complete the Trial of Wisdom.
93773c20d954a1e8497f954c8f30147fe5e1a7db.text: 解決水晶鑰匙謎題以完成 智慧者 的試用。

d017547ee5c81f095634a5a87420f36fa4120a9d.source: Defeat the enraged djinn to reach the two princes.
d017547ee5c81f095634a5a87420f36fa4120a9d.text: 擊敗憤怒的神靈，找到兩位王子。

18b93eba00a288c3848ccfe7da1bbf2047f51dd6.source: *Bonus* Help Margrid collect the Treasure of Ahdashim.
18b93eba00a288c3848ccfe7da1bbf2047f51dd6.text: *額外獎勵* 幫助瑪格麗德收集阿達希姆的寶藏。

405c2f1056e4a66fc892444ef348a53a4ac67c2a.text: 已發現 [0...3] 的 3 寶藏。

7c1c3cd13a56bcf3c9c1b6da3a8d776bbc16aacf.source: Talk to the Lock of Ahdashim in the Dasha Vestibule outpost to start the mission. Goren will be in the starting area; speak to him and he will join the party. He will need to survive the mission. The entrance to the three chambers has a number of groups of Djinn. Tackle them one group at a time. When fighting groups of Djinn, the Ruby Djinns using Searing Flames should be a priority target as they can deal massive amounts of damage to the party. Proceed towards the far wall where you will find three paths. The central path leads to the Trial of Eternity, the left the Trial of Divinity, and the right leads to the Trial of Wisdom. The only path open at this time is the Trial of Eternity.
7c1c3cd13a56bcf3c9c1b6da3a8d776bbc16aacf.text: 與 達沙走廊 前哨站的阿達希姆鎖交談以開始任務。 高恩 將位於起始區域；與他交談，他就會加入隊伍。他需要在任務中生存下來。三個室的入口處有多組 巨靈怪。一次對付一組。當與 巨靈怪 群體戰鬥時，使用 爆裂火焰 的紅寶石神應該是優先目標，因為它們可以對隊伍造成大量傷害。朝遠處的牆走，你會發現三條路。中央路徑通往永恆試煉，左側通往神性試煉，右側通往智慧者試煉。此時唯一開放的道路就是永恆試煉。

b1800631a805589065fe4266b8e0b2cebaedb98b.source: There are six Eternal Guardians which produce global environmental effects for this trial. Defeating a guardian will remove its effect. Complete the trial by defeating all six guardians.
b1800631a805589065fe4266b8e0b2cebaedb98b.text: 有六名永恆守護者為本次試驗產生全球環境影響。擊敗守護者將消除其效果。擊敗全部六名守護者即可完成試煉。

f6310a24877ca901a7b5e384511cdad483a1e6d1.source: The guardians may produce one of three environmental effects. The guardians at the base of the stairs produce lesser effects than those further back. These effects are as follows:
f6310a24877ca901a7b5e384511cdad483a1e6d1.text: 守護者可能會產生三種環境影響之一。樓梯底部的守衛者產生的效果比後面的守衛者小。這些效果如下：

e26de35277e84984732ebbf03d8228262c4d6f62.source: Note that when you reach the stairs, the left path is slightly more difficult, as the guardians of the sapphire chest will spawn once the party gets close to the chest and augment the group of Djinn and guardians already there. Either pull the Djinns away from the chest or take the path to the right. This requires defeating the Ruby of Ahdashim which is needed for the bonus.
e26de35277e84984732ebbf03d8228262c4d6f62.text: 請注意，當您到達樓梯時，左側的路徑會稍微困難一些，因為一旦隊伍靠近藍寶石箱，藍寶石箱的守護者就會出現，並增加已經在那裡的 巨靈怪 和守護者的隊伍。要嘛把巨靈從箱子裡拉開，要嘛走右邊的路。這需要擊敗阿達希姆紅寶石，這是獎勵所必需的。

38398f009855a73b2f40550f0c62249b35c5edbb.source: Upon completing the trial, the door to the Trial of Divinity will open.
38398f009855a73b2f40550f0c62249b35c5edbb.text: 完成試煉後，神性試煉之門就會開啟。

98067561bb76a42b765b8cb618102e97a5c0b343.source: There are two traps placed just after the left turn in the entrance corridor to this trial (one fire, and one water). It is imperative that you pull the Djinn away from the traps to battle them, in order to avoid accidentally being caught in the traps.
98067561bb76a42b765b8cb618102e97a5c0b343.text: 在這次審判的入口走廊左轉彎後放置了兩個陷阱（一個火，一個水）。您必須將 巨靈怪 拉離陷阱才能與它們戰鬥，以避免意外陷入陷阱。

bbee61a6323f0eb57a8cc467e38cacdc6ddb0638.source: Towards the back of the room stands a row of Divine Guardians. They will ask questions regarding the Gods of Tyria, and you must choose the answer that fits the clue the best. The clues change during each run of the mission, but the answers are always the same. From left to right, the correct answers are as follows:
bbee61a6323f0eb57a8cc467e38cacdc6ddb0638.text: 房間的後方，站著一排神衛。他們會詢問有關 泰瑞亞真神 的問題，您必須選擇最適合線索的答案。每次執行任務時線索都會發生變化，但答案總是相同的。從左到右，正確答案如下：

6780dd3ed611df1c9923e6f46a875777c3e42e71.source: If you give the wrong answer, a group of foes will spawn around you, but the Divine Guardian will still count as completed.
6780dd3ed611df1c9923e6f46a875777c3e42e71.text: 如果你給出錯誤的答案，一群敵人會在你周圍產生，但神聖 守護者 仍將算完成。

c7851d3b71709dfd4dd745981297a8a749e8e255.source: After answering all six questions (one way or the other), the door to the Trial of Wisdom will open.
c7851d3b71709dfd4dd745981297a8a749e8e255.text: 回答完所有六個問題（以一種或另一種方式）後，智慧者 試用之門將會開啟。

88020076c04ca461de87723657088c2d5fb08ae5.source: Like the Trial of Divinity, the first turn is greeted with a pair of Djinn and a pair of water traps. Pull the Djinn away from the traps to battle before proceeding.
88020076c04ca461de87723657088c2d5fb08ae5.text: 與神性試煉一樣，第一個回合會出現一對 巨靈怪 和一對水陷阱。 拉出 和 巨靈怪 遠離陷阱後再繼續戰鬥。

4dd6e434f0fe405097316bd23b81c160c23f887e.source: The main chamber includes four Thunder of Ahdashim — these are essentially Diamond Djinn that use Quake Of Ahdashim, a skill that knocks down and damages characters in the area. Since it also destroys any crystal keys they may be carrying, you should kill them before attempting the puzzle.
4dd6e434f0fe405097316bd23b81c160c23f887e.text: 主房間包括四個 Ahdashim 雷霆 - 這些本質上是 鑽石巨靈，使用 Ahdashim 之鎚，這是一種擊倒並傷害該區域角色的技能。由於它還會破壞他們可能攜帶的所有水晶鑰匙，因此你應該在嘗試解謎之前殺死他們。

d443967be631739405433ba92b10fed0a025b75b.source: The Ruby Djinns and Roaring Ethers have strong AoE skills. There are a number of ways to counter:
d443967be631739405433ba92b10fed0a025b75b.text: 紅寶石巨靈和咆哮以太擁有強大的 範圍性 技能。對抗的方法有很多種：

cac42f001badb368c1a13795d3a04e3d64d75f24.text: 苦痛 逆變器很快就能殺死它們。

c762f7a1b11f3b3cbd00e452fc2883eae18fc41c.source: They can be interrupted, dazed, or knocked down.
c762f7a1b11f3b3cbd00e452fc2883eae18fc41c.text: 他們可能會被打斷、暈眩或擊倒。

723e43637357cf2c2c8b0f0250797248f379217a.source: The Djinni are vulnerable to cold damage, making Winter a good choice.
723e43637357cf2c2c8b0f0250797248f379217a.text: 神靈容易受到寒冷傷害，這使得 寒冬 成為一個不錯的選擇。

d2e74112624172636b3f28b6f45120d6c32ab5be.source: Burning (caused by Searing Flames) can be countered with Extinguish or Breath of the Great Dwarf.
d2e74112624172636b3f28b6f45120d6c32ab5be.text: 燃燒（由 爆裂火焰 引起）可以用 熄滅 或 偉大矮人 的呼吸來對抗。

c560dd1ba1133d389b1f55ee6ac1daa0c6e12e2e.source: Frozen Soil or interrupts (e.g. Complicate) can be useful to counter the Roaring Ethers' Resurrection Signets.
c560dd1ba1133d389b1f55ee6ac1daa0c6e12e2e.text: 凍土 或中斷（例如 糾纏）可用來對抗咆哮以太的復活印記。

043c4d6cd9a30c5f90dd54d838bc0cc7ac52088e.source: Protection skills are very useful, including Protective Spirit and Shelter; henchman Kihm uses Protective Spirit.
043c4d6cd9a30c5f90dd54d838bc0cc7ac52088e.text: 防護技巧非常有用，包括精神守護和庇護；追蹤者 Kihm 使用 精神守護。

7b88f605cda2d3c848343f4d466fcc78180d3c8b.source: Bonders are very effective; none of the foes can remove enchantments.
7b88f605cda2d3c848343f4d466fcc78180d3c8b.text: 黏合劑非常有效；沒有一個敵人能夠移除結界。

a2ee48e5fab40efb54b6c30eaa5a668645ecde43.source: Very few of the foes are fleshy (just the Ethers); avoid skills that exploit corpses or inflict Bleeding, Disease, and Poison.
a2ee48e5fab40efb54b6c30eaa5a668645ecde43.text: 很少有敵人是肉質的（只有以太）；避免利用屍體或造成 流血、疾病和 中毒 的技能。

dbac3b005649a66a8c5053769e21fe26b9e0efbc.source: For most of the mission, Goren should sustain little damage. The most dangerous times are if you try to run away, as Goren will usually be last to follow and thus be the focus of enemy fire. This is especially true in the Central Chamber fight where the bosses may deal lethal damage to Goren should you need to flee. Traps also have a possibility to deal substantial damage to Goren if not careful.
dbac3b005649a66a8c5053769e21fe26b9e0efbc.text: 在大部分任務中，高恩 受到的傷害應該很小。最危險的時刻是當您嘗試逃跑時，因為 高恩 通常會最後跟隨，從而成為敵人火力的焦點。在中央密室戰鬥中尤其如此，如果您需要逃跑，頭目可能會對 高恩 造成致命傷害。如果不小心的話，陷阱還有可能對 高恩 造成嚴重損害。

2f35214f9992625aa8fa3fcb8c7307bf2af255bc.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to the Kodash Bazaar.
2f35214f9992625aa8fa3fcb8c7307bf2af255bc.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 Kodash Bazaar。

ed56886cc1476644d03fe7d88d0f614ab76c721b.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #9 in the Night Falls storybook.
ed56886cc1476644d03fe7d88d0f614ab76c721b.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#9 頁。

dc7ba82bd2bac6e553ae9fdd6f0a0e7d9389bcfd.text: 主職 不是 僧侶

a7fa84b23e7884c7544a9452d1340669f1b5dfcc.source: Speak with Headmaster Amara in the monastery.
a7fa84b23e7884c7544a9452d1340669f1b5dfcc.text: 與修道院的阿瑪拉校長交談。

a4e9ff107e9bbfe5267b0caaae1235efca8f2ecc.source: You must have chosen to go with Master of Whispers in the Mysterious Message quest.
a4e9ff107e9bbfe5267b0caaae1235efca8f2ecc.text: 您必須選擇在 機密資訊 任務中選擇與低語大師同行。

6854619290a59ec680ba8a2fa964a7582cdf2a04.source: You must have Masters of Whispers in your party
6854619290a59ec680ba8a2fa964a7582cdf2a04.text: 你的隊伍中必須有密語大師

e9269d67c34618fe5f56cac48e1ad57a0941c01f.source: Call upon the Order of Whispers.

68aef2cc004b4e3a0e124c77799c44d01b84d3c7.source: Bring the Master of Whispers with you and use the Acolytes to defend against the Margonite threat.
68aef2cc004b4e3a0e124c77799c44d01b84d3c7.text: 帶上密語大師並使用追隨者來防禦 瑪骨奈 威脅。

adf837b25420aed5480083fe7579f507f3e7dec0.source: Use the Acolytes to defend against the onslaught of demons.
adf837b25420aed5480083fe7579f507f3e7dec0.text: 使用侍僧來抵禦惡魔的攻擊。

49c8efb4707bfcb3c66423b8da27c9b75e1b2552.source: Defend Norgu from the attacking forces.
49c8efb4707bfcb3c66423b8da27c9b75e1b2552.text: 保衛諾爾古免受攻擊部隊的攻擊。

5a316c5ba01e300519d768dc1eecc4ab2b23670e.source: Inform Prince Ahmtur the Mighty that the Order of Whispers will help protect the Citadel of Dzagon.
5a316c5ba01e300519d768dc1eecc4ab2b23670e.text: 通知強大的阿姆圖爾王子，低語騎士團將幫助保護扎貢城堡。

ad7470378027083e07b013d934fcd91c18c84c77.source: See Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.
ad7470378027083e07b013d934fcd91c18c84c77.text: 去找穆倫達中尉領取獎勵。

ff3f49e19e402bd70008ec7560673329e3422974.source: Make your way north from Chantry of Secrets to the map marker.
ff3f49e19e402bd70008ec7560673329e3422974.text: 從 隱密教堂 往北前往地圖示記。

dd918e5b46d52a532707e9e5e4144e3ab8882eb8.source: Tip: Kill Lieutenant Vanahk for a 2% morale boost.
dd918e5b46d52a532707e9e5e4144e3ab8882eb8.text: 提示：殺死 Vanahk 中尉可獲得 2% 士氣提升。

12f984be0e50918174f30158b0ea436baa426054.source: When you arrive Disciple of Secrets tells you to choose a side that the Order of Whispers should fight. For an easy fight choose Rangers and stay with Norgu and kill the Warriors that will appear. The Whispers Acolytes use "Shields Up!", so they are more suited to fight the Rangers. Your party should be able to kill the Warriors before they gain enough adrenaline to use their adrenaline attack skills.
12f984be0e50918174f30158b0ea436baa426054.text: 當你到達時，秘密門徒會告訴你選擇低語騎士團應該戰鬥的一方。為了輕鬆戰鬥，選擇遊騎兵並留在諾古並殺死將出現的勇士。低語追隨者使用“護盾升起！”，因此他們更適合與遊騎兵作戰。你的隊伍應該能夠在勇士獲得足夠的腎上腺素來使用他們的腎上腺素攻擊技能之前殺死他們。

eb0e7f4107b413fdf396725bd54c479119d5697d.source: Talk to Norgu after both sets of Margonites are killed.
eb0e7f4107b413fdf396725bd54c479119d5697d.text: 殺死兩組瑪貢尼特後與諾爾古交談。

48fbad7ecf47b9b65ed9ca60d9f4fbeb0a0fb3be.source: Map travel to Grand Court of Sebelkeh and then exit on the east side to make your way towards Dzagonur Bastion in the north-east
48fbad7ecf47b9b65ed9ca60d9f4fbeb0a0fb3be.text: 沿著地圖前往 Sebelkeh Grand Court，然後從東側出口駛向東北部的 薩崗諾稜堡

c0df92e323fd6fdb5377d783108d80679141af42.source: Incorrectly matching pedestals resets the puzzles and spawns new Ahdashim. After completing this puzzle, the final set of doors (leading to the end-bosses) will open.
c0df92e323fd6fdb5377d783108d80679141af42.text: 不正確匹配的基座會重置謎題並產生新的阿達希姆。完成這個謎題後，最後一組門（通往最終首領）將會開啟。

bfa65d194caec0eeaef0c3a3275367448c495a5e.source: There are three combinations that work, each matching pedestal pairs the same distance from the center:
bfa65d194caec0eeaef0c3a3275367448c495a5e.text: 共有三種有效組合，每種配對的基座與離中心的距離相同：

4d34754ba5877f36429d98ab415b74fd6f4133b4.source: If doing the bonus, don't forget to pick up the Sapphire Treasure as you make your way to the final room.
4d34754ba5877f36429d98ab415b74fd6f4133b4.text: 如果您想獲得獎勵，請不要忘記在前往最後一個房間時拿起藍寶石寶藏。

b66948c070e257f9392a2cf37d131748902ae2b9.source: The final stage of the mission contains three Djinn bosses. Luckily, each boss may be pulled and fought separately from the others. The mission ends after defeating the last one.
b66948c070e257f9392a2cf37d131748902ae2b9.text: 任務的最後階段包含三個 巨靈怪 Boss。幸運的是，每個 Boss 都可以被單獨拉動並與其他 Boss 單獨戰鬥。擊敗最後一個任務後任務結束。

7606e0c61c3b111983413c21d0f2e92c8bdf53d5.source: Most groups find Kormab (the elementalist boss) to be the most dangerous. Kormab uses several AoE spells and can quickly wipe out clustered parties; be sure to spread before taking him on. Alternatively, you can shut down his offense (e.g. using interrupts) or use anti-caster hexes (e.g. Backfire). Pain Inverter is also very effective.
7606e0c61c3b111983413c21d0f2e92c8bdf53d5.text: 大多數團體認為科爾馬布（元素師 Boss）是最危險的。 Kormab 使用多個 範圍性 法術，可以快速消滅叢集隊伍；在對付他之前一定要傳播出去。或者，你可以阻止他的進攻（例如使用中斷）或使用反施法者六角形（例如魔力反噬）。 苦痛逆變器也非常有效。

c6b71b3003bc460f78064f704574a7430e5a8e40.source: Goren must stay alive, so make sure he does not rush ahead into the group of bosses while you are pulling.
c6b71b3003bc460f78064f704574a7430e5a8e40.text: 高恩 必須保持活力，因此請確保在您拉動時他不會衝進 Boss 群組。

0b7c3b864027221bf3bbc46872f0e5e4e513ce69.source: If you want to capture skills, be sure to pull the relevant Djinn first or second; the mission ends as soon as the third boss dies.
0b7c3b864027221bf3bbc46872f0e5e4e513ce69.text: 如果要捕捉技能，一定要先拉相關的巨靈怪或第二；第三個老闆死後任務就結束。

4965bf50c589ebb8c7faa392195d2e64352317e4.source: The bonus requires you to pick up three treasures from various chests: each chest is located in one of the trial areas and the key is held by a Djinn of Ahdashim with a similar name. Very little extra effort is required for the bonus: if you follow the standard mission order (Eternity→Divinity→Wisdom), you will pick up each key before you come across the corresponding chest.
4965bf50c589ebb8c7faa392195d2e64352317e4.text: 獎勵要求您從不同的寶箱中拾取三件寶藏：每個寶箱都位於其中一個試驗區域，鑰匙由 Ahdashim 的 巨靈怪 持有，名字相似。獎勵只需很少的額外努力：如果您遵循標準任務順序（永恆→神性→智慧者），您將在遇到相應的寶箱之前拿起每個鑰匙。

892f786363f61e465ecb9e7a743f4fd151dd6782.source: There are only two complications: as you approach each chest, a group of three Djinn will pop up (including a Ruby Djinn), but these are no harder than any of the other groups you encounter. There is a fire trap in the left trial room behind the Diamond chest, so be careful. You must also pick up the third treasure before you kill the third Djinn boss in the final room.
892f786363f61e465ecb9e7a743f4fd151dd6782.text: 只有兩個複雜之處：當您接近每個箱子時，會彈出一組三個 巨靈怪（包括一個 紅寶石巨靈），但這些並不比您遇到的任何其他組更難。左邊審判室鑽石箱後面有火陷阱，要小心。在殺死最後一個房間中的第三個 巨靈怪 boss 之前，您還必須拾取第三個寶藏。

40bdca4aaf54c46de4d8a76c68e412f382da0558.source: The chests and keys appear as follows:
40bdca4aaf54c46de4d8a76c68e412f382da0558.text: 箱子和鑰匙如下圖所示：

efb6c6c7e923a7e53565672d5c8eb083a4b83e9b.source: The key to victory will depend on how you make good use of Margrid. Rangers have 30 extra armor against elemental damage and are the best suited for these occasions. Since she is a required hero, use one of the first three individual hero flags to position her in the party composition. The hardest enemies in this mission are the Ruby Djinns and the Elementalist boss which spam Searing Flames, to reduce their damage output, disable their elite with skills like Distracting Shot, Magebane Shot and Diversion. Due to the Roaring Ethers energy removal, your hero will need a generous energy base pool in order to use skills, e.g.:30~40 and a good spec in Expertise. Once the Elementalist foe has been killed, only the Dervish Djinns will remain. Flagging this hero ahead of the main team is essential to survival, she can be placed just over the aggro bubble or a bit ahead, so that all foes target lock on her rather the entire team. At the central room, eliminate the enemies that cause environmental effects to remove pressure and make sure to use this hero to trigger the chest pop-ups. While performing this technique, it is vital to pay close attention to the radar and watch enemy positioning, make sure your projectile attacks and skills will not be obstructed by the walls of each narrow corridor.
efb6c6c7e923a7e53565672d5c8eb083a4b83e9b.text: 勝利的關鍵取決於你如何充分利用瑪格麗德。遊騎兵擁有 30 額外裝甲來抵禦元素傷害，最適合這些場合。由於她是必需的英雄，請使用前三個個人英雄旗幟之一將她定位在隊伍組成中。此任務中最難對付的敵人是紅寶石神靈和 元素使 boss，它們會向 爆裂火焰 傳送垃圾郵件，以減少其傷害輸出，並使用 震暈之箭、馬格班射擊 和 牽制 等技能停用其精英。由於咆哮以太能量被移除，你的英雄將需要充足的能量基礎池才能使用技能，例如：30~40 以及 專精 中的良好規格。一旦 元素使 敵人被殺死，就只剩下 神喚使 巨靈了。將這個英雄標記在主隊之前對於生存至關重要，她可以放置在仇恨氣泡上方或稍靠前的位置，以便所有敵人的目標鎖定她而不是整個團隊。在中央房間，消滅造成環境影響的敵人以消除壓力，並確保使用該英雄觸發寶箱彈出視窗。在執行此技術時，密切注意雷達並觀察敵人的位置至關重要，確保你的投射物攻擊和技能不會被每個狹窄走廊的牆壁阻擋。

f1c92538207c44dab6c1386a95da723df3441b9f.source: The puzzle itself involves two Crystal Keys, four obelisks numbered 2, 3, 5, and 7 (the first four prime numbers), and six pedestals numbered 6, 10, 14, 15, 21, and 35. Your objective is to activate (using the keys) two of these pedestals whose numbers are divisible by the numbers on the obelisks. As you place a key, the matching obelisks will display keys (meaning they are activated). Make sure you do not overlap. Proper combinations are suggested below.
f1c92538207c44dab6c1386a95da723df3441b9f.text: 謎題本身涉及兩把水晶鑰匙、四個編號的方尖碑 2 , 3 , 5 , 和 7 （前四個質數）和六個基座編號 6 , 10 , 14 , 15 , 21 , 和 35 。您的目標是啟動（使用鑰匙）其中兩個基座，其數字可以被方尖碑上的數字整除。當您放置鑰匙時，匹配的方尖碑將顯示鑰匙（表示它們已啟動）。確保不重疊。下面建議了適當的組合。

0f513b84566a1cfbd6cfb1ad160719027fa392da.source: Alternatively, map travel directly to Dzagonur Bastion if you unlocked it previously then simply exit southwest and speak with Prince Ahmtur the Mighty who is just outside.
0f513b84566a1cfbd6cfb1ad160719027fa392da.text: 或者，如果您之前已解鎖 薩崗諾稜堡，則可以直接在地圖上前往 薩崗諾稜堡，然後只需退出西南方向並與外面的強大阿姆圖爾王子交談即可。

330f7dafe21e6f97285712cb536716180cfd388b.source: Sending the Order of Whispers to a side too early (not triggering Norgu) may cause them to miss their Margonite group, allowing Norgu to be attacked and killed.
330f7dafe21e6f97285712cb536716180cfd388b.text: 過早將低語騎士團傳送到一方（不觸發 Norgu）可能會導致他們錯過 瑪骨奈 小組，從而使 Norgu 受到攻擊並被殺死。

7f18d8c0e41c98e97b7f63f82c7b66d58a691407.source: If your quest log does not update properly after sending the Whispers to the Ranger side, check near the bridge for remaining Margonites. On very rare occasions, your allies can get killed by a nearby group of Kournans.
7f18d8c0e41c98e97b7f63f82c7b66d58a691407.text: 如果在將低語傳送到 遊俠 一側後您的任務日誌沒有正確更新，請檢查橋附近是否有剩餘的瑪貢尼特。在極少數情況下，你的盟友可能會被附近的一群庫南人殺死。

b4415bbc170521b50e0306fe1bbde297e8e63c1b.source: Access to Zen Daijun (explorable area), which requires completing the Zen Daijun mission.
b4415bbc170521b50e0306fe1bbde297e8e63c1b.text: 進入禎臺郡（可探索區域），需要完成禎臺郡任務。

8afee68abc3a351b3d7f1d6aafd5fe5e2e21db59.source: Defeat the plagued aspect of Zunraa.
8afee68abc3a351b3d7f1d6aafd5fe5e2e21db59.text: 擊敗受瘟疫困擾的祖拉。

fe7655758bafa9c1112f1a2174f69ba6063ac1a9.source: Defeat the rotten aspect of Zunraa.
fe7655758bafa9c1112f1a2174f69ba6063ac1a9.text: 擊敗 Zunraa 腐爛的一面。

f3b6fbc71416875b16e63039170e856e5809eb71.source: Defeat the tainted aspect of Zunraa.
f3b6fbc71416875b16e63039170e856e5809eb71.text: 擊敗 Zunraa 的汙染面。

e37ef2d624d4d11196a82bdd41052f572b9eedcc.source: Defeat the infected aspect of Zunraa.
e37ef2d624d4d11196a82bdd41052f572b9eedcc.text: 擊敗 Zunraa 的感染者。

a6d13d63409aeca70006df76f0e4dd54cb7d1cab.source: Defeat the diseased aspect of Zunraa.
a6d13d63409aeca70006df76f0e4dd54cb7d1cab.text: 擊敗 Zunraa 的患病部分。

b1b0be3ffc2f9873bffc21c4573507bf87929a65.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Zen Daijun; specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn but are replaced by Scavengers.
b1b0be3ffc2f9873bffc21c4573507bf87929a65.text: 完成此任務會改變 禎臺郡 中出現的敵人；具體來說，受折磨者將不再生成，而是被拾荒者取代。

bb4b58d566b6a83482fb2c6ad4554d49871f90bc.source: The standard enemy party size here is 4 or 6, and the enemy party size around each Shrine of Zunraa is 6, not including the afflicted aspect of Zunraa. Careful pulling is recommended as the groups tend to bunch up near each other.
bb4b58d566b6a83482fb2c6ad4554d49871f90bc.text: 這裡的標準敵方隊伍規模是 4 或 6，每個 Zunraa 神殿周圍的敵方隊伍規模是 6，不包括 Zunraa 受折磨的面向。建議小心拉動，因為這些群體往往會聚集在一起。

44b5e71abecc21caf3b8aeea7f5e9c98cb20331c.source: Caution: when approaching some of the Shrines of Zunraa, a nearby mobile group of 4 enemies will approach to attack you. Take care of them first, before engaging the group around the shrine itself.
44b5e71abecc21caf3b8aeea7f5e9c98cb20331c.text: 注意：當接近某些 Zunraa 神殿時，附近的 4 敵人移動群將接近並攻擊您。先解決掉他們，然後再與神社周圍的隊伍交戰。

2b2e715ab56d8789be28d68d71767a3e482fd443.source: The groups surrounding the afflicted aspects of Zunraa can be pulled separately. It appears that the afflicted aspects of Zunraa do not heal or interact with them in any way.
2b2e715ab56d8789be28d68d71767a3e482fd443.text: 圍繞 Zunraa 受影響區域的團體可以單獨拉動。看來 Zunraa 的受折磨的方面不會以任何方式治癒或與他們互動。

391209a461a44318931a4918bd6cc48d61d28f69.source: Pain Inverter is extremely effective against the aspects of Zunraa, as well as Afflicted Elementalists.
391209a461a44318931a4918bd6cc48d61d28f69.text: 苦痛 逆變器對於 Zunraa 以及受折磨的元素主義者非常有效。

7a1d37cf46c649dc5f3d9cd520c95d7d60b0b09c.source: Mesmers capable of interrupt and skill disabling are a good idea here.
7a1d37cf46c649dc5f3d9cd520c95d7d60b0b09c.text: 能夠打斷和停用技能的催眠師在這裡是個好主意。

dea94be127ec1c5d9731a020cad5fce131acd134.source: AoE skills will not be highly effective, as enemies tend to spread out somewhat.
dea94be127ec1c5d9731a020cad5fce131acd134.text: 範圍性 技能不會非常有效，因為敵人往往會分散一些。

c5ea76f1536013fbde8f473031f53abe6e0f70d8.source: Five of the Elite skills in Smiting Prayers are available for capture during this quest.
c5ea76f1536013fbde8f473031f53abe6e0f70d8.text: 懲戒祈禱 中的五個 精英 技能可在此任務中擷取。

af9b9564a20eadf687a1ab3fb5713107db40feae.source: If you have the "unwelcome guest" quest. The area will bug and you will not get Zunraa spawns
af9b9564a20eadf687a1ab3fb5713107db40feae.text: 如果你有「不速之客」的任務。該區域將會出現 bug，並且您不會獲得 Zunraa 的生成

468ab864368a4d1561300f5015ebef0004e1d4ec.source: Entering the mission has no requirements, but the only way to access the outpost is by completing Abaddon's Mouth.
468ab864368a4d1561300f5015ebef0004e1d4ec.text: 進入任務沒有任何要求，但訪問前哨站的唯一方法是完成 地獄隘口。

130d05f2eaaf624e3323cc13901b8e5440c93e68.source: Stop the Lich from destroying the world.

7f4615187ea62cc3122595f322d083591f7f0972.text: 停用 泰坦 入口網站。

173f2f5f484089199054646743edead7712e9962.text: 擊敗 不死系 魯裡克。

f12ba86159db8cc6a1e763dcbd0e59f982b28ac5.text: *獎勵* 摧毀所有三個哈米吉多頓領主。

4a7ce20f0d928dadec6a4c9069802ead04891173.source: The Door of Komalie has been opened and now the Lich has gained control over the Titans through the Scepter of Orr. He has opened three portals to teleport these servants onto different regions of Tyria. Players must close them to save the world and finally defeat the Lich. The portals are located south-west of the island. The major difficulty players meet here is the combined strength of two types of foes, the Titans and the Imps called Spark of the Titans. The Imps deal massive area of effect fire damage (Rodgort's Invocation/Mind Burn) and are very dangerous as a group. The Titans cause burning condition to adjacent foes and also spawn other titans when killed in the following sequence: Burning Titan, Risen Ashen Hulk, Fist of the Titans and Hand of the Titans together. Always target the Imps first.
4a7ce20f0d928dadec6a4c9069802ead04891173.text: 科瑪利亞之門已經開啟，現在巫妖已經透過 歐爾 權杖控制了泰坦。他開啟了三個傳送門，將這些僕人傳送到 泰瑞亞 的不同區域。玩家必須關閉它們來拯救世界並最終擊敗巫妖。門戶位於島的西南部。玩家在這裡遇到的主要困難是泰坦和小惡魔這兩個敵人的綜合實力，稱為 泰坦火花。小惡魔會造成大面積火焰傷害（洛葛特的魔咒/心靈燃燒），並且作為一個群體非常危險。泰坦會對鄰近的敵人造成燃燒狀態，並在以下順序被殺死時產生其他泰坦：燃燒泰坦、灰生巨怪、泰坦之拳 和 泰坦之手 一起。始終先瞄準 Imp。

df346b0ee12c0547a0cafef37327bb19ae8428a2.source: At the beginning of the mission, there are two bridges to the south; avoid fighting over them and use those structures as choke points instead. After crossing the second bridge, players will encounter a fork (both roads merge afterwards) and an overwhelming number of foes. Soon, a boss will spawn and all present patrols will rush towards it. Instead of engaging this huge army, it is advised to wait for them to go away and proceed to the south-east path to avoid such deadly threat. Another group of foes will be there. Before fighting these, make sure the big group has moved far enough away to avoid fighting both mobs. The Ancient Seer will be standing on the path to the south, "guarded" by at least (1) Burning Titan and must be saved for those willing to start the bonus. The Ancient Seer will not be attacked until within radar range of a party member. Continue to the south-west and you will arrive at a small area with different groups with overlapping patrols. The ground has ruptures and standing over them causes burning; watch positioning. Fight those foes separately to avoid over-aggro. Cross a third bridge to find the large open area where the three portals are located with numerous groups of foes.
df346b0ee12c0547a0cafef37327bb19ae8428a2.text: 任務開始時，南邊有兩座橋；避免爭奪它們，而是將這些建築物用作咽喉要道。穿過第二座橋後，玩家將遇到一個岔路口（兩條路隨後合併）和大量的敵人。很快，一個boss就會出現，所有在場的巡邏隊都會衝向它。建議不要與這支龐大的軍隊交戰，而是等待他們走開，然後向東南方向前進，以避免這種致命的威脅。另一群敵人將會在那裡。在與這些怪物戰鬥之前，請確保大群已經移得足夠遠，以避免與這兩個怪物戰鬥。古代 預言者 將站在通往南方的道路上，至少由 (1) 燃燒泰坦 “守衛”，並且必須為願意開始獎勵的人儲存。遠古 預言者 只有在黨員的雷達範圍內才會受到攻擊。繼續向西南方向走，你會到達一個小區域，有不同的小組，巡邏重疊。地面有裂縫，站在裂縫上會造成燃燒；手錶定位。分別與這些敵人戰鬥以避免過度仇恨。穿過第三座橋，找到三個傳送門所在的大片開放區域，那裡有許多敵人。

40f6152c28bbeb8cca1f2ca42e1133db4426ce52.source: This section features a large lava pool to the north-east from where more foes emerge until two bosses have spawned. Take out isolated foes that are scattered across the field to reduce their numbers. The very large number of mobs here can all be pulled in ones or twos if one waits patiently enough; Risen Ashen Hulk don't spawn any further Titans either. Then pull the roaming patrol away from the portals. Finally, close the portals by killing the three Portal Wraiths guarding them.
40f6152c28bbeb8cca1f2ca42e1133db4426ce52.text: 該區域的東北部有一個大型熔岩池，更多的敵人會從那裡出現，直到出現兩個 Boss。消滅分散在戰場上的孤立敵人以減少他們的數量。這裡的怪物數量非常多，只要耐心等待，三兩兩的都能被拉過來。 灰生巨怪 也不會再產生任何泰坦。然後將漫遊巡邏隊拉離傳送門。最後，殺死三個守衛傳送門的 介面 幽靈來關閉傳送門。

db3cfd7e90825b6e925551f2849b13f1d9e601db.source: A cinematic will trigger and players will be taken north to face the Undead Prince Rurik with a pair of Spark of the Titans, in addition to two groups of Fist of the Titans. It can be easier to pull Rurik and the two imps from the platform to isolate them away from their titan allies. Once the two imps and Rurik are dead, the next cinematic will trigger.
db3cfd7e90825b6e925551f2849b13f1d9e601db.text: 動畫將會觸發，玩家將被帶到北方，除了兩組 泰坦之拳 之外，還有一對 泰坦火花 面對 不死族盧瑞克王子。將魯裡克和兩個小惡魔從平臺上拉出來，將他們與泰坦盟友隔離開來會更容易。一旦兩個小鬼和魯裡剋死了，下一個過場動畫就會觸發。

4b85816ae6bd8e7181c5de1478255b3b831c1271.source: Defeat the very end boss, the Lich, who has the ability to cast characters into the lava, as well as teleport himself to escape the party's attack. He can also resurrect with full life from one to three times, every time accompanied by two Fists. It is recommended to take care of these servants immediately and before targeting the revived Lich again. Contrary to Rurik's cinematic dialogue, the Lich can be killed anywhere and not just while standing on the Bloodstone.
4b85816ae6bd8e7181c5de1478255b3b831c1271.text: 擊敗最後的首領巫妖，他有能力將角色投入熔岩中，並傳送自己以逃避隊伍的攻擊。他還可以滿血復活一到三次，每次都伴隨著兩個拳頭。建議在再次瞄準復活的巫妖之前立即解決這些僕人。與魯裡克的電影對話相反，巫妖可以在任何地方被殺死，而不僅僅是站在 血石 上。

781a707ec59cb8dd50bbc1dc8981e74ece117e1c.source: Parties with heroes/henchmen should flag them at the center of the Bloodstone so that they won't run into the lava.
781a707ec59cb8dd50bbc1dc8981e74ece117e1c.text: 有英雄/追隨者的隊伍應該在 血石 的中心標記他們，這樣他們就不會跑進熔岩中。

eb292fd7885ede1e04251a14ae36bf4f1a01231e.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Droknar's Forge (explorable area). Each player will receive a Deldrimor Talisman (once only) from Jalis Ironhammer which can be exchanged for a unique item.
eb292fd7885ede1e04251a14ae36bf4f1a01231e.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 卓克納熔爐（可探索區域）。每個玩家都會從 Jalis Ironhammer 收到一個 戴爾狄摩 護身符（僅限一次），可以兌換獨特的物品。

9608af955fc154c8433ef17e3551eb043663ef17.source: The bonus goal is to kill three Armageddon Lords (they also spawn Risen Ashen Hulks) at the large lava pool in front of the portals.
9608af955fc154c8433ef17e3551eb043663ef17.text: 獎勵目標是在傳送門前的大型熔岩池中殺死三名末日領主（他們還會生成復活的灰燼浩克）。

2d3248579c097968020814431117d98b043964bd.source: To obtain the objectives, players must first save the Ancient Seer located after the large spawn that moves toward the boss. A Burning Titan will be near the Seer, but will not attack them until a player reaches within spirit range. Pulling the mob just north of the Seer can therefore make the rescue easier. The bonus will fail if the Seer dies, even if you kill all the Armageddon Lords. The party healers can protect the Seer until the enemy is defeated. Once the foes are defeated, interact with the Seer, who will give you the bonus.
2d3248579c097968020814431117d98b043964bd.text: 為了獲得目標，玩家必須先儲存位於向 Boss 移動的大型生成點後面的古代 預言者。 燃燒泰坦 將位於 預言者 附近，但在玩家到達精神範圍內之前不會攻擊它們。因此，將怪物拉到 預言者 的北邊可以讓救援變得更容易。如果 預言者 死亡，即使您殺死了所有末日領主，獎勵也會失敗。隊伍治療者可以保護 預言者 直到敵人被擊敗。擊敗敵人後，與 預言者 互動，他會給你獎勵。

b854453750e5074421debca6407475fa9da90e15.source: The Armageddon Lords are themselves relatively easy to defeat and can be pulled individually from the lava pool. Do not close the portals before defeating the Armageddon Lords; doing so will trigger the cinematic, and players will have to backtrack twice--once to finish off the Armageddon Lords and then to engage Undead Prince Rurik later.
b854453750e5074421debca6407475fa9da90e15.text: 世界末日領主本身相對容易擊敗，並且可以單獨從熔岩池中拉出。在擊敗哈米吉多頓領主之前不要關閉傳送門；這樣做會觸發過場動畫，玩家將不得不原路返回兩次——一次是為了消滅末日領主，然後是稍後與 不死族盧瑞克王子 交戰。

49ce654064f65bdedae81938c03fa4fd7de5f259.source: Note: There is a chance to face a bad spawn where all the Hulks and Sparks appear very close to the Seer and aggro much more easily, which makes it practically impossible to save the Seer. It is recommended to approach the Seer from the north, as it is possible to trigger these foes on your way south.
49ce654064f65bdedae81938c03fa4fd7de5f259.text: 注意：有可能會遇到糟糕的重生，其中所有綠巨人和火花都非常接近 預言者，並且更容易產生仇恨，這使得幾乎不可能儲存 預言者。建議從北方接近 預言者，因為在向南的途中可能會觸發這些敵人。

7c4b731bacb95e90972e2c7856cf8ddb8ce62eaf.source: Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm, Mantra of Flame, interrupts like Maelstrom and Panic, and daze-inflicting skills like Technobabble.
7c4b731bacb95e90972e2c7856cf8ddb8ce62eaf.text: 元素結界 或 守護結界、火焰頌歌、水漩渦 和 恐慌 等中斷，以及 Technobabble 等造成眩暈的技巧。

47934ef7e3dd10fd34f8380af21bb600ef0615cf.source: Party-wide heals to counter the massive AoE damage.
47934ef7e3dd10fd34f8380af21bb600ef0615cf.text: 隊伍 範圍內的治療可以對抗巨大的 範圍性 傷害。

853271472dd5da455608416350c1eba88b55387d.source: A Frigid Armor tank to draw damage away from the rest of the party.
853271472dd5da455608416350c1eba88b55387d.text: 一輛 冰凍護甲 坦克，可將傷害從隊伍的其他成員身上轉移。

d671d95defb76724c9506edc0350f49cbac7099b.source: Cold damage skills are more effective against titans.
d671d95defb76724c9506edc0350f49cbac7099b.text: 冰凍傷害 技能對抗泰坦更有效率。

4af520e9309663e728950903a66e3e8fbb05dd87.source: Area of effect Weakness such as Enfeebling Blood to mitigate damage from multiple Fists and Hands of the Titans.
4af520e9309663e728950903a66e3e8fbb05dd87.text: 虛弱 的效果區域，例如 血之衰弱，可減輕來自多個泰坦之拳和之手的傷害。

21609759d3c14e8a0421f92fe7902e981b55b5e6.source: Only Sparks and Risen Ashen Hulk are fleshy. Other titans are not and thus are immune to conditions such as Bleeding, Poison and Disease, and don't leave a corpse. Since Risen Ashen Hulks also carry Aura of the Lich, this can make it difficult for minion masters. Steal their minions with Verata's Gaze or Verata's Aura, and bring Jagged Bones if you have access to it.
21609759d3c14e8a0421f92fe7902e981b55b5e6.text: 只有Sparks和灰生巨怪是肉質的。其他泰坦則不然，因此對 流血、中毒 和疾病等條件免疫，並且不會留下屍體。由於復活的灰燼綠巨人也攜帶 巫妖靈氣，這可能會給小兵大師帶來困難。使用 芙瑞達的凝視 或 芙瑞達的靈氣 竊取他們的僕從，如果您有權利使用 鋸齒骸骨，請帶上它。

ae2f24868c89048e4bbbe9079c794a8af6aacacc.source: Risen Ashen Hulks use Strip Enchantment. Bring cover enchantments if dependent.
ae2f24868c89048e4bbbe9079c794a8af6aacacc.text: 復活的灰燼浩克使用 剝奪加持。如果有依賴性，請帶上掩護結界。

ff96907e4441574538790d01ef0080a511d5f9ce.source: An Avatar of Melandru Dervish can be helpful for elemental armor and party-wide condition removal, as well as applying blindness with Dust Cloak against Fists and Hands of the Titans.
ff96907e4441574538790d01ef0080a511d5f9ce.text: 梅蘭朵化身 神喚使 有助於元素護甲和全隊條件移除，以及使用 塵土掩蔽 對抗泰坦之拳和之手施加失明。

78d1ac3ead12a3f962a28c554398faf2a35eefaa.source: Meteors will randomly fall throughout the mission, knocking down, and slightly damaging those they hit. The points at which they fall are predetermined and will not change, but how often they fall is varied.
78d1ac3ead12a3f962a28c554398faf2a35eefaa.text: 流星會在整個任務中隨機落下，擊落並輕微損壞被擊中的人。它們掉落的點是預先決定的並且不會改變，但是它們掉落的頻率是不同的。

7c0f3ddfe61b2513379cce23d453cd6c6e489d53.source: Offensive Binding rituals placed outside earshot range may help against the Lich, as he will not move toward you from the center. Make sure you can inflict enough damage to overcome the Lich's health regeneration.
7c0f3ddfe61b2513379cce23d453cd6c6e489d53.text: 放置在聽力範圍之外的進攻性束縛儀式可能有助於對抗巫妖，因為他不會從中心向你移動。確保你可以造成足夠的傷害來克服巫妖的生命恢復。

09ad271b9766ebc7e5b5eacbbb6267f3b63edab0.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.06% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
09ad271b9766ebc7e5b5eacbbb6267f3b63edab0.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.06% 的貢獻。

f70f111bbc607d405e254d405235983bf756e312.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Rhea's Crater. Specifically, Afflicted and Focus of Hanaku will no longer spawn.
f70f111bbc607d405e254d405235983bf756e312.text: 完成此任務會改變 席亞火山口 中出現的敵人。具體來說，Hanaku 的 Afflicted 和 聚能器 將不再產生。

5ae57decb8602641418cfcfa5de0f011864913eb.source: Starting from Seafarer's Rest, follow the quest markers and eliminate the three mobs of afflicted.
5ae57decb8602641418cfcfa5de0f011864913eb.text: 從航海者休憩處開始，依照任務標記消滅三個受影響的小怪。

f7c4f14e6603cd7ede0108aec8dfa7579ff5604f.source: The subsequent groups will not spawn until the previous group has been defeated, forcing you to finish the groups in order.
f7c4f14e6603cd7ede0108aec8dfa7579ff5604f.text: 在前一組被擊敗之前，後續組不會產生，迫使您按順序完成組。

2ee589ac0d77b2d08a6014e3f5546889ea8f0e81.source: Initiate Zei Ri leaves the party list before defeating the final group of afflicted, resulting in Zei Ri attempting to heal the Afflicted.
2ee589ac0d77b2d08a6014e3f5546889ea8f0e81.text: 新人 Zei Ri 在擊敗最後一批受折磨者之前離開了隊伍名單，導致 Zei Ri 試圖治癒受折磨者。

83ad7ba40c9bc4e452afb05c513fd5a9a08e3be3.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Calling the Order or Greed and Regret.
83ad7ba40c9bc4e452afb05c513fd5a9a08e3be3.text: 所有黨員都必須接受過「號令」或「貪婪與悔恨」的獎勵。

b2b4d06d5388a3692080e6d6ee7ff7bd9a6ff7d0.source: Defeat the Margonite generals before their forces take the Citadel. Preserve the perimeter bombards to aid you in the battle. Defend the gates to prevent enemy forces from reaching the Citadel.
b2b4d06d5388a3692080e6d6ee7ff7bd9a6ff7d0.text: 在 瑪骨奈 的軍隊佔領城堡之前擊敗他們。保留外圍轟炸以幫助你在戰鬥中。保衛大門，防止敵軍到達城堡。

54abbd2279de1fe6d0994753487f90657a3cc53d.source: Speak to Prince Ahmtur the Mighty.
54abbd2279de1fe6d0994753487f90657a3cc53d.text: 與強大的阿姆圖爾王子交談。

e78a9d39621b0975eb7b7804949ad4314ee106c7.text: *額外獎勵* 保持堡壘防禦完好無損。

cc014831a1041b4fc53e5a3258b9952672e78f65.source: If you are attempting the bonus with heroes and henchmen, it may take a few attempts to be successful. Assign all the Vabbi defenders to either the western or eastern bombard, and use your party to defend the remaining two. It may also be easier to let one of the bombards fall after the bosses spawn, since this will prompt the boss at that bombard to move towards the center; you can then engage him without having to move too far away from the other bombards. However, if any other defensive structures are lost you'll have to restart the mission for the bonus. You should also keep an eye on the status of the Vabbians; while they can usually hold their own against the Kournans, you may have to come to their aid.
cc014831a1041b4fc53e5a3258b9952672e78f65.text: 如果您嘗試英雄和追隨者的獎勵，可能需要幾次嘗試才能成功。將所有 瓦貝 防禦者分配到西部或東部轟炸區，並使用你的隊伍保衛剩餘的兩個。在 Boss 生成後讓其中一顆轟炸機落下也可能更容易，因為這會促使該轟炸機上的 Boss 向中心移動；然後你就可以與他交戰，而不必距離其他轟炸機太遠。但是，如果任何其他防禦結構遺失，您將必須重新啟動任務才能獲得獎勵。您還應該關注瓦比亞人的狀況；雖然他們通常可以抵抗庫南人，但你可能必須幫助他們。

c225445565ec7fea81d8a3b30eb35af69c70ffb4.source: Tactically, the Eastern Bombard is easier for the Vabbian defenders to hold because the difference in elevation between the attacking position and the Vabbian defenders is less significant, so the Kournan archers receive a smaller height advantage against the defenders. Furthermore, General Doriah is typically easier for smaller parties to defeat due to his lack of area of effect damage and generally weaker healing ability. Defeating him early in the battle will make it much easier for you to manage against the other generals, because the Western Bombard is much farther from the other two bombards.
c225445565ec7fea81d8a3b30eb35af69c70ffb4.text: 從戰術上來說，東部砲擊更容易被瓦比亞守軍守住，因為攻擊位置與瓦比亞守軍之間的海拔差異較小，因此庫爾南弓箭手對守軍的高度優勢較小。此外，多利亞將軍通常更容易被較小的隊伍擊敗，因為他缺乏有效傷害範圍並且治療能力通常較弱。在戰鬥初期擊敗他將使你更容易對付其他將軍，因為西方轟炸機距離其他兩架轟炸機要遠得多。

3df8535082661bd7c86c43680b7febeb5f0b0055.source: It helps to bring a minion master (especially Master of Whispers) and/or a spirit spammer to provide additional allies to hold the enemies' attention.
3df8535082661bd7c86c43680b7febeb5f0b0055.text: 它有助於帶來一個隨從大師（尤其是低語大師）和/或一個精神垃圾郵件傳送者，以提供額外的盟友來吸引敵人的注意力。

bfa019410c450fbc2ac90e6b78109116e5c6c441.source: Party-wide speed boosts, such as "Fall Back!", to move between bombards more quickly.
bfa019410c450fbc2ac90e6b78109116e5c6c441.text: 隊伍 範圍內的速度提升，例如“後退！”，可以更快地在轟炸之間移動。

99047b9f0c6b5c5d0801de0fe7215b1d8e2b1fe2.source: Shutdowns to prevent General Tirraj from dealing heavy damage, including interrupts and daze (along with martial players/heroes). Alternatively, damage mitigation skills, e.g. Shelter or Ward Against Elements.
99047b9f0c6b5c5d0801de0fe7215b1d8e2b1fe2.text: 關閉以防止提拉吉將軍造成嚴重傷害，包括打斷和眩暈（以及武術玩家/英雄）。或者，減輕傷害的技能，例如庇護 或 元素結界。

3d6e1aecea8a15a72dbc648fc7baf8c8accf80bb.source: Along with The Eternal Grove, this is one of the hardest missions to complete with only heroes and henchmen, due to having to defend multiple points against large numbers of foes.
3d6e1aecea8a15a72dbc648fc7baf8c8accf80bb.text: 就像永恆叢林一樣，這是僅靠英雄和追隨者完成的最難的任務之一，因為必須防禦大量敵人的多個點。

9d759f351cc1acf3c256760394e3fc0786b77ab0.source: You can force the generals to come forward as soon as they spawn by allowing one or more of the bombards to fall early on. The two central generals will come forward if the middle bombard is taken; the others will move closer if the bombard nearest to them falls.
9d759f351cc1acf3c256760394e3fc0786b77ab0.text: 你可以透過讓一枚或多枚砲彈儘早落下來迫使將軍們在出現後立即挺身而出。中砲，則兩中將出面；如果離他們最近的砲彈落下，其他人就會靠近。

d98d5098086e703e25b21e1fdadeac5797a1b1b6.source: If the generals are killed near where they spawned, their summoned groups usually will not move towards the bombards after their deaths. This allows you to specifically aim to kill only the general, before disengaging and running off to kill the next general.
d98d5098086e703e25b21e1fdadeac5797a1b1b6.text: 如果將軍在他們出生的地方附近被殺，他們的召喚團體通常不會在他們死後朝砲擊方向移動。這允許你專門瞄準只殺死將軍，然後脫離並跑去殺死下一個將軍。

c3589003ae02057e1e6ce272534510c055d40c1c.source: Cartographers can choose to ignore all the foes and make a run for the portal in the south, normally leading to Resplendent Makuun. Because it's a mission, you'll just run through the portal and encounter an end-of-the-world glitch. This makes for an extra, non-required 0.1% - 0.2%.
c3589003ae02057e1e6ce272534510c055d40c1c.text: 製圖師可以選擇忽略所有敵人並跑向南部的傳送門，通常通往輝煌的馬庫恩。因為這是一個任務，你只會穿過門戶並遇到世界末日的故障。這會產生額外的、非必要的 0.1% - 0.2%。

9d92d5ecab39046a496d2355d56b91ed800caaf4.source: If Prince Ahmtur dies, the mission fails.
9d92d5ecab39046a496d2355d56b91ed800caaf4.text: 如果阿姆圖爾王子死亡，任務就會失敗。

ca89929d3736133bbc42dc71dd165defa01ed8fc.source: After completing this mission, your party will appear in the Kodash Bazaar.
ca89929d3736133bbc42dc71dd165defa01ed8fc.text: 完成此任務後，你的隊伍將出現在 Kodash Bazaar 中。

640b66af65b2811ce8c2c36a69c98f7616346e3c.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #8 in the Night Falls storybook.
640b66af65b2811ce8c2c36a69c98f7616346e3c.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#8 頁。

3c1bf2550c31bad44fc0984767e63235a44cf164.source: The waves of Kournan soldiers that spawn after the Generals provide experience but do not drop items or gold.
3c1bf2550c31bad44fc0984767e63235a44cf164.text: 在將軍之後產生的庫南士兵浪潮會提供經驗，但不會掉落物品或金幣。

80a11148369a68c8c28f399409cd227c0333be24.text: de:扎貢努爾堡壘 (主線任務)

35eb9537c2c27aa394cbf76188b365027c9b4b88.source: Defeat the Afflicted in the Silent Surf.
35eb9537c2c27aa394cbf76188b365027c9b4b88.text: 在 寂靜之浪 中擊敗受影響者。

becbd67baa094b7a07565ab30e7818a14e57d3ad.source: Completing this quest changes the foes that appear in Silent Surf, specifically, Afflicted will no longer spawn.
becbd67baa094b7a07565ab30e7818a14e57d3ad.text: 完成此任務會改變 寂靜之浪 中出現的敵人，具體來說，受苦者將不再生成。

e0a75682d29e70a966b7b98748d8ddfbd2825411.source: After several waves of Kournan groups, four Margonite bosses (the Generals) will spawn at the far edge of the area in front of the citadel. The Chaos rifts which they control will continue to spawn groups of Kournan soldiers accompanied by a single Margonite demon as long as the boss is alive. The bosses must be killed to reduce the defensive workload for the team and complete the mission. The Generals will only come down towards the fort when each defense is broken - so the elementalist boss will come down to the East Bombard when the East Bombard is destroyed by the Kournan forces and will move onto the gate and beyond when the Kournan forces have destroyed the East Gate. The generals in order from west to east are; WarriorGeneral Doriah, MonkGeneral Nimtak, ParagonGeneral Kumtash, ElementalistGeneral Tirraj.
e0a75682d29e70a966b7b98748d8ddfbd2825411.text: 經過幾波 Kournan 小組的攻擊後，四個 瑪骨奈 Boss（將軍）將在城堡前面區域的最邊緣生成。只要 Boss 還活著，他們控制的混沌裂隙就會繼續產生一群庫南士兵，並伴隨著一個 瑪骨奈 惡魔。必須殺死boss才能減少隊伍的防守工作量並完成任務。將軍們只會在每次防禦被破壞時才會朝堡壘下降 - 因此，當東砲臺被庫南部隊摧毀時，元素主義者 Boss 會來到東砲臺，而當庫南部隊摧毀東門時，元素主義者 Boss 會移至大門並超越。將軍從西向東依序是：戰士將軍多利亞、僧侶將軍尼姆塔克、典範將軍庫姆塔什、元素師將軍蒂拉吉。

3483e788a2a76e3c7200d091f52a81e5a13ff4c6.source: Go to the side which does not have the Vabbi defenders. Kill any group of Kournans which emerge after the boss spawn and then push up to take out the boss. Fall back if need be to defend the middle, but each time you attack try to kill the boss or at least one of the Margonites in the boss' group. When that boss is killed get on top of the defensive situation on the other side and middle then work on the next boss along from the one you just killed. When the second boss is killed the worst is over and it should now be easy for you to get the situation under control as the attackers and defenders are focused in the same spot. Take out the remaining two bosses to finish the mission.
3483e788a2a76e3c7200d091f52a81e5a13ff4c6.text: 前往沒有 瓦貝 防守者的一側。殺死 Boss 出現後出現的任何一群 Kournan，然後往上推去消滅 Boss。如果需要的話可以撤退以防守中間，但每次攻擊時都嘗試殺死老闆或至少老闆團隊中的一個瑪貢尼特。當那個老闆被殺後，控制另一邊和中間的防禦情況，然後從你剛剛殺死的老闆開始處理下一個老闆。當第二個頭目被殺死後，最糟糕的情況就已經過去了，現在你應該很容易控制局勢，因為攻擊者和防禦者都集中在同一個地方。幹掉剩下的兩個boss即可完成任務。

07f9c948eddee82ef3c643c1a789a5d786cd3cfa.source: Remember that the mission becomes easier the more generals you kill as they will no longer summon more troops, so be assertive even if it means you suffer a few losses. If you send the Vabbians to the east gate (you should) then you can work from west to east, i.e. starting with General Doriah (the warrior). This will mean you have less running to do, and by the time you get to General Tirraj you should have a sizeable Vabbian force left to help you out (and absorb some of Tirraj's ridiculous spike damage). Go in for the kill - take out the priest (if there is one) and then the general - massive spike damage is your best friend, so a high-damage assassin build, air elementalist (or AoE fire elementalist if you've got snares) and mesmers are effective. When you go in for the kill, commit to it. Make sure you've got the energy reserves to get it, then you can retreat to regenerate before finishing off the group.
07f9c948eddee82ef3c643c1a789a5d786cd3cfa.text: 請記住，你殺死的將軍越多，任務就會變得越容易，因為他們將不再召喚更多的部隊，所以要有自信，即使這意味著你會遭受一些損失。如果你把瓦比人送到東門（你應該），那麼你可以從西向東工作，也就是從多利亞將軍（戰士）開始。這意味著你需要跑的次數更少，當你到達提拉吉將軍時，你應該有一支相當大的瓦比亞軍隊來幫助你（並吸收提拉吉的一些荒謬的尖刺傷害）。去殺戮 - 幹掉牧師（如果有的話），然後一般 - 巨大的尖刺傷害是你最好的朋友，所以高傷害刺客構建，空氣元素師（或 範圍性 火元素師，如果你有圈套）和催眠師是有效的。當你想要殺戮時，就要全心投入。確保你有足夠的能量儲備來獲得它，然後你可以在消滅隊伍之前撤退以恢復活力。

988d6b5a049db3e7de3a7cc2ff95246bb448f05b.source: You lose this mission (and bonus) by getting worn down. The Kournans and Margonites are fighting a war of attrition against you - you have very little time to recuperate between battles as you constantly need to be fighting somewhere else. That means your team needs to be relatively self-sufficient - bring a self-heal and something to help you regenerate energy quickly. The longer the mission goes on, the harder it will get as death penalty starts to rack up and you have no reserves left you will find it harder to eliminate groups quick enough and you'll find yourself overwhelmed. Consequently, end it as soon as possible - be ready to eliminate at least one general the moment they spawn. While this is a tough mission, well-equipped teams shouldn't have too much trouble.
988d6b5a049db3e7de3a7cc2ff95246bb448f05b.text: 你會因為疲憊而失去這個任務（和獎金）。庫爾南人和瑪貢尼特人正在與你進行一場消耗戰——你在戰鬥之間幾乎沒有時間恢復，因為你經常需要在其他地方戰鬥。這意味著你的團隊需要相對自給自足——帶來自我修復和幫助你快速恢復能量的東西。任務持續的時間越長，任務就會變得越困難，因為死刑開始累積，而你沒有剩餘的儲備，你會發現很難足夠快地消滅團體，你會發現自己不知所措。因此，盡快結束它——準備好在他們出現時消滅至少一名將軍。雖然這是一項艱鉅的任務，但裝備精良的團隊應該不會遇到太多麻煩。

53350177f51389fa0c9d6e7a09b9284433b31020.source: For the Master's reward on this mission only 5 of the 6 defensive structures need to remain.
53350177f51389fa0c9d6e7a09b9284433b31020.text: 為了獲得此任務中主人的獎勵，只需保留 6 防禦結構中的 5。

9fdb66891ee69a8938d0b1e2eef6bc1426bea3cf.source: For the best chance of survival and for minimization of damage, kill enemies in this order: Spark of the Titans · Armageddon Lords · Scelus Prosum (Elementalist boss) · Burning Titans · Fist of the Titans · Hand of the Titans · Bosses (excluding Elementalist boss) · Risen Ashen Hulk · Bone Horror
9fdb66891ee69a8938d0b1e2eef6bc1426bea3cf.text: 為了獲得最佳生存機會並最大限度地減少傷害，請按以下順序殺死敵人： 泰坦火花 · 世界末日領主 · 賽勒斯 普洛桑 （ 元素使 boss) · 燃燒泰坦 · 泰坦之拳 · 泰坦之手 · 老闆（不含 元素使 老闆）· 灰生巨怪 · 骨頭恐怖

a661698d7d21225482faf68a8e2c75abdd9e1030.source: (When you have defeated a Risen Ashen Hulk, be sure to finish the spawning Fists/Hands before moving to the next one.)
a661698d7d21225482faf68a8e2c75abdd9e1030.text: （當您擊敗 灰生巨怪 後，請務必完成生成的拳頭/手，然後再進行下一個。）

dbee277ecbc4c7b9725281abca58981cdb7e94f1.source: Though she's referred to as Glint, the dragon does not appear in the flesh during the end cinematic but rather in the same ghostly form as her Vision.
dbee277ecbc4c7b9725281abca58981cdb7e94f1.text: 雖然她被稱為 葛林特先知，但這條龍並沒有在片尾動畫中以肉體出現，而是像她的幻視一樣出現在幽靈般的 型態 中。

89c78447ee1375ac54016fc89034ac2271dc3977.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #18 of The Flameseeker Prophecies storybook.
