89c78447ee1375ac54016fc89034ac2271dc3977.text: 完成此任務將填滿火焰探索者 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事書的#18 頁。

c9349c71a04f85b3434a8947525d8f0fbce62edc.source: Occasionally, one of the portals does not appear. In this case, closing the other two portals does not help, but should be attempted. On rare occasions, the seer will be dead before you can trigger the bonus, even if you stayed out of compass distance.
c9349c71a04f85b3434a8947525d8f0fbce62edc.text: 有時，其中一個門戶不會出現。在這種情況下，關閉其他兩個門戶沒有幫助，但應該嘗試。在極少數情況下，即使您處於羅盤距離之外，預言家也會在您觸發獎勵之前死亡。

0b1a0e6e5c97d27d9d02e0b810c1e588b5a9ed59.source: Defeat the Afflicted in Rhea's Crater.
0b1a0e6e5c97d27d9d02e0b810c1e588b5a9ed59.text: 在 席亞火山口 中擊敗受影響者。

5bfe8b139a834dea69c459ff638475e52ddb5b58.source: There are 2-3 waves with several groups in each wave. The groups in each wave stagger from each other, but do overlap. It is easy to get quickly overwhelmed. Fortunately, there is a resurrection shrine nearby, either at the entrance if aligned with the Luxons or on the island to the northeast if aligned with the Kurzicks.
5bfe8b139a834dea69c459ff638475e52ddb5b58.text: 有 2-3 波，每波中有幾組。每個波浪中的群體彼此交錯，但確實重疊。很容易很快就不知所措。幸運的是，附近有一個復活神殿，如果與盧克森人對齊，則在入口處；如果與庫茲克人對齊，則在東北部的島上。

8163caf53e56733298200b5b194640c1b75161ce.source: However, you can stay away from where the Afflicted converge and pull foes away from the area to make the encounter less deadly. You do not need to kill all the afflicted to complete this quest. This quest can be completed by only killing five (1-5) groups of Afflicted:
8163caf53e56733298200b5b194640c1b75161ce.text: 然而，你可以遠離受影響者聚集的地方，並將敵人拉離該區域，以減少遭遇的致命性。你不需要殺死所有受苦的人來完成這個任務。只需殺死五組 (1-5) 受災者即可完成此任務：

ee1a19a6804113a96c6f84c428634d820f259cf2.source: Start from Unwaking Waters (Luxon), hug the west (left) wall towards the boats, and flag your team near the Mob (3) spawn point. Pull the starting Mob (1); once eliminated, use speed boosts to swiftly aggro Mob (2) that spawns near/behind one of the further boats before it moves to the center. After these are killed, Mob (3) will spawn behind you, near the original flag-point. Mob (4) will spawn right behind the boat that's closest to you. The last group, Mob (5), spawn relatively far away to the east of your likely location, but will move towards the boats before moving towards the center. After killing this group, the quest should be completed.
ee1a19a6804113a96c6f84c428634d820f259cf2.text: 從 Unwaking Waters (勒克森) 開始，緊靠西（左）牆朝向船隻，並在生物 (3) 重生點附近標記你的團隊。 拉出 起始生物 (1)；一旦被消滅，使用速度提升來快速攻擊在其中一艘船移動到中心之前在其附近/後面產生的生物（2）。這些被殺死後，生物（3）將在你身後生成，靠近原來的旗點。暴徒（4）將在距離您最近的船後面生成。最後一組，暴徒（5），在您可能的位置以東相對較遠的地方產卵，但會在向中心移動之前向船移動。殺掉這群人後，任務就該完成了。

48c2620e04182f2a2ad352c280f6ee405c2e59d2.text: 建議使用 範圍性 技能。

f56768a847b3052704e1680f9b8f395e5a6fd4e1.source: You do not need to kill all of the Afflicted. There is a spawn point to the southeast of the Afflicted gathering spot. During the second wave, the mob that triggers the end quest spawns from there.
f56768a847b3052704e1680f9b8f395e5a6fd4e1.text: 你不需要殺死所有的受折磨者。受影響者聚集點的東南方有一個重生點。在第二波期間，觸發最終任務的生物會從那裡產生。

d596a938f661e40f5916c367b6c16ba214eb1074.source: The Princes of Vabbi await you in the Halls of Chokhin.
d596a938f661e40f5916c367b6c16ba214eb1074.text: 瓦貝 的王子們在 Chokhin 大廳等著您。

847bfbb644f9f117c84c4197b6cf3787f64859f7.source: Defeat the invading forces and protect the messenger of Lyssa.
847bfbb644f9f117c84c4197b6cf3787f64859f7.text: 擊敗入侵勢力並保護 麗莎 的使者。

3c781bb8dfb44f6817998141707b86bd205e603e.source: Speak with the messenger of Lyssa.
3c781bb8dfb44f6817998141707b86bd205e603e.text: 與 麗莎 的信差交談。

88aaed712b6d561934f8f106b259da77c31d13f3.source: Hurry to the Mirror of Lyss and investigate what's happening at the Grand Court of Sebelkeh.
88aaed712b6d561934f8f106b259da77c31d13f3.text: 趕緊前往裡斯之鏡並調查塞貝爾克大法庭發生的事情。

16cf887cd9866c1480e99a20a08951c4922f378f.source: If you have Mihanu Township unlocked, you can map travel there and head north to the Hall of Chokhin; however if you don't, it is easiest to leave from the Grand Court of Sebelkeh outpost and head west to Mihanu Township.
16cf887cd9866c1480e99a20a08951c4922f378f.text: 如果您解鎖了 米哈努小鎮，您可以繪製那裡的旅行地圖並向北前往 Chokhin 大廳；但如果您不這樣做，最簡單的方法是從 Sebelkeh 大法院前哨站出發，向西前往 米哈努小鎮。

e74122dbd3300bf4959b6603b0c58af28b892715.source: After you walk near the princes, the quest evolves. You have to protect the Messenger of Lyssa against the four Margonites. After you talked to the messenger, map to the Grand Court of Sebelkeh and enter The Mirror of Lyss through the eastern exit. After talking to Morgahn, you see a cinematic. Now you can enter the Grand Court of Sebelkeh mission.
e74122dbd3300bf4959b6603b0c58af28b892715.text: 當你走近王子之後，任務就會改變。你必須保護 麗莎 的使者免受四個瑪貢尼特的侵害。與信差交談後，前往 Sebelkeh 大法院並從東面出口進入 麗之鏡湖。與摩根交談後，你會看到一部電影。現在你可以進入Sebelkeh大法庭任務了。

3191392f4b62ef19b8fdff929d66ad32a2fdbed3.source: If the Messenger of Lyssa dies at any point - even after talking to her - you will have to restart the quest.
3191392f4b62ef19b8fdff929d66ad32a2fdbed3.text: 如果 麗莎 的信差在任何時候死亡 - 即使在與她交談之後 - 你將不得不重新開始任務。

fca2e3738384d26d9a877574b76f52c141bb570e.source: During this quest, you can find another Prince Mehtu standing in the left chamber of the halls, in addition to the Prince Mehtu that spawns for the quest. It is possible to skip the first three objectives by talking to Morgahn. When doing this quest in Hard Mode, Vabbi Guards are occasionally able to outheal the damage output from the Margonites if a Margonite Cleric is present, causing them to never reach the Halls of Chokhin.
fca2e3738384d26d9a877574b76f52c141bb570e.text: 在這個任務中，除了為任務生成的梅圖王子之外，你還可以在大廳的左室中找到另一個梅圖王子。與摩根交談可以跳過前三個目標。在困難模式下執行此任務時，如果有 瑪骨奈 牧師在場，瓦貝 守衛偶爾能夠治癒瑪貢尼特人輸出的傷害，導致他們永遠無法到達 Chokhin 大廳。

fc4e94c08b66c237b72269675fd491cab2475219.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Pledge of the Merchant Princes.
fc4e94c08b66c237b72269675fd491cab2475219.text: 所有黨員必須接受 雜貨商人 王子誓言的獎勵。

5bdde3a8f5fc26d9757b8ab3ab21e68e7d5719f3.source: The Altar of Lyssa must not be captured by the Blasphemy.
5bdde3a8f5fc26d9757b8ab3ab21e68e7d5719f3.text: 麗莎 的祭壇不能被褻瀆者佔領。

190a8472203d42f52a2afefd437a55292b5227b2.source: Capture the torment rifts guarded by the Margonites. Stand near a rift to claim it. [0...3] of 3 rifts captured.
190a8472203d42f52a2afefd437a55292b5227b2.text: 佔領瑪貢派守衛的折磨裂縫。站在裂痕附近奪取它。捕捉 [0...3] 個 3 裂縫。

a29c79ced2553ae08652c55c8e0d661b7723df44.text: 摩根將軍 加入您的隊伍。

83522437a3f1bbd448f884ffde5a059601b8b857.source: The aim of this mission is to make sure that the citadel is not captured. You aren't alone in this task; you have several groups of Vabbi defenders to help you out and siege support from the citadel. You start out in the citadel and use a teleporter to exit the stronghold and begin the mission.
83522437a3f1bbd448f884ffde5a059601b8b857.text: 此任務的目的是確保城堡不被佔領。您並不孤單地執行這項任務；你有幾組 瓦貝 防禦者來幫助你，並從城堡中提供圍攻支援。你從城堡開始，使用傳送器離開要塞並開始任務。

eca4887cf5d9de171b0da4d6ad24f5f4e64317ca.source: In front of the citadel there are 3 groups of Vabbi defenders. The Disciple of Secrets which leads each group can be given instructions on where they should be defending. It is recommended that you send 2 groups to defend one side, and defend the middle with the last group.
eca4887cf5d9de171b0da4d6ad24f5f4e64317ca.text: 城堡前方有 3 組的 瓦貝 防禦者。帶領每個小組的秘密弟子可以得到指示，告訴他們應該防守哪裡。建議派2組防守一側，最後一組防守中間。

da0282e594a82ccf362fe7cb4bf06dc7dd52716c.source: Initially a few groups of Kournan soldiers will come towards the citadel. Focus your defense on the center with the Vabbi defenders, but you may need to travel widely to help control the Kournans. In a team with 2 or more human players, split into two teams of 4 for mobility and better defense. If you are alone it is best to stay with your team and defend the middle and the side without Vabbi defenders - Master of Whispers as a minion master is a good choice. 2 groups of Vabbi defenders will have trouble defending a side without some assistance.
da0282e594a82ccf362fe7cb4bf06dc7dd52716c.text: 最初，幾組庫爾南士兵將前往城堡。 聚能器 與 瓦貝 後衛一起在中路防守，但您可能需要廣泛移動以幫助控制庫南。在擁有 2 或更多人類玩家的隊伍中，分成兩隊 4 以提升機動性和更好的防守。如果你獨自一人，最好和你的團隊在一起，在沒有 瓦貝 防守者的情況下防守中路和邊路 - 密語大師作為隨從大師是一個不錯的選擇。 2 組的 瓦貝 防守球員在沒有任何幫助的情況下很難防守球隊。

0348db610267ea6ffd1ed0206a20b0af03484874.source: Successful completion of the mission in hard mode requires being able to kill the initial Margonite groups quickly, otherwise you will get overwhelmed and wipe. Bring either teams that can spike or create overlapping areas of effect (to damage several foes at once).
0348db610267ea6ffd1ed0206a20b0af03484874.text: 在困難模式下成功完成任務需要能夠快速殺死最初的瑪骨奈組，否則你會不知所措並消滅。派出可以刺殺或創造重疊效果區域的隊伍（同時傷害多個敵人）。

6582cf53999c4e45e8c9702f28794183b98a1e31.source: After clearing out the initial foes from the center, most parties split into two groups: 1-2 characters to hold the altar and the rest to capture the rifts. There are a variety of ways to accomplish this, the most popular of which include a healer with party-wide skills, a minion master, and/or a spirit spammer for the stationary team. The roving team should include mostly damage dealers.
6582cf53999c4e45e8c9702f28794183b98a1e31.text: 在清除了中心的最初敵人後，大多數隊伍分成了兩組：1-2 角色負責守衛祭壇，其餘角色負責佔領裂縫。有多種方法可以實現這一點，其中最受歡迎的方法包括具有全隊技能的治療師、小兵大師和/或固定團隊的精神垃圾郵件傳送者。巡迴團隊應該主要包括傷害經銷商。

4f92218e9e05367098e79524dcbefb7832899c89.source: If you don't split up, it's advised to close the southern rift first since it's much further away from the other two rifts. This means that when attempting to close the two much closer northwestern and northeastern rifts, The Blasphemy can be spotted much quicker should it spawn from the other rift.
4f92218e9e05367098e79524dcbefb7832899c89.text: 如果不分頭的話，建議先關閉南部裂谷，因為它距離另外兩個裂谷比較遠。這意味著，當試圖關閉兩個更近的西北和東北裂痕時，如果褻瀆者從另一個裂痕中產生，可以更快地被發現。

b9143f4da050dcbe78c689a1b6f2a08b4748c976.source: Lightbringer's Gaze is a useful interrupt against all enemies, especially the Torment Claws.
b9143f4da050dcbe78c689a1b6f2a08b4748c976.text: 光明使者的凝視可以有效打斷所有敵人，尤其是折磨之爪。

55f5474dbda9e19a515014cc3e211a9d98a87ca7.source: Wastrel's Worry and Wastrel's Demise are very useful against both the claws and Unbound Energies — the latter do not use any skills and the claws use only one skill with a long activation time.
55f5474dbda9e19a515014cc3e211a9d98a87ca7.text: 瓦思崔的憂慮和瓦斯崔之死對於對抗爪子和Unbound Energies都非常有用——後者不使用任何技能，而爪子只使用一種技能，並且啟用時間很長。

2df4ca0d0fbe40e42efad15beabbd896c7e1446a.source: Last Rites of Torment can be removed from the entire party nearly-instantly using Inspired or Revealed Hex. Hex Eater Signet will remove that hex from over half the team, if they are within range.
2df4ca0d0fbe40e42efad15beabbd896c7e1446a.text: 使用 Inspired 或 降咒顯露 幾乎可以立即從整個隊伍中移除最後的折磨儀式。 噬咒紋章 將從超過一半的團隊中移除該十六進位（如果他們在範圍內）。

6c02f5f9e2e7047f24f4ed0523c567ab054a82f1.source: Wards are especially useful, since the party and opposing mobs are restricted to small spaces.
6c02f5f9e2e7047f24f4ed0523c567ab054a82f1.text: 守衛特別有用，因為隊伍和敵對生物都被限制在狹小的空間。

c4e31f21789da99502928def421b3ad81997a4ad.source: With sufficient energy management, Dark Apostasy can work well to remove Spell Breaker.
c4e31f21789da99502928def421b3ad81997a4ad.text: 透過充分的能量管理，黑暗變節 可以很好地去除 魔法粉碎。

80a09b90f9f6da858f317189a65d0e02a101f0ac.source: The center altar can be held by two heroes: one useful combination is an Aura of the Lich minion master and a Necromancer/Ritualist healer.
80a09b90f9f6da858f317189a65d0e02a101f0ac.text: 中心祭壇可以由兩位英雄佔據：一個有用的組合是 巫妖靈氣 僕從大師和 死靈法師/祭祀者 治療者。

a89101ccbde025c108bbb13e1850d5f1adb8a3ac.source: Sometimes when playing the mission, The Blasphemy will immediately cast Summon Torment once upon respawning. If this happens it will continue to do so when respawning throughout the mission, making the task of completing it more stressful and potentially much more difficult.
a89101ccbde025c108bbb13e1850d5f1adb8a3ac.text: 有時在執行任務時，褻瀆者重生後會立即施放一次召喚折磨。如果發生這種情況，它將在整個任務重生時繼續這樣做，從而使完成任務的壓力更大，並且可能會更加困難。

e7eafcafa0ee3f1a97cd923e1d99e34fc1374ec1.source: After completing this mission for the first time, Garden of Seborhin is replaced by Nightfallen Garden until the completion of Abaddon's Gate.
e7eafcafa0ee3f1a97cd923e1d99e34fc1374ec1.text: 第一次完成此任務後，希伯欣花園 被墮夜花園取代，直到 亞霸頓 之門完成。

e2f7133853bf8ef3013f0fc6719985d6508b3874.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #10 in the Night Falls storybook.
e2f7133853bf8ef3013f0fc6719985d6508b3874.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#10 頁。

e0e0361c5724e2672c2e9dfb3fd3cf2f9b6e3b1f.text: de:Großer Hof von Sebelkeh (主線任務)

334061c48b4ca1cffb2620a526425a2d8264f93b.text: 所需英雄：寇斯 和 梅隆妮。

8ab1c759c8b1609f91b63600cfc73f6d63863cb3.source: Take Koss and Melonni to speak with Butoh the Bold to prepare the defenses of the Grand Forum of Vabb. (Koss and Melonni must be equipped heroes)
8ab1c759c8b1609f91b63600cfc73f6d63863cb3.text: 帶著 寇斯 和 梅隆妮 與大膽的 Butoh 交談，準備瓦布大廣場的防禦工事。 （寇斯和梅隆妮必須是裝備英雄）

9014fc0611fd8d87b51f7919beffe66890f5f431.source: Help defend the Grand Forum of Vabb. If it should fall, so will the Kodash Bazaar.
9014fc0611fd8d87b51f7919beffe66890f5f431.text: 幫助保衛瓦布大論壇。如果它倒塌，Kodash Bazaar 也會倒塌。

e4334ca66f40aabc0fdea4e4cfc10d08467ccc1c.source: See Zerai the Learner for your reward.
e4334ca66f40aabc0fdea4e4cfc10d08467ccc1c.text: 請見學習者澤萊以獲得獎勵。

b226db91ff9b2979e1a3306cf47ef7b48584cd46.source: Start in The Kodash Bazaar. Head out southwest and walk to Butoh the Bold. After talking to him, five groups of Margonites will spawn one after each other. Don't wait in the center for them to arrive, but head directly toward the first group in the southwest. The Ruby Djinn will help you, therefore it is a good idea to heal them. Proceed with the next groups. Don't worry about Margonites massing in the center, they won't do anything until/unless you're in aggro range. After killing all groups, talk again to Butoh the Bold. Map back to The Kodash Bazaar for your reward.
b226db91ff9b2979e1a3306cf47ef7b48584cd46.text: 從 庫丹西市集廣場 開始。往西南走，步行至勇敢的舞踏 (Butoh the Bold)。與他交談後，五組瑪貢尼特會依序生成。不要在中心等待他們到來，而是直接朝西南方向的第一批人走去。 紅寶石巨靈 將為您提供協助，因此治癒它們是個好主意。繼續進行下一組。不要擔心瑪貢尼特會聚集在中心，他們不會做任何事情，除非/除非你處於仇恨範圍內。殺死所有隊伍後，再次與無畏的舞踏交談。映射回 庫丹西市集廣場 以獲得獎勵。

621c5e2bc504507770eb3cdc8fa0a3d3e19b0fc0.source: "Please take this as thanks. I fear this is only the beginning. The Garden of Seborhin has fallen and Ronjok may be in peril. It seems you must now make a choice, hero."
621c5e2bc504507770eb3cdc8fa0a3d3e19b0fc0.text: “請以此表示謝意。恐怕這只是一個開始。希伯欣花園已經淪陷，羅鳩村可能陷入危險。看來你現在必須做出選擇，英雄。”

d8d98c57d6ce082853895c7b6c660369b66b5db9.source: A paragon with "They're on Fire!" will greatly reduce the damage dealt by the Margonites.
d8d98c57d6ce082853895c7b6c660369b66b5db9.text: 「他們著火了！」的典範。將大大減少瑪貢尼特造成的傷害。

0de6ec4eb1f8432d5f7f2f2423ef8c439655121a.source: If you have the quest Norgu's Nightfall active, Butoh the Bold will not spawn.
0de6ec4eb1f8432d5f7f2f2423ef8c439655121a.text: 如果您啟動了諾古的 黑暗逆襲 任務，大膽的布托將不會產生。

f2028dc3ea935af1224f185389ee6e2844da40f2.source: Sometimes even after killing all groups that have spawned you still won't complete the quest. This might be caused by one of the Vabbian Commoners being stuck behind a Vabbian Chest.
f2028dc3ea935af1224f185389ee6e2844da40f2.text: 有時，即使殺死了所有產生的群體，你仍然無法完成任務。這可能是由於一名瓦比安平民被困在瓦比安 寶箱 後面造成的。

2b0cffbd64cd644c5b77014828050352f79da82c.text: 主職 不是 死靈法師

1943712e24cf6f63533b31b50e47145f59f6ed2f.source: Speak with Headmaster Kuju in the monastery.
1943712e24cf6f63533b31b50e47145f59f6ed2f.text: 與修道院的久久校長交談。

dc7a00b4190203fbefcc4e7249cc80a5d3772492.source: Koss must be in your party.
dc7a00b4190203fbefcc4e7249cc80a5d3772492.text: 寇斯 必須在您的隊伍中。

179385e03109a739d42a26c204d753ead7ffe7a5.source: Bring Koss and find Hedge Wizard Lohhaj in the Nightfallen Garden.
179385e03109a739d42a26c204d753ead7ffe7a5.text: 帶著 寇斯 去墮夜花園找樹籬法師 Lohaj。

ba81cd75ab28b80e205068b76040682a54a4b82d.source: See Master Gardener Kobahl for your reward.
ba81cd75ab28b80e205068b76040682a54a4b82d.text: 去找園丁大師科巴爾領取獎勵。

65e176318425c86a3ff444e04c789137a8283137.source: This is a short, straightforward quest. Starting from Tihark Orchard, go out the west exit and head into the now Nightfallen Garden of Seborhin. Hedge Wizard Lohhaj is just a short distance to the north.
65e176318425c86a3ff444e04c789137a8283137.text: 這是一個簡短而直接的探索。從提哈克果園出發，從西邊出口出去，進入現在的墮夜精靈 希伯欣花園。樹籬巫師 Lohaj 位於北部不遠的地方。

d33727f6a48162e7b217077f432552ce98937fba.source: Contrary to Zerai the Learner telling you to choose one or the other, you can take both this quest and Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger at the same time to do both subsequent missions. Only one mission is needed to continue the storyline.
d33727f6a48162e7b217077f432552ce98937fba.text: 與學習者 Zerai 告訴你選擇其中一個相反，你可以同時接受此任務和「危險中的心或思想：羅鳩村」來完成後續任務。只需要執行一項任務即可繼續故事情節。

484e1817a1b9efd22b65a5217590086acf007942.source: This quest is the key in retaining access to the Nightfallen Garden after completion of the Nightfall campaign.
484e1817a1b9efd22b65a5217590086acf007942.text: 任務是完成 黑暗逆襲 戰役後保留進入墮夜花園的關鍵。

cfbf8dcf1451d42736bf868eceac0b62e3659d18.text: 恢復 安費 保護殼。

5a5738f832bdf803bca6ad6a7d4b206104235152.source: See Xan Hei for your reward.

b2fe679c6e2e13a6715273eb22a23ed8522b0e66.source: Your stated goal is to prevent the courier from reaching his vessel in Bejunkan Pier. However the quest will succeed as long as you kill him and pick up his Am Fah Case; it does not matter if he reaches the boat. As he runs to the docks, he will taunt you. Groups of Am Fah will popup along the way and attempt to prevent you from following. This allows you to take several distinct approaches:
b2fe679c6e2e13a6715273eb22a23ed8522b0e66.text: 您設定的目標是阻止快遞員到達 君瞰碼頭 中的船隻。然而，只要你殺死他並拿起他的 安費 箱子，任務就會成功；他是否到達船並不重要。當他跑到碼頭時，他會嘲笑你。一路上會彈出一群 安費 並試圖阻止您跟隨。這允許您採取幾種不同的方法：

6bd4446a0791629fa6a264000d0c1a999c0e9f3c.source: Simple: follow the courier slowly, spawning one group of foes at a time. You can use the same 8-member party that has worked for you for other Winds of Change quests (these Am Fah are weaker than most Afflicted groups). There is no need to follow the courier all the way down to the lowest level of the docks. Once he gets to his end point, he can be reached by longbow from the platform one level higher and will merrily run all the way up to you, reducing the number of groups that spawn by three.
6bd4446a0791629fa6a264000d0c1a999c0e9f3c.text: 簡單：慢慢跟隨信使，一次生成一組敵人。您可以使用其他曾經為您工作過的 變幻之風 任務的 8 成員隊伍（這些 安費 比大多數受影響群體弱）。無需一路跟隨快遞員到達碼頭的最底層。一旦他到達終點，就可以從更高一層的平臺用長弓到達他，並且他會愉快地跑到你身邊，從而將生成的群體數量減少三個。

f983951897ac1beaf083915285d4ba54a0f74922.source: Snare: using a combination of Dash (to catch up with the courier), "You Move Like A Dwarf!" (to knock him down early), and Mind Freeze or other hexes (to prevent him from getting away). The courier and his Am Fah allies will heal him and remove his conditions, so you will have to be able to spike him quickly.
f983951897ac1beaf083915285d4ba54a0f74922.text: 圈套：使用急衝（追趕快遞員）的組合，「You Move Like A 矮人！」（提前擊倒他），以及 心靈凍結 或其他六角形（防止他逃跑）。信差和他的 安費 盟友會治癒他並消除他的狀況，所以你必須能夠快速消滅他。

15c3499f3c94a2756dc2d17c80217395b47a5ac6.source: Degen: Instead of chasing or snaring the courier, let him go down the stairs. Kill just the first group and then spam health degeneration skills on him. Be careful not to go down the stairs yourself (or let any heroes do so), which will spawn a new group of Am Fah (that could heal and/or remove hexes and conditions). Useful skills include Life Siphon, Conjure Nightmare, and Illusion of Pain.
15c3499f3c94a2756dc2d17c80217395b47a5ac6.text: 德根：與其追趕或誘捕快遞員，不如讓他下樓梯。只殺死第一組，然後向他傳送健康退化技能。小心不要自己下樓梯（或讓任何英雄這樣做），這將產生一組新的 安費（可以治癒和/或移除六角形和狀況）。實用的技能包括 吸取生命、召喚夢魘 和 苦痛幻覺。

1ae3d23d850e7c4bb73cc5b26c9d09607b336c31.source: Nightfall Lightbringer Completion time > 9 minutes 6 - 9 minutes 16 minutes 12 - 16 minutes < 12 minutes 25 25 25 75 75 75
1ae3d23d850e7c4bb73cc5b26c9d09607b336c31.text: 黑暗逆襲 光明使者完成時間 > 9 分分鐘 6 - 9 分分鐘 16 分分鐘 12 - 16 分鐘 < 12 分分鐘 25   25   25   75   75   75

691ef370fcbd54fdb18d8a9ffc4647d40bc200de.source: The Sebelkeh Basilica has an octagonal lay out with the Altar of Lyssa at the center and three surrounding platforms to the south, northwest, and northeast. Each platform is initially occupied by 7 Margonites, a Torment Claw, and a Torment Rift. The goal of this mission is to capture all three Torment Rifts without losing the Altar of Lyssa. For each Torment Rift that is captured the first time, your party gains a 2% Morale Boost.
691ef370fcbd54fdb18d8a9ffc4647d40bc200de.text: Sebelkeh 大教堂呈八角形佈局，麗莎 祭壇位於中心，周圍有南、西北和東北三個平臺。每個平臺最初都被 7 Margonites、折磨爪和折磨裂縫所佔據。任務的目標是在不失去 麗莎 祭壇的情況下佔領所有三個折磨裂縫。對於第一次佔領的每個折磨裂縫，你的隊伍都會獲得 2% 士氣提升。

d89d33f79214d3124ad14776a4112fc5c71d648c.source: Capturing a rift (or the altar) works the same as similar mechanics in other missions: each character standing on or near the object adds one pip towards capturing it; each foe subtracts a pip; this is capped at a maximum of 4 pips in either direction.
d89d33f79214d3124ad14776a4112fc5c71d648c.text: 佔領裂縫（或祭壇）的工作原理與其他任務中的類似機制相同：站在該物體上或附近的每個角色都會為佔領該物體增加一個點；每個敵人減去一個點；任一方向的上限為 4 點的最大值。

1bca59f17b5f5a72f92bd5b1a61d3174d9b854f7.source: The party starts standing in a teleportation circle, north from the Altar of Lyssa; leaving the circle starts the countdown timer and triggers the first wave of Margonites: two will rush from each of the three platforms to attempt to capture the Altar. As soon as possible, position party members close to the altar to prevent this from happening.
1bca59f17b5f5a72f92bd5b1a61d3174d9b854f7.text: 隊伍開始站在 麗莎 祭壇以北的傳送圈中；離開圓圈會啟動倒數計時器並觸發第一波瑪貢尼特：兩個將從三個平臺中衝出，試圖佔領祭壇。盡快將黨員安置在靠近祭壇的位置，以防止這種情況發生。

f2b167f3eddd60167458a7c95185f12605bfe682.source: As soon as you kill the pair of Margonites from a single Rift, a second pair spawns and moves towards the Altar.
f2b167f3eddd60167458a7c95185f12605bfe682.text: 一旦你從一個裂縫中殺死了一對瑪貢尼特，第二對就會生成並移向祭壇。

37d8818fc4626f26b267ed1af79f0f0846479278.source: The Blasphemy will spawn at a random Rift and move towards the center; to speed up its recapture of the altar, it will use Summon Torment. Kill it to counter this. Unfortunately, its death hexes the entire party with Last Rites of Torment and triggers the spawning of three Unbound Energies; they deal considerable damage to those under the hex.
37d8818fc4626f26b267ed1af79f0f0846479278.text: 褻瀆者會在隨機裂縫處生成並向中心移動；為了加快奪回祭壇的速度，它會使用召喚折磨。殺死它來對抗這一點。不幸的是，它的死亡用最後的折磨儀式對整個隊伍施咒，並觸發了三個未束縛能量的產生；它們對那些被詛咒的人造成了相當大的傷害。

1a7c176d259c4f028f0126df7f7b957ad4b20071.source: The Blasphemy continues to respawn throughout the mission; it appears faster with each time you capture a rift. Make sure you kill any remaining Unbound Energies before killing it again. If it heads towards a Rift (to re-open it), send one or more party members to prevent this.
1a7c176d259c4f028f0126df7f7b957ad4b20071.text: 褻瀆在整個任務中不斷重生；每次捕捉裂縫時，它都會出現得更快。確保在再次殺死它之前殺死任何剩餘的未束縛能量。如果它走向裂縫（重新開啟它），請派遣一名或多名黨員來阻止這種情況。

d17008001f40fcc5f2e4c77e4d952c1481331d7d.source: Each time the Blasphemy successfully activates Summon Torment, the rift status bars will fill 25%, allowing the rifts to be reopened and additional margonites to spawn. To prevent this, interrupt the Blasphemy's first use of the skill and kill it before it can cast it again. Keep an eye on the rift bars; if they get to 75%, send a party member to return the rift bar back to blue (or at least, reduce the amount of red).
d17008001f40fcc5f2e4c77e4d952c1481331d7d.text: 每次褻瀆成功啟動召喚折磨時，裂縫狀態列都會填充 25%，從而允許裂縫重新開啟並生成更多瑪貢石。為了防止這種情況發生，請打斷褻瀆者第一次使用該技能並在其再次施放該技能之前將其殺死。留意裂縫條；如果他們到達 75%，請派一名隊員將裂縫條恢復為藍色（或至少減少紅色數量）。

344dd600a839ab4215ee1efac593fe26a75ec0eb.source: You can ignore The Blasphemy when it first spawns and capture one of the Rifts instead. You must kill all foes in addition to capturing it or they will re-open the Rift later. To speed up the capture, stand near each rift during the fight. Stay spread out while confronting the Torment Claws to avoid massive area of effect damage or take advantage of Torment Slash's long activation time and interrupt it. You can also dodge the slash by moving away.
344dd600a839ab4215ee1efac593fe26a75ec0eb.text: 當褻瀆第一次出現時，你可以忽略它並捕獲其中一個裂縫。除了捕獲敵人之外，你還必須殺死所有敵人，否則他們稍後會重新開啟裂縫。為了加快捕獲速度，請在戰鬥中站在每個裂縫附近。面對折磨利爪時保持分散，以避免大範圍的效果傷害，或利用折磨斬的長啟用時間並打斷它。您也可以透過移動來躲避斜線。

e384b1e7dcc6d0d766cec0feef0de739a770e1e8.source: After capturing the first Rift, go back to the Altar and kill The Blasphemy plus the Unbound Energies. Once you have ensured the safety of the Altar, go capture a second Rift. Then return to kill The Blasphemy again and finally capture the last Rift. The mission will often take a few seconds to complete once all the rifts are closed.
e384b1e7dcc6d0d766cec0feef0de739a770e1e8.text: 佔領第一個裂縫後，返回祭壇並殺死褻瀆者和未束縛的能量。一旦確保了祭壇的安全，就去佔領第二個裂縫。然後再次返回擊殺褻瀆者，最終佔領最後一個裂縫。一旦所有裂縫都關閉，任務通常需要幾秒鐘才能完成。

e3d491571f9b06d1654a5bc7532dd058e3c89afc.source: Shadow step: equip all party members and heroes with a shadow step skill, the remainder of their builds can be as normal. Allow the courier to run down the stairs then kill the first group. While remaining up the top, edge into the corner closest to where the courier stops. You can then shadow step the team to him and kill him; as this bypasses the normal trigger point, the courier does not attempt to run off. If high damage skills are used the team can easily spike him and retrieve the case before the surrounding Am Fah pop.
e3d491571f9b06d1654a5bc7532dd058e3c89afc.text: 闇影步驟：為所有隊員和英雄裝備暗影步技能，其餘的建造可以正常進行。讓信差跑下樓梯，然後殺死第一組。在保持頂部的同​​時，邊緣進入最靠近快遞停止處的角落。然後你可以用影子步將團隊帶到他身邊並殺死他；由於這繞過了正常的觸發點，因此快遞員不會嘗試逃跑。如果使用高傷害技能，團隊可以輕鬆地秒殺他並在周圍的 安費 爆炸之前取回箱子。

d57d7366d0919d491325c777821d8c69181bc4cd.source: Bodyblock upon entering dash to the courier and use "You Move Like a Dwarf!" on him, bodyblock him on the stairs as he used antidote signet preventing him from escaping.
d57d7366d0919d491325c777821d8c69181bc4cd.text: 衝向快遞員時用身體阻擋並使用“You Move Like a 矮人!”在他使用解毒印章時，用身體把他擋在樓梯上，防止他逃跑。

d6ff8ede249a878cab98fcda3332609c090f01d6.source: Long range damage: Take casters with you and after you killed the first spawn the courier will be standing still. You can hit him with long range damage from the top and he will not run away, if you have enough firepower you can kill him this way.
d6ff8ede249a878cab98fcda3332609c090f01d6.text: 遠端傷害：隨身攜帶腳輪，在殺死第一個生成後，信差將靜止不動。你可以從上面對他進行遠端傷害，他不會逃跑，如果你有足夠的火力，你可以這樣殺死他。

d564d6b1158f7b28f622ef2cc01297250fc3e5f8.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger.
d564d6b1158f7b28f622ef2cc01297250fc3e5f8.text: 所有黨員必須接受《心與心：危險花園》的獎勵。

5c5ab6289ab7d1df28a49aa5ea22594a0ef24e73.source: Defeat the Harbinger of Nightfall before it summons enough demons to destroy Seborhin.
5c5ab6289ab7d1df28a49aa5ea22594a0ef24e73.text: 在 黑暗逆襲 召喚足夠的惡魔來摧毀 Seborhin 之前擊敗它。

c474051b949c7ca0c5e17b1126d182640c616eb6.source: Protect the Spirits of Seborhin from the onslaught of torment demons.
c474051b949c7ca0c5e17b1126d182640c616eb6.text: 保護塞博欣的靈魂免受折磨惡魔的攻擊。

ecc4182646f136ef5e09a0eb9e5ca14ae31ffc27.source: The Light of Seborhin is the only thing that can harm the Harbingers. Drop the Light of Seborhin when you are close enough to an enemy to release its energy.
ecc4182646f136ef5e09a0eb9e5ca14ae31ffc27.text: 塞伯林之光是唯一可以傷害先驅者的東西。當您距離敵人足夠近以釋放其能量時，放下塞伯林之光。

84d8c883cf50902fb89569fd08eae38e7d9a9e0b.text: *額外獎勵* 擊敗額外的先驅者。

1b0ce069c601041bc4dd59680c6db5fc55c563cc.source: You have defeated [0...2] of 2 additional Harbingers.
1b0ce069c601041bc4dd59680c6db5fc55c563cc.text: 您已擊敗 [0...2] 個 2 額外先驅者。

fb0dc829e313a298062aaccd052a1bdbfb0d5dc4.source: Repeat this same pattern (i.e. Patrol → Stationary → Patrol → Stationary, etc.) until you reach the Harbinger of Nightfall. This end boss will only die after three Lights of Seborhin have been dropped on it. Either have the three needed ready somewhere nearby before engaging, or have three players carry each of them.
fb0dc829e313a298062aaccd052a1bdbfb0d5dc4.text: 重複相同的模式（即巡邏 → 固定 → 巡邏 → 固定等），直到到達 黑暗逆襲 的先驅。這個最終頭目只有在三顆Seborhin之光落在它身上後才會死亡。要麼在交戰前將所需的三個人準備在附近的某個地方，要麼讓三名玩家分別攜帶它們。

e581ad9a2cc1691f44b39a5e80e581d6b48a5296.source: The bonus consists of killing the two additional Harbingers and their Margonite company located at the top of the north and south stairs. Ideally, lure some of the foes down the stairs towards where the patrol will cross - so that you can catch the patrol before they escape your party - walking next to the edge of the staircase and then away, is usually enough to pull the Margonites down the stairs. Note that killing only the Harbinger is not enough, and you must kill the entire group of Margonites near the Harbinger to get credit.
e581ad9a2cc1691f44b39a5e80e581d6b48a5296.text: 獎勵包括殺死另外兩名先驅者和他們位於南北樓梯頂部的 瑪骨奈 連。理想情況下，引誘一些敵人下樓梯到巡邏隊將要經過的地方 - 這樣你就可以在他們逃離你的隊伍之前抓住他們 - 走到樓梯邊緣然後離開，通常足以將瑪貢尼特人拉下樓梯。注意，僅僅殺死先驅者是不夠的，你必須殺死先驅者附近的整群瑪貢尼特才能獲得功勞。

3aac371b396d79c6c5d0f6f5cddb3eed56540336.source: Lightbringer skills and Lightbringer title active.
3aac371b396d79c6c5d0f6f5cddb3eed56540336.text: 光明使者技能和光明使者稱號處於啟動狀態。

dc34b2e3dfb755e0b1b429c0c1ef9185dd12cf94.source: A speed boost to intercept the patrols and transport Lights of Seborhin.
dc34b2e3dfb755e0b1b429c0c1ef9185dd12cf94.text: 攔截巡邏隊和運輸塞伯林之光的速度提升。

e82ecc1e9b7cbf0c2b99a31c5bad2f0181a1dee2.source: A minion master to provide a meat shield and prevent Margonite Warlocks creating wells.
e82ecc1e9b7cbf0c2b99a31c5bad2f0181a1dee2.text: 一個僕從大師提供肉盾並防止 瑪骨奈 術士建立井。

d72305c36a6c226b7eeeb12c809c8809678df84d.source: Martial professions should focus on bursting down Margonite Clerics who use Spell Breaker.
d72305c36a6c226b7eeeb12c809c8809678df84d.text: 武術職業應該專注於消滅使用 魔法粉碎 的 瑪骨奈 牧師。

d1d93bd674bcf5351deacd473c4d5d160d550842.source: Abilities that blind such as Blinding Surge and or Ineptitude can be helpful against the melee Margonite Reapers and Executioners.
d1d93bd674bcf5351deacd473c4d5d160d550842.text: 盲目震盪 和/或 愚蠢 等致盲能力有助於對抗近戰 瑪骨奈 收割者和劊子手。

961b57c81cca471dc01705389f399d38e2accbd6.source: Interrupts are important to bring, not just for Margonite Clerics, Sorcerers and Warlocks, but also to interrupt the Margonite monster skill Abaddon's Chosen which will lengthen a fight drastically.
961b57c81cca471dc01705389f399d38e2accbd6.text: 打斷很重要，不僅對瑪骨奈牧師、術士和術士來說，而且還可以打斷瑪骨奈怪物技能亞霸頓的選擇，這將大大延長戰鬥時間。

b4fa8e6ed4381a8a99f8e7d3bcf53ee17e2ffe74.source: Martial professions should bring unblockable skills or Asuran Scan as Margonite Clerics use Aegis.
b4fa8e6ed4381a8a99f8e7d3bcf53ee17e2ffe74.text: 武術職業應攜帶不可阻擋的技能或阿蘇蘭掃描，因為 瑪骨奈 牧師使用 神賜之盾。

22fce7e1825be2c2f03490ad4fabce3f042a3158.source: The types of Margonites found in the patrol group depends on how many Harbingers have been killed. However, the composition of the teams does not affect the above strategy.
22fce7e1825be2c2f03490ad4fabce3f042a3158.text: 巡邏隊中發現的瑪貢尼特的型別取決於有多少先驅者被殺死。不過，球隊的組成並不影響上述策略。

df4a0619619dca6dff2e80f91317e3450008ea22.source: The Margonite patrols do not drop loot or give experience, possibly to prevent farming exploitation.
df4a0619619dca6dff2e80f91317e3450008ea22.text: 瑪骨奈 巡邏隊不會掉落戰利品或提供經驗，可能是為了防止農業剝削。

510caf7db0be3557d4711ed4b208a52c9b2cdede.source: On rare occasion, killing both additional Harbingers and their support groups will not progress the bonus objective (You have defeated [0 or 1] of 2 additional Harbingers.). Players will have to restart the mission to get master's reward. (Let the Bonus Harbingers hit you before you drop the Light and kill them, the bug seems to trigger when they get killed before they have the chance to land a single blow.)
510caf7db0be3557d4711ed4b208a52c9b2cdede.text: 在極少數情況下，殺死額外的先驅者及其支援小組不會推進獎勵目標（您已擊敗 [0 或 1] 的 2 額外先驅者。）。玩家必須重新開始任務才能獲得大師的獎勵。 （讓 額外獎勵 先驅者在你放下聖光並殺死他們之前擊中你，當他們在有機會發動一擊之前被殺死時，該錯誤似乎會觸發。）

f403c1dd5f5ffda4c5d4a49f4a332220c850bcbf.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to The Kodash Bazaar.
f403c1dd5f5ffda4c5d4a49f4a332220c850bcbf.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 庫丹西市集廣場。

46dde20cd48c2205f4438d289607f41b9b7be7b7.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #11 in the Night Falls storybook.
46dde20cd48c2205f4438d289607f41b9b7be7b7.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#11 頁。

8dbd9a00110ba80922e5b578cbbc8a20dc8c9aee.source: Melonni must be in your party.
8dbd9a00110ba80922e5b578cbbc8a20dc8c9aee.text: 梅隆妮 必須在您的隊伍中。

786b607a171e8903b3786b4d490a39453286a876.source: Take Melonni to Ronjok in the Marga Coast and speak with Elder Jonah.
786b607a171e8903b3786b4d490a39453286a876.text: 將 梅隆妮 帶到 馬加海岸 中的 羅鳩村 並與喬納長老交談。

629c62b278ba52caaaac61fd002010ac80c3e8f9.source: Follow Melonni's directions and investigate the area around Ronjok.
629c62b278ba52caaaac61fd002010ac80c3e8f9.text: 依照 梅隆妮 的指示並調查 羅鳩村 周圍的區域。

1165a91c81b650e3811b31d73fdcf7f5d94ca747.source: Quell Hahla's nightmares. Defeat the torment demons.
1165a91c81b650e3811b31d73fdcf7f5d94ca747.text: 平息哈拉的惡夢。擊敗折磨惡魔。

30b292cbf0349a16637fa8ab5dc71f968886e1a7.source: See Dreamer Raja for your reward.
30b292cbf0349a16637fa8ab5dc71f968886e1a7.text: 前往夢想家 Raja 領取獎勵。

af53a4f9497482691599a4b3af821f1ee5872694.source: After accepting the quest, map to the Sunspear Sanctuary. Take Melonni with you and head out the Marga Coast exit into the village of Ronjok and talk to Elder Jonah. Melonni will want to investigate the area and will lead you to three points in the vicinity of the village. At the third point, you will find Dreamer Hahla. As you approach her, a group of six Torment creatures will spawn, which you will have to fight off. After a cinematic, you are at Nundu Bay.
af53a4f9497482691599a4b3af821f1ee5872694.text: 接受任務後，對映到日戟避難所。隨身攜帶 梅隆妮，從 馬加海岸 出口前往 羅鳩村 村，並與喬納長老交談。 梅隆妮 會想要調查該區域，並會帶您前往村莊附近的三個地點。在第三點，你會找到夢想家哈拉。當你接近她時，會生成一組六隻折磨生物，你必須擊退它們。看完電影後，您將進入 納度灣。

e1ae53f4adb7279a86c9ad7b86a598c4fc00baa4.source: Contrary to Zerai the Learner telling you to choose one or the other, you can take both this quest and Heart or Mind: Garden in Danger at the same time to do both subsequent missions. Only one mission is needed to continue the storyline.
e1ae53f4adb7279a86c9ad7b86a598c4fc00baa4.text: 與學習者澤萊告訴你選擇其中一個相反，你可以同時接受這個任務和《心與思想：危險花園》來完成後續任務。只需要執行一項任務即可繼續故事情節。

3baacdd31c55e796db74f7ed5b16c43ede6d4460.source: Find information regarding the chalice. Good responses: [0...3] of 3.
3baacdd31c55e796db74f7ed5b16c43ede6d4460.text: 尋找有關聖杯的資訊。好的回應：3 的 [0...3]。

68b3afba8d5d6684bcf2dc55da5a92742ed4a788.source: Find information regarding the chalice. Bad responses: [0...3] of 3
68b3afba8d5d6684bcf2dc55da5a92742ed4a788.text: 尋找有關聖杯的資訊。錯誤回應：3 的 [0...3]

1544c23c998221f0bf658804b30c37862bcbcc66.source: Start from Senji's Corner and exit to Xaquang Skyway to talk to Xan Hei who is a few steps from the town. He will transport you to a small area in The Marketplace where you must talk to the people in order to further the quest.
1544c23c998221f0bf658804b30c37862bcbcc66.text: 從 山吉之街 出發，到 夏安便道 出口與距離城鎮僅幾步之遙的 Xan Hei 交談。他將帶你到 市集 的一個小區域，你必須在那裡與人們交談才能進一步完成任務。

5c5af4c78a44bf45b368ef1011349daa4e09fff9.source: There are two parts to the quest. The first requires that you obtain intel about the Chalice by questioning the locals; you succeed by getting three good or three bad responses. Fortunately, there are five NPCs, so you will inevitably get three responses of the same type no matter how they respond.
5c5af4c78a44bf45b368ef1011349daa4e09fff9.text: 任務分為兩個部分。第一個要求你透過詢問當地人來獲得有關聖杯的情報；如果你得到三個好的或三個壞的反應，你就成功了。還好NPC有五個，所以無論他們如何反應，你都不可避免地會得到三個相同型別的反應。

7725670955caaedbb2d5c3b4fcca5a04eb908e1f.source: Unfortunately, as soon as you accomplish this task, Fah Yu the Shadow's Eye and a couple of Am Fah mobs spawn and rush toward the center of The Marketplace area (the red platform in the middle). Initially there are two mobs from each direction, then after they are dead there is another group from each side. As long as you are spread out when this happens, you should not expect too much trouble, since these foes are not any tougher than the ones you have seen so far. After killing Fah Yu and company, listen to the brief dialogue, then return to Xan Hei to claim your reward.
7725670955caaedbb2d5c3b4fcca5a04eb908e1f.text: 不幸的是，一旦您完成此任務，闇影 之眼 Fah Yu 和幾個 安費 怪物就會產生並衝向 市集 區域的中心（中間的紅色平臺）。最初，每個方向都有兩個小怪，然後在它們死後，每個方向都會有另一組小怪。當這種情況發生時，只要你分散開來，你就不會遇到太多麻煩，因為這些敵人並不比你迄今為止所見過的敵人更難對付。殺死Fah Yu和他的同伴後，聽簡短的對話，然後回到Xan Hei領取獎勵。

0a688abd9272fa13a0c81726723f69842ae6f1a6.source: Since the area is small, certain skills are especially effective: those with AoE damage or protection, Shouts, Wards, and Wells. To prevent getting wiped by the Am Fah's Chaos Storms, replace any wands or staves with martial weapons (preferably spears for heroes, so that they do not follow foes into melee range).
0a688abd9272fa13a0c81726723f69842ae6f1a6.text: 由於該區域很小，某些技能特別有效：具有 範圍性 傷害或保護、喊叫、守衛和水井的技能。為了防止被 安費 的混沌風暴消滅，請用軍用武器替換任何魔杖或法杖（英雄最好是長矛，這樣他們就不會跟隨敵人進入近戰範圍）。

d976e2ca237927c46caea90f646821800cbdc0f0.source: In hard mode, the typical strategy is to park the party in the northwest corner, near Kaineng Docks exit, where enemies are least likely to go towards. Having a bonder hero eases the difficulty in this quest. Am Fah that spawn out of the Bukdek Byway exit will head west along the north side, and are easy to aggro from the Kaineng Docks exit; meanwhile the enemies from Wajjun Bazaar exit will head east to the spawn point and can be pulled later by players at their leisure. It is best to leave Kun Yao last to talk to be in position without aggroing a Wajjun group.
d976e2ca237927c46caea90f646821800cbdc0f0.text: 在困難模式下，典型的策略是將隊伍停在西北角，靠近 凱寧船塢 出口，敵人最不可能前往的地方。擁有一個邦德英雄可以減輕這個任務的難度。從 巴德克小徑 出口產生的 安費 會沿著北側向西移動，並且很容易從 凱寧船塢 出口被仇恨；同時，來自 瓦江市場 出口的敵人將向東前往重生點，稍後玩家可以在閒暇時將其拉走。最好把坤耀留在最後，以便在不激怒瓦軍團體的情況下就位。

e8daa3d92defcc342bee0521d02c21f3325994d7.source: To get the desired response, choose the listed dialogue as it becomes available during your conversations:
e8daa3d92defcc342bee0521d02c21f3325994d7.text: 要獲得所需的回應，請選擇在對話期間可用的列出的對話：

9b2a0baf9cae60c3b62aede30df8309d5fe184fe.source: Speaking with Ja Wen, Vai Di, Jeiff, or Sho Ri will not advance the quest.
9b2a0baf9cae60c3b62aede30df8309d5fe184fe.text: 與 Ja Wen、Vai Di、Jeiff 或 Sho Ri 交談不會推進任務。

64b51261ad9473e71492c1285c7e871df23c0076.text: 尋找 Jeijou，闇影 低聲說。

fa72c49a60f8ecd6e48466808fd845bf9254a58d.source: Enter Nahpui Quarter from Senji's Corner. Follow the walkthrough map.
fa72c49a60f8ecd6e48466808fd845bf9254a58d.text: 從 山吉之街 輸入 納普區。依照演練地圖進行操作。

8873c41dac6564783655a65024f61325c9bccf22.source: There is a very large battle at the first map marker on your mission map. While going up the last ramp, be prepared for a battle. Also, midway between the first and second marker there are an extremely large number of Am Fah. It is recommended to pull them in small groups back through the door.
8873c41dac6564783655a65024f61325c9bccf22.text: 在你的任務地圖上的第一個地圖示記處有一場非常大的戰鬥。爬上最後一個坡道時，請做好戰鬥準備。此外，在第一個和第二個標記之間存在大量的 安費。建議將他們分組拉回門口。

31d32c2db3225345c1498cc7652cc28372e223a2.source: When you get to Jeijou, he appears to be alone, but soon spawns a large number of Am Fah before engaging in combat. Once you have killed him, return to Xan Hei. Because you only have to kill Jeijou, you can map out once he's dead even if the rest of the final groups are not.
31d32c2db3225345c1498cc7652cc28372e223a2.text: 當你到達 Jeijou 時，他似乎是孤身一人，但很快就會產生大量 安費，然後開始戰鬥。一旦你殺了他，就回到Xan Hei。因為你只需要殺死 Jeijou，一旦他死了你就可以製定計劃，即使最後一組的其他人還沒有死。

80103e5d1cfdf76819edfb9d8ec1c964c8a393d3.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Heart or Mind: Ronjok in Danger.
80103e5d1cfdf76819edfb9d8ec1c964c8a393d3.text: 所有隊伍成員必須接受《心與心：危險中的 羅鳩村》的獎勵。

8df50ded6d4c04a9233d4c24fa0c05fa0a32f2f4.source: Defeat the Harbingers of Nightfall before they can destroy the village of Ronjok.
8df50ded6d4c04a9233d4c24fa0c05fa0a32f2f4.text: 在 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者摧毀 羅鳩村 村莊之前擊敗他們。

01b6ee16691142c72aa2f27c08f4d9db08a7c4e9.source: The Harbingers of Nightfall can only be damaged once they are affected by the purified water of the vials.
01b6ee16691142c72aa2f27c08f4d9db08a7c4e9.text: 黑暗逆襲 的 Harbingers 只有在受到小瓶中純淨水的影響時才會被損壞。

56bbd65e0df3a2c62c8e4c8d41320efa43595af2.source: Protect and defend Elder Jonah. He must survive.
56bbd65e0df3a2c62c8e4c8d41320efa43595af2.text: 保護並捍衛約拿長老。他必須生存。

f93aaa0d1ec7a171f73061eb7cc8818647591a2c.source: You start in the village (point 1 on the map); after some dialogue you will be told that the only way in which the Harbingers may take any damage is by using the skill Vial of Purified Water on them. Talk to Elder Jonah to receive this skill, a hex spell which at least one player character needs to equip (heroes cannot equip the skill). Taking the Vial of Purified Water is the trigger for additional Margonite forces to spawn and begin attacking the village. Consider waiting to take the skill from him until you kill some of the Margonite groups around the village along the bone crag path, up to the location where the Harbinger of Nightfall will spawn, as doing this will make the fight to defend the village easier.
f93aaa0d1ec7a171f73061eb7cc8818647591a2c.text: 您從村莊開始（地圖上的 1 點）；經過一些對話後，您會被告知先驅者可能受到傷害的唯一方法是對他們使用技能「一瓶純淨水」。與喬納長老交談以獲得此技能，這是至少一個玩家角色需要裝備的十六進位制咒語（英雄無法裝備該技能）。拿走一瓶純淨水會觸發額外的 瑪骨奈 部隊生成並開始攻擊村莊。考慮等待從他那裡獲取技能，直到你沿著骨巖路徑殺死村莊周圍的一些 瑪骨奈 小組，直到 黑暗逆襲 先驅者將產生的位置，因為這樣做將使保衛村莊的戰鬥變得更容易。

3918ac9643ea61e4d1c2d64aa7dca0728a1fcad6.source: Several waves of Margonites, starting with groups of two and increasing to groups of six, will approach the village, attacking through alternating entrances. The last group of the first wave will be led by the Monk boss Priest Zein Zuu. When he has been defeated, a Harbinger of Twilight will spawn. From close range, use the Vial of Purified Water against it to ensure you're doing damage and dispatch it. After that, a group led by Elementalist boss Scribe Wensal will spawn, followed by a group led by Paragon boss Commander Chutal. Another Harbinger of Twilight will spawn next, and finally a group led by Zealot Sheoli. Once she is defeated you are free to travel out of the village to the old Kournan fort, as there are no more groups which might come and kill Elder Jonah.
3918ac9643ea61e4d1c2d64aa7dca0728a1fcad6.text: 幾波瑪貢尼特人，從兩人一組開始，逐漸增加到六人一組，將接近村莊，透過交替的入口進行攻擊。第一波的最後一組將由 僧侶 boss 牧師 Zein Zuu 領導。當他被擊敗後，暮光先驅者將會出現。從近距離使用一瓶純淨水來對付它，以確保你能造成傷害並消滅它。之後，將產生由 元素使 首領 Scribe Wensal 領導的小組，隨後由 聖言者 首領 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Chutal 領導的小組。接下來會出現另一個暮光先驅者，最後是由狂熱者希奧利領導的團隊。一旦她被擊敗，你就可以自由地離開村莊前往古老的庫爾南堡壘，因為不再有團體可能來殺死喬納長老。

2cc0e472dfb30d7ce177d6a9d29b370b949003d4.source: Sometimes the Margonites will stop spawning. This is irrelevant, you may safely exit the village and kill the Harbinger of Nightfall.
2cc0e472dfb30d7ce177d6a9d29b370b949003d4.text: 有時瑪貢尼特會停止產卵。這無關緊要，你可以安全地離開村莊並殺死 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者。

fe403252ec1163e16fe25a1f94999e130faac85a.source: Sometimes the Harbinger of Twilight will not spawn after defeating Priest Zein Zuu, and you must restart the mission.
fe403252ec1163e16fe25a1f94999e130faac85a.text: 有時，在擊敗牧師 Zein Zuu 後，暮光先驅者不會出現，你必須重新開始任務。

d6b8e2aafa761f659b40c1ddf57ae2de1594198b.source: Kill the groups of Margonites up to the Harbinger of Nightfall (point 2 on the map). The Harbinger does not share aggro with the groups around it, so pulling is a good tactic. Try killing everything around the Harbinger before directing attention to the Harbinger itself. As the Harbinger of Nightfall becomes weaker, he will summon two additional groups of Margonites, once at 50% health and another at 25% health. The summoned Margonites will take some time to arrive so it may be a good strategy to retreat and engage the newly summoned foes before returning to the Harbinger, although he can be defeated before the arrival of the additional Margonites. Destroy the Harbinger of Nightfall the same way you killed the Harbingers of Twilight to complete the mission.
d6b8e2aafa761f659b40c1ddf57ae2de1594198b.text: 殺死直到 黑暗逆襲 先驅者（地圖上的 2 點）的瑪貢尼特大隊。先驅者不會與周圍的隊伍分享仇恨，因此拉動是一個很好的策略。在將注意力集中到先驅者本身之前，請嘗試殺死先驅者周圍的一切。當 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者變得較弱時，他將召喚另外兩組瑪貢尼特，一組處於 50% 生命值，另一組處於 25% 生命值。召喚的瑪貢尼特需要一些時間才能到達，因此在返回先驅者號之前撤退並與新召喚的敵人交戰可能是一個不錯的策略，儘管他可以在額外的瑪貢尼特到達之前被擊敗。摧毀 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者，就像殺死暮光先驅者一樣完成任務。

1b177df01adfcd3ee097f994cf5455978c92bbc6.source: The group at the Harbinger of Nightfall will be there before you grab the Vial, making it easier to fight the Harbinger of Nightfall when he spawns.
1b177df01adfcd3ee097f994cf5455978c92bbc6.text: 在你拿到瓶子之前，黑暗逆襲 先驅者的隊伍就會在那裡，這樣在 黑暗逆襲 先驅者生成時就可以更輕鬆地與他戰鬥。

3149a8581be39d9ce10af312ac22a06eb1e06d1e.source: Sometimes Elder Jonah will follow and heal your minions when you leave the village to go fight the Harbinger of Nightfall. As you must protect him or the mission fails, consider sacrificing your minions before leaving the village to avoid this bug. If Elder Jonah starts to follow the group, you can bring the minion master near the entrance of the Sanctuary to lure him back to safety.
3149a8581be39d9ce10af312ac22a06eb1e06d1e.text: 有時，當您離開村莊去對抗 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者時，喬納長老會跟隨並治癒您的爪牙。由於你必須保護他，否則任務就會失敗，因此請考慮在離開村莊之前犧牲你的爪牙以避免這個錯誤。如果喬納長老開始跟隨隊伍，你可以將僕從大師帶到聖所入口附近，將他引誘回安全地帶。

e7defd7eaf5a6c7787cc57bbbd78e87bc8133798.source: The bonus is to kill additional two Harbingers of Twilight and their associated Margonite mobs. These are located inside the Kournan fort surrounded by Margonites to the south of where the Harbinger of Nightfall spawns. You will need the Vial of Purified Water to defeat these, so you must complete the siege on the village first. The first Harbinger is at the entrance to the fort area, while the second is located further into the fort; they can be killed like the other Harbingers using the Vial of Purified Water. When fighting near or in the fort, take note of your party's position, especially heroes and henchmen, and ensure that the walls of the fort are not obstructing your attacks. It is recommended to pull the mobs into more level or open spaces before engaging them.
e7defd7eaf5a6c7787cc57bbbd78e87bc8133798.text: 獎勵是殺死另外兩位暮光先驅者及其相關的 瑪骨奈 怪物。它們位於 Kournan 堡壘內，周圍環繞著 Margonites，位於 黑暗逆襲 先驅者生成處以南。你需要一瓶純淨水來擊敗它們，所以你必須先完成對村莊的圍攻。第一個先驅者位於要塞區域的入口處，而第二個先驅者則位於要塞的更深處；他們可以像其他先驅者一樣使用一瓶純淨水被殺死。當在堡壘附近或堡壘內戰鬥時，請注意你的隊伍的位置，尤其是英雄和追隨者，並確保堡壘的牆壁不會阻礙你的攻擊。建議在與怪物交戰之前將它們拉到更高的水平或開放空間。

ef8cda1083b924566f15dd140914aff0c53af821.source: Unlike the Harbinger of Nightfall, the bonus Harbingers of Twilight cannot be pulled away from the Margonite mobs accompanying them.
ef8cda1083b924566f15dd140914aff0c53af821.text: 與 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者不同，暮光之城的獎勵先驅者不能從伴隨它們的 瑪骨奈 生物中被拉走。

c7580f8d980bbbb7e817f43fbc7f8a3d8cd79e7f.source: As with Jennur's Horde, killing only the two additional Harbingers does not complete the bonus. You must kill the entire group to get credit.
c7580f8d980bbbb7e817f43fbc7f8a3d8cd79e7f.text: 與詹努爾的部落一樣，僅殺死另外兩個先驅者並不能完成獎勵。你必須殺死整個隊伍才能獲得榮譽。

315ad69871d8759d2e0c2ee1e087fe41986c774b.source: Backtrack to head north once both have been dispatched to kill the Harbinger of Nightfall to complete the mission.
315ad69871d8759d2e0c2ee1e087fe41986c774b.text: 當兩人都被派去殺死 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者以完成任務後，原路返迴向北。

b98444da4c31e3fb8cbcf11a3bed7ab0cc5731a7.source: At least one party member needs to equip the Vial of Purified Water. Ideally, have two members do so, since its recharge time of 15 seconds exceeds its 10 second duration. In single-player teams, you could use Arcane Echo and/or Echo to duplicate Vial of Purified Water, but it is not essential.
b98444da4c31e3fb8cbcf11a3bed7ab0cc5731a7.text: 至少一名隊員需要裝備一瓶純水。理想情況下，有兩位成員會這樣做，因為其 15 秒的充電時間超過了 10 秒的持續時間。在單人團隊中，您可以使用 魔法迴音 和/或 迴響 來複製一瓶純淨水，但這不是必要的。

d59e40fa70f052cbedc9c34ff0decb1f2d893ce9.source: There are plenty of corpses around Elder Jonah at the beginning of the mission; bringing a minion master (or even two) also helps prevent Margonite Warlocks from using those corpses to create Wells of Silence.
d59e40fa70f052cbedc9c34ff0decb1f2d893ce9.text: 任務開始時，喬納長老周圍有很多屍體；帶來一個僕從大師（甚至兩個）也有助於防止 瑪骨奈 術士使用這些屍體來建立沉默之井。

7cf87ca9fc49294d7ad8a81daaf2759953a40a23.source: Bring skills to interrupt the Wave of Torment spell that is cast by both types of Harbingers. Distracting Shot is particularly effective, since it disables the skill for 20 additional seconds.
7cf87ca9fc49294d7ad8a81daaf2759953a40a23.text: 帶來技能來打斷兩種型別先驅者施放的折磨之波法術。 震暈之箭 特別有效，因為它會在 20 的額外秒數內停用此技能。

e60d5917607028f6c12e145ef0a29f48aeb333b4.source: All the foes in this mission are affected by Lightbringer skills. Lightbringer's Gaze can be used to interrupt Wave of Torment.
e60d5917607028f6c12e145ef0a29f48aeb333b4.text: 此任務中的所有敵人都會受到光明使者技能的影響。光明使者的凝視可以用來打斷折磨之波。

c30dd1ded23e688deb1a9a1abef8ba04c37b5189.source: The area behind the village, near where the entrance to the Sunspear Sanctuary would normally be, still keeps the normal, non Nightfallen terrain.
c30dd1ded23e688deb1a9a1abef8ba04c37b5189.text: 村莊後面的區域，靠近 日戟避難所 入口的地方，仍然保留著正常的、非墮夜精靈的地形。

45eaefda0b281da5a5f4784fb1b4cedd6a611494.source: Due to the number and frequency of boss appearances, Scroll of Hunter's Insight may last longer than other types.
45eaefda0b281da5a5f4784fb1b4cedd6a611494.text: 由於 Boss 出現的數量和頻率，獵人洞察力的 卷軸 可能比其他型別的持續時間更長。

c2f2b39fac0a7498d5373be6125c0ae82fe50e01.source: The Harbinger of Nightfall is not spawned at the beginning of the mission, so it is therefore impossible to rush up the middle path and kill him from the start. It is, however, possible to kill the two additional Harbingers at the beginning by splitting up a strong party.
c2f2b39fac0a7498d5373be6125c0ae82fe50e01.text: 黑暗逆襲 的先驅者並不是在任務開始時產生的，因此不可能從一開始就衝上中路並殺死他。然而，一開始就可以透過分裂一個強大的隊伍來殺死另外兩個先驅者。

d9262eac4cbb04f166f8f6e197e88a7f5eef5b34.source: After completing this mission, your party will be teleported to Sunspear Sanctuary.
d9262eac4cbb04f166f8f6e197e88a7f5eef5b34.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將會傳送到 日戟避難所。

1f2402e4cdebd05341b1cca20d68298c3394e484.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #12 in the Night Falls storybook.
1f2402e4cdebd05341b1cca20d68298c3394e484.text: 完成此任務將填入夜幕降臨故事書中的#12 頁。

fa4b1ae982fb06de0d3988f958644f8ea6dff4bb.source: The overland and world maps still show the character on the normal Marga Coast when in this mission, unlike other Nightfallen regions.
fa4b1ae982fb06de0d3988f958644f8ea6dff4bb.text: 與其他墮夜精靈區域不同，在執行此任務時，陸路和世界地圖仍然顯示正常 馬加海岸 上的角色。

ee210e7c639ef1b96441ab3231481efa025808f1.text: 黑暗逆襲 光明使者 擊敗其他先驅者 0   1   2   0   1   2   30   30   30   75   75   75

233fec9e1486721024fbaf721917802fbf0f3be5.source: The goal of this mission is to stop the corruption of the entire Garden by defeating the Harbinger of Nightfall.
233fec9e1486721024fbaf721917802fbf0f3be5.text: 該任務的目標是透過擊敗 黑暗逆襲 的先驅來阻止整個花園的腐敗。

dae5ea2f84bcc215f80d6c7f4f8a8660c935f2ba.source: There are regular Harbingers and also two types of Margonite groups; stationary groups and groups that spawn every two minutes and patrol towards Horticulturist Hinon - who must survive. The patrol will either go north or south around the large trench in the floor, but they always start in the same place. Any character with a speed boost should be able to lure the patrol back to the party before they run to Hinon.
dae5ea2f84bcc215f80d6c7f4f8a8660c935f2ba.text: 有常規 Harbingers 和兩種型別的 瑪骨奈 團體；固定群體和每兩分鐘產生一次的群體，並向必須生存的園藝師 Hinon 巡邏。巡邏隊將圍繞地板上的大溝渠向北或向南行駛，但他們總是從同一個地方開始。任何具有速度提升的角色都應該能夠在巡邏隊跑向 Hinon 之前將他們引誘回隊伍。

d5e0dc8c09ff81eeeb148d9a9f93ede02532bdfa.source: At the start, Horticulturist Hinon will create a Light of Seborhin (bundle) which is the only tool that can harm the Harbingers and the final boss, the Harbinger of Nightfall. Dropping a Light of Seborhin beside a Harbinger will kill it (granting a morale boost) - and then the Harbinger will be replaced by a Spirit of Seborhin, which will create another Light of Seborhin. Try and keep these Spirits alive since they shorten the distance the player has to run to fetch a Light of Seborhin. (Note that although the Lights of Seborhin are destroyed when they kill a Harbinger, if they are dropped in the wrong place they can be picked up again.)
d5e0dc8c09ff81eeeb148d9a9f93ede02532bdfa.text: 一開始，園藝師 Hinon 將創造一個 Seborhin 之光（捆綁包），這是唯一可以傷害 Harbingers 和最終 Boss 黑暗逆襲 Harbinger 的工具。在先驅者旁邊掉落一盞塞博欣之光會殺死它（提高士氣） - 然後先驅者將被塞博欣之魂取代，這將創造另一個塞博欣之光。試著讓這些靈魂保持活力，因為它們會縮短玩家獲得塞博欣之光所需的跑動距離。 （請注意，雖然塞博欣之光在殺死先驅者時會被摧毀，但如果它們掉落在錯誤的地方，則可以再次撿起。）

5b301b143b6c6991d41266b6ac7f4f2d75c7ab8a.source: The easiest tactic to avoid the threat of being overwhelmed by the patrol is to alternate between killing a stationary group and a patrol group of Margonites.
5b301b143b6c6991d41266b6ac7f4f2d75c7ab8a.text: 避免被巡邏隊淹沒的威脅的最簡單策略是交替殺死固定隊伍和巡邏隊的瑪貢尼特人。

5afab44fb98eea2934c805db4cf2df11dd168932.source: To make things easier for you, only eliminate the Harbinger located at the top of the stairs, so the groups of Margonites that appear every two minutes will be limited to 4 members. To do this, quickly tag your group where this Harbinger is located, and thus avoid the two located in your path.
5afab44fb98eea2934c805db4cf2df11dd168932.text: 為了讓事情變得更容易，只需消除位於樓梯頂部的先驅者，因此每兩分鐘出現的瑪貢尼特群體將僅限於 4 成員。為此，請快速標記該先驅者所在的小組，從而避開您路徑中的兩個。

48bdcd8d668c3bdb40b932106da8ff0c61f4958f.source: Zhed Shadowhoof must be in your party.
48bdcd8d668c3bdb40b932106da8ff0c61f4958f.text: 傑德·影蹄一定在你的隊伍中。

d77ddc4e62e1c40fa02a8792c63d41b068728de4.source: Talk to Kormir in the Command Post to find a way across the Desolation.
d77ddc4e62e1c40fa02a8792c63d41b068728de4.text: 與 指揮所 中的科米爾交談，找出穿越 荒蕪之地 的方法。

cbecc2706e230b2cdd033f28fc4c761af8f52628.source: Travel with Zhed to speak with Mirza about crossing the Desolation.
cbecc2706e230b2cdd033f28fc4c761af8f52628.text: 與哲德一起旅行，與米爾扎談論穿越 荒蕪之地 的事情。

de61d62740893ded5f339a2147f16a211a31dbda.source: Meet Mirza on the outskirts of the Desolation.
de61d62740893ded5f339a2147f16a211a31dbda.text: 在 荒蕪之地 的郊區與 Mirza 見面。

b0b91f562c81188f34bb79356a04ba81c4e592d7.source: Meet with Kormir at the monument to Palawa Joko's defeat.
b0b91f562c81188f34bb79356a04ba81c4e592d7.text: 在 帕勒瓦‧傑格 戰敗紀念碑處與科米爾會面。

a12224d958828fba46ca1106e30664baea2e0533.source: Examine the monument to Palawa Joko's defeat.
a12224d958828fba46ca1106e30664baea2e0533.text: 檢查 帕勒瓦‧傑格 失敗的紀念碑。

aa1cc7945d5056a95449b05f8397fbd87741b69c.source: Have Zhed help track Palawa Joko. Take Zhed to speak with Dirah Traptail.
aa1cc7945d5056a95449b05f8397fbd87741b69c.text: 讓 Zed 幫助追蹤 帕勒瓦‧傑格。帶傑德去見迪拉·特拉普泰爾。

605f0b6de4d0272ed4aa5eb6d6635ebff68c503f.source: See Laph Longmane for your reward.
605f0b6de4d0272ed4aa5eb6d6635ebff68c503f.text: 請見拉夫·朗邁恩以獲得獎勵。

b94c523864ee89d40b7aa9e8092f6311796f8786.source: 200 Gold (if this quest is acquired from Lonai)
b94c523864ee89d40b7aa9e8092f6311796f8786.text: 200 金幣（如果該任務是從洛奈那裡獲得的）

fa2559a3d75ca4ddd7d04dda7890d08a6269c79e.source: 250 Gold (if this quest is acquired from Zerai the Learner)
fa2559a3d75ca4ddd7d04dda7890d08a6269c79e.text: 250 金幣（如果此任務是從學習者澤萊那裡獲得的）

12b841e6d3d7bdc51067cba1b3657721719302c1.source: After accepting the quest from Zerai or Lonai, travel to the Sunspear Sanctuary and exit to the Command Post. Speak with Kormir and head out to Turai's Procession through the nearby portal. Follow the quest marker to Mirza Veldrunner. (Most of the enemies can be avoided or a group of hero/henchmen should be able to handle anything you come across.)
12b841e6d3d7bdc51067cba1b3657721719302c1.text: 接受澤萊或洛奈的任務後，前往日戟避難所並退出至指揮所。與科米爾交談並透過附近的傳送門前往 托雷長廊。跟隨任務標記前往米爾扎·維德行者。 （大多數敵人都可以避免，或者一群英雄/追隨者應該能夠處理你遇到的任何事情。）

56c784dcece7afb10cb2349a7fdb76d0653ca4cc.source: The next quest marker is misleading: it is northwest from your location, but the only way to reach it is to head northeast (see this article's map). Meet up with Mirza in The Sulfurous Wastes, then head back to the Command Post to speak with Kormir again, who will instruct you to meet her in Jahai Bluffs. After she leaves, inspect the monument; this releases Palawa Joko himself. He departs quickly after his dialogue; as Zhed points out, there is no point in following him.
56c784dcece7afb10cb2349a7fdb76d0653ca4cc.text: 下一個任務標記具有誤導性：它位於您所在位置的西北方向，但到達它的唯一方法是向東北方向行駛（請參閱本文的地圖）。在 硫磺荒地 與 Mirza 會面，然後返回 指揮所 再次與 Kormir 交談，Kormir 將指示您在 夏亥峭壁 與她會面。她離開後，檢查紀念碑；這會釋放 帕勒瓦‧傑格 本身。對話結束後他很快就離開了。正如傑德指出的那樣，跟隨他是沒有意義的。

608f324ab6fdb643100b1ec688aded1bbaaa18d2.source: Since this quest does not require you to kill any foes, you can complete this by running.
608f324ab6fdb643100b1ec688aded1bbaaa18d2.text: 由於此任務不需要你殺死任何敵人，因此你可以透過跑步來完成此任務。

3caffaef458fe9e73b29bbfaa044d337124b116c.source: This quest can only be acquired from:
3caffaef458fe9e73b29bbfaa044d337124b116c.text: 此任務只能從以下位置獲得：

0788daf434b9306b4e90f286e496abb1e4e8d36e.source: Lonai if your character has completed Nundu Bay.
0788daf434b9306b4e90f286e496abb1e4e8d36e.text: Lonai（如果您的角色已完成 納度灣）。

27c8727a1600412121263cd6fa37c57e72893981.source: Zerai the Learner if your character has completed Jennur's Horde.
27c8727a1600412121263cd6fa37c57e72893981.text: 學習者澤萊（Zerai the Learner），如果你的角色已經完成了詹努爾的部落。

3f3099f8dde050e3cfb35027ab36babb4c629411.source: Combine this with Centaur Concerns, which is on the way from Sunspear Sanctuary.
3f3099f8dde050e3cfb35027ab36babb4c629411.text: 將其與 日戟避難所 即將推出的 半人馬 關注點結合。

ed84c488a7c5c86cbb5178a18b97de10a4c33c74.source: You can combine this quest with Mirza's Last Stand, if you have previously completed Centaur Concerns.
ed84c488a7c5c86cbb5178a18b97de10a4c33c74.text: 如果您之前已完成 半人馬 關注，您可以將此任務與米爾扎的背水一戰結合。

becbb8fe6cdb496b8bd59073cee1ea32f9c006fe.source: This quest presents an opportunity to capture elite skills from Sergeant Behnwa and Chiossen, Soothing Breeze on the way through Turai's Procession.
becbb8fe6cdb496b8bd59073cee1ea32f9c006fe.text: 任務提供了一個機會，讓您可以在穿越 托雷長廊 的途中，從 Behnwa 中士和 Chiossen、緩和 Breeze 那裡獲得精英技能。

bf04ec1b317dc2c02b6e779c0245ce848f086176.source: Palawa Joko sometimes fails to appear when the monument is activated; however, the quest still updates (even though there is no dialogue after Kormir leaves). If you acquire the quest from Lonai, she will claim to not know where the Sunspear Sanctuary is even though she is standing in it. The gold reward, some of the dialogue, and quest game link differs depending on which NPC this quest is acquired from.
bf04ec1b317dc2c02b6e779c0245ce848f086176.text: 紀念碑啟動時有時無法出現帕勒瓦‧傑格；然而，任務仍然更新（即使科米爾離開後沒有對話）。如果你從洛奈那裡獲得任務，她會聲稱不知道 日戟避難所 在哪裡，即使她站在哪裡。黃金獎勵、部分對話和任務遊戲連結根據從哪個 NPC 獲得該任務而有所不同。

11cd4a030efafa9d7b52bddd86cea7a5fbc5f34f.source: Defeat Ganshu the Scribe, and obtain the Jade Brotherhood Text.
11cd4a030efafa9d7b52bddd86cea7a5fbc5f34f.text: 擊敗抄寫員甘舒，取得翡翠兄弟會文本。

3bb2a196453d91c995aa518d25867f8f8c12bd98.source: Leave from The Marketplace and head west, fighting through several large groups of Jade Brotherhood. You will receive many allies in the form of members of the Ministry of Purity as well as some regular Canthan Peasants. The Peasants are not very useful, but provide excellent fodder for minion masters. Upon reaching Ganshu the Scribe, his group and one more behind him will initially be friendly; after some brief dialogue they will turn hostile. Defeat Ganshu and pick up the Jade Brotherhood Text to complete the quest.
3bb2a196453d91c995aa518d25867f8f8c12bd98.text: 從 市集 出發，向西前進，與幾大群 翡翠兄弟會 戰鬥。您將在 型態 中收到許多純潔部成員的盟友以及一些普通的凱珊農民。農民不是很有用，但為奴才大師提供了極好的素材。到達文士甘書後，他的團隊和他身後的其他團隊一開始會表現得很友善；經過一些簡短的對話後，他們會變得充滿敵意。擊敗甘樹並拿起 翡翠兄弟會 文字來完成任務。

826062be8737e353eff5d698d2e54331cd2dc297.source: Alternatively, leave from Nahpui Quarter and head north. This route takes a few more minutes, but it is safer. There will be some regular Am Fah mobs and Mantids along the way, but nothing dangerous. Once you reach the island stronghold, a large brawl will already be going on between some Peasants and Ministry forces; you can either try to save some by rushing in head first, or forget about them and play it safe, pulling the Jade groups apart for easier killing. After this, proceed to Ganshu as normal.
826062be8737e353eff5d698d2e54331cd2dc297.text: 或者，從 納普區 出發，往北行駛。這條路線多花幾分鐘，但比較安全。沿途會有一些常規的 安費 怪物和螳螂，但沒有危險。一旦你到達島上的據點，一些農民和魔法部部隊之間就會發生一場大規模的爭吵；你可以嘗試先衝進去來拯救一些人，或者忘記他們並謹慎行事，將玉石群拉開以便更容易殺死。之後，如常前往甘肅。

3f42fcb0fa2622bee33ba1df28f501bc5ab90e7e.source: Another option using a party with strong spiking skills and speed boosts is to run west from The Marketplace, ignoring the enemies along the way until you reach the westernmost bridge from the main landmass to the island containing the Jade Brotherhood guild hall. Using this bridge, run north and west past two packs of enemies until you reach a small courtyard with a central dais within compass range just south of Ganshu. Prepare, flag heroes (possibly locking targets for shutdown), precast spirits and protective spells as necessary and then spike down Ganshu. Pick up the text when Ganshu dies and you may freely resign or map out. These tactics work even with small party sizes (where they benefit greatly from accompanying summoned allies).
3f42fcb0fa2622bee33ba1df28f501bc5ab90e7e.text: 使用具有強大尖峰技能和速度提升的隊伍的另一個選擇是從 市集 向西跑，忽略沿途的敵人，直到到達從主陸地到包含 翡翠兄弟會 公會大廳的島嶼的最西邊的橋梁。使用這座橋，向北和向西跑，經過兩群敵人，直到到達甘肅以南羅盤範圍內的一個小庭院，有一個中央講臺。準備，標記英雄（可能鎖定目標以使其關閉），根據需要預製精神和保護法術，然後刺殺甘樹。甘書死後拿起文字，可以自由辭職或出謀劃策。這些策略甚至適用於小規模的隊伍（他們從伴隨召喚的盟友中受益匪淺）。

4d8dbdeda71e1aa485fdb7689ad339e546be814a.source: It is also worth noting that Ganshu does not pull with either of the packs to his immediate west and south. If you lack the means to fight him with his allies, you can pull the west pack first and then pull Ganshu independently for an easy kill.
4d8dbdeda71e1aa485fdb7689ad339e546be814a.text: 另外值得注意的是，甘樹並沒有將任何一個狼群拉到他緊鄰的西部和南部。如果你沒有辦法和他的盟友一起對抗他，你可以先拉西群，然後獨立拉甘樹，輕鬆擊殺。

c4e2007f1610ea16a233a8d05204aa5897682e4a.text: 主職 不是 幻術師

d4e07d2993a4fd9ce883789dcdb443cbd74663bb.source: Speak With Headmaster Kaa in the Shing Jea Monastery.
d4e07d2993a4fd9ce883789dcdb443cbd74663bb.text: 在 星岬寺 中與 Kaa 校長交談。

157448937e8997ce226c3636e0785f5e647c1b72.source: Locate and defeat Reisen the Phoenix.
157448937e8997ce226c3636e0785f5e647c1b72.text: 找到並擊敗 火鳳凰 雷森。

c6a0a4b1cf543a40c47906a73915150715f266fb.source: Speak to Xan Hei again, who will transport your party to an altered Dragon's Throat.
c6a0a4b1cf543a40c47906a73915150715f266fb.text: 再次與 Xan Hei 交談，他會將你的隊伍運送到經過改造的 龍喉 (挑戰任務)。

a71d90a47b42a87078d76e3b7a0e682ebf00d72f.source: There is only one route to Reisen the Phoenix, requiring you to fight through group after group of Jade Brotherhood. If you deviate from it, you will have to fight additional foes, including additional bosses. Each time you kill one of these bosses, additional foes will spawn with Reisen and along the path itself. Stick to the path, if you want things to be as easy as possible.
a71d90a47b42a87078d76e3b7a0e682ebf00d72f.text: 通往Reisen the 火鳳凰的路線只有一條，需要你穿過一組又一組的翡翠兄弟會。如果你偏離了它，你將不得不與更多的敵人戰鬥，包括更多的領導者。每次你殺死其中一個 Boss 時，就會有更多的敵人與雷森一起出現並沿著路徑本身。如果你想讓事情盡可能簡單，就堅持走這條路。

dc3c6a7041b13e439bcb918afb02941c06938f58.source: As with most of Winds of Change, groups here spawn close to one another and have overlapping patrol routes. Sometimes, a healer from one group will separate to heal one of their allies in another, so it can be hard to avoid over-aggroing. Do your best to pull groups apart and be ready to retreat before you get overwhelmed.
dc3c6a7041b13e439bcb918afb02941c06938f58.text: 與大多數 變幻之風 一樣，這裡的隊伍彼此靠近生成，並且巡邏路線重疊。有時，一個群體中的治療者會分開去治療另一個群體中的一位盟友，因此很難避免過度仇恨。盡最大努力將團體拉開，並在不知所措之前做好撤退的準備。

0c81d1720a6fac29605a841875494ace0a1219ea.source: The layout of Dragon's Throat lends itself well to balling up, both for you and for the enemies; there are plenty of choke points (e.g. corners, narrow hallways, or stairways). Take advantage of this by positioning the party before the choke point, pulling groups towards you, forcing them to clump; then use AoE skills and effects to wipe out entire mobs at a time. Avoid letting this happen to the party, since your foes can return the favor (particularly their Splinter Weapon-wielding Warriors).
0c81d1720a6fac29605a841875494ace0a1219ea.text: 龍喉 (挑戰任務) 的佈局非常適合您和敵人的聚集；有許多阻塞點（例如角落、狹窄的走廊或樓梯）。利用這一點，將隊伍放置在阻塞點之前，將隊伍拉向你，迫使他們聚集在一起；然後使用 範圍性 技能和效果一次消滅整個小怪。避免讓這種情況發生在隊伍中，因為你的敵人可以回報你的恩惠（特別是他們揮舞著 爆刺武裝 的戰士）。

4ff2aadf1d38e351f91afd697c95dbc1ba7e08ab.source: Bring skills that can take advantage of the choke-point tactics: Wards, AoE damage/effects (especially damage over time), defensive spirits (since they can be setup safely behind your group), and multiple-foe interrupts. Melee characters should consider bringing Asuran Scan due to the enemies' propensity to use blocking and blind-inflicting skills.
4ff2aadf1d38e351f91afd697c95dbc1ba7e08ab.text: 帶來可以利用阻塞點戰術的技能：守衛、範圍性傷害/效果（尤其是隨著時間的推移造成的傷害）、防禦精神（因為它們可以安全地設定在你的團隊後面）和多敵人中斷。 肉搏 角色應該考慮使用阿蘇蘭掃描，因為敵人傾向於使用格擋和致盲技能。

14e709d8e201ddb3b1062d82ea5973e9f5f4e8f0.source: After defeating Reisen the Phoenix, be sure to wait for the conversation between you and Xan Hei to end before leaving the map.
14e709d8e201ddb3b1062d82ea5973e9f5f4e8f0.text: 擊敗火鳳凰雷森後，一定要等你和Xan Hei之間的對話結束後再離開地圖。

27481c7313b3748c0a94e521c21dae98b8939499.source: Although there is no visible Resurrection Shrine on the Mission Map, you will respawn at the beginning of the quest if you die.
27481c7313b3748c0a94e521c21dae98b8939499.text: 儘管 主線任務 地圖上沒有可見的 復活祭壇，但如果您死亡，您將在任務開始時重生。

ddfd12d6704c0b454ab7daf97c8b0873a776be90.source: Each member of Reisen's group, including Reisen himself, can be pulled separately from other members of the group.
ddfd12d6704c0b454ab7daf97c8b0873a776be90.text: 雷森團隊的每個成員，包括雷森本人，都可以與團隊的其他成員分開拉動。

540046c8d6e2be178d515e18ba403e6701404b09.source: The Jade Brotherhood Warriors that accompany Lai, Graceful Blade as well as Sheng Pai will not always say their line of dialogue.
540046c8d6e2be178d515e18ba403e6701404b09.text: 陪伴賴、優雅之刃以及盛派的翡翠兄弟會戰士們不會總是說他們的臺詞。

3df084daec897e49c5348dcfc8b42ead79ccf724.source: All party members must have accepted the reward for Crossing the Desolation.
3df084daec897e49c5348dcfc8b42ead79ccf724.text: 所有隊伍成員必須接受穿越 荒蕪之地 的獎勵。

dc6821d31454e10d58247f220076a1e28aac4d15.source: Tame Queen Aijundu and gain control of the junundu wurms.
dc6821d31454e10d58247f220076a1e28aac4d15.text: 馴服艾君杜女王並控制朱南杜亞龍。

ec21814dbb2e91b19584c8ad73f6ecd63b388632.source: ADDED: Defeat Queen Aijundu and her undead minions.
ec21814dbb2e91b19584c8ad73f6ecd63b388632.text: 新增：擊敗艾君杜女王和她的不死爪牙。

6ad5b707c037c378c5650cc28d00f6940af1d3b7.source: ADDED: Call forth a junundu so you may ride it through the sulfur.
6ad5b707c037c378c5650cc28d00f6940af1d3b7.text: 新增：召喚一個朱南杜，這樣你就可以騎著它穿過硫磺。

1dd772d3deb665bd997b37d274c9a7d22b9b94d4.source: ADDED: Guide the junundu to the Remains of Sahlahja.
1dd772d3deb665bd997b37d274c9a7d22b9b94d4.text: 新增：引導 junundu 前往 Sahlahja 遺跡。

08ca61da03da7a8f6937bbe8a24362d39e244273.source: *Bonus* Protect the junundu young from the demon hordes.
08ca61da03da7a8f6937bbe8a24362d39e244273.text: *額外獎勵* 保護朱南杜幼崽免受惡魔部落的侵害。

9c2061ec6693ba9a942ab627c9f3b01574e911be.source: You have saved [0...3] of 3 junundu young.
9c2061ec6693ba9a942ab627c9f3b01574e911be.text: 您已儲存 3 junundu young 的 [0...3]。

5599385b56559a64b5d7568b2d50b2d377f546d4.source: After a few groups of undead have attacked and been defeated, Queen Aijundu will approach and attack. Once her health has been reduced a bit she will retreat and further undead will attack. There are quite a few bosses who spawn in the undead groups - keep an eye out for them. Aijundu will attack again when all the undead are killed, this time when you've damaged her enough she will allow you to use the wurms to cross the Desolation. Look out for enemies with hard resses: Awakened Acolytes, Awakened Cavaliers and especially the boss Chakeh the Lonely. Left alone these will resurrect fallen enemies on top of the new groups approaching you, which might overwhelm the party. Tip: If you feel your party is overwhelmed with attacking foes try running away from the Wurm Spoor. Not all enemies will follow you all the way to your new destination. This smaller group of enemies will be easier to individually target and take down. This also gives your party a chance to regroup, heal, and target the remaining foes left guarding the Wurm Spoor. Also it's not necessary to fight next to the Wurm Spoor. You can flag your party a fair distance away at the start and simply pull the successive groups of enemies.
5599385b56559a64b5d7568b2d50b2d377f546d4.text: 當幾群亡靈攻擊並被擊敗後，艾君杜女王就會逼近並攻擊。一旦她的生命值減少一點，她就會撤退，更多的不死生物將會攻擊。有不少 Boss 會在不死族中生成 - 請留意他們。當所有不死生物都被殺死後，Aijundu 會再次攻擊，這次當你對她造成足夠的傷害時，她將允許你使用亞龍穿越 荒蕪之地。留意那些兇猛的敵人：覺醒的追隨者、覺醒的騎士，尤其是 Boss 孤獨者查克 (Chakeh the Lonely)。如果不去管它們，它們會在接近你的新隊伍之上復活倒下的敵人，這可能會壓垮隊伍。提示：如果您覺得您的隊伍被攻擊的敵人淹沒，請嘗試逃離 地蟲 Spoor。並非所有敵人都會跟著你一路到達新目的地。這一小群敵人將更容易單獨瞄準並擊倒。這也讓你的隊伍有機會重新集結、治療並瞄準守衛 地蟲 Spoor 的剩餘敵人。也沒有必要在 地蟲 Spoor 旁邊戰鬥。你可以在開始時將你的隊伍標記在距離較遠的地方，然後簡單地拉動連續的敵人群。

6ba27e42e82ba75a5e599d53c56380b0cdafe685.source: The order of appearance of the bosses is as follows: first Chakeh the Lonely (Paragon); second Avah the Crafty (Warrior); third Chundu the Meek (Dervish); fourth and fifth appear together, Nehmak the Unpleasant (Necromancer) and Amind the Bitter (Mesmer).
6ba27e42e82ba75a5e599d53c56380b0cdafe685.text: Boss 出現的順序如下：首先是孤獨者 Chakeh (聖言者)；第二個狡猾的阿瓦（戰士）；第三個是溫順的春杜 (神喚使)；第四和第五一起出現，Nehmak the Unpleasant (死靈法師) 和 Amind the Bitter (幻術師)。

14d9ebf17ca2054c06135f777ff84b8a6b4b0452.source: Click on the Wurm Spoor. This will summon wurms to transport you and the party. You now have control of the wurm and will use Junundu skills rather than those you have equipped on your character. You can now travel on the sulfur areas without dying.
14d9ebf17ca2054c06135f777ff84b8a6b4b0452.text: 點選 地蟲 Spoor。這將召喚亞龍來運送你和隊伍。你現在可以控制亞龍並使用朱南杜技能而不是你角色上裝備的技能。你現在可以在硫磺地區旅行而不會死亡。

16836fda371c10799bd16a067c8a8c5ca724a15f.source: Follow Palawa Joko as he leads you to the Remains of Sahlahja. Along the way you will fight groups of Margonites and Elementals. Margonites are easy to take down in the Desert Wurm disguise, but take care with the Elementals, especially the Sandstorm Crags whose earth damage attacks prove dangerous to the wurms. Mind that both these and Cracked Mesas cannot be knocked down for healing through Junundu Bite nor leave corpses for Junundu Feast. Remember to use Junundu Wail to resurrect fallen party members and heal once a fight is over.
16836fda371c10799bd16a067c8a8c5ca724a15f.text: 跟著 帕勒瓦‧傑格，他會帶您前往 Sahlahja 遺跡。一路上你將與瑪貢人和元素人戰鬥。瑪貢尼特在沙漠 地蟲 偽裝中很容易被擊倒，但要小心元素生物，尤其是 沙塵暴 峭壁，它們的地球傷害攻擊對亞龍來說是危險的。請注意，這些和裂紋臺地都不能透過朱南杜咬擊擊倒進行治療，也不能在朱南杜盛宴中留下屍體。請記得使用朱南杜哀嚎來復活倒下的隊員並在戰鬥結束後進行治療。

ebd992866021c763f1b25659437e71b4b9bc3a90.source: During the journey you will encounter rocky ground which the wurms cannot travel through. You will have to abandon the wurm until you find another Wurm Spoor which will allow you to travel on the sulfur again. By timing your movement, you can avoid the Margonite group nearby and proceed to the next Wurm Spoor. You complete the mission when you reach the Remains of Sahlahja.
ebd992866021c763f1b25659437e71b4b9bc3a90.text: 在旅途中你會遇到亞龍無法穿越的岩石地面。你必須放棄這條亞龍，直到你找到另一個 地蟲 Spoor，它可以讓你再次在硫磺上旅行。透過計時您的移動，您可以避開附近的 瑪骨奈 群組並繼續前往下一個 地蟲 Spoor。當您到達薩赫拉賈遺跡時，您就完成了任務。

90038e72779a9e177ac5ac9226edf578e68c6db1.source: The bonus is not difficult, but it detours from Joko's direct route in order to rescue 3 Junundu Young. There is no need to exit Junundu to reach them.
90038e72779a9e177ac5ac9226edf578e68c6db1.text: 獎勵並不困難，但為了營救3 Junundu Young，它繞過了Joko的直接路線。無需離開朱南杜即可到達他們。

52a4c6f57b3350823076fb470a687fa120718698.source: Each Junundu Young is surrounded by a group of a half-dozen Margonites. Follow the bonus route on the map and kill each group in turn. As you do, an advice box appears stating that the young has been saved and you can move on to the next objective along the path. You still receive credit for a rescue even if the young dies after you have disposed of the foes that threatened it.
52a4c6f57b3350823076fb470a687fa120718698.text: 每個朱南杜年輕人都被六名瑪貢尼特人包圍。沿著地圖上的獎勵路線依序殺死每一組。當您這樣做時，會出現一個建議框，提示幼體已獲救，您可以沿著路徑繼續下一個目標。即使幼崽在你消滅了威脅它的敵人後死去，你仍然會因為救援而獲得榮譽。

adc4b91a5cbc879b1e9eba6052f9f4d92ba97445.source: Although the Margonites do not attack the young directly, these wurms can be hurt by area of effect skills, including your own — most notably, the young can be damaged by Junundu Smash. To guarantee the bonus, pull the Margonites away from the young before engaging them in combat.
adc4b91a5cbc879b1e9eba6052f9f4d92ba97445.text: 雖然瑪貢尼特不會直接攻擊幼龍，但這些亞龍可能會被範圍技能傷害，包括你自己的——最值得注意的是，幼龍可能會被朱南杜粉碎傷害。為了確保獎金，在與年輕人交戰之前將瑪貢尼特人從他們身邊拉開。

037227b1e4547d8c1dadf2858e55a436c4194242.text: 額外獎勵 不含元素

fb14ed2dc846b28b77b45c0c83f8fdf1da44a86f.text: 黑暗逆襲 拯救光明使者少年朱南杜 0   1 - 2   3   0   1 - 2   3   30   30   30   75   75   75

6d51cc0346110133a8638b977065d3b23b83959f.source: As you enter the mission Palawa Joko starts to talk and will lead you to a Wurm Spoor to the left of the entrance. The Wurm Spoor is situated in a hole beyond which the yellow Sulfurous Haze begin. To walk in human form on the areas which show as bright yellow on the map means near immediate death. Stay clear.
6d51cc0346110133a8638b977065d3b23b83959f.text: 當您進入任務時，帕勒瓦‧傑格 開始說話，並將引導您到入口左側的 地蟲 Spoor。 地蟲 Spoor 位於一個洞中，洞外開始出現黃色硫磺煙霧。如果穿著人類 型態 行走在地圖上顯示為亮黃色的區域，則表示瀕臨死亡。保持清醒。

c05c29adc2e30498cf0b939216c64f883baf0090.source: It is at this Wurm Spoor (1 on the map) that you will tame Queen Aijundu, so set up for the fight. You should stage the fight from the hill over looking the Wurm Spoor which will give you a height advantage and keeps you away from the sulfur. If you are using heroes and henchmen, they should be pinned at the top of the hill at the point furthest from the sulfur and set to defensive mode. For a better idea, when Palawa Joko runs to the Wurm Spoor, he will stop before reaching it, then move to the other side, and then remain in that spot until you tame Aijundu. Flag your heroes and henchmen at the point he stops at before moving to his final position. If there is a minion master in your party, avoid fighting near Palawa Joko, since he will use Well of Darkness on recharge, exploiting the corpses that the minion master could have used; however, if your party doesn't have a minion master, it is recommended to fight near Palawa Joko, so he will create Wells of Darkness that will hinder hexed undead physical attackers and at the same time prevent Awakened Defilers from using those corpses to create Wells of Darkness that will hinder your party.
c05c29adc2e30498cf0b939216c64f883baf0090.text: 正是在這個 地蟲 Spoor（地圖上的 1）處，您將馴服 Aijundu 女王，因此做好戰鬥準備。您應該從山上觀看 地蟲 Spoor 進行戰鬥，這將為您帶來高度優勢並讓您遠離硫磺。如果你使用英雄和追隨者，他們應該被釘在山頂距離硫磺最遠的地方，並設定為防禦模式。更好的想法是，當 帕勒瓦‧傑格 跑向 地蟲 Spoor 時，他會在到達之前停下來，然後移動到另一側，然後留在那個位置直到你馴服 Aijundu。在他移動到最終位置之前，在他停下來的地方標記你的英雄和追隨者。如果你的隊伍中有小兵大師，請避免在 帕勒瓦‧傑格 附近戰鬥，因為他會在充電時使用 暗夜之池，利用小兵大師本可以使用的屍體；但是，如果你的隊伍沒有小兵大師，建議在帕勒瓦‧傑格附近戰鬥，這樣他會創造黑暗之井，阻礙你施咒的不覺醒者

e31bb8d5e10e692019dbddc96e459dd2b27ed837.source: As the Elementals are tough and dangerous foes, especially for the Desert Wurm (disguise), one may wish to take a safer route around them, while still completing the bonus objective.
e31bb8d5e10e692019dbddc96e459dd2b27ed837.text: 由於元素是兇猛而危險的敵人，特別是對於沙漠 地蟲（偽裝）來說，人們可能希望採取一條更安全的路線繞過它們，同時仍然完成獎勵目標。

a9e592f15faf491ad19741766f0e873aa0586d46.source: After having gained access to the wurm form and having first reached solid ground again, continue west instead of taking the route north. This will bring the party to a second route leading directly to the first (the second for the normal route) Junundu Young. Continuing north after rescuing gets you to the second (the first for the normal route) Junundu Young (remember to stick close to the wall to avoid aggroing more groups of Margonites). After mounting up again, avoid the first Elemental group on the way by sticking close to the north wall and taking the northern passage.
a9e592f15faf491ad19741766f0e873aa0586d46.text: 在進入亞龍 型態 並再次到達堅實地面後，繼續向西而不是向北走。這會將隊伍帶到第二條路線，直接通往第一條路線（正常路線的第二條路線）Junundu Young。救援後繼續向北，你會到達第二個（正常路線的第一個）Junundu Young（記住靠近牆壁，以避免激怒更多的瑪貢尼特群體）。再次上馬後，緊貼北牆並走北面通道，避開途中的第一個 元素生物 小組。

396cddba33a2cb810749333994fd43351c9a1df0.source: Don't take the first canyon north as it is full of Elementals, instead head for the Margonites to the northeast and save the third Junundu Young, guarded by two groups of Margonites. From there, going north and then west will bring you to one last Wurm Spoor, and from there to the end point where there is only one Elemental group and maybe one Margonite group. Simply use Junundu Tunnel to bypass them and run the last bit to finish the mission.
396cddba33a2cb810749333994fd43351c9a1df0.text: 不要向北走第一個峽谷，因為那裡充滿了元素，而是前往東北方的瑪貢尼特，並拯救由兩組瑪貢尼特守衛的第三個朱南杜·楊。從那裡，向北然後向西將帶您到最後一個 地蟲 Spoor，從那裡到終點，那裡只有一個 元素生物 組，也許還有一個 瑪骨奈 組。只需使用 Junundu 隧道繞過他們並執行最後一點即可完成任務。

1ea1249d4c23359e5432396b98b424a7fcdaf650.source: Holy damage does double damage to undead.
1ea1249d4c23359e5432396b98b424a7fcdaf650.text: 神聖傷害 對不死生物造成雙倍傷害。

52c0c1e1dcb3315bd57f632cefa3ac1ae0e521f9.source: Area of effect spells, non-spell skills, and certain enchantment removal skills can help to overcome Obsidian Flesh and Vow of Silence, used by the Carven Effigies and Awakened Dune Carvers respectively.
52c0c1e1dcb3315bd57f632cefa3ac1ae0e521f9.text: 區域效果法術、非法術技能和某些結界移除技能可以幫助克服分別由卡文雕像和覺醒沙丘雕刻師使用的 黑曜石肉體 和 沉靜誓約。

f54ec607f34e0743942f53321df14c97105c1f9c.source: Minions created outside the wurms can run through the Sulfurous Haze; however, while in the Desert Wurm disguise, the party will not be able to heal or create new minions.
f54ec607f34e0743942f53321df14c97105c1f9c.text: 在亞龍之外創造的小兵可以穿過硫磺煙霧；然而，在沙漠 地蟲 偽裝中，隊伍將無法治癒或創造新的小兵。

7a769ab1c52a3a5fe5804ec2a4dee832b88ce004.source: Bring plenty of party-wide heals, protective wards, and/or anti-melee and anti-caster skills — the undead at the start can be overwhelming to an unprepared party.
7a769ab1c52a3a5fe5804ec2a4dee832b88ce004.text: 帶來大量的全隊治療、保護病房和/或反近戰和反施法者技能——一開始的不死生物可能會讓毫無準備的隊伍不知所措。

ffe539f9038d6da08be8a021c1973093847d9852.source: Rebirth or Sunspear Rebirth Signet for resurrection, since they are more convenient for any party members who die on the sulfur.
ffe539f9038d6da08be8a021c1973093847d9852.text: 重生 或 Sunspear 重生 紋章 用於復活，因為它們對任何死於硫磺的黨員來說更方便。

0b97685a29efeacbe1f68713e63d399b34d643c5.source: Lightbringer skills are not very useful, since your party will encounter the majority of Margonites while inside the Junundu and the other foes in this mission are not affected by those skills.
0b97685a29efeacbe1f68713e63d399b34d643c5.text: 光明使者技能不是很有用，因為你的隊伍會在朱南杜內部遇到大多數瑪貢尼特，而此任務中的其他敵人不會受到這些技能的影響。

929cbfb5178ceea4afc6d8f4e82484abb5f03e24.source: When crossing the desolation, Palawa Joko does not need to be with you to complete the mission - you may as well rush forward without his guidance.
929cbfb5178ceea4afc6d8f4e82484abb5f03e24.text: 穿越荒涼時，帕勒瓦‧傑格不需要和你一起完成任務－不妨在沒有他指引的情況下向前衝。

f230fa8573c5220d444ed17d03f4518cf3e1e52a.source: The mission does not progress past the fifth boss, unless you return to Joko, who will say his remaining lines and then you'll become able to use the Wurm Spoor.
f230fa8573c5220d444ed17d03f4518cf3e1e52a.text: 任務不會進展到第五個 Boss，除非你回到 Joko 那裡，他會說出他剩下的臺詞，然後你將能夠使用 地蟲 Spoor。

2a650f74442848d494196c3c166ef18d863dd952.source: If Joko is missing, retrace your steps back towards the start of the mission; he may have gone a different way and stopped once you became separated.
2a650f74442848d494196c3c166ef18d863dd952.text: 如果喬科失蹤了，則原路返回任務開始處；當你們分開後，他可能會走不同的路並停止。

13888e345d49262c2e00e76986874b53e2eb2aaf.source: When riding junundu, remember to switch heroes from Avoid Combat to Guard or Fight mode, otherwise they will be ineffective during battle.
13888e345d49262c2e00e76986874b53e2eb2aaf.text: 騎junundu時，記得將英雄從避免戰鬥切換到守衛或戰鬥模式，否則他們在戰鬥中會失效。

456117f940b7836daa2c5a07199b34f374973769.source: It is fairly easy to die while in a junundu since your team members cannot heal you. The death resets progress toward the Survivor title. Flagging heroes can be done to avoid that.
456117f940b7836daa2c5a07199b34f374973769.text: 在 junundu 中很容易死亡，因為你的團隊成員無法治癒你。死亡重置了 生存者 頭銜的進度。可以透過標記英雄來避免這種情況。

9f897ed4af109c2388c2136c0a02ef60c8999fa3.source: Bringing a Signet of Capture overrides one of the Junundu skills. The position of the Signet of Capture on the skill bar will correspond to the Junundu skill that is removed.
9f897ed4af109c2388c2136c0a02ef60c8999fa3.text: 攜帶 捕捉紋章 會涵蓋 Junundu 技能之一。技能欄上捕捉紋章的位置將對應於被移除的Junundu技能。

ab589adba7dbbd082fc5c33cae30c7f225c4918c.source: It is recommended to place it at the fourth position before using a Wurm Spoor, since Unknown Junundu Ability is an unusable skill that usually takes that slot1.
ab589adba7dbbd082fc5c33cae30c7f225c4918c.text: 建議在使用 地蟲 Spoor 之前將其放置在第四個位置，因為未知的 Junundu 能力是一項無法使用的技能，通常會佔用該位置 1。

52a6f9cb217cca92c0cdaa171060bb435a31160e.source: It is not necessary to be inside the junundu to rescue the young. All three of the young are in sandy areas that you can traverse without being in the wurms. Consider dismounting from the junundu and fighting outside the wurms if you prefer to use your build over the Junundu skills.
52a6f9cb217cca92c0cdaa171060bb435a31160e.text: 沒有必要在朱南杜內部來營救幼崽。所有三隻幼龍都在沙地裡，你可以穿越這些沙地而不必身處亞龍之中。如果您更喜歡使用自己的構建而不是朱南杜技能，請考慮從朱南杜下馬並在亞龍外戰鬥。

fb6c052037d4bb780df8f7eb760c06a3bef760d0.source: You no longer have to keep the young worms alive to get credit for the bonus, just approach them and the bonus note will update.
