cd29e8d35e3447b6b30cc29355bd48aa1a561b7b.source: Enchantment heavy builds are vulnerable to one or more foes from each group and especially to the Undead Lich's Hunger of the Lich
cd29e8d35e3447b6b30cc29355bd48aa1a561b7b.text: 加持魔法 重建築容易受到每個群體的一個或多個敵人的攻擊，尤其是 不死系 巫妖的巫妖之飢

bbe4c1addee67f7cd82795a02f7c022602fd9c7f.source: Stance removing skills, such as Wild Blow or Wild Throw, to end Battle Scars.
bbe4c1addee67f7cd82795a02f7c022602fd9c7f.text: 態勢 移除技能，例如 狂暴一擊 或 野性投擲，以結束戰鬥傷痕。

704e27c1c85e28d6513c9251e9a3003cd26d8640.source: Blocking skills, especially Critical Defenses (which can be maintained indefinitely when tanking Shiro).
704e27c1c85e28d6513c9251e9a3003cd26d8640.text: 格擋技能，尤其是致命防禦（坦克Shiro時可以無限期維持）。

02d3d8a7303043300bafbc45a2fcebb352b2f278.source: Conditions can be dangerous against Shiro, since he can spread them using Impossible Odds.
02d3d8a7303043300bafbc45a2fcebb352b2f278.text: 條件對白來說可能是危險的，因為他可以使用不可能的賠率來傳播它們。

9eaaeefcfb4f09ad18310ef4d34a6c157acca2bd.source: Blind is great when bringing spellcaster-heavy parties, e.g. from Blinding Flash, Eruption, Ebon Dust Aura, Shadowsong, or Sneak Attack.
9eaaeefcfb4f09ad18310ef4d34a6c157acca2bd.text: 當帶來大量施法者的聚會時，盲人非常有用，例如來自 眩目之光、火山爆發、烏塵靈氣、闇影共鳴 或偷襲。

36e15f82922e58289596412891853b9f228a5f27.source: Find and rescue Ryun Grayfeather at Jaya Bluffs.
36e15f82922e58289596412891853b9f228a5f27.text: 在 蛇野斷崖 找到並營救瑞恩·灰羽。

34a52fe808a1008ea81207bb97af87093f7fc321.source: Defeat the Ministry of Purity Forces engaging you.
34a52fe808a1008ea81207bb97af87093f7fc321.text: 擊敗與你交戰的純潔部部隊。

bc62a68695db4a8b70a27fd3948493f4ba3dae6a.source: Catch the Ministry of Purity Sergeant.

c7fea0f4b0084fb157c7e82d98d520094be38f06.source: Survive the battle between the Sensali and the Ministry of Purity.
c7fea0f4b0084fb157c7e82d98d520094be38f06.text: 在 聖沙利天狗 和純潔部之間的戰鬥中生存下來。

157bb23e2d678d53a246f6a4ee4b35a083226b4e.source: Follow the quest markers from Seitung Harbor in order to locate Ryun Grayfeather; it is possible to avoid the Ministry of Purity and Sensali forces battling it out as you make your way north. Once Ryun is found and his dialogue with the Sensali concludes, they will turn hostile and attack. The quest will not fail if Ryun dies, as he will automatically revive after the skirmish if your party does not wipe. Shortly after disposing of the Sensali, Ministry troops led by Jiao Kuai the Swift will approach from the east, and will also turn hostile after dialogue is completed. Continue following quest markers as you "chase" Jiao Kuai, being careful not to over-aggro enemies other than the Ministry groups you'll fight along the way.
157bb23e2d678d53a246f6a4ee4b35a083226b4e.text: 跟著 青函港 的任務標記找到 Ryun Grayfeather；當你往北前進時，可以避開純潔部和 聖沙利天狗 部隊的戰鬥。一旦 Ryun 被發現並且他與 聖沙利天狗 的對話結束，他們就會轉而敵對並發動攻擊。如果 Ryun 死亡，任務不會失敗，因為如果你的隊伍沒有消滅，他會在小衝突後自動復活。消滅聖沙利天狗後不久，史威夫焦快率領的部軍將從東面逼近，對話完成後也會轉為敵對。當你「追趕」焦快的時候，繼續跟隨任務標記，小心不要過度仇恨除了你一路上要戰鬥的部族之外的敵人。

6786346ae938e5ec5f26be5246390b498a21b87f.source: Once Jiao Kuai reaches Sizhou Hall, he will confront the player alongside Commander Chui Kantu just before a Sensali group appears as well, and both will attack the player. Note: In order to avoid wiping at this stage, flag your team just outside Sizhou to the southeast along the ridge protected by a rock wall before triggering the quest dialogue and let both sides take each other out. If you're lucky there will only be a handful of enemies left for you to handle, resulting in an easy finish.
6786346ae938e5ec5f26be5246390b498a21b87f.text: 一旦焦快到達泗州廳，他將與玩家一起與指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜)崔坎圖對峙，隨後聖沙利天狗隊伍也會出現，兩人都會攻擊玩家。注意：為了避免在這個階段被消滅，請在觸發任務對話之前將你的隊伍標記在泗州城外東南方有巖壁保護的山脊上，讓雙方互相消滅對方。如果你幸運的話，你將只剩下少數敵人需要對付，以便輕鬆完成任務。

5b7bbeef82dfc1307fcf329f18e6e3beb580057d.source: Find and speak with Ryun Grayfeather in Jaya Bluffs.
5b7bbeef82dfc1307fcf329f18e6e3beb580057d.text: 在 蛇野斷崖 中找到瑞恩·灰羽並與其交談。

401b478f816b8234c98d098721f4431fe0dbc4cf.source: Talk to Ryun Grayfeather to travel to Tsumei Village.
401b478f816b8234c98d098721f4431fe0dbc4cf.text: 與 Ryun Grayfeather 交談以前往 蘇梅村。

dc9fac681261a568bac290773e5a608790d9f6a3.source: Defend Tsumei Village from the attacking Sensali Tengu.
dc9fac681261a568bac290773e5a608790d9f6a3.text: 防禦 蘇梅村 免受 聖沙利天狗 天狗 的攻擊。

72ae65fbbc504b4529a1dca88f511fe3b17c3a40.source: Defeat the Ministry of Purity's Forces.

3714dc1873bc1282850c7749ebd845f90d41d285.source: Ryun Grayfeather waits for you in Jaya Bluffs just outside Seitung Harbor. Talk to him to be sent into an explorable area version of Tsumei Village, which you must defend from attacking forces.
3714dc1873bc1282850c7749ebd845f90d41d285.text: Ryun Grayfeather 在 青函港 外的 蛇野斷崖 等您。與他交談即可進入 蘇梅村 的可探索區域，您必須防禦攻擊部隊。

85f396e6d960783039f71de75bee9c4f762e1891.source: The Sensali attack first; midway into the battle, Ryun Grayfeather will arrive to reinforce your position with the Angchu Tengu. After you defeat the Sensali, the Ministry of Purity's forces will arrive, entering the village. After a brief dialogue, the Ministry forces become hostile. Defeat these enemies to complete the quest.
85f396e6d960783039f71de75bee9c4f762e1891.text: 首先進行聖沙利天狗攻擊；戰鬥進行到一半時，Ryun Grayfeather 將抵達並使用 Angchu 天狗 來加固你的陣地。在你擊敗 聖沙利天狗 後，純潔部的部隊將會抵達並進入村莊。短暫對話後，魔法部部隊變得敵對。擊敗這些敵人即可完成任務。

67c690e4868e6224da12702b2c8b04c72c1685c0.source: All attacks come from the east; if you are farther than earshot range outside the gate, you will be teleported back to the village. The gate is a natural choke point: use this to ball up the Sensali so you can maximize your area of effect skills. Alternatively you can fight at the high ground in the center of town.
67c690e4868e6224da12702b2c8b04c72c1685c0.text: 所有的攻擊都來自東方；如果您距離門外聽力範圍較遠，您將被傳送回村莊。大門是一個天然的阻塞點：用它來聚集 聖沙利天狗，這樣你就可以最大化你的技能效果範圍。或者，您也可以在市中心的高地進行戰鬥。

925045845da4d8e53729b064dafa703e97157175.source: Bring corpse exploitation skills to counter the enemy's use of Aura of the Lich.
925045845da4d8e53729b064dafa703e97157175.text: 帶上屍體剝削技巧來對抗敵人使用巫妖靈氣。

36a2c4ad3ee0bc19a4f2759ff78c5548f8ef8e85.source: Alternatively, bring your own minion master, Verata's Aura, or other minion counters.
36a2c4ad3ee0bc19a4f2759ff78c5548f8ef8e85.text: 或者，帶上自己的小兵大師、芙瑞達的靈氣 或其他小兵計數器。

654737b3ed4b06f04fbae2ae7d9aa9893e2a5aba.source: If you flag heroes near the first Ministry group, while they are non-hostile, they will attempt to heal any minions. Shortly after combat begins, the minions will expire and explode (if you bring Death Nova and other minion bomber skills).
654737b3ed4b06f04fbae2ae7d9aa9893e2a5aba.text: 如果你在第一個魔法部組附近標記英雄，當他們沒有敵意時，他們會嘗試治療任何小兵。戰鬥開始後不久，小兵就會過期並爆炸（如果你帶了 死亡新星 和其他小兵轟炸機技能）。

e37d6fb546e4b87038d5afd52784004ff2c84f68.source: Trappers are very effective since you can funnel all incoming enemies through the village gate. They have plenty of time to set traps for the final battle, since the next-to-last dialogue is long-winded.
e37d6fb546e4b87038d5afd52784004ff2c84f68.text: 陷阱非常有效，因為你可以透過村門將所有進來的敵人集中起來。他們有足夠的時間為最後的戰鬥設定陷阱，因為倒數第二個對話很冗長。

61d89333dc30b0427928bb3f52a2eeed49b6592f.source: If players stray too far outside the portals in the village, players are teleported back inside the village walls and the message "You must not abandon the village!" displays.
61d89333dc30b0427928bb3f52a2eeed49b6592f.text: 如果玩家在村莊的傳送門外走得太遠，玩家會被傳送回村莊牆內，並顯示「你不能放棄村莊！」的訊息。顯示。

2596020eb1866106a63eb91903366630ee96a1dd.text: 主職 不是 祭祀者

f0d7efb3ba33ac8d26794ba547af1216fb47a1b6.source: Miku must reach Ashu in order to trigger the final dialogue. If Miku dies along the way, she risks resurrecting behind a closed gate and staying there forever. Unless you can quickly trace her back before the pursuing ministry forces reach her, or are able to overwhelm you instead, you must restart the quest.
f0d7efb3ba33ac8d26794ba547af1216fb47a1b6.text: Miku 必須到達 Ashu 才能觸發最終對話。如果 Miku 在途中死亡，她就有可能在關閉的大門後復活並永遠留在那裡。除非你能在追擊的魔法部部隊到達她之前快速追蹤到她，或者能夠壓倒你，否則你必須重新開始任務。

877a51412dc7faf1f154ce650d95837276cc66bb.source: Warn Soar Honorclaw of the Ministry of Purity's deceit.
877a51412dc7faf1f154ce650d95837276cc66bb.text: 警告 光榮之爪 索爾 純潔部的欺騙行為。

b4384c352e23ac3f6cb0b97f068dbe3a676a0b36.source: Defeat the Ministry of Purity forces.

17108fc882a4183f4bff1e9d6522f056f9e19796.text: 光榮之爪 索爾 必須生存。

999fc0994e0da4539a7211f7fd22d94002ac3922.source: See Soar Honorclaw for your reward.
999fc0994e0da4539a7211f7fd22d94002ac3922.text: 請參閱 光榮之爪 索爾 以取得獎勵。

b4ce4838d671740801596c4dc1e388c4ccbb6140.source: Start from Ran Musu Gardens and head southwest to the Tengu camp. The initial group of Ministry troops will be reinforced by two groups, one from the west and another from the south. Since your party is small:
b4ce4838d671740801596c4dc1e388c4ccbb6140.text: 從 嵐穆蘇花園 出發，往西南方向前往 天狗 營地。第一批部隊將得到兩支部隊的增援，一支來自西部，另一支來自南部。由於您的聚會規模較小：

c596fdefb8b672b0b9eefed21288ccac2c79bf9e.source: The Tengu can be used to grab initial aggro, if desired.
c596fdefb8b672b0b9eefed21288ccac2c79bf9e.text: 如果需要，天狗 可用於取得初始仇恨。

b83d0285de25846fb82f51c701256a1832ba6744.source: Consider bringing a Minion Bomber hero for extra meat shields (Ministry of Purity healers will keep them alive during dialogue).
b83d0285de25846fb82f51c701256a1832ba6744.text: 考慮帶一個小兵轟炸機英雄來獲得額外的肉盾（純潔部治療師將在對話期間讓他們保持活力）。

fa620cd15a58d05c878f90f4c87d96d2da9e8bd4.source: A Spirit wall is also recommended to help body block foes.
fa620cd15a58d05c878f90f4c87d96d2da9e8bd4.text: 也建議使用精神牆來幫助身體阻擋敵人。

040d7e7d3ac2b0a9ff33d617000d6e290dafbf8f.source: The Ministry foes stand around in a large group while the dialogue takes place; consider abusing this by bringing a trapper to cover the ground under them with traps that will all trigger at once when they turn hostile, effectively wiping them out, or at least thinning their numbers.
040d7e7d3ac2b0a9ff33d617000d6e290dafbf8f.text: 對話期間，魔法部的敵人們圍成一大群站著；考慮濫用這一點，讓一個捕獸者用陷阱覆蓋他們下面的地面，當他們變得敵對時，這些陷阱會立即觸發，有效地消滅他們，或者至少減少他們的數量。

675231becdcecffbb4878095215951b6eb27ae07.source: When you accept this quest, a Ministerial Decree is added to your inventory.
675231becdcecffbb4878095215951b6eb27ae07.text: 當您接受此任務時，部長法令將新增到您的庫存中。

b4b1d8e514cf75f30961af97b249745de8528519.source: Meet Soar Honorclaw and his forces in Xaquang Skyway.
b4b1d8e514cf75f30961af97b249745de8528519.text: 在 夏安便道 中認識 光榮之爪 索爾 和他的部隊。

c43fddf469201c80a6ca11d9bd75e1ada13dd07f.source: Fight your way inside the "Tengu Containment Zone."
c43fddf469201c80a6ca11d9bd75e1ada13dd07f.text: 在「天狗 收容區」內殺出一條血路。

1824a6d7e5b19086a67f834c1b1c3bd03654c2f1.source: Locate and free the Tengu Prisoners.
1824a6d7e5b19086a67f834c1b1c3bd03654c2f1.text: 找出並釋放 天狗 囚犯。

271c31c8b25c4dc897b1c2d908c6121d38eb5e05.source: Escort the prisoners to the Shenzun Tunnels.
271c31c8b25c4dc897b1c2d908c6121d38eb5e05.text: 護送囚犯前往 申贊通道。

eb9e72e9fe7df9065d32fd965474602efdf56be4.source: At least one Tengu Prisoner must survive.
eb9e72e9fe7df9065d32fd965474602efdf56be4.text: 至少一名 天狗 囚犯必須生存。

566b9bb499bfa35b1ec90a3521b3d3671aef6ae0.source: Meet up with Soar Honorclaw and her Angchu Tengu allies east of the entrance to Senji's Corner. Note that Soar's group of Angchu will resurrect after a short time out of earshot of foes. Head north, being careful not to aggro too many Ministry fighters at the same time. Once you reach The Roost, wait for the short dialogue between Elite Ministry Captain and the party leader, after which the Ministry will turn hostile and Tengu from the Roost will become allies. More Ministry fighters will arrive; defeat them and lead the Tengu to the exit to Shenzun Tunnels. Map travel back to Ran Musu Gardens and return to Aerie to claim your reward.
566b9bb499bfa35b1ec90a3521b3d3671aef6ae0.text: 在 山吉之街 入口東邊與 光榮之爪 索爾 和她的 Angchu 天狗 盟友會合。請注意，索爾的安楚隊會在敵人聽不到的短時間內復活。向北前進，小心不要同時激怒太多魔法部戰士。到達棲息地後，等待 精英 部門隊長和黨魁之間的簡短對話，之後部門將轉為敵對，而棲息地的 天狗 將成為盟友。更多魔法部戰士將會抵達；擊敗他們並帶領 天狗 到達 申贊通道 的出口。地圖返回 嵐穆蘇花園，然後返回 Aerie 領取獎勵。

7e5957045f779c67ead47769af384b5115b25a21.source: The Ministry foes here are very aggressive: they will chase your party farther than most other foes.
7e5957045f779c67ead47769af384b5115b25a21.text: 這裡魔法部的敵人非常具有侵略性：他們會比大多數其他敵人追趕你的隊伍更遠。

80e54f8735cae4f119b8d0bc5b92434ee3e79cd5.source: If you're having trouble keeping the prisoners alive, you can take several steps before approaching the prisoners.
80e54f8735cae4f119b8d0bc5b92434ee3e79cd5.text: 如果你很難讓囚犯活下去，你可以在接近囚犯之前採取幾個步驟。

f144079f4ce15e0ec722b3c38963ce3c61578c0f.source: Clear the path to Shenzun Tunnels.
f144079f4ce15e0ec722b3c38963ce3c61578c0f.text: 清除 申贊通道 的路徑。

7f6e660e86e8e2d38dfdd0ca37f9d062b4452dc2.source: Setup a Spirit wall before the fight begins, to delay the Ministry reinforcements from south.
7f6e660e86e8e2d38dfdd0ca37f9d062b4452dc2.text: 在戰鬥開始前設定精神牆，以拖延魔法部從南方來的援軍。

310bf8e83f74ded4080128b1a9b66dafffac5193.source: Bring speed boosts for two reasons
310bf8e83f74ded4080128b1a9b66dafffac5193.text: 帶來速度提升有兩個原因

c8bfce28c0a5a530620d888b1a95dbf15f1cb01d.source: This will help you pull speed-boosted foes away from the slower-moving casters.
c8bfce28c0a5a530620d888b1a95dbf15f1cb01d.text: 這將幫助您將速度提升的敵人從移動速度較慢的施法者身邊拉開。

beb99692c529cbc9c1650c664373104bf933b4fd.source: To help counter the snares used by the Ministry.
beb99692c529cbc9c1650c664373104bf933b4fd.text: 幫助對抗魔法部使用的圈套。

6447b910a0c21692924f103805c5e30551031011.source: Skills that affect allies in an area are very effective due to the large amount of allies in this quest, especially Ebon Battle Standard of Honor.
6447b910a0c21692924f103805c5e30551031011.text: 由於此任務中有大量盟友，影響區域內盟友的技能非常有效，尤其是 黑檀 榮譽戰旗。

50707ee0e61ff7ba08e84d09704611c10f32035c.source: During this solo quest, you will be under the effects of the Dastardly Disguise, which makes you look like a member of one of various thug groups. The quest is straightforward: enter the area, talk to several NPCs, listen to a speech, and then make a hasty retreat. However, there are several pitfalls that can cause the quest to fail:
50707ee0e61ff7ba08e84d09704611c10f32035c.text: 在這個單人任務中，你將受到卑鄙偽裝的影響，這讓你看起來像是各個暴徒組織之一的成員。任務很簡單：進入該區域，與幾個 NPC 交談，聽取演講，然後倉促撤退。然而，有幾個陷阱可能會導致任務失敗：

ca161aa09acebb82f4ed12a371244e6f4e7f4bd3.source: During the talking phase, giving three bad answers or talking to an NPC that recognizes you as an impostor (i.e. you are disguised as one of them).
ca161aa09acebb82f4ed12a371244e6f4e7f4bd3.text: 在談話階段，給出三個錯誤的答案或與認為你是冒名頂替者的 NPC 交談（即你偽裝成其中之一）。

88b3a22945899cee8e181bc2d374bb97ed99a0be.source: During the speech phase, getting too far away from the crowd (e.g. to prepare to escape) — this causes everyone to become hostile and the quest will fail.
88b3a22945899cee8e181bc2d374bb97ed99a0be.text: 在演講階段，離人群太遠（例如準備逃跑）——這會導致每個人都變得充滿敵意，任務就會失敗。

8ed566245bd9885b91ea7b9e0ef22024e46945ba.source: During the escape phase, if you leave the area too quickly — wait until your quest log updates your success, otherwise you will not get credit (even if you have done everything else correctly).
8ed566245bd9885b91ea7b9e0ef22024e46945ba.text: 在逃生階段，如果你離開該區域太快——請等到你的任務日誌更新你的成功，否則你將不會獲得積分（即使你已經正確完成了其他所有事情）。

c91e864bb033eca7dcea391a399cc35d631f03d1.source: You need to give at least three good answers to the relevant NPCs.
c91e864bb033eca7dcea391a399cc35d631f03d1.text: 你需要給相關NPC至少三個好的答案。

9eb163ef373dfc3da58b9cf67d0cdf142dcc1345.source: You can start moving away once the PC says "What, no, I'm not an imposter."
9eb163ef373dfc3da58b9cf67d0cdf142dcc1345.text: 一旦電腦說“什麼，不，我不是冒名頂替者”，你就可以開始離開。

8bfc646e1c114ef10a158fbec49f8010f2c3ce31.source: A speed boost (even Drunken Master) is helpful to keep you ahead of any foes, but the quest can be completed without one.
8bfc646e1c114ef10a158fbec49f8010f2c3ce31.text: 速度提升（甚至醉酒大師）有助於讓你領先任何敵人，但任務可以在沒有速度提升的情況下完成。

1fe2afca9494673e424be79d18dbdf27f5d0fc1f.source: It is also possible to distract the foes using spirits and minions.
1fe2afca9494673e424be79d18dbdf27f5d0fc1f.text: 也可以使用靈魂和僕從來分散敵人的注意力。

7e4924b8c30dc112b4aae8ba027c3611d45e8c67.source: Speak with Guardsman Qao Lin when you are ready for combat.
7e4924b8c30dc112b4aae8ba027c3611d45e8c67.text: 當你準備好戰鬥時，與守衛喬林交談。

ca787e698e23a7635a1440445df54a60f1d3c77a.source: Position the Imperial Guards in defensive positions. There is only a short time before they reach the gates!
ca787e698e23a7635a1440445df54a60f1d3c77a.text: 將帝國衛隊佈置在防禦位置。距離他們到達大門只有很短的時間了！

0f8e9872a9b6e1f3b16e06239bbfe3220ac59f81.source: Do not allow the gangs to breach the gate to the palace.
0f8e9872a9b6e1f3b16e06239bbfe3220ac59f81.text: 不要讓幫派闖入宮殿的大門。

5c9a57a3ae8b0fad6f2551419517cfa3ec4e8934.source: Defeat Reisen the Phoenix and Apep, Unending Night
5c9a57a3ae8b0fad6f2551419517cfa3ec4e8934.text: 擊敗 火鳳凰 雷森和阿佩普，無盡之夜

1db4482d1eb3289ec6c27ed32d6534a4301a9d5f.source: You can talk to the guards to have them follow you. Talk to them again to have them wait at a suitable position.
1db4482d1eb3289ec6c27ed32d6534a4301a9d5f.text: 你可以和守衛交談，讓他們跟著你。再次與他們交談，讓他們在適當的位置等待。

450e75be1d6d677ea58684aae2452631e29b6f61.source: Soon, the Main Gate will be broken. Defeat all incoming attackers. After a while, the Dock Gate is breached as well. With attackers from both sides, you can either split your forces or take a stand near the Palace Gate. If you stay at the gate, let all the guards follow you, this keeps them from going too far away from your position to defend the main Gate.
450e75be1d6d677ea58684aae2452631e29b6f61.text: 很快，正門就會被攻破。擊敗所有來襲的攻擊者。過了一會兒，碼頭大門也被攻破。當雙方都有進攻時，你可以選擇分兵，或是在宮門附近站穩腳步。如果你留在門口，讓所有的守衛跟著你，這樣他們就不會離開你的位置太遠來保衛大門。

24ad9a870bfd610d4bb0f1699ac9b8cccc5904de.source: Note that all three gates cannot be healed or otherwise repaired. Be sure to intercept your foes early. (e.g. you could use the central courtyard and pull from both sides)
24ad9a870bfd610d4bb0f1699ac9b8cccc5904de.text: 請注意，所有三個門都無法治癒或以其他方式修復。一定要儘早攔截你的敵人。 （例如，您可以使用中央庭院並從兩側拉）

dbf7c65c4142be1dd48aef9301e2c94488b3c778.source: If your party wipes, you will be resurrected at the Palace Gate. Dead Canthan Guards will self-resurrect between waves.
dbf7c65c4142be1dd48aef9301e2c94488b3c778.text: 如果你的隊伍被消滅，你將在宮殿門口復活。死去的凱珊守護會在波浪之間自我復活。

9dbd05dfec01d26d61dcd8d52f87eaabb901211e.source: When Reisen the Phoenix arrives, it is recommended to target him first since he has very high damage.
9dbd05dfec01d26d61dcd8d52f87eaabb901211e.text: 當火鳳凰雷森到達時，建議先瞄準他，因為他的傷害非常高。

ca258506f22e80d4ef45b1cc6d414d9ba43312c2.source: Make the guards follow you at the start, and stay by the main gate.
ca258506f22e80d4ef45b1cc6d414d9ba43312c2.text: 讓守衛一開始就跟著你，並留在大門附近。

2eba0292ce5c656f48eb34d4d30f18181dc627bc.source: Bring Pain Inverter and target elementalists and bosses with it.
2eba0292ce5c656f48eb34d4d30f18181dc627bc.text: 帶上 苦痛 逆變器和目標元素主義者和 Boss。

565544c7c1e762087e3549b2becef7c98a7727d5.source: Bring area of effect (AoE) skills. The staircases can serve as choke points.
565544c7c1e762087e3549b2becef7c98a7727d5.text: 帶來區域效果（範圍性）技能。樓梯可以作為阻塞點。

c5a496e99955332c45530f39a69ae6ea49c3f5fa.source: Flag heroes quickly out of Chaos Storm or Churning Earth when enemies cast it; otherwise, sit back and enjoy the show while the guards serve as a never-ending meat shield for your party and your AoE skills wreak havoc on the incoming mobs.
c5a496e99955332c45530f39a69ae6ea49c3f5fa.text: 當敵人施放技能時，將英雄快速標記為退出 混沌風暴 或 渦流大地；否則，坐下來享受表演，而守衛將成為你的隊伍永無休止的肉盾，而你的 範圍性 技能會對到來的暴民造成嚴重破壞。

be71eabe68d58ce6a20f9820592b4ec5c991c852.source: A Soul Twisting (Shelter and Union) hero is recommended for defense.
be71eabe68d58ce6a20f9820592b4ec5c991c852.text: 建議使用 生靈扭轉（庇護 和 聯合）英雄進行防禦。

aa4b5ad7e58a1c83028fb74b7ed9b95c0f7a61b2.source: Because there will be many foes and allies, considering bringing a minion master (or even two) and Ebon Battle Standard of Honor, respectively.
aa4b5ad7e58a1c83028fb74b7ed9b95c0f7a61b2.text: 因為會有很多敵人和盟友，可以考慮分別帶一個小兵大師（甚至兩個）和黑檀榮譽戰旗。

5087fd193700b00129e3e10cba7be39da76a221f.source: Sometimes the incoming waves of enemies will not spawn. Instead, only a few waves will spawn in the Main Gate, and no other enemies will spawn afterwards.
5087fd193700b00129e3e10cba7be39da76a221f.text: 有時來襲的敵人不會出現。相反，只有幾波會在主門中生成，之後不會生成其他敵人。

68a6f792beda264cbb7d278d3cf977293b737d03.source: Speak with Headmaster Quin in the Shing Jea Monastery
68a6f792beda264cbb7d278d3cf977293b737d03.text: 在 星岬寺 中與奎因校長交談

7ce1ffb81799eb2805a08f2915a918316c99ea4f.source: Defeat the attacking Ministry of Purity forces. Jinnai has placed traps in the area that will aid you.
7ce1ffb81799eb2805a08f2915a918316c99ea4f.text: 擊敗進攻的純潔部軍隊。陣內在該區域設定了陷阱，可以幫助你。

c524122fc7e0c2b07eebf10e29cde40a74d174bf.source: Talk to Miku in the Shenzun Tunnels Shenzun Tunnels (Winds of Change) (just south of Tahnnakai Temple). This will transport your party to Jinnai's location. After a brief dialogue between Jinnai and Miku, Ministry of Purity will appear all over the map. They will slowly approach your location. Defeat them all to complete the quest. Be aware that neither Jinnai nor Miku can use the teleporters found throughout the area.
c524122fc7e0c2b07eebf10e29cde40a74d174bf.text: 與 申贊通道 申贊通道 (變幻之風) 中的 Miku 交談（就在 譚納凱神殿 的南方）。這將把你的隊伍運送到陣內的位置。陣內和初音短暫對話後，地圖上就會出現純潔部。他們會慢慢接近你的位置。擊敗他們所有人即可完成任務。請注意，陣內和未來都無法使用整個區域中的傳送器。

0d73cba19d8ed228be013a4b7aeac67cb330d051.source: There are two basic approaches: find a good place to defend or keep moving around.
0d73cba19d8ed228be013a4b7aeac67cb330d051.text: 有兩種基本方法：找到一個好地方進行防守或繼續移動。

dc4233ffef73ac4d299f10f118651980ba79461b.source: Immediately after initiating the opening dialogue, use the teleporter near your starting location and head to the cemetery due south of where you get teleported to; it's one of several decent defensive locations. Regardless of your choice, keep the party spread out to counter the enemy's AoE skills. Defeat the groups as they spawn. Jinnai and Miku will remain at their initial location, diverting the enemy until you are ready to pull them towards you. Or you can wait for the Ministry to find you.
dc4233ffef73ac4d299f10f118651980ba79461b.text: 開始對話後，立即使用起始位置附近的傳送器前往傳送到的正南方墓地；它是幾個不錯的防禦地點之一。無論您如何選擇，請保持隊伍分散以對抗敵人的 範圍性 技能。在群體產生時擊敗它們。陣內和未來將留在他們的初始位置，轉移敵人的注意力，直到你準備好將他們拉向你。或者你可以等待魔法部來找你。

3e1afc00192503ff35d6c4148642f17ec3466d59.source: If you use the cemetery, use the stairs as a choke point and block it with a spirit wall, minions, or a tank. You can also walk to your chosen spot, in which case, the NPCs will follow you and aid in the fight.
3e1afc00192503ff35d6c4148642f17ec3466d59.text: 如果你使用墓地，請使用樓梯作為阻塞點，並用精神牆、小兵或坦克來阻擋它。你也可以步行到你選擇的地點，這樣NPC就會跟著你並協助戰鬥。

ac970ce89644e3798c9522e66d54d6ada4da5a54.source: Alternatively, head north from the first teleporter's exit (instead of south to the cemetery). Defeat the 2-3 ministry groups that spawn at this location and leave any heroes flagged here. Go south to find the next ministry group and draw them back to your heroes. Keep repeating this until there are no more ministry troops. Be careful approaching Miku and Jinnai, since they will also attract foes towards your heroes.
ac970ce89644e3798c9522e66d54d6ada4da5a54.text: 或者，從第一個傳送器的出口向北（而不是向南前往墓地）。擊敗在此位置產生的 2-3 部會團體，並在此標記所有英雄。前往南方尋找下一個事工小組，並將他們吸引回你的英雄身邊。不斷重複此操作，直到不再有部會部隊為止。接近 Miku 和 Jinnai 時要小心，因為他們也會吸引敵人來攻擊你的英雄。

ebd16015bbe821698a8c2ae898d7a9fff20bd005.source: Since Jinnai has spiked the area with traps, you can move between teleporters, drawing the ministry foes to each trap in turn. The traps are not likely to kill all your opponents, but they will weaken them sufficiently to allow your team to mop up the remnants. do the traps do any damage at all? talk page seems to suggest not
ebd16015bbe821698a8c2ae898d7a9fff20bd005.text: 由於陣內在該區域佈滿了陷阱，你可以在傳送器之間移動，依次將部會敵人吸引到每個陷阱。這些陷阱不太可能殺死你所有的對手，但它們會充分削弱他們的力量，讓你的團隊可以清理殘餘物。這些陷阱會造成任何損害嗎？討論頁面似乎建議不要

8a3d9560f8290e7cef1d1bf7120fa337301200a4.source: Bringing a Minion Bomber or two is useful due to the sheer number of available corpses.
8a3d9560f8290e7cef1d1bf7120fa337301200a4.text: 由於可用屍體的數量龐大，因此攜帶一兩個小兵轟炸機非常有用。

7f97eb406230a4b3f945484f75b3f783333ff533.source: A Soul Twisting hero is recommended for additional protection.
7f97eb406230a4b3f945484f75b3f783333ff533.text: 建議使用 生靈扭轉 英雄來提供額外保護。

b8e48555d0d8c96c2fb2c34c5e3223b2a6b38256.source: Synergy with MM Protection spells greatly increases survivability if too many enemies are accidentally aggroed.
b8e48555d0d8c96c2fb2c34c5e3223b2a6b38256.text: 如果有太多敵人被意外攻擊，與 MM 保護法術的協同作用會大大提高生存能力。

ea04d2c8346dcbbd4345d9f18f10c3b959f4ea17.source: An effective body block method if using the cemetery defense, such as a Signet of Spirits hero or melee hero capable of AoE damage.
ea04d2c8346dcbbd4345d9f18f10c3b959f4ea17.text: 如果使用墓地防禦，這是一種有效的身體阻擋方法，例如 縛靈紋章 英雄或能夠造成 範圍性 傷害的近戰英雄。

14f90cae7ebd227c1e75754d226ca13458da2906.source: A Vow of Strength Dervish or Hundred Blades Warrior is highly recommended, or:
14f90cae7ebd227c1e75754d226ca13458da2906.text: 強烈建議使用 力量誓約 神喚使 或 快速劍 戰士，或：

abd2ec9d2fdd35926327474512e88b7fe2910f2b.source: An Assassin with Death Blossom if protection/healing capability is high.
abd2ec9d2fdd35926327474512e88b7fe2910f2b.text: 如果保護/修復能力較高，則 暗殺者 與 死神之花 一起使用。

62b994d4fae509c116f2c2cc846463ad17566626.source: This quest takes place in an explorable version of Altrumm Ruins.
62b994d4fae509c116f2c2cc846463ad17566626.text: 此任務發生在 奧楚蘭廢墟 的探索版本中。

63a29c298329fd4d43dd7328af9019dbe2f4b052.source: Travel to Shadow's Passage and investigate the meeting.
63a29c298329fd4d43dd7328af9019dbe2f4b052.text: 前往 陰暗通道 並調查會議。

7a87560d6d2d10a0684b666db121d14c26b19e66.source: Speak with the attendees to find out what the criminals are planning. Avoid the group you are disguised as and mind your tongue. The wrong words will draw unwanted attention.
7a87560d6d2d10a0684b666db121d14c26b19e66.text: 與與會者交談，瞭解犯罪者的計畫。避開你所偽裝的群體並注意你的舌頭。錯誤的用詞會引起不必要的注意。

476b2574496325b3f67886875fedd5222321e132.source: Go listen to the criminal's speech. Leaving early will blow your cover.
476b2574496325b3f67886875fedd5222321e132.text: 去聽聽罪犯的講話吧。提早離開會暴露你的身分。

e9c86b6896ab99de81db006b266f1df7b8e5b0c9.source: Travel to Bukdek Byway to protect the citizens from the retreating gangs.
e9c86b6896ab99de81db006b266f1df7b8e5b0c9.text: 前往 巴德克小徑 保護公民免受撤退幫派的侵害。

598a94731526c8e239c912d4654184c70a804c59.source: Do not allow more than three groups of Peasants to die.
598a94731526c8e239c912d4654184c70a804c59.text: 不要讓超過三組的農民死亡。

54c8845f3f85cb9b5f3765fcc0f2f10fd651b3ed.source: Listen to Eri, Heart of Fire and determine her fate.
54c8845f3f85cb9b5f3765fcc0f2f10fd651b3ed.text: 聆聽火之心艾莉的聲音並決定她的命運。

28bc8a8972df0c1410c58fa3b0cd63ea5cec0028.source: Getting closer than two aggro bubbles to the hostile foes and allies will cause them to engage in combat, this allows you to recharge your skills and energy before charging towards the next group of allies. Use skills such as "Fall Back!" to close the distance quickly to rescue the canthan peasants. Only one peasant needs to survive from each group to count as "saving" the group for the purposes of the quest. Consider microing heroes or telling human healers to heal peasants under fire. Should you let Eri escape, she will become an ally in the quest The Final Confrontation.
28bc8a8972df0c1410c58fa3b0cd63ea5cec0028.text: 距離敵對敵人和盟友超過兩個仇恨氣泡會導致他們參與戰鬥，這可以讓你在衝向下一組盟友之前補充你的技能和能量。使用諸如“後退！”之類的技能。迅速拉近距離，拯救凱珊農民。為了任務的目的，每個群體中只有一名農民需要生存下來才能算作「拯救」該群體。考慮微英雄或告訴人類治療師治療遭受砲火攻擊的農民。如果你讓艾莉逃脫，她將成為任務「最終對抗」中的盟友。

9ca47fdf03407d73d6cf561fbed03a5062ccb8fb.source: Arrive at the rally before the Ministry of Purity and warn Xin Ji of their attack.
9ca47fdf03407d73d6cf561fbed03a5062ccb8fb.text: 到達清部前的集會處，警告辛霽他們的襲擊。

256e474bf4631c5589fa0c09011b21ce92b389d2.source: Escort Xin Ji and the other demonstrators to Xaquang Skyway.
256e474bf4631c5589fa0c09011b21ce92b389d2.text: 護送辛吉和其他示威者前往 夏安便道。

ed735864001994f2f07673f18568b38aebe59f81.source: Your goal is to successfully escort the demonstrators out of harm's way. However, the quest will succeed as long as Xin Ji survives.
ed735864001994f2f07673f18568b38aebe59f81.text: 你的目標是成功護送示威者脫離危險。不過，只要辛霽還活著，任務就會成功。

363a0972487c5bc0906d58d6d793aa56ee93b47b.source: As soon as you enter the zone, head towards Xin Ji to trigger the initial dialogue. Once that ends, start moving towards each successive quest marker; these lead you through the most efficient escape route. If you start right away, you can evade the ministry troops even after they start following you. Along the way, reinforcements will spawn, but as long as you keep moving, you will be able to lead Xin Ji to safety.
363a0972487c5bc0906d58d6d793aa56ee93b47b.text: 進入區域後，前往辛吉，觸發初始對話。一旦結束，開始朝著每個連續的任務標記移動；這些將引導您通過最有效的逃生路線。如果你立即開始，即使部會部隊開始跟蹤你，你也可以躲避他們。一路上會出現援軍，但只要你繼續前進，就能帶領辛霽安全抵達安全地帶。

8e0bc1e7acaddd8bcf1e947d75bf6c02f5b46f5e.source: As soon as you reach the bridge near the Xaquang Skyway portal, the demonstrators are removed from your party window, which completes the quest. You can /resign or map out or wait to see the cinematic, which begins after the last line of dialogue.
8e0bc1e7acaddd8bcf1e947d75bf6c02f5b46f5e.text: 一旦您到達 夏安便道 入口網站附近的橋梁，示威者就會從您的隊伍視窗中移除，從而完成任務。你可以/辭職或計劃或等待觀看從最後一行對話之後開始的電影。

263ccd3b23d7c2560ce07829b97a348662db3616.source: If you have trouble, you can distract your pursuers by flagging heroes or dropping spirits behind you. You can also bring speed boosts that affect allies, notably "Charge!", "Fall Back!", and/or "Incoming!".
263ccd3b23d7c2560ce07829b97a348662db3616.text: 如果你遇到麻煩，你可以透過標記英雄或在你身後丟下靈魂來分散追擊者的注意力。你還可以帶來影響盟友的速度提升，特別是「衝鋒！」、「後退！」和/或「來襲！」。

615cf542e9b7d95b727e65052f70db31b2aee328.source: Speak with Qao Lin when you are ready for combat.
615cf542e9b7d95b727e65052f70db31b2aee328.text: 當你準備好戰鬥時與喬林交談。

e70b0f60b8625f6a8625ba6f826b62fc0ab5b8e4.source: Position the Imperial Guards in defensive positions and utilize your Improvised Fire Bombs. There is only a short time before they breach the gates!
e70b0f60b8625f6a8625ba6f826b62fc0ab5b8e4.text: 將帝國衛隊置於防禦位置並使用簡易火焰炸彈。距離他們突破大門只有很短的時間了！

3ba56516416e3957857acb3643a5ba16e7c4822d.text: 臨時校長 涵洛 必須生存。

cc1d57349448733609e62ab91c3e05622aa6b44c.source: The Tengu will enter through two gates: first through the main gate (near where the profession trainers stand normally) and later through the north gate (i.e. the Sunqua Vale portal); fortunately, they do not come through Linnok Courtyard, so you only have to defend from two directions. Your best bet is to defend Mhenlo where he stands, since your primary goal is to prevent his death and it is nearly impossible to defend both gates. You have about 30 seconds before your opponents start attacking the gates and perhaps another 30 seconds before they can make their way to Mhenlo.
cc1d57349448733609e62ab91c3e05622aa6b44c.text: 天狗 將通過兩個門進入：首先通過正門（靠近職業培訓師通常站立的位置），然後通過北門（即 桑泉谷 入口）；幸運的是，它們不是通過 裡諾庭園 來的，所以你只需從兩個方向進行防禦。你最好的選擇是保衛 涵洛 所在的位置，因為你的主要目標是防止他死亡，而保衛兩扇門幾乎是不可能的。在你的對手開始攻擊大門之前，你還有大約 30 秒的時間，也許還有 30 秒的時間，然後他們可以進入 涵洛。

44caa7c2f988fb76b5d3bf263b10af2c8b56db43.source: Once the Tengu start to swarm, their Necromancers will use Aura of the Lich to create massive minion armies and their Mesmers will use Panic. There are no healers (and almost no hex removal). Should you wipe, the party will resurrect near Mhenlo's original location, although this usually leads to quest failure because he will be left unprotected.
44caa7c2f988fb76b5d3bf263b10af2c8b56db43.text: 一旦 天狗 開始蜂擁而至，他們的死靈法師將使用 巫妖靈氣 來建立大規模的僕從軍隊，而他們的幻術師將使用 恐慌。沒有治療師（並且幾乎沒有去除妖術）。如果你擦除，該隊伍將在 涵洛 的原始位置附近復活，儘管這通常會導致任務失敗，因為他將不受保護。

904b3a7bf13713c69c4bdef2ca4d3db0c5ba1d06.source: You have two additional types of help available during this quest:
904b3a7bf13713c69c4bdef2ca4d3db0c5ba1d06.text: 在此任務期間，您還可以獲得兩種額外型別的幫助：

16beaa5da7b9364d12849afff5b5e7838b307caa.source: After choosing a secondary profession, consider speaking with your headmaster and earning your insignia. It is possible to unlock all of the skills related to each training quest without having to do the quests. This is done by accepting the quest from Instructor Ng, receiving the skills, then abandoning the quest.
16beaa5da7b9364d12849afff5b5e7838b307caa.text: 選擇第二個職業後，請考慮與您的校長交談並獲得您的徽章。無需執行任務即可解鎖與每個訓練任務相關的所有技能。這是透過接受吳教練的任務，獲得技能，然後放棄任務來完成的。

f66d45e4db0d7a0868fedd1edc7dc49fcc09c6f0.source: 1 - This reward is not listed in the quest log.
f66d45e4db0d7a0868fedd1edc7dc49fcc09c6f0.text: 1 - 此獎勵未列在任務日誌中。

debf5cd9cdfa9d5178dce10ddbdab6c28553fd9c.source: Miku stands south of the entrance to Tahnnakai Temple outpost. After initial dialogue, she will take you to the garden where Reiko walks with Ashu, which is the explorable vesion of Shing Jea Arena. After a brief dialogue, Reiko will become hostile. During the fight, she will use three special skills:
debf5cd9cdfa9d5178dce10ddbdab6c28553fd9c.text: Miku 位於 譚納凱神殿 前哨入口的南邊。初步對話後，她將帶您前往玲子與阿修一起散步的花園，這是 星岬競技場 的探索版本。簡短的對話後，玲子就會變得充滿敵意。在戰鬥中，她會使用三種特殊技能：

e86e039620336b8ead0b0ed52d495eb649d25eb9.source: Grand Illusion, which creates a vortex of phantoms; its strength is indicated by a purple bar on the screen.
e86e039620336b8ead0b0ed52d495eb649d25eb9.text: 大幻境，製造出幻影漩渦；它的強度由螢幕上的紫色條表示。

12a19219e74041ca231c30adf00704fe74679f7b.source: Mirror Echo, which creates images of herself.
12a19219e74041ca231c30adf00704fe74679f7b.text: 鏡子 迴響，它可以創造她自己的影像。

ee2f8a4f6d0ccc67c3b468aa1299b4545a31d780.source: Mirror of Darkness, which creates copies of party members and allies; these will have exactly the same skill bar as their parent (including any PvE skills of player characters).
ee2f8a4f6d0ccc67c3b468aa1299b4545a31d780.text: 黑暗之鏡，建立黨員和盟友的副本；這些將具有與其父級完全相同的技能欄（包括玩家角色的任何 PvE 技能）。

3ed78e7482c5b683fde6dc131b7b948b960763a3.source: Your goal is to reduce the Grand Illusion bar to zero strength by attacking the real Reiko. During the confrontation, you will be aided by various allies from previous quests while members of the Ministry of Purity will come to her defense.
3ed78e7482c5b683fde6dc131b7b948b960763a3.text: 你的目標是透過攻擊真正的玲子，將大幻象的強度降低到零。在對抗過程中，你將得到先前任務中的各種盟友的幫助，而純潔部的成員將前來保衛她。

305d86eed26c522cd8449fda58353268063b5337.source: You can use any team here that successfully met any of the previous challenges. As long as you can keep the party alive, you will outlast Reiko in a war of attrition. Keep spread out, concentrate on one target at a time, and deal with the ministry foes as they come along.
305d86eed26c522cd8449fda58353268063b5337.text: 您可以在這裡使用任何成功應對之前任何挑戰的團隊。只要你能保住隊伍，你就能在消耗戰中比麗子活得更久。保持分散，一次集中於一個目標，並在事工敵人出現時對付他們。

612d95baa528afa2dfd7fe520fc2c1fda9a309f0.source: Hex Eater Vortex is used frequently by Reiko (and the many "false images" of herself) to strip enchantments and deal massive AoE damage.
612d95baa528afa2dfd7fe520fc2c1fda9a309f0.text: 麗子（以及她自己的許多“假像”）經常使用 食咒渦流 來去除結界並造成大量 範圍性 傷害。

1243ec2c819fa4d071e0bea198650867fa7041bf.source: Conditions are effective. Extend Conditions and Plague Signet can be spammed to spread and manage conditions, such as Burning, Cracked Armor, and Deep Wound; the latter of which triggers Miku's Venom Fang.
1243ec2c819fa4d071e0bea198650867fa7041bf.text: 條件有效。 病症延長 和 疫病紋章 可以透過垃圾郵件來傳播和管理條件，例如燒錄、破解 防禦 和 重傷；後者會觸發 Miku 的毒牙。

af4b29577964ccf068b7866e196f9a522a611095.source: All phantoms and clones are summoned creatures:
af4b29577964ccf068b7866e196f9a522a611095.text: 所有幻影和分身都是召喚生物：

5994536dc397e9cdaa1266e7ec2e79049da0b977.source: Swap can be used to identify the true Reiko. If she is selected, the skill will report her as an invalid target. Use Swap then immediately cancel so it doesn't cast. You will get the notification whether or not you successfully cast it if it is the real Reiko.
5994536dc397e9cdaa1266e7ec2e79049da0b977.text: 交替 可用於識別真正的 Reiko。如果她被選中，該技能會將她報告為無效目標。使用 交替 然後立即取消，這樣它就不會投射。如果是真正的玲子，無論您是否成功施放，您都會收到通知。

d513e129102929c767136a33e2789601ef3d93b1.source: Anti-summon skills are effective. Holy Spear, Spiritual Pain and Consume Soul can be spammed to deliver strong AoE damage, since the false images tend to ball up.
d513e129102929c767136a33e2789601ef3d93b1.text: 反召喚技能有效。神聖的 矛、生靈苦痛 和 靈魂毀滅 可以透過垃圾郵件傳送來造成強烈的 範圍性 損害，因為假影像往往會聚集起來。

b5e47d7963b8a81570a314ca18a3ad0e962a3af8.text: 這裡的幹擾施法者很多：

6baa302231f1d6dbfafe0bfacec4167a3b7bf722.source: Mantra of Resolve and Power Drain on most, if not all, casters. Power Drain serves as both an interrupt and energy management (to counter the penalty from the stance).
6baa302231f1d6dbfafe0bfacec4167a3b7bf722.text: 意志頌歌 和 強力吸收 適用於大多數（如果不是全部）腳輪。 強力吸收 既充當中斷又充當能量管理（以抵消立場的懲罰）。

63de1135c8f38f8afca739104c87900554faf69d.source: There is an opportunity to map the area before and after the dialogue, which permits access to Shing Jea Arena that would normally be accessible during PvP.
63de1135c8f38f8afca739104c87900554faf69d.text: 有機會在對話之前和之後繪製區域地圖，這允許存取通常在 PvP 期間可以存取的 星岬競技場。

b73416269e893b862a934c5d111e7956cacc94f5.source: Elite Ministry Captains and Elite Ministry Zealots have their name swapped during this quest.
b73416269e893b862a934c5d111e7956cacc94f5.text: 精英 部會隊長和 精英 部會狂熱者在此任務中交換了名字。

2cb08839692bb8ebcffcbb29999d29a7ab72dbe4.source: Meet Master Togo outside the monastery in Sunqua Vale.
2cb08839692bb8ebcffcbb29999d29a7ab72dbe4.text: 在 桑泉谷 的修道院外與 藤吾大師 會面。

dc6f634f94ad1540d2b907c38a06d9239d1dbd82.source: Accompany Master Togo to Minister Cho's Estate.
dc6f634f94ad1540d2b907c38a06d9239d1dbd82.text: 陪同 藤吾大師 前往趙部長的莊園。

c93c9d4a4072c1d356a6bd9e77074f1e5bdfb116.source: Speak with Guardsman Zui to gain entrance to the estate.
c93c9d4a4072c1d356a6bd9e77074f1e5bdfb116.text: 與守衛Zui交談以進入莊園。

44a38e9d10456ddd200bd8b6231a3160a8be474e.source: See Guardsman Kayao for your reward.
44a38e9d10456ddd200bd8b6231a3160a8be474e.text: 前往衛兵卡亞那裡領取獎勵。

2fe0634350d4b0da66a1a6833440b2040a9ff937.source: Apprentice Zhi will make explosives that can be used as Improvised Fire Bombs or 90 second-duration Improvised Fire Traps (IFTs). These skills can be obtained approximately every 10 seconds. Once you use one of the two explosive skills your skillbars resets back to normal and each skill must recharge before it can be used again.
2fe0634350d4b0da66a1a6833440b2040a9ff937.text: 學徒Zhi將製作可用作簡易火焰炸彈或90第二持續時間簡易火焰陷阱（IFT）的炸藥。這些技能大約每 10 秒就可獲得一次。一旦您使用了兩種爆炸性技能中的一種，您的技能欄就會重置回正常狀態，並且每種技能都必須重新充電才能再次使用。

9ea40348ec65ab47cf95c1aabcc8ea0419a913f6.source: Take note that should Apprentice Zhi die, she does not resurrect, unlike the Canthan Guards.
9ea40348ec65ab47cf95c1aabcc8ea0419a913f6.text: 請注意，如果芝學徒死了，她不會復活，這與凱珊衛隊不同。

359d2e2d2e54e03e75c7faa27a949e11b22226f8.source: For quick access, you can accept multiple bombs from Zhi, then drop the Improvised Fire Bomb bundle on the ground without using it up.
359d2e2d2e54e03e75c7faa27a949e11b22226f8.text: 為了快速訪問，你可以接受來自Zhi的多枚炸彈，然後將簡易火焰炸彈包扔在地上而不用完。

a4689987f750f0308c26e8cdb4974b3edb8b0d0e.source: You can move the Canthan Guards to better positions. Talk to them once to get them to follow you; speak to them again to get them to remain where they are.
a4689987f750f0308c26e8cdb4974b3edb8b0d0e.text: 您可以將凱珊守衛移動到更好的位置。與他們交談一次，讓他們跟隨你；再次與他們交談，讓他們留在原地。

e1945df4a70677f4c1c0fb6b85567a6ecfddd1bd.source: First, place the guards to make good use of the natural choke points by having them body block the two stairways leading to Mhenlo; make sure these guards are positioned within earshot of a healer NPC. Then, drop as many IFTs as you can along the paths. Spread out any heroes and pop any defensive spirits they might have available before the Tengu arrive. During the battle, you can keep grabbing explosives and tossing them at the balled-up foes.
e1945df4a70677f4c1c0fb6b85567a6ecfddd1bd.text: 首先，放置守衛以充分利用天然的咽喉要道，讓他們用身體擋住通往 涵洛 的兩個樓梯；確保這些守衛位於治療 NPC 的聽力範圍內。然後，沿著路徑放置盡可能多的 IFT。在 天狗 到來之前，分散所有英雄並消滅他們可能擁有的所有防禦精神。在戰鬥中，你可以不斷地抓住炸藥並將其扔向被壓成球狀的敵人。

334800c53db8b26267e412e5149c9084f5c12216.source: An aggressive style of playing is to fight at an archway just west of Mhenlo's location. Aggro incoming mobs to fight your party there, so they don't reach Mhenlo. Should you party wipe, there will be time for your party to get resurrected.
334800c53db8b26267e412e5149c9084f5c12216.text: 一種激進的遊戲風格是在 涵洛 位置西邊的拱門處進行戰鬥。仇恨傳入的小怪來與你的隊伍戰鬥，這樣他們就不會到達 涵洛。如果你的隊伍被消滅，你的隊伍會有時間復活。

787d2e5590292db8d1d2a1dd0492e2c0b23fbcec.source: If you have a minion master, watch out for Mhenlo following your minions around as he tries to keep them healed. In fact, if you flag your team at the Linnok Courtyard gate beyond the portal, both Quin AND Mhenlo will follow the minions there. If you kill your minions, Mhenlo and Quin will stay stationary near the gate, allowing you to more easily deal with the Sensali at your pace.
787d2e5590292db8d1d2a1dd0492e2c0b23fbcec.text: 如果你有一個隨從大師，請留意 涵洛 追蹤你的隨從，因為他試圖讓他們得到治療。事實上，如果您在門戶外的 裡諾庭園 門口標記您的團隊，Quin 和 涵洛 都會跟隨那裡的小兵。如果您殺死了您的小兵，涵洛 和 Quin 將在大門附近保持靜止，讓您可以按照自己的步調更輕鬆地應對 聖沙利天狗。

46e5492ccaffb4fc4ed7ec778fbf66adb8c21af1.source: AoE protection and healing skills (so that your allies benefit), especially Recuperation, Shelter and/or Union.
46e5492ccaffb4fc4ed7ec778fbf66adb8c21af1.text: 範圍性 保護和治療技能（以便您的盟友受益），特別是 復原、庇護 和/或 聯合。

33ca9df21434475386c5744cf2bd8885f8e72b18.source: After using one of the explosive skills or dropping the bundle, all of your skills begin recharging for their normal recharge times.
33ca9df21434475386c5744cf2bd8885f8e72b18.text: 使用其中一項爆炸性技能或掉落捆綁包後，您的所有技能都會開始按正常充電時間充電。

127e3b2cc6b128f8b7af64bd92f7a940e55b777b.source: An Audience with Master Togo for at least one profession other than the primary.
127e3b2cc6b128f8b7af64bd92f7a940e55b777b.text: 除主要職業外至少有一種職業的 藤吾大師 受眾。

0b02326c5fb88cd044237f2377ade6df7285b09d.source: Seek out at least one headmaster and complete that headmaster's training.
0b02326c5fb88cd044237f2377ade6df7285b09d.text: 尋找至少一位校長並完成該校長的培訓。

68c622733b346a03b86c5cd3b762b89a0daf2cae.source: Talk to Master Togo and select which secondary profession you want, then speak with him again for the quest reward if you wish to keep the chosen profession. If you are unsure about whether you wish to keep this secondary profession, you may choose not to take the reward, giving you the chance to choose again if able, though it is unconfirmed whether you can purchase skills from a Skill Trainer at such a stage. This is a rather straightforward quest, though which secondary profession will be best to take will vary on your primary profession or playing style.
68c622733b346a03b86c5cd3b762b89a0daf2cae.text: 與 藤吾大師 交談並選擇你想要的次要職業，如果你想保留所選職業，請再次與他交談以獲得任務獎勵。如果你不確定是否要保留這個次要職業，你可以選擇不接受獎勵，如果可以的話，給你重新選擇的機會，儘管此時是否可以從技能導師購買技能尚未確定。這是一個相當簡單的任務，儘管最適合選擇的次要職業會因你的主要職業或遊戲風格而有所不同。

b1ef4565f65fe474090d289e0a27996282667fb7.source: Despite what Togo claims, further on in the story, you will gain the ability to change secondary profession.
b1ef4565f65fe474090d289e0a27996282667fb7.text: 儘管多哥聲稱，在故事的進一步發展中，你將獲得改變第二職業的能力。

fd44b70ff94628d7f78d7d76e0589fe8ebd8d454.source: After completing this mission, your party ends up in Ran Musu Gardens.
fd44b70ff94628d7f78d7d76e0589fe8ebd8d454.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將進入 嵐穆蘇花園。

00817158ecde3d6a4a0c577d9be6793a66548d84.source: At least one player must participate in the demonstration of how to use the mini-map to continue the mission (i.e. run up to the tree Master Togo is talking about).
00817158ecde3d6a4a0c577d9be6793a66548d84.text: 至少有一位玩家必須參與示範如何使用小地圖來繼續任務（即跑到 藤吾大師 正在討論的樹上）。

36b95f8f6ef851bcf6337b969d225eaefaaa0c32.source: After entering the menagerie area, if you keep to the far right before moving around to the next area, Yijo and Master Togo will get stuck at the end of the walkway; this allows you to continue the mission without them, preventing them from being killed prematurely. They will both catch up with you later when you talk to the Minister.
36b95f8f6ef851bcf6337b969d225eaefaaa0c32.text: 進入動物園區域後，如果在前往下一個區域之前保持最右側，Yijo 和 藤吾大師 會卡在走道的盡頭；這可以讓你在沒有他們的情況下繼續執行任務，防止他們過早被殺死。當您稍後與部長交談時，他們都會來找您。

85e38eb12de97c1453684a8732ea7c13f3874457.source: If the player's character is from either Prophecies or Nightfall, talking to Ang the Ephemeral after completion of this mission will have no effect.
85e38eb12de97c1453684a8732ea7c13f3874457.text: 如果玩家的角色來自 阿斯卡隆戰記 或 黑暗逆襲，則在完成此任務後與短暫的 Ang 交談將無效。

c52da933770610266b43550bbe257f52e00d19f3.source: During one of the tutorials, Master Togo attempts to pull a set of guards away from their post. Since they will not attack until Togo is in range, they can easily be killed without fear of reprisal.
c52da933770610266b43550bbe257f52e00d19f3.text: 在其中一個教程中，藤吾大師 試圖將一群警衛從他們的崗位上拉下來。由於它們只有在多哥進入攻擊範圍後才會發動攻擊，因此它們很容易被殺死，而不必擔心遭到報復。

35997659d51aa5c335663b3642be485659319eea.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #9 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
35997659d51aa5c335663b3642be485659319eea.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#9 頁。

e57b708eda0e051376439a71ddaf6f49054ceccd.source: Although Minister Cho turns into the Diseased Minister at the end of the mission, he leaves behind a human corpse when he dies.
e57b708eda0e051376439a71ddaf6f49054ceccd.text: 儘管趙部長在任務結束時變成了病部長，但他死後留下了一具人類屍體。

a53f17dfabd52d5d0150d1eb687b1764b70488b4.source: It is possible for the Sickened Guards to kill the infected Minister Cho before you have a chance to. Thus, the mission will become impossible to complete and players will have to resign and retry.
a53f17dfabd52d5d0150d1eb687b1764b70488b4.text: 病態守衛有可能在你有機會之前殺死被感染的趙部長。因此，任務將變得不可能完成，玩家將不得不辭職並重試。

b4e1381603c1234f142b8b70bf1243f2a62b6db0.text: de:Chos Anwesen 部長 (主線任務)

be7c27a837dad74c25b7c93812e7b7f80a2e7a5d.source: Travel to Aerie, the Angchu Tengu Village
be7c27a837dad74c25b7c93812e7b7f80a2e7a5d.text: 前往 Aerie，Angchu 天狗 村

b4340177dad0647595f6b9fb6c8f2c98e2336eda.text: 與 光榮之爪 索爾 交談。

9ef492bc6e16158beed5929d28a8364d5c23a9e0.source: Players can find Aerie, the Angchu Village, West of Ran Musu Gardens.
9ef492bc6e16158beed5929d28a8364d5c23a9e0.text: 玩家可以找到 Aerie，即 嵐穆蘇花園 西邊的 Angchu 村。

ef498ab93be0e19a1c7643ab870b33b67f9940ba.source: To reach the village, players should leave the Ran Musu Gardens from the South portal into Kinya Province and then follow the Western road past the North side of the mountain. Following the road as it veers South will lead players straight to the village.
ef498ab93be0e19a1c7643ab870b33b67f9940ba.text: 要到達村莊，玩家應該從南門離開 嵐穆蘇花園 進入 欣彌領地，然後沿著西邊的道路經過山的北側。沿著向南行駛的道路將引導玩家直接到達村莊。

a07f023efc8c66729d2d5a3d9aaba34b774690bf.source: When arriving at the village, players should speak with Soar Honorclaw. She will give instructions for the elimination of an Afflicted Assassin which can be found to the South west of the village. Talon Silverwing will accompany the players.
a07f023efc8c66729d2d5a3d9aaba34b774690bf.text: 到達村莊後，玩家應與 光榮之爪 索爾 交談。她將指示消滅位於村莊西南部的受影響的 暗殺者。利爪銀翼將陪伴玩家。

9452e81266e066c8e2aa8abbc35d2ce0cb04bb5a.source: After speaking with Talon, players should follow the quest arrow and kill the Afflicted Creature. When the Afflicted Creature has been eliminated, players can return to the village and talk to Soar Honorclaw to collect the reward.
9452e81266e066c8e2aa8abbc35d2ce0cb04bb5a.text: 與泰隆交談後，玩家應該按照任務箭頭殺死受折磨的生物。當受影響的生物被消滅後，玩家可以返回村莊並與光榮之爪 索爾對話以領取獎勵。

ee5535427afabeb7cb2291cfe10d957c62ee43ef.source: Talon Silverwing does not appear if you have a festival quest active
ee5535427afabeb7cb2291cfe10d957c62ee43ef.text: 如果您有活躍的節日任務，利爪銀翼不會出現

04e734abc75a4a2b69d20a36abf1360c42d5c4da.source: Travel to Kaitan Village on the Panjiang Peninsula.
04e734abc75a4a2b69d20a36abf1360c42d5c4da.text: 搭乘 班讓半島 前往凱坦村。

4c8f317955ba569b81191b7d31c67802cb67e056.source: Destroy the sickened guards attacking Kaitan Village.
4c8f317955ba569b81191b7d31c67802cb67e056.text: 消滅攻擊凱坦村的生病守衛。

b488381daddbb185c106951370e6d1c5d498338a.source: See Sister Tai for your reward.

788eee52af8fab178deae110e1c85e5aef3b7b25.source: This quest may seem difficult because of the groups of enemies you will be fighting, but it's really quite simple. Make your way to Kaitan Village but stay away from the quest marker to avoid spawning the enemies. Instead, wait on the left side of the NPCs and watch for the group of Canthan Guards to get close to the Kaitan Village sign. Once they are there, move to the NPCs and activate the spawns. The enemies will approach from the southwest. If done correctly, the level 20 Guards will kill the mobs for you and complete the quest.
788eee52af8fab178deae110e1c85e5aef3b7b25.text: 由於你將要與一群敵人作戰，這個任務可能看起來很困難，但實際上非常簡單。前往凱坦村，但遠離任務標記，以避免生成敵人。相反，在 NPC 的左側等待，觀察凱珊守衛隊接近凱坦村的標誌。一旦他們到達那裡，移動到 NPC 並啟動生成點。敵人將從西南方向逼近。如果操作正確，關卡 20 守衛將為您殺死小怪並完成任務。

d4067059e9881c898c3a261d91ac3248ea397efe.source: An easy way to time this (and alleviate boredom) is to couple this mission with Cash Crops. Just avoid the quest marker (after kneeling at the appropriate places for Cash Crops), by circling to it from the south, and approach from the southwest.
d4067059e9881c898c3a261d91ac3248ea397efe.text: 計時（並緩解無聊）的一個簡單方法是將這個任務與經濟作物結合。只需避開任務標記（在跪下獲取經濟作物的適當位置後），從南邊繞到它，然後從西南接近即可。

ec19ce48e36406676c80ae5b2e0b2d7e83a2eb11.source: Head into Sunqua Vale from Shing Jea Monastery and speak to Master Togo. Simply follow Master Togo and Yijo Tahn to Minister Cho's Estate. When you arrive at the estate, speak to Guardsman Zui and a cutscene will begin. After the cutscene, your party will be in Minister Cho's Estate. Speak to Guardsman Kayao for your reward.
ec19ce48e36406676c80ae5b2e0b2d7e83a2eb11.text: 從 星岬寺 進入 桑泉谷 並與 藤吾大師 交談。只需跟隨 藤吾大師 和 Yijo Tahn 即可到達趙部長莊園。當你到達莊園時，與守衛Zui交談，過場動畫就會開始。過場動畫結束後，你們的隊伍將來到趙部長的莊園。與衛兵卡亞交談以獲得獎勵。

bae3dc69ef00312e97cee4b07591447c531fb984.source: Sometimes Master Togo will get stuck on Water Buffalo, and you will need to restart the quest from Shing Jea Monastery. A workaround for this is to activate a point blank area of effect damage skill, such as Ancestors' Rage, while standing next to the buffalo, which causes the buffalo to move. Also, sometimes Master Togo will exhibit extremely faulty scripting, and pause some distance away from the guard, refusing to move further. You will need to restart.
bae3dc69ef00312e97cee4b07591447c531fb984.text: 有時 藤吾大師 會卡在 Water Buffalo，您需要從 星岬寺 重新開始任務。解決此問題的方法是站在水牛旁邊時啟動效果傷害技能的空白區域，例如 先人的盛怒，這會導致水牛移動。此外，有時 藤吾大師 會表現出極為錯誤的指令碼，並在距離守衛一定距離處暫停，拒絕進一步移動。您將需要重新啟動。

0bd55d65314bffe0e40a9ed63580a30cfda65f19.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed A Formal Introduction (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Sunqua Vale will be closed.
0bd55d65314bffe0e40a9ed63580a30cfda65f19.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中包含任何未完成正式介紹的盟與敵角色（不需要接受獎勵），桑泉谷的大門將會關閉。

215b25cc582938bde1bd5b1cc739a266663d5059.source: A Formal Introduction grants access, but any Factions characters without a secondary profession will be left behind in Sunqua Vale.
215b25cc582938bde1bd5b1cc739a266663d5059.text: 正式介紹會授予存取許可權，但任何沒有第二職業的 盟與敵 角色都會留在 桑泉谷 中。

6edc39489079d3d013100056f326ac07a22b58a4.source: Access through Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area) is unavailable because the gate from Kinya Province to Ran Musu Gardens is closed if the party contains any characters that have not completed Minister Cho's Estate.
6edc39489079d3d013100056f326ac07a22b58a4.text: 無法通過趙部長莊園（可探索區域）進入，因為如果隊伍中包含任何尚未完成趙部長莊園的角色，從 欣彌領地 到 嵐穆蘇花園 的大門就會關閉。

352debb8362d6cda8e5da41f896a2bb90eb4e730.source: Master Togo must survive to reach the Minister's Estate.
352debb8362d6cda8e5da41f896a2bb90eb4e730.text: 藤吾大師 必須生存才能到達部長莊園。

42d7814ebb1b2826f207b63a577fed857bd64cd8.source: Yijo Tahn must survive to reach the Minister's Estate.
42d7814ebb1b2826f207b63a577fed857bd64cd8.text: 伊喬·塔恩必須生存才能到達部長官邸。

0ec8e28ca2da617437bea1cb896a7242134ebc0f.source: Non-Factions characters will not receive any reward for completing this mission on normal mode.
0ec8e28ca2da617437bea1cb896a7242134ebc0f.text: 非 盟與敵 角色在正常模式下完成此任務不會獲得任何獎勵。

3ef4773cc559867f0e83b1774f7bbcef719baee0.source: This mission is given in a tutorial style with frequent stops and locked doors where Master Togo explains to the players the fundamentals of combat including calling and attacking of a single target, sticking together as a group, using the mini map, and avoiding battling a large group of enemies by waiting for a patrol to separate from the main group.
3ef4773cc559867f0e83b1774f7bbcef719baee0.text: 任務以教程形式進行，頻繁停靠並鎖門，藤吾大師 向玩家解釋戰鬥的基本原理，包括呼叫和攻擊單一目標、作為一個團隊團結在一起、使用小地圖，以及透過等待巡邏隊與主力部隊分離來避免與一大群敵人作戰。

6fd6f6586c98a1863805d07e9e43682a5ec17ed9.source: In the initial part of the mission, there is only a single path through which players can travel under each newly opened door onto the next tutorial. Once players kill the first boss (warrior), the Afflicted Horror, the tutorial is essentially over and the path becomes more liberal. Players can follow Master Togo from this stage to avoid confusion. Players with low level characters should take care through these areas and try not to aggravate more groups of animals than necessary as well as watch for area of effect spells from the Sickened Scribes. The final fight can be tough for low level characters. Mind in particular the Afflicted Soul Explosion which occurs when the boss dies. Master Togo can sometimes get obstructed by a chest spawn. If this happens before the menagerie area, the only way to continue is to restart the mission and try again.
6fd6f6586c98a1863805d07e9e43682a5ec17ed9.text: 在任務的初始部分，只有一條路徑，玩家可以透過每扇新開啟的門進入下一個教學。一旦玩家殺死了第一個 Boss（戰士），即受折磨的恐怖者，教程就基本上結束了，路徑變得更加自由。玩家可以從此階段開始遵循 藤吾大師 以避免混淆。低等級角色的玩家應該小心這些區域，盡量不要激怒更多的動物群，同時也要注意病態抄寫員的區域法術效果。對於低等級角色來說，最後的戰鬥可能會很艱難。特別要注意 Boss 死亡時發生的痛苦靈魂爆炸。 藤吾大師 有時會被寶箱生成所阻礙。如果這種情況發生在動物園區域之前，唯一繼續的方法就是重新啟動任務並重試。

83ef5c8867b383a53f857570bd37b0eca318a500.source: Hard mode should present little trouble for a balanced party: the Sickened Servants near the end have some area of effect spells, some warriors have knock downs, and a number of foes have Primal Rage or/and Frenzy. There are no hexes and the only condition is burning from Sickened Servant's Star Burst and Sickened Scribe's Spirit Burn.
83ef5c8867b383a53f857570bd37b0eca318a500.text: 困難模式 對於平衡的一方來說應該不會帶來什麼麻煩：接近尾聲的病態僕人有一些區域效果法術，一些戰士有擊倒，並且許多敵人有 盛怒 或/和 狂暴。沒有六角形，唯一的條件是 病變的使者 的 星爆 和 Sickened Scribe 的 生靈燃燒 燃燒。

71ea1b6b3bd42617b3648d4b03a66567aada6740.source: Keeping out of earshot of Yijo and Togo when they walk to/up on the bridge at the end of the menagerie (by keeping to the far left or far right of it) makes them stop on it, which can make the last bit easier by giving a bit of breathing room between encounters.
71ea1b6b3bd42617b3648d4b03a66567aada6740.text: 當 Yijo 和 Togo 走到動物園盡頭的橋上時（透過保持在動物園最左邊或最右邊），不要讓他們聽到他們的聲音，這樣他們就可以在橋上停下來，這樣可以在遭遇之間留出一點喘息的空間，從而讓最後的過程變得更容易。

b40d6ebc0f8ab2a7fc7a77d0e1d7e632d946423c.source: If you walk to the peninsula right after receiving the quest from Soar Honorclaw, you can talk to Tahbo Paa near the map entrance to Panjiang Peninsula, to get the quest The Agriculturist. You also will have higher level henchmen if you walk from Ran Musu Gardens to the peninsula.
b40d6ebc0f8ab2a7fc7a77d0e1d7e632d946423c.text: 如果你在收到光榮之爪 索爾的任務後立即步行前往半島，你可以與班讓半島地圖入口附近的Tahbo Paa交談，以獲取任務「農業家」。如果您從 嵐穆蘇花園 步行到半島，您還將擁有更高等級的追隨者。

08880d28392d25c5d968d4d82cfac128eec9948b.source: Instructor Weng Gha does not participate in combat, even if he is standing within aggro range of the fighting.
08880d28392d25c5d968d4d82cfac128eec9948b.text: 教官翁嘉不參與戰鬥，即使他站在戰鬥的仇恨範圍內。

30ebc51dff99f83f9e8b59e9894f4f61163a649d.source: Meet Master Togo in the Linnok Courtyard.
30ebc51dff99f83f9e8b59e9894f4f61163a649d.text: 在 裡諾庭園 中認識 藤吾大師。

afff00166a577a9083fa031027806aff6030dadb.source: Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and go through the portal to Linnok Courtyard. Speak with Master Togo to collect your quest reward.
afff00166a577a9083fa031027806aff6030dadb.text: 將行程對應到 星岬寺，然後透過入口網站到達 裡諾庭園。與 藤吾大師 交談以領取你的任務獎勵。

ac1216efb4c2c96eda6145eae7a4086699f3c48d.source: Speak with Guard Tsukaro about traveling to Seitung Harbor.
ac1216efb4c2c96eda6145eae7a4086699f3c48d.text: 與守衛塚郎討論前往 青函港 的事宜。

860207783ed6549ca053fca03287fae8d0632bc3.source: Travel to Seitung Harbor with Brother Pe Wan.
860207783ed6549ca053fca03287fae8d0632bc3.text: 與 Pe Wan 弟兄一起前往 青函港。

61c36ea5ca57d78eac2776a43a6b74c11098126e.source: Speak with Brother Pe Wan once you have traveled to Seitung Harbor.
61c36ea5ca57d78eac2776a43a6b74c11098126e.text: 前往 青函港 後與 Pe Wan 弟兄交談。

d28c7927503436c64216a2c50ba7e3f06a28723c.source: Begin the quest in Linnok Courtyard by speaking to Guard Tsukaro. He will transport you to Saoshang Trail. Following the path will lead you directly to Seitung Harbor. Brother Pe Wan will also lead the way. Stick close to him for extra healing.
d28c7927503436c64216a2c50ba7e3f06a28723c.text: 透過與警衛塚郎交談來開始 裡諾庭園 中的任務。他將帶您前往 紹商小徑。遵循該路徑將直接引導您前往 青函港。佩萬弟兄也將帶路。靠近他以獲得額外的治療效果。

20cc424d90100985cc7dd23a4a6ede1e1419410b.source: Only about half of the enemies are visible when first entering; the rest are popup monsters. It is best to stay together to prevent a mass aggro.
20cc424d90100985cc7dd23a4a6ede1e1419410b.text: 第一次進入時，只有大約一半的敵人是可見的；其餘的都是彈出怪物。最好呆在一起以防止大規模仇恨。

5c48e793fde12313890860999a4aaf4bdf60be0d.source: Upon reaching Seitung Harbor, speak with Brother Pe Wan for your reward.
5c48e793fde12313890860999a4aaf4bdf60be0d.text: 到達 青函港 後，與 Pe Wan 弟兄交談以獲得獎勵。

3c8876bd925de56e90651ae9f954d26aaf7bdd4d.source: If you kill all mantids and get close to Seitung Harbor before talking to Brother Pe Wan he won't follow you. And if he gets ahead of you, and ends up getting killed, don't worry about it. You can still contact him in Seitung Harbor.
3c8876bd925de56e90651ae9f954d26aaf7bdd4d.text: 如果你在與 Pe Wan 兄弟交談之前殺死所有螳螂並接近 青函港，他就不會跟著你。如果他領先你並最終被殺，請不要擔心。您仍然可以在 青函港 中聯絡他。

1d3ee2b876f2b8732c20338ac0510aa6d3b96075.source: Only Canthan characters can be in the party while completing this quest.
1d3ee2b876f2b8732c20338ac0510aa6d3b96075.text: 完成此任務時，只有凱珊角色可以在隊伍中。

bd9a3e317a7cea773b4ede15774dc479009bd48d.source: Depending on how far back you stay, Brother Pe Wan may get killed, and yet when you enter Seitung Harbor, he is there waiting for you.
bd9a3e317a7cea773b4ede15774dc479009bd48d.text: 根據你停留的距離，佩萬弟兄可能會被殺，但當你進入 青函港 時，他就在那裡等你。

0bef242396b7a86dbeb07fefa05874fa2a7d216f.source: Find Zho, Talon Silverwing, Panaku, and Lo Sha in Jaya Bluffs.
0bef242396b7a86dbeb07fefa05874fa2a7d216f.text: 在 蛇野斷崖 中尋找 若、Talon Silverwing、Panaku 和 羅夏。

fca27755882874d4dab8f777dfeebb7e76f55e33.source: Destroy the plague creatures that have overrun the monastery.
fca27755882874d4dab8f777dfeebb7e76f55e33.text: 消滅佔領修道院的瘟疫生物。

b72ab41a770b209e78768c37bf631ef7839f8a4f.source: Head out into Jaya Bluffs and go northwest, fighting hostile Tengu along the way. When you reach Zho and company, there will be three groups of Afflicted in a small monastery, the Sizhou Hall on a tall island. Eliminate them and claim your reward.
b72ab41a770b209e78768c37bf631ef7839f8a4f.text: 前往 蛇野斷崖 並向西北方向前進，沿途與敵對的 天狗 戰鬥。當你到達若和你的同伴時，在一座高島上的四洲堂的小修道院裡，會出現三群受折磨者。消滅他們並領取你的獎勵。

e91f75d1f4cb4f132f8cb11e01cf9a2f0854b302.source: If you avoid the Sizhou Hall after Zho, Talon Silverwing, Panaku, and Lo Sha have joined your party as allies, you can bring them along with you to kill Jaya Bluffs foes that are not in Sizhou Hall.
e91f75d1f4cb4f132f8cb11e01cf9a2f0854b302.text: 如果您在 若、Talon Silverwing、Panaku 和 羅夏 作為盟友加入您的隊伍後避開了泗州大廳，您可以帶著他們一起殺死不在泗州大廳的 蛇野斷崖 敵人。

968a23ee90be171b5b4e0696fbc40a6358ca00fd.source: After clearing Sizhou Hall, Zho says ", come over here and speak with me" for the reward dialogue, even when this quest is active on another party member and not the leader. The reward dialogue will only appear for the member(s) who has/have this quest active.
968a23ee90be171b5b4e0696fbc40a6358ca00fd.text: 清理泗州大廳後，若 會在獎勵對話中說“過來這裡和我說話”，即使這個任務對另一位黨員而不是領導者有效。獎勵對話方塊只會出現在啟動此任務的成員身上。

6d69d0d49d6e7a6f3e76e6fafa3719292de936aa.source: Find Su, Sister Tai, Kai Ying, and Professor Gai in Linkei Township in Haiju Lagoon.
6d69d0d49d6e7a6f3e76e6fafa3719292de936aa.text: 在 海幽潟湖 的林溪鎮找到蘇、泰姐、凱英 和蓋教授。

8074f190a0e3ac89434dce1a3a0b36b324d0fb61.source: Defend Linkei Township from the Afflicted creatures.
8074f190a0e3ac89434dce1a3a0b36b324d0fb61.text: 保衛林溪鎮免受受苦生物的侵害。

92d6daae6de534c6da1994f9f3388b5518bdd792.source: Once you meet up with the four NPCs (Su, Sister Tai, Professor Gai, and Kai Ying) at the Linkei Township, you will be attacked by Sickened Guards and Afflicted from both sides after a short dialogue sequence. Although Professor Gai and Kai Ying will only attack with their staves, Sister Tai will heal your party with Orison of Healing and Su will cast Life Siphon on enemies. You will want to stay by these four throughout the quest to make sure you capitalize on their assistance; if any die, they cannot be resurrected. If Su dies you will be unable to claim the reward and will have to rezone to claim the reward and acquire To Zen Daijun.
92d6daae6de534c6da1994f9f3388b5518bdd792.text: 一旦你在林溪鎮遇到四個 NPC（蘇、泰姐、蓋教授和 凱英），在簡短的對話序列後，你將受到來自雙方的病態守衛和痛苦者的攻擊。雖然蓋教授和凱英只會用法杖攻擊，但泰姐會用治癒祈禱治癒你的隊伍，而蘇會對敵人施放吸取生命。在整個任務過程中，你需要和這四個人待在一起，以確保你能利用他們的幫助；如果有人死了，他們就無法復活。如果 Su 死亡，您將無法領取獎勵，並且必須重新分割槽才能領取獎勵並獲得“To 禎臺郡”。

503b156469c12ccf7fcd7fd024a5869b025dd204.source: There are two methods to beating this quest. The first is to have your entire party sit by the four NPCs, and simply wait for the Afflicted to come to you; this can lead to chaotic battles that can become overwhelming. The other method is to take a more liberal approach, by moving your team away from the NPCs and take out the foes before they reach your colleagues; this method reduces the chaos of the battle, but requires that you keep a constant eye on your allies, lest they become overwhelmed (especially when the afflicted boss arrives). Both methods are well served by placing spirits (e.g. Pain or Favorable Winds) and traps in various locations.
503b156469c12ccf7fcd7fd024a5869b025dd204.text: 有兩種方法可以完成這個任務。第一種是讓你的隊伍坐在四個NPC旁邊，等待受折磨者來找你；這可能會導致混亂的戰鬥，甚至變得勢不可擋。另一種方法是採取更自由的方法，讓你的團隊遠離 NPC，並在敵人到達你的同事之前消滅他們；這種方法減少了戰鬥的混亂，但要求你時刻關注你的盟友，以免他們被淹沒（特別是當受影響的老闆到來時）。透過將烈酒（例如 苦痛 或 順風）和陷阱放置在不同位置，這兩種方法都可以很好地發揮作用。

b38922f55c6d5b3783e160d4c43b4dc41b6d9738.source: Once you complete this quest, the four NPCs will follow you until you complete To Zen Daijun. So if you do this quest first, it will make the other quests in Haiju Lagoon much easier, as the NPCs will continue to help your party.
b38922f55c6d5b3783e160d4c43b4dc41b6d9738.text: 完成此任務後，四個 NPC 將跟隨您，直到您完成 To 禎臺郡。因此，如果您先完成此任務，海幽潟湖 中的其他任務就會變得更加容易，因為 NPC 將繼續幫助您的隊伍。

1da7428bdee589e47e0ca50b031e1a401b2906a9.source: Occasionally, some groups of Afflicted will become stuck while walking to the fight, specifically on the bridge to the west. If the quest fails to update, and Su does not respond with the completion dialogue, check that you have killed all Afflicted mobs in the area.
1da7428bdee589e47e0ca50b031e1a401b2906a9.text: 有時，一些受折磨者群體在前往戰鬥地點時會被卡住，特別是在西邊的橋上。如果任務更新失敗，且 Su 沒有回應完成對話方塊，請檢查您是否已殺死該區域中的所有受影響的生物。

88946b01521a822adcd4c44ee6778b74207f0506.source: After defeating all attackers, Su says "Hey, ! Come over here. I need to talk to you" for the reward dialogue, even when this quest is active on another party member and not the leader. The reward dialogue will only appear for the member(s) who has/have this quest active.
88946b01521a822adcd4c44ee6778b74207f0506.text: 擊敗所有攻擊者後，蘇會在獎勵對話中說“嘿，！到這裡來。我需要和你談談”，即使這個任務對另一個黨員而不是領導者有效。獎勵對話方塊只會出現在啟動此任務的成員身上。

dafc6d300f280fd66a6e49200f91bb059116ae7b.source: The Quest Log displays "Zho (Haiju Lagoon)" even though she gives this quest in Jaya Bluffs and she never spawns in Haiju Lagoon.
dafc6d300f280fd66a6e49200f91bb059116ae7b.text: 任務 日誌顯示“若 (海幽潟湖)”，即使她在 蛇野斷崖 中給了此任務並且她從未在 海幽潟湖 中產生。

ec173fc84cb583ffe16492b9a0b23f0652edc285.source: Travel with Su, Professor Gai, Sister Tai, and Kai Ying to the gates of Zen Daijun.
ec173fc84cb583ffe16492b9a0b23f0652edc285.text: 與蘇、蓋教授、泰姐和 凱英 一起前往 禎臺郡 的大門。

b18760848af768d05ba9d9f93b6ab1cbfa46c473.source: Speak with Master Togo at the gates of Zen Daijun.
b18760848af768d05ba9d9f93b6ab1cbfa46c473.text: 在 禎臺郡 門口與 藤吾大師 交談。

bf3492be64ec6f059b1775041da83aced6939c85.source: See Brother Hanjui for your reward.

63efe1a35cda37d6579a6d59f49d4e7f3681acb4.source: This quest should actually be quite easy. The map to the upper right shows the path you will take. Normally you only encounter 3 groups of 3-4 afflicted (level 12-15) each. Because you are helped by Su, Professor Gai, Sister Tai, and Kai Ying, killing these afflicted should not be a problem. For this reason, you should consider doing any of the area's secondary quests before completing this quest; they will also be much easier due to your larger party. Be cautious though, as Su must be alive when you finally reach Master Togo, or you will not be allowed into the next outpost (if there's a problem, Su is often the first of the four to die).
63efe1a35cda37d6579a6d59f49d4e7f3681acb4.text: 這個任務其實應該很容易。右上角的地圖顯示了您將要走的路徑。通常，您只會遇到 3-4 受影響的 3 群組（等級 12-15）。因為有蘇、蓋教授、泰姐、凱英的幫助，殺死這些受折磨的人應該不成問題。因此，您應該在完成此任務之前考慮執行該區域的任何次要任務；由於您的聚會規模更大，他們也會更容易。不過要小心，因為當你最終到達 藤吾大師 時，Su 必須還活著，否則你將不會被允許進入下一個前哨站（如果出現問題，Su 通常是四個人中第一個死的）。

962e2ae04f546ce6d56914e6f3149af7c9601a19.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed To Zen Daijun (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Haiju Lagoon will be closed.
962e2ae04f546ce6d56914e6f3149af7c9601a19.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中包含任何未完成至禎臺郡的盟與敵角色（不需要接受獎勵），則來自海幽潟湖的大門將會關閉。

ab440b3ecd33b4eda0caa9841b93a8cba88e04b7.text: 禎臺郡 授予存取許可權。

b4542ad8da921d8bfe13ef8333da11c877d8322f.source: Access through Zen Daijun (explorable area) is unavailable because Guard Lae Fao will not grant access if the party contains any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun.
b4542ad8da921d8bfe13ef8333da11c877d8322f.text: 透過 禎臺郡（可探索區域）的存取不可用，因為如果隊伍中包含任何未完成 禎臺郡 的角色，Guard Lae Fao 將不會授予存取許可權。

8c1fc674f8b81585a9594d6039d6ec6b3c5849e1.source: Find the source of the plague.

5037d6f7ce859e90929513270f86fd0d4a0c6a80.text: 新增：殺死受影響的伊喬。

1cc4c7193c664b5027c51d1d04cf4927bdb8d06a.source: ADDED: Kill Afflicted Farmer Xeng Jo.
1cc4c7193c664b5027c51d1d04cf4927bdb8d06a.text: 新增：殺死受折磨的農民Xeng Jo。

17e6b4aebbf73ebe9988e7b405ee785b26a15b0e.text: 新增：殺死受影響的假名。

0b062beafd4f80ee7be83173037d28677dbcd960.source: Speed boosts (e.g. "Fall Back!") are helpful for two reasons: the mission is timed and often party members will find themselves running from one fight to another.
0b062beafd4f80ee7be83173037d28677dbcd960.text: 速度提升（例如「後退！」）之所以有用，有兩個原因：任務是定時的，並且隊員經常會發現自己從一場戰鬥跑到另一場戰鬥。

d7106fdc4f1b992c9092dad80ccc566b1a09ce40.source: Afflicted Ritualists can slow progress, especially in hard mode since they are potent healers who can resurrect their allies. Bring shutdowns or other anti-caster skills.
d7106fdc4f1b992c9092dad80ccc566b1a09ce40.text: 受折磨的儀式主義者會減慢進度，尤其是在困難模式下，因為他們是強大的治療者，可以復活盟友。帶上關機或其他反施法者技能。

9f41d5ea703c72011031221c11eeb85cc82ea67d.source: If entering from Local Quarter, consider not bringing Signet of Spirits, since Chiyo of the Foreign Quarter party (if no player-Foreign Quarter party joins) uses it.
9f41d5ea703c72011031221c11eeb85cc82ea67d.text: 如果從本地區進入，請考慮不要帶縛靈紋章，因為外國區隊伍的Chiyo（如果沒有玩家外國區隊伍加入）使用它。

83847ea6d50e4b9b71917057970918b8915e0c9e.source: Enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to enchantment removal by Afflicted Necromancers and Mesmers. Afflicted that deal physical damage can also remove enchantments when enchanted with Afflicted Necromancer's Order of Apostasy.
83847ea6d50e4b9b71917057970918b8915e0c9e.text: 基於 加持魔法 的建構很容易被受折磨的死靈法師和催眠師移除結界。當受災者 死靈法師 的 背叛命令 附魔時，造成物理傷害的受災者也可以移除結界。

1e9be1c982f5765a48f22a1265f2eb29a712aacc.source: When a boss is killed, the subsequent Morale Boost is only awarded to the party that inflicted the killing blow.
1e9be1c982f5765a48f22a1265f2eb29a712aacc.text: 當頭目被殺死時，隨後計程車氣提升只會獎勵給造成致命一擊的一方。

a1fa3efcabb237e0583206e56bc88db97a261e75.source: You will have to fight some of the Canthan civilians, who have been infected by the plague. On dying, they will spawn an Afflicted creature; such spawned Afflicted, while technically hostile to the party, will not attack you and will generally try to flee. However, you'll usually end up killing them anyway as any NPCs in your party will attack them.
a1fa3efcabb237e0583206e56bc88db97a261e75.text: 你將不得不與一些被瘟疫感染的凱珊平民戰鬥。死亡時，他們會生成一個受折磨的生物；這些產生的受折磨者雖然在技術上對隊伍懷有敵意，但不會攻擊你，並且通常會嘗試逃跑。然而，無論如何你通常都會殺死他們，因為你隊伍中的任何 NPC 都會攻擊他們。

3c726690a94bfa03c107e256669f0213a42c228b.source: The death that occurs during the end cinematic does not halt progress of the Survivor title track.
3c726690a94bfa03c107e256669f0213a42c228b.text: 片尾動畫中發生的死亡並沒有阻止 生存者 主打歌的進展。

e29f15bbfd09f422bc80423e8ffa72a18da3a006.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #1 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
e29f15bbfd09f422bc80423e8ffa72a18da3a006.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#1 頁。

cffdee1d8bbeabc0f6e8572d080ed5c0e148fdc8.source: On completion of this mission, your party will appear in Dragon's Throat.
cffdee1d8bbeabc0f6e8572d080ed5c0e148fdc8.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將出現在 龍喉 (挑戰任務) 中。

7cab7c16c08de342458cf689d602943cc9291ec1.source: A large chunk of the inaccessible southeast corner can be explored for Canthan Cartographer by viewing the mission cinematic. (Talk to Guardsman Chow in the Foreign Quarter to replay it.)
7cab7c16c08de342458cf689d602943cc9291ec1.text: 透過觀看任務動畫，可以探索 Canthan 版圖 難以到達的東南角的一大片區域。 （與外國區的衛兵週交談重播。）

c15c42e8c8455fccf55bda8ad68e264fa6a1c5a5.source: It is possible for Togo to die before you reach him the first time, thus failing the mission.
c15c42e8c8455fccf55bda8ad68e264fa6a1c5a5.text: 多哥有可能在你第一次到達他之前就死了，導致任務失敗。

ef6e588b05916bb030dfb0aad04c51f322541005.source: The Foreign Quarter party need only defeat the first four Am Fah at the start of the mission, and then simply wait and leave Mhenlo to run his scripted path to reach Master Togo alone. All of the other foes on the route are popups and are not triggered by Mhenlo. When he walks to the bottom, the cinematic teleports the Foreign Quarter party down into the square.
ef6e588b05916bb030dfb0aad04c51f322541005.text: 外國區隊伍只需在任務開始時擊敗前四個 安費，然後只需等待並離開 涵洛 執行他的指令碼路徑即可單獨到達 藤吾大師。路線上的所有其他敵人都是彈出視窗，不會被 涵洛 觸發。當他走到底部時，電影將外國區的隊伍傳送到廣場上。

b9bf74e31a882d9e0cfdd9694c102fe430e0d4fe.source: Some Afflicted may spawn without weapons.
b9bf74e31a882d9e0cfdd9694c102fe430e0d4fe.text: 一些受影響者可能會在沒有武器的情況下生成。

be87aa5f2c2782b90ba7d4d293459fde896d17a4.source: This mission highlights many deficiencies in the NPC pathfinding AI:
be87aa5f2c2782b90ba7d4d293459fde896d17a4.text: 該任務凸顯了 NPC 尋路 AI 的許多缺陷：

f1b8aedd14287d079225dceab1d617d982b2fcfc.source: It is possible for a henchman-only party to get stuck behind a chest, forcing you to either restart the mission or continue alone. If the henchman party is starting from the Foreign Quarter, this can happen before they reach the first meeting point. It is possible for Togo or Mhenlo to get stuck in the same way.
f1b8aedd14287d079225dceab1d617d982b2fcfc.text: 只有追隨者的隊伍可能會被困在箱子後面，迫使你要麼重新開始任務，要麼獨自繼續。如果追隨者隊伍從外國區出發，這可能會在他們到達第一個集合點之前發生。 Togo 或 涵洛 也有可能陷入同樣的困境。

fc8739149abef42ab94df9da8c80c0ee177cb1ef.source: It is possible for Togo to just get stuck for no reason, which causes the last fight to fail to initialize, making the final battle of the mission impossible to complete.
fc8739149abef42ab94df9da8c80c0ee177cb1ef.text: 多哥有可能無緣無故卡住，導致最後一場戰鬥無法初始化，導致任務最後一戰無法完成。

5a5b869f0f0da9f159123244a6c95548b2483b05.source: If you bring minions, Mhenlo can get distracted in healing them, causing him not to reach his waypoints. A sign that this has happened is Togo standing still some distance behind the party. If this happens, try moving back towards Togo; when Mhenlo gets close enough, the missed waypoint will trigger and Togo will start moving again.
5a5b869f0f0da9f159123244a6c95548b2483b05.text: 如果你帶了小兵，涵洛 可能會在治療他們時分心，導致他無法到達路徑點。發生這種情況的一個跡像是多哥站在隊伍後面一段距離。如果發生這種情況，請嘗試返回多哥；當 涵洛 足夠接近時，錯過的航路點將觸發，多哥將再次開始移動。

aa62d43a4b6ea5bdccae0706a69be25d9acb2b8a.source: If your party has a monk maintaining Unyielding Aura, Shiro won't wipe the whole party. If the party leader is resurrected by this means, they will not appear in the proper place for the cinematics.
aa62d43a4b6ea5bdccae0706a69be25d9acb2b8a.text: 如果你的隊伍中有一個武士維護 堅毅靈氣，Shiro 不會消滅整個隊伍。如果黨魁透過這種方式復活，他們將不會出現在過場動畫的正確位置。

0737be41ae3f639be5954310f6a3fab91340a640.source: Speak to Mhenlo and Togo about how to find the Oracle of the Mists.
0737be41ae3f639be5954310f6a3fab91340a640.text: 與 涵洛 和多哥交談，瞭解如何找到迷霧神諭。

2d358086dc6c734dc2a81ca06d3d657758642acd.source: Seek out Nika in Bukdek Byway.
2d358086dc6c734dc2a81ca06d3d657758642acd.text: 在 巴德克小徑 中尋找 Nika。

0829e211453eaa096de7a0c9cb4e9f79f9a55bbf.source: The goal of this mission is to reach Zen Daijun temple to find the source of the plague and extinguish it. Master Togo and Headmaster Vhang will help you through as allies and Master Togo must survive or the mission will fail. Follow Master Togo a short walk and you will see Miasma (purplish glowing air), an environmental effect that spreads between creatures of the same kind and cause -5 health degeneration. To counter this hazard, summon Zunraa (the guardian of this valley) by ringing the bell at any Shrine of Zunraa (wiki map: blue dots) found through the area. This ally can be called again if he is slain (but you can only have one at a time) and possesses the skill Blessing of the Kirin, used to cure your team of Miasma. Always pull enemies away from the Miasma to fight them or rush through it and fight on the other side. Avoid engaging two groups at the same time, never let them outnumber you.
0829e211453eaa096de7a0c9cb4e9f79f9a55bbf.text: 任務的目標是到達 禎臺郡 神廟，找到瘟疫的源頭並消滅它。 藤吾大師 和 Vhang 校長將作為盟友幫助您度過難關，藤吾大師 必須生存，否則任務就會失敗。沿著 藤吾大師 走一小段路，您會看到瘴氣（紫色發光的空氣），這是一種在同類生物之間傳播並導致 -5 健康退化的環境效應。為了應對這種危險，請在該地區發現的任何 Zunraa 神殿（維基地圖：藍點）敲響鐘聲，召喚 Zunraa（山谷的守護者）。如果該盟友被殺死，則可以再次召喚他（但一次只能擁有一個），並且擁有麒麟的 祝福 技能，用於治癒你團隊的瘴氣。始終將敵人從瘴氣中拉開來與他們戰鬥，或衝過瘴氣並在另一邊戰鬥。避免同時與兩個群體交戰，永遠不要讓他們的數量超過你。

696f21f435d1d859ceabe5c5f6dab8ff24965108.source: After traveling a short distance you will reach a small shrine with a large Afflicted group, including The Afflicted Xai. The path splits here: to reach the temple, either travel south through the caves (wiki map: yellow path) or north past the waterfall (wiki map: red path).
696f21f435d1d859ceabe5c5f6dab8ff24965108.text: 行駛一小段距離後，您將到達一座小神殿，裡面有一大群受折磨的人，其中包括受折磨的賽伊。路徑在這裡分開：要到達寺廟，要麼向南穿過洞穴（維基地圖：黃色路徑），要麼向北穿過瀑布（維基地圖：紅色路徑）。

ca2662c15f5128973504ae5637fbe2047e036a17.source: Once at the entrance to the temple (bridge with two dragon statues), defeat both Afflicted Farmer Xeng Jo and Afflicted Yijo. After killing these two bosses, eliminate the remaining Afflicted inside the temple to finish the mission. Lure enemies outside if possible to gain more space and avoid AoE damage.
ca2662c15f5128973504ae5637fbe2047e036a17.text: 到達寺廟入口處（有兩條龍雕像的橋）後，擊敗受苦的農民 Xeng Jo 和受苦的 Yijo。殺死這兩個頭目後，消滅神廟內剩餘的受折磨者即可完成任務。如果可能的話，將敵人引誘到外面以獲得更多空間並避免 範圍性 傷害。

7c9fe4df604dfa79c0a1156d5a3d2b3bdfc82c23.source: Interrupting Yijo's Spirit Rift or careful usage of skills such as Protective Spirit can prove crucial to prevent mission failure.
7c9fe4df604dfa79c0a1156d5a3d2b3bdfc82c23.text: 打斷 Yijo 的 生靈裂縫 或謹慎使用 精神守護 等技能對於防止任務失敗至關重要。

83a0b545d5569a9c01faf8a84a7066728b2731b8.source: You can leave Master Togo behind after he stops at the first pocket of Miasma, he will stay there and wait for a party member to go near him to trigger his first intermediate dialogue. Avoid the main path and go northwest, which will prevent your party from going near him. Be sure to clear enemies in the area or they might kill Togo after your party leaves him.
83a0b545d5569a9c01faf8a84a7066728b2731b8.text: 當 藤吾大師 停在瘴氣的第一個口袋時，你可以將他留在後面，他會留在那裡等待隊友靠近他以觸發他的第一個中間對話。避開主幹道並向西北走，這將阻止你的隊伍靠近他。一定要清除該地區的敵人，否則他們可能會在你的隊伍離開多哥後殺死他。

6330d1f9091bde8bd589cce291fdc563f880d48f.source: A minion master to increase the size of your team and form meat shields to reduce incoming damage.
6330d1f9091bde8bd589cce291fdc563f880d48f.text: 一個小兵大師可以增加你的團隊規模，型態 肉盾可以減少傳入的傷害。

b5d272fcff5f144bdbb14f49d20bd719573354f3.source: Afflicted Elementalists can do huge AoE damage, but pulling a group by hitting its Elementalist with Pain Inverter can instantly neutralize the threat.
b5d272fcff5f144bdbb14f49d20bd719573354f3.text: 受影響的元素主義者可以造成巨大的 範圍性 傷害，但使用 苦痛 逆變器擊中 元素使 來拉動團隊可以立即消除威脅。

ccd05eda5885161e81888264e56a6e5a0f11ab36.source: Entire party can be set on fire often throughout the mission; Extinguish (with some investment into Protection Prayers) or Breath of the Great Dwarf can be very helpful.
ccd05eda5885161e81888264e56a6e5a0f11ab36.text: 在整個任務過程中，整個隊伍經常會被點燃； 熄滅（對 防護祈禱 進行一些投資）或 偉大矮人 的呼吸可能非常有幫助。

d63b3766b937360ca902dfe0d0c332dbc2799982.source: Skills that benefit from Cracked Armor synergize well with Master Togo's Spirit Rift.
d63b3766b937360ca902dfe0d0c332dbc2799982.text: 受益於 Cracked 防禦 的技能與 藤吾大師 的 生靈裂縫 可以很好地協同作用。

f7f3427d1e422b6b4835a2c2ca6edc0c0169cdf2.source: Interrupts can prevent Yijo's Spirit Rift.
f7f3427d1e422b6b4835a2c2ca6edc0c0169cdf2.text: 中斷可以阻止 Yijo 的 生靈裂縫。

28dbc4e855556a31932fd976885ed5bab25452e4.source: In hard mode, enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to enchantment removal by Afflicted Necromancers and Mesmers. Afflicted that deal physical damage can also remove enchantments when enchanted with Afflicted Necromancer's Order of Apostasy.
28dbc4e855556a31932fd976885ed5bab25452e4.text: 在困難模式下，基於結界的建構很容易被受苦的死靈法師和催眠師移除結界。當受災者 死靈法師 的 背叛命令 附魔時，造成物理傷害的受災者也可以移除結界。

853a53eb0a1b250bdc74d168935bee18d85eccc8.source: This mission is required for non-Factions characters in order to be able to enter Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), but does not allow such characters to enter on their own. They need to join a Factions character who is doing Mayhem in the Market.
853a53eb0a1b250bdc74d168935bee18d85eccc8.text: 非 盟與敵 角色需要執行此任務才能進入 薇茹廣場（本地區域），但不允許此類角色自行進入。他們需要加入在市場上進行混亂的 盟與敵 角色。

01c9addc75a1e8ce80d58451c339ed08c32ffe61.source: Completion of this mission in Hard Mode will fill in page #10 of the Young Heroes of Tyria storybook.
01c9addc75a1e8ce80d58451c339ed08c32ffe61.text: 在困難模式下完成此任務將填入 泰瑞亞 故事書的青少年英雄的#10 頁。

f43d674706012034b03f49ec13eac9a06807e7b3.source: Speak with Headmaster Greico on the Kaineng Docks.
f43d674706012034b03f49ec13eac9a06807e7b3.text: 在 凱寧船塢 上與 Greico 校長交談。

f291b3711d4b1bb1aa52b1d94959c27177f0fd5a.source: Find Master Togo in Wajjun Bazaar.
f291b3711d4b1bb1aa52b1d94959c27177f0fd5a.text: 在 瓦江市場 中找到 藤吾大師。

ce72a18432593a533f778c143aa5504c5071eacc.source: Find Yijo's mother, Jia, in Wajjun Bazaar. Inform her of her son's demise.
ce72a18432593a533f778c143aa5504c5071eacc.text: 在 瓦江市場 中找出 Yijo 的母親賈。通知她她兒子的死訊。

fe33654f9dd72b0b3fed4eb97876c2f8de22fa6b.source: See Headmaster Greico for your reward.
fe33654f9dd72b0b3fed4eb97876c2f8de22fa6b.text: 去找格雷科校長領取獎勵。

4635a1e676f91f9de1fe783ac52e919e9be9fc95.source: Speak with First Mate Xiang to arrange travel to Kaineng Docks. As soon as you arrive, speak with Headmaster Greico and enter The Marketplace, where you can increase your party size to 8. Exit to Wajjun Bazaar and follow the map to Master Togo. As always, move slowly enough to avoid over-aggroing.
4635a1e676f91f9de1fe783ac52e919e9be9fc95.text: 與向大副交談，安排前往 凱寧船塢 的行程。當您到達後，請與校長 Greico 交談並進入 市集，您可以在其中將隊伍規模增加到 8。退出至 瓦江市場，然後依照地圖前往 藤吾大師。一如既往，動作要夠慢，以避免過度攻擊。

b0c791f2608ea24e7157249dd69f785befaa440c.source: After speaking with Togo, turn around and follow the map to Jia (if you encounter Am Fah along the way, take out their healers first). Map back to The Marketplace and return to the docks to accept the quest reward from Greico.
b0c791f2608ea24e7157249dd69f785befaa440c.text: 與多哥對話後，轉身依照地圖前往賈（途中遇到安費，先解決他們的治療者）。映射回 市集 並返回碼頭接受 Greico 的任務獎勵。

5ddc51014c6a44f60ae9b9aac264c47ff09f1b59.source: To reduce the number of Am Fah you have to fight, you can start Seek out Brother Tosai; these foes will remain neutral until you complete Drink from the Chalice of Corruption or take Refuse to Drink.
5ddc51014c6a44f60ae9b9aac264c47ff09f1b59.text: 為了減少你必須戰鬥的安費的數量，你可以開始尋找東齋兄弟；這些敵人將保持中立，直到您完成「從腐敗聖杯中喝水」或採取「拒絕飲酒」。

06e629a9709beec9bac0d6eb2279c2a742df788e.text: 在 瓦江市場 中找到 Kisai。

422e333e756e23c665a8dbbe8dc9f4ed1ef98e5d.source: Locate Aeson in the Market and speak with him.
422e333e756e23c665a8dbbe8dc9f4ed1ef98e5d.text: 在市場上找到 Aeson 並與他交談。

68ebc577663395c95a95bf44b65d95bbfcfc4398.source: Find Yuun and speak with him.
68ebc577663395c95a95bf44b65d95bbfcfc4398.text: 找到 Yuun 並與他交談。

db1e5976884cfb749113417fec989a17c9607383.source: Find Lukas and speak with him.
db1e5976884cfb749113417fec989a17c9607383.text: 找到盧卡斯並與他交談。

60d86592df306c8f9f4aff6e200e109dcec0b6f3.source: Locate and speak with Jinzo and Master Togo in the sewers.
60d86592df306c8f9f4aff6e200e109dcec0b6f3.text: 在下水道中找到 Jinzo 和 藤吾大師 並與其交談。

26cc0cfbb5c0e4d5f3772f891d552a946e7c4a07.source: Find out what Master Togo learned at the palace. Give him your information.
26cc0cfbb5c0e4d5f3772f891d552a946e7c4a07.text: 瞭解 藤吾大師 在宮殿中學到了什麼。把你的訊息給他。

d73455deacdb9502200b0e2b70af509082dc44e0.source: See Guardsman Pei for your reward.

38c9d29d7cf85c66549eb92ff5de652752df22a4.source: Follow the quest marker on the compass; there are no additional enemies from the quest.
