However, the Undercity can be difficult for players new to high level areas. Make sure to bring plenty of defensive skills. High-leveled Afflicted patrol the areas, along with Am Fah popups. Some might find it easier to enter the Undercity from Bukdek Byway.
38c9d29d7cf85c66549eb92ff5de652752df22a4.text: 遵循指南針上的任務標記；任務中沒有額外的敵人。然而，幽暗城對於剛接觸高等級區域的玩家來說可能會很困難。確保攜帶足夠的防禦技能。高階受災者在該地區巡邏，同時彈出 安費 彈出視窗。有些人可能會發現從 巴德克小徑 進入幽暗城更容易。

70d3d632394efc57a9fe402e54d74a8faa6ba0a0.source: The difficulty and completion time of this quest can be drastically decreased if any party member has the following quests:
70d3d632394efc57a9fe402e54d74a8faa6ba0a0.text: 如果任何隊員有以下任務，則該任務的難度和完成時間可以大大減少：

33747798ffa1a0fe5aa2f6d8537564ba1c99e440.source: Seek out Brother Tosai — causes all Am Fah in Wajjun Bazaar to be allies.
33747798ffa1a0fe5aa2f6d8537564ba1c99e440.text: 尋找東齋兄弟 — 讓 瓦江市場 中的所有 安費 成為盟友。

9353f1bfd136222efc5fe332ee6ac97fec584060.source: Chasing Zenmai — reduces enemy spawns in the Undercity after the objective "Travel to the Undercity. Zenmai must survive." has been completed and the current objective is "Stop the Am Fah from creating new afflicted soldiers.".
9353f1bfd136222efc5fe332ee6ac97fec584060.text: 追逐 Zenmai — 在「前往幽暗城。Zenmai 必須生存」目標後，減少幽暗城中敵人的生成。已完成，當前目標是「阻止 安費 建立新的受折磨計程車兵。」。

7a7fe32044e296ae94ab4de9512cd607d6ae29a1.source: In contrast, the quest can be made more difficult by including party members who have started Winds of Change: unless those players take Memories of Purity from the Herald of Purity, the enemies in The Undercity will easily crush an unprepared team.
7a7fe32044e296ae94ab4de9512cd607d6ae29a1.text: 相較之下，如果包括已經開始 變幻之風 的隊伍成員，任務就會變得更加困難：除非這些玩家從純潔先驅那裡奪取純潔記憶，否則 地下城 中的敵人將很容易粉碎一支毫無準備的隊伍。

f0d7f5e4952150a159315bc6401c843004e5aeda.source: Non-Factions characters who have completed Zen Daijun can reach Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) by joining a Factions character doing this quest.
f0d7f5e4952150a159315bc6401c843004e5aeda.text: 完成 禎臺郡 的非 盟與敵 角色可以加入執行此任務的 盟與敵 角色到達 薇茹廣場（本地區）。

c2945f7a36908b90d34e09ab00d838f28021acd9.source: This is useful for non-Factions characters for progressing the Cartographer title, access to the Undercity, and starting Vizunah Square with a different choice of henchmen.
c2945f7a36908b90d34e09ab00d838f28021acd9.text: 這對於非 盟與敵 角色來說非常有用，可用於推進 版圖 標題、進入幽暗城以及以不同選擇的追隨者啟動 薇茹廣場。

5076c04fbee5f929df9f225f3ba77ceeebc9fa0b.source: Note that the Factions character has to start this quest from the very beginning in order to be able to ferry the non-Factions character(s) to Vizunah Square (Local Quarter). However you can safely abandon this quest once you reach that outpost and retake it from Headmaster Greico.
5076c04fbee5f929df9f225f3ba77ceeebc9fa0b.text: 請注意，盟與敵 角色必須從一開始就開始此任務，以便能夠將非 盟與敵 角色運送到 薇茹廣場（本地區域）。然而，一旦你到達那個前哨站，你就可以安全地放棄這個任務，並從校長格雷科那裡重新奪回它。

72701389e2ccd7ace6f1530a987f5ba60aa085f4.source: Factions characters who have not completed all the objectives may join a character who is completing the quest and enter Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), allowing both characters to complete the quest.
72701389e2ccd7ace6f1530a987f5ba60aa085f4.text: 未完成所有目標的 盟與敵 角色可以加入正在完成任務的角色並進入 薇茹廣場（本地區域），從而允許兩個角色完成任務。

773067f4dccf108385ca2d0b227923331c77e666.source: The party must defeat the four Celestial creatures to become "Weh no Su", Closer to the Stars. Each Celestial boss spawns at a fixed point on the map, marked by the green stars on the mission map. Once a Celestial boss is killed, it causes multiple weaker versions of the Celestials to spawn, they have some of the same skills as their Celestial boss and should be fought in the same way . These weaker versions also do re-spawn 3 minutes after being killed, so be on the move to avoid having to fight foes you have already defeated. The four bosses can be defeated in any order; however, it is easier if the party enters the far left portal first as the essences will be easier to fight. The key to succeed in this mission is to keep moving cautiously forwards, and not to hang around too long in the same spot.
773067f4dccf108385ca2d0b227923331c77e666.text: 隊伍必須擊敗四個天界生物才能成為“Weh no Su”，更接近星星。每個天界 Boss 都會在地圖上的固定點生成，並在任務地圖上以綠色星星標記。一旦天神boss被殺死，就會導致多個較弱版本的天神出現，它們擁有一些與天神boss相同的技能，應該以同樣的方式戰鬥。這些較弱的版本也會在被殺死後幾分鐘重新生成 3，因此請保持移動以避免與您已經擊敗的敵人戰鬥。四個 Boss 可以任意順序擊敗；然而，如果隊伍先進入最左邊的傳送門會更容易，因為精華會更容易戰鬥。成功完成這項任務的關鍵是保持謹慎地前進，不要在同一個地方停留太久。

99fe8ae5d7f710cd6f02ab859640ee99b2d89984.source: There also are three varieties of Star Tengu throughout the mission that do not re-spawn: Star Blade, Star Sentinel and Star Light.
99fe8ae5d7f710cd6f02ab859640ee99b2d89984.text: 還有三種 Star 天狗 在整個任務中不會重新產生：Star Blade、Star Sentinel 和 Star Light。

a839a28516d70f1428404158865eea87aeb8cee0.source: Avoid over-aggroing, pull enemies to prevent overwhelming numbers.
a839a28516d70f1428404158865eea87aeb8cee0.text: 避免過度侵略，拉動敵人以防止壓倒性的數量。

56c6ab433e8fc8b49564bfff4ff356c1ed6f6dee.source: Stance removal skills to counter Star Blades's Balanced Stance and Sentinels's Lightning Reflexes.
56c6ab433e8fc8b49564bfff4ff356c1ed6f6dee.text: 態勢 移除技能可對抗 Star Blades 的 平衡態勢 和 Sentinels 的 閃電迴避。

ac81106fbe04ab336bf40c026a1d1b323d11c32d.source: Hex removal skills help against Hai Jii, Tahmu, and their essences.
ac81106fbe04ab336bf40c026a1d1b323d11c32d.text: 妖術清除技能有助於對抗 Hai Jii、Tahmu 及其本質。

52bc1c979a88c0bec9ca18a572d86eb7cb0bb0b6.source: Area of effect damage skills to deal with the large number of foes.
52bc1c979a88c0bec9ca18a572d86eb7cb0bb0b6.text: 範圍傷害技能可應付大量敵人。

e491633de5ccbfa1e8964ed6087ff87a0f7fc1d4.source: Since Celestials are not fleshy, skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here.
e491633de5ccbfa1e8964ed6087ff87a0f7fc1d4.text: 由於天神不是肉質的，因此造成 流血、疾病或 中毒 或需要屍體的技能在這裡效果較差。

24ca89f0c42229f2ec9feabc2f767281ca14a7ae.source: Anti-caster skills, since most foes are spellcasters.
24ca89f0c42229f2ec9feabc2f767281ca14a7ae.text: 反施法者技能，因為大多數敵人都是施法者。

4a9c6ca0fed1a144cb0b3b30ee75818046f03662.source: A minion master can balance your party's number since there are many Tengu that leave exploitable corpses even though the Celestials do not. Essences of Turtle will deny you of corpses via use of Well of Weariness.
4a9c6ca0fed1a144cb0b3b30ee75818046f03662.text: 小兵大師可以平衡你的隊伍數量，因為有許多 天狗 會留下可利用的屍體，儘管天神不會。海龜精華將透過使用 疲倦之池 拒絕你的屍體。

f668c4b868b60017120e0d1f4ca347c202fd5794.source: Enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to enchantment removal by Essences of Turtle and so long recharge enchantments should be avoided.
f668c4b868b60017120e0d1f4ca347c202fd5794.text: 基於 加持魔法 的建置很容易被海龜精華移除結界，因此應避免長時間充能結界。

126fde317e3ed71419d6d816868f0fa82599cf4f.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #2 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
126fde317e3ed71419d6d816868f0fa82599cf4f.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#2 頁。

25f6f160f3687c22bbead04875bfe9afef0733b5.source: Immediately after the last boss dies, the mission will end, and your party will be taken to Senji's Corner.
25f6f160f3687c22bbead04875bfe9afef0733b5.text: 最後一個 Boss 死亡後，任務將立即結束，您的隊伍將被帶到 山吉之街。

cf0b3750e4d59f63d846aedfc33527578855f136.source: Keep boss order in mind when trying to capture skills, as there will not be enough time to use Signet of Capture on the fourth boss.
cf0b3750e4d59f63d846aedfc33527578855f136.text: 嘗試捕捉技能時請記住 Boss 順序，因為沒有足夠的時間對第四個 Boss 使用 捕捉紋章。

48d0d9e18f6df309f82a1bf9dd514a2ac610d97c.source: Similar to other foes that respawn/resurrect after being killed, respawned Celestial essences neither give experience nor drop any loot.
48d0d9e18f6df309f82a1bf9dd514a2ac610d97c.text: 與其他被殺死後重生/復活的敵人類似，重生的天界精華既不會提供經驗，也不會掉落任何戰利品。

7ba327e08ad04ad7a739141052e55f5ee6a78f57.source: Speak to Temple Guard Bai at the temple gate.
7ba327e08ad04ad7a739141052e55f5ee6a78f57.text: 與寺廟門口的寺廟守衛白交談。

720e7f86533d7876562936bfe801891ece992e43.source: Help Togo and Mhenlo defeat the Afflicted assaulting Nika's guild.
720e7f86533d7876562936bfe801891ece992e43.text: 幫助 Togo 和 涵洛 擊敗攻擊 Nika 公會的 Afflicted。

05f52dc1887c1355d037925a17806c3b3e3696d3.source: Escort Togo to Tahnnakai Temple and speak with Temple Guard Bai there.
05f52dc1887c1355d037925a17806c3b3e3696d3.text: 護送多哥前往 譚納凱神殿 並與那裡的聖殿守衛白交談。

21a95ff2ec89619650328ba21269fa63651cff9d.source: See Brother Khai Jhong for your reward.
21a95ff2ec89619650328ba21269fa63651cff9d.text: 去找凱忠弟兄領取獎勵。

07c845fb9846cb747b1007ef6db44da73934014c.source: Exit Senji's Corner into Xaquang Skyway and make your way North, being careful not to aggro more than one group at a time. At the first bridge it's best to wait until you can see Orosen, Tranquil Acolyte. He will run down the bridge followed by his accompanying group. If you run back down to the two guards he will follow you all the way down. If you choose to fight this gives you the bonus of having the assistance of the guards and it will result in the enemies being crowded together. Another option is to move to the right side of the bridge (out of aggro range) and wait for the guards to die; the group will then continue on and you can skip fighting them. Continue northwards across the next bridge. At point 1 (see above image) be sure to pull each group separately back onto the bridge so as not to set off multiple groups.
07c845fb9846cb747b1007ef6db44da73934014c.text: 從 山吉之街 退出進入 夏安便道 並向北走，小心不要一次招惹超過一組。在第一座橋上，最好等到你能看到寧靜侍僧奧羅森。他將跑下橋，後面跟著他的隨行人員。如果你跑回兩個守衛那裡，他會一直跟著你。如果你選擇戰鬥，這會為你帶來警衛協助的好處，並且會導致敵人擁擠在一起。另一種選擇是移動到橋的右側（超出仇恨範圍）並等待守衛死亡；然後隊伍將繼續前進，你可以跳過與他們的戰鬥。繼續往北穿過下一座橋。在 1 點（請參閱上圖），確保將每組分別拉回橋上，以免引發多組。

758f0d13e3a32c2da9c559f4dddc48e318b4a47c.source: After completing this quest, Nika and the Off-Duty Guards will continue to spawn in Bukdek Byway, repeating their dialogue from this quest when you approach them, until the follow-up quest, Closer to the Stars, is accepted.
758f0d13e3a32c2da9c559f4dddc48e318b4a47c.text: 完成此任務後，尼卡和下班警衛將繼續在 巴德克小徑 中生成，當您接近他們時重複此任務中的對話，直到接受後續任務“更接近星星”。

d87d75ef150411760890b5c09fa1db22b24fcec6.source: Exit Dragon's Throat into Shadow's Passage and talk to Brother Mhenlo. Then make your way to Nika in Bukdek Byway. You can either go to Bukdek Byway from Shadow's Passage or map travel to Kaineng Center, The Marketplace or Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) (if you're playing a foreign character) and start from one of those.
d87d75ef150411760890b5c09fa1db22b24fcec6.text: 退出 龍喉 (挑戰任務) 進入 陰暗通道 並與 涵洛教友 對話。然後前往 巴德克小徑 中的 Nika。您可以從 陰暗通道 轉到 巴德克小徑，也可以將旅行對映到 凱寧中心、市集 或 薇茹廣場（外國地區）（如果您正在扮演外國角色）並從其中之一開始。

f465a9847e71b586667fa447cd67faf6dfe591e1.source: Either way, proceed to the map marker giving Nika's location; when you approach her, she will begin her scripted dialogue with the Off-Duty Guards who are harassing her. Be careful when you approach her, as there are a number of patrolling Jade Brotherhood groups close by. Careful pulling should enable you to dispatch the groups individually, although you will probably find that Nika begins talking while you are fighting.
f465a9847e71b586667fa447cd67faf6dfe591e1.text: 無論哪種方式，請前往給出尼卡位置的地圖示記；當你接近她時，她將開始與騷擾她的下班警衛進行指令碼對話。接近她時要小心，因為附近有許多 翡翠兄弟會 小組在巡邏。儘管你可能會發現尼卡在你們戰鬥時開始說話，但小心的拉動應該能讓你單獨解決小組。

0ce523e53812336dca3cd15e212a24904e797396.source: Talk to Fishmonger Bihzun in Wajjun Bazaar.
0ce523e53812336dca3cd15e212a24904e797396.text: 與 瓦江市場 中的魚販 Bihzun 交談。

cfdd49977aa78f1ca8a72800a6af43b0596766e2.source: Defend Fishmonger Bihzun from the Jade Brotherhood.
cfdd49977aa78f1ca8a72800a6af43b0596766e2.text: 保護魚販 Bihzun 免受 翡翠兄弟會 的侵害。

60e5847b901309256a7506385f3ea2fa18d52772.source: Ask Fishmonger Bihzun how to contact the Oracle of the Mists.
60e5847b901309256a7506385f3ea2fa18d52772.text: 詢問魚販 Bihzun 如何聯絡迷霧神諭者。

5ae7cf2916a2c5bcd77da55ad1d1ecca4d74d31e.source: Talk to Loud Kou in Wajjun Bazaar.
5ae7cf2916a2c5bcd77da55ad1d1ecca4d74d31e.text: 與 瓦江市場 中的 Loud Kou 交談。

a6b46c9662ab1f0f7d5fa1e00afa9036130cd2c6.source: See Adept Nai for your reward.

81e2b5ae8ae59b3303e7f28fdb00feca7a378920.source: Start out from The Marketplace and enter Wajjun Bazaar. Head straight west to find Fishmonger Bihzun. Once you talk to him a Jade Brotherhood Knight will approach and accost the Fishmonger. The Knight will turn hostile and several groups of Jade Brotherhood will come at you, one at a time. Defeat them and defend the Fishmonger.
81e2b5ae8ae59b3303e7f28fdb00feca7a378920.text: 從 市集 開始並輸入 瓦江市場。一直往西走就能找到 Fishmonger Bihzun。一旦你與他交談，翡翠兄弟會 騎士就會接近並與魚販搭話。騎士會變得敵對，幾組 翡翠兄弟會 會向您撲來，一次一組。擊敗他們並保衛魚販。

d71d6235d0fc1a428110f523056d96f36018fafd.source: Talk to the Fishmonger again, and he will tell you where to go. Head south to Nahpui Quarter and talk to Loud Kou to gain entrance.
d71d6235d0fc1a428110f523056d96f36018fafd.text: 再次與魚販交談，他會告訴你該去哪裡。向南前往 納普區，與 Loud Kou 交談即可進入。

ba4f851c5f727447a968d3f5a5c8a1ddd50cc094.source: While this quest is active, it will cause a friendly Jade Brotherhood Knight to spawn inside the wall near the place where Lian, Dragon's Petal usually spawns. He is involved in a dialogue with Fishmonger Bihzun, he then turns hostile.
ba4f851c5f727447a968d3f5a5c8a1ddd50cc094.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，它將導致友好的 翡翠兄弟會 騎士在龍花瓣蓮通常生成的地方附近的牆內生成。他與魚販 Bihzun 進行對話，然後變得敵對。

d1a239e173ec1dbf4df4e654d0f396feca11ea05.source: Becoming "Closer to the Stars" is similar to ascending in Prophecies or doing the quest Hunted! in Nightfall.
d1a239e173ec1dbf4df4e654d0f396feca11ea05.text: 成為「更接近星星」類似於在 阿斯卡隆戰記 中提升或完成任務「獵殺」！在 黑暗逆襲 中。

c4bd3eb513301d9fe9d9a59b647a0938909c4c7f.source: Entering and completely mapping the Nahpui Quarter outpost adds ~ 0.4% to Canthan Exploration Title.
c4bd3eb513301d9fe9d9a59b647a0938909c4c7f.text: 進入並完整繪製 納普區 前哨站的地圖，將 ~ 0.4% 加入 Canthan 探索 頭銜。

fb7fa60bb6bf64ffc637a9868b916c90df5304d0.source: If you kill the Jade Brothers too fast, the quest will not update and thus not be able to be finished.
fb7fa60bb6bf64ffc637a9868b916c90df5304d0.text: 如果你殺玉兄弟太快，任務將不會更新，因此無法完成。

b84894556446de756eb26c4b4923952b2d2164d1.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Closer to the Stars (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Wajjun Bazaar will be closed.
b84894556446de756eb26c4b4923952b2d2164d1.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中有任何未完成靠近星星的角色（不需要接受獎勵），瓦江市場 的大門將關閉。

a63cbdf3e94a762bce3165ef069b06cf9c185315.source: Closer to the Stars grants access, but any characters that have not completed Vizunah Square will be left behind in Wajjun Bazaar.
a63cbdf3e94a762bce3165ef069b06cf9c185315.text: 靠近星星會授予存取許可權，但任何未完成 薇茹廣場 的角色都會留在 瓦江市場 中。

83562e7db554cac3fc0002862f71c50da4f52c4d.source: Defeat the celestial creatures to become Closer to the Stars.
83562e7db554cac3fc0002862f71c50da4f52c4d.text: 擊敗天體生物，離星星更近。

8b7182d7fefcfda1e3f1afd488aa3fd14f7a0b93.source: Defeat Kaijun Don, the Celestial Kirin.
8b7182d7fefcfda1e3f1afd488aa3fd14f7a0b93.text: 擊敗天界麒麟 Kaijun Don。

217202a0cd8343732a5583666c58d854553d3d04.source: Defeat Kuonghsang, the Celestial Turtle Dragon.

7096c9c88483dc9c38893a61348dbb94b44b43cc.source: Defeat Hai Jii, the Celestial Phoenix.
7096c9c88483dc9c38893a61348dbb94b44b43cc.text: 擊敗天神 火鳳凰 海吉。

c8efe028c1f1a6216c60cc630395c0ebe1d8b2bb.text: 擊敗 天神龍 塔穆。

53b75bb6ebbe9254dbd294ca777ff663a10b74c7.text: 繼續進入 申贊通道。

1e1d8e5540f6294bf4de0bb86cc3f3f7bbc517ce.source: Follow the path to the east and then south killing any Am Fah you come across. Be aware the way is blocked by enemy groups and bosses with unusually high damage - it's entirely possible you will be one-shot and suffer a rapid party wipe. Remember to watch out for the rangers who will no doubt have laid traps such as Viper's Nest and Spike Trap. Follow the quest marker to the east at the "T" junction and continue up to the entrance to the temple (2). Speak to the guard and Mhenlo will join you. At this point backtrack to the "T" junction and continue straight west. Assure Mhenlo is NOT left behind, if he dies, 'mission fails' requiring you start over. You can usually dodge the group of the Afflicted here but sometimes Mhenlo will set them off. Kill the group of Am Fah and head round to join up with Nika and Master Togo (3).
1e1d8e5540f6294bf4de0bb86cc3f3f7bbc517ce.text: 沿著小路向東然後向南殺死你遇到的任何 安費。請注意，道路被敵方團體和具有異常高傷害的 Boss 擋住 - 完全有可能你會被一槍打中並遭受快速的隊伍消滅。請記得提防護林員，他們無疑會佈下陷阱，例如 毒蛇之巢 和 尖刺陷阱。沿著「T」路口的任務標記向東行駛，然後繼續到達寺廟的入口（2）。與警衛交談，涵洛 將加入您。此時原路返回「T」形路口並繼續向西直行。確保 涵洛 不會落下，如果他死了，“任務失敗”，需要您重新開始。你通常可以在這裡躲避一群受折磨的人，但有時 涵洛 會引爆他們。殺死 安費 隊伍並前往與 Nika 和 藤吾大師 (3) 會合。

f111b6d295dc7dbe8aae16717d8a668da460c044.source: Here you will have to fend off the Afflicted. They come from three sides but there aren't many so you shouldn't have a problem. Sometimes the last group will get "stuck", head down the ramp and dispose of them to get the final dialog to appear.
f111b6d295dc7dbe8aae16717d8a668da460c044.text: 在這裡你必須抵禦受折磨的人。它們來自三個方向，但數量不多，所以應該不會有問題。有時最後一組會被“卡住”，走下坡道並處理掉他們以獲得最終的對話方塊。

ad4b12c876e4df7936ae9ad616eba0efebb1ef9f.source: Leave with Master Togo and backtrack again back to the entrance to the temple (2) and talk to the guard to head inside.
ad4b12c876e4df7936ae9ad616eba0efebb1ef9f.text: 帶著 藤吾大師 離開，然後再次原路返回寺廟入口 (2)，並與守衛交談以進入內部。

09f59c0c5fc9e658db535f2da165373065d1d5ca.source: As an alternative path, you can proceed from Senji's Corner through Nahpui Quarter into Shenzun Tunnels, and then proceed along the south side of the region to Maatu Keep. Not only does this add Maatu Keep to your map much sooner than you would otherwise get there, but the quest is more easily completed from there.
09f59c0c5fc9e658db535f2da165373065d1d5ca.text: 作為替代路徑，您可以從 山吉之街 穿過 納普區 進入 申贊通道，然後沿著該區域的南側前往 麻都堡壘。這不僅可以比您更快地將 麻都堡壘 新增到您的地圖中，而且從那裡更容易完成任務。

6610d3a4e6a17af3503a81544ef7e11d13221174.source: Mhenlo is programmed to take a specified path to Togo and Nika, and will not follow or wait for your party, therefore stay close to him. He also cannot be led to Togo's location before speaking with him; he will simply path to the first node in his route, then proceed from there.
6610d3a4e6a17af3503a81544ef7e11d13221174.text: 涵洛 被程式設計為採取指定路徑前往 Togo 和 Nika，並且不會跟隨或等待您的隊伍，因此請靠近他。在與多哥交談之前，也無法將他帶到多哥所在的位置；他將簡單地路徑到路線中的第一個節點，然後從那裡繼續。

29faf484484d26edf2f6b2d470f2ba4ee782dded.source: To prevent Mhenlo from becoming stuck or taking the wrong path, destroy any minions prior to him joining your party.
29faf484484d26edf2f6b2d470f2ba4ee782dded.text: 為了防止 涵洛 陷入困境或走上錯誤的道路，請在他加入你的隊伍之前消滅他。

ac4f35ac57fec6c5591355eee13e6c7c4e025e61.source: If you re-zone (i.e. head into another area or outpost) after completing the fight with Nika you will have to re-do the quest. This can be annoying if you want to flag Maatu Keep during the Seeking Shelter quest at the same time. Instead, escort Togo back to the Temple and wait for the quest to update. You should then be able to double back to the Keep, enter the tunnels again and fight your way back to the Temple without having to re-do the quest.
ac4f35ac57fec6c5591355eee13e6c7c4e025e61.text: 如果你在完成與尼卡的戰鬥後重新分割槽（即前往另一個區域或前哨站），你將不得不重新執行任務。如果您想在尋求 庇護 任務期間同時標記 麻都堡壘，這可能會很煩人。相反，護送多哥返回聖殿並等待任務更新。然後你應該能夠原路返回要塞，再次進入隧道並一路殺回聖殿，而無需重新執行任務。

62346cf32e572fab2e42e0fee945bbfcb57a7e14.source: Even if Mhenlo dies — and the quest log says Quest Failed — you might be able to complete the quest: keep moving forward to complete the objectives and you should be able to enter the temple as usual.
62346cf32e572fab2e42e0fee945bbfcb57a7e14.text: 即使 涵洛 死亡 - 並且任務日誌顯示 任務 失敗 - 你也許能夠完成任務：繼續前進以完成目標，你應該能夠像往常一樣進入寺廟。

22dbfa4b617757a35c5c3146037a14a892a5bf48.source: Sometimes Nika and Mhenlo will say their dialogue early and out-of-order.
22dbfa4b617757a35c5c3146037a14a892a5bf48.text: 有時 Nika 和 涵洛 會事先說出他們的對話並且亂序。

761e4e8a2854ef3f2f5b1f8f01aba999df08f003.source: Mhenlo and Togo both may become stuck at various points in this quest: Mhenlo often stops to heal minions; Togo can get body blocked by the Obsidian Flame Assassin and/or Nika after the battle, just before the trek back to the Temple. Brother Mhenlo can get stuck standing by Temple Guard Bai and will not follow you to the next marker. There is no option but to start over.
761e4e8a2854ef3f2f5b1f8f01aba999df08f003.text: 涵洛 和 Togo 都可能會在這個任務的不同點陷入困境：涵洛 經常停下來治療小兵；多哥可以在戰鬥結束後、徒步返回聖殿之前，用 黑曜石火焰 暗殺者 和/或 Nika 阻擋身體。 涵洛教友 可能會被困在聖殿守衛白身邊，並且不會跟著你到達下一個標記。別無選擇，只能重新開始。

9a93c33758f8d64e91f0588b0ff90861e03cc81d.source: The quest log will not update once Mhenlo meets up with Master Togo and Nika. This occurs if he takes a path other than the one programmed.
9a93c33758f8d64e91f0588b0ff90861e03cc81d.text: 一旦 涵洛 與 藤吾大師 和 Nika 相遇，任務日誌將不會更新。如果他選擇了與程式路徑不同的路徑，就會發生這種情況。

9c45bc8ae0f03a267a136c6b76dcaf06fecbc3dd.source: The last group of afflicted at the bottom of the ramp may sometimes get stuck fighting a group of Am Fah and not approach Mhenlo. Seeking out and killing the group still allows progression.
9c45bc8ae0f03a267a136c6b76dcaf06fecbc3dd.text: 坡道底部的最後一組受影響者有時可能會與一群 安費 戰鬥而無法接近 涵洛。尋找並殺死該群體仍然可以取得進展。

f2cf44fc8a2b1a311a19afc5a0d89d7f817654ac.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed Mayhem in the Market (accepting the reward is not required) or any foreign characters, the gate from The Undercity into Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) will be closed, and if the party contains any foreign characters that have not completed Welcome to Cantha (accepting the reward is not required) or any Factions characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter, the gate from Bukdek Byway into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) will be closed.
f2cf44fc8a2b1a311a19afc5a0d89d7f817654ac.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中有任何要求 盟與敵 未完成市場混亂的角色（不需要接受獎勵）或任何外國角色，門從 地下城 進入 薇茹廣場 （Local Quarter）將被關閉，並且如果聚會包含任何未完成的外來字元 歡迎來到凱珊 （不需要接受獎勵）或任何 盟與敵 未完成的字元 納普區 ，門從 巴德克小徑 進入 薇茹廣場 （外國區）將關閉。

a05fde917106b57b06260e75c2e2d259a5d65c46.source: Mayhem in the Market grants access to the Local Quarter, but any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun will be left behind in The Undercity.
a05fde917106b57b06260e75c2e2d259a5d65c46.text: 市場混亂允許進入本地區塊，但任何未完成 禎臺郡 的角色將被留在 地下城 中。

5bdbcacfc6388488c2642bec8810be0d81c549d2.source: Welcome to Cantha grants access to the Foreign Quarter.
5bdbcacfc6388488c2642bec8810be0d81c549d2.text: 歡迎來到凱珊 授予對外國區的存取權。

a51a1beae643d514872acd92ba8e57ca077e75c6.source:
Locate the source of the plague in Kaineng City.
 Find Togo in Vizunah Square. (If your party is from Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter).)
 Hold out until Mhenlo 's party arrives. (If your party is from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter).)
 Travel with Mhenlo and Togo in search of the plague's source.
 Defeat Shiro's Construct.
a51a1beae643d514872acd92ba8e57ca077e75c6.text:
在 凱寧城 中找到瘟疫的源頭。
 在 薇茹廣場 中找出多哥。 （如果您的隊伍來自 薇茹廣場（外國區）。）
 堅持到 涵洛 的隊伍到來。 （如果您的隊伍來自 薇茹廣場（當地街區）。）
 與 涵洛 和多哥一起尋找瘟疫的源頭。
 擊敗白的構裝體。

efb6623ab1daf01962ff4853a17ad97b6febfc8f.source: Factions Completion time > 30 minutes 25 - 30 minutes 40 minutes 35 - 40 minutes < 35 minutes
efb6623ab1daf01962ff4853a17ad97b6febfc8f.text: 盟與敵 完成時間 > 30 分鐘 25 - 30 分鐘 40 分鐘 35 - 40 分鐘 < 35 分鐘

1cd453934fe4b2e4fea44ebb1ca72d5c08b80059.source: The local and foreign parties start at separate locations. The local party, together with Master Togo, will enter an area where they will be faced with spawning Afflicted. The foreign party, with Mhenlo, will need to fight several groups of Am Fah enemies first to make their way to the meet up point. Since Master Togo has to be kept alive, a common reason to fail the mission is for the local party to become overwhelmed and Togo dies, before the foreign party arrives. To prevent this, the local party should place more emphasis on healing compared to the foreign one. Once the two groups meet, healers from both parties are able to heal both NPCs.
1cd453934fe4b2e4fea44ebb1ca72d5c08b80059.text: 本地和外國各方在不同的地點開始。當地隊伍與 藤吾大師 一起進入一個區域，在那裡他們將面臨產卵的受折磨者。擁有 涵洛 的外國隊伍需要先與幾組 安費 敵人戰鬥才能到達集合點。由於 藤吾大師 必須保持活力，任務失敗的常見原因是在外國隊伍到達之前，當地隊伍不知所措，多哥死亡。為了防止這種情況的發生，與外國政黨相比，本土政黨應該更加重視療癒。一旦兩隊相遇，雙方的治療師就能夠治療兩個 NPC。

c79c4345935aa4a914daacfa67516be362e83998.source: After the first large battle, the mission follows a linear path, including two other large fights at Afflicted spawning points. During these fights, multiple waves of Afflicted spawn (and respawn) from three separate points. The Afflicted Soul Explosion can overwhelm parties in these situations. Eliminating the afflicted bosses will stop the respawning of Afflicted and cause the opening of the nearby gate, allowing continuation of the mission. Spread apart and try to intercept the spawns with three "mini-parties" instead of fighting them all in one big melee.
c79c4345935aa4a914daacfa67516be362e83998.text: 在第一次大型戰鬥之後，任務遵循線性路徑，包括在受影響的產卵點進行的另外兩場大型戰鬥。在這些戰鬥中，多波受折磨者會從三個不同的點產卵（和重生）。在這些情況下，痛苦的靈魂爆炸可以壓倒各方。消滅受影響的 Boss 將阻止受影響的重生並導致附近的大門開啟，從而允許任務繼續進行。分散開來，試著用三個「小隊」攔截重生者，而不是在一場大混戰中與他們全部戰鬥。

8364da128a682c690481c28984ab3580a988bb1d.source: Note that while you can heal members of the other group, you cannot resurrect them. Each party has to provide for their own means of resurrection.
8364da128a682c690481c28984ab3580a988bb1d.text: 請注意，雖然您可以治癒另一組的成員，但無法復活他們。每一方都必須提供自己的復活方式。

d08f6003b2547d9d37f9e38570a965663a4c034a.source: This mission has numerous bugs, some forcing a restart. See the notes for details.
d08f6003b2547d9d37f9e38570a965663a4c034a.text: 該任務有許多錯誤，其中一些迫使重新啟動。詳細資訊請參閱註釋。

f94525d388c6e8ad1654b3cb0d827735329ade1a.source: Bring skills that can affect multiple allies, since there will be 16 characters (from the two parties) plus Togo and Mhenlo.
f94525d388c6e8ad1654b3cb0d827735329ade1a.text: 帶來可以影響多個盟友的技能，因為會有 16 角色（來自雙方）以及 Togo 和 涵洛。

5166265c0378c0ebf3672ba3b6cdac86116c9088.source: Area of effect skills are very helpful because the fighting is tight and packed. Wards, wells, and point blank area of effect skills are very effective in this mission. Area of effect skills that inflict damage can cause many Afflicted Soul Explosions to trigger at the same time.
5166265c0378c0ebf3672ba3b6cdac86116c9088.text: 區域效果技能非常有幫助，因為戰鬥非常緊張且擁擠。守衛、水井和近距離效果技能在此任務中非常有效。造成傷害的範圍技能可以同時觸發多個痛苦靈魂爆炸。

a10c15c0885357062a18da0c0494461fd33e5f1f.source: There are enough exploitable corpses to support several minion masters; however, remember that the sacrifice from Blood of the Master is determined by the total number of allied minions.
a10c15c0885357062a18da0c0494461fd33e5f1f.text: 有足夠的可利用屍體來支援幾個小兵大師；然而，請記住，主人之血 的犧牲取決於友方小兵的總數。

6f1287f033fa0caab7cdc50d0553718d7fa4efb4.source: "I Will Avenge You!" will benefit from the deaths of Canthan Guards and Peasants; it can provide a near-continuous buff during the mission.
6f1287f033fa0caab7cdc50d0553718d7fa4efb4.text: 「我會為你報仇！」將從凱珊衛兵和農民的死亡中受益；它可以在任務期間提供近乎連續的增益。

1890bcd902ffd879cac8c5a0e26449ad935bc7c5.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed To Tahnnakai Temple (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Shenzun Tunnels will be closed.
1890bcd902ffd879cac8c5a0e26449ad935bc7c5.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中有任何未完成前往譚納凱神殿的角色（不需要接受獎勵），申贊通道的大門將關閉。

775f5d30b84537ce5424eea621af4063a8e9194c.source: To Tahnnakai Temple grants access, but any characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.
775f5d30b84537ce5424eea621af4063a8e9194c.text: 前往譚納凱神殿 授予存取許可權，但任何未完成 納普區 的字元都會留在 申贊通道 中。

8f383c4dec52357a35b87d194ccd381a11e07c47.source: Stop the Spirit Binder from consuming Vizu.
8f383c4dec52357a35b87d194ccd381a11e07c47.text: 阻止靈魂束縛者吞噬維祖。

f293fe89064ad30fde1a9c4d16b3d64e2f4bcc42.source: You have freed [0...8] souls out of 8.
f293fe89064ad30fde1a9c4d16b3d64e2f4bcc42.text: 您已將 [0...8] 個靈魂從 8 中解放出來。

bc11c66e6d684d103fe17163056b5de8c4973764.source: Factions Completion time > 25 minutes 20 - 25 minutes 35 minutes 30 - 35 minutes < 30 minutes
bc11c66e6d684d103fe17163056b5de8c4973764.text: 盟與敵 完成時間 > 25 分鐘 20 - 25 分鐘 35 分鐘 30 - 35 分鐘 < 30 分鐘

8f0fb5b3fa248648dc74c7d641b7ab5eb3307a1e.source: Your goal is to defeat eight bosses in eight separate rooms, representing souls that have been bound by Shiro. As each soul is released, it will open the door to the next room, and you continue until your reach the eighth and final room. The mission fails if either Togo or Mhenlo die or if the party wipes.
8f0fb5b3fa248648dc74c7d641b7ab5eb3307a1e.text: 你的目標是擊敗八個不同房間中的八個頭目，代表著被白束縛的靈魂。當每個靈魂被釋放時，它將開啟下一個房間的門，你繼續前進，直到你到達第八個也是最後一個房間。如果 Togo 或 涵洛 死亡或隊伍被消滅，任務就會失敗。

eb1f325a2d101a0fba0c09ace1d23b77f33f3c2e.source: This can be one of the harder Factions missions, especially when using only heroes and henchmen, particularly when trying to earn the Master's Reward. Although the mission is timed and Togo keeps urging the party to hurry, take your time: as you defeat each of the bosses below, the countdown clock is set back; as long as your progress is steady, there is more than enough time to finish.
eb1f325a2d101a0fba0c09ace1d23b77f33f3c2e.text: 這可能是較難的 盟與敵 任務之一，特別是在僅使用英雄和追隨者時，尤其是在嘗試贏得大師的 任務獎勵 時。雖然任務是有時間限制的，而且多哥一直催促隊伍抓緊時間，但請慢慢來：當你擊敗下面的每個 Boss 時，倒數計時就會倒數計時；只要你的進度穩定，完成的時間就綽綽有餘。

4760a05bac68c387dff763fcb77244365c92fc8f.source: One of the main problems solo players will encounter when pulling is that Mhenlo and Togo will follow them, often resulting in their deaths and mission failure. A solution to this is to use a bow (a flatbow or longbow) or heroes to pull. Flag a high-armour hero (e. g. Warrior) to aggro range of a mob while you hold back in safety to lure them to you. Using spells like Protective Spirit and Mantra of Flame helps here. If you are playing as a melee character, pulling can be especially dangerous if you have the rest of your party flagged further back. In this case it may be easier if you simply do not front line and hold back to ensure their safety (you can mop up any enemies that rush forwards). A minion master can provide the front line and an effective meat shield - use bridges and walls as choke points.
4760a05bac68c387dff763fcb77244365c92fc8f.text: 單人玩家在拉動時會遇到的主要問題之一是 涵洛 和 Togo 會跟隨他們，常常導致他們死亡和任務失敗。解決這個問題的方法是使用弓（平弓或長弓）或英雄來拉動。將高甲英雄（例如 戰士）標記到暴徒的仇恨範圍內，同時您在安全的地方進行退避以將他們引誘到您身邊。使用 精神守護 和 火焰頌歌 等咒語在這裡會有所幫助。如果你扮演的是近戰角色，如果你的隊伍中的其他人被標記得更遠，那麼拉扯可能會特別危險。在這種情況下，如果你只是不前線並保留以確保他們的安全（你可以消滅任何衝上來的敵人），這可能會更容易。僕從大師可以提供前線和有效的肉盾 - 使用橋梁和牆壁作為阻塞點。

bfcb3190f577495febc7c5ed7f54b1b93d23ec3e.source: Another solution to avoid Mhenlo and Togo getting killed is to stuck them in the start room using Recall, which is especially useful in hard mode. Clear room 1 (Kitah) as usual, as soon as you enter room 2 (Naku), flag your heroes on the bottom of the stairs and use Recall on one of them. Walk back to the start room to the Portal which leads to the outpost to the corner farthest away from the rest of your party. Note that if you have other human players in the party, they need to stand still, otherwise Mhenlo and Togo won't follow you. You can then end recall and unflag your heroes - Mhenlo's and Togo's names should be now gray in the party list and they won't follow any longer.
bfcb3190f577495febc7c5ed7f54b1b93d23ec3e.text: 避免 涵洛 和 Togo 被殺死的另一個解決方案是使用 回歸 將它們困在起始房間中，這在困難模式下特別有用。像往常一樣清理房間 1 (Kitah)，一旦你進入房間 2 (Naku)，在樓梯底部標記你的英雄並對其中一個使用 回歸。走回起始房間到 介面，它通往前哨站，到達距離其他隊伍最遠的角落。請注意，如果您的隊伍中有其他人類玩家，他們需要保持靜止，否則 涵洛 和 Togo 將不會跟隨您。然後，您可以結束召回並取消標記您的英雄 - 涵洛 和 Togo 的名字現在應該在隊伍列表中顯示為灰色，並且他們將不再跟隨。

23a60980b65a27e39073488f29d871ae554a50e2.source: In general, keep the party apart to avoid damage from area of effect (AoE) skills (particularly from Temple Guardians, Afflicted Elementalists, and Monks). Typically, the trick is to keep most of the party back, pull enemies with a long range weapon like a staff or a long bow, and retreat. The Afflicted will then chase that party member, bunching up and allowing the party to use AoE skills against them.
23a60980b65a27e39073488f29d871ae554a50e2.text: 一般來說，讓隊伍保持距離，以避免受到範圍技能 (範圍性) 的傷害（特別是來自神殿守護者、受折磨的元素師和武僧的傷害）。通常，訣竅是讓大部分隊伍後退，用棍棒或長弓等遠端武器拉動敵人，然後撤退。然後，受折磨的人會追趕該隊伍成員，聚集在一起並允許隊伍使用 範圍性 技能來對付他們。

3503c86fff99caea1bcb9f86e36f1a4b2489c695.source: In some of the rooms, the Afflicted may be patrolling or move into a different formation after the party enters. This may seem like they have detected the party, which is not the case. Stay calm, fall back and keep the same tactics: do not rush in and pull them carefully to avoid aggroing too many enemies.
3503c86fff99caea1bcb9f86e36f1a4b2489c695.text: 在某些房間中，受折磨者可能正在巡邏，或在隊伍進入後進入不同的陣型。這看起來好像他們已經發現了該黨，但事實並非如此。保持冷靜，後退，保持同樣的戰術：不要衝進去，小心地拉著他們，以免激怒太多的敵人。

a1a8dbd415966594bac89f520faa4f659af946aa.source: In the first seven rooms, you only need to kill the boss to trigger the opening of the gate. However, you should still kill everything, since it is nearly impossible to get Togo and Mhenlo through the rooms safely.
a1a8dbd415966594bac89f520faa4f659af946aa.text: 在前七個房間中，你只需要殺死頭目即可觸發大門的開啟。然而，你仍然應該殺死一切，因為要讓 Togo 和 涵洛 安全地穿過房間幾乎是不可能的。

9861dc2e077a166add3d6eeeb8f8fa4c1bd2f450.source: Fight the 2 pairs of Temple Guardians separately from the main group. If you're careful you should be able to sneak past the first group of Temple Guardians. As with all Afflicted groups, concentrate on their monks and powerful Ritualists first.
9861dc2e077a166add3d6eeeb8f8fa4c1bd2f450.text: 與主力部隊分開對抗 2 成對的聖殿守護者。如果你小心的話，你應該能夠溜過第一組聖殿守護者。與所有受影響群體一樣，首先關注他們的僧侶和強大的儀式者。

c7877d1f7c03b598fd0611028022af355b130859.source: The groups to the left, right and center can be pulled separately. This is most easily accomplished by pulling the right group first and back into the walkway, then the center and finally the left.
c7877d1f7c03b598fd0611028022af355b130859.text: 左、右、中的組別可以分別拉動。最容易實現的方法是，首先將右側的組拉回走道，然後是中間的組，最後是左側的組。

3726b275cf3614f81f24f4ce84f35824ef37cf8b.source: All the enemies in this room, with the exception of Teinai herself, form one large group. You can pull the Afflicted to the corner near the entrance and kill them there, before fighting Teinai. Be wary of her Sliver Armor and Star Burst which can kill multiple characters in seconds.
3726b275cf3614f81f24f4ce84f35824ef37cf8b.text: 這個房間裡的所有敵人，除了手內本人之外，都是型態一大群。你可以將受折磨者拉到入口附近的角落並在那裡殺死他們，然後再與Teinai戰鬥。小心她的 裂片護甲 和 星爆，它們可以在幾秒鐘內殺死多個角色。

93ac35e44ccac954564a7a0cbe649a77d3a0ec25.source: Like in the first room, fight the Temple Guardians separately from the main group before killing the boss.
93ac35e44ccac954564a7a0cbe649a77d3a0ec25.text: 就像在第一個房間一樣，在殺死 Boss 之前，與主力部隊分開對抗聖殿守護者。

bd74ed373a6cb3f7ddbd7c751ebb85b6d321b126.source: The group to the right can be pulled independently of the main group. Additionally, pulling can make the enemy warriors rush out of range of their healers. Two doors lead to the next room. While it is sufficient to kill the group guarding one door, the other will join in while the players fight in the next group, therefore it is easier to kill both beforehand.
bd74ed373a6cb3f7ddbd7c751ebb85b6d321b126.text: 右側的組可以獨立於主組進行拉動。此外，拉扯可以使敵方戰士衝出治療者的範圍。兩扇門通往下一個房間。雖然殺掉守衛一扇門的那群人就足夠了，但另一群人會在下一組的玩家戰鬥時加入進來，因此提前殺死他們會更容易。

d5ca1247226461dbedc1e9e73ef48f3498fef52e.source: It is easier to pull the Temple Guardians separately if taking the left door. After the party enters, any remaining enemies from the previous room will rush in, and a couple of small Afflicted groups will move towards the two sets of stairs. Wait until they move out, then kill those first, then pull and kill the Temple Guardians, then the main group. You can use the wall just beyond the stairs to hide behind. With careful manipulation of enemy aggro, you can get them all to bunch up by the corner for easy AoE damage.
d5ca1247226461dbedc1e9e73ef48f3498fef52e.text: 如果走左門，單獨拉神廟守衛會更容易。隊伍進入後，前一個房間中剩餘的敵人將會衝進來，並且幾個小股的受折磨者群體將向兩組樓梯移動。等他們搬出去，先殺掉那些人，然後拉殺聖殿守衛，然後是主力部隊。你可以利用樓梯後面的牆躲在後面。透過仔細操縱敵人的仇恨，你可以讓他們全部聚集在角落裡，輕鬆造成 範圍性 傷害。

ee8cdbbc84f3500116a58cdd167067fb597893b6.source: Beware of the patrols rushing in on you in this room and watch out for the high powered elementalists. Keep in mind that the boss is a Ritualist that uses Restoration, an AoE resurrect. This is arguably the hardest room. The elementalists are lethal and will decimate unprepared teams frighteningly quickly. Set up protective spirits (a Soul Twisting ritualist can be useful here) and use a hero (preferably with protective spirit) to pull the enemies towards your group. Try and flag your heroes out as much as possible. The group leader should be careful if engaging because of Togo and Mhenlo. With a bit of luck, you'll get the enemies running into your team one-by-one and die.
ee8cdbbc84f3500116a58cdd167067fb597893b6.text: 小心在這個房間裡向你衝來的巡邏隊，並提防高能元素師。請記住，Boss 是使用 復甦（範圍性 復活）的 祭祀者。這可以說是最難的房間。元素主義者是致命的，會以驚人的速度消滅毫無準備的隊伍。設定保護精神（生靈扭轉 儀式師在這裡可能很有用）並使用英雄（最好具有保護精神）將敵人拉向您的團隊。試著盡可能地標記你的英雄。如果因為 Togo 和 涵洛 的原因而參與其中，小組領導者應小心謹慎。如果運氣好的話，你會讓敵人一一衝進你的隊伍然後死掉。

3908fb7e3201448c8bdbe2efc0710f3f3c7dedd5.source: Single Afflicted Rangers patrol this circular room clockwise and counter-clockwise. They, as well as the pairs of Temple Guardians protecting the bridges to the center, do not need to be killed to finish the mission. However, do take care of those patrols that might aggro on your backline while engaging the boss group. While fighting the last group, it is advisable to have your melee fighters pull the big enemy group onto the bridge and body block them there, thus protecting your backline. All enemies in the center need to be killed to finish the mission (even those that might not initially aggro with the rest of the group) - killing Vizu does not automatically end the mission. Also, watch out for powerful AoE. Sometimes your group will get mobbed and cannot advance beyond the bridge, and will be torn to pieces by AoE in seconds, try flagging heroes and henchman around for less damage to your party.
3908fb7e3201448c8bdbe2efc0710f3f3c7dedd5.text: 單一受折磨的遊騎兵順時針和逆時針巡邏這個圓形房間。他們，以及保護通往中心的橋梁的一對聖殿守衛，不需要被殺死就能完成任務。然而，在與 Boss 隊伍交戰時，一定要注意那些可能會在你的後線上聚集的巡邏隊。在與最後一組戰鬥時，建議你的近戰戰士將大敵群拉到橋上並用身體擋住他們，從而保護你的後線。中心的所有敵人都需要被殺死才能完成任務（即使是那些最初可能不會與團隊其他成員產生仇恨的敵人） - 殺死維祖並不會自動結束任務。另外，請留意強大的 範圍性。有時你的隊伍會被圍攻，無法越過橋，並會在幾秒鐘內被 範圍性 撕成碎片，嘗試標記周圍的英雄和追隨者，以減少對你的隊伍的傷害。

40b5310d16fab02d498655fb13a0de325e2dcb60.source: Skills that deal AoE damage work well here since there are plenty of clumped-together enemies; however, many Afflicted Soul Explosions may trigger at the same time because of the AoE damage.
40b5310d16fab02d498655fb13a0de325e2dcb60.text: 造成 範圍性 傷害的技能在這裡效果很好，因為有許多聚集在一起的敵人；然而，由於 範圍性 傷害，許多受折磨的靈魂爆炸可能會同時觸發。

cf00bd30acb9ff21d5c9523f80434bafa53294f0.source: Since you kill a boss in each room (approximately once every 3 minutes), you can take Resurrection Signets or Sunspear Rebirth Signets instead of hard resurrection skills.
cf00bd30acb9ff21d5c9523f80434bafa53294f0.text: 由於您在每個房間中殺死一個 Boss（大約每 3 分鐘一次），因此您可以使用復活徽記或陽矛 重生 徽記來代替硬復活技能。

246be36d2748517ef3a1f039ab9cf34de6ed3183.source: Minion masters will have plenty of corpses; their minions form valuable meat shields to reduce the chances of Afflicted Soul Explosions affecting party members.
246be36d2748517ef3a1f039ab9cf34de6ed3183.text: 小兵大師將會有大量屍體；他們的爪牙 型態 有價值的肉盾，以減少受折磨的靈魂爆炸影響黨員的機會。

cdbc0c832f2ed435dec4f5d354a99fe17e9fab51.source: Elementalists can combine Glyph of Sacrifice with Meteor Shower to target the bosses in each room for fast damage and knock downs; killing the boss recharges both skills, negating the added delay from the glyph.
cdbc0c832f2ed435dec4f5d354a99fe17e9fab51.text: 元素師可以將 犧牲符號 與 隕石雨 結合起來，瞄準每個房間的 Boss 進行快速傷害和擊倒；殺死頭目會為這兩種技能充電，消除雕文帶來的額外延遲。

ef630a75f1191cf405ce9fdfe20473575af680b2.source: Pain Inverter is useful against the AoE damage of the Temple Guardians.
ef630a75f1191cf405ce9fdfe20473575af680b2.text: 苦痛 逆變器對於對抗聖殿守護者的 範圍性 傷害非常有用。

ecf5faeeedb9da0fa2ba9f1982de763f9be27ab9.source: Consider bringing Mantra of Flame or skills that protect against elemental damage, since Afflicted Rangers, Afflicted Elementalists, and Temple Guardians have skills that deal fire damage.
ecf5faeeedb9da0fa2ba9f1982de763f9be27ab9.text: 考慮攜帶 火焰頌歌 或防止元素傷害的技能，因為受影響的遊俠、受影響的元素主義者和聖殿守護者擁有造成火焰傷害的技能。

1e1193268332e8de7237f722281b15bb071c14cc.source: The touch skills of Ursan, Volfen or Raven Blessing work through blindness, Aegis and Sliver Armor. Asuran Scan is also an option since Afflicted in this mission cannot remove hexes, but remember that Karei and Kitah have hex removal skills, so it may have to be covered or reapplied against those two bosses.
1e1193268332e8de7237f722281b15bb071c14cc.text: Ursan、Volfen 或 Raven 祝福 的觸控技巧可透過失明、神賜之盾 和 裂片護甲 發揮作用。阿蘇蘭掃描也是一個選項，因為在這個任務中受苦者無法移除六角形，但請記住卡雷和基塔擁有六角形移除技能，因此可能必須覆蓋或重新應用於這兩個老闆。

ee8991df2a1474e9cf52e6c1ea0add60f1c598c9.source: Condition removal is helpful for the Afflicted Rangers, who will cause blindness.
ee8991df2a1474e9cf52e6c1ea0add60f1c598c9.text: 去除條件對受影響的遊騎兵很有幫助，他們會導致失明。

c6b571313357c96c5f477c1d122d777f770c7403.source: Though all of the Bound bosses except Naku and Vizu have skills named after them (e.g., Jaizhenju Strike), none of them use any of their namesake skills.
c6b571313357c96c5f477c1d122d777f770c7403.text: 儘管除 Naku 和 Vizu 之外的所有 Bound Boss 都擁有以他們命名的技能（例如 絕纏衝擊），但他們都沒有使用任何同名技能。

008c71a00976c88dc9bdbf5bb90a253c1377d44a.source: If you wish to capture Vizu's elite, Shroud of Silence, you must defeat her before killing off her mob, as the cinematic will start almost immediately after the mob is defeated.
008c71a00976c88dc9bdbf5bb90a253c1377d44a.text: 如果你想捕捉 Vizu 的精英 寂靜遮蔽，你必須在殺死她的暴徒之前擊敗她，因為電影幾乎會在暴民被擊敗後立即開始。

febcc6c306b355a1f4371ec79214d55e1b837d35.source: The countdown timer for Vizu to be consumed by Shiro stays in front of all NPC messages, possibly hindering the reading of the message. This can be avoided by rearranging the user interface through the interface tab of the F11 menu.
febcc6c306b355a1f4371ec79214d55e1b837d35.text: 維祖被白消耗的倒數計時停留在所有 NPC 訊息前面，可能會妨礙訊息的讀取。透過 F11 選單的介面標籤重新排列使用者介面可以避免這種情況。

8d8f76c3093f72ef4406537d0629fd4932fe1fe7.source: The bound spirits do not instantly open the gates when freed, but instead speak some lines of dialogue when you run over to them, and finally cast a spell to open the gates. As this takes valuable minutes in a mission with somewhat tight time constraints, it may be advantageous to kill the bosses before you've eliminated their entire party, and kill off the remaining mobs while they are dawdling about.
8d8f76c3093f72ef4406537d0629fd4932fe1fe7.text: 被束縛的靈魂在被釋放時不會立即開啟大門，而是在你跑到它們面前時說出一些對話，最後施展咒語來開啟大門。由於這在時間有限的任務中需要寶貴的時間，因此在消滅整個隊伍之前殺死老闆並在他們閒逛時殺死剩餘的小怪可能是有利的。

40dac52667a56554b464d4bcbbe64d4630f565f6.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #3 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
40dac52667a56554b464d4bcbbe64d4630f565f6.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#3 頁。

c4d12fecaffad072b0f0b1a5d0eafce25dbce222.source: Sometimes the released spirits can get stuck on an object, allied spirit, or minion and therefore cannot reach the door to unlock the next area. NPC allies such as Master Togo and Brother Mhenlo can get in the way too. You have time to wait for your spirits to expire, you can move the party to adjust the minion's position, and (sometimes) moving the party will also distract the spirit past the obstacle. There is no work-around if the spirit is completely stuck on a corner or chest. Should that happen, you must restart the mission.
c4d12fecaffad072b0f0b1a5d0eafce25dbce222.text: 有時，被釋放的精魂可能會卡在物體、盟友精魂或隨從上，因此無法到達門來解鎖下一個區域。 藤吾大師 和 涵洛教友 等 NPC 盟友也可能造成阻礙。你有時間等待你的精氣耗盡，你可以移動隊伍來調整小兵的位置，並且（有時）移動隊伍也會分散精氣越過障礙物。如果靈魂完全卡在角落或箱子上，則沒有解決方法。如果發生這種情況，您必須重新開始任務。

1a54b42fa0f2e47a9ccc3d71542358fe642cf640.source: If a chest spawns in the far corner of Bound Jaizhanju's area, the item from it can drop in an unreachable area inside the pipe.
1a54b42fa0f2e47a9ccc3d71542358fe642cf640.text: 如果寶箱在 Bound Jaizhanju 區域的遠角生成，其中的物品可能會掉落到管道內無法到達的區域。

e2583ffd3460de1266e941e138df7027e3307c10.source: See Emperor's Voice for your reward.
e2583ffd3460de1266e941e138df7027e3307c10.text: 請參閱《皇帝之聲》以獲得獎勵。

bd9a3473581cb07937265cc47d361e8a32ec7b67.source: Master Togo and Mhenlo will not be in the allies section of your party window when you zone into the Temple. To trigger their dialogue, move back to the portal and hug the wall until they are added to your party. After a few moments they will start talking. You miss out on their dialogue in this quest if you fail to do this. This does not affect quest progress.
bd9a3473581cb07937265cc47d361e8a32ec7b67.text: 當您進入聖殿時，藤吾大師 和 涵洛 將不會出現在您的隊伍視窗的盟友部分中。要觸發他們的對話，請返回到門戶並擁抱牆壁，直到他們被新增到您的隊伍中。幾分鐘後，他們將開始交談。如果你不這樣做，你就會錯過他們在這個任務中的對話。這不會影響任務進度。

87f0d049e2ad48b496a0239f80468018dc72ba91.source: This quest will allow players to vanquish Tahnnakai Temple by killing only 2 Temple Guardians, as long as any other enemies do not enter compass range in the process.
87f0d049e2ad48b496a0239f80468018dc72ba91.text: 該任務將允許玩家透過僅殺死 2 神殿守護者來擊敗 譚納凱神殿，只要任何其他敵人在過程中不進入羅盤範圍。

c20912ca7a5c7841e994d7c05fd7586028425d15.source: Jade Brotherhood will still need to be killed if the quests The Search for a Cure, Captured, or Housing for Refugees are active.
c20912ca7a5c7841e994d7c05fd7586028425d15.text: 如果任務「尋找治療方法」、「被俘虜」或「為難民提供住房」處於活動狀態，翡翠兄弟會 仍然需要被殺死。

ec041fdf718a45bfbffa47a10387c38c1c93f1fe.source: Emperor's Voice: Emperor Kisu wishes to speak with you. When he received word that Shiro was within the city walls, he ordered the Imperial Army to surround the area. He is in the temple now seeking counsel from the spirits ensconced there, and he awaits your arrival.
ec041fdf718a45bfbffa47a10387c38c1c93f1fe.text: 皇帝之聲：基肅皇帝 希望與您交談。當他收到四郎在城牆內的訊息時，他命令帝國軍隊包圍該地區。他現在正在聖殿中向棲息在那裡的神靈尋求建議，並等待著你的到來。

70c35ae2cefcd52f4eefbdf23265699a04ccd4a1.text: 與丹尼卡·祖·赫爾策交談

b1dccc580f6aa6afcb61e29463eaf3ac39b2ebe3.source: Meet Danika zu Heltzer outside the gates of Maatu Keep.
b1dccc580f6aa6afcb61e29463eaf3ac39b2ebe3.text: 在 麻都堡壘 大門外與 Danika zu Heltzer 見面。

c6b33fc63bf066e2187d742ad82654e1f508877b.text: 與電梯操作員舒爾茨交談。

d1592fca69c580c44ea52f6aac722ece18bd8bba.source: See Acolyte Hanz for your reward.
d1592fca69c580c44ea52f6aac722ece18bd8bba.text: 去找侍僧漢茲領取獎勵。

081d8bdb5584eb120c639624d729940807bf079b.source: Enter Sunjiang District (explorable area) from Zin Ku Corridor, where Mhenlo will join your party. Follow the quest marker to Danika, fighting Am Fah along the way. Once you have talked to Danika you can map travel to Maatu Keep if you have it unlocked. If not, follow the quest marker to Pongmei Valley, fighting Am Fah and Afflicted along the way; once in Pongmei Valley follow the quest marker, watching out for the popup Ranger boss Meynsang the Sadistic (if you follow the quest marker directly), until you get to Danika and talk to her. After talking to Danika and Redemptor Karl, follow the quest marker to Tanglewood Copse. Once in Arborstone (explorable area) follow the quest marker to Lift Operator Shulz, being careful not to get stuck between the two groups of Wardens. Lift Operator Shulz will take you to Arborstone where you can collect the quest reward.
081d8bdb5584eb120c639624d729940807bf079b.text: 從 辛庫走廊 進入 孫江行政區（可探索區域），涵洛 將在那裡加入您的隊伍。跟著任務標記前往 Danika，一路上與 安費 戰鬥。與 Danika 交談後，如果您已解鎖，則可以將旅行對應到 麻都堡壘。如果沒有，請按照任務標記前往 朋美谷，一路與 安費 和 Afflicted 戰鬥；進入 朋美谷 後，跟隨任務標記，留意彈出的 遊俠 boss Meynsang the Sadistic（如果您直接跟隨任務標記），直到您到達 Danika 並與她交談。與丹妮卡和救贖者卡爾交談後，按照任務標記前往 譚格塢樹林。到達阿伯斯通（可探索區域）後，按照任務標記找到升降機操作員舒爾茨，小心不要被困在兩組守望者之間。電梯操作員 Shulz 將帶您前往 Arborstone，在那裡您可以領取任務獎勵。

c4adbb8147eaaa55af4892ef3a21e8bb6b47a2eb.source: Meynsang the Sadistic and The Afflicted Huan (Ranger) are along the way in this quest if you wish to cap their skills
c4adbb8147eaaa55af4892ef3a21e8bb6b47a2eb.text: 如果你想限制施虐者 Meynsang 和受折磨的 Huan (遊俠) 的技能，他們就在這個任務中

2ea6ddfc2cb417201407265446bcdbc9e9bd8a3d.source: Mhenlo does not need to survive to complete the quest, it can be completed normally even if he is dead.
2ea6ddfc2cb417201407265446bcdbc9e9bd8a3d.text: 涵洛不需要生存來完成任務，即使他死了也可以正常完成。

8dba502a6546efa458520a04175f6fe1c7842f7f.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but the gate from Arborstone (explorable area) is inaccessible from the north side of the area. However, there is a glitch that allows access to the southern side, from which you can simply walk into the mission outpost.
8dba502a6546efa458520a04175f6fe1c7842f7f.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但阿伯斯通（可探索區域）的大門無法從該區域的北側進入。然而，有一個小故障可以進入南側，從那裡你可以簡單地走進任務前哨站。

0ff3a5ea4910c34ad9d867cd4c8d84f7c2daf2b1.source: The Count's Daughter grants access, but any characters that have not completed Tahnnakai Temple will be left behind in Arborstone (explorable area).
0ff3a5ea4910c34ad9d867cd4c8d84f7c2daf2b1.text: 伯爵的女兒授予存取許可權，但任何未完成 譚納凱神殿 的角色都將被留在 Arborstone（可探索區域）。

3d64691dad0d614ddc58462d39999783f18c56ae.source: Retrieve the sacred Urn of Saint Viktor and deliver it to Mhenlo.
3d64691dad0d614ddc58462d39999783f18c56ae.text: 取回聖維克託的神聖甕並將其交給 涵洛。

1e7b1e16a78bca2a433e71231b424038b0fb36d7.source: Escort Danika to the door of the cathedral so she can open it.
1e7b1e16a78bca2a433e71231b424038b0fb36d7.text: 護送丹妮卡到大教堂門口，以便她可以開啟門。

0fcfcf512a053a1fbe307eb196c905a28bd114f4.source: Clear the cathedral of the guardians binding the Urn of Saint Viktor. You have [5...0] groups of guardians remaining.
0fcfcf512a053a1fbe307eb196c905a28bd114f4.text: 清除大教堂裡束縛聖維克多甕的守護者。您還剩下 [5...0] 群組監護人。

7dfc88d6e43f50c062f60ae77fde725bc028f9e6.source: Collect the Urn of Saint Viktor

435aeda7f10870ca1fccf3d47f9ba30708cb8146.source: ADDED: Make your way out of the cathedral! Defeat the guardian Stone Souls.
435aeda7f10870ca1fccf3d47f9ba30708cb8146.text: 新增：離開大教堂！擊敗守護者石魂。

0e181ed69bf3de7b6fe06f6f062334089a36a181.source: ADDED: Protect Danika so that she can open the door.
0e181ed69bf3de7b6fe06f6f062334089a36a181.text: 新增：保護丹妮卡，以便她可以開啟門。

bbbc034663887c47effeb0b47e177bd8eb03c33b.source: Head up the stairs past the defeated Warden boss. At the end of the stairs, a pair of hidden Stone Reapers will come to life. A few wardens will patrol along the platform too. If you linger here, another group of Warden will come at you from the right. Head left along the platform and clear out the groups upto the staircase. (The left side of the cathedral hall is less dangerous than the right, due to the placement of the collapsing ceiling triggers.)
bbbc034663887c47effeb0b47e177bd8eb03c33b.text: 上樓梯，經過被擊敗的典獄長頭目。在樓梯的盡頭，一對隱藏的石收割者將會復活。有些看守也會沿著平臺巡邏。如果你在這裡逗留，另一群典獄長就會從右邊向你襲來。沿著平臺向左走，清理掉上樓梯的人群。 （由於放置了倒塌的天花板觸發器，大教堂大廳的左側比右側危險性要小。）

b4fc2e1412bcba7836abb81d4925505ade8e3c48.source: The stairway itself is under a near permanent Cathedral Collapse effect, so either lure Wardens off the staircase, or run down to the lower area (either way, don't drop the urn on the staircase). At the bottom of the stairs are two hidden Stone Rains. Make your way slowly through the Wardens towards the southeast staircase.
b4fc2e1412bcba7836abb81d4925505ade8e3c48.text: 樓梯本身處於近乎永久的大教堂倒塌效果下，因此要麼將守望者引誘離開樓梯，要麼跑到較低的區域（無論哪種方式，都不要將甕掉在樓梯上）。樓梯底部有兩個隱藏的石雨。慢慢穿過守望者，朝著東南樓梯走去。

1f88571ab5bcd3abf624af504319a39bd19ad90b.source: There are two hidden groups of Oni on the staircase out of the main hall. When combined with the Cathedral Collapse effect, the Oni can become difficult to fight. The first group appears as you fight the last Wardens in the room, and the second appear right at the top of the stairs. For the second group there is a small patch on the topmost part of the stairs which is not collapsing. You should be standing on it when the Oni reveal themselves. Wait there for them to engage you, do not charge up at them, as this would mean you would have to fight in a collapsing area.
1f88571ab5bcd3abf624af504319a39bd19ad90b.text: 正殿外的樓梯上隱藏著兩群鬼。當與大教堂倒塌效果結合使用時，鬼會變得難以戰鬥。當你與房間裡最後的守望者戰鬥時，第一組出現，第二組出現在樓梯頂部。對於第二組，樓梯最頂部有一小塊沒有倒塌的補丁。當鬼現身時，你應該站在上面。在那裡等待他們與你交戰，不要向他們衝鋒，因為這意味著你將不得不在崩潰的區域中戰鬥。

aa43d5ecee3d074566643e6e38e782ed1d52d797.source: Foes on this route are primarily melee based. This path is also generally narrow in several spots, making skills that benefit from balled foes more effective, but that also means it is more difficult for your team to spread out.
aa43d5ecee3d074566643e6e38e782ed1d52d797.text: 這條路線上的敵人主要是近戰型的。這條路徑在幾個地方通常也很狹窄，這使得從敵人的攻擊中受益的技能更加有效，但這也意味著你的團隊更難分散。

5d11530f8b5aec66294c448a192a6c50c8b3b8d1.source: Take the southern stairway. There will be a mob of Dredge at the top of the hill. All the Dredge groups on this route have a similar composition, mostly Gutters and Guardians with either one Gardner or one Gatherer. After the first mob, head through the doorway and there will be a similar mob of Dredge, and behind them will be two Blood Drinkers and Dark Fang (boss). In the doorway out of Dark Fang's room you will encounter three Oni popups.
5d11530f8b5aec66294c448a192a6c50c8b3b8d1.text: 走南邊的樓梯。山頂上將會有一群 挖掘者 的暴民。這條路線上的所有 挖掘者 團體都有相似的組成，主要是 Gutters 和 Guardians，以及一名 Gardner 或一名 Gatherer。在第一個小怪之後，穿過門口，就會有一個類似挖掘者的小怪，在他們後面是兩個飲血者和暗牙（boss）。在暗牙房間的門口，你會遇到三個鬼彈出視窗。

62b1657cd8aef29b26bcc2796fa824ef4c09d540.source: In the following corridors there will be two more Dredge mobs followed by a pair of Blood Drinkers. The next Oni popups will be in the middle of a long set of stairs following the Blood Drinkers. Two more Dredge mobs follow and then the final Oni popups occur in a doorway just before one final mob of Dredge.
62b1657cd8aef29b26bcc2796fa824ef4c09d540.text: 在接下來的走廊裡，將會有另外兩個 挖掘者 怪物，後面跟著一對吸血者。下一個鬼彈出視窗將位於飲血者後方一長串的樓梯中間。接下來是另外兩個 挖掘者 生物，然後最後一個 Oni 彈出視窗出現在 挖掘者 最後一個生物之前的門。

8d67a1d3db8261a5b94d491d38426ba1725d63f3.source: It is worth noting that this pathway drops you out right next to the exit that Danika must open for you to complete the mission. If you flag your team and drop the ashes near that door, you can potentially avoid Danika suddenly rushing over there when The Judge is defeated, because she'll already be near the door.
8d67a1d3db8261a5b94d491d38426ba1725d63f3.text: 值得注意的是，這條路會讓你在丹妮卡必須為你開啟的出口旁邊下車才能完成任務。如果你標記你的團隊並將骨灰撒在那扇門附近，你就有可能避免在 審判者 被擊敗時 Danika 突然衝過去，因為她已經在門附近了。

481f5c960ccbcc3a0d9414a509ec81dae332e62e.source: Take the stairway to your left. As you head up the stairs be prepared to meet your first group of 3 Oni. Defeat them and proceed to the top of the stairs, note that although you are outside the cathedral, you will still run into several areas with Cathedral Collapse. When you reach the courtyard, avoid the group to the left and eliminate the group on the right. Defeat The Ancient (spread out to avoid Shatterstone nuking your group) and go through the doorway.
481f5c960ccbcc3a0d9414a509ec81dae332e62e.text: 走左邊的樓梯。當您走上樓梯時，請準備好迎接您的第一批 3 Oni。擊敗他們並前往樓梯頂部，請注意​​，雖然你在大教堂外面，但你仍然會遇到幾個有大教堂倒塌的區域。當你到達庭院時，避開左邊的隊伍並消滅右邊的隊伍。擊敗遠古者（散開以避免 碎裂冰石 攻擊你的隊伍）並穿過門。

e67042b6c558024e36abcc871a4176b420eff57c.source: Head south and then follow the right-hand wall. Again you can avoid the group to your east and just take care of the group directly ahead. At the end of the chamber, turn right again and head south up the stairs back into the cathedral.
e67042b6c558024e36abcc871a4176b420eff57c.text: 往南走，然後沿著右邊的牆走。同樣，你可以避開東邊的隊伍，只需要照顧正前方的隊伍即可。在房間的盡頭，再次右轉，向南走上樓梯回到大教堂。

57806495bb5b02d476f959a01463bf23d63725d1.source: As you go up the stairs, 3 Oni will appear. Defeat them and move up to the top of the stairs but be prepared for another set of 3 Oni to appear. Continue south down the hallway into the cathedral. 3 Oni will appear in the middle of the hallway and then another 2 when you reach the end of the hallway. After defeating this final pair of Oni, continue forward to the sealed door guarded by Stone Judge.
57806495bb5b02d476f959a01463bf23d63725d1.text: 當你上樓梯時，3鬼就會出現。擊敗他們並移動到樓梯頂部，但要做好另一組 3 Oni 出現的準備。沿著走廊繼續向南進入大教堂。 3 Oni 會出現在走廊中間，然後當您到達走廊盡頭時另一個 2 會出現。擊敗最後一對鬼後，繼續前往由石判官守護的封印門。

cdaecf7c5634903a103657796b884c82cd37f0bd.source: The largest difference is that the Warden Mesmers and Elementalists become considerably more dangerous. This is especially noticeable with the first boss, as Ryver Mossplanter (Ranger) is fairly easily neutralized while Milefaun Mindflayer (Mesmer) can either severely damage or wipe out an entire party with Energy Surge, requiring the latter to be focused and disabled alongside the two accompanying Elementalists while the former can be ignored for last in most cases.
cdaecf7c5634903a103657796b884c82cd37f0bd.text: 最大的區別是守望者催眠師和元素使變得更加危險。這對第一個 Boss 來說尤其明顯，因為 Ryver Mossplanter (遊俠) 相當容易被消滅，而 Milefaun Mindflayer (幻術師) 可以使用 能量震盪 嚴重損害或消滅整個隊伍，要求後者與兩名伴隨的元素師一起集中和停用，而前者在大多數情況下可以忽略前者。

445b914089da4e232a6ee94ef838ee95b1134acc.source: The falling rocks that happen at regular intervals (and not merely because someone is in an unstable area) are always preceded by a screenshake about a second beforehand. Make sure to not use any vital, interruptible skills during this brief period and be mindful of using skills with a cast time of a second or longer if the rockfall hasn't happened for a while.
445b914089da4e232a6ee94ef838ee95b1134acc.text: 定期發生的落石（不僅是因為某人處於不穩定區域）總是會提前大約一秒發生螢幕震動。確保在這段短暫的時間內不要使用任何重要的、可打斷的技能，如果有一段時間沒有發生落石，請注意使用施法時間為一秒或更長的技能。

533786a99d99973939997cf7c8397b9be1922657.source: Check periodically that Danika is following you, as there are several situations where she gets distracted:
533786a99d99973939997cf7c8397b9be1922657.text: 定期檢查 Danika 是否在跟蹤您，因為在幾種情況下她會分心：

8d695176b75a12ea130e2b2ed68121fe2dcb2f9d.source: Just before opening the main doors, Danika might stop to heal minions; flag any minion masters as closely to the cathedral entrance as possible until her dialogue triggers.
8d695176b75a12ea130e2b2ed68121fe2dcb2f9d.text: 在開啟大門之前，丹妮卡可能會停下來治療小兵；將任何隨從大師標記為盡可能靠近大教堂入口，直到她的對話觸發。

3e9abf29fea9e9c14b6e67dee752e4c910123db1.source: Just before and shortly after picking up the Urn, Danika might stop for several reasons; make sure the quest log updates appropriately.
3e9abf29fea9e9c14b6e67dee752e4c910123db1.text: 在拿起甕之前和之後不久，丹妮卡可能會因為幾個原因而停下來；確保任務日誌適當更新。

caae9d15cfb355c4a3af02ba004d77f7f31c4d67.source: Any time you encounter a popup, a chest might appear (causing her to get stuck on the unexpected object).
caae9d15cfb355c4a3af02ba004d77f7f31c4d67.text: 每當你遇到彈出視窗時，可能會出現一個箱子（導致她卡在意外的物體上）。

84f7dd88040c918e943c45237a9d74c0da430de4.source: After the Urn of Saint Viktor is picked up the first time Danika will not follow you unless you are carrying the Urn, until the Stone Judge dies (you can use this to flag her position, out of danger from foes).
84f7dd88040c918e943c45237a9d74c0da430de4.text: 聖維克托甕第一次被拾起後，除非你攜帶甕，否則丹妮卡不會跟隨你，直到石法官死亡（你可以用它來標記她的位置，遠離敵人的危險）。

33fe0b854761af9361967e4cae1693f0d976a96a.source: After the Stone Judge dies she won't follow the Urn-bearer and will instead try to run to the final door, using the shortest path possible. Make sure she is not stuck behind a chest when this happens, as she won't automatically walk around it.
33fe0b854761af9361967e4cae1693f0d976a96a.text: 石判官死後，她不會跟著甕者，而是會試著用最短的路徑跑到最後的門。發生這種情況時，請確保她沒有被卡在箱子後面，因為她不會自動繞過箱子。

451622de7135291e76f0a3fab273fde2f3b50127.source: The Urn provides Shield of Saint Viktor when dropped.
451622de7135291e76f0a3fab273fde2f3b50127.text: 甕在掉落時會提供聖維克託的 盾。

26b4ea54d7cc072e0843aaa80cfce4722b170618.source: Avoid killing the Stone Judge too quickly: as soon as it dies, Danika will rush to the exit door, triggering additional popups. You can easily wipe if you have not yet whittled down the Judge's allies.
26b4ea54d7cc072e0843aaa80cfce4722b170618.text: 避免太快殺死石法官：一旦它死，丹妮卡就會衝向出口，觸發額外的彈出視窗。如果你還沒有消滅法官的盟友，你可以輕易消滅。

3398e20cba2a64ae19a40ca3ba5742c7447db448.source: Standard melee counter techniques are helpful to dispose of the Oni and other physical attackers (including the Stone Judge).
3398e20cba2a64ae19a40ca3ba5742c7447db448.text: 標準的近戰反擊技術有助於消滅鬼魂和其他物理攻擊者（包括石判）。

e263f820e35fabb06241c28205b3dad80a373efc.source: You can prevent or avoid interruptions due to Cathedral Collapse in several ways: bring short-activation time skills, skills that reduce activation time, or interrupt-prevention skills (e.g. Mantra of Resolve or Glyph of Concentration); mesmers can increase their Fast Casting rank.
e263f820e35fabb06241c28205b3dad80a373efc.text: 您可以透過多種方式來防止或避免因大教堂倒塌而造成的中斷：攜帶短啟用時間技能、減少啟用時間的技能或防止中斷技能（例如意志頌歌或專注符號）；催眠師可以提高他們的 快速施法 等級。

47a2ab28bd72fec89e69a2787157e1d0db958b58.source: Use caution with overcast-causing skills, since that effect is triggered immediately; if you are interrupted, you will be overcast and waste the energy cost of the skill.
47a2ab28bd72fec89e69a2787157e1d0db958b58.text: 請謹慎使用陰天技能，因為該效果會立即觸發；如果被打斷，就陰了，浪費技能的能量消耗。

1c87b9a86cba28a197601280c1b8294556f66e1c.source: Minion master builds are tricky to use during this mission: Danika can be delayed by healing them, the final battle lacks any fleshy enemies, and most skills that create minions have long activation times that can be interrupted by Cathedral Collapse.
1c87b9a86cba28a197601280c1b8294556f66e1c.text: 在這個任務中，小兵大師的構建很難使用：丹尼卡可以通過治療它們來延遲，最後的戰鬥沒有任何肉質敵人，而且大多數創造小兵的技能都有很長的啟用時間，可能會被大教堂倒塌打斷。

2d428dc33dd37b4448b60e51efa4c66820fa4af3.source: Consider bringing skills that benefit from holding a bundle on the character that carries the Urn.
2d428dc33dd37b4448b60e51efa4c66820fa4af3.text: 考慮為攜帶甕的角色帶來一些技能，這些技能可以透過將包裹放在攜帶甕的角色身上而受益。

a126a2cb3047e8c2061c4eed1f4535c0d43679ac.source: Once you have picked up the Urn, you can safely drop it and wander off without failing the mission. If you finish the mission without holding the Urn, your character will talk about recovering the Urn in the post-mission cinematic, but you will be empty-handed.
a126a2cb3047e8c2061c4eed1f4535c0d43679ac.text: 一旦你拿起甕，你就可以安全地放下它並走開，而不會失敗任務。如果你在沒有拿著甕的情況下完成任務，你的角色會在任務結束後的動畫中談論找回甕，但你會兩手空空。

0cf7b0ddbf57a90ea0e9654680301679f3f5953b.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #4 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
0cf7b0ddbf57a90ea0e9654680301679f3f5953b.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#4 頁。

161f8427763f5b0bba26324303fdfd64fca4acf2.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Altrumm Ruins.
161f8427763f5b0bba26324303fdfd64fca4acf2.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 奧楚蘭廢墟。

11d9604b167a28bc69edaaf95391fd129519ffd6.source: Sometimes Danika will get stuck on one of the randomly spawned chests. Either have the urn bearer attempt to drag her out of it or place someone who has lost some health just out of range of her (and in a direction she can move) to try and bait her to approach them to use a healing skill on them to get her out of there. You will have to restart if she is permanently stuck.
11d9604b167a28bc69edaaf95391fd129519ffd6.text: 有時丹妮卡會卡在隨機生成的箱子之一上。要麼讓骨灰盒搬運者嘗試將她拖出來，要麼將失去一些生命值的人放在她的射程之外（並且朝著她可以移動的方向），試圖引誘她接近他們，對他們使用治療技能，讓她離開那裡。如果她永久卡住，您將必須重新啟動。

1f374362b65370a9613032e75f29ad96668d332e.source: If you leave the central area without waiting for Danika to follow, she will run through the center route on her own. There is a high probability of her dying if you took an alternate route, as she will run through the spawns attempting to get to the end of the mission.
1f374362b65370a9613032e75f29ad96668d332e.text: 如果你不等丹妮卡跟隨就離開中心區域，她會自己跑過中心路線。如果你選擇另一條路線，她很可能會死亡，因為她會穿過重生點，試圖到達任務終點。

fd190a098b1a64753fcebee84a2e0545232c9e9a.source: Sometimes Danika will get stuck against the wall on the northern route. You will often have to restart as she will return to this position even when dragged past by the urn bearer.
fd190a098b1a64753fcebee84a2e0545232c9e9a.text: 有時丹妮卡會被困在北線的牆上。你經常需要重新開始，因為即使被骨灰盒搬運者拖過，她也會回到這個位置。

d14a7640157e0373e91eededb8af1f75615df987.source: The Drinker group that includes Dark Fang sometimes spawns outside of the boundaries of the mission, sometimes still within the Danger Zone and sometimes outside of it.
d14a7640157e0373e91eededb8af1f75615df987.text: 包括暗牙在內的飲酒者群體有時會在任務邊界之外產生，有時仍在危險區域內，有時在危險區域之外。

cf0c917496fff3aa51a8a5e70c01c1404263273d.text: 與 藤吾大師 會面。

071e189f1a44270803a7cc1d5d946515ca766705.text: 尋求進入北風之神海底的許可。

e84850da8fc60fba04a2805e27ab4d5e329c926c.source: See Elder Rhea for your reward.

62ab234a5324c1520c102d2856eac9651f393145.source: Players must first meet with Master Togo and Brother Mhenlo. They can be found at the crossroads right outside of Maatu Keep in Pongmei Valley. After the conversation between the two, the group needs to head towards Boreas Seabed and gain admission from Seaguard Lykaios right outside the entrance to Boreas Seabed located in the southeast corner of the area. It is possible to avoid all combat running through this quest.
62ab234a5324c1520c102d2856eac9651f393145.text: 玩家必須先遇到 藤吾大師 和 涵洛教友。它們位於 朋美谷 中 麻都堡壘 外面的十字路口。兩人對話後，小隊需要前往北風之神海底，並在位於該地區東南角的北風之神海底入口處的海衛利凱奧斯處獲得許可。可以避免整個任務中的所有戰鬥。

00ad3eadc9ed3b32b07d8d2688e4423fcee78b48.source: Master Togo does not need to survive to complete this quest.
00ad3eadc9ed3b32b07d8d2688e4423fcee78b48.text: 藤吾大師 不需要生存即可完成此任務。

118dca23a8085d0955ee6212f9937f43ac540c7e.source: If you rezone after talking to Togo, he won't follow you. However, you can still complete the quest without him.
118dca23a8085d0955ee6212f9937f43ac540c7e.text: 如果你在與多哥交談後重新劃分割槽域，他將不會跟隨你。但是，即使沒有他，你仍然可以完成任務。

e29de67acb5d7c331565c3cc8d8997e5c1e65ba5.source: Togo will not appear if you have the primary quest The Count's Daughter in your Quest Log.
e29de67acb5d7c331565c3cc8d8997e5c1e65ba5.text: 如果您的 任務 日誌中有主要任務伯爵的女兒，多哥將不會出現。

355df4a630f9f23a1a3eea28dc7d95524e256f7b.source: Head southwest across the bridge, turn left and follow the path down to the Cathedral doors. Avoid standing beneath giant mushrooms which emit the Stone Spores effect. You will find mixed groups of Wardens throughout this area. When Danika gets in range of the doors, she will open them. (Note that if there are minion masters in the party, she may become distracted by their minions and attempt to heal them instead.)
355df4a630f9f23a1a3eea28dc7d95524e256f7b.text: 向西南穿過橋，左轉，沿著小路一直走到大教堂大門。避免站在會發出石孢子效果的巨型蘑菇下面。你會在這個區域發現混合的守望者群體。當丹妮卡進入門的範圍內時，她會開啟門。 （請注意，如果隊伍中有隨從大師，她可能會被他們的隨從分散注意力，並嘗試治療他們。）

5cac89cc11dd3f3addd22f9ec00bbecb0ebf70f4.source: After a short dialog, Danika will open the gate, allowing the party into the cathedral. In order to pick up the Urn of Saint Viktor, the five groups of Wardens must first be defeated. Take advantage of the terrain - the water provides Blessed Water which lengthens enchantments, and the walls can be used as cover from the rangers. The group at the top of the stairs will also include two Wardens of Earth and a boss (either Ryver Mossplanter or Milefaun Mindflayer).
5cac89cc11dd3f3addd22f9ec00bbecb0ebf70f4.text: 短暫對話後，丹妮卡將開啟大門，允許隊伍進入大教堂。為了拾取聖維克多的甕，必須先擊敗五組守望者。利用地形 - 水提供祝福水，延長結界，牆壁可以用作遊俠的掩護。樓梯頂部的隊伍還將包括兩名地球守望者和一名 Boss（Ryver Mossplanter 或 Milefaun Mindflayer）。

8893355e7d57e00352dca2bf7943a5ded0442d77.source: Picking up the urn will trigger a cinematic, and Mhenlo will become trapped outside the building, leaving the party and Danika to escape through the collapsing cathedral. From here on fragments of the building fall at a regular rate, causing minor damage to the whole party and interrupting skills and attacks. Several areas are in a near-constant state of collapse, players should make sure that neither Danika nor heroes are left unattended in these areas (i.e. avoid dropping the urn in the middle of these areas).
8893355e7d57e00352dca2bf7943a5ded0442d77.text: 撿起骨灰盒會觸發過場動畫，涵洛 將被困在建築物外，隊伍和丹妮卡只能透過倒塌的大教堂逃脫。從這裡開始，建築物的碎片會以固定的速度掉落，對整個隊伍造成輕微傷害並打斷技能和攻擊。有幾個區域處於近乎持續的崩潰狀態，玩家應該確保丹妮卡和英雄都不會在這些區域無人看管（即避免將甕掉在這些區域的中間）。

2d518172660e180afadd2d440f9aa89ac466d5c2.source: When the cinematic ends, Stone Rains and Stone Reapers will spawn in front of the group. After clearing these foes out, Danika will make a short speech and when she is finished she will then follow the bearer of the urn. There are now three possible routes to the cathedral exit, all with some hidden groups of Oni and the Cathedral Collapse effect:
2d518172660e180afadd2d440f9aa89ac466d5c2.text: 當動畫結束時，石雨和石收割者會在隊伍面前出現。清除這些敵人後，丹妮卡將發表簡短的演講，完成後她將跟隨骨灰盒的持有者。現在有三種可能的路線通往大教堂出口，所有路線都有一些隱藏的鬼群和大教堂倒塌效果：

ae59add2925b3190ef21aa30f5462fe9e433641b.source: The southern route (purple path on the wiki map) is mainly populated by balanced teams of Dredge, which can be quite difficult to defeat. Except for Dredge Gardeners, all the Dredge have an interrupt skill and each melee Dredge also has a knock down skill, which can be problematic with Cathedral Collapse also interrupting your party. The narrow corridors leave little room for maneuver.
ae59add2925b3190ef21aa30f5462fe9e433641b.text: 南線（維基地圖上的紫色路徑）主要由 挖掘者 的平衡隊伍組成，很難被擊敗。除了 挖掘者 園丁外，所有 挖掘者 都有中斷技能，每個近戰 挖掘者 也有擊倒技能，這可能會導致大教堂崩潰也會打斷你的隊伍。狹窄的走廊幾乎沒有迴旋的餘地。

523182363aadcef4c7e05baacb4cad63def1c218.source: The middle route (yellow path on the wiki map) is primarily populated by Wardens. This is the most straightforward route.
523182363aadcef4c7e05baacb4cad63def1c218.text: 中間路線（維基地圖上的黃色路徑）主要由守望者組成。這是最直接的路線。

fc81a7f8ef49b7f7cb2695b4fad7950cb1720298.source: The northern route (green path on the wiki map) is populated by Stone Scale Kirin, Dragon Mosses, and large groups of Undergrowths.
fc81a7f8ef49b7f7cb2695b4fad7950cb1720298.text: 北線（維基地圖上的綠色路徑）佈滿了石鱗麒麟、龍苔和大群的灌木叢。

c18b87ad2d5074f59ab612e165728c25511f4b97.source: Archemorus' Strike can cause damage (and knock down) to the party during the convocation battles, if too many creatures die near the Spear of Archemorus.
c18b87ad2d5074f59ab612e165728c25511f4b97.text: 如果在Archemorus的矛附近死亡太多生物，Archemorus的打擊可能會在集會戰鬥中對隊伍造成傷害（並擊倒）。

abef0f97e4a342a9258041881ccabc300cfe5bd7.source: If your party wipes at the end of the third convocation battle, but your foes somehow die anyhow (e.g. due to spirits, minions, and/or degeneration), your party will be resurrected after the mid-mission cinematic. The return to outpost window will still appear.
abef0f97e4a342a9258041881ccabc300cfe5bd7.text: 如果你的隊伍在第三次集會戰鬥結束時全軍覆沒，但你的敵人無論如何都死了（例如，由於靈魂、僕從和/或退化），你的隊伍將在任務中期動畫後復活。返回前哨視窗仍然會出現。

e8ce82c33444e0a14e7c51c7ebd5afebcc96ee78.source: The portals to Mount Qinkai and Zos Shivros Channel are blocked.
e8ce82c33444e0a14e7c51c7ebd5afebcc96ee78.text: 通往 今凱山 和 佐席洛斯水道 的門戶已封鎖。

31141258f0c9675bed905fa5de7c150d74f741a1.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #5 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
31141258f0c9675bed905fa5de7c150d74f741a1.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#5 頁。

b5ee7810f803d237a7332c9860e4c7486f9d944e.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Zos Shivros Channel.
b5ee7810f803d237a7332c9860e4c7486f9d944e.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 佐席洛斯水道。

86381bc75b36cdc5cd196b5db46f6d9902e5d3c2.source: Find Master Togo at the city gates.
86381bc75b36cdc5cd196b5db46f6d9902e5d3c2.text: 在城門口找 藤吾大師。

3ea0b24b482381cb58184e4a22d32d1e814a4f23.source: Learn what is going on in the sewers.
3ea0b24b482381cb58184e4a22d32d1e814a4f23.text: 瞭解下水道裡發生了什麼事。

f1dd26bb982937bf8a8ae63f4cb02df50dd7d338.source: Speak to the emperor in Raisu Pavilion.
f1dd26bb982937bf8a8ae63f4cb02df50dd7d338.text: 在 萊蘇閣 中與皇帝交談。

4aa7483c37570fff0bb48a748fe5de0716d1235e.source: Map travel to Maatu Keep or Tanglewood Copse and exit into Pongmei Valley to meet with Master Togo. After Mhenlo and Togo's dialogue, map or walk to Maatu Keep and exit into Shenzun Tunnels and follow the quest marker to Commander Jafai and speak with him. You will fight many Afflicted and Am Fah along the way.
4aa7483c37570fff0bb48a748fe5de0716d1235e.text: 將行程對應到 麻都堡壘 或 譚格塢樹林，然後退出到 朋美谷 與 藤吾大師 會合。 涵洛 和 Togo 對話後，地圖或步行到 麻都堡壘 並退出到 申贊通道，然後依照任務標記找到 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Jafai 並與他交談。一路上你將與許多受折磨者和 安費 戰鬥。

3f70aab183090a829726d9243e69b576530a3506.source: After speaking with Commander Jafai, map travel to Kaineng Center and exit to Raisu Pavilion in the east. Speak with Emperor Kisu to finish the quest.
3f70aab183090a829726d9243e69b576530a3506.text: 與 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Jafai 交談後，在地圖上前往 凱寧中心，然後退出到東部的 萊蘇閣。與 基肅皇帝 交談以完成任務。

8f8cbdb17739950dee91888041e01d54065550cf.source: Togo will not appear if you have the primary quest The Count's Daughter in your Quest Log and it has not been completed.
8f8cbdb17739950dee91888041e01d54065550cf.text: 如果您的 任務 日誌中有主要任務伯爵的女兒並且尚未完成，多哥將不會出現。

0b89e56bcffbc9af38045820fd00c40a5bdc4453.source: Meet the Royal Guard in the Shenzun Tunnels.
0b89e56bcffbc9af38045820fd00c40a5bdc4453.text: 在 申贊通道 遇見皇家衛隊。

23e63d2d0d8a42965459557a7e66db2a5403405d.source: Escort the Royal Guard to Commander Jafai.
23e63d2d0d8a42965459557a7e66db2a5403405d.text: 護送皇家衛隊前往 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Jafai。

f8088f5277b5ac5e8c1506976775072f3b1f67bf.source: See Royal Guard Kazuya for your reward.
f8088f5277b5ac5e8c1506976775072f3b1f67bf.text: 前往皇家衛隊和也那裡領取獎勵。

d88bb9200746815dcd2a635271441fec9b4c3b0e.source: After you've been given the quest, map travel to Tahnnakai Temple or Maatu Keep. You will find a group of 10 Royal Guards outside. Follow the directions and clear the mobs in your way. Make sure you keep at least one Guard alive while traveling to Commander Jafai. If you have succeeded, Commander Jafai will let you into the Sunjiang District outpost. Do not linger around since there will be more groups of Afflicted approaching once you get near the commander.
d88bb9200746815dcd2a635271441fec9b4c3b0e.text: 接到任務後，在地圖上前往 譚納凱神殿 或 麻都堡壘。您會在外面看到一群 10 皇家衛兵。按照指示並清除路上的小怪。在前往 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Jafai 旅行時，請確保至少有一名守衛活著。如果你成功了，指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Jafai 會讓你進入 孫江行政區 前哨站。不要徘徊，因為一旦你靠近指揮官，就會有更多的受折磨者群體接近。

95ef5776fc6e1252e741875feee68e87e0a60b69.source: Two groups of Afflicted Warriors and Assassins (that spawn due to this quest) on the way to Commander Jafai won't move or attack, and use no skills except Endure Pain (used by the Afflicted Warriors). Sometimes the allied Royal Guards won't spawn when you enter Shenzun Tunnels. Rezoning seems to fix this.
95ef5776fc6e1252e741875feee68e87e0a60b69.text: 前往 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Jafai 途中的兩組受苦戰士和刺客（因該任務而生成）不會移動或攻擊，並且不會使用除 忍耐痛苦（由受苦戰士使用）以外的技能。有時，當您進入 申贊通道 時，盟軍皇家衛隊不會出現。重新分割槽似乎可以解決這個問題。

71f1f42b864a6ddc016fb780e6a0aad3434fe8f1.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Battle in the Sewers (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Shenzun Tunnels will be closed.
71f1f42b864a6ddc016fb780e6a0aad3434fe8f1.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中有任何未完成下水道戰鬥的角色（不需要接受獎勵），申贊通道的大門將關閉。

295dd1612e408a18a9e0712c384659db25faeda6.source: Battle in the Sewers grants access, but any characters that have not completed Boreas Seabed will be left behind in Shenzun Tunnels.
295dd1612e408a18a9e0712c384659db25faeda6.text: 下水道之戰授予存取許可權，但任何未完成北風之神海底的角色都將被留在 申贊通道 中。

a9ecd023543464c4751aa056a20bee08bb35e0c6.source: Prevent Shiro from summoning his spirit army!
a9ecd023543464c4751aa056a20bee08bb35e0c6.text: 阻止白召喚他的精靈大軍！

ed315c699cc3984a62f45d48bccfdd45bb47f057.source: Added: Unlike the other "ADDED" objective, this one is lowercase Destroy the spirit rifts to remove Shiro's protective shield. [4...0] spirit rifts remaining.
ed315c699cc3984a62f45d48bccfdd45bb47f057.text: 補充：與其他「新增」目標不同，這個目標是小寫的 摧毀精神裂縫以移除白的防護罩。 [4...0] 剩餘精神裂縫。

c5b3603ff3f795870dd9590f63314c7f35732252.source: If you abandon this quest after unlocking Boreas Seabed outpost, and then reacquire it from Headmaster Amara, then Master Togo can be available to your party as an ally for vanquishing Pongmei Valley whenever you wish.
c5b3603ff3f795870dd9590f63314c7f35732252.text: 如果您在解鎖北風之神海底前哨站後放棄此任務，然後從阿瑪拉校長那裡重新獲得它，那麼您的隊伍可以隨時使用 藤吾大師 作為盟友來擊敗 朋美谷。

27749c698bac5d78990a87082f84d7ee09fc4c6b.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed The Convocation (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Pongmei Valley will be closed.
27749c698bac5d78990a87082f84d7ee09fc4c6b.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中包含任何未完成集會的角色（不需要接受獎勵），朋美谷 的大門將關閉。

b960a865640695b37c42c240fd8e5b5d1b38b2a1.source: The Convocation grants access, but any characters that have not completed Arborstone will be left behind in Pongmei Valley.
b960a865640695b37c42c240fd8e5b5d1b38b2a1.text: 集會授予存取許可權，但任何未完成 Arborstone 的角色都將被留在 朋美谷 中。

b00b6d5c44a148e3097f1fcee71d7bb3fdd8f33e.source: Access through Boreas Seabed (explorable area) is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Boreas Seabed.
b00b6d5c44a148e3097f1fcee71d7bb3fdd8f33e.text: 無法通過北風之神海底（可探索區域）進入，因為在未完成北風之神海底的情況下，沒有通往那裡的路線。

ddf8849ac482baf8e4055b583cab9f956ef1deb2.source: Triumph in the Convocation and earn the right to use the Spear of Archemorus against Shiro.
ddf8849ac482baf8e4055b583cab9f956ef1deb2.text: 在集會中取得勝利並獲得使用Archemorus的矛對抗Shiro的權利。

df29ff19b53de2a80cab2f740e75ee1317772a10.source: Defeat the three Champions and their Seaguard.
df29ff19b53de2a80cab2f740e75ee1317772a10.text: 擊敗三位冠軍和他們的海衛。

63b8325d03812731f7deaaf1c7ff244893029d84.source: Defeat Zhu Hanuku using the Spear of Archemorus.
63b8325d03812731f7deaaf1c7ff244893029d84.text: 使用 Archemorus 的 矛 擊敗 Zhu Hanuku。

a1ba2d86d6dc8bf0451411df128aec10f26bf83c.source: ADDED: Unlike the other "Added" objective, this one is capitalized Defeat Shiro's Constructs.
a1ba2d86d6dc8bf0451411df128aec10f26bf83c.text: 新增：與其他「新增」目標不同，這個目標是大寫的「擊敗 Shiro 的構造體」。

8f1250318dd0e5f68079763323f15fa10900c623.source: Factions Completion time > 25 minutes 20 - 25 minutes 30 minutes 25 - 30 minutes < 25 minutes
8f1250318dd0e5f68079763323f15fa10900c623.text: 盟與敵 完成時間 > 25 分鐘 20 - 25 分鐘 30 分鐘 25 - 30 分鐘 < 25 分鐘

4eaab92e1b93de4acef8abffbecade4c9453f2c5.source: The objective of the mission is to destroy four Spirit Rifts (energy spheres) and defeat four Shiro's Constructs. Kill the guarding Spirit of Portals to close the Spirit Rift. These guards also summon more Shiro'kens to replace fallen ones.
4eaab92e1b93de4acef8abffbecade4c9453f2c5.text: 任務的目標是摧毀四個精神裂縫（能量球）並擊敗四個白色的構裝體。殺死守衛傳送門的靈魂以關閉 生靈裂縫。這些守衛還會召喚更多的白肯來代替倒下的白肯。

4f251851de3dd7b565c8296d37d4ed3855e0ebc5.source: At the beginning, the party has access to the Spear of Archemorus and the Urn of Saint Viktor. These tools are provided as boosts only and carrying them is not required to complete the mission. If your party consists mainly of heroes and can only take one of the bundles, consider taking the Spear instead of the Urn, since heroes are not affected by the Urn's effect.
4f251851de3dd7b565c8296d37d4ed3855e0ebc5.text: 一開始，隊伍可以使用阿基莫洛斯的 矛 和聖維克多的甕。這些工具僅作為助推器提供，完成任務不需要攜帶它們。如果你的隊伍主要由英雄組成，並且只能拿走其中一個捆綁包，請考慮拿 矛 而不是甕，因為英雄不受甕效果的影響。

042188952aebdaa0690ca1a8b9341efe5e609a9b.source: A bridge will come down and the mission will start.
042188952aebdaa0690ca1a8b9341efe5e609a9b.text: 一座橋將會倒塌，任務將會開始。

9ffc02e336e6fbb5b3f4eb367e5143af52f49acd.source: The first area has Flame Fissures that cause burning and crippled to anyone who walks over them. The first Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Assassins will be there. The party can now proceed either left or right. If taking right, Shiro can be sighted but will be unreachable at this time.
9ffc02e336e6fbb5b3f4eb367e5143af52f49acd.text: 第一個區域有火焰裂縫，任何走過它們的人都會被灼傷並致殘。第一批 生靈裂縫 和 白影軍團 刺客將會在那裡。隊伍現在可以向左或向右前進。如果向右走，可以看到白，但此時無法到達。

0c1fc1ff28e5df9fa41e2fc1d529d90ca7e8872e.source: There is another fork ahead. The second Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Rangers will be to the right. This area has several spikes squares that cause bleeding and crippled when walked over. Pull carefully to avoid over-aggro.
0c1fc1ff28e5df9fa41e2fc1d529d90ca7e8872e.text: 前面還有另一個岔路口。第二個 生靈裂縫 和 白影軍團 Ranger 將位於右側。該區域有幾個尖刺方塊，走過時會導致流血和殘廢。小心 拉出 以避免過度仇恨。

ecae1d99ed0a2e52e63d65b6afdf5d5226922050.source: The party should double back to the previous fork. The third Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Necromancers will be down that path atop a small hill surrounded with poisoned water.
ecae1d99ed0a2e52e63d65b6afdf5d5226922050.text: 隊伍應該回到前一個岔路口。第三個 生靈裂縫 和 白影軍團 死靈法師將沿著那條小路來到一座被毒水包圍的小山頂上。

39d1da370e61947a567987a30c9a7bf485c4d334.source: Turn right and out of the poisoned water to find the fourth and final Spirit Rift and Shiro'ken Warriors. The spike plates in this area cause dazed, casters should be careful.
39d1da370e61947a567987a30c9a7bf485c4d334.text: 右轉，走出毒水，找出第四個也是最後一個 生靈裂縫 和 白影軍團 戰士。該區域的尖刺板會造成眩暈，腳輪應小心。

5fde33b002a819a7e8fd604d6a27b89491819c45.source: After the fourth Spirit of Portals and its mob are destroyed, a cinematic will play and then the party will be in the central area where Shiro was previously seen, facing four Construct bosses. Finish off all four to complete the mission. If you are playing with henchmen/heroes, immediately flag them to the nearest corner as they tend to run to the center between all bosses, causing a quick wipe. Then slowly pull the bosses one or two at a time.
5fde33b002a819a7e8fd604d6a27b89491819c45.text: 第四個傳送門之靈及其生物被摧毀後，將播放一段過場動畫，然後隊伍將位於先前看到白的中心區域，面對四個構造體 Boss。完成所有四個即可完成任務。如果您正在與追隨者/英雄一起玩，請立即將他們標記到最近的角落，因為他們往往會跑到所有 Boss 之間的中心，從而導致快速消滅。然後慢慢地一次拉一兩個老闆。

78eab447e32f0f300810c1d5ccdfff83dd8d9a74.source: Spirit of Portals can be defeated quickly by using Gaze of Fury on them.
78eab447e32f0f300810c1d5ccdfff83dd8d9a74.text: 對傳送門之魂使用 狂暴凝視 可以快速擊敗它們。

54c41860f38b49932679b8f74f8e8ec5e503f998.source: This mission's environment traps also affect enemies.
54c41860f38b49932679b8f74f8e8ec5e503f998.text: 此任務的環境陷阱也會影響敵人。

96986107793ed93bfdc77dc8b67aed66d5da7a62.source: Shiro Tagachi is passive and has Invulnerability in this mission; however, allied minions that wander into his aggro circle will still attempt to engage him in combat.
