He may be killed by means such as Agony and Unholy Feast, but doing so appears to have no effect on the mission besides preventing him from speaking his lines. In the cinematic after closing all the rifts, he appears as normal.
96986107793ed93bfdc77dc8b67aed66d5da7a62.text: 樣版:Shiro Tagachi在此任務中處於被動且無敵；然而，進入他的仇恨圈的盟友小兵仍然會試圖與他交戰。他可能會被 Agony 和 邪惡饗宴 等手段殺死，但這樣做除了阻止他說出自己的臺詞之外，似乎對任務沒有任何影響。在消除所有裂痕後的動畫中，他看起來像正常人一樣。

a3c42794cdc7be0f4740dd9c4ddb9993c517a600.source: This mission does not provide a reliable opportunity to capture skills, because you have to go through the entire mission to reach the bosses, only four of eight potential bosses spawn, and there is very little time to capture the skill of the fourth-defeated boss.
a3c42794cdc7be0f4740dd9c4ddb9993c517a600.text: 這個任務並沒有提供可靠的捕獲技能的機會，因為你必須完成整個任務才能到達boss，八個潛在boss中只有四個產生，並且幾乎沒有時間捕獲第四個被擊敗的boss的技能。

f430e7c945309b54244d401ddd4330ed52146d74.source: After completing the mission for the first time, the sectioned off area of Sunjiang District (explorable area) will be accessible, and in turn so will the six construct bosses.
f430e7c945309b54244d401ddd4330ed52146d74.text: 第一次完成任務後，孫江行政區 的隔離區域（可探索區域）將可以進入，六個建築 Boss 也將進入。

618a1510e6c598f255ca8260026a88edb9f3e8a2.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #6 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
618a1510e6c598f255ca8260026a88edb9f3e8a2.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#6 頁。

1d6e81a227d509fb6458b8e72ce0bce07cf4e8f5.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Maatu Keep.
1d6e81a227d509fb6458b8e72ce0bce07cf4e8f5.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 麻都堡壘。

3bd49132bc5e7dda54e2be3f14173998e2d90171.source: Although they are not fleshy (with the exception of Flesh Golems), Celestial Summoning Stone and minion allies can be affected by the bleeding traps and poisoned water. Both the Spear of Archemorus and the Urn of Saint Viktor are supposed to be destroyed at the end of the mission; however, if a player was holding them (or dropped them just before the defeat of the final boss), both can be seen briefly during the cinematic.
3bd49132bc5e7dda54e2be3f14173998e2d90171.text: 雖然它們不是肉質的（血肉傀儡除外），但天界召喚石和小兵盟友可能會受到流血陷阱和毒水的影響。阿基莫洛斯的 矛 和聖維克託的甕都應該在任務結束時被摧毀；然而，如果玩家持有它們（或在擊敗最終 Boss 之前掉落它們），則在過場動畫中可以短暫看到兩者。

55c2dc25ad701e28ab1435596092aa554e5972e5.text: de:孫江-貝茲爾克 (主線任務)

83c5da1a5c2d7fa562813aa9ba1bb2640598fd75.source: Your party will not be able to enter this mission unless it has eight members.
83c5da1a5c2d7fa562813aa9ba1bb2640598fd75.text: 除非你的隊伍有八名成員，否則你的隊伍將無法進入此任務。

3e4d6e206fbbf021f3acb25ba2370854da6e7096.source: If the party contains any characters that have not completed Into the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Morostav Trail will be closed, and if the party contains any characters that have not completed Journey to the Whirlpool (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Silent Surf will be closed.
3e4d6e206fbbf021f3acb25ba2370854da6e7096.text: 如果隊伍中有未完成「漩渦之旅」（無需接受獎勵）的角色，則摩洛神秘通道的大門將關閉，如果隊伍中有未完成「漩渦之旅」的角色（無需接受獎勵），則寂靜之浪的大門將關閉。

30a4e548f34c5d5df9c6c795b63c80e969c56793.source: Into the Whirlpool and Journey to the Whirlpool grant access, but any characters that have not completed The Eternal Grove will be left behind in Morostav Trail.
30a4e548f34c5d5df9c6c795b63c80e969c56793.text: 進入漩渦和漩渦之旅授予存取許可權，但任何未完成永恆叢林的角色將留在 摩洛神秘通道 中。

d528c9f17bd900eefd6d9036d172775526096886.source: Weaken Kuunavang to destroy the barrier.
d528c9f17bd900eefd6d9036d172775526096886.text: 削弱庫納旺以摧毀屏障。

e69b6ffef3012f073b49771ab52ef79450083ef5.source: Continue to weaken Kuunavang until the next barrier is destroyed.
e69b6ffef3012f073b49771ab52ef79450083ef5.text: 繼續削弱庫納旺直到下一個屏障被摧毀。

9109b2026bcbd78e6eede76660bb0d3def857412.source: Continue weakening Kuunavang until the last barrier is destroyed.
9109b2026bcbd78e6eede76660bb0d3def857412.text: 繼續削弱庫納旺，直到最後一個屏障被摧毀。

a8037f2c84d4abd224734f4c396b51bfb3edd569.source: Defeat the three Luxon clans and their champions one by one to earn the right to challenge Zhu Hanuku. Each group has two bosses, and the next will enter the arena as soon as the previous group is killed. The Crab Clan will be your first opponent from the South-East corner. The Serpent Clan seconds from the South-West corner. And last the Turtle Clan from the North-West lead by Argo, a very hard elementalist boss who uses Argo's Cry, a skill stronger than Meteor Shower (interrupts highly recommended). Since they all spawn inside narrow corridors, use its gate as choke points before they spread.
a8037f2c84d4abd224734f4c396b51bfb3edd569.text: 一一擊敗三個 勒克森 隊伍及其冠軍，贏得挑戰朱哈努庫的權利。每組有兩個boss，前一組被殺死後，下一組就會進入競技場。蟹族將是你在東南角的第一個對手。蛇族從西南角開始。最後是來自西北的龜族，由 艾高 領導，這是一個非常難對付的元素 Boss，他使用 艾高 的吶喊，這是比 隕石雨 更強的技能（強烈建議打斷）。由於它們都在狹窄的走廊內生成，因此在它們蔓延之前將其大門用作阻塞點。

9ae0f4e953c7d95d5a8ae5d0f8937c67cb8a604a.source: Members of the Luxon teams (bosses are marked in bold):
9ae0f4e953c7d95d5a8ae5d0f8937c67cb8a604a.text: 勒克森 團隊成員（老闆以粗體標示）：

43e2b32a42da4305e30b8d27485caedaf017e9c8.source: This is a dangerous enemy: its Jade Fury skill deals significant area of effect damage and also has two resurrection skills to bring back the Kraken Spawns. Fortunately, its skills have long activation time, which can be easily interrupted.
43e2b32a42da4305e30b8d27485caedaf017e9c8.text: 這是一個危險的敵人：它的翡翠之怒技能會造成大範圍的傷害，並且還有兩個復活技能可以帶回海妖產卵。還好它的技能發動時間較長，容易被打斷。

1f0d55689efb81797c6ae89636bfb9a810433304.source: Interrupts or daze skills to counter Argo and Zhu Hanuku e.g. Broad Head Arrow which can be captured from Daeman in this mission itself.
1f0d55689efb81797c6ae89636bfb9a810433304.text: 打斷或眩暈技能可以對抗 艾高 和 Zhu Hanuku，例如闊首箭 可以在此任務中從 Daeman 處捕獲。

83605fa3e34117b2e730c13b8dbb922f34ad6647.source: A minion master and/or spirit spammer, since minion and spirit deaths charge the spear.
83605fa3e34117b2e730c13b8dbb922f34ad6647.text: 隨從大師和/或靈魂垃圾郵件傳送者，因為隨從和靈魂死亡會衝向長矛。

644cb4a8d2bf1602bddd148aceedcb8257482f05.source: Frozen Soil can be useful versus the Luxon clans as their bosses carry Resurrection Signet.
644cb4a8d2bf1602bddd148aceedcb8257482f05.text: 凍土 在對抗 勒克森 部落時非常有用，因為他們的頭目攜帶 復活紋章。

494e2607826267cb387009e2d046cdfba272fc6f.source: After Elder Rhea announces the start, the first gate opens when a player is in or enters the central area around the spear.
494e2607826267cb387009e2d046cdfba272fc6f.text: 雷亞長老宣佈開始後，當玩家進入或進入長矛周圍的中心區域時，第一扇門就會開啟。

35bbc957d023ed7e5518e7bb023ce03865eeb99e.source: In addition, this is the second two-party mission (after Vizunah Square). You will not be able to see the health bar of the other party, but skills that affect other allies will benefit both groups. If no party joins from the other outpost, your allies will consist of eight henchmen. You cannot use resurrect skills on the other party and the two Resurrection Orbs that can be found during the mission cannot resurrect members of the other party.
35bbc957d023ed7e5518e7bb023ce03865eeb99e.text: 此外，這是第二個雙方任務（繼薇茹廣場之後）。你將看不到對方的生命條，但影響其他盟友的技能將使雙方受益。如果沒有任何隊伍從另一個前哨加入，你的盟友將由八名追隨者組成。不能對對方使用復活技能，任務中找到的兩個復活珠也不能復活對方成員。

cefad6ec2db0bae77d06907501f098e0b321062c.source: You have plenty of time to obtain the Master's reward for the mission: the right team can finish it in less than five minutes, even in hard mode with henchmen from the other side. Even with henchmen from both sides, you should be able to finish in less than the required fifteen minutes if you proceed carefully.
cefad6ec2db0bae77d06907501f098e0b321062c.text: 你有足夠的時間來獲得主人對任務的獎勵：合適的團隊可以在不到五分鐘的時間內完成任務，即使是在困難模式下，還有來自另一方的追隨者。即使有雙方的追隨者，如果你小心行事，你應該能夠在不到十五分鐘的時間內完成任務。

4dc540440a0fe0c2fa8ef2a44b108f046cc3e4d9.source: After the initial gate opens, clear out the initial Afflicted mobs and then attack Kuunavang. Stay spread out to avoid AoE damage. Keep attacking until the first gate opens and she leaves; if you have enough firepower, you can damage her enough to open all the remaining gates, and teleport you straight to the temple, skipping all the remaining Afflicted of the mission.
4dc540440a0fe0c2fa8ef2a44b108f046cc3e4d9.text: 最初的大門開啟後，清除最初的受影響小怪，然後攻擊庫納旺。保持分散以避免 範圍性 損壞。繼續攻擊，直到第一扇門開啟，她離開；如果你有足夠的火力，你可以對她造成足夠的傷害以開啟所有剩餘的大門，並將你直接傳送到寺廟，跳過任務中所有剩餘的受折磨者。

eaee343751e21eb1d5b42c081f238ab8d2f4ba05.source: As you approach the next gate, two more groups of Afflicted spawn (the composition varies and the number depends on how many bosses appear with them). Kill the new mobs and cross the gate to find the first Resurrection Orb, which you might want to save for the final battle. Kuunavang will appear again and you must fight her again to open the next gate (and find the final Resurrection Orb). As you follow the path, two more groups of Afflicted will spawn. You can destroy them and then attack the dragon to drop the last gate or you can wait for Kuunavang to fly back towards you; as long as you stay near the gate, you will not trigger the last group.
eaee343751e21eb1d5b42c081f238ab8d2f4ba05.text: 當您接近下一個大門時，也會產生兩組受折磨的人（組成各不相同，數量取決於與他們一起出現的 Boss 數量）。殺死新的小怪並穿過大門找到第一個復活球，您可能想將其儲存到最後的戰鬥中。庫納旺將再次出現，你必須再次與她戰鬥才能開啟下一扇門（並找到最後的復活球）。當你沿著這條路走時，將會出現另外兩組受折磨者。你可以消滅它們，然後攻擊龍以放下最後一扇門，或者你可以等待庫納旺飛回你身邊；只要你待在大門附近，就不會觸發最後一組。

12eef3ee3bb7f11ce14ab9b2cf85359c992c9670.source: Lowering her health to near zero will trigger a cinematic, after which you will be transported to the temple and the final battle.
12eef3ee3bb7f11ce14ab9b2cf85359c992c9670.text: 將她的生命值降低到接近零將觸發一個過場動畫，之後您將被傳送到寺廟並進行最後的戰鬥。

1d7f1692f428146cfa5fd79d22528ae27ac8c9f2.source: The biggest danger during this part of the mission is trying to attack Kuunavang and the Afflicted at the same time. If the dragon overlaps with the other foes, retreat quickly to the outside of the path, so you are out of her reach. Finish off the Afflicted before confronting her again.
1d7f1692f428146cfa5fd79d22528ae27ac8c9f2.text: 這部分任務中最大的危險是試圖同時攻擊庫納旺和受折磨者。如果龍與其他敵人重疊，請迅速撤退到路徑外側，這樣你就超出了她的範圍。在再次面對她之前先解決受折磨者。

e01c7a003e78656995957240adac947910fa329e.source: The final battle takes place in the Harvest Temple against Enraged Kuunavang alone. Melee characters will finally be able to attack the dragon, but there is no room to maneuver and both parties will be at risk of her massive AoE damage skills, so put up protection skills as quickly as possible. Keep spread out and try to interrupt as many of her skills as possible. If she summons Corrupted Scale creatures, eliminate them before returning your attention to the dragon; you will need to call them as targets, otherwise heroes and henchmen from both sides will ignore them. Leaders of henchmen-only parties should be prepared to flag and re-flag their party repeatedly to keep them out of harm's way.
e01c7a003e78656995957240adac947910fa329e.text: 最後一場戰鬥發生在 豐收神殿 中，獨自對抗激怒的庫納萬。 肉搏角色終於可以攻擊龍了，但沒有迴旋的餘地，雙方都會面臨她巨大的範圍性傷害技能的風險，所以盡快放出保護技能。保持分散並嘗試盡可能打斷她的技能。如果她召喚腐化鱗片生物，請在將注意力轉向龍之前消滅它們；你需要稱他們為目標，否則雙方的英雄和追隨者都會忽略他們。只有追隨者的政黨的領導人應該準備好反覆標記和重新標記他們的政黨，以使其免受傷害。

30b8edf8e488f9c4669369a1aa6cb57f9408fd82.source: The mission ends when you deplete the dragon's health to near zero again.
30b8edf8e488f9c4669369a1aa6cb57f9408fd82.text: 當你將龍的生命值再次消耗到接近零時，任務結束。

5659869120f8f33170d78ec219dade3c4a9a7d38.source: Defeating Kuunavang in hard mode is only slightly more difficult, since she is not much stronger. However, the Afflicted mobs are likely to take more time to take down, so proceed more carefully.
5659869120f8f33170d78ec219dade3c4a9a7d38.text: 在困難模式下擊敗庫納旺只是稍微困難一些，因為她的實力並不強。然而，消滅受影響的生物可能需要更多時間，所以要小心行事。

76abc6f0143bc0cd80a9fe5e5aa5a6dc7e8b81db.source: You can skip the later Afflicted spawns by damaging Kuunavang quickly at the start of the mission, which triggers the pre-temple cinematic and takes you to the final battle. This makes it possible to complete the mission in under three minutes.
76abc6f0143bc0cd80a9fe5e5aa5a6dc7e8b81db.text: 你可以在任務開始時快速傷害庫納旺來跳過後來的受折磨者生成，這會觸發神廟前的過場動畫並帶你進入最後的戰鬥。這使得在三分鐘內完成任務成為可能。

0ff236a2276beaf84751ad16138109b8ae240755.source: With at least one party of mostly players and/or heroes, spike her with as much ranged damage as possible.
0ff236a2276beaf84751ad16138109b8ae240755.text: 至少有一支主要由玩家和/或英雄組成的隊伍，對她造成盡可能多的遠端傷害。

3dbd1efa6a83928bfe7c16513b73aadac57bf5aa.source: With any team (including henchmen alone), stack as many hex spells and long-lasting health degeneration on her as possible.
3dbd1efa6a83928bfe7c16513b73aadac57bf5aa.text: 對於任何團隊（包括單獨的追隨者），請在她身上疊加盡可能多的十六進位制咒語和長期的健康退化。

4ef5641c59869303bb0e77240a32736dc0667356.source: Enchantment-based builds are vulnerable to Afflicted Necromancers, Afflicted Mesmers, and Kuunavang's Corrupted Breath. Afflicted that deal physical damage can also remove enchantments when enchanted with Afflicted Necromancer's Order of Apostasy.
4ef5641c59869303bb0e77240a32736dc0667356.text: 基於 加持魔法 的建構很容易受到受影響的死靈法師、受影響的催眠師和庫納旺的腐化呼吸的影響。當受災者 死靈法師 的 背叛命令 附魔時，造成物理傷害的受災者也可以移除結界。

3b096a1d49ff2e43e6ba982495daece796b3cc92.source: Barbs combines well with the physical damage of ranger henchmen from the Luxon outpost.
3b096a1d49ff2e43e6ba982495daece796b3cc92.text: 荊棘 與 勒克森 前哨站的遊俠追隨者的物理傷害完美結合。

6a2595f9fdc1383eb1ccb15479a8a9002e9f3c06.source: If entering from the Kurzick outpost, consider not bringing Signet of Spirits, since Aeson of the Luxon party (if no player-Luxon party joins) uses it.
6a2595f9fdc1383eb1ccb15479a8a9002e9f3c06.text: 如果從 庫茲柯 前哨站進入，請考慮不要帶 縛靈紋章，因為 勒克森 隊伍的 Aeson（如果沒有玩家 勒克森 隊伍加入）使用它。

a88571d986c5012a06638c9184f162915517a91a.source: Binding Rituals such as Shelter and Displacement can easily provide protection to both parties provided the caster has a Soul Twisting-based build.
a88571d986c5012a06638c9184f162915517a91a.text: 如果施法者俱有基於 生靈扭轉 的構建，諸如 庇護 和 偏移 之類的繫結儀式可以輕鬆地為雙方提供保護。

123fb40f4b7aef5c3cd0724591923d871044d6bf.source: Ranged attacks and skills are usually easier to consistently deal damage Kuunavang during the first phase of the mission.
123fb40f4b7aef5c3cd0724591923d871044d6bf.text: 遠距 攻擊和技能通常更容易在任務的第一階段持續對 Kuunavang 造成傷害。

605123e356b4b5b2ee4af4170c13810ebb580a88.source: Armor-ignoring damage and life stealing bypass Kuunavang's high armor rating.
605123e356b4b5b2ee4af4170c13810ebb580a88.text: 防禦 - 忽略傷害和生命竊取繞過 Kuunavang 的高護甲等級。

162f6c11f7b6e21f72fba80f67baa2a2989a5670.source: Kuunavang's large amount of health makes Spoil Victor especially valuable.
162f6c11f7b6e21f72fba80f67baa2a2989a5670.text: Kuunavang 的大量生命值使得 勝者的掠奪 特別有價值。

5d4464acec47b04e5469c17a07ae667b328bafbc.source: Bring ways to mitigate her Dark Chain Lightning.
5d4464acec47b04e5469c17a07ae667b328bafbc.text: 採取一些方法來緩解她的黑暗 連鎖閃電。

70fc04d9fa13ecb87c26d7159d97ea88b5881193.text: 苦痛 逆變器將反映損壞。

eda4cb0600e8344adc6f830ba42c38fd7cbeadaa.source: Minions and spirits can absorb some of the damage.
eda4cb0600e8344adc6f830ba42c38fd7cbeadaa.text: 小兵和精魂可以吸收部分傷害。

2bbb79f3788d11dfd863c02942f41fd4fe3267ee.source: Consider other damage mitigation skills, e.g. Shelter.
2bbb79f3788d11dfd863c02942f41fd4fe3267ee.text: 考慮其他減輕傷害的技能，例如庇護。

b3c35da41894d982b9009deac137b4506d9334f3.source: Blindness prevents her from hitting the first target.
b3c35da41894d982b9009deac137b4506d9334f3.text: 失明使她無法擊中第一個目標。

801c3a5993fa5062b18b3361f178c6cf4052e854.text: 衰弱 有助於減少她的傷害。

f9d684a2328cf821eef07250cd1eeff07eac8550.text: 腐化的鱗片被視為靈魂：

4ba28b46fda3a88c8151053ddf4b53d96b70eb21.source: They are immune to hex spells and all conditions except for burning.
4ba28b46fda3a88c8151053ddf4b53d96b70eb21.text: 它們對十六進製法術和除燃燒之外的所有情況免疫。

373b0974ab1e31f108091c4f7e3e618f0ff31f66.source: They are vulnerable to anti-summon skills (e.g. Banish or Consume Soul) and will trigger effects that depend on the presence of spirits.
373b0974ab1e31f108091c4f7e3e618f0ff31f66.text: 它們很容易受到反召喚技能（例如驅逐或靈魂毀滅）的影響，並且會根據靈魂的存在而觸發效果。

772a1d62dc42cb4666c82b58c23b916575073c66.source: Kuunavang is partially resistant to interrupts.
772a1d62dc42cb4666c82b58c23b916575073c66.text: Kuunavang 對中斷具有部分抵抗力。

7e10f0625d3a8fc36b0fadecc9c2a4207936cbb8.source: To maximize your chances of preventing the dragon's skill use, take multiple interrupts and daze Kuunavang.
7e10f0625d3a8fc36b0fadecc9c2a4207936cbb8.text: 為了最大程度地阻止龍使用技能，請多次打斷並迷惑庫納旺。

43e1e16be0307bda1eac1246be2ed2d4ac1d83d2.source: She is also vulnerable to Choking Gas.
43e1e16be0307bda1eac1246be2ed2d4ac1d83d2.text: 她也容易受到 窒息毒氣 的影響。

a6a0e098f651746880c1872563d262467221752c.source: A Dissonance spirit can interrupt Kuunavang every two seconds.
a6a0e098f651746880c1872563d262467221752c.text: 失調 精魂每兩秒就可以打斷 Kuunavang。

0941c5705e0b710d654eeed3ed95be1925b416d1.source: Bring skills that can affect multiple allies. Wards and Wells are especially useful in the small battleground for the final confrontation.
0941c5705e0b710d654eeed3ed95be1925b416d1.text: 帶來可以影響多個盟友的技能。沃茲和威爾斯在最後對抗的小戰場上尤其有用。

e8f2456193fd79940d8286ab3abf6e06ff78f5a3.source: Party healing helps, e.g. Heal Party or Breath of the Great Dwarf.
e8f2456193fd79940d8286ab3abf6e06ff78f5a3.text: 隊伍 有助於治癒，例如治癒隊伍 或 偉大矮人 的呼吸。

e9116c2f94f5b5d3888131ed6d9b0246c9d9122e.source: Groups from the Kurzick and Luxon outposts can usually synchronize their entry by pressing the Enter Mission button at close to the same time.
e9116c2f94f5b5d3888131ed6d9b0246c9d9122e.text: 來自 庫茲柯 和 勒克森 前哨站的小組通常可以透過幾乎同時按下 Enter 主線任務 按鈕來同步其進入。

7489c89d9b2942b487b3fd4befa05fcaf14723d1.source: You will only encounter three of the Afflicted bosses during the mission. If you are attempting to capture skills you may need to repeat it a number of times.
7489c89d9b2942b487b3fd4befa05fcaf14723d1.text: 在任務期間你只會遇到三個受影響的 Boss。如果您試圖掌握技能，您可能需要重複多次。

85a418d35c6789bce7ab9ac509e725885cda2496.source: Until the first barrier is brought down, enough Afflicted reinforcements will spawn every two minutes (at the barrier) in order to maintain a group size of seven. Similarly, enough reinforcements will spawn at the second barrier to keep the opposition at five foes.
85a418d35c6789bce7ab9ac509e725885cda2496.text: 在第一個障礙物被摧毀之前，每兩分鐘（在障礙物處）就會產生足夠的受折磨的增援部隊，以維持七人的隊伍規模。同樣，足夠的增援部隊將在第二個障礙物處產生，以將對手限制在五個敵人之內。

6dcd7f25b9197608f558e7c663a3ab5617282d07.source: At each barrier, the composition of the group will remain the same for the remainder of the mission but will differ next time you play.
6dcd7f25b9197608f558e7c663a3ab5617282d07.text: 在每個障礙處，團隊的組成將在任務的其餘部分保持不變，但下次玩時會有所不同。

1d19c613894caa28de3f8ae7923813b1d52c9154.source: These reinforcements do not drop loot.
1d19c613894caa28de3f8ae7923813b1d52c9154.text: 這些增援不會掉落戰利品。

d0bbdba87698c24e412e811e12ae3203957ff774.source: The Kurzick party leader will have the spoken dialogue during the end cinematic unless there is no human player from that side.
d0bbdba87698c24e412e811e12ae3203957ff774.text: 庫茲柯 隊伍領袖將在影片結束時進行口頭對話，除非該方沒有人類玩家。

e3e080fabf81180f11c9c4ff6d96b9e49272d505.source: After completing this mission, your party will be taken to Harvest Temple.
e3e080fabf81180f11c9c4ff6d96b9e49272d505.text: 完成此任務後，您的隊伍將被帶到 豐收神殿。

3dc17196e699658062b4013e57d00abfcf638ada.source: If there are players on both sides then skipping the cutscenes without the other party's approval is not possible.
3dc17196e699658062b4013e57d00abfcf638ada.text: 如果雙方都有玩家，那麼在未經對方同意的情況下跳過過場動畫是不可能的。

6367313015f9e9c04ad545911ca51a7c4d5fd38b.source: If you approach her from the upper cliffside she will be in melee range, however if you approach from the lower cliffside closest to her, she will not.
6367313015f9e9c04ad545911ca51a7c4d5fd38b.text: 如果你從上懸崖接近她，她將處於近戰範圍內，但是如果你從最靠近她的下懸崖接近，她就不會。

51c15a3bb7fb8c17f1e0e5f86784d967d75fd5c5.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #9 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
51c15a3bb7fb8c17f1e0e5f86784d967d75fd5c5.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#9 頁。

3d19526252310912862b140e0c1c9e27dd1f4959.source: In the end cinematic, the gender of the voice of the lead party member is often reversed (e.g. male Assassins will get a female voice). Also, if the lead party member is female, the character model from another (male) character in the group will be used. that's another story - I'd be willing to test w/ someone else Unlike the other henchmen NPCs, if no party joined from Unwaking Waters (Luxon), Aeson uses a skill set that is different from the one he uses as a henchman.
3d19526252310912862b140e0c1c9e27dd1f4959.text: 在最終的動畫中，主角的聲音的性別通常會顛倒（例如，男性刺客將獲得女性聲音）。此外，如果主角是女性，則會使用團隊中另一個（男性）角色的角色模型。那是另一個故事了 - 我願意與其他人一起測試 與其他追隨者 NPC 不同，如果沒有任何隊伍加入不醒之水 (勒克森)，Aeson 使用的技能集與他作為追隨者使用的技能不同。

075afb33600a207b5b41aad05c14558f0c4279f0.source: de:Verschlafene Gewässer (Mission) fr:Eaux Endormies (Mission en mode coopératif)
075afb33600a207b5b41aad05c14558f0c4279f0.text: de:Verschlafene Gewässer (主線任務) fr:Eaux Endormies (主線任務 en mode coopératif)

fc03b4141eda50fca179c6c13262451861e8e3e3.source: Talk to Palace Guard Tsungkim in Raisu Pavilion to gain access to Raisu Palace.
fc03b4141eda50fca179c6c13262451861e8e3e3.text: 與 萊蘇閣 中的宮殿守衛 Tsungkim 交談以存取 萊蘇皇宮。

88fa2722124390e39037a491cbe1b7997c508620.source: See Captain Sei for your reward.
88fa2722124390e39037a491cbe1b7997c508620.text: 去找 Sei 隊長領取獎勵。

d2d2b9e957c1b9393ad6349450ae76a56abfddd1.text: 將旅行地圖對映到 凱寧中心。

c1d6122f695c3ed6bf7efb898c31ab7e77db9312.source: Head through the east portal to Raisu Pavilion.
c1d6122f695c3ed6bf7efb898c31ab7e77db9312.text: 穿過東部傳送門前往 萊蘇閣。

43fc5f16b620b4a5b191b56234084b3918e56f15.source: Speak to Palace Guard Tsungkim to access Raisu Palace.
43fc5f16b620b4a5b191b56234084b3918e56f15.text: 與宮殿守衛 Tsungkim 交談以存取 萊蘇皇宮。

dd8bdd8264cc6d2e3f80832c81c080931a24a14c.source: Speak to Captain Sei for your reward.
dd8bdd8264cc6d2e3f80832c81c080931a24a14c.text: 與 Sei 隊長交談以獲得獎勵。

8b02981bd42fbd48561f10f4180cd36afc1e9a0b.source: The first objective of this quest does not update correctly during the Dragon Festival and Anniversary Celebration, presumably because the decorated version of Kaineng Center is considered a different area. This does not prevent completion by traveling to Raisu Pavilion.
8b02981bd42fbd48561f10f4180cd36afc1e9a0b.text: 任務的第一個目標在端午節和週年慶典期間無法正確更新，大概是因為 凱寧中心 的裝飾版本被認為是不同的區域。這不會阻止透過前往 萊蘇閣 來完成。

c39fadfdfeb44b91524bc4030ae48ba65e334f1e.source: Party members that have not completed Unwaking Waters will be left behind.
c39fadfdfeb44b91524bc4030ae48ba65e334f1e.text: 未完成「不醒之水」的 隊伍 成員將被拋在後面。

1952047e656181e5dbfbf4173fc1d8ae35dc8734.source: Travel to House zu Heltzer. reads HzH, but should say AR outpost
1952047e656181e5dbfbf4173fc1d8ae35dc8734.text: 前往 鳳荷議院。讀作 HzH，但應該說 AR 前哨

176486a03d1be9db219bb8200f80dc99a9e52f88.source: Speak with Guardsman Oldrich at Altrumm Ruins.
176486a03d1be9db219bb8200f80dc99a9e52f88.text: 與 奧楚蘭廢墟 的衛兵奧爾德里奇交談。

9e5df81b22fc8c6f02fbbe6bd3e6547562a68f31.source: See Count zu Heltzer for your reward.
9e5df81b22fc8c6f02fbbe6bd3e6547562a68f31.text: 去找赫爾策伯爵領取獎勵。

e2b5dd5ab17adac3c9ffcf7a0798c0ea4067eb26.source: Once you've obtained this quest from Jamei, simply map-travel over to the Altrumm Ruins and speak with Guardsman Oldrich. He will teleport your party into House zu Heltzer, where you can collect your reward from Count zu Heltzer.
e2b5dd5ab17adac3c9ffcf7a0798c0ea4067eb26.text: 一旦你從 Jamei 那裡獲得了這個任務，只需透過地圖旅行到 奧楚蘭廢墟 並與衛兵 Oldrich 交談。他會將你的隊伍傳送到 鳳荷議院，在那裡你可以從 zu Heltzer 伯爵那裡領取獎勵。

2ac8d4ca6eac4308bb2e9132779d7b179fb3a426.source: See Kurzick faction for ways to accumulate faction. Note that faction is per account, and does not have to be accumulated on the character with the quest.
2ac8d4ca6eac4308bb2e9132779d7b179fb3a426.text: 累積 陣營值 的方法，請參閱 庫茲柯 陣營值。請注意，陣營值 是針對每個帳戶的，不必在執行任務的角色上累積。

bce9928575249d1dfa8e32073aa31425c9344c42.source: This increase is only applied once per account. To receive this reward, you must either complete the quest (if none of your characters has done so), or log in with a character in your account that has done the quest.
bce9928575249d1dfa8e32073aa31425c9344c42.text: 每個帳戶僅適用一次此增加。要獲得此獎勵，您必須完成任務（如果您的角色都沒有完成任務），或使用您帳戶中已完成任務的角色登入。

c2514213fee8745ac67d19372f32c77701aded1f.source: Speak to Klaus in Drazach Thicket.
c2514213fee8745ac67d19372f32c77701aded1f.text: 與 德瑞扎灌木林 中的克勞斯交談。

e814480f7efb4cbf58d13ec845389b9282685eee.source: Speak to Leiber in Drazach Thicket.
e814480f7efb4cbf58d13ec845389b9282685eee.text: 與 德瑞扎灌木林 中的萊伯交談。

b44ff1ef4682704245c1345201b3f9f1343a43b7.source: Speak to Ex-Redemptor Berta in Drazach Thicket.
b44ff1ef4682704245c1345201b3f9f1343a43b7.text: 與 德瑞扎灌木林 中的前救贖者貝爾塔交談。

7c8805475d76bf2a39920ea163e9f2675ca16919.text: 確保所有 3 志工的生命。

0970765536d1c14fcab3c251177d33acbc48fac9.source: Escort Klaus, Leiber, and Ex-Redemptor Berta to the Eternal Grove.
0970765536d1c14fcab3c251177d33acbc48fac9.text: 護送克勞斯、萊伯和前救贖者貝爾塔前往永恆叢林。

e6cb3145e96a30f333e4de04de40421873542319.source: See Baron Mirek Vasburg for your reward.
e6cb3145e96a30f333e4de04de40421873542319.text: 前往米雷克·瓦斯堡男爵那裡領取獎勵。

0aa20f8329d66c7697f7f0a718b3501b2113f68d.source: Follow either of the paths shown on the map. Talk with the NPCs, remember to wait for Leiber's farewell to his wife to end or you will have to backtrack to get him. Remember to heal the NPCs, as their death will result in a failure of the quest. Heroes and henchmen will do this of their own accord, but with low priority. Skills that heal all allies in an area of effect can be helpful here.
0aa20f8329d66c7697f7f0a718b3501b2113f68d.text: 沿著地圖上顯示的任一路徑行駛。與NPC交談，記得等待雷伯與妻子的告別結束，否則你將不得不原路返回才能找到他。記得治療 NPC，因為他們的死亡會導致任務失敗。英雄和追隨者會自願這樣做，但優先順序較低。治療作用範圍內所有盟友的技能在這裡會很有幫助。

653858800440a2e46c4d16ac9927ddc4a4a1c111.source: Be especially wary of approaching Mantid Bosses, as there are popups associated with them. That said, if the quest is found to be difficult, travel the path without the NPCs first and clear all enemies. Then return for the NPCs and travel to the Eternal Grove without any resistance. Talk to Sergeant Geinrich to gain access to the outpost.
653858800440a2e46c4d16ac9927ddc4a4a1c111.text: 要特別警惕接近的螳螂頭目，因為有與它們相關的彈出視窗。也就是說，如果發現任務很困難，請先走沒有 NPC 的路徑並清除所有敵人。然後返回去找 NPC，毫無抵抗地前往永恆叢林。與蓋因裡希中士交談以進入前哨站。

45bc18b91a3bdb213b9688d5b152c0630817b311.source: After retrieving Leiber, do not enter Brauer Academy or you will have to fetch the volunteers all over again.
45bc18b91a3bdb213b9688d5b152c0630817b311.text: 找回 Leiber 後，不要輸入 巴爾學院，否則您將必須重新取得志工。

26d3044e1c4acdc689d431a8ccd92b3a5c5401e3.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed The Defenders of the Forest (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Drazach Thicket will be closed.
26d3044e1c4acdc689d431a8ccd92b3a5c5401e3.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中包含任何未完成森林守護者的角色（不需要接受獎勵），德瑞扎灌木林 的大門將關閉。

dbcbed61d0296004e3d4733b32dc35657b80071e.source: The Defenders of the Forest grants access, but any characters that have not completed Befriending the Kurzicks will be left behind in Drazach Thicket.
dbcbed61d0296004e3d4733b32dc35657b80071e.text: 森林保衛者授予存取許可權，但任何未完成與 Kurzick 交友的角色將被留在 德瑞扎灌木林 中。

597bc80324b239120dd34dd574affa4aaa84c9a4.source: Alternatively, it is possible for any character to walk into the outpost from The Eternal Grove (explorable area), but this first requires you to complete Unwaking Waters from the Luxon side and glitch through the gate from Unwaking Waters (explorable area) to Unwaking Waters (Kurzick).
597bc80324b239120dd34dd574affa4aaa84c9a4.text: 或者，任何角色都可以從永恆叢林（可探索區域）走進前哨站，但這首先需要您從 勒克森 側完成不醒之水，並通過從不醒之水（可探索區域）到不醒之水（庫茲柯）的大門。

ec33ac744f8afebb89581ee7116dbc9e0d342bb5.source: Protect the Forever Trees by keeping the Tree Singers alive. You have [12...0] of 12 Tree Singers remaining.
ec33ac744f8afebb89581ee7116dbc9e0d342bb5.text: 讓樹歌手活下來，保護永恆之樹。您還剩下 [12...0] 個 12 樹歌手。

1aaaf30332dae4a77ce744cef1fdb63ff8613568.source: ADDED: Defeat the Afflicted forces. You have [12...0] groups remaining.
1aaaf30332dae4a77ce744cef1fdb63ff8613568.text: 新增：擊敗受影響的勢力。您還剩下 [12...0] 群組。

6a9e72d957bdc03f71c23a42677554070f2bb548.source: This faction can only be gained once in each difficulty mode.
6a9e72d957bdc03f71c23a42677554070f2bb548.text: 這個陣營值在每個難度模式下只能獲得一次。

df9b8ca6798ab625f8556370e6ec42d18866da95.source: In this mission, you have to defeat the corrupted version of Kuunavang in the Harvest Temple in the heart of the Jade Sea's whirlpool. Your path follows a downward spiral blocked by three gates, each powered by the dragon — they can be breached by dealing enough damage to her (the first gate opens when she reaches 75% health, the second at 50%, and the third at 25%). Each gate is blocked by groups of Afflicted, usually led by a boss, and Kuunavang cannot move back beyond an opened gate, forcing the parties to pursue her if she flees.
df9b8ca6798ab625f8556370e6ec42d18866da95.text: 在這個任務中，您必須在 碧玉海 漩渦中心擊敗 豐收神殿 中的腐敗版本 Kuunavang。你的道路沿著一條向下的螺旋前進，被三個門阻擋，每個門都由龍提供動力——可以透過對她造成足夠的傷害來突破它們（當她達到 75% 生命值時，第一個門開啟，第二個門在 50% 時開啟，第三個門在 25% 時開啟）。每個大門都被一群受折磨者擋住，通常由一個老闆領導，而庫納旺無法移出開啟的大門，迫使各方在她逃跑時追趕她。

70f7f1e61e34e7fb7bc7cff0bfc19fe6c18673d4.source: There are several challenges unique to this mission:
70f7f1e61e34e7fb7bc7cff0bfc19fe6c18673d4.text: 這項任務有幾個獨特的挑戰：

3ed5074a683ddbc5a834815b7377da3f18562ce6.source: Kuunavang can sometimes be out of melee range during her phases until you reach the temple.
3ed5074a683ddbc5a834815b7377da3f18562ce6.text: 庫納旺有時會在她的階段脫離近戰範圍，直到你到達神殿。

24f510573bf8af75ecf2b6a6072ec1b1e92020ce.source: She is semi-resistant to interrupts, taking sometimes multiple interrupts to interrupt a skill.
24f510573bf8af75ecf2b6a6072ec1b1e92020ce.text: 她對打斷具有半抗性，有時需要多次打斷才能打斷一項技能。

850ba6572a370a7941df0166c14ca7e73126f797.source: She has several deadly skills, notably Corrupted Dragon Scales (creating six creatures) and Dark Chain Lightning (which hits an initial target for 300 damage and will then hit subsequent targets, diminishing in force by 10% with each hit).
850ba6572a370a7941df0166c14ca7e73126f797.text: 她擁有多種致命技能，特別是腐化龍鱗（創造六個生物）和黑暗 連鎖閃電（擊中初始目標造成 300 傷害，然後擊中後續目標，每次擊中時力量減少 10%）。

fe411216dc53254cb6851ecca302e86280ca243e.source: Luxons will attack from all sides, coming down the paths from the north, west and south. Take care not to let any Luxon Elementalists or Luxon Warriors slip through to the Tree Singers, as they can kill the Tree Singers quickly. Luxon Rangers are a comparatively minor threat. At six timed points during this stage, a Siege Turtle will approach from a side path, its arrival announced by Baron Mirek Vasburg. The order of arrival is west, south, north, south, north and west. They will start firing at the Tree Singers if they reach the small hills, marked with X on the map, but the Tree Singers can survive a minimal bombardment and the turtles will soon redirect their fire on a Kurzick team attacking them. Don't let the Luxon Rangers distract you from protecting the Grove - the turtles are the primary threat. Killing the rangers and the two turtles to the west will trigger the cinematic and arrival of the Afflicted. You can optionally leave the rangers and turtles alive to the north and south, as they become additional allies during the Afflicted attack.
fe411216dc53254cb6851ecca302e86280ca243e.text: 盧克森人將從四方進攻，從北、西、南的路徑而來。注意不要讓任何 勒克森 元素師或 勒克森 戰士溜到樹歌者身邊，因為他們可以快速殺死樹歌者。 勒克森 遊騎兵的威脅相對較小。在這一階段的六個定時點，一隻攻城龜將從一條小路接近，由米雷克·瓦斯堡男爵宣佈其到來。到達的順序是西、南、北、南、北、西。如果樹歌手到達小山丘（地圖上標有 X），他們就會開始向樹歌手開火，但樹歌手可以在最低程度的轟炸中倖存下來，而海龜很快就會將火力轉向攻擊他們的 庫茲柯 隊伍。不要讓 勒克森 Rangers 分散您對保護樹林的注意力 - 海龜是主要威脅。殺死西邊的護林員和兩隻海龜將觸發受折磨者的動畫和到來。你可以選擇讓遊俠和海龜活著到北方和南方，因為他們在受折磨的攻擊期間會成為額外的盟友。

ce5dae79a34353a1f0153455ab8bc5fde75fd188.source: If you run a split defense, position your teams at the base of the stairs, to intercept the Luxons as early as possible and minimize travel to the Siege Turtles when they arrive. Otherwise stay in the central area to avoid lengthy runs between Luxon siege positions and only go out of the fort for quick hit-and-run attacks on the turtles.
ce5dae79a34353a1f0153455ab8bc5fde75fd188.text: 如果你進行分割防禦，請將你的隊伍部署在樓梯底部，以便儘早攔截盧克森，並在攻城龜到達時盡量減少前往它們的距離。否則，請留在中心區域，以避免在 勒克森 攻城陣地之間進行長時間的奔跑，只走出堡壘對海龜進行快速的打了就跑的攻擊。

9005fa238b7cc989b6ae98ec910fd4cfb39e0d1a.source: With heroes, the most effective way to do this is to have a team of three guarding the north entrance. Ideally, this team should consist of a minion master, a healer (skills like heal area will help) and a nuker. Position them quite far forward. Use the minimap and learn the positions of the two entrances so you can re-flag even when they're not visible (they're between the patches of green - zooming in can help). Your team (you plus four heroes) should have high damage output. A team speed boost isn't necessary, but it will definitely help. Your team guards the southern entrance. Dispatch the incoming groups as quickly as possible and constantly look for incoming siege turtles. When you see one, run towards it, kill it, then run straight back to base. Don't be tempted to mop up any other enemies you see running around. Speed is of utmost priority here - use heavy AoE damage and kill the turtles and their guards as quickly as possible. The less time you spend outside the base, the better. It can help if you create spirits dotting the map as these will distract and slow down enemies.
9005fa238b7cc989b6ae98ec910fd4cfb39e0d1a.text: 對英雄來說，最有效的方法就是派三人小隊守北入口。理想情況下，這個團隊應該由一名隨從大師、一名治療者（治療區域等技能會有所幫助）和一名核彈者組成。將它們放置在相當前面的位置。使用小地圖並瞭解兩個入口的位置，這樣即使它們不可見（它們位於綠色區域之間 - 放大可以提供幫助），您也可以重新標記。你的團隊（你加上四名英雄）應該要有高傷害輸出。團隊速度提升不是必要的，但肯定會有幫助。你的隊伍守衛南面入口。盡快遣散前來的部隊，並不斷尋找前來的攻城龜。當你看到一個時，跑向它，殺死它，然後直接跑回基地。不要試圖消滅你看到的任何其他在周圍奔跑的敵人。速度在這裡是最重要的 - 使用大量 範圍性 傷害並儘快殺死海龜及其守衛。在基地外度過的時間越少越好。如果你在地圖上創造靈魂，這會有所幫助，因為它們會分散敵人的注意力並減慢敵人的速度。

65389577ecc9c7e7f7b28109d08b3b47f7b11898.source: When you see a siege turtle heading towards the northern entrance (this should be the second wave), move your defensive team to the other (southern) gate while you head out north to kill the turtle and any mobs you come across en-route. Again, run back when it's killed. Keep flagging your defensive/base team to whatever entrance is needed while you dispatch the turtles. You may need to help them from time to time, particularly if they're under attack from elementalists.
65389577ecc9c7e7f7b28109d08b3b47f7b11898.text: 當你看到一隻攻城龜朝北入口前進時（這應該是第二波），將你的防禦團隊移至另一個（南）門，同時向北移動以殺死烏龜和你在途中遇到的任何小怪。還是那句話，被殺了就跑回來。當你派遣海龜時，不斷標記你的防守/基地團隊到任何需要的入口。你可能需要時不時地幫助他們，特別是當他們受到元素主義者的攻擊時。

e35fa98907fc28c516f401636e3bc0ae45966c0e.source: Grab the Juggernauts as soon as they become available and set them to follow you. With a split defense it is recommended to use two for the south team, one for the north. With them set to follow they will automatically return to you if killed.
e35fa98907fc28c516f401636e3bc0ae45966c0e.text: 一旦主宰可用，就抓住它們並讓他們跟隨你。分體防守時，建議南隊使用兩名，北隊使用一名。當他們設定跟隨時，如果被殺，他們會自動回到你身邊。

8ce01b08661d8c227393479757369ef2d8464be9.source: There is little doubt that the master's award for this mission is among the hardest in the campaign. It may take several attempts to learn the attack patterns and, with heroes, learn where you need to flag them for optimal positioning. However, it is achievable for teams with balanced skill builds. Thankfully, if you can survive the Luxon attack with all the Tree Singers still alive then the hardest bit is over and the next stage shouldn't pose too many problems.
8ce01b08661d8c227393479757369ef2d8464be9.text: 毫無疑問，這次任務的大師獎是競選活動中最艱難的獎項之一。可能需要多次嘗試才能瞭解攻擊模式，並且對於英雄來說，瞭解需要在哪裡標記他們以獲得最佳定位。然而，對於具有平衡技能建構的團隊來說這是可以實現的。值得慶幸的是，如果您能夠在所有樹歌手都還活著的情況下在 勒克森 攻擊中倖存下來，那麼最困難的部分就已經過去了，下一階段應該不會造成太多問題。

d79f6594040476bc93fb5048e58b1e1cdc75cb97.source: After you have beaten the Luxons, you will be attacked by waves of the more dangerous Afflicted. The Afflicted have no siege attack so you can stay inside the grove. The good news is that the Afflicted will focus more on you and your allies than the Tree Singers, meaning it's easier to simply keep your party together and move between the gates. Splitting your group (especially if you're the only player) is still possible but much more dangerous. The afflicted come in large groups and can very easily overwhelm a group of 3-4 heroes, after which they're free to flank the remaining party members or down the Tree Singers.
d79f6594040476bc93fb5048e58b1e1cdc75cb97.text: 在你擊敗盧克森人後，你將受到更危險的受災者的攻擊。受折磨者沒有圍攻攻擊，所以你可以留在樹林裡。好訊息是，與樹歌者相比，受折磨者會更專注於你和你的盟友，這意味著更容易讓你的隊伍保持在一起並在大門之間移動。分裂你的團隊（特別是如果你是唯一的玩家）仍然是可能的，但要危險得多。受折磨的人成群結隊，可以輕易地壓倒一群 3-4 英雄，之後他們可以自由地從側翼攻擊剩餘的黨員或從樹歌手那裡下來。

a6bf87b1087e48544e7388e400f6a5de8b8da0e7.source: The strategy here is similar to the first stage. Split your team to defend the two gates. There's no reason to leave the base. In the case of this mission, the best defence is NOT offence! If you decide to push out, Afflicted can and will get into your base and start attacking the Tree Singers. The stronger team should help the weaker one as soon as they're finished with their group.
a6bf87b1087e48544e7388e400f6a5de8b8da0e7.text: 這裡的策略與第一階段類似。分裂你的隊伍來保衛兩個大門。沒有理由離開基地。在這次任務中，最好的防禦不是進攻！如果您決定退出，受折磨者可以並將會進入您的基地並開始攻擊樹歌手。實力較強的球隊應該在完成小組任務後立即幫助實力較弱的球隊。

455c19a817f3b1148bcbd39f6061effba3fcc556.source: If you still want to split your team: the south gate is generally a bit tougher than the north, so if you have a disparity in the two teams, send the better one to the south. (Watch out in particular for the Afflicted Monk's Ray of Judgment, and the Afflicted Elementalist's Mind Burn.) Position your teams well inside the gates, behind the NPC defenders, closer to the NPC healers and the other team. Don't go through the gates unless mopping up. Poor positioning at this stage can lead to mission failure.
455c19a817f3b1148bcbd39f6061effba3fcc556.text: 如果你還是想分隊：南門通常比北門難一點，所以如果兩隊實力懸殊，就派更好的一支去南門。 （特別注意受影響的 僧侶 的 制裁目光 和受影響的 元素使 的 心靈燃燒。）將您的團隊部署在大門內，位於 NPC 防禦者後面，更靠近 NPC 治療者和其他團隊。除非擦乾淨，否則不要穿過大門。此階段定位不當可能會導致任務失敗。

6faeb83d8a0c3323f6199384dc79eaa68aa6f568.source: The Afflicted will always attack both gates simultaneously, but the strength of the waves varies. The first couple of waves are tougher on the southern gate, while the last few are tougher on the north gate. With the second wave, the southern gate will be attacked by the Afflicted Maaka. If you run a split team, the northern gate will usually be clear quickly, while the southern team may struggle to stay alive. In that case, the northern team should hurry to assist them. In the final wave two warriors will attempt to sneak in the southern door while the north is attacked by the Afflicted Xenxo and Senku, so make sure they are killed first before converging on the two bosses.
6faeb83d8a0c3323f6199384dc79eaa68aa6f568.text: 受折磨者總是會同時攻擊兩扇門，但波浪的強度各不相同。前幾波在南門比較難，最後幾波在北門比較難。在第二波攻擊中，南門將受到受苦瑪卡的攻擊。如果你組建一支分裂的隊伍，北門通常會很快被清理乾淨，而南門可能會很難生存。既然如此，北方隊就趕快去支援吧。在最後一波中，兩名戰士將嘗試潛入南門，而北門則受到受折磨的 Xenxo 和 Senku 的攻擊，因此請確保他們在會合到兩個 Boss 之前先被殺死。

e36552712e7c17c14bc1e476852dddaf46bf465a.source: A minion master can provide fodder against Luxon or Afflicted mobs; better still, they can help block the gates from enemy incursions.
e36552712e7c17c14bc1e476852dddaf46bf465a.text: 僕從大師可以提供對抗 勒克森 或受影響生物的素材；更好的是，它們可以幫助阻擋敵人的入侵。

8861609cd714c57859d695c9dc70c5999b1d0f84.source: At the start of the mission, you can make use of the exploitable corpses left behind by Ex-Redemptor Berta, Klaus, and Lieber as they become Juggernauts.
8861609cd714c57859d695c9dc70c5999b1d0f84.text: 在任務開始時，你可以利用前救贖者貝爾塔、克勞斯和利伯成為主宰時留下的可利用屍體。

57cd07da94196835b3778926bb96961d69703a34.source: Blood of the Master helps to keep minions alive between the waves.
57cd07da94196835b3778926bb96961d69703a34.text: 主人之血 有助於讓小兵在波浪之間保持活力。

c24f494983bb928b0cb611dbd9e6d3ab505f8609.source: A spirit spammer can patrol between the two gates and defend both at the same time as most rituals have longer duration than their cooldown and the gates are far enough from each other for duplicate spirits to not be destroyed.
c24f494983bb928b0cb611dbd9e6d3ab505f8609.text: 靈魂垃圾郵件傳送者可以在兩個大門之間巡邏並同時防禦兩個大門，因為大多數儀式的持續時間都比其冷卻時間長，而且大門彼此之間距離足夠遠，重複的靈魂不會被摧毀。

a9a35a0537ba78874a55f88facb33cb713dd34a7.source: Trapping at the entrances to the hill area can be effective.
a9a35a0537ba78874a55f88facb33cb713dd34a7.text: 在山區入口處進行誘捕可能會很有效。

1eda40c4b85e8f92ad77bbf389954148d4c7b8b4.source: Bring offensive area of effect (AoE) skills, since mobs will cluster on the stairways and at the gates. However, killing several Afflicted at the same time can cause an AoE spike from multiple Afflicted Soul Explosions.
1eda40c4b85e8f92ad77bbf389954148d4c7b8b4.text: 帶上進攻性的影響範圍（範圍性）技能，因為小怪會聚集在樓梯和門口。然而，同時殺死多個受折磨者可能會因多個受折磨者靈魂爆炸而導致 範圍性 尖峰。

5cb53e4f743ace6ec4f0b798b3d4350c0eba60ae.source: A ritualist with Life and Recuperation stationed in the center of the grove will be able to heal all the Tree Singers simultaneously as well as supporting the team.
5cb53e4f743ace6ec4f0b798b3d4350c0eba60ae.text: 駐紮在樹林中心的帶有 生命 和 復原 的儀式師將能夠同時治癒所有樹歌者並支援團隊。

b5823b8029dde1de3f8a3f24b3e1056a9d0e6411.source: A single well-timed Pain Inverter can instantly kill a turtle, even in hard mode.
b5823b8029dde1de3f8a3f24b3e1056a9d0e6411.text: 即使在困難模式下，一個適時的 苦痛 逆變器也可以立即殺死一隻烏龜。

cb19d1d82c6cf934e18e568794fe458c062a6511.source: Bring party range skills (such as Heal Party or Light of Deliverance).
cb19d1d82c6cf934e18e568794fe458c062a6511.text: 帶上隊伍範圍技能（例如治癒隊伍或拯救聖光）。

fc60bc22229d1410a94ceae026ea9cf200a40c59.source: Necromancer orders skills can be helpful.
fc60bc22229d1410a94ceae026ea9cf200a40c59.text: 死靈法師 指令技巧可能會有所幫助。

f43f0c548646d66982c5a7c317e90abafc215a59.source: Offensive binding ritual spirits can be set at each gate by the same caster, as they are far enough apart.
f43f0c548646d66982c5a7c317e90abafc215a59.text: 攻擊性束縛儀式靈可以由同一施法者在每個門處設定，因為它們之間的距離足夠遠。

1bec7559990226f5eac7ff715ac4cf8746f14b5a.source: Defensive spirits such as Shelter can be placed between the gates and reach allies at both gates, making it an ideal location for a Soul Twisting Ritualist. Heroes will typically require manual control to place spirits in this position.
1bec7559990226f5eac7ff715ac4cf8746f14b5a.text: 防衛 精神（例如 庇護）可以放置在大門之間並到達兩個大門的盟友，使其成為 生靈扭轉 祭祀者 的理想位置。英雄通常需要手動控制才能將靈魂放置在這個位置。

2bbb9c01bfce1300225c005ba9bca6089605e795.source: It is possible to gain about 2% toward the Canthan Cartographer title track here just by exploring. Flag your NPCs around the trees and explore.
2bbb9c01bfce1300225c005ba9bca6089605e795.text: 只要探索，就可以瞭解關於 Canthan 版圖 主打歌的 2%。在樹林周圍標記您的 NPC 並進行探索。

b9d7cc73cc19c963b8d6ba10735fc29361af0d96.source: The mission won't advance to the Afflicted phase if there are still Luxons alive in all three groups outside the gates. You can take advantage of this to explore the map, then kill the Western group completely when you wish to proceed.
b9d7cc73cc19c963b8d6ba10735fc29361af0d96.text: 如果大門外的所有三個群體中仍然有盧克森人活著，任務將不會進入受折磨階段。你可以利用這個機會探索地圖，然後在你想繼續的時候徹底殺死西方隊伍。

bec1e73c7fc79f13c0f18ae2857bf1ad3fc8aeb1.source: Pet - Elder Reef Lurker as allies won't attack, yet the Luxon Soldiers still use pet attack skills.
bec1e73c7fc79f13c0f18ae2857bf1ad3fc8aeb1.text: 寵物 - 老礁石潛伏者作為盟友不會攻擊，但 勒克森 士兵仍然使用寵物攻擊技能。

582328cbda8d05457e385c0cd48eae6d3efe3f1f.source: Occasionally, if the Luxon Soldiers die before their pets, the pets will become invulnerable until the corpse of the Luxon Soldier disappears.
582328cbda8d05457e385c0cd48eae6d3efe3f1f.text: 有時，如果 勒克森 士兵先於寵物死亡，則寵物將變得無敵，直到 勒克森 士兵的屍體消失。

714ed936caa7e2cc12b7eb5e110e4fe6170cecba.source: When the final group containing the bosses dies, remaining Afflicted from other groups will immediately die as well and the mission will complete.
714ed936caa7e2cc12b7eb5e110e4fe6170cecba.text: 當包含 Boss 的最後一組死亡時，其他組中剩餘的受影響者也將立即死亡，任務將完成。

3db41ebb9db5e336d288a59f327ee239005f9ff6.source: If a Juggernaut dies, it will revive at the Forever Tree that spawned it, provided at least one Tree Singer remains alive at the tree.
3db41ebb9db5e336d288a59f327ee239005f9ff6.text: 如果主宰死亡，它會在生成它的永恆之樹處復活，前提是樹上至少有一名樹歌者還活著。

623298332ed0e3ab42a43bf198458a7c4a55d0eb.source: The western Siege Turtle and its group are within longbow range of the western Forever Tree.
623298332ed0e3ab42a43bf198458a7c4a55d0eb.text: 西部攻城龜及其群體位於西部永恆之樹的長弓射程。

9e9f714366d951817a48fa56e3964772765e24c1.source: Completion of this mission will fill in page #7 of the Shiro's Return storybook.
9e9f714366d951817a48fa56e3964772765e24c1.text: 完成此任務將填入 Shiro 的 影返 故事書的#7 頁。

f0aaee70530bdaacd21556549996e05b2ffcbf3e.source: After completion, your party will be teleported to Vasburg Armory.
f0aaee70530bdaacd21556549996e05b2ffcbf3e.text: 完成後，您的隊伍將會傳送至 維思柏兵營。

e8afbfbb5ebcc3af1e4027eed397988ce6d8f4c5.source: Siege Turtles and Luxon Rangers on the small hills from groups before the final group will remain hostile after the intermediate cinematic. The Afflicted will still attack them and vice-versa.
e8afbfbb5ebcc3af1e4027eed397988ce6d8f4c5.text: 攻城龜和 勒克森 遊騎兵在最後一組之前的小山上，在中間過場動畫之後將保持敵對狀態。受折磨者仍會攻擊他們，反之亦然。

9358e06359b6b68e94107f192f9525cad555068d.source: As the first wave of Luxon approach from the west, the party can intercept these enemies as a large group. Killing the Siege Turtle before it has reached its destination may prevent the mission from continuing onto the Afflicted stage, however.
9358e06359b6b68e94107f192f9525cad555068d.text: 當第一波 勒克森 從西邊逼近時，隊伍可以以大隊的形式攔截這些敵人。然而，在攻城龜到達目的地之前將其殺死可能會阻止任務繼續進入受折磨的階段。

25f36beebd408583b7a96bad3d5af8f0751ad809.source: Sometimes not all the Luxons turn friendly when the Afflicted phase begins. If there are both friendly and foe Luxons left in the same group they will spend the phase fighting each other.
25f36beebd408583b7a96bad3d5af8f0751ad809.text: 有時，當受折磨階段開始時，並不是所有的盧克森人都會變得友善。如果同一組中同時存在友方和敵人盧克森，他們將在這一階段互相戰鬥。

de2a9d3ae6b7b7a43c25f752b08c08c4f2d82f46.source: de:Der Ewige Hain (Mission) fr:Le Verger Eternel (Mission en mode coopératif)
de2a9d3ae6b7b7a43c25f752b08c08c4f2d82f46.text: de:Der Ewige Hain (主線任務) fr:Le Verger Eternel (主線任務 en mode coopératif)

84808bb449e4276a4d64079b0591b5bbca42352d.source: Travel with Mhenlo to the edge of the Unwaking Waters.
84808bb449e4276a4d64079b0591b5bbca42352d.text: 與 涵洛 一起前往不醒水域的邊緣。

2418657bb1d214314a9d0f4c367d4b5e4957c601.source: Speak with Acolyte Jorg to gain access to the Unwaking Waters.
2418657bb1d214314a9d0f4c367d4b5e4957c601.text: 與侍僧喬格交談以進入不醒水域。

cb92ccd1063cc1bd0386f3851cfdb2a2d5eb45f0.source: See Redemptor Iszar for your reward.
cb92ccd1063cc1bd0386f3851cfdb2a2d5eb45f0.text: 前往救贖者伊札爾領取獎勵。

c7c214765e4855c972a365b6b9ab752fb2583671.source: As you enter this mission note the additional health display which shows the health status of the three Forever Trees. The trees are located at the points 1, 2 and 3 on the map. There are four Tree Singers grouped around each tree - each singer contributes for one quarter of the tree's health. As the singers take damage the tree will also take damage. If a singer dies the tree is permanently damaged by a quarter; however seeing the bar go down by a quarter does not mean a Tree Singer has died - several could merely be injured, making it look as if one has died. If all four singers of one tree are dead the tree will be also. Only one Tree Singer/tree needs to survive the mission to complete it.
c7c214765e4855c972a365b6b9ab752fb2583671.text: 當您進入此任務時，請注意附加的健康狀況顯示，其中顯示了三棵永恆之樹的健康狀況。這些樹位於地圖上的 1、2 和 3 點。每棵樹周圍有四名樹歌手 - 每個歌手貢獻樹四分之一的生命值。當歌手受到傷害時，樹也會受到傷害。如果歌手去世，這棵樹將永久受損四分之一；然而，看到酒吧下降四分之一並不意味著樹歌手已經死亡——可能只是有幾個人受傷，看起來好像有人已經死了。如果一棵樹上的四個歌手都死了，那麼這棵樹也會死。只有一棵樹歌手/樹需要在任務中倖存下來才能完成任務。

eba6b346b493c4e8271565e9070e639c927a7c01.source: Baron Mirek Vasburg, Danika, and Mhenlo are present as stationary allies. Danika and Mhenlo will heal the party, but you will have no control over them whatsoever and they cannot be resurrected. Their death does not result in a failure of the mission. Danika spawns at the beginning of the mission and is stationed in the middle of the grove. Mhenlo spawns after the intermediate cinematic and is stationed at the north gate.
eba6b346b493c4e8271565e9070e639c927a7c01.text: 米雷克·瓦斯堡男爵、丹尼卡和 涵洛 作為固定盟友出現。 Danika 和 涵洛 會治癒隊伍，但你無法控制他們，而且他們無法復活。他們的死亡不會導致任務失敗。丹妮卡在任務開始時生成，駐紮在樹林中央。 涵洛 在中間過場動畫之後生成，駐紮在北門。

0d775c4481d0ea11f04a8631980390147b2e72d3.source: Three Juggernauts are available to assist you after they have been transformed, and they can be ordered to follow you or defend a spot (talking to them once will set them to follow you, talking to them again will make them defend where they are). While close to a Juggernaut, you will benefit from the Aura of the Juggernaut (which boosts your energy regeneration).
0d775c4481d0ea11f04a8631980390147b2e72d3.text: 三名主宰在變形後可以為你提供幫助，並且可以命令他們跟隨你或防守一個地點（與他們交談一次將使他們跟隨你，再次與他們交談將使他們防守他們所在的位置）。當接近主宰時，你將受益於主宰光環（這會促進你的能量再生）。

95d43ff8b6439e94b573b82ccd1e70ff7bfea7fa.source: The hill has only two entrances through which opponents can get to the Tree Singers, and is covered by the Aura of the Grove environmental effect, which provides a speed boost while in the area. A good tactic for the first part is for the party to split up into two balanced groups of 4 players (or heroes, if available; note that this split team tactic is very difficult with henchmen), one guarding each gate. Most of the foes in the mission will approach the hill but it is sometimes advantageous or necessary to leave it and engage them outside.
95d43ff8b6439e94b573b82ccd1e70ff7bfea7fa.text: 這座山只有兩個入口，對手可以通過這兩個入口到達樹歌手，並且被叢林光環環境效果覆蓋，可以在該區域提供速度提升。第一部分的一個好策略是將隊伍分成兩組平衡的 4 玩家（或英雄，如果有的話；請注意，這種分隊策略對追隨者來說非常困難），每個門都有一個人守衛。任務中的大多數敵人都會接近山丘，但有時離開山丘並在外面與他們交戰是有利的或必要的。

c1de8072994f160c26ea155aabd82ad9a9cba7eb.source: During the second stage of the mission you will be joined by a handful of Luxons plus any that were left alive from the first stage.
c1de8072994f160c26ea155aabd82ad9a9cba7eb.text: 在任務的第二階段中，少數盧克森人和第一階段中倖存的人將加入您的行列。

ff09c044549eb8ab375a29be7daa65ebe099f9c3.source: Protecting the Tree Singers while taking out the Siege Turtles is the goal for this stage.
ff09c044549eb8ab375a29be7daa65ebe099f9c3.text: 保護樹歌者並消滅攻城龜是這一階段的目標。

cb5089f6d44a842f1b8020405c563408ed4e951a.source: Upon entering Morostav Trail, go north a little bit to meet with Mhenlo. Then fight your way to the east until you reach Acolyte Jorg in front of a gate. Speak with him to be greeted with a cinematic.
cb5089f6d44a842f1b8020405c563408ed4e951a.text: 進入 摩洛神秘通道 後，往北走一點與 涵洛 會合。然後向東殺出一條路，直到到達門前的侍僧喬格。與他交談即可觀看電影。

a8e2b92d2dfa5effec3b9679d170bcc9ee8bda17.source: Do not go past the large pond with Arbor Earthcall. This path has a dead end, many foes, and several bosses. This combination may cause a wipe and if Mhenlo dies, you have to restart the quest.
a8e2b92d2dfa5effec3b9679d170bcc9ee8bda17.text: 使用 大地之喚 亞伯 時請勿經過大池塘。這條路有一條死衚衕，有許多敵人，還有幾個頭目。此組合可能會導致擦除，如果 涵洛 死亡，您必須重新開始任務。

7e0a431a6688d0c7716bdb7cd7a76b2da3ca7a54.text: 前往 佐席洛斯水道。

9d83eeb1bdbaf34e97a70ec1bf25f48429c0f59e.source: Map travel to the Zos Shivros Channel and speak with Watchman Bencis. He'll warp you into Cavalon, where you can speak with Elder Rhea to get your reward.
9d83eeb1bdbaf34e97a70ec1bf25f48429c0f59e.text: 將旅行對映到 佐席洛斯水道 並與守望者本西斯交談。他會傳送你到 卡瓦隆，在那裡你可以與瑞亞長老交談以獲得獎勵。

f9374b3b21d2af4f3e9765c0a104a8a73657d418.source: The mission Boreas Seabed now gives 1000 faction per level of completion for a total of 3000 faction that can be earned fairly quickly with just Heroes and/or Henchmen.
f9374b3b21d2af4f3e9765c0a104a8a73657d418.text: 北風之神海底任務現在為每個完成等級提供 1000 陣營值，總計 3000 陣營值，只需使用英雄和/或 傭兵 即可相當快地獲得。

3e0ef08279cf97ef8683881c06708e31c36ebe9b.source: If you have access to Hard mode, then vanquishing an area is your best option - you gain more faction per kill from the Blessing of the Luxons - and vanquishing an entire zone will reward an additional faction bonus. The most efficient vanquish is in Mount Qinkai, which should take less than 25 minutes for about 10k faction.
3e0ef08279cf97ef8683881c06708e31c36ebe9b.text: 如果您有權利使用 困難模式，那麼征服一個區域是您的最佳選擇 - 每次擊殺 Luxons 的 祝福 時您都會獲得更多 陣營值 - 並且征服整個區域將獎勵額外的 陣營值 獎勵。最有效的征服是在 今凱山 中，大約需要不到 25 分鐘的時間，大約是 10k 陣營值。

15276230baf4739b3e4545904cbb52f8838fe3b9.source: The table below provides a summary of quests in and around Cavalon that can be performed to obtain the required faction points. Note that even if you complete every quest you will not generate enough faction (except if you repeat the repeatable quests) - so you would have to take the Blessing of the Luxons so that you can gain some Luxon faction while killing foes.
15276230baf4739b3e4545904cbb52f8838fe3b9.text: 下表提供了 卡瓦隆 及其周圍的任務摘要，執行這些任務可以獲得所需的 陣營值 點數。請注意，即使您完成每個任務，您也不會產生足夠的 陣營值（除非您重複可重複的任務） - 因此您必須採取 Luxons 的 祝福，以便在殺死敵人時獲得一些 勒克森榮譽值。

1f92c9d1493e19c42e53eeaa953e7fdb577b4f93.source: Since faction points are shared among characters of the same account it may be worth considering to do this quest with more than one character simultaneously, so that those characters benefit from the collected Faction.
1f92c9d1493e19c42e53eeaa953e7fdb577b4f93.text: 由於 陣營值 點在同一帳戶的角色之間共享，因此可能值得考慮同時與多個角色一起執行此任務，以便這些角色從收集的派系中受益。

433c560dfc21ce0734574846828204177c78c2f4.source: Recover the stolen chest of turtle eggs.

50e9925e35993adfa77dd5c95d918d0dd4a45640.source: Return the chest of turtle eggs to Hatchery Keeper Gratian.
50e9925e35993adfa77dd5c95d918d0dd4a45640.text: 影返 將一箱海龜蛋交給孵化場管理員 Gratian。

b46883552338a029f99fc4743a5b4f7c87557d6b.source: From Cavalon follow the path on the mission map east then north. The chest is located in the southwest corner of Maishang Hills, point 1 on the mission map. Sergeant Rodrik and the Outcast crew will start a conversation once you get close, and soon will become hostile and attack. After the fight is over, grab the chest and follow the path marked on the mission map. After crossing the bridge at point 2, you will need to turn almost 180 degrees to the left and take the path heading south. Take the chest to Gyala Hatchery which is in the southeast corner of the same territory. The Kappa and Naga you encounter along this path are quite strong so come prepared. Also as you approach the beach at the end, you will run into a group of Naga which includes Stsou Swiftscale.
b46883552338a029f99fc4743a5b4f7c87557d6b.text: 從 卡瓦隆 出發，沿著任務地圖上的路徑向東然後向北行駛。寶箱位於 麥尚山丘 的西南角，任務地圖上的 1 點。羅德里克中士和流亡者船員一旦靠近就會開始對話，很快就會產生敵意並發動攻擊。戰鬥結束後，抓住箱子並沿著任務地圖上標記的路徑走。在 2 點過橋後，您需要向左轉幾乎 180 度，然後沿著向南的路徑行駛。將箱子帶到位於同一區域東南角的蓋拉孵化所。您在這條路上遇到的 Kappa 和 納迦 非常強大，所以要做好準備。另外，當您接近最後的海灘時，您會遇到一群 納迦，其中包括 Stsou Swiftscale。

1d30e108f0209e3157d212f8a03a3c180ff7ab36.source: The chest is a bundle item, which provides no blessing of any kind, but does not interfere with movement speed.
1d30e108f0209e3157d212f8a03a3c180ff7ab36.text: 寶箱是捆綁物品，不提供任何祝福，但不影響移動速度。

a6a307318d4bacfff4c0e229e2c396be55879c14.source: Stsou Swiftscale will not spawn if the quest Attack the Kurzicks! is active.
a6a307318d4bacfff4c0e229e2c396be55879c14.text: 如果任務“攻擊庫茲克！”，Stsou Swiftscale 將不會生成。是活躍的。

501176e819114e043d93ee645a29f535247fbc0f.source: It is possible to run this quest without attacking any foes.
501176e819114e043d93ee645a29f535247fbc0f.text: 可以在不攻擊任何敵人的情況下執行此任務。

a437ffe07113c09ab71b3bed6b14009666aab486.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Stolen Eggs (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Maishang Hills will be closed.
a437ffe07113c09ab71b3bed6b14009666aab486.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中有任何未完成「偷蛋」的角色（不需要接受獎勵），麥尚山丘 的大門將關閉。

d87276a02f9ce3b6b6d5131ca37fe058474fc69e.source: Stolen Eggs grants access, but any characters that have not completed Befriending the Luxons will be left behind in Maishang Hills.
d87276a02f9ce3b6b6d5131ca37fe058474fc69e.text: 被盜的雞蛋授予訪問許可權，但任何未完成與 Luxons 交友的角色將被留在 麥尚山丘 中。

86e94741f3f69f5fa70f01209ddc40c2d9a43779.source: Access through Gyala Hatchery (explorable area) is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Befriending the Luxons.
86e94741f3f69f5fa70f01209ddc40c2d9a43779.text: 透過 蓋拉孵化所（可探索區域）進入是不可用的，因為在沒有完成與 Luxons 交友之前沒有通往那裡的路線。

0d4ecbe94aa3ede99be37c2c9bb4c85ad7a7387d.source: Escort the young turtles to the Leviathan Pits.
0d4ecbe94aa3ede99be37c2c9bb4c85ad7a7387d.text: 護送幼龜前往 利拜亞森礦場。

f273025b928b274149aeb70eb71d807dfbba8912.source: At least 1 young turtle must survive. You have [5...0] remaining.
f273025b928b274149aeb70eb71d807dfbba8912.text: 至少 1 幼龜必須生存。您還剩 [5...0]。

d32ba4cbabd91408b69f954f9cace8d727666f58.source: This walkthrough involves sticking with the turtles - see the Hard Mode section for a more advanced method involving running ahead at times to clear foes.
d32ba4cbabd91408b69f954f9cace8d727666f58.text: 本演練涉及堅持使用海龜 - 請參閱「困難模式」部分，以瞭解更高階的方法，包括有時向前奔跑以清除敵人。

9076ee1ee7a14efbb46ff2813f5cb87000eb681e.source: Walk towards the caravan lead by Argo to start the journey, and take a smoke canister from Petras. Shortly after the caravan begins moving, at point 1 on the map (white text), the turtles will stop and Kurzicks will approach. Drop your smoke canister amongst the Young Turtles and wait for them to arrive. The first foes will be three juggernauts and a handful of Kurzick Warriors. Focus on the juggernauts to prevent them from killing a Siege Turtle; the bombardment should make short work of the warriors. They will quickly be followed by more warriors and a few Kurzick Monks; leave the canister where it is and focus on the warriors first unless you find yourself struggling to overcome the monks' healing, in which case you may find it easier to kill the monks first while they are still trying to heal the bombarded warriors.
9076ee1ee7a14efbb46ff2813f5cb87000eb681e.text: 走向艾高帶領的商隊開始旅程，從佩特拉斯拿走煙霧罐。商隊開始移動後不久，在地圖上的 1 點（白色文字），海龜將停下來，庫爾茲克斯將接近。將你的煙霧罐丟到小海龜中間，等待他們的到來。第一批敵人將是三位主宰者和少數 庫茲柯 戰士。 聚能器 對主宰者進行攻擊，以防止他們殺死攻城龜；轟炸應該很快就能消滅戰士們。他們很快就會被更多的戰士和一些 庫茲柯 僧侶追隨；將罐子留在原處，首先關注戰士，除非你發現自己很難克服僧侶的治療，在這種情況下，你可能會發現在僧侶仍在嘗試治療被轟炸的戰士時先殺死他們會更容易。

e76a922591ca5be15b73daf8ca945ac3b302ce1f.source: After these foes have been dealt with, the caravan will begin moving again. At point 2 on the map, you will see Kurzicks waiting up ahead. The turtles will stop just before them, and then they will begin to rush to the caravan. You may place the canister amongst the Young Turtles again, but as this fight mostly involves ranger and spellcaster foes, it may be more effective to place the canister on the beach to the left, near the coral bed. When the initial foes are almost all dead, Argo will announce that a lot of Kurzicks are approaching. The Kurzicks will come from all three directions; pick off the Kurzick Elementalists quickly and focus on the juggernauts when they arrive, then attack the warriors (especially if you did not place the smoke canister within the caravan) and finally finish off the rangers. When all foes are dead, the caravan will move on.
e76a922591ca5be15b73daf8ca945ac3b302ce1f.text: 解決掉這些敵人後，商隊將再次開始行進。在地圖上的 2 點，您會看到 Kurzicks 在前面等待。海龜會停在他們面前，然後開始衝向商隊。你可以再次將罐子放在幼龜中間，但由於這場戰鬥主要涉及遊俠和施法者敵人，因此將罐子放在左側海灘上靠近珊瑚床的地方可能更有效。當最初的敵人幾乎全部死亡時，艾高 會宣佈大量庫茲克人正在逼近。庫茲克人將來自三個方向；快速幹掉 庫茲柯 元素師，並在主宰到來時集中精力攻擊他們，然後攻擊戰士（特別是如果你沒有將煙霧罐放置在商隊內），最後幹掉遊騎兵。當所有敵人都死掉後，商隊就會繼續前進。

5f4410db2ae425bc35fcf5533c2e0f3f41d82cc6.source: At point 3, there will be a large number of Kurzicks underneath the Leviathan, who will begin to rush the caravan after a short delay. These foes consist mainly of warriors, so place the smoke canister amongst the Young Turtles again. A wave of Kurzicks will then come from the north, again containing mainly warriors. Dispatch these as normal, and move on to point 4. Here there will be two groups of Kurzicks waiting, one to the south and one to the west. Aside from the juggernauts, these foes all use ranged attacks, so you may want to place the smoke canister near one group and let the Siege Turtles take them out while your party focuses on the other. However, beware that near the end of this fight two more Kurzick groups will come from the north and the west with large numbers of warriors, and you will want to move the smoke canister to the center of the caravan. If this gives you trouble, leave the canister in the middle of the caravan at the beginning of the fight.
5f4410db2ae425bc35fcf5533c2e0f3f41d82cc6.text: 在3點，利維坦下方會有大量的庫茲克人，他們會在短暫的延遲後開始衝向商隊。這些敵人主要由戰士組成，因此請將煙霧罐再次放置在幼龜中間。隨後，一波庫茲克人將從北方而來，同樣主要由戰士組成。正常排程這些，然後繼續到 4 點。這裡將有兩群庫爾茲克人等待，一組在南邊，一組在西邊。除了主宰者之外，這些敵人都使用遠端攻擊，因此你可能需要將煙霧罐放置在一組附近，讓攻城龜幹掉他們，而你的隊伍則專注於另一組。然而，要注意的是，在這場戰鬥即將結束時，另外兩個 庫茲柯 隊伍將從北部和西部帶著大量戰士而來，你需要將煙霧罐移至商隊的中心。如果這給你帶來麻煩，請在戰鬥開始時將罐子留在商隊中間。

eb5082bd3fdc0badd79f1ff4de897415e3d8ca18.source: At point 6 on the map you will initially face two groups of Kurzicks, one from the west and one from the south. Place the smoke canister at the top of the slope to the west and focus on the juggernauts and warriors before killing the smaller southern group. When these groups are dead, two very large waves of Kurzicks will approach from the west. However, do not panic: remain within the caravan until they arrive and then focus on the warriors. If done correctly, the rangers will stop near the smoke canister, and the Siege Turtles will make short work of them. Retreat to within the caravan when the second wave approaches so that the rangers will again be drawn to the canister, and fight this wave as you did the last one.
eb5082bd3fdc0badd79f1ff4de897415e3d8ca18.text: 在地圖上的 6 點，您最初將面對兩組庫爾茲克人，一組來自西部，一組來自南部。將煙霧罐放置在西邊斜坡的頂部，集中攻擊主宰者和戰士，然後再殺死較小的南部群體。當這些群體死亡後，兩波非常大的庫爾茲克人將從西邊逼近。不過，別驚慌：留在商隊內，直到他們到達，然後專注於戰士。如果操作正確，遊騎兵將停在煙霧罐附近，而攻城龜很快就會解決他們。當第二波浪潮接近時，撤退到商隊內部，以便遊騎兵再次被吸引到罐子附近，並像上一波一樣對抗這一波浪潮。

470ebe9d9ec5637cbe2a9b7b12fe527713ccfc1a.source: Once these foes are killed, the caravan will move towards point 7. Pick up the smoke canister and wait. A cinematic will trigger and then the Afflicted will assault both Luxons and Kurzicks from the north. They mostly come in small numbers, with only one large group, and pose little threat especially with both Kurzick and Luxon allies to help you. The Young Turtles will be far behind you, so they are at minimal risk. At the start of the fight, drop your smoke canister some way behind the gate; if you struggle, you can retreat to pull the Afflicted towards it. Do not place the canister too far forward or the slope will obstruct the Siege Turtles' line of sight. The mission will complete when the last of the Afflicted is killed.
470ebe9d9ec5637cbe2a9b7b12fe527713ccfc1a.text: 一旦這些敵人被殺死，商隊就會前往 7 點。拿起煙罐並等待。一段過場動畫將會觸發，然後受苦者將從北方攻擊盧克森人和庫茲克人。他們大多較少，只有一大群，不會構成什麼威脅，尤其是有 庫茲柯 和 勒克森 盟友來幫助你。小海龜會遠遠落後於你，所以他們面臨的風險很小。戰鬥開始時，將煙霧罐扔到大門後面某處；如果你掙扎，你可以撤退，將受折磨的人拉向它。不要將罐子放置得太靠前，否則斜坡會阻礙攻城龜的視線。當最後一個受折磨者被殺死時任務就會完成。

782383418184db97a81c14628ac69e561f5a3e56.source: This method takes 30 (with speedbuff eg. pcons) to up to 45 minutes to complete but gives you the opportunity to take your time and pull smaller groups and almost always results in a master's reward. As soon as the mission starts, turn right and head west to the far NW corner of the map. Turn south and hug the right hand wall and make your way to the very south of the map. The mission dialog will continue and you will even see Argo say, "Turtle clan, move out!". However, at this point, the turtles will continue to stay put near Gyala Hatchery.
782383418184db97a81c14628ac69e561f5a3e56.text: 此方法需要 30（使用 speedbuff，例如 pcons）最多 45 分鐘才能完成，但讓您有機會慢慢來並拉動較小的團體，並且幾乎總是會獲得大師的獎勵。任務一開始，右轉並向西前往地圖最遠的西北角。向南轉，緊靠右手邊的牆，然後前往地圖的最南端。任務對話方塊將繼續，您甚至會看到 艾高 說：「海龜部落，撤離！」。然而，此時，海龜將繼續留在 蓋拉孵化所 附近。

391570b8f57d6323d50ec5ec1a80d7137516c425.source: There will be 10 areas of Kurzicks and Kurzick Juggernauts that you will need to clear out. Move up the mission path "backwards" starting from yellow point #1 on the map, killing all Kurzicks on the way, and ending up back at Gyala Hatchery and the turtles who will still be waiting for you at yellow point #8. Since you lack the Siege Turtles' firepower, be careful not to be overwhelmed - best technique here is to pull small groups at a time and then run out of the way of the large Kurzick forces that rush to that location. Draw each subsequent group and keep an eye on rush attacks. Deal with these smaller groups at your leisure.
391570b8f57d6323d50ec5ec1a80d7137516c425.text: 您需要清除庫茲克和 庫茲柯 主宰的 10 區域。從地圖上的黃點#1開始「向後」移動任務路徑，殺死途中所有的Kurzicks，最後回到蓋拉孵化所，而海龜仍然會在黃點#8等你。由於你缺乏攻城龜的火力，請小心不要被淹沒 - 這裡最好的技巧是一次拉出一小群，然後跑開沖向該位置的大型 庫茲柯 部隊。繪製每個後續組並密切注意突襲攻擊。閒暇時與這些較小的團體打交道。

ad68186f1ad3e916ead50a243902f278088d598a.source: After arriving back at the turtles, take the smoke canisters (from Petras) and immediately drop them on the Young Turtles. Kurzick groups will charge at the turtles from the sides while juggernauts will come from the south. Dropping the canisters on the Young Turtles will help take care of most of the Kurzick forces and the juggernauts can be killed before they reach the turtles. Grab a canister and follow the turtles back down the path south to yellow points #7 through #3. There will be a short encounter on the way near yellow point #6, so don't rush ahead of the turtles. However, this is a much smaller group of Kurzick and should pose no problem.
ad68186f1ad3e916ead50a243902f278088d598a.text: 回到海龜身邊後，拿起煙霧罐（來自佩特拉）並立即將其扔到幼龜身上。 庫茲柯 小組將從側面向海龜發起衝鋒，而主宰部隊將從南方而來。將罐子扔到幼龜身上將有助於對付大部分 庫茲柯 部隊，並且可以在巨獸到達幼龜之前將其殺死。拿起一個罐子，跟著海龜沿著小徑往南返回到黃點 #7 到 #3。靠近黃點#6 的路上會有短暫的遭遇，所以不要衝到海龜前面。然而，這是一個小得多的 庫茲柯 組，應該不會造成任何問題。

a9f08123b904a7f7ce4ce933c9098a02e5c6f2eb.source: As you make your way south, the mission dialog will continue. Although the turtles will stop periodically and Argo will say things like "To arms! To arms! Kurzicks approaching!", you will not have any additional encounters. Once you arrive at point #4, the cinematic will trigger; however, the mission is not over yet. You need to face 3 small waves of Afflicted and defeat them. Try to battle them outside the gate away from the Young Turtles. You can still take advantage of the smoke canisters for this final battle. Finish them off and you've completed the mission and hopefully achieved a master's award.
a9f08123b904a7f7ce4ce933c9098a02e5c6f2eb.text: 當你向南前進時，任務對話將會繼續。儘管海龜會定期停下來，並且 艾高 會說“拿起武器！拿起武器！庫爾茲克正在逼近！”，但您不會再遇到任何額外的遭遇。一旦你到達#4點，過場動畫就會觸發；然而，任務還沒結束。你需要面對 3 的小波受災者並擊敗他們。嘗試在遠離幼龜的門外與他們戰鬥。在這場最後的戰鬥中，你仍然可以利用煙霧罐。解決掉它們，你就完成了任務，並有望獲得大師獎。

7b66855f42660aa68f4cb73425a234de841dadcd.source: Start off from the northwestern corner as stated above but instead of going all the way to the bottom, head to the break in the surf in front of point #1 (see accompanying map). Kill the Kurzicks there. More Kurzicks will spawn behind you where you entered the gap. Pull carefully and they will go down easy.
7b66855f42660aa68f4cb73425a234de841dadcd.text: 如上所述，從西北角出發，但不要一直走到底部，而是前往 #1 點前面的海浪休息處（請參閱隨附地圖）。殺死那裡的庫茲克人。更多的庫茲克人會在你進入缺口的地方產卵。小心地 拉出，它們會很容易被擊倒。

bff3f575ba38a3dd0f9aeebf237b9f997c5e8fb3.source: Now make your way onto the beach to point #2 and kill the Kurzicks there. Concentrate on taking out the Kurzick Monks early as they are powerful healers that will make dealing with the Warriors and the juggernauts a dangerous affair. You now have a couple of options: you can continue south to point #3 or you can move to point #5. There will be Kurzicks you will need to take out at both points.
bff3f575ba38a3dd0f9aeebf237b9f997c5e8fb3.text: 現在前往海灘指向#2並殺死那裡的庫爾茲克人。儘早集中精力消滅 庫茲柯 武僧，因為他們是強大的治療者，這將使與勇士和主宰打交道變得危險。您現在有幾個選擇：您可以繼續向南到達點#3，也可以移動到點#5。在這兩個地點你都需要幹掉庫茲克。

af3d94e431e5de919cda76cea2a7203cf109f63c.source: At point #3 you will face three waves of Kurzicks. Kill the first group quickly and retreat, to escape the rush attack of three groups. Let them converge and then carefully pull and dispatch them one group at a time. Once it's clear, continue to point #4.
af3d94e431e5de919cda76cea2a7203cf109f63c.text: 在#3 點，您將面對三波 Kurzicks。迅速擊殺第一組並撤退，以躲避三組的猛攻。讓他們聚集在一起，然後小心地一次一組地拉動並派遣他們。一旦清楚，繼續指向#4。

294b8cfca374294f66ff3801a5c8ba295f32c2c3.source: At point #5, a large group of Kurzicks will spawn on the beach behind you. Clear them out by careful pulling before heading to point #4.
294b8cfca374294f66ff3801a5c8ba295f32c2c3.text: 在#5點，一大群庫茲克人將在你身後的海灘上產卵。在前往點 #4 之前，請小心拉動以清除它們。

beab3eb07e16d26833a3238c9ae19e83fa609ffb.source: At point #4, clear out the small band of Kurzicks at the entrance to the Leviathan Pits. Now work your way north to point #6, going through point #3 or point #5, depending on which you have not cleared yet. There are two waves of Kurzicks at point #6 together with several juggernauts. Once they are all dead, head up to point #7 and talk to Petra to get a smoke canister. Drop it in the middle of the Young Turtles to protect them against the small incoming wave of Kurzicks. Once those are clear, the turtle caravan will start heading out. At point #1, a small band of Kurzicks will still spawn. Use the smoke canister to quickly deal with them. That would be the last you will see of Kurzicks. Escort the turtle caravan to the gates to trigger the cinematic. Remember to drop a smoke canister at the gates and fight the Afflicted at the gates. With the Siege Turtles' support, the Afflicted will go down quickly.
beab3eb07e16d26833a3238c9ae19e83fa609ffb.text: 在 #4 點，清除 利拜亞森礦場 入口處的一小群庫爾茲克人。現在向北前往點#6，穿過點#3 或點#5，取決於您尚未清除的點。在 #6 點有兩波 Kurzick 和幾個主宰。一旦他們都死了，前往#7點並與佩特拉交談以獲得煙霧罐。將其扔到幼龜中間，以保護它們免受庫茲克小波的攻擊。一旦這些都清楚了，海龜商隊就會開始出發。在#1 點，一小群 Kurzick 仍會生成。使用煙霧罐快速處理它們。那將是你最後一次見到庫茲克斯。護送海龜商隊到門口觸發過場動畫。記得在門口扔一個煙霧罐並在門口與受折磨者戰鬥。有了攻城龜的支援，受災者很快就會倒下。

c7f5c3e81e0dfe4fb270570a0bda8489f88318b6.source: To obtain the master's reward, players must ensure the survival of all five Young Turtles.
c7f5c3e81e0dfe4fb270570a0bda8489f88318b6.text: 為了獲得主人的獎勵，玩家必須確保所有五隻幼龜都存活下來。

c278ea43725c54571c6bcab796b306bf7f8dcd27.source: Minion masters can prove very useful. The large numbers of Kurzicks will easily provide enough corpses for 2 minion masters, and the minions serve to distract them from the Young Turtles (if going the front way) or from your party members (if going the back way). With the dense enemy mobs, minion bombers are particularly effective.
c278ea43725c54571c6bcab796b306bf7f8dcd27.text: 僕從大師非常有用。大量的庫茲克人很容易為 2 僕從大師提供足夠的屍體，而僕從可以分散他們對幼海龜（如果走前路）或你的隊伍成員（如果走後路）的注意力。對於密集的敵方生物，小兵轟炸機尤其有效。

c422fc17ebf17158aa939423dcb56865d78d5e92.source: Bring skills that inflict blindness or weakness on foes, as most of the threat comes from juggernauts, and Kurzick Warriors and Rangers.
c422fc17ebf17158aa939423dcb56865d78d5e92.text: 帶來對敵人造成失明或虛弱的技能，因為威脅大部分來自主宰、庫茲柯 戰士和遊騎兵。

f9bb7a27ea1ad395a41fe166251d8a5127ed03b0.source: Consider bringing skills that can affect multiple allies. With the enemies clustering around the Young Turtles and your party, area of effect skills that mitigate damage can help keep the turtles and your party alive (e.g. Ward Against Harm, Ward Against Melee, Ebon Battle Standard of Courage, Enfeebling Blood, Shadow of Fear). Blood Bond can be an effective ally heal, especially when used on their melee attackers.
f9bb7a27ea1ad395a41fe166251d8a5127ed03b0.text: 考慮引入可以影響多個盟友的技能。當敵人聚集在小海龜和你的隊伍周圍時，減輕傷害的效果範圍技能可以幫助小海龜和你的隊伍保持活力（例如 守護結界、迴避結界、黑檀 勇氣戰旗、血之衰弱、恐懼陰影）。 血之連結 可以有效治療盟友，尤其是用於近戰攻擊者時。

3e164a1851c76b25b3cc04f218c43555716bb5a9.source: To make the Siege Turtles move faster, bring "Incoming!", "Fall Back!", or "Charge!". If you took the back way, it makes the march down to the end much less painful.
3e164a1851c76b25b3cc04f218c43555716bb5a9.text: 為了讓攻城龜移動得更快，請帶上「來襲！」、「後退！」或「衝鋒！」。如果你走後路，那麼走到終點的痛苦就會少很多。

aefd5676bf59e5c31ca024489e0484f5c95ea1b9.text: 困難模式（以 20 分鐘為單位）

edac20ec746d8a56ec88c84b291547cc0d5a7731.source: There are 2 NPCs named Petras in the final battle. Any Young Turtles that die appear to be resurrected after the cinematic; however, they still count as "dead" for the master's reward. Some of the groups at point 6 might fail to spawn when doing the mission via the back way. To prevent this, stay with the turtles and avoid letting them stray too far. The Young Turtles at the end of the mission sometimes wander off past the Afflicted.
edac20ec746d8a56ec88c84b291547cc0d5a7731.text: 在最後的戰鬥中出現了名為佩特拉斯 (Petras) 的 2 NPC。任何死去的小海龜似乎都會在電影結束後復活；然而，對於主人的獎勵來說，他們仍然算「死」了。當透過後路執行任務時，6 點的某些小組可能無法產生。為了防止這種情況發生，請與海龜待在一起，避免讓它們走得太遠。任務結束時，幼龜有時會從受折磨者身邊走過。

19fc475bf06a6ed1236728852b587396951cf908.source: de:Gyala-Brutstätte (Mission) fr:Couvoir de Gyala (Mission en mode coopératif)
19fc475bf06a6ed1236728852b587396951cf908.text: de:Gyala-Brutstätte (主線任務) fr:Couvoir de Gyala (主線任務 en mode coopératif)

eef117a5c7a4b4934b1925f514732ad7fdbfbf63.source: Escort Master Togo to the edge of the Unwaking Waters.
eef117a5c7a4b4934b1925f514732ad7fdbfbf63.text: 護送 藤吾大師 到不醒水域的邊緣。

65de092e13916703ebc14a2d5ffe2a5551884941.source: Speak with Attis to gain access to the Unwaking Waters.
65de092e13916703ebc14a2d5ffe2a5551884941.text: 與阿蒂斯交談以進入不醒水域。

886a36b9e09ebc038d9e8af7f60db539cea2f423.source: See Elder Oxis for your reward.
886a36b9e09ebc038d9e8af7f60db539cea2f423.text: 去找奧克西斯長老領獎勵。

7a62c55a35c101820fbaa0c125e8164bd52de739.source: Travel through Silent Surf from Leviathan Pits to Unwaking Waters. All you need to do is make sure Master Togo survives (else the quest fails and must be restarted). Be alert to the movements of various mobs, including those in the distance, as most have wide patrol routes and can easily join aggro while you're busy dispatching another mob.
7a62c55a35c101820fbaa0c125e8164bd52de739.text: 從 利拜亞森礦場 穿過 寂靜之浪 到達不醒水域。您需要做的就是確保 藤吾大師 存活下來（否則任務會失敗並且必須重新啟動）。警惕各種怪物的行動，包括遠處的怪物，因為大多數怪物都有很寬的巡邏路線，當你忙於消滅另一個怪物時，它們很容易加入仇恨。

e38c06ea1627352a454ca88bb59410613a1c6667.source: Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any characters that have not completed Taking Back the Palace (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Raisu Pavilion will be closed.
e38c06ea1627352a454ca88bb59410613a1c6667.text: 開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中有任何未完成奪回皇宮的角色（不需要接受獎勵），萊蘇閣的大門將關閉。

db96665c9042aeaf9d7a4c392d89779e06dd1a43.source: Taking Back the Palace grants access, but any characters that have not completed Unwaking Waters will be left behind in Raisu Pavilion.
db96665c9042aeaf9d7a4c392d89779e06dd1a43.text: 奪回皇宮 授予存取許可權，但任何未完成 Unwaking Waters 的角色都會留在 萊蘇閣 中。

906a4466cf66409c3af7bd2955bba696432ed36a.source: Get to the emperor before Shiro kills him!
906a4466cf66409c3af7bd2955bba696432ed36a.text: 在四郎殺死皇帝之前到達他身邊！

d98e6c483ce715e9da61d9b8e7d9beef97bf2ce4.source: , you must choose two allies from among these heroes to accompany the party.
d98e6c483ce715e9da61d9b8e7d9beef97bf2ce4.text: ，你必須從這些英雄中選擇兩名盟友來陪伴隊伍。

1a230c198da9e35a75b5eca4b8ea7939f2aff6b4.text: 藤吾大師 必須生存。

1d10b0bce5816fe9167299fe288e0bde8db1e618.source: Factions Completion time > 25 minutes 20 - 25 minutes 28 minutes 26 - 28 minutes < 26 minutes
1d10b0bce5816fe9167299fe288e0bde8db1e618.text: 盟與敵 完成時間 > 25 分鐘 20 - 25 分鐘 28 分鐘 26 - 28 分鐘 < 26 分鐘

fa616b1f970a0ce12412d19f888f94c638a8aa62.source: At the beginning of this mission, be sure to acquire a Celestial skill from Kuunavang. These skills are very powerful, and will recharge each time you defeat one of the many bosses in this mission. Take note that only player characters and henchmen can get Celestial skills; heroes cannot. As such, it is worth considering whether or not your hero build really is more effective than the warrior and elementalist henchmen as they get Storm of Swords and Celestial Storm respectively.
fa616b1f970a0ce12412d19f888f94c638a8aa62.text: 在這個任務開始時，一定要從庫納旺那裡獲得一項天體技能。這些技能非常強大，每次您在此任務中擊敗眾多頭目之一時，它們都會重新充電。請注意，只有玩家角色和追隨者才能獲得天神技能；英雄不能。因此，值得考慮的是，你的英雄構建是否真的比戰士和元素主義者的追隨者更有效，因為他們分別獲得了冰雨風暴和天體風暴。

d5dd38033a27ef08a8e8e28e81ab07ec3a5dfe54.source: After that, the party leader has to choose two NPCs to join as allies. These NPCs will fight with you, but cannot be resurrected if they die, and will leave your party at a prescribed point during the mission (if they are still alive) to let your party skip a small section of the mission:
d5dd38033a27ef08a8e8e28e81ab07ec3a5dfe54.text: 之後，黨魁必須選擇兩名 NPC 作為盟友加入。這些 NPC 會與你一起戰鬥，但如果他們死了就無法復活，並且會在任務期間的指定地點離開你的隊伍（如果他們還活著），讓你的隊伍跳過任務的一小部分：

9f96b50e7ee06250f5effaf7bc9fe3504456fefb.source: Argo - Lets the party skip the first groups of Shiro'ken; thereby allowing the party to head straight to the Warrior boss.
9f96b50e7ee06250f5effaf7bc9fe3504456fefb.text: 艾高 - 讓隊伍跳過第一組 白影軍團；讓隊伍可以直接前往 戰士 Boss。

c715dc3030ff5cc2e15471f38297bfa99f66f5f2.source: Cynn - Lets the party skip the group of Shiro'ken; this occurs before the bridges after the Elementalist boss.
c715dc3030ff5cc2e15471f38297bfa99f66f5f2.text: 莘 - 讓隊伍跳過 白影軍團 群組；這發生在 元素使 boss 之後的橋梁之前。

eb1ad142f37a5d57f969409d2cce6357bef1ab2a.source: Danika - Closes a gate in a large room full of Shiro'ken; thereby providing the party with a faster alternate route to the Ritualist boss.
eb1ad142f37a5d57f969409d2cce6357bef1ab2a.text: Danika - 關上充滿 白影軍團 的大房間的門；從而為隊伍提供了一條更快的到達 祭祀者 boss 的替代路線。

21b1818b07284ebd9302a7f91c11de06a6c4f2b1.source: Nika - Lets the party skip the Ranger boss.
21b1818b07284ebd9302a7f91c11de06a6c4f2b1.text: Nika - 讓隊伍跳過 遊俠 boss。

b3da3cd4538fc479bc80d4979c583bf4d97a764d.source: Panaku - Disables the Acid Traps in the corridor that leads to the Ritualist boss.
b3da3cd4538fc479bc80d4979c583bf4d97a764d.text: Panaku - 停用通往 祭祀者 boss 的走廊中的酸性陷阱。

4bcf997bc72aa7643713c51b28f8b05ccafc3eb2.source: Talon Silverwing - Closes the gates on the portal rooms after the Warrior boss; thereby containing the Shiro'ken in those rooms.
4bcf997bc72aa7643713c51b28f8b05ccafc3eb2.text: Talon Silverwing - 在 戰士 Boss 之後關閉傳送室的大門；從而將 白影軍團 納入這些房間。

bb64509c3a5cdc803de6d6c9697f1cc5ae971714.source: There are two ways to defeat this mission: The front way is faster to finish. The back way is longer, but safer for master's reward.
bb64509c3a5cdc803de6d6c9697f1cc5ae971714.text: 有兩種方法可以完成這個任務：前面的方法完成得更快。後面的路更長，但為了主人的獎勵更安全。

bead1e6de02bf7884d802284cfdf40afa4a9e367.source: The goal is to escort Young Turtles (which are now allied to your party) through the length of an explorable area to another outpost. The objective will be completed as long as one of them arrives safe.
bead1e6de02bf7884d802284cfdf40afa4a9e367.text: 目標是護送小海龜（現在已與你的隊伍結盟）穿過可探索區域到達另一個前哨站。只要其中一人安全抵達，目標就完成了。

1c28b3bd65846f0241760e4916ce2721e13f03e9.source: Petras can provide you with Smoke Canisters which mark locations for the Siege Turtles to bombard (only harming foes); good placement is key to survival, especially for the master's reward. Though Petras can provide up to three canisters, it is generally most effective to use only one as this will focus all three turtles' fire on one location.
1c28b3bd65846f0241760e4916ce2721e13f03e9.text: 佩特拉斯可以為您提供煙霧罐，標記出攻城龜的轟炸位置（僅傷害敵人）；良好的安置是生存的關鍵，尤其是對於主人的獎勵而言。雖然佩特拉斯最多可以提供三個罐子，但通常只使用一個是最有效的，因為這會將所有三隻烏龜的火力集中在一個位置。

cae169d177f42727b6d27a17d14b4253db05481b.source: The Young Turtles are very fragile so keeping enemies from getting close is essential, especially the Kurzick Juggernauts which have the strength to kill Siege Turtles. Kurzicks will be spawning from different locations at the same time, remain close to the friendly NPCs and do not wander off ahead. When playing alone with henchmen/heroes only, bring a minion master and ensure that you have ranged attacks.
cae169d177f42727b6d27a17d14b4253db05481b.text: 小海龜非常脆弱，因此阻止敵人靠近至關重要，尤其是 庫茲柯 主宰，它們有能力殺死攻城海龜。 Kurzicks 會同時從不同地點生成，保持靠近友善的 NPC，並且不會在前方徘徊。當僅與追隨者/英雄單獨遊戲時，帶上一個隨從大師並確保你有遠端攻擊。

1f6520143c1de4547033ec52c1a50ca9d9927a93.source: Some of the fights involve several enemy waves at once, so a strong team with good defense is needed. Proper use of the Siege Turtles is critical, and it's important to only ever use one smoke canister, even if you have multiple players.
1f6520143c1de4547033ec52c1a50ca9d9927a93.text: 有些戰鬥會同時涉及數波敵人，因此需要一支具有良好防禦能力的強大團隊。正確使用攻城龜至關重要，即使有多名玩家，也只使用一個煙霧罐很重要。

7a9604f7d92b0a7100e8b0621deb45b486f82625.source: Just follow the route on the map (back-tracking where necessary), fighting at each of the numbered points in sequence. You will often be running ahead of the turtles to clear areas before they arrive. You only fight with the turtles at points 3, 5, 7 and 9. In those cases, place the smoke canister in the middle of the Young Turtles and huddle your entire party around it. Don't worry about focusing fire on monks or backliners in general, just wait until the Siege Turtles kill all the immediate threats to the turtles then clean up the rest.
7a9604f7d92b0a7100e8b0621deb45b486f82625.text: 只需按照地圖上的路線（必要時回溯），按順序在每個編號點進行戰鬥即可。您通常會跑在海龜前面，在它們到達之前清理區域。您只能在 3、5、7 和 9 點與海龜戰鬥。在這種情況下，請將煙霧罐放在幼龜中間，並將整個團隊聚集在它周圍。一般來說，不要擔心將火力集中在僧侶或後排身上，只需等待攻城龜殺死所有對龜的直接威脅，然後清理其餘的即可。

4da00da304d1d92d26d0db32956ae0b0028592bb.source: When not fighting with turtles always use flag and pull tactics, and where possible use corners and edges of jade waves to provide cover for your backline while bunching up enemies to increase AoE damage.
4da00da304d1d92d26d0db32956ae0b0028592bb.text: 當不與烏龜戰鬥時，請始終使用旗幟和拉動戰術，並在可能的情況下使用玉波的角落和邊緣為您的後線提供掩護，同時聚集敵人以增加 範圍性 傷害。

54fb573dc88d55b1042f19db97e68234fb91a9cf.source: At spot 3, grab the canister from Petras and place it in front of the southern Siege Turtle for a single salvo on the juggernauts, then immediately move it to the Young Turtles.
54fb573dc88d55b1042f19db97e68234fb91a9cf.text: 在 3 地點，從佩特拉斯抓住罐子並將其放在南部攻城龜前面，對主宰進行一次齊射，然後立即將其移至幼龜處。

4ac408bb21c1de3a13e0e649039a5bf4a8086cee.source: The fight at spot 7 can cause problems.
