Unless Paulus was damaged earlier or either of you gets bogged down by an enemy, he can actually survive the trip without needing to be healed even once. In fact, you might want to keep a closer look on your own health. For peace of mind (and to practice your new skill), tossing one or two Orisons of Healing his way while in the water will guarantee a safe retrieval.
280b6cb85c9cc332219d1ff0348144d2879eba60.text: 最終，保盧斯帶你進入沼澤水區。在裡面時，它會給你們倆帶來持續的健康惡化。除非保盧斯早些時候受到傷害，或者你們中的任何一個被敵人陷入困境，否則他實際上可以在旅途中倖存下來，甚至不需要被治癒一次。事實上，您可能想密切注意自己的健康狀況。為了安心（並練習你的新技能），在水中投擲一兩顆奧裡森治療劑將保證安全恢復。

014901d7b350a2ba82fd065dccc23df6d76946f1.source: You shouldn't encounter any enemies on the way back, as you've already cleared the path of undead. Follow Paulus until you both reach the entrance to Ashford Abbey. Wait for the quest to update then walk through the portal and collect your reward from Mhenlo.
014901d7b350a2ba82fd065dccc23df6d76946f1.text: 你在回程的路上不應該遇到任何敵人，因為你已經清除了不死族的道路。跟著保盧斯到你們都到達 灰色淺灘修道院 的入口。等待任務更新，然後穿過門戶並從 涵洛 領取獎勵。

13fdb073c0864f6cf942fdde37785e983aee88ba.source: You must defeat 10 more Am Fah
13fdb073c0864f6cf942fdde37785e983aee88ba.text: 您必須再次擊敗 10 安費

5a8aef887bdda9faa389e3d07b4d07d1967a3ff5.source: See Imperial Agent Hanjo for your reward
5a8aef887bdda9faa389e3d07b4d07d1967a3ff5.text: 見帝國特務半條以獲得獎勵

e3b6fe03dbe575ec90fc4b5c172d446a936d0d2d.source: This quest does not have a green quest marker to follow until completed. Instead, simply killing the required number of Am Fah is tallied while the quest is active.
e3b6fe03dbe575ec90fc4b5c172d446a936d0d2d.text: 該任務在完成之前沒有綠色任務標記可供遵循。相反，當任務處於活動狀態時，只需殺死所需數量的 安費 即可進行統計。

15b7bd7f3a6d454e7f4774987a6019f51d3ad3b9.source: You can complete this quest, The Xunlai Agent, Eliminate the Am Fah or many other quests simultaneously.
15b7bd7f3a6d454e7f4774987a6019f51d3ad3b9.text: 您可以同時完成此任務、桑萊專員、消除 安費 或許多其他任務。

4b1bb43f1c0b18ddd8361e47d07b89703bc5c0b9.source: When starting Vizunah Square from the Local Quarter, this quest will be completed without a fight, as Mhenlo and his party will kill enough Am Fah while making their way to your location.
4b1bb43f1c0b18ddd8361e47d07b89703bc5c0b9.text: 當從當地地區啟動 薇茹廣場 時，此任務將無需戰鬥即可完成，因為 涵洛 和他的隊伍將在前往您所在位置的同時殺死足夠的 安費。

99433331ee5addef7d32b82e66ddaa4a9cabe5c5.source: Find the location of the farm referred to in Yomindhe's note.
99433331ee5addef7d32b82e66ddaa4a9cabe5c5.text: 找到 Yomindhe 筆記中提到的農場位置。

497581a1eedad7e45dbd961729cf60825accb312.source: Travel to the Plains of Jarin.

1ccfbe5619d3f72711c095e7b182428daa12a39b.text: 找到尤敏德埋藏的資訊。

fdf0efdf95c2cd18720a2c019bbfc9bbe79bc851.source: Leave from Jokanur Diggings out into Zehlon Reach. Head for the compass point in the northwest corner of Zehlon Reach. Talk to Farmer Muenda there and then open the Warped Chest.
fdf0efdf95c2cd18720a2c019bbfc9bbe79bc851.text: 從 Jokanur Diggings 出發前往 Zehlon Reach。前往澤隆河段西北角的羅盤點。與那裡的農民 Muenda 交談，然後開啟 Warped 寶箱。

88dd1e5817f4f4fdfba09c1748da599a1c7a883a.source: Map travel to Kamadan and head out into the Plains of Jarin. Follow the compass point to a Mound of Dirt. Rummage through it to find Yomindhe's message and journal, then return to Scholar Chago to complete the quest.
88dd1e5817f4f4fdfba09c1748da599a1c7a883a.text: 地圖上前往卡馬丹 (Kamadan)，然後前往 賈林平原。沿著羅盤指向土堆。翻閱它以找到尤敏德的訊息和日記，然後返回學者查戈來完成任務。

857212810dd8819092514e036690d201e2ef0d76.source: If the player accesses the Warped Chest before talking to Farmer Muenudo, it is possible that the map marker will not appear properly when you travel to the Plains of Jarin despite your quest journal updating. The Mound of Dirt can be found just north of the Sentient Root Collector.
857212810dd8819092514e036690d201e2ef0d76.text: 如果玩家在與農民 Muenudo 交談之前訪問扭曲的 寶箱，則當您前往 賈林平原 時，儘管您的任務日誌已更新，但地圖示記可能不會正確顯示。土丘位於 Sentient Root 收藏家 的北部。

08281a5d9dbdc115502e28c4fa6cf9aab9673925.text: 進一步的冒險 已完成

d707b2ff921433144af0c7cc4cf38176752b6dab.source: Follow the road southwest from town and continue past Ashford Abbey to find Wizard's Folly. Continue following the road until you reach the tower, and speak to Elementalist Aziure.
d707b2ff921433144af0c7cc4cf38176752b6dab.text: 沿著城鎮西南方的道路行駛，經過 灰色淺灘修道院 即可找到 巫師的怪異建築。繼續沿著路走，直到到達塔樓，然後與 元素使艾西兒 交談。

c0b9de102f14427966cf07a3f829e134a2e57b06.source: Although the journey from Lakeside County to Elementalist Aziure is long, the path is not hard to find. Simply go south and continue past Ashford Abbey. Follow the signs to Wizard's Folly. Once there, follow the road that leads into the mountains. For those who have not explored the area yet, it is a good idea to visit Foible's Fair, as this outpost is just along the path.
c0b9de102f14427966cf07a3f829e134a2e57b06.text: 雖然從湖畔郡到元素使艾西兒的路程很長，但路徑並不難找。只需向南行駛並繼續經過 灰色淺灘修道院。依照路標前往 巫師的怪異建築。到達那裡後，沿著通往山裡的路走。對於那些還沒有探索過該地區的人來說，參觀 佛伊伯市集 是個好主意，因為這個前哨站就在路邊。

e43e52271fc9579a83a2fa809e33198c0ab4170b.source: Farther along the road you will see a very large tower. Elementalist Aziure can be found at the foot of the central tower. Speaking to her and accepting the quest immediately starts the action. While you're presented with new skills, ice elementals rush to your location in waves. Three waves of three ice elementals will rush in and attack.
e43e52271fc9579a83a2fa809e33198c0ab4170b.text: 沿著路繼續前行，你會看到一座非常大的塔。 元素使艾西兒 位於中央塔腳下。與她交談並接受任務立即開始行動。當你獲得新技能時，冰元素會一波又一波地湧向你所在的位置。三波三冰元素會衝進來攻擊。

12019f42e0d17340e8bb4fedb6d09db411032179.source: Despite the strength and number of ice elementals, take a moment to accept at least two of the skills offered by Aziure for immediate use on your skill bar: Glyph of Lesser Energy and Firestorm. These two skills can be used to handle most of the the elementals while any other offensive skills you may have will deal with the rest.
12019f42e0d17340e8bb4fedb6d09db411032179.text: 儘管冰元素的力量和數量眾多，但請花點時間接受 Aziure 提供的至少兩項技能，以便在您的技能欄上立即使用：微能符號 和 Firestorm。這兩種技能可用於處理大多數元素，而您可能擁有的任何其他進攻技能將處理其餘的元素。

604e2661e37b9707ccf75d2fe8b413542cb4a008.source: In the mountain you will encounter many Ice Elementals, so be sure to bring fire related skills to make defeating the creatures easier.
604e2661e37b9707ccf75d2fe8b413542cb4a008.text: 在山裡你會遇到很多冰元素，所以一定要帶上火相關的技能，這樣打敗冰元素會比較容易。

48ea159b69a731208a48f711b2c1e1a1c5c05918.source: Next to the resurrection shrine outside of Foibles Fair you will encounter a collector named Savich. He will exchange 3 Icy Lodestones for a pair of Elementalist's Gloves, so be sure to save any stones you may acquire from fighting elementals in the mountains.
48ea159b69a731208a48f711b2c1e1a1c5c05918.text: 在 Foibles Fair 外面的復活神殿旁邊，您會遇到一位名叫 賽維 的收藏家。他會將 3 冰凍 磁石交換為一對 元素手套，因此請務必儲存您在山中與元素戰鬥時可能獲得的任何石頭。

ea6838662a0cefab1496b4d80cbcd5cb0f7950e6.source: Meet Merchant Orek and the Caravan in Drazach Thicket.
ea6838662a0cefab1496b4d80cbcd5cb0f7950e6.text: 在 德瑞扎灌木林 中認識 雜貨商人 Orek 和商隊。

d17e5bfa48f4c6e6ddcd73411c8de691bf1046c2.source: Escort Merchant Orek and the Caravan to Saint Anjeka's Shrine.
d17e5bfa48f4c6e6ddcd73411c8de691bf1046c2.text: 護送 雜貨商人 奧雷克和商隊前往 聖者安捷卡的祭壇。

366e0423848ff326c866c5a2ebbc20fbc9b4c57d.source: See Merchant Orek for your reward.
366e0423848ff326c866c5a2ebbc20fbc9b4c57d.text: 請參閱 雜貨商人 Orek 以取得獎勵。

0e92c8d228f9d483a5b2475a06087dadc49a9217.source: You'll find Merchant Orek waiting just outside the north exit of Brauer Academy, with his caravan of 3 other Merchants. Once you talk to Orek, the quest will update and point towards Saint Anjeka's Shrine to which you must lead Orek and his merchants, defeating any creatures you encounter along the way and taking care of the 4 allies as well.
0e92c8d228f9d483a5b2475a06087dadc49a9217.text: 您會發現 雜貨商人 Orek 和他的 3 商隊在 巴爾學院 北出口外等候。一旦你與 Orek 交談，任務就會更新並指向 聖者安捷卡的祭壇，你必須帶領 Orek 和他的商人到達那裡，擊敗沿途遇到的任何生物，並照顧 4 盟友。

904dc1174d46e9f5c8b716ec6dc974ca151b32c9.source: The merchants are quite weak, so you should beware of warden popups as you travel through Drazach Thicket, they can cause trouble by focusing their attacks on the merchants. Once you are within sight of the shrine outpost, there will also be two groups of wardens and three groups of dragon mosses to defeat.
904dc1174d46e9f5c8b716ec6dc974ca151b32c9.text: 商人相當弱，所以當你穿越 德瑞扎灌木林 時，你應該提防典獄長的彈出視窗，他們可能會透過集中攻擊商人來製造麻煩。當你進入神社前哨站的視線範圍內時，還會有兩組守衛和三組龍苔需要被擊敗。

dd26576dd50294a9785adbd137c5a47ec539ae0b.source: At the end, walk up to, but do not enter Saint Anjeka's Shrine, and wait for the quest to update, then speak to Orek to collect your reward.
dd26576dd50294a9785adbd137c5a47ec539ae0b.text: 最後，走到 聖者安捷卡的祭壇，但不要進入，等待任務更新，然後與 Orek 交談以領取獎勵。

62d997ca1bb7a602cde4aba5db9d9180a4623454.source: Alternatively, if you have unlocked Saint Anjeka's Shrine, you can do the quest backwards: starting from the shrine, head towards the academy to clear the way and pick up the merchants, then return the way you came.
62d997ca1bb7a602cde4aba5db9d9180a4623454.text: 或者，如果你已經解鎖了聖者安捷卡的祭壇，你可以向後執行任務：從神社開始，前往學院清理道路並接上商人，然後按原路返回。

c9737625dba9976a556283ac7a10293b46f54f80.source: Only Orek must survive to complete the quest; the unnamed merchants are expendable.
c9737625dba9976a556283ac7a10293b46f54f80.text: 只有奧雷克必須生存才能完成任務；那些不知名的商人是可以犧牲的。

0c745ccaefcb36511dbb5684856d255512b3f7f5.source: The caravan follows the party leader; you can send others in the party (including heroes and henchman) ahead to clear the way.
0c745ccaefcb36511dbb5684856d255512b3f7f5.text: 大篷車跟隨黨的領袖；你可以派隊伍中的其他人（包括英雄和追隨者）先行掃清道路。

731064370dd3d0e2e3b16739d978de0596471974.source: If you keep the quest active, the three groups of Dragon Moss can be farmed for Plant Fibers, Spiritwood Planks, and Dragon Roots.
731064370dd3d0e2e3b16739d978de0596471974.text: 如果您保持任務活躍，則可以種植三組龍苔以獲得 植物 纖維、靈木板和龍根。

468b945b9d562ee93f82870a648207e2e2648695.source: Although the unnamed merchants are listed as Monks, they do not use any healing skills on themselves or the party. However, they will attack using their wands.
468b945b9d562ee93f82870a648207e2e2648695.text: 儘管這些無名商人被列為武僧，但他們不會對自己或隊伍使用任何治療技能。然而，他們會用魔杖攻擊。

a2a716205fedee72a2c45fb364533b0e62a5df23.source: Help Curator Ruras unearth a fossil for his "Tyrian Investors."
a2a716205fedee72a2c45fb364533b0e62a5df23.text: 幫助館長魯拉斯為他的「泰爾投資者」挖掘化石。

2be30d2ba47a17761096003cdde70b4f436f5b5b.source: Bring the fossilized shellfish to Curator Ruras.
2be30d2ba47a17761096003cdde70b4f436f5b5b.text: 將貝類化石交給魯拉斯館長。

a4b4e03569e6b8ddcc9ddf6e77efd86bac2e9f1e.source: Escort Curator Ruras back to the Lair of the Forgotten.
a4b4e03569e6b8ddcc9ddf6e77efd86bac2e9f1e.text: 護送館長 Ruras 返回 被遺忘者的巢穴。

1a4025bb1a1a8ece859fa692ed393c37a4c44494.source: See Curator Ruras for your reward
1a4025bb1a1a8ece859fa692ed393c37a4c44494.text: 請見館長魯拉斯以獲得獎勵

d76061be82fbfabffdaa44a5d3a4603834f19754.source: Find a Pile of Rocks that contains the fossil that Curator Ruras needs. After that, escort Ruras back to the Lair of the Forgotten. He does not join as an ally so there is no need to worry about him getting attacked.
d76061be82fbfabffdaa44a5d3a4603834f19754.text: 找到一堆岩石，裡面有魯拉斯館長需要的化石。之後，護送 Ruras 返回 被遺忘者的巢穴。他不是作為盟友加入的，所以不用擔心他會受到攻擊。

f62c1f6cbb36d4058c578f826e599d0a1585d6e1.source: Fondalz the Spiteful hovers near Curator Ruras' starting position with the Signet of Suffering elite skill.
f62c1f6cbb36d4058c578f826e599d0a1585d6e1.text: 惡意的豐達爾茲使用 苦難紋章 菁英技能在館長魯拉斯的起始位置附近盤旋。

d76cb325bfaa048168b84755ece5a5ef3b4905de.source: Follow the road northwest from town. Talk to Lady Althea at the Actor's Stage.
d76cb325bfaa048168b84755ece5a5ef3b4905de.text: 沿著城鎮西北方向的道路行駛。在演員舞臺與 奧瑟雅小姐 交談。

64c58e6b654e1dc5c086a4009745e4daf24c5625.source: Upon receiving the quest, follow the road to the northwest and head up the hill. The Actor's Stage is on just up this hill next to the city walls, and Lady Althea can be found standing in front of it. Simply talk to her and obtain your reward.
64c58e6b654e1dc5c086a4009745e4daf24c5625.text: 接到任務後，沿著西北方的路，往上山。演員舞臺就位於城牆旁的這座山上，奧瑟雅小姐 就站在它的前方。只需與她交談即可獲得獎勵。

b691a4008a8eb694ebf7160616d07e59d02cbb06.source: Follow the road southwest toward Ashford. Continue on to Ashford Abbey. Talk to Brother Mhenlo.
b691a4008a8eb694ebf7160616d07e59d02cbb06.text: 沿著西南方向的道路前往阿什福德。繼續至 灰色淺灘修道院。與 涵洛教友 交談。

458121b614dcb24444ab3492793979d3518b665b.source: Follow the road southwest along the river and up a hill until a cliff edge overlooking the village of Ashford to the south. Follow the road as it turns west towards a fenced off building. Enter the portal at the end of the road to arrive at Ashford Abbey.
458121b614dcb24444ab3492793979d3518b665b.text: 沿著河流向西南方向行駛，爬上一座小山，直到懸崖邊緣，俯瞰南邊的阿什福德村。沿著道路向西轉向一棟用柵欄圍起來的建築物。進入道路盡頭的傳送門即可到達 灰色淺灘修道院。

39df25b47ea38f7372d7375f3fc9b1c0136069b1.source: Follow the road southwest from town. Proceed past Ashford Abbey to the Catacombs. Talk to Necromancer Munne.
39df25b47ea38f7372d7375f3fc9b1c0136069b1.text: 沿著城鎮西南方向的道路行駛。繼續經過 灰色淺灘修道院 到達地下墓穴。與 死靈法師繆涅 交談。

919e21f0d2a920f2bf59c6603c0c1853939b574d.source: Inside Ashford Abbey, exit via the western portal to enter the primary entrance area of the Catacombs. Inside, head directly right. Necromancer Munne can be seen standing within an old building immediately to the north. Talk to her to complete the quest.
919e21f0d2a920f2bf59c6603c0c1853939b574d.text: 在 灰色淺灘修道院 內，透過西部入口退出，進入地下墓穴的主要入口區域。進去後，直接往右​​走。可以看到 死靈法師繆涅 矗立在北面的一棟舊建築內。與她交談以完成任務。

51f7f58ffde2a7e33fdc98940761722bb68c0a49.source: Wilton Payce can be found traveling this route to and from Ascalon City.
51f7f58ffde2a7e33fdc98940761722bb68c0a49.text: Wilton Payce 可在這條往返 阿斯卡隆城 的路線上找到。

31bc1a3696e8e1007a39673a36de16a0c229063c.source: Follow the road southwest from town. Turn south on the bridge near the village and enter Regent Valley. Talk to Master Ranger Nente.
31bc1a3696e8e1007a39673a36de16a0c229063c.text: 沿著城鎮西南方向的道路行駛。在村莊附近的橋上向南轉，進入 統治者之谷。與 遊俠大師涅特 交談。

34efea677e80cf33ff1044f2c5e96353f6eba48e.source: It will take a while to reach Master Ranger Nente's location, but the path is not hard to follow or travel. From Haversdan, follow the road southwest along the river. Before the bridge to Ashford Village, turn south and follow the signs into Regent Valley (which is another explorable area). Continue south along the road past non-hostile Devourers to find Master Ranger Nente on a small rise.
34efea677e80cf33ff1044f2c5e96353f6eba48e.text: 要到達 遊俠大師涅特 的位置需要一段時間，但這條路並不難走。從 哈伯斯丹 出發，沿著河流向西南方向行駛。在通往 灰色淺灘村莊 的橋梁之前，向南轉，按照路標進入 統治者之谷（這是另一個可探索的區域）。沿著道路繼續向南，經過非敵對的 蠍，在一個小山丘上找到 遊俠大師涅特。

63c902011f0af3fe745bdd53029f1b4571478058.source: Follow the road northwest from town. Follow the signs to Green Hills County. Talk to Warmaster Grast.
63c902011f0af3fe745bdd53029f1b4571478058.text: 沿著城鎮西北方向的道路行駛。依照路標前往 綠丘郡。與 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特 交談。

13747488ce0c451a0394c2d0769922c7c94ea0bc.source: Head northwest along the road from Haversdan and follow the road to Green Hills County. Warmaster Grast is standing near where you entered, before the large statue of Balthazar.
13747488ce0c451a0394c2d0769922c7c94ea0bc.text: 從 哈伯斯丹 沿著道路向西北行駛，然後沿著道路前往 綠丘郡。 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特 就站在您進入的地方附近，巴薩澤 的大型雕像前。

a7a4a57b9531b0607c9faf87d6db005c93ab16d6.source: A Loose Cannon not active or completed
a7a4a57b9531b0607c9faf87d6db005c93ab16d6.text: 鬆散的大砲未啟動或完成

6ad8c0a0ad6f2f2d1c803bfcfc9d9985123e544f.source: Mutually exclusive with A Loose Cannon.
6ad8c0a0ad6f2f2d1c803bfcfc9d9985123e544f.text: 與鬆散的大砲相互排斥。

f14c7007d8f0df51adffa9e699221ddc90d3ec1c.source: Shaudok is more a dead weight than a loose cannon. He simply won't join any fight.
f14c7007d8f0df51adffa9e699221ddc90d3ec1c.text: 肖多克與其說是一門鬆散的大砲，不如說是一個沉重的負擔。他根本不會參加任何戰鬥。

0e6617e0853c454847a2928b84ddef966d204d43.source: Search Fahranur for clues as to the nature of the Scarab Plague.
0e6617e0853c454847a2928b84ddef966d204d43.text: 搜尋法赫拉努爾尋找有關聖甲蟲瘟疫本質的線索。

612c8358e589766add8ef88c3975e9c1d7925966.source: From Jokanur Diggings, enter Fahranur, The First City and move forward a little to get the quest objective to update. The rest of the quest is accomplished by simply following the quest marker to find five different interactive objects. In order, your character needs to examine two sets of Weathered Bones, an Old Chest, a Rusty Chest, and a Loose Rock. At each location, several hostile insects will spawn, but they are easily dispatched.
612c8358e589766add8ef88c3975e9c1d7925966.text: 從 Jokanur Diggings 進入 舊城 法蘭努爾 並向前移動一點以更新任務目標。任務的其餘部分只需跟隨任務標記找到五個不同的互動物件即可完成。按照順序，您的角色需要檢查兩組風化骨頭：一組舊 寶箱、一組生鏽 寶箱 和一組鬆動岩石。每個地點都會產卵一些敵對昆蟲，但很容易消滅它們。

7300714a42ce6f1c9475fe76ed5f76cb74ee3154.source: Several additional chests may spawn near the location of the respective interactive objects.
7300714a42ce6f1c9475fe76ed5f76cb74ee3154.text: 幾個額外的箱子可能會在對應互動物件的位置附近產生。

968382bfae388d3ecb893882ddc92d9cca4496ee.text: 不遵守 梅蘭朵 的協議

6efa7e485a661e47cbf445f1e092534e643c2ab5.source: Talk to a Xunlai Agent and open a storage account.
6efa7e485a661e47cbf445f1e092534e643c2ab5.text: 與 桑萊專員 交談並開啟儲存帳戶。

1805ca2316444b8f855ed60d76172a8b674749be.source: See Xunlai Agent Jueh for your reward.
1805ca2316444b8f855ed60d76172a8b674749be.text: 請參閱 桑萊專員 Jueh 以獲得獎勵。

86878289ee802dee3aeb22e6ac656063c1674831.source: With the money you earned from completing quests in Chahbek Village (plus completing the first mission), you should have more than enough money to give your new character access to your storage and add access to the crafting material storage. It will cost 100 gold to accomplish this feat. Simply walk up the stairs to the north and turn right and speak with the other Xunlai Agents.
86878289ee802dee3aeb22e6ac656063c1674831.text: 利用您在 Chahbek 村完成任務（加上完成第一個任務）獲得的金錢，您應該有足夠的錢來讓您的新角色訪問您的儲存空間並新增對製作材料儲存的訪問許可權。完成這項壯舉需要花費 100 金幣。只需沿著樓梯向北走，然後右轉並與其他迅來特工交談即可。

f730e038c1f3240f43dfe3d8246ef811806e6d13.source: Note: You only need to open the account in order to complete the quest, but it's easier to kill two birds with one stone by adding the crafting material storage.
f730e038c1f3240f43dfe3d8246ef811806e6d13.text: 注意：只需開通帳號即可完成任務，但增加製作材料庫後，一舉兩得會更容易。

b0cf0a841b29c9d9f89ee19f5f005edba2494a02.source: Protect the fields. Do not let them be overrun.
b0cf0a841b29c9d9f89ee19f5f005edba2494a02.text: 保護田地。不要讓他們被淹沒。

d19b697f2af8ec9257ba9382513caf4f1fa8bc88.source: See Elder Isma for your reward.
d19b697f2af8ec9257ba9382513caf4f1fa8bc88.text: 去找伊斯瑪長老領獎勵。

85ba2fcd98ade19139683c3cfe262a0ae2c28c3d.source: When you reach Elder Isma in Arkjok Ward north farmers village, the preamble dialog starts. The quest is only available from Isma after she finishes her speech.
85ba2fcd98ade19139683c3cfe262a0ae2c28c3d.text: 當您到達 阿爾科監禁區 北部農民村莊的伊斯瑪長老時，序言對話方塊開始。只有伊斯瑪完成演講後才能獲得任務。

cdb533014dbb5801cd29e7ae184184394b40d58f.source: Once you accept the quest, a timer starts counting down from 5 minutes. If the timer reaches 0:00 with any foes still alive, the quest fails, and you will have to leave the zone and return to try again.
cdb533014dbb5801cd29e7ae184184394b40d58f.text: 一旦您接受任務，計時器就會從 5 分鐘開始倒數計時。如果計時器到達 0:00 並且有任何敵人仍然活著，任務就會失敗，您將必須離開該區域並返回重試。

2172ac3a2b15d13709bd555c87b35f7434f92572.source: The invading insects come as 3 waves of 2 groups each. All the groups spawn and approach from the portal to Jahai Bluffs nearby, so the party can easily intercept and destroy them by standing in front of the portal - just make sure you don't accidentally run through after a creature. Flagging heroes/henchmen near the first field below the portal is a good way to catch the first insect invaders as you return from accepting the quest. Correct placement also helps ensure all the attackers clear the portal but don't scatter over the fields.
2172ac3a2b15d13709bd555c87b35f7434f92572.text: 入侵的昆蟲以 2 組的 3 波的形式出現。所有隊伍都會從傳送門生成並接近附近的 夏亥峭壁，因此隊伍可以透過站在傳送門前輕鬆攔截並摧毀它們 - 只需確保您不會意外地追隨生物即可。當你接受任務返回時，在傳送門下方第一個區域附近標記英雄/追隨者是捕獲第一批昆蟲入侵者的好方法。正確的放置也有助於確保所有攻擊者清除門戶，但不會分散在各個區域。

1ef9122cb9cd2f4ecc1c5ce33a7e83de53aaaa80.source: When all the insects are killed, speak to Elder Isma to get the reward.
1ef9122cb9cd2f4ecc1c5ce33a7e83de53aaaa80.text: 當所有昆蟲都被殺死後，與伊斯瑪長老交談以獲得獎勵。

fe5916e85800e8c6f6d82a07754673da50a89cba.source: This quest can be used to farm Insect Carapaces.
fe5916e85800e8c6f6d82a07754673da50a89cba.text: 此任務可用於種植昆蟲甲殼。

41cbbad2bd4305d64ec50043dfbf94c2fd1fbb6a.text: 所需英雄：狡猾的瑪格麗特

4c150e838e9c07681650efcfd8d62ef966ba5c3b.source: Locate the caravan in Arkjok Ward.
4c150e838e9c07681650efcfd8d62ef966ba5c3b.text: 在 阿爾科監禁區 中尋找露營車。

1e23f21c9a282488685145d2afaf1fe0808ff0d7.source: Steal the supplies from Herbalist Umjabwe.
1e23f21c9a282488685145d2afaf1fe0808ff0d7.text: 從草藥師 Umjabwe 那裡竊取補給品。

ecc0ba3571391e364d47177649cfddd34f04d6bd.source: Take the herbal remedies to Ruthless Sevad in Barbarous Shore or Elder Jonah in Ronjok.
ecc0ba3571391e364d47177649cfddd34f04d6bd.text: 將草藥交給 野蠻河岸 中的無情塞瓦德或 羅鳩村 中的喬納長老。

3fcac9bd1fbe3be6b3c5307f9965a4e22f46bf7e.source: Take the herbal remedies to Elder Jonah in Ronjok. (added if the party goes to Ruthless Sevad first)
3fcac9bd1fbe3be6b3c5307f9965a4e22f46bf7e.text: 將草藥交給 羅鳩村 的喬納長老。 （如果隊伍先去無情的塞瓦德則新增）

543ddaae9c51e06e7c5fbda6cde023b7891e2bee.source: This can be started from either the Command Post, Yohlon Haven or Pogahn Passage. The party will need to make their way to Umjabwe, who can be found in the north-east side of Arkjok Ward overlooking the farmland areas. Umjabwe will be surrounded by a group of Kournans, which the party will have to defeat to continue the quest.
543ddaae9c51e06e7c5fbda6cde023b7891e2bee.text: 這可以從 指揮所、猶朗避難所 或 波甘驛站 啟動。該隊伍需要前往 Umjabwe，Umjabwe 位於 阿爾科監禁區 的東北側，俯瞰農田地區。 Umjabwe 將被一群庫南人包圍，該黨必須擊敗他們才能繼續任務。

dc70655ba9b2000f4dd38d2d5acd705b10f1315d.source: Once the Kourans are dispatched, speak to Umjabwe to get his supplies, and then decide who is more deserving of them: the corsair blackmailer Ruthless Sevad, or the needy village of Ronjok.
dc70655ba9b2000f4dd38d2d5acd705b10f1315d.text: 庫蘭人被派遣出去後，與烏姆賈布韋交談以獲取他的補給品，然後決定誰更值得獲得這些補給品：海盜勒索者無情的塞瓦德，還是貧困的 羅鳩村 村莊。

275fe48b316156be4399ae7999b0dba6d354df74.source: To get to Ronjok, it's quickest to map back to the Sunspear Sanctuary and walk out into the Marga Coast where you will find Elder Jonah. Ruthless Sevad as always will be found in the Barbarous Shore, south of Camp Hojanu. Should you choose to speak with Ruthless Sevad first, an additional quest can be picked up before he directs you to take the medicines to Elder Jonah anyway.
275fe48b316156be4399ae7999b0dba6d354df74.text: 要到達 羅鳩村，最快的方法是映射回 日戟避難所，然後走進 馬加海岸，在那裡您會找到喬納長老。一如既往，冷酷無情的塞瓦德會出現在 何加努營地 以南的 野蠻河岸 中。如果你選擇先與無情的塞瓦德交談，那麼在他指示你將藥物帶給喬納長老之前，你可以接受一個額外的任務。

69a9f8629163473b8d783f1aed0c57c628d8b05f.source: To get the followup quest, you must return to see Ruthless Sevad, before taking the herbal remedies to Elder Jonah.
69a9f8629163473b8d783f1aed0c57c628d8b05f.text: 要完成後續任務，你必須返回見無情的塞瓦德，然後將草藥交給喬納長老。

0788675637dc35bcb0df4ea873ea61dda32824ae.source: Inform Palawa Joko about the Great Margonite Temple in The Sulfurous Wastes.
0788675637dc35bcb0df4ea873ea61dda32824ae.text: 向 帕勒瓦‧傑格 告知 硫磺荒地 中偉大的 瑪骨奈 寺廟的情況。

8781460baf24083b9802a908f69eb4528cdc6c8d.source: Report to Officer Lohru in the Remains of Sahlahja.
8781460baf24083b9802a908f69eb4528cdc6c8d.text: 向 Sahlahja 遺蹟的 Lohru 警官報告。

263d6cae2359c1593e3bd370e4fae490b98839f9.source: Report to Officer Lohru in The Sulfurous Wastes. She will release minions to you.
263d6cae2359c1593e3bd370e4fae490b98839f9.text: 向 硫磺荒地 中的 Lohru 警官報告。她會釋放爪牙給你。

cb05203879cd223f6772e74280f79aedba3bf72e.source: Destroy the Great Margonite Temple with the rune!
cb05203879cd223f6772e74280f79aedba3bf72e.text: 用符文摧毀偉大的 瑪骨奈 神殿！

7ad8d72967dbb2e676eddab76ec7cb755e6db62e.source: See Palawa Joko for your reward.
7ad8d72967dbb2e676eddab76ec7cb755e6db62e.text: 請參閱 帕勒瓦‧傑格 以取得獎勵。

82835ea178eb5e731ce467497ae802006574e846.source: Once this quest has been completed, allied Mummies will spawn in The Sulfurous Wastes and Graven Monoliths will no longer spawn in The Sulfurous Wastes.
82835ea178eb5e731ce467497ae802006574e846.text: 一旦完成此任務，盟友木乃伊將在 硫磺荒地 中生成，而墓碑將不再在 硫磺荒地 中生成。

b6fed84290d09b5b766f940679643a50c0a2865e.source: Firstly, you need to travel to the Bone Palace and talk to Palawa Joko.
b6fed84290d09b5b766f940679643a50c0a2865e.text: 首先，您需要前往 白骨宮殿 並與 帕勒瓦‧傑格 交談。

7a9f7353d69a8e5ed74cedd5cae7fb0c13224256.source: Next, you will need to travel back to the Remains of Sahlahja and talk to Officer Lohru (the quest giver). She will also give you a Rune of DOOM.
7a9f7353d69a8e5ed74cedd5cae7fb0c13224256.text: 接下來，您需要返回薩赫拉賈遺跡並與洛赫魯警官（任務提供者）交談。她還會給你一個 符文 of DOOM。

4d4b8aa555d335b41ea64a59a1f01d19d2c59aee.source: Then you must travel outside to The Sulfurous Wastes and optionally talk to Officer Lohru out there. There is no reason not to, though you are able to complete the quest without taking this step. She will give you four Minions of Joko to fight for you. They will not really help that much, just doing a little damage and taking some damage for you. Before you leave, consider bringing a lockpick or key, because in the temple there is one Ancient Elonian Chest and one Treasure Chest (the latter of which does not need a key).
4d4b8aa555d335b41ea64a59a1f01d19d2c59aee.text: 然後您必須前往 硫磺荒地 並選擇與那裡的 Lohru 警官交談。儘管您無需執行此步驟也可以完成任務，但沒有理由不這樣做。她會給你四個約科小小兵來為你戰鬥。他們不會真正幫助你那麼多，只是造成一點傷害並為你承受一些傷害。在離開之前，考慮帶一把 開鎖道具 或鑰匙，因為寺廟裡有一個古代伊隆尼亞 寶箱 和一個寶藏 寶箱（後者不需要鑰匙）。

2789ef1ca6d4ed52326f5b40d333d91398a0c0c3.source: Next you must travel from there to the Great Margonite Temple (structure at the bottom left of the map) using the wurms. You will have to defeat all of the enemies in the temple, then destroy it. There will be a ton of Graven Monoliths, but with your wurms, it should be no problem. There will also be Abaddon Shrines lining the outside of the temple. You will need to use each shrine, with the Rune of DOOM that you got earlier in your inventory. When you use each shrine, five Graven Monoliths will always spawn. With them will be either zero, two or four Margonites as well, except in the first shrine on the right-hand side when you first enter the temple. On the left-hand side, the first four Shrines will have only Monoliths, the last two will have two margonites. On the right-hand side, the first shrine will have three Margonite bosses, the next three will have four margonites and the last two will have two margonites.
2789ef1ca6d4ed52326f5b40d333d91398a0c0c3.text: 接下來，您必須使用亞龍從那裡前往偉大的 瑪骨奈 神殿（地圖左下角的結構）。你必須擊敗神廟中的所有敵人，然後摧毀它。會有大量的墓碑，但有了你的亞龍，這應該不成問題。寺廟外部也將設有 亞霸頓 神社。您將需要使用每個神殿以及您先前在庫存中獲得的 DOOM 符文。當您使用每個神殿時，總是會生成五個墳墓巨石。與他們一起的還有零個、兩個或四個瑪貢尼特，除了當你第一次進入神殿時右手邊的第一個神殿。在左側，前四個神殿將只有巨石，最後兩個神殿將有兩個瑪崗石。在右側，第一個神社將有三個 瑪骨奈 Boss，接下來的三個將有四個瑪崗石，最後兩個將有兩個瑪崗石。

bc61405c1f9f3ffd931ba2367ecf6feb18ee0458.source: After you use all of the shrines, your quest log will be updated, telling you to travel back to the Bone Palace and see Palawa Joko for your reward. You do not have to defeat all of the spawns to complete the quest.
bc61405c1f9f3ffd931ba2367ecf6feb18ee0458.text: 使用完所有神殿後，您的任務日誌將會更新，告訴您返回 白骨宮殿 並檢視 帕勒瓦‧傑格 以獲得獎勵。您不必擊敗所有生成點即可完成任務。

8cb1d135c3b34dc19374067c3a8ef166134eda4f.source: This quest can be used in conjunction with Requiem for a Brain to farm Sunspear and Lightbringer points (see Guide to farming Lightbringer promotion points).
8cb1d135c3b34dc19374067c3a8ef166134eda4f.text: 任務可以與《大腦安魂曲》一起使用來種植陽矛和光明使者點數（請參閱種植光明使者升級點指南）。

2b26ba17ce3422205aa4c04656136192c0670524.source: Some players avoid claiming the quest reward, since it provides an easy opportunity to farm Graven Monoliths for Inscribed Shards (needed for Sticks and Stones) or Elemental Swords. Remember to map out while one shrine remains (or abandon and retake the quest).
2b26ba17ce3422205aa4c04656136192c0670524.text: 一些玩家避免領取任務獎勵，因為它提供了一個輕鬆的機會來種植銘文碎片（棍棒和石頭所需）或 元素生物 劍。記得在剩下一座神殿的時候制定地圖（或放棄並重新接受任務）。

49869b6eadef6ff9873182a6549f54d104dd8d12.source: Although this quest is marked as "Master" difficulty, it can be easily completed using Junundu.
49869b6eadef6ff9873182a6549f54d104dd8d12.text: 雖然這個任務被標記為「Master」難度，但使用 Junundu 可以輕鬆完成。

c6b4bb769d8fb906549006b99163ecdbf75ec939.source: As with other triggered spawns, one or more of the shrine-based monoliths will sometimes appear without being able to aggro or respond to attacks. Likewise, heroes will not attack them until the player initiates combat. While in this inactive state, they appear in their fully assembled form.
c6b4bb769d8fb906549006b99163ecdbf75ec939.text: 與其他觸發生成一樣，一個或多個基於神殿的巨石有時會出現，但無法仇恨或回應攻擊。同樣，在玩家發動戰鬥之前，英雄不會攻擊他們。當處於非活動狀態時，它們會以完全組裝好的 型態 形式出現。

95557014a2397eff9ca8e5080d08732c7495c9c0.source: Visit some of Ahmtur's old friends and acquaintances. Find suitable reinforcements.
95557014a2397eff9ca8e5080d08732c7495c9c0.text: 拜訪阿姆圖爾的一些老朋友和熟人。尋找合適的增援。

8eb5a8f35cbcfbe6c5e424b13782c8ff49bdde86.source: Visit Ordash in the Kodash Bazaar.
8eb5a8f35cbcfbe6c5e424b13782c8ff49bdde86.text: 參觀柯達什市集 (Kodash Bazaar) 的奧爾達什 (Ordash)。

2226e5b1f5ff8061ebdf8469a8dc397329fc2559.source: See Archivist Mijir in the Halls of Chokhin.
2226e5b1f5ff8061ebdf8469a8dc397329fc2559.text: 在喬欣大廳見檔案管理員米吉爾。

d0ba43bbd1089256f59fb286eb4a3370af0059cc.source: Consult with retired General Poruk in Vehtendi Valley.
d0ba43bbd1089256f59fb286eb4a3370af0059cc.text: 請諮詢 巍天帝峽谷 中的退休將軍波魯克。

9dec5705dbb3207729ae86b81d70bd61ac759872.source: Speak to Hervahn the Vexing in Resplendent Makuun.
9dec5705dbb3207729ae86b81d70bd61ac759872.text: 與輝煌馬庫恩的惱人赫爾萬交談。

8aa7670defbf9c5e2266ccf1ac27193762dcb7f7.source: Ordash is easily found by mapping to the Kodash Bazaar and speaking to him near the fountain.
8aa7670defbf9c5e2266ccf1ac27193762dcb7f7.text: 透過對映到 Kodash Bazaar 並在噴泉附近與他交談，可以輕鬆找到 Ordash。

c83d87172fdc82b868ba7abe2d54f24f6e6fc2d2.source: Archivist Mijir is in the library north of Mihanu Township.
c83d87172fdc82b868ba7abe2d54f24f6e6fc2d2.text: 檔案管理員 Mijir 位於 米哈努小鎮 北部的圖書館。

4022b6dae85f569819f696897f5554fcf0d0503b.source: General Poruk is by a shrine, just to the east side of the Kodash Bazaar, head out of the south-east corner of the town.
4022b6dae85f569819f696897f5554fcf0d0503b.text: 波魯克將軍就在一座神社旁邊，就在科達什集市的東側，從城鎮的東南角出發。

b20d6675ed1a2428a367cb1e86cadb307dfe3740.source: Hervahn the Vexing is just to the south-east of Honur Hill in Prince Bokka's palace.
b20d6675ed1a2428a367cb1e86cadb307dfe3740.text: 令人惱火的赫爾萬位於博卡王子宮殿 霍奴爾丘陵 的東南方。

56616a1399b5cc4a7a02a2896487c6a4ff9fd550.source: It's worth noting that all these npcs can be reached and spoken to without the need to fight any creatures - getting to Mijir may need some fancy footwork to avoid aggroing the groups along the way, but it is possible.
56616a1399b5cc4a7a02a2896487c6a4ff9fd550.text: 值得注意的是，無需與任何生物戰鬥即可接觸到所有這些 NPC 並與之交談 - 到達米吉爾可能需要一些花哨的步法以避免沿途騷擾群體，但這是可能的。

47b8d5cc89f2cdb275e7aed8a88619172007d93d.source: Eliminate the corsairs camping out in Lahtenda Bog. 0..5 of 5 camps still remain.
47b8d5cc89f2cdb275e7aed8a88619172007d93d.text: 消滅在 洛天帝沼澤 露營的海盜。 0..5 和 5 營地仍然存在。

98e62fc32baf1fc55b6aa0335bed48e62cdaafc4.source: See Guard Kovu for your reward.
98e62fc32baf1fc55b6aa0335bed48e62cdaafc4.text: 請見守衛科烏以獲得獎勵。

190298364ac7742809fa0942672cd1190658874e.source: Head out into Lahtenda Bog and follow the green compass point to find the 5 corsair camps. There is a group of 6 level 15-17 Corsair Seamen at each camp. Expect pop-ups along the way.
190298364ac7742809fa0942672cd1190658874e.text: 前往 洛天帝沼澤，依照綠色羅盤點尋找 5 海盜營地。每個營地都有一組 6 等級 15-17 海盜 水手。預計一路上會有彈出視窗。

24af7262266f62578aeb07f37f82390b08daa21d.source: Catch the three children and retrieve the stolen spores.
24af7262266f62578aeb07f37f82390b08daa21d.text: 抓住三個孩子並取回被偷的孢子。

32e03b233a1e86baac462013400fa0792ebeb315.source: Enter Zehlon Reach by way of the Astralarium. As you approach the group of three children, they'll begin to discuss the spores they stole from Scholar Chago. They'll notice you and start running - Nehduvad in one direction, and Adina and Paldinam in the opposite direction.
32e03b233a1e86baac462013400fa0792ebeb315.text: 經由星辰館進入澤隆河段。當您接近三個孩子時，他們將開始討論從學者查戈那裡偷來的孢子。他們會注意到你並開始奔跑——內杜瓦德朝一個方向跑，阿迪娜和帕爾迪納姆朝相反方向跑。

ac11b28c10f653b64675b414f646508c7abe3d5e.source: It's easy to get close to the children while they are standing and talking; simply get inside their little circle, and then talk to them very quickly once Nehduvad shouts to run away. It is possible to catch all 3 of them before they get past the first group of insects.
ac11b28c10f653b64675b414f646508c7abe3d5e.text: 當孩子們站著說話時，很容易拉近與他們的距離；只需進入他們的小圈子，然後一旦內杜瓦德大喊要逃跑，就很快地與他們交談。在它們越過第一組昆蟲之前，可以捕獲所有 3。

9387c176bac165211ceca060eaef4ccd0868d281.source: If that fails, then it's best to use a speed boosting skill to try and catch the children before they wander off. If the children slip away from you, don't worry. They meet up near the exit to the Cliffs of Dohjok to the south. The children will run through mobs of insects, corsairs, skale, and plants. Travel southwest and take out the groups one by one, grabbing bounties along the way.
9387c176bac165211ceca060eaef4ccd0868d281.text: 如果失敗了，那麼最好使用速度提陞技能，在孩子們走開之前嘗試抓住他們。如果孩子們從你身邊溜走，別擔心。他們在 杜夏懸崖 南邊的出口附近集合。孩子們將穿過成群的昆蟲、海盜、蛇和植物。向西南方行駛，一一消滅這些隊伍，沿途搶奪賞金。

4361606f6a3a73863db5a5fdc83f935ca164264e.source: If you reach the exit to the Cliffs of Dohjok before the children do, simply wait for them to show up. Use your speed boosting skill of choice to run up to them and get the spore. Once you've spoken with all three children, return to the Astralarium and see Scholar Chago to get your reward.
4361606f6a3a73863db5a5fdc83f935ca164264e.text: 如果您在孩子之前到達 杜夏懸崖 的出口，只需等待他們出現即可。使用您選擇的加速技能跑向他們並獲取孢子。與所有三個孩子交談完後，返回星體館並見學者查戈以獲得獎勵。

58ac55dc5f7596db9a39590b83adbf6bf96b0bcd.source: Meet up with Charen in the Ruptured Heart.
58ac55dc5f7596db9a39590b83adbf6bf96b0bcd.text: 在破碎之心與查倫會面。

fdec188df86d00c46e8b6307cb7c7299715c717f.source: Journey with Charen to find Rebirther Jirath, the Margonite soul eater.
fdec188df86d00c46e8b6307cb7c7299715c717f.text: 與查倫一起尋找重生者吉拉斯，瑪骨奈 噬魂者。

f3b0165c409f575d47243a51c6ca5e2bf82857a1.source: Wait in hiding until you hear the signal. The code word is: cat.
f3b0165c409f575d47243a51c6ca5e2bf82857a1.text: 躲起來等待，直到聽到訊號。暗號是：貓。

bbc4156efcf8ba9d4d29c144bb965e2827028364.source: Kill the soul eating Margonite before he devours Charen.
bbc4156efcf8ba9d4d29c144bb965e2827028364.text: 在吞噬靈魂的 瑪骨奈 吞噬查倫之前殺死他。

0918425f51d17e5216a38bb4f03b6665d8d15e6f.source: Once you meet Charen in the North Eastern portion of The Ruptured Heart go south to the shrine where Jirath is waiting. Initially he will be an ally and you will not be able to attack him. Wait for Charen to talk to Jirath without going in Jirath's aggro range or Jirath will flee before he becomes an enemy. If you wait patiently the dialogue will follow and Jirath will start attacking Charen. You must kill him before he kills Charen to successfully complete the quest.
0918425f51d17e5216a38bb4f03b6665d8d15e6f.text: 當你在 破裂之心 的東北部遇到 Charen 後，向南前往 Jirath 正在等待的神社。最初他將是一個盟友，你將無法攻擊他。等待查倫與吉拉斯交談，但不要進入吉拉斯的仇恨範圍，否則吉拉斯會在他成為敵人之前逃跑。如果你耐心等待，對話將會隨之而來，吉拉斯將開始攻擊查倫。你必須在他殺死查倫之前殺死他才能成功完成任務。

50d6c7df70c90909dfc0afd5f1c45825435b66dc.source: To make things easier you can clear the area of monsters first, optionally using the Junundu. There is a Wurm Spoor close-by.
50d6c7df70c90909dfc0afd5f1c45825435b66dc.text: 為了讓事情變得更容易，你可以先清除怪物區域，也可以選擇使用 Junundu。附近有一個 地蟲 Spoor。

e3338e721cd75f341e98fd77a863ef30e0b60e51.source: If, during your current visit, you have passed near the resurrection shrine where Jirath is, Charen will head directly there (instead of staying with you) and will often get stuck on the way, preventing completion of the quest. If rezoning does not work, you can try abandoning the quest: afterward, return to the Ruptured Heart to pick up the quest again and this time, avoid the shrine until after you speak to Charen.
e3338e721cd75f341e98fd77a863ef30e0b60e51.text: 如果在你目前訪問期間，你經過了吉拉斯所在的復活神殿附近，查倫會直接前往那裡（而不是和你呆在一起），並且經常被困在路上，從而阻止任務完成。如果重新分割槽不起作用，你可以嘗試放棄任務：之後，返回破碎之心再次接受任務，這一次，避開神殿，直到你與查倫交談。

cc13bb0b91ae302943dd8c72b2000001e233a007.source: Follow the ridge east until you find a plague worm. Kill all the Plague Worms in the time allotted.
cc13bb0b91ae302943dd8c72b2000001e233a007.text: 沿著山脊向東走，直到找到瘟疫蠕蟲。在規定的時間內殺死所有瘟疫蠕蟲。

01e180e609818fce46f535426853eedf415b29e3.text: 殺死 [5...0]/0 更多瘟疫蠕蟲。

e5afda78f7e8f831148d8a305c0c7af81d60826a.source: Return to Ivor Trueshot for your reward.
e5afda78f7e8f831148d8a305c0c7af81d60826a.text: 影返 至 神射手伊波爾 以獲得獎勵。

f3ce046dc59eb0dd695c5900c3aa6078f1a91606.source: Ivor Trueshot will give you a Starter bow and the following skills upon taking the quest:
f3ce046dc59eb0dd695c5900c3aa6078f1a91606.text: 接受任務後，神射手伊波爾 將為您提供一把入門弓和以下技能：

f2f58ddf66ed1d20c5ff32ede8e71a348c09dce2.source: This is a simple quest. Just go to the pointed location and kill all the worms in under 1 minute and 30 seconds. Using the skills provided with the quest will make it much easier for Bow wielding characters.
f2f58ddf66ed1d20c5ff32ede8e71a348c09dce2.text: 這是一個簡單的任務。只需前往指定位置並在 1 分鐘和 30 秒內殺死所有蠕蟲。使用任務中提供的技能將使使用 弓 的角色變得更加容易。

666707976351ac0ffabb4d776828a1d1c8974c20.source: The worms do not need to be killed with a bow to complete this quest.
666707976351ac0ffabb4d776828a1d1c8974c20.text: 不需要用弓殺死蠕蟲即可完成此任務。

01ec8f71243b2246dccef94e652faf7a819ae400.source: The skills will not be removed if the quest is abandoned or the timer runs out. This is useful if a careful experience management strategy is needed.
01ec8f71243b2246dccef94e652faf7a819ae400.text: 如果任務被放棄或計時器耗盡，技能不會被刪除。如果需要仔細的體驗管理策略，這非常有用。

b0e744b00f573a8e9844553b83c4da1abbde635f.source: Once the quest is completed, the worms will not spawn anymore
b0e744b00f573a8e9844553b83c4da1abbde635f.text: 任務完成後，蠕蟲將不再生成

37020b15a9a5dc861b5dac4d25f898aa74a701d6.source: Assault the Kournan column marching north to Jahai.
37020b15a9a5dc861b5dac4d25f898aa74a701d6.text: 攻擊向北行進至賈海的庫爾南縱隊。

39435f665ec0fbb94faedb0b06f77b686a2c58ac.source: Fall back to escape the incoming Kournan army.
39435f665ec0fbb94faedb0b06f77b686a2c58ac.text: 撤退以躲避即將到來的庫爾南軍隊。

0202f1d06b7d849b673ea5c0ebb03f28f3af056b.source: Run toward Pogahn to escape the Kournan reinforcements.
0202f1d06b7d849b673ea5c0ebb03f28f3af056b.text: 跑過 前往波加恩以躲避庫爾南增援部隊。

d035ff1bb43ff90202dc73143ddff2c7f4c213d7.source: Exit Pogahn Passage and head west. Clearing the path between the portal and Nerashi’s location, (including the two Kournan guards near Gandara's side gate) will make this quest easier.
d035ff1bb43ff90202dc73143ddff2c7f4c213d7.text: 退出 波甘驛站 並向西行駛。清理傳送門和奈拉什位置之間的道路（包括甘達拉側門附近的兩名庫南守衛）將使這個任務變得更容易。

294b2606212fe1a09b042fae07ab97903958b13d.source: Once you reach Nerashi, there are two possible strategies. The first option is the quicker, more direct approach. The second strategy takes longer, but can be easier & safer.
294b2606212fe1a09b042fae07ab97903958b13d.text: 一旦到達 Nerashi，有兩種可能的策略。第一個選擇是更快、更直接的方法。第二種策略需要更長的時間，但更容易、更安全。

ee026f2ebccac17a81e7053f77f520160c16b40e.source: Accepting the quest from Nerashi will cause three waves of Kournan soldiers to advance toward your location. Each wave must be completely defeated before the next will begin their approach.
ee026f2ebccac17a81e7053f77f520160c16b40e.text: 接受奈拉什的任務將會導致三波庫南士兵向你所在的位置前進。在下一波攻擊開始之前，每一波攻擊都必須被徹底擊敗。

2dedf02b08ba87d396fec2155db006643d4168f9.source:
The first wave is made up of Kournan Guards, Phalanxes and Bowmen. 
 The second wave is a combination of Kournan Priests, Seers and Scribes. 
 The third wave is a mix of Kournan Zealots and Oppressors.
2dedf02b08ba87d396fec2155db006643d4168f9.text:
第一波由庫南衛兵、方陣和弓箭手組成。 
 第二波是庫南牧師、先知和文士的組合。 
 第三波是庫南狂熱者和壓迫者的混合體。

93bd8b9b9149179e49ff9d04f21637154734b0b7.source: Once the first three waves are defeated, the quest marker will update and Nerashi will tell the party to fall back. You can choose to stay and fight the extra groups, but be forewarned that all three waves will attack as one mob, and can easily overwhelm an unprepared party.
93bd8b9b9149179e49ff9d04f21637154734b0b7.text: 一旦前三波被擊敗，任務標記就會更新，奈拉什會告訴隊伍撤退。你可以選擇留下來與額外的隊伍戰鬥，但要預先警告，所有三波攻擊都會作為一個暴徒進行攻擊，並且很容易壓倒毫無準備的隊伍。

16506702b9a0f83aaf5bc148d78dbc59f494d74f.source: Whether you choose to fight or run, another Kournan ambush waits to the east, at the quest marker. Pulling the mobs toward the small bridge can help prevent over-aggro (and/or getting hit by Kournan siege fire from Gandara.) After the second set of Kournan mobs are killed, Nerashi will again advise the party to retreat. As before, you can choose to fight the incoming soldiers, or just run to the next quest marker right outside of Pogahn Passage.
16506702b9a0f83aaf5bc148d78dbc59f494d74f.text: 無論你選擇戰鬥還是逃跑，另一個庫爾南伏擊會在東邊的任務標記處等待。將小怪拉向小橋可以幫助防止過度仇恨（和/或被甘達拉的庫南攻城火力擊中）。在第二組庫南小怪被殺死後，奈拉什將再次建議隊伍撤退。和以前一樣，你可以選擇與到來計程車兵戰鬥，或者直接跑到 波甘驛站 外面的下一個任務標記。

7d38e88662b17948e59135a816911413c66321b1.source: Do not enter the portal. Wait for the quest to update, and then collect your reward from Nerashi.
7d38e88662b17948e59135a816911413c66321b1.text: 不要進入門戶。等待任務更新，然後從奈拉什領取獎勵。

bc9243e506954d7d53b77d28152a4cc1fdf73dc2.source: Instead of taking the quest from Nerashi, the easier approach is to completely ignore her until your party is finished clearing all the Kournans from the area.
bc9243e506954d7d53b77d28152a4cc1fdf73dc2.text: 與其接受 Nerashi 的任務，更簡單的方法是完全忽略她，直到你的團隊完成清除該地區的所有 Kournans。

af58d7c97ae10cbc9c884422fb02fcefdd6a2a48.source: The soldiers are clumped together into three large groups in the western plain just past Nerashi. (These mobs are the first three waves and both extra groups that chase the party.) They can be easily pulled and defeated, one at a time. Sometimes, one group will break off and gather around Nerashi, but will not attack her. Clear the remaining Kournans, and then pick off that mob as normal.
af58d7c97ae10cbc9c884422fb02fcefdd6a2a48.text: 士兵們在奈拉什附近的西部平原上聚整合三大群。 （這些小怪是前三波，也是追逐隊伍的額外小組。）它們可以很容易地被拉動和擊敗，一次一個。有時，一群人會分開並聚集在奈拉什周圍，但不會攻擊她。清除剩餘的庫南人，然後像往常一樣幹掉那個怪物。

2fb99e84a84fc8acd4b5f5f65c2a4bc1fc588874.source: Consider activating the nearby resurrection shrine, so the party can easily pick up where they left off in case of disaster.
2fb99e84a84fc8acd4b5f5f65c2a4bc1fc588874.text: 考慮啟動附近的復活神殿，這樣隊伍就可以在災難發生時輕鬆地從上次停下的地方繼續前進。

d78f69ea55e9e494f59a6edb93374a671010877b.source: Once all three groups have been eliminated, continue back east and defeat the soldiers that spawn near the fortress. Scout the path back to Pogahn Passage, clearing any stray Kournans, then return to Nerashi to take the quest.
d78f69ea55e9e494f59a6edb93374a671010877b.text: 一旦所有三個小組都被消滅，繼續向東返回並擊敗在堡壘附近產卵計程車兵。偵察返回 波甘驛站 的路徑，清除所有迷失的 Kournan，然後返回 Nerashi 接受任務。

c0a05d5bf22c53faeff67176a50c8a0e4d50b0cf.source: Follow her through the now-empty quest markers, but do not run into Pogahn Passage. Wait until the quest updates, then accept the reward.
c0a05d5bf22c53faeff67176a50c8a0e4d50b0cf.text: 跟著她穿過現已空的任務標記，但不要遇到 波甘驛站。等待任務更新，然後接受獎勵。

f2f50dcad71467ce57b6c10e951823fccf31d852.source: It is recommended that you complete this quest prior to vanquishing the area, as it spawns several mobs of Kournan Soldiers.
f2f50dcad71467ce57b6c10e951823fccf31d852.text: 建議您在征服該地區之前完成此任務，因為它會產生一些庫南士兵小怪。

08aa502b8a72e9e91802a7fc8ef432e39e0fe132.source: As per A Time for Heroes quest.
08aa502b8a72e9e91802a7fc8ef432e39e0fe132.text: 根據 英雄的光彩年代 任務。

42a20647469e41d35c47b50d731c543b4de5a937.source: Kill insects and gather 10 Scarab Spores for Scholar Chago. 0...10 of 10 spores gathered.
42a20647469e41d35c47b50d731c543b4de5a937.text: 殺死昆蟲並為學者查戈收集 10 聖甲蟲孢子。 10 孢子的 0...10 聚集。

8335bf9be42b917f63ce0c6e18b278c81d9e82a3.source: You can farm insects in Fahranur, The First City. Start from Blacktide Den if you want a party of eight.
8335bf9be42b917f63ce0c6e18b278c81d9e82a3.text: 您可以在 舊城 法蘭努爾 中養殖昆蟲。如果您想要八人聚會，請從 Blacktide Den 開始。

d2060a58d7be2386c57c03ad700ff681dedf3e86.source: It's a good idea to do the quest Defender's Choice at the same time, since the insects reached from the Jokanur Diggings entrance is near the targets for Defender's Choice.
d2060a58d7be2386c57c03ad700ff681dedf3e86.text: 同時執行任務 守護者之盾 的選擇是個好主意，因為從 Jokanur 礦區入口到達的昆蟲靠近 守護者之盾 的選擇的目標。

1d031385ca2a875b595ac973407673fb71da465f.source: Follow the path along Majesty's Rest towards the Sage Lands. There are fewer foes if you go around the north of The Mausoleum and Rotscale.
1d031385ca2a875b595ac973407673fb71da465f.text: 沿著 王者安息處 的路徑前往 賢者領地。如果你繞過陵墓和 惡臭骨龍 的北部，敵人會更少。

cc68a28a722f38a213e5e7b9f206aee540cb90ed.source: As in other Hearts of the North mini-missions:
cc68a28a722f38a213e5e7b9f206aee540cb90ed.text: 與其他 極地之心 迷你任務一樣：

9326b1ed010746ccbb4c80e12a937f94a6d71533.source: Use Keiran's Sniper Shot against targets called out by Miku, which causes over 900 points of damage if it hits (unless Miku's Promise of Death is removed).
9326b1ed010746ccbb4c80e12a937f94a6d71533.text: 使用 Keiran 的狙擊射擊攻擊 Miku 召喚的目標，如果擊中目標，會造成超過 900 點的傷害（除非 Miku 的死亡承諾被移除）。

c5a9e3acb34196863e173791bf2061e2c4b45cf8.source: If Miku dies, she will self-resurrect once no enemies are in earshot.
c5a9e3acb34196863e173791bf2061e2c4b45cf8.text: 如果 Miku 死亡，一旦沒有敵人在耳邊，她就會自我復活。

3fb04b012f401debcca02f0470c1d7912f20f28e.source: This quest is automatically obtained upon entering Majesty's Rest (via the Scrying Pool), and will be removed should one leave.
3fb04b012f401debcca02f0470c1d7912f20f28e.text: 該任務在進入 王者安息處（透過占卜池）時自動獲得，一旦離開就會被刪除。

653597d24bd02d898804111f0aa04c7e0e650d4a.source: The foes that spawn near Danthor (friendly until approached) can be individually pulled.
653597d24bd02d898804111f0aa04c7e0e650d4a.text: 在丹託附近生成的敵人（在接近之前是友好的）可以單獨拉動。

47ed97813cdd3b5e508ac533014540a53176e482.source: Danthor can be separated from his group and killed quickly, ending the mission. Attack him, step back and wait for Miku to call him as a target, then use Keiran's Sniper Shot to finish the job.
47ed97813cdd3b5e508ac533014540a53176e482.text: 丹索爾可以與他的團隊分開並迅速殺死，從而結束任務。攻擊他，後退一步等待 Miku 把他作為目標，然後使用 Keiran 的狙擊射擊來完成任務。

1e825d14db7ff03f66c1064aeb89df4fa38b6ec6.source: Even if you die, this quest can still be completed if Danthor dies (either via Miku or degen).
1e825d14db7ff03f66c1064aeb89df4fa38b6ec6.text: 即使你死了，如果丹託死了（透過 Miku 或 degen），這個任務仍然可以完成。

c7e3d183126cdb50e411422166aceff843a77e6c.source: If your inventory is full after Danthor is defeated, any reward items will be dropped on the ground; they will be in the Unclaimed Items box the next time you enter an outpost, if you do not get a chance to pick them up sooner.
c7e3d183126cdb50e411422166aceff843a77e6c.text: 如果丹索爾被擊敗後你的物品欄已滿，任何獎勵物品都會掉落在地上；如果您沒有機會盡快拿起它們，那麼下次您進入前哨站時，它們將出現在無人認領的物品框中。

62010b7c3c96a116434cf2f257c6ca32f18844ea.source: While you must equip Keiran's Bow to access this mission, you can switch it out for another weapon, including a long or flatbow for pulling and especially one that has weapon upgrades appropriate to Keiran's skills. However, you cannot increase his maximum health, energy, or total attributes using weapon or armor upgrades.
62010b7c3c96a116434cf2f257c6ca32f18844ea.text: 雖然您必須裝備 Keiran 的 弓 才能執行此任務，但您可以將其換成另一種武器，包括用於拉動的長弓或扁弓，尤其是具有適合 Keiran 技能的武器升級的武器。但是，您無法使用武器或護甲升級來增加他的最大生命值、能量或總屬性。

b848d14a4d123e2fb7ec2cdd412428091b2034d8.source: Rotscale can be killed during this mission, making this an easy way to get Rotwing Recurve Bow. However, his death during this mission will not count for his Zaishen Bounty.
b848d14a4d123e2fb7ec2cdd412428091b2034d8.text: 惡臭骨龍 可以在此任務中被殺死，這使得這是獲得 墮落反曲弓 的簡單方法。然而，他在這次任務中的死亡不會計入他的 戰承懸賞 中。

4b126d5ebcfe0286b3ae15c40b6f50b424efbb6a.text: *獎勵* 在 20 分鐘內擊敗 亞霸頓。

88bf4bbe5a9edf01888a32a5cda312e17ddd131d.source: Complete the Base Objective for 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
88bf4bbe5a9edf01888a32a5cda312e17ddd131d.text: 完成 30 再神銅幣的基礎 任務目標。

7b876192a5142e19cee7c32d3df53ce21c1e60d8.source: Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 45 Zaishen Copper Coins.
7b876192a5142e19cee7c32d3df53ce21c1e60d8.text: 完成第一個*獎勵* 任務目標 可獲得額外的 45 Zaishen 銅幣。

8fe4c240679a74573bcb4857137a25c891cfef7f.source: Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.
8fe4c240679a74573bcb4857137a25c891cfef7f.text: 完成第二個*獎勵* 任務目標 可獲得額外的 75 Zaishen 銅幣。

1a39cc9ddf7da60df85bc6beb104a9bb48c0061b.source: As per the Abaddon's Gate mission.
1a39cc9ddf7da60df85bc6beb104a9bb48c0061b.text: 根據 亞霸頓 的 Gate 任務。

44924463325f9b133461a5f43ec7fda42a3841c2.source: Open the Door of Komalie on the Ring of Fire Islands.
44924463325f9b133461a5f43ec7fda42a3841c2.text: 開啟 火環群島地域 上的 Komalie 之門。

1e05ad5db44348bd57c97dba550449ea80cef24c.source: *BONUS* Guide the spirit of Leah Stone to her rest.
1e05ad5db44348bd57c97dba550449ea80cef24c.text: *獎勵*引導利亞·斯通的靈魂安息。

f634e737fc78683d85de398badd90fe3671dae7d.source: Find your way north of the Wall. Search the road to Piken Square for Ben Wolfson.
f634e737fc78683d85de398badd90fe3671dae7d.text: 找到長城以北的路。尋找 Ben Wolfson 通往 派肯廣場 的道路。

d73e8d04d7bf32623b829570b5fdf45ecea4af17.source: Lead Ben Wolfson back to the gate.
d73e8d04d7bf32623b829570b5fdf45ecea4af17.text: 帶領本·沃爾夫森回到大門。

813392622f86267ee859e2c405001081a50abf94.source: Return to Gate Guard Torin for your reward.
813392622f86267ee859e2c405001081a50abf94.text: 影返 至 城門警衛陶寧 以獲得獎勵。

0278c289668d26896455d483f077eed4e8d2ff75.text: 魅惑之長弓（反曲弓皮膚）

a0a3871bc464128a178be75c3aaaeef0e9a3b7d0.text: 致命短棒（戰儀杖 皮膚）

371361d13cff13ff84b7dcb3cc790df37a777b1a.source: Reforged Mode: After completing this quest, even before accepting the reward, Ben Wolfson will spawn in Lakeside County next to Gate Guard Torin, offering A Bastion In the North.
371361d13cff13ff84b7dcb3cc790df37a777b1a.text: 重鑄模式：完成此任務後，甚至在接受獎勵之前，本·沃爾夫森將在 城門警衛陶寧 旁的 湖畔郡 中生成，提供北方堡壘。

ff6c5f42c0feeb73f70aa616ff706751abf8a1d3.source: In the Northlands, head north, ignoring the path east leading to large ruins and packs of Charr. You should come to a fork in the road, with one path descending to the right (north-east) toward areas of water and one to the left (west) leading to a cliff and a few Oakhearts.
ff6c5f42c0feeb73f70aa616ff706751abf8a1d3.text: 在北地，往北走，忽略通往大型廢墟和 夏爾 的東邊小路。你應該來到一個岔路口，其中一條路向右（東北）下降，通往水域，另一條路向左（向西）通往懸崖和一些橡心樹。

84d366362cb6ee69d0d6c8191d675af352693d68.source: Follow the left path. At its end, you will find a group of Grawl at the bottom of the cliff to the right, a group of four Charr near one of their gods' effigy to the left, with Ben in the back in between. Avoid aggroing any of the two hostile groups. While the Grawl should not pose much of a threat, the Charr will easily kill you in a matter of seconds if you are not prepared for them. Wait until they group up before carefully sneaking past them, hugging the cliff to the right.
84d366362cb6ee69d0d6c8191d675af352693d68.text: 沿著左邊的路走。在盡頭，您會在右側的懸崖底部發現一組 穴居人，在左側的一個神的雕像附近有四個 夏爾，Ben 位於中間。避免攻擊兩個敵對團體中的任何一個。雖然 穴居人 不會構成太大的威脅，但如果您沒有做好應對準備，夏爾 很容易在幾秒鐘內殺死您。等到他們聚集在一起，然後小心翼翼地從他們身邊溜過去，緊貼著右側的懸崖。

b676d1ab0804d809e693ce3124d2adc1c31ec42e.source: Alternatively, instead of taking the left path at the fork, you can opt for the right one instead, crossing the lake. This makes it easier to avoid the Charr, but you will have to confront the group of Grawl directly, as they are in the way.
b676d1ab0804d809e693ce3124d2adc1c31ec42e.text: 或者，您也可以選擇右側的路線，穿過湖泊，而不是在岔路口走左側的路線。這可以更輕鬆地避開 夏爾，但你必須直接面對 穴居人 的隊伍，因為他們擋道了。

de2a5ff3f3175b2bb8a146372e0b291f91cabfd8.source: As you get close to Ben, the quest will update and the Grawl will start moving toward Ben's location in an attempt to ambush you. You can either dispose of them with Ben's help, or simply back up to the cliff, wait and sneak around them. Note that you need to get closer to Ben than just aggro range, as he will not follow you otherwise (despite him telling you "I'm right behind you"). Occasionaly, the Grawl may even aggro the Charr, usually leading to their death.
de2a5ff3f3175b2bb8a146372e0b291f91cabfd8.text: 當您接近 Ben 時，任務將會更新，穴居人 將開始向 Ben 的位置移動，試圖伏擊您。你可以在本的幫助下處理掉它們，或者乾脆回到懸崖上，等待並偷偷繞過它們。請注意，你需要靠近本，而不僅僅是仇恨範圍，否則他不會跟隨你（儘管他告訴你「我就在你身後」）。有時，穴居人 甚至可能會攻擊 夏爾，通常會導致它們死亡。

eb4138aa4d8bfad8763bcf7b2662b995ae031413.source: To complete the quest, simply escort Ben back to the gate. Go through the gate yourself and talk to Torin for your reward.
eb4138aa4d8bfad8763bcf7b2662b995ae031413.text: 要完成任務，只需護送本回到大門即可。親自穿過大門並與託林交談以獲得獎勵。

83eac45bd366185e7c219fcc063ff8b83c501522.source: Having Across the Wall active in the quest log will override NPC spawns for A Bastion In the North and will prevent access to the Piken Square outpost (except by map travel) and the Forsaken Tunnels, so it must be abandoned or completed (though not necessarily handed in for rewards) whenever the subsequent quests are attempted.
83eac45bd366185e7c219fcc063ff8b83c501522.text: 在任務日誌中啟動 通過城牆 將覆蓋北方堡壘的 NPC 生成，並阻止訪問 派肯廣場 前哨站（地圖旅行除外）和被遺忘的隧道，因此每當嘗試後續任務時都必須放棄或完成它（儘管不一定會提交獎勵）。

9859f30c2e3e91acba91349245000a8aa5d13f2e.source: During this quest, all three gates leading to the northern section of the Northlands will be open, instead of just the Piken Square gate.
9859f30c2e3e91acba91349245000a8aa5d13f2e.text: 在此任務期間，通往北地北部的所有三個大門都將開啟，而不僅僅是 派肯廣場 大門。

e87fb6dd7f6e5e8845f140d5eee82b3ed0e8a6dc.source: Kill Admiral Kantoh in the Fortress of Jahai.
e87fb6dd7f6e5e8845f140d5eee82b3ed0e8a6dc.text: 在 Jahai 堡壘殺死 上將 坎托。

aa9e0f8d9305a957f5180337e65c1c393dd8960a.source: *BONUS* Kill Admiral Kantoh in Hard Mode.
aa9e0f8d9305a957f5180337e65c1c393dd8960a.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 上將 坎托。

593678f545e7dd035141cd35246edaa95ffc3d6d.source: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Zaishen Copper Coins.
593678f545e7dd035141cd35246edaa95ffc3d6d.text: 完成 20 再神銅幣的基礎 任務目標。

138a5f35dd03a8cda3df2badacf2c0884e559e94.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.
138a5f35dd03a8cda3df2badacf2c0884e559e94.text: 完成*獎勵* 任務目標 可獲得額外的 50 Zaishen 銅幣。

d91eeaa01abbde259ac12568295b9ebbdee1482c.source: Leave from the Sunspear Sanctuary, through the Command Post into Jahai Bluffs. From there keep going east until you reach the Fortress of Jahai. There are a large number of foes within the fort so it is advised to bring a longbow for pulling. Also area of effect skills are of great use. Skills like Panic, Spiteful Spirit, and Searing Flames can greatly help turn the odds. A minion master is also valuable in taking advantage of the number of corpses, but be careful as they can overaggro. The boss is at the very top of the fort and should not be too much of a problem if your party makes it to him without much difficulty. Speed tip: It is not necessary to fight all the Kournan foe and go to the top of the hill, if you aggro the Admiral from outside the fort - before crossing the bridge. Killing him is possible with skills that will ignore walls. This can avoid 6 or 7 mobs of Kournan.
d91eeaa01abbde259ac12568295b9ebbdee1482c.text: 從日戟避難所離開，經過指揮所進入夏亥峭壁。從那裡繼續向東行駛，直到到達賈海堡壘。要塞內敵人較多，建議攜帶長弓進行牽引。區域效果技能也很有用。 恐慌、惡靈附身 和 爆裂火焰 等技能可以大大幫助扭轉局面。僕從大師在利用屍體數量方面也很有價值，但要小心，因為它們可能會過度仇恨。老闆位於要塞的最頂端，如果你的隊伍沒有太大困難就能到達他那裡，那麼應該不會有太大問題。速度提示：如果你在過橋之前從堡壘外攻擊海軍上將，則無需與所有庫南敵人戰鬥並到達山頂。使用無視牆壁的技能可以殺死他。這可以避免庫南的6或7小怪。

97f87ed9c09a133c2689f61fc186e9eb49c054e2.text: 任何已啟動的徽章任務

9602261a61724992eec828d61b4c15f3f6d00572.source: Talk to Weng Gha again to begin your test.
9602261a61724992eec828d61b4c15f3f6d00572.text: 再次與 Wen Gha 交談以開始測試。

e417c17b0fd7e42f920ff4dda01db07b903cec76.source: Use defensive skills to survive attacks for 2 minutes, or defeat Jinzo and Weng Gha.
e417c17b0fd7e42f920ff4dda01db07b903cec76.text: 使用防禦技能在 2 分鐘內抵禦攻擊，或擊敗 Jinzo 和 Weng Gha。

e0b3698ac1dcf5397622937a781b943cedb4cb96.source:
If you can, just defeat them. Otherwise, use the skills you gained when accepting the quest to stay alive for as long as you can.
 Also, since Weng Gha will be using Drunken Blow, bring a condition removal skill.
e0b3698ac1dcf5397622937a781b943cedb4cb96.text:
如果可以的話，就打敗他們吧。否則，請使用您在接受任務時獲得的技能來盡可能長時間地生存。
 另外，由於Weng Gha將使用酣醉打擊，請帶上條件消除技能。

ba247c0212fbabb2cd62dcc4bc6022609dc0d04d.source: Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills if you wait until you are Weh no Su. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.
ba247c0212fbabb2cd62dcc4bc6022609dc0d04d.text: 由於技能是在接受這個任務時給予的，所以如果你等到你成為Weh no Su，你實際上可以學習所有技能。只需接受任務，放棄它，切換次要職業，然後再次接受任務。重複直到你的角色學會所有技能。

9c92bffc532f5a730735b1dea9d47c4b269952dc.source: Return to Ascalon City. Form a party with another player.
9c92bffc532f5a730735b1dea9d47c4b269952dc.text: 影返 到 阿斯卡隆城。與另一名玩家組成隊伍。

393f5cd2d84cc5167a1754b6a58aa3c535032b13.source: This is a very simple and short quest. All that is needed is a fellow party member. If you don't have a friend online, there are generally plenty of players in Ascalon City wanting to do this quest as well, so if you need someone, just send a message in the chat window. If you find a player who is willing to join you, and they haven't invited you already, you will need to invite them to join you. Once you have a full party and both of you are ready, exit Ascalon City towards Lakeside County and the quest is complete. Speak to Lina the Healer for the reward.
393f5cd2d84cc5167a1754b6a58aa3c535032b13.text: 這是一個非常簡單且簡短的任務。所需要的只是一名黨員。如果你沒有線上好友，阿斯卡隆城 中通常有很多玩家也想做這個任務，所以如果你需要某人，只需在聊天視窗中傳送訊息即可。如果您找到願意加入您的玩家，而他們尚未邀請您，您需要邀請他們加入您。一旦你們的隊伍已滿並且你們都準備好了，退出 阿斯卡隆城 前往 湖畔郡，任務就完成了。與 治癒師麗娜 聯絡以獲得獎勵。

25e478dba56bd61d7012538316a39c98efecf40c.source: It is worth doing this quest in order to get the Resurrection Signet, even if you intend to solo during the entirety of your time in pre-Searing Ascalon, since you'll have to pay in order to get it following the Searing. You may wish to skip this quest if you take Monk as your primary or secondary profession, as reusable resurrection skills are available later on; however, none are available immediately after reaching post-Searing Ascalon.
25e478dba56bd61d7012538316a39c98efecf40c.text: 為了獲得 復活紋章 做這個任務是值得的，即使你打算在 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 之前的整個時間裡獨奏，因為你必須付費才能在 崩壞 之後獲得它。如果您將 僧侶 作為您的主要或次要職業，您可能想要跳過此任務，因為稍後將提供可重複使用的復活技能；但是，在到達後 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 後，沒有一個立即可用。

d21bc7a2698feea2529d587d2e2db694d24db742.source: This quest can be completed without a partner by adding the hero Devona to your party.
d21bc7a2698feea2529d587d2e2db694d24db742.text: 透過將英雄 德佛娜 加入你的隊伍中，可以在沒有夥伴的情況下完成此任務。

2de924a3097b631e3b0ae4ccbd85013c966d1959.source: It may be difficult to complete this quest if you are using a free trial account, as you can't use chat or invite another player to your party. It would require being invited to a party, or obtaining Devona.
2de924a3097b631e3b0ae4ccbd85013c966d1959.text: 如果您使用免費試用帳戶，可能很難完成此任務，因為您無法使用聊天功能或邀請其他玩家加入您的隊伍。這需要被邀請參加聚會，或獲得 德佛娜。

f82b233cfae639c595469e7cc698ad04c0dbb81a.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.
f82b233cfae639c595469e7cc698ad04c0dbb81a.text: 完成*獎勵* 任務目標 可獲得額外的 75 Zaishen 銅幣。

8e76942d747b6d57fcf52415ef3657ac527eb4f8.source: As per the Against the Charr mission.
8e76942d747b6d57fcf52415ef3657ac527eb4f8.text: 根據 對抗夏爾 任務。

b47defb23f9dc8eaa950781a7305fff6baa6866f.source: Clear the Alcazia Tangle on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode.
b47defb23f9dc8eaa950781a7305fff6baa6866f.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人 灰暗沿岸 上的 Alcazia Tangle。

25e930b85a093947715720e74fa326831436e8a4.source: Complete the Base Objective for 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.
25e930b85a093947715720e74fa326831436e8a4.text: 完成 150 再神銅幣的基礎 任務目標。

f781196af22b7e19be0c5ad2033f3f3ef96485f3.source: "Clear the Alcazia Tangle on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode."
f781196af22b7e19be0c5ad2033f3f3ef96485f3.text: “在困難模式下清除 灰暗沿岸 上所有敵人的阿爾卡齊亞纏結。”

388b6fd7e5819fcfb14fb7ee933ce025840cfce4.source: Leave via any of the exits in the Tarnished Haven. If that outpost has not been reached, then start from Rata Sum and pass through either Magus Stones or Riven Earth.
388b6fd7e5819fcfb14fb7ee933ce025840cfce4.text: 透過 灰暗避難所 中的任意出口離開。如果尚未到達該前哨站，則從 洛達頂點 開始，穿過魔法石或 撕裂大地。

b8f404c3fa45f9b3b06a5d11848a48dc79215284.source: These quests affect the spawns in this area:
b8f404c3fa45f9b3b06a5d11848a48dc79215284.text: 這些任務會影響該區域的產生：

0fc83f75aeab804d78d7a79a6cb7f20f792407f4.source: When engaging dinosaurs in Hard mode (excluding Raptors), forgetting to spread out in their area of effect damage will easily kill bunched up heroes and henchmen. Ceratadons particularly must be avoided at melee range due to their deadly spells.
0fc83f75aeab804d78d7a79a6cb7f20f792407f4.text: 當在 困難模式 中與恐龍（不包括猛龍隊）交戰時，忘記在其影響範圍內分散傷害將很容易殺死成群結隊的英雄和追隨者。由於角齒龍具有致命的法術，因此在近戰範圍內尤其必須避免。

fe04fba0607c255b099d2da0ffc0411dd1bd3803.source: Shing Jea Sherman can be used as an additional ally for foes to target, which can relieve some pressure off your party.
fe04fba0607c255b099d2da0ffc0411dd1bd3803.text: Shing Jea Sherman 可以作為敵人攻擊目標的額外盟友，這可以減輕你的隊伍的一些壓力。

a3882c39b4581fd59a095c08fb65f7d71ab7d4b5.source: When looking for your final foes, remember there is a group of Simians right up against the portal to Arbor Bay.
a3882c39b4581fd59a095c08fb65f7d71ab7d4b5.text: 當你尋找最後的敵人時，請記住有一群猿猴就在通往喬木灣的入口處。

a37d47f706c203dfa92c7fdd4e4a669965e034fa.source: This area can be completely explored without enemies during the quest Insidious Remnants for Master of the North.
a37d47f706c203dfa92c7fdd4e4a669965e034fa.text: 在北方大師的陰險遺跡任務中，可以在沒有敵人的情況下完全探索該區域。

06fb6058a38680904ea13dcc4bd63c68f1896926.source: The southern edge of the map does not line up with the character perspectives along the coast. For this reason, some of the explorable footage in those areas does not clear when explored.
06fb6058a38680904ea13dcc4bd63c68f1896926.text: 地圖的南邊與海岸沿線的角色視角不一致。因此，這些區域中的一些可探索的鏡頭在探索時並不清晰。

b487a1fe69b716053f068827f1814dab56f775c1.source: An account with both Prophecies and Nightfall
b487a1fe69b716053f068827f1814dab56f775c1.text: 同時具有 阿斯卡隆戰記 和 黑暗逆襲 的帳戶

f0e7f4b160143d0ce69dfe1cb56a7fde4954e2fa.source: Meet Lionguard Figo in Lion's Arch.
f0e7f4b160143d0ce69dfe1cb56a7fde4954e2fa.text: 在 獅子拱門 中認識獅子衛士菲戈。

7c2600c2e8d29d6658501243b53e12ba17409be5.text: 在 血石沼澤 中找到奧利亞斯。

02917e253fe2fadc334bb87bdce43b2ffdf723a4.text: 幫助奧利亞斯拯救選民。

5f9951a13ddb82fa46927786f041cf97bbb471a4.source: Return to Clerk Arlon in Kamadan.
5f9951a13ddb82fa46927786f041cf97bbb471a4.text: 影返 給卡馬丹的阿爾隆書記官。

4f1298955d98d30d17a1deeffc2a97ff377f23ac.text: 奧利亞斯加入你的隊伍。

4a76ea99e2c90d6303addba5d4f03e7353e5d837.source: See campaign travel for information on reaching Tyria and Elona.
4a76ea99e2c90d6303addba5d4f03e7353e5d837.text: 請參閱活動旅行，以瞭解有關到達 泰瑞亞 和 Elona 的資訊。

91a6a98701f4f72a47a08a17663f46a5a3142bf8.source: Travel to Lion's Arch, either via the Terror in Tyria or Chaos in Kryta quest if you have not been there previously, or using the boat icon on the map if you have. Once there, follow the quest marker to find Lionguard Figo on the docks, and speak to him to travel to Bloodstone Fen.
91a6a98701f4f72a47a08a17663f46a5a3142bf8.text: 如果您之前沒有去過 獅子拱門，可以透過 泰瑞亞 中的恐怖任務或 科瑞塔 任務中的混亂前往 獅子拱門，或使用地圖上的船圖示（如果您去過）。到達那裡後，按照任務標記在碼頭上找到獅子衛士菲戈，並與他交談以前往 血石沼澤。

868b925178d6d8dafab73101a6582db71543a222.source: It is not possible to collect ashes from the altar if the quest is not active or is completed.
868b925178d6d8dafab73101a6582db71543a222.text: 如果任務未啟動或已完成，則無法從祭壇收集骨灰。

06b5f15ffbd9c25e70ab1bc5187e8d8eec013665.source: Collect as much amber as possible before the timer runs out. Kill a boss to gain a time bonus.
06b5f15ffbd9c25e70ab1bc5187e8d8eec013665.text: 在計時器耗盡之前收集盡可能多的琥珀。殺死老闆以獲得時間獎勵。

5325f865711c3f461daed1c812afa8f8ddd30bd8.source: Scoring in this mission rewards Kurzick faction, experience, and gold based on the formulas below. Values are rounded down. An additional bonus is given for achieving daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best.
5325f865711c3f461daed1c812afa8f8ddd30bd8.text: 在此任務中得分，根據以下公式獎勵 庫茲柯 陣營值、經驗值和金幣。值向下舍入。達到每日最佳、每月最佳或季度最佳的成績可獲得額外獎金。

1401e62d2c6571b9f1b8fddcd36bde51bbde74e2.source: This mission has a 10 minute time limit, however, killing a boss adds 60 seconds to the timer. 30 seconds after the mission timer starts, Azukhan Stonewrath spawns in the north-west. After 1 minute, Froth Stonereap spawns in the north-east. After 1 minute 30 seconds, Ennsa Stoneweaver spawns in the southwest. After 2 minutes, Dorn Stonebreaker spawns in the southeast. Each boss respawns 5 minutes after being killed.
1401e62d2c6571b9f1b8fddcd36bde51bbde74e2.text: 此任務有 10 分鐘的時間限制，但是，殺死 Boss 會增加 60 秒的計時器。任務計時器開始後 30 秒，Azukhan Stonewrath 在西北部產生。 1 分鐘後，泡棉石收在東北方生成。 1 分鐘 30 秒後，Ennsa 補石者 在西南方產生。 2 分鐘後，多恩碎石者在東南方生成。每個 Boss 在被殺死後幾分鐘都會重生 5。

8ed52e9535669cf51b9209218d78fe4254b7a4dd.source: There are two types of amber to collect, both of which add 1 point to the total score when picked up. Raw Amber Chunks are dropped when an enemy is killed (bosses drop 4). Refined Amber Chunks randomly spawn on the ground.
8ed52e9535669cf51b9209218d78fe4254b7a4dd.text: 有兩種型別的琥珀可供收集，拾取後都會將 1 分數新增到總分中。當敵人被殺死時，原始 硬玉 方塊會掉落（Boss 會掉落 4）。精緻的 硬玉 區塊隨機在地面上產生。

ef27ec9e90b0c87ab60e3d532a3716d1a516f53c.source: Consider bringing speed stances or shouts to quickly move around. Also consider bringing AoE ( Area of Effect) and DoT (Damage over Time) characters to assist with the multiple enemies
ef27ec9e90b0c87ab60e3d532a3716d1a516f53c.text: 考慮採取速度姿勢或喊叫來快速移動。也可以考慮使用 範圍性（效果區）和 DoT（傷害 隨著時間的推移）角色來協助多個敵人

bfc27fd7da12d87f86843a36e8a37b93ce24a34e.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
bfc27fd7da12d87f86843a36e8a37b93ce24a34e.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Canthan 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.4% 的貢獻。

1da172091967910f5164d551095d761490f1ad8b.source: Obtaining a score of 100 or above will increase your Kurzick faction cap once by 1000.
1da172091967910f5164d551095d761490f1ad8b.text: 取得 100 或以上的分數將使您的 庫茲柯 陣營值 上限增加一次 1000。

93267db632a6bd551d35aa39851429cef39d6ec3.source: Save as many Kurzick refugees as possible before time elapses.
93267db632a6bd551d35aa39851429cef39d6ec3.text: 在規定時間內拯救盡可能多的 庫茲柯 難民。

ab676fec48d95a41cb84ab473f92782e1299b25e.source: This mission has a 10 minute time limit; however, additional time can be earned after rescuing a set number of refugees (+60 seconds every 25 people saved). Kurzick refugees come in groups of 1 - 4 from three different paths and head towards the portal. Approximately every 30 seconds, the next group spawns and makes its way toward the portal. Between the refugee spawn points and the portal is where several groups of Wardens spawn. As time progresses, more groups will spawn. Guard Karsten and Guard Uwe are standing next to the portal and will help fight any Wardens that get within range. They are not required to survive, but their presence is helpful.
ab676fec48d95a41cb84ab473f92782e1299b25e.text: 任務有 10 分鐘的時間限制；然而，在拯救一定數量的難民後可以獲得額外的時間（每拯救一個 25 人就需要 +60 秒）。 庫茲柯 難民以 1 - 4 的形式從三個不同的路徑湧入，前往傳送門。大約每隔 30 秒，下一組就會產生並前往傳送門。在難民生成點和傳送門之間是幾組守望者產生的地方。隨著時間的推移，將會產生更多的群體。卡斯滕警衛和烏維警衛站在傳送門旁邊，將幫助對抗任何進入射程的守望者。它們並不是生存所必需的，但它們的存在是有幫助的。

5a598b3bb19f546e2820d282f49832bfc419e814.source: The general strategy for this mission is to keep the Wardens distracted while the Kurzick refugees run to the portal.
5a598b3bb19f546e2820d282f49832bfc419e814.text: 此任務的整體策略是在 庫茲柯 難民跑向傳送門時分散看守者的注意力。

933cb5b743f0608a01b4fac3561d5af360f3b57f.source: Doing this mission in hard mode provides a few benefits:
933cb5b743f0608a01b4fac3561d5af360f3b57f.text: 在困難模式下執行此任務有一些好處：

9ad059e9b739e10d88530d7739b76ed4a4a1e1d3.source: While the Wardens are only 2-6 levels higher, the refugees become level 20, therefore last longer.
9ad059e9b739e10d88530d7739b76ed4a4a1e1d3.text: 雖然典獄長僅提高了 2-6 級別，但難民的等級則變成 20，因此持續時間更長。

f55ac9155cb5e863d04472d3d45bc07221e662c8.source: If you bring it, Churning Earth's knock down effect will always trigger on non-snared Wardens.
f55ac9155cb5e863d04472d3d45bc07221e662c8.text: 如果你帶上它，渦流大地 的擊倒效果將始終在未陷入陷阱的守望者身上觸發。

d830d00c91561a58c586cadad3b58252978cae78.source: Consider using Shelter or Displacement to help the level 10 refugees survive.
d830d00c91561a58c586cadad3b58252978cae78.text: 考慮使用 庇護 或 偏移 來幫助 10 等級的難民生存。

cb213892288384ce3a7a4acaff07c9d87ff79475.source: Hex spells are not used by any of the foes in this area.
cb213892288384ce3a7a4acaff07c9d87ff79475.text: 該區域的任何敵人都不會使用十六進製法術。

99d17c917f412ba9590232451d5ae18e47b968be.source: Although Ash Blast is a hex spell, the hex is only applied to Burning foes. None of the foes in this area can apply Burning, so you would have to apply it to yourself.
99d17c917f412ba9590232451d5ae18e47b968be.text: 雖然 塵暴 是一個十六進位法術，但該十六進位僅適用於燃燒敵人。該區域的所有敵人都無法施加燃燒，因此您必須將其應用到自己身上。

83731fc5cdfe665497da8aaaddbe5850cd9108f5.source: Wells and Wards are helpful, since you're going to be in the same general area the entire time.
83731fc5cdfe665497da8aaaddbe5850cd9108f5.text: 水井和病房很有幫助，因為你將一直處於同一個區域。

15b2eb4bacae7ac7719e26c51447a617e63deafb.source: Talk to Olias to have him join your party as an ally, then follow the map, fighting each group of enemies along the way. You will first encounter two groups of two Thorn Stalkers, then three groups of two Jungle Trolls, and finally two groups of White Mantle. The first White Mantle group consists of two Zealots and a Seeker, and the second group consists of a Zealot, a Seeker, and an Abbot. When you arrive at the Bloodstone, you will meet the necromancer boss Erulai the Inimical. Wait for Erulai and Olias to finish talking, then fight Erulai until he is low on health. After more dialogue, two Blades of Corruption and one Arm of Insanity will spawn and be hostile to both Erulai and your party. Kill them, then return to Kamadan and speak to Clerk Arlon to collect your reward.
15b2eb4bacae7ac7719e26c51447a617e63deafb.text: 與奧利亞斯交談，讓他作為盟友加入你的隊伍，然後按照地圖前進，與沿途的每一組敵人戰鬥。你會先遇到兩組，每組兩個荊棘追獵者，然後是三組，每組兩個叢林巨魔，最後是兩組 白斗篷。第一個 白斗篷 組由兩名狂熱者和一名搜尋者組成，第二組由一名狂熱者、一名搜尋者和一名方丈組成。當你到達 血石 時，你會遇到死靈法師 Boss Erulai the Inimical。等艾如萊和奧利亞斯說完，然後和艾如萊戰鬥，直到他血量不足。經過更多對話後，兩把腐化之刃和一把 狂亂武裝 將會生成，並且對艾魯萊和你的隊伍都懷有敵意。殺死他們，然後返回卡馬丹並與書記官阿爾隆交談以領取獎勵。

909f5e6997d3ce3b5fc585a0d6763b7ffa108f08.source: This map is an alternate version of Bloodstone Fen, exclusive to this quest only.
909f5e6997d3ce3b5fc585a0d6763b7ffa108f08.text: 這張地圖是 血石沼澤 的替代版本，僅此任務獨有。

4fb3559b43825d1683941dc778784addfd83000a.source: While on the Bloodstone, Curse of the Bloodstone extends resurrection time.
4fb3559b43825d1683941dc778784addfd83000a.text: 而在 血石 上，血石的詛咒 會延長復活時間。

d02984d2fa68b7096d8b82dd7056173185c2db2a.source: You can use Hard mode to make the Lion's Arch henchmen, as well as Olias, level 20 for this quest, however Olias will be level 15 when you gain him upon completion.
d02984d2fa68b7096d8b82dd7056173185c2db2a.text: 您可以使用 困難模式 讓 獅子拱門 追蹤者以及 Olias 在此任務中達到 20 等級，但是當您完成後獲得他時，Olias 將達到 15 等級。

6f2d970c149e562c7e4a3a183b21a548bfc674cf.source: Survivors can use the sitting Krytans at the end as an obstacle against the two melee torment creatures as they perfectly body block them.
6f2d970c149e562c7e4a3a183b21a548bfc674cf.text: 倖存者可以使用最後坐著的科瑞坦人作為對抗這兩個近戰折磨生物的障礙，因為它們完美地用身體阻擋了它們。

1660f0e4c34dfc1b680340053f5714b766d225f5.source: This quest replaced the now removed quest Gain Olias. If Gain Olias was completed, this quest can not be accepted. Likewise, if you have Gain Olias you can not start this quest until it is abandoned.
1660f0e4c34dfc1b680340053f5714b766d225f5.text: 該任務取代了現已刪除的任務「獲得奧利亞斯」。如果獲得奧利亞斯已完成，則無法接受該任務。同樣，如果你有獲得奧利亞斯，你就無法開始這個任務，直到它被放棄。

64c798c6e39116eedbb6e5fac01361396363db59.source: Find the temple where Althea was killed and use the Barradin Family Urn to gather her ashes.
64c798c6e39116eedbb6e5fac01361396363db59.text: 尋找 奧瑟雅 被殺的神廟，並使用巴拉丁家族甕收集她的骨灰。

befaa542db463eeeaf10148ec5aecd33a7391e20.source: Bring Althea's Ashes to Duke Barradin.
befaa542db463eeeaf10148ec5aecd33a7391e20.text: 將 奧瑟雅的骨灰 引入 巴拉丁公爵。

0c5d1a71cac3742700136bdbc2cfdff0a7621943.source: First, make sure you have the Barradin Family Urn.
0c5d1a71cac3742700136bdbc2cfdff0a7621943.text: 首先，確保您擁有巴拉丁家族甕。

9bdf59d256a624044f80ef9bad7f6df518cb2878.source: Head to Diessa Lowlands in order to reach the Flame Temple Corridor where the ashes are located. It is easier to start from the Grendich Courthouse, but if player hasn't been there yet, it's possible to start from Piken Square and get to Diessa Lowlands from The Breach. The entrance to the Flame Temple Corridor is in the north-east corner of the Diessa Lowlands across the large tar pit.
9bdf59d256a624044f80ef9bad7f6df518cb2878.text: 前往 底耶沙低地 以到達骨灰所在的 夏爾火焰神殿。從 葛蘭迪法院 開始比較容易，但如果玩家還沒去過那裡，可以從 派肯廣場 開始，然後從 缺口 到達 底耶沙低地。 夏爾火焰神殿 的入口位於 底耶沙低地 的東北角，穿過大焦油坑。

6b2945eca31b990d5f974ab11907f9b244c7980a.source: Once at the Flame Temple Corridor, fight several groups of Charr and get to the altar where Althea's ashes are. There will be four Ascalon Strikers allies, but they aren't very strong. It's advisable to clear a single path towards the altar. The altar is guarded by a large group of Charr, so players should try to avoid aggroing too many groups at once. After the Charr have been cleared, interact with the Altar and the Barradin Family Urn will turn into the Urn of Althea's Ashes.
6b2945eca31b990d5f974ab11907f9b244c7980a.text: 到達 夏爾火焰神殿 後，與幾組 夏爾 戰鬥並到達 奧瑟雅 骨灰所在的祭壇。將會有四個 阿斯卡隆 St​​rikers 盟友，但他們並不是很強。建議清理一條通往祭壇的道路。祭壇由一大群 夏爾 守衛，因此玩家應盡量避免同時攻擊過多的隊伍。清除夏爾後，與祭壇互動，巴拉丁家族甕將變成奧瑟雅的骨灰的甕。

ed6f2db5b375b89129f44477911f2a30165dea06.source: An alternative to killing the large groups of Charr at the altar would be to just run up and click on the altar, instead of fighting the Charr. Consider using henchmen as a decoy.
ed6f2db5b375b89129f44477911f2a30165dea06.text: 在祭壇處殺死大群 夏爾 的另一種方法是跑上並點選祭壇，而不是與 夏爾 戰鬥。考慮使用追隨者作為誘餌。

550542a3f6de62bf5985fc21a0bf8d3e5de939ba.source: Having The Titan Source active will make this quest much more difficult.
550542a3f6de62bf5985fc21a0bf8d3e5de939ba.text: 啟動 泰坦根源 將使這個任務變得更加困難。

820e879e148e441b95f1c97a78cd6a4ee6c81301.source: To collect the ashes one must have the Barradin Family Urn in your inventory.
820e879e148e441b95f1c97a78cd6a4ee6c81301.text: 要收集骨灰，您的庫存中必須有巴拉丁家族骨灰盒。

3dca03a394220b8f8a2bee53986564fc94571f87.source: If player does not have the urn in their inventory, talking to Duke Barradin will give another.
3dca03a394220b8f8a2bee53986564fc94571f87.text: 如果玩家的庫存中沒有該甕，與 巴拉丁公爵 交談將會給予另一個甕。

c8f8fd1c6ac2d442ecfbfeeb43b87b03cf807597.source: It is possible to get multiple urns by placing them into the Storage and talking to Duke Barradin.
c8f8fd1c6ac2d442ecfbfeeb43b87b03cf807597.text: 將多個骨灰盒放入 個人倉庫 並與 巴拉丁公爵 對話，可以獲得多個骨灰盒。

a6aaa140d02f50d06c7d7538d0e034fd3e717eb2.source: Having multiple urns into the inventory, it is possible to interact with the altar multiple times to get multiple ashes from one single visit.
a6aaa140d02f50d06c7d7538d0e034fd3e717eb2.text: 庫存中有多個骨灰盒，可以與祭壇多次互動，一次訪問即可獲得多個骨灰。

6fced9b9c995574c789379d38416022aa288925e.source: It is possible to complete the quest by buying the ashes from another player.
6fced9b9c995574c789379d38416022aa288925e.text: 可以透過從其他玩家那裡購買骨灰來完成任務。

74c8c51f3943a4dfdbfaf6a22f740f7f30332324.source: Seek out and purify the corrupted sprouts in Turai's Procession. Defeat any vile incarnations you encounter. You have 3..0 sprouts left to purify.
74c8c51f3943a4dfdbfaf6a22f740f7f30332324.text: 在 托雷長廊 中尋找並淨化損壞的豆芽。擊敗你遇到的任何邪惡的化身。您還有 3..0 豆芽需要淨化。

8d37cadce9fde210ba4128975aade1698793b039.source: See Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.
8d37cadce9fde210ba4128975aade1698793b039.text: 去找米爾扎·維德行者領取獎勵。

8c52be8809eba9630efab36781aa47f0a70fd086.source: Follow the arrows on your minimap to the corrupted sprout, you must have the Sacred Roots with you to succeed. Repeat 2 more times and return to Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.
8c52be8809eba9630efab36781aa47f0a70fd086.text: 按照小地圖上的箭頭到達腐化的芽苗，你必須有神聖的根源才能成功。重複 2 多次並返回 Mirza Veldrunner 領取獎勵。

f160f47007fe6ed24fb6bc4a89db16656cbc8604.source: Plants have reduced armor to fire damage so it's handy to bring Fire Magic elementalists or to use weapons with the accordant prefix.
f160f47007fe6ed24fb6bc4a89db16656cbc8604.text: 植物降低了火焰傷害的護甲值，因此攜帶 火系魔法 元素主義者或使用帶有相應字首的武器會很方便。

28b2a2eae40ec5a8a8d9690cb577d485949002d4.source: It's advised to focus on the monk sprouts at first since Corrupted Healing can heal allies for 300 health.
28b2a2eae40ec5a8a8d9690cb577d485949002d4.text: 建議先關注僧侶芽，因為腐化治療可以治療盟友以獲得 300 生命值。

f369c257039ffafc5f17a993354174851834b3d2.source: Corrupted Healing can be easily interrupted, so bring suitable skills to stop it being cast.
f369c257039ffafc5f17a993354174851834b3d2.text: 腐化治療很容易被打斷，所以要帶上合適的技能來阻止它被施放。

608ae15305751fb827e5f424f3d124e037da015f.source: Find Sennat Sen in Salt Flats.
608ae15305751fb827e5f424f3d124e037da015f.text: 在 鹽灘 中找到 瑟納森。

050242648dc6fec5e48089623755bccf300d43a5.source: Sennat Sen is in the northeast corner of the Salt Flats. The outpost closest to his location is Seeker's Passage, which is reachable through a long walk from the Amnoon Oasis or Augury Rock. You may need to use teleporters to reach Sennat Sen, depending on the path you take.
050242648dc6fec5e48089623755bccf300d43a5.text: 瑟納森 位於 鹽灘 的東北角。距離他所在位置最近的前哨站是 探索者通道，從 安奴綠洲 或 占卜之石 步行很長一段路即可到達。您可能需要使用傳送器才能到達 瑟納森，具體取決於您選擇的路徑。

bd19ae5f0c48f9f519bcf25a3200f43eb3ac761b.source: Sennat Sen is an artisan. It is not necessary to complete this quest before making use of his services.
bd19ae5f0c48f9f519bcf25a3200f43eb3ac761b.text: 瑟納森 是一位工匠。在使用他的服務之前無需完成此任務。

5cd2633e0140519dbb30acbc4d04e3e3ba03d3c7.source: Consider picking up the quest A Belated Betrothal at Seeker's Passage before completing this quest, since its destination lies close to the same route.
5cd2633e0140519dbb30acbc4d04e3e3ba03d3c7.text: 請考慮在完成此任務之前在 探索者通道 處接取任務 遲來的訂婚，因為它的目的地靠近相同路線。

325dca1d87733b75dfeeff707e838309bdb23a5b.source: Travel to Zehlon Reach and talk to Tahon.
325dca1d87733b75dfeeff707e838309bdb23a5b.text: 前往澤隆河段並與塔洪交談。

bc8efa7fe74e01e49f2b1af68d4ab6aadae352ce.source: [Incomplete source section] Walk northwest until you come to the same spot where the Stone Face Cult always stand. Before talking to Tahon, it is advised that low level characters have some enchantments active since he is a level 12 monk. After killing him, travel to The Astralarium and talk to Kihawa to receive your reward.
bc8efa7fe74e01e49f2b1af68d4ab6aadae352ce.text: [不完整的來源部分] 向西北走，直到到達石面教始終站立的同一地點。在與 Tahon 交談之前，建議低等級角色啟動一些結界，因為他是 12 等級的武僧。殺死他後，前往星辰館並與基哈瓦交談以獲得獎勵。

b9f180d9341188158c43ccf0e738f011c7e9e67a.source: Clear Anvil Rock in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
b9f180d9341188158c43ccf0e738f011c7e9e67a.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 北席娃山脈 中的 鐵砧石。

b6aa443a0160d5efa3ffe12455bf2ce684701aa4.source: "Clear Anvil Rock in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
b6aa443a0160d5efa3ffe12455bf2ce684701aa4.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的北席娃山脈中的鐵砧石。”

95104eef6fa541034d84afb58fe5959c72ebf9d7.text: 從 寒霜之門 離開

dba197611c381557113b3817771a99638eb1ec15.source: Head west from Yak's Bend through Iron Horse Mine if you have not completed Borlis Pass.
dba197611c381557113b3817771a99638eb1ec15.text: 如果您尚未完成 柏里斯通道，請從 犛牛村 向西行駛，穿過 鐵馬礦山。

5ee472d14510fbe40f003a94780f4974089399cc.source: Head north through Deldrimor Bowl if coming from Lion's Arch.
5ee472d14510fbe40f003a94780f4974089399cc.text: 如果從 獅子拱門 出發，則透過 戴爾狄摩盆地 向北行駛。

2b518b924a9e0f596778295e4488a4fe9bc68d71.source: These quests will affect the spawns in this area:
2b518b924a9e0f596778295e4488a4fe9bc68d71.text: 這些任務將影響該區域的產生：

aa4ba15ec2938877ac858842ff5582cb03aae59b.source: There is a small Dwarven village in the southern area of the map. On a random chance per map instance, about 5 waves of Frostfire Dryders will attack (totaling to about 30 Dryders). The allied Dwarven Soldiers there will fight with you. Depending on where you entered the map, those Dwarven allies may already have been killed by the time you reach their location. The Dryders can also get stuck on the way to the village from Deldrimor Bowl so if you are looking for a missed wave check along that path.
aa4ba15ec2938877ac858842ff5582cb03aae59b.text: 地圖南部有一個矮人小村莊。每個地圖例項都會隨機發生大約 5 波的霜火乾燥機攻擊（總計約 30 乾燥機）。那裡的矮人盟軍將與你並肩作戰。根據您進入地圖的位置，當您到達他們的位置時，那些矮人盟友可能已經被殺死了。 Dryders 也可能被困在從 戴爾狄摩盆地 到村莊的路上，所以如果您正在尋找錯過的波浪，請檢查沿著該路徑。

56988a4791427d132733ffb0c7583674727b9b0c.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.9% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
56988a4791427d132733ffb0c7583674727b9b0c.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.9% 的貢獻。

370aa6109f9e576bb833c923b6de7bea70dae582.source: There is an area in the mountain range just northeast of Ice Tooth Cave where you can explore a fair distance farther north than on the field. The ridge is large enough that several Snow Wolves may spawn along it.
370aa6109f9e576bb833c923b6de7bea70dae582.text: 冰牙洞穴 東北部的山脈中有一個區域，您可以在那裡探索比場地更北的一段距離。山脊足夠大，數隻雪狼可能會沿著它生成。

260cddcd7a564c4e3319cea9956341917b403c1d.source: Have one player tank one direction the wardens approach from to distract them while the rest of the team focus on saving the refugees from another side only.
260cddcd7a564c4e3319cea9956341917b403c1d.text: 讓一名玩家向看守者靠近的一個方向坦克以分散他們的注意力，而團隊的其他成員則專注於從另一側拯救難民。

10f96369751d5938405134a44f049d9b4164a5f4.source: AoE skills are effective due to the eventual high number of foes.
10f96369751d5938405134a44f049d9b4164a5f4.text: 由於最終的敵人數量較多，範圍性 技能非常有效。
