f49f335ba29a32769ce25a707c6f9881d2837150.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.3% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
f49f335ba29a32769ce25a707c6f9881d2837150.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Canthan 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.3% 的貢獻。

97035357b5dec866fdb7e1470b1a2e14512ae414.source: Find Tukan on the rooftops and end his suffering
97035357b5dec866fdb7e1470b1a2e14512ae414.text: 在屋頂上找到圖坎並結束他的痛苦

b9068f6a2ff2c038c2db1781aa42a8b4520c9b1c.source: Head out from Senji's Corner into Xaquang Skyway and head left, you will come across Tukan after a while. He is alone and his skills are identical to normal Afflicted Warriors, so fighting him shouldn't be a problem.
b9068f6a2ff2c038c2db1781aa42a8b4520c9b1c.text: 從 山吉之街 進入 夏安便道，然後往左走，過一會兒就會遇到 Tukan。他孤身一人，技能也和普通的病魔戰士無異，與他戰鬥應該不成問題。

9c8bb14ac99a09c8087023fb64bde1e36e4b39fa.source: After Tukan has been killed, return to Qian and claim the reward.
9c8bb14ac99a09c8087023fb64bde1e36e4b39fa.text: 殺死圖坎後，返回乾並領取獎勵。

bd224b7d2c107a1d2a4da556719704ac3958b561.source: Restore Zunraa's presence by cleansing the valley of miasma. Should he fall, you may revive Zunraa by ringing the ceremonial bell at any of his shrines.
bd224b7d2c107a1d2a4da556719704ac3958b561.text: 淨化山谷中的瘴氣，恢復祖拉的存在。如果他倒下了，你可以透過在他的任何神殿敲響儀式鐘來復活祖拉。

8f6bdab95a52fcd9f23bba1cbf0c50508c55a01e.text: 前往 Zunraa 領取獎勵。

28e12c3ca84e9c1651b1484ee82d66505e0871a0.source: Foes will not spawn in Zen Daijun if you enter from Seitung Harbor. Water Buffalos will appear.
28e12c3ca84e9c1651b1484ee82d66505e0871a0.text: 如果您從 青函港 進入，敵人將不會在 禎臺郡 中生成。水牛將會出現。

bc41a01ccd13d2f90e0e0be237ff2e79ebc915f2.source: The Afflicted will no longer appear in Haiju Lagoon; they are replaced with equal numbers of Crimson Skull.
bc41a01ccd13d2f90e0e0be237ff2e79ebc915f2.text: 受影響者將不再出現在 海幽潟湖 中；它們被相同數量的 紅顱 取代。

147d26e04991041b7b8e50a4992380bd48fbc10a.source: Afflicted will remain in Minister Cho's Estate.
147d26e04991041b7b8e50a4992380bd48fbc10a.text: 受影響者將留在趙部長的莊園。

c3b9dc3eea13f62619fde95de3c44cbfe12ea9c2.source: Zunraa can be found to the right of the entrance to the Zen Daijun explorable area in Seitung Harbor, at the Shrine of Zunraa on the hill. If Zunraa isn't present, interact with the shrine to summon Zunraa. After accepting the quest, talk to Guard Lae Fao to enter Zen Daijun. Remember to bring skills that give health regeneration to counter the effects of the miasma.
c3b9dc3eea13f62619fde95de3c44cbfe12ea9c2.text: Zunraa 位於 青函港 的 禎臺郡 可探索區域入口右側，山上的 Zunraa 神社內。如果 Zunraa 不存在，請與神殿互動以召喚 Zunraa。接受任務後，與守衛Lae Fao交談以進入禎臺郡。記得帶上能夠恢復生命值的技能來對抗瘴氣的影響。

fec7f727b26172d53e5abb3dec6536875f690036.source: In the explorable area, follow the quest markers to the spots where miasma needs to be cleared. To achieve that, you have to run through them so that Zunraa will follow and clear them. Consider flagging your henchmen away from the miasma before leading Zunraa through it, to minimize the health degeneration. If Zunraa dies, you can re-summon him at any of the bells that are found in several spots in the area.
fec7f727b26172d53e5abb3dec6536875f690036.text: 在可探索區域中，依照任務標記到達需要清除瘴氣的地點。為了實現這一點，你必須穿過它們，以便 Zunraa 跟隨並清除它們。在帶領 Zunraa 穿過瘴氣之前，考慮標記你的追隨者遠離瘴氣，以盡量減少健康狀況惡化。如果祖拉死了，你可以透過該地區多個地點的任何鐘聲重新召喚他。

03211d247969072abe48d1c1fa21db764659644f.source: Instead of running through the miasma and tagging Zunraa along, you can run in circles (whenever possible) around the miasma. The advantage being that you won't be affected, while Zunraa will try to follow you, remain in the miasma and clear it.
03211d247969072abe48d1c1fa21db764659644f.text: 你可以繞著瘴氣跑圈（只要可能），而不是穿過瘴氣並跟著 Zunraa。好處是你不會受到影響，而 Zunraa 會試圖跟隨你，留在瘴氣中並清除它。

6457b361f30e89ec418ed8cbd902e620a307d2a2.source: Once the miasma have all been cleared, the quest will update and point you towards the Daijun Library. Clear the miasma there and take down the Corrupted Zunraa to complete the quest.
6457b361f30e89ec418ed8cbd902e620a307d2a2.text: 一旦瘴氣全部清除，任務就會更新並引導你前往大君圖書館。清除那裡的瘴氣並擊倒腐化的祖拉來完成任務。

caca969c0685e2fefb20933c726eab53432d3303.source: One tactic is to clear the final miasma area before clearing the other areas (the Corrupted Zunraa doesn't appear until all other miasma have been cleared), that way when you battle the Corrupted Zunraa you won't also have to combat party wide health degeneration while fighting him.
caca969c0685e2fefb20933c726eab53432d3303.text: 一種策略是在清除其他區域之前先清除最後的瘴氣區域（在清除所有其他瘴氣之前，腐化的 Zunraa 不會出現），這樣當你與腐化的 Zunraa 戰鬥時，你就不必在與他戰鬥時對抗全隊的健康退化。

e5ee4b6878dbd5531d4a0522199620ec75e69805.source: Corrupted Zunraa does not appear sometimes.
e5ee4b6878dbd5531d4a0522199620ec75e69805.text: 腐化的 Zunraa 有時不會出現。

fe47b51502b24351f29a076b781cf47012f31f9e.source: This is the second of the two attribute point quests available for Factions PvE characters. Completion of these quests is necessary to gain the full 200 attribute points for your character. The first quest is Lost Treasure.
fe47b51502b24351f29a076b781cf47012f31f9e.text: 這是 盟與敵 PvE 角色可用的兩個屬性點任務中的第二個。完成這些任務對於您的角色獲得完整的 200 屬性點是必要的。第一個任務是失落的寶藏。

4f3c0d9ace1ebc869921624857f40c22a703156f.source: Though the quest marker at the end directs you back to Seitung Harbor, you can also get the reward from the Zunraa in your party.
4f3c0d9ace1ebc869921624857f40c22a703156f.text: 雖然最後的任務標記會引導你回到 青函港，但你也可以從隊伍中的 Zunraa 那裡獲得獎勵。

7ab231f937007dee545f43b1f81362d4b27ac438.source: The Zunraa in Seitung Harbor is occasionally called Kirin.
7ab231f937007dee545f43b1f81362d4b27ac438.text: 青函港 中的 Zunraa 有時也稱為 Kirin。

a667e2204b3536cdfe7edd99f3061ad92925a643.source: The Centaur boss Jolo Lighthaunch's healing may prove difficult to overcome if you party lacks firepower or interrupts, especially if two Shiverpeak Protectors spawned in its group. Consider defeating this boss right at the start. The group is large, and strays far from its origin point. Pulling them so they are bodyblocked by the nearest cliff corner and having your team hold them for AoE damage is suggested.
a667e2204b3536cdfe7edd99f3061ad92925a643.text: 如果你的隊伍缺乏火力或被打斷，半人馬 Boss Jolo Lighthaunch的治療可能很難克服，特別是如果隊伍中出現了兩個席瓦峰保護者。考慮從一開始就擊敗這個老闆。該群體規模龐大，且偏離原點很遠。建議拉動它們，使它們被最近的懸崖角擋住，並讓你的團隊抓住它們以防止 範圍性 傷害。

d87bb3f46e648d7fa219f866bb04c17df7f8ee7a.source: In the Southeast of the area, there is a small road leading to the Frost Gate outpost. There are Dwarven and Minotaur groups that patrol that path, and they may be easily missed during vanquishing.
d87bb3f46e648d7fa219f866bb04c17df7f8ee7a.text: 在該地區的東南部，有一條小路通往 寒霜之門 前哨站。有矮人和 牛頭怪 團體在這條路上巡邏，在征服過程中很容易錯過他們。

a42c92ddd545383d684ed1c754185d761ea622ad.source: Some minotaur groups patrol in very large circles at a fast pace, both clockwise and counter-clockwise around the center. If you're looking for the last mob and can't find it, try circling the center of the map one way, then the other. Also check the north-south path in the far eastern part of the map.
a42c92ddd545383d684ed1c754185d761ea622ad.text: 一些牛頭人群體以非常大的圓圈快速巡邏，圍繞中心順時針和逆時針旋轉。如果您正在尋找最後一個生物但找不到它，請嘗試以一種方式繞著地圖中心轉一圈，然後再以另一種方式繞一圈。也要檢查地圖遠東部分的南北路徑。

bbc118a14a7742af0aa7ec04392a70b9da74fa34.source: Centaurs and minotaurs are hostile to each other.
bbc118a14a7742af0aa7ec04392a70b9da74fa34.text: 半人馬和牛頭人彼此敵對。

146f4afeb4cd1fd0a8e300301340801de4e11a48.source: A few groups of Centaurs have been reported to be hostile to each other.
146f4afeb4cd1fd0a8e300301340801de4e11a48.text: 據報道，一些半人馬群體彼此敵對。

aa5ac48c3c43ef7dd2ce2cd14ed34dc797afacdd.source: Prove your worth to Sif. Bring down Whiteout in Jaga Moraine.
aa5ac48c3c43ef7dd2ce2cd14ed34dc797afacdd.text: 向西芙證明你的價值。消滅賈加冰磧的白暴。

271dc5f1628ae728df7008c2af15687fda0519c0.source: Test your mettle. Defeat Avarr the Fallen in Jaga Moraine
271dc5f1628ae728df7008c2af15687fda0519c0.text: 考驗你的勇氣。在賈加冰磧擊敗墮落者阿瓦爾

8cf6de95059159ea25febdeb122b469bb844a100.source: See Sif Shadowhunter for your Reward
8cf6de95059159ea25febdeb122b469bb844a100.text: 請參閱 獵影者 希夫 瞭解您的 任務獎勵

b0d51beb9a6feabc8591021be54e034911ab97de.source: Whiteout is on a circular cliff towards the north of Jaga Moraine. As you approach, a massive ice boulder rolls down the path. It kills anyone in its way, but there is room to step aside if you act quickly. Note that you do not get a death penalty from the ice boulder.
b0d51beb9a6feabc8591021be54e034911ab97de.text: Whiteout 位於 Jaga Moraine 北部的圓形懸崖上。當您接近時，一塊巨大的冰塊沿著小徑滾落。它會殺死任何擋道的人，但如果你行動迅速，就有退讓的空間。請注意，冰巨石不會對您造成死刑。

4a7aff8a1e801cb57020c2f1dead0bbfe979cce1.source: Avarr the Fallen is on the north-west corner of Jaga Moraine.
4a7aff8a1e801cb57020c2f1dead0bbfe979cce1.text: 墮落者阿瓦位於賈加冰磧的西北角。

a064b055295216d9c06402b80ab8e40780710919.source: You can save time by combining this quest with A Hunter's Pride, Krak's Cavalry, and Prenuptial Disagreement.
a064b055295216d9c06402b80ab8e40780710919.text: 您可以將此任務與 獵人的榮譽、克拉克騎兵隊 和 破碎的婚約 結合使用來節省時間。

9484d028e73939a150e4cf815d36258f111a85a5.source: Defeating Remnant of Antiquities may, but does not always, count as defeating Fragment of Antiquities.
9484d028e73939a150e4cf815d36258f111a85a5.text: 擊敗 殘餘的斷片 可能（但不總是）算作擊敗古物碎片。

d749fb7a517e0905b93111fb8c3ffc96073131ed.source: Speak with Sister Choi Ju in Tsumei Village to learn more about Zen Nai Falls.
d749fb7a517e0905b93111fb8c3ffc96073131ed.text: 與 蘇梅村 的 Choi Ju 姐妹交談，以瞭解有關 Zen Nai 瀑布的更多資訊。

4fe0c3f03923442d4d27cfbe42ef7245bd21d360.source: Go to Zen Nai Falls and find the Naga that have invaded the area.
4fe0c3f03923442d4d27cfbe42ef7245bd21d360.text: 前往 Zen Nai 瀑布並找到入侵該地區的 納迦。

31744cb06009d7ff068cf26f9a9f6ef7ad09e04c.source: Scare off the Naga from the area.
31744cb06009d7ff068cf26f9a9f6ef7ad09e04c.text: 嚇跑該區域的 納迦。

c3c4bd0d011468d85b07c2da93a0175b219cd3c5.source: See Captain Zinghu for your reward.
c3c4bd0d011468d85b07c2da93a0175b219cd3c5.text: 去找 Zinghu 隊長領獎勵。

5082c4cb164b10fe33e10822e9e2b9d2e6e51455.source: This quest can be quite tricky, especially at a low level, due to the Naga Witches using Spirit Rift which can cause significant damage if not avoided. It would be a good idea to leave this quest until you are a higher level which makes it a lot easier; but if not just take Taya [Healer Henchman] and Aeson [Spirit Henchman] for maximum healing to survive the high damage per second.
5082c4cb164b10fe33e10822e9e2b9d2e6e51455.text: 這個任務可能非常棘手，特別是在低階時，因為 納迦 女巫使用 生靈裂縫，如果不避免，可能會造成重大損害。最好先放棄這個任務，直到你達到更高的等級，這樣會容易得多；但如果不是的話，只需使用 Taya [醫治傭兵 Henchman] 和 Aeson [Spirit Henchman] 即可獲得最大治療量，以在每秒的高傷害中生存。

096f66cbd2fbd68d236f2da272b37aad9f14bf65.source: Starting from Tsumei Village will give you more powerful followers, and the road will be shorter. From there just follow the pointer to Lake Puang, killing Nagas as you encounter them. By the time you reach the falls, you're done.
096f66cbd2fbd68d236f2da272b37aad9f14bf65.text: 從蘇梅村開始會為你帶來更強大的追隨者，而且路會更短。從那裡沿著指標前往 Puang 湖，在遇到 Nagas 時殺死它們。當你到達瀑布時，你就完成了。

988a00057cbacc8ad4be95fcd2868e87f13fcb68.source: Kill Arachni in the Depths of Tyria. Lists the region instead of the dungeon name
988a00057cbacc8ad4be95fcd2868e87f13fcb68.text: 在 泰瑞亞深處 中殺死 奧拉赫妮。列出區域而不是地下城名稱

cfef3278895659e8e206538f62a888bc35c1ea79.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 奧拉赫妮。

aedaae2fe6fd5afd566fc49f5f74a53bce18efa4.source: Warrior 24 (24) Dwarven Ghost can be found in the rectangular chamber with the poison arrow traps.
aedaae2fe6fd5afd566fc49f5f74a53bce18efa4.text: 戰士 24 (24) 矮人幽靈可以在帶有有毒箭陷阱的矩形房間中找到。

2efb1a35647321a8b7283417147851ed663e0a61.source: Dwarven Ghost can be found near the Spider Matriarch, on the ledges above the eggs. Go behind the left hand eggs to find it
2efb1a35647321a8b7283417147851ed663e0a61.text: 矮人幽靈可以在 蜘蛛 女族長附近的蛋上方的壁架上找到。走到左手蛋後面找到它

5d5c1d49f81af1807967b9b0d9486315f1c594d0.source: No profession 1 (20) Secret Switch near the south corner of Lok The Mischievous's room, which opens the door to a secret area that contains multiple Hidden Treasures and a Dwarven Ghost.
5d5c1d49f81af1807967b9b0d9486315f1c594d0.text: 無職業 1 (20) 惡作劇者洛克房間南角附近的秘密開關，可開啟通往包含多個隱藏寶藏和矮人幽靈的秘密區域的門。

68d86995f4a01c42e08d164dd571784c3b913fcb.source: 3 Hidden Treasures can be found near Dagnor Grubeater.
68d86995f4a01c42e08d164dd571784c3b913fcb.text: 3 隱藏的寶藏可以在達格諾食蟻獸附近找到。

8303df513b8288c64d9d853cc200a952dd1845e7.source: 3 Hidden Treasures can be found near the dungeon key.
8303df513b8288c64d9d853cc200a952dd1845e7.text: 3 隱藏的寶藏可以在地牢鑰匙附近找到。

eb0e1d354ef99e0dc2480df69642d0a32181abd8.source: There is a secret passage way that opens at the Area Map if you use Light of Deldrimor at the nearest intersection to the Area Map and then activate the switch. This passageway will lead you straight to the Flame Guardian. The passage also contains two Hidden Treasures, side by side.
eb0e1d354ef99e0dc2480df69642d0a32181abd8.text: 如果您在距離區域地圖最近的十字路口使用戴爾狄摩的光，然後啟動開關，則在區域地圖上會開啟一條秘密通道。這條通道將直接帶您前往 Flame 守護者。該通道還包含兩個並排的隱藏寶藏。

1c9dca0d85ea69d4ad1cbc373a641e13fb0b8664.source: A Hidden Treasure is located under the Flame Guardian.
1c9dca0d85ea69d4ad1cbc373a641e13fb0b8664.text: 隱藏的寶藏位於火焰 守護者 下方。

d5c2c60fd9fcb9b54e12e6bda5b5a7407afee00b.source: Two Hidden Treasures are in a beetle-filled side room southwest of the entrance. One is in a water pool which conceals the light effect.
d5c2c60fd9fcb9b54e12e6bda5b5a7407afee00b.text: 兩個隱藏寶藏位於入口西南側一個充滿甲蟲的側室中。其中一個位於水池中，隱藏了燈光效果。

7456705412d54a62c1a8029b538e1b27dfd84d81.source: There is a Hidden Treasure in that candlelit corridor south of the waterlogged room before the second Beacon of Droknar.
7456705412d54a62c1a8029b538e1b27dfd84d81.text: 在第二個德羅克納信標前的浸水房間以南的燭光走廊裡有一個隱藏的寶藏。

19abe948f95216a31d208133c6fde5305a2b2e5d.source: There are two Hidden Treasures and a Dwarven Ghost in the waterlogged room, which conceals the glowing effect.
19abe948f95216a31d208133c6fde5305a2b2e5d.text: 浸水的房間裡有兩個隱藏寶藏和一個矮人幽靈，隱藏了發光效果。

e6b3fef34adbb06213116b89f2e049e9c7a2a9c2.source: The Treasures are placed towards the back, approximately three Zhed-Lengths into the water. One is approximately central to the (overgrown) exit, while the other is approximately central to the large ramp. The Dwarven Ghost is roughly in the middle of the room. A little trial and error may be in order.
e6b3fef34adbb06213116b89f2e049e9c7a2a9c2.text: 寶藏被放置在後面，大約三哲德長度進入水中。一個大約位於（雜草叢生的）出口的中心，而另一個大約位於大坡道的中心。矮人幽靈大約在房間的中間。可能需要進行一些嘗試和錯誤。

c36cd018fe26997321d33aa900099be188f84dda.source: There is a Hidden Treasure in a dead-end southward corridor at the second Beacon of Droknar. It can be pinged on the compass while standing at the Beacon.
c36cd018fe26997321d33aa900099be188f84dda.text: 在第二個卓克納爾燈塔的南邊死衚衕走廊裡有一個隱藏寶藏。站在信標處時可以對指南針進行 ping 操作。

c6a935efb2f65653dd984153f79d7bddd00dfd00.source: A Hidden Treasure can be found near the entrance to the poison-filled spider room after the second Beacon of Droknar.
c6a935efb2f65653dd984153f79d7bddd00dfd00.text: 在第二個卓克納信標之後，可以在充滿毒藥的蜘蛛房入口附近找到隱藏寶藏。

03983da24821efa384efe9a2005a993ce65d0213.source: Without the required quest, you cannot pass the spiderwebs of the first room, near the Torn Cloth.
03983da24821efa384efe9a2005a993ce65d0213.text: 如果沒有所需的任務，您將無法通過撕裂布附近第一個房間的蜘蛛網。

f829a0ffca09df28b13f94a0266de6a0579a5d67.source: Though you can walk past them easily, burning the spider eggs is the only way to spawn Spider Matriarchs, and thus get the Dungeon Key.
f829a0ffca09df28b13f94a0266de6a0579a5d67.text: 雖然你可以輕鬆地走過它們，但燃燒蜘蛛蛋是生成 蜘蛛 女族長的唯一方法，從而獲得 地監 鑰匙。

1daf2ce547de8461223e22320ffc42183153efc6.source: Lok The Mischievous's fiery boulders will kill you instantly if you are struck by them, although they do not cause any Death Penalty.
1daf2ce547de8461223e22320ffc42183153efc6.text: 如果你被惡作劇者洛克的熾熱巨石擊中，它們會立即殺死你，儘管它們不會造成任何死刑。

0c66d600362311b51f05cda9c5bfa529ff95934b.source: To disable the fire traps on Level 2, kill the Flame Guardian in the southeastern corner.
0c66d600362311b51f05cda9c5bfa529ff95934b.text: 若要停用 2 層的火焰陷阱，請殺死東南角的火焰 守護者。

c2905598ebc73c9d7eb9d19bd274413fa5d3ce23.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #14 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
c2905598ebc73c9d7eb9d19bd274413fa5d3ce23.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#14 頁。

bd430ddb56a0c6603a8af3968f9a7bf2a6202617.source: In first person mode, you can see behind the walls if you stand next to them at certain points:
bd430ddb56a0c6603a8af3968f9a7bf2a6202617.text: 在第一人稱模式下，如果您在某些點站在牆邊，您可以看到牆後面：

ac722793e0126f656f2aead31a496d58c1727807.source: On Level 1: an extra normal gate and several hidden rooms.
ac722793e0126f656f2aead31a496d58c1727807.text: 1 層：一個額外的普通門和幾個隱藏的房間。

240901829f28d4cc923609a69fbd93d9f057e4f6.source: On Level 2: an extra Asura Gate behind one of the walls.
240901829f28d4cc923609a69fbd93d9f057e4f6.text: 在 2 層：其中一面牆後面有一個額外的 阿蘇拉 門。

ed13d4438a03f1433efe8cc9668460f65eebe6ab.source: On Level 2, there is an Albino Rat that occasionally spawns behind the walls. You can shadow step or teleport to it (e.g. using Consume Corpse), which will leave you stuck behind the wall (unless you can jump back, e.g. via Recall).
ed13d4438a03f1433efe8cc9668460f65eebe6ab.text: 在 2 關卡，牆後偶爾會出現一隻白化鼠。你可以暗影步或傳送到它（例如使用 屍體吸收），這會讓你被困在牆後面（除非你可以跳回來，例如透過 回歸）。

d3d8308740d6f512eb5810ca637aad8f1e6c0b74.source: The spawns including Arachni and the final Spider Matriarch may be significantly delayed after burning the eggs. If the party continues burning eggs during this delay, it can lead to Arachni spawning before the matriarch, though both must still be killed to spawn the chest.
d3d8308740d6f512eb5810ca637aad8f1e6c0b74.text: 燃燒蛋後，包括 奧拉赫妮 和最終 蜘蛛 Matriarch 在內的生成可能會顯著延遲。如果隊伍在此延遲期間繼續燃燒雞蛋，可能會導致 奧拉赫妮 在女族長之前生成，儘管仍然必須殺死兩者才能生成寶箱。

8c670ddf520ce848eb514bf72bb06741e30eaa9f.source: Beware of the Ooze! They multiply and can wipe an unprepared party with PBAoE damage spam.
8c670ddf520ce848eb514bf72bb06741e30eaa9f.text: 小心軟泥！它們會大量繁殖，並可以透過​​ PBAoE 損害垃圾郵件消滅毫無準備的一方。

30284a0f2157a5543c49c692fa18c9676ecc1907.source: On the first level, you need to take out a number of groups of Needling Lavastriders and Lifeweavers. If you kill the Lifeweaver first, the rest of each group is much easier. The Oozes should be pulled carefully or avoided if possible since they tend to swarm the party quickly with high amounts of AoE damage. There are plenty of pop ups throughout the dungeon, so try to aggro mobs one by one.
30284a0f2157a5543c49c692fa18c9676ecc1907.text: 在第一層，你需要幹掉多組針刺熔岩行者和生命編織者。如果你先殺死 織命者，那麼每組的其餘部分就會容易得多。如果可能的話，應該小心地拉出軟泥怪或避免它們，因為它們往往會迅速湧向隊伍並造成大量 範圍性 傷害。整個地牢裡有很多彈出視窗，所以嘗試一一攻擊小怪。

477d603a12ee7c0d90bfc0aa5d5385c51a66ab2a.source: To the south of the start point there is a dungeon map guarded by spiders. Following the map, you will find an Asura Flame Staff bundle among the dead asura, which must be used to light up the nearby spider web blocking the path. (You do not need to keep the first staff, but keeping hold of the second one you obtain later will save time.) Continue until you reach the next Beacon of Droknar - where a ranger boss will appear.
477d603a12ee7c0d90bfc0aa5d5385c51a66ab2a.text: 在起點的南面有一張由蜘蛛守護的地下城地圖。順著地圖走，你會在死去的阿修羅中間找到一個 阿蘇拉 火焰 法杖 包，必須用它來點亮附近擋路的蜘蛛網。 （你不需要保留第一根法杖，但保留稍後獲得的第二根法杖可以節省時間。）繼續前進，直到到達下一個卓克納爾信標 - 遊俠首領將出現在那裡。

c05a2b6e3b428ad42f3a61a329c7a7f3a6b9f1f0.source: There are a lot of spiders and poison traps in the next room, so pick a wall and keep close to it to avoid spawning too many spiders. Head for the northwest gate, pickup the staff and burn the web. (Keep this staff.) Keep close to the right hand wall and you can avoid many of the Elementals and Forge Masters in this room, but be wary of the Fire Bombs that Lok sends down the passage. Exit the room by the next web, and kill the plant popups in the next room. Pass the narrow passage with more Painweavers and poison jets.
c05a2b6e3b428ad42f3a61a329c7a7f3a6b9f1f0.text: 隔壁房間有很多蜘蛛和毒藥陷阱，所以選擇一堵牆並靠近它，以避免產生太多蜘蛛。前往西北門，拿起法杖並燒毀網路。 （保留這根法杖。）靠近右手邊的牆，你可以避開這個房間裡的許多元素和鍛造大師，但要小心洛克沿著通道傳送的火焰炸彈。從下一張網退出房間，並殺死隔壁房間的植物彈出視窗。通過有更多痛苦編織者和毒液噴射器的狹窄通道。

b279c29a77c880767315f9195efefb2573800955.source: Clear the spiders out from around the Spider Eggs. It is useful to the party if you light the eggs one at a time to prevent the party being overwhelmed by the popups. Also on the fourth group of eggs, the spawn of spiders is delayed. After lighting all the eggs, a Spider Matriarch will appear.
b279c29a77c880767315f9195efefb2573800955.text: 清除 蜘蛛 蛋周圍的蜘蛛。如果一次點燃一個雞蛋，可以防止聚會被彈出視窗淹沒，這對聚會很有用。同樣在第四組卵上，蜘蛛的產卵也被延遲。點燃所有彩蛋後，蜘蛛 女族長將會出現。

7a6152ab1901ac48702170b59f7928fedf63b5d8.source: Repeat this process on the eastern bunch of Spider Eggs. Once complete, the Dungeon Key will appear on the ground in front of the last Spider Web gate.
7a6152ab1901ac48702170b59f7928fedf63b5d8.text: 對東部的 蜘蛛 蛋重複此過程。完成後，地監 鑰匙 將出現在最後一個 蜘蛛 網門前方的地面上。

d251fdd4efe29582ddb33d3c944ff2fc7075f6d0.source: If a party misses the first matriarch by running straight past the eggs, then the key will not drop at the matriarch near the entrance to the next level. The party must run back to the first matriarch and kill it. This will cause the key to spawn in the location of the matriarch near the entrance to level 2, this had been mistaken for a bug but can be avoided by simply killing the first matriarch as you pass the eggs.
d251fdd4efe29582ddb33d3c944ff2fc7075f6d0.text: 如果隊伍直接跑過雞蛋而錯過了第一位女族長，那麼鑰匙不會掉落在下一層入口附近的女族長處。隊伍必須跑回第一位女族長那裡並殺死它。這將導致鑰匙在 2 關卡入口附近的女族長位置生成，這被誤認為是一個錯誤，但可以通過在傳遞雞蛋時簡單地殺死第一個女族長來避免。

8c933a77e4fb7e66410d0a0c30fedcbc9bf0803a.source: Head east as soon as you enter the level to retrieve the asura flame staff, then back-track to the start and head southwest. Ignore the tunnel with the Spider Web gate in front of it and head up the stairs past the Fire Darts. If the Fire Darts are difficult to deal with, they can be disabled by killing a Flame Guardian off the direct path to the south of the entrance; a safer route to the Guardian can be opened at the Area Map using a Secret Switch that can be revealed using Light of Deldrimor within compass range of the entrance.
8c933a77e4fb7e66410d0a0c30fedcbc9bf0803a.text: 進入關卡後立即向東走，取回阿修羅火焰法杖，然後原路返回起點，向西南方向走。忽略前方有 蜘蛛 網門的隧道，上樓梯經過火鏢。如果火鏢很難對付，可以透過殺死入口南邊直接路徑上的火焰 守護者 來停用它們；可以使用秘密開關在區域地圖上開啟通往 守護者 的更安全路線，該秘密開關可以在入口的羅盤範圍內使用 戴爾狄摩 的光來顯示。

08240954510a3c897f4891181063f5a0bb597ed5.source: Head west across the waterlogged next room and to the Beacon of Droknar. Ignore the skelk-infested passage and head northwest to the large room with the Spider Web gate in front of it. From here there is only one route to the end of the dungeon, with large numbers of spiders and a few popups of plants.
08240954510a3c897f4891181063f5a0bb597ed5.text: 向西穿過被水淹沒的隔壁房間，到達卓克納爾燈塔。忽略臭鼬出沒的通道，往西北方向前往前方有 蜘蛛 網門的大房間。從這裡到地牢盡頭只有一條路，那裡有大量的蜘蛛和一些植物。

2cd4b89c8bd199c31adb55c7026279b99958fc7f.source: In the final room there are many spiders, from Level 14 Spiders to Lifeweavers of Level 24, and it is recommended to kill all of the spiders before starting to burn the eggs because of the pop ups. There are ten clutches of eggs to burn, in two groups of five on either side of the chamber. Burning all five clutches on one side causes a large group of spiders including a Spider Matriarch to spawn, and after you've burned the last clutch of eggs, Arachni spawns with another large group. You have to kill the matriarch and Arachni to complete the quest and reveal Arachni's Spoils; it doesn't matter which one you kill first.
2cd4b89c8bd199c31adb55c7026279b99958fc7f.text: 最後一間房間裡有許多蜘蛛，從14級蜘蛛到24級Lifeweavers，建議在開始燒蛋之前殺死所有蜘蛛，因為會彈出視窗。有十窩雞蛋需要燃燒，分成兩組，每組五個，分佈在燃燒室的兩側。燒毀一側的所有五個蜘蛛會導致一大群蜘蛛（包括 蜘蛛 Matriarch）產卵，在燒毀最後一批雞蛋後，奧拉赫妮 會與另一大群蜘蛛一起產卵。你必須殺死女族長和 奧拉赫妮 才能完成任務並揭示 奧拉赫妮 的戰利品；你先殺掉哪一個並不重要。

bd3cf01f8700c09ab8e05e696e0a96b317344388.source: Blinding skills, or skills such as Price of Failure and Spiteful Spirit make the final boss battle much easier. The damage from Arachni comes from Barrage and Whirling Defense. If you use Diversion to stop Barrage then Arachni will simply stop attacking.
bd3cf01f8700c09ab8e05e696e0a96b317344388.text: 致盲技能，或失敗的代價和惡靈附身等技能讓最終的boss戰變得更容易。 奧拉赫妮 的損壞來自 齊射 和 旋風防禦。如果您使用 牽制 來停止 齊射，則 奧拉赫妮 將停止攻擊。

1a74a4b2b1596e61a9a4b0ba24e7125a0f76fd8c.source: Whirling Defense can be turned to your advantage with Pain Inverter.
1a74a4b2b1596e61a9a4b0ba24e7125a0f76fd8c.text: 旋風防禦 可以透過 苦痛 逆變器轉換為您的優勢。

15cea1880987a69eda931822b3c6764cf57f502f.source: Minion Masters are extremely useful, as they are very efficient in killing the many weaker mobs. There are enough corpses to easily support two Minion Masters. Ebon Battle Standard of Honor can boost the damage output considerably.
15cea1880987a69eda931822b3c6764cf57f502f.text: 僕從大師非常有用，因為他們可以非常有效地殺死許多較弱的生物。屍體數量夠輕鬆養活兩位小兵大師。 黑檀 榮譽戰旗可以大幅提升傷害輸出。

9d4ce4b2e36bf566cd2dbd9a8616a190a6eacbd2.source: AoE damage is extremely useful against the large groups of low level spiders.
9d4ce4b2e36bf566cd2dbd9a8616a190a6eacbd2.text: 範圍性 傷害對於對付大群低等級蜘蛛非常有用。

d41066f30edd54058f392c01751f6c9ecddf2476.source: Because of the large number of Ranger and Paragon enemies in this dungeon, consider taking a skill like "Shields Up!" or Winds to reduce the damage you and your party takes. The henchman Talon Silverwing uses "Shields Up!".
d41066f30edd54058f392c01751f6c9ecddf2476.text: 由於該地下城有大量 遊俠 和 聖言者 敵人，請考慮採用「Shields Up！」之類的技能。或風來減少你和你的隊伍所受到的傷害。追隨者利爪銀翼使用「護盾升起！」。

e701db57885c1ae60e009d467f5da1f0ac11a58f.source: When trying to do this dungeon, remember that your NPC allies are warriors as primary, and they'll rush to attack anything crossing their aggro bubble. This can be extremely dangerous when trying to pull the oozes on level 1, because the NPCs following you will attack your target and aggro all the others. For this reason, it's highly recommended to bring along with you at least one running skill to break NPCs' aggro on foes.
e701db57885c1ae60e009d467f5da1f0ac11a58f.text: 當嘗試進入這個地下城時，請記住，您的 NPC 盟友主要是戰士，他們會衝向任何穿過其仇恨氣泡的東西。當嘗試在 1 關卡中拉出軟泥時，這可能非常危險，因為跟隨您的 NPC 會攻擊您的目標並仇恨所有其他目標。因此，強烈建議您至少攜帶一項跑步技能，以打破 NPC 對敵人的仇恨。

4ce6fc86870445074e433d02da104842c626bfc9.source: Clear the Arbor Bay on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode.
4ce6fc86870445074e433d02da104842c626bfc9.text: 在困難模式下清除 Arbor Bay 上 灰暗沿岸 上的所有敵人。

053ecf0c2f2022cb78cf01290b296b4ace1e5e3c.source: Complete the Base Objective for 250 Zaishen Copper Coins.
053ecf0c2f2022cb78cf01290b296b4ace1e5e3c.text: 完成 250 再神銅幣的基礎 任務目標。

34309f3daeeaf5696599372e2ce9286f5670be41.source: "Clear the Arbor Bay on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode."
34309f3daeeaf5696599372e2ce9286f5670be41.text: “在困難模式下清除 灰暗沿岸 上喬木灣的所有敵人。”

4083d95285badc6bfb3f5f6fea1475f7bcea799f.source: Discounting quest influences, it has been reported to range from 375 to 563.
4083d95285badc6bfb3f5f6fea1475f7bcea799f.text: 扣除任務影響後，據報道範圍從 375 到 563。

3573369d4293dff4491cb2c59384ab3cf4f9d6c1.source: O Brave New World will increase the amount of enemies by about 50, although you can vanquish the area prior to triggering the quest spawns to reduce the kill count.
3573369d4293dff4491cb2c59384ab3cf4f9d6c1.text: 噢! 壯觀的新世界 會增加約 50 的敵人數量，儘管您可以在觸發任務產生之前征服該區域以減少擊殺數。

31b665ac9bcfbfc5b900019d32b4ab9f5528b90d.source: The Cipher of Kormir will cause an additional boss, Facet of Spirit, to spawn.
31b665ac9bcfbfc5b900019d32b4ab9f5528b90d.text: 科米兒的刻文 會導致額外的 Boss「精神面」產生。

4d5608c0067552e4d783b2a41ed0032ee9e16edb.source: Aggressive Hippopotami (around Ventari's sanctuary) and Elder Crocodiles (in the southeast) spawn only in hard mode.
4d5608c0067552e4d783b2a41ed0032ee9e16edb.text: 侵略的 河馬（凡特里 保護區周圍）和老鱷魚（位於東南部）僅在困難模式下產生。

8a63bddb3df5c1ec9c5d052822373e6f11d68212.source: Several groups of Wind Riders (some large, some small) patrol quickly around Ventari's sanctuary in a counter-clockwise direction. They are also found moving quickly in the forests to the southwest.
8a63bddb3df5c1ec9c5d052822373e6f11d68212.text: 幾組禦風者（有大有小）以逆時針方向在 凡特里 的庇護所周圍快速巡邏。人們也發現它們在西南部的森林中快速移動。

639939b61d6ab5964f8819f78910e1211ae16714.source: A cave just outside Vlox's Falls and one halfway to the Shards of Orr have hidden Venomweavers.
639939b61d6ab5964f8819f78910e1211ae16714.text: 沃洛克斯瀑布外的一個洞穴和 歐爾殘跡 半路上的一個洞穴裡隱藏著毒液編織者。

c4f3c1654ae19b1c05510e0b0a8a9cfcb90fdff2.source: crossing the opposite ramp near the Cathedral portal
c4f3c1654ae19b1c05510e0b0a8a9cfcb90fdff2.text: 穿過大教堂大門附近對面的坡道

f14eb2511a10870e0c96ad6cdfed21a01450b490.source: approaching the pillars where the stone enemies spawn.
f14eb2511a10870e0c96ad6cdfed21a01450b490.text: 接近石質敵怪生成的柱子。

45146df736efa799c1f94bb9d6ae5eaa8c8e72c4.source: In some cases, it may be necessary to revisit the cathedral multiple times to find all enemies.
45146df736efa799c1f94bb9d6ae5eaa8c8e72c4.text: 在某些情況下，可能需要多次重新訪問大教堂才能找到所有敵人。

90d4493ea604d2e306cbaa77d702fe87aa71ebcd.source: Kneeling at the statue of Balthazar resurrection shrine at the exit into Altrumm Ruins will sometimes not cause the Champion of Balthazar to appear. If you reconnect after disconnect, any dead elemental will respawn. They will have to be killed again to count for a vanquish.
90d4493ea604d2e306cbaa77d702fe87aa71ebcd.text: 在奧楚蘭廢墟出口的巴薩澤復活神社雕像下跪有時不會導致巴薩澤的勇士(公會戰頭銜)出現。如果斷開連線後重新連線，任何死亡的元素都會重生。他們必須再次被殺死才能算作勝利。

73886bfe80128dd8a619eb1e6835156d574e4ea4.source: Clear the Archipelagos in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
73886bfe80128dd8a619eb1e6835156d574e4ea4.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的碧玉海中的群島。

e96f9b4d45286308cfc9a170e46acd4618c751d4.source: "Clear the Archipelagos in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."
e96f9b4d45286308cfc9a170e46acd4618c751d4.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的碧玉海中的群島。”

ee1f1d9b6e6deb20123d187942b9dfd1e7b0e544.source: Many quests acquired from Cavalon will lead players into and through this explorable area, including the primary quests of Fort Aspenwood, the Jade Quarry, and Stolen Eggs.
ee1f1d9b6e6deb20123d187942b9dfd1e7b0e544.text: 從 卡瓦隆 獲得的許多工將引導玩家進入並穿越這個可探索的區域，包括 楊木要塞、翡翠礦場 和 Stolen Eggs 的主要任務。

2da02b2221e3868fd7747038d3117125624b3d79.source: This area lies between Cavalon, Breaker Hollow, and Jade Flats (Luxon).
2da02b2221e3868fd7747038d3117125624b3d79.text: 此區域位於 卡瓦隆、斷崖谷 和 Jade Flats (勒克森) 之間。

821a646c1badfae5eb24934372156d82c1f0b900.source: Anti-melee skills are effective due to a large number of warriors and assassins in this area.
821a646c1badfae5eb24934372156d82c1f0b900.text: 由於該區域有大量戰士和刺客，反近戰技能非常有效。

08e64747a30098f7fa14b2dfcb5e18ec3d5f3974.source: Snapjaw Windshell is in a group with several Rockhide Dragons and Saltspray Dragons, making that group very deadly to unprepared groups that are bunched up.
08e64747a30098f7fa14b2dfcb5e18ec3d5f3974.text: 鉗嘴風殼與幾條巖皮龍和鹽霧龍處於一組，這使得該組對於沒有準備的聚集在一起的組來說非常致命。

0b8455acc51bdb4ccfc18c8e6edef405ada6a9c3.source: There are five hidden Oni spawn points - one on a clearing east of Snapjaw Windshell, two at the Jade Sea path connecting Breaker Hollow and Cavalon, On the hill north of the Luxon arena, and there is one behind Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna.
0b8455acc51bdb4ccfc18c8e6edef405ada6a9c3.text: 有五個隱藏的鬼生成點 - 一個位於 Snapjaw Windshell 以東的空地上，兩個位於連線 斷崖谷 和 卡瓦隆 的 碧玉海 路徑上，位於 勒克森 競技場以北的山上，還有一個位於 薇娜的祝福 桑斯 後面。

68d48af80895c5eb14b3268afba4f1983fb94941.source: Exploring this area will contribute approximately 2.6% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
68d48af80895c5eb14b3268afba4f1983fb94941.text: 探索該領域將為 Canthan 版圖 標題貢獻約 2.6%。

542c63396fdd04bbed0a2ae11db3e8be22678dac.source: There is a bridge near the Jade Flats, where the coral below can strike allies crossing over.
542c63396fdd04bbed0a2ae11db3e8be22678dac.text: 翡翠灘附近有一座橋，橋下的珊瑚可以攻擊過橋的盟友。

9bb8383e3601263f76bb267629d95e0f20043c87.source: Clear Arkjok Ward in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
9bb8383e3601263f76bb267629d95e0f20043c87.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 阿爾科監禁區。

7779f583a692beee71b59a0d2ddbe1fd3aa9a798.source: "Clear Arkjok Ward in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."
7779f583a692beee71b59a0d2ddbe1fd3aa9a798.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 阿爾科監禁區。”

b8eedbe8046e838e79378f95b46a7f8d81ad4d70.source: The Great Escape is the primary quest that will first lead characters into this area.
b8eedbe8046e838e79378f95b46a7f8d81ad4d70.text: 大逃亡 是主要任務，將首先引導角色進入該區域。

6de2a3b6a39b703dc4b47869235eb6e16f7a9d9d.source: Secondary quests that take place in this area include A Little Recon and Drake in a Cage.
6de2a3b6a39b703dc4b47869235eb6e16f7a9d9d.text: 在該區域發生的次要任務包括「小偵察」和「籠子裡的 龍獸」。

910eda33087e60153db293156d4ed822fcda9919.source: The A Prescription for Conscription quest in particular will produce a lot more insect spawns.
910eda33087e60153db293156d4ed822fcda9919.text: 徵兵處方任務尤其會產生更多的昆蟲產卵。

cd6e4222ba33dac9ad5fca23da32d42096093bd0.source: Several hidden groups of Mandragors are located in the southeast area from the Yohlon Haven exit.
cd6e4222ba33dac9ad5fca23da32d42096093bd0.text: 幾個隱藏的曼陀羅群體位於 猶朗避難所 出口的東南部區域。

663f4bfaf1c125a329cbb140c0270b6b3735767d.source: The exit into Sunspear Sanctuary is blocked until the completion of Hunted!
663f4bfaf1c125a329cbb140c0270b6b3735767d.text: 日戟避難所 的出口被封鎖，直到狩獵完成！

66619d1a95c7710afe7963306885f2f67bac043b.source: Meet with Dengo on the Plains of Jarin.
66619d1a95c7710afe7963306885f2f67bac043b.text: 在 賈林平原 上與 Dengo 會面。

e2b45ff7438617b7e1e7e524a8fe95ec2f548cb9.source: The enclosed area surrounding the ruins has many groups of hidden Incubi, some will spawn right next to Simian groups.
e2b45ff7438617b7e1e7e524a8fe95ec2f548cb9.text: 廢墟周圍的封閉區域有許多隱藏的夢魘群體，其中一些會在猿猴群體旁邊生成。

339f84c58b92dbfdef2f84c286b59915a788f51a.source: Kill Arbor Earthcall in the Morostav Trail.
339f84c58b92dbfdef2f84c286b59915a788f51a.text: 在 摩洛神秘通道 中殺死 大地之喚 亞伯。

0a4ec302b71e9d0839a1646f417b79b5616af3e8.source: *BONUS* Kill Arbor Earthcall in Hard Mode.
0a4ec302b71e9d0839a1646f417b79b5616af3e8.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 大地之喚 亞伯。

bc17e96086daa3ada6f9e4e9d60ec6f44dfaeb20.source: Leave from Durheim Archives, Vasburg Armory or Unwaking Waters (Kurzick). Even though he appears to be alone, six Wardens of Seasons will popup when you get close to his initial location. However, as he has a larger-than-usual aggro bubble, you can pull him towards you without spawning those Wardens of Seasons.
bc17e96086daa3ada6f9e4e9d60ec6f44dfaeb20.text: 從 杜漢姆卷藏室、維思柏兵營 或 Unwaking Waters (庫茲柯) 出發。儘管他看起來很孤獨，但當你靠近他的初始位置時，六個季節守望者會彈出。然而，由於他有一個比平常更大的仇恨氣泡，你可以把他拉向你，而不會產生那些季節守望者。

13d3442971646376fe10d29be81c0147f7159888.source: Retrieve the Urn of Saint Viktor from the cathedral in Arborstone.
13d3442971646376fe10d29be81c0147f7159888.text: 從阿伯斯通的大教堂取回聖維克託的甕。

e0cf838c64c97c7eca28026dbc6ff0826d6dbb1e.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 30 minutes.
e0cf838c64c97c7eca28026dbc6ff0826d6dbb1e.text: *獎勵* 在 30 分鐘內完成任務。

73bd37eefa9e30068843c897fb28992a311a9ca7.source: Clear Arborstone in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
73bd37eefa9e30068843c897fb28992a311a9ca7.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人 科凡德森林 中的 Arborstone。

a5ecf0a8342cf7f98e7ae3c21db13f2d10582e9d.source: "Clear Arborstone in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."
a5ecf0a8342cf7f98e7ae3c21db13f2d10582e9d.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人 科凡德森林 中的 Arborstone。”

03848f9ef69f4885fd57e9903796da4932d99347.source: The Count's Daughter primary quest will lead a party through here for the first time, although that part of this explorable area is actually in an isolated small section. To explore the rest of this explorable area will entail reaching the Altrumm Ruins first. From there, secondary quests like Song and Stone and Wardens On the March will bring parties here. From Arborstone, talk to Gatekeeper Becker. This will allow you to enter the northern part of the explorable area (with Lift Operator Shulz).
03848f9ef69f4885fd57e9903796da4932d99347.text: 伯爵的女兒的主要任務將帶領一支隊伍第一次穿過這裡，儘管這個可探索區域的那部分實際上是在一個孤立的小區域中。要探索這個可探索區域的其餘部分，首先需要到達 奧楚蘭廢墟。從那裡開始，像《歌與石》和《行軍中的守望者》這樣的次要任務將把派對帶到這裡。從阿伯斯通，與看門人貝克爾交談。這將允許你進入可探索區域的北部（與電梯操作員舒爾茨一起）。

537d6f4982ed61df65e74ad31a792602ee617e79.source: Your character can bypass the lift by having more unspent faction of the allegiance not controlling Tanglewood Copse and not activating the resurrection shrine outside of Tanglewood Copse (by bribing the priest or killing the resurrection shrine NPCs). When your party wipes, your party will be resurrected at a shrine closer to Altrumm Ruins and/or the Arborstone outpost.
537d6f4982ed61df65e74ad31a792602ee617e79.text: 你的角色可以透過擁有更多未花費的效忠 陣營值 而不控制 譚格塢樹林 並且不在 譚格塢樹林 之外啟動復活神殿（透過賄賂牧師或殺死復活神殿 NPC）來繞過電梯。當你的隊伍消滅後，你的隊伍將在靠近 奧楚蘭廢墟 和/或 Arborstone 前哨站的神社復活。

65b07f8a31fc86bb1dc02d9330f62a9f16582a32.source: There are places here that allow a view of the eastern edge of the map. However, instead of the Qinkaishi Mountains, the player will see water.
65b07f8a31fc86bb1dc02d9330f62a9f16582a32.text: 這裡有一些地方可以看到地圖的東部邊緣。然而，玩家看到的不是秦開石山脈，而是水。

89cb64d1ca652c8be2022235c89001eca60777ae.source: Each of the stone guardian bosses appear to be alone. However, they are guarded by spawns hidden in nearby pillars (typically 2 each of Stone Crushers, Reapers, and Rains). Be prepared to take on 6 pillars plus the boss.
89cb64d1ca652c8be2022235c89001eca60777ae.text: 每個石頭守護者 Boss 似乎都是孤獨的。然而，它們受到隱藏在附近柱子中的生成點的保護（通常是碎石機、收割機和雨機的 2）。準備好對抗 6 支柱和頭目。

4ab9c1b02b08728021cafcdf9c1c81b7ad09eb2b.source: These extra guardians are not automatically released from the pillars: the Warrior Boss' guards are triggered when a human player walks over the top of the southwest ramp in the main room (from Altrumm Ruins); the caster bosses' guards are triggered by the northeast ramp.
4ab9c1b02b08728021cafcdf9c1c81b7ad09eb2b.text: 這些額外的守衛不會自動從柱子上釋放：當人類玩家走過主房間西南坡道的頂部時，戰士 頭目 的守衛就會被觸發（來自 奧楚蘭廢墟）；施法者 Boss 的守衛由東北坡道觸發。

502976de499f91bb871c1e35c0e0dfab5e3be8ca.source: Bosses can be pulled away from the pillars without triggering opening of the pillars. Alternatively, you can sometimes break the guardians out of the pillars without aggroing the nearby boss.
502976de499f91bb871c1e35c0e0dfab5e3be8ca.text: 可以將老闆從柱子上拉開，而不會觸發柱子的開啟。或者，有時你可以將守衛者從柱子上打下來，而不會激怒附近的首領。

89d976f7fa215eb725b231db517bb5ae22859302.source: Cartographer candidates should scrape the edges of this small area (uncovering approximately 0.5% additional area).
89d976f7fa215eb725b231db517bb5ae22859302.text: 版圖 考生應該刮掉這個小區域的邊緣（發現大約 0.5% 的額外區域）。

e977b02bd1791709746f033208895ed2c9b2ef93.source: You will be warned, "You must enter the Arborstone explorable area from Altrumm Ruins in order to vanquish it."
e977b02bd1791709746f033208895ed2c9b2ef93.text: 您將收到警告：“您必須從 奧楚蘭廢墟 進入 Arborstone 可探索區域才能征服它。”

a48f7d94e53f70f0cdf94836781e37a681db149b.source: Some enemies in the Cathedral zu Heltzer may spawn out of sight in an area that has already been visited. While the exact spawn triggers are unknown, reported methods to trigger them include:
a48f7d94e53f70f0cdf94836781e37a681db149b.text: 赫爾茨大教堂中的一些敵人可能會在已經訪問過的區域中出現在視線之外。雖然確切的生成觸發器尚不清楚，但報告的觸發它們的方法包括：

b9a9ab840f88ef1b7779a879837a458d7734d6c7.source: killing or approaching the bosses on one side of the cathedral
b9a9ab840f88ef1b7779a879837a458d7734d6c7.text: 殺死或接近大教堂一側的首領

8a486f15784a36f7b2ff2a383a91a0fe1da7a690.source: Protect Dengo from corsair attacks as you travel to the Sunspear Great Hall.
8a486f15784a36f7b2ff2a383a91a0fe1da7a690.text: 當您前往 日戟大會堂 時，保護 Dengo 免受海盜攻擊。

b796b5399cce6f04dc32eea3d3fddcb39137e9ed.text: 前往 Mehinu 領取獎勵。

9d9e3c2d0d2c0acf321c12b8a064cb36fc389ceb.source: Exit Kamadan through the gate leading to the Plains of Jarin. Dengo will be standing around in the open, waiting for you. Speak to him and he'll take off in the direction of the Sunspear Great Hall, taking regular stops to catch his breath (you can also use this emote yourself: type "/catchbreath"). At the middle of the journey, he'll yell and you'll have to deal with a wave of four, low-level Corsairs. Keep following him as he proceeds towards his destination. Remember to wait for the quest to update before leaving this area or you will have to restart from Kamadan.
9d9e3c2d0d2c0acf321c12b8a064cb36fc389ceb.text: 透過通往 賈林平原 的大門離開卡馬丹。 Dengo 將站在空曠的地方等待您。與他交談，他就會朝著 日戟大會堂 的方向起飛，並定期停下來喘口氣（您也可以自己使用此表情：輸入“/catchbreath”）。在旅程的中間，他會大喊大叫，你將不得不對付一波四隻低階海盜。繼續跟隨他，直到他朝著目的地前進。請記住在離開該區域之前等待任務更新，否則您將必須從卡馬丹重新開始。

02eb24de088f0a83f0f14a4108adf95596276072.source: Combines well with Quality Steel and Map-Travel Inventor.
02eb24de088f0a83f0f14a4108adf95596276072.text: 與 Quality Steel 和 Map-Travel Inventor 完美結合。

8a0d79745c0ebd05aaf4bef5b7e55a90a36ab9d6.source: If you travel north-northwest from where the corsairs attack you, you may find another group or two apparently hanging around, maybe as backup for the first wave.
8a0d79745c0ebd05aaf4bef5b7e55a90a36ab9d6.text: 如果你從海盜襲擊你的地方向西北偏北行駛，你可能會發現另一群或兩群顯然在附近徘徊，也許是第一波浪潮的後援。

0ad965416e268effcac691cc1db369256897bcce.source: Sometimes the corsairs that run at you while on the plains will run away as soon as they reach your aggro radius, making you run after them until they stop. Then you can kill them. (Example) After killing the corsairs, Dengo sometimes will not move, forcing you to restart the quest.
0ad965416e268effcac691cc1db369256897bcce.text: 有時，在平原上向你跑來的海盜一到達你的仇恨半徑就會逃跑，讓你追趕他們直到他們停下來。然後你就可以殺掉他們了。 （例如）殺死海盜後，Dengo有時不會移動，迫使你重新開始任務。

e76e2153d71f072526629117c682a02eb35770d2.source: Find Old Mac's body out in the Breach.
e76e2153d71f072526629117c682a02eb35770d2.text: 在突破口找到老麥克的屍體。

a6b463845869a1fa3e0515183faa55b59aa62025.source: Escort Old Mac back to Piken Square.
a6b463845869a1fa3e0515183faa55b59aa62025.text: 將舊 Mac 護送回 派肯廣場。

b34beda7dc459160bdb79c5a7dddd4d83daa7fc6.source: Return to Armsman Pitney for your reward.
b34beda7dc459160bdb79c5a7dddd4d83daa7fc6.text: 影返 至 重灌兵 菲特尼 以獲得獎勵。

267b2e4c824d72d86424f593ca5d6b69ea7a7126.source: Exit Piken Square and travel West towards some old ruins and climb the slope, killing the Charr along the way. Watch out for patrols (composed of a Charr mesmer and two rangers). Head towards the Charr Elementalists and take out the various patrols in this area one at a time. Afterwards move south and look for an entry into the rock wall to the west, usually blocked by a Charr Overseer, Martyr, and Axe Warrior (visible on the radar). Kill them. Move onward and you will soon see Old Mac, usually close to a Charr Overseer and a Martyr.
267b2e4c824d72d86424f593ca5d6b69ea7a7126.text: 退出 派肯廣場 並向西前往一些古老的廢墟並爬上斜坡，殺死沿途的 夏爾。留意巡邏隊（由一名 夏爾 幻術師和兩名護林員組成）。前往 夏爾 元素師並一次消滅該地區的各個巡邏隊。然後向南移動，尋找西邊巖壁的入口，通常被 夏爾監督者、殉教 和 斧 戰士 阻擋（在雷達上可見）。殺掉他們。繼續前進，您很快就會看到舊版 Mac，通常接近 夏爾監督者 和 殉教。

951d5161b5df28b1d5223603945f7d00e43548d1.source: Quickly make your way to Mac and kill the nearby Charr — if he dies, you have to restart the quest. Backtrack your way to Piken. Wait for the quest to update before passing through the portal.
951d5161b5df28b1d5223603945f7d00e43548d1.text: 快速前往 Mac 並殺死附近的 夏爾——如果他死了，你必須重新開始任務。原路返回皮肯。等待任務更新後再通過傳送門。

06996380d13a26c2ccadb89f48b81cf844150e51.source: Ironically, the quest cannot be completed if Old Mac is killed by the Charr before you reach him, despite the quest log saying that you have to find Old Mac's dead body.
06996380d13a26c2ccadb89f48b81cf844150e51.text: 諷刺的是，如果老麥克在你到達他之前被 夏爾 殺死，任務就無法完成，儘管任務日誌說你必須找到老麥克的屍體。

0c80c4ba4f32dbc34c29299d4ba34a64996144a2.source: Joe has a few pips of constant health regeneration.
0c80c4ba4f32dbc34c29299d4ba34a64996144a2.text: 喬有一些持續的健康恢復能力。

f3fd57f3013545ec3c3fbe70879e8839deed3c2b.source: Old Mac might repeat his dialogue as you approach the portal.
f3fd57f3013545ec3c3fbe70879e8839deed3c2b.text: 當你接近傳送門時，老麥克可能會重複他的對話。

d700a2c89fb964e1d6cdf495e765ccb0f3e00ec9.source: You must clear the camp on the western edge of the Great Battle Field for Kromril the Eternal to spawn.
d700a2c89fb964e1d6cdf495e765ccb0f3e00ec9.text: 你必須清理大戰場西邊的營地，永恆者克羅姆瑞爾才能生成。

384345ff1b37b6d5522761ec8db2a61257a61361.text: 摧毀 曼席斯的祭司

87cbedf55fc8b8af89bcc4c538479ef9e3841906.source: Deliver the unholy text to Kromril the Eternal
87cbedf55fc8b8af89bcc4c538479ef9e3841906.text: 將邪惡的文本交給永恆的克羅姆瑞爾

f0c4670a8eccddb3ef622e46878ab426a5de181b.source: The Priest of Menzies is in a camp across the battlefield to the east. There are several patrols of Skeleton Army units with scattered popups of Skeletal Impalers between you and the camp. It is wise to dispose of the Skeletal patrols near the camp, because it's quite possible to aggro them when going for the Priest.
f0c4670a8eccddb3ef622e46878ab426a5de181b.text: 曼席斯的祭司 位於戰場東側的一個營地。有幾支 骷髏 軍隊巡邏隊，在你和營地之間散佈著骷髏穿刺者的彈出視窗。明智的做法是消滅營地附近的骷髏巡邏隊，因為在攻擊牧師時很可能會激怒他們。

b0f13ff298889bb29e7f595753e358979ce5a3d5.source: The camp is accessable by two ramps on opposite sides of the camp. Each ramp is guarded by a powerful Dragon Lich. Despite being necromancers, they are strong melee attackers that can take out a caster with as few as two hits. Pull one of the dragons and the accompanying Skeletal Ether Breaker away from the camp to dispose of them.
b0f13ff298889bb29e7f595753e358979ce5a3d5.text: 營地可從營地兩側的兩個坡道進入。每個坡道均由強大的 巫妖之龍 保護。儘管是死靈法師，他們也是強大的近戰攻擊者，只需兩次攻擊就可以幹掉施法者。 拉出 將其中一條龍和伴隨的骷髏以太破壞者帶離營地並消滅它們。

284c26bc2655c37ac14edd98def749a3ba48ae9d.source: With one of the entrances clear, you can proceed to the Shadow Army group in the camp. It is possible to pull the group out and away from the Priest and his healing. There will also be a Skeletal Impaler popup in the camp. Keep a wary eye on the compass when attacking the camp though; it's possible for the second Dragon Lich to come after you.
284c26bc2655c37ac14edd98def749a3ba48ae9d.text: 當其中一個入口暢通無阻後，您就可以前往營地中的 暗影軍團 小組。有可能將團隊拉出並遠離牧師和他的治療。營地中還會有一個骷髏穿刺者彈出視窗。不過，在攻擊營地時，請務必留意指南針；第二個 巫妖之龍 可能會跟隨您。

c9e45ad90af44801aeffadd0659bc41b2584070a.source: When the Priest of Menzies has been killed, he will drop an Unholy Text. This is a bundle item you will need to pick up and carry back to Kromril. Before handing the text over to Kromril, make sure your teammates all have the quest first. If someone doesn't have the quest before turning in the text, they will be unable to complete it afterward.
c9e45ad90af44801aeffadd0659bc41b2584070a.text: 當 曼席斯的祭司 被殺死時，他會掉落邪惡文字。這是一個捆綁物品，您需要拿起並帶回克羅姆裡爾。在將文字交給克羅姆裡爾之前，請確保您的隊友都先完成了任務。如果有人在提交文字之前沒有任務，那麼他們之後將無法完成任務。

27e41d2b19c723cede1152f6fd626bc33f55c1c4.source: The Priest of Menzies is the only boss in the Fissure of Woe and as such the only opportunity for the party to gain a morale boost, if they do not carry certain consumables such as a Powerstone of Courage.
27e41d2b19c723cede1152f6fd626bc33f55c1c4.text: 曼席斯的祭司 是悲痛裂縫中唯一的 Boss，因此，如果隊伍沒有攜帶某些消耗品（例如勇氣能量石），那麼這也是隊伍獲得士氣提升的唯一機會。

0dd179f6b766187163ef431fd10c9d17e47ffc68.source: There is an invisible wall on the west ramp that can be used to obstruct the Shadow Rangers' line of sight, resulting in less damage taken.
0dd179f6b766187163ef431fd10c9d17e47ffc68.text: 西坡道上有一面隱形牆，可以用來阻擋 闇影 Rangers 的視線，從而減少受到的傷害。

bfd6818afd995aff0016358567d5ce1cb84d1958.source: Kill the Sly Dredge who stole Jun's art supplies
bfd6818afd995aff0016358567d5ce1cb84d1958.text: 殺死偷了 Jun 美術用品的狡猾的 挖掘者

e63e96995ce43e446a032b378cb42f7b54b9ffa1.source: The Sly Dredge is found in Melandru's Hope. Head northeast from Lutgardis Conservatory or, if it is unlocked, west from Jade Flats (Kurzick) and follow the quest pointer to the Sly Dredge. The Sly Dredge will usually be accompanied by a group of 5-6 other Dredge.
e63e96995ce43e446a032b378cb42f7b54b9ffa1.text: Sly 挖掘者 位於 梅蘭朵的盼望 中。從 路嘉帝斯溫室 向東北走，或如果已解鎖，則從 Jade Flats (庫茲柯) 向西走，然後按照任務指標到達 Sly 挖掘者。 Sly 挖掘者 通常會伴隨一組 5-6 和其他 挖掘者。

bb020e215ecb31112aca6ab3d5ad1466d703daef.source: The quest is completed once you return Jun's Art Supplies to Jun in House zu Heltzer.
bb020e215ecb31112aca6ab3d5ad1466d703daef.text: 當您將 Jun 的藝術用品歸還給 鳳荷議院 中的 Jun 後，任務就完成了。

f3eae399a2b15591ddbd32e3c7e1fcb976f95036.source: Clear the Ascalon Foothills of all enemies in hard mode.
f3eae399a2b15591ddbd32e3c7e1fcb976f95036.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆丘陵。

a9c2573163b34e8ce96154593b768dfad9a5e7ad.source: Complete the Base Objective for 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.
a9c2573163b34e8ce96154593b768dfad9a5e7ad.text: 完成 50 再神銅幣的基礎 任務目標。

857e89e19e56b217cc387d39e58892e508987fcb.source: "Clear the Ascalon Foothills of all enemies in hard mode."
857e89e19e56b217cc387d39e58892e508987fcb.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆丘陵。”

ac018a04e4ce0cd5ffa44742fec35f0cdeb295ce.source: Leave from Yak's Bend southeast through Traveler's Vale or from Nolani Academy or Grendich Courthouse and travel north/west (respectively) through Diessa Lowlands.
ac018a04e4ce0cd5ffa44742fec35f0cdeb295ce.text: 從 犛牛村 向東南方向出發，經過 旅人谷，或從 若拉尼學院 或 葛蘭迪法院 出發，（分別）向北/向西行駛，經過 底耶沙低地。

ec754fc953452c355faee23eb21f04552474ce53.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.5% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
ec754fc953452c355faee23eb21f04552474ce53.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.5% 的貢獻。

b0a0c52aea13b67e494f123b52aae949951e3140.source: If starting from Yak's Bend or Borlis Pass, you can come to this area with a party size of 6. Consider continuing onwards into Diessa Lowlands with the larger group.
b0a0c52aea13b67e494f123b52aae949951e3140.text: 如果從 犛牛村 或 柏里斯通道 開始，您可以以 6 的隊伍規模來到該區域。考慮繼續與更大的群體一起進入 底耶沙低地。

284706392c3394e8c8c45ff57d08fcc93e427791.source: Complete the Advanced Defense Techniques course.
284706392c3394e8c8c45ff57d08fcc93e427791.text: 完成高階防禦技術課程。

9c0e88816cf2bbe28ce9589b422b1ce492daf1a9.text: 完成 削弱 課程。

82b6f45a055a14ee5fdeaf9af11a1ba2c2df58eb.text: 完成 技能 連結課程。

e4887ec7a473dcd45d604a8ecf935619edd487f9.source: See Headmaster Lee for your reward.

3905642c027c840b7fbcbfa54a6f606d45b6d332.source: This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. The order of completion is entirely optional.
3905642c027c840b7fbcbfa54a6f606d45b6d332.text: 此任務需要完成吳教練給予的四個子任務。完成的順序完全是可選的。

1157b6fcb2ea3eee6ea98d73ac03b6f630cce2de.source: Find Ratsu and stop him before he kills Saito.
1157b6fcb2ea3eee6ea98d73ac03b6f630cce2de.text: 找到拉茲並在他殺死齊藤之前阻止他。

bf4209914b899fd81a7fcc6cf7474e60f9fff9aa.source: Starting from Nahpui Quarter, head down the bridge and over to the area with Qian and Paomu. When you approach them, Ratsu will appear. Slay him to finish the quest.
bf4209914b899fd81a7fcc6cf7474e60f9fff9aa.text: 從納普區出發，走下橋，前往錢和跑木所在的區域。當你接近他們時，Ratsu就會出現。殺死他即可完成任務。

1ac134bf5fd0ae00a3f3b0ead62a17f9790db220.source: Having Seek out Brother Tosai active in your quest log will not prevent you from completing this quest as Ratsu will still be hostile.
1ac134bf5fd0ae00a3f3b0ead62a17f9790db220.text: 在你的任務日誌中尋找活躍的東齋兄弟不會阻止你完成這個任務，因為拉蘇仍然是敵對的。

0dfb721903cba79bde3679fe88784c3b7c6c2dc0.source: Speak to Elder Jurdu when all members of your party are ready to defend Beknur Harbor
0dfb721903cba79bde3679fe88784c3b7c6c2dc0.text: 當你的隊伍的所有成員都準備好保衛貝克努爾港時，與長老朱爾杜交談

05ce221b38085d699214e48e90bb6fba5fb7e257.source: Defend Beknur Harbor from the attacking amphibian army. 6...0 waves of attackers remain.
05ce221b38085d699214e48e90bb6fba5fb7e257.text: 保衛貝克努爾港免受兩棲大軍的攻擊。 6...0 攻擊者的浪潮仍然存在。

ee0629dc0cc449ef8d2534395e6e7fc14deb16e6.source: See Elder Jurdu for your reward.
ee0629dc0cc449ef8d2534395e6e7fc14deb16e6.text: 去找朱爾杜長老領獎勵。

8d734b6e73cb892d249879e937c2bd7b1a13f36f.source: You will begin in an explorable version of Beknur Harbor and a countdown timer will start. Once the timer ends, the gates to the harbor will open and the first wave of Skale will rush in. A good tactic would be to bottleneck them in the opening of the gate with your melee fighters and hit them with AoE damage. This will kill off the lower level foes quickly and allow you to target the higher level ones. You need to be careful not to let them mob your casters and monks because with so many foes it is difficult for your casters to run away. Once the first wave starts, there will be constant waves of Skale until the quest ends, so be sure to have proper energy management and healing to endure the assault. The Skale Blighter can be particularly nasty because they carry Rotting Flesh and will spread disease quickly throughout your party. Consider bringing sufficient Condition removal to combat this. The last group to spawn will have Glug Klugg in it, finishing him and his small group will end the quest and you will be automatically returned to the Harbor.
8d734b6e73cb892d249879e937c2bd7b1a13f36f.text: 您將從貝克努爾港的可探索版本開始，倒數計時器將啟動。一旦計時器結束，港口的大門就會開啟，第一波 鱗怪 將會衝進來。一個好的策略是用你的近戰戰士在大門開啟時限制他們，並用 範圍性 傷害擊中他們。這將快速殺死低等級的敵人，並讓你瞄準高等級的敵人。你需要小心，不要讓他們圍攻你的施法者和武僧，因為敵人太多，你的施法者很難逃跑。一旦第一波開始，就會有持續不斷的 鱗怪 波，直到任務結束，所以一定要進行適當的能量管理和治療來承受攻擊。 鱗怪 Blighter 可能特別令人討厭，因為它們攜帶 肉體腐爛 並且會在整個團隊中快速傳播疾病。考慮進行足夠的條件移除來解決這個問題。最後出現的隊伍中將有格魯格·克魯格（Glug Klugg），殺死他和他的小隊將結束任務，你將自動返回港口。

6efbcb154fc75cb691ab2119ac37a33d77bbfc10.source: This is one of the more challenging quests in the game, depending upon your character and build, since there are large waves of enemies which never seem to stop coming. Having a minion master and an AoE Elementalist (or two) helps quite a lot.
6efbcb154fc75cb691ab2119ac37a33d77bbfc10.text: 這是遊戲中更具挑戰性的任務之一，取決於你的角色和體型，因為一波又一波的敵人似乎永遠不會停止到來。擁有一個 Minion Master 和一個 範圍性 元素使（或兩個）會有很大幫助。

f8bb4354876b68a1fa6ad4118b7496ec443a8db9.source: If you're having trouble taking on all groups at once, then once the gates open, head out to the far left and take out the groups that spawn there first. Then pull the group inside the gate to the far right and repeat. Finally, take out the groups that spawn in the middle.
f8bb4354876b68a1fa6ad4118b7496ec443a8db9.text: 如果你在一次對付所有隊伍時遇到困難，那麼一旦大門開啟，前往最左邊並消滅首先在那裡產生的隊伍。然後將門內的小組拉到最右邊並重複。最後，取出中間產生的組。

b98e8771f91a3a6fae318474f894eb16d6766ab7.source: If you let one of the first few waves inside, the quest will not progress, although the monsters will still come. After you go back and defeat the wave inside, groups of 4 or so creature waves follow for the remainder of the quest.
b98e8771f91a3a6fae318474f894eb16d6766ab7.text: 如果你讓前幾波中的一波進入，任務將不會進展，儘管怪物仍然會來。當你回去並擊敗裡面的浪潮後，4 左右的生物浪潮會跟著你完成剩餘的任務。

f73dfa6c1e7634ee1aee2ea2e7d84985059c5303.source: Assault the Stronghold and free the Ebon Vanguard captives from Hierophant Burntsoul.
f73dfa6c1e7634ee1aee2ea2e7d84985059c5303.text: 攻擊要塞並從 Hierophant Burntsoul 手中解救 黑檀 俘虜。

b5aa01c1d4fe15b19b6d3e00ea4d1602756ac3a4.source: As per the Assault on the Stronghold quest.
b5aa01c1d4fe15b19b6d3e00ea4d1602756ac3a4.text: 根據 襲擊根據地 任務。

ec69be33fe8804931695d7f003c86fa459c8948f.source: Locate Waeng in the sewers and eliminate him.
ec69be33fe8804931695d7f003c86fa459c8948f.text: 在下水道中找到Waeng並消滅他。

5879afc12def484e171507bf72ebbecec56f9afe.source: See Guardsman Tang for your reward

cc8d1bd88a75fc1a9e5b747c7091be0d1c0999aa.source: This quest is very straightforward. Starting from the entrance to The Undercity from Wajjun Bazaar, head right and follow the arrow on your radar. The Am Fah patrols between you and Waeng are small, around 4-6 members per group, and are easily dispatched. Eliminating Waeng himself is the only thing required by the quest.
cc8d1bd88a75fc1a9e5b747c7091be0d1c0999aa.text: 這個任務非常簡單。從 瓦江市場 到 地下城 的入口開始，向右行駛並按照雷達上的箭頭行駛。您和 Waeng 之間的 安費 巡邏隊規模較小，每組大約有 4-6 成員，並且很容易派遣。消滅瓦恩本人是任務唯一需要做的事情。

cbd1d7b04f58ff974649289e240db545af3007e2.source: This quest can easily be completed at the same time as Capturing the Orrian Tome and It Ends Here, as they're all in the same general area of The Undercity.
cbd1d7b04f58ff974649289e240db545af3007e2.text: 此任務可以輕鬆地與「奪取奧裡安之書」和「一切就此結束」同時完成，因為它們都位於 地下城 的同一區域。

bb64f56f0407d806c57c447711e6590d4526d782.source: Waeng is an Assassin boss who gives players an early opportunity to capture Flashing Blades
bb64f56f0407d806c57c447711e6590d4526d782.text: Waeng 是 暗殺者 的首領，為玩家提供了早期捕捉 閃光劍刃 的機會

758e1e078a73d1c47ceb5b06cf8145e4360ad632.source: Complete the "Zinn's Task" or "The Knowledgeable Asura" quest
758e1e078a73d1c47ceb5b06cf8145e4360ad632.text: 完成「Zinn 的任務」或「知識淵博的 阿蘇拉」任務

14c71d26547085a5fa46bde93cd23794d61e94f1.source: Speak with the Asura Chark in the Tarnished Coast.
14c71d26547085a5fa46bde93cd23794d61e94f1.text: 與 灰暗沿岸 中的 阿蘇拉 查克交談。

5f26d73762787893e264ac13b72ac12adb571df8.source: Report to Salma in Talmark Wilderness on the outcome of the Asuran Trial.
5f26d73762787893e264ac13b72ac12adb571df8.text: 向 突馬克荒地 中的薩爾瑪報告阿蘇蘭審判的結果。

f922a5b080dd686362dc6a733fae05e5ce389676.source: Speak with the Lion's Arch Keep gate guard to gain access to Lion's Arch Keep where Salma will have your congratulatory message.
f922a5b080dd686362dc6a733fae05e5ce389676.text: 與 獅子拱門要塞 門衛交談以進入 獅子拱門要塞，薩爾瑪將在那裡收到您的祝賀訊息。

86bf6333424744df93848e7dda232ba92eebef1e.source: After completing either Zinn's Task or the Knowledgeable Asura quests, map travel to Vlox's Falls and exit into Arbor Bay. Talk to Chark who is immediately outside the portal you just came through. Simply entering Zinn's Trial and stepping into the witness area will complete the objective for witnessing the trial, it is not necessary to watch the entire scene.
86bf6333424744df93848e7dda232ba92eebef1e.text: 完成 Zinn 的任務或 Knowledgeable 阿蘇拉 任務後，在地圖上前往 Vlox's Falls 並退出進入 Arbor Bay。與就在你剛通過的傳送門外的查克交談。只要進入辛恩的審判，踏入證人區域就可以完成見證審判的目的，不需要觀看整個場景。

689130a242b3d608da04579ef409c9bf5cda5e40.source: After that, return to the Shining Blade camp to witness Livia Recruits Zinn. Once the dialogue is complete, then head to the Lion's Arch Keep and talk to Salma to finish the quest.
689130a242b3d608da04579ef409c9bf5cda5e40.text: 之後，返回光刃營地，見證莉薇亞招募Zinn。對話完成後，前往 獅子拱門要塞 並與薩爾瑪交談以完成任務。

914b067f1c09a234ce7754a6d87b87f539e65e40.source: After reporting, Livia, Zinn and Blimm will walk towards the future site of the Secret River Passage, which will appear the next time the player enters this map.
914b067f1c09a234ce7754a6d87b87f539e65e40.text: 報告後，莉薇亞、Zinn 和 布林姆 將走向秘密河流通道的未來地點，該地點將在玩家下次進入地圖時出現。

e207ae4c40aa524982e87429d254fa74b0699207.source: Tell Orozar that you are ready to defend King Jalis and his camp.
e207ae4c40aa524982e87429d254fa74b0699207.text: 告訴奧羅扎爾，你已準備好保衛賈利斯國王和他的營地。

783c33e6610621a307591d76b9cba8f23969a384.source: Ask Orozar when Ural will arrive.
783c33e6610621a307591d76b9cba8f23969a384.text: 詢問 Orozar 烏拉爾何時到達。

f21bddc84c5e7b6360d1a32c0aff01c1fe490c6c.source: Defend King Jalis's camp from the attacking Stone Summit forces.
f21bddc84c5e7b6360d1a32c0aff01c1fe490c6c.text: 保衛賈利斯國王的營地免受 石峰矮人 部隊的攻擊。

2768115311f40f0e7807ebf1523523c8bf5ac8f0.source: See Orozar Highstone for your reward.
2768115311f40f0e7807ebf1523523c8bf5ac8f0.text: 請參閱 奧羅薩高石 以取得獎勵。

52bf5f8b9778bdd0e6b025c2673c8033f94912e5.source: Speak with Orozar, and Ural Highstone will come down warning of the impending attack. Shortly after, four waves of Stone Summit will attack from the north, east, and south (for a total of 12 waves). In the last waves, you will encounter the Taskmasters Nard, Beld, and Larn. The final attack is led by Marln Steelfist. The Deldrimor dwarves will assist you in this fight, and they have some ability to resurrect each other, but they will likely take heavy losses from attrition.
52bf5f8b9778bdd0e6b025c2673c8033f94912e5.text: 與奧羅扎爾交談，烏拉爾海斯通將會警告即將到來的襲擊。不久後，四波 石峰矮人 將從北、東、南攻擊（總共有 12 波）。在最後幾波中，您將遇到監工納爾德、貝爾德和拉恩。最後的進攻由馬恩·鋼拳領導。 戴爾狄摩 矮人將在這場戰鬥中協助你，他們有一定的能力互相復活，但他們很可能會因消耗而遭受重大損失。

683f50eee65761f7b3995ba1c109d3953a1f15b6.source: Like the allies you get in dungeons, Ural Highstone, Orozar Highstone, Telzar Ironjaw and Jalis Ironhammer all self-resurrect once there are no enemies within their aggro radius, but High Priest Alkar self-resurrects even if there is an enemy near him which makes the necromancer enemies get more minions. This means that they can effectively delay enemy waves for a very long time. Therefore, it's best to focus on the waves coming from one particular direction until they have all been killed, then move to another direction.
683f50eee65761f7b3995ba1c109d3953a1f15b6.text: 就像你在地下城中獲得的盟友一樣，烏拉爾·海斯通、奧羅薩高石、特爾扎爾·鐵顎和賈利斯·鐵錘在其仇恨半徑內沒有敵人時都會自我復活，但 高等祭司 阿爾卡 即使附近有敵人也會自我復活，這使得死靈法師的敵人獲得更多的小兵。這意味著它們可以有效地長時間拖延敵人的攻擊波。因此，最好專注於從一個特定方向傳來的波浪，直到它們全部被消滅，然後移動到另一個方向。

a7f6cc3828b79004c52d8337de47c639c27dd613.source: Note that only Marln Steelfist's group needs to be killed for the quest to be completed. Once his group is dead, you will be returned to the Battledepths map after a brief countdown, even if there are still other Stone Summit dwarves still alive and attacking the camp.
a7f6cc3828b79004c52d8337de47c639c27dd613.text: 請注意，只有馬恩·鋼拳的隊伍需要被殺死才能完成任務。一旦他的隊伍死亡，即使有其他 石峰矮人 矮人仍然活著並攻擊營地，您也會在短暫的倒數計時後返回 戰鬥深淵 地圖。

d962991633b3dead71823803f4b991ee743cf66d.source: Another good trick to use is to have someone in your party bring Verata's Aura. The Stone Summit Gnashers generally summon 20~30 minions.
d962991633b3dead71823803f4b991ee743cf66d.text: 另一個好技巧是讓你的隊伍中有人帶上 芙瑞達的靈氣。 石峰矮人 咬咬者通常會召喚 20~30 小兵。

ff1cc83b0df9defc229494d48383fa65a4c5ef3a.source: No NPCs need to be protected. Jalis Ironhammer can be killed. If he comes close to dying, he regains a significant amount of health but he can die after a while. Ural Highstone can be attacked and killed, but this has no effect on his death by Marln Steelfist in a scripted event at the end of the quest. Orozar Highstone seems to have extremely high health, armor and regeneration, and the quest will not fail if he is killed. All other dwarves can be killed by the Stone Summit.
ff1cc83b0df9defc229494d48383fa65a4c5ef3a.text: 不需要保護 NPC。賈利斯·鐵鎚可以被殺死。如果他接近死亡，他會恢復大量健康，但一段時間後他可能會死亡。烏拉爾·海斯通可以被攻擊並殺死，但這對他在任務結束時被馬恩·鋼拳殺死的指令碼事件沒有影響。 奧羅薩高石似乎擁有極高的生命值、護甲和再生能力，即使他被殺，任務也不會失敗。所有其他矮人都可以被 石峰矮人 殺死。

d6678124627a72b7363e8d243564f45d9fb265ce.source: After finding the embedded arrowhead consult the scrying pool In the Hall of Monuments. Get Keiran's Bow from Gwen, equip the bow, and consult the scrying pool, select "Show me the story of the arrowhead". You will be transported to Watchtower Coast and will be under the effect of Keiran Thackeray (disguise) for the duration of this quest.
d6678124627a72b7363e8d243564f45d9fb265ce.text: 找到嵌入的箭頭後，請查閱 史蹟殿堂 中的占卜池。從關中取得凱蘭的弓，裝備弓，並查閱占卜池，選擇「向我展示箭頭的故事」。您將被傳送到 瞭望塔海岸，並在此任務期間受到凱蘭·薩克雷（偽裝）的影響。

a922b04e56fcceeacdeae79d4a2714d649035c3c.source: Follow the path towards Divinity Coast to find Danthor the Adamant.
a922b04e56fcceeacdeae79d4a2714d649035c3c.text: 沿著通往 神聖海岸 的道路尋找堅定的丹托爾。

8ba46a094dc3ffa1daa0adbf907801acba06df7b.source: Use Keiran's Sniper Shot against targets called out by Miku, which causes a fatal amount of damage if it hits (unless Miku's Promise of Death is removed).
8ba46a094dc3ffa1daa0adbf907801acba06df7b.text: 使用 Keiran 的狙擊射擊攻擊 Miku 召喚的目標，如果擊中目標，會造成致命傷害（除非 Miku 的死亡承諾被移除）。

ad4b531f140b9ffdbde44dcb8fcd32c55deee152.source: Until she does so, it is more efficient to concentrate on far-away targets; Miku targets the nearest ones, which you will be able to instantly kill with the sniper shot.
ad4b531f140b9ffdbde44dcb8fcd32c55deee152.text: 在她這樣做之前，專注於遠處的目標會更有效率； Miku 瞄準最近的敵人，你可以用狙擊槍立即殺死它們。

b6f499076051bae57a8b3d6a8ee586379f9702b4.source: Miku's aggro range is smaller than Keiran's, so pull targets and retreat slightly so that she will engage foes more quickly.
b6f499076051bae57a8b3d6a8ee586379f9702b4.text: Miku 的仇恨範圍比 Keiran 的小，所以拉動目標並稍微後退，這樣她就能更快地與敵人交戰。

73b4c20ccb2038b9825755f2b9e80de4bb787a86.source: If Miku dies, she will self-resurrect after a short period of time.
73b4c20ccb2038b9825755f2b9e80de4bb787a86.text: 如果Miku死亡，她會在短時間內復活。

36749d528f1a48f74326047c5748b96b31604f2c.source: Several of the foe groups can be avoided by leaving the patrolled path and taking a detour over the hills.
36749d528f1a48f74326047c5748b96b31604f2c.text: 離開巡邏路線並繞道翻過山丘可以避開幾個敵人群體。

fa34fb8d5072efea803f7c7c945cbffcbf003ba0.source: This quest is automatically obtained upon entering Watchtower Coast (via the Scrying Pool), and is removed should one leave.
fa34fb8d5072efea803f7c7c945cbffcbf003ba0.text: 該任務在進入 瞭望塔海岸（透過占卜池）後自動獲得，一旦離開就會被刪除。

b9b0904a0b4783dd8cca4150d9dcaaa19863d066.source: Rewards are placed automatically into inventory. If your inventory is full, it will be dropped on the ground. With the short time until next mission, make sure you have an inventory slot available.
b9b0904a0b4783dd8cca4150d9dcaaa19863d066.text: 任務獎勵 會自動放入庫存。如果你的庫存已滿，它就會掉在地上。由於距離下一次任務的時間很短，請確保您有可用的庫存位置。

c958abf3835a123e5987789893b709dd9d7b8922.source: While you must equip Keiran's Bow to access this mission, you can switch it out for another weapon, including a long- or flatbow for pulling and especially one that has weapon upgrades appropriate to Keiran's skills. However, you cannot increase his maximum health, energy, or total attributes using weapon or armor upgrades.
c958abf3835a123e5987789893b709dd9d7b8922.text: 雖然您必須裝備 Keiran 的 弓 才能執行此任務，但您可以將其換成另一種武器，包括用於拉動的長弓或扁弓，尤其是具有適合 Keiran 技能的武器升級的武器。但是，您無法使用武器或護甲升級來增加他的最大生命值、能量或總屬性。

9ef140b8ed895ddb8c70cb9f07974b398d612159.source: You cannot zone into Divinity Coast during this quest.
9ef140b8ed895ddb8c70cb9f07974b398d612159.text: 在這個任務中你不能進入神聖海岸。

b0a0ae4692510e3af0108ab48624d7dc023094ea.source: A tutorial to complete quest in 5 minutes can be found here.
b0a0ae4692510e3af0108ab48624d7dc023094ea.text: 您可以在此處找到在 5 分鐘內完成任務的教學課程。

c4a45f39f25a221dc5c8f1ce08e7e268d4ff9b62.source: Sometimes Gwen endlessly repeats the last dialogue in the Hall of Monuments.
c4a45f39f25a221dc5c8f1ce08e7e268d4ff9b62.text: 有時，關 會無止盡地重複 史蹟殿堂 中的最後一個對話。

a20da3985f81f472d7db049cb16609167d34b9a4.source: If you fail the mission by swapping out Keiran's Bow too soon, the game incorrectly states you must equip Togo's Staff to play the mission.
a20da3985f81f472d7db049cb16609167d34b9a4.text: 如果您過早更換 Keiran 的 弓，導致任務失敗，遊戲會錯誤地指出您必須裝備 Togo 的 法杖 才能執行任務。

5ce68af87457169088f6412f5f9f8b3393a7a986.source: Spirits and pets do not turn hostile in the final battle, even those summoned after enemies turn hostile.
5ce68af87457169088f6412f5f9f8b3393a7a986.text: 靈魂和寵物在最終戰鬥中不會變得敵對，即使是敵人變得敵對後召喚的那些。

cc94133fe4f38a6c003ceaa2c22cc7a979da17c4.source: Alternatively, the player could start at the Gate of Secrets, if that outpost has already been reached. This significantly shortens the distance and decreases the number of enemies that must be killed to reach the Fortune Teller.
cc94133fe4f38a6c003ceaa2c22cc7a979da17c4.text: 或者，如果已經到達該前哨，玩家可以從秘密之門開始。這顯著縮短了距離並減少了到達算命師所需殺死的敵人數量。

44a1e2d576a63a3c26ac0ed6e190099d1d27393d.source: Marln Steelfist will spawn when the last southern wave (containing Taskmaster Nard) has been defeated. It is recommended that you clear all northern waves before that, otherwise Marln's group will gang together with the group of Taskmastern Larn (also from the north). The resulting mob is quite large and can easily kill the party.
44a1e2d576a63a3c26ac0ed6e190099d1d27393d.text: 當最後一波南方浪潮（包括模仿大師納爾德）被擊敗時，馬恩·鋼拳將會出現。建議在此之前清理掉所有北方的波浪，否則Marln的隊伍會和模仿大師Larn的隊伍（同樣來自北方）結夥。由此產生的暴徒數量相當大，可以輕鬆殺死隊伍。

4728b21998b7fb4368a9a981d61f9cfb48e011d1.source: Destroy the forces marching on Gyala Hatchery. You have [9...0] groups remaining.
4728b21998b7fb4368a9a981d61f9cfb48e011d1.text: 消滅在 蓋拉孵化所 上行進的部隊。您還剩下 [9...0] 組。

38c56ad4f36a24e1f8b31d7af2eabad162352406.source: See Captain Juno for your reward.
38c56ad4f36a24e1f8b31d7af2eabad162352406.text: 去找朱諾船長領取獎勵。

a4f6eb7dd11aacc89550f43ac066c4dd9f2496e5.source: Despite its name, this quest is really about defending the portal into Gyala Hatchery. All of the Kurzick attackers are heading toward the portal.
a4f6eb7dd11aacc89550f43ac066c4dd9f2496e5.text: 儘管它的名字如此，這個任務實際上是為了保衛 蓋拉孵化所 的門戶。所有 庫茲柯 攻擊者都朝著門戶前進。

c19bf6e70b370a8204325ab8bfeea58ab467cd2d.source: The first quest objective is to find Khim who is in the Maishang Hills, just outside of the Gyala Hatchery portal. He is so close to the portal that it might not be immediately obvious that you are not being directed back into the outpost. Provided you have access to it, Gyala Hatchery is the best starting location. Otherwise, Eredon Terrace is the next closest location.
c19bf6e70b370a8204325ab8bfeea58ab467cd2d.text: 第一個任務目標是找到位於 麥尚山丘 中的 Khim，就在 蓋拉孵化所 入口網站外。他離傳送門太近了，你可能不會立即意識到你沒有被引導回前哨站。如果您有權存取它，蓋拉孵化所 是最好的起始位置。否則，爾雷登平地 是下一個最近的位置。

9f1a4685589f323d109a1ea237a939f047bf4f2d.source: Advancing the quest further requires speaking to Khim. Besides answering you, Khim runs off to the west. Your quest destination star is set at Khim's new location. Joining him there will start the waves of Kurzick attackers; however, do not remain at this spot. Move half the distance back toward the resurrection shrine. This will place you outside of immediate aggro range of incoming waves of attackers from either direction.
9f1a4685589f323d109a1ea237a939f047bf4f2d.text: 進一步推進任務需要與 Kim 交談。除了回答你之外，Khim 還往西跑去。你的任務目的地星星已設定在 Kim 的新位置。加入他的行列將引發 庫茲柯 攻擊者的浪潮；但是，不要停留在這個地方。向復活神殿後退一半距離。這將使您處於來自任一方向的攻擊者的直接仇恨範圍之外。

cf0e79878876a39266ced01cf99b83d116a4b4cc.source: Each wave, alternately attacking from the west and northeast, usually consists of at least four foes with a monk or ritualist. Having defeated one group, run to the next group and kill them off. Keep doing this until you have defeated all nine groups of foes. One of the western groups will include two Kurzick Juggernauts and the final wave will have foes attacking from both sides along with General Kaimer Vasburg.
cf0e79878876a39266ced01cf99b83d116a4b4cc.text: 每波從西邊和東北邊交替攻擊，通常由至少四個敵人和一名僧侶或儀式者組成。擊敗一組後，跑到下一組並殺死他們。繼續這樣做，直到你擊敗所有九組敵人。其中一支西方隊伍將包括兩名 庫茲柯 主宰，最後一波敵人將與凱默·瓦斯伯格將軍一起從兩側發動攻擊。

2be767c0b98ed3d269507bc90d3185743bdd72dd.source: After all the Kurzicks are defeated return to Cavalon to obtain your reward.
2be767c0b98ed3d269507bc90d3185743bdd72dd.text: 擊敗所有 Kurzick 後，返回 卡瓦隆 獲取獎勵。

3223bff9d2cbc9ccfaf7c87563bc3de272c5aa6e.source: Despite the arrows pointing away, it is best to stay by the shrine as Kurzicks will come from both sides.
3223bff9d2cbc9ccfaf7c87563bc3de272c5aa6e.text: 儘管箭頭指向遠處，但最好還是留在神社附近，因為庫茲克人會從兩邊湧來。

e21950109c4f6b68f424db04ef25e7828030efa2.source: You may wish to accept this quest but not complete it so that it is active in your quest log while you perform the quest Stolen Eggs. This will prevent the final boss Stsou Swiftscale from spawning making the run to your destination a bit easier.
e21950109c4f6b68f424db04ef25e7828030efa2.text: 您可能希望接受此任務但不完成它，以便在您執行“偷來的雞蛋”任務時它會在您的任務日誌中處於活動狀態。這將防止最終 Boss Stsou Swiftscale 生成，從而使您更容易到達目的地。

39cfdb0c9e9c7f21ff23ec5731d64d0ad4c079f0.source: Even if you already completed this quest, when you re-enter Maishang Hills without accepting the reward, the quest log resets and you will have to complete it again.
39cfdb0c9e9c7f21ff23ec5731d64d0ad4c079f0.text: 即使您已經完成了此任務，當您在未接受獎勵的情況下重新進入 麥尚山丘 時，任務日誌將重置，您將必須再次完成該任務。

568b37720880bb93acfaab5a0260b4aee91a8954.source: Defeat your Doppelganger at Augury Rock.
568b37720880bb93acfaab5a0260b4aee91a8954.text: 在 占卜之石 擊敗你的分身。

6d54aa66de4187d7399930d4f185423ada107610.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 10 minutes (2 minutes in Hard Mode).
6d54aa66de4187d7399930d4f185423ada107610.text: *獎勵* 在 10 分鐘內完成任務（困難模式為 2 分鐘）。

7d8865105c6aab80d75c6852da5487f1e0b28a06.source: Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
7d8865105c6aab80d75c6852da5487f1e0b28a06.text: 完成第一個*獎勵* 任務目標 可獲得額外的 30 Zaishen 銅幣。

5eaba8a0f2ef2772d71fdc8669307e7114d9b7af.source: Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.
5eaba8a0f2ef2772d71fdc8669307e7114d9b7af.text: 完成第二個*獎勵* 任務目標 可獲得額外的 50 Zaishen 銅幣。

5144096a3c9ac6f6222f9230c808a53009dd2aea.source: As per the Augury Rock mission.
5144096a3c9ac6f6222f9230c808a53009dd2aea.text: 根據 占卜之石 任務。

ec91b005d5ddba21cbac3c6a82812c8f97466062.source: The mission doesn't need to be a success. Defeating the Doppelganger is enough to complete the quest; however, the first bonus is not satisfied if you die before the Doppelganger.
ec91b005d5ddba21cbac3c6a82812c8f97466062.text: 任務不需要成功。擊敗分身就足以完成任務；但是，如果您在分身之前死亡，則無法滿足第一個獎勵。

5bcc7977d52d870f9d13d103160193e02d40d245.source: Attune to and use the Henge Portal in the Aurora Glade before the White Mantle can do the same.
5bcc7977d52d870f9d13d103160193e02d40d245.text: 在 白斗篷 執行相同操作之前，請在 歐若拉林地 中調諧並使用 丹拉維聖地傳送門。

042ce4aea4b86a6140723963b707c790196cc896.source: As per the Aurora Glade mission.
042ce4aea4b86a6140723963b707c790196cc896.text: 根據 歐若拉林地 任務。

a293f71a32a83ca5bb23fe59d4ac85ab50dbf9ef.source: Rescue Miku from the White Mantle.
a293f71a32a83ca5bb23fe59d4ac85ab50dbf9ef.text: 從 白斗篷 手中救出 Miku。

da8450a2b62be01176e914a6dbb03112504cec30.source: Although the Gate of Secrets is probably the closest starting point, this quest combines well with the Last Patrol to provide some much needed allies, in which case, it would have to be started from the Gate of Fear.
da8450a2b62be01176e914a6dbb03112504cec30.text: 雖然秘密之門可能是最近的起點，但這個任務與最後的巡邏很好地結合在一起，提供了一些急需的盟友，在這種情況下，它必須從恐懼之門開始。

ede1733ab2e28e7634bfecfb7057a33810d89e93.source: Clear the Bahdok Caverns in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
ede1733ab2e28e7634bfecfb7057a33810d89e93.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 巴多克洞穴。

3100f0b44d3abed5b7806ca72d9ef02da3155a1a.source: "Clear the Bahdok Caverns in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."
3100f0b44d3abed5b7806ca72d9ef02da3155a1a.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 巴多克洞穴。”

05ae7213619201914dc1c4d8e0ff7a5a9eeef7b9.source: Your character must have completed the Moddok Crevice mission to be able to enter this area. If entering from the Moddok Crevice mission outpost, talk to Gatekeeper Kahno to gain entry.
05ae7213619201914dc1c4d8e0ff7a5a9eeef7b9.text: 您的角色必須完成 摩多克裂縫 任務才能進入該區域。如果從 摩多克裂縫 任務前哨站進入，請與守門人卡諾交談以獲得進入權。

6bb804357ca8f7cce2adbb04938d0698e2396162.source: No quests take place here; entering this explorable area is completely optional.
6bb804357ca8f7cce2adbb04938d0698e2396162.text: 這裡沒有任務發生；進入這個可探索區域是完全可選的。

dea8f5168c93873eac5a632b6c34c242227ce85b.source: This area does not contribute to the Elonian Cartographer title track because it is considered underground (i.e. not uncovered on the world map).
dea8f5168c93873eac5a632b6c34c242227ce85b.text: 該區域對 Elonian 版圖 的主打歌沒有貢獻，因為它被認為是地下的（即在世界地圖上沒有被發現）。

972ff935436aecb061b6b42341de2ec71c53a011.source: There are several hidden groups of mandragors in the northeastern portion of the area. It is advised to start from Wehhan Terraces and work your way through the foes counter-clockwise to avoid popups.
972ff935436aecb061b6b42341de2ec71c53a011.text: 該地區的東北部有幾個隱藏的曼德拉草群。建議從 薇恩平臺 開始，逆時針穿過敵人以避免彈出視窗。

69c2c4e0f0182cb0c1ba67c971e5167ef4391503.source: The mandragor boss, Joknang Earthturner, appears to be alone, however upon approaching him several mandragors will spawn. If you approach slowly, there is a chance that only half the mandragors will spawn.
69c2c4e0f0182cb0c1ba67c971e5167ef4391503.text: 曼陀羅 Boss 喬克南·大地翻者 (Joknang Earthturner) 看起來很孤獨，但當他接近他時，就會出現幾隻曼陀羅。如果你慢慢靠近，有可能只會生成一半的曼德拉草。

4634eaf4dc036af6a6bbd9f5f6ab571e6ff3f2de.source: The sole Skale group in the area is led by Armind the Balancer. Before taking them on, take note of the nearby heket groups. At least two small heket groups have patrol paths that go very near the large Skale group.
4634eaf4dc036af6a6bbd9f5f6ab571e6ff3f2de.text: 該地區唯一的 鱗怪 小組由平衡者 Armind 領導。在與他們較量之前，請注意附近的赫克特團體。至少有兩個小型 Heket 小組的巡邏路徑非常靠近大型 鱗怪 小組。

0ccb5a31fcaf7463773229c7d1de6f419d694d3d.source: Recover the Ashford strongbox from the bandits.
0ccb5a31fcaf7463773229c7d1de6f419d694d3d.text: 從強盜手中奪回阿什福德保險箱。

469e48193ed145a8c4cff49fc6cd3c4202bdbadf.source: Return the strongbox to Devona in Ashford.
469e48193ed145a8c4cff49fc6cd3c4202bdbadf.text: 影返 位於阿什福德的 德佛娜 保險箱。

767d5de8769af39eaeec3d13d89368830d17d8bb.text: 巨盾（石峰矮人 盾 皮膚）

eadce739112190181a925ae61258b32ef65393ce.source: The quickest route to the strongbox is from Ashford Abbey. Head across the worm-infested farmland until you reach a bandit camp marked by a campfire and crates. You do not need to clear the entire area; while there are Bandit Raiders and Bandit Firestarters in the vicinity, only the Bandit Blood Sworn surrounding the strongbox are immediately hostile. Be careful not to aggro too many bandits at once, especially the Firestarters, whose ability to use Flare can be deadly to lower level characters. After defeating the foes, pick up the strongbox and take it to Devona for your reward.
eadce739112190181a925ae61258b32ef65393ce.text: 前往保險箱的最快路線是從 灰色淺灘修道院。穿過蠕蟲出沒的農田，直到到達一個有篝火和板條箱的強盜營地。您不需要清理整個區域；雖然附近有Bandit Raiders和Bandit Firestarters，但只有保險箱周圍的血咒強盜立即具有敵意。小心不要同時招惹太多強盜，尤其是 Firestarters，他們使用 火花 的能力對於低等級角色來說可能是致命的。擊敗敵人後，拿起保險箱並將其帶到 德佛娜 以獲得獎勵。

8b63eec7d409f8d133b15248e90700cd4d71578b.source: Sometimes a Wolf will attack the Bandit Firestarters and a long fight will start. It's safe to go up close and watch, because the Wolf will be busy and the Firestarters won't attack you unless you start a fight with them. You can even walk right up to them with the strongbox and they won't do anything.
8b63eec7d409f8d133b15248e90700cd4d71578b.text: 有時，狼 會攻擊 Bandit Firestarters，一場漫長的戰鬥就會開始。近距離觀察是安全的，因為 狼 會很忙，除非您與 Firestarters 開始戰鬥，否則 Firestarters 不會攻擊您。你甚至可以拿著保險箱走到他們面前，他們也不會做任何事。

b52a2f230c531b2d3e08d37c8106cea4274faefc.source: Higher level characters (particularly Elementalists with Fire Storm) can farm this quest for dyes and/or Worn Belts.
b52a2f230c531b2d3e08d37c8106cea4274faefc.text: 更高階別的角色（特別是具有 火焰風暴 的元素主義者）可以進行此任務以獲得染料和/或磨損的腰帶。

c7e332a030f5778c69f193ce3a7fa44c34806e48.source: Tell Mantle Knight Karriya of Miraba's bandit problem.
c7e332a030f5778c69f193ce3a7fa44c34806e48.text: 將 米拉芭 的強盜問題告訴地幔騎士卡里亞。

0df2d59f927f57f5792b8e54b6b61e278e54652e.source: Deliver the Token of Janthir to Miraba.
0df2d59f927f57f5792b8e54b6b61e278e54652e.text: 將 Janthir 的令牌交付給 米拉芭。

9f0f43f6b6f789d2a6f032519bb46a2a37f50456.text: 防禦 +5（而 體力 低於 50%）

9c5f9fa09705b042ebe1b2ef585b9fad31f8a042.source: Map travel or walk to D'Alessio Seaboard and talk to Mantle Knight Karriya. He will give you a Token of Janthir for Miraba and promise to do something about the bandit problem. Deliver the token to Miraba to get your reward.
9c5f9fa09705b042ebe1b2ef585b9fad31f8a042.text: 地圖旅行或步行至 達雷西海濱 並與披肩騎士卡里亞交談。他會給你一個用於 米拉芭 的 Janthir 令牌，並承諾對強盜問題採取一些措施。將代幣交付給 米拉芭 以獲取獎勵。

895acb762f9a6425aacf54dc242e9b5abb1a88ef.source: When you reach the Centaur troops, two groups of Margonites will charge in (one from either side of the mound). Each group contains eight Margonites: two Margonite Clerics, two Margonite Seers, two Margonite Executioners and two Margonite Reapers. Once a group is eliminated another will spawn immediately. There is a total of four waves: the first will have three groups of Margonites, as will the second. The third wave will have only two, both on the right. The fourth wave will have only one group on the left, with a Margonite Necromancer Boss. There are three spawn points, to the left, right and back of the mound next to the shrine. The three groups now meet at a gathering point in the middle.
895acb762f9a6425aacf54dc242e9b5abb1a88ef.text: 當您到達 半人馬 部隊時，兩組瑪貢尼特人將衝鋒（土丘兩側各一組）。每組包含八名瑪貢尼特：兩位 瑪骨奈 牧師、兩位 瑪骨奈 先知、兩位 瑪骨奈 劊子手和兩位 瑪骨奈 收割者。一旦一個群體被消滅，另一個群體就會立即產生。總共有四波：第一波將有三組瑪貢尼特，第二波也是如此。第三波只有兩個，都在右邊。第四波將只有左側一組，即 瑪骨奈 死靈法師 頭目。神殿旁的土丘的左側、右側和後方有三個生成點。現在，三組人在中間的一個集合點匯合。

adb70276ff645192e344ec0a6c19cb871236b862.source: Note: Moving to either side of the battlefield (i.e. not staying at the three-way focal point) allows a party to take out one group at a time. This still leaves a crowd of two groups at the focal point, but it's more manageable. There is a nearby resurrection shrine (on the north side of the mound).
adb70276ff645192e344ec0a6c19cb871236b862.text: 注意：移動到戰場的任一側（即不停留在三路焦點）允許一方一次消滅一組。這仍然使兩群人成為焦點，但更容易管理。附近有一個復活神社（在土丘的北側）。

39d2d9878cdb0ab14c747cdaf635958d120cd7cb.source: Since the Margonite groups tend to bunch up, area of effect skills are very useful.
39d2d9878cdb0ab14c747cdaf635958d120cd7cb.text: 由於 瑪骨奈 群體往往會聚集在一起，因此區域效果技能非常有用。

7e926851bb08151d6a4120fd8566b46c53fe153f.source: Lightbringer's Gaze, Panic and other interrupt skills to interrupt the Margonite Clerics' use of Spell Breaker and Aegis.
7e926851bb08151d6a4120fd8566b46c53fe153f.text: 光明使者的凝視、恐慌等打斷技能可以打斷瑪骨奈牧師對魔法粉碎和神賜之盾的使用。

9682ab65b27d62833d99a0f78ea85d8746857a0b.source: As there will be plenty of corpses to work with, a minion master (or two) will be enormously helpful.
9682ab65b27d62833d99a0f78ea85d8746857a0b.text: 由於需要處理大量屍體，一名（或兩名）隨從大師將會非常有幫助。

fcad9fdd40d9ab85606511f0536e80806c381277.source: Taking out the Clerics is crucial when the waves come.
fcad9fdd40d9ab85606511f0536e80806c381277.text: 當海浪來襲時，消滅牧師至關重要。

ee6e11470e761c2c22d64f79f0a6fcc3dd31448c.source: Mirza Veldrunner can die without affecting the success of this quest. If he dies, just rezone and turn it in.
ee6e11470e761c2c22d64f79f0a6fcc3dd31448c.text: 米爾扎·維德行者即使死亡也不會影響該任務的成功。如果他死了，只需重新分割槽並將其上交即可。

55ae8ed8f5df6f3f41bd5e1373709cbc2a232272.source: If a group doesn't come for some time, they may have become stuck behind a rock and need to be found.
55ae8ed8f5df6f3f41bd5e1373709cbc2a232272.text: 如果一群人有一段時間沒有來，他們可能被困在岩石後面，需要被發現。

b862c9594e33e2da917c4063bb652adba718f6a5.source: Kill Baubao Wavewrath in the Undercity.
b862c9594e33e2da917c4063bb652adba718f6a5.text: 在幽暗城殺死 怒浪 保博。

b3766c5b287bb6b7daa9692f38f9f0980f21e4f0.source: *BONUS* Kill Baubao Wavewrath in Hard Mode.
b3766c5b287bb6b7daa9692f38f9f0980f21e4f0.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 怒浪 保博。

3218d203664330c0adeb39b74baadc28e96316a9.source: The shortest route would be to enter the Undercity from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), if unlocked. There are plenty of Kappa surrounding Baubao who use Turtle Shell, so plan accordingly.
