3fb3b6a4dc271fc046110d48099af9a611aed3f4.source: If NPCs are aggroed, Mhenlo may say his second line before the Caravan Guard's answer. The initial dialogue plays even for non-Tyrian characters, who cannot accept the quest.
3fb3b6a4dc271fc046110d48099af9a611aed3f4.text: 如果 NPC 受到攻擊，涵洛 可能會在商隊守衛回答之前說出他的第二句話。最初的對話甚至適用於無法接受任務的非泰爾角色。

721ea8f1a5e44d3c6f2e6dc7c9b0aedf986b3186.text: 與農民 Xeng Jo 交談。

f810d4e87ab1eeaf3fa5e14ef3e45844cc041da9.source: Kneel and plant seeds in each of the farmer's fields.
f810d4e87ab1eeaf3fa5e14ef3e45844cc041da9.text: 跪下，在每一塊農田播種種子。

6a2e119d42d72791625bdd0b2364ac3c95b50e17.source: See Villager Hijai for your reward.
6a2e119d42d72791625bdd0b2364ac3c95b50e17.text: 去找村民 Hijai 領取獎勵。

e04ecac3e5eb8031c8964db6c2274c16290dd71e.source: This is a relatively simple quest involving no fighting, and takes only about 1-2 minutes.
e04ecac3e5eb8031c8964db6c2274c16290dd71e.text: 這是一個相對簡單的任務，不涉及戰鬥，只需大約 1-2 分鐘。

0d9c4ee9f108a2f47e5027a903e93adf82e79786.source: Use the emote /kneel to plant the seeds at each location.
0d9c4ee9f108a2f47e5027a903e93adf82e79786.text: 使用表情/跪在每個位置播種種子。

747e28859ca8a1ce834a28735ddc4f9c04e510d8.source: Similar to Study Buddy, if you completed the Zen Daijun mission with this quest in your Quest Log, you can go accept the reward even though the quest objectives do not display as being completed.
747e28859ca8a1ce834a28735ddc4f9c04e510d8.text: 與 Study Buddy 類似，如果您在 任務 日誌中完成了 禎臺郡 任務並包含此任務，則即使任務目標未顯示為已完成，您也可以接受獎勵。

2f0aacfbee7e31e18559fc897f9a4aa726dd87cf.source: Deliver the Casualty Report to Warmaster Tydus.
2f0aacfbee7e31e18559fc897f9a4aa726dd87cf.text: 將 傷亡報告 傳送到 戰鬥教官泰德。

2e5bf1c1bca159a44030906fe6df8bf88b057d5d.source: Return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.
2e5bf1c1bca159a44030906fe6df8bf88b057d5d.text: 影返 至 承辦者克題斯 以獲得獎勵。

ea5fd748652485a2274ab10ba03df793d894bbc1.source: Simply map travel to Ascalon City and talk to Warmaster Tydus, then return to Undertaker Cortis for your reward.
ea5fd748652485a2274ab10ba03df793d894bbc1.text: 只需將旅行對映到 阿斯卡隆城 並與 戰鬥教官泰德 交談，然後返回 承辦者克題斯 即可獲得獎勵。

fcd197e03352b2f7b8418842a935735eea7a4f9c.source: All professions can do this quest, but only necromancers get a skill as a reward.
fcd197e03352b2f7b8418842a935735eea7a4f9c.text: 所有職業都可以完成這個任務，但只有死靈法師才能獲得技能作為獎勵。

469d17f00ed4fb54ca93990ef8726361fa72dba6.source: This is a non-repeatable quest. If completed under any other profession(s), this skill reward will have to be acquired from a skill trainer.
469d17f00ed4fb54ca93990ef8726361fa72dba6.text: 這是一個不可重複的任務。如果在任何其他職業下完成，則必須從技能訓練師處獲得該技能獎勵。

6c00a7b5d4d99a9222a2c2759ebe4ee61b30264d.source: This quest continues the storyline of Fallen Soldiers, even though this quest can be completed before Fallen Soldiers.
6c00a7b5d4d99a9222a2c2759ebe4ee61b30264d.text: 該任務延續了陣亡士兵的故事情節，儘管該任務可以在陣亡士兵之前完成。

3880dfda2cf702915ee1f0defb319be1e019b740.source: You do not have to complete the dungeon to finish this quest. If you already have the quest item you can obtain the reward directly. This is useful for Survivors.
3880dfda2cf702915ee1f0defb319be1e019b740.text: 您不必完成地牢即可完成此任務。如果您已經擁有任務物品，則可以直接獲得獎勵。這對於倖存者來說很有用。

f879fb23b7231331693e35ad4be308c514cdf765.source: Find the Hamou Ukaiou and destroy it.

fd90f619dfba4b6374e16cf61e18c7fd6e6d7804.source: See Lendu the Fisherman for your reward.
fd90f619dfba4b6374e16cf61e18c7fd6e6d7804.text: 去找漁夫倫杜領取獎勵。

50457deba13b67c3e9839c940db12f176e00cfed.source: Lendu the Fisherman is near the center of Zehlon Reach. After getting the quest, locate Hamou Ukaiou in the waters almost directly north of Lendu. It is alone so it is not difficult to take it down, although you may want to make sure you have the skills to counter the poison condition. Be careful when fighting him, as the ranger boss, Ensign Lumi - who is level 19 and is accompanied by four level 10 Corsairs - can sometimes spawn nearby.
50457deba13b67c3e9839c940db12f176e00cfed.text: 漁夫倫杜 (Lendu the Fisherman) 位於澤隆河段 (Zehlon Reach) 中心附近。接到任務後，在倫杜以北的水域找到哈穆·烏凱歐。它是單獨的，因此將其取下並不困難，儘管您可能需要確保自己擁有對抗中毒狀態的技能。與他戰鬥時要小心，因為遊俠首領 Lumi 少尉（等級為 19，並伴隨著四名 10 海盜）有時會在附近生成。

3bdc75f414d758f1f0c49818a8b76b1d464ae44e.source: Lendu is good on his word to bury his friends, as two gravestones appear when you come back later next to the nearby town's southeastern bridge.
3bdc75f414d758f1f0c49818a8b76b1d464ae44e.text: 倫杜信守諾言，埋葬了他的朋友，當你稍後回來時，附近城鎮東南部的橋梁旁會出現兩塊墓碑。

56c8b34d15a676f0f80e3f581581778ed1da7782.source: If you read the graves it shows that the two people who died were husband and wife, though if you look at the two bodies lying around the Hamou Ukaiou, they are both male. Lendu also speaks of Shankulu as "her".
56c8b34d15a676f0f80e3f581581778ed1da7782.text: 如果你看墳墓，你會發現死者是夫妻，但如果你看哈莫烏凱王周圍的兩具屍體，他們都是男性。倫杜也稱山庫魯為「她」。

06cc457c0c1de0fa0555039771a1ff2374e1b590.source: This dungeon can only be entered via prompt in the required quest.
06cc457c0c1de0fa0555039771a1ff2374e1b590.text: 該地下城只能透過所需任務中的提示進入。

5748d4fde8bc8823907f3688d1b734b990b1d419.source: This is the only place where Golden Rin Relics and Diessa Chalices are dropped.
5748d4fde8bc8823907f3688d1b734b990b1d419.text: 這是唯一掉落金色 瑞恩 遺物和迪薩聖杯的地方。

ece97fbd4baad8dbcc485152565cb5b22d8171a9.source: Corpses of Charr can be found throughout all three levels.
ece97fbd4baad8dbcc485152565cb5b22d8171a9.text: 夏爾 的屍體遍佈所有三個關卡。

d380652bc6c60760af1a54ac211fe123f49b92ec.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #3 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
d380652bc6c60760af1a54ac211fe123f49b92ec.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#3 頁。

07c71c1f6c1f6f3a0e999f4f9e142ff797be288a.source: The Bone Fiends and Servant of Murakai in the final room are not vulnerable to skills that affect summoned creatures, even though they are identified as being summoned. There are several rare bugs that can prevent the party from completing the dungeon:
07c71c1f6c1f6f3a0e999f4f9e142ff797be288a.text: 最後一個房間中的骨魔和村凱僕人不會受到影響召喚生物的技能的影響，即使它們被識別為被召喚。有幾個罕見的錯誤可能會阻止隊伍完成地下城：

465390ccd1f5b0f6bb7ca73d124f268876a425ed.source: Level 1: The Keeper (and minions) can spawn behind the door to the next level, making them impossible to kill without enough ranged damage.
465390ccd1f5b0f6bb7ca73d124f268876a425ed.text: 1 關卡：守護者（和小兵）可以在下一關的門後生成，如果沒有足夠的遠端傷害，他們就無法被殺死。

56a5995bcbc78e5f79cdadf09249391755a65f3c.source: Level 3: If the Keymaster of Murakai is allowed to travel all the way back to its resting point, the dungeon key may drop over the edge of the lava stream, making it unreachable.
56a5995bcbc78e5f79cdadf09249391755a65f3c.text: 3 關卡：如果允許 Murakai 的鑰匙大師一路返回其休息點，地牢鑰匙可能會掉落到熔岩流的邊緣，使其無法到達。

fd2708bafcbabcde3ea6859f085eeee1a21dfcb0.source: Some foes do not consistently engage the party as expected:
fd2708bafcbabcde3ea6859f085eeee1a21dfcb0.text: 有些敵人並沒有像預期的那樣一致地與隊伍交戰：

4586db39cfe8fb18a906801f5256cf0246cf52ee.source: The group of Charr near the area map may get stuck in the wall.
4586db39cfe8fb18a906801f5256cf0246cf52ee.text: 區域地圖附近的 夏爾 群組可能會被卡在牆上。

eb392786d93ad7c140e3f0abfa17f029f8d6cd68.source: Leaving Faze Magekiller just out of the Danger Zone will leave him friendly and his group will attack him.
eb392786d93ad7c140e3f0abfa17f029f8d6cd68.text: 將 Faze Magkilliller 留在危險區域之外將使他變得友好，他的團隊將攻擊他。

45c8c582f71dbe816dbf1485fd07b85724cfb357.source: After The Keeper is defeated, the mobs that subsequently spawn do not attack unless engaged, even if they are inside the aggro bubble.
45c8c582f71dbe816dbf1485fd07b85724cfb357.text: 守護者被擊敗後，隨後生成的小怪除非交戰，否則不會攻擊，即使它們位於仇恨氣泡內。

54c8b5faf40f06522ad9172adb4106f87fc23b5b.source: Leaving Tyndir Flamecaller just out of the Danger Zone will leave him friendly and his group will attack him.
54c8b5faf40f06522ad9172adb4106f87fc23b5b.text: 將廷迪爾·喚火者留在危險區域之外將使他變得友好，他的團隊將攻擊他。

004a489b5c450d79a34543fabab3c9b63f9c5d0a.source: The Master and his minions sometimes spawn behind the door to the third level, making them harder to kill.
004a489b5c450d79a34543fabab3c9b63f9c5d0a.text: 大師和他的爪牙有時會在第三層的門後生成，使他們更難被殺死。

6c51a224c1737593badc4b1f648974b1434331ea.source: Despite being collectors, Dextarr Dirtdigger and Lars Bridgeater do not have [Collector] appended to their names, and do not appear on the mission map. There are graphical display errors when standing in certain parts of the room with Murakai.
6c51a224c1737593badc4b1f648974b1434331ea.text: 儘管是收藏家，Dextarr Dirtdigger 和 Lars Bridgeater 的名字後並沒有 [收藏家]，也沒有出現在任務地圖上。與村井一起站在房間的某些部分時，會出現圖形顯示錯誤。

11bc695b2038352a2c80661931043a0d5040cd34.source: The Temple of the Damned features the Cathedral of Flames with a heavy population of undead, Enchanted weapons, and Charr.
11bc695b2038352a2c80661931043a0d5040cd34.text: 詛咒神殿擁有大量不死生物的 火焰大教堂、附魔 武器和 夏爾。

feb7c467d1c1e5b3e7dc9fc6d9ac5c9716e49a26.source: The first level is straight forward. Kill Faze Magekiller to obtain the dungeon key, open the door and proceed to the next area. The Keeper and his group of restless spirits are in that area. Killing The Keeper opens the door to the next level.
feb7c467d1c1e5b3e7dc9fc6d9ac5c9716e49a26.text: 第一級是直接的。殺死法茲法師取得地牢鑰匙，開啟門前往下一個區域。守護者和他那群不安分的靈魂就在那個區域。殺死守護者將開啟通往下一關的大門。

535d4f4445ccdee69b5577fe48b09f0c537ea30e.source: If you do not have the required quest, you cannot advance beyond the door on the first level before the first collector near the Torn Cloth.
535d4f4445ccdee69b5577fe48b09f0c537ea30e.text: 如果您沒有所需的任務，則無法在撕裂布附近的第一個收集者之前超越第一層的門。

27f73655d9b57b024d6e703cebc12671b86e869a.source: Killing a Becalmed Djinn on level 3 will cause a number of hidden monsters to spawn.
27f73655d9b57b024d6e703cebc12671b86e869a.text: 在 3 級殺死平靜的 巨靈怪 會導致大量隱藏的怪物產生。

f6fdc3808aae02926484c5031718972a124a905e.source: Fire Jet and Fire Dart turrets can be disabled by killing the Flame Guardians.
f6fdc3808aae02926484c5031718972a124a905e.text: 殺死火焰守護者可以使火焰噴射器和火焰鏢砲塔失效。

e7e85c013f3439027a64e3a216b8682f69863ea1.source: This dungeon has many foes that are not fleshy.
e7e85c013f3439027a64e3a216b8682f69863ea1.text: 這個地下城有很多非肉身的敵人。

f61d8e1898a246b34b3a0b8eeec0312bb1a4703d.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #1 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
f61d8e1898a246b34b3a0b8eeec0312bb1a4703d.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#1 頁。

1302ca2da39ded82f42665d986d8605e1f56afde.source: Roaring Ethers sometimes spawn inside a wall and walk through a wall in level 2 and get stuck.
1302ca2da39ded82f42665d986d8605e1f56afde.text: 咆哮的以太有時會在牆內生成，並在 2 關卡中穿過牆壁並被卡住。

3efa98efc5f9b0bf760c1b507bebf250c0e6d459.source: The main issues with this dungeon are the groups of Elementals, bring spell caster shutdown and spread out when facing them.
3efa98efc5f9b0bf760c1b507bebf250c0e6d459.text: 這個地下城的主要問題是元素群體，在面對他們時會導致施法者關閉並分散開來。

8b1b59f5a5c87128f7d6f218aacb6ae35b53bace.source: Go north through the tunnel and head left through the flame traps, then proceed northwest. You need to kill the Infernal Siege Wurm in the trench for the Dungeon Key - casters and ranged attacks can reach it from the cliffs east of the wurm, but you will have to venture into the pit to pick up the key (be wary of flame traps). Head west for the dungeon gate and to the portal to level 2.
8b1b59f5a5c87128f7d6f218aacb6ae35b53bace.text: 向北穿過隧道，向左穿過火焰陷阱，然後向西北前進。你需要殺死戰壕中的地獄圍攻地蟲以獲得地監 鑰匙 - 施法者和遠端攻擊可以從亞龍東面的懸崖到達它，但你必須冒險進入坑中拿起鑰匙（小心火焰陷阱）。向西前往地牢門和傳送門，到達 2 關卡。

36cbb56ed813fb4ffc93528eb7fe24d8837c2b11.source: Kill the southern Regent of Flame to obtain the Dungeon Key. The southern route is shorter and poses fewer problems for melee characters as there are fewer burning surfaces. After unlocking the gate be wary of the burrowing Infernal Wurm.
36cbb56ed813fb4ffc93528eb7fe24d8837c2b11.text: 殺死南部的火焰攝政王以獲得 地監 鑰匙。南部路線較短，由於燃燒表面較少，因此對近戰角色造成的問題較少。開啟大門後，請小心挖洞的地獄火 地蟲。

75df081c22248acf21aa78a05f6ddeccc6d8dbb6.source: If you kill the Becalmed Djinn then the spiders will patrol super-fast around the room, in addition to procuring at least one additional spider group. After clearing the spiders out, head for the gate - just as you reach the gate a Flame Djinn will appear.
75df081c22248acf21aa78a05f6ddeccc6d8dbb6.text: 如果你殺死 Becalmed 巨靈怪，那麼蜘蛛除了獲得至少一組額外的蜘蛛之外，還會在房間裡超快地巡邏。清除蜘蛛後，前往大門 - 當您到達大門時，將會出現火焰 巨靈怪。

ffbf2677c4ab69209d68f0143b8b6dd7a5a11c53.source: Stand your group close to the Djinn when fighting it, as this will lower the damage inflicted by Consuming Flames (equip heroes with melee weapons) and also the amount the Djinn is healed by. Pain Inverter and knock downs are particularly effective. Unlock the gate with the key it drops. Carefully cross the Elemental infested area, heading left when in the room with the bridges and multiple Wurms.
ffbf2677c4ab69209d68f0143b8b6dd7a5a11c53.text: 與 巨靈怪 戰鬥時，讓你的隊伍靠近 巨靈怪，因為這會降低消耗火焰（為英雄配備近戰武器）造成的傷害以及 巨靈怪 的治療量。 苦痛 逆變器和擊倒特別有效。用掉落的鑰匙 解除 門。小心穿過 元素生物 出沒的區域，在有橋梁和多個亞龍的房間時向左走。

4f53ce446c577b7f971b41888ea2ccccf3ed561c.source: After aggroing Ilsundur, Lord of Fire, 2 lava boulders will appear: One lava boulder travels clockwise around the inner perimeter and the other counterclockwise around the outer perimeter, so flag heroes not engaged in melee in between. Like other boulders they will instantly kill a player (but will not inflict death penalty).
4f53ce446c577b7f971b41888ea2ccccf3ed561c.text: 攻擊 火之主 音喪多 後，會出現 2 熔岩巨石：一個熔岩巨石沿著內週順時針移動，另一個沿著外周逆時針移動，因此標記英雄在其間不參與近戰。與其他巨石一樣，它們會立即殺死玩家（但不會造成死刑）。

3133a6ad7f450c58ca43b7e73160e40a3837dfd9.source: Ilsundur has no natural health regeneration, so he can be worn down with patience if you are having problems. Note that Ilsundur uses Firebomb, which forces heroes, henchmen and even pets to hold a bundle. AI controlled allies will drop it immediately and cause area of effect damage. If you find yourself holding it, you should drop it away from any allies. Also, be mindful of the two lava boulders previously described.
3133a6ad7f450c58ca43b7e73160e40a3837dfd9.text: 伊爾桑杜爾沒有自然的生命再生能力，所以如果你遇到問題，他可以耐心地消耗掉。請注意，伊爾桑杜爾使用火焰炸彈，這會迫使英雄、追隨者甚至寵物拿著包裹。 AI控制的盟友會立即掉落它並造成範圍傷害。如果你發現自己拿著它，你應該把它從任何盟友手中扔掉。另外，請注意前面描述的兩個熔岩巨石。

2505a1ccb9320e8f88dff44eff26f92c9f6df4fb.source: It is highly recommended that when the dungeon has been completed, you wait for the timer to finish counting down so that you will be transported to Sacnoth Valley where you can claim your reward from Swithin Nye.
2505a1ccb9320e8f88dff44eff26f92c9f6df4fb.text: 強烈建議當地下城完成後，等待計時器倒數結束，這樣你就會被傳送到 聖諾谷，在那裡你可以從 Swithin Nye 那裡領取獎勵。

9828680654d3f94f891b7f91afb311e018168ef7.source: Caster shutdown - useful against the many Roaring Ethers, Burning Spirits and Flowstone Elementals.
9828680654d3f94f891b7f91afb311e018168ef7.text: 法師 關閉 - 對許多咆哮以太、燃燒之靈和流石元素有用。

33201363f8f1efae5724d07f19aacc9a718e0545.source: Pain Inverter or knock downs - useful against the Flame Djinn & Ilsundur.
33201363f8f1efae5724d07f19aacc9a718e0545.text: 苦痛 逆變器或擊倒 - 對於對抗火焰 巨靈怪 和 Ilsundur 很有用。

37153065233f6e4c8620109109fb5dcc86b8bbd9.source: There are not many corpses on levels 1 or 2, so minion masters won't be suitable.
37153065233f6e4c8620109109fb5dcc86b8bbd9.text: 1 或 2 關卡中的屍體不多，因此小兵大師不適合。

f7bdfeca5f749b7d1b8c4ed5cdcbe6f0fa32c486.source: On the second level there is a dungeon map to the south of the staircase. Tyndir Flamecaller guards the locked door on the east side of the level. Beyond that door, Vraxx the Condemned patrols with a group of Plague Zombies which can be easily pulled and dispatched. Next, carefully pull and clear the Enchanted and undead patrols around the edge of the chamber. Finally, defeat the Master to open the door to the next level.
f7bdfeca5f749b7d1b8c4ed5cdcbe6f0fa32c486.text: 第二層樓梯南邊有一張地牢地圖。廷迪爾·喚火者守護著關卡東側上鎖的門。在那扇門外，被判刑者 Vraxx 帶著一群瘟疫殭屍巡邏，可以輕鬆地拉動和消滅它們。接下來，小心地拉動並清除房間邊緣周圍的 附魔 和不死巡邏隊。最後，擊敗Master即可開啟下一關的大門。

9d0d12bf34d6c34d794c76a502a94d384af73b7c.source: Either quickly kill the Keymaster of Murakai, or follow it to the location of the dungeon floor map and kill it. The Keymaster will drop the dungeon key when slain. Proceed around the central chamber to the western side of the level. After unlocking the locked door, wait for the Murakai's Steward to finish speaking and slowly pull as many popups as possible from the room. Stay outside the range of the poison darts before killing the Steward and his group at the hill top. With his dungeon key backtrack to the first ramp and proceed north through a nearby tunnel which will take you to the northern side of the main chamber. Clear any undead along the way and run up the northern stairway to the boss door as fast as possible to minimize damage from the fire darts. It is not recommended to run through the center of the chamber as there are a lot more fire darts to contend with.
9d0d12bf34d6c34d794c76a502a94d384af73b7c.text: 要麼快速殺死村凱的鑰匙大師，要麼跟隨它到地下城地圖的位置並殺死它。鑰匙大師被殺後會掉落地城鑰匙。繞過中央房間到達關卡西側。開啟上鎖的門後，等待村凱的管家說完，慢慢地從房間裡拉出盡可能多的彈出視窗。在殺死山頂上的管家和他的團隊之前，請留在毒鏢的射程之外。使用地牢鑰匙原路返回第一個坡道，然後通過附近的隧道向北行駛，到達主室的北側。清除沿途的所有亡靈，並儘快從北邊的樓梯跑到 Boss 門，以盡量減少火鏢造成的傷害。不建議穿過房間的中心，因為有更多的火鏢需要處理。

7c7918fe16cd9d710e9fe28654f8553babcb68cb.source: In the boss room there are Plague Zombies and Bone Fiends that can be easily dispatched before battling with Murakai. When Murakai uses Murakai's Consumption her power meter fills up, which allows her to use Murakai's Storm of Souls. Interrupting Murakai's skills will prevent her from dealing much damage and she will die with only moderate pressure.
7c7918fe16cd9d710e9fe28654f8553babcb68cb.text: Boss 房間裡有瘟疫殭屍和骨魔，可以在與村凱戰鬥之前輕鬆消滅它們。當村凱使用村凱的消耗時，她的能量計會填滿，這使她能夠使用村凱的靈魂風暴。打斷村凱的技能將阻止她造成太多傷害，並且她只會在中等壓力下死亡。

41e80a22c28670126f86fd17a8f45518e66e4dc6.source: Murakai, Lady of the Night#Tips for defeating Murakai
41e80a22c28670126f86fd17a8f45518e66e4dc6.text: 夜之女 幕蘭凱#擊敗村凱的技巧

9513af570348fd29a5d0c0f02777eb287c260364.source: Minion masters are less useful in this dungeon as there are small numbers of exploitable corpses, and the undead can make short work of them using Ray of Judgment and Banishing Strike.
9513af570348fd29a5d0c0f02777eb287c260364.text: 在這個地牢中，小兵大師的用處不大，因為可利用的屍體數量很少，而不死生物可以使用 制裁目光 和 驅逐攻擊 快速解決它們。

fa14079cc74d27c484569af37a3444ccfc5781af.source: The Charr and the undead are hostile to each other and you can just let them fight each other.
fa14079cc74d27c484569af37a3444ccfc5781af.text: 夏爾 和不死族是敵對的，你可以讓他們互相戰鬥。

21c73799ae60b19b24b5ac85e4c9c8b84820dbfb.source: The Charr have high fire damage and the undead use powerful lightning spells, so pre-protting is crucial to mitigate massive amounts of damage.
21c73799ae60b19b24b5ac85e4c9c8b84820dbfb.text: 夏爾 具有很高的火焰傷害，而亡靈會使用強大的閃電法術，因此預先防護對於減輕大量傷害至關重要。

85b05fb12289bdbf5b3653435c3720ab32a932fe.source: Beware of the undead popups in this dungeon.
85b05fb12289bdbf5b3653435c3720ab32a932fe.text: 小心這個地牢中的不死彈出視窗。

fef0923858634d872a8a9cf5ba58bec03ef41089.source: Holy damage, such as from Light of Deldrimor, is very effective against the skeletons and zombies.
fef0923858634d872a8a9cf5ba58bec03ef41089.text: 神聖傷害，例如戴爾狄摩之光，對骷髏和殭屍非常有效。

492a0ee77715e802d6885974436c0ddcefe099e0.source: Poison Dart, Poison Jet or Poison Spout can hurt the enemy as well as you, so use flags and proceed carefully around them, and possibly pull enemies into these traps.
492a0ee77715e802d6885974436c0ddcefe099e0.text: 中毒 飛鏢、中毒 噴射或 中毒 噴射可以傷害敵人和您，因此使用旗幟並小心地繞過它們，並可能將敵人拉入這些陷阱。

efcc983f71069ef5063e08907c36b2d80107851b.source: After accepting the reward, you have to return to Doomlore Shrine first if you want to go for another run, or simply change to a different district.
efcc983f71069ef5063e08907c36b2d80107851b.text: 接受獎勵後，如果您想再跑一次，或者乾脆換個區，就必須先返回末日傳說神殿。

8a8e069a0e24e80ee1417d1c9cfccbe1a491d5cb.source: Journey with Zhed Shadowhoof to the Ancestor Tree in Turai's Procession.
8a8e069a0e24e80ee1417d1c9cfccbe1a491d5cb.text: 在 托雷長廊 中與 Zhed Shadowhoof 一起前往祖先樹。

07efb0031f64b1584aea6f5132804b755e585a31.source: After accepting the reward and until the completion of the following quest (Mirza's Last Stand), the Wandering Priest at the Resurrection Shrine nearest Mirza (that gives the Monster Hunt bounty) will not spawn and the Melandru's Watcher will also not spawn when kneeling at that Resurrection Shrine.
07efb0031f64b1584aea6f5132804b755e585a31.text: 接受獎勵後，直到完成以下任務（米爾扎的最後一站），距離米爾扎最近的 復活祭壇 處的流浪牧師（提供 怪物 狩獵賞金）將不會生成，並且當跪在該 復活祭壇 處時，梅蘭朵 的觀察者也不會生成。

4be4f11471cb9321f866d129ead6361d13f044df.source: Map travel to Venta Cemetery. Continue to Turai's Procession and speak with Mirza.
4be4f11471cb9321f866d129ead6361d13f044df.text: 地圖旅行到文塔公墓。繼續 托雷長廊 並與 Mirza 交談。

a0eddb7a3c0a8c365105a973c3a1f4811d68d034.source: Destroy the corsairs invading Chahbek Village.
a0eddb7a3c0a8c365105a973c3a1f4811d68d034.text: 消滅入侵恰貝克村的海盜。

dbb1fabbdb2e2230391f0876be902f390ff44385.text: *獎勵* 讓烈陽之矛新兵保持活力。

9320362d2e2f9e9c8464cccbc4079ed2350f96f5.source: As per the Chahbek Village mission.

fa00139d3ab109160f55f0aa7e361d042bfc840d.text: 擊敗遠古長老 納迦。

fbb674f1171307346a0d0942e3cd53d76a93cb9d.source: See Captain Elora for your reward.
fbb674f1171307346a0d0942e3cd53d76a93cb9d.text: 去找埃洛拉船長領取獎勵。

bc984135c6ea934752ad7f45fd85d17344e3a3a6.source: Start from Gyala Hatchery and head north into the Maishang Hills. The Ancient Elder Naga are located just outside the portal, immediately to the east of your starting location. You will have to fight one group of (Archaic) Kappa along the way.
bc984135c6ea934752ad7f45fd85d17344e3a3a6.text: 從 蓋拉孵化所 出發，往北進入 麥尚山丘。古代長老 納迦 位於傳送門外，緊鄰起始位置的東邊。一路上你將不得不與一群（古代）河童戰鬥。

c3ec4d066bd58a089798352cb201f746ebd5abb2.source: If you do not have access to the hatchery, start instead from Eredon Terrace and head due south, fighting several groups of monsters along the way, including the necro boss, Sessk, Woe Spreader. When you reach the coast, activate the resurrection shrine outside of Gyala Hatchery and then head east to the Elder Nagas.
c3ec4d066bd58a089798352cb201f746ebd5abb2.text: 如果您無法進入孵化場，請從 爾雷登平地 開始，向正南方前進，沿途與幾組怪物戰鬥，包括死靈 Boss、Sessk、災難散佈者。當您到達海岸時，啟動 蓋拉孵化所 外的復活神殿，然後向東前往長老納迦。

b87d5f5a34217d6768d9730f57f72653974e90d9.source: The Ancient Elder Naga is a category of Naga, composed of the Elder Naga Warrior, Archer, and Ritualist.
b87d5f5a34217d6768d9730f57f72653974e90d9.text: 古代長者 納迦 是 納迦 的類別，由長者 迦納戰士、射手傭兵 和 祭祀者 組成。

e726f56f17acef0f15ccd6b2d2fc7ed96a91feb5.source: Guild Wars Prophecies on the account
e726f56f17acef0f15ccd6b2d2fc7ed96a91feb5.text: 公會 帳號上的戰爭 阿斯卡隆戰記

59cc95bfb186a81bdd659a09c7d98122e9216951.source: Speak to Mhenlo at Bejunkan Pier.
59cc95bfb186a81bdd659a09c7d98122e9216951.text: 與 君瞰碼頭 處的 涵洛 交談。

22b3c7b41c78885c0f5cf2931dec38b5a0db06b6.source: Speak to Armian to book passage on the good ship Sea Swift, bound for Tyria.
22b3c7b41c78885c0f5cf2931dec38b5a0db06b6.text: 與阿米安交談，預訂前往 泰瑞亞 的好船 Sea 史威夫 的船票。

8187de1dfa980d409d594e43e6a1df2dce22667f.source: Speak to Lionguard Neiro in the foreign administration center and gain entrance to Lion's Arch and the lands of Kryta.
8187de1dfa980d409d594e43e6a1df2dce22667f.text: 與外國管理中心的獅子衛士內羅交談，以獲得 獅子拱門 和 科瑞塔 土地的入口。

def6fd791dcf890830ecbf21763b8cdc0acf1d25.source: Speak to Firstwatch Sergio, captain of the Lionguard, to inform him you have arrived in Lion's Arch.
def6fd791dcf890830ecbf21763b8cdc0acf1d25.text: 與獅衛隊隊長 警衛隊長薩吉歐 交談，告知他你已抵達 獅子拱門。

73e90b08d7bd017ea164d4205d0065f58004258e.source: Just follow the quest marker and talk with the relevant people. There is no fighting involved in this quest.
73e90b08d7bd017ea164d4205d0065f58004258e.text: 只需跟隨任務標記並與相關人員交談即可。此任務不涉及戰鬥。

bb4f20cb60ff47c1d0c10a767171c7e038cd4ef2.source: This quest unlocks Lions Arch port (once you have walked through the portal from Lion's Gate).
bb4f20cb60ff47c1d0c10a767171c7e038cd4ef2.text: 此任務解鎖獅子拱門埠（一旦您從 獅門 走過門戶）。

a3462f1a16904f640674cd172300775e2e616f44.source: Although Prophecies and Nightfall characters cannot obtain this quest, a Factions character can use this quest to ferry them to Lion's Arch.
a3462f1a16904f640674cd172300775e2e616f44.text: 雖然阿斯卡隆戰記和黑暗逆襲角色無法取得此任務，但盟與敵角色可以使用此任務將他們傳送到獅子拱門。

5d6501145a432176db1af8a3067da7cb4f5176a9.source: Should your whole party die in the Bejunkan Pier area (e.g. via Vampiric weapon, etc), they will be resurrected at the shrine near Mhenlo and can continue with the quest; however, should they die in Lion's Gate, you will receive a "your party has been defeated" dialog and then be returned to the Kaineng Center.
5d6501145a432176db1af8a3067da7cb4f5176a9.text: 如果你的整個隊伍在 君瞰碼頭 區域死亡（例如透過 吸血鬼 武器等），他們將在 涵洛 附近的神社復活並可以繼續任務；但是，如果他們在 獅門 中死亡，您將收到「您的隊伍已被擊敗」對話方塊，然後返回 凱寧中心。

987834c677135f817e9fc3b6396ec56d8ee0dae7.source: See Campaign travel and Ferry for additional information.
987834c677135f817e9fc3b6396ec56d8ee0dae7.text: 請參閱 章節 旅行和渡輪以瞭解更多資訊。

11f93789a7258ab768082760a872f318d78ebc3e.source: Kill a group of Charged Blackness in the Underworld.
11f93789a7258ab768082760a872f318d78ebc3e.text: 在地獄中殺死一群 暗黑幽靈。

cee0786f04f6cd9cd1a23556e2b5b5a9de068ac9.source: *BONUS* Kill a group of Charged Blackness in Hard Mode.
cee0786f04f6cd9cd1a23556e2b5b5a9de068ac9.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死一群 暗黑幽靈。

78afc1276407c82376c35ed408d55011d5ad6310.source: When you enter the Underworld, you'll arrive at the yellow spot on the map. Finish the first part of Clear the Chamber to open the doors, then proceed south towards Twin Serpent Mountains. Until then, you will mostly encounter warrior foes.
78afc1276407c82376c35ed408d55011d5ad6310.text: 當你進入地獄時，你會到達地圖上的黃色點。完成清理房間的第一部分以開啟門，然後向南前往雙蛇山。在那之前，你將主要遇到戰士敵人。

6e2e95ec0e5b92f56ac7e64bb570862d350f63b3.source: Move up the mountains, keeping your distance from the Obsidian Behemoths and their traps. Several groups of Charged Blacknesses patrol here. To finish this quest, one of their groups needs to be killed.
6e2e95ec0e5b92f56ac7e64bb570862d350f63b3.text: 爬上山，與黑曜石巨獸及其陷阱保持距離。幾群帶電的黑暗在這裡巡邏。為了完成這個任務，需要殺死他們的一個小組。

62710f8e35e8ae6efaa34847a2eb399924c9e696.source: Follow Rurik and help him defeat the Charr.
62710f8e35e8ae6efaa34847a2eb399924c9e696.text: 跟隨魯裡克並幫助他擊敗 夏爾。

59d23137aa4f44bd27236bfe0979db50dff8d0f7.source: Return to Prince Rurik for your reward.
59d23137aa4f44bd27236bfe0979db50dff8d0f7.text: 影返 至 盧瑞克王子 以獲得獎勵。

3cb2dd2890448687fda8f7f9eba9070c04da359b.source: Upon accepting the quest, Prince Rurik will spawn outside the city gates in Lakeside County, alongside an Academy Monk and an Ascalon Guard. They will begin running to engage the Charr who spawn at the gate to the Northlands.
3cb2dd2890448687fda8f7f9eba9070c04da359b.text: 接受任務後，盧瑞克王子 將在 湖畔郡 的城門外生成，旁邊還有學院 僧侶 和 阿斯卡隆 守護程式。他們將開始奔跑，與在北地大門生成的 夏爾 交戰。

fbb55f40b9506d2cbdd1e03e880fe4c281bbcc7b.source: Exit the town and meet Prince Rurik just outside Ascalon City. Stand by him for a few moments and he will start running along the road to the Northlands.
fbb55f40b9506d2cbdd1e03e880fe4c281bbcc7b.text: 離開城鎮並在 阿斯卡隆城 外與 盧瑞克王子 會合。在他身邊待一會兒，他就會開始沿著通往北地的道路奔跑。

0aeea3d347dcdddad65032b3fc9ce0b7dcb53509.source: At several locations Rurik will stop and wait for you if you wander too far, forcing you to get close to him to resume his run.
0aeea3d347dcdddad65032b3fc9ce0b7dcb53509.text: 如果你走得太遠，魯裡克會在幾個地方停下來等你，迫使你靠近他才能繼續奔跑。

e1765ff474c316afa20c437b16b9097b8e22c14e.source: Level 1: Fight your way south down the winding path towards the Dungeon Lock. The enemies you encounter will be the same as on your last trip through this floor, except for the addition of some Shard Elementals and Hulking Shard Elementals near each patch of crystalline ground, which are just slightly stronger versions of the Cave Elementals encountered previously. At the south end of the dungeon, there will be a large chamber with numerous Charr, grawl, and elemental foes, so pull carefully to avoid over-aggro, and be mindful of two Charr Hunters circling the perimeter. Wyle Brimscourge will also be patrolling the area, and although he is a high-level warrior, he can be pulled and fought by himself, making him relatively simple to defeat. Time your most damaging abilities for when he uses Frenzy or Healing Signet. If you cannot withstand his attack damage, consider retreating up the slopes to the north to the edge of his following range, or using a pet or fire imp to tank. Wyle will drop a Dungeon Key, allowing you to open the lock and enter the portal to level 2.
e1765ff474c316afa20c437b16b9097b8e22c14e.text: 1 關卡：沿著蜿蜒的小路往南前進，前往 地監 船閘。你遇到的敵人將與你上次穿過這個樓層時遇到的敵人相同，除了在每塊水晶地面附近增加了一些碎片元素和巨大的碎片元素，它們只是之前遇到的洞穴元素的稍微更強的版本。在地牢的南端，會有一個大房間，裡面有許多 夏爾、穴居人和元素敵人，因此請小心拉動以避免過度仇恨，並注意周圍有兩個 夏爾 獵人。懷爾·布里姆斯科奇也會在該地區巡邏，雖然他是高階戰士，但他可以被自己拉著戰鬥，這使得他相對容易被擊敗。當他使用 狂暴 或 治療紋章 時，計算你最具破壞性的技能。如果你無法承受他的攻擊傷害，請考慮從北邊的斜坡撤退到他的追隨範圍的邊緣，或者使用寵物或火焰小鬼來坦克。 Wyle 會掉落一個 地監 鑰匙，讓您可以開啟鎖並進入傳送門以升級 2。

448fddeed9eb2d1290beee237b87b3b5d666958f.source: Level 2: Follow the passage down and east through some grawl, and as you turn to the north, you will see a vast chamber full of grawl and some patrolling Charr groups. Carefully cross to the north side of the chamber, pulling groups and keeping an eye on their patrol routes. Head for the western stairs on the north side, leading up to a room with more Shard Elementals and crystalline ground, then head directly north to encounter the first of three Charr patrols. Each patrol consists of one Charr Patrol Leader and a pair of Charr Patrol Stalkers. The stalkers are in a separate group and can easily be engaged separately from their leaders. Once you have killed this patrol, continue north past some more Shard Elementals to a passage leading to a crystal gate, where you will find the second patrol. Finally, head east past some oakhearts and ironhearts to find the third patrol in the northeast corner of the dungeon. Once all three patrols are dead, map travel back to Piken Square to claim the rewards.
448fddeed9eb2d1290beee237b87b3b5d666958f.text: 2 關卡：沿著通道向下和向東穿過一些穴居人，當你轉向北邊時，你會看到一個充滿穴居人的巨大房間和一些巡邏的 夏爾 群體。小心地穿過房間的北側，拉著隊伍並留意他們的巡邏路線。前往北側的西樓梯，通往一個有更多碎片元素和水晶地面的房間，然後直接向北遇到三個 夏爾 巡邏隊中的第一個。每個巡邏隊由一名 夏爾 巡邏隊長和一對 夏爾 巡邏追蹤者組成。跟蹤者處於一個單獨的群體中，可以輕鬆地與他們的領導者分開交戰。一旦你殺死了這個巡邏隊，繼續向北經過更多的碎片元素到達通往水晶門的通道，在那裡你會找到第二個巡邏隊。最後，向東走，經過一些橡心樹和鐵心樹，在地牢的東北角找到第三支巡邏隊。一旦三名巡邏隊全部死亡，地圖將返回 派肯廣場 領取獎勵。

6068d8b658e73b7c27c110d5ae422e876d02928f.source: The Charr Patrol Leaders do not need to be killed to progress the quest. Only the Charr Patrol Stalkers are counted.
6068d8b658e73b7c27c110d5ae422e876d02928f.text: 夏爾巡邏隊 領導者無需被殺死即可完成任務。僅計算 夏爾 巡邏追蹤器。

11381c37105d31d4d2af1ec459511cf2dc248080.source: The Charr Patrol Leaders start moving when they are approached, and will walk to a new location if they are left alone. The central leader moves northwest and stops at the entrance to the chamber filled with rock-crushing machines, the northern leader heads southeast through a tunnel filled with crystals and walks all the way to the middle of the large atrium chamber, and the northeastern leader merely steps out to the entrance of the tunnel he is found in.
11381c37105d31d4d2af1ec459511cf2dc248080.text: 夏爾巡邏隊 當領導者被接近時，他們就會開始移動，如果他們獨自一人，他們會走到新的位置。中央領導者向西北方向移動，停在裝滿岩石破碎機的房間入口處，北方領導者向東南方向穿過一條裝滿水晶的隧道，一直走到大中庭房間的中間，而東北領導者則只是走到隧道的入口處。

b8b0df595bf65ecf0bba6b2a2180de59d17dd082.source: If any party members have not completed Long Thought Forgotten, the western entrance to the dungeon will be closed, requiring the party to travel to the eastern entrance.
b8b0df595bf65ecf0bba6b2a2180de59d17dd082.text: 如果任何隊員沒有完成長思被遺忘者，地牢的西入口將被關閉，要求隊伍前往東入口。

67ba49008038dc1fa401e1a7b5e5d85ed0ef8eab.source: The quest spawns, including Wyle Brimscourge, will be overridden if any party members have Long Thought Forgotten active in their quest log.
67ba49008038dc1fa401e1a7b5e5d85ed0ef8eab.text: 如果任何隊伍成員的任務日誌中啟動了長期思考 被遺忘者，則任務生成（包括懷爾·布里姆斯科奇）將被覆蓋。

447902f60455cd1cafd8c2c10cd86f9b4842e6ff.source: Although this quest can be acquired without Reforged Mode enabled, the quest NPCs will not spawn and the objectives will not progress while any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode.
447902f60455cd1cafd8c2c10cd86f9b4842e6ff.text: 雖然此任務可以在未啟用重鑄模式的情況下完成，但當隊伍的任何成員未處於重鑄模式時，任務 NPC 不會生成，目標也不會進展。

2bf074b924431907106f09d5996d13cf1232eff5.source: Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies spawning in the northern part of the Northlands, making it significantly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.
2bf074b924431907106f09d5996d13cf1232eff5.text: 將沒有重鑄模式的玩家新增到隊伍中將阻止敵人在北地北部生成，從而更容易到達被遺忘的隧道。如果所有沒有重鑄模式的玩家在進入地牢之前退出或離開地圖，任務仍然可以完成。

6d546f8e90840879b3eb1da7c886935e10bf2263.source: Kill the four Charr located at the gate once you get there. You can let Rurik and the two NPCs handle them on their own, as they are more than capable to defeat the group by themselves.
6d546f8e90840879b3eb1da7c886935e10bf2263.text: 到達那裡後，殺死位於門口的四個 夏爾。你可以讓留裡克和那兩個NPC自己對付他們，因為他們完全有能力獨自擊敗這群人。

401f4403512797dec6c07b3b05b33802a37909da.source: Though the monk that follows Prince Rurik is quite an efficient healer with her Heal Other spell, you may wish to keep your distance from the Charr if you are at low level.
401f4403512797dec6c07b3b05b33802a37909da.text: 雖然跟隨 盧瑞克王子 的武士是一位非常有效率的治療者，她的 治癒他人 法術非常有效，但如果您等級較低，您可能想要與 夏爾 保持距離。

5b9bed43dd2c22abb2b9d7d1e2fc7ede01dca511.source: You can talk to Rurik right afterwards for your reward or map travel and receive it from him in Ascalon City.
5b9bed43dd2c22abb2b9d7d1e2fc7ede01dca511.text: 之後您可以立即與 Rurik 聯絡以獲得獎勵或地圖旅行，並在 阿斯卡隆城 中從他那裡收到。

fe7dbc66bdfb205ad89c4392a2ee357395a7424f.source: This quest can be used to help reach level 10 in pre-Searing, since it is a quick way to kill up to four level 5 foes. Map travel back to Ascalon City after killing the last Charr, abandon the quest from the quest log, then talk to Rurik to take it again.
fe7dbc66bdfb205ad89c4392a2ee357395a7424f.text: 此任務可用於協助在 崩壞 之前達到 10 等級，因為這是殺死最多四個 5 等級敵人的快速方法。殺死最後一個夏爾後，地圖返回阿斯卡隆城，從任務日誌中放棄任務，然後與Rurik對話再次接受。

4704c53122a87091947cface8877c2c5f06ce15b.source: If the Charr are killed without Rurik, they will respawn upon zoning. This allows for rapid farming by repeatedly killing the group and traveling to The Northlands.
4704c53122a87091947cface8877c2c5f06ce15b.text: 如果 夏爾 在沒有魯裡克的情況下被殺死，它們將在分割槽時重生。這樣可以透過重複殺死群體並前往 北國 來快速耕作。

0ee5f90cf807a1e3eafc8e1e691041829c2bfeff.source: Consider stopping to pickup a Red Iris Flower — one almost always spawns along the way to the gate. Press Alt to see where it is.
0ee5f90cf807a1e3eafc8e1e691041829c2bfeff.text: 考慮停下來撿起 紅色鳶尾花——它幾乎總是在通往大門的路上出現。按 Alt 鍵檢視它在哪裡。

2fd49c8eb9ce5a46a82353fb1603e1912d8b3b41.source: It can be worth a detour to kill the Rogue Bull (as long as you have not completed A Mesmer's Burden).
2fd49c8eb9ce5a46a82353fb1603e1912d8b3b41.text: 繞道殺死流氓公牛是值得的（只要你還沒完成 幻術師的重任）。

27361c934cc80b07413f7b6d8c3f5454731e733e.source: Ben Wolfson will not spawn in Lakeside County during this quest.
27361c934cc80b07413f7b6d8c3f5454731e733e.text: 本·沃爾夫森在此任務期間不會在 湖畔郡 中產生。

c5057741086764132f967160f13eb4957398e366.source: The objective to meet up with Rurik outside of Ascalon City is counted separately from the objective to defeat the Charr, despite being one line in the quest log. Charr can occasionally spawn behind the gate.
c5057741086764132f967160f13eb4957398e366.text: 在 阿斯卡隆城 之外與 Rurik 會面的目標與擊敗 夏爾 的目標是分開計算的，儘管它們在任務日誌中只有一行。 夏爾 偶爾會在門後產生。

8f98c89fa559c9b075a7ec6271c45baf8fa77ccd.text: 樹林的紛爭 已完成

f7cc34802df879d0cf7d400a86c34a052e3cd46b.source: Find out if the Charr Ranger is using the catacombs. Speak to Brother Mhenlo in Ashford Abbey.
f7cc34802df879d0cf7d400a86c34a052e3cd46b.text: 找出 夏爾 遊俠 是否正在使用地下墓穴。與 灰色淺灘修道院 中的 涵洛教友 交談。

fbb2c0ffaf1ca05358cedaae63b4524e51e6813d.source: Ask Necromancer Munne if she has any information on the Charr.
fbb2c0ffaf1ca05358cedaae63b4524e51e6813d.text: 詢問 死靈法師繆涅 是否有任何有關 夏爾 的資訊。

9f3c7700d7805dbb29096aedd7cfc36fe0a9105e.source: Seek out Oberan the Reviled deep within the catacombs. Ask him about the Charr Ranger.
9f3c7700d7805dbb29096aedd7cfc36fe0a9105e.text: 在地下墓穴深處尋找 謾罵者歐伯藍。向他詢問有關 夏爾 遊俠 的資訊。

5139d2d3b6c758b3584ca98225cecacca2db79d5.source: Return to Rurik in Ascalon City and show him the sharp charr tooth.
5139d2d3b6c758b3584ca98225cecacca2db79d5.text: 影返 給 阿斯卡隆城 中的魯裡克，並向他展示尖銳的炭牙。

d71f669096b90724852b7a88023bcc79f2bd4ec5.source: Take the southwest road from Ascalon City to Ashford Abbey and speak with Brother Mhenlo. From there, enter the Catacombs; you will find Necromancer Munne just inside to your right.
d71f669096b90724852b7a88023bcc79f2bd4ec5.text: 沿著西南路從 阿斯卡隆城 行駛至 灰色淺灘修道院，並與 涵洛教友 交談。從那裡進入地下墓穴；您會在右側找到 死靈法師繆涅。

675fab8d175916ab9835e32378e485daffe137b1.source: Oberan the Reviled is a bit harder to get to from Necromancer Munne's position, as you have to fight your way through various undead and Deadly Crypt Spiders (use the quest marker on the Mission Map as a reference point).
675fab8d175916ab9835e32378e485daffe137b1.text: 從 死靈法師繆涅 的位置到達 謾罵者歐伯藍 有點困難，因為你必須在各種不死生物和致命地穴蜘蛛中殺出一條血路（使用 主線任務 地圖上的任務標記作為參考點）。

09b449b266918fab46440904f9e80a80a9ed2ed3.source: Alternatively, entering the Catacombs from the Green Hills County portal (north of the Barradin Estate) offers a much faster and safer trek to Oberan.
09b449b266918fab46440904f9e80a80a9ed2ed3.text: 或者，從 綠丘郡 門戶（巴拉丁莊園以北）進入地下墓穴可以更快、更安全地前往奧伯蘭。

8f31e13922cf6ab06519c53a62e344918e7777b4.source: Once you obtain the Sharp Charr Tooth from him, you can simply map travel back to Ascalon City for your reward.
8f31e13922cf6ab06519c53a62e344918e7777b4.text: 一旦您從他那裡獲得了鋒利的 夏爾 牙齒，您就可以簡單地將旅行映射回 阿斯卡隆城 以獲得獎勵。

e0daf1e159fb40547d8cbc808d588083c56f832d.source: This is a good way to get to Oberan the Reviled for Necromancers to grab the skill quest The Accursed Path, as this quest leads you straight to him.
e0daf1e159fb40547d8cbc808d588083c56f832d.text: 對於死靈法師來說，這是到達 謾罵者歐伯藍 並完成技能任務 詛咒之路 的好方法，因為這個任務會直接引導你去找他。

bf918a4758b7b0df389877ca099d5ad842474909.text: 與熟練的穆勒尼克斯會合。

b62cfae516fcf8eba0c6a4320a6e245b66f31a2e.source: Take out Wyle Brimscourge and use the key to access the lower level.
b62cfae516fcf8eba0c6a4320a6e245b66f31a2e.text: 取出懷爾·布里姆斯科奇並使用鑰匙進入下層。

72002fc3728c0aeacc1d4f275b3c11c2358d6ede.source: Take out the Charr patrols. [3...0] remain.
72002fc3728c0aeacc1d4f275b3c11c2358d6ede.text: 消滅 夏爾 巡邏隊。 [3...0] 保留。

69be0845ad27368b881d138d322fa4cb0433c9df.source: Exit Piken Square through the northern exit and head north to locate the tunnel entrance (see map).
69be0845ad27368b881d138d322fa4cb0433c9df.text: 從北出口退出 派肯廣場，然後向北行駛，找到隧道入口（請參閱地圖）。

90014a459d01513537a2f42ced098d8dfa0b0d57.source: By using the eastern dungeon entrance, running swiftly through the portal to level 2 when it is open, and moving very carefully on level 2, it is possible to complete this quest without fighting any Charr groups inside the dungeon except Wyle and the Charr Patrol Stalkers.
90014a459d01513537a2f42ced098d8dfa0b0d57.text: 透過使用東部地牢入口，在門開啟時快速穿過傳送門到達 2 關卡，並在 2 關卡中非常小心地移動，可以在不與地牢內的任何 夏爾 團體戰鬥（除了 Wyle 和 夏爾 巡邏跟蹤者）的情況下完成此任務。

f4bef1ed5da8cece5eb1bd148eaf45ac144e4281.source: The objective to rendezvous with Adept Mullenix completes immediately upon entering the Tunnels, even if the party uses the eastern entrance.
f4bef1ed5da8cece5eb1bd148eaf45ac144e4281.text: 即使隊伍使用東部入口，與穆勒尼克斯大師會合的目標也會在進入隧道後立即完成。

ecdd8e20fb253bfd986fa0b5470b3cf77a3ac8c0.source: Destroy the Charr expeditionary force in Norrhart Domains.
ecdd8e20fb253bfd986fa0b5470b3cf77a3ac8c0.text: 摧毀諾拉特領地的 夏爾 遠徵軍。

d163dcaa853a6ea014f56dd4253a42c8daf0f783.source: See Artificer Mullenix for your reward.
d163dcaa853a6ea014f56dd4253a42c8daf0f783.text: 請參閱 工匠 穆尼克斯 以取得獎勵。

f2f8229d0587603eb8fc61693005b51084bb78e0.source: If leaving from Gunnar's Hold, avoid the first few Charr groups you see and run north following the green arrow until you hear the Charr Wardkeeper dialogue, "Humans! Hierophant Burntsoul was right! [...]" Now you can start killing off the three groups at the starred location on the compass. Head south to find two more sets of Charr waiting for you to aggro them. Pull back onto the top of the ramp, wait for the Charr to ball up on the bottom of the ramp, and use area of effect skills to take them out. If they run away, wait until they return and repeat for any stragglers.
f2f8229d0587603eb8fc61693005b51084bb78e0.text: 如果您從 甘拿的佔領地 出發，請避開您看到的前幾個 夏爾 群體，然後沿著綠色箭頭向北跑，直到您聽到 夏爾 守衛對話：「人類！Hierophant Burntsoul 是對的！[...]」現在您可以開始殺死羅盤群體上星號位置的三個群體。往南走，會發現另外兩組 夏爾 等著你去攻擊它們。 拉出回到坡道頂部，等待夏爾在坡道底部形成球，然後使用區域效果技能將其消滅。如果他們逃跑了，請等到他們回來並對任何落後的人重複上述步驟。

c5b87bfa0f5ae29e9e38925d542d49dabbae5fa5.source: In normal mode, the low level Charr from this quest do not count as enemies for the Norn Hunting Party blessing.
c5b87bfa0f5ae29e9e38925d542d49dabbae5fa5.text: 在正常模式下，此任務中的低等級 夏爾 不會被視為 諾恩 狩獵 隊伍 祝福的敵人。

c97b8511484eed1a445edf8b411616650813b283.source: Meet Aidan just outside of Piken Square.
c97b8511484eed1a445edf8b411616650813b283.text: 在 派肯廣場 外與 艾登 會面。

9b043a160b6a3401f2cebf4740935d80de3898ec.text: 伏擊 夏爾 援軍。

5196a9bb6a48b1c0ffe0270ded66e13fa1147b6a.text: 掠奪 夏爾 補給站。

dfe4232049cbacfa6b74d3aa75541428098c0c41.source: Meet Aidan just outside of Piken Square and talk to him. Follow him to kill 4 Charr Stalkers and then slay another group of 4 Charr Stalkers to pillage the 4 Charr Supply Depots (Chests). The chests may drop zero to three items per chest. Make sure to flag your Henchmen or Heroes away.
dfe4232049cbacfa6b74d3aa75541428098c0c41.text: 在 派肯廣場 外面遇見 艾登 並與他交談。跟著他殺死 4 夏爾 追蹤者，然後殺死另一群 4 夏爾 追蹤者來掠奪 4 夏爾 補給站（箱子）。每個箱子可能會掉落零到三件物品。請務必標記您的 傭兵 或英雄。

63f89a3adc80a93e1f46d08f539a18e44d327253.source: Finally kill Kaargoth Bloodclaw (Necromancer Boss). Walk back with Aidan to Piken Square for the reward. Aidan must survive to complete the quest.
63f89a3adc80a93e1f46d08f539a18e44d327253.text: 最後殺死卡爾格斯·血爪（死靈法師 頭目）。帶著 艾登 返回 派肯廣場 以獲得獎勵。 艾登 必須生存才能完成任務。

bb6459a899693b39f917e61c5b32c6d08de3add1.source: Explore Arborstone for Sekai the Mapmaker. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
bb6459a899693b39f917e61c5b32c6d08de3add1.text: 為地圖製作者世界探索阿伯斯通。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

888605e8637074f2a3f3ecaa9263f0ee7b2ed428.source: Explore Ferndale. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
888605e8637074f2a3f3ecaa9263f0ee7b2ed428.text: 探索 蕨谷。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

b82e9b47fbb89c7e845601fc49db9142fd5bb08a.source: Explore Melandru's Hope. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
b82e9b47fbb89c7e845601fc49db9142fd5bb08a.text: 探索 梅蘭朵的盼望。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

a39fc7151c31b16e8b3af3e63b835786d9522717.source: Explore Drazach Thicket. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
a39fc7151c31b16e8b3af3e63b835786d9522717.text: 探索 德瑞扎灌木林。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

960095a2ae517603c5ab394d71afa82583178d3e.source: See Sekai the Mapmaker for your reward.
960095a2ae517603c5ab394d71afa82583178d3e.text: 前往地圖製作者世界領取獎勵。

f6b1cf0d87b2456d8d0312a6f5eead22372fcdc2.source: The order of the explorable areas you go through doesn't matter. Simply get to each green marker to complete the quest. For exact locations of the markers, see the maps to the right - the order of the locations does not matter. Each area is easiest to start from the following outposts:
f6b1cf0d87b2456d8d0312a6f5eead22372fcdc2.text: 您經過的可探索區域的順序並不重要。只需到達每個綠色標記即可完成任務。有關標記的確切位置，請參閱右側的地圖 - 位置的順序並不重要。每個區域最容易從以下前哨站開始：

89b9c4aaef822ed03894fb3a4e2514efb3d0e4a9.source: For Arborstone start from Altrumm Ruins.
89b9c4aaef822ed03894fb3a4e2514efb3d0e4a9.text: 對於 Arborstone，從 奧楚蘭廢墟 開始。

9907ac96b3bc2a734f9958aac8082b9954c1ada2.source: For Ferndale start from House zu Heltzer.
9907ac96b3bc2a734f9958aac8082b9954c1ada2.text: 對於 蕨谷 從 鳳荷議院 開始。

50266662d5bfe7cfe13c1b13fb9cafb3169c6f6d.source: For Melandru's Hope start from Lutgardis Conservatory.
50266662d5bfe7cfe13c1b13fb9cafb3169c6f6d.text: 對於 梅蘭朵的盼望 從 路嘉帝斯溫室 開始。

be59e5245a6c1da5d574bc8da62c1e045acc9600.source: In this area, there are several groups that have wide ranged patrol areas that overlap. Due to this, they can overwhelm unprepared/unobservant players. It is best to watch their patrol paths and engage them where they don't overlap.
be59e5245a6c1da5d574bc8da62c1e045acc9600.text: 在這個區域裡，有幾個小組，巡邏範圍很廣，而且有重疊。因此，他們可能會壓倒沒有準備/不細心的玩家。最好觀察他們的巡邏路徑並在不重疊的地方與他們交戰。

6b6d3d69a1bae153874267efe1d17b24f4d0da3b.source: For Drazach Thicket start from Brauer Academy northern exit.
6b6d3d69a1bae153874267efe1d17b24f4d0da3b.text: 對於 德瑞扎灌木林，從 巴爾學院 北出口出發。

cbe59a594a761851417a41f85f31cc8221ddbb44.source: Do not leave an area before finding all five marker locations, otherwise you will have to restart that explorable area.
cbe59a594a761851417a41f85f31cc8221ddbb44.text: 在找到所有五個標記位置之前不要離開某個區域，否則您將必須重新啟動該可探索區域。

c3f98e626b5ad138a00bec2df86a8a2431f84d3e.source: Several quests that give Kurzick faction for Befriending the Kurzicks are located in the areas you have to explore and may be done while you visit the five places.
c3f98e626b5ad138a00bec2df86a8a2431f84d3e.text: 與庫爾茲克人交朋友可以獲得 庫茲柯 陣營值 的幾個任務位於您必須探索的區域，並且可以在您訪問這五個地方時完成。

1fcd6ea7e8901b50f3585157aa605c436de69b30.source: One method to complete this quest is to vanquish all the listed areas, since a vanquish pretty much requires you to sweep the entire area.
1fcd6ea7e8901b50f3585157aa605c436de69b30.text: 完成此任務的一種方法是征服所有列出的區域，因為征服幾乎需要您橫掃整個區域。

dc284949f704846354b0e6d7c6d152b4ee28f685.source: Consider waiting until the Zaishen Vanquish Challenge quest of each corresponding area is available.
dc284949f704846354b0e6d7c6d152b4ee28f685.text: 考慮等到每個對應區域的 戰承清圖 挑戰任務可用。

a7c8498255eee99cf04f4997763fbe654f3528e9.source: Explore Mount Qinkai. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
a7c8498255eee99cf04f4997763fbe654f3528e9.text: 探索 今凱山。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

6af77d57e27ccfc4f0aba16ff48cf3414347dd62.source: Explore Boreas Seabed. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
6af77d57e27ccfc4f0aba16ff48cf3414347dd62.text: 探索北風之神海底。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

51e01f4173e92a3e7b734d2b526e554bb99fe368.source: Explore Archipelagos. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
51e01f4173e92a3e7b734d2b526e554bb99fe368.text: 探索 群島。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

b31b457f84eb430b2c4637fd03d6ffc268e08165.source: Explore Maishang Hills. You have [5...0] places left to visit.
b31b457f84eb430b2c4637fd03d6ffc268e08165.text: 探索 麥尚山丘。您還有 [5...0] 個地點可以參觀。

71c68f5fd5fbb96cd90329294f831bbb4ec67915.source: For Mount Qinkai, start from Aspenwood Gate (Luxon)
71c68f5fd5fbb96cd90329294f831bbb4ec67915.text: 對於 今凱山，從 Aspenwood Gate (勒克森) 出發

b89ee662aa2f3ac3ec77c7be588c7f6cc1f080cc.source: For Boreas Seabed, start from Zos Shivros Channel
b89ee662aa2f3ac3ec77c7be588c7f6cc1f080cc.text: 對於北風之神海底，從 佐席洛斯水道 開始

cf4d0e2c41cf735f9cace106320cc104fa205525.source: For Archipelagos, start from Jade Flats (Luxon)
cf4d0e2c41cf735f9cace106320cc104fa205525.text: 對於 群島，從 Jade Flats (勒克森) 出發

8f43da6947fb6015efeb1d2eeece9ed7d7bf3453.source: For Maishang Hills, start from Bai Paasu Reach
8f43da6947fb6015efeb1d2eeece9ed7d7bf3453.text: 對於 麥尚山丘，從 拜巴蘇區域 開始

0d42ac90b3baa703cef6e4b21d42b595b224073e.source: You will encounter several bosses along the way. It may be wise to bring Signet of Capture with you.
0d42ac90b3baa703cef6e4b21d42b595b224073e.text: 一路上你會遇到幾個boss。隨身攜帶 捕捉紋章 可能是明智之舉。

b3454841057e971721076fdc132d5f212e515d7a.source: Several quests that give Luxon faction for Befriending the Luxons are located in the areas you have to explore and may be done while you visit the five places.
b3454841057e971721076fdc132d5f212e515d7a.text: 與 Luxons 交友可獲得 勒克森榮譽值 的幾個任務位於您必須探索的區域，並且可以在您造訪這五個地點時完成。

868fcae2d9094b4b795fea1fd07f8da9c5e3acf3.source: Guild Wars Factions linked to Guild Wars Nightfall on same account
868fcae2d9094b4b795fea1fd07f8da9c5e3acf3.text: 公會 戰爭 盟與敵 連結到相同帳號上的 公會 戰爭 黑暗逆襲

cfc0c731aabbb396ab5ed05d573d05d11c9f341b.source: Speak with Imperial Guardsman Linro in Kaineng Center.
cfc0c731aabbb396ab5ed05d573d05d11c9f341b.text: 在 凱寧中心 中與帝國衛兵林洛交談。

dc8a7947e35e85e1d94dd108985a51fd1a6943d9.text: 在 巴德克小徑 中找到 Zenmai。

6dabcbc3d83de1fbff2143ff2676e65dcacf62f4.source: Travel to the Undercity. Zenmai must survive.
6dabcbc3d83de1fbff2143ff2676e65dcacf62f4.text: 前往幽暗城。善麥必須生存。

6063ef83c1291b7787c3a51170c42a886e353202.source: Stop the Am Fah from creating new afflicted soldiers.
6063ef83c1291b7787c3a51170c42a886e353202.text: 阻止 安費 創造新的受苦士兵。

16bce66a963d096b1ab9e49858e8cdd6b989d7a4.text: 與 Zenmai 交談缺少句號

b2ebb6611fed4f0a49c79f88cb4c47a9b2d99701.source: Return to Clerk Arlon in Kamadan with Zenmai.
b2ebb6611fed4f0a49c79f88cb4c47a9b2d99701.text: 影返 與 Zenmai 一起前往卡馬丹的書記官 Arlon。

64577df4ab4efde33ebaa076a39b07c6f77368aa.source: During this quest, the number of foes in Bukdek Byway will be reduced to only 1-10, which makes vanquishing easier. See Bukdek Byway notes.
64577df4ab4efde33ebaa076a39b07c6f77368aa.text: 在這個任務中，巴德克小徑中的敵人數量將會減少到只有1-10，這使得征服變得更容易。請參閱 巴德克小徑 註解。

b645bbe7a3d89ed52287780ee1503dc326bb08ee.source: During this quest, some bosses in the Undercity or several bosses in that explorable area during Winds of Change will not spawn after speaking to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway and then entering the Undercity with her.
b645bbe7a3d89ed52287780ee1503dc326bb08ee.text: 在此任務期間，幽暗城中的一些 Boss 或 變幻之風 期間該可探索區域中的幾個 Boss 在與 巴德克小徑 中的 Zenmai 交談並與她一起進入幽暗城後不會生成。

c252c27c25baccf8bfe69349d625d15d584a2764.source: See campaign travel for information on travelling to Cantha and Elona.
c252c27c25baccf8bfe69349d625d15d584a2764.text: 有關前往 Cantha 和 Elona 的資訊，請參閱競選旅行。

8e768cf96f7e0e63fc363dcc193a7f904299492a.source: Leave from Kaineng Center and follow the quest map to Zenmai. After you talk to her, Zenmai will disappear into the Undercity. Proceed south to the entrance to the Undercity and follow the quest map to Lale the Vindictive. After you defeat him, a series of Am Fah will appear which you must also defeat. Following these battles, speak to Zenmai again. Then map travel back to Kamadan and speak to Clerk Arlon for your reward.
8e768cf96f7e0e63fc363dcc193a7f904299492a.text: 從 凱寧中心 出發，依照任務地圖前往 Zenmai。與她交談後，善邁就會消失在幽暗城中。向南前往幽暗城的入口，依照任務地圖前往復仇者拉萊。擊敗他後，會出現一系列 安費，你也必須擊敗它們。這些戰鬥結束後，再次與善麥對話。然後用地圖返回卡馬丹並與書記官阿爾隆交談以獲取獎勵。

493a0976babe66da0b33023aced0c631f8db1b8a.source: To complete the quest, Zenmai must stay alive the entire time. One option is to repeatedly order a Monk player or hero to use Healing Prayers or Protection Prayers skills on her. For players that are not level 20 yet, flagging your heroes and henchmen to tackle the mobs would be a good idea. This also minimizes the chance of Zenmai dying, as she will stay behind with you.
493a0976babe66da0b33023aced0c631f8db1b8a.text: 為了完成任務，善邁必須一直活著。一種選擇是重複命令 僧侶 玩家或英雄對她使用 治療祈禱 或 防護祈禱 技能。對於還沒有達到 20 等級的玩家來說，標記你的英雄和追隨者來對付小怪是個好主意。這也可以最大限度地減少善舞死亡的可能性，因為她會留在你身邊。

ef7ab1e307e48df47e1743cd5e679ed86ce3fd6c.source: The Historical Monument of King's Watch is located a distance away from Fort Ranik in Regent Valley. Simply have the quest active in your log, and follow the green star on your map. It is recommended to combine this quest with The Red-Cloaked Deserter and Regent Valley Defense since they lead to the same vicinity. If you have the quest Counting the Fallen (from the same quest giver), you can also start from Sardelac Sanitarium and head Southeast, collecting the Ascalon Census on the way.
ef7ab1e307e48df47e1743cd5e679ed86ce3fd6c.text: 王者之眼 的歷史紀念碑位於 統治者之谷 距離拉尼克堡較遠的地方。只需在您的日誌中啟用該任務，然後按照地圖上的綠色星星即可。建議將此任務與 紅鬥蓬的背叛者 和 統治者之谷 Defense 結合起來，因為它們會通往相同的區域。如果你有任務 調查死者（來自同一個任務提供者），你也可以從 薩德拉克療養院 出發，往東南方向前進，在途中收集 阿斯卡隆 人口普查。

d36f52bf7046a04bc95d8965b1a3f094c5a38bd4.source: The Historical Monument of Surmia is found near the end of the Ruins of Surmia mission which takes place shortly after the Fort Ranik mission.
d36f52bf7046a04bc95d8965b1a3f094c5a38bd4.text: 蘇米亞 的歷史紀念碑位於 蘇米亞廢墟 任務即將結束時，該任務發生在拉尼克堡任務之後不久。

53b5db3a87e097251608975c39a365d4caa44bf0.source: The Historical Monument of Nolani is located in Diessa Lowlands, just outside the Nolani Academy (the last mission outpost in Ascalon) . You have to turn to the left and walk upstairs. Be careful of the large mob of gargoyles as it can kill an unprepared team.
53b5db3a87e097251608975c39a365d4caa44bf0.text: 若拉尼歷史紀念碑 位於 底耶沙低地 中，就在 若拉尼學院（阿斯卡隆 中最後一個任務前哨站）的外面。你必須向左轉然後走上樓。小心大量的石像鬼，因為它可以殺死毫無準備的隊伍。

16aa33a74dd5cce6a46dee069a623fa890a42b90.source: The Grim Cesta awarded through this quest is the only item that can reduce your health to 55, as popularised by the "55 Monk" style of farming builds.
16aa33a74dd5cce6a46dee069a623fa890a42b90.text: 透過此任務獎勵的 邪惡法器 是唯一可以將您的生命值降低到 55 的物品，正如「55 僧侶」風格的農業建築所普及的那樣。

d0251f98224ca8a2f870f7eb2fbf701881834bbd.source: As such, this item is likely to be your first valuable reward. If you have no plans to use it, consider selling it to other players.
d0251f98224ca8a2f870f7eb2fbf701881834bbd.text: 因此，該物品很可能是您的第一個有價值的獎勵。如果您沒有計劃使用它，請考慮將其出售給其他玩家。

d1e8b4bf89331c58d02f95c1091dca527380f1dd.source: Completing this quest almost always results in vanquishing the area, since the foes consist entirely of the three groups of Afflicted and one group of Jade Brotherhood (except if they happen to survive getting caught between the party and the Afflicted).
d1e8b4bf89331c58d02f95c1091dca527380f1dd.text: 完成這個任務幾乎總是會導致征服該地區，因為敵人完全由三組受折磨者和一組 翡翠兄弟會 組成（除非他們恰好夾在隊伍和受折磨者之間倖存下來）。

2e6940632fb4aa03021759565302604ef6e57af6.source: Deliver the carved buckeye to Soar Honorclaw.
2e6940632fb4aa03021759565302604ef6e57af6.text: 將雕刻好的七葉樹交給 光榮之爪 索爾。

c81be349a36631b3bf1967e444d8e6aa7af2ecfe.source: Meet Dao Weng in Panjiang Peninsula and kill him.
c81be349a36631b3bf1967e444d8e6aa7af2ecfe.text: 在 班讓半島 遇見道翁並殺死他。

2d290ee0de9db0c307a8599ee04ff7126c2d2e86.source: Return to Soar Honorclaw to let her know you have succeeded.
2d290ee0de9db0c307a8599ee04ff7126c2d2e86.text: 將 影返 改為 光榮之爪 索爾，讓她知道您已成功。

ba21fae070a4b1b7e73c7e0ba8ec67b0c418eaa7.text: 穿刺傷害：5-10（需 4 匕首精通）

10982ae38fa4c2968519f0256159038ae7007320.source: First travel to Aerie. The fastest way is to first maptravel to Ran Musu Gardens and then go south. After talking to Soar, maptravel to Tsumei Village and then leave for Panjiang Peninsula. Weng and his four guards are nearby and not difficult foes if you bring allies. Any henchmen will do. Then return to Aerie before getting the reward in the Monastery.
10982ae38fa4c2968519f0256159038ae7007320.text: 第一次前往艾利。最快的方法是先地圖旅行到嵐穆蘇花園，然後往南走。與 Soar 交談後，前往 蘇梅村，然後前往 班讓半島。翁和他的四名衛兵就在附近，如果你帶上盟友的話，他們並不是難對付的敵人。任何追隨者都可以。然後返回鷹巢，然後在修道院獲得獎勵。

eda84007405109c957f72df27acf6e1d29b56fb0.source: Clear the chamber of any grasping darkness. You have [3..0] groups remaining.
eda84007405109c957f72df27acf6e1d29b56fb0.text: 清除房間內任何令人抓狂的黑暗。您還剩下 [3..0] 群組。

a4c2b23dd2d9a2a8e3ce288fd6aff22118e19e96.source: Destroy the Terrorwebs around the statue of Grenth.
a4c2b23dd2d9a2a8e3ce288fd6aff22118e19e96.text: 摧毀 古蘭斯 雕像周圍的恐怖網。

83a3c60ae63786df626e5389cd40527c5145c1bc.source: See Reaper of the Labyrinth for your reward.
83a3c60ae63786df626e5389cd40527c5145c1bc.text: 請參閱迷宮收割者以獲得獎勵。

42213660196d62190126589b377323fe2d1998ed.source: Although the Reaper of the Labyrinth is credited as quest-giver in your quest log, it is the Lost Soul next to where you start in the Underworld from whom you can obtain this quest.
42213660196d62190126589b377323fe2d1998ed.text: 雖然迷宮收割者在你的任務日誌中被記為任務給予者，但你可以從你在地獄開始處旁邊的失魂者那裡獲得這個任務。

b7d08c43f20ced4adb168731bf18cb43483d0523.source: Clear the Cliffs of Dohjok in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
b7d08c43f20ced4adb168731bf18cb43483d0523.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 杜夏懸崖。

ca27dea9fd542bd5ac14bb4dcab447011e0ee3e5.source: "Clear the Cliffs of Dohjok in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."
ca27dea9fd542bd5ac14bb4dcab447011e0ee3e5.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 杜夏懸崖。”

2cf1d1b6ec6c3c7331dbb640378160d8963c45fc.source: The Cliffs of Dohjok connects to quite a few other locations. The fastest way is to travel southwest from Sunspear Great Hall to Champion's Dawn, which also exits onto the eastern edge of the Cliffs of Dohjok.
2cf1d1b6ec6c3c7331dbb640378160d8963c45fc.text: 杜夏懸崖 連線到許多其他位置。最快捷的方式是從 日戟大會堂 向西南行駛至 勇士曙光，該路線也可從 杜夏懸崖 的東邊駛出。

4f58510f37f3b293796610086046bcf2da13f300.source: Nightfall characters will be led through here as part of the quest Leaving a Legacy. Non-Nightfall characters will come here as part of the A Land of Heroes quest.
4f58510f37f3b293796610086046bcf2da13f300.text: 作為留下遺產任務的一部分，黑暗逆襲 角色將被引導穿過這裡。非 黑暗逆襲 角色將作為 英雄之地 任務的一部分來到這裡。

589141a4d231a38a68c8539041084cff3c97e539.source: Having this quest active can drastically reduce the number of foes required to vanquish Bukdek Byway, less than 10 kills if combined with The Afflicted Guard, The Drunken Master or Missing Daughter, down to 60 otherwise.
589141a4d231a38a68c8539041084cff3c97e539.text: 啟用此任務可以大大減少擊敗 巴德克小徑 所需的敵人數量，如果與受苦的守衛、醉酒大師或失蹤的女兒結合使用，則殺死的敵人數量少於 10，否則降至 60。

3d598187c297d0456dc591130ac621a002d34d0f.source: For the Guild Wars Nightfall campaign, Plague in Cantha given by Funwa Shento in Kamadan is associated with this quest.
3d598187c297d0456dc591130ac621a002d34d0f.text: 對於 公會 戰爭 黑暗逆襲 戰役，卡馬丹的 Funwa Shento 給予的 Cantha 瘟疫與此任務相關。

7efd8cbec246d1a843baf933c1df27b4c936d24b.source: For the Guild Wars Prophecies campaign, Mhenlo's Request given by Firstwatch Sergio in Lion's Arch is associated with this quest.
7efd8cbec246d1a843baf933c1df27b4c936d24b.text: 對於 公會 戰爭 阿斯卡隆戰記 戰役，獅子拱門 中 警衛隊長薩吉歐 給予的 涵洛 請求與此任務相關聯。

55ff6b5eb1c032e6ca190a313e4f8162faff7e27.source: Combines very well with Mayhem in the Market if you are using a Factions character in this quest, as the number of Afflicted in the region are significantly reduced.
55ff6b5eb1c032e6ca190a313e4f8162faff7e27.text: 如果您在此任務中使用 盟與敵 角色，則與市場中的混亂結合得很好，因為該地區的受影響者數量顯著減少。

45a4b372ed38d02be3ba7829814caa8e407cb6ec.source: The Torment creatures are affected from your Lightbringer title effect as usual.
45a4b372ed38d02be3ba7829814caa8e407cb6ec.text: 折磨生物照常受到你的光明使者稱號效果的影響。

9ab64863114f326543ad5c0ee5aaedbeca5586d4.source: Once you talk to Zenmai in Bukdek Byway, you need to escort her to the Undercity. If you zone away from Bukdek Byway or enter the Undercity before she arrives, you need to re-enter and talk to Zenmai again. If Zenmai is missed after you have entered the Undercity, exit back to Bukdek Byway and re-enter.
9ab64863114f326543ad5c0ee5aaedbeca5586d4.text: 當你在 巴德克小徑 中與 Zenmai 交談後，你需要護送她前往幽暗城。如果你在 巴德克小徑 到達之前離開或進入幽暗城，你需要重新進入並再次與 Zenmai 交談。如果進入幽暗城後錯過了 Zenmai，請退出回到 巴德克小徑 並重新進入。

5f69fbd876c5aef2229aec3215ec2fd7f819449b.source: This quest replaced the now removed quest Gain Zenmai. If Gain Zenmai was completed, this quest can not be accepted. Likewise, if you have Gain Zenmai you can not start this quest until it is abandoned.
5f69fbd876c5aef2229aec3215ec2fd7f819449b.text: 該任務取代了現已刪除的任務「獲得禪麥」。如果增益禪麥已完成​​，則無法接受該任務。同樣，如果你有增益禪麥，你就無法開始這個任務，直到它被放棄。

0cdfdf67b68a9d34ff5d44f4445ee95ebacda5da.source: Kill Chung, the Attuned in the Undercity.
0cdfdf67b68a9d34ff5d44f4445ee95ebacda5da.text: 在幽暗城殺死 激戰。

ed9efda00b8b806417b00aeae3d5a302a4e8de7c.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 Chung。

c602f7578c4093a0a5af30f8756d9281e3c772a5.source: Head to the Nahpui Quarter outpost and enter the Undercity from Wajjun Bazaar, as Chung is much closer to that exit than the Bukdek Byway exit. Be careful when approaching his spawn location, because he will not appear until you approach his location; and when he does appear, two other groups of Am Fah will also popup for an ambush. These groups can all be pulled separately; there is no need to try to kill everyone at the same time.
c602f7578c4093a0a5af30f8756d9281e3c772a5.text: 前往 納普區 前哨站並從 瓦江市場 進入幽暗城，因為 Chung 距離該出口比 巴德克小徑 出口近得多。接近他的出生位置時要小心，因為直到你接近他的位置他才會出現；當他出現時，另外兩組 安費 也會出現伏擊。這些組別都可以單獨拉取；沒有必要試圖同時殺死所有人。

e13c0d5b128ebc8845134f72be2a373207efd32a.source: Killing Chung in his alternate location during the quest Eliminate the Am Fah does not count toward completion. He must be killed at his normal spawn in the Undercity.
e13c0d5b128ebc8845134f72be2a373207efd32a.text: 在消除 安費 任務期間，在 Chung 的備用地點殺死 Chung 並不計入完成。他必須在幽暗城正常出生時被殺死。

990b7bd252ddc3a6c7b9d6142aa9e9e5ac8c8718.source: His group is spawned automatically during the quest It Ends Here.
990b7bd252ddc3a6c7b9d6142aa9e9e5ac8c8718.text: 他的隊伍會在任務「結束於此」期間自動生成。

e8cf01986017b2c12757ab9907c6fc63facdbff5.source: If a party member has Seek out Brother Tosai active, the walk to the Undercity will have allied Am Fah on it.
e8cf01986017b2c12757ab9907c6fc63facdbff5.text: 如果一名隊伍成員啟動了“尋找東齋兄弟”，那麼前往幽暗城的路上將會有盟友 安費 參與其中。

a81b0d30d2912bb9e96d5eb75d012d863620e968.source: If a party member has the quest Chasing Zenmai active (particularly, if said party member has reached said quest's second objective in the quest log), he will not spawn at the marked location.
a81b0d30d2912bb9e96d5eb75d012d863620e968.text: 如果一名隊員的任務“追逐善舞”處於活動狀態（特別是，如果該隊員已達到任務日誌中該任務的第二個目標），他將不會在標記的位置生成。

feecf31c0f09ef5c50cefdba40984251d59978dc.source: Find the historical monument in Surmia.
feecf31c0f09ef5c50cefdba40984251d59978dc.text: 在 蘇米亞 中找到歷史紀念碑。

c44b324e0fd0981277eb34d071538f8ed887f241.source: Find the historical monument in Nolani.
c44b324e0fd0981277eb34d071538f8ed887f241.text: 在 若拉尼 中找到歷史紀念碑。

9ff0ad845b04556291aa99f21f5796938c0fa082.source: Find the historical monument of King's Watch.
9ff0ad845b04556291aa99f21f5796938c0fa082.text: 尋找 王者之眼 的歷史紀念碑。

e2c39883334d0713572ea207279e55cacd3d61c5.text: 能量 +5（而 體力 低於 40%）

18492f7608528221c7d95823e8793787566242aa.source: The weapon bonuses listed in gray are not mentioned in the quest log.
18492f7608528221c7d95823e8793787566242aa.text: 任務日誌中未提及以灰色列出的武器獎勵。

cd1fb85151043b8089e33701f021a0e21d064457.source: While the first monument can be reached right after obtaining the quest, the two others are located further away and usually require completion of additional missions.
cd1fb85151043b8089e33701f021a0e21d064457.text: 雖然第一個紀念碑可以在獲得任務後立即到達，但另外兩個紀念碑距離較遠，通常需要完成額外的任務。

7c4265bd01a1a5f70856017ace7cd53843a0910a.source: Upon entrance, the area map is on your right. Since approaching the Siege Wurm causes another Frost Wurm to spawn, carefully pulling the Incubi and the Mandragors away from the wurms is recommended. It's possible to hide behind the ice to prevent the Siege Wurm from hitting you while you bring down the other wurm. Past the ice bridge, a Frostmaw Spawn will popup so it's best to pull the Mandragors across the bridge and dispatch them separately. Run to the right past the Icy Stalagmite into the next chamber and ignore the Siege Wurms if you can. From the next doorway, a group of Siege Wurms are visible, accompanied by Mandragors. Lure the Mandragors away, and kill them while out of range of the Siege Wurms. Next, a group of Jotun are guarding the path to the Level 5 entrance. You need to pull the Jotun away from their post since a Frostmaw Spawn and one or more, Frost Wurms popup and aggro with them. It is best to attack from the hillside to the right of the Jotun spawn. Finally, the gate itself is guarded by two Icy Stalagmites.
7c4265bd01a1a5f70856017ace7cd53843a0910a.text: 進入後，區域地圖位於您的右側。由於接近圍攻 地蟲 會導致另一個冰霜 地蟲 生成，因此建議小心地將夢魘和曼陀羅拉離亞龍。當你打倒另一個亞龍時，你可以躲在冰後面，以防止圍攻 地蟲 擊中你。過了冰橋，就會彈出霜喉生成者，所以最好將曼德拉角拉過橋，然後分別消滅它們。 跑過 向右經過 冰凍 石筍進入下一個房間，如果可以的話，忽略攻城龍。從隔壁門口可以看到一群攻城亞龍，還有曼陀羅。引誘曼德拉角，並在攻城亞龍攻擊範圍之外殺死他們。接下來，一群佐頓正在守護通往 5 層入口的道路。你需要將佐頓從他們的位置拉開，因為霜喉產卵和一個或多個冰霜龍會彈出並與他們仇恨。最好從佐敦產卵點右側的山坡進行攻擊。最後，大門本身由兩塊 冰凍 石筍守護。

be7c482925f8d5378d0a26f392d6b6c51c11f7bb.source: The area map is in the top left corner of the cavern. To make Frostmaw the Kinslayer spawn, you will need to kill the Frost Wurm Youngs and Frost Wurm Larvae, which will make her appear along with 2 Frostmaw Spawns and 3 Frost Siege Wurms. Once Frostmaw is dead, a reward chest will appear. (You are not required to kill all of the siege wurms, although it does make it easier to reach the chest and claim the quest reward from Latham.)
be7c482925f8d5378d0a26f392d6b6c51c11f7bb.text: 區域地圖位於洞穴的左上角。要產生 凍擊 弒族者，您需要殺死冰霜 地蟲 幼蟲和冰霜 地蟲 幼蟲，這將使她與 2 霜喉生成體和 3 冰霜攻城亞龍一起出現。一旦霜喉死亡，獎勵箱就會出現。 （你不需要殺死所有的攻城亞龍，儘管它確實讓你更容易到達寶箱並從萊瑟姆那裡領取任務獎勵。）

669fb8bd9456282a28ae4a3bc2e6957f2e9148d3.source: Dust rises and the ground starts to shimmy and shake as Frost Wurms and Frostmaw Spawns approach. You could try to avoid your entire party being covered in Wurm Bile by using one player as a lure while the others back away: the wurms will concentrate on just that character and the rest of the party will avoid the area of effect of Wurm Bile (which is point-based rather than targeted).
669fb8bd9456282a28ae4a3bc2e6957f2e9148d3.text: 當冰霜亞龍和霜喉之卵逼近時，灰塵揚起，地面開始搖晃。你可以嘗試避免你的整個隊伍被 地蟲 膽汁覆蓋，方法是使用一名玩家作為誘餌，而其他玩家則後退：亞龍將只集中在該角色上，而隊伍的其餘部分將避開 地蟲 膽汁的影響區域（這是基於點的而不是有針對性的）。

c1011e26f7c3bcc661ea85a7de9d1c8cd0f49be5.source: These wurms tend to remain for a while before moving to your party's new location; this usually gives you enough time to kill them.
c1011e26f7c3bcc661ea85a7de9d1c8cd0f49be5.text: 這些亞龍在移動到你的隊伍的新位置之前往往會停留一段時間；這通常會給你足夠的時間殺死他們。

c9b9c3baf7965d5816a2a1d812fc9857738fcaa9.source: Bring Lockpicks and/or Light of Deldrimor; this dungeon is rich in chests and Hidden Treasure.
c9b9c3baf7965d5816a2a1d812fc9857738fcaa9.text: 帶上開鎖器和/或 戴爾狄摩 燈；這個地牢裡有豐富的箱子和隱藏的寶藏。

925cbc9e873c0d50cc3b5ccb7988c901c448dc60.source: Proceed carefully to avoid the numerous popups.
925cbc9e873c0d50cc3b5ccb7988c901c448dc60.text: 小心操作以避免大量彈出視窗。

5734505845456ba60505a961c68ca96bb2605976.source: As with any quest allies, the accompanying Norn NPCs can be difficult to control. However, they are extremely sturdy and self-resurrect, making them ideal meat shields.
5734505845456ba60505a961c68ca96bb2605976.text: 與任何任務盟友一樣，伴隨的 諾恩 NPC 可能很難控制。然而，它們極其堅固且能夠自我復活，使它們成為理想的肉盾。

b8b99c8ab156c89c980e69968420c0e1a559ae19.source: Frostmaw does not regenerate health; you can keep whittling her down even after accumulating a high Death Penalty.
b8b99c8ab156c89c980e69968420c0e1a559ae19.text: 霜喉不會恢復生命值；即使在累積了很高的死刑之後，你也可以繼續削弱她。

355233067abdb9d13d40f8155d83d5b815ca301f.source: Keep spread out; most of the foes on this level deal significant AoE damage.
355233067abdb9d13d40f8155d83d5b815ca301f.text: 保持分散；此等級的大多數敵人都會造成顯著的 範圍性 傷害。

663ea1aa9d9f655466493186f9fa586d0fa4fc3b.source: In the final chamber, there is a safe spot (near a gate) that you can use for staging your assault. Attack the siege wurms from there and pull back; Frostmaw and her spawns will chase you, allowing you to divide and conquer.
663ea1aa9d9f655466493186f9fa586d0fa4fc3b.text: 在最後一個房間裡，有一個安全地點（靠近大門），你可以用來發動攻擊。從那裡攻擊攻城亞龍並撤退；霜喉和她的後代會追趕你，讓你分而治之。

c79cc8fe76948e9ec959ab28a82d8746a3fe8bb6.source: Bring hex removal skills: Wurm Bile is deadly unless countered by removal, regeneration, or lots of healing. Complicate counters the bile. Hex Eater Vortex, Inspired or Revealed Hex are ideal; the latter two recharge immediately when removing monster skill hexes. Alternatively, Withdraw Hexes removes all hexes from a cluster of allies.
c79cc8fe76948e9ec959ab28a82d8746a3fe8bb6.text: 帶來六角去除技能：地蟲 膽汁是致命的，除非透過去除、再生或大量治療來對抗。 糾纏 對抗膽汁。 食咒渦流、Inspired 或 降咒顯露 是理想選擇；後兩者在移除怪物技能六角形時立即充能。或者，降咒退散 會刪除盟友群集中的所有六角形。

8e588aba99438b011e632e4769d71612b4c696bc.source: Bring skills that prevent knock down (e.g. "Don't Trip!") to prevent being hampered by mobs of Wurms and Jotun.
8e588aba99438b011e632e4769d71612b4c696bc.text: 帶上防止被擊倒的技能（例如“不要絆倒！”），以防止受到亞龍和佐頓小怪的阻礙。

43dc01a56586c4c9d556ffc9e04350c28d6f0308.source: "Can't Touch This!" to counter air elementals and Mandragor.
43dc01a56586c4c9d556ffc9e04350c28d6f0308.text: 「這個不能碰！」對抗空氣元素和曼德拉格。

5341083a0842daf074f999fa0cf78dff9eb820a0.source: This level is fairly straightforward and the exit to the next level is very close. There are a lot of mobs and snowballs along the way, therefore it is advisable to tread slowly, and pull each mob to prevent the party from getting overwhelmed. The area map for this level is unnecessary, but can be found by the entrance door.
5341083a0842daf074f999fa0cf78dff9eb820a0.text: 這個等級相當簡單，通往下一個等級的出口也非常接近。沿途有很多小怪和雪球，因此建議緩慢行走，並拉動每個小怪，以防止隊伍被淹沒。這一層的區域地圖是不必要的，但可以在入口處找到。

1b7f9783c7f24c23b743d7c11e198e1d635a8172.source: Upon entrance, a player may find an area map nearby. Near the bottom of the icy area Frost Wurms and Frostmaw Spawns will popup. Just outside of that room, there will be a group of Chromatic Drakes, Frozen Elementals, and a Frostmaw Spawn. It is essential, especially in hard mode to carefully pull each group to prevent a party wipe.
1b7f9783c7f24c23b743d7c11e198e1d635a8172.text: 進入後，玩家可能會在附近找到一張區域地圖。在冰冷區域的底部附近，霜龍和霜喉生成體將會彈出。就在那個房間外面，會有一群彩色幼龍、冰凍元素和霜喉之卵。必須小心地拉動每個組，以防止一方被擦除，這一點非常重要，尤其是在困難模式下。

bc425af94623f8155dbebe9c19bdebf3c0e1b3f0.source: The portal to level 3 can be approached from either the left or the right path. The path to the left has (3) popup mobs of Stormcloud Incubi (8 to 10 total) which appear just past the doorway into the final chamber. Careful sweeping and pulling can prevent a party wipe, but the path to the right is safer with less popups. Combined mobs of Frozen Elementals and Chromatic Drakes in the confined corridors of the right hand path, can easily wipe an un-prepared party without careful pulling. This path does offer at least (3) Light of Deldrimor treasures, scattered throughout the passages.
bc425af94623f8155dbebe9c19bdebf3c0e1b3f0.text: 通往 3 關卡的傳送門可以從左側或右側路徑進入。左邊的路徑有 (3) 彈出的 Stormcloud Incubi 怪物（總共 8 到 10），它們出現在進入最後一個房間的門。小心地掃動和拉動可以防止派對擦除，但向右的路徑更安全，彈出視窗更少。右手路徑的狹窄走廊中的冰凍元素和彩色龍怪的組合，可以輕鬆消滅毫無準備的隊伍，無需小心拉動。這條路徑確實提供了至少 (3) 的 戴爾狄摩 寶藏之光，散佈在各個通道中。

02ff0988151c78d28d1815e4c2b44c82de8c56e5.source: Keep left on entry. The first open area will contain Ice Imps, Frost Wurms, 3 large mobs of Whirling Wisps, Frozen Elementals, Ice Imps and a Frostmaw Spawn. Frost Siege Wurms and the Frostmaw Spawn tend to popup while attacking any mob near the entrance to the level. This area leads to a path with a side hallway on left. This left hallway is a dead-end but contains an area map and a collection of Dwarven Powder Kegs. The kegs can be used to break down walls but are not necessary. When the wurms near each wall are defeated a large snowball spawns and crashes into the wall, breaking it down. The path leads to a small open area to the north which can be bypassed. To the east, the path forks north and east. The fork is guarded by 3 mobs of popup Stormcloud Incubi, which should be carefully sweeped and pulled. The northern path contains a number of wurm popups and leads to a Beacon of Droknar. The eastern path leads to more wurm popups and a large empty chamber to the south. The next chamber to the northeast is guarded by Ice Imps, Frozen Elementals, Whirling Wisps, more mobs of popup Stormcloud Incubi, as well as 2 more popup groups of Frost Wurms and Frostmaw Spawn. Careful pulling here is advised to prevent a party wipe. When the last of the wurms guarding the cracked wall blocking the exit to the 4th level is defeated, a snowball will spawn and break the wall down.
02ff0988151c78d28d1815e4c2b44c82de8c56e5.text: 入口處靠左行駛。第一個開放區域將包含冰小鬼、冰霜亞龍、3 旋轉小精靈、冰凍元素、冰小鬼和霜喉之子等大型生物。冰霜攻城龍和霜喉之卵在攻擊關卡入口附近的任何生物時往往會彈出。該區域通往一條小路，左側有一條側走廊。左邊的走廊是一條死衚衕，但包含一張區域地圖和一系列矮人火藥桶。小桶可以用來拆牆，但不是必要的。當每面牆附近的亞龍被擊敗時，一個大雪球就會生成並撞向牆，將其擊碎。這條路通往北面的一個小空地，可以繞過它。向東，道路向北和向東分岔。叉子由彈出的 Stormcloud Incubi 的 3 小怪守衛，應該小心地掃蕩和拉動。北面的道路包含許多亞龍彈出視窗並通往卓克納爾信標。東邊的路徑通往更多的亞龍彈出視窗和南面的一個大空房間。東北方的下一個房間由冰小鬼、冰凍元素、旋轉小精靈、更多彈出的暴風雲夢魘小怪以及 2 的更多彈出群體冰霜亞龍和霜喉之卵守衛。建議小心拉動此處，以防止派對擦拭。當守衛阻擋 4 關卡出口的裂牆的最後一隻亞龍被擊敗時，將會產生一個雪球並打破牆。

45a2609f860da45aca92a681ffc150a1490c2671.source: After talking to Sif, you will be taken to an empty Sifhalla, where after a short period of time, the Glacial Griffon will spawn. Defeat it and you will be returned to town to turn in the quest.
45a2609f860da45aca92a681ffc150a1490c2671.text: 與 Sif 交談後，您將被帶到一個空的 襲哈拉，短時間後，冰川獅鷲將在那裡生成。擊敗它，你將返回城鎮交任務。

c697176c4fc19cbfb97a6b1c198f8ebd24b00c40.source: Cold as Ice/Guide for a detailed walkthrough

68b7a1793eb48ed1d5810355eddf4322a293a9e7.source: Display the Norn title for the additional maximum health from Heart of the Norn.
68b7a1793eb48ed1d5810355eddf4322a293a9e7.text: 顯示 諾恩 標題，以獲得來自 諾恩 心的額外最大生命值。

a7b9abe47c366c1402bdaf4c0f225d7adce267c4.source: Many PvE skills apply a number of damaging conditions or provide an extra ally, including Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support, Summon Ruby Djinn, Mental Block.
a7b9abe47c366c1402bdaf4c0f225d7adce267c4.text: 許多 PvE 技能會應用許多破壞性條件或提供額外的盟友，包括 黑檀 暗殺者 支援、召喚 紅寶石巨靈、精神障礙。

1a7ad6e67249057a52dabe8f98e45b183b23790e.source: Bring anti-summon skills to counter the spirits.
1a7ad6e67249057a52dabe8f98e45b183b23790e.text: 帶上反召喚技能來對抗鬼魂。

22910ce5d89fd68c56dcf15a520a4fc8a75b3a38.source: Bring your own spirits: the standard spirit lord works well.
22910ce5d89fd68c56dcf15a520a4fc8a75b3a38.text: 帶上自己的武魂：標準武魂領主效果很好。

e97a9adc3c52f9f90120394da8ad1cb4ea8d3fd3.source: Bring health degeneration: take advantage of its lack of healing by countering its natural health regeneration
e97a9adc3c52f9f90120394da8ad1cb4ea8d3fd3.text: 帶來健康退化：透過對抗其自然健康再生來利用其缺乏治癒能力

1160e0ebfc27ac7fc2e8a051767be9fd72aa3ddf.source: Bring Energy denial: prevents it from creating the spirits.
1160e0ebfc27ac7fc2e8a051767be9fd72aa3ddf.text: 帶來能量否認：阻止它創造精神。

3eca68e1fda7ce3f266b85b6307abd47783b23c7.source: During the quest, there are six exploitable White Wolf corpses.
3eca68e1fda7ce3f266b85b6307abd47783b23c7.text: 在任務過程中，有六具可利用的白色 狼 屍體。

e7b186494b063e6bbccc46f78b3cfc6854468bda.source: You get credit for completing this quest if you kill the Griffon, even if you die.
e7b186494b063e6bbccc46f78b3cfc6854468bda.text: 如果你殺死了獅鷲，即使你死了，你也會因為完成這個任務而獲得榮譽。

6c1c7db4484a09fbdcdc536975bda35cc74fe05a.source: Summit Slaves active in quest log.
6c1c7db4484a09fbdcdc536975bda35cc74fe05a.text: 峰會奴隸在任務日誌中活躍。

927b0c444b98ff3f489d98adbe9fb92e76afa6f0.source: Lead frost golems through the crushers. Combine enough ice with the "warm one" to make a "cold one."
927b0c444b98ff3f489d98adbe9fb92e76afa6f0.text: 帶領冰霜傀儡穿過破碎機。將足夠的冰與“熱冰”混合製成“冷冰”。

67f07ec3792854d1971244292de630bbe5818990.source: See Krak Flamewhip for your reward.
67f07ec3792854d1971244292de630bbe5818990.text: 參見克拉克火鞭以獲得獎勵。

3c7bd33c97576f7c7eb33b1f176ca6c48ae37058.source: A very straightforward mission. Go to the marker point, and around seven Frost Golems will start to follow you. Walk through a crusher, and stop just outside it. It is best to flag any heroes or henchmen you bring with you away from the crushers so they don't get smashed too. Turn around and watch the golems get crushed into ice. Pick up five pieces of ice, and apply them to a "warm one" to turn it into a "cold one". Speak to Krak Flamewhip for your reward.
3c7bd33c97576f7c7eb33b1f176ca6c48ae37058.text: 一個非常簡單的任務。前往標記點，大約七個冰霜魔像將開始跟隨您。穿過破碎機，並在其外部停下來。最好將你帶來的任何英雄或追隨者標記為遠離粉碎者，這樣他們就不會被粉碎。轉身看著傀儡被壓成冰。拿起五塊冰塊，貼在「熱的」上，就變成了「冷的」。與克拉克·火鞭交談以獲得獎勵。

03c745f0d105fa2181935eba3f68a8d55d8b4429.source: The Gap can be scouted for Summit Slaves while making ice.
03c745f0d105fa2181935eba3f68a8d55d8b4429.text: 製冰時可以在峽谷中尋找山頂奴隸。

49650108bfee520367a90a6b54eca0d159aad29a.source: There is a lot of iron ore in this area, for the Gathering Resources quest.
49650108bfee520367a90a6b54eca0d159aad29a.text: 該地區有大量鐵礦石，可用於採集資源任務。

c77b543321a77ad43627332128631a4194ce5ee8.source: It is possible to leave this quest uncompleted, instead focusing on your other quests, this gives you as many as 10 powerful allies, which is very useful for some of the other quests from Krak Flamewhip.
c77b543321a77ad43627332128631a4194ce5ee8.text: 可以讓這個任務未完成，而不是專注於你的其他任務，這會給你盡可能多的 10 強大盟友，這對於 Krak Flamewhip 的其他一些任務非常有用。

fa4e26c86d301b7882a7fb0b0d24710bf39c313f.source: The Crushers seem to only kill you and the Frost Golems, but do not give any Death Penalty.
fa4e26c86d301b7882a7fb0b0d24710bf39c313f.text: 破碎者似乎只會殺死你和冰霜傀儡，但不會給予任何死刑。

27f38bf8eb499d9253e1b577c19025abb6429588.source: Should you delete the Warm One, Krak won't give you a new one.
27f38bf8eb499d9253e1b577c19025abb6429588.text: 如果您刪除了 Warm One，Krak 不會再給您一個新的。

dda1c4b6dead6501bbf1020192f2d0731f6b419a.source: Travel through the wurm's lair and destroy Frostmaw the Kinslayer.
dda1c4b6dead6501bbf1020192f2d0731f6b419a.text: 穿過亞龍的巢穴並摧毀 凍擊 弒族者。

c15fdabfcc356c93045e949dee0c544e61408921.source: Speak with Fastulf and discover his findings.
c15fdabfcc356c93045e949dee0c544e61408921.text: 與法斯塔爾夫交談並發現他的發現。

0d932c85946b049fb727f480c612344439187795.source: Destroy Frost Larvae within the wurm's lair to enrage Frostmaw the Kinslayer and force her to appear.
0d932c85946b049fb727f480c612344439187795.text: 消滅亞龍巢穴內的冰霜幼蟲，激怒 凍擊 弒族者 並迫使她出現。

36a2e330cc90d0d90fa148c7b3980b7516a050b1.source: Exact revenge on Frostmaw the Kinslayer for all the Norn she and her offspring have killed.
36a2e330cc90d0d90fa148c7b3980b7516a050b1.text: 為她和她的後代殺死的所有 諾恩 報復 凍擊 弒族者。

46a3d38e8537b6058b67ff3df75de72386d815ae.source: Convince Latham to share the glory of the kill.
46a3d38e8537b6058b67ff3df75de72386d815ae.text: 說服萊瑟姆分享殺戮的榮耀。

ea0e222ff3e6a3e8ea2f8d4e1157a847b1c2f9d7.source: If you wish to level up early and quickly, the primary quest Leaving a Legacy (the one where you get Dunkoro) will allow you to clear this area quickly and safely, since you get the help of Dunkoro and a group of Diggers as allies. The bonus from bounties will give quite a bit of experience. To get even more, flag any hero and henchmen far away and just clear the area with Dunkoro and the Diggers, so that you will get the full amount of experience per kill.
ea0e222ff3e6a3e8ea2f8d4e1157a847b1c2f9d7.text: 如果你想早點快速升級，主要任務「留下遺產」（你會得到 Dunkoro 的任務）將讓你快速安全地清理這個區域，因為你會得到 Dunkoro 和一群挖掘者作為盟友的幫助。賞金的獎勵會帶來相當多的經驗。為了獲得更多，標記遠處的任何英雄和追隨者，然後用 Dunkoro 和 Diggers 清理該區域，這樣你每次擊殺就能獲得全部經驗。

fdb628bc3ef1fb7d14070c5d927038d7980e5f51.source: There are several quests here which involve friendly NPCs who follow you around and body block for you during combat - Dalz Jelon, Mofuun, Dajwa. Since it's possible to have more than one of these NPCs active at one time, this effect can help someone going for the Survivor title.
fdb628bc3ef1fb7d14070c5d927038d7980e5f51.text: 這裡有幾個任務涉及友好的 NPC，他們會跟隨你並在戰鬥中為你擋住——Dalz Jelon、Mofuun、Dajwa。由於可能同時有多個 NPC 處於活動狀態，因此這種效果可以幫助某人獲得 生存者 頭銜。

105c1055080aa9b7a47042ba7e13d30ea2b63f9f.source: There is no bounty on the corsairs in this area.
105c1055080aa9b7a47042ba7e13d30ea2b63f9f.text: 該地區的海盜沒有賞金。

037d4d5a2176f62b997fcb9f9ed82cc68abe3788.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.5% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
037d4d5a2176f62b997fcb9f9ed82cc68abe3788.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Elonian 版圖 主打歌貢獻了約 2.5%。

678d433b488f4d97388cb2dae451271441edecd1.source: Leaving a Legacy produces the lowest amount of creatures as no corsairs spawn on the beach.
678d433b488f4d97388cb2dae451271441edecd1.text: 留下遺產產生的生物數量最少，因為海灘上沒有海盜生成。

b257a6f62880c6868b33bfc7044e0aee0f9d8dd9.source: Consider starting from Beknur Harbor or Blacktide Den for a party size of 8 instead of 4.
b257a6f62880c6868b33bfc7044e0aee0f9d8dd9.text: 考慮從 Beknur Harbour 或 Blacktide Den 出發，隊伍規模為 8 而非 4。

d75cd3193ce8505cdcbabb1d21bb1bb7d5f44f15.source: A few Skale groups to the east of the quarry area have large patrol routes and may easily be missed.
d75cd3193ce8505cdcbabb1d21bb1bb7d5f44f15.text: 採石場東部的幾個 鱗怪 小組有很大的巡邏路線，很容易被錯過。

662c06e3b3c7e6d2b62c4410bb221523f04b59e0.source: The quest Skree Hatchling Season in particular will produce a lot more foes.
662c06e3b3c7e6d2b62c4410bb221523f04b59e0.text: 特別是任務「鳥妖 孵化季節」將會產生更多的敵人。

1e3322ca03f82503bc8eb04d1d76abcc58b82b9a.source: Locate the ancient coffer of Palawa Joko.
1e3322ca03f82503bc8eb04d1d76abcc58b82b9a.text: 尋找 帕勒瓦‧傑格 的古老保險箱。

353b8d2b415293a6518b18e63b8f23a4cff0f3a3.source: Eliminate all hostiles and secure the coffer.
353b8d2b415293a6518b18e63b8f23a4cff0f3a3.text: 消滅所有敵人並保護金庫。

df2a3f00abf7671fb543e3dc8a2feab33a3141d1.source: Obtain the Scriptures of Abaddon from the ancient coffer.
df2a3f00abf7671fb543e3dc8a2feab33a3141d1.text: 從古老的保險箱中取得亞霸頓的經文。

4a617d4908fbccd1bc6ad1b2681920684600228a.source: See Belgun the Quarry Master for your reward.
4a617d4908fbccd1bc6ad1b2681920684600228a.text: 去見採石場大師貝爾根以獲得獎勵。

399f1a62e059211eb6248201d6c397b65786f955.source: Follow your quest pointer to find Jenahn and the Ancient Coffer. They are located in the north-west corner of Vehjin Mines, so if you already have the Basalt Grotto mapped, it is much quicker to start from there.
399f1a62e059211eb6248201d6c397b65786f955.text: 跟著你的任務指標找到傑納恩和遠古保險箱。它們位於 威金礦坑 的西北角，因此如果您已經映射了 玄武岩石穴，從那裡開始會更快。

8a062d677da16b2b9d6fa57ee88f445dc842c2f8.source: The area around the Coffer is patrolled by several groups of Margonites and Kournans, and as you approach the Coffer, Jenahn will open it for the Kournans and be killed for his trouble. After defeating the groups in the area around the Coffer, click on it to recover the scriptures of Abaddon for the Master of Whispers, then speak to Belgun for your reward.
8a062d677da16b2b9d6fa57ee88f445dc842c2f8.text: 金庫周圍的區域由幾組瑪貢人和庫爾南人巡邏，當你接近金庫時，傑納恩將為庫爾南人開啟它，並因他的麻煩而被殺。擊敗金庫周圍區域的團體後，點選它可以為密語大師取回 亞霸頓 的經文，然後與貝爾根交談以獲得獎勵。

00e0dfe864cb5781d0453ad2c02fc1fe182d5a51.source: If you don't want to fight through Vehjin Mines, start from Basalt Grotto.
00e0dfe864cb5781d0453ad2c02fc1fe182d5a51.text: 如果你不想打完威金礦坑，就從玄武岩石穴開始。
