b1ad06f1f00488271dae2dcaf0539a6da9add2be.source: With this quest active and with the party meeting the requirements of completing this quest, upon entering Vehjin Mines, the western portion of the area will be devoid of most of the normal spawns and kneeling at the shrine of Melandru will not summon the Melandru's Watcher (the other shrine works as usual).
b1ad06f1f00488271dae2dcaf0539a6da9add2be.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態且隊伍滿足完成此任務的要求時，進入 威金礦坑 後，該區域的西部部分將沒有大多數正常生成點，跪在 梅蘭朵 的神社不會召喚 梅蘭朵 的守望者（另一個神社照常工作）。

022f26d62551f60cb2971e3652841db12427d237.source: It has been reported that if the Scriptures of Abaddon is in your inventory, leaving this area before completing the quest will cause the quest objectives to reset in the quest log. The quest can still be completed from where you left off when you re-enter the area.
022f26d62551f60cb2971e3652841db12427d237.text: 據報道，如果亞霸頓的經文在你的庫存中，在完成任務之前離開該區域將導致任務日誌中的任務目標被重置。當您重新進入該區域時，任務仍然可以從您離開的地方完成。

289c482f9d079bc36429d6f0bab0606a258e2edb.source: Speak to Sif when you are ready to face the Glacial Griffon.
289c482f9d079bc36429d6f0bab0606a258e2edb.text: 當你準備好面對冰川獅鷲時，與希芙交談。

fc4bac11c2c92feb08209900b7506ac1081fd8ad.source: Destroy the Glacial Griffon and prove your valor to Sif. Earn your song!
fc4bac11c2c92feb08209900b7506ac1081fd8ad.text: 摧毀冰川獅鷲並向希芙證明你的勇氣。贏得你的歌！

f267b83f2983f929b57977cef4f11b24e9622d41.text: 綠色物品 拆解工具

7d0f71bc9bab6ef28bb587045c689f407f4dae08.source: Wurms and Jotun are themselves immune to knock down; Earthbind is the only skill that can bypass that immunity.
7d0f71bc9bab6ef28bb587045c689f407f4dae08.text: 亞龍和佐敦本身免疫擊倒； 地縛 是唯一可以繞過該免疫力的技能。

fdb3513b5d6435096f37b0ffeadb1792ac5f0e3d.source: The elemental mobs are vulnerable to fire-damage, however there are many spirits of Winter throughout the dungeon that convert elemental damage to cold damage.
fdb3513b5d6435096f37b0ffeadb1792ac5f0e3d.text: 元素生物很容易受到火焰傷害，但是整個地牢中有許多 寒冬 的靈魂，可以將元素傷害轉化為寒冷傷害。

4c66fda50f2b294b1118fa329ecfde2f84caec57.source: Nature's Renewal to mitigate damage and aid in interrupts; avoid using any hexes and non-dervish enchantments. When taking on the wurm mobs, put down Nature's Renewal, flag your team a bit closer to the fight, and then pull solo with a bow getting the agro on you/allies. This helps to keep the wurms from going after your casters and the NR spirit.
4c66fda50f2b294b1118fa329ecfde2f84caec57.text: 自然再生 用於減輕損壞並協助中斷；避免使用任何六角形和非苦行僧結界。當對付亞龍小怪時，放下 自然再生，標記你的團隊離戰鬥更近一點，然後用弓單獨拉，讓你/盟友獲得農業。這有助於防止亞龍追擊你的施法者和 NR 精魂。

9f35e26002a0b583eaf9dcabd260b180219d7fa4.source: Report to Tactician Haj once you have a Hero in your party to begin command training.
9f35e26002a0b583eaf9dcabd260b180219d7fa4.text: 當您的隊伍中有 英雄 後，向戰術家 Haj 報告，開始指揮訓練。

615e5930984f764d56a872d939b24bbf212a129c.source: Use your Hero to capture area one.
615e5930984f764d56a872d939b24bbf212a129c.text: 使用 英雄 佔領第一區域。

ca5512b8d702e30374b641210ac3499dcfccc472.source: Use your Hero to capture area two and area three.
ca5512b8d702e30374b641210ac3499dcfccc472.text: 使用 英雄 佔領區域二和區域三。

f08f350a026b94bea93bfeb9d8be238fe7a1e980.source: Order your Hero to return to area one.
f08f350a026b94bea93bfeb9d8be238fe7a1e980.text: 命令您的 英雄 返回第一區。

f1a4f971dcc1d895f8634a37869fc1ef3980607a.source: Speak with Second Spear Binah by the gate to Churrhir Fields to the South of First Spear Dehvad to gain access to Churrhir Fields. Follow Tactician Haj's directions in using flags to direct the Heroes to each Area when asked. The flags are located at the bottom of the compass. There is a flag for each individual Hero, as well as one for the entire group. By clicking on a flag, and then click on the compass, players can position the hero to this location. Tactician Haj commands the party to take Area One, Two and Three respectively. There are two very easy to dispose of Razorback Skale at Area Two and Three. When each area's "bar" changes from red to blue, the party controls that area. Once all three are captured, Tactician Haj directs the party to return to Area One. Disable the flags by double-clicking the flag button for that Hero or group, or the red icon with the white cross to the right of the hero flags. See First Spear Dehvad in the city for the reward.
f1a4f971dcc1d895f8634a37869fc1ef3980607a.text: 與位於第一個 矛 Dehvad 以南的 Churrir Fields 大門處的第二個 矛 Binah 交談，以進入 Churrir Fields。按照戰術家 Haj 的指示，在詢問時使用旗幟將英雄引導至每個區域。標誌位於指南針的底部。每個 英雄 都有一個標誌，整個團體也有一個標誌。透過點選旗幟，然後點選指南針，玩家可以將英雄定位到該位置。戰術家哈吉命令隊伍分別佔領一區、二區和三區。在第二區和第三區有兩個非常容易處置的 Razorback 鱗怪。當每個區域的「條」從紅色變為藍色時，該方就控制了該區域。一旦三人全部被抓獲，戰術家哈吉就會指示隊伍返回第一區。透過雙擊 英雄 或群組的標誌按鈕或英雄標誌右側帶有白色十字的紅色圖示來停用標誌。前往城市中的第一個 矛 Dehvad 獲取獎勵。

7da96fe1f434f574f364b09efecaaf0af0a53030.source: Be sure to look for Area signs. Hold down key to light up the yellow signs that represent each control area. Alternatively, use the map and look for flags there: a red flag is one of the areas captured by the enemy, a grey flag is an area that is not controlled by anyone, and a blue flag is an area the party is controlling.
7da96fe1f434f574f364b09efecaaf0af0a53030.text: 請務必尋找區域標誌。按住 鍵點亮代表每個控制區域的黃色標誌。或者，使用地圖並尋找那裡的旗幟：紅旗是敵人佔領的區域之一，灰旗是不受任何人控制的區域，藍旗是一方正在控制的區域。

8362d50a728adaed016320d86a0213e99828a6e4.source: Near Area Two, there is an NPC named Wounded Villager who is suffering from an unknown condition. If a hero has a condition removal skill, they will move out of the flag capture area to remove it. However, the hapless NPC's mystery condition is scripted and will be reapplied. This will trigger the hero to repeatedly cure this condition. For the sake of expediency, it may be best to capture Area Two using a hero without any condition removal ability, or simply key + click on the hero's condition removal skill to disable it.
8362d50a728adaed016320d86a0213e99828a6e4.text: 在第二區附近，有一個名為「受傷村民」的 NPC，患有某種不明疾病。如果英雄有條件移除技能，他們會移出奪旗區域來移除它。然而，倒楣的 NPC 的神秘條件是有劇本的，將會被重新應用。這將觸發英雄反覆治癒這種情況。為了方便起見，最好使用沒有任何狀態消除能力的英雄來佔領第二區域，或者直接按住英雄的狀態消除技能來停用它。

277181022f85c8d4d1af04784348fb5787256780.source: The easiest way to complete this mission is the following: Rather than first capturing Area One as instructed, capture the other two areas, then capture Area One. This prevents Razorback Skales from spawning at Area Two and Three as would otherwise occur.
277181022f85c8d4d1af04784348fb5787256780.text: 完成此任務的最簡單方法如下：不是先按照指示佔領一區，而是佔領其他兩個區域，然後佔領一區。這可以防止剃刀鯨骷髏在第二區和第三區生成，否則會發生這種情況。

2d7a72bf1d659cefee3fc3b320156d2308b91f78.source: Don't forget to open the Treasure Chest while you're there, if you haven't already done so recently.
2d7a72bf1d659cefee3fc3b320156d2308b91f78.text: 如果您最近還沒有開啟寶藏 寶箱，請不要忘記開啟它。

502b3c0201e79e7b33134e7aeacd26b1c48e6649.source: Go with the men of the village and Elder Olunideh and drive the corsairs away from Istani soil.
502b3c0201e79e7b33134e7aeacd26b1c48e6649.text: 與村裡的人和奧魯尼德長老一起去，將海盜從伊斯塔尼的土地上趕走。

e874d89493f15e959d258842bc9621dd66524053.source: See Elder Olunideh for your reward.
e874d89493f15e959d258842bc9621dd66524053.text: 去找奧魯尼德長老領獎勵。

52a7f2b98c5ec450e7a7038272c2228cd11c1645.source: Enter Mehtani Keys and meet up with Elder Olunideh and 4 Istani Commoners. This quest is almost exactly the same as the previous quest, but there are about 30 enemies instead of 10, separated into two groups of about 15 corsairs apiece. These groups can, with a bit of luck, be separated further into groups of four or five. Take out both groups and see Elder Olunideh for your reward.
52a7f2b98c5ec450e7a7038272c2228cd11c1645.text: 進入 梅坦尼之鑰 並與 Olunideh 長老和 4 伊斯坦尼平民會面。這個任務和之前的任務幾乎一模一樣，但是有大約30的敵人而不是10，分成兩組大約15的海盜。如果運氣好的話，這些小組可以進一步分成四人或五人一組。幹掉兩組人，去見奧魯尼德長老，領取獎勵。

e62f5d902f7314fae36d962d54266748fbdd4338.source: Find the Ascalon census in the ruins in Old Ascalon.
e62f5d902f7314fae36d962d54266748fbdd4338.text: 在 舊阿斯卡隆 的廢墟中找到 阿斯卡隆 人口普查。

143e1130c5fb5328f7c72dfea07985352ef2007a.source: Return to Symon the Scribe for your reward.
143e1130c5fb5328f7c72dfea07985352ef2007a.text: 影返 至 書記賽門 以獲得獎勵。

5467cb571ae7b44b338eb435ad49636e43ea49a4.source: Leave Ascalon City. Head southwest under the bridge past Warmaster Grast. Veer to the left past Ambassador Zain's camp down into the ditch (where the river was in pre-Searing Ascalon) and continue heading southwest. You'll face off against some Gargoyles and Devourers, but if you take on the groups one at a time, you'll have no problems getting to the chest containing the census.
5467cb571ae7b44b338eb435ad49636e43ea49a4.text: 離開 阿斯卡隆城。從橋下向西南行駛，經過 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特。向左轉，經過 大使薩因 的營地，進入溝渠（河流在 崩壞 阿斯卡隆 之前的位置），然後繼續向西南行進。你將面對一些石像鬼和 蠍，但如果你一次只對付一個小組，你將毫無問題地到達包含人口普查的箱子。

7d11c1f130b3d4c1c80a36b2855fa9e213854921.source: With the census in hand, go back to Ascalon City and give it to Symon the Scribe.
7d11c1f130b3d4c1c80a36b2855fa9e213854921.text: 掌握人口普查後，返回 阿斯卡隆城 並將其交給 書記賽門。

79ba3c714ced586e44d3b6afdf891735ee7e4dcd.source: Warrior primaries can complete Gargoyle Trouble while doing this quest. There are gargoyles down in the ditch that satisfy the requirements for that quest.
79ba3c714ced586e44d3b6afdf891735ee7e4dcd.text: 戰士 初選可以在執行此任務時完成 殺死石像鬼。溝裡有石像鬼，可以滿足任務的要求。

1c4cb9518cdc8908e8784e273052b4ae2a777d57.source: A quicker route is had by starting from Sardelac Sanitarium, and heading East.
1c4cb9518cdc8908e8784e273052b4ae2a777d57.text: 一條更快的路線是從 薩德拉克療養院 出發，向東行駛。

2d21bf98a51c926b82c5d7792f0c7b9bd67f656a.source: Escort Kauniss to Atrocity Library. Kauniss must survive.
2d21bf98a51c926b82c5d7792f0c7b9bd67f656a.text: 護送考尼斯前往暴力圖書館。考尼斯必須生存。

a5bfb2f1f947e37ddacb5097ce3019ee212d2455.source: Protect Kauniss while he casts the Incantation of Fog. Kauniss must survive.
a5bfb2f1f947e37ddacb5097ce3019ee212d2455.text: 在考尼斯施展霧咒時保護他。考尼斯必須生存。

645516e28ee04b9125ace7c51a1d697298d10722.source: See Keeper Kauniss for your reward.
645516e28ee04b9125ace7c51a1d697298d10722.text: 去找守護者考尼斯領獎勵。

db3500755d14e55db7835ec58502a94647f45c19.source: While in this area, your party suffers from the Veiled Nightmare environment effect (skills cost 40% more energy).
db3500755d14e55db7835ec58502a94647f45c19.text: 在這個區域中，您的隊伍會受到矇蔽 夢魘 環境效果的影響（技能會消耗 40% 更多能量）。

516619af45bd2c4d9c0f9c2fbc4f05b823064569.source: Faster, more difficult: Follow the Forgotten on its path. Kill any enemies attacking it.
516619af45bd2c4d9c0f9c2fbc4f05b823064569.text: 更快、更困難：跟隨 被遺忘者 的腳步。殺死任何攻擊它的敵人。

4069bb419c221587546dc710ba3131d05a162ead.source: Slower, easier: Learn the scripted path (see the map), clear any patrols on or near the route, then approach the Forgotten. It takes approximately ten minutes for it to reach the destination if the path is clear of foes.
4069bb419c221587546dc710ba3131d05a162ead.text: 更慢、更簡單：瞭解指令碼路徑（請參閱地圖），清除路線上或附近的所有巡邏，然後接近 被遺忘者。如果路徑上沒有敵人，它大約需要十分鐘才能到達目的地。

5c74de1325bebf2b0419de7beea53f4c465e5a00.source: Keeper Kauniss only joins your party when a member moves within its aggro range. Whenever it is not directly engaged by the enemy, the Forgotten will continue its route without waiting for you.
5c74de1325bebf2b0419de7beea53f4c465e5a00.text: 只有當成員移動到其仇恨範圍內時，守護者考尼斯才會加入你的隊伍。只要沒有與敵人直接交戰，被遺忘者 就會繼續其路線，不等您。

b106118b05f3717ed038ebfbaa3f2a13159f9516.source: The library is at the center of the Margonite stronghold just south of the Gate of Secrets; while there is a short, direct path to the library, Kauniss instead follows a long, winding route around the stronghold.
b106118b05f3717ed038ebfbaa3f2a13159f9516.text: 圖書館位於 瑪骨奈 要塞的中心，位於秘密之門以南；雖然有一條短而直接的路徑通往圖書館，但考尼斯卻沿著要塞周圍一條漫長而蜿蜒的路線走。

0403cfaa50b7e1e22ea54c5a8bdd97970e42c61d.source: You will face Margonites, Graven Monoliths, Shadow Army creatures, and Shiro'ken Assassins along the way. When Kauniss arrives at its destination, it will quickly cast the fog spell. After this, a group of Shiro'ken Assassins will spawn, but the quest will be completed. Kauniss is removed from the Ally list and the Shiro'ken cannot hurt him. Thus the quest cannot fail anymore.
0403cfaa50b7e1e22ea54c5a8bdd97970e42c61d.text: 一路上你將面對瑪貢石、墓碑、暗影軍團 生物和 白影軍團 刺客。當考尼斯到達目的地時，它會迅速施展霧咒。此後，一群 白影軍團 刺客將會出現，但任務將會完成。考尼斯已從盟友清單中刪除，白影軍團 無法傷害他。因此，任務不能再失敗了。

19db3f8b7458ef24394ed9e83a4f9e837c4d23a9.source: If Area Two and Area Three are captured before capturing Area One, the quest can be finished by capturing Area One last, without the Razorback Skales spawning. Scared Razorback Skales glitch. If the Razorback Skales enters the player's earshot range, they will attempt to run up and attack. Failing to reach, they then run away and the hero nor the Skales will initiate combat. If the hero leaves the area that the bugged Skales belong to, they will run back to it. The quest can still be finished if the player teleports down before completing all objectives. Although it says "Use your hero to capture area one" Mercenary Heroes do not count and will result in failing the quest. If the areas are "captured" before talking to Tactician Haj, they will display as such during the quest. This will only become noticeable after talking to him.
19db3f8b7458ef24394ed9e83a4f9e837c4d23a9.text: 如果在佔領一區之前佔領了二區和三區，則可以透過最後佔領一區來完成任務，而不會出現刀背斯卡勒斯。害怕的剃刀鯨斯卡萊斯出了故障。如果刀背骷髏進入玩家的聽力範圍，它們會嘗試跑起來攻擊。如果無法到達，他們就會逃跑，英雄和斯卡萊斯都會發起戰鬥。如果英雄離開被竊聽的斯卡萊斯所屬的區域，他們會跑回那裡。如果玩家在完成所有目標之前傳送下來，任務仍然可以完成。儘管上面寫著“使用你的英雄佔領一區”，但僱傭英雄並不計算在內，並且會導致任務失敗。如果這些區域在與戰術家哈吉交談之前被“佔領”，它們將在任務中如此顯示。這只有在與他交談後才會變得明顯。

12c4a39c6d3187a99d7ec3fc47e6bf25dcd1d4f8.source: Kill Commander Wahli in the Barbarous Shore.
12c4a39c6d3187a99d7ec3fc47e6bf25dcd1d4f8.text: 在 野蠻河岸 中殺死 指揮官 瓦里。

d454eadedbbe048bd51b20a4f433940a8c48481b.source: *BONUS* Kill Commander Wahli in Hard Mode.
d454eadedbbe048bd51b20a4f433940a8c48481b.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 指揮官 瓦里。

233e10042cbaf9b65826ae1b86cab2bda6687569.source: There are several patrols along the way a few can be avoided, watch out for overlapping patrols. Commander Wahli is surrounded by a huge mob, be prepared to retreat if overwhelmed especially in hard mode. If you resurrect, be careful as another group (including a Corsair boss) patrols very near the closest resurrection shrine to Wahli.
233e10042cbaf9b65826ae1b86cab2bda6687569.text: 沿途有幾個巡邏隊，有幾個是可以避開的，要注意重疊的巡邏隊。 指揮官 瓦里 被一大群暴徒包圍，如果被壓垮，請準備好撤退，尤其是在困難模式下。如果你復活了，請小心，因為另一支隊伍（包括 海盜 boss）正在離瓦赫利最近的復活神殿附近巡邏。

b9c59da1d36c74554608fe3064051658602eac4b.source: Of the three routes shown on the map to the right, the blue path has some easily avoidable Heket groups and later a few plant and elemental groups. The red path avoids most of the Corsair bosses, but does include a significant number of elemental foes. The Corsair bosses patrol fairly close together on the yellow path, but can be carefully pulled apart.
b9c59da1d36c74554608fe3064051658602eac4b.text: 在右側地圖上顯示的三條路線中，藍色路徑有一些容易避免的 青蛙族群 組，以及後來的一些植物和元素組。紅色路徑避開了大多數 海盜 Boss，但也包含了大量的元素敵人。 海盜 Boss 在黃色路徑上巡邏時距離相當近，但可以小心地拉開。

1741554f01aeaff3687be057ac5ddf0d1b392893.source: Monk, Necromancer or Ritualist as your primary or secondary profession.
1741554f01aeaff3687be057ac5ddf0d1b392893.text: 僧侶、死靈法師 或 祭祀者 作為您的主要或次要職業。

2173ad50158838f55ffa9b589be48c8b3041253f.source: Speak with Weng Gha again to begin the test.
2173ad50158838f55ffa9b589be48c8b3041253f.text: 再次與Weng Gha交談以開始測試。

94366fa19bdfe8041befd676cd5d35d28282fd3d.source: Survive for 2 minutes by removing Conditions as they are placed upon you.
94366fa19bdfe8041befd676cd5d35d28282fd3d.text: 透過消除施加在您身上的條件，可以生存 2 分鐘。

bc877f449d031ebf50a42106396237ca384847ff.source: The easiest way to fulfill this task is by attacking Weng Gha until his health bar turns green. It is possible to survive by removing all conditions for 2 minutes, but the aforementioned method is far preferable.
bc877f449d031ebf50a42106396237ca384847ff.text: 完成此任務最簡單的方法是攻擊Weng Gha，直到他的生命條變成綠色。透過消除 2 分鐘內的所有條件，可以生存，但上述方法要好得多。

a468c51b3979dc8da6822f92025ea596ba2dcb3d.source: Since the skills are given upon accepting this quest, you can actually learn all the skills. Simply take the quest, abandon it, switch secondary professions, then take the quest again. Repeat until your character learns all the skills.
a468c51b3979dc8da6822f92025ea596ba2dcb3d.text: 由於技能是在接受此任務時給予的，因此您實際上可以學習所有技能。只需接受任務，放棄它，切換次要職業，然後再次接受任務。重複直到你的角色學會所有技能。

7e3223e1b45e7e10726a134145c9cc9606a27f29.source: Although the dialogue mentions condition removal, Ritualists receive Resilient Weapon, a skill that mitigates, but does not remove conditions.
7e3223e1b45e7e10726a134145c9cc9606a27f29.text: 儘管對話提到了條件移除，但儀式主義者會收到 活力武裝，這是一種可以緩解但不會移除條件的技能。

1f81f777c79ff991effba3a4e8180c956d176461.source: Take Dunkoro and join the assault on Gandara.
1f81f777c79ff991effba3a4e8180c956d176461.text: 佔領敦科羅並加入對甘達拉的攻擊。

c28693d4cc21fa91298a2efc9db118ce964e63b3.source: As per the Consulate Docks mission.

192faa2da4155aa9b9daf15e1923e19d684f0b71.source: Go with Rahlon and protect the village from corsairs.
192faa2da4155aa9b9daf15e1923e19d684f0b71.text: 和拉隆一起保護村莊免受海盜襲擊。

1be7045a175deeba848b6a1c0d12918c3f53c567.source: Eradicate the corsairs in Mehtani Keys.
1be7045a175deeba848b6a1c0d12918c3f53c567.text: 消滅 梅坦尼之鑰 中的海盜。

58116386c771f86ea389a334d8271c44983ff371.source: Speak with Elder Olunideh for your reward.
58116386c771f86ea389a334d8271c44983ff371.text: 與奧魯尼德長老交談以獲得獎勵。

0c1a9caeb7ff9771963155193491c6c7629f8937.source: [Incomplete source section] Meet Rahlon right outside the gate of Kodlonu Hamlet and head south to the corsair camp shown on the map. Rahlon does not need to survive to complete the quest. There are about 10 corsairs at the camp and one corsair boss. Kill them all and go back to Kodlonu Hamlet to get your reward.
0c1a9caeb7ff9771963155193491c6c7629f8937.text: [不完整的來源部分] 在科德洛努哈姆雷特的大門外與拉隆會面，然後向南前往地圖上所示的海盜營地。拉隆不需要生存就能完成任務。營地中有大約 10 海盜和一名海盜頭目。殺死他們所有人並返回科德洛努哈姆雷特以獲得獎勵。

da93067bb7055919894f8ee1760642efea891ca2.source: The Sunspear Scout at the resurrection shrine just north of the camp offers a Corsair Bounty for a few extra Sunspear rank points.
da93067bb7055919894f8ee1760642efea891ca2.text: 營地北部復活神殿的陽矛偵察兵會提供 海盜 賞金，以獲得一些額外的 日戟 點數。

13de0f715399ebd01b4b3b47ce620d1f5c82445f.source: Chests might spawn in Keeper Kauniss path, making the quest impossible to complete.
13de0f715399ebd01b4b3b47ce620d1f5c82445f.text: 箱子可能會在守護者考尼斯的路徑中生成，使任務無法完成。

2b0c118dc589eac0ae9cff653406148f511b67dc.source: Go to Lahtenda Bog and tell Necromancer Lahse you will be her guide.
2b0c118dc589eac0ae9cff653406148f511b67dc.text: 前往 洛天帝沼澤 並告訴 死靈法師 Lahse 你將成為她的嚮導。

e081f43e40781bfdbc3328a826e9df781d753454.source: Take Necromancer Lahse to the Sunspear Crypts and protect her along the way.
e081f43e40781bfdbc3328a826e9df781d753454.text: 帶著 死靈法師 Lahse 前往陽矛墓穴並一路保護她。

7aaa49c32594cd6aebd98ab55148456baf543fc6.source: See Necromancer Lahse for your reward.
7aaa49c32594cd6aebd98ab55148456baf543fc6.text: 請參閱 死靈法師 Lahse 以獲得獎勵。

24a0d74a8e770a33eb663c5f899425c3218fb9cd.source: Follow map through the swamp, killing the various creatures that pop-up along the way, such as Mandragors and the roaming Insects. Necromancer Lahse seems to be basically untargeted by foes so you don't need to worry about her - provided she does not get stuck. It is a good idea after turning this quest in to stay and do her next one (Ghosts in the Graveyard), as it's also in the area and is very short.
24a0d74a8e770a33eb663c5f899425c3218fb9cd.text: 按照地圖穿過沼澤，殺死沿途出現的各種生物，例如曼陀羅和漫遊的昆蟲。 死靈法師 拉赫斯似乎基本上不會成為敵人的目標，因此你無需擔心她 - 只要她不被卡住即可。在完成這個任務後，最好留下來完成她的下一個任務（墓地裡的鬼魂），因為它也在該地區，而且時間很短。

dc1abe155b0d613064ac0ba4cfc3d77919756351.source: This quest can be combined with the quest To Ask For More as the both lead to the same spot in Lahtenda bog
dc1abe155b0d613064ac0ba4cfc3d77919756351.text: 這個任務可以與「要求更多」任務結合起來，因為兩者都會通往拉赫滕達沼澤的同一個地點

0e704cc5aaae7ce77e9d42d58e7eb465c8f82a9f.source: You can also do the quest Wandered Off Again while working on this quest.
0e704cc5aaae7ce77e9d42d58e7eb465c8f82a9f.text: 你也可以在做這個任務的同時做任務「再次流浪」。

92bc74ee8fca883266260283ea7db4a67771ecb3.text: 擊敗 怪異雙頭巨人。

861d325f477efcd9489b9213d300de7fe7da042c.source: Return the spectral crystal to Saerin for a reward.
861d325f477efcd9489b9213d300de7fe7da042c.text: 影返 將光譜水晶交給 Saerin 作為獎勵。

0593707325fd67091a6e9c9c7e666bfdf3c1bc0d.source: Head towards the Bloodstone Caves by going east through southern Sparkfly Swamp, enter the dungeon by walking through the portal, do not use the Inscription Stone. Once inside, attack the Forge Masters first, this will cause their associated Enchanted Shields to vanish. Melee counter skills are recommended.
0593707325fd67091a6e9c9c7e666bfdf3c1bc0d.text: 透過 火星蠅沼澤 南部向東前往 血石洞，透過傳送門進入地牢，不要使用 鑄印 石頭。進入內部後，首先攻擊鍛造大師，這將導致其相關的 附魔 護盾消失。推薦使用肉搏反擊技能。

675ff7a274df56ca104956abc49ba11472fffc92.source: In the first level, go to the center to fight the Paranoia Ettin to obtain the Dungeon Key to access the second level, then walk northeast to engage the First Inscribed, open the Dungeon Lock.
675ff7a274df56ca104956abc49ba11472fffc92.text: 在第一層，去中心與偏執狂雙頭巨人戰鬥，獲得地監 鑰匙進入第二層，然後向東北走與第一個銘刻者交戰，開啟地監鎖定。

64f820393704ac54b4e55a05b4955309540d134e.source: The second level, is a narrow corridor, proceed forward and avoid fighting/standing too long over the Poison Spouts. Soon, you will find the Crystal Ettin walking by a structure composed by columns with several non-hostile NPCs around. Once you engage the Ettin, those skeletons will turn hostile and surround you, since there's too many of them, retreat and fight small numbers so that you are not overwhelmed. Obtain the Dungeon Key and continue towards the next level. While the hostile Skeletons don't disappear after killing the boss, unlike how it is in the mission that also takes place here, they can be avoided entirely by heading back to the room's entrance and heading south along the east wall right next to the resurrection shrine.
64f820393704ac54b4e55a05b4955309540d134e.text: 第二層是一條狹窄的走廊，向前走並避免在 中毒 噴口上戰鬥/站立太久。很快，您就會發現水晶 雙頭巨人 走過一個由柱子組成的結構，周圍有幾個非敵對的 NPC。一旦你與 雙頭巨人 交戰，這些骷髏就會變得敵對並包圍你，因為它們數量太多，會撤退並與少數人戰鬥，這樣你就不會被壓垮。獲得 地監 鑰匙 並繼續進入下一級。雖然敵對骷髏在殺死 Boss 後不會消失，但與這裡發生的任務不同，可以通過返回房間入口並沿著復活神殿旁邊的東牆向南走來完全避免它們。

c9dcfbd537a98240d1229ca6671c297c681279fc.source: The third and last level has Poison Jets, fight away from them to reduce pressure and if possible make foes stand by a Poison Spout to ease your battles. At the final chamber, there will be three groups of foes moving around; killing the First Inscribeds as well as the Eldritch Ettin will make all other enemies disappear; this means you only need to concentrate your firepower on three targets only. Each First Inscribed and its group can be pulled away from the others so that you can fight one group at a time. Finally once the Eldritch is killed, pick up the Spectral Crystal to claim the quest rewards and also don`t forget to open the reward chest.
c9dcfbd537a98240d1229ca6671c297c681279fc.text: 第三個也是最後一個關卡有 中毒 噴射機，遠離它們以減輕壓力，如果可能的話，讓敵人站在 中毒 噴口旁邊以緩解戰鬥。在最後一個房間裡，將有三組敵人在四處移動；殺死第一個銘刻者以及 怪異雙頭巨人 將使所有其他敵人消失；這意味著您只需將火力集中在三個目標上。每個第一銘刻者及其小組都可以從其他小組中拉開，以便您可以一次與一個小組戰鬥。最後，當惡魔被殺後，拿起光譜水晶來領取任務獎勵，同時不要忘記開啟獎勵箱。

db6ab059dcc65b1865d5a18622c7fe60b1f7480c.source: The Blade's Essence and The Arrow's Point can be completed at the same time, but only this quest can be repeated.
db6ab059dcc65b1865d5a18622c7fe60b1f7480c.text: 刀鋒的模板:Reclaim Essence和箭尖可以同時完成，但只有這個任務可以重複。

4579f336a291cd568b3813fead75062c1ddf8ad5.source: Bloodstone Cave appears to be blocked by a door, but you can walk through it to cross the portal. On very rare occasions, the Spectral Crystal does not drop, forcing you to return to the dungeon.
4579f336a291cd568b3813fead75062c1ddf8ad5.text: 血石 洞穴似乎被門擋住了，但你可以穿過它穿過傳送門。在極少數情況下，光譜水晶不會掉落，迫使你返回地牢。

5971bda523f9dbd6090874b17a43a8191e4a844d.source: Clear the Crystal Overlook in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
5971bda523f9dbd6090874b17a43a8191e4a844d.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的荒蕪之地中的水晶高地。

2741d4a9ae336f0922f069c13d2d925dd183ef1e.source: "Clear the Crystal Overlook in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
2741d4a9ae336f0922f069c13d2d925dd183ef1e.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的荒蕪之地中的水晶高地。”

85a529905b0eeda8a8bfccf841a4f5c6d1813049.source: You can only reach this area by crossing from one of the three adjoining explorable areas: the Alkali Pan, the Arid Sea, or The Ruptured Heart; it is not connected to any outpost or town. You can complete the Nightfall storyline without visiting this area, which is the site of a single secondary quest (Family Soul, which requires access to Prophecies) and one Zaishen Bounty.
85a529905b0eeda8a8bfccf841a4f5c6d1813049.text: 你只能透過三個相鄰的可探索區域之一到達該區域：鹼鍋、乾旱海或 破裂之心；它不與任何前哨站或城鎮相連。您無需造訪該區域即可完成 黑暗逆襲 故事情節，該區域是次要任務（家庭靈魂，需要存取 阿斯卡隆戰記）和一個 戰承懸賞 的地點。

fca8b1a441ae359c6b51fc4b7039c44cbaba8a20.source: There is a Forgotten Guardian in the northwest corner of the map that allows travel to the Arid Sea (a region in the Crystal Desert of Prophecies). However, your account must have access to the Prophecies campaign and your current character must have completed the Sanctum Cay mission. Party members who do not meet these conditions will be left behind.
fca8b1a441ae359c6b51fc4b7039c44cbaba8a20.text: 地圖西北角有一個被遺忘者 守護者，可以前往乾旱海（水晶沙漠或阿斯卡隆戰記中的區域）。但是，您的帳戶必須有權存取 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動，並且您目前的角色必須已完成 神聖沙灘 任務。不符合這些條件的 隊伍 成員將被拋在後面。

54450cb48ade81839f51e10e475aebb143b31cca.source: The quest Family Soul affects the spawns in this area.
54450cb48ade81839f51e10e475aebb143b31cca.text: 任務「家族靈魂」會影響該區域的生成點。

2416c64bb2b5a3e50b2764c09b131c130967ad6e.source: There is an ancient structure at the very center of the map, inside the Sulfurous Haze area. Zehtuka's Great Horn may be found there, along with a Searing Cauldron.
2416c64bb2b5a3e50b2764c09b131c130967ad6e.text: 地圖的正中心有一座古老的建築，位於硫磺霧霾區域內。澤圖卡的大號角和 崩壞 大鍋都可以在那裡找到。

5f3f11e2016e780a18bf3d72428c1896cc3368ec.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.8% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
5f3f11e2016e780a18bf3d72428c1896cc3368ec.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Elonian 版圖 主打歌貢獻了約 2.8%。

51147ebb81243c56606640bb80883acbc92b2907.source: Only the central sulfurous area and two sandy areas can be cleared while inside a Junundu.
51147ebb81243c56606640bb80883acbc92b2907.text: 在 Junundu 內，只能清理中央硫磺區域和兩個沙質區域。

0daff0fdad163bfac5fdd282750f89d90c4b87c5.source: Apart from two spots where Desert Wurms and the graveyard where Restless Dead may appear, there are no hidden groups.
0daff0fdad163bfac5fdd282750f89d90c4b87c5.text: 除了沙漠亞龍可能出現的兩個地點和不安死者的墓地之外，沒有隱藏的群體。

aad51ed71ab17b781ae7dbc3949d21f8b60c0f30.source: There are a couple of easy to miss Djinn groups directly west of The Ruptured Heart exit.
aad51ed71ab17b781ae7dbc3949d21f8b60c0f30.text: 破裂之心 出口以西有幾個很容易錯過的 巨靈怪 組。

3d2f30d68a5269428ea355bdad3d1690af19c5f8.source: This area is relatively mild and easy compared to the other areas in the Desolation.
3d2f30d68a5269428ea355bdad3d1690af19c5f8.text: 與 荒蕪之地 中的其他區域相比，該區域相對溫和且容易。

96299df8264b96f80481b96fd90f4dd1387c83ca.source: Help Jora track and defeat the Nornbear.
96299df8264b96f80481b96fd90f4dd1387c83ca.text: 幫助 喬拉 追蹤並擊敗諾恩熊。

d14570e9dd11a13a80d91065d477ed4360e8e83b.source: As per Curse of the Nornbear.
d14570e9dd11a13a80d91065d477ed4360e8e83b.text: 根據 諾恩熊的詛咒。

322b44e7d79b04183bfb31e227d696e4ec5e94f4.source: Clear the Cursed Lands in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
322b44e7d79b04183bfb31e227d696e4ec5e94f4.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 詛咒之地。

dc3b3523bbb916a606a7c09019b22436d5987c67.source: "Clear the Cursed Lands in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."
dc3b3523bbb916a606a7c09019b22436d5987c67.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 詛咒之地。”

b7c2344935ecb5f22c95210d535a23178aa12479.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title
b7c2344935ecb5f22c95210d535a23178aa12479.text: 對該區域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.4% 的貢獻

1e88ce0239eb8bae98f8ba7816ec25339438984f.source: This explorable area is on the only direct route from Lion's Arch to the Temple of the Ages and between the outpost Bergen Hot Springs and the Temple.
1e88ce0239eb8bae98f8ba7816ec25339438984f.text: 此可探索區域位於從 獅子拱門 到 世紀神殿 以及前哨站 卑爾根溫泉 和神殿之間的唯一直接路線。

e3439309c7b28b0b197508d9610a589d2f168fcc.source: Vanquishing: 72–83 foes. There are a lot of hidden Grasping Ghouls.
e3439309c7b28b0b197508d9610a589d2f168fcc.text: 擊敗：72–83 敵人。有很多隱藏的抓握食屍鬼。

2a666b191296fdce22c7bf034c91a4be099c68cc.source: Consider starting from Temple of the Ages to get a party size of 8. Also, the path through the Black Curtain has fewer foes than the one through Nebo Terrace if you start from Bergen Hot Springs. With your party of 8, you can also consider caravan vanquishing by continuing with your party of 8 into Nebo Terrace and beyond.
2a666b191296fdce22c7bf034c91a4be099c68cc.text: 考慮從 世紀神殿 開始以獲得 8 的聚會規模。另外，如果你從 卑爾根溫泉 開始，穿過黑幕的路徑比穿過 尼伯山丘 的敵人少。與您的 8 隊伍一起，您也可以考慮透過繼續您的 8 隊伍進入 尼伯山丘 及更高版本來征服商隊。

828d1a9d80a042adcf0c6be61d25ff3332b2ded7.source: Beware of the central area on this map where two groups of Skeleton Mesmers and Damned Clerics are packed together with Zombie Warlocks. The warlocks stand on a slope where they can comfortably spawn bone minions each time you kill a foe. If you are coming from one of the exits to the Black Curtain, it is advisable to run past this mob and approach it from the other side, where you can engage the warlocks alone and retain a height advantage over the mesmers and clerics. Note that if your party is wiped when you are a bit further from the group, you will resurrect at the shrine close to the exit to Nebo Terrace - which is not an altogether unwise strategy if you can spare the death penalty.
828d1a9d80a042adcf0c6be61d25ff3332b2ded7.text: 小心這張地圖的中心區域，那裡有兩群 骷髏 幻術師和該死牧師與殭屍術士擠在一起。術士站在斜坡上，每次你殺死敵人時，他們都可以輕鬆地生成骨頭小兵。如果你從黑幕的一個出口出來，建議跑過這個怪物並從另一側接近它，在那裡你可以單獨與術士交戰，並保持相對於催眠師和牧師的高度優勢。請注意，如果您的隊伍在離隊伍稍遠的時候被消滅，您將在靠近 尼伯山丘 出口的神社復活 - 如果您可以免於死刑，這並不是一個完全不明智的策略。

657d7c3152d0e5263eae00d597074cbde240d296.source: Cleanse Hakewood of undead and retrieve the Scepter of Orr.
657d7c3152d0e5263eae00d597074cbde240d296.text: 清除哈克伍德的亡靈並取回 歐爾 的權杖。

e77d615c6258b3a909c14967eb6f50bd2edf6ac9.source: *BONUS* Make an offering to the statue of Melandru.
e77d615c6258b3a909c14967eb6f50bd2edf6ac9.text: *獎勵* 向 梅蘭朵 雕像獻祭。

46cd010363eb1f6002b5b61618d873e35f3c8c24.text: 根據 達雷西海濱 任務。

28df7ee295fedfc5606de9c362a84f359ac7cf37.source: Assault the corsair guild halls and defeat their Guild Lords.
28df7ee295fedfc5606de9c362a84f359ac7cf37.text: 攻擊海盜公會大廳並擊敗他們的 公會 領主。

5346e323747891f394225e79399669f1748ff95f.source: Defeat the corsair Guild Lords to move to the next island.
5346e323747891f394225e79399669f1748ff95f.text: 擊敗海盜船 公會 領主，移動到下一個島嶼。

5749a0c7ac2598ed554b32578360859aa8e480b8.source: Use the portal to access the next island.
5749a0c7ac2598ed554b32578360859aa8e480b8.text: 使用傳送門進入下一個島嶼。

933c184d4fa6d933a7d5f83fc847b9de8e9c7c60.source: Kill Corsair commanders to gain extra time.
933c184d4fa6d933a7d5f83fc847b9de8e9c7c60.text: 殺死 海盜 指揮官以獲得額外時間。

c8d327bef054356c304c274483665b48b5966c41.source: Scoring in this mission rewards experience and gold base on the formulas below. Values are rounded down. An additional bonus is given for achieving daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best.
c8d327bef054356c304c274483665b48b5966c41.text: 在此任務中得分將根據以下公式獎勵經驗和金幣。值向下舍入。達到每日最佳、每月最佳或季度最佳的成績可獲得額外獎金。

37b9ba21d8f8aeaf730f5e8e89a9a3aabfbf5ba1.source: Guild Lords have a chance to drop Stolen Sunspear Armor which will automatically appear in one player's inventory.
37b9ba21d8f8aeaf730f5e8e89a9a3aabfbf5ba1.text: 公會 領主有機會掉落被盜的陽矛 防禦，它會自動出現在一個玩家的庫存中。

2a383a22ab41ed5545e7b0acdc56718af4ead0d4.source: Corsair Commanders will give 5 seconds less time bonus for every 2 cycles.
2a383a22ab41ed5545e7b0acdc56718af4ead0d4.text: 海盜 對於每個 2 迴圈，指揮官會給予 5 秒少的時間獎勵。

07029e8a81252df471243e2facd3fc0a92b286ed.source: The challenge starts with a 60 second countdown before the gate opens allowing you access.
07029e8a81252df471243e2facd3fc0a92b286ed.text: 挑戰從 60 秒倒數開始，然後大門開啟，允許您進入。

e9967cdc635a90fb5622c724787d77044b43e79f.source: The opening of the gate starts a 10 minute countdown timer and each Guild Lord killed adds 1 minute to the timer.
e9967cdc635a90fb5622c724787d77044b43e79f.text: 大門開啟會啟動 10 分鐘倒數計時器，每殺死一個 公會 領主就會在計時器中加入 1 分鐘。

aafdaaadc83b74d7274065c17545bdbe27ef478b.source: There are three maps: The first with one Guild Lord, the later ones with two Guild Lords each. All Guild Lords on a map need to be killed before the portal to the next map is activated.
aafdaaadc83b74d7274065c17545bdbe27ef478b.text: 共有三張地圖：第一張地圖有一個 公會 領主，後面的地圖各有兩位 公會 領主。在啟動下一張地圖的傳送門之前，需要先殺死地圖上的所有 公會 領主。

d9ca8fb0b1ec1d1a6b8064d64768e7b745269528.source: On maps with two Guild Lords, one Guild Lord needs to be killed first to open up the gates of the other Guild Lord's hall (the one to kill first is always the south-western one).
d9ca8fb0b1ec1d1a6b8064d64768e7b745269528.text: 在有兩個 公會 領主的地圖上，需要先殺死一個 公會 領主才能開啟另一個 公會 領主大廳的大門（第一個殺死的總是西南方向的領主）。

3b307fd4d83cdbbefcdc23a4bcab905b3ff07843.source: After completing the first cycle of maps, the final warp takes you back to the beginning, and you can go through again with higher level enemies such as the Corsair Commanders, which add +30 seconds to your remaining time in addition to the guild lord time bonus. Each fortress has two commanders, except for the first.
3b307fd4d83cdbbefcdc23a4bcab905b3ff07843.text: 完成第一個地圖週期後，最後的扭曲會帶你回到起點，你可以再次遇到更高階別的敵人，例如 海盜 指揮官，除了公會領主時間獎勵之外，它們還會為你的剩餘時間新增 +30 秒。每個要塞都有兩名指揮官，除了第一位指揮官。

ba69ebae2f27ff1378650bbc60cea0281e0a4a95.source: After completing the second cycle of maps, invulnerable Corsair Ghosts will start to appear throughout the mission.
ba69ebae2f27ff1378650bbc60cea0281e0a4a95.text: 完成第二個地圖週期後，無敵的 海盜 幽靈將開始在整個任務中出現。

35000121ddd17c81dc46f275924eb5d9c5068a50.source: For the first 200 or so points, speed is of the essence and the time will be declining. But after that there is a huge shift in how the game is played. By the time you get to 300-350 points, tanking is essential and you will experience getting hit for up to 4-500 points per hit if you are a low AL target. There is however very little enchantment removal present, so Protective Spirit and Spirit Bond will be a great combination for keeping the tank alive and should be enough by itself. By the time you hit 500 points you will experience fighting as many as 12 level 28 bosses at the same time which all have AoE damage strong enough to single handedly wipe the team alone with one or two attacks.
35000121ddd17c81dc46f275924eb5d9c5068a50.text: 對於第一個 200 左右的點，速度至關重要，時間將會減少。但在那之後，遊戲的玩法發生了巨大的轉變。當您達到 300-350 點時，坦克至關重要，如果您是低 AL 目標，每次命中您將體驗到最多 4-500 點。然而，存在的結界移除非常少，因此 精神守護 和 精神連結 將是保持坦克活力的絕佳組合，並且本身就足夠了。當您達到 500 點時，您將同時與多達 12 等級的 28 頭目戰鬥，這些頭目都具有 範圍性 傷害，足以透過一兩次攻擊單槍匹馬消滅整個團隊。

44a2b7d9586ba0995af4cb32c8f76c9e28ce657a.source: Pain Inverter will deal massive damage.
44a2b7d9586ba0995af4cb32c8f76c9e28ce657a.text: 苦痛 逆變器將造成巨大損壞。

5318edcffc256b2fb2ec3cc9b7e70839d27ab9da.source: The chances of an armor drop are increased as you get more points, armors are also rewarded for breaking the daily or monthly record.
5318edcffc256b2fb2ec3cc9b7e70839d27ab9da.text: 積分越多，掉落護甲的機率就會越高，打破每日或每月記錄也會獲得護甲獎勵。

1f83bf8f5dd83f05d6e30d1b9a02946280505949.source: Heavy condition removal helps a lot with the speed in the beginning.
1f83bf8f5dd83f05d6e30d1b9a02946280505949.text: 沉重 條件刪除對於提高開始時的速度有很大幫助。

8eb1e6ca14c189b5caba19be50e5984168ad9078.source: The first map re-uses the Uncharted Isle guild hall map, the second map the Isle of Solitude one. The third one resembles a guild hall, but no such guild hall is available in the game.
8eb1e6ca14c189b5caba19be50e5984168ad9078.text: 第一張地圖重新使用了神秘島公會大廳地圖，第二張地圖則使用了孤獨島地圖。第三個類似公會大廳，但遊戲中沒有這樣的公會大廳。

9694bae3c3d565c3517ffa75447cc981b631bbaf.source: Unlike most challenge missions, enemies in this mission drop loot.
9694bae3c3d565c3517ffa75447cc981b631bbaf.text: 與大多數挑戰任務不同，此任務中的敵人會掉落戰利品。

c682f75a9e2e12ba94b6e9c96c18342c6cb4a740.source: Enemies that have been killed in a previous round and respawned will not give additional experience or loot. Respawned Corsair Commanders will not recharge skills or give a morale boost, but Corsair Guild Lords will.
c682f75a9e2e12ba94b6e9c96c18342c6cb4a740.text: 在上一輪被殺死並重生的敵人不會提供額外的經驗或戰利品。重生的 海盜 指揮官不會恢復技能或提升士氣，但 海盜 公會 領主會。

dc6b8e128b4fdc16e6a0591497aa278920a0d0b9.source: A video walkthrough for the mission can be found here.
dc6b8e128b4fdc16e6a0591497aa278920a0d0b9.text: 可以在此處找到該任務的視訊演練。

1cecfcad42d32f76d9c5e9e4673fd2c78344029f.source: Clear Dalada Uplands in the Charr Homelands of all enemies in hard mode.
1cecfcad42d32f76d9c5e9e4673fd2c78344029f.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 夏爾家園區 中的 達拉達山地。

2bde2942600b8526c4c1f594473942c858753e00.source: "Clear Dalada Uplands in the Charr Homelands of all enemies in hard mode."
2bde2942600b8526c4c1f594473942c858753e00.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的夏爾家園區中的達拉達山地。”

e9eec971e879ece0ebb3835ef284f23e289201c3.source: Note that there are about 15 stone fury in a cave along the eastern flank.
e9eec971e879ece0ebb3835ef284f23e289201c3.text: 請注意，東側的一個洞穴中有大約 15 石怒。

53e69688dcb64cfc83e4cb6767eb431640343a6a.source: Beware of Molotov Rocktail, even in normal mode as it has double the usual aggro range and Devourer Siege can cause party wipe.
53e69688dcb64cfc83e4cb6767eb431640343a6a.text: 小心 石尾 摩洛托夫，即使在正常模式下也是如此，因為它的仇恨範圍是通常的兩倍，而 蠍 Siege 可能會導致隊伍被消滅。

b0694b57fdceda109b74223dba442e394729145d.source: As you approach the wide open space in the center, keep an eye out for the approaching Molotov. Spread out and activate defenses before engaging.
b0694b57fdceda109b74223dba442e394729145d.text: 當您接近中心廣闊的空地時，請留意正在接近的莫洛托夫。在交戰前分散並啟動防禦。

2270c366bf04127ee903499529475d5e6c3934cc.source: There are two hidden Rockshot Devourers at Molotov's spawn location.
2270c366bf04127ee903499529475d5e6c3934cc.text: 在莫洛托夫的出生位置有兩個隱藏的 Rockshot 蠍。

51b2d7e70457d980a431c8bc6a4fc602d2b794f2.source: There are several Charr groups that consist of only Charr Seekers. Spread out before engaging as they can easily kill bunched up heroes and henchmen.
51b2d7e70457d980a431c8bc6a4fc602d2b794f2.text: 有多個僅由 夏爾 搜尋者組成的 夏爾 群組。在交戰前分散開來，因為他們可以輕鬆殺死成群結隊的英雄和追隨者。

36acf16114922c98ebca017d134c2074543f5b76.source: As with any area in the Charr Homelands, if at least two player characters are in the party, several Siege Devourer can be mounted which can make vanquishing much easier.
36acf16114922c98ebca017d134c2074543f5b76.text: 與 夏爾家園區 中的任何區域一樣，如果隊伍中至少有兩名玩家角色，則可以安裝多個 Siege 蠍，這可以使征服變得更加容易。

a4af11309003cb69adc9a58756f5d263568e6d5a.source: Defeat the Emissary of Dhuum and close the gateway to the Jahai Bluffs.
a4af11309003cb69adc9a58756f5d263568e6d5a.text: 擊敗 多姆 的使者並關閉通往 夏亥峭壁 的大門。

6c0c3c01bf75eab03c1479bf43fb052dabb9f09e.source: Head to Nightfallen Jahai and defeat the Emissary to complete this quest. Approaching nearby range will cause torment creatures to spawn after a short delay. Refrain melee characters from engagement to save trouble, although is just one group.
6c0c3c01bf75eab03c1479bf43fb052dabb9f09e.text: 前往墮夜精靈賈海並擊敗使者即可完成此任務。接近附近範圍會導致折磨生物在短暫延遲後生成。避免近戰角色參與戰鬥以節省麻煩，儘管只是一組。

2bf6b4d8da9207e4c755d712657a3bcb6c8cdf45.source: The gate in the first room, next to the Scrap of Parchment, will not open without the required quest.
2bf6b4d8da9207e4c755d712657a3bcb6c8cdf45.text: 第一個房間的大門位於羊皮紙碎片旁邊，如果沒有所需的任務，大門將不會開啟。

98e197dd558d24f853d4354f8322e261c1033023.source: Picking up the Dungeon Key on the first level will disable the Ice Dart traps.
98e197dd558d24f853d4354f8322e261c1033023.text: 在第一層拾取 地監 鑰匙 將停用冰鏢陷阱。

2e0e913738bfe178d03495dcacbd1b5a428bcf27.source: Pull the small groups around the end boss, until there is only Havok Soulwail and a few other Jotun.
2e0e913738bfe178d03495dcacbd1b5a428bcf27.text: 拉出 三五成群地圍著末地老大，直到只剩下 霍克 靈嘆 和其他幾個佐敦。

d568eb8042aa0317f04b49f38995572a7ac97563.source: After killing the end boss, Havok's Chest spawns.
d568eb8042aa0317f04b49f38995572a7ac97563.text: 殺死最終 Boss 後，Havok 的 寶箱 就會出現。

ea3ccef1a98815fd4d6d76a50847d1ca317f769c.source: The Stone Summit listed in the dungeon are no threat as they are being constantly wiped out by the Jotun every time they are encountered.
ea3ccef1a98815fd4d6d76a50847d1ca317f769c.text: 地牢中列出的 石峰矮人 並不構成威脅，因為每次遇到它們都會被佐敦消滅。

1b4c544e185d1bcbc6fcc5b210b8f7123a7c476f.source: The location of the Area Map in level 3 may not be correct. It may be just inside and to the left of the entry at the end of the dead end trail shown.
1b4c544e185d1bcbc6fcc5b210b8f7123a7c476f.text: 3 等級中區域地圖的位置可能不正確。它可能就在所示死衚衕盡頭入口的左側。

f5218833cb499c99ab5ffe1b9ba274bd0ff08ad9.source: The southern end of level 3 contains a switch that opens a secret door on the east side of the map. Inside are four Hidden Treasures and a Dwarven Ghost.
f5218833cb499c99ab5ffe1b9ba274bd0ff08ad9.text: 3 關卡的南端有一個開關，可以開啟地圖東側的秘密門。裡面有四個隱藏寶藏和一個矮人幽靈。

4394a2bde280679a927645e1887a27222a987943.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #5 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
4394a2bde280679a927645e1887a27222a987943.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#5 頁。

7a0ace90f6b9235ed1e1a6086d90bad5feb28cae.source: Close to the start of the level, a massive snowball will be sent towards you but can be easily avoided by keeping close to the right hand wall. Go southwest through the opening and follow the map to the Dwarven Powder keg station - grab a keg and blow up the southern door. Follow the right wall, and then kill the Havok-kin you encounter, who drops a key. Blow up the ice wall with the keg, kill the Jotun group, and then unlock the gate with the key. Either cross the near bridge if it is down, or head north to the other bridge to cross the chasm. There will be groups of Vaettir that popup. Continue south and then pull the lever to lower the bridge - cross it and pickup the key (be careful not to harm yourself by triggering the Ice Jet traps). More Vaettir spawns will appear on the cleared path after pulling the lever. Backtrack and unlock the gate, and then continue to the portal.
7a0ace90f6b9235ed1e1a6086d90bad5feb28cae.text: 接近關卡開始時，一個巨大的雪球將向您傳送，但可以透過靠近右側牆壁輕鬆避開。透過開口向西南方向走，按照地圖到達矮人火藥桶站 - 抓住一個小桶並炸毀南門。沿著右邊的牆走，然後殺死你遇到的哈沃克人，他會掉落一把鑰匙。用小桶炸毀冰牆，殺死佐敦集團，然後用鑰匙開啟大門。如果附近的橋梁倒塌了，請穿過它，或向北前往另一座橋以穿過裂縫。將會彈出一組 Vaettir。繼續向南，然後拉動控制桿降低橋 - 穿過橋並拿起鑰匙（小心不要觸發冰噴射陷阱而傷害自己）。拉動控制桿後，更多的瓦蒂爾會出現在清理過的路徑上。原路返回並解鎖大門，然後繼續前往傳送門。

1ea5b5b83e05a984802e12b25cab2316f3c58abf.source: Follow the path down the ramp until the terrain changes and you are in a dark room with a Cracked Wall opposite. A group of Jotun including a warrior boss will charge in. Take the middle route in the next room - and then avoid the two giant snowballs that roll down the hill. Kill the Jotun at the far end and then proceed slowly into the next room to deal with the Chromatic Drakes. Another Jotun boss awaits at the southern end of the room. Keep heading south and lure small groups of Jotun out of the room until you can pull Grelk Icelash out - killing it provides the key to level 2. Backtrack north, unlock the gate and proceed. Hard mode features an additional Havok-kin boss prior to the exit gate.
1ea5b5b83e05a984802e12b25cab2316f3c58abf.text: 沿著坡道走下去，直到地形發生變化，您將進入一間黑暗的房間，對面是一堵裂牆。包括戰士首領在內的一群佐頓將衝進來。走隔壁房間的中間路線 - 然後避開從山上滾下來的兩個巨大雪球。殺死遠端的佐頓，然後慢慢進入下一個房間對付彩色龍。另一位佐敦老闆在房間的南端等待著。繼續往南走，引誘小群佐敦離開房間，直到你能把格雷克·冰鞭拉出來——殺死它就是通關 2 的關鍵。原路返迴向北，解鎖大門並繼續前進。 困難模式 在出口前設有額外的 Havok-kin Boss。

bc3275f883ea369e9e4bba31d090a8c98ce96657.source: Head south and then loop back into the boss room where there are loads of stationary Jotun. Lure Jotun out until you can pull Havok Soulwail - kill her and then swoop in for the reward chest.
bc3275f883ea369e9e4bba31d090a8c98ce96657.text: 往南走，然後繞回老闆房間，那裡有大量的固定佐頓。引誘佐敦出來，直到你可以拉出 霍克 靈嘆 - 殺死她，然後猛撲上去獲取獎勵箱。

cbc0de3832ea8c5c5b05c34476fc5655a0e2c266.text: 反近戰 - 對抗近戰佐敦有用。

999464d8eff73dbc10512f15f923284821c1ad1f.source: Hex removal - useful vs Jotun Bladeturners and Mindbreakers.
999464d8eff73dbc10512f15f923284821c1ad1f.text: 去除六角形 - 對抗佐敦轉刃者和心靈破壞者有用。

5f60d9ae4ba9fdd25ee1d1e49bd89610c2a4a9c5.source: Anti-knock down - useful vs Giant Stomp which is used by melee Jotun, and various skills used by Chromatic Drakes.
5f60d9ae4ba9fdd25ee1d1e49bd89610c2a4a9c5.text: 抗擊倒 - 對抗近戰佐頓使用的 重踩 以及彩色幼龍所使用的各種技能時很有用。

0ca7195f8b2d4fe19402f6d70d786ed90041b076.source: It's best to wait until the timer ends after opening the dungeon chest. You will be brought back next to Einarr Frostcleft, allowing you take the reward.
0ca7195f8b2d4fe19402f6d70d786ed90041b076.text: 開啟地牢寶箱後最好等到計時器結束。你將被帶回埃納爾霜裂旁邊，讓你獲得獎勵。

2a993641b2a3d4085d39f85ecde198a0e1a930a4.source: It is possible to pull each individual Jotun from around Havok Soulwail without aggroing her directly.
2a993641b2a3d4085d39f85ecde198a0e1a930a4.text: 可以將 霍克 靈嘆 周圍的每個佐頓拉出來，而不會直接激怒她。

73c36f1b152ba89db0336aef8eec82a6ee5b86c2.source: It's also possible to pull Havok Soulwail (after killing some Jotuns in front of her). Simply use a longbow/flatbow and shoot her several times until she hits you with melee attacks.
73c36f1b152ba89db0336aef8eec82a6ee5b86c2.text: 也可以拉霍克 靈嘆（在她面前殺死一些佐敦人後）。只需使用長弓/扁弓向她射擊幾次，直到她用近戰攻擊擊中你。

7fe8c04551640c56c6664ca772fc6a7aed9714ec.source: While in the Darkrime Delves during this quest, Einarr Frostcleft and Kolgrim Bainwight cannot be targeted by foes and do not attack, take damage nor use any skills.
7fe8c04551640c56c6664ca772fc6a7aed9714ec.text: 在 黑霜洞穴 期間執行此任務時，艾納爾·霜裂和科爾格瑞姆·貝恩懷特不會成為敵人的目標，並且不會攻擊、受到傷害或使用任何技能。

e58338bee828feedda7ded55eef70f63f1419216.source: Upon completion of the Darkrime Delves portion of this quest, you end up in the Bjora Marches, just outside Volsung's Stead.
e58338bee828feedda7ded55eef70f63f1419216.text: 完成此任務的 黑霜洞穴 部分後，您最終會到達 碧拉邊境，就在沃爾松格的牧場外。

5ef491436bfc6f077ffb5a8c8bad4f65a682a837.source: Ironically, when you go to talk to Einarr to claim your reward for this quest, he and Kolgrim start the beginning dialogue again.
5ef491436bfc6f077ffb5a8c8bad4f65a682a837.text: 諷刺的是，當你去與埃納爾交談以領取此任務的獎勵時，他和科爾格林再次開始了開始的對話。

17da4680d8329b09917d92be8e6b786105d62ecb.source: When using Light of Deldrimor, the secret switch found in the Southern end of the third level opens the door found East of the boss room.
17da4680d8329b09917d92be8e6b786105d62ecb.text: 當使用 戴爾狄摩 之光時，第三層南端的秘密開關會開啟 Boss 房間東邊的門。

48548d0df36b7d15238b58ea9b021e0d592d5fb3.source: The "Reward dialogue" ignores the fact that Einarr accompanies your party in Darkrime Delves during the quest and was present when your party kills Havok Soulwail.
48548d0df36b7d15238b58ea9b021e0d592d5fb3.text: 「任務獎勵 對話」忽略了這樣一個事實：埃納爾在任務期間在 黑霜洞穴 中陪伴你的隊伍，並且在你的隊伍殺死 霍克 靈嘆 時也在場。

d0c3b241d7c7eef8655dc44a6bd81ecba756991d.source: Complete the three trials and defeat the three djinn in the Dasha Vestibule.
d0c3b241d7c7eef8655dc44a6bd81ecba756991d.text: 完成三項考驗並擊敗 達沙走廊 中的三個巨靈。

4917ad9a526486786d9e89abfa203016d030eba5.source: *BONUS* Collect three treasures of Ahdashim for Margrid.
4917ad9a526486786d9e89abfa203016d030eba5.text: *獎勵*為瑪格麗德收集阿達希姆的三件寶藏。

f8ce744d0e1b64f8d4f5f3cc4d605610d712890a.source: As per the Dasha Vestibule mission.
f8ce744d0e1b64f8d4f5f3cc4d605610d712890a.text: 根據 達沙走廊 任務。

4f37e6fa17a630379e58a650f8441d68cef362df.text: 需要 英雄：密語大師

e4d3a001af0a53d2fa3079466c6c14ff72293c05.source: Query miner Lahri about suspicious activity around the quarry.
e4d3a001af0a53d2fa3079466c6c14ff72293c05.text: 向礦工 Lahri 詢問採石場周圍的可疑活動。

1720a5887dd6e873aba4a5b6c346332c5514344b.source: Find out if miner Moh has witnessed anything strange lately.
1720a5887dd6e873aba4a5b6c346332c5514344b.text: 看看礦工 Moh 最近是否目睹了任何奇怪的事情。

134d583b9b5d6245a20b67e6143220d669cbdf18.source: See if miner Kurli has noticed anything unusual recently.
134d583b9b5d6245a20b67e6143220d669cbdf18.text: 看看礦工Kurli最近有沒有發現什麼異常。

0adfb9242efd369ef00a7fa7b9641377f03bf637.source: No fighting needed for this quest. Simply walk over to each of the miners and talk to them.
0adfb9242efd369ef00a7fa7b9641377f03bf637.text: 此任務不需要戰鬥。只需走到每個礦工面前並與他們交談即可。

5b3620d6aa6183d39ba5f748d98689236eceaa49.source: Speak with Attendant to the Prince in Resplendent Makuun.
5b3620d6aa6183d39ba5f748d98689236eceaa49.text: 與輝煌馬庫恩的王子侍從交談。

6f468e8ef9c26575f5269b2076ce9df7623f0779.source: Defend Prince Bokka. He must survive.
6f468e8ef9c26575f5269b2076ce9df7623f0779.text: 保衛博卡王子。他必須生存。

c8f5d086af2ef2444b0edbaba62c80d8e8987fbe.source: Once this quest is completed, Attendant to the Prince will no longer spawn in Resplendent Makuun.
c8f5d086af2ef2444b0edbaba62c80d8e8987fbe.text: 此任務完成後，王子侍從將不再在輝煌馬庫恩生成。

5f63273cdee9e85aa09d672c0139fd5786393359.source: Head into Resplendent Makuun and follow the quest marker to the Attendant to the Prince who bring you to Bokka Amphitheatre, just in time to save Prince Bokka from getting killed. The fight against N.O.X. has three stages.
5f63273cdee9e85aa09d672c0139fd5786393359.text: 前往輝煌的馬庫恩，依照任務標記找到王子的侍從，他會帶你到博卡露天劇場，及時拯救博卡王子免於被殺。對抗 N.O.X.分為三個階段。

2ded79417b0245c319c642c895b4e88f5732bf09.source: The first stage begins as soon as players enter the quest; it consists of defending Prince Bokka as N.O.X. attacks. Bit Golems will spawn on the map.
2ded79417b0245c319c642c895b4e88f5732bf09.text: 玩家進入任務後，第一階段就開始了；它包括以 N.O.X 身份捍衛博卡王子。攻擊。位元魔像將在地圖上產生。

86d9845116c45a6f37df04a7a253050d1d491dfe.source: The second stage begins once N.O.X.'s health has been reduced to approximately 80%. Bokka will declare his intention to flee, but you have to make sure he actually leaves through the portal. Afterward, N.O.X. will summon reinforcements (see below) that will continually spawn in the area.
86d9845116c45a6f37df04a7a253050d1d491dfe.text: 一旦 N.O.X. 的生命值降低到大約 80%，第二階段就會開始。博卡會宣佈他打算逃跑，但你必須確保他確實通過傳送門離開。隨後，N.O.X.將召喚在該區域不斷生成的增援部隊（見下文）。

1a2abdc7c9156ea64314369372d1e7b49b9548cc.source: The third stage begins once N.O.X.'s health has been reduced to 50%. All remaining reinforcement golems will explode (damaging adjacent party members) and those that appear from now on will explode for 150 AoE damage as soon as they spawn.
1a2abdc7c9156ea64314369372d1e7b49b9548cc.text: 一旦 N.O.X. 的生命值降至 50%，第三階段就會開始。所有剩餘的強化傀儡都會爆炸（對相鄰的隊伍成員造成傷害），而從現在開始出現的傀儡一旦生成就會爆炸並造成 150 範圍性 傷害。

24282cd19043b8952ff823fbf37cd6592c53c8a5.source: Once you reduce N.O.X.'s health below 25%, it will be defeated.
24282cd19043b8952ff823fbf37cd6592c53c8a5.text: 一旦你將 N.O.X. 的生命值降低到 25% 以下，它就會被擊敗。

3dda62e82cdbcb3b215958c1ae35804cbfc71787.source: The various Bit Golems can pose a bigger threat to Bokka (and the party) than N.O.X. itself, so ensure that your team can handle them quickly and safely. The tactics are slightly different during the three stages, so be prepared for each.
3dda62e82cdbcb3b215958c1ae35804cbfc71787.text: 與 N.O.X 相比，各種 Bit Golem 對 Bokka（和隊伍）的威脅更大。本身，因此請確保您的團隊能夠快速、安全地處理它們。這三個階段的戰術略有不同，因此請為每個階段做好準備。

fe46fba507289f1be587c1eb916dd3cb258c7495.source: The Bit Golems are stationary; at this point, they do not threaten the party directly, but activate an AoE whenever they are approached. Your party can easily avoid them, but Bokka is not as clever: in his panic, he will run straight into them. You can either attempt to destroy them quickly or focus just on the ones that the Prince gets stuck on.
fe46fba507289f1be587c1eb916dd3cb258c7495.text: 位元傀儡是靜止的；此時，他們不會直接威脅該方，而是在接近他們時啟動 範圍性。你的隊伍可以輕易地避開他們，但博卡並不那麼聰明：在他的恐慌中，他會直接撞上他們。你可以嘗試快速摧毀它們，也可以只專注於王子被卡住的那些。

5ed742055b12ebc1e69934a953c93f7f27641b79.source: Three of the golem types will amplify NOX's special attacks, to the point that N.O.X. will eventually be able to defeat the party with a single hit. However, all its skills during this stage are spells with long casting times; use interrupts, skills that daze, or other counters to his casting; this will allow you to defeat him while ignoring most of his reinforcements. Destroy Rectifiers that are in casting range of NOX to stop his healing, and destroy Breakers that are in attack range of the party to stop their conditions. Because of these golems, during this stage it is advantageous to keep NOX and the party still and use as little space to fight as safety allows. However, as you approach the threshold for the next stage you will want to clear out a larger area of golems and spread your party out.
5ed742055b12ebc1e69934a953c93f7f27641b79.text: 三種傀儡型別將增強 NOX 的特殊攻擊，以至於 N.O.X.最終能夠一擊擊敗隊伍。但這個階段的技能都是施法時間較長的法術，使用打斷、眩暈技能或其他對抗施法的方法；這將使你能夠擊敗他，同時忽略他的大部分援軍。摧毀在 NOX 施法範圍內的整流器以阻止他的治療，並摧毀在隊伍攻擊範圍內的破壞者以阻止他們的狀況。由於這些魔像的存在，在此階段，保持 NOX 和隊伍靜止並在安全允許的情況下使用盡可能小的空間進行戰鬥是有利的。然而，當您接近下一階段的門檻時，您將需要清除更大區域的傀儡並將您的隊伍分散開。

11caaaf83770c9e3f8436dc61e0977a4b2279b3e.source: Phantom Bit Golems (increase the power of N.O.X.'s N.O.X. Phantom skill),
11caaaf83770c9e3f8436dc61e0977a4b2279b3e.text: 幽靈 Bit Golems（增加 N.O.X. 的 N.O.X. 幽靈 技能的威力），

9738d0feb7e73a0c681bec08b06f59cfb10ce2c2.source: Thunder Bit Golems (increase the power of N.O.X.'s N.O.X. Thunder),
9738d0feb7e73a0c681bec08b06f59cfb10ce2c2.text: Thunder Bit Golems（增加 N.O.X. 的 N.O.X. Thunder 的力量），

62eab6b65cb8df15d240cb1b7ba42290512e902b.source: Fire Bit Golems (increase the power of N.O.X.'s N.O.X. Fire),
62eab6b65cb8df15d240cb1b7ba42290512e902b.text: Fire Bit Golems（增加 N.O.X. 的 N.O.X. Fire 的力量），

49a0d9b28f460bbcc07ef300cb1e3b038dedbe51.text: 整流器位元傀儡（治癒 N.O.X.），以及

49f294a3474f38ccdef05c4d916f7746eb996784.source: Breaker Bit Golems (inflict random conditions on the party)
49f294a3474f38ccdef05c4d916f7746eb996784.text: Breaker Bit Golems（對隊伍造成隨機條件）

bdfcd083b9d04a063077a783dae3992421a3ca37.source: Spread out to avoid getting overwhelmed. The golem spawns are random, not targeted, so it does no good to move around. Doing so will just decrease dps and drag out the fight, increasing pressure on healers. During this stage, N.O.X. will switch skills again, to N.O.X. Knuckle, N.O.X. Field Dash and N.O.X. Divider Drive. Continue to interrupt these skills.
bdfcd083b9d04a063077a783dae3992421a3ca37.text: 分散開以避免被淹沒。傀儡的生成是隨機的，沒有針對性，所以四處移動沒有好處。這樣做只會降低 DPS 並拖延戰鬥，增加治療者的壓力。在此階段，N.O.X.將再次切換技能，至N.O.X。指關節，N.O.X.現場 急衝 和 N.O.X.分頻器驅動器。繼續打斷這些技能。

1ae66beef22f9486028ef9e544b0a4203b578b50.source: Skills that cause Daze (e.g. Broad Head Arrow) and interrupts are extremely helpful.
1ae66beef22f9486028ef9e544b0a4203b578b50.text: 導致暈眩（例如 闊首箭）和中斷的技能非常有幫助。

1a610de8e1c2970b4be2977f02afb74783669d82.source: Skills that reduce casting speed such as Migraine, Frustration, and Arcane Conundrum.
1a610de8e1c2970b4be2977f02afb74783669d82.text: 降低施法速度的技能，例如 頭痛、頓挫 和 思緒混亂。

fab3da740feb5a09ed35f12f512bc2292e591e4e.source: To prevent N.O.X.ion Buster, you must interrupt N.O.X. between the end of Countdown and activation of ion buster.
fab3da740feb5a09ed35f12f512bc2292e591e4e.text: 為了阻止 N.O.X.ion Buster，你必須打斷 N.O.X.。倒數結束和離子破壞器啟用之間。

1185980f5fe4f20efbc7bfe09416ba2a3e850fec.source: Party-wide heals are very helpful in countering the AoE damage from the bit golems and protecting Bokka during phase 1. Party-wide damage reduction is also useful for this, especially Union or Shelter.
1185980f5fe4f20efbc7bfe09416ba2a3e850fec.text: 隊伍 範圍內的治療對於對抗位元魔像的 範圍性 傷害以及在 1 階段保護 Bokka 非常有幫助。 隊伍 範圍內的傷害減少對此也很有用，尤其是 聯合 或 庇護。

ba9d998b0843efa3729c0eac80d249adcd7678f0.source: Divide your team into two groups: those that focus on keeping the Prince (and party members) alive and those that can quickly take down the Bit Golems and/or N.O.X. In teams with seven heroes,
ba9d998b0843efa3729c0eac80d249adcd7678f0.text: 將你的團隊分成兩組：一組專注於讓王子（和黨員）活著，一組能夠快速擊倒位元魔像和/或 N.O.X。在七位英雄的隊伍中，

a86ce05a3e4429a5adf3def55c381d774f074cc8.source: Flag two or three healers in between the seats and the stage and allow the others to follow you.
a86ce05a3e4429a5adf3def55c381d774f074cc8.text: 在座位和舞臺之間標記兩到三名治療師，並允許其他人跟隨您。

a3584de47097e89004908a56ea469cff77292abc.source: Force dedicated hero healers to lock on Bokka; call targets for the others as you move around.
a3584de47097e89004908a56ea469cff77292abc.text: 強迫英雄治療師鎖定博卡；當你四處走動時，為其他人呼叫目標。

c583fb62167547781f4ce2d01c88cc4928b83d35.source: If you can damage quickly enough, have one or two party members focus on N.O.X., one or two to keep Bokka alive, and the remaining members are free to take out the Bit Golems (and can help damage N.O.X. whenever they are few in number). If you are quick enough, the big golem will never pose any threat to the party.
c583fb62167547781f4ce2d01c88cc4928b83d35.text: 如果你能夠快地造成傷害，請讓一到兩名隊員專注於 N.O.X.，一到兩名隊員讓 Bokka 活下去，剩下的成員可以自由地消滅 Bit Golem（只要 N.O.X. 數量很少，就可以幫助傷害 N.O.X.）。如果你夠快，大傀儡永遠不會對隊伍造成任何威脅。

de0b5329ad8da081df38d87b96a782f5e0e7f6ae.source: You can back up through the portal and attack N.O.X. through the wall although its massive attack will hurt you unless you back up all the way to the back of the closed area behind the portal.
de0b5329ad8da081df38d87b96a782f5e0e7f6ae.text: 你可以透過門戶備份並攻擊 N.O.X.穿過牆壁，儘管它的大規模攻擊會傷害你，除非你一路後退到門戶後面的封閉區域的後面。

3e0823d7bba895e9a6a0b474b12f7ba2d6ddf4f7.source: Alternate to above - Through the portal and lure N.O.X. into the courtyard and fight him there.
3e0823d7bba895e9a6a0b474b12f7ba2d6ddf4f7.text: 與上述交替 - 通過傳送門並引誘 N.O.X.進入院子並在那裡與他戰鬥。

7b4a9b0cddf6e44de6c40b40aaf42a793ef6b750.source: Golems will appear on the other side of the portal if you go through it.
7b4a9b0cddf6e44de6c40b40aaf42a793ef6b750.text: 如果你穿過傳送門，傀儡就會出現在傳送門的另一邊。

424f63d163115886bbdd6c0a1c7f33de2af4d65b.source: There are exploitable corpses of Vabbian civilians strewn around the theatre. The enemies you face here do not leave any corpses.
424f63d163115886bbdd6c0a1c7f33de2af4d65b.text: 劇院周圍散落著可供剝削的瓦比亞平民屍體。你在這裡面對的敵人不會留下任何屍體。

5b7eff2de28d054a9ad36db413051ed3dce772d5.source: M.O.X. is not required to be in your party for this quest.
5b7eff2de28d054a9ad36db413051ed3dce772d5.text: M.O.X.不需要在你的隊伍中完成這個任務。

f18244f77adcc2e7fb0e16e726bb4da063ed24ff.source: This quest is obtained automatically after accepting Zinn's Task. If it is abandoned, it can be re-obtained by asking Image of Zinn about the Zinn's Task quest. The initial dialogue can only be seen in the quest log, and it has no accept, decline or when asked about dialogue.
f18244f77adcc2e7fb0e16e726bb4da063ed24ff.text: 該任務在接受津恩的任務後自動獲得。如果它被放棄，可以透過向津恩的影像詢問津恩的任務任務來重新獲得它。初始對話只能在任務日誌中看到，且沒有接受、拒絕或詢問對話時的選項。

41b4012af8f0574e1b2ff1caa472dba9f198c262.source: Even if N.O.X. is not within range heroes and henchmen will not attack the smaller golems unless a player does.
41b4012af8f0574e1b2ff1caa472dba9f198c262.text: 即使 N.O.X.不在射程內的英雄和追隨者不會攻擊較小的傀儡，除非玩家這樣做。

13e1becaedf69bd8e6677e1e63f716b265529b24.source: The attendant does not spawn if Til Death Do Us Part... is active and uncompleted.
13e1becaedf69bd8e6677e1e63f716b265529b24.text: 如果「直到死亡將我們分開...」處於活動狀態且未完成，則服務員不會產生。

8dd15bafd6f0a9570ae192dc7be313a675d050ee.source: If you fail this quest, you will be teleported to Honur Hill, even if you started from another outpost and have not yet unlocked it.
8dd15bafd6f0a9570ae192dc7be313a675d050ee.text: 如果你失敗了這個任務，你將被傳送到 霍奴爾丘陵，即使你從另一個前哨站開始並且尚未解鎖它。

dc8a7203d5451cbaf7992a65c84f08c91aba7334.source: Speak with Guardsman Makuruyo in The Marketplace.
dc8a7203d5451cbaf7992a65c84f08c91aba7334.text: 與 市集 中的衛兵 Makuruyo 交談。

38ffe7ba489e9a4bd363f82ed217fa0d2820a049.source: Follow your new Jade Brotherhood allies and assist them in killing the Am Fah. Head West along the shore and cross the bridge to the island with Lian, Dragon's Petal. Defend against the onslaught of the Am Fah. After they have been killed head west again towards the area with the two bosses and their mobs. Be careful of drop-downs on the way. Then head North-West towards P.O.X. and the Jade Brotherhood that purchased it. Simply attack P.O.X to 20% hp and take the crystal to end the mission.
38ffe7ba489e9a4bd363f82ed217fa0d2820a049.text: 跟隨您的新 翡翠兄弟會 盟友並協助他們殺死 安費。沿著海岸往西走，過橋到有龍瓣蓮的島嶼。抵禦 安費 的攻擊。他們被殺後，再次向西前往兩個首領和他們的暴民所在的地區。小心路上的下拉式選單。然後向西北方向前往 P.O.X.以及購買它的 翡翠兄弟會。只需攻擊 P.O.X 至 20% hp 並拿走水晶即可結束任務。

6c5c2d47659fc70d5d57e1030e4d17c9fc3c51f4.source: If you are doing this quest with heroes/henchmen, it is recommended that you take a Minion Master, as the many minions will provide a buffer zone to protect your healer/casters from the numerous Am Fah Assassins. Also, for the last battle against the P.O.X golem, it is recommended that you take an interrupt hero to stop the golem from using Reactor Blast, which could easily wipe the whole party if it is not prepared. When using henchmen, a fool-proof way of defeating P.O.X. is that when it starts casting his Reactor Blast skill, flag all henchmen/heroes away, using the minimap. After the casting is finished, just remove the flag and let them return.
6c5c2d47659fc70d5d57e1030e4d17c9fc3c51f4.text: 如果你和英雄/追隨者一起做這個任務，建議你選擇一個小兵大師，因為許多小兵將提供一個緩衝區來保護你的治療者/施法者免受眾多 安費 刺客的傷害。另外，在最後一場與 P.O.X 傀儡的戰鬥中，建議你使用中斷英雄來阻止傀儡使用反應爐爆炸，如果沒有準備好，這很容易消滅整個團隊。使用追蹤者時，這是擊敗 P.O.X 的萬無一失的方法。是當它開始施放他的反應爐爆炸技能時，使用小地圖示記所有追隨者/英雄離開。施法結束後，只要把旗幟去掉，就可以讓他們回來了。

149008bfb43bb683d7f0e1019afc04c1ef5976ef.source: Note: P.O.X. cannot be knocked down.

8a6909289e934a5f54613bf05c5aebce46413168.source: It is possible to run past all the Am Fah mobs and run straight to P.O.X.. The fight with P.O.X. will trigger normally, and the quest will be complete after defeating P.O.X.. It is recommended to use party-wide running skills, such as "Charge!", to bypass the Am Fah easily. After P.O.X. is defeated and everyone has collected the power crystal, the "mission completed" countdown may not appear, but the quest is properly completed.
8a6909289e934a5f54613bf05c5aebce46413168.text: 可以跑過所有 安費 怪物並直接跑到 P.O.X.. 與 P.O.X 的戰鬥。會正常觸發，擊敗P.O.X後任務完成。建議使用全隊跑動技能，如“衝鋒！”，輕鬆繞過安費。 P.O.X. 後被擊敗並且每個人都收集了能量水晶時，「任務完成」倒數計時可能不會出現，但任務已正確完成。

296ecef027d7f9c8f5f6747b4eaa5a00ad56a55a.source: Throughout this mission, human party members will be under the Jade Brotherhood Disguise effect and all Jade Brotherhood will be allies. Wing, Three Blade will turn aggressive but Lian, Dragon Petal will not.
296ecef027d7f9c8f5f6747b4eaa5a00ad56a55a.text: 在整個任務中，人類隊伍成員將受到 翡翠兄弟會 偽裝效果的影響，並且所有 翡翠兄弟會 將成為盟友。翼、三刃會變得攻擊性，但蓮、龍瓣不會。

42bd70bd8d66958a5dae30544ce2066dc51b9836.source: After P.O.X. goes haywire the disguise will wear off and you will be set upon by the Jade Brotherhood.
42bd70bd8d66958a5dae30544ce2066dc51b9836.text: P.O.X. 後一旦失控，偽裝就會消失，您將被 翡翠兄弟會 攻擊。

de66d72a1da6e28393a2bba65c1213c0b0b31aa6.source: It is possible to capture elite skills from the Jade Brotherhood bosses when they die.
de66d72a1da6e28393a2bba65c1213c0b0b31aa6.text: 當 翡翠兄弟會 頭目死亡時，可以從他們身上獲得精英技能。

3aafb80fda3f9a3ead8aae18a92f043128b48ec8.source: Whenever you pass by Jade Brotherhood guards while under the disguise, they do the /salute emote.
3aafb80fda3f9a3ead8aae18a92f043128b48ec8.text: 每當你在偽裝下經過 翡翠兄弟會 守衛時，他們都會做出 /致敬 表情。

6bfb067cc85ab22d1dcc05c6ba1539fc85a3aad6.source: If a Jade Brotherhood boss dies, you will still gain a morale boost even though they are your allies.
6bfb067cc85ab22d1dcc05c6ba1539fc85a3aad6.text: 如果 翡翠兄弟會 首領死亡，即使他們是你的盟友，你仍然會獲得士氣提升。

85e0ebbe3f89bb854f8bac6e370f16df75f80f14.source: Sometimes, an Am Fah assassin will not attack if attacked by range.
85e0ebbe3f89bb854f8bac6e370f16df75f80f14.text: 有時，如果受到範圍攻擊，安費 刺客將不會攻擊。

a4bb37b0c7b04b62710a8783a771d343119b8047.source: Although this quest happens predominantly in Wajjun Bazaar, certain changes have been made to the normal explorable area.
a4bb37b0c7b04b62710a8783a771d343119b8047.text: 雖然此任務主要發生在 瓦江市場，但對正常可探索區域進行了某些變更。

afb22fad6532079ae120dba12f94023d7953f78e.source: The map denotes this location as Waijun Bazaar, instead of Wajjun Bazaar.
afb22fad6532079ae120dba12f94023d7953f78e.text: 地圖將此位置標記為外軍集市，而不是 瓦江市場。

6d5be0226548ca4a1a977e778b316ed368270c8e.source: There are various "territory" markers for both the Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood.
6d5be0226548ca4a1a977e778b316ed368270c8e.text: 安費 和 翡翠兄弟會 都有各種「區域」標記。

76909174b091c35470c08790635041d0b20fad37.source: Some walkways that are normally open have been blocked by debris.
76909174b091c35470c08790635041d0b20fad37.text: 一些平時開放的走道被碎片堵塞。

b4d181867d5614150fbc1a3a09792a57d0d686b4.source: If you keep the quest active, the groups of Am Fah can be farmed for Bolts of Cloth, Bolts of Linen, and Plague Idols.
b4d181867d5614150fbc1a3a09792a57d0d686b4.text: 如果你保持任務活躍，安費 組可以用來取得布捲、亞麻捲和瘟疫神像。

9404b1435c14eaa495ca35ed2105dd02f45dd750.source: Sometimes after P.O.X. goes haywire you cannot interact because whenever you click it automatically makes you use your first skill. Mercenary Heroes will always transform into a male even if they are female.
9404b1435c14eaa495ca35ed2105dd02f45dd750.text: 有時在痘痘之後。一旦失控，你就無法互動，因為每當你點選它時，你就會自動使用你的第一個技能。傭兵英雄即使是女性，也總是會變身為男性。

c52be5742dc411ee3367461d0523d9da2e4708ab.source: Speak with Salma in the Temple of the Ages.
c52be5742dc411ee3367461d0523d9da2e4708ab.text: 在 世紀神殿 中與薩爾瑪交談。

8c985ec584a22e6028db3af447e10d3664c36bed.source: Defend Princess Salma. She must survive.
8c985ec584a22e6028db3af447e10d3664c36bed.text: 保衛薩爾瑪公主。她必須生存。

35c36c0feca16871d555586a6507ff650d271130.source: Deactivate R.O.X. and eliminate his forces.
35c36c0feca16871d555586a6507ff650d271130.text: 停用 R.O.X.並消滅他的勢力。

bd849312e48a002618741a3f3314b5f42ec100ed.source: After speaking to Salma, you enter into a mini-mission to defend an explorable version of the Temple of the Ages. The party has 30 seconds to talk to the acolytes and ask them to pray for blessings from each god. It's possible to send more than one acolyte to pray for the same god, increasing the blessing given; this gives diminishing returns, however. The blessings are shown in the following table:
bd849312e48a002618741a3f3314b5f42ec100ed.text: 與薩爾瑪交談後，您將進入一項小任務，保衛可探索版本的 世紀神殿。隊伍有 30 秒的時間與侍祭交談，並要求他們祈求每位神的祝福。可以派遣多名學徒向同一個神祈禱，增加祝福；然而，這會帶來收益遞減。祝福如下表：

846ce2064d8f53547c0fcb7d594fdc5dcbc2ef9b.source: The time counts down to zero, and waves of level 20 golems come crashing down. These golems may kill the acolytes praying at the shrines, removing the blessings from the gods; they will prioritize killing those NPCs over the players, if within range. As such, it may be a good strategy to pray for only two or three blessings that are next to each other, to minimize the travel distance needed to defend these acolytes. After several waves, R.O.X. will turn up. Kill the other golems first so you can focus your attack on R.O.X. who has a large amount of health. R.O.X. will be defeated when its health is reduced below approximately 20%.
846ce2064d8f53547c0fcb7d594fdc5dcbc2ef9b.text: 時間倒數到零，一波又一波的 20 魔像轟然倒下。這些傀儡可能會殺死在神殿祈禱的侍僧，剝奪眾神的祝福；如果在範圍內，他們會優先殺死那些 NPC，而不是玩家。因此，只祈求兩到三個相鄰的祝福可能是一個很好的策略，以盡量減少保護這些侍僧所需的行進距離。幾波之後，R.O.X.將會出現。先殺死其他傀儡，這樣你就可以集中攻擊 R.O.X。誰擁有大量的生命值。 R.O.X.當其生命值降低到大約 20% 以下時將會被擊敗。

b3240be758026118eaa272c64ab08a8d9e6a510e.source: You should prioritize killing the golems nearest to Salma, since her death will cause the mission to fail.
b3240be758026118eaa272c64ab08a8d9e6a510e.text: 你應該優先殺死離薩爾瑪最近的傀儡，因為她的死會導致任務失敗。

bf6a96f1bab0f4d35111853ec9f91216e90fb3da.source: You cannot capture Triple Chop from R.O.X with a signet of capture because you don't actually kill him.
bf6a96f1bab0f4d35111853ec9f91216e90fb3da.text: 你不能用捕獲印章從 R.O.X 手中捕獲 三重砍擊，因為你實際上並沒有殺死他。

9cc07554a4c5f73e59fcb5ea42513a22f981e755.source: Acolytes beyond the first at each god statue increase the bonus received by much less than the first. Sending one Acolyte to each god will increase your bonuses, but sending them all to one statue will make it easier to protect them and the bonus they give.
9cc07554a4c5f73e59fcb5ea42513a22f981e755.text: 每個神像處第一個追隨者所獲得的加值增幅遠小於第一個。向每個神派遣一名侍僧會增加你的加值，但將他們全部傳送到一尊雕像將使保護他們和他們所提供的加值變得更容易。

18f9c3c247a8b1ee194c0995fac038a5bc8d12c1.source: The Xunlai Agent spawns, mentioning how she will be safe within the nearby Xunlai Chest before disappearing.
18f9c3c247a8b1ee194c0995fac038a5bc8d12c1.text: 桑萊專員 出現，並提到她在消失之前會在附近的尋來 寶箱 內保持安全。

55dc2fbf73d90d2ec2c3255cdd791208863f9698.source: If you are dead when R.O.X. has been defeated and none of the alive party members have a resurrection skill then you will have to start the quest over as you cannot get his power crystal.
55dc2fbf73d90d2ec2c3255cdd791208863f9698.text: 如果 R.O.X. 時你死了已被擊敗並且活著的黨員都沒有復活技能，那麼你將不得不重新開始任務，因為你無法獲得他的能量水晶。

2a90370d77684856d5071d41fa09c51ad2fbb7f9.source: The 55 monk build is quite effective here, but extremely slow. Plant all acolytes at the Statue of Lyssa for extra energy, then flag your heroes near the statue. Stand in the center of the stone barries where the creatures will spawn and keep protective spirit up. Your ranged heroes and henchmen should start attacking the Golems, but should only aggro at most 1 golem per grouping. Once the R.O.X. appears, unflag your heroes and henchmen and annihilate R.O.X.
2a90370d77684856d5071d41fa09c51ad2fbb7f9.text: 55 修士建構在這裡非常有效，但速度非常緩慢。 植物 麗莎聖像 處的所有助手以獲得額外能量，然後在雕像附近標記您的英雄。站在生物生成的石壘中心，並保持保護精神。你的遠端英雄和追隨者應該開始攻擊傀儡，但每個組最多隻能攻擊 1 傀儡。一旦 R.O.X.出現後，拔掉你的英雄和追隨者的旗幟，消滅 R.O.X.

b32e25701175a9e1840d16da89ed343438fed7c3.source: During the fight with R.O.X., he will sometimes get caught on a wall, and stop attacking. The statue of Dwayna often fails to load. When this happens, sending more than one acolyte there will provide no additional blessing.
b32e25701175a9e1840d16da89ed343438fed7c3.text: 在與R.O.X.的戰鬥中，他有時會被卡在牆上而停止攻擊。德薇娜的雕像經常無法裝載。當這種情況發生時，派遣超過一名侍僧去那裡不會提供額外的祝福。

85e6d86486217a3d45bea418bfa9edfeed4f640f.source: In the Hard Mode version of the quest there are often two demolitionists instead of one per spawn point.
85e6d86486217a3d45bea418bfa9edfeed4f640f.text: 在任務的困難模式版本中，通常有兩位爆破專家，而不是每個重生點各一個。

dd032e942c7a345c8f8c06d85425b6568d797a6f.source: The quest reward for this quest lists no gold or experience in the reward, though they are given when the quest is turned in.
dd032e942c7a345c8f8c06d85425b6568d797a6f.text: 該任務的任務獎勵中沒有列出金幣或經驗，儘管它們是在上交任務時給出的。

16f7cbad801f0aafc0f0766db224887d01c1a8db.text: 主要或次要職業：死靈法師

12d6902077e0429683e89caff3e69142781aefef.source: Return to Kasha Blackblood for your reward.
12d6902077e0429683e89caff3e69142781aefef.text: 影返 至 黑血卡夏 以獲得獎勵。

0a25afa8728c3a5f1ec66b63099552a045a5a0cc.source: You will find Oberan's Minions east of the Sardelac Sanitarium. To complete the quest, you must kill all of them. If your character is low level, carefully pull the minions with a bow or long-range skill to avoid luring the nearby Grawl as well.
0a25afa8728c3a5f1ec66b63099552a045a5a0cc.text: 您會在 薩德拉克療養院 東邊找到奧貝蘭的小兵。要完成任務，你必須殺死他們所有人。如果你的角色等級較低，請小心地用弓或遠端技能拉小兵，以避免引誘附近的 穴居人。

d02984a1573e5d8d4d3d02c292d9af56d3dd1363.source: Kill Gull Hookbeak and talk to Yorrt Strongjaw to get this quest.
d02984a1573e5d8d4d3d02c292d9af56d3dd1363.text: 殺死海鷗鉤嘴並與約特·強顎交談即可完成此任務。

86f77d4a79bbe570716f9c0cc94c8a6a15ac4c4d.source: Find a group of enemies that can grant Yorrt Strongjaw death with honor.
86f77d4a79bbe570716f9c0cc94c8a6a15ac4c4d.text: 找到一群能讓約特·強顎榮譽死亡的敵人。

9a5ab95b3cb7c53a049c35ad55feaf8251f4b92d.source: Take Yorrt Strongjaw's club to his son Trrok.
9a5ab95b3cb7c53a049c35ad55feaf8251f4b92d.text: 將約特·強顎的棍棒交給他的兒子特羅克。

e31ed7faacef1f57428734337a237a412bc50b77.source: See Trrok Strongjaw for your reward.
e31ed7faacef1f57428734337a237a412bc50b77.text: 請見Trrok Strongjaw 以獲得獎勵。

453935dc2a905051bdb7d727d9f7d9d6dc68e493.source: Lead Yorrt Strongjaw to the indicated quest area, killing any Tengu or Yeti you encounter along the way. Once you are close to the quest area, Yorrt will run toward it on his own. Do not follow Yorrt or help him kill any Tengu in this area. Just run away and wait a few minutes. Yorrt will die and drop his Club. Now go back to the quest area and kill all Tengu. Pick up Yorrt Strongjaw's Club and take it to his son, Trrok Strongjaw, to finish the quest.
453935dc2a905051bdb7d727d9f7d9d6dc68e493.text: 帶領約特強顎前往指定的任務區域，殺死沿途遇到的任何 天狗 或雪人。一旦你接近任務區域，約爾特就會自己跑向任務區域。不要跟隨約爾特或幫助他殺死該區域的任何 天狗。趕緊跑開，等幾分鐘。約爾特會死掉並丟掉他的棍棒。現在回到任務區域並殺死所有 天狗。拿起約特·強顎的棍棒，交給他的兒子特羅克·強顎，以完成任務。

51faa0aa611d841b505c1d1df69d5e70f2c9c13a.source: This quest is useful to farm Feathers, since it causes additional groups of Sensali to spawn.
51faa0aa611d841b505c1d1df69d5e70f2c9c13a.text: 此任務對於種植羽毛很有用，因為它會導致產生額外的 聖沙利天狗 群組。

bfe04a823f9f79682e13b1fc329eaf0ed7decbc9.source: Despite what Yorrt and Trrok Strongjaw say, carrying the club does not affect whether other Yeti are hostile. Yeti will still attack the player even while they are carrying the club, and Trrok will not turn hostile even if the player interacts with him without the club or after the quest is complete.
bfe04a823f9f79682e13b1fc329eaf0ed7decbc9.text: 不管約爾特和特洛克·強顎怎麼說，攜帶這根棍棒並不影響其他雪人是否有敵意。即使雪人攜帶球桿，雪人仍然會攻擊玩家，而即使玩家在沒有球桿的情況下或在任務完成後與他互動，Trrok 也不會變得敵對。

65b0e7184f26e8b389bb69a7ccbad66ea3589b8c.source: This quest is (normally) mutually exclusive with The Rite of Valor, depending on which boss dies first.
65b0e7184f26e8b389bb69a7ccbad66ea3589b8c.text: 這個任務（通常）與勇氣儀式是互斥的，取決於哪個老闆先死。

91c5b56ababab7097ad2063b72eaee3578c67ef4.source: Gull Hookbeak's death leads to this quest.
91c5b56ababab7097ad2063b72eaee3578c67ef4.text: 海鷗鉤嘴的死導致了這個任務。

3fe97855b6675e563bdaa864b5bd34abcd0519ac.source: Yorrt Strongjaw's death leads to the other.
3fe97855b6675e563bdaa864b5bd34abcd0519ac.text: 約特·強顎的死導致了另一個問題。

780b85c3fd7c107aa587c5403413a8f5f41654a5.source: It is possible to complete both Death with Honor and The Rite of Valor by entering the area with another player who has not completed either quest.
780b85c3fd7c107aa587c5403413a8f5f41654a5.text: 與另一位尚未完成這兩個任務的玩家一起進入該區域，可以同時完成「榮耀死亡」和「英勇儀式」。

d609f38be5cfe641435cb0b9afcb002e0e3c5056.source: See Voice of Whispers for your reward.
d609f38be5cfe641435cb0b9afcb002e0e3c5056.text: 請參閱《耳語之聲》以獲得獎勵。

78e9463203bbd06c6f72393f5da8a78e38c1e453.source: This is a relatively easy quest. The Deathbringer Company is a group of eight Torment creatures; one of each profession (except for the 2 monks). Defeat that group to complete the quest. They are located west of the rift (from the preceding quest).
78e9463203bbd06c6f72393f5da8a78e38c1e453.text: 這是一個相對容易的任務。死亡使者連隊是由八個折磨生物組成的團體；每個職業之一（2 武僧除外）。擊敗該小組即可完成任務。它們位於裂谷以西（來自先前的任務）。

6b14d909c7b4363e98a61801cacfe05fd345f50b.source: When the quest reward is accepted, the Greater Darkness will spawn nearby. See the quest information in Mallyx the Unyielding for strategies in defeating it.
6b14d909c7b4363e98a61801cacfe05fd345f50b.text: 當任務獎勵被接受時，更大的黑暗將會在附近生成。請參閱“不屈的馬裡克斯”中的任務資訊，以瞭解擊敗它的策略。

847fa95d3921ae2a72ba327382d9fccdb05b5420.source: Retrieve the top left treasure map piece for Koris Deeprunner.
847fa95d3921ae2a72ba327382d9fccdb05b5420.text: 取回 深奔 高理斯 左上角的藏寶圖碎片。

cce0460ad12f0d96cdbee12fc895b3315d1ea8ea.source: Retrieve the top right treasure map piece for Koris Deeprunner.
cce0460ad12f0d96cdbee12fc895b3315d1ea8ea.text: 取回 深奔 高理斯 右上角的藏寶圖碎片。

f24879f00d8617a78b360d383d24a8f8a613753f.source: Retrieve the bottom left treasure map piece for Koris Deeprunner.
f24879f00d8617a78b360d383d24a8f8a613753f.text: 取回 深奔 高理斯 的左下方藏寶圖碎片。

aab0e734aaf6b493ee67cd5c78787089a61c93a1.source: Retrieve the bottom right treasure map piece for Koris Deeprunner.
aab0e734aaf6b493ee67cd5c78787089a61c93a1.text: 取回 深奔 高理斯 右下角的藏寶圖碎片。

8b9ba80e7db3b0d9809b079a2315fe7b44d51517.source: See Koris Deeprunner for your reward.
8b9ba80e7db3b0d9809b079a2315fe7b44d51517.text: 請參閱 深奔 高理斯 以取得獎勵。

8ccdd31f1f792d4cfd6fdc14dd5624269ab6dfbb.source: Collect each of the four treasure map pieces and return them to Koris. Pieces randomly drop from all foes and charmable animals in the Far Shiverpeaks and Grothmar Wardowns.
8ccdd31f1f792d4cfd6fdc14dd5624269ab6dfbb.text: 收集四塊藏寶圖並將它們歸還給科里斯。 北部席娃山脈 和 Grothmar Wardowns 中的所有敵人和迷人動物都會隨機掉落碎片。

6ba8f2466426c2686366b60f421b1de4dfef4293.source: The map pieces can be traded from player to player.
6ba8f2466426c2686366b60f421b1de4dfef4293.text: 地圖碎片可以在玩家之間進行交易。

e6b20e8ff039be70b4cc212a374b5b510647ff0a.source: They are only needed one time per character to enter the Lair of the Snowmen dungeon. After that, the dungeon is repeatable by just talking to Koris.
e6b20e8ff039be70b4cc212a374b5b510647ff0a.text: 每個角色只需要進入雪人地牢巢穴一次。之後，只需與科里斯交談即可重複進入地牢。

573123f299067ee4ced895155d6dc9cc8326af28.source: Travel to The Henge of Denravi and speak with Shadow to learn how you can help defend against the Titan threat.
573123f299067ee4ced895155d6dc9cc8326af28.text: 前往 丹拉維聖地 並與 闇影 交談，瞭解如何協助防禦 泰坦 威脅。

61c032773b4bea48d4cd2c9f1cdaef5aff8e0df3.source: Seek out Evennia and offer her your assistance.
61c032773b4bea48d4cd2c9f1cdaef5aff8e0df3.text: 尋找 伊凡妮雅 並向她提供協助。

784cb0cdefc6627615ac896776cd93769dadd874.source: Help the Shining Blade defend Denravi from the Titans. Evennia must survive.
784cb0cdefc6627615ac896776cd93769dadd874.text: 幫助 光刃公會 保衛丹拉維免受泰坦的攻擊。 伊凡妮雅 必須生存。

ee776cc5c802cc1e9371bba17acbce76891d9761.source: This quest is similar to its predecessor, but you do not have to travel far to find your target. Start by mapping to the Henge of Denravi to speak with Shadow and then exit into Tangle Root. You are asked to add Evennia as an ally, but if you do so and she dies, you have to rezone and retry. Consider ignoring her entirely for this quest.
ee776cc5c802cc1e9371bba17acbce76891d9761.text: 該任務與其前身類似，但您無需走很遠就能找到目標。首先對應到 丹拉維聖地 以與 闇影 對話，然後退出到 糾結之根。系統會要求您將 伊凡妮雅 新增為盟友，但如果您這樣做而她死了，您必須重新分割並重試。考慮在這個任務中完全忽略她。

927b97cf4f551f51f9628cb59f55c0902926cfdd.source: Next, take out the Malices (and their spawns).
927b97cf4f551f51f9628cb59f55c0902926cfdd.text: 接下來，消滅惡意生物（及其生成體）。

99a0a50194f8d26123714cd141e11df9aaa99156.source: Tackle any remaining Brutes and Darks.
99a0a50194f8d26123714cd141e11df9aaa99156.text: 解決剩餘的野獸和黑暗。

fdc017f8d7aeb65b8ae67cab40ec713f04686f37.source: Although Frost Titans are powerful AoE elementalists, they should be handled last to avoid generating too many new enemies.
fdc017f8d7aeb65b8ae67cab40ec713f04686f37.text: 雖然冰霜泰坦是強大的 範圍性 元素主義者，但最後應該處理它們以避免產生太多新敵人。

69799b23b8d0e86c5e66ed72990d3a3ad22ae32f.source: You will be able to kneel and summon the avatar of Lyssa.
69799b23b8d0e86c5e66ed72990d3a3ad22ae32f.text: 您將能夠跪下並召喚 麗莎 的化身。

b408929670531124d488c86a2dbfa3af0d4f6b35.source: The bosses in this area have Elite skills that are not regularly available in this area. Utilizing a Signet of Capture may also help with Death Penalty reduction.
b408929670531124d488c86a2dbfa3af0d4f6b35.text: 該區域的首領擁有該區域不常見的 精英 技能。使用 捕捉紋章 也可能有助於減少死刑。

ddb1299edc02586dbd1152c4a1e7747e264755ee.source: While this quest is active, the spawn locations of the Avicara bosses are fixed. In the northern path, the order of bosses from west to east will be: Hyl Thunderwing, Nhy Darkclaw, Wyt Sharpfeather. In the southern path, the order of bosses from west to east will be: Ryk Arrowwing, Syr Honorcrest, Myd Springclaw.
ddb1299edc02586dbd1152c4a1e7747e264755ee.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，阿畢卡拉 Boss 的產生位置是固定的。在北部路徑中，西到東的 Boss 順序為：雷翼合爾、黑爪恩亥、銳翅維特。在南部路徑中，西到東的 Boss 順序為：箭翼裡克、光榮鬃毛西勒、鐵爪米德。

bff2962210c075e1a641078c1f19f56b91ce26b9.source: To make things easier in this quest, your party can take advantage of the fact that the titans will fight anything they come across, including the Avicara. Accordingly, trying to lure the titans into range of the Avicara groups may ease the difficulty of the quest. It is recommended that the party assists the Avicara in these battles, as the titans are generally far stronger.
bff2962210c075e1a641078c1f19f56b91ce26b9.text: 為了讓這個任務變得更容易，你的隊伍可以利用這樣一個事實：泰坦會與他們遇到的任何東西戰鬥，包括 阿畢卡拉。因此，嘗試將泰坦引誘到 阿畢卡拉 群體的範圍內可能會減輕任務的困難。建議隊伍在這些戰鬥中協助 阿畢卡拉，因為泰坦通常強大得多。

162643e35c28eba2ee71ae7a00928be0cb418d23.source: During this quest most of the normal bestiary are replaced by level 40 titans. Before tackling titan groups for the first time, it is important to know the correct order to kill the titans. Frost Titans spawn a Titan's Malice and an Icy Brute. Titan's Malice spawn a Titan's Heart and Icy Brutes spawn Dark Titans. Frost Titans are powerful AoE elementalists, but they should be tackled last because of the amount of enemies they spawn. Icy Brutes and Dark Titans pale in comparison to Titan's Malice, Panic mesmers that effectively shut down entire caster groups, and Titan's Heart, competent healers. Titan's Heart should be spiked down first because they make killing the other Titans difficult and they don't spawn any enemies upon death. Titan's Malice should then be taken out next and their spawn immediately afterwards. The Brutes and Dark Titans can be mopped up before targeting the Frost Titans and his respective spawns.
162643e35c28eba2ee71ae7a00928be0cb418d23.text: 在這個任務中，大多數普通的動物寓言都被 40 等級的泰坦所取代。在第一次對付泰坦群體之前，瞭解殺死泰坦的正確順序很重要。冰霜泰坦會產生 泰坦 的惡意和 冰凍 野蠻人。 泰坦 的惡意生成 泰坦 的心臟，冰凍 野獸生成黑暗泰坦。冰霜泰坦是強大的 範圍性 元素主義者，但由於它們產生的敵人數量較多，所以最後應該解決它們。 冰凍 的野獸和黑暗泰坦與 泰坦 的惡意、恐慌 能夠有效關閉整個施法者群體的催眠器以及 泰坦 的心臟（強大的治療者）相比相形見絀。 泰坦 的心臟應該先被釘下來，因為它們會使殺死其他泰坦變得困難，而且它們死後不會產生任何敵人。接下來應該消滅 泰坦 的 Malice，並立即消滅它們的生成。在瞄準冰霜泰坦及其各自的生成點之前，可以消滅野獸和黑暗泰坦。

bc2f294af465b43163febc809367292aca461648.source: Armed with this knowledge on how to beat the Titans, fight your way through Tasca's Demise to Mineral Springs. Take either the upper or lower path, both have many Titan mobs to fight through. Note that many mobs patrol, and it is easy to over-aggro and wipe. Spawns of patrolling groups do not patrol with them, so you can pick off those smaller groups at your leisure. The Avicara also fight the Titans, but they are seriously overmatched, and need your help to defeat the Titans. Eviro Sectus's group is larger than most other mobs, with several Frost Titans.
