If you wipe, his group will patrol back and forth in a small part of the canyon area, allowing you to kill the lone Titans that spawn. The spawns don't have to be killed to complete the quest, just the original Titans in Eviro's group. DP removal is very helpful for the quest as a whole because it is very easy to wipe. If you have cons, they are also helpful.
bc2f294af465b43163febc809367292aca461648.text: 掌握如何擊敗泰坦的知識，從 塔斯拉之死 到 礦物泉源 一路戰鬥。走上面或下面的路徑，兩條路都有許多 泰坦 怪物需要戰鬥。注意，很多小怪巡邏，很容易過度仇恨和消滅。巡邏隊的生成不會與他們一起巡邏，所以你可以在閒暇時幹掉那些較小的隊伍。 阿畢卡拉 也與泰坦作戰，但他們嚴重處於劣勢，需要您的幫助才能擊敗泰坦。埃維羅·塞克圖斯的隊伍比大多數其他生物都要龐大，其中有數名冰霜泰坦。如果你消滅，他的隊伍將在峽谷區域的一小部分割槽域來回巡邏，讓你殺死生成的孤獨泰坦。不必殺死生成者即可完成任務，只需殺死埃維羅團隊中的原始泰坦即可。 DP 去除對於整個任務非常有幫助，因為它很容易擦除。如果你有缺點，它們也會有幫助。

bd75ce68d7afe6b1bd983ca85a7b89a5ac452967.source: Make sure your group puller has a speed boost. Else the Titans can quickly snare and kill him before he can escape.
bd75ce68d7afe6b1bd983ca85a7b89a5ac452967.text: 確保你的組員有速度提升。否則泰坦們可以在他逃脫之前迅速誘捕並殺死他。

1be612b14bbd719605c351d683b793681c4797d7.source: Walk up the path until it forks. As you do, you will see the (temporarily friendly) residents of the jungle scurry away from the titans and head towards the Henge. Take up a position just before the small valley north of Evennia's starting position. You can use the path as a choke point, avoid getting surrounded by the titans, and make pulling easier.
1be612b14bbd719605c351d683b793681c4797d7.text: 沿著小路一直走，直到分岔。當你這樣做時，你會看到叢林中的（暫時友好的）居民逃離泰坦並前往巨石陣。在 伊凡妮雅 起始位置以北的小山谷前佔據一個位置。您可以使用路徑作為阻塞點，避免被泰坦包圍，並使拉動更容易。

da41f0b8171e307161009a0157645bd340836b0c.source: Now, approach the guards in the clearing to trigger the first wave of Titans. After about 2-3 waves, Desnas Hubor will appear. If you can do so safely, pull him separately and concentrate all your fire power on the boss; once he dies, you can return to Glint (you get credit even if there are other titans remaining).
da41f0b8171e307161009a0157645bd340836b0c.text: 現在，接近空地中的守衛以觸發第一波泰坦。大約 2-3 波後，Desnas Hubor 將會出現。如果可以安全的話，單獨拉他，集中火力攻擊boss；一旦他死了，你就可以返回 葛林特先知（即使還有其他泰坦剩下，你也會獲得積分）。

0f8f7efa59857ead6a678dd5171e30527514755e.source: If you have trouble with the titans and/or if you want to do it the proper way (with Evennia helping), always focus on the final evolution first, the Born Titans. Once they are dead, attack just one Wild Growth at-a-time and defeat its born spawns before moving on to the next. You can also fall back to the top of the hill near Evennia; it makes pulling more difficult, but is more easily defended and allows you to control how many titans you tackle at once.
0f8f7efa59857ead6a678dd5171e30527514755e.text: 如果您在泰坦方面遇到麻煩和/或如果您想以正確的方式做到這一點（在 伊凡妮雅 的幫助下），請始終首先關注最終的進化，即天生泰坦。一旦它們死了，一次只攻擊一個野生生長物並擊敗其出生的幼崽，然後再繼續攻擊下一個。您也可以退回 伊凡妮雅 附近的山頂；它使拉扯變得更加困難，但更容易防守，並允許您控制一次對付多少泰坦。

572cce956b9282703fba2a02cd60879f95e8743c.source: The foes tend to clump (especially those that appear after the death of a parent), making Panic helpful.
572cce956b9282703fba2a02cd60879f95e8743c.text: 敵人往往會聚集在一起（尤其是那些在父母過世後出現的敵人），這使得 恐慌 很有幫助。

47bbb7fb10275c599e9f3e8b299577c386f6c555.source: Other interrupts are also useful, since most of the foes here are spellcasters.
47bbb7fb10275c599e9f3e8b299577c386f6c555.text: 其他打斷也很有用，因為這裡的敵人大多是施法者。

5d2d5dc956ca58802fd1d20560b1f948439c5125.source: During this quest, the only foes in the area are the Titans.
5d2d5dc956ca58802fd1d20560b1f948439c5125.text: 在這個任務中，該地區唯一的敵人是泰坦。

b7f831497bc4f23af0e846b14b3e8c0edcc6d17d.source: Vanquishing the area while the quest is active will yield credit for approximately 200 foes, including any that spawned as a result of the deaths of other Titans. However, the kills counter will not reflect these deaths.
b7f831497bc4f23af0e846b14b3e8c0edcc6d17d.text: 在任務進行期間征服該區域將為大約 200 敵人帶來功勞，包括因其他泰坦死亡而產生的敵人。然而，擊殺計數器不會反映這些死亡。

09713247355c216a34be18b68ff097974e9d3588.source: If you complete the quest before talking to Evennia, she continues to have the green quest arrow. If you talk to her, she moves into place as if the quest was ongoing, including her script. No further titans spawn, however, and once her script is finished she leaves into the Henge of Denravi as she normally would.
09713247355c216a34be18b68ff097974e9d3588.text: 如果您在與 伊凡妮雅 交談之前完成任務，她將繼續擁有綠色任務箭頭。如果你和她說話，她就會移動到位，就好像任務正在進行一樣，包括她的指令碼。然而，沒有更多的泰坦生成，一旦她的指令碼完成，她就會像平常一樣進入 丹拉維聖地。

3b25d36815c0a2341f1af9e44d3553861e6cc39e.source: Find and destroy the Titan Lord Evirso Sectus and his army in Mineral Springs.
3b25d36815c0a2341f1af9e44d3553861e6cc39e.text: 在 礦物泉源 中找到並摧毀 泰坦 領主埃維爾索·塞克圖斯和他的軍隊。

d3c0ecd43f1d745488988d212368aaf9a47a1a60.source: Return to Vision of Glint for your reward.
d3c0ecd43f1d745488988d212368aaf9a47a1a60.text: 影返 到 葛林特先知 的願景以獲得獎勵。

a52672f215f57fc76c7355ca61c4a2a6f158b212.source: While the quest is active, the Ancient Seer and Ice Beast will not spawn in Mineral Springs.
a52672f215f57fc76c7355ca61c4a2a6f158b212.text: 當任務處於活動狀態時，遠古 預言者 和 冰獸 不會在 礦物泉源 中產生。

7f85efc5d01ffde587de57617202f63a3fcb4f89.source: This quest is straightforward in terms of where to go and what to do. However, killing titans is very difficult. Travel to Granite Citadel and take the northern exit into Tasca's Demise, where you will get your first taste of the new titans: mesmers (Titan's Malice) and monks (Titan's Heart). Head northeast to exit into Mineral Springs.
7f85efc5d01ffde587de57617202f63a3fcb4f89.text: 這個任務就去哪裡和做什麼來說很簡單。然而，殺死泰坦是非常困難的。前往花崗巖城堡，從北出口進入 塔斯拉之死，在那裡您將第一次體驗新泰坦：催眠師（泰坦 的惡意）和僧侶（泰坦 的心）。向東北方向行駛，進入 礦物泉源。

7019f8923a0c10479b8134d93ad01f540111acf7.source: At the first fork in the road, take the right path and stay with it. It will weave and turn until you reach a resurrection shrine. Past it, you will find a narrow path in the mountain. Inside that path you will find Evirso Sectus, a necromancer boss.
7019f8923a0c10479b8134d93ad01f540111acf7.text: 在第一個岔路口，走正確的路並堅持下去。它會蜿蜒轉動，直到你到達復活神殿。過了它，你會發現山裡有一條狹窄的小路。在那條路上，你會找到死靈法師 Boss Evirso Sectus。

5d31635ed495b1766c5df452818bfe9907579cd4.source: You can save yourself a lot of trouble by killing titans in a certain order, since each titan death triggers additional titan spawns: Frost Titan deaths result in an Icy Brute and a Titan's Malice; Brutes spawn a Dark Titan; and Malices spawn a Titan's Heart.
5d31635ed495b1766c5df452818bfe9907579cd4.text: 以一定順序殺死泰坦可以為自己省去很多麻煩，因為每次泰坦死亡都會觸發額外的泰坦生成：霜凍 泰坦 死亡會導致 冰凍 野蠻和 泰坦 惡意；蠻族會產生黑暗 泰坦；惡意會產生 泰坦 的心臟。

bf7a2138ff6d8ad2a38b40b5ecde768ccebb500b.source: Start with the Hearts: (a) they make killing the other titans difficult and (b) their deaths do not result in more titans.
bf7a2138ff6d8ad2a38b40b5ecde768ccebb500b.text: 從紅心開始：(a) 它們使殺死其他泰坦變得困難，並且 (b) 它們的死亡不會產生更多泰坦。

dfb238c448c9eef075dd729cb2fcdb970606c2f1.source: Skill considerations: One of the greatest challenges comes from the Frost Titan's new skill, Smash of the Titans. This skill does around 300 AoE damage, AoE knockdown, and removes all enchantments from one foe. This means that tanks that rely on enchantments (such as Shadow Form, for example) will be ineffective. Also Bonders will have trouble keeping the team bonded. An effective strategy is to use a Soul Twisting ritualist with Shelter, Displacement, and Union up 100% of the time in order to keep the team healthy with other healers to back him up.
dfb238c448c9eef075dd729cb2fcdb970606c2f1.text: 技能 注意事項： 最大的挑戰之一來自於 Frost 泰坦 的新技能「泰坦粉碎」。此技能造成 300 範圍性 傷害、範圍性 擊倒，並移除一名敵人的所有結界。這意味著依賴結界（例如 暗影形態）的坦克將無效。此外，債券人也很難維持團隊的凝聚力。一個有效的策略是使用 生靈扭轉 儀式師與 庇護、偏移 和 聯合 一起使用 100%，以保持團隊健康並有其他治療師支援他。

0e65f061d5706dd931b4429970b5531901846b31.source: Travel to Fort Aspenwood and speak to Master Architect Gunther.
0e65f061d5706dd931b4429970b5531901846b31.text: 前往 楊木要塞 並與建築大師 Gunther 交談。

c1f14347eb2590b72297638f5bcfae7507c5e1e4.source: Leave House Zu Heltzer via the portal into Ferndale. Slowly pull the patrolling Mantids to the initial shrine where the NPCs will assist you in fighting them. Once they are dead, head northeast, being wary of the Stone Spores enviromental effect, past Urkal the Ambusher, killing the Dredge monks first. Continue east across the wide flats, avoiding Mungri Magicbox if you do not have the ability to kill a strong monk boss. Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick) lies ahead, and through this outpost you can access Fort Aspenwood. Talk to Master Architect Gunther to receive your reward.
c1f14347eb2590b72297638f5bcfae7507c5e1e4.text: 透過傳送門離開 鳳荷 之家進入 蕨谷。慢慢地將巡邏的螳螂拉到最初的神殿，在那裡 NPC 會協助你對抗它們。一旦他們死了，向東北方向前進，警惕石孢子的環境影響，經過伏擊者烏卡爾，首先殺死 挖掘者 僧侶。繼續向東穿過寬廣的平地，如果你沒有能力殺死強大的武僧首領，請避開 魔法盒 牧格里。阿斯本伍德門 (庫茲柯) 位於前方，透過這個前哨站您可以進入 楊木要塞。與建築大師岡瑟交談以獲得獎勵。

dba43ec2a311a254c086cbe5500471a128948822.source: The Luxon equivalent of this quest is Fort Aspenwood.
dba43ec2a311a254c086cbe5500471a128948822.text: 此任務的 勒克森 等效項是 楊木要塞。

c69592182d87fb13fbdda53be961382a492a7eea.source: Nobody in your party has All for One and One for Justice or Mhenlo's Request active.
c69592182d87fb13fbdda53be961382a492a7eea.text: 你的隊伍中沒有人啟動「一切為了一和一為了正義」或 涵洛 的請求。

071f22e50c0b643eebf5c1145b8a63a6ab91d048.source: Travel to Lion's Arch and speak with Firstwatch Sergio to learn of the fate of North Kryta Province.
071f22e50c0b643eebf5c1145b8a63a6ab91d048.text: 前往 獅子拱門 並與 警衛隊長薩吉歐 交談，瞭解 科瑞塔北部 的命運。

0003e17424c23566f7d94220de27176e042b5e7a.source: Speak with Lionscout Gabrian to discover the fate of the Ascalon Settlement.
0003e17424c23566f7d94220de27176e042b5e7a.text: 與 Lionscout Gabrian 交談，瞭解 阿斯卡隆移民區 的命運。

e18d8c7026f3a6b294ef868d47f20f94ecbb3626.source: Seek out Captain Greywind to discover if the Ascalon Settlement is safe.
e18d8c7026f3a6b294ef868d47f20f94ecbb3626.text: 尋找 格雷溫軍官 以瞭解 阿斯卡隆移民區 是否安全。

bdc4992680c26c00d104484829e830e1fa7dd7cf.source: Defend Captain Greywind and the trapped Ascalon Settlers. Keep Captain Greywind alive!
bdc4992680c26c00d104484829e830e1fa7dd7cf.text: 保衛 格雷溫軍官 和被困的 阿斯卡隆 定居者。讓 格雷溫軍官 保持活力！

70668561aeee3d03a4c8bf0e20bd4779437e45bc.source: Return to the Ascalon Settlement and defend it! Captain Greywind must survive.
70668561aeee3d03a4c8bf0e20bd4779437e45bc.text: 影返 到 阿斯卡隆移民區 並捍衛它！ 格雷溫軍官 必須生存。

6574db39317b9013882ee1d0f476fd64d73814dd.source: When you leave Lion's Arch, you will find Lionscout Gabrian just outside the door, he will direct you to Captain Greywind. Follow the path to the settlement. It is possible to dodge all the Titan patrols on the way to the Captain. When you get to the sign where it points to the settlement in one way and Giant's Basin in the other, head to Giant's Basin (northeast). As soon as you near Captain Greywind, he will warn of incoming Titans. They will come from two directions in groups of Wind Born Titans, Earth Born Titans and Water Born Titans.
6574db39317b9013882ee1d0f476fd64d73814dd.text: 當您離開 獅子拱門 時，您會在門外找到 Lionscout Gabrian，他會帶您前往 格雷溫軍官。沿著小路前往定居點。在前往隊長的途中可以躲避所有 泰坦 巡邏隊。當您到達一側指向聚居地、另一側指向 馴服的霜巨人 盆地的標誌時，前往 馴服的霜巨人 盆地（東北）。一旦您靠近 格雷溫軍官，他就會警告即將到來的泰坦。他們將來自兩個方向，分別是風生泰坦、地生泰坦和水生泰坦。

d34f2ab53137ed6a535a20fba61862dc785e529c.source: After all waves (four in total) are beaten, Greywind will take you to the Ascalon Settlement, where you will have to fight off several waves of Titans led by Mentanl Arobo, a necromancer Titan boss. If your party wipes, Captain Greywind will most certainly die before you resurrect at the shrine, and you will fail the quest.
d34f2ab53137ed6a535a20fba61862dc785e529c.text: 在擊敗所有波次（總共四波）後，灰風將帶您前往 阿斯卡隆移民區，在那裡您必須擊退死靈法師 泰坦 Boss Mentanl Arobo 領導的幾波泰坦。如果你的隊伍被消滅了，格雷溫軍官 肯定會在你在神社復活之前就死掉，而你的任務也會失敗。

931dccb0d9106c8188e34d25abf1408507b4e3e0.source: It is important to properly prepare for this quest. Your party must be able to do two things:
931dccb0d9106c8188e34d25abf1408507b4e3e0.text: 為這個任務做好適當的準備很重要。你的隊伍必須能夠做兩件事：

7d9983976ccdae1849bc9e457917b3e7a6c9d3db.source: Keep fighting for a long time. The siege at the end will present wave after wave of Titan groups, and running out of energy or having two party members die is not an option.
7d9983976ccdae1849bc9e457917b3e7a6c9d3db.text: 繼續戰鬥很長時間。最後的圍攻將出現一波又一波的 泰坦 隊伍，能量耗盡或兩名隊員死亡都不是一個選擇。

5ba4feb4cf613d8da2c87ecd71ad46b585df64da.source: Finish off groups quickly. Your party will need to be deadly efficient and organized. The longer a group of titans takes to kill, the closer your party is to certain failure as it will soon be overrun.
5ba4feb4cf613d8da2c87ecd71ad46b585df64da.text: 快速完成小組任務。你的聚會需要非常有效率和有組織。一群泰坦殺死敵人的時間越長，你的隊伍就越接近失敗，因為很快就會被佔領。

cf8757e9225e1416fa3f0363ddb6b743d50833c6.source: The main threat is from the Wind, Water and Earth Born Titans which are all elementalists with strong defensive skills. Always take them out first, then Rotting Titans, and leave Wild Growths for last. Of the Born Titans, concentrate on killing the Wind Born Titans before the others. They possess the ability to deal spike damage in groups, and have been known to deal over 180 damage with their Chain Lightning to multiple targets at once. They will also blind and weaken the attackers on your team using Blinding Flash and Enervating Charge. The Water and Earth Born Titans are not as dangerous: Earth Born Titans use Stone Daggers which deals relatively low damage, while Water Born Titans cast Maelstrom, which can be moved away from (you may have to manually flag heroes and henchmen, however).
cf8757e9225e1416fa3f0363ddb6b743d50833c6.text: 主要威脅來自風生泰坦、水生泰坦和土生泰坦，他們都是具有強大防禦能力的元素使。永遠先消滅它們，然後消滅腐爛泰坦，最後留下野生植物。在天生泰坦中，集中精力先於其他人殺死風生泰坦。他們擁有成群造成尖峰傷害的能力，並且眾所周知，他們的 連鎖閃電 可以同時對多個目標造成超過 180 傷害。他們也會使用 眩目之光 和 衰弱電擊 來致盲並削弱團隊中的攻擊者。水生泰坦和地生泰坦並不那麼危險：地生泰坦使用 石之匕首，造成相對較低的傷害，而水生泰坦則施放 水漩渦，可以將其移開（但是，您可能需要手動標記英雄和追隨者）。

5c3945c2eb9f551fcd682d07a7418068487f6ea2.source: In fact, the key to winning the final siege is to ignore every Wild Growth that comes and to reduce every Rotting Titan to a Wild Growth then leave it. After the attacking forces are only a bunch of Wild Growths, clear them out one at a time, killing the Wild Growth and then the three Born Titans that it spawns before moving on to the next one. This is because the Wild Growths are rangers with no interruption skills, only damage and poison, which a pair of good monks should be able to overcome.
5c3945c2eb9f551fcd682d07a7418068487f6ea2.text: 事實上，贏得最終圍攻的關鍵是忽略每一個出現的野生生長，並將每一個腐爛的 泰坦 減少為野生生長，然後離開它。當攻擊部隊只剩下一堆野生生長物後，一次清除一個，殺死野生生長物，然後殺死它所產生的三個天生泰坦，然後再繼續處理下一個。因為野怪是遊俠，沒有打斷技能，只有傷害和毒藥，一對好修士應該要能克服。

a109376d14316c83709eda85efed9cb451ae09e2.source: Resurrection Signet or Sunspear Rebirth Signet: fighting for an extended period with a party member down is not advised.
a109376d14316c83709eda85efed9cb451ae09e2.text: 復活紋章 或 Sunspear 重生 紋章：不建議在隊伍成員倒下的情況下進行長時間戰鬥。

8fba280749bfcebdb0b6c1e907480b42f0929845.source: Blood is Power and/or Blood Ritual to provide energy for the long fights.
8fba280749bfcebdb0b6c1e907480b42f0929845.text: 血之權能 和/或 血之祭典 提供長期戰鬥能量。

1d0b6e07db49d3801640a981ac5d30fa7eb0bd02.source: Meteor Shower or Maelstrom: cast on Wild Growths just before they die so that the spawning Titans are interrupted.
1d0b6e07db49d3801640a981ac5d30fa7eb0bd02.text: 隕石雨 或 水漩渦：在野生生物死亡前施放，以便打斷生成的泰坦。

4ed02eb7a765f94bfe85207e37c252bd29cc5524.source: Interrupt and daze skills to shut down the Born Titans.
4ed02eb7a765f94bfe85207e37c252bd29cc5524.text: 中斷 和暈眩技能可以關閉天生泰坦。

c9968e67c6f28be1b75805b380040304cd6bcadb.source: Condition removal skills such as Restore Condition, Martyr, and Cautery Signet.
c9968e67c6f28be1b75805b380040304cd6bcadb.text: 條件移除技能，例如 回復病症、殉教 和 淨潔紋章。

645b1d8c1e936532566bcff30ba2c266fc733e25.source: Corpse exploitation skills can be useful to preempt the Rotting Titans' Well of Suffering, but be wary of bringing minions as they can inadvertently kill Wild Growths.
645b1d8c1e936532566bcff30ba2c266fc733e25.text: 屍體剝削技能對於搶佔腐爛泰坦的 痛苦之池 很有用，但要小心攜帶小兵，因為它們可能會無意中殺死野生生物。

e30a4f1b2a4b6d7d327fb03f87ca28e1fab0e73e.source: Skills that use conditions to your advantage such as Melandru's Resilience, "I Will Survive!", or Resilient Weapon can also be useful.
e30a4f1b2a4b6d7d327fb03f87ca28e1fab0e73e.text: 利用條件對你有利的技能，例如 梅蘭朵的元氣、「我會生存！」或 活力武裝 也很有用。

42ba1d0561eab44d4b36604e3999a766d7b77961.source: Fire damage is effective against the Titans.
42ba1d0561eab44d4b36604e3999a766d7b77961.text: 火焰傷害 對泰坦很有效。

6c4ececc218e62a3782498cb65a270cd32609a75.source: Leaving from the Temple of the Ages and not entering any outposts along the way will give you an 8 member party. Be aware though that if you are doing the quest with heroes and fail, your party will be returned to Lion's Arch and will lose two members.
6c4ececc218e62a3782498cb65a270cd32609a75.text: 從 世紀神殿 出發並且沿途不進入任何前哨基地將為您提供一個 8 成員隊伍。但請注意，如果您與英雄一起執行任務並失敗，您的隊伍將返回 獅子拱門 並失去兩名成員。

366cf6b7f3d0c3df3165f4c6041058f0b4f3b297.source: You can skip talking to Lionscout Gabrian and go straight to Captain Greywind.
366cf6b7f3d0c3df3165f4c6041058f0b4f3b297.text: 您可以跳過與 Lionscout Gabrian 的對話，直接前往 格雷溫軍官。

c1ac0782f71fc1370b5f7f814d853a8289bfa6da.source: Minion masters can use the corpses of Krytan Peasants that lie along the back path to the Ascalon settlement so that they have a standing army before the battle.
c1ac0782f71fc1370b5f7f814d853a8289bfa6da.text: 小兵大師可以使用位於 阿斯卡隆 定居點後路的科瑞坦農民的屍體，以便他們在戰鬥前擁有一支常備軍。

01edd994c348d4a701e7751245cae82dbfa3ff57.source: Area of effect spells should be used carefully to ensure that you do not accidentally kill more than one Wild Growth at once.
01edd994c348d4a701e7751245cae82dbfa3ff57.text: 應謹慎使用範圍法術，以確保您不會意外地同時殺死超過一株野生植物。

bc59569e6c117606fce64cde59614118ed7f64b5.source: Morale Boosts and Holy Blessing can be acquired from the statue of Dwayna.
bc59569e6c117606fce64cde59614118ed7f64b5.text: 士氣提升與神聖 祝福 可從德薇娜雕像中獲得。

3fecced231ae61aaff8990fe8706224bf231ae48.source: You can kill bosses in Nebo Terrace to gain a 2% Morale Boost for each boss. Using the portal to North Kryta Province to rezone, you can continually kill the Tengu boss on the path between North Kryta Province and Bergen Hot Springs to gain a 10% Morale Boost.
3fecced231ae61aaff8990fe8706224bf231ae48.text: 您可以殺死 尼伯山丘 中的頭目，為每個頭目獲得 2% 士氣提升。使用 科瑞塔北部 的傳送門進行重新分割槽，您可以連續殺死 科瑞塔北部 和 卑爾根溫泉 之間路徑上的 天狗 boss，以獲得 10% 士氣提升。

b6c68f4049d6b0bfb7553c497e4cf701480d0f42.source: There are some Lion's Arch Sentinels near the Ascalon Settlement. Beware of the Titans that spawn when you approach them.
b6c68f4049d6b0bfb7553c497e4cf701480d0f42.text: 阿斯卡隆移民區 附近有一些 獅子拱門 哨兵。當你接近泰坦時要小心它們。

8c4b0bd3b7096cd873b4786ab8a5f2e68d3cb48f.source: Having the quests Gain Olias (old) or Mhenlo's Request active will prevent this quest from being available.
8c4b0bd3b7096cd873b4786ab8a5f2e68d3cb48f.text: 啟動任務「獲得奧利亞斯」（舊）或 涵洛 的請求將阻止該任務可用。

a85705e97d7008436c49809feb430aa832700299.source: If War in Kryta is active, you will have a Shining Blade ally, and some groups of associated enemies will spawn.
a85705e97d7008436c49809feb430aa832700299.text: 如果 科瑞塔戰爭 處於活動狀態，您將擁有一個 光刃公會 盟友，並且會產生一些相關敵人群組。

b3dd2754474291155e5165050e401c5c57b2a914.source: There is a group of about 5 Lionguard Sentries on the northern beach. They will cry out for help, after which two groups of third-generation Titans will spawn. Because the sheer power of the Titans, if this spawn is triggered when not charging to the Lionguard's rescue from the western entrance of the beach, they will be killed quickly.
b3dd2754474291155e5165050e401c5c57b2a914.text: 北部海灘上有一群大約 5 的獅衛哨兵。他們會大聲呼救，之後會產下兩組第三代泰坦。因為泰坦的力量非常強大，如果在沒有從海灘西入口衝鋒救援雄獅守衛時觸發這個重生，他們很快就會被殺死。

c9c3eeb085b165c8823d826f5ba0600f2b088182.source: Before you start moving towards North Kryta Province, make sure you activate War in Kryta spawns (if available) by taking a daily Wanted quest from Lion's Arch Keep. This will net you up to three extra allies upon entering the zone. One can even keep zoning between the Nebo Terrace and North Kryta Province to make the desired ally spawn, for example the fire Elementalist Lawrence Crafton.
c9c3eeb085b165c8823d826f5ba0600f2b088182.text: 在開始走向 科瑞塔北部 之前，請確保通過接受 獅子拱門要塞 的每日通緝任務來啟用 科瑞塔戰爭 生成點（如果有）。這將使你在進入該區域時獲得最多三個額外的盟友。人們甚至可以在 尼伯山丘 和 科瑞塔北部 之間保持分割槽，以生成所需的盟友，例如火焰 元素使 Lawrence Crafton。

bef496f82412b13fc7bcc84bb5cfb577f1364da7.source: Starting from the Temple of the Ages with your party of 8, travel through the Black Curtain, Cursed Lands and Nebo Terrace into North Kryta Province. Head North East into the Ascalonian Settlement and then South East to Captain Greywind - talking to Lionscout Gabrian is optional and not required.
bef496f82412b13fc7bcc84bb5cfb577f1364da7.text: 與您的 8 隊伍從 世紀神殿 出發，穿過黑幕、詛咒之地 和 尼伯山丘 進入 科瑞塔北部。向東北方向前往阿斯卡隆定居點，然後向東南方向前往 格雷溫軍官 - 與 Lionscout Gabrian 交談是可選的，但不是必需的。

bfd030cf1058c14dca4fed9bac75bce3fc3144f7.source: This first area will have a few waves of third generation elementalist Titans followed by a few Wild Growths. The elementalist Titans should be killed before attacking any Wild Growths to avoid facing huge numbers of high damage output elementalists. It is recommended to make any elementalists attacking Greywind a priority, since if he dies the quest fails and you have to return to the outpost.
bfd030cf1058c14dca4fed9bac75bce3fc3144f7.text: 第一個區域將有幾波第三代元素泰坦，然後是一些野生生長物。在攻擊任何野生植物之前應該先殺死元素泰坦，以避免面對大量高傷害輸出的元素主義者。建議優先考慮攻擊灰風的元素主義者，因為如果他死了，任務就會失敗，你必須回到前哨站。

7a6d39b830347a3d4871c209fcdf25b5f9b7856c.source: After the initial battle, Captain Greywind will head to the gates of the Ascalonian Settlement and this is when the fight becomes much tougher. As before, attempt to eliminate elementalists before any other type of titan. Beware of Greywind moving away from the camp to engage titans. If this does happen however, and there are still waves to go, consider moving the frontline forward, instead of hoping to make Greywind retreat to his original location. This increases the chance of getting flanked, but decreases the chance of having Greywind becoming attacked by an entire mob.
7a6d39b830347a3d4871c209fcdf25b5f9b7856c.text: 最初的戰鬥結束後，格雷溫軍官 將前往阿斯卡隆定居點的大門，此時戰鬥將變得更加激烈。和以前一樣，嘗試在消滅任何其他型別的泰坦之前消滅元素主義者。小心灰風離開營地去與泰坦交戰。然而，如果這種情況確實發生了，而且還有一波波的攻擊，請考慮將前線向前推進，而不是指望讓灰風撤退到原來的位置。這增加了受到側翼攻擊的機率，但降低了灰風被整個生物攻擊的機率。

9c9b107f68c379b26a65a38d7d47e2bbec2f8d60.source: Eventually Captain Greywind will say that "It appears that was the last of them", and the quest is complete.
9c9b107f68c379b26a65a38d7d47e2bbec2f8d60.text: 最終 格雷溫軍官 會說“看來這是他們中的最後一個了”，任務就完成了。

52baa3e7d803a3d44ab555c7ce25bc72f11003ea.source: Stopping the damage from the Earth, Water & Wind Born Titans is the key to success. To achieve this, defensive skills like Protective Spirit, "Save Yourselves!" and Shelter, and offensive shutdown like Panic or daze are a good idea since the majority of the threat is from casters.
52baa3e7d803a3d44ab555c7ce25bc72f11003ea.text: 阻止地球的破壞，水與風生泰坦是成功的關鍵。為了實現這一目標，需要使用 精神守護 等防禦技能“拯救自己！”和 庇護，以及像 恐慌 或發呆這樣的進攻性關閉是一個好主意，因為大多數威脅來自腳輪。

d572f207c9db972b5a11589f65b4075aeea31e1c.source: A consumable set, in conjunction with summoning stones will make the party significantly more effective and durable.
d572f207c9db972b5a11589f65b4075aeea31e1c.text: 消耗品套裝與召喚石相結合將使隊伍變得更加有效和持久。

60e31c56b69e053015069e726b10042cb4931e1a.source: Hero builds should be able to maintain energy during extended periods of combat.
60e31c56b69e053015069e726b10042cb4931e1a.text: 英雄 版本應該能夠在長時間的戰鬥中保持能量。

c35ea65b508bdca6bdb2b08a1532d695f489653c.source: There is a group of about 5 Lionguard Sentries on the northern beach, which will join you if saved, and thus provide extra allies. The sentries will cry out for help when the player gets in range, after which two groups of third-generation Titans will spawn. Because of the sheer power of the Titans, if this spawn is triggered when not charging to the Lionguard's rescue from the western entrance of the beach, they will be killed in seconds.
c35ea65b508bdca6bdb2b08a1532d695f489653c.text: 北部海灘上有一群大約 5 的獅子衛士哨兵，如果被拯救，它們會加入你，從而提供額外的盟友。當玩家進入射程時，哨兵會大聲呼救，之後會產生兩組第三代泰坦。由於泰坦的強大力量，如果在沒有從海灘西入口衝鋒救援雄獅守衛時觸發此重生，他們將在幾秒鐘內被殺死。

77aef5cf1979145490065e119c192cc0dcbd1368.source: If Captain Greywind dies, a window about mission failure will appear but there will be a countdown to resurrecting. However, you die immediately when resurrected. Two of the six Settlement Guards are level 20 instead of level 28.
77aef5cf1979145490065e119c192cc0dcbd1368.text: 如果格雷溫軍官死亡，將會出現任務失敗的視窗，但會有復活倒數計時。然而，當你復活時，你會立即死亡。六個定居點守衛中有兩個是 20 級別，而不是 28 級別。

a9d1807df9467b5710674458516e76a9a1b9626f.source: Destroy the Shadow Army Invader. You have 12..0 groups left.
a9d1807df9467b5710674458516e76a9a1b9626f.text: 摧毀 暗影軍團 入侵者。您還剩下 12..0 組。

15122e33101502f1f275b4a6a51a7dac05f5da28.source: Return to Eternal Forgemaster for your reward.
15122e33101502f1f275b4a6a51a7dac05f5da28.text: 影返 至 永生的鍛造大師 以獲得獎勵。

f64564d2f99139ebbddb4fd6313bff48d55922d9.source: Upon accepting this quest two large groups of Abyssals and Shadow Beasts will spawn at the doors to the Temple, and will soon start attacking the altar. Make sure your party is ready before accepting.
f64564d2f99139ebbddb4fd6313bff48d55922d9.text: 接受此任務後，兩大群深淵獸和 闇影 野獸將在神殿門口生成，並很快開始攻擊祭壇。在接受之前請確保您的聚會已準備好。

0eb52148de1be89ccdc198524aa9f1eaf2d4f1c3.source: The invaders will come up a pair at a time and are relatively easy to dispose of. First eight pairs of Shadow Beasts then the four pairs of Abyssals. When they are all defeated, Temple Guards will spawn to take over the defense of the Temple. The waves are scripted to flank the Eternal Forgemaster: walking around the anvil and attacking it from its sides. An easy protection measure is thus to simply flag two heroes adjacent to the Forgemaster. The enemies will be unable to get to him.
0eb52148de1be89ccdc198524aa9f1eaf2d4f1c3.text: 入侵者一次會出現一對，相對容易消滅。前八對 闇影 野獸，然後是四對深淵獸。當他們全部被擊敗後，聖殿守衛就會出現，接管聖殿的防禦。波浪被設計為從側面攻擊 永生的鍛造大師：繞過鐵砧並從其側面攻擊它。因此，一個簡單的保護措施就是簡單地標記與鍛造大師相鄰的兩個英雄。敵人將無法接近他。

c486f1c66696036757859384fd0f094dd7edb462.source: Like most quest NPCs, the Eternal Forgemaster's death will fail the quest and the team will be kicked out of the Fissure of Woe.
c486f1c66696036757859384fd0f094dd7edb462.text: 與大多數任務 NPC 一樣，永生的鍛造大師 的死亡將使任務失敗，並且團隊將被踢出悲傷裂縫。

88297c9ed75e0b5b93d2ca4edb65766263360e9e.source: This quest, along with The Eternal Forgemaster and Restore the Temple of War quests, are required to be completed in order to craft Obsidian Armor.
88297c9ed75e0b5b93d2ca4edb65766263360e9e.text: 為了製作黑曜石 防禦，需要完成此任務以及 永生的鍛造大師 和恢復戰爭神殿任務。

4eb80d02d374e45138ef608137bd676b67fd4f38.source: Defeat the band of Corsairs roaming in Fahranur.
4eb80d02d374e45138ef608137bd676b67fd4f38.text: 擊敗在法赫拉努爾漫遊的海盜團夥。

4989b264b6fab58a1596c5b1bdc514bbbf64ee3c.source: Seek out Arred the Unready and force him into submission.
4989b264b6fab58a1596c5b1bdc514bbbf64ee3c.text: 找到未準備者阿瑞德並迫使他屈服。

14ff5a9987f3e737e64736c3501c91522fb3b2ee.source: Make Arred the Unready tell you about the rumored Corsairs rallying in the area. Use any means necessary.
14ff5a9987f3e737e64736c3501c91522fb3b2ee.text: 讓未準備者阿雷德告訴你傳聞中的海盜在該地區集結的訊息。使用任何必要的手段。

64cbc35380ec7b1df7d322cff4f1056a15e625de.source: Leave Blacktide Den from the northwest gate and defeat the three groups of corsairs. They are in groups of three, and shouldn't pose any real threat. After defeating these, head to Arred the Unready. After getting him down to roughly 10% of his health, he becomes non-hostile. It is recommended that you keep using the "interrogate" option, as it saves an unnecessary battle, although it has been reported that he may turn hostile anyway.
64cbc35380ec7b1df7d322cff4f1056a15e625de.text: 從西北門離開黑潮巢穴，擊敗三組海盜。他們三人一組，不會構成任何真正的威脅。擊敗這些人後，前往未準備者阿雷德。在讓他的健康狀況下降到大約 10% 後，他變得不再有敵意。建議您繼續使用「審問」選項，因為它可以避免不必要的戰鬥，儘管有報道稱他可能會變得敵對。

fa6c8d97cd715d6325cb9798b3849619a495505a.source: If you approach Arred before defeating all of the other corsairs, he will still fight and turn non-hostile around 10% health, but will not progress the quest until you kill the rest of his crew.
fa6c8d97cd715d6325cb9798b3849619a495505a.text: 如果你在擊敗所有其他海盜之前接近 Arred，他仍然會戰鬥並圍繞 10% 生命值轉為非敵對狀態，但在你殺死他的其餘船員之前不會繼續任務。

405074e89723edf86c855181cf1f0cb3831a7b10.source: Find Captain Sargen's unit deep in Raven's Point.
405074e89723edf86c855181cf1f0cb3831a7b10.text: 在 渡鴉岬角 深處找到薩根隊長的部隊。

8244a454615acb2db8c7adecdb056e89caeb5355.source: Captain Sargen's unit is located within Level 3 of the Raven's Point dungeon.
8244a454615acb2db8c7adecdb056e89caeb5355.text: 薩根隊長的單位位於 渡鴉岬角 地牢的 3 層內。

670688b7c2452890819180faa04d728501056bd6.source: There are many places throughout the levels where there are flame braziers, which must be lit to open the doors. One is always lit. A chest will spawn after defeating an Ancient Vaettir, and spawns a torch that you can light the other braziers with. Keep in mind that any torch can be used and thus carrying just one torch through the level is sufficient.
670688b7c2452890819180faa04d728501056bd6.text: 關卡中很多地方都有火盆，必須點燃火盆才能開啟門。其中一個始終亮著。擊敗遠古瓦蒂爾後會產生一個箱子，並產生一個火炬，你可以用它點燃其他火盆。請記住，可以使用任何火炬，因此只需攜帶火炬通過關卡就足夠了。

093e4e7f1722155e793395fb174bd26e1c8e5bca.source: In the first level, you need to defeat the Reaper of Destruction, which is a dervish boss, and several Destroyers that will spawn around it to get the dungeon key. You must kill all the Destroyers (including the ones that have not spawned behind the boss yet, if the boss is lured) for the dungeon key to drop. You also can summon a Dwarven Ghost if you have Light of Deldrimor close to where you pick up the area map. There are two hidden treasures in the exit area with the drakes.
093e4e7f1722155e793395fb174bd26e1c8e5bca.text: 在第一個關卡中，你需要擊敗 毀滅 的收割者，這是一個托缽僧 Boss，以及在它周圍生成的幾隻毀滅者，以獲得地牢鑰匙。你必須殺死所有毀滅者（包括那些尚未在 Boss 後面生成的毀滅者，如果 Boss 被引誘的話）才能掉落地牢鑰匙。如果您在拾取區域地圖的位置附近有 戴爾狄摩 之光，您也可以召喚矮人幽靈。出口處有兩個隱藏的寶藏和龍。

083f2deff7d597497777b0d859fe6272ddec72e3.source: At the second level, the dungeon key is located in the western portion. When you pick up the key, several Destroyers will spawn between your party and the dungeon gate. There is a potentially frustrating section on this level that requires you to light a torch, run past a gauntlet of ice-jet traps, and then light another pair of braziers (in order to make a bridge appear). It is possible to do this without a speed boost skill, but it is advised to bring one. With or without, you may have to try this several times before you succeed. This can be accomplished simply by running between the ice wall and the ice-jet traps (behind them). There is enough space to run behind them when they are on and down the middle of the chamber when they turn off.
083f2deff7d597497777b0d859fe6272ddec72e3.text: 在第二層，地牢鑰匙位於西部。當你拿起鑰匙時，幾輛毀滅者會在你的隊伍和地牢門之間產生。這個關卡中有一個可能令人沮喪的部分，需要你點燃火把，跑過冰射陷阱的挑戰，然後點燃另一對火盆（為了讓一座橋出現）。沒有速度提陞技能也可以做到這一點，但建議攜帶一個。不管有沒有，你可能都需要嘗試幾次才能成功。這可以透過在冰牆和冰噴射陷阱（在它們後面）之間執行來簡單地實現。當它們開啟時，有足夠的空間可以在它們後面執行；當它們關閉時，它們可以在腔室的中間執行。

24e1ffd91332bf00068e121723c0c5b6ecaaa280.source: The third level is very short. You will notice a group of Dwarves, and they will be attacked by several waves of Destroyers coming from all sides. Survive the waves, and the end boss, the Plague of Destruction will show up at the end of it. Kill it to clear the dungeon, and pick up your reward from the Destroyer Chest. Note that surviving the waves of Destroyers is generally harder than defeating the Plague of Destruction.
24e1ffd91332bf00068e121723c0c5b6ecaaa280.text: 第三層很短。你會注意到一群矮人，他們會受到來自四面八方的幾波毀滅者的攻擊。在海浪中生存下來，最後的boss 疫之破壞者將在最後出現。殺死它以清除地牢，並從毀滅者 寶箱 處領取獎勵。請注意，在毀滅者的浪潮中生存通常比擊敗 疫之破壞者 更困難。

3183c801a3809406816951c05ba508b1bbac9405.source: A speed boost can make it easier to run torches (especially on level 2), but you can manage without one.
3183c801a3809406816951c05ba508b1bbac9405.text: 速度提升可以讓你更輕鬆地執行火把（尤其是在 2 關卡），但你也可以在沒有火把的情況下進行管理。

8217cf827474d638bc40dda24878a186cfe6e726.source: You generally can drop the Unlit Torches after opening a passageway as there are several chests containing new unlit torches that you can find along the way.
8217cf827474d638bc40dda24878a186cfe6e726.text: 通常，您可以在開啟通道後掉落未點燃的火把，因為沿途您可以找到幾個裝有新的未點燃的火把的箱子。

701b16da64d8b007c5f5e84fc6b125c93550235c.source: Once you kill the Reaper of Destruction on level 2, your route to the exit will fill with spawns of destroyers.
701b16da64d8b007c5f5e84fc6b125c93550235c.text: 一旦你在 2 關卡殺死了 毀滅 的死神，你通往出口的路線就會佈滿驅逐艦。

a6b3005d04ba0848e7b0446e26282a8f99eb88d6.source: If you are having trouble, you can run away from the destroyers and wait for nearby ice traps or remaining foes to weaken the groups enough for you to finish off the rest.
a6b3005d04ba0848e7b0446e26282a8f99eb88d6.text: 如果你遇到麻煩，你可以逃離驅逐艦，等待附近的冰陷阱或剩餘的敵人削弱隊伍的力量，讓你消滅剩下的人。

a44d2b9f60e908d689f710d5e049b51d57a4e982.source: Destroyers are resistant to fire damage and immune to Burning. Several foes here (Elementals and Nightmares) are not fleshy.
a44d2b9f60e908d689f710d5e049b51d57a4e982.text: 驅逐艦能夠抵抗火焰傷害並免疫燃燒。這裡的幾個敵人（元素和夢魘）不是肉身的。

867f54e59592306d6fc5deb06c68848336e0b63d.source: If you save the northeastern group of Dwarves then they will patrol towards Captain Sargen's unit - potentially helping your group engage with the Destroyers.
867f54e59592306d6fc5deb06c68848336e0b63d.text: 如果你拯救了東北部的矮人隊伍，那麼他們將向薩根隊長的部隊巡邏——可能會幫助你的隊伍與毀滅者交戰。

3fbba82435f113e14f19e62d3a0999a7cb73e5fb.source: The quest log could update itself as "Completed" after killing the waves of Destroyers but not the Plague of Destruction.
3fbba82435f113e14f19e62d3a0999a7cb73e5fb.text: 殺死一波波驅逐艦後，任務日誌可以將自身更新為“已完成”，但不能更新為 疫之破壞者。

b6d841ddb76f1aace66c3a2c3b3cc58553a2aa79.source: You must have Monk or Mesmer as your primary or secondary profession.
b6d841ddb76f1aace66c3a2c3b3cc58553a2aa79.text: 您必須將 僧侶 或 幻術師 作為您的主要或次要職業。

44e9f524cc04e738d94f5a8634817ab05b14a184.source: Speak with Lo Sha again to begin the test.
44e9f524cc04e738d94f5a8634817ab05b14a184.text: 再次與 羅夏 交談以開始測試。

0751f03911acd077880c85eb35cb9c3b6cbc4ad3.source: Defeat Su or survive for 2 minutes.
0751f03911acd077880c85eb35cb9c3b6cbc4ad3.text: 擊敗 Su 或存活 2 分鐘。

66cb09f36d88844c5fd54941b59f28bc54b751e9.text: 再次與 羅夏 交談。

9e8c8d1e979ac61812943fecf17f58a42b2c5d40.source: Using a hex removal skill will not ensure your survival; bring a healing skill as well. Alternatively, just hurt Su enough and you will complete the quest, regardless of how much time remains.
9e8c8d1e979ac61812943fecf17f58a42b2c5d40.text: 使用六角去除技能並不能確保你的生存；還帶來一個治療技能。或者，只要對蘇造成足夠的傷害，無論還剩多少時間，你都會完成任務。

2d83151d03e8971066e293561ffa87453eb5132e.source: Lo Sha claims the skills are provided by him, when they are provided by Instructer Ng.
2d83151d03e8971066e293561ffa87453eb5132e.text: 羅夏 聲稱這些技能是他所提供的，而實際上這些技能是由吳教練提供的。

41fda3d80407ee653f4fe2aad7bea5675476e917.source: Clear the Dejarin Estate in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
41fda3d80407ee653f4fe2aad7bea5675476e917.text: 在困難模式下清除 高楠 中德賈林莊園的所有敵人。

22550a38978d7cb2ef355b69e82df275fc118617.source: "Clear the Dejarin Estate in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."
22550a38978d7cb2ef355b69e82df275fc118617.text: “在困難模式下清除 高楠 中德賈林莊園的所有敵人。”

fe10a7c3e3ae33819a7ba96181b8faf7fe717356.source: From Yohlon Haven, head east through Arkjok Ward and Pogahn Passage.
fe10a7c3e3ae33819a7ba96181b8faf7fe717356.text: 從 猶朗避難所 出發，向東穿過 阿爾科監禁區 和 波甘驛站。

578650b82df82a28291a8a8ca4fb4b80b11b85a0.source: Alternatively, from the Sunspear Sanctuary, one can head north into the Command Post then east through Jahai Bluffs and south east through Kodonur Crossroads.
578650b82df82a28291a8a8ca4fb4b80b11b85a0.text: 或者，可以從 日戟避難所 往北進入 指揮所，然後往東穿過 夏亥峭壁，再往東南穿過 科登諾入口。

e63f6e5f979c17c4a4e1438903f8d520e404f73c.source: The majority of Kournan troops are level 16 (normal mode), but level 20 troops can be found inside the fort and when certain quests are active.
e63f6e5f979c17c4a4e1438903f8d520e404f73c.text: 大多數庫南部隊的等級為 16（正常模式），但在堡壘內以及某些任務處於活動狀態時可以找到 20 等級的部隊。

9121da17210e99e049d38f30858ca7f508b4c474.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.2% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
9121da17210e99e049d38f30858ca7f508b4c474.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Elonian 版圖 主打歌貢獻了約 3.2%。

abb6927ee1ac8380124aae9560cd34deabdfaea6.source: Due to a large number of foes that inflict damage with physical attacks, having some melee counter skills is recommended.
abb6927ee1ac8380124aae9560cd34deabdfaea6.text: 由於大量敵人會透過物理攻擊造成傷害，因此建議擁有一些近戰反擊技能。

40d10e9930f42ce351425c4c1f658cfe9ca9ef96.source: The central fort and its surrounding areas contain a large number of Kournan military, some with overlapping patrols. Pull carefully.
40d10e9930f42ce351425c4c1f658cfe9ca9ef96.text: 中央要塞及其周邊地區有大量 高楠士兵，其中一些有重疊巡邏。仔細拉出。

101b968f4cf3d528a69cdec24a5ab97a0a013f07.source: Podaltur the Angry's Spirit Rift is capable of dealing over 500 damage in one hit.
101b968f4cf3d528a69cdec24a5ab97a0a013f07.text: 憤怒的波達爾圖的 生靈裂縫 能夠在一擊中造成超過 500 的傷害。

875f1921e763afa786259c81e789479dba78ca0e.source: Acolyte of Dwayna can be difficult to take down because of her powerful self heals; bring interrupts or skills that can inflict Daze. She does little damage, except for her critical hits.
875f1921e763afa786259c81e789479dba78ca0e.text: 德薇娜的侍僧很難被擊倒，因為她具有強大的自我治療能力；帶來可以造成暈眩的打斷或技能。除了暴擊之外，她造成的傷害很少。

2c04a0cf957456351f0fd1f367fb3176d5b40245.source: For characters that chose Margrid the Sly over Master of Whispers during the quest Mysterious Message, or who have accepted the quest but not yet begun it, Dehjah and three Water Djinn will always spawn near the northern exit. These NPCs are actually part of the quest Secrets in the Shadow, which can no longer be completed.
2c04a0cf957456351f0fd1f367fb3176d5b40245.text: 對於在任務 機密資訊 期間選擇狡猾的瑪格麗特而非密語大師的角色，或已接受任務但尚未開始的角色，Dehjah 和三個 水巨靈 將始終在北出口附近生成。這些 NPC 其實是 闇影 中任務 Secrets 的一部分，無法再完成。

745a7a943dfb7f8ce0f296f8e069a7f22bf3a174.source: After you have killed every soldier in the central fort's garrison, the Commander on the nearby bridge can still call Kournan Siege "to summon siege fire from any nearby garrisons".
745a7a943dfb7f8ce0f296f8e069a7f22bf3a174.text: 當你殺死中央要塞駐軍中的所有士兵後，附近橋上的 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) 仍然可以呼叫庫南圍攻「從附近的駐軍召喚攻城火力」。

04ed4e438d110910d0826ac2daed36044e32156a.source: Clear Deldrimor Bowl in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
04ed4e438d110910d0826ac2daed36044e32156a.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 北席娃山脈 中的 戴爾狄摩盆地。

eb8202dcce160f578c0e9282dc6bacdf4def73e5.source: "Clear Deldrimor Bowl in the Northern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
eb8202dcce160f578c0e9282dc6bacdf4def73e5.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的北席娃山脈中的戴爾狄摩盆地。”

81340636c50de5f29192daba6701ba67808157b5.source: This explorable area will be traversed as part of the primary quest To Kryta: Refugees.
81340636c50de5f29192daba6701ba67808157b5.text: 這個可探索的區域將作為主要任務 往科瑞塔:難民們 的一部分進行穿越。

763c06a66c3cdf7002c0331b43216c2388deb764.source: It lies to the northwest of Beacon's Perch and is along the only route connecting outposts in the Northern Shiverpeaks to outposts in Kryta.
763c06a66c3cdf7002c0331b43216c2388deb764.text: 它位於 畢肯高地 的西北部，是連線 北席娃山脈 中的前哨站和 科瑞塔 中的前哨站的唯一路線。

dc4c0bbc7856c3f4e16a91ee0b484182540e75f7.source: Groups of 3 to 5 Refugees will spawn and move from Beacon's Perch towards to the Griffon's Mouth exit. They will attack hostile foes along the way, making them helpful allies (or additional corpses to exploit).
dc4c0bbc7856c3f4e16a91ee0b484182540e75f7.text: 成群的 3 至 5 難民將會產生並從 畢肯高地 移向 獅鷲獸隘口 出口。他們會沿途攻擊敵對的敵人，使他們成為有用的盟友（或更多的屍體可供利用）。

f6dce831692215cf9b0f2017485a25b4a3d9ca4a.source: These quests will affect the spawns in this area: Hungry Devourer, The Deserters and To Kryta: Refugees.
f6dce831692215cf9b0f2017485a25b4a3d9ca4a.text: 這些任務將影響該區域的生成點：饑餓的蠍子、叛徒 和 往科瑞塔:難民們。

65c3d1c90eabbaea2223b58b79d592af821ca6bc.source: The Deserters spawns three allies (Cynn, Mehnlo and Devona) next to Beacon's Perch's exit that can be useful for vanquishing or farming.
65c3d1c90eabbaea2223b58b79d592af821ca6bc.text: 叛徒 在 畢肯高地 的出口旁產生三個盟友（莘、Mehnlo 和 德佛娜），可用來征服或耕種。

89ec9727e574a00f633c3d74122915ede6296ff6.source: Shiverpeak Protectors are competent healers due to Aura of Faith. If your party cannot overcome their combined healing, it is recommended to restart and adjust builds/party since this area is full of centaurs with up to 3 to 4 Shiverpeak Protectors per group. Try more offensive setups like playing with only one healer.
89ec9727e574a00f633c3d74122915ede6296ff6.text: 由於 信仰靈氣，席瓦峰保護者是稱職的治療者。如果你的隊伍無法克服他們的綜合治療，建議重新啟動並調整構建/隊伍，因為該區域充滿了半人馬，每組最多有 3 到 4 Shiverpeak 保護者。嘗試更多進攻性的設定，例如只與一名治療師一起比賽。

57ca990364a783b625d3b274017f712a94a16931.source: Do not base your party build around conditions, since Shiverpeak Protectors use Mend Ailment and Purge Conditions.
57ca990364a783b625d3b274017f712a94a16931.text: 不要依照條件建立你的隊伍，因為 Shiverpeak Protectors 使用 治療病痛 和 淨化病症。

068edfaeb94589d5609acc5bc3c1aabc9ca406fb.source: Enchantment removal skills are highly recommended.
068edfaeb94589d5609acc5bc3c1aabc9ca406fb.text: 強烈推薦 加持魔法 刪除技能。

af902db53dc08926daae69815132c91a0ef2686c.source: Centaurs do not possess hex removal skills, degeneration hexes such as Crippling Anguish or Life Transfer are incredibly cost-effective counters to Healing Breeze.
af902db53dc08926daae69815132c91a0ef2686c.text: 半人馬不具備去除六角技能，諸如 致殘、苦惱 或 生命轉移 之類的退化六角是 治癒之風 的極具成本效益的反擊手段。

3cfe9dfaf50348cca9ec38a390eb0c90beb26883.source: If the Hungry Devourer quest is not active, Moro Stormcalf is the only foe that uses spells that can target your party, so avoid bringing Guilt and Mistrust.
3cfe9dfaf50348cca9ec38a390eb0c90beb26883.text: 如果 饑餓的蠍子 任務未啟用，摩洛暴風牛是唯一使用可以以你的隊伍為目標的法術的敵人，因此請避免攜帶 內疚 和 疑惑。

dd1891415dec026d39925e677b83fa4d0ddeb85e.source: All of the damage inflicted by non-boss foes is from attacks, making melee counters very effective.
dd1891415dec026d39925e677b83fa4d0ddeb85e.text: 非頭目敵人造成的所有傷害都來自攻擊，這使得近戰反擊非常有效。

92e4cd406a3c91c12c2e37f487553c18928c4ce1.source: Screecher and Scratcher will no longer spawn in Wilderness of Bahdza (except before or during Population Control) after this quest is completed.
92e4cd406a3c91c12c2e37f487553c18928c4ce1.text: 此任務完成後，尖叫者和尖叫者將不再在 巴薩荒野 中產生（人口控制之前或期間除外）。

f987195f60fc74c8b700ce106a4f013f2cd41b02.source: This quest requires to eliminate 4 groups of Harpies. Each of them have level 28 Elders and level 2 Hatchings, which makes them a large group but actually weak. All nests are located directly south from Dzagonur Bastion's portal. Follow the quest marker to find each of them. Return to Lieutenant Murunda for your reward.
f987195f60fc74c8b700ce106a4f013f2cd41b02.text: 任務需要消滅 4 群鷹身女妖。他們每個人都有28等級的長老和2等級的孵化者，這使他們成為一個龐大的群體，但實際上很弱。所有巢穴均位於 薩崗諾稜堡 門戶的正南方。依照任務標記找到他們每個人。 影返 送給 Murunda 中尉，作為獎勵。

8f6fafd7d7cc0b37e51ba75c60fd435ea63f9fcb.source: If you keep the quest without claiming its rewards, the Skree Harpies spawned by it can be farmed for Bolt of Cloths, Feathers, Skree Wings and Tanned Hide Squares.
8f6fafd7d7cc0b37e51ba75c60fd435ea63f9fcb.text: 如果您繼續任務而不領取獎勵，則可以透過它產生的 鳥妖 鷹身女妖來養殖布捲、羽毛、鳥妖 翅膀和曬黑的獸皮方塊。

7162bd3f454243d584315a76176f8ffd3a3e0d10.source: You cannot capture Visions of Regret until this quest is completed.
7162bd3f454243d584315a76176f8ffd3a3e0d10.text: 在該任務完成之前，你無法佔領 懊悔幻想。

286f8260d09df5bbcb01f7b0d7268cb9f9ad59f2.source: Destroy the renegade slave spirits before they can harm the spirit of Primeval King Jahnus.
286f8260d09df5bbcb01f7b0d7268cb9f9ad59f2.text: 在叛徒奴隸靈魂傷害原始國王賈努斯的靈魂之前將其消滅。

a6d19b3e7904cb5b4347af42f738e586fc12a932.source: See Primeval King Jahnus for your reward.
a6d19b3e7904cb5b4347af42f738e586fc12a932.text: 前往原始國王雅努斯領取獎勵。

d0aaebf0e51645d1494b5526b8d80a5cf88efe09.source: [Incomplete source section] Kill the groups of Slave Spirits that approach King Jahnus. The quest fails if he dies.
d0aaebf0e51645d1494b5526b8d80a5cf88efe09.text: [不完整的來源部分]殺死接近賈努斯王的奴隸靈魂群。如果他死了，任務就會失敗。

402f2ce1404c4a5e15ac951e07f77a857dc95e8a.source: Both this quest and its sister quest, Refuse the King, give the same rewards.
402f2ce1404c4a5e15ac951e07f77a857dc95e8a.text: 該任務和它的姊妹任務“拒絕國王”都提供相同的獎勵。

9f88c2399dd82d5c1cbc7d3546a9630a40630aea.source: Complete this quest quickly after receiving it, otherwise you might have trouble reaching the king in time to save him from the onslaught of slaves.
9f88c2399dd82d5c1cbc7d3546a9630a40630aea.text: 收到任務後請盡快完成此任務，否則你可能很難及時到達國王身邊，將他從奴隸的攻擊中拯救出來。

d108692f4afe3801624d4362651c1df7c838d56b.source: This quest is sometimes used to farm Dead Swords, which frequently drop from warrior Slave Spirits.
d108692f4afe3801624d4362651c1df7c838d56b.text: 此任務有時用於種植死劍，這些劍經常從戰士奴隸靈魂中掉落。

2160d7db50c4f54f0cbc336934ec631c935a844b.source: Reclaim the Asura Gate to the Central Transfer Chamber from the Destroyers in the Depths of Tyria.
2160d7db50c4f54f0cbc336934ec631c935a844b.text: 從 泰瑞亞深處 的驅逐艦手中奪回通往中央傳送室的 阿蘇拉 大門。

1c02c521395e4d48eba644e7e025b9edd22d28a6.source: As per the Destruction's Depths quest.
1c02c521395e4d48eba644e7e025b9edd22d28a6.text: 根據 破壞的深淵 任務。

a4804da73ad12ea7e7acb5cc36dc14c869b7341d.source: Gather 3 Destroyer Cores. You have [3...0] of 3 left to collect.
a4804da73ad12ea7e7acb5cc36dc14c869b7341d.text: 收集 3 驅逐艦核心。您還有 [3...0] 的 3 需要收集。

18df8cb9e8b00804dc196b6ff706cd29cd2d834c.source: See High Priest Alkar for your reward.
18df8cb9e8b00804dc196b6ff706cd29cd2d834c.text: 請參閱 高等祭司 阿爾卡 以取得獎勵。

997f26e0f52f719862abc7449580e74a9bdd712f.source: Destroyer Cores are dropped by Destroyers, which can be encountered in large numbers in the Raven's Point dungeon, and during the A Gate Too Far or G.O.L.E.M. missions.
997f26e0f52f719862abc7449580e74a9bdd712f.text: 毀滅者核心由毀滅者掉落，可以在 渡鴉岬角 地下城以及 一道過遠的門 或 G.O.L.E.M. 期間大量遇到。任務。

7bdaed6362f1da978b744e7dedb2bc952c2de486.source: Meet Dajwa on the Cliffs of Dohjok to help him recover his ring.
7bdaed6362f1da978b744e7dedb2bc952c2de486.text: 在 杜夏懸崖 上與 Dajwa 會面，幫助他找回戒指。

5c011e0ede84e8bf266e322f27358038d57485f8.source: Help Dajwa find and slay the skree harpy that stole his pie.
5c011e0ede84e8bf266e322f27358038d57485f8.text: 幫助達吉瓦找到並殺死偷了他派的斯克裡鷹身女妖。

4cc93195bfbb60bce00ce7a8a5820c88246c0eb3.source: Search the harpy nests for the missing ring. You have searched n of 5 nests.
4cc93195bfbb60bce00ce7a8a5820c88246c0eb3.text: 在鷹身女妖巢穴中尋找遺失的戒指。您已搜尋 n 個 5 巢穴。

f808d7c06b82eb96129a515aa415df6e67ef9387.text: 前往 Dajwa 領取獎勵。

e8d011f4606d5f59c2f505ca77a6e547a7d6cf0a.source: Foes in this quest will be of level 8, if you and your heroes/henchmen are lower, you can leave it for later until you level up a bit. An alternative approach is to start from Jokanur Diggings which provides level 9 henchmen.
e8d011f4606d5f59c2f505ca77a6e547a7d6cf0a.text: 此任務中的敵人等級為 8，如果你和你的英雄/追隨者等級較低，你可以稍後再升級。另一種方法是從 Jokanur Diggings 開始，它提供 9 等級的追隨者。

5a07d23020c6cdf5c32ab6fd520a4458a715ead0.source: Enter the Cliffs of Dohjok and speak to Dajwa. Follow the first quest marker location to a corpse, and subsequently to all of the harpy nests. Due to the close proximity of the nests with each other, it is easy to get overwhelming aggro if you charge right in. Pull harpies to isolate each group and dispatch them with ease. Try to take out the Skree Hatchling early, to remove their healer. Eventually you will find the ring. Return to Champion's Dawn and see Dajwa for your reward.
5a07d23020c6cdf5c32ab6fd520a4458a715ead0.text: 進入 杜夏懸崖 並與 Dajwa 交談。跟隨第一個任務標記位置到達一具屍體，隨後到達所有鷹身女妖巢穴。由於巢穴彼此距離很近，如果你直接衝進去，很容易受到壓倒性的仇恨。 拉出 鷹身女妖可以隔離每個群體並輕鬆消滅它們。試著儘早消滅 鳥妖 幼體，移除它們的治療者。最終你會找到戒指。從 影返 到 勇士曙光，並前往 Dajwa 領取獎勵。

21d4f6376548b85f336b9330b7f15c2d26136bb3.source: The quest Queen of the Quarry spawns three sunspears allies which can strengthen your fire power to complete this quest.
21d4f6376548b85f336b9330b7f15c2d26136bb3.text: 任務「採石場女王」會產生三個陽矛盟友，它們可以增強你的火力來完成這項任務。

9adc82ced542dd3069c648b84e3adbab063e6dff.source: Can be used for farming Sunspear Promotion Points in Cliffs of Dohjok.
9adc82ced542dd3069c648b84e3adbab063e6dff.text: 可用於在 杜夏懸崖 中種植 Sunspear 促銷點。

a9ef9fdcdc8cc9e8bd25a1fb5674ff880d9ce038.source: Clear the Diessa Lowlands in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
a9ef9fdcdc8cc9e8bd25a1fb5674ff880d9ce038.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 底耶沙低地。

978a3bdc72d4d4a5e150052e5db6c70e08636ce4.source: "Clear the Diessa Lowlands in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
978a3bdc72d4d4a5e150052e5db6c70e08636ce4.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 底耶沙低地。”

d30168d09273651a1a2e873f95f72a1e5c6fcfc1.source: This area lies northwest of the Breach and northeast of the Nolani Academy mission outpost. Many secondary quests will lead to or through this area.
d30168d09273651a1a2e873f95f72a1e5c6fcfc1.text: 該區域位於 Breach 的西北部和 若拉尼學院 任務前哨的東北部。許多次要任務將通往或穿過該區域。

6376281aaedfbf27a3f2e1255cf28f552e5f19b0.source: The following quests affect the spawns in this area:
6376281aaedfbf27a3f2e1255cf28f552e5f19b0.text: 以下任務會影響該區域的產生：

8b7a3d6f4186a44b5366fc64fb5ed41f4e2cb5e7.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.1% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
8b7a3d6f4186a44b5366fc64fb5ed41f4e2cb5e7.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 2.1% 的貢獻。

5a33bdd37e99724535d77c1a83bb7d1b0e44c9cd.source: The Diessa Chalice is likely a relic of this area, plundered by the Charr as their invasion pushed the borders of Ascalon.
5a33bdd37e99724535d77c1a83bb7d1b0e44c9cd.text: 迪薩聖杯很可能是該地區的遺跡，在 夏爾 入侵 阿斯卡隆 邊界時被掠奪。

7b8528822bf09f18053482e8aa40580a318a55ca.source: Vanquishing: 271–393 foes. There are many hidden groups of devourers on the eastern half of the map, with a large number of them closely-packed in the tar-filled northeastern end. As such, it is recommended to clear the rest of the map before venturing to the northeastern corner.
7b8528822bf09f18053482e8aa40580a318a55ca.text: 擊敗：271–393 敵人。地圖的東半部有許多隱藏的吞噬者群體，其中大量密集地聚集在充滿焦油的東北端。因此，建議在冒險前往東北角之前清除地圖的其餘部分。

b0b5d207accdcc561162ff50bf5abcbbb970722b.source: Consider starting from Yak's Bend in order to have a party of six to make vanquishing easier. Consider continuing into Flame Temple Corridor and Dragon's Gullet as well.
b0b5d207accdcc561162ff50bf5abcbbb970722b.text: 考慮從 犛牛村 開始，組成六人小隊，讓征服變得更容易。也可以考慮繼續使用 夏爾火焰神殿 和 巨龍峽灣。

cffa485fcea1e16b260553b7bb59f4060765a2ee.source: With patience, it is possible to bring a party of eight from Temple of the Ages.
cffa485fcea1e16b260553b7bb59f4060765a2ee.text: 只要有耐心，就可以從 世紀神殿 帶來八人小隊。

ea2434f83338204969ca5963933a8d261fa90776.source: If arriving from Ascalon Foothills, take note that sometimes a group of hydra (4 or 5) will spawn at that exit a few minutes after the map has loaded. If this happens and they were not intercepted, they will run all way to the Flame Temple Corridor exit, passing by in front of Grendich Courthouse. Upon arrival, they have been reported to either patrol (possibly as 2 groups) to and from the exits, or linger at the Flame Temple Corridor exit.
ea2434f83338204969ca5963933a8d261fa90776.text: 如果從 阿斯卡隆丘陵 到達，請注意，有時在地圖載入後幾分鐘，一群九頭蛇（4 或 5）會在該出口處產卵。如果發生這種情況並且他們沒有被攔截，他們將一路跑到 夏爾火焰神殿 出口，從 葛蘭迪法院 前面經過。抵達後，他們被報告要麼在出口巡邏（可能是 2 小組），要麼在 夏爾火焰神殿 出口徘徊。

55262eb6f64a3ac14fcc12b69e41fb1619fa8d4d.source: The Charr Hunters can be devastating, but you can often use the terrain to your advantage. Have one character pull the enemies while the rest of the party is around a corner; this effectively separates the melee fighters from the rangers and can make the larger Charr groups much more manageable.
55262eb6f64a3ac14fcc12b69e41fb1619fa8d4d.text: 夏爾 獵人可能具有毀滅性，但您通常可以利用地形來發揮自己的優勢。讓一個角色拉動敵人，而隊伍的其他成員就在拐角處；這有效地將近戰戰士與遊騎兵分開，並且可以使更大的 夏爾 群體更易於管理。

b7727bc8a87e9a2744ef6f311fd386e8eb36668f.source: As with other Ascalon maps, many foes in this area are Charr - consider displaying your Ebon Vanguard rank for the Rebel Yell effect for bonus armor and energy gain on kill against Charr.
b7727bc8a87e9a2744ef6f311fd386e8eb36668f.text: 與其他 阿斯卡隆 地圖一樣，該區域的許多敵人都是 夏爾 - 考慮顯示您的 黑檀先鋒隊名聲點數 以獲得叛軍大喊效果，以在對抗 夏爾 時獲得額外護甲和能量增益。

c74f7fbfd70ea0cba0b9e3a4d4b88901538d8c2a.source: The Stone Elemental groups are hostile towards each other. The exit to Nolani Academy has no physical Resurrection Shrine, even though it appears on the Mission Map and is functional.
c74f7fbfd70ea0cba0b9e3a4d4b88901538d8c2a.text: 石元素 團體彼此敵對。 若拉尼學院 的出口沒有實體 復活祭壇，即使它出現在 主線任務 地圖上並且有效。

9c7c7619d54a3142f2898dce09a7f629326fd129.source: Hunt down and kill the Discord Wallow. Retrieve its discord sinew and return to Vasili Lutgardis.
9c7c7619d54a3142f2898dce09a7f629326fd129.text: 追捕並殺死 協調破壞 瓦洛。取回它的不協調肌腱並返回瓦西里·盧特加迪斯身邊。

a785aac1905dab6839cd15453326ae7cfb77cc69.source: See Vasili Lutgardis for your reward.
a785aac1905dab6839cd15453326ae7cfb77cc69.text: 請前往瓦西里·盧特加迪斯 (Vasili Lutgardis) 領取獎勵。

5f39c7b8e2dcfb4e91ff944600767fc7e83618b7.source: The Discord Wallow is situated roughly in the middle of Drazach Thicket and can be reached from either Brauer Academy or Saint Anjeka's Shrine. Once killed, the Discord Wallow will drop the quest item, Discord Wallow Sinew, which you must pick up and return to Vasili Lutgardis for your reward.
5f39c7b8e2dcfb4e91ff944600767fc7e83618b7.text: 協調破壞 窪地大致位於 德瑞扎灌木林 的中間，可從 巴爾學院 或 聖者安捷卡的祭壇 到達。一旦被殺死，協調破壞 瓦洛就會掉落任務物品 協調破壞 瓦洛肌腱，您必須撿起它並返回給 Vasili Lutgardis 以獲得獎勵。

98f85cd11dc923427393820e3ee24da9281eada5.source: You must have Necromancer, Mesmer or Assassin as your primary or secondary profession.
98f85cd11dc923427393820e3ee24da9281eada5.text: 您必須將 死靈法師、幻術師 或 暗殺者 作為您的主要或次要職業。

ba744bd76c0309b65fd24dd186ebd4545c19189f.source: Speak with Mei Ling again to begin your test.
ba744bd76c0309b65fd24dd186ebd4545c19189f.text: 再次與美玲對話開始你的測驗。

e14faaf6aaf1561073f3d10b2f53331148eeef44.source: You will have been provided with one or more skills that allows you to remove one or more enchantments from an enemy. Use these to strip Pe Wan of his elite skill.
e14faaf6aaf1561073f3d10b2f53331148eeef44.text: 您將獲得一項或多項技能，使您能夠消除敵人的一項或多項結界。用這些來剝奪佩萬的精英技能。

93f811cdca3e479ad8339338643d54ea8af13e09.source: Life Sheath's functionality was redesigned since this quest was introduced making its removal rather ineffective; if stripped he will reapply it within two seconds, making the quest unusually difficult.
93f811cdca3e479ad8339338643d54ea8af13e09.text: 生命保護 的功能被重新設計，因為這個任務的引入使得它的刪除相當無效；如果被剝離，他會在兩秒鐘內重新應用它，這使得任務異常困難。

f8bdc20c9d29343986435abd48cf4298e62e17a6.source: It thus may be easier to take any fast rate of damage; if three hits are dealt every 2 seconds — one to trigger Life Sheath, one to redo what was healed, one to damage, then he will die eventually.
f8bdc20c9d29343986435abd48cf4298e62e17a6.text: 因此，可能更容易承受任何快速的傷害；如果每 2 秒進行三擊——一擊觸發 生命保護，一擊重做已治癒的內容，一擊造成傷害，那麼他最終會死。

f51e2182a05ff61d85700a5a76e0894e20be7029.source: If you are an assassin, try letting his life sheath absorb a normal attack after the first move of your combo, then you can finish your combo before the next life sheath.
f51e2182a05ff61d85700a5a76e0894e20be7029.text: 如果你是刺客，試著在你的第一個連擊之後讓他的生命鞘吸收普通攻擊，然後你可以在下一個生命鞘之前完成你的連擊。

f1c025209cbb4fcf38aad5d734730fba497515da.source: At level 10, with 5 points each in Dagger Mastery, Shadow Arts, and Critical Strikes, using Unsuspecting Strike, Fox Fangs, Twisting Fangs and Shroud of Distress, maintaining Shroud while using the attack skills (with the above in consideration) will ensure safe, but slow, completion.
f1c025209cbb4fcf38aad5d734730fba497515da.text: 在 10 級別，匕首精通、暗影技巧 和 致命攻擊 中各有 5 點，使用 意外狙殺、狐狸尖牙、旋殺尖牙 和 危難遮蔽，在使用移動攻擊技能（考慮上述情況）的同時保持裹屍布完成的同時保持包裹。

0a264bda07699b160adfa36fcbe514fa7551cf11.source: Taking skills that apply health degeneration such as Faintheartedness, Life Siphon, and Conjure Phantasm will negate the effects of Life Sheath altogether.
0a264bda07699b160adfa36fcbe514fa7551cf11.text: 採取影響健康退化的技能，例如 懦弱、吸取生命 和 召喚幻影 將完全抵銷 生命保護 的效果。

3035d1f23ed26e77178085041a70d64639f9744e.source: Seek out and destroy the Titan, Securis Phasmatis.
3035d1f23ed26e77178085041a70d64639f9744e.text: 找出並摧毀 泰坦，Securis Phasmatis。

37a51ffa74928685e6413eed2e8684a5b8b81543.source: Find and defeat the remaining Titan, Letum Contineo.
37a51ffa74928685e6413eed2e8684a5b8b81543.text: 找到並擊敗剩下的 泰坦，Letum Contineo。

e8d287d2000b541f0d6a8d30f6fa58a1b4dcbb03.source: You must have Warrior, Ranger, Mesmer, Elementalist or Ritualist as your primary or secondary profession.
e8d287d2000b541f0d6a8d30f6fa58a1b4dcbb03.text: 您必須將 戰士、遊俠、幻術師、元素使 或 祭祀者 作為您的主要或次要職業。

c6f80316c1cfa66c9aee91fe34ba9d7e2de94f38.source: Speak to Talon Silverwing again to begin your test.
c6f80316c1cfa66c9aee91fe34ba9d7e2de94f38.text: 再次與利爪銀翼交談以開始你的測試。

2d66e9f8dc154e1dd3cfae80aa5ac76793222863.source: You will have been provided with skill that allows you to prevent an enemy from activating skills. Use this skill against key enemy skills, and it's an easy match.
2d66e9f8dc154e1dd3cfae80aa5ac76793222863.text: 您將獲得能夠阻止敵人啟動技能的技能。使用此技能對抗敵方關鍵技能，輕鬆應對。

eae586d6575bc51d0248d6bf95044da15a34b971.source: Clear Diviner's Ascent in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
eae586d6575bc51d0248d6bf95044da15a34b971.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 水晶沙漠 中的 預言者之坡。

47cf22ba669e9e6c13b8862b1f400ebb2f249679.source: "Clear Diviner's Ascent in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."
47cf22ba669e9e6c13b8862b1f400ebb2f249679.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的水晶沙漠中的預言者之坡。”

3f5de0704348e1bd77af7d639718f54b91fc0eee.source: This area accounts for approximately 1.4% of the Tyrian Cartographer title.
3f5de0704348e1bd77af7d639718f54b91fc0eee.text: 此區域約佔 Tyrian 版圖 標題的 1.4%。

5eb5f99be7ce82d74154b162e25a880eb7ec9656.source: There are hidden Sand Wurms and devourers scattered about the area.
5eb5f99be7ce82d74154b162e25a880eb7ec9656.text: 該地區散佈著隱藏的沙龍和吞噬者。

2e9b505f2801e4b0bdfd05f82ce9838b8add3d3d.source: There are also several groups of scarabs, but they are all concentrated near teleporters and between the tall obelisks. Avoid the teleporters and travel around the obelisk areas to reduce the number of foes to kill.
2e9b505f2801e4b0bdfd05f82ce9838b8add3d3d.text: 還有幾群聖甲蟲，但它們都集中在傳送器附近和高大的方尖碑之間。避開傳送器並在方尖碑區域周圍移動，以減少要殺死的敵人數量。

18c3ca7a3a23e8dacdc4328e55550801998fc1d4.source: You do not have to kill burrowed Sand Wurms to vanquish the area, even if they have previously attacked you.
18c3ca7a3a23e8dacdc4328e55550801998fc1d4.text: 你不必殺死地下沙龍來征服該地區，即使它們之前攻擊過你。

03f2a0175ea1b4ae3b03636be5fd20ce3b23fba3.source: The Hydra boss group patrols a long route. The best place to wait for that group is in the small path that connects the upper and lower halves.
03f2a0175ea1b4ae3b03636be5fd20ce3b23fba3.text: 三頭龍 頭目組巡邏很長的路線。等待那群人的最佳地點是在連線上半部和下半部的小路上。

fb398dc9b5e49551bb6147a4f10d1568eead65a1.source: If having trouble finding the last foe, try checking the portal to Salt Flats, a lone Sand Drake can be located there.
fb398dc9b5e49551bb6147a4f10d1568eead65a1.text: 如果找不到最後一個敵人，請嘗試檢查 鹽灘 的門戶，在那裡可以找到一個單獨的 沙龍獸。

1e150aa68fa21a847e4b91cccd258b62019024d1.source: Shiverpeak Longbows use Winter and Shiverpeak centaurs have additional armor rating against cold damage, so avoid using elemental damage, since your party will constantly be within range of a Spirit of Winter (i.e. destroying a Spirit of Winter will cause another Shiverpeak Longbow, possibly in another centaur mob within spirit range of the mob your party is attacking, to create another Spirit of Winter). If using a spirit spammer build, consider using Gaze of Fury on a Spirit of Winter.
1e150aa68fa21a847e4b91cccd258b62019024d1.text: 席瓦峰長弓使用 寒冬 和席瓦峰半人馬擁有針對寒冷傷害的額外護甲等級，因此請避免使用元素傷害，因為你的隊伍將始終處於冰雪之靈的射程之內。 寒冬 （即摧毀一個靈魂 寒冬 會引起另一個 席娃山脈長弓手 ，可能在你的隊伍正在攻擊的生物的精神範圍內的另一個半人馬生物中，以創造另一個精神 寒冬 ）。如果使用精神垃圾郵件傳送者構建，請考慮使用 狂暴凝視 的精神 寒冬 。

4dbbaf1701b45a55de1ad4bbf32f3c06954ab265.source: There are two groups of three centaurs that patrol clockwise around the map. One group patrols the upper half and one group the lower. If you have not yet vanquished the map, running counterclockwise around the entire outer edge should reveal these groups.
4dbbaf1701b45a55de1ad4bbf32f3c06954ab265.text: 有兩組半人馬，每組三人，在地圖上順時針巡邏。一組巡邏上半部，一組巡邏下半部。如果你還沒征服地圖，繞著整個外緣逆時針跑應該會發現這些群體。

874a75e32baedd718488e72de7a3f0c0e157ccaa.source: The resurrection shrines in this area do not always show the light animation of an active resurrection shrine:
874a75e32baedd718488e72de7a3f0c0e157ccaa.text: 該區域的復活神殿並不總是顯示活躍復活神殿的燈光動畫：

abf26199aa4766f917db6f7748a2ff2e86414ba1.source: Upon entry from Anvil Rock, the shrine animation at the Anvil Rock shrine does not work.
abf26199aa4766f917db6f7748a2ff2e86414ba1.text: 從 鐵砧石 進入後，鐵砧石 神社的神社動畫無法運作。

fdd96dec01d8a6a3532b89819322a5e7ff860e75.source: Upon entry from Beacon's Perch, the shrine animation at the Beacon's Perch shrine does not work.
fdd96dec01d8a6a3532b89819322a5e7ff860e75.text: 從 畢肯高地 進入後，畢肯高地 神社的神社動畫無法運作。

30231cf2d8f991b3522e3c2912c0f6926321f25d.source: Find Melka Blanston, outside of Ascalon City, and tell her that Gurn loves her.
30231cf2d8f991b3522e3c2912c0f6926321f25d.text: 找到 阿斯卡隆城 外面的 Melka Blanston，並告訴她 Gurn 愛她。

180b07184ac562118a1066ed6c6027d2757ba71e.source: Gurn is on a hill just after the initial fight in the Fort Ranik mission. He can be attacked and killed by Charr before you can talk to him. After accepting this quest from him, you do not have to complete the mission.
180b07184ac562118a1066ed6c6027d2757ba71e.text: 拉尼克堡任務的最初戰鬥結束後，古恩就在一座小山上。在您與他交談之前，他可能會被 夏爾 攻擊並殺死。接受他的任務後，你不必完成任務。

0074de25d92fcac8bfe245562fc2c7c2af816926.source: You can map travel to Ascalon City and exit into Old Ascalon. Melka is right outside Ascalon City.
0074de25d92fcac8bfe245562fc2c7c2af816926.text: 您可以將行程對應到 阿斯卡隆城，然後退出到 舊阿斯卡隆。 Melka 就位於 阿斯卡隆城 外面。

4c0726a1ce9a466ce7e16a3ed8753d65b0ddfe79.source: This quest is unique in that it's the only one that can be obtained inside of a mission area.
4c0726a1ce9a466ce7e16a3ed8753d65b0ddfe79.text: 這個任務的獨特之處在於它是唯一可以在任務區域內獲得的任務。

b89fc2c8b75e503faa29811b82dd261939853f57.source: Destroy the Reaper Slayer before it reaches the mountain top.
b89fc2c8b75e503faa29811b82dd261939853f57.text: 在死神殺手到達山頂之前將其消滅。

2555cdebf2a0f5a8b16038bc57d342a749cecdc6.source: Return to Reaper of the Twin Serpent Mountains for your reward.
2555cdebf2a0f5a8b16038bc57d342a749cecdc6.text: 影返 交給雙蛇山收割者以獲得獎勵。

866bd62f5dcb58b02a4bcaaba959a3176c44d785.source: Kill the harpy leader, Render, in the Forum Highlands.
866bd62f5dcb58b02a4bcaaba959a3176c44d785.text: 在 高地廣場 中殺死鷹身女妖首領渲染者。

f4f8fca3c8d2142d27cfebcfd9aa7c6ce7171b2b.source: Exterminate the heket commander, Harrk Facestab, in the Forum Highlands.
f4f8fca3c8d2142d27cfebcfd9aa7c6ce7171b2b.text: 消滅 高地廣場 中的赫克特指揮官 Harrk Facestab。

a7baf59a2da04b4b3b72a02e26f4112202b83c53.text: 前往 Kamveh 領取獎勵。

c1b287c3641436a7a26a1af7546c152b34fb2bb1.source: Accepting this quest dramatically increases the number of Harpies and Hekets that spawn in Forum Highlands, as part of the well-established war between the two species. The quest marker points to Render first and Harrk Facestab second. You can dive right in or wait for the hostile groups (and Vabbian Guard patrols) to weaken each other, finishing off the survivors (including the bosses). Head back to Kamveh to claim your reward.
c1b287c3641436a7a26a1af7546c152b34fb2bb1.text: 接受此任務會顯著增加 高地廣場 中生成的鷹身女妖和赫克特的數量，這是兩個物種之間長期存在的戰爭的一部分。任務標記首先指向“渲染”，然後指向“Harrk Facestab”。你可以直接潛入或等待敵對團體（和瓦比安守衛巡邏隊）互相削弱，消滅倖存者（包括首領）。返回 Kamveh 領取獎勵。

ec65078545426e2a5004df0d0dc66cac064c93d5.source: After completing this quest the heket and skree groups between Tihark Orchard and Jennur's Horde are replaced by Kournan and Margonite groups.
ec65078545426e2a5004df0d0dc66cac064c93d5.text: 完成此任務後，提哈克果園和詹努爾部落之間的赫克特和斯克雷團體將被庫南和 瑪骨奈 團體取代。

0418e0fb839b050dbdb27b1f7fc4d7c9c9108a92.source: When keeping this quest exclusively for farming:
0418e0fb839b050dbdb27b1f7fc4d7c9c9108a92.text: 當將此任務專門用於農業時：

94a25018f66b7b0c8abcf0b4b8ac4c63024acb26.source: The extra 75 Skree Harpies can be farmed for Bolts of Cloth, Feathers, Skree Wings, and Tanned Hide Squares.
94a25018f66b7b0c8abcf0b4b8ac4c63024acb26.text: 額外的 75 鳥妖 鷹身女妖可用於養殖布捲、羽毛、鳥妖 翅膀和鞣製皮革方塊。

f4b855a8ec8aaaae039a1e9f1ceb94dd8ebd3677.source: It also synergises with another quest She Hungers, increasing Juicy Heket Legs drops.
f4b855a8ec8aaaae039a1e9f1ceb94dd8ebd3677.text: 它還與另一個任務「她的飢餓」協同作用，增加多汁的 青蛙族群 腿的掉落。

93500f08c04af2add790f983a8ae74b947cad9d8.source: If playing with a reduced party, consider bringing Frozen Soil to counter the Skree resurrect skills: "We Shall Return!" (Skree Singers and Render) and Renew Life (Skree Griffins).
93500f08c04af2add790f983a8ae74b947cad9d8.text: 如果與減少的隊伍一起玩，請考慮使用 凍土 來對抗 鳥妖 復活技能：“我們將 影返！” （鳥妖 歌手和渲染器）和 更新生命（鳥妖 獅鷲）。

3be0064977886ad18a305b8d70150c6e25072ab5.source: If you leave the area having only killed one boss, the quest will reset from the beginning again.
3be0064977886ad18a305b8d70150c6e25072ab5.text: 如果你離開該區域時只殺死了一個首領，任務將再次從頭開始重置。

616b60241e2c691287482b47d85530cb219d51e7.source: Find the harpy roosts in the Wilderness of Bahdza and eliminate them. You have [4...0] roosts remaining.
616b60241e2c691287482b47d85530cb219d51e7.text: 找到 巴薩荒野 中的鷹身女妖棲息地並消滅它們。您還剩 [4...0] 個棲息地。

68897dea61b1bde25b5dd1143e260d3068590f98.source: Korrub, Flame of Dreams will spawn in Wilderness of Bahdza after this quest is completed.
68897dea61b1bde25b5dd1143e260d3068590f98.text: 此任務完成後，夢想之火科魯布將在 巴薩荒野 中產生。

2306ec0d13448270adb5153603594cfd6cfa70c9.source: Lead Vidaj to the relics in the Lahtenda Bog. You have 5 areas left to explore.
2306ec0d13448270adb5153603594cfd6cfa70c9.text: 帶領 Vidaj 找到 洛天帝沼澤 中的遺跡。您還有 5 區域需要探索。

3d048e7687b973444f40583875d1160ddfd7177c.source: Lead Vidaj out from the bayou.

63502cb34da026cd635bc82fa88e746a2ba1cf89.source: Meet with Vidaj outside of Blacktide Den. Follow the quest marker to each of the different spots. Clear enemies in your way, and be wary of pop-ups.
63502cb34da026cd635bc82fa88e746a2ba1cf89.text: 在黑潮巢穴外與維達吉會面。依照任務標記到達每個不同的地點。清除路上的敵人，並警惕彈出視窗。

34ee4324c0b0b0cd488e6607d9f296438ff7ed08.source: You need to keep this NPC alive, he is only level 10 and can be easily killed. Though being a monk with healing prayers skills helps him survive.
34ee4324c0b0b0cd488e6607d9f296438ff7ed08.text: 你需要讓這個 NPC 活著，他只有 10 等級，很容易被殺死。儘管作為一個擁有治癒祈禱技能的和尚可以幫助他生存。

d9210b70ef32544d5a1f1c46e9c4b006be5e0958.source: A good way to ensure completion of this quest is by using the "Hero flag All" command below your radar and send your company ahead first while you stand behind, since Vidaj follows you, he will be safely away with you. As he is a monk, he might attempt to heal your team so make sure he doesn't engage and get into harm's way.
d9210b70ef32544d5a1f1c46e9c4b006be5e0958.text: 確保完成此任務的一個好方法是在雷達下方使用“英雄 flag All”命令，讓你的連隊先行，而你則站在後面，因為維達吉跟著你，他會安全地離開你。由於他是一名僧侶，他可能會嘗試治癒你的團隊，因此請確保他不會參與並受到傷害。

05e393d6ac71e03412b7fb94c4183411876e3128.source: After exploring the third marker on the mission map, a small group of four low level corsairs will approach the party. Dispatch them and continue.
05e393d6ac71e03412b7fb94c4183411876e3128.text: 探索任務地圖上的第三個標記後，由四名低階海盜組成的小隊將接近隊伍。派遣他們並繼續。

f6d3f6a9367a6e7a1238934beaba971ba32f16ab.source: After you have explored all areas of interest, you must lead Vidaj back to the entrance to Blacktide Den in order to complete the quest.
f6d3f6a9367a6e7a1238934beaba971ba32f16ab.text: 當你探索完所有感興趣的區域後，你必須帶領維達回到黑潮巢穴的入口才能完成任務。

cfc1f18898791934c0d339da0ab38dddda252cbd.source: You can also do the quest War Preparations (Ghost Reconnaissance) while working on this quest.
cfc1f18898791934c0d339da0ab38dddda252cbd.text: 您還可以在執行此任務時執行任務戰爭準備（幽靈偵察）。

7809c1d326b0f5b57d1f24fd552cc8c2fa6c2bd0.source: Kill a Dragon Lich in the Great Battle Field.
7809c1d326b0f5b57d1f24fd552cc8c2fa6c2bd0.text: 在偉大的戰場上殺死 巫妖之龍。

1ec11af1290ed6b8f3692c388e923491b0429e86.source: *BONUS* Kill a Dragon Lich in Hard Mode.
1ec11af1290ed6b8f3692c388e923491b0429e86.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 巫妖之龍。

89a29c9a86588d78af1506dae5ce7031994f997e.source: A Dragon Lich is found in the Fissure of Woe guarding the entrances of the Shadow Army encampment at the Great Battle Field.
89a29c9a86588d78af1506dae5ce7031994f997e.text: 在悲痛裂縫中發現了 巫妖之龍，守護著偉大戰場 暗影軍團 營地的入口。

88901eea68a23d1917c5d68e4a9541c486d237b1.source: Clear Dragon's Gullet in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
88901eea68a23d1917c5d68e4a9541c486d237b1.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 巨龍峽灣。

92689316c49094e21ede4830458eec9293636763.source: "Clear Dragon's Gullet in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
92689316c49094e21ede4830458eec9293636763.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 巨龍峽灣。”

051503363a8876aa0e40bf5062d276a7e6522cbe.source: The shortest distance to get here is leave from Grendich Courthouse and keep heading northeast, through the Diessa Lowlands and the Charr-controlled Flame Temple Corridor.
051503363a8876aa0e40bf5062d276a7e6522cbe.text: 到達這裡的最短距離是從 葛蘭迪法院 出發，繼續往東北方向行駛，穿過 底耶沙低地 和 夏爾 控制的 夏爾火焰神殿。

a2d03a591c79bae4997826e01f9be6bd97f3c4a5.source: The Charr and Hydra are hostile to each other, but they rarely overlap.
a2d03a591c79bae4997826e01f9be6bd97f3c4a5.text: 夏爾 和 三頭龍 彼此敵對，但很少重疊。

1cebb3892f8e3ead65f694a6048ac02dc359523f.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.5% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
1cebb3892f8e3ead65f694a6048ac02dc359523f.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.5% 的貢獻。

7cb6620cd343b466819229c7490f8dc0e0af501c.source: You can explore most of the zone without the Tar effect during the Special Ops: Dragon's Gullet quest.
7cb6620cd343b466819229c7490f8dc0e0af501c.text: 在「特別行動：巨龍峽灣」任務中，您可以在沒有 瀝青 效果的情況下探索大部分割槽域。

be73e0bb93f6cf4112672078999c08e6dcc1a93b.text: 擊敗：117–205 敵人。已隱藏 蠍。

0dc133aff7e3a5a833e489c9c41afae7d4efc83f.source: The fast-moving hydra group in the southwest corner can be easily missed due to its long patrol route. Be careful so that they don't rush your party while you're fighting other hydra.
0dc133aff7e3a5a833e489c9c41afae7d4efc83f.text: 西南角快速移動的九頭蛇群由於巡邏路線較長，很容易被錯過。當你與其他九頭蛇戰鬥時，要小心，以免他們催促你的隊伍。

2edec7209de8070fa838ca30c7348a9890dfe890.source: Consider bringing a party of six starting from either Borlis Pass, Yak's Bend or even a party of eight from Temple of the Ages.
2edec7209de8070fa838ca30c7348a9890dfe890.text: 考慮從 柏里斯通道、犛牛村 開始組成六人小隊，甚至從 世紀神殿 開始組成八人小隊。

9ef06d42c9020342942644286d15bd0e9c2eeb29.source: Vanquishing during The Titan Source drastically increases the number of foes and changes all spawns to either Titans or Charr.
9ef06d42c9020342942644286d15bd0e9c2eeb29.text: 在 泰坦根源 期間擊敗敵人會大幅增加敵人數量，並將所有生成點變更為泰坦或 夏爾。

9166565fcd2d836f3fae6981615da0cb2512bdd1.source: Party-wide speed boost skills will help counter the effect of walking in the tar.
9166565fcd2d836f3fae6981615da0cb2512bdd1.text: 隊伍 範圍內的速度提陞技能將有助於抵消在焦油中行走的影響。

7c17f5ab7153d9cb2ae720d95d0b33545c29df36.source: Kill as many of the afflicted as possible before the timer runs out. Kill an afflicted boss to gain a time bonus.
7c17f5ab7153d9cb2ae720d95d0b33545c29df36.text: 在計時器耗盡之前殺死盡可能多的受折磨的人。殺死一個受影響的老闆以獲得時間獎勵。

7b3a2a9c6023b891cd29536fefbc3372cd6880da.source: This mission rewards gold based on the formula below. Values are rounded down. Additional bonuses are awarded for beating the daily best, monthly best, or quarterly best scores.
7b3a2a9c6023b891cd29536fefbc3372cd6880da.text: 該任務根據以下公式獎勵金幣。值向下舍入。超越每日最佳成績、每月最佳成績或季度最佳成績將獲得額外獎金。

10361727faa2fc8c77d36de2f174a08efccbbb92.source: There is a 15 minute time limit for this mission, which is extended by approximately 61 seconds for each boss killed. There are two strategies for extending the time limit:
10361727faa2fc8c77d36de2f174a08efccbbb92.text: 此任務有 15 分鐘的時間限制，每殺死一個 Boss，時間限制就會延長約 61 秒。延長時間限制有兩種策略：

35a0df455646e21ee870c58b80e2eadf91105833.source: To cover long distances quickly, bring party-wide speed boosts, e.g. "Charge!" or "Fall Back!".
35a0df455646e21ee870c58b80e2eadf91105833.text: 若要快速覆蓋長距離，請提高隊伍範圍內的速度，例如「收費！」或「後退！」。

1b78598fbe1efbc61775fff2d5a31f8d50b5af90.source: Deliver the Eye of Janthir to Loamhurst.
1b78598fbe1efbc61775fff2d5a31f8d50b5af90.text: 將詹瑟爾之眼交給 沃土森林。

b9857f05505606085f7aee0894b07a97460355fa.source: *BONUS* Find and deliver five Chosen to Loamhurst.
b9857f05505606085f7aee0894b07a97460355fa.text: *獎勵* 找出五個被選中的人並將其交付給 沃土森林。

8711a786aa32499773a932ea2579c98cee175f35.source: As per the Divinity Coast mission.
8711a786aa32499773a932ea2579c98cee175f35.text: 根據 神聖海岸 任務。

6f786531d0cbf6172fcefee961312d9f70bd5bde.source: It might be easier to complete the first bonus objective in normal mode, since the five Chosen can die more quickly in hard mode.
6f786531d0cbf6172fcefee961312d9f70bd5bde.text: 在普通模式下完成第一個獎勵目標可能會更容易，因為五個選民在困難模式下會死得更快。

6d1f652c1fd431eb79910f410ba96afd08cf9e02.source: Head east from Foible's Fair to the woods. Destroy the skale brood.
6d1f652c1fd431eb79910f410ba96afd08cf9e02.text: 從 佛伊伯市集 向東前往樹林。消滅斯凱爾巢穴。

482ac3d20c968913ec5e5a5f9d7fb9ec2f6cece7.source: Vassar will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
482ac3d20c968913ec5e5a5f9d7fb9ec2f6cece7.text: 接受任務後，瓦薩 將為您提供以下技能：

8837f921bde3af0b2b66ef164c9fde5c50825c68.source: Leave from Foible's Fair and head east, then curve southeast into the woods. This area is teeming with bandits and level 3 black bears. The bears are little more than a nuisance, but watch out for the Bandit Firestarters spamming Flare. Your new Backfire skill is very helpful against them.
8837f921bde3af0b2b66ef164c9fde5c50825c68.text: 從 佛伊伯市集 出發，向東行駛，然後向東南轉彎進入樹林。該地區充斥著強盜和 3 等級的黑熊。這些熊只不過是個麻煩，但要小心強盜 Firestarters 向 火花 傳送垃圾郵件。你的新 魔力反噬 技能對對抗他們非常有幫助。

186a326a79a79e4aa3dfd807d3e4c61d6e7b75ba.source: Once you have the river skale brood in compass range, it will begin moving along the path accross the woods towards Foible's Fair (so if you came from Foible's Fair it should come your way). It has an extended aggro range so pull it cautiously to avoid engaging other nearby enemies at the same time.
186a326a79a79e4aa3dfd807d3e4c61d6e7b75ba.text: 一旦你的河蛇巢穴位於指南針範圍內，它就會開始沿著穿過樹林的路徑向 佛伊伯市集 移動（所以如果你來自 佛伊伯市集，它應該會朝你這邊走）。它具有較長的仇恨範圍，因此請小心拉動它，以避免同時與附近的其他敵人交戰。

cc56612c6c4b3c50cf3cdcd7b48cc16df4ae9760.source: The skale brood is a dangerous foe for low level characters, capable of both healing with Aura of Restoration and dealing damage with Ice Spear. Maintain Backfire as much as possible and refrain from removing it too soon with Shatter Delusions.
cc56612c6c4b3c50cf3cdcd7b48cc16df4ae9760.text: 對於低階角色來說，骷髏巢穴是危險的敵人，既能使用 回復靈氣 進行治療，還能用 冰之矛 造成傷害。盡可能保留 魔力反噬，並避免過早使用 幻覺粉碎 刪除。

37f719ba4287819ab83f512e3ca98299a1185b5a.source: Go to where the water sparkles like diamonds and the dunes hide gold from the Elders.
37f719ba4287819ab83f512e3ca98299a1185b5a.text: 前往那兒，那裡的水像鑽石一樣閃閃發光，而沙丘則隱藏著長老們的黃金。

49d8e159a9137c544cfb56097d00fa6e58ae19cd.source: Travel east past the place where men sleep on stilts. Reach the tower that lies on the edge of the world.
49d8e159a9137c544cfb56097d00fa6e58ae19cd.text: 向東行進，經過男人踩高蹺的地方。到達位於世界邊緣的塔。

a56aa91205c7cc2fe62c8bee87133268fd449b54.source: Follow the Queen's gaze south and find an ill tempered bear guarding his cave.
a56aa91205c7cc2fe62c8bee87133268fd449b54.text: 跟隨女王的目光向南，發現一頭脾氣暴躁的熊守護著他的洞穴。

146a9d2c3fccd221e8caed09d68d37a166f188ff.source: Pass the wrathful bear and run to the doors of the sanctuary that clings to the land as the maiden of the sea pulls it towards her bosom.
146a9d2c3fccd221e8caed09d68d37a166f188ff.text: 越過憤怒的熊，跑向緊貼陸地的聖所大門，海中少女將其拉向懷抱。

705f98517456f8143fcaa9a7975273b2c38172db.source: Face northwest and walk thirty-five paces. From beneath the Arch of the Twin Queens, gaze upon the great pillars that have stood since ages past.
705f98517456f8143fcaa9a7975273b2c38172db.text: 面向西北，行三十五步。從雙皇后拱門下方，凝視自古以來矗立的巨大石柱。

bd6ecff1da2fe99c4d5b5b27db441f74f3b9fc8f.source: Stand at the feet of the pillar that lies in eternal slumber.
bd6ecff1da2fe99c4d5b5b27db441f74f3b9fc8f.text: 站在永恆沉睡的柱子腳下。

14590b63c2c31f9e73154156b94db92682c99a85.source: From the sleeping pillar, travel west towards the spot where man's creation meets its end.
14590b63c2c31f9e73154156b94db92682c99a85.text: 從沉睡的柱子出發，向西前往人類創造的終點。

19fdf342e53a8f52611cdf46bde0023992ab4e20.source: Beyond man's creation a huge boulder hugs the dunes. Find the treasure buried on the lee of the stone.
19fdf342e53a8f52611cdf46bde0023992ab4e20.text: 在人類的創造之外，一塊巨大的巨石擁抱著沙丘。找到埋在石頭背風處的寶藏。

ad120c2fac7e3ae36a990687ab887ea28935da32.source: Kneel down and search the sand for the buried treasure.
ad120c2fac7e3ae36a990687ab887ea28935da32.text: 跪下來在沙裡尋找埋藏的寶藏。

df4665760fbf684062e9733ff476c6d6ac90061b.source: Take Bobo back to Ashigun and collect your reward.

34c1871f9e26954413cdaadedcd4d7d226af6e9e.source: Ashigun does not give you any clue where to go for this quest, nor do you get an arrow to help you. All you have to go on is his cryptic clues given to you through the objectives. The first thing is to go to the Mehtani Keys and you will get the next clue. Then travel east past the small village and over to the tower standing alone in the northeast corner of the map near Ajamduk, Hunter of the Sands. Head south and to where Behrdos will yell at you. Go past him to the Cyclone Palace's door at the southeast corner of the map. Then head northwest and stand under the arch. Look towards the pillars for your next clue. Run over to the pillar that has fallen down. You will then be directed to the west where there is a sunken ship. Once you get to the ship you will get an update telling you there is a huge boulder beyond the ship. It is a short distance west of the ship. Go to the far side of the boulder and it will tell you to kneel in the sand to find the treasure. /kneel to find Bobo. Once you have Bobo head back to Ashigun in Zehlon Reach and return it to him.
34c1871f9e26954413cdaadedcd4d7d226af6e9e.text: 阿什貢（Ashigun）不會給你任何去哪裡完成這個任務的線索，也沒有箭頭來幫助你。你所要做的就是他透過目標給你的神秘線索。首先是進入梅坦尼之鑰，你會得到下一個線索。然後向東行進，經過小村莊，到達位於地圖東北角、靠近金沙獵人阿賈姆杜克的塔樓。往南走，到貝赫多斯會對你大喊大叫的地方。經過他來到地圖東南角旋風宮的門口。然後向西北方向行駛，站在拱門下。向柱子找下一條線索。 跑過 移至倒下的柱子處。然後您將被引導到西邊，那裡有一艘沉船。一旦你到達船上，你就會收到一條更新訊息，告訴你船外有一塊巨大的巨石。這是船以西不遠的地方。走到巨石的另一邊，它會告訴你跪在沙子裡找到寶藏。 /跪下尋找波波。一旦你找到了波波，你就可以回到澤隆河段的阿什貢並把它還給他。

c2b792dcdaccfd20508b4e41d3771027bcd608bd.text: 在 洛天帝沼澤 中認識 Vidaj。

7274954a5ff52a4560e319b7b0b214eb5c059849.source: If the player hasn't advanced enough in the Nightfall storyline, the doors in the north part of the Floodplain will remain closed, but the Corsairs will still spawn on the other side. Wekehsa may try to pursue the Corsairs and shall halt progress in the quest until they are killed. Consider bringing a hero or henchmen with skills that don't require line of sight.
7274954a5ff52a4560e319b7b0b214eb5c059849.text: 如果玩家在 黑暗逆襲 故事情節中進展不夠，漫灘北部的大門將保持關閉，但海盜船仍會在另一側生成。維克薩可能會嘗試追擊海盜，並會停止任務的進展，直到他們被殺死。考慮帶一位英雄或擁有不需要視線技能的追隨者。

c6e10b246380453a1c35aa4b7361397a117eac04.source: Koss will resurrect whenever he has a line of dialogue.
c6e10b246380453a1c35aa4b7361397a117eac04.text: 每當 寇斯 有對話時就會復活。

8c69c287d5f1257a9dce81835ff10fa29645f8e0.source: The quest may be kept active for farming Chunks of Drake Flesh or Spiked Crests. To maximize your drop rate, send Koss to die and do not speak with Wekehsa.
8c69c287d5f1257a9dce81835ff10fa29645f8e0.text: 此任務可能會因耕種 龍獸 肉塊或尖刺冠而保持活躍。為了最大限度地提高你的掉落率，請傳送 寇斯 去死，並且不要與 Wekehsa 交談。

bdb6ba117aece8b81a3f4b970c20a0a8fdb3b660.source: Unlike other quests with a required hero, you are not provided with a green note in the quest log reminding you to include Koss in the party. Wekehsa still holds the Banana Scythe after you get rewarded.
bdb6ba117aece8b81a3f4b970c20a0a8fdb3b660.text: 與其他需要英雄的任務不同，任務日誌中不會向您提供綠色註釋，提醒您將 寇斯 包含在隊伍中。在您獲得獎勵後，Wekehsa 仍然持有 Banana 鐮刀。

0c5beb6a156e0098010e241889678488b4d8f293.source: Clear Drakkar Lake in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
0c5beb6a156e0098010e241889678488b4d8f293.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 北部席娃山脈 中的 卓卡湖。

10e893e5538aeadf4a475260b597627ed7183859.source: "Clear Drakkar Lake in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
10e893e5538aeadf4a475260b597627ed7183859.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的北部席娃山脈中的卓卡湖。”

d9853a537fab836ed6602e3a7a959c7924cea800.source: Just south of the Norrhart Domains exit is a path that leads to a small enclosed valley. A rabbit stands at the start of the path. It will start downwards to the center when you approach. Be warned that this is a trap. If you follow the rabbit to the center, Nulfastu Earthbound will spawn with about five dozen Vaettir around you and along the path. These are levels 15 to 20 in normal mode. To be safer, you can send someone to trigger the ambush while you wait atop the path and then fight your way down. Note that once triggered, the path also contains additional hidden Vaettir. For exploration purposes, you can circle the valley without triggering the spawns; just keep away from the center.
d9853a537fab836ed6602e3a7a959c7924cea800.text: 諾拉特領地出口以南有一條小路，通往一個封閉的小山谷。一隻兔子站在小徑的起點。當您接近時，它將開始向下到中心。請注意，這是一個陷阱。如果你跟隨兔子到達中心，Nulfastu Earthbound 將會生成，大約有五打 Vaettir 在你周圍和沿途。這些是正常模式的 15 至 20 等級。為了更安全，你可以派人在路上等待時觸發伏擊，然後一路殺下去。請注意，一旦觸發，路徑還包含額外的隱藏 Vaettir。出於探索目的，您可以繞著山谷旋轉而不觸發生成；只要遠離中心即可。

82fb7b92acb61623cee0ffc6685f79e2349248d9.source: The area around the frozen lake is the most dangerous; be aware that many small groups of Chilling Wisps circle the frozen lake in a counter-clockwise direction.
82fb7b92acb61623cee0ffc6685f79e2349248d9.text: 結冰的湖泊周圍地區是最危險的；請注意，許多小群的冰冷小精靈以逆時針方向圍繞著結冰的湖面。

b0531a463ae0df611273647eeeec3c9674bf0455.source: If you wish to fight less, avoid triggering the rabbit hole trap in the southeast.
b0531a463ae0df611273647eeeec3c9674bf0455.text: 如果你想少打架，請避免觸發東南方的兔子洞陷阱。

30d2fd914dd419536b525d735d6281848993d6d2.source: There are many other spots where hidden Vaettir will spawn, most notably in corners, around clumps of trees, and the graveyard between the two Sifhalla exits.
