30d2fd914dd419536b525d735d6281848993d6d2.text: 還有許多其他地方會出現隱藏的瓦蒂爾，最明顯的是在角落、樹叢周圍以及兩個 襲哈拉 出口之間的墓地。

beb36acdeb494cfa234f15cb1525b553f872e855.source: If you talk to Kilroy Stonekin, additional Stone Summit will spawn in their encampment.
beb36acdeb494cfa234f15cb1525b553f872e855.text: 如果你與 基羅伊石族 交談，額外的 石峰矮人 將會在他們的營隊中產生。

00d4381d8e18cfc035efd1c65ff87a18ed785b22.source: Koren Wildrunner's group patrols a long route around the frozen lake and sometimes the surrounding areas as well.
00d4381d8e18cfc035efd1c65ff87a18ed785b22.text: 科倫野行者的隊伍在冰凍湖周圍的很長一段路線上巡邏，有時也在周邊地區巡邏。

fe766c2cd6b1575816da51bae57c4be0490e8e98.source: Sometimes you need to kill charmable animals to complete the vanquish.
fe766c2cd6b1575816da51bae57c4be0490e8e98.text: 有時你需要殺死可愛的動物才能完成征服。

79ce73d86c07f206c89d509fd4ae5615db88d7fe.source: Clear the Drazach Thicket in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
79ce73d86c07f206c89d509fd4ae5615db88d7fe.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的科凡德森林中的德瑞扎灌木林。

2327d4f23a65f341b18ce3aa86a9b9cb08484d66.source: "Clear the Drazach Thicket in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."
2327d4f23a65f341b18ce3aa86a9b9cb08484d66.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的科凡德森林中的德瑞扎灌木林。”

8e7b859b4ba6289152f51c698fd6bcd6851f2f12.source: The Defenders of the Forest is the primary quest that will lead characters through this area.
8e7b859b4ba6289152f51c698fd6bcd6851f2f12.text: 森林守護者是帶領角色穿越這個區域的主要任務。

b80f199c9ed96f9316e9a2117f853411cf8d8600.source: Drazach Thicket lies between Saint Anjeka's Shrine, Brauer Academy, and the Eternal Grove.
b80f199c9ed96f9316e9a2117f853411cf8d8600.text: 德瑞扎灌木林 位於 聖者安捷卡的祭壇、巴爾學院 與永恆叢林之間。

7b5b1f3f67a320f2ce877705667d52ac164ed2dc.source: A New Escort (Wardens are replaced by Dragon Mosses near the entrance of Saint Anjeka's Shrine.)
7b5b1f3f67a320f2ce877705667d52ac164ed2dc.text: 新護衛隊（聖者安捷卡的祭壇 入口附近的守望者被龍苔蘚取代。）

9b55f7a129e36508e9e058fc037ffbc660f1dc60.source: Due to their different teams, the Wardens and Mantises will fight each other.
9b55f7a129e36508e9e058fc037ffbc660f1dc60.text: 由於隊伍不同，守望者和螳螂會互相爭鬥。

c40a6cb2f22aa60a5f041696bfe3cd3fd1ea2551.text: 有 4 隱藏的 Oni 群組：

abd4e4691c8de570495d16ad4b160dbe07103fe2.source: Along the northwestern route moving away from the Eternal Grove.
abd4e4691c8de570495d16ad4b160dbe07103fe2.text: 沿著西北路線離開永恆叢林。

c1d56826d283c23ee9953fe10d3d763d8ea0e333.source: Along the western edge, near the center.
c1d56826d283c23ee9953fe10d3d763d8ea0e333.text: 沿著西部邊緣，靠近中心。

a197bd7964ac8dc58c6a79d1f15977e434e8da3e.source: A short distance south from Saint Anjeka's Shrine.
a197bd7964ac8dc58c6a79d1f15977e434e8da3e.text: 距離 聖者安捷卡的祭壇 以南不遠。

d54b2ecda6c0b496836561df9f9588d23fcd19c9.source: Remain in the same area and wait for groups to respawn (making sure that there is a boss in the group to extend the time limit). Groups respawn ~2 minutes after being defeated, so you will have to kill 3 or more bosses per cycle in order to extend the timer indefinitely.
d54b2ecda6c0b496836561df9f9588d23fcd19c9.text: 留在同一區域等待隊伍重生（確保隊伍中有boss以延長時間限制）。團體在被擊敗後約 2 分鐘重生，因此您必須在每個週期殺死 3 或更多 Boss，才能無限期延長計時器。

0f3f02a52cc7da11e4641033b2dc1242e069bfe2.source: As with all challenge missions, foes do not drop items when killed.
0f3f02a52cc7da11e4641033b2dc1242e069bfe2.text: 與所有挑戰任務一樣，敵人被殺死時不會掉落物品。

bc133797f16c15142129e7a7db98f9cd2be08afe.source: After 30 minutes, players will suffer from Extensive Plague Exposure.
bc133797f16c15142129e7a7db98f9cd2be08afe.text: 30 分鐘後，玩家將遭受廣泛的瘟疫暴露。

d5bd8e5cdc1bf832aa7aec3d2ab08a727765c0ad.source: Enemies aren't resurrected, but new ones are spawned. This means that each boss killed will give an additional morale boost and leave an additional corpse.
d5bd8e5cdc1bf832aa7aec3d2ab08a727765c0ad.text: 敵人不會復活，但會產生新的敵人。這意味著每個被殺死的老闆都會額外提升士氣並留下額外的屍體。

a5c75a937ad674db998eec1967a614f7f838d8f6.source: Some bosses will spawn in multiple locations.they may also leash from across the map, further testing is needed
a5c75a937ad674db998eec1967a614f7f838d8f6.text: 有些 Boss 會在多個位置產生。它們也可能會在整個地圖上出現，需要進一步測試

e5c23f1ab9e3e552d2eea911b715a77942ba4386.source: It is possible to kill enemies before the start of the mission, if they patrol close enough to the gate. These kills do not count towards your score, but will be respawned as normal.
e5c23f1ab9e3e552d2eea911b715a77942ba4386.text: 如果敵人巡邏得足夠靠近大門，則可以在任務開始之前殺死敵人。這些擊殺不會計入你的分數，但會正常重生。

6ba1a4c059a1656e94963e1940f5aa5dcda68165.source: The bosses in this mission respawn after being defeated; the death of respawned bosses still adds time to the mission timer.
6ba1a4c059a1656e94963e1940f5aa5dcda68165.text: 此任務中的 Boss 被擊敗後會重生；重生 Boss 的死亡仍然會增加任務計時器的時間。

e0010bd6e3dbd1353e38943112cdb57d0bcfc3c0.source: Scores were previously kept on a leaderboard on the official guildwars.com site.
e0010bd6e3dbd1353e38943112cdb57d0bcfc3c0.text: 分數之前儲存在 guildwars.com 官方網站的排行榜上。

c32eebed2986d7d4e04c94f36db1ace5d8a77851.source: The Afflicted Mei will despawn immediately after spawning.
c32eebed2986d7d4e04c94f36db1ace5d8a77851.text: 受折磨的美將在產卵後立即消失。

45b6a409fe085e745a545b0ce250b09bb28d902e.source: Killing a boss may not grant additional time.
45b6a409fe085e745a545b0ce250b09bb28d902e.text: 殺死老闆可能不會獲得額外的時間。

3d89b0590ee3a61a82524cdbdba80eaf3e4827d3.text: de:德拉亨哈爾斯 (主線任務)

121e8b50fa6ef1ae616ae7df2b93eee36583551c.source: Slay kuskale and harvest their flesh for bait. You need [5...0] more hunks of fresh meat.
121e8b50fa6ef1ae616ae7df2b93eee36583551c.text: 殺死庫斯卡勒並收穫它們的肉作為誘餌。你需要[5...0]更多的新鮮肉。

be35139b6c9713d7a0855ef9f019b20aa627111e.source: Place fresh meat in the basket by the shore to lure the ferocious beast.
be35139b6c9713d7a0855ef9f019b20aa627111e.text: 將新鮮的肉放在岸邊的籃子裡，以引誘兇猛的野獸。

1a19694fecf7b018d9211a3429d325a8b6951005.text: 請參閱 周納 以取得獎勵。

ade80577a5ec4bab705d0bf2813b49d4ae644b58.source: Enter Arkjok Ward from the Command Post and there will be skale at the lake. Kill enough to get the required 5 hunks of meat and place them in the Drake Cage. When the Ferocious Drake appears, attack it until it becomes neutral.
ade80577a5ec4bab705d0bf2813b49d4ae644b58.text: 從指揮所輸入阿爾科監禁區，湖邊就會有skale。殺死足夠的肉以獲得所需的 5 大塊肉並將它們放入 龍獸 籠子中。當兇猛的 龍獸 出現時，攻擊它直到它變成中立。

f167aa9eebbac02265c90d5aeb1f2359ffcd9d20.source: If you follow the Drake it leads you to the entrance to the Command Post. This only makes sense since apparently the Drake is now tamed and villagers have made it a guardian named Toma.
f167aa9eebbac02265c90d5aeb1f2359ffcd9d20.text: 如果您沿著 龍獸 走，它會帶您到達 指揮所 的入口。這才有意義，因為顯然 龍獸 現在已被馴服，並且村民已將其設為名為 托瑪 的守護者。

087eb1326234efb91fda5d80dd292c5ac224c4bd.source: Take Koss to meet Wekehsa on The Floodplain of Mahnkelon.
087eb1326234efb91fda5d80dd292c5ac224c4bd.text: 搭乘 寇斯 前往馬恩科隆洪氾區與 Wekehsa 會面。

430ad5a46aea90e1c7e2e282bba9a6ef5e12ae63.source: Escort Wekehsa to his meeting place.
430ad5a46aea90e1c7e2e282bba9a6ef5e12ae63.text: 護送 Wekehsa 前往他的會面地點。

14b6aab3045b7c29a88fb9885b1252c1200e8753.source: Defeat Lord Yama the Vengeful and his guards.
14b6aab3045b7c29a88fb9885b1252c1200e8753.text: 擊敗復仇者閻羅王和他的守衛。

b7fa69af863e999b7465b217f34db33eadc6e2c8.text: 請前往 Wekehsa 領取獎勵。

aef88b466da4e0f0cc723cb5f58668ee2d25038f.source: Travel into The Floodplain of Mahnkelon and find Wekehsa who is waiting just outside Rilohn Refuge. Follow Wekehsa to his meeting with the banana scythe buyer, Lord Yama the Vengeful. Once there, defeat Lord Yama and claim the scythe for yourself!
aef88b466da4e0f0cc723cb5f58668ee2d25038f.text: 前往 Mahnkelon 洪氾平原並找到在 Rilohn 避難所外等待的 Wekehsa。跟隨韋克薩去見他與香蕉鐮刀買家、復仇者亞瑪勳爵的會面。到達那裡後，擊敗閻羅王並為自己奪取鐮刀！

1342cb88c1193428565f4a0c49a0c836c0451ffe.source: It is a relatively short journey along the north side of the floodplain, and along the way, the party will encounter several groups of drakes of various types: Irontooth Drakes, Sand Drakes, and Obsidian Furnace Drakes.
1342cb88c1193428565f4a0c49a0c836c0451ffe.text: 沿著洪氾平原北側的旅程相對較短，沿途，隊伍會遇到幾群不同型別的龍：鐵牙龍、沙龍和黑曜石龍龍。

35837fd594043f6b6994fe6302da4416114e0219.source: Sand Drakes are from the Crystal Desert, Grand Drakes & Lightning Drakes are from Kryta, River Drakes are from Ascalon (pre-Searing), and Obsidian Furnace Drakes are from the Fissure of Woe.
35837fd594043f6b6994fe6302da4416114e0219.text: 沙龍來自 水晶沙漠，大龍和閃電龍來自 科瑞塔，河龍來自 阿斯卡隆（崩壞 之前），而黑曜石熔爐龍來自哀傷裂縫。

1d8689cc92b67bfb6b6f33eff915acacd68faa23.source: The insect boss, Zelnehlun Fastfoot, and its group of hidden insects will not spawn while this quest is active (and you have Koss in your party).
1d8689cc92b67bfb6b6f33eff915acacd68faa23.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，昆蟲 Boss Zelnehlun Fastfoot 及其隱藏的昆蟲群不會產生（並且您的隊伍中有 寇斯）。

b97d6fdcfd6ef7ab8ef19d9d0081f57725429ec3.source: A short distance northwest from Brauer Academy.
b97d6fdcfd6ef7ab8ef19d9d0081f57725429ec3.text: 距 巴爾學院 西北不遠。

c564bafacf4ff6ac87b59f79c6540fbcf32abf47.source: There are also two Warden spawns.

b46aabbc832d825cdb1778e98cd6bf3acd6131e4.source: Occasionally, Chkkr Thousand Tail's group doesn't spawn as expected when you enter the bosses range. If this happens, they can instead spawn at Chkkr's location when you spawn either Bezzr Wingstorms or Bazzr Icewings group. If you've been through the whole map while vanquishing and are missing a group, check if this has happened.
b46aabbc832d825cdb1778e98cd6bf3acd6131e4.text: 有時，當您進入 Boss 範圍時，Chkkr 千尾的隊伍不會如預期般產生。如果發生這種情況，當您生成 Bezzr Wingstorms 或 Bazzr Icewings 組時，它們可以改為在 Chkkr 的位置生成。如果您在征服時已經瀏覽了整個地圖並且丟失了一個團隊，請檢查是否發生了這種情況。

c86828a601ff763adeb71c0581aef66164e21575.source: Clear Dreadnought's Drift in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
c86828a601ff763adeb71c0581aef66164e21575.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 南席娃山脈 中的 無懼者之丘。

c2629b9b53306069912d018b5cadd238b7f87bdf.source: "Clear Dreadnought's Drift in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
c2629b9b53306069912d018b5cadd238b7f87bdf.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的南席娃山脈中的無懼者之丘。”

60fe1cead2e600ea1bd0d104124415de018d9867.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.4% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
60fe1cead2e600ea1bd0d104124415de018d9867.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.4% 的貢獻。

25bcab0fb7ca17adb80263b4782b36ee1a5458d1.source: There are hidden Azure Shadows in this area.
25bcab0fb7ca17adb80263b4782b36ee1a5458d1.text: 該區域隱藏著蔚藍之影。

ae861115f32cfd1a09fc94c4eec89541af0d043e.source: Beware the range and height advantage of the Tundra Giant groups in front of the Statue of Dwayna.
ae861115f32cfd1a09fc94c4eec89541af0d043e.text: 請注意 Dwayna 的 雕像 前面的 冰原巨人 組的射程和高度優勢。

977529679c03fca55da2e87ce8a4b0d8eecc9ef5.source: Consider bringing enchantment removal due to the possibility of as many as four Dolyak Masters spawning in the same group.
977529679c03fca55da2e87ce8a4b0d8eecc9ef5.text: 考慮移除結界，因為同一組可能會出現多達四名多利亞克大師。

4a137b6e4404d6a20bf1a416fedd6fc36c6a5d1f.source: Due to how far this location is, consider vanquishing Snake Dance, Dreadnought's Drift and Lornar's Pass in one go. Leaving from Camp Rankor to accomplish this will also allow for a party size of 8, where an exit from Beacon's Perch restricts the party to 6 members.
4a137b6e4404d6a20bf1a416fedd6fc36c6a5d1f.text: 由於該位置距離較遠，請考慮一次性消滅 蛇舞、無懼者之丘 和 洛拿斯通道。退出 藍口營地 來實現此目的還允許 8 的聚會規模，其中退出 畢肯高地 會將聚會限制為 6 成員。

60ad8c61423750ef72c3d07e03a87c8fec32f441.source: Free the Dredge slaves by slaying Stone Summit Taskmasters.
60ad8c61423750ef72c3d07e03a87c8fec32f441.text: 通過殺死 石峰矮人 工頭來釋放 挖掘者 從站。

69d5a9fb919337f46a7c7779bf75e2a92578c4de.source: Discover what the Stone Summit Dwarves are searching for in the Vloxen Excavations.
69d5a9fb919337f46a7c7779bf75e2a92578c4de.text: 瞭解 石峰矮人 矮人在 弗洛森古蹟 中尋找什麼。

f8fa9e1a635fed05927186ec660855f09d78bf60.source: Seek and destroy Zoldark the Unholy.
f8fa9e1a635fed05927186ec660855f09d78bf60.text: 尋找並摧毀 不潔 咒暗。

faa194ae9fb076b42f1cfe4b9bbffce37908810d.source: Best starting point to enter Vloxen Excavations for this quest is from Vlox's Falls, then head east into the dungeon where you will find groups of Stone Summit and Dredge Slaves. You will soon find the boss Taskmaster Durgon; defeating him will release the first Slaves and drop the Boss Key to the second level. The best tactic to defeat him is to first kill the healer. Light of Deldrimor will reveal a Dwarven Ghost near the area map.
faa194ae9fb076b42f1cfe4b9bbffce37908810d.text: 進入 弗洛森古蹟 執行此任務的最佳起點是從 Vlox's Falls 出發，然後向東進入地牢，在那裡你會發現成群的 石峰矮人 和 挖掘者 奴隸。你很快就會找到 Boss 監工杜爾貢；擊敗他將釋放第一批奴隸並將 頭目 鑰匙 降至第二級。擊敗他的最佳策略是首先殺死治療者。 戴爾狄摩 的光芒將在區域地圖附近顯示一個矮人幽靈。

82aa1a814b11fe749663a5237cbb910a21bd0d4d.source: On the second level, you must seek out and defeat Taskmaster Kurg and Taskmaster Bellok. If you are playing in hard mode, it is advisable to pull Bellok's group away from the nearby Resurrection Shrine (they will follow quite far); otherwise, a party wipe, will respawn you to close to the enemies and you might easily reach -60% Death Penalty. After Bellok is eliminated, a Dredge Slave will show the way to some Dwarven Powder Kegs to blast through a cracked wall and gain access to the entrance of the dungeon's third level. There is a lever in the southwest of the southeastern chamber which disables the Poison Dart traps; however, it is out of the way. Light of Deldrimor will reveal a Dwarven Ghost near a Beacon of Droknar past the second door opened by the master gear. There is a Hidden Treasure near Taskmaster Kurg.
82aa1a814b11fe749663a5237cbb910a21bd0d4d.text: 在第二層，你必須找到並擊敗模仿大師庫爾格和模仿大師貝洛克。如果你在困難模式下玩，建議將 Bellok 的隊伍拉離附近的 復活祭壇（他們會追得很遠）；否則，隊伍消滅會讓你重生到靠近敵人的地方，你可能很容易達到 -60% 死刑。貝洛克被消滅後，挖掘者 奴隸將為一些矮人火藥桶引路，炸開裂開的牆壁並進入地牢第三層的入口。東南室的西南方向有一個槓桿，可以停用 中毒 飛鏢陷阱；然而，它不礙事。 戴爾狄摩 之光將在主齒輪開啟的第二扇門後顯示卓克納爾信標附近的矮人幽靈。模仿大師庫爾格附近有一個隱藏的寶藏。

f142f480687f5fac3f7e7dd01ed6279087192672.source: On the third level you will need to find Sotanaht the Tomb Guardian, who holds the key to access the dominion of Zoldark the Unholy. The third level also contains 2 levers which disable all the Poison Dart traps there: one in the northwest of the northwestern room, and one in the northwest of the northeastern room (just beyond Sotanaht the Tomb Guardian).
f142f480687f5fac3f7e7dd01ed6279087192672.text: 在第三層，您需要找到 Sotanaht 古墓 守護者，他擁有進入 不潔 咒暗 領地的鑰匙。第三層還包含 2 控制桿，可停用那裡的所有 中毒 飛鏢陷阱：一個位於西北房間的西北部，一個位於東北房間的西北部（就在 Sotanaht 古墓 守護者 之外）。

57d08bb265552fc907ae3869bbb97a50a3dce014.source: To kill Zoldark the Unholy, kill his minions until he stops resurrecting them. He loses health every time he resurrects one, and he cannot heal so he will continue losing health with every resurrection. He will be easy to kill once he is unable to resurrect his minions.
57d08bb265552fc907ae3869bbb97a50a3dce014.text: 要殺死 不潔 咒暗，請殺死他的爪牙，直到他停止復活他們為止。他每次復活都會失去生命值，而且他無法治癒，所以每次復活他都會繼續失去生命值。一旦他無法復活他的爪牙，他將很容易被殺死。

3d542e11a56c91de16119b740808d0ef4f372bec.source: Light of Deldrimor rewards are listed in the Vloxen Excavations entry.
3d542e11a56c91de16119b740808d0ef4f372bec.text: 戴爾狄摩 獎勵之光在 弗洛森古蹟 條目中列出。

2861444f1a4f9912f4bae554d0a45791be5dce20.source: In hard mode, Frozen Soil will prevent the Dwarves on the first two levels from resurrecting their fallen.
2861444f1a4f9912f4bae554d0a45791be5dce20.text: 在困難模式下，凍土 將阻止前兩層的矮人復活倒下的矮人。

a530600ce5071bffebc19ee1d315917d8358bd42.source: Three minutes after everyone in your party opens the reward chest, you will be automatically mapped to Umbral Grotto, even if you began in Vlox's Falls.
a530600ce5071bffebc19ee1d315917d8358bd42.text: 在你的隊伍中的每個人開啟獎勵箱三分鐘後，即使你是從 Vlox 瀑布開始的，你也會自動對應到 陰影石穴。

d5be2f0e222ac9119506c67d048cb8114f08789e.source: Prepare for Ranger foes striking you from height advantage, which can lead to higher than expected spike damage.
d5be2f0e222ac9119506c67d048cb8114f08789e.text: 準備好應對 遊俠 敵人從高度優勢攻擊您的情況，這可能會導致高於預期的尖刺傷害。

cf1c8ccc2fc37cf07fc8316c82f0d0de80490fd5.source: When facing Taskmaster Kurg, you can pull him or his allies away from each other. If you kill him first, the nearby Dredge will rise up and help you kill the remaining foes.
cf1c8ccc2fc37cf07fc8316c82f0d0de80490fd5.text: 當面對模仿大師庫爾格時，你可以將他或他的盟友拉開。如果你先殺死他，附近的 挖掘者 就會崛起並幫助你殺死剩餘的敵人。

d115622b97dcc5b34265f7de2511e3db8dd884d4.source: If you wipe near the fourth Master Gear, you will respawn at the entrance to this level (since that will be the closest resurrection shrine).
d115622b97dcc5b34265f7de2511e3db8dd884d4.text: 如果您在第四個大師裝備附近擦拭，您將在該級別的入口處重生（因為那將是最近的復活神社）。

f74c189ccb3d2978b370dda44c0994c47144642a.source: The Ancient Undead respawn every two minutes (until Zoldark dies). (Be careful of those close to the Boss Lock; if you draw them towards the nearby resurrection shrine, you can make it difficult to reach the Boss Key.)
f74c189ccb3d2978b370dda44c0994c47144642a.text: 遠古 不死系 每兩分鐘重生一次（直到佐爾達剋死亡）。 （小心那些靠近 頭目 鎖的人；如果你把他們拉向附近的復活神社，你可能會很難到達 頭目 鑰匙。）

0790a28e4d57d833de6aacbdb476fcc81010e443.source: After killing Zoldark, all remaining foes will disappear, allowing you time to safely open Locked Chests and look for Hidden Treasures.
0790a28e4d57d833de6aacbdb476fcc81010e443.text: 殺死佐爾達克後，所有剩餘的敵人都會消失，讓你有時間安全地開啟上鎖的寶箱並尋找隱藏的寶藏。

73fa55080cf24db343a26e39a70c0a7dd9478b9a.source: Allow Brother Tosai to finish his ritual.
73fa55080cf24db343a26e39a70c0a7dd9478b9a.text: 讓東齋哥哥完成他的儀式。

2d60c8ed8e0d52dd4010eba1c8f181306e129e97.source: See Brother Tosai for your reward.

c5473e902a88a03eca2e457a355054e25aadbacd.source: Just speak with Brother Tosai after accepting the reward for the quest Seek out Brother Tosai, await his dialogue to finish, then collect the reward and the next quest in the series.
c5473e902a88a03eca2e457a355054e25aadbacd.text: 接受任務獎勵後與土井兄弟交談即可找到土井兄弟，等待他的對話完成，然後收集獎勵和系列中的下一個任務。

1d8283ad9e5b71d7ad0eea361aab7a91e9ff892b.source: The opposing team will be wandering around aimlessly until you approach. When you get close enough they will turn hostile and will bunch together. The team you face is determined randomly. You face either:
1d8283ad9e5b71d7ad0eea361aab7a91e9ff892b.text: 對方隊伍會漫無目的地徘徊，直到你接近。當你足夠接近時，他們會變得充滿敵意並聚集在一起。你面對的隊伍是隨機決定的。您面臨以下任一情況：

b6b7158e4aaef03341f83f15a5dfeaf7cb8fab68.source: House Brauer, led by the mesmer Lord Brauer.
b6b7158e4aaef03341f83f15a5dfeaf7cb8fab68.text: 巴爾 家族，由催眠師 巴爾 主領導。

e71b045188d5c1c2195e2a34835cbf751378fa16.source: House Durheim, led by the necromancer Count Durheim.
e71b045188d5c1c2195e2a34835cbf751378fa16.text: 德海姆家族，由死靈法師德海姆伯爵領導。

747f6f1a35d088e80daf7f33930ec34a64a33594.source: House Lutgardis, led by the ranger Lord Lutgardis.
747f6f1a35d088e80daf7f33930ec34a64a33594.text: 盧特加迪斯家族，由遊俠盧特加迪斯領主領導。

33e2e9f740823f1d5d9db07d28ed37c1ea2cbed0.source: House Vasburg, led by the warrior Baroness Vasburg.
33e2e9f740823f1d5d9db07d28ed37c1ea2cbed0.text: 瓦斯伯格家族，由戰士瓦斯伯格男爵夫人領導。

d6d6cb03742a41875af0c98e078c07ddbe68eb40.source: The first two, Brauer and Durheim, are somewhat similar to fight. They both deal a reasonable amount of damage and their elementalists cast Unsteady Ground which should be avoided. Being purely spell-casters they clump together rendering AoE spells such as Firestorm and Meteor Shower highly effective (making Cynn come in handy). Be careful if you're facing Count Durheim as his double damage (see notes) Defile Enchantments can be devastating, especially in concert with Unsteady Ground.
d6d6cb03742a41875af0c98e078c07ddbe68eb40.text: 前兩個，巴爾和Durheim，有點類似格鬥。他們都造成了合理的傷害，並且他們的元素師施放了 地動山搖，這是應該避免的。作為純粹的施法者，他們聚集在一起使得 範圍性 法術如 Firestorm 和 隕石雨 非常有效（使得 莘 派上用場）。如果您面對德海姆伯爵，請小心，因為他的雙重傷害（見註釋）敗壞加持 可能具有毀滅性，尤其是與 地動山搖 配合使用。

513e19b823b29543c95df8bd542eacc5bcd28403.source: House Lutgardis isn't too problematic as you don't have to rely on your henchmen scattering effectively from AoE spells. The majority of the team bunch together so, again, AoE spells will come in handy. Due to rangers having inherently better armor against elemental damage it may be worth taking spells such as Spiteful Spirit and Reckless Haste as well. The team isn't as fragile as Brauer's and Durheim's so you may need to reapply Frozen Soil. Remember to do it a small distance away from the battle to prevent it being destroyed.
513e19b823b29543c95df8bd542eacc5bcd28403.text: 盧特加迪斯家族並沒有太大問題，因為你不必依賴你的追隨者有效地分散 範圍性 法術。大多數團隊成員聚集在一起，因此 範圍性 咒語將再次派上用場。由於遊俠本身就具有更好的防禦元素傷害的護甲，因此也值得使用諸如 惡靈附身 和 失心瘋 之類的法術。團隊不像 巴爾 和 Durheim 那麼脆弱，因此您可能需要重新套用 凍土。請記住在距離戰鬥較遠的地方進行，以防止其被摧毀。

253700e779d9eb4b2fb178c642f1c929c6b425b1.source: House Vasburg is composed chiefly of melee characters so spells such as Ward Against Melee could prove useful. The team clumps together around your team so if everyone remains still AoE spells can again prove effective. However, the AI for henchmen and heroes may cause them to run around your group, resulting in it being difficult to keep enemies in the AoE. Spells such as Spiteful Spirit are especially useful. This battle is likely to be slightly longer so, again, remember to replant Frozen Soil far enough away to stop it being attacked.
253700e779d9eb4b2fb178c642f1c929c6b425b1.text: House Vasburg 主要由近戰角色組成，因此諸如 迴避結界 之類的咒語可能會很有用。團隊聚集在您的團隊周圍，因此如果每個人都保持靜止，範圍性 咒語可以再次證明是有效的。然而，追隨者和英雄的 AI 可能會導致他們在你的隊伍周圍奔跑，導致 範圍性 中很難留住敵人。 惡靈附身 等咒語特別有用。這場戰鬥可能會稍微長一些，所以再次記住，將 凍土 重新種植到足夠遠的地方以阻止它受到攻擊。

a5b0cbc59eb27863973402789ed25265ec386a47.source: More generally, always target the Monk first (see Kurzick Duelist for a guide to identifying the profession of each duelist). An interrupter will make the duel easier as the Monks are very effective, carrying Word of Healing. It's also best to take out the team before the House leader as, being technically a separate party, they can't resurrect their 'team' mates.
a5b0cbc59eb27863973402789ed25265ec386a47.text: 更一般地說，請務必先瞄準 僧侶（有關識別每個決鬥者職業的指南，請參閱 庫茲柯 決鬥者）。中斷者將使決鬥變得更容易，因為武士非常有效，並攜帶 治癒文字。最好在眾議院領袖之前消滅該團隊，因為從技術上講，作為一個獨立的政黨，他們無法復活他們的「團隊」夥伴。

4d917550745ecddaf872c0030e6ac4b19e7ee002.source: If you are having trouble defeating one particular group you can use the alt key to ascertain which House you are facing as you run down the hill past the first set of Wardens. If it is not to your liking you can simply re-zone.
4d917550745ecddaf872c0030e6ac4b19e7ee002.text: 如果你在擊敗某個特定群體時遇到困難，當你跑下山經過第一組守望者時，可以使用 alt 鍵來確定你面對的是哪個學院。如果不符合您的喜好，您可以簡單地重新分割。

c864d19bcad2759fcb6242adc06b5f5048078c4b.source: After the battle speak to Duel Master Vaughn to receive your reward. Then if you are farming faction simply map back to Brauer Academy and start again.
c864d19bcad2759fcb6242adc06b5f5048078c4b.text: 戰鬥結束後與決鬥大師 魏嘉斯 交談即可獲得獎勵。然後，如果您正在耕種 陣營值，只需對應回 巴爾學院 並重新開始。

893316cd80a43c77dee2bf06f1c3f5a65694662d.source: A team of three mesmers including Lord Brauer, three elementalists and two monks.
893316cd80a43c77dee2bf06f1c3f5a65694662d.text: 由三位催眠師組成的團隊，包括 巴爾 領主、三位元素師和兩位武僧。

036769318f5d0aef57da3e9f848dc2f93f2c3218.source: A team of four necromancers including Count Durheim, two elementalists and two monks. They have strong anti-melee skills and spiking capability.
036769318f5d0aef57da3e9f848dc2f93f2c3218.text: 由四名死靈法師組成的隊伍，包括德海姆伯爵、兩名元素師和兩名僧侶。他們具有很強的抗近戰能力和扣球能力。

7a864ef6233a8e1fb9dfba0746bde8df932f2118.text: 盧特加迪斯家族決鬥者

7a27cd8fc0bd4600a5c7dce123150e4a0c936b9c.source: A team of five rangers including Lord Lutgardis, two monks and one ritualist.
7a27cd8fc0bd4600a5c7dce123150e4a0c936b9c.text: 一支由五名遊騎兵組成的隊伍，其中包括盧特加迪斯勳爵、兩名僧侶和一名儀式師。

81e4721c373c3b317c2ba0aa7bc6ed0e75621b22.source: A melee-oriented team of three warriors including Baroness Vasburg, three assassins, and two monks.
81e4721c373c3b317c2ba0aa7bc6ed0e75621b22.text: 一支近戰型隊伍，由三名戰士（包括瓦斯堡男爵夫人）、三名刺客和兩名僧侶組成。

f8b6fe5c6cb10f311392b42991cdc7fbda7b34fc.source: *BONUS* Kill Droajam, Mage of the Sands in Hard Mode.
f8b6fe5c6cb10f311392b42991cdc7fbda7b34fc.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 沙之法師 卓加姆。

243e94ec75ab1e7915d76ade5f6e204e3232bd4f.source: The best way to kill the Mage of the Sands is to head straight for him and attack him with everything you have. If you try to pick off the creatures immediately around him his group could quickly overwhelm your party.
243e94ec75ab1e7915d76ade5f6e204e3232bd4f.text: 殺死金沙 法師傭兵 的最佳方法就是直奔他並用你擁有的一切攻擊他。如果你試圖消滅他周圍的生物，他的隊伍可能會很快壓倒你的隊伍。

1ae483e89353f3ff6911a09a42c8819aeba26c68.source: The skill Pain Inverter is very effective against Droajam.
1ae483e89353f3ff6911a09a42c8819aeba26c68.text: 苦痛逆變器技能對Droajam非常有效。

5cc65991b02838788ff0f1fed661eb88698bfd7e.source: Find the White Mantle meeting spot and eavesdrop on their conversation.
5cc65991b02838788ff0f1fed661eb88698bfd7e.text: 找到 白斗篷 會面地點並竊聽他們的談話。

31e7365146ba453f1900e5798977cc0341a05ba4.source: Return to Deep Root and tell him what you have overheard.
31e7365146ba453f1900e5798977cc0341a05ba4.text: 影返 到 機智的魯特 並告訴他您無意中聽到的內容。

7b1e784a331e9edae9b6aa91ec22d876344a7828.source: Head south then west into the Reed Bog. Once there, take the west path and follow the quest marker. There will be a few Moss Scarab popups and Redwood Shepherds along the way. Once you approach the White Mantle, they will begin talking. Do not attack them; just listen in and return to Deep Root when they are finished.
7b1e784a331e9edae9b6aa91ec22d876344a7828.text: 向南然後向西進入 蘆葦沼澤。到達那裡後，走西邊的道路並跟隨任務標記。沿途會出現一些 苔聖甲蟲 彈出視窗和 Redwood Shepherds。一旦您接近 白斗篷，他們就會開始說話。不要攻擊他們；只需聆聽並在完成後返回 機智的魯特。

93fdac9b3c443be61ca4525e2f6853b75deac229.source: The identity of the Shining Blade traitor is revealed in the Sanctum Cay mission.
93fdac9b3c443be61ca4525e2f6853b75deac229.text: 光刃公會 叛徒的身分在 神聖沙灘 任務中揭曉。

3930053aeec029824311aefd074b204ef404fb9e.source: If the White Mantle Zealots are allowed to finish their conversation and leave, they will make their way southward passing through the portal into The Falls.
3930053aeec029824311aefd074b204ef404fb9e.text: 如果 白斗篷 狂熱者被允許結束對話並離開，他們將向南穿過傳送門進入 陷落區。

e3df74d1c609150dbaf19171630ab4c5dfd9330f.source: Clear Dry Top in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
e3df74d1c609150dbaf19171630ab4c5dfd9330f.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 梅古瑪叢林 中的 乾燥高地。

70e9d796fac00915f7d1a69f9486e000c1f92c97.source: Consider holding this quest for three days until the quest to vanquish neighboring Ettin's Back also comes up.
70e9d796fac00915f7d1a69f9486e000c1f92c97.text: 考慮將這個任務保留三天，直到征服鄰近的 雙頭怪隱匿地 的任務也出現。

d3e0dd20c3c67529f63959acd011983343ea82be.source: "Clear Dry Top in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."
d3e0dd20c3c67529f63959acd011983343ea82be.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的梅古瑪叢林中的乾燥高地。”

80b4bb1338565f024f3b650787248ab32827d13d.source: There are some hidden Devourers scattered around the area.
80b4bb1338565f024f3b650787248ab32827d13d.text: 該區域周圍散佈著一些隱藏的 蠍。

16ce1be1e5403a4ba9134398b6141aaa20682ab0.source: There is a Centaur group that patrols counterclockwise; consider moving clockwise.
16ce1be1e5403a4ba9134398b6141aaa20682ab0.text: 有一個半人馬組逆時針巡邏；考慮順時針移動。

3e967192e45042e9dc1f65804a8cba760402662a.source: Consider holding the Zaishen Vanquish for this area for three days until the quest to vanquish neighboring Ettin's Back also comes up.
3e967192e45042e9dc1f65804a8cba760402662a.text: 考慮在該區域舉行 戰承清圖 三天，直到征服鄰近的 雙頭怪隱匿地 的任務也出現。

8a9172dd4ba8e43ef3bef21e4806330f9ed0457c.source: Defeat the Kurzick House in an honorable duel.
8a9172dd4ba8e43ef3bef21e4806330f9ed0457c.text: 在一場光榮的決鬥中擊敗 庫茲柯 家族。

233ce63f8fe06326178a4f0e7b4e3b447ff64ee6.source: See Duel Master Vaughn for your reward.
233ce63f8fe06326178a4f0e7b4e3b447ff64ee6.text: 請參閱決鬥大師 魏嘉斯 以取得獎勵。

92c5f6f5d7b4d86d8b7880fadcf4bf9aa27e7436.source: After obtaining the quest just outside of Brauer Academy(1), follow the path north. Duel Master Vaughn will make his own, albeit slow, way up to the dueling grounds but you can just head off on your own. There are two groups of Wardens that can drift into your path; either defeat them or wait until they're out of aggro range and make your way past. There are also a few, seemingly random, Oni spawn points, spawning either a lone or 3-strong group of Oni. It is best to hug the wall as you make your way to the dueling grounds so as not to aggro the Wardens and Oni simultaneously. You can also opt to take the blessing from the priest for 100 gold, completing the quest will yield 150 gold and all slain NPCs will gain you more faction points.
92c5f6f5d7b4d86d8b7880fadcf4bf9aa27e7436.text: 在 巴爾學院(1) 外面獲得任務後，沿著路徑往北走。決鬥大師 魏嘉斯 會自行前往決鬥場，儘管速度較慢，但您可以自行前往。有兩組守望者可以闖入你的道路；要嘛打敗他們，要嘛等到他們離開仇恨範圍後再過去。還有一些看似隨機的鬼生成點，產生單獨的或 3 強大的鬼群。當你前往決鬥場時最好緊貼牆壁，以免同時激怒守望者和鬼。您也可以選擇接受牧師的祝福以獲得 100 金幣，完成任務將獲得 150 金幣，並且所有被殺死的 NPC 將為您獲得更多 陣營值 積分。

2c590cd4bdd1f5d8b178a632d984864f42f23377.source: Once you reach the dueling grounds(2) continue to hug the wall round and plant Frozen Soil if you have it. Try not to place it too close to the opposing team as they will destroy it if they get too close. When you're ready approach the quest marker and everyone will turn hostile. Note that Duel Master Vaughn is completely irrelevant at this point. It is actually possible to complete the duel before he announces that the duel has started. Approach when you're ready.
2c590cd4bdd1f5d8b178a632d984864f42f23377.text: 一旦你到達決鬥場地（2），繼續緊貼牆壁並種植 凍土（如果有的話）。盡量不要將其放置在距離對方隊伍太近的地方，因為如果他們靠得太近，他們會摧毀它。當你準備好接近任務標記時，每個人都會變得充滿敵意。請注意，Duel Master 魏嘉斯 此時完全無關。在他宣佈決鬥開始之前，其實是可以完成決鬥的。準備好後就接近。

1a2380960e8d917f30b66707a863512312ac5050.source: Although they are not technically bosses, the attacks and skills of the teams leaders inflict double damage.
1a2380960e8d917f30b66707a863512312ac5050.text: 雖然從技術上講他們不是 Boss，但隊長的攻擊和技能會造成雙倍傷害。

fa77f13eaff0032f15ce14395abe3d73ed666f41.source: The team leaders are not part of the same party as the rest of the teams, so they can be pulled separately.
fa77f13eaff0032f15ce14395abe3d73ed666f41.text: 團隊領導者與其他團隊不屬於同一方，因此可以單獨拉動他們。

af226824a4a7aa2c6960b63018284a0187f018cf.source: The professions of the duelists can be identified by their appearance.
af226824a4a7aa2c6960b63018284a0187f018cf.text: 決鬥者的職業可以透過他們的外表來識別。

2fcee00ca9a3223c6cb1b397d1dfac4ba39b4046.source: The Duelists carry resurrection signets. Bringing a skill such as Frozen Soil will help.
2fcee00ca9a3223c6cb1b397d1dfac4ba39b4046.text: 決鬥者攜帶復活印章。攜帶 凍土 等技能會有幫助。

9f0fd6241166b48ac509e2a483ad2bbfbcea039b.source: This run can be completed in 2-3 minutes with a meta hero team.
9f0fd6241166b48ac509e2a483ad2bbfbcea039b.text: 使用元英雄團隊可以在 2-3 分鐘內完成此執行。

c561a28845315450939453734e06e11ac05be2a3.source: The duel won't start if you kill Lord Brauer too fast. The duel may start afterwards. You can reduce the likelihood of this bug by ensuring Duel Master Vaughn reaches the training grounds, and stops moving, before you enter the training grounds. You can use Incoming or Fall back to help speed up Duel Master Vaughn to his destination. Rarely, the enemy team won't spawn at all and the reward can immediately be collected.
c561a28845315450939453734e06e11ac05be2a3.text: 如果您太快殺死 巴爾 領主，決鬥將不會開始。決鬥可能隨後開始。您可以透過確保決鬥大師 魏嘉斯 到達訓練場並在進入訓練場之前停止移動來減少此錯誤的可能性。您可以使用傳入或後退來幫助決鬥大師 魏嘉斯 加速到達目的地。在極少數情況下，敵方隊伍根本不會出現，並且可以立即領取獎勵。

798b29b9a42bda73693f99b87af91484ca8c27cc.source: Kill Duncan the Black in Slavers' Exile.
798b29b9a42bda73693f99b87af91484ca8c27cc.text: 在 奴隸商人放逐地 中殺死 黑色 唐肯。

cd045e4144987422278652f9c98bc6d96949f517.source: *BONUS* Kill Duncan the Black in Hard Mode.
cd045e4144987422278652f9c98bc6d96949f517.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 黑色 唐肯。

ec6188c7548effdd771bb368f35d244a8f7351c7.source: Complete the Base Objective for 60 Zaishen Copper Coins.
ec6188c7548effdd771bb368f35d244a8f7351c7.text: 完成 60 再神銅幣的基礎 任務目標。

fd484342ad100916faef11474e5d29f8c452ba92.source: Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 150 Zaishen Copper Coins.
fd484342ad100916faef11474e5d29f8c452ba92.text: 完成*獎勵* 任務目標 可獲得額外的 150 Zaishen 銅幣。

8e4d5eb683d852ed2a6fe958a30b3e0943dd7f5a.source: As per The Last Hierophant quest.
8e4d5eb683d852ed2a6fe958a30b3e0943dd7f5a.text: 根據最後的聖職者任務。

06a41541b00e267ab6e0978b44c62bb4fbdb6952.source: To gain access to Duncan's dungeon, all party members have to have killed the preceding four bosses Justiciar Thommis, Rand Stormweaver, Selvetarm and Forgewight as shown in The Last Hierophant quest. The 4 "defeat" lines must be crossed off leaving only "Destroy Duncan the Black" left undone. This situation is frequently abbreviated "4/5."
06a41541b00e267ab6e0978b44c62bb4fbdb6952.text: 要進入鄧肯的地牢，所有隊伍成員都必須殺死前面的四個頭目 司法官 湯米茲、織暴者 硬皮、希維塔姆 和 煉冶維特，如《最後的聖職者》任務中所示。 4「失敗」行必須劃掉，只留下「銷毀 黑色 唐肯」未完成。這種情況通常縮寫為“4/5”。

6e1a9df28d84c84fd57e163dd0c7feca62c24e24.source: Help the Ghostly Hero reclaim his throne in the Dunes of Despair.
6e1a9df28d84c84fd57e163dd0c7feca62c24e24.text: 幫助 英雄之魂 奪回 絕望沙丘 的王座。

fcd67aebbb40a41c492d717e99f0cd969f006e88.text: *獎勵* 擊敗三位 被遺忘者 將軍。

b92d045c1d7afd7462b4ddea9f55dc434c471461.source: As per the Dunes of Despair mission.
b92d045c1d7afd7462b4ddea9f55dc434c471461.text: 根據 絕望沙丘 任務。

3bdde75df8bb417c9e42913a5e53ee9e173082f3.source: Look for Lionguard Orrin at Miraba's farm.
3bdde75df8bb417c9e42913a5e53ee9e173082f3.text: 在 米拉芭 的農場尋找獅子守護奧林。

582d1f0daa4e992bcec59744f5253785dc83fccf.source: Take the quest from Lionguard Riddik and walk a short distance north to Miraba's farm. Talk to Miraba to accept the quest reward.
582d1f0daa4e992bcec59744f5253785dc83fccf.text: 接受 開拓者的毛毯 的任務並往北步行一小段距離即可到達 米拉芭 的農場。與 米拉芭 交談以接受任務獎勵。

8c7dc448882e75a494784a26657cc641c7c45739.source: Defend Dzagonur Bastion against the invading generals.
8c7dc448882e75a494784a26657cc641c7c45739.text: 保衛 薩崗諾稜堡 免受入侵將軍的侵害。

93466ef159ffe921f4c6f3e66f5890ee2a3bd851.text: *獎勵*保持防禦結構完好無損。

d65b3cc892af8f17153fd50c0feb52cab4ec1799.source: As per the Dzagonur Bastion mission.
d65b3cc892af8f17153fd50c0feb52cab4ec1799.text: 根據 薩崗諾稜堡 任務。

1f1aa00a4891a7cd4e38420b67a3e2664c4f06bf.source: Clear the Eastern Frontier in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
1f1aa00a4891a7cd4e38420b67a3e2664c4f06bf.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 東方邊境。

9931694dc790c762f1185fdc1aa3aff60a4da543.source: "Clear the Eastern Frontier in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
9931694dc790c762f1185fdc1aa3aff60a4da543.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 東方邊境。”

b41969ecb63352eef3b0d38af27806ef276b123a.source: This area lies to the east of Frontier Gate and the Ruins of Surmia mission outpost. Several secondary quests of the Ascalon region take place here.
b41969ecb63352eef3b0d38af27806ef276b123a.text: 此區域位於 邊境關所 和 蘇米亞廢墟 任務前哨站的東部。 阿斯卡隆 地區的幾個次要任務都發生在這裡。

741f38d3d343e5d9d5f70cd17ea0a4395c28f02e.source: If you fight near Guardsman Noell (a collector), he will join in the fight.
741f38d3d343e5d9d5f70cd17ea0a4395c28f02e.text: 如果你在警衛諾爾（收集者）附近戰鬥，他就會加入戰鬥。

00f6decf2583686aa8d96b3eaf7b7b42a372394f.source: The Frontier Gate resurrection shrine is not visible; you will resurrect near the stairs leading to the portal.
00f6decf2583686aa8d96b3eaf7b7b42a372394f.text: 邊境關所 復活神殿不可見；你將在通往傳送門的樓梯附近復活。

d22bf56241c9ed75a3cf4be2295c27901ec7811c.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.36% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
d22bf56241c9ed75a3cf4be2295c27901ec7811c.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.36% 的貢獻。

fdfdf571e10f1a122ec5ced04a0ac685d7dbedec.source: Vanquishing: 180–216 foes. There are many hidden Devourer groups in this area, concentrated mostly in the southern half.
fdfdf571e10f1a122ec5ced04a0ac685d7dbedec.text: 擊敗：180–216 敵人。該地區有許多隱藏的 蠍 團體，主要集中在南半部。

04c7f65fe75f2ed85ab0e79a2559bdd6bdfe2bd1.source: After drinking from the Chalice of Corruption you will have a -2 health degeneration.
04c7f65fe75f2ed85ab0e79a2559bdd6bdfe2bd1.text: 飲用腐敗聖杯後，你將獲得 -2 健康退化。

a10c694bf9b53eaaaa6c3a1ff9138a2a5da75242.source: Wait a few moments, then speak to Tosai again to receive the reward. The health degeneration will not be removed until completing the next quest, Masters of Corruption.
a10c694bf9b53eaaaa6c3a1ff9138a2a5da75242.text: 稍等片刻，然後再次與土齋對話即可領取獎勵。在完成下一個任務「腐敗大師」之前，健康退化不會被消除。

24ed025ae1adf8ba3693ed52a076005c2aaf6b72.source: Completing the quest Masters of Corruption removes the -2 health degeneration and the visual effect.
24ed025ae1adf8ba3693ed52a076005c2aaf6b72.text: 完成任務「腐敗大師」可消除 -2 健康退化和視覺效果。

8be2fac802e6aa5c4555d76f718e5b755edee507.source: The health degeneration is active even in PvP, and will kill afflicted players even when not using vampiric weapons.
8be2fac802e6aa5c4555d76f718e5b755edee507.text: 即使在 PvP 中，健康退化也會很活躍，即使不使用吸血鬼武器也會殺死受影響的玩家。

569a60379cf956fc2c87231f024680a437cc3169.source: This quest is mutually exclusive with Refuse to Drink.
569a60379cf956fc2c87231f024680a437cc3169.text: 該任務與拒絕飲酒是互斥的。

4877afce1c0570cfcca4f3ef99a3aae48e366f32.source: The effect animation is active when the player is in an outpost but does not cause -2 health degeneration.
4877afce1c0570cfcca4f3ef99a3aae48e366f32.text: 當玩家處於前哨站時效果動畫處於作用中狀態，但不會導致 -2 生命值退化。

45b9d733578a5461ef3557f00326abf8fd2c6372.source: Defeat the Abominations camped on Neersi's wine.
45b9d733578a5461ef3557f00326abf8fd2c6372.text: 擊敗在尼爾斯的酒中紮營的憎惡者。

be010e36867aaaa11c03743c6e6bbb4e78b67b09.source: Although this quest is given in the Gate of Torment, you can reach the objective more easily from either the Gate of Pain or the Gate of the Nightfallen Lands.
be010e36867aaaa11c03743c6e6bbb4e78b67b09.text: 雖然此任務是在 苦痛之門 中給出的，但您可以從 懲罰之門 或墮夜之地之門更輕鬆地達到目標。

2f6cf1171c1070b72518cb412c4a486fd2e4ea5b.source: The missing wine crate is located in the north-east area of Nightfallen Jahai, not far from the Gate of Pain mission outpost. There is usually a group of torment creatures near the crate along with several patrolling Arms of Insanity. The Arms can be pulled separately, after which, the main torment group should be little trouble. Once the area is clear of creatures, click on the wine crate to complete the quest.
2f6cf1171c1070b72518cb412c4a486fd2e4ea5b.text: 失蹤的酒箱位於墮夜精靈賈海的東北部區域，距離 懲罰之門 任務前哨站不遠。板條箱附近通常有一群折磨生物，還有幾隻巡邏的瘋狂之臂。手臂可以分開拉，拉完之後主折磨組就沒什麼麻煩了。一旦該區域沒有生物，點選酒箱即可完成任務。

0d331cd7e13069350103696fc54334acdfc72070.source: Neersi's Wine is not an alcoholic drink and cannot be used to improve the Drunkard title.
0d331cd7e13069350103696fc54334acdfc72070.text: Neersi's Wine 不是酒精飲料，不能用於提高 酒鬼 頭銜。

7f22219efd627d762e1fd492dc60361b4606b990.source: Despite the quest objective stating you have to kill the demons, you only have to click the wine crate to complete the quest.
7f22219efd627d762e1fd492dc60361b4606b990.text: 儘管任務目標規定你必須殺死惡魔，但你只需點選酒箱即可完成任務。

5a70e43142620608b5e506f0862e3f63678e003c.source: Kill Droajam, Mage of the Sands in the Poisoned Outcrops.
5a70e43142620608b5e506f0862e3f63678e003c.text: 在 劇毒地表 中殺死 沙之法師 卓加姆。

e99b2df77b173d152d06afef6d95a0613e2be2af.source: Grawl Ulodytes in hard mode are strong healers. If your party has trouble, interrupt or otherwise prevent their use of Heal Area. Otherwise, attempt to move them away from their allies. It may be beneficial to start vanquishing from Ruins of Surmia.
e99b2df77b173d152d06afef6d95a0613e2be2af.text: 穴居人 困難模式下的 Ulodytes 是強大的治療者。如果您的團隊遇到麻煩，請中斷或以其他方式阻止他們使用 區域治癒。否則，試著讓他們遠離盟友。從 蘇米亞廢墟 開始征服可能會有所幫助。

22a647d5eea5351f67e3990d2e7426e26822cff0.source: During Frontier Gate Fugitives, Footman Tate is a useful ally and will follow your party around until he is led back to Frontier Gate.
22a647d5eea5351f67e3990d2e7426e26822cff0.text: 在 邊境關所逃犯 期間，步兵塔特是一位有用的盟友，他會跟隨你的隊伍，直到他被帶回 邊境關所。

903c91b74593245fefc772a8151f996e44709aa0.source: During The Last Day Dawns active, almost all visible foes are Charr and the total number of foes increases slightly. Take advantage of Ebon Vanguard PvE skills (and especially Rebel Yell). Use caution if you trigger the quest foes: if King Adelbern dies, the quest will fail, forcing your party to return to an outpost.
903c91b74593245fefc772a8151f996e44709aa0.text: 在「末日黎明」活動期間，幾乎所有可見的敵人都是 夏爾，並且敵人總數略有增加。利用 黑檀 PvE 技能（尤其是 Rebel Yell）。如果您觸發任務敵人，請務必小心：如果阿德爾伯恩國王死亡，任務將失敗，迫使您的隊伍返回前哨站。

1c49dc5dfb293605842a56effcc584aff2622c53.source: Occasionally a group of Grawl might spawn inside a rock on one of the cliff faces between Surmia and Frontier Gate, preventing you from retrieving their drops.
1c49dc5dfb293605842a56effcc584aff2622c53.text: 有時，一群 穴居人 可能會在 蘇米亞 和 邊境關所 之間的一個懸崖面上的岩石內生成，從而阻止您取回它們的掉落物。

10ae2818644066930aed87276262b10f8c53a39e.source: There is a cliff just east of Ruins of Surmia that does not clip correctly, allowing you to slide down.
10ae2818644066930aed87276262b10f8c53a39e.text: 蘇米亞廢墟 東邊有一個懸崖，沒有正確夾住，讓你滑下來。

5e1b67e32d5b81417760d031465fd9c80bad235c.source: Eavesdrop on the Kournan captains and collect information on Kormir.
5e1b67e32d5b81417760d031465fd9c80bad235c.text: 竊聽庫南船長並收集有關科米爾的資訊。

266b9db7fa332332e0cfc43d938c7da35e230005.source: After talking to Zhed, exit the Command Post and head to the cliff overlooking the village in southeast Jahai Bluffs. Listen to the conversation between Ronkhet and Nundho. After the conversation, 3 groups of Kournan military troops will show up, but the quest is completed, so map travel to collect the reward.
266b9db7fa332332e0cfc43d938c7da35e230005.text: 與Zhed交談後，退出指揮所並前往俯瞰夏亥峭壁東南部村莊的懸崖。聽聽 Ronkhet 和 Nundho 之間的對話。對話結束後，3的高楠士兵部隊會出現，但任務已經完成，所以地圖旅行去領取獎勵。

a8bc6b2a77876cb0cc00ce296b6cb4193c80b867.source: If Koss and/or Dunkoro are not in your party, their respective dialogue do not appear in the team chat log.
a8bc6b2a77876cb0cc00ce296b6cb4193c80b867.text: 如果 寇斯 和/或 Dunkoro 不在您的隊伍中，則他們各自的對話不會出現在團隊聊天日誌中。

edc69e27538b654db5a5126186dea6396dedeb81.source: This quest prevents the elemental boss, Churrta the Rock, from spawning.
edc69e27538b654db5a5126186dea6396dedeb81.text: 此任務可防止元素 Boss 岩石丘爾塔生成。

d5e997d469485ef6575bbeb4c9801e9d01fad12b.source: The rare scroll trader in the southern village, Kohn, also does not spawn.
d5e997d469485ef6575bbeb4c9801e9d01fad12b.text: 南部村莊科恩的稀有捲軸商人也不會生成。

2a76abb4791c42d4e8c70a81663f7a32e7d7250b.source: Additionally, the nearby Wandering Priest may not spawn.
2a76abb4791c42d4e8c70a81663f7a32e7d7250b.text: 此外，附近的流浪牧師可能不會生成。

7ebac4dc4bb57ff654ad4e15a58a0ebfbada5702.source: Speak with Gwen in the Hall of Monuments.
7ebac4dc4bb57ff654ad4e15a58a0ebfbada5702.text: 與 史蹟殿堂 中的 關 交談。

80a8144af84945ce38d69f3f257eba407194d1f7.source: Assist Keiran with his ill fated plan to win Gwen's affection.
80a8144af84945ce38d69f3f257eba407194d1f7.text: 協助 Keiran 實施他命運多舛的計劃，以贏得 關 的喜愛。

482c943c053166dec42749a755a7285790e4ee85.source: Return to the Hall of Monuments.
482c943c053166dec42749a755a7285790e4ee85.text: 影返 到 史蹟殿堂。

109167b8cb0cbb4fd97a731a14bdf5eec6501d10.source: Witness the pact between the Shining Blade and the Ebon Vanguard in the Ice Cliff Chasms.
109167b8cb0cbb4fd97a731a14bdf5eec6501d10.text: 在 冰崖裂口 中見證 光刃公會 和 黑檀 之間的協定。

61a063c5d046a37db12bdef6cf80e3aeed34a049.source: Finish enlisting the aid of the Asura. (Asuran Allies)
61a063c5d046a37db12bdef6cf80e3aeed34a049.text: 完成 阿蘇拉 的協助。 （阿蘇蘭盟友）

4c2dbfce4e7cd203e832c7f3da1332a7bfe14638.source: Complete A Good Deed given by Thackeray, just outside EotN outpost.
4c2dbfce4e7cd203e832c7f3da1332a7bfe14638.text: 完成薩克雷 (Thackeray) 在 EotN 前哨站外提供的一項善行。

27d1cf556fa8bf26662bdcb59752f92cc4fd17e6.source: This requires completion of the The Missing Vanguard.
27d1cf556fa8bf26662bdcb59752f92cc4fd17e6.text: 這需要完成 失蹤的先鋒隊。

a5def16052e6c826f836694ffd6efd3886d7f79a.source: This is essentially the same quest as Wintersday Cheer; players that completed that quest during Wintersday 2009 or 2010 can speak to Gwen immediately.
a5def16052e6c826f836694ffd6efd3886d7f79a.text: 這與 Wintersday Cheer 本質上是相同的任務；在 2009冬慶日 或 2010 期間完成該任務的玩家可以立即與 關 交談。

6235a00c98e71854806433d6bbb72ec6a4c6f999.source: Enter the Hall of Monuments and listen to the dialogue between Gwen and Thackeray.
6235a00c98e71854806433d6bbb72ec6a4c6f999.text: 進入史蹟殿堂並聆聽關和薩克雷之間的對話。

efb3b15e148480be49d3d44e01e40ecb3fd2f3f6.source: Return to Thackeray, who will ask you to collect four types of items (see below).
efb3b15e148480be49d3d44e01e40ecb3fd2f3f6.text: 影返 給薩克雷，他會要求你收集四種型別的物品（見下文）。

ddfb0be5044da313a509c711ca98648f87ad2a7c.source: Return to the HoM to listen to an additional dialogue between Thackeray and Gwen.
ddfb0be5044da313a509c711ca98648f87ad2a7c.text: 影返 到 史蹟殿堂 以聆聽薩克雷和 關 之間的附加對話。

369d94e743dc897f8360679916bdac1ed3e056e8.source: Exit the EotN outpost to listen to a dialogue between Evennia and The Vanguard leaders.
369d94e743dc897f8360679916bdac1ed3e056e8.text: 退出 EotN 前哨站，聆聽 伊凡妮雅 和 The Vanguard 領導人之間的對話。

cde7c72079cd3f55c9229d7022a86ecb4c609784.source: Head to the Shining Blade Camp in Talmark Wilderness to speak to Salma as part of the Asuran Allies Quest
cde7c72079cd3f55c9229d7022a86ecb4c609784.text: 前往 突馬克荒地 的 光刃公會 營地與擔任阿蘇蘭盟友 任務 成員的薩爾瑪交談

e989be6e73cb80c1a13b26dea85fb21147e38cc4.source: Return to Lion's Arch Keep and speak to Salma. Where you'll complete both Primary Quest (Asuran Allies & Ebon Vanguard Allies )
e989be6e73cb80c1a13b26dea85fb21147e38cc4.text: 影返 至 獅子拱門要塞 並與薩爾瑪交談。您將在其中完成主要 任務（阿蘇拉盟友和 黑檀 盟友）

cb551357d9e0d31d5d50eb4c27179ba1815ff053.source: Note: All four items can quickly be obtained from the April Fools quest "Annihilator 2: Searing Day".
cb551357d9e0d31d5d50eb4c27179ba1815ff053.text: 注意：所有四個物品都可以從愚人節任務「殲滅者 2：崩壞 Day」中快速取得。

f77bae67e6b56b594641c03a44cf4f1bd17a990c.source: Though items like Sugary Blue Drink can be offered, Keiran will not accept them.
f77bae67e6b56b594641c03a44cf4f1bd17a990c.text: 雖然可以提供像含糖藍色飲料這樣的物品，但 Keiran 不會接受。

8bed1e2d4ddb326c4e39983116aca28896c3e2c3.source: Some of the quest details are vague and the quest log does not keep track of your progress in assisting Keiran with winning Gwen's affection.
8bed1e2d4ddb326c4e39983116aca28896c3e2c3.text: 有些任務細節很模糊，任務日誌也沒有記錄你協助 Keiran 贏得 關 好感的進度。

618dbad1681ea0953b383bdab336c889a7b27f3b.source: Sometimes after listening to a dialogue in the Hall of Monuments, only the party leader's quest log is updated for the Ebon Vanguard Allies quest. Party members might see the main quest log updated, but they might still have to return individually to the HoM and the Ice Cliff Chasms to listen to the dialogue again.
618dbad1681ea0953b383bdab336c889a7b27f3b.text: 有時，聽完 史蹟殿堂 中的對話後，黑檀 盟友任務中只會更新隊伍領袖的任務日誌。 隊伍 成員可能會看到主任務日誌已更新，但他們可能仍需要單獨返回 史蹟殿堂 和 冰崖裂口 才能再次聆聽對話。

f5b4095d896d1bf791974bd7fe9368c83717ffd5.source: Kill the Eldritch Ettin in the Bloodstone Caves.
f5b4095d896d1bf791974bd7fe9368c83717ffd5.text: 殺死 血石洞 中的 怪異雙頭巨人。

ad244d947c133d2fc7db5f6cb8371de36ac2a5c3.source: *BONUS* Kill the Eldritch Ettin in Hard Mode.
ad244d947c133d2fc7db5f6cb8371de36ac2a5c3.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 怪異雙頭巨人。

d5411a09db8fc62ec7ef63a6da7c91fca4fc38c3.source: As per the Crystal Method walkthrough.

ddaec863a845eae1e92f7bd1f12083986833f508.source: This quest was first offered on 13th May 2009
ddaec863a845eae1e92f7bd1f12083986833f508.text: 此任務首次於 13 五月 2009 提供

3af08ae39c542c8afb3686ad0b509d6ebf0ec456.source: When doing this quest, walk through the door to the dungeon as this will put you into the dungeon and not the story mode quest; do not interact with the Inscription Stone.
3af08ae39c542c8afb3686ad0b509d6ebf0ec456.text: 執行此任務時，穿過地牢的門，因為這會將您帶入地牢而不是故事模式任務；請勿與 鑄印 Stone 互動。

bddc4c2e1f817b8b52c7a6bfaec47745d82a7ed1.source: Enter the Tunnels of the Forsaken.

05e192c7eedfede373f896fe8bc80e36f1192dec.source: Ignite the first pyre. 3 remaining. Hold off the waves of furious spirits.
05e192c7eedfede373f896fe8bc80e36f1192dec.text: 點燃第一個柴堆。剩餘 3。擋住狂怒的靈魂的波浪。

add8976abd570e75145843ed83d4b8d0b8bf7c81.source: Ignite the second pyre. 2 remaining. Hold off the waves of furious spirits.
add8976abd570e75145843ed83d4b8d0b8bf7c81.text: 點燃第二個柴堆。剩餘 2。擋住狂怒的靈魂的波浪。

a2c17cd9f00970719b18dbaf59a3f573bd820fa1.source: Ignite the third pyre. 1 remaining. Hold off the waves of furious spirits.
a2c17cd9f00970719b18dbaf59a3f573bd820fa1.text: 點燃第三個柴堆。剩餘 1。擋住狂怒的靈魂的波浪。

ef39e18fbbcdce103f96c5b9181058fd862bc427.source: Speak with Ghost of Althea in the ruined village.
ef39e18fbbcdce103f96c5b9181058fd862bc427.text: 與廢棄村莊中 奧瑟雅 的鬼魂交談。

4a867eceb6dc43e5324d49da9d34a0a1de7c4b92.source: It is advised to bring a full party, as well as skills and weapons dealing holy damage. This quest can be difficult with henchmen and not enough firepower, as the spawning rate of the Furious Ghosts is high and they attack from various angles, making AoE spells less effective. The henchmen are also quite frail meaning that keeping them alive for the pyre part can be tedious.
4a867eceb6dc43e5324d49da9d34a0a1de7c4b92.text: 建議帶上完整的隊伍，以及造成神聖傷害的技能和武器。對於追隨者和沒有足夠的火力來說，這個任務可能會很困難，因為 狂怒 幽靈的生成率很高，而且它們從不同的角度進行攻擊，使得 範圍性 法術的效果較差。追隨者也很虛弱，這意味著讓他們在柴堆上活著可能會很乏味。

20c858689a72feb9e24fcf3e6a9f16490b67c8cf.source: Follow the quest marker after entering the area (the left path is a dead end anyway). Walk towards the three pyres indicated on the map. To ignite a pyre, simply stand close to it (a charging bar will appear) until the quest updates and flames appear; no particular item is needed.
20c858689a72feb9e24fcf3e6a9f16490b67c8cf.text: 進入該區域後按照任務標記走（無論如何左邊的路都是死衚衕）。朝地圖上指示的三個柴堆走去。要點燃柴堆，只需站在柴堆附近（會出現充電條），直到任務更新並出現火焰；不需要特定的專案。

b1aff3fa6bf5cc717d9ee6df5a155b061456e8d2.source: Entering the range of a pyre will initiate the spawning of Furious Ghosts, which will run towards the pyre until it is ignited. The rate at which the bar progresses depends on the difference between the number of party members in range minus the number of foes.
b1aff3fa6bf5cc717d9ee6df5a155b061456e8d2.text: 進入柴堆範圍將開始生成 狂怒 幽靈，它們會跑向柴堆直至其被點燃。進度條的進展速度取決於範圍內的黨員數量減去敵人數量之間的差異。

c822d1bfb3c0cdc1b1298c40fd668ae16c96e9c0.source: Blunted, Fractured, and Withered Spirits are encountered on the path. They will not respawn unlike the Furious Ghosts. It is recommended to make sure the area is clear of them before entering the pyre's area, as the continuously respawning Furious Ghosts in addition can easily overwhelm the group. If the party lacks the damage to clear the Furious Ghosts quickly enough, one can attempt to tank them outside of the pyre range while some party member stands in the capture zone. Once the pyre has been ignited, the remaining Furious Ghosts will despawn.
c822d1bfb3c0cdc1b1298c40fd668ae16c96e9c0.text: 路上會遇到鈍化的、破碎的和枯萎的靈魂。與 狂怒 幽靈不同，它們不會重生。建議在進入柴堆區域之前確保該區域沒有它們，因為不斷重生的 狂怒 幽靈也容易壓倒隊伍。如果隊伍缺乏足夠快的傷害來清除 狂怒 幽靈，則可以嘗試在火堆範圍之外將它們坦克起來，同時一些隊伍成員站在捕獲區域中。一旦柴堆被點燃，剩餘的 狂怒 幽靈就會消失。

2c6c1387d04b694109846b99dc59be05b757761e.source: Once all three pyres are ignited, return to Ghost of Althea near the middle pyre to accept the reward.
2c6c1387d04b694109846b99dc59be05b757761e.text: 一旦所有三個柴堆都被點燃，請返回中間柴堆附近的 奧瑟雅 的幽靈處接受獎勵。

dbde536b29d8a414a53d38c5b47c27da0eb223de.source: Only level 1 of Tunnels of the Forsaken will be accessible while this quest is active.
dbde536b29d8a414a53d38c5b47c27da0eb223de.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，只能存取被遺忘者隧道的 1 關卡。

73e490502f0b02caf2463a7c24c04eb47151ded2.source: Further enemies like Bandits, Grawl and Elementals will also spawn as usual, but are not encountered on the quest's path.
73e490502f0b02caf2463a7c24c04eb47151ded2.text: 其他敵人，如強盜、穴居人 和元素也會像往常一樣生成，但不會在任務路徑上遇到。

96eb20068e62e625fdbca1557e4e146e001b8305.source: Find Shalev in Old Ascalon. The shortest way is to start from Sardelac Sanitarium. When you arrive, sometimes Shalev will be attacked by some Devourers around there. Kill the devourers and talk to Shalev for your reward.
96eb20068e62e625fdbca1557e4e146e001b8305.text: 在 舊阿斯卡隆 中找到 Shalev。最短的方法是從 薩德拉克療養院 開始。當你到達時，有時 Shalev 會受到附近一些 蠍 的攻擊。殺死吞噬者並與沙萊夫交談以獲得獎勵。

87e49a810479922b1186896a9c5e8db9c90991b4.text: 完成 技能 連結課程。

0f820b61942b69025f64ca7e72f3f1b0bfe2974a.source: See Headmaster Vhang for your reward.
0f820b61942b69025f64ca7e72f3f1b0bfe2974a.text: 去找 Vhang 校長領取獎勵。

b703116f98506208bf136594f8a7dad0bf8aa93d.source: The completion of this quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. The order of completion is entirely optional.
b703116f98506208bf136594f8a7dad0bf8aa93d.text: 完成這個任務需要完成吳導師給予的四個子任務。完成的順序完全是可選的。

d3b072b8acb571e24fca2cef9a077865a2b2e55d.source: Over level 10 fire elementalists can kill the opponents easily. Use Fireball, Lava Arrows and Fire Storm and they will become passive in a while.
d3b072b8acb571e24fca2cef9a077865a2b2e55d.text: 超過10等級的火元素師可以輕鬆殺死對手。使用火球、熔岩之箭和火焰風暴，它們很快就會變得被動。

948bd2dbe95ef90684058ebf3647cb52177960b3.source: Seek out the Am Fah gathering in Bukdek Byway and eliminate them.
948bd2dbe95ef90684058ebf3647cb52177960b3.text: 尋找 巴德克小徑 中聚集的 安費 並將其消滅。

c714b95174fda334a1be43fb95310e81998dec8a.source: See Guardsman Ping for your reward.
c714b95174fda334a1be43fb95310e81998dec8a.text: 請見衛兵平以獲得獎勵。

a6377f4baf048aba0822b6539a12809b1697778b.source: After leaving from The Marketplace head east. You will encounter two groups of Am Fah after crossing the second of two bridges (at point 1 on the wiki map). Try to engage only one group at a time, but don't worry, if your party wipes you will be resurrected nearby. If you hug the left side of the bridge as you cross it you have a good chance to not aggro the second group. After defeating the two groups of Am Fah continue to head east. You will come into contact with two groups of Am Fah, with a more manageable placement, as well as a statue of Balthazar (point 2) that you can kneel in front of while Favor of the Gods is active to acquire Morale Boosts and blessings. After killing the Am Fah enter a small alcove to the east. Once inside you will encounter Chung, the Attuned (point 3). As you approach Chung more enemies will drop from above, so be ready for a fight.
a6377f4baf048aba0822b6539a12809b1697778b.text: 從 市集 出發後向東行駛。穿過兩座橋中的第二座後（位於 wiki 地圖上的 1 點），您將遇到兩組 安費。嘗試一次只與一組交戰，但不用擔心，如果你的隊伍消滅了你，你會在附近復活。如果你在過橋時擁抱橋的左側，你就有很好的機會不去激怒第二組。擊敗安費的兩組後繼續向東進發。您將接觸到兩組 安費，其位置更易於管理，以及一尊 巴薩澤 雕像（點 2），您可以在眾神的寵愛啟用時跪在它前面以獲得士氣提升和祝福。殺死 安費 後，進入東邊的一個小壁龕。進入後，您將遇到 激戰（指向 3）。當你接近鐘時，更多的敵人將從上方掉落，所以準備好戰鬥吧。

0ba272de88b8832e0eac3bce0e1cc37ccb6c64ff.source: You can complete this quest, The Xunlai Agent, and A Monstrous Revelation simultaneously.
0ba272de88b8832e0eac3bce0e1cc37ccb6c64ff.text: 您可以同時完成此任務、桑萊專員 和巨大的啟示。

2e989470fd2ad17a7ba322c0c968a568f6f7701b.source: The counterpart to this quest is Eliminate the Jade Brotherhood.
2e989470fd2ad17a7ba322c0c968a568f6f7701b.text: 此任務的對應任務是消除 翡翠兄弟會。

3a292aa64d5f176d60166bda0541f7e0d784f7fd.source: Find the Jade Brotherhood in Bukdek Byway and eliminate them.
3a292aa64d5f176d60166bda0541f7e0d784f7fd.text: 尋找巴德克小徑中的翡翠兄弟會並將其消除。

dcc72f4ffda27e43a32f635974cb4c3c693513cb.source: See Guardsman Chienpo for your reward.
dcc72f4ffda27e43a32f635974cb4c3c693513cb.text: 去見侍衛千保，領取獎勵。

60ff6c7276b37b85b1704b42056d359d5b230cd6.source: If you have access to it, the easiest way to complete this is to start from Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter). Otherwise exit from The Marketplace and head east. When you attack Kenshi Steelhand a small group of Jade Brotherhood will spawn to help him.
60ff6c7276b37b85b1704b42056d359d5b230cd6.text: 如果您有權存取它，完成此操作的最簡單方法是從 薇茹廣場（國外季度）開始。否則從 市集 退出並向東行駛。當你攻擊 Kenshi Steelhand 時，一小群 翡翠兄弟會 將會出現來幫助他。

e4288dcdcfbf64659e5982d8c53fd95c91975c1c.source: Kenshi Steelhand spawns twice during this quest. Once in his usual location and once in the quest location.
e4288dcdcfbf64659e5982d8c53fd95c91975c1c.text: 劍士鋼手在此任務中生成兩次。一次在他通常的位置，一次在任務位置。

716bb572766270f1b21fda3b7b50a20d28f2dfa8.source: The counterpart to this quest is Eliminate the Am Fah.
716bb572766270f1b21fda3b7b50a20d28f2dfa8.text: 此任務的對應任務是消除 安費。

7c56fa49912f8d0aafe09c5798d9363a1e61fd47.source: Deliver the crystal shards to the Ghostly Hero.
7c56fa49912f8d0aafe09c5798d9363a1e61fd47.text: 將水晶碎片傳送至 英雄之魂。

d59f828fcf3e1051d52cdfdab454a2fcc804850f.source: *BONUS* Awaken the three Ritual Priests of Elona.
d59f828fcf3e1051d52cdfdab454a2fcc804850f.text: *獎勵* 喚醒伊洛娜的三個 儀式祭司。

7f759213765289ae7bc3b16b2f8192c7faaa64ec.source: As per the Elona Reach mission.
7f759213765289ae7bc3b16b2f8192c7faaa64ec.text: 根據 伊洛那流域 任務。

0cebdb69c7802ccd03dd354b7d022dbb2ad0e3c8.source: Deliver a Melandru's Stalker to Nente.
0cebdb69c7802ccd03dd354b7d022dbb2ad0e3c8.text: 將 梅蘭朵潛行者 交付給 Nente。

f75f78d532568b5a5cb8624023852a92d722fa96.source: Return to Master Ranger Nente for your reward.
f75f78d532568b5a5cb8624023852a92d722fa96.text: 影返 至 遊俠大師涅特 以獲得獎勵。

ec4eec80f127de4c88d7550332786ebbe78743d8.source: If you already have a Melandru's Stalker as a pet, you can immediately complete the quest by speaking to Nente again; he will not take your pet away. Otherwise, you will need to find a Stalker in Old Ascalon and tame it using Charm Animal.
ec4eec80f127de4c88d7550332786ebbe78743d8.text: 如果你已經有梅蘭朵潛行者作為寵物，你可以透過再次與Nente交談來立即完成任務；他不會帶走你的寵物。否則，您需要在 舊阿斯卡隆 中找到 潛行者 並使用 迷魅動物 馴服它。

20f05f42f51e2883d3bc1e491742d55a35271a65.source: There is no quest marker to lead you to a Stalker, but some can be found nearby to the southwest of the entrance to The Breach, past the statue of Balthazar. Alternatively, Stalkers can also be found around the cave that Shalev the Hermit lives in, which may be a shorter and safer option.
20f05f42f51e2883d3bc1e491742d55a35271a65.text: 沒有任務標記可以引導您到達 潛行者，但可以在 缺口 入口西南方附近、巴薩澤 雕像後面找到一些任務標記。另外，在 隱士薛樂 居住的洞穴周圍也可以找到潛行者，這可能是更短且更安全的選擇。

cd437f717f2ab370af8618224fedd2ff6ed67d45.source: If you have already tamed a different type of pet, you will have to give up your pet to a pet tamer to complete the quest. Jarrel the Tamer can be found just outside Ascalon City, but you may prefer to delay this quest until you have access to the Zaishen Menagerie to make your current pet easier to recover.
cd437f717f2ab370af8618224fedd2ff6ed67d45.text: 如果你已經馴服了不同型別的寵物，則必須將你的寵物交給寵物馴服師才能完成任務。馴獸師賈瑞爾就位於 阿斯卡隆城 外面，但您可能更願意推遲此任務，直到您可以進入 Zaishen 動物園，以便更容易恢復您目前的寵物。

231966125b63027c59364d16374e1fd23a51e221.source: Master Ranger Nente will not recognize a Hero's or another player's pet to advance the quest.
231966125b63027c59364d16374e1fd23a51e221.text: 遊俠大師涅特 不會辨識 英雄 或其他玩家的寵物來推進任務。

8f6bee161ed035a3a23bc17369dc4e88ea3e81e6.source: A Melandru's Stalker obtained from the Zaishen Menagerie will not suffice. This quest rewards the skill Charm Animal, but you need the skill in order to charm a Melandru's Stalker in the first place.
8f6bee161ed035a3a23bc17369dc4e88ea3e81e6.text: 從 Zaishen Menagerie 獲得的 梅蘭朵潛行者 是不夠的。此任務獎勵技能 迷魅動物，但您首先需要該技能才能魅惑 梅蘭朵潛行者。

86a791c0213a757e40aa1666f71420fd6fb849aa.source: You can buy the skill from Sir Bertran in Ascalon City.
86a791c0213a757e40aa1666f71420fd6fb849aa.text: 您可以在 阿斯卡隆城 中從 伯特蘭隊長 購買技能。

7e1035bff0bbe70710d7a4923e25b32c91687c70.source: Find Count zu Heltzer. Try to negotiate a ceasefire between the Kurzicks and the Dredge.
7e1035bff0bbe70710d7a4923e25b32c91687c70.text: 找到赫爾策伯爵。試著在庫爾茲克人和 挖掘者 之間談判停火。

d468ec87dc7b1aa0a60fa6417ddd334152b04770.text: 請前往莫勒諾領取獎勵。

04719ee33b6dab647bc31ccdf4a6184ccc525604.source: Map to House zu Heltzer and speak with Count zu Heltzer, then return to Moleneaux for the reward.
04719ee33b6dab647bc31ccdf4a6184ccc525604.text: 對映到 鳳荷議院 並與 zu Heltzer 伯爵交談，然後返回 Moleneaux 獲取獎勵。

ebda46fe4d02172c7c82e4cb5655770a2849a709.source: If exploring Ferndale for the first time, players should be aware that Moleneaux is located right outside of the entrance to Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick), and gaining access to this outpost before mapping back makes getting the reward much more convenient.
ebda46fe4d02172c7c82e4cb5655770a2849a709.text: 如果是第一次探索 蕨谷，玩家應該注意莫勒諾就位於阿斯彭伍德之門 (庫茲柯) 入口的外面，在映射回來之前進入這個前哨站可以讓獲得獎勵變得更加方便。

c496d6c880a7db1f090db38de81d2ad1e283c043.text: 擊敗 亞霸頓 的軍隊！

78b459af9e80560ed4815ee7405ac765fb473231.source: Start from the Gate of Secrets and meet Terick just outside the portal. After talking to Terick, your quest pointer will update and direct the party to a point due west of the Gate of Secrets. You will need to escort Terick along the way. Terick remains friendly, but does not join your party as an ally so he appears to be in no danger of attack from creatures along the way.
78b459af9e80560ed4815ee7405ac765fb473231.text: 從秘密之門出發，在門外與泰裡克會合。與泰裡克交談後，你的任務指標將更新並引導隊伍到達秘密之門正西的一個點。你需要一路護送泰裡克。泰裡克仍然很友好，但不會作為盟友加入你的隊伍，因此他似乎一路上沒有受到生物攻擊的危險。

1b0ba46a762d69b0dab3dd1b6c4679550b835e74.source: On reaching the quest point, Terick taunts the party about their impending death, and a group of Margonites spawn around the party, while Terick runs off to the south. Defeating the Margonites will complete this quest. Your character must live for the quest to be completed. If you cannot hold your own and survive, send your heroes in and direct their attacks from afar.
1b0ba46a762d69b0dab3dd1b6c4679550b835e74.text: 到達任務點後，泰裡克嘲笑隊伍即將死亡，一群瑪貢尼特人在隊伍周圍出現，而泰裡克則跑向南方。擊敗瑪貢尼特即可完成此任務。你的角色必須活著才能完成任務。如果你無法堅持自己的立場並生存下來，請派出你的英雄並從遠處指揮他們的攻擊。

5bac3238b23f2c66a46fb828107ae119226ea7d5.source: You may consider doing this quest at the same time as All Alone in the Darkness, which takes place in the same area and follows a similar route.
5bac3238b23f2c66a46fb828107ae119226ea7d5.text: 您可以考慮與「獨自在黑暗中」同時執行此任務，該任務發生在同一區域並遵循相似的路線。

b95154541155912288c164ae9fea513283961a33.source: Sometimes after defeating Abaddon's forces the quest is updated as failed.
b95154541155912288c164ae9fea513283961a33.text: 有時，在擊敗 亞霸頓 的部隊後，任務會更新為失敗。

3617c1a9a17043fd8b520020677556a2298d7f5e.source: Escort the souls to Mayor Alegheri in the Forgotten Vale.
3617c1a9a17043fd8b520020677556a2298d7f5e.text: 護送靈魂前往 被遺忘者 谷的阿萊格里市長。

b633c92c868113e935e04e989fce3ce5b5b4b951.source: See Mayor Alegheri for your reward.
b633c92c868113e935e04e989fce3ce5b5b4b951.text: 去找阿萊格里市長領獎勵。

271649ccca335428e11f101a6a9afe3a9588cff1.source: Delay taking the quest Wrathful Spirits given by the Reaper of the Forgotten Vale until after you have finished Escort of Souls. Otherwise the hostile Tortured Spirits may kill one of the New Souls, causing you to fail the quest and be ejected from the Underworld.
271649ccca335428e11f101a6a9afe3a9588cff1.text: 延後接受 被遺忘者 谷收割者給予的憤怒之靈任務，直到你完成靈魂護航之後。否則，敵對的折磨靈魂可能會殺死其中一個新靈魂，導致你任務失敗並被逐出地獄。

f16dda6a59d7cc528c7e1ce329bbba9edbc1d9d3.source: Taking this quest spawns an additional group of Mindblade Spectres in the starting chamber; kill this group before taking the quest Unwanted Guests.didnt have this happen just now, talk comment from 2015 asks the same, rng or hm only group?
f16dda6a59d7cc528c7e1ce329bbba9edbc1d9d3.text: 接受此任務會在起始房間中產生額外的一群心刃幽靈；在接受不受歡迎的客人任務之前殺死這個組。剛才沒有發生這種情況，來自 2015 的評論詢問相同的，rng 或 hm 組？

d22831b412f2efc118005df48d7fee9d5f45fabb.source: On rare occasions, the Mindblades do not attack the New Souls, making far easier to complete this quest.
d22831b412f2efc118005df48d7fee9d5f45fabb.text: 在極少數情況下，心靈之刃不會攻擊新靈魂，這使得完成此任務變得更加容易。

617185de8d7ff9ae9f2aee898ff6aea3a849a6f2.source: Talk to Kwaju. He can show you around the estate.
617185de8d7ff9ae9f2aee898ff6aea3a849a6f2.text: 與誇朱交談。他可以帶你參觀莊園。

4b5bc5bd03a2e4702867e74cfecf37c603bb6bcf.source: Scout the estate with Kwaju and Koss.
4b5bc5bd03a2e4702867e74cfecf37c603bb6bcf.text: 與 Kwaju 和 寇斯 一起偵察莊園。

80a79646a7cbba94c936b797cc2436c3315930f6.text: 請參閱 Behchu 領取獎勵

882f7e73166f17cbb82d10dafe386ba7a98390ee.source: Exit into Dejarin Estate from Pogahn Passage and proceed northeast to meet Kwaju. He can be found a little southeast of the garrison. Lead him to each of the three checkpoints. He will not begin talking until the nearby enemies have been killed.
882f7e73166f17cbb82d10dafe386ba7a98390ee.text: 從 波甘驛站 出口進入 Dejarin Estate，然後向東北行駛與 Kwaju 會合。他位於要塞東南方向不遠的地方。把他帶到三個檢查站。在附近的敵人被殺死之前他不會開始說話。

df6e6eb1816e19a0ef4639093a6400b761296ebb.source: Clear Ettin's Back in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
df6e6eb1816e19a0ef4639093a6400b761296ebb.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 梅古瑪叢林 中的 雙頭怪隱匿地。

fb567354428fc7bdc423cb1041592e553f585e18.source: "Clear Ettin's Back in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."
fb567354428fc7bdc423cb1041592e553f585e18.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的梅古瑪叢林中的雙頭怪隱匿地。”

9c522dfe6934b99989ac70cc1981abaf4426c16f.source: The primary quest White Mantle Wrath: Demagogue's Vanguard will lead you through here.
9c522dfe6934b99989ac70cc1981abaf4426c16f.text: 主要任務 白斗篷公會的復仇：煽動者的先鋒隊 將引導您到達這裡。

09bab32beb7d1a14690cc728f322b3a5c069ed24.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.6% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
09bab32beb7d1a14690cc728f322b3a5c069ed24.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.6% 的貢獻。

af4f2dc48252514450217736ed10817f38098983.source: There are a lot of popups in this area. Hidden devourers riddle the area to a point where large swathes of the southern central half are empty except for hidden foes. The small green area in the east also hides Moss Scarabs amongst the few Thorn Stalker Sprouts. Consider heading east last.
af4f2dc48252514450217736ed10817f38098983.text: 該區域有很多彈出視窗。隱藏的吞噬者遍佈該地區，以至於中南部的大片地區除了隱藏的敵人外都是空的。東部的小綠地也將苔蘚聖甲蟲隱藏在少數 棘刺潛行者 芽中。考慮最後向東行駛。

ab74085f7a7cc15ea7d00a0d3a56b7916032ed42.source: A few groups of Thorn Stalkers patrol a long route in the center and may be missed. Backtrack in the opposite direction to find them. There are also groups of Maguuma centaurs patrolling large areas to the northwest which can be missed easily.
ab74085f7a7cc15ea7d00a0d3a56b7916032ed42.text: 幾組荊棘追獵者在中心的一條很長的路線上巡邏，可能會被錯過。沿相反方向原路返回即可找到它們。還有成群的 梅古瑪 半人馬在西北大片區域巡邏，很容易被忽略。

dc481cf68692496079194c4f3bb19cab2fc9897f.source: North of Ventari's Refuge are a few groups of centaurs that travel fast, and may be missed.
dc481cf68692496079194c4f3bb19cab2fc9897f.text: 凡特里避難所 北部有幾群半人馬，它們行進速度很快，可能會被錯過。

46f15f89a16b3d1184cf25529acad5bfd093cbc7.source: Area of effect opportunities are very limited on this vanquish. For this reason, Elementalists should consider elites like Invoke Lightning, and Mesmers should avoid elites like Panic or Keystone signet.
46f15f89a16b3d1184cf25529acad5bfd093cbc7.text: 這次勝利的影響範圍非常有限。因此，元素主義者應該考慮像 閃電祈禱 這樣的精英，而幻術師應該避免像 恐慌 或 Keystone Signet 這樣的精英。

70efa9a0ca054bd2f5918f43f7fd1dd83d9f0634.source: It is unnecessary to bring hex removal skills, since a boss with Life Siphon is the sole hex on this vanquish.
70efa9a0ca054bd2f5918f43f7fd1dd83d9f0634.text: 沒有必要攜帶六角去除技能，因為具有 吸取生命 的 Boss 是此征服中唯一的六角形。

765280d83e9f774aeddfaa29474ce9bd5e3ec2ed.source: With great patience, it is possible to bring a party of 8 from the Temple of the Ages.
765280d83e9f774aeddfaa29474ce9bd5e3ec2ed.text: 只要有極大的耐心，就有可能從 世紀神殿 帶來 8 的聚會。

1cb8ca812c465e98493b7b428516d9f0751aef39.source: The Quest Log doesn't display the gold or experience rewards for this quest, though gold and experience are given when the quest is turned in, and are displayed in the initial quest dialogue.
1cb8ca812c465e98493b7b428516d9f0751aef39.text: 任務 日誌不顯示該任務的金幣或經驗獎勵，儘管在提交任務時會給予金幣和經驗，並顯示在初始任務對話中。

57683841b30242ad4ede0b8f7d259254769b8437.source: Give the experimental elixir to Fadden Hathorn in Sardelac Sanitarium.
57683841b30242ad4ede0b8f7d259254769b8437.text: 將實驗靈藥交給 薩德拉克療養院 中的法登‧哈索恩 (Fadden Hathorn)。

1c58375f716c575e9559dba29c3dd3f1a8920470.text: 請參閱 瓦薩 以取得獎勵。

53ccdcaa1afc6dbf577ed6cc322726974e9cf8f9.source: Just map travel and follow the objectives; there are no challenges involved.
53ccdcaa1afc6dbf577ed6cc322726974e9cf8f9.text: 只需繪製旅行地圖並遵循目標即可；不存在任何挑戰。

b0b43133da728eaf305e5daee136ab9988e4c981.source: Explore the area outside the Citadel and kill any remaining heket. [6...0] of 6 heket groups remain.
b0b43133da728eaf305e5daee136ab9988e4c981.text: 探索城堡外的區域並殺死剩餘的赫克特。 6 heket 群組的 [6...0] 保留。

7fb4fe3401a91e9ead7cb5a2060e42a725336727.source: Defeat the heket leader and his comrades.
7fb4fe3401a91e9ead7cb5a2060e42a725336727.text: 擊敗赫克特首領和他的戰友。

8f7c961737e8e061b2c4c54d086dd8ba39b5524e.source: Bull Trainer Giants, Hunting Minotaurs, and Kunan the Loudmouth will spawn in Wilderness of Bahdza after this quest is completed.
8f7c961737e8e061b2c4c54d086dd8ba39b5524e.text: 此任務完成後，馴牛巨人、狩獵牛頭怪和大嘴庫南將在 巴薩荒野 中生成。

64532ead9813a6881684330a91d2e00e04c9503a.source: The Hekets in Wilderness of Bahdza (Beast Sworn Hekets, Blood Cowl Hekets, Blue Tongue Hekets, Brokk Ripsnort, and Stoneaxe Hekets) will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.
64532ead9813a6881684330a91d2e00e04c9503a.text: 此任務完成後，巴薩荒野 中的赫克特（野獸宣誓赫克特、血罩赫克特、藍舌赫克特、布洛克·利普斯諾特和石斧赫克特）將不再生成。

a235259b872feea31f6e4fbbdede12ff3cd35662.source: Head out from Dzagonur Bastion and follow your quest pointer to each of the 6 heket groups in turn, that are all clustered in the north-east corner of the Wilderness of Bahdza. After killing the 6 heket groups, make your way to the heket leader, Brokk Ripsnort, who is accompanied by one final heket group.
a235259b872feea31f6e4fbbdede12ff3cd35662.text: 從 薩崗諾稜堡 出發，沿著任務指標依序到達每個 6 heket 群組，這些群組都聚集在 巴薩荒野 的東北角。消滅 6 赫克特小隊後，前往赫克特首領布洛克‧瑞普斯諾特 (Brokk Ripsnort) 身邊，他身邊還有最後一支赫克特小隊。

e718b656cdd9da76277336dc54fc51af4553097b.source: Find Grahm in the Sage Lands.
e718b656cdd9da76277336dc54fc51af4553097b.text: 在 賢者領地 中找到格雷姆。

1478d6f31ea9b27297ca36baaf732388a6160ee1.source: Slay Gale Stormsend and obtain the Lilac Eye.
1478d6f31ea9b27297ca36baaf732388a6160ee1.text: 消滅 狂風 斯托森德並獲得紫丁香之眼。

ddb3feddad22ce1e3c96401d90c5a1144c0d942b.source: Return the Lilac Eye to Trader Versai.
ddb3feddad22ce1e3c96401d90c5a1144c0d942b.text: 影返 將淡紫色眼睛改為 商人法薩依。

48a633ad4fd66f6ca37c22302fca2e357af002d8.source: Exit Druid's Overlook and find Grahm in the Sage Lands by following the quest marker. After speaking with him, head northwest towards The Wilds and follow the northern path back east. As in most areas in the Maguuma Jungle, beware of large popup groups of Maguuma Spiders and Moss Scarabs. Gale Stormsend can be found alone at the end of the path in the waterfall area, and fights with Empathy and Cry of Frustration, but should be easy for a group to take down. When Gale is dead, pick up the Lilac Eye and return to Trader Versai.
48a633ad4fd66f6ca37c22302fca2e357af002d8.text: 退出 德魯伊高地 並依照任務標記在 賢者領地 中找到格雷姆。與他交談後，向西北方向前往 荒原，然後沿著北邊的小路向東走。與 梅古瑪叢林 中的大多數區域一樣，請小心彈出的大量 梅古瑪 蜘蛛和苔蘚聖甲蟲。 狂風 St​​​​ormsend 可以在瀑布區域路徑的盡頭單獨找到，並與 自虐 和 挫折哭喊 戰鬥，但對於團隊來說應該很容易拿下。當 狂風 死亡時，拿起紫丁香之眼並返回 商人法薩依。

954c2be5a3d7bc0c1805d9e2a7937a19f21877c1.source: The quest does not actually require speaking to Grahm, so the fastest way to complete this quest (other than trading for the Lilac Eye) is to enter the Sage Lands from The Wilds and go directly to Gale Stormsend.
954c2be5a3d7bc0c1805d9e2a7937a19f21877c1.text: 任務實際上並不需要與格雷姆交談，因此完成任務的最快方法（除了交易紫丁香之眼之外）是從荒原進入賢者領地並直接前往狂風 Stormsend。

340b8742e1b6f2e4558f9b1d376ee10e6c0f45f6.source: The quest Wisdom of the Druids is done near where Gale Stormsend is found. Doing both quests at the same time can save time.
340b8742e1b6f2e4558f9b1d376ee10e6c0f45f6.text: 德魯伊的任務 智慧者 在發現 狂風 斯托姆森德的地方附近完成。同時完成這兩個任務可以節省時間。

8e709c215fd270bd42e31c82003fc7544b37e0ac.source: Slay Flesh Gluttons to help the Wandering Soul recover his memory. You have [5...0] of 5 left to kill.
8e709c215fd270bd42e31c82003fc7544b37e0ac.text: 消滅食肉者，幫助遊魂恢復記憶。您還有 [5...0] 的 5 需要殺死。

b1dafb6cede921a26a09cc961fbb5df14c850c7f.source: The Flesh Gluttons will spawn with a squad of Margonites in the Leech Tunnels, the triangle-shaped area around the three nearest resurrection shrines in the east. Consider clearing this area at first before accepting the quest if you have problems with dealing both the regular patrols and those from the quest.
b1dafb6cede921a26a09cc961fbb5df14c850c7f.text: 食肉者會在水蛭隧道中與一隊瑪貢尼特人一起生成，水蛭隧道是東部最近的三個復活神殿周圍的三角形區域。如果您在處理常規巡邏隊和任務中的巡邏隊時遇到問題，請考慮在接受任務之前先清理該區域。

cada1bcc36ec2790e462ef169b7bb15e1006be1e.source: The Flesh Glutton and the Margonites are technically two separate groups, so either part of the patrol can be pulled seperately if needed. When fighting the entire patrol it's advisable to kill the Margonites at first since a Flesh Glutton will spawn a Pain Titan which again will spawn two Madness Titans upon death.
cada1bcc36ec2790e462ef169b7bb15e1006be1e.text: 從技術上講，食肉者和瑪貢尼特是兩個獨立的群體，因此如果需要的話，巡邏隊的任何一部分都可以單獨拉動。當與整個巡邏隊戰鬥時，建議先殺死瑪貢尼特，因為食肉者會產生一個 苦痛 泰坦，死亡後又會產生兩個瘋狂泰坦。

1ee83166149358cf919a832f47e3764900a240f7.source: Consider clearing the Leech Tunnels before accepting the subsequent quest A Fleshy Operation, since it will spawn groups of torment creatures.
1ee83166149358cf919a832f47e3764900a240f7.text: 在接受後續任務「肉質行動」之前，請考慮清理水蛭隧道，因為它會產生成群的折磨生物。

26790d96b8b516a173bb7fbddb8d789c0abe18ac.source: Taking this quest will spawn an additional chest near one of the Flesh Gluttons.
26790d96b8b516a173bb7fbddb8d789c0abe18ac.text: 接受這個任務會在一個貪食者附近產生一個額外的箱子。

14c437194c3f800b764ca4ae4b7e91ee38a5bf0d.source: Clear Fahranur, the First City in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
14c437194c3f800b764ca4ae4b7e91ee38a5bf0d.text: 清除 Fahranur，困難模式下所有敵人中 艾斯坦 中的第一個 城市。

18f3e396fbd635eee5fa27e3751a3c9c0f52a172.source: "Clear Fahranur, the First City in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."
18f3e396fbd635eee5fa27e3751a3c9c0f52a172.text: “清除 Fahranur，困難模式下所有敵人中 艾斯坦 中的第一個 城市。”

3e755d6655cede9c6f88afec19887af71c101d08.source: Even though the area outside the ruins is freely accessible, the ruins themselves are not accessible for Nightfall characters until after completion of the Jokanur Diggings mission.
3e755d6655cede9c6f88afec19887af71c101d08.text: 儘管廢墟外的區域可以自由進入，但在完成 Jokanur Diggings 任務之前，黑暗逆襲 角色無法進入廢墟本身。

da0d42b1622f71c5c7ed063c4f90c5e35cd2ceeb.source: There are no primary quests that take place here but several secondary quests do, including the first two of Scholar Chago's quest chain (starting with A Perplexing Plague) and Defender's Choice.
da0d42b1622f71c5c7ed063c4f90c5e35cd2ceeb.text: 這裡沒有發生主要任務，但有幾個次要任務，包括學者查戈的任務鏈的前兩個（從令人困惑的瘟疫開始）和 守護者之盾 的選擇。

615777cdb9a86b44199666893d71387dc188be50.source: Although Istani civilization (and the Order of the Sunspears) originated here, Fahranur has been completely abandoned since the Scarab Plague.
615777cdb9a86b44199666893d71387dc188be50.text: 儘管伊斯塔尼文明（以及烈陽之矛騎士團）起源於這裡，但法赫拉努爾自聖甲蟲瘟疫以來就被完全遺棄了。

9329cd8596f2a79e2844d1458168370f5858b70a.source: The fallen statue head in the opening cinematic of the Nightfall campaign appears to be the one that lies near the exit into Jokanur Diggings.
9329cd8596f2a79e2844d1458168370f5858b70a.text: 黑暗逆襲 活動的開場動畫中倒下的雕像頭部似乎位於 Jokanur 礦區出口附近。

b602f7333227164a81a5c12740bf7d939a1c39ed.source: Librarian Gahmir Lenon's dialogue in the Halls of Chokhin hints at a connection between the First City and the kings of Orr.
b602f7333227164a81a5c12740bf7d939a1c39ed.text: 圖書館員 Gahmir Lenon 在 Chokhin 大廳中的對話暗示了第一個 城市 和 歐爾 國王之間的聯絡。

0bad3baf7fd170565e2cd8c9dcea7481d1c0c809.source: The entrance into the ruins is protected by falling crusher traps.
0bad3baf7fd170565e2cd8c9dcea7481d1c0c809.text: 廢墟的入口受到掉落的破碎機陷阱的保護。

235ec681406d1cae435c697f98ea43f34abc55ec.source: Start at Piken Square. Head straight to the West and walk along a narrow path on the right. When reaching the marked point you will find several Charr Overseers and Martyrs there. After killing the Overseers first, the Martyrs second and finally the other Charr, you can click on each dead soldier lying on the ground. Each body holds a family crest (needs a slot in your inventory). After collecting 10 of them you can travel back for the reward.
235ec681406d1cae435c697f98ea43f34abc55ec.text: 從 派肯廣場 開始。一直往西走，沿著右邊的一條狹窄的小路走。當到達標記點時，您會在那裡發現幾位 夏爾 監督者和殉道者。首先殺死督軍，然後殺死烈士，最後殺死另一個 夏爾，您可以點選躺在地上的每個死去計程車兵。每個屍體都擁有一個家族徽章（需要在您的庫存中有一個插槽）。收集完 10 後，您可以返回以獲得獎勵。

3943d1bcf9f5d07535d214f3bec652d409627db7.source: Consider doing this alongside Supplies for the Duke to give the nearby Charr additional targets.
3943d1bcf9f5d07535d214f3bec652d409627db7.text: 考慮與 援助公爵 一起執行此操作，為附近的 夏爾 提供額外目標。

5ebfd2c8c4c677e98d39f2f865654e8bebdccd18.source: The storyline of this quest continues in Casualty Report, even though Casualty Report can be completed before this quest.
5ebfd2c8c4c677e98d39f2f865654e8bebdccd18.text: 此任務的故事情節在 傷亡報告 中繼續，儘管 傷亡報告 可以在此任務之前完成。

c9065338550760cc62857f4337621ec0b8c95bae.source: You must first listen to the conversation that Sergeant Weststar is having with his troops just outside Longeye's Ledge in Grothmar Wardowns.
c9065338550760cc62857f4337621ec0b8c95bae.text: 您必須先在 Grothmar Wardowns 的 長眼巖脈 外聆聽 中尉 西方之星 與他的部隊的對話。

7e84c1f5695476a10cc3fd5706ccc3f945119f56.source: Discover the fate of Jenn Valefield.
7e84c1f5695476a10cc3fd5706ccc3f945119f56.text: 探索詹·維爾菲爾德的命運。

09f46aee2c86d268ab88eb8c169caa50ce432a39.source: Discern the fate of Chance Redding.

f2d080545d6e047a62f03a5162e9699d932e379d.source: Divine the fate of Sergeant Weststar.
f2d080545d6e047a62f03a5162e9699d932e379d.text: 神聖的 中尉 西方之星 的命運。

8af6daf6ac8e08242cbccd2a00194a8aca3dd34e.source: This quest can be completed without fighting at all (e.g. by running). However, the following quest The Hunting of the Charr cannot.
8af6daf6ac8e08242cbccd2a00194a8aca3dd34e.text: 這個任務可以在不戰鬥的情況下完成（例如透過跑步）。然而，下列任務「狩獵 夏爾」則不能。

e56ae52fe1db75c9852560d4defc443fc82a590e.source: After listening to the conversation, go to Dalada Uplands and head down to the southeast corner where the portal to Sacnoth Valley is. You may want to pick up the Siege Devourer on the way.
e56ae52fe1db75c9852560d4defc443fc82a590e.text: 聽完對話後，前往達拉達山地並前往東南角，那裡是聖諾谷的傳送門。您可能會想在途中拿起 Siege 蠍。

ee1a193a368060db0ea4a52f5c686ddb8f828b9f.source: Look for the Corpse of Brave Brent Poltroon nearby and investigate the corpse to obtain the quest. Head through the portal into Sacnoth Valley. Once there follow the quest marker that points to the location of each NPC you need to contact. After speaking to each NPC they will follow your party to the next location.
ee1a193a368060db0ea4a52f5c686ddb8f828b9f.text: 尋找附近的勇敢 布恩 普爾創的屍體並調查屍體以獲得任務。透過門戶進入 聖諾谷。到達那裡後，請遵循指向您需要聯絡的每個 NPC 位置的任務標記。與每個 NPC 交談後，他們會跟隨你的隊伍前往下一個地點。

14326efee4e9bb0790b08dcd087c395f650f1aa4.source: Jenn Valefield is to the south sitting beneath a tree in a field with a dozen stone elementals nearby.
14326efee4e9bb0790b08dcd087c395f650f1aa4.text: Jenn Valefield 位於南方，坐在田野中的一棵樹下，附近有十幾個石元素。

646dbc77256ec06cc505cb561fa8b31435f992c5.source: Chance Redding is your next target. He is located in the middle of the zone, just south of where the zone name appears on the World Map.
646dbc77256ec06cc505cb561fa8b31435f992c5.text: 錢斯·雷丁是你的下一個目標。他位於該區域的中間，就在世界地圖上該區域名稱出現的位置的南邊。

3dc15689509eb3238ede6d66a175e1229b0ad0ad.source: Sergeant Weststar is in the southwest corner of the zone, having followed Rake Blazeclaw here. Speaking to Sergeant Weststar completes the quest.
3dc15689509eb3238ede6d66a175e1229b0ad0ad.text: 中尉 西方之星 位於該區域的西南角，跟隨 Rake Blazeclaw 來到這裡。與 中尉 西方之星 對話即可完成任務。

d98b99078bed95136f1dfc77d2ee9d980a4b446e.source: Enemies cannot target nor harm Jenn and Chance.
d98b99078bed95136f1dfc77d2ee9d980a4b446e.text: 敵人無法瞄準或傷害 Jenn 和 Chance。

823ac89c39975c7134b7618ab5bbe4f026a349c7.source: Find Imperial Guard Miyuki in Wajjun Bazaar.
823ac89c39975c7134b7618ab5bbe4f026a349c7.text: 在 瓦江市場 中找到帝國守護美雪。

0cb379804660cff5451ebe5187e96ea37f0ffda1.source: Ask around to find out where Imperial Guard Natsumi has been.
0cb379804660cff5451ebe5187e96ea37f0ffda1.text: 四處打聽，看看帝國衛隊夏海去了哪裡。

9c5938a09db6dc4c2a579ba09d142c9897229586.source: Head to the location Miyuki has suggested.

6514f4e7975f7cdaf50b86bc3502fac38a5bfa3d.source: Defeat Meijun, Vengeful Eye and his allies.
6514f4e7975f7cdaf50b86bc3502fac38a5bfa3d.text: 擊敗美君、復仇之眼和他的盟友。

73278108a3dac3c02175f0780d2b2ba656c92914.source: See Lei Jeng For your reward.

8553f4710d5d4735df12460cdd2c81a1a173e4ad.source: Miyuki is just south of The Marketplace, battling a single Jade Brotherhood member. Help her defeat and interrogate him. Search for more Jade Brotherhood Members and Peasants in Wajjun Bazaar. Depending on the NPC you speak to, some of the options will increase the progress bar more than the other options, while other options won't increase the progress bar at all. Jade Brotherhood Members have a higher effect on the bar than the peasants with one exception. If you ask Peasant 1, "Who's your daddy?" he tells you his father is Yon Ruino. Speaking to Yon Ruino will greatly increase the bar's progress. After you have found enough evidence, head towards the Jade Brotherhood headquarters on the dock north of Wajjun Bazaar. Defeat Meijun's party to finish the quest. Make sure that Miyuki follows you while you gather information, or you will not be able to finish the quest, as Miyuki tends to get stuck between the NPCs and gets left behind.
8553f4710d5d4735df12460cdd2c81a1a173e4ad.text: Miyuki 位於 市集 的南邊，與一名 翡翠兄弟會 成員作戰。幫助她擊敗並審問他。在 瓦江市場 中搜尋更多 翡翠兄弟會 會員和農民。根據與您交談的 NPC，某些選項會比其他選項增加更多進度條，而其他選項則根本不會增加進度條。 翡翠兄弟會 會員對酒吧的影響力高於農民，但有一個例外。如果你問農民 1，「你爸爸是誰？」他告訴你他的父親是Yon Ruino。與Yon Ruino交談將大大增加酒吧的進度。找到足夠的證據後，前往 瓦江市場 以北碼頭上的 翡翠兄弟會 總部。擊敗美君一行人即可完成任務。確保 Miyuki 在收集資訊時跟隨您，否則您將無法完成任務，因為 Miyuki 往往會被困在 NPC 之間並被落在後面。

a184b32d60fd2b0297a1ca0b69e8b879e548c792.source: The most efficient way of gathering evidence:
a184b32d60fd2b0297a1ca0b69e8b879e548c792.text: 收集證據最有效的方法：

0a4b510a0f7177077c1719856ac437b11fce42ab.source: Head to Miyuki at the start

4b5d039b2251dffc0f1326dcc5fd0476965a7b97.source: Continue past her to defeat and speak to Jade Brotherhood Member 1, picking the first option.
4b5d039b2251dffc0f1326dcc5fd0476965a7b97.text: 繼續越過她打敗她並與 翡翠兄弟會 成員 1 交談，選擇第一個選項。

3e0d39e87d78439ed0bbfb313ebead18682023a3.source: Dying from being crushed does not cause Death Penalty and does not count as a death (for Survivors).
3e0d39e87d78439ed0bbfb313ebead18682023a3.text: 被壓死不會導致死刑，也不算死亡（對於倖存者）。

462f8cf4e728a74d556d28c05f57d4ef75555bbb.source: The traps will kill player characters, but will not kill Heroes.
462f8cf4e728a74d556d28c05f57d4ef75555bbb.text: 陷阱會殺死玩家角色，但不會殺死英雄。

0536f33a98370b96d2d9c071a2d390b3dcc791ba.source: This area has a large number of low level Skale enemies near the entrance to the city itself.
