0411d4da276ddcd6228a3f6d72103409c6d7e7ad.source: This part of the quest is the same as Charr in the Tunnels, except that the inhabitants of Wyle Brimscourge's chamber may be slightly more numerous, and you will have to deal with the more powerful Charr on repeat visits. Fight your way down to the south end of the dungeon as usual, pull Wyle Brimscourge and kill him for the Dungeon Key, then run or fight your way to the Dungeon Lock and the portal to level 2.
0411d4da276ddcd6228a3f6d72103409c6d7e7ad.text: 這部分任務與隧道中的 夏爾 相同，只是懷爾·布里姆斯科奇房間的居民可能稍微多一些，並且在重複訪問時你將不得不對付更強大的 夏爾。像往常一樣一路殺到地牢的南端，拉出懷爾·布里姆斯科奇並殺死他以獲得 地監 鑰匙，然後奔跑或戰鬥到 地監 鎖和通往 2 關卡的傳送門。

c3d50f42e9090c6e9e11d75815f9a9359f48f49c.source: Once again, you need to make your way from the south side of this floor to the north side. Sneak or fight your way through the large atrium to the stairs and northern tunnels; it may be easiest to keep close to the eastern side. Your quest marker will be pointing you to the crystal gate where the northern patrol was found during Charr in the Tunnels, but you actually need to go to where you found the northeastern patrol first (at the exclamation point on the map to the right). In the far northeastern tunnel, you will need to kill some Shard Elementals, unless the nearby Ironheart has already taken care of them for you. Pick up the Elemental Crystal bundle they drop, and carry it west to the crystal gate. When you approach the gate, the crystal will disappear, and the gate will open to reveal the entrance to level 3.
c3d50f42e9090c6e9e11d75815f9a9359f48f49c.text: 再次，您需要從該層的南側走到北側。潛行或戰鬥穿過大中庭到達樓梯和北部隧道；靠近東側可能是最容易的。你的任務標記將指向水晶門，在 夏爾 隧道中發現北方巡邏隊的地方，但你實際上需要先前往發現東北巡邏隊的地方（在右側地圖上的感嘆號處）。在最東北的隧道中，你需要殺死一些碎片元素，除非附近的鐵心已經幫你解決了。撿起他們掉落的 元素生物 水晶束，並將其向西帶到水晶門。當您接近大門時，水晶將會消失，大門將會開啟，露出 3 關卡的入口。

dae72e16e7b24c32b09092881da2e13d4ab459c6.source: You start at the middle of the south side of this floor, and will need to follow the purple path on the map to the right. Head northeast until you reach a large chamber filled with ruins and Charr, then hug the left wall heading north until you can start heading west again. Pass under the bridge, being careful of any Charr above. Just after the bridge, you may want to take a short detour south to clear out the Charr atop another bridge you will be passing under later. Continue west and you will reach a large foundry area, where your goal is to reach one of the stairways leading up to the higher walkways to the southwest. There is a resurrection shrine nearby, and from there you should be able to see the Boss Key lying on the overlook further south. After picking up the key, return to the red path on the map to the right, and fight your way around to the Boss Lock, then to the large open area to the southwest where Maz Scourgeheart and his elementals await you.
dae72e16e7b24c32b09092881da2e13d4ab459c6.text: 你從這一層南側的中間開始，需要沿著地圖上的紫色路徑向右走。向東北方向前進，直到到達一個充滿廢墟和 夏爾 的大房間，然後緊靠左牆向北行駛，直到您可以再次向西行駛。從橋下穿過，小心上面的任何 夏爾。過了橋後，您可能需要向南繞一小段路，以清除稍後將要經過的另一座橋上的 夏爾。繼續向西，您將到達一個大型鑄造區，您的目標是到達通往西南方向較高走道的樓梯之一。附近有一個復活神社，從那裡您應該可以看到位於更南邊的觀景臺上的 頭目 鑰匙。拿起鑰匙後，返回到右側地圖上的紅色路徑，一路殺到 頭目 鎖，然後到達西南邊的大片空地，馬茲·天災之心和他的元素生物在那裡等著你。

d38497a1e650bae5223ed0b1dec0b8535cdb8f41.source: Maz will start with Fire Magic, including Mark of Rodgort, Fireball and Lava Font. After teleporting once, he will switch to Air Magic, with Lightning Javelin and Whirlwind to interrupt attackers and Lightning Strike to hit without line of sight. For the last confrontation he will use Water Magic, snaring his enemies with Deep Freeze and Shard Storm while protecting himself with Blurred Vision and Swirling Aura. In all three fights, he will also use Earthquake for AoE knockdown and Kinetic Armor to increase his armor rating.
d38497a1e650bae5223ed0b1dec0b8535cdb8f41.text: Maz將從火系魔法開始，包含洛葛特的印記、火球和熔岩。傳送一次後，他會切換到風系魔法，用閃電標槍和旋風打斷攻擊者，用閃電衝擊進行無視線攻擊。在最後的對抗中，他將使用 水系魔法，以 強力凍結 和 冰風暴 誘捕敵人，同時以 模糊視線 和 旋渦靈氣 保護自己。在所有三場戰鬥中，他還將使用 地震 來擊倒 範圍性，並使用 魔動護甲 來提升他的護甲等級。

42e85021db41a811d9f9da4b350b705965345d3c.source: His elementals are identical to the other elementals in the dungeon, and behave as a group. While they can deal significant melee damage at low levels, sufficient AoE damage should dispatch them quickly.
42e85021db41a811d9f9da4b350b705965345d3c.text: 他的元素與地牢中的其他元素相同，並且表現得像一個群體。雖然它們可以在低等級時造成大量近戰傷害，但足夠的 範圍性 傷害應該可以快速消滅它們。

2a101405ad912da35e0c4d8f97504d4bb967ce77.source: Maz and his minions shouldn't pose too much of a threat compared to the other mobs in the dungeon, especially if you are a spellcaster with high firepower. His spells are also slow to cast, giving you a generous window to spike him down before he becomes a problem. Armor-ignoring damage in particular bypasses Kinetic Armor, and Backfire will shut him down completely. Should you still face difficulties, equipping Devona with interrupts and/or enchantment removal can counter most of Maz's tactics.
2a101405ad912da35e0c4d8f97504d4bb967ce77.text: 與地牢中的其他怪物相比，馬茲和他的爪牙不應該構成太大的威脅，特別是如果你是一個擁有高火力的施法者。他的法術施放速度也很慢，這給了你一個寬裕的時間來在他成為問題之前把他擊倒。 防禦-忽略傷害特別繞過魔動護甲，而魔力反噬將完全關閉他。如果您仍然遇到困難，為 德佛娜 配備中斷和/或結界移除功能可以對抗 Maz 的大部分策略。

5dfdc3151ece0e6b6b1dd007ee0c6decd1c432f1.source: Upon his death, Maz's Chest will spawn. After every player in the party has opened the chest, a countdown will start and the party will be returned to Piken Square.
5dfdc3151ece0e6b6b1dd007ee0c6decd1c432f1.text: 在他死後，Maz 的 寶箱 將會生成。當隊伍中的每位玩家都開啟寶箱後，倒數計時將開始，隊伍將返回 派肯廣場。

59ccaa5dc679b039acfa3aa4b44b5dadecce8ce7.source: Talk to Devona to finish the quest.
59ccaa5dc679b039acfa3aa4b44b5dadecce8ce7.text: 與 德佛娜 交談以完成任務。

a9dabab86288bf07790784c9f84143ae95f9b1e6.source: Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies from spawning in the northern part of the Northlands, making it slightly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.
a9dabab86288bf07790784c9f84143ae95f9b1e6.text: 將沒有重鑄模式的玩家新增到隊伍中將阻止敵人在北地北部生成，從而更容易到達被遺忘的隧道。如果所有沒有重鑄模式的玩家在進入地牢之前退出或離開地圖，任務仍然可以完成。

83b06b56c58ddb6e85cecf9f1f17a0b0292f1433.source: When repeating the quest, there will be additional Charr groups throughout the dungeon with no loot and levels that scale with the weakest member of the party. Players interested in speed clears and safer runs may therefore prefer to abandon the quest after opening the reward chest, though this means never unlocking Devona as a hero.
83b06b56c58ddb6e85cecf9f1f17a0b0292f1433.text: 重複任務時，整個地牢中將會有額外的 夏爾 小組，沒有戰利品，並且等級會隨著隊伍中最弱的成員而變化。因此，對速度通關和安全執行感興趣的玩家可能更願意在開啟獎勵箱後放棄任務，儘管這意味著永遠不會以英雄身份解鎖 德佛娜。

0883cd962deadb810315debbfaf7af5c13fdcfef.source: An alternative is to join a party with another player who is doing the first-time version of the quest, or with a player whose level is lower than 10.
0883cd962deadb810315debbfaf7af5c13fdcfef.text: 另一種方法是與正在執行第一次版本任務的其他玩家或等級低於 10 的玩家一起加入隊伍。

653358ba455e00bd7f9c6ca02eb57b98155c2170.source: The quest spawns, including Wyle Brimscourge and the Elemental Crystal on level 2, will be overridden if any party members have Long Thought Forgotten or Charr in the Tunnels active in their quest log.
653358ba455e00bd7f9c6ca02eb57b98155c2170.text: 如果任何隊伍成員在其任務日誌中啟動了隧道中的長期思考 被遺忘者 或 夏爾，則任務生成（包括 2 等級的 Wyle Brimscaurge 和 元素生物 水晶）將被覆蓋。

f28fa74ae4a4c680b862eabc654b1b4059f412be.source: If another player in the party has Charr in the Tunnels active, the party can complete that quest by killing all of the Charr Patrol Stalkers, then use the portal back to level 1 to reset the map, enabling access to level 3 without returning to the surface. This makes the run slightly longer, but allows the party to kill three additional charr bosses along the way.
f28fa74ae4a4c680b862eabc654b1b4059f412be.text: 如果隊伍中的另一位玩家在隧道中啟動了 夏爾，則該隊伍可以透過殺死所有 夏爾 巡邏追蹤者來完成該任務，然後使用傳送門返回 1 關卡重置地圖，從而無需返回地面即可進入 3 關卡。這使得執行時間稍微長一些，但允許隊伍沿途殺死三個額外的夏爾老闆。

5db092bd81684460e815cf4e37b20d0709fa49db.source: It is possible to kill Maz Scourgeheart by dealing damage at range (typically with spells such as Fire Storm or Symbol of Wrath or a bow with long enough range) without opening any crystal gate.
5db092bd81684460e815cf4e37b20d0709fa49db.text: 在不開啟任何水晶門的情況下，可以透過在一定範圍內造成傷害（通常使用 火焰風暴 或 神怒之符 等法術或射程足夠長的弓）來殺死馬茲·天災之心。

9c68514125dc756c1efd6a19b02218c78a88a4af.source: Once Maz is killed, the remaining Shard Elementals of the second wave (with the exception of the one carrying the Elemental Keystone) will have a special animation and stop attacking the players. They won't retaliate even when attacked.
9c68514125dc756c1efd6a19b02218c78a88a4af.text: 一旦馬茲被殺死，第二波剩餘的碎片元素（攜帶 元素生物 鑰石的除外）將出現特殊動畫並停止攻擊玩家。即使受到攻擊，他們也不會反擊。

83909e9f3751c88f22c61adfe386d8869b9d9271.source: Travel to Fort Aspenwood and speak to the Luxon Commander.
83909e9f3751c88f22c61adfe386d8869b9d9271.text: 前往 楊木要塞 並與 勒克森 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) 交談。

5616a34b29c956eb57c14aebc707f38938a0f172.source: Leaving from Zos Shivros Channel, head west through Boreas Seabed (explorable area) and Mount Qinkai. Alternatively, you can leave from Cavalon into Archipelagos and through Breaker Hollow.
5616a34b29c956eb57c14aebc707f38938a0f172.text: 從 佐席洛斯水道 出發，向西穿過北風之神海底（可探索區域）和 今凱山。或者，您可以從 卡瓦隆 進入 群島，然後透過 斷崖谷。

3b512ea531d78bbda9f109f96ef8c2eb08d6f044.source: The Kurzick equivalent of this quest is Defend Fort Aspenwood.
3b512ea531d78bbda9f109f96ef8c2eb08d6f044.text: 此任務的 庫茲柯 等效項是保衛 楊木要塞。

3fba9d316fef554c55742d04ed2b6c8f480b760a.source: Push the invading Charr forces back to the Great Northern Wall.
3fba9d316fef554c55742d04ed2b6c8f480b760a.text: 將入侵的 夏爾 部隊趕回北長城。

d9d57d72aa117db650b2b19285da2bd0784da622.source: *BONUS* Rescue Deeter Saberlin from the Charr.
d9d57d72aa117db650b2b19285da2bd0784da622.text: *獎勵* 從 夏爾 中救出 Deeter Saberlin。

39d6b005b7fc50e86acc4ccece877a290f235c3c.source: As per the Fort Ranik mission.

94b5af4e6f89dd98b4df7429c8595aac62531db2.source: Clear the Forum Highlands in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
94b5af4e6f89dd98b4df7429c8595aac62531db2.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 瓦貝 中的 高地廣場。

c89de153fa832573f6218f1886302ad0de371938.source: Keeping the prisoners alive can be quite difficult. First, the prisoners do not follow anyone in particular, instead they tend to follow the party member who is moving most frequently and/or calling targets. Having one member of the party constantly moving to keep the prisoners towards the back of the party is helpful, along with resisting the temptation to call targets as much as possible.
c89de153fa832573f6218f1886302ad0de371938.text: 要讓囚犯活著是相當困難的。首先，囚犯不會特別追蹤任何人，而是傾向於追蹤移動最頻繁和/或呼叫目標的黨員。讓隊伍中的一名成員不斷移動以將囚犯保持在隊伍的後面是有幫助的，同時也能盡可能地抵制呼叫目標的誘惑。

6d2236653d5d86a12c25505cb7d6a81c9c7e6537.source: Bonding the prisoners makes it easier to keep them alive. Also, casting Spell Breaker on Captain Valkyss as he runs from the Tortureweb Dryders is recommended. Summoning Ritualist spirits near the prisoners before talking to them can help distract the enemies while the prisoner gets away.
6d2236653d5d86a12c25505cb7d6a81c9c7e6537.text: 將囚犯束縛起來可以更容易保住他們的性命。另外，建議在 Valkyss 船長從 Tortureweb Dryders 中逃跑時對其施放 魔法粉碎。在與囚犯交談之前在囚犯附近召喚 祭祀者 靈魂可以幫助在囚犯逃跑時分散敵人的注意力。

3a0c961d2350094456bbb9cf2d7b94c56643ed11.source: Kill Fozzy Yeoryios in Sacnoth Valley.
3a0c961d2350094456bbb9cf2d7b94c56643ed11.text: 在 聖諾谷 中殺死 凍 耀爾伊歐。

044b2ad1ecea530e3cf825b40d20e7f920717e4e.source: *BONUS* Kill Fozzy Yeoryios in Hard Mode.
044b2ad1ecea530e3cf825b40d20e7f920717e4e.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 凍 耀爾伊歐。

503904b1a6cef328945d90152aeba70c19f70eee.source: [Incomplete source section] This is a Grawl boss, near the center of Sacnoth Valley. He is surrounded by many Grawl followers. In particular, there are quite a few Grawl Dark Priests in the area, which can keep each other, and Fozzy, alive for a very long time. When coming from Doomlore Shrine it's very easy when you take the siege devourer.
503904b1a6cef328945d90152aeba70c19f70eee.text: [不完整的原始碼部分] 這是一個 穴居人 boss，靠近 聖諾谷 的中心。他周圍有許多 穴居人 追隨者。特別是，該地區有相當多的穴居人黑暗牧師，可以讓對方和Fozzy存活很長一段時間。當你來自 末日傳說神殿 時，拿下攻城吞噬者是非常容易的。

2525726683e4f6555011da983531ed7982f3f81b.text: 在 火星蠅沼澤 中找到 海妲。

ffce35274cf35f3bc694fc5093f101e14ed762b7.source: Clear out the frogmen. You have [3...0] of 3 groups remaining.
ffce35274cf35f3bc694fc5093f101e14ed762b7.text: 清除蛙人。您還剩下 [3...0] 個 3 群組。

ed89b0199145252bb110d4e42cb4c93745f98e17.source: Exit into Sparkfly Swamp. Hayda will be directly north a short walk, you shouldn't need to fight any mobs on the way to get her. The three groups of hekets are to the north, you'll have to clear out some other mobs along with way but none should pose any problem to a full party. Map travel back to Gadd's Encampment for your reward.
ed89b0199145252bb110d4e42cb4c93745f98e17.text: 退出到 火星蠅沼澤。 海妲 就在往北走一小段路的地方，你不需要在路上與任何小怪戰鬥就能得到她。三組赫克特人在北邊，你必須沿途清除一些其他小怪，但不會對整個隊伍造成任何問題。地圖旅行返回 蓋德營區 以獲得獎勵。

9268670c5b6a4fd4cc54a5014772a9e7f9e1e892.source: Consider combining this quest with Finding Gadd, since you will have Hayda as additional support.
9268670c5b6a4fd4cc54a5014772a9e7f9e1e892.text: 考慮將此任務與 尋找蓋德 結合起來，因為您將獲得 海妲 作為額外支援。

7fff62a92e28ff11e2c9a570edce31e18714d509.source: Also consider saving this quest until vanquishing Sparkfly Swamp.
7fff62a92e28ff11e2c9a570edce31e18714d509.text: 也可以考慮儲存這個任務直到擊敗 火星蠅沼澤。

38afd51d1dec6335dcd84b4ac4f7cc43af398dfb.source: Kill Fronis Irontoe in his lair.
38afd51d1dec6335dcd84b4ac4f7cc43af398dfb.text: 在 鐵趾 弗朗尼 的巢穴中殺死他。

1b198461e87f0694fa6d1d307ef14c17b61e0aee.source: *BONUS* Kill Fronis Irontoe in Hard Mode.
1b198461e87f0694fa6d1d307ef14c17b61e0aee.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 鐵趾 弗朗尼。

d0595211e27c77a62c015b99600b6a75356d89ef.source: The easiest way to receive credit for this quest is to receive Kilroy Stonekin's buff, "Kilroy Stonekin", and run past all of the enemies directly to Fronis Irontoe. You can bypass the final blockade by staying to the right side.
d0595211e27c77a62c015b99600b6a75356d89ef.text: 獲得此任務積分的最簡單方法是接收 基羅伊石族 的增益“基羅伊石族”，然後直接跑過所有敵人到達 鐵趾 弗朗尼。您可以透過留在右側來繞過最後的封鎖。

9ab34904a4f599e891af9993d1fcbf2c81373994.source: Alternatively, see the walkthrough at Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!.
9ab34904a4f599e891af9993d1fcbf2c81373994.text: 或者，請參閱 基羅伊石族 的 Punch-Out Extravaganza! 中的演練。

2ae06c38847f65262e132fe7a815b572a7478021.source: It is only possible to enter this dungeon via dialogue in the required quest.
2ae06c38847f65262e132fe7a815b572a7478021.text: 只能透過所需任務中的對話進入該地下城。

10089db8676cd0de899b5b1b0fd2dff60cdca0d4.source: 500 Deldrimor reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon for the first time in normal mode, and 250 points are awarded for subsequent completions. 750 Deldrimor reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon in hard mode for the first time, and 375 points are awarded for subsequent completions.
10089db8676cd0de899b5b1b0fd2dff60cdca0d4.text: 500 戴爾狄摩 聲譽點在正常模式下首次完成該地下城時獲得，250 點在後續完成時獲得。首次在困難模式下完成地下城將獲得 750 戴爾狄摩 聲望點，後續完成將可獲得 375 點。

fb58ef6a816a58883b0158bd866da414f0c80163.source: There is a total of 56 enemies in this dungeon.

b026f16c044ed6045f20a4b5f35f83f0a95da0f8.source: Sometimes Kilroy will run past some enemies. To prevent them from being missed, he sometimes runs back, even when there are no enemies there.
b026f16c044ed6045f20a4b5f35f83f0a95da0f8.text: 有時基爾羅伊會跑過一些敵人。為了防止錯過他們，他有時會跑回去，即使那裡沒有敵人。

b35905d967f3bbbe4c96853d0e226438ed9adb46.source: Although both bosses have an elite skill, neither can be captured because your character's skill set is replaced by the Dwarven Brawler set.
b35905d967f3bbbe4c96853d0e226438ed9adb46.text: 雖然兩個 Boss 都擁有精英技能，但都無法被捕獲，因為你的角色技能集已經被矮人 鬥士傭兵 集取代。

d8f394c4a29355741d5d01da0fe3e55f6e800ccb.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #16 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
d8f394c4a29355741d5d01da0fe3e55f6e800ccb.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#16 頁。

91128dfaf22819ed39f7fed3939703bd80d4a750.source: "Clear the Forum Highlands in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."
91128dfaf22819ed39f7fed3939703bd80d4a750.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 瓦貝 中的 高地廣場。”

aa7b0bd7fbf6015ac069973c7d32686b5ddf9bcc.source: Characters will pass through here out of Vehtendi Valley as part of the primary quest Rally The Princes, on their way to meet with Priestess Haila in the center of the plaza.
aa7b0bd7fbf6015ac069973c7d32686b5ddf9bcc.text: 作為主要任務「集結王子」的一部分，角色將從 巍天帝峽谷 中經過這裡，並在廣場中心與女祭司海拉會面。

61f0e2251e21877df604837fe9477fd150271f06.source: The elemental groups are concentrated towards the south. Their groups, although small, are close to each other. Careful pulling is recommended.
61f0e2251e21877df604837fe9477fd150271f06.text: 元素族集中在南方。他們的群體雖然規模不大，但彼此距離很近。建議小心拉動。

d8ec09ca77f631b9fedbf17dad4e2ce573af3d91.source: The Desperate Measures quest in particular will produce additional Harpy and Heket spawns.
d8ec09ca77f631b9fedbf17dad4e2ce573af3d91.text: 特別是「絕望措施」任務將產生額外的哈比和 青蛙族群 生成點。

458d7de617542dab7be2bc669117e1c3371df9c0.source: The Hekets and Harpies in this area are hostile to each other. After one group wipes another out, take advantage of the winner's weakened state.
458d7de617542dab7be2bc669117e1c3371df9c0.text: 該地區的赫克特人和鷹身女妖彼此敵對。當一組消滅另一組後，利用獲勝者的軟弱狀態。

902c7da2c5dc95e875cdc3e3e698cc868b7cce39.source: Korshek the Immolated can easily wipe out unprepared groups. Protective Spirit and Pain Inverter are highly recommended, as the first will lower his damage output, and the second will reflect the damage back to him. See Korshek the Immolated (Zaishen quest) for additional strategies.
902c7da2c5dc95e875cdc3e3e698cc868b7cce39.text: 宰殺者 科薛克 可以輕鬆消滅毫無準備的團體。強烈推薦 精神守護 和 苦痛 逆變器，因為第一個會降低他的傷害輸出，第二個會將傷害反射回他身上。有關其他策略，請參閱 宰殺者 科薛克（Zaishen 任務）。

8db8c29b97903866ff92955261c6b0e5cec996a8.text: 被遺忘者 囚犯必須生存。

33f7318717bca5f5ba5357e8b8463b93d948d2c7.text: 找到並釋放延扎什將軍。

771bbb1ce78889ad256b1225296ba88c2fca2cde.source: Escape through the back exit to the Foundry.
771bbb1ce78889ad256b1225296ba88c2fca2cde.text: 脫逃 透過後出口到達鑄造廠。

ad87c9c854e0d2eb1a514ca9bb115ae744e3332d.source: Defeat the Black Beast of Arrgh and his minions.
ad87c9c854e0d2eb1a514ca9bb115ae744e3332d.text: 擊敗阿格的黑獸和他的爪牙。

7be11274af4a72fc7f02a16038d10ce21e67888f.source: See General Yendzarsh for your reward.
7be11274af4a72fc7f02a16038d10ce21e67888f.text: 去找延札什將軍領取獎勵。

90eab5b933e5777e1cf9e5116077f90deccc1025.source: After taking this quest, clear the entire Foundry of enemy patrols before attempting to complete the quest objectives. Patrols will consist of Titans, Margonites, Greater Dream Riders and Tortureweb Dryders. Unlike previous rooms, the Foundry itself is spacious and allows for kiting and evading enemies.
90eab5b933e5777e1cf9e5116077f90deccc1025.text: 接受此任務後，先清除整個鑄造廠的敵人巡邏隊，然後再嘗試完成任務目標。巡邏隊將由泰坦、瑪貢尼特、偉大夢想騎士和折磨網乾燥者組成。與以前的房間不同，鑄造廠本身很寬敞，可以放風箏和躲避敵人。

0bf7f9e2b32f0fdac22bb13790115bcb6c5457d4.source: Once the Foundry is cleared, the prisoners can be freed. When speaking to each prisoner, a spawn will appear when choosing the related quest dialog. Captain Valkyss is guarded by Tortureweb Dryders and Greater Dream Riders. Silzesh is guarded by fourteen Dementia Titans and General Yendzarsh is guarded by a mixed group of Titans.
0bf7f9e2b32f0fdac22bb13790115bcb6c5457d4.text: 一旦鑄造廠被清理乾淨，囚犯就可以被釋放。與每個囚犯交談時，選擇相關任務對話方塊時會出現一個重生點。瓦爾基斯船長由酷刑網乾燥者和偉大的夢想騎士看守。西爾澤什（Silzesh）由十四名痴呆泰坦守衛，延扎什將軍（General Yendzarsh）由一群混合泰坦守衛。

5481901859d2f0745475a3a87e3360ab03126fff.source: After all three are freed, the quest marker will point southward. The party should send their tank or puller to the gate. This will trigger the spawn of The Black Beast of Arrgh. He will be accompanied by a small group of Titans. The Beast is a Dervish with a very nasty skill called "Touch of Aaaaarrrrrrggghhh", which will set the target's attributes to zero for 20 seconds. However, it is fairly easy to kill the Beast if the party can offer him a tank who can keep him from laying his touch on other party members.
5481901859d2f0745475a3a87e3360ab03126fff.text: 三個人都被釋放後，任務標記將指向南方。隊伍應將坦克車或拉車員送到門口。這將觸發 黑色野獸 阿爾古 的產生。他將由一小群泰坦陪同。野獸是一個 神喚使，擁有一個非常令人討厭的技能，稱為“Aaaaarrrrrggghhh 之觸”，該技能會將目標的屬性設為零，持續 20 秒。然而，如果隊伍可以為他提供一輛可以阻止他接觸其他隊伍成員的坦克，那麼殺死野獸是相當容易的。

4e35ee04ec0cee3b50f98525e3ad9cf815e5279e.source: After the Beast and his original minions are killed (spawns of the Titans do not count), the quest will be completed and the three prisoners will, thankfully, be removed from the party list.
4e35ee04ec0cee3b50f98525e3ad9cf815e5279e.text: 野獸和他最初的爪牙被殺死後（泰坦的後代不算在內），任務將完成，幸運的是，三名囚犯將從隊伍名單中刪除。

bc5ba053772091d766d3fb9d1cb7aa6da405c2b3.source: Be careful when accepting the quest reward. When you do, The Fury and his minions will spawn at the location indicated on the map - if General Yendzarsh happens to stand there, they will spawn right next to you. Killing those will spawn a Titan Chest (containing Titan Gemstones), open the path to the City of Torc'qua and progress the quest Mallyx the Unyielding. See there for a walkthrough.
bc5ba053772091d766d3fb9d1cb7aa6da405c2b3.text: 接受任務獎勵時要小心。當你這樣做時，狂怒和他的爪牙將在地圖上指示的位置產卵 - 如果 Yendzarsh 將軍恰好站在那裡，他們將在你旁邊產卵。殺死它們會產生 泰坦 寶箱（包含 泰坦 寶石），開啟通往托克誇的 城市 的道路並繼續任務 Mallyx the Unyielding。請參閱此處的演練。

366cc0169c01e178f49d1a97fee13ef336cd008a.source: Greater Dream Riders will follow indefinitely. Separate them from their patrols and then pull them far from the Dryders and then try to destroy them with regular attacks or Lightbringer's Gaze. Avoid using enchantments when engaging them as their Shatter Enchantment will deal a lot of damage when they are "Enraged".
366cc0169c01e178f49d1a97fee13ef336cd008a.text: 偉大的夢想騎士將無限期地跟隨。將他們與巡邏隊分開，然後將他們拉離乾燥者，然後嘗試用常規攻擊或光明使者的凝視摧毀他們。與他們交戰時避免使用結界，因為當他們「激怒」時，他們的 加持粉碎 會造成大量傷害。

8e2acf145c61b9afbaac3f68dff0fa850c3ed354.source: In the hallway, Kilroy will often die, and so will you. Kill them and move on towards the entrance of the boss room.
8e2acf145c61b9afbaac3f68dff0fa850c3ed354.text: 在走廊裡，基爾羅伊常常會死，你也會死。殺掉他們，然後朝boss房間的入口走去。

eefe9c88b042254643a697a72b1f01337e0e92a3.source: Wait for Kilroy to be near you, and move on to the big room. Pull the mobs to the top of the small hill there by the doorway, and unleash a big attack chain at once. If you did this correctly, you will now have aggro and will be defeating the next dwarf. If you are standing on the top of the hill, most of the dwarves will be running in to the middle before running up to you. That means you will fight all the dwarves two versus one, and will be able to finish up the room very quickly. If Kilroy dies, try to continue as long as possible. But if you die, it is very slow to get a good hold on the situation when fighting three versus one all the time. So pull the mobs far away from Kilroy's corpse and resurrect him.
eefe9c88b042254643a697a72b1f01337e0e92a3.text: 等待基爾羅伊靠近你，然後前往大房間。 拉出 將小怪移到門口附近的小山頂上，並立即釋放出巨大的攻擊鏈。如果你正確地做到了這一點，你現在將擁有仇恨並擊敗下一個矮人。如果你站在山頂上，大多數矮人會先跑到中間再跑到你身邊。這意味著你將與所有矮人以二對一的方式戰鬥，並且能夠很快完成房間。如果基爾羅伊死了，請盡可能長時間地繼續下去。但如果你死了，一直打三對一的話，掌控局勢就很慢了。因此，將小怪拉離基爾羅伊的屍體並復活他。

cceeb217c186bc6afe4df2bed535cf228db670b4.source: On the first boss group, Kilroy will almost always start with the far left dwarf. Unleash a big attack chain and kill him first, then kill the second. Kill boss last. If Kilroy dies pull him away. The boss will follow you indefinitely while the other dwarves will move back. Kilroy will not move in to the boss room without you being near him, and he will take care of the returning dwarves in the hallway.
cceeb217c186bc6afe4df2bed535cf228db670b4.text: 在第一個 Boss 組中，基爾羅伊幾乎總是從最左邊的矮人開始。釋放一條巨大的攻擊鏈，先殺死他，再殺死第二個。最後殺掉boss。如果基爾羅伊死了，把他拉走。老闆會無限期地跟隨你，而其他矮人會後退。如果你不在他附近，基爾羅伊不會搬進老闆房間，他會照顧走廊回來的矮人。

e3b56434de5c20a2004d69ecf82af9660d0e84dc.source: In the final boss room, it is perfectly applicable to attack the ettin directly without delay. As long as you pull it a little back so Kilroy starts attacking it earlier, killing it and giving you a health boost. Use knockdowns on Fronis Irontoe instead of the ettin as the ettin is immune to knockdown.
e3b56434de5c20a2004d69ecf82af9660d0e84dc.text: 在最終boss房間裡，完全適用於直接攻擊ettin，毫不拖延。只要你把它拉回來一點，基爾羅伊就會更早開始攻擊它，殺死它並給你帶來生命值提升。使用 鐵趾 弗朗尼 上的擊倒而不是 ettin，因為 ettin 對擊倒免疫。

88236396b58986a5792db8c37ef5184722e3703f.source: When you are fighting 3 or more foes at the same time, let Kilroy attack first and choose the same target as he does. A quick kill provides you with a health bonus and reduces the total damage you take.
88236396b58986a5792db8c37ef5184722e3703f.text: 當你同時與 3 或更多敵人戰鬥時，讓基爾羅伊先攻擊並選擇與他相同的目標。快速擊殺可為您提供生命值加成並減少您受到的總傷害。

1558c6998774a43e097719278bbb6fb8f56c7eec.source: While KO'd and surrounded by several foes, pick the opponent with the lowest HP and use Brawling Combo Punch or Brawling Straight Right as your first attack after standing up. Taking a dwarf down quickly decreases the threats and potential damage against you, gives you an easier route to retreat, and boosts your health.
1558c6998774a43e097719278bbb6fb8f56c7eec.text: 當被擊倒並被多個敵人包圍時，選擇生命值最低的對手，並使用亂鬥組合拳或亂鬥直右作為站立後的第一次攻擊。快速擊倒矮人會減少對你的威脅和潛在傷害，為你提供更輕鬆的撤退路線，並提高你的生命值。

a7c45a2d1f169fc57ba07c16613837983795061c.source: With assassin as one of your professions, maximize dagger mastery. This gives a chance of double strikes, which give extra adrenaline and a little extra damage.
a7c45a2d1f169fc57ba07c16613837983795061c.text: 將刺客作為你的職業之一，最大限度地提高匕首的掌握程度。這提供了雙重打擊的機會，從而提供額外的腎上腺素和一點額外的傷害。

70024dc12dd4e8126cad571dfc75eb5fb3db15f4.source: Your Brawling Combo Punch recharges when you get knocked out. If your energy is low, you can use this to take care of the bosses. However, Lieutenant Mahgma will most likely interrupt it immediately if his Dwarven Battle Stance is active. Instead, use Brawling Block, wait 2-3 seconds, then unleash the combo punch on him.
70024dc12dd4e8126cad571dfc75eb5fb3db15f4.text: 當你被擊倒時，你的爭吵組合拳會重新充電。如果你的精力不足，你可以用它來對付boss。然而，如果 Mahgma 中尉的 矮人戰鬥態勢 處於活動狀態，他很可能會立即中斷它。相反，使用格鬥格擋，等待 2-3 秒，然後對他發動組合拳。

4d18928d080da738d1219d64602a1b33939e216a.source: If Kilroy dies in the room with Lieutenant Mahgma, you can pull the mobs far enough away from him that he self-resurrects. However, this requires that you be under the effects of a consumable-based speed boost (e.g. Rock Candy).
4d18928d080da738d1219d64602a1b33939e216a.text: 如果基爾羅伊和馬格瑪中尉死在房間裡，你可以把小怪拉得離他夠遠，讓他自我復活。然而，這需要你受到基於消耗品的速度提升（例如冰糖）的影響。

deb6057520a801d533df57f65e78a12ccaba6369.text: 生存者 候選者的特殊注意事項

ec484815a31b445495806cd7ab8c19f3a20f9c4e.source: The quest is renowned for its part in easily obtaining the Survivor Title: it is repeatable and death is easily avoided. The following ideas are designed for Survivors, but are generally useful in completing the Dungeon. The quest is riskier for caster professions, with a maximum AR of 60.
ec484815a31b445495806cd7ab8c19f3a20f9c4e.text: 該任務因其輕鬆獲得 生存者 頭銜 而聞名：它是可重複的，並且很容易避免死亡。以下想法是為倖存者設計的，但通常可用於完成 地監。對於施法者職業來說，該任務的風險更大，最大 AR 為 60。

1d5d79c181dd9941c2a8b8162054ff0914b79abb.source: Be sure to use maximum armor.
1d5d79c181dd9941c2a8b8162054ff0914b79abb.text: 一定要使用最大的護甲值。

34b655058ad13af608be43471764b5b978100134.source: There are several useful Insignias and Runes.
34b655058ad13af608be43471764b5b978100134.text: 有幾種有用的徽章和符文。

8e450c7a01fd58842bfb498a1ec098a28ac6dd25.source: Map STAND UP! to more than one key and/or alternate mouse-clicks with the 8 key; this will make it easier to regain your energy quickly, even if you need to recharge it to 140 energy.
8e450c7a01fd58842bfb498a1ec098a28ac6dd25.text: 地圖 站起來！使用 8 鍵進行多個按鍵和/或交替單擊滑鼠；這將使您更容易快速恢復能量，即使您需要將其充電至 140 能量。

e9b30262743f69b560799012a81a366667cfa9a5.source: Sometimes the locked chest will spawn inside a wall. Sometimes Kilroy may get stuck behind the locked chest that has spawned in his way, if you lure a Stone Summit near him he will often get free, otherwise you will have to continue without him. The first Enslaved Ettin doesn't refresh the duration of Scroll of Rampager's Insight, but works properly with Scroll of Berserker's Insight.
e9b30262743f69b560799012a81a366667cfa9a5.text: Sometimes the locked chest will spawn inside a wall.有時基爾羅伊可能會被困在阻礙他前進的鎖著的箱子後面，如果你引誘一個 石峰矮人 靠近他，他通常會獲得自由，否則你將不得不在沒有他的情況下繼續前進。第一款被奴役的雙頭怪不會重新整理Rampager's Insight的卷軸的持續時間，但可以與Berserker's Insight的卷軸正常搭配。

1837e02adcf3165764575d1efa42a89e07bc5fb8.source: Upon entering Fronis Irontoe's Lair, your skills will be replaced with the Brawling build (an extra skill will become available in Hard mode, Brawling Combo Punch). Kilroy Stonekin will fight along side you and use his shout "Kilroy Stonekin". Make your way through the Stone Summit one by one.
1837e02adcf3165764575d1efa42a89e07bc5fb8.text: 進入 鐵趾 佛朗尼的巢穴 後，您的技能將被鬥毆構建所取代（困難模式 中將提供額外技能，鬥毆組合拳）。 基羅伊石族 will fight along side you and use his shout "基羅伊石族". Make your way through the 石峰矮人 one by one.

f24634614fcbdfe43b8e1104082ddd63686b7b17.source: At one point, you'll come across an entire room of Stone Summit, but they only turn hostile two or three at a time. Focus on one target at a time (preferably the same targeted by Kilroy Stonekin), as defeating a foe will refill some of your health. If you are knocked down, use STAND UP! repeatedly until your energy is fully restored. If Kilroy KD'd, he will revive when no foes are around. If you just want to complete the dungeon, you can run all the way to Fronis and punch him down, bypassing the blockade by Lieutenant Mahgma and his companions.
f24634614fcbdfe43b8e1104082ddd63686b7b17.text: 有一次，你會遇到整個房間的 石峰矮人，但他們一次只會對兩三個人產生敵意。 聚能器 一次針對一個目標（最好與 基羅伊石族 的目標相同），因為擊敗敵人會恢復您的部分生命值。如果您被擊倒，請使用“站起來”！如此反覆，直到你的能量完全恢復。如果基爾羅伊被擊殺，他會在周圍沒有敵人的情況下復活。如果你只是想完成地牢，你可以一路跑到弗洛尼斯身邊，把他打倒，繞過馬格瑪中尉和他的同伴的封鎖。

dae94df57b4fce844c1d89eadf2b22d60b50f040.source: At the end of the cave, you will encounter Fronis Irontoe and an Enslaved Ettin. Although you only need to kill Fronis to finish the quest, it is easier if you kill the Ettin first.
dae94df57b4fce844c1d89eadf2b22d60b50f040.text: At the end of the cave, you will encounter 鐵趾 弗朗尼 and an 被奴役的雙頭怪. Although you only need to kill Fronis to finish the quest, it is easier if you kill the 雙頭巨人 first.

27780a646b1ef54d8745fad6f94d9c352b4523c0.source: Keep moving. Killing a foe heals you fast and preserves your adrenaline.
27780a646b1ef54d8745fad6f94d9c352b4523c0.text: 繼續前進。殺死敵人可以快速治癒你並保留你的腎上腺素。

a07adcb9ac4e52c104b37c792bf371d6070c4148.source: Engage a new group with Brawling Uppercut, Brawling Headbutt, or both ready. This takes down their numbers quickly and provides you with healing and adrenaline at the same time.
a07adcb9ac4e52c104b37c792bf371d6070c4148.text: 使用 Brawling Uppercut、Brawling 頭鎚 或兩者準備好與新隊伍交戰。 This takes down their numbers quickly and provides you with healing and adrenaline at the same time.

2dcdb921d168927434c34f64df2b365adb53799b.source: Save Brawling Uppercut for the carvers and crushers. The rangers are merely annoying unless you're already badly injured. Don't waste these powerful skills on foes that are near death.
2dcdb921d168927434c34f64df2b365adb53799b.text: Save Brawling Uppercut for the carvers and crushers. The rangers are merely annoying unless you're already badly injured. Don't waste these powerful skills on foes that are near death.

abf556bf594a6817b3eb729ec485f3d77f9601f7.source: Pack a bow, wand, or staff. As soon as you defeat Lieutenant Mahgma, run for the final encounter. Plink the ettin with your bow until Kilroy catches up to you. This preserves (and builds) your adrenaline for the final encounter.
abf556bf594a6817b3eb729ec485f3d77f9601f7.text: 帶上弓、魔杖或法杖。 As soon as you defeat Lieutenant Mahgma, run for the final encounter.用你的弓敲響埃丁，直到基爾羅伊追上你。 This preserves (and builds) your adrenaline for the final encounter.

dde63d65717bcc1430850f449b788aaaa93c0ddf.source: Any customized Flatbow can be used against the Stone Summit Rangers; although it will deal only 1 damage per hit, the rangers will not retaliate and you can (very slowly) take them down without threat of getting KO'd. If you use a Vampiric Bow, you will do 6 damage per hit.
dde63d65717bcc1430850f449b788aaaa93c0ddf.text: Any customized 平底弓 can be used against the 石峰矮人 Rangers;雖然每次攻擊只會造成 1 傷害，但遊騎兵不會反擊，你可以（非常緩慢地）擊倒他們，而不會受到被擊倒的威脅。如果您使用 吸血鬼 弓，則每次攻擊都會造成 6 傷害。

f0def885feb1b0de829866e1be4578715465b8cd.source: When starting the game, run up near the two first mobs and wait for Kilroy to catch up. Run in front of him and attack them. Save your adrenal attack and double combo punch for the next group.
f0def885feb1b0de829866e1be4578715465b8cd.text: 開始遊戲時，跑到前兩個小怪附近並等待基爾羅伊追上。 跑過 在他面前並攻擊他們。 Save your adrenal attack and double combo punch for the next group.

5e88713056dd1b51e98d6b170f54167d6351d73e.source: When approaching the second group, quickly attack one of the two first melee Stone Summit Dwarves. Unleash your adrenal attacks on him starting with your knockdown. If you knocked him out quickly enough you and Kilroy should have no problems finishing the rest.
5e88713056dd1b51e98d6b170f54167d6351d73e.text: 當接近第二組時，快速攻擊兩個第一近戰 石峰矮人 矮人之一。從你的擊倒開始，向他釋放你的腎上腺攻擊。如果你夠快地擊倒他，你和基爾羅伊應該可以毫無問題地完成剩下的任務。

6fa08f4879d8b60ab68b757a6cfc3927dbd33fe2.source: On the third group, run straight up to the ranger on the far right. Kill him and move on to Ettin. Then run up and kill the three Dwarves in the doorway. Unleashing an adrenal chain here is beneficial.
6fa08f4879d8b60ab68b757a6cfc3927dbd33fe2.text: On the third group, run straight up to the ranger on the far right.殺死他並前往 雙頭巨人。然後跑上去殺掉門口的三個矮人。在這裡釋放腎上腺鏈是有益的。

74605ebfe1647e6cb46b366a5a9cd6e4eb504aff.source: On the fourth group, run towards the dwarf on the right side. Run straight past the wolf and knock him out. Kilroy will follow you, if the other dwarf joins combat, kill him next as that will usually be the target Kilroy attacks. Finish up the wolves.
74605ebfe1647e6cb46b366a5a9cd6e4eb504aff.text: 第四組，跑向右側的矮人。 跑過 直接越過狼並將其擊倒。基爾羅伊會跟隨你，如果另一個矮人加入戰鬥，接下來殺死他，因為那通常是基爾羅伊攻擊的目標。消滅狼群吧

2650217a82e56b2ce4c72f24da4bd68ff636bc4e.source: With full adrenaline, use the following skill chain for a quick kill: Brawling Combo Punch > Brawling Uppercut > Brawling Straight Right.
2650217a82e56b2ce4c72f24da4bd68ff636bc4e.text: 在充滿腎上腺素的情況下，使用以下技能鏈快速擊殺：亂鬥組合拳 > 亂鬥上勾拳 > 亂鬥直右。

bfb43cca38ec8a308a12e39a0ee07bad17016837.source: Use extreme caution when resigning. You can die a real death (losing progress towards the Survivor title) if you resign while knocked out or if you get knocked out before the game acknowledges your resignation. Try to reach a safe area and map out instead (your Guild Hall is usually the easiest place to reach, using the default keyboard shortcut of [G]).
bfb43cca38ec8a308a12e39a0ee07bad17016837.text: 辭職時要格外小心。如果您在被淘汰時辭職或在遊戲確認您辭職之前被淘汰，您可能會真正死亡（失去 生存者 標題的進度）。嘗試到達安全區域並繪製地圖（您的 公會大廳 通常是最容易到達的地方，使用預設鍵盤快速鍵 [G]）。

824cbfcf784abdd83acce625b52a062a38284073.source: As you pass the allied dwarf, strafing to the left can cause any pursuers to get body blocked by the allied dwarves. This is also a common place for rubberbanding (using /stuck is handy to make sure you got between dwarf and wall)
824cbfcf784abdd83acce625b52a062a38284073.text: 當你經過矮人盟軍時，向左掃射可能會導致任何追擊者的身體被矮人盟軍擋住。這也是橡皮筋的常見位置（使用 /stuck 可以輕鬆確保你位於矮人和牆壁之間）

9ae32ac0fed19de5db42be56d9a1f269168e7c5f.source: The final room contains only Fronis Irontoe and an Enslaved Ettin. At this point Kilroy's shout will have expired but it should not be problematic to kill Fronis without it.
9ae32ac0fed19de5db42be56d9a1f269168e7c5f.text: 最後一間房間僅包含 鐵趾 弗朗尼 和 被奴役的雙頭怪。此時基爾羅伊的喊叫聲將會消失，但沒有它殺死弗羅尼斯應該不成問題。

0998043b8c1ef9d29f5519281f2cf9f692e23236.source: Ignore the ettin; it cannot be knocked down and does not need to be killed to cause Irontoe's Chest to spawn.
0998043b8c1ef9d29f5519281f2cf9f692e23236.text: 忽略ettin；它無法被擊倒，也不需要被殺死才能導致 最終寶箱 生成。

6fe1d7cb68aeb4badb928aea05014d958292d77b.source: It is probable that you get 'knocked out' once or twice during this fight.
6fe1d7cb68aeb4badb928aea05014d958292d77b.text: 在這場戰鬥中，你很可能會被「擊倒」一兩次。

9b59f1c32759a14eb61cfb94b1b1de654d8c425f.text: 要最小化執行之間的時間：

5d9b5abbeff09f94944d498000ac5173cbc91293.source: Map travel to Gunnar's Hold after you have looted Irontoe's Chest.
5d9b5abbeff09f94944d498000ac5173cbc91293.text: 搶劫 最終寶箱 後，將旅行對應到 甘拿的佔領地。

5740b1321792a4d8fd0f39666814a3a08df46b9f.source: Accept the quest reward from Kilroy.
5740b1321792a4d8fd0f39666814a3a08df46b9f.text: 接受基爾羅伊的任務獎勵。

76b60353c6d49bcfc5549806592c447dbab6afa9.source: Kilroy is vulnerable to the archers past the second door; try to pull them out of the hallway so that he can survive longer. Similarly, pull the next set of enemies into the archers' now-empty area, so that you need only fight a few at a time. If you find yourself overwhelmed, run away; the dwarves will return to their original positions while you take time to heal.
76b60353c6d49bcfc5549806592c447dbab6afa9.text: 基爾羅伊很容易受到穿過第二扇門的弓箭手的攻擊；試著把他們拉出走廊，這樣他就能活得更久。同樣，將下一組敵人拉到弓箭手現在空出的區域，這樣你一次只需要與幾個敵人戰鬥。如果你發現自己不知所措，就逃跑；當你需要時間治療時，矮人會回到原來的位置。

02fba4c92b7c17449dde2abd106e8359af4eeb2f.source: Treasure Hunters should enter the dungeon in normal mode, grab the loot from the locked chest, and zone out quickly, avoiding any fighting at all.
02fba4c92b7c17449dde2abd106e8359af4eeb2f.text: 寶藏獵人應該以正常模式進入地牢，從上鎖的箱子中取出戰利品，然後迅速撤離，避免任何戰鬥。

0328ccf1f5680b9290f7513cd580ecedbca705d4.source: To quickly repeat the quest, you can rezone or switch districts after accepting the reward.
0328ccf1f5680b9290f7513cd580ecedbca705d4.text: 為了快速重複任務，您可以在接受獎勵後重新分割槽或切換區域。

bbdf9cdc9e61fc6e036a0550991e97f22a2e6f54.source: There are several differences between Normal and Hard modes:
bbdf9cdc9e61fc6e036a0550991e97f22a2e6f54.text: 普通模式和困難模式之間有幾個區別：

f2a367015014950d78132b0d882f50b074fdfe36.source: The dwarves have 80 health in normal mode and 200 in hard mode.
f2a367015014950d78132b0d882f50b074fdfe36.text: 矮人在正常模式下擁有 80 生命值，在困難模式下擁有 200 生命值。

80573053f8f32c1c58d0e671555a766701751402.source: You have 500 health in NM and 600 in HM.
80573053f8f32c1c58d0e671555a766701751402.text: 您在 NM 擁有 500 健康狀況，在 HM 中擁有 600 健康狀況。

bde6b3696f5722d3e46a687d4bf58b705297dfcd.source: When a foe dies, you gain 200 health in NM and 300 in HM.
bde6b3696f5722d3e46a687d4bf58b705297dfcd.text: 當敵人死亡時，您在 NM 中獲得 200 生命值，在 HM 中獲得 300 生命值。

48048ec4845fa69f20e7e577364a7fb2cc841ef5.source: In HM, the rangers use Broad Head Arrow if you have a caster weapon equipped.
48048ec4845fa69f20e7e577364a7fb2cc841ef5.text: 在 HM 中，如果你裝備了施法者武器，遊騎兵會使用 闊首箭。

2c4dea907f17c67b45ab1916317b686eec39051e.source: If Kilroy does more damage to an enemy, you will gain experience, but any experience scroll effects will not be renewed.
2c4dea907f17c67b45ab1916317b686eec39051e.text: 如果基爾羅伊對敵人造成更多傷害，你將獲得經驗，但任何經驗捲軸效果都不會更新。

6411f2a987ea6e867641b349013ea6484db1c48f.source: Standard attacks don't affect you, only skills.
6411f2a987ea6e867641b349013ea6484db1c48f.text: 標準攻擊不會影響你，只會影響你的技能。

b04a0987722abf45fdb9bcef0d04945466c24da4.source: Kilroy is affected by standard attacks.
b04a0987722abf45fdb9bcef0d04945466c24da4.text: 基爾羅伊受到標準攻擊的影響。

a6196cc59284da9f12b303bdd3a1d5d0641e73f8.source: Kilroy does not gain +200/300 health after a monster is killed, so to keep him alive, make sure you lead the way.
a6196cc59284da9f12b303bdd3a1d5d0641e73f8.text: 殺死怪物後，基爾羅伊不會獲得 +200/300 生命值，因此為了讓他活下去，請確保你在前面帶路。

712fcf4faf4da6ee404f7c7aeb172b13c68b31aa.source: This quest is a reasonable way to earn money quickly: assuming you identify and sell everything, you should expect to earn 1 — 31 platinum per run.
712fcf4faf4da6ee404f7c7aeb172b13c68b31aa.text: 這個任務是一種快速賺錢的合理方式：假設你辨識並出售所有東西，你應該期望每次執行都能賺取 1 — 31 白金。

75f57f031998e516ea5043593d85fe4b7667006e.source: As with other solo quests, you may not use summoning stones.
75f57f031998e516ea5043593d85fe4b7667006e.text: 就像其他單人任務一樣，你不能使用召喚石。

fda1038feef6d6c3a37579755d9a3a232768c439.source: You can repeat this quest to level up heroes if you add them into your party before accepting the quest reward.
fda1038feef6d6c3a37579755d9a3a232768c439.text: 如果您在接受任務獎勵之前將英雄新增到您的隊伍中，則可以重複此任務來升級英雄。

bb5e73dad0b76da037eb68166b394b2c818d7b6e.source: During special events, you have the same chances of getting special drops as anywhere else.
bb5e73dad0b76da037eb68166b394b2c818d7b6e.text: 在特殊活動期間，您與其他地方一樣有機會獲得特殊掉落物。

009f1578cea4c0b21745b89faea0d9461555591c.source: If you resign after opening the dungeon chest, you will receive a note stating that you failed the quest. However, you still be able to collect the reward from Kilroy.
009f1578cea4c0b21745b89faea0d9461555591c.text: 如果您在開啟地牢寶箱後辭職，您將收到一條說明您任務失敗的訊息。不過，您仍然可以從基爾羅伊那裡領取獎勵。

dd4319bfc1db5aabc1655706431c2f6776d434d8.source: If one levels up while knocked down (e.g. because Kilroy kills an enemy) STAND UP! has no effect and you will be kicked out of the dungeon. Unfortunately, this counts as a death towards a Survivor title — be sure to map out of the dungeon if this happens.
dd4319bfc1db5aabc1655706431c2f6776d434d8.text: 如果一個人在被擊倒時升級（例如因為基爾羅伊殺死了一名敵人），請站起來！沒有效果，你會被踢出地牢。不幸的是，這對 生存者 遊戲來說算是死亡——如果發生這種情況，請務必繪製出地牢的地圖。

66251911e8916b2dcc0fb6e43fda0caf30099770.source: As in other areas, locked chests can spawn inside a wall. Should you be able to open the chest but cannot pick up the loot, complete the dungeon and wait 3 minutes for the game to return you to Gunnar's Hold. The item will then appear in the Unclaimed Items window.
66251911e8916b2dcc0fb6e43fda0caf30099770.text: 與其他區域一樣，上鎖的箱子可以在牆內生成。如果您能夠開啟寶箱但無法拾取戰利品，請完成地牢並等待 3 分鐘，讓遊戲將您返回 甘拿的佔領地。該專案隨後將出現在「無人認領的專案」視窗中。

b6a2f46552b04edaa97690a69bea07b35853bbe5.source: Sometimes Kilroy may get stuck on a chest that has spawned in his way, if you lure a Stone Summit near him he will often get free, otherwise you will have to continue without him.
b6a2f46552b04edaa97690a69bea07b35853bbe5.text: 有時基爾羅伊可能會被卡在阻礙他前進的箱子上，如果你引誘一個 石峰矮人 靠近他，他通常會獲得自由，否則你將不得不在沒有他的情況下繼續前進。

3284134f802ae8a4e318e3c31257560364c6ccc1.source: Search the Eastern Frontier and Pockmark Flats for Footman Tate and Footman Quinn. Bring them to justice.
3284134f802ae8a4e318e3c31257560364c6ccc1.text: 在 東方邊境 和 麻點平原 中搜尋 Footman Tate 和 步兵坤意。將他們繩之以法。

291be8b1c38597443d0874d5eb025d3fc5381e90.source: Footman Tate surrendered. Lead him back to the Frontier Gate.
291be8b1c38597443d0874d5eb025d3fc5381e90.text: 步兵泰特投降了。帶他回到 邊境關所。

623a2771e93d4088c0793fdf612e6888c2cc189e.source: Return to Warmaster Riga for your reward.
623a2771e93d4088c0793fdf612e6888c2cc189e.text: 影返 至 戰鬥教官萊加 以獲得獎勵。

e4a6cd552ef33bfa26f7540c2531b377457a650d.text: 穿刺傷害：11-18（需 3 弓術精通）

6fd3492aa4feb741423ac022530c333a845cd207.source: Halves Skill Recharge of Spells (10% chance)
6fd3492aa4feb741423ac022530c333a845cd207.text: 技能 法術充能減半（10% 機會）

9e6701c195de03b8e73ef9abe034398ba84b2025.source: The Jeweled Chakram has what would normally be the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chalice. Conversely, the quest A Mission of Peace rewards a Jeweled Chalice with the skin and attribute of a Jeweled Chakram.
9e6701c195de03b8e73ef9abe034398ba84b2025.text: 寶石的圓月輪 具有 寶石聖杯 通常的外觀和屬性。相反，任務 和平任務 會獎勵具有 寶石的圓月輪 皮膚和屬性的 寶石聖杯。

2e32a6e036989c1d459cee86d412cd5a83d79afd.source: To get to Footman Tate, travel southeast from the Frontier Gate. You'll encounter some Devourers along the way as they pop out of the ground, but if you take them a group at a time, you'll have no problems defeating them. The path will curve around east and then veer northeast after the collector, then turn sharply back towards the south. Keep following the path and hug the wall (being careful not to aggro the Devourers on top of the plateau). Round the corner and head northeast in the chasm before tapering off east. Round the corner south and climb the small knoll. A group of Devourers may be waiting for you, but they're not too tough. Defeat them, and speak with Footman Tate (location marked by the green indicator on the first map).
2e32a6e036989c1d459cee86d412cd5a83d79afd.text: To get to Footman Tate, travel southeast from the 邊境關所.一路上你會遇到一些從地下冒出來的 蠍，但如果你一次帶他們一組，打敗他們就不會有問題。路徑將向東彎曲，然後在收集器之後轉向東北，然後急劇轉向南方。繼續沿著小路走並緊貼牆壁（小心不要激怒高原頂部的 蠍）。 Round the corner and head northeast in the chasm before tapering off east. Round the corner south and climb the small knoll. A group of 蠍 may be waiting for you, but they're not too tough.擊敗他們，並與步兵塔特上的

3d71d8b11648a69888b7d14c01ebf7683c856a80.source: If you choose the conversation choices "Don't make me kill you" or "If you run, I'll find you," he'll simply respond with "I don't know what to do. This is all very confusing." He'll agree to follow you if you tell him that "everything will be all right." Simply reverse the path you took to get to him and escort him back to the Frontier Gate.
3d71d8b11648a69888b7d14c01ebf7683c856a80.text: 如果你選擇對話選項“別讓我殺了你”或“如果你逃跑，我會找到你”，他只會簡單地回答“我不知道該怎麼辦。這一切都非常令人困惑。” He'll agree to follow you if you tell him that "everything will be all right." Simply to path." Simply to path elect to elect y好嗎 到 文章." Simply to path. 邊境關所.

3149cc6690e3dac76c5460840aef697f30fcb2ea.source: It's quicker to reach Footman Quinn by departing from Fort Ranik. Travel south and walk under the aqueduct/series of arches. You'll encounter some Renegades and some Charr (depending on what quests you have active), but they're relatively easy to take care of. Some Devourers may pop up from the ground, but defeat them and head east. Walk through the zone to Pockmark Flats.
3149cc6690e3dac76c5460840aef697f30fcb2ea.text: It's quicker to reach 步兵坤意 by departing from Fort Ranik. Travel south and walk under the aqueduct/series of arches.你會遇到一些叛徒和一些 夏爾（取決於你啟動的任務），但他們相對容易處理。 Some 蠍 may pop up from the ground, but defeat them and head east.穿過該區域到達 麻點平原。

bc0811a515473c3780a0dcc436eb4c5bfe96c3e4.source: Once you're in Pockmark Flats, head east and follow the path. You'll encounter a Crimson Devourer or two along with some Flash and Shatter Gargoyles and perhaps a Storm Rider or two. Head north until you reach the aqueduct/series of arches and head east, following the structure. You may have to fight some Wind Riders, Hulking Stone Elementals, and a Stone Elemental, but fight the Riders and the Elementals separately and you shouldn't have too much of a problem. Stick with the path and follow it southeast. You'll reach a point where you can take the first path north, but keep heading down until you reach the shoreline and follow that north. You'll have to follow a winding path up northeast, but after you crest the hill, Footman Quinn will be waiting for you (the green indicator on the second map). Alternatively, you can travel south from Serenity Temple through Pockmark Flats.
bc0811a515473c3780a0dcc436eb4c5bfe96c3e4.text: Once you're in 麻點平原, head east and follow the path. You'll encounter a Crimson 蠍 or two along with some Flash and Shatter Gargoyles and perhaps a 暴風駕馭者 or two。你可能需要與一些風騎者、巨石元素和 石元素 戰鬥，但分別與騎手和元素戰鬥，你應該不會有太大問題。沿著小路一直走，然後朝東南方向走。 You'll reach a point where you can take the first path north, but keep heading down until you reach the shoreline and follow that north.你必須沿著一條蜿蜒的小路向東北方向走，但當你爬上山頂後，步兵坤意 就會在等著你（第二張地圖上的綠色指示器）。 Alternatively, you can travel south from 寧靜神殿 through 麻點平原.

087b148f4e15f17feb31f22af2aaecec250167f9.source: Once you kill him, map back to the Frontier Gate to get your reward from Warmaster Riga.
087b148f4e15f17feb31f22af2aaecec250167f9.text: Once you kill him, map back to the 邊境關所 to get your reward from 戰鬥教官萊加.

5e5e4455b58468913c7896b3d0eb8606e3cce9f9.source: Footman Tate will continue to spawn in the Eastern Frontier even after you lead him back to the Frontier Gate.
5e5e4455b58468913c7896b3d0eb8606e3cce9f9.text: 即使您將步兵塔特帶回 邊境關所，他也會繼續在 東方邊境 中生成。

dfdc21dc65bdf5134e77403639fd343031834ed0.source: Kill Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Frostmaw's Burrows.
dfdc21dc65bdf5134e77403639fd343031834ed0.text: 在 凍霜地道 中殺死 凍擊 弒族者。

8bbb8d87a7a6d1d309f80a9e6c40282768a6981d.source: *BONUS* Kill Frostmaw the Kinslayer in Hard Mode.
8bbb8d87a7a6d1d309f80a9e6c40282768a6981d.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 凍擊 弒族者。

4587117902052b822d0e693c6b0f84d4e051c8bd.source: Without the required quest, you cannot pass the door to the staircase next to the Inscribed Stone.
4587117902052b822d0e693c6b0f84d4e051c8bd.text: Without the required quest, you cannot pass the door to the staircase next to the Inscribed Stone.

21525bd93d9a930714f744d1dd3f47e274216f6b.source: The number of ice boulders increases in Hard mode.
21525bd93d9a930714f744d1dd3f47e274216f6b.text: 困難模式 中冰塊的數量增加。

b0beb0d09621edd8414758885c1900d42ca2e5f9.source: Particularly on level 5, in Normal mode it is void of all enemies and traps before the final chamber with the wurms.
b0beb0d09621edd8414758885c1900d42ca2e5f9.text: 特別是在 5 關卡，在 普通模式 中，在有亞龍的最後一個房間之前沒有所有敵人和陷阱。

5502f42ddf40285a71de7b299cff5cf3bae81f63.source: You can reduce the number of normal mode runs to 104 runs using Scrolls of Adventurer's Insight.
5502f42ddf40285a71de7b299cff5cf3bae81f63.text: 您可以使用冒險家洞察捲軸將正常模式運作次數減少到 104 運作次數。

3edbf4562d2c7ad711607d5a1f8a9f04f2429183.source: The most cost-efficient choice is a Scroll of Berserker's Insight, if you can make it last until you kill Lieutenant Mahgma.
3edbf4562d2c7ad711607d5a1f8a9f04f2429183.text: 最具成本效益的選擇是狂戰士洞察力的 卷軸，如果你能讓它持續到你殺死 Mahgma 中尉。

ff69c791f156edcff29421e24091426f5a0cc20a.source: Since experience gain is capped at 300% in hard mode, there is no additional value in paying for scrolls offering more than a 250% XP bonus from kills.
ff69c791f156edcff29421e24091426f5a0cc20a.text: 由於在困難模式下獲得的經驗值上限為 300%，因此支付捲軸所帶來的額外價值不會超過擊殺帶來的 250% XP 獎勵。

7bc2c69a2292cd5cbbd062d237425327a46d043a.source: You cannot use more than one scroll at a time.
7bc2c69a2292cd5cbbd062d237425327a46d043a.text: 您一次不能使用多個捲軸。

50a95a899b4563ba2905ce3e2e5501014cba1c55.text: 用於農業 最終寶箱

39329ee69532e76d31a99076d30c7a20e60d3a4f.source: You can farm this dungeon without killing any mobs except for Fronis Irontoe.
39329ee69532e76d31a99076d30c7a20e60d3a4f.text: 除了 鐵趾 弗朗尼 之外，你可以在不殺死任何生物的情況下耕種這個地下城。

8a1a6178d8aa834cf6123d0ef9d13ed8b5be7ce2.source: As soon as you zone into the lair start running towards the group of four dwarves (two archers, two melee) at the exit to the first room. Before you arrive at the dwarves Kilroy will use his shout, increasing your movement speed - this will allow you pass between the two archers and proceed into the second room.
8a1a6178d8aa834cf6123d0ef9d13ed8b5be7ce2.text: 一旦你進入巢穴，就開始跑向第一個房間出口處的四名矮人（兩名弓箭手，兩名近戰者）。在你到達矮人之前，基爾羅伊會使用他的喊聲，增加你的移動速度 - 這將允許你穿過兩個弓箭手之間並進入第二個房間。

93285ad80b21e4b063a8637bb4ef36f277046d18.source: In the second room run slightly to the right of the archer. The three melee dwarves will begin to run towards the exit but if you continue running past the archer you will overtake them and enter the third room before they arrive. If you target the archer he will use one of these three tactics: take no shots and run past and then follow you a short bit, use Point Blank Shot then stand around, or use Marauder's Shot and take 1-2 more shots, possibly including Point Blank shot. Use Brawling Block to block as many attacks as needed.
93285ad80b21e4b063a8637bb4ef36f277046d18.text: 在第二個房間裡，跑到弓箭手的右邊。三個近戰矮人將開始向出口跑去，但如果你繼續跑過弓箭手，你將超越他們並在他們到達之前進入第三個房間。如果你瞄準弓箭手，他將使用以下三種戰術之一：不射擊並跑過去，然後跟著你一小段，使用 近距弓射 然後站在周圍，或使用 掠奪者射擊 並進行 1-2 多次射擊，可能包括近距離射擊。使用爭吵封鎖來阻止盡可能多的攻擊。

da34d545ab48ca7b0444c05af869320bf2d7b222.source: The third room is relatively straightforward; run past the wolf and melee dwarf, and between the two melee dwarves at the exit to the room.
da34d545ab48ca7b0444c05af869320bf2d7b222.text: 第三個房間相對簡單；跑過狼和近戰矮人，以及房間出口處的兩個近戰矮人之間。

a97788878dc4e84d2fcbaaf9341c04bce2906cf1.source: It is very easy to rubberband if you have any latency when attempting to exit this room. To help avoid rubberbanding avoid getting into melee range with the dwarves for as long as possible.
a97788878dc4e84d2fcbaaf9341c04bce2906cf1.text: 如果您在嘗試退出此房間時出現任何延遲，則很容易使用橡皮筋。為了避免橡皮筋，請盡可能長時間地避免與矮人進入近戰範圍。

3d8823d7f9eba2a6acb20598752a9aaa0c177edf.source: The archers in the fourth room can cause a significant amount of damage and it is not uncommon to be 'knocked out' near the exit to this room. Hugging the left wall will minimize the time you are in this room and in range of the archers and Brawling Block can be used to negate some of the damage.
3d8823d7f9eba2a6acb20598752a9aaa0c177edf.text: 第四個房間中的弓箭手可以造成大量傷害，並且在該房間出口附近被「擊倒」的情況並不少見。擁抱左牆將最大限度地減少你在這個房間和弓箭手射程內的時間，並且可以使用爭吵塊來抵消一些傷害。

bd99e60fbe82eee9d2adb64cff3ea06acb4b885b.source: There is also a patrol of two melee dwarves in this room (not marked on the map.)
bd99e60fbe82eee9d2adb64cff3ea06acb4b885b.text: 這個房間裡還有兩個近戰矮人巡邏隊（地圖上沒有標示。）

329b574bd429537f4758049604e2b5be342f27d8.source: The following room (number five) can be bypassed by passing on the right side of the rightmost allied dwarf near the exit.
329b574bd429537f4758049604e2b5be342f27d8.text: 接下來的房間（五號）可以通過靠近出口的最右邊的盟友矮人的右側繞過。

8a81f0aea84b761ed2b3490ff4612055f87376b6.source: On the fifth level, a Locked Chest always spawns after defeating the initial three Wurms in Frostmaw's area.
8a81f0aea84b761ed2b3490ff4612055f87376b6.text: 在第五層，在擊敗霜喉區域的最初三隻亞龍後，總是會產生鎖定的 寶箱。

2300d9a543335005d7bdf8de604406fd2a59ace0.source: This dungeon is rich in Light of Deldrimor treasures; see the talk page for details.
2300d9a543335005d7bdf8de604406fd2a59ace0.text: 這個地牢裡有豐富的戴爾狄摩之光寶藏；詳情請參閱討論頁。

c8b7a05898dc904b263705d1f87fb2ef7d4a7a31.source: Four Norn allies will participate in combat; they are tanky, especially while they are in Bear Form.
c8b7a05898dc904b263705d1f87fb2ef7d4a7a31.text: 四位 諾恩 盟友將參與戰鬥；它們很矮，尤其是在熊形態下。

7f5659344d8a725c5789da71b94bdaba36df481c.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #6 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
7f5659344d8a725c5789da71b94bdaba36df481c.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#6 頁。

9524392101cc9609d7dc180da14900782bcd13d5.source: Clear the Frozen Forest in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
9524392101cc9609d7dc180da14900782bcd13d5.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的南席娃山脈中的冰凍森林。

c1c57cb5e9daa99d01451e89e1a93a99558ee2f2.source: "Clear the Frozen Forest in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
c1c57cb5e9daa99d01451e89e1a93a99558ee2f2.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的南席娃山脈中的冰凍森林。”

229ddb4ed8397f25900d7e776657a1a5449ce4f8.source: The Hero's Challenge quest will affect the spawns in this area.
229ddb4ed8397f25900d7e776657a1a5449ce4f8.text: 英雄的挑戰 任務將影響該區域的產生點。

9636c6a1a2f4a4254877c753c4e628e03eff1949.source: Complete exploration of this area adds over 1.6% towards the Tyrian Cartographer title.
9636c6a1a2f4a4254877c753c4e628e03eff1949.text: 對這一領域的完整探索將 1.6% 新增到 Tyrian 版圖 標題中。

41bd979cd438b7218ba255b7375f05618297c816.source: There are a small number of Jade constructs in the southeastern corner; they have a long patrol route, so can be easily missed.
41bd979cd438b7218ba255b7375f05618297c816.text: 東南角有少量玉石建築；他們的巡邏路線很長，很容易被錯過。

f10f8b17e1814b750f272ea5d0c84be69b8b96de.source: There are hidden Azure Shadows in the northwestern section of this area.
f10f8b17e1814b750f272ea5d0c84be69b8b96de.text: 該區域的西北部隱藏著蔚藍之影。

1d5603ea841a894027f4c750ee94d4e14518d029.source: Henchmen from Thunderhead Keep and Marhan's Grotto are infused and can enter the area from Ice Floe in the southeast corner of the map.
1d5603ea841a894027f4c750ee94d4e14518d029.text: 雷雲要塞和馬翰洞穴中的傭兵被注入，可以從地圖東南角的浮冰進入該區域。

894e9ff402be826d973e29ba6b1c62158dfb6701.source: Henchmen from Copperhammer Mines and Iron Mines of Moladune are not infused. There are not many groups of Jades on this map, each having only 3-4 in number, so the concern on infusion is minimal.
894e9ff402be826d973e29ba6b1c62158dfb6701.text: 銅錘礦坑 和 莫拉登礦山 中的 傭兵 未註入。這張地圖上的玉石群不多，每組玉石的數量只有3-4，所以對輸注的擔憂很小。

a4c13953f23466d52edda30de81e40dc01c8fc9e.text: 在 洛天帝沼澤 中認識 Rohtu。

f89d0be861eb8851e6e68877d5780089db2af09b.source: Help Rohtu track down and kill the corsairs who killed his mother.
f89d0be861eb8851e6e68877d5780089db2af09b.text: 幫助羅圖追蹤並殺死殺害他母親的海盜。

7d37d24d4563aae04030fbf9372bc87b85737ce7.source: Exit Blacktide Den into Lahtenda Bog and speak to Rohtu to have him follow you and head south until you find the Corsairs. Defeat them and Rohtu will run to the corpse of his mother and grieve. When he's done, speak to him to collect your reward.
7d37d24d4563aae04030fbf9372bc87b85737ce7.text: 離開 Blacktide Den 進入 洛天帝沼澤 並與 Rohtu 交談，讓他跟隨你並向南行駛，直到找到海盜。擊敗他們，羅圖就會跑到他母親的屍體旁並悲傷。當他完成後，與他交談以領取獎勵。

59737819f34ac1ac6104b3b66fe917dfea65b849.source: Defend the G.O.L.E.M. kilns and destroy the Destroyer hive outside Rata Sum.
59737819f34ac1ac6104b3b66fe917dfea65b849.text: 保衛 G.O.L.E.M.窯並摧毀 洛達頂點 外的毀滅者蜂巢。

a639721550ee4158e3bc2c7734ab1374a4ea20a9.source: Must not have Goren as one of your heroes.
a639721550ee4158e3bc2c7734ab1374a4ea20a9.text: 不得將 高恩 作為您的英雄之一。

8fef160bd1b96099aff64bfaf1d594f1eefd4216.source: Must not have Goren's Stuff: Part 1 active.
8fef160bd1b96099aff64bfaf1d594f1eefd4216.text: 不得使 高恩 的內容：1 部分處於作用中狀態。

74d5414779e95ae43e255066c925bffdc28f2138.source: Release Goren from his debt to Prince Bokka the Magnificent.
74d5414779e95ae43e255066c925bffdc28f2138.text: 解除 高恩 對博卡王子的債務。

5753ab4d4dda79a9b88556f4982480093cd523a2.text: 高恩 加入您的隊伍。

7cacd62ae16f701c247c366c3b68154e66003667.source: Exit the Throne of Secrets and head to Honur Hill. Head south into Resplendent Makuun and find Prince Bokka the Magnificent.
7cacd62ae16f701c247c366c3b68154e66003667.text: 退出 神秘王座 並前往 霍奴爾丘陵。向南前往輝煌的馬庫恩，找到偉大的博卡王子。

1bdfa78e641431e0522812f8a318fd2cb6dd6f6b.source: Only available if you hadn't recruited Jin yet.
1bdfa78e641431e0522812f8a318fd2cb6dd6f6b.text: 僅當您尚未招募 Jin 時才可用。

f30781f2041f55dd1b745b0ba38bc5c50f00055b.source: Speak to Field General Hayao and formally accept Jin's oath of service.
f30781f2041f55dd1b745b0ba38bc5c50f00055b.text: 與隼雄將軍交談並正式接受金恩的服役誓言。

678e433622e1dcdf5e53744ee6ae2c82f5f4556e.text: 侍從 靜 加入您的隊伍。

c971c033133baf58e136eecec28b461bf7cae78e.source: Switch districts (switch to International from your district, or vice-versa, if there is only one local district.) or return to the character selection screen and select the same character again (F12, c, space/enter).
c971c033133baf58e136eecec28b461bf7cae78e.text: 切換地區（從您所在的地區切換到國際，或者反之亦然，如果只有一個當地地區。）或返回到字元選擇螢幕並再次選擇相同的字元（F12，c，空格/回車）。

4af835d845953df07805ea32fb64a1b1ff789866.source: Speak to Kilroy, accept the quest, and enter the Lair.
4af835d845953df07805ea32fb64a1b1ff789866.text: 與基爾羅伊交談，接受任務，然後進入巢穴。

ef081868e76577873c76d0863de28a8206ecada7.source: In hard mode this run takes around ten minutes. Rewards:
ef081868e76577873c76d0863de28a8206ecada7.text: 在困難模式下，此執行大約需要十分鐘。 任務獎勵：

da67515b8ade7673306e47516f6a1180013e55ad.source: 2 Aged Dwarven Ale, 2 Dwarven Ale or one of each
da67515b8ade7673306e47516f6a1180013e55ad.text: 2 老化 矮人啤酒、2 矮人啤酒 或其中之一

51e83f6a82d317f84736df627883d7586e46599a.source: Adding 5x Stalwart Insignias gives you an additional AR +10 against physical damage. If you are having trouble, you can use an Armor of Salvation, Drake Kabobs, Skalefin Soup, or War Supplies.
51e83f6a82d317f84736df627883d7586e46599a.text: 新增 5x 堅定徽章可為您提供額外的 AR +10 來抵禦物理傷害。如果您遇到問題，可以使用 Salvation 的 防禦、龍獸 烤肉串、Skalefin Soup 或 戰備物資。

121aadb02b876827d23b5dd7c035e7a59c147259.source: Regardless of your primary profession, ensure that you set your Dagger Mastery to at least 9.
121aadb02b876827d23b5dd7c035e7a59c147259.text: 無論您的主要職業是什麼，請確保將 匕首精通 至少設定為 9。

c5d803fbee47ebb3e0a65cc7ac5d91b73c6282c7.source: You can apply useful mods to Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles:
c5d803fbee47ebb3e0a65cc7ac5d91b73c6282c7.text: 您可以對 Thunderfist 的指節銅套應用有用的模組：

45ea013d11f82be7b4b972f27e50adf3978d0b3e.source: Dagger Tangs: Sundering (for armor penetration), Furious (to recharge Brawling skills more quickly)
45ea013d11f82be7b4b972f27e50adf3978d0b3e.text: 匕首唐：分離（用於護甲穿透），狂怒（用於更快地恢復格鬥技能）

4a231072d59255e064596ea8e86280030b52ba29.source: A Dagger Handle of Shelter will add additional armor protection.
4a231072d59255e064596ea8e86280030b52ba29.text: 庇護 的匕首把手將增加額外的裝甲保護。

a1b01062069b3367f0d3c13462b2594a27d023c3.source: A "Brawn over Brains" Inscription adds 15% to your damage without any penalties (for this mission).
a1b01062069b3367f0d3c13462b2594a27d023c3.text: 「體力壓倒大腦」鑄印 將 15% 加入您的傷害中，且沒有任何懲罰（對於此任務）。

7b6b3efe1002125bb9406c887981c64fe5ec97eb.source: You can use items and switch weapons while Knocked Out, since the KO does not count as a Death. Use the opportunity to refresh experience scrolls.
7b6b3efe1002125bb9406c887981c64fe5ec97eb.text: 你可以在被擊倒時使用物品和切換武器，因為擊倒不算死亡。趁此機會重新整理經驗捲軸。

d4e1aa330bf2a193e25c27911a2c1b0acff21091.source: You can damage Stone Summit Rangers using a Vampiric Long or Flatblow; they will not retaliate if you stand outside of aggro range..
d4e1aa330bf2a193e25c27911a2c1b0acff21091.text: 您可以使用 吸血鬼 長擊或平擊傷害 石峰矮人 遊騎兵；如果你站在仇恨範圍之外，他們不會報復。

3760c723cba2938224702096ac5bde091decf4b6.source: Almost every foe has the same health: 80 in normal mode and 200 in hard mode. Exceptions: Ettins, Wolves and bosses.
3760c723cba2938224702096ac5bde091decf4b6.text: 幾乎每個敵人都有相同的生命值：在正常模式下為 80，在困難模式下為 200。例外：埃廷斯、狼隊和老闆。

52db2a91627bb3fd1a64e76e189deee157a98a0d.source: Kilroy Stonekin doesn't gain health from enemy deaths, he does however have some natural health regeneration.
52db2a91627bb3fd1a64e76e189deee157a98a0d.text: 基羅伊石族 不會從敵人死亡中獲得生命值，但他確實有一些自然的生命值再生。

ea6175719aca160de3f2c1dbff72db9b31439364.source: Attacking the same foe as Kilroy allows you to regain health more quickly; each death boosts your health substantially.
ea6175719aca160de3f2c1dbff72db9b31439364.text: 攻擊與基爾羅伊相同的敵人可以讓你更快地恢復生命值；每一次死亡都會大大促進你的健康。

0feec49911fc160cff014f819995cb78a96f98b2.source: Speak with Field General Hayao in Sun Docks.
0feec49911fc160cff014f819995cb78a96f98b2.text: 與太陽碼頭的隼雄將軍交談。

18984b77835c0a9e49478da91f165bfefa6f7878.source: Only available if you hadn't recruited Margrid the Sly before.
18984b77835c0a9e49478da91f165bfefa6f7878.text: Only available if you hadn't recruited Margrid the Sly before.

b6ef0cea65da0d5938b892e7d42aa3c8687978ca.text: 與瑪格麗德的船員做出安排。

7f7a70c67051aabb4cfd9c7da2b8b006b573cfe5.source: Speak with Shifty Lem in Nundu Bay.
7f7a70c67051aabb4cfd9c7da2b8b006b573cfe5.text: 在 納度灣 中與 Shifty Lem 交談。

029017e8125152c36482fb4f89e3dccf92a2421b.source: Master of Whispers not yet recruited as one of your heroes
029017e8125152c36482fb4f89e3dccf92a2421b.text: Master of Whispers not yet recruited as one of your heroes

a16913a3d63c44df32e953b436f0761cc8ee9348.source: Find the Adept of the Order of Whispers and deliver the Master's commands.
a16913a3d63c44df32e953b436f0761cc8ee9348.text: Find the Adept of the Order of Whispers and deliver the Master's commands.

bfcce14fc134a2b5f88e9cc5aa9f962233aca300.source: Exit the Throne of Secrets and head to the Chantry of Secrets. Find the Whispers Adept by the statue of Grenth and talk to him.
bfcce14fc134a2b5f88e9cc5aa9f962233aca300.text: 退出 神秘王座 並前往 隱密教堂。 Find the Whispers Adept by the statue of 古蘭斯 and talk to him.

206c18c0e76ac656adeadeec5d4defbe7562248c.source: Only available if you have not recruited Norgu before and do not have The Role of a Lifetime active.
206c18c0e76ac656adeadeec5d4defbe7562248c.text: Only available if you have not recruited Norgu before and do not have The Role of a Lifetime active.

76a332b5179657d080875fa9971e293e48a82956.source: Make arrangements with Korvus to perform Norgu's Nightfall.
76a332b5179657d080875fa9971e293e48a82956.text: 與 Korvus 安排表演 Norgu 的 黑暗逆襲。

7ba3f3e282786dc73b160c3b2d76678482396b16.source: Map back to Elona, then map to Honur Hill. Speak with Korvus.
7ba3f3e282786dc73b160c3b2d76678482396b16.text: 映射回 Elona，然後對映到 霍奴爾丘陵。與科爾烏斯交談。

936344ba5fe14dbc333e7f204a19f2ea380ec8d8.source: Must not have Acolyte Sousuke as one of your heroes.
936344ba5fe14dbc333e7f204a19f2ea380ec8d8.text: 不得將侍僧宗介作為你的英雄之一。

79c908c4c5017c4b01078f9fd9945d270b1a04b5.source: Speak with General Hayao and formally accept Sousuke's oath of fealty.
79c908c4c5017c4b01078f9fd9945d270b1a04b5.text: Speak with General Hayao and formally accept Sousuke's oath of fealty.

611a1ddabfb26c54551438d28f0602c92d4e1be4.text: 侍僧宗介加入你的隊伍。

3c96f44fd3a62ce3bafd11130309f474f37c209b.source: Exit the Throne of Secrets and return to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan. Then exit into the Sun Docks and speak to Field General Hayao to complete the quest.
3c96f44fd3a62ce3bafd11130309f474f37c209b.text: Exit the 神秘王座 and return to 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽. Then exit into the Sun Docks and speak to Field General Hayao to complete the quest.

adfde5f7c610a2a78754bc2f95806138918675fa.source: Clear Gandara, the Moon Fortress in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
adfde5f7c610a2a78754bc2f95806138918675fa.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 弦月要塞 幹達拉。

d2c775c73360f055a5b10de6970d0446c5870f15.source: "Clear Gandara, the Moon Fortress in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."
d2c775c73360f055a5b10de6970d0446c5870f15.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 弦月要塞 幹達拉。”

5aaf9f334f291746a158c9e232b043a499757bb1.source: The only way to get here is via the Pogahn Passage outpost. The latter part of the primary quest No Me, No Kormir will point characters a short distance into this area.
5aaf9f334f291746a158c9e232b043a499757bb1.text: The only way to get here is via the 波甘驛站 outpost. The latter part of the primary quest No Me, No Kormir will point characters a short distance into this area.

ef4d97b6fc905db8896ecc4bd6066266d3e61988.source: You cannot enter the main fortress from Gandara.
ef4d97b6fc905db8896ecc4bd6066266d3e61988.text: 你無法從甘達拉進入主要堡壘。

8ea11ccf0a81bd8d89f747f9406c2df6d9e8ad16.source: Despite the presence of Kournan military, the Kournan Bounty is not available here.
8ea11ccf0a81bd8d89f747f9406c2df6d9e8ad16.text: Despite the presence of 高楠士兵, the Kournan Bounty is not available here.

4a3ba51c6ecd7c77f18332d7ad6309bbdc8be179.source: Complete exploration of this area (including the fortress) contributes approximately 2.9% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
4a3ba51c6ecd7c77f18332d7ad6309bbdc8be179.text: Complete exploration of this area (including the fortress) contributes approximately 2.9% to the Elonian 版圖 title track.

c1639d817d5d68a040e7e06696ebe17da66d3b3d.source: You can map the full 2.9% during Pogahn Passage without dealing with any foes.
c1639d817d5d68a040e7e06696ebe17da66d3b3d.text: You can map the full 2.9% during 波甘驛站 without dealing with any foes.

67779f7c1b10d1c6fd66e11669937f434d67aec6.source: Slightly less than half can be mapped without entering the mission.
67779f7c1b10d1c6fd66e11669937f434d67aec6.text: 在不進入任務的情況下可以繪製出略少於一半的地圖。

1a0acdfc2120d0491119d63c5ba3eea548fbe3f5.source: Around 50 additional foes will be present until you complete A Thorn in Varesh's Side (whether or not you have accepted the quest).
1a0acdfc2120d0491119d63c5ba3eea548fbe3f5.text: Around 50 additional foes will be present until you complete A Thorn in Varesh's Side (whether or not you have accepted the quest).

007139ecbc66f767cf0f073f9c96b138396884b9.source: After vanquishing the area, you can take and complete Nerashi's quest without having to kill additional targets.
007139ecbc66f767cf0f073f9c96b138396884b9.text: After vanquishing the area, you can take and complete Nerashi's quest without having to kill additional targets.

6ca3659c481a2b8d9a1f3e621a76a745585ee164.source: Occasionally foes will spawn behind the western fortress gate, beyond the reach of melee and projectile attacks.
6ca3659c481a2b8d9a1f3e621a76a745585ee164.text: Occasionally foes will spawn behind the western fortress gate, beyond the reach of melee and projectile attacks.

968a76d57de0be9e8156f9226b187b1f115867c6.source: *BONUS* Retrieve the Orrian Text for the Historian.
968a76d57de0be9e8156f9226b187b1f115867c6.text: *獎勵* 為歷史學家取回奧裡安文本。

362c652ca91db6417d0b25ea5e0d9b3b83299bfb.source: As per the Gates of Kryta mission.
362c652ca91db6417d0b25ea5e0d9b3b83299bfb.text: 根據 科瑞塔關所 任務。

9d721b0e9ca1132b4f6eadb16e96bc09dd837db6.text: 與薩恩·斯通裡夫特交談。

8556c9eb8e2f2960fecbb310b59ac321b3fc183d.source: Return the ore ingots to Tharn Stonerift.
8556c9eb8e2f2960fecbb310b59ac321b3fc183d.text: 影返 將礦錠交給 Tharn Stonerift。

52ef7b0cc3fc2be15ab12e133c84cd964cf49709.source: Follow your direction arrows to reach the ten Ore Boxes, although it doesn't matter where you find the ore, or in which order you pick it up. A lot of ore can be found in the course of completing the Cold One quest, and in the adjoining cavern (the big one hanging with chains).
52ef7b0cc3fc2be15ab12e133c84cd964cf49709.text: 按照方向箭頭到達十個礦石箱，儘管你在哪裡找到礦石或以什麼順序拾取礦石並不重要。在完成 冰東西 任務的過程中以及毗鄰的洞穴（掛著鏈條的大洞穴）中可以找到大量礦石。

d4b2c6e26d06715065e7bee2d0862886a030517e.source: It's best to accept this quest prior to attempting the other quests from Krak Flamewhip, as you will be required to go to the same locations to finish those other quests.
d4b2c6e26d06715065e7bee2d0862886a030517e.text: 最好在嘗試克拉克火鞭的其他任務之前接受此任務，因為您將需要前往相同的位置來完成這些其他任務。

163a09507eba4513acdb6cf58fdd45f3cfc207cf.source: After gathering ten ingots, speak to Tharn Stonerift to complete the quest, then see Krak Flamewhip for your reward.
163a09507eba4513acdb6cf58fdd45f3cfc207cf.text: 收集十個錠後，與薩恩·斯通裂谷交談以完成任務，然後見克拉克·火鞭以獲得獎勵。

bfb5e2622d6f7b4e17cb08eaa2ef4729560da03b.source: Help Kane extract his revenge by destroying Margonite Scouts.
bfb5e2622d6f7b4e17cb08eaa2ef4729560da03b.text: 摧毀 瑪骨奈 偵察兵，幫助凱恩報仇。

cf775d2f1161ffcc840d13a1811f96d174862cbd.source: You have killed … of 30 Margonite Scouts.
cf775d2f1161ffcc840d13a1811f96d174862cbd.text: 你已經殺死了…30 瑪骨奈 偵察兵。

380fd06df1fc12cac42efd0603ae514ea4f208f9.source: Enter The Shattered Ravines through the entrance in the Lair of the Forgotten and Kane will be waiting right at the entrance. Accept the quest, then head for the nearby Wurm Spoor and enter the Junundu. Follow the path on the map and kill all Margonites on the way.
380fd06df1fc12cac42efd0603ae514ea4f208f9.text: 從 被遺忘者的巢穴 的入口進入 碎裂溝谷，凱恩將在入口處等候。接受任務，然後前往附近的 地蟲 Spoor 並進入 Junundu。沿著地圖上的路徑前進，殺死途中所有的瑪貢尼特。

4c5e4e270dd54ac76739f95b1dfc3ca8871775ac.source: All Margonites count, not only Margonite Scouts, so Forgotten Retribution can be completed at the same time.
4c5e4e270dd54ac76739f95b1dfc3ca8871775ac.text: 所有瑪格尼特都算在內，不只是瑪骨奈偵察兵，所以被遺忘者 天譴可以同時完成。

24746b96610a0edf1a2d8b98d334c9dbf218b6c9.source: The counter of killed Margonite Scouts resets if you leave the area.
24746b96610a0edf1a2d8b98d334c9dbf218b6c9.text: 如果您離開該區域，被殺死的 瑪骨奈 偵察兵的計數器會重設。

941b5a661d69a9bc5ffc22076b974a055a74e7dc.source: This quest can be used to help farm Lightbringer Points.
941b5a661d69a9bc5ffc22076b974a055a74e7dc.text: 這個任務可以用來幫助農場光明使者點數。

4276594fdf0dd89db4cead3f826efa03bc64d92a.source: Kill Ghial the Bone Dancer in the Xaquang Skyway.
4276594fdf0dd89db4cead3f826efa03bc64d92a.text: 在 夏安便道 中殺死 骨之舞者 葛西。

561d6bc37cdae2d60cb420fef189db77f29ac509.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 Ghial。

9d274a4ffe8d8cc58cf92b42ec96cfe9bde6a2ca.source: Exit from the Marketplace into Bukdek Byway and then enter Xaquang Skyway or exit from Senji's Corner and head north. See maps for directions. The route from the Marketplace to Ghial is faster as your party will encounter fewer foes than the route from Senji's Corner; however, Senji's Corner has a wider selection of henchmen.
9d274a4ffe8d8cc58cf92b42ec96cfe9bde6a2ca.text: 從市場退出進入 巴德克小徑，然後進入 夏安便道 或從 山吉之街 退出並向北行駛。請參閱地圖以瞭解路線。從市場到吉阿爾的路線比從 山吉之街 的路線更快，因為您的隊伍遇到的敵人更少；然而，山吉之街 有更廣泛的追隨者選擇。

94bc3d8191f041621872f2dea822a6a173e496e1.source: Ghial relies on his Flesh Golem for offense and self healing as it leaves an exploitable corpse. Consider bringing an exploit skill to prevent Ghial from reusing the corpse.
94bc3d8191f041621872f2dea822a6a173e496e1.text: Ghial 依靠他的 鮮血高崙 進行進攻和自我修復，因為它留下了可用的屍體。考慮使用漏洞技能來防止吉阿爾重複使用屍體。

fdff4a08a11beabaea3cced0c9c4ceddf9981883.source: Return to Marchena for your reward.
fdff4a08a11beabaea3cced0c9c4ceddf9981883.text: 影返 至 馬其納 以獲得獎勵。

b3b089f6686fe09d40bc5daedf1777652d13f6cd.text: 元素使 黑曜石火焰

1ea17b222000afa8a6f744ba33d0407e9e878ada.source: Kill 10 Minotaurs anywhere in Prophet's Path. Mobs of Minotaurs can be found patrolling Prophet's Path. A large group of Minotaurs lies west past the teleporter in Prophet's Path. The 10 kills can be done in more than one instance.
1ea17b222000afa8a6f744ba33d0407e9e878ada.text: 殺死 先知之路 中任何地方的 10 牛頭怪。可以發現牛頭怪小怪在 先知之路 巡邏。一大群牛頭怪位於 先知之路 傳送器的西邊。 10 殺戮可以在多個例項中完成。

86f190d6e006ea590ae4c40edb0e18168d7804d4.source: Alternatively, take this quest on reaching Augury Rock, then play through the desert as normal. Any Minotaurs encountered in the desert will count for this quest. You will also face enough Minotaurs during the beginning of the Elona Reach mission to satisfy this quest.
86f190d6e006ea590ae4c40edb0e18168d7804d4.text: 或者，在到達 占卜之石 時執行此任務，然後像往常一樣穿越沙漠。在沙漠中遇到的任何牛頭怪都將計入此任務。在 伊洛那流域 任務開始時，您還將面對足夠的牛頭怪來滿足此任務。

38d8229455dde1ab2343ef6557066636ff43ce4d.source: Before completing Garden Chores there are several groups of Seborhin Pests on the east side of the garden (square part) (23 foes).
38d8229455dde1ab2343ef6557066636ff43ce4d.text: 在完成花園雜務之前，花園東側（方形部分）有幾組 Seborhin 害蟲（23 敵人）。

3e2e1355687881d3f993f82118e18ee935daddb2.source: There are several hidden groups of beetles along the patrol routes of elemental groups and other visible beetle groups. Try to sweep and proceed slowly or pull enemy mobs rather than charging at them.
3e2e1355687881d3f993f82118e18ee935daddb2.text: 沿著元素群體和其他可見甲蟲群體的巡邏路線，有幾個隱藏的甲蟲群體。嘗試掃蕩並緩慢前進或拉動敵方生物而不是衝向它們。

81e0db1a1ec2c5bf6a8937d320e5ba5e10233f0c.source: The Plague of Frogs quest will cause a lot more hekets to spawn.
81e0db1a1ec2c5bf6a8937d320e5ba5e10233f0c.text: 青蛙瘟疫任務將導致產生更多的赫克特。

a0dd048fdf0b2304c9eaf38bc2ec0bb72e1d618a.source: Go to the Diessa Lowlands. Kill Garfazz Bloodfang.
a0dd048fdf0b2304c9eaf38bc2ec0bb72e1d618a.text: 轉至 底耶沙低地。殺死 卡法斯血牙。

9bd04bba51ac3120a65bc4c528ce2fd05d9ee619.source: Return to Viggo for your reward.
9bd04bba51ac3120a65bc4c528ce2fd05d9ee619.text: 影返 至 維格 以獲得獎勵。

0a6c8fba3fa3c368bb7f7455db99855ee74de5da.text: 藤杖（使用致命短棒的皮膚）

87ed3ee57cccd31ba5687720235f8122a1227924.text: 混沌 Dmg：4-7（需 3 幻術魔法）

6f9577c680cf22e37ca1f8e26b37ef8e7a9914bb.text: 削減傷害：10-14（需要3 精通劍術）

e154f86c0bf046216a48c0d73efcb5ebfe441e7b.source: Travel to Diessa Lowlands; Grendich Courthouse is conveniently close to the location of the quest. If you don't want to kill all the Charr surrounding Garfazz, attack him from the north. You will be able to pull him away from most of the others easily, and with more careful pulling he can be engaged by himself.
e154f86c0bf046216a48c0d73efcb5ebfe441e7b.text: 前往 底耶沙低地； 葛蘭迪法院 距離任務地點很近，非常方便。如果你不想殺死加爾法茲周圍的所有 夏爾，請從北方攻擊他。你可以輕鬆地將他從大多數其他人身邊拉開，如果更小心地拉動，他就可以自己參與其中。

c155f0e8b615c63d9189208699b723ec7151a957.source: Sometimes, after you accept the reward from Duke Barradin on completion of The Siege of Piken Square (the prerequisite quest for Garfazz Bloodfang), Viggo won't gain the expected green exclamation point above his head until you click on him.
c155f0e8b615c63d9189208699b723ec7151a957.text: 有時，在您完成圍攻 派肯廣場（卡法斯血牙 的先決任務）並接受 巴拉丁公爵 的獎勵後，維格 不會在您點選他的頭頂時獲得預期的綠色感嘆號。

c427118f890068571c39390e7c4e3c5a2640f5d2.source: Kill 5 Shatter or Flash Gargoyles. You have killed 0..5 gargoyles.
c427118f890068571c39390e7c4e3c5a2640f5d2.text: 殺死 5 粉碎石像鬼或閃光石像鬼。您殺死 0..5 石像鬼。

3301807016c85b2e28514566b34082d3330ded14.source: Return to Warmaster Grast for your reward.
3301807016c85b2e28514566b34082d3330ded14.text: 影返 至 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特 以獲得獎勵。

a824600f76465f7764c40051e779380b701df8a8.source: There are several Gargoyles throughout Old Ascalon. You will most likely find enough nearby when you accept this quest. Just slay enough gargoyles and claim your reward for your deeds. Be aware of the Hex Spell "Conjure Phantasm" of the Shatter Gargoyles and the Air Magic Spell "Lightning Orb" of the Flash Gargoyles, these two can be devastating to an unprepared and inexperienced hero.
a824600f76465f7764c40051e779380b701df8a8.text: 舊阿斯卡隆 中有多位石像鬼。當你接受這個任務時，你很可能會在附近找到足夠的東西。只要殺死足夠多的石像鬼並領取你的行為獎勵即可。請注意粉碎石像鬼的 降咒魔法“召喚幻影”和閃光石像鬼的 風系魔法 咒文魔法“閃電球”，這兩個對於沒有準備和缺乏經驗的英雄來說可能是毀滅性的。

0edd046de003bbb0352e26274afe9ff3e5ad6844.source: It's easy to complete this quest while working on Counting the Fallen due to the number of flash and shatter gargoyles roaming in the area.
0edd046de003bbb0352e26274afe9ff3e5ad6844.text: 由於在該地區漫遊的閃光和破碎石像鬼數量眾多，因此在 調查死者 上工作時很容易完成此任務。

4b813fd3d950b2e02dc4730f76133130749fb18a.source: Tame Queen Aijundu to travel across The Desolation.
4b813fd3d950b2e02dc4730f76133130749fb18a.text: 馴服艾君杜女王，穿越 荒蕪之地。

5960315483782445972966932ec104f1fe157892.text: *獎勵* 拯救三位年輕的朱南杜。

e7653e1af420a0954f942da3fa1def7daa50a878.source: Defeat Shiro and the Lich at the Gate of Madness.
e7653e1af420a0954f942da3fa1def7daa50a878.text: 在 瘋狂之門 擊敗白和巫妖。

846deed73dc1036b91c016ba3dc8c24b78381213.source: *BONUS* Capture favor of the five shrines.

34ab4925328c54ff090921838668af91d0e3074d.source: As per the Gate of Madness mission.
34ab4925328c54ff090921838668af91d0e3074d.text: 根據 瘋狂之門 任務。

95a83fe925ea93ba161e6508dedfcd19d749ca76.source: Take Dunkoro and release the tortured souls at the Gate of Pain.
95a83fe925ea93ba161e6508dedfcd19d749ca76.text: 帶著 Dunkoro 去 懲罰之門 釋放受折磨的靈魂。

6637b42ae470dce01cb9e0fa82e908b4793b339c.source: *BONUS* Kill three additional Emissaries of Dhuum.
6637b42ae470dce01cb9e0fa82e908b4793b339c.text: *獎勵* 殺死另外三位 多姆 使者。

c4a746b11f37ac44b925b23ec19b5cfadd809285.source: As per the Gate of Pain mission.
c4a746b11f37ac44b925b23ec19b5cfadd809285.text: 根據 懲罰之門 任務。

915b1b35d3f4a96d6474aef754dfdaa82c8edb3c.source: Destroy the undead in the swamp south of Lion's Arch.
915b1b35d3f4a96d6474aef754dfdaa82c8edb3c.text: 消滅 獅子拱門 南部沼澤中的不死生物。

8da980033a65c34392c841d660e7a1119d536e55.source: Kneel to water the garden plants. You have [6...0] more plants to water.
8da980033a65c34392c841d660e7a1119d536e55.text: 跪下給花園植物澆水。您有 [6...0] 更多植物需要澆水。

94e09a6f341fed2790fe128b7b26683522c59c71.source: Pick up all fallen leaves. [10...0] leaf piles left.
94e09a6f341fed2790fe128b7b26683522c59c71.text: 撿起所有落葉。 [10...0] 剩下樹葉堆。

bc9293e035e4d39b09147a750353bde126b67603.source: Carry the leaf bags up the stairs. [3...0] leaf bags left.
bc9293e035e4d39b09147a750353bde126b67603.text: 拎著樹葉袋上樓梯。 [3...0] 剩下葉子袋。

455905d28576b8d39e0524966084d34016a35d59.source: See Hedge Wizard Mabai for your reward.
455905d28576b8d39e0524966084d34016a35d59.text: 請參閱對沖巫師馬白以獲得獎勵。

12354c41afa645535286a0b1c9296147412ba6b1.source: Once this quest is completed, the Seborhin Pests will no longer spawn in the Garden of Seborhin.
12354c41afa645535286a0b1c9296147412ba6b1.text: 一旦完成此任務，Seborhin 害蟲將不再在 希伯欣花園 中產生。

92a147480f4baae24e7bcfdf22e4428756397768.source: All the tasks here are pretty easy to perform and take place in the paved garden area in front of Mabai.
92a147480f4baae24e7bcfdf22e4428756397768.text: 這裡的所有任務都非常容易執行，並在馬拜前面的鋪好的花園區域中進行。

f33cb1d63d00022eb3ac84137710d77b6d869efa.source: The groups of Seborhin Pests are all located near to Mabai. To water the plants, walk over and stand by each one indicated on the map, and use the /kneel emote to water them. The leaf piles can be picked up by clicking on them like loot items. Likewise, each of the leaf bags must be picked up and carried to the top of the stairs to the left of where Mabai is waiting: you will automatically drop each bag once it has been carried far enough to satisfy the quest.
f33cb1d63d00022eb3ac84137710d77b6d869efa.text: Seborhin害蟲群都位於馬拜附近。要給植物澆水，請走到地圖上指示的每一棵植物旁邊，然後使用 /kneel 表情給它們澆水。樹葉堆可以像戰利品一樣透過點選來拾取。同樣，每個葉子袋都必須被拾起並帶到馬白等待的左側的樓梯頂部：一旦每個袋子被帶到足夠遠以滿足任務，你就會自動掉落每個袋子。

6ccc33ab74a663e0414bc860b275dd184faff480.source: Note that the tasks do not have to be done in order: the plants can be watered as soon as the quest is accepted from Mabai as long as you know where you need to kneel, without needing to kill the pests first (the quest log does not reflect this). The leaf piles will appear as soon as all six plants are watered, and the quest log will simultaneously display the objectives for both killing the pests and picking up the leaf piles. The leaf bags appear once all the other objectives are completed.
6ccc33ab74a663e0414bc860b275dd184faff480.text: 請注意，任務不必按順序完成：只要你知道需要跪在哪裡，從馬白接受任務後就可以給植物澆水，而不需要先殺死害蟲（任務日誌沒有反映這一點）。當所有六種植物都澆水後，樹葉堆就會出現，任務日誌將同時顯示殺死害蟲和拾取樹葉堆的目標。當所有其他目標完成後，葉子袋就會出現。

aa99449792962dbad581ab0071e695eba122443f.source: Clear the Garden of Seborhin in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode.
aa99449792962dbad581ab0071e695eba122443f.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 瓦貝 中的 希伯欣花園。

930b24273ae2a1e75b7ed161d28fdeb8960fff03.source: "Clear the Garden of Seborhin in Vabbi of all enemies in hard mode."
930b24273ae2a1e75b7ed161d28fdeb8960fff03.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 瓦貝 中的 希伯欣花園。”

9de3692a0cf68e8ac0196dad9f5bd0dd51d66418.source: The entrance to this area is right outside the northwestern exit of Tihark Orchard outpost. Talk to Seborhin Protector Zuor outside the entrance in the Forum Highlands.
9de3692a0cf68e8ac0196dad9f5bd0dd51d66418.text: 該區域的入口就位於提哈克果園前哨西北方出口的外部。與 高地廣場 入口外的 Seborhin 守護者 Zuor 交談。

88b589f49bd6eaaf3a77d6faaf750a887a3beab8.source: To be allowed entry, Tahlkora must be in your party, unless the party leader has already completed Abaddon's Gate.
