9b05d2e0c22353f9c14ad302e847bca5d54b26fb.text: 司法官 湯米茲 是地圖上最左邊的 Boss。 石峰矮人 守衛應該是第一個目標，因為他們擁有保護守衛並且可以造成大範圍的效果傷害。另一個主要目標應該是 石峰矮人 防禦者，因為他們有 強力吸收 和浪費，不希望不允許他們傳送垃圾郵件保護咒語以及打斷

d7bfe0b5106d3ea89b438ebbe83373ad0b9c1404.source: Frozen Soil, as most of the Stone Summit have a resurrection skill.
d7bfe0b5106d3ea89b438ebbe83373ad0b9c1404.text: 凍土，因為大多數石峰矮人都有復活技能。

4bf7641cfdfb039cf31ef844ccfba0d8c8712535.source: Anti-knock down, there are large mobs of Modniir on the path to Justiciar Thommis.
4bf7641cfdfb039cf31ef844ccfba0d8c8712535.text: 反擊倒，通往司法官 湯米茲的路上有莫德尼爾大群小怪。

1ae9a2f276c7ac7948064e3bf2d680cc05fef3d8.text: 在深處殺死 加奈賽。

757cea01749e45ff2457940641267e6bea2a78a3.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 加奈賽。

990fc732b708d369c418558e948859fbe7d8e161.source: Completing this quest requires completion of the Deep, an elite mission. See that mission's article for details.
990fc732b708d369c418558e948859fbe7d8e161.text: 完成此任務需要完成“深淵”，這是一項精英任務。有關詳細資訊，請參閱該任務的文章。

4dd6c6f4ab080b22026b856e6767c6cd4a49c6d1.text: 找回卡坦德拉克斯的破碎機。

2ed15598b9a0d715235812ccf316b78820cf9e41.source: Return Kathandrax's Crusher to Swithin Nye in Sacnoth Valley Missing period
2ed15598b9a0d715235812ccf316b78820cf9e41.text: 影返 聖諾谷 中 Kathandrax 的破碎機對 Swithin Nye 缺失時段

df30d7f7593313ed043617b797adb540cadc79ae.source: Kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in Prophet's Path.
df30d7f7593313ed043617b797adb540cadc79ae.text: 在 先知之路 中殺死 柯柏海特食隨者。

d328122f527fa606d38b00e05f91911b78902c11.source: *BONUS* Kill Kepkhet Marrowfeast in Hard Mode.
d328122f527fa606d38b00e05f91911b78902c11.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 柯柏海特食隨者。

ed58275d508cdf360ee9f5ff02dcc26207b4c92e.source: If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Marrow Scarabs, Minotaurs, Rockshot Devourers, and Scarab Nest Builders on your way to Kepkhet Marrowfeast. Hex removal skills are unnecessary, as the aforementioned foes do not cast hexes.
ed58275d508cdf360ee9f5ff02dcc26207b4c92e.text: 如果您按照右側地圖中的路徑前進，則在前往 柯柏海特食隨者 的途中只會遇到骨髓聖甲蟲、牛頭怪、Rockshot 蠍 和聖甲蟲築巢者。去除妖術的技能是不必要的，因為上述敵人不會施放妖術。

6d5670293789a345c6be265c05f254de946dd80d.source: Avoid using condition-inflicting skills on Marrow Scarabs, as they will use Plague Touch and then Virulence. Marrow Scarabs use Well of the Profane, so either interrupt its activation, avoid bringing enchantments with long recharge times, and/or move away from corpses before they are exploited to create a Well of the Profane.
6d5670293789a345c6be265c05f254de946dd80d.text: 避免對骨髓聖甲蟲使用造成狀況的技能，因為它們會先使用 疫病之觸，然後使用 惡毒。骨髓聖甲蟲使用 褻瀆之池，因此要麼中斷其啟用，避免帶來較長充電時間的結界，和/或在屍體被利用以建立 褻瀆之池 之前遠離屍體。

ab696285e8824b85c9a99e203f2636eb91a83dd5.source: Rockshot Devourers and Scarab Nest Builders use Distracting Shot, so skills that block, inflict the blind condition, cause misses, or prevent interruption can be helpful. They also use numerous traps, so it may be a good idea to have one party member walk ahead of the party to trigger the traps and prevent the entire party from taking damage.
ab696285e8824b85c9a99e203f2636eb91a83dd5.text: Rockshot 蠍 和 Scarab Nest Builders 使用 震暈之箭，因此阻擋、造成盲態、導致錯誤或防止中斷的技能可能會有所幫助。他們也使用許多陷阱，因此最好讓一名隊伍成員走在隊伍前面來觸發陷阱並防止整個隊伍受到傷害。

32772a533a6f73bb96c8f69fe9a1706393ce932c.source: After you enter Sorrow's Furnace and speak to Kilroy, he will begin to run ahead of you through the caverns. Your objective now is to keep him alive. If Kilroy Stonekin dies, you lose the mission and will be teleported back to Deldrimor War Camp. If you exit the Furnace without completing the quest, Kilroy gets teleported to where you first found him in Grenth's Footprint, and you'll have to start again.
32772a533a6f73bb96c8f69fe9a1706393ce932c.text: 當你進入 悲傷熔爐 並與基爾羅伊交談後，他將開始在你前面穿過洞穴。你現在的目標是讓他活下去。如果 基羅伊石族 死亡，您將失去任務並將被傳送回 戴爾狄摩兵營。如果你在沒有完成任務的情況下退出熔爐，基爾羅伊會被傳送到你在 古蘭斯的足跡 中第一次發現他的地方，而你將不得不重新開始。

07264861476bcac97da84ec2361e3a7e9a7c9cba.source: The mobs in the Furnace are fairly easy. Just watch that the Priests of Sorrows don't resurrect the dead Stone Summit.
07264861476bcac97da84ec2361e3a7e9a7c9cba.text: 熔爐裡的小怪相當容易。只要注意悲傷牧師不會復活死者 石峰矮人。

0d4ed99e5972ce7c83d1e86f5c1b5c038df9c214.source: A couple of times Kilroy will start fighting without you, but mostly he'll run to the next checkpoint and wait for you to catch up to him. You normally have time to pick up loot, and, as you draw near to the next checkpoint, to check out the composition of the mob ahead and to cast enchantments before you walk up to Kilroy and start the fight. If you want to stay on the safe side, pick up loot during each battle and keep following Kilroy, who will begin to run to the next checkpoint as soon as all foes around him are dead.
0d4ed99e5972ce7c83d1e86f5c1b5c038df9c214.text: 有幾次基爾羅伊會在沒有你的情況下開始戰鬥，但大多數時候他會跑到下一個檢查站並等待你追上他。你通常有時間拾取戰利品，並且當你接近下一個檢查站時，檢查前方暴民的構成並在走到基爾羅伊並開始戰鬥之前施放結界。如果你想保持安全，請在每場戰鬥中拾取戰利品並繼續跟隨基爾羅伊，一旦他周圍的所有敵人都死了，他就會開始跑到下一個檢查站。

e9b27c095b2e6ff71cb0f5f4b943e9a3d924843e.source: Selecting his name and pressing spacebar to follow comes in handy.
e9b27c095b2e6ff71cb0f5f4b943e9a3d924843e.text: 選擇他的名字並按空白鍵進行關注很方便。

26ff5f6fa68d5670f447d97f4b5b454283d5c3ba.source: In the final part of this quest, there will be three mobs facing you. Stay with Kilroy — he'll run for the monk boss, Gulnar Irontoe.
26ff5f6fa68d5670f447d97f4b5b454283d5c3ba.text: 在這個任務的最後部分，你將面對三個小怪。留在基爾羅伊身邊——他將競選僧侶老大古爾納爾·艾恩托。

255efad5c61d46aa2dfc51c50809dd036cfd10e7.source: When Kilroy stops at his "checkpoints" and waits for you to catch up, it is possible to sneak past him, thus allowing your party to eliminate remaining enemies (including Irontoe) without him engaging.
255efad5c61d46aa2dfc51c50809dd036cfd10e7.text: 當基爾羅伊停在他的「檢查站」並等待你追上時，你可以偷偷溜過他，從而讓你的隊伍在沒有他參與的情況下消滅剩餘的敵人（包括鐵趾）。

6bfdd41a4dac4ae98d95a38a1dd9bdaad5f91f5c.source: At three times during this quest, an unlocked chest will spawn. Opening it will reveal one to three purple items assigned to random party members within compass range.
6bfdd41a4dac4ae98d95a38a1dd9bdaad5f91f5c.text: 在此任務期間，會出現三次解鎖的箱子。開啟它會顯示一到三個紫色物品，分配給羅盤範圍內的隨機隊伍成員。

a116026fe08371b2238b5d61322cc9e784969015.source: Speak to Kilroy when you are ready to hunt for Fronis Irontoe.
a116026fe08371b2238b5d61322cc9e784969015.text: 當您準備好尋找 鐵趾 弗朗尼 時，請與基爾羅伊交談。

2894ace3718b1a1276ba665713a066a23edfc38c.source: Accompany Kilroy. Find and defeat Fronis Irontoe using nothing but brass knuckles.
2894ace3718b1a1276ba665713a066a23edfc38c.text: 陪伴基爾羅伊。僅使用指節銅套即可找到並擊敗 鐵趾 弗朗尼。

ceb3eb22911c56ff1ea876d6104c312fe18850aa.source: See Kilroy Stonekin for your reward.
ceb3eb22911c56ff1ea876d6104c312fe18850aa.text: 請參閱 基羅伊石族 以取得獎勵。

6431808eb800966ee7014551380ab04c5126e0bd.source: Speak to Kilroy Stonekin to start the brawling tournament.
6431808eb800966ee7014551380ab04c5126e0bd.text: 與 基羅伊石族 交談以開始爭吵錦標賽。

aef6bead4f81aa5496360641a2995cfe108d14c9.source: Defeat eight opponents in a row to win the brawling tournament.
aef6bead4f81aa5496360641a2995cfe108d14c9.text: 連續擊敗八個對手，贏得亂鬥錦標賽。

ff216762cd6fff2518dc84b35f86140f68370b29.source: When entering, first make sure you equip your Brass Knuckles if you haven't already. After the timer has finished counting down, the doors to the arena — which should be quite familiar to you by now — will open. You will have to defeat the eight enemies one by one. The enemies that spawn are random but a good general piece of advice is to go behind a wall if you are facing a ranged enemy and are low on hp. Another good idea is to save Brawling Straight Right and sometimes even Brawling Headbutt until it matters. If you are facing a warrior you can expect it to have Healing Signet.
ff216762cd6fff2518dc84b35f86140f68370b29.text: 進入時，請先確保您裝備了指節銅套（如果您尚未裝備）。計時器倒數完畢後，競技場的大門（現在你應該已經很熟悉了）將會開啟。你必須一一擊敗八個敵人。生成的敵人是隨機的，但如果你面對的是遠端敵人並且生命值較低，一個很好的一般建議是躲到牆後。另一個好主意是儲存Brawling Straight Right，有時甚至會儲存Brawling 頭鎚，直到它變得重要為止。如果您面對的是戰士，您可以期待它擁有 治療紋章。

42401802bce65176af1d7994faeac22f4484b5ec.source: TIP: If/when you are knocked down, use one hand to "button mash" the number 8 on your keyboard (or the button you have assigned to skill 8), and use the other hand on the mouse to spam click the skill to generate energy even faster. You can also assign additional keys to activate skill 8 and "button mash" all of them to regain energy extremely quickly.
42401802bce65176af1d7994faeac22f4484b5ec.text: 提示：如果/當您被擊倒時，請用一隻手「按鍵搗碎」鍵盤上的數字 8（或您分配給技能 8 的按鈕），然後用另一隻手在滑鼠上快速點選技能以更快地產生能量。您還可以指派額外的按鍵來啟動技能 8 和“按鍵組合”，以極快地恢復能量。

2b701566e2c34b2ca32e415e971b7771f7cbd084.source: Sometimes Kepkhet Marrowfeast is hidden at first and won't popup until a party member approaches her spawn point. The Scarab Nest Builders surrounding Kepkhet Marrowfeast won't move if attacked from flatbow or longbow range, so you can cause Kepkhet Marrowfeast to deplete her energy by healing and protecting the Scarab Nest Builder prior to your party engaging Kepkhet Marrowfeast. When you go near Kepkhet Marrowfeast, several Marrow Scarabs will popup. If Kepkhet Marrowfeast casts Mark of Protection on herself, applying a condition or hex will cause her to use Contemplation of Purity and remove Mark of Protection.
2b701566e2c34b2ca32e415e971b7771f7cbd084.text: 有時，柯柏海特食隨者 一開始是隱藏的，直到隊伍成員接近她的重生點時才會彈出。如果受到平弓或長弓範圍的攻擊，柯柏海特食隨者 周圍的聖甲蟲築巢者將不會移動，因此您可以在您的隊伍與 柯柏海特食隨者 交戰之前透過治療和保護聖甲蟲築巢者來耗盡 柯柏海特食隨者 的能量。當你靠近 柯柏海特食隨者 時，會彈出幾隻骨髓聖甲蟲。如果 柯柏海特食隨者 對自己施放 守護印記，則套用條件或十六進位將導致她使用 純淨的冥想 並移除 守護印記。

930501b3f7db0726593e1fb90e5cdbdbba0150d3.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Family Soul quest, since it also requires you to kill her.
930501b3f7db0726593e1fb90e5cdbdbba0150d3.text: 考慮與家庭靈魂任務同時完成這個任務，因為它也需要你殺死她。

7f99f97fecd93cd18bb967dcc2fe69817af53ffa.source: Clear Kessex Peak in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
7f99f97fecd93cd18bb967dcc2fe69817af53ffa.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 凱席斯山峰。

f862a677cf7969a231861ae9c1197f119cddb6e8.source: This area is harder if War in Kryta is active.
f862a677cf7969a231861ae9c1197f119cddb6e8.text: 如果 科瑞塔戰爭 處於作用中狀態，則該區域會更困難。

fe3ebc1e1eb9e520670f7830e0928047a064a1e2.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Verata, Destor the Truth Seeker, Justiciar Amilyn, and/or Justiciar Marron bounties.
fe3ebc1e1eb9e520670f7830e0928047a064a1e2.text: 考慮與 芙瑞達、真相探索者德斯特、正義者阿米林和/或正義者馬龍賞金同時完成此任務。

efdc7004149c43c3b922b50613c49f682a89dc07.source: "Clear Kessex Peak in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."
efdc7004149c43c3b922b50613c49f682a89dc07.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 凱席斯山峰。”

7b24eeb8937e6731aed15504e0c2d2fbe7c2ca4b.source: From Temple of the Ages, head south through the Black Curtain.
7b24eeb8937e6731aed15504e0c2d2fbe7c2ca4b.text: 從 世紀神殿 出發，向南穿過黑幕。

9cb2561de592674403fe0e3948c04f5565c68b00.source: The only resurrection shrine is at the beginning of the area.
9cb2561de592674403fe0e3948c04f5565c68b00.text: 唯一的復活神社位於該地區的開頭。

d9296d765a204bbd5425843fc8541a19eac24ba3.source: Apprentices of Verata will steal party members' minions using Verata's Gaze.
d9296d765a204bbd5425843fc8541a19eac24ba3.text: 芙瑞達 的學徒將使用 芙瑞達的凝視 竊取隊伍成員的小兵。

2e0028c3f5f9922ff63de2587b09852f6dcd30fb.source: The Villainy of Galrath (reduces foes by about 20)
2e0028c3f5f9922ff63de2587b09852f6dcd30fb.text: 加拉斯的陰謀（減少敵人約 20）

ed6087599daf0b0c487efae6fd9f7a2999323690.source: Heirlooms of the Mad King (Halloween quest)
ed6087599daf0b0c487efae6fd9f7a2999323690.text: 瘋狂國王的傳家寶（激戰萬聖節 任務）

b866f52ea9d3ad2fbc02651d02fbda86b90964b8.text: 擊敗：156–205 敵人。有隱藏的敵人。

1eb30c766121cee923b8f8af894985564fd767b7.source: Many consider this area more difficult than others due to the Cult of Verata presence.
1eb30c766121cee923b8f8af894985564fd767b7.text: 由於 芙瑞達 崇拜的存在，許多人認為這個領域比其他領域更困難。

1bdbb38b25a55c4439c02ac8ab59c3e0e90ff1cd.source: Bring party members that are not dependent on line of sight; this allows for killing many of the Cult of Verata in relative safety by standing at the foot of their cliff, out of compass range from the access slope. (EVAS is great for luring enemies from even further away into to the party's range.)
1bdbb38b25a55c4439c02ac8ab59c3e0e90ff1cd.text: 攜帶不依賴視線的黨員；這使得站在懸崖腳下、遠離斜坡的羅盤範圍，可以相對安全地殺死許多 芙瑞達 邪教。 （EVAS 非常適合將敵人從更遠的地方引誘到隊伍的射程內。）

3438fd7a71c4f1bbb923708b1f95877982be2b98.source: With The Villainy of Galrath (not the hard mode version) active, many of the groups are converted to weaker groups of bandits, making vanquishing easier.
3438fd7a71c4f1bbb923708b1f95877982be2b98.text: 當 加拉斯的陰謀（不是困難模式版本）啟動時，許多團體會轉變為較弱的強盜團體，使征服變得更容易。

0680b02a5ec485f361cb9878a873d6c05d445336.source: If the War in Kryta is active, the area will also include Peacekeepers and White Mantle.
0680b02a5ec485f361cb9878a873d6c05d445336.text: 如果 科瑞塔戰爭 處於活動狀態，該區域還將包括 Peacekeepers 和 白斗篷。

a9d5a99f57651dd93d77d1d7ca193122825ecfc7.text: 在 泥塘根源地 中殺死 卡布斯。

978e17bdaec18e71ba6b939d21fe9f1bfdf34948.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 卡布斯。

7731971d002c1003c9a5b2f44d7315a6e5c363fb.source: The Bogroot Chest will not appear, and this quest will not update, until Khabuus and the two Ophil allies with him are defeated.
7731971d002c1003c9a5b2f44d7315a6e5c363fb.text: 博格魯特 寶箱 不會出現，這個任務也不會更新，直到 卡布斯 和他的兩個奧菲爾盟友被擊敗。

b3d92330085b5f98dbcb168a312586c8a653b593.source: See the Eternal Forgemaster for your reward
b3d92330085b5f98dbcb168a312586c8a653b593.text: 檢視 永生的鍛造大師 以獲得獎勵

eb43b3f2bcfe39cf6b25819334d778854f74317b.source: Follow the starburst to the Lake of Fire southeast of the Eternal Forgemaster. In the Lake of Fire area, you will run across groups of Obsidian Furnace Drakes, Smoke Walker monks, and a few Infernal Wurms. Khobay's group itself isn't hard to dispose of, but it is next to an Infernal Wurm that can be a problem due to its siege attacks. Pulling Khobay away from it, into a chasm that your team passes through, is a recommended tactic as it blocks the siege attack's line of sight.
eb43b3f2bcfe39cf6b25819334d778854f74317b.text: 沿著星芒到達 永生的鍛造大師 東南方的火湖。在火湖區域，你會遇到成群的黑曜石熔爐龍、煙行僧和一些地獄亞龍。 Khobay 的隊伍本身並不難消滅，但它緊鄰地獄火 地蟲，由於其圍攻攻擊可能會成為一個問題。將霍拜拉離它，進入你的團隊穿過的裂縫中是建議的策略，因為它阻擋了圍攻攻擊的視線。

8aaf15d03d8cc6b61851be71a5e82c48f2af6f12.text: 幫助基爾羅伊擊敗古爾納爾·鐵趾

3a154c0e7cf9cd1d2cf25bdbd38680a2909d0c28.source: See Kilroy Stonekin for your reward
3a154c0e7cf9cd1d2cf25bdbd38680a2909d0c28.text: 請參閱 基羅伊石族 取得獎勵

bb9914c06be58cbe65cc9856252f1cd3bd457e58.source: Find Kilroy Stonekin in Grenth's Footprint, just south west of exit from Deldrimor War Camp, and escort him to Sorrow's Furnace. Along the way you'll face a number of Stone Summit bosses, but nothing difficult. Kilroy will stay in the rear, and neither attack nor be attacked.
bb9914c06be58cbe65cc9856252f1cd3bd457e58.text: 在 戴爾狄摩兵營 出口西南方的 古蘭斯的足跡 中找到 基羅伊石族，並護送他前往 悲傷熔爐。一路上你會面對許多 石峰矮人 頭目，但沒什麼困難的。基爾羅伊將留在後方，既不攻擊也不被攻擊。

85e51f130f1af9ba95169a74380a9e2e0b06dad9.source: Even though this is not specified during the tournament, you are permitted to use Thunderfist's Brass Knuckles instead of regular Brass Knuckles; this will increase your chances of winning.
85e51f130f1af9ba95169a74380a9e2e0b06dad9.text: 儘管在錦標賽期間沒有指定，但您可以使用雷拳的指節銅套代替普通的指節銅套；這會增加您獲勝的機會。

1b870f3d9ab786c7afc3377fa57c4b87cf58abcc.source: Though the foes you face are random, research shows that there appears to be a list of foes which may occur each round (for example, the 6th round seems to be a Heket most of the time).
1b870f3d9ab786c7afc3377fa57c4b87cf58abcc.text: 雖然你面對的敵人是隨機的，但研究表明，似乎每輪都可能出現敵人清單（例如，6th 輪大多數時候似乎是 青蛙族群）。

ba18a9dbd70da3e7b95664a920279adf138450da.source: This quest seems to be a safe, albeit slow, way to gain experience for the Survivor title seeing as when you die, you have 10 seconds to either map out or get back on your feet using STAND UP!. Your death counter will not increase unless the timer runs out and you don't have full energy after you get knocked down.
ba18a9dbd70da3e7b95664a920279adf138450da.text: 這個任務似乎是一種安全但緩慢的獲得 生存者 遊戲經驗的方法，因為當你死後，你有 10 秒的時間來製定計劃或使用 STAND UP! 重新站起來！你的死亡計數器不會增加，除非計時器用完並且你被擊倒後沒有滿能量。

b76bf2430e7dfe44d473c746111502e2aa9f38d0.source: Clear the Kinya Province on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
b76bf2430e7dfe44d473c746111502e2aa9f38d0.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 欣彌領地 和 星岬島。

d07db7f4eb49e5e98516dcdcf1469fcc6479b49c.source: "Clear the Kinya Province on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode."
d07db7f4eb49e5e98516dcdcf1469fcc6479b49c.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 欣彌領地 和 星岬島。”

bf178c43c5c2ee6bbe8f542878aa8f233cfd4030.source: Exit from Ran Musu Gardens or travel west through Sunqua Vale or Panjiang Peninsula.
bf178c43c5c2ee6bbe8f542878aa8f233cfd4030.text: 從 嵐穆蘇花園 退出或透過 桑泉谷 或 班讓半島 向西行駛。

3eaa5953c87c3bfc3eb292a8eb5d240ab81f5b05.source: Several early profession-related training quests will lead here.
3eaa5953c87c3bfc3eb292a8eb5d240ab81f5b05.text: 一些早期與職業相關的訓練任務將引導到這裡。

16f09e44bcb4c157af17166ed209a8625902e7a1.source: These festival quests will also affect the spawns in this area:
16f09e44bcb4c157af17166ed209a8625902e7a1.text: 這些節日任務也會影響該區域的生成：

cbd9548a65df1ce32649cdd36c6b74ad5afa8dc2.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.1% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
cbd9548a65df1ce32649cdd36c6b74ad5afa8dc2.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Canthan 版圖 標題做出了大約 3.1% 的貢獻。

e4a7428429d580bb9bafd9633396f49589667ca1.source: If starting from Ran Musu Gardens, do not engage many Mantid Drones together in Seijun Woods, their combined Deathly Swarms may overwhelm the party's healing.
e4a7428429d580bb9bafd9633396f49589667ca1.text: 如果從 嵐穆蘇花園 開始，不要在 Seijun Woods 中與許多螳螂無人機交戰，它們聯合起來的死亡群可能會壓倒隊伍的治療效果。

7ea0b43fee62a19770b91aebc11d035a7afe790a.source: A monk player should watch Kappa groups spike damage.
7ea0b43fee62a19770b91aebc11d035a7afe790a.text: 武僧玩家應該注意河童群體的傷害。

4e19236d272981bb2260001e656e830a49b55d43.source: There are hidden Kappa popups in the sandy area to the west.
4e19236d272981bb2260001e656e830a49b55d43.text: 西邊的沙地裡有隱藏的河童彈出視窗。

76121ed05a8735c9572ab469d6aec2a2daf77b33.source: The Dragon Festival quest A Strange Request removes around 50 Crimson Skulls, including the bosses Auri the Skull Wand and Sulmeng the Skull Staff.
76121ed05a8735c9572ab469d6aec2a2daf77b33.text: 龍節任務「奇怪的請求」移除了 50 猩紅骷髏周圍的物品，包括 Boss 骷髏奧裡 手杖 和骷髏蘇爾蒙 法杖。

0af9594e8a0290f64b5c63beaf31d18ef9bbc962.source: The Dragon Festival quest The Rampaging Yetis adds Yeti groups.
0af9594e8a0290f64b5c63beaf31d18ef9bbc962.text: 端午節任務狂暴的雪人增加了雪人團體。

0be4515b8056565265d17c501dd9f8e64051afa2.source: Even before the quest to go to the Aerie area, the map icon for the Naga Hide collector will show on the mission map, without the actual collector being in the Aerie.
0be4515b8056565265d17c501dd9f8e64051afa2.text: 即使在前往鷹巢區域的任務之前，納迦皮 收集器的地圖圖示也會顯示在任務地圖上，而實際的收集器並不在鷹巢中。

450d2f27a1c929c64d4a70ab1a993902904071db.source: Travel to the Gate of Fear and speak with the Apostate.
450d2f27a1c929c64d4a70ab1a993902904071db.text: 前往恐懼之門並與叛教者交談。

0f491bef8772f830797b5dbb265821708a299b96.source: The quest is a simple matter of map travel.
0f491bef8772f830797b5dbb265821708a299b96.text: 任務是一個簡單的地圖旅行問題。

09bab27879742bbcf8b5ad686934898e00a1225d.source: Take Zhed Shadowhoof and rescue Mirza Veldrunner from the Kodonur Crossroads in Kourna.
09bab27879742bbcf8b5ad686934898e00a1225d.text: 在 高楠 中，帶著哲德影蹄並從 科登諾入口 中救出米爾扎維德行納。

2bd8bf95331d64c3e65159e091093a50c029a47c.source: *BONUS* Kill the three cruel Taskmaster bosses.
2bd8bf95331d64c3e65159e091093a50c029a47c.text: *獎勵*殺死三個殘酷的監工頭目。

926672acf68bda9c72ef0a252cb00f07dcaaad05.source: As per the Kodonur Crossroads mission.
926672acf68bda9c72ef0a252cb00f07dcaaad05.text: 根據 科登諾入口 任務。

61832f862fd9e3da4ff97e38eb264e8a73768870.source: Kill Korshek the Immolated in Forum Highlands.
61832f862fd9e3da4ff97e38eb264e8a73768870.text: 在 高地廣場 中殺死 宰殺者 科薛克。

723d3bd2227672c97b99060829e6e32e35a60e1f.source: *BONUS* Kill Korshek the Immolated in Hard Mode.
723d3bd2227672c97b99060829e6e32e35a60e1f.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 宰殺者 科薛克。

6f4dac84c5064bdcbe36a2e9c8ffde926f6386d4.source: Korshek's group includes several Roaring Ethers and at least one other Djinn. There are also up to three satellite groups, each consisting of more Djinn and Roaring Ethers. In hard mode, Ruby Djinn can hit very hard with Liquid Flame (over 200 damage) and Korshek follows with Searing Flames which can deal over 250 damage against 60 armor rating characters. This means, even with no death penalty, the entire party can be wiped in two to three hits, as these are AoE attacks. Consider getting the Shielding Branches blessing from the Melandru's Watcher outside of Tihark Orchard to reduce the damage caused by Korshek and Ruby Djinn.
6f4dac84c5064bdcbe36a2e9c8ffde926f6386d4.text: Korshek 的團隊包括幾個 Roaring Ethers 和至少一個其他 巨靈怪。還有多達三個衛星組，每個衛星組由更多的 巨靈怪 和 Roaring Ethers 組成。在困難模式下，紅寶石巨靈 可以使用 液態火焰 進行非常猛烈的攻擊（超過 200 傷害），而 Korshek 則使用 爆裂火焰，它可以對 60 裝甲等級角色造成超過 250 的傷害。這意味著，即使沒有死刑，整個隊伍也可以在兩到三擊中被消滅，因為這些都是 範圍性 攻擊。考慮從提哈克果園外的 梅蘭朵 守望者那裡獲得遮蔽樹枝的祝福，以減少 Korshek 和 紅寶石巨靈 造成的傷害。

205f707fc3d7bc660ffd5d667a31f051fd745eca.source: There are several techniques to effectively counter Searing Flames:
205f707fc3d7bc660ffd5d667a31f051fd745eca.text: 有多種技術可以有效對抗 爆裂火焰：

90857a0075e4aa91354edf0cb4cb9e5db8fba1ec.source: Bring skills that interrupt or inflict Dazed.
90857a0075e4aa91354edf0cb4cb9e5db8fba1ec.text: 帶來中斷或造成 暈眩 的技能。

53bbfcff1873e01db5eb18e68fbaa5eb03d4df44.source: Use Frigid Armor to prevent being set on fire.
53bbfcff1873e01db5eb18e68fbaa5eb03d4df44.text: 使用 冰凍護甲 防止著火。

84cc025231f5c7280f527acaff1f24f166de34a6.source: Signet of Humility will prevent Searing Flames from being cast; Diversion will disable it for an extended period.
84cc025231f5c7280f527acaff1f24f166de34a6.text: 謙卑紋章 將阻止 爆裂火焰 被施放； 牽制 將在較長時間內停用它。

1e3571d8fed85aaecff8919931a969bc19fe33a0.source: The boss will quickly kill itself while hexed with either Pain Inverter or Spoil Victor.
1e3571d8fed85aaecff8919931a969bc19fe33a0.text: 當使用 苦痛 變頻器或 勝者的掠奪 施咒時，Boss 會快速自殺。

931983c528b7f3bc2acaf9b1f63696531764f41b.source: Ward Against Elements or Ward Against Harm will reduce the elemental damage.
931983c528b7f3bc2acaf9b1f63696531764f41b.text: 元素結界 或 守護結界 將可減少元素傷害。

0890f42fc0d71ad7613a2b3730454cf9ea678999.source: Winter converts all elemental damage to cold damage, which deals more damage to Ruby Djinns.
0890f42fc0d71ad7613a2b3730454cf9ea678999.text: 寒冬 將所有元素傷害轉化為寒冷傷害，這對紅寶石魔靈造成更多傷害。

21ffb3da7eb2e8626ee19e38d44d8c69155e7940.source: Extinguish and Breath of the Great Dwarf remove Burning from all party members.
21ffb3da7eb2e8626ee19e38d44d8c69155e7940.text: 熄滅 和 偉大矮人 的呼吸消除了所有隊伍成員的燃燒。

9249e126b0dae137f63632f0f9254fd76d0afbf8.source: Frozen Soil will prevent the Roaring Ethers from using Resurrection Signet.
9249e126b0dae137f63632f0f9254fd76d0afbf8.text: 凍土 將阻止咆哮以太使用 復活紋章。

9cc61bb2fffc7a4c99ccc2111ff7361d0e12c5cb.source: The ethers are the only fleshy foes in Korshek's group, so it does not help much to bring skills that cause Bleeding, Disease, or Poison; similarly, skills that exploit corpses are ineffective for this battle.
9cc61bb2fffc7a4c99ccc2111ff7361d0e12c5cb.text: 以太是 Korshek 隊伍中唯一的肉質敵人，因此帶來導致 流血、疾病或 中毒 的技能並沒有多大幫助；同樣的，利用屍體的技能對於這場戰鬥也是無效的。

d39376e47c40801c94067eca316f8579f3a17730.source: Consider going to open the Do Not Touch Treasure in Forum Highlands after killing Korshek the Immolated, which is near the boss' location.
d39376e47c40801c94067eca316f8579f3a17730.text: 殺死靠近 Boss 位置的 宰殺者 科薛克 後，考慮開啟 高地廣場 中的請勿觸控寶藏。

cb9212f582299e2b8891bec6436d0e0b7c6e0032.source: Melonni Goes Recruiting neither active nor completed
cb9212f582299e2b8891bec6436d0e0b7c6e0032.text: 梅隆妮 開始招募既不活躍也不完成

5e6fe468a2f16c53e890d6d86fdb160389aa0a84.source: Take Koss to meet his contact on the Barbarous Shore.
5e6fe468a2f16c53e890d6d86fdb160389aa0a84.text: 帶著 寇斯 去見他在 野蠻河岸 上的聯絡人。

dbc1ef5c49debe5327773623575dde35ffd6e4a4.source: Help Hasahk the Clever defeat the corsairs.
dbc1ef5c49debe5327773623575dde35ffd6e4a4.text: 幫助聰明的哈薩克擊敗海盜。

e13e0eb376fa6dc07d9fbfdaa7b80f09b261db23.source: After picking up the quest, speak to Koss in the Command Post, then map to Camp Hojanu to head into the Barbarous Shore. From there, the quest pointer will lead you to Hasahk the Clever waiting a little to the south, nearby.
e13e0eb376fa6dc07d9fbfdaa7b80f09b261db23.text: 接到任務後，與 指揮所 中的 寇斯 交談，然後對應到 何加努營地 以進入 野蠻河岸。從那裡，任務指標將引導你找到聰明的哈薩克，他在附近南邊一點處等待著。

55cd937827fa0da8e98f6a1c53161921b4bf4ab7.source: After talking to Hasahk, a mob of corsairs will appear to the north, keen to recover the wares that Hasahk "borrowed" from them. Defeat the group to complete the quest.
55cd937827fa0da8e98f6a1c53161921b4bf4ab7.text: 與哈薩克交談後，一群海盜會出現在北方，熱衷於收回哈薩克從他們那裡「借來」的物品。擊敗小隊即可完成任務。

b7a8e361eb284c77d0a2c82f66f236dde08aabca.source: After completion of this quest, Hasahk the Clever will appear in the Command Post as a rare material trader NPC.
b7a8e361eb284c77d0a2c82f66f236dde08aabca.text: 完成此任務後，聰明的哈薩克將會以 稀有材料商 NPC 出現在 指揮所 中。

1e3ef83dcaa74f589936da5a9553a825dade1c06.source: Dunkoro also offers the quest Melonni Goes Recruiting. The player can only choose one of these quests, the other becoming unavailable, which is similar to the Mysterious Message quest.
1e3ef83dcaa74f589936da5a9553a825dade1c06.text: Dunkoro 也提供任務 梅隆妮 去招募。玩家只能選擇其中一個任務，另一個將不可用，這與 機密資訊 任務類似。

8e59be0d0957cda1553c81e94d63f2a6cd388859.source: Hasahk's presence in the Command Post bears no significance to the function of the Command Post since both types of material traders are already present.
8e59be0d0957cda1553c81e94d63f2a6cd388859.text: Hasahk 出現在 指揮所 中對於 指揮所 的功能沒有任何意義，因為兩種型別的材料貿易商都已經存在。

1bddfda3ee122b3adfdb7873f9aafd62a142f6aa.source: Take Koss to Yohlon Haven and speak with Herbalist Makala about the Elixir of Strength.
1bddfda3ee122b3adfdb7873f9aafd62a142f6aa.text: 將 寇斯 帶到 猶朗避難所 並與草藥師 Makala 談論 力量 的靈丹妙藥。

475ceec56fb07418111e78522e735280182ca096.source: Join Herbalist Makala on a zephyr hedger hunt in Arkjok Ward.
475ceec56fb07418111e78522e735280182ca096.text: 與 Herbalist Makala 一起在 阿爾科監禁區 中進行微風樹籬狩獵。

b6640458be540d4c0db3ed53e73eb8bfacd01b70.source: The potion is ready! Talk to Herbalist Makala to obtain it.
b6640458be540d4c0db3ed53e73eb8bfacd01b70.text: 藥水準備好了！與草藥師馬卡拉交談即可獲得它。

edfe8244cf6e4e0ce6d13d323bfe10baeb53d32a.source: Test your newfound strength by slaying Slort Nilbog.
edfe8244cf6e4e0ce6d13d323bfe10baeb53d32a.text: 殺死斯洛特·尼爾博格，測試你新獲得的力量。

917f6982fd69ed143db8be87c73b4973771c1e45.source: See Herbalist Makala for your reward.
917f6982fd69ed143db8be87c73b4973771c1e45.text: 請見草藥師馬卡拉以獲得獎勵。

995d9f0e4e674a346c090bf01727f9fa7bfb5e4f.source: Map to Yohlon Haven and speak to Herbalist Makala, then walk out into Arkjok Ward to begin the zephyr hedger hunt with him. Makala will direct the party to a point half-way up the west side of Arkjok Ward (see the map for exact location), where they will find a zephyr hedger to slay.
995d9f0e4e674a346c090bf01727f9fa7bfb5e4f.text: 地圖至 猶朗避難所 並與草藥師 Makala 交談，然後走進 阿爾科監禁區 與他一起開始追捕西風樹籬。馬卡拉將引導隊伍前往 阿爾科監禁區 西側中途的一個點（具體位置請參閱地圖），在那裡他們會找到一隻可以殺死的和風樹籬。

8cd524f346ed59b8fc91615f91c7971c0baa8bc1.source: Once it is slain, Makala will concoct his potion and dispense it to the party, which will give them the condition The Elixir of Strength, just in time to test it on the approaching creature: Slort Nilbog. Funnily enough, the potion doesn't make you any stronger, and while it's in effect, prevents you from attacking the creature.
8cd524f346ed59b8fc91615f91c7971c0baa8bc1.text: 一旦它被殺死，馬卡拉就會配製他的藥水並將其分發給隊伍，這將使他們獲得 力量 的藥劑，正好可以在接近的生物：斯洛特尼爾博格身上進行測試。有趣的是，該藥水並不會讓你變得更強大，而且在它生效時，會阻止你攻擊該生物。

0c5624d940283401817fba3e54b46a6138ea6f4f.source: Don't worry, the effect is soon dispelled by Makala and you can defeat Slort Nilbog normally.
0c5624d940283401817fba3e54b46a6138ea6f4f.text: 別擔心，效果很快就會被馬卡拉驅散，你可以正常擊敗斯洛特·尼爾博格。

83be5c1e2a1c6f975093a67fccf507a54b04cbc6.source: Although the quest isn't long in itself, it can be shortened with good preparation. Slort is vulnerable to damage from Traps and Spirits that are placed in his path before the elixir is taken. Since he is level 5, he dies easily, and the quest is instantly completed when he dies. Spirit Spammers can make short work of Slort, wiping him out in one or two seconds.
83be5c1e2a1c6f975093a67fccf507a54b04cbc6.text: 雖然任務本身並不長，但如果做好充分的準備，可以縮短它。在服用長生不老藥之前，斯洛特很容易受到放置在他路徑上的陷阱和靈魂的傷害。由於他的等級是5，所以他很容易死，而且任務在他死後立即完成。精神垃圾郵件傳送者可以在短時間內消滅斯洛特，在一兩秒鐘內消滅他。

d43c3c72e89594c1c4bf2ebfdc74194438505235.source: Necromancer Minions are apparently immune to the elixir's effect. If any remain from the Zephyr Hedger fight, minions may attack and kill Slort before the quest dialogue "The elixir should kick in any any second now..." even has a chance to display.
d43c3c72e89594c1c4bf2ebfdc74194438505235.text: 死靈法師 小兵明顯對聖水的效果免疫。如果 Zephyr Hedger 戰鬥留下任何痕跡，小兵可能會在任務對話「萬能藥現在隨時生效…」之前攻擊並殺死 Slort，甚至有機會展示。

70c272206cc5ca4fc2fea0d9193e09ff4d264d25.source: The effect of the elixir often does not end on henchmen, heroes, animal companions and sometimes the player character. However the effect is removed upon zone change or their death. Once in a while, Slort won't spawn.
70c272206cc5ca4fc2fea0d9193e09ff4d264d25.text: 萬能藥的效果通常不會止於追隨者、英雄、動物夥伴，有時甚至是玩家角色。然而，當區域改變或他們死亡時，效果就會被消除。偶爾，斯洛特不會生成。

83c1121f338089e5b0bf95eda1a962047ded6e85.source: Find and destroy Krak Flamewhip's elite cavalry unit in Jaga Moraine.
83c1121f338089e5b0bf95eda1a962047ded6e85.text: 找到並摧毀克拉克·火鞭在賈加冰磧的精銳騎兵部隊。

2dce87555f3b2e057a948fc128bdad3a759ed7ec.source: See Undrath Blastrock for your reward.
2dce87555f3b2e057a948fc128bdad3a759ed7ec.text: 請參閱 破石 安爪斯 以取得獎勵。

28473230cdf1c374edb70b7753a85169ab1ae9ba.source: Start from Sifhalla. Leave out through the portal and head east. Krak Flamwhip and his party of two Stone Summit Arcanists and four Stone Summit Herders patrol counter-clockwise around the southwest area of the zone. If you have difficulty finding them, try staying put near the resurrection shrine of Gunnleif at the middle of the map and let the patrol come to you. Kill the entire patrol, then return to Undrath for your reward.
28473230cdf1c374edb70b7753a85169ab1ae9ba.text: 從 襲哈拉 開始。通過傳送門離開並向東走。 Krak Flamwhip 和他的隊伍由兩名 石峰矮人 奧術師和四名 石峰矮人 牧民組成，在該區域的西南部逆時針巡邏。如果你很難找到他們，試著待在地圖中間的岡萊夫復活神殿附近，讓巡邏隊來找你。殺死整個巡邏隊，然後返回安德拉斯領取獎勵。

9e187d3887eeaf6a5558f5c0d40436481ce4b6a4.source: You can save time by combining this quest with A Hunter's Pride, Prenuptial Disagreement, and Anything You Can Do.
9e187d3887eeaf6a5558f5c0d40436481ce4b6a4.text: 您可以將此任務與 獵人的榮譽、破碎的婚約 和任何您可以做的事情結合起來，以節省時間。

e36b6b87b33f9014760caf7d3a325b04ee3d6d4c.source: Kill Kunvie Firewing in the Unwaking Waters.
e36b6b87b33f9014760caf7d3a325b04ee3d6d4c.text: 在不醒水域殺死 火翼 坤維。

cdf31a85d14c6e03451200ec540b759f331c4430.source: *BONUS* Kill Kunvie Firewing in Hard Mode.
cdf31a85d14c6e03451200ec540b759f331c4430.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 火翼 坤維。

f0251175d53093315c885631e1a402b237ded178.source: There is an Oni popup group just to the east of Kunvie, so it is important to spawn them separately and kill them well away from any possible aggro. Kunvie and their group hit hard, so make sure that one well-protected party member or a tank takes the multiple Ride the Lightning, and be sure the party is spread out to avoid multiple AoE skills. Also Pain Inverter helps a great deal in killing Kunvie.
f0251175d53093315c885631e1a402b237ded178.text: Kunvie 東邊有一個 Oni 彈出團體，因此單獨生成它們並在遠離任何可能的仇恨的地方殺死它們非常重要。 Kunvie 和他們的隊伍受到重擊，因此請確保一名受到良好保護的隊員或坦克使用多個 閃電傳送，並確保隊伍分散以避免多個 範圍性 技能。 苦痛 逆變器對於消滅 Kunvie 也有很大幫助。

4d3705b02ef78db01a62d1c8e0651a99f7754cad.source: Deliver the Kurzick supplies to Quartermaster Mikhail.
4d3705b02ef78db01a62d1c8e0651a99f7754cad.text: 將 庫茲柯 補給品交付給軍需官米哈伊爾。

b3c3497903bc33179d29d5687118a5bd1922abf1.source: About halfway, you will see Mugra Swiftspell and some Dredge. It is possible to sneak past this group without a fight. At the next fork, turn left and immediately right again. On this way you will encounter two groups of Wardens. Try to lure the second group near where you fought the first group, because next to the second group's spawn place will also be a Luxon and Oni popup location, which can be deadly for your party. When you can target Quartermaster Mikhail, there is only one popup group of Wardens left (in the narrow corridor) and a group of Luxons right in front of Mikhail. You can just run past both of these and get your quest reward.
b3c3497903bc33179d29d5687118a5bd1922abf1.text: 大約中途，你會看到 Mugra Swiftspell 和一些 挖掘者。不戰而屈人之兵是有可能溜過這群人的。在下一個岔路口左轉，然後立即右轉。在這條路上你會遇到兩組守望者。試著將第二組引誘到您與第一組戰鬥的位置附近，因為第二組的重生地點旁邊也將是 勒克森 和 Oni 彈出位置，這對您的隊伍來說可能是致命的。當你可以瞄準軍需官米哈伊爾時，只剩下一組彈出的守望者（在狹窄的走廊裡）和一組盧克森人就在米哈伊爾面前。你可以直接跑過這兩個地方並獲得任務獎勵。

31fe45404d65844f20483fe16c9379086e4049d6.source: You can rush through (using a running build) without fighting; you are not required to kill the Luxon groups.
31fe45404d65844f20483fe16c9379086e4049d6.text: 你可以在不戰鬥的情況下衝過去（使用正在執行的構建）；您不需要殺死 勒克森 組。

26b680fafecf95e42e0ac1cd17ba5850852101a4.source: This quest is suited well as a pointer for the way from House zu Heltzer to Lutgardis Conservatory, since Quartermaster Mikhail stands right in front of the entry to Lutgardis.
26b680fafecf95e42e0ac1cd17ba5850852101a4.text: 這個任務非常適合作為從 鳳荷議院 到 路嘉帝斯溫室 的指示，因為軍需官米哈伊爾就站在盧特加迪斯入口的前面。

f680638a8b6fb6a29c95d0099e3252e9fb010077.source: This quest works well with the other Ferndale repeatable quest Scouting Ferndale. The last group of that quest is not far from the beginning for this one, and the rewards are next to each other just outside Lutgardis Conservatory. Therefore start from Lutgardis, do Scouting Ferndale and finish with this quest.
f680638a8b6fb6a29c95d0099e3252e9fb010077.text: 此任務與其他 蕨谷 可重複任務偵察 蕨谷 搭配良好。此任務的最後一組距離本任務的開始並不遠，獎勵彼此相鄰，就在 路嘉帝斯溫室 之外。因此，從 Lutgardis 開始，進行 蕨谷 偵察並完成此任務。

2e4a72ac7603003ce9b829858485ccfdfa33f938.source: If Lutgardis Conservatory is under Luxon control, the Luxon Guards at the resurrection shrine will attack any hostile Luxons. Sometimes the Luxon groups will spawn even if this quest is not in your Quest Log, though once you have completed the quest they will not spawn again.
2e4a72ac7603003ce9b829858485ccfdfa33f938.text: 如果 路嘉帝斯溫室 受到 勒克森 的控制，則復活神殿的 勒克森 守衛將攻擊任何敵對的盧克森人。有時，即使此任務不在您的 任務 日誌中，勒克森 群組也會生成，但一旦您完成任務，它們將不會再次生成。

e5a7ddfd6322deb5523526a50169ff058f9b8472.source: Clear the Lahtenda Bog in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
e5a7ddfd6322deb5523526a50169ff058f9b8472.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 洛天帝沼澤。

cb9ebe8e17c7da0981d89ece638ac4740be0b49c.source: "Clear the Lahtenda Bog in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."
cb9ebe8e17c7da0981d89ece638ac4740be0b49c.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 洛天帝沼澤。”

f6927224bb0e11b4b18577c42b290d49b4f3ef80.source: Can only be accessed via the Blacktide Den outpost, even without completing the Blacktide Den mission beforehand. The primary quest War Preparations (Ghost Reconnaissance) will lead Nightfall characters to this area.
f6927224bb0e11b4b18577c42b290d49b4f3ef80.text: 即使沒有事先完成黑潮巢穴任務，也只能透過黑潮巢穴前哨站進入。主要任務「戰爭準備」（幽靈偵察）將引導 黑暗逆襲 角色前往該區域。

907e6b90fc60e79bf65c55869f0aa67f51f76353.source: This is one of the few areas in Guild Wars where the ambient environment of the area resembles nighttime.
907e6b90fc60e79bf65c55869f0aa67f51f76353.text: 這是 公會 Wars 中少數的周圍環境類似於夜間的區域之一。

cd8a47227a7b02595cb909a5eb8d76d44975b5ec.source: If a character completes the mission Blacktide Den and never actually enters the area separately, the label will not appear on their map. Keep this in mind when going for the Vanquisher and Cartographer titles.
cd8a47227a7b02595cb909a5eb8d76d44975b5ec.text: 如果角色完成了黑潮巢穴任務並且從未真正單獨進入該區域，則該標籤將不會出現在他們的地圖上。在購買 Vanquisher 和 版圖 遊戲時請記住這一點。

ba379ca4433f079fcd4b6cd77f8b5f48645046b5.source: Most, if not all, of the quests that take place here increase the total number of foes. The master difficulty quest What Do You Do with a Drunken Shauben? in particular will increase the total number of foes by at least a hundred.
ba379ca4433f079fcd4b6cd77f8b5f48645046b5.text: 大多數（如果不是全部）在這裡發生的任務都會增加敵人的總數。主難度任務「你對醉酒的肖本做什麼？」尤其是敵人總數至少會增加一百人。

b8e3ff213f733cf5cbaccca30b3b9d073ae9ec84.source: Habab the merchant is available if your bags are starting to get full.
b8e3ff213f733cf5cbaccca30b3b9d073ae9ec84.text: 如果您的行李開始滿了，商家 Habab 可以提供服務。

7d4a13f9075a2f1dfc44916ce094145433e797e2.source: Condition removal skills will come in handy here, due to the foes inflicting a variety of conditions, including disease, bleeding, and cripple.
7d4a13f9075a2f1dfc44916ce094145433e797e2.text: 由於敵人會造成各種狀況，包括疾病、流血和殘廢，因此狀況消除技能在這裡會派上用場。

c418b6e4d356d2cbb3a178170edbc86a9a9eca38.source: There are a lot of hidden Mandragors throughout this area, especially the northern half.
c418b6e4d356d2cbb3a178170edbc86a9a9eca38.text: 這個地區有很多隱藏的曼德拉角，尤其是北半部。

17d05bb5a35069514a5252e01a4b642957af0d1f.source: Rendezvous with the Obsidian Flame and prepare for the assault on the Shadow Blades.
17d05bb5a35069514a5252e01a4b642957af0d1f.text: 與 黑曜石火焰 會合併準備攻擊 闇影 刀片。

ca1b142297facfbc6f7412d41d219fcbf2db1868.source: Lead the Obsidian Flame to the place where the Shadow Blades are meeting. Destroy the rival organization.
ca1b142297facfbc6f7412d41d219fcbf2db1868.text: 將 黑曜石火焰 引導至 闇影 刀片相遇的位置。摧毀敵對組織。

1320b2a782f7e8faf42106cf11d41243b6695933.source: See Guildmaster Luan for your reward.

d11599ba611129dee7ab83c7737b9f515184e2bd.source: There are three ways to complete the quest. The first two reduce the number of foes before meeting with your allies, while the third attempts to reduce the threat on the Obsidian Flame (the "lambs") by exploiting the game mechanics. Following the most direct route tends to end in failing the quest because the assassins are dying very easily. Only one of your assassin allies needs to survive to get credit for the quest.
d11599ba611129dee7ab83c7737b9f515184e2bd.text: 有三種方法可以完成任務。前兩者是在與盟友會面之前減少敵人的數量，而第三個則嘗試利用遊戲機制來減少 黑曜石火焰（「羔羊」）的威脅。遵循最直接的路線往往會導致任務失敗，因為刺客很容易死亡。只有你的一名刺客盟友需要生存才能獲得任務的榮譽。

96f0db66e7fd99d16dfd1b8240a1a78849ff88c2.text: (1) 從 薇茹廣場（當地街區）出發

c51f9cb4888a24452d92529493a3c4d9e642065c.source: Exit Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) into the Undercity. Proceed across the bridge, killing the afflicted mob. Follow the route on the map to the north, avoiding The Afflicted Miju, then west (along the passage pointed to by the quest marker), and turn east. This provides enough time for the afflicted to pop out of the ground around the monk boss and approach the party.
c51f9cb4888a24452d92529493a3c4d9e642065c.text: 退出 薇茹廣場（本地區）進入幽暗城。繼續過橋，殺死受苦的暴民。沿著地圖上的路線向北走，避開受折磨的米朱，然後向西（沿著任務標記指向的通道），然後向東轉。這為受折磨的人提供了足夠的時間從僧侶老大周圍的地面上跳出來並接近隊伍。

e12aa28719814eee9565cdd0f19c41f7a5b5214c.source: Kill the nearest two mobs of afflicted and then the monk boss; being careful of Miju's Ray of Judgment, which can easily wipe your heroes or henchmen. Slowly kill the afflicted in the corridors leading to the west, luring mobs to avoid dual aggro. Once you reach the tunnel with the water droplets falling into a pool on the ground, return to the corridor where you fought Miju to fetch the Obsidian Flame Assassins.
e12aa28719814eee9565cdd0f19c41f7a5b5214c.text: 殺死最近的兩個受折磨的小怪，然後殺死僧侶老闆；小心 Miju 的 制裁目光，它可以輕鬆消滅你的英雄或追隨者。慢慢殺死通往西方的走廊中的受折磨者，引誘暴徒以避免雙重仇恨。一旦你到達隧道，水滴落入地面的水池中，回到與 Miju 戰鬥的走廊去拿 黑曜石火焰 刺客。

05eec2de82305ab67b5bb1c93ec9798f210c6f73.source: Lead them to the tunnel you just cleared, and beyond to the waiting Shadow Blade Assassins. Flag any heroes or henchmen into the mob of Shadow Blade Assassins. They will remain friendly until the end of a brief dialogue, after which they will attack both the party and the Obsidian Flame Assassins. If you have flagged the team well, you can defeat the Shadow Blades with little or no Obsidian Flame casualties.
05eec2de82305ab67b5bb1c93ec9798f210c6f73.text: 帶領他們前往您剛剛清理的隧道，並前往等待的 闇影 刀片刺客。將任何英雄或追隨者標記為 闇影 Blade Assassins 的暴民。他們將保持友好，直到簡短的對話結束，之後他們將攻擊隊伍和 黑曜石火焰 刺客。如果您對團隊進行了很好的標記，您就可以在很少或沒有 黑曜石火焰 傷亡的情況下擊敗 闇影 Blades。

b60b714b38d1ae18bd3c53945ff2d1b9f705d299.source: Non-Canthans without access to the Local Quarter can enter the Undercity from Wajjun Bazaar. You can speed things up considerably if you have Seek out Brother Tosai in your quest log, since this makes the Am Fah in the bazaar friendly. Once inside, proceed north and defeat the Am Fah within the Undercity on your way to the tunnel with the dripping water (near the quest marker on the map). Otherwise, follow the the same steps above.
b60b714b38d1ae18bd3c53945ff2d1b9f705d299.text: 無法進入本地街區的非凱森人可以從 瓦江市場 進入幽暗城。如果你在任務日誌中找到“尋找東齋兄弟”，你可以大大加快速度，因為這使得集市中的 安費 變得友好。進入內部後，繼續向北前進，在通往滴水隧道的途中擊敗幽暗城內的 安費（地圖上的任務標記附近）。否則，請按照上述相同步驟操作。

afefbecb2afe15d94dd63ee93b401b708899845b.source: This method is the most direct, but depends on a well balanced team of heroes and/or henchmen that you will micromanage. Take the north exit from the The Marketplace (toward Bukdek Byway), then head east, cross the first bridge, and head to the Undercity portal (only two foe groups are en route). The Obsidian Flame assassins are allied immediately on entering the Undercity. Instead of leading your allies into danger, flag the heroes ahead to engage foes while the quest holder remains safely behind with the assassins. Repeat this process until you reach the Shadow Blades and defeat them. The Obsidian Flame will say, "Come and face your nightmare, Shadow Blades", even though they are not within aggro range. As soon as the last Shadow Blade dies, the quest log will update and you can return for your reward.
afefbecb2afe15d94dd63ee93b401b708899845b.text: 這種方法是最直接的，但取決於你將進行微觀管理的平衡良好的英雄和/或追隨者團隊。從 市集 的北出口（朝 巴德克小徑）走，然後向東走，穿過第一座橋，前往幽暗城傳送門（途中只有兩個敵人小組）。 黑曜石火焰 刺客在進入幽暗城後立即結盟。不要讓你的盟友陷入危險，而是標記前方的英雄與敵人交戰，而任務持有者則安全地與刺客留在後面。重複此過程，直到到達 闇影 刀片並擊敗它們。 黑曜石火焰 會說：“來面對你的噩夢吧，闇影 刀片”，即使它們不在仇恨範圍內。一旦最後一次 闇影 Blade 死亡，任務日誌就會更新，您可以返回領取獎勵。

91d8c820f4fd154ab7b0bcb75c4a6e3e41f4ca32.source: It helps to eliminate the Afflicted along the route between the two groups before speaking with the Obsidian Flame Assassins, to prevent the assassins from being killed along the way and forcing you to restart the quest.
91d8c820f4fd154ab7b0bcb75c4a6e3e41f4ca32.text: 它有助於在與 黑曜石火焰 刺客交談之前消滅兩個隊伍之間路線上的受折磨者，以防止刺客沿途被殺死並迫使你重新開始任務。

cfa14ff59e58080d106032a9bbf43cd225e486e3.source: It can sometimes take several minutes after the first Shadow Blade assassin turns hostile for the rest to follow suit. Backtracking to the Obsidian Flame's rendezvous point may help to resolve this problem when it occurs.
cfa14ff59e58080d106032a9bbf43cd225e486e3.text: 有時，在第一個 闇影 Blade 刺客變得敵對之後，可能需要幾分鐘時間，其他人才會效仿。當問題發生時，回溯到 黑曜石火焰 的集合點可能有助於解決此問題。

a89016639d64dbbe20a9cf215cfd65a1a18f3420.source: Some of the dialogue is misleading:

c072453a6c10def51be126a28db1ce1ac174fc02.source: All the action takes place in the Undercity, but the Ask dialogue directs you to Shenzun Tunnels.
c072453a6c10def51be126a28db1ce1ac174fc02.text: 所有的行動都發生在幽暗城，但詢問對話方塊會引導您前往 申贊通道。

6214f19c4a9fe4ba72c5298d84a7dd7f6d5d841a.source: Although a Shadow Blade Assassin states, "her blade took three of my fingers", he appears to have all ten fingers intact.
6214f19c4a9fe4ba72c5298d84a7dd7f6d5d841a.text: 儘管 闇影 刀片 暗殺者 聲稱“她的刀片奪走了我的三個手指”，但他的十個手指似乎都完好無損。

50c896a2d3144a7f26bcb23cb2fb4cb0d2894d31.source: The Centaurs need more gray giant tusks. Collect [3...0] more before returning to the village.
50c896a2d3144a7f26bcb23cb2fb4cb0d2894d31.text: 半人馬需要更多的灰色巨牙。在返回村莊之前收集更多 [3...0]。

c105d3533c64580f58e12148e9ce16a794ad61f0.source: Any time you slay a Nomad Giant or a Sadistic Giant, they have a small chance of dropping a Giant Tusk. Collect 3 of these tusks and return them to Mirza Veldrunner for your reward.
c105d3533c64580f58e12148e9ce16a794ad61f0.text: 每當你殺死遊牧者 馴服的霜巨人 或虐待狂 馴服的霜巨人 時，他們都有很小的機會掉落 馴服的霜巨人 獠牙。收集 3 這些象牙並將它們歸還給 Mirza Veldrunner 以獲得獎勵。

4fbe5da0c41db54fbce9b7b373ea76619bd772ef.source: The three Giant Tusks can be collected quite rapidly by going in and out of any portal to The Shattered Ravines with a solo build and repeatedly killing the nearby giants. The 3 giants by the entrance to Lair of the Forgotten are particularly convenient.
4fbe5da0c41db54fbce9b7b373ea76619bd772ef.text: 透過單獨建造並反覆殺死附近的巨人，進出 碎裂溝谷 的任何門戶，可以非常快速地收集三個 馴服的霜巨人 象牙。 被遺忘者的巢穴 入口處的 3 巨人特別方便。

55f655a26de40ee15e3cc8291df71387023a59c6.source: The quest log mentions slaying gray giants and collecting gray giant tusks, but what is actually needed are regular giant tusks which drop from Nomad Giants and Sadistic Giants (and not from Awakened Gray Giants).
55f655a26de40ee15e3cc8291df71387023a59c6.text: 任務日誌提到殺死灰色巨人和收集灰色巨人像牙，但實際需要的是從遊牧巨人和虐待巨人（而不是從覺醒的灰色巨人）掉落的常規巨型象牙。

834b0f30ae19b24ef0bd0db038a202e68ea57328.source: Travel to Bjora Marches and enlist the help of the tundra wolves, 6 of 6 remaining.
834b0f30ae19b24ef0bd0db038a202e68ea57328.text: 前往 碧拉邊境 尋求苔原狼的協助，剩下 6 或 6。

75aebdf68f36fa2862f96fd229573c134cd318b4.source: Head south to meet the oncoming Destroyer threat.
75aebdf68f36fa2862f96fd229573c134cd318b4.text: 向南前進，迎接即將到來的驅逐艦威脅。

16765ce7107961d2a7e0d26d9b0f1445629a6f9d.text: 卷軸 英雄 的見解

37feedf6900ad02d31eabf5c3315a39f495b5e49.source: For 10 minutes your party gains double XP from combat.
37feedf6900ad02d31eabf5c3315a39f495b5e49.text: 在 10 分鐘內，你的隊伍從戰鬥中獲得雙倍 XP。

186a97f874c5ed3ff7522be0021ea519074775fa.source: After obtaining this quest from Hogni Truthseeker in Drakkar Lake, you can map travel to either Longeye's Ledge or Gunnar's Hold. If starting from Longeye's Ledge, travel west until you reach the cave of Tundra Wolves (point 1 on the map). If starting from Gunnar's Hold, travel north to the cave. Along with the wolves will be an Alpha Tundra Wolf. You'll need to defeat all of them in battle in order for them to become allies. Travel south to point 2 on the map where you will be faced with four waves of 3-4 Destroyers, in Hard Mode they will be in larger groups of 4-5. Wait for them to come to you in order to buy a little time between each encounter so you can regenerate health and energy. Take care not to enter the portal to Norrhart Domains while fighting, as in that case you will have to begin again by defeating the wolves. Once you defeat the Destroyers, map travel to Olafstead and head to Hogni Truthseeker to obtain your reward.
186a97f874c5ed3ff7522be0021ea519074775fa.text: 在 卓卡湖 中從 真實追尋者 霍格尼 取得此任務後，您可以將旅行對應到 長眼巖脈 或 甘拿的佔領地。如果從 長眼巖脈 出發，向西行駛，直到到達苔原狼的洞穴（地圖上的 1 點）。如果從 甘拿的佔領地 出發，向北前往洞穴。與狼一起的還有 Alpha Tundra 狼。你需要在戰鬥中擊敗所有人才能讓他們成為盟友。向南行駛到地圖上的 2 點，在那裡您將面臨四波 3-4 驅逐艦，在困難模式下它們將處於更大的 4-5 群體中。等待他們來找你，以便在每次遭遇之間爭取一點時間，這樣你就可以恢復健康和能量。戰鬥時注意不要進入諾拉特領域的傳送門，否則你將不得不通過擊敗狼重新開始。擊敗毀滅者後，請前往 尤拉夫之地 並前往 真實追尋者 霍格尼 以獲得獎勵。

3202dbeec3d9b5cca5191be290da0b7075ecca62.source: After defeating the Destroyers, any surviving wolves will remain with your party and so can be useful in killing foes in or vanquishing Bjora Marches.
3202dbeec3d9b5cca5191be290da0b7075ecca62.text: 擊敗毀滅者後，任何倖存的狼將留在你的隊伍中，因此可以在殺死敵人或擊敗 碧拉邊境 時發揮作用。

89f73a2eae3d37481ef673c7677ed0c9af6a80bc.source: Meet Imperial Guard Lei Jeng in Xaquang Skyway
89f73a2eae3d37481ef673c7677ed0c9af6a80bc.text: 在 夏安便道 中認識禁軍雷正

6ffa2496f1fd110afe1f3cc2a3f9c13118d37c10.source: Find and capture the missing Fire Drakes: [5...0] of 5 remaining.
6ffa2496f1fd110afe1f3cc2a3f9c13118d37c10.text: 找到並捕捉失蹤的火龍：剩餘 5 的 [5...0]。

e13919e1dc44af59b563b077c8e4da80bdff8fb2.source: Prevent the Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood from taking the Drakes.
e13919e1dc44af59b563b077c8e4da80bdff8fb2.text: 防止 安費 和 翡翠兄弟會 奪走 Drakes。

a76a33c0a4ce40e0c1211144620277cd856ad78e.source: Start from Senji's Corner and pick up Lei Jeng a little ways off to the west of the exit. You will see a "Heat Gauge" bar that you will use to find the Missing Fire Drakes. The bar goes from blue to red. When filled, it means your party is very close to a Fire Drake. Note that the gauge actually shows Lei Jeng's proximity, not your character's proximity. You must locate the Fire Drakes in the correct order, as they do not spawn all at once.
a76a33c0a4ce40e0c1211144620277cd856ad78e.text: 從 山吉之街 出發，在出口西邊不遠的地方接 Lei Jeng。您將看到一個“熱量計”欄，您可以用它來尋找失蹤的火龍。條形從藍色變為紅色。填滿後，表示您的隊伍非常接近 Fire 龍獸。請注意，儀表實際上顯示的是 Lei Jeng 的接近度，而不是您角色的接近度。您必須按照正確的順序找到火龍，因為它們不會同時生成。

ae97c632890af4e2e99e8e4ecf7281f783d13281.source: Start by heading east towards the corner, where you will find the first Drake. Bring its life down and it will join as an ally. The second drake is towards the northwest of the first. This one will initially run away. Just follow it until it turns hostile, then defeat it. The third drake is past the burnt area filled with Vermin, accompanied by Am Fah that turns hostile as you approach. The fourth drake is east of the third, on the other side of the map. It's accompanied by a group of Jade Brotherhood. The final drake is at the exit to Bukdek Byway, where you will have to fight both Am Fah and the Jade Brotherhood. (They will not attack each other).
ae97c632890af4e2e99e8e4ecf7281f783d13281.text: 首先向東走到拐角處，您會在那裡找到第一個 龍獸。降低它的生命力，它就會作為盟友加入。第二條龍位於第一條龍的西北方。這個人一開始會逃跑。只要跟隨它，直到它變得敵對，然後擊敗它。第三隻幼龍經過充滿 寄生蟲 的燒焦區域，伴隨著 安費，當您接近時，安費 會變得充滿敵意。第四條龍位於第三龍的東邊，位於地圖的另一邊。它伴隨著一群 翡翠兄弟會。最後的龍位於 巴德克小徑 的出口處，在那裡你必須與 安費 和 翡翠兄弟會 戰鬥。 （他們不會互相攻擊）。

29019470e13b2407a8e07360bac563a37377b12a.source: The quest will succeed even if your allies die: Lei Jeng and any rescued Fire Drakes will resurrect automatically.
29019470e13b2407a8e07360bac563a37377b12a.text: 即使你的盟友死亡，任務也會成功：雷震和任何獲救的火龍都會自動復活。

9bd4b04b57a16b87f11bc8bef2e0c4bcf251e48d.source: Consider Vanquishing Xaquang Skyway at the same time:
9bd4b04b57a16b87f11bc8bef2e0c4bcf251e48d.text: 同時考慮消滅 夏安便道：

2eb830e3e24fcfbf21cb4e92078dd1d9aabb892b.source: You need to kill most of the local enemies to complete the quest; there will be relatively few left.
2eb830e3e24fcfbf21cb4e92078dd1d9aabb892b.text: 你需要殺死大部分當地敵人才能完成任務；剩下的將會相對較少。

440a2b7f8523278d42dc601d1fcb628ecaaefb05.source: Although the 182 foes will be tougher (i.e. Hard mode spawns from Winds of Change) and they will be slightly greater in number, you will have Lei Jeng and rescued Fire Drakes as allies.
440a2b7f8523278d42dc601d1fcb628ecaaefb05.text: 雖然 182 的敵人會更強大（即 困難模式 從 變幻之風 生成）並且數量會稍微多一些，但你將有雷晶和獲救的火龍作為盟友。

a0fabe69a1e0ccbd12b4e3236a82d9fa37533fc1.source: Save the fifth Drake until near the end, since this allows you to keep your allies.
a0fabe69a1e0ccbd12b4e3236a82d9fa37533fc1.text: 將第五個 龍獸 儲存到接近尾聲，因為這可以讓你保留你的盟友。

51e274c88a2312df22cc9689a39290567ffb99b9.source: While this quest is active, Ghial the Bone Dancer and Orosen, Tranquil Acolyte will not spawn.
51e274c88a2312df22cc9689a39290567ffb99b9.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，骨之舞者 葛西 和奧羅森，寧靜的侍僧將不會產生。

0206f37433701fcca1ec53a773fd6760632f7e79.source: The spawn points of the Missing Fire Drakes in this quest are different from the spawn points of the normal mode version.
0206f37433701fcca1ec53a773fd6760632f7e79.text: 此任務中失蹤的火龍的生成點與普通模式版本的生成點不同。

cf5c1a99ea79e2b142a4a45677eb43b9edba1589.source: Once this quest is completed, the Old Chest will no longer spawn in Wajjun Bazaar.
cf5c1a99ea79e2b142a4a45677eb43b9edba1589.text: 一旦此任務完成，舊的 寶箱 將不再在 瓦江市場 中產生。

8e5182b0f29e1cff0bbd81016c3c8a9aac73316c.source: Starting from Nahpui Quarter, follow the upper-level street that is right next to Paomu and Qian. Continue following it down, fighting Am Fah along the way, until you find an Old Chest. Click on it to receive the Tattered Bear quest item. Return it to Kaya for your reward.
8e5182b0f29e1cff0bbd81016c3c8a9aac73316c.text: 從 納普區 出發，沿著跑木和錢旁的上層街道行駛。繼續追蹤它，一路與 安費 戰鬥，直到找到舊的 寶箱。點選它即可接收破爛熊任務物品。將其 影返 給 Kaya 以獲得獎勵。

bcb88032989bfb07a69944be7ce94083dd7c7973.source: If you have Seek out Brother Tosai active in your Quest Log, you will not have to fight any of the Am Fah at all.
bcb88032989bfb07a69944be7ce94083dd7c7973.text: 如果您在 任務 日誌中活躍地尋找 Tosai 兄弟，您根本不需要與任何 安費 戰鬥。

decb937431a5f0b8bffdfa1b999b2d18ee84dfd0.source: Acquire a bear pelt. Many bears can be found in Wizard's Folly.
decb937431a5f0b8bffdfa1b999b2d18ee84dfd0.text: 獲得熊皮。在 巫師的怪異建築 中可以找到許多熊。

040ad386c2fb65d6497c1f9b62c46cdd8c5549f2.source: Take the bear pelt to Alison the Tanner in Ashford.
040ad386c2fb65d6497c1f9b62c46cdd8c5549f2.text: 將熊皮帶到阿什福德的 皮革匠艾莉森。

2f920efe3a7dfdd246c0c61873fcc4b06c03910e.source: Go to Barradin Estate in Green Hills County and deliver the cloak to Little Thom.
2f920efe3a7dfdd246c0c61873fcc4b06c03910e.text: 前往 綠丘郡 的巴拉丁莊園，將斗篷交給 小湯姆。

44997af0c39347982fafadf3f6fe54aa86f8b434.source: Battle Axe of Fortitude (Serpent Axe skin)
44997af0c39347982fafadf3f6fe54aa86f8b434.text: 堅韌的 戰斧（蛇 斧 皮膚）

ff0ce7b5164b13d181dc79a2472c697c734c30e2.text: 庇護 的 藤杖（支配魔法 皮膚）

429c044a540299bf0692b494717c387ec91a5f41.source: You can find Wizard's Folly southwest of Ashford. Follow the road and signs and go through the portal. From there, you will see a snowy area, though don't go there. Instead, you can find Black Bears roaming the green surrounding it. Kill them until one of them drops a bear pelt. Return it to Alison, and you'll be given the cloak. Travel to the Barradin Estate and give it to Thom to be rewarded.
429c044a540299bf0692b494717c387ec91a5f41.text: 您可以在阿什福德西南方找到 巫師的怪異建築。遵循道路和標誌並通過門戶。從那裡，你會看到一片雪地，但不要去那裡。相反，您會發現黑熊在周圍的綠地裡漫步。殺死他們，直到其中一個掉落熊皮。將其影返給艾莉森，你就會得到斗篷。前往巴拉丁莊園並將其交給湯姆以獲得獎勵。

782ed75ed3583462b787290ae164bee15e3f11cd.source: The reward wand Cane of Shelter is unique among wands: it consists of the Cane (domination version) and Staff Wrapping of Shelter; normally these items cannot be combined in any way. This wrapping can be salvaged from the cane, but cannot be attached back or replaced with any other staff wrapping.
782ed75ed3583462b787290ae164bee15e3f11cd.text: 庇護的獎勵魔杖藤杖在魔杖中是獨一無二的：它由藤杖（統治版本）和庇護的法杖把手組成；通常這些專案不能以任何方式組合。這種包裝材料可以從手杖上回收，但不能貼回或用任何其他員工包裝材料替換。

40af38042af53af56a099f66db2124df6eae419a.source: Investigate the source of the malfunctioning golems.

654db2d49e5f9ee02d79e51aeb934aeb48947844.source: Defeat the total protection security regulator golem.
654db2d49e5f9ee02d79e51aeb934aeb48947844.text: 擊敗全面保護安全調節器傀儡。

c26d1710cdade2906e5151a4bb7b32294bbd6224.text: 請參閱 布林姆 以取得獎勵。

a1a5843f3064f4f714a8d532c8d9a44e0cdfc03b.source: Enter the dungeon and make your way south, defeating enemies along the path. When you reach an oakheart grove lit by blue wisps, your party leader will remark on a patch of blue, crystalline ground. Patches like this are scattered throughout the dungeon and inflict the Crippled and Dazed conditions if stepped on, so be careful to avoid them while you are in danger. Once you reach the southern wall, turn west and you will come to a large area with numerous grawl and some Charr, as well as a Dungeon Lock. Make sure to go relatively close to the lock so that objective 3 updates properly, otherwise you'll need backtrack later. You can avoid most of these enemies if you turn sharply to the north and cross the crystalline ground under a Titan effigy, but make sure that you approach close enough to trigger your character's dialogue.
a1a5843f3064f4f714a8d532c8d9a44e0cdfc03b.text: 進入地牢並向南前進，擊敗沿途的敵人。當你到達一片被藍色光芒照亮的橡心樹林時，你的隊伍領袖會在一塊藍色水晶地面上發表評論。像這樣的補丁散佈在整個地牢中，如果踩到就會造成 殘癈 和 暈眩 狀況，所以在遇到危險時要小心避開它們。到達南牆後，向西轉，您將來到一大片區域，那裡有許多穴居人和一些 夏爾，以及 地監 鎖。確保相對靠近鎖，以便目標 3 正確更新，否則稍後您需要回溯。如果你急速轉向北方並穿過 泰坦 雕像下的水晶地面，你可以避開大部分敵人，但要確保你足夠接近以觸發角色的對話。

64c4dbb1945c1ba0e73b0d85a7277ca1cbc19832.source: Continue north along the route towards the quest marker. You will have to defeat or run past one group of four Charr similar to those in the Northlands; be aware that Vanguard Initiate does not function in the dungeon, so you may have less armor than you are used to. At the top of the winding path, you will find a lever which you can pull to open the exit leading back into the Northlands. Make sure the quest is listed as complete in your quest log before you leave; you can then map travel directly back to Piken Square to claim the reward from Adept Mullenix.
64c4dbb1945c1ba0e73b0d85a7277ca1cbc19832.text: 沿著路線繼續向北前往任務標記。您將必須擊敗或跑過一組由四個人組成的 夏爾，類似於北地的情況；請注意，先鋒啟動在地牢中不起作用，因此您的護甲可能比平時要少。在蜿蜒小路的頂部，您會發現一個控制桿，拉動控制桿即可開啟返回北地的出口。離開之前，請確保任務在任務日誌中列為已完成；然後，您可以將旅行直接對應回 派肯廣場，以從 Adept Mullenix 領取獎勵。

97e2b51b9e786301a93030604dd81c470ed94fd7.source: Although this quest can be acquired without Reforged Mode enabled, the quest objectives and dialogue will not progress while any member of the party is not in Reforged Mode.
97e2b51b9e786301a93030604dd81c470ed94fd7.text: 雖然可以在未啟用重鑄模式的情況下完成此任務，但當隊伍的任何成員未處於重鑄模式時，任務目標和對話將不會取得進展。

f81dcfded7c407d9babb30826d88ae65e7192804.source: Adding a player without Reforged Mode to the party will prevent enemies from spawning in the northern part of the Northlands, making it significantly easier to reach the Forsaken Tunnels. The quest can still be completed if all players without Reforged Mode log out or map travel away before entering the dungeon.
f81dcfded7c407d9babb30826d88ae65e7192804.text: 將沒有重鑄模式的玩家新增到隊伍中將阻止敵人在北地北部生成，從而更容易到達被遺忘的隧道。如果所有沒有重鑄模式的玩家在進入地牢之前退出或離開地圖，任務仍然可以完成。

d4cd229221eea0cee043b99b1c49adfb13c9f723.source: The Forsaken Tunnels cannot be entered if either Across the Wall or A Bastion In the North is active in the map.
d4cd229221eea0cee043b99b1c49adfb13c9f723.text: 如果地圖中啟動了 通過城牆 或北方堡壘，則無法進入被遺忘者隧道。

cab683860a76ef790553e9d053b43261b97575df.source: Along with some lower level foes, foes here are level 6-8, and never more than 4 in a group.
cab683860a76ef790553e9d053b43261b97575df.text: 與一些較低階的敵人一起，這裡的敵人等級為 6-8，並且在群體中永遠不會超過 4。

feb309fd2da0ab2758471a7ff857b5ca8ba71d53.source: The quest marker for objective 3 is misleading. The star is close to the exit, but the objective only updates when you get close to the Dungeon Lock. The gate before the exit from the tunnels has no collision, and can be passed through regardless of whether the lever has been pulled. After exiting the Forsaken Tunnels, the quest marker is placed in The Northlands. To complete the quest, travel to Piken Square (pre-Searing) and talk to Adept Mullenix. The player's dialogue lines will trigger multiple times if there is more than one player in the party with the quest active. It is possible to skip the second dialogue if the player goes through the trapped area with crystals to the right. If doing so, quest objectives won't properly update. If the player exits the area through the final portal, all quest objectives will be reset, forcing the player to go all the way back to the first entrance (having to go twice through the tunnels with respawned enemies).
feb309fd2da0ab2758471a7ff857b5ca8ba71d53.text: 目標 3 的任務標記具有誤導性。星星靠近出口，但目標僅在您靠近 地監 鎖時更新。隧道出口前的閘門無碰撞，無論拉桿是否拉動都可以通過。退出被遺忘者隧道後，任務標記會被放置在 北國 中。要完成任務，請前往 派肯廣場（崩壞 之前）並與 Adept Mullenix 交談。如果隊伍中有多於一名玩家正在執行任務，則玩家的對話將會多次觸發。如果玩家穿過右側有水晶的被困區域，則可以跳過第二個對話。如果這樣做，任務目標將無法正確更新。如果玩家透過最終傳送門退出該區域，則所有任務目標都將被重置，迫使玩家一路回到第一個入口（必須與重生的敵人一起穿過隧道兩次）。

15a10926f92575523e097a4fc900a11226af52fa.source: Kill Lord Jadoth in the City of Torc'qua.
15a10926f92575523e097a4fc900a11226af52fa.text: 在托克誇的 城市 中殺死 霸王 賈多司。

dff75a4b3d3182235e78de1dc1c2d197175974a1.source: *BONUS* Kill Lord Jadoth in Hard Mode.
dff75a4b3d3182235e78de1dc1c2d197175974a1.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 霸王 賈多司。

02e8cd66a0b0eed297fe030f6663835f44a8833f.source: In the City of Torc'qua, complete the quest The City of Torc'qua to spawn Lord Jadoth. See Mallyx the Unyielding (quest) for tactics against him.
02e8cd66a0b0eed297fe030f6663835f44a8833f.text: 在托克誇的 城市 中，完成托克誇的 城市 任務以產生 霸王 賈多司。參見不屈者馬裡克斯（任務）來瞭解對抗他的戰術。

3e5da7351d226798e88821a37d7c1f48e9e814f9.source: In the first level, you must kill Xien to get the dungeon key. He appears and disappears at several points in the dungeon. Just keep heading towards level two and you'll eventually be allowed to kill him for the key. The boss icons on the map for this level mark the locations of Flame Guardians. For an easier trip, destroy these boss Golems to disable the Fire Dart traps along the way.
3e5da7351d226798e88821a37d7c1f48e9e814f9.text: 在第一關中，你必須殺死西恩才能獲得地牢鑰匙。他在地牢的幾個地方出現又消失。只要繼續向第二級前進，你最終就會被允許殺死他以獲得鑰匙。該關卡地圖上的 Boss 圖示標示了火焰守護者的位置。為了更輕鬆的旅行，摧毀這些頭目傀儡以停用沿途的火鏢陷阱。

d9ab302de957083590706b000e6df82f75b8b807.source: To obtain the dungeon key you must destroy the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem. In order to destroy the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem, you need to pick up the nearby Flux Matrix and bring it to the Unstable Magical Energy Storage, then drop it next to the Golem to damage it. This may take 2-3 times until the Malfunctioning Enduring Golem is finally destroyed.
d9ab302de957083590706b000e6df82f75b8b807.text: 要獲得地牢鑰匙，您必須摧毀故障的持久傀儡。為了摧毀故障的持久魔像，您需要拿起附近的 流量 矩陣並將其帶到不穩定的魔法 能量儲存 處，然後將其扔到魔像旁邊以對其造成傷害。這可能需要 2-3 次，直到故障永續性傀儡最終被摧毀。

5526941bc1451389aa4c2727533ad18f30ee398d.source: In the third level, destroying one of the the 2 Flame Guardians will disable half the Fire Dart traps around the TPS Regulator Golem. Destroying both Flame Guardians will disable all the Fire Dart traps within the area. To make destroying the TPS Regulator Golem easier, you can attempt to lure the Flame Guardians and/or the TPS Regulator Golem down the stairs of the Fire Dart trapped area. After destroying the TPS Regulator Golem, Oola's Chest will appear within the area of the Fire Dart traps, so it is recommended to destroy the Flame Guardians.
5526941bc1451389aa4c2727533ad18f30ee398d.text: 在第三級中，摧毀其中一個 2 火焰守護者將停用 TPS調節高輪 周圍一半的火鏢陷阱。摧毀兩個火焰守護者將停用該區域內的所有火鏢陷阱。為了更容易摧毀 TPS調節高輪，您可以嘗試將火焰守護者和/或 TPS調節高輪 引誘下火鏢陷阱區域的樓梯。消滅TPS調節高輪後，烏拉的寶箱會出現在火鏢陷阱區域內，所以建議消滅火焰守護者。

af28365720124ebe5a2c9d6add0af96e2e98f011.source: The golems tend to bunch up together since they are warriors and dervishes. Bringing skills that cause area of effect damage is recommended.
af28365720124ebe5a2c9d6add0af96e2e98f011.text: 由於傀儡是戰士和苦行僧，所以它們往往會聚集在一起。建議攜帶會造成範圍傷害的技能。

d5ff9a9c90cd603fba6ee2a93a36cdef2f4fdbaa.source: Minion masters will find that there are few corpses to animate and Skelk Corrupters use Verata's Aura.
d5ff9a9c90cd603fba6ee2a93a36cdef2f4fdbaa.text: 小兵大師會發現幾乎沒有屍體可以動畫，而 Skelk Corrupters 使用 芙瑞達的靈氣。

0ce3b2d784312e9fc3e8fc21005daa897c8f25ba.source: Conditions are prevalent here, especially blindness and burning. Skills to remove conditions are very helpful.
0ce3b2d784312e9fc3e8fc21005daa897c8f25ba.text: 這裡的情況很普遍，尤其是失明和燒傷。消除條件的技能非常有幫助。

ac5f969039619e57509912a77798bc97a47a4320.source: Do not confuse this dungeon with the entry in the Hero's Handbook - which is also called Oola's Lab. Despite having the same name, the handbook requires you to complete the quest The Elusive Golemancer.
ac5f969039619e57509912a77798bc97a47a4320.text: 不要將此地下城與 英雄 手冊（也稱為 Oola 實驗室）中的條目混淆。儘管名稱相同，手冊要求您完成任務 烏拉的實驗室。

5998d7b702d46cc3b04b353ddae03bbd1c4951fc.source: Insects and golems are both hostile to each other. You can use this to your advantage.
5998d7b702d46cc3b04b353ddae03bbd1c4951fc.text: 昆蟲和魔像都是相互敵對的。您可以利用這一點來發揮自己的優勢。

457f434a398637455962c84105f2438cda2728e9.source: A Bastion In the North completed

c77a49b997cccef04c8f2001b196d9f9f6b4b55e.source: Find a way into the underground tunnels.
c77a49b997cccef04c8f2001b196d9f9f6b4b55e.text: 找到進入地下隧道的方法。

98a69c577fc7cc8a0cb0267466229dfd9ae6115f.source: Explore the remainder of this floor.
98a69c577fc7cc8a0cb0267466229dfd9ae6115f.text: 探索這一層的其餘部分。

44a8dbeec6bd5727289f263c6b79c3affc3f7a83.source: Exit the tunnels and report to Adept Mullenix.
44a8dbeec6bd5727289f263c6b79c3affc3f7a83.text: 退出隧道並向穆勒尼克大師報告。

105e4e2fb5431a42f29f58278f2d2084e72c3fd2.text: 元素生物 水晶碎片

8baa4e09fdbc8bea87961fef684b31f4466414b6.source: The gate barring the western entrance to the Forsaken Tunnels dungeon opens after completing this quest.
8baa4e09fdbc8bea87961fef684b31f4466414b6.text: 完成此任務後，封鎖被遺忘隧道地牢西入口的大門將開啟。

a94e6382d51384af5b538434457761a30d29c422.source: Exit Piken Square through the northern gate and head northeast until you reach a bridge leading north, then loop around on the west side through some Charr groups and pass under the same bridge. Continue east and a little bit north, then turn southeast across another bridge, and you will come to a Charr campsite. Alternatively, you can reach the campsite by crossing the large southeastern bridge near Piken Square, then following the northern cliff and passing through a Charr-infested ruin, continuing a little further north on the other side. Just to the north of the campsite along a dirt path, you will find a small cave entrance nestled behind a tree and guarded by a lone Cave Elemental. Within that cave is an entrance to the Forsaken Tunnels.
a94e6382d51384af5b538434457761a30d29c422.text: 從北門退出 派肯廣場，然後向東北走，直到到達一座通往北方的橋，然後在西側繞過一些 夏爾 組，從同一座橋下穿過。繼續向東，稍微向北行駛，然後向東南轉，跨過另一座橋，您將來到 夏爾 露營地。或者，您可以穿過 派肯廣場 附近的東南大橋到達露營地，然後沿著北部懸崖前進，穿過 夏爾 出沒的廢墟，在另一側繼續向北走一點。就在露營地的北部，沿著一條土路，您會發現一個小洞穴入口，坐落在一棵樹後面，並由一個孤獨的 元素生物 洞穴守衛。那個洞穴內有一個通往被遺忘者隧道的入口。

4f25cbf1e130409a4a3451442af2dcbfd94cb6d6.source: The Zaishen quest only requires killing Lord Jadoth himself, but doing a bit of extra work to kill his mob will progress the Mallyx the Unyielding quest and reward you with a Torc'qua Chest.
4f25cbf1e130409a4a3451442af2dcbfd94cb6d6.text: Zaishen 任務只需要殺死 霸王 賈多司 本人，但做一些額外的工作來殺死他的生物將推進 Mallyx the Unyielding 任務並獎勵你一個 Torc'qua 寶箱。

8a115e4b6a85f320fd593da0d1d670f2c4c1b549.source: Kill Lord Khobay in the Lake of Fire.
8a115e4b6a85f320fd593da0d1d670f2c4c1b549.text: 在火湖殺死 領主庫貝。

80b45e8d6f43ccbe8e6942558bef20712710fb17.source: *BONUS* Kill Lord Khobay in Hard Mode.
80b45e8d6f43ccbe8e6942558bef20712710fb17.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 領主庫貝。

216d71c4ddc8f1c63d1181a02342af5426041b95.source: As per the quest Khobay the Betrayer.

ed7f4791ee58abe1a88bff1484c998cefb0f3a85.source: Clear Lornar's Pass in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
ed7f4791ee58abe1a88bff1484c998cefb0f3a85.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 南席娃山脈 中的 洛拿斯通道。

3bd9d9b859393ca88fd4a717977f6a809dae9c2a.source: "Clear Lornar's Pass in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
3bd9d9b859393ca88fd4a717977f6a809dae9c2a.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的南席娃山脈中的洛拿斯通道。”

5e3a15ce6784881bb7fbe26d9bc2f13064761818.source: The main difficulty is the Stone Summit in a fort on the eastern side of the map. Two particularly large groups are located there, one of which contains two Dolyak Masters and one Dolyak Rider. See the talk page for discussion and tips on how to defeat this mob.
5e3a15ce6784881bb7fbe26d9bc2f13064761818.text: 主要困難是地圖東側堡壘中的石峰矮人。那裡有兩個特別大的團體，其中一個包含兩名 Dolyak Master 和一個 石犛牛騎士。請參閱討論頁面，以瞭解有關如何擊敗生物的討論和技巧。

b99027ea85d66eb1da16c98e0eac39529fe42965.source: It is recommended to start from Camp Rankor and vanquish Snake Dance and Dreadnought's Drift along the way. While this takes a while, you have a party of 8, making it easier than starting from Beacon's Perch.
b99027ea85d66eb1da16c98e0eac39529fe42965.text: 建議從藍口營地開始，一路擊敗蛇舞和無懼者之丘。雖然這需要一段時間，但您有一個 8 聚會，這比從 畢肯高地 開始更容易。

09d1403f2f0b57005372207dd8ad365917c47104.source: The Grawl Crones use Verata's Aura - make sure you have a way to deal with this if your party includes a minion master.
09d1403f2f0b57005372207dd8ad365917c47104.text: 穴居人 克隆人使用 芙瑞達的靈氣 - 如果您的隊伍中有小兵大師，請確保您有辦法處理這個問題。

57a5c8e3670cb5b6390d1f9234863a1e5e8d5fbc.source: The hidden Frost Wurms are mostly along the path that circles the frozen lake as well as north of the tunnel that connects to that path.
57a5c8e3670cb5b6390d1f9234863a1e5e8d5fbc.text: 隱藏的冰霜亞龍大多位於圍繞冰凍湖的路徑以及連線該路徑的隧道以北。

08ddb8b8ad1aed0bc241649c329c4c85da08f142.source: In normal mode, if you enter this area from Beacon's Perch, you will need heroes instead of henchmen, because the latter are too low level compared to the foes here.
08ddb8b8ad1aed0bc241649c329c4c85da08f142.text: 在普通模式下，如果你從畢肯高地進入這個區域，你將需要英雄而不是追隨者，因為後者與這裡的敵人相比等級太低。

07719ce86129423cafca7ba910c680f581c397d7.source: When trying to enter the Underworld at the Temple of Grenth, you will be unable to enter with henchmen as they are not Ascended. Likewise if your character is not Ascended, or achieved the Factions (Weh no Su) or Nightfall (Hunted!) equivalents, your character cannot enter.
07719ce86129423cafca7ba910c680f581c397d7.text: 當您嘗試進入 古蘭斯 神殿的地下世界時，您將無法與追隨者一起進入，因為他們尚未揚升。同樣，如果您的角色未昇天，或達到 盟與敵（Weh no Su）或 黑暗逆襲（狩獵！）等價物，則您的角色無法進入。

f00b377cc757f9ccc875de6bcf8dcd47f464469a.source: When you enter the area from Beacon's Perch, the gate back in is closed; however, you can still walk through it.
f00b377cc757f9ccc875de6bcf8dcd47f464469a.text: 當您從畢肯高地進入該區域時，後面的門關閉；但是，您仍然可以瀏覽它。

5b8eb859728107ec3e013b0a4ccf4c8c7a6ae9ce.source: Discover the whereabouts of Lady Glaive's crew and free their spirits.
5b8eb859728107ec3e013b0a4ccf4c8c7a6ae9ce.text: 發現格萊夫女士船員的下落並釋放他們的靈魂。

52363cef381bdedea7c8069861dc39a0535d64ea.source: Avenge the crew of the Queen of Fools by destroying Fendi Nin.
52363cef381bdedea7c8069861dc39a0535d64ea.text: 摧毀 梵帝寧，為愚人女王號的船員報仇。

4dfad8ef72d9d493d5a7bc46a67dad72498df508.source: See Crewmember Shandra for your reward.
4dfad8ef72d9d493d5a7bc46a67dad72498df508.text: 去找船員珊德拉領取獎勵。

8da1ac7558328e09b706e784a172be9bbb4d3475.source: The first level is self explanatory: find the area map, kill the Cursed Brigand that has the dungeon key and proceed to the second level. Take care to not warp to Gadd's Encampment. If you started from Gadd's Encampment, you will have to fight your way towards the Arbor Bay entrance to get Crewmember Shandra or else the door for the dungeon lock will remain closed.
8da1ac7558328e09b706e784a172be9bbb4d3475.text: 第一層是不言自明的：找到區域地圖，殺死擁有地牢鑰匙的被詛咒的強盜，然後進入第二層。注意不要扭曲到 蓋德營區。如果你從 蓋德營區 開始，你將必須奮力朝 Arbor Bay 入口處尋找船員 Shandra，否則地牢鎖的門將保持關閉狀態。

e7d2c621272876fec626f2c00cd4e45b658933cc.source: Kill the Cursed Brigand to the immediate left of the portal. When it dies, a chest spawns with an unlit torch, which you will need for most of this level. Take down the mob that blocks the way to a lit brazier and then light all the flame braziers in the circular graveyard room. Be ready for a large mob of undead and enchanted that spawn in a random spot within the room after the final one ignites; they must be killed before the exit door will open for you. Next, make your way to the tiled room to light the 2 of 4 unlit flame braziers, spawning yet another mob including a Cursed Brigand. Kill the Brigand to get the dungeon key to exit the level (he can be pulled away from his group). Leave the torch behind and head for the exit to the next level.
e7d2c621272876fec626f2c00cd4e45b658933cc.text: 殺死傳送門左側的被詛咒的強盜。當它死亡時，會生成一個帶有未點燃的火把的箱子，這是您在本關卡的大部分時間都需要的。消滅阻擋通往點燃火盆的道路的怪物，然後點燃圓形墓地房間中的所有火焰火盆。準備好迎接一大群不死生物和附魔生物，它們會在最後一個被點燃後在房間內的隨機位置產生；必須在出口門為你開啟之前殺死他們。接下來，前往鋪有瓷磚的房間，點燃 2 或 4 未點燃的火盆，產生另一個生物，包括被詛咒的強盜。殺死強盜以獲得退出關卡的地牢鑰匙（可以將他從他的隊伍中拉開）。留下火把，前往下一層的出口。

79d3d4b70f0df59a3e72a6484c6abeabd2eb5fda.source: The third level is similar but with more undead mobs, and careful pulling is recommended here. Once again, you need to light up a series of flame braziers to gain access to the final area. These are farther apart than on the other levels, but can easily be lit without a speed boost if you are careful about clearing any groups of foes in the way.
79d3d4b70f0df59a3e72a6484c6abeabd2eb5fda.text: 第三層類似，但不死生物較多，建議小心拉動。再次，您需要點燃一系列火盆才能進入最終區域。它們比其他關卡相距更遠，但如果你小心清除擋道的敵人群體，很容易在不提高速度的情況下被點燃。

8e18e806303a04bb6780962ae3cec4027db64cce.source: After entering the level, take out the group of undead and enchanted to your right, blocking the first unlit brazier. Open the nearby chest to get a new torch, light it on the nearby brazier, light the now unblocked brazier, then drop the torch for the moment. There are 2 groups of foes and a patrol along the route to the second unlit canister; pull carefully and take them out one at a time. Recover the torch to light the next set of braziers until you come to the entrance of the large chamber with the final set of containers to be lit.
8e18e806303a04bb6780962ae3cec4027db64cce.text: 進入關卡後，幹掉右邊那群不死族和附魔，擋住第一個未點燃的火盆。開啟附近的箱子得到一個新的火炬，將其點燃附近的火盆，點燃現在暢通無阻的火盆，然後暫時放下火炬。沿著通往第二個未點燃的罐子的路線，有 2 群敵人和一支巡邏隊；小心地拉動，一次取出一個。收回火把來點燃下一組火盆，直到你來到大房間的入口處，最後一組容器被點燃。

8966b96880707fe2055aa5dad5cbad0a59480a2a.source: There are several groups in this chamber, but you only have to take out 3 or 4: a group that spawns near the entryway; a group that spawns near the boss lock; the group that spawns with a Cursed Brigand (who carries the final key); and perhaps one more group. After taking out the group near the entrance, light the two stands to the left and right of the entrance. Then, carefully walk around and between any other mobs to light two braziers up the center of the room and two more in the back. If you have heroes and henchmen, flag them to the back so they do not accidentally aggro any foes and take down the Brigand's group, which has now spawned. From this position, you can also confront the group blocking the boss lock, safely leaving room to maneuver and retreat.
8966b96880707fe2055aa5dad5cbad0a59480a2a.text: 這個房間裡有幾個小組，但你只需要取出 3 或 4：一個在入口附近生成的小組；在 Boss 鎖附近生成的一組；與被詛咒的強盜（攜帶最終鑰匙）一起生成的隊伍；也許還有一組。消滅入口附近的小組後，點亮入口左右的兩個看臺。然後，小心地在其他小怪之間走來走去，點燃房間中央的兩個火盆和後面的另外兩個火盆。如果你有英雄和追隨者，請將他們標記到後面，這樣他們就不會意外地激怒任何敵人並擊倒現在已經生成的強盜隊伍。從這個位置，你還可以對抗阻擋boss鎖的隊伍，安全地留出迴旋和撤退的空間。

51f1d2dfddeb653b7ba6a0dfdd4cc0b6680722d1.source: Take the zig-zag corridor protected by Poison Spouts and give your party a chance to heal before killing two Bone Dragons and some undead archers. These are the last of the ordinary groups in the dungeon. The final area contains Fendi Nin and his archer body guards.
51f1d2dfddeb653b7ba6a0dfdd4cc0b6680722d1.text: 走上由 中毒 Spouts 保護的之字形走廊，在殺死兩條骨龍和一些不死弓箭手之前給你的隊伍一個治癒的機會。這是地牢裡最後的普通群體。最後一個區域包含 梵帝寧 和他的弓箭手保鑣。

a3d62b74c2703343ae2d2235c6b2b381c2c57da6.source: Fendi Nin has two forms: as an undead and as a soul. When you kill him in his undead form, a group of Damned Crewmen will replace the Skeleton Archers accompanying him and he will turn into the Soul of Fendi Nin. Keep spread out: the Crewmen will spike clumped party members with Clamor of Souls and Fendi attacks with armor-ignoring area of effect damage; they can quickly wipe an unprepared party, especially in hard mode. Fendi remains in his soul form for approximately half a minute, after which time he will revert back to his undead form and the crewmen will revert back into archers. Repeat the process until the soul form has been destroyed to finish the dungeon.
a3d62b74c2703343ae2d2235c6b2b381c2c57da6.text: 梵帝寧 有兩種型態：不死生物和靈魂。當你在他的亡靈 型態 中殺死他時，一群詛咒船員將取代陪伴他的 骷髏 弓箭手，他將變成 梵帝寧 的靈魂。保持分散：船員將使用 喧鬧之靈 和 Fendi 攻擊攻擊聚集的隊伍成員，造成無視護甲的區域傷害；他們可以快速消滅毫無準備的隊伍，尤其是在困難模式下。芬迪會在他的靈魂 型態 中停留大約半分鐘，之後他將恢復為不死族 型態，而船員將恢復為弓箭手。重複這個過程，直到靈魂 型態 被摧毀，完成地牢。

b12eea70a1573e3a9b1130215ce1e0cd7e7c25aa.source: Note: the Damned Crewmen spawn wherever the Skeleton Archers were, so you can kill the Archers then lure Fendi Nin away from where the Archers were killed and the Crewmen will not aggro when the Soul of Fendi Nin spawns. However, Skeleton Archers spawn on top of Fendi Nin when he reverts to his undead form.
b12eea70a1573e3a9b1130215ce1e0cd7e7c25aa.text: 注意：該死的船員會在 骷髏 弓箭手所在的地方生成，因此您可以殺死弓箭手，然後引誘 梵帝寧 遠離弓箭手被殺死的地方，並且當 梵帝寧 的靈魂生成時，船員不會仇恨。然而，當 梵帝寧 恢復為亡靈 型態 時，骷髏 弓箭手會在 梵帝寧 之上產生。

c96d5d66e9581d7f5299c13d1eaa6f961537f628.source: Ward of Stability and Ward Against Melee are very useful, since much of the difficulty of the dungeon comes from the knock downs caused by Skeleton Wizards and Zombie Brutes.
c96d5d66e9581d7f5299c13d1eaa6f961537f628.text: 穩定結界 和 迴避結界 非常有用，因為地下城的大部分難度來自 骷髏 Wizards 和 Zombie Brutes 造成的擊倒。

860e9f35e397241ae4a66f23c3e4f8e56fe9159e.source: Blind is also prevalent; skills such as Sight Beyond Sight and Antidote Signet can help.
860e9f35e397241ae4a66f23c3e4f8e56fe9159e.text: 盲人也很普遍； 天外視覺 和 解毒紋章 等技能可以提供協助。

c39e1654645215124e119feef6b52d80e05d6ce1.source: Holy damage is highly effective against the Skeletons and Zombies.
c39e1654645215124e119feef6b52d80e05d6ce1.text: 神聖傷害 對骷髏和殭屍非常有效。

b971dce8e8111bc8636283e8f6d785ffbbb97ca7.source: Rising Bile, if placed on the soul form before it reverts, will still proc proving an effective way to do damage to the soul form while dealing with the archers and regular form.
b971dce8e8111bc8636283e8f6d785ffbbb97ca7.text: 憤怒高漲，如果在恢復之前放置在靈魂 型態 上，在處理弓箭手和常規 型態 時，仍然會證明是對靈魂 型態 造成傷害的有效方法。

7f4bb32fdcf57bee28e61823d848476124b4343a.source: Since Zombies are the only fleshy creatures in the dungeon, skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here.
7f4bb32fdcf57bee28e61823d848476124b4343a.text: 由於殭屍是地牢中唯一的肉質生物，因此造成 流血、疾病或 中毒 或需要屍體的技能在這裡效果較差。

6061a08f6e8d07b2730e0942503eae86af1bb718.source: Remember to keep your party spread out before engaging Skeleton Wizards to mitigate their AOE damage.
6061a08f6e8d07b2730e0942503eae86af1bb718.text: 請記住，在與 骷髏 巫師交戰之前，讓您的隊伍分散開來減輕他們的 AOE 傷害。

87f82c4bca1ca764ced598cfc74f2fe6d2da0399.source: Consider clearing rooms and areas of all foes before lighting flame braziers.
87f82c4bca1ca764ced598cfc74f2fe6d2da0399.text: 在點燃火盆之前，請考慮清理所有敵人的房間和區域。

2e8d53d36b7c4ce71db13b28ce4dcfbb9bf3d07d.source: Lighting all braziers in the southwest room on 3rd level (where you get the last key) opens a secret passage near the very beginning of the 3rd level (Northeast corner of the map). Consider running back to that secret area to collect hidden treasures.
2e8d53d36b7c4ce71db13b28ce4dcfbb9bf3d07d.text: 點燃 3rd 關卡西南房間的所有火盆（在那裡你可以獲得最後一把鑰匙）會在 3rd 關卡的最開始處（地圖的東北角）開啟一條秘密通道。考慮跑回那個秘密區域收集隱藏的寶藏。

74963187d52dbfda8f232eef45402b2ba11a0188.source: You may not receive credit in your Dungeon Guide for this quest even after talking to the correct NPCs. Fendi Nin might not spawn at all, making it impossible to finish the quest and forcing the player to resign and restart.
74963187d52dbfda8f232eef45402b2ba11a0188.text: 即使與正確的 NPC 交談後，您可能不會在 地監 指南中收到此任務的積分。 梵帝寧 可能根本不會生成，從而無法完成任務並迫使玩家辭職並重新開始。

b32aef0d7ebdec72fbd2d54ba04bf400fc1a7754.source: Meet Raitahn Nem inside Minister Cho's Estate.
b32aef0d7ebdec72fbd2d54ba04bf400fc1a7754.text: 在趙部長的莊園內與 Raitahn Nem 會面。

7ab3836d38b91be34ef361e331f03aa96a2fca1d.text: 找到萊塔恩·尼姆的寶藏。

29a84bd5216e1fece4bd02c45878e339ff210c14.source: See Raitahn Nem for your reward.
29a84bd5216e1fece4bd02c45878e339ff210c14.text: 請前往 Raitahn Nem 領取獎勵。

181860eecffd470bbde1874a1eb37809f0a91dbf.source: This quest starts in Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area), from the northeastern exit from Ran Musu Gardens. Outside, you will meet Raitahn Nem who will join your party as an ally. Follow and defend him all the way to the quest marker. Once you have found Jaje Niya, the two will talk out their dialogue, after which you can speak with Raitahn Nem to obtain your reward.
181860eecffd470bbde1874a1eb37809f0a91dbf.text: 此任務從 嵐穆蘇花園 的東北出口開始，位於趙部長莊園（可探索區域）。在外面，你會遇到 Raitahn Nem，他將作為盟友加入你的隊伍。一路跟隨並保護他到達任務標記。一旦你找到了賈傑·尼婭，兩人就會說出他們的對話，之後你可以與雷坦·內姆交談以獲得獎勵。

2f4c5aa824d854e76bf7898a4a46c0de6a4ad2a4.source: Nem is on a scripted path, so he is leading you, not the other way around. Be prepared for a wandering route.
2f4c5aa824d854e76bf7898a4a46c0de6a4ad2a4.text: 內姆走在一條既定的道路上，所以他正在引導你，而不是相反。做好走迷路的準備。

3873aa4eb4349dd5fe8004f5716eaf4dac4aadc4.source: Keep Nem within earshot at all times. He has been known to disappear entirely if he gets too far from your aggro bubble.
3873aa4eb4349dd5fe8004f5716eaf4dac4aadc4.text: 始終將 Nem 放在聽得見的範圍內。眾所周知，如果他距離你的仇恨泡沫太遠，他就會完全消失。

2ce42c725ebb1e1ae006baea52fce71bf2f686af.source: Note that he will sometimes pause and yawn. Sometimes he will run back and forth like he's lost. There's nothing to do but wait for him to get motivated onwards again.
2ce42c725ebb1e1ae006baea52fce71bf2f686af.text: 請注意，他有時會停下來打哈欠。有時他會像迷路一樣來回奔跑。沒有什麼可做的，只能等他再次有動力繼續前進。

b6f97b307cdfc0eb608d33a6b262319719d6e72a.source: Nem will often ignore enemies in his path until he has aggroed the next group. Be wary of this, and accept that it will happen.
b6f97b307cdfc0eb608d33a6b262319719d6e72a.text: 內姆經常忽視路上的敵人，直到他攻擊了下一組敵人。對此保持警惕，並接受它將會發生。

3bfcc974b35e64ee3171af3e90e2b82b7e825fad.source: You will be unable to accept the reward for this quest from the version of Nem in Ran Musu Gardens. Either accept the reward when Nem finds his "treasure", or re-enter Minister Cho's Estate while partied with another player who has the quest in their log but has not yet completed it.
3bfcc974b35e64ee3171af3e90e2b82b7e825fad.text: 您將無法從 嵐穆蘇花園 的 Nem 版本中接受此任務的獎勵。要麼在 Nem 找到他的“寶藏”時接受獎勵，要麼重新進入 Cho 部長的莊園，同時與另一名日誌中有任務但尚未完成的玩家組隊。

9cf72069b1ffaee75318835ba736e1087a213a17.source: This is the first of the two attribute point quests available for Factions characters. Completion of these quests is necessary to gain the full 200 attribute points for your character. The second quest is An Unwelcome Guest.
9cf72069b1ffaee75318835ba736e1087a213a17.text: 這是 盟與敵 角色可用的兩個屬性點任務中的第一個。完成這些任務對於您的角色獲得完整的 200 屬性點是必要的。第二個任務是不速之客。

86da5276bd7eedf2f9fce5aff337be64d329753a.source: If Raitahn Nem dies it will cause the quest to fail, and you will need to exit the map and restart it.
86da5276bd7eedf2f9fce5aff337be64d329753a.text: 如果 Raitahn Nem 死亡，將會導致任務失敗，你需要退出地圖並重新啟動。

e8c00fec7124e6ecb6a0f4ff4115baba2d949c64.source: If you run away from Raitahn Nem and kill enemies too early, he will stop moving, making it impossible to complete the quest.
e8c00fec7124e6ecb6a0f4ff4115baba2d949c64.text: 如果你逃離 Raitahn Nem 並過早殺死敵人，他會停止移動，從而無法完成任務。

236108ac492fd52bceb02308d81139ad7370b13c.source: If you stay too long in the explorable area spawn zone (even if you don't click on him) Raitahn Nem will leave you and do the quest himself causing him to die and the mission to fail.
