236108ac492fd52bceb02308d81139ad7370b13c.text: 如果你在可探索區域的重生區停留太久（即使你沒有點選他），雷塔恩·尼姆（Raitahn Nem）會離開你並自己完成任務，導致他死亡並且任務失敗。

9a8f8886c9290cd1ef28a39cbb82797d7c954c2f.source: Speak to Koris Deeprunner when you're ready to begin the hunt for King Hundar's lost treasure.
9a8f8886c9290cd1ef28a39cbb82797d7c954c2f.text: 當您準備好開始尋找洪達爾國王失落的寶藏時，請與 深奔 高理斯 交談。

4f9463e8463fcc13b995f0a73bc28bd499336116.source: Raid the ancient cave to recover King Hundar's treasure.
4f9463e8463fcc13b995f0a73bc28bd499336116.text: 突襲古老的洞穴，奪回洪達爾國王的寶藏。

72d07092b727ad9a32658d6f0dafb92ed1c48236.source: Upon entry, you can take Dwarven Raider from the Beacon of Droknar. The destination is all the way South. You will encounter massive numbers of fragile Snowmens which pose little threat. There are Ice Darts and Ice Spouts spread through the area, avoid them as much as you can.
72d07092b727ad9a32658d6f0dafb92ed1c48236.text: 進入後，你可以從卓克納爾燈塔拿走矮人襲擊者。目的地是一路向南。你會遇到大量脆弱的雪人，它們幾乎不構成威脅。該區域遍佈冰鏢和冰噴，請盡可能避開它們。

b22e9ca30a65a40f0a06a3269d6bbc6c56f547ae.source: After a short walk inside, a Mischievous Snowman will send two Ice Boulders your way, dodge them or your party will be killed instantly. The Area Map can be found at the second Beacon of Droknar, but the quest is pretty straight forward and it is not of much use.
b22e9ca30a65a40f0a06a3269d6bbc6c56f547ae.text: 進去走一小段路後，一個淘氣的雪人會向你傳送兩個冰巨石，躲開它們，否則你的隊伍將被立即殺死。區域地圖可以在卓克納爾的第二個信標處找到，但任務非常簡單，沒有太大用處。

a61ae8a0787bbc2351309157136fd7df4873699a.source: At the third Beacon of Droknar, turn east to get the Dungeon Key which drops after defeating the Angry Snowman at the very back of that little room. Procede slowly in there, many Snowmen and Ice Darts stand inside. The darts will deactivate after killing the key holder. Unlock the Dungeon Gate and fight the group immediatly behind it.
a61ae8a0787bbc2351309157136fd7df4873699a.text: 在卓克納的第三個信標處，向東轉向，獲得 地監 鑰匙，它會在擊敗那個小房間最後面的憤怒雪人後掉落。慢慢往裡面走，裡面立著很多雪人和冰鏢。殺死鑰匙持有者後，飛鏢將停用。 解除 地監 門並與緊接在後的隊伍戰鬥。

4b654ea97b63e22fe74d25243582b430127b619d.source: Head east, and battle Freezie and its large Snowmen army. This boss will drop the Boss Key, which opens the door right behind. Enter this chamber to trigger the final dialogue which spawns the Chest of Wintersday Past to collect your rewards.
4b654ea97b63e22fe74d25243582b430127b619d.text: 向東前進，與 Freezie 及其龐大的雪人軍隊作戰。這個 Boss 會掉落 頭目 鑰匙，它會開啟後面的門。進入此房間觸發最終對話，產生過去冬日的 寶箱 收集獎勵。

f58a9434feb91064245e0805c933c02b9bbacbe0.source: Mid-way through the quest, you will find Wintersday Moa along the western side of the cave before the dungeon gate.
f58a9434feb91064245e0805c933c02b9bbacbe0.text: 在任務中途，你會在地牢門前的洞穴西側找到冬日恐鳥。

45c78068dad267c3d267503de005fc037575c1c1.source: This is probably the best place to farm Deldrimor points. Large amounts of points can be farmed from here, as there are 170 enemies in a relatively small area. The mobs are also level 15 and relatively easy to kill.
45c78068dad267c3d267503de005fc037575c1c1.text: 這可能是種植 戴爾狄摩 點的最佳地點。由於在相對較小的區域記憶體在 170 敵人，因此可以從此處獲取大量點數。這些小怪的等級也是 15 並且相對容易殺死。

e27e05c89bc00bb79c1b119a2cd2c589504d9a4f.source: To repeat the quest, you must zone out then back again after accepting the quest reward. For instance, changing districts after receiving the reward.
e27e05c89bc00bb79c1b119a2cd2c589504d9a4f.text: 要重複任務，您必須在接受任務獎勵後先走開然後再回來。例如，獲得獎勵後更換地區。

aa8dc47f88d8d146a4e666cd1671741ddd9c7856.source: In normal mode, a typical run takes 10-15 minutes, and yields approximately 1000 Dwarven Reputation points. In hard mode, a typical run takes slightly longer, and yields approximately 50% more Dwarven Reputation points.
aa8dc47f88d8d146a4e666cd1671741ddd9c7856.text: 在正常模式下，典型的運作需要 10-15 分鐘，並產生約 1000 矮人聲望點數。在困難模式下，典型的執行時間會稍微長一些，並且會產生大約 50% 更多的矮人聲望點。

d69fe8444ecb4ae0ac9db343573da90f09cb50dc.source: Sometimes Koris Deeprunner will get stuck at a locked chest, making the quest impossible to complete.
d69fe8444ecb4ae0ac9db343573da90f09cb50dc.text: 有時 深奔 高理斯 會卡在上鎖的箱子裡，導致任務無法完成。

5a486c95da58282d86b1599abcd6c6e31ec074c8.source: Telling Dzaga that Kehtmah sent you during initial dialogue
5a486c95da58282d86b1599abcd6c6e31ec074c8.text: 在最初的對話中告訴 Dzaga 是 Kehtmah 派你來的

64cab52306faac20af6c5a0f6dc499151d579e1e.source: Mutually exclusive with Money on the Side
64cab52306faac20af6c5a0f6dc499151d579e1e.text: 與“Money on the Side”相互排斥

b8dd5a2fbe6c1c540463a479012c2b5ab35d1429.source: Go with Dzaga and his band of smugglers to the rendezvous.
b8dd5a2fbe6c1c540463a479012c2b5ab35d1429.text: 與扎加和他的走私團夥一起前往集合點。

110eee0127c2f1049c3f181b3af8996c31a279c5.source: Break up the deal and hand out some Sunspear justice.
110eee0127c2f1049c3f181b3af8996c31a279c5.text: 終止交易並伸張陽矛正義。

35d5bb616d54c3f3f9d682bfaeb2ee3604ee29a8.source: Kill Dzaga and Sakku, and put an end to this smuggling ring!
35d5bb616d54c3f3f9d682bfaeb2ee3604ee29a8.text: 殺死札加和薩庫，終結這個走私集團！

7a8a83f39757d822b27da7ab505515b6df720241.source: "Now is your chance to prove yourself a loyal Sunspear. Infiltrate Dzaga's gang and follow him to the rendezvous. When you get there, use the advantage of surprise to break up the deal and bring the smugglers some Sunspear justice It's your choice. Remain loyal to the Sunspear cause, or go along with Dzaga's Gang and make some money on the side."
7a8a83f39757d822b27da7ab505515b6df720241.text: 「現在是你證明自己是一名忠誠的烈陽之矛者的機會了。潛入扎加的幫派並跟隨他前往會合點。到達那裡後，利用出其不意的優勢打破交易，為走私者帶來一些陽矛正義。這是你的選擇。保持對陽矛事業的忠誠，或者跟隨扎加的幫派並賺點外快。」

937e609fa3267576f9b997ee7a2e90635dc019b2.source: Deliver the Luxon Supplies to Quartermaster Hector
937e609fa3267576f9b997ee7a2e90635dc019b2.text: 將 勒克森 補給品交付給軍需官赫克托

11ef4eb8635f961b5788fb0c1713f0032a8438c9.source: You need to get supplies to Quartermaster Hector, near the entrance to Cavalon. Kurzick NPCs will ambush you as you go there. Once you reach the Quartermaster, he will be attacked by two Scuttle Fish, so make sure to kill all potential enemies in the area before reaching the Quartermaster.
11ef4eb8635f961b5788fb0c1713f0032a8438c9.text: 您需要向 卡瓦隆 入口附近的軍需官赫克托取得補給。當您前往那裡時，庫茲柯 NPC 會伏擊您。一旦您到達軍需官，他將受到兩個 甲板魚 的攻擊，因此請確保在到達軍需官之前殺死該區域中的所有潛在敵人。

e10d087899ae7bd289f505d7110ce12ece1c6176.source: This quest is useful for increasing vanquish numbers with easy kills for the area.
e10d087899ae7bd289f505d7110ce12ece1c6176.text: 這個任務對於增加該地區的征服數量和輕鬆殺戮很有用。

4f3e3a445f93d23b2faa8d8436f9814e122fa5b3.source: The Kurzick equivalent is Kurzick Supply Lines.
4f3e3a445f93d23b2faa8d8436f9814e122fa5b3.text: 庫茲柯 的等值是 庫茲柯 供應線。

1b7ee9db1e76fba39e84976a599c5f3adad72075.source: Seek out a homeless Canthan in need.
1b7ee9db1e76fba39e84976a599c5f3adad72075.text: 尋找有需要的無家可歸的凱珊。

3d296267af1e39b1519636fe92a3b7e558102dee.source: Find another homeless Canthan in need.
3d296267af1e39b1519636fe92a3b7e558102dee.text: 尋找另一個有需要的無家可歸的 Canthan。

a0262e00660031dcd032ce6c22b9ad4e4963f7ae.text: 找到最後一個無家可歸的凱森。

5f5c264c5dd8fec128cc879ef85359b4ab5bb21a.source: See Officer Chitaro for your reward.
5f5c264c5dd8fec128cc879ef85359b4ab5bb21a.text: 去找知太郎警官領取獎勵。

5b72d91806dbd2e4b23fac01c308c9715fe5ff90.source: Once in Bukdek Byway, you have to take the Elonian Mirrors to the Homeless Canthans in order. The locations of the Homeless Canthans are on the map to the right.
5b72d91806dbd2e4b23fac01c308c9715fe5ff90.text: 進入 巴德克小徑 後，您必須按順序將 Elonian Mirror 帶到無家可歸的 Canthans。無家可歸的 Canthans 的位置位於右側地圖上。

e81b3d7d8f9058d21c04d3739be916b961d51148.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 麥格默斯。

49d895da007f77816a1b23c588d81e048d1bc24d.source: Clear Magus Stones on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode.
49d895da007f77816a1b23c588d81e048d1bc24d.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人 灰暗沿岸 上的魔法石。

c7d8ed8ac0b29d4489b83de861dbb43abf66e571.source: "Clear Magus Stones on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode."
c7d8ed8ac0b29d4489b83de861dbb43abf66e571.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人 灰暗沿岸 上的魔法石。”

0cf65e10bc551c70ccce8fddc0b59ed75876e7db.source: Discounting quest influences, it has been reported to range from 367 to 409.
0cf65e10bc551c70ccce8fddc0b59ed75876e7db.text: 扣除任務影響後，據報道範圍從 367 到 409。

c4faf238cd6ae4dd716f2bb05c73ca7d61ee7816.source: The groups of Wind Riders can interrupt most skill usage and apply heavy area of effect damage with Cry of Frustration. Try to spread out before engaging to minimize the shutdown.
c4faf238cd6ae4dd716f2bb05c73ca7d61ee7816.text: 風騎者群體可以打斷大多數技能的使用，並使用 挫折哭喊 施加大範圍的效果傷害。嘗試在參與之前分散開來，以最大程度地減少停工。

66343ee3eb08a01576389f6abd76aa63b962fd8f.source: Beware of hidden Arachnids when you traverse narrow tunnels or valley passes.
66343ee3eb08a01576389f6abd76aa63b962fd8f.text: 當您穿過狹窄的隧道或山谷通道時，請小心隱藏的蜘蛛。

cdaad69a336aaf0c74b732db1cf4802c2dc3de05.source: Clear the Maishang Hills in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
cdaad69a336aaf0c74b732db1cf4802c2dc3de05.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的碧玉海中的麥尚山丘。

2971ae80d26d1c595f746e1142a63ed964133635.source: "Clear the Maishang Hills in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."
2971ae80d26d1c595f746e1142a63ed964133635.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的碧玉海中的麥尚山丘。”

ad9857f4f58dd25258dd477917def6016958cd93.source: The Stolen Eggs primary quest will lead characters from Cavalon through this area on the way to Gyala Hatchery.
ad9857f4f58dd25258dd477917def6016958cd93.text: 被偷走的蛋主線任務將引導來自 卡瓦隆 的角色穿過該區域，前往 蓋拉孵化所。

0d18e483027362e79901e53a693bef265f72cec1.source: This area is the northeastern-most area of the Jade Sea region, hence it is initially accessible only via the Archipelagos in the southwest.
0d18e483027362e79901e53a693bef265f72cec1.text: 該區域是 碧玉海 區域的最東北部區域，因此最初只能透過西南方的 群島 存取。

3fdaa51deaa36925e1952c9a2749829c35ab7c23.source: If you come here from Cavalon via Archipelagos, note that there is no priest with bounty at the shrine at the Archipelagos exit.
3fdaa51deaa36925e1952c9a2749829c35ab7c23.text: 如果您從卡瓦隆經群島來到這裡，請注意群島出口的神社裡沒有有賞金的牧師。

daa152e015eed260333ee1b5357ec80c1718683b.source: Scouting Maishang Hills spawns Kurzick groups, making it much longer.
daa152e015eed260333ee1b5357ec80c1718683b.text: 偵察 麥尚山丘 會產生 庫茲柯 群組，使其更長。

35aff373c7bba92c2cec1f6267487fd54761ea75.source: Enter from one of the three outposts to get the blessing for vanquishing. The shrines nearest the Archipelagos exit have no Kurzick or Luxon Priests.
35aff373c7bba92c2cec1f6267487fd54761ea75.text: 從三個前哨站之一進入即可獲得征服祝福。距離 群島 出口最近的神社沒有 庫茲柯 或 勒克森 牧師。

762add209f0ce05b96924028f096d24ccaee49ba.source: There are 5 hidden Oni groups (each consisting of 3 or 4 of them):
762add209f0ce05b96924028f096d24ccaee49ba.text: 有 5 隱藏 Oni 群組（每組由 3 或 4 組成）：

839d2f3df68698390dcc900fde8c9efde9cf1555.source: The path heading south from Eredon Terrace.
839d2f3df68698390dcc900fde8c9efde9cf1555.text: 從 爾雷登平地 向南的路徑。

fed991669562ccd8569a52c144680f39ad0cee85.source: The path heading southwest from Eredon Terrace.
fed991669562ccd8569a52c144680f39ad0cee85.text: 從 爾雷登平地 向西南延伸的路徑。

3561fb45a355e31ba6963657c83e17530821268c.source: Southeastern path from the Balthazar shrine.
3561fb45a355e31ba6963657c83e17530821268c.text: 從 巴薩澤 神社出發的東南小路。

3852f0c4652b193367d185c4441995621db8c406.source: Southwestern path from the Balthazar shrine.
3852f0c4652b193367d185c4441995621db8c406.text: 從 巴薩澤 神社出發的西南小路。

3a95ff08f512ec4c63d1f2069716c0c053342808.source: The narrow path to the west of the high bridge near the center.
3a95ff08f512ec4c63d1f2069716c0c053342808.text: 靠近中心的高橋以西的狹窄道路。

fe02d2103e3f552aa657ed01e42666444ea42595.source: When vanquishing, remember to visit both areas of sea; the one near Cavalon has 1 group, while the sea area near Gyala Hatchery has 3.
fe02d2103e3f552aa657ed01e42666444ea42595.text: 征服時，記得造訪這兩個海域； 卡瓦隆附近的海域有1群組，而蓋拉孵化所附近的海域有3。

769f987f93472087d1849e7a0b9e6fa1d059d407.source: Exploring this area will contribute approximately 3.1% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
769f987f93472087d1849e7a0b9e6fa1d059d407.text: 探索該領域將為 Canthan 版圖 標題貢獻約 3.1%。

1a48b718b0e0f171d928a7e17034e9f9eaa86dea.source: The resurrection shrine near Eredon Terrace has both the statues of Dwayna and Balthazar overlapping. Only the Champion of Balthazar can appear.
1a48b718b0e0f171d928a7e17034e9f9eaa86dea.text: 爾雷登平地 附近的復活神社有 Dwayna 和 巴薩澤 的雕像重疊。只能出現 勇士(公會戰頭銜) 或 巴薩澤。

ea6a7ab638bfad459a6357d7274859919025a7df.source: Clear Majesty's Rest in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
ea6a7ab638bfad459a6357d7274859919025a7df.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 王者安息處。

499b05d3cf5263780ec029934632c5afcf8334b9.source: "Clear Majesty's Rest in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."
499b05d3cf5263780ec029934632c5afcf8334b9.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 王者安息處。”

c438b847e50fbc4c6baed5d067ca2a261ec378fc.source: From Kryta, either leave from Temple of the Ages and head west through the Black Curtain and Talmark Wilderness or from Fisherman's Haven and travel north through Stingray Strand and Tears of the Fallen, then northwest through Talmark Wilderness.
c438b847e50fbc4c6baed5d067ca2a261ec378fc.text: 從 科瑞塔 出發，可以從 世紀神殿 出發，向西穿過黑幕和 突馬克荒地，或從漁人港出發，向北穿過 魟魚湖濱 和 戰死者之淚，然後向西北穿過 突馬克荒地。

5603dfbd7f6d9fa6729b6f372c561335bd6bde6a.source: From the Maguuma Jungle, leave from the Wilds or Druid's Overlook and head east/northeast (respectively) through Sage Lands.
5603dfbd7f6d9fa6729b6f372c561335bd6bde6a.text: 從 梅古瑪叢林 出發，從荒野或 德魯伊高地 出發，然後（分別）向東/東北方向行駛，穿過 賢者領地。

3bb55b9b27915abede686dde39bc56c73e8bc592.text: 雕像 或 巴薩澤

169460ad79b55b68d0d566a349d791d056edd2ea.source: Enter the Mausoleum (only during Commandeering a Mortal Vessel)
169460ad79b55b68d0d566a349d791d056edd2ea.text: 進入陵墓（僅在徵用凡人船隻期間）

6c8b3874b9045787223efcd978d38387bc4a2c10.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.9% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
6c8b3874b9045787223efcd978d38387bc4a2c10.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.9% 的貢獻。

a04a2da78f6bb560fdeabede6cfe6188a80358af.source: Vanquishing: 44–85 foes. All the visible enemies are concentrated in the eastern half, so it is recommended to start from Temple of the Ages and approach from Talmark Wilderness.
a04a2da78f6bb560fdeabede6cfe6188a80358af.text: 擊敗：44–85 敵人。所有可見的敵人都集中在東半部，所以建議從世紀神殿開始，從突馬克荒地接近。

a3882346d3f8700676552c547a4341dae0b9c74c.source: If you avoid triggering too many popups, you can realistically complete the vanquish with around 55 kills.
a3882346d3f8700676552c547a4341dae0b9c74c.text: 如果你避免觸發太多的彈出視窗，你實際上可以透過大約 55 擊殺來完成勝利。

73accef37d363fd080537ba6dac40b23ce057b12.source: This explorable area is home to Rotscale.
73accef37d363fd080537ba6dac40b23ce057b12.text: 這個可探索的區域是 惡臭骨龍 的所在地。

90d7774041a040aa53d89d0b50da3b0b62acea84.source: The popups on the eastern side include Reed Stalkers in the water, hidden Grasping Ghouls near undead spawns, and one or two spots with Fog Nightmares and Smoke Phantoms.
90d7774041a040aa53d89d0b50da3b0b62acea84.text: 東側的彈出視窗包括水中的蘆葦追獵者、不死生成點附近隱藏的抓握食屍鬼，以及一兩個帶有霧夢魘和煙霧幻影的地點。

a1b8ada90a04337b343449039485f6f529e85c6a.source: The western side has close to a dozen spots of hidden spiders (where there are trees overhead) and devourers (in the dry brown areas).
a1b8ada90a04337b343449039485f6f529e85c6a.text: 西側有近十幾個隱藏的蜘蛛點（頭頂有樹的地方）和吞噬者（在乾燥的棕色區域）。

eb165a0192c6d312825939b339c928a5de4a6f73.source: Although Majesty’s Rest is considered to be in Kryta, it is divided into a Maguuma Jungle area and a Krytan area, each with their own typical vegetation, landscape and foes. Chests in the Maguuma Jungle area will be Krytan Chests, but Maguuma Keys can drop from foes there.
eb165a0192c6d312825939b339c928a5de4a6f73.text: 儘管Majesty's Rest被認為位於科瑞塔中，但它分為梅古瑪叢林區域和Krytan區域，每個區域都有自己典型的植被、景觀和敵人。 梅古瑪叢林 區域中的寶箱將是 Krytan 寶箱，但 梅古瑪 鑰匙可以從那裡的敵人掉落。

2eb54f63f4cf3d5ca3a334aaf3189b39fc3a413c.source: Your party gains three Mad King's Guards as allies during Commandeering a Mortal Vessel.
2eb54f63f4cf3d5ca3a334aaf3189b39fc3a413c.text: 在徵用凡人船隻期間，你的隊伍獲得三名瘋狂國王的守衛作為盟友。

7fcf593115003ec8c06695451781e54e7a115a9e.source: Seek out a suitable target and use the Signet of Capture to gain a skill.
7fcf593115003ec8c06695451781e54e7a115a9e.text: 尋找合適的目標並使用 捕捉紋章 來獲得技能。

65f44cc164d293a5b6898bc2f31be97767ee130a.source: See Magi Malaquire for your reward.
65f44cc164d293a5b6898bc2f31be97767ee130a.text: 請參閱 法師瑪拉凱爾 以取得獎勵。

ad1699e00204caddb2e7afc9ea20ce9d262ba3e3.source: You receive a Signet of Capture after accepting this quest for the first time.
ad1699e00204caddb2e7afc9ea20ce9d262ba3e3.text: 第一次接受此任務後，您會收到 捕捉紋章。

c72e68a311c5c57ee5d17d226f37b30d74ac080c.source: There is no real "set" course for this quest; simply find a boss, kill it, and use the Signet of Capture to capture a skill from it. This may take some time, as you are only able to "capture" a skill from a boss with the same profession as your primary or secondary profession.
c72e68a311c5c57ee5d17d226f37b30d74ac080c.text: 這個任務並沒有真正的「設定」路線；只需找到一個 Boss，殺死它，然後使用 捕捉紋章 從中獲取技能即可。這可能需要一些時間，因為你只能從與你的主要或次要職業相同的老闆那裡「獲取」技能。

4997abc862170979c91a630e086812305b55bbb8.source: When progressing through the campaign, bosses generally do not have elite skills to capture until reaching the Crystal Desert.
4997abc862170979c91a630e086812305b55bbb8.text: 在進行戰役時，頭目通常沒有精英技能可以捕獲，直到達到 水晶沙漠。

19085761e5b4c5347d748b6c78ee7c704ff7f500.source: Some skills (that have not been unlocked on an account previously) are only available later in the Prophecies Campaign from skill vendors but can be captured much earlier from bosses.
19085761e5b4c5347d748b6c78ee7c704ff7f500.text: 某些技能（之前尚未在帳戶上解鎖）只能在 阿斯卡隆戰記 章節 中從技能供應商取得，但可以更早從老闆處取得。

00a5d0aa57f216031a7e8f78ef6d4c855cf0486c.source: Go to the City of Torc'qua and destroy Lord Jadoth.
00a5d0aa57f216031a7e8f78ef6d4c855cf0486c.text: 前往托克誇的 城市 並摧毀 霸王 賈多司。

b250a6a4d02af412044c6d6885d1f9160f8bf9b4.source: Go to Ravenheart Gloom and destroy the Greater Darkness.
b250a6a4d02af412044c6d6885d1f9160f8bf9b4.text: 前往鴉心幽暗並摧毀大黑暗。

399ec468c94b5c6a7b41e2f9c1777ef13db38c2b.source: Go to The Foundry of Failed Creations and destroy the Fury.
399ec468c94b5c6a7b41e2f9c1777ef13db38c2b.text: 前往失敗創造鑄造廠並摧毀狂怒。

e57416e3f767a21bf91837dc4427178ed463c574.source: Go to the Stygian Veil and destroy the Dreadspawn Maw.
e57416e3f767a21bf91837dc4427178ed463c574.text: 前往斯泰吉亞面紗並摧毀恐龍之口。

41193eee96d4774a2b1419f62ba4f72821b74f35.source: Report your success in defeating the Lords of Anguish to High Priest Zhellix.
41193eee96d4774a2b1419f62ba4f72821b74f35.text: 向高階牧師 Zhellix 報告您擊敗 苦惱 領主的成功。

e59c39d825e7ced1737b5d183ba92b55d00cd92d.source: Speak to High Priest Zhellix to commence the assault on the Ebony Citadel of Mallyx the Unyielding.
e59c39d825e7ced1737b5d183ba92b55d00cd92d.text: 與大祭司熱利克斯交談，開始攻擊不屈者馬裡克斯的烏木城堡。

cf448b34779eee445f907011e508bffeec76ae28.source: Seek out and destroy Mallyx the Unyielding in his Ebony Citadel.
cf448b34779eee445f907011e508bffeec76ae28.text: 在他的烏木堡壘中尋找並摧毀不屈者馬裡克斯。

c360b5cb7fb1d2917d9b933c4db3128465d9bcb2.source: See High Priest Zhellix for your reward.
c360b5cb7fb1d2917d9b933c4db3128465d9bcb2.text: 去見大祭司澤利克斯以獲得獎勵。

0d28af352be5141606e74b823829ba8896aa63ea.source: The quest consists of four separate parts done in four separate zones of the Domain of Anguish. You may enter any of the four areas in any order to complete the quest. Completing an area and killing the Overlord in the area updates the quest and causes a chest to appear which drops Anguish Gemstones for each party member (see notes below). For further details, see the articles on the individual quests and overlords.
0d28af352be5141606e74b823829ba8896aa63ea.text: 任務由四個獨立部分組成，在 悲難之門 的四個獨立區域中完成。您可以按任意順序進入四個區域中的任何一個來完成任務。完成一個區域並殺死該區域的霸主會更新任務並導致出現一個箱子，該箱子會為每個隊伍成員掉落 苦惱 寶石（請參閱下面的註釋）。有關更多詳細資訊，請參閱有關各個任務和霸主的文章。

b3aec199c28581fa6c49a15d223583756c60de68.source: In the City of Torc'qua, complete the quest The City of Torc'qua to spawn Lord Jadoth.
b3aec199c28581fa6c49a15d223583756c60de68.text: 在托克誇的 城市 中，完成托克誇的 城市 任務以產生 霸王 賈多司。

331a5022d16b776a8c3d08bfbe1c783952a49be2.source: Four groups of Margonites will spawn outside the gates to the Stygian Veil. The first will rush to the city gates, and does not have any boss. It may be easily defeated by having the players to stand on the hill right inside the city, and using a puller to lure the enemies so they may be attacked from above.
331a5022d16b776a8c3d08bfbe1c783952a49be2.text: 四組瑪貢尼特將在斯泰吉亞面紗的大門外生成。第一個會衝到城門口，沒有任何boss。讓玩家站在城市內的山上，並使用拉手引誘敵人，這樣他們就可以從上方攻擊，就可以輕鬆擊敗它。

0cb5c62ecb71431385783d5961182d5692234bb1.source: The second and the third groups will each have a boss, Shaunur the Divine and Turep, Maker of Orphans. These groups are also significantly larger than the previous one and may pose a threat to players who engage them head on. After both groups have been destroyed, Lord Jadoth himself and his group will step forward, standing in front of the gate to the Stygian Veil. Those enemies have two Margonite monks, and so may be hard to defeat.
0cb5c62ecb71431385783d5961182d5692234bb1.text: 第二組和第三組各有一個 Boss，神聖肖努爾和孤兒製造者圖雷普。這些群體的規模也比前一個群體大得多，可能會對正面交鋒的玩家構成威脅。兩隊都被消滅後，霸王 賈多司 本人和他的隊伍將向前邁出，站在通往斯泰吉亞面紗的大門前。這些敵人有兩個 瑪骨奈 武僧，因此可能很難擊敗。

6a852ab4c694ad545f51fef3fe6d9c78bbaa9aa1.source: A strategy to defeat the three boss groups is by forcing them to split. Each of the three groups moves as a single whole, so directly pulling them will result in an entire group following. However, if players stay within the walls of the city, at the eastern position of the map, it's possible to use a Longbow to attack and so pull the enemies. Some will try to hit the players through the walls, while others will move all the way around the city gate and so engage the players directly - when that happens, if the players retreat, all enemies will try to move directly back to their original position, and those who are within the city walls will be separated from those outside. This will end in smaller groups that are easier to defeat.
6a852ab4c694ad545f51fef3fe6d9c78bbaa9aa1.text: 擊敗三個首領組的策略是迫使他們分裂。三組各自作為一個整體移動，因此直接拉動它們將導致整個組跟隨。然而，如果玩家留在地圖東部位置的城牆內，則可以使用 長弓 來攻擊並拉動敵人。有些會試圖穿過城牆攻擊玩家，而有些則會繞著城門移動，直接與玩家交戰——在這種情況下，如果玩家撤退，所有敵人都會試圖直接移回原來的位置，城牆內的敵人將與城外的敵人分開。這將導致更小的團體更容易被擊敗。

3b73571851c611e526de712b27d354ad277e590f.source: When all groups are completely wiped, the quest will update and a Torc'qua Chest will spawn, containing Margonite Gemstones for everyone.
3b73571851c611e526de712b27d354ad277e590f.text: 當所有組別都完全消滅後，任務將會更新，並且會產生 Torc'qua 寶箱，其中包含適合每個人的 瑪骨奈 寶石。

e641fc7b934247e42547349ea30b8a5222d573e1.source: In HM, the combination of Repressive Energy and Quickening Zephyr results in severe energy denial. It would be advisable to take away caster Heroes' weapons (wands and staves should be removed, they should ideally have only a focus item) to prevent them from auto-attacking and disabling particularly energy intensive skills. For those who are running a BiP hero, disabling Protective Was Kaolai and Life (commonly included in a BiP hero build) helps. The player should try to engage outside the range of Quickening Zephyr as much as possible. Martial professions that rely on energy, Assassin's in particular, will have a difficult time due to the nature of energy denial.
e641fc7b934247e42547349ea30b8a5222d573e1.text: 在 HM 中，壓制性 能量 和 活力微風 的組合會導致嚴重的能量拒絕。建議拿走施法者英雄的武器（應該移除魔杖和法杖，理想情況下他們應該只有一個焦點物品），以防止他們自動攻擊並停用特別能量密集型技能。對於執行 BiP 英雄的使用者，停用 護衛者高萊 和 生命（通常包含在 BiP 英雄版本中）會有所幫助。玩家應盡可能嘗試在 活力微風 範圍之外進行攻擊。由於能量否認的本質，依賴能量的武術職業，尤其是 暗殺者，將會經歷一段困難時期。

a6c7dafdc24d07914de7e257900861d3bd4cb5f1.source: In Ravenheart Gloom, complete the quest chain To the Rescue! → The Rifts Between Us → Deathbringer Company, after which The Greater Darkness will spawn and taunt you.
a6c7dafdc24d07914de7e257900861d3bd4cb5f1.text: 在鴉心幽暗中，完成任務鏈救援！ → 我們之間的裂痕 → 死亡使者連，之後 巨大暗影 將出現並嘲弄你。

6e23bc7edd0a613975d7436443ed02db466a0b9b.source: When moving closer to its initial spawn point, two of the Darknesses will spawn. All three are easily defeated, but killing the group will spawn five more of the Darknesses, and whenever one of these the Darknesses is killed, it spawns five Earth Tormentors.
6e23bc7edd0a613975d7436443ed02db466a0b9b.text: 當靠近其初始生成點時，將會產生兩個黑暗。這三個人都很容易被擊敗，但殺死這群人會再產生五個黑暗力量，每當其中一個黑暗力量被殺死時，它就會產生五個地球折磨者。

940e5698bf7ef66a3085bcd9d46d1805d188e837.source: Once you kill the three initial darknesses, run away to break aggro (leaving minions/spirits behind will help). The five the Darknesses that spawn are separate groups and can be pulled individually. By doing so, you will only face five Earth Tormentors at a time. A well-timed area of effect snare or Aegis will render them mostly harmless, allowing you to decimate the group before it hurts.
940e5698bf7ef66a3085bcd9d46d1805d188e837.text: 一旦你殺死了三個最初的黑暗，就逃跑以打破仇恨（留下小兵/靈魂會有所幫助）。產生的五個黑暗是獨立的組，可以單獨拉動。藉由這樣做，你一次只會面對五個地球折磨者。適時的效果圈套或 神賜之盾 將使他們幾乎無害，讓你在群體受到傷害之前消滅他們。

04fca46128ca3b731a6bc9988d96d4e70073fea0.source: After killing all 33 foes, the quest will update and a Ravenheart Chest will spawn, containing Torment Gemstones for everyone.
04fca46128ca3b731a6bc9988d96d4e70073fea0.text: 殺死所有 33 敵人後，任務將會更新，並且會產生鴉心 寶箱，其中包含每個人的折磨寶石。

165306b0fc428e1b8d323b674abc6c443f40d3d2.source: In The Foundry of Failed Creations, complete the quest chain The Foundry of Failed Creations → Foundry Breakout to spawn The Fury.
165306b0fc428e1b8d323b674abc6c443f40d3d2.text: 在失敗創作的鑄造廠中，完成任務鏈失敗創作的鑄造廠 → 鑄造廠突圍以生成狂怒。

15a48d8f79ae8d30289b91b2be922f308f14e2bb.source: He will be accompanied by several mesmer and elementalist Guardians of Komalie and two Margonite Anur Ki. They will spawn at their usual location as soon as the quest reward for Foundry Breakout is accepted - make sure General Yendzarsh is nowhere near their spawn point when finishing the quest, or they'll spawn right on top of you.
15a48d8f79ae8d30289b91b2be922f308f14e2bb.text: 他將由幾位催眠師和元素師科馬裡守護者以及兩名 瑪骨奈 Anur Ki 陪同。一旦接受了 Foundry Breakout 的任務獎勵，它們就會在原來的位置生成 - 確保 Yendzarsh 將軍在完成任務時遠離它們的生成點，否則它們會在你的上方生成。

521a4735a7cf5f419a6c762d7a6b165b836bdafd.source: The group is easier to kill if it's split with careful pulling. Spread out to avoid their AoE damage. The elementalists (including The Fury) are susceptible to Pain Inverter.
521a4735a7cf5f419a6c762d7a6b165b836bdafd.text: 如果小心地把隊伍分開，就更容易殺死。分散開來避免 範圍性 造成的傷害。元素主義者（包括 The Fury）容易受到 苦痛 逆變器的影響。

0e7c011e3854a126f9b9872ac319f2819f101333.source: When both the Fury and his group are destroyed, the quest will update and a Titan Chest will spawn, containing Titan Gemstones for everyone.
0e7c011e3854a126f9b9872ac319f2819f101333.text: 當Fury和他的團隊都被摧毀時，任務將會更新，並且會產生一個泰坦 寶箱，其中包含每個人的泰坦寶石。

3bde2a18c9b7a68d1166dc2d37f2ebe298c4e0d2.source: In the Stygian Veil, complete the quest chain Breaching the Stygian Veil → Brood Wars to spawn the Dreadspawn Maw.
3bde2a18c9b7a68d1166dc2d37f2ebe298c4e0d2.text: 在斯泰吉亞面紗中，完成任務鏈突破斯泰吉亞面紗 → 母巢之戰以生成恐龍之口。

82e57928de27d08f70740823fe42ccca6cf639dd.source: She is not a targetable foe, but can be killed by destroying the six Smothering Tendrils that spawn along with her. The Dreadspawn Maw will have a progress indicator that shows her strength. Killing a Tendril will remove 1/12th of the bar and killing the Stygian mob that spawns afterwards will remove an additional 1/12th. All in all, all six Tendrils and their spawns must be destroyed for the quest to update. Killing a Smothering Tendrils also spawns a number of Torment Claws which are not required, but may get in the way if left alive.
82e57928de27d08f70740823fe42ccca6cf639dd.text: 她不是一個可瞄準的敵人，但可以透過摧毀與她一起生成的六個窒息卷鬚來殺死她。恐龍之喉將有一個進度指示器來顯示她的實力。殺死卷鬚將移除該條的 1/12，殺死隨後產生的冥河生物將移除額外的 1/12。總而言之，必須摧毀所有六個卷鬚及其生成物才能更新任務。殺死窒息卷鬚也會產生許多折磨爪，這些爪子不是必需的，但如果活著的話可能會妨礙。

499721be6d95c0e21b202b282038f486ad623fdd.source: Kill the Smothering Tendrils one at a time, then retreat to safe grounds before dispatching the Stygian mob. Engaging the Stygians amidst the Torment Claws is not recommended. Clear out any claws that are in the way before proceeding to the next Tendril.
499721be6d95c0e21b202b282038f486ad623fdd.text: 一次殺死一隻窒息卷鬚，然後撤退到安全地帶，然後再消滅斯泰吉亞暴徒。不建議在折磨之爪中與斯泰吉亞人交戰。在前往下一個卷鬚之前清除所有擋路的爪子。

c277b7837350e11565977476b3ecb8b5dcff5848.source: If you have trouble retreating through the claws, retreat early and leave a dedicated party member behind to finish the Tendril - he will likely die, but everyone else is safe. Bring Rebirth and a means to remove Death Penalty when using this tactic.
c277b7837350e11565977476b3ecb8b5dcff5848.text: 如果你在從爪子中撤退時遇到困難，請儘早撤退，並留下一名專注的隊員來完成捲鬚——他很可能會死，但其他人都是安全的。使用此策略時，請攜帶 重生 和消除死刑的方法。

26e293dadcd27be0630428c1746427c76a126180.source: After the Dreadspawn Maw is dead, the quest will update and a Stygian Chest will spawn, containing Stygian Gemstones for everyone.
26e293dadcd27be0630428c1746427c76a126180.text: 恐懼之牙死亡後，任務將會更新，並且會產生一個冥河 寶箱，其中包含適合每個人的冥河寶石。

aeeb78a2cf96cd078622f95c22bd061ba0bcd5a5.source: The last part of the quest is at the same time the Elite Mission of the Nightfall campaign.
aeeb78a2cf96cd078622f95c22bd061ba0bcd5a5.text: 任務的最後一部分同時也是 黑暗逆襲 活動的 精英任務。

0867e9986f9474371d8bc259ffe9526662a3a5c5.source: For all further information, see The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx.
0867e9986f9474371d8bc259ffe9526662a3a5c5.text: 有關所有詳細資訊，請參閱馬裡克斯烏木城堡。

e334ba6408e85c35442bf19fc63d71a16ed8a489.source: All members of your party have a chance of getting Primeval Armor Remnants in their inventory while completing the quest.
e334ba6408e85c35442bf19fc63d71a16ed8a489.text: 完成任務時，您隊伍的所有成員都有機會在庫存中獲得原始 防禦 遺跡。

9c28eb5a954cbffffe7cc191443c73abc3adbb71.source: Doing the four sub-quests successfully in one run, as opposed to doing each separately, causes the chests that appear once the areas are completed to drop an increasing number of gems. For example: the first chest drops one gem for each party member, next chest drops two gems per party member, third chest drops three and fourth chest drops four. These numbers are doubled in hard mode.
9c28eb5a954cbffffe7cc191443c73abc3adbb71.text: 在一次執行中成功完成四個子任務，而不是單獨完成每個子任務，會導致區域完成後出現的箱子掉落越來越多的寶石。例如：第一個寶箱為每位黨員掉落一顆寶石，下一個寶箱為每位黨員掉落兩顆寶石，第三個寶箱掉落三顆寶石，第四個寶箱掉落四顆寶石。這些數字在困難模式下會翻倍。

81cd83210d0a4ea6bf66165d3704cacb2faac270.source: Complete exploration of this area adds approximately 2.9% towards the Elonian Cartographer title; portal jumping allows for an additional 0.1–0.2% leeway (see below).
81cd83210d0a4ea6bf66165d3704cacb2faac270.text: 對該領域的完整探索將大約 2.9% 新增到 Elonian 版圖 標題中；傳送門跳躍允許額外的 0.1–0.2% 餘地（見下文）。

a1c4c03783438d4d9fd317fbc46a1783426c96b1.source: The portal to Sunspear Sanctuary is bugged — it allows heroes to walk through it without bouncing (as they do elsewhere).
a1c4c03783438d4d9fd317fbc46a1783426c96b1.text: 日戟避難所 的門戶被竊聽了——它允許英雄穿過它而不會彈跳（就像他們在其他地方所做的那樣）。

842ee58b1bce537819055fbe9f257f113beb532c.source: Follow Brother Tosai to the Undercity.
842ee58b1bce537819055fbe9f257f113beb532c.text: 跟隨東齋兄弟前往幽暗城。

6a04654dad786568653712e5ba296dabe8b387e1.source: Follow Brother Tosai through the Undercity to meet your new master.
6a04654dad786568653712e5ba296dabe8b387e1.text: 跟著東齋修士穿越幽暗城去見你的新主人。

86b88247a1bb277b11de0da29beacc7e99060015.source: Follow Brother Tosai through the Undercity until you reach the spot marked on the mission map. Once there, a group of afflicted will spawn. Defeat this group and others in the area. Eventually 2 or 3 smaller groups will spawn and attack from both directions. After defeating these groups a final group with 3 afflicted warriors and an assassin will appear. Defeat them to remove the effect of Chalice of Corruption and finish the quest.
86b88247a1bb277b11de0da29beacc7e99060015.text: 跟隨東齋修士穿過幽暗城，直到到達任務地圖上標記的地點。一旦到達那裡，就會產生一群受折磨的人。擊敗該組織和該地區的其他組織。最終，2 或 3 較小的群體將會產生並從兩個方向發動攻擊。擊敗這些團體後，最後一個由 3 受折磨的戰士和刺客組成的團體將會出現。擊敗他們以消除腐敗聖杯的效果並完成任務。

82152629ed421f71c424700b995412c6bf0b764d.source: Once this quest is activated via drinking from the Chalice of Corruption, you will have a -2 health degeneration and a visual effect identical to disease until this quest is complete. The effect persists even in outposts, although you won't actually lose health in outposts. Abandoning this quest will also remove the effects of the chalice.
82152629ed421f71c424700b995412c6bf0b764d.text: 一旦透過飲用腐敗聖杯來啟動此任務，您將出現 -2 健康退化和與疾病相同的視覺效果，直到此任務完成。即使在前哨站，這種效果仍然存在，儘管你實際上不會在前哨站失去生命值。放棄這個任務也會消除聖杯的效果。

a11c64048010bbb905041fd00c4666c24f356911.source: Does not work while you have quest "Mayhem in the Market" active. Tosai will not spawn near Master Togo as it is a Primary Quest.
a11c64048010bbb905041fd00c4666c24f356911.text: 當你有任務「市場混亂」時不起作用。 Tosai 不會在 藤吾大師 附近生成，因為它是主要 任務。

a92f88ae8269f14e8a1658ccf3a19dc60359ff39.source: After finishing this quest the Am Fah are once again hostile against you.
a92f88ae8269f14e8a1658ccf3a19dc60359ff39.text: 完成此任務後，安費 再次對你懷有敵意。

c67bea19dc5a01d05704d7aeca2c6a0b1297ef55.source: During Winds of Change, you can potentially overaggro at the fight location, so either pull the Am Fah away to kill them, or alternatively, move close enough to Brother Tosai to trigger the Afflicted attack, and let the Am Fah kill the Afflicted.
c67bea19dc5a01d05704d7aeca2c6a0b1297ef55.text: 在 變幻之風 期間，你可能會在戰鬥地點過度仇恨，因此要麼將 安費 拉開以殺死他們，要麼移動到足夠靠近 Tosai 兄弟以觸發受折磨者的攻擊，然後讓 安費 殺死受折磨者。

0ad94c4c03d13378c9f7ce635b4df2a73a4abd0c.source: The last group of Am Fah may get stuck on the bridge to the south east of the battle area. In this case, you have to kill them there to trigger Brother Tosai's final speech.
0ad94c4c03d13378c9f7ce635b4df2a73a4abd0c.text: 最後一組 安費 可能會被困在戰區東南方的橋上。在這種情況下，你必須在那裡殺死他們才能觸發東齋兄弟的最後演講。

042a7223d4a8f5e42a18f0fd87dc793bdf9c2a71.source: Check on Pelei on the Plains of Jarin and see if she's safe.
042a7223d4a8f5e42a18f0fd87dc793bdf9c2a71.text: 在 賈林平原 上檢視 Pelei，看看她是否安全。

df5b6efc171d1721ae6dc86c186c2b075b1e9266.source: Help Pelei by slaying 10 Killer Iboga. You have slain [0...10] of 10 Killer Iboga.
df5b6efc171d1721ae6dc86c186c2b075b1e9266.text: 幫助佩雷殺死 10 殺手伊博加。你已經殺了 10 殺手伊博加的 [0...10]。

0c471205a1eaa21115815437946c12dd4bb41658.source: Inform Pelei that the area is now safe from Killer Iboga.
0c471205a1eaa21115815437946c12dd4bb41658.text: 通知佩雷該地區現已安全，不會受到殺手伊博加的攻擊。

56e2e66ed1c788b286ae2fde98166edbf2ffcb4e.source: From Kamadan, leave for the Plains of Jarin. Grab the plant bounty from the Sunspear Scout outside of Kamadan so you can receive the double experience points for the plants and work on your Sunspear rank. Head west until you reach Pelei, talk to her, then turn south and kill the Killer Iboga (you can use the Ctrl key to locate them). Return to Pelei, and then go back to Kamadan to get your reward.
56e2e66ed1c788b286ae2fde98166edbf2ffcb4e.text: 從卡馬丹 (Kamadan) 出發前往 賈林平原。從卡馬丹郊外的陽矛偵察兵處獲取植物賞金，這樣您就可以獲得植物的雙倍經驗值並在 日戟 上工作。往西走，直到你到達佩雷，與她交談，然後轉向南邊殺死殺手伊博加（你可以使用 Ctrl 鍵找到他們）。 影返 前往 Pelei，然後回到 Kamadan 領取獎勵。

f539fa638449e65d3011c2be77b3d4b194887032.source: 16 to 20 Killer Iboga spawn when you enter the area. If you killed too many of them before talking to Pelei, you will have to go back to Kamadan and re-enter the area to kill the last few you need.
f539fa638449e65d3011c2be77b3d4b194887032.text: 當您進入該區域時，16 至 20 殺手伊博加會產生。如果你在與佩雷交談之前殺死了太多的人，你將不得不返回卡馬丹並重新進入該地區來殺死你需要的最後幾個人。

7ab8233d1cf82117c1846e2a7923bb6a2b166560.source: You can use this quest to farm sunspear points, Iboga Petals, and Sentient Roots. Even after killing the required 10 Killer Ibogas, the plants will continue to spawn in the area until you talk to Pelei again to complete the quest.
7ab8233d1cf82117c1846e2a7923bb6a2b166560.text: 你可以使用這個任務來種植陽矛點數、伊博加花瓣和感知根。即使在殺死所需的 10 殺手伊博加斯之後，植物仍會繼續在該區域生成，直到您再次與佩雷交談以完成任務。

a12336de25b35a3c2ab5d39980db57d214e2fbf5.source: Find Officer Chitaro and speak to him about medical supplies for the refugees.
a12336de25b35a3c2ab5d39980db57d214e2fbf5.text: 找到Chitaro警官並與他討論為難民提供醫療用品的問題。

a84fdcfbddef0e8b22356e1b2067fbfc461a9fbf.source: This quest requires little to no fighting and is a simple case of talking to another NPC once the quest has been obtained. It is quickest to start from Nahpui Quarter. Otherwise you will have to start from the Marketplace (this will take less time if you have the Seek out Brother Tosai quest active.)
a84fdcfbddef0e8b22356e1b2067fbfc461a9fbf.text: 這個任務幾乎不需要戰鬥，完成任務後只需與另一個 NPC 交談即可。從 納普區 啟動最快。否則，你將不得不從市場開始（如果你啟動了「尋找東齋兄弟」任務，這將花費更少的時間。）

3eba7b606d85fe3f629cca73c97802b9946ff579.source: Head west from Guardsman Pah, then head down the steps and around the coastline to Officer Chitaro. Two small groups of Am Fah may spawn along the way.
3eba7b606d85fe3f629cca73c97802b9946ff579.text: 從 Guardsman Pah 向西走，然後走下臺階，沿著海岸線到達 Chitaro 警官處。沿途可能會產生兩組 安費。

e6ab03970e72f9f921758d5f277329b14668428b.source: Clear the Mehtani Keys in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
e6ab03970e72f9f921758d5f277329b14668428b.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 梅坦尼之鑰。

07591f066bb9c16f30f6d4c99bf07d5d7570c7e8.source: "Clear the Mehtani Keys in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."
07591f066bb9c16f30f6d4c99bf07d5d7570c7e8.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 梅坦尼之鑰。”

858f89d6ed3be3a503c32300fdaaf93a0824fc6d.source: Characters will likely come here for the first time as part of the primary quest Isle of the Dead, which can be acquired after completion of the Jokanur Diggings mission.
858f89d6ed3be3a503c32300fdaaf93a0824fc6d.text: Characters will likely come here for the first time as part of the primary quest Isle of the Dead, which can be acquired after completion of the Jokanur Diggings mission.

0884abffa334d7b08ab2b02fc886f6feccc1872e.source: Secondary quests that lead to this area from other locations include the Cyclone Palace, Corsair Invasion, and Double Dog Dare.
0884abffa334d7b08ab2b02fc886f6feccc1872e.text: 從其他地點通往該區域的次要任務包括旋風宮殿、海盜 入侵和雙狗大冒險。

625e90a0ec1ffcf3d1dc7be5387a6d3889d85922.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.3% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
625e90a0ec1ffcf3d1dc7be5387a6d3889d85922.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Elonian 版圖 主打歌貢獻了約 2.3%。

921453d19b89cc6aa09a84b90ed46a8eba99f159.source: Anti-melee skills are useful here as there are many warriors and dervishes in this area.
921453d19b89cc6aa09a84b90ed46a8eba99f159.text: 反近戰技能在這裡很有用，因為這個地區有很多戰士和托缽僧。

c4995441c6be4e2cedaadbdaaf38149cebcb8a3b.source: There are several random spots of hidden mandragors: northeast from the exit into Kodlonu Hamlet, the first island southwest from that exit, bottom of the bridge leading to the northern island, and the northeastern corner.
c4995441c6be4e2cedaadbdaaf38149cebcb8a3b.text: There are several random spots of hidden mandragors: northeast from the exit into Kodlonu Hamlet, the first island southwest from that exit, bottom of the bridge leading to the northern island, and the northeastern corner.

90192c8f7c1b7957111ee885d6c59986e8fb8ea0.source: The Lone Raider quest gives you four additional allies that could be somewhat helpful to vanquishing this area.
90192c8f7c1b7957111ee885d6c59986e8fb8ea0.text: 孤獨的襲擊者任務為您提供了四個額外的盟友，這可能對征服該地區有所幫助。

316ca7610299e3b8e55ab95828b0f3751ed248f4.source: The Cyclone Palace quest in particular will produce a lot more skale spawns.
316ca7610299e3b8e55ab95828b0f3751ed248f4.text: 特別是旋風宮殿任務將產生更多的斯凱爾生成。

f5c3b18d7cfcdf9731c62c34bb7f1d10a960add2.source: The resurrection shrine that summons Lyssa's Muse in the village on the northernmost island has a statue depicting Balthazar.
f5c3b18d7cfcdf9731c62c34bb7f1d10a960add2.text: 在最北端島嶼的村莊裡，召喚麗莎繆斯的復活神社有一座描繪巴薩澤的雕像。

dc627232f361eadb74667efbe06c97ccc4be59cf.source: Clear Melandru's Hope in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
dc627232f361eadb74667efbe06c97ccc4be59cf.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科凡德森林 中的 梅蘭朵的盼望。

ccfa5940dee28890567dda59803ee4c5e8e1c12b.source: "Clear Melandru's Hope in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."
ccfa5940dee28890567dda59803ee4c5e8e1c12b.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的科凡德森林中的梅蘭朵的盼望。”

8eeb0c6a6fb56da38661fcefec8807cd105fe3f7.source: This area is largely optional if not for the Jade Quarry primary quest that leads to Jade Flats (Kurzick). It's also possible that one may be following the secondary quests of Rhythm Drinker Drum, The Beak of Darkness, Artistic Endeavors, or Charting the Forests when one first enters this area.
8eeb0c6a6fb56da38661fcefec8807cd105fe3f7.text: 如果不是為了通往翡翠公寓 (庫茲柯) 的 翡翠礦場 主要任務，這個區域在很大程度上是可選的。 It's also possible that one may be following the secondary quests of Rhythm Drinker Drum, The Beak of Darkness, Artistic Endeavors, or Charting the Forests when one first enters this area.

c29b97bc505ef7da90f6643fd91625508fdc853d.source: Artistic Endeavors (adds a few additional Dredge foes)
c29b97bc505ef7da90f6643fd91625508fdc853d.text: 藝術努力（增加了一些額外的 挖掘者 敵人）

bbc5af1d0afd5107c2aee751830434d40441008a.source: Rhythm Drinker Drum (adds a single Drinker foe)
bbc5af1d0afd5107c2aee751830434d40441008a.text: 節奏飲酒者鼓（加上一個飲酒者敵人）

1d616653f3d6a98ffb62019837c278927ef650f5.source: Securing Echovald Forest (adds lots of Luxon foes)
1d616653f3d6a98ffb62019837c278927ef650f5.text: 確保 科凡德森林 的安全（增加大量 勒克森 敵人）

93bab74b1c450887278d9b62976df283ea15e785.source: The bosses Nundak The Archer and Rot Foulbelly are part of the same mob and can't be pulled separately.
93bab74b1c450887278d9b62976df283ea15e785.text: 首領 Nundak The 射手傭兵 和 Rot Foulbelly 是相同生物的一部分，不能單獨拉動。

4c2d5a631ef24854f0ea33bc1fab81c86c2cc9d5.source: Exploring this area will contribute approximately 3.3% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
4c2d5a631ef24854f0ea33bc1fab81c86c2cc9d5.text: 探索該領域將為 Canthan 版圖 標題貢獻約 3.3%。

e7d19d41af2aa4376027dcb070f91a8f5ad7e3a7.source: There are several hidden foes around Chkkr Brightclaw and Byzzr Wingmender that appear once each boss is aggro'd.
e7d19d41af2aa4376027dcb070f91a8f5ad7e3a7.text: Chkkr 光爪 和 Byzzr Wingmender 周圍有幾個隱藏的敵人，一旦每個 Boss 被攻擊，就會出現。

df2a366de6f0b63aa814c8e62397620e0e7c582a.source: Hunt down and kill the melodic gaki. Retrieve its melodic horn and return to Vasili Lutgardis.
df2a366de6f0b63aa814c8e62397620e0e7c582a.text: 追捕並殺死旋律加基。取回它的旋律號角並返回瓦西里·盧特加迪斯那裡。

3555250ed34635b7d10673022c80d26924a83dd1.source: Starting from House zu Heltzer, travel south from the portal to Ferndale. You should meet some Mantis and Dredge before seeing the Gaki just south of the resurrection shrine. You should be able to kill the Melodic Gaki and take its horn without aggroing the surrounding wardens. Take the horn back to House zu Heltzer to claim your reward.
3555250ed34635b7d10673022c80d26924a83dd1.text: 從 鳳荷議院 出發，從傳送門往南行駛至 蕨谷。在看到復活神社南邊的加奇之前，你應該會遇到一些螳螂和 挖掘者。你應該能夠殺死旋律加基並拿走它的號角，而不會激怒周圍的守望者。將號角帶回 鳳荷議院 領取獎勵。

65dfcc17363564c0e170317efe5cfa0dcf655213.source: Clear Mamnoon Lagoon in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
65dfcc17363564c0e170317efe5cfa0dcf655213.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 梅古瑪叢林 中的 瑪奴潟湖。

ced2c81e08a37c3e599b3cf59bdf80b66e4bdff7.source: "Clear Mamnoon Lagoon in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."
ced2c81e08a37c3e599b3cf59bdf80b66e4bdff7.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的梅古瑪叢林中的瑪奴潟湖。”

2936a9808cca18b0bb177c18392e8371bf79e424.source: Exit from Druid's Overlook. Travel west through Sage Lands. The secondary quest Mysterious Message will take you here.
2936a9808cca18b0bb177c18392e8371bf79e424.text: 從 德魯伊高地 退出。透過 賢者領地 向西行駛。次要任務 機密資訊 將帶你到這裡。

2e7773a28c0f44923a79b34c84ebbe02c2cbe33e.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.3% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
2e7773a28c0f44923a79b34c84ebbe02c2cbe33e.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.3% 的貢獻。

79a0ec71d7fb091121aeffbf20398ff2373f7a68.source: Hidden Life Pods are scattered around the area.
79a0ec71d7fb091121aeffbf20398ff2373f7a68.text: 隱藏的 生命 Pod 分散在該區域各處。

b0f293dc40895cd458f06ecf0d8a19bea3c15d35.source: There are several large groups of Wind Riders that circle the lagoon; some patrol clockwise and some counterclockwise. Keep an eye on patrols to avoid being caught between two groups and spread out to avoid their area of effect interrupts.
b0f293dc40895cd458f06ecf0d8a19bea3c15d35.text: 有幾大群禦風者圍繞著潟湖；有的順時針巡邏，有的逆時針巡邏。密切注意巡邏隊，避免被夾在兩支隊伍之間，並分散開來，避免其影響範圍受到幹擾。

ac4860855ca6b43ea665626988bc19b76ce76db4.source: Speak to Artificer Mullenix when you are ready to duel with Knorr Oaken.
ac4860855ca6b43ea665626988bc19b76ce76db4.text: 當您準備好與 Knorr Oaken 決鬥時，請與 工匠 穆尼克斯 交談。

6d09af5b0952843d2b6519253b937f76ccb03404.source: Stand as the champion for the Eye of the North and defeat Knorr Oaken for the sake of all humanity!
6d09af5b0952843d2b6519253b937f76ccb03404.text: 成為 極地之眼 的冠軍，為了全人類擊敗 Knorr Oaken！

2a51ddf25ab6318bb51d50ec8c59f24128a8babf.source: Mano a Norn-o/Guide for a detailed walkthrough
2a51ddf25ab6318bb51d50ec8c59f24128a8babf.text: Mano 的 諾恩-o/詳細演練指南

9f404ef10cdbc41a467ddd91bb88ac6a274f9b28.source: Knorr is not hostile during the initial 30 second countdown, allowing him time to insult you.
9f404ef10cdbc41a467ddd91bb88ac6a274f9b28.text: 克諾爾在最初的 30 第二倒數計時期間沒有敵意，讓他有時間侮辱你。

450e11aa8b51d3400f5e050f45c21a3c4df24897.source: You will be returned to the Eye of the North 10 seconds after winning.
450e11aa8b51d3400f5e050f45c21a3c4df24897.text: 獲勝後您將返回 極地之眼 10 秒。

3872377653de7addfec8316e9c8abab8fcab96d3.source: You can turn north and enter the Hall of Monuments: there is no portal and you will see all 4 tapestries (regardless of how many your character has displayed).
3872377653de7addfec8316e9c8abab8fcab96d3.text: 您可以向北轉向並進入 史蹟殿堂：沒有傳送門，您將看到所有 4 掛毯（無論您的角色顯示了多少）。

c08d4f2cb457a15911bf8defe2ba94cc44def339.source: You can also win if you keep Knorr at less than 50% health for around 2 minutes.
c08d4f2cb457a15911bf8defe2ba94cc44def339.text: 如果您讓克諾爾的生命值低於 50% 並持續約 2 分鐘，您也可以獲得勝利。

2c9fb26b3b8274bad4f91b38b8914468c9d7f993.source: Map travel to Kamadan and speak to Alekaya.
2c9fb26b3b8274bad4f91b38b8914468c9d7f993.text: 地圖前往卡馬丹並與阿萊卡亞交談。

820a0c8eadb404f7e241238a13b63cbb73644729.text: 前往阿萊卡亞領取獎勵。

c3b92b0de927de25dd1b10a62641722cf93c0143.source: To complete this quest you do not actually have to map travel to Kamadan, walking to Kamadan and speaking to Alekaya will also complete the quest.
c3b92b0de927de25dd1b10a62641722cf93c0143.text: 要完成這個任務，你實際上不需要在地圖上前往卡馬丹，步行到卡馬丹並與阿萊卡亞交談也將完成任務。

39f947fe009ded5c8bd02a0cfee256be09d835ff.source: "Hey, guess what? My mom showed me how to map travel the other day! It's amazing! I just look at my map and select a place I've already been, and I go there instantly! It only works on cities I've marked with a big gold and green symbol, but once I start going to other towns and outposts I'll end up finding more places I can travel to instantly. I just saw you come out of town, so you should have a marker for town on your map. You should click on it and tell my mom thanks for inventing map travel!"
39f947fe009ded5c8bd02a0cfee256be09d835ff.text: 「嘿，你猜怎麼著？前幾天我媽媽向我展示瞭如何繪製旅行地圖！太神奇了！我只需檢視地圖並選擇一個我去過的地方，然後立即前往那裡！它只適用於我用大金色和綠色符號標記的城市，但一旦我開始前往其他城鎮和前哨站，我最終會找到更多我可以立即前往城鎮的

6be2d2393e259fcf9f005160d5dc3e194ea53f09.source: Clear the Marga Coast in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode.
6be2d2393e259fcf9f005160d5dc3e194ea53f09.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 馬加海岸。

fa9966cb95ef08d6ad8027934cda06acf83c16eb.source: "Clear the Marga Coast in Kourna of all enemies in hard mode."
fa9966cb95ef08d6ad8027934cda06acf83c16eb.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 高楠 中的 馬加海岸。”

9c00e2251bd387cee168cc2e1890c774c2a6aa63.source: Combines well with Trying Times as Ignis will be along the way.
9c00e2251bd387cee168cc2e1890c774c2a6aa63.text: 與 艱苦時刻 完美結合，因為 Ignis 將一直陪伴著左右。

e68325f265307fd868571a3e362272d71bbf852e.source: Find the author of the message.

46bfcf6dcbac2b55f5e8f43ba7b8e07ec1c159d4.source: See Great Reaver Rixor for your reward.
46bfcf6dcbac2b55f5e8f43ba7b8e07ec1c159d4.text: 前往偉大掠奪者裡克索領取獎勵。

d1528878a03fe5086af8ef94519b30020adb6e2f.source: Start from the Leviathan Pits, and head into Gyala Hatchery, then make your way to the green island found just to the south of the Gyala Hatchery (outpost). On the island, you will find Samti Kohlreg at his lonely vigil. Speak to Samti to update your quest then take the followup quest from him.
d1528878a03fe5086af8ef94519b30020adb6e2f.text: 從 利拜亞森礦場 出發，前往 蓋拉孵化所，然後前往位於 蓋拉孵化所（前哨站）南邊的綠島。在島上，您會發現薩姆蒂·科爾雷格正在孤獨地守夜。與薩姆蒂交談以更新你的任務，然後從他那裡接受後續任務。

4bee8222ab2a9950bd0f9fecfe9b6e4bd66ca5e1.source: Map back to Seafarer's Rest to claim your reward from Rixor.
4bee8222ab2a9950bd0f9fecfe9b6e4bd66ca5e1.text: 映射回 航海者休憩處 以從 Rixor 領取獎勵。

7f1444bbf5c5ccdd582b4b0c417c24455642c836.source: See Samti Kohlreg for your reward.
7f1444bbf5c5ccdd582b4b0c417c24455642c836.text: 請前往 Samti Kohlreg 領取獎勵。

3192f8e8d4fbbef9c6f9b830ada43ce5ddc1648e.source: You'll need to take a little trip round the Jade Sea to find each of the 3 message bottles in the explorable areas listed in the quest dialogue:
3192f8e8d4fbbef9c6f9b830ada43ce5ddc1648e.text: 您需要在 碧玉海 周圍走一圈，才能在任務對話方塊中列出的可探索區域中找到每個 3 訊息瓶：

97bf483899abdd53ffe0c73208694607df270b4b.source: Maishang Hills (Year 2) - This bottle is just outside the Gyala Hatchery (outpost), step carefully and avoid the Kappa patrols.
97bf483899abdd53ffe0c73208694607df270b4b.text: 麥尚山丘（年份2）-這個瓶子就在蓋拉孵化所（前哨站）外面，小心行走並避開Kappa巡邏隊。

34341fe3ea3376be22e7755835a95e0ae21fb3ce.source: Archipelagos (Year 3) - This bottle is due south of Cavalon in the middle of a group of Naga
34341fe3ea3376be22e7755835a95e0ae21fb3ce.text: 群島（年份 3） - 瓶子位於 卡瓦隆 的正南，位於一組 納迦 的中間

b0703bc4895d2a17f761241b7342c0dfcaa20d97.source: Silent Surf (Year 4) - This bottle is due east of Unwaking Waters (Luxon), be careful at this bottle, since patrol routes for groups of Saltspray Dragons and Rockhide Dragons cross near it. Move carefully and you can probably avoid them.
b0703bc4895d2a17f761241b7342c0dfcaa20d97.text: 寂靜之浪（年份4） - 這個瓶子位於不醒水域（勒克森）的正東，小心這個瓶子，因為鹽霧龍和巖皮龍的巡邏路線在它附近交叉。小心移動，你也許可以避開它們。

e6dfb618e22f4b99141c20baa6dd9c890b96269f.source: When all 3 bottles have been collected, map-travel to the Leviathan Pits and return to Samti, following the same route you used to find him in the preceding quest.
e6dfb618e22f4b99141c20baa6dd9c890b96269f.text: 收集完所有 3 瓶子後，沿著地圖旅行至 利拜亞森礦場 並返回 Samti，遵循您在先前的任務中找到他的相同路線。

8ec0058bbd6696ffde3aee1f98403fda4b57943d.source: Guild Wars factions on the account
8ec0058bbd6696ffde3aee1f98403fda4b57943d.text: 公會 帳號上的戰爭派系

f10606750ef38dc3e2989cb0603fe918639c6ec0.source: Plague in Cantha neither active nor completed
f10606750ef38dc3e2989cb0603fe918639c6ec0.text: 凱薩的鼠疫既不活躍也不結束

6139a696807e24a084726bbb3a1c8e8e97427608.source: Defend North Kryta Province not active
6139a696807e24a084726bbb3a1c8e8e97427608.text: 保護 科瑞塔北部 未啟動

5ce39572f9473011a5b55dbdeeb0d9c3b5aa2ed0.source: Find Mhenlo in North Kryta Province to learn more about the letter he has received.
5ce39572f9473011a5b55dbdeeb0d9c3b5aa2ed0.text: 在 科瑞塔北部 中找到 涵洛，以瞭解有關他收到的信件的更多資訊。

16acea8b02212f1f42a6032c52c6f4f45884c377.source: Speak with Jiaju Tai to book passage to Cantha.
16acea8b02212f1f42a6032c52c6f4f45884c377.text: 與 加貝泰 交談以預訂前往 Cantha 的旅程。

37240290442963984d6e108c3ad95bf62bf6a37b.source: Speak with Dockhand Quangnai to learn more about the situation in Cantha.
37240290442963984d6e108c3ad95bf62bf6a37b.text: 與 Dockhand Quangnai 交談，以瞭解更多有關 Cantha 的情況。

ce688b610a80f21bfa6f2deef688e9dbb16e872d.source: Travel north through the portal into North Kryta Province. Mhenlo will be waiting for you just outside of town. Mhenlo will send you to the docks inside Lion's Arch to speak with Jiaju Tai to book passage to Cantha.
ce688b610a80f21bfa6f2deef688e9dbb16e872d.text: 向北穿過傳送門進入 科瑞塔北部。 涵洛 將在城外等您。 涵洛 將帶您前往 獅子拱門 內的碼頭，與 加貝泰 通話以預訂前往 Cantha 的船票。

189efdfcba54df628f73179646a4fab56e608045.source: Your ship docks at Bejunkan Pier in Cantha. Immediately after getting off the ship you will find Dockhand Quangnai. He has your reward, a message from Mhenlo and another quest to give you.
189efdfcba54df628f73179646a4fab56e608045.text: 您的船停靠在 Cantha 的 君瞰碼頭。下船後立刻就能看到Dockhand Quangnai。他有你的獎勵、一封來自 涵洛 的訊息、另一個任務要交給你。

bd8532f40a627ecc85fba416ebf4242c7ca0b735.source: Mhenlo won't spawn with Evil Residents or Evil Residents Code: Harmonica in the quest log.
bd8532f40a627ecc85fba416ebf4242c7ca0b735.text: 涵洛 不會在任務日誌中與邪惡居民或邪惡居民程式碼：口琴一起產生。

18ff3c1c4fbae3619c84b9453466f2a3bb64bb85.source: This quest unlocks the Kaineng Center port (once you have traveled to Bejunkan Pier).
18ff3c1c4fbae3619c84b9453466f2a3bb64bb85.text: 此任務解鎖 凱寧中心 連線埠（一旦您前往 君瞰碼頭）。

0f4b574ff4dfe320b57022f27877c801e2d2c982.source: Having this quest active or completed will make Plague in Cantha unavailable.
0f4b574ff4dfe320b57022f27877c801e2d2c982.text: 啟動或完成此任務將使凱薩的瘟疫變得不可用。

4d5080f83de648e6c7d147841cc439fc3762c171.source: While walking along Bejunkan Pier, there are two level 20 monsters that attack the party. At the end of the battle, the conversation continues, then the allies in the party wave just before entering Kaineng Center.
4d5080f83de648e6c7d147841cc439fc3762c171.text: 沿著君瞰碼頭行走時，有兩個等級20怪物攻擊隊伍。戰鬥結束時，對話繼續，然後隊伍中的盟友在進入 凱寧中心 之前揮手致意。

6b6ac0b463f394e3851c7c4399470ac3b564ea51.source: You may wish to also have the quest The Experimental Weaponsmith active while performing this quest since both quests take you to the same general area in Ferndale.
6b6ac0b463f394e3851c7c4399470ac3b564ea51.text: 在執行此任務時，您可能還想啟動實驗性 武器商人 任務，因為這兩個任務都會將您帶到 蕨谷 中的相同區域。

9920f625473342d4fd6fb8f48acf629c8ff8a2bc.source: Koss Goes Recruiting neither active nor completed
9920f625473342d4fd6fb8f48acf629c8ff8a2bc.text: 寇斯 開始招募既不活躍也不完成

810be47bbc3fb41c9c7b53505dbcac5ed31122d6.text: 與 梅隆妮 交談。

1eae4a4057400d968f82e98501c803f1ba5e6daa.source: Escort Melonni to meet her contact in the Sunward Marches.
1eae4a4057400d968f82e98501c803f1ba5e6daa.text: 護送 梅隆妮 去見她在 向陽邊境 中的聯絡人。

c440d75a7912349ea9fc721d2b6fa1028a5a6a39.source: The easiest way to do this quest is starting from Dajkah Inlet. Walk out to the north where the boss Eshim Mindclouder is located. You might be able to run in and update the quest without fighting that group. Return to Sunspear Sanctuary once the quest updates itself as completed.
c440d75a7912349ea9fc721d2b6fa1028a5a6a39.text: 完成此任務最簡單的方法是從達吉卡灣開始。向北走，那裡有 Boss Eshim Mindclouder 所在的地方。您也許可以跑進去並更新任務，而無需與該組織戰鬥。一旦任務更新為已完成，影返 就會變成 日戟避難所。

9f2969e87ebb0921a4444ed7f08b239a95078252.source: Dunkoro also offers the quest Koss Goes Recruiting. You can only choose one of the 2 quests, since the other will then become unavailable.
9f2969e87ebb0921a4444ed7f08b239a95078252.text: Dunkoro 也提供任務 寇斯 去招募。您只能選擇其中一個 2 任務，因為其他任務將變得無法使用。

89ab9cac42676f26e8e0e5c517be7c0884f03ec9.source: After completion of this quest, Jehrono will appear in the Command Post as an additional material trader NPC.
89ab9cac42676f26e8e0e5c517be7c0884f03ec9.text: 完成此任務後，傑羅諾將作為額外的材料商人 NPC 出現在 指揮所 中。

96fb2a4ee16fef98d47348378598491c1b48f2f1.source: Although Jehrono is labeled as a rare material trader, he acts like a normal material trader. However, this bears no significance to the function of the Command Post since both types of material traders are already present.
96fb2a4ee16fef98d47348378598491c1b48f2f1.text: 儘管傑羅諾被標記為 稀有材料商，但他的行為就像一個普通的材料商人。然而，這對 指揮所 的功能沒有任何意義，因為這兩種型別的材料貿易商都已經存在。

e4d6ecf4fd689a16d3169aa76159a0aa7217f528.text: 必需的 英雄：梅隆妮

8c64048cec56276a91af0e7856b954df8fe5134b.source: Lead Melonni through the Marga Coast as she attempts to commune with the natural world.
8c64048cec56276a91af0e7856b954df8fe5134b.text: 當 梅隆妮 嘗試與自然世界溝通時，引導 梅隆妮 透過 馬加海岸。

4f2ce274f5e517a45a0e0f0c5be59adc0be89b38.source: Defeat the creatures that attack when Melonni prays by the pond.
4f2ce274f5e517a45a0e0f0c5be59adc0be89b38.text: 擊敗 梅隆妮 在池塘邊祈禱時發動攻擊的生物。

988be5f1805daa21fc945dd5df0aa76e48d4ba8a.source: Defeat the creatures that attack when Melonni prays by the rock formation.
988be5f1805daa21fc945dd5df0aa76e48d4ba8a.text: 擊敗當 梅隆妮 在巖層邊祈禱時發動攻擊的生物。

ad8895d5002e4eeea4a28fb9f8e69c65b8571a0c.source: Defeat the creatures that attack when Melonni prays by the dying tree.
ad8895d5002e4eeea4a28fb9f8e69c65b8571a0c.text: 擊敗當 梅隆妮 在垂死的樹旁祈禱時發動攻擊的生物。

130de7cc8e9b2f02894476c486e1dc94f026c659.source: Elder Jonah can be found at point J on the quest map just outside the southwest exit from the Sunspear Sanctuary. Go with Melonni to each of the quest points. At each one, groups of Corrupted Natures will attack. These groups are small and should pose no threat to a full party. A new group will spawn only after completely destroying the previous one. The final group also contains an Infectious Nightmare.
130de7cc8e9b2f02894476c486e1dc94f026c659.text: 喬納長老位於任務地圖上的 J 點，就在 日戟避難所 西南方出口外。使用 梅隆妮 前往每個任務點。每到一處，就會有成群的腐化自然生物發動攻擊。這些團體規模很小，不會對整個政黨構成威脅。只有在完全摧毀前一個群體後才會產生新的群體。最後一組還包含 Infectious 夢魘。

c471944c7e4c996ad5d42c84056100ce55ee4156.source: From the Wandering Priest at point W on the quest map, you can obtain the Kournan Bounty blessing which gives you double XP from Kournan soldiers and 4 Sunspear promotion points for every Kournan soldier your slay. x2 in hard mode.
c471944c7e4c996ad5d42c84056100ce55ee4156.text: 從任務地圖上 W 點的流浪牧師那裡，你可以獲得庫南賞金祝福，它可以讓你從庫南士兵那裡獲得雙倍經驗值，並為你殺死的每一個庫南士兵提供 4 陽矛升級點。 x2 處於困難模式。

a545a49964880dcf5e010724b5f1294a0e8b9a25.source: Spawns in Marga Coast will be different from normal when Melonni is in your party unless all players in your party have finished this quest.
a545a49964880dcf5e010724b5f1294a0e8b9a25.text: 當 梅隆妮 在您的隊伍中時，馬加海岸 中的生成將與正常情況不同，除非您隊伍中的所有玩家都已完成此任務。

5bf4e02efe7cd653d12ea4ed64595c975dcea79a.source: Deliver the strongbox to Captain Greywind in the Ascalon Settlement.
5bf4e02efe7cd653d12ea4ed64595c975dcea79a.text: 將保險箱交付給 阿斯卡隆移民區 中的 格雷溫軍官。

a1053e2abbfd67c8d9476d8bdb120f8c40d5de33.source: After getting the quest and the Settlement's Strongbox from Bodrus the Outfitter, exit from Lion's Arch into North Kryta Province and head northwest to the Ascalon Settlement. Speak with Captain Greywind to complete the quest.
a1053e2abbfd67c8d9476d8bdb120f8c40d5de33.text: 從 雜貨商保得勒斯 取得任務和定居點的保險箱後，從 獅子拱門 退出進入 科瑞塔北部，然後向西北前往 阿斯卡隆移民區。與 格雷溫軍官 交談以完成任務。

300501aa48f2a3304d963185a99806dd0b60de17.source: Complete the Defense Against Hexes course.

79a00f19cf61148459fa2d17a69d3c046998db45.text: 完成 削弱 課程。

141274d3362e0132fbb4eef9512a79dcf48d66a1.source: See Headmaster Kaa for your reward.
141274d3362e0132fbb4eef9512a79dcf48d66a1.text: 去找卡校長領取你的獎勵。

c4409d1584d2f0df3b304d9d8a312b9763de368d.source: Although you don't have to do the Advanced Defense Techniques, it is useful to do so, as you will gain a mesmer skill Clumsiness upon quest acceptance.
c4409d1584d2f0df3b304d9d8a312b9763de368d.text: 雖然你不必執行高階防禦技術，但這樣做很有用，因為接受任務後你將獲得催眠技能 笨拙。

f7a88a313577f441d769128de4b50c17c48db96f.source: Go to the ruins of Ashford and defeat Ignis Phanaura.
f7a88a313577f441d769128de4b50c17c48db96f.text: 前往阿什福德廢墟並擊敗伊格尼斯·法瑙拉。

ff0ee8fd7ce374a86107e3a4a29a3405a7e2d09e.source: You will find Ignis Phanaura just south of the Sardelac Sanitarium alongside two additional gargoyles. When accompanied by henchmen or in a group, they shouldn't pose much of a threat. Beware of Ignis's Chaos Storm, which can deal a significant hit to both your Health and Energy over time. When you see him cast it, change your position to avoid the area damage.
ff0ee8fd7ce374a86107e3a4a29a3405a7e2d09e.text: 您會在 薩德拉克療養院 以南發現伊格尼斯‧法瑙拉 (Ignis Phanaura)，旁邊還有另外兩隻石像鬼。當有追隨者陪伴或成群結隊時，他們不應該構成太大的威脅。當心 Ignis 的 混沌風暴，隨著時間的推移，它會對您的 體力 和 能量 造成重大打擊。當你看到他施放它時，改變你的位置以避免區域損壞。

6e47f4c3ec1f2b4d6a9dcbec97efdbe097c92d03.source: Whenever a character who has not visited Cantha enters Lion's Arch, unless this quest or Plague in Cantha is in their log, the message "To unlock travel to Cantha, accept the quest Mhenlo's Request from Firstwatch Sergio" will appear.
6e47f4c3ec1f2b4d6a9dcbec97efdbe097c92d03.text: 每當未造訪過 Cantha 的角色進入 獅子拱門 時，除非該任務或 Cantha 瘟疫在其日誌中，否則會出現訊息「要解鎖前往 Cantha 的旅行，請接受來自 警衛隊長薩吉歐 的任務 涵洛 的請求」。

dec2c6f4cd866a77d2ee592fdb8c315be7a24d44.source: See Campaign travel for additional information.
dec2c6f4cd866a77d2ee592fdb8c315be7a24d44.text: 請參閱 章節 旅行了解更多資訊。

808b6478eb2dcb609f3cf68a2b1fe02efec2bec7.source: Talk to Sergeant Clark in Regent Valley.
808b6478eb2dcb609f3cf68a2b1fe02efec2bec7.text: 與 統治者之谷 中的克拉克中士交談。

e8fee808dee6bf5c5689a363911dfd79e1073a35.source: Escort Sergeant Clark back to Warmaster Grast.
e8fee808dee6bf5c5689a363911dfd79e1073a35.text: 護送克拉克中士返回 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特。

fb80981543dd93fa2ac1006dbe03884347e7b5fe.source: Warmaster Grast is located close to Ascalon City, talk to him and then head south-east to Regent Valley. Enter Regent Valley and you will see Sergeant Clark; talk to him and return to Old Ascalon explorable area. Sergeant Clark will be awaiting you with two or three Ascalonian Guards, and will start to follow you when approached. Escort Clark back to Warmaster Grast. Ensure his safety; he is a warrior and only has one skill, Healing Signet. Only Clark needs to survive. There are several Devourer pop-ups, so try not to over-aggro.
fb80981543dd93fa2ac1006dbe03884347e7b5fe.text: 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特 位於 阿斯卡隆城 附近，與他交談，然後向東南方向前往 統治者之谷。輸入統治者之谷，你會看到Clark中士；與他交談並返回 舊阿斯卡隆 可探索區域。克拉克中士將帶著兩到三名阿斯卡隆衛兵等待你，當你接近時他會開始跟隨你。護送克拉克返回 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特。確保他的安全；他是一名戰士，只有一項技能：治療紋章。只有克拉克需要生存。有幾個 蠍 彈出視窗，所以盡量不要過度仇恨。

3ef7e49d9a390559bd63e272981c8923d3fc1e4e.source: The Ascalon Guards follow Sergeant Clark, not the player. If Clark dies, the guards will no longer follow the party.
3ef7e49d9a390559bd63e272981c8923d3fc1e4e.text: 阿斯卡隆 守衛跟隨克拉克中士，而不是玩家。如果克拉克死了，守衛將不再跟隨隊伍。

f0aa4a90f886db44b217e5d2c9c0e169ae34bd91.source: The additional allies can make this quest useful for vanquishing Old Ascalon and Regent Valley.
f0aa4a90f886db44b217e5d2c9c0e169ae34bd91.text: 額外的盟友可以使該任務對於擊敗 舊阿斯卡隆 和 統治者之谷 很有用。

2d74a8d8bb8b57f5c565c5957ef37a5b36ac1ef9.source: Find Minaar Stonesledge in Iron Horse Mine.
2d74a8d8bb8b57f5c565c5957ef37a5b36ac1ef9.text: 在 鐵馬礦山 中找到米納爾石獅。

ad82c0a00f7d93552e53a922b77925f4837962b0.source: Escort Minaar back to Traveler's Vale.
ad82c0a00f7d93552e53a922b77925f4837962b0.text: 護送米納爾返回 旅人谷。

fc22a2312398042bc178b5188f5c7ceb8b24c5b5.source: Once you obtain the quest, go into the Iron Horse Mine and turn right. Follow the quest marker to Minaar Stonesledge and try not to lure too many mobs at once — the Summit Beastmasters use Giant Stomp which knocks down anyone within earshot range. Once you arrive at Minaar, lead him back to the portal but do not enter it. Wait for the quest to update and then go through to see Rangil for your reward. Alternatively, clearing the path from the portal to Minaar of enemies before interacting with him will remove all risks of him dying.
fc22a2312398042bc178b5188f5c7ceb8b24c5b5.text: 獲得任務後，進入 鐵馬礦山 並右轉。跟著任務標記前往米納爾石獅，盡量不要一次引誘太多的怪物——峰會獸王使用 重踩 來擊倒聽力範圍內的任何人。到達米納爾後，將他帶回傳送門，但不要進入。等待任務更新，然後去見蘭吉爾以獲得獎勵。或者，在與米納爾互動之前清除從傳送門到米納爾的路徑上的敵人將消除他死亡的所有風險。

7594a65d34b8c171bfb0f214d8893017c9b34f0f.source: Despite the quest tracker indicating you should zone into Traveler's Vale to continue the quest, doing so before triggering Minaar's dialogue will revert the quest to finding him in Iron Horse Mines.
7594a65d34b8c171bfb0f214d8893017c9b34f0f.text: 儘管任務追蹤器指示你應該進入 旅人谷 來繼續任務，但在觸發米納爾的對話之前這樣做會將任務恢復到在鐵馬礦井中尋找他。

20344f25f92239af6a5b3a3c50aa1e74e4559886.source: Minaar is not actually found in the mine, but rather the Ettin cave east of it.
20344f25f92239af6a5b3a3c50aa1e74e4559886.text: 米納爾實際上並不是在礦井中發現的，而是在礦井東邊的 雙頭巨人 洞穴中發現的。

6b192af168c0a13af55e3f402f95303c7ba46fbf.source: Before heading out to take this quest, take Helping the Dwarves from Grand Mason Stonecleaver in Yak's Bend, as it leads directly to Rangil Ironbow.
6b192af168c0a13af55e3f402f95303c7ba46fbf.text: 在出發執行此任務之前，請從 犛牛村 中的 偉大石匠史東克里佛 中獲取 支援矮人，因為它直接通向 鐵弓冉吉爾。

01ef44d548d19fe505d5f270f35c46a9fd4dd4eb.source: Go to the Iron Horse Mine and kill Ore Darkwhip.
01ef44d548d19fe505d5f270f35c46a9fd4dd4eb.text: 前往 鐵馬礦山 並殺死 Ore Darkwhip。

59befdf7a07a0eaac3af72d15cba8235840dd087.source: Deliver the war machine plans to Rangil Ironbow.
59befdf7a07a0eaac3af72d15cba8235840dd087.text: 將戰爭機器計劃交付給 鐵弓冉吉爾。

43bad58ab45845fa25f42a108a946a3efe61e53e.source: Go back into Iron Horse Mine and take the same path you took to reach Minaar. Continue on past the cave and you will find Ore Darkwhip just on the other end of the mining area. He'll drop the war machine plans when you kill him. Grab them and take them back to Rangil.
43bad58ab45845fa25f42a108a946a3efe61e53e.text: 返回 鐵馬礦山 並沿著到達米納爾的路線走。繼續穿過洞穴，您會在礦區的另一端找到黑鞭礦石。當你殺了他時，他就會放棄戰爭機器計畫。抓住他們並將他們帶回蘭吉爾。

757ad513662e031df79dd467c464b1860991bece.source: If you attempt this quest with multiple players, only one "war machine plans" is required to complete the quest. Have the player that picked up the plans talk to Rangil and everyone can complete the quest.
757ad513662e031df79dd467c464b1860991bece.text: 如果您與多名玩家一起嘗試此任務，則只需要一個「戰爭機器計畫」即可完成該任務。讓拿起計畫的玩家與蘭吉爾交談，每個人都可以完成任務。

a10ab79bf1643736e8bb37594082d7b0e0a23aa2.source: The Battle Axe given as a reward uses the Dwarven Axe skin and deals slashing damage.
a10ab79bf1643736e8bb37594082d7b0e0a23aa2.text: 作為獎勵的 戰斧 使用矮人 斧 皮膚並造成大幅傷害。

e8646ed598288ef057706705fb8706da9fbd4d58.source: Clear the Mineral Springs in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
e8646ed598288ef057706705fb8706da9fbd4d58.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的南席娃山脈中的礦物泉源。

481795011b3aa519b29a7ca5408fb5d07c3c61e0.source: This area lies northwest from Yohlon Haven, the first outpost of Kourna that characters will arrive at, after completion of the Consulate Docks mission. The next primary quest from there, Hunted!, will lead characters through this area.
481795011b3aa519b29a7ca5408fb5d07c3c61e0.text: 該地區位於西北 猶朗避難所 ，第一個前哨基地 高楠 完成領事館碼頭任務後，角色將到達的地方。從那裡開始的下一個主要任務，狩獵！ ，將帶領角色穿過這個區域。

f3b185b7dd7085832985283f5baf35dfc4e5d3de.source: The Kournan military soldiers are of two different levels. Level 16 soldiers are found outside the fort; while level 20 soldiers are found inside or near the fort.
f3b185b7dd7085832985283f5baf35dfc4e5d3de.text: 高楠士兵 士兵有兩個不同等級。 16 級士兵出現在堡壘外；而 20 等級計程車兵則出現在堡壘內部或附近。

f4a19db0afc4601435b8d03115b2550c254fac40.source: Along the beach to the southeast, there are several groups of hidden Frigid Skale. Proceed along the beach slowly.
f4a19db0afc4601435b8d03115b2550c254fac40.text: 沿著海灘向東南方向，隱藏著幾組寒冰鱗怪。沿著海灘慢慢前進。

e35a6d9e32ba0e4d65eca9ff096723fc13a354a4.source: There are also several hidden insect groups.
e35a6d9e32ba0e4d65eca9ff096723fc13a354a4.text: 還有幾個隱藏的昆蟲群。

c3cade3b58b5fd578bfc53df20f0b9b5a4c14eab.source: Vanquishing the area with the Feeding Frenzy quest active can be helpful, since your party will gain the help of Toma, a level 22 drake that can instantly kill enemies with low health.
c3cade3b58b5fd578bfc53df20f0b9b5a4c14eab.text: 啟動餵食 狂暴 任務來征服該區域會很有幫助，因為你的隊伍將獲得 托瑪 的幫助，托瑪 是一個等級 22 的幼龍，可以立即殺死生命值較低的敵人。

dd139f860f2ca332de5cd9e3b70714a14bd60faa.source: When missing some foes, take a look to the southwest and southeast of the Fortress. Some Kournan groups have a long patrol area.
dd139f860f2ca332de5cd9e3b70714a14bd60faa.text: 當錯過一些敵人時，請看看要塞的西南方向和東南方向。一些庫爾南團體有很長的巡邏區域。

412772854c2895611ca985645a681642f05a1fc1.source: "Clear the Mineral Springs in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
412772854c2895611ca985645a681642f05a1fc1.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的南席娃山脈中的礦物泉源。”

f8514396b66189f2083eda07d2baae35e2dbcafc.source: Vanquishing: 182–241 foes. There are hidden Azure Shadows in the cave leading towards the Ancient Seer, hidden Frost Wurms at Maw the Mountain Heart's spawn point, and an occasional hidden Juniper Bark near Pinesouls.
f8514396b66189f2083eda07d2baae35e2dbcafc.text: 擊敗：182–241 敵人。通往遠古 預言者 的洞穴中有隱藏的蔚藍暗影，在莫山之心的生成點有隱藏的冰霜亞龍，松魂附近偶爾有隱藏的 松木樹皮。

aba7cbfd2902a8f567a7bc1ac461c86a934eedb5.source: Do not bunch up while engaging the Avicara, or the Avicara Fierce can quickly decimate the party.
aba7cbfd2902a8f567a7bc1ac461c86a934eedb5.text: 與 阿畢卡拉 交戰時不要聚集在一起，否則 阿畢卡拉天狗射手 會迅速消滅隊伍。

df953e526890bd8e0f3b57e3132a8477a217f039.source: The Avicara are hostile to the few Tundra Giants found here.
df953e526890bd8e0f3b57e3132a8477a217f039.text: 阿畢卡拉 對這裡發現的少數苔原巨人充滿敵意。

e1a767a4582aebbb27efdcbbf960a11cdadcf3ce.source: Technically, there are fewer foes during Defend Droknar's Forge, but due to the Titans that spawn from other Titans, there are more foes to kill. The extra Titan spawns do not count towards vanquish completion.
e1a767a4582aebbb27efdcbbf960a11cdadcf3ce.text: 從技術上講，保衛卓克納熔爐 期間的敵人較少，但由於泰坦是從其他泰坦中生成的，因此有更多的敵人需要殺死。額外的 泰坦 產生不計入征服完成。

341ad98ce87f3a4bbe24093e6b592e4c39ab4ae0.source: During Defend Droknar's Forge, the spawn locations of the Avicara bosses are fixed. In the northern path, the order of bosses from west to east will be: Hyl Thunderwing, Nhy Darkclaw, Wyt Sharpfeather. In the southern path, the order of bosses from west to east will be: Ryk Arrowwing, Syr Honorcrest, Myd Springclaw.
341ad98ce87f3a4bbe24093e6b592e4c39ab4ae0.text: 在 保衛卓克納熔爐 期間，阿畢卡拉 Boss 的產生位置是固定的。在北部路徑中，西到東的 Boss 順序為：雷翼合爾、黑爪恩亥、銳翅維特。在南部路徑中，西到東的 Boss 順序為：箭翼裡克、光榮鬃毛西勒、鐵爪米德。

4456b6c69f246d25cf431f47f4cccd78c36e6882.source: The Avicara and Titans are hostile to each other.
4456b6c69f246d25cf431f47f4cccd78c36e6882.text: 阿畢卡拉 和泰坦彼此敵對。

11c34437f1bae2ed1c88152d44d89b13ace43b0c.source: A main attraction of Mineral Springs is Lyssa's ice cave to the north east. This cave is the only place where the Icy Dragon Sword can be found through monster drops.
11c34437f1bae2ed1c88152d44d89b13ace43b0c.text: 礦物泉源 的一個主要景點是 麗莎 東北部的冰洞。這個洞穴是唯一可以透過怪物掉落來找到 冰凍巨龍之劍 的地方。

c88c9a8906fcfd601b2922e73b34a60a3532f7a6.source: See Gift of the Traveler given by Nicholas the Traveler for the inscribable version.
c88c9a8906fcfd601b2922e73b34a60a3532f7a6.text: 請參閱 地圖 提供的旅客的禮物，以瞭解可書寫的版本。

37567e5e75b3f410084b51483c5686fbfe1409aa.source: The cave also contains an Ice Beast which drops the Spectral Essence. This can be given to the Seer at the end of the ice cave to infuse a character's armor.
37567e5e75b3f410084b51483c5686fbfe1409aa.text: 洞穴還包含一個 冰獸，它會掉落光譜 模板:Reclaim Essence。這可以交給冰洞盡頭的 預言者 以注入角色的盔甲。

a326e8d45a4afd5feabd58acd47c121cf498a109.source: The last point of interest in the cave is a broken shrine to Lyssa. Morale Boosts and Holy Blessing can be acquired from the statue of Lyssa. Icy Ground is not inflicted by walking on the ice in the cave.
a326e8d45a4afd5feabd58acd47c121cf498a109.text: 洞穴中的最後一個景點是一座殘破的 麗莎 神殿。士氣提升與神聖 祝福 可從 麗莎 雕像中取得。 冰凍 在洞穴的冰面上行走不會造成地面損壞。

81a7c22be5968f911f2cdc9780e0197d8f0a26c4.source: For faster and more efficient skill capping, do not go to the closest group. Head north/northeast to where there are 3 Avicara spawns. There you will have 3 of the 6 possible bosses, and thus a greater chance to find the one you need. You may also go to the nearest spawn and hold the hotkey to highlight enemies to check if the boss is there. If it is not, just run back to Tasca's Demise and back to Mineral Springs. Remember not to resign or you'll have to cross Tasca's Demise again.
81a7c22be5968f911f2cdc9780e0197d8f0a26c4.text: 為了更快、更有效地限制技能，不要去最近的小組。往北/東北方向前往有 3 阿畢卡拉 生成點的地方。在那裡，您將擁有 3 的 6 可能的 Boss，因此更有機會找到您需要的老闆。您也可以前往最近的重生點並按住熱鍵突出顯示敵人以檢查 Boss 是否在那裡。如果不是，只需返回 塔斯拉之死，然後返回 礦物泉源。記得不要辭職，否則你將不得不再次穿越 塔斯拉之死。

470bd08c896e9721a98eeacbf6a35beb5ab17c62.source: Neutralize the danger to Minister Cho.

b36063e066446eaa6a9056f4ee330cca80a40a0a.source: As per the Minister Cho's Estate mission.
b36063e066446eaa6a9056f4ee330cca80a40a0a.text: 根據趙部長的莊園任務。

9162f3cfc6c7187ead2467749fd04dff72347e25.source: Clear Minister Cho's Estate on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
9162f3cfc6c7187ead2467749fd04dff72347e25.text: 在困難模式下清除 星岬島 上所有敵人的趙部長莊園。

1926cb0696bd5c10ccf0c9d329fabc4f2da81ffb.source: "Clear Minister Cho's Estate on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode."
1926cb0696bd5c10ccf0c9d329fabc4f2da81ffb.text: “在困難模式下清除 星岬島 上趙部長莊園的所有敵人。”

19ab04b17116922a50182a9d6b7a485f68ebb2ed.source: The only entrance is from Ran Musu Gardens.
19ab04b17116922a50182a9d6b7a485f68ebb2ed.text: 唯一的入口是 嵐穆蘇花園。

978f6ee19a83f9e17658a3ad76cccf15e00afde4.source: If Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate has been completed and Memories of Purity is not active, all spawns will be replaced by Scavenger type enemies. It is recommended to activate the quest when vanquishing the area.
978f6ee19a83f9e17658a3ad76cccf15e00afde4.text: 如果趙部長莊園的救援已完成且純潔記憶未啟用，則所有生成點都將被清道夫型別的敵怪取代。建議在征服該區域時啟動任務。

9b2b174c16c98b4fb541a52f25d300da4d89c78c.source: These quests affect the spawns in this area: Lost Treasure and Rescue at Minister Cho's Estate.
9b2b174c16c98b4fb541a52f25d300da4d89c78c.text: 這些任務會影響該區域的生成：趙部長莊園的失落寶藏和救援。

3a8b7799cc49b20ef15874d18e3d3e339d7c694f.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield approximately 2.6% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
3a8b7799cc49b20ef15874d18e3d3e339d7c694f.text: 對該區域的完整探索將產生大約 2.6% 到 Canthan 版圖 的主打歌。

db7a37a03b8d0b3db2606c9cff0ade8eb2f9b549.source: There are no bosses in this area, so avoid skills that recharge with Morale Boost (i.e. Resurrection Signet and Sunspear Rebirth Signet).
db7a37a03b8d0b3db2606c9cff0ade8eb2f9b549.text: 此區域沒有 Boss，因此請避免使用士氣提升來補充能量的技能（即 復活紋章 和 Sunspear 重生 紋章）。

491051b25bbc5c80a8f42e4cee29f7e4c4eea071.source: Since you can only have a party of four, having a spirit spammer helps.
491051b25bbc5c80a8f42e4cee29f7e4c4eea071.text: 由於您只能組成四人聚會，因此擁有精神垃圾郵件傳送者會有所幫助。

b48c16b03c0a489c792758eb716ffe97b9ed6604.source: There is a chain of islands to the northeast with foes that cannot easily be seen from the beach. Likewise, there are more foes inside the caverns to the southeast.
b48c16b03c0a489c792758eb716ffe97b9ed6604.text: 東北部有一系列島嶼，從海灘上很難看到敵人。同樣，東南方的洞穴內還有更多的敵人。

6c0723ca0f73521e8d3a642eeddda60b04ba1884.source: See Minister Jaisan for your reward
6c0723ca0f73521e8d3a642eeddda60b04ba1884.text: 請見 Jaisan 部長以領取獎勵

f83929465d19c9d3bef99fdd9be84bf73d339910.source: Defend the Centaur Village. You have [5...0] groups of Kournan troops remaining.
f83929465d19c9d3bef99fdd9be84bf73d339910.text: 保衛 半人馬 村莊。您還剩下 [5...0] 團體 Kournan 部隊。

19ffdeb1a01cccfed20470088bf2df617947ca77.text: 米爾扎·維德行者必須生存。

e9fffcb9a9612d4ab856ffc91aca6634ebc31b4a.source: Until this quest is completed, the Wandering Priest at the Resurrection Shrine nearest Mirza (that gives the Monster Hunt bounty) will not spawn and the Melandru's Watcher will also not spawn when kneeling at that Resurrection Shrine.
e9fffcb9a9612d4ab856ffc91aca6634ebc31b4a.text: 在這個任務完成之前，位於距離米爾扎最近的 復活祭壇 處的流浪牧師（提供 怪物 狩獵賞金）將不會生成，並且當跪在該 復活祭壇 處時，梅蘭朵 的觀察者也不會生成。

3d7a8001e17af05ce540827f1ce38bc16e90d612.source: You will need to rezone if you just received the reward for Centaur Concerns before you can receive this quest.
3d7a8001e17af05ce540827f1ce38bc16e90d612.text: 如果您剛剛收到 半人馬 問題的獎勵，則需要重新分割才能收到此任務。

47d337eddb21c60e30883bf8687cf2848d4bda22.source: As you come up to Mirza, some non-hostile Kournans nearby are already speaking to Mirza and threatening the other centaurs, as they challenge the Centaurs, the Kournan Phalanx will execute a centaur that they are holding hostage.
47d337eddb21c60e30883bf8687cf2848d4bda22.text: 當你到達米爾扎時，附近一些非敵對的庫南人已經在與米爾扎交談並威脅其他半人馬，當他們挑戰半人馬時，庫南方陣將處決他們扣為人質的半人馬。

5f0a22f28afffbfb600b1f71a6f01ef0bf3f475f.source: When the kournans stop talking, Mirza will offer this quest. Note that hostile soldiers will start to arrive shortly after, even if you haven't taken the quest, although it is still possible to accept it from Mirza in the middle of the battle.
5f0a22f28afffbfb600b1f71a6f01ef0bf3f475f.text: 當庫南們停止說話時，米爾札就會提出這個任務。請注意，即使您沒有接受任務，敵對士兵也會在不久後開始到達，儘管您仍然可以在戰鬥中從米爾扎那裡接受任務。

e313a749eae1c22ea5558e8be71ed0492ff00e6e.source: The Kournan soldiers will attack from both the north and south sides of Mirza's position, 3 small groups to the south, and 2 larger groups from the north. The second group from the north will have the Kournan commander, Captain Kuruk with them.
e313a749eae1c22ea5558e8be71ed0492ff00e6e.text: Kournan 士兵將從 Mirza 陣地的南北兩側進攻，3 小部隊從南部進攻，2 較大部隊從北部進攻。來自北方的第二組將有庫爾南指揮官庫魯克上尉隨行。

d2d08de1ff4798ffe58e18fdf77e032b345e1897.source: Do not leave Mirza unguarded, since he will not move from his position during the attack, and will die easily if left alone.
d2d08de1ff4798ffe58e18fdf77e032b345e1897.text: 不要讓米爾札無人看守，因為他在攻擊過程中不會離開自己的位置，如果獨自一人，他很容易死亡。

4bde7921c11246ceab819f05284106cfd82602c0.source: Mutu, the Oldest Child quest not active or completed
4bde7921c11246ceab819f05284106cfd82602c0.text: 穆圖，最大的孩子任務未啟動或完成

42394f3853d03dc45a74862a41967604b06ecd04.source: Jedur, the Youngest Child quest not active or completed
42394f3853d03dc45a74862a41967604b06ecd04.text: 傑杜爾，最小的孩子任務未啟動或完成

01cdf916a3f32085a80f2d75f5d7c5b601020220.source: Misela Wahmeh must survive to recover her inheritance.
01cdf916a3f32085a80f2d75f5d7c5b601020220.text: 米塞拉·瓦梅 (Misela Wahmeh) 必須活下來才能收回她的遺產。

9dae285db22456bf2339e3670ed0d1e180f80a67.source: After accepting the quest, accept Zenwa's offer to transport you to the ruins of Fahranur. Once there, fight your way through the undead hordes to Nehbawa Wahmeh's inheritance, which is marked by the compass point.
9dae285db22456bf2339e3670ed0d1e180f80a67.text: 接受任務後，接受 Zenwa 的提議，將你傳送到 Fahranur 廢墟。到達那裡後，殺出一條血路，穿過不死族群，到達內巴瓦·瓦梅 (Nehbawa Wahmeh) 的繼承地，那裡有羅盤點標記。

3b35441938d92163c5146be3e305ab7f5916bb29.source: Once you make it to the inheritance, Misela will retrieve it, and you will be transported back to Issnur Isles.
3b35441938d92163c5146be3e305ab7f5916bb29.text: 一旦你到達繼承地，Misela 就會取回它，而你將被傳送回 伊斯諾島。

b4360e9eaf57674e0be6dc425e54f2c5582ced7b.text: 護送愛子去見她的父親。

cf03b626a2f35be2dd06717d30cd31863ed3ed2f.source: Aiko can be found in the southwestern part of Bukdek Byway, slightly north of the entrance to The Marketplace. She is surrounded by neutral Jade Brotherhood who will turn hostile on accepting the quest. After you beat these enemies you will have to escort her back to her father Taojo. He can be found close to Kaineng Center to the north. Without any other active quests you should have only one more fight if following the directions on the map. Aiko does not join your party as an ally which means she doesn't take damage and you don't have to look after her.
cf03b626a2f35be2dd06717d30cd31863ed3ed2f.text: Aiko 位於 巴德克小徑 的西南部，市集 入口稍偏北的位置。她被中立的 翡翠兄弟會 包圍，他們在接受任務後會變得敵對。打敗這些敵人後，你必須護送她回到她父親陶城身邊。他位於北部 凱寧中心 附近。如果沒有任何其他活動任務，如果按照地圖上的指示進行操作，您應該只再進行一場戰鬥。愛子不會作為盟友加入你的隊伍，這意味著她不會受到傷害，你也不必照顧她。

ea4ff1badccd5edf78af1a0ed5ca3e4838c3181e.source: One of the easier ways to deal with the initial fight is to lure the Afflicted from Feed the Hungry over to the Jade Brotherhood while still neutral, allowing them to kill them.
ea4ff1badccd5edf78af1a0ed5ca3e4838c3181e.text: 處理最初的戰鬥的一種更簡單的方法是在中立的情況下將受折磨者從餵食飢餓者引誘到翡翠兄弟會，讓他們殺死他們。

0e72d10588b88870126b8dc51d276c37abcf7571.source: Another way to deal with this fight is to flag your party by the entrance away from the Jade Brotherhood. Talk to to Aiko and when the Jade brotherhood turns hostile run to your party. The guards and the Jade Brotherhood start fighting first and you can finish them off.
0e72d10588b88870126b8dc51d276c37abcf7571.text: 處理這場戰鬥的另一種方法是在遠離 翡翠兄弟會 的入口處標記你的隊伍。與 Aiko 交談，當 Jade 兄弟會變得敵對時，就跑到你的隊伍中。守衛和 翡翠兄弟會 首先開始戰鬥，你可以消滅他們。

5f9323dcfce8ab0e348c4a99bf9552b416be4d95.source: Note: The quest reward must be claimed before leaving the area.
5f9323dcfce8ab0e348c4a99bf9552b416be4d95.text: 注意：任務獎勵必須在離開區域前領取。

1dae940bd4b2a447e7b1b866f5763e7626c76b38.source: Find the shipment of ink somewhere on the Plains of Jarin.
1dae940bd4b2a447e7b1b866f5763e7626c76b38.text: 在 賈林平原 上的某處找到墨水貨物。

fefb551579ed2fe05984ac4e403c0b1129f19669.source: Bring the box of ink back to Kailona and collect your reward.
fefb551579ed2fe05984ac4e403c0b1129f19669.text: 將墨水盒帶回凱洛納並領取獎勵。

894fec189f9b6c38a87aadd91c72d646b9d3e917.source: Travel to the Sunspear Great Hall and walk out to the Plains of Jarin. Head west and then north, hugging the side of the building. Once you've cleared the building, head north towards the shoreline. You'll find the shipment of ink waiting for you there. Grab it, and then return to Kamadan to see Kailona.
894fec189f9b6c38a87aadd91c72d646b9d3e917.text: 前往 日戟大會堂，然後步行至 賈林平原。向西然後向北，緊貼建築物的一側。清理完建築物後，向北前往海岸線。您會發現那批墨水正在那裡等著您。抓住它，然後回到卡馬丹去見凱洛納。

a532974f5c6d38311d88ddbe4905cdfdb1ee939e.source: The Rune of Minor Vigor that this quest rewards may only be sold once per account. Once any of your characters have sold it to a rune trader, other characters cannot sell the quest reward rune to a rune trader. However, this seems to reset if you delete the character that sold the rune originally.
a532974f5c6d38311d88ddbe4905cdfdb1ee939e.text: 此任務獎勵的小活力的 符文 每個帳戶只能出售一次。一旦您的任何角色將其出售給符文商人，其他角色就無法將任務獎勵符文出售給符文商人。然而，如果你刪除最初出售符文的角色，這似乎會重置。

30409e9680a65546d7319cf211d51c4c46efb226.source: Kailona incorrectly suggests that using expert or superior salvage kits always destroys the armor to which they are applied; there is a minimum 50% chance to retain the armor (see salvage for details).
30409e9680a65546d7319cf211d51c4c46efb226.text: 凱洛納錯誤地認為，使用專家或高階救援套件總是會破壞它們所應用的裝甲；有最低 50% 機會保留盔甲（詳情請參閱搶救）。

5665230f3ba651ce814a14651841558c2be4d15a.source: Speak to Elder Belin to learn more about Moa'vu'Kaal.
5665230f3ba651ce814a14651841558c2be4d15a.text: 與貝林長老交談，以瞭解有關莫阿武卡爾的更多資訊。

1bbfbff1d441aadc60691653deb147bef5b0da18.source: Find and stop the skale performing the summoning ritual.
1bbfbff1d441aadc60691653deb147bef5b0da18.text: 找到並阻止斯凱爾進行召喚儀式。

3f6ddd325b3b33b5ac2dd3d05e515e98019c178e.source: Warn Elder Jurdu in Beknur Harbor about the skale activity near his village.
3f6ddd325b3b33b5ac2dd3d05e515e98019c178e.text: 警告貝克努爾港的朱杜長老他的村莊附近有斯卡萊活動。
