be2a0b7d0f6e91d1bf076c14280cc1022f26c206.source: After talking to Elder Belin in Zehlon Reach, travel to Beknur Harbor. Head out the east gate into the Issnur Isles and follow the quest marker. You will find Moa'vu'Kaal a short distance away surrounded by a group of 7 Skale Lashers. Moa'vu'Kaal will already be present by the time you get there (you cannot prevent him from being summoned), so you only need to defeat him to complete the quest. Map back to Beknur Harbor and speak to Elder Jurdu to receive the reward.
be2a0b7d0f6e91d1bf076c14280cc1022f26c206.text: 與澤隆河段的貝林長老交談後，前往貝克努爾港。走出東門進入 伊斯諾島，然後依照任務標記前進。您會在不遠處發現 Moa'vu'Kaal，周圍有一群 7 鱗怪 鞭打者。當你到達那裡時，莫阿烏卡爾已經出現了（你無法阻止他被召喚），所以你只需要擊敗他即可完成任務。返回貝克努爾港口並與長老朱爾杜交談以獲得獎勵。

8ad31d35dd72eb9e62f9116a273f78c972d25541.source: The Decline text might be a reference to the Nightfall campaign, as this is exactly what you do.
8ad31d35dd72eb9e62f9116a273f78c972d25541.text: 拒絕文本可能是對 黑暗逆襲 活動的引用，因為這正是您所做的。

252f21a525936c06dc58f0af3d3b6d2dd45a6275.source: Kill Mobrin, Lord of the Marsh in Sparkfly Swamp.
252f21a525936c06dc58f0af3d3b6d2dd45a6275.text: 在 火星蠅沼澤 中殺死 碎之主 魔兵。

d8743e5846c0fbde42341dd5a28c7e618816ae63.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死莫布林。

d1163a21a0ee5e4a14a6fe262f35fc2c14dee224.source: Head east from Gadd's Encampment. He patrols in a small area just to the north west of Bloodstone Caves. He is often accompanied by a patrol of raptors. Earthbind, Weakness, "Can't Touch This!" and/or Pain Inverter are particularly effective.
d1163a21a0ee5e4a14a6fe262f35fc2c14dee224.text: 從 蓋德營區 向東行駛。他在 血石洞 西北方的一小片區域巡邏。他經常伴隨著猛禽巡邏隊。 地縛，虛弱，「不能碰這個！」和/或 苦痛 變頻器特別有效。

0d28a8e144a37618c65ac9e3ab198df2b05b3e77.source: Take Dunkoro through the Moddok Crevice into Vabbi.
0d28a8e144a37618c65ac9e3ab198df2b05b3e77.text: 帶著 Dunkoro 穿過 摩多克裂縫 進入 瓦貝。

4a030e8ff9c4919aedc53c4b23fa077ad5aa2f1e.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission by following Dunkoro's suggestions.
4a030e8ff9c4919aedc53c4b23fa077ad5aa2f1e.text: *獎勵* 依照 Dunkoro 的建議完成任務。

74b057aa1b081fc9642aa41c145e1671c41d4ebe.source: As per the Moddok Crevice mission.
74b057aa1b081fc9642aa41c145e1671c41d4ebe.text: 根據 摩多克裂縫 任務。

ef7ac4946494a4d5213a29761449151ea3f85f49.source: Kill Mohby Windbeak in the Gyala Hatchery.
ef7ac4946494a4d5213a29761449151ea3f85f49.text: 在 蓋拉孵化所 中殺死 莫比 風喙。

3bff1a38bcae928c6bf4c7b375cedd0e77a39987.source: *BONUS* Kill Mohby Windbeak in Hard Mode.
3bff1a38bcae928c6bf4c7b375cedd0e77a39987.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 莫比 風喙。

938895b47b0725e38048af3dcf7149c37d8ea9b2.source: Complete the Base Objective for 20 Copper Zaishen Coins.
938895b47b0725e38048af3dcf7149c37d8ea9b2.text: 完成 20 銅 Zaishen 硬幣的基礎 任務目標。

13d3b1c4836665a159cd4c8b82a23307417fdaf7.source: Enter from Leviathan Pits. Go towards the gate where the Outcasts and Luxons are fighting. You can try to slip by them while they fight, but in hard mode the Outcasts kill the Luxons quite quickly. After you pass the gate, take the left side of the fork and hug the hillside going northwest. Then go towards the massive jade wave - there are many north-south groups with overlapping patrol paths along the way that can be avoided, or farmed for reputation (approximately 60 enemies, including 4 bosses). Be aware of over-aggroing as new patrols arrive. From there you will be able to scout out the boss patrolling along the jade. Try to pull foes away first as they may get aggroed while you fight the boss.
13d3b1c4836665a159cd4c8b82a23307417fdaf7.text: 從 利拜亞森礦場 輸入。前往流亡者和盧克森人正在戰鬥的大門。你可以在他們戰鬥時嘗試從他們身邊溜走，但在困難模式下，流亡者會很快殺死盧克森人。過了大門後，從岔路口左側走，緊靠山坡往西北走。然後走向巨大的玉波——沿途有很多巡邏路徑重疊的南北群體可以避開，或者刷聲望（大約是60敵人，包括4 Boss）。當新的巡邏隊到達時，要注意過度侵略。從那裡你將能夠偵察沿著玉石巡邏的 Boss。試著先將敵人拉開，因為在你與老闆戰鬥時他們可能會受到攻擊。

a30e3808019801398cdf83b491d4212d4f0eaff7.source: Kill Molotov Rocktail in the Dalada Uplands.
a30e3808019801398cdf83b491d4212d4f0eaff7.text: 在 達拉達山地 中殺死 石尾 摩洛托夫。

ecfbd61e4a967a6c747e46ad6ddc7fb94ed75c74.source: *BONUS* Kill Molotov Rocktail in Hard Mode.
ecfbd61e4a967a6c747e46ad6ddc7fb94ed75c74.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 石尾 摩洛托夫。

d60ce754b66c9bb71495225db8de70b998106622.source: As you approach his location, spread out the party, using flags for heroes and henchmen; Rocktail's siege attack can easily wipe an entire party. That same spike also makes the boss vulnerable to damage reflection skills, especially Pain Inverter.
d60ce754b66c9bb71495225db8de70b998106622.text: 當你接近他的位置時，分散隊伍，使用英雄和追隨者的旗幟；石尾的攻城攻擊可以輕鬆消滅整個隊伍。同樣的尖峰也讓 Boss 容易受到傷害反射技能的影響，尤其是 苦痛 逆變器。

08153d8a9082b4ad5a49d17ba8e2caf33a0e0691.source: A group of Charr appears near the devourer's location; you can pull Rocktail away or just wait for the patrol to move away.
08153d8a9082b4ad5a49d17ba8e2caf33a0e0691.text: 一群 夏爾 出現在吞噬者所在位置附近；你可以把Rocktail拉開或只是等待巡邏隊離開。

de656f7d770ca976e8f858e999eacbe996254974.source: You can use the nearby Siege Devourer to tank against both the Charr party and Rocktail.
de656f7d770ca976e8f858e999eacbe996254974.text: 您可以使用附近的 Siege 蠍 來對抗 夏爾 隊伍和 Rocktail。

136051e04009e1018b18fb1036c33264734198bc.source: Speak to Chaplain Phyratyss in the Gate of Anguish.
136051e04009e1018b18fb1036c33264734198bc.text: 與 苦惱 門口的牧師菲拉蒂斯交談。

c51d2a068f9514056a8c61e150fcf834db1cfc73.source: Simply go to Chaplain Phyratyss and get your reward.
c51d2a068f9514056a8c61e150fcf834db1cfc73.text: 只需前往牧師菲拉蒂斯並獲得獎勵即可。

2caa1ddee7c1ce61f4ccad4f6200973509df5523.source: Mutually exclusive with Loyal 'til the End.

b17b222d00bc14061e8e92d64a75ffa1e6d7c36b.source: Watch the deal go down and make sure it goes smoothly.
b17b222d00bc14061e8e92d64a75ffa1e6d7c36b.text: 觀察交易的進展並確保其順利進行。

f470e3b3d4b2a2135e7fad33e7d24a606d1d50de.source: Kill the treacherous Sakku and his cronies!
f470e3b3d4b2a2135e7fad33e7d24a606d1d50de.text: 殺死姦詐的薩庫和他的親信！

8f836dc7c672ccb75ae4e1068a340a81b2962328.text: 前往 Dzaga 領取獎勵。

c57871ce25fa56648d838f77b25eaf443efcfd58.source: After you accept the quest, Dzaga and his band leave for the little island to the south. There are some patrols in the way, it may be beneficial for you to clear them before accepting the quest. Once you arrive to the rendezvous, Sakku will come, start the dialogue and after that he summons a few adds and turns hostile. Kill him and make sure Dzaga stays alive.
c57871ce25fa56648d838f77b25eaf443efcfd58.text: 接受任務後，札加和他的團隊出發前往南部的小島。路上有一些巡邏隊，在接受任務之前清除它們可能對你有好處。一旦你到達集合點，薩庫就會過來，開始對話，之後他會召喚一些小怪並變得敵對。殺了他並確保札加活著。

4e95d93fe35765a08cd1dae6928f036e14f94bde.source: See Headmaster Amara for your reward.
4e95d93fe35765a08cd1dae6928f036e14f94bde.text: 去找阿瑪拉校長領獎勵。

be010eb1e79f7fcc7414a15420a37640d97d79cf.source: If you are a Monk focused on support, Skill Chaining is a rather difficult part (depending on your secondary class). Support Monks tends to struggle with dealing enough damage, and chaining alone does not complete the quest. It is advised to alter your build to something more offensive. Temporarily investing points in Smiting Prayers is a good choice. Use interruption and knock-down skills such as Leech Signet (Mesmer) and Bane Signet, as it buys you some time to deal more damage. Otherwise, focus on your secondary class as much as possible.
be010eb1e79f7fcc7414a15420a37640d97d79cf.text: 如果您是專注於支援的 僧侶，技能 連結是一個相當困難的部分（取決於您的次要課程）。支援武僧往往難以造成足夠的傷害，而僅靠連結並不能完成任務。建議將您的建置更改為更具攻擊性的內容。暫時將積分投資於懲戒祈禱是一個不錯的選擇。使用中斷和擊倒技能，例如 搾取紋章 (幻術師) 和 天懲紋章，因為它可以為您贏得一些時間來造成更多傷害。否則，請盡可能專注於中學課程。

10658dad6104e0afd4816957489d218bd3c18e21.source: Search the beach near Mount Qinkai for Eurus' blessed cowbell.
10658dad6104e0afd4816957489d218bd3c18e21.text: 在 今凱山 附近的海灘搜尋 Eurus 的祝福牛鈴。

e6d3abe2bbd12d13d8ed0996f0d55fab42340d0e.source: Return the blessed cowbell to Eurus.
e6d3abe2bbd12d13d8ed0996f0d55fab42340d0e.text: 影返 給尤魯斯祝福的牛鈴。

0f2eac6e17ca09fd98124cbe04d14dbc570b7781.source: Simply exit Breaker Hollow to the west. The cowbell will be in the most remote Blue Oysters just outside. Generally you won't even need to fight.
0f2eac6e17ca09fd98124cbe04d14dbc570b7781.text: 只需從 斷崖谷 向西退出即可。牛鈴將位於外面最偏遠的藍牡蠣中。一般來說，你甚至不需要戰鬥。

1b55914a66ec6c2d7cab1b0a9ddde0d3dd8c0474.source: The quest star and the actual location of the Blue Oysters do not always line up.
1b55914a66ec6c2d7cab1b0a9ddde0d3dd8c0474.text: 任務星和藍牡蠣的實際位置並不總是一致。

414aada3f011725098955ecccc8b5b60052c8a73.source: Clear the Morostav Trail in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
414aada3f011725098955ecccc8b5b60052c8a73.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的科凡德森林中的摩洛神秘通道。

4ca7f4774c68a1a946cc074347cf43116f1a1427.source: "Clear the Morostav Trail in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."
4ca7f4774c68a1a946cc074347cf43116f1a1427.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的科凡德森林中的摩洛神秘通道。”

32ccbf48eb4be2d49bc63165ab33dff2594f2cc6.source: The primary quest Into the Whirlpool will lead through here on the way to the next mission outpost.
32ccbf48eb4be2d49bc63165ab33dff2594f2cc6.text: 主線任務「進入漩渦」將穿過這裡前往下一個任務前哨站。

3d62b1553168af973d94eeb70163601136585c07.source: This explorable area lies between Durheim Archives, Vasburg Armory, and Unwaking Waters (Kurzick).
3d62b1553168af973d94eeb70163601136585c07.text: 此可探索區域位於 杜漢姆卷藏室、維思柏兵營 和 Unwaking Waters (庫茲柯) 之間。

e526cf92ce43e807163aef0bbbd39a8448e99c96.source: Mhenlo will spawn as an ally if a character in the party has Into the Whirlpool active; he will provide additional healing for the party.
e526cf92ce43e807163aef0bbbd39a8448e99c96.text: 如果隊伍中的角色已進入漩渦活動，涵洛 將作為盟友生成；他將為隊伍提供額外的治療。

5a5f00c4cfe7868f1b40dbd606a3f209c8683562.source: The boss Arbor Earthcall appears alone in the middle of the central lake, but on approach (he has a slightly larger aggro), 6 Warden of Seasons will popup around him.
5a5f00c4cfe7868f1b40dbd606a3f209c8683562.text: Boss 大地之喚 亞伯 獨自出現在中央湖中央，但在接近時（他的仇恨稍大），6 季節守望者會在他周圍彈出。

bcda44275a1ce903f3a930d2973eead38d270489.source: There are at least 5 spots around the lake with hidden Warden spawns (3 or 4).
bcda44275a1ce903f3a930d2973eead38d270489.text: 湖周圍至少有 5 點，其中有隱藏的守望者生成點（3 或 4）。

0d89211ff2e2988d441aa3adc3f73e82095ce9f7.source: Along narrow paths be wary of hidden Warden and Blood Drinker spawns.
0d89211ff2e2988d441aa3adc3f73e82095ce9f7.text: 沿著狹窄的路徑，要小心隱藏的守望者和 鮮血飲者 的生成。

f93aab4b3902589db14481120eb2c1b4eb5ad4bc.source: Afflicted are hostile to other enemies on the map - if you let them fight it out, it can reduce enemy numbers by 30.
f93aab4b3902589db14481120eb2c1b4eb5ad4bc.text: 受影響的人對地圖上的其他敵人懷有敵意 - 如果你讓他們戰鬥下去，它可以減少敵人數量 30。

248115a9f097ddb0663fc60235831b0e66694dea.source: This area is frequently speed cleared for Kurzick faction. This is called "Morostav Trail speed clear" (abbreviated as ).
248115a9f097ddb0663fc60235831b0e66694dea.text: 此區域經常為 庫茲柯 陣營值 進行速度清除。這稱為“摩洛神秘通道 速度清除”（縮寫為 ）。

e56a8e2f5caa7ae631a5ad342e79d268752c969f.source: Exploring this area will contribute approximately 2.7% towards Canthan Cartographer title.
e56a8e2f5caa7ae631a5ad342e79d268752c969f.text: 探索該領域將為 Canthan 版圖 標題貢獻約 2.7%。

20b378f71ce2235f2a480520751dab2ec621cecc.source: Occasionally a foe may become stuck on one of the hedges near the spawn of Konrru, Tainted Stone. Attacks by the foe or party members will be obstructed from any direction, preventing damage from any skill that requires a line of sight. This may prevent an unprepared party from vanquishing the area.
20b378f71ce2235f2a480520751dab2ec621cecc.text: 有時，敵人可能會被困在汙染石康魯生成點附近的樹籬上。敵人或隊伍成員從任何方向的攻擊都會被阻擋，防止任何需要視線的技能造成傷害。這可以防止毫無準備的一方征服該地區。

41da926cc9f590a28339085544608179cd58999c.source: Meet Justiciar Naveed at the Magus Stones.
41da926cc9f590a28339085544608179cd58999c.text: 在魔法石與審判官納維德會面。

ac8ff192a209defeadad356f2fb16744058b2e44.text: 與 白斗篷 會合。

1f10fbbd4323025284845fdee3b121f04cf12923.source: Lead the White Mantle to Justiciar Naveed's ambush point.
1f10fbbd4323025284845fdee3b121f04cf12923.text: 帶領 白斗篷 前往法官納維德的伏擊點。

6c0653b91df4724ce3b2587e59beb7d6511c3d1a.source: Exit from Rata Sum to the Magus Stones and head down the hill to the right. You need to take out 2 groups of Wind Riders and another group of Krait (by the covered pool). When you arrive at (Point 1) on the map (by the Resurrection Shrine), you meet Justicar Naveed and are given the rest of the mission. Move through the gap to (Point 2) on the map (again by a Resurrection Shrine), killing the Krait groups found along the way, where you meet up with the group of White Mantle. After a short (but sweet) dialogue, return with the White Mantle to (Point 1), where Justicar Naveed awaits. Kill the (now hostile) White Mantle group and see Justicar Naveed for your reward. Don't forget to activate the Resurrection Shrines, even though the White Mantle will not attack your party until you return to (Point 1) and meet with the Justicar Naveed.
6c0653b91df4724ce3b2587e59beb7d6511c3d1a.text: 從 洛達頂點 出口前往 Magus Stones，然後向右下山。你需要幹掉 2 組的檜風者和另一組 環蛇（在有頂棚的水池邊）。當您到達地圖上的（1 點）（復活祭壇 旁）時，您會遇到 Justicar Naveed 並接受剩餘的任務。穿過間隙到達地圖上的（點2）（再次經過復活祭壇），殺死沿途發現的環蛇隊伍，在那裡你會遇到白斗篷隊伍。短暫（但甜蜜）的對話後，帶著 白斗篷 返回（1 點），Justicar Naveed 正在那裡等待。殺死（現在是敵對的）白斗篷 小組並去見正義卡·納維德以獲得獎勵。不要忘記啟動復活神殿，即使 白斗篷 不會攻擊您的隊伍，直到您返回（點 1）並與正義者納維德會面。

3c1e08db767b913c98c049e33421633ee5e11990.source: If the White Mantle Scout gets stuck on an iguana or a locked chest the quest will not update when Justicular Naveed has laid his trap.
3c1e08db767b913c98c049e33421633ee5e11990.text: 如果 白斗篷斥候 卡在鬣蜥或上鎖的箱子上，當正義納維德佈下陷阱時，任務將不會更新。

e0d9d1c0276937b862dce3929dd42499399bd8a4.source: Until leading them back to Naveed, the White Mantle are considered allies and will aid your party; for example, Abbots will heal Necromancer minions.
e0d9d1c0276937b862dce3929dd42499399bd8a4.text: 在帶領他們返回納維德之前，白斗篷 被視為盟友並會幫助你的隊伍；例如，方丈會治療 死靈法師 小兵。

5d60be5ecb1a4876987fada4dd98dd95e50b9c7c.source: Clear Mount Qinkai in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode.
5d60be5ecb1a4876987fada4dd98dd95e50b9c7c.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 碧玉海 中的 今凱山。

39861697e1271c24f02a28e6c576b9e0fc8a00f2.source: "Clear Mount Qinkai in the Jade Sea of all enemies in hard mode."
39861697e1271c24f02a28e6c576b9e0fc8a00f2.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的碧玉海中的今凱山。”

42a903827273d137fb07e0f6c1a3661a10ec5ec3.source: The primary quest of Fort Aspenwood will lead characters through this area on their way to Aspenwood Gate (Luxon).
42a903827273d137fb07e0f6c1a3661a10ec5ec3.text: 楊木要塞 的主要任務將引導角色穿過該區域前往阿斯彭伍德之門 (勒克森)。

f057feb6db2298e919b6c1f5b0bb9918577cd2b4.source: This area lies to the south of Boreas Seabed and west of Cavalon.
f057feb6db2298e919b6c1f5b0bb9918577cd2b4.text: 該區域位於北風之神海底以南、卡瓦隆 以西。

1db5ee4c2e6ef24383c2ef08c27febaea43c67e6.source: This area allows earlier access to Fort Aspenwood than the Kurzick side as Aspenwood Gate (Luxon) is in this area, which lies before Cavalon. The Kurzick side requires the completion of the Sunjiang District mission to first gain access to House zu Heltzer before being able to reach Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick).
1db5ee4c2e6ef24383c2ef08c27febaea43c67e6.text: 此區域允許比 庫茲柯 側更早存取 楊木要塞，因為 Aspenwood Gate (勒克森) 位於該區域，位於 卡瓦隆 之前。 庫茲柯 方需要完成 孫江行政區 任務才能先存取 鳳荷議院，然後才能到達阿斯本伍德門 (庫茲柯)。

7d4e27131f492c157a3f442762706b90075a8993.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield about 2.1% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
7d4e27131f492c157a3f442762706b90075a8993.text: 對該領域的完整探索將為 Canthan 版圖 主打歌帶來 2.1%。

bceb4a5b6f8c4d9a7e749943892a2ca11e0f6f32.source: There are 4 hidden Oni groups (each consisting of 3 or 4 of them):
bceb4a5b6f8c4d9a7e749943892a2ca11e0f6f32.text: 有 4 隱藏 Oni 群組（每組由 3 或 4 組成）：

b5bc310a928a28fa4e1371008252bafe57e112d5.source: Northwest from Aspenwood Gate (Luxon) exit, on the first cliff overlooking it.
b5bc310a928a28fa4e1371008252bafe57e112d5.text: 從阿斯彭伍德門（勒克森）西北出口，在第一個懸崖上俯瞰它。

5899564d6d05f21b42d4eef854482f8779dd6623.source: Middle point of the east-west path along the southern edge at its apex.
5899564d6d05f21b42d4eef854482f8779dd6623.text: 沿著其頂點的南部邊緣的東西向路徑的中點。

118245e6588e88057dde4f00979f3048e623ba1a.source: In a small clearing just south of the westernmost tip of sandy beach.
118245e6588e88057dde4f00979f3048e623ba1a.text: 在沙灘最西端南邊的一塊小空地上。

a6ffe9bc54786b861cca6f6176ef3155e8a206d5.source: On narrow northeast path leading away from Breaker Hollow.
a6ffe9bc54786b861cca6f6176ef3155e8a206d5.text: 位於遠離 斷崖谷 的狹窄東北小路上。

de7b85e44fcc53eb16009c78103aac88d3bdde6e.source: This area is frequently speed cleared for Luxon faction. See Guide to MQSC for further details.
de7b85e44fcc53eb16009c78103aac88d3bdde6e.text: 此區域經常為 勒克森榮譽值 進行速度清除。有關更多詳細資訊，請參閱 MQSC 指南。

ca88cd55bdbbfc2a8a0a41a774cf0f05e0921e51.source: Clear Mourning Veil Falls in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode.
ca88cd55bdbbfc2a8a0a41a774cf0f05e0921e51.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科凡德森林 中的 哀傷之幕瀑布。

9fd9dc8fce6983fc61ba9d9a104995bb7bd0ecc8.source: "Clear Mourning Veil Falls in the Echovald Forest of all enemies in hard mode."
9fd9dc8fce6983fc61ba9d9a104995bb7bd0ecc8.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的科凡德森林中的哀傷之幕瀑布。”

903e2f4f8a520887ab095693d2ef1975016f1032.source: The fastest way to get here is to exit southwest from Durheim Archives (southeast of Vasburg Armory). This explorable area is completely optional and is bypassed by the main storyline.
903e2f4f8a520887ab095693d2ef1975016f1032.text: 到達這裡最快的方式是從 杜漢姆卷藏室 西南方向（維思柏兵營 東南方）出口。這個可探索的區域完全是可選的，並且被主要故事情節繞過。

e44c8dc4193b3e85297b09b5690b219bea74ff4c.source: If you bring a Moa Egg to the sign in the water that reads Mourning Veil Falls, the egg will harden. This is part of the process required for obtaining a Black Moa Chick miniature.
e44c8dc4193b3e85297b09b5690b219bea74ff4c.text: 如果您將恐鳥蛋帶到水中的標有 哀傷之幕瀑布 的地方，蛋會變硬。這是獲得 黑恐鳥 Chick 微型模型所需流程的一部分。

2459a1e89a131ddcc002609d85e13e63ea8adf25.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.5% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
2459a1e89a131ddcc002609d85e13e63ea8adf25.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Canthan 版圖 主打歌貢獻了約 2.5%。

087cd3bf4e7857751d04b2af70cf1c42ed8b184e.source: Wardens are hostile to other types of enemies. If you let them fight it out, it can reduce enemy numbers by 20+.
087cd3bf4e7857751d04b2af70cf1c42ed8b184e.text: 守望者對其他型別的敵人充滿敵意。如果你讓他們戰鬥，它可以減少敵人數量 20+。

3675ddb1ae2762d43f0409aeeb38f4fd4b86172a.source: Mantis are hostile to Dragon Moss and Undergrowth.
3675ddb1ae2762d43f0409aeeb38f4fd4b86172a.text: 螳螂對龍苔和灌木叢懷有敵意。

b1babd50fe679a994d0645f23684fe4054e8f5c9.source: There are 4 hidden Oni groups (each consisting of only 1 Oni):
b1babd50fe679a994d0645f23684fe4054e8f5c9.text: 有 4 隱藏 Oni 群組（每個群組僅包含 1 Oni）：

aa00124b0ffc757a48837ce963dfe6b00fb180bf.source: A short distance southwest from the Eternal Grove exit, near a Skill Hungry Gaki.
aa00124b0ffc757a48837ce963dfe6b00fb180bf.text: 距離永恆叢林出口西南方不遠，靠近 靈巧的餓鬼。

7bfdcf03843a6144b37c668e3719ac52ec28366b.source: Towards the end of the path heading directly east from the Eternal Grove exit.
7bfdcf03843a6144b37c668e3719ac52ec28366b.text: 從永恆樹林出口向東直行，走向小路的盡頭。

4169541d7d403cae7cc4919d515455b6a7cd37c4.source: Next to the statue of Lyssa, near Chkkr Ironclaw.
4169541d7d403cae7cc4919d515455b6a7cd37c4.text: 麗莎 雕像旁邊，Chkkr Ironclaw 附近。

ba214ecfe9f60a8d3e62833a162f2981fe1e9c67.source: On the western side of Rahse Windcatcher's position.
ba214ecfe9f60a8d3e62833a162f2981fe1e9c67.text: 拉赫斯捕風者陣地的西側。

b642c666012df7385844ba60a60dc2d2ab925106.text: 在 蕨谷 中殺死 魔法盒 牧格里。

951209348e640a61fdfb95316d370130976953a6.source: *BONUS* Kill Mungri Magicbox in Hard Mode.
951209348e640a61fdfb95316d370130976953a6.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 魔法盒 牧格里。

bd3735f587179e8b4da4d6fc1f81dbc7bf1981a6.source: This quest involves meeting the Doctor Jung's Remedies and Potions collector in Wajjun Bazaar which will exchange two Naga Pelts for a Plague Remedy. Naga Pelts are trophy drops found by killing Naga along the coast of Haiju Lagoon, Shing Jea Island.
bd3735f587179e8b4da4d6fc1f81dbc7bf1981a6.text: 該任務涉及在 瓦江市場 中與榮格博士的藥物和藥劑收藏家會面，他將用兩塊 納迦 毛皮換取瘟疫藥物。 納迦 毛皮是在 海幽潟湖、星岬島 海岸殺死 納迦 後發現的戰利品掉落物。

f99f0f5be1dc05bd03c57e0b0f8c5d5f0b5c785e.source: Foreigners to Cantha need to speak with First Mate Xiang at Kaineng Docks, who will ship characters to Seitung Harbor. From there, players enter Jaya Bluffs, a pass by explorable area, to finally arrive to Haiju Lagoon at the East. Nagas are found walking by the beach. Zen Daijun is the closest outpost to renew farming runs.
f99f0f5be1dc05bd03c57e0b0f8c5d5f0b5c785e.text: 前往 Cantha 的外國人需要與 凱寧船塢 的向大副交談，他會將角色運送到 青函港。從那裡，玩家進入 蛇野斷崖，經過可探索區域，最終到達東部的 海幽潟湖。人們發現納迦在海灘上行走。 禎臺郡 是最近的更新農業經營的前哨站。

54c62d933704b8d7519c1c1656a67f54f2a00b5e.source: Once obtained, return to any of those collectors and deliver the quest item to the Emperor's Hand at Raisu Pavilion.
54c62d933704b8d7519c1c1656a67f54f2a00b5e.text: 獲得後，返回到任何一個收集者處，並將任務物品交給位於 萊蘇閣 的皇帝之手。

bef26ee0679c51c2f76af7ec550c5c185c036acf.source: Become Closer to the Stars within the Nahpui Quarter of Kaineng City.
bef26ee0679c51c2f76af7ec550c5c185c036acf.text: 在 凱寧城 的 納普區 中更接近星星。

bf2926d747db73852dd761506f93df44c2d37601.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 25 minutes.
bf2926d747db73852dd761506f93df44c2d37601.text: *獎勵* 在 25 分鐘內完成任務。

605154eaa603227f7be94afe6b443eaf4ebe7696.source: As per the Nahpui Quarter mission.
605154eaa603227f7be94afe6b443eaf4ebe7696.text: 根據 納普區 任務。

df92d07487e1486a71ee5d0acb5049c51533f44a.source: To complete the first bonus objective, you must complete the mission within 40 minutes in Hard Mode or 25 minutes in Normal Mode. It may be that the text should read "complete the mission and attain the Master's Reward" rather than give a fixed time frame.
df92d07487e1486a71ee5d0acb5049c51533f44a.text: 要完成第一個獎勵目標，您必須在困難模式下的 40 分鐘內或普通模式下的 25 分鐘內完成任務。文本可能應該是“完成任務並獲得主人的 任務獎勵”，而不是給出固定的時間範圍。

117067971b0f76bb2da861df6f1e525ea224ad9b.source: Clear Nahpui Quarter in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
117067971b0f76bb2da861df6f1e525ea224ad9b.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 凱寧城 中的 納普區。

a3d821c99d838dda8e29f309e309b46020d62c45.source: "Clear Nahpui Quarter in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode."
a3d821c99d838dda8e29f309e309b46020d62c45.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 凱寧城 中的 納普區。”

5e3841275b54184174fc613f6787ebe1c8a8ad91.source: Exit from Senji's Corner or travel through Shenzun Tunnels.
5e3841275b54184174fc613f6787ebe1c8a8ad91.text: 從 山吉之街 退出或經過 申贊通道。

0ecd5f9f5c702cd7a8f050754e391adccd83a73d.source: Vanquishing: 96–112 foes. Has hidden groups of Jade Brotherhood.
0ecd5f9f5c702cd7a8f050754e391adccd83a73d.text: 擊敗：96–112 敵人。具有隱藏的 翡翠兄弟會 群組。

f7665b88d26825ae05172c15fcb477794276f0ba.source: The western section of the area (the Nahpui Quarter mission area) does not contain any creatures, friendly or hostile.
f7665b88d26825ae05172c15fcb477794276f0ba.text: 該區域的西部部分（納普區 任務區域）不包含任何生物，無論是友善的還是敵對的。

803010320685cca8743a81b58af1408d32031fc9.source: During Architect of Corruption, the number of foes rises to about 394. The western section of the area (the Nahpui Quarter mission area) will contain Am Fah.
803010320685cca8743a81b58af1408d32031fc9.text: 在腐敗建築師期間，敵人的數量上升到大約 394。此區域的西部部分（納普區 任務區域）將包含 安費。

2d1578a8530e3b7ca62ffde1a44a21ba334e8daf.source: Clear Nebo Terrace in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode.
2d1578a8530e3b7ca62ffde1a44a21ba334e8daf.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 尼伯山丘。

8160f3bfe83252da4caf6d3fe99fd9ded103eeb0.source: "Clear Nebo Terrace in Kryta of all enemies in hard mode."
8160f3bfe83252da4caf6d3fe99fd9ded103eeb0.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔 中的 尼伯山丘。”

4d6653892b6ccd9ad0f864630eca52d415b30bb7.source: Head east out of Beetletun or north from Bergen Hot Springs.
4d6653892b6ccd9ad0f864630eca52d415b30bb7.text: 從 甲蟲鎮 向東行駛或從 卑爾根溫泉 向北行駛。

3f2c0848aa9da8a91403c42870ca3b01bb7c1748.source: In the southern area, each undead boss has approximately a 3.3% chance to spawn (there are 6 possible bosses and only about a 20% chance that any of them appear).
3f2c0848aa9da8a91403c42870ca3b01bb7c1748.text: 在南部地區，每個不死 Boss 都有大約 3.3% 的機會產生（有 6 可能的 Boss，並且只有大約 20% 的機會出現其中任何一個）。

b5e6bf9e72764409b29f3a76e8e40e870a811bea.source: There is a popular farm for Decayed Orr Emblems (they can be traded for festive items during Halloween and Wintersday).
b5e6bf9e72764409b29f3a76e8e40e870a811bea.text: 有一個受歡迎的農場，出售腐爛的 歐爾 徽章（在 激戰萬聖節 和冬日期間可以將它們換成節日物品）。

457bea44e264355e047c3fd2aed058dc8a669483.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes 1.17% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
457bea44e264355e047c3fd2aed058dc8a669483.text: 對這一領域的全面探索為 1.17% 貢獻了 Tyrian 版圖 頭銜。

441ce2786f9405f5140564a4491797731a640a5d.source: Vanquishing: 138–226 foes. There are hidden Spined Aloes in the northwestern area.
441ce2786f9405f5140564a4491797731a640a5d.text: 擊敗：138–226 敵人。西北地區藏有刺蘆薈。

9eec6310e0b3a0efb20cba6e68dc69ffb2a18fef.source: There are few exploitable corpses in the southern area, but plenty elsewhere.
9eec6310e0b3a0efb20cba6e68dc69ffb2a18fef.text: 南部地區可利用的屍體很少，但其他地方卻很多。

ca9afd3b84e046bd6b3bdf7cbc731bb478bb1fcc.source: A party of eight can caravan vanquish the area by leaving from the Temple of the Ages.
ca9afd3b84e046bd6b3bdf7cbc731bb478bb1fcc.text: 八人隊伍可以從 世紀神殿 出發征服該地區。

7b2d6d088a6c967cf1fc34cb45712f6f096ddb9c.source: During Mustering a Response, Captain Langmar and Lieutenant Thackeray will join you, but the challenge will be more difficult: there will be closer to 235 foes; the extra 50% will be mostly White Mantle with the tougher War in Kryta builds.
7b2d6d088a6c967cf1fc34cb45712f6f096ddb9c.text: 在科瑞塔戰爭主線任務期間，隊長連瑪和中尉薩克雷禮物將加入你，但挑戰將更加困難：將會有更接近235的敵人；額外的 50% 將主要是 白斗篷 以及更堅固的 科瑞塔戰爭 版本。

dc39230914d16cf9dc6026fd2a4410bdc5d20daf.source: See Headmaster Kuju for your reward.
dc39230914d16cf9dc6026fd2a4410bdc5d20daf.text: 請見九重校長以領取獎勵。

1de7e4c3db98d294c3fb2a175befd744f34c15fc.source: Collect 2 Juvenile Termite Legs and bring them back to Nenah. You have collected x of 2 Juvenile Termite Legs.
1de7e4c3db98d294c3fb2a175befd744f34c15fc.text: 收集 2 幼年白蟻腿並將它們帶回尼納。您已收集 x 條 2 幼年白蟻腿。

ceba2594033fe02c88f9317681c13fca3b04270c.source: Trade your Juvenile Termite Legs to Nenah for a Belt Pouch.
ceba2594033fe02c88f9317681c13fca3b04270c.text: 交易 將您幼年的白蟻腿帶到 Nenah 以進行 腰帶。

e04f099d4db4e8abf9d2295e4b94e61d552e9b57.source: Mungri is located close to the Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick) entrance to Ferndale. Note that the area is swarming with Dredge patrols, so advance carefully and pull each group to avoid over aggroing. He is a powerful healer and often has a Dredge Gardener in his mob. Interrupts, skills that punish healing or enchantments are recommended due to the boss's reliance on Life Bond and other enchantments.
e04f099d4db4e8abf9d2295e4b94e61d552e9b57.text: Mungri 靠近阿斯本伍德門 (庫茲柯) 和 蕨谷 的入口。請注意，該地區擠滿了 挖掘者 巡邏隊，因此請小心前進並拉動每個小組，以避免過度攻擊。他是一位強大的治療者，並且經常在他的暴民中擁有 挖掘者 園丁。由於 Boss 對 生命連結 和其他結界的依賴，建議使用中斷、懲罰治療或結界的技能。

ffb50265b0dc1b468c8955177634fa4e114634e7.source: Kill Murakai, Lady of the Night in the Cathedral of Flames.
ffb50265b0dc1b468c8955177634fa4e114634e7.text: 在 火焰大教堂 中殺死 夜之女 幕蘭凱。

19d78113f97d69c3d7aaabad498a7bd8e0eccf29.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死村凱。

1bff02c80fd5b34d58d7198ed27848e368bc3ea5.source: See the Temple of the Damned walkthrough for information on reaching Murakai, Lady of the Night and for tips on defeating her.
1bff02c80fd5b34d58d7198ed27848e368bc3ea5.text: 請參閱詛咒神殿演練，以瞭解有關到達 夜之女 幕蘭凱 的資訊以及擊敗她的技巧。

bfca70ad8f14b2bcb4a2994435ceadf612a2bc3f.source: Misela, the Middle Child quest not active or completed
bfca70ad8f14b2bcb4a2994435ceadf612a2bc3f.text: 米塞拉，中間孩子任務未啟動或完成

8b557e828d637b36fd880f0c107c27a2f9453823.source: Mutu Wahmeh must survive to recover his inheritance.
8b557e828d637b36fd880f0c107c27a2f9453823.text: 穆圖·瓦梅 (Mutu Wahmeh) 必須生存下來才能收回他的遺產。

d1dc131376799b8c9315f1195df72e94eaef4836.source: Once you make it to the inheritance, Mutu will retrieve it, and you will be transported back to Issnur Isles.
d1dc131376799b8c9315f1195df72e94eaef4836.text: 一旦你成功繼承，Mutu 就會取回它，你將會被傳送回 伊斯諾島。

ee66e20e3a1aef22c2efbceb3936f75a0fcaca3e.source: Kill Myish, Lady of the Lake in Drakkar Lake.
ee66e20e3a1aef22c2efbceb3936f75a0fcaca3e.text: 殺死 卓卡湖 中的湖之女士邁什。

f548cc56387e77ab7a39c15491d622f6c037f8b2.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死邁什。

6984886eef9f2462533a17e52e09d7eefaf34af6.source: As per Myish, Lady of the Lake.
6984886eef9f2462533a17e52e09d7eefaf34af6.text: 根據湖之女士邁什的說法。

c139d9761034302cfa5b0a7e2dd1dd3790b747e9.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Worthy Deeds (Done Dirt Cheap) quest, since it also requires you to kill her as one objective.
c139d9761034302cfa5b0a7e2dd1dd3790b747e9.text: 考慮在完成這項任務的同時完成「值得做的事」（做得很便宜）任務，因為它還要求你把殺死她作為一個目標。

3e973c38eab78ce1954dc6aa31ed3676bca33a41.source: Drop the mysterious message into the hollow log.
3e973c38eab78ce1954dc6aa31ed3676bca33a41.text: 將神秘的訊息放入空心圓木中。

b56b368901e5882bd67b77267a11b44e5a7c5c2a.source: Let Alari Doubleblade know that the message has been delivered.
b56b368901e5882bd67b77267a11b44e5a7c5c2a.text: 讓 雙刀艾拉里 知道訊息已送達。

d506d49ec6cb3aed90deccaddcc958cd8a27ebf7.source: Make the trek into Mamnoon Lagoon from either Druid's Overlook or The Wilds. Once there, you will find groups of Jungle Skale and patrols of 5 Wind Riders circling the lagoon that can be quite challenging for mid-level characters; however, it is possible to avoid the Wind Rider patrols.
d506d49ec6cb3aed90deccaddcc958cd8a27ebf7.text: 從 德魯伊高地 或 荒原 長途跋涉進入 瑪奴潟湖。到達那裡後，您會發現成群的 叢林鱗怪 和 5 風騎巡邏隊在環礁湖周圍巡邏，這對於中級角色來說非常具有挑戰性；但是，可以避免 馭風者 巡邏。

51ad85a44c7b3c62a211c79233a95f2d203603ee.source: Put the message in the log (simply click on the Hollow Log, it's an interactive object) and circle the lake to get to the next zone, Silverwood. From there head west and talk to Alari Doubleblade. Alternatively, if you have been to either Quarrel Falls or Bloodstone Fen, you can map travel and start from there.
51ad85a44c7b3c62a211c79233a95f2d203603ee.text: 將訊息放入日誌中（只需點選空心日誌，它是一個互動式物件）並繞著湖到達下一個區域 銀樹。從那裡向西行駛並與 雙刀艾拉里 交談。或者，如果您去過 怨言瀑布 或 血石沼澤，您可以繪製旅行地圖並從那裡開始。

4b738d749ebe513feacec6c2f2373d1fd1a22e70.source: When you will have noticed Alari, the Wind Riders nearby may start to attack her. Try to reach her quickly and defeat the foes, otherwise she may be killed and you will need to re-enter the zone.
4b738d749ebe513feacec6c2f2373d1fd1a22e70.text: 當你注意到阿拉瑞時，附近的駕馭風者可能會開始攻擊她。嘗試快速接近她並擊敗敵人，否則她可能會被殺死，而你將需要重新進入該區域。

03637c133ab867a45a3e979ab227cf76b51c0899.source: Note: Although Alari appears close to the Bloodstone Fen entrance to Silverwood, the path to her is actually a lot shorter from the Quarrel Falls entrance which you'll pass right by if you use the Bloodstone Fen entrance. Save yourself some time and take the right-hand fork immediately outside Quarrel Falls.
03637c133ab867a45a3e979ab227cf76b51c0899.text: 注意：雖然 Alari 看起來靠近 血石沼澤 和 銀樹 入口，但到她的路徑實際上距離 怨言瀑布 入口要短得多，如果您使用 血石沼澤 入口，您將直接經過該入口。為自己節省一些時間，在 怨言瀑布 外面立即走右手邊的叉子。

b8bda61e937a62c11964f57734658fc712d313cf.source: This quest may confuse players playing through the Prophecies storyline for the first time, because when you get to Druid's Overlook in the storyline, you are chasing the Shining Blade to save the Chosen they've kidnapped.
b8bda61e937a62c11964f57734658fc712d313cf.text: 這個任務可能會讓第一次玩 阿斯卡隆戰記 故事情節的玩家感到困惑，因為當你進入故事情節中的 德魯伊高地 時，你正在追逐 光刃公會 以拯救他們綁架的選民。

580373664feebd4d79658840e150813a7380e651.source: Players should instead take the quest A Brother's Fury from Trader Versai, which will lead them on through the storyline in the correct order.
580373664feebd4d79658840e150813a7380e651.text: 玩家應該從 商人法薩依 接取任務 兄弟的憤怒，這將引導他們按照正確的順序完成故事情節。

c0b8af20ebe1444885f62acf22bd61a64c815d7b.source: Alari further compounds the confusion by giving you The Price of Steel, which sends you to Quarrel Falls and can cause you to skip those missions and break the storyline.
c0b8af20ebe1444885f62acf22bd61a64c815d7b.text: Alari 透過給你 鋼鐵的價值 進一步加劇混亂，這會將你送到 怨言瀑布 並可能導致你跳過這些任務並破壞故事情節。

1e0766d8ef696685c1b4c9c72e628c4512c8deeb.text: 請參閱 Nenah [收藏家] 以取得獎勵。

215feed123dc33d5749ccd8b5673552dc91f6fd0.source: If you don't have any Juvenile Termite Legs sitting in your storage, you can pick some up on the Plains of Jarin while completing other quests. It may be difficult to pick up the termite legs as they don't drop as often as they should, but with a little patience, you can farm them yourself. There is a herd of Juvenile Bladed Termites in a river near the west side of the Plains of Jarin (Near the single dark colored island that appears on your map).
215feed123dc33d5749ccd8b5673552dc91f6fd0.text: 如果您的倉庫中沒有任何幼年白蟻腿，您可以在完成其他任務的同時在 賈林平原 上拾取一些東西。撿起白蟻腿可能很困難，因為它們不會像應有的那樣經常掉落，但只要有一點耐心，您就可以自己養殖牠們。 賈林平原 西側附近的一條河流中（地圖上出現的單一深色島嶼附近）有一群幼年刀鋒白蟻。

7bf89c1a900d59bf594308e72a56f67b212401d1.source: When you have the two Juvenile Termite Legs in your inventory, come back to Kamadan and give them to Nenah. She'll give you the belt pouch through the collector screen. Speak to her again to receive the remainder of the quest rewards.
7bf89c1a900d59bf594308e72a56f67b212401d1.text: 當你的庫存中有兩條幼年白蟻腿時，回到卡馬丹並將它們交給妮娜。她會透過收集螢幕給你腰包。再次與她交談以獲得剩餘的任務獎勵。

d64466c7107fc0eba7f813c87fef251e09178a3c.source: A Friend in Need neither active nor completed
d64466c7107fc0eba7f813c87fef251e09178a3c.text: 一個有需要的朋友既不活躍也不完整

94bfa385cc417ad60bdd7ee2cbe6fa8c4bf3332d.source: Add at least one henchman to you party and speak to Jibehr.
94bfa385cc417ad60bdd7ee2cbe6fa8c4bf3332d.text: 在你的隊伍中新增至少一名追隨者並與吉貝爾交談。

3ce4482e860cd24b20f8da12b6ed8805c20e91df.source: Take the quest, add one or more henchmen to your party, and talk to Jibehr to complete the quest.
3ce4482e860cd24b20f8da12b6ed8805c20e91df.text: 接受任務，在你的隊伍中新增一名或多名追隨者，然後與吉貝爾交談以完成任務。

064315fbdc6f9b3987c82695de02f77ac0e15a85.source: A Friend in Need - which rewards 100 gold - will become unavailable if you do this quest.
064315fbdc6f9b3987c82695de02f77ac0e15a85.text: 如果您執行此任務，需要幫助的朋友 - 獎勵 100 金幣 - 將變得不可用。

39f64d2012db3a7cd4e0330a6d98b5b5f9e1bb8e.text: 與掠奪者塔莫克斯交談。

6811f1976a12fc71d16ff74cba9960a4b873601c.source: Bring Tahwaj Zing the head of Xiriss Stickleback.
6811f1976a12fc71d16ff74cba9960a4b873601c.text: 將塔瓦吉·辛 (Tahwaj Zing) 帶到西里斯刺魚的頭。

67fbc03d311a89e457ed31d2167e9778bc5db35b.source: Exit Jade Flats (Luxon) into the Archipelagos and head north to speak to Reaver Tammox (just outside the portal). Next, head north then east to the big island. Among the Naga groups are two bosses: the first boss, Ssyn Coiled Grasp, is just over the bridge. The second is Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna, who can be bypassed by moving along the southern rim and avoiding the small lake. Xiriss Stickleback is at the top of the hill. After defeating him, pick up the Head of Xiriss Stickleback.
67fbc03d311a89e457ed31d2167e9778bc5db35b.text: 從翡翠公寓 (勒克森) 退出進入 群島，然後向北與掠奪者 Tammox 交談（就在傳送門外面）。接下來，向北然後向東前往大島。 納迦 組有兩個 Boss：第一個 Boss，Ssyn Coiled Grasp，就在橋的那邊。第二個是薇娜的祝福 桑斯，可以沿著南緣移動並避開小湖來繞過他。 Xiriss Stickleback 位於山頂。擊敗他後，拿起西里斯刺魚的頭。

501e52f39e3a95217edf5d0597b23b764c56fb10.source: Map travel to Eredon Terrace and exit into the Maishang Hills, heading southwest toward the shrine. A stationary group of foes and a patrol can be passed without fighting if timed correctly. Tahwaj Zing is in the village to the east of the shrine, up some stairs, at the back of the village. Talking to him will complete the quest.
501e52f39e3a95217edf5d0597b23b764c56fb10.text: 地圖行至 爾雷登平地，然後進入 麥尚山丘，向西南方前往神社。如果時機正確，一群靜止的敵人和一支巡邏隊可以在不發生戰鬥的情況下通過。 Tahwaj Zing 位於神社東邊的村莊裡，爬上一些樓梯，就在村莊的後面。與他交談即可完成任務。

2bbdbb3878a9c95d32e06d58a54a638d97c24f4c.source: Alternatively, skip the conversation with Tammox and head for Xiriss Stickleback directly from Cavalon, retrieve its head, and then go to Tahwaj Zing for the reward.
2bbdbb3878a9c95d32e06d58a54a638d97c24f4c.text: 或者，跳過與 Tammox 的對話，直接從 卡瓦隆 前往 Xiriss Stickleback，取回它的頭，然後前往 Tahwaj Zing 獲取獎勵。

2b5a5157753191d49f3bafe9863732ad924c9d0f.source: This quest can be completed at the same time as the Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna Zaishen quest.
2b5a5157753191d49f3bafe9863732ad924c9d0f.text: 此任務可以與 薇娜的祝福 桑斯 Zaishen 任務同時完成。

5bdf8d586ea061a077cefcdb8f3d7e217c672e82.source: Follow Orozar Highstone to the meeting place.
5bdf8d586ea061a077cefcdb8f3d7e217c672e82.text: 跟著 奧羅薩高石 前往集合地點。

5de193bba9086beaf396b5264fa11d96a169cb26.source: Find Orozar Highstone in Grenth's Footprint, and lead him to Sorrow's Furnace.
5de193bba9086beaf396b5264fa11d96a169cb26.text: 在古蘭斯的足跡中找到奧羅薩高石，並引導他到悲傷熔爐。

e44cddf434fa9aec273c558efbcc509e257b9cd8.source: Once inside Sorrow's Furnace, speak to Highstone again, and he'll tell you he's bribed the guards and wants you to find his brother. Follow him through the cavern. You'll fight one easy mob, and a dialog will start where a Priest of Sorrows (accompanied by some Summit Deep Knights) tells Highstone that they have tricked him, upon which they will run away.
e44cddf434fa9aec273c558efbcc509e257b9cd8.text: 進入 悲傷熔爐 後，再次與 Highstone 交談，他會告訴你他已經賄賂了守衛並希望你找到他的兄弟。跟著他穿過山洞。你將與​​一個簡單的暴民戰鬥，然後會開始一個對話，其中一個 哀傷祭司（由一些頂峰深淵騎士陪同）告訴 Highstone 他們欺騙了他，然後他們就會逃跑。

f1fa0d920669c05d3cd810e149bed83bdaa47ddd.source: He'll remain in one spot, and then you'll face four waves of Stone Summit, including a lot of Summit Deep Knights, Summit Taskmasters, Summit Dark Binders, Summit Surveyors, Summit Wardens, a couple of Priest of Sorrows, and two random bosses (one in the second wave; second in the fourth -- see the entry "Sorrow's Furnace" for a guide to the bosses). There's a brief pause between each wave to pick up loot (there will be a lot of it) and to regenerate.
f1fa0d920669c05d3cd810e149bed83bdaa47ddd.text: 他將留在一個地方，然後你將面對四波 石峰矮人，包括許多峰會深淵騎士、峰會監工、峰會黑暗束縛者、峰會測量員、峰會看守者、幾個 哀傷祭司 和兩個隨機 Boss（第二波中有一個；第四波中有第二個 - 請參閱“悲傷熔爐”條目以獲取有關 Boss 的指南）。每波之間有一個短暫的停頓，以拾取戰利品（會有很多）並重新生成。

dc0ffc44253868155893278a10a60b1345aacc8c.source: Tactically, it's probably easiest to stay with Highstone rather than split your party trying to attack each mob as it approaches (they come from different directions). Flag your heroes/henchmen to the one spot. You lose and get teleported back to the outpost if Highstone dies, but the foes will prioritize your party over Highstone. So long as you aggro them before they reach Highstone, they'll attack you even with Highstone in their aggro range.
dc0ffc44253868155893278a10a60b1345aacc8c.text: 從戰術上來說，留在海斯通身邊可能是最簡單的，而不是在每個怪物接近時分散你的隊伍試圖攻擊它們（它們來自不同的方向）。將你的英雄/追隨者標記到一處。如果海斯通死亡，你會失敗並被傳送回前哨站，但敵人會優先考慮你的隊伍而不是海斯通。只要你在他們到達高石之前仇恨他們，即使高石在他們的仇恨範圍內，他們也會攻擊你。

b01e97cc1801e590dedd7bd2d31206d09f28655c.source: A resurrection shrine is very close by, so even if the party wipes, you should still be able to complete this quest.
b01e97cc1801e590dedd7bd2d31206d09f28655c.text: 復活神殿就在附近，所以即使隊伍被消滅，你應該仍然能夠完成這個任務。

624545af3e2000edd7fa7e2e3c10fe36b03436dc.source: Upon completion, speak to Highstone to be awarded 4000 experience points (which will restore 53% of negative morale up to zero which takes care of most Death Penalty). Gather all drops before speaking to him again for Noble Intentions Plan B.
624545af3e2000edd7fa7e2e3c10fe36b03436dc.text: 完成後，與 Highstone 交談即可獲得 4000 經驗值（這會將 53% 的負面士氣恢復至零，從而解決大部分死刑問題）。收集所有掉落物，然後再次與他交談以執行崇高意圖 B 計劃。

54f776a2363771442931d787b058b767601bc240.source: A minion master will make this quest a lot easier.
54f776a2363771442931d787b058b767601bc240.text: 一個隨從大師將使這個任務變得更容易。

40c98fe9bb0525877782ccef418c1f2b6d47d975.source: The Priest of Sorrows will remain allied even after the waves of enemies begins to spawn and if using a minion master he will often ignore his path and return to heal your minions.
40c98fe9bb0525877782ccef418c1f2b6d47d975.text: 即使在敵人開始出現後，哀傷祭司 仍將保持聯盟狀態，如果使用小兵大師，他通常會忽略他的路徑並返回治療你的小兵。

7d4c2337ebaf232462b7595fcfce5b182ce1a247.source: Also note that unlike many similar normally hostile creatures turned into allies they will be attacked by the other hostile stone summits and likely killed.
7d4c2337ebaf232462b7595fcfce5b182ce1a247.text: 另請注意，與許多類似的通常敵對的生物變成盟友不同，它們會受到其他敵對石峰的攻擊並可能被殺死。

0eff790150c710389f0fd8f2f231f37a7ae89913.source: Bosses appear randomly; there is a chance that the boss from whom you need to capture a skill won't appear at all.
0eff790150c710389f0fd8f2f231f37a7ae89913.text: Boss 隨機出現；你需要取得技能的 Boss 有可能根本不會出現。

45313f42397534d8f62fd985cdd9a37453966053.source: Keep Orozar Highstone alive as he leads you to the exit of Sorrow's Furnace. Bring the shackled Ural Highstone with you.
45313f42397534d8f62fd985cdd9a37453966053.text: 讓 奧羅薩高石 活著，因為他會帶您前往 悲傷熔爐 的出口。帶上枷鎖的烏拉高石。

e84bdb0a0ebfe930c0adf95b3f5b83211a80c91a.source: After the big battle at the end of Noble Intentions, speak to Orozar Highstone again to trigger Plan B. He'll begin to rush off through the caverns. Follow him to keep him alive as you will automatically fail this quest when Orozar dies. You'll face a couple of groups of Stone Summit and find Orozar's brother, Ural Highstone. There will be a cutscene and Highstone will transform his brother into a bundle item.
e84bdb0a0ebfe930c0adf95b3f5b83211a80c91a.text: 在崇高意圖結束的大戰結束後，再次與 奧羅薩高石 對話以觸發 B 計劃。他將開始衝過洞穴。跟隨他以保證他的生命，因為當奧羅扎死後你將自動失敗這個任務。您將面對幾組 石峰矮人，並找到奧羅扎爾的兄弟烏拉爾·海斯通。將會有一個過場動畫，海斯通將把他的兄弟變成一個捆綁物品。

801a0b07f44bebef5b2031d10f5dd89d480c3dd9.source: After the cutscene Orozar will tell you to pick up a master gear to lower the bridge and to pick up his brother and escort both of them out of Sorrow's Furnace. If you're the only player, just pick up his brother for now. He'll rush to a raised bridge. Defend him from the two foes there. If you're the only player, you will have to temporarily drop his brother and go back to grab the gear located by his brother's initial location.
801a0b07f44bebef5b2031d10f5dd89d480c3dd9.text: 過場動畫結束後，Orozar 會告訴你拿起一個主裝備來放下橋，然後去接他的兄弟並護送他們兩個離開 悲傷熔爐。如果你是唯一的玩家，現在就去接他的兄弟吧。他會衝向一座高架橋。保護他免受那裡的兩個敵人的傷害。如果你是唯一的玩家，你將不得不暫時放下他的兄弟，然後回去獲取他兄弟最初位置的裝備。

96aa8cced1cbbbf3fc8dd0cd9c40769a386ecf22.source: Once the bridge is lowered Orozar will continue running ahead and rushing into battle, make sure to keep him safe. Occasionally he will not advance as he attempts to engage the Stone Summit in the path underneath the bridge. Soon more foes will also come from behind you. You will be defending Orozar in a bottleneck situation, but there is a very limited amount of area of effect damage enemies can do. Fight until Orozar does start to advance. If Orozar does not run in range of the Stone Summit on the path underneath the bridge, you can slow down the enemies advancing from behind by leaving spirits, though this is optional.
96aa8cced1cbbbf3fc8dd0cd9c40769a386ecf22.text: 一旦橋降下，奧羅扎爾將繼續向前奔跑並衝入戰鬥，確保他的安全。有時，當他嘗試與橋下路徑中的 石峰矮人 交戰時，他不會前進。很快更多的敵人也會從你身後出現。你將在瓶頸情況下保衛奧羅扎，但敵人可以造成的效果傷害區域非常有限。戰鬥直到奧羅札開始前進。如果 Orozar 不在橋下路徑上的 石峰矮人 範圍內執行，您可以通過留下靈魂來減慢從後面前進的敵人，儘管這是可選的。

705815940446d8a7d8afc2ba731c6f175b5f2f58.source: If you run too much ahead of Orozar he may switch to walking instead of running. You can prompt him back to running by approaching him.
705815940446d8a7d8afc2ba731c6f175b5f2f58.text: 如果你跑在奧羅扎前面太多，他可能會改用步行而不是跑步。您可以透過接近他來促使他重新開始跑步。

7ec8e36aa312c8e886e8604e2e7f36faf009cc1c.source: Eventually you'll reach the exit, where Ural will automatically drop and the quest will be complete. Remember to accept your reward from Orozar before exiting Sorrow's Furnace.
7ec8e36aa312c8e886e8604e2e7f36faf009cc1c.text: 最終你會到達出口，烏拉爾會自動掉落在那裡，任務就會完成。記得在退出 悲傷熔爐 之前接受 Orozar 的獎勵。

985959989179dab24186bc94c5949c4b85c25d6a.source: There are two ways to make this quest easier, should your party be unable to handle the Stone Summit numbers or if you prefer not to fight so much. Proceed along the quest as normal until you reach the bridge. Do not lower the bridge, but instead do either:
985959989179dab24186bc94c5949c4b85c25d6a.text: 如果你的隊伍無法處理 石峰矮人 數字或如果你不想打那麼多仗，有兩種方法可以讓這個任務變得更容易。像往常一樣繼續任務，直到到達橋。不要降低橋，而是執行以下任一操作：

4462cbc00e7d573f7cf47898351f9ce1f924d911.source: Backtrack to the starting cave, and head in a northeasterly direction, aiming for the other end of the bridge. You will pass by a resurrection shrine, some heavy machinery, and a big cavern hung with chains. This is aimed at clearing away the stationary mobs before returning all the way to Orozar to lower the bridge. The subsequent run to the entrance will be much easier. An option here is that you bring with you a Master Gear from a gearbox (there is one by the brother and some on the way) and use that to lower the bridge from the other side (saving you the time to run back) - hurry over the bridge to pick up the brother and continue the quest because lowering the bridge will trigger some large patrols that will come the way you used when first entering the brother's cave.
4462cbc00e7d573f7cf47898351f9ce1f924d911.text: 原路返回起始洞穴，向東北方前進，瞄準橋的另一端。你會經過一個復活神殿、一些重型機械和一個掛著鎖鏈的大洞穴。這樣做的目的是在一路返回奧羅扎爾降低橋梁之前清除靜止的怪物。接下來跑到入口處就會容易很多。這裡的一個選擇是，你從變速箱中攜帶一個主齒輪（兄弟有一個，路上有一個），並用它從另一側降低橋（節省你跑回來的時間） - 趕緊過橋去接兄弟並繼續任務，因為降低橋會觸發一些大型巡邏隊，這些巡邏隊會像你第一次進入兄弟的洞穴時使用的方式一樣。

e09d534eee0511ca5c03502f57fb262126eb00a2.source: Exploit the quest trigger for quest completion. Simply carry Ural Highstone all the way back to the entrance until he is automatically dropped. Then run all the way back to Orozar for the reward. Keep in mind that the foes on your path, friendly during Noble Intentions, will now have turned hostile.
e09d534eee0511ca5c03502f57fb262126eb00a2.text: 利用任務觸發器來完成任務。只需將烏拉爾海斯通一路帶回入口，直到他自動掉落。然後一路跑回奧羅扎以獲得獎勵。請記住，你路上的敵人，在崇高意圖期間是友好的，現在將變得充滿敵意。

4b4f23561eeca7697ea1ad5d9cf1afa1940d4475.source: Do not try to clear the way before activating the quest. When you return to the front of Sorrow's Furnace this room is full of stone summit. Additionally, lowering the bridge will spawn foes at Highstone's location and kill him very quickly.
4b4f23561eeca7697ea1ad5d9cf1afa1940d4475.text: 在啟用任務之前不要嘗試清理道路。當你回到 悲傷熔爐 的前面時，這個房間充滿了石頭山頂。此外，降低橋梁會在海斯通的位置產生敵人並很快殺死他。

627e23fd77c695ef90c35680d33a7f46fe0e374c.source: Orozar may get caught in a chest on his way to save his brother. Try to pull some enemies to the spot where he is stuck, and if he engages to fight he will then proceed to his brother. If that is not possible, you are forced to restart the quest by zoning out.
627e23fd77c695ef90c35680d33a7f46fe0e374c.text: 奧羅札在拯救弟弟的途中可能會被箱子卡住。試著將一些敵人拉到他被困的地方，如果他參與戰鬥，他就會前往他的兄弟。如果這是不可能的，你將被迫透過分割槽重新開始任務。

2ba098f16d6471cea95fd3d38172184ae4383f19.source: Help Prince Rurik exit the besieged Nolani Academy and return to Rin.
2ba098f16d6471cea95fd3d38172184ae4383f19.text: 幫助盧瑞克王子退出被圍困的若拉尼學院並回到瑞恩。

cac22894974637a649fe3c27fa1ee0c5c0c31820.source: *BONUS* Return the Tome of the Fallen to its pedestal.
cac22894974637a649fe3c27fa1ee0c5c0c31820.text: *獎勵* 影返 將墮落者之書固定在其基座上。

9505924fa8c8e66fbd6d48783f617250dbe368fa.source: As per the Nolani Academy mission.
9505924fa8c8e66fbd6d48783f617250dbe368fa.text: 根據 若拉尼學院 任務。

27ebd6bfb12b9b0b91ce9f50aa47b9f52394d831.source: Norgu must be present to continue.
27ebd6bfb12b9b0b91ce9f50aa47b9f52394d831.text: Norgu 必須在場才能繼續。

e444444b1f944a74ed4c02031a2cd13337c78ed3.source: Watch "Norgu's Nightfall" while it is performed for Academy consideration.
e444444b1f944a74ed4c02031a2cd13337c78ed3.text: 觀看為學院考慮而表演的“Norgu's 黑暗逆襲”。

331825f79075959b2008c7b2f813e4b603bb505f.source: Find out if "Norgu's Nightfall" gets nominated.
331825f79075959b2008c7b2f813e4b603bb505f.text: 瞭解「Norgu's 黑暗逆襲」是否獲得提名。

3bdd7ed6f03c313934fc766d37542dfbfa6f8a9a.source: Attend the Entertainment Academy awards show.
3bdd7ed6f03c313934fc766d37542dfbfa6f8a9a.text: 參加娛樂學院頒獎典禮。

d1969402f335a8d990227cc297eb1933d4426ea0.source: Receive the "Greatest Play in Vabbi and, Indeed, the Whole World" award.
d1969402f335a8d990227cc297eb1933d4426ea0.text: 獲得「瓦貝 乃至全世界最偉大的表演」獎。

65dfd6dd6aa165c6aa8451aa5db76f0673cabd4a.source: Leaving from The Kodash Bazaar makes the trip shorter. Then just travel a short distance to 'attend the performance'.
65dfd6dd6aa165c6aa8451aa5db76f0673cabd4a.text: 從 庫丹西市集廣場 出發會使行程更短。然後就走一小段路去“看演出”。

e4bc6a3e8cc958ea2268baa0edb47644309f52be.source: When it is done, map to The Kodash Bazaar and speak with Records Keeper Palin for an update. Map to Honur Hill and walk to the Bokka Amphitheatre. Talk to Bahskir for your update to see Prince Bokka the Magnificent for your reward.
e4bc6a3e8cc958ea2268baa0edb47644309f52be.text: 完成後，請對應到 庫丹西市集廣場 並與記錄管理員 Palin 聯絡以取得更新資訊。地圖到 霍奴爾丘陵，然後步行到博卡露天劇場。與巴斯基爾交談以獲取最新訊息，並與偉大的博卡王子見面以獲得獎勵。

cbc20b09eb3112858c889f6b3dd3827ce386ea2d.source: Although the initial dialogue does not indicate Norgu as a requirement for the whole quest, there will be pauses during the performance of the play, where his comments would be, and the objectives will state that Norgu must be present to continue.
cbc20b09eb3112858c889f6b3dd3827ce386ea2d.text: 儘管最初的對話並未表明諾爾古是整個任務的必要條件，但在戲劇表演期間會有暫停，他會發表評論，並且目標將表明諾爾古必須在場才能繼續。

5a8f3169c81acd62140ed1cae077ee523ecbd260.source: If you are near the "play" without Norgu in your party, the remaining dialogue will continue, including the acted "Norgu". Only the actual Norgu's dialogue will be missing.
5a8f3169c81acd62140ed1cae077ee523ecbd260.text: 如果您接近「表演」時，隊伍中沒有 Norgu，則剩餘的對話將繼續，包括扮演的「Norgu」。只有諾爾古的真實對話將會丟失。

7a4ad60615b0614e8d80512dd0990a604ab72601.source: However you do need to have Norgu in your party at the "Receive the "Greatest Play in Vabbi, and Indeed, the Whole World" award." part of the quest, because if that condition is not fulfilled, you will not be able to talk to Bashkir to receive the award. Parties should ensure that Norgu is at least present before entering Resplendent Makuun to attend the awards ceremony.
7a4ad60615b0614e8d80512dd0990a604ab72601.text: 不過，您確實需要 Norgu 參加您的派對，參加“獲得“瓦貝 乃至整個世界最偉大的表演”獎。”這是任務的一部分，因為如果不滿足該條件，您將無法與巴什基爾對話以獲得獎勵。各方應確保 Norgu 在進入 Resplendent Makuun 參加頒獎典禮之前至少在場。

aba3c7e008111cb58cfec5f85c46d4e12c86458d.source: When "Abaddon" is "killed" he leaves a corpse that can be exploited.
aba3c7e008111cb58cfec5f85c46d4e12c86458d.text: 當「亞霸頓」被「殺死」時，他留下了一具可以被利用的屍體。

2f50f576cbb201377d8df240957703ad841a17ec.source: If anyone on the team has the first stage of this quest active Butoh the Bold will not spawn near the Font of Lyss for the primary quest, Attack at the Kodash, to continue.
2f50f576cbb201377d8df240957703ad841a17ec.text: 如果團隊中的任何人在該任務的第一階段處於活躍狀態，那麼大膽的布托將不會在主要任務攻擊科達什的萊斯噴泉附近產卵，以繼續進行。

ee1628d78ed1d7bf579de492821a9d5e17e77a37.source: Slay the Alpha Tyrannus inside Alcazia Tangle for fine, slow roasted Tyrannus Fillets.
ee1628d78ed1d7bf579de492821a9d5e17e77a37.text: 殺死阿爾卡齊亞坦格內的阿爾法霸王，獲得精美的慢烤霸王魚片。

681e79e3558a7a5a36dd3ad12a17645397fffe1f.source: Hunt down the Elusive Black Moa inside Mourning Veil Falls for Spicy Moa Wings.
681e79e3558a7a5a36dd3ad12a17645397fffe1f.text: 追捕 哀傷之幕瀑布 內難以捉摸的 黑恐鳥 以獲得辣恐鳥翅膀。

85a80efbb7fa40e8131175a010f43e2a16cd37dc.source: Defeat 3 Ripened Mirage Ibogas inside the Garden of Seborhin for the Gourmet Iboga Salad.
85a80efbb7fa40e8131175a010f43e2a16cd37dc.text: 擊敗 希伯欣花園 內的 3 成熟的幻影伊博加，獲得美味伊博加沙拉。

7c2e394e5ff05ea1ac28c85d2a12b4a59fa22166.source: See Lieutenant Thackeray for your reward.
7c2e394e5ff05ea1ac28c85d2a12b4a59fa22166.text: 請參閱 中尉薩克雷禮物 以取得獎勵。

9b770a0179376f4bbf9f47b1ff7e76168c0d3d0c.source: Defeat the targets in any order and return to Thackeray for your reward.
9b770a0179376f4bbf9f47b1ff7e76168c0d3d0c.text: 以任意順序擊敗目標並返回薩克雷領取獎勵。

c0d7e94f3fc2cfc47e54ff86905aca1ca10ca0b7.source: Start from either Rata Sum or Tarnished Haven. Despite its high level, the Alpha Tyrannus (and the surrounding dinosaurs) can be easily defeated using standard anti-melee techniques.
c0d7e94f3fc2cfc47e54ff86905aca1ca10ca0b7.text: 從 洛達頂點 或 灰暗避難所 開始。儘管等級很高，但使用標準的反近戰技術可以輕鬆擊敗阿爾法暴龍（以及周圍的恐龍）。

60dfcecaae53bc425895215868483b3355f9696e.text: 難以捉摸的 黑恐鳥

6c5ce7ba4f5b38bd02369363a2cb8265d82c8830.source: Start from Durheim Archives. The Elusive Black Moa will escape the first few times you approach, spawning a group of Wardens each time, though most of the groups are easy to avoid because of their location and the delay before spawning (the Wardens are also highly aggressive to the local Mantid). Continue to follow the quest marker until it turns hostile, at which point another Warden group will appear. This moa can be difficult to kill using only spells because it uses Shadow Form.
6c5ce7ba4f5b38bd02369363a2cb8265d82c8830.text: 從 杜漢姆卷藏室 開始。難以捉摸的 黑恐鳥 會在你前幾次接近時逃脫，每次都會生成一組守望者，儘管大多數群體由於其位置和生成前的延遲而很容易避開（守望者對當地的螳螂也具有高度攻擊性）。繼續跟隨任務標記直到它變得敵對，此時另一個守望者小組將會出現。僅使用法術很難殺死這隻恐鳥，因為它使用 暗影形態。

7e8983a5c72b08346c339f8e0588e482f7dbb542.source: Start from Tihark Orchard. The locations of the Ripened Mirage Ibogas are not indicated by the quest marker, but the map on the right will show you their locations. Their skills are the same as any other Mirage Iboga, but with a slightly higher Illusion Magic attribute. Note that the Garden of Seborhin can only be accessed under certain conditions.
7e8983a5c72b08346c339f8e0588e482f7dbb542.text: 從蒂哈克果園出發。成熟的幻影伊博加斯的位置不會由任務標記指示，但右側的地圖會向您顯示它們的位置。他們的技能與其他 幻象伊波枷 相同，但 幻術魔法 屬性稍高。請注意，希伯欣花園 只能在特定條件下存取。

b2d76584cebe4973ce19d58caf476f3fa9cc672c.source: All three ibogas have to be killed in the same instance; re-zoning will reset the counter back to 3.
b2d76584cebe4973ce19d58caf476f3fa9cc672c.text: 所有三個伊博加人必須在相同情況下被殺死；重新分割槽會將計數器重置回 3。

8d568c14e5bbf08c57351cb307177320c613079a.source: This quest can be completed before or after completing The Wedding.
8d568c14e5bbf08c57351cb307177320c613079a.text: 該任務可以在完成婚禮之前或之後完成。

d4ebf580b190ae1cb35155e000e807ecf95999bc.source: Track down and destroy the troublesome jotun to prove Kahmu's worthiness.
d4ebf580b190ae1cb35155e000e807ecf95999bc.text: 追蹤並摧毀麻煩的巨人，證明 卡慕 的價值。

6e453018f5daf13d0c197ada28d3922ae5be60d4.source: The jotun that you have to defeat is Lann Browsmasher, who can be found in Drakkar Lake. The fastest way to reach him is to head south from Sifhalla. Along the way, Kahmu will point out clues. The clues also appear as Suspicious Markings (holding down the ALT key). If you do not see the Suspicious Markings while heading south, Lann Browsmasher will spawn to the west of the wolf shrine. He seems to spawn in three locations:
6e453018f5daf13d0c197ada28d3922ae5be60d4.text: 你必須擊敗的角頓是 Lann Browsmasher，你可以在 卓卡湖 中找到他。到達他最快的方法是從 襲哈拉 向南行駛。一路上，卡慕 會指出線索。線索也顯示為可疑標記（按住 ALT 鍵）。如果你在向南行駛時沒有看到可疑標記，蘭恩粉碎者將會在狼神殿的西邊生成。他似乎出現在三個位置：

6381bf7d821d7e26c4151c7cde738b7d741126cc.source: Near the Stone Summit encampment, the Jotun boss near Sifhalla.
6381bf7d821d7e26c4151c7cde738b7d741126cc.text: 在石峰矮人營地附近，襲哈拉附近的佐敦老闆。

426636515bc48b3cb9f6cc35efe6e66e098f6ad4.source: West of the wolf shrine or Curse of the Nornbear mission marker in the cave hallway.
426636515bc48b3cb9f6cc35efe6e66e098f6ad4.text: 狼神殿西邊或洞穴走廊的 諾恩熊的詛咒 任務標記。

1b0c703562deeb546a4e9347082177fe52238d9a.source: Along the eastern shore of the lake.

66332c13d4a80798248fa247c38c25c1d0ce7671.source: Lann Browsmasher will become visible. Killing it will complete the quest.
66332c13d4a80798248fa247c38c25c1d0ce7671.text: Lann Browsmasher 將變得可見。殺死它即可完成任務。

425296ee5cee7008af06777ef28023c6fdbfbfc7.source: You must start from Sifhalla. Kahmu's hints will only trigger at the first Suspicious Markings outside of Sifhalla. If you entered Drakkar Lake from the south, you must still go to Sifhalla's entrance and then start the quest from there.
425296ee5cee7008af06777ef28023c6fdbfbfc7.text: 您必須從 襲哈拉 開始。 卡慕 的提示只會在 襲哈拉 以外的第一個可疑標記處觸發。如果您從南邊進入卓卡湖，您仍然必須前往襲哈拉的入口，然後從那裡開始任務。

e3182157540e50373bbb91a3d8070de0b16e5349.source: Clear Norrhart Domains in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
e3182157540e50373bbb91a3d8070de0b16e5349.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人 北部席娃山脈 中的諾拉特域。

e410c5b5e3249c45b3da9c06d31e83479106719a.source: "Clear Norrhart Domains in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
e410c5b5e3249c45b3da9c06d31e83479106719a.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人 北部席娃山脈 中的諾拉特領域。”

ec51375a336a9534ffc0841747bc0721074792dc.source: This is directly accessible from Gunnar's Hold, Bjora Marches, Varajar Fells, Drakkar Lake and Ice Cliff Chasms. This can be initially reached through Ice Cliff Chasm.
ec51375a336a9534ffc0841747bc0721074792dc.text: 可從 甘拿的佔領地、碧拉邊境、維拉戛陣地、卓卡湖 和 冰崖裂口 直接存取。最初可以通過冰崖峽谷到達。

f2a3c7c94e608f930f29cf52b74b5b38a933d605.source: This area cannot be entered until every player in the party has watched the First Vision cinematic.
f2a3c7c94e608f930f29cf52b74b5b38a933d605.text: 直到隊伍中的所有玩家都觀看了第一視覺動畫後才能進入該區域。

5c6c6f2d15150db9f8797795639a13e4a12cb51c.source: As per the Nundu Bay mission.
5c6c6f2d15150db9f8797795639a13e4a12cb51c.text: 根據 納度灣 任務。

1d03798678400e7fd5b314d64c2f232d66a8160e.text: 在阿伯灣與艾爾夫見面。

08357a38398f170a501c4c20856c95976534edcd.source: Guide Erff to a potential settlement location in Arbor Bay.
08357a38398f170a501c4c20856c95976534edcd.text: 引導埃爾夫前往阿伯灣的一個潛在定居點。

4d64f505ccfdbde92f005bed920a9b32a77e7eed.source: Help Erff scout out another potential settlement location.
4d64f505ccfdbde92f005bed920a9b32a77e7eed.text: 幫助埃爾夫尋找另一個潛在的定居點。

cf71fbcedfbb7dc6788d0e080bcfb570fc0c27e5.source: Defend the work krewe from the invading Destroyers.
cf71fbcedfbb7dc6788d0e080bcfb570fc0c27e5.text: 保衛工作克魯免受入侵的毀滅者的侵害。

1c7b8b10c9f64a6ea264598dfd7210f932447b7e.text: 請參閱 布洛夫 以取得獎勵。

cd75353dfad5d5097803c8b5079e32fb335f4c34.source: Follow the map markers as Erff scouts out various locations in Arbor Bay. The local fauna in the first stage are easily dealt with. However, Erff eventually takes you to the top of a ruined building, where you must defend the party against waves of Destroyers and ultimately, the Shock of Destruction (a Destroyer boss). The destroyers only come from one direction so there is no need to worry about defending the north side of the pyramid too.
cd75353dfad5d5097803c8b5079e32fb335f4c34.text: 跟隨地圖示記，埃爾夫偵察阿伯灣的各個地點。第一階段的當地動物群很容易處理。然而，Erff 最終將您帶到一座廢墟建築的頂部，在那裡你必須保衛隊伍免受一波又一波的驅逐艦攻擊，並最終抵禦 毀滅 的 電擊（驅逐艦 Boss）。驅逐艦隻來自一個方向，因此無需擔心保衛金字塔的北側。

09cb170be6212b0b5b107091d6453eac37b31137.source: When the Destroyers approach, position the team just behind the top of the stairs. While the melee attackers will get to you, the rangers will stay on the stairway and attack, but will not be able to hit you. Take out the warriors and any other Destroyer that makes it to the top of the platform and then deal with those below. Pull back from the stairs after each wave to regenerate health and energy.
09cb170be6212b0b5b107091d6453eac37b31137.text: 當毀滅者接近時，將團隊定位在樓梯頂部後方。雖然近戰攻擊者會攻擊你，但遊騎兵會留在樓梯上攻擊，但無法擊中你。消滅到達平臺頂部的戰士和任何其他驅逐艦，然後處理下面的人。每次揮手後，拉出 從樓梯返回，以恢復生命值和能量。

7f71f39b41a5e04cbc3ace02809a4e377337c85a.source: Switch to Stout-Hearted against the destroyers unless your Deldrimor rank is extremely low.
7f71f39b41a5e04cbc3ace02809a4e377337c85a.text: 除非您的 戴爾狄摩 等級極低，否則切換到「堅強的心」來對抗驅逐艦。

d613a16bf7995a0f897dcf35b8fee81f7ba2000a.source: Pain Inverter is useful against the boss and the various destroyers.
d613a16bf7995a0f897dcf35b8fee81f7ba2000a.text: 苦痛 逆變器對於對抗 Boss 和各種驅逐艦非常有用。

4f95ee2b21cc6aeb1391ee676bf859ed65c76dd2.source: Group-wide protection and healing skills are helpful for the final battle, e.g. Union or Shelter.
4f95ee2b21cc6aeb1391ee676bf859ed65c76dd2.text: 全隊的保護和治療技能有助於最終的戰鬥，例如聯合 或 庇護。

6b96a5b448576b9f2c881d02cc7ec1ffc36d474e.source: Ward spells are useful here, since the party is defending a particular spot.
6b96a5b448576b9f2c881d02cc7ec1ffc36d474e.text: 守衛咒語在這裡很有用，因為隊伍正在保衛一個特定的地點。

89bea03ead923d00f99739b87b5290cdb910359e.source: Anti-melee skills help against the Destroyer waves, particularly Clumsiness or Wandering Eye.
89bea03ead923d00f99739b87b5290cdb910359e.text: 反近戰技能有助於對抗毀滅者浪潮，特別是 笨拙 或流浪之眼。

d890c4b49d0741385985f7eb1f8688860927941d.source: If Erff and the artisans are not outside Vlox's Falls then continue to the pyramid where you will find them waiting for you.
d890c4b49d0741385985f7eb1f8688860927941d.text: 如果艾爾夫和工匠不在弗洛克斯瀑布外面，那麼繼續前往金字塔，在那裡你會發現他們在等你。

1f7c446ae3f1b4bc0b517188b822b542f2000c97.source: If your party wipes, a resurrection shrine is close enough to admit another try.
1f7c446ae3f1b4bc0b517188b822b542f2000c97.text: 如果你的隊伍被消滅了，復活神殿就夠近了，可以再試一次。

c572173b8f7ddf2b1a7436e92dd551edab9445d7.source: If you walk to the first island in Arbor Bay without talking to Erff first, the quest will update and say that you have completed the second objective, even though Erff and the Krewe will remain stationary at the entrance to Vlox Falls. Upon reaching the third location, however, you will not be able to complete the quest without having talked to Erff. If you are concerned about the safety of the Krewe, you can have one player stay at the entrance to Vlox Falls, then once the party is in position on the pyramid, the player who stayed behind can talk to Erff to trigger the destroyer spawn, then rejoin the party. Sometimes one of the destroyers will be caught in a rock, requiring nonprojectile damaging spells to kill it.
c572173b8f7ddf2b1a7436e92dd551edab9445d7.text: 如果你在沒有先與 Erff 交談的情況下走到阿伯灣的第一個島嶼，任務將會更新並說你已經完成了第二個目標，儘管 Erff 和 Krewe 將在 Vlox Falls 入口處保持靜止。然而，到達第三個地點後，如果不與埃爾夫交談，你將無法完成任務。如果你擔心克魯的安全，你可以讓一名玩家留在Vlox瀑布的入口處，然後一旦隊伍在金字塔上就位，留下來的玩家可以與Erff交談以觸發驅逐艦產卵，然後重新加入隊伍。有時其中一艘驅逐艦會被岩石卡住，需要非投射傷害法術才能殺死它。

fd7d61b9a7e898e0730b93613a1c749d27a8065b.text: 主要或次要職業：死靈法師

fd5ea38e8eaf886d40635866a6746f6a83daf895.text: 廢墟的死者 已完成

862d1e44d6301f44c14f0f1aae6557daacfdb797.text: 殺死 謾罵者歐伯藍

28824a5e2747b0728dabbbce3cebcab51191a7e5.source: Oberan and four of his minions will advance down the road from the east. Intercept the necromancer, strike him down, and return to Kasha Blackblood to claim your reward.
28824a5e2747b0728dabbbce3cebcab51191a7e5.text: 奧貝蘭和他的四個爪牙將從東邊的道路上前進。攔截死靈法師，將其擊倒，然後返回 黑血卡夏 領取獎勵。

945cda8c4864c8e08d7a7743a7210b4501264df5.source: Clear Old Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
945cda8c4864c8e08d7a7743a7210b4501264df5.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 舊阿斯卡隆。

8de97ea7f923092e6f512523db4ef041b20d8ed0.source: "Clear Old Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
8de97ea7f923092e6f512523db4ef041b20d8ed0.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 舊阿斯卡隆。”

d7fbc62307c7fd05308a7f5617ca17456d3927e7.source: New Prophecies campaign characters will enter this area automatically upon completion of the Ascalon Academy mission. Travel north to find the exit into Ascalon City.
d7fbc62307c7fd05308a7f5617ca17456d3927e7.text: 完成 阿斯卡隆學院 任務後，新的 阿斯卡隆戰記 戰役角色將自動進入該區域。向北行駛找到 阿斯卡隆城 的出口。

f913433c5e0840bc08ebcac3cee1f226b45ad4d4.source: Factions and Nightfall characters will need to travel back from Lion's Arch to Ascalon City. See this map.
f913433c5e0840bc08ebcac3cee1f226b45ad4d4.text: 盟與敵 和 黑暗逆襲 角色需要從 獅子拱門 返回 阿斯卡隆城。看這張地圖。

da7a46d4fdcd2544e0088f1c11428c2ad9e33a47.source: In normal mode, the low level Charr from the Charr Invaders quest do not count as enemies for the Norn Hunting Party blessing.
da7a46d4fdcd2544e0088f1c11428c2ad9e33a47.text: 在正常模式下，夏爾 入侵者任務中的低等級 夏爾 不會被視為 諾恩 狩獵 隊伍 祝福的敵人。

4392931c0e425acaa0aaf40485c1deb9122ad0a5.source: Baglorag Grumblesnort's group is easy to miss as they patrol a long route in the northwestern section.
4392931c0e425acaa0aaf40485c1deb9122ad0a5.text: 巴格洛拉格·格魯布林斯諾特的隊伍在西北地區的一條長路線上巡邏，很容易被忽略。

141490846b5bf3217cd19c676fdbe3ff2dd08a01.source: There are fewer foes during Tracking the Nornbear, but more during Charr Invaders.
141490846b5bf3217cd19c676fdbe3ff2dd08a01.text: 追蹤諾恩熊期間的敵人較少，但 夏爾 入侵者期間的敵人較多。

cd306aa8c1e8bc2574f19e9cbf90346e9e34d5d4.source: There are several frost traps near the Modniir in the northeast.
cd306aa8c1e8bc2574f19e9cbf90346e9e34d5d4.text: 東北部莫尼爾附近有幾個霜凍陷阱。

bcf96d43f950e7c49411d0d20ad1ab1d9dd1cc13.source: The Modniir centaurs are hostile to the Mountain Pinesouls.
bcf96d43f950e7c49411d0d20ad1ab1d9dd1cc13.text: 莫尼爾半人馬對山地鬆魂人懷有敵意。

4d35325f9d060d286c266a97bcaaabd15a6ce6df.source: Near the exit into Drakkar Lake, 6 neutral Jotun giants circle two hostile Jotun warriors dueling with each other; you can safely watch the contest from an overlook.
4d35325f9d060d286c266a97bcaaabd15a6ce6df.text: 在 卓卡湖、6 的出口附近，中立的佐敦巨人包圍著兩個敵對的佐敦戰士，他們正在互相決鬥；您可以安全地從觀景臺觀看比賽。

20df2465b0a1a8ad67cf4ea60df83ba42b1e003f.source: During the competition, the duelers are automatically healed when their health drops below 5%, making them invulnerable. You do not need to engage these other Jotun to complete a vanquish, unless they become hostile.
20df2465b0a1a8ad67cf4ea60df83ba42b1e003f.text: 比賽期間，當決鬥者的生命值低於 5% 時，他們會自動得到治療，使他們變得刀槍不入。你不需要與其他佐頓交戰來完成征服，除非他們變得敵對。

46998488fe685f198419af9a9e153ff2fc7895ec.source: To end their auto-heal, you must interrupt the event by approaching the ring from the west and aggroing the neutrals. You can pull them into two groups, each composed of a dueler with three of his "fans".
46998488fe685f198419af9a9e153ff2fc7895ec.text: 要結束他們的自動治療，你必須從西邊接近環並攻擊中立者來中斷事件。你可以將他們分成兩組，每組由一名決鬥者和他的三名「粉絲」組成。

f902384616e40d6f10af1d88b8992afc7a093a91.source: If you attack the two Jotun with a longbow and pull them out of the ring, they could follow the party without losing their invulnerability. If you approach the ring and the auto-healing Jotun turn hostile, it will be impossible to vanquish the area.
f902384616e40d6f10af1d88b8992afc7a093a91.text: 如果你用長弓攻擊兩個佐頓並將他們拉出環，他們就可以跟隨隊伍而不會失去刀槍不入的狀態。如果你接近環並且自動治療的佐頓變得敵對，那麼就不可能征服該地區。

afebf16caffe8004030acdd3a135b02fdb02a6e0.source: Clear the North Kryta Province of all enemies in hard mode.
afebf16caffe8004030acdd3a135b02fdb02a6e0.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔北部。

22a13f509329d6a66c1da946ea0ccb850234fb2a.source: Prophecies characters who have not completed The Ascalon Settlement can have Mhenlo, Cynn, Devona, and Aidan help vanquish the area. (They will be level 20 but possess no elite skills.)
22a13f509329d6a66c1da946ea0ccb850234fb2a.text: 未完成 阿斯卡隆移民區 的 阿斯卡隆戰記 角色可以讓 涵洛、莘、德佛娜 和 艾登 協助征服區域。 （他們的等級為 20，但不具備精英技能。）

55d507515e8e03c9a2fd3b42092d01fbb93a7618.source: "Clear the North Kryta Province of all enemies in hard mode."
55d507515e8e03c9a2fd3b42092d01fbb93a7618.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 科瑞塔北部。”

b41dfb75f9575e2f6dc41cffc4742d233ca2d0bd.source: Head north from Lion's Arch or D'Alessio Seaboard.
b41dfb75f9575e2f6dc41cffc4742d233ca2d0bd.text: 從 獅子拱門 或 達雷西海濱 向北行駛。

7e2848f3cbad1bb567baa2d51d540f657e1bbf64.text: 擊敗：126–241 敵人。有隱藏的敵人。

114b0e2f3597ca970dcfd33f7cb2f5242a065c4b.source: Elemental damage protection can help against the Fire and Inferno Imps. Remember to spread out before engaging them.
114b0e2f3597ca970dcfd33f7cb2f5242a065c4b.text: 元素傷害 保護有助於抵禦火災和 地獄火 Imps。記得在與他們接觸之前先分散開。

300393bc820189308ad793cc1905c64698da52e6.text: 雕刻的圖文 期間有更多敵人。

e137219fe94b594eb8765baef3076aa9b85987d5.source: Prophecies characters who have not completed the Ascalon Settlement can have Mhenlo, Cynn, Devona, and Aidan help vanquish the area. (They will be level 20 but possess no elite skills.)
e137219fe94b594eb8765baef3076aa9b85987d5.text: 未完成 阿斯卡隆移民區 的 阿斯卡隆戰記 角色可以讓 涵洛、莘、德佛娜 和 艾登 協助征服區域。 （他們的等級為 20，但不具備精英技能。）

edaa5d1038ea925521e77117732f73df4ea1e162.source: Defend North Kryta Province (Hard Mode) in conjunction with War in Kryta spawns may, accounting for the completion of the quest and hidden spawns all over the area, drive the enemy count up to 300.
edaa5d1038ea925521e77117732f73df4ea1e162.text: 防禦 科瑞塔北部（困難模式）與 科瑞塔戰爭 生成結合，考慮到任務的完成和整個區域的隱藏生成，可以將敵人數量增加到 300。

7afe3ee34410dee49485b5f42858c9839a17b998.source: Kill Nulfastu, Earthbound in Drakkar Lake.
7afe3ee34410dee49485b5f42858c9839a17b998.text: 在 卓卡湖 中殺死 地縛 納法斯圖。

2f4eb8eec9508217182cff53632a5cf0fb500671.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 Nulfastu。

82788a51cdcc938b366aa62a238b2e427cb1d83a.text: 請參閱 地縛 納法斯圖。

d94b354808cd9e09f152aa977eb95d6d00874c87.source: The quest Worthy Deeds (Done Dirt Cheap) has this boss as one of its objectives.
d94b354808cd9e09f152aa977eb95d6d00874c87.text: 任務「值得做的事（做得很便宜）」將此老闆作為其目標之一。

d762a6680ccd7dd2b96e874fe4645a66eede888f.source: Take Melonni and defend the village of Ronjok.
d762a6680ccd7dd2b96e874fe4645a66eede888f.text: 帶著 梅隆妮 保衛 羅鳩村 的村莊。

0a06177f0badc6227edd93452d9cc23207d34c9b.source: *BONUS* Defeat two additional Harbingers of Nightfall.
0a06177f0badc6227edd93452d9cc23207d34c9b.text: *獎勵* 擊敗另外兩位 黑暗逆襲 先驅者。

f665f4422a06c2f1204f99c92a91151864785651.source: If a Tyrian (Prophecies) character is present, Sergeant Clark and 2 or 3 Ascalon Guards will offer their help regardless of whether the quest Military Matters is active.
f665f4422a06c2f1204f99c92a91151864785651.text: 如果有 Tyrian (阿斯卡隆戰記) 角色，克拉克中士和 2 或 3 阿斯卡隆 守衛將提供協助，無論任務 軍事危機 是否處於活動狀態。

58ffef5584c1c3c283ee2ab3e6c03c9631c11070.source: There are many hidden Devourers and Crowns of Thorns throughout the entire area.
58ffef5584c1c3c283ee2ab3e6c03c9631c11070.text: 整個區域都有許多隱藏的 蠍 和荊棘王冠。

fd89e951523381e99aaf9c32381bbffb58d9e497.source: Gwen's Broken Flute can be found in the ruins of Ashford.
fd89e951523381e99aaf9c32381bbffb58d9e497.text: 關 的損壞的 長笛 可以在阿什福德的廢墟中找到。

7c1819d4b7f270ccfab8e77a6c38f67970a42405.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.8% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
7c1819d4b7f270ccfab8e77a6c38f67970a42405.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.8% 的貢獻。

37577b80d04a255acc91158ae2260597877d0a41.source: Vanquishing: 200–312 foes. The Eastern portion has numerous Devourer and Crown of Thorns pop-ups.
37577b80d04a255acc91158ae2260597877d0a41.text: 擊敗：200–312 敵人。東部部分有許多 蠍 和 棘刺之冠 彈出視窗。

08fa01742298e063e20d2a3e77f29e2add3a8fbe.source: Most enemies are hostile towards other types of enemies, letting them fight it out can save a couple dozen kills.
08fa01742298e063e20d2a3e77f29e2add3a8fbe.text: 大多數敵人都對其他型別的敵人懷有敵意，讓他們戰鬥可以節省數十人的生命。

ffe44a17801b3963948eb4dfcc16505463400783.source: Speak with Sergeant Bokkun about the heket rumor.
ffe44a17801b3963948eb4dfcc16505463400783.text: 與博昆中士談論赫克謠言。

0214cb4cf15dcd19364bcfd5c0a49e077252b90c.source: Go to Dzagonur Bastion. Walk out to the Mirror of Lyss, and talk to Sergeant Bokkun. Go back in to Dzagonur Bastion, and collect your reward.
0214cb4cf15dcd19364bcfd5c0a49e077252b90c.text: 轉至 薩崗諾稜堡。走到利斯之鏡，與博昆中士交談。返回 薩崗諾稜堡，並領取您的獎勵。

056de6ecfe75fac4792968a1d8aa26adfb889197.source: Travel to Raiyan Cave and kill the bedeviled Naga.
056de6ecfe75fac4792968a1d8aa26adfb889197.text: 前往 Raiyan Cave 並殺死陷入困境的 納迦。

8673c469ad0a0d8d674dacf9d84518e501c210de.source: Upon leaving Shing Jea Monastery, you will find Su standing right in front of you in Sunqua Vale. After talking to her, head north over to Reng Ku near Zhengjo Temple (which you cleared out in your first Necromancer training quest). Once you are done talking with him, you can map travel to Tsumei Village. Enter Panjiang Peninsuala, then over to Raiyan Cave (the cave where your second Necromancer training quest took place).
8673c469ad0a0d8d674dacf9d84518e501c210de.text: 離開星岬寺後，您會發現在桑泉谷中Su就站在您的面前。與她交談後，向北前往 徵臼神殿 附近的 Reng Ku（您在第一個 死靈法師 訓練任務中清除了該區域）。與他交談完畢後，您可以將行程對應到 蘇梅村。進入盤江半島，然後前往雷巖洞（第二個 死靈法師 訓練任務發生的洞穴）。

a695f0e242974d2544f1e71bcdd3fb683b9e952c.source: Upon entering the cave, you will find three groups of Naga. Depending on your level, it may be best to pull some of them away. Once they are dispatched, head farther into the cave and battle the Bedeviled Naga. Once it is killed, map travel back to Shing Jea Monastery and claim your reward from Headmaster Kuju.
a695f0e242974d2544f1e71bcdd3fb683b9e952c.text: 進入洞穴後，您會發現三組納迦。根據您的級別，最好將其中一些拉開。一旦他們被消滅，就繼續深入洞穴並與惡魔 納迦 戰鬥。一旦它被殺死，地圖就會回到 星岬寺 並從 Kuju 校長那裡獲得獎勵。

823a870dbeab2c8ba4c5ebc0370133bfd3890457.source: Cleanse the area of Kournans. [5...0] groups of Kournans remain.
823a870dbeab2c8ba4c5ebc0370133bfd3890457.text: 清潔 Kournans 區域。 [5...0] 一群庫南人仍然存在。

575a88e03b571bcc80a320829e81599861b0fa11.source: In order to get the quest you must approach Engineer Tosi and a ghost will appear which scares Engineer Tosi. He will then run up the stairs and back down the other stairs in a circle two times before giving the quest. Follow the map to the river ghost Yartu and talk to him to receive your task. Then, travel south and dispatch the Kournan groups. Be careful when attacking; there are many Kournans and Corsair as well as Kournan and Corsair bosses, which may overwhelm even the best prepared parties. Kournan and Corsair Mesmers Shatter Enchantments, Rangers use Whirling defense, the bosses deal large amounts of damage and the Scribes deal AoE damage. Make sure to lure carefully. Once you kill all the Kournan groups, return to Yartu for your reward.
575a88e03b571bcc80a320829e81599861b0fa11.text: 為了獲得任務，你必須接近工程師托西，然後會出現一個幽靈，嚇壞了工程師托西。然後他會跑上樓梯並繞圈跑下另一個樓梯兩次，然後再給出任務。按照地圖找到河鬼雅爾圖並與他交談即可接受任務。然後，向南行進並派遣庫爾南部隊。攻擊時要小心；有許多 Kournan 和 海盜 以及 Kournan 和 海盜 老闆，即使是準備最充分的團隊也可能不知所措。 Kournan 和 海盜 幻術師粉碎附魔，遊騎兵使用旋轉防禦，Boss 造成大量傷害，抄寫員造成 範圍性 傷害。一定要小心引誘。一旦你殺死了所有的庫爾南團體，就回到雅爾圖領取獎勵。

1924c7f5c20a98ef89ec25a494c9ab6f815f702f.source: Yartu will not spawn if the quest Weird Waters is active.
1924c7f5c20a98ef89ec25a494c9ab6f815f702f.text: 如果奇怪的水域任務處於活動狀態，雅爾圖將不會產生。

dbf06f952b23336f87f1d6b137ff92472e487810.source: Do not leave the area - you will have to restart the quest if you only partially finished it.
dbf06f952b23336f87f1d6b137ff92472e487810.text: 不要離開該區域 - 如果您只完成了部分任務，則必須重新開始任務。

cd8613214fbbcef1d215f1f9236558e968ffa70d.source: Once you accept the reward and leave, Yartu will not spawn anymore. If you want the items she offers, make sure to bring the Kournan Pendants along.
cd8613214fbbcef1d215f1f9236558e968ffa70d.text: 一旦您接受獎勵並離開，雅爾圖將不再生成。如果您想要她提供的物品，請務必帶上庫南吊墜。

2d854b8ed148255366770ffaf54ab493736e41c2.source: All 5 mobs of Kournans will spawn at the Kodonur Crossroads exit after finding Yartu. If you are attempting to get the Survivor title, don't use this exit while not having finished the quest.
2d854b8ed148255366770ffaf54ab493736e41c2.text: 找到雅圖後，庫南的所有 5 生物都會在 科登諾入口 出口處產生。如果您試圖取得 生存者 標題，請在未完成任務時不要使用此出口。

d12a58b0951894a0d23fd3864d96f34e8da970e8.source: Even if you finished the quest but left the area before receiving your reward, Yartu will not spawn, making it impossible to get the reward.
d12a58b0951894a0d23fd3864d96f34e8da970e8.text: 即使您完成了任務但在收到獎勵之前離開了該區域，雅爾圖也不會生成，從而無法獲得獎勵。

b58c718b165a6f7ce1622cca4de4431386880072.source: Deliver to Captain Gudur on the Plains of Jarin the proposed Sunspear duties needed during the visits of the diplomats from Kourna and Vabbi.
b58c718b165a6f7ce1622cca4de4431386880072.text: 向 賈林平原 上的古杜爾船長交付 高楠 和 瓦貝 外交官訪問期間所需的建議陽矛職責。

2c337b81ae9a20a6828d3ccb56a9b9eb52854b47.source: Inform Elder Belin in the Zehlon Reach of the need for fresh game at the scheduled banquet.
2c337b81ae9a20a6828d3ccb56a9b9eb52854b47.text: 通知澤隆河段的貝林長老在預定的宴會上需要新鮮的野味。

640ff2fe85575cc17697bfb6189ffae12a902855.source: Speak with Stonecutter Ged on the Cliffs of Dohjok about meeting with the representative from the Wilderness of Bahdza.
640ff2fe85575cc17697bfb6189ffae12a902855.text: 與 杜夏懸崖 上的 Stonecutter Ged 討論與 巴薩荒野 代表會面的事宜。

ea9fd9a70ddf8cfca5e8ee8aaed7c90f2964878b.source: See Clerk Arlon for your reward.
ea9fd9a70ddf8cfca5e8ee8aaed7c90f2964878b.text: 請向職員阿隆索取獎勵。

739ba1e76dd2c0c6952cb4f8c36977ff46238757.source: Enter Plains of Jarin via the Sunspear Great Hall and speak with Captain Gudur, who is directly east. To get to Elder Belin, exit Jokanur Diggings into Zehlon Reach and head north to the village. For the next step exit Blacktide Den to Cliffs of Dohjok and speak with Stonecutter Ged. These are all simple talk-to-and-go-on steps with very little fighting required. Finally go back to Clerk Arlon and get your reward.
739ba1e76dd2c0c6952cb4f8c36977ff46238757.text: 通過 日戟大會堂 進入 賈林平原 並與正東方向的古杜爾隊長交談。要前往貝林長老，請離開喬卡努礦區進入澤隆河段，然後向北前往村莊。下一步，退出 Blacktide Den 前往 杜夏懸崖，並與昂船洲蓋德交談。這些都是簡單的交談和繼續步驟，幾乎不需要戰鬥。最後回到書記員阿隆那裡領取獎勵。

ffadb99006256609293f8e3716fbc990a74fb7d4.source: Meet Hedge Wizard Mabai in the Forum Highlands.
ffadb99006256609293f8e3716fbc990a74fb7d4.text: 在 高地廣場 中認識 Hedge Wizard Mabai。

0575d99eb493ea87443d07b531e268997945fdcd.source: Seek the wish grantor using the clues in the ancient parchment.
0575d99eb493ea87443d07b531e268997945fdcd.text: 使用古代羊皮紙上的線索尋找願望實現者。

a14e2e95d06240aa5d368953d093b5c050c43326.source: Find Hedge Wizard Mabai in the Halls of Chokhin.
a14e2e95d06240aa5d368953d093b5c050c43326.text: 在喬金大廳找到樹籬巫師馬拜。

16c1075960b187d533652d28534c74f1aedd852c.source: After starting the quest with Hedge Wizard Mabai in the Garden, map travel to Jennur's Horde and exit through the east portal. Hedge Wizard Mabai is immediately to your right. After talking to him again, map travel to Tihark Orchard and exit through the west portal. Head roughly south (trend west) to a spot just north of the second resurrection shrine (see the map) to find the dusty urn. It is advisable to clear the immediate area of enemies and spread out your party before interacting with the urn, as the spawns will use powerful AoE that can instantly wipe an unprepared party if it is clustered together around the urn. This is because the djinns will spawn on top of your party and immediately subject it to Searing Flames, Fire Storm and Dervish attacks. Additionally, Mabai will body block and impede the party's escape.
16c1075960b187d533652d28534c74f1aedd852c.text: 在花園裡開始與樹籬巫師馬拜的任務後，在地圖上前往詹努爾的部落並通過東邊的傳送門退出。 Hedge Wizard Mabai 就在您的右邊。再次與他交談後，在地圖上前往提哈克果園並從西邊的門戶退出。大致向南（向西）前往第二個復活神殿以北的地點（參見地圖），找到佈滿灰塵的甕。建議在與甕互動之前清除周圍的敵人並分散你的隊伍，因為生成點將使用強大的 範圍性，如果沒有準備的隊伍聚集在甕周圍，它可以立即消滅它。這是因為巨靈會在你的隊伍上方生成，並立即使其受到 爆裂火焰、火焰風暴 和 神喚使 攻擊。此外，馬白還會用身體阻擋並阻止隊伍逃跑。

74aed6e4d940ca781833d46e0e25c78df839ac3f.source: When ready, rub the dusty urn (by selecting it) three times and defeat the Djinn Overseer who appears (along with a Ruby Djinn and 2 Sapphire Djinns). Defeat them and the Overseer turns friendly. Talk to the now friendly Djinn Overseer. Travel to the Halls of Chokhin (inside the Holdings of Chokhin) and talk to Mabai, now Prince Mabai.
74aed6e4d940ca781833d46e0e25c78df839ac3f.text: 準備好後，擦拭佈滿灰塵的甕（透過選擇它）三次並擊敗出現的 巨靈怪 督軍（以及 紅寶石巨靈 和 2 藍寶石巨靈）。擊敗他們，督軍就會變得友善。與現在友好的 巨靈怪 監督者交談。前往 Chokhin 大廳（舟克辛卷藏室 內）並與 Mabai（現在的 Mabai 王子）交談。

4c9103334a7785448fa6bceca7f6b1d030ca9910.source: If you zoom in and look up after turning south you will see a series of jeweled mirrors with rays of light pointing towards another mirror. Follow it to easily complete the quest.
4c9103334a7785448fa6bceca7f6b1d030ca9910.text: 如果您向南轉向後放大並向上看，您會看到一系列鑲有寶石的鏡子，其光線指向另一面鏡子。按照它即可輕鬆完成任務。

3cdbf2b90a88e2efc743efc1e2580f8a8b88dee3.source: It is not required to talk to Hedge Wizard Mabai in Forum Highlands - the quest will update anyway after talking to the Djinn Overseer.
3cdbf2b90a88e2efc743efc1e2580f8a8b88dee3.text: 不需要與 高地廣場 中的樹籬巫師 Mabai 交談 - 在與 巨靈怪 督軍交談後，任務無論如何都會更新。

5fff54835ecda091bf7323c47c40eb03b83a8027.source: The Area Map incorrectly shows the location of the Dungeon Key on the first level. The Dungeon Key is actually dropped by Xien, and you can only kill him at the end of the first level.
5fff54835ecda091bf7323c47c40eb03b83a8027.text: 區域地圖錯誤地顯示了第一層 地監 鑰匙 的位置。 地監 鑰匙其實是Xien掉落的，你只能在第一關結束時殺死他。

2ef1900c438b98118f78678968fb02a8d869fdf0.source: Xien will not spawn without the required quest (Little Workshop of Horrors — obtained from Blimm in Rata Sum), thus preventing access to level 2. You cannot pass beyond the gate near the second Flame Guardian.
2ef1900c438b98118f78678968fb02a8d869fdf0.text: 如果沒有所需的任務（恐怖小工坊 - 從 洛達頂點 中的 布林姆 取得），Xien 不會生成，從而阻止存取 2 關卡。您無法越過第二臺 Flame 守護者 附近的大門。

9dc79647775007044cd78447e67869190e6f0de1.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #13 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
9dc79647775007044cd78447e67869190e6f0de1.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#13 頁。

fb86cd0e236066226fe53055f2a88cdd55485c8d.source: Two bugs can force the party to restart the dungeon: (a) On the first level, the gate leading to the middle area sometimes fails to open. (b) The first floor Dungeon Key sometimes fails to appear after killing Xien. There are no work-arounds for either problem. On the second level, the AI-controlled creatures will attack and kill fire traps. Once they start attacking, you can also cause AoE damage to them.
fb86cd0e236066226fe53055f2a88cdd55485c8d.text: 有兩個錯誤可以迫使隊伍重新開始地下城： (a) 在第一層，通往中間區域的大門有時無法開啟。 (b)殺死Xien後，第一層地監 鑰匙有時無法出現。這兩個問題都沒有解決方法。在第二層，人工智慧控制的生物將攻擊並殺死火焰陷阱。一旦他們開始攻擊，你也可以對他們造成 範圍性 傷害。

6666e2ee9dae5a2306402230074a6e377aa3325a.source: If you enter without the required quest, you cannot pass the door in the southwest just before the second Beacon of Droknar.
6666e2ee9dae5a2306402230074a6e377aa3325a.text: 如果你在沒有完成所需任務的情況下進入，你將無法通過第二個德羅克納爾信標前西南方向的門。

ef426f51a3aea6ee48e47f0eecfbc26633e66cd7.source: Some Ooze may drop Unstable Gelatinous Material bundles.
ef426f51a3aea6ee48e47f0eecfbc26633e66cd7.text: 有些軟泥怪可能會掉落不穩定的凝膠材料包。

45b1853a571db0d4f982017c42c3803d5a627065.source: The area in the northwest of the map that contains two Albino Rats is not accessible.
45b1853a571db0d4f982017c42c3803d5a627065.text: 地圖西北方有兩隻白化老鼠的區域無法進入。

20000333a00aebdce11ce21cf7063fd402da0f69.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #4 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
20000333a00aebdce11ce21cf7063fd402da0f69.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#4 頁。

5eea2b4050318766dc2f7aeef3930bf4cc79774f.source: After accepting the quest from Seer Fiercereign, map to Longeye's Ledge and head for the Ooze Pit in Grothmar Wardowns. Your party can fight its way there or a single character can run there by carefully waiting out the patrols along the way (go east from Longeye's, cross the bridge, and then head south to the dungeon).
5eea2b4050318766dc2f7aeef3930bf4cc79774f.text: 接受 預言者 Fiercereign 的任務後，對應到 長眼巖脈 並前往 Grothmar Wardowns 中的 烏茲地窖。你的隊伍可以一路戰鬥到那裡，或者一個角色可以通過小心地等待沿途的巡邏隊跑到那裡（從長眼向東走，過橋，然後向南到達地牢）。

64fb17e654f208d3ccdce53fc886519cde73f244.source: Nearly every foe in the pit is a jelly, each of which can deal powerful area of effect (AoE) damage.
