Many of the jellies will split into two identical foes using Ooze Division: each new foe has the same build as the parent, but half the health; this makes them easier to kill, but allows mobs to deal twice as much damage. Be careful to keep spread out or use a tank to ball up the oozes away from the party. Beware of the rolling boulders that appear at several locations in the dungeon.
64fb17e654f208d3ccdce53fc886519cde73f244.text: 坑中幾乎每個敵人都是果凍，每個都可以造成強大的效果區域（範圍性）傷害。許多水母會使用軟泥分裂分裂成兩個相同的敵人：每個新敵人的體型與母體相同，但生命值只有一半；這使得它們更容易被殺死，但可以讓怪物造成兩倍的傷害。小心地保持分散或使用坦克將軟泥聚集起來遠離隊伍。小心地牢中多個位置出現的滾動巨石。

8c858dca3971b13cd7a5a11cb268f0e41c5a1e45.source: At the beginning, the route is obvious: go west briefly and then head north until you get to the first pressure plate. (You can leave it closed while tackling the oozes on the other side.) Once through the gate, you need to kill Gloop to get the Boss Key. There are several possible routes to Gloop, some of which require opening a gate via another pressure plate and some which require breaking down Cracked Walls with Unstable Gelatinous Material, a bundle dropped by some of the dungeon's jellies.
8c858dca3971b13cd7a5a11cb268f0e41c5a1e45.text: 一開始，路線很明顯：短暫向西走，然後向北走，直到到達第一個壓力板。 （你可以在處理另一邊的軟泥時將其關閉。）一旦通過大門，你需要殺死 古魯普 以獲得 頭目 鑰匙。通往 古魯普 有多種可能的路線，其中一些需要通過另一個壓力板開啟大門，另一些則需要用不穩定的凝膠材料（由地牢中的一些果凍掉落的包裹）打破破裂的牆壁。

2f5ee76e555a0e77532427694ad7b9bacbd6ed21.source: If you follow the route on the map (which bypasses the second pressure plate and second gate), you will approach Gloop from the north and requires a Unstable Gelatinous Material to break down a Cracked Wall. Pull and destroy the nearby oozes before tackling that boss; several can be pulled one at a time or in pairs but there is one larger group. Gloop can be pulled without engaging the four Oozes behind the boss. If you approach Gloop from the southeast (via the second gate using the second pressure plate), you can pull Gloop without having to deal with any other foes. Afterward, retrace your steps and then head to the Boss Lock to reach the final room in the dungeon.
2f5ee76e555a0e77532427694ad7b9bacbd6ed21.text: 如果你按照地圖上的路線（繞過第二個壓力板和第二個門），你會從北邊接近古魯普，並需要不穩定的凝膠材料來打破裂牆。 拉出 並在對付該 Boss 之前摧毀附近的軟泥怪；可以一次拉一個或成對地拉幾個，但有一個更大的組。可以在不與 Boss 後面的四個軟泥怪交戰的情況下拉動 古魯普。如果您從東南方向接近 古魯普（使用第二個壓力板通過第二個門），您可以拉動 古魯普，而無需處理任何其他敵人。然後，原路返回，前往 頭目 鎖，到達地牢的最後一個房間。

4b455ba0ee1d47651e7468724757d7a35260e544.source: The end-battle requires defeating three Prismatic Oozes, each of which spawns around a dozen new oozes when it dies. In addition, the boss-like foes use Gelatinous Absorption to turn damage into healing.
4b455ba0ee1d47651e7468724757d7a35260e544.text: 最終戰鬥需要擊敗三個稜柱軟泥怪，每個軟泥怪死後都會生成大約十幾個新軟泥怪。此外，像頭目一樣的敵人會使用凝膠吸收將傷害轉化為治療。

0f274f1b601511d749580fa8df0ae75d3a91f22a.source: Pre-cast protections and enchantments before aggroing the group.
0f274f1b601511d749580fa8df0ae75d3a91f22a.text: 在攻擊團隊之前預先施放保護和結界。

b4b08cb60b5d9fdfe7bf6bc21530e464f6ad9943.source: Focus on one ooze at a time; call the target to make this easier players and so that heroes and henchmen react more quickly.
b4b08cb60b5d9fdfe7bf6bc21530e464f6ad9943.text: 聚能器 一次針對一個軟泥；呼叫目標，讓玩家更容易做到這一點，讓英雄和追隨者反應更快。

0e07b3a1d2c1493312da0d9236189777c45503ac.source: Switch targets as soon as you notice an ooze start to heal quickly.
0e07b3a1d2c1493312da0d9236189777c45503ac.text: 一旦發現軟泥開始快速癒合，請立即切換目標。

15739f4a0e1ce9c071b831c31c52ce5faba8e11b.source: After each Prismatic Ooze dies, you have a few seconds to regroup or retreat to prevent getting overwhelmed by the jellies that spawn afterward.
15739f4a0e1ce9c071b831c31c52ce5faba8e11b.text: 每個 多彩烏茲 死亡後，您都有幾秒鐘的時間重新集結或撤退，以防止被隨後生成的水母淹沒。

13ea6efe7ff31b985251b20a93ed2895d84e5d9f.source: Killing the third Prismatic Ooze will cause the Prismatic Chest to spawn, which will drop the Prismatic Gelatinous Material that Seer Fiercereign requested.
13ea6efe7ff31b985251b20a93ed2895d84e5d9f.text: 殺死第三個 多彩烏茲 將導致稜柱形 寶箱 生成，這將掉落 預言者 Fiercereign 請求的稜柱形凝膠材料。

162e191d635e7a231e942ec5aec8c19bebc306c1.source: Avoid skills that inflict or require bleeding, disease or poison, or exploit corpses:
162e191d635e7a231e942ec5aec8c19bebc306c1.text: 避免造成或需要流血、疾病或毒藥或利用屍體的技能：

96f3a214e8a86b635d9d574471c8be3689590cf3.source: The only fleshy creatures in the dungeon are Albino Rats and a very few Stormcloud Incubii (only one popup group will be encountered when following the route on the map provided above).
96f3a214e8a86b635d9d574471c8be3689590cf3.text: 地牢中唯一的肉質生物是白化鼠和極少數暴雲夢魘（沿著上面提供的地圖上的路線前進時只會遇到一個彈出組）。

6e537bdb42bf70269868450f46a4af16b91489b3.source: In addition, Ominous Oozes can steal minions using Verata's Aura and Shimmering Oozes use Spiritual Pain.
6e537bdb42bf70269868450f46a4af16b91489b3.text: 此外，不祥軟泥怪可以使用 芙瑞達的靈氣 竊取小兵，閃光軟泥怪則使用 生靈苦痛。

f0e416d56f21e81aeb17bac729a2ca75e1063361.source: Bring skills that can bypass Gelatinous Absorption, i.e. those that cause health degeneration or health loss instead of damage. Spoil Victor is especially effective here, due to the high health of the boss-like foes.
f0e416d56f21e81aeb17bac729a2ca75e1063361.text: 帶來可以繞過凝膠吸收的技能，即那些導致健康退化或健康損失而不是傷害的技能。 勝者的掠奪 在這裡特別有效，因為像 Boss 這樣的敵人的生命值很高。

671485aacf5fe4e75d5a8491a58ded3c46c71ce1.source: Damage reduction skills help prevent wipes caused by multiple jellies dealing simultaneous AoE damage:
671485aacf5fe4e75d5a8491a58ded3c46c71ce1.text: 傷害 減少技能有助於防止多重果凍同時造成 範圍性 傷害而造成的擦拭：

0f411f8a14833c76bea47c23b9326a45dda58ec3.source: Pain Inverter will often kill a single foe outright.
0f411f8a14833c76bea47c23b9326a45dda58ec3.text: 苦痛 逆變器通常會直接殺死一個敵人。

2f938fb8e04898bbb9ffd9443eab1cbaba5a5084.source: Pre-cast Shelter and/or Union to keep them out of the aggro-range of the oozes.
2f938fb8e04898bbb9ffd9443eab1cbaba5a5084.text: 預製 庇護 和/或 聯合，使它們遠離軟泥怪的仇恨範圍。

e38969d3bdc757d3c0cade9a4ef38b8e9eb28611.source: Armor of Unfeeling helps to prevent spirits from being destroyed quickly by the various AoE damage skills, such as Spiritual Pain.
e38969d3bdc757d3c0cade9a4ef38b8e9eb28611.text: 無情護甲 有助於防止靈魂被各種 範圍性 傷害技巧（例如 生靈苦痛）快速摧毀。

ad2c02eda2429db6dfcde6352c5feef9dd341a01.source: See also: threshold damage reduction skills.
ad2c02eda2429db6dfcde6352c5feef9dd341a01.text: 另請參閱：閾值傷害減少技能。

9e3f1d8d02571f6d961ff115c8b595d026ab3c26.source: Ebon Vanguard Assassin Support can be used to ball up foes and to dispose of Volatile Oozes (those jellies will waste their Unstable Ooze Explosion on the summon).
9e3f1d8d02571f6d961ff115c8b595d026ab3c26.text: 黑檀 暗殺者 支援可用於聚集敵人並處理揮發性軟泥（這些水母會在召喚時浪費不穩定的軟泥爆炸）。

0894c11620f700d294540a02a523c3736ffaa720.source: "Can't Touch This!" can prevent the use of Unstable Ooze Explosion and other touch skills (such as Headbutt used by Aggressive Oozes and Ancient Ooze, and Vile Touch used by Ominous Oozes) on your party members.
0894c11620f700d294540a02a523c3736ffaa720.text: 「這個不能碰！」可以防止對你的隊伍成員使用不穩定軟泥爆炸和其他接觸技能（例如 侵略的 軟泥和古代軟泥使用的 頭鎚，以及不祥軟泥使用的 不幸之觸）。

7a696a1f419f0573cce50813534edc6a0348729d.source: If your party does not bring "Can't Touch This!", consider bringing skills that transfer conditions among foes (i.e. Epidemic, Extend Conditions or Fevered Dreams) to transfer daze from Aggressive Oozes' Headbutt to the ooze spellcasters in its proximity.
7a696a1f419f0573cce50813534edc6a0348729d.text: 如果你的隊伍沒有攜帶“不能碰這個！”，請考慮攜帶在敵人之間轉移條件的技能（即病症擴散，病症延長或惡夢傳染），以將侵略的軟泥怪的頭鎚的眩暈轉移到其附近的軟泥施法者。

65b1035d24eb9774fd858bb94f7361b1c400dcf1.source: Letting the timer run out, after all players open the chest, returns the party to Dalada Uplands next to Seer Fiercereign.
65b1035d24eb9774fd858bb94f7361b1c400dcf1.text: 讓計時器耗盡，在所有玩家開啟寶箱後，將隊伍返回 預言者 Fiercereign 旁的 達拉達山地。

b75a175ea2946069605887dabf1ce2897ad6717e.source: If someone in your party doesn't have the quest, Seer Fiercereign won't appear in the Dalada Uplands, so you won't be able to claim your reward.
b75a175ea2946069605887dabf1ce2897ad6717e.text: 如果您隊伍中的某人沒有任務，預言者 Fiercereign 將不會出現在 達拉達山地 中，因此您將無法領取獎勵。

1fc83406251d021aec701abe6cc8b8c6564f87bf.source: When Seer Fiercereign does appear, anyone can claim the reward if they have the quest item, regardless of whether they completed the dungeon.
1fc83406251d021aec701abe6cc8b8c6564f87bf.text: 當預言者 Fiercereign出現時，任何人只要擁有任務物品就可以領取獎勵，無論他們是否完成了地下城。

b3dc7bb81ca8ac558afedb73acfa7a45a4ac59f2.source: This can give easy experience for the Survivor title track. Simply getting the gelatin via trade and turning it in gives lots of experience without risk of death.
b3dc7bb81ca8ac558afedb73acfa7a45a4ac59f2.text: 這可以為 生存者 主打歌提供輕鬆的體驗。只需透過交易獲得明膠並將其上交即可獲得大量經驗，且沒有死亡風險。

0aad846d1c37e0ade514059b87f06c01ca07ba1d.source: Defeat the Hunter. Be mindful of the Pack that guards him.
0aad846d1c37e0ade514059b87f06c01ca07ba1d.text: 擊敗獵人。注意保護他的狼群。

0a56f019061979d77f8bef6099a1365bdce4853b.source: This quest combines well with the quest Blueprint of the Fall
0a56f019061979d77f8bef6099a1365bdce4853b.text: 這個任務與秋天的藍圖任務很好地結合在一起

b7a5fe89e37dc2ff87a5b26b9cf58c08e6259bc6.text: 不安的傳聞 已完成

21afa9741b948515bd696fc3ee793758752e0956.source: Go north from Ashford to find the road to Green Hills County. Once in Green Hills County, question at least three locals about opposition to the king.
21afa9741b948515bd696fc3ee793758752e0956.text: 從阿什福德向北走，找到通往 綠丘郡 的路。進入 綠丘郡 後，詢問至少有三名當地人有關反對國王的情況。

dca3e9f1f570be0c14da01e9dfc81b406095c480.source: Return to Devona for your reward.
dca3e9f1f570be0c14da01e9dfc81b406095c480.text: 影返 至 德佛娜 以獲得獎勵。

dba27c3597f34f77c2b86f54f9cf038f9440a297.source: Head north from Ashford and cross the portal to Green Hills County in the northwest. Near Balthazar's statue, talk to the three closest NPCs, Farrah Cappo, Grazden the Protector and Kasha Blackblood.
dba27c3597f34f77c2b86f54f9cf038f9440a297.text: 從阿什福德向北行駛，穿過傳送門到達西北方的 綠丘郡。在 巴薩澤 的雕像附近，與三個最近的 NPC 法拉卡波、保護者葛拉登 和 黑血卡夏 交談。

c0799ef7c8c2bd7e7e96d0e65e90df75691ba9fc.source: You can also talk to Little Thom and Duke Barradin in the Barradin Estate, but since you need three witnesses, you will still need to talk to at least one person near the Balthazar statue.
c0799ef7c8c2bd7e7e96d0e65e90df75691ba9fc.text: 您也可以與 Barradin Estate 中的 小湯姆 和 巴拉丁公爵 交談，但由於您需要三名目擊者，因此您仍然需要與 巴薩澤 雕像附近的至少一個人交談。

233b88d68aec1f63fb9fec890434be75120ae262.text: 收集 [5..0] 更多 Orrian 平板電腦碎片。

75360e65fb85005a5ccae3b18d5cc92a947071a5.source: Return to Magi Malaquire for your reward.
75360e65fb85005a5ccae3b18d5cc92a947071a5.text: 影返 至 法師瑪拉凱爾 以獲得獎勵。

9e6056ae1c9a3d151a7b55ef143fe644c725167b.source: Head outside into North Kryta Province and follow the quest marker to the northeast corner of the map. Alternatively, you can start from Gates of Kryta for a shorter trip through Scoundrel's Rise, which connects to North Kryta Province very close to where you need to go.
9e6056ae1c9a3d151a7b55ef143fe644c725167b.text: 前往 科瑞塔北部 並跟隨任務標記到達地圖的東北角。或者，您也可以從 科瑞塔關所 出發，透過 惡漢山丘 進行較短的行程，惡漢山丘 連線到距離您要去的地方非常近的 科瑞塔北部。

aa4cddaca350ee33e2ca6423a910e619c5935aa4.source: The area marked on the map is only accessible from the sea. There is a path in the cliff that can be entered from a sand bank in front of the shore, to the east of the beach. Usually there is a group of Mergoyles around the beach.
aa4cddaca350ee33e2ca6423a910e619c5935aa4.text: 地圖上標示的區域只能從海上進入。懸崖上有一條小路，可以從海岸前的沙洲進入，到海灘的東邊。通常海灘周圍有一群水鬼。

c0ecd86ac836fe66cb4b956dda7f9aff55aa85ba.source: When you head up the hill, you'll be faced with a relatively large group of Enchanted Clay. They shouldn't be too difficult to kill, and using AoE skills will make it significantly easier.
c0ecd86ac836fe66cb4b956dda7f9aff55aa85ba.text: 當您上山時，您將面對一大群 附魔 Clay。殺死它們應該不會太困難，使用 範圍性 技能將使殺死它們變得更容易。

c44fe938263a03fface1be52201f01d53444eeae.source: Once they're all defeated, you'll find they'll have dropped 20 Orrian Tablet Shards in total, not just the 5 you need to complete this quest. As long as you pick up the five you need, you don't need any more: you won't get an extra reward for it. Once you've collected what you need, head back to Magi Malaquire to collect your reward.
c44fe938263a03fface1be52201f01d53444eeae.text: 一旦他們全部被擊敗，你會發現他們總共掉落了 20 Orrian 平板電腦碎片，而不僅僅是完成此任務所需的 5。只要你拿起了你需要的五個，你就不再需要了：你不會因此獲得額外的獎勵。收集完所需物品後，請返回 法師瑪拉凱爾 領取獎勵。

a1ea87f5e072ad52a04f57a43b31e4215748bc4b.source: Upon completion, Magi Malaquire will take all the shards in your inventory. If you wish to keep any extras, put them in storage or give them to a different character first.
a1ea87f5e072ad52a04f57a43b31e4215748bc4b.text: 完成後，法師瑪拉凱爾 將取得您庫存中的所有碎片。如果您想保留任何額外物品，請將它們存放起來或先將它們交給其他角色。

c67a1e5dd97718bc2f4846adea06cc7915b1602d.source: Search the Ascalon Foothills for Oswalt's Headstone.
c67a1e5dd97718bc2f4846adea06cc7915b1602d.text: 在 阿斯卡隆丘陵 中搜尋奧斯瓦爾特的墓碑。

5f5e47eeb55b1a9ad91bd6dbafc14671b5095e50.source: Inscribe Elsa's words on the headstone.
5f5e47eeb55b1a9ad91bd6dbafc14671b5095e50.text: 將艾爾莎的話刻在墓碑上。

c157f8be87c22053d42e1fffe13f3bdde66f6ef5.source: See Oswalt Alston for your reward.
c157f8be87c22053d42e1fffe13f3bdde66f6ef5.text: 前往奧斯瓦爾特·阿爾斯通領取獎勵。

47b9413385f223e56f11992d1b9da794bcbc7e9e.source: Leave Traveler's Vale to the southeast and enter The Ascalon Foothills. Oswalt's grave can be found in the northern portion of the Foothills.
47b9413385f223e56f11992d1b9da794bcbc7e9e.text: 離開 旅人谷 往東南方向進入 阿斯卡隆丘陵。奧斯瓦爾特的墳墓位於山麓北部。

04f67c478a15ae2caed6c11d385e1321836bbf22.source: The epitaph reads, "Oswalt Alston. Loving husband in life. Savior in death. My strength. My inspiration. My love."
04f67c478a15ae2caed6c11d385e1321836bbf22.text: 墓誌銘上寫著：“奧斯瓦爾特·阿爾斯通。生前深愛的丈夫。死後的救世主。我的力量。我的靈感。我的愛。”

baf832f49cbe8bf4411b77585cab8a5e9fa934fe.source: When acquiring this quest, occasionally it will immediately update to indicate that you have completed the second objective ("Inscribe Elsa's words on the headstone"), but not the first objective.
baf832f49cbe8bf4411b77585cab8a5e9fa934fe.text: 當完成這個任務時，有時它會立即更新，表明你已經完成了第二個目標（「將艾爾莎的話銘刻在墓碑上」），但不是第一個目標。

d6759c78c5946aa2f4dcce31cb30b262d98c83da.source: Clear the Jade Quarry of all Outcast raiders. You have [5...0] groups remaining.
d6759c78c5946aa2f4dcce31cb30b262d98c83da.text: 清除所有流亡者襲擊者的 翡翠礦場。您還剩下 [5...0] 組。

c8d37b619589c7a48d6d166e91aa3bc96b86ecff.source: While this quest is active, two additional groups of Outcasts will spawn in areas unreachable by foot in Unwaking Waters (even though none of the quest objectives take place there): one on the path traversed during the mission, the other inside the Kurzick outpost.
c8d37b619589c7a48d6d166e91aa3bc96b86ecff.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，另外兩組流亡者將在不醒水域中步行無法到達的區域中產生（即使沒有任何任務目標發生在那裡）：一組位於任務期間經過的路徑上，另一組位於 庫茲柯 前哨站內。

81aab0898524835723ea7eea517cb98737c7c651.source: After receiving the quest from Rixonon, map to Seafarer's Rest and speak to Rixor, then exit via the northeastern portal into Rhea's Crater where the jade quarry is located. Rion is standing just outside along with his party: Khim, Ting and Hannai.
81aab0898524835723ea7eea517cb98737c7c651.text: 收到 Rixonon 的任務後，對應到 航海者休憩處 並與 Rixor 交談，然後經由東北傳送門進入翡翠採石場所在的 席亞火山口。 Rion 和他的同伴 Kim、Ting 和 Hannai 就站在外面。

c99c250cee5ff6fd3e7838c0d484e394232b726c.source: After you have spoken to Rion, the quest pointer will be updated to indicate the first Outcast group you must find and defeat. Simply follow your quest pointer to each of the five groups and eliminate them all, but be wary of overlapping patrol routes. It can be helpful to stay back and observe the movements of hostile groups before attacking, luring single groups towards the party whenever possible.
c99c250cee5ff6fd3e7838c0d484e394232b726c.text: 在你與里昂交談後，任務指標將更新，以指示你必須找到並擊敗的第一個流亡者團體。只需按照任務指標指向五個小組中的每一個並將其全部消滅，但要警惕重疊的巡邏路線。在攻擊之前，留在後面觀察敵對團體的動向，盡可能引誘單一團體靠近隊伍是有幫助的。

0a766eec3ef04fd6f4efc77d216361804e63dfa4.source: Once complete, return to Seafarer's Rest and collect your reward from Rixor.
0a766eec3ef04fd6f4efc77d216361804e63dfa4.text: 完成後，返回 航海者休憩處 並從 Rixor 領取獎勵。

ce71510d8da341d7e74f9322661d09f738081ca0.source: Note that although Rion's group will follow the party and fight any creatures, they do not join the party as allies, and it is not necessary for any of them to survive to complete the quest. That said, their assistance can complete fights more quickly, and Ting uses his healing spells on the party.
ce71510d8da341d7e74f9322661d09f738081ca0.text: 請注意，雖然里昂的隊伍會跟隨隊伍並與任何生物戰鬥，但他們並不以盟友的身份加入隊伍，而且他們中的任何一個都不需要生存來完成任務。也就是說，他們的協助可以更快完成戰鬥，而婷則在隊伍中使用他的治療法術。

ae424c48c181d9f7ebe02c663eef2ebf553572a8.source: Note at each checkpoint, there are two or three groups. For the quest to complete, you may not need to kill all the groups, sometimes one group is sufficient.
ae424c48c181d9f7ebe02c663eef2ebf553572a8.text: 請注意，每個檢查點都有兩到三組。為了完成任務，你可能不需要殺死所有的群體，有時一組就足夠了。

86de9522f9cd29dac36b9e7d19f4d02262c2153f.source: Clear Panjiang Peninsula on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode.
86de9522f9cd29dac36b9e7d19f4d02262c2153f.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 星岬島 上的 班讓半島。

ad09d4ed653f19e988fa4bdd8b34c6f710d8a62e.source: "Clear Panjiang Peninsula on Shing Jea Island of all enemies in hard mode."
ad09d4ed653f19e988fa4bdd8b34c6f710d8a62e.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 星岬島 上的 班讓半島。”

bb8355e8920b5d5f9903a9b7e784fe2a696da66f.source: This area lies to the southwest of Tsumei Village. Several early profession-related quests will lead players here.
bb8355e8920b5d5f9903a9b7e784fe2a696da66f.text: 該區域位於 蘇梅村 的西南方。一些早期與職業相關的任務將引導玩家來到這裡。

5569a3ff131320d99d3b5f3c75f96e1d3f181874.source: These Shing Jea Island quests will affect the spawns in this area:
5569a3ff131320d99d3b5f3c75f96e1d3f181874.text: 這些 星岬島 任務將影響該區域的產生：

43d31fbab73cfbe01d9b87988a232189efe7856d.source: Complete exploration of this area will yield approximately 3.3% to the Canthan Cartographer title track.
43d31fbab73cfbe01d9b87988a232189efe7856d.text: 對該區域的完整探索將產生大約 3.3% 到 Canthan 版圖 的主打歌。

53715655870e937b5bc4e0cd3cc7742ed9c859d2.source: Kappa and Crimson Skull are hostile to each other, though their patrols only overlap in a small area.
53715655870e937b5bc4e0cd3cc7742ed9c859d2.text: Kappa 和 紅顱 彼此敵對，儘管他們的巡邏只在一個小區域內重疊。

3ac5d50822da642e7d1d4e701fbf75a98a165948.source: Skills like Shelter, Union, Shield of Absorption, and Protective Spirit are highly recommended as this area is populated by numerous Elementalists and damage-dealing Ritualists.
3ac5d50822da642e7d1d4e701fbf75a98a165948.text: 強烈建議使用 庇護、聯合、吸收盾 和 精神守護 等技能，因為該地區居住著眾多元素師和造成傷害的儀式師。

d95e1f107119913afb57734a6656092fb20dfd40.source: The vast majority of damage dealt by foes in this area comes from projectile attacks and/or projectile spells. Conveniently, the area's naturally hilly/mountainous terrain makes it very easy to break line of sight.
d95e1f107119913afb57734a6656092fb20dfd40.text: 該區域的敵人造成的絕大多數傷害來自投射物攻擊和/或投射物法術。該地區自然的丘陵/山區地形非常方便，容易破壞視線。

1b1055a16bbe435e53a8d19b1d961c543b83e7d1.source: Mantra of Frost and Mantra of Lightning are also very effective in this area due to the prevalence of cold and lightning damage.
1b1055a16bbe435e53a8d19b1d961c543b83e7d1.text: 由於寒冷和雷電損壞的普遍存在，冰霜頌歌 和 閃電頌歌 在該領域也非常有效。

85ddc7d79551162e4b1c22b88fab7465bb57bf69.source: Without active quests the area east of the Tsumei Village entrance doesn't have any enemies.
85ddc7d79551162e4b1c22b88fab7465bb57bf69.text: 如果沒有活動任務，蘇梅村 入口以東的區域沒有任何敵人。

bf7ea8d77962c8399816403b45692b35df21690b.source: A hidden Naga group in Raiyan Cave will spawn if one ventures close to the waterline at the southern edge of the cave.
bf7ea8d77962c8399816403b45692b35df21690b.text: 如果有人冒險靠近洞穴南緣的水線，就會在 Raiyan 洞穴中產生一個隱藏的 納迦 群體。

cacd781a30e7ae95b9457ac187c5b617e77324c0.source: A hidden pair of Kappa will appear if one ventures along the beach immediately north of Pei the Skull Blade's ship. There's another hidden Kappa group south of Kaitan Village, on the sandy beach.
cacd781a30e7ae95b9457ac187c5b617e77324c0.text: 如果沿著骷髏刀佩伊船北邊的海灘冒險，就會出現一對隱藏的河童。在凱坦村以南的沙灘上還有另一個隱藏的河童群。

21a8695aee592088f2150367c68208469bec8688.source: Naga groups will also appear if one traverses the water along the western edge.
21a8695aee592088f2150367c68208469bec8688.text: 如果沿著西邊穿過水域，納迦 群體也會出現。

56f7faf7478653ccc025c450e4ccedb78d1b2630.source: Starting from the resurrection shrine along the southern edge west of Raiyan Cave, and at several points along the path towards and around Port Kaimu, are many hidden groups of Crimson Skull. At least one of the hidden groups at Port Kaimu may be required to be killed in order for the vanquish to complete.
56f7faf7478653ccc025c450e4ccedb78d1b2630.text: 從雷巖洞以西南緣的復活神殿開始，在通往凱姆港及其周圍的道路上的幾個地點，有許多隱藏的 紅顱 團體。為了完成征服，可能需要至少殺死凱姆港的一個隱藏組織。

4a664393e8eac8e8c0126c282f01a52876c7b9a4.source: There are two hidden Lesser Oni in this area:
4a664393e8eac8e8c0126c282f01a52876c7b9a4.text: 該區域有兩個隱藏的小鬼：

b71eeed76fa1ec705d90563c874b870e892f7334.source: Along the curving mountain path west of Losai Hapatu, the Kappa Shell collector.
b71eeed76fa1ec705d90563c874b870e892f7334.text: 沿著 Kappa 外殼 收集器 Losai Hapatu 以西的彎曲山路前進。

9d078d7b6ed22b5ccc1519eda039857d86ee8c2b.source: The Lesser Oni that spawns west of Losai Hapatu has to be killed to complete the vanquish even when it is still hidden.
9d078d7b6ed22b5ccc1519eda039857d86ee8c2b.text: 必須殺死在洛賽哈帕圖以西生成的小鬼才能完成征服，即使它仍然處於隱藏狀態。

32f30b82dc8ef99ec97a5510fdfe7bfb3ca6d4c2.source: Vanquishing during Darkness at Kaitan (during the Dragon Festival) produces some spawn changes.
32f30b82dc8ef99ec97a5510fdfe7bfb3ca6d4c2.text: 在黑暗中擊敗凱坦（龍節期間）會產生一些生成變化。

c76e3bd5466eef4e03ca4f74e00556e93123544a.source: Naga groups spawn in the village, in groups of five.
c76e3bd5466eef4e03ca4f74e00556e93123544a.text: 納迦 群體在村莊中生成，每組五人。

1aedb151063f9e420bfb8b099ea2f84178211b9e.source: Raiyan Cave is filled with groups of 1-2 Lesser Grasps.
1aedb151063f9e420bfb8b099ea2f84178211b9e.text: 雷巖洞裡充滿了成群的 1-2 小抓握者。

552a3b55fdb8a19a32b70f9abe693d392319a1b5.source: The "s"-shaped area east of the bridge on the southern edge of the map is empty - this eliminates several closely packed groups of Crimson Skull.
552a3b55fdb8a19a32b70f9abe693d392319a1b5.text: 地圖南緣橋以東的“s”形區域是空的 - 這消除了幾個緊密排列的 紅顱 組。

d010d567c2984583eea3152eabbea818f385b514.source: Overall, the result is a slight reduction in the total number of foes.
d010d567c2984583eea3152eabbea818f385b514.text: 總體而言，結果是敵人總數略有減少。

efc65d806bcf2c6d804fc239afa52a91221b0805.source: Vanquishing during Togo's Ultimatum will affect the spawns in this area.
efc65d806bcf2c6d804fc239afa52a91221b0805.text: 在多哥最後通牒期間的勝利將會影響該區域的生成。

4bf91a6e1b2f4bf072649c3c44e699a815719830.source: The Crimson Skull at the harbor will not turn hostile and Cho Wei the Skull Axe does not spawn.
4bf91a6e1b2f4bf072649c3c44e699a815719830.text: 港口的 紅顱 不會變成敵對狀態，而且骷髏 Cho Wei 斧 也不會產生。

0d2df786eca5b8521fae5873d281e8061d4c7a4a.source: The bridge after the "s"-like mountain will not have Crimson Skull popup.
0d2df786eca5b8521fae5873d281e8061d4c7a4a.text: 「s」狀山後面的橋梁不會有 紅顱 彈出視窗。

e38f52c6fad42923b7b9c511d84be355d590b6d4.source: Leaving from Kaineng City, head directly southeast through Bukdek Byway and cross the bridge to receive the quest from Minister Tahlen, then talk to Minister Khannai who is nearby. Map travel to The Marketplace, exit south into Wajjun Bazaar and talk to Minister Baasong who is just outside the portal. Head back through the marketplace to the northeast over the bridge to talk to Minister Onghsang. Map travel to Nahpui Quarter (outpost) and exit north into Wajjun Bazaar, following the last quest marker to talk to Guardsman Pah to receive the quest reward.
e38f52c6fad42923b7b9c511d84be355d590b6d4.text: 從凱寧城出發，直接向東南方向穿過巴德克小徑，過橋接受塔倫部長的任務，然後與附近的卡奈部長交談。地圖旅行至 市集，向南退出進入 瓦江市場，並與門戶外的巴松部長交談。穿過市場向東北方向走，過橋與 Onghsang 部長交談。地圖旅行到 納普區（前哨站）並向北退出進入 瓦江市場，沿著最後一個任務標記與衛兵 Pah 交談以獲得任務獎勵。

7ee29a7bc24342e1e2835f1a016efc8063d7cdfd.source: Clear Perdition Rock in the Ring of Fire Islands of all enemies in hard mode.
7ee29a7bc24342e1e2835f1a016efc8063d7cdfd.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 火環群島地域 中的 破滅石。

3db3d751d3acff5c0c3e64dd37c8bc399f9b4362.source: "Clear Perdition Rock in the Ring of Fire Islands of all enemies in hard mode."
3db3d751d3acff5c0c3e64dd37c8bc399f9b4362.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的火環群島地域中的破滅石。”

74a35a9522c90e514aafdd84e43821e73c59f0ee.source: The Final Blow primary quest will take characters through this area on their way to the next mission outpost.
74a35a9522c90e514aafdd84e43821e73c59f0ee.text: 最後一擊 主要任務將帶領角色穿過該區域前往下一個任務前哨站。

69bd774bc654640c6d73d5c7cba35edfe7f6c422.source: You can get the Volcanic Rock for the Black Moa Chick from the northeast part of this area.
69bd774bc654640c6d73d5c7cba35edfe7f6c422.text: 您可以從該區域的東北部獲得 黑恐鳥 小雞的 火山岩。

d542b73a1617e09f70941d7c0e2c9c8fc0bc7e7b.source: Watch out for Mahgo Hydras with their Meteor Shower. They can also do massive damage through other fire skills.
d542b73a1617e09f70941d7c0e2c9c8fc0bc7e7b.text: 小心使用 隕石雨 的 Mahgo Hydra。他們還可以透過其他火焰技能造成巨大傷害。

58915f3f676dae996e2b100dae385ec0e3a90dbf.source: Martial Professions will want to bring a way to deal with Blind as Phantoms pop up throughout the zone.
58915f3f676dae996e2b100dae385ec0e3a90dbf.text: 當幻影在整個區域中突然出現時，武術職業將希望找到一種方法來對付盲人。

2f121b8fc0aa9ad3a35469eeecbf498c51386840.source: Caster Professions will also want to bring a way to deal with Interrupts as Phantoms carry 3 with one of them being Cry of Frustration which is an area of effect interrupt.
2f121b8fc0aa9ad3a35469eeecbf498c51386840.text: 法師 專業人士也希望提供一種處理中斷的方法，因為 Phantom 隨附 3，其中一個是 挫折哭喊，它是一個有效中斷區域。

db004da77f6926a4d017adb83bc7b29c705d9374.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.2% to the Tyrian Cartographer title track.
db004da77f6926a4d017adb83bc7b29c705d9374.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 主打歌貢獻了約 1.2%。

dc311f7e0d98275b9a6b9a5405a35df931a043a2.source: There are less foes after accepting the quest reward for Final Blow.
dc311f7e0d98275b9a6b9a5405a35df931a043a2.text: 接受 最後一擊 的任務獎勵後，敵人減少了。

97717e0e7a729b072012ecc01e6192d74cdf8dd9.source: Having Proof of Triumph in the inventory will make a further group with Abaddon's Cursed spawn.
97717e0e7a729b072012ecc01e6192d74cdf8dd9.text: 庫存中包含 凱旋憑證 將會與 亞霸頓 的詛咒生成體形成進一步的群組。

278d012baa12752babdff026bde6d0255632abde.source: Not all of the elite skills are available for capture in any one instance of the map.
278d012baa12752babdff026bde6d0255632abde.text: 並非所有精英技能都可以在地圖的任何一個例項中捕獲。

e87a80f315924fc661d7e10a6efc61f4f89493d3.source: Not all bosses listed above will spawn in the same map instance. Generally, only one boss will spawn at each spawn point.
e87a80f315924fc661d7e10a6efc61f4f89493d3.text: 並非上面列出的所有 Boss 都會在同一個地圖例項中產生。一般來說，每個生成點只會產生一個 Boss。

8821a4bb0b2da1e4c8172283f043563cc07f64fe.source: Any spawn point may spawn more than one boss.
8821a4bb0b2da1e4c8172283f043563cc07f64fe.text: 任何生成點都可能產生多個 Boss。

84814ada5c7bd2ef5de2dfd3ffae46f79592c061.source: Occasionally no boss spawns at a spawn point for Abomination or Ghost bosses.
84814ada5c7bd2ef5de2dfd3ffae46f79592c061.text: 有時，憎惡或幽靈 Boss 的生成點不會生成 Boss。

de61a2976e3295684528f1da845700c176e7fce8.source: Sometimes, not all of the Phantom bosses will spawn.
de61a2976e3295684528f1da845700c176e7fce8.text: 有時，並非所有 幽靈 Boss 都會產生。

c12405eea2ae2cad33406165ff89864a112869c6.source: Harn and Maxine Coldstone will not spawn in the same instance.
c12405eea2ae2cad33406165ff89864a112869c6.text: 冰石哈恩/麥辛 不會在相同例項中產生。

66013d2fc56230fb8bb4a0f1263a63121419b853.source: Since there are four spawn points shared by the Ettin boss and two Hydra bosses, one of the spawn points will be empty.
66013d2fc56230fb8bb4a0f1263a63121419b853.text: 由於 雙頭巨人 Boss 和兩個 三頭龍 Boss 共享四個生成點，因此其中一個生成點將為空。

b9c09d9ef345f75f99580d52ed0dee093139c5ee.source: An easy way to capture the elite skills of the Ghost and Abomination bosses is to exit from Ember Light Camp and then run to the first boss location to the east (one or two bosses will spawn there). If the boss you are looking for is not there then rezone. This could take many tries since there are 5 Abominations and 3 Phantom bosses and their spawn is random.
b9c09d9ef345f75f99580d52ed0dee093139c5ee.text: 捕捉幽靈和憎恨 Boss 精英技能的一個簡單方法是從 殘火營地 退出，然後跑到東邊的第一個 Boss 位置（那裡會產生一個或兩個 Boss）。如果你要找的老闆不在，那就重新分割。這可能需要多次嘗試，因為存在 5 Abominations 和 3 幽靈 Boss，並且它們的生成是隨機的。

cc6a27e5b6dcd2f592876d057620eb3315e4c57b.source: Travel to Shing Jea Monastery and get a kappa trap for Farmer Zinhao.
cc6a27e5b6dcd2f592876d057620eb3315e4c57b.text: 前往 星岬寺 並為農夫 Zinhao 取得河童陷阱。

9de49f3e3088ce9c3bda4d5f274a59b97ad4dbf7.source: See Farmer Zinhao for your reward.

206b51237196958a7ff9699f312798910169e2bf.source: Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Suhkaro. Return to Farmer Zinhao in Panjiang Peninsula for your reward. He may not be present, if you have already got an active quest in the area.
206b51237196958a7ff9699f312798910169e2bf.text: 將旅行地圖對映到 星岬寺 並與 Suhkaro 交談。 影返 給 班讓半島 中的農民 Zinhao 以獲得獎勵。如果你已經在該地區有一個活躍的任務，他可能不在場。

473421a99226999681e54af3bca80df07b5a1d31.source: Escort the ghost Ganji to the spot Krahm fell.
473421a99226999681e54af3bca80df07b5a1d31.text: 護送幽靈甘吉到克拉姆墜落的地方。

0f5d003e7286aa04464c4d5814d833ec4f177369.source: Guide the wandering spirits to Allura's last resting place.
0f5d003e7286aa04464c4d5814d833ec4f177369.text: 引導流浪的靈魂前往阿魯拉最後的安息之地。

9a26f273a7345cf50edd0d0683a3a1f4df3d5e3a.source: Walk to the spot where Shandara and her daughter were lost.
9a26f273a7345cf50edd0d0683a3a1f4df3d5e3a.text: 走到珊達拉和女兒失蹤的地方。

06e48b46f11c8adf7486d90fcf3bd106ce337acf.source: Reunite the spirits with Shahin to complete the pilgrimage.
06e48b46f11c8adf7486d90fcf3bd106ce337acf.text: 讓靈魂與沙欣重聚，完成朝聖之旅。

1822cd03bbd8ee0f34c47b78447ea6975238d032.source: Upon completing this quest, Allura, Ganji, Krahm, Shahin, and Shandara will be placed outside Augury Rock, finally completing their Pilgrimage.
1822cd03bbd8ee0f34c47b78447ea6975238d032.text: 完成此任務後，Allura、Ganji、Krahm、Shahin 和 Shandara 將被放置在 占卜之石 之外，最終完成他們的朝聖之旅。

12bdae4865952ec6f7dda3c7ed2d7133a3638ead.source: Ganji is in The Ruptured Heart near the southwestern exit into the Alkali Pan. After you accepted the quest, just follow the quest markers. To complete the last objective and reach Shahin you need a Junundu. There is a Wurm Spoor southeast from the quest marker (right of the writing "The Ruptured Heart"). Alternatively just follow the path on the map.
12bdae4865952ec6f7dda3c7ed2d7133a3638ead.text: Ganji 位於靠近鹼鍋西南方出口的 破裂之心。接受任務後，只需按照任務標記進行即可。要完成最後一個目標並到達沙欣，您需要朱南杜。在任務標記的東南方向（寫著「破裂之心」的右邊）有一個 地蟲 Spoor。或者，只需沿著地圖上的路徑行駛即可。

3054abb2ea35b7613a639c79710fff739b9d88c1.source: Mhenlo's Request neither active nor completed
3054abb2ea35b7613a639c79710fff739b9d88c1.text: 涵洛 的請求既不活躍也不完成

046ef6cc53b34ee43fccf02e00b17c1084569d19.source: You must also have completed and accepted the reward for The Time is Nigh
046ef6cc53b34ee43fccf02e00b17c1084569d19.text: 您還必須已完成並接受《時辰已近》的獎勵

064ce4136e5597e0b87bf12c8613e4f958ae3247.source: Speak to Funwa Shento in Kamadan, Jewel of Istan to be directed to Mhenlo.
064ce4136e5597e0b87bf12c8613e4f958ae3247.text: 與 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽 中的 Funwa Shento 交談以引導至 涵洛。

1333d681585d4e127707e996aa379397d74d7050.source: Speak to Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks to learn about what is occurring in Cantha.
1333d681585d4e127707e996aa379397d74d7050.text: 與領事館碼頭的 涵洛 交談，瞭解 Cantha 正在發生的情況。

818b6779b3b34f4122efd7bb92593eaa0a263c58.source: Tell Mhenlo when you are ready to leave for Cantha.
818b6779b3b34f4122efd7bb92593eaa0a263c58.text: 當您準備好前往 Cantha 時，請告訴 涵洛。

6987b118968f1ad50d2f48bfbf2c0744f27532ec.source: Find Dockhand Quangnai to learn more about the situation in Cantha.
6987b118968f1ad50d2f48bfbf2c0744f27532ec.text: 找到Dockhand Quangnai，瞭解更多關於Cantha的情況。

a403d5bf6ba2c7bc36b35d0a4deaaadfdf9ca79a.source: Just follow the radar indicators. There will be no fights in this quest. Although this can be done solo, players may want to bring lower level heroes to make the most of the experience received.
a403d5bf6ba2c7bc36b35d0a4deaaadfdf9ca79a.text: 只需遵循雷達指示器即可。這個任務中不會有戰鬥。雖然這可以單獨完成，但玩家可能希望帶上較低階別的英雄來充分利用他們獲得的經驗。

18abfeab58fc05ef9069cb721d5a2baaf03738b6.source: This quest unlocks Kaineng City port (once you have arrived at Bejunkan Pier).
18abfeab58fc05ef9069cb721d5a2baaf03738b6.text: 此任務解鎖 凱寧城 連線埠（一旦您到達 君瞰碼頭）。

95af3cb133323f5e29c51dbcc74cc813b79feb53.text: 與 涵洛 的請求互斥。

3e0be1cf3edc3d2eff6a40c139607a1e9f1d45ce.source: A Nightfall character with this quest can ferry characters of any level (from any Campaign) to Cantha, provided that they have the Consulate Docks unlocked (i.e. by either having completed The Time is Nigh themselves, or having previously received a ferry to the docks from Kamadan via that quest).
3e0be1cf3edc3d2eff6a40c139607a1e9f1d45ce.text: 執行此任務的 黑暗逆襲 角色可以將任何級別的角色（來自任何 章節）運送到 Cantha，前提是他們已解鎖領事館碼頭（即，自己完成了“時日將至”，或者之前通過該任務從卡馬丹收到了前往碼頭的渡輪）。

609498be0129c8398efc763ecf8670f8da39b8d3.source: You can be taken to Benjunkan Pier by Mhenlo multiple times without restarting the quest and even after accepting the reward. There is no reason to keep this quest in your log.
609498be0129c8398efc763ecf8670f8da39b8d3.text: 即使在接受獎勵後，您也可以多次被 涵洛 帶到 Benjunkan 碼頭，而無需重新啟動任務。沒有理由將此任務保留在您的日誌中。

293cb7bff64bd5df89d3d0143ddd3fcf49489d89.source: Ferried characters can map travel to Kaineng Center right away and do not have to walk there.
293cb7bff64bd5df89d3d0143ddd3fcf49489d89.text: 乘坐渡輪的角色可以立即將旅行對映到 凱寧中心，而不必步行到那裡。

f44814415e4ba8af233324e339a8678e03417d45.source: In order to take the follow-up quest, Welcome to Cantha, you must either accept the reward for this quest or abandon it. You can also skip Welcome to Cantha if you are ferried into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) by another character with that quest.
f44814415e4ba8af233324e339a8678e03417d45.text: 為了完成後續任務 歡迎來到凱珊，您必須接受此任務的獎勵或放棄它。如果您被執行該任務的另一個角色帶到 薇茹廣場（國外地區），您也可以跳過 歡迎來到凱珊。

77636dc19a79c522d51986e077da6139bd30cdfc.source: Kill Plague of Destruction and accompanying foes in Raven's Point.
77636dc19a79c522d51986e077da6139bd30cdfc.text: 殺死 疫之破壞者 和 渡鴉岬角 中伴隨的敵人。

ff365da808ea5647ada9f0af2f384b89d169e5af.source: *BONUS* Kill Plague of Destruction and accompanying foes in Hard Mode.
ff365da808ea5647ada9f0af2f384b89d169e5af.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 疫之破壞者 和伴隨的敵人。

bdeb553cf58a65123adb2213d3b9a626b5939f87.source: As per Defending the Breach. Note that unlike that quest, you have to defeat all the Destroyers in the final room to finish this (as with spawning the chest).
bdeb553cf58a65123adb2213d3b9a626b5939f87.text: 根據捍衛違規行為。請注意，與該任務不同的是，您必須擊敗最後一個房間中的所有毀滅者才能完成此任務（與生成箱子一樣）。

3ef70cbb4786a4f86d558c5503b5e3caae8cb087.source: Kill the heket in the Garden of Seborhin. You have X of 10 groups remaining.
3ef70cbb4786a4f86d558c5503b5e3caae8cb087.text: 在 希伯欣花園 中殺死 heket。您還剩下 X 個 10 群組。

393809625ea740e23a1b60264c60fcfe080e4bc8.source: See Horticulturist Hinon for your reward.
393809625ea740e23a1b60264c60fcfe080e4bc8.text: 向園藝師 Hinon 尋求獎勵。

447bc6eb56de093ea4ceef60d4e14f3bf49a7d5c.source: This quest is a simple process of following the pointer to each group of heket, and eliminating them. These heket groups are in addition to those that normally spawn in this area. These new groups are located around or inside the garden compound. The plague cannot be done when the garden is under nightfall so do it before you trigger that or after you have completed the campaign.
447bc6eb56de093ea4ceef60d4e14f3bf49a7d5c.text: 這個任務是一個簡單的過程，沿著指標找到每組heket，然後消除它們。這些 heket 群體不屬於通常在該區域產生的群體。這些新的群體位於花園大院周圍或內部。當花園在夜幕降臨時，瘟疫無法發生，所以在觸發瘟疫之前或完成戰役之後進行。

1a4166e7d37e8d4c60fd0471576857b30de86779.source: After receiving the quest, it's a good idea to speak to the Vabbian Scout nearby, since he has a Heket Hunt blessing which will earn sunspear promotion points for any player taking it.
1a4166e7d37e8d4c60fd0471576857b30de86779.text: 收到任務後，最好與附近的瓦比安偵察兵交談，因為他有 青蛙族群 狩獵祝福，任何接受該祝福的玩家都會獲得陽矛晉升積分。

c17ae886e12e170cb2e9401b50e9c874da780b26.source: This quest cannot be completed in Nightfallen Jahai. If Nightfall has occurred, you must complete the campaign before completing this quest.
c17ae886e12e170cb2e9401b50e9c874da780b26.text: 該任務無法在墮夜者賈海完成。如果發生了 黑暗逆襲，您必須在完成此任務之前完成戰役。

a092b847bc4cf41085c892623446ddcb9cd24410.source: Clear the Plains of Jarin in Istan of all enemies in hard mode.
a092b847bc4cf41085c892623446ddcb9cd24410.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 賈林平原。

e407c4d95b8740121b04eb8db3951053d857b2de.source: "Clear the Plains of Jarin in Istan of all enemies in hard mode."
e407c4d95b8740121b04eb8db3951053d857b2de.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 艾斯坦 中的 賈林平原。”

f7b82e0b1ce4532480f1374cc958b40f1daff751.source: The Plains of Jarin connects Kamadan and three other outposts. Leaving Kamadan for the first time using the northwestern exit will bring players here. A variety of quests available in Kamadan and the Sunspear Great Hall lead to and take place here.
f7b82e0b1ce4532480f1374cc958b40f1daff751.text: 賈林平原 連線卡馬丹和其他三個前哨站。第一次從西北出口離開卡馬丹會將玩家帶到這裡。卡馬丹和 日戟大會堂 中的各種任務都通往並發生在這裡。

613785bb545c3bd8edb997f450296787409cfeb8.source: The Juvenile Bladed Termites are passive. There's a large group of them in the western waters. Watch out for the lone hostile Irontooth Drake in their midst.
613785bb545c3bd8edb997f450296787409cfeb8.text: 幼年葉片白蟻是被動的。西部海域有一大群。小心他們中間孤獨的敵對分子 鋼牙龍獸。

b4c33032003e851718ebf3b7d40b74281a95f56f.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.7% to the Elonian Cartographer title.
b4c33032003e851718ebf3b7d40b74281a95f56f.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Elonian 版圖 標題做出了大約 2.7% 的貢獻。

e25f9e617ed095783d39b76be0e2fb0d52c80233.source: Be careful with the hidden mandragor groups near Tarom Rockbreaker; the boss itself is part of a hidden group.
e25f9e617ed095783d39b76be0e2fb0d52c80233.text: 小心Tarom Rockbreaker附近隱藏的曼德拉草群；老闆本身就是一個隱藏團體的一部分。

7242f0b64c2a3e9db2f9f753e08eb82a5371a44e.source: If the quest Zaishen Elite is active, you must defeat the two Acolytes to successfully vanquish the area.
7242f0b64c2a3e9db2f9f753e08eb82a5371a44e.text: 如果任務 Zaishen 精英 處於活動狀態，您必須擊敗兩名侍僧才能成功征服該地區。

8dd40d22268d3a8d225782b9b48e8d90b7866b2e.source: The festival quest White Mist adds three allied Humbugs to your team.
8dd40d22268d3a8d225782b9b48e8d90b7866b2e.text: 節日任務「白霧」為您的團隊添加了三名騙子盟友。

3642909f5d938d2f81c1d20422977245d8e58153.source: It is possible to vanquish this area with a party of eight members. See Kamadan, Jewel of Istan notes for details.
3642909f5d938d2f81c1d20422977245d8e58153.text: 八人小隊就有可能征服這個地區。有關詳細資訊，請參閱 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽 註釋。

5bc939e12cccce17a7288d19a0cb19d57ee79269.source: It is also possible to get a party of eight members from the Sunspear Great Hall under the same conditions after completing Blacktide Den mission.
5bc939e12cccce17a7288d19a0cb19d57ee79269.text: 完成黑潮巢穴任務後，在相同條件下也可以從 日戟大會堂 取得八人小隊。

ba38c2bb0a1fd9af6cb44d3574d252ffe3c173ec.source: Meet Vael at the rendezvous point in Grothmar Wardowns.
ba38c2bb0a1fd9af6cb44d3574d252ffe3c173ec.text: 在 Grothmar Wardowns 的集合點與 衛兒 會面。

ab47e72a5559b18393db20e7e1a53591d90b5253.source: Get into position and wait for Vael to create a diversion. Do not alert the Charr in the camp to your presence.
ab47e72a5559b18393db20e7e1a53591d90b5253.text: 就位並等待 衛兒 建立改道。請勿提醒營地中的 夏爾 您的存在。

fd6dd02f8db558c021ba2b1af65d2d7b3a4e8e89.source: Run in and steal the plans while Vael keeps the Charr busy.
fd6dd02f8db558c021ba2b1af65d2d7b3a4e8e89.text: 跑過 進來並竊取計劃，而 衛兒 讓 夏爾 忙碌。

2d19c3f34ac6e9568f867045f541c923b3aa76d3.source: Take the plans back to Captain Langmar.
2d19c3f34ac6e9568f867045f541c923b3aa76d3.text: 將計劃帶回 隊長連瑪。

8d25b53cdfaf9f4a5120b10c50abbf3d81167f44.source: Don't forget the plans! (If the plans are dropped.)
8d25b53cdfaf9f4a5120b10c50abbf3d81167f44.text: 不要忘記計劃！ （如果計劃被放棄。）

a4c90a885766d969727b35b291dccf4318a29f18.source: If zoning in with a party member who has never spoken to Vael:
a4c90a885766d969727b35b291dccf4318a29f18.text: 如果與從未與 衛兒 交談過的黨員進行分割槽：

fe0f0ca63d2bf57b8e6f4537c1eb8e87bdbff844.source: Vael is not ready to undertake the covert mission. He has still not made himself known to one of your party members.
fe0f0ca63d2bf57b8e6f4537c1eb8e87bdbff844.text: 衛兒 尚未準備好執行秘密任務。他還沒有讓你們的一位黨員知道他的身分。

026f899d81a86fd7d6e123bd97521468e7a62f4b.source: If zoning in with a party member who has spoken to Vael but has not completed Be Very, Very Quiet...:
026f899d81a86fd7d6e123bd97521468e7a62f4b.text: 如果與已與 衛兒 交談但尚未完成「非常非常安靜」的隊員劃入分割槽：

4d9f4ddadcfcaa22192ace50a779d8be56136e13.source: Vael is not ready to undertake the covert mission. He is busy following a suspicious looking Charr. Help your party member discover what that Charr is up to, and then Vael will be ready to raid the Charr camp for plans.
4d9f4ddadcfcaa22192ace50a779d8be56136e13.text: 衛兒 尚未準備好執行秘密任務。他正忙著跟蹤一個看起來很可疑的 夏爾。幫助您的隊伍成員發現 夏爾 的意圖，然後 衛兒 將準備好突襲 夏爾 營地以獲取計劃。

9d2fa347aa4ab524cad3a3373a103e5915457681.source: After speaking with Vael, the party waits on a bluff close by while he runs to the Charr camp and lures them away. A large group will follow Vael once he challenges them, wait a few seconds and a lingering group of four or more Charr will run out after them. Once the Charr have left, the Battle Plans are easily attainable. Return them to Captain Langmar for the reward.
9d2fa347aa4ab524cad3a3373a103e5915457681.text: 與 衛兒 交談後，隊伍在附近的懸崖上等待，而他跑到 夏爾 營地並引誘他們離開。一旦 衛兒 挑戰他們，一大群人就會跟著 衛兒，等待幾秒鐘，四人或更多的 夏爾 會在他們後面跑出來。一旦 夏爾 離開，作戰計畫就很容易實現。將他們 影返 轉至 隊長連瑪 以獲得獎勵。

a26c762073ccaa5d8bf2dd257c53aec0b31b496e.source: Note that the Battle Plans are a bundle item, and that you will not be able to map travel back to Longeye's Ledge without losing it. Also, don't wait too long, because those Charr do come back.
a26c762073ccaa5d8bf2dd257c53aec0b31b496e.text: 請注意，作戰計畫是捆綁物品，您將無法在不遺失它的情況下將地圖旅行回 長眼巖脈。另外，不要等太久，因為那些 夏爾 確實會回來。

20709ab371330aec01b7ccaee8f80911aa983786.source: Avoid lingering in the camp too long as the Charr will return shortly.
20709ab371330aec01b7ccaee8f80911aa983786.text: 避免在營地逗留太久，因為 夏爾 很快就會回來。

644d752c4c2e1d40f77661730544b1257c99c8b7.source: There is usually a Locked Chest in the camp near the plans.
644d752c4c2e1d40f77661730544b1257c99c8b7.text: 營地附近計劃附近通常有一個鎖定的 寶箱。

d158f62236c238777a2b8e4b80133926c5767ef4.source: The Battle Plans can be carried while in Siege Devourer form, but the Devourer's standard ranged spacebar attack cannot be used.
d158f62236c238777a2b8e4b80133926c5767ef4.text: 在《圍攻》蠍 型態 中可以攜帶作戰計劃，但無法使用 蠍 的標準遠端空白鍵攻擊。

606523ffed4a77e5daaf1c128a9e78a3943f1c3a.source: Vael will sometimes get stuck, and not lure the Charr as the quest suggests. If this occurs, simply zone in and out of nearby Sacnoth Valley and try talking to him again. You may receive a "QUEST FAILED" message upon retrieving the plans. The quest reward can still be collected upon returning them to Captain Langmar
606523ffed4a77e5daaf1c128a9e78a3943f1c3a.text: 衛兒 有時會卡住，並且不會像任務建議的那樣引誘 夏爾。如果發生這種情況，只需進出附近的 聖諾谷，然後再次嘗試與他交談即可。檢索計劃後，您可能會收到「任務失敗」訊息。將任務獎勵回傳 隊長連瑪 後仍可領取

851fc62f32cda7f96c472a1afd3cb7b013b0e053.source: Clear the Pockmark Flats in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
851fc62f32cda7f96c472a1afd3cb7b013b0e053.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 麻點平原。

18f964eaa64d479927edb4424da146f6305d3e17.source: "Clear the Pockmark Flats in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
18f964eaa64d479927edb4424da146f6305d3e17.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 麻點平原。”

46556446dad610cbbd272835b66834bf733386ff.source: Several secondary quests of the Ascalon region lead here. This area is located south of the Eastern Frontier and due east of Serenity Temple.
46556446dad610cbbd272835b66834bf733386ff.text: 阿斯卡隆 地區的幾個次要任務通往這裡。該區域位於 東方邊境 的南部和 寧靜神殿 的正東。

4605119f3f4eb1480b7cce755984ccf1e5491576.source: There is a resurrection point just inside the small walled area near the Serenity Temple portal, but no visible shrine.
4605119f3f4eb1480b7cce755984ccf1e5491576.text: 在 寧靜神殿 門戶附近的小圍牆區域內有一個復活點，但沒有可見的神殿。

d04fbdc3517a446afb325f846181bfceb7f33446.source: Vanquishing: 135–234 foes. There are numerous Devourer pop-ups throughout the zone, with a large number in the northern valley surrounding the Searing Crystal.
d04fbdc3517a446afb325f846181bfceb7f33446.text: 擊敗：135–234 敵人。整個區域內有許多 蠍 彈出視窗，其中大量位於 崩壞 水晶周圍的北部山谷。

5db04f19abd453e8afe0cdb5433a4af315910634.source: The Geomancer's Test will significantly increase the number of foes, and Replacement Healers will add Devona as an ally.
5db04f19abd453e8afe0cdb5433a4af315910634.text: 地法師的考驗 將顯著增加敵人的數量，支援戰鬥任務 將增加 德佛娜 作為盟友。

0f48af9f7de73d5d0dfe2e73626539ee5e151823.source: There appear to be three variations of spawns in the crater valley; you should be able to tell which shortly after exiting Serenity Temple:
0f48af9f7de73d5d0dfe2e73626539ee5e151823.text: 火山口山谷中似乎有三種不同的生成點：退出 寧靜神殿 後不久您應該能夠分辨出哪一個：

180ba1c0d165958c37c62cc2fb01a502a48b3a1d.source: Riders: Patrols of Storm Riders swirl around crevices, and then circle the valley counter-clockwise around the crystal; there is a separate group that stays near the center. When vanquishing, move clockwise to avoid missing any. (Rough estimate: 80% of visits.)
180ba1c0d165958c37c62cc2fb01a502a48b3a1d.text: 騎士：風暴騎士的巡邏隊繞著裂縫旋轉，然後繞著水晶逆時針繞山谷一圈；有一個單獨的小組住在中心附近。擊敗時順時針移動，以免錯過任何機會。 （粗略估計：80% 造訪次數。）

352be386f1fbf671411491caa3597ceb0150f93a.source: Elementals: The crater contains patrols of Stone Elementals instead. (Roughly 10% of visits.)
352be386f1fbf671411491caa3597ceb0150f93a.text: 元素：火山口內有石頭元素的巡邏隊。 （大約 10% 次訪問。）

9797e6f067358c014736006efc4ca1baa6914bae.source: Gargoyles: The spawns are gargoyles and there appear to be fewer devourer pop-ups. (Roughly 10% of visits.)
9797e6f067358c014736006efc4ca1baa6914bae.text: 石像鬼：生成的是石像鬼，並且吞噬者的彈出視窗似乎較少。 （大約 10% 次訪問。）

8bbe1ba920f773495a2cb23732e62c92d55e257a.source: The collector Nicanor Gannel does not always appear; his presence might be tied to the type of spawns in the crystal valley.
8bbe1ba920f773495a2cb23732e62c92d55e257a.text: 收集器 尼卡諾加涅 並不總是出現；他的存在可能與水晶谷中的生成點型別有關。

5e70b2362daaa3fe64d68460e4c7b26fa9c604e3.source: As per the Pogahn Passage mission.
5e70b2362daaa3fe64d68460e4c7b26fa9c604e3.text: 根據 波甘驛站 任務。

03062e954b5f76025943153b1e9138819bfa2d2b.source: The quest reward is greater than that of other Zaishen quests from the region.
03062e954b5f76025943153b1e9138819bfa2d2b.text: 該任務獎勵高於該地區的其他再神任務。

abd699aa5e43dac9ef9a5ea6f08a793c0f5b7f29.source: Clear the Poisoned Outcrops in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
abd699aa5e43dac9ef9a5ea6f08a793c0f5b7f29.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的荒蕪之地中的劇毒地表。

2dc56b596c5b6b5d1e5537637cc98087396178d6.source: "Clear the Poisoned Outcrops in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
2dc56b596c5b6b5d1e5537637cc98087396178d6.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的荒蕪之地中的劇毒地表。”

763f729fba3843976b0524ee543643880d086176.source: Head out the northeastern exit of either the Lair of the Forgotten or the Ruptured Heart.
763f729fba3843976b0524ee543643880d086176.text: 從 被遺忘者的巢穴 或破裂之心的東北出口出發。

d58fdcd6ef3eab95f7eb19da189b92b4347522db.source: This is the only area in the Desolation where Junundu are not available.
d58fdcd6ef3eab95f7eb19da189b92b4347522db.text: 這是 荒蕪之地 中唯一無法使用 Junundu 的區域。

a3aedf1a910e6a517e066cc65561c991d883d363.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.4% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
a3aedf1a910e6a517e066cc65561c991d883d363.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Elonian 版圖 主打歌貢獻了約 2.4%。

5979384eda825e71529407e40eca6c0253703461.source: There's a small group of hidden insects at the end of the northern path just out of the Lair of the Forgotten. They can be avoided simply by not using that short central path.
5979384eda825e71529407e40eca6c0253703461.text: 在 被遺忘者的巢穴 外面的北邊小路的盡頭有一小群隱藏的昆蟲。只需不使用那條短的中心路徑就可以避免它們。

bcfac3f2f3b05035c8118853966baf93c6e079fd.source: The boss group of Droajam, Mage of the Sands is, by far, the most difficult group to take down. It consists of the boss itself plus 4 other elementals (Sandstorm Crag and Shambling Mesa, usually more of the former). The sheer damage that they can dish out at once can wipe even a well-prepared party several times. Focusing on one at a time and spreading out wide is essential to taking them down. Alternatively, a well-timed Pain Inverter will also usually kill the boss and Sandstorm Crags in one Sandstorm, especially if using spirits/minions/pets (which can also act as a decoy).
bcfac3f2f3b05035c8118853966baf93c6e079fd.text: 沙之法師 卓加姆 的頭目組是迄今為止最難打倒的組別。它由 Boss 本身和 4 其他元素組成（沙風暴．克雷格 和 震顫者．梅薩，通常前者較多）。他們一次性造成的巨大傷害甚至可以將準備好的隊伍消滅數次。一次集中精力並廣泛傳播對於消滅他們至關重要。或者，適時的 苦痛 逆變器通常也會殺死 沙塵暴 中的 Boss 和 沙塵暴 峭壁，特別是在使用精魂/小兵/寵物（也可以充當誘餌）的情況下。

88b76d9f10dd9323990f80b8e4bae6fa4ec3387b.source: Just west of the Lair of the Forgotten are several very closely placed groups of undead, possibly overlapping with a Margonite group as well. Carefully pull each group into the narrow path before fully engaging them. The boss group containing Nehjab the Parched may be difficult to take down; it depends on the number of Awakened Acolytes and Awakened Cavaliers there are. Consider skills like Frozen Soil.
88b76d9f10dd9323990f80b8e4bae6fa4ec3387b.text: 被遺忘者的巢穴 的西邊有幾個距離非常近的不死族群，也可能與 瑪骨奈 群重疊。小心地將每個小組拉入狹窄的路徑，然後再讓他們完全參與。包含「乾渴者內賈布」的 Boss 隊伍可能很難被消滅；取決於覺醒侍僧和覺醒騎士的數量。考慮像 凍土 這樣的技能。

cf9eefddfbc15669aca09f9c707219b3ef66a3ae.source: Both the Hallowed Point and the Growing Threat quests will significantly increase the number of Margonite spawns, although the latter also provides some allies.
cf9eefddfbc15669aca09f9c707219b3ef66a3ae.text: 神聖點和日益增長的威脅任務都將顯著增加 瑪骨奈 生成的數量，儘管後者也提供了一些盟友。

14bd05b086d464307e6062a32e9e044234ab2c9e.source: Enter Sorrow's Furnace without To Sorrow's Furnace sub quests.
14bd05b086d464307e6062a32e9e044234ab2c9e.text: 進入 悲傷熔爐，不執行 前往哀傷熔爐 子任務。

cf73a2b1c9bf5796545adec580e1fbd3338d8eda.source: Find and slay 6 more Stone Summit leaders.
cf73a2b1c9bf5796545adec580e1fbd3338d8eda.text: 找出並殺死 6 更多 石峰矮人 領導者。

ec139a513e8d7636caa173f9e14454b05655ccb2.source: See Tharn Stonerift for your reward.
ec139a513e8d7636caa173f9e14454b05655ccb2.text: 去找薩恩·斯通裡夫特領取獎勵。

dc7edbc19fb0a1c34df63d75ef0700a1355081da.source: Turning north at the fork and following the sparsely-populated crescent passage (the Gap) leads to another two bosses, which may be a preferable alternative to clearing the more enemy-dense Basilica.
dc7edbc19fb0a1c34df63d75ef0700a1355081da.text: 在岔路口向北轉向，沿著人煙稀少的新月形通道（缺口）通往另外兩個 Boss，這可能是清除敵人更密集的大教堂的更好選擇。

6d190e1c78b36382ad2c5d7b1023e7a14cb62d38.source: This quest requires killing exactly half of the bosses in Sorrow's Furnace.
6d190e1c78b36382ad2c5d7b1023e7a14cb62d38.text: 該任務需要殺死 悲傷熔爐 中一半的 Boss。

e93f1688426fbad1aec26ab7679990717b29ea71.source: Any bosses killed before you accept the quest are retroactively counted towards the objective, potentially allowing the reward to be claimed immediately.
e93f1688426fbad1aec26ab7679990717b29ea71.text: 在您接受任務之前殺死的任何 Boss 都會被追溯計入目標，從而有可能立即領取獎勵。

68afee9c45b87a20e0c79817cb4fef5d38328d09.source: If a boss is resurrected (e.g. by a Priest of Sorrows), killing him again will not affect the counter.
68afee9c45b87a20e0c79817cb4fef5d38328d09.text: 如果 Boss 復活（例如透過 哀傷祭司），再次殺死他不會影響計數器。

6827fd69fbfdb7b6267b0fcd75891370b7147a59.source: The northwestern boss can sometimes wander into the crushers, providing a free kill.
6827fd69fbfdb7b6267b0fcd75891370b7147a59.text: 西北首領有時會溜進粉碎機，提供免費殺戮。

82c3c6d38089b96b3ba8c18dcf22fe965190378a.source: Like many monk NPCs, Tharn can sometimes travel long distances with the party to provide healing, particularly if there is a minion master present. However, this may do more harm than good, since Tharn will also heal and cleanse conditions on enemies, including his supposed rivals.
82c3c6d38089b96b3ba8c18dcf22fe965190378a.text: 與許多僧侶 NPC 一樣，薩恩有時可以與隊伍一起長途跋涉來提供治療，特別是在有小兵大師在場的情況下。然而，這可能弊大於利，因為 Tharn 也會治癒和淨化敵人的狀況，包括他所謂的對手。

bb6f21f9afdb7761e684d76259388f495baf4f0e.source: This quest can easily be completed alongside Tasca's Reprise or Subversive Ideas, since both require exploring most of the dungeon.
bb6f21f9afdb7761e684d76259388f495baf4f0e.text: 這個任務可以很容易地與塔斯卡的重演或顛覆性想法一起完成，因為兩者都需要探索大部分地牢。

749b1258e896390a68e132d5fec68498c2ab497a.source: As with other quests offered inside Sorrow's Furnace, this quest is automatically abandoned if you leave the zone.
749b1258e896390a68e132d5fec68498c2ab497a.text: 與 悲傷熔爐 內提供的其他任務一樣，如果您離開該區域，此任務將自動放棄。

487cf2b7e7de1b124a4d585bb098a2cb94e8475a.source: Defeat Blarp in a game of Polymock at Gadd's Encampment.
487cf2b7e7de1b124a4d585bb098a2cb94e8475a.text: 在 蓋德營區 的 Polymock 遊戲中擊敗 Blarp。

4f53f7ac172c2cf4cc78e384d0983a6fc2908823.source: See Hoff [Polymock Master] for your reward.
4f53f7ac172c2cf4cc78e384d0983a6fc2908823.text: 請參閱 荷夫 [Polymock Master] 以取得獎勵。

8dfea048ff2a054975083aebf9bc94fc2e24ce1f.source: Blarp's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
8dfea048ff2a054975083aebf9bc94fc2e24ce1f.text: 布拉普的棋子及其獨特技能如下：

3b85cd85b39e9c20a2b0a28dffa54960ce3ee189.source: Earth Elemental: Polymock Stone Daggers, Polymock Obsidian Flame, Polymock Earthquake
3b85cd85b39e9c20a2b0a28dffa54960ce3ee189.text: 地球 元素生物：Polymock 石之匕首、Polymock 黑曜石火焰、Polymock 地震

7a0b9537f4a156037fa687e9b854aec3ed94052e.source: Ice Elemental: Polymock Ice Spear, Polymock Frozen Armor, Polymock Glyph Freeze
7a0b9537f4a156037fa687e9b854aec3ed94052e.text: 冰元素：Polymock 冰之矛、Polymock 結凍 防禦、Polymock 符號 凍結

aaf4025ae854eab2b79b2686beda244475597de0.source: Fire Elemental: Polymock Flare, Polymock Fireball, Polymock Rodgort's Invocation
aaf4025ae854eab2b79b2686beda244475597de0.text: 火 元素生物：Polymock 火花、Polymock 火球、Polymock 洛葛特的魔咒

4500d5142f93b2717c577bf35dfda08296ca4f9c.source: The following pieces are good counters:
4500d5142f93b2717c577bf35dfda08296ca4f9c.text: 以下棋子是很好的計數器：

27a91f8bbdeb257b83cfead5cfa416cef681b3dd.source: Kappa Polymock piece vs. Earth Elemental Polymock piece
27a91f8bbdeb257b83cfead5cfa416cef681b3dd.text: Kappa Polymock 作品與 Earth 元素生物 Polymock 作品對比

b10ef6e778589503b77a4ee81a6441b6640922b3.source: Fire Imp Polymock piece vs. Ice Elemental Polymock piece
b10ef6e778589503b77a4ee81a6441b6640922b3.text: 火焰小惡魔 Polymock 件與 冰元素 Polymock 件

4b7553066de5d40af5ef3c3ce4266252b2fd4dab.source: Skale Polymock piece vs. Fire Elemental Polymock piece
4b7553066de5d40af5ef3c3ce4266252b2fd4dab.text: 鱗怪 Polymock 件與 Fire 元素生物 Polymock 件

50f8b1f93f3acb40ed560be349cba9aa081fce09.source: Skale Polymock piece vs. Earth Elemental Polymock piece
50f8b1f93f3acb40ed560be349cba9aa081fce09.text: 鱗怪 Polymock 件與 Earth 元素生物 Polymock 件

38f902461870c90ef4b8bb1983704b6b1a1b1d8d.source: Gargoyle Polymock piece vs. Ice Elemental Polymock piece
38f902461870c90ef4b8bb1983704b6b1a1b1d8d.text: 石像鬼 Polymock 件與 冰元素 Polymock 件

7a3ad6a33a246933afb514da664af5171b1b9f19.source: Kappa Polymock piece vs. Fire Elemental Polymock piece
7a3ad6a33a246933afb514da664af5171b1b9f19.text: Kappa Polymock 件與 Fire 元素生物 Polymock 件

dd19992ae69373437c4a38533a7ebffd21619c93.source: Blarp can be quite difficult to defeat as he uses three Uncommon pieces (and you're likely to only have one, the Kappa). Be sure to Block/Drain the two most important skills of each piece. The latter is more powerful.
dd19992ae69373437c4a38533a7ebffd21619c93.text: 布拉普很難擊敗，因為他使用三件罕見棋子（而你很可能只有一件，河童）。確保阻止/耗盡每件作品中兩個最重要的技能。後者更強大。

12c6bf8f944c26c6bc46f0c4f189d246be3ec408.source: These are the skills to watch out for:
12c6bf8f944c26c6bc46f0c4f189d246be3ec408.text: 這些都是需要注意的技能：

dbdc652a24e6e79d69d0dcf4e72015914cbaea1e.source: Once you have the three starter pieces, you can do the quest chain which starts from Polymock: Defeat Yulma. The objective of a Polymock match is to kill all three of your opponent's pieces before they kill yours.
dbdc652a24e6e79d69d0dcf4e72015914cbaea1e.text: 一旦你擁有了三個起始件，你就可以完成從Polymock開始的任務鏈：擊敗Yulma。 Polymock 比賽的目標是在對手殺死你的棋子之前殺死對手的所有三個棋子。

c711153e89cc0adf06f5f71f6e577a4176ed9377.source: After defeating the designated opponent (i.e. completed the quest and accepted the reward), you can return to those you have defeated and challenge them to a match under tournament rules. The one difference is that you are required to choose your Polymock pieces from all three rarities (white, purple, gold). If you did not register at least one Polymock piece for each rarity, you cannot challenge opponents using tournament rules. Winning such Polymock matches will earn you from 40 to 90 Asuran reputation points, depending on who you challenged.
c711153e89cc0adf06f5f71f6e577a4176ed9377.text: 擊敗指定對手（即完成任務並接受獎勵）後，您可以回到已擊敗的對手並按照錦標賽規則挑戰他們。一個區別是，您需要從所有三種稀有品（白色、紫色、金色）中選擇您的 Polymock 作品。如果您沒有為每種稀有度註冊至少一件 Polymock 棋子，則無法使用錦標賽規則挑戰對手。贏得此類 Polymock 比賽將為您贏得從 40 到 90 阿蘇蘭聲望點，具體取決於您挑戰的物件。

8ffc4d4d664d5cec2e6b9a738363b89609f83f79.source: Polymock takes place in several special explorable areas, depending on which region the opponent is found in:
8ffc4d4d664d5cec2e6b9a738363b89609f83f79.text: Polymock 發生在幾個特殊的可探索區域，具體取決於對手所在的區域：

f7e7ce92b82c0a9d5ed7117263176143a8ee01cf.source: Polymock Coliseum in the Tarnished Coast.
f7e7ce92b82c0a9d5ed7117263176143a8ee01cf.text: 灰暗沿岸 中的 Polymock 體育館。

48c4f92aba54a19f187a10a69ad094cbcdc83696.source: Polymock Glacier in the Far Shiverpeaks.
48c4f92aba54a19f187a10a69ad094cbcdc83696.text: 北部席娃山脈 中的 Polymock 冰川。

c3524a4ecb7d51d3a8265adff28454fe32e6dd3c.source: Polymock Crossing in the Charr Homelands.
c3524a4ecb7d51d3a8265adff28454fe32e6dd3c.text: 夏爾家園區 中的 Polymock 交叉。

03de3c7d194fe4bc9c257cfe0aebc6bfbc160d7f.source: After completing all polymock quests, you must play by tournament rules. The game is played with 3 pieces of different rarities polymock. To play, you must have 1 common piece, 1 uncommon piece and 1 rare piece.
03de3c7d194fe4bc9c257cfe0aebc6bfbc160d7f.text: 完成所有 Polymock 任務後，您必須遵守錦標賽規則。遊戲使用 3 不同稀有度的模型進行。要玩，您必須擁有 1 普通棋子、1 不常見棋子和 1 稀有棋子。

600d2c4f0b4a2eec6a76b3474cb499a3f0012753.source: You win 90 Asuran reputation points for defeating Fonk, Volumandus, Teardrinker, Silverfist or Hoff, 80 points for defeating Blarp, 60 points for Plurgg and 40 points for Yulma.
600d2c4f0b4a2eec6a76b3474cb499a3f0012753.text: 您擊敗 Fonk、Volumandus、Teardrinker、Silverfist 或 荷夫 贏得 90 阿蘇蘭聲望點，透過擊敗 Blarp 贏得 80 點，為 Plurgg 贏得 60 點，為 Yulma 贏得 40 點。

6bae99416574d190a7d551b4f61534062a2e188b.text: 為了最大化阿蘇拉頭銜

f70f69ffb94445dda7299ae336e1aea16b9c3131.text: 1 贏得 90 積分。 1 比賽持續 5 分鐘。

53aee0d5edc34a9d47572809498f6ba8210eb803.source: It will take approximately 74 hours to reach tier 8 of the Asuran title if Asuran reputation points are gained exclusively using Polymock matches. No points are awarded past tier 8 therefore it is impossible to max the Asuran title by Polymock exclusively.
53aee0d5edc34a9d47572809498f6ba8210eb803.text: 如果僅使用 Polymock 比賽獲得阿蘇蘭聲望點數，則需要大約 74 小時才能達到阿蘇蘭頭銜的 8 級。超過 8 等級後不會獲得任何積分，因此無法透過 Polymock 獨家獲得阿蘇蘭頭銜。

80b8e12b478d4d41d15146a3e0c81709f9959abb.source: Talk to Wokk to choose the three Polymock pieces that you want to use. After selecting your three pieces, you are then asked to select which of the three to start with. You are allowed to examine your skill bar before each round begins. Note that the platforms your piece and your opponent's piece are standing on are close to each other and that it is impossible to move out of range (although strafing to dodge projectiles is possible). Your character is replaced by the Polymock piece that you have chosen. Any enchantments or summons you have are removed. Your weapon and armor bonuses do not apply to Polymock skills.
80b8e12b478d4d41d15146a3e0c81709f9959abb.text: 與 Wokk 交談以選擇您想要使用的三個 Polymock 部件。選擇三件作品後，系統會要求您選擇三件作品中的哪一件開始。您可以在每輪開始之前檢查您的技能欄。請注意，您的棋子和對手的棋子所站立的平臺彼此靠近，並且不可能移出範圍（儘管可以進行掃射以躲避射彈）。您的角色將被您選擇的 Polymock 棋子所取代。你擁有的任何結界或召喚都會被移除。你的武器和護甲加值不適用於 Polymock 技能。

cb0e9e13a403cd861515f81e994cd88c0c5ddb83.source: When you use a white (common) Polymock piece, your maximum health is 3000 and your energy is 30. Purple (uncommon) pieces give a maximum health of 4000 and a maximum energy of 35. Gold (rare) pieces give you 5000 maximum health and 40 energy.
cb0e9e13a403cd861515f81e994cd88c0c5ddb83.text: 當您使用白色（普通）Polymock 零件時，您的最大生命值是 3000，您的能量是 30。紫色（不常見）碎片可提供 4000 的最大生命值和 35 的最大能量。金（稀有）碎片為您提供 5000 最大生命值和 40 能量。

9a2e43715f0d74d1dc768e0243d3eeaa953867ce.source: Skill use and effects during the match are similar to normal PvE, the only difference being conditions like Burning, Bleeding, and Disease always cause full -10 health degeneration.
9a2e43715f0d74d1dc768e0243d3eeaa953867ce.text: 技能 在比賽中的使用和效果與正常 PvE 類似，唯一的區別是燃燒、流血 和疾病等條件總是會導致 -10 健康狀況完全退化。

5873798ab75fd53ae1eda028d83f606fc4484cc2.source: When you are done reviewing your skills, you can tell Wokk to start the match. A 10-second countdown timer will begin, counting down to the start of the duel, at which point the opponent's Polymock piece turns hostile.
5873798ab75fd53ae1eda028d83f606fc4484cc2.text: 當你回顧完你的技能後，你可以告訴 Wokk 開始比賽。 10 秒倒數計時器將開始，倒數計時直到決鬥開始，此時對手的 Polymock 棋子將轉為敵對。

5043574b282b55e08b65df2b078af248e0eb6658.source: A round ends when one or both Polymock pieces loses all health. The loser is required to select another Polymock piece from the remaining two to start the next round. The winner retains its current level of health and energy, and all skills continue their recharge duration (i.e. the skills are not automatically recharged). Once the loser selects the next piece and starts the next round, the 10-second countdown will start again. If your opponent (i.e. the NPC) lost the previous round, the countdown timer starts almost immediately, since the winner is not prompted to start the next round.
5043574b282b55e08b65df2b078af248e0eb6658.text: 當一個或兩個 Polymock 棋子失去所有生命值時，一輪結束。失敗者需要從剩餘的兩塊 Polymock 中選擇另一塊來開始下一輪。獲勝者保留當前的生命值和能量水平，並且所有技能都會繼續其充能持續時間（即技能不會自動充能）。一旦失敗者選擇下一個棋子並開始下一輪，10 秒倒數計時將再次開始。如果你的對手（即 NPC）輸掉了上一輪，倒數計時器幾乎立即開始，因為獲勝者不會被提示開始下一輪。

658a0a5b0c5e5ed04e1110ee6dcbc0bbcf2e5864.source: This continues until one side's three Polymock pieces have all been defeated. Win or lose, you will be returned to the previous location.
658a0a5b0c5e5ed04e1110ee6dcbc0bbcf2e5864.text: 這樣一直持續到一方的三塊 Polymock 棋子全部被擊敗為止。無論輸贏，您都將回到先前的位置。

0eb517ce497d33a128bf6ab98f066194ba79e8f2.source: A good opening piece when you still need to use common pieces is the Skale because it does 150 damage with its spammable attack to enemies > 50% health and has two damage skills, both of which do a great deal of damage but take time to activate and thus benefit from facing a healthy opponent.
0eb517ce497d33a128bf6ab98f066194ba79e8f2.text: 當你仍然需要使用普通棋子時，一個很好的開局棋子是鱗怪，因為它通過對敵人> 50%生命值的垃圾郵件攻擊造成150傷害，並且有兩種傷害技能，這兩種技能都會造成很大的傷害，但需要時間來啟用，因此從面對健康的對手中受益。

8c973e2b36c7fc4c9312e9f1bfff366689dc1d76.source: When the opponent begins a round with a new piece, they will always start off with Polymock Glyph of Concentration, followed by either their most damaging spell or sometimes the light damage spell. This can be taken advantage of by using your 2-second spells right from the start. Even if your opponent attempts Polymock Power Drain after the glyph, you will almost always get your spell off. Using the 2-second spell here risks taking their high damage spell without being able to get Polymock Block off in time, so using your 1-second spell then Blocking instead may be preferred. Be careful to wait at least 30 seconds for your opponent's skills to recharge before beginning with your new piece so they will have the Polymock Glyph of Concentration available, otherwise they'll start the round in an unpredictable manner.
8c973e2b36c7fc4c9312e9f1bfff366689dc1d76.text: 當對手以新棋子開始一輪時，他們總是會以 Polymock 專注符號 開始，然後是他們最具傷害性的咒語，有時是輕傷害咒語。可以透過從一開始就使用 2 秒法術來利用這一點。即使你的對手在字形之後嘗試 Polymock 強力吸收，你幾乎總是會擺脫你的咒語。在這裡使用 2 秒法術會冒著承受高傷害法術而無法及時關閉 Polymock 的風險，因此使用 1 秒法術然後進行格擋可能是首選。在開始使用新棋子之前，請小心等待至少 30 秒，以便對手的技能恢復，這樣他們就可以使用 Polymock 專注符號，否則他們將以不可預測的方式開始回合。

319dc1a631d02331f1925639cf230e9f0a44db84.source: Always watch your health and energy levels. When you're below 50% health, do not neglect the bonus damage offered by Polymock Glyph of Power. But do not activate it blindly, as the enemy will Polymock Power Drain your attempts to use the Glyph. Be aware of whether you have enough energy to pull it off, because the Glyph works very well with your spammable skill.
319dc1a631d02331f1925639cf230e9f0a44db84.text: 時刻關注您的健康和精力水平。當您的生命值低於 50% 時，請不要忽視 Polymock 符號 of Power 提供的額外傷害。但不要盲目啟動它，因為敵人會使用 Polymock 強力吸收 您嘗試使用 符號。請注意您是否有足夠的精力來完成它，因為 符號 非常適合您的垃圾郵件技能。

b2fc68f9285a23dde01334b9611f48e006a2b465.source: Do not forget to use Polymock Ether Signet the moment you reach zero energy. Trying to cast spells without energy wastes valuable time. If you or your opponent is weak, don't hesitate to waste a Polymock Power Drain or Polymock Block to use up your energy so that you can use the Ether Signet and hit them with a higher damage ability.
b2fc68f9285a23dde01334b9611f48e006a2b465.text: 當您達到零能量時，請不要忘記使用 Polymock 精神紋章。嘗試在沒有能量的情況下施展法術會浪費寶貴的時間。如果你或你的對手很弱，不要猶豫，浪費一個Polymock 強力吸收或Polymock Block來消耗你的能量，這樣你就可以使用精神紋章並以更高的傷害能力擊中他們。

c39ff8eb35e7aa440dbd989c238779d5e372a5c0.source: Try to use Polymock Power Drain and Polymock Block wisely. Try to save them for highly damaging spells and time their recharge. Polymock Glyph of Power is a good interrupt target as well. Be aware of what type of spells can be blocked and what type can be interrupted but not blocked.
c39ff8eb35e7aa440dbd989c238779d5e372a5c0.text: 嘗試明智地使用 Polymock 強力吸收 和 Polymock Block。盡量讓它們免受高傷害法術的傷害，並安排好它們的充電時間。 Power 的 Polymock 符號 也是一個很好的中斷目標。注意什麼型別的法術可以被格擋，什麼型別的法術可以被打斷但不能格擋。

95e42f253fc6d1546bafd8591e6ca2fa3e61562a.source: Polymock Block can be used as an alternative to Polymock Glyph of Concentration if you use a 1 second spell right after it. Frequently the enemy won't react right away after having a spell blocked, giving plenty of time for your spell to complete. They will often be able to interrupt a 2 second spell after being blocked though, but if you can use the block while they're not casting then it will work for longer spells as well. If you have neither available, you can also slip a 1 second spell in right as the enemy is activating one of their spammable attacks to get it through uninterrupted.
95e42f253fc6d1546bafd8591e6ca2fa3e61562a.text: 如果您在 Polymock 專注符號 之後使用 1 第二個咒語，則 Polymock Block 可以用作 Polymock 專注符號 的替代品。通常，敵人在法術被阻擋後不會立即做出反應，從而為你的法術提供充足的時間來完成。他們通常能夠在被阻擋後打斷 2 第二個法術，但如果你可以在他們不施法時使用阻擋，那麼它也適用於更長的法術。如果你兩者都沒有，你也可以在敵人啟動其垃圾郵件攻擊之一時，在右側插入 1 第二個咒語，以使其不間斷地通過。

5274ac5d58492cfe4e5125bdbf290ce4073ab7a9.source: The following opponents are listed in the order the quest chain introduces them:
5274ac5d58492cfe4e5125bdbf290ce4073ab7a9.text: 以下對手依照任務鏈介紹的順序列出：

06c6fc692d344c650e8d30b84915173a807dfef7.source: Yulma (1) - uses the three starter pieces - see Polymock: Defeat Yulma
06c6fc692d344c650e8d30b84915173a807dfef7.text: Yulma (1) - 使用三個起始件 - 請參閱 Polymock：擊敗 Yulma

640cc6b127e198e25bef844f93ff6e7be10cc540.source: Plurgg (2) - uses Fire Imp, Ice Imp, and Kappa - see Polymock: Defeat Plurgg
640cc6b127e198e25bef844f93ff6e7be10cc540.text: Plurgg (2) - 使用 火焰小惡魔、冰小惡魔 和 Kappa - 請參閱 Polymock：擊敗 Plurgg

4f67ee673cbca46b8be335d08d6fc8c014f0b381.source: Blarp (3) - uses Earth Elemental, Ice Elemental, and Fire Elemental - see Polymock: Defeat Blarp
4f67ee673cbca46b8be335d08d6fc8c014f0b381.text: Blarp (3) - 使用地球 元素生物、冰元素 和火 元素生物 - 請參閱 Polymock：擊敗 Blarp

891f372b72733c40596a18212c828380d086d025.source: Fonk (4) - uses Kappa, Aloe, and Wind Rider - see Polymock: Defeat Fonk
891f372b72733c40596a18212c828380d086d025.text: Fonk (4) - 使用 Kappa、Aloe 和 馭風者 - 請參閱 Polymock：擊敗 Fonk

40921c14fbf42980d95e58228cb32809f6b52798.source: Dune Teardrinker (5a) - uses Charr Shaman, Charr Flamecaller, Titan - see Polymock: Defeat Dune Teardrinker
40921c14fbf42980d95e58228cb32809f6b52798.text: 沙丘飲淚者 (5a) - 使用 夏爾巫醫、夏爾 喚火者、泰坦 - 請參閱 戰鬥仿旗:擊敗飲淚 度

249825e3bdc7702004d6cb26075bc3f01e088b6f.source: Grulhammer Silverfist (5b) - uses Dredge, Dolyak, Dwarf - see Polymock: Defeat Grulhammer Silverfist
249825e3bdc7702004d6cb26075bc3f01e088b6f.text: Grulhammer Silverfist (5b) - 使用 挖掘者、Dolyak、矮人 - 請參閱 戰鬥仿旗:擊敗銀拳果漢姆

94fa43c6d35de6fdde62e197f0f25a04139626f8.source: Necromancer Volumandus (5c) - uses Skeleton, Wraith, Dragon - see Polymock: Defeat Necromancer Volumandus
94fa43c6d35de6fdde62e197f0f25a04139626f8.text: 死靈法師 Volumandus (5c) - 使用 骷髏、Wraith、Dragon - 請參閱 戰鬥仿旗:擊敗死靈法師 沃倫曼多斯

c47b7264d3239aa88dcea4a90fe66d783aca4102.source: Hoff (8) - uses random pieces - see Polymock: Defeat Master Hoff
c47b7264d3239aa88dcea4a90fe66d783aca4102.text: 荷夫 (8) - 使用隨機片段 - 請參閱 戰鬥仿旗:擊敗荷夫大師

7163c00d159408d2f3506f1a19fd00992c15ac58.source: Begin the fight with your highest damage 1 second cast spell. This will hit your enemy while they are using their Polymock Glyph of Concentration. Optionally, if you cast your other high-priority spell right in the beginning, your opponent will not be able to interrupt it.
7163c00d159408d2f3506f1a19fd00992c15ac58.text: 以你的最高傷害 1 第二次施放法術開始戰鬥。當你的敵人使用 Polymock 專注符號 時，這會擊中他們。或者，如果你一開始就施展其他高優先順序法術，你的對手將無法打斷它。

4f10c19f6f717dba013c267ed534a15897a13bdf.source: Use Polymock Block to interrupt your enemy's high powered spell.
4f10c19f6f717dba013c267ed534a15897a13bdf.text: 使用 Polymock Block 打斷敵人的高能量法術。

4b77c2e2f7476977150f00677c009a5ff85ebb9d.source: Use Polymock Glyph of Concentration followed by your other high-priority spell.
4b77c2e2f7476977150f00677c009a5ff85ebb9d.text: 使用 Polymock 專注符號，然後使用其他高優先權咒語。

2e6dbea93f363f7fa5f6737e5cf07673d6dc7fc8.source: Be ready to interrupt their 2 second cast or other high damage spell which is almost always used soon after.
2e6dbea93f363f7fa5f6737e5cf07673d6dc7fc8.text: 準備好打斷他們的 2 第二次施法或其他高傷害法術，這些法術幾乎總是在不久後使用。

fd9fdec3c07fa16e053ac86af9c2bc82baba2cc5.source: Use Polymock Block instantly and start casting your 2-second spell. Usually, when the enemy finishes Concentration and tries to interrupt you, the Block will still be in effect.
fd9fdec3c07fa16e053ac86af9c2bc82baba2cc5.text: 立即使用 Polymock Block 並開始施放 2 秒法術。通常，當敵人完成集中並試圖打斷你時，格擋仍然有效。

17cac41ec53626398c702861b262cf1793f2b2a9.source: Use Polymock Power Drain to interrupt their high-powered spell which they generally try to cast now, but whose Concentration effect was wasted on trying to interrupt you.
17cac41ec53626398c702861b262cf1793f2b2a9.text: 使用 Polymock 強力吸收 打斷他們現在通常會嘗試施放的高能法術，但其集中效果在試圖打斷你時被浪費了。

a89946b2d1dcf6eeebbf88c111e2cc67772215ee.source: Use Polymock Glyph of Concentration followed by your highest damage spell.
a89946b2d1dcf6eeebbf88c111e2cc67772215ee.text: 使用 Polymock 專注符號，然後使用最高傷害法術。

376da03efd1bbda81a080e9cf9e851e99cfa005e.source: After opening with one of the above two starting attack chains, spam your primary low-damage spell continuously. It breaks the opponent's Block rapidly, and it delivers continual damage while you wait for skills to recycle, targets to interrupt, or while you think of tactics or are moving your mouse with the other hand. It is a very important default action requiring no thought.
376da03efd1bbda81a080e9cf9e851e99cfa005e.text: 使用上述兩個起始攻擊鏈之一開啟後，連續向你的主要低傷害法術傳送垃圾郵件。它能快速打破對手的格擋，並在你等待技能回收、目標打斷、思考戰術或用另一隻手移動滑鼠時持續造成傷害。這是一個非常重要的預設操作，無需思考。

c1283f05924f6ebbf4c9223d012579d684974843.source: While spamming and attacking with other spells, use the fast Polymock Block and Polymock Power Drain between them.
c1283f05924f6ebbf4c9223d012579d684974843.text: 在使用其他法術進行垃圾郵件和攻擊時，請在它們之間使用快速 Polymock Block 和 Polymock 強力吸收。

1a98cbaf78527cf65cbeb0a89afad8c9ce939cef.source: Cast Polymock Block whenever it is ready for use. Because of its fast cycle time (12s), don't delay using it, except when a high-damage spell will be ready for casting soon and Polymock Glyph of Concentration is not yet available.
1a98cbaf78527cf65cbeb0a89afad8c9ce939cef.text: 只要準備好使用，就鑄造 Polymock 塊。由於其快速迴圈時間（12），請不要延遲使用它，除非高傷害法術即將準備好施放並且 Polymock 專注符號 尚未可用。

1c6cefadebc3e939627afa227ae447f5cd487e72.source: Cast Polymock Power Drain tactically, don't waste it. Hover your mouse over the skill while you wait for something good to interrupt, meanwhile spamming away with your primary low-damage spell and casting Polymock Block periodically.
1c6cefadebc3e939627afa227ae447f5cd487e72.text: 戰術上施放 Polymock 強力吸收，不要浪費它。將滑鼠懸停在技能上，等待有好東西打斷，同時使用主要的低傷害法術並定期施放Polymock Block。

875c16e31211c6f7c14ec62d0696818d72be1f52.source: Always use Polymock Glyph of Concentration before casting your high-damage spell to reduce the chance of it being wasted.
875c16e31211c6f7c14ec62d0696818d72be1f52.text: 在施放高傷害法術之前，請務必使用 Polymock 專注符號，以減少浪費的機會。

Sometimes the Titan Polymock piece uses Polymock Savannah Heat as a last attack just before you hit him with the final attack that will make you win. The result of this is, you defeat him, but then die because of the Polymock Savannah Heat and you must go back to the outpost. You also then have to defeat him again.

c3edf88c69646bed8b992c37f84d2d7bb7302ff1.source: Polymock Immolate and Polymock Ice Shard Storm deal considerable damage, however they are slow casting, making them easy to block or interrupt. As long as you interrupt them and prevent your own damage skills from being interrupted with Polymock Block, Polymock Glyph of Concentration and timing, you should have no problem. If you hit them first with a high damage dealing throw then block, then do a concentration block then a long term affliction, you should win.
c3edf88c69646bed8b992c37f84d2d7bb7302ff1.text: Polymock 火焰焚身 和 Polymock Ice 冰風暴 會造成相當大的傷害，但它們的施法速度很慢，很容易被阻擋或打斷。只要你用Polymock Block、Polymock 專注符號和時機打斷它們並防止自己的傷害技能被打斷，應該沒有問題。如果你先用高傷害造成的投擲擊中他們，然後進行格擋，然後進行集中格擋，然後進行長期痛苦，你應該獲勝。

A registered Polymock piece will be removed from your inventory and your character (and only that character) will be able to use this piece in any Polymock game. Once you have three pieces registered (if you don't have additional pieces from dungeon rewards), talk to Yulma to challenge her.
48d0dc8d5b45e4ce3a4abdd2a09717c11d02f0c8.text: 荷夫 將提供您三個 Polymock 入門元件：石像鬼、石像魔 和 鱗怪。將它們放入您的庫存中後，與 Denn 交談以將它們一一註冊。註冊的 Polymock 零件將​​從您的庫存中刪除，您的角色（並且只有該角色）將能夠在任何 Polymock 遊戲中使用該零件。一旦您註冊了三件作品（如果您沒有來自地牢獎勵的額外作品），請與尤爾瑪交談以挑戰她。

14b8070701f2bd7e92ddbf6b332d83dbeac34700.source: Yulma's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
14b8070701f2bd7e92ddbf6b332d83dbeac34700.text: 尤爾瑪的棋子及其獨特技能如下：

918c98858ca23e26802020e8dc95f1c677a96dec.source: Gargoyle: Polymock Lightning Strike, Polymock Lightning Orb, Polymock Lightning Djinn's Haste
918c98858ca23e26802020e8dc95f1c677a96dec.text: 石像鬼：Polymock 閃電衝擊、Polymock 閃電球、Polymock Lightning 巨靈怪 的急速

013d3b8621fb755ca9817e914d80779779b70d16.source: Skale: Polymock Deathly Chill, Polymock Rising Bile, Polymock Rotting Flesh
013d3b8621fb755ca9817e914d80779779b70d16.text: 鱗怪：Polymock 致命嚴寒、Polymock 憤怒高漲、Polymock 肉體腐爛

603361bdaa47a43750b4faa73538188cc86809bc.source: Mergoyle: Polymock Overload, Polymock Glyph Destabilization, Polymock Mind Wreck
603361bdaa47a43750b4faa73538188cc86809bc.text: 石像魔：Polymock 超載、Polymock 符號 不穩定、Polymock 精神崩潰

2f6e108cbd61a0e3bc5593a673b1da66fc5231c4.source: Yulma is fairly easy to beat. You can freely use any of the pieces you have against her in any order, although leaving the Gargoyle piece for last might be a good idea as it's your most damaging piece and you can use it to regain ground if you've lost your first two pieces.
2f6e108cbd61a0e3bc5593a673b1da66fc5231c4.text: 尤爾瑪相當容易被擊敗。你可以以任何順序自由地使用你擁有的任何棋子來對抗她，儘管將 石像鬼 棋子留在最後可能是一個好主意，因為它是你最具破壞性的棋子，如果你失去了前兩個棋子，你可以用它來收復失地。

aa9694ee5eefd1e1bfbf7336512f4f60a28fa29c.source: Yulma can be a bit disconcerting to fight because she sometimes uses skills in odd combinations (such as using Glyph of Concentration and then Blocking, for example), and has frequent pauses in between using skills. This can make her somewhat difficult to predict (and therefore interrupt/block). In general, a good offense is the best way to deal with Yulma; it is possible to simply spam your offensive skills at her until she loses.
aa9694ee5eefd1e1bfbf7336512f4f60a28fa29c.text: 尤爾瑪在戰鬥中可能會有點令人不安，因為她有時會以奇怪的組合使用技能（例如使用 專注符號，然後使用格擋），並且在使用技能之間經常停頓。這可能會使她有點難以預測（因此會中斷/阻止）。一般來說，良好的進攻是對付尤爾瑪的最佳方法；您可以簡單地向她傳送進攻技巧，直到她輸掉。

5575b50b52af349991cb9ede5e3e744e3bd00bb8.source: Clear Pongmei Valley near Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
5575b50b52af349991cb9ede5e3e744e3bd00bb8.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人 凱寧城 附近的 朋美谷。

526b6b6ef3af7e14a911febd7757ec909962fef1.source: "Clear Pongmei Valley near Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode."
526b6b6ef3af7e14a911febd7757ec909962fef1.text: “在困難模式下清除 凱寧城 附近所有敵人的 朋美谷。”

fc4bf7fc97d4abc9298caa5bc06a04dfdaff47e9.source: The Count's Daughter quest will lead characters through here. The first time characters enter here will be from Maatu Keep or Sunjiang District.
fc4bf7fc97d4abc9298caa5bc06a04dfdaff47e9.text: 伯爵的女兒任務將引導角色穿過這裡。首次輸入此處的字元將來自 麻都堡壘 或 孫江行政區。

ba1947d04d78356a6848b41c4f1f4d7b07e234b3.source: The Convocation (Both Master Togo and Headmaster Greico will travel with you, but only the former will fight, while the latter won't and will body block allies.)
ba1947d04d78356a6848b41c4f1f4d7b07e234b3.text: 集會（藤吾大師 和校長 Greico 都會和你一起旅行，但只有前者會戰鬥，而後者不會，並且會用身體阻止盟友。）

473bb3df9f629a3c4678728c7b5d50f1f65137f6.source: The Yeti in this area charm the elder pets when you get into compass range. If you stay out of compass range and let heroes and henchmen kill the Yeti, you can tame an Elder Crane or Tiger.
473bb3df9f629a3c4678728c7b5d50f1f65137f6.text: 當您進入指南針範圍時，該區域的雪人會吸引年長的寵物。如果你遠離指南針範圍並讓英雄和追隨者殺死雪人，你可以馴服老鶴或老虎。

e16713c0b53217b5505921d13ee27e8a299835ea.source: As you approach Xuekao, the Deceptive, use caution to avoid getting surrounded. Groups of Am Fah and Jade Brotherhood will spawn and fight each other; you can either join the brawl or let them fight it out and dispose of what remains.
e16713c0b53217b5505921d13ee27e8a299835ea.text: 當你接近欺騙者雪考時，要小心避免被包圍。 安費 和 翡翠兄弟會 會產生並互相戰鬥；你可以加入爭吵，也可以讓他們決一死戰並處理掉剩下的東西。

75247a1d0caa74ff482f9616182aecfba33ca4b0.source: Foes that only appear in Echovald Forest (e.g. Stone Scale Kirins) or the Jade Sea (e.g. Yeti) with the exception of Pongmei Valley will drop:
75247a1d0caa74ff482f9616182aecfba33ca4b0.text: 僅出現在 科凡德森林（如石鱗麒麟）或 碧玉海（如雪人）（朋美谷 除外）的敵人將會掉落：

203f07ef13978de82809a175f735da90c1eb0907.source: Kurzick Keys or Luxon Keys in normal mode, respectively, even though only Canthan Chests spawn in this area.
203f07ef13978de82809a175f735da90c1eb0907.text: 分別為正常模式的 庫茲柯 鍵或 勒克森 鍵，即使該區域僅產生 Canthan 寶箱。

f2b45b7430f7974bebd248ed4e8afc9d52a55fde.source: Weapons that typically only drop in Echovald Forest (e.g. Amber weapons) or the Jade Sea (e.g. Jade weapons), respectively.
f2b45b7430f7974bebd248ed4e8afc9d52a55fde.text: 通常只分別在 科凡德森林（例如 硬玉 武器）或 碧玉海（例如玉武器）中掉落的武器。

495a7b3f7eca1a2088296874e65c7cb2960df552.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.58% to the Canthan Cartographer title.
495a7b3f7eca1a2088296874e65c7cb2960df552.text: 對這一領域的完整探索為 Canthan 版圖 標題做出了大約 2.58% 的貢獻。

c2784931d55980fdaf9d7e77cd3087b2ca187d41.source: You will not gain a faction bonus for vanquishing this area. However, you can acquire blessings to gain points while killing foes from the Luxon Priest near Boreas Seabed or the Luxon/Kurzick Priest near Tanglewood Copse.
c2784931d55980fdaf9d7e77cd3087b2ca187d41.text: 征服該區域不會獲得 陣營值 獎勵。但是，您可以在殺死北風之神海底附近的 勒克森 牧師或 譚格塢樹林 附近的 勒克森/庫茲柯 牧師的敵人時獲得祝福並獲得積分。

dcfa755ee9dcb119a5e11fc05aad8b3ecdfd7a5b.source: You can skip fighting Meynsang the Sadistic by avoiding his spawn point.
dcfa755ee9dcb119a5e11fc05aad8b3ecdfd7a5b.text: 你可以透過避開施虐狂梅恩桑的重生點來跳過與他的戰鬥。

b9505a7dfc3d06edaa80e7295b71549517f820d9.source: When your energy is at 5 or below, focus almost exclusively on getting it to zero fast so that Polymock Ether Signet can be used. If you're down to energy 6 but your 6-energy high-damage spell is not yet available, forget it, focus on losing all your energy. Your main spam skill (cost 1e), Polymock Glyph of Power (1e) and Polymock Block (2e) are best for shedding your energy. Polymock Power Drain (3e) could be used, but it is such an important skill that it is best left for its primary role of interrupting tactically.
b9505a7dfc3d06edaa80e7295b71549517f820d9.text: 當你的能量處於 5 或以下，幾乎完全專注於快速歸零，以便 Polymock 精神紋章 可以使用。如果你精力不足 6 但你的 6 - 能量高傷害法術還沒有，算了，集中精力消耗掉你所有的能量。您主要的垃圾郵件技能（成本 1 e)、Polymock 符號 功率（ 1 e) 和 Polymock 區塊 ( 2 e) 最適合釋放你的能量。多莫克 強力吸收 （ 3 e) 可以使用，但這是一項非常重要的技能，最好保留它的主要作用是戰術上的打斷。

9a6f93e1c0c8b5d548bccdda5cc3df0a1d858d9b.source: Throughout all of the above, always use Polymock Glyph of Power if you are under 50% health. By adding 200 damage, it makes your primary low-damage spell a real powerhouse, and should be used at every opportunity.
9a6f93e1c0c8b5d548bccdda5cc3df0a1d858d9b.text: 在上述所有內容中，如果您處於 50% 健康狀況，請務必使用 Polymock 符號 of Power。透過增加 200 傷害，它使你的主要低傷害法術成為真正的強大法術，應該抓住每一個機會使用。

b83751c9d64ffbc3936754a97bfec2b89f233c4e.source: Using the above strategy, all the main quest opponents can be defeated very easily and almost automatically.
b83751c9d64ffbc3936754a97bfec2b89f233c4e.text: 使用上述策略，所有主線任務對手都可以非常輕鬆且幾乎自動擊敗。

3dfbb69d887076b04eb2c073d10a4e2453e8bcfa.source: You can map travel out to abandon a match. This makes it faster to restart a match if it goes badly or if you've made a mistake selecting your pieces. Using /resign will let you teleport to the outpost without having to locate it on the world map.
