3dfbb69d887076b04eb2c073d10a4e2453e8bcfa.text: 您可以計劃外出旅行以放棄比賽。如果比賽進展不佳或您選擇棋子時出現錯誤，這可以更快地重新開始比賽。使用 /resign 可以讓你傳送到前哨站，而無需在世界地圖上找到它。

4ecc0f9b087cdeb6411e8b8d1017bc796e6c09b8.source: Survivors beware that losing all three battles will on rare occasion count as a death.
4ecc0f9b087cdeb6411e8b8d1017bc796e6c09b8.text: 倖存者要注意，在極少數情況下，輸掉所有三場戰鬥將被視為死亡。

82772e537aa92344dee3a0903590a9977f65f151.source: When you are outside of your Polymock piece, you will be subject to all active Polymock effects. For example, if the match has ended and a projectile is already mid flight, it will still deal damage to you once it hits. Another example is an area damage over time skill such as Polymock Savannah Heat. Because of the high amounts of Polymock skill damage (most Polymock skills deal over 500 damage), you will die but you will be resurrected instantly without any animation. You might not notice your death mid-match, even if you actually defeat your opponent in the Polymock battle.
82772e537aa92344dee3a0903590a9977f65f151.text: 當您處於 Polymock 作品之外時，您將受到所有活動 Polymock 效果的影響。例如，如果比賽已經結束並且彈體已經在飛行中，那麼它一旦擊中仍然會對您造成傷害。另一個例子是隨時間推移造成區域傷害的技能，例如 Polymock 燎原之火。由於 Polymock 技能傷害很高（大多數 Polymock 技能造成的傷害超過 500 傷害），你會死，但會立即復活，沒有任何動畫。即使您實際上在 Polymock 戰鬥中擊敗了對手，您可能不會在比賽中註意到自己的死亡。

84870c0a32656f486626a084f6dae3d1a56f34d3.source: After defeating an opponent Polymock piece, there's a short time window that allows you to activate another skill with an activation time of 1 second or less, such as Polymock Glyph of Power.
84870c0a32656f486626a084f6dae3d1a56f34d3.text: 擊敗對手 Polymock 棋子後，有一個很短的時間視窗，可讓您啟動另一個技能，其啟動時間為 1 秒或更短，例如 Polymock 符號 of Power。

9290471059d4db4d7d6c4158e3d219d9a549e215.source: To make future runs easier, avoid registering the Ice Elemental, Aloe Seed, and Mirage Iboga pieces as you get them, and just complete the quest sequence with the Earth Elemental, Fire Elemental, and Kappa. Then pass the three unregistered pieces off to new characters that need to go through, and return them after completion. Note that this will prevent you from participating in Tournament Mode until you register a Rare piece.
9290471059d4db4d7d6c4158e3d219d9a549e215.text: 為了讓以後的運作更容易，請避免在獲得 冰元素、蘆薈種子 和 幻象伊波枷 時註冊它們，只需使用地球 元素生物、火 元素生物 和河童完成任務序列。然後將未註冊的三塊交給需要經過的新角色，完成後歸還。請注意，這將阻止您參與 錦標賽 模式，直到您註冊了稀有零件。

29656732c3d08ce676a2561111feec7d52a68769.source: Defeat Dune Teardrinker in a game of Polymock at Doomlore Shrine.
29656732c3d08ce676a2561111feec7d52a68769.text: 在 末日傳說神殿 的 Polymock 遊戲中擊敗 Dune Teadrinker。

22000c9aa4eb0d7cbad7eddffa160e0c162abd8a.source: Dune Teardrinker's pieces and their unique skills are as follows:
22000c9aa4eb0d7cbad7eddffa160e0c162abd8a.text: 沙丘飲淚者的棋子及其獨特技能如下：

256648f646659c2041eda726be9480d0e208afb2.source: Charr Shaman: Polymock Smite, Polymock Piercing Light Spear, Polymock Signet of Smiting
256648f646659c2041eda726be9480d0e208afb2.text: 夏爾巫醫：Smiting的Polymock 懲戒、Polymock穿刺燈矛、Polymock 紋章

d3a3075b5953eb61ab062832cbdd8d6856780149.source: Charr Flamecaller: Polymock Flare, Polymock Fireball, Polymock Mind Blast
d3a3075b5953eb61ab062832cbdd8d6856780149.text: 夏爾 喚火者：Polymock 火花、Polymock 火球、Polymock 心靈轟擊

5c9fdcaed55ce6204cff6818a1e5c727593d0e52.source: Titan: Polymock Flare, Polymock Savannah Heat, Polymock Rodgort's Invocation
5c9fdcaed55ce6204cff6818a1e5c727593d0e52.text: 泰坦：Polymock 火花、Polymock 燎原之火、Polymock 洛葛特的魔咒

b70654494237d6324614e9a12f1b56f63b2bcc7e.source: Use the Earth Elemental against the Charr Shaman.
b70654494237d6324614e9a12f1b56f63b2bcc7e.text: 使用地球 元素生物 對抗 夏爾巫醫。

441119d376a11adaf94f9224a1151adbacb15345.source: Use the Fire Elemental or Fire Imp against the Charr Flamecaller.
441119d376a11adaf94f9224a1151adbacb15345.text: 使用火力 元素生物 或 火焰小惡魔 對抗 夏爾 烈焰召喚者。

7b0e87cc1d9d53c1c569248b114483fa93997a52.source: Use the Kappa against the Titan.
7b0e87cc1d9d53c1c569248b114483fa93997a52.text: 使用 Kappa 對抗 泰坦。

7353ed9f55d27c70c7c3deb39c87e74e319e1329.source: Fire Elemental: Fireball (800 damage, 6energy, 1activation, 20recharge), Rodgort's Invocation (200 damage, 10 degeneration for 15 seconds, 2energy, 2activation, 20recharge)
7353ed9f55d27c70c7c3deb39c87e74e319e1329.text: 火 元素生物 : 火球 （ 800 損壞， 6 能源， 1 啟用， 20 儲值）， 洛葛特的魔咒 （ 200 損壞， 10 退化為 15 秒， 2 能源， 2 啟用， 20 儲值）

626e3f9d9b51da24027c00678bce9660b4441e35.source: Keep in mind that by strafing (walking from side to side) you can avoid getting hit by projectiles such as Polymock Stone Daggers, Ice Spear, Flare and Fireball.
626e3f9d9b51da24027c00678bce9660b4441e35.text: 請記住，透過掃射（從一側走到另一側），您可以避免被 Polymock 石之匕首、冰之矛、火花 和 火球 等射彈擊中。

30033db966e89e815b69ecb0141510952df181ad.source: Before you can participate in Polymock matches, you must first obtain three starter pieces from Hoff in Rata Sum and then register them with Denn. Each registration removes the Polymock piece from your inventory and is permanently tied to your character (as opposed to your account). Do not register the piece if you plan on trading it to another character.
30033db966e89e815b69ecb0141510952df181ad.text: 在參加 Polymock 比賽之前，您必須先從 洛達頂點 中的 荷夫 取得三個起始棋子，然後向 Denn 註冊。每次註冊都會從您的庫存中刪除 Polymock 零件，並永久繫結到您的角色（而不是您的帳戶）。如果您打算將其交易給其他角色，請不要註冊該零件。

9c00f59e944f4ae2d535affd18a23754a5757cf8.source: If you trigger the Jade Brotherhood and Am Fah groups near Xuekao, the Deceptive, but leave the area without fighting them, it can save ~14 kills. This is easiest done by flagging a hero while most of the party stays near compass range.
9c00f59e944f4ae2d535affd18a23754a5757cf8.text: 如果你在欺騙者雪考附近觸發 翡翠兄弟會 和 安費 小組，但離開該區域而不與他們戰鬥，它可以節省 ~14 殺戮。最簡單的方法是在大部分隊伍都在指南針範圍內時標記英雄。

a2be210e48091a40d988ccb28c480a67f3288547.source: Some Canthan Guards will fight the enemies on the map, and get killed by them.
a2be210e48091a40d988ccb28c480a67f3288547.text: 有些凱珊守衛會與地圖上的敵人戰鬥，並被他們殺死。

b6cc64b9a4833405ad3ae78220ac0d85947b8591.source: Follow the road southwest from town to Ashford. Find Miller Upton and ask him to help Namar.
b6cc64b9a4833405ad3ae78220ac0d85947b8591.text: 沿著從城鎮向西南方向行駛的道路前往阿什福德。找米勒厄普頓並請他幫忙 納瑪爾。

3cd3d0ff351606870699a61d8e7481351cdb9515.source: Use the honeycomb to lure the three bee swarms across the bridge.
3cd3d0ff351606870699a61d8e7481351cdb9515.text: 使用蜂巢引誘三群蜂群過橋。

7c52cd979c08fbeaced6f29416a76ace90b890a2.source: Return to Miller Upton for your reward.
7c52cd979c08fbeaced6f29416a76ace90b890a2.text: 影返 送給 Miller Upton，以獲得獎勵。

81295887d710d0ff19ac0f2b2631f87450c4eda8.text: 能量 +12（而 體力 低於 33%）

d82a61c0f906eb9dd94007a66b7f70ab7240a3ff.text: 防禦 +10（而 體力 低於 33%）

bc724242e8b1a35bb6bcdd7546a8ef13d3c3c530.source: Head down the southwest road from Ascalon City to Ashford and speak with Miller Upton. Before he can help Namar, you'll need to handle a bee problem for him. Pick up the Massive Honeycomb and approach the three bee swarms to grab their attention. Lead the swarms across the bridge until the quest updates, drop the honeycomb, and return to Upton for your reward.
bc724242e8b1a35bb6bcdd7546a8ef13d3c3c530.text: 從 阿斯卡隆城 沿著西南路前往阿什福德，並與米勒厄普頓交談。在他幫助 納瑪爾 之前，您需要為他解決蜜蜂問題。拿起大型 蜂巢 並接近三群蜂群以吸引他們的注意。帶領蜂群過橋，直到任務更新，放下蜂巢，然後返回厄普頓領取獎勵。

26b4c3f645deb1f3a86589f803eae87f9ff4f3a8.source: This quest introduces players to Bundle items.
26b4c3f645deb1f3a86589f803eae87f9ff4f3a8.text: 此任務向玩家介紹捆綁物品。

15f2cf5259d3bf177cfc3d07114e5c21a506575b.source: The path you take to bring the Massive Honeycomb across the bridge affects the quest getting updated.
15f2cf5259d3bf177cfc3d07114e5c21a506575b.text: 您將大規模 蜂巢 帶到橋上的路徑會影響任務的更新。

3173376dc6c120b7ffa784d476dc699f7afc53dc.source: The bee swarms might get stuck during the quest and stop moving. The easiest way to get around this issue is to lead the bees underneath the bridge just within range of the quest marker to achieve quest completion.
3173376dc6c120b7ffa784d476dc699f7afc53dc.text: 蜂群可能會在任務過程中被卡住並停止移動。解決這個問題的最簡單方法是引導蜜蜂到橋下任務標記的範圍內以完成任務。

d3dd2bd25f810bf5d6247e74699f5d4523dde4ff.source: Glean information about the harpies from Captain Jafahni.
d3dd2bd25f810bf5d6247e74699f5d4523dde4ff.text: 從賈法尼船長那裡收集有關鷹身女妖的資訊。

b766aa0466b540c8eaa306f699beabc4ff298315.source: Scavenge the wilderness for Screecher and Scratcher. Kill them to reduce harpy morale.
b766aa0466b540c8eaa306f699beabc4ff298315.text: 在荒野中搜尋尖叫者和尖叫者。殺死他們可以降低鷹身女妖計程車氣。

c5251279a0022b34021af66e1aa10c6a51cb04d8.source: Captain Jafahni and the "Elder Skree" harpies in Wilderness of Bahdza (Elder Skree Griffins, Elder Skree Raiders, Elder Skree Singers, and Elder Skree Trackers) will no longer spawn after this quest is completed.
c5251279a0022b34021af66e1aa10c6a51cb04d8.text: Jafahni 隊長和 巴薩荒野 中的「長者 鳥妖」鷹身女妖（長者 鳥妖 獅鷲、長者 鳥妖 突襲者、長者 鳥妖 歌手和長者 鳥妖 追蹤者）在此任務完成後將不再生成。

8e62b8d4f761510c7efa929a853f98f958902588.source: Start out from Dzagonur Bastion, and meet Captain Jafahni in the Wilderness of Bahdza (just to the east of the outpost). From here, follow your quest pointer deep into the wilderness to hunt down and slay the two harpy leaders: Screecher and Scratcher.
8e62b8d4f761510c7efa929a853f98f958902588.text: 從 薩崗諾稜堡 出發，並在 巴薩荒野（就在前哨站的東邊）與 Jafahni 隊長會面。從這裡開始，跟隨你的任務指標深入荒野，追捕並殺死兩個鷹身女妖首領：尖叫者和尖叫者。

c9007ec903b4f6daaf4875095f34145c0e65c1ee.source: Each leader will be accompanied by 3 other skree harpies, usually Trackers and Raiders. After defeating each leader's group, a 2nd group of skree will pop up and attempt to run away, towards the portal with Resplendent Makuun (without attacking the party); chasing them down or letting them run away does not affect the quest.
c9007ec903b4f6daaf4875095f34145c0e65c1ee.text: 每個領導者都會有 3 其他斯克裡鷹身女妖陪同，通常是追蹤者和掠奪者。在擊敗每個首領的隊伍後，2nd 的斯克裡隊會突然出現，並試圖與 Resplendent Makuun 一起逃向傳送門（不攻擊隊伍）；追趕他們或讓他們逃跑並不影響任務。

c47907e29c67094dacb2592bb7c264afd10d2ec5.source: Alternately, one can zone into the Wilderness of Bahdza from the Resplendent Makuun entrance. Screecher and Scratcher are both relatively near the portal, and once they have been slain, you will receive credit for completion.
c47907e29c67094dacb2592bb7c264afd10d2ec5.text: 或者，您可以從 Resplendent Makuun 入口進入 巴薩荒野。尖叫者和尖叫者都相對靠近傳送門，一旦他們被殺死，你將獲得完成的積分。

0b7a9ba7131b2bd7d717c5eb38f2db6d353c184e.source: Once the two skree leaders have been killed, return to Prince Ahmtur in the north-west corner of the Wilderness (or map back to Dzagonur Bastion and take a short walk into the Citadel).
0b7a9ba7131b2bd7d717c5eb38f2db6d353c184e.text: 殺死兩名斯克雷首領後，返回荒野西北角的阿姆圖爾王子處（或返回地圖至 薩崗諾稜堡，步行一小段距離進入城堡）。

df044826ad4db78d6c149e67c857ae02c1b9e103.source: The additional Skree popup group at the second leader, Scratcher, sometimes gets stuck on the shrine nearby when they try to run away.
df044826ad4db78d6c149e67c857ae02c1b9e103.text: 第二個領導者 Scratcher 的額外 鳥妖 彈出小組有時在試圖逃跑時被困在附近的神社上。

598e09dc75af691b2cf704ca1db2b0c3e1592b97.source: The group of Skrees near Scratcher will attack you when you begin to fight with him, but occasionally if you inflict enough damage they will run away through the portal into Resplendent Makuun.
598e09dc75af691b2cf704ca1db2b0c3e1592b97.text: 當你開始與 Scratcher 戰鬥時，Scratcher 附近的 Skrees 群會攻擊你，但偶爾如果你造成足夠的傷害，他們會透過傳送門逃到 Resplendent Makuun。

cd1e774baff8dcbccf2d3ebad37d6415ce826d06.source: See Headmaster Quin for your reward.
cd1e774baff8dcbccf2d3ebad37d6415ce826d06.text: 去找奎恩校長領取獎勵。

bdb4bd4dc3bb45332e6b8318a3176ce59c7dfba5.source: Leave from Tsumei Village and head south to talk to Jaikmo, then head south again and kill the Unbound Spirit.
bdb4bd4dc3bb45332e6b8318a3176ce59c7dfba5.text: 從 蘇梅村 出發，向南前往與 Jaikmo 交談，然後再次向南殺死 Unbound Spirit。

f9d832cb7aa4f30683bd5ac5182c96dfe73500cd.source: Travel to Jaga Moraine and find the bottomless pit.
f9d832cb7aa4f30683bd5ac5182c96dfe73500cd.text: 前往賈加冰磧並找到無底洞。

1613308f5587d0e2e1283e3e34bd1923faf1fdac.source: Travel to the northeastern corner of Jaga Moraine to find the bottomless pit, and defeat Ssissth the Leviathan.
1613308f5587d0e2e1283e3e34bd1923faf1fdac.text: 前往賈加冰磧的東北角找到無底洞，並擊敗利維坦西斯。

bac5b0cb22a8d2f956f58bda87010aad4f1cf969.source: You can save time by combining this quest with A Hunter's Pride, Krak's Cavalry, and Anything You Can Do.
bac5b0cb22a8d2f956f58bda87010aad4f1cf969.text: 您可以將此任務與 獵人的榮譽、克拉克騎兵隊 和任何您可以做的事情結合起來，以節省時間。

2728cdafdc4d05da250acd4ccdb0acca27790987.source: This quest cannot be repeated after an Extreme Makeover Credit (sex change) because the boss will not be there.
2728cdafdc4d05da250acd4ccdb0acca27790987.text: 在獲得極限改造積分（性別改變）後無法重複此任務，因為老闆不會在那裡。

ad1594604ba95425ebe36587d76a42e78cd9a751.source: Kill the Priest of Menzies in the Fissure of Woe.
ad1594604ba95425ebe36587d76a42e78cd9a751.text: 殺死悲傷裂縫中的 曼席斯的祭司。

12137440d6e941f05f3106a4f49090530cf36a84.source: *BONUS* Kill the Priest of Menzies in Hard Mode.
12137440d6e941f05f3106a4f49090530cf36a84.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 曼席斯的祭司。

9ac66b759c256d2b95eae3a4be5a308718c23277.source: As per Army of Darkness walkthrough.

3435c90610ba6eb12b535fd507d0c2779628ad51.source: Consider completing this quest at the same time as the Dragon Lich Zaishen quest, since that quest is available from the Zaishen Bounty signpost on the eighth day after this quest (based on the Zaishen Bounty cycle) and both targets are found in the same location at the Great Battle Field.
3435c90610ba6eb12b535fd507d0c2779628ad51.text: 考慮與 巫妖之龍 Zaishen 任務同時完成此任務，因為該任務可在該任務後的第八天從 戰承懸賞 路標上獲得（基於 戰承懸賞 週期），並且兩個目標都在大戰場的同一位置找到。

4d6a0b655ecf3cefcd5a4787ff9769bbc1a75bec.source: Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in the Depths of Tyria. Lists the region instead of the dungeon name
4d6a0b655ecf3cefcd5a4787ff9769bbc1a75bec.text: 殺死 泰瑞亞深處 中的 3 稜柱軟泥怪。列出區域而不是地下城名稱

c0033918ee6c69a2041fd5b29b81aefa3d439a44.source: *BONUS* Kill 3 Prismatic Oozes in Hard Mode.
c0033918ee6c69a2041fd5b29b81aefa3d439a44.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 3 稜柱軟泥怪。

d12311fd1826e6f7794a491b6ae57405db83e5e1.source: As per the Watch it Jiggle quest. At least one party member must have the quest in order to get past the locked gate in the dungeon.
d12311fd1826e6f7794a491b6ae57405db83e5e1.text: 根據“Watch it Jiggle”任務。至少一名隊員必須完成任務才能穿越地牢的上鎖大門。

03e23735899fadda81fb586ada576b959e535517.source: This quest takes place entirely in Wajjun Bazaar and requires little (if any) fighting. Due to the sequence of events, it does require a significant amount of "backtracking" to complete, since Guardsman Pah is located between Paomu and Officer Chitaro, and Budo is located beyond both of them (along the path to The Marketplace). Once you have spoken to Paomu, Officer Chitaro and Guardsman Pah (in that order), you can map travel to The Marketplace to meet Budo, before returning to Paomu for the reward. If you have access to Nahpui Quarter then map traveling there after meeting Budo shortens the amount of time to complete this quest.
03e23735899fadda81fb586ada576b959e535517.text: 任務完全在 瓦江市場 中進行，幾乎不需要（如果有的話）戰鬥。由於事件的順序，它確實需要大量的「回溯」才能完成，因為衛兵 Pah 位於 Paomu 和軍官 Chitaro 之間，而 Budo 位於他們兩人之外（沿著通往 市集 的路徑）。與 Paomu、Chitaro 警官和 Pah 衛士（按順序）交談後，您可以將行程對映到 市集 與 Budo 會面，然後返回 Paomu 獲取獎勵。如果您有權存取 納普區，那麼在遇到 Budo 後前往那裡的地圖會縮短完成此任務的時間。

525f940f58870894c0b33acbb576549a5dee0b7f.source: Meet Poturi on the Plains of Jarin.
525f940f58870894c0b33acbb576549a5dee0b7f.text: 在 賈林平原 上認識 Poturi。

96bc80c284631ca1860b2a44353e65a1c1abaa4a.source: Retrieve the sword from the injured Corsair.
96bc80c284631ca1860b2a44353e65a1c1abaa4a.text: 從受傷的 海盜 身上取回劍。

4ec31c58ee9a8621b715db7a33246bdd5616e901.source: Speak to Poturi for your reward.
4ec31c58ee9a8621b715db7a33246bdd5616e901.text: 與波圖裡交談以獲得獎勵。

843be8cd31f31670e548bf6a326b94c53b9025b3.source: [Incomplete source section] Exit the Sunspear Great Hall into the Plains of Jarin with Poturi and travel to where the Wounded Corsair is. There's a surprisingly large group of corsairs around him, so if you're still a low level you may wish to try pulling the groups of four, one by one. Defeat the Wounded Corsair and then interact with the Corsair Chest to receive the Notched Sword. No key is required. Speak with Poturi afterward for your reward.
843be8cd31f31670e548bf6a326b94c53b9025b3.text: [不完整的原始碼部分] 與 Poturi 一起退出 日戟大會堂 進入 賈林平原 並前往受傷的 海盜 所在的位置。他周圍有一大群海盜，如果你等級還低的話，不妨試試四人一組，一一拉。擊敗受傷的 海盜，然後與 海盜 寶箱 互動以接收缺口 劍。不需要鑰匙。之後與波圖裡交談以獲得獎勵。

cbe27f885b8ff8b092e9b388f3f1a8ddbeaf9374.source: Clear Prophet's Path in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode.
cbe27f885b8ff8b092e9b388f3f1a8ddbeaf9374.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 水晶沙漠 中的 先知之路。

259e954d5a52ab11221b290d0047fb2b012a231f.source: "Clear Prophet's Path in the Crystal Desert of all enemies in hard mode."
259e954d5a52ab11221b290d0047fb2b012a231f.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的水晶沙漠中的先知之路。”

50b3591e88840b98bf75f776221654bc4d669bbe.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.72% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
50b3591e88840b98bf75f776221654bc4d669bbe.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 1.72% 的貢獻。

7abec3cb0d8b7efe0ad7038b94266cd12814f742.source: There are lots of hidden scarabs and devourers, with several Sand Wurms and Salving Cactuses. The Salving Cactuses may burrow similar to wurms for a short time.
7abec3cb0d8b7efe0ad7038b94266cd12814f742.text: 這裡有很多隱藏的聖甲蟲和吞噬者，還有一些沙龍和拯救仙人掌。救援仙人掌可能會像亞龍一樣在短時間內挖洞。

9036f60c1839fdf63da78e38bdec2efd86919291.source: The area around Kepkhet Marrowfeast is likely the most difficult, as there are several Scarab Nest Builders that cannot be pulled away (but you can pull the boss). Ranged damage is best because the Scarab Nest Builders litter the area with traps. Consider clearing out the patrols around the boss before engaging. The patrols are hostile to non-scarab foes.
9036f60c1839fdf63da78e38bdec2efd86919291.text: 柯柏海特食隨者 周圍的區域可能是最困難的，因為有幾個無法拉走的聖甲蟲巢建造者（但你可以拉 Boss）。 遠距 傷害是最好的，因為聖甲蟲築巢者在該區域佈滿了陷阱。考慮在交戰前清除 Boss 周圍的巡邏隊。巡邏隊對非聖甲蟲敵人充滿敵意。

e9f43779e78bc2370fb6f2365385a04bb0295166.source: The foes here use conditions liberally. Condition removal skills can be brought, but since they are reapplied very quickly, it is best to bring skills to counter health degeneration.
e9f43779e78bc2370fb6f2365385a04bb0295166.text: 這裡的敵人可以隨意利用條件。可以攜帶消除狀況的技能，但由於它們重新應用的速度非常快，因此最好攜帶對抗生命退化的技能。

bac36e24be4d240434389139acb9bd02c9fc9308.source: The hydra boss (random profession) patrols a long route west of Augury Rock and might be missed.
bac36e24be4d240434389139acb9bd02c9fc9308.text: 九頭蛇頭目（隨機職業）在 占卜之石 以西的一條漫長路線上巡邏，可能會被錯過。

75379617dc1f935bec8b1bd8d485759f9e567948.source: Even if the player waits on the hydra boss route, the hydra may not approach the player on its own. Various groups of patrolling minotaurs are hostile to all foes, including other minotaurs. If you start from Augury Rock, Heroes' Audience, or Vulture Drifts and kill all the foes south of the green oasis belt, sometimes the area is considered vanquished, even if there are still foes north of the line of greenery (the area outside of the Amnoon Oasis).
75379617dc1f935bec8b1bd8d485759f9e567948.text: 即使玩家在九頭蛇頭目路線上等待，九頭蛇可能不會自行接近玩家。各種巡邏的牛頭怪群體對所有敵人都懷有敵意，包括其他牛頭怪。如果您從占卜之石、英雄之痕或禿鷹沙丘開始並殺死綠洲帶以南的所有敵人，有時該區域被視為被征服，即使綠線以北（安奴綠洲以外的區域）仍然有敵人。

45514d4478561f52b753ec751a6a203e8f6b8fb5.source: Protect the Halcyon from Outcast raiders. You have 7..0 groups remaining.
45514d4478561f52b753ec751a6a203e8f6b8fb5.text: 保護翡翠鳥免受流亡者的襲擊。您還剩下 7..0 群組。

6d294b7d722517cef2bd04ccde577b2b85a0bfc3.source: See Captain Lexis for your reward.
6d294b7d722517cef2bd04ccde577b2b85a0bfc3.text: 去找萊克西斯船長領獎勵。

5e66a6211f8b7f8d91d998b902bcc52a71d36d07.source: This quest simply requires you to fight off several waves of attacking Outcasts. This is most easily accomplished with ranged attacks or spells. A warrior (or minion master) can tank the Outcasts as they head inside and move upwards to your position.
5e66a6211f8b7f8d91d998b902bcc52a71d36d07.text: 這個任務只需要你擊退幾波攻擊的流亡者。透過遠端攻擊或法術最容易實現這一點。當流亡者進入並向上移動到你的位置時，戰士（或隨從大師）可以坦克他們。

98ca10ba9517cf0ebf3dc14c1ed6952ff0a58b90.source: After obtaining the quest, travel to Zos Shivros Channel and head out the northern gate into the Boreas Seabed. The Halcyon is the large ship just to the north of your starting location.
98ca10ba9517cf0ebf3dc14c1ed6952ff0a58b90.text: 獲得任務後，前往 佐席洛斯水道 並從北門前往北風之神海底。 Halcyon 是一艘位於您起始位置以北的大型船。

8237128a95f64e08457c68e74f8b0624838bf394.source: The ship is hollow with several levels of walkways inside. Rion is located up the first ramp, on the tiny first level. Talking to him immediately starts the waves of attackers. Head up the ramp to the second level and attack from here. This level is within casting range of the NPCs in the area (who have Word of Healing) and attacking range of the Outcasts on the ground.
8237128a95f64e08457c68e74f8b0624838bf394.text: 船是中空的，裡面有幾層走道。 Rion 位於第一個坡道上，位於狹小的第一層。與他交談立即引發一波又一波的攻擊。沿著坡道前往第二層，然後從這裡攻擊。此等級處於該區域 NPC（具有 治癒文字）的施法範圍和地面上的流亡者的攻擊範圍內。

dc383c99c0025c1924e9715cbd0ad43b5eebf547.source: Targeting opponents requires moving along the walkways rather than moving to ground level. Be careful of this when targeting the next opponent. Whether using the keyboard or the mouse to target opponents, game mechanics will move you downward rather than along the walkway to a viable shooting location.
dc383c99c0025c1924e9715cbd0ad43b5eebf547.text: 瞄準對手需要沿著走道移動而不是移動到地面。當瞄準下一個對手時要小心這一點。無論是使用鍵盤還是滑鼠來瞄準對手，遊戲機制都會讓你向下移動，而不是沿著走道到達可行的射擊位置。

3d96947dfdd0e9e1dabf907d57b0ba0450f0717e.source: If somebody in your group has the Quest "The Halcyon Job" active, the assault will not start and your quest log states that you have 7 groups remaining.
3d96947dfdd0e9e1dabf907d57b0ba0450f0717e.text: 如果您的小組中有人啟動了 任務“在神翠的工作”，則攻擊將不會開始，並且您的任務日誌會顯示您還剩下 7 小組。

9c7b5f952d6c370b9e791e06c427ccf699873f00.source: Alert the scholars about the assault on the Halls of Chokhin. You have spoken to 0...8 of 8 scholars.
9c7b5f952d6c370b9e791e06c427ccf699873f00.text: 向學者通報喬欣大廳遭到的攻擊。您曾與 8 學者的 0...8 交談。

b88dc1704386c314e3021682145539268ec51ab8.source: Protect the scholars from the advancing Margonite forces. At least 4 scholars must survive. 8...0 of 8 scholars are still alive.
b88dc1704386c314e3021682145539268ec51ab8.text: 保護學者免受不斷推進的 瑪骨奈 勢力的侵害。至少 4 學者必須生存。 8...0 中的 8 學者還活著。

ace165820f2547d9c6ffc107bbdd3632275bc207.source: Eliminate the groups of Margonites attacking Chokhin. 12...0 of 12 groups remain.
ace165820f2547d9c6ffc107bbdd3632275bc207.text: 消滅攻擊喬欣的瑪貢尼特部隊。 12 群組中的 12...0 保留。

2fcd134fba1e97eaacb233f8555c953553d87c15.source: When this quest is active, there appear to be "hidden" triggers in the Halls of Chokhin which set off each wave of Margonite groups, however, these triggers only become active after the party has spoken to all 8 scholars. When the scholars are spoken to, they will run to the shrine of Lyssa at the north-west side of the halls. For this reason, it is best to start talking to the scholars furthest from the shrine, then work your way in to speak to the closest scholars last.
2fcd134fba1e97eaacb233f8555c953553d87c15.text: 當這個任務啟動時，喬欣大廳裡似乎有「隱藏」的觸發器，它會引發每一波 瑪骨奈 團體，但是，這些觸發器只有在該隊伍與所有 8 學者交談後才會啟動。當與學者交談時，他們會跑到大廳西北側的 麗莎 神社。因此，最好先與距離神社最遠的學者交談，然後最後與最近的學者交談。

bece2d335c005af9dc6b2ebc7e0963bd9a013b02.source: Once all the scholars have been spoken to and have congregated at the shrine, the party can start to trigger the Margonite groups. This is best done by carefully moving forward on one side while holding the Show Targets key (Left Ctrl by default) until you can see a Margonite group, and then moving enough to trigger make them head towards the scholars. At this point, hold your position to head them off, or retreat to a suitable ambush/blocking point.
bece2d335c005af9dc6b2ebc7e0963bd9a013b02.text: 一旦與所有學者交談並聚集在神社後，隊伍就可以開始觸發 瑪骨奈 小組。最好的方法是在按住「顯示目標」鍵（預設為左 Ctrl）的同時小心地向前移動一側，直到您可以看到 瑪骨奈 組，然後移動足夠的距離以觸發使它們朝向學者。此時，堅守陣地阻止他們，或撤退到適當的伏擊/阻擋點。

27720a444e679da40a1f189f624d43620ee703a6.source: Even with this careful approach, you will likely find that the Margonites attack in waves of 3 groups (so 2 waves on each of the north and south sides to make the total 12 groups). Do note that there are 4 different kinds of groups. The first group at the east are mostly rangers. The 2nd at the east side are melee. The 2 groups on the west side are both casters and melee.
27720a444e679da40a1f189f624d43620ee703a6.text: 即使採用這種謹慎的方法，您也可能會發現瑪貢尼特人會以 3 組的形式進行攻擊（因此 2 會在北側和南側各進行一波攻擊，以形成總共 12 組）。請注意，4 有不同型別的群組。東部的第一組主要是護林員。東側的2正在混戰。西側的2團體既是腳輪又是近戰。

09da48138d4c487ebb759c5c57ad08206b54ed3c.source: When you have cleared the 6 groups on one side in this fashion, switch to the other and repeat.
09da48138d4c487ebb759c5c57ad08206b54ed3c.text: 當您以這種方式清除一側的 6 群組後，切換到另一側並重複。

eee3339260bd0b0cd3ca6c435f264fe0c5b250d6.source: The terrain here benefits a smart party: make use of height advantage by standing at the top of stairs and use ranged attacks to increase damage; use body blocking at corners to hold groups and nuke them together; wells and wards can help the party or hinder foes (minion masters or other corpse users will have plenty of material); since the Margonites will have to cross bridges or climb narrow stairways, placing traps in their path before you trigger each wave can be of great help too. Casting Death Nova on minions to spread poison is also useful.
eee3339260bd0b0cd3ca6c435f264fe0c5b250d6.text: 這裡的地形有利於聰明的一方：利用高度優勢，站在樓梯頂部，使用遠端攻擊來增加傷害；在角落使用身體阻擋來控制群體並將他們集中在一起；水井和守衛可以幫助隊伍或阻礙敵人（小兵大師或其他屍體使用者將擁有大量材料）；由於瑪貢尼特人必須過橋或爬狹窄的樓梯，因此在觸發每一波浪潮之前也會在他們的路徑上放置陷阱。對小兵施放 死亡新星 來傳播毒藥也很有用。

71c4561b7d27051c3c8af8eeb0c887b6f684607f.source: For more tips and tactics for this mission, see this article's Talk page
71c4561b7d27051c3c8af8eeb0c887b6f684607f.text: 有關此任務的更多提示和策略，請參閱本文的討論頁面

be506ee1de61982b8b0f43c4919c072eeb02a30f.source: Find Paulus the Monk in Regent Valley
be506ee1de61982b8b0f43c4919c072eeb02a30f.text: 在 統治者之谷 中找到 僧侶 保盧斯

cd382d14e5e504db5f489322c51979a0e2c2e89d.source: Search Paulus's body for any personal effects.
cd382d14e5e504db5f489322c51979a0e2c2e89d.text: 搜查保盧斯的屍體，尋找任何個人物品。

66ca3d8d162e8f8cce99863f245622c34e92121e.source: Return the holy symbol to Grazden the Protector.
66ca3d8d162e8f8cce99863f245622c34e92121e.text: 影返 保護者葛拉登 的聖徽。

2fb808d506c32312e66996fae4cfad86d4a76899.source: Go into Regent Valley to look for Paulus. If you're having trouble finding the path to the portal, follow the creek bed in the direction of Ascalon City a short distance until you can climb a hill on your right. Once through the portal it's a fairly straight path; just follow the quest arrow. Alternatively start from Fort Ranik and walk alongside the aqueduct. This not only is extremely easy to find but also much shorter.
2fb808d506c32312e66996fae4cfad86d4a76899.text: 進入 統治者之谷 尋找保盧斯。如果您找不到通往傳送門的路徑，請沿著河床向 阿斯卡隆城 方向行駛一小段距離，直到您可以爬上右側的一座小山。一旦通過傳送門，就會出現一條相當筆直的路徑；只需跟隨任務箭頭即可。或從拉尼克堡出發，沿著渡槽行走。這不僅非常容易找到，而且也短得多。

26ccfd4d06e6d7c23f1f6cb72c7345d27492c5f7.source: You'll find that you are too late to save him. You'll need to click on his body to obtain his holy symbol to take back to Grazden. Beware, though. Party members will become poisoned by the spot. Return the symbol to Grazden.
26ccfd4d06e6d7c23f1f6cb72c7345d27492c5f7.text: 你會發現你已經來不及拯救他了。你需要點選他的身體以獲得他的聖徽並帶回格拉茲登。不過要小心。 隊伍 成員將會因該斑點而中毒。 影返 前往格拉茲登的符號。

327b127d69843cf267ec39c3c3ea23a7d457ba97.source: The poison inflicted by interacting with Paulus's body suggests that he fell to a similar environment effect to the one monk players had to protect him from in pre-Searing.
327b127d69843cf267ec39c3c3ea23a7d457ba97.text: 與保盧斯身體互動所造成的毒害表明，他陷入了與 崩壞 之前僧侶玩家必須保護他免受的環境影響類似的環境影響。

f9e2ad4a2bc3f2960289cf7ecb66dcc232f7a299.source: Meet Farrah Cappo in Lakeside County.
f9e2ad4a2bc3f2960289cf7ecb66dcc232f7a299.text: 在 湖畔郡 中認識 法拉卡波。

d8de0024005c4f57f750305f76c4a7d0fd7c8bf8.source: Keep Farrah alive while she hunts down the infamous Alain.
d8de0024005c4f57f750305f76c4a7d0fd7c8bf8.text: 讓法拉活下去，同時追捕惡名昭彰的 阿萊恩。

b7994fb2e12b56e52a315865b27a35d419038b40.source: Return to Grazden the Protector for your reward.
b7994fb2e12b56e52a315865b27a35d419038b40.text: 影返 至 保護者葛拉登 以獲得獎勵。

e9f7dd182bc246dc3571f10616e34969981ce4b1.source: Grazden will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
e9f7dd182bc246dc3571f10616e34969981ce4b1.text: 接受任務後，格拉茲登會給你以下技能：

0ba6a122ac20ff4557963ef8ac3ad2dc48626d7a.source: After accepting the quest from Grazden the Protector, leave Green Hills County to Lakeside County. There you will find Farrah Cappo waiting for you. She will start running to fight the groups of bandits. Follow her and make sure she doesn't die. You can help her fight if you want but the main objective of the quest is to keep her alive. Once she fights off four groups she will run into Alain. Keep Farrah alive at all costs. Once he is dead run back to Green Hills County to talk to Grazden the Protector for your reward.
0ba6a122ac20ff4557963ef8ac3ad2dc48626d7a.text: 接受 保護者葛拉登 的任務後，將 綠丘郡 留給 湖畔郡。在那裡您會發現 法拉卡波 正在等著您。她將開始奔跑與強盜團夥作戰。跟著她，確保她不會死。如果你願意，你可以幫助她戰鬥，但任務的主要目標是讓她活下去。一旦她擊退了四個小組，她就會遇到 阿萊恩。不惜一切代價保住法拉的生命。一旦他死了，就跑回 綠丘郡 與 保護者葛拉登 交談以獲得獎勵。

3ed855792a1a3962891e3ac0e0ccc11404f41a14.source: If Alain kills you but Farrah still manages to kill him, you will get credit for completing the quest
3ed855792a1a3962891e3ac0e0ccc11404f41a14.text: 如果 阿萊恩 殺死了你，但法拉仍然設法殺死了他，你將獲得完成任務的獎勵

58789bdeabe8c6c69df5e7fc99a528129923dd7d.source: Alternatively, if you kill Alain before the escort (which only starts when you approach Farrah at the Green Hills County zone portal), the quest will be marked complete once Farrah reaches Alain's location safely.
58789bdeabe8c6c69df5e7fc99a528129923dd7d.text: 或者，如果您在護送之前殺死 阿萊恩（護送僅在您接近 綠丘郡 區域門戶的法拉時開始），一旦法拉安全到達 阿萊恩 的位置，任務將被標記為完成。

76076062761aa37cca5efe288985f448f978d755.source: Speak to Kilroy to start your brawling training.
76076062761aa37cca5efe288985f448f978d755.text: 與基爾羅伊交談以開始你的爭吵訓練。

e9341183965a7f087e776d10f0e9a627464ba4f0.source: Defeat the Norn brawlers using your new skills.
e9341183965a7f087e776d10f0e9a627464ba4f0.text: 使用新技能擊敗 諾恩 爭吵者。

e02a844952d4bd3f68ba4b5fb2d6b94dfca913a9.source: Accepting Kilroy's quest offer will not place the Brass Knuckles in your inventory yet, but you will have it once you enter the arena and will need to equip it in your weapon slot. Your skills will be replaced with the Brawling build. The Norn Brawlers will become hostile in order. First, two single brawlers will face you, then a pair and finally the last three. Your health is partially refilled any time you defeat a brawler, and the next set does not turn hostile until you have defeated all the previous group.
e02a844952d4bd3f68ba4b5fb2d6b94dfca913a9.text: 接受基爾羅伊的任務不會將指節銅套放入你的庫存中，但是一旦你進入競技場，你就會擁有它，並且需要將它裝備到你的武器槽中。你的技能將被鬥毆技能所取代。 諾恩 爭吵者將依序變得敵對。首先，兩個單獨的鬥士將面對你，然後一對，最後是最後三個。每當你擊敗一個爭吵者時，你的生命值都會得到部分恢復，並且在你擊敗前一組之前，下一組不會變得敵對。

8d4f6f7088cc492eea97d2fa214aad2bdd137bb5.source: Although the pair and trio of Norn Brawlers move to the center of the arena as if they were a group, they actually are not together as a team and using a longbow/flatbow or slowly moving towards them from the side can help you pull just one at a time.
8d4f6f7088cc492eea97d2fa214aad2bdd137bb5.text: 雖然一對或三人組的 諾恩 Brawlers 會像一群人一樣移動到競技場中央，但實際上他們並不是一個團隊，使用長弓/扁弓或從側面慢慢向他們移動可以幫助你一次只拉一個。

2819fb91060c0cde116a6205c16dd00eb4e130a4.source: Seek the meaning of the ancient parchment.
2819fb91060c0cde116a6205c16dd00eb4e130a4.text: 尋找古代羊皮紙的含義。

8b1a6c2c9d9652157c8e06b87cf3279275b98e27.source: Map travel to Tihark Orchard, then head out into the western Forum Highlands, and speak to Seborhin Protector Zuor to gain entrance to the Garden of Seborhin. Once in the garden, make your way to Hedge Wizard Mabai located in the middle area of the east side. Speak to Mabai and show him the ancient parchment to complete the quest.
8b1a6c2c9d9652157c8e06b87cf3279275b98e27.text: 地圖旅行到蒂哈克果園，然後前往西部 高地廣場，並與 Seborhin 守護者 Zuor 交談以進入 希伯欣花園。進入花園後，前往位於東側中部區域的樹籬嚮導馬白。與馬白交談並向他展示古老的羊皮紙以完成任務。

e915ce1e1e87f80f575918a5017d41b49c085dce.source: You can only complete this quest if you have completed the Nightfall campaign, or if you have Tahlkora in your party (before the garden becomes Nightfallen).
e915ce1e1e87f80f575918a5017d41b49c085dce.text: 只有當你完成了 黑暗逆襲 戰役，或者你的隊伍中有塔爾科拉（在花園變成墮夜精靈之前），你才能完成這個任務。

9df8a5c2ec174a9d07bbaa89a1485c294ec77ac6.source: The garden is not always accessible. See Garden of Seborhin for details.
9df8a5c2ec174a9d07bbaa89a1485c294ec77ac6.text: 花園並不總是可以進入。有關詳細資訊，請參閱 希伯欣花園。

cf2eee1705855a65ceb82342b7606cd0b9030238.source: Kill Pywatt the Swift in Alcazia Tangle.
cf2eee1705855a65ceb82342b7606cd0b9030238.text: 在阿爾卡齊亞糾纏區殺死 迅捷 派維特。

c7998f62def3bf81a7ac080d22f07ae9cc2e036e.source: *BONUS* Kill Pywatt the Swift in Hard Mode.
c7998f62def3bf81a7ac080d22f07ae9cc2e036e.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 迅捷 派維特。

7d2d3644bbd5c25aa1dd965a0f77ba48fdd1bef7.source: The simplest way to reach Pywatt is to leave from Rata Sum via Magus Stones. Use the southeast portal to travel to Alcazia Tangle; Pywatt is just south of the portal in Alcazia Tangle.
7d2d3644bbd5c25aa1dd965a0f77ba48fdd1bef7.text: 到達 Pywatt 最簡單的方法是從 洛達頂點 經 Magus Stones 出發。使用東南傳送門前往阿爾卡齊亞坦格爾；皮瓦特位於阿爾卡齊亞坦格爾傳送門的南邊。

e1d568fa9d8e75b1701024cb5fcb6e6f09ec0ae8.source: Goes well with the quest Turning the Page.

d55d1bc8f447bd59acd1b77d80439f2f8d37d644.source: Deliver the custom sword to Castellan Puuba at the Sunspear Great Hall.
d55d1bc8f447bd59acd1b77d80439f2f8d37d644.text: 將訂製劍交給 日戟大會堂 的 Castellan Puuba。

09bd7e0235c2b71b1bcdec8487110c2c9bca131c.source: Meet up with Castellan Puuba on the Plains of Jarin.
09bd7e0235c2b71b1bcdec8487110c2c9bca131c.text: 在 賈林平原 上與 Castellan Puuba 會面。

28dffa3252df9476014a1e91203c62581e393e0f.source: Fight beside Castellan Puuba as he tries out his new, customized sword. You have slain x of 10 creatures.
28dffa3252df9476014a1e91203c62581e393e0f.text: 當普巴堡主嘗試他的新定製劍時，與他並肩作戰。您已殺死 x 個 10 生物。

008dd4d84690773529f4f096dcee1d19c6a7b2d3.text: 請參閱 Chorben [武器] 以獲得獎勵。

113e28c1fddb82d8beec3c5c717fee4ac7449b66.source: Speak with Miner Tonabanza to start him walking towards the cliff wall. When he starts to work, a group of three mandragors will spawn near him. Kill the mandragors and keep them off the miner. Once the mandragors are dead, talk to the Tonabanza again and then return to Quarrymaster Bohanna for the reward.
113e28c1fddb82d8beec3c5c717fee4ac7449b66.text: 與礦工托納班札交談，讓他走向懸崖壁。當他開始工作時，一群三隻曼陀羅會在他附近生成。殺死曼陀羅並讓他們遠離礦工。曼德拉草死後，再次與托納班扎交談，然後返回採石場大師博哈納處獲取獎勵。

582b1eb587581b8eb758a0240527fb469b939039.source: Meet the Sunspear squad at the Cliffs of Dohjok
582b1eb587581b8eb758a0240527fb469b939039.text: 在 杜夏懸崖 認識烈陽之矛小隊

3f798b0dae078f9adef7091544948c45da0f75b6.source: Kill all the mandragor in the quarry
3f798b0dae078f9adef7091544948c45da0f75b6.text: 殺死採石場裡所有的曼德拉草

e4076e7ff346270ac03b64cc0cea4c9316481977.source: See Quarrymaster Bohanna for your reward
e4076e7ff346270ac03b64cc0cea4c9316481977.text: 請參閱採石場大師 Bohanna 領取獎勵

2ef6a8838709c3a45e47762eb413260430eb110c.source: After talking to Quarrymaster Bohanna, exit the outpost onto the Cliffs of Dohjok. Talk to Captain Vahndah to have the Sunspear squad follow you to the quarry. At its west end, you will find a group of stoneflesh, slitherers, and imp mandragor guarding the Queen. After killing all of them, return to the Quarrymaster for your reward.
2ef6a8838709c3a45e47762eb413260430eb110c.text: 與 Quarrymaster Bohanna 交談後，退出前哨站並進入 杜夏懸崖。與瓦恩達隊長交談，讓烈陽之矛小隊跟著你到採石場。在它的西端，你會發現一群石肉人、滑行者和小惡魔曼陀羅守護著女王。殺死所有人後，返回採石場老闆那裡領取獎勵。

058cd132d14f5a4902afc105e07f7c4f67523cff.source: As an alternative (if you've already been there), Map travel to Blacktide Den. This will give you a shorter route with fewer monsters, and a party of 8, at the cost of not gaining the level 10 allies from outside Champion's Dawn.
058cd132d14f5a4902afc105e07f7c4f67523cff.text: 作為替代方案（如果您已經去過那裡），可以透過地圖前往黑潮巢穴。這將為您提供一條更短的路線、更少的怪物和一支 8 隊伍，但代價是無法從 勇士曙光 之外獲得等級 10 的盟友。

2309662609a1bde214316e1bafff2d49168556d8.source: Assault the Crimson Skull Guild Hall and defeat Captain Quimang. Find reinforcements along the way
2309662609a1bde214316e1bafff2d49168556d8.text: 攻擊 紅顱 公會大廳 並擊敗 Quimang 隊長。沿途尋找援軍

5d121c0e4c8d4ac5c97419ed8ed9cd93e1919ac2.source: See The Emperor's Blade for your reward.
5d121c0e4c8d4ac5c97419ed8ed9cd93e1919ac2.text: 請參閱帝皇之刃以獲得獎勵。

1dfb7c39925caf7b538340e66b2aaf458633ab1b.source: You have to find recruits who are guards and go to Captain Quimang. The guards are necessary as Quimang has a lot of Crimson Skull protecting him in all directions.
1dfb7c39925caf7b538340e66b2aaf458633ab1b.text: 你必須找到擔任守衛的新兵，然後去找奎芒隊長。守衛是必要的，因為 Quimang 有許多 紅顱 在各個方向保護他。

58e3190bcfaeeb5c076e7e0c2160fa73d62d88a5.source: Best if using Henchmen to start in Ran Musu Gardens, that way your henchmen will be level 10 where as starting in Tsumei Village your Henchmen will be level 6. Start in Ran Musu Gardens, go down through Kinya Province to Panjiang Peninsula to keep henchmen at level 10. Kill Tahkayun Tsi to give your party a morale boost, as he is right outside of the exit from Ran Musu Gardens. Head down towards Port Kaimu where Captain Quimang is, killing the groups on both sides of where the Captain is, but staying away from contact with him. Then head to the farming village (Kaitan Village) just outside Tsumei Village starting from as far south as you can go working north and you'll end up with 9 level 10 guards to help you with the final group and Captain Quimang.
58e3190bcfaeeb5c076e7e0c2160fa73d62d88a5.text: 最好使用 傭兵 在 嵐穆蘇花園 中開始，這樣您的追隨者將達到 10 級別，而在 蘇梅村 中開始時，您的 傭兵 將達到 6 等級。從 嵐穆蘇花園 開始，向下經過 欣彌領地 到 班讓半島，以將追隨者保持在 10 等級。殺死 Tahkayun Tsi 可以鼓舞你的隊伍計程車氣，因為他就在 嵐穆蘇花園 的出口外。前往奎芒船長所在的凱姆港，殺死船長所在兩側的隊伍，但不要與他接觸。然後前往 蘇梅村 外的農莊（Kaitan Village），從最南邊向北走，最後你會看到 9 級別的 10 守衛來幫助你處理最後的小組和 Quimang 隊長。

1c8e61c498229f87978fecfaad989cc8263508f9.source: If one of the partymembers has the quest Togo's Ultimatum, you cannot do this quest as Captain Quimang will not be hostile.
1c8e61c498229f87978fecfaad989cc8263508f9.text: 如果其中一名隊員有任務“多哥的最後通牒”，你就不能做這個任務，因為奎芒隊長不會有敵意。

4cd483166a0c4760964e7b9f108469aaba80addf.source: There are groups of Crimson Skull all over the area. The best way to collect the help described above is to take on and kill these groups.
4cd483166a0c4760964e7b9f108469aaba80addf.text: 整個地區都有 紅顱 團體。獲得上述幫助的最佳方法就是對抗並消滅這些團體。

14d7d276df54dd8bb97b800584e46f53c61e8492.source: The gathered reinforcements will be useless if playing a ranged character. This is is because their aggro range is quite short and being under attack (or attacking) will not cause them to engage the enemy.
14d7d276df54dd8bb97b800584e46f53c61e8492.text: 如果扮演遠端角色，聚集的援軍將毫無用處。這是因為他們的仇恨範圍很短，受到攻擊（或攻擊）不會導致他們與敵人交戰。

fe4b158a5b2ce8685b822cb9b3395487ef89f1df.source: Speak to the first Sunspear Recruit.
fe4b158a5b2ce8685b822cb9b3395487ef89f1df.text: 與第一位烈陽之矛新兵交談。

5f7107f21d4aab4e98ada3d3e4a7e623b2559418.source: Speak to the second Sunspear Recruit.
5f7107f21d4aab4e98ada3d3e4a7e623b2559418.text: 與第二名烈陽之矛新兵交談。

00a3b814d7b542f4aafc30ccf8e89c2826c0231c.source: Speak to the third Sunspear Recruit.
00a3b814d7b542f4aafc30ccf8e89c2826c0231c.text: 與第三名烈陽之矛新兵交談。

0e5789822110f9c4f81c7f50a4279164b01b4f25.source: Speak to the three Sunspear Recruits and return to First Spear Jahdugar for your reward.
0e5789822110f9c4f81c7f50a4279164b01b4f25.text: 與三名烈陽之矛新兵交談並返回第一 矛 賈杜加爾領取獎勵。

b22d794c783b02e2957eaf527fcb1d3d4d0138e2.source: This is marked as a Primary Quest but is not required to proceed.
b22d794c783b02e2957eaf527fcb1d3d4d0138e2.text: 這被標記為主要 任務，但不需要繼續。

6895beb31da96f1c8ab5a92ab99da9b223807e56.source: Escort Hareh to the ancient graveyard in the Sulfurous Wastes.
6895beb31da96f1c8ab5a92ab99da9b223807e56.text: 護送哈雷前往硫磺荒原的古老墓地。

b918f3a4bf42520f6863549a793cdc7803780338.source: Visit gravesites and help Hareh summon the undead. You have visited 0 of 5 gravesites.
b918f3a4bf42520f6863549a793cdc7803780338.text: 參觀墓地並幫助 Hareh 召喚亡靈。您曾經造訪過 0 或 5 墓園。

4fe1c1f6a12ab2f7cf0c6148f8a0f4d61c88849e.source: Protect Hareh while he performs the ritual to raise the undead.
4fe1c1f6a12ab2f7cf0c6148f8a0f4d61c88849e.text: 在哈雷執行復活亡靈儀式時保護他。

5e7b70cea6061fa2ce024584dbdf5e1b99ebaca1.source: See Infantryman Hareh for your reward.
5e7b70cea6061fa2ce024584dbdf5e1b99ebaca1.text: 請見步兵哈雷以獲得獎勵。

311fd650be17f5b9648aaf012c5ceb5be8dd7a5a.source: If you don't have the Sunspear Great Hall on your map yet you can combine this quest with Armored Transport, which will take you there. If you haven't entered the Sunpspear Great Hall after that quest you have to go there now and enter the outpost. Once in the Sunspear Great Hall, find Castellan Puuba (you can use the "Alt" key to find NPCs inside a town/outpost). When you talk to him he will ask you to go outside into Plains of Jarin to test his new blade.
311fd650be17f5b9648aaf012c5ceb5be8dd7a5a.text: 如果您的地圖上沒有 日戟大會堂，但您可以將此任務與裝甲運輸車結合起來，後者將帶您前往那裡。如果你在該任務之後還沒有進入陽矛大廳，你現在就必須去那裡並進入前哨站。進入 日戟大會堂 後，找到 Castellan Puuba（您可以使用「Alt」鍵尋找城鎮/前哨站內的 NPC）。當您與他交談時，他會要求您到外面的 賈林平原 測試他的新刀片。

67af019dfefa30382e42764933de2cee05ded152.source: Enter the area and after taking the Insect Hunt Bounty at the resurrection shrine, approach Castellan Puuba. He will now be added to your party as a ally. Straight ahead from the entrance there is a colony of Stalking Nephila. Lead the Castellan there and he will start to attack them; and, as a good ally, he will even change his target to whatever target you are attacking. After slaying the required 10 creatures, the Castellan will thank you for your help and you can return to Kamadan to collect your reward.
67af019dfefa30382e42764933de2cee05ded152.text: 進入該區域，在復活神殿獲得昆蟲狩獵賞金後，接近城主普烏巴。他現在將作為盟友新增到您的隊伍中。入口正前方有一群潛行新蜘蛛。將城主帶到那裡，他就會開始攻擊他們；而且，作為一個好的盟友，他甚至會改變他的目標，無論你攻擊什麼目標。殺死所需的 10 生物後，城主將感謝您的幫助，您可以回到卡馬丹領取獎勵。

3cd64f53790c2a2af12f345aad0d8fe35d8f9c68.source: Puuba doesn't personally have to slay a beast to make it count.
3cd64f53790c2a2af12f345aad0d8fe35d8f9c68.text: 普巴並不需要親自殺死一頭野獸才算有價值。

d7a875b4792207772708ffd89a1ef1cec2de5989.source: Combines well with Armored Transport, Proof of Courage, and Map-Travel Inventor.
d7a875b4792207772708ffd89a1ef1cec2de5989.text: 與裝甲運輸、勇氣證明和地圖旅行發明者完美結合。

693685810d341c7af3def28a0a8e5b284a8a1b21.source: The word Castellan is a Title, not part of the NPC's Name.
693685810d341c7af3def28a0a8e5b284a8a1b21.text: Castellan 一詞是 頭銜，而不是 NPC 名稱的一部分。

26a23ca8d6c015fcaab8321332794cfb31e9d595.source: Unlike most other quests when you give an item to an NPC, there doesn't appear to be a text notification that Puuba takes his sword.
26a23ca8d6c015fcaab8321332794cfb31e9d595.text: 與大多數其他任務不同的是，當你將物品交給 NPC 時，似乎不會出現 Puuba 拿走他的劍的文字通知。

21f7223d86db26ea44180fcc601eb04b998f9bee.source: Kill Quansong Spiritspeak in Tahnnakai Temple.
21f7223d86db26ea44180fcc601eb04b998f9bee.text: 在 譚納凱神殿 中殺死 通靈者 魁嵩。

4b893a75d58f6bee94e887234dcc35030272a6b6.source: *BONUS* Kill Quansong Spiritspeak in Hard Mode.
4b893a75d58f6bee94e887234dcc35030272a6b6.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 通靈者 魁嵩。

5174d4b6075f73a1d34f49bc842009e76e81a48b.source: Head north through the Tahnnakai Temple explorable area from Zin Ku Corridor. Be prepared for area of effect fire damage from the Temple Guardians around him. If you follow the path in the the map posted on the right, you will only encounter Temple Guardians on your way to Quansong Spiritspeak.
5174d4b6075f73a1d34f49bc842009e76e81a48b.text: 從 辛庫走廊 向北穿過 譚納凱神殿 可探索區域。做好應對周圍聖殿守護者造成的區域火焰傷害的準備。如果您沿著右側地圖中的路徑前進，您只會在前往 通靈者 魁嵩 的途中遇到神殿守護者。

1e9166a271f94f76ad32344ad279f228c3d8c7ad.source: You will not encounter any physical attackers, so skills that block, cause misses, or inflict the blind condition are less effective here; however, Temple Guardians have Stun on Critical Hit.
1e9166a271f94f76ad32344ad279f228c3d8c7ad.text: 你不會遇到物理攻擊者，所以格擋、失手、致盲的技能在這裡效果較差；然而，聖殿守護者在暴擊時會暈眩。

5141e021bca77222a3894b38da56605221b32680.source: Quansong Spiritspeak and Temple Guardians are not fleshy creatures, so skills that exploit corpses and inflict bleeding, disease, or poison are ineffective against them.
5141e021bca77222a3894b38da56605221b32680.text: 通靈者 魁嵩 和聖殿守護者不是肉質生物，因此利用屍體並造成流血、疾病或中毒的技能對它們無效。

ec4ef189a6c6a99c42be4559508dbb1a5564ba92.source: You will only encounter spellcaster mobs, so consider bringing anti-caster skills and/or various Ranger nature rituals that can benefit your party but cannot benefit the Temple Guardians (such as Favorable Winds, Infuriating Heat, and Winnowing).
ec4ef189a6c6a99c42be4559508dbb1a5564ba92.text: 你只會遇到施法者生物，因此請考慮攜帶反施法者技能和/或各種 遊俠 自然儀式，這些儀式可以使你的隊伍受益，但不能使聖殿守護者受益（例如 順風、怒火 和 吹拂之風）。

902c5a3cb6827263a2c57f1474a635d4f15ef3d3.source: Follow the quest marker to come to a spot with five gravesites located near each other. Infantryman Hareh will follow you (he is undead, so don't worry about him not being inside a Junundu). The quest marker will point you successively to all five of the gravesites. At each gravesite, Infantryman Hareh will use the skill Rise From Your Grave! to animate two level 18 Undead Soldiers (they look like Flesh Golems). You do not need to click on the gravesites. Just get Hareh to follow you close enough to trigger his use of that skill.
902c5a3cb6827263a2c57f1474a635d4f15ef3d3.text: 按照任務標記來到一個有五個彼此相鄰的墓地的地方。步兵 Hareh 會跟著你（他是不死生物，所以不用擔心他不在 Junundu 裡面）。任務標記將依次將您指向所有五個墓地。在每個墓地，步兵 Hareh 都會使用技能「從墳墓中崛起！」製作兩級 18 不死系 士兵的動畫（他們看起來像血肉傀儡）。您不需要點選墓地。只要讓 Hareh 跟隨你足夠近，以觸發他使用該技能。

d943d67efdc643e33b50d24f3b2f02ffa0183930.source: After Hareh animates each pair of his minions (unlike normal minions, these will not have inherent health degeneration), a group of about 6 Margonites will attack your position. Being inside Junundu will make the fight easy, but note this will prevent you from using healing skills on Infantryman Hareh, so consider having a monk outside of the wurm if you have trouble keeping him alive. Don't worry about the Undead Soldiers dying. Once Hareh has activated his skill for the fifth time, the quest is considered complete and you can claim the quest from him before the fifth group of Margonites arrives.
d943d67efdc643e33b50d24f3b2f02ffa0183930.text: Hareh 啟動他的每對小兵後（與普通小兵不同，這些小兵不會有固有的生命值退化），一群大約 6 的瑪貢尼特將攻擊你的位置。在朱南杜內部會讓戰鬥變得容易，但請注意，這會阻止你對步兵哈雷使用治療技能，所以如果你很難讓他活著，請考慮在亞龍外面安排一個和尚。不用擔心 不死系 士兵的死亡。一旦哈雷第五次激活了他的技能，任務就被認為完成了，你可以在第五組瑪貢尼特到達之前向他領取任務。

825b1e9992897866898c376ab8b2218eb87c0e47.text: 保護 基肅皇帝 免受 白影軍團 的影響。

0c6b8eafbba65d3eeda8ff753a9d3c81b32b3598.source: *BONUS* Complete the mission in under 20 minutes (26 minutes in Hard Mode).
0c6b8eafbba65d3eeda8ff753a9d3c81b32b3598.text: *獎勵* 在 20 分鐘內完成任務（困難模式為 26 分鐘）。

056e954f13e30967b59bf700269936be4cb816c2.source: As per the Raisu Palace mission.
056e954f13e30967b59bf700269936be4cb816c2.text: 根據 萊蘇皇宮 任務。

8e4f3ce6f0b4d1e7caad638e6ac313c75784064e.source: This quest was first offered on April 26, 2009.
8e4f3ce6f0b4d1e7caad638e6ac313c75784064e.text: 此任務首次於四月 26、2009 提供。

2f04a8e46518bcb1de6c120f0f1936eb4476c657.source: Clear Raisu Palace in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode.
2f04a8e46518bcb1de6c120f0f1936eb4476c657.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 凱寧城 中的 萊蘇皇宮。

0f852d9d8e59e3cbade5db50b17a2b52526d40ca.source: "Clear Raisu Palace in Kaineng City of all enemies in hard mode."
0f852d9d8e59e3cbade5db50b17a2b52526d40ca.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 凱寧城 中的 萊蘇皇宮。”

32a3607e0e8fe2b1289941bcfdfafba5bfe0defb.source: This explorable area can only be entered from the Imperial Sanctum outpost, and is therefore only accessible after completion of the Raisu Palace mission.
32a3607e0e8fe2b1289941bcfdfafba5bfe0defb.text: 此可探索區域只能從 帝國聖所 前哨進入，因此只能在完成 萊蘇皇宮 任務後才能進入。

398a0bbadab7e07d235a78ce6a0d788a2afab969.source: There are globes of light scattered throughout the area. Those near a boss will spawn Shiro'ken if you approach too closely when fighting. To avoid this, pull the boss away from the globe. (The Ranger Boss does not have a globe in its vicinity.)
398a0bbadab7e07d235a78ce6a0d788a2afab969.text: 整個區域散佈著光球。如果戰鬥時距離太近，靠近 Boss 的人會生成 白影軍團。為了避免這種情況，請將老闆從地球上拉開。 （遊俠 頭目 附近沒有地球儀。）

3cdf15bbe8a0c55d9e31aeb2fa37b6dc8e5a27e9.source: The progress bar in the vanquish counter drastically overestimates progress, as most foes in the instance are not included in the total count until they enter compass range.
3cdf15bbe8a0c55d9e31aeb2fa37b6dc8e5a27e9.text: 征服計數器中的進度條大大高估了進度，因為例項中的大多數敵人在進入羅盤範圍之前都不會包含在總計數中。

90e8975faeb5b6794638c3e6a7cb27428f5e8c58.source: The portal near the Imperial Sanctum outpost can be used, even though the gate sometimes appears to be closed.
90e8975faeb5b6794638c3e6a7cb27428f5e8c58.text: 可以使用 帝國聖所 前哨站附近的傳送門，儘管大門有時看起來是關閉的。

ea336a1b0eeebe196e0e5bdb59f90b89c089439f.source: Kill Rand Stormweaver and accompanying foes in Slavers' Exile.
ea336a1b0eeebe196e0e5bdb59f90b89c089439f.text: 殺死 織暴者 硬皮 和 奴隸商人放逐地 中伴隨的敵人。

32d7a692728a3d0e3714430e13a8973824f2c108.source: *BONUS* Kill Rand Stormweaver and accompanying foes in Hard Mode.
32d7a692728a3d0e3714430e13a8973824f2c108.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 織暴者 硬皮 和伴隨的敵人。

fd8bb0ad4986f1e7132c7b41424148a69fcf9970.source: As per Justiciar Thommis' level. Both Rand Stormweaver and the small group directly around him must be killed.
fd8bb0ad4986f1e7132c7b41424148a69fcf9970.text: 根據 司法官 湯米茲' 等級。 織暴者 硬皮 和他周圍的小隊都必須被殺死。

f7e8607ffc3092570866c105487ed882310234ae.source: Take Rastin's request to Artisan Daved in Old Ascalon.
f7e8607ffc3092570866c105487ed882310234ae.text: 將 Rastin 的請求交給 工匠 舊阿斯卡隆 中的 Daved。

afc96da8c5d60c2f379f25624dde2ea7f7f81857.source: Deliver the Scribe's supplies to Witness Rastin in Old Ascalon.
afc96da8c5d60c2f379f25624dde2ea7f7f81857.text: 將抄寫員的用品交付給 舊阿斯卡隆 中的 檔案管理員拉斯丁。

1af91de93c50aebabfdf36accabfdc4fffda2876.source: Head south from Witness Rastin along the main road. You'll encounter some Gargoyles, a Hulking Stone Elemental or two, some Devourers, and a couple Grawl. After you crest the top of the hill, turn southwest and speak with Artisan Daved to get the necessary items. Head back to Rastin and give him the supplies to get your reward.
1af91de93c50aebabfdf36accabfdc4fffda2876.text: 從 檔案管理員拉斯丁 沿著主幹道往南行駛。你會遇到一些石像鬼、一兩個 巨石元素、一些 蠍 和幾個 穴居人。登上山頂後，轉向西南並與 工匠 Daved 交談以獲得必要的物品。返回拉斯廷並給他補給品以獲得獎勵。

fd59f7624fb28ff3e34d24e6a9abdc220baf8cdc.source: This quest can be completed in conjunction with Gargoyle Trouble and Counting the Fallen, as they take place in roughly the same area.
fd59f7624fb28ff3e34d24e6a9abdc220baf8cdc.text: 此任務可以與 殺死石像鬼 和 調查死者 一起完成，因為它們發生在大致相同的區域。

ef50208a6155d37441647bbb3b00b11c063f0268.source: You may have to speak with Artisan Daved twice. If you speak with him and the green arrow over his head is still present, speak with him again to get the supplies.
ef50208a6155d37441647bbb3b00b11c063f0268.text: 您可能需要與 工匠 Daved 交談兩次。如果你與他交談並且他頭上的綠色箭頭仍然存在，請再次與他交談以獲得補給。

e38fb93aca0ec0cd593e4624c3d4ca5438242da9.source: If you do not have the required quest, the closed door by the Inscribed Stone will not let you leave the first room.
e38fb93aca0ec0cd593e4624c3d4ca5438242da9.text: 如果你沒有完成所需的任務，銘刻石關閉的門將不會讓你離開第一個房間。

f5b3c6841468d238ad18a9276798ce4d753c584e.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #8 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
f5b3c6841468d238ad18a9276798ce4d753c584e.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#8 頁。

229e837d63ba38b290572f8ba4fdf9a7b1717c30.source: Be careful of the ice traps.

dfad90c96574ab3e62e379ea436481ae8c2c9460.source: East from the Dungeon Key, a lone Ancient Vaettir roams at the end of the corridor. When approached, it will "push" three ice boulders that roll down and kill any creature in their path.
dfad90c96574ab3e62e379ea436481ae8c2c9460.text: 從 地監 鑰匙 往東，一個孤獨的遠古瓦蒂爾在走廊的盡頭徘徊。當接近時，它會「推」三塊冰塊滾下來並殺死路徑上的任何生物。

ee86962df96055bad1948b8014d5528293843091.source: Allies such as minions and Dwarven Heroes will attempt to attack these boulders and may die as a result.
ee86962df96055bad1948b8014d5528293843091.text: 小兵和矮人英雄等盟友將嘗試攻擊這些巨石，並可能因此而死亡。

4a68367ff2543e80a4822419942667adb7a09f28.source: The Vaettir may also die to these boulders.
4a68367ff2543e80a4822419942667adb7a09f28.text: 維提爾也可能死於這些巨石。

0f2294956617355275c5e0172e40443451e6e719.source: Light the braziers near the north bridge to lower the bridges.
0f2294956617355275c5e0172e40443451e6e719.text: 點燃北橋附近的火盆以降低橋梁。

3b7322b06b0d3620a719c573307b1bc51c7d1d5a.source: To get the dungeon key to drop, you must kill the Reaper of Destruction and the group of hidden destroyers at the Reaper's initial location.
3b7322b06b0d3620a719c573307b1bc51c7d1d5a.text: 要掉落地牢鑰匙，您必須殺死 毀滅 的收割者以及收割者初始位置的隱藏驅逐艦群。

52481f91c58e6ebe4b51ee45cb49771e48080eb5.source: Near the portal to Level 3, the Chromatic Drakes and the Destroyers will fight against each other.
52481f91c58e6ebe4b51ee45cb49771e48080eb5.text: 在 3 關卡的入口附近，彩色龍和毀滅者將互相戰鬥。

2eab67afbda9514581f597f04a2a2e8d3875a1fd.source: There is an area beyond the traps that is not shown on the map. There is nothing of value.
2eab67afbda9514581f597f04a2a2e8d3875a1fd.text: 陷阱之外還有一個區域未在地圖上顯示。沒有什麼有價值的東西。

450f6f13015ee8226c10106b06cdce536bcdecd5.source: There appears to be an unreachable area beyond the south west corner of level 2 which does not appear on the minimap, within which a Whirling Wisp may occasionally be seen. The final Destroyers may be friendly, making the dungeon impossible to complete.
450f6f13015ee8226c10106b06cdce536bcdecd5.text: 在 2 關卡的西南角之外似乎有一個無法到達的區域，該區域沒有出現在小地圖上，在該區域內偶爾可以看到旋轉的小精靈。最後的毀滅者可能會很友好，使地下城無法完成。

c0a574d0e740df67f27867932194bd4545998377.source: Find Junior Minister Jejiang. Convince him to call off the destruction of "The Roost."
c0a574d0e740df67f27867932194bd4545998377.text: 找到傑江少部長。說服他取消對「棲息地」的破壞。

731274bc0ab31a9d08bd1afc783abbc49c96bdc7.source: Collect 2 platinum to bribe Junior Minister Jejiang.
731274bc0ab31a9d08bd1afc783abbc49c96bdc7.text: 收集 2 白金賄賂傑江少部長。

091ec5975297c1dcd00946ade1b80478eb478147.source: See Quill Songfeather for your reward.
091ec5975297c1dcd00946ade1b80478eb478147.text: 請參閱羽毛筆歌羽以獲得獎勵。

cadff8ccb4e7b5fd2a3fc51b75928ffa861806e3.source: The quest itself is straight forward, simply travel between the quest giver and the Minister, and then back.
cadff8ccb4e7b5fd2a3fc51b75928ffa861806e3.text: 任務本身很簡單，只需在任務提供者和部長之間移動，然後再返回即可。

e04de3411043f5decf5350d29ced8c9792ba47a4.source: You can complete the quest without spending any money: with at least 2 platinum in your inventory, speak to Junior Minister Jejiang and follow the dialogue until the "Accept" and "Decline" options appear. Drop all your money and Accept the reward. (Remember to pick up your cash before zoning out.)
e04de3411043f5decf5350d29ced8c9792ba47a4.text: 您無需花費任何金錢即可完成任務：庫存中至少有 2 白金，與傑江次官交談並按照對話進行，直到出現“接受”和“拒絕”選項。放下你所有的錢並接受獎勵。 （記得在走神前領取現金。）

ca68002810517a98cbaa0356bd215686054c10b2.source: Find Rojis on Issnur Isles and convince him to rejoin the Sunspears.
ca68002810517a98cbaa0356bd215686054c10b2.text: 在 伊斯諾島 上找到羅吉斯並說服他重新加入烈陽之矛隊。

3fdd8e3e548f5aac9219e5a4e46720cffb6381cf.source: Find the nest of mandragor destroying Rojis' field and eliminate them.
3fdd8e3e548f5aac9219e5a4e46720cffb6381cf.text: 找到摧毀羅吉斯領域的曼德拉草巢穴並消滅它們。

67c4ed7a2322b0da18f1d5991fa8ccc4be7b443f.source: Tell Rojis the Mandragor are dead.
67c4ed7a2322b0da18f1d5991fa8ccc4be7b443f.text: 告訴羅吉斯曼德拉戈爾已經死了。

c70a8a07f0787fb53902792028285f1ae4989f42.source: Enter Issnur Isles from Kodlonu Hamlet and follow the quest marker to find Rojis. He will ask you to kill five level 11 Mandragors located to the south-west of Rojis' position, in the midst of several groups of skale. When you have killed all five mandragors, speak to Rojis again, and then return to Castellan Puuba.
c70a8a07f0787fb53902792028285f1ae4989f42.text: 從 Kodlonu Hamlet 輸入 伊斯諾島，然後依照任務標記找到 Rojis。他會要求你殺死位於羅吉斯陣地西南、幾組斯卡萊中間的五隻 11 級曼德拉戈。當你殺死所有五個曼德拉草後，再次與羅吉斯交談，然後返回卡斯特蘭普烏巴。

85cbc7ac36419dc52ebd9dd1f5f3b81cdb92d73c.source: Rojis will appear outside Kamadan with the group of Sunspears during the quest War Preparations (Recruit Training) even if this quest is not completed.
85cbc7ac36419dc52ebd9dd1f5f3b81cdb92d73c.text: 在任務戰爭準備（新兵訓練）期間，即使該任務尚未完成，羅吉斯也會與烈陽之矛隊一起出現在卡馬丹外。

620e0b3aeea21d964a940fe4f854b0cf099c7d8d.source: Completing this quest requires completing the first step in Isle of the Dead; curiously, however, Rojis is part of the Sunspear squad met during that quest in Cliffs of Dohjok, despite being recruited back into the Sunspears in this quest.
620e0b3aeea21d964a940fe4f854b0cf099c7d8d.text: 完成此任務需要完成死亡之島的第一步；然而，奇怪的是，羅吉斯是在 杜夏懸崖 的任務中遇到的烈陽之矛小隊的一員，儘管他在這次任務中被重新招募回烈陽之矛。

4a62bfac15fc75ee2d22f45318e260f0f2d6176b.source: Meet Lieutenant Murunda and her soldiers in the Mirror of Lyss.
4a62bfac15fc75ee2d22f45318e260f0f2d6176b.text: 在里斯之鏡中遇見穆倫達中尉和她計程車兵。

85d65a40bd1089bdce780cd36629c3fee6f28069.source: Kill the demons infesting the Sebelkeh Basilica. 7...0 of 7 groups remain.
85d65a40bd1089bdce780cd36629c3fee6f28069.text: 消滅侵擾塞貝爾克大教堂的惡魔。 7 群組中的 7...0 保留。

e15017f595e5c63f804c390761a60efd76e5b92e.source: Start from Dzagonur Bastion, and meet Lieutenant Murunda just outside in the Mirror of Lyss. After speaking to Murunda, a Vabbi Guard Captain and 4 Vabbi Guards will join your party as allies.
e15017f595e5c63f804c390761a60efd76e5b92e.text: 從 薩崗諾稜堡 出發，在里斯之鏡外與穆倫達中尉會面。與 Murunda 交談後，瓦貝 守衛隊長和 4 瓦貝 守衛將作為盟友加入你的隊伍。

e946a57f5acfcbd0fe47623b511b57fca9f87c75.source: Temple Guardians have less armor rating against cold damage, so consider bringing Winter or skills that deal cold damage. Consider bringing Water Magic hex spells that snare and deal cold damage (i.e. Deep Freeze, Ice Spikes, Mind Freeze, and Shard Storm), which will slow their movement speed and can help in preventing them from reaching your midline/backline and dealing point blank area of effect damage from Temple Guardians' Double Dragon and Quansong Spiritspeak's Ancestors' Rage.
e946a57f5acfcbd0fe47623b511b57fca9f87c75.text: 聖殿守衛的防禦寒冷傷害的護甲等級較低，因此請考慮帶上 寒冬 或造成寒冷傷害的技能。考慮帶 水系魔法 誘捕並造成寒冷傷害的十六進製法術（即 強力凍結 , 冰之尖刺 , 心靈凍結 , 和 冰風暴 ），這會減慢他們的移動速度，並有助於防止他們到達你的中線/後線並造成聖殿守護者的空白區域效果傷害 雙龍 和 通靈者 魁嵩 的 先人的盛怒 。

c3d06df2194df9e28d0bf48c1e753bf3a99378a7.source: Temple Guardians have less armor rating against blunt damage, so consider using a weapon that deals blunt damage.
c3d06df2194df9e28d0bf48c1e753bf3a99378a7.text: 聖殿守衛對鈍器傷害的護甲等級較低，因此請考慮使用造成鈍器傷害的武器。

05f2befbca377024413d56cb97731c3c1ba31ad9.source: Speak to Miner Tonabanza at the Cliffs of Dohjok and tell him you will stand guard while he continues mining.
05f2befbca377024413d56cb97731c3c1ba31ad9.text: 與 杜夏懸崖 的礦工 Tonabanza 交談，並告訴他在他繼續採礦時你將站崗。

ddf0795c9fc183b495a6bf19c026143805fc9354.source: Protect the miner if he gets attacked.
ddf0795c9fc183b495a6bf19c026143805fc9354.text: 如果礦工受到攻擊，請保護他。

1eceece163c9eb7f7a0a31111dc382e691b39f9e.source: From here, it's a simple search and destroy type quest, as you follow the quest pointer to each group of Margonites and defeat them. Be aware that the usual spawns for The Mirror of Lyss will also be present along the way.
1eceece163c9eb7f7a0a31111dc382e691b39f9e.text: 從這裡開始，這是一個簡單的搜尋和摧毀型別的任務，當你跟隨任務指標找到每組瑪貢尼特並擊敗他們。請注意，麗之鏡湖 的常見生成點也會沿途出現。

03cfcfa0d27423c4c655301f37b6c2a8b7e483ce.source: If the Margonite groups are killed out of order, the Vabbi Guard's dialogue appear in a different order as well. Each quote is tied to a specific group.
03cfcfa0d27423c4c655301f37b6c2a8b7e483ce.text: 如果 瑪骨奈 組被無序殺死，瓦貝 守衛的對話也會以不同的順序出現。每個報價都與一個特定的群組相關聯。

b46e95ced7a7378487c4616ff9a9315fed8989ed.source: The Guards will follow you until the quest is finished, which makes Vanquishing this area much easier. While the quest does add the Margonite groups, it also removes most of the Kournan spawns, for only a small overall increase in foes to be vanquished.
b46e95ced7a7378487c4616ff9a9315fed8989ed.text: 守衛會跟著你直到任務完成，這使得征服這個區域變得更容易。雖然該任務確實添加了 瑪骨奈 群體，但它也刪除了大部分 Kournan 生成點，因此被消滅的敵人總體上只增加了一小部分。

918c55b856ebdb3576864ebf000e57372e6ab941.source: The Great Northern Wall mission completed
918c55b856ebdb3576864ebf000e57372e6ab941.text: 北方長城 任務完成

3470fb0690a16621dcf576c41bf969f55ee34dd1.source: Go from town to Old Ascalon and find the Army Recruits.
3470fb0690a16621dcf576c41bf969f55ee34dd1.text: 從城鎮前往 舊阿斯卡隆 並找到陸軍新兵。

cd9408775560960437dfb5e813ff66c7b5afe8a1.source: Lead all three recruits west along the wall to the far gate and present them to Gate Guard Hollis.
cd9408775560960437dfb5e813ff66c7b5afe8a1.text: 帶領所有三名新兵沿著牆壁向西到達遠處的大門，並將他們交給 城門警衛哈利斯。

344bccbacdc692b80695668b01b914bbf2dc0593.source: Speak to Gate Guard Hollis for your reward.
344bccbacdc692b80695668b01b914bbf2dc0593.text: 與 城門警衛哈利斯 聯絡以獲得獎勵。

1614c3401bb3ebedcd880fa7f164c591b3aafd03.source: Start from Ascalon City. Outside you will meet three Army Recruits, who will follow you automatically. The recruits tend to lag behind the party, and all three must survive to complete the quest, so take care while escorting them. Head to the entrance to The Breach, where Gate Guard Hollis stands, but do not go through. The quest will be updated when the three recruits have arrived.
1614c3401bb3ebedcd880fa7f164c591b3aafd03.text: 從 阿斯卡隆城 開始。在外面你會遇到三名陸軍新兵，他們會自動跟著你。新兵往往落後於隊伍，三人必須生存才能完成任務，所以護送他們時要小心。前往 缺口 的入口，城門警衛哈利斯 就在那裡，但不要穿過。當三名新兵到達時，任務將會更新。

12f192044112a7dceefb804c86de842d390363c3.source: The recruits will stop moving during combat and do not fight back if attacked.
12f192044112a7dceefb804c86de842d390363c3.text: 新兵在戰鬥中會停止移動，如果受到攻擊也不會反擊。

c1ba5c38acf1c0a2b7a46cf4fe10ca059724b2a8.source: Speak to Guardsman Pah about filling out the ministry's scrollwork.
c1ba5c38acf1c0a2b7a46cf4fe10ca059724b2a8.text: 與衛兵帕交談，瞭解如何填寫該部的捲軸。

ed917ec8636affe664003cc4d9a5a5a6e8eb77c7.source: This quest is quite easy, all it requires is for you to retrace your path taken in the previous quest back to Guardsman Pah.
ed917ec8636affe664003cc4d9a5a5a6e8eb77c7.text: 這個任務很簡單，只需要你沿著上一個任務中的路徑回到衛兵帕。

bd657399dbe104a0cc574af106268ccecac3a27d.source: Alternatively, map travel to Nahpui Quarter and return into Wajjun Bazaar to Guardsman Pah.
bd657399dbe104a0cc574af106268ccecac3a27d.text: 或者，透過地圖前往 納普區，然後返回 瓦江市場 前往 Guardsman Pah。

6ccff4861c426256f644826710b8bf66c5774cfb.source: This quest appears to be mutually exclusive with the Imperial Assistance quest.
6ccff4861c426256f644826710b8bf66c5774cfb.text: 任務似乎與帝國援助任務相互排斥。

edde32d0968c143e0072c7701c6dc66127734bd2.text: 在 孫江行政區 認識 Zenmai。

950463ec20d36abe21a45b3d1d3fffb0f36da8e4.source: Talk to Yayoi of the Orders.

60c2781b7ed1ec4e9c77024e4225c5ec9c91b932.source: Talk to Chow Zhong the Inferno.
60c2781b7ed1ec4e9c77024e4225c5ec9c91b932.text: 與 地獄火 周忠交談。

03563c432538cf980d2ba01a04e10e97e3e9d378.source: Talk to Gao Han of the Rings.

444e8f09cfad231100a8d8752b20fa78f3be60f2.source: Talk to Disciple of Shadow Feung Zhu.
444e8f09cfad231100a8d8752b20fa78f3be60f2.text: 與 闇影 Feung Zhu 的弟子交談。

a400d8fe34927be01abc36867f35e6611ce13a0e.source: Talk to Min the Dragon's Claw.

96fd1cc2398c2e0c7492817911a451cf207fad0e.source: While this quest is active, the Shiro'ken bosses in Sunjiang District do not spawn.
96fd1cc2398c2e0c7492817911a451cf207fad0e.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，孫江行政區 中的 白影軍團 首領不會產生。

1721778f83beff84a6cee81bc5a7f67a81d31410.source: Start from Zin Ku Corridor and head out a short distance to meet up with Zenmai, who is having a conversation with Daisuke Crimson Edge. The Ministry of Purity will approach soon; kill them and Zenmai will join as an ally.
1721778f83beff84a6cee81bc5a7f67a81d31410.text: 從辛庫走廊出發，走出一小段距離，與正在與緋紅之刃大輔對話的善舞會面。純潔部即將到來；殺死他們，善邁就會作為盟友加入。

0e09a1c6d34d5dbb6c8f6d135a536827d9e64447.source: Your task now is to lead Zenmai to find her friends in the Am Fah. Keep an eye on her as she has a tendency to get stuck on chests and be left behind. The Ministry of Purity are hostile to Am Fah groups, so try to take advantage of this. The mobs are spaced out enough that you mostly do not need to worry about over-aggro.
0e09a1c6d34d5dbb6c8f6d135a536827d9e64447.text: 你現在的任務是帶領 Zenmai 在 安費 中找到她的朋友。密切注意她，因為她很容易被卡在箱子上而被拋在後面。純潔部對 安費 團體懷有敵意，因此請嘗試利用這一點。怪物之間的距離夠遠，你基本上不需要擔心過度仇恨。

fb59cc714197743dbeb5c185d5eee4317632aeab.source: Refer to the map for the shortest path to reach all of Zenmai's friends. She must get within range before the quest update will trigger. Each of her friends will turn hostile at end of a dialogue. Four of them, when defeated, will turn into allies. Of particular note is Chow Zhong the Inferno - spread out your group before his dialogue ends because he uses PBAoE skills.
fb59cc714197743dbeb5c185d5eee4317632aeab.text: 請參閱地圖，瞭解到達 Zenmai 所有朋友的最短路徑。她必須進入射程內，任務更新才會觸發。她的每個朋友在對話結束後都會變得充滿敵意。其中四個被擊敗後將成為盟友。特別值得注意的是 地獄火 的周忠 - 在他的對話結束之前分散你的團隊，因為他使用 PBAoE 技能。

f3f8485a2f14123891a8dc572281631a9e60375e.source: After Chow Zhong, you will run into two groups of Ministry, led by the ranger and assassin bosses.
f3f8485a2f14123891a8dc572281631a9e60375e.text: 在周忠之後，你將遇到由遊俠和刺客頭目領導的兩組部門。

d10fb0b958d9dcc41bf7942eead8fa1b35829f0b.source: At the last point on the map, where Min the Dragon's Claw is located, the dialogue will trigger the spawning of two large groups of Ministry, led by the remaining two bosses. Right before they turn hostile, friendly Am Fah will show up. You can either let the Am Fah weaken the Ministry for you first, or just join in the fray. Once all hostiles are dead, the quest is complete.
d10fb0b958d9dcc41bf7942eead8fa1b35829f0b.text: 在地圖上的最後一個點，即龍爪敏所在的地方，對話將觸發由剩下的兩個 Boss 領導的兩大部落的生成。就在他們變得敵對之前，友善的 安費 將會出現。你可以讓 安費 先為你削弱魔法部，或是直接加入戰鬥。一旦所有敵人都死了，任務就完成了。

1231e152aec80646133dc4da116fe9420a69c673.source: For players without Guild Wars Nightfall, the Sunspear that Zenmai mentions in her opening dialogue refers to a prominent NPC in the Nightfall campaign.
1231e152aec80646133dc4da116fe9420a69c673.text: 對於沒有 公會 戰爭 黑暗逆襲 的玩家來說，Zenmai 在開頭對話中提到的陽矛指的是 黑暗逆襲 戰役中的一個著名 NPC。

2d13bbe7a8b63f3b54815335d0e414c182cfaeae.source: If any of the Am Fah allies recruited in this quest die in combat, their "death" will count as a morale boost, and you will be able to capture their skills. They will still self-resurrect after a period of time.
2d13bbe7a8b63f3b54815335d0e414c182cfaeae.text: 如果在此任務中招募的任何 安費 盟友在戰鬥中死亡，他們的「死亡」將算作士氣提升，您將能夠獲得他們的技能。一段時間後它們仍然會自我復活。

93b39152827cbc8fe9f78ce64d1ff68bb133b61d.source: As per the normal mode version, refer to the map for the locations of the quest NPCs. Take note that their locations are different compared to normal mode.
93b39152827cbc8fe9f78ce64d1ff68bb133b61d.text: 和普通模式版本一樣，任務NPC的位置請參考地圖。請注意，它們的位置與正常模式不同。

e98a69f82a9d2e82b3aec3e52a3ca350e0822fb4.source: Another difference is that as Zenmai approaches each quest NPC, the moment the dialog triggers, a group of Am Fah will spawn near the boss. They turn hostile the moment the boss turns hostile. Consider placing spirits and flagging heroes apart before letting Zenmai trigger the dialogue.
e98a69f82a9d2e82b3aec3e52a3ca350e0822fb4.text: 另一個差異是，當 Zenmai 接近每個任務 NPC 時，對話觸發的那一刻，一群 安費 會在 Boss 附近產生。當老闆變得敵對時，他們就會變得敵對。在讓善邁觸發對話之前，請考慮將靈魂和標記英雄分開。

2f0c8f6f59036230f8f6fe70ee02654c9f4d6f85.source: The ambush at the end of the quest, although in a different location, is the same. It is best to quickly move away from the Min's location, where the Ministry will converge. Let Daisuke's Am Fah take the brunt of the attack before joining in.
2f0c8f6f59036230f8f6fe70ee02654c9f4d6f85.text: 任務最後的伏擊雖然地點不同，但都是一樣的。最好趕緊離開敏的位置，那裡是部會匯聚的地方。讓大輔的安費在加入之前首當其沖地受到攻擊。

9fd5657dafb19dac28090176b109fd1982ae5440.source: The locations of the quest NPCs are different compared to the normal mode version.
9fd5657dafb19dac28090176b109fd1982ae5440.text: 與普通模式版本相比，任務 NPC 的位置有所不同。

83610c246ff5c3839b0d3ea352462f42efcf7740.source: The first time each boss ally dies, the party gains a morale boost.
83610c246ff5c3839b0d3ea352462f42efcf7740.text: 每個首領盟友第一次死亡時，隊伍計程車氣都會提升。

34a963e61c469d34f379dd747481f1b2f2b27e97.source: Including enemies defeated during the quest, there are 223-227 enemies to vanquish in this area while the quest is active.
34a963e61c469d34f379dd747481f1b2f2b27e97.text: 包括在任務中擊敗的敵人在內，當任務處於活動狀態時，該區域有 223-227 個敵人需要消滅。

05464b406f7878294ab55d59fed48d839dcc9323.source: Clear Reed Bog in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode.
05464b406f7878294ab55d59fed48d839dcc9323.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 梅古瑪叢林 中的 蘆葦沼澤。

c2bc8de8d962d8cf6ec7a018d0929fbaaa1fb7eb.source: "Clear Reed Bog in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."
c2bc8de8d962d8cf6ec7a018d0929fbaaa1fb7eb.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的梅古瑪叢林中的蘆葦沼澤。”

155ad2e31fb8c8414a781e6d4d67a99e1898c284.source: Start from Ventari's Refuge and travel south through Ettin's Back. The secondary quest Dropping Eaves given outside Ventari's Refuge will lead here.
155ad2e31fb8c8414a781e6d4d67a99e1898c284.text: 從 凡特里避難所 出發，往南穿過 雙頭怪隱匿地。 凡特里避難所 外部給予的次要任務 掉落的屋簷 將引導至此處。

6c9b3b58dd1bc5591c4a4a73e0243dab1d156a53.source: Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.6% to the Tyrian Cartographer title.
6c9b3b58dd1bc5591c4a4a73e0243dab1d156a53.text: 對該領域的完整探索為 Tyrian 版圖 標題做出了大約 0.6% 的貢獻。

4785b9fc815d2d83ac19e3962b3a8a808e1ed120.source: Minion masters should be aware that the Moss Scarabs will steal minions using Verata's Gaze.
4785b9fc815d2d83ac19e3962b3a8a808e1ed120.text: 小兵大師應該意識到苔蘚聖甲蟲會使用 芙瑞達的凝視 偷走小兵。

05972f3c0c36487385c8fab9b2c090c9a40bcde4.source: Most foes in the area are hidden.
05972f3c0c36487385c8fab9b2c090c9a40bcde4.text: 該地區的大多數敵人都是隱藏的。

23fca5fe9a833aa47fe03589c717c526942a6613.source: The northern path has many hidden Moss Scarabs.
23fca5fe9a833aa47fe03589c717c526942a6613.text: 北邊的小路有許多隱藏的苔蘚聖甲蟲。

e50c9546290cf16750b7e910fcdeaffa64dab1ce.source: The southern path has many hidden Maguuma Spiders and Life Pods.
e50c9546290cf16750b7e910fcdeaffa64dab1ce.text: 南邊的小路有許多隱藏的 梅古瑪 Spider 和 生命 Pod。

8e1b615201c664d735e5fe3ab672f5f1ad89c5cd.source: Defeat Primeval King Jahnus and his royal guards.
8e1b615201c664d735e5fe3ab672f5f1ad89c5cd.text: 擊敗原始國王賈努斯和他的皇家衛隊。

7bb349b34240f3f7faffeacd3e993291adfbbb6e.source: Find Myrish, the leader of the slave spirits, and tell him of King Jahnus' demise.
7bb349b34240f3f7faffeacd3e993291adfbbb6e.text: 找到奴隸靈魂的首領密裡什，並告訴他雅努斯國王的滅亡。

4c0022ce5b0a0898ff841f4bc70e9cd2580e7ba2.source: Right after taking the quest, King Jahnus and his guards will turn hostile. You just need to kill the king to get the first objective. It's a relatively easy fight.
4c0022ce5b0a0898ff841f4bc70e9cd2580e7ba2.text: 接受任務後，雅努斯國王和他的衛兵就會變得敵對。你只需要殺死國王即可獲得第一個目標。這是一場相對容易的戰鬥。

c60f524b65d068ab68418c58abc5e51ef2a6dd75.source: Both this quest and its sister quest, Destroy the Ungrateful Slaves, give the same rewards.
c60f524b65d068ab68418c58abc5e51ef2a6dd75.text: 這個任務和它的姊妹任務「消滅忘恩負義的奴隸」都提供相同的獎勵。

63645ed519a72ac2aa31a1fddaa676660054e022.source: Immediately after accepting this quest, the king and his guards will become hostile.
63645ed519a72ac2aa31a1fddaa676660054e022.text: 接受這個任務後，國王和他的衛兵就會立刻變得敵對。

ac9c9735b79ed9ee767f6e33a73931976a1a0240.source: Bring the Chalice of Corruption to the Imperial Agent Hanjo.
ac9c9735b79ed9ee767f6e33a73931976a1a0240.text: 將腐敗聖杯交給帝國特工半條。

858dff6cd25987b5ae1e2404beb8ae42907860a7.source: Just speak with Imperial Agent Hanjo in Kaineng Center.
858dff6cd25987b5ae1e2404beb8ae42907860a7.text: 只需與 凱寧中心 中的帝國特工 Hanjo 交談即可。

08be9c271f9140e406a235e7e52cec2534dd5530.source: Accepting this quest will turn all the surrounding Am Fah hostile.
08be9c271f9140e406a235e7e52cec2534dd5530.text: 接受此任務將使周圍的所有 安費 變得充滿敵意。

bbde51aa0daebc0e424f1826ddf3edcdc90ed1c3.source: When the Am Fah become hostile, you can just map travel to Kaineng Center to see Imperial Agent Hanjo for your reward.
bbde51aa0daebc0e424f1826ddf3edcdc90ed1c3.text: 當 安費 變得敵對時，您可以將旅行對映到 凱寧中心 去見帝國特工 Hanjo 以獲得獎勵。

689b60114dc39e2dfc033ac13a46c6ba1fc87c13.source: Once this quest is completed, your character can no longer complete the Drink from the Chalice of Corruption quest.
689b60114dc39e2dfc033ac13a46c6ba1fc87c13.text: 一旦完成此任務，你的角色就無法再完成「腐化聖杯的飲料」任務。

59ecb063ae326cf8c46c1c50af587ccdd29051cb.source: Upon turning hostile, many of the Am Fah, especially the Marksmen will fall victim to the numerous traps they set while friendly.
59ecb063ae326cf8c46c1c50af587ccdd29051cb.text: 一旦轉為敵對，許多 安費，尤其是射手，將成為他們在友善時設定的眾多陷阱的受害者。

a004113a88a540421e7cb8b1efb621c4dae35d93.source: Clear the Regent Valley in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode.
a004113a88a540421e7cb8b1efb621c4dae35d93.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 統治者之谷。

702010afdefd4d4c3562be223c9ec9fa395caa68.source: "Clear the Regent Valley in Ascalon of all enemies in hard mode."
702010afdefd4d4c3562be223c9ec9fa395caa68.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 阿斯卡隆 中的 統治者之谷。”

4ba3761a275b8e7021f1802a0bb166b13305fbe2.source: There are many secondary quests that will lead to this area. It lies to the southeast of Old Ascalon and leads to Fort Ranik in its northeastern corner.
4ba3761a275b8e7021f1802a0bb166b13305fbe2.text: 有許多次要任務會通往這個區域。它位於 舊阿斯卡隆 的東南方，通往其東北角的拉尼克堡。

3af6ba5e1e22522674ad2d22efbe05873815e3d5.source: If entering from Fort Ranik, a small group of soldiers can be seen engaging either the renegades or a group of Charr.
3af6ba5e1e22522674ad2d22efbe05873815e3d5.text: 如果從拉尼克堡進入，可以看到一小群士兵正在與叛徒或一群 夏爾 交戰。

7733ca5a09d6d2432a6e1a0772b7e834c6740dad.source: You can obtain a Moa Egg (required to hatch a Black Moa Chick) in the southeastern section, near a large number of Moas.
7733ca5a09d6d2432a6e1a0772b7e834c6740dad.text: 您可以在東南部靠近大量恐鳥的地方獲得恐鳥蛋（孵化 黑恐鳥 小雞所需）。

d6f7ad1d4c8f9a0aa75175649d834758efb6b68a.source: Vanquishing: 129–178 foes. There are many hidden Devourers in this area.
d6f7ad1d4c8f9a0aa75175649d834758efb6b68a.text: 擊敗：129–178 敵人。這個區域有很多隱藏的蠍。

596208edd99b91b8933703a7145e4cf6fe1f9cac.source: The Renegade Elementalists have Mind Burn in hard mode, a powerful area of effect spell.
596208edd99b91b8933703a7145e4cf6fe1f9cac.text: 叛徒元素師在困難模式下擁有 心靈燃燒，這是一個強大的區域效果法術。

00de76a8ed58cbc7c4284c7e696380cc00fb6b7e.source: The fog in the northwest corner of the map does not uncover for an unknown reason, so it will not look like it is explored on the map; exploring this part will still add to your Cartographer title.
00de76a8ed58cbc7c4284c7e696380cc00fb6b7e.text: 地圖西北角的迷霧不知為何沒有被揭開，所以在地圖上看起來不會像是被探索過；探索這部分仍然會新增到您的 版圖 標題中。

c6bd9205dfba9f6e28cf951a42ee820e4ed25697.source: At the exit to Pockmark Flats the shrine on the other side looks destroyed with both arches incomplete but when changing the area the shrine is complete and working.
c6bd9205dfba9f6e28cf951a42ee820e4ed25697.text: 在 麻點平原 的出口處，另一側的神殿看起來已被摧毀，兩個拱門都不完整，但當更改區域時，神殿已完成並正常工作。

6d851e90761999d8e13eb224513dbd99e7f421c1.text: 搜尋 王者之眼 尋找 夏爾。

f3e305f1a98baa7d232e58b03f237c3a0c9563e0.source: See Lord Darrin for your reward.
f3e305f1a98baa7d232e58b03f237c3a0c9563e0.text: 去見達林勳爵以獲得獎勵。

169a7d98e2d8f92eb14467db5050bd8e2fae2fb3.text: Charrslaying 的 長弓（半月弓 皮膚）

fc6b7d2bba49066a08d08fa4ab65137a1ea21409.source: After obtaining the quest from Sergeant Brannen just outside Fort Ranik, head to King's Watch in Regent Valley. A group of four Charr will be waiting at the marked location, but they do not need to be killed. The quest will update upon reaching the quest marker, and you can map travel back to Fort Ranik for the reward.
fc6b7d2bba49066a08d08fa4ab65137a1ea21409.text: 從拉尼克堡外的布蘭寧中士處獲得任務後，前往 統治者之谷 中的 王者之眼。一群四人的 夏爾 將在標記的位置等待，但不需要殺死他們。任務將在到達任務標記後更新，您可以在地圖上返回拉尼克堡以獲得獎勵。

bc584dfedec6c54e307f82fcf0aaee915e867705.source: This quest combines well with Cities of Ascalon and The Red-Cloaked Deserter as all three require traveling to King's Watch.
bc584dfedec6c54e307f82fcf0aaee915e867705.text: 任務與 阿斯卡隆的城市 和 紅鬥蓬的背叛者 完美結合，因為這三個任務都需要前往 王者之眼。

fbba1a4b391ec0d3e2b8920981d847f07f24babc.source: Start from Lost Soul [Challenge Mission Starter] located in Remains of Sahlahja.
fbba1a4b391ec0d3e2b8920981d847f07f24babc.text: 從位於 Sahlahja 遺跡的 失魂者 [挑戰任務 Starter] 出發。

111880d39df1b664567b250e1e515157f9aeb0c0.source: Evade angry ghosts and cleanse the tombs by killing the insects that have infested the area.
111880d39df1b664567b250e1e515157f9aeb0c0.text: 透過殺死出沒該地區的昆蟲來躲避憤怒的鬼魂並清理墳墓。

f526de747cf2c81adc94ed0bc81831e6cbf57d65.source: Evade the ghosts of the primeval kings.

d8d1b3919fff96b4c49f49b9b5f1587920a26bda.text: 殺死感染者以獲得積分。

b673033da58beb846be3c0848e497b3f5192c040.source: Kill greater infestations to earn points and gain the temporary ability to harm ghosts.
b673033da58beb846be3c0848e497b3f5192c040.text: 殺死更大的感染者以獲得分數並獲得傷害鬼魂的臨時能力。

5d42c70a9eae5e8ae01bff804096464bbd0ea3a7.source: Destroy lost souls to free their spirits and earn points.
5d42c70a9eae5e8ae01bff804096464bbd0ea3a7.text: 摧毀迷失的靈魂以釋放他們的靈魂並賺取分數。

27cca2b89ddfe22ae3cb418937589db51dce0d9b.source: Earn 15 points to unlock access to each section of the tombs.
27cca2b89ddfe22ae3cb418937589db51dce0d9b.text: 賺取 15 積分來解鎖進入古墓各部分的許可權。

1b919b0ee0838f6d932adf41e358d62e5b0df93d.source: For every Maddened Spirit that you kill, you have a chance of acquiring an Ancient Armor Remnant (each of these allows you to upgrade the visual appearance of hero armor; you can add statues of heroes with upgraded armor to the Hall of Monuments).
1b919b0ee0838f6d932adf41e358d62e5b0df93d.text: 對於您殺死的每個瘋狂靈魂，您都有機會獲得古代 防禦 遺跡（其中每一個都可以讓您升級英雄盔甲的視覺外觀；您可以將具有升級盔甲的英雄雕像新增到 史蹟殿堂）。

0de85d53ca01e4dd7500a2aa60952b4ceee155a0.source: During the mission, you will suffer from Corrupted Lands, which causes a constant Health degeneration of 1 pip. This can be hard to mitigate because your ability to heal is limited by spending most of the mission riding a Junundu. There are 5 different areas in this challenge. You start out in the center and have 4 locked doors to the other areas at the beginning. For every 15 points you earn you unlock a new section. You earn points by defeating various enemies during the mission
0de85d53ca01e4dd7500a2aa60952b4ceee155a0.text: 在任務期間，您將遭受腐化土地的影響，這會導致 體力衰減效果 或 1 點數不斷增加。這可能很難緩解，因為你的治療能力因大部分任務都騎在朱南杜而受到限制。此挑戰中有 5 不同的領域。您從中心開始，4 在開始時鎖定了通往其他區域的門。您賺取的每一個 15 積分都可以解鎖一個新部分。您可以透過在任務期間擊敗各種敵人來獲得積分

5f8db5aa7c9f082b7db41f9b7df7352731be1118.text: 感染（1 點、1 光明使者點）

bd884884572d4f7ebbd1e87e1a942c56e9674755.text: 更大的感染（3 點、3 光明使者點）

155e660c9a6498099ad7b7ec5ce91ae8a5dea5ab.text: 瘋狂之靈（4 積分、4 光明使者積分）

1184c51c39a2beeb786d4821822dc41d55ba7fcc.text: 失魂者（8 積分、8 光明使者積分）

fe6907a224ffd6b132443ade873ade2b86ee86a6.source: The Maddened Spirits deal 700 damage and are invincible unless you are enchanted with Spirit Form, which lasts for a short period after killing a Greater Infestation while within a Junundu. You get the most points for defeating Lost Souls, which spawn at random locations on the map.
fe6907a224ffd6b132443ade873ade2b86ee86a6.text: 瘋狂的靈魂會造成 700 傷害並且是無敵的，除非你被靈魂形態附魔，在朱南杜殺死一隻大感染者後，靈魂形態會持續很短一段時間。擊敗失落的靈魂會獲得最多的積分，失落的靈魂會在地圖上的隨機位置產生。

ed97c58567fa7cfe5a60ad68c7ebdb5d051ee72d.source: The Paragon skill, "Can't Touch This!", will protect you from the Maddened Spirit's Maddened Strike (but you can only kill a Maddened Spirit while inside a wurm — and you can enter a wurm while being attacked by Maddened Spirit, unlike with any other creature).
ed97c58567fa7cfe5a60ad68c7ebdb5d051ee72d.text: 聖言者 技能「不能碰這個！」將保護你免受瘋狂之靈的瘋狂打擊（但你只能在亞龍體內殺死瘋狂之靈——並且你可以在被瘋狂之靈攻擊時進入亞龍，這與任何其他生物不同）。

386c0a6d6824a9492fad089a77c13020f15f8330.source: The best method to get Armor Remnants is to camp near a Greater Infestation and keep it near death as you kill Infestations. Keep an eye on your radar and watch for a moving red dot, then as the Maddened Spirit gets near you kill the Greater Infestation. You should then be able to kill the spirit and move on to camp the next Greater Infestation.
386c0a6d6824a9492fad089a77c13020f15f8330.text: 獲得 防禦 殘餘物的最佳方法是在大型感染者附近紮營，並在殺死感染者時使其接近死亡。密切注意你的雷達並注意移動的紅點，然後當瘋狂的靈魂接近你時殺死更大的感染。然後你應該能夠殺死靈魂並繼續前往下一個大感染的營地。

5a0437cf67e7ef7164a49f203a602917bfbd44bd.source: For souls on rocky ground, have at least 2 aggro circles' distance between you and the spirits before having the wurm spit you out. You will need a running skill (perhaps two) and enough damage to kill the soul quickly.
5a0437cf67e7ef7164a49f203a602917bfbd44bd.text: 對於岩石地面上的靈魂，在讓亞龍把你吐出來之前，你和靈魂之間至少有 2 仇恨圈的距離。你需要一個跑步技能（也許兩個）和足夠的傷害來快速殺死靈魂。

79079f317339504b9f641495dd4fbec21fad152d.source: To heal you can either build up your adrenaline and use Junundu Smash to KD a mob then use Junundu Bite (given that the first attack doesn't kill your target) to heal for 500 hp. You can also use Junundu Tunnel then use Junundu Bite to knock down and heal for 500 hp. You can also use Junundu Wail to heal for 500 hp if there are no enemies near you. The best way to heal is to exit your wurm and get a new wurm, but you are very vulnerable while doing this so make sure you have at least two aggro circles' distance between you and the spirits before you try this.
