9def1935d5ae6685d7c880f0aafb479770b9728f.source: As an alternative to fleeing across the lake, you may retreat back into the cave until the Mursaat patrol has moved ahead of the party. They will clear out the Stone Summit foes on the path, but they might stop moving when they reach Darda Goldenchief. If they stop at this boss, they will need to be killed. They can be pulled into separate groups of six Mursaat each, and if you are patient a nearby catapult will thin their numbers. Try to avoid letting Evennia aggro the Mursaat; in particular, the party member whom she is following should not be the one to pull. Regardless, the Mursaat that remain alive will need to be killed, before you reach the boat.
9def1935d5ae6685d7c880f0aafb479770b9728f.text: 作為逃離湖面的替代方案，您可以撤退到洞穴中，直到 馬賽特 巡邏隊移動到隊伍前面。他們將清除路徑上的 石峰矮人 敵人，但當到達 金首達勒塔 時可能會停止移動。如果他們停在這個頭目面前，他們就需要被殺死。它們可以分成單獨的群組，每組有 6 個 馬賽特，如果你有耐心，附近的彈射器會減少它們的數量。盡量避免讓 伊凡妮雅 攻擊 馬賽特；尤其是她所跟隨的黨員，更不該是拉的人。無論如何，在你到達船上之前，仍然活著的 馬賽特 需要被殺死。

772b52e366fc9863d30a18b51021d6fdbf0b716d.source: All paths converge here. Upon reaching the wide open area with the closed door, several Stone Rain, two Stone Reapers and one Stone Soul will emerge from the stone pillars and gather around the Stone Judge boss. Try to intercept and take down one or two of the Stone Rains spawning next to you before they can join the group. Kill the Stone Judge last unless the Rains are overwhelming the party, since killing him causes Danika to rush towards the door to attempt to open it - whereby she aggros two Stone Crushers who awaken beside the doorway, and all surviving Elementals will also rush towards the door. Kill these to prevent them from interrupting Danika. The mission ends when Danika successfully opens the door, though this might be delayed a bit if she gets hit by falling boulders while opening it.
772b52e366fc9863d30a18b51021d6fdbf0b716d.text: 所有路徑都匯聚於此。到達大門緊閉的開放區域後，數臺 石之雨、2 臺石收割者和 1 臺 石之靈 將從石柱中出現，並聚集在石判 Boss 周圍。在石雨加入隊伍之前，試著攔截並擊倒在你旁邊生成的一兩個石雨。最後殺死石頭審判者，除非雨勢壓倒了隊伍，因為殺死他會導致丹妮卡衝向門試圖開啟它——她會激怒兩個在門口醒來的碎石者，所有倖存的元素也會沖向門。殺死他們以防止他們打擾丹妮卡。當丹妮卡成功開啟門時任務結束，儘管如果她在開啟門時被落下的巨石擊中，任務可能會延遲一點。

If your guild is allied with the Kurzicks, you can still participate in Alliance Battles since you can convert the Imperial faction to Luxon faction via Hei Tsu. Some quests that reward Luxon faction are repeatable.

4310974875b1cf339830ee1fc05a910f44f93e19.source:
To use a Signet of Capture which you received from Minister Jaisan, you need to equip it on the skill bar and find a suitable powerful foe, or in other words, a boss with corresponding profession. Many bosses can be found in three explorable areas which are accessible after you have arrived at Kaineng: Bukdek Byway, Wajjun Bazaar and The Undercity. Also, bosses with all Factions professions can be met while doing the mission Vizunah Square. You may capture any skill from a boss, however, capturing an elite skill is preferable because you get the additional experience and powerful skill as well.

 Upon capturing this skill, you will have completed the quest. Then you see Minister Jaisan; as your reward, you get a second signet of capture, 2,500 Experience and you may keep the skill you captured in order to complete the quest.
4310974875b1cf339830ee1fc05a910f44f93e19.text:
要使用從 Jaisan 部長那裡得到的 捕捉紋章，你需要將其裝備到技能欄上，並找到合適的強大敵人，或者換句話說，是具有相應職業的 BOSS。許多老闆可以在到達凱能後進入的三個可探索區域中找到：巴德克小徑、瓦江市場 和 地下城。此外，在執行 薇茹廣場 任務時可以遇到所有 盟與敵 職業的頭目。您可以從老闆那裡獲得任何技能，但是，獲得精英技能會更好，因為您還可以獲得額外的經驗和強大的技能。

 掌握此技能後，您將完成任務。然後你會看到 Jaisan 部長；作為獎勵，您將獲得第二個捕獲徽章，2,500 經驗值，並且您可以保留捕獲的技能來完成任務。

39b3706f67fee86e221ccb3927fc34d6f06d190a.source: The best method for gaining points is seeking and killing Lost Souls. Kill the first few Maddened Spirits until you have unlocked two areas. Then, start running in your wurm through the areas. There are three spawn points in the northwestern corner (one on rocky ground), three in the northeastern corner, one in the southeastern corner (on rocky ground) and two in the southwestern corner. When you start running, go through each area methodically, scanning for lost souls. Do not fight the Spirits. Let them chase you and use your tunnel skill to keep ahead of them. When you find a lost soul, make sure you have some space between you and the spirits before you kill it. Then, tunnel quickly away. This will take a while, but done effectively you can rack up many points.
39b3706f67fee86e221ccb3927fc34d6f06d190a.text: 獲得積分的最佳方法是尋找並殺死失落的靈魂。殺死前幾個瘋狂的靈魂，直到你解鎖兩個區域。然後，開始在你的亞龍中奔跑穿過這些區域。西北角有 3 個生成點（1 個在岩石地面上），東北角有 3 個，東南角有 1 個（岩石地面），西南角有 2 個。當你開始跑步時，有條不紊地穿過每個區域，尋找迷失的靈魂。不要與靈魂對抗。讓他們追你，並利用你的隧道技巧保持領先。當你發現一個迷失的靈魂時，在殺死它之前確保你和靈魂之間有一些距離。然後，快速地隧道離開。這將需要一段時間，但如果做得有效，您可以獲得很多積分。
39b3706f67fee86e221ccb3927fc34d6f06d190a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5f1bb336baaa91a0622a9ca40a1cd8b441ba2fae.source: Head east along the beach of North Kryta Province and enter Scoundrel's Rise. Just as you enter you will see Settlement Scout Drew (if he dies you cannot complete the quest until you zone somewhere, luckily he stands right next to a portal). He will point you in the direction of Lord Timot, a zombie boss who you must kill to complete the quest. Proceed east until you can travel south into a dead-end swamp where the boss will be located. The route is guarded by 4 Executioners who may prove difficult to take down if faced all at once. Timot himself can be found at the bottom of the path together with some Smoke Phantoms.
5f1bb336baaa91a0622a9ca40a1cd8b441ba2fae.text: 沿著 科瑞塔北部 海灘向東行駛，進入 惡漢山丘。當你進入時，你會看到定居點偵察兵德魯（如果他死了，你就無法完成任務，直到你在某個地方區域，幸運的是他就站在傳送門旁邊）。他會為你指示蒂莫特領主的方向，你必須殺死他才能完成任務。向東前進，直到你可以向南進入一個死衚衕沼澤，老闆將在那裡。這條路線由 4 劊子手把守，如果同時面對他們，可能很難將其擊倒。蒂莫特本人和一些煙霧幻影就在道路的底部。
5f1bb336baaa91a0622a9ca40a1cd8b441ba2fae.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2abc07f71175d7322ed415bf063a10a01791549b.source: When you enter the dead-end swamp, Lord Timot and the Executioners will begin moving out towards you, leaving the rest of the undead behind. The Executioners move much more slowly than their Lord, passing them at the swamp's entrance, so you can wait for them to separate in order to kill Timot without his guardsmen. Once outside, Lord Timot will turn southeast and march towards the Gates of Kryta, eventually becoming unreachable when he moves beyond the portal. Consider pre-clearing the large clump of enemies just east of the swamp entrance to make sure you can safely catch up with Lord Timot if you intend to let him move away from the Executioners before engaging him.
2abc07f71175d7322ed415bf063a10a01791549b.text: 當你進入死衚衕的沼澤時，蒂莫特領主和劊子手們將開始向你移動，將其餘的不死族拋在身後。劊子手的移動速度比他們的領主慢得多，在沼澤入口處經過他們，所以你可以等待他們分開，以便在沒有衛兵的情況下殺死蒂莫特。一旦到達外面，蒂莫特勳爵將轉向東南並向 科瑞塔關所 進軍，最終當他越過傳送門時就變得無法到達。考慮預先清除沼澤入口東邊的一大群敵人，以確保你可以安全地追上蒂莫特領主，如果你想讓他在與劊子手交戰之前離開劊子手的話。
2abc07f71175d7322ed415bf063a10a01791549b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f6b72f52cf7880e9c4280c4ab36d978f9207c0cb.source: When the mission begins, you will be in the town of Beetletun. White Mantle soldiers will threaten villagers on the east side of the mission map. Position Miku close to them during their speech and when they become hostile, kill them as quickly as possible. Keep using Nature's Blessing to heal the villagers; all survivors will assist you in the battles that follow. Following the initial fight, Keiran will receive an additional shout, "There's Nothing to Fear!"; use it often on both sides of the village to increase the durability of your allies.
f6b72f52cf7880e9c4280c4ab36d978f9207c0cb.text: 當任務開始時，你將到達 甲蟲鎮 鎮。 白斗篷 士兵將威脅任務地圖東側的村民。在他們講話時讓 Miku 靠近他們，當他們變得有敵意時，盡快殺死他們。繼續使用大自然的祝福來治癒村民；所有倖存者都會在接下來的戰鬥中協助你。在最初的戰鬥之後，凱蘭將額外聽到一聲喊叫：「沒什麼好害怕的！」；經常在村莊兩側使用它來增加盟友的耐用性。
f6b72f52cf7880e9c4280c4ab36d978f9207c0cb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8fa510440aa5f137de557e8e6ecc3b43fc76f142.source: Six waves of enemies will then attack alternating sides of the village: waves 1 and 3 come from the Nebo side; waves 2 and 4 come from the Watchtower side; and waves 5 and 6 come nearly simultaneously from both sides. Avoid the front lines, so that you can cover as many villagers as possible with Keiran's shout and stance. Use interrupts frequently, and watch out for minion-producing necromancers that hide outside the village.
8fa510440aa5f137de557e8e6ecc3b43fc76f142.text: 然後，六波敵人會交替攻擊村莊的兩側：1 和 3 來自 Nebo 一側；波 2 和 4 來自瞭望塔一側； 5 和 6 波幾乎同時從兩側傳來。避開前線，這樣你就可以用凱蘭的喊聲和姿態覆蓋盡可能多的村民。經常使用打斷，並提防隱藏在村外的生產小兵的死靈法師。
8fa510440aa5f137de557e8e6ecc3b43fc76f142.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ebb323889c80db741f8fcd45eb8ad47b7514ecc7.source: Throughout the campaign there are resurrection shrines. An NPC can be found at each shrine who can grant a bounty for hunting certain creatures. The bounty normally provides extra experience and, more importantly for this quest, it includes Sunspear promotion points. Gather 100 points to achieve the Master Sergeant level. You can see your progress in your Hero panel; press H to open it, and select the "Titles" tab. 176f873064bde294a04d311a4f68eeeee5132722.source: The first potential recruit, Morik, can be found on a pier in the center of the north coast in Zehlon Reach. Speak to him to find out he doesn't have confidence in himself and would rather stay with Dahni. Speak to Dahni, who can be found a little south on the same pier. She is the second recruit and has already decided to join the Sunspears. She asks you to tell Morik that she is leaving. Talk to Morik and he will join the Sunspears. The third recruit, Ando, can be found southwest in a small village. Speak to him to find out he can't leave the village until he is certain that it will be safe without him protecting it. Head a little south and kill the group of five Irontooth Drakes that is threatening his village. Tell Ando that the threat is gone and he will join. Return to the Sunspear Great Hall and speak to Castellan Puuba to collect your reward.
176f873064bde294a04d311a4f68eeeee5132722.text: 第一個潛在的新兵莫里克可以在澤隆河段北海岸中心的一個碼頭上找到。與他交談，發現他對自己沒有信心，寧願留在達尼身邊。與達尼交談，他位於同一個碼頭南邊不遠的地方。她是第二位新兵，已經決定加入陽矛隊。她要求你告訴莫里克她要離開。與莫里克交談，他將加入烈陽之矛隊。第三名新兵安藤位於西南方的一個小村莊。與他交談，瞭解他不能離開村莊，除非他確信沒有他的保護村莊會安全。往南走一點，殺死威脅他村莊的五隻鐵牙幼龍。告訴安藤威脅已經消失，他會加入。 影返 到 日戟大會堂 並與 Castellan Puuba 交談以領取獎勵。

0aebb64c515364995a29829e1dfb59b146c78f58.source: Talk to Necromancer Munne and take the 4 Votive Candles. Proceed through the Catacombs and place a candle on each of the four Remembrance Braziers in the order shown on the mission map.

a08e7193b7e44b689da267db0b3bd48255e90b4f.source: Completing the Condition Removal quest should be relatively easy. Before entering the dojo, set all of your attribute points in Restoration Magic. Before you start the course, use Generous Was Tsungrai to increase your maximum health, and be ready to drop the ashes when you need a quick burst of healing or just before the spell ends. Keep Resilient Weapon up as soon as you're first hit with a condition; it should deal with any damage you take as long as you're not bleeding. You can also train Soothing Memories if you want to be extra sure of survival. As the warrior attacking you uses self-knockdown skills, kiting can be very effective too.
a08e7193b7e44b689da267db0b3bd48255e90b4f.text: 完成條件移除任務應該相對容易。進入道場前，請在復原魔法中設定所有屬性點。在開始課程之前，使用 慷慨者桑雷 來增加你的最大生命值，並準備好在你需要快速爆發治療時或在法術結束之前掉落灰燼。當您第一次出現症狀時，請立即保持 活力武裝 處於運作狀態；只要你不流血，它就可以處理你受到的任何傷害。如果您想更確保生存，還可以訓練 柔順記憶。由於攻擊你的戰士使用自我擊倒技能，風箏也非常有效。
a08e7193b7e44b689da267db0b3bd48255e90b4f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9b5546c2dd4d5f441a0ae4772772b5db2376c871.source: You should use the same tactics as the ones for Condition Removal, however you should train Soothing Memories if you didn't already as you will be losing health much faster.
9b5546c2dd4d5f441a0ae4772772b5db2376c871.text: 您應該使用與條件去除相同的策略，但是如果您還沒有訓練 柔順記憶，那麼您會更快地失去生命值。
9b5546c2dd4d5f441a0ae4772772b5db2376c871.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

138c40ea84a29e3d4f3d913cfa513c244ea0beb6.source: You can also create spirits and back up. They will focus their attack the spirits. Just remember to keep creating spirits when the current ones are about to die. You can then choose to wait it out or try to deplete their health.
138c40ea84a29e3d4f3d913cfa513c244ea0beb6.text: 您還可以建立精神並備份。他們將集中攻擊靈魂。只要記住在當前的靈魂即將死去時繼續創造靈魂即可。然後你可以選擇等待或嘗試耗盡他們的生命值。
138c40ea84a29e3d4f3d913cfa513c244ea0beb6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

040829709acf15201cbf0a367eba9ef99c089c03.source: The Disruption quest is slightly harder; you should mix your attributes between Communing and Spawning Power for this quest. It also helps to have taken a secondary profession with strong interrupts. You should bring Pain as well as Dissonance, and any secondary profession skills that can interrupt. Essentially your goal here is to reduce the instructor to 50% health, while they try to use skills against you with very long casting times. If you have any interrupts that cast quickly, save them to counter Meteor.
040829709acf15201cbf0a367eba9ef99c089c03.text: 破壞任務稍微困難；對於此任務，您應該在 神諭 和 召喚 之間混合使用您的屬性。選擇一個有強烈幹擾的第二個職業也有幫助。你應該帶上苦痛和失調，以及任何可以打斷的輔助職業技能。本質上，你的目標是減少教練的 50% 生命值，同時他們會嘗試使用技能來對抗你，並且施法時間很長。如果您有任何快速施放的中斷，請將它們儲存到對抗 隕石。
040829709acf15201cbf0a367eba9ef99c089c03.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4683e2a29e15ab9725857893e5b1621984b5778e.source: Skill Chaining is the hard part of this quest and you may want to level up before attempting it. It should be very easy by the time you reach level 10. Simply put all of your attribute points into Channeling Magic and bring Cruel Was Daoshen, Channeled Strike, Spirit Rift, and Spirit Boon Strike. Before they start attacking use Cruel Was Daoshen. When they start attacking use Channeled Strike then drop Cruel. Next use Spirit Rift and Spirit Boon Strike. Repeat if necessary.
4683e2a29e15ab9725857893e5b1621984b5778e.text: 技能 連結是此任務的困難部分，您可能需要在嘗試之前升級。當您達到 10 等級時，這應該非常容易。只需將您的所有屬性點放入 導引魔法 並帶入 殘酷者道森、導引衝擊、生靈裂縫 和 聖靈衝擊 中。在他們開始攻擊之前使用 殘酷者道森。當他們開始攻擊時，使用 導引衝擊，然後放下 殘酷。接下來使用 生靈裂縫 和 聖靈衝擊。如有必要，請重複。
4683e2a29e15ab9725857893e5b1621984b5778e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

58eed0e027b4c183a55f5046c7642ab3f2f6cedb.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 野獸看守者羅彥。
58eed0e027b4c183a55f5046c7642ab3f2f6cedb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a9202fa65aae4793fd6f9b454c93bb056f54c9d1.source: From Senji's Corner, walk out the southern exit into Nahpui Quarter (explorable area). Follow the path as indicated on the map. (Directly under the Q in "Nahpui Quarter" on the map, be careful for an over-aggro of Jade Brotherhood, especially if using heroes and henchmen.) When fighting Royen, you may want to move up on the hill above him to remove his damage bonus due to his elevation, but, his skills are all pet based so the elevation bonus only applies to his auto-attacks.
a9202fa65aae4793fd6f9b454c93bb056f54c9d1.text: 從 山吉之街 出發，走出南出口進入 納普區（探索區域）。按照地圖上指示的路徑行駛。 （在地圖上「納普區」中Q的正下方，小心翡翠兄弟會的過度仇恨，特別是在使用英雄和追隨者時。）當與Royen戰鬥時，你可能想要移動到他上方的山上，以消除他由於海拔而造成的傷害加成，但是，他的技能都是基於寵物的，因此海拔加成僅適用於他的自動攻擊。
a9202fa65aae4793fd6f9b454c93bb056f54c9d1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

32d629441059a491f26d4adb0d2cbdec8eeb4710.source: Kill Rragar Maneater in the Depths of Tyria. Lists the region instead of the dungeon name
32d629441059a491f26d4adb0d2cbdec8eeb4710.text: 在 泰瑞亞深處 中殺死 拉喀 食人者。列出區域而不是地下城名稱
32d629441059a491f26d4adb0d2cbdec8eeb4710.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ba7883cca67dcfd7fd53aa84e1182153863f5d53.source: *BONUS* Kill Rragar Maneater in Hard Mode.
ba7883cca67dcfd7fd53aa84e1182153863f5d53.text: *獎勵* 在困難模式下殺死 拉喀 食人者。
ba7883cca67dcfd7fd53aa84e1182153863f5d53.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

39eaf1876236579737cf2ecf0e87ad970940655c.source: As per the Veiled Threat quest. At least one party member must have the quest.
39eaf1876236579737cf2ecf0e87ad970940655c.text: 根據隱藏的威脅任務。至少一名黨員必須有該任務。
39eaf1876236579737cf2ecf0e87ad970940655c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

55eeb5f5249133d4c504eacbc7fb656fddac1bfa.source: You need to have the quest Veiled Threat (from Gron Fierceclaw in Doomlore Shrine) to advance through level 1 of this dungeon. Otherwise, the door beside the Scrawled Hide in the first room will not open.
55eeb5f5249133d4c504eacbc7fb656fddac1bfa.text: 您需要完成任務「隱藏的威脅」（來自 末日傳說神殿 中的 Gron Fierceclaw）才能通過該地下城的 1 關卡。否則，第一個房間的潦草獸皮旁邊的門將打不開。
55eeb5f5249133d4c504eacbc7fb656fddac1bfa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c29a0ed18fa05486075c83552d62f03dc5738a69.source: You will earn 3,000 Ebon Vanguard reputation points upon your first completion of this dungeon on normal mode, and 1,500 for subsequent completions. 4,500 Vanguard reputation points are awarded for completing this dungeon for the first time in hard mode, and 2,250 for subsequent completions in hard mode.
c29a0ed18fa05486075c83552d62f03dc5738a69.text: 在正常模式下首次完成此地下城時，您將獲得 3,000 黑檀 聲望點，後續完成時將可獲得 1,500 聲望。 4,500 先鋒聲譽點在困難模式下首次完成該地下城時獲得，2,250 在困難模式下後續完成時獲得。
c29a0ed18fa05486075c83552d62f03dc5738a69.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a0565a5d72e673a9ba39f4a90fbf61121e1fd513.source: Feeding a "Blobby" will cause it to join your party as an ally.
a0565a5d72e673a9ba39f4a90fbf61121e1fd513.text: 餵食「Blobby」會使其作為盟友加入你的隊伍。
a0565a5d72e673a9ba39f4a90fbf61121e1fd513.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0b94882cd8928f718edfd2adb6eecf2d3aaa6f45.source: Rragar and Hidesplitter do not regenerate their health.
0b94882cd8928f718edfd2adb6eecf2d3aaa6f45.text: 拉加和裂皮者不會恢復生命值。
0b94882cd8928f718edfd2adb6eecf2d3aaa6f45.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d3060802d02d893e037a7f4a59011435c7abd0b8.source: When fighting Rragar and Hidesplitter, it is useful to kill Rragar first, because he carries Resurrection Chant.
d3060802d02d893e037a7f4a59011435c7abd0b8.text: 當與 Rragar 和 Hidesplitter 戰鬥時，先殺死 Rragar 很有用，因為他攜帶 復活聖歌。
d3060802d02d893e037a7f4a59011435c7abd0b8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d53d266f4fe8071fcdd54ab843aca03dc5a9b4ab.source: Completion of this dungeon will fill in page #2 of the Master Dungeon Guide storybook.
d53d266f4fe8071fcdd54ab843aca03dc5a9b4ab.text: 完成這個地下城將填寫大師 地監 指南故事書的#2 頁。
d53d266f4fe8071fcdd54ab843aca03dc5a9b4ab.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

322e9ea923d6b09595238a00c81e5a6e440ecddd.source: Sometimes the door at first level, is closed. Re-zone to continue the dungeon.
322e9ea923d6b09595238a00c81e5a6e440ecddd.text: 有時第一層的門是關著的。重新區域以繼續地牢。
322e9ea923d6b09595238a00c81e5a6e440ecddd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

14fcd04fd4d23906decb5fd90cc9082e633f5641.source: Leave from Doomlore Shrine and go southwest through Dalada Uplands, to Grothmar Wardowns, and then southeast into Sacnoth Valley. Head south to the southwest corner, as this is where the entrance to Rragar's Menagerie is found.
14fcd04fd4d23906decb5fd90cc9082e633f5641.text: 從 末日傳說神殿 出發，往西南方向穿過 達拉達山地，到達 Grothmar Wardowns，然後往東南方向進入 聖諾谷。往南前往西南角，因為這裡是 拉喀的牢籠 的入口。
14fcd04fd4d23906decb5fd90cc9082e633f5641.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

85b5c0f98ba377c3bd0e9d694291af39e08b9e56.source: Talk to the Beacon of Droknar to gain Dwarven Raider. Head north past Blobby (a neutral Ooze). Just after, some Fleshreavers will appear. Save any Fleshreaver Morsels that they might drop; you can use them to tame Blobby and have him follow you. Throughout the first level, the Charr and Fleshreavers are hostile; you can leave them to kill each other off and mop up the remains.
85b5c0f98ba377c3bd0e9d694291af39e08b9e56.text: 與卓克納爾信標交談以獲得矮人襲擊者。向北行駛，經過布洛比（一個中立的軟泥怪）。緊接著，一些食肉者就會出現。儲存好它們可能掉落的食肉者碎片；你可以用它們來馴服布洛比並讓他跟隨你。在整個第一關中，夏爾 和 Fleshreavers 都是敵對的；你可以讓他們互相殘殺並清理屍體。
85b5c0f98ba377c3bd0e9d694291af39e08b9e56.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e947766580bcf5e48541d12a8efca6431bcd5848.source: To get the optional dungeon map, take the north-east passage. Proceed carefully to avoid aggroing too many of the Charr patrols along the way.
e947766580bcf5e48541d12a8efca6431bcd5848.text: 要獲得可選的地下城地圖，請走東北通道。小心前進，避免沿途激怒太多 夏爾 巡邏隊。
e947766580bcf5e48541d12a8efca6431bcd5848.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

83f2686dfa8b165604e9db7f0e86683e4dc6b337.source: On your way back to the western passage, pick up a Dwarven Powder Keg (bundle) or clear out the group of Charr near the weakened wall and then return for it. Your next goal is to acquire the dungeon key to advance to the next level. Crack the wall to your right and ignore the cracked wall in the chamber you enter. Take the right passageway that will lead to a group of Charr (led by a boss). After finishing them off, continue down the passage to meet Rragar Maneater and still more Charr. You can pull about half of them without aggroing Rragar. As you kill off the group, Rragar will take off leaving behind the key. Return back to the wall you've cracked open. Head north-west. Magma Blisters will appear in the piles of magma, which can cause Burning when stepped on. After killing the blisters, turn left (west) and go down the ramp (the first ramp is a dead end the second is a tunnel; can be easy to miss if your screen is dark.
83f2686dfa8b165604e9db7f0e86683e4dc6b337.text: 在返回西部通道的路上，拿起矮人火藥桶（捆綁包）或清除弱化牆壁附近的 夏爾 隊伍，然後返回。您的下一個目標是獲得地牢鑰匙以進入下一個等級。打破你右邊的牆壁，並忽略你進入的房間裡破裂的牆壁。走正確的通道，會到達一群 夏爾（由老闆帶領）。解決它們後，繼續沿著通道走下去會遇到 拉喀 食人者 和 夏爾。你可以拉出大約一半的怪物而不惹惱拉加。當你消滅這群人時，拉加會離開並留下鑰匙。 影返 回到你已經裂開的牆上。向西北方向行駛。巖漿堆中會出現巖漿水泡，踩到會造成燃燒。殺死水泡後，左轉（向西）並走下坡道（第一個坡道是死衚衕，第二個坡道是隧道；如果螢幕很暗，很容易錯過。
83f2686dfa8b165604e9db7f0e86683e4dc6b337.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4419dad4581b8a8edeb333f7fbe5e9317b543bc9.source: As you enter the next chamber, Fleshreavers will pop up; an Ooze group will pop-up right at the shrine - be careful not to aggro the charr and ooze at the same time. After finishing these foes, you will notice a Keg Station near a Beacon of Droknar. Grab a keg and head north to find more Charr and Blisters. Blow up the cracked wall you find. Do not enter immediately to allow the Fleshreavers and Charr to fight; move in and finish them off. Avoid any remaining Charr on your way to Level 2.
4419dad4581b8a8edeb333f7fbe5e9317b543bc9.text: 當你進入下一個房間時，食肉者會彈出；軟泥怪隊伍會在神社附近突然出現－小心不要同時攻擊夏爾和軟泥怪。消滅這些敵人後，你會注意到卓克納爾信標附近有一個小桶站。拿起一個小桶，往北走去尋找更多 夏爾 和水泡。炸毀你發現的有裂縫的牆。不要立即進入，讓 Fleshreavers 和 夏爾 發生戰鬥；進去解決他們。在通往 2 關卡的途中避免任何剩餘的 夏爾。
4419dad4581b8a8edeb333f7fbe5e9317b543bc9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a8e5e047f3d124b775694e2832a614e721893642.source: As you enter and head left, a group of Charr will run away, unleashing two Boulders and closing a large gate. You have three options: run quickly to the right and follow them out the gate (so it does not lock you in); snare them (so that you can kill them before they exit); or allow them to lock the gate. The fight is easier using the first two options, but you end up in the same place regardless.
a8e5e047f3d124b775694e2832a614e721893642.text: 當你進入並向左走時，一群 夏爾 會逃跑，釋放兩塊巨石並關閉一扇大門。你有三個選擇：快速向右跑，跟著他們走出大門（這樣它就不會把你鎖在裡面）；誘捕他們（這樣你就可以在他們離開之前殺死他們）；或允許他們鎖門。使用前兩個選項，戰鬥會更容易，但無論如何你最終都會在同一個地方。
a8e5e047f3d124b775694e2832a614e721893642.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

91cefb42da0b4ed91ed42674ee10d4d81255da19.source: This hallway has several spots where there are rockslides. You will eventually encounter a sizable group of Charr. You can easily pick up the dungeon map for this level if you head into the left chamber from where you encountered the Charr group. After handling these, you will enter an area with a body of water you will have to walk through, Ooze pop-ups will occur. Turn right after handling the pop-ups and head north through the entrance. Turn left after going through this entrance. Keep heading south-west, killing a group of Fleshreavers a few Charr groups.
91cefb42da0b4ed91ed42674ee10d4d81255da19.text: 這條走廊有幾個地方發生岩石滑坡。您最終會遇到一大群 夏爾。如果您從遇到 夏爾 小組的地方進入左側房間，您可以輕鬆拿起該級別的地下城地圖。處理完這些之後，你將進入一個有水體的區域，你必須步行穿過，軟泥彈出視窗將會出現。處理完彈出視窗後右轉，然後通過入口向北行駛。穿過這個入口後左轉。繼續往西南方向前進，殺死一群食肉者和一些 夏爾 隊伍。
91cefb42da0b4ed91ed42674ee10d4d81255da19.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2986ac1bd1779c59cccaca678eccecc430a1b867.source: It is easy to miss the boss key on this floor. You will reach a Beacon of Droknar. West of this beacon is Rragar Maneater, again, with Charr around him. You can pull the Charr without Rragar to make the battle easier. Get the Key.
2986ac1bd1779c59cccaca678eccecc430a1b867.text: 這層樓很容易錯過老闆鑰匙。你將到達卓克納爾信標。這個信標的西邊又是 拉喀 食人者，夏爾 就在他周圍。你可以在沒有Rragar的情況下拉動夏爾，讓戰鬥變得更簡單。取得 鑰匙。
2986ac1bd1779c59cccaca678eccecc430a1b867.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d0b7f685184f9f8897c2b17785027b23bb042b97.source: Start heading south-east to reach the entrance to the last level. You will fight through Fleshreavers, Charr, and Ooze to get there.
d0b7f685184f9f8897c2b17785027b23bb042b97.text: 開始向東南方向行駛，到達最後一層的入口。你將透過 Fleshreavers、夏爾 和 Ooze 的戰鬥才能到達目的地。
d0b7f685184f9f8897c2b17785027b23bb042b97.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d3a46991c95ee41220455ba4e6b60d8671f2f665.source: If you kill the Charr group at the beginning of the level before they close the gate on you and pick up the key they drop, then use the Dungeon Lock, the gate will close.
d3a46991c95ee41220455ba4e6b60d8671f2f665.text: 如果您在關卡開始時殺死 夏爾 小組，然後在他們關閉您的門之前並撿起他們掉落的鑰匙，然後使用 地監 鎖，門就會關閉。
d3a46991c95ee41220455ba4e6b60d8671f2f665.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

eef7c15be0dad3add3b404747f1288f6b21a6781.source: Head to the south passage. After you kill the Fleshreavers blocking the way, head west. Charr and Fleshreavers will start appearing in hybrid groups. Head south-west when possible. You will reach a chamber with a Beacon of Droknar and another Keg Station; as you approach, the wall nearby will be blown up by an incoming Charr group. Head directly south down this now-opened passage and retrieve the boss key, after killing a sizable group of Fleshreavers with a boss type amongst them.
eef7c15be0dad3add3b404747f1288f6b21a6781.text: 前往南邊的通道。殺死擋路的食肉者後，向西前進。 夏爾 和 Fleshreavers 將開始出現在混合組中。如果可能的話，向西南方向行駛。你將到達一個帶有 Droknar 信標和另一個 Keg Station 的房間；當您接近時，附近的牆壁將被傳入的 夏爾 小組炸毀。殺死一大群帶有 Boss 型別的食肉者後，沿著這條現已開啟的通道直接向南走，取回 Boss 鑰匙。
eef7c15be0dad3add3b404747f1288f6b21a6781.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6a5be893899cde151d6dbd6f4c48e50de96fd06b.source: Start heading north-west when possible now. You may fight through several Fleshreaver groups. However, if you are careful and watch the patrols, you can avoid all but one or two. Use the Boss Key to open the gate.
6a5be893899cde151d6dbd6f4c48e50de96fd06b.text: 如果可能的話，現在就開始向西北行駛。你可能會與幾個食肉者組織戰鬥。然而，如果你小心並觀察巡邏者，你可以避開除了一兩個之外的所有。使用 頭目 鑰匙 開啟門。
6a5be893899cde151d6dbd6f4c48e50de96fd06b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

793fd613ec28b6e6a003dc8c59fe67bebbb40766.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ec98c8919891b6d12094d9c85db3eece9cf4a69d.source: Most players concentrate on killing Rragar first; if Hidesplitter dies first, Rragar will resurrect him. Hidesplitter, on the other hand, goes into a rage when Rragar dies, but if you got this far, you should not have any trouble surviving anything he tries to throw at you.
ec98c8919891b6d12094d9c85db3eece9cf4a69d.text: 大多數玩家先專心殺死拉加；如果劈皮者先死，拉加會復活他。另一方面，劈皮者在拉加死後會勃然大怒，但如果你已經走到這一步，無論他向你扔什麼東西，你都不會有任何困難。
ec98c8919891b6d12094d9c85db3eece9cf4a69d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f498f4fc5553f3d047c7068f488ef91cd4e4d319.source: There are plenty of exploitable corpses for minion masters; however, Fleshreaver Hounds deal holy damage, Ominous Oozes have Verata's Aura, and Shimmering Oozes have Spiritual Pain.
f498f4fc5553f3d047c7068f488ef91cd4e4d319.text: 有大量可供小兵大師利用的屍體；然而，食肉獵犬會造成神聖傷害，不祥軟泥怪有 芙瑞達的靈氣，微光軟泥怪有 生靈苦痛。
f498f4fc5553f3d047c7068f488ef91cd4e4d319.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

09a3652d6f65c0aee05d3ba2766355ec0f06c2ec.source: Shadow Form is a poor skill for tanking; Fleshreaver Hounds can cause substantial melee-range damage through it.
09a3652d6f65c0aee05d3ba2766355ec0f06c2ec.text: 暗影形態 是一個很差的坦克技能；食肉獵犬可以透過它造成大量的近戰傷害。
09a3652d6f65c0aee05d3ba2766355ec0f06c2ec.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8ee91b7d3abf7088b5fb6656fd876bcce60e81f6.source: On the first level, Charr and Fleshreavers are hostile to each other; however, they are allied with each other on the second and third levels.
8ee91b7d3abf7088b5fb6656fd876bcce60e81f6.text: 在第一層，夏爾和Fleshreavers彼此敵對；然而，它們在第二層和第三層上彼此結盟。
8ee91b7d3abf7088b5fb6656fd876bcce60e81f6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

52a21d5203d077c9184405b9965beb1dc47c4626.source: The key to an easy victory is by bringing down the health of one boss to a minimum and then attack the other boss. If Rragar Maneater is killed first, then Hidesplitter will enter an aggressive stance and deals more damage. If Hidesplitter gets killed, Rragar Maneater will try to resurrect his companion using Resurrection Chant.

8352640de97df92d3e410ce10a8e6871ad497556.source: Originally, the Battle Axe (hatchet) that is given as reward in this mission, had different upgrades, allowing to put two grips at the same time. Doing this, for example, combinations of two Axe Grips of Enchanting were possible, providing a permanent +40% longevity in enchantments. More healing does not work too well against Mesmers, faster killing is most of the time the key in beating them. A skill to remove Hexes is a good thing to have in your skillbar while doing this quest.
df96e1598629e7cd803075d7688c370806c2e944.text: 美麗伊波枷 屬於 10 級別，並且分別以 3 為群組。確保你能快速殺死他們，因為他們是 幻術師 職業。更多的治療效果並不能很好地對抗幻術師，更快的殺戮大多數時候是擊敗他們的關鍵。在執行此任務時，技能欄中擁有移除六角形的技能是一件好事。

Last but not least, collect your reward from Midauha.

4db5df70e765b76a888aa0ae6aa0a1e0395140fa.source: Obtain the quest from Scoutmaster Aerios standing just outside Breaker Hollow. Follow the path on the mission map to points 1 through 4. At each point a group of Kurzicks will appear. They often appear around your party so as soon as this happens, take several steps back so that you are not surrounded. Defeat them and move on to the next destination. Along the way, you will encounter a couple groups of Oni. Continue until you clear out all four locations. Return to Scoutmaster Aerios for your reward.
4db5df70e765b76a888aa0ae6aa0a1e0395140fa.text: 從站在 斷崖谷 外面的偵察隊長 Aerios 取得任務。沿著任務地圖上的路徑到達 1 到 4 點。在每個點都會出現一群庫茲克人。他們經常出現在你的隊伍周圍，所以一旦發生這種情況，請後退幾步，以免被包圍。擊敗他們並前往下一個目的地。一路上，你會遇到幾群鬼。繼續，直到清除所有四個位置。 影返 交給童子軍 Aerios，以獲得獎勵。

4c941455338ee4c7bb3c9a511987532bb315b3a8.source: This quest can be easily combined with Return of the Yeti. As you approach point 1 on the mission map, you will pass by Magistrate Kin. Speak to him to obtain the Return of the Yeti quest. Make Scout the Coast your current quest and continue with the quest by going to point 2 and then to point 3. At point 3, in addition to the group of Kurzicks, you will also find several groups of Yeti. Arrahhsh Mountainclub is among one of the groups. Defeat him and you can pick up the Golden Lantern to complete Return of the Yeti. You can then either go back to Magistrate Kin immediately for your reward or finish Scout the Coast and then go back to Magistrate Kin later.
4c941455338ee4c7bb3c9a511987532bb315b3a8.text: 這個任務可以很容易地與雪人的 影返 結合。當您接近任務地圖上的 1 點時，您將經過法官 Kin。與他交談以獲得雪人任務的 影返。將偵察海岸設為目前任務，然後依序指向 2 和 3 來繼續任務。在 3 點，除了 Kurzick 群之外，您還會發現幾群 Yeti。 Arrahhsh Mountainclub 就是其中之一。擊敗他，你就可以拿起金燈籠來完成雪人的 影返。然後，您可以立即返回金裁判官那裡領取獎勵，或完成海岸偵察，然後稍後再返回金裁判官處。

3b5ee61826d4f6b16e2d6e75712374782c2201f8.source: Obtain the quest from Scoutmaster Theron just outside of Eredon Terrace. You will need to defeat four Kurzick scout groups. There are seven possible locations where these groups will appear (marked with an "X" on the quest map). Follow the quest marker to each location in the Maishang Hills. A Kurzick Scout and a random group of Kurzicks will spawn at each location. Only killing the Kurzick Scout is necessary to update the quest log, so pulling and killing the Kurzick Scout and not killing the rest of the group can save time.
3b5ee61826d4f6b16e2d6e75712374782c2201f8.text: 從 爾雷登平地 外面的童子軍長塞隆那裡獲得任務。您需要擊敗四個 庫茲柯 偵察小組。這些團體可能會出現在七個位置（在任務地圖上以“X”標記）。依照任務標記到達 麥尚山丘 中的每個位置。每個地點都會產生一個 庫茲柯 偵察兵和一組隨機的庫茲克人。只需殺死 庫茲柯 Scout 即可更新任務日誌，因此拉動並殺死 庫茲柯 Scout 並且不殺死該組的其餘成員可以節省時間。
3b5ee61826d4f6b16e2d6e75712374782c2201f8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fa447627ec6abd7d71e0d48afc9ae7db881ea787.source: After defeating the Kurzicks at each of the four locations, return to Scoutmaster Theron to collect your reward. Remember that you should not map travel to Eredon Terrace before collecting your reward, since leaving Maishang Hills area will automatically abandon this quest.
fa447627ec6abd7d71e0d48afc9ae7db881ea787.text: 在四個地點選敗庫茲克人後，返回童子軍隊長塞隆處領取獎勵。請記住，在領取獎勵之前，您不應將旅行對應到 爾雷登平地，因為離開 麥尚山丘 區域將自動放棄此任務。

Each Luxon raiding party spawns in two groups, each consisting of three to five Luxons. After the first group is eliminated, the second group immediately spawns. Once your party has cleared all four checkpoints, return to Scoutmaster Arne for your reward.

c45c6986aa8011d6a4fdc62f1a4b678908b3174a.source: The first floor consists of several gates which indirectly lead to the second floor, which contains the boss. To open each gate, you need to step on a proof within the dungeon, of the same name. For example, stepping on Proof of Strength will open the Gates of Strength, and so on. The dungeon includes rooms with several posts which fire Ice Darts and Ice Jets. The streams are easy to avoid; however, the darts can be very annoying and potentially deadly. A party entering a room full of dart posts and foes should be wary. It is usually safer to pull enemies out of the rooms to avoid being hit by the darts.
c45c6986aa8011d6a4fdc62f1a4b678908b3174a.text: 第一層由幾扇門組成，這些門間接通往第二層，第二層包含老闆。要開啟每個門，您需要踩到地牢內同名的證據。例如，踩到力量的證明將開啟力量的大門，等等。地牢的房間裡有幾個可以發射冰鏢和冰射流的柱子。溪流很容易避開；然而，飛鏢可能非常煩人，甚至可能致命。進入充滿飛鏢和敵人的房間的隊伍應該保持警覺。將敵人拉出房間以避免被飛鏢擊中通常會更安全。
c45c6986aa8011d6a4fdc62f1a4b678908b3174a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d47b1f72afac162f460bd69f795bf6827b529fbf.source: In general, players should avoid fighting large mobs of monsters and getting trapped in places where they are constantly taking damage. This strategy will make for a relatively straightforward run. When players arrive at the boss area, they will see Remnant of Antiquities and two other ice elementalist creatures. It is recommended to dispatch the non-boss creatures first, as they cast dangerous AoE spells.
d47b1f72afac162f460bd69f795bf6827b529fbf.text: 一般來說，玩家應該避免與大群怪物戰鬥並被困在不斷受到傷害的地方。這一策略將使執行相對簡單。當玩家到達boss區域時，他們會看到殘餘的斷片和另外兩個冰元素生物。建議先消滅非 Boss 生物，因為它們會施放危險的 範圍性 法術。
d47b1f72afac162f460bd69f795bf6827b529fbf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ffa844a113bfe64f1635cf19b9a21c911da3343c.source: Defeating the Remnant of Antiquities can be a very difficult and grueling experience, especially if the party has no reliable interrupts or dazing. The boss casts the monster-only AoE spell Diamondshard Mist, a type of ward which causes bleeding and heavy damage to those within its boundaries at its expiration.
ffa844a113bfe64f1635cf19b9a21c911da3343c.text: 擊敗 殘餘的斷片 可能是一次非常困難且艱苦的經歷，尤其是當隊伍沒有可靠的打斷或眩暈的情況下。 Boss 會施放僅限怪物的 範圍性 法術 Diamondshard Mist，這是一種結界型別，在結界到期時會對其範圍內的人員造成流血和嚴重傷害。
ffa844a113bfe64f1635cf19b9a21c911da3343c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

892343c3f01434ca8610b449c8658531233a79b1.source: If you are unable to prevent the spell, it is essential to keep moving in order to stay out of the Diamondshard Mist. The party should spread out so that multiple party members avoid taking heavy damage simultaneously. If the entire party dies, there is a nearby resurrection shrine, so you can return to the assault before the boss can recover completely. A persistent party can defeat the Remnant regardless of Death Penalty.
892343c3f01434ca8610b449c8658531233a79b1.text: 如果您無法阻止法術，則必須繼續移動才能遠離鑽石碎片迷霧。隊伍應該分散開來，以避免多名隊員同時受到嚴重傷害。如果整個隊伍都死了，附近有一個復活神殿，所以你可以在boss完全恢復之前返回攻擊。無論死刑如何，堅持不懈的一方都可以擊敗殘黨。
892343c3f01434ca8610b449c8658531233a79b1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

09d46f20739afdcb86a93a03d216a2e3deb21cb8.source: Bring hex removal as the dryders and elementals in this dungeon use a lot of hexes.
09d46f20739afdcb86a93a03d216a2e3deb21cb8.text: 由於這個地牢中的乾燥者和元素使用了大量的六角形，因此需要去除六角形。
09d46f20739afdcb86a93a03d216a2e3deb21cb8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f6bcbb8af3213e2e79289cef2a8e5a649f4adcf4.source: Careful pulling and avoiding bunching up will make this dungeon a relatively easy run. Also, because the traps can deal a lot of damage, it's advised to lure the enemies to a location where the traps can't hit you.
f6bcbb8af3213e2e79289cef2a8e5a649f4adcf4.text: 小心拉動並避免聚集將使這個地牢相對容易運作。另外，由於陷阱會造成大量傷害，因此建議將敵人引誘到陷阱無法擊中您的位置。
f6bcbb8af3213e2e79289cef2a8e5a649f4adcf4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3f155de0b8c7899fb2df1be97c6cde35fbc09cba.source: Bringing the following skills will make this dungeon much easier: Ward Against Elements, Mantra of Frost, Light of Deliverance, Extinguish (for the final boss), and interrupts such as Savage Shot, Distracting Shot, or anything causing Daze.
3f155de0b8c7899fb2df1be97c6cde35fbc09cba.text: 攜帶以下技能將使這個地下城變得更加容易：元素結界、冰霜頌歌、拯救聖光、熄滅（對於最終老闆），以及野性之箭、震暈之箭等中斷或任何導致發呆的東西。
3f155de0b8c7899fb2df1be97c6cde35fbc09cba.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

84b908c7f3cb6e99f76ee7ce35f5523ff1d0aa96.source: There are not many fleshy creatures, so skills that inflict Bleeding, Disease or Poison, or require corpses are less effective here. Plus, the Whirling Wisps carry Banishing Strike, destroying minions quickly.
84b908c7f3cb6e99f76ee7ce35f5523ff1d0aa96.text: 肉質生物不多，因此造成 流血、疾病或 中毒 或需要屍體的技能在這裡效果較差。此外，旋轉小精靈還攜帶 驅逐攻擊，可以快速消滅小兵。
84b908c7f3cb6e99f76ee7ce35f5523ff1d0aa96.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5f2d4dcd9cd8d0220b5f1650c4fc93f1d243ba2d.source: Cold damage is less effective here, since several foes have additional armor rating against cold damage.
5f2d4dcd9cd8d0220b5f1650c4fc93f1d243ba2d.text: 冰凍傷害 在這裡效果較差，因為一些敵人具有針對寒冷傷害的額外裝甲等級。
5f2d4dcd9cd8d0220b5f1650c4fc93f1d243ba2d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b756fef8ef13d402fd4337449cee9adeeb37d92e.source: The henchwoman Zho uses Broad Head Arrow, making her the henchman of choice for this dungeon if you don't have a hero with a daze skill yourself.
b756fef8ef13d402fd4337449cee9adeeb37d92e.text: 女追隨者 若 使用 闊首箭，如果你自己沒有擁有迷惑技能的英雄，她將成為這個地下城的首選追隨者。
b756fef8ef13d402fd4337449cee9adeeb37d92e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5981c0524a85a3b94dcd60b4386dd96455a6f484.source: The centaurs arrive in 3 waves which will attack whether or not the previous wave has been defeated. The first wave consists solely of warriors. The second is solely rangers so the newly acquired spirit Winds is useful against this wave. The third and final wave contains warriors, rangers, monks, and a boss. Beware of the Ice Boulders that roll across the frozen lake, as they will kill anyone they roll over, including the Centaurs themselves.
5981c0524a85a3b94dcd60b4386dd96455a6f484.text: 半人馬以 3 波的形式抵達，無論前一波是否被擊敗，它們都會發動攻擊。第一波僅由戰士組成。第二個是純粹的遊俠，所以新獲得的精神之風在對抗這一波時很有用。第三波也是最後一波包含戰士、遊俠、僧侶和 Boss。小心地滾過冰凍湖面的冰巨石，因為它們會殺死任何被滾過的人，包括半人馬本身。
5981c0524a85a3b94dcd60b4386dd96455a6f484.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

577b7c6846434284e1f5fcb000d1b7380946bb3c.source: Edge of Extinction is also very useful here, again provided that you do not bring Zhed Shadowhoof.
577b7c6846434284e1f5fcb000d1b7380946bb3c.text: 滅絕之地 在這裡也非常有用，前提是你不帶 Zhed Shadowhoof。
577b7c6846434284e1f5fcb000d1b7380946bb3c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a0b412a73846038ad7c856592c326d623d3f3054.source: This quest provides an opportunity to map Ice Cliff Chasms for Master of the North: equip your heroes with speed boosts (especially "Charge!", "Fall Back!", and "Incoming!") and move away from the portal to the EotN outpost. The remainder of the area will be free of foes, giving you plenty of time to scrape.
a0b412a73846038ad7c856592c326d623d3f3054.text: 此任務提供了為北方大師繪製 冰崖裂口 的機會：為您的英雄裝備速度提升（特別是「衝鋒！」、「撤退！」和「來襲！」）並從傳送門移至 EotN 前哨站。該區域的其餘部分將沒有敵人，並給你足夠的時間來搜尋。
a0b412a73846038ad7c856592c326d623d3f3054.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c6400f3e8ccd3b527ad2761fd2f1cd29cc20804c.source: Several exits are blocked by closed doors. Those that are open (the portals to Boreal Station and Norrhart Domains) lead back to the EotN outpost. This is also true for the exit to The Battledepths, even though it appears blocked (you can walk through the doors).
c6400f3e8ccd3b527ad2761fd2f1cd29cc20804c.text: 幾個出口被緊閉的門擋住。那些開放的（通往北方太空站和諾拉特域的傳送門）會帶回 EotN 前哨站。對於 戰鬥深淵 的出口也是如此，即使它看起來被封鎖（您可以穿過門）。
c6400f3e8ccd3b527ad2761fd2f1cd29cc20804c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b8eb570f8ae4cb28182b9fc357e724cb6cbfd830.source: When you resign, you get the usual, message that "Your party was defeated". However, you remain alive and centaurs continue to attack you until you're returned to the outpost.
b8eb570f8ae4cb28182b9fc357e724cb6cbfd830.text: 當你辭職時，你會收到通常的訊息「你的政黨被擊敗了」。然而，你仍然活著，半人馬會繼續攻擊你，直到你回到前哨站。
b8eb570f8ae4cb28182b9fc357e724cb6cbfd830.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fd5dfc92bd049b2ba89d94d61b14fee47e77a068.source: If you kill the boss too far from the main battle (the base of the stairs), your three allies will start celebrating at the location where the boss died; they will not return with you to the stairs to kill any remaining foes.
fd5dfc92bd049b2ba89d94d61b14fee47e77a068.text: 如果你殺死的boss距離主戰（樓梯底部）太遠，你的三個盟友將在boss死亡的地方開始慶祝；他們不會和你一起回到樓梯去殺死任何剩餘的敵人。
fd5dfc92bd049b2ba89d94d61b14fee47e77a068.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

13507a0b89198806ea76ed10026661d2d7967f3b.source: Tell Artificer Mullenix when you are ready to start the training session.
13507a0b89198806ea76ed10026661d2d7967f3b.text: 當您準備好開始培訓課程時，請告訴 工匠 穆尼克斯。
13507a0b89198806ea76ed10026661d2d7967f3b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5c394ba9e5e27c86f5bac43190122b0fca665589.source: Help train the service staff by leading them into combat. Destroy 20 practice dummies in 3 minutes.
5c394ba9e5e27c86f5bac43190122b0fca665589.text: 透過引導服務人員參加戰鬥來幫助訓練他們。在 3 分鐘內摧毀 20 練習假人。
5c394ba9e5e27c86f5bac43190122b0fca665589.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

104b1b38cb789b2d98a5336a7c6a608b4afcc27d.source: When you start the quest, you are brought to an instance of the Eye of the North outpost along with the three service staff. After the twenty training dummies pop up, you must help the NPCs destroy them. The NPCs will attack the closest dummy and continue around the circle until all twenty are destroyed. The dummies don't attack or use skills, so healing skills and interrupts are not needed.
104b1b38cb789b2d98a5336a7c6a608b4afcc27d.text: 當您開始任務時，您將與三名服務人員一起被帶到 極地之眼 前哨站的一個例項。當二十個訓練假人出現後，你必須幫助 NPC 摧毀它們。 NPC 將攻擊最近的假人並繼續繞圈，直到所有二十個都被摧毀。假人不會攻擊或使用技能，因此不需要治療技能和打斷。
104b1b38cb789b2d98a5336a7c6a608b4afcc27d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3d222f05ca6d30572a15e213ce2efee2702e5b05.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3e9830abac2b7c50cae49fa83160d34d136c97d0.source: As the dummies leave exploitable corpses, a minion master with damage skills.
3e9830abac2b7c50cae49fa83160d34d136c97d0.text: 當假人留下可利用的屍體時，具有傷害技能的小兵大師。
3e9830abac2b7c50cae49fa83160d34d136c97d0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fcd396f269820e3e7dc9501c94c1af0750612c64.source: Signet of Spirits build and Great Dwarf Weapon works exceptionally well.

fcd396f269820e3e7dc9501c94c1af0750612c64.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4e82b16283e4ca2767264c505cab4e9eeecd5ef4.source: To complete the quest as quickly as possible, resign when you first arrive at the site, before the timer begins. Type the /resign command before entering the mission, and simply hit enter as soon as possible after the loading screen disappears. The log will say you have failed, but it will also say you killed all twenty dummies. In about five seconds, you will be returned to the Eye of the North, and you can claim your reward.
4e82b16283e4ca2767264c505cab4e9eeecd5ef4.text: 為了盡快完成任務，請在計時器開始之前第一次到達站點時退出。在進入任務之前輸入 /resign 命令，並在載入畫面消失後儘快按下 Enter 鍵。日誌會說你失敗了，但它也會說你殺了所有二十個假人。大約五秒鐘後，您將返回 極地之眼，您可以領取獎勵。
4e82b16283e4ca2767264c505cab4e9eeecd5ef4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8b41e7f29ccd1596513027cb3d69712285150ec1.source: Even if you miss this opportunity, the quest itself should be easy.
8b41e7f29ccd1596513027cb3d69712285150ec1.text: 即使你錯過了這個機會，任務本身也應該很容易。
8b41e7f29ccd1596513027cb3d69712285150ec1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c5ee16b2b4c083790b8195c0b90b240cc36fcb7f.source: The dummies actually count as Charr according to the title Rebel Yell so when you kill/destroy one you will gain 2 energy.
c5ee16b2b4c083790b8195c0b90b240cc36fcb7f.text: 根據《Rebel Yell》的標題，這些假人實際上算作 夏爾，因此當您殺死/摧毀一個假人時，您將獲得 2 能量。
c5ee16b2b4c083790b8195c0b90b240cc36fcb7f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e8292027683a900a87b944de1d543303c27f1014.source: The instance inside the Eye of the North outpost used for this quest is labeled Mano a Norn-o.
e8292027683a900a87b944de1d543303c27f1014.text: 用於此任務的 極地之眼 前哨站內的例項被標記為 Mano a 諾恩-o。
e8292027683a900a87b944de1d543303c27f1014.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9caf7a86c47170c58e6ee64679a52eb5daadbc49.source: Resigning while the timer is up will mark the quest as completed.
9caf7a86c47170c58e6ee64679a52eb5daadbc49.text: 在計時器到時退出將把任務標記為已完成。

b77e8ac81b7cd57b8f63a1c684056e5fa3319862.source: This area always contains one chest. When entering the area from Bukdek Byway, the chest most often spawns near Afflicted, otherwise you'll find it near Jade Brotherhood.
b77e8ac81b7cd57b8f63a1c684056e5fa3319862.text: 該區域始終包含一個箱子。當從 巴德克小徑 進入該區域時，寶箱通常會在受影響的附近生成，否則你會在 翡翠兄弟會 附近找到它。

9f1dbe74948f5da95ac33493bbd4732d2873e1a8.source: If starting from Dragon's Throat it is possible to vanquish only the Afflicted groups, The Afflicted Ako and one small spawn before him, by pulling them closer so you are never within range for the Jade Brotherhood to spawn. This will decrease the number of foes to vanquish to approximately 8.
9f1dbe74948f5da95ac33493bbd4732d2873e1a8.text: 如果從 龍喉 (挑戰任務) 開始，則可以只擊敗受折磨的群體、受折磨的 Ako 和他之前的一個小生成，方法是將它們拉近，這樣你就永遠不會在 翡翠兄弟會 生成的範圍內。這會將需要消滅的敵人數量減少到大約 8。

0e01ab0635e3549b26f321d3001e1db7c34a28cd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

362a7a13a4a951eae7a09a632711a3e67a1bbd32.source: Find information about the White Mantle's plans.
362a7a13a4a951eae7a09a632711a3e67a1bbd32.text: 尋找有關 白斗篷 計劃的資訊。

54bc572ca43a0692f0a06a142588fdc4a1977e49.source: Follow the main path from Aurora Glade until you reach the area with the Henge Portal, killing foes along the way. Find and read the White Mantle Missive deep in the camp to finish the quest.

97aa7ed05a2894b49dfb385d2a11951e201d46eb.source: Find Shalev in a cave on the western border of Old Ascalon, west-northwest of Sardelac Sanitarium. Map travel or navigate to Piken Square. Cross the small valley to the west and climb the path to the right (watching for Charr patrols) to find up to three Charr Fire Callers. When defeated, one will drop a bottle of fiery unguent. Bring it back to Shalev for the reward.
97aa7ed05a2894b49dfb385d2a11951e201d46eb.text: 在 舊阿斯卡隆 西部邊界、薩德拉克療養院 西北偏西的一個洞穴中找到 Shalev。繪製旅行地圖或導航至 派肯廣場。穿過西邊的小山谷，爬上右側的小路（注意 夏爾 巡邏隊），最多可找到三個 夏爾 消防來電者。被擊敗後，會掉落一瓶熾熱的藥膏。把它帶回給沙萊夫以獲得獎勵。

0efe2211783a592908674dfa492f47eda21ff580.source: From Vlox's Falls head south. You will also pass through this dungeon as part of Finding Gadd. If you have access, you can start directly from Gadd's Encampment (however, if your goal is completing Lost Souls, you will need to visit the other entrance to find Crewmember Shandra; only she can open the door required for the quest).
0efe2211783a592908674dfa492f47eda21ff580.text: 從弗洛克斯瀑佈出發，向南行駛。作為 尋找蓋德 的一部分，您還將穿越這個地牢。如果您有訪問許可權，則可以直接從 蓋德營區 開始（但是，如果您的目標是完成“迷失的靈魂”，則需要訪問另一個入口才能找到船員珊德拉；只有她可以開啟任務所需的門）。

c0d7f83bcac9c0262782fb488ea7cb9aec9710ea.source: Completion of this dungeon rewards 1,500 Asuran points in normal mode and 2,250 in hard mode. Completing the dungeon for the first time in each mode rewards twice that.
c0d7f83bcac9c0262782fb488ea7cb9aec9710ea.text: 完成地下城會在普通模式下獎勵 1,500 阿蘇蘭點數，在困難模式下獎勵 2,250 點數。在每種模式中首次完成地下城的獎勵是該模式的兩倍。

c203a800c5b1636fb5ff982381319e82ceafdb7c.source: The easiest way to complete this quest is to retreat up the ramp. Rangers and spirit spammers then have plenty of time to lay/summon their spirits/traps without the attacking centaurs being aggroed (beware spirits too far down attacking the centaurs). Players can then aggro the centaurs causing them to move up the ramp to attack. Once your enemies are grouped together on the ramp unleash a barrage of area of effect damage, this will quickly destroy the level 8 Shiverpeaks Centaurs leaving only the level 20 Modniir Centaurs. Take notice of the Modniir Centaur's skill Trample as it can cause havoc if you're not prepared.
c203a800c5b1636fb5ff982381319e82ceafdb7c.text: 完成這個任務最簡單的方法就是撤退到坡道上。然後遊騎兵和靈魂垃圾郵件傳送者有足夠的時間放置/召喚他們的靈魂/陷阱，而不會攻擊半人馬​​（小心太遠的靈魂攻擊半人馬​​）。然後玩家可以攻擊半人馬​​，使他們爬上坡道進行攻擊。一旦你的敵人在坡道上聚集在一起，就會釋放出一連串的區域傷害傷害，這將迅速摧毀關卡 8 南部席娃山脈 半人馬，只留下關卡 20 Modniir 半人馬。請注意 Modniir 半人馬 的技能“踐踏”，因為如果您沒有做好準備，它可能會造成嚴重破壞。
c203a800c5b1636fb5ff982381319e82ceafdb7c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

cbb425ee24969d6f0c7ad4ef4f8e5b4f2e2967cb.source: An alternate strategy calls for running directly to the left at the beginning of the mission. Simply allow the centaurs to reach the front of the Eye, then pull them into smaller groups. This tactic allows players to avoid the mobs of Centaurs (which ultimately requires less firepower), but requires more time in return.
cbb425ee24969d6f0c7ad4ef4f8e5b4f2e2967cb.text: 另一種策略是在任務開始時直接向左跑。 Simply allow the centaurs to reach the front of the Eye, then pull them into smaller groups.這種策略可以讓玩家避開半人馬的小怪（最終需要更少的火力），但需要更多的時間來回報。
cbb425ee24969d6f0c7ad4ef4f8e5b4f2e2967cb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

This strategy puts fewer demands on group composition, though inclusion of two elementalists, two healers and two warriors is recommended (not counting the three allies that join you on this mission).
16b437536c6b443a8c944cdc5c621415e2ab1f94.text: Another strategy is to retreat far back on the ramp and stay there, pull one group of foes at a time on the ramp by using a ranged attack such as a longbow. 780981ae06b3e17b90f80f4bbd81c749f2404dfa.text: 如果 梵帝寧 在沒有與你的隊伍進行任何互動的情況下被火焰噴射殺死，梵帝寧 的靈魂將不會出現。相反，當您接近噴射機時，梵帝寧 將以完全生命值重生。

bf8d19b051d1e785478471d8796bf4b97034a5a9.source: On very rare occasions, Fendi Nin will not spawn. Unfortunately, there is no work-around; you must restart the dungeon. This happens if you have quests for other dungeons. There is an interval of approximately 2 seconds during which Fendi respawns and the soul disappears (these two events do not occur simultaneously - Fendi respawns first). If the soul has been killed before its disappearance and after Fendi's respawn, its death will trigger the chest but will not unspawn Fendi and the archers.
bf8d19b051d1e785478471d8796bf4b97034a5a9.text: 在極少數情況下，梵帝寧 不會產生。不幸的是，沒有解決方法；你必須重新啟動地牢。如果您有其他地下城的任務，就會發生這種情況。芬迪重生和靈魂消失之間有大約 2 秒的間隔（這兩個事件不會同時發生 - 芬迪首先重生）。如果靈魂在消失之前和芬迪重生之後被殺死，它的死亡將觸發寶箱，但不會使芬迪和弓箭手消失。
bf8d19b051d1e785478471d8796bf4b97034a5a9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f7d257e21934d6ffb14eb43c43172874e4d25374.source: While a character has this quest active, all Heket killed will drop a Juicy Heket Leg each until your character holds 10 of it in their inventory. This means that if those collected legs are dropped or moved into storage, the Juicy Heket Legs will start dropping off any Heket again.
f7d257e21934d6ffb14eb43c43172874e4d25374.text: 當角色啟動此任務時，所有被殺死的 青蛙族群 都會掉落一條多汁的 青蛙族群 腿，直到您的角色將其 10 保留在其庫存中。這意味著，如果這些收集的腿被丟棄或移入儲存，Juicy 青蛙族群 腿將再次開始丟棄任何 青蛙族群。

If the Stone Summit dwarves spawned by the quest are still alive when a player approaches Elsa, they will run south and spread themselves out over the road, but there is ample time to evade them and return to Yak's Bend along the eastern path. Lead the refugees to Yak's Bend and make sure the quest has updated before entering the outpost and claiming the reward from Captain Osric.

8cda5622aa93f0827327aeaa4dfbbf4adeb92ba5.text: 即使退出地牢，任務 進度也會儲存。如果需要，這允許您修改每個 Boss 的隊伍建構。
8cda5622aa93f0827327aeaa4dfbbf4adeb92ba5.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

14b1f099252190048ec4c769ea9f9b4f0ee6f179.source: Unlike most dungeons, Slavers' Exile is not linear, and you can kill the first four bosses in any order. The initial room leads directly to each sub-level, with Duncan's room opening once the others are complete.
14b1f099252190048ec4c769ea9f9b4f0ee6f179.text: 與大多數地下城不同，奴隸商人放逐地 不是線性的，你可以任意順序殺死前四個 Boss。最初的房間直接通往每個地下層，一旦其他房間完成，鄧肯的房間就會開啟。
14b1f099252190048ec4c769ea9f9b4f0ee6f179.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b9ffcf3551874fba108f61437f4c1a89c9f9c11d.source: You don't need to defeat all of the bosses in Hard Mode to get the Hard Mode page for the dungeon book, only Duncan.
b9ffcf3551874fba108f61437f4c1a89c9f9c11d.text: 你不需要擊敗困難模式中的所有 Boss 來獲得地下城書的困難模式頁面，只需擊敗鄧肯即可。
b9ffcf3551874fba108f61437f4c1a89c9f9c11d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

634181b76e909f44b5edcf26ba9da9a59f7ee409.source: If striving to complete all the sub-quests in one go, consider bringing a few Identification Kits. There is a Weaponsmith in the main area to whom you can sell your items.
634181b76e909f44b5edcf26ba9da9a59f7ee409.text: 如果努力一次完成所有子任務，請考慮帶一些識別工具包。主區域有一個 武器商人，您可以向其出售您的物品。
634181b76e909f44b5edcf26ba9da9a59f7ee409.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

411f1d3d26a28fb3004481b466df353d24a7a750.source: Most of the Stone Summit have some type of resurrection skill, consider bringing Frozen Soil.
411f1d3d26a28fb3004481b466df353d24a7a750.text: 大多數石峰矮人都有某種型別的復活技能，可以考慮帶上凍土。
411f1d3d26a28fb3004481b466df353d24a7a750.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c62bf6da3e6115738814740a379837390d92fc41.text: 司法官 湯米茲' 級別
c62bf6da3e6115738814740a379837390d92fc41.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0978f262775fd3832a183ce18cfa514421ce2d5b.source: There are two bosses on this level, Justiciar Thommis, and Rand Stormweaver. It is recommended to do both during the same run, otherwise the exit will be blocked. The main difficulty is the large number of Dwarves that tend to aggro at the same time. Be prepared to do hit and run, or to manage large groups.
0978f262775fd3832a183ce18cfa514421ce2d5b.text: 此關卡有兩個 Boss：司法官 湯米茲 和 織暴者 硬皮。建議在同一執行期間執行這兩項操作，否則出口將被阻塞。主要的困難是大量的矮人往往會同時仇恨。做好肇事逃逸或管理大型團體的準備。
0978f262775fd3832a183ce18cfa514421ce2d5b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

177bcad2d8efcd1c21a7459921646cca9e8e0090.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d9109f0e00f3ef87f428f68131dcf6b1819a1d40.source: Aside from large groups of Dwarves (see above), there are three additional difficulties here. (1) Some places have chained clerics and reavers popups, which may overwhelm groups already engaged in a fight. Pulling is recommended, as well as tactical retreats. (2) At the door right before the boss, there are popups. Each time you kill them, a larger groups spawns. There are a limited number of groups, but unprepared groups may suffer a wipe. Pulling is recommended to avoid the new group appearing on top of you. Also, these use life-stealing skills. Focus fire and general caster-shutdown is recommended against them. (3) Selvetarm and his group use Jagged Bones and Death Nova to produce a self-renewing supply of undead bombs. Using Verata skills to steal his minions will help, or some form of spike AoE damage such as splinter barrage.
d9109f0e00f3ef87f428f68131dcf6b1819a1d40.text: 除了一大群矮人（見上文）之外，這裡還存在三個額外的困難。 (1) 有些地方有鍊式牧師和掠奪者彈出視窗，這可能會壓垮已經參與戰鬥的團體。建議撤退，以及戰術撤退。 (2) 在 Boss 前方的門口，有一個彈出視窗。每次你殺死它們，就會產生更大的群體。團體數量有限，但毫無準備的團體可能會遭到抹殺。建議拉動以避免新的組出現在您的上方。此外，它們還使用生命竊取技能。建議針對它們使用 聚能器 火災和一般施法器關閉。 (3) 希維塔姆 和他的團隊使用 鋸齒骸骨 和 死亡新星 生產可自我更新的不死炸彈。使用芙瑞達技能偷走他的小兵會有所幫助，或是一些型態的尖峰範圍性傷害，例如碎片彈幕。
d9109f0e00f3ef87f428f68131dcf6b1819a1d40.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2731d5609ec73d514983b23f8e420ee957e460ee.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7e3b8f98e80cd69b496b36e9fdf94aba57152c14.source: Enemies primarily consist of large groups of fire elementals and large groups of Stone Summit.
7e3b8f98e80cd69b496b36e9fdf94aba57152c14.text: 敵人主要由大群火元素和大群 石峰矮人 組成。
7e3b8f98e80cd69b496b36e9fdf94aba57152c14.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d180179ee6df13872496fd6490af18f49a38ef5c.source: A general strategy against this is to have a dedicated Tank/Aggro manager, a Protection or bonder monk, and a few AoE damagers. Cast protective spells on tank, have them hold the aggro, then do as much AoE damage as possible to thin out the group. A ranger with Frozen Soil is highly recommended against Stone Summit to prevent resurrection, and Gaze of Fury to remove spirits when needed.
d180179ee6df13872496fd6490af18f49a38ef5c.text: 應對這種情況的一般策略是擁有專門的 擋怪的人/Aggro 經理、一名保護或束縛僧侶以及一些 範圍性 傷害者。對坦克施放保護法術，讓他們控制住仇恨，然後盡可能造成 範圍性 傷害，以削弱隊伍的實力。強烈建議使用 凍土 的遊俠對抗 石峰矮人 以防止復活，並在需要時使用 狂暴凝視 來移除靈魂。
d180179ee6df13872496fd6490af18f49a38ef5c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a6a77512b99034eb7147926d08aaff918760fa67.text: 黑色 唐肯 的級別
a6a77512b99034eb7147926d08aaff918760fa67.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8a71f481984a128f60e87c0ba208b1346b7df329.source: The mobs in this area are composed entirely of Stone Summit and Restless Dead popups. The Restless Dead use Vampiric Touch and Vampiric Bite quite a bit, which can be countered with "Can't Touch This!". Refer to the other sections for skills and tactics to counter Summit dwarves.
8a71f481984a128f60e87c0ba208b1346b7df329.text: 該區域的生物完全由 石峰矮人 和 Restless Dead 彈出視窗組成。 Restless Dead 常用 吸血鬼之觸 和 吸血之咬，這可以用「Can't Touch This!」來應付。請參閱其他部分以瞭解對抗頂峰矮人的技能和戰術。
8a71f481984a128f60e87c0ba208b1346b7df329.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

98b193fa93cec894a22a712af9efd7e57f5337d7.source: Duncan the Black awaits in a large room full of Restless Dead popups. Sweeping the room to popup and killing all foes makes the following fight easier.
98b193fa93cec894a22a712af9efd7e57f5337d7.text: 黑色 唐肯 在一個充滿 Restless Dead 彈出視窗的大房間裡等待著。掃蕩房間彈出並殺死所有敵人使接下來的戰鬥變得更容易。
98b193fa93cec894a22a712af9efd7e57f5337d7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

588b1f412b08cc3a8d5bba806e806a0b45d7bf3e.source: When approaching Duncan, several groups of Spirits will appear. Not only will these spirits damage, blind and disenchant you, several of Duncan's skills profit from having a spirit within earshot as well. These spirits will respawn when killed, but it is possible to move them away using Swap before engaging Duncan.
588b1f412b08cc3a8d5bba806e806a0b45d7bf3e.text: 接近鄧肯的時候，就會出現幾群魂靈。這些靈魂不僅會傷害、致盲和驅散你的迷惑，而且鄧肯的一些技能也會因聽力範圍內的靈魂而受益。這些靈魂在被殺死後會重生，但在與鄧肯交戰之前可以使用 交替 將它們移除。
588b1f412b08cc3a8d5bba806e806a0b45d7bf3e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b25226bd6963771627fe98d608ae2b43d9be9789.source: Duncan himself uses Duncan's Defense, which deals twice the damage he takes back to you. Don't damage him too quickly, or your healers will struggle to keep you alive. This can be circumvented by using life stealing or health loss instead of damage. Due to his large amount of health, Spoil Victor works great.
b25226bd6963771627fe98d608ae2b43d9be9789.text: 鄧肯本人使用鄧肯防禦，造成的傷害是他對你造成的傷害的兩倍。不要太快傷害他，否則你的治療師將很難讓你活下去。這可以透過使用生命竊取或健康損失而不是傷害來規避。由於 勝者的掠奪 的生命值很高，因此效果非常好。
b25226bd6963771627fe98d608ae2b43d9be9789.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f8aa317b84f4b696d4aeb9853b2cd7505e06c9f9.source: Once Duncan is dead, the spirits will disappear.
f8aa317b84f4b696d4aeb9853b2cd7505e06c9f9.text: 一旦鄧肯死了，靈魂就會消失。
f8aa317b84f4b696d4aeb9853b2cd7505e06c9f9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a092e89f326e6a522eb37b940a6c3deb03688209.source: You can leave the dungeon at any time between completing the rooms of the bosses. The game records any killed bosses as killed in the quest log. The log will not be reset.
a092e89f326e6a522eb37b940a6c3deb03688209.text: 您可以在完成 Boss 房間之間的任何時間離開地牢。遊戲會在任務日誌中記錄所有被殺死的 Boss。日誌不會被重置。
a092e89f326e6a522eb37b940a6c3deb03688209.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a8ee84dd70f9adf2c0c4b9a0fcf38a163e6c0886.source: This quest also rewards 5000 Norn reputation points for first time completion. 2500 Norn reputation are awarded upon repeat.
a8ee84dd70f9adf2c0c4b9a0fcf38a163e6c0886.text: 首次完成此任務也會獎勵 5000 諾恩 聲望點數。 2500 諾恩 聲譽在重複時授予。
a8ee84dd70f9adf2c0c4b9a0fcf38a163e6c0886.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ed3907c2c4a544c1a366ab85055db3a7b0f510e1.source: To gain access to Duncan's dungeon, all party members must kill the preceding four bosses Justiciar Thommis, Rand Stormweaver, Selvetarm and Forgewight as shown in The Last Hierophant quest. The 4 "defeat" lines must be crossed off leaving only "Destroy Duncan the Black" left undone. This situation is frequently abbreviated "4/5". Once you have completed the quest, you will need to retake it and kill the other bosses before you can face Duncan again.
ed3907c2c4a544c1a366ab85055db3a7b0f510e1.text: 要進入鄧肯的地牢，所有隊員必須殺死前面的四個頭目 司法官 湯米茲、織暴者 硬皮、希維塔姆 和 煉冶維特，如《最後的聖職者》任務中所示。 4「失敗」行必須劃掉，只留下「銷毀 黑色 唐肯」未完成。這種情況通常縮寫為“4/5”。完成任務後，您需要重新接受任務並殺死其他 Boss，然後才能再次面對鄧肯。
ed3907c2c4a544c1a366ab85055db3a7b0f510e1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

93587988b81627dc9f137fbd62df9e5f808e6a30.source: Destroy the Shadow Overlords. You have [4...0] Shadow Overlords left.
93587988b81627dc9f137fbd62df9e5f808e6a30.text: 摧毀 闇影 霸主。您還剩下 [4...0] 闇影 霸主。
93587988b81627dc9f137fbd62df9e5f808e6a30.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

19d233e31311f3264e914757efa15d67b855045b.source: Return to Miko the Unchained for your reward.
19d233e31311f3264e914757efa15d67b855045b.text: 影返 交給不受束縛的米科以獲得獎勵。
19d233e31311f3264e914757efa15d67b855045b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d1461ccfac850414de699634b3050356ed4d8cd5.source: Clear the Burning Forest before accepting this quest, otherwise you will have to deal with the original mobs while you tackle those spawned by the quest. As long as you can control how many mobs you confront at once, the area is easy. However, it is often difficult to do this because they have overlapping patrol routes. If you start to get overwhelmed, get as far away as quickly as you can; the groups will sometimes follow you almost all the way back to Miko.
d1461ccfac850414de699634b3050356ed4d8cd5.text: 在接受這個任務之前清理燃燒的森林，否則你將不得不在處理任務產生的怪物時處理原來的怪物。只要你能控制一次面對的小怪數量，這個區域就很容易。然而，這樣做往往很困難，因為它們的巡邏路線重疊。如果您開始不知所措，請盡快遠離；有時，這些團體會跟著你幾乎一路回到 Miko。
d1461ccfac850414de699634b3050356ed4d8cd5.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4925f5beb69300e0033de7c2cfdb2024e144dc83.source: The quest itself spawns four additional groups, each consisting of a Shadow Overlord and three allies. Killing these groups is all that's required to complete the quest.
4925f5beb69300e0033de7c2cfdb2024e144dc83.text: 任務本身會產生四個額外的小組，每個小組由一個 闇影 霸主和三個盟友組成。只需殺死這些團體即可完成任務。
4925f5beb69300e0033de7c2cfdb2024e144dc83.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

50a24f14bf9249102ac948e1945bf6aae40ca4ca.source: The Enslaved Hero you save makes a slow, safe walk back to the Forest of the Wailing Lord.
50a24f14bf9249102ac948e1945bf6aae40ca4ca.text: 你拯救的被奴役的 英雄 會緩慢而安全地走回 悲鳴領主區。
50a24f14bf9249102ac948e1945bf6aae40ca4ca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0486a5fd0cc7be0b09322664a1514edcff9706d6.source: Unlike every other quest (except A Strange Request), the objectives include words highlighted in green.
0486a5fd0cc7be0b09322664a1514edcff9706d6.text: 與其他任務不同（除了「奇怪的請求」），目標包括以綠色突出顯示的單字。
0486a5fd0cc7be0b09322664a1514edcff9706d6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b7a2105171153f5ed17d2bab5a8987d7e4172e61.source: Clear Snake Dance in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.
b7a2105171153f5ed17d2bab5a8987d7e4172e61.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人的 南席娃山脈 中的 蛇舞。
b7a2105171153f5ed17d2bab5a8987d7e4172e61.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

85fadddb39747c175dfa89baae20c51cb7fac1f5.source: "Clear Snake Dance in the Southern Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode."
85fadddb39747c175dfa89baae20c51cb7fac1f5.text: “在困難模式下清除所有敵人的南席娃山脈中的蛇舞。”
85fadddb39747c175dfa89baae20c51cb7fac1f5.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3d478011d131a6eecc5735c608a89bc80bcb2045.source: The easiest way to reach this area is to first get to Camp Rankor and head out its northwestern exit. Camp Rankor is usually reached only towards the end of the Prophecies campaign.
3d478011d131a6eecc5735c608a89bc80bcb2045.text: 到達該區域的最簡單方法是先到達 藍口營地 並從其西北出口出去。 藍口營地 通常只有在 阿斯卡隆戰記 活動結束時才會達到。
3d478011d131a6eecc5735c608a89bc80bcb2045.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

db0f875ef0dc04fc3389ed074e62875cc18a43d0.source: To reach here from the Northern Shiverpeaks, head south out of Beacon's Perch and through both Lornar's Pass and Dreadnought's Drift; the journey is dangerous for a party of 6 out of Beacon's Perch as the areas are filled with high-level foes. This area lets characters reach Droknar's Forge, and there is a Beacon's Perch - Droknar's Forge run to allow early access to late-game areas and prestige armors.
db0f875ef0dc04fc3389ed074e62875cc18a43d0.text: 要從 北席娃山脈 到達這裡，請從 畢肯高地 向南行駛，穿過 洛拿斯通道 和 無懼者之丘；對於 畢肯高地 中的 6 隊伍來說，這段旅程很危險，因為這些區域充滿了高階敵人。該區域允許角色到達 卓克納熔爐，並且有一個 畢肯高地 - 卓克納熔爐 執行，以便儘早進入遊戲後期區域和聲望裝甲。
db0f875ef0dc04fc3389ed074e62875cc18a43d0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

449628c5a22b6194efbe99c7c19b35c95c96cdc0.source: There are many spots with about five or more Stone Summit corpses that do not vanish like regular corpses, exploited or not. The northern ones sometimes have a Tundra Giant corpse among them or a single hidden Nightmare. This is perhaps indicative that the Stone Summit are having difficulty gaining a foothold in this hostile area.
449628c5a22b6194efbe99c7c19b35c95c96cdc0.text: 許多地點大約有五具或更多 石峰矮人 屍體，無論是否被剝削，它們都不會像普通屍體一樣消失。北方的有時會有一具 冰原巨人 屍體或一個隱藏的 夢魘。這或許顯示 石峰矮人 很難在這個充滿敵意的地區站穩腳步。
449628c5a22b6194efbe99c7c19b35c95c96cdc0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3c35df0cc2a3333f98034443f94229332f89782a.source: There are many hidden Nightmare groups in this area, concentrated mostly around the center and towards the south.
3c35df0cc2a3333f98034443f94229332f89782a.text: 該區域有許多隱藏的 夢魘 團體，主要集中在中心周圍和南部。
3c35df0cc2a3333f98034443f94229332f89782a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

75261f3e56dede42abd7293cfdaca39c0ad90aba.source: If attempting to complete one or both of these quests at the same time, most of the Stone Summit spawned by Shiverpeak Stragglers will move out of the way if you bypass them and speak to Elsa Alston first.
75261f3e56dede42abd7293cfdaca39c0ad90aba.text: 如果嘗試同時完成其中一個或兩個任務，大多數 石峰矮人 產生於 掃蕩席娃山脈 如果你繞過他們並與之交談，他們就會讓開 愛爾莎艾斯頓 首先。
75261f3e56dede42abd7293cfdaca39c0ad90aba.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

95c49cc6b8d4a86b46e31dcdddae160dabf782af.source: The Ascalon Refugees will shout "Look out! It's the Dwarves!" when you engage any mob, even if they aren't Dwarves. They will also attack, despite Elsa's claim not to be fighters.

04d2ecc0aa6ccf381398498cf084d3717ae94dc2.source: For the quickest multiple profession skill capture running, it is best to start from Deldrimor War Camp and head west through Grenth's Footprint. This will bring you directly to the center of Snake Dance within a couple of minutes, thus closer to most of the bosses, which are in the north side of Snake Dance.

5d18e61af1ff90ca5b51b0164141a7f32a4ca19d.source: You will have been provided with skill that allows you to slow down an enemy (Warriors will receive a skill to run faster). Use these to hunt down and defeat Zho.

dd48e67166bdd98040e2f8d921ff10cb982a7e5e.source: Start from Altrumm Ruins. Follow the quest markers to the stone singers then protect them. The quest markers will lead you on a specific path (due to the complex nature of Arborstone's landscape), if you already know the locations of the singers you can find your own (possibly quicker path), or keep following the marker.
dd48e67166bdd98040e2f8d921ff10cb982a7e5e.text: 從 奧楚蘭廢墟 開始。跟著任務標記找到石歌手，然後保護他們。任務標記將引導您走上一條特定的路徑（由於阿伯斯通景觀的複雜性），如果您已經知道歌手的位置，您可以找到自己的位置（可能更快的路徑），或者繼續跟隨標記。
dd48e67166bdd98040e2f8d921ff10cb982a7e5e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

908684d64f2f9042545cd4e7159776a7351b6319.source: When you get to the places where Stone Singers are, as soon as you get close, they will plead for their lives and two or three groups of Luxons will spawn nearby within a few seconds and rush towards them. Each group of Luxons usually have about three units.
908684d64f2f9042545cd4e7159776a7351b6319.text: 當你到達石歌者所在的地方時，只要你靠近，他們就會求饒，幾秒鐘之內就會有兩三群盧克森人在附近生成，並向他們衝去。每組 Luxons 通常有大約三個單位。
908684d64f2f9042545cd4e7159776a7351b6319.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

212312afc55ca87f7ebb91fab62471bb36665542.source: If there is only one Stone Singer, make sure your party quickly surrounds him in order to act as a shield. The Luxons will aggro your party and engage the soft targets, ignoring the singer. If you have one or more Ritualists in your party, setting up spirits around the singer will also help distract the attackers, therefore allowing you to easily attack without the worry of having to protect the Stone Singers.
212312afc55ca87f7ebb91fab62471bb36665542.text: 如果只有一名石歌者，請確保你的隊伍迅速包圍他，以充當盾牌。 Luxons 會激怒你的隊伍並與軟目標交戰，而忽略歌手。如果你的隊伍中有一名或多名儀式者，在歌手周圍設定靈魂也將有助於分散攻擊者的注意力，因此讓你可以輕鬆攻擊，而不必擔心必須保護石歌手。
212312afc55ca87f7ebb91fab62471bb36665542.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8c1fc5c585ced6cd5f359b15c3a3b8c04813f073.source: The one location where it might be problematic is point 3 in the map above. There are three singers there and it could be hard to cover all of them since the Luxons approach from three directions, and there is usually a group of Stone Scale Kirin and Dragon Moss nearby that is hard to avoid. If you are playing with other players, spread out further and take on the individual groups. If you're playing this with henchmen, try to stand near the middle and move about as the Luxons approach to take the aggro. Please note that henchmen do not heal the Stone Singers. If this is difficult, then try to protect just one of them, since the quest can still be completed even if you lose a couple singers.
8c1fc5c585ced6cd5f359b15c3a3b8c04813f073.text: 可能出現問題的一個位置是上面地圖中的 3 點。那裡有三個歌手，很難將他們全部覆蓋，因為盧克森人從三個方向接近，而且附近通常有一群石鱗麒麟和龍苔，很難避開。如果您正在與其他玩家一起玩，請進一步分散並與各個小組進行對抗。如果你和追隨者一起玩這個遊戲，請嘗試站在中間附近，並在盧克森人接近時四處走動以承受仇恨。請注意，追隨者不會治癒石歌者。如果這很困難，那麼試著只保護其中一個，因為即使你失去了幾個歌手，任務仍然可以完成。
8c1fc5c585ced6cd5f359b15c3a3b8c04813f073.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

572fae18077a0b1db84a1c19c0a0d4629c0ba6e4.source: If you have the quest Wardens On the March active in your Quest Log and follow the path put forth by the quest markers, getting to the last marker will require you to go through the large mob of Wardens from that quest. They will be waiting on the stairs between points 7 and 8 (refer to the quest map), but of course you can either avoid this mob, or save time and do both quests at the same time.
572fae18077a0b1db84a1c19c0a0d4629c0ba6e4.text: 如果您的 任務 日誌中啟動了「行軍中的守望者」任務，並按照任務標記所指定的路徑前進，則要到達最後一個標記，您將需要穿過該任務中的大量守望者。他們將在 7 和 8 點之間的樓梯上等待（請參閱任務地圖），但當然你可以避開這個怪物，或者節省時間並同時完成兩個任務。
572fae18077a0b1db84a1c19c0a0d4629c0ba6e4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5a26ad418a6304c915859fde7b9eb934b041b9b4.source: If you find it too difficult to get past the mobs of the wardens in order to get to point 8, you can purposely die to get to the Resurrection Shrine. From there, backtrack all the way to the Altrumm Ruins exit and then use the back door to the cathedral. While it is a long way, there are no enemies along this route, so it easily lets you complete the quest.
5a26ad418a6304c915859fde7b9eb934b041b9b4.text: 如果你發現透過守望者的小怪來到達 8 太困難了，你可以故意死亡來到達 復活祭壇。從那裡一直原路返回到 奧楚蘭廢墟 出口，然後從後門到達大教堂。雖然路途遙遠，但沿途沒有敵人，所以很容易就能完成任務。
5a26ad418a6304c915859fde7b9eb934b041b9b4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f7ccd7e4fa7355ca79f8688a0898bcf50a434cf3.source: Having the quest Charting the Forests at the same time is a also good idea as you will be easily able to complete the charting of the area with only minimal extra effort.
f7ccd7e4fa7355ca79f8688a0898bcf50a434cf3.text: 同時進行繪製森林圖任務也是一個好主意，因為您只需付出最少的額外努力即可輕鬆完成該區域的繪製。
f7ccd7e4fa7355ca79f8688a0898bcf50a434cf3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5a1a472b182fd19e2638f31d7f9e7da80e4745c4.source: A Restoration Ritualist should drop healing / protection spirits near the Singers. If possible, prioritize keeping the singers alive over your party.
5a1a472b182fd19e2638f31d7f9e7da80e4745c4.text: 復甦 祭祀者 應該在歌手附近掉落治療/保護精神。如果可能的話，優先考慮讓歌手活下去而不是你的派對。

6a33f78eade094f97a7cdd6c8fab77daa8887bcf.source: The route from Cavalon doesn't require you to fight Ssyn Coiled Grasp. Exit into the Archipelagos and head east, dispatching the first mob of fish that you encounter, then continue until you reach the edge of the map and head south. Now head for the boss, killing the patroling Naga and the two stationary Naga mobs in front of the boss. Engage and kill Ssuns, Blessed of Dwayna to complete the bounty.
6a33f78eade094f97a7cdd6c8fab77daa8887bcf.text: 從卡瓦隆開始的路線不需要你與Ssyn Coiled Grasp戰鬥。進入 群島 並向東走，消滅你遇到的第一批魚，然後繼續前進，直到你到達地圖邊緣並向南走。現在前往 Boss，殺死 Boss 面前巡邏的 納迦 和兩個靜止的 納迦 怪物。交戰並殺死 薇娜的祝福 桑斯 以完成賞金。

3b0318e863848d5432097ef61560bf4d11545b95.source: If taking the route from Jade Flats (Luxon), your party will only encounter Naga Warriors, Naga Archers, Naga Ritualists, Ssyn Coiled Grasp, and a few Kappa. Hex removal skills are unnecessary if your party does not contain any allies that require attacks and attack skills to deal damage, since your party will only encounter a total of two Kappas who use Blurred Vision and Shatterstone (whose end effect triggers even if the hex is removed). Consider not bringing blocking skills, since they can be bypassed by Naga Warriors and Archers. Naga Warriors and Archers can also interrupt with Distracting Blow and Concussion Shot, so consider skills that can prevent interrupts, inflict blind or cause misses. Consider Signet of Binding for Destruction spirits created by Naga Ritualists and Ssyn Coiled Grasp.
3b0318e863848d5432097ef61560bf4d11545b95.text: 如果從玉石灘 (勒克森) 出發，你的隊伍只會遇到 納迦 戰士、納迦 弓箭手、納迦 儀式者、Ssyn 捲起手和一些河童。如果你的隊伍不包含任何需要攻擊和攻擊技能來造成傷害的盟友，則不需要妖術去除技能，因為你的隊伍只會遇到總共兩個使用模糊視線和碎裂冰石的卡帕（即使妖術被去除，其最終效果也會觸發）。考慮不要帶阻擋技能，因為 納迦 戰士和弓箭手可以繞過它們。 納迦 戰士和弓箭手也可以用 虛晃打擊 和 迷惑之箭 打斷，因此請考慮可以防止打斷、造成失明或導致失誤的技能。請考慮使用 束縛紋章 購買由 納迦 Ritualists 和 Ssyn Coiled Grasp 打造的 毀滅 烈酒。

ddcc651c604cd61aaf0db820a46f6074f08b388f.source: Starting from The Marketplace follow along the northern edge until you reach the bridge closest to the northwestern end. Getting to Quufu will be difficult; the small island has a number of enemies and a large group of them constantly patrols around it. Pulling one group of enemies will spawn another which may end up pulling another nearby group, leading to you quickly being swarmed and wiped. Quufu will initially be alone, but if you step in the immediate vicinity of the asterisk on your minimap, a mob will spawn with him. You can pull Quufu away using ranged attacks, and aggro him separately, preventing the additional spawns. Killing him ends the quest.

You can pull Quufu away using ranged attacks, and aggro him separately, preventing the 殺了他就結束了任務。
