b7f4aabe8ebf150b8edbcf58d76ecb0c78486205.source: Find Galen Trask in Grenth's Footprint, and lead him to Sorrow's Furnace. Once inside, speak to him to receive this quest. He wants you to pretend to be a slave, and to scout out five locations. He will cast Chains of Enslavement on you, which will render most Stone Summit friendly. The main enemies you'll fight will be rebellious Dredge, and nearby Stone Summit will help you. It is not possible to remove the Chains of Enslavement condition while inside Sorrow's Furnace during this quest, so don't worry about betraying your identity.
b7f4aabe8ebf150b8edbcf58d76ecb0c78486205.text: 在古蘭斯的足跡中找到嘉倫崔斯特，並引導他到悲傷熔爐。進去後與他交談即可接受此任務。他希望你假裝是奴隸，並偵察五個地點。他會對你施放奴役之鏈，這將使大多數 石峰矮人 變得友好。你要對抗的主要敵人是叛逆的 挖掘者，附近的 石峰矮人 會幫助你。在此任務期間，在 悲傷熔爐 內無法消除奴役之鏈條件，因此不必擔心洩露您的身分。
b7f4aabe8ebf150b8edbcf58d76ecb0c78486205.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

55a983f2c9c76bf228d3b8c0fd12d9baf8f18108.source: Galen Trask will sell you to Taskmaster Ironboot, who will lead you to Krak Flamewhip, who will offer five optional subquests that can be done whilst scouting the locations for Trask. These quests will take you to places close to the spots you'll have to scout for Galen. For more information on these subquests, see the entries: Cold One, Fire in the Hole, Gathering Resources, Unruly Slaves, and Wrenches In The Gears. If you don't want to bother with the subquests, simply follow your direction arrows to scout out locations. If you wish to do the subquests, have a look at Gathering Resources first and speak to Tharn Stonerift, as he will ask you to gather iron ore that can be found in the course of completing the other subquests.
55a983f2c9c76bf228d3b8c0fd12d9baf8f18108.text: 嘉倫崔斯特 會把你賣給模仿大師鐵靴，他會帶你去克拉克·火鞭，他會提供五個可選的子任務，可以在偵察特拉斯克的位置時完成。這些任務將帶你前往尋找蓋倫的地點附近的地方。有關這些子任務的更多資訊，請參閱條目：冰東西、Fire in the Hole、Gathering Resources、Unruly Slaves 和 Wrenches In The Gears。如果您不想打擾子任務，只需按照方向箭頭偵察位置即可。如果你想完成子任務，請先檢視收集資源並與 Tharn Stonerift 交談，因為他會要求你收集在完成其他子任務過程中可以找到的鐵礦石。
55a983f2c9c76bf228d3b8c0fd12d9baf8f18108.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c76af716b54f41e2f55603f9a78075ad315b3c0f.source: Accepting a subquest from Krak Flamewhip will spawn a number of foes. The main Summit Slaves quest is a lot easier to complete without accepting any of these subquests. Alternatively, it's possible (though it'll take a long time) to complete the main Summit Slaves quest and then go to Krak Flamewhip to accept his subquests. These will be less difficult seeing that you'll already have killed most of the foes.
c76af716b54f41e2f55603f9a78075ad315b3c0f.text: 接受克拉克火鞭的子任務將會產生許多敵人。在不接受任何這些子任務的情況下，主峰會奴隸任務更容易完成。或者，也可以（儘管需要很長時間）完成主峰奴隸任務，然後前往克拉克火鞭接受他的子任務。因為你已經殺死了大部分敵人，所以這些都會變得不那麼困難。
c76af716b54f41e2f55603f9a78075ad315b3c0f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fb432555b0aeb817f816baefd44e5272d392d5f6.source: While journeying through the caves, carrying a Master Gear is unnecessary as these slow your movement rate and there is always one nearby in a working gearbox. Since the main quest (and all 5 subquests, should the player choose to do them) mostly consists of running, consider having at least one party member bring a party-wide speed boost skill.
fb432555b0aeb817f816baefd44e5272d392d5f6.text: 在洞穴中旅行時，沒有必要攜帶主齒輪，因為它們會減慢你的移動速度，而且附近總是有一個正在工作的齒輪箱。由於主要任務（以及所有 5 子任務，如果玩家選擇執行它們）主要由跑步組成，因此請考慮讓至少一名隊伍成員攜帶全隊速度提陞技能。
fb432555b0aeb817f816baefd44e5272d392d5f6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8a382d6284efc5017eca18d2e6864865089550b9.source: When you have found a location the message "Quest Updated: Summit slaves" is displayed. Select the Summit Slaves quest in your quest log to see which locations you have visited. (Following the quest arrows in the order they appear results in a bit of backtracking, following the numbers on the wiki map would be quicker.)
8a382d6284efc5017eca18d2e6864865089550b9.text: 當您找到位置時，會顯示訊息「任務 已更新：Summit 從站」。在任務日誌中選擇高峰會奴隸任務，檢視您曾經造訪過的地點。 （按照任務箭頭出現的順序進行操作會導致一些回溯，按照維基地圖上的數字進行操作會更快。）

8d237895ae4107e589a3dadf58da7525335e58fe.source: After accepting the quest in Maatu Keep head south through the exit to Pongmei Valley. At the bottom of the ramp there are 3 refugees. As you approach them they will wave to each other and begin walking in separate directions. There's no need to rush since they are only walking and you can easily get to all three of them pretty easily before they've gone very far. Next head a little farther south where there will be 5 more refugees who will again wave to each other and begin walking their separate ways as soon as you approach them. Just like before these are pretty easy to get to as well.
8d237895ae4107e589a3dadf58da7525335e58fe.text: 接受任務後 麻都堡壘 通過出口向南行駛 朋美谷 。坡道底部有 3 難民。當你接近它們時，它們會互相揮手並開始朝著不同的方向行走。無需著急，因為他們只是步行，您可以在他們走很遠之前輕鬆到達他們三個。接下來再往南走一點，就會有 5 更多的難民會再次互相揮手，一旦你接近他們，他們就會開始分道揚鑣。就像以前一樣，這些也很容易到達。

ede7f59a791c7c8201c20699b2486e952fdd2dae.source: The quest to retrieve the egg is straightforward; the main thing to be contended with is the fact that Miresh dies entirely too easily, voiding the quest. A good strategy for getting around this is to stand back a ways from the quest target, then send your heroes in just past the nest. Once they've distracted the harpies, run in and grab the egg, then run away before you attract the attention of the Skree. Once you get a bit away, you can talk to Miresh to finish the quest, then head back to clean up the rest of the Skree (and resurrect any heroes which may have died during the initial assault).
ede7f59a791c7c8201c20699b2486e952fdd2dae.text: 取回蛋的任務很簡單；需要解決的主要問題是米雷什太容易死了，導致任務無效。解決這個問題的一個好策略是遠離任務目標，然後將你的英雄送到巢穴附近。一旦他們分散了鷹身女妖的注意力，就跑過去搶雞蛋，然後在吸引 鳥妖 的注意之前逃跑。 Once you get a bit away, you can talk to Miresh to finish the quest, then head back to clean up the rest of the 鳥妖 (and resurrect any heroes which may have died during the initial assault).

eb3393df099b7f8123f9d0f2640d1d0938d37d70.source: This quest is an easier way to gain access to Nightfall than Sunspears in Kryta, the equivalent quest from Prophecies: the party size is eight (instead of six); henchmen are level 20 (instead of 10); your other allies will be more durable; and it can be easier to take advantage of the geography to bunch up opponents or avoid them.

fab9d036e09af16cbcd7c390aa5c2ba2c508c9dd.source: After setting up your party, enter Bejunkan Pier and speak to Kormir who will transport you to a mission-instance of Kaineng Center. You will be confronted by Torment Claws and various other Chaos creatures (Grasps of Insanity, Scythes of Chaos, and Wrathful Storms). Your goal is to destroy the four Chaos Rifts (large purple bubbles) without succumbing to the foes.
fab9d036e09af16cbcd7c390aa5c2ba2c508c9dd.text: 組成好隊伍後，進入 君瞰碼頭 並與 Kormir 交談，他會將你傳送到 凱寧中心 的任務例項。你將面對折磨利爪和各種其他混沌生物（瘋狂之握、混沌鐮刀和憤怒風暴）。你的目標是摧毀四個混沌裂縫（紫色的大氣泡）而不屈服於敵人。
fab9d036e09af16cbcd7c390aa5c2ba2c508c9dd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

95a54a11a07c099a1ae836cc5150d3860890135b.source: Each time you stand near one of the rifts, a red progress bar will appear; it takes about 10 seconds to take down the rift and once removed, it cannot reappear. After you have banished the fourth rift, a countdown timer will appear (giving you some time to pick up any drops), after which you will be returned to the pier. Speak to Kormir again to take you to Elona. After a short cinematic, you will transported to the Sun Docks. Speak to Seamarshall Bendro to get credit for the quest.
95a54a11a07c099a1ae836cc5150d3860890135b.text: 每次你站在其中一個裂縫附近時，都會出現一個紅色進度條；大約需要 10 秒才能消除裂痕，一旦消除，它就無法再次出現。當你消除第四個裂縫後，將會出現一個倒數計時器（給你一些時間來拾取任何掉落物），之後你將回到碼頭。再次與科米爾交談，帶你前往伊洛娜。觀看簡短的電影後，您將前往太陽碼頭。與海軍元帥本德羅交談以獲得任務獎勵。
95a54a11a07c099a1ae836cc5150d3860890135b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c63772c1fdad1f17e7a4968c72358ac889e1fe3e.source: There is no time limit for the quest so proceed slowly and avoid aggroing too many foes at once: mobs are close together and will easily cause a wipe if you move too quickly. Pull foes away from the Torment Claws so you can confront those individually; if you do get swarmed, focus on the claws first or at least interrupt their Torment Slash. A cautious team of one player and seven henchmen can easily succeed while even a well-balanced party of eight players can fail if they over-aggro.
c63772c1fdad1f17e7a4968c72358ac889e1fe3e.text: 任務沒有時間限制，所以要慢慢進行，避免同時攻擊太多敵人：怪物距離很近，如果你移動得太快，很容易造成消滅。 拉出 敵人遠離折磨之爪，這樣你就可以單獨對抗他們；如果你確實被包圍，請先專注於利爪，或至少打斷他們的折磨斬。一支由一名玩家和七名追隨者組成的謹慎團隊很容易成功，而即使是由八名玩家組成的平衡良好的隊伍如果過度仇恨也可能會失敗。
c63772c1fdad1f17e7a4968c72358ac889e1fe3e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

It may also be difficult to complete this quest using only the level 10 henchmen from Lion's Arch. You will, however, have four very hardy Lionguard Sentries following you.
40e1f52286e06b83f6184576ada278e71bfb13d2.text: 會有一些與高等級敵人的戰鬥，所以強烈建議不要單獨前往。僅使用 獅子拱門 等級的 10 追蹤者也可能很難完成此任務。然而，您將有四個非常頑強的獅子衛士哨兵跟隨您。

0c03823c13560b96a21da10a1728e553327f7546.source: You need to close four Chaos Rifts to defend Lion's Arch while fighting or avoiding groups of Wrathful Storms (level 24 elementalists), Scythes of Chaos (level 18 mesmers), Grasps of Insanity (level 22 warriors), and Torment Claws (stationary level 22 warriors) in the area. To close a rift, stand under it and wait to capture it. A red bar on the left side of your screen will indicate how far the rift has to go to close and how quickly it is closing. When the bar turns blue, the rift has closed.
0c03823c13560b96a21da10a1728e553327f7546.text: 你需要關閉四個混沌裂隙來保衛 獅子拱門，同時與該地區的憤怒風暴（24 級元素師）、混沌之鐮（18 級催眠師）、瘋狂之握（22 級戰士）和折磨之爪（22 級靜止戰士）戰鬥或躲避。要閉合裂縫，請站在裂縫下方等待捕獲它。螢幕左側的紅色條將指示裂縫需要多遠才能關閉以及關閉的速度。當條變成藍色時，裂縫已經關閉。
0c03823c13560b96a21da10a1728e553327f7546.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a8f8cd9e73a8afed317a0df1254d719b478807e0.source: Each rift is guarded by a Grasp of Insanity and either a Wrathful Storm or a Scythe of Chaos, sometimes with a Torment Claw as well. You may avoid killing them while you capture the rift, but they can capture the rifts back. Be wary of other groups that may be patrolling nearby. Once all four rifts are closed, a 30 second timer counts down. You must hold all four rifts during this time.

266398e29d1db0cc182bc740604952795093bac1.source: With the primary quest A Meeting With the Emperor active, there will be only 2 Temple Guardian foes to kill; however, be careful on your route or you will illuminate other foes that are still present to the north (a map is available here). It does not matter when you speak with the Emperor, as long as the quest is active.
266398e29d1db0cc182bc740604952795093bac1.text: 當主線任務「與皇帝會面」啟動後，將只有 2 神殿 守護者 敵人需要殺死；然而，要小心你的路線，否則你會照亮其他仍然存在於北方的敵人（這裡有地圖）。只要任務有效，什麼時候與皇帝交談並不重要。

19b684bf92370a9ffaa8fe0700a7f3d68d9f88c3.source: When vanquishing normally, take care when engaging the numerous Jade Brotherhood mobs. Spread out the party before engaging, as the casters can easily cause a party wipe. Anti-melee skills and elemental damage protection or mitigation are recommended.
19b684bf92370a9ffaa8fe0700a7f3d68d9f88c3.text: 正常擊敗時，在與眾多 翡翠兄弟會 怪物交戰時要小心。在參與之前將隊伍分散開，因為腳輪很容易導致隊伍消失。建議使用反近戰技能和元素傷害保護或緩解。
19b684bf92370a9ffaa8fe0700a7f3d68d9f88c3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e69401b23ea1130c37b80b18c822ade691beb911.source: Jade Knights can cause serious damage to your back line, so it is recommended to take care of them first.
e69401b23ea1130c37b80b18c822ade691beb911.text: 翡翠騎士會對你的後線造成嚴重傷害，所以建議先處理掉他們。
e69401b23ea1130c37b80b18c822ade691beb911.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c0542e8f93ca2890698fa75033e96e3e982e92c2.source: The shimmer on the exit portal to the Tahnnakai Temple outpost does not always show up, making it appear the same as any other door, so be careful you do not accidentally exit this area while vanquishing.
c0542e8f93ca2890698fa75033e96e3e982e92c2.text: 譚納凱神殿 前哨站的出口門戶上的微光並不總是出現，使其看起來與任何其他門相同，因此請小心，不要在征服時意外退出該區域。
c0542e8f93ca2890698fa75033e96e3e982e92c2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b631715c4c7d6ede3e60594695cb4e6936235ae9.source: The northern-most tip of this area contains a feature not found anywhere else in Guild Wars: a multi-level spiraling ramp that leads from the lower temple area mostly inhabited by Temple Guardian foes to a much higher area occupied by the Jade Brotherhood. The upper section contains its own system of watery areas and bridges across them, so if that is actually "ground level" then the spiraling ramp provides a good indication of the depth of the temple shrines and the Zin Ku Corridor within the sewers.
b631715c4c7d6ede3e60594695cb4e6936235ae9.text: 該區域的最北端包含一個在 公會 戰爭中其他任何地方都找不到的特徵：一個多層螺旋坡道，從主要由 守護者 敵人居住的較低神廟區域通往由 翡翠兄弟會 佔據的較高區域。上部部分包含其自己的水域系統和橫跨它們的橋梁，因此，如果這實際上是“地面”，那麼螺旋坡道可以很好地指示寺廟神社和下水道內 辛庫走廊 的深度。
b631715c4c7d6ede3e60594695cb4e6936235ae9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6b8fa0f3619f9817858b549e1cca8fb158815654.source: This area is replaced by its War in Kryta equivalent and the level design changes after your character has completed either Prophecies or Eye of the North. If War in Kryta is completed and your character holds no Wanted by the Shining Blade bounty, you'll enter the War in Kryta version of the map without the War in Kryta spawns.
6b8fa0f3619f9817858b549e1cca8fb158815654.text: 該區域將被其 科瑞塔戰爭 等效項取代，並且關卡設計會在您的角色完成 阿斯卡隆戰記 或 極地之眼 後變更。如果 科瑞塔戰爭 已完成且您的角色沒有獲得 光刃公會 賞金的通緝，您將進入地圖的 科瑞塔戰爭 版本，而不會產生 科瑞塔戰爭。

b0f632b34f22e906762f6a67ad3a0c270d710323.source: You can only return to the pre-WiK level design version by teaming up with someone which has not completed Eye of the North or Prophecies. This is relevant for cartography, as there's a sliver of map to the north-east that can only be uncovered when exploring the original map.
b0f632b34f22e906762f6a67ad3a0c270d710323.text: 您只能透過與未完成 極地之眼 或 阿斯卡隆戰記 的人員團隊一起回到 WiK 之前的關卡設計版本。這與製圖相關，因為東北方有一小片地圖只能在探索原始地圖時才能發現。

1b786fd945e1f50cd404585d1058423a0d93b4da.source: Two groups of Tundra Giants are easy to miss. Both patrol a long route using the mountain top path on the westernmost side of the map - one patrols clockwise, the other counter-clockwise.
1b786fd945e1f50cd404585d1058423a0d93b4da.text: 兩群苔原巨人很容易被錯過。兩者都使用地圖最西側的山頂小路巡邏很長的路線 - 一個順時針巡邏，另一個逆時針巡邏。

5af23b4bffb18c636e624accd7a31f8658398b6c.source: There are many forms of knock down in this area, between Giant Stomp and Water Trident. Bringing anti-knockdown skills can be a huge help.
5af23b4bffb18c636e624accd7a31f8658398b6c.text: 此區域有多種擊倒形式，介於 重踩 和 水之三叉戟 之間。攜帶抗擊倒技能可以提供巨大的幫助。

bfef5f0d021e67e2404658ff33f42cc1d7c8f416.source: A roaming group of Avicara may also lengthen your vanquish, they range over an area south and east of the nametag on the map.
bfef5f0d021e67e2404658ff33f42cc1d7c8f416.text: 阿畢卡拉 的漫遊群體也可能延長您的征服時間，它們的範圍涵蓋地圖上名牌以南和以東的區域。
bfef5f0d021e67e2404658ff33f42cc1d7c8f416.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f955a1d901936a296ab5bcdde28339f2f6cadcbe.source: Low-level creatures usually encountered in the Northern Shiverpeaks can be found wandering about various places in solitude. They have no special abilities that distinguish them from other low-level monsters, and do not appear to have any purpose or relation to any quest. In hard mode, their levels and skills are adjusted to a degree appropriate for the area, but they are still alone.
f955a1d901936a296ab5bcdde28339f2f6cadcbe.text: 通常在 北席娃山脈 中遇到的低階生物會在各個地方孤獨地遊蕩。它們沒有與其他低階怪物區分開來的特殊能力，並且似乎與任何任務沒有任何目的或關係。在困難模式下，他們的等級和技能會調整到適合該地區的程度，但他們仍然是孤獨的。
f955a1d901936a296ab5bcdde28339f2f6cadcbe.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1bfa1218700e71753956f4fa48ca85b43f847274.source: The "troll cave" can be found to the west of Droknar's Forge, which contains many Mountain Trolls and two Troll bosses. It was once a popular spot for farming.
1bfa1218700e71753956f4fa48ca85b43f847274.text: 「巨魔洞穴」位於 卓克納熔爐 的西邊，裡面有許多山地巨魔和兩個巨魔 Boss。它曾經是一個受歡迎的農業地點。
1bfa1218700e71753956f4fa48ca85b43f847274.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aab179829afd267fdc9c61ec45a6fb744a0eeaa6.source: It is possible to reach the edge of the map in the eastern Talus Chute. The terrain abruptly ends, with the sky and ocean visible beyond it. This "edge of the world" bug is an artifact of the way DirectX renders the world. It exists in all areas, but most have obstructions to prevent players from seeing it.
aab179829afd267fdc9c61ec45a6fb744a0eeaa6.text: 可以到達東部碎石坡道的地圖邊緣。地形突然結束，遠處可見天空和海洋。這個「世界邊緣」錯誤是 DirectX 渲染世界方式的產物。它存在於所有區域，但大多數都有障礙物阻止玩家看到它。
aab179829afd267fdc9c61ec45a6fb744a0eeaa6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

26bde3c9d00f9ab22d1c73d5b5acdb3f30e62ffc.source: The items are easily located by simply following the quest marker, although you can probably save time by knowing where to go to minimize the distance traveled. Each item is found in a plain Chest that appears only after defeating an enemy group that "guards" it (it's the group that's targeted by the quest marker). Each enemy group consists of the same set of Stone Summit, as noted in the NPCs section below. These groups are relatively easy to defeat, just be careful of not getting entangled with more than one or two enemy groups, since their locations are usually filled with closely packed enemies. After retrieving the five items, head back to Marshall Whitman for your reward.
26bde3c9d00f9ab22d1c73d5b5acdb3f30e62ffc.text: 只需跟隨任務標記即可輕鬆找到這些物品，儘管您可以透過知道去哪裡以最小化行駛距離來節省時間。每個專案都在一個簡單的 寶箱 中找到，只有在擊敗「守衛」它的敵方團體（這是任務標記的目標團體）後才會出現。每個敵人群體都由同一組 石峰矮人 組成，如下面的 NPC 部分所述。這些群體相對容易被擊敗，只是要小心不要與超過一兩個敵人群體糾纏，因為它們的位置通常充滿了密集的敵人。取回五件物品後，返回馬歇爾·惠特曼那裡領取獎勵。

67e39a8ab3cceeeea0ca61b37ef363d4fe052d3c.source: See Zudash Dejarin for your reward.
67e39a8ab3cceeeea0ca61b37ef363d4fe052d3c.text: 請前往 Zudash Dejarin 領取獎勵。
67e39a8ab3cceeeea0ca61b37ef363d4fe052d3c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4fe963ca925743f7d93f110cf5c4841e1eb2bbdc.source: After accepting the quest, talk to Vadah who is also in Pogahn Passage. Next pay a visit to Caretaker Palmor in the Dejarin Estate. She will initially be hostile, so kill off the other soldiers and attack her until she is willing to talk. Backtrack to the location of the squatting soldiers and kill them.
4fe963ca925743f7d93f110cf5c4841e1eb2bbdc.text: 接受任務後，與也在 波甘驛站 中的瓦達交談。接下來拜訪德賈林莊園的看守帕瑪。她一開始會懷有敵意，所以殺死其他士兵並攻擊她，直到她願意說話為止。返回蹲守士兵的位置並殺死他們。
4fe963ca925743f7d93f110cf5c4841e1eb2bbdc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

657a1a974a3f7bb44ff186726f6bec9bbbcc2dc1.source: The quest can be completed without having Koss in the party by simply defeating both Caretaker Palmor's group and the group that needs to be "evicted" from the estate. The quest log will continue demanding for Koss' attendance and not update until both groups are dealt with (thus not showing the location of the latter), at which point it will complete.
657a1a974a3f7bb44ff186726f6bec9bbbcc2dc1.text: 只需擊敗看護者帕爾莫的隊伍和需要從莊園「驅逐」的隊伍，即可在隊伍中沒有 寇斯 的情況下完成任務。任務日誌將繼續要求 寇斯 的出席，並且直到兩組都被處理後才會更新（因此不會顯示後者的位置），此時它將完成。
657a1a974a3f7bb44ff186726f6bec9bbbcc2dc1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d649a22ce2de846fda12c1d898bbcb55dba28c71.source: Speak to Mhenlo at the Consulate Docks to learn more about the situation in Tyria.
d649a22ce2de846fda12c1d898bbcb55dba28c71.text: 請與領事館碼頭的 涵洛 聯絡，以瞭解更多有關 泰瑞亞 情況的資訊。
d649a22ce2de846fda12c1d898bbcb55dba28c71.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1dc2d4c518cbf151277d6d556eb720121184b64d.source: Tell Mhenlo when you are ready to leave for Tyria.
1dc2d4c518cbf151277d6d556eb720121184b64d.text: 當您準備好前往 泰瑞亞 時，請告訴 涵洛。
1dc2d4c518cbf151277d6d556eb720121184b64d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fd6925f401a38bea271ed8e33c0bdd9cd7d41b0f.source: Report to Lionguard Neiro in the foreign administration center and gain entrance to Lion's Arch and the lands of Kryta.
fd6925f401a38bea271ed8e33c0bdd9cd7d41b0f.text: 向外國管理中心的獅王內羅報到並進入 獅子拱門 和 科瑞塔 的土地。
fd6925f401a38bea271ed8e33c0bdd9cd7d41b0f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

05e293f4effc07cacd9897cc8397b8d57acc5191.source: Inform Firstwatch Sergio, captain of the Lionguard, that you have arrived in Lion's Arch.
05e293f4effc07cacd9897cc8397b8d57acc5191.text: 通知獅衛隊隊長 警衛隊長薩吉歐，您已到達 獅子拱門。
05e293f4effc07cacd9897cc8397b8d57acc5191.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bd429845bb9b057f9891ca870f66172e15982073.source: Map travel to the Consulate Docks. Walking there is impossible due to a closed gate. Talk to Mhenlo once, then talk to him again to set off for Tyria. When you get to Lion's Gate talk to Lionguard Neiro to open the gate into Lion's Arch.
bd429845bb9b057f9891ca870f66172e15982073.text: 地圖前往領事館碼頭。由於大門緊閉，步行去那裡是不可能的。與 涵洛 交談一次，然後再次與他交談以出發前往 泰瑞亞。當你到達 獅門 時，與 Lionguard Neiro 交談以開啟 獅子拱門 的大門。
bd429845bb9b057f9891ca870f66172e15982073.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b4273c8363191d96fc42651940fd39e14877e5d2.source: This quest unlocks the Lions Arch port (once you have walked through the portal from Lion's Gate).
b4273c8363191d96fc42651940fd39e14877e5d2.text: 此任務將解鎖獅子拱門埠（一旦您從 獅門 穿過門戶）。
b4273c8363191d96fc42651940fd39e14877e5d2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a93276593acf5d01bd02a33eddbc13746dfe5968.source: A Nightfall character with this quest can ferry characters of any level (from any Campaign) to Tyria, provided that they have Consulate Docks unlocked (i.e. by either having completed The Time is Nigh themselves, or having previously received a ferry to the docks from Kamadan via that quest).
a93276593acf5d01bd02a33eddbc13746dfe5968.text: 執行此任務的 黑暗逆襲 角色可以將任何級別的角色（從任何 章節）運送到 泰瑞亞，前提是他們已解鎖領事館碼頭（即，自己完成了“時日將至”，或者之前通過該任務從卡馬丹收到了前往碼頭的渡輪）。
a93276593acf5d01bd02a33eddbc13746dfe5968.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

324881642199b75814c948ee6e5d28943f911efc.source: Although you can be taken to Lion's Gate by Mhenlo multiple times, Lionguard Neiro will only open the gates to Lion's Arch for you once, so you will need to abandon the quest and retake it for subsequent ferries.
324881642199b75814c948ee6e5d28943f911efc.text: 雖然您可以被 涵洛 多次帶到 獅門，但 Lionguard Neiro 只會為您開啟通往 獅子拱門 多次的大門，因此您需要放棄該任務並在後續渡輪中重新接受該任務。
324881642199b75814c948ee6e5d28943f911efc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c2fa5e47dedd901b9c1eba25c6effafe1e3d8e38.source: Should your whole party die in the Lion's Gate area (e.g. via Vampiric weapon, etc), you will receive a "your party has been defeated" dialog and then be returned to Kamadan, Jewel of Istan.
c2fa5e47dedd901b9c1eba25c6effafe1e3d8e38.text: 如果您的整個隊伍在 獅門 區域死亡（例如透過 吸血鬼 武器等），您將收到「您的隊伍已被擊敗」對話方塊，然後返回 卡瑪丹‧艾斯坦之鑽。
c2fa5e47dedd901b9c1eba25c6effafe1e3d8e38.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6bb8624ac16393a2d21b5695162b6f6dcae48961.source: If a Guild Wars Nightfall character has used a ferry to get to the Consulate Docks early, they will still be able to obtain and use this quest later, after having completed The Time is Nigh.
6bb8624ac16393a2d21b5695162b6f6dcae48961.text: 如果 公會 戰爭 黑暗逆襲 角色提前使用渡輪到達領事館碼頭，則在完成「時機已到」後，他們仍然能夠稍後獲得並使用此任務。
6bb8624ac16393a2d21b5695162b6f6dcae48961.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8958f4b141c3fa7b2ffd794e545b4465eb301adf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

24ed9e1fb85a2e58f1aa108dbf04f4dc15b5aaab.source: Return to Reaper of the Spawning Pools for your reward.
24ed9e1fb85a2e58f1aa108dbf04f4dc15b5aaab.text: 影返 交給產卵池收割者以獲得獎勵。
24ed9e1fb85a2e58f1aa108dbf04f4dc15b5aaab.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8dee5643c66c30d94aaa46849fc36904ca09b002.source: Consider using spells that do not require a line of sight, and kill the Obsidian Guardians one by one from behind a wall. Note that if you can't interrupt Obsidian Flesh you need to wait until it expires.
8dee5643c66c30d94aaa46849fc36904ca09b002.text: 考慮使用不需要視線的法術，從牆後一一殺死黑曜石守護者。請注意，如果您無法中斷 黑曜石肉體，則需要等到它到期。
8dee5643c66c30d94aaa46849fc36904ca09b002.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

40786cddb7cb562d7b27787dc8f180a4a8164c1c.source: You can also fill the spawning area with traps before taking the quest. By concentrating the traps in one or two corners of this area, you should be able to take out one or two Guardians without any trouble. The queen will most likely survive any such attempts.
40786cddb7cb562d7b27787dc8f180a4a8164c1c.text: 您也可以在接受任務之前在產卵區域佈滿陷阱。透過將陷阱集中在該區域的一兩個角落，你應該能夠毫無困難地幹掉一兩個守護者。女王很可能會在任何此類嘗試中倖存下來。
40786cddb7cb562d7b27787dc8f180a4a8164c1c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9f0ee6ea77b87bdc30be84f7f0f0ff17c976234d.source: Groups of Charged Blackness pop up in the a broad area around where the Queen spawns if you didn't kill them before accepting the quest.
9f0ee6ea77b87bdc30be84f7f0f0ff17c976234d.text: 如果您在接受任務之前沒有殺死它們，則成群的 暗黑幽靈 會出現在女王生成的廣闊區域中。
9f0ee6ea77b87bdc30be84f7f0f0ff17c976234d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a12e399c6682d479599aad92122b83aea6de5d9f.source: Go south and destroy all the crypt fiends there.
a12e399c6682d479599aad92122b83aea6de5d9f.text: 往南走，消滅那裡所有的地穴惡魔。
a12e399c6682d479599aad92122b83aea6de5d9f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6cbc6a9acf2f0f45546dcfaacf41e8d4e947ea87.text: 消滅 [5..0] 更多地穴惡魔。

3f3d901174046d6b05b119942226c96997d8b5f4.source: Return to Oberan the Reviled for your reward.

3f3d901174046d6b05b119942226c96997d8b5f4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

434ac3e9267435291887f28812cfc34fea34cf59.source: Oberan the Reviled will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
434ac3e9267435291887f28812cfc34fea34cf59.text: 接受任務後，謾罵者歐伯藍 將為您提供以下技能：

bc934456a631ac6b4b753f4c5897ec3f78abbfaa.source: Oberan can be hard to find for new players; however, the quest Charr in the Catacombs from Prince Rurik will lead the player straight to Oberan.
bc934456a631ac6b4b753f4c5897ec3f78abbfaa.text: 對於新玩家來說，奧貝蘭可能很難找到；然而，盧瑞克王子 地下墓穴中的任務 夏爾 將引導玩家直接前往奧伯蘭。
bc934456a631ac6b4b753f4c5897ec3f78abbfaa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

64c401165b076e3ff2f2e4bc8b96659776771fbe.source: Upon accepting the quest, the Crypt Fiends will start spawning one at a time and approach through the long southern hallway. The crypt fiends have no skills and attack at melee range with low damage output, so they are not difficult to defeat. Just kill all 5 and collect your reward.
64c401165b076e3ff2f2e4bc8b96659776771fbe.text: 接受任務後，地穴惡魔將開始一次生成一個，並穿過漫長的南部走廊。地穴惡魔沒有技能，攻擊範圍為近戰，傷害輸出較低，所以要打敗它們並不困難。只需殺死所有 5 即可獲得獎勵。
64c401165b076e3ff2f2e4bc8b96659776771fbe.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3e1cbe4e9abf0a18e81b9efd5b7ee93b67091bc4.source: Faintedheartedness is a very weak hex, and its main use is to trigger Soul Barbs' damage. Soul Barbs, on the other hand, is quite strong and works with all hexes, including Siphon Strength and mesmer hexes such as Conjure Phantasm and Imagined Burden.
3e1cbe4e9abf0a18e81b9efd5b7ee93b67091bc4.text: Faintedheartness是一個非常弱的十六進位制，它的主要用途是觸發靈魂荊棘的傷害。另一方面，靈魂荊棘 非常強大，適用於所有六角形，包括 吸取力量 和催眠六角形，例如 召喚幻影 和 意念負荷。
3e1cbe4e9abf0a18e81b9efd5b7ee93b67091bc4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b0c36460b770f1f6056d6ce5027818bfd6608a51.source: An easy way to finish this quest is to hide behind the wall behind Oberan so that the Crypt Fiends will get stuck trying to reach you as they will be bodyblocked by him. You will then be able to slowly kill them with ranged spells.
b0c36460b770f1f6056d6ce5027818bfd6608a51.text: 完成這個任務的一個簡單方法是躲在奧伯蘭後面的牆後面，這樣地穴惡魔就會被困在試圖接近你的過程中，因為他們會被他身體擋住。然後你就可以用遠端法術慢慢殺死他們。
b0c36460b770f1f6056d6ce5027818bfd6608a51.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ccf353cf1b968cfb3ab3ceeec1d2c1f87c99438b.source: Karleen, the universal collector for foot armor pieces in pre-Searing (collecting Gargoyle Skulls), can be found a short way to the north of Oberan.
ccf353cf1b968cfb3ab3ceeec1d2c1f87c99438b.text: 卡琳 是 崩壞 之前的腳甲碎片通用收集器（收集 石像鬼 頭骨），位於奧伯蘭以北不遠的地方。
ccf353cf1b968cfb3ab3ceeec1d2c1f87c99438b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

de9cc681f0c6e67dd62aeabc839800e1c3439a6f.source: Find the afflicted creature that was once Imperial Guardsman Chun and destroy it.
de9cc681f0c6e67dd62aeabc839800e1c3439a6f.text: 找到曾經是皇家衛士淳的受折磨的生物並消滅它。
de9cc681f0c6e67dd62aeabc839800e1c3439a6f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6429aeeeb13862afbbd2a039b7c1d56c88a15a20.source: Heading east from Kaineng Center, you will head up a ramp and across a bridge. Chun is in the middle of a mob of afflicted creatures. Once you kill Chun, the quest is over.
6429aeeeb13862afbbd2a039b7c1d56c88a15a20.text: 從 凱寧中心 向東行駛，您將走上坡道並穿過一座橋。春天身處一群受苦的生物中間。一旦你殺死了Chun，任務就結束了。
6429aeeeb13862afbbd2a039b7c1d56c88a15a20.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

51d0ef5438d1c8484cd9bfe80133f346c95c3171.source: Because the guardsman uses Frenzy, has no self heal, often spawns alone and is attacked by some Canthan Guards, this quest sometimes "completes itself".
51d0ef5438d1c8484cd9bfe80133f346c95c3171.text: 因為守衛使用 狂暴，沒有自我治療，經常單獨生成並受到一些凱珊守衛的攻擊，所以這個任務有時會「自行完成」。
51d0ef5438d1c8484cd9bfe80133f346c95c3171.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e8239bb239d790e81946a3005c72522318a8b533.source: With Winds of Change, the Ministry of Purity members or the Am Fah can also attack the guard and complete the quest.
e8239bb239d790e81946a3005c72522318a8b533.text: 使用變幻之風，純潔部成員或安費也可以攻擊守衛並完成任務。
e8239bb239d790e81946a3005c72522318a8b533.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e8f763fda23c9fc974a26014bd2d38b0de0e1860.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d3c03848367459bd3c494815ae8bcd8eeac884f3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2c7d8aacd5cc8b43bc8a745f62e144cb6d320f6f.source: See Tahbo Paa for your reward.
2c7d8aacd5cc8b43bc8a745f62e144cb6d320f6f.text: 請前往 Tahbo Paa 領取獎勵。
2c7d8aacd5cc8b43bc8a745f62e144cb6d320f6f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bc8db849c628b9cd14e9ac9e9dbc8c1656376e44.source: You can find Tahbo Paa at the resurrection shrine in the Southwestern corner of Kinya Province, near the portal to Panjiang Peninsula. To reach the Aerie, simply follow the Western coast North.
bc8db849c628b9cd14e9ac9e9dbc8c1656376e44.text: 你可以在 欣彌領地 西南角的復活神殿找到塔博帕，靠近 班讓半島 的傳送門。要到達鷹巢，只需沿著西海岸北部行駛即可。
bc8db849c628b9cd14e9ac9e9dbc8c1656376e44.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e256020bb96350ba25609377931d7d3ce9f7fc52.source: If you accept this quest then leave the area, the quest marker will be in the wrong place when you return. The marker will still be in Aerie, though you must collect Tahbo Paa again.
e256020bb96350ba25609377931d7d3ce9f7fc52.text: 如果您接受此任務然後離開該區域，當您返回時任務標記將位於錯誤的位置。儘管您必須再次收集 Tahbo Paa，但標記仍會位於 Aerie。
e256020bb96350ba25609377931d7d3ce9f7fc52.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

eed2608be32bae32219541eceb68d1b5bc9cf31d.text: 在困難模式下清除所有敵人 荒蕪之地 中的鹼鍋。

54bff412f8db4be1eda6f1dc2d5a6ff570ae6275.source: The primary quest that will lead your party here from the Bone Palace is Horde of Darkness. The secondary quest Strange Bedfellows also takes place here.
54bff412f8db4be1eda6f1dc2d5a6ff570ae6275.text: 白骨宮殿 帶領你的隊伍來到這裡的主要任務是黑暗部落。次要任務「奇怪的同床者」也發生在這裡。
54bff412f8db4be1eda6f1dc2d5a6ff570ae6275.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

172aa5a36b137609c6939732f3ecd76b8a92fb15.source: Complete exploration of the area contributes approximately 3.02% towards the Elonian Cartographer Title.
172aa5a36b137609c6939732f3ecd76b8a92fb15.text: 該區域的完整勘探大約為 Elonian 版圖 頭銜 貢獻了 3.02%。
172aa5a36b137609c6939732f3ecd76b8a92fb15.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

924b7ea1af89e62fd86f902dccf2613240822729.source: Head south from Fort Ranik. A group of Charr may come running from the arches to ambush you, so take them out. Head west, following the arches. Along the way, you'll engage scattered groups of Renegades and Renegade Elementalists. Turn north at the next fork, watching your step for burrowing Devourers, which may pop up from the ground. Cross the bridge and take out the first group of Renegades after the bridge. Then, head west to a dead end where Torin and two Renegade Elementalists are standing. Eliminate the bandit leader and return to Ambassador Zain for your reward.
924b7ea1af89e62fd86f902dccf2613240822729.text: 從拉尼克堡向南行駛。一群 夏爾 可能會從拱門跑來伏擊你，所以要把他們幹掉。沿著拱門往西走。一路上，你會遇到分散的叛徒和叛徒元素師。在下一個岔路口向北轉，注意你的腳步，尋找挖洞的 蠍，它可能會從地面彈出。過橋並幹掉橋後第一組叛徒。然後，向西前往一個死衚衕，託林和兩名叛徒元素師站在那裡。消滅強盜首領並返回 大使薩因 領取獎勵。

47f1e1c3da5f971f5b65fd651bdc94dbe0e09f57.source: At the start, there are nine quarry sites controlled by the nightmare horde. Each site is guarded by a Shadow of Kanaxai. Defeating a Shadow of Kanaxai changes control of that site to your side and a Luxon Enchanter will spawn at that site. There are patrols that move to quarry sites that you control and attack the Luxon Enchanters there. When a Luxon Enchanter is defeated, the site changes control to the nightmare horde and a Shadow of Kanaxai spawns. The frequency and size of these patrols increases over time, but there can only be 4 groups present at any one time. Every 10 seconds, the nightmare horde's score and your score increases by the number of quarry sites that are controlled, which is indicated by the flags next to the scores. This mission does not have a time limit, however, once the nightmare horde has a score of 500 the challenge ends.
47f1e1c3da5f971f5b65fd651bdc94dbe0e09f57.text: 一開始，惡夢部落控制著九個採石場。每個站點均由 闇影 或 加奈賽 保護。擊敗 闇影 或 加奈賽 會將該網站的控制權轉移到您這邊，並且 勒克森 幻術士傭兵 將在該網站產生。有巡邏隊移動到您控制的採石場並攻擊那裡的 勒克森 附魔師。當 勒克森 幻術士傭兵 被擊敗時，該網站將控制權轉移給惡夢部落，並產生 闇影 或 加奈賽。這些巡邏的頻率和規模隨著時間的推移而增加，但任一時刻只能有 4 小組在場。每 10 秒，惡夢部落的分數和你的分數都會增加所控制的採石場數量，這由分數旁邊的標誌表示。任務沒有時間限制，但是，一旦惡夢部落的得分達到 500，挑戰就會結束。
47f1e1c3da5f971f5b65fd651bdc94dbe0e09f57.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8fccec69d786671c3aa05cc9b0df388dc4343660.source: To obtain a score of at least 100, you will need to control at least two shrines until the game ends. One possible way is to run to each quarry site and kill the Shadow of Kanaxai there while avoiding patrols. Consider bringing party wide speed boosts such as "Charge!" or "Fall Back!" to reduce the time spent between each site. Alternatively, you could have a few party members split off and solo each Shadow of Kanaxai, while the rest of the party defend the sites that are already controlled. In both strategies, Luxon Enchanters provide party wide defenses and healing that stall patrols and assist the party when defending.
8fccec69d786671c3aa05cc9b0df388dc4343660.text: 要獲得至少 100 的分數，您需要控制至少兩個神社直到遊戲結束。一個可能的方法是跑到每個採石場並殺死那裡的 闇影 或 加奈賽，同時避免巡邏。考慮在全隊範圍內提供速度提升，例如“衝鋒！”或“撤退！”以減少每個站點之間花費的時間。或者，您可以讓某些小隊成員分開並單獨進行每個 闇影 或 加奈賽，而小隊的其餘成員則保衛已控制的網站。在這兩種策略中，勒克森 附魔師提供全隊防禦和治療，阻止巡邏並在防守時協助隊伍。
8fccec69d786671c3aa05cc9b0df388dc4343660.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

This is because when charming the Black Moa, he will become hostile, and your henchmen and heroes will attack. Also, not killing the nearby foes will cause them to also attack the Black Moa.

f41366575776dc188853da9444ea8c819a0cc5a5.source: Make your way north-east from Seitung Harbor towards Haiju Lagoon or start from Zen Daijun if you already have it, and follow the quest marker. The Crimson Skull camp has several members which can easily overwhelm your team. Instead of fighting them all together, pull them apart from each other so that you can fight only a few of them at a time. Use ground features to obstruct their projectiles or to create choke points. Additionaly you can obtain blessings from Melandru's shrine by kneeling at her statue.
f41366575776dc188853da9444ea8c819a0cc5a5.text: 從 青函港 向東北方向朝 海幽潟湖 前進，或從 禎臺郡 開始（如果您已經擁有它），然後按照任務標記前進。 紅顱 陣營有多名成員，可以輕鬆壓垮您的團隊。不要將他們全部打在一起，而是將他們分開，這樣你一次只能與其中的幾個人戰鬥。使用地面特徵來阻擋他們的彈體或建立阻塞點。此外，您還可以透過跪在 梅蘭朵 的雕像前獲得她的神社的祝福。

83f4335708d0d2f781c7c4d123f6ab3a1ccc9c1e.source: When you arrive at his location, Bakghu will not be hostile. As he begins speaking, the other gangs will arrive; take this opportunity to move out of range (there is a good spot to the north, though be wary if you have The Shadow Blades active, as there will be a cluster of aggressive Shadow Blade Assassins nearby). Once the last gang member arrives, the groups will become hostile and attack each other. You can either join in or wait to defeat the weakened victors.
83f4335708d0d2f781c7c4d123f6ab3a1ccc9c1e.text: 當你到達他的位置時，Bakghu不會有敵意。當他開始講話時，其他幫派就會到達；藉此機會移出射程（北邊有一個好地方，但如果您啟用了 闇影 刀片，請小心，因為附近會有一群侵略性的 闇影 刀片刺客）。一旦最後一個幫派成員到達，各幫派就會變得敵對並互相攻擊。你可以加入，也可以等待擊敗實力較弱的勝利者。

b0863161631ff1c9a51071f213fa97408c70fe85.source: Nente will immediately start to run, heading south. While he is passing several points on the map fighting against the creatures on that way, the quest will be updated at each point. At the final quest marker you will reach a little wooden bridge where 5 Charr Stalkers are standing. After you have killed them, you can immediately talk to Master Ranger Nente for your reward.
b0863161631ff1c9a51071f213fa97408c70fe85.text: 南特立即開始奔跑，向南而去。當他經過地圖上的幾個點並與沿途的生物戰鬥時，每個點的任務都會更新。在最後的任務標記處，您將到達一座小木橋，5 夏爾 潛行者就站在那裡。殺死它們後，您可以立即與 遊俠大師涅特 對話以獲得獎勵。
b0863161631ff1c9a51071f213fa97408c70fe85.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b8e8a86314710d2fbb19e3576ced017b8ef52d7f.source: You do need to follow Nente to the quest markers, as he will stop moving if you follow a path far enough away from the one he is taking.
b8e8a86314710d2fbb19e3576ced017b8ef52d7f.text: 你確實需要跟隨南特到達任務標記，因為如果你沿著一條距離他所走的路足夠遠的路徑走，他就會停止移動。
b8e8a86314710d2fbb19e3576ced017b8ef52d7f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

90c4331c8de23740fef2581bb322496212f9b07d.source: If Nente dies or is stuck on some certain point, you may have to start the quest again. (Sometimes, if Nente is stuck, clicking on him will cause him to continue.) Even if you kill the Charr patrol and the quest is updated in your quest log, you won't be able to gain the reward from Nente.
90c4331c8de23740fef2581bb322496212f9b07d.text: 如果 Nente 死亡或卡在某個特定點上，你可能必須重新開始任務。 （有時，如果 Nente 被卡住，點選他會讓他繼續。）即使你殺死了 夏爾 巡邏隊並且任務在你的任務日誌中更新，你也無法從 Nente 獲得獎勵。

a8e2ddba363b5754d8d72d0c47ed4fa408eb00a2.source: Make sure your party is able to make enough damage and to heal enough, if possible also Master Ranger Nente. Every time he kneels it is better to wait for him to ensure that the quest will be updated and Nente will head forward on his way.
a8e2ddba363b5754d8d72d0c47ed4fa408eb00a2.text: 確保你的隊伍能夠造成足夠的傷害和足夠的治療，如果可能的話還可以遊俠大師涅特。每次跪下最好等他，以確保任務更新，Nente會繼續前進。
a8e2ddba363b5754d8d72d0c47ed4fa408eb00a2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

036c81d686fc83248820116706a2d2c9794b33dd.source: After accepting the quest, travel to the gate west of Nente's original position at the Balthazar statue and enter The Breach, then travel a short distance northeast to the stone bridge where you will find the Warrior boss Gorgaan Hatemonger on the far side, replacing the usual boss spawn there. He is accompanied by a group of three Charr including a Charr Martyr and a Charr Overseer; however, he can be pulled away to engage him alone.
036c81d686fc83248820116706a2d2c9794b33dd.text: 接受任務後，前往 Nente 在 巴薩澤 雕像的原始位置以西的大門，進入 缺口，然後向東北移動一小段距離到達石橋，在那裡你會發現遠端的 戰士 boss 煽動者果剛，取代了那裡通常的 Boss 生成點。與他同行的有三名 夏爾，其中包括一名 夏爾烈士 和一名 夏爾監督者；然而，可以將他拉開，單獨與他交戰。
036c81d686fc83248820116706a2d2c9794b33dd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6577c9e5ac973b61a272a84d85948adb4218d851.text: 殺死戈爾甘後，請回到 舊阿斯卡隆 中 巴薩澤 雕像處的 遊俠大師涅特 獎勵。
6577c9e5ac973b61a272a84d85948adb4218d851.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

18d06f4e413d92062d912e9db4f9f6bab32ce3bb.text: 重複的 煽動者果剛 可能會在 缺口 中的任何其他 Boss 位置生成，包括位於 舊阿斯卡隆 入口以西的羅盤範圍內的位置。殺死任何版本的戈爾甘都會完成任務。

d5b241f5c292cbdd532702a27eacaa4728d4af36.text: 如果你想拿這個，請進入區域門到 撕裂大地。穿過區域門後，返回阿爾卡齊亞·坦格 (Alcazia Tangle)。檢查占卜。如果在選通後立即填充 25%，密碼將位於您位置的東邊附近。如果不是，則返回 撕裂大地 並重復此操作。這樣就會容易很多。
d5b241f5c292cbdd532702a27eacaa4728d4af36.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4f3375e5f25a35dcf51a2406c6dd5c314cc536dd.source: Divination refers to the bar labeled "Proximity to Target" which fills as you approach the Facet's location. Initially the bar fills as blue, even though your character is moving towards the target - an increasing, blue bar means your character is going in the right direction. At 50% proximity to target the bar turns red. Once you find a location where the proximity bar is filled, wait and look around to see a circle of light, signaling the Facet is coming out of hiding. Defeat the Facet to complete the quest.
4f3375e5f25a35dcf51a2406c6dd5c314cc536dd.text: 占卜是指標有「接近 目標」的欄，當您接近 Facet 的位置時，就會填滿。最初，即使您的角色正在向目標移動，該條仍填充為藍色 - 不斷增加的藍色條意味著您的角色正在朝著正確的方向前進。當 50% 接近目標時，條形變為紅色。一旦找到接近條已填滿的位置，請等待並環顧四周，看到一圈光，這表明 Facet 正在從隱藏中顯現出來。擊敗分面即可完成任務。
4f3375e5f25a35dcf51a2406c6dd5c314cc536dd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6969b5a12fc83f66c343b2539515a8b04100a78c.source: Turning off the mission progress bar in the interface menu will hide the Divination bar.

6969b5a12fc83f66c343b2539515a8b04100a78c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ff4d81a84ce44e3f75bb55024ccb005bbe749dc9.source: This quest has good synergy with the quest Turning the Page. Start from Rata Sum, taking the southern exit into Magus Stones. Select the Turning the Page quest and follow the quest marker south to the exit into Alcazia Tangle. Zone in and out of Alcazia Tangle, until the Divination bar is filled about 10-15%. Walk south following the quest marker again. Defeat the White mantle and take the tome out of the chest, then walk further south (and defeating, or skipping Pywatt the Swift) until the divination bar is full. Defeat the Cipher of Melandru, and zone to Tarnished Haven. Exit Tarnished Haven to get the quest reward for Turning the Page.
ff4d81a84ce44e3f75bb55024ccb005bbe749dc9.text: 該任務與翻頁任務具有良好的協同作用。從 洛達頂點 出發，從南方出口進入 Magus Stones。選擇翻頁任務，然後沿著任務標記向南到達阿爾卡齊亞糾纏區的出口。區域進出 Alcazia Tangle，直到占卜欄填滿 10-15%。再次沿著任務標記向南走。擊敗白斗篷並從箱子中取出書本，然後繼續向南走（擊敗或跳過 迅捷 派維特），直到占卜欄已滿。擊敗 梅蘭朵 的密碼，並前往 灰暗避難所。退出 灰暗避難所 即可獲得翻頁任務獎勵。
ff4d81a84ce44e3f75bb55024ccb005bbe749dc9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

56f5e716bc2d8701f9c056fba03a8db0c0bcd122.source: This quest may be divided in different parts. The players begin outside of the Margonite City itself, where many Margonite groups stand in long patrol patterns - it's important to pull each group individually, making sure that the players do not stand on the patrol route of other enemies. It's wise to kill the Margonites standing on the City's walls - they are out of range from melee characters, but they are able to hit players thanks to being elementalists and rangers, and so ranged sources of damage are capable of destroying them.
56f5e716bc2d8701f9c056fba03a8db0c0bcd122.text: 這個任務可以分成不同的部分。玩家從 瑪骨奈 城市 本身之外開始，其中許多 瑪骨奈 小組以長巡邏模式站立 - 單獨拉動每個小組非常重要，以確保玩家不會站在其他敵人的巡邏路線上。殺死站在 城市 牆上的瑪貢尼特是明智之舉 - 它們超出了近戰角色的範圍，但由於它們是元素主義者和遊俠，它們能夠攻擊玩家，因此遠端傷害源能夠摧毀它們。
56f5e716bc2d8701f9c056fba03a8db0c0bcd122.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4e607879232e400fcd7f1c6986ce89f10027a28e.source: After all enemies outside have been killed, Captain Sulahresh will move foward and the gates for the city itself will open. Inside, there are more Margonite groups, similar to those outside - the same strategies work here, with the advantage that it's possible to use the terrain for the players' benefit (such as when attacking enemies through walls).
4e607879232e400fcd7f1c6986ce89f10027a28e.text: 當外面的所有敵人都被殺死後，蘇拉赫雷什隊長將繼續前進，城市本身的大門將會開啟。內部有更多的 瑪骨奈 組，與外部類似 - 在這裡使用相同的策略，其優點是可以利用地形為玩家謀取利益（例如穿過牆壁攻擊敵人時）。
4e607879232e400fcd7f1c6986ce89f10027a28e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f5f57a7fe8499ab8326585d194f6f7dc44da2422.source: Once all enemies have been killed, the quest itself will be over, and it becomes possible to accept the quest reward from Captain Sulahresh (a good way of removing Death Penalty for the group). Once the quest reward has been accepted, Lord Jadoth and his army of Margonites will arrive through the gate leading to the Stygian Veil, allowing you to spawn a Torc'qua Chest and progress the quest Mallyx the Unyielding. See there for strategies.
f5f57a7fe8499ab8326585d194f6f7dc44da2422.text: 一旦所有敵人都被殺死，任務本身就會結束，並且可以接受蘇拉赫什隊長的任務獎勵（這是消除團隊死刑的好方法）。接受任務獎勵後，霸王 賈多司 和他的瑪貢尼特大軍將穿過通往冥河面紗的大門到達，讓您可以生成托克誇 寶箱 並繼續任務「不屈的馬裡克斯」。請參閱那裡的策略。
f5f57a7fe8499ab8326585d194f6f7dc44da2422.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6f25897e5d055c8a2656134963313214e84f33fa.source: Enter the Poisoned Outcrops and follow the quest pointer towards the north-west. There is a wide area with several patrols after the left corridor which can easy over-aggro, pull them back to the corridor to dispatch them one by one. The quest log will update by first time once you reach the resting place of the Staff of the Mist, you will see two enemy types Mummies and Margonite patrols, always keep watch of your radar so that foes won`t overwhelm your party.
6f25897e5d055c8a2656134963313214e84f33fa.text: 進入 劇毒地表 並按照任務指標向西北方向前進。左邊走廊後面有一片廣闊的區域，有幾個巡邏隊，很容易產生仇恨，把他們拉回走廊一一消滅。當你到達迷霧法杖的休息地點時，任務日誌將第一時間更新，你會看到兩種敵人型別木乃伊和瑪骨奈巡邏隊，時刻注意你的雷達，這樣敵人就不會壓倒你的隊伍。

d6243f64953d8d1b6fd5162c3aaf4b0786b567c5.source: Battlelord Turgar will be behind 3 separate groups of Margonites, each group can be lured away and dispatched before killing the boss alone. Once defeated, it will drop the Staff of the Mists and the spirit of Buuran will be released for your reward.
d6243f64953d8d1b6fd5162c3aaf4b0786b567c5.text: 戰將圖爾加將在 3 後面有獨立的瑪貢尼特組，每個組都可以在單獨殺死 Boss 之前被引誘並派遣出去。一旦被擊敗，它將掉落迷霧的 法杖，並且布蘭的靈魂將被釋放以獲取獎勵。

015644263d7916516a021073d2878544dff70041.source: Though we are battered, we are not broken...so long as we have you to lead us! At the back of the Sunspear Sanctuary is an area called the Command Post. This is where you can meet with your squad to discuss battle tactics and strategies. It also links to underground passages to other areas of Kourna so we can move about undetected by Varesh. Dunkoro is waiting in the Command Post. No doubt he has some plans about how we should proceed."
015644263d7916516a021073d2878544dff70041.text: 雖然我們遍體鱗傷，但我們不會破碎……只要有你的帶領！ 日戟避難所 的後方是稱為 指揮所 的區域。在這裡，您可以與您的小隊會面，討論戰術和策略。它也連線到 高楠 其他區域的地下通道，這樣我們就可以在不被 Varesh 發現的情況下移動。 Dunkoro 正在 指揮所 中等待。毫無疑問，他對我們應該如何進行有一些計劃。 」

92a2d3da05fe19286d6cbff71105ebdbe0a8e783.source: Players familiar with the walkthrough of Forsaken Tunnels will find this quest to proceed in a similar way, with the Duke at the same location as Maz Scourgeheart, without boss key or boss lock, and an elemental keystone located on the other side when facing the crystal gate, forcing you to go a bit further.
92a2d3da05fe19286d6cbff71105ebdbe0a8e783.text: 熟悉被遺忘隧道流程的玩家會發現這個任務以類似的方式進行，公爵與馬茲·天災之心位於同一位置，沒有老闆鑰匙或老闆鎖，並且在面對水晶門時在另一側有一個元素梯形石，迫使你走得更遠。
92a2d3da05fe19286d6cbff71105ebdbe0a8e783.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2c185aff18bfc67528bc3225b9ffa2033b152648.source: Enter the Tunnels of the Forsaken and be careful of occasional Wind Riders patrols. Head towards the objective marker and talk to Ghost of Althea. From there, head straight north, up the hill, and kill the bandits at the camp until you get a Elemental Keystone. Pick it up, and bring it to the crystal gate in the north. The gate opens, enter the second level.
2c185aff18bfc67528bc3225b9ffa2033b152648.text: 進入被遺忘者隧道並小心偶爾巡邏的乘風者。前往目標標記並與 奧瑟雅 的幽靈交談。從那裡，一直往北走，上山，殺死營地裡的強盜，直到拿到 元素生物 鑰匙石。撿起來，帶到北邊的水晶門。門開啟，進入第二層。
2c185aff18bfc67528bc3225b9ffa2033b152648.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

632677e553cf560cd2b9bd3337f27e0f3db6acd3.source: On the second level, head forward and take the left side wherever possible, left around the tree, left of the crystal, left around the rock, left around the cauldron and go under the overpass. Take left again after the glowing altar, and after you'll start getting dialogue from Duke Willgrove, head straight to find him. Talk to Duke to retrieve the stolen supplies.
632677e553cf560cd2b9bd3337f27e0f3db6acd3.text: 在第二層，向前走，盡可能走左邊，在樹周圍左邊，在水晶左邊，在岩石周圍左邊，在大鍋周圍左邊，然後到立交橋下。經過發光祭壇後再次左轉，在你開始收到威爾格羅夫公爵的對話後，徑直去找他。與杜克交談以取回被盜的物資。
632677e553cf560cd2b9bd3337f27e0f3db6acd3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c599ef986404711af0c5cbe3d778b7bcf4a30524.source: To return the supplies to Althea on the first level of the dungeon, it can be faster to map travel to Piken Square. Talk to Althea to return the stolen supplies, and again to accept the reward for the quest.
c599ef986404711af0c5cbe3d778b7bcf4a30524.text: 要將補給品返回到地牢第一層的 奧瑟雅，可以更快地將行程對應到 派肯廣場。與 奧瑟雅 交談以歸還被盜的物資，並再次接受任務獎勵。
c599ef986404711af0c5cbe3d778b7bcf4a30524.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9127e4f97cddb8d5f771c4763df58c50e578b5d9.text: 當進入被遺忘者隧道第二層時，威爾格羅夫公爵的任務標記將顯示為指向出口
9127e4f97cddb8d5f771c4763df58c50e578b5d9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ffcfe9a4fcc989c2f1f2af41ad8a801036e47416.source: If you travel outside of the dungeon after recovering the stolen goods, the quest objectives will reset; but if you re-enter the dungeon they will return to where they should be, allowing you to complete the quest without redoing any steps.
ffcfe9a4fcc989c2f1f2af41ad8a801036e47416.text: 如果你在找回贓物後離開地牢，任務目標將會重置；但如果你重新進入地牢，它們會回到它們應該在的地方，讓你無需重做任何步驟即可完成任務。
ffcfe9a4fcc989c2f1f2af41ad8a801036e47416.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9b15c73218f9db02e778627965aec18743066831.source: You can do this quest faster with a running build, since only some bandits on the first level have to be defeated, for the Elemental Keystone. Just make sure you bring something that can kill them (e.g.: a party, a summoning stone or even skills near your running ones, especially on normal mode).
9b15c73218f9db02e778627965aec18743066831.text: 您可以透過執行建置更快地完成此任務，因為對於 元素生物 Keystone，只需擊敗第一層的一些強盜。只要確保你帶了一些可以殺死他們的東西（例如：一個隊伍，一塊召喚石，甚至是你正在奔跑的人附近的技能，尤其是在正常模式下）。
9b15c73218f9db02e778627965aec18743066831.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

The cultists will not get attacked. For low-level parties, be careful of the AoE damage spikes from the skales.

cafdbae398181dadd73ed7cdd80bca1310d0b45d.source: The entire mission area is divided into fifteen sections, each with its own environment effect. The environment effect for each section persists until the Aspect of Kanaxai in that section is defeated. While killing the Aspect quickly will help in some rooms, it is not necessary to kill the Aspects to continue through the mission to the next section. The effects in the initial and final sections are permanent.
cafdbae398181dadd73ed7cdd80bca1310d0b45d.text: 整個任務區分為十五個區域，每個區域都有自己的環境效果。每個部分的環境效果持續存在，直到該部分中的 加奈賽 方面被擊敗。雖然快速殺死守護者在某些房間會有所幫助，但沒有必要殺死守護者才能繼續下一部分的任務。最初和最後部分的效果是永久性的。
cafdbae398181dadd73ed7cdd80bca1310d0b45d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3fa67e74ea2903bf3aafba8c40eb5e4804ad30d0.source: Bear in mind that this mission can take around 1 to 2 hours, depending on how experienced the team is. If you have not been there before, it is wise to proceed slowly and carefully, due to Oni pops and Aspect effects. It is a bad idea to try to rush through this mission without knowing the spawns.
3fa67e74ea2903bf3aafba8c40eb5e4804ad30d0.text: 請記住，此任務可能需要大約 1 到 2 小時，具體取決於團隊的經驗。如果您以前沒有去過那裡，那麼明智的做法是緩慢而小心地進行，因為有鬼流行和麵向效果。在不知道生成點的情況下嘗試匆忙完成此任務是一個壞主意。
3fa67e74ea2903bf3aafba8c40eb5e4804ad30d0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9979c6251739d839f1548d366408b98cd3d1af7b.source: In The Deep, a tank and wall method is often used. One tank pulls foes into a wall made of either other tank, spirits and/or minions who bodyblock. The skill level of your tank/s often define how effective your team will be. Before attempting The Deep, its highly suggested to find an experienced tank or someone who knows the Deep reasonably well. Stance warriors are recommended for the tanking role, as enchant removal and area effects can get through skills such as Shadow Form and Spell Breaker.
9979c6251739d839f1548d366408b98cd3d1af7b.text: 在 深處 中，經常使用水箱和牆壁的方法。一輛坦克將敵人拉入由其他坦克、靈魂和/或身體阻擋的小兵組成的牆中。你的坦克的技能水平通常決定了你的團隊的效率。在嘗試 深處 之前，強烈建議找一位經驗豐富的坦克或對深海相當瞭解的人。建議使用 態勢 戰士擔任坦克角色，因為附魔移除和區域效果可以透過 暗影形態 和 魔法粉碎 等技能來實現。
9979c6251739d839f1548d366408b98cd3d1af7b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f9b7d06bf90c7bc34397e14db311dfb34c4183d4.source: Enchantment removals or interrupts are required to stop Kanaxai's Nightmare Refuge (Revealed Enchantment is particularly good since it recharges instantly vs Monster enchantments, and can also be used on other Oni and Aspects). Knock down skills are a must to kill Kanaxai and his aspects. "You Move Like a Dwarf!" is a good shout for this, as it is available to all classes and activates instantly, making it an efficient interrupt as well.
f9b7d06bf90c7bc34397e14db311dfb34c4183d4.text: 需要移除或中斷 加持魔法 來停止 加奈賽 的 夢魘 避難所（加持顯露 特別好，因為它相對於 怪物 魔咒可以立即充電，並且也可以用於其他 Oni 和 Aspects）。擊倒技能是殺死 加奈賽 及其方面的必備技能。 「你的移動就像 矮人 一樣！」這是一個很好的說法，因為它可供所有類別使用並立即啟用，這也使其成為一個有效的中斷。
f9b7d06bf90c7bc34397e14db311dfb34c4183d4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e75885dbba9aa2a3cc7f485281d37d6920976b35.source: You can complete this quest with little effort as follows: enter Sparkfly Swamp from Gadd's Encampment, and head east along the path towards the nearby wooden cart; check the proximity bar — if it starts to fill, continue northeast to the Facet of Death and defeat it. Otherwise, rezone and repeat. Be cautious of the two Raptor groups, whose patrol routes converge nearby.
e75885dbba9aa2a3cc7f485281d37d6920976b35.text: 你可以毫不費力地完成這個任務，如下：從蓋德營區進入火星蠅沼澤，然後沿著小路向東前往附近的木車；檢查鄰近條——如果它開始填滿，繼續向東北方向到達死亡面並擊敗它。否則，重新分割並重複。小心兩個 毒瑞克斯 小組，它們的巡邏路線在附近交會。
e75885dbba9aa2a3cc7f485281d37d6920976b35.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

674fbd7ed91cae333f89dd9dd9d2b07091b56e02.text: 每次當您在此任務處於活動狀態時輸入 火星蠅沼澤 時，生成位置將重設為以下隨機選擇的位置之一：

9e306304716119d4e3ffed877d32e14304fa9a4f.source: This is the arrival room. The party must split into four groups of three. Each group needs to enter through one of four different portals, which will activate from the far right to the far left one at a time. Ideally each group of 3 should possess a knockdown. The team should have decided upon the group split prior to entering the mission - do not linger in this section, characters will quickly be overcast. When organizing groups ensure to assign characters equally e.g.: two damage dealers and one monk. As long as one of the four teams breaks out into the 5th section and kills the Aspect of Pain, they can then rescue the whole team through the now open gates. It is not necessary to kill any of the first four Aspects as killing the fish in each room will open the gates regardless of the status of the Aspects.
9e306304716119d4e3ffed877d32e14304fa9a4f.text: 這是到達房間。該黨必須分成四組，每組三人。每個小組需要通過四個不同的門戶之一進入，這些門戶將從最右到最左一次啟動。理想情況下，3 的每組都應具有擊倒。團隊應該在進入任務之前就決定好分組——不要在這個部分徘徊，角色很快就會陰沉的。組織團體時，確保平等分配角色，例如：兩名傷害經銷商和一名僧侶。只要四支隊伍中的一支突入5區域並殺死苦痛的守護者，他們就可以透過現在開啟的大門營救整個隊伍。沒有必要殺死前四個守護者中的任何一個，因為無論守護者的狀態如何，殺死每個房間中的魚都會開啟大門。
9e306304716119d4e3ffed877d32e14304fa9a4f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7def39f8b802959e774582c38d0f16566540c051.source: It is possible to have 10 heroes in a single room. With two players, one flags their first three heroes to gate one (far right) and flag the rest of the heroes back at the wooden gate. Once all two/three players are inside Room Two, unflagging the heroes will cause them all to rejoin the players after a short delay.
7def39f8b802959e774582c38d0f16566540c051.text: 一間房間裡可以有 10 英雄。對於兩名玩家，一名玩家將他們的前三名英雄標記為一號門（最右側），並將其餘英雄標記為木門。一旦所有兩/三名玩家都進入二號房間，取消英雄標記將使他們在短暫的延遲後重新加入玩家。

dae6c4a19f2c8bc1b6c677582c949a143840e524.source: The Aspects of Kanaxai are fast moving and attacking melee foes. At 75%, 50%, and 25% health, they will stop taking damage until knocked down. It is not necessary to kill them, as the gates open once mobs are killed.
dae6c4a19f2c8bc1b6c677582c949a143840e524.text: 加奈賽 的面向是快速移動並攻擊近戰敵人。在 75%、50% 和 25% 生命值下，它們將停止受到傷害，直到被擊倒。沒有必要殺死他們，因為一旦怪物被殺死，大門就會開啟。

709b487279837d55759e8473dab9e79dc2ab48ae.text: 苦痛 面向：在該方面下，您會受到 -2 體力衰減效果 的影響並受到 重傷 的影響。
709b487279837d55759e8473dab9e79dc2ab48ae.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9de3c3b73c5eb92052c931a1c2ddd18c00030df9.source: This Section is heavily patrolled by three large groups of Ripper Carps, Scourge Mantas, Blessed Mantas and Darkened Irukandjis. A bad pull will result in over-aggro, so watch patiently and pull them back inside either of the previous rooms to avoid aggroing more while in combat. The only difficulty here is the Irukandji's Restoration spirit, which resurrects every other foe that was killed in its area. Killing the spirit or stealing it with Signet of Binding will prompt the Irukandjis to cast a new one, but you can use Swap to move it away from corpses.
9de3c3b73c5eb92052c931a1c2ddd18c00030df9.text: 該區域由三大群開膛鯉魚、天災蝠鱝、祝福蝠鱝和黑暗伊魯卡嚴密巡邏。拉不好會導致過度仇恨，因此請耐心觀察並將它們拉回先前的房間內，以避免在戰鬥中出現更多仇恨。這裡唯一的困難是 毒水母 的 復甦 精神，它會復活在其區域內被殺死的所有其他敵人。殺死靈魂或使用 束縛紋章 竊取它會促使 Irukandjis 施放新的靈魂，但您可以使用 交替 將其從屍體上移開。
9de3c3b73c5eb92052c931a1c2ddd18c00030df9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

03e4acaaab0057456d09cde61edfbef57c773dc6.text: 殺死除 加奈賽 之外的所有敵人，苦痛 方面將解鎖所有大門，包括從前四個部分通往的大門。
03e4acaaab0057456d09cde61edfbef57c773dc6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0b00afff91773455d9c01f9217c3e8e0b20d719c.text: 昏睡相位：在這個相位下，你的 50% 移動速度會變慢。

e2fbd4c69a5cd8ba60a1204bda145a427a34ecc4.source: This room contains Leviathan Arms, Leviathan Minds and Leviathan Heads. Avoid rushing in to the middle as foes will close in from both sides. Instead, choose one side and clear to the other. Casters should be wary of Choking Gas from the Leviathan Heads. There is a Fire Flower nearby which throws fire projectiles that cause burning, touch once only to deactivate it. (A second touch will re-activate it.) The Aspect of Lethargy will be standing alone at the back of the room. When the Aspect is dead, kill the foes immediately behind the gate. In order to open the next gate, the team will have to temporarily sacrifice some of the players. It is important that crucial players do not stand on the pad (i.e. healers).
e2fbd4c69a5cd8ba60a1204bda145a427a34ecc4.text: 這個房間包含利維坦武器、利維坦思想和利維坦頭。避免衝入中間，因為敵人會從兩側逼近。相反，選擇一側並清除另一側。施法者應該警惕來自利維坦頭的 窒息毒氣。附近有一朵火焰花，它會發射火焰彈，造成燃燒，觸控一次即可停用。 （第二次觸控將重新啟用它。）昏睡的方面將獨自站在房間的後面。當守護者死亡後​​，立即殺死門後的敵人。為了開啟下一扇門，隊伍將不得不暫時犧牲一些隊員。重要的是關鍵玩家不要站在墊子上（即治療者）。
e2fbd4c69a5cd8ba60a1204bda145a427a34ecc4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4561c575796901482f888594f940be24815456a3.source: In the room that you have just cleared, there are a series of five wooden pads (square in shape with a round turtle shell in the center) which are activated when five players or heroes stands on them at once, one body per switch. If any of the five volunteers step off the pads, the gate will close after a short delay. While the five are standing on the pads, the other seven should cross through the temporarily open gate. The five volunteers should then move touch range to the now shut gate. Players with Recall, Shadow Meld or Dwarven Stability combined with Dash can manage to shadow step/rush through the gate before it closes (allowing them to avoid committing suicide).
4561c575796901482f888594f940be24815456a3.text: 在你剛剛清理的房間裡，有一系列五個木墊（方形，中間有一個圓形龜殼），當五個玩家或英雄同時站在它們上時，每個開關一個身體，這些木墊就會被啟用。如果五名志工中的任何一個人離開墊子，大門將在短暫延遲後關閉。當五個人站在墊子上時，其他七個人應該穿過暫時開啟的大門。然後，五名志工應將觸控範圍移至現已關閉的大門。具有 回歸、暗影結合 或矮人穩定性與 急衝 結合的玩家可以在大門關閉之前設法暗步/衝過大門（讓他們避免自殺）。
4561c575796901482f888594f940be24815456a3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c065da4cd171fdb52c25a4bb8c22852d9c384062.source: Normal mode only note: Sapping Nightmares will not cast Chaos Storm in normal mode on allies wielding martial weapons (i.e. no staves or scepters), regardless of profession. They will and do however use it in hard mode!
c065da4cd171fdb52c25a4bb8c22852d9c384062.text: 普通模式 只注意：侵蝕夢魘不會在正常模式下對使用軍用武器（即沒有法杖或權杖）的盟友施放 混沌風暴，無論其職業如何。然而他們會並且確實在困難模式下使用它！
c065da4cd171fdb52c25a4bb8c22852d9c384062.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8ebd9ec10488942f4e5775118af38b3cc7e1e2c5.source: In the seventh section, three groups of Outcast stand in an inverted U pattern. You will be able to see a small rock on the ground - anybody approaching nearby range of this stone will trigger a large spawn of Sappings and Freezing Nightmares behind the gate that head towards the five trapped in the sixth room.
8ebd9ec10488942f4e5775118af38b3cc7e1e2c5.text: 在第七部分中，三組被驅逐者站成倒U型。你將能夠看到地面上的一塊小石頭 - 任何接近這塊石頭附近範圍的人都會在門後觸發大量的坑害和冰凍夢魘，這些惡夢會朝著被困在第六個房間的五個人飛去。
8ebd9ec10488942f4e5775118af38b3cc7e1e2c5.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9f241c2c906fe4559c72b13043ba47614f0de8d8.source: Aspect of Depletion : While under this aspect, every 30 seconds, you lose 10 Energy and take 8 points of damage for every point of Energy lost this way.
9f241c2c906fe4559c72b13043ba47614f0de8d8.text: 消耗方面：在此方面下，每30秒，您會失去10 能量，並因這種方式失去的每點能量而受到8點傷害。

ff8e0607608ae3efdf4ff964b25f36dab71648d8.source: The gate at the entrance to the room will re-open after defeating all of the Outcasts and the Aspect of Depletion.
ff8e0607608ae3efdf4ff964b25f36dab71648d8.text: 擊敗所有流亡者和枯竭之靈後，房間入口處的大門將重新開啟。
ff8e0607608ae3efdf4ff964b25f36dab71648d8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

86feaef57b9d934b778fcef5943a608f82bdb35b.source: With a longbow, lure and kill the Aspect who patrols between the Outcast groups to remove the environmental effect. It is possible to pull the aspect without aggroing any of the Outcasts.
86feaef57b9d934b778fcef5943a608f82bdb35b.text: 用長弓引誘並殺死在流亡者群體之間巡邏的守護者，以消除環境影響。可以在不激怒任何流放者的情況下拉動局面。
86feaef57b9d934b778fcef5943a608f82bdb35b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d2f29f2285d8b31501cbb55682980e2a5917a25e.source: If you choose to kill the Aspect before finishing off all of the Outcasts, then you can kill the Nightmares through the gate without them running amok (do bear in mind the potency of Chaos Storm). You won't be able to re-group your allies yet though. First, take out each group of Outcasts seperately. Watch out for Outcast Spellstorms casting Gust and Maelstrom, and Outcast Deathhands using Putrid Explosion. Once all foes are cleared, the back gates will re-open allowing you to resurrect and reunite the entire team again.
d2f29f2285d8b31501cbb55682980e2a5917a25e.text: 如果你選擇在消滅所有流亡者之前殺死守護者，那麼你可以透過大門殺死夢魘，而不會讓他們發瘋（請記住 混沌風暴 的效力）。不過，你還無法重新組合你的盟友。首先，分別消滅每組流放者。留意施放 噴發 和 水漩渦 的流亡法術風暴，以及使用 屍爆 的流亡死亡之手。一旦所有敵人被清除，後門將重新開啟，讓你復活並再次重新團結整個團隊。
d2f29f2285d8b31501cbb55682980e2a5917a25e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d86306be938cfcb1cbe696badb4077ea989d8d08.source: Aspect of Failure : While under this aspect, all of your spells fail.
d86306be938cfcb1cbe696badb4077ea989d8d08.text: 失敗方面：在此方面下，你所有的法術都會失敗。
