8fd7d4efd45d7065f417fb8208a591c52461f44a.source: Casters are rendered useless here. To clear this section more easily, pull the patrolling Outcasts into the entrance. Teams can place tanks, spirits, minions across the gate to set up a body-blocking wall. Once the patrols are killed, only Outcast Raiders and the Aspect of Failure will remain in room at an elevated level.
8fd7d4efd45d7065f417fb8208a591c52461f44a.text: 腳輪在這裡變得毫無用處。為了更容易清除這個區域，請將巡邏的流放者拉到入口處。團隊可以將坦克、靈魂、小兵放置在大門對面，以建立身體阻擋牆。一旦巡邏隊被殺死，只有被遺棄的掠奪者和失敗之靈會以較高的水平留在房間裡。
8fd7d4efd45d7065f417fb8208a591c52461f44a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

dbf8f634abda11f1e29678b4e6c9b5dc0c457514.source: Players can ignore these foes and move to the next section by keeping close to the wall opposite the Outcast Raiders. The platform just before section 9 does not have the environmental effect. If the party wishes to clear the top level, e.g. for a chest, a good strategy would be to first move to the exit of room 8, setup another wall near the steps, and then pull the Aspect down from the elevated level. With the removal of the environmental effect, the party should have no trouble clearing out the remaining Outcasts.
dbf8f634abda11f1e29678b4e6c9b5dc0c457514.text: 玩家可以忽略這些敵人，並靠近被驅逐者對面的牆壁移動到下一個部分。 9 部分之前的平臺沒有環境影響。如果一方希望清除頂層，例如對於箱子，一個好的策略是先移動到 8 房間的出口，在階梯附近設定另一面牆，然後將 Aspect 從高處拉下來。隨著環境影響的消除，隊伍應該可以毫無困難地清除剩餘的流亡者。
dbf8f634abda11f1e29678b4e6c9b5dc0c457514.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e228c3b30f276449423f1c1fec21961696a064d7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d5dbb563f8d516df68e80b45f874d94654390019.source: Aspect of Shadows : While under this aspect, you cannot use enchantments or be targeted by enchantments.
d5dbb563f8d516df68e80b45f874d94654390019.text: 陰影方面：在此方面下，您無法使用結界或成為結界的目標。
d5dbb563f8d516df68e80b45f874d94654390019.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7d7c3dd49f2c33e41a271335413dd20182636680.source: This wide area has numerous Oni pop-ups and a massive wurm, The Leviathan at the center. It is apparently trapped in jade but it breaks free and attacks if the party walks too close. Ignore both the Leviathan and the Reborn Irukandjis (with Disenchantment) as they respawn indefinitely. It is recommended to pull the first few Oni groups out of the room into the gate into section 8 to reduce the number of oni faced at once. Following the left wall will lead to the Aspect, and beyond that, the exit.
7d7c3dd49f2c33e41a271335413dd20182636680.text: 這個廣闊的區域有許多鬼彈出視窗和一個巨大的亞龍，利維坦位於中心。它顯然被困在玉石中，但如果隊伍走得太近，它就會掙脫並發動攻擊。忽略利維坦和重生的伊魯卡（使用 削弱），因為它們會無限期重生。建議將前幾組鬼從房間拉到8區域的大門，以減少一次性面對的鬼數量。沿著左邊的牆走就會到達看點，再往前走就是出口。
7d7c3dd49f2c33e41a271335413dd20182636680.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7f4f5ed6b1399208068265b080bfc51e69bd6a49.source: The Aspect of Shadows stands at the opposite end of the room to the entrance, kill it to use enchantments again. There are a few more oni popups before the gate into the 10th section.
7f4f5ed6b1399208068265b080bfc51e69bd6a49.text: 暗影守護者站在房間入口的另一端，殺死它以再次使用結界。在進入 10 部分之前，還有一些 Oni 彈出視窗。
7f4f5ed6b1399208068265b080bfc51e69bd6a49.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2fda872ff3501f44ff9b7453443d7554a777ded1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ba01863a16acdf37b339d4d0a5a56ec107751224.source: Scorpion Aspect : While under this aspect, every 30 seconds, you are teleported to the nearest foe and knocked down.
ba01863a16acdf37b339d4d0a5a56ec107751224.text: 蠍子相位：在此相位下，每隔 30 秒，你就會被傳送到最近的敵人並被擊倒。
ba01863a16acdf37b339d4d0a5a56ec107751224.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e99e782ac2060459e148eda9c3d0b69707ff40e2.source: This section is considered by many the most difficult area in the Deep. A safe method is to have the full team wait atop the stairs (next to the Irukandji that keeps respawning) and have a player enter the 10th section and lure Oni patrols. Use the stairs to ball and nuke them with ease. Once several groups are killed, there may appear to be no more threats, but the room is not clear yet. Once the lure walks near to the Fire Flower, the Aspect of Scorpions will start to talk. At this point more Oni patrols will spawn (one to three groups), employ the same tactic of pulling them out of the room. Beware of further Oni popups.
e99e782ac2060459e148eda9c3d0b69707ff40e2.text: 此部分被許多人認為是深海中最困難的區域。安全的方法是讓整個團隊在樓梯頂部等待（在不斷重生的 毒水母 旁邊），然後讓一名玩家進入 10 區域並引誘 Oni 巡邏隊。使用樓梯輕鬆地攻擊和攻擊他們。一旦幾個群體被殺死，可能看起來不再有威脅，但房間還不清楚。一旦誘餌靠近火花，蠍子守護者就會開始說話。此時將會產生更多的鬼巡邏隊（一到三組），並以相同的策略將它們拉出房間。當心更多的 Oni 彈出視窗。
e99e782ac2060459e148eda9c3d0b69707ff40e2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

deb17fd2d51498ebf88eedc86658c768697bda28.source: The remaining enemies are Outcast patrols which will have to be fought under the environmental effect. Since the environment effect is bugged, it is recommended to remove it by exiting into the ninth section to reset the frequency of teleports and knockdowns. The battle ahead will be very confusing as party members are ripped off into enemy mobs away from the team. Ensure to regroup as soon as possible. Players can time the effect to place themselves closer to the groups ahead and manipulate the effect to their advantage.
deb17fd2d51498ebf88eedc86658c768697bda28.text: 剩下的敵人是流亡者巡邏隊，必須在環境影響下與他們戰鬥。由於環境效果有bug，建議透過退出第九部分重置傳送和擊倒頻率來消除它。前方的戰鬥將會非常混亂，因為隊伍成員會被誘騙到遠離隊伍的敵方暴徒。確保盡快重新集結。玩家可以安排效果的時間，讓自己更接近前方的隊伍，並操縱效果對自己有利。
deb17fd2d51498ebf88eedc86658c768697bda28.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c0cd34d13b564eb3c60fa8b251c7bd10718107a4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f2fc67f440869d18bb4a0414a97a2734e82e89a8.source: Aspect of Fear : While under this aspect, you move 10% faster. You take 25 damage each second you are moving.
f2fc67f440869d18bb4a0414a97a2734e82e89a8.text: 恐懼方面：在該方面下，你移動10%的速度更快。你每移動一秒鐘就會受到 25 傷害。
f2fc67f440869d18bb4a0414a97a2734e82e89a8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

676bc604970b1ee0f6a580c31f7561ca18a8f9f4.source: A snaking corridor awaits ahead, turning the first corner will trigger the charge of seven waves of Oni & Nightmares that spawn on the path behind. (Occasionally a chest will spawn with the foes.) The party will also be under fire from flowers that can be deactivated by touching them just like in the 6th section. There are two distinct methods to deal with the waves of foes:
676bc604970b1ee0f6a580c31f7561ca18a8f9f4.text: 前方有一條蜿蜒的走廊，轉彎第一個轉角將觸發後方道路上產生的七波鬼與夢魘的衝鋒。 （偶爾會有一個箱子與敵人一起生成。）隊伍也會受到花朵的攻擊，可以透過觸控它們來停用花朵，就像在 6 部分中一樣。有兩種不同的方法來應對敵人的浪潮：
676bc604970b1ee0f6a580c31f7561ca18a8f9f4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b4843b7546d3456a6544ccb59b3fc4cd5aa8a93c.source: Fast but risky: The whole team rushes to the Aspect of Fear, quickly killing Oni popups that appear in the way, then turn around and defeat the incoming groups.
b4843b7546d3456a6544ccb59b3fc4cd5aa8a93c.text: 快速但危險：整個團隊衝向恐懼之面，快速殺死出現在路上的鬼彈出視窗，然後轉身擊敗來襲的隊伍。
b4843b7546d3456a6544ccb59b3fc4cd5aa8a93c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ea3d7268d81d1214779ff6ba97cb6f8040954eb0.source: Slow but safer: Stand your ground at the stairs before the first wooden bridge. Create a wall of spirits or party members, and have everybody else attack from behind. Await here for the incoming waves. A team composed mostly of heroes can use this place to take a break (afk) of five minutes as the AI can usually handle these small groups. After the waves have been defeated, make your way to the Aspect and dispose of any Oni popups.
ea3d7268d81d1214779ff6ba97cb6f8040954eb0.text: 緩慢但更安全：站在第一座木橋前的樓梯。創造一道精神牆或黨員牆，讓其他人從後面攻擊。在這裡等待到來的波浪。主要由英雄組成的團隊可以使用這個地方休息（afk）五分鐘，因為AI通常可以處理這些小團體。擊敗海浪後，前往守護點並處理所有鬼彈出視窗。
ea3d7268d81d1214779ff6ba97cb6f8040954eb0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d82a3d84c0c33ecb4635b64bf4c3253857cf5ffc.source: Note: It is possible to dodge the flowers' projectiles.
d82a3d84c0c33ecb4635b64bf4c3253857cf5ffc.text: 注意：可以躲避花朵的彈頭。
d82a3d84c0c33ecb4635b64bf4c3253857cf5ffc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f009e221c049070f14f33b480f91d2a2e0807885.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

54346b389c7c2019bb82651117a37b9f1fbc5be2.source: Aspect of Depletion : While under this aspect, whenever your Energy hits 0, you take 50 damage.
54346b389c7c2019bb82651117a37b9f1fbc5be2.text: 耗盡方面：在此方面下，每當您的能量擊中0時，您都會受到50傷害。
54346b389c7c2019bb82651117a37b9f1fbc5be2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

99d9b671ef926dd24e61b279d9de127431fb9cc2.source: From this point onwards, the scenery will change from the depths of the Jade Sea to the caverns deep beneath the sea itself.
99d9b671ef926dd24e61b279d9de127431fb9cc2.text: 從此時開始，場景將從 碧玉海 深處轉變為海底深處的洞穴。
99d9b671ef926dd24e61b279d9de127431fb9cc2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

85f152caed2e554c0c12c7ba78f2c5a9e128bfed.source: The twelth precinct is round in shape, appearing to be empty at first, but contains many counter-clockwise Nightmare patrols. Chaos Storm is their most dangerous skill, and will deplete any energy very quickly. Create another bottle neck by creating a wall and sending the lure in to pull some foes. Depending on the tank's skill and the party's overall firepower, one single luring process can be more than enough to clear all foes at once.
85f152caed2e554c0c12c7ba78f2c5a9e128bfed.text: 第十二區呈圓形，乍看之下似乎空無一人，但包含許多逆時針的 夢魘 巡邏隊。 混沌風暴 是他們最危險的技能，會很快耗盡能量。透過建立一堵牆並傳送誘餌來吸引一些敵人，從而創造另一個瓶頸。根據坦克的技能和隊伍的整體火力，一次引誘過程足以一次消滅所有敵人。
85f152caed2e554c0c12c7ba78f2c5a9e128bfed.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f96981052d5b94a96bf9b1428fcef6cffee08d33.source: The Aspect of Depletion stands at the center of this area and does not assist the Nightmares. You can choose to avoid it by hugging one of the walls.
f96981052d5b94a96bf9b1428fcef6cffee08d33.text: 枯竭巨像位於該區域的中心，不會對夢魘提供幫助。您可以選擇擁抱其中一面牆來避免它。
f96981052d5b94a96bf9b1428fcef6cffee08d33.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

cec84ef5401999994f933cae088dd8bafb1bdac7.source: In normal mode, consider keeping caster weapons unequipped for the rest of the mission.
cec84ef5401999994f933cae088dd8bafb1bdac7.text: 在正常模式下，請考慮在任務的其餘部分中保持未裝備施法者武器。
cec84ef5401999994f933cae088dd8bafb1bdac7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9b0bfff9d7e867e3914c3d63eea7ee3194c56121.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

12dcf940057fceb17db75167d743146093bfce66.source: Aspect of Decay : While under this aspect, if you are Poisoned or Bleeding, you suffer an additional -4 Health degeneration.
12dcf940057fceb17db75167d743146093bfce66.text: 腐爛方面：在此方面下，如果您中毒或流血，您會遭受額外的-4 體力衰減效果。
12dcf940057fceb17db75167d743146093bfce66.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

838c92c73c080919eb0cf2061dfb9a5536ae4b6c.source: Another circular cavern, this time with a backpath circling up to the central mound where the Aspect of Decay stands atop.
838c92c73c080919eb0cf2061dfb9a5536ae4b6c.text: 另一個圓形洞穴，這次有一條小路盤旋至中央土丘，腐朽守護者就矗立在上面。
838c92c73c080919eb0cf2061dfb9a5536ae4b6c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ecff2a7ad71edf59a50bcd6266feb16f409f97ce.source: Here the team can choose to either follow the left path or the right path. They both lead to the final section, so the choice makes little difference. Both paths have seven Blood Flowers in the outer ring, and four Venom Flowers on the inner ring. Like the Fire Flowers and the Thorn Flowers, these can also be turned off by touching them. There are two Oni spawn spots at the fork, one Outcast group and two other Oni pop-ups behind. If you happen to walk to the mound, the Onis from the other path will close in. Assign one or two players to turn off all the flowers to ease the healers' job.
ecff2a7ad71edf59a50bcd6266feb16f409f97ce.text: 在這裡，團隊可以選擇走左路或右路。它們都通向最後一部分，因此選擇幾乎沒有什麼區別。兩條道路的外環都有七朵血花，內環有四朵毒花。與火花和荊棘花一樣，它們也可以通過觸控來關閉。岔路口有兩個鬼怪重生點，一個被遺棄者群體和另外兩個鬼怪彈出視窗。如果你碰巧走到土丘上，另一條路的奧尼斯就會靠近。指派一到兩名玩家關閉所有花朵以減輕治療師的工作。
ecff2a7ad71edf59a50bcd6266feb16f409f97ce.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1f6f61dbe07cee6f6982e65a01b7ac08ec93dfe3.text: 房間 11（除非使用技能否則會造成傷害）
1f6f61dbe07cee6f6982e65a01b7ac08ec93dfe3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

32f77e21ba75c43fd1ddec93eef8d9da977f3ffd.source: Aspect of Torment : While under this aspect, you take 50 damage every 3 seconds if you don't use a skill.
32f77e21ba75c43fd1ddec93eef8d9da977f3ffd.text: 折磨方面：在此方面下，如果您不使用技能，則每 3 秒就會受到 50 傷害。
32f77e21ba75c43fd1ddec93eef8d9da977f3ffd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

423bc2ec2913cd903e12a6ca541a9cb0aa080f40.source: The hidden foes that spawn will vary depending on which side you entered from; the south has Oni and the north has Nightmares. Finally, the Aspect of Torment stands with a group of Outcasts - you can pull the Aspect away from the Outcasts since they are not part of the same team.
423bc2ec2913cd903e12a6ca541a9cb0aa080f40.text: 產生的隱藏敵人會根據您從哪一邊進入而有所不同；南方有鬼，北方有夢魘。最後，折磨方面與一群流放者站在一起 - 您可以將方面從流放者中拉開，因為他們不屬於同一團隊。
423bc2ec2913cd903e12a6ca541a9cb0aa080f40.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b8a811621edecbd9961e1e276b3ef05986d6ca89.text: 房間12（健康狀況嚴重惡化）
b8a811621edecbd9961e1e276b3ef05986d6ca89.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aa82b138effddf58ed607c43adb62739969f9670.source: Nightmare Aspect : While under this aspect, you suffer -8 Health degeneration.
aa82b138effddf58ed607c43adb62739969f9670.text: 夢魘 相位：在這個相位下，你會遭受 -8 體力衰減效果 的痛苦。
aa82b138effddf58ed607c43adb62739969f9670.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e4d91849fb7773d5f1b9309d42199738d70328b8.source: This is the final chamber where Kanaxai resides, seemingly alone, at the back. The constant -8 health degeneration makes the use of party-wide healing (e.g. Heal Party) imperative. Note that this environmental effect does not go away even after Kanaxai has been defeated.
e4d91849fb7773d5f1b9309d42199738d70328b8.text: 這是 加奈賽 所在的最後一個房間，看似孤獨，位於後面。持續的 -8 健康狀況惡化使得使用全黨治療（例如 治癒隊伍）勢在必行。請注意，即使 加奈賽 被擊敗後，這種環境影響也不會消失。
e4d91849fb7773d5f1b9309d42199738d70328b8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

79ac6a13d4f899115e107750c6921b90cb855bf4.source: Kanaxai is a difficult foe, as he hits very hard and very fast. Each successful hit also knocks his target down. He uses an enchantment called Nightmare Refuge (1-second cast time, 10-second recharge), which makes all spells fail 50% of the time, and gives him a 50% chance to block attacks. In addition, that enchantment also heals him for 1,000 health if it is not removed within the 10 seconds it lasts. And finally, like all of the Aspects of Kanaxai, he stops taking damage at 80%, 60%, 40%, and 20% of his maximum health. To resume normal damage, a knockdown is necessary (although life stealing skills continue to function). The difference between Kanaxai and his aspects are that each of Kanaxai's knockdowns will spawn a mob of twelve creatures:
79ac6a13d4f899115e107750c6921b90cb855bf4.text: 加奈賽 是一個很難對付的敵人，因為他的攻擊非常猛烈且速度非常快。每一次成功的命中也會擊倒他的目標。他使用了一種名為 夢魘 避難所的結界（1 秒施法時間，10 秒充能），這使得所有法術在 50% 時間內失敗，並給了他 50% 格擋攻擊的機會。此外，如果該結界在持續的 10 秒內沒有被移除，它還會治癒他 1,000 的生命值。最後，像 加奈賽 的所有方面一樣，他在最大生命值的 80%、60%、40% 和 20% 時不再受到傷害。要恢復正常傷害，需要擊倒（儘管生命竊取技能仍然有效）。 加奈賽 和他的面向之間的差異在於 加奈賽 的每次擊倒都會產生十二個生物的暴徒：
79ac6a13d4f899115e107750c6921b90cb855bf4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f05e73d67b1fcb4abe08bedf0f00f71022818d37.text: 削弱噩夢（高於最大生命值 80%）
f05e73d67b1fcb4abe08bedf0f00f71022818d37.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b7bacb219be22025f3327e8e19fba1d769711f37.source: Send one character that has two knock downs, or two characters with one knock down skill each to lure Kanaxai to one side of the cavern. Avoid maintaining bonds on these characters since the Sapping Nightmares that spawn will remove their enchantments.
b7bacb219be22025f3327e8e19fba1d769711f37.text: 派出一個擁有兩次擊倒技能的角色，或兩名各擁有一項擊倒技能的角色，將 加奈賽 引誘到洞穴的一側。避免與這些角色保持聯絡，因為生成的侵蝕噩夢會消除他們的結界。

bded78e2b4fa3258b73eef1d025e7b639501ac7d.source: Once Kanaxai gets close to a wall, knock him down 2 times in succession to create the maximum amount of spawned creatures. Wait until Kanaxai stands up again before applying the second knock-down. Recall or Shadow Meld allow these characters to quickly escape from the spawned mob and rejoin the main team. (Either by dismissing the enchantment or the Nightmares removing it with Feedback.)
bded78e2b4fa3258b73eef1d025e7b639501ac7d.text: 一旦 加奈賽 靠近牆壁，請連續將其擊倒 2 次，以創造最大數量的生成生物。等到 加奈賽 再次站起來，然後再進行第二次擊倒。 回歸 或 暗影結合 允許這些角色快速逃離生成的生物並重新加入主隊。 （通過解除結界或噩夢使用 反饋 將其移除。）
bded78e2b4fa3258b73eef1d025e7b639501ac7d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

125d9ecbc7087602e5a68904cbd783a95626220c.source: After these creatures have spawned, the whole party can run to the opposite side of the room and await Kanaxai. Since the boss has an extended aggro range, he will immediately run to the party, and his spawned Nightmares will stay where they appeared.
125d9ecbc7087602e5a68904cbd783a95626220c.text: 這些生物生成後，整個隊伍可以跑到房間的另一側並等待 加奈賽。由於 Boss 的仇恨範圍較遠，他會立即跑向隊伍，而他生成的惡夢會留在出現的地方。
125d9ecbc7087602e5a68904cbd783a95626220c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bbf6be16f928181cb0c0112ced707e4359642492.text: 不要忘記，殺死任何生成的敵人都會導致更多生物重新生成（如果 加奈賽 還活著）。

8e412553511e2a87e826d9992a90dc0538c26fec.source: After defeating Kanaxai, Kanaxai's Chest will spawn in the center of the room. The game will ping its location on the compass with the red ping typical of players. Ensure that your team does not misjudge the ping as a sign to rush in, as sometimes the spawned Nightmare creatures may be wandering in range of the chest. Remember that the environmental effect will still persist even when Kanaxai has been defeated, if members of your party wish to backtrack through the mission for loot, then move out of the final room as soon as possible.
8e412553511e2a87e826d9992a90dc0538c26fec.text: 擊敗 加奈賽 後，加奈賽 的 寶箱 將在房間中央產生。遊戲將使用玩家典型的紅色 ping 來顯示指南針上的位置。確保您的團隊不會將 ping 錯誤判斷為衝入的訊號，因為有時生成的 夢魘 生物可能會在箱子範圍內徘徊。請記住，即使 加奈賽 被擊敗，環境影響仍然會持續，如果你的隊伍成員希望返回任務以獲取戰利品，請盡快離開最後一個房間。
8e412553511e2a87e826d9992a90dc0538c26fec.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c314c6696cb579b64e42e8678233e3a66a629af2.source: Start from the Leviathan Pits and head into Silent Surf, where you will find Turimachus waiting just outside the outpost. As you walk near him, the quest will update and point to the location where you can find the dragon eggs. Turimachus will join your party as an ally. Should Turimachus die, you will need to map back to an outpost and restart the quest.
c314c6696cb579b64e42e8678233e3a66a629af2.text: 從 利拜亞森礦場 出發，前往 寂靜之浪，您會發現圖裡馬科斯就在前哨站外面等候。當你走近他時，任務將會更新並指向你可以找到龍蛋的位置。圖裡馬科斯將作為盟友加入你的隊伍。如果圖裡馬科斯死了，你將需要映射回前哨站並重新開始任務。
c314c6696cb579b64e42e8678233e3a66a629af2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

afafb66829ce48de30c517a4057ce8120f45a811.source: Head south through Silent Surf to the location of the dragon eggs. As you approach, make sure that the area around the objective is clear of other creatures to avoid any aggro problems when the dragons spawn.
afafb66829ce48de30c517a4057ce8120f45a811.text: 向南穿過 寂靜之浪 到達龍蛋的位置。當您接近時，請確保目標周圍的區域沒有其他生物，以避免龍生成時出現任何仇恨問題。
afafb66829ce48de30c517a4057ce8120f45a811.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

04df7ab83fd9d6ccaa8f75ebee19ffccd939a271.source: As you approach the quest marker, a group of 5 Saltspray Dragons will popup and 9-10 Saltspray Dragon Eggs will drop on the ground. Pay close attention to Turimachus here. When he has spoken his dialogue, he will rush into the dragon group to pick up an egg, and if successful, he'll run off north with his prize. However, he will be under attack from the dragons while doing this, so make sure he's well protected and healed.
04df7ab83fd9d6ccaa8f75ebee19ffccd939a271.text: 當您接近任務標記時，一群 5 鹽霧龍會彈出，9-10 鹽霧之龍 雞蛋會掉在地上。密切關注這裡的圖裡馬科斯。當他說完對話後，他會衝進龍群去拿一個雞蛋，如果成功，他就會帶著他的獎品向北跑。然而，在這樣做時他會受到龍的攻擊，所以要確保他得到良好的保護和治療。
04df7ab83fd9d6ccaa8f75ebee19ffccd939a271.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

109c67a84a23befbf78a6d6b1b350327016c1b03.source: If Turimachus gets away safely with an egg, the quest will update and become completed. At this point, map back to the Leviathan Pits to collect your reward.
109c67a84a23befbf78a6d6b1b350327016c1b03.text: 如果圖裡馬科斯帶著雞蛋安全逃脫，任務就會更新並完成。此時，映射回 利拜亞森礦場 以領取您的獎勵。

f24c39bda71f7ccaac0081a0943843d941b56076.source: Another option for completing this quest is going to the nest (carefully avoiding Turimachus so the log will not trigger, or entering from Seafarer's Rest), clearing out all enemies along the way. Then, return to Turimachus and simply escort him to the nest, so he won't die. You'll only have to worry about the many dragons that spawn upon his arrival, but he should be okay.
f24c39bda71f7ccaac0081a0943843d941b56076.text: 完成此任務的另一個選擇是前往巢穴（小心避開圖裡馬科斯，這樣日誌就不會觸發，或從 航海者休憩處 進入），清除沿途的所有敵人。然後，返回圖裡馬科斯並護送他到巢穴，這樣他就不會死。你只需要擔心他到來時會出現的許多龍，但他應該沒事。

a9e610a6821618283c62fbf445ffaccab0096a94.source: It should be noted that Turimachus can be killed by other patrolling enemies as he attempts to escape with the Dragon Eggs, so clear out any nearby enemies. However, once your quest log has been updated with "See Turimachus for your reward", you should be able to map back to Leviathan Pits and meet him inside, whether or not he gets killed while escaping with the egg.
a9e610a6821618283c62fbf445ffaccab0096a94.text: 應該注意的是，當圖裡馬科斯試圖帶著龍蛋逃跑時，他可能會被其他巡邏的敵人殺死，所以要清除附近的所有敵人。然而，一旦你的任務日誌被更新為“檢視圖裡馬庫斯以獲得獎勵”，你應該能夠映射回 利拜亞森礦場 並在裡面見到他，無論他在帶著蛋逃跑時是否被殺死。

aa34b47923874df30b816c6e28aa13869ab0a61e.source: When repeating the quest, it is possible to pull the various Manipulated Grawls in the boss room into a fight with the Echos and Horsemen. This is not possible during a first run of the quest, because Echos and Horsemen will not spawn yet.

556a106e50c8a2c77e669d28a4cbad200e4e8c6d.source: From Kaineng Center, head South, then South-West, until you get out into an open courtyard area. There will be none of the afflicted there that would usually be there, and he's standing off by himself off to the side. He'll start off neutral towards you, but as you approach him he'll turn red and attack. When you damage him until he has about 1/4 health, he'll turn neutral again and credit you with defeating him.
556a106e50c8a2c77e669d28a4cbad200e4e8c6d.text: 從 凱寧中心 出發，向南行駛，然後向西南行駛，直到進入一個開放的庭院區域。那裡不會有平常那樣的受苦者，而他獨自站在一旁。他一開始會對你保持中立，但當你接近他時，他會變紅並發動攻擊。當你對他造成傷害直到他有大約 1/4 生命值時，他會再次轉為中立並相信你擊敗了他。

01611965a67238587ad95ddd23bbad273d48ec8b.source: To capture Drinkmaster Tahnu's elite skill Enraged Smash, follow him to Kaineng Center after defeating him. He will die just before entering the town. If he gets stuck between a group of Canthan Peasants along the way, you will need to abandon the quest and start over. To prevent this, stand in front of him just before he approaches the group, forcing him to change course. Alternatively, you can use minions to kill the peasants or lure them away from Tahnu's path.
01611965a67238587ad95ddd23bbad273d48ec8b.text: 要獲得飲酒大師塔努的精英技能 憤怒猛擊，請在擊敗他後跟隨他前往 凱寧中心。他將在進入城鎮之前死去。如果他一路上被一群凱珊農民困住，你將需要放棄任務並重新開始。為了防止這種情況發生，請在他接近團隊之前站在他面前，迫使他改變路線。或者，你可以使用爪牙殺死農民或引誘他們遠離塔努的道路。
01611965a67238587ad95ddd23bbad273d48ec8b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0b25b52aab256233f624b1bfe308eeb44f7385ef.source: Althea is standing in one of the many possible locations in Diessa Lowlands, at the location of the quest marker. It is possible to keep rezoning from either Grendich Courthouse or Nolani Academy until she is relatively close by. It is not advised to travel to Diessa Lowlands from Piken Square for this quest. Regardless of the spawn point, she is often surrounded by various Charr. Despite this, the player only needs to talk to her to progress the quest. Once spoken to her, players can map travel back to Piken Square.
0b25b52aab256233f624b1bfe308eeb44f7385ef.text: 奧瑟雅 位於 底耶沙低地 中眾多可能位置之一，位於任務標記的位置。可以繼續從 葛蘭迪法院 或 若拉尼學院 重新分割槽，直到她相對較近。不建議從 派肯廣場 前往 底耶沙低地 執行此任務。無論在哪個重生點，她都經常被各種 夏爾 包圍。儘管如此，玩家只需要與她交談即可完成任務。與她交談後，玩家可以在地圖上返回 派肯廣場。

fe4c50b777b44c0b68c1b0e767f545a7e27da43a.source: A technique that makes fending off the groups much easier is to pull the priest away from the spot where he is performing the ritual (which is the end point for all incoming waves). This can be achieved by having the priest chase a foe down to the gate of the citadel, and then killing that foe. The priest will remain in that spot and will not try to return to his original spot.
fe4c50b777b44c0b68c1b0e767f545a7e27da43a.text: 一種更容易抵禦群體的技術是將牧師拉離他正在進行儀式的地點（這是所有傳入波的終點）。這可以透過讓牧師將敵人追到城堡門口，然後殺死該敵人來實現。牧師將留在那個位置，不會嘗試返回原來的位置。

d9e4d9e2f7a0fcfa9d793ebe01d8bf10999691ad.source: The best candidate for this action is one of the two Fury Titans that come as part of group 2. Since they are original members of the group, the following spawns will not trigger until they die. And because they are the smallest titans, they will not spawn any more after their death. Therefore, the party should leave one Fury Titan alive, bring him close to the priest so that the priest starts attacking him and then have his target slowly back up all the way to the Citadel door and wait for the priest to catch up. If done correctly, protecting the priest will not be a factor in defeating these monsters.
d9e4d9e2f7a0fcfa9d793ebe01d8bf10999691ad.text: 此行動的最佳人選是 2 組中的兩名憤怒泰坦之一。由於他們是該群體的原始成員，因此在他們死亡之前不會觸發以下生成。而且因為它們是最小的泰坦，所以它們死後不會再生成。因此，隊伍應該留下一名狂怒泰坦活著，把他靠近牧師，以便牧師開始攻擊他，然後讓他的目標慢慢後退到城堡門口，等待牧師追上。如果做得正確，保護牧師將不會成為擊敗這些怪物的因素。
d9e4d9e2f7a0fcfa9d793ebe01d8bf10999691ad.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e0033d0a7b15f700e884aaed623c27eea35f02fa.source: Fighting away from the priest: Another tactic to facilitate defending the priest is, once the priest is moved, to actually pull groups up the hill (towards the southwest) and use the big rock at that spot for tanking and nuking. The one draw back of this approach is that there are two groups (group 9 and 17) that spawn at that position. However, the benefit (which strongly outweighs the disadvantage) is that the party can retreat at any time and disengage whenever they feel overwhelmed.
e0033d0a7b15f700e884aaed623c27eea35f02fa.text: 遠離牧師的戰鬥：另一種有助於保護牧師的策略是，一旦牧師被移動，實際上將團隊拉上山（朝向西南）並使用該地點的大岩石進行坦克和核武器攻擊。這種方法的一個缺點是有兩個組（組 9 和 17）在該位置產生。然而，好處（遠大於壞處）是，該方可以隨時撤退，並在感到不知所措時脫離。
e0033d0a7b15f700e884aaed623c27eea35f02fa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4897d706ca8a02e14ed1e1afd0d686e48c56ed4b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

136633de925ce0c11427b7509ac424af042bbe41.source: Ritualists are especially effective because they do not have to depend on hexes or enchantments. Mallyx has no special defenses against Spirits or Weapon Spells. In particular, Displacement and Shelter are very potent in containing Mallyx since his only actual damage comes from his melee attacks and environment effects.
136633de925ce0c11427b7509ac424af042bbe41.text: 儀式主義者特別有效，因為他們不必依賴巫術或結界。 Mallyx 對靈魂或 武器 法術沒有特殊的防禦能力。特別是，偏移 和 庇護 在遏制 Mallyx 方面非常有效，因為他唯一的實際傷害來自他的近戰攻擊和環境影響。
136633de925ce0c11427b7509ac424af042bbe41.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

899b64fc8929084e97b55173e86337aca3a4840f.source: Anti-summon skills are useful: Holy Spear and Spiritual Pain do bonus damage to the Soul spirits; Gaze of Fury destroys them.
899b64fc8929084e97b55173e86337aca3a4840f.text: 反召喚技能很有用：神聖矛和生靈苦痛對靈魂精神造成額外傷害； 狂暴凝視 會摧毀它們。
899b64fc8929084e97b55173e86337aca3a4840f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5b7fb5238bf660dad840bc0a36dcf1860c660d1b.source: Never use enchantments unless you can shutdown his use of Banish Enchantment.
5b7fb5238bf660dad840bc0a36dcf1860c660d1b.text: 除非您可以關閉他對 驅逐 加持魔法 的使用，否則切勿使用結界。
5b7fb5238bf660dad840bc0a36dcf1860c660d1b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c88e3f991b41ffc8a9c70cd92dd460e340b3be72.source: Bring alternatives to hexes, conditions, and enchantments: Wards, Wells, Shouts, Spirits, Weapon Spells, signets, and plain skills.
c88e3f991b41ffc8a9c70cd92dd460e340b3be72.text: 帶來六角形、條件和結界的替代品：守衛、水井、喊叫、精神、武器 法術、圖章和普通技能。
c88e3f991b41ffc8a9c70cd92dd460e340b3be72.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f66ab05b1a5a5d057aa79f3fe5b643b5c093211f.source: Mallyx's skills cannot be disabled; skills such as Blackout and Diversion are of no use.
f66ab05b1a5a5d057aa79f3fe5b643b5c093211f.text: 馬裡克斯的技能無法被停用； 意識喪失 和 牽制 等技能沒有用。
f66ab05b1a5a5d057aa79f3fe5b643b5c093211f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

15da00568865c88ae6aa69af7f99e10339069038.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

089a25029e601f2c32c540f0ad040a487c261efe.source: Mallyx's skills tend to prevent the use of the standard tactic of a frontline of tanks, a midline of ranged attackers/casters, and a backline of healers.
089a25029e601f2c32c540f0ad040a487c261efe.text: 馬裡克斯的技能往往會阻止使用前線坦克、中線遠端攻擊者/施法者和後線治療者的標準戰術。
089a25029e601f2c32c540f0ad040a487c261efe.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9f61f546e50a884869b534d91d33a3f97263e31d.source: His Shadow Smash ability is always active and will often cause him to retarget different allies, making Tanking extremely difficult. Summoning Shadows similarly makes it difficult to keep out of his aggro range.
9f61f546e50a884869b534d91d33a3f97263e31d.text: 他的 闇影 粉碎能力始終處於活躍狀態，並且經常導致他重新瞄準不同的盟友，使坦克變得極其困難。召喚暗影同樣讓人很難脫離他的仇恨範圍。
9f61f546e50a884869b534d91d33a3f97263e31d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a4b6a3ad00c0fb63ab31343225021e7a72430620.source: Kill the spirits to remove their environmental effects.
a4b6a3ad00c0fb63ab31343225021e7a72430620.text: 殺死靈魂以消除它們對環境的影響。
a4b6a3ad00c0fb63ab31343225021e7a72430620.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a19714bf44b70d0fba382a48994006f1a1f1229b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

79344d56f7392ce614fe23d8d2095da66692c485.source: Examine Mallyx's movement, should he run off: aimless movement means he will return shortly; no movement means he has lost aggro.
79344d56f7392ce614fe23d8d2095da66692c485.text: 檢查馬裡克斯的動作，看他是否逃跑：漫無目的的動作意味著他很快就會回來；沒有任何動作意味著他已經失去了仇恨。
79344d56f7392ce614fe23d8d2095da66692c485.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0a82c144918e4ea5f940b2ae8499661c8c7f0d33.source: Sometimes you need to distract him by leaving 2 or 3 people inside the gate to get him to stay, instead of running off after he kills the puller.
0a82c144918e4ea5f940b2ae8499661c8c7f0d33.text: 有時你需要將 2 或 3 的人留在門內分散他的注意力，讓他留下來，而不是在他殺死拉手後逃跑。
0a82c144918e4ea5f940b2ae8499661c8c7f0d33.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d900da502960e27439c7500d2fa64418917485d8.source: After Mallyx uses Shadow Smash, party members need to kite in order to force him to re-establish aggro on the tank, if using a tank.
d900da502960e27439c7500d2fa64418917485d8.text: 在 Mallyx 使用 闇影 Smash 後，如果使用坦克，隊員需要放風箏才能迫使他在坦克上重新建立仇恨。
d900da502960e27439c7500d2fa64418917485d8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0bc3b90eb3f609e2f5c43a0c7023874254aabf1f.source: Once Mallyx is defeated, a Citadel Chest and Spirit of Truth will spawn. If your party wipes after Mallyx has been killed (or while he is degenerating to death, ie through Well of Suffering), they will not be resurrected to claim the chest. The quest will be considered complete.
0bc3b90eb3f609e2f5c43a0c7023874254aabf1f.text: 一旦 Mallyx 被擊敗，Citadel 寶箱 和真理之靈就會生成。如果你的隊伍在 Mallyx 被殺死後（或當他墮落至死時，即透過 痛苦之池）進行清掃，他們將不會復活來領取寶箱。任務將被視為完成。
0bc3b90eb3f609e2f5c43a0c7023874254aabf1f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f46397da64ac0851b01ff6a8e658ba28c437f2ec.source: Gaze of Fury may sometimes spawn the spirit but leave the Anguished Soul alive.
f46397da64ac0851b01ff6a8e658ba28c437f2ec.text: 狂暴凝視 有時可能會生成靈魂，但會讓痛苦的靈魂存活。
f46397da64ac0851b01ff6a8e658ba28c437f2ec.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

46ee21a73daca548ce4c6d9395efbdf7e7635881.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ea117ba5fc407381e5b0939f932b39d6093958e1.source: If a party member goes through the portal leading to Mallyx's room right after killing the last group of enemies and all 8 party members skip the cut scene quickly, then the entire party can stay in the original room. One person can pull Mallyx back to the original room and the entire fight can take place there to make it significantly easier due to the lack of spawns attacking you & negative spirit effects.
ea117ba5fc407381e5b0939f932b39d6093958e1.text: 如果隊伍成員在殺死最後一組敵人後立即通過通往 Mallyx 房間的傳送門，並且所有 8 隊伍成員都快速跳過過場動畫，那麼整個隊伍都可以留在原來的房間裡。一個人可以將 Mallyx 拉回原來的房間，整個戰鬥可以在那裡進行，由於沒有攻擊你的生成物和負面精神效果，因此變得更加容易。
ea117ba5fc407381e5b0939f932b39d6093958e1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d0ed01caef98b5ca8b40e6d4d3ec98059f1f9b27.source: When planning to complete this mission in hard mode, it can be a good idea to first obtain the quest Miniature Companion: The Domain of Anguish from Merrise, Sworn to Seas in Embark Beach. This quest rewards 2025 experience, 2006 gold and the Miniature Greased Lightning.
d0ed01caef98b5ca8b40e6d4d3ec98059f1f9b27.text: 當計劃在困難模式下完成此任務時，最好先從 征途海灘 中向海洋宣誓的 Merrise 處獲得任務微型伴侶：悲難之門。此任務獎勵 2025 經驗、2006 金幣和微型油脂閃電。
d0ed01caef98b5ca8b40e6d4d3ec98059f1f9b27.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5bee4219cd8991554a0a656231ea5fff10cb5278.text: 德：埃本霍爾茲-馬裡克斯之歌
5bee4219cd8991554a0a656231ea5fff10cb5278.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2480108b22180b101054cbf8fdbee353604282e3.source: Escort Fadden Hathorn into the Devourer devourer cave and keep him safe while he gathers eggs.
2480108b22180b101054cbf8fdbee353604282e3.text: 護送 Fadden Hathorn 進入 蠍 吞噬者洞穴，並在他收集雞蛋時確保他的安全。
2480108b22180b101054cbf8fdbee353604282e3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8be1100bc96a3c9b5d3d0c5cfa36df614af608ca.source: Escort Fadden Hathorn back to Duke Gaban.
8be1100bc96a3c9b5d3d0c5cfa36df614af608ca.text: 護送 Fadden Hathorn 返回 格班公爵。
8be1100bc96a3c9b5d3d0c5cfa36df614af608ca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d96fe694cb6d3429d8238dfd13766fb7d916ee3a.source: Return to Duke Gaban for your reward.
d96fe694cb6d3429d8238dfd13766fb7d916ee3a.text: 影返 至 格班公爵 以獲得獎勵。
d96fe694cb6d3429d8238dfd13766fb7d916ee3a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2e45013ff7da3e6364912ac6aa0f6a96aff52ea0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0265a4fe659f17fc55f7ed4778802a9d7879db45.source: Upon completing this quest, Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn will no longer spawn in Lakeside County. They can both be seen again post-Searing, Fadden in Sardelac Sanitarium and Duke Gaban in the Bonus Mission Pack.
0265a4fe659f17fc55f7ed4778802a9d7879db45.text: 完成此任務後，格班公爵 和 Fadden Hathorn 將不再在 湖畔郡 中產生。它們都可以在 崩壞 之後再次出現，Fadden 在 薩德拉克療養院 中，格班公爵 在 額外獎勵 主線任務 套件中。
0265a4fe659f17fc55f7ed4778802a9d7879db45.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

332428af3aec3ffaf312644a231f47c26ba70023.source: Upon completing this quest, the Devourer Nests will no longer be interactive.
332428af3aec3ffaf312644a231f47c26ba70023.text: 完成此任務後，蠍 巢穴將不再具有互動性。
332428af3aec3ffaf312644a231f47c26ba70023.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b05d24474bcbbfd7f53a308e52e5239c2e20f267.source: Exit Ascalon City, cross the river to the south, and head slightly uphill to locate Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn (hold Alt if you have trouble spotting them). Accept the quest and lead Fadden into the cave.
b05d24474bcbbfd7f53a308e52e5239c2e20f267.text: 退出 阿斯卡隆城，向南過河，稍微上坡即可找到 格班公爵 和 Fadden Hathorn（如果您很難找到它們，請按住 Alt）。接受任務並帶領法登進入洞穴。
b05d24474bcbbfd7f53a308e52e5239c2e20f267.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e5d5c426c940411e5c8f5eb133261e04527e47e9.source: Fadden will flee from any living devourer, even though most are not hostile. To keep him moving, you must systematically clear the cave. The eight level 1 Carrion and Lash Devourers inside shouldn't pose much of a threat, especially if you pull them one by one.
e5d5c426c940411e5c8f5eb133261e04527e47e9.text: 法登會逃離任何活著的吞噬者，即使大多數都沒有敵意。為了讓他繼續前進，你必須有系統地清理洞穴。裡面的八級 1 腐肉和鞭打 蠍 應該不會造成太大的威脅，特別是如果你一一拉動它們的話。
e5d5c426c940411e5c8f5eb133261e04527e47e9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a670715d8a434a574101b03c1363e3c8cb16e51e.source: One level 0 Diseased Devourer will unburrow at the second nest and attack you, and two more will strike at the third. This can trigger nearby devourers to attack as well. Focus down the level 0 ambushers first, as they drop after one or two basic attacks, which quickly brings down the incoming damage.
a670715d8a434a574101b03c1363e3c8cb16e51e.text: 一層 0 疫病蠍 會在第二個巢穴中挖洞並攻擊您，另外兩層會攻擊第三個巢穴。這也會觸發附近的吞噬者進行攻擊。 聚能器 首先降低 0 伏擊者的等級，因為它們會在一兩次基本攻擊後掉落，從而迅速降低傳入的傷害。
a670715d8a434a574101b03c1363e3c8cb16e51e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0c42e8852f9180cab601f7c25239017a9200a05c.source: Once Fadden gathers all three eggs, escort him back to the Duke. Two Lash Devourers will spawn near the cave entrance while you are inside. If you haven't already, clear them out so Fadden can safely exit and you can claim your reward.
0c42e8852f9180cab601f7c25239017a9200a05c.text: 一旦法登集齊了所有三個蛋，就護送他回到公爵身邊。當你在裡面時，兩個鞭子 蠍 會在洞穴入口附近生成。如果你還沒有清理掉它們，那麼法登就可以安全退出，然後你就可以領取獎勵了。
0c42e8852f9180cab601f7c25239017a9200a05c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a7563652436bfe079ef649c24410ff08f7c998d8.source: Upon completing the quest, Duke Gaban will give you two devourer eggs. One can be used in the quest The Worm Problem and the other in The Rogue's Replacement. You can also get eggs by giving Brownlow five skale fins or trading with another player.
a7563652436bfe079ef649c24410ff08f7c998d8.text: 完成任務後，格班公爵 會給你兩隻吞噬蛋。一個可以在任務 地蟲的危害 中使用，另一個可以在 流氓的賠償 中使用。您也可以透過給 布朗羅 五個 skale fin 或與其他玩家交易來獲得雞蛋。
a7563652436bfe079ef649c24410ff08f7c998d8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8b6e98a5d2fedb5c58af8a2fe28cbc8370a6d406.source: Two Hidden Stashes also spawn in the cave. On rare occasions, this might block Fadden's path. To get him to move, try pulling some foes nearby, which should cause him to flee. If that does not work, you will have to rezone and try again.
8b6e98a5d2fedb5c58af8a2fe28cbc8370a6d406.text: 洞穴中也會生成兩個隱藏的藏匿處。在極少數情況下，這可能會阻礙法登的道路。為了讓他移動，試著拉附近的一些敵人，這應該會導致他逃跑。如果這不起作用，您將不得不重新分割並重試。
8b6e98a5d2fedb5c58af8a2fe28cbc8370a6d406.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a5d31162d5cab9de5a92577ebde58aac9e1ed824.source: When you attack a devourer that is trapped behind a rock or egg, your attacks can be obstructed. Reposition yourself so that you can attack from a different angle (or bring skills that can do damage without a line-of-sight).
a5d31162d5cab9de5a92577ebde58aac9e1ed824.text: 當你攻擊被困在岩石或雞蛋後面的吞噬者時，你的攻擊可能會被阻礙。重新調整自己的位置，以便可以從不同的角度進行攻擊（或使用可以在視線外造成傷害的技能）。
a5d31162d5cab9de5a92577ebde58aac9e1ed824.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d002638a23866548d87a2168ef4d6d47b125d5a9.source: Use your Fire Storm spell to defeat the ice beasts that attack Aziure.
d002638a23866548d87a2168ef4d6d47b125d5a9.text: 使用 火焰風暴 法術擊敗攻擊 Aziure 的冰獸。
d002638a23866548d87a2168ef4d6d47b125d5a9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

637c3ff21e98774bbd80acbcb4372a31b27f29ed.source: Aziure will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
637c3ff21e98774bbd80acbcb4372a31b27f29ed.text: 接受任務後，Aziure 將為您提供以下技能：
637c3ff21e98774bbd80acbcb4372a31b27f29ed.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

51d017383bde3c78953eeb055d6e79e69d007013.source: Upon accepting the quest, simply wait for the Ice Elemental Shards to spawn. They come periodically in three waves. Since the Ice Elemental Shards take double damage from fire, a single, well-placed Fire Storm will easily kill them even with 0 Fire Magic. Wait until they cluster around you or Aziure, cast the spell once they stop moving, and watch them melt.
51d017383bde3c78953eeb055d6e79e69d007013.text: 接受任務後，只需等待 冰元素 碎片生成即可。它們週期性地分三波出現。由於 冰元素 碎片會受到雙倍火焰傷害，因此即使使用 0 火系魔法，單一放置良好的 火焰風暴 也能輕鬆殺死它們。等到它們聚集在你或阿茲烏爾周圍，一旦它們停止移動就施放咒語，然後看著它們融化。
51d017383bde3c78953eeb055d6e79e69d007013.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7b958936aab5257399b5cc82e022975ef6bc78e0.source: Once the final wave is defeated, speak to Aziure to claim your reward.
7b958936aab5257399b5cc82e022975ef6bc78e0.text: 一旦最後一波被擊敗，與 Aziure 交談以獲得獎勵。
7b958936aab5257399b5cc82e022975ef6bc78e0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

63bc02db9db35e6efcc6398c001daa5ba31db3a9.source: If Aziure is killed you cannot accept the reward for this quest, so kill the Ice Elemental Shards before they can kill her.
63bc02db9db35e6efcc6398c001daa5ba31db3a9.text: 如果 Aziure 被殺死，您將無法接受此任務的獎勵，因此請在 冰元素 碎片殺死她之前殺死它們。
63bc02db9db35e6efcc6398c001daa5ba31db3a9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

77c34caa70139b7b740857b9c5872cd1579a089c.text: 解鎖第二職業的 元素使。
77c34caa70139b7b740857b9c5872cd1579a089c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6282e8fa43ea0e18602bff297cd6cd0bf0d288c4.source: Some players may find it worthwhile to repeatedly do the quest for experience and drops, zoning back to Foible's Fair, abandoning the quest and going back to Aziure. However, the Ice Elemental Shards are level 1 (compared to the standard level 3 Ice Elementals) and do not drop Icy Lodestones.
6282e8fa43ea0e18602bff297cd6cd0bf0d288c4.text: 有些玩家可能會發現重複進行經驗和掉落的任務是值得的，然後分割槽回 佛伊伯市集，放棄任務並返回 Aziure。然而，冰元素 碎片的等級為 1（與標準等級 3 冰元素相比），且不會掉落 冰凍 磁鐵。

d445f1ff054cdf604f87441b7427dd20ede4017f.source: If you are a ranged character of some sort, this quest is easy. Go west from Augury Rock to the teleporter near the Kree Minotaur. If you attack the Kree Minotaur from the raised area, it will not be able to reach you, although it will frequently run out of range for a short time. Melee characters will have to make a small detour to the north to get to the lower area that the Kree Minotaur patrols, or use the teleporter to cross the valley and take a shorter detour south. Be sure to pick up the Kree Minotaur Hide before you map travel back to Heroes' Audience to get the reward.

a2200e8acb6c95c90ee203722603836b07575b7d.source: The Temple sits atop the large hill in the center of the Fissure, and is guarded by some sizable groups of Shadow Army. It is possible to make them and nearby Skeleton Army groups aggro each other to weaken them. When the groups leading up to the Temple are dead, the gate will open. Inside are groups of Shadow Monks and Shadow Mesmers guarding the ramps to the central altar, with groups of Abyssals and Shadow Beasts patroling between them. Pull the first patrol to the door and away from the monks, then work your way around the Temple taking out one group at a time. Atop the central platform are Shadow Rangers and more Shadow Beasts. Clear these out and the Eternal Forgemaster will spawn with your reward.
a2200e8acb6c95c90ee203722603836b07575b7d.text: 神殿坐落在裂隙中心的一座大山頂上，由一些相當大的 暗影軍團 群體把守。可以讓他們和附近的 骷髏 軍團互相攻擊來削弱他們。當通往聖殿的隊伍全部死亡時，大門就會開啟。裡面有成群的 闇影 武僧和 闇影 幻術師守護著通往中央祭壇的坡道，成群的深淵人和 闇影 野獸在他們之間巡邏。 拉出 第一個巡邏隊到門口並遠離僧侶，然後繞著寺廟走，一次消滅一組。中央平臺頂部是 闇影 Rangers 和更多 闇影 Beasts。清除這些，永生的鍛造大師 將產生並附帶您的獎勵。

You may encounter some Bog Skale Blighters and will likely find some hidden Spined Aloes on the road, which should not be too hard to dispatch by themselves.

33ec68b4e24a57de03dae228af8ee4fc4cd3f086.source: You must defeat Abbot Ramoth, whereupon he will drop the Litanies of the Unseen. Ramoth is a skilled protector monk, so engaging him together with his warrior guards may be challenging for an unprepared party, though the party size of 8 available from the Temple of the Ages is a boon. Fortunately, Ramoth can be separated from the Justiciars, and their wide wandering range should make it easy to pull them. If you do end up fighting all of them together, focus on the Abbot; the Justiciars are hardy even without his support, and they do not have to be killed to complete the quest.
33ec68b4e24a57de03dae228af8ee4fc4cd3f086.text: 你必須擊敗 修道者拉模斯，然後他就會掉落未見之禱文。拉摩斯是一位熟練的保護僧侶，因此讓他與他的武士守衛一起戰鬥對於毫無準備的隊伍來說可能是一個挑戰，儘管 世紀神殿 提供的 8 的隊伍規模是一個福音。幸運的是，拉摩斯可以與審判者分開，而且他們的遊走範圍很廣，應該很容易拉動他們。如果你最終與他們所有人一起戰鬥，請專注於方丈；即使沒有他的支援，正義者們也很堅強，而且不需要殺死他們來完成任務。
33ec68b4e24a57de03dae228af8ee4fc4cd3f086.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4ead0ef046c225d21bede9add11bb5fb59a7c5a4.source: After talking to Ennis Granitestrider inside Sorrow's Furnace, Budger Blackpowder will accompany you. He will provide you with explosive Dwarven Powder Kegs, which will be used to blow up sealed doors inside this area (master gears won't work on the doors -- only on the bridge). Budger Blackpowder cannot die, and will not help out in battle. He does tend to stand in the middle of skirmishes, getting in your way, though. If you find he's gone missing, he may be stuck behind the crushing traps; run back and he should begin to follow you again when you're back within range.
4ead0ef046c225d21bede9add11bb5fb59a7c5a4.text: 與 悲傷熔爐 內的 艾尼斯崗石行者 交談後，巴哲黑火藥 將陪伴您。他將為你提供爆炸性矮人火藥桶，用於炸毀該區域內的密封門（主齒輪無法在門上工作——只能在橋上工作）。 巴哲黑火藥 不會死亡，也不會在戰鬥中提供協助。不過，他確實傾向於站在小衝突中間，妨礙你。如果你發現他失蹤了，他可能被困在陷阱後面；跑回去，當你回到射程範圍內時，他應該會再次開始跟隨你。

9567fe056b3d65be6e8acdd20c68177a9707bcca.source: You start at the upper left corner of the map, and your objective is to reach the lower right-hand corner. Most of the enemies you encounter along the way are not difficult to kill. Towards the end of the journey, there will be a few groups of enemies together — pull small groups to avoid getting the attention of all of them at once.
9567fe056b3d65be6e8acdd20c68177a9707bcca.text: 您從地圖的左上角開始，您的目標是到達右下角。一路上遇到的大多數敵人都不難殺死。在旅程的最後，將會有幾組敵人聚集在一起——拉成小隊以避免同時引起所有人的注意。
9567fe056b3d65be6e8acdd20c68177a9707bcca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7a47298e23b0b00f7fd08e2e61cca42e96571fbf.source: You'll find The Iron Forgeman in a walled area surrounded by a number of guards. There are three Rage Binders accompanied by two Furnace Guardians, and one roaming Stone Summit patrol. In addition, while you are inside the walled area, The Iron Forgeman will dump lava on your group and hit you with a wrecking ball if you are stationary.
7a47298e23b0b00f7fd08e2e61cca42e96571fbf.text: 您會在一個被許多守衛包圍的圍牆區域中找到 鋼鐵巨人。共有三名憤怒束縛者、兩名熔爐守護者和一名漫遊 石峰矮人 巡邏隊。此外，當您處於圍牆區域內時，鋼鐵巨人 會向您的團隊傾倒熔岩，並在您靜止不動時用破壞球擊中您。
7a47298e23b0b00f7fd08e2e61cca42e96571fbf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1302515b19f7f7b9e644b7d19e0cba5074b90a0e.source: The easiest method is to take your time, and eliminate each group of Furnace Guardians first, and then the patrol.
1302515b19f7f7b9e644b7d19e0cba5074b90a0e.text: 最簡單的方法就是慢慢來，先消滅每一組守爐者，再消滅巡邏隊。
1302515b19f7f7b9e644b7d19e0cba5074b90a0e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

84b1f44feb65c1122afaa7dd48f26f26260011df.source: There will be three Rage Binders left. When you kill one, it will respawn in about 30-45 seconds. You have to kill all three of them in a short amount of time. With a group of human players, this is fairly easy since you can split up into two teams. With heroes/henchmen only, it will be harder. You may have to race around the circle killing them as fast as you can. A speed boost can be handy, as can interrupt for the Life Siphon that the Rage Binders use.
84b1f44feb65c1122afaa7dd48f26f26260011df.text: 將會剩下三個憤怒束縛者。當你殺死一個時，它會在大約 30-45 秒內重生。你必須在短時間內殺死他們三個。對於一群人類玩家來說，這相當容易，因為你可以分成兩隊。只有英雄/追隨者，事情會更困難。你可能必須繞圈跑，盡快殺死他們。速度提升可以很方便，就像可以中斷憤怒繫結者使用的 吸取生命 一樣。
84b1f44feb65c1122afaa7dd48f26f26260011df.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

35b49b10a2ddfda19aeec8379aa6cc27f83b74d0.source: Don't kill the first one with slow-recharging skills, since there is no hurry killing the first. Your skills can better serve defeating the second.
35b49b10a2ddfda19aeec8379aa6cc27f83b74d0.text: 不要用慢充技能殺死第一個，因為沒有急於殺死第一個的能力。你的技能可以更好地幫助擊敗第二個。
35b49b10a2ddfda19aeec8379aa6cc27f83b74d0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a17794907506b4213048a51c63300c8701c63707.source: It may be possible to damage one of the Rage Binders, and then move on to the second. In this way, the first will be killed faster when you come back to it.
a17794907506b4213048a51c63300c8701c63707.text: 可能會損壞其中一個憤怒束縛者，然後繼續攻擊第二個。這樣一來，當你再回來的時候，第一個就會被殺得更快。
a17794907506b4213048a51c63300c8701c63707.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c51d6cfc51ce4326e5bc56d725f5de19dbd9cdce.source: Experienced players with heroes/henchmen can flag your heroes around one Rage Binder to keep it killed, while you and the henchmen kill the other 2 Rage Binders.
c51d6cfc51ce4326e5bc56d725f5de19dbd9cdce.text: 經驗豐富的英雄/追隨者玩家可以在一個憤怒束縛者周圍標記你的英雄以使其被殺死，而你和追隨者則殺死其他 2 憤怒束縛者。
c51d6cfc51ce4326e5bc56d725f5de19dbd9cdce.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4fe0dddfa6491124fa1fbeed99a60bf3b5eb9eb9.source: Alternatively, if using a full party of heroes, you can kill the middle Rage Binder first then flag half of your heroes to one of the remaining Rage Binders and accompany half to the other, if your builds are good enough they should easily kill both in time.
4fe0dddfa6491124fa1fbeed99a60bf3b5eb9eb9.text: 或者，如果使用一整隊英雄，你可以先殺死中間的憤怒束縛者，然後將一半的英雄標記為剩餘的憤怒束縛者之一，並陪伴另一半英雄，如果你的構建足夠好，他們應該很容易及時殺死兩者。
4fe0dddfa6491124fa1fbeed99a60bf3b5eb9eb9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e1c88dc596b334b948cf765865f9f9807a11dca3.source: When you have killed all three you will get to see a cut-scene.
e1c88dc596b334b948cf765865f9f9807a11dca3.text: 當你殺死三個人後，你會看到一個過場動畫。

e7c0a411f344726844e5be370481b400946cd6b3.source: There will now be three Flame Djinn in the circle. You most certainly don't want to aggro all of them at the same time, so get back out of the circle quickly to regenerate. Pull one of them at a time outside the circle and interrupt the Consuming Flames skill to kill it faster. Even with a large Death Penalty it shouldn't be too big of a problem to kill one of them.
e7c0a411f344726844e5be370481b400946cd6b3.text: 現在圓圈中將出現三個火焰 巨靈怪。你一定不想同時攻擊所有的人，所以要快速退出圈子來恢復。 拉出 在圓圈外一次保護其中一個並打斷消耗火焰技能以更快地殺死它。就算是重重的死刑，殺掉一個也不是太大的問題。
e7c0a411f344726844e5be370481b400946cd6b3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1f19184c8210fe57cbeb8c8ec61ea45d8cf4628b.source: Pain Inverter is highly effective if used when the Flame Djinn is using Consuming Flames resulting in it losing almost half of its health if 5 party members are next to it.
1f19184c8210fe57cbeb8c8ec61ea45d8cf4628b.text: 如果在火焰 巨靈怪 使用消耗火焰時使用 苦痛 逆變器，則非常有效，如果 5 隊伍成員在其旁邊，則會導致其失去幾乎一半的生命值。
1f19184c8210fe57cbeb8c8ec61ea45d8cf4628b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6c2498e20966306bd75576cc2ab3784ae27eb5ef.source: If there are two Djinn stuck together, keep trying to pull one of them away from the other one. There's a resurrection shrine nearby, so you have all the time in the world. Some parties can probably kill two djinn at the same time, but with a large death penalty it will not work. But even with a full death penalty, a minion master can mitigate a large amount of damage from the djinns.
6c2498e20966306bd75576cc2ab3784ae27eb5ef.text: 如果有兩個 巨靈怪 卡在一起，請繼續嘗試將其中一個與另一個分開。附近有一個復活神社，所以你有充足的時間。有些隊伍可能可以同時殺死兩個巨靈，但如果有大量的死亡懲罰，那就行不通了。但即使受到完全死亡的懲罰，小兵大師也可以減輕巨靈的大量傷害。
6c2498e20966306bd75576cc2ab3784ae27eb5ef.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

The initial group consists of Margonite Anur mixed with Tortureweb Dryders. After these are destroyed, the new spawns include Tortureweb Dryders mixed with Greater Dream Riders.
d2542c6d74608cc3ace345124f6269e782d1c7a0.text: 密室 2：這個密室可能很難戰鬥，因為它的尺寸沒有留下迴旋的空間。第一組由 瑪骨奈 Anur 與 Tortureweb Dryders 混合組成。這些被摧毀後，新的生成物包括折磨網乾燥者與偉大的夢想騎士的混合。

fc502363325cc4c44abb30f021d20b9b943a277f.source: Chamber 3: This room has only a single spawn, but it includes four patrols: four Anguish Titans; four Rage Titans; four Misery Titans; and three Tortureweb Dryders with a single Greater Dream Rider. When the titans die, they will spawn lesser titans (Anguish → Despair → Fury; Misery → Rage → Dementia). Each patrol covers the full perimeter of the room, so it is very difficult to pull just a single group unless you stand in the far corner and are very careful. Positioning is extremely important in this room, both to avoid over-aggro, and to minimize the harm from powerful AoE spells. Once the initial enemies are dead, the door to the next room will open.
fc502363325cc4c44abb30f021d20b9b943a277f.text: Chamber 3：這個房間只有一個重生點，但它包括四個巡邏隊：四個 苦惱 泰坦；四個憤怒泰坦；四個苦難泰坦；以及三個 Tortureweb Dryders 和一個 Great Dream Rider。當泰坦死亡時，它們會產生較小的泰坦（苦惱 → 絕望 → 憤怒；痛苦 → 憤怒 → 痴呆）。每個巡邏隊都會覆蓋房間的整個週邊，因此很難只拉動一個小組，除非你站在遠處的角落並且非常小心。在這個房間裡，走位非常重要，既可以避免過度仇恨，又可以最大限度地減少強大的 範圍性 法術的傷害。一旦最初的敵人死亡，下一個房間的門就會開啟。
fc502363325cc4c44abb30f021d20b9b943a277f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

Then make the long trek across the Arkjok Ward through Pogahn Passage across the Dejarin Estate to Camp Hojanu and then finally to the Barbarous Shore. Find Ruthless Sevad with a group of corsairs in the Barbarous Shore. After talking to him, the corsairs will become hostile. Defeat them, and return to Zudash to collect your reward.
630a0ea90d697fcdff13c18f1c2dedb3119c6c7b.text: 首先在 猶朗避難所 中與 Zudash Dejarin 交談。然後長途跋涉，穿過 阿爾科監禁區、波甘驛站，穿過 Dejarin Estate，到達 何加努營地，最後到達 野蠻河岸。在 野蠻河岸 中找到無情的塞瓦德和一群海盜。與他交談後，海盜們就會變得敵對。擊敗他們，然後返回祖達什領取獎勵。

8d7d007d1cbaa00eacbd30f2c1f33cfd74269fd0.source: Each earth shrine can be found in relation to the massive crater in the northern part of the Pockmark Flats. The first earth shrine is north of the crater, the second shrine is to the west of the crater, and the third shrine is south of the crater.

The Stone Golem spawns by itself, but there are several earth elemental patrols around its position. Stone Golem can be seen from the southern earth shrine.
1a1ca3b5dcf16a17aa55198b37e6307545623d92.text: 當所有三個神殿都放置了 燒焦的磁石 後，石高崙 將出現在火山口的東南方。 石高崙 會自行生成，但在其位置周圍有幾個土元素巡邏隊。從南土神殿可以看到石高崙。

06f2c4c0ff3d55548df4164d9fae368d98f2d6dd.source: After obtaining the quest from Annelle Fipps in Destiny's Gorge, you can take one of two paths. You can take the northern exit at Destiny's Gorge and travel south through Skyward Reach. After a while, you will arrive at a teleporter which you will need to activate to continue south and then west where you will find Sariss Yassith. Alternatively you can map travel to Augury Rock, take the northern exit and travel south through Skyward Reach and then east to Sariss Yassith. The alternate route is a bit shorter, but takes you past a few groups of Hydra. Once you arrive at Sariss' location, simply speak to him to receive your reward.
06f2c4c0ff3d55548df4164d9fae368d98f2d6dd.text: 在命運峽谷中從安娜麗菲思中取得任務後，您可以選擇兩條路徑之一。您可以從 命運峽谷 的北出口出發，然後經由 天際流域 往南行駛。過了一會兒，你將到達一個傳送器，你需要啟動它才能繼續向南，然後向西，在那裡你會找到 塞利司亞西斯。或者，您也可以在地圖上前往 占卜之石，從北出口向南行駛穿過 天際流域，然後向東行駛至 塞利司亞西斯。替代路線稍微短一些，但會帶您經過幾組 三頭龍。到達薩里斯的位置後，只需與他交談即可獲得獎勵。

fb580043be0a7a8e8be47bf29219900f2d8e7b77.source: Clear the four chambers leading to the foundry. After all party members step past the tentacles to enter a chamber, the tentacles will close behind them and the party will be locked inside; this also triggers the initial spawn of foes. The tentacles will not open again until all the monsters in the chamber have been destroyed. In three of the four chambers, additional group(s) spawn after the first group is killed.
fb580043be0a7a8e8be47bf29219900f2d8e7b77.text: 清理通往鑄造廠的四個房間。當所有小隊成員跨過觸手進入房間後，觸手會在他們身後閉合，小隊將被鎖在裡面；這也會觸發敵人的初始生成。直到房間裡的所有怪物都被消滅之前，觸手才會再次張開。在四個房間中的三個中，第一組被殺死後會產生額外的組。

Also:

e0d9f5d7529939e3546e28745b0409f9411c9797.source: When the quest is taken, the seven Shard Wolves will spawn scattered about the Fissure. There will be a Shard Wolf in each of the major areas surrounding the Temple, with the exception of the Lake of Fire. The Shard Wolves can be killed in conjunction with exploring or doing other quests in the Fissure. When the last Shard Wolf is dead, return to Nimros the Hunter for your reward.
e0d9f5d7529939e3546e28745b0409f9411c9797.text: 完成任務後，七隻碎片狼會分散在裂縫周圍生成。除了火湖之外，聖殿周圍的每個主要區域都會有一個碎片 狼。碎片狼可以在探索裂縫或執行其他任務時被殺死。當最後一個碎片 狼 死亡後，返回獵人尼姆羅斯那裡領取獎勵。

a3386e82c5f7b8262ba1557dc2d3e79fceb18406.text: 確保所有玩家在殺死第一隻狼之前接受任務，否則他們可能會失去 10,000 xp 任務獎勵（但是，他們仍然會因為完成狩獵作為十一個任務目標之一而獲得積分）。

5085c1a991159c50bf071f2cc70c3255ac8cd6ca.source: After receiving the quest from Chantalle head southeast towards Regent Valley. Once you travel through the portal into Regent Valley start heading south towards the healing spring. This quest has a lot of running across long distances, so make sure your character will survive the journey. At the Healing Spring there are River Skale, Black Bears, Wolves, and all around are Grawl, so when doing the quest make sure you take your time and kill everybody on the way.
5085c1a991159c50bf071f2cc70c3255ac8cd6ca.text: 收到尚塔勒的任務後，向東南方向前往 統治者之谷。一旦你穿過傳送門進入 統治者之谷，就開始往南前往療癒之泉。這個任務需要大量的長途奔跑，所以要確保你的角色能夠在旅途中倖存下來。在 治癒之泉 有 河鱗怪、黑熊、狼，周圍都是 穴居人，所以在做任務時一定要花點時間殺死路上的所有人。

bab898a8449a2dd4db7721852faa1791409efd7d.source: Follow your updated quest marker west to the entrance to Wizard's Folly. There, travel west along the river until you come to a fishing village, then go south and loop east, where you will find Aidan. Talk to him and get your reward.
bab898a8449a2dd4db7721852faa1791409efd7d.text: 沿著更新後的任務標記向西前往 巫師的怪異建築 的入口。在那裡，沿著河流向西行駛，直到您到達一個漁村，然後向南並向東環行，在那裡您會找到 艾登。與他交談並獲得獎勵。

0ff02f296392713026d9f58b14c21a0f137ee8ee.source: Enter through the nearby portal into Rragar's Menagerie located in Sacnoth Valley South-West corner. You do not need the quest Veiled Threat that is otherwise needed for the dungeon, as the foes are found in the first room. Pick up the blessing from the Beacon of Droknar and go straight ahead to the mob that you can clearly see with the two melee bosses in. It is a good idea to take out the Flameshielders first as they deal the most damage here. After you have killed the small mob, map travel to Longeye's Ledge and exit into Grothmar Wardowns and speak to Captain Langmar for your reward.
0ff02f296392713026d9f58b14c21a0f137ee8ee.text: 透過附近的門戶進入位於 聖諾谷 西南角的 拉喀的牢籠。您不需要地牢中需要的任務“隱藏的威脅”，因為敵人是在第一個房間中找到的。接受卓克納爾信標的祝福，然後徑直走到怪物那裡，你可以清楚地看到裡面有兩個近戰 Boss。最好先乾掉火焰護盾者，因為他們在這裡造成的傷害最大。殺死小怪後，在地圖上前往 長眼巖脈 並退出格羅斯瑪戰區並與 隊長連瑪 交談以獲得獎勵。

defac5a4c6611216297565e980c342df2bdfe20d.text: 每個 夏爾 群組中都有一個 Prophet 和一個 夏爾避燃者。因此，完成此任務的最簡單方法（僅限英雄和追隨者）是從 末日傳說神殿 開始並控制駐紮在前哨站外的圍攻 蠍。

9331064b7f99236f054ac893c6c8e2486dabf1b5.text: 從 利拜亞森礦場 出發，向北進入 蓋拉孵化所，芝諾斯和船員們就在外面等候。不幸的是，在船員們加入他之前，芝諾斯無法滿足他們的任何要求或要求，所以只有芝諾斯和他的隊伍正在進行怪物狩獵！

15e5323db2ccb1ad1e4abed8f6d80be26085b438.source: It does not matter if Zenos dies before you get to the Impossible Sea Monster, since once you kill it the quest will finish anyway and you will be able to get your reward from Po Fang.

2e1498d9346bf1b56fc12f8fdd8952bbbc27af09.text: 沒有接受/拒絕對話，因為當您收到前面的任務獎勵時，該任務會自動新增到您的任務日誌中。

2c4d545e8bf37ad0f997c02093509434f511dc97.text: 如果您在收到任務後放棄該任務，這也適用；如果您與海豚交談，它會立即重新新增到您的任務日誌中，而無需任何對話。

6eacd94c16813564615475c7c8585b35b28f4ec8.text: 如果芝諾斯在最初的對話結束之前死亡，任務就會凍結，你必須重新分配區域才能繼續。
6eacd94c16813564615475c7c8585b35b28f4ec8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

44b7018c858829426ff3c53fad6b330701cf2979.source: There is an intermediate dialogue that most players miss, after you have killed the monster with Zenos still alive. The problem is that, as a low level NPC, Zenos almost always dies before you get even close to the monster. One way around this, literally, is to enter Gyala Hatchery from Rhea's Crater and then kill all the enemies between Zenos and the The Impossible Sea Monster, being careful to not kill the monster itself or getting too close to Zenos so he won't follow you. Once everyone is dead, go get Zenos and bring him to the monster - after killing it, you'll see the last intermediate dialogue.
44b7018c858829426ff3c53fad6b330701cf2979.text: 當你在芝諾斯還活著的情況下殺死怪物後，大多數玩家都會錯過中間對話。問題是，作為一個低等級的 NPC，芝諾斯幾乎總是在你接近怪物之前就死了。從字面上看，解決這個問題的一種方法是從 席亞火山口 進入 蓋拉孵化所，然後殺死芝諾斯和不可能之海 怪物 之間的所有敵人，小心不要殺死怪物本身或離芝諾斯太近，這樣他就不會跟著你。一旦所有人都死了，去找芝諾斯並把他帶到怪物那裡 - 殺死怪物後，你會看到最後的中間對話。

c3f78b1f97de06b684578871fcd5cd78d2cc2bf6.source: Ideally, come from the south, keeping east of Adelbern's trigger circle. Kill the eastern-most group first. Work your way counter-clockwise for groups 2 and 3. For the last of the northern groups, use only one hero to pull them closer to you by carefully flagging the hero, while keeping the rest of your party back with you. As soon as the hero gets attacked, pull them back to you. If the hero should die, use another hero to ressurect them. Finally, backtrack towards the 5th and last group to the crossroad. Careful pulling should also be used for enemies between you and the last group.
c3f78b1f97de06b684578871fcd5cd78d2cc2bf6.text: 理想情況下，從南邊過來，保持在阿德爾伯恩觸發圈的東邊。先殺掉最東邊的那群。對於 2 和 3 群組，以逆時針方向工作。對於最後的北方團體，只使用一名英雄，小心地標記該英雄，將他們拉近你的距離，同時讓你的隊伍的其他成員留在你身邊。一旦英雄受到攻擊，就將他們拉回你身邊。如果英雄死了，請用另一個英雄來復活他們。最後，原路返回 5 和最後一組，到達十字路口。對於你和最後一組之間的敵人也應該小心拉動。
c3f78b1f97de06b684578871fcd5cd78d2cc2bf6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c25c2557f58efbdaf53ed6c418560bc8a220f195.source: From Farmer Dirk, you have to travel South. The prize winning hog is a bit South of the entrance to Nebo Terrace. At the junction to the Nebo Terrace entrance, four groups of two level 15 Gypsie Ettins will appear. Once these are killed, you need to chase the hog back to Farmer Dirk, approaching it from the south so that it runs north. If it gets stuck along the sides of the path, back off a bit and wait for it to move out enough that you can redirect it. You don't have to get the hog into the pen, just as far as Farmer Dirk. When the path splits into two with the big tree in the middle, try to avoid letting the hog near the tree where it can get stuck when it moves through the tree. If this happens you have to rezone and start over again.
c25c2557f58efbdaf53ed6c418560bc8a220f195.text: 從 農夫德克 出發，您必須向南行駛。獲獎豬位於 尼伯山丘 入口稍南的位置。在 尼伯山丘 入口的交界處，將出現四組兩層 15 吉普賽·埃廷斯。一旦它們被殺死，你需要把豬追回 農夫德克，從南邊接近它，讓它向北跑。如果它卡在路徑兩側，請後退一點，等待它移出足夠的距離，以便您可以重新引導它。您不必將豬放入豬欄，只要使用 農夫德克 即可。當路徑分成兩部分並且中間有大樹時，盡量避免讓豬靠近樹，因為它在穿過樹時可能會被卡住。如果發生這種情況，您必須重新分割並重新開始。

There are many foes nearby: Torment creatures, Torment Claws, Terrorweb Dryders, Grasp of Insanities and Scythe of Chaos. Avoid over-aggro and proceed with caution (pulls, watch minions).
84f882e02e7a8d65485c992479c99eb0464b5481.text: 任務的目標是殺死三隻在 苦痛之地隘口 附近進行儀式的 介面 幽靈。附近有許多敵人：折磨生物、折磨爪、恐網烘乾機、瘋狂之握和混沌 鐮刀。避免過度仇恨並謹慎行事（拉動，觀察小兵）。

ab1f77b4544c12d0067cb07c20a3b7176b166485.source: [Incomplete source section] After accepting the quest, head out into Mehtani Keys and talk to Rahlon. The objective is to kill the Sneaky Corsair waiting on the small island nearby. However, when you approach, he will run away, and if he runs too far the quest will fail. It is difficult to catch the corsair, even with speed boosts and snares, mainly because you will be slowed down by other foes along the way. One of the easiest ways to complete the quest is to cut a wide path around him as shown in the map above and approach from the other side. He will start running towards you, giving you plenty of time to use a snare and kill him. Bringing ranged attackers can help to finish the runner if he slips through your initial attack.
ab1f77b4544c12d0067cb07c20a3b7176b166485.text: [不完整的原始碼部分] 接受任務後，前往 梅坦尼之鑰 並與 Rahlon 交談。目標是殺死在附近小島上等待的狡猾的 海盜。然而，當你靠近時，他就會逃跑，如果他跑得太遠，任務就會失敗。即使有速度提升和陷阱，也很難抓住海盜船，主要是因為沿途的其他敵人會減慢你的速度。完成任務的最簡單方法之一是在他周圍開闢一條寬闊的路徑，如上圖所示，然後從另一側接近。他會開始跑向你，給你足夠的時間使用陷阱並殺死他。如果跑動者躲過了你最初的攻擊，帶上遠端攻擊者可以幫助他完成任務。
ab1f77b4544c12d0067cb07c20a3b7176b166485.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a36cc0d76b07e9826ec63f1c9576edbce18e2730.source: You can simply kill the corsair after he reaches his destination if you haven't talked to Rahlon, and then talk to Rahlon (after killing the Sneaky Corsair) to get your reward.
a36cc0d76b07e9826ec63f1c9576edbce18e2730.text: 如果你還沒有與 Rahlon 交談，你可以在海盜到達目的地後殺死他，然後與 Rahlon 交談（殺死 Sneaky 海盜 後）以獲得獎勵。

7684cde06ec9f929a533ddfee2d5b2b3bd185e34.source: Another possibility is to clear the island as mentioned and then station your heroes and henchmen (if any) on a pass which he takes, such as a bridge. The corsair will follow his route and run right to your heroes and henchmen.
7684cde06ec9f929a533ddfee2d5b2b3bd185e34.text: 另一種可能性是如上所述清理島嶼，然後將你的英雄和追隨者（如果有的話）駐紮在他所採取的通道上，例如橋梁。海盜船將沿著他的路線直奔你的英雄和追隨者。
7684cde06ec9f929a533ddfee2d5b2b3bd185e34.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a149902a57ab8b4c21cbbc36d370f58810281004.source: Invite at least one player or henchman to your party before stepping through the portal into Old Ascalon. Head straight east toward a small Krytan camp ahead. Beware of the two Devourers that pop up from the ground next to the bridge if you get too close to them. If you're a warrior, you can easily pick up quests from Warmaster Grast who is on the route of this quest (just past the bridge).
a149902a57ab8b4c21cbbc36d370f58810281004.text: 在通過門戶進入之前，請至少邀請一名玩家或追隨者加入您的隊伍 舊阿斯卡隆 。直向東前往前方的一個小型科瑞塔營地。小心這兩個 蠍 如果你離它們太近，它們就會從橋旁邊的地面上彈出。如果你是一名戰士，你可以輕鬆地接到任務 戰鬥教官葛拉斯特 誰在這個任務的路線上（剛剛過了橋）。
a149902a57ab8b4c21cbbc36d370f58810281004.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

66fd155ae425bfc234b8f5a9655b377ef39bac23.source: This objective becomes active again if you leave your group at any point in the future. You must face Ambassador Zain in a group if you wish to proceed with the quest.

573f4a954c1be0400a5e7130d6c126823f447599.source: Because of the high level charr and low level henchmen, it is best to either go with other players or with heroes. Also, due to the small party size, the party must be well balanced.
573f4a954c1be0400a5e7130d6c126823f447599.text: 由於高等級的夏爾和低等級的追隨者，最好要麼與其他玩家一起去，要麼與英雄一起去。此外，由於政黨規模較小，政黨必須保持良好的平衡。
573f4a954c1be0400a5e7130d6c126823f447599.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

465984fbc86c77c03c50bd24982bbebbb30c6849.source: The quest itself is straightforward. Walk out the gate and a short distance (through a few Charr groups) to find King Adelbern, one Adelbern's Priest and two Adelbern's Guards rushing towards a group of Charr. They are low level Charr and no threat, but after the elimination of that group the Armageddon Lords will start to arrive, one at a time. Each one will be accompanied with some regular Charr and some Charr lords. The groups increase in difficulty; at first there will be only one Charr lord, then two, then two including a healer and then three Charr lords. The final group will have two Armageddon Lords together.
465984fbc86c77c03c50bd24982bbebbb30c6849.text: 任務本身很簡單。走出大門，走了一小段距離（穿過幾個 夏爾 隊伍），發現國王 Adelbern、一名 Adelbern 牧師和兩名 Adelbern 守衛衝向一群 夏爾。他們是低等級的 夏爾 並且沒有威脅，但在消滅該團體後，世界末日領主將開始到來，一次一個。每一位都會伴隨一些常規 夏爾 和一些 夏爾 領主。各組難度增加；一開始只有一個 夏爾 領主，然後是兩個，然後兩個，包括一個治療者，然後是三個 夏爾 領主。最後一組將有兩位世界末日領主在一起。
465984fbc86c77c03c50bd24982bbebbb30c6849.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4790a868300fd32dfb5b2ab3767378f551039722.source: In general, you need to watch the composition of the incoming enemies. If there are any Spark of the Titans, take them down as fast as you can; they have the potential to deal a large amount of damage to the party. Next on the list are the Charr Lord casters — Charr Shaman Lord, Charr Flame Lord, Charr Mind Lord, and Charr Ashen Lord. Turn your attention to any Charr Axe Lords and Charr Stalker Lords before tackling the Armageddon Lord. You can pretty much ignore the regular level 8 or 9 Charr, as they usually die to any AoE damage when you're attacking the Charr Lords.
4790a868300fd32dfb5b2ab3767378f551039722.text: 一般來說，你需要觀察來襲敵人的組成。如果有任何 泰坦火花，請盡快將其取下；他們有可能對政黨造成大量損害。清單中的下一個是 夏爾 Lord 施法者 - 夏爾巫醫 Lord、夏爾 Flame Lord、夏爾 Mind Lord 和 夏爾 Ashen Lord。在處理 末日領主 之前，請將注意力轉向任何 夏爾 斧 領主和 夏爾潛行者 領主。您幾乎可以忽略常規級別的 8 或 9 夏爾，因為當您攻擊 夏爾 領主時，它們通常會因任何 範圍性 傷害而死亡。
4790a868300fd32dfb5b2ab3767378f551039722.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

220459f2517963b09b5ed47fa8e7ec0314d05f57.source: Another strategy is to kill the Sparks, the Armageddon and their spawns, avoiding killing one or two Charr casters, who do considerably less damage. Since the next enemy wave won't approach until all the charr in the previous group are dead, by keeping them alive you can buy some time to heal and regenerate energy with little pressure before facing a new wave.
220459f2517963b09b5ed47fa8e7ec0314d05f57.text: 另一個策略是殺死火花、世界末日及其衍生體，避免殺死一兩個 夏爾 施法者，因為他們造成的傷害要小得多。由於只有前一組中的所有夏爾都死了，下一波敵人才會接近，透過讓他們活著，你可以在面對新一波之前以較小的壓力贏得一些時間來治療和再生能量。
220459f2517963b09b5ed47fa8e7ec0314d05f57.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5d3b44000ec62d85c56ef9377dea4376c02b1f02.source: Always attempt to intercept the incoming groups well ahead of King Adelbern and always protect Adelbern's Priest. Losing the priest ally will most assuredly put too much pressure on the single monk in the party.
5d3b44000ec62d85c56ef9377dea4376c02b1f02.text: 始終嘗試在阿德爾伯恩國王之前攔截即將到來的部隊，並始終保護阿德爾伯恩的牧師。失去牧師盟友肯定會給隊伍中的單一僧侶帶來太大的壓力。
5d3b44000ec62d85c56ef9377dea4376c02b1f02.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

260e24b02351c152b7770642062c0ea8be6cbfa4.source: If possible, bring cold damage. Cold damage deals heavy damage against the Titans.
260e24b02351c152b7770642062c0ea8be6cbfa4.text: 如果可能的話，帶來寒冷傷害。 冰凍傷害 對泰坦造成嚴重傷害。
260e24b02351c152b7770642062c0ea8be6cbfa4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

025eb1ca1a597fdce29915c536fca9ca6230d8d9.source: Bringing Winter is a better alternative as Adelbern and his guards use Fiery Dragon Swords.
025eb1ca1a597fdce29915c536fca9ca6230d8d9.text: 帶上 寒冬 是更好的選擇，因為阿德爾伯恩和他的守衛使用 火焰 龍劍。
025eb1ca1a597fdce29915c536fca9ca6230d8d9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ca95d0760d38aefa31b655e095d0d18c4f0ade5a.source: Likewise, Area of Effect skills like traps are helpful as the groups are often close together and come from the same direction.
ca95d0760d38aefa31b655e095d0d18c4f0ade5a.text: 同樣，陷阱等效果區域技能也很有幫助，因為隊伍通常距離很近並且來自同一方向。
ca95d0760d38aefa31b655e095d0d18c4f0ade5a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

57c822c7cd3d5fe1163e7a9e6fee6b8311607494.source: One last possibility is to again, clear the island as mentioned above, and then go talk to Rahlon (it doesn't really matter if you talk to him or not, really, because of how slow he and his group run). As you approach the Corsair, he'll begin running; just keep after him, and if you haven't equipped any sprint skills, don't worry- just cut as many corners as you can while doing this. You should finally be able to catch him about halfway through the explorable area, and kill him easily, before making your way back to Rahlon for your reward. If you should happen to run right by Rahlon's volunteer group at some point after killing the corsair, you'll notice that, even though they are all standing there, they're perfectly lined up with one another- giving the effect of there being just one man standing there.
57c822c7cd3d5fe1163e7a9e6fee6b8311607494.text: 最後一種可能性是再次按照上面提到的方式清理島嶼，然後去與拉隆交談（你是否與他交談並不重要，真的，因為他和他的團隊跑得有多慢）。當您接近 海盜 時，他會開始奔跑；只要跟在他後面，如果你沒有配備任何衝刺技能，別擔心——在這樣做的時候盡可能多地走捷徑。你最終應該能夠在可探索區域的一半左右抓住他，並輕鬆殺死他，然後返回拉隆以獲得獎勵。如果你在殺死海盜後的某個時刻碰巧跑到拉隆的志願者隊伍旁邊，你會注意到，儘管他們都站在那裡，但他們彼此完美地排成一排——給人一種只有一個人站在那裡的效果。
57c822c7cd3d5fe1163e7a9e6fee6b8311607494.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a9cbd912de6029552d06230879b97520a70b00b8.source: The travel from Fisherman's Haven to Temple of the Ages requires crossing four explorable areas. The starting outpost provides level 15 henchmen and a party size of six. The whole journey may seem to be a long trip, but it is actually quite quick as there are only a few foes in the way in each area. The only instances that need careful engagement are where there are different types of creatures standing close together, and skale groups with a Grand Drake. Consider hex removal since the Bog Skales use numerous hexes.
a9cbd912de6029552d06230879b97520a70b00b8.text: 從漁人港到 世紀神殿 的旅程需要穿越四個可探索區域。起始前哨站提供 15 等級的追隨者和六人隊伍。整個旅程看似漫長，但其實很快，因為每個區域的敵人都只有幾個。唯一需要仔細參與的情況是不同型別的生物站在一起，以及帶有 強龍獸 的骷髏群體。考慮去除六角形，因為沼澤斯卡萊斯使用大量六角形。
a9cbd912de6029552d06230879b97520a70b00b8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

71cf3dae06e1d06e506beaacbc2d4038997cb992.source: This route also crosses four explorable areas: North Kryta Province, Nebo Terrace, the Cursed Lands, and the Black Curtain. However, the henchmen are only level 10, and there is significantly more fighting along the way. It is advisable to unlock Bergen Hot Springs on the way and gain level 12 henchmen; if you have already been to that outpost, you can start there to skip North Kryta Province and half of Nebo Terrace. Be careful crossing the Cursed Lands, since many of the undead groups are close together, and head northwest to the northern portal leading to the Black Curtain. Be prepared for frequent applications of poison and crippled.
71cf3dae06e1d06e506beaacbc2d4038997cb992.text: 這條路線也穿過四個可探索區域：科瑞塔北部、尼伯山丘、詛咒之地 和黑幕。然而，追隨者的等級只有 10，而且一路上的戰鬥明顯較多。建議在途中解鎖卑爾根溫泉並獲得12追隨者等級；如果您已經去過該前哨站，則可以從那裡開始跳過 科瑞塔北部 和 尼伯山丘 的一半。穿過 詛咒之地 時要小心，因為許多不死族群都靠得很近，並向西北方向前往通往黑幕的北部傳送門。做好頻繁使用毒藥和致殘的準備。
71cf3dae06e1d06e506beaacbc2d4038997cb992.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

27d23787ff0758dc72327f6e0ede317dcf18a7ad.source: This is easiest to accomplish leaving Elona Reach. Hug the south wall, moving to the teleporters, and continue eastward, hugging the north wall to where it makes a sharp northward turn, then straight out to the end of the area. The Tempest Drakes are immediately north of this position, and will not separate from their mob. Area of effect skills and some hit and run tactics will easily defeat all three very quickly. After the going through teleporter, if you do not hug the north wall, there is a good chance that you will aggro the Sand Wurm which dwells in the middle of this explorable area.
27d23787ff0758dc72327f6e0ede317dcf18a7ad.text: 離開 伊洛那流域 後，這是最容易完成的。擁抱南牆，移動到傳送器，然後繼續向東，擁抱北牆，直到它急劇向北轉向，然後徑直到達該區域的盡頭。暴風龍龍就在這個位置的北面，不會與他們的暴徒分開。範圍技能和一些打了就跑的戰術將很容易很快地擊敗這三個人。通過傳送器後，如果你不緊貼北牆，你很有可能會攻擊居住在這個可探索區域中間的沙巨蟲。

When Ke Feng's health is low he will turn friendly and the actual quest can be accepted from him. Travel to Kaineng Center and talk to Shae Wong. Return to the Undercity and go to Ke Feng's location. As you approach him Noqui will pop up in front of him and kill him. Kill Noqui.
605d5dd042d02ca3eaaa592c69eaae6285987df9.text: 該任務是透過與寶森對話觸發的。 Ke Feng 和幾位 翡翠兄弟會 成員將會出現。當柯峰的生命值較低時，他會變得友好，並且可以從他那裡接受實際的任務。前往 凱寧中心 並與 Shae Wong 交談。 影返 前往幽暗城並前往柯峰所在的位置。當你接近他時，諾基會突然出現在他面前並殺死他。殺死諾基。

c02e9dc2da65fafe02bc57b22fb101d27b372618.source: Start from the Gate of Torment, pick up the Monolith bounty for the single monolith you'll encounter. Make your way directly to the quest marker, you will not encounter any groups apart from those surrounding Yithlis. Though appearing to be an easy quest, it can become complicated by the outnumbering spawns and nearby patrols. Try to clear the area of hostile groups (especially patrols) before approaching Captain Yithlis (entering aggro range will add his group to the party window and will spawn a group coming to attack you from the direction of the Gate of Torment). Do not talk to Captain Yithlis until all nearby attacking mobs have been defeated. After defeating the attacking groups, you can pick up the nearby Torment Bounty to the west.
c02e9dc2da65fafe02bc57b22fb101d27b372618.text: 從 苦痛之門 開始，為您將遇到的單一巨石領取巨石賞金。直接前往任務標記，除了伊斯利斯周圍的人之外，你不會遇到任何團體。雖然看起來是一個簡單的任務，但由於數量過多和附近的巡邏，它可能會變得複雜。在接近 Yithlis 隊長之前，試著清除該區域的敵對隊伍（尤其是巡邏隊）（進入仇恨範圍會將他的隊伍新增到隊伍視窗中，並會產生一個隊伍從 苦痛之門 的方向攻擊你）。在附近所有攻擊怪物被擊敗之前，不要與伊斯里斯隊長交談。擊敗攻擊團後，你可以在西邊附近拾取折磨賞金。
c02e9dc2da65fafe02bc57b22fb101d27b372618.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

378ee42b9a640f5feb446251ed9bc29d131cc06a.text: 與 Yithlis 隊長交談將開始產生額外的 4 組受折磨的生物（全部來自北方）。保護隊長免受折磨生物的侵害，他的盟友對於完成任務的目的並不重要，但會幫助你對抗遭受折磨的敵人。

106ce408141b50471e6b72115d6d43e86d4548e5.source: Although the quest says you must go through the Salt Flats to get to Diviner's Ascent, it is easier and faster if you simply map travel to Elona Reach and then walk northeast to the quest marker. The Eater of Souls will appear in the distance. As the player approaches; however, it will soon disappear and a swarm of Jade Scarabs will take its place. After defeating a total of three waves of enemies, the Eater of Souls finally reappears to allow itself to be defeated.
106ce408141b50471e6b72115d6d43e86d4548e5.text: 雖然任務說你必須經過 鹽灘 才能到達 預言者之坡，但如果你簡單地將旅行對映到 伊洛那流域，然後向東北走到任務標記，會更容易、更快。 嗜魂者 將出現在遠處。當玩家接近時；然而，它很快就會消失，一大群翡翠聖甲蟲將取代它。在擊敗了總共三波敵人後，嗜魂者終於再次出現，讓自己被擊敗。
