2bec043a2e363aec08831c80ddd0b317245b7c73.source: It's preferable to wait with this quest until you have unlocked Zen Daijun (outpost), as the route is shorter and the henchmen are of a higher level. Otherwise you have to travel from Seitung Harbor. In either case, make your way to Scout Shenfai, talk to him, and then travel north and then northeast. There are no extra foes on the route. Once near the beach, clear the normal nagas from the area, and then investigate the beach location indicated. A group of nagas will spawn, defeat them. This is repeated two more times. Take care to only trigger one group at a time. After that, you can go back and collect the reward.
2bec043a2e363aec08831c80ddd0b317245b7c73.text: 最好等到您解鎖 禎臺郡（前哨站）後再執行此任務，因為路線較短且追隨者的等級較高。否則您必須從 青函港 出發。無論哪種情況，請前往偵察兵 Shenfai 處，與他交談，然後向北行駛，然後向東北行駛。路線上沒有額外的敵人。靠近海灘後，清除該地區的正常納迦，然後調查指示的海灘位置。一群納迦將會出現，擊敗他們。這又重複兩次。注意一次只觸發一組。之後就可以回去領取獎勵了。

63e78f4208d6c8e1cb44cc304dd22f38faf313c9.text: 任務標記將引導您到達戰鬥大師，然後是 魔法大師，然後是條件大師；但是，您可以按任何順序與任何友好的大師交談。

db6a88cc072b969ab30b9cc4e5a4492d386aff76.source: Munne will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
db6a88cc072b969ab30b9cc4e5a4492d386aff76.text: 接受任務後，穆恩會給你以下技能：
db6a88cc072b969ab30b9cc4e5a4492d386aff76.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

67b1f2f106e62c8e2e0028d333303f2a5f6641f9.source: Follow Necromancer Munne, fighting enemies as you go. Eventually she'll stop at the beginning of a long hallway with three consecutive Flame Geyser trap runes on the ground.
67b1f2f106e62c8e2e0028d333303f2a5f6641f9.text: 跟隨 死靈法師繆涅，邊走邊與敵人戰鬥。最後她會停在一條長長的走廊的入口處，地上有三個連續的火焰間歇泉陷阱符文。
67b1f2f106e62c8e2e0028d333303f2a5f6641f9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a9ec3195b9be99c015d14bca7861b19743bfb6ef.source: These traps are especially deadly, dealing 500 elemental damage to unarmored targets, instantly killing most characters. Even rangers (which possess the highest armor against elemental damage among all professions) have to be at least level 6 with a good shield (e.g. the Serrated Shield) to survive. The game immediately demonstrates this destructive power by having a devourer spawn from the wall and run straight in the second trap, getting killed on the spot.
a9ec3195b9be99c015d14bca7861b19743bfb6ef.text: 這些陷阱尤其致命，會對無裝甲目標造成 500 元素傷害，立即殺死大多數角色。即使是遊俠（在所有職業中擁有最高的抵禦元素傷害的護甲）也必須至少達到 6 等級並擁有良好的盾牌（例如鋸齒狀 盾）才能生存。遊戲立即展示了這種破壞力，吞噬者從牆上產生並徑直跑進第二個陷阱，當場被殺死。
a9ec3195b9be99c015d14bca7861b19743bfb6ef.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c0c1c90050003fc825bc1e278f3aedb582f1cdbc.source: The idea is to use Animate Bone Horror; as the corpse is within the trap, the minion summoned from it will immediately trigger the trap, at the cost of it dying in the process.
c0c1c90050003fc825bc1e278f3aedb582f1cdbc.text: 這個想法是使用 操縱恐懼骸骨；當屍體在陷阱內時，從屍體中召喚的小兵將立即觸發陷阱，但代價是它會在過程中死亡。
c0c1c90050003fc825bc1e278f3aedb582f1cdbc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

301434a74158e0eec75cbb067a6de291a98a15f4.source: Once the traps are removed, the path to the Tomb Nightmare is clear. Despite being level 4, the Nightmare is very weak. It is especially susceptible to cold damage, making Deathly Swarm particularly effective.
301434a74158e0eec75cbb067a6de291a98a15f4.text: 一旦陷阱被移除，通往古墓 夢魘 的道路就暢通無阻了。儘管是 4 級別，但 夢魘 卻非常弱。它特別容易受到冷害，因此 致命蟲群 特別有效。
301434a74158e0eec75cbb067a6de291a98a15f4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9eee05de63faccfd3e33bfdfa9574bba450e1296.source: Go back to Munne to collect the reward. You can also map travel to Ashford Abbey and re-enter the Catacombs as she will be back at her original location.
9eee05de63faccfd3e33bfdfa9574bba450e1296.text: 返回Munne領取獎勵。您也可以將旅行對映到 灰色淺灘修道院 並重新進入地下墓穴，因為她會回到原來的位置。
9eee05de63faccfd3e33bfdfa9574bba450e1296.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e0da04dabe14bffa33865ea37c2015f9294d9909.source: There are various ways to kill the Tomb Nightmare without confronting it directly:
e0da04dabe14bffa33865ea37c2015f9294d9909.text: 有多種方法可以殺死 夢魘 古墓而不直接面對它：
e0da04dabe14bffa33865ea37c2015f9294d9909.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1ada09777748f0ab5162cc8043dbfd4966704658.source: If you have a flatbow or longbow, instead of triggering the last Flame Geyser, you can take advantage of the stairs' elevation to pull the Nightmare. It will try to get to you and run straight into the trap.
1ada09777748f0ab5162cc8043dbfd4966704658.text: 如果你有平弓或長弓，你可以利用樓梯的高度來拉動夢魘，而不是觸發最後一個火焰間歇泉。它會試圖接近你並徑直落入陷阱。
1ada09777748f0ab5162cc8043dbfd4966704658.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a82129827ab1e306d57b5d53c9dc016896cad69d.source: There's a ledge overlooking the Tomb Nightmare to the west of the last room, which can be more easily reached from the entrance in Green Hills County, north of The Barradin Estate, going then straight south then east. You can again pull the Nightmare with a bow and it will try to come straight to you, leaving you some time to kill it with ranged spells or attacks while it is still pondering how to reach you.
a82129827ab1e306d57b5d53c9dc016896cad69d.text: 最後一間房間的西邊有壁架，可俯瞰古墓 夢魘，可以從 巴拉丁領地 以北的 綠丘郡 的入口更容易到達，然後一直往南再向東走。你可以再次用弓拉動 夢魘，它會嘗試直接向你靠近，讓你有時間用遠端法術或攻擊殺死它，同時它仍在思考如何到達你身邊。
a82129827ab1e306d57b5d53c9dc016896cad69d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

dc331f3eb35237a8fccf2fdcd561953f4afb9ae4.source: During the quest Vanguard Rescue: Save the Ascalonian Noble, two vanguard foes will spawn in the same spot than the Tomb Nightmare, and kill it in your stead.
dc331f3eb35237a8fccf2fdcd561953f4afb9ae4.text: 在任務「先鋒營救：拯救阿斯卡隆貴族」期間，兩個先鋒敵人將在與古墓 夢魘 相同的位置生成，並代替你殺死它。
dc331f3eb35237a8fccf2fdcd561953f4afb9ae4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

381cb8bc550d0f947446dfadb5741abf90b71b28.source: You can use Devona to trigger the first trap which will likely kill her unless she's level 8 or higher. You will need to resurrect her with a Resurrection Signet to sacrifice her again to trigger the second trap.
381cb8bc550d0f947446dfadb5741abf90b71b28.text: 你可以使用 德佛娜 觸發第一個陷阱，這可能會殺死她，除非她的等級為 8 或更高。你需要用 復活紋章 復活她，再次犧牲她來觸發第二個陷阱。
381cb8bc550d0f947446dfadb5741abf90b71b28.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6d2295a8e85051880f4f3aca43706c32c81f74fd.text: 從 占卜之石 離開來完成這個任務要快得多。

dc5ad69fafcb7138d76c04f070e613385a199e77.source: Head west from Augury Rock, veering south. You will encounter some Rockshot Devourers, some Scarabs, and a small handful of Minotaurs along the way. Take the groups one at a time, and you should not have too much trouble. The Devourers will probably lay a few traps down before you can engage them, so you should be prepared to deal with conditions like blindness and burning.
dc5ad69fafcb7138d76c04f070e613385a199e77.text: 從 占卜之石 向西行駛，轉向南。一路上你會遇到一些 Rockshot 蠍、一些聖甲蟲和一小部分牛頭怪。一次一組地進行，你應該不會有太多麻煩。 蠍 可能會在你攻擊它們之前設定一些陷阱，所以你應該準備好應對失明和燃燒等情況。
dc5ad69fafcb7138d76c04f070e613385a199e77.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

82995b2a2355925c9f5bfb409ed44b39c01a2cda.source: Continue heading southeast. You will encounter more Devourers and Scarabs. Kepkhet Marrowfeast will also be there, along with a rather large group of Scarabs. Avoid them and continue southeast. The Sacred Griffon of Amnoon will be surrounded by a small group of Desert Griffons. Kill the Sacred Griffon first as it is a Monk, followed by the Desert Griffons, or alternatively pull them separately as the Sacred Griffon is not part of the group. Return to Zratha Kor for your reward.
82995b2a2355925c9f5bfb409ed44b39c01a2cda.text: 繼續向東南方向行駛。您將遇到更多 蠍 和聖甲蟲。 柯柏海特食隨者 也會在那裡，還有一大群聖甲蟲。避開他們並繼續向東南方向行駛。 安奴的神聖獅鷲獸 將被一小群沙漠獅鷲包圍。首先殺死神聖獅鷲，因為它是 僧侶，然後殺死沙漠獅鷲，或單獨拉它們，因為神聖獅鷲不屬於該組。 影返 到 哲爾塞侯爾 以獲得獎勵。
82995b2a2355925c9f5bfb409ed44b39c01a2cda.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

61ef5975d45191581d00e2afe167fa990886a4d9.source: You can kill some minotaurs on your way to the Sacred Griffon of Amnoon, which helps you complete the quest Ghostly Vengeance.
61ef5975d45191581d00e2afe167fa990886a4d9.text: 您可以在前往 安奴的神聖獅鷲獸 的途中殺死一些牛頭怪，這可以幫助您完成任務 幽靈的復仇。
61ef5975d45191581d00e2afe167fa990886a4d9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

80c18158bd781c13c3133ff887338b1673a2e15c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

70624e53db6bf5640b8047abbb6f439eec5add6a.source: Protect the Reapers while they channel all their energy into Dhuum's Rest, a powerful enchantment developed to force Dhuum into dormancy. At least one Reaper must survive. There are 7..1 Reapers still standing.
70624e53db6bf5640b8047abbb6f439eec5add6a.text: 保護收割者，同時將他們所有的能量引導到 多姆 的休息中，這是一種強大的結界，旨在迫使 多姆 進入休眠狀態。至少一名收割者必須生存。還有 7..1 收割者仍然站立。
70624e53db6bf5640b8047abbb6f439eec5add6a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b7ece5465df81d7fc49945160f61ad8a0afd1faa.source: Lay Dhuum low so the Reapers' magic can force Dhuum into dormancy.
b7ece5465df81d7fc49945160f61ad8a0afd1faa.text: 將 多姆 置於低電平，以便收割者的魔法可以迫使 多姆 進入休眠狀態。

2b79bb76e28cbda3e991a9a5cb8a8d651005c429.source: Having survived the preceeding quest, escort Captain Yithlis and his patrol back to the Gate of Torment. You will be attacked by 3 mobs of torment creatures running at your escort on the way, so don't think you can take it easy!
2b79bb76e28cbda3e991a9a5cb8a8d651005c429.text: 在前面的任務中倖存下來後，護送 Yithlis 隊長和他的巡邏隊返回 苦痛之門。你會在途中受到護送你的 3 折磨生物小怪的攻擊，所以不要以為你可以輕鬆！
2b79bb76e28cbda3e991a9a5cb8a8d651005c429.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

cc76726b92b98a0ffd4d0c4bcd9c3e3660be2276.source: Scythes of Chaos like to attack Yithlis and the spell casting party, running around the warriors so keep an eye on them. Consider killing Shadows of Fear first to ensure that you don't have to face exploding minions in addition to the other demons.
cc76726b92b98a0ffd4d0c4bcd9c3e3660be2276.text: 混沌之鐮喜歡攻擊伊斯利斯和施法隊伍，在戰士周圍奔跑，所以要留意他們。考慮先殺死恐懼之影，以確保除了其他惡魔之外，你不必面對爆炸的小兵。
cc76726b92b98a0ffd4d0c4bcd9c3e3660be2276.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

832c1a23d594db4293b1293b5310a4bcc1123dcb.source: The enemy groups spawn on the route back to the Gate of Torment even between handing in the previous quest and picking up this one — so if you want to make sure all the Oddbodies survive, you can fight the mobs before you accept this quest. If you killed all enemy groups around the NPCs during The Missing Patrol, they stay safe in that spot while you are off hunting the quest mobs.
832c1a23d594db4293b1293b5310a4bcc1123dcb.text: 即使在提交上一個任務和拿起這個任務之間，敵人也會在返回 苦痛之門 的路線上產生 - 所以如果你想確保所有奇怪的人都生存下來，你可以在接受這個任務之前與小怪戰鬥。如果您在失蹤巡邏期間殺死了 NPC 周圍的所有敵方團體，那麼當您外出狩獵任務小怪時，他們會安全地留在該地點。
832c1a23d594db4293b1293b5310a4bcc1123dcb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a1d038ef01fb8c6e8935872b6aeddfffeebdb01d.source: You can use the Oddbodies to help farm Lightbringer points in this area. It may be worthwhile not to turn in the quest for this reason.
a1d038ef01fb8c6e8935872b6aeddfffeebdb01d.text: 您可以使用奇怪的人來幫助在該區域種植光明使者點。由於這個原因，不提交任務可能是值得的。

6040a041fa75307de151bbc5e8e9c35b1086414d.source: Travel south from Fort Ranik, then turn east toward an area with stone arches. Giant Needle Spiders will popup at the entrance of the path leading to the area and around the ruins. Kill them and then pick up the basket lying underneath a nearby tree.
6040a041fa75307de151bbc5e8e9c35b1086414d.text: 從拉尼克堡向南行駛，然後向東轉向有石拱門的區域。 馴服的霜巨人 針蜘蛛會出現在通往該區域和廢墟周圍的路徑入口處。殺死他們，然後撿起附近樹下的籃子。
6040a041fa75307de151bbc5e8e9c35b1086414d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e34cf737055b3cdec00faa36778cc32d5916c28d.source: Picking up the basket triggers an additional spider to spawn next to you immediately and others on the way back. In total, 6 additional level 2 spiders spawn while you carry the basket, 3 next to the arches, 3 others near the exit. Their spawn locations are about the same as the regular spawns.
e34cf737055b3cdec00faa36778cc32d5916c28d.text: 拿起籃子會立即觸發一隻額外的蜘蛛在您旁邊生成，並在返回的路上觸發其他蜘蛛。總共，當您攜帶籃子時，6 額外等級的 2 蜘蛛會生成，3 會在拱門旁邊生成，3 其他蜘蛛會在出口附近生成。它們的生成位置與常規生成位置大致相同。
e34cf737055b3cdec00faa36778cc32d5916c28d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

666ef7fd89c359cea3271a465df08bff1dff791e.source: As with most bundles, you cannot attack with your weapon and your movement speed is reduced while carrying the basket, though you can still cast most spells. Should you need to attack with your weapon, feel free to drop the bundle and pick it up again after the fight. Kill the spiders and return the basket to Mary to get your reward.
666ef7fd89c359cea3271a465df08bff1dff791e.text: 與大多數包裹一樣，你無法使用武器進行攻擊，並且攜帶籃子時你的移動速度會降低，但你仍然可以施展大多數法術。如果您需要使用武器進行攻擊，請隨意放下包裹並在戰鬥結束後再次撿起。殺死蜘蛛並將籃子還給瑪麗即可獲得獎勵。
666ef7fd89c359cea3271a465df08bff1dff791e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2a788e7cefc0926a694bdcc7921e68adfa690e70.source: Caution: Do not map travel to save time; doing so will cause you to lose the basket, forcing you to fetch it again, similar to the strongbox in the Bandit Raid quest.
2a788e7cefc0926a694bdcc7921e68adfa690e70.text: 注意：不要為了節省時間而繪製旅行地圖；這樣做會導致你丟失籃子，迫使你再次取回它，類似於 盜匪的侵襲 任務中的保險箱。
2a788e7cefc0926a694bdcc7921e68adfa690e70.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

61f9cdf4a3cb2a21c424d92ece4ba91f1225666c.source: Head south from Ascalon City and cross the river to reach the island cave (which appears grey on your map). Go around the western side until you reach the cave's entrance near Duke Gaban and Fadden Hathorn, and venture into the cave.

3ff9a85935e0ac12d2cdcf9643216497f0ff6ede.source: Although there are four more Carrion Devourers in the cave during this quest than usual, you can ignore most of them and the Lash Devourers, since they don't attack you unless a Diseased Devourer pops up. When this happens, focus on Diseased Devourers first, since they are level 0 and will die in one or two basic hits.
3ff9a85935e0ac12d2cdcf9643216497f0ff6ede.text: 儘管在此任務期間洞穴中的腐肉 蠍 比平時多了四個，但您可以忽略其中的大多數和鞭笞 蠍，因為除非彈出 疫病蠍，否則它們不會攻擊您。發生這種情況時，請首先關注患病的 蠍，因為它們的級別為 0，並且會在一兩次基本攻擊中死亡。

7a32fb1490717c4b0053291fd1e12ad3bd72e654.source: The Plague Devourer is located near the end of the cave and will pop up and attack you once approached. Despite the dialogue, it cannot poison you. Once you have killed it, two poisonous stingers will drop. Collect one of them and map travel to Ashford Abbey to give it to Brother Mhenlo.
7a32fb1490717c4b0053291fd1e12ad3bd72e654.text: 瘟疫蠍 位於洞穴盡頭附近，一旦接近就會彈出並攻擊你。儘管有對話，但它不會毒害你。一旦你殺死它，就會掉落兩根毒刺。收集其中一張並將旅行對映到 灰色淺灘修道院，將其交給 涵洛教友。

37333d66da8971f0e7855a3d319945ce1b81a1c9.source: Alternatively, you may map travel to Ashford Abbey and enter the Catacombs there. When the path forks, follow the quest marker to the stairs which lead to a crypt on the right, where the fanatics are located.
37333d66da8971f0e7855a3d319945ce1b81a1c9.text: 或者，您可以將旅行對映到 灰色淺灘修道院 並進入那裡的地下墓穴。右側有一條隱藏通道，位於 死靈法師繆涅 後方。在洞穴的盡頭，沿著佈滿石像鬼的長路一直往前走。當路徑分岔時，沿著任務標記到達通往右側地下室的樓梯，那裡是狂熱者所在的地方。

e2a576c5205076aa128399ae51578c679ead08af.source: From Ashford Abbey: Head south down one set of stairs, then west down another to a Y-intersection. Take the northwestern path across a bridge and down yet another set of stairs. There are two paths north from this room: a near one which leads to a Flame Geyser, and a less obvious one on the far side of the room. Take the far one, then turn southwest after the second pillar. Deadly Crypt Spiders pop up along this section. Continue along this path until just before the walls change over to stone blocks, and you'll find a passage south. This passage leads to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. Continue south up one set of stairs and down another to find the Corpse of Prize Moa Bird.
e2a576c5205076aa128399ae51578c679ead08af.text: 從 灰色淺灘修道院 出發：向南走下一組樓梯，然後向西走另一組樓梯到達 Y 形交叉路口。沿著西北方向穿過一座橋，然後走下另一組樓梯。從這個房間向北有兩條路：一條靠近的通往火焰間歇泉，另一條不太明顯的位於房間的遠端。走最遠的一根，然後在第二根柱子後轉向西南。致命的地穴蜘蛛會沿著這個區域彈出。繼續沿著這條路走，直到牆壁變成石頭之前，你會發現一條向南的通道。這條通道通往一個十字路口，走廊上有一群不死生物。繼續往南走上一組樓梯，再走下另一組即可找到 恐鳥 獎品屍體。
e2a576c5205076aa128399ae51578c679ead08af.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

47bf5a2bbf2414959b938417fa771c27e919aaff.source: From Green Hills County: Move past the Gargoyles and take the path south, turning west at the intersection. In the large circular room, head southwest and take the corridor south where Oberan the Reviled stands. After the corridor turns east, Deadly Crypt Spiders will start popping up. Where the stone wall on your right ends, take path south, and you'll come to an intersection with a corridor with groups of undead. 3a5bdd6119da6aad6dc8bcb1d707c3ffc7581bc5.source: Head towards the rift, which is located north of the cave that you defended in the preceding quest. You will notice a list of stationary Torment creatures, with three groups of patrols around it. Two of the stationary foes are Torment Claws. It is advisable to clear off other mobs around the area before you engage the foes around the rift, to give you more space.
3a5bdd6119da6aad6dc8bcb1d707c3ffc7581bc5.text: 前往裂縫，它位於你在上一個任務中保衛的洞穴的北部。你會注意到一列靜止的折磨生物，周圍有三組巡邏隊。其中兩個靜止的敵人是折磨之爪。建議您在與裂縫周圍的敵人交戰之前先清除該區域周圍的其他生物，以便為您提供更多空間。

ee1c2b345001dfef6db8cca10d1979eacfcd36ca.source: Start by pulling the patrols and taking care of them one at a time. Once the patrols are cleared, pull the stationary foes, which are not all in the same group. Once you kill the Torment Claws, be ready to retreat. When the rift starts closing, five groups of Torment creatures will spawn and charge to the rift's location in waves. It's recommended to retreat to a safe location and intercept just one or two of the groups away from the rift. Then just return and pull the remaining groups before closing the rift.
ee1c2b345001dfef6db8cca10d1979eacfcd36ca.text: 首先拉動巡邏隊並一次處理一個。一旦巡邏隊被清除，拉動靜止的敵人，這些敵人並不都在同一組中。一旦你殺死了折磨之爪，就準備撤退。當裂縫開始關閉時，五組折磨生物將會生成並一波又一波地衝向裂縫位置。建議撤退到安全位置並攔截遠離裂縫的一兩個小組。然後返回並拉動剩餘的小組，然後再關閉裂縫。

77a020607e7904cd00c691be86659af7ec3fbde6.source: On arrival at the Kodash Bazaar, walk up to the entrance, but do not walk in (or leave the area) until the quest updates, otherwise the quest will not complete properly. The quest updates when Talgun, Priest Tuwahan, and Belanu reach the final quest pointer.
77a020607e7904cd00c691be86659af7ec3fbde6.text: 到達 Kodash Bazaar 後，走到入口處，但在任務更新之前不要走進（或離開該區域），否則任務將無法正確完成。當塔爾根、牧師圖瓦漢和貝拉努到達最終任務指標時，任務就會更新。
77a020607e7904cd00c691be86659af7ec3fbde6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

52756cc476c5c8ea7f226bf0db8382bb3f258449.source: The final dialogue with the family (Belanu, Charmah, and Kimab) doesn't always trigger. Try to have them arrive at the location at the same time to make it trigger.
52756cc476c5c8ea7f226bf0db8382bb3f258449.text: 與家人（Belanu、Charmah 和 Kimab）的最後對話並不總是會觸發。嘗試讓他們同時到達該位置以使其觸發。
52756cc476c5c8ea7f226bf0db8382bb3f258449.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

320f6a8a53ddba12a1c5d5c1a015a67c95551aa4.source: The amount of chests is reduced while this quest is active.
320f6a8a53ddba12a1c5d5c1a015a67c95551aa4.text: 當此任務處於活動狀態時，箱子的數量會減少。
320f6a8a53ddba12a1c5d5c1a015a67c95551aa4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6b351a6777379e3cbde4cca13219938df084facf.source: The survivor groups follow the party around, but do not join as allies, so they are not attacked by hostile groups (except for any accidental AoE effects targeted on the party members).
6b351a6777379e3cbde4cca13219938df084facf.text: 倖存者團體跟隨隊伍，但不作為盟友加入，因此他們不會受到敵對團體的攻擊（除了任何針對隊伍成員的意外 範圍性 效果）。
6b351a6777379e3cbde4cca13219938df084facf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7b9b2c5abc4a48a059d9692394a6375ade60d09e.source: The survivor groups move slowly and so care should be taken that they do not get stuck on any objects - all of the survivors are required to complete the quest.
7b9b2c5abc4a48a059d9692394a6375ade60d09e.text: 倖存者群體移動緩慢，因此應注意不要卡在任何物體上 - 所有倖存者都需要完成任務。
7b9b2c5abc4a48a059d9692394a6375ade60d09e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4eece800a30669b82b2ee6f04699b05f2d1531cb.source: It isn't necessary to use the Vabbi Guards, so you may start from Kodash Bazaar if you wish (i.e. you could clear the quest path of foes before talking to Ahmtur the Mighty).
4eece800a30669b82b2ee6f04699b05f2d1531cb.text: 沒有必要使用 瓦貝 守衛，因此如果您願意，您可以從 Kodash Bazaar 開始（即您可以在與強大的阿姆圖爾交談之前清除敵人的任務路徑）。
4eece800a30669b82b2ee6f04699b05f2d1531cb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fd2a2b8e3d9ae77d3d6f427a8598812075314fd2.source: Since the guards follow the party but not your commands, they may need to be led towards any hostile groups that you are attacking. This can be a problem for solo (with henchmen) players who use ranged attacks and skills, since you may have to move into close aggro range to ensure the guards start to attack.
fd2a2b8e3d9ae77d3d6f427a8598812075314fd2.text: 由於守衛聽從隊伍而不是你的命令，因此他們可能需要被引導去對付你正在攻擊的任何敵對團體。對於使用遠端攻擊和技能的單人（與追隨者）玩家來說，這可能是一個問題，因為你可能必須進入近距離仇恨範圍以確保守衛開始攻擊。
fd2a2b8e3d9ae77d3d6f427a8598812075314fd2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

81d876d2d47fa1fb3fcd28b014c986d3b00cf91e.source: Priest Tuwahan from this quest is quite close to Hanbahd from The Madness of Prophecy quest, and since you will have 5 guard NPCs to assist you, that quest can also be completed very easily while doing this one.
81d876d2d47fa1fb3fcd28b014c986d3b00cf91e.text: 此任務中的牧師 Tuwahan 與《瘋狂預言》任務中的 Hanbahd 非常接近，並且由於您將有 5 守衛 NPC 來協助您，因此在執行此任務時也可以輕鬆完成該任務。
81d876d2d47fa1fb3fcd28b014c986d3b00cf91e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0bd5b8526ef205ef77c1abdeb6fa9f98228d0040.source: If you die and resurrect via a shrine, the survivors you have gathered will rejoin your party by running towards you from your previous point of death.
0bd5b8526ef205ef77c1abdeb6fa9f98228d0040.text: 如果你死了並透過神殿復活，你聚集的倖存者將從你先前的死亡點跑向你，重新加入你的隊伍。
0bd5b8526ef205ef77c1abdeb6fa9f98228d0040.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1ca9f26cb845b9a6eceeee13f07a7dec812de9a9.source: Travel to the secret location of the Shadow Blades' meeting. Avoid being spotted.
1ca9f26cb845b9a6eceeee13f07a7dec812de9a9.text: 前往 闇影 Blades 會議的秘密地點。避免被發現。
1ca9f26cb845b9a6eceeee13f07a7dec812de9a9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2270fae6e6a5b52bfce4fc302e9be8d5656d685d.source: Eavesdrop on the Shadow Blades' meeting. Remain hidden.
2270fae6e6a5b52bfce4fc302e9be8d5656d685d.text: 竊聽 闇影 Blades 會議。保持隱藏。
2270fae6e6a5b52bfce4fc302e9be8d5656d685d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5bedc846e31abe895c90f2e475881cad87da35e1.source: Start from Vizunah Square (Local Quarter), enter The Undercity. Proceed across the bridge towards the quest marker, killing the single mob of afflicted in your path. Flag any heroes or henchmen at that spot, since any rogue spirits, minions or summons will cause the quest to fail.
5bedc846e31abe895c90f2e475881cad87da35e1.text: 從 薇茹廣場（本地季度）開始，輸入 地下城。穿過橋前往任務標記，殺死路上的單一受折磨的暴徒。在該地點標記任何英雄或追隨者，因為任何盜賊靈魂、爪牙或召喚物都會導致任務失敗。
5bedc846e31abe895c90f2e475881cad87da35e1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5840224361a97a135b93966292752409e152b829.source: Walk slowly north up the corridor that links to the shadow blades' meeting spot. Keep going until the quest updates and remain there until you you see the line, "May your blades guide you to the hearts of your enemies". Wait until the quest log updates and then you can map out.
5840224361a97a135b93966292752409e152b829.text: 沿著連線暗影之刃交會點的走廊慢慢往北走。繼續前進，直到任務更新，並停留在那裡，直到您看到一行「願您的刀片引導您到達敵人的心臟」。等到任務日誌更新後就可以繪製地圖了。
5840224361a97a135b93966292752409e152b829.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4594016246a7b32a64b0f669b404c6505dc3b95a.source: Alternatively, you can flag a hero to the corner just east of the meeting spot, after removing their ability to aggro foes (set their AI to avoid combat, disable any damage skills, and remove their weapon).
4594016246a7b32a64b0f669b404c6505dc3b95a.text: 或者，你可以在移除英雄仇恨敵人的能力後將其標記到集合地點東邊的角落（將他們的AI設定為避免戰鬥，停用任何傷害技能，並移除他們的武器）。
4594016246a7b32a64b0f669b404c6505dc3b95a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

32b790d9a0eca56f05afa05d52995fe154a0d347.source: Non-Canthan characters can head north from The Marketplace, killing the Am Fah in the way while heading South West, eventually proceeding down a ramp into the Undercity.
32b790d9a0eca56f05afa05d52995fe154a0d347.text: 非凱珊角色可以從 市集 向北行進，在向西南行進時殺死路上的 安費，最終沿著坡道進入幽暗城。
32b790d9a0eca56f05afa05d52995fe154a0d347.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e903983650b8f233666d6056469886c66ed8dd74.source: It is also possible to just do the The Challenge quest and get the quest completed by accident. Killing Tae Xang counts for both quests.
e903983650b8f233666d6056469886c66ed8dd74.text: 也有可能只做挑戰任務並意外完成任務。殺死泰翔對於這兩個任務都有效。
e903983650b8f233666d6056469886c66ed8dd74.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6d8c59161389927793b24b8f6a4f31ae3723d41f.source: Keep the Margonite Portal Mages from summoning enough demons and Margonites to overwhelm the area.
6d8c59161389927793b24b8f6a4f31ae3723d41f.text: 阻止 瑪骨奈 介面 法師召喚足夠的惡魔和瑪貢尼特來淹沒該區域。
6d8c59161389927793b24b8f6a4f31ae3723d41f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

639c845291b90cb2008a196b67b39ddde224fa6f.source: Defeat the creatures guarding the Torment rifts to increase your score.
639c845291b90cb2008a196b67b39ddde224fa6f.text: 擊敗守衛折磨裂縫的生物來增加你的分數。
639c845291b90cb2008a196b67b39ddde224fa6f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5d645c574f2ffe0ca363169e2252bea515dd328a.source: Defeat the Margonite Portal Mages to close the rift and earn a bonus score!
5d645c574f2ffe0ca363169e2252bea515dd328a.text: 擊敗 瑪骨奈 介面 法師以關閉裂縫並獲得獎勵分數！
5d645c574f2ffe0ca363169e2252bea515dd328a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ca789d32743741ed38d80908168beda3120ac5d4.source: Each party member has a random chance to obtain Mysterious Armor Pieces whenever a Margonite Portal Mage is killed. Like other armor pieces given in other Nightfall challenge missions, they do not drop on the ground; they are automatically placed in the player's inventory. These pieces can be used to upgrade the visual appearance of certain hero armor to Mysterious armor. This upgrade is available for Norgu, Goren, General Morgahn, Zenmai, and Olias. You also gain Lightbringer points if you achieve a daily, monthly or quarterly best score similar to the gold bonus.
ca789d32743741ed38d80908168beda3120ac5d4.text: 每當 瑪骨奈 介面 法師傭兵 被殺時，每個隊伍成員都有隨機機會獲得神秘的 防禦 碎片。與其他 黑暗逆襲 挑戰任務中提供的其他盔甲一樣，它們不會掉落在地面上；它們會自動放置在玩家的庫存中。這些部件可用於將某些英雄盔甲的視覺外觀升級至 神秘。此升級適用於 Norgu、高恩、摩根將軍、Zenmai 和 Olias。如果您達到每日、每月或每季的最佳分數（類似於黃金獎勵），您還將獲得光明使者積分。
ca789d32743741ed38d80908168beda3120ac5d4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

747e012be320068aab32a9c363348cb2eda75044.source: Use the Mission Map (default hotkey U) to see all of the rifts and their current states. Gray rifts are inactive and have no units there. Red rifts are active and contributing to the rift progress. Use this information to save as much time as possible when moving between rifts.
747e012be320068aab32a9c363348cb2eda75044.text: 使用 主線任務 地圖（預設熱鍵 U）檢視所有裂痕及其目前狀態。灰色裂隙處於非活動狀態，那裡沒有單位。紅色裂痕活躍並促進裂痕進展。在裂縫之間移動時，使用這些資訊可以節省盡可能多的時間。
747e012be320068aab32a9c363348cb2eda75044.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fb8a57626beb502c07137779f1d0d70f2fb37924.source: Once the party zones in, there is a one minute countdown before the mission begins. Because not all the rifts are visible in the Mission Map to start, use this time to explore to the north and reveal the last three rifts.
fb8a57626beb502c07137779f1d0d70f2fb37924.text: 一旦隊伍進入區域，任務開始前會有一分鐘的倒數計時。由於並非所有裂痕在 主線任務 地圖中都可見，因此請利用這段時間向北探索並揭示最後三個裂痕。
fb8a57626beb502c07137779f1d0d70f2fb37924.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f0fa979596d94991cf7b60284010b90d94a37eb9.source: Bringing Fall Back to move between rifts can save precious time.
f0fa979596d94991cf7b60284010b90d94a37eb9.text: 讓墮落者在裂縫之間移動可以節省寶貴的時間。
f0fa979596d94991cf7b60284010b90d94a37eb9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e77b4a5fd800a44a0956dcaca24fe3d5f64075ae.source: The portal mages are powerful air elementalists. Their Invoke Lightning can wreak havoc on unprepared groups. There are a few steps teams can take to prevent wipes:
e77b4a5fd800a44a0956dcaca24fe3d5f64075ae.text: 傳送門法師是強大的空氣元素師。他們的 閃電祈禱 可能會對毫無準備的群體造成嚴重破壞。團隊可以採取一些步驟來防止擦除：
e77b4a5fd800a44a0956dcaca24fe3d5f64075ae.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

19e5779623e116bc16987555af8b3cb0b103e447.source: Bring skills that increase armor against elemental or lightning damage (Mantra of Lightning, Ward Against Elements).
19e5779623e116bc16987555af8b3cb0b103e447.text: 帶來可以增加防禦元素或閃電傷害護甲的技能（閃電頌歌、元素結界）。
19e5779623e116bc16987555af8b3cb0b103e447.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

21296da862a2d6b7f98f84bf0cfa0e8cbbb8175e.source: It is highly recommended for monks to bring a form of damage mitigation, like Protective Spirit or Spirit Bond. Remember to preprot.
21296da862a2d6b7f98f84bf0cfa0e8cbbb8175e.text: 強烈建議修士攜帶 型態 減輕傷害，例如 精神守護 或 精神連結。記住要預先保護。
21296da862a2d6b7f98f84bf0cfa0e8cbbb8175e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

13a0268db08979c82afa31ce61ad48258c9933bb.source: When engaging a portal mage, spread out so that the mage's Invoke Lightning will only damage one team member.
13a0268db08979c82afa31ce61ad48258c9933bb.text: 當與傳送門法師交戰時，分散開，以便法師的 閃電祈禱 只會傷害一名團隊成員。
13a0268db08979c82afa31ce61ad48258c9933bb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

908d5255f2acfc36c20f3a0b7fdee3fe043878e8.source: Rangers and Mesmers should bring interrupts. Interrupting Invoke Lightning is the best way to prevent damage.
908d5255f2acfc36c20f3a0b7fdee3fe043878e8.text: 遊騎兵和催眠師應該帶來干擾。中斷 閃電祈禱 是防止損壞的最佳方法。
908d5255f2acfc36c20f3a0b7fdee3fe043878e8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1ea486698da4b4f6c8618086a7f27b37cb1a7dda.source: While only the portal mage needs to be killed to close a rift, it is advisable to kill the surrounding creatures as well. This is because the monster would otherwise still be present should the rift reopen, leaving higher numbers of monsters near the next portal mage.
1ea486698da4b4f6c8618086a7f27b37cb1a7dda.text: 雖然只需要殺死傳送門法師來關閉裂縫，但建議也殺死周圍的生物。這是因為如果裂縫重新開啟，怪物仍然會存在，從而在下一個傳送門法師附近留下更多的怪物。
1ea486698da4b4f6c8618086a7f27b37cb1a7dda.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fffee815abb1689b88fa1a65a50a46a687005413.source: After clearing a rift, move away from it as quickly as possible. This is imperative because the rift may reopen while you are engaging a nearby rift, causing potential aggro problems from multiple monster groups.
fffee815abb1689b88fa1a65a50a46a687005413.text: 清除裂痕後，儘快離開裂痕。這是必要的，因為當你與附近的裂縫交戰時，裂縫可能會重新開啟，導致多個怪物群潛在的仇恨問題。
fffee815abb1689b88fa1a65a50a46a687005413.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

80c1e97655e106df021145f6a032c83325fe5cb9.source: The portal mage is not in the same group as the creatures guarding it, so if possible, pull the surrounding creatures before engaging the mage.
80c1e97655e106df021145f6a032c83325fe5cb9.text: 傳送門法師與守衛它的生物不在同一組中，因此如果可能的話，在與法師交戰之前拉動周圍的生物。
80c1e97655e106df021145f6a032c83325fe5cb9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a2246ba3365b9f2a8f9c7a3a98f876d7ce9f1e52.source: The portal mage is a boss giving a +2% morale boost when killed, so Resurrection Signets will be recharged frequently and provide a very effective resurrection skill. Skills that recharge slowly will also be ready for use after killing a portal mage due to the morale boost.
a2246ba3365b9f2a8f9c7a3a98f876d7ce9f1e52.text: 傳送門法師是一個在被殺死時會給予 +2% 士氣提升的 Boss，因此復活徽記會經常充電並提供非常有效的復活技能。由於士氣提升，殺死傳送門法師後，緩慢充能的技能也將可以使用。
a2246ba3365b9f2a8f9c7a3a98f876d7ce9f1e52.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

dd3486318482e9dcdc7391766d77502df9a5f2b3.source: Like most other Challenge Missions, monsters in this mission do not drop loot.
dd3486318482e9dcdc7391766d77502df9a5f2b3.text: 與大多數其他挑戰任務一樣，此任務中的怪物不會掉落戰利品。
dd3486318482e9dcdc7391766d77502df9a5f2b3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8a8b69ec3c931a05c085c5558577423e29ded875.source: You can reach the Shadow Nexus through an east exit in Gate of Torment.
8a8b69ec3c931a05c085c5558577423e29ded875.text: 您可以透過 苦痛之門 的東出口到達 闇影 Nexus。
8a8b69ec3c931a05c085c5558577423e29ded875.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

320dcfa65b8609f7a2440f2f51ed2b4b1c83a6aa.source: Clear the Shattered Ravines in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode.
320dcfa65b8609f7a2440f2f51ed2b4b1c83a6aa.text: 在困難模式下清除 荒蕪之地 中所有敵人的破碎峽谷。
320dcfa65b8609f7a2440f2f51ed2b4b1c83a6aa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

45a17415b6a4219713a8ba982e92f1797412dd23.source: "Clear the Shattered Ravines in the Desolation of all enemies in hard mode."
45a17415b6a4219713a8ba982e92f1797412dd23.text: “在困難模式下清除 荒蕪之地 中所有敵人的破碎峽谷。”
45a17415b6a4219713a8ba982e92f1797412dd23.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

cd3dd9dd9ad9897a028e413c96156748ccb63082.source: Tell Theatre Manager Daudi that the prince wants another play to soothe his raging heart. And he wants one now!
cd3dd9dd9ad9897a028e413c96156748ccb63082.text: 告訴劇場經理達迪，王子想要另一場演出來安撫他洶湧的心。他現在就想要一個！
cd3dd9dd9ad9897a028e413c96156748ccb63082.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4e52815aa4e9ab13ef512a6bc1fa8da098622f23.source: Find a playwright to pen a new script for the prince to enjoy.
4e52815aa4e9ab13ef512a6bc1fa8da098622f23.text: 找一位劇作家寫一個新劇本給王子欣賞。

8fbf895022ca200bf7592c68886c90cc87da7684.source: The initial quest objective can be approached from either Honur Hill or the Kodash Bazaar. Going from Honur Hill will take you through Yahnur Market, and while this isn't an often frequented outpost, it may be worth seeing on your way through for exploration purposes. Going from the Kodash Bazaar may be easier.
8fbf895022ca200bf7592c68886c90cc87da7684.text: 初始任務目標可以從 霍奴爾丘陵 或 Kodash Bazaar 實現。從 霍奴爾丘陵 出發將帶您穿過 雅諾爾市集，雖然這不是一個經常光顧的前哨站，但出於探索目的，在途中可能值得一看。從 Kodash Bazaar 出發可能會更方便。
8fbf895022ca200bf7592c68886c90cc87da7684.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b213306e830a857ac2333acc0a4650ce26bbb2c6.source: From Honur Hill, head due south along the west side of Resplendent Makuun to arrive at Yahnur Market, then on into Vehtendi Valley. Although the first objective is due west of Yahnur Market, it will be necessary to take a route that turns south, west over the fields, then north to meet with Norgu. This area mainly has Heket, Behemoths and Kournans. The Behemoth Gravebanes act as minion masters and also inflict degeneration using hexes on the party, so kill them first if possible.
b213306e830a857ac2333acc0a4650ce26bbb2c6.text: 從 霍奴爾丘陵 出發，沿著 Resplendent Makuun 西側向正南行駛，到達 雅諾爾市集，然後進入 巍天帝峽谷。雖然第一個目標位於 雅諾爾市集 的正西，但有必要走一條向南、向西越過田野，然後向北與 Norgu 會合的路線。此區域主要有青蛙族群、Behemoths和Kournans。 巨獸 Gravebanes 充當小兵大師，也會使用巫術對隊伍造成退化，所以如果可能的話，先殺死他們。
b213306e830a857ac2333acc0a4650ce26bbb2c6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7823070d26e2bb06338725d0050229805079151a.source: On meeting Norgu at Jahinur (point 1 on the map), you'll get the chance to create a script via some multiple choice dialogue, then watch the audience response to his "masterpiece". After the first performance at Jahinur, you must escort Norgu north to his next engagement (at point 2), making sure he doesn't die on the way. As a level 18 mesmer, Norgu provides some assistance, casting Clumsiness, Mantra of Persistence, and Conjure Phantasm as required.
7823070d26e2bb06338725d0050229805079151a.text: 在 Jahinur（地圖上的 1 點）遇見 Norgu 時，您將有機會透過一些多項選擇對話建立指令碼，然後觀看觀眾對他的「傑作」的反應。在 Jahinur 的第一次表演後，你必須護送 Norgu 向北前往他的下一場戰鬥（地點為 2），確保他不會在途中死亡。作為 18 等級的幻術師，Norgu 提供了一些協助，根據需要施放 笨拙、持久頌歌 和 召喚幻影。
7823070d26e2bb06338725d0050229805079151a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

627194dd84adcabc63535cc00aa71c82057c1ed9.source: Once the last objective is activated, it's an easy matter of map traveling to the Kodash Bazaar and collecting your reward and a new mesmer hero.
627194dd84adcabc63535cc00aa71c82057c1ed9.text: 一旦啟動了最後一個目標，就可以輕鬆前往 Kodash Bazaar 地圖並收集獎勵和新的催眠英雄。
627194dd84adcabc63535cc00aa71c82057c1ed9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

21905b2ccbf54df70226f5bd6f5b22b01ab38ccd.source: On your way from the first play to the next engagement with the heket, the quest The Hanging Gardener can be picked up and completed soon after this quest is finished (see point 3 on the maps above).
21905b2ccbf54df70226f5bd6f5b22b01ab38ccd.text: 在你從第一次玩到下一次與heket交戰的過程中，任務「懸掛的園丁」可以在任務完成後很快被拾起並完成（參見上面地圖上的3點）。
21905b2ccbf54df70226f5bd6f5b22b01ab38ccd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8282c29482b694a48fd27cd82860562103bb03d5.source: If you are not in a hurry to acquire Norgu, it is easier to complete Gain Norgu than this quest, since that quest only requires you to speak to Korvus. The Gain Norgu quest also awards 500 more experience than this quest.
8282c29482b694a48fd27cd82860562103bb03d5.text: 如果你不急於獲得諾爾古，那麼完成獲得諾爾古比這個任務更容易，因為該任務只需要你與科爾烏斯交談。 Gain Norgu 任務也為 500 獎勵比該任務更多的經驗。
8282c29482b694a48fd27cd82860562103bb03d5.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5a0779cef33dd150956a8dd8990cd0ac402f30af.source: After picking up this quest from Prince Bokka (point 1), straight away go and speak to Theatre Manager Daudi nearby to trigger the second objective (point 2). The playwright you need to find is in fact Kenyatta in the Honur Hill outpost on the west side of Resplendent Makuun (point 3). Unfortunately, Kenyatta is having a bit of writer's block and suggests that you go and find Sijo in Resplendent Makuun, from the quest pointer Sijo appears to be getting in touch with his muse up in the north-east corner of the explorable area (point 4).
5a0779cef33dd150956a8dd8990cd0ac402f30af.text: 從博卡王子那裡接到這個任務後（點1），立即去與附近的劇院經理達迪交談以觸發第二個目標（點2）。您需要找到的劇作家實際上是位於 Resplendent Makuun 西側（3 點）霍奴爾丘陵 前哨站的肯雅塔。不幸的是，肯雅塔遇到了一些寫作障礙，建議你去輝煌的馬庫斯尋找西喬，從任務指標來看，西喬似乎正在探索區域的東北角（點 4）與他的繆斯聯絡。
5a0779cef33dd150956a8dd8990cd0ac402f30af.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f67e23910d42b866479651a703b67134c5f7fc2c.source: However, as you find on arrival, Sijo the Stagnant has been done in (probably by the Djinn wandering nearby), but fear not, the body has a freshly written script on it! (click on the body to pickup the "Springtime for Varesh" Script quest item).
f67e23910d42b866479651a703b67134c5f7fc2c.text: 然而，正如您抵達後發現的那樣，靜止的 Sijo 已經被消滅了（可能是由附近徘徊的 巨靈怪 造成的），但不用擔心，屍體上有一個新寫的指令碼！ （點選屍體拾取「瓦雷什的春天」指令碼任務專案）。
f67e23910d42b866479651a703b67134c5f7fc2c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2ebdd8e01c58565dae8a85cce4cb5ab772ef1aec.source: This is a straightforward quest. Head southeast out of Tsumei Village until you get to the quest marker. Use Mend Ailment on Fawn, Jia and Kin. Then map travel back to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Headmaster Amara for your reward.
2ebdd8e01c58565dae8a85cce4cb5ab772ef1aec.text: 這是一個簡單的任務。從 蘇梅村 向東南方向前進，直到到達任務標記。對 Fawn、Jia 和 Kin 使用 治療病痛。然後在地圖上返回 星岬寺 並與阿瑪拉校長交談以獲得獎勵。
2ebdd8e01c58565dae8a85cce4cb5ab772ef1aec.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

29fbccac09cd3a79943e77340e6eb6e8c1c02039.source: Sometimes only Fawn and Jia have the green mist of sickness around them. Kin can still be "cured" though.

12473783e496f1473288200036405dcc76f28f78.text: 雖然聽說村民生病了，但他們其實是中毒了。

584ecd3842dcb61cf162d7afcc4c610a87735af8.text: 前往 桑泉谷 並消滅逼近的 紅顱 部隊。剩餘的 [9...0] 群組 紅顱 佇列。

149f48db992a6298b250251ea2b52f64c48b182b.text: 前往 班讓半島 並消滅逼近的 紅顱 部隊。剩餘的 [9...0] 群組 紅顱 佇列。

7e1838d4f402c45b8f3db756f4b10af4d45c861e.source: There is a two pronged attack of Crimson Skull, from both sides of Tsumei Village. Start by defending the Sunqua Vale side: spread out near the portal and hold your position; the attackers will come to you. Once you have cleared out most of them, tackle the remaining stragglers. As soon as the quest updates (giving you credit for removing all groups), head back into town.
7e1838d4f402c45b8f3db756f4b10af4d45c861e.text: 紅顱 從 蘇梅村 的兩側進行雙管齊下的攻擊。先防守 桑泉谷 一側：在傳送門附近分散並堅守陣地；攻擊者會來找你。一旦你清除了其中的大部分，就可以解決剩下的落後者。一旦任務更新（給你移除所有團體的功勞），就回到城鎮。
7e1838d4f402c45b8f3db756f4b10af4d45c861e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

12facbb7ad181c4407fd1f5159d561f77927102b.source: You can use the same tactics to defend the Panjiang Peninsula side, i.e. spread out and wait for the Skull to come to you. However, one of the groups will try to make an end run and attack you from behind. This can be an issue if you are using three henchmen; if you are, reposition your group closer to the resurrection shrine or otherwise backup so that the Canthan Guards can take some of the aggro while you regroup. Groups of Crimson Skull will also appear away from the main fighting area and head into the village to attack the villagers. Killing these groups do not count towards completing the quest.
12facbb7ad181c4407fd1f5159d561f77927102b.text: 你可以用相同的策略來防守 班讓半島 一方，也就是分散開來等待骷髏來找你。然而，其中一組會試圖進行最後的奔跑並從後面攻擊你。如果你使用三個追隨者，這可能是一個問題；如果你是這樣，請將你的隊伍重新定位到更靠近復活神殿的位置，或者以其他方式進行備份，以便凱珊守衛在你重新集結時可以承受一些仇恨。成群的 紅顱 也會出現在遠離主要戰鬥區域的地方，並進入村莊攻擊村民。殺死這些群體並不算完成任務。
12facbb7ad181c4407fd1f5159d561f77927102b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1d6adfdeb4a4835c4877c862018c4e72795b856b.source: Once you receive credit for defeating the last group, head back into town to collect your reward.
1d6adfdeb4a4835c4877c862018c4e72795b856b.text: 一旦您因擊敗最後一組而獲得積分，請返回城鎮領取獎勵。
1d6adfdeb4a4835c4877c862018c4e72795b856b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ac533f5187dfba2de9078f36e10dae9a764d0364.source: Note: You must complete the Sunqua Vale part of the quest first or else the final group in Panjiang Peninsula will not spawn.
ac533f5187dfba2de9078f36e10dae9a764d0364.text: 注意：您必須先完成任務的 桑泉谷 部分，否則 班讓半島 中的最後一組將不會產生。
ac533f5187dfba2de9078f36e10dae9a764d0364.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

49de999c7fb90ebdd7f25867a35726a12e151a75.source: If you keep the quest active, the groups of Crimson Skulls can be farmed for Copper Crimson Skull Coins, Silver Crimson Skull Coins, and Gold Crimson Skull Coins.
49de999c7fb90ebdd7f25867a35726a12e151a75.text: 如果您保持任務處於活動狀態，則可以透過種植猩紅骷髏群來獲得銅 紅顱 硬幣、銀 紅顱 硬幣和金 紅顱 硬幣。
49de999c7fb90ebdd7f25867a35726a12e151a75.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

60d8fca0dc9b0d11f3dcbdfe8d7c4bbeea010ccb.source: The easiest way to complete this quest is to map travel to Doomlore Shrine and leave from there. Go directly south from the entrance until you find a hostile Siege Devourer. Kill it and its Charr rider, then mount it. Fight your way south-southeast through Dalada Uplands to get to Sacnoth Valley. After zoning you will still be riding the Devourer, which will make this quest much easier. Head south until you reach a burning forest. There you will find Ignus the Eternal. While approaching him watch out for Borrguus Blisterbark who patrols the area. Fighting both bosses at the same time will probably kill your team. Avoid the brightly burning trees, both upright and fallen, otherwise you will begin burning if you get too close. After you kill Ignus the Eternal head back to Captain Langmar for your reward.
60d8fca0dc9b0d11f3dcbdfe8d7c4bbeea010ccb.text: 完成此任務的最簡單方法是將旅行地圖繪製到 末日傳說神殿 並從那裡離開。從入口直接往南走，直到找到敵對的 Siege 蠍。殺死它和它的 夏爾 騎手，然後騎上它。向東南偏南方向前進，穿過 達拉達山地，到達 聖諾谷。分割區後，您仍將搭乘 蠍，這將使此任務變得更加容易。向南行駛，直到到達燃燒的森林。在那裡你會找到永恆的伊格努斯。接近他時，請留意在該區域巡邏的 風吼 柏格斯。同時與兩個老闆戰鬥可能會殺死你的團隊。避開燃燒的明亮樹木，無論是直立的還是倒下的，否則如果太近就會開始燃燒。殺死永恆者伊格努斯後，請返回 隊長連瑪 領取獎勵。
60d8fca0dc9b0d11f3dcbdfe8d7c4bbeea010ccb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e624799e670fb4d53ea7b03a77f3b6f078d2a02f.source: As you will be fighting lots of fire Elementalists, skills such as interrupts, Mantra of Flame and Ward Against Elements are good choices.
e624799e670fb4d53ea7b03a77f3b6f078d2a02f.text: 由於您將與大量火元素師戰鬥，因此中斷、火焰頌歌 和 元素結界 等技能是不錯的選擇。
e624799e670fb4d53ea7b03a77f3b6f078d2a02f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a5c947c521886d2d929ce3e67dfd149cce2b20b4.source: While Pyre Fierceshot is in range of any of the creatures spawned by the quest, he will automatically resurrect after approximately 3 seconds with the cry of "A false god stands before us. We shall see if it can stand against the harsh realities of my wrath!" If there are a lot of enemies surrounding him when this occurs he is likely to be overwhelmed very quickly by their numbers. It may be necessary to flag him a sufficient distance away so that the enemies that trigger this move away, allowing the party to resurrect fully at the active shrine.
a5c947c521886d2d929ce3e67dfd149cce2b20b4.text: 當 Pyre Fierceshot 處於該任務所產生的任何生物的範圍內時，他會在大約 3 秒後自動復活，並喊道「一個虛假的神站在我們面前。我們將看看它是否能抵抗我憤怒的嚴酷現實！」如果發生這種情況時他周圍有很多敵人，他很可能很快就會被他們的數量淹沒。可能有必要將他標記在足夠遠的距離，以便觸發此事件的敵人移開，從而使隊伍能夠在活躍的神殿中完全復活。
a5c947c521886d2d929ce3e67dfd149cce2b20b4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

96e29d49cdf287df0dd32f10bf1c9525e927ab4d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6b66e36bec64535f919cd35b180e791e697eb03a.source: Once you enter a Norn style ring, the gates will open and Bjorn Thunderfist will turn hostile to start the single round. You only need to Knock him out once to win.
6b66e36bec64535f919cd35b180e791e697eb03a.text: 一旦您進入 諾恩 風格的擂臺，大門就會開啟，Bjorn Thunderfist 將轉而敵對，開始單輪比賽。你只需要擊倒他一次即可獲勝。

7c120447cb0b94f376ca7c10e606d2f7cbefa280.source: The easiest way to win is by only auto-attacking without using any skills to build up adrenaline. Keep the Block up whenever possible and interrupt when you can. Use the uppercut, knockdown and combination punch to do damage. You may get knocked out numerous times while slowly wearing him down. Or simply use the skills as in a real boxing fight. Brawling Jab to break his Brawling Block defense and then a powerful skill.
7c120447cb0b94f376ca7c10e606d2f7cbefa280.text: 最簡單的獲勝方法是僅自動攻擊，而不使用任何技能來累積腎上腺素。盡可能保持阻塞狀態，並儘可能打斷。使用上勾拳、擊倒拳和組合拳來造成傷害。你可能會被擊倒無數次，同時慢慢地讓他疲憊不堪。或像在真正的拳擊比賽中一樣使用這些技能。鬥毆刺破他的鬥毆格擋防禦，然後是一個強大的技能。
7c120447cb0b94f376ca7c10e606d2f7cbefa280.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

78b624ea2a1237ee7d8fd010ecb8931ec988bf51.text: 前往 葛蘭迪法院 並與戰帥 Labofski 交談，瞭解如何協助防禦 泰坦 威脅。

16e95522b3591e4f35be530e48fc82673d049efa.source: The best strategy is to start out at Grendich Courthouse and travel to Flame Temple Corridor, killing any bosses encountered along the way for extra morale. Alternatively, it is possible to start from Yak's Bend to have a party of 6 members, but this requires to make your way through Traveler's Vale, Ascalon Foothills and Diessa Lowlands. In Flame Temple, you will encounter the Charr Lords. Pull them away from the patrols and take them on one group at a time, then continue on to the Dragon's Gullet.
16e95522b3591e4f35be530e48fc82673d049efa.text: 最好的策略是從 葛蘭迪法院 出發，前往 夏爾火焰神殿，殺死沿途遇到的所有 Boss 以獲取額外士氣。或者，也可以從 犛牛村 開始組成 6 成員隊伍，但這需要透過 旅人谷、阿斯卡隆丘陵 和 底耶沙低地。在火焰神殿中，您將會遇到 夏爾 領主。 拉出 他們遠離巡邏隊，一次帶領他們一組，然後繼續前往 巨龍峽灣。
16e95522b3591e4f35be530e48fc82673d049efa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

29be0a9c25ec49b79e93e8dfd85130bb3e97639b.source: Consider maxing out your morale before venturing into the lake itself.

29be0a9c25ec49b79e93e8dfd85130bb3e97639b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e97ecdb26f17c7c875f1fddba4d4b62f7f6aeb28.source: Enter the lake from the southeastern shore, northwest of the resurrection shrine that makes for a convenient restart spot should you wipe while fighting the Titan Lords. A pair of Hand and Fist of the Titans will pop out of the tar to greet you.
e97ecdb26f17c7c875f1fddba4d4b62f7f6aeb28.text: 從復活神殿西北部的東南岸進入湖泊，如果您在與 泰坦 領主戰鬥時進行擦拭，這裡將是一個方便的重新啟動點。一雙手和 泰坦之拳 會從焦油中彈出迎接您。
e97ecdb26f17c7c875f1fddba4d4b62f7f6aeb28.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

459945d93dc2fbedcd584913031825f55fe58f5f.source: In the lake, you will have to deal with the constant 30% reduction in speed from the Tar environment effect.
459945d93dc2fbedcd584913031825f55fe58f5f.text: 在湖中，您將不得不應對 瀝青 環境影響所導致的 30% 速度不斷降低的問題。
459945d93dc2fbedcd584913031825f55fe58f5f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aada8d09d836c841292b23d237573777e2d47253.source: After you deal with the popups, you need to take out a number of titan patrols that circle the bosses. The patrols are made up of more Hands and Fists, and also Sparks of the Titans and Risen Ashen Hulks; the sparks should be your priority target as they are capable of some extremely lethal Fire Magic. The Risen Hulks are the least dangerous, and should be left for last as they split into another pair of Hand and Fist when they die.
aada8d09d836c841292b23d237573777e2d47253.text: 處理完彈出視窗後，您需要消滅圍繞 Boss 的大量泰坦巡邏隊。巡邏隊由更多的手和拳頭組成，還有泰坦火花和復活的灰燼浩克；火花應該是你的首要目標，因為它們能夠造成極其致命的 火系魔法。復活的綠巨人是最不危險的，應該留在最後，因為他們死後會分裂成另一個對手和拳頭。
aada8d09d836c841292b23d237573777e2d47253.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5af0d3259da249da01098005383649ec5358c89b.source: A second group of pop-up warrior titans will greet you in the southwest corner of the lake.
5af0d3259da249da01098005383649ec5358c89b.text: 第二組彈出的泰坦戰士將在湖的西南角迎接您。
5af0d3259da249da01098005383649ec5358c89b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2bac44af37200285809b526283951c4da357a4d7.source: After the lake has been cleared of patrols, it is time to complete the main objective. In the center of the lake are three Titan bosses: the Titan Lords you were sent here to dispatch. Among their ranks is a small group of Charr Lords. A good tactic is to kill the Charr Lords first then go for the Titans.

c89dc9ae9905af9b6b79fe5764712e00dd59c1f2.source: Keeper Jinyssa transports you to the mission location. There is a one minute countdown timer before the first wave spawns. Your allies consist of one Forgotten Sage and three Forgotten Cursebearers to the northeast, one Forgotten Sage and three Forgotten Illusionists to the southwest and two Forgotten Sages, one Forgotten Arcanist and Keeper Jinyssa, a Mesmer, in the center. Waves attack from the northeast and southwest, with four groups in each wave and pauses between waves. Keeper Jinyssa dies easily if the player aggroes the attackers. Blades of Corruption, Rains of Terror, Scythes of Chaos and Margonite Sorcerers are particularly dangerous due to their high damage capacity.
c89dc9ae9905af9b6b79fe5764712e00dd59c1f2.text: 守護者吉妮莎將帶您前往任務地點。在第一波出現之前有一個一分鐘的倒數計時器。你的盟友包括東北方的一名 被遺忘的賢者 和三名 被遺忘者 咒語者，西南方向的一名 被遺忘的賢者 和三名 被遺忘者 幻術師，以及中間的兩名 被遺忘者 賢者，一名 被遺忘的秘術士 和守護者 Jinyssa（一名 幻術師）。波浪從東北和西南方向進攻，每波有四組，每波之間有停頓。如果玩家攻擊攻擊者，守門員吉妮薩很容易死亡。腐化之刃、恐怖之雨、混沌之鐮和 瑪骨奈 巫師因其高傷害能力而特別危險。

1f6f44cbfb62d8929211918e67ebeed424ccad8b.source: "So, you win a few duels and kill a few monsters and you think you have what it takes to be an Elementalist. Well, then, I have a task for you... a simple thing to be sure. Take this Stone of the Elements to Kupah Beach in Kinya Province. There you will find a stone pedestal. Place the Stone of the Elements upon the stone pedestal, and then return to me. It sounds straightforward, does it not? Just remember that the destination is often less important than the journey."
1f6f44cbfb62d8929211918e67ebeed424ccad8b.text: 「所以，你贏得了幾場決鬥並殺死了一些怪物，你認為你具備成為 元素使 所需的條件。那麼，我有一個任務給你......這是一個簡單的事情。把這塊元素之石帶到 欣彌領地 的庫帕海灘。在那裡你會發現一個石基座。將元素之石放在石基座上，只要回到我身邊，這聽起來更簡單嗎？

e7e32f361a039da481b0a22cb8be58be66b975d4.source: Ulrik is almost directly outside of Yak's Bend. He uses enchantment spells to boost his armor rating, so consider bringing enchantment removal skills. If these haven't been obtained yet, the henchman Dunham is equipped with Drain Enchantment. Ulrik's armor-boosting enchantments are Armor of Earth and Kinetic Armor, both of which apply bonus armor rating, and therefore do not stack. The largest bonus will be that of Kinetic Armor. As expected of a Mesmer quest, skills such as Backfire and armor-ignoring damage skills work wonders. Melee attack-oriented skill bars face not only Ulrik's armor bonus, but also Ward Against Melee. When Ulrik is defeated, return to Sebedoh in Yak's Bend.
e7e32f361a039da481b0a22cb8be58be66b975d4.text: Ulrik 幾乎直接位於 犛牛村 之外。他使用結界法術來提高他的護甲等級，所以考慮帶上結界移除技能。如果尚未獲得這些，則追隨者 得恩韓 將配備 加持吸收。烏爾裡克的護甲增強結界是 地之護甲 和 魔動護甲，兩者都適用額外護甲等級，因此不會疊加。最大的獎勵將是 魔動護甲。正如 幻術師 任務所期望的那樣，魔力反噬 等技能和無視護甲的傷害技能會產生奇蹟。 肉搏 攻擊型技能欄不僅面對烏爾裡克的護甲加成，也面對 迴避結界。當烏爾裡克被擊敗後，返回 犛牛村 中的塞貝多。

5322113fb8cc3968fc51c6d3f225bd24cd5b168c.text: 調查占卜池中失去光澤的徽章。
5322113fb8cc3968fc51c6d3f225bd24cd5b168c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5c8c4f238d6c7636b83af4f541e9d0d468675881.source: The Tarnished Emblem is located at the resurrection shrine as you enter Majesty's Rest from Sage Lands.
5c8c4f238d6c7636b83af4f541e9d0d468675881.text: 當您從 賢者領地 進入 王者安息處 時，失去光澤的徽章位於復活神殿處。
5c8c4f238d6c7636b83af4f541e9d0d468675881.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c290d1bb36d67f37e1b3d87f371edefec348babf.source: This quest is part of Hearts of the North, the second installment in Guild Wars Beyond.
c290d1bb36d67f37e1b3d87f371edefec348babf.text: 此任務是 極地之心 的一部分，激戰Beyond 的第二部分。
c290d1bb36d67f37e1b3d87f371edefec348babf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

594f22c12e48b6d2ce2e8ba7c6fb0c09b8201035.source: Something on the ground catches your eye. It is faint, covered in dirt, and stained with old blood. Closer inspection reveals it to be the tarnished emblem of a high-ranking White Mantle member. What happened here? Perhaps the scrying pool can provide further answers.
594f22c12e48b6d2ce2e8ba7c6fb0c09b8201035.text: 地上的東西引起了你的注意。它很微弱，佈滿了泥土，還沾滿了陳舊的血跡。仔細觀察後發現，它是 白斗篷 資深成員的玷汙徽章。這裡發生了什麼事？也許占卜池可以提供進一步的答案。
594f22c12e48b6d2ce2e8ba7c6fb0c09b8201035.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a4d6d39341f0c330c45862e5bb06675ba4c6bc79.source: Speak to the Master of Paths on the Isle of the Nameless.
a4d6d39341f0c330c45862e5bb06675ba4c6bc79.text: 與 無名島 上的路徑大師交談。
a4d6d39341f0c330c45862e5bb06675ba4c6bc79.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6c1c40e93e9a53b39393b2a229ed42b6cdfa9b14.source: Defeat all four arenas consecutively from outside the Great Temple of Balthazar.
6c1c40e93e9a53b39393b2a229ed42b6cdfa9b14.text: 從 巴薩澤聖殿 之外連續擊敗所有四個競技場。
6c1c40e93e9a53b39393b2a229ed42b6cdfa9b14.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

350579545b27c8b2f437df249fc62cc600cded06.text: 在 Zaishen 挑戰賽 據點 中向挑戰大師 Rioka 報到。
350579545b27c8b2f437df249fc62cc600cded06.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

255fb678c4fb64df763aea7bf0a724d977c54594.source: Unlocks the Zaishen Challenge outpost for the account.
255fb678c4fb64df763aea7bf0a724d977c54594.text: 解鎖該帳號的 Zaishen 挑戰前哨站。
255fb678c4fb64df763aea7bf0a724d977c54594.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

59e10ed93917adc20c710776bda5042b781317ac.source: Waves 1, 2, and 3, have three groups of enemies each. Wave 4 has four groups. Wave 5 is the last wave, and has three groups, the last group being the Bone Dragon and a Damned Cleric.
59e10ed93917adc20c710776bda5042b781317ac.text: 1、2 和 3 波各有三組敵人。 Wave 4 有四組。 5 波是最後一個波，有三組，最後一組是 骸骨龍 和 地獄牧師。
59e10ed93917adc20c710776bda5042b781317ac.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1f53c00528a8cea25a7ce45f5629615ea18fdb91.source: You only need to kill the last group of each wave to trigger the next wave to come. For the last wave, the final group is the Bone Dragon with a Cleric, and upon killing them, the quest will complete.
1f53c00528a8cea25a7ce45f5629615ea18fdb91.text: 你只需要殺死每一波的最後一組即可觸發下一波的到來。對於最後一波，最後一組是帶有牧師的 骸骨龍，殺死他們後任務就會完成。
1f53c00528a8cea25a7ce45f5629615ea18fdb91.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

033896f7e6cbeacf505c3e5ad3481c6c8031c36e.source: Abandon the quest after completing it and take it again to farm items during times with special drops, such as Wintersday, Halloween, etc.
033896f7e6cbeacf505c3e5ad3481c6c8031c36e.text: 完成任務後放棄任務，並在有特殊掉落的時期再次帶它去農場物品，例如 Wintersday、激戰萬聖節 等。
033896f7e6cbeacf505c3e5ad3481c6c8031c36e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1e7971c21a5e1d52f9f3e93a6023128e5512900a.source: On some of the groups, there are a large number of Level 1 and Level 3 enemies. It might be better to take them out quickly, to reduce the number of targets, and also to make it easier to concentrate your entire party's attack damage on the higher level monsters.
1e7971c21a5e1d52f9f3e93a6023128e5512900a.text: 在某些群體中，有大量 1 級和 3 級敵人。最好儘快消滅它們，這樣可以減少目標數量，也可以更容易地將全隊的攻擊力集中在更高等級的怪物身上。
1e7971c21a5e1d52f9f3e93a6023128e5512900a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

801304e1fa7268cdb2bae3b78ed57d8a3b3ac974.source: In the War in Kryta environment you may not need to fight at all: wait a few minutes near a quest mark until 2 groups of Peacekeepers kill all quest foes, then go after the reward.
801304e1fa7268cdb2bae3b78ed57d8a3b3ac974.text: 在 科瑞塔戰爭 環境中，您可能根本不需要戰鬥：在任務標記附近等待幾分鐘，直到 2 的和平衛士組殺死所有任務敵人，然後去追求獎勵。
801304e1fa7268cdb2bae3b78ed57d8a3b3ac974.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4b4b78dedf59e3d46ace09e067fcf9f0b19b4b6f.source: If you don't succeed in stopping them you can just be resurrected nearby and return to finish the job, as the hordes will just wait at the Beetletun gates.
4b4b78dedf59e3d46ace09e067fcf9f0b19b4b6f.text: 如果你沒有成功阻止他們，你可以在附近復活並返回完成任務，因為部落只會在 甲蟲鎮 門口等待。
4b4b78dedf59e3d46ace09e067fcf9f0b19b4b6f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1c161fb633413fd8b30778841eeb213137c78337.source: If you wait right in front of the gates, the large group of NPCs will engage the enemies as well and they do not need to survive for the quest to complete.
1c161fb633413fd8b30778841eeb213137c78337.text: 如果你在門前等待，一大群 NPC 也會與敵人交戰，他們不需要生存就能完成任務。
1c161fb633413fd8b30778841eeb213137c78337.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4f968644e137e5ce27268884bec5368ac2432e95.source: Seek out Galrath at the wizard's tower in Kessex Peak. Put an end to his villainy.
4f968644e137e5ce27268884bec5368ac2432e95.text: 在 凱席斯山峰 的法師塔中尋找 加拉斯。制止他的惡行。
4f968644e137e5ce27268884bec5368ac2432e95.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5844b78ce33cfd76d0b97a80d6030e1785ddbb09.source: Return to Firstwatch Sergio for your reward.
5844b78ce33cfd76d0b97a80d6030e1785ddbb09.text: 影返 至 警衛隊長薩吉歐 以獲得獎勵。
5844b78ce33cfd76d0b97a80d6030e1785ddbb09.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fdf48a0b1be712d733071afbc24674acd3233e07.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1a4487e22e27c0b16d66cd0bf2ab0123eb30a375.text: 狂怒 長劍 堅韌

0cae4ff84b330316b539ed6a2f401a182fc2fe02.text: 削減傷害：13-19（需要6 精通劍術）
0cae4ff84b330316b539ed6a2f401a182fc2fe02.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6f83008addd13bd69903436d53e2de9121dc3b8c.source: Starting from the Temple of the Ages (in order to have a maximum party size of 8) head south through The Black Curtain towards Kessex Peak. You will immediately encounter a group of Reed Stalkers. After defeating the Stalkers follow the path leading to the southeast, making sure to avoid the poisonous water whenever possible. You will soon come upon a Damned Cleric, who once aggroed will be accompanied by Smoke Phantoms and a Wraith. Be sure to dispatch these foes quickly or pull them to the west, because a group of Hellhounds and a Necrid Horseman will be patrolling the area.
6f83008addd13bd69903436d53e2de9121dc3b8c.text: 從 世紀神殿 出發（以便最大隊伍規模為 8）向南穿過 黑色帷幕 前往 凱席斯山峰。你會立即遇到一群蘆葦追獵者。擊敗潛行者後，沿著通往東南方的道路前進，確保盡可能避開毒水。你很快就會遇到 地獄牧師，一旦被攻擊，就會有煙霧幻影和幽靈陪伴。一定要快速消滅這些敵人或將他們拉到西邊，因為一群地獄犬和 那奎德騎師 將在該地區巡邏。
6f83008addd13bd69903436d53e2de9121dc3b8c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a31f0d3a3092d92c447735abcbac30fb0f084b0b.source: Continue following the path to the southeast, making sure to watch for more Undead, until you come to a three-way intersection. Take the southern path where you will soon run out of land and be forced to head west to circle around the poisonous swamp. You will encounter a group of Ancient Oakheart, possibly including the Tree of Judgment, as well as some Bog Skale Blighters and the occasional Spined Aloe.
a31f0d3a3092d92c447735abcbac30fb0f084b0b.text: 繼續沿著小路向東南方向行駛，確保留意更多 不死系，直到到達一個三向交叉路口。走南邊的小路，你很快就會耗盡土地，被迫向西繞過有毒的沼澤。您將遇到一群 成年橡樹妖，可能包括審判樹，以及一些 泥鱗怪 暴徒和偶爾的 刺突蘆薈。
a31f0d3a3092d92c447735abcbac30fb0f084b0b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4c8c2351a06f77f4ab5cc745e5ad9cb636430e8a.source: When you come upon a path follow it to the east, being sure to cross over the bridge to avoid the fetid water. You will come upon another group of Reed Stalkers as well as several Forest Minotaurs. Continue heading east until you reach the portal to Kessex Peak.
4c8c2351a06f77f4ab5cc745e5ad9cb636430e8a.text: 當你遇到一條小路時，沿著它向東走，一定要過橋，以避免惡臭的水。您將遇到另一群蘆葦追獵者以及幾隻森林牛頭怪。繼續向東行駛，直到到達 凱席斯山峰 的傳送門。
4c8c2351a06f77f4ab5cc745e5ad9cb636430e8a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e356f688bf7591dcf74dc7b31f1713c86e750196.source: In Kessex Peak, continue south, passing over the next bridge where you will encounter some Fog Nightmares and more Reed Stalkers. After dispatching the monsters turn towards the southwest and follow the canyon towards the Krytan coast. Be sure to watch out for Nightmares and Aloes that will pop out of the ground while you fight the Reed Stalkers that patrol the canyon.
e356f688bf7591dcf74dc7b31f1713c86e750196.text: 在 凱席斯山峰 中，繼續向南，經過下一座橋，在那裡您會遇到一些霧夢魘和更多蘆葦追獵者。消滅怪物後轉向西南方，沿著峽谷前往科瑞塔海岸。當你與在峽谷巡邏的蘆葦追獵者戰鬥時，一定要小心從地下冒出來的夢魘和蘆薈。
e356f688bf7591dcf74dc7b31f1713c86e750196.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6bb528e8f62748eddf3c1438cf6da8a5db496275.source: Once you reach the end of the canyon turn south on the nearby path. Fen Trolls will be patrolling the path along with Ancient Oakhearts, and Forest Minotaurs. The Trolls and Minotaurs have very large patrol areas, so be especially careful not to find yourself stuck between two groups of enemies. When you come to the area where there are about 20 of them guarding the path, study their pattern of movement and aggro them from the north, one group at a time. Continue to follow the path to the southwest until you come to a floating castle overlooking a plateau. Head east until you come to a path leading up to where Galrath and his bandits are waiting.
6bb528e8f62748eddf3c1438cf6da8a5db496275.text: 到達峽谷盡頭後，沿著附近的小路往南行駛。沼澤巨魔將與古代橡心樹和森林牛頭怪一起在道路上巡邏。巨魔和牛頭怪的巡邏區域非常大，所以要特別小心，不要發現自己被困在兩群敵人之間。當你到達大約有 20 的敵人守護道路的區域時，研究他們的行動模式並從北面攻擊他們，一次一組。繼續沿著小路向西南方向行駛，直到到達一座俯瞰高原的漂浮城堡。向東行駛，直到來到一條通往 加拉斯 和他的強盜等待的小路。
6bb528e8f62748eddf3c1438cf6da8a5db496275.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

345bad51416438d4cb1d303226c753862feea941.source: You will find large groups of Verata the Necromancer's cultists blocking your path. Be careful to only aggro one group at a time; dispatching Verata's army is not easy and aggroing more than one group means almost certain death for lower-level groups or henchmen. If players or henchmen have obtained a high death penalty it may be very difficult to kill even one group. If this happens, it is possible with the right timing to slip past the cult and engage Galrath and his bandits. The Apprentices of Verata will spawn Bone Fiends so a Necromancer with corpse exploitation skills of their own can be very useful. A minion master may not be the best however, as the Apprentices will use Verata's Gaze to steal your minions. After defeating the cultists, head west and kill the bandits before taking on Galrath himself.
345bad51416438d4cb1d303226c753862feea941.text: 您會發現一大群 死靈法師 芙瑞達 的信徒擋住了您的道路。小心一次只能攻擊一組；派遣 芙瑞達 的軍隊並不容易，而且攻擊多個團體意味著低階團體或追隨者幾乎肯定會死亡。如果玩家或追隨者獲得了很高的死刑，那麼即使是殺死一群人也可能非常困難。如果發生這種情況，就有可能在正確的時機溜過邪教並與 加拉斯 和他的強盜交戰。 芙瑞達 的學徒會生成骨魔，因此擁有自己的屍體開發技能的 死靈法師 會非常有用。然而，小兵大師可能不是最好的，因為學徒會使用 芙瑞達的凝視 來偷走你的小兵。擊敗邪教徒後，向西前進並殺死強盜，然後親自對抗 加拉斯。
345bad51416438d4cb1d303226c753862feea941.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6ba86e0e43c29b0dc7b6822df4fed7e703586c92.source: Once you have killed Galrath, simply map travel to Lion's Arch and see Sergio for your reward.
6ba86e0e43c29b0dc7b6822df4fed7e703586c92.text: 殺死 加拉斯 後，只需將旅行對映到 獅子拱門 即可看到 Sergio 領取獎勵。
6ba86e0e43c29b0dc7b6822df4fed7e703586c92.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9efd033eeffe525f390b80e8217de3f8c1cd4c85.source: You may be able to find easier groups to fight through if, once you get to the main plateau area, you follow the northern edge from west to east, then south along the eastern edge along a path inhabited by a few Hill Giants. This path will also aid you if you are working on the cartographer title.
9efd033eeffe525f390b80e8217de3f8c1cd4c85.text: 如果你到達主要高原區域後，沿著北部邊緣從西到東，然後沿著東部邊緣向南，沿著一條居住著一些山丘巨人的小路，你可能會找到更容易戰鬥的隊伍。如果您正在研究製圖師頭銜，此路徑也會對您有所幫助。
9efd033eeffe525f390b80e8217de3f8c1cd4c85.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c01808636fbd38100218b5679451c2410951a69d.source: Similarly, pulling some of the groups away from the plateau may make the task of reaching Galrath slightly easier.
c01808636fbd38100218b5679451c2410951a69d.text: 同樣，將一些群體拉離高原可能會使達到 加拉斯 的任務稍微容易。
c01808636fbd38100218b5679451c2410951a69d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5d5a561107ec1a869c0413baa485ffa1a4db3e8e.source: The Long Sword which is given as a reward has a 10% furious mod which can be salvaged.
5d5a561107ec1a869c0413baa485ffa1a4db3e8e.text: 作為獎勵給予的 長劍 有一個可以回收的 10% furious mod。
5d5a561107ec1a869c0413baa485ffa1a4db3e8e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

13c3d8535b9acfcf4df6154705ac607f0b03ea1b.source: You do not need to kill every bandit to complete the quest, although it does make it easier to kill Galrath.
13c3d8535b9acfcf4df6154705ac607f0b03ea1b.text: 你不需要殺死每個強盜來完成任務，儘管它確實讓殺死 加拉斯 變得更容易。
13c3d8535b9acfcf4df6154705ac607f0b03ea1b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ba1d1bebab2dcf669f0ad2a89799bc9083a2df94.source: Bringing Frozen Soil can help to suppress resurrection by White Mantle foes if the War in Kryta is active, as well as by Shepherds of Verata.
ba1d1bebab2dcf669f0ad2a89799bc9083a2df94.text: 如果 科瑞塔戰爭 處於活動狀態，攜帶 凍土 可以協助抑制 白斗篷 敵人的復活，以及 芙瑞達 牧羊人的復活。
ba1d1bebab2dcf669f0ad2a89799bc9083a2df94.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7e517bd74c16cf6b6f84689c3f1497560917df05.source: For the route to Galrath, see The Villainy of Galrath. He is surrounded by several groups of level 30 bandits. Careful pulling of these mobs is essential to avoid being overwhelmed. Be aware that the mobs tend to aggro simultaneously, so be prepared to conduct long pulls to string them out.
7e517bd74c16cf6b6f84689c3f1497560917df05.text: 有關至 加拉斯 的路由，請參閱 加拉斯的陰謀。他被幾組 30 等級的強盜包圍。小心地拉動這些小怪對於避免被淹沒至關重要。請注意，小怪往往會同時仇恨，因此請準備好進行長時間的拉力以將它們拉出去。
7e517bd74c16cf6b6f84689c3f1497560917df05.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a2ecc3ece871f54330bf78f3e0170dc2921bede1.source: It is possible to engage the bandits from the foot of the cliff, where the path emerges from the northern valley. The main damage-dealers are melee assassins, so this can trim their numbers down with less risk to your party. You can also lure them into Verata's cultists, who are occupying the lower slopes of the hill; the ensuing fight will usually see the cultists quickly defeated, saving you some work in clearing the way to Galrath.

Proceed with caution even if things look clear or you can be quickly overwhelmed.

a876527f331be3134772a7789ac39167e47bd636.source: Do not attack the Wailing Lord. You will be kicked out of the Fissure if he dies. Beware that because he's hostile he will take AoE damage and will be attacked by minions (if you have any). It is best to pull the Banshees, and any other enemy, across the bridge to ensure the Wailing Lord is unharmed.
a876527f331be3134772a7789ac39167e47bd636.text: 不要攻擊哀嚎領主。如果他死了，你就會被踢出裂縫。請注意，因為他是敵對的，所以他會受到 範圍性 傷害，並且會受到小兵（如果有的話）的攻擊。最好將女妖和其他敵人拉過橋，以確保哀嚎領主不受傷害。

93de9450d8f7322b51f3872085662b008ba0946a.source: Head south from Destiny's Gorge into The Scar until you reach a teleporter where groups of hydras patrol. Use the teleporter to enter the gorge. Losaru groups will be patrolling the oasis with a boss in the center. To avoid being overwhelmed, pull each group away from the others before killing them. Continue southeast until you reach a small river, and then head east until you get to an open area. The Orshad Chieftain will be in the center surrounded by patrols. Again, pull the groups one by one. Defeat the chieftain and then return to Agastos the Brave for your reward.
93de9450d8f7322b51f3872085662b008ba0946a.text: 從 命運峽谷 向南進入 斷崖，直到到達傳送點，那裡有成群的九頭蛇巡邏。使用傳送器進入峽谷。 羅沙魯 小組將在綠洲巡邏，首領位於中心。為了避免被淹沒，在殺死他們之前將每個小組從其他小組中拉開。繼續向東南方向行駛，直到到達一條小河，然後向東行駛，直到到達一片開闊區域。 奧夏得首領 將位於中心，周圍有巡邏人員。再次，將各組一一拉。擊敗酋長，然後返回 勇士阿加多斯 獲取獎勵。

6ca57d6ec4253eea97fcadbe7bf52c3ddb8ed08c.source: For those who have difficulty with hydras, an easier route is from the Thirsty River. There is a hidden entrance into the gorge to the extreme west of where the path opens up. Hug the southern wall and you will turn northward passing under a rope bridge guarded by a Dune Burrower at each end. This route is somewhat shorter as well, and there are 3 Losaru bosses that are fairly easy to kill, providing a nice +6% to your morale. An image of this route can be found on the discussion page.
6ca57d6ec4253eea97fcadbe7bf52c3ddb8ed08c.text: 對於那些對九頭蛇有困難的人來說，更簡單的路線是 乾枯河流。在小徑的最西端有一個通往峽谷的隱藏入口。緊靠南牆，您將向北轉過一座繩橋，繩橋兩端都有 沙漠鑽地蟲 守衛。這條路線也較短，並且有相當容易殺死的 3 羅沙魯 boss，為您計程車氣提供了一個很好的 +6%。可以在討論頁面上找到該路線的影像。

Alternatively, you can find large numbers of Hulking Stone Elementals in Old Ascalon without any Stone Elemental elementalists accompanying them.

Alternatively, you can barter for one with local collectors: trade 5 skale fins to Brownlow or 3 dull carapaces to Rownan.

f3d0dac97f315f9c0d20e0e153d3efcc1ce6b5af.source: After leaving from The Marketplace head east. You will encounter two groups of Am Fah after crossing the second of two bridges (1). Try to engage only one group at a time, but don't worry, if your party wipes you will be resurrected nearby. After defeating the two groups of Am Fah continue to head east. You will come into contact with two more manageably placed groups of Am Fah as well as a statue of Balthazar (2) that you can kneel in front of to give your team a boost. After killing the Am Fah enter a small alcove to the east. Once inside you will encounter a group of Am Fah guarding the Storage Chest (3). As soon as you attack the Am Fah more enemies will fall from the ceiling, so be ready for a fight.
f3d0dac97f315f9c0d20e0e153d3efcc1ce6b5af.text: 從 市集 出發後向東行駛。穿過兩座橋中的第二座橋 (1) 後，您將遇到兩組 安費。嘗試一次只與一組交戰，但不用擔心，如果你的隊伍消滅了你，你會在附近復活。擊敗安費的兩組後繼續向東進發。您將接觸到兩組更容易管理的 安費 以及 巴薩澤 (2) 的雕像，您可以跪在它前面為您的團隊提供動力。殺死 安費 後，進入東邊的一個小壁龕。進入後，您會遇到一群 安費 守衛 個人倉庫 寶箱 (3)。一旦您攻擊 安費，就會有更多敵人從天花板上掉下來，因此請做好戰鬥準備。

It's best that, before escorting Alionseh to Camp Hojanu, your party would kill all the monsters along the path to avoid her dying because she is only a level 10 monk. Be wary not to let her lag too far behind, as she has no regard for the aggro range of monsters, leading to her quick demise.

At the final checkpoint, it will initially be two NPCs having a conversation, before a quest trigger turns them hostile. Defeat the two bosses to complete this quest.

b5c6876cb6d84c55c541b91ef9edcd19709be7d8.text: 一旦任務標記處的隊伍被消滅，就可以沿著你的到達路徑撤退，並單獨與那一端的重生戰鬥，從而避免敵人的夾擊運動。一旦不再有敵人出現，就回到標記處與來自另一邊的敵人戰鬥。
