38e6ae0f390911088f42a8c737363d73527ec299.source: The foes at the eastern end sometimes get stuck indefinitely on a Vabbi Chest which spawns in that narrow passage, so waiting at the quest marker can be fruitless. Simply travel out and tackle them at their sticking point.
38e6ae0f390911088f42a8c737363d73527ec299.text: 東端的敵人有時會無限期地卡在狹窄通道中生成的 瓦貝 寶箱 上，因此在任務標記處等待可能是徒勞無功的。只需出去並解決他們的癥結即可。
38e6ae0f390911088f42a8c737363d73527ec299.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b2e95764abd60445f3c76b16fb905616d9a7c9bb.source: Rescue the Order of Whispers company trapped behind enemy lines.
b2e95764abd60445f3c76b16fb905616d9a7c9bb.text: 營救被困在敵後的密語教團連。
b2e95764abd60445f3c76b16fb905616d9a7c9bb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3bfbb6f6d3a2724a9d71308a7778186338b9ee6f.text: 在惡魔大軍的襲擊中倖存下來。
3bfbb6f6d3a2724a9d71308a7778186338b9ee6f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

efa7e06b202c31fc55fb7461cc5e3e74e7a25218.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4f1dbab13370449366cb56bd6cd4c45abbcbbf42.source: See Warden of Whispers for your reward.
4f1dbab13370449366cb56bd6cd4c45abbcbbf42.text: 前往密語典獄長處領取獎勵。
4f1dbab13370449366cb56bd6cd4c45abbcbbf42.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

de246562997ded19af1a6589ff65b77c5fcc6fe3.source: After accepting the quest, pick up the Shard of Brilliance if you want, it will give a little light, although it's not essential. As you leave the short passageway, notice a group of Order of Whispers standing out front. As you approach, four groups of three Torment creatures each will charge that position. Defend yourselves.
de246562997ded19af1a6589ff65b77c5fcc6fe3.text: 接受任務後，如果你願意的話，可以撿起光輝碎片，它會發出一點光，儘管這不是必需的。當你離開短通道時，注意到一群低語教團站在前面。當你接近時，四組每組三個折磨生物將衝向該位置。保衛自己。
de246562997ded19af1a6589ff65b77c5fcc6fe3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

010f669e7553d1772fd5fcd4e8e0de6f0cee60fb.source: Follow the quest marker to the west, pulling and taking out patrols as necessary. There are groups of Order of Whispers and Torment creatures at several locations. At each one, they will begin fighting as you approach. Helping them is optional, since the survivors won't follow you anyway.
010f669e7553d1772fd5fcd4e8e0de6f0cee60fb.text: 沿著任務標記向西走，根據需要拉動和消滅巡邏隊。在幾個地點有成群的低語教團和折磨生物。在每一個地方，當你接近時，他們都會開始戰鬥。幫助他們是可選的，因為倖存者無論如何都不會跟隨你。
010f669e7553d1772fd5fcd4e8e0de6f0cee60fb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bebbcbf3a4b07891b23210799f6b5cf01391cf43.source: Once you reach the quest marker where the Warden of Whispers and four Order of Whispers are, the waves will start coming. Each wave consists of 3 Torment creatures of the same profession. The waves come fast, and gets even faster towards the end. Your party must be able to dispatch each wave as quickly as possible before the numbers become overwhelming. The NPCs are of little help except as corpses, but take note that the Warden of Whispers inside the cave must survive.
bebbcbf3a4b07891b23210799f6b5cf01391cf43.text: 一旦你到達低語守望者和四個低語騎士團所在的任務標記，波浪就會開始到來。每波由相同職業的 3 折磨生物組成。海浪來得很快，到最後會變得更快。你的隊伍必須能夠在人數變得壓倒性之前盡快派遣每一波。除了屍體之外，NPC 幾乎沒有什麼幫助，但請注意，洞穴內的低語守衛必須生存。
bebbcbf3a4b07891b23210799f6b5cf01391cf43.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bfab312d28f7dcba7d348502683b2cf139bdd250.source: Depending on your style, it is also possible to intercept the Torment creatures outside the cave, in order to have a wider battlefield. This is quite risky as the NPCs inside that cave cannot survive even one group.
bfab312d28f7dcba7d348502683b2cf139bdd250.text: 根據你的風格，還可以攔截洞穴外的折磨生物，以便擁有更廣闊的戰場。這是相當危險的，那個洞穴裡的NPC連一群都無法生存。
bfab312d28f7dcba7d348502683b2cf139bdd250.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c6c1f4f17cc8b0c71e8327d993050e033a29e309.source: If you enter the cave where the Warden of Whispers is prior to starting the quest, the waves of torment creatures will attack before you can reach the Warden, making it next to impossible to succeed.
c6c1f4f17cc8b0c71e8327d993050e033a29e309.text: 如果你在開始任務之前進入低語守望者所在的洞穴，一波又一波的折磨生物會在你到達守望者之前發動攻擊，這使得任務幾乎不可能成功。
c6c1f4f17cc8b0c71e8327d993050e033a29e309.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

58f1d0e596ad78aaa86196f66eccfce5190f6b04.source: Deliver Master Togo's ultimatum to Captain Quimang.
58f1d0e596ad78aaa86196f66eccfce5190f6b04.text: 將 藤吾大師 的最後通牒交給 Quimang 隊長。
58f1d0e596ad78aaa86196f66eccfce5190f6b04.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ea1ecd681eef39a3dff56d0a75568dbc1051a61e.source: This quest is relatively easy to complete. Basically, you have to walk to Port Kaimu, where Captain Quimang and his group are hanging out. Upon leaving Tsumei Village, Port Kaimu is to the Southwest (as the crow flies). You can follow the Southwest path, or go across Qi Falls near Ang the Ephemeral, and then turn South.
ea1ecd681eef39a3dff56d0a75568dbc1051a61e.text: 這個任務相對容易完成。基本上，你必須步行到凱姆港，奎芒船長和他的團隊在那裡閒逛。離開 蘇梅村 後，凱穆港位於西南方（直線方向）。你可以沿著西南方向走，或者穿過短命昂附近的氣瀑布，然後向南轉。
ea1ecd681eef39a3dff56d0a75568dbc1051a61e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9a6d42ebf20e51f4616e559b58f66a23212745ed.source: You will probably encounter various groups of Kappa and the occasional hostile group of Crimson Skull along your travel. Once you get closer to the Port, the Crimson Skull pirates present will not be hostile, and will let you deliver the message and leave in peace.
9a6d42ebf20e51f4616e559b58f66a23212745ed.text: 在旅途中，您可能會遇到各種河童群體，偶爾也會遇到敵對的 紅顱 群體。一旦你接近港口，在場的紅顱海盜不會有敵意，會讓你傳遞訊息並安心離開。
9a6d42ebf20e51f4616e559b58f66a23212745ed.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

08fff4b1a3576611066e9ff57c4aee4794ba0c50.source: Captain Quimang and his men do not become hostile when given the ultimatum. If you can get to him, this quest is Survivor-safe. The only potential problem is the groups of Crimson Skull you encounter before getting to Port Kaimu, where Captain Quimang is.
08fff4b1a3576611066e9ff57c4aee4794ba0c50.text: 當收到最後通牒時，基芒上尉和他的部下並沒有變得敵對。如果你能找到他，這個任務就是 生存者 安全的。唯一潛在的問題是你在到達 Quimang 船長所在的凱穆港之前遇到的 紅顱 群體。
08fff4b1a3576611066e9ff57c4aee4794ba0c50.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bcad939c1b91bd4d60ccd70c3eae6e686a7b77ec.text: 等到孫祖和中井的對話結束。

36aad4a563e81b9189bde60c200a5336b520c632.source: Nakai and Sunzu can initially be found in Bukdek Byway, east of The Marketplace: you will need to head east from the Marketplace over the bridge where the merchants and peasants are located, then double back over a shorter bridge south of this one.
36aad4a563e81b9189bde60c200a5336b520c632.text: Nakai 和 Sunzu 最初可以在 市集 以東的 巴德克小徑 中找到：您需要從市場向東走，越過商人和農民所在的橋，然後從橋以南的一座較短的橋返回。
36aad4a563e81b9189bde60c200a5336b520c632.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a9fb084be258caf50c16f5c14d9ebf1010799e9c.source: When your party approaches them, Nakai and Sunzu will have an argument about the debt Mitah owes, then Sunzu will run off back over the bridge towards Mitah. When Sunzu has gone far enough, Nakai will offer this quest.
a9fb084be258caf50c16f5c14d9ebf1010799e9c.text: 當你的隊伍接近他們時，中井和孫祖會因為米塔所欠的債務發生爭執，然後孫祖會從橋上跑回米塔。當孫祖走得夠遠時，中井就會提供這個任務。
a9fb084be258caf50c16f5c14d9ebf1010799e9c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1fa3e27ab2c9052233eda17ac8f16cb10c4bf3c2.source: Head back to Mitah and Sunzu and speak to them in turn, and decide which of Sunzu's choices for the debt fix you prefer, either pay up 250 gold to help out Mitah, or refuse and kill Sunzu. If you refuse, and choose to kill Sunzu, a group of Jade Brotherhood members will appear (3 Mages and 1 Mesmer) and Sunzu himself will turn hostile and attack.
1fa3e27ab2c9052233eda17ac8f16cb10c4bf3c2.text: 返回 Mitah 和 Sunzu，依次與他們交談，並決定您更喜歡 Sunzu 的哪個債務修復選擇，要麼支付 250 金幣來幫助 Mitah，要麼拒絕並殺死 Sunzu。如果您拒絕並選擇殺死 Sunzu，則會出現一群 翡翠兄弟會 成員（3 法師和 1 幻術師），並且 Sunzu 本人將轉為敵對並進行攻擊。
1fa3e27ab2c9052233eda17ac8f16cb10c4bf3c2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2dcef3fbc0ebb69bcb675cee82f7b371c906fda4.source: Finally, head back across the bridge to collect your reward from Nakai.
2dcef3fbc0ebb69bcb675cee82f7b371c906fda4.text: 最後，返回過橋，從 Nakai 那裡領取獎勵。
2dcef3fbc0ebb69bcb675cee82f7b371c906fda4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6ae5573a4af44002af54df76a0c2f9cc19733156.source: Sometimes Nakai won't offer the quest after Sunzu has run far enough to normally trigger the offer. Running back to Mitah, then back to Nakai can correct this. Sometimes Sunzu's helpers only spawn when you run through that area at a later time, even if you handed in the quest in the meanwhile.
6ae5573a4af44002af54df76a0c2f9cc19733156.text: 有時，在孫祖跑得夠遠以正常觸發任務後，中井不會提供任務。跑回 Mitah，然後跑回 Nakai 可以糾正這個問題。有時，孫祖的助手只會在你稍後跑過該區域時才會出現，即使你同時提交了任務。
6ae5573a4af44002af54df76a0c2f9cc19733156.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

334212166300f87ba4d0e3098ad2cab7a37a2edb.source: Defeat 5...0 more ancestral sprouts to cleanse the Ancestor Tree.
334212166300f87ba4d0e3098ad2cab7a37a2edb.text: 擊敗 5...0 更多祖先芽來淨化祖先樹。
334212166300f87ba4d0e3098ad2cab7a37a2edb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b6c82c21d0ce4fa8b7302e34af01996af76b23c6.source: Defeat the 5 ancestral sprouts near the Ancestor Tree. They spawn one at a time and once a group is defeated, the next will appear.
b6c82c21d0ce4fa8b7302e34af01996af76b23c6.text: 擊敗祖先樹附近的 5 祖先芽苗。它們一次產生一個，一旦一組被擊敗，下一組就會出現。
b6c82c21d0ce4fa8b7302e34af01996af76b23c6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b78f191a61f17fb6d5b6e1f922bab60e57e363ed.source: Destroy the Shadow Army forces surrounding the Tower of Courage. You have 5...0 groups left.
b78f191a61f17fb6d5b6e1f922bab60e57e363ed.text: 摧毀勇氣之塔周圍的 暗影軍團 部隊。您還剩下 5...0 群組。
b78f191a61f17fb6d5b6e1f922bab60e57e363ed.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c3bd843fc3369b42365a1fea430d2386591c1170.source: Destroy the Shadow Lord within the Tower of Courage.
c3bd843fc3369b42365a1fea430d2386591c1170.text: 摧毀勇氣之塔內的 闇影 領主。
c3bd843fc3369b42365a1fea430d2386591c1170.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ccc624d933eb6bbf983241bdb9bb5f2c309fdbb5.source: The events of this quest will play out whether the quest is taken or not. You must be prepared for this if your party approaches the Tower of Courage because you will be thrown out of the Fissure of Woe if Rastigan the Eternal perishes. Each group of Shadow Army you need to kill for this quest consists of an Abyssal and two Shadow Rangers. Aggroing these groups will cause Rastigan to run forward, and he will certainly die if you haven't taken care of things.
ccc624d933eb6bbf983241bdb9bb5f2c309fdbb5.text: 無論任務是否被接受，該任務的事件都會發生。如果你的隊伍接近勇氣之塔，你必須為此做好準備，因為如果永恆的拉斯蒂根滅亡，你將被扔出痛苦裂縫。您需要為此任務殺死的每組 暗影軍團 均由一名深淵遊俠和兩名 闇影 遊騎兵組成。仇恨這些群體會讓拉斯蒂根向前奔跑，如果你不處理好他一定會死。
ccc624d933eb6bbf983241bdb9bb5f2c309fdbb5.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

86c2aa81bba38cd249601c9e31f1f9d075fde52f.source: First, clear out the area between you and the Tower without aggroing the Abyssal/Ranger groups. Most groups start with the left side first, and then the right. Be mindful of patrols and Shadow Beast popups. When the area is clear, take out the first group at the southwest of the Tower. Rastigan will run forward and stand where this group was. Take out the rest of the groups around the Tower. When they're dead, Rastigan will come up and open the tower gate. Shadow Lord Vogris will spawn inside with 2 Abyssals. One possible tactic to defeat this last group is to have one or more players body block them at the gate entrance. This will help focus their damage on fewer party members and bunch them up for AoE damage.
86c2aa81bba38cd249601c9e31f1f9d075fde52f.text: 首先，清理你和塔之間的區域，不要激怒深淵/遊俠 隊伍。大多數小組首先從左側開始，然後是右側。注意巡邏和 闇影 Beast 彈出視窗。當該區域清空後，幹掉塔西南的第一組。拉斯蒂根將向前跑去，站在這群人所在的地方。幹掉塔周圍的其餘隊伍。當他們死後，拉斯蒂根會出現並開啟塔門。 闇影 沃格里斯勳爵將在裡面與 2 深淵生成。擊敗最後這群人的一種可能策略是讓一名或多名玩家在大門入口處擋住他們。這將有助於將他們的傷害集中在更少的隊伍成員身上，並將他們集中起來造成 範圍性 傷害。
86c2aa81bba38cd249601c9e31f1f9d075fde52f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a3b8c791fff54a0a2dd8b8993931311713c84225.source: It is possible to prevent Rastigan from running forward after aggroing one of the Shadow Army groups if your party is well out of his range. The groups can then be defeated at your own pace. When you are ready for him to run forward, move within his range.
a3b8c791fff54a0a2dd8b8993931311713c84225.text: 如果你的隊伍遠遠超出了拉斯蒂根的攻擊範圍，那麼在攻擊 暗影軍團 隊伍之一後，可以阻止拉斯蒂根向前奔跑。然後可以按照你自己的步調擊敗這些團體。當你準備好讓他向前跑時，就在他的射程範圍內移動。
a3b8c791fff54a0a2dd8b8993931311713c84225.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3706f78b5a144e038f4ef278698e8ddfb1a8a0db.source: An unlocked Chest spawns inside the tower when this quest is completed.
3706f78b5a144e038f4ef278698e8ddfb1a8a0db.text: 當這個任務完成時，一個解鎖的 寶箱 會在塔內產生。
3706f78b5a144e038f4ef278698e8ddfb1a8a0db.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e8afa96349250817934d94a76983803a9c2f8dac.source: Clear the path to the Tower of Strength. You have 5...0 Shadow Patrols left.
e8afa96349250817934d94a76983803a9c2f8dac.text: 清理通往 力量 塔的道路。您還剩下 5...0 闇影 巡邏。
e8afa96349250817934d94a76983803a9c2f8dac.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

571680897be42c20caa25d1b0e82ccb3acf50154.source: Enter the Tower of Strength and destroy the Shadow Lord.
571680897be42c20caa25d1b0e82ccb3acf50154.text: 進入 力量 塔並摧毀 闇影 領主。
571680897be42c20caa25d1b0e82ccb3acf50154.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7eadcc4139f532f3b7f81a1f133a93cd476dca8e.source: Return to Eternal Lord Taeres for your reward.
7eadcc4139f532f3b7f81a1f133a93cd476dca8e.text: 影返 送給永恆之主泰瑞斯，作為獎勵。

0132d4bdd786b43ae3e024694369aded10decbca.source: Exit the forge to the south and keep to the left. You will find several strong patrols of Shadow Army creatures and a lot of hidden Shadow Beasts on your way, so advance carefully. The Shadow Patrols that have to be killed are five single beasts similar to Abyssals, however, they are accompanied by large numbers of other nightmares and some Infernal Wurms.
0132d4bdd786b43ae3e024694369aded10decbca.text: 向南退出熔爐並保持左側。你會在路上發現幾個強大的 暗影軍團 生物巡邏隊和許多隱藏的 闇影 野獸，所以要小心前進。需要殺死的闇影巡邏隊是五隻類似深淵的單一野獸，但它們伴隨著大量的其他夢魘和一些地獄亞龍。

4ed2daa56108d1870f15ce28b0fbabf9267793a2.source: When the Tower of Strength comes into sight, keep close to the right wall and always fight only one group at a time. With careful luring you can use the geography of this place to your advantage: There is a path leading down towards the tower with a ridge at its side. Spellcasters and Rangers should stay on that ridge and Warriors should lure the opponents to the place directly below the ridge. If done right this will keep the fragile party members out of harm's reach (at least from the powerful melee attacks of the Abyssals) but still enable them to participate in the fight.
4ed2daa56108d1870f15ce28b0fbabf9267793a2.text: 當 力量 塔出現在視野中時，靠近右側牆壁並且始終一次只與一組作戰。透過仔細的引誘，你可以利用這個地方的地理位置來發揮自己的優勢：有一條小路通往塔樓，塔樓的一側有山脊。施法者和遊騎兵應該留在山脊上，而戰士應該將對手引誘到山脊正下方的地方。如果做得好，這將使脆弱的黨員遠離傷害（至少免受深淵者強大的近戰攻擊），但仍然使他們能夠參與戰鬥。

01304ee2bf8dbc8c869eb9a8dfc0ea5025b86954.text: 一條比穿過阿爾卡齊亞坦格爾到達西側更簡單的路線是從 洛達頂點 向南穿過魔法石，然後通過傳送門進入阿爾卡齊亞坦格爾。 白斗篷 位於門戶南側。

739fde17b68237271c9e9d8f7c83d33727082506.source: Justiciar Naveed will not accept the Grimoire Arcanum if you get it on one character and try to turn it in on another character, who has not completed the first objective (which is similar to Temple of the Damned and its quest item).

d18b571905ce6c8a0df780f120831426ecd63e6d.source: Kournan soldiers will gather at the three entrances to the village. After some dialogue, the center group will attack, followed by the two outside groups. With the exception of the Kournan Commander, all the troops are level 16 and killing them should not be a problem for a full group.
d18b571905ce6c8a0df780f120831426ecd63e6d.text: 庫爾南士兵將聚集在村莊的三個入口處。經過一番對話後，中心組將發動攻擊，接著是外側的兩組。除了 Kournan 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) 之外，所有部隊都是 16 級別，殺死他們對整個團隊來說應該不成問題。

5ecb961de5080f3530f8313d67406e6c635849b3.source: If you kill the center group before they enter the village gates, the other two groups will not become hostile. Thus, the quest cannot be completed.
5ecb961de5080f3530f8313d67406e6c635849b3.text: 如果你在中間的隊伍進入村門之前殺死他們，其他兩組就不會變得敵對。因此，任務無法完成。

81c5f4f2d113ab2db13cdd379a86cdb5f78e5c39.source: Convince Kareh Ossa's commanders to align with Joko by defeating them in combat. You have defeated [0...4] of 4 commanders.
81c5f4f2d113ab2db13cdd379a86cdb5f78e5c39.text: 在戰鬥中擊敗卡雷·奧薩的指揮官，說服他們與約科結盟。您已擊敗 [0...4] 名 4 指揮官。

2c68c80811975678697acf71b116b6b87aacf78c.source: Follow the quest pointer to each of the commanders in turn and defeat them and their guards. Be careful, since the normal area spawns will also be present making for large mixed groups of enemies. Two commanders can be reached using Junundu, making them easy to defeat.
2c68c80811975678697acf71b116b6b87aacf78c.text: 依序跟隨任務指標找到每位指揮官並擊敗他們和他們的守衛。請小心，因為正常區域也會出現，從而形成大量混合的敵人。使用 Junundu 可以接觸到兩名指揮官，這使得他們很容易被擊敗。

1dbd750d9d4d18bb5547f5c83030605301a35370.source: The four commanders are: Commander Mosek, Commander Yamji, Commander Lohgor and Commander Giturh. Note that while some of them have elite skills, they cannot be captured due to the fact that they automatically turn non-hostile if defeated (less than 20% health), preventing their deaths. Also since they do not, technically, die - you do not receive any morale boosts.
1dbd750d9d4d18bb5547f5c83030605301a35370.text: 這四位指揮官分別是：指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Mosek、指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Yamji、指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Lohgor 和 指揮官(英雄對戰頭銜) Giturh。請注意，雖然其中一些擁有精英技能，但他們無法被捕獲，因為如果被擊敗（低於 20% 生命值），他們會自動轉為非敵對狀態，從而防止死亡。此外，從技術上講，他們不會死亡——你不會獲得任何士氣提升。
1dbd750d9d4d18bb5547f5c83030605301a35370.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b0a728a90d80a1f1c2a7c14e41436addf74d329a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

There will be one or two Grawl boss groups in front of the cave entrance, as well as the elemental Grit Slingstone inside the cave; you do not have to kill any of them to complete the quest. Click on the mossy rock on the ground and you will obtain a Mossy Rock quest item. Take this back to Vassar.
81bc6f7914cec8f5cc07b534270b039ad5477111.text: 該洞穴位於療養院的東南方。跟隨任務標記。洞穴入口前會出現一到兩個穴居人 Boss群，以及洞穴內的元素砂石彈石；你不必殺死他們中的任何一個來完成任務。點選地面上的苔蘚岩石，你將獲得苔蘚岩石任務物品。將其帶回 瓦薩。

0822f5c467164a46c5429d6f5d56c236cfeabb70.text: 該地區以圖萊·奧薩 (Turai Ossa) 命名，但「遊行」可能指的是他的軍隊向賈海戰役行進，或者他帶領定居者前往 水晶沙漠。從地理上看，後者的可能性更大。

4c0927ade433fb768ef2d937a9dfbcd7bccee6f1.source: Until the quest Troubled Lands is completed, vanquishing requires killing the Tormented Lands. They spawn in a fixed order and might make vanquishing confusing - refer to the map in on the quest page if you're having difficulty finding the last few mobs.
4c0927ade433fb768ef2d937a9dfbcd7bccee6f1.text: 在任務「麻煩之地」完成之前，征服需要殺死「折磨之地」。它們以固定的順序生成，可能會讓征服變得混亂 - 如果您很難找到最後幾個小怪，請參閱任務頁面上的地圖。

be765374d3f8aa8907b168f176168cbcbb83a31c.source: Kill each Tormented Land once - another will spawn nearby until the original ten are killed, at which point an Earthen Abomination spawns. Kill the Abomination and from this point on you can ignore these creatures. Two minutes later, the spawning process will begin again. The first 11 unique kills contribute to experience, leave drops, and count towards vanquishing; killing the re-spawned ones does not; the Earthen Abomination boss gives the morale boost only after first kill.
be765374d3f8aa8907b168f176168cbcbb83a31c.text: 殺死每個折磨之地一次 - 另一個會在附近生成，直到最初的十個被殺死，此時會生成土靈憎惡。殺死憎惡，從現在開始你就可以忽略這些生物了。兩分鐘後，產卵過程將再次開始。第一款 11 獨特擊殺有助於獲得經驗、留下掉落物併計入征服；殺死重生的則不會；大地憎惡 Boss 僅在首次擊殺後才會提升士氣。
be765374d3f8aa8907b168f176168cbcbb83a31c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a4e72086562272832253b890e5ba9dd5b3005b37.source: Completing Troubled Lands raises the kill count, as it replaces the Tormented Lands (10) and Earthen Abomination (1) with groups totaling more than the aforementioned 11 elementals required to complete the quest.
a4e72086562272832253b890e5ba9dd5b3005b37.text: 完成麻煩之地會提高擊殺數，因為它取代了折磨之地 (10) 和大地憎惡 (1)，其群體總數超過了完成任務所需的上述 11 元素。

b7e5489489b4a80e195d5f8106e7892cefb5ba81.source: Exit Serenity Temple and follow the quest marker to reach the giant crystal. The boss will spawn in the general area. Once you kill the boss, pick up the Storm Rider Tissue Sample and bring it back to Erudine for your reward.
b7e5489489b4a80e195d5f8106e7892cefb5ba81.text: 退出 寧靜神殿 並依照任務標記到達巨型水晶。 Boss 將在一般區域產生。殺死 Boss 後，拿起 暴風駕馭者 組織樣本並將其帶回 璦洛丹 以獲得獎勵。

f18ac495b067d26b6ab8ffa317cafa69de80d997.text: 接受此任務時，艾登 將為您提供以下技能：

f70c7e2a353014eb63a839aec3f6570636f0bb6c.source: You can find Aidan south-east next to a small fishing village in the Wizard's Folly.
f70c7e2a353014eb63a839aec3f6570636f0bb6c.text: 您可以在 巫師的怪異建築 東南方的一個小漁村旁邊找到 艾登。

5f071914eb75ba6e520c5bd3c577e79d82af4ae7.source: If you draw a line straight south from Ashford Abbey to the bottom of the map, the bottom of the line would cross the small fishing village. By foot that means go east from Foible's Fair until you come to the river. Then try to go south and you'll find the village. The village is in an area of the river shaped like a large "Y".
5f071914eb75ba6e520c5bd3c577e79d82af4ae7.text: 如果從 灰色淺灘修道院 向南畫一條直線到地圖底部，該線的底部將穿過小漁村。步行意味著從 佛伊伯市集 向東走，直到到達河邊。然後嘗試向南走​​，你會找到村莊。這個村莊位於河邊，形狀像一個大“Y”形。
5f071914eb75ba6e520c5bd3c577e79d82af4ae7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

40ab566eb9a931fd8f3f562a21f9ff12d199fa3b.source: When you're at the village, go south. You'll encounter some spiders. When you can't go south anymore, go east; you'll see a small house at a mountain. You can find Aidan at the foot of the hill, next to a part of the river which flows north to south.
40ab566eb9a931fd8f3f562a21f9ff12d199fa3b.text: 到了村子後，往南走。你會遇到一些蜘蛛。當你不能再向南走時，就向東走；你會看到山上有一座小房子。您可以在山腳下找到 艾登，靠近一條從北向南流淌的河流。
40ab566eb9a931fd8f3f562a21f9ff12d199fa3b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

71a6b72d254ed8cbc3bf11904e1f4dfeea8e3c18.source: Equipping the two skills Aidan gives you will be a big help, as the Large Aloe Seeds you will encounter are susceptible to fire damage and come in clusters of three. This quest serves as an introduction to the concept of skill chaining, using skills in combination for greater effect. Using Dual Shot doubles the effect of Ignite Arrows.
71a6b72d254ed8cbc3bf11904e1f4dfeea8e3c18.text: 裝備 艾登 給你的兩個技能將會給你很大的幫助，因為你將遇到的大蘆薈種子很容易受到火焰傷害，並且是三個一組的。此任務介紹了技能鏈的概念，組合使用技能以獲得更大的效果。使用 雙重箭 可以讓 爆烈箭 的效果加倍。
71a6b72d254ed8cbc3bf11904e1f4dfeea8e3c18.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

455759e42583bd2a78bb7de28aca99a37d423cd8.source: Follow the quest marker west until you encounter the river. Several Large Aloe Seeds will be hanging out here. Kill them, using your new skills if you wish. They will drop Aloe Roots when they die. Pick one up and take it back to Aidan.
455759e42583bd2a78bb7de28aca99a37d423cd8.text: 沿著任務標記向西走，直到遇到河流。幾顆大蘆薈種子將掛在這裡。如果你願意的話，可以使用你的新技能殺死他們。他們死後會掉落蘆薈根。拿起其中一個並將其帶回 艾登。
455759e42583bd2a78bb7de28aca99a37d423cd8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4924a5c5a6ae7bec2064e3a48d85b1dc5449f36a.source: The Hunter's Horn quest leads to Aidan, who can be hard to find for new players.
4924a5c5a6ae7bec2064e3a48d85b1dc5449f36a.text: 獵人的角 任務會導致 艾登，對新玩家來說很難找到。
4924a5c5a6ae7bec2064e3a48d85b1dc5449f36a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

96159916211811bdf4c5f55e97dbe295abac86cf.text: 即使日誌中沒有啟動任務，大蘆薈種子也會生成，但任務完成後它們會停止生成。
96159916211811bdf4c5f55e97dbe295abac86cf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

faff6bc94665209ed7596dd7ef7be326d468141c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b16ff3b747d486592d5da459048f4e5c2d061541.text: 在莫洛格大祭司得知偉大毀滅者的真名之前將其消滅。
b16ff3b747d486592d5da459048f4e5c2d061541.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0767a2ccbad5d991bff408b65f841a2116f90b63.text: 將盧比孔河之書 影返 移至古代遺跡。將其放在 高等祭司 阿爾卡 等待的地方。
0767a2ccbad5d991bff408b65f841a2116f90b63.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aa0308a0b2f9d4613a440c04742a4bb300d977cf.source: Collect 4 shards of Balthazate crystal and place them near High Priest Alkar. You have [4..0] shards remaining. Be sure to protect the High Priest from enemy patrols.
aa0308a0b2f9d4613a440c04742a4bb300d977cf.text: 收集 4 巴爾塔札特水晶碎片並將其放置在 高等祭司 阿爾卡 附近。您還剩下 [4..0] 碎片。一定要保護大祭司免受敵人巡邏隊的傷害。
aa0308a0b2f9d4613a440c04742a4bb300d977cf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9fb0f77060b82e8b3c099c8632ea9cb891618226.text: 8,000 經驗值（您必須在離開 悲傷熔爐 之前領取獎勵。）
9fb0f77060b82e8b3c099c8632ea9cb891618226.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

004f63484a604fd48214254a944d5e18061fc43b.source: To acquire this quest, you will first need to locate High Priest Alkar in Grenth's Footprint. You'll find him towards the northeast. You will then have to lead Alkar into Sorrow's Furnace, taking down several groups of Stone Summit along the way. Simply head towards the quest marker and enter Sorrow's Furnace, regardless of whether Alkar managed to keep up with your party.
004f63484a604fd48214254a944d5e18061fc43b.text: 要完成此任務，您首先需要在古蘭斯的足跡中找到高等祭司 阿爾卡。你會在東北方向找到他。然後，你必須帶領 Alkar 進入 悲傷熔爐，一路擊倒幾組 石峰矮人。只需前往任務標記並輸入 悲傷熔爐，無論 Alkar 是否設法跟上您的隊伍。
004f63484a604fd48214254a944d5e18061fc43b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

eea666d55f2745961f13b4457269f405bbba31ce.source: Getting the Tome of the Rubicon
eea666d55f2745961f13b4457269f405bbba31ce.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6729e40d48246641a6e9d404a010b04174e2f1c1.source: Once inside, talk to Alkar again to accept this quest. Head past the large doors and down to engage the first enemy group. After taking down this group, Alkar will start moving on his own towards the Stone Basilica (taking a right at the first junction). It is important that the party keep an eye on Alkar, since his death will return the party to an outpost. Try to gather drops during a fight rather than after, since Alkar will immediately set off towards the quest marker the moment the last enemy falls.
6729e40d48246641a6e9d404a010b04174e2f1c1.text: 進去後，再次與阿爾卡交談以接受此任務。穿過大門，向下與第一支敵軍交戰。消滅這群人後，阿爾卡將開始自行前往石大教堂（在第一個路口右轉）。隊伍要密切注意阿爾卡，這一點很重要，因為他的死將使隊伍回到前哨基地。嘗試在戰鬥中而不是戰鬥後收集掉落物，因為當最後一個敵人倒下時，阿爾卡會立即出發前往任務標記。
6729e40d48246641a6e9d404a010b04174e2f1c1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

25ff76701491c1ad3ea30507b0b96d528df9d405.source: Kill all nearby Dredge before engaging a Dredge Blastrock and do not kill a Dredge Blastrock too quickly after engaging it (to avoid quickly overwhelming the defending group).
25ff76701491c1ad3ea30507b0b96d528df9d405.text: 在與 挖掘者 Blastrock 交戰之前殺死附近的所有 挖掘者，並且在交戰後不要太快殺死 挖掘者 Blastrock（以避免快速壓倒防禦小組）。
25ff76701491c1ad3ea30507b0b96d528df9d405.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

af3edd60875114595d4772ed62ff041e2ebac439.source: When a Dredge Blastrock is almost dead, if the party has multiple players, have some of them start running back. If using henchmen, run back to Alkar immediately after killing a Dredge Blastrock. Consider ignoring the Balthazate Crystal first and come back for it later, after defending Alkar from the assault. Running back only after Alkar starts taking damage usually means it will be too late.
af3edd60875114595d4772ed62ff041e2ebac439.text: 當 挖掘者 Blastrock 幾乎死亡時，如果隊伍中有多名玩家，請讓其中一些人開始跑回來。如果使用追隨者，殺死 挖掘者 Blastrock 後立即跑回阿卡卡。考慮先忽略巴爾薩扎特水晶，然後在保護阿爾卡免受攻擊後再回來拿它。僅在阿爾卡開始受到傷害後才跑回來通常意味著為時已晚。
af3edd60875114595d4772ed62ff041e2ebac439.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fe288f21c4693f85d704dc59880fe6abb78365b1.source: For each Balthazate Crystal retrieved, just drop them near Alkar. Once you have successfully recovered four of them, a cutscene will trigger and the quest will be completed.
fe288f21c4693f85d704dc59880fe6abb78365b1.text: 對於每個取回的巴爾薩扎特水晶，只需將它們放在阿爾卡附近即可。一旦你成功恢復其中四個，就會觸發過場動畫，任務就會完成。
fe288f21c4693f85d704dc59880fe6abb78365b1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8bd04d72d148127c190c2c71ed7fd824e965e560.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8b762748d2baf6cdc488284d53849517445de7f0.source: It may be possible to leave Alkar going one-on-one with Hierophant Morlog, possibly supported by just one healer. If they manage to fight to a standstill, it makes the second part of this quest much easier, since you don't have to worry about Alkar dying. You just need to know where the Dredge Blastrock will spawn (since they have not spawned yet), and also to keep your heroes, henchmen, or minions from killing the Hierophant.
8b762748d2baf6cdc488284d53849517445de7f0.text: 也許可以讓阿爾卡與聖職者莫洛格進行一對一的戰鬥，可能只有一名治療師的支援。如果他們能夠戰鬥到停滯狀態，那麼這個任務的第二部分就會變得容易得多，因為你不必擔心阿爾卡會死。你只需要知道 挖掘者 Blastrock 將在哪裡生成（因為它們還沒有生成），並防止你的英雄、追隨者或小兵殺死聖職者。
8b762748d2baf6cdc488284d53849517445de7f0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e11d4897746465244f3b6e95bd9fdcc7c55e739e.source: If only using henchmen, completing this quest will be tricky. The key would be in knowing how to trigger the enemy spawn that attacks Alkar. The idea is that you trigger a spawn, then immediately run back to defend Alkar. Having party-wide speed boost skills will be helpful (e.g. "Charge!").
e11d4897746465244f3b6e95bd9fdcc7c55e739e.text: 如果只使用追蹤者，完成這個任務將會很棘手。關鍵在於知道如何觸發攻擊阿爾卡的敵人生成。這個想法是你觸發一個重生，然後立刻跑回去保衛阿爾卡。擁有全隊速度提陞技能將會很有幫助（例如「衝鋒！」）。
e11d4897746465244f3b6e95bd9fdcc7c55e739e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

abc227f6af7fb1eb2c7f15b5b15b4de5aecdd6e3.source: Leaving a single warrior with defensive stances and powerful AoE damage to defend Alkar is also possible, because Alkar is a powerful healer. A single trapping ranger would be even better. Covering the stairs in traps will decimate the enemies charging down it, or at least weaken them enough for the rest of the party to come back and help.
abc227f6af7fb1eb2c7f15b5b15b4de5aecdd6e3.text: 留下一個具有防禦姿態和強大的 範圍性 傷害的戰士來保衛阿爾卡也是可能的，因為阿爾卡是一個強大的治療者。一個誘捕遊俠就更好了。用陷阱覆蓋樓梯將消滅衝下樓梯的敵人，或至少削弱他們的力量，讓隊伍的其他成員回來幫忙。

No. Instead, they ask about shells. Shells! They're all over the beaches in Mehtani Keys. You just walk the dunes and look down. We never collect them; they're just shells. But that's what the Vabbians want. I need a "starter shipment" of 20 shells. If you gather them for me, I'll give you a share of the profits."
0466f8416d2a31e00c05c2cc1628cafc48f3c6ea.text: 「那些瓦比亞商人是個奇怪的人。他們來這裡大肆談論我們人民之間的貿易，但他們對我們的農作物感興趣嗎？不。相反，他們問貝殼。貝殼！他們遍佈在我們的海灘上。 梅坦尼之鑰 。你只需走在沙丘上並向下看即可。我們從不收集它們；它們只是貝殼。但這正是瓦比亞人想要的。我需要一份“首發貨” 20 貝殼。如果你幫我收集，我就分給你一份利潤。 」

31fc8ab2a56031b4f0547e4fb07567fdd1341c7d.source: Your goal is to make your way to Urgoz and defeat him. To do this, you must make your way through the Warren, a job complicated by Environmental Effects that are created by Twisted Barks; killing the tree-like creatures removes the effect, so they are often your primary targets as you traverse the area. Each room is blocked by a gate which can only open after defeating a Guardian Serpent; these are usually the least difficult challenge and can often be ignored until it is safe to move on.
31fc8ab2a56031b4f0547e4fb07567fdd1341c7d.text: 你的目標是到達 爾果 並擊敗他。要做到這一點，你必須穿過沃倫，這項工作因扭曲樹皮造成的環境影響而變得複雜；殺死樹狀生物會消除該效果，因此當您穿越該區域時，它們通常是您的主要目標。每個房間都被一扇門封鎖，只有在擊敗 守護者 Serpent 後才能開啟；這些通常是最簡單的挑戰，通常可以被忽略，直到可以安全地繼續前進。
31fc8ab2a56031b4f0547e4fb07567fdd1341c7d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

41cf19e63ed50eed523f5dd38facb5bde32844a7.source: This area has Hopping Vampire and Thought Stealer popups at the start which use Suicide Health and Suicide Energy that either kill the target or take all of the target's energy respectively. They die in the process of using the skill. The easiest way to combat this is to move entire party back out of the corridor into the large room at the start. Consider using spirits as decoys for the suicidal creatures. Killing them at long range will avoid your health or energy depleting.
41cf19e63ed50eed523f5dd38facb5bde32844a7.text: 該區域一開始就有跳躍吸血鬼和思想竊取者彈出視窗，它們使用自殺 體力 和自殺 能量 分別殺死目標或奪走目標的所有能量。他們在使用技能的過程中死亡。解決這個問題最簡單的方法就是一開始就將整個隊伍從走廊移回大房間。考慮使用靈魂作為自殺生物的誘餌。遠距離殺死它們將避免你的健康或能量耗盡。
41cf19e63ed50eed523f5dd38facb5bde32844a7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a532d627c2e83ee9b1a2f17befefed36c81543d7.source: Moving down the corridor you will experience your first Environment Effect (Weakness). A simple method for this room is to pull the dredge back towards the corridor you started in, out of range of the Weakness. The first group of Dredge will not pull very far into the corridor. Attempt to avoid aggroing the other four patrolling groups of Dredge while killing the first. Going too far into the room will initiate the patrols to swarm into the main area to protect the Twisted Bark. Retreat and back up the corridor to the edge of the effect and begin pulling groups of Dredge to your party. Be patient and watch the patrol patterns. Luring two groups at the same time will often result in early failure.
a532d627c2e83ee9b1a2f17befefed36c81543d7.text: 沿著走廊走下去，您將體驗到第一個環境效果 (虛弱)。對於這個房間，一個簡單的方法是將挖泥機拉回您開始的走廊，超出 虛弱 的範圍。 挖掘者 的第一組不會駛入走廊太遠。殺死第一個巡邏隊的同時，盡量避免激怒 挖掘者 的其他四個巡邏隊。進入房間太遠將會引發巡邏隊湧入主要區域以保護扭曲樹皮。撤退並退回走廊到效果邊緣，然後開始將 挖掘者 組拉到您的隊伍中。要有耐心，觀察巡邏模式。同時引誘兩個群體往往會導致早期失敗。
a532d627c2e83ee9b1a2f17befefed36c81543d7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9b17f9efefae520b35c204b87302ae8345a3f48d.source: Once you have a clear run to the Twisted Bark, move in for the kill to remove the Environment Effect.
9b17f9efefae520b35c204b87302ae8345a3f48d.text: 一旦你順利跑到扭曲樹皮處，就可以前去擊殺以消除環境效果。
9b17f9efefae520b35c204b87302ae8345a3f48d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

775c567ca31d4354f88ca3698e8ef8914a9cd15f.source: Continue straight on up the stairs. Be careful here, because as soon as you enter this room two patrols will move in from the left and right. Due to this, try pulling back the stationary group down the stairs. Then kill the two patrol groups. Moving to the left or right of this chamber will initiate some popups of hidden Greater Blood Drinkers.
775c567ca31d4354f88ca3698e8ef8914a9cd15f.text: 繼續直行上樓梯。這裡要小心，因為一旦你進入這個房間，就會有兩個巡邏隊從左右移動。因此，請嘗試將固定組拉下樓梯。然後殺掉兩個巡邏隊。移動到這個房間的左側或右側將會彈出一些隱藏的大型飲血者的彈出視窗。
775c567ca31d4354f88ca3698e8ef8914a9cd15f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

004bef298f615d67b3236454b06285a80596bd6b.source: Once again best technique is to pull the closest groups of foes out of the environment effect. You will be able to lure all three Dredge groups with some patience. It is highly likely that you will spawn some Greater Blood Drinkers in the process. Using the walls can block the projectiles as the lure comes around the corner towards the team. Be mindful that this may also impact your team's ability to use ranged attacks.
004bef298f615d67b3236454b06285a80596bd6b.text: 再次強調，最好的技巧是將最近的敵人群體從環境影響中拉出來。只要有耐心，您就能夠引誘所有三個 挖掘者 群體。在過程中你很有可能會產生一些強效飲血者。當誘餌從角落向團隊襲來時，使用牆壁可以阻擋彈頭。請注意，這也可能會影響您的團隊使用遠端攻擊的能力。
004bef298f615d67b3236454b06285a80596bd6b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c7eef6a2bdb41b89ea6a750a73babf95d1b930fe.source: When the area is apparently clear, have your party rush to the Twisted Bark. You should be able to kill it before any party members die due to the degeneration.
c7eef6a2bdb41b89ea6a750a73babf95d1b930fe.text: 當該區域明顯暢通無阻時，讓你的隊伍衝向扭曲樹皮。你應該能夠在任何黨員因退化而死亡之前殺死它。

3356215ceb6fd8cdc8229f493dfac07d7d80615d.source: Do not rush forward at this point. This room is infested with more Greater Blood Drinkers. Proceed slowly towards the Guardian Serpent at the southern edge of the room.
3356215ceb6fd8cdc8229f493dfac07d7d80615d.text: 此時不要急於向前。這個房間裡擠滿了更多的高階飲血者。慢慢走向房間南邊的 守護者 Serpent。
3356215ceb6fd8cdc8229f493dfac07d7d80615d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review
