8846fc53ce8b65cd8313ca39ed72fa078833d0e6.source: Eventually, you'll see Hierophant Morlog, who is surrounded by many Summit Taskmasters. Pull the surrounding enemies to thin them before engaging the Hierophant, who will drop the Tome of the Rubicon upon defeat. Alkar will head back towards the stairs. Bring the Tome to him and drop it near him. Do not delay bringing the tome to Alkar because he will be attacked when he reaches the platform. You must return to defend him. The next (more difficult) part of the quest will start.
8846fc53ce8b65cd8313ca39ed72fa078833d0e6.text: 最終，你會看到聖職莫洛格，他被許多峰會監工包圍。 拉出 在與聖職者交戰之前，周圍的敵人會削弱他們的實力，聖職者在失敗後會掉落盧比孔之書。阿爾卡將返回樓梯。將聖典交給他並放在他附近。不要拖延將書交給阿爾卡，因為當他到達平臺時他會受到攻擊。你必須回來保衛他。任務的下一個（更困難的）部分將開始。
8846fc53ce8b65cd8313ca39ed72fa078833d0e6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b40039018e624422db8e9eae7b3e71ee200fd075.text: 收集四塊巴爾塔札特水晶
b40039018e624422db8e9eae7b3e71ee200fd075.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

28570156b018d0b1896e76552d17811f9646f331.source: The second part of the quest will require you to retrieve four Balthazate Crystals to help power Alkar's ritual to bury the Tome of the Rubicon. The Balthazate Crystals will drop from the four newly-spawned Dredge Blastrocks. Each of the Dredge Blastrocks spawn amongst a group of Dredge, but are not part of the group. As such, depending on your luck, it may be possible to pull the Dredge Blastrock away from the Dredge group.
28570156b018d0b1896e76552d17811f9646f331.text: 任務的第二部分將要求你取回四顆巴爾塔札特水晶，以幫助為阿爾卡埋葬盧比孔之書的儀式提供動力。 Balthazate 水晶將從四個新生成的 挖掘者 Blastrocks 中掉落。每個 挖掘者 爆彈石都會在一組 挖掘者 中生成，但不屬於該組。因此，根據您的運氣，有可能將 挖掘者 Blastrock 從 挖掘者 群組中拉出來。
28570156b018d0b1896e76552d17811f9646f331.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a89db531c5ea206c5470d30a1e242b6af0b17564.source: Alkar will remain on the platform. The party must split up at this point - a smaller group to protect Alkar (he will get attacked), and a larger group to retrieve the Balthazate Crystals. The group protecting Alkar should consist of at least a tank and a healer, but no more than three, or there may not be enough firepower to take down the Dredge Blastrocks.
a89db531c5ea206c5470d30a1e242b6af0b17564.text: Alkar 將繼續留在該平臺上。此時隊伍必須分開－一個較小的小組來保護阿爾卡（他會受到攻擊），一個較大的小組來取回巴爾塔札特水晶。保護阿爾卡的隊伍應該至少由一名坦克和一名治療者組成，但不能超過三人，否則可能沒有足夠的火力來擊落 挖掘者 Blastrocks。
a89db531c5ea206c5470d30a1e242b6af0b17564.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aad9f598ad4a006b2e75779710da8b22b999cd7b.source: The quest marker will indicate the location of the next Dredge Blastrock, so use it to find them. Keep in mind that engaging and killing Dredge Blastrocks will trigger enemy spawns to charge down the stairs towards Alkar's position, so be ready to run back to help defend Alkar. Left alone, Alkar will fall very quickly.
aad9f598ad4a006b2e75779710da8b22b999cd7b.text: 任務標記將指示下一個 挖掘者 Blastrock 的位置，因此請使用它來找到它們。請記住，與 挖掘者 Blastrocks 交戰並殺死它們會觸發敵人生成，從樓梯上沖向 Alkar 的位置，因此請準備好跑回來幫助保衛 Alkar。如果放任不管，阿爾卡很快就會倒下。
aad9f598ad4a006b2e75779710da8b22b999cd7b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8cab252eb57ba8b7ac18fbff4acfaed4995aa8dc.source: The first Dredge Blastrock is a short distance to the southeast. The third and fourth are further beyond, to the southeast and southwest respectively (watch out for overlapping patrols). The second Dredge Blastrock actually requires that you backtrack up the stairs. The tricky thing about taking down the Dredge Blastrock is that enemies will spawn and charge towards Alkar's position the first time a Dredge Blastrock is attacked and when a Dredge Blastrock is killed.
8cab252eb57ba8b7ac18fbff4acfaed4995aa8dc.text: 第一款 挖掘者 Blastrock 位於東南方向不遠的地方。第三個和第四個在更遠的地方，分別在東南和西南（注意重疊的巡邏）。第二個 挖掘者 Blastrock 其實要求你原路返回樓梯。拿下 挖掘者 Blastrock 的棘手之處在於，當 挖掘者 Blastrock 第一次受到攻擊以及 挖掘者 Blastrock 被殺死時，敵人會生成並向 Alkar 的位置衝鋒。
8cab252eb57ba8b7ac18fbff4acfaed4995aa8dc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e6ef4b86a73f5f67cca85e5d9348b6c53d66fa74.source: In other words, when a Dredge Blastrock is attacked for the first time, a small group of usually three Stone Summit will attack Alkar's position. Upon killing a Dredge Blastrock, a larger group of about 5 or 6 Stone Summit and spawn and charge Alkar's position.
e6ef4b86a73f5f67cca85e5d9348b6c53d66fa74.text: 換句話說，當挖掘者 Blastrock第一次受到攻擊時，一小群通常由三個石峰矮人組成的小組會攻擊Alkar的位置。殺死 挖掘者 Blastrock 後，一大群大約 5 或 6 石峰矮人 會產生並衝鋒 Alkar 的位置。
e6ef4b86a73f5f67cca85e5d9348b6c53d66fa74.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

135357724324eb989782d6e22bd035ebfa26ca91.source: There are two things to keep in mind:
135357724324eb989782d6e22bd035ebfa26ca91.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8c9dafd26b100a80f298eae585abf315b1595f6c.source: When you reach the end of the bridge there will be a small group of wolves that spawn in the next room. Across the bridge there is another chamber to the right which you should head to after. There is an area beside the vine gate in that next room where there is no exhaustion effect, consider letting your party's exhaustion levels lower before continuing.
8c9dafd26b100a80f298eae585abf315b1595f6c.text: 當你到達橋的盡頭時，隔壁房間會出現一小群狼。過了橋，右側有另一個房間，您應該前往該房間。隔壁房間的藤門旁邊有一個區域沒有疲勞效果，在繼續之前考慮讓你的隊伍的疲勞程度降低。
8c9dafd26b100a80f298eae585abf315b1595f6c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

399c9212f2954d4487abd593488a8e9054b26e27.source: Again there is an exhaustion effect at the far side of the room, pull all the groups of wolves to your party (who should be standing in the area without the exhaustion effect).
399c9212f2954d4487abd593488a8e9054b26e27.text: 房間的另一邊再次出現疲憊效果，將所有狼群拉到你的隊伍中（他們應該站在沒有疲憊效果的區域）。
399c9212f2954d4487abd593488a8e9054b26e27.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c6b8d81ec6ab930d45b9b6333c24994542bb9166.source: Once the area is clear, proceed to the next gate.
c6b8d81ec6ab930d45b9b6333c24994542bb9166.text: 一旦該區域清理完畢，前往下一個門。
c6b8d81ec6ab930d45b9b6333c24994542bb9166.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f22bc12eed20aacf3a23d98b6eefb4b4e34b1336.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

665a78e88c4747b3f8387f87885d3078c42d5810.source: You will see two Brooding Thorns in this next room, and there will be another two hidden groups of wolves but no exhaustion in this chamber. After killing them head west towards the valley with giant mushrooms at the sides.
665a78e88c4747b3f8387f87885d3078c42d5810.text: 你會在隔壁的房間看到兩隻孵化荊棘，而且還會有另外兩組隱藏的狼，但這個房間裡不會疲憊不堪。殺死他們後，向西前往兩側有巨大蘑菇的山谷。
665a78e88c4747b3f8387f87885d3078c42d5810.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9e9567e5b08edb6279fa2f6a8046595200afa20f.source: The usual Thorn Wolf groups will appear out of the ground as your party makes its way to the north east towards the bridge. Deal with the wolves and continue across.
9e9567e5b08edb6279fa2f6a8046595200afa20f.text: 當你的隊伍向東北方向的橋梁前進時，通常的荊棘 狼 隊伍會從地下出現。解決掉狼群後繼續穿越。
9e9567e5b08edb6279fa2f6a8046595200afa20f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f7620a32f6cf39062bfea16f2c2ebe2fecb1eb0e.source: The next room contains a few more wolf patrols. Lure them out. In this room you will need to head south east to the vine gate, making a 270° turn on the map as you follow the walls of the path. This means enter the room and keep as much to the right hand side as possible. Head down the ramp towards the crystallised walls and follow the path which will take you under the bridge you were just on. There are no pops in the bright room but on your way to the next bridge you will encounter two underground wolf patrols so do not rush.
f7620a32f6cf39062bfea16f2c2ebe2fecb1eb0e.text: 下一個房間裡還有幾隻狼巡邏隊。把他們引出來。在這個房間裡，您需要向東南方向前往藤蔓門，當您沿著路徑的牆壁行駛時，請在地圖上進行 270° 轉彎。這意味著進入房間並盡可能保持在右側。沿著坡道朝結晶牆走去，然後沿著小路走下去，將您帶到剛才所在的橋下。明亮的房間裡沒有流行音樂，但在前往下一座橋的路上，您會遇到兩個地下狼巡邏隊，所以不要著急。
f7620a32f6cf39062bfea16f2c2ebe2fecb1eb0e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6bb1ffd38289874d0e894ed4c3b21549ad8c3718.source: Pause when you see the Guardian Serpent, do not step onto the bridge in front of it until you have read the next section.
6bb1ffd38289874d0e894ed4c3b21549ad8c3718.text: 當您看到 守護者 蛇時請暫停，在閱讀下一部分之前不要踏上它前面的橋。
6bb1ffd38289874d0e894ed4c3b21549ad8c3718.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4df66bd5603d10eac0df14fee6e66f8887660fb9.source: One player must stay behind at this point - if all the party members are in the room at the same time, 138 additional foes will spawn, which can be difficult in addition to the -4 energy degeneration Environment Effect. The image to the right depicts where the player/hero should stand until the rest of the party has crossed the room and the foes in section 8 have spawned - only then is it safe for the waiting player/hero to return to the main group.
4df66bd5603d10eac0df14fee6e66f8887660fb9.text: 此時必須有一名玩家留在後面 - 如果所有隊伍成員同時在房間中，則會產生 138 額外的敵人，除了 -4 能量退化環境效應之外，這可能會很困難。右圖描繪了玩家/英雄應該站立的位置，直到隊伍的其他成員穿過房間並且 8 部分中的敵人已經生成 - 只有這樣等待的玩家/英雄才能安全地返回主組。
4df66bd5603d10eac0df14fee6e66f8887660fb9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f98fe5dc3e3378311a192c19c5c8d22a637dfa45.source: Even if your party isn't full, you still need to have one waiting before the bridge.
f98fe5dc3e3378311a192c19c5c8d22a637dfa45.text: 即使您的隊伍未滿，您仍需要在橋前等候。
f98fe5dc3e3378311a192c19c5c8d22a637dfa45.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d553ea2b76782d16e9ba262fdf092c590e6c41ab.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

58536d09dcd3c742041e80496b71fd9160dc01be.source: There are 3 bridges in this room, 1 leading into the room, 1 within the room, and 1 leading out of the room.
58536d09dcd3c742041e80496b71fd9160dc01be.text: 此房間內有 3 橋，1 通往房間，1 在房間內，1 通往房間外。
58536d09dcd3c742041e80496b71fd9160dc01be.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7bffe7431bc7dbc5b65672383ab0f427abe14578.source: With one player/hero waiting before the bridge leading to the first Guardian Serpent, the rest of the group can kill this Serpent and proceed across the internal bridge to the Twisted Bark. Killing it will remove the Environment Effect. (If you do not kill the Twisted Bark, there will be -4 energy degeneration in the final Urgoz battle on the southern side of the room.)
7bffe7431bc7dbc5b65672383ab0f427abe14578.text: 當玩家/英雄在通往第一條 守護者 蛇的橋梁前等待時，團隊的其餘成員可以殺死蛇並穿過內部橋梁到達扭曲樹皮。殺死它會消除環境效果。 （如果你不殺死扭曲樹皮，在房間南側的最後一場 爾果 戰鬥中將會出現 -4 能量衰退。）
7bffe7431bc7dbc5b65672383ab0f427abe14578.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0a32cb2cba0ef3bb32bc895e19f41196a141cfd0.source: The incomplete party can now move to the second Guardian Serpent, kill it and continue across the bridge until the Wardens and Plants spawn in the next section.
0a32cb2cba0ef3bb32bc895e19f41196a141cfd0.text: 不完整的隊伍現在可以移動到第二條 守護者 蛇，殺死它並繼續過橋，直到下一部分出現守望者和植物。
0a32cb2cba0ef3bb32bc895e19f41196a141cfd0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3b94c79f4a7258e6ab1dc6e3106a80969a7557a7.source: Only then can the waiting player/hero return to the main group.
3b94c79f4a7258e6ab1dc6e3106a80969a7557a7.text: 只有這樣等待的玩家/英雄才能返回主組。
3b94c79f4a7258e6ab1dc6e3106a80969a7557a7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b9a7f7e9cb18784fe2fa6b729e2398a773740e2e.source: If all party members are in this room at the same time, 42 suicidal creatures and 96 wardens will spawn. The four Warden groups closest to the entrance can be pulled out of the effect, whereupon the group can then kill the Twisted Bark. There will be the first batch of suicidal creatures beyond the second Guardian Serpent, a large group of Wardens on the bridge, followed by a second batch of suicidal creatures at the far end of the bridge and another large groups of Wardens after the bridge.
b9a7f7e9cb18784fe2fa6b729e2398a773740e2e.text: 如果所有隊伍成員同時在這個房間裡，則會產生 42 自殺生物和 96 守望者。距離入口最近的四個守望者小組可以被拉出效果，然後該小組可以殺死扭曲樹皮。在第二個 守護者 Serpent 之外將會出現第一批自殺生物，橋上有一大群守望者，接下來是橋遠端的第二批自殺生物以及橋後的另一大群守望者。
b9a7f7e9cb18784fe2fa6b729e2398a773740e2e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

47a5a2e7e9e75d171b2165ee4215dc7569ac0aa8.source: Lure out the first Plant group towards the entrance to kill them safely away from the Environmental Effects. There are three other groups of plants - one at each of the two Twisted Barks, and a third at the Guardian Serpent blocking the gate. The third group can be lured when it is safe to do so, take care of the Warden's traps though. Do not rush in and attempt to kill the Guardian Serpent you see directly in front of you until later.
47a5a2e7e9e75d171b2165ee4215dc7569ac0aa8.text: 將第一批 植物 隊伍引誘到入口處，以安全地殺死他們，使其遠離環境影響。還有其他三組植物 - 兩個扭曲樹皮中各有一組，第三組位於阻擋大門的 守護者 蛇上。在安全的情況下可以引誘第三組，但要小心守望者的陷阱。在稍後之前，請勿衝進去並嘗試殺死直接在您面前看到的 守護者 蛇。
47a5a2e7e9e75d171b2165ee4215dc7569ac0aa8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c48c5065f09962af08b123cadb49a5b231e0497f.source: There are also four groups of Wardens, two on each side, patrolling up and down. Lure each group outside the room one group at a time. It is advised to focus on the Maddened Earth Wardens (Earth Magic Elementalist nukers) before the Maddened Song Wardens (healers).
c48c5065f09962af08b123cadb49a5b231e0497f.text: 還有四組典獄長，每邊兩個，上下巡邏。將每一組引誘到房間外面，一次一組。建議先專注於瘋狂的地球守望者（地系魔法 元素使 nukers），然後再專注在瘋狂的歌曲守望者（治療者）。
c48c5065f09962af08b123cadb49a5b231e0497f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ca8e073c4ba9b3996eb9111ddf0b97a1cadef54f.source: Once the exhaustion effect is gone proceed over to the opposite hill and eliminate the group on top of it. Take out the Twisted Bark to get rid of the Weakness effect.
ca8e073c4ba9b3996eb9111ddf0b97a1cadef54f.text: 一旦疲憊效果消失，就前往對面的山丘並消滅山頂上的隊伍。取出扭曲樹皮以消除 虛弱 效果。
ca8e073c4ba9b3996eb9111ddf0b97a1cadef54f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6bfa7d2cb5d337f8073a6a0b44aa5914692ac644.source: Go back to the middle of the room and kill the Guardian Serpent and the last Plant group to enter the next section.
6bfa7d2cb5d337f8073a6a0b44aa5914692ac644.text: 回到房間中間，殺死守護者蛇和最後一個植物群組進入下一部分。
6bfa7d2cb5d337f8073a6a0b44aa5914692ac644.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

cdd462cfcc95c77fe9d4721fe039a2dea1f09097.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b48a64948a69f5a663175837b682b2165885be7c.source: This room is filled with Wardens and stationary Plants (the plants can be ignored entirely). Lure the first group of Wardens to the top of the entry stairs (this will likely ball them up as they turn the corner). Again focus on the Maddened Earth Wardens first. This door will provide you with an excellent location to launch your attacks on the next set of groups, because the Wardens can be corner-blocked here.
b48a64948a69f5a663175837b682b2165885be7c.text: 這個房間充滿了守望者和固定植物（植物可以完全忽略）。將第一組守望者引誘到入口樓梯的頂部（這可能會在他們轉彎時將他們聚集起來）。再次先關注瘋狂的地球守望者。這扇門將為你提供一個絕佳的位置，可以對下一批隊伍發動攻擊，因為守望者可以在這裡被堵在角落。
b48a64948a69f5a663175837b682b2165885be7c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aa4f66102f704a6bacc6a40994534bda69cf3731.source: Kill any Plants as needed, they are guarding their spot and shouldn't move around too much. With the exception of the wardens in the north west corner, all Warden groups can be pulled to the stairway.
aa4f66102f704a6bacc6a40994534bda69cf3731.text: 根據需要殺死任何植物，它們正在守衛自己的位置，不應該走動太多。除了西北角的守望者之外，所有的守望者隊伍都可以拉到樓梯上。
aa4f66102f704a6bacc6a40994534bda69cf3731.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

12e816db3f752f1f0226685b7ec0b209e19cb889.source: Be careful of the traps the Burning Brushes leave behind and kill the last group of Wardens in the middle of the room (there is a big tree which your casters can hide behind).
12e816db3f752f1f0226685b7ec0b209e19cb889.text: 小心燃燒刷子留下的陷阱，並殺死房間中間的最後一組守望者（有一棵大樹，你的施法者可以躲在後面）。
12e816db3f752f1f0226685b7ec0b209e19cb889.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6606533f2ac629c015c3c4c189d1926b8ab84d2c.source: Kill the Guardian Serpent to move on to the next section.
6606533f2ac629c015c3c4c189d1926b8ab84d2c.text: 殺死 守護者 蛇以繼續下一部分。
6606533f2ac629c015c3c4c189d1926b8ab84d2c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

26d407ba35b5cdf014bc8400c2c1b4966f3ebf95.source: One player/hero must remain outside the next room beyond the linking corridor, this will avoid the door closing and the party being trapped inside with many spawns.
26d407ba35b5cdf014bc8400c2c1b4966f3ebf95.text: 一名玩家/英雄必須留在連線走廊之外的下一個房間外面，這將避免門關閉和隊伍被困在裡面有很多重生。
26d407ba35b5cdf014bc8400c2c1b4966f3ebf95.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

130e17183286af52f751cca5030ddab81d48ece3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fdfe23f9923d8914218ef12afbf4f383005e409f.source: Pull all the visible groups of Thorn Wolves and Greater Blood Drinkers towards the gate, one group at a time. Killing one group of foes will enable another to spawn within the room at a random location, also bear in mind the underground patrols move around, so don't go too far into the room. NOTE: If your party advances too far into the room before the patrols and random spawns arrive, the entry doors will close behind you, cutting off any escape.
fdfe23f9923d8914218ef12afbf4f383005e409f.text: 拉出 所有可見的荊棘狼和強效飲血者群體朝大門移動，一次一組。殺死一組敵人將使另一組敵人在房間內的隨機位置產卵，還要記住地下巡邏隊會四處走動，所以不要進入房間太遠。注意：如果你的隊伍在巡邏隊和隨機重生到達之前進入房間太遠，入口門將在你身後關閉，切斷任何逃生通道。
fdfe23f9923d8914218ef12afbf4f383005e409f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

caa6c353a6adf754e28b47fd1b7425183e0b497b.source: You will know when the room is clear because the exit gate will open to the next section when clear. Continue to be wary as there are often a few more popups even after the gate opens.
caa6c353a6adf754e28b47fd1b7425183e0b497b.text: 您會知道房間何時暢通，因為暢通時出口門將開啟至下一個區域。請繼續保持警惕，因為即使在大門開啟後，通常還會出現更多彈出視窗。
caa6c353a6adf754e28b47fd1b7425183e0b497b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

18ee04de028dcf81f2c48832e9e2ac643e8e8a8c.source: Once you have exited the room, continue down the path and you'll see a Twisted Bark causing the degeneration in this room, you can kill it easily as there are no hidden foes here. Ignore the first two Guardian Serpents on the right and left.
18ee04de028dcf81f2c48832e9e2ac643e8e8a8c.text: 離開房間後，繼續沿著小路走，你會看到扭曲樹皮導致這個房間退化，你可以輕鬆殺死它，因為這裡沒有隱藏的敵人。忽略左右前兩個 守護者 Serpent。
18ee04de028dcf81f2c48832e9e2ac643e8e8a8c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

24466e861a8338cae3bea3e51f7868ee9c86aebc.source: Cross the bridge and kill the various Plants awaiting your team. There are some hidden Brooding Thorns beside the Guardian Serpent that must be killed to open the final gate to Urgoz's chamber.
24466e861a8338cae3bea3e51f7868ee9c86aebc.text: 過橋並殺死等待你的團隊的各種植物。 守護者 蛇旁邊有一些隱藏的荊棘，必須殺死它們才能開啟 爾果 房間的最後一扇門。
24466e861a8338cae3bea3e51f7868ee9c86aebc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

161e128b1635ec6d0beba0ac1654b283957b3379.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0804f96a3d92fc93ad36bf84417f02d2b9b8874a.source: Urgoz is in the center of this area, accompanied by two Greater Serpents. Urgoz uses Forest's Binding, which has an extremely long range, damages a foe and hexes them with Binding Chains. If characters get close enough to Urgoz, Explosive Growths will spawn. If it survives for several seconds, an Explosive Growth will die, causing an Exploding Spores effect, which will inflict 300 damage on you. Killing Explosive Growths will prevent the Exploding Spores effect. Don't stand still too long on the same spot or you will die.
0804f96a3d92fc93ad36bf84417f02d2b9b8874a.text: 爾果位於該區域的中心，伴隨著兩條大蛇。 爾果 使用森林的束縛，其射程極遠，對敵人造成傷害，並使用 束縛鎖鍊 對他們施咒。如果角色距離 爾果 夠近，就會產生爆炸生長。如果它存活了幾秒鐘，爆發增長就會死亡，造成爆炸孢子效果，這會對你造成300傷害。殺死爆炸性生長物將防止爆炸孢子效果。不要在同一個地方靜止太久，否則你會死。
0804f96a3d92fc93ad36bf84417f02d2b9b8874a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e10565e095b063078ff6dc487ad9134a3b02649d.source: Clear out the entrance to Urgoz's room to the east first and then clear and enter via the southern entrance. Just inside the southern entrance is a safe spot with a rock on the right. This is a safe place to flag your heroes, healers and your caster for Edge of Extinction--within Urgoz's attack range, but not Explosive Growth spawn range. Take a moment to run a player right up to Urgoz to ensure that Urgoz is in the area of effect for Edge of Extinction.
e10565e095b063078ff6dc487ad9134a3b02649d.text: 首先清理 爾果 房間東邊的入口，然後清理並從南邊入口進入。南入口內有安全地點，右側有一塊岩石。這是一個安全的地方，可以為 滅絕之地 標記您的英雄、治療者和施法者 - 在 爾果 的攻擊範圍內，但不在 爆發增長 的生成範圍內。花點時間執行播放器至 爾果，以確保 爾果 位於 滅絕之地 的影響範圍內。
e10565e095b063078ff6dc487ad9134a3b02649d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9b35f6ed7f857a993b199499cf80081940078fd5.source: If you did not kill the Twisted Bark in Section 7, party members will face the added burden of -4 energy degeneration in the south half of the room.
9b35f6ed7f857a993b199499cf80081940078fd5.text: 如果你沒有在 7 部分殺死扭曲樹皮，隊員將在房間南半部面臨 -4 能量退化的額外負擔。
9b35f6ed7f857a993b199499cf80081940078fd5.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d38682c9f6f8285b94eae09261e9f0a2c27bc1fd.source: Each Player can now run into the pop area for Explosive Growths, cast their Urgoz Skill (3 second cast time or less) and then move on and dodge Growths as needed. Keep running around the room using this technique. Once you reduce Urgoz to below 90% health it will start dying faster, but keep the pressure on with your Player characters.
d38682c9f6f8285b94eae09261e9f0a2c27bc1fd.text: 現在，每個玩家都可以跑進爆炸性生長的流行區域，施放 爾果 技能（3 第二次施法時間或更少），然後根據需要繼續前進並躲避生長。使用這種技術繼續在房間裡跑來跑去。一旦您將 爾果 的生命值降低到 90% 以下，它就會開始更快死亡，但請繼續對您的玩家角色施加壓力。
d38682c9f6f8285b94eae09261e9f0a2c27bc1fd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2c184208ff8be962f69999f905e112cc263b372b.source: If using a team of only heroes, flag the healers and Edge of Extinction caster in the safe spot mentioned above. Queue the other heroes' spike skills and flag them directly in front of Urgoz. Several Explosive Growths will spawn along their path and next to Urgoz while they are casting their skills. After a couple seconds, flag the heroes towards the column closest to the gate you did not enter from, then back to the original entrance. Repeat this triangular pattern of movement; the spike skills and dying Explosive Growths will gradually wear down Urgoz's health. The gates will remain open during the fight so you can reset if needed.
2c184208ff8be962f69999f905e112cc263b372b.text: 如果使用僅由英雄組成的團隊，請在上述安全地點標記治療者和 滅絕之地 施法者。將其他英雄的秒殺技能排隊，並將其直接標記在 爾果 前面。當他們施放技能時，會在他們的路徑上和 爾果 旁邊生成一些爆炸性生長物。幾秒鐘後，將英雄標記到距離您未進入的大門最近的列，然後返回原來的入口。重複這個三角形的運動模式；尖峰技能和垂死的爆炸性生長會逐漸消耗 爾果 的生命值。戰鬥期間大門將保持開啟狀態，因此您可以在需要時重置。
2c184208ff8be962f69999f905e112cc263b372b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

15471c930cd8489a148e3bb61202c68fae79cf63.source: Kill Urgoz and your objective is completed. You can mop up the Greater Serpents at your leisure.
15471c930cd8489a148e3bb61202c68fae79cf63.text: 殺死 爾果，你的目標就完成了。你可以在閒暇時清理巨蛇。
15471c930cd8489a148e3bb61202c68fae79cf63.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

96909f8c20b11384d27808721fe735dc531e03ca.source: After Urgoz is defeated, an Urgoz's Chest spawns, the Explosive Growths stop spawning and a teleporter activates at the eastern end of the room. Using the teleporter removes you from the party and returns you to the Urgoz's Warren outpost.
96909f8c20b11384d27808721fe735dc531e03ca.text: 爾果 被擊敗後，爾果 的 寶箱 會生成，爆炸生長物會停止生成，傳送器會在房間東端啟動。使用傳送器會將你從隊伍中移除並返回 爾果的養殖場 前哨站。
96909f8c20b11384d27808721fe735dc531e03ca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c7f3c40c152a12ba8c9241f2c6ca0b164a582856.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aa75df86a240d23284a82b784394c001c9ac3e15.source: There is no so called "standard build" for Urgoz's Warren, but there are key roles that are frequently used.
aa75df86a240d23284a82b784394c001c9ac3e15.text: 爾果的養殖場 沒有所謂的“標準建置”，但有一些經常使用的關鍵角色。
aa75df86a240d23284a82b784394c001c9ac3e15.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

beccbd9c1dcf8389efa3e7e34d5db03a5db27c1e.source: Lure/Guide (player): A person with a long range bow who knows where foes appear, where to go, and what to do.
beccbd9c1dcf8389efa3e7e34d5db03a5db27c1e.text: 誘餌/嚮導（玩家）：擁有遠距離弓箭的人，知道敵人出現在哪裡、去哪裡、做什麼。
beccbd9c1dcf8389efa3e7e34d5db03a5db27c1e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

14e8493cfbc555bce10ceefc396ce510bfdbfeea.source: Linebacker/Tank (2-players or heroes): A good linebacker/tank team can keep the most dangerous foes from reaching the midline.
14e8493cfbc555bce10ceefc396ce510bfdbfeea.text: 線衛/擋怪的人（2-玩家或英雄）：優秀的線衛/坦克團隊可以阻止最危險的敵人到達中線。
14e8493cfbc555bce10ceefc396ce510bfdbfeea.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6346e1bd55da82a5ca10e0ebacb3a1c3c5fbe1f1.source: Runner (player or hero): There are no resurrection shrines so if the entire party dies, it is all over, and you are teleported back to the Warren's entry point. Nominate a human player as a runner: a ranged attacker with Rebirth who can hold back and still contribute but runs away at the first sign of trouble. A speed boost might also be advantageous for this character.
6346e1bd55da82a5ca10e0ebacb3a1c3c5fbe1f1.text: 奔跑者（玩家或英雄）：沒有復活神殿，所以如果整個隊伍都死了，一切就結束了，你會被傳送回沃倫的入口點。指定人類玩家為跑者：使用 重生 的遠端攻擊者，他可以阻止並仍然做出貢獻，但一旦出現麻煩跡象就會逃跑。速度提升也可能對該角色有利。
6346e1bd55da82a5ca10e0ebacb3a1c3c5fbe1f1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ab3f40f3f53ada5abef82dcc136705484693b79a.source: Minion master (player or hero): A good minion master is useful. Include no fewer than 3 minion summons and Rotting Flesh. The monsters have no way of removing conditions, nor of passing disease back to your party, so this skill is exceptionally useful.
ab3f40f3f53ada5abef82dcc136705484693b79a.text: 隨從大師（玩家或英雄）：一個好的隨從大師很有用。包括不少於 3 小兵召喚和 肉體腐爛。怪物無法消除條件，也無法將疾病傳回給你的隊伍，所以這個技能非常有用。
ab3f40f3f53ada5abef82dcc136705484693b79a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0bc152ae8d20e290fb999035ef38547a79edbed2.source: Nukers (players or heroes): The bulk of the party will need to be able to dish out plenty of attacks using AoE damage. There are huge mobs of monsters in the warren, and you must destroy multiple targets at once if you are going to succeed.
0bc152ae8d20e290fb999035ef38547a79edbed2.text: Nukers（玩家或英雄）：大部分隊伍需要能夠使用 範圍性 傷害來發動大量攻擊。沃倫中有大量怪物，如果你想成功，你必須一次摧毀多個目標。
0bc152ae8d20e290fb999035ef38547a79edbed2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e5620a0f8c29d150a0227bc1a80d7823194c61a7.source: Healers (players or heroes): Usually only two healers are used for a run through Urgoz's Warren using players (bring more healers if using heroes). This can be a combination of Protection, Spike Healing, Party Heals, etc., depending on your party mix. If your healers are predominantly heroes, make sure you spread them around the players.
e5620a0f8c29d150a0227bc1a80d7823194c61a7.text: 治療者（玩家或英雄）：通常只有兩位治療者用於使用玩家來執行 爾果的養殖場（如果使用英雄，請攜帶更多治療者）。這可以是保護、尖峰治療、隊伍 治療等的組合，這取決於您的團隊組合。如果你的治療者主要是英雄，請確保將他們分散到玩家周圍。
e5620a0f8c29d150a0227bc1a80d7823194c61a7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

20a76be4ce09efeddc48b7c39f8416b8d121ffbb.source: Edge of Extinction (player or flagged hero): This party member creates an Edge of Extinction spirit. This is very useful with a lot of AoE, because it damages anyone of the same type under 90% health when something is killed. Some also kill Urgoz with this spirit, by attacking Urgoz until he is under 90% health and then letting the pop ups around him blow themselves up, eventually killing Urgoz. Be wary of your team exploding too.
20a76be4ce09efeddc48b7c39f8416b8d121ffbb.text: 滅絕之地（玩家或標記的英雄）：這位隊伍成員創造了 滅絕之地 精神。這對於大量 範圍性 非常有用，因為當某些東西被殺死時，它會損害 90% 下相同型別的任何人的健康狀況。有些人也用這種精神殺死 爾果，攻擊 爾果 直到他的生命值低於 90%，然後讓他周圍的彈出視窗引爆自己，最終殺死 爾果。也要警惕你的團隊的爆炸。
20a76be4ce09efeddc48b7c39f8416b8d121ffbb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0cba1249913bca59f029708078699cd9a1b1d4ca.text: 其他有用的各方考慮因素。
0cba1249913bca59f029708078699cd9a1b1d4ca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6bdbf8d43a01a0c2b97108b8698dc4a79dd52fbe.source: The more players the better. This can be done with a single player and seven Heroes but more players can speed up the run and makes Urgoz's room easier.
6bdbf8d43a01a0c2b97108b8698dc4a79dd52fbe.text: 玩家越多越好。這可以透過一個玩家和七個英雄來完成，但更多的玩家可以加快執行速度並使 爾果 的房間更容易。
6bdbf8d43a01a0c2b97108b8698dc4a79dd52fbe.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0be97016800972434dfdba6c86139ade1fae9def.source: When making a party, be aware of skill synergy - for example a paragon with "They're on Fire!" might be extremely useful when you have many elementalists with fire magic in your party. Or a Ritualist with Splinter Weapon with Barrage-rangers.
0be97016800972434dfdba6c86139ade1fae9def.text: 舉辦派對時，請注意技能協同作用 - 例如，一個典範會說“他們著火了！”當你的隊伍中有許多擁有火魔法的元素主義者時，這可能非常有用。或 祭祀者 與 爆刺武裝 與 齊射 護林員。
0be97016800972434dfdba6c86139ade1fae9def.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fd111cbf819ffaf8edbddbdbebed5f7e8e89e79e.source: Do not take too many healers as it will reduce your AoE offensive capability. Two should be sufficient for a Normal Mode run.
fd111cbf819ffaf8edbddbdbebed5f7e8e89e79e.text: 不要帶太多治療者，因為這會降低你的 範圍性 進攻能力。對於正常模式運作來說，兩個應該就夠了。
fd111cbf819ffaf8edbddbdbebed5f7e8e89e79e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b0dfb30c357879af42daaac4f2a91e11b05acd0d.source: Taking a minion master or spirit spammer helps occupy a mob while AoE damage destroys it.
b0dfb30c357879af42daaac4f2a91e11b05acd0d.text: 佔領小兵大師或靈魂垃圾郵件傳送者有助於佔領小怪，而 範圍性 傷害則會摧毀它。
b0dfb30c357879af42daaac4f2a91e11b05acd0d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0da37310494dc12c380e0a34b42348b88eddb10c.source: Check if everyone has a minimum of 2 hours of time. A group has a higher chance of failing if they rush and aggro as much as possible to speed up the mission. Instances of one player running in (towards a chest for example) will endanger the whole mission. Make this clear to the group before starting.
0da37310494dc12c380e0a34b42348b88eddb10c.text: 檢查每個人是否至少有 2 小時的時間。如果團隊盡可能地衝刺和仇恨以加快任務速度，那麼他們失敗的可能性就會更高。一名玩家跑進去（例如跑向箱子）的情況會危及整個任務。在開始之前向小組明確這一點。
0da37310494dc12c380e0a34b42348b88eddb10c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2d9565c42406702908acb13374a75eb451a207d3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d04bdff573d3af1a75aff7bbd07599b74576d3e9.source: Once the gate opens, keep your team behind the gateway and pull the big groups of Brooding Thorns and Burning Brushes back to the gate and use a few party members to form a bottle neck trap to easily dispatch them. Beware rushing into the next room since there will be ranger traps that were laid by the Brooding Thorns.
d04bdff573d3af1a75aff7bbd07599b74576d3e9.text: 一旦大門開啟，讓你的團隊留在大門後面，並將大群的沉思荊棘和燃燒灌木拉回大門，並使用一些小隊成員來 型態 一個瓶頸陷阱，可以輕鬆消滅它們。小心衝進下一個房間，因為那裡會佈下沉思荊棘的遊俠陷阱。
d04bdff573d3af1a75aff7bbd07599b74576d3e9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

35e83205e3a6ce4b4eb07871bbb46fbf753987d8.source: Now you will see a bridge ahead, with a ramp at each side upto two sets of levers. Clear the room and pull both levers to open the gate to the next section. Your team could choose to shelter from the ranged attacks of the Dredge by standing beneath the bridge.
35e83205e3a6ce4b4eb07871bbb46fbf753987d8.text: 現在您將看到前面有一座橋，橋的兩側各有一個坡道，可通往兩組槓桿。清理房間並拉動兩個控制桿以開啟通往下一部分的大門。您的團隊可以選擇站在橋下躲避 挖掘者 的遠端攻擊。
35e83205e3a6ce4b4eb07871bbb46fbf753987d8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

71fe4aa6d80fc9787c934a99e2efd68b220802fb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b1ad0355bf0ade5da6e4eb3b80dba0c87e542a31.source: This section consists of a long dark bridge over a pit, with Fire Flowers along each side. If someone runs onto the bridge, the Fire Flowers act like turrets and will spit fire at them. There are points along the bridge where groups of Thorn Wolves appear - these can easily kill your lure.
b1ad0355bf0ade5da6e4eb3b80dba0c87e542a31.text: 這部分由一座跨越坑的長黑橋組成，每側都有火花。如果有人跑上橋，火花就會像砲塔一樣向他們噴火。橋上的某些地方會出現成群的荊棘狼 - 這些可以輕鬆殺死你的誘惑。
b1ad0355bf0ade5da6e4eb3b80dba0c87e542a31.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

563d8dbbb326c71f29cbe22741e5f36cbaf97f8e.source: After killing the first group of wolves along the bridge, setup a spirit decoy at the entrance to the bridge (if you have no spirits, you can later just kill the suicidal creatures at range before they reach your party). Proceed to the next wolf spawn, and kill them. Moving further along the bridge will spawn a third group of Wolves, kill them and then kill any remaining Hopping Vampires and Thought Stealers that spawned at the start of the bridge beside your spirit decoy. Continue to the end of the bridge, where another group of Hopping Vampires and Thought Stealers will spawn.
563d8dbbb326c71f29cbe22741e5f36cbaf97f8e.text: 殺死橋上的第一群狼後，在橋的入口處設定一個靈魂誘餌（如果你沒有靈魂，你可以稍後在自殺的生物到達你的隊伍之前殺死它們）。前往下一個狼產卵處，殺死它們。沿著橋繼續前進會產生第三組狼，殺死它們，然後殺死在橋的起點處你的靈魂誘餌旁邊產生的任何剩餘的跳躍吸血鬼和思想竊取者。繼續走到橋的盡頭，那裡會出現另一群跳躍吸血鬼和思想竊取者。
563d8dbbb326c71f29cbe22741e5f36cbaf97f8e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

52eee6104b4878ea89017a18a86c9d304f9ef2d2.source: Kill the Guardian Serpent to continue to room 5.
52eee6104b4878ea89017a18a86c9d304f9ef2d2.text: 殺死 守護者 蛇以繼續進入 5 房間。
52eee6104b4878ea89017a18a86c9d304f9ef2d2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8d87bb75cbe2592ea87436c28481c6b086db58f9.source: This section has quite a big room with 3 exits, but you only need the exit to the west. Have your lure pull the Thorn Wolves that pop up by strafing around the room. The four hidden groups of wolves patrol underground. Lure them back to your party at the gate (where there is no exhaustion effect) and finish the wolves off.
8d87bb75cbe2592ea87436c28481c6b086db58f9.text: 這個部分有一個相當大的房間，有3出口，但你只需要往西的出口。讓你的誘餌拉動在房間裡掃射而彈出的荊棘狼。四群隱藏的狼群在地下巡邏。將他們引回門口的隊伍中（那裡沒有疲憊效果）並消滅狼群。
8d87bb75cbe2592ea87436c28481c6b086db58f9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3eab00e9573881a7afb70152d1df2d4156749e09.source: When all four groups are defeated, head across the room through the vine gate on the left and onto the bridge - your party will now be under the Environmental Effect. It is much easier to just ignore the Twisted Bark in this room and move on to the next room.
3eab00e9573881a7afb70152d1df2d4156749e09.text: 當所有四個小組都被擊敗後，穿過房間，穿過左邊的藤門，到達橋上 - 你的隊伍現在將受到環境影響。忽略這個房間中的扭曲樹皮並前往下一個房間要容易得多。
3eab00e9573881a7afb70152d1df2d4156749e09.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

deb18be5ddf7e2330e733c08bc4fabf9ae0940f1.source: Rangers: Barrage and Edge of Extinction (place the spirit behind doors or walls so it is not easily destroyed by foes).
deb18be5ddf7e2330e733c08bc4fabf9ae0940f1.text: 遊騎兵：齊射 和 滅絕之地（將靈魂放在門或牆後面，這樣它就不會輕易被敵人摧毀）。
deb18be5ddf7e2330e733c08bc4fabf9ae0940f1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7c3f6f4380408330fa1c986894868975eecb15ca.source: Elementalists: Meteor Shower, Mark of Rodgort, or Searing Flames.
7c3f6f4380408330fa1c986894868975eecb15ca.text: 元素主義者：隕石雨、洛葛特的印記 或 爆裂火焰。
7c3f6f4380408330fa1c986894868975eecb15ca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7ba67b94bcc24c5a092f3957f317671f564105df.source: Ebon Battle Standard of Honor will help improve everyone's damage.
7ba67b94bcc24c5a092f3957f317671f564105df.text: 黑檀 榮譽戰旗將有助於提高每個人的傷害。
7ba67b94bcc24c5a092f3957f317671f564105df.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9aebdc7ea0a513742675d926bdec7cd90a9bd502.source: Mesmers: Energy Surge, Ineptitude (useful vs wolves), Panic, and Mistrust.
9aebdc7ea0a513742675d926bdec7cd90a9bd502.text: 催眠師：能量震盪、愚蠢（對狼有用）、恐慌 和 疑惑。
9aebdc7ea0a513742675d926bdec7cd90a9bd502.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e883981cace522924796bbbf33ba038f26daaed9.source: Necromancers: Spiteful Spirit combination with minions, Blood is Power Blood Magic build.
e883981cace522924796bbbf33ba038f26daaed9.text: 死靈法師：惡靈附身 與小兵組合，血之權能 血魔法 建構。
e883981cace522924796bbbf33ba038f26daaed9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

426e0e3165b3fe2e7334c5e5ac276a9e76509d13.source: Heal Party, Divine Healing, Protective Was Kaolai, and Aegis are effective. Ritualist spirits and Paragon shouts that affect the party are also beneficial.
426e0e3165b3fe2e7334c5e5ac276a9e76509d13.text: 治癒隊伍、神聖治癒、護衛者高萊 和 神賜之盾 有效。影響隊伍的祭祀者精神和聖言者喊聲也有好處。
426e0e3165b3fe2e7334c5e5ac276a9e76509d13.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

dd65f33ed1200261fb23c16f499107bac9c8258d.source: Energy management: your party must be able to counter the energy loss effects in various rooms. Consider a battery.
dd65f33ed1200261fb23c16f499107bac9c8258d.text: 能量 管理：您的隊伍必須能應付各個房間的能量損失影響。考慮電池。
dd65f33ed1200261fb23c16f499107bac9c8258d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

421c11c1393fec909e6085bc990fe80f3ad3c8c2.source: Protection spells: Protective Spirit or Shelter will prevent Thorn Wolves from killing your party members in one hit.
421c11c1393fec909e6085bc990fe80f3ad3c8c2.text: 保護法術：精神守護 或 庇護 將阻止荊棘狼一擊殺死你的隊伍成員。
421c11c1393fec909e6085bc990fe80f3ad3c8c2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

785ca75345c69058c29abedf531aa2f0bbb5580e.source: Resurrection Spells: Remember to bring a resurrection spell. Spells used for in combat resurrection spells should resurrect at full health such as Resurrection Chant, and for long range resurrection spells in case party is required to retreat consider using spells like Rebirth. Unyielding Aura on a monk serves both these goals as well as boosting the healing of Divine Healing or Heal Party.
785ca75345c69058c29abedf531aa2f0bbb5580e.text: 復活法術：記得帶復活法術。用於戰鬥復活法術的法術應在滿血狀態下復活，例如 復活聖歌，而對於遠端復活法術，如果一方需要撤退，請考慮使用 重生 等法術。武僧身上的 堅毅靈氣 既能達成這些目標，也能促進 神聖治癒 或 治癒隊伍 的治療。
785ca75345c69058c29abedf531aa2f0bbb5580e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ba2e763511d1760c53fe95ad7c04ed8573fd5d61.source: Hex removal skills are useful, as Thorn Wolves use Shroud of Silence which can quickly render your monks useless.
ba2e763511d1760c53fe95ad7c04ed8573fd5d61.text: 移除妖術技能非常有用，因為荊棘狼使用 寂靜遮蔽，它很快就會讓你的武僧變得毫無用處。
ba2e763511d1760c53fe95ad7c04ed8573fd5d61.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

15706e3136db0ed84a781a1f4c895b2d04ce2b8e.source: Environment effects: Try to lure enemy groups outside of the Environment Effects. Only enter the area of the Environment Effect when you are sure you can eliminate the Twisted Bark that is causing the effect.
15706e3136db0ed84a781a1f4c895b2d04ce2b8e.text: 環境效果：嘗試將敵方群體引誘到環境效果之外。只有當您確定可以消除造成效果的扭曲樹皮時，才進入環境效果區域。
15706e3136db0ed84a781a1f4c895b2d04ce2b8e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

91edd1cd2848f5476706579380989d46cb683f19.source: Luring: Let your Lure take their time and watch the patrols to lure only one group at a time. The Lure should be able to strafe: shoot and run backwards, running side to side as you retreat. This ensures groups stay aggroed and follow. Also, strafing in rooms should allow easier aggro of hidden underground (Thorn Wolves) and ceiling (Greater Blood Drinker) creatures.
91edd1cd2848f5476706579380989d46cb683f19.text: 引誘：讓你的誘餌慢慢來，觀察巡邏隊，一次只引誘一組。誘餌應該能夠掃射：射擊並向後跑，在撤退時從一邊跑到另一邊。這可以確保團體保持關注並跟隨。此外，在房間裡掃射應該可以更容易攻擊隱藏的地下（荊棘狼）和天花板（更偉大的鮮血飲者）生物。
91edd1cd2848f5476706579380989d46cb683f19.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

94a68381d7c5aed143289293e24b8814ce9f4f94.source: Patience: Listen to your Guide and be patient. Also wait for your minion master to raise as many Minions as possible after each combat and then regenerate Energy for next combat. Allow relevant characters to raise Pets post-combat also.
94a68381d7c5aed143289293e24b8814ce9f4f94.text: 耐心：聆聽您的指南並保持耐心。也要等待你的小兵大師在每次戰鬥後培養盡可能多的小兵，然後為下一場戰鬥重新生成 能量。也允許相關角色在戰鬥後飼養寵物。
94a68381d7c5aed143289293e24b8814ce9f4f94.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

704fdd39d94a57eda04f31d76233cf8441625eaa.source: Ensure Edge of Extinction, wards, shouts, and healing spirits are up at all times. Control your Heroes manually if needed.
704fdd39d94a57eda04f31d76233cf8441625eaa.text: 確保 滅絕之地、守衛、喊叫和治療精神始終處於狀態。如果需要，手動控制你的英雄。
704fdd39d94a57eda04f31d76233cf8441625eaa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

44158212d72d9414e1bebc7acca2a2c8f74ebc44.source: Pets: Bring as many pets as you can. The party size of 12 means that a pet shield can be incredibly useful, especially since pets do not accrue Death Penalty.
44158212d72d9414e1bebc7acca2a2c8f74ebc44.text: 寵物：盡可能多攜帶寵物。 12 的隊伍規模意味著寵物護盾非常有用，特別是因為寵物不會產生死刑。
44158212d72d9414e1bebc7acca2a2c8f74ebc44.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1df935a7b5bc883d7859e841f4790d699b9e5344.source: Consumables: Bring some items that remove DP or give party bonuses to health and attributes. This is a long mission, and even with a good team, dying is an occupational hazard. A morale boost at critical points can potentially make or break an Urgoz run.
1df935a7b5bc883d7859e841f4790d699b9e5344.text: 消耗品：攜帶一些可以消除 DP 或給予隊伍生命值和屬性獎勵的物品。這是一項漫長的任務，即使有再好的團隊，死亡也是一種職業病。關鍵時刻計程車氣提升可能會決定 爾果 運作的成敗。
1df935a7b5bc883d7859e841f4790d699b9e5344.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

424ff1211b9309753d2523e80d2099942d52e2d2.source: Chests and Treasure: Don’t forget to bring keys and lockpicks to open chests. Although these are expensive, the rewards from this area are worth it. Zodiac items can only be gained from Urgoz’s Warren and The Deep, and they are very valuable, popular skins. Do not rush forward to chests without telling the party your intentions - especially in uncleared areas.
424ff1211b9309753d2523e80d2099942d52e2d2.text: 箱子和寶藏：別忘了帶鑰匙和開鎖器來開啟箱子。儘管這些都很昂貴，但該領域的回報是值得的。十二生肖物品只能從 爾果 的沃倫和 深處 獲得，它們是非常有價值、受歡迎的皮膚。不要在沒有告訴對方你的意圖的情況下衝向箱子——尤其是在未清理的區域。
424ff1211b9309753d2523e80d2099942d52e2d2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

77af0ae1733f25e4285623de2e0a65b3b81ef0b3.source: Killing Urgoz for the first time raises your account's Kurzick faction cap by 10,000.
77af0ae1733f25e4285623de2e0a65b3b81ef0b3.text: 首次終止 爾果 會讓您帳號的 庫茲柯 陣營值 上限提升 10,000。
77af0ae1733f25e4285623de2e0a65b3b81ef0b3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ea9150f59cef28c237556a4a9dfc7f51452c8e11.source: Be sure to obtain the quest for the Miniature Island Guardian from Merrise, Sworn to Seas, at embark beach if attempting to do this dungeon in Hard Mode for the first time since the 2025 anniversary update.
ea9150f59cef28c237556a4a9dfc7f51452c8e11.text: 如果自 2025 週年更新以來第一次嘗試在困難模式下完成這個地下城，請務必從登船海灘的宣誓海洋的 Merrise 那裡獲得微型 島嶼守護者 的任務。
ea9150f59cef28c237556a4a9dfc7f51452c8e11.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e461d97e8d671e257ad5aa0c8344315dddfbc11f.source: If someone is too close to the gate in room 10 when it closes, that person can be trapped within the door and won't be able to move out of it.
e461d97e8d671e257ad5aa0c8344315dddfbc11f.text: 如果有人在 10 房間關閉時離門太近，則該人可能會被困在門內而無法離開。
e461d97e8d671e257ad5aa0c8344315dddfbc11f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f1c1112705470fe0933768ebaaa49ea5503f088c.source: Seal the rifts in Vehtendi Valley by defeating all demons surrounding each rift. You have 3...0 rifts left to seal.
f1c1112705470fe0933768ebaaa49ea5503f088c.text: 擊敗每個裂縫周圍的所有惡魔，密封 巍天帝峽谷 中的裂縫。您還有 3...0 裂痕需要密封。
f1c1112705470fe0933768ebaaa49ea5503f088c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6ab7bb409b9e62bbce73a1352287efe98065f5cf.source: As in the preceeding quest, Yahnur Market is the closest starting point. Head into Vehtendi Valley and follow your quest pointer to each of the three rifts, where you must eliminate the Margonites around them to close the rift. When you have closed all 3 rifts, return to Prince Bokka in Resplendent Makuun for your reward.
6ab7bb409b9e62bbce73a1352287efe98065f5cf.text: 與前面的任務一樣，雅諾爾市集 是最近的起點。進入 巍天帝峽谷 並按照任務指標到達三個裂縫中的每一個，在那裡你必須消滅它們周圍的瑪貢尼特以關閉裂縫。當您關閉所有 3 裂縫後，返回輝煌馬庫恩的博卡王子那裡領取獎勵。
6ab7bb409b9e62bbce73a1352287efe98065f5cf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b48bbdd0e206f1c205207fa942594d4a35b85df0.source: If this quest is active, Jarimiya the Unmerciful does not spawn.
b48bbdd0e206f1c205207fa942594d4a35b85df0.text: 如果此任務處於活動狀態，無情者賈裡米亞不會產生。
b48bbdd0e206f1c205207fa942594d4a35b85df0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

704c96073e493d691ede789c1d5d2fcc5845088f.source: Find and kill the Bandit Ringleaders inside Regent Valley. [6...0] remain.
704c96073e493d691ede789c1d5d2fcc5845088f.text: 找出並殺死 統治者之谷 內的強盜頭目。 [6...0] 保留。
704c96073e493d691ede789c1d5d2fcc5845088f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d9fba2f33d7f6924399c917700f7b28420515520.source: See Lieutenant Langmar for your reward.
d9fba2f33d7f6924399c917700f7b28420515520.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d308ff46199403ac463ade091e22dd1f63d0e7b1.source: The locations pointed out on the map are approximate. The Ringleaders may spawn more than compass range away from each of the 6 locations.
d308ff46199403ac463ade091e22dd1f63d0e7b1.text: 地圖上指出的位置均為近似位置。頭目可能會在距離每個 6 位置超過羅盤範圍的地方產生。
d308ff46199403ac463ade091e22dd1f63d0e7b1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b1a5c0870ce5f10b2e2510dd48c6405ee323b66e.source: This quest can be done very quickly by some professions (mesmer for instance) by focusing only on Bandit Ringleaders and moving between groups under the effects of a Birthday Cupcake.
b1a5c0870ce5f10b2e2510dd48c6405ee323b66e.text: 某些職業（例如幻術師）可以透過僅關注強盜頭目並在生日蛋糕的影響下在團體之間移動來快速完成此任務。
b1a5c0870ce5f10b2e2510dd48c6405ee323b66e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

493f71d26e11b0f8520dbe7b472d9dc61a8c06c3.source: The bandits spawned by this quest are hostile to Mary Malone and Ivor Trueshot, and will occasionally spawn close enough to aggro and kill them.
493f71d26e11b0f8520dbe7b472d9dc61a8c06c3.text: 此任務產生的強盜對 瑪莉瑪倫 和 神射手伊波爾 懷有敵意，並且偶爾會產生足夠近的距離來仇恨並殺死它們。
493f71d26e11b0f8520dbe7b472d9dc61a8c06c3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0d722b642bf1872f307307d66b4297d5ac1c0832.source: When one bandit leader remains, the quest text erroneously ends with 1 remain.
0d722b642bf1872f307307d66b4297d5ac1c0832.text: 當剩下一個強盜首領時，任務文字會錯誤地以 1 結尾。
0d722b642bf1872f307307d66b4297d5ac1c0832.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

dd775032bcd3639f183fd0461001ff2bd70c84ad.source: "These bandit raids are getting ridiculous! Frankly, I don't care if their motives are greed, politics, or anything else, I just want them gone and out of our hair! I'm fairly sure if we take out their leaders, the rest will either flee or be too disorganized to pose a serious threat. If you are up to the task, go to Regent Valley and Kill all of the Bandit Ringleaders. That should let the rest of them know we aren't going to stand for this any longer!"
dd775032bcd3639f183fd0461001ff2bd70c84ad.text: 「這些強盜攻擊變得越來越荒謬！坦白說，我不在乎他們的動機是貪婪、政治還是其他任何東西，我只想讓他們消失，從我們的頭髮中消失！我相當確定，如果我們除掉他們的領導人，其餘的人要麼逃跑，要麼組織混亂，無法構成嚴重威脅。如果你能勝任這項任務，去統治者之谷
dd775032bcd3639f183fd0461001ff2bd70c84ad.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

303ab2a70131904f88d99cd5ce8891976be6b502.source: Find and kill the Charr Champions inside the Northlands. [6...0] remain.
303ab2a70131904f88d99cd5ce8891976be6b502.text: 找出並殺死北地內的 夏爾 冠軍。 [6...0] 保留。
303ab2a70131904f88d99cd5ce8891976be6b502.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9e85ef8661c471ae46764c49ddb3c4b90b9323c3.source: There are more than 6 potential spawn points. Another one is slightly east of the entrance from Lakeside County. Also spotted on the far east side past the double-bridge.
9e85ef8661c471ae46764c49ddb3c4b90b9323c3.text: 有超過 6 的潛在生成點。另一個位於 湖畔郡 入口稍偏東的位置。在雙橋後方的遠東側也發現了這種現象。
9e85ef8661c471ae46764c49ddb3c4b90b9323c3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ce239801ec8a59091771a3e36741f8513a5b355f.source: The Champion Groups consist of a Charr Champion, and 2 Charr which might be of any combination of the lower levels. For example, a Charr Fire Caller and a Charr Stalker.
ce239801ec8a59091771a3e36741f8513a5b355f.text: 勇士(公會戰頭銜) 群組由 夏爾 勇士(公會戰頭銜) 和 2 夏爾 組成，它們可以是較低階的任意組合。例如，夏爾火焰招喚者 和 夏爾潛行者。
ce239801ec8a59091771a3e36741f8513a5b355f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

07c467be8ad71d57f967f3a0bf46bb8450cffe28.source: When one charr champion remains, the quest text erroneously ends with 1 remain.
07c467be8ad71d57f967f3a0bf46bb8450cffe28.text: 當剩下一位夏爾冠軍時，任務文字會錯誤地以 1 剩餘結束。
07c467be8ad71d57f967f3a0bf46bb8450cffe28.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6d75fe01f620bbc36c83550f2710012aa235b2a9.source: The Undead Necromancer just north of Ashford Abbey zone will kill the gargoyles as you approach and create minions; because of this, it is advised to trigger its spawn then go kill the other necromancers so that the minions will die on their own. You can also opt to spike the Necromancer first so that its underlings have to fend off the masterless minions.
6d75fe01f620bbc36c83550f2710012aa235b2a9.text: 灰色淺灘修道院 區域以北的 不死系 死靈法師 會在您接近時殺死石像鬼並創造小兵；因此，建議觸發它的生成，然後去殺死其他死靈法師，這樣小兵就會自行死亡。你也可以選擇先刺殺 死靈法師，這樣它的下屬就必須抵禦無主的小兵。
6d75fe01f620bbc36c83550f2710012aa235b2a9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e304f2a30b062b8b3a6898ff330f48fdabd83e11.source: The Undead Necromancer in the northwestern pit's room can spawn on either the left or right side of the room.
e304f2a30b062b8b3a6898ff330f48fdabd83e11.text: 西北坑房間中的 不死系 死靈法師 可以在房間的左側或右側生成。
e304f2a30b062b8b3a6898ff330f48fdabd83e11.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

df6533bf8aea904563e3cc743c00a39228ce36bb.source: Several active quests can provide allies:
df6533bf8aea904563e3cc743c00a39228ce36bb.text: 幾個活躍的任務可以為盟友提供：
df6533bf8aea904563e3cc743c00a39228ce36bb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

032048eda27f89b6c12621102ff373e230bf261d.source: A Monk's Mission and Rites of Remembrance will spawn allies in the area with the Swamp Water. Respectively, Paulus the Abbot, a level 3 ally with skills dealing holy damage, and several Restless Spirits, level 10 allies.
032048eda27f89b6c12621102ff373e230bf261d.text: 僧侶任務 和 紀念儀式 將在有沼澤水的區域生成盟友。分別是方丈保盧斯（Paulus the Abbot），具有造成神聖傷害技能的 3 等級盟友，以及幾個不安分的靈魂，10 等級盟友。
032048eda27f89b6c12621102ff373e230bf261d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

27a9fa2f2be35c95d601b2474b09e0e5cd0bfaf8.source: The Necromancer's Novice will have Necromancer Munne, a level 5 ally, guide you to the area before the spiders. However, you have to talk to her and this will override your secondary profession skills with necromancer skills.
27a9fa2f2be35c95d601b2474b09e0e5cd0bfaf8.text: 死靈法師的新成員 將有 死靈法師繆涅，5 級別的盟友，引導您到達蜘蛛之前的區域。然而，你必須與她交談，這將用死靈法師技能取代你的次要職業技能。
27a9fa2f2be35c95d601b2474b09e0e5cd0bfaf8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b739edf464c4acdf292f0d9de046dd13a07c97a3.source: "Necromancer Munne may not want to admit it, but the number of roaming undead in the Catacombs is getting dangerous. Each day there are more decomposing abominations roaming the dark halls of that place. Recently, we've even encountered some making their way to the surface and frightening the locals. Or worse, attacking them!
b739edf464c4acdf292f0d9de046dd13a07c97a3.text: 「死靈法師繆涅可能不想承認這一點，但地下墓穴中游蕩的不死生物數量正變得越來越危險。每天都有更多的腐爛怪物在那個地方的黑暗大廳中游盪。最近，我們甚至遇到了一些它們來到地表並嚇壞了當地人。或者更糟的是，攻擊他們！
b739edf464c4acdf292f0d9de046dd13a07c97a3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c2edb4915a18d39dcf4185d5ff2148df94ef5113.source: We have discovered that the increasing number of undead in the Catacombs is caused by several powerful Undead Necromancers whose tombs have been disturbed. They are now going through the Catacombs, animating every corpse they come across. Go to the Catacombs and put those Necromancers back to rest, so we don't have to worry about walking dead in addition to Charr. Unless, of course, you're afraid of the dark..."
c2edb4915a18d39dcf4185d5ff2148df94ef5113.text: 我們發現地下墓穴中亡靈數量的增加是由幾名強大的不死系死靈法師的墳墓被擾亂造成的。他們現在正在穿過地下墓穴，啟用他們遇到的每一具屍體。去地下墓穴讓那些死靈法師重新安息，這樣我們除了夏爾就不用擔心行屍走肉了。當然，除非你害怕黑暗…”
c2edb4915a18d39dcf4185d5ff2148df94ef5113.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b6f421ce2717bc9fcfaab79333438617095b45e9.source: Find and kill Blazefiend Griefblade inside the Northlands.
b6f421ce2717bc9fcfaab79333438617095b45e9.text: 在北地找到並殺死烈焰魔悲傷之刃。
b6f421ce2717bc9fcfaab79333438617095b45e9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

43d22d6ffdeea71a1b9efbfec4ab5d464ce9fb4e.source: Once you've identified her location, pull any wandering groups of Firestarters or Raiders away before engaging. Be especially cautious of any nearby Bandit Blood Sworn, as aggroing one can aggro more surrounding Vanguard foes. When you confront the Countess open with Firestorm and/or Backfire before closing in. Use a pet, minions, or the Fire Imp as a meatshield to absorb her powerful Backfire and Empathy. If you're lucky, she'll cast Shatter Delusions herself and inadvertently remove the hex.
43d22d6ffdeea71a1b9efbfec4ab5d464ce9fb4e.text: 一旦你確定了她的位置，在交戰之前將所有遊蕩的點火者或襲擊者群體拉開。要特別小心任何附近的 血咒強盜，因為攻擊它可能會攻擊周圍更多的先鋒敵人。當您在接近伯爵夫人時使用火焰風暴和/或 魔力反噬 面對伯爵夫人時。使用寵物、小兵或 火焰小惡魔 作為肉盾來吸收她強大的 魔力反噬 和 自虐。如果你幸運的話，她會自己施放 幻覺粉碎 並無意中移除咒語。
43d22d6ffdeea71a1b9efbfec4ab5d464ce9fb4e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8d60cc0f39fe7c8e4e7d3dd845b806d1dd1cf094.source: Similarly to all Vanguard Bounty targets, the Countess will speak the Intermediate Dialogue if you come close enough to her spawning point. If she's already dead when you do, one of the other quest-related Bandits nearby will say the dialogue instead.
8d60cc0f39fe7c8e4e7d3dd845b806d1dd1cf094.text: 與所有先鋒賞金目標類似，如果您距離伯爵夫人的生成點足夠近，伯爵夫人將說出中級對話。如果你這樣做時她已經死了，附近的其他與任務相關的強盜之一將會說出對話。
8d60cc0f39fe7c8e4e7d3dd845b806d1dd1cf094.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

070be2a36df49867d9624e7677890ad337755882.source: This quest occasionally spawns lone bandits near the portals in Regent Valley. This includes a spawn near Fort Ranik, which will lead to the death of Mary Malone.
070be2a36df49867d9624e7677890ad337755882.text: 此任務偶爾會在 統治者之谷 的傳送門附近產生孤獨的強盜。這包括拉尼克堡附近的生成，這將導致 瑪莉瑪倫 的死亡。
070be2a36df49867d9624e7677890ad337755882.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3ee5a52c8ddeeaafcec08dd1936915204c592559.source: Find and kill Utini Wupwup inside of Green Hills County.
3ee5a52c8ddeeaafcec08dd1936915204c592559.text: 在 綠丘郡 中找到並殺死 Utini Wupwup。
3ee5a52c8ddeeaafcec08dd1936915204c592559.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6bcd955ebce6506b19b9f1dbf92ccd57dbbdb360.source: Leave from Barradin Estate. Utini spawns randomly in one of 4 possible locations in the area listed on the map to the right. Throughout the explorable, there are several groups of two grawls, which can be either warrior or monk. The boss itself is always accompanied by two warriors.
6bcd955ebce6506b19b9f1dbf92ccd57dbbdb360.text: 從巴拉丁莊園出發。 Utini 在右側地圖上列出的區域中的 4 可能位置之一隨機產生。在整個探索過程中，有幾組兩隻穴居人，可以是戰士，也可以是僧侶。 Boss本身總是有兩位戰士陪伴。
6bcd955ebce6506b19b9f1dbf92ccd57dbbdb360.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

85dfb4481a3a34af27ec9dc18da5457804bcde4f.source: It is a good idea to refrain from dealing a lot of damage to the Grawl warriors until they start attacking. This is because if they haven't taken too much damage they will use Frenzy, allowing you to deal double damage to them, as well as usually rendering their monks unable to outheal the damage (especially considering the fact that they also have Healing Signet which lowers their defense).
85dfb4481a3a34af27ec9dc18da5457804bcde4f.text: 在 穴居人 戰士開始攻擊之前，最好不要對其造成大量傷害。這是因為，如果他們沒有受到太多傷害，他們會使用 狂暴，讓你對他們造成雙倍傷害，並且通常會使他們的武士無法治癒傷害（特別是考慮到他們也有 治療紋章，這會降低他們的防禦）。
85dfb4481a3a34af27ec9dc18da5457804bcde4f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

89df034f3701dd788b7887a7cc60d59def1b66e4.source: Spells dealing AoE damage like Symbol of Wrath or Fire Storm are especially effective.
89df034f3701dd788b7887a7cc60d59def1b66e4.text: 造成 範圍性 傷害的法術（如 神怒之符 或 火焰風暴）特別有效。
89df034f3701dd788b7887a7cc60d59def1b66e4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f8725c3006a52f26118bc45ae7af3db6fc0c76ad.source: Don't wait for too long, however, as Hammer Bash can interrupt you in the middle of an important spell.
f8725c3006a52f26118bc45ae7af3db6fc0c76ad.text: 不過，不要等太久，因為 鎚子重擊 可能會在重要咒語中打斷您。
f8725c3006a52f26118bc45ae7af3db6fc0c76ad.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0fc2b0270bef5bbce4d74ebb9002c314abd73ef8.source: The holy damage caused by Utini Wupwup and the Grawl Shamans, especially from Symbol of Wrath and Banish, as well as the lack of exploitable corpses, usually makes attempts to use minions difficult if not impossible.
0fc2b0270bef5bbce4d74ebb9002c314abd73ef8.text: Utini Wupwup 和 穴居人 薩滿造成的神聖傷害，尤其是 神怒之符 和 驅逐 造成的神聖傷害，以及缺乏可用的屍體，通常使得嘗試使用小兵變得困難，甚至不可能。
0fc2b0270bef5bbce4d74ebb9002c314abd73ef8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

24e09cffb4aeec981e63bcd7ee595a4756805089.source: The level of the foes depends on that of the party member with the lowest level:
24e09cffb4aeec981e63bcd7ee595a4756805089.text: 敵人的等級取決於等級最低的隊員的等級：
24e09cffb4aeec981e63bcd7ee595a4756805089.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c97f6b0df79cfc29572a633876d179014fb66bf2.source: There are around 30 grawl in the area.
c97f6b0df79cfc29572a633876d179014fb66bf2.text: 該地區周圍有 30 穴居人。
c97f6b0df79cfc29572a633876d179014fb66bf2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

49f20aff63795b765ecbf5419030efa418dbf348.source: Go to Regent Valley. Acquire the Vanguard equipment from Gelsan.
49f20aff63795b765ecbf5419030efa418dbf348.text: 轉至 統治者之谷。從蓋爾桑那裡獲得先鋒裝備。
49f20aff63795b765ecbf5419030efa418dbf348.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9f7e7c8fd18d76aa3d9a77906e28b28f9e1fe777.source: Recover Gelsan's stolen goods from the bandits.
9f7e7c8fd18d76aa3d9a77906e28b28f9e1fe777.text: 從強盜手中奪回蓋爾桑的贓物。
9f7e7c8fd18d76aa3d9a77906e28b28f9e1fe777.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9caa9c76145b36de3937a7c0d6c5f767e4ffee16.source: Deliver the stolen goods to Gelsan.
9caa9c76145b36de3937a7c0d6c5f767e4ffee16.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

53b08bf0bbb3fc22a67a3b3f1a1cb54712efe434.source: Deliver the Vanguard equipment to Captain Arne in Ascalon City.
53b08bf0bbb3fc22a67a3b3f1a1cb54712efe434.text: 將 Vanguard 裝置交付給 阿斯卡隆城 中的 艾倫軍官。
53b08bf0bbb3fc22a67a3b3f1a1cb54712efe434.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3c331ea5c38374cd1a3e10a66c1d65ef3e6d02e7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7619f9563ca4c9628803ec7418ece187f7f2f0d0.source: After accepting the quest, enter Regent Valley from Fort Ranik and speak to Gelsan the Outfitter who is standing near the portal. Travel south until you can see some bandits, one of whom will drop the stolen goods when killed. Pick up the item and carry it back to Gelsan, and speak to him to receive the Vanguard Equipment. Return the Vanguard Equipment to Captain Arne to complete the quest.
7619f9563ca4c9628803ec7418ece187f7f2f0d0.text: 接受任務後，從拉尼克堡進入 統治者之谷 並與站在傳送門附近的裝備者蓋爾桑交談。向南行駛，直到看到一些強盜，其中一名強盜被殺死後會掉落贓物。撿起物品並將其帶回給 Gelsan，並與他交談以獲得 先鋒隊的補給品。 影返、先鋒隊的補給品 到 艾倫軍官 即可完成任務。
7619f9563ca4c9628803ec7418ece187f7f2f0d0.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

66d3ddefaac066f41c55788c3939fa6f5d590500.source: Find and rescue Farmer Hamnet, who is lost in Wizard's Folly.
66d3ddefaac066f41c55788c3939fa6f5d590500.text: 找出並營救在 巫師的怪異建築 中迷路的農夫哈姆內特。
66d3ddefaac066f41c55788c3939fa6f5d590500.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

765b267b96b085b8be86665a2161bcbff21e2ca3.source: Farmer Hamnet can be escorted back to any of the five portals in Wizard's Folly to complete the quest, even though places such as The Catacombs or Regent Valley are not really safer.
765b267b96b085b8be86665a2161bcbff21e2ca3.text: 農夫哈姆內特可以被護送回 巫師的怪異建築 中的五個傳送門中的任何一個來完成任務，即使 地下墓穴 或 統治者之谷 等地方並不真正安全。
765b267b96b085b8be86665a2161bcbff21e2ca3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

41b807009081c0ba568d6675a5684883eaadc599.source: Be sure to wait for the quest to update before mapping out or zoning. Should Farmer Hamnet stop moving before he gets close enough, take a few steps in the direction of the portal until the quest updates.
41b807009081c0ba568d6675a5684883eaadc599.text: 在繪製地圖或分割槽之前，請務必等待任務更新。如果農夫哈姆內特在足夠接近之前停止移動，請朝傳送門的方向走幾步，直到任務更新。
41b807009081c0ba568d6675a5684883eaadc599.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

df00c04b5225958e3db7021892f5e479fae8a877.source: While active, two vanguard bandits spawn very close to Foible's Fair, making it useful as an experience farm. Plus the Academy Monk will be healing near the Shrine. If you find farming just these first two bandits tedious (30 seconds or so), there are another two just up the hill (another 30 seconds) and another four (rarely only three) down around the south side of the big circle. It takes a fair amount of time to run to these final four and defeat them (closer to 60 seconds), but they're usually all together.
df00c04b5225958e3db7021892f5e479fae8a877.text: 活躍時，兩個先鋒強盜會在 佛伊伯市集 附近生成，使其成為一個有用的體驗農場。另外，學院 僧侶 將在神社附近進行治療。如果你覺得只耕種前兩個強盜很無聊（30 秒左右），那麼在山上還有另外兩個強盜（另一個 30 秒），另外四個（很少只有三個）在大圓圈的南側。跑到最後四個並擊敗他們需要相當長的時間（接近 60 秒），但他們通常都在一起。
df00c04b5225958e3db7021892f5e479fae8a877.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bd6adbc5c4a636fdb80d00237f09d353e696b2e4.source: "We have just received word from the residents of Ashford that Farmer Hamnet has gone missing. He was last seen heading up to Wizard's Folly to gather supplies, but was due back hours ago. His neighbors are starting to get nervous, so we have agreed to send a search party. Are you interested in leading the search? This seems like a perfect way for you to get some more experience under your belt!"
bd6adbc5c4a636fdb80d00237f09d353e696b2e4.text: 「我們剛剛收到阿什福德居民的訊息，農民哈姆內特失蹤了。最後一次有人看到他前往 巫師的怪異建築 收集物資，但原定在幾個小時前回來。他的鄰居開始變得緊張，所以我們同意派出一支搜尋隊。你有興趣領導搜尋嗎？這似乎是你獲得更多經驗的完美方式！」
bd6adbc5c4a636fdb80d00237f09d353e696b2e4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

372d4b9a2d229f69985d697181e1203902171bc8.source: Rescue Footman Tate, who is trapped behind enemy lines in the Northlands.
372d4b9a2d229f69985d697181e1203902171bc8.text: 營救被困在北地敵後的步兵泰特。
372d4b9a2d229f69985d697181e1203902171bc8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

24445acd60baf5f1027d36e4c3e3aa84efa67317.source: The new Charr spawn in pairs, whereas the native Charr are almost always in groups of 4.
24445acd60baf5f1027d36e4c3e3aa84efa67317.text: 新的 夏爾 成對出現，而原生 夏爾 幾乎總是成組出現在 4 中。
24445acd60baf5f1027d36e4c3e3aa84efa67317.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

86942a79d4ad2db9202a0a4a14381001ceea03f7.source: Footman Tate activates as an ally when you get close, and will follow you thereafter.
86942a79d4ad2db9202a0a4a14381001ceea03f7.text: 當你靠近時，步兵塔特會作為盟友啟用，並隨後跟隨你。
86942a79d4ad2db9202a0a4a14381001ceea03f7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4ff5ab1b6244525c6b6232b6222d5abcba0e2bd1.source: If Footman Tate spawns inside or close to a group of Charr, be careful when approaching. When you get close he will automatically become an ally and the Charr will attack him. At lower levels, they can quickly kill him causing the quest to fail.
4ff5ab1b6244525c6b6232b6222d5abcba0e2bd1.text: 如果步兵塔特在一群 夏爾 內部或附近生成，接近時要小心。當您靠近時，他會自動成為盟友，夏爾 會攻擊他。在較低階別，他們可以很快殺死他，導致任務失敗。
4ff5ab1b6244525c6b6232b6222d5abcba0e2bd1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4b6fca1a090497fecb2188ad2f4d93091ccaeba9.source: Footman Tate must be led to the exit to Lakeside County to complete the quest, even if the party has access to Piken Square.
4b6fca1a090497fecb2188ad2f4d93091ccaeba9.text: 步兵塔特必須被引導到 湖畔郡 的出口才能完成任務，即使隊伍有權存取 派肯廣場。
4b6fca1a090497fecb2188ad2f4d93091ccaeba9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

d13dda66444cc6a241b193a615d2e2fbc314e1ed.source: This quest spawns a total of 30 high level charr. This is ideal for farming for Legendary Defender of Ascalon.
d13dda66444cc6a241b193a615d2e2fbc314e1ed.text: 此任務總共產生 30 高等級夏爾。這是傳奇 阿斯卡隆保衛者 耕種的理想選擇。
d13dda66444cc6a241b193a615d2e2fbc314e1ed.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1d2c6141a6847815ffee26fbc5b3901f5448569e.source: Try combining with Vanguard Annihilation: Charr for additional foes (requires a party member with that quest active).
1d2c6141a6847815ffee26fbc5b3901f5448569e.text: 試著與先鋒殲滅：夏爾 結合以獲得更多敵人（需要活躍該任務的黨員）。
1d2c6141a6847815ffee26fbc5b3901f5448569e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2df8721421f06f57c046c7313efd80e545b5860b.source: You can rezone faster by letting yourself get killed by a charr group at the end of the run. This way you will get resurrected at the entrance of the area.
2df8721421f06f57c046c7313efd80e545b5860b.text: 你可以透過在跑步結束時讓自己被一群夏爾殺死來更快地重新定位。這樣你就會在該區域的入口處復活。
2df8721421f06f57c046c7313efd80e545b5860b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

62435b8bd9367eb36b10933f97269972176aaa19.source: If you have a second account with a high level character in pre-Searing, you can alternatively simply team up and have that character rezone.
62435b8bd9367eb36b10933f97269972176aaa19.text: 如果您在 崩壞 之前的第二個帳戶中擁有高階角色，您也可以簡單地組隊並重新指派該角色。
62435b8bd9367eb36b10933f97269972176aaa19.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bb8639d14a2f7b0341618eb9d2b9a49b61baf5f8.source: "I swear, one day those Devourers are going to be the death of Duke Gaban! Some rumor convinced him that there is an even bigger Devourer nest hidden within the Catacombs below Ashford Abbey, and that egg-obsessed fool actually went down there looking for it! Now we need to waste our limited resources to go on a rescue mission. Say, you don't look too busy; how would you like to go find the poor duke before something down there decides to eat him for breakfast?"
bb8639d14a2f7b0341618eb9d2b9a49b61baf5f8.text: 「我發誓，有一天那些蠍會害死格班公爵！有傳言讓他相信灰色淺灘修道院下面的地下墓穴裡藏著一個更大的蠍巢穴，而那個痴迷於雞蛋的傻瓜竟然去那裡尋找它！現在我們需要浪費我們有限的資源去執行救援任務。 」
bb8639d14a2f7b0341618eb9d2b9a49b61baf5f8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

290ecdd6e809d7089f76fdbeb5cafc53e4848e42.source: Search the Ruptured Heart for anyone who might know the whereabouts of Kwalanah.
290ecdd6e809d7089f76fdbeb5cafc53e4848e42.text: 搜尋破碎之心，尋找可能知道誇拉納下落的人。
290ecdd6e809d7089f76fdbeb5cafc53e4848e42.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e126a434aa85d6f937e07373307e8491cd7f91d8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7951b8897e0f4c1c1b4c241132933a5d29cba260.source: After receiving the quest, head west past the small strip of sulfurous sands to find Jehner. Speak to Jehner and return to Charen for your reward.
7951b8897e0f4c1c1b4c241132933a5d29cba260.text: 接到任務後，往西行進，穿過一小片硫磺沙地找到耶納。與耶納交談並返回查倫領取獎勵。
7951b8897e0f4c1c1b4c241132933a5d29cba260.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ff1b4f0972a1044d8c080547aea0c749a6b991bc.source: Occasionally, Charen will not give the reward for this quest. When this happens, you have to exit to an outpost, abandon the quest and and return to the area to restart
ff1b4f0972a1044d8c080547aea0c749a6b991bc.text: 有時，查倫不會給予該任務的獎勵。發生這種情況時，您必須退出到前哨站，放棄任務並返回該區域重新開始
ff1b4f0972a1044d8c080547aea0c749a6b991bc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6f6795dfea402f71074aa2bed9581cc99506b79a.source: Clear the Varajar Fells in the Far Shiverpeaks of all enemies in hard mode.

fc105ced6f30acc979978c93b66343e70a0c1967.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9eff618140f4b5850013efee28b04b43a6ef1df7.source: Asterius the Mighty spawns in the green areas of the southwest quarter of the map and starts to patrol the southwestern part of the map, going as far as circling around the base of Olafstead.
9eff618140f4b5850013efee28b04b43a6ef1df7.text: 強大的 Asterius 在地圖西南區的綠色區域中生成，並開始在地圖的西南部巡邏，最遠繞著 尤拉夫之地 的基地盤旋。
9eff618140f4b5850013efee28b04b43a6ef1df7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bc01f98a17ec9d3337022091a81e365bbe7c8bc7.source: Dazehl Brainfreezer does not spawn immediately; instead, he pops up after all the other Ice Imps west of Olafstead have been killed.
bc01f98a17ec9d3337022091a81e365bbe7c8bc7.text: Dazehl Brainfreezer 不會立即產生；相反，當 尤拉夫之地 以西的所有其他冰小鬼都被殺死後，他就會出現。
bc01f98a17ec9d3337022091a81e365bbe7c8bc7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aa9ed67ff19973dee7050fe81cc985b388705d36.source: The skeletons surrounded by Crypt Slashers in the northeastern section of the map turn hostile when you approach them.
aa9ed67ff19973dee7050fe81cc985b388705d36.text: 當你接近地圖東北方的地穴切割者時，那些被地穴切割者包圍的骷髏會變得充滿敵意。
aa9ed67ff19973dee7050fe81cc985b388705d36.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7c5223b22ded21d3d5d0f31330fb657d63729ccd.text: 冰小惡魔和半人馬彼此敵對。
7c5223b22ded21d3d5d0f31330fb657d63729ccd.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review
