ce4a0ac251e01007493be93ad533755015de6eec.text: 地圖的南半部都有隱藏的維提爾，特別是靠近其他生物和地圖邊緣。
ce4a0ac251e01007493be93ad533755015de6eec.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3fea11989c777190e6dd7470656ca72e532b898f.source: The eastern side of the map has a small enclosed section that is darkened by shadows. There are hidden individual Smoke Phantoms throughout this area.
3fea11989c777190e6dd7470656ca72e532b898f.text: 地圖的東側有一個小的封閉部分，被陰影變暗。整個區域都隱藏著單獨的煙霧幻影。
3fea11989c777190e6dd7470656ca72e532b898f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fecb514bc262ce08fd6297418d61e1605b23b17c.source: The Path to Revelations affect this part of the map, where there is a ritual area of sorts.
fecb514bc262ce08fd6297418d61e1605b23b17c.text: 通往啟示的道路 影響地圖的這一部分，那裡有某種儀式區域。
fecb514bc262ce08fd6297418d61e1605b23b17c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6da868bbeb01bd2952b0b12406f37df25a667ee1.source: If the quest is active, foes need to be triggered to appear, so it can be avoided entirely to reduce the kills needed.
6da868bbeb01bd2952b0b12406f37df25a667ee1.text: 如果任務處於活動狀態，則需要觸發敵人出現，因此可以完全避免它以減少所需的殺戮。
6da868bbeb01bd2952b0b12406f37df25a667ee1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ba57c0dfd65c8bae44b232903f6607fbba023afa.source: If the quest is not active, hostile Crypt Slashers surround a non-hostile skeleton group led by Nifling the Chained. Moving into aggro range of the skeletons turn them hostile. The Crypt Slashers should be pulled away before attacking the skeletons. You do not have to hostile or kill the skeletons to complete vanquishing the area.
ba57c0dfd65c8bae44b232903f6607fbba023afa.text: 如果任務未啟用，敵對的地穴砍殺者會包圍由鎖鏈尼夫林領導的非敵對骷髏小隊。進入骷髏的攻擊範圍後，它們就會變得充滿敵意。在攻擊骷髏之前，應該將地穴切割者拉開。你不必敵對或殺死骷髏來完成征服該地區。
ba57c0dfd65c8bae44b232903f6607fbba023afa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

daace6ff2c82b784fcad11811f6254b5c2245b8e.source: If nobody in your party has yet completed A Gate Too Far, you will be unable to reach about twenty Frozen Elementals near outside Raven's Point; they are behind a gate which will otherwise be locked.
daace6ff2c82b784fcad11811f6254b5c2245b8e.text: 如果你的隊伍中沒有人完成 一道過遠的門，你將無法到達 渡鴉岬角 外附近大約二十個冰凍元素；他們在一扇門後面，否則門就會被鎖上。
daace6ff2c82b784fcad11811f6254b5c2245b8e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

8e79f586aecf487f48493e56909ed2410b4e2cb7.source: This area is a popular choice for farming Norn title points. You can earn 4,000 points in Normal mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active or 450 points per 5 minute run in hard mode by just defeating the Facets. You can earn around 20,000 points in Hard mode by clearing the area with The Path to Revelations active. See Norn farming for details.
8e79f586aecf487f48493e56909ed2410b4e2cb7.text: 此區域是種植 諾恩 頭銜點數的熱門選擇。您可以透過清除具有 通往啟示的道路 活動的區域來在 普通模式 中獲得 4,000 積分，或在困難模式下每執行 5 分鐘只需擊敗 Facet，即可獲得 450 積分。在 困難模式 中，透過清除 通往啟示的道路 處於活動狀態的區域，您可以獲得大約 20,000 積分。有關詳細資訊，請參閱 諾恩 農業。
8e79f586aecf487f48493e56909ed2410b4e2cb7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0d0f470a9f146c4eda6bdb441dc1e163fdc4b3ec.source: Go to the palace and talk to the diplomats.
0d0f470a9f146c4eda6bdb441dc1e163fdc4b3ec.text: 前往宮殿並與外交官交談。
0d0f470a9f146c4eda6bdb441dc1e163fdc4b3ec.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9347aa14ada2e89186473923fa96c75d02f6a011.source: Clear out the remaining Am Fah from the Jade Sea.
9347aa14ada2e89186473923fa96c75d02f6a011.text: 從 碧玉海 中清除剩餘的 安費。
9347aa14ada2e89186473923fa96c75d02f6a011.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4d6f244e577c9e0a80989bea87547b4c5dfea94a.source: Clear out the remaining Jade Brotherhood from the Echovald Forest.
4d6f244e577c9e0a80989bea87547b4c5dfea94a.text: 從 科凡德森林 中清除剩餘的 翡翠兄弟會。
4d6f244e577c9e0a80989bea87547b4c5dfea94a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5ebcafd2de12346e836780edbb1b07770407f75f.source: Tell the diplomats that their lands are clear.
5ebcafd2de12346e836780edbb1b07770407f75f.text: 告訴外交官他們的土地是乾淨的。
5ebcafd2de12346e836780edbb1b07770407f75f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2d36b31aaa91e38a33b8854d9c8b649b6f93ceac.source: "We have heard reports that there are a number of Charr Champions up in the Northlands. Chances are the Charr are planning for something and have brought their finest warriors to be part of the attack. Rather than wait for the fight to come to us, we are going to get the upper hand by going north and killing the Charr's Champions, demoralizing them, and making them think twice before attacking. If you think you have what it takes to face these Charr Champions in battle, I will give you that opportunity. You cannot go alone, though. No one is permitted north of the wall without someone to watch their back!"
2d36b31aaa91e38a33b8854d9c8b649b6f93ceac.text: 「我們聽到報道稱，有些 夏爾 北地冠軍。機會是 夏爾 他們正在計劃一些事情，並派出了他們最優秀的戰士來參與進攻。我們不應該等待戰鬥來臨，而是要透過向北消滅敵人來佔上風。 夏爾 的冠軍，使他們士氣低落，並使他們在進攻前三思而後行。如果你認為自己有能力面對這些 夏爾 戰鬥中的冠軍，我會給你這個機會。但你不能一個人去。如果沒有人看守，任何人都不允許進入城牆以北！ 」
2d36b31aaa91e38a33b8854d9c8b649b6f93ceac.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a0a3c2e4ebfca0fce99707aef4c2cadb44a76d69.source: Find and kill the Undead Necromancers inside the Catacombs. [6...0] remain.
a0a3c2e4ebfca0fce99707aef4c2cadb44a76d69.text: 找出並殺死地下墓穴內的 不死系 死靈法師。 [6...0] 保留。
a0a3c2e4ebfca0fce99707aef4c2cadb44a76d69.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4d2d85f910930b2038723533910f04a0ae7d24ca.source: "Our scouts report that a Charr Legionnaire named Blazefiend Griefblade is amassing forces for his Warband in the Northlands. We're not sure what he is up to, but we do know we would be better off with one less Charr commander this close to Ascalon City! If you think you have what it takes to challenge the Charr, head to the Northlands. Don't travel alone, though. We will not allow lone travelers to cross the wall."
4d2d85f910930b2038723533910f04a0ae7d24ca.text: “我們的球探報告說 夏爾 名為烈火魔·悲刃的軍團士兵正在北地為他的戰幫集結兵力。我們不確定他在做什麼，但我們知道少一個我們會更好 夏爾 commander this close to 阿斯卡隆城 ！如果你認為自己有能力挑戰 夏爾 ，前往北地。不過，不要獨自旅行。我們不會允許孤獨的旅行者越過圍牆。 」
4d2d85f910930b2038723533910f04a0ae7d24ca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a97669610d2d10798bb8fdf45fda9d7514c02f75.source: Find and kill Countess Nadya inside the Regent Valley.
a97669610d2d10798bb8fdf45fda9d7514c02f75.text: 找出並殺死 統治者之谷 內的娜迪亞伯爵夫人。
a97669610d2d10798bb8fdf45fda9d7514c02f75.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

03cc894f650ebdefb3cbf2f1e31d73c82370c99b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ce4bcadc438e5c8f8106fd138e8d4c15c1c8b80c.source: Countess Nadya's spawn location changes with every rezone, so locating her efficiently is the first priority. There are two viable routes depending on your preference.
ce4bcadc438e5c8f8106fd138e8d4c15c1c8b80c.text: 娜迪亞伯爵夫人的生成位置會隨著每次重新分割槽而變化，因此有效地定位她是首要任務。根據您的喜好，有兩條可行的路線。
ce4bcadc438e5c8f8106fd138e8d4c15c1c8b80c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

da4acc69eea2e229ba13893cb1bd8537dece9b7e.source: Route 1: Starting from Fort Ranik: Enter Regent Valley from Fort Ranik and head to the southernmost marked point on the map. If she isn't there, her three remaining possible spawn locations can be checked consecutively from that point. Note that this route has less distance to cover but many more enemies to deal with.
da4acc69eea2e229ba13893cb1bd8537dece9b7e.text: 路線1：從拉尼克堡出發：從拉尼克堡進入統治者之谷，前往地圖上最南端的標記點。如果她不在那裡，則可以從該點開始連續檢查她剩餘的三個可能的重生位置。請注意，這條路線的距離較短，但需要對付的敵人較多。
da4acc69eea2e229ba13893cb1bd8537dece9b7e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5d43c87bc87f169b7b169151eeb29600730499e8.source: Route 2: Starting from Ashford Abbey: Exit through Ashford Abbey to Lakeside County and then Regent Valley and check the spawn locations near the portal. If she isn't there, re-enter Lakeside County through the portal and try again. While the route itself is longer, there are significantly fewer enemies to deal with along the way, making it quicker overall. Note that abandoning and retaking the quest appears to reset her spawn position.

99d07322b2ff59e6e570a866969b9bc22c79c67e.source: "I knew that greenhorn couldn't handle a foray into the Northlands! Footman Tate insisted he was ready to kill some Charr, so we allowed him to go along, but at the first sign of combat he vanished into the woods. We found a bit of blood where we last saw him, so chances are he is wounded as well as cowardly. That does not bode well for someone stuck behind enemy lines, especially when the Charr are involved!
99d07322b2ff59e6e570a866969b9bc22c79c67e.text: 「我知道新手無法應付對北地的攻擊！步兵泰特堅持他已經準備好殺死一些人 夏爾 ，所以我們允許他繼續前行，但一有戰鬥跡象，他就消失在樹林裡。我們最後一次見到他的地方發現了一點血跡，所以他很可能受傷而且膽怯。對於被困在敵後的人來說這不是一個好兆頭，尤其是當 夏爾 參與其中！
99d07322b2ff59e6e570a866969b9bc22c79c67e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

54ea8c9dde07a035e7484a6914e2cf77093eb1ee.source: If you feel you can fare better than he did, please head to the Northlands, find that poor fool, and bring him back to this side of the Great wall. You will need someone else to go with you, though. We don't let anyone travel alone north of the Wall."
54ea8c9dde07a035e7484a6914e2cf77093eb1ee.text: 如果你覺得你能比他做得更好，請前往北國，找到那個可憐的傻瓜，並把他帶回長城的這一邊。不過，您需要有人陪您一起去。我們不允許任何人單獨前往隔離牆以北。 」
54ea8c9dde07a035e7484a6914e2cf77093eb1ee.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

Killing the foe again does not count towards Dwarven Raider and does not yield loot or experience; however, the ancient Mummies will leave exploitable corpses whenever they are killed.
40e12ac7962ac33a52de02a35d133a648dc47aaa.text: 當你殺死「遠古」木乃伊或 元素生物 時，它會在兩分鐘內復活。再次殺死敵人不會計入矮人襲擊者，也不會產生戰利品或經驗；然而，古代木乃伊在被殺時會留下可利用的屍體。

933a72ecefc0d68eb18d795e3e2c586d939e3735.source: You find Elder Belin in the non-incorporated village north of Jokanur Diggings, in the northwestern corner of Zehlon Reach. After accepting the quest you have to go to the northeastern corner of the area to fight the Evil Mime. The way to the mime is a straight line so he is not hard to find.
933a72ecefc0d68eb18d795e3e2c586d939e3735.text: 你可以在佐卡努礦區北部的非建制村莊中找到貝林長老，該村莊位於澤隆河段的西北角。接受任務後，你必須前往該地區的東北角與邪惡啞劇戰鬥。通往啞劇的路是一條直線，所以不難找到他。
933a72ecefc0d68eb18d795e3e2c586d939e3735.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3bc647cf502de4ac2c3cbe0abb51bbe4f9f9fe64.source: The Evil Mime is a level 24 Mesmer with skills like: Spirit Shackles, Backfire and Mind Wrack. Taking hex removal and knowing when not to cast spells/attack can be vital for you. The mime is only healed through using Ether Feast, so it is imperative that you interrupt this. Paragons are at a major disadvantage in this quest: the little island where the Evil Mime is standing has an area effect: Curse of Silence. This area effect means you can not use any chants or shouts. The effect will wear off shortly after the Evil Mime is slain.
3bc647cf502de4ac2c3cbe0abb51bbe4f9f9fe64.text: 邪惡啞劇是 24 幻術師 級別，具備以下技能：精神束縛、魔力反噬 和 心靈破壞。去除妖術並知道何時不施法/攻擊對你來說至關重要。啞劇只能透過使用 精神饗宴 來治癒，因此您必須中斷此操作。典範在這個任務中處於一個主要劣勢：邪惡啞劇所站立的小島有一個區域效果：沉默詛咒。該區域效果意味著您無法使用任何聖歌或喊叫。邪惡啞劇被殺後不久，效果就會消失。
3bc647cf502de4ac2c3cbe0abb51bbe4f9f9fe64.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0c12bfd571a966ebbbf4eaeece6ee53d179f25cf.source: After you have slain the Evil Mime and the area effect has been lifted you can touch the jars to open them and free the trapped voices. There are three jars, two big ones and one smaller one that is easy to miss. You may have trouble setting them free due to some odd mechanics involving the jars. Double-clicking on the jars does not seem to work to free the voices. Instead, double-click on the yellow name that appears with the each jar. After freeing them, you can go back to Elder Belin for your reward.
0c12bfd571a966ebbbf4eaeece6ee53d179f25cf.text: 殺死邪惡啞劇並且區域效果解除後，您可以觸控罐子將其開啟並釋放被困的聲音。一共有三個罐子，兩個大一個小一個，很容易錯過。由於涉及罐子的一些奇怪的機制，您可能無法將它們釋放。雙擊罐子似乎無法釋放聲音。相反，雙擊每個罐子出現的黃色名稱。釋放他們後，你可以回到貝林長老那裡領取獎勵。
0c12bfd571a966ebbbf4eaeece6ee53d179f25cf.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

27ef74f5a8acc3e5f87f5fdeeb366f4e1dd5b224.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2e74be5dcd9d408228da070f4372dfceb8e4faa4.source: A lone Hydra group patrols the northwest and is easily missed because it starts circling clockwise when you enter its radar range. To avoid hunting for it, approach from the east when you first encounter it (so that it moves towards you); if you think you missed it, start your own patrol in a counter-clockwise direction. The group does not always spawn.

18e81440daf62420583c408e89871b012782a36e.source: Start from Divinity Coast and follow the map towards the second clearing and head up the slope to your left, towards the resurrection shrine, i.e. do not follow the road. (If you have trouble using the keyboard to navigate the route, click at the top of the incline, near the shrine, leaving it to the game's pathfinding AI.)
18e81440daf62420583c408e89871b012782a36e.text: 從 神聖海岸 開始，按照地圖前往第二個空地，然後沿著左邊的斜坡朝復活神殿走，即不要沿著路走。 （如果您在使用鍵盤導航路線時遇到困難，請點選神社附近的斜坡頂部，將其留給遊戲的尋路人工智慧。）

e27bc957433d634accb22beba17c308a84262491.source: After the shrine, keep to your left, heading north and counter-clockwise to reach Amalek due north, but around the corner from the shrine. The number of groups you encounter along the way depend on several factors: which foes spawn, their party composition, and how close to each other. Amalek's group is easy enough to defeat on its own, although the boss does bring condition and hex removal that can slow you down.
e27bc957433d634accb22beba17c308a84262491.text: 離開神殿後，靠左行駛，向北逆時針方向行駛，即可到達正北方的阿瑪力人，但就在神殿的轉角處。你一路上遇到的隊伍數量取決於幾個因素：生成的敵人、他們的隊伍組成以及彼此之間的距離。亞瑪力人的隊伍很容易被單獨擊敗，儘管 Boss 確實會帶來條件和妖術移除，這會減慢你的速度。
e27bc957433d634accb22beba17c308a84262491.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

792156ac2e41e49aa4e493ccb8d05be991e68d8f.source: However, the difficulty in reaching Amalek ranges from trivial to among the most difficult routes of all 21 of the Shining Blade bounties. Since the Mantle and Peacekeepers are hostile to the Tengu, Mergoyle, and Bog Skale, you can sometimes find only a few foes to mop up. In rare situations, a Mergoyle boss group will spawn close to Amalek and defeat him before you get close (allowing you to immediately return to Lion's Arch Keep for your reward); the only indication of this is when you receive the morale boost and your quest log updates.
792156ac2e41e49aa4e493ccb8d05be991e68d8f.text: 然而，到達阿瑪力人的難度從微不足道到 光刃公會 賞金中所有 21 中最困難的路線不等。由於地函和和平衛士對 天狗、石像魔 和 泥鱗怪 懷有敵意，因此有時您只能找到幾個敵人來消滅。在極少數情況下，石像魔 首領組會在阿瑪力人附近生成，並在您接近之前擊敗他（允許您立即返回 獅子拱門要塞 獲取獎勵）；唯一的跡像是當您收到士氣提升和任務日誌更新時。
792156ac2e41e49aa4e493ccb8d05be991e68d8f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6faa744cfee4d746e68c2c6c447ae95f8c268caa.source: In contrast, you can also end up with up to four groups of Mantle/Peacekeepers before reaching your target. The first group (located just after the resurrection shrine) is small and presents no trouble. However, the remaining full-strength groups typically overlap and can wipe even a well-balanced party. The second group is stationary, on the northeast corner of the bluffs (before you have to turn west); they can be pulled south, away from the remaining groups. The third group walks a tight-patrol path on the slope between the second group and the edge of Amalek's protective zone; you can pull them east (to the second group's original location). The fourth group is a patrol; you can avoid them with careful timing, although some find it safer to pull them south so that they do not combine forces with Amalek's team.
6faa744cfee4d746e68c2c6c447ae95f8c268caa.text: 相較之下，在到達目標之前，你也可以擁有最多四組地幔/維和人員。第一組（位於復活神殿後方）規模較小，不會造成任何麻煩。然而，剩餘的全力隊伍通常會重疊，甚至可以消滅一個平衡良好的隊伍。第二組靜止不動，位於懸崖的東北角（在您必須向西轉向之前）；他們可以被拉到南方，遠離剩餘的群體。第三組在第二組和亞瑪力保護區邊緣之間的斜坡上走一條嚴密巡邏的小路；你可以把他們拉向東（到第二組原來的位置）。第四組是巡邏隊；你可以小心地避開他們，儘管有些人發現將他們拉向南方更安全，這樣他們就不會與亞瑪力的隊伍聯合起來。
6faa744cfee4d746e68c2c6c447ae95f8c268caa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

37d56f61735984e443bd2adc0e50759046d6a7db.source: Leave the Temple of the Ages with a balanced group. Either rescue your escort from the Reed Stalkers or just run east. Evade or dispatch the undead and make your way through the swamp. After the swamp, you need to cross the path. Wait a few seconds for the patrols to move away, then cross it without engaging any foes. Move past the Resurrection Shrine, then east. Dispatch the small White Mantle group without engaging the Lynx. There are a few White Mantle popups before the exit to Cursed Lands. If you're quick you can run past them to the portal.
37d56f61735984e443bd2adc0e50759046d6a7db.text: 將 世紀神殿 保留為平衡組。要嘛從蘆葦追獵者手中救出你的護衛隊，要嘛就向東跑。躲避或消滅不死生物並穿過沼澤。過了沼澤，你需要穿過小路。等待幾秒鐘，讓巡邏隊離開，然後在不與任何敵人交戰的情況下穿過它。經過 復活祭壇，然後向東。排程 白斗篷 小組而不與 山貓 接觸。在退出 詛咒之地 之前，會出現一些 白斗篷 彈出視窗。如果你夠快的話，你可以跑過他們到達傳送門。
37d56f61735984e443bd2adc0e50759046d6a7db.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0cda72127506d67f7e04b24ad2503fe6dd26c7a5.source: In the Cursed Lands, your new escort is likely to aggro the group of Lynx. You can take it slow, dispatch each group, then tackle Barthimus. It's faster, but riskier, to lead the Lynx, other wildlife and the White Mantle to each other - they're hostile to each other. You can use the ensuing chaos to spike Barthimus, then map-travel back to Lion's Arch.

02b095d75731ab8cc024325b262eba5abcfc1d7d.source: To break apart the Boss group, start by going left after crossing the bridge to take out all the enemies in the circular route around the fortress. Return to the central plaza. As soon as they attack, pull back and head left down the path, leaving some spirits (or minions) in the path; some of the group will attack and follow. Repeat until those foes move beyond the outer walls. Then, move down the road.
02b095d75731ab8cc024325b262eba5abcfc1d7d.text: 要瓦解 頭目 隊伍，請在過橋後向左走，消滅要塞周圍環形路線中的所有敵人。 影返 到中央廣場。一旦他們攻擊，就向後退並沿著路徑向左走，在路徑中留下一些靈魂（或小兵）；一些群體會攻擊並跟隨。重複此動作，直到敵人移出外牆。然後，沿著路走。
02b095d75731ab8cc024325b262eba5abcfc1d7d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e0061748f99df19103c933cd19f301537f3c0eff.source: Those separated will try go back to original position in center; some will make it through the gate, others will get stuck in outer wall. Your party should always return to the middle of the bridge when aggroed, leaving minions and/or spirits to engage the foe and weaken them. Continue to pull the White Mantle mobs until the plaza is clear, then ensure that no additional spawns can surprise you by circling the fortress, clearing any remaining Mantle from the area. Once complete, the main target force can be attacked, again relying on minions/spirits to bear the brunt of the foes attacks.
e0061748f99df19103c933cd19f301537f3c0eff.text: 分開的人會試著回到原來的中心位置；有些人會穿過大門，有些人會被困在外牆裡。當你的隊伍受到攻擊時，應該總是回到橋的中間，留下小兵和/或靈魂來與敵人交戰並削弱他們。繼續拉 白斗篷 怪物，直到廣場被清理乾淨，然後通過繞著堡壘轉圈，清除該區域中任何剩餘的地幔，確保沒有額外的生成可以讓你感到驚訝。完成後，可以攻擊主要目標部隊，再次依靠小兵/靈魂來承受敵人的攻擊。
e0061748f99df19103c933cd19f301537f3c0eff.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2f17bfebda947ec9df1a504cff67c7dc95253346.source: The Temple of the Ages is the only outpost in Kryta that lets you form a party of eight, so you should start from there. Travel through The Black Curtain to Kessex Peak, killing various creatures and White Mantle/Peacekeepers along the way. In Kessex Peak, follow the trail south-southwest, towards the southern edge of the map, and you will eventually run into Marron. Kill him and then claim your reward.
2f17bfebda947ec9df1a504cff67c7dc95253346.text: 世紀神殿 是 科瑞塔 中唯一允許您 型態 八人隊伍的前哨站，因此您應該從那裡開始。從 黑色帷幕 前往 凱席斯山峰，沿途殺死各種生物和 白斗篷/和平衛士。在 凱席斯山峰 中，沿著西南偏南的小路，向地圖的南邊緣前進，您最終會遇到馬龍。殺掉他然後領取你的獎勵。

Note that Kane is located on a rocky outcrop on the east side of The Shattered Ravines, which cannot be traveled while in wurm form. The party will find Kane under interrogation by a Margonite group when they arrive and the group will become hostile and attack the party. Once the Margonites are defeated, escort Kane back to Curator Ruras just outside the Lair of the Forgotten.
50861135edaa329524083042f4599bddd9462321.text: 從 被遺忘者的巢穴 開始，按照任務指標尋找失蹤的嚮導凱恩。請注意，凱恩位於 碎裂溝谷 東側的岩石露頭上，在亞龍 型態 中時無法移動。當隊伍到達時，他們會發現凱恩正在接受 瑪骨奈 小組的審訊，該小組將變得敵對並攻擊隊伍。擊敗瑪貢尼特後，護送凱恩回到 被遺忘者的巢穴 外的 Curator Ruras。

09b75c5fe3ccbca29b8f34d42f843e4aa37a0328.source: The crevasse that you must get to is just slightly north from Lion's Arch. It is to the east of Miraba and Leighton Cranford. Click on the crevasse and choose to enter. You will be brought to Beneath Lion's Arch. Follow the path through the small cavern and into the ancient hall, killing some undead along the way. Keep going on the singular path until you see dwarven allies. Climb up the stairs and a cinematic will begin. The Beginning of the End is the follow-up primary quest that is automatically added to your quest log.
09b75c5fe3ccbca29b8f34d42f843e4aa37a0328.text: 您必須到達的裂縫位於 獅子拱門 稍偏北的位置。它位於 米拉芭 和 Leighton Cranford 的東邊。點選裂縫並選擇進入。您將被帶到 獅子拱門 下方。沿著小路穿過小洞穴，進入古老的大廳，沿途殺死一些不死生物。繼續沿著單一的道路前進，直到看到矮人盟友。爬上樓梯，電影就會開始。終結的開始是後續主要任務，會自動新增到您的任務日誌中。
09b75c5fe3ccbca29b8f34d42f843e4aa37a0328.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

17993b80b016028b51ff02adbb1c6116afc2f36c.source: Enter the Undercity from the Wajjun Bazaar, via the Nahpui Quarter outpost. Since Oroku must survive stay near him at the areas of corruption and let the Kappa come to you. At each site, the Kappa will attack in 4 waves from each entry point in groups of 3 or 4. Since the Kappa are large groups of spellcasters, area of effect skills and caster shutdown will be very helpful. Oroku will stay with the party between the sites, so the only danger during movement is the Am Fah. Take care with these mobs, as it is easy to over-aggro and fail the quest. It is safest, though time consuming, to clear out the path before taking Oroku (either by not entering from south Wajjun Bazaar, or by running past before he finishes the dialogue.)
17993b80b016028b51ff02adbb1c6116afc2f36c.text: 從 瓦江市場 經由 納普區 前哨進入幽暗城。由於 Oroku 必須生存，請在腐敗區域靠近他，讓河童來找你。在每個地點，Kappa 將從每個進入點以 3 或 4 的群組進行 4 攻擊。由於河童是一大群施法者，範圍技能和施法者關閉將會非常有幫助。 Oroku 將在站點之間與隊伍待在一起，因此移動過程中唯一的危險是 安費。小心這些小怪，因為很容易過度仇恨並導致任務失敗。儘管耗時，但最安全的做法是在進入 Oroku 之前清理出道路（要麼不從 瓦江市場 南部進入，要麼在他完成對話之前跑過去。）

eed385897999980a985f4a294894f9e895078f0b.source: In Hard Mode at site 2, a good strategy is to: clear the site's 2 area from mobs. Then flag all Heroes upstairs on the left side (as looking from the site 2 into the corridor). Next, run with Oroku to start the waves and as soon as Kappas appear, run upstairs to your Heroes. Or stay down as melee support. Keep an eye on Heroes' health and move them as needed, good idea is to place two Heroes near the edge to keep Kappas' aggro and the rest as support which you move forward and backward when health drops. Give them Flesh of My Flesh for fast Resurrection.
eed385897999980a985f4a294894f9e895078f0b.text: 在網站 2 的困難模式下，一個好的策略是：清除網站 2 區域的小怪。然後在左側標記樓上的所有英雄（從 2 站點看向走廊）。接下來，與 Oroku 一起奔跑以發起波浪，河童一齣現，就跑上樓去找你的英雄。或留在下面作為近戰支援。密切注意英雄的健康狀況並根據需要移動他們，好主意是將兩名英雄放置在邊緣附近以保持卡帕斯的仇恨，其餘英雄作為健康下降時您向前和向後移動的支援。給他們 生體犧牲 以快速復活。

15ffaa24e453df9f52ca9a370f50e18b7e736f9c.text: 這些波浪是透過殺死指定的河童（可能是暴力河童或瘋狂河童）來觸發的。你應該嘗試最後殺死那些指定的卡帕，但一波中這些型別的卡帕很少，所以你無法確定哪一個會觸發下一波。

e6e91174c26febb4acf0713e593e18549fd261ab.text: 雖然劇場經理 Daudi 在某些任務中不會出現，例如《直到死亡將我們分開…》，但 Norgu 會在接近 Daudi 的正常位置時說出他的部分對話，從而使任務能夠進展到下一個目標。

16d005eb880b405cc800651925e106688826e287.source: "Oh, , I never got a chance to thank you for saving me. As for you, Norgu, stay away from my buffet!"
16d005eb880b405cc800651925e106688826e287.text: 「哦，我一直沒有機會感謝你救了我。至於你，諾爾古，離我的自助餐遠一點！”

0c12848c0239272adb3a9f4c2624f5e64900eaf7.source: "I must admit, I am still rather shaken from the attempt on my life. I never thought that I could be a target in my own home...how could this have happened? I want to know, I want to know, and I want to know what you know, as soon as you know it! Norgu, you've dealt with that spineless Theatre Manager Daudi before. Go with and find out how he could let this happen! I am tempted to call my executioner again, I tell you, but I just got this new manager broken in. I go through them so quickly..."
0c12848c0239272adb3a9f4c2624f5e64900eaf7.text: 「我必須承認，我仍然對自己的人生嘗試感到震驚。我從來沒有想過我會成為自己家中的目標……這怎麼可能發生？我想知道，我想知道，我想知道你知道什麼，一旦你知道了！諾爾古，你以前和那個沒有骨氣的劇院經理達迪打過交道。
0c12848c0239272adb3a9f4c2624f5e64900eaf7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1794870d2ff5b91e5d1c37ef70c558893011e03a.source: Theatre Manager Daudi: "But I didn't know they were Kournans! I had to hire more actors. My regulars quit! Bokka only pays them in bread. And these new actors applied! They agreed to work cheap, so I overlooked their lack of proper references...."
1794870d2ff5b91e5d1c37ef70c558893011e03a.text: 劇院經理達迪：“但我不知道他們是庫爾南人！我不得不僱用更多演員。我的常客辭職了！博卡只付給他們麵包。這些新演員申請了！他們同意廉價工作，所以我忽略了他們缺乏適當的推薦信......”

cd7a4268b394a352d5d26e0db1d998494c9d83a5.text: Norgu：“也許你是對的。我想我們必須讓王子決定從這裡做什麼。”

2f0da743ed121418c0f9412b02d5e6020311044b.text: 劇院經理達迪：“你知道我永遠不會做任何傷害王子的事。拜託，你必須告訴他這不是我的錯......我有孩子！哦，這是沒有用的。沒有出路......”

The real actors all decided to go overseas and work for someone else who lets them keep their profits AND gives them sprawling buffets every night? How dare they! It's all THEIR fault this happened! My bread is just as good as any lousy buffet could ever be."
cef902c1089f9c4468aa3b6b0e5338201dabdfb6.text: 「什麼？真正的演員都決定去海外為別人工作，讓他們保留利潤，每天晚上給他們提供豐盛的自助餐？他們怎麼敢！這都是他們的錯！我的麵包和任何糟糕的自助餐一樣好。”

d16bb982788566fe2ad86cf3565c02d8c60c2de9.source: Start out from Camp Hojanu and go speak to Ruthless Sevad in the middle of the Barbarous Shore to see what he can tell you about Jerob No-Spine. After talking to Ruthless Sevad, it's quickest to map straight to Yohlon Haven and see Makala. From there, map to Nundu Bay and head out to the Marga Coast to meet with Mehnosi. His location depends on whether you have done a quest Herds to the Slaughter before. If yes, he is standing on the western side of the zone near the sea; otherwise he is near the small swamp southeast of the Kournan garrison. After speaking to Mehnosi, follow the quest pointer to find Jerob in the Marga Coast area.
d16bb982788566fe2ad86cf3565c02d8c60c2de9.text: 從 何加努營地 開始，到 野蠻河岸 中間與無情的塞瓦德交談，看看他能告訴你關於傑羅布無脊椎的事。與無情的塞瓦德交談後，最快的方法是直接對應到 猶朗避難所 並檢視馬卡拉。從那裡，對映到 納度灣 並前往 馬加海岸 與 Mehnosi 會面。他的位置取決於你之前是否完成過「群殺」任務。如果是的話，他就站在該區域的西側靠近大海的地方；否則他就在庫爾南駐軍東南部的小沼澤附近。與 Mehnosi 交談後，請依照任務指標在 馬加海岸 區域找到 Jerob。

a91e7afdc40ac13fc120e69b538ae400f528df3a.source: At the start of the mission, Battle Priest Calibos will greet the party and run to the top of the island. He will remain there to assist with healing and smiting spells, but cannot keep himself alive if left completely alone. Each wave is made up of several separate groups that immediately head toward the island once summoned.
a91e7afdc40ac13fc120e69b538ae400f528df3a.text: 任務開始時，戰鬥牧師卡利波斯會迎接隊伍並跑到島頂。他將留在那裡協助治療和重擊法術，但如果完全獨自一人，他將無法保住自己的生命。每波浪潮都由幾個獨立的群體組成，一旦被召喚，它們就會立即前往島嶼。
a91e7afdc40ac13fc120e69b538ae400f528df3a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bd4437f4f53f3418aa661b31def19923a982b7e7.source: It is a good idea to flag any Heroes and Henchmen in your party near Battle Priest Calibos at the start of the mission; this will ensure that they cover both sides equally and do not allow enemies to slip in on an unprotected side. You will not be moving from this spot until much later, if at all, so it is very advisable to bring skills which take advantage of this. Wells and wards in particular can be very advantageous here, because they will nearly always affect a large number of allies or enemies. It is also almost essential to have a minion master, or even better a minion bomber type character in your party, because this will provide a valuable meat shield which enemies will target preferentially over your party or Battle Priest Calibos.
bd4437f4f53f3418aa661b31def19923a982b7e7.text: 在任務開始時，最好在戰鬥牧師卡利博斯附近標記您隊伍中的任何英雄和 傭兵；這將確保它們平等地覆蓋兩側，並且不會讓敵人從未受保護的一側溜進去。直到很久以後你才會離開這個地方（如果有的話），所以最好帶上利用這一點的技能。水井和守衛在這裡尤其非常有利，因為它們幾乎總是會影響大量盟友或敵人。在你的隊伍中擁有一個小兵大師，甚至更好的小兵轟炸機型別的角色也幾乎是必要的，因為這將提供一個有價值的肉盾，敵人會優先瞄準你的隊伍或戰鬥牧師卡利博斯。
bd4437f4f53f3418aa661b31def19923a982b7e7.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

de57753b52f10ff1fea08b3ff2ab2e810097d171.source: Due to the massive number of enemies it is also advisable that you bring plenty of area of effect damage. Skills such as Splinter Weapon really shine here, so you might consider bringing multiple copies.
de57753b52f10ff1fea08b3ff2ab2e810097d171.text: 由於敵人數量眾多，建議您帶來足夠的效果傷害範圍。像 爆刺武裝 這樣的技能在這裡真的很閃耀，所以你可以考慮帶多份。
de57753b52f10ff1fea08b3ff2ab2e810097d171.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5fa3d4d0d05f34282bcc7efe91cbeeaaa314fec8.source: If you start to have difficulty with the Naga you may have to start focusing damage on single targets. Naga Archers in particular have block stances, and a self heal. If trying to bring down more than one at once your damage may become spread too thin, and you will have more difficulty killing them. From wave four you will start to see Oni and Saltspray Dragons. These have the potential to inflict a large amount of damage on your party, so it is wise to focus damage on these to bring them down quickly.
5fa3d4d0d05f34282bcc7efe91cbeeaaa314fec8.text: 如果您開始在使用 納迦 時遇到困難，您可能必須開始將傷害集中在單一目標上。 納迦 弓箭手尤其具有格擋姿勢和自我治療能力。如果試圖一次擊倒多個敵人，你的傷害可能會變得太分散，你將更難殺死它們。從第四波開始，您將開始看到鬼和鹽霧龍。它們有可能對你的隊伍造成大量傷害，因此明智的做法是集中傷害以快速擊倒它們。
5fa3d4d0d05f34282bcc7efe91cbeeaaa314fec8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

4829486fd56f2752df9e0f150809b642f6579a77.source: The reward for killing the 6 Luxon Adepts gradually increases, but they do not respawn, so it is advisable to wait as long as possible before defeating them. Rangers, ritualist spirits, or any character with ranged attacks can kill them while the rest of the party defends the priest. The location of each Adept is marked on the map above.
4829486fd56f2752df9e0f150809b642f6579a77.text: 殺死 6 勒克森 行者的獎勵會逐漸增加，但它們不會重生，因此建議在擊敗它們之前等待盡可能長的時間。遊騎兵、儀式神靈或任何具有遠端攻擊能力的角色都可以殺死他們，而隊伍的其他成員則可以保護牧師。每個專家的位置都標記在上面的地圖上。
4829486fd56f2752df9e0f150809b642f6579a77.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

84f66bf509bc818562a6de434bce72ffaf3e23cb.source: After you reach wave eight, each wave will afterwards consist of six Siege Turtles scattered across the map in pairs. Defeating all six in the time allotted for that wave will grant you a 50 point bonus, plus 5 points for each wave of turtles you have successfully destroyed previously. The turtles will attack from a large range, but then will be vulnerable while their attack is recharging.
84f66bf509bc818562a6de434bce72ffaf3e23cb.text: 當你到達第八波後，每一波將由六隻成對分散在地圖上的攻城龜組成。在為該波分配的時間內擊敗全部六隻海龜將為您提供 50 積分獎勵，並為您之前成功消滅的每波海龜加上 5 積分。海龜會從大範圍攻擊，但在攻擊充電時會變得脆弱。
84f66bf509bc818562a6de434bce72ffaf3e23cb.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b3bd908a36b346678cc824e065f11aa9358e7063.source: When the turtles start spawning, they will stop attacking and just walk back and forth near their spawn point, allowing for infinite points and faction without any risk or effort
b3bd908a36b346678cc824e065f11aa9358e7063.text: 當海龜開始生成時，它們將停止攻擊，只是在生成點附近來回走動，從而允許無限點和 陣營值，無需任何風險或努力
b3bd908a36b346678cc824e065f11aa9358e7063.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

042638d56a9add67c601f589f5f606550cf8dbca.source: Skills like Protective Spirit will be extremely useful in surviving the initial cannon blasts, which each do up to about 300 points of damage to their main target, and slightly less to foes in their AoE. Turtles will also try to flee during the times when their attack skill is recharging, making snares somewhat useful. Running skills can also help greatly with this stage, although it may not be possible to bring them if you have trouble holding out beyond the initial seven waves.
042638d56a9add67c601f589f5f606550cf8dbca.text: 像 精神守護 這樣的技能對於在最初的大砲爆炸中生存非常有用，每個砲彈都會對其主要目標造成約 300 點的傷害，而對 範圍性 中的敵人造成的傷害則略低。海龜在攻擊技能恢復時也會嘗試逃跑，這使得陷阱有點用處。跑步技能對這個階段也有很大幫助，儘管如果你在最初的七波之後遇到困難，可能就無法使用它們。
042638d56a9add67c601f589f5f606550cf8dbca.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed A Formal Introduction (accepting the reward is not required), the gate from Sunqua Vale will be closed.
A Formal Introduction grants access, but any Factions characters without a secondary profession will be left behind in Sunqua Vale.
Access through Minister Cho's Estate (explorable area) is unavailable because the gate from Kinya Province to Ran Musu Gardens is closed if the party contains any characters that have not completed Minister Cho's Estate.
27bf1bfdb9f2155e5d9c5e4935bc8adfd5963954.text:
開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中包含任何未完成正式介紹的盟與敵角色（不需要接受獎勵），桑泉谷的大門將會關閉。
正式介紹即可授予存取許可權，但任何沒有第二職業的 盟與敵 角色都會留在 桑泉谷 中。
無法通過趙部長莊園（可探索區域）進入，因為如果隊伍中包含任何尚未完成趙部長莊園的角色，從 欣彌領地 到 嵐穆蘇花園 的大門就會關閉。

Access through Zen Daijun (explorable area) is unavailable because Guard Lae Fao will not grant access if the party contains any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun.
2f972f50bdf606c1f826fb545fc9e7d3027632cb.text:

5ec6dfb4dcb72047a31f4f7ba22f8ffc350c52c2.source:
Starting the mission has no requirements, but if the party contains any Factions characters that have not completed Mayhem in the Market (accepting the reward is not required) or any foreign characters, the gate from The Undercity into Vizunah Square (Local Quarter) will be closed, and if the party contains any foreign characters that have not completed Welcome to Cantha (accepting the reward is not required) or any Factions characters that have not completed Nahpui Quarter, the gate from Bukdek Byway into Vizunah Square (Foreign Quarter) will be closed.
Mayhem in the Market grants access to the Local Quarter, but any characters that have not completed Zen Daijun will be left behind in The Undercity.
Welcome to Cantha grants access to the Foreign Quarter.
5ec6dfb4dcb72047a31f4f7ba22f8ffc350c52c2.text:
開始任務沒有任何要求，但如果隊伍中有任何要求 盟與敵 未完成市場混亂的角色（不需要接受獎勵）或任何外國角色，門從 地下城 進入 薇茹廣場 （Local Quarter）將被關閉，並且如果聚會包含任何未完成的外來字元 歡迎來到凱珊 （不需要接受獎勵）或任何 盟與敵 未完成的字元 納普區 ，門從 巴德克小徑 進入 薇茹廣場 （外國區）將關閉。
市場混亂允許進入本地區域，但任何尚未完成的角色 禎臺郡 將被拋在後面 地下城 。 歡迎來到凱珊 授予進入外國區的許可權。

7d9e1efb1b855b000c83cea2d2f39f21fd5a72c7.text:

Starting the mission has no requirements, but the gate from Arborstone (explorable area) is inaccessible from the north side of the area. However, there is a glitch that allows access to the southern side, from which you can simply walk into the mission outpost.
The Count's Daughter grants access, but any characters that have not completed Tahnnakai Temple will be left behind in Arborstone (explorable area).

Access through Boreas Seabed (explorable area) is unavailable because there is no route leading there without having completed Boreas Seabed.

Embark Beach (No statue, scroll only)
Chantry of Secrets
Temple of the Ages
Zin Ku Corridor
Southeast corner of Lornar's Pass (Statue only, no scroll)

* Works with self inflicted knock down (i.e. Grapple, Desperation Blow, and Drunken Blow).
* If a single effect knocks down the affected ally multiple times (e.g. hitting multiple enemies with the skills above using a scythe), the shout will inflict its damage, but will not prevent the ally from being knocked down.
* Damage is inflicted even if the knock down would be prevented by other effects, such as "I Am Unstoppable!" or Balanced Stance.
eb17f9b820a7d11aec6b3c393cb64802b9b805d2.text:

* 如果單一效果多次擊倒受影響的盟友（例如使用鐮刀以上述技能擊中多個敵人），則呼喊會對其造成傷害，但不會阻止盟友被擊倒。
* 即使擊倒會被其他效果（例如「我勢不可擋！」）阻止，也會造成 傷害。或 平衡態勢。

* This is the only skill that prevents touch skills; however, it does not work against Touch of Dhuum nor Smash of the Titans.

"Can't Touch This!" is applied to party members only.

31fcf5008dd903067ef0b84525b92f051e983a39.source:
* In the case of attacks which strike more than one foe, only the target will have the damage and deep wound applied.
* A character affected by this shout successfully hitting with Agonizing Chop will interrupt the target, which suggest that Deep Wound is applied first.
* Heroes use this skill on party members wielding a sword, axe, hammer, daggers, scythe, spear or shortbow, with an attribute level of at least 1 in the corresponding weapon mastery.
** Attribute bonuses, such as runes, are taken into account.
** Anniversary weapons are treated as though they have a regular attribute requirement.
The exact description should be "the next time target ally successfully hits with an attack", as this skill will not be removed and its effects won't be applied if the next attack misses (due to blind), is blocked or if there is no line of sight.
{{DEFAULTSORT:Find Their Weakness!}}
31fcf5008dd903067ef0b84525b92f051e983a39.text:
* 如果攻擊攻擊多個敵人，則只有目標會受到傷害和深度傷害。
* 受此喊叫影響的角色成功用 苦痛砍擊 擊中將打斷目標，這表明首先應用 重傷。
* 英雄對使用​​劍、斧頭、鐵鎚、匕首、鐮刀、矛或短弓的隊員使用此技能，且相應武器掌握的屬性等級至少為 1。
** 屬性 獎勵（例如符文）已被考慮在內。
** 週年紀念武器被視為具有常規屬性要求。
準確的描述應該是“下次攻擊成功擊中目標盟友時”，因為如果下次攻擊未擊中（由於盲）、被阻擋或沒有視線，則該技能不會被移除，也不會應用其效果。
{{DEFAULTSORT：找到他們的 虛弱！ }}

127b219116e0b32c689c0a2cfee7fd95cc07e685.source:
Unlike most skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier, this doubles all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.
* Enduring Harmony extends the duration of this shout to 30 seconds, even at 0 Leadership.
* Often used to fuel and maintain "Save Yourselves!".

;Warrior / Paragon
"For Great Justice!" is a staple skill for Paragons and Warriors, as these professions tend to rely on adrenaline skills to compensate for their low energy regeneration. 
* This skill can function as an indirect energy management tool for Paragons by allowing an increased use of adrenaline-based shouts and chants to trigger Leadership's energy gain more often. 
** The shouts "Go for the Eyes!" and "The Power Is Yours!" are in particular effective, as they have low adrenaline costs, no activation time and no recharge time. 
* Combines very well with Dragon Slash at 10 or higher Swordsmanship, as the doubled adrenaline gain equals the cost of Dragon Slash itself. This allows the attack skill to be used repeatedly, while also rapidly fueling all other equipped adrenaline skills.
127b219116e0b32c689c0a2cfee7fd95cc07e685.text:
與大多數通過乘數增加腎上腺素增益率的技能不同，這會使所有非乘數來源的腎上腺素加倍，而不僅僅是進行攻擊時的基本 1 攻擊。
* 恆久福音 將此喊叫的持續時間延長至 30 秒，即使在 0 領導 時也是如此。
* 常用於補充和維持「拯救自己！」。

;戰士 / 聖言者
「為了大正義！」是典範和戰士的主要技能，因為這些職業往往依賴腎上腺素技能來彌補他們的低能量再生。 
* 該技能可以作為 Paragon 的間接能量管理工具，通過允許更多地使用基於腎上腺素的喊叫和口號來更頻繁地觸發 領導 的能量增益。 
** 喊聲“為眼睛而戰！”和“力量是你的！”特別有效，因為它們的腎上腺素成本低，沒有啟用時間，也沒有充電時間。 
* 與 10 或更高的 精通劍術 的 龍斬 完美結合，因為雙倍的腎上腺素增益等於 龍斬 本身的成本。這使得攻擊技能可以重複使用，同時也可以快速補充所有其他裝備的腎上腺素技能。

1ca800f3ed3aa40cffc57a879954ea4ecb021679.source:
* This skill is a staple energy management skill for primary paragons, even at 0 command, as it allows to trigger the Leadership's energy gain effect frequently and without halting attacks.
** It can also indirectly help primary Assassins via Critical Strikes.
* This skill can help party members to meet the critical hit-dependent effects of skills such as Keen Arrow.
* As with most skills affecting the next attack, this shout will affect attacks already in-flight when used.
* The shout seems to end before the attack hits, triggering relevant Finales before the attack connects, but Soldier's Strike is still unblockable.
* Synergizes with a minion master since:
** It affects allies, so the more minions the party has, the more damage will be added by this skill.
** Unlike party members and pets that gain bonus damage from attack skills, generally all of the damage of minions is their base damage, causing them to benefit disproportionally from landing critical hits.

Contrary to what the description suggests, this skill triggers on hit rather than on attack. For instance, if Cyclone Axe hits several foes, only one of them has increased chance to be critically hit.
1ca800f3ed3aa40cffc57a879954ea4ecb021679.text:
* 該技能是初級典範的主要能量管理技能，即使在 0 命令下也是如此，因為它允許頻繁觸發 領導 的能量增益效果，並且不會停止攻擊。
** 它也可以透過 致命攻擊 間接幫助初級刺客。
* 此技能可幫助隊員滿足鋒銳之箭等技能的致命一擊依賴效果。
* 就像大多數影響下一次攻擊的技能一樣，這種喊叫會影響使用時已經在飛行中的攻擊。
* 喊叫似乎在攻擊到來之前就結束了，在攻擊連線之前觸發相關結局，但 士兵之擊 仍然無法阻擋。
* 與僕從大師協同作用，因為：
** 它影響盟友，所以隊伍的隨從越多，技能所造成的傷害就越大。
** 與從攻擊技能中獲得額外傷害的隊伍成員和寵物不同，一般來說，小兵的所有傷害都是其基礎傷害，導致他們從致命一擊中獲得不成比例的好處。

與描述相反，該技能在擊中而不是攻擊時觸發。例如，如果 旋風斧 擊中多個敵人，則只有其中一個敵人受到暴擊的機率會增加。

* This skill may seem to last indefinitely, but actually has a duration of 7 hours and 30 minutes, making it the longest finite duration for an effect in the game.
** This skill can be activated well before triggering its effect, allowing for it to recharge before battle.
** Since this is a shout, this can be used to trigger Soldier's Speed's additional effect for running purposes, or Signet of Aggression for building adrenaline before the fight. 
*Missed or blocked attacks don't count toward the number of attacks.
*"Attacks" by this skill are considered to be hits, thus if you hit three enemies with a scythe, that counts as three attacks toward this shout.
Unlike most shouts, "I Am the Strongest!" ends if it's reapplied before it expires, triggering the effects of echoes.
464960f030770a0ca66aeb91c2c3c1ca3ddb79e9.text:
* 此技能看似無限期持續，但實際上持續時間為 7 小時和 30 分鐘，使其成為遊戲中效果的最長有限持續時間。
** 此技能可以在觸發效果之前就啟用，以便在戰鬥前進行充能。
** 由於這是一聲喊叫，因此可以用來觸發士兵速度的額外效果以實現跑步目的，或使用 侵略紋章 在戰鬥前增強腎上腺素。 
*錯過或阻止的攻擊不計入攻擊次數。
*該技能的「攻擊」被視為命中，因此如果你用鐮刀擊中三個敵人，則該喊叫將算作三次攻擊。
與大多數人的喊叫不同，「我是最強的！」如果在過期之前重新應用，則會結束，從而觸發迴聲效果。

* This skill is often referred to by its initials, "IWAY".
* All dead allies on your compass count for this skill.
** Because of this, this skill can be maintained indefinitely on certain missions (such as Dzagonur Bastion) if enough allied pets within the party are killed. 
* Non-stop upkeep of this skill's effect requires 5 dead allies, 3 if under the effects of Enduring Harmony.
* Without a dead ally, the shout will still appear in a speech bubble as usual but no effect at all seems to be applied. Echoes will not trigger.
* When used by a PvE foe, this skill will consider all dead PvE foes in compass range as allies of the PvE foe using this skill, even foes of different creature types.
dea49acdd75322232667c62b4e6edaf385bdcabf.text:
* 此技能通常以其縮寫“IWAY”來表示。
* 指南針上所有死去的盟友都算是此技能。
** 因此，如果隊伍內有足夠的盟友寵物被殺死，技能可以在某些任務（例如 薩崗諾稜堡）中無限期地保持。 
* 不間斷維持此技能的效果需要5死去的盟友，若處於恆久福音的效果下則需要3。
* 如果沒有死去的盟友，喊叫聲仍會像往常一樣出現在對話氣泡中，但似乎沒有任何效果。迴聲不會觸發。
* 當被 PvE 敵人使用時，該技能會將羅盤範圍內所有死去的 PvE 敵人視為使用該技能的 PvE 敵人的盟友，甚至是不同生物型別的敵人。

* Good adrenaline management is essential to quickly refill the adrenaline pool of this skill to make up for its short duration.

*If you recast this skill while it is still active, the healing effect will not happen.
*To determine the total damage reduction when combining skills like "They're on Fire!", multiply the % of damage not reduced of each skill by each other, and the result is the % of damage your affected party takes (provided all conditions are met). 
**Example (assuming all conditions are met, i.e. burning, in earshot, etc.):
***"They're on Fire!" at Leadership 12 = 29% reduction / 71% damage
***"There's Nothing to Fear!" at Sunspear rank 5 to 10 = 35% reduction / 65% damage
***(ToF) .71 x (TNtF) .65 = .46 (or 46% damage is received / 54% reduction)
When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Nightfall skill.
fded2f6b6ecf936e2b5fa4135483d7e30610ef23.text:
*如果在該技能仍然有效時重新施放該技能，則不會產生治療效果。
*要確定組合技能（例如「他們著火了！」）時的總傷害減少量，請將每個技能未減少的傷害百分比相乘，結果就是受影響方受到的傷害百分比（前提是滿足所有條件）。 
**範例（假設滿足所有條件，即燃燒、在聽力範圍內等）：
***「他們著火了！」 領導 12 = 29% 減少 / 71% 傷害
***「沒什麼好怕的！」 日戟 5 至 10 = 35% 減少 / 65% 傷害
***(ToF) .71 x (TNtF) .65 = .46（或 46% 受到傷害/54% 減少）
當以活動方式對技能進行排序時，它會列在 核心 下，儘管它是 黑暗逆襲 技能。

* Contrary to Mark of Insecurity, this hex actually makes enchantments expire faster.

* Air of Enchantment reduces the energy cost of all enchantments, both targeted and self-targeting.
** This includes self-targeting enchantments such as Flash Enchantments and Attunements.
** Party wide enchantments that do not target an ally (such as Aegis and Orders enchantments) will have their energy cost reduced if used by the recipient of Air of Enchantment.
** Doublecast Enchantment Spells are affected only if the target is under Air of Enchantment, not the caster, even though the caster also becomes enchanted when the skill activation completes.
** The cost of enchantments that target a foe is reduced if the target is under Air of Enchantment, not the caster.

** 這包括自我瞄準附魔，例如閃光附魔和調諧。
** 不針對盟友的 隊伍 廣泛結界（例如 神賜之盾 和命令結界）如果由 微風加持 的接收者使用，其能量消耗將會降低。
** 雙重施放 加持魔法 僅當目標處於 微風加持 之下時，法術才會受到影響，而施法者則不會受到影響，即使施法者在技能啟動完成後也會被附魔。
** 如果目標處於 微風加持 之下，而不是施法者，則以敵人為目標的結界成本會降低。

* This skill creates a Spirit of Anguish that uses the Anguish attack skill.
* Synergizes with Painful Bond.
* Synergizes well with Blood Bond which grants healing to the spirit while also fulfilling the requirement for a hexed target. 
* On hexed foes, Anguish also doubles the bonus damage from Signet of Ghostly Might and Anthem of Envy.
* Spiritleech Aura combines poorly with Anguish, as the damage reduction penalty significantly reduces the effectiveness of this spirit.
81a7c89bfb3ef47dfb619d41fdb640cd63bf2ef2.text:

* 與 苦痛連結 協同作用。
* 與 血之連結 協同作用，可以治癒精神，同時滿足十六進位制目標的要求。 
* 對於施咒的敵人，苦惱 也會讓 生靈神力紋章 和 妒忌聖歌 的額外傷害加倍。
* Spiritleech Aura與苦惱的結合不佳，因為傷害減少懲罰顯著降低了該精神的有效性。

"We Shall Return!" does not return energy from Leadership.

“我們將 影返 ！ 」不返回能量 領導 。

*The bonus percentage is added to resurrection skills' levels of health and energy, rather than modifying these levels by a factor.
**For example, a rank 15 "We Shall Return!" (PvP) used with Resurrection Signet will give the target 75% energy, not 37.5%.
*To use this skill with Lively Was Naomei, it needs to be active when you drop the ashes.
*This skill does not affect Restoration (PvP).

* As shouts can be used while activating other skills, this allows for useful tactics:
** It can always be timed to hit at the right moment when another skill would benefit from its knockdown, such as Bed of Coals.
** It can be used to interrupt enemies before they can use skills that would prevent the currently channeled skill from activating, such as Spellbreaker. 
* Often shortened to YMLAD.
df57a3f2d08f2e85280296a493487fb00a904d6d.text:

** 它可用於在敵人使用阻止當前引導技能啟動的技能（例如破法者）之前打斷他們。

bf1e14aa1fdfdd715aa5e235e4bf5cd1db7e4dc2.source:
* Bone Minions are useful with skill combinations that rely on the minions dying, such as Jagged Bones, Death Nova or cause them to die, such as Putrid Flesh or Feast for the Dead. It is generally useful with builds that rely on Soul Reaping for energy management.
* This spell will trigger Explosive Growth, Boon of Creation, and Spirit's Gift twice.
bf1e14aa1fdfdd715aa5e235e4bf5cd1db7e4dc2.text:
* 骨頭小兵對於依賴小兵死亡的技能組合非常有用，例如 鋸齒骸骨、死亡新星 或導致它們死亡的技能組合，例如 惡臭肉體 或 死亡盛宴。它通常適用於依賴 靈魂吸取 進行能源管理的建置。
* 此法術會觸發 爆發增長、創物者恩賜 和 生靈天賦 兩次。

b3f4d0bf9710dcb09bedf7e84f75b058993db134.source:
* This skill is the only player skill that can spawn exploitable corpses. 
* The corpses created by this skill will count as dead allies for the purpose of "I Will Avenge You!".
* Multiple additional exploitable corpses have a few notable consequences:
** Taste of Death or Feast for the Dead can be used more effectively, for instance, to respectively make Blood of the Master safer or keep the minion army alive longer.
** Allows a team to carry multiple corpse exploitation skills without worrying about running out of corpses. 
** Allows a minion master to always have one Flesh Golem and a few other minions alive, even in areas where exploitable corpses are scarce, as long as the team can find at least one corpse to animate the first golem.
*** A player or hero bringing sacrifice skills, such as a saccer or a Blood is Power build, can kill themselves to provide this initial corpse.
* A Flesh Golem's size is determined by its level; the higher the level, the larger the minion.
On some very rare occasions, living NPCs will spawn rather than corpses when the golem dies.
b3f4d0bf9710dcb09bedf7e84f75b058993db134.text:
* 此技能是唯一可以產生可利用屍體的玩家技能。 
* 該技能產生的屍體將被視為「我將為你報仇！」目的的死亡盟友。
* 多個額外的可利用屍體會產生一些顯著的後果：
** 死亡滋味 或 死亡盛宴 可以更有效地使用，例如，分別使 主人之血 更安全或讓小兵軍隊存活更長時間。
** 允許團隊攜帶多種屍體開發技能，而不用擔心屍體耗盡。 
** 允許小兵大師始終擁有一個 鮮血高崙 和其他一些小兵活著，即使在可利用屍體稀缺的區域，只要團隊可以找到至少一具屍體來啟用第一個傀儡。
*** 具有犧牲技能的玩家或英雄，例如 saccer 或 血之權能 構建，可以自殺來提供這個初始屍體。
* 鮮血高崙 的大小由其等級決定；等級越高，小兵越大。
在一些非常罕見的情況下，當傀儡死亡時，會生成活著的 NPC 而不是屍體。
b3f4d0bf9710dcb09bedf7e84f75b058993db134.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

6fcedc9c8f5011f389c07c67e9743812e0f03e5c.source:
* When the Shambling Horror dies, the spawned Jagged Horror will trigger Explosive Growth, Boon of Creation, and Spirit's Gift.
* Shambling Horrors are good targets for Taste of Death and Feast for the Dead, since it leaves a Jagged Horror when it dies.
* When combined with Jagged Bones, two Jagged Horrors are produced.
* The level of the Jagged Horror is determined by the Death Magic rank of the caster when the Shambling Horror was created.
* Masterless Shambling Horrors do not spawn a Jagged Horror when they die.
* This skill has a much longer recharge when compared to most animation skills, and thus cannot be relied upon alone to create a full army of minions.
* The bleeding lasts for 25 seconds.
The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.
6fcedc9c8f5011f389c07c67e9743812e0f03e5c.text:
* 當蹣跚恐怖者死亡時，產生的鋸齒恐怖者將觸發 爆發增長、創物者恩賜 和 生靈天賦。
* 蹣跚恐魔是 死亡滋味 和 死亡盛宴 的好目標，因為它死後會留下鋸齒恐魔。
* 與 鋸齒骸骨 結合使用時，會產生兩種鋸齒恐怖。
* 鋸齒恐怖物的等級由創造蹣跚恐怖物品時施法者的 死亡魔法 等級決定。
* 無主的蹣跚恐怖者死亡時不會產生鋸齒恐怖者。
* 與大多數動畫技能相比，該技能的充電時間要長得多，因此不能單獨依靠它來建立一支完整的小兵軍隊。
* 出血持續 25 秒。
描述中沒有提及鋸齒恐怖造成的流血持續時間。
6fcedc9c8f5011f389c07c67e9743812e0f03e5c.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* Combine Echo and Arcane Echo to create echo chains, allowing you to use three copies of any single skill.
* If the next skill after Arcane Echo is not a spell, this enchantment will end with no effect.
* Arcane Echo will only recharge normally if no spell was copied. If a spell was copied, the copy remains for 20 seconds, after which Arcane Echo is disabled for 20 seconds.
** Consider using Auspicious Incantation before Arcane Echo for energy management, since the recharge time will not be increased.
* If used to copy a spell that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that spell is used and will bypass Arcane Echo's 20-second copy duration.
** E.g., if used to copy Echo, whatever skill that is copied by the Arcane Echo version of Echo will remain as that skill for 30 seconds and then revert back to Arcane Echo.
*Arcane Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the spell that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Gift of Health, the copy is disabled by Gift of Health's effect afterwards.
Arcane Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy itself.

;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.

a6690ea3871437cbc6cfaa0dea59f49d814f88be.source:
* Arcane Larceny does not distinguish between spells that are already disabled or recharging. It can steal a spell that was already disabled by the effects of another skill, such as Diversion, or a recharging spell whose recharge exceeds the duration of Arcane Larceny's disabling effect, such as Meteor Shower.
* This cannot be activated on a target with no spells. "That target has no spells to steal." appears when you attempt to.
* If you die when the duration of Arcane Larceny has not ended, the stolen spell on your skill bar will revert back to Arcane Larceny (similar to other skills that can copy skills); however, the target's spell will remain disabled for the full duration. This allows you to use Arcane Larceny to disable two spells at the same time if you are resurrected before the disable duration of the prior use of Arcane Larceny has ended.
* This can be used to interfere with skill chains on professions that tend to use only a few spells, e.g. primary Assassins.
a6690ea3871437cbc6cfaa0dea59f49d814f88be.text:

* 這無法對沒有法術的目標啟動。 「那個目標沒有法術可以竊取。」當您嘗試這樣做時會出現。

cfec6a9c103eed49bf6727f634af7c8f5a781e41.source:
* When using Arcane Mimicry on an ally that has more than one elite skill, the first elite skill from the left on their skill bar is copied. Accordingly, keep Arcane Mimicry to the right of any intended elite skill(s) if the team build requires mutual mimicry.
* If used on an ally without a non-form elite skill, Arcane Mimicry recharges instead.
**Heroes (and presumably other NPCs) cannot use this skill to copy any PvE-only skill.
* A successful Arcane Mimicry does not recharge like other skills: after the copy effect ends, the skill is disabled for 60 seconds.
* Maintained enchantments, skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep or skills that renew themselves copied with Arcane Mimicry will continue to be maintained, active or renewable even after expiration of Arcane Mimicry copy effect.
* Signet of Illusions or Symbols of Inspiration can be used to boost the attribute rank of a relevant copied elite.
* Players are able to copy elite skills which are not available from their skill list, but use them only when certain conditions are met:
** if the skill is a core skill or belongs to a campaign available on the account, the player (and their heroes) can use it even if it has not been unlocked.
** if the skill belongs to a campaign unavailable to the account, it will be copied to the skill bar but cannot be used by the playable character (remaining locked like PvE-only skills are in a PvP area).
** heroes are able to copy and use skills from any campaigns available and unavailable to an account, but the player cannot force the use of skills from campaigns unavailable to them.

* 當對擁有多個精英技能的盟友使用 魔力模仿 時，將複製其技能欄左側的第一個精英技能。因此，如果團隊建立需要相互模仿，請將 魔力模仿 保留在任何預期精英技能的右側。
* 如果對沒有非 型態 精英技能的盟友使用，則 魔力模仿 會重新充電。
**英雄（大概還有其他 NPC）不能使用此技能複製任何僅限 PvE 的技能。
* 成功的魔力模仿不會像其他技能那樣充能：複製效果結束後，技能會在60秒內停用。
* 即使在 魔力模仿 複製效果到期後，保留的結界、無需維護即可無限期持續的技能或透過 魔力模仿 複製的自我更新技能將繼續保留、啟動或更新。
* 幻術紋章或靈感標誌可用來提升相關複製菁英的屬性等級。
* 玩家可以複製技能清單中沒有的精英技能，但只有在滿足某個條件時才能使用：
** 如果該技能是核心技能或屬於帳戶上可用的戰役，則即使尚未解鎖，玩家（及其英雄）也可以使用它。
** 如果該技能屬於該帳戶無法使用的戰役，它將被複製到技能欄，但不能由可玩角色使用（保持鎖定，就像 PvE 專用技能在 PvP 區域中一樣）。
** 英雄可以複製和使用帳戶可用和不可用的任何戰役中的技能，但玩家不能強制使用他們不可用的戰役中的技能。

* Arcane Thievery does not distinguish between spells that are already disabled or recharging. It can steal a spell that was already disabled by the effects of another skill, such as Diversion, or a recharging spell whose recharge exceeds the duration of Arcane Thievery's disabling effect, such as Meteor Shower.
* This cannot be activated on a target with no spells. "That target has no spells to steal." appears when you attempt to. 
* If you die when the duration of Arcane Thievery has not ended, the stolen spell on your skill bar will revert back to Arcane Thievery (similar to other skills that can copy skills); however, the target's spell will remain disabled for the full duration. This allows you to use Arcane Thievery to disable two spells at the same time if you are resurrected before the disable duration of the prior use of Arcane Thievery has ended.
* This can be used to interfere with skill chains on professions that tend to use only a few spells, e.g. primary Assassins.

* The caster receives the Death Penalty reduction when the hexed foe dies, regardless of who delivered the killing blow.

* This hex only applies to attacks that would be blocked and attacks affected by Blindness or skill effects that cause attacks to miss; it does not prevent hits from straying, being obstructed, or being dodged. 55af1d2778f61af1cc7347917906a4d706f14645.source:
* This skill can only be captured from Mursaat monk bosses.

;Game mechanics
* Unlike Healer's Boon and Unyielding Aura, this skill also affects other healing sources, including Divine Favor and Divine Boon. 
** Aura of Faith increases the Divine Favor healing of itself.
* If you cast Spirit Bond first and then Aura of Faith, it will increase Spirit Bond's healing and then decrease the damage. But if you cast Aura of Faith first, it will reduce the incoming damage before Spirit Bond checks if it is over 50 (resulting in fewer heals from Spirit Bond).
55af1d2778f61af1cc7347917906a4d706f14645.text:
* 此技能只能從 馬賽特 武僧 Boss 身上取得。

；遊戲機制
* 與治癒者恩賜和堅毅靈氣不同，此技能也會影響其他治療來源，包括神恩和神之恩賜。 
** 信仰靈氣 增加 神恩 本身的治療效果。
* 如果您先施放精神連結，然後施放信仰靈氣，則會增加精神連結的治療效果，然後減少傷害。但如果您先施放 信仰靈氣，它會在 精神連結 檢查是否超過 50 之前減少傳入傷害（導致 精神連結 的治療量減少）。

cd9af4bccf7c6a9aee7c1236feddd3193faf89e1.source:
With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), an instance of this skill's damage will trigger for each Dervish enchantment except for Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, or Vow of Revolution. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Aura of Holy Might (plus Aura of Holy Might itself).
*After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
*The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*This skill triggers itself when it ends.
*Pious Renewal synergizes with this skill because of its "recharge on end" effect.
cd9af4bccf7c6a9aee7c1236feddd3193faf89e1.text:
對於移除「所有結界」的技能（例如 純淨的冥想），除了永恆光環、盾 力量、古蘭斯 光環或革命誓言之外，每個 神喚使 結界都會觸發該技能的傷害例項。相較之下，如果特定數量的結界被移除（例如透過 粉碎加持 或 神喚使 拆卸），則對於哪些 神喚使 結界將觸發傷害沒有限制，只要它們覆蓋聖能光環（加上聖能光環本身）即可。
*達到第一個效忠等級、庫茲柯/勒克森 支持者、20 等級角色後，可以從 庫茲柯理事 或 勒克森 拾荒者學習此技能，以用於 3,000 陣營值。
*庫茲柯版本的技能圖示位於頂部，勒克森版本的技能圖示位於底部。
*該技能結束時會自行觸發。
*神性修補 由於其「結束充電」效果而與該技能產生協同作用。
cd9af4bccf7c6a9aee7c1236feddd3193faf89e1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

79429dc622f114f6c3bf936530746aa04ab64148.source:
* Aura of the Lich does not target a corpse, and is unaffected by equipping a Bloodstained Insignia.
* This skill is the only way to raise a minion without any corpses being available. Malign Intervention creates a masterless minion when the foe dies.
* The +1 Death Magic buff activates after any minions are summoned.
* The skill indeed exploits all corpses in range regardless of how many minions the caster's allowed to control, in this case the extra minions will die immediately.
** This will often replenish the caster's energy provided they have points in Soul Reaping.

* 此技能是在沒有任何屍體的情況下養育小兵的唯一方法。當敵人死亡時，惡性感染 會創造一個無主僕從。
* +1 死亡魔法 增益會在召喚任何小兵後啟動。
* 該技能確實會利用範圍內的所有屍體，無論施法者允許控制多少小兵，在這種情況下，多餘的小兵將立即死亡。
** 如果施法者在 靈魂吸取 中有點數，這通常會補充施法者的能量。

* The fastest way to capture this skill is to start the Raisu Palace mission, as Sword Ancient Kai is near the beginning of the mission.

* Each of Barrage's arrows counts as a separate attack. Effects that trigger on attack/hit can trigger multiple times; however, some skills have no effect, or only affect the first arrow.
** If Barrage is combined with Paragon shouts or chants that apply conditions or damage boosts such as Anthem of Flame or "Find Their Weakness!", the condition and/or bonus damage will be applied randomly to one of the foes hit by Barrage rather than all of them.
* Barrage can be used to maintain adrenaline skills, since each arrow that hits will provide one strike of adrenaline. 
* Since the extra arrows are fired at foes adjacent to your target, always try to target an enemy in the middle of a large group.
* Combine with Splinter Weapon for a large area of effect spike.
e3c5ffcb9eca3ae8d554f8cbd8605ef341267e5f.text:
* 齊射 的每支箭都算是單獨的攻擊。攻擊/擊中時觸發的效果可以多次觸發；然而，有些技能沒有任何效果，或隻影響第一支箭。
** 如果 齊射 與 聖言者 喊叫或聖歌相結合，應用條件或傷害提升，例如 火焰聖歌 或“找到他們的 虛弱！”，條件和/或額外傷害將隨機應用於被 齊射 擊中的其中一個敵人，而不是全部。
* 齊射 可用於維持腎上腺素技能，因為每擊中的箭都會提供一次腎上腺素。 
* 由於額外的箭是向目標附近的敵人發射的，因此請始終嘗試瞄準大群中間的敵人。
* 與 爆刺武裝 結合使用，可實現大面積的峰值效果。

* Can be maintained even with rank 0 in Strength as long as the user continuously hits a foe successfully (i.e. not have all attacks be blocked, miss, be obstructed, etc.) while this stance is active.

* 即使在力量中排名為0，只要使用者在該姿態處於活動狀態時連續成功擊中敵人（即沒有所有攻擊被格擋、錯過、被阻礙等），就可以保持。

* Where Verata's Sacrifice works on your own minions, Blood of the Master heals all allied minions, including those in separate parties. Be careful when using this skill if there is another minion master around.
* A minion master spamming this skill can often keep their minions alive for periods far exceeding their usual life span; however, such a player can be a large drain on their party's healer.
* If your party has multiple minion masters, heroes will kill themselves with this skill if not having access to strong self-healing. To counteract this, consider bringing Taste of Death on that hero, since this makes them much less likely to die. 
* It is even possible to kill yourself at full health by using this skill; with at least 48 minions, you will sacrifice 101% health.

* This skill will activate only if you do not have an animal companion and the target is a charmable animal. 
** It can target friendly and hostile creatures, but not allies nor animals already charmed to be pets.
** If you try to use it on an invalid target, it will fail to activate (and you will see the relevant error message in red text).
* Once an animal is charmed, there is no special value to bringing this skill over Comfort Animal or Heal as One in PvE.
* Although this skill is unaffected by your rank in Beast Mastery, your pet's attacks benefit from a higher rank and you recover more quickly if your pet dies.
* Even if you replace this skill with another (e.g. a mission-specific skill such as Disarm Trap), your pet will remain with you. If you rezone and retain the replacement skill, the pet will not zone with you.
* PvE characters and heroes have to charm their own pets; PvP players start off with an Elder Wolf.
* Be careful when charming a pet with nearby heroes or henchmen: the target will become hostile and could be killed. To prevent this, flag your allies farther away and/or set heroes to avoid combat. 
* There are six special versions of this skill, notably the one used in the Codex Arena.
Although technically considered a pet, occasionally a charmed animal will retain the red wording associated with a hostile enemy just after completing the charm animal skill.
0bec3dc1b2b41b5f7cf43f671098f47057a2c2e2.text:

* This skill creates a Spirit of Conflagration.
* Mechanically, this skill is vastly different than how Winter works:
** Winter will not allow you to trigger the requirement of Conjure Frost, as it changes the elemental damage received to cold, rather than change the damage output of an elemental weapon to cold. 
** Conflagration changes the damage type output to fire, like Kindle Arrows, which will allow you to trigger Conjure Flame with it on its own.
* Because of this, this skill can be used to replace fiery bowstring, and synergizes with Conjure Flame and/or Mark of Rodgort fire damage requirements.
** This allows you to use to use Zealous or Vampiric bowstrings along with a fire damage bow, which is an important benefit for buiilds focusing in multiple attack skills and Conjure Flame.
** However, beware that the skill's damage type change will also stop physical damage triggers such as Winnowing, Mark of Pain or Barbs from working when the effect is active.

This spirit also causes Bone Fiend attacks and spear attacks to strike with fire damage.
Unlike Winter, this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.
fed9c51936a2aefa624fd5f176521ed1725e4019.text:
* 此技能創造出火靈的精神。
* 從機制上講，該技能與 寒冬 的工作原理有很大不同：
** 寒冬 不會允許您觸發 召喚冰霜 的要求，因為它將收到的元素傷害變更為寒冷，而不是將元素武器的傷害輸出變更為寒冷。 
** 火靈 將傷害型別輸出變更為開火，與 火箭 類似，這將允許您自行觸發 召喚火焰。
* 正因為如此，該技能可以用來取代熾熱弓弦，並與 召喚火焰 和/或 洛葛特的印記 火焰傷害要求相協同。
** 這允許您將 熱望 或 吸血鬼 弓弦與火焰傷害弓一起使用，這對於專注於多種攻擊技能和 召喚火焰 的建築是一個重要的好處。
** 但是，請注意，當效果啟動時，技能的傷害型別變更也會阻止物理傷害觸發器（例如 吹拂之風、痛苦印記 或 荊棘）發揮作用。

該精魂也會使骨魔攻擊和矛攻擊造成火焰傷害。
與寒冬不同，此技能要求攻擊者位於精神效果範圍內。

e1f763b97ade9388fdcc02079faecf7fff87c846.source:
When Contemplation of Purity (or any skill that removes "all enchantments") triggers the damage effects of Mirage Cloak or Aura of Holy Might, it behaves inconsistently compared to skills that remove a specific number of enchantments:

Mirage Cloak: Damage will only trigger for a restricted list of Dervish enchantments (Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and itself).

Aura of Holy Might: Damage will trigger for all Dervish enchantments except Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, and Vow of Revolution.

Skills that remove a defined number of enchantments (like Rend Enchantments or standard Dervish teardowns) do not suffer from these restrictions.
* Synergizes with enchantments with a positive end effect.
**This includes most Dervish Enchantments, making this skill a potentially effective replacement for teardowns.
e1f763b97ade9388fdcc02079faecf7fff87c846.text:
當純淨的冥想（或任何移除「所有結界」的技能）觸發魔幻掩蔽或神聖力量光環的傷害效果時，與移除特定數量結界的技能相比，其表現不一致：

魔幻掩蔽：傷害 只會觸發有限的 神喚使 附魔清單（荊棘靈氣、巴薩澤盛怒、神性修補、塵土掩蔽、驚天神力、古蘭斯之指 及其本身）。

聖力光環：傷害 將觸發除永恆光環、盾 力量、古蘭斯 光環和革命誓言之外的所有 神喚使 結界。

移除指定數量結界的技能（例如 粉碎加持 或標準 神喚使 拆卸）不受這些限制。
* 與結界協同作用，產生正面的最終效果。
**這包括大多數 神喚使 附魔，使該技能成為拆卸的潛在有效替代品。
e1f763b97ade9388fdcc02079faecf7fff87c846.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* Deathly Swarm is rather similar to Chain Lightning. It is a non-projectile spell with standard spell range. It does not immediately strike target foe (as most spells do), there is a delay before doing so.
:* 1 second after spell activation, the spell triggers on the target foe.
:* 2 seconds after spell activation, the spell triggers on a second foe in the area of the primary target.
:* 3 seconds after spell activation, the spell triggers on a third foe in the area of the secondary target.
*The casting animation resembles a pentagram around the target.
6de3831b7e6981a6dba830e09274fa3fba1d248c.text:
* 致命蟲群 與 連鎖閃電 非常相似。這是一個具有標準法術範圍的非投射法術。它不會立即攻擊目標敵人（就像大多數法術那樣），在這樣做之前會有一段延遲。
：* 1 法術啟動後第二秒，該法術在目標敵人身上觸發。
：* 2 法術啟動後秒，此法術會觸發主要目標區域內的第二個敵人。
：* 3 法術啟動後秒，該法術會在次要目標區域內的第三個敵人身上觸發。
*施法動畫類似目標周圍的五角星。

* Crude Swing is a single attack that can hit multiple foes.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to attack kiting opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.

24cecbe79eed4842796ebb6bcf8c8f4850f7d927.source:
* You lose more health as Dark Aura deals more damage with each rank in Death Magic.

Does not cause charmable animals to turn hostile.

;Player builds
* This skill is frequently used by Saccers to forced-trigger Death Nova.
** Combine Dark Aura with touch or point-blank skills that require sacrifices such as Signet of Agony and Touch of Agony. Other sacrifice skills, touch skills, or point-blank skills may also work well.

;AI tactics
* If triggered too rapidly in PvE, creatures will flee the AoE.
24cecbe79eed4842796ebb6bcf8c8f4850f7d927.text:
* 你會失去更多的生命值 暗黑靈氣 每個等級都會造成更多傷害 死亡魔法 。

不會導致可愛的動物變得充滿敵意。

;玩家建構
* 此技能常被Saccers用來強制觸發 死亡新星 。
** 結合 暗黑靈氣 具有需要犧牲的接觸或直擊技能，例如 劇痛紋章 和 劇痛之觸 。其他犧牲技能、接觸技能或近距離技能也可能有效。

;人工智慧戰術
* 如果在 PvE 中觸發得太快，生物將會逃離 範圍性 。

* While this skill typically deals more damage to the user than the target, there are multiple situations where this can be useful: 
** The short recharge time allows it to trigger Dark Aura frequently. This can become even more frequent if combining it with Masochism. 
** Dark Pact has an energy cost of just 1, making it a very cost-efficient choice for damage. This can be useful if the user has a surplus of health from the many life-stealing skills associated with Blood Magic.
da6e01329c56e588b43dc2f5e30046a69bf80a5b.text:

** 充電時間短，可頻繁觸發 暗黑靈氣。如果將其與受虐狂結合起來，這種情況會變得更加頻繁。 
** 暗黑契約 的能源成本僅為 1，使其成為非常經濟高效的損壞選擇。如果使用者從與 血魔法 相關的許多生命竊取技能中獲得了剩餘的生命值，這會很有用。

**如果十六進位失敗（即目標受到 破咒頌歌 的影響），你還是會影子步到目標。

** Combine with Dwarven Stability for up to 6 seconds speed boost every 8 seconds and up to 37.5% average speed boost.
* Despite being linked to an Attribute, this skill does not benefit from that attribute in any way.

* 儘管與 屬性 相關聯，但該技能不會以任何方式從該屬性中受益。

3bb023d969291048a04859f077680ec1bd36d62c.source:
* When looking for skills to meet Discord's conditions, consider those that either inflict their hexes or conditions in an area (e.g. Barbed Signet, Blood Bond) or have low energy costs, cast times, and recharge times (e.g. Parasitic Bond, Enfeeble).
** Similarly, Glyph of Immolation (followed by any hex that targets a foe) will set up Discord by applying the condition and hex together. (If the foe has already been hexed, just casting Discord is sufficient; the damage triggers because the Glyph's condition is applied before Discord checks the target's status.)
* This is the backbone skill for the PvE team build Discordway.
3bb023d969291048a04859f077680ec1bd36d62c.text:
* 在尋找符合 協調破壞 條件的技能時，請考慮那些在某個區域造成六角形或條件的技能（例如 荊棘紋章、血之連結）或能量消耗、施法時間和充電時間較低的技能（例如 寄生連結、衰弱）。
** 同樣，獻祭的 符號（後面跟著任何針對敵人的十六進位）將透過同時套用條件和十六進位來設定 協調破壞。 （如果敵人已經被施咒，只需施放 協調破壞 就足夠了；因為在 協調破壞 檢查目標狀態之前應用了 符號 的條件，所以會觸發傷害。）
* 這是PvE團隊建構Discordway的骨幹技能。

* This skill creates a Spirit of Displacement.
* Often used with Shelter and Union to provide superior damage reduction.
* Since this spirit will usually die very quickly, it is best to use this skill before the fight starts so that when it actually does begin, this skill will be ready to use again.
* Armor of Unfeeling can be used to reduce the damage taken by this spirit due to its effect.
* Miss effects can reduce the damage taken by this spirit, since they are resolved before this spirit's block chance.
There is a delay of 2-3 seconds from the spirit's creation to its effect being applied, unlike other skills.
The spirit will take damage even for attacks blocked by another blocking source. 
The duration bar beneath the effects monitor skill icon does not shrink over time like other effects with durations.
01f76108be127a718f536a2355018aff2bb45a1c.text:
* 此技能創造出偏移的精神。
* 通常與 庇護 和 聯合 一起使用，以提供卓越的傷害減少效果。
* 由於該精神通常會很快死亡，因此最好在戰鬥開始前使用該技能，以便在戰鬥真正開始時可以再次使用該技能。
* 無情護甲可以用來減少該戰魂因效果而受到的傷害。
* 未擊中的效果可以減少該戰魂所受到的傷害，因為它們會在該戰魂的格擋機率之前解決。
與其他技能不同，從靈魂創造到其效果生效有一個 2-3 秒的延遲。
即使攻擊被其他阻擋源阻擋，精神也會受到傷害。 
效果監視器技能圖示下方的持續時間欄不會像其他具有持續時間的效果那樣隨著時間的推移而縮小。

* Unlike Distracting Strike, no damage packet is displayed when hitting the target.
** Barbs, and the damage increase from Soul Taker, Order of Pain, Strength of Honor, and Conjures will not trigger.
* A hit is still registered on the target:
** Adrenaline (and energy if using a Zealous weapon modifier) is gained as usual. 
** Scythe attacks will hit up to two additional adjacent foes (interrupting them and foes adjacent to them).
** Adrenaline gain from Mark of Fury and Dark Fury, Blood Bond's healing, and Soul Taker's health sacrifice will occur.
** Life stealing from a Vampiric weapon modifier, Avatar of Grenth, Grenth's Aura and Order of the Vampire will occur.
** Splinter Weapon will trigger.
** Distracting Blow needs to hit for its interruption to occur. If Distracting Blow misses (due to blind for instance) or the user is under the effects of Illusionary Weaponry, the interruption will not occur. 
The concise description is incorrect: the adjacent foes are interrupted but not attacked. Notably, you won't gain adrenaline from them, and Illusionary Weaponry will not damage them (unless wielding a scythe).
62cfe46c6dc5ce42bee20dfb3957292ebc8b5dc4.text:
* 與分散打擊不同，擊中目標時不會顯示傷害包。
** 荊棘，靈魂奪走者、痛苦命令、榮耀之力 和召喚術的傷害增加不會觸發。
* 目標上仍記錄有命中：
** 怒氣（以及能量，如果使用 熱望 武器修飾符）照常取得。 
** 鐮刀 攻擊將擊中最多兩個額外的相鄰敵人（打斷他們以及與他們相鄰的敵人）。
** 怒氣 從 狂暴印記 和 暗黑憤怒 中取得，血之連結 的治療以及靈魂奪取者的健康犧牲將會發生。
** 來自 吸血鬼 武器修改器的 偷取生命、古蘭斯化身、古蘭斯 的光環和 吸血鬼命令 將會發生。
** 爆刺武裝 將會觸發。
** 虛晃打擊 需要點選才能發生中斷。如果 虛晃打擊 未命中（例如因失明）或使用者受到 幻象武器 的影響，則不會中斷。

cc2d95c1fb5eda4e7cfe03c6e241d8a051f8b1ae.source:
*As with any doublecast skill, NPCs will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's area of effect range of an ally.
*If a foe is targeted, the nearest ally (which can be the caster) will be enchanted instead. If nothing is targeted, Double Dragon will only be applied to the caster (the nearest ally).
**This is the only offensive doublecast skill that does not deal double damage when targeting yourself, because Double Dragon does not have an initial effect. This is due to game mechanics: you cannot be affected by two of the same enchantment.
*Burning is applied before the effect of skills, thus Double Dragon combines well with skills that require a condition (e.g. Virulence or Vile Miasma) or burning (e.g. Glowing Gaze or Searing Flames).
If a foe with a spell targeting prevention skill is targeted, Double Dragon will fail, despite the enchantment applying to the ally nearest to the target foe.
Whenever a target under the effects of Double Dragon is interrupted, the animation restarts.
Unlike most area damage over time skills, Double Dragon does not cause AI to scatter.
cc2d95c1fb5eda4e7cfe03c6e241d8a051f8b1ae.text:
*與任何雙施技能一樣，只要盟友的法術效果範圍內有敵人，NPC 就會使用該技能。
*如果敵人成為目標，最近的盟友（可以是施法者）將被附魔。如果沒有任何目標，雙龍將只應用於施法者（最近的盟友）。
**這是唯一一個在以自己為目標時不會造成雙倍傷害的進攻性雙重施放技能，因為 雙龍 沒有初始效果。這是由於遊戲機制所致：你不能受到兩個相同結界的影響。
*燃燒在技能效果之前應用，因此雙龍與需要條件（例如惡毒或惡劣毒氣）或燃燒（例如灼熱凝視或爆裂火焰）的技能很好地結合。
如果以具有法術鎖定預防技能的敵人為目標，則 雙龍 將會失敗，儘管該結界適用於距離目標敵人最近的盟友。
每當處於 雙龍 效果下的目標中斷時，動畫就會重新開始。
與大多數隨時間推移造成區域傷害的技能不同，雙龍 不會導致 AI 分散。
cc2d95c1fb5eda4e7cfe03c6e241d8a051f8b1ae.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

c248da69a2fe4c472ab16039c14283b0963479e7.source:
* The fastest sure way to capture this skill is from Taskmaster Durgon with the quest Dredging the Depths entering from Vlox's Falls.
* Lieutenant Mahgma, found in Fronis Irontoe's Lair during Kilroy Stonekin's Punch-Out Extravaganza!, also has Dwarven Battle Stance, but it cannot be captured from him as your skill bar is replaced with Dwarven brawling skills.
* This stance can be maintained indefinitely if used in combination with Dwarven Stability.
* The interrupt lands before the attack skill does. If the enemy is set to resume attacking after their action would complete, they will then transition into an "attacking" state after being interrupted. This will satisfy both Counter Blow and Counterattack's conditional bonuses against attacking foes. This significantly increases the reliability of these two skills in PvE, even against caster targets. This will not work if you hit them during Aftercast delay, as the interrupt will not apply to a target in that state.
c248da69a2fe4c472ab16039c14283b0963479e7.text:

* 如果與矮人穩定性結合使用，則該姿態可以無限期地保持。
* 打斷先於攻擊技能落地。如果敵人設定為在行動完成後繼續攻擊，那麼他們會在被打斷後轉變為「攻擊」狀態。這將滿足 反擊之鎚 和 反擊 針對攻擊敵人的條件加值。這顯著提高了這兩項技能在 PvE 中的可靠性，即使是針對施法者目標。如果您在 Aftercast 延遲期間擊中它們，這將無法運作，因為中斷不會套用於該狀態下的目標。

** It will increase the damage of skills that deal damage indirectly, such as Smoldering Embers, Spike Trap and Fire Storm, but not from similar skills inflicting armor ignoring damage such as Wastrel's Demise or Chaos Storm. 
** For non-attack skills, it will not increase typed armor-ignoring damage, such as Holy damage or Shadow damage. It also does not increase the physical damage from Splinter Weapon or Whirling Defense.
** Attack skills that deal entirely armor-ignoring damage, such as Banishing Strike, are still increased.
* The bonus damage is Armor-ignoring. 
* The bonus damage is dealt as long as the damage dealer remains standing in the ward; damage from ranged physical attacks as well as from area damage over time skills, such as Fire Storm or Spike Trap, increases while the caster stands in the ward, and will decrease if they leave it.
* The bonus damage is part of the original damage packet (e. g. Barbs and Mark of Pain will not trigger again on physical attacks).

* When used against Charr, the Ebon Vanguard Assassin can survive long enough to complete up to two attack chains. When used against other foes, the Assassin only has enough time for a single attack chain.
** All its skills are unblockable
** His Iron Palm will knock down foes that are hexed or suffering from a condition.
* You can create multiple Assassins in an area.
* It is not infused nor does it leave an exploitable corpse.
* When its summoning period ends, it appears to Shadow Step into nothingness.
* It will be higher than level 20 if cast under the effects of Signet of Illusions with an Illusion Magic rank 17 or more.

The Assassin doesn't shadow step; it is spawned directly next to the target.
The Assassin is counted as a created creature for Spirit's Gift, Explosive Growth, and Boon of Creation. However, it does not count as a summoned creature and is not affected by Spawning Power. Despite this classification, it is not affected by sulfur.
Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.
The Assassin does not always target the foe targeted by the caster, but instead targets the foe closest to its creation point.
Very rarely, the assassin may survive indefinitely. This can occur if resurrected by an enemy-created Restoration spirit, as by Reborn Irukandji.
