05bc1c61d0bee26078897d55aa5597d3ce23e295.source:
* Echo can copy powerful skills with long recharge times, doubling the rate at which they can be used.
* Use it to copy skills with short recharge times in order to spam them, e.g. adrenaline skills that have any recharge time.
* Combine Echo with Arcane Echo to create Echo chains, allowing you to have three copies of a skill at once. Add Arcane Mimicry to create multiple copies of a party member's elite.
* Echo will only recharge normally if no skill was copied. If a skill was copied, the copy remains for 30 seconds, after which Echo is disabled for 10 seconds.
* Use Auspicious Incantation to help manage energy costs (especially since Echo chains consume a lot of energy); the downside is mitigated since the disabled skill gets replaced shortly after.
* To capture Echo from a boss that has just copied a skill, wait 30 seconds (for the effect to wear off) before using your Signet of Capture.
* If used to copy a skill that can copy another skill or spell, the copy duration of that skill is used and will bypass Echo's 30-second copy duration, but Echo will still be disabled for 10 seconds afterwards.
** E.g., if used to copy Arcane Larceny/Thievery with Domination Magic rank 15, whatever spell that is stolen from a foe by the Echo version of Arcane Larceny/Thievery will remain as that stolen spell for 35 seconds and then revert back to Echo.
** E.g., if used to copy Arcane Larceny/Thievery with Domination Magic rank 0, whatever spell that is stolen from a foe by the Echo version of Arcane Larceny/Thievery will remain as that stolen spell for 5 seconds and then revert back to Echo.
*Echo's copying effect triggers first, before the effects of the skill that triggers it. For instance, when used to copy Blackout, the copy is disabled for 5 seconds.
Echo's description omits the fact that it cannot copy a Signet of Capture and itself.
05bc1c61d0bee26078897d55aa5597d3ce23e295.text:
* 迴響 可以複製強大的技能，充能時間長，使用速度倍增。
* 用它來複製充電時間短的技能，以便向它們傳送垃圾郵件，例如腎上腺素技能有任意充能時間。
* 合併 迴響 與 魔法迴音 創造 迴響 鏈，讓你可以同時擁有一個技能的三個副本。新增 魔力模仿 打造多個黨員精英副本。
* 迴響 只有在沒有複製技能的情況下才會正常充值。如果技能被複製，該副本將保留 30 秒，之後 迴響 已停用 10 秒。
* 使用 幸運咒語 幫助管理能源成本（特別是因為 迴響 鏈條消耗大量能量）；由於停用的技能很快就會被替換，因此缺點得到了緩解。
* 捕捉 迴響 來自剛複製技能的老闆，等等 30 使用前幾秒鐘（讓效果消失） 捕捉紋章 。
*如果用於複製可以複製另一個技能或法術的技能，則使用該技能的複製持續時間並繞過 迴響 的 30 -第二次複製持續時間，但是 迴響 仍將被停用 10 幾秒鐘後。
** 例如，如果用於複製 盜竊魔法 /偷竊與 支配魔法 等級 15 ，無論從敵人那裡偷走什麼咒語 迴響 的版本 盜竊魔法 /偷竊將繼續作為被盜咒語 35 秒，然後恢復到 迴響 。
** 例如，如果用於複製 盜竊魔法 /偷竊與 支配魔法 等級 0 ，無論從敵人那裡偷走什麼咒語 迴響 的版本 盜竊魔法 /偷竊將繼續作為被盜咒語 5 秒，然後恢復到 迴響 。
* 迴響 的複製效果先觸發，然後再觸發該技能的效果。例如，當用於複製時 意識喪失 ，副本被停用 5 秒。 迴響 的描述忽略了它不能複製的事實 捕捉紋章 和它本身。
05bc1c61d0bee26078897d55aa5597d3ce23e295.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* Greater Conflagration or Stone Striker can be used to eliminate the downside of this skill.
* Heroes do not maintain this stance and rarely use it, so it may require micromanagement. This differs from the otherwise similar stances Mantra of Flame, Mantra of Frost, Mantra of Earth, and Mantra of Lightning, which are all maintained permanently by heroes and hence easier to use against elemental damage.
Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Elemental Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against physical damage, Elemental Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
cbf9299b2dedc28c2ab234690d066c246dca1898.text:
* 可以使用更大的火靈或石之打擊來消除此技能的缺點。
* 英雄不會保持這種姿態，也很少使用它，因此可能需要微觀管理。這與其他類似的立場 火焰頌歌、冰霜頌歌、大地頌歌 和 閃電頌歌 不同，這些立場均由英雄永久保留，因此更容易用於對抗元素傷害。
與破解防禦類似，該技能不會將你的護甲等級降低到60以下，或者如果你的「核心」護甲等級低於60，則你的「核心」護甲等級不會降低。
如果你使用的技能或技能和效果的組合，在減去元素抵抗的懲罰後，仍然給予+26或更高的物理傷害護甲等級，則元素抵抗的護甲懲罰不起作用。另請參見護甲計算。

* Damage reduction is effective for as long as the target is hexed, i.e. if an attack lands after the hex ends (e.g. if the attacker dies while attacking), the attack will deal normal damage and if an attack iniated before the hex begins lands after the hex is applied, it'll deal less damage.
* Any attack triggers the damage, whether or not it hits; you are still affected even if missed, blocked, or enchanted with Illusionary Weaponry. Similarly, you are damaged for each attack made from attack skills that can deal multiple attacks and for each foe hit with a scythe.
* Combine with Reckless Haste in Normal mode to cause the damage to trigger more often.

;Hard mode
* This skill is more effective in Hard mode because foes (including spellcasters) attack faster.
* Hard Mode AI enemies will only cast this on a martial profession wielding a martial weapon.

Empathy triggers on failed attack skills, whereas Vigorous Spirit does not.
c195fdf0384ca5ac522358ca4b26aecd313a014b.text:
* 只要目標處於十六進位制狀態，傷害 減少就有效，即，如果攻擊在十六進位制結束後發生（例如，如果攻擊者在攻擊時死亡），則攻擊將造成正常傷害，如果在十六進位制開始之前發起的攻擊在應用十六進位制之後發生，則造成的傷害會減少。
* 任何攻擊都會觸發傷害，無論是否擊中；即使錯過、被阻止或被 幻象武器 迷住，您仍然會受到影響。同樣，每次使用可造成多次攻擊的攻擊技能進行的攻擊以及用鐮刀擊中的每個敵人都會對您造成傷害。
* 與普通模式中的失心瘋結合使用，可以更頻繁地觸發傷害。

;困難模式
* 此技能在 困難模式 中更有效，因為敵人（包括施法者）攻擊速度較快。
* 困難模式 AI 敵人只會對使用武術武器的武術職業施放此技能。

自虐 在攻擊技能失敗時觸發，而 精力充沛 則不會。

8ebc8e0a50f62ec780e2dce2e50182ec8c205be4.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Extinction.
* This skill does not affect creatures with no creature type, such as most Titans (with the exception of titans in the Domain of Anguish).
* Beware of the possible backfire of this skill on your party or allied NPCs.
** M.O.X., Jora, Pyre Fierceshot, Ogden Stonehealer, Vekk and Zhed Shadowhoof are respectively golem, norn, charr, dwarf, asura and centaur heroes. If using this skill, use those heroes rather than other human heroes of the same profession, as long as the area doesn't have other members of the same type (i.e. avoid using Pyre while in the Charr Homelands and Ascalon areas, Ogden while in the Southern and Northern Shiverpeaks, and Zhed when in the Maguuma Jungle; Jora is generally safe since Avarr the Fallen and Johon the Oxflinger are the only Norn foes you can kill).
** Not all allied human NPCs are considered the same creature type for the purposes of this ritual. For example, service NPCs (collectors, merchants, etc) and many non-hostile NPCs (including allies but not henchmen party members) each have their own species category separate from both each other and players.
* This skill is particularly lethal to minions, as most of them will already be below the 90% health requisite due to their innate health degeneration.
* Consider using with disease, as it also affects members of the same type and allows to reach the 90% requisite more easily.
* As with all nature rituals, being in range of 2 EoE spirits does not increase the damage - only the stronger EoE takes effect.
:* If 2 creatures are each in range of a different EoE (and each other), the EoE that deals damage will be the one in range of the creature that died.
8ebc8e0a50f62ec780e2dce2e50182ec8c205be4.text:
* 該技能會產生滅亡之魂。
* 此技能不會影響沒有生物型別的生物，例如大多數泰坦（除了泰坦） 悲難之門 ）。
* 注意該技能可能對你的隊伍或盟友 NPC 造成適得其反的效果。
** M.O.X.， 喬拉 、Pyre Fierceshot、Ogden Stonehealer、Vekk 和 Zhed Shadowhoof 分別是魔像、諾恩、夏爾、矮人、阿修羅和半人馬英雄。如果使用此技能，請使用這些英雄而不是同一職業的其他人類英雄，只要該區域沒有相同型別的其他成員（即避免在 夏爾家園區 和 阿斯卡隆 區，奧格登在南部和 北席娃山脈 和哲德在 梅古瑪叢林 ; 喬拉 整體來說是安全的，因為墮落者阿瓦爾和牧牛約翰是唯一的 諾恩 你可以殺死的敵人）。
** 就本儀式而言，並非所有人類 NPC 盟友都被視為相同的生物型別。例如，服務 NPC（收藏家、商人等）和許多非敵對 NPC（包括盟友但不包括黨羽成員）各自擁有自己的物種類別，彼此之間和玩家之間都是分開的。
* 這個技能對小兵來說特別致命，因為他們中的大多數已經低於 90% 由於他們先天的健康退化而需要健康。
*考慮與疾病一起使用，因為它也會影響相同型別的成員並允許達到 90% 更容易滿足要求。
* 與所有自然儀式一樣，處於 2 EoE精神不會增加傷害－只有更強的EoE才會生效。
:* 如果 2 每個生物都處於不同的 EoE 範圍內（並且彼此之間），造成傷害的 EoE 將是死亡生物範圍內的 EoE。
8ebc8e0a50f62ec780e2dce2e50182ec8c205be4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

577fc4bb89aaf9e1581edf15237ed1e68f1693f2.source:
* This skill is best used when very low on health.
* The health gained is temporary; your health can drop below zero when this ends. However, if that happens, you won't always die. For example, if you have positive health regeneration, your health bar will show 1 health while you recover the negative health caused from this skill ending. But if you have health degeneration or take any damage, you will die. Healing may also be fatal if it does not bring your health above zero.
577fc4bb89aaf9e1581edf15237ed1e68f1693f2.text:
* 此技能最適合在生命值很低時使用。
* 獲得的健康是暫時的；當這一切結束時，你的健康狀況可能會降至零以下。然而，如果發生這種情況，你也不會總是死。例如，如果你有積極的生命恢復，你的生命條會顯示1生命值，同時你恢復該技能結束造成的負生命值。但如果你的健康惡化或受到任何傷害，你就會死亡。如果治癒不能使你的生命值高於零，那麼它也可能是致命的。

* This skill creates a Spirit of Energizing Wind.
* Can be combined with Quickening Zephyr to reduce the recharge cost introduced by this skill.
* If affected by both Energizing Wind and Quickening Zephyr, 10 and 15 energy skills are cheaper with Energizing Wind applied last, while 25 Energy skills are cheaper if Quickening Zephyr is applied last.
* The effects of Expertise are calculated after the effects of Energizing Wind.
0888aed57523028bd91a4c3aa71faa1502ecb5cc.text:
* 此技能創造出能量之風的精神。

* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.

* The Energy Storage-dependent gain is rounded down, i.e. you receive no energy unless you have at least rank 10 in the attribute and can receive at most 2 energy with rank 20 or higher.
* The healing from this enchantment considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.

bfd1372bbd6b2a4ae00f43d91beaba25b94d1522.source:
* Essence Bond will not trigger unless damage is taken, so it might not trigger if the target is protected by skills such as Shielding Hands. However, it will trigger through Shield of Absorption.
* As with any maintained enchantment, heroes only use this skill during combat and stop maintaining it at other times.
** They will use it on any ally taking damage and will even maintain it on multiple allies (will stop maintaining when they are no longer taking damage).
* Essence Bond pays for its its own upkeep as long as the bonded ally suffers physical or elemental damage at least once every three seconds.
** Most martial foes attack fast enough to meet this requirement.
** The skill is frequently used for solo farming against multiple foes, since it can restore nearly all energy back to the caster. 
*** Balthazar's Spirit can be a better choice where foes deal other types of damage.
*** The two skills are combined for 55 monks and 600 builds.
** It is frequently used on tanks to help maintain the monk's energy.
bfd1372bbd6b2a4ae00f43d91beaba25b94d1522.text:
* 本質連結除非受到傷害才會觸發，因此如果目標受到防禦之手等技能的保護，則可能不會觸發。但是，它將透過 吸收盾 觸發。
* 與任何維持的結界一樣，英雄僅在戰鬥中使用此技能，並在其他時間停止維持它。
** 他們會對任何受到傷害的盟友使用它，甚至會在多個盟友上維持它（當他們不再受到傷害時將停止維持）。
* 只要繫結的盟友每三秒鐘至少遭受一次物理或元素傷害，本質連結 就會為其自己的維護付費。
** 大多數武術敵人的攻擊速度足以滿足此要求。
** 此技能經常用於單獨對付多個敵人，因為它可以將幾乎所有能量恢復給施法者。 
*** 當敵人造成其他型別的傷害時，巴薩澤的精神 可能是更好的選擇。
*** 這兩種技能結合用於 55 武僧和 600 建置。
** 它經常用於坦克，以幫助維持僧侶的能量。

Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
11abbf444c63967ef1c0bcc409adba7ea02103e6.text:

與描述相反，該技能會帶來治療效果，但不會增加生命值。

f05d22aa05d07cd670d3dc738754ecd764b10c2d.source:
* When using this skill, energy can be hidden to meet the requirement for the energy gain. 
* Heroes cannot effectively use this skill as they will begin to use it when they are at the upper cap, thus overpassing it due to natural energy regeneration and receiving no energy.
* The energy gain from Scribe's Insight is applied before this skill checks your current energy.
f05d22aa05d07cd670d3dc738754ecd764b10c2d.text:
* 使用此技能時，可以隱藏能量，以滿足能量增益的要求。

* 在該技能檢查您目前的能量之前，會先套用 銘刻者洞察 的能量增益。

* The energy gain does trigger upon the death of the hexed foe.
*If you cast this skill on a target which an ally has already put Ethereal Burden on, you will gain two packets of energy. One for when theirs would have normally ended, and one when yours ends
f0d7b57cd706fece6dbe6ff7e2e8b70d23c76dcb.text:

a7822154bbd9816f470e3f600a43dcb43ffe8649.source:
*Exhausting Assault is the only dual attack skill that doesn't require an off-hand attack skill to precede it.
*This skill will inflict overcast on its target even if the interruption is prevented.
*As this is an attack skill, the activation time is actually 0.25 second.
*If the target is skill queuing, this attack can interrupt two skills. This way, it is possible to inflict 20 overcast with one attack.
*A target elementalist may actually benefit from the effects of this skill, as some of their skills gain additional effects while the caster is overcast.
a7822154bbd9816f470e3f600a43dcb43ffe8649.text:
*衰竭突襲 是唯一不需要先有副手攻擊技能的雙重攻擊技能。

*由於這是攻擊技能，所以啟動時間實際上是0.25秒。
*如果目標是技能排隊，攻擊可以打斷兩個技能。這樣一來，一次攻擊就能造成 20 陰暗。
*目標元素師實際上可能會從該技能的效果中受益，因為他們的一些技能在施法者處於陰暗狀態時會獲得額外的效果。

* This does not increase the duration of conditions on your target.

* The duration cap is applied before other extending effects. Upgrade components (e.g. Silencing prefixes) can be used to increase durations beyond 30 seconds.
0fa77e3e2b3b2b9dc4429973656b328c56998bf6.text:

* 持續時間上限先於其他延長效果應用。升級元件（例如靜音字首）可用於將持續時間延長至 30 秒以上。

* This skill actually extends the next Dervish enchantment that is applied to you, no matter who cast it or how it was applied.

** It will extend another ally's Watchful Intervention that targets you.
** It won't extend your Watchful Intervention that targets another ally.
The visual indicator of the maximum duration on the skill icon of Vow of Piety and Vow of Revolution in the skill monitor is not full after renewal if they were extended before.
a4eeca08c4cac17b6b381230b40e7ed51296bfe4.text:

** 它將延長另一個盟友針對您的 警戒干涉。
** 它不會延長針對另一個盟友的 警戒干涉。
如果之前延長過的話，技能監視器中虔誠誓言和革命誓言的技能圖示上最大持續時間的視覺指示器在更新後不會滿。

* This skill creates a Spirit of Famine.

* Energy must be at least 1 before dropping to 0 in order for Famine to deal damage (losing fractional energy gained by energy regeneration does not count).
4de502030524c72ad746382b8dac809297881eab.text:

* 飢荒 與 感同身受 和/或 先人容貌 結合使用時，用於吸收傷害的單一坦克時非常強大。它是隨著敵人（特別是近戰敵人）數量的增加而變得越來越強大的組合之一。
* 能量 在下降到 0 之前必須至少為 1，飢荒 才能造成傷害（損失能量再生所獲得的部分能量不算在內）。

a61abf775be10272fcf3eaf25377936ffa58811e.text:

e0b8d45f538a5c3a9a775e91ea7720021e2b9562.source:
* This skill will not fail if the target dies while it is being activated.
* Combines well with hex spells that hex foes in an area of effect, such as Reckless Haste, Suffering or Meekness.
* Cannot be captured from some unique foes that use it:
** Rotscale, Selvetarm, and Fendi Nin are boss-like foes, not bosses.
** The death of the Inscribed Guardian at the end of Finding the Bloodstone triggers a cinematic, leaving no time to capture the skill.
e0b8d45f538a5c3a9a775e91ea7720021e2b9562.text:
* 如果目標在啟動過程中死亡，技能不會失敗。

* 無法從使用它的某些獨特敵人手中捕獲：
** 惡臭骨龍、希維塔姆 和 梵帝寧 是類似 Boss 的敵人，而不是 Boss。
** 銘文 守護者 在 尋找血石 結束時死亡會觸發過場動畫，沒有時間捕捉該技能。

*Can be combined with Life or Signet of Spirits for a larger healing burst.
*Healing occurs before spirits are destroyed.
**Synergizes very well with Lacerate, to trigger bleeding on foes but not allies.
**Destroying the spirit of Restoration will resurrect allies but they will not get the healing.
*Healing is caused by the caster and will trigger hexes like Scourge Healing.
*Be careful using this if you have more than one Ritualist in your party. While the healing will be greater, you may destroy their build by killing important spirits.

The plain text description says "nearby allies" spirits, instead of "nearby allied spirits". The skill works according to the concise description.
f2b842400a093597b7c5d1f31c61d702727b299c.text:
*可與 生命 或 縛靈紋章 結合使用，以獲得更大的治療爆發力。

**與 撕裂 協同作用非常好，可觸發敵人流血，但不會觸發盟友流血。
**摧毀 復甦 的精神會復活盟友，但他們不會得到治療。
*治療是由施法者引起的，並且會觸發像災禍治癒這樣的六角形。
*如果您的隊伍中有多於一個 祭祀者，請小心使用此功能。雖然治療效果會更好，但你可能會透過殺死重要的靈魂來摧毀他們的建構。

54c96e0843bba1c7b6e291e2ea76b256cf232840.text: *沒有 死靈法師 技能會導致擊倒，因此您需要使用僅限 PvE 的技能或其他職業的技能才能利用第二個效果。

6d35ca7cbab89878e64bc72c92d415ba3f80917a.source:
* Fevered Dreams will spread the Dazed it applies.
* Dazed will cover the new condition.
* Since the hex will not trigger when reapplying conditions, consider using Hypochondria or Crystal Wave to remove all conditions before reapplying them. Reap Impurities will remove one condition, likely Dazed. 
* Works well with shouts inflicting conditions, most notably "You Move Like a Dwarf!", "You Are All Weaklings!", and "Finish Him!". 
Applying or reapplying the hex on a target suffering from one or more condition(s) will trigger the Dazed effect.
The Dazed caused by this hex is always spread to foes in the area, even if the target was already Dazed.
The Dazed caused by this hex triggers Fragility twice upon application on the target (but not on surrounding foes).
If two foes hexed with Fevered Dreams are next to each other and one of them starts suffering from a new condition, both will be Dazed.
6d35ca7cbab89878e64bc72c92d415ba3f80917a.text:
* 惡夢傳染 將傳播其適用的 暈眩。
* 暈眩 將涵蓋新條件。
* 由於重新套用條件時不會觸發十六進位，請考慮使用 免疫破壞 或 水晶波動 刪除所有條件，然後重新套用它們。 汙穢回收 將刪除一個條件，可能是 暈眩。 
* 與造成條件的喊叫配合得很好，最明顯的是“你像 矮人 一樣移動！”、“你們都是弱者！”和“幹掉他！”。 
對患有一種或多種病症的目標應用或重新應用十六進位制將觸發 暈眩 效果。
此十六進位所引起的 暈眩 總是會傳播到該區域內的敵人，即使目標已經是 暈眩。
此十六進位所引起的 暈眩 在套用至目標時會觸發 脆弱 兩次（但不適用於周圍的敵人）。
如果兩個被 惡夢傳染 咒語的敵人彼此相鄰，並且其中一個開始患有新的病症，則兩人都將被 暈眩 咒語。
6d35ca7cbab89878e64bc72c92d415ba3f80917a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* Damage from this skill is calculated at the time of activation on the skill bar, not when the animal companion uses it.

* 傷害 此技能的計算是在技能欄上啟動時計算的，而不是在動物夥伴使用它時計算的。

*Not counting elite skills, the longest recharge time for a player-useable attack skill is 30 seconds, which is the recharge time for Renewing Smash. Aside from Renewing Smash, the longest recharge time is 20 seconds, which is the recharge time of Disarm, Overbearing Smash, Bestial Mauling, Disrupting Lunge, Pounce, and Spear Swipe.
*Often used with energy-based attack skills causing knockdown such as Bull's Strike, Horns of the Ox or Trampling Ox (and with an effect depending on knockdowns such as Falling Lotus Strike or Falling Spider) to keep an opponent on the ground.
*Useful for recharging dagger attacks that have long recharge times.
b02f945367f135eb165cb08e81b70125cbd97476.text:
*不計算菁英技能，玩家可用的攻擊技能最長充能時間為30秒，即復原猛擊的充能時間。除復原猛擊外，最長儲值時間為20秒，即移除、傲慢猛擊、獸性之爪、擾亂衝刺、突襲、矛刷卡的儲值時間。
*經常與基於能量的攻擊技能一起使用，導致擊倒，例如公牛衝擊、牛角衝擊或踐踏牛（並且效果取決於擊倒，例如墜落蓮花打擊或毒蛛墜殺），以將對手保持在地面上。
*對於充能時間較長的匕首攻擊很有用。

* Only the base damage from attacks is reduced, the bonus damage of attack skill and damage caused by skills is not. 
** Very useful for Assassins in PvP, as most of their damage comes from attack skill bonus damage, which isn't reduced by Flurry.
** Most common stance for IW mesmers, since Illusionary Weaponry ignores Flurry's damage reduction.
* Heroes don't seem to use this skill.
Contrary to the description, the 25% damage reduction only applies to base damage.
3b3bbd4388025cdff0bfc89bdbbcc012161c2ada.text:
* 僅減少攻擊的基礎傷害，攻擊技能的加成傷害和技能造成的傷害不減少。 
** 對於 PvP 中的刺客非常有用，因為他們的大部分傷害來自攻擊技能加成傷害，而 疾風攻勢 不會減少傷害。
** IW 催眠師最常見的立場，因為 幻象武器 忽略 疾風攻勢 的傷害減免。
* 英雄好像不使用這個技能。
與描述相反，25% 傷害減免僅適用於基礎傷害。

a9e54580c2493432dfb7dc72d704a6f4d00ff874.source:
Unlike most skills that increase the rate of adrenaline gain by a multiplier, this increases all non-multiplier sources of adrenaline, not just the basic 1 strike from making an attack.
*Focused Anger will not stack with other skills to bring your total adrenaline gain above 100%; however, if you have more than 100% gain from Focused Anger, you will still gain that amount.
*Because adrenal gain is done on a point system, with some units smaller than a strike, it can often be difficult to tell how much impact this skill will make when charging adrenaline skills. 
*Commonly used as the elite for Imbagons.
a9e54580c2493432dfb7dc72d704a6f4d00ff874.text:
與大多數透過乘數增加腎上腺素獲得率的技能不同，這會增加所有非乘數來源的腎上腺素，而不僅僅是進行攻擊時的基本 1 打擊。
*集聚怒氣 不會與其他技能疊加以使您的總腎上腺素增益高於 100%；但是，如果您從 集聚怒氣 獲得的收益超過 100%，您仍將獲得該金額。
*因為腎上腺增益是在積分系統上完成的，有些單位比一次打擊還要小，所以通常很難判斷該技能在充能腎上腺素技能時會產生多大的影響。 
*通常用作伊姆巴貢斯的精英。
a9e54580c2493432dfb7dc72d704a6f4d00ff874.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

This Soul Reaping skill uses the Blood Magic casting symbol because it was originally a Blood Magic skill.

If this skill transfers Disease, it will recharge in 2 seconds regardless of modifiers affecting its recharge such as Diversion.
 
Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing and not health gain.

Activating this skill while hexed with Soul Bind will damage the user even if no conditions are transferred.
aae3f14892b4660609600c765384c0f739d73fb0.text:

* 與 散播疫病 結合使用，使敵人產生的條件對他們不利。
* 可用來觸發 安哥羅頓 Gaze 的能量優勢。
* 小心敵人攜帶 脆弱 的地方，這會觸發多次。

此 靈魂吸取 技能使用 血魔法 施法符號，因為它原本是 血魔法 技能。

如果此技能轉移疾病，無論 牽制 等影響其充能的修飾因子為何，它都會在 2 秒內充能。

在使用 靈魂束縛 施咒時啟動此技能，即使沒有條件轉移也會對使用者造成傷害。

af0931401d11f28488154c9d255f69db3d9c2206.source:
* Fragility deals no damage upon reapplying a condition.
** It's best to keep conditions on the target almost non-stop, letting conditions expire and directly afterwards re-apply the condition again.
* Shockwave and Virulence can apply three conditions in one skill.
* Synergizes well with Avatar of Balthazar and Reap Impurities in dealing large amounts of damage over a short period of time.
* With enough conditions, Epidemic, Crystal Wave or Hypochondria can cause a massive AoE spike.
af0931401d11f28488154c9d255f69db3d9c2206.text:
* 脆弱 重新套用條件時不會造成任何傷害。
** 最好讓目標上的條件幾乎不間斷，讓條件過期，然後立即重新套用條件。
* 衝擊波和惡毒可以在一個技能中應用三個條件。
* 與 巴薩澤化身 和 汙穢回收 很好地協同作用，在短時間內造成大量傷害。
* 在足夠的條件下，病症擴散、水晶波動 或 免疫破壞 可能會導致大量 範圍性 尖峰。

6c5ca01825ba55aabe8a47598cff283e0c9d1577.source:
* Fragility only triggers when the target receives a new condition. Reapplying already applied conditions doesn't trigger Fragility.
* Casting Fragility while under the effect of Glyph of Immolation will cause the burning condition to be applied before Fragility, causing Fragility to not trigger. 
* Synergizes well with Virulence, even with low Death Magic attribute.
6c5ca01825ba55aabe8a47598cff283e0c9d1577.text:
* 脆弱 僅在目標收到新條件時觸發。重新套用已套用的條件不會觸發 脆弱。
* 在獻祭的 符號 效果下施放 脆弱 會導致燃燒條件在 脆弱 之前應用，導致 脆弱 無法觸發。 
* 即使 死亡魔法 屬性較低，也能與 惡毒 良好協同。
6c5ca01825ba55aabe8a47598cff283e0c9d1577.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

a0634391b2c3613686e613efef5078174104b1c5.source: * Similarly to Ash Blast, Freezing Gust does not count as a hex spell if the target is hexed with a Water Magic hex. Skills that check for hexed foes (e.g. Soul Barbs) or skills that trigger when the user casts a hex spell (e.g. Elemental Flame) do not trigger if Freezing Gust hits a target hexed with a Water Magic hex.
a0634391b2c3613686e613efef5078174104b1c5.text: * 與 塵暴 類似，若目標被 水系魔法 十六進位施咒，寒風 不算十六進位咒語。如果 寒風 擊中具有 水系魔法 十六進位的目標，則檢查是否有十六進位敵人的技能（例如 靈魂荊棘）或在使用者施放十六進位咒語時觸發的技能（例如 元素火焰）不會觸發。

*Can be effectively used by secondary warriors, since it is the only No Attribute skill that provides blocking.
*Damage reduction, such as Protective Spirit, will be taken into account after Frenzied Defense, therefore mitigating the double damage.
**If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, consider using a cancel stance.
*Used with Spirit Bond, the attacks that are not blocked are more likely to trigger the healing effect and can effectively negate all incoming damage from attacks.
018c71367fb9a8de60186c30dc0ba935f733e62d.text:
*可以被二級戰士有效使用，因為它是唯一提供阻擋的無屬性技能。
*傷害 減少，例如 精神守護，將在 狂暴防禦 之後考慮，從而減輕雙重損害。
**如果不使用 精神守護 等技能，請考慮使用取消姿勢。
*與精神連結搭配使用，未被格擋的攻擊更有可能觸發治療效果，並能有效抵消所有攻擊造成的傷害。
018c71367fb9a8de60186c30dc0ba935f733e62d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0e28e0a30b948bf22dbabeae851b06e34344c3bd.source:
* Generally used by sword and axe warriors in PvP. Hammer warriors tend to use Flail instead, partly due to their lower armor rating and partly because Flail has less of a drawback when foes are knocked down. 
* Damage reduction, such as Protective Spirit, will be taken into account after Frenzy, therefore mitigating the additional damage.
** If not using skills such as Protective Spirit, the use of a cancel stance, such as Rush, is advisable.
* Frenzy is generally too risky to use on secondary warriors, as their lower armor rating combined with the Frenzy drawback makes them too vulnerable.
* It is the only stance available in pre-Searing.
0e28e0a30b948bf22dbabeae851b06e34344c3bd.text:
* 通常由 PvP 中的劍戰士和斧戰士使用。 鎚 戰士傾向於使用 連枷，部分原因是其護甲等級較低，部分原因是 連枷 在敵人被擊倒時的缺點較小。 
* 傷害 減少，例如 精神守護，將在 狂暴 之後考慮，從而減輕額外損壞。
** 如果不使用 精神守護 等技能，建議使用取消姿態，例如 突進。
* 狂暴 通常對次要戰士來說風險太大，因為他們較低的護甲等級加上 狂暴 的缺點使他們太脆弱。
* 這是 崩壞 先前版本中唯一可用的姿勢。

* "Create" includes spawning minions, Asura summons, and Ebon Vanguard Assassin.
* Synergy with skills that can create multiple summoned creatures, since this skill triggers when each creature is created.
** This skill will trigger simultaneously for each creature created when using Animate Bone Minions, Aura of the Lich, or Signet of Spirits.
** Using Animate Shambling Horror will trigger this skill two times eventually: once when the Shambling Horror is animated, and then once again when it dies and a Jagged Horror is spawned.
** Jagged Horrors created via Jagged Bones will trigger this skill.
5435d17021fbd28621f4893d64aafdda07a20abd.text:
*「建立」包括生成小兵、阿蘇拉 召喚和 黑檀 暗殺者。
* 與可以建立多個召喚生物的技能協同作用，因為該技能會在建立每個生物時觸發。
** 使用 操縱骸骨爪牙、巫妖靈氣 或 縛靈紋章 時建立的每個生物都會同時觸發此技能。
** 使用 操縱爬行骸骨 最終會觸發該技能兩次：一次是在蹣跚恐怖生物動畫時觸發，另一次是在它死亡並生成鋸齒恐怖生物時觸發。
** 透過 鋸齒骸骨 建立的鋸齒恐怖將觸發此技能。

901746b44f59cff6013a998921722c4eee61f2cc.source:
*This skill creates a Spirit of Frozen Soil.
*This spirit prevents creatures in its range from using resurrection skills, not resurrection itself.
**A creature outside the range of the spirit can resurrect a character inside its range, while a character inside its range cannot resurrect a character outside its range.
**Unyielding Aura, Lively Was Naomei and Restoration will still resurrect when removed, dropped or destroyed respectively, but none of these can be cast while in range of this spirit.
**A Scroll of Resurrection will still work, as it is not a skill.
*Does not affect skills that resurrect pets.
*Can be combined with Gaze of Fury or Rupture Soul to kill the spirit on command, expediting party resurrection.
Eternal Aura can be cast while under the effects of Frozen Soil.
901746b44f59cff6013a998921722c4eee61f2cc.text:
*此技能創造了凍土的精神。
*此精魂會阻止其範圍內的生物使用復活技能，而不是復活本身。
**精神範圍外的生物可以復活其範圍內的角色，而其範圍內的角色則無法復活其範圍外的角色。
**堅毅靈氣、復活者娜歐梅 和 復甦 分別在被移除、掉落或摧毀時仍然會復活，但在該精魂的範圍內時，這些都無法施放。
**復活的 卷軸 仍然有效，因為它不是技能。
*不影響復活寵物的技能。
*可以與狂暴凝視或生靈迸裂結合使用來殺死指令中的靈魂，加速隊伍的復活。
永恆光環可以在 凍土 的效果下施放。

bdeb61cad4f194fb2f7a82df06da063799edc62c.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Fury that uses the Gaze of Fury attack skill. 
* Can target and destroy enemy spirits as well.
** This is notably useful in Sunjiang District in Factions, and in the Domain of Anguish when facing Mallyx the Unyielding 
* Consider using with Destruction, Life, and Restoration.
* Use on spirits that will expire soon, and spirits that will die soon, notably from their own effect, such as Agony. 
* Can be recast on an already created Spirit of Fury, allowing one to recycle the spirit indefinitely.
Can be used on any target, not just spirits; can also be cast without a target. If the target is not an enemy spirit, it will destroy the spirit closest to the target. If cast without a target, it will destroy the spirit closest to the caster.
Using this skill while targeting an ally (including spirits) will stop automatic health regeneration.
If multiple spirits occupy exactly the same spot, using Gaze of Fury on one of them may destroy one of the others instead.
bdeb61cad4f194fb2f7a82df06da063799edc62c.text:
* 此技能會創造出使用 狂暴凝視 攻擊技能的憤怒之魂。 
* 也可以瞄準並摧毀敵人的靈魂。
** 這在 孫江行政區 和 盟與敵 中以及在 悲難之門 中面對不屈的 Mallyx 時特別有用
* 考慮與 毀滅、生命 和 復甦 一起使用。
* 用於即將過期的靈魂，以及很快就會死亡的靈魂，特別是由於其自身效果，例如痛苦。 
* 可以在已經建立的憤怒之魂上重鑄，允許人們無限期地回收該精神。
可以對任何目標使用，而不僅僅是精神；也可以在沒有目標的情況下施放。如果目標不是敵方戰魂，則會消滅距離目標最近的戰魂。如果在沒有目標的情況下施放，它會摧毀距離施法者最近的靈魂。
在瞄準盟友（包括靈魂）時使用此技能將停止自動生命恢復。
如果多個精魂佔據完全相同的位置，則對其中一個精魂使用 狂暴凝視 可能會摧毀其他精魂之一。

* The amount of energy loss can be lowered by energy hiding.

* Burning is applied before the effect of the spell, thus the glyph combines well with skills that require a condition (e.g. Virulence or Vile Miasma) or burning (e.g. Glowing Gaze or Searing Flames).
* This skill only burns the targeted foe, even if the spell has an area of effect (e.g. Fireball); it does not have any effect on point blank area-of-effect spells (e.g. Inferno). 
* When used with projectile spells, the burning takes effect after activation, but before the projectile starts to move; the target will burn even if the projectile misses.
445b51316b8e32ab311ebbd865c75091ef6cb965.text:
* 燃燒在法術效果之前應用，因此該雕文與需要條件（例如惡毒或惡劣毒氣）或燃燒（例如灼熱凝視或爆裂火焰）的技能很好地結合在一起。
*即使該法術有一定的影響範圍，該技能只會燃燒目標敵人（例如火球）；它對直射區域效果法術沒有任何效果（例如地獄火）。 
*與投射物法術一起使用時，燃燒在啟用後、投射物開始移動之前生效；即使彈體未命中，目標也會燃燒。

*This skill will remain on an ally even if all enchantments end or are removed, but the speed boost will be lost until another enchantment is applied.
*This skill increases average speed by 4.17...14.17...16.67% if used every time it recharges and ally/allies is/are enchanted for the full duration of Godspeed. 
* If the team members do not already use their own enchantments, one can use the following options to enchant and get the speed boost on as many of them as possible:
** Party wide enchantments spells: Aegis, Dwayna's Sorrow, Magnetic Surge, Swirling Aura, Magnetic Aura (all three if overcast) and order spells. 
*** Dwayna's Sorrow is the only one to combine both perfect upkeep and long lasting duration. It is also notably cheap with a short casting time.
** Spammable long-lasting enchantments: Tainted Flesh or Vigorous Spirit mostly. 
** Maintained enchantments. 
This skill doesn't have punctuation in its name like other shouts, even though the character still shouts it with the punctuation.
63a59cdd2d5027980bf4149ff07d68cb4b00bcdb.text:
*即使所有結界結束或被移除，該技能仍將保留在盟友身上，但速度提升將丟失，直到應用另一個結界。
*如果每次充電時使用該技能，並且盟友在 天使賜福 的整個持續時間內被附魔，則該技能的平均速度會提高 4.17...14.17...16.67%。 
* 如果團隊成員尚未使用自己的附魔，則可以使用以下選項來附魔並獲得盡可能多的速度提升：
** 隊伍 廣泛的結界法術：神賜之盾、薇娜的憂傷、磁湧、旋渦靈氣、磁能靈氣（如果是陰天，則全部三個）和順序法術。 
*** 薇娜的憂傷 是唯一一款兼具完美維護且持久的產品。它的價格也特別便宜，鑄造時間短。
** 垃圾郵件持久附魔：主要是 腐敗肉體 或 精力充沛。 
** 維持結界。

c3cd9f34482e2b6d6d0857c127e11b246da03d7a.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Greater Conflagration.
* Synergizes with skills/items that are contingent on fire damage: Mark of Rodgort, Conjure Flame, Pyrebound Insignia, Mantra of Flame, and others.
** It is especially useful to counter certain enemy skills, e.g. Glint's Jagged Crystal Skin is rendered useless in The Dragon's Lair. 
** Combine with Winter to take advantage of cold-based contingencies, e.g. Mantra of Frost.

Unlike Winter this skill requires the attacker to be inside the spirit area of effect.

Does not properly convert the physical damage of certain skills (notably: Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support and Veil of Thorns). As a result, the skill chain will not trigger the conditional effects of other skills that depend on fire damage (in particular, for Intensity).
c3cd9f34482e2b6d6d0857c127e11b246da03d7a.text:

44744f18116b58e17e52b890d029e855360450eb.source:
* Grenth's Balance is most effective when:
** The target has as much health as possible and
** The caster has a high maximum health, but is left with very little actual health.

* Effects that cause spell casting to inflict health loss or gain (e.g. Backfire, Vigorous Spirit) trigger before this skill checks the caster's health.
** If that effect brings the caster's health to zero, then Grenth's Balance still causes the target to lose health, but the caster dies before they can gain any health.
* The AI uses Grenth's Balance properly, prioritizing high health targets.

The concise description omits the fact that your health gain (and your target's health loss) is capped by your maximum health.
44744f18116b58e17e52b890d029e855360450eb.text:
* 古蘭斯的平衡 在以下情況下最有效：
** 目標擁有儘可能多的生命值並且
** 施法者的最大生命值很高，但實際生命值卻很少。

* 導致施法造成生命值損失或增加的效果（例如 魔力反噬、精力充沛）在此技能檢查施法者的生命值之前觸發。
** 如果該效果使施法者的生命值歸零，則 古蘭斯的平衡 仍會導致目標失去生命值，但施法者在獲得任何生命值之前就會死亡。
* AI正確使用古蘭斯的平衡，優先考慮高健康目標。

簡潔的描述忽略了一個事實：你的健康增益（以及你的目標的健康損失）受到你的最大生命值的限制。

* The condition removal works regardless of whether foes are nearby or not. However, conditions are not transferred if the enchantment ends due to the caster's death.
* Transferred conditions' durations are affected by their appropriate weapon mods.
8aa0360a62023d6abc93183033fb50a826e2ee02.text:
* 無論敵人是否在附近，條件移除都會起作用。然而，如果結界因施法者死亡而結束，條件不會轉移。

8cd434828d19a1b8a20cbb1ca4c2054143df8bc4.source:
* Applies cripple before the effects of the attack skill, which enables skills like Reap Impurities.
* Grenth's Grasp only transfers conditions after you've successfully hit the foe.
** If you're suffering from Weakness or Blindness, they will still apply to your attack.
** The self-inflicted weakness from Wearying Spear is applied after the condition transfer. It won't be transferred until your next attack skill.
* Consider using with Volley for spammable mass cripple and condition transfer.
8cd434828d19a1b8a20cbb1ca4c2054143df8bc4.text:
* 在攻擊技能生效之前應用癱瘓，從而啟用諸如 汙穢回收 之類的技能。
* 古蘭斯之爪 僅在您成功擊中敵人後傳輸條件。
** 如果您患有 虛弱 或失明，它們仍然適用於您的攻擊。
** 衰竭之矛 的自傷弱點在條件轉移後應用。直到你的下一個攻擊技能才會轉移。
* 考慮與 Volley 一起使用來進行垃圾郵件群發癱瘓和條件轉移。
8cd434828d19a1b8a20cbb1ca4c2054143df8bc4.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

acab1c098483b165ee300648a884e652d954441a.source: For the purposes of this skill, a single scythe auto-attack or a single-targeted skill (such as Pious Assault, Twin Moon Sweep, or Triple Shot) counts as one attack in total (even if it hits multiple enemies or multiple times), but attack skills that explicitly strike multiple foes (such as Eremite's Attack or Volley) count as one attack per foe.
acab1c098483b165ee300648a884e652d954441a.text: 就該技能而言，單次鐮刀自動攻擊或單一目標技能（例如 神性突襲、雙月掃蕩 或三重射擊）總共算作一次攻擊（即使擊中多個敵人或多次），但明確攻擊多個敵人的攻擊技能（例如 隱士攻擊 或齊射）算作每個敵人的一次攻擊。

d142843ca8a4c8cf7c72038d1737b019cb5741cc.text:
* 生命偷取效果首先生效，因此只有當你的寵物在施法時還活著時才會產生效果。

* Does not increase the Divine Favor healing bonus. Even though healing done by enchantments is not normally enhanced, Patient Spirit is. For details, see healing modifiers.
* Since the duration of Healer's Boon is the same as its recharge time with no attribute rank in Divine Favor, it proves usable by secondary monk healers as long as energy permits.
* Its faster activation effect stacks with Fast Casting, as long as the Healing Prayers spell's original casting time is 2 seconds or longer.
1026fc0d7af22df7183ef3ca0e8f73e5cbbcf5fa.text:
* 不會增加 神恩 治療加值。儘管結界所帶來的治療效果通常不會增強，但耐心精神卻會增強。有關詳細資訊，請參閱治療修飾符。

* The target does not benefit from the additional party healing, however does benefit from Divine Favor.
* Skills that increase the healing of spells will increase the party healing beyond your Divine Favor bonus.
Contrary to the descriptions, this skill causes healing in earshot and not health gain.
65d28c4fc496c0839e8503423c7da55651d0f4c2.text:
* 耳擊治療效果授予施法者的隊伍成員，而不是目標的成員（與 生命 的種子不同）。

bd417bbb4eb9e7ad0040f8c674bd254707b7905d.source:
*Synergizes well with attack skills that can cause multiple attacks with a sword (Sun and Moon Slash, Whirlwind Attack, and Twin Moon Sweep) and with hex spells that deal damage whenever the hexed foe takes physical damage (Barbs and Mark of Pain).
**When Whirlwind Attack is used, this skill will trigger for each adjacent foe attacked.
*Because this triggers on attack, you don't actually have to hit for the damage to occur.
*The damage from Hundred Blades is inflicted before the damage from your sword. This is relevant for skills such as Reversal of Fortune or Empathy.
*Because this damages all "adjacent foes", kiting opponents will avoid damage if they have moved away by the time the attack connects.
*If you are using an emote when using this skill, no animation will show until you stop doing the emote. The animation will stack with several Hundred Blades.
bd417bbb4eb9e7ad0040f8c674bd254707b7905d.text:
*與可以用劍造成多次攻擊的攻擊技能（日月斬、旋風 Attack和雙月掃蕩）以及每當被施咒的敵人受到物理傷害時造成傷害的咒語（荊棘和痛苦印記）很好地協同作用。
**當使用旋風攻擊時，每個受到攻擊的相鄰敵人都會觸發該技能。
*因為這會在攻擊時觸發，所以你實際上不必擊中就會發生傷害。
*快速劍 造成的傷害先於你的劍所造成的傷害。這與 幸運逆轉 或 自虐 等技能有關。
*因為這會傷害所有“相鄰的敵人”，所以如果風箏對手在攻擊連線時已經離開，他們將避免受到傷害。
*如果您在使用此技能時使用表情，則在您停止執行表情之前不會顯示任何動畫。動畫將與多個 快速劍 疊加。

d18d164e50a7268743447db1cf8f46655b1049dd.source:
* While under the effect of this skill, attacks with a bow will deal armor-respecting fire damage to all foes in an area adjacent to the landing area of each shot arrow, before the arrow itself hits.
** The explosion occurs regardless of whether the arrow actually hits its target (even if it misses, strays or is blocked).
** Multiple-arrow attacks (Dual Shot, Forked Arrow, Triple Shot and Incendiary Arrows) will trigger an explosion for each arrow.
** The fact that the explosion triggers first is relevant for skills such as Reversal of Fortune or Reversal of Damage.
** Unlike Kindle Arrows, the damage type of the arrows is not converted to fire, thus:
*** This skill alone will not be enough to make the arrows meet the condition of Conjure Flame's bonus damage without using a fiery bowstring.
*** The fire damage of the explosion, however, can be used to trigger burning on foes hexed with Mark of Rodgort without the need of a fiery bowstring. 
*** This also allows the main arrow attack to benefit from physical damage triggers, such as Winnowing, Mark of Pain or Barbs, even if the secondary preparation-caused explosions deal fire damage.
** The explosion itself is not an attack. The damage will not be increased by effects increasing the damage of attacks such as modifiers on the bow or skills like Ursan Roar or "Together as One!". However it is increased by Ebon Battle Standard of Honor.
d18d164e50a7268743447db1cf8f46655b1049dd.text:
* 在該技能的效果下，使用弓箭攻擊會在箭擊中之前對每支箭的著陸區域附近區域內的所有敵人造成與護甲相關的火焰傷害。
** 無論箭是否真正擊中目標（即使未擊中、偏離或被阻擋），爆炸都會發生。
** 多箭攻擊（雙重箭、雙箭、三重射擊和 燃燒之箭）將觸發每支箭的爆炸。
** 爆炸首先觸發的事實與 幸運逆轉 或 傷害反轉 等技能相關。
** 與 火箭 不同，箭頭的傷害型別不會轉換為火焰，因此：
*** 在不使用熾熱弓弦的情況下，僅憑此技能不足以使箭滿足召喚火焰額外傷害的條件。
*** 然而，爆炸的火焰傷害可以用來觸發對被 洛葛特的印記 施咒的敵人的燃燒，而無需使用熾熱的弓弦。 
*** 這也允許主箭攻擊受益於物理傷害觸發器，例如 吹拂之風、痛苦印記 或 荊棘，即使二次準備引起的爆炸造成火焰傷害。
** 爆炸本身並不是攻擊。增加攻擊傷害的效果（例如弓上的修飾符或烏山咆哮或“團結一致！”）不會增加傷害。然而，它透過 黑檀 榮譽戰旗而增加。

* This skill will cause maximum health degeneration at rank 14 and above.
* The healing effect scales to be ~50% of the hex's maximum damage potential. For example, at rank 12, the skill will inflict a maximum of 216 damage, healing 113 points when it ends.
* You can increase the duration of the hex, increasing the net damage without affecting the amount of healing:
** Using Mantra of Persistence. (+1/2/3 seconds at 0/8/11 Inspiration Magic, respectively)
** By re-applying the hex before it runs out. 
* Removing the hex early (e.g. via Cure Hex) will trigger the healing. Use a cover hex to prevent this.
* The healing caused by Illusion of Pain does not trigger Scourge Healing.
* The AI only uses this skill on targets whose health is below two thirds of maximum.

** 在六角形用完之前重新套用六角形。

* 苦痛幻覺 引起的治療不會觸發 災禍治癒。
* AI僅對生命值低於最大值三分之二的目標使用此技能。

* Be careful using this skill on heroes. * You do not lose health again if you recast this enchantment before the initial casting expires.
* A damage packet must reduce you to less than 25% maximum health without killing you for the enchantment to trigger.
* If you cast this skill as soon as you are resurrected you will not lose health due to temporary invulnerability.
Despite the skill descriptions, this skill heals rather than provide health gain.

b9710cb9728c374a4cfe5b64727c17f420a11845.source:
*The damage is done by the enchantment and not by the attack.
** Blindness, missing and blocking cannot prevent the damage from being inflicted.
** Flurry will increase attack speed without lowering the damage.
* Attacks are initiated but never hit:
** Effects that activate when an enemy is struck by an attack, such as Vampiric and Zealous mods and the early ending of Feigned Neutrality do not trigger.
** No adrenaline is gained from making an attack.
** Even if a skill description does not specifically mention that it triggers on hit, most attack buffs will not trigger, such as Strength of Honor, Warmonger's Weapon (and other on-attack weapon spells), or Soul Taker.
** When using the appropriate weapon type, Hundred Blades and Vow of Strength will trigger successfully.
** You cannot score a critical hit.
** Failed attacks such as Dagger Attacks out of sequence (such as using most Dual Attacks without an offhand) will not trigger damage.
** Dagger Attack chain marks will not trigger from attack skills.
*** Dagger attacks that require a chain can still be used if the appropriate marks are already present (from spells that count as lead attacks or off-hand attacks, or casting Illusionary Weaponry after setting up part of a chain). Notably, this allows dual attacks to be chained until the enemy dies.
*** When used with the correct chain requirements, dual attacks will double strike, but no additional effects will occur (e.g. Death Blossom will not hit multiple targets).
** Skills that require an attack (such as Empathy or Clumsiness) will still trigger.
** Attack from scythes and attack skills that can deal multiple attacks will cause the damage to be inflicted on several foes. Damage will trigger twice on a double strike.
* This is one of the few skills that can damage invulnerable foes (such as the Base Defender), though this requires an indirect attack such as Cyclone Axe.
* The main spell of an IW mesmer.
Similarly to "I Am Unstoppable!" and Mantra of Signets, the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the armor calculation. As such, it is not counted in the bonus armor cap of +25 and is not reduced by Armor penetration.
b9710cb9728c374a4cfe5b64727c17f420a11845.text:
*傷害是由結界造成的，而不是攻擊造成的。
** 盲目、缺失、阻擋都無法阻止傷害的發生。
** 疾風攻勢 將提高攻擊速度而不降低傷害。
* 攻擊已發動但從未命中：
** 當敵人受到攻擊時啟動的效果，例如 吸血鬼 和 熱望 mods 以及 陰影庇護 的提前結束不會觸發。
** 攻擊不會獲得腎上腺素。
** 即使技能描述沒有明確提及它會在擊中時觸發，大多數攻擊增益也不會觸發，例如 榮耀之力、好戰者武裝（以及其他攻擊武器法術）或 Soul Taker。
** 當使用適當的武器型別時，快速劍和力量誓約將成功觸發。
** 你無法獲得致命一擊。
** 失敗的攻擊，例如無序的匕首攻擊（例如在沒有副手的情況下使用大多數雙重攻擊）不會觸發傷害。
** 匕首攻擊鏈痕不會由攻擊技能觸發。
*** 如果已經存在適當的標記（來自算作引導攻擊或副手攻擊的法術，或者在設定部分鏈後施放 幻象武器），仍然可以使用需要鏈的匕首攻擊。值得注意的是，這允許雙重攻擊被連鎖，直到敵人死亡。
*** 當使用正確的連鎖要求時，雙重攻擊將雙重打擊，但不會發生額外效果（例如死神之花不會擊中多個目標）。
** 需要攻擊的技能（例如自虐或笨拙）仍然會觸發。
** 鐮刀和可造成多重攻擊的攻擊技能的攻擊會對多個敵人造成傷害。 傷害 在兩次打擊時將觸發兩次。
* 這是少數可以傷害無敵敵人的技能之一（例如基地 守護者之盾），儘管這需要間接攻擊，例如 旋風斧。
* IW催眠師的主要法術。
類似於「我勢不可擋！」而紋章頌歌，該技能提供的護甲僅在護甲運算結束時應用。因此，它不計入 +25 的額外護甲上限，也不會被 防禦穿透 減少。

* This skill can not steal monster-only enchantments (e.g. Demonic Agility); however, you still gain energy and Inspired Enchantment recharges instantly.
* It is possible to steal enchantments you need to maintain, such as Holy Veil. They will remain active with upkeep cost when Inspired Enchantment ends.
* Heroes will use the copied skill as they normally would do.
** Maintained enchantments that heroes would dismiss can be disabled to be maintained for the duration of the copy effect. When the copy effect ends the enchantment will be dropped as soon as the AI dictates it to (i.e. the hero is not in a situation where it would normally maintain the enchantment). Out of combat, Blessed Aura, Divine Boon and Unyielding Aura are the only maintained enchantments that the AI won't immediately dismiss.
405debb3fc3092e8d370f5cf5f3bfafc0557d548.text:

* 可以竊取您需要維護的結界，例如 神聖遮罩。當 靈感加持 結束時，它們將保持活躍並產生維護成本。
*英雄將像平常一樣使用複製的技能。
** 英雄會解除的維持結界可以被停用，以便在複製效果持續時間內維持。當複製效果結束時，一旦人工智慧指示，結界就會被丟棄（即英雄不處於通常會保持結界的情況）。在非戰鬥狀態下，祝福靈氣、神之恩賜 和 堅毅靈氣 是人工智慧不會立即消除的唯一保留的結界。

e51b93b4be5db84cff1ff5b398692c5ba56a42ac.source:
*This skill will increase the damage done by a minion, but not by an animal companion.
**A maxed (+4) Heroic Refrain increases the damage of a Level 20 Bone Fiend by around 13%.
*At 16 Leadership, this skill may be cast by the player character on themselves to raise their Leadership attribute to 19. This meets the threshold required for Heroic Refrain to provide a +4 boost to all attributes. 
**Another subsequent casting on the player will then also raise their Leadership attribute to 20, maximising energy gain from casting party wide shouts and chants.
* This skill only increases the primary profession's primary and secondary attributes and the secondary profession's secondary attributes. It doesn't increase other attributes, even those with a rank above 0 (for instance due to blessings, skills such as Seven Weapons Stance or "Of the (Profession)" modifiers).
e51b93b4be5db84cff1ff5b398692c5ba56a42ac.text:
*此技能會增加小兵造成的傷害，但不會增加動物夥伴的傷害。
**最大 (+4) 英雄副歌可使 20 級骨魔的傷害增加約 13%。
*在16 領導時，玩家角色可以對自己施放此技能，將其領導屬性提升至19。這滿足了 Heroic Refrain 為所有屬性提供 +4 提升所需的閾值。 
**隨後對玩家進行的另一次施法也會將他們的 領導 屬性提升至 20，從而最大限度地提高施法方廣泛呼喊和口號所獲得的能量。
* 此技能僅增加主職業的主副屬性和副職業的副屬性。它不會增加其他屬性，即使是那些等級高於 0 的屬性（例如由於祝福、七械態勢 或「（職業）」修飾符等技能）。

* It's advised to equip this skill in ranged-only teams, to avoid heroes walking into the frontline.

The PBAoE effect is centered around the caster, not the touched target.
Although you can target an ally with this skill (and will touch it), hexes will be removed from party members only, not even allies listed in the party window.
The touched target will not necessarily have a hex removed if it is not a party member, runs out of range during cast or if there are 2…4…5 hexed party members in the party window above the target.
The total number of hexes removed is 2…4…5.
90df629697d4d20ebe23530d57353e1a43dc750c.text:

雖然你可以用此技能瞄準盟友（並且會觸控它），但六角形只會從隊伍成員身上移除，甚至不會從隊伍視窗中列出的盟友身上移除。
如果觸控的目標不是隊伍成員、施法期間超出範圍或目標上方的隊伍視窗中有 2…4…5 十六進位的隊伍成員，則不一定會刪除十六進位。
刪除的六角形總數為 2…4…5。

51cf98e2472bd194a04ab7d8a0a6717af058b339.source:
*Intensity's area of effect damage triggers on one elemental damage packet done by a spell after Intensity is activated.
**The concise description is correct; untargeted spells such as Inferno can still trigger Intensity.
**High damage packets from spells such as Fireball, Rodgort's Invocation, Lightning Orb, Lightning Surge or Lightning Hammer are usually better to optimize intensity's effect. 
**Try to target foes with the lowest armor rating, typically casters and foes affected with Cracked Armor.
**Conjure spells do not trigger Intensity (nor does any non-spell source of damage, such as attacks, regardless of damage type).
*The damage ignores armor.
*This skill can be activated while moving or activating a skill; you can also use it after you cast the spell to be intensified if there is a delay between the end of the casting and the damage packet, e.g. Meteor Shower → Intensity.
*Outside of elementalist skills, high elemental damage is mostly found in Death Magic (Deathly Swarm and Icy Veins being of note), and Spawning Power/Channeling Magic (Rupture Soul, Spirit Rift and Destructive was Glaive being of note). Some PvE skills are also eligible, namely Snow Storm and (combined with other effects to convert it to elemental damage) Ebon Vanguard Sniper Support.

When sorting skills by campaign, this is listed under Core although it's a Nightfall skill.
51cf98e2472bd194a04ab7d8a0a6717af058b339.text:
*強度啟動後，法術造成的一個元素傷害包會觸發強度的效果傷害範圍。
**簡潔的描述是正確的；諸如 地獄火 之類的非目標法術仍然可以觸發強度。
**來自 火球、洛葛特的魔咒、閃電球、閃電震盪 或 閃電之鎚 等法術的高傷害資料包通常可以更好地最佳化強度效果。 
**嘗試瞄準裝甲等級最低的敵人，通常是施法者和受到 Cracked 防禦 影響的敵人。
**召喚法術不會觸發強度（任何非法術傷害來源也不會觸發，例如攻擊，無論傷害型別為何）。
*傷害忽略護甲。
*該技能可以在移動或發動技能時發動；如果施法結束和傷害包之間存在延遲，您也可以在施放要強化的法術後使用它，例如隕石雨 → 強度。
*除了元素技能之外，高元素傷害主要出現在死亡魔法（值得注意的是致命蟲群和冰冷紋理）和召喚/導引魔法（值得注意的是生靈迸裂、生靈裂縫和毀滅者葛雷薇）。一些 PvE 技能也符合資格，即暴風雪和（與其他效果結合將其轉換為元素傷害）黑檀 狙擊支援。

當以活動方式對技能進行排序時，它會列在 核心 下，儘管它是 黑暗逆襲 技能。

79c17e4e4cca4b5d8304a211fa10ede692f0cf8e.source:
The effects of this skill apply to all spells, regardless of target or attribute.
* It takes 6s to recover from 2 points of overcast. If you cast more than three spells while under the effect of this enchantment, you will not be able to completely recover from this skill's overcast during its recharge.
** If you are concerned about building up too much overcast, consider a lower attribute investment and shorter enchantment duration. Only use the spells that really need the reduced casting time and recharge time while enchanted by Iron Mist. Cast your other spells when this enchantment has worn off. Non-spell skills can be activated any time. Alternatively, use Soul Ignition to recover from Overcast.
* The overcast caused by this skill is not increased by Equinox, and not prevented by Glyph of Energy.
* The overcast caused by casting a spell is applied in time to trigger that spell’s additional effects.
79c17e4e4cca4b5d8304a211fa10ede692f0cf8e.text:
此技能的效果適用於所有法術，無論目標或屬性為何。
* 需要 6 才能從 2 陰天點復原。如果你在該結界的效果下施展了三個以上的法術，你將無法在充能期間完全從該技能的陰暗狀態中恢復。
** 如果您擔心建立過多的陰暗，請考慮較低的屬性投資和較短的結界持續時間。在 鐵之迷霧 附魔時，只使用真正需要減少施法時間和充能時間的法術。當這個結界消失後，施展你的其他咒語。非法術技能可以隨時啟動。或者，使用靈魂點燃從陰暗中恢復。
* 此技能造成的陰天不會被晝夜增加，也不會被能量符號阻止。
* 施展法術造成的陰霾會及時應用，以觸發此法術的附加效果。

5c9dce546f5d19e6e866ca00d80517e9482d6030.source:
* The effects of this spell occur when a minion dies. Thus, Shambling Horrors will produce two Jagged Horrors on death in total, Flesh Golems will still leave an exploitable corpse, Bone Minions can be used to create Jagged Horrors of a higher level than they were and finally, Jagged Horrors created by this skill may be recycled endlessly.
* The created Jagged Horror is bound to the previous minion's controller, not to the Jagged Bones' user.
** Jagged Horrors created by this enchantment will trigger Explosive Growth, Boon of Creation and Spirit's Gift if the previous minion's controller had one of those enchantments active.
** Minions created benefit from the controller's Spawning Power.
* Unless a minion is targeted, Jagged Bones will be cast on a random minion that is not already enchanted with Jagged Bones.
* The bleeding lasts for 25 seconds.
The descriptions do not mention the duration of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.
5c9dce546f5d19e6e866ca00d80517e9482d6030.text:
* 此法術的效果會在隨從死亡時發生。因此，蹣跚恐懼在死亡時總共會產生兩個鋸齒恐懼，血肉傀儡仍然會留下可利用的屍體，骨小兵可以用來創造比原來更高階別的鋸齒恐懼，最後，由該技能創造的鋸齒恐懼可以無限迴圈。
* 建立的鋸齒恐怖繫結到前一個小兵的控制器，而不是 鋸齒骸骨' 使用者。
** 如果前一個隨從的控制者啟動了其中一個結界，則此結界產生的鋸齒狀恐怖將觸發 爆發增長、創物者恩賜 和 生靈天賦。
** 建立的小小兵受益於控制器的 召喚。
* 除非小兵被定為目標，否則 鋸齒骸骨 將施放於尚未被 鋸齒骸骨 附魔的隨機小兵上。
* 出血持續 25 秒。
描述中沒有提及鋸齒恐怖造成的流血持續時間。

* Unlike Sundering Weapon, this skill causes bonus armor penetration, and stacks with Strength and armor penetrating attacks.
* The holy damage caused by this spell is not armor ignoring.
* Heroes do not know how to use this skill effectively. They will seemingly prioritize party members with melee weapons that are not yet enchanted with this spell, but can otherwise also cast this on party members who are not even attacking.
bb905ca8d040e35a1ad11a840eba56fe0ac40d13.text:

* 此法術造成的神聖傷害並非無視護甲。
* 英雄們不知道如何有效地使用這個技能。他們似乎會優先考慮擁有尚未被該法術附魔的近戰武器的隊伍成員，但也可以將其施放於甚至沒有攻擊的隊伍成員上。

42b7f8fb27d1d9204672c4fb431f5e06ddb4f910.source:
* The triggering damage is calculated before damage reduction, so a 55 Monk enchanted with Protective Spirit and Judge's Intervention could be dealt 60 damage, have that reduced to 5 damage, and still trigger Judge's Intervention.

* Combines well with minions, but will not trigger if they die due to their natural health degeneration.
* This skill can cause the highest armor-ignoring damage in one packet amongst all player-useable skills; however, Grenth's Balance can potentially cause a foe to lose more health.
Unlike most other monk spells, Judge's Intervention does not invoke an animation upon the target.
{{Outdated info|}}
;February 05, 2019 update; please verify changes to AI behavior.
* Heroes will use it on allies who have low health and are not in combat, such as minions when travelling between mobs.
42b7f8fb27d1d9204672c4fb431f5e06ddb4f910.text:
* 觸發傷害是在傷害減免之前計算的，因此附魔了 精神守護 和 審判干涉 的 55 僧侶 可能會造成 60 傷害，減至 5 傷害，但仍會觸發 審判干涉。

* 與小兵配合良好，但如果他們因自然健康退化而死亡，則不會觸發。
* 此技能在所有玩家可用技能中可以造成最高的一包無視護甲傷害；然而，古蘭斯的平衡 可能會導致敵人失去更多生命值。
與大多數其他武僧法術不同，審判干涉 不會對目標呼叫動畫。
{{過時的資訊|}}
；2月05、2019更新；請驗證 AI 行為的變更。

bf63edbf8018566f813969e44f4cb35e0d4db74c.source:
* Judgment Strike is a single attack that can hit multiple foes.
** When wielding a scythe, each target will only be hit once.
* The foes hit by this skill are those adjacent to the user, not the target.
** This attack will fail to hit kiting opponents, including the target, if they have moved away by the time the attack would have connected.
* The damage type of the base attack is converted to armor-respecting holy damage for this attack, resulting in double damage to undead but voiding any damage boost from skills such as Conjure Frost.
bf63edbf8018566f813969e44f4cb35e0d4db74c.text:

** 如果風箏對手（包括目標）在攻擊連線時已經離開，則此攻擊將無法擊中。
* 基本攻擊的傷害型別將轉換為此攻擊的護甲神聖傷害，對不死生物造成雙倍傷害，但使 召喚冰霜 等技能的任何傷害提升無效。

7cbd6a4002229bbc3f8694072743ed7c43bdb6af.source:
* This skill only recharges Resurrection Signet or Sunspear Rebirth Signet if they were disabled by another skill (e.g. by Distracting Shot); it will not recharge them if they were used to resurrect.
* Combines well with Symbolic Posture or Mantra of Inscriptions.
* Since this skill can and will recharge all signets, including those without any investment in their attribute, consider using Symbolic Celerity to cast your signets based on your current rank in Fast Casting only.
* Other signets' bonus effects apply before the interrupt caused by Keystone.
* Gao Han of the Rings is an ally, but getting him killed by enemies during the Redemption for the Lost quest allows you to capture the skill.

Some non-English descriptions incorrectly expand the area of effect beyond adjacent foes: the French full description adds nearby foes and the German concise description adds the target.

At ranks 0-1 Fast Casting, all signets activated within the duration will deal damage and interrupt foes.
7cbd6a4002229bbc3f8694072743ed7c43bdb6af.text:
* 此技能僅在 復活紋章 或陽矛 重生 紋章 被其他技能（例如 震暈之箭）停用時才對其進行充能；如果它們被用來復活，它不會為它們充電。
* 與 紋章姿態 或 碑銘頌歌 完美結合。
* 由於此技能可以並且將為所有印章充能，包括那些沒有對其屬性進行任何投資的印章，因此請考慮使用 迅捷標誌 僅根據您在 快速施法 中的當前排名來施放您的印章。
* 其他圖章的加成效果在梯形失真校正造成的中斷前適用。
* 魔戒高瀚是盟友，但在救贖失落者任務中讓他被敵人殺死可以讓你獲得該技能。

一些非英語描述錯誤地將影響範圍擴大到相鄰敵人之外：法語完整描述添加了附近的敵人，而德語簡明描述則添加了目標。

在等級 0-1 快速施法 中，在持續時間內啟動的所有印章都會造成傷害並打斷敵人。

* This skill can be used to effectively replace fiery bowstring, and synergizes with Conjure Flame and/or Mark of Rodgort fire damage requirement.
** This allows you to use to use Zealous or Vampiric bowstrings along with fire damage on a bow, which is an important benefit for buiilds focusing in attack skills that can deal multiple attacks.
** However, beware that the skill's damage type change will also stop physical damage triggers such as Winnowing, Mark of Pain or Barbs from working when the effect is active.
* The additional fire damage from this skill is affected by armor rating and dealt separately from the arrow damage.
7b8fe5cbd446b83af3ee5ed0f2cdc78d60d0ffe1.text:

** 這允許您使用 熱望 或 吸血鬼 弓弦以及弓上的火焰傷害，這對於專注於可以造成多次攻擊的攻擊技能的建築來說是一個重要的好處。
** 但是，請注意，此技能的傷害型別變更也會在效果啟動時停止物理傷害觸發器（例如 吹拂之風、痛苦印記 或 荊棘）的工作。
* 此技能的額外火焰傷害受護甲等級影響，與箭矢傷害分開處理。

* This skill creates a Spirit of Laceration.
* Renew the spirit when foes are under 90% health in order to get both the bleeding condition and the health degeneration.
**Alternatively, destroy the spirit before renewing it with skills such as Spirit to Flesh or Feast of Souls to ensure your allies won't be affected.
**Using this you can maintain both effects on a large number of foes at 10 beast mastery
5a89106ffaedc23e18dd0cda2fb13ad638b0f376.text:

65c4f9576b5b8ecafd1d2600ae0f8eae5ebc4977.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Life.
* This spirit heals 120-180 health throughout its lifespan with 12 ranks (or higher) in Restoration Magic.
** Effective when used with skills which reduces skill recharge time and/or destroys spirits to control the healing spike.
** Life will heal for 60-90 health if refreshed every 10 seconds upon recharge (with Ritual Lord).
* This spirit will also heal allied NPCs and members of allied parties, making it effective in large or multi party missions, especially with multiple minion masters since it also heals any allied minions.
This skill will create a spirit with an offensive appearance.
65c4f9576b5b8ecafd1d2600ae0f8eae5ebc4977.text:
* 此技能創造出生命的精神。
* 這種精神在其整個生命週期中治癒 120-180 健康，並在 復原魔法 中達到 12 等級（或更高）。

a8686888a94c089a17c0dbf3d4cf15d49d577151.source:
* The skill and the Hidden Treasures are commonly referred to as LoD.
* This skill is required to spawn the Silver Vaettir.


;Hidden Objects
* Hidden objects can only be found in dungeons.
** There are no hidden objects in Fronis Irontoe's Lair, Slavers' Exile, or in any underground instance entered as part of a primary quest.
* Using the skill will expose any nearby hidden objects; any remaining ones within compass range will ping yellow on the compass and be marked by a green shimmer over its location.
** A yellow ping does not sound for the objects already shimmering.
** The shimmer remains for a short period of time.
* Hidden objects include:
** Ghostly allies, i.e. a level 24 Dwarven Ghost.
** Hidden Treasures.
** Secret passages, such as the wall in the first level of Raven's Point that crumbles once the players are in front of it.
** Switches that open doors.
a8686888a94c089a17c0dbf3d4cf15d49d577151.text:
* 技能和隱藏寶藏通常稱為 LoD。
* 需要此技能才能產生 Silver Vaettir。


;隱藏物體
* 隱藏物品只能在地牢中找到。
** 鐵趾 佛朗尼的巢穴、奴隸商人放逐地 或作為主要任務的一部分輸入的任何地下例項中沒有隱藏物體。
* 使用該技能會暴露附近所有隱藏的物體；指南針範圍內的任何剩餘物體都會在指南針上發出黃色提示，並在其位置上標記出綠色閃光。
** 對於已經閃爍的物體，不會發出黃色提示音。
** 閃光會持續很短一段時間。
* 隱藏的物件包括：
** 幽靈盟友，即 24 等級的矮人幽靈。
** 隱藏的寶藏。
** 秘密通道，例如 渡鴉岬角 第一層中的牆，一旦玩家走到它前面就會崩潰。
** 開啟門的開關。

* Heroes do not use this skill on non-attacking foes.
* Lightning Javelin and Spear of Lightning are the only two skills that uses this line-shaped area of effect.
** The projectile is identical to a staff's attack, and follows a high arc, similar to that of a flatbow.
** The projectile strikes foes adjacent to the target, and all foes adjacent to the projectile's flight-path originating from the caster.
** The projectile seemingly acknowledges "facing", as it does not affect "flanking" adjacent foes' immediate position to the caster's "left/right sides and rear", when facing relative to the target; despite the area of effect being centered on the caster.
** If the target foe evades towards the spell caster and the projectile misses far, the targeted foe will not receive any damage even if they are still in the projectiles flight path. This is commonly seen using lightning javelin to engage a fight with npcs.
** If the target is line of sight obstructed, the other foes in the aoe will still be struck even if they too would normally be obstructed.
5cafdba16ccf3bd454100204123c026c077279fd.text:

** 彈體與法杖的攻擊相同，並遵循高弧線，類似於平弓。
** 彈體會攻擊目標附近的敵人，以及來自施法者的彈體飛行路徑附近的所有敵人。
** 彈體似乎承認“面對”，因為當相對於目標面對時，它不會影響施法者“左/右側和後方”的“側翼”相鄰敵人的直接位置；儘管效果區域以施法者為中心。

** 如果目標視線被阻擋，範圍內的其他敵人仍然會被擊中，即使他們通常也會被阻擋。

* There is a 3 second delay between dropping the ashes and resurrection.
* If you are holding this when you die, you drop it and are resurrected.
* Your team will wipe in PvE and still lose an annihilation round even if your last remaining party member is holding the ashes after being killed.
* This skill cannot be cast while under effect of Frozen Soil. The ashes, however, will successfully resurrect party members if dropped while in range of a Frozen Soil spirit.
** Combine with Frozen Soil to prevent enemy resurrection while enabling it for your own party.
* This skill has a distinctive caster aura at the end of casting and a distinctive urn graphic.
90cb8df772f2430f172221e5342618b8384e0ddd.text:
* 掉落骨灰和復活之間有 3 秒的延遲。
* 如果你死時拿著這個，你會丟掉它並復活。
* 即使你最後剩下的隊員在被殺後持有骨灰，你的隊伍也會在 PvE 中被消滅，並且仍然會輸掉一輪殲滅戰。
* 此技能在 凍土 效果下無法施放。然而，如果在 凍土 精魂的範圍內掉落的話，骨灰將成功復活隊員。
** 與 凍土 結合，防止敵人復活，同時為自己的隊伍啟用它。
* 此技能在施法結束時具有獨特的施法者光環和獨特的甕圖形。

* The spell requires the target to leave an exploitable corpse; but does not exploit the corpse.
* Healing modifiers stack multiplicatively. Combining with Deep Wound or Lingering Curse will amount to -36% healing.
* Verata's Gaze can be used to gain control of the masterless Bone Horror.
** Alternatively, if you do not intend to take control of the minion, Swap can be used to shadow step it away from your team (preferably in the opposing team). It also provides a suitable target to trigger the bonus effects of Holy Spear.
* Heroes tend to spam this skill regardless of whether the target or enemy group has healing skills, leading to several extra Bone Horrors per fight.
* Since the Bone Horror is created masterless, it will not trigger skills that depend on summoned creature creation such as Boon of Creation. It also does not gain extra max health from Spawning Power. 

Cannot be used on non-fleshy targets.
a95597d1093fc019b94f638f9c3c10a2d3366248.text:
* 此法術要求目標留下一具可利用的屍體；但不利用屍體。
* 治療效果乘數疊加。與 重傷 或 強力詛咒 結合將達到 -36% 療癒效果。
* 芙瑞達的凝視 可用來控制無主的 Bone Horror。
** 或者，如果您不打算控制該隨從，則可以使用 交替 將其從您的團隊（最好是在對方團隊中）移開。它還提供了一個合適的目標來觸發Holy 矛的額外效果。
* 無論目標或敵人群體是否具有治療技能，英雄都傾向於垃圾郵件此技能，從而導致每場戰鬥產生一些額外的骨頭恐怖。
* 由於骨頭恐怖是無主創造的，它不會觸發依賴召喚生物創造的技能，例如 創物者恩賜。它也不會從 召喚 獲得額外的最大生命值。

256921a3ddf2cd79f5d5dc6c5e2d48a30358b084.source:
* This skill overrides any existing modifiers, including: skills that boost elemental attributes (e.g. Elemental Lord), runes, Weakness and consumables (e.g. Candy Corn).
** Bonuses will take effect if they are applied after Master of Magic (e.g. remove/reapply headgear before casting).
***Removing and reapplying runes has no effect.
** Renewing Master of Magic whilst under the attribute boosting modifiers will retain the higher attribute ranks and not reset them to the rank predicted by Master of Magic.
** Renewing Master of Magic while boosted by Heroic Refrain will cause the boost to not be renewed even if the echo is renewed. Recast Heroic Refrain immediately after renewing Master of Magic.
* Journey to the North takes precedence, setting only one attribute to 12 (and any others to 9). [Source claim needs verification]
* The most effective uses of this skill are:
** To boost the effectiveness of low-level characters, since it can allow them to reach and maintain an elemental attribute rank of 9 at only rank 3 in Energy Storage. 
** To maximize the strength of Prismatic Insignia (raising an elementalist's armor by 20).
** To free attribute points for builds that draw on several elementalist attributes or to meet the requirement of certain weapons (notably shields).
* The amount of energy regained is rounded down: 5 energy spells return 1 energy, 15 energy spells return 4 and 25 energy spells return 7.
* The amount of energy regained considers only the base cost of the spells, without any modifiers, such as Glyph of Lesser Energy or Quickening Zephyr.
* Elemental spells refers to spells associated with the four elemental attributes, rather than spells that deal elemental damage.
While under the effects of Master of Magic, being weakened with attribute points in elemental ranks will cause elemental ranks to lower by 1. Elemental attributes without attribute points in will not lower by 1.
256921a3ddf2cd79f5d5dc6c5e2d48a30358b084.text:
* 此技能會涵蓋任何現有的修飾符，包括：提升元素屬性的技能（例如 元素生物 Lord）、符文、虛弱 和消耗品（例如 栗米糖）。
** 如果在 魔法大師 之後應用，獎勵將生效（例如，在施法前移除/重新戴上頭盔）。
***移除並重新套用符文沒有效果。
** 在屬性提升修改器下更新 魔法大師 將保留較高的屬性等級，並且不會將其重設為 魔法大師 預測的等級。
** 在英雄副歌增強的同時更新 魔法大師 將導致即使迴聲更新也不會更新增強效果。更新 魔法大師 後立即重鑄英雄副歌。
* 北遊記優先，僅將一個屬性設為 12（將任何其他屬性設為 9）。 [來源宣告需要驗證]
* 此技能最有效的用途是：
** 提高低等級角色的效率，因為它可以讓他們在能量儲存中僅達到並保持9的元素屬性等級，而僅達到3的等級。 
** 最大化稜柱 徽記 的強度（透過 20 提升元素師的護甲）。
** 為利用多種元素屬性的建構釋放屬性點或滿足某些武器（尤其是盾牌）的要求。
* 恢復的能量量向下捨去：5 能量法術回傳 1 能量，15 能量法術回傳 4，25 能量法術回到 7。
* 恢復的能量量只考慮法術的基本成本，沒有任何修飾符，例如 微能符號 或 活力微風。
* 元素生物法術是指與四種元素屬性相關的法術，而非造成元素傷害的法術。
在魔法大師的影響下，元素等級屬性點被削弱，會導致元素等級降低1。沒有屬性點的元素生物屬性不會因為1而降低。

* Although there is immediate visual indication of rocks hitting the ground, the first damage and knock down event does not occur until 3 seconds after the spell has been cast.
** Since the earliest knock down occurs after the first 3 seconds, it is recommended that foes are snared when the spell is cast.
* If knock down length is increased to 3 seconds (from Earthbind or a Stonefist Insignia), then foes will either be knocked down two times with a 3 second delay, two times with a perfect quarterknock, or three times with two perfect quarterknocks.
* This is one of the few spells that makes full use of Glyph of Energy.
* Be wary of foes using this skill against your party, especially if it is composed of mostly henchmen and heroes, as they will all stand in approximately the range of the attack (unless you order them to move), devastating your party.
286404576236102956b797ff3665f5f728227115.text:
* 雖然立即有岩石撞擊地面的視覺指示，但直到施法後 3 秒後才會發生第一次傷害和擊倒事件。
** 由於最早的擊倒發生在第一個 3 秒之後，因此建議在施放該法術時將敵人困住。
* 如果擊倒長度增加到 3 秒（從 地縛 或 石拳徽記），那麼敵人將被 3 秒延遲擊倒兩次，完美四分之一敲擊兩次，或兩次完美四分之一敲擊三次。
* 這是少數充分利用 能量符號 的法術之一。
* 警惕使用此技能對付你的隊伍的敵人，特別是當它主要由追隨者和英雄組成時，因為他們都會站在大約攻擊範圍內（除非你命令他們移動），從而摧毀你的隊伍。

e100ae9d6748e5497e05be28ea3eeded167b08a2.source:
With skills that remove "all enchantments" (such as Contemplation of Purity), the only Dervish enchantments this skill's damage can trigger for are Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and Mirage Cloak itself. By contrast, there is no restriction on which Dervish enchantments will trigger damage if a specific number of enchantments is removed (such as by Rend Enchantments or Dervish teardowns), as long as they cover Mirage Cloak (plus Mirage Cloak itself).
*This skill triggers itself when it ends.
*Pious Renewal synergizes with this skill because of its "recharge on end" effect.
The concise description omits that block chance is capped to 80%.
e100ae9d6748e5497e05be28ea3eeded167b08a2.text:
對於移除「所有結界」的技能（例如 純淨的冥想），此技能的傷害可以觸發的唯一 神喚使 結界是 荊棘靈氣、巴薩澤盛怒、神性修補、塵土掩蔽、驚天神力、古蘭斯之指 和 魔幻掩蔽 本身。相較之下，如果移除特定數量的結界（例如透過 粉碎加持 或 神喚使 拆卸），哪些 神喚使 結界將觸發傷害則沒有限制，只要它們覆蓋 魔幻掩蔽（加上 魔幻掩蔽 本身）即可。
*該技能結束時會自行觸發。
*神性修補 由於其「結束充電」效果而與此技能產生協同作用。
簡潔的描述省略了阻止機會上限為 80%。

* As with any doublecast skill, NPCs will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's area of effect range of an ally.
* Foes suffer two damage packets if the caster is targeted; the skill also recharges 50% faster (in effect, the second packet hits a hexed target, triggering the effect).
* As this is a Hex Spell that can target an ally, Holy Veil will double this skill's casting time when it is used on a target enchanted with it, despite the fact that this ally will not be hexed.
06541027421a9675aa53f04b560842f1fb89a7c2.text:
* 與任何雙施技能一樣，只要盟友的法術效果範圍內有敵人，NPC 就會使用該技能。
* 如果施法者成為目標，敵人會受到兩次傷害；該技能還可以更快地為 50% 充電（實際上，第二個資料包擊中了十六進位制目標，從而觸發了該效果）。
* 由於這是一個可以以盟友為目標的 降咒魔法，因此 神聖遮罩 在對已附魔的目標使用該技能時，其施法時間會加倍，儘管該盟友不會被施咒。

8e9b86cef6be5e7e41bc8458d7dcd08cdf4bd3de.source:
* The copied stance uses the foe's attribute rank, so you get the same benefit.
* Stances are copied when the foe enters them while hexed; if multiple foes are hexed, you gain the most recently used one.
** However, it cannot copy monster skills, such as Turtle Shell or Battle Scars.
** Some stances can backfire on you, e.g. Frenzy or Primal Rage.
If the copied stance has an initial effect, the initial effect will not affect you. I.e. Bestial Fury/Tiger's Fury, Deadly Paradox, and Shadow Walk will not disable your skills; Shadow Walk will also not cause you to shadow step to a foe.
8e9b86cef6be5e7e41bc8458d7dcd08cdf4bd3de.text:
* 複製的姿勢使用敵人的屬性等級，因此您可以獲得相同的好處。
* 當敵人在施咒時進入姿態時，姿態會被複製；如果多個敵人被施咒，您將獲得最近使用過的一個。
** 但是，它不能複製怪物技能，例如海龜 外殼 或戰痕。
** 有些立場可能適得其反，例如狂暴 或 盛怒。
如果複製的姿勢有初始效果，則初始效果不會對你產生影響。 IE。 獸性之怒/虎之怒、暗殺者之舞 和 暗影微步 不會停用您的技能； 暗影微步 也不會導致你對敵人進行暗影步。

*This spell's animation is similar to those of some Paragon skills like "Fall Back!" and Focused Anger, as well as the Ritualist skill Destructive Was Glaive.
*This hex works slightly different depending on whether or not the target is casting an enemy-targeting spell when this hex is first applied to them. If not, the effect will immediately trigger the next time the target tries to cast an enemy-targeting spell. If so, the effect will trigger upon the enemy-targeting spell finishing its activation (if the hex remains on them). 
*Note that since only directly enemy-targeting spells will be affected self-centered spells such as Shockwave will be unaffected. 

Mistrust will take effect if the hexed character attempts to cast a spell on any NPC hostile to them, including other foes. For example, in Varajar Fells, an Ice Imp's Maelstrom will fail if they attempt to cast it on a Modniir Hunter.
65d94608180896c633c4cae4077179c5f0f1d4f0.text:

*請注意，由於只有直接以敵人為目標的法術才會受到影響，因此以自我為中心的法術（例如 衝擊波）將不受影響。 

如果被施咒的角色試圖對任何與他們敵對的 NPC（包括其他敵人）施展法術，疑惑 就會生效。例如，在 維拉戛陣地 中，如果 冰小惡魔 的 水漩渦 嘗試將其投射到 莫得米獵人 上，則會失敗。

* The amount of life stolen is not affected by the amount of damage you would have dealt.
** As a result, consider using this skill on allies that deal the least amount of attack damage if you want to minimize Nightmare Weapon's damage reduction. 
* Every hit is counted, but misses are not. For example, if a Barrage attack successfully strikes two foes, but misses four others, Nightmare Weapon would only lose two charges.
* Consider using with Dual Shot (commonly used in conjunction with Distracting Shot) and particularly Triple Shot for a spike.
ff5851889dcf5a5bca0038aa358eeb0102b791e3.text:

** 因此，如果您想最大限度地減少 夢魘武裝 的傷害減免，請考慮對造成最少攻擊傷害的盟友使用此技能。

* This skill only recharges Resurrection Signet, Sunspear Rebirth Signet or Celestial skills if they were disabled by another skill (e.g. by Distracting Shot); it will not recharge them if they were used successfully.
* This skill is sometimes used by trappers, as it allows them to plant another set of traps or nature rituals without waiting out the long recharge time.
* Combine with Determined Shot, which recharges all your attack skills if it fails to hit. This can be used to rapidly recharge Oath Shot.
** This tactic can be extended with Shadow Sanctuary, which almost guarantees a miss.
** Add "Dodge This!" or Asuran Scan to the skill chain to ensure that Oath Shot hits through block and/or blind, bear in mind it will still have a 50% chance to miss when below 8 Expertise.
* The 50% miss chance is actually a 50% fail chance and cannot be prevented with effects such as Asuran Scan. Oath Shot will still go into recharge, unlike in regular attack skill failure.
2512b102a3323c2c2131fcb87c95b8627f4bb18e.text:
* 此技能僅在 復活紋章、陽矛 重生、紋章 或天界技能被其他技能（例如 震暈之箭）停用時才對其進行充能；如果使用成功，則不會為其充電。
* 捕獸者有時會使用此技能，因為它允許他們設定另一組陷阱或自然儀式，而無需等待漫長的充電時間。
* 與決心之箭結合使用，如果沒有擊中，它會為你的所有攻擊技能充電。這可用於快速為 誓言之箭 充電。
** 這個戰術可以用 闇影 Sanctuary 來擴充套件，這幾乎肯定會失敗。
** 加上「閃避 這個！」或阿蘇蘭 掃描技能鏈以確保 誓言之箭 擊穿格擋和/或盲區，請記住，當低於 8 專精 時，它仍然有 50% 機會錯過。
* 50% 錯失機會其實是 50% 失敗機會，無法透過阿蘇蘭掃描等效果來阻止。 誓言之箭 仍會進入充能狀態，這與普通攻擊技能失敗不同。

0cda2de386859f37ee6f3ac8d2aba826628d5851.source:
===Order of damage modifiers===
See: Order of damage modifiers
* Pain Inverter follows these general rules:
:* Damage dealt to the hexed foe is calculated before damage reduction effects such as Protective Spirit, but after the damage reduction from Armor of Salvation.
:* Does not apply to life draining skills such as Vampiric Bite.
:* Does not apply to Duncan's Defense or Shield of Fire.
:* Applies to passive damage skills such as Empathy, Backfire, or Clumsiness.
:* Applies to traps that cause direct damage, such as Spike Trap.
:* Applies to retaliation-based damage skills, e.g. Whirling Defense, Retribution, or Holy Wrath.

* The base damage is capped at 80, but there is no limit on total damage. Pain Inverter can deal more than 80 damage by using damage modifying skills, including Frenzy and the Lightbringer title.

===Game mechanics===
* Pain Inverter triggers multiple times if the hexed foe hits multiple targets; each time a creature is hit, the skill produces a separate packet of damage, each of which is capped at 80. This makes PI especially effective in these situations: 
:* Against high-damage area of effect (AoE) spells (base damage is capped at 80 per affected ally) — examples: Searing Flames and Earthquake.
:* Against damage over time (DoT) spells (base damage is capped at 80 per pulse) — examples: Searing Heat and Fire Storm. 
:* Against high-armor foes, especially bosses, since the damage ignores armor.
:* Against blocking skills that deal damage to attackers — examples: Whirling Defense, Flashing Blades, and Gladiator's Defense
:* Against foes using skills that generate extra packets of damage on attack — example: Ignite Arrows.

* An obvious way to take advantage of PI's mechanics is to provide the target with lots of fodder for AoE and DoT skills, e.g. by bringing minions, spirits, Asura Summons, Summoning Stones and/or animal companions.
0cda2de386859f37ee6f3ac8d2aba826628d5851.text:
===傷害調整值的順序===
請參閱：傷害修正值的順序
* 苦痛 逆變器遵循以下一般規則：
:* 對被詛咒的敵人造成的 傷害 是在 精神守護 等傷害減免效果之前計算的，但在救贖的 防禦 的傷害減免之後計算。
：* 不適用於消耗生命的技能，例如 吸血之咬。
：* 不適用於 Duncan's Defense 或 盾 of Fire。
:* 適用於被動傷害技能，例如 自虐、魔力反噬 或 笨拙。
:* 適用於造成直接傷害的陷阱，例如 尖刺陷阱。
:* 適用於基於報復的傷害技能，例如旋風防禦、天譴 或 神威。

* 基礎傷害上限為 80，但總傷害沒有限制。 苦痛 變頻器可以透過使用傷害修正技能（包括 狂暴 和光明使者稱號）造成比 80 更高的傷害。

===遊戲機制===
* 苦痛 如果被施咒的敵人擊中多個目標，逆變器會觸發多次；每次擊中生物時，技能都會產生一組單獨的傷害，每個傷害的上限為 80。這使得 PI 在以下情況下特別有效：
：*對抗高傷害範圍（範圍性）法術（每個受影響盟友的基礎傷害上限為80） - 例如：爆裂火焰和地震。
：* 針對持續傷害 (DoT) 法術（每個脈衝的基礎傷害上限為 80） — 例如：灼熱氣息 和 火焰風暴。 
：* 針對高護甲敵人，尤其是 Boss，因為傷害忽略護甲。
:* 對抗對攻擊者造成傷害的格擋技能 - 範例：旋風防禦、閃光劍刃 和 鬥士防禦態勢
：* 對抗使用在攻擊時產生額外傷害包的技能的敵人 - 例如：爆烈箭。

* 利用 PI 機制的一個明顯方法是為目標提供大量 範圍性 和 DoT 技能的素材，例如透過攜帶小兵、靈魂、阿蘇拉 召喚物、召喚石和/或動物夥伴。
0cda2de386859f37ee6f3ac8d2aba826628d5851.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

69633b8ce5760cd209b780cd7d96415842370d2e.source:
* The projectile's arc is much higher than similar spells like Fireball.
* This spell will not fail if the target dies during its casting.
* The healing does not affect allied spirits.
* Useful when playing alongside a Minion Master or close combat professions, as they will benefit from the healing reliably if they're targeting the same enemy.
69633b8ce5760cd209b780cd7d96415842370d2e.text:
* 彈體的弧度遠高於火球等類似法術。
* 若目標在施法過程中死亡，該法術不會失敗。
* 治療效果不會影響盟友的靈魂。
* 與小兵大師或近戰職業一起玩時很有用，因為如果他們瞄準同一個敵人，他們將受益於可靠的治療。

748acbdf4fd93d2fe8e80fd1804dbb8f03b38e59.source:
* In PvP, most physical damage characters carry an elemental damage weapon for use against Warriors (who often have less armor against elemental damage). This stance can be quite dangerous to use since, upon seeing it used, attackers can simply swap weapons.
* This skill is often used by Warriors when farming in the Underworld.
Similar to Cracked Armor, this skill will not lower your armor rating below 60 or your "core" armor rating, if your "core" armor rating is lower than 60.
If you use a skill or combination of skills and effects that, after subtraction of the penalty from Physical Resistance, still grants +26 or more armor rating against elemental damage, Physical Resistance's armor penalty does not function. See also armor calculation.
748acbdf4fd93d2fe8e80fd1804dbb8f03b38e59.text:
* 在 PvP 中，大多數物理傷害角色都攜帶元素傷害武器，用於對抗戰士（他們通常擁有較少的防禦元素傷害的護甲）。使用這種姿勢可能非常危險，因為一旦看到它被使用，攻擊者就可以簡單地交換武器。
* 這個技能是戰士在地獄耕種時常使用的。
與破解防禦類似，如果你的「核心」護甲等級低於60，該技能不會將你的護甲等級降低到60以下或你的「核心」護甲等級。
如果你使用的技能或技能和效果的組合，在減去物理抵抗的懲罰後，仍然獲得+26或更高的針對元素傷害的護甲等級，則物理抵抗的護甲懲罰不起作用。另請參見護甲計算。

5232f14d7607b9745a5056c59088b31fd598131f.source:
*There are no traps, nor any ranger skills, that apply cracked armor.
**Therefore, consider selectively laying Piercing Trap next to a foe that has just received cracked armor, either from a secondary profession skill or a fellow party member.
*Damage is dealt in two packets. First the trap is triggered and deals unconditional damage, then the second packet is dealt only to enemies who have cracked armor. If an enemy is in a Well of Ruin when the trap is triggered, the initial damage will inflict cracked armor, causing the bonus damage to trigger as well.
5232f14d7607b9745a5056c59088b31fd598131f.text:
*沒有陷阱，也沒有任何遊俠技能，會應用破裂的盔甲。
**因此，請考慮有選擇地將穿刺 陷阱 放置在剛從次要職業技能或其他黨員那裡獲得裂紋盔甲的敵人旁邊。
*傷害 分為兩個資料包。首先陷阱被觸發並造成無條件傷害，然後第二個資料包僅對裝甲破裂的敵人造成。如果觸發陷阱時敵人位於毀滅之井中，則初始傷害將造成護甲破裂，同時觸發額外傷害。

If your Mysticism is at 0, the skill will still remove an enchantment but only give 25% move speed instead of 50%.
* Pious Haste's conditional speed boost is enough to allow a character to pass through and trigger a trap without being affected.
* This skill increases average speed by 4.17...25...29.17% if used while enchanted with a Dervish enchantment every time it recharges.
** This stance can be maintained indefinitely under Dwarven Stability.
* Consider combining with Zealous Renewal.
67d59e4346ebec0f6168b7cad2f5206a6e5576df.text:
如果您的 秘法 位於 0，技能仍會移除結界，但僅提供 25% 移動速度，而非 50%。
* 神性迅速 的條件速度提升足以讓角色通過並觸發陷阱而不受影響。
* 如果每次充能時被 神喚使 結界附魔時使用此技能，則平均速度會提升 4.17...25...29.17%。
** 在矮人穩定狀態下，該姿態可以無限期地保持。
* 考慮與 狂熱復原 結合使用。

c306c014af2e58704aab06879361b5802aa3f054.text:

641ca94e35f92c0af7350a062498ef013e4d3b6c.source:
* Use Epidemic to spread the conditions from the target to adjacent targets.
* Synergy with skills which inflict conditions on oneself, especially those that draw conditions from allies to you, such as Foul Feast, Draw Conditions and Verata's Sacrifice.
* Primary PvP-only Necromancers will be able to use this skill, even if it is not unlocked on your account.
* The AI will not prioritize fleshy targets when using this skill to transfer bleeding (for instance using it on minions even if their master is in range).
641ca94e35f92c0af7350a062498ef013e4d3b6c.text:
* 使用 病症擴散 將條件從目標傳播到相鄰目標。
* 與為自己帶來條件的技能協同作用，特別是那些為你的盟友帶來條件的技能，例如「汙穢盛宴」、「狀態吸收」和「芙瑞達的犧牲」。
* 初級 PvP 死靈法師將能夠使用此技能，即使您的帳戶未解鎖該技能。
* 當使用此技能轉移流血時，AI不會優先考慮肉質目標（例如對小兵使用它，即使他們的主人在範圍內）。

* This is a skill, not a spell, and is therefore unaffected by Dazed.
d1204e19479b7b88b531fa1550968697fa86dd74.text:

* 這是一項技能，而不是咒語，因此不受 暈眩 的影響。

*Apply Poison allows to spread poison more often and more importantly without taking the elite slot. Bring Poison Arrow only if you are planning on using another preparation.
* Poison Arrow and Quick Shot are tied for the lowest recharge of bow attack skills that don't remove a preparation, making them potentially effective to trigger the effects of anthems, songs and damage from Expert Focus.
4c941ea3ff6548a1638452381fcc4486a5f11881.text:
*塗毒 允許更頻繁、更重要地傳播毒藥，而無需佔用精英槽。僅當您打算使用其他製劑時才攜帶 毒箭。
* 毒箭 和 風速之箭 與弓箭攻擊技能的最低充能相關，不會移除準備工作，使其可能有效觸發專家 聚能器 的國歌、歌曲和傷害效果。

9d205674b6c56a4e44ebb79b70bfd75afb368e42.source:
* Only affects the nearest target when an attack hits multiple foes, e.g. using Barrage or with a Scythe.
* Unlike Nightmare Weapon, the unsuccessful attack (e.g. missed or obstructed) is counted and discharges the skill effect.
* The condition is applied after the strike, making it valuable as a cover condition for skills that apply more valuable conditions such as Cripple or Daze.
9d205674b6c56a4e44ebb79b70bfd75afb368e42.text:
* 當攻擊擊中多個敵人時，隻影響最近的目標，例如使用 齊射 或 鐮刀。
* 與夢魘武裝不同，不成功的攻擊（例如未擊中或受阻）會被計數並釋放技能效果。
* 此條件在攻擊後應用，使其成為應用更有價值條件（例如「跛行」或「發呆」​​）的技能的掩護條件。

64c73487f84b6b2cf66695123246127362169c91.source:
* If Power Block interrupts a PvE-only skill or one without a linked attribute, only that skill will be disabled; the target will still be able to use other title-track or no attribute skills.
* Wastrel's Worry and Wastrel's Demise are good sources of unconditional damage during the period that Power Block disables skills, especially against single-attribute builds (e.g. nukers).
* Power Block will extend the recharge time of skills with a shorter disable/recharge time (skills with a longer downtime will not be affected).
* Disables skills even if interruption is prevented.
64c73487f84b6b2cf66695123246127362169c91.text:
* 如果 強力封鎖 打斷了僅限 PvE 的技能或沒有連結屬性的技能，則僅該技能將被停用；目標仍能使用其他標題曲目或無屬性技能。
* 瓦思崔的憂慮 和 瓦斯崔之死 是 強力封鎖 停用技能期間無條件傷害的良好來源，特別是針對單一屬性建置（例如核彈）。
* 強力封鎖將延長停用/充能時間較短的技能的充能時間（停機時間較長的技能不受影響）。
* 即使阻止中斷，也會停用技能。
