e6a6859ff606fea07240dfa4db96110efdd704e3.source:
* This skill triggers when the target fails to hit, for whatever reason. Hence, blocking with a skill, simply dodging a ranged attack, or even using the terrain to avoid being hit by a ranged attack will trigger the damage.
* Combine with skills that causes Blindness to increase the miss chance and improve damage rate.
* This skill can be combined with Spirit of Failure as each will cause the foe to miss more often, thereby triggering both effects more frequently than either alone; however, hexes that make the target "miss" combine multiplicatively and not additively. Thus, a foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and Price of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks.
e6a6859ff606fea07240dfa4db96110efdd704e3.text:
* 當目標因任何原因未能擊中時，技能就會觸發。因此，用技能格擋、簡單躲避遠端攻擊、甚至利用地形躲避遠端攻擊都會觸發傷害。
* 與導致失明的技能結合，增加失誤率，提高傷害率。
* 該技能可以與 失誤心靈 結合使用，因為兩者都會導致敵人更頻繁地失手，從而比單獨使用任一技能更頻繁地觸發這兩種效果；然而，使目標“未命中”的六角形是乘法組合而不是加法組合。因此，同時使用 失心瘋 和 失敗的代價 施咒的敵人有 62.5% 機會錯過攻擊。
e6a6859ff606fea07240dfa4db96110efdd704e3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

1bfa35642d8fb2d10a29695d732970720516c6d9.source:
* The energy loss can be split between multiple characters maintaining the same enchantment on one character. Two characters with 8 Protection Prayers will each lose 2 energy per hit. Three characters at 13 Protection Prayers will each only lose 1 energy per hit. Two characters at 13 Protection Prayers will lose 2 and 1 energy, respectively. The first to cast takes the larger energy burden on an odd split. If characters are at differing attribute ranks of Protection Prayers, the lowest rank is used.
**If the enchantment is split up so that each bonder will lose 1 energy, then each of the bonders can cast Life Bond on the character that is the target of Protective Bond, and then Balthazar's Spirit on themselves to cover all of the energy cost, and maintain Protective Bond as long as it isn't stripped. However, Life Bond only splits up damage from attacks, so 1 energy will still be lost for each packet of damage from non-attack damage. As long as the non-attack damage isn't reduced to zero, 1 energy can usually still be gained from Essence Bond.
* If more than one character is maintaining this enchantment and one character runs out of energy, all other characters stop maintaining the enchantment.
1bfa35642d8fb2d10a29695d732970720516c6d9.text:
* 能量損失可以在多個角色之間分配，並在一個角色上保持相同的魔力。兩個具有 8 防護祈禱 的角色每次擊中都會損失 2 能量。 13 防護祈禱 的三個角色每次擊中只會損失 1 能量。 13 防護祈禱 處的兩個角色將分別失去 2 和 1 能量。第一個施法的人在奇數分裂中承擔更大的能量負擔。如果角色處於不同的 防護祈禱 屬性等級，則使用最低等級。
**如果結界被分開，使得每個束縛者都會失去1能量，那麼每個束縛者都可以對作為保護連結目標的角色施放生命連結，然後對自己施放巴薩澤的精神以覆蓋所有能量消耗，並在不被剝奪的情況下維持保護連結。然而，生命連結 僅分割攻擊造成的傷害，因此 1 能量仍會因非攻擊傷害造成的每包傷害而損失。只要非攻擊傷害沒有降為零，通常仍可從本質連結中獲得1能量。
* 如果有多個角色維持此結界，且其中一個角色耗盡能量，則所有其他角色將停止維持此結界。
1bfa35642d8fb2d10a29695d732970720516c6d9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* This skill is the base for all 55 Monk builds.
* Spirit Bond and Protective Spirit stack to great effect. Even if Protective Spirit would reduce damage taken to below 50, as long as the initial damage (before reduction from Protective Spirit) is above 50, Spirit Bond will still take effect. This is the basis for the "600" monk in the 600/smite team used for farming.
* The concise description is more accurate than the verbose one: damage from signets and traps for example will also be reduced.
* Life stealing and health loss is not reduced.
f6f7f737a84bbd1d6bc269327ded47f5621eb1df.text:
* 此技能是所有 55 僧侶 建置的基礎。
* 精神連結 和 精神守護 疊加效果極佳。即使精神守護會將受到的傷害減少到50以下，只要初始傷害（從精神守護減少之前）高於50，精神連結仍然有效。這是 600/smite 團隊中用於耕種的「600」武僧的基礎。
* 簡潔的描述比冗長的描述更準確：例如印章和陷阱造成的傷害也會減少。
* 偷取生命 和健康損失並未減少。

738420749dd901a68116eb23ef9c44eb52059a9e.source:
* Precast this item spell to gain reduced damage provided by the additional armor rating and drop the ashes to use as an emergency Heal Party or when energy is low to regain the benefits from your weapon set.
* Can be maintained indefinitely by re-casting the spell while still holding the ashes to retain the additional armor rating while providing a steady stream of party healing.
* Requires care when facing Soul Bind or Scourge Healing as once the item spell has been cast, the party heal cannot be stopped.
* Combines well with Herald's Insignia for an extra +10 armor rating.
** When used together these two effects provide +30 armor rating, which reduces armor-respecting damage by 41%.
738420749dd901a68116eb23ef9c44eb52059a9e.text:
* 預施此物品法術，以減少額外護甲等級帶來的傷害，並掉落灰燼以用作緊急 治癒隊伍 或在能量較低時重新獲得武器組的好處。
* 可以通過重新施放法術來無限期地維持，同時仍然保持骨灰以保留額外的護甲等級，同時提供穩定的隊伍治療流。
* 面對 靈魂束縛 或 災禍治癒 時需要小心，因為一旦施放物品法術，隊伍治療就無法停止。
* 與 Herald 的 徽記 完美結合，以獲得額外的 +10 裝甲等級。
** 一起使用時，這兩種效果提供 +30 裝甲等級，從而減少 41% 造成的裝甲傷害。
738420749dd901a68116eb23ef9c44eb52059a9e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* This skill sets a single flight time and arc for standard arrows fired from any bow:
** All standard arrows travel at the same (faster) rate and fly nearly parallel to the ground.
Some bow attack skills with a modified flight time or arc ignore the effect of Read the Wind on their flight time and arc but still benefit from the bonus damage, e.g. Broad Head Arrow and Called Shot. Quick Shot and Arcing Shot are exceptions to this.
* When used in conjunction with Favorable Winds, the bonus damage stacks. Arrow arc reduction and speed increase only stack when Favorable Winds is applied last.
** Read the Wind is a slightly better choice for Flatbows, since it lowers arc more, making it less likely that foes will dodge.
542f5e1b6a6e601a236b859164bccd7820d13215.text:
* 此技能為任何弓射出的標準箭設定單次飛行時間和弧度：
** 所有標準箭頭都以相同（更快）的速度行進，並且幾乎平行於地面飛行。
一些修改了飛行時間或弧度的弓攻擊技能會忽略 風之解讀 對飛行時間和弧度的影響，但仍受益於額外傷害，例如闊首箭 和 必中之箭。 風速之箭 和 弧光射擊 是例外。
* 與 順風 結合使用時，額外傷害會疊加。最後塗抹 順風 時，箭頭弧度減少和速度增加僅疊加。
** 風之解讀 對於平弓來說是一個稍微更好的選擇，因為它可以降低弧度，從而減少敵人躲避的可能性。

* This skill significantly reduces both the arc and flight time of arrows for all bow types and sets them equal to one another. Under Read the Wind, arrows fly at the same arc and speed regardless of the type of bow they are fired from. 

* This skill does not change the modified arc or flight times from certain arc-changing bow attack skills, such as Broad Head Arrow, Needling Shot, Quick Shot, etc. These skills ignore the effect of Read the Wind. Arcing Shot, however, does have its arc significantly reduced.

* The arrow speed enhancing effect of this skill does not stack with Favorable Winds. Favorable Winds will still provide additional damage; however, the flight of the arrow remains the same as Read the Wind by itself.

* Expect the affected foes to deal 33% less damage on average.
* Like blocking, chances to miss stack multiplicatively, not additively. A foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and Price of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks, not 75%.
* Good synergy with skills like Spiteful Spirit and Empathy in normal mode; the increased attack speed will trigger these more often.
* Enemies in hard mode already attack 25% faster, so this skill's additional increase will be less effective. Expect this skill to decrease the damage of hard mode foes by 42%.
f3cc1f96f85dc06d1c341ed1c4007933296a2fd5.text:
* 預期受影響的敵人平均會造成 33% 較少的傷害。
* 與阻塞一樣，錯過堆疊的機會是乘法，而不是加法。同時使用 失心瘋 和 失敗的代價 施咒的敵人有 62.5% 機會錯過攻擊，而不是 75%。
* 普通模式下與惡靈附身、自虐等技能有良好的協同作用；攻擊速度的提升會更頻繁地觸發這些事件。
*困難模式的敵人攻擊25%的速度已經更快，因此該技能的額外增幅效果會減弱。預計技能可以減少 42% 對困難模式敵人的傷害。

* Consider using Ritual Lord, Soul Twisting or Spirit Channeling instead of this skill if using 12+ ranks in Spawning Power. 
** These skills provide superior energy-management, a faster recharge bonus, do not require pre-existing spirits to function at full potential and they do not destroy spirits.
022ee079789235293652299b6e91d3b8456da841.text:

* 如果在 召喚 中使用 12+ 等級，請考慮使用 祭祀之主、生靈扭轉 或 導引之靈 取代此技能。 
** 這些技能提供卓越的能量管理、更快的充值獎勵，不需要預先存在的靈魂即可充分發揮作用，並且不會破壞靈魂。

b57cce87d823125b4a8407de18069d44f2787a7d.source:
When Release Enchantments (or any skill that removes "all enchantments") triggers the damage effects of Mirage Cloak or Aura of Holy Might, it behaves inconsistently compared to skills that remove a specific number of enchantments:

Mirage Cloak: Damage will only trigger for a restricted list of Dervish enchantments (Aura of Thorns, Balthazar's Rage, Pious Renewal, Dust Cloak, Staggering Force, Grenth's Fingers, and itself).

Aura of Holy Might: Damage will trigger for all Dervish enchantments except Eternal Aura, Shield of Force, Grenth's Aura, and Vow of Revolution.

Skills that remove a defined number of enchantments (like Rend Enchantments or standard Dervish teardowns) do not suffer from these restrictions.
* This spell affects party members in party range.
* The enchantments are removed first, voiding any possible healing bonus from Unyielding Aura.
** However, Vigorous Spirit will trigger its healing before being removed.
b57cce87d823125b4a8407de18069d44f2787a7d.text:
當釋放加持（或任何移除「所有結界」的技能）觸發魔幻掩蔽或神聖力量光環的傷害效果時，與移除特定數量結界的技能相比，其表現不一致：

魔幻掩蔽：傷害 只會觸發有限的 神喚使 附魔清單（荊棘靈氣、巴薩澤盛怒、神性修補、塵土掩蔽、驚天神力、古蘭斯之指 及其本身）。

聖力光環：傷害 將觸發除永恆光環、盾 力量、古蘭斯 光環和革命誓言之外的所有 神喚使 結界。

移除指定數量結界的技能（例如 粉碎加持 或標準 神喚使 拆卸）不受這些限制。
* 此法術影響隊伍範圍內的隊伍成員。
* 先移除結界，使 堅毅靈氣 中任何可能的治療加成無效。
** 但是，精力充沛 在被移除之前會觸發其癒合。
b57cce87d823125b4a8407de18069d44f2787a7d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9fdb104e40710544c0b3dea19a42c388df32349e.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Restoration.
* This skill can bypass Frozen Soil's effect since this skill can indirectly resurrect party members and the caster.
** Cannot be cast in the range of a Frozen Soil spirit.
** Use this before Frozen Soil, to provide a means to resurrect your own team while suppressing enemy resurrections. 
* Combine with Feast of Souls for rapid healing after resurrection. Rupture Soul or Spirit to Flesh can respectively provide damage or healing before resurrection.
* Can be recast with skills that shorten the recharge times of Binding Rituals, such as Soul Twisting or Ritual Lord, to control when the resurrection occurs.
* If your entire party dies before this spirit does, you will not get resurrected.
* You can prevent enemy resurrections by using Signet of Binding on hostile Restoration spirits.

This spirit will also resurrect creatures created via summoning stones that were dead and in the area of the spirit.
9fdb104e40710544c0b3dea19a42c388df32349e.text:
* 此技能創造出復甦的精神。
* 此技能可繞過凍土的效果，因為此技能可間接復活隊員和施法者。
** 無法在 凍土 精魂的射程內施展。
** 在 凍土 之前使用此功能，可提供復活己方隊伍同時壓制敵人復活的方法。 
* 與生靈饗宴結合使用可在復活後快速癒合。 生靈迸裂或生靈之血可以分別在復活前提供傷害或治療。
* 可以使用縮短繫結儀式充能時間的技能進行重鑄，例如生靈扭轉或祭祀之主，以控制復活發生的時間。
* 如果你的整個隊伍在這個靈魂之前死亡，你將不會復活。
* 您可以透過對敵對的 復甦 靈魂使用 束縛紋章 來防止敵人復活。

該精神還將復活透過召喚已死亡的石頭而在該精神區域中建立的生物。
9fdb104e40710544c0b3dea19a42c388df32349e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

578e96a376426bdbfff4bf1dcb4a10ec8986cd77.source: * With this skill at 11 or more Healing Prayers, a party member is able to resurrect a 55 Monk even when the 55 Monk is at 1 maximum health due to Death Penalty (see 55 Monk for more details).
578e96a376426bdbfff4bf1dcb4a10ec8986cd77.text: * 使用此技能在11或更高治療祈禱時，即使55 僧侶因死亡懲罰而處於1最大生命值，隊員也能夠復活55 僧侶（更多詳情請參閱55 僧侶）。

f2d82d447a58f9643d846e88ae4792705acb834c.source:
* Consider carefully whether to bring this skill. If it is used to resurrect a team member in the midst of battle, that member will have low health, requiring a follow-up heal. In addition, with no energy that member will likely not be able to join the battle quickly. In such situations, a non-reusable Resurrection Signet or a different resurrection skill is better. 
* Among all monk henchmen, currently only Taya has this skill.
f2d82d447a58f9643d846e88ae4792705acb834c.text:
* 慎重考慮是否帶此技能。如果它用於在戰鬥中復活團隊成員，該成員的生命值將會很低，需要後續治療。另外，沒有能量的成員很可能無法快速加入戰鬥。在這種情況下，不可重複使用的 復活紋章 或不同的復活技能會更好。 
* 在所有僧侶追隨者中，目前只有塔亞擁有此技能。

59f4b9f6c7d5695b38c418bec63d24d3cd7cf2db.source:
* Because it has a quick cast time and no energy cost, this skill is a favorite for most forms of PvP.
* Since it only recharges on morale boosts (usually gained by killing bosses in PvE or flag objectives in PvP), this skill is significantly less useful in situations in which players will be fighting a long time with no morale boosts (i.e. the Underworld).
* This skill is referred to as a "soft" resurrection (contrary to a "hard" resurrection skill such as Death Pact Signet or Flesh of my Flesh) due to the fact it can only be used once per morale boost.
* As with any other skill, a morale boost will not recharge the signet if it is hidden while you are under the effect of a form with form-specific skill bar, e.g. if you kill a boss while under the effects of Ursan Blessing.

This skill, along with all other skills, recharges when zoning, despite the description text stating it requires a morale boost.
When used on an invalid target, this skill incorrectly gives the "Invalid spell target." message rather than the generic "Invalid target." message.
59f4b9f6c7d5695b38c418bec63d24d3cd7cf2db.text:
* 由於施法時間短且無能量消耗，該技能是大多數 PvP 形式的最愛。
* 由於它只能在士氣提升時重新充電（通常通過在 PvE 中殺死 Boss 或在 PvP 中標記目標來獲得），因此在玩家長時間戰鬥而沒有士氣提升的情況下（即地獄），此技能的用處明顯較小。
* 該技能被稱為「軟」復活（與 死契紋章 或 Flesh of my Flesh 等「硬」復活技能相反），因為每次士氣提升只能使用一次。
* 與其他技能一樣，如果您在具有 型態 特定技能欄的 型態 效果下隱藏印章，士氣提升不會為其充電。如果你在 Ursan 祝福 的影響下殺死了 Boss。

儘管描述文字表明該技能需要鼓舞士氣，但該技能與所有其他技能一樣，會在分割槽時重新充電。
當對無效目標使用時，技能會錯誤地給予「無效法術目標」。訊息而不是通用的「無效目標」。資訊.
59f4b9f6c7d5695b38c418bec63d24d3cd7cf2db.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

44f6180b70644a36dfb5e8aa596cbad87c5aee01.source:
* The attack damage is not reduced.
* Retribution deals holy damage.
* Damage is rounded up to a minimum of 1.
* Retribution will only trigger on the damage from attacks, not on the indirect damage from Hundred Blades or Vow of Strength.
* Returned damage is calculated after the effects of enchantments (e.g. Protective Spirit), therefore is useless for 55 Monks.
* Retribution is one of the keystone skills of 600+smiter combinations.
If you somehow manage to maintain Retribution on a foe, it will not deal damage back to you or your allies.
44f6180b70644a36dfb5e8aa596cbad87c5aee01.text:
* 攻擊傷害不減少。
* 天譴 造成神聖傷害。
* 傷害 向上舍入為最小值 1。
* 天譴 只會在攻擊造成的傷害時觸發，不會在 快速劍 或 力量誓約 造成的間接傷害時觸發。
* 回傳的傷害是在結界效果之後計算的（例如精神守護），因此對於55武僧來說毫無用處。
* 天譴是600+smiter組合的關鍵技能之一。
如果你設法對敵人保持 天譴，它不會對你或你的盟友造成傷害。

f79a6d20de1bc08c8a0c206ccabbfe6d12edcd51.source:
* This skill can not "steal" monster-only enchantments (e.g. Demonic Agility); however, the energy gain does happen and Revealed Enchantment recharges instantly.
* It is possible to steal enchantments you need to maintain, such as Mending. They will remain active when Revealed Enchantment ends.
* Heroes will use the copied skill as they normally would do.
** Maintained enchantments that heroes would dismiss can be disabled to be maintained for the duration of the copy effect. When the copy effect ends the enchantment will be dropped as soon as the AI dictates it to (i.e. the hero is not in a situation where it would normally maintain the enchantment). Out of combat, Blessed Aura, Divine Boon and Unyielding Aura are the only maintained enchantments that the AI won't immediately dismiss.
f79a6d20de1bc08c8a0c206ccabbfe6d12edcd51.text:
* 此技能不能「竊取」怪物專用的附魔（例如惡魔敏捷）；然而，能量增益確實會發生，並且 加持顯露 會立即充電。
* 可以竊取您需要維護的結界，例如 癒合。當 加持顯露 結束時，它們將保持活動狀態。
*英雄將像平常一樣使用複製的技能。
** 英雄會解除的維持結界可以被停用，以便在複製效果持續時間內維持。當複製效果結束時，一旦人工智慧指示，結界就會被丟棄（即英雄不處於通常會保持結界的情況）。在非戰鬥狀態下，祝福靈氣、神之恩賜 和 堅毅靈氣 是人工智慧不會立即消除的唯一保留的結界。
f79a6d20de1bc08c8a0c206ccabbfe6d12edcd51.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9d108e8a2abf34b59b4fcf8304e343a70009d525.source:
* This skill cannot "steal" monster-only hex spells (e.g. Crystal Bonds); however, the energy gain does happen and Revealed Hex recharges instantly.
* This skill is not susceptible to recharge-lengthening skills like Diversion.
* If the caster is in the process of casting the copied hex spell at the end of the 20 seconds copy duration, the casting of the spell will fail.
9d108e8a2abf34b59b4fcf8304e343a70009d525.text:
* 此技能無法「竊取」怪物專用的十六進位咒語（例如水晶債券）；然而，能量增益確實會發生，並且 降咒顯露 會立即充電。
* 此技能不受 牽制 等恢復時間延長技能的影響。
* 如果施法者在 20 秒複製持續時間結束時正在施放複製的十六進位法術，則該法術的施展將會失敗。

ba35a6919fc2acb49751b2aef47ce1c84cb99e55.source:
* Damage inflicted by this skill is considered holy damage.
* If the target takes more damage than the stated maximum, then the damage taken will be reduced by that maximum and the attacker will receive the same amount. For example, at 14 Smiting Prayers, a target with Reversal of Damage on them being struck by a Lightning Orb that would deal 100 damage would take 30 damage and the attacker would take 70.
* The damage for this reversal is calculated before other damage reduction. So, a 55 Monk using Protective Spirit and Reversal of Damage can deal more than five damage, with the remaining (above the stated maximum for this skill) damage being reduced by Protective Spirit.
* This skill will still prevent damage even if there is no foe to redirect damage to, for example when struck by environmental damage.
ba35a6919fc2acb49751b2aef47ce1c84cb99e55.text:
* 此技能造成的 傷害 被視為神聖傷害。
* 如果目標受到的傷害超過規定的最大傷害，則受到的傷害將減少該最大傷害，而攻擊者將受到相同的傷害。例如，在 14 懲戒祈禱 處，帶有 傷害反轉 的目標被 閃電球 擊中（造成 100 傷害）時，將受到 30 傷害，而攻擊者將受到 70 傷害。
* 此逆轉的傷害是在其他傷害減免之前計算的。因此，使用 精神守護 和 傷害反轉 的 55 僧侶 可以造成超過 5 點傷害，剩餘的傷害（高於此技能規定的最大值）會被 精神守護 減少。
* 即使沒有敵人可以將傷害重定向到該技能，例如受到環境傷害時，該技能仍然可以防止傷害。
ba35a6919fc2acb49751b2aef47ce1c84cb99e55.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

9364d1e59287312f20b43d710b1356d6a7fb7497.source:
* Just like the concise description says, this spell converts damage to healing, up to the stated maximum. For example, at rank 12 it can negate up to 134 damage (67 damage reduced and 67 damage healed).
* Under Reversal of Fortune, the healing occurs before damage. As such, it is possible for this spell to result in a net loss of health if used on an ally at or near full health.
* This skill, unlike Reversal of Damage, will trigger after damage reduction like Protective Spirit and Protective Bond, meaning that you often won't get the full benefit from this skill with other protection in place.
Contrary to the full description, this skill causes healing and not health gain.
9364d1e59287312f20b43d710b1356d6a7fb7497.text:
* 如簡明描述所說，法術將傷害轉化為治療，最高可達規定的最大值。例如，在等級 12 時，它最多可以抵消 134 傷害（67 傷害減少，67 傷害治癒）。
* 在 幸運逆轉 下，修復發生在損壞之前。因此，如果對處於或接近完全生命值的盟友使用該法術，則可能會導致生命值淨損失。
* 此技能與 傷害反轉 不同，會像 精神守護 和 保護連結 一樣在傷害減少後觸發，這表示在有其他保護的情況下，您通常無法從該技能中獲得全部好處。
與完整描述相反，該技能會帶來治療效果，但不會增加生命值。
9364d1e59287312f20b43d710b1356d6a7fb7497.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

197cf8734f6a299e19ca19b2ec547129b01865e3.source: * Reverse Hex is one of the few hex removal skills that have an activation time of 0.25 second, so this skill can be cast during the aftercast delay between a hex and its cover hex, removing it before it is covered.
197cf8734f6a299e19ca19b2ec547129b01865e3.text: * 降咒反轉 是為數不多的啟動時間為 0.25 秒的六角形移除技能之一，因此該技能可以在六角形與其覆蓋六角形之間的施法延遲期間施放，在其被覆蓋之前將其移除。

bd2c4fb21a450867834ddc191dd7dbc5dffc3a2c.source:
* The range for this skill is much shorter than the resurrection range of Comfort Animal.
* As of the August 6, 2009 game update and August 26, 2026 game update, Comfort Animal or Comfort Animal (PvP) can be used instead of Charm Animal for your companion to travel with you. Heal as One was updated with the February 25, 2010 game update to also have this functionality in PvE. These updates largely render Revive Animal suboptimal because of their ability to resurrect pets, mandatory bar placement for pet usage, cast time, recharge time, pet heal and range.
bd2c4fb21a450867834ddc191dd7dbc5dffc3a2c.text:
* 此技能的範圍比安慰動物的復活範圍短得多。
* 自 8 月 6、2009 遊戲更新和 8 月 26、2026 遊戲更新起，您的同伴可以使用 安慰動物 或 安慰動物 (PvP) 取代 迷魅動物 與您一起旅行。 治癒合一 隨 2 月 25、2010 遊戲更新一起更新，在 PvE 中也具有此功能。這些更新在很大程度上使 復活動物 變得次優，因為它們具有復活寵物的能力、寵物使用的強制欄位置、施法時間、充電時間、寵物治療和範圍。

* This skill is mechanically the same as a shadow step.
* This skill (and its PvP version) is the only shadow step skill able to move the user to any target regardless of whether the target is a foe or ally.
c303653e178ed6345d149c66dcc761efd67ad64e.text:

* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* One attack will trigger your Riposte, Deadly Riposte, and Auspicious Parry/Gladiator's Defense if you have all active.
63ff6245a0e60f66d02845eec88d4148d06f1e3e.text:

12c460bd41635375b88cbc7e27b2752533a5caa4.text:

aa5392a62bc0bbd747b0920234d28c394ce79a6d.source:

aa5392a62bc0bbd747b0920234d28c394ce79a6d.text:

Ritual Lord will only increase the skill progression of a skill, and not inherent effects from Spawning Power.

* This skill can be used without Charm Animal, Comfort Animal nor Heal as One equipped or when your animal companion is dead.
{{speed|5|15|25|15}}
* Animal companions already run faster than normal player speed so this may not be needed for the pet's benefit though it will still allow the pet to better catch a running target.
* This skill will continue to be active for the pet even if the owner has activated another stance after it.
* Consider using in combination with Feral Aggression.
83cfbc1e956c41b76b78591fe53abc74e3becead.text:
* 此技能可在未裝備 迷魅動物、安慰動物 或 治癒合一 的情況下或當您的動物夥伴死亡時使用。
{{速度|5|15|25|15}}
* 動物 同伴的奔跑速度已經快於正常玩家的速度，因此寵物可能不需要這樣做，儘管它仍然可以讓寵物更好地捕捉奔跑的目標。
* 即使主人在該技能之後啟動了另一個姿勢，該技能也會繼續對寵物有效。

* 與 毀滅、生命 和 復甦 完美結合。

c1c0010b25c40bc2f34d2e1cef2789bbc98ff15e.text:

* Very useful in Random Arenas, as almost everyone is likely to have a Resurrection Signet equipped.
* The description is ambiguous. Rust will only disable a single signet on a target, and only if that target is casting a signet when struck. Additionally, Rust will disable that signet even if the target is under an effect that prevents interruption.
* Rust will not fail if the target dies before the skill completes casting.
2510243e6209c30bbac19d13e7fa81045e0c1fbf.text:

* 如果目標在技能完成施法之前死亡，紋章鏽蝕 不會失敗。

e6e0eb2f251197f7a8f698b60343206e8fc609bd.text:

5a21c20cb3758d163515b231f02c5548a6d3bd42.source:
* Only attacks (including wanding and attack skills) will trigger this skill's effect.
* This skill grants energy whenever you strike a foe with a condition, i.e it does not end upon hitting a foe who is suffering from a condition.
* Energy gain occurs immediately after the hit.
** Attacks that successfully inflict a condition will cause energy gain whether or not the foe is already suffering a condition.
** If Reap Impurities removes the foe's only condition, it will still cause energy gain.
* Can be very effectively combined with Quickening Zephyr.
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its skill revision history for details.
5a21c20cb3758d163515b231f02c5548a6d3bd42.text:
* 只有攻擊（包括魔杖和攻擊技能）才會觸發該技能的效果。
* 每當你攻擊患有某種疾病的敵人時，該技能都會賦予能量，也就是說，它不會在擊中患有某種疾病的敵人時結束。
* 能量 增益在命中後立即發生。
** 成功造成某種狀況的攻擊將導致能量增益，無論敵人是否已經患有某種狀況。
** 如果 汙穢回收 消除了敵人的唯一條件，它仍然會導致能量增益。
* 可以與活力微風非常有效地結合。
* 此技能的功能自推出以來已發生變化；詳情請參閱其技能修訂歷史。

3e24e2fbdacf4006e9ca0a7f85d073870436f85f.source: * As this is the only skill measured in feet, it can be hard to judge the wire’s range. 75' or 900" is just slightly shorter than earshot range, shortbow and spear range, or the size of your aggro bubble.
3e24e2fbdacf4006e9ca0a7f85d073870436f85f.text: * 由於這是唯一以英尺為單位的技能，因此很難判斷電線的範圍。 75' 或 900" 比聽力範圍、短弓和長矛範圍或仇恨氣泡的大小稍短。

* Deals holy damage.
* This skill will deal damage if an enchantment is renewed, whether by being recast or by reapplying itself (in the cases of Critical Defenses, Lyssa's Aura, and Kinetic Armor).
* This skill is often very effective against Dervishes, since they tend to rely on casting Flash Enchantments on themselves.
e47ef17c2c6faf65941625343821bafc1404109f.text:

* This skill only affects skills that directly heal (e.g. Ether Feast or Healing Signet). It does not affect health gain via Divine Favor or life stealing, indirect healing via Divine Boon, health regeneration, or similar effects.
This hex does not trigger for Heal Area, Karei's Healing Circle, and Healing Ring.
86663702eec86694d11132910540a1b36de57631.text:
* 災禍治癒 造成的傷害會在治療前施加。這意味著，如果受到 災禍治癒 施咒時使用自我治療技能造成的傷害大於您剩餘的生命值，則可以使用自我治療技能來自殺。
* 此技能僅影響直接治療的技能（例如精神饗宴或治療紋章）。它不會影響透過 神恩 獲得的生命值或生命竊取、透過 神之恩賜 的間接治療、生命值再生或類似效果。
區域治癒、嘉黎光環 和 治療光環 不會觸發該十六進位。

1532da298a47517b469a426bc84df4f550ae9888.source:
* Consider using Fire Attunement, Glowing Gaze, and Glyph of Lesser Energy to compensate for this spell's high energy cost.
* Under Glyph of Immolation, burning is applied to the target before the condition is checked for, so damage will be applied to target. Nearby foes will only suffer burning.
** Intensity can be used to perform half-damage to foes around target in addition to the previous action.
* If your target dies while you are casting Searing Flames, the spell will not fail.
1532da298a47517b469a426bc84df4f550ae9888.text:
* 考慮使用火之調和、灼熱凝視和微能符號來補償此法術的高能量消耗。
* 在獻祭的符號下，在檢查條件之前對目標施加燃燒，因此會對目標施加傷害。附近的敵人只會遭受灼傷。
** 除了先前的動作之外，強度還可用於對目標周圍的敵人造成一半傷害。
* 如果你的目標在你施放 爆裂火焰 時死亡，法術就不會失敗。

efe3515755277057632a8d478d78e2866328f210.source:
* The shadow step and the hex are considered separate effects:
**If the shadow step fails (i.e. if the target is in an inaccessible location), the target will still be affected by the movement speed hex.
**If the hex fails (i.e. the target is under the effects of Hex Breaker), you will still shadow step to the target.
efe3515755277057632a8d478d78e2866328f210.text:
* 陰影步和六角形被視為獨立的效果：
**如果暗影步失敗（即目標位於無法到達的位置），目標仍會受到移動速度十六進位的影響。
**如果十六進位失敗（即目標受到 破咒頌歌 的影響），你還是會影子步到目標。
efe3515755277057632a8d478d78e2866328f210.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

2b47fef815d748d75e2e26a1ba275fa616c4b37d.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*Combines well with Asuran Scan on martial classes.
2b47fef815d748d75e2e26a1ba275fa616c4b37d.text:
* 達到第一個效忠等級、庫茲柯/勒克森 支持者、20 等級角色後，可以從 庫茲柯理事 或 勒克森 拾荒者學習此技能，以用於 3,000 陣營值。
* 庫茲柯 版本的技能圖示位於頂部，勒克森 版本的技能圖示位於底部。
*與武術課上的阿蘇蘭掃描完美結合。
2b47fef815d748d75e2e26a1ba275fa616c4b37d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b65866f995a22d68079703a3d59ef9fa29308467.source:
* Creatures affected by the shroud can still cast enchantments that do not require targeting (e.g. Shadow Form or Conjure Flame).
* Foes with this hex cannot be targeted by enchantment spells that target a foe, like Ice Spear.
b65866f995a22d68079703a3d59ef9fa29308467.text:
* 受護罩影響的生物仍然可以施放不需要瞄準的結界（例如 暗影形態 或 召喚火焰）。
* 具有此十六進位制的敵人無法成為針對敵人的結界法術的目標，例如 冰之矛。
b65866f995a22d68079703a3d59ef9fa29308467.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f0f3d8c9be29759cd8be25981ecacebe2bbcf8b2.source:
* Shadow Theft can buff itself. This can be done at rank 16 by casting it just as it recharges, raising the duration to 25s and attribute increase to 6.
* The attribute reduction effect persists if the caster dies.
* With at least rank 14 Critical Strikes, Shadow Theft will push the Critical Strikes attribute over rank 18 which is the threshold to gain 4 energy per critical hit.
* This skill only increases the primary profession's primary attribute and primary and secondary profession's secondary attributes, it doesn't increase attributes obtained through blessings or Seven Weapons Stance.
f0f3d8c9be29759cd8be25981ecacebe2bbcf8b2.text:
* 闇影 竊盜可以增強自身。這可以在等級 16 上完成，方法是在它充電時施放它，將持續時間提高到 25，並將屬性增加到 6。
* 如果施法者死亡，屬性減少效果仍然存在。
* 至少等級為 14 致命攻擊，闇影 竊盜會將 致命攻擊 屬性推到等級 18 上方，這是每次重擊獲得 4 能量的門檻。
* 此技能僅增加主職業的主屬性以及主副職業的副屬性，不會增加透過祝福或七械態勢獲得的屬性。
f0f3d8c9be29759cd8be25981ecacebe2bbcf8b2.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0dd71217866b248789755063b11ad4647f354506.source:
* Consider bringing a cancel stance so that you get to choose when you return to your activation location.
* If you reuse this skill before its duration ends (for example, through recharge from Morale Boost), you will shadow step to the second target (as expected), but you will return to your original location (from the first time you used the skill).
* When the stance ends, the character is returned to his original location via shadow step.
* Avoid using with adrenaline attack skills; the adrenaline will be lost when those skills are disabled.
* This is the only shadow step skill that teleports you to your target and lacks an aftercast delay, which allows you to attack your target instantly. Since Shadow Walk disables your attack skills, it is not commonly used with martial professions; however, spellcaster professions that rely on close combat skills, such as Star Burst or saccers that rely on Death Nova, may find this skill useful.
0dd71217866b248789755063b11ad4647f354506.text:
* 考慮帶上取消姿勢，以便您可以在返回啟動位置時進行選擇。
* 如果您在持續時間結束之前重複使用該技能（例如，透過士氣提升進行充能），您將暗影步到第二個目標（如預期），但您將返回到原來的位置（從您第一次使用該技能開始）。
* 當姿態結束時，角色會通過暗影步回到原來的位置。
*避免與腎上腺素攻擊技能一起使用；當這些技能被停用時，腎上腺素就會消失。
* 這是唯一一個可以將你傳送到目標並且沒有施法延遲的暗影步技能，可以讓你立即攻擊目標。由於 暗影微步 會停用你的攻擊技能，因此它不常用於武術職業；然而，依賴近戰技能的施法者職業，例如 星爆 或依賴 死亡新星 的空投者，可能會發現此技能很有用。
0dd71217866b248789755063b11ad4647f354506.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* This skill creates a Spirit of Shadowsong that uses the Shadowsong attack skill. 
The non-concise description states that the "spirit dies after 30 second" instead of using the plural "seconds" with Communing rank 0 and 1.
2f220d0295a714b4373a9f73cffd1ead8fd20786.text:
* 此技能創造出使用闇影共鳴攻擊技能的闇影共鳴靈魂。 
不簡潔的描述指出“靈魂在 30 秒後死亡”，而不是使用複數“秒”，神諭 等級為 0 和 1。
2f220d0295a714b4373a9f73cffd1ead8fd20786.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5ad5f6fd65fec1089264f4aaedc68cae2e91ad22.source:
* This skill creates a Spirit of Rejuvenation.
* The spirit is created with a higher level than other spirits at the same attribute rank. At 21 Restoration Magic, it is level 28, which is the highest leveled summoned spirit in the game. 
* Only heals party members below full health, so while your party hasn't started combat, try not to equip vampiric weapon modifiers.
* At level 14 (0 Spawning Power), Rejuvenation does the equivalent of 5 pips of health regeneration for a total of 38 seconds distributed amongst the party members (1 party member under its effect will receive 38 seconds while 4 party members will receive 9.5 seconds, etc.).
5ad5f6fd65fec1089264f4aaedc68cae2e91ad22.text:
* 該技能會產生回春之魂。
* 所創造的武魂等級高於同屬性等級的其他武魂。在 21   復原魔法 , 是水平的 28 ，這是遊戲中等級最高的召喚靈。 
* 只能治療低於完全生命值的隊伍成員，所以當你的隊伍還沒有開始戰鬥時，盡量不要裝備吸血鬼武器修飾符。
* 處於水平 14 （ 0   召喚 ），回春術相當於 5 總共恢復生命點數 38 黨員之間分配的秒數（ 1 受其影響的黨員將收到 38 秒同時 4 黨員將獲得 9.5 秒等）。
5ad5f6fd65fec1089264f4aaedc68cae2e91ad22.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

793e063ef33ac71e7a3baebef076d5fbfc27ac57.source: * This is the only player skill that increases the movement speed of a foe.
793e063ef33ac71e7a3baebef076d5fbfc27ac57.text: * 這是唯一可以提高敵人移動速度的玩家技能。
793e063ef33ac71e7a3baebef076d5fbfc27ac57.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f03427f2b1bae34c0ade7c891fb0cbf22fa73962.source:
* Bleeding will cover conditions inflicted by attack skills.
* If using with Apply Poison, Poison will cover bleeding. If using with Poison Tip Signet, the conditions apply in order, so bleeding will cover poison if Sharpen Daggers is applied second.
* Attacks while wielding daggers will trigger the bleeding, so Melee Attacks are included.
** Secondary targets for skills such as Golden Phoenix Strike or Death Blossom do NOT trigger the bleeding.
** Combine with Whirlwind Attack to apply bleeding on a large scale.
If a ranged weapon is swapped for daggers after the attack was made and before the projectile hit, Sharpen Daggers will count this projectile hit as a dagger attack.
f03427f2b1bae34c0ade7c891fb0cbf22fa73962.text:
* 流血 將涵蓋攻擊技能所造成的狀況。
* 如果與 塗毒 一起使用，中毒 將遮蓋出血。如果與 中毒 提示 紋章 一起使用，條件依序適用，因此若其次套用 銳利匕首，出血將覆蓋毒物。
* 揮舞匕首時的攻擊會觸發流血，因此包含 肉搏 攻擊。
** 火鳳凰狙殺 或 死神之花 等技能的次要目標不會觸發流血。
** 與 旋風 Attack 結合使用可大規模出血。
如果在攻擊後、彈體擊中之前將遠端武器替換為匕首，銳利匕首 會將此彈體擊中視為匕首攻擊。
f03427f2b1bae34c0ade7c891fb0cbf22fa73962.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

b05f47929e77f6ecc4d8351f5035432cac38b0ea.source:
* Combines well with Mesmer hexes that have an effect upon ending, such as Phantom Pain.
* Since the foe is targeted before the hex is removed, the energy loss and damage from Mind Wrack will still trigger.
b05f47929e77f6ecc4d8351f5035432cac38b0ea.text:
* 與 幻術師 六角形完美結合，對結束有影響，例如 痛苦幻影。
* 由於敵人在六角形移除前就被鎖定，心靈破壞 的能量損失和傷害仍然會觸發。
b05f47929e77f6ecc4d8351f5035432cac38b0ea.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0965a8aa2efeda24960865ed6ee45d6a1720b1ee.source:
* Combines well with Ether Phantom, Overload, Phantom Pain, Shrinking Armor, Wastrel's Demise, and Web of Disruption.
* Be careful if you are partied with several other Mesmers. On one hand, you have a good chance of being able to use this skill on any target, at any time. On the other hand, you may remove a well-planned hex placed by an ally who won't appreciate your undoing of their hex.
0965a8aa2efeda24960865ed6ee45d6a1720b1ee.text:
* 與 幽靈氣息、超載、痛苦幻影、收縮 防禦、瓦斯崔之死 和 瓦解之網 完美結合。
* 如果您與其他幾位幻術師一起組隊，請務必小心。一方面，你很有可能隨時對任何目標使用此技能。另一方面，你可能會移除一個盟友精心策劃的六角形，而他們不會欣賞你撤銷他們的六角形。
0965a8aa2efeda24960865ed6ee45d6a1720b1ee.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

62269d94bf10f9409b5a344ced773e242039c65f.source: * This skill removes the enchantment before applying the damage.
62269d94bf10f9409b5a344ced773e242039c65f.text: * 此技能會在造成傷害前移除結界。
62269d94bf10f9409b5a344ced773e242039c65f.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

bdc0eede73ce20141b85ab2ec6f6ac956b8ccd30.source:
* The AI will prioritize targets with foes in range.
* The AI will only use this on party members, not other allies.
bdc0eede73ce20141b85ab2ec6f6ac956b8ccd30.text:
*人工智慧將優先考慮範圍內有敵人的目標。
* AI只會對黨員使用此功能，而不會對其他盟友使用。
bdc0eede73ce20141b85ab2ec6f6ac956b8ccd30.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

ad43c4e255061c1e832b130b5814188c29e51fa9.source:
* Each of the two attacks removes an enchantment after dealing damage.
This skill replaces your dagger's attack damage with the stated damage, which is non-armor-ignoring damage (unlike other attack skills such as Distracting Shot and Needling Shot). This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.
ad43c4e255061c1e832b130b5814188c29e51fa9.text:
* 兩次攻擊都會在造成傷害後移除結界。
此技能將匕首的攻擊傷害替換為指定傷害，這是非護甲無視傷害（與其他攻擊技能如 震暈之箭 和 刺針射擊 不同）。此傷害受到 匕首精通、爆擊、護甲穿透、銘文和銘文等效武器傷害加值以及目標護甲等級的影響，但不受益於自訂傷害加值。
ad43c4e255061c1e832b130b5814188c29e51fa9.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

This damage is affected by Dagger Mastery, critical hits, armor penetration, inscription and inscription-equivalent weapon damage bonuses and the target's armor rating, but does not benefit from the customization damage bonus.
c639c422a8196a579ab517a6d8c2ee9b3d21c3a7.text: bug：此技能將匕首的攻擊傷害替換為規定的傷害，這是非護甲忽略傷害（與其他攻擊技能如 震暈之箭 和 刺針射擊 不同）。此傷害受到 匕首精通、爆擊、護甲穿透、銘文和銘文等效武器傷害加值以及目標護甲等級的影響，但不受益於自訂傷害加值。

0094391c1e528c8306e4a2cf1c0e5e58582f674d.source:
* Consider using with skills that require a Water Magic hex for a decent spike, such as Freezing Gust.
* Unlike Incendiary Bonds, Lightning Strike, and Lightning Surge, removing Shatterstone prematurely using a hex removal skill will still trigger the end effect damage.
* The additional damage will occur if the target dies before the hex expires.
0094391c1e528c8306e4a2cf1c0e5e58582f674d.text:
* 考慮使用需要 水系魔法 十六進位才能獲得不錯的峰值的技能，例如 寒風。
* 與 燃燒連結、閃電衝擊 和 閃電震盪 不同，使用十六進位移除技能過早移除 碎裂冰石 仍會觸發最終效果傷害。
* 如果目標在咒語失效前死亡，則會造成額外傷害。
0094391c1e528c8306e4a2cf1c0e5e58582f674d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

df9072e78717f47083f962e8858346e6350c9d73.source: * Like Lightning Hammer, Cracked Armor is applied after calculating damage.
df9072e78717f47083f962e8858346e6350c9d73.text: * 與 閃電之鎚 一樣，破解的 防禦 在計算傷害後套用。
df9072e78717f47083f962e8858346e6350c9d73.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

85b7247fac93758d7b851eadd8fa1d9ddd7bbe6b.source:
* You gain energy and health from this skill’s own overcast cost.
* You can quickly build up overcast to a useful amount by activating and canceling this skill a few times.
* This spell takes fractional points of overcast into account. For example, if you cast this skill while you’re not otherwise overcast, you will gain 5 points of overcast as you start casting it. By the time you finish casting it, you will have already regenerated 0.3333333333333333 points of overcast and this skill will give you only 4 energy and 23 health, not 5 energy and 25 health.
* It takes 15 seconds to fully recover from this skill’s overcast cost and maintain a stable level of overcast. When cast every 15 seconds, this skill gives the equivalent of 1 pip of energy regeneration for every 5 points of overcast. *It is the party members of the target that gets the healing, not those of the caster.
**If used on a minion, all allied minions will receive the health instead of party members.
*Only the party members in compass range of the target will be healed.
*The enchantment ends if the target leaves the caster's compass range.
* Combines well with Shield of Absorption when the target of both enchantments is under heavy attack (e.g. a character tanking).
*Works very well when used on an emo who has a Life Bond on a tank.
*This skill will trigger if the damage received is 0, unlike Essence Bond. 
If two people cast this spell on one target, both will take effect; however, only one enchantment will show on the effects monitor.
The heal amount is based on your rank of Divine Favor at the time of each hit rather than at the initial casting, i.e. if your attributes are increased/decreased while the enchantment is in effect, the heal amount will change accordingly.
This skill actually causes health gain.

**如果對小兵使用，則所有盟友小兵都將獲得生命值，而不是黨員。
*只有目標羅盤範圍內的小隊成員才會被治癒。
*如果目標離開施法者的羅盤範圍，結界就會結束。

如果兩個人對一個目標施放此法術，則雙方都會生效；然而，效果監視器上只會顯示一個結界。
治療量取決於您每次命中時的 神恩 等級，而不是初始施法時的等級，即，如果您的屬性在結界生效時增加/減少，治療量將相應變化。
這項技能實際上會帶來健康增益。

* Often used by secondary warriors in PvP for several reasons :

* The damage reduction increases with every hit received. Damage from the first hit will be reduced by 5, damage from the second by 10, damage from the third by 15 and so on, until the enchantment ends or is recast.
* This skill is particularly useful for a tank absorbing a lot of damage. For a low armor rating tank being hit rapidly, coupling this skill with Spirit Bond is extremely beneficial, as Spirit Bond takes care of sustaining the tank at first, and thereafter Shield of Absorption usually reduces any damage to zero.
* Combines well with Seed of Life when the target of both enchantments is under heavy attack (e.g. a character tanking).
* One of the better enchantments to use with any way of extending Monk Enchantments, such as the Of Enchanting Weapon upgrade and Blessed Aura due to how this enchantment improves its effectiveness the longer it lasts.
* For characters upholding Melandru's Accord, unlocking Tahlkora will not unlock this skill for other heroes or skill trainers. As a result, it only becomes available much later in Nightfall, in the Desolation or the Gate of Torment instead of Istan.
6bbb4c7e23c4cb7ae074833c93401f3d602d482b.text:
* 每次受到攻擊時，傷害減免都會增加。第一次攻擊的 傷害 將減少 5，第二次攻擊的傷害將減少 10，第三次攻擊的傷害將減少 15，依此類推，直到結界結束或重鑄。
* 此技能對於吸收大量傷害的坦克特別有用。對於被快速擊中的低裝甲等級坦克，將此技能與 精神連結 結合非常有益，因為 精神連結 首先負責維持坦克，然後 吸收盾 通常會將任何傷害降至零。
* 當兩個結界的目標都受到猛烈攻擊時（例如角色坦克），與 生命 的種子很好地結合。
* 與任何擴充套件 僧侶 結界的方式一起使用的更好的結界之一，例如 附魔、元件 和 祝福靈氣，因為這種結界隨著持續時間的延長而提高其有效性。
* 對於支援梅蘭朵協議的角色，解鎖塔爾科拉不會為其他英雄或技能訓練師解鎖該技能。因此，它直到很晚才在 黑暗逆襲、荒蕪之地 或 苦痛之門（而不是 艾斯坦）中變得可用。

* Serpent's Quickness can be maintained indefinitely while the user is enchanted with Dwarven Stability: with a Deldrimor rank of 2, the user needs a Wilderness Survival rank of 12; if the Deldrimor rank is 5 or higher, only rank 8 Wilderness Survival is required.
* Serpent's Quickness will not reduce its own recharge, since stances end before being reapplied.
* Serpent's Quickness will not end unless direct damage is dealt to the player while under 50% health. As such, it will not end early due to health sacrifice or degeneration.
* Serpent's Quickness has a reduced effect on skills with short recharge times due to rounding. For example, Quick Shot's recharge time would be unaffected (i.e. a 33% reduction would be 0.67 seconds, which rounds back up to 1 second).

* 蛇之敏捷 不會減少自身的充能，因為姿態在重新應用之前就結束了。
* 蛇之敏捷 除非在以下情況下對玩家造成直接傷害，否則不會結束 50% 健康。因此，它不會因健康犧牲或退化而提前結束。
* 蛇之敏捷 由於四捨五入，對恢復時間短的技能的影響會降低。例如， 風速之箭 的充電時間將不受影響（即 33% 減少將是 0.67 秒，四捨五入到 1 第二）。

8269c815eacb12b882d4dedd33017b419fc3f776.source:
* Each time a character learns a new elite, they gain another point of progress in the relevant Skill Hunter title track.
* Unlike other skills, it is possible to obtain multiple copies of Signet of Capture.
* This skill counts as a PvE skill:
** It cannot be equipped for PvP or by heroes.
** You can equip up to three copies of this signet on your skill bar.
** Although this allows you to have multiple elites after capturing, when you zone, you will be left with only one elite.
*** The game will drop any extra elites on the left side of the skill bar.
*** You may rearrange your skills so that the skill you wish to keep is on the right before you zone.
* This skill cannot be Echoed, unlocked, or learned by using a skill tome.
* Non-fleshy bosses leave a spot on the ground rather than a visible corpse.

Signet of Capture's actual range is larger than earshot.

=== Dialogue (if no skills for your professions) ===
: No valid skills were found. You can only capture skills that correspond to your profession.
8269c815eacb12b882d4dedd33017b419fc3f776.text:
* 每次角色學習新的精英時，他們都會在相關的 技能獵人 標題曲目中獲得另一個進步點。
* 與其他技能不同，捕捉紋章 可以獲得多個副本。
* 此技能算 PvE 技能：
** 它不能為 PvP 或英雄裝備。
** 您的技能欄上最多可以裝備三個此印章。
** 雖然這允許你在佔領後擁有多個精英，但當你進行分割槽時，你將只剩下一個精英。
*** 遊戲將在技能欄左側掉落任何額外的精英。
*** 您可以重新排列您的技能，以便您希望保留的技能位於您區域之前的右側。
* 此技能無法回顯、解鎖或透過使用技能書學習。
* 非肉體的 Boss 會在地面上留下一個點，而不是一具可見的屍體。

捕捉紋章 的實際範圍比聽力範圍更大。

=== 對話（如果沒有適合您職業的技能）===
：沒有找到有效的技能。您只能獲得與您的職業相對應的技能。

abc992298f8224bb544da57236ed4ab0b69666f0.source:
* The additional damage from this skill happens before Anguish's damage-doubling property comes into effect.
* If you use this signet on a target that is not a summoned ally, the nearest allied summoned creature within spell range of your target will be affected. If there are no allied summoned creatures within spell range of your target, you will receive the message "Invalid Spell Target". This can prove useful as it allows you to affect summons that might be too far away to target directly or to quickly affect a summon that is likely to attack the foe you are targeting.
abc992298f8224bb544da57236ed4ab0b69666f0.text:
* 此技能的額外傷害發生在苦惱的傷害加倍屬性生效之前。
* 如果你對非召喚盟友的目標使用此印章，則距離你目標法術範圍最近的盟友召喚生物將受到影響。如果你的目標的法術範圍內沒有盟友召喚的生物，你將收到訊息「無效的咒文魔法 目標」。這可以證明是有用的，因為它可以讓你影響距離太遠而無法直接瞄準的召喚，或快速影響可能攻擊你瞄準的敵人的召喚。

48fe81dfc2bba2f8fbbf985185d0c70e8fe25e52.source:
* This skill will disable all of the target's elite skills.
** Players can have multiple elites by copying skills (e.g. using Arcane Larceny or a Signet of Capture). In addition, several monster skills can also capture elites.
** A small number of NPCs have multiple elites.
48fe81dfc2bba2f8fbbf985185d0c70e8fe25e52.text:
* 該技能會停用目標的所有精英技能。
** 玩家可以透過複製技能（例如使用 盜竊魔法 或 捕捉紋章）擁有多個菁英。另外，幾個怪物技能還可以捕獲精英。
** 少數NPC擁有多個精英。
48fe81dfc2bba2f8fbbf985185d0c70e8fe25e52.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

cc3ffe0d6b6b51513ca7dc4a80ebe9d1833628e8.source:
* Consider using this with Plague Touch or Plague Sending for a second blind.
* Consider using with condition spreading skills such as Epidemic for spreading blind to mobs.
* The AI will only use this skill on a foe wielding a martial weapon, regardless of it being Normal or Hard mode. This is similar to Eruption, but unlike Blinding Flash and Throw Dirt. 
** The AI uses this skill on spirits which are immune to all conditions except burning.
cc3ffe0d6b6b51513ca7dc4a80ebe9d1833628e8.text:
* 考慮將其與 疫病之觸 或 散播疫病 一起使用作為第二個盲板。
* 考慮使用條件傳播技能，例如病症擴散，以盲目地向小怪傳播。
* AI只會對使用軍用武器的敵人使用此技能，無論是普通武器還是困難模式。這與 火山爆發 類似，但與 眩目之光 和 揚塵 不同。 
** AI對靈魂使用此技能，這些靈魂免疫除燃燒之外的所有條件。
cc3ffe0d6b6b51513ca7dc4a80ebe9d1833628e8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

7e4ba34f642daaf329173f6826367cdf40f27f40.source:
* This skill will affect both targeted enchantments targeted at the caster as well as all untargeted enchantment spells (which include party-wide enchantments such as Aegis).
** Combines well with Mystic Healing and Orders build skills.
** Consider using this signet to cast Eternal Aura instantly to resurrect allies in mid-battle.
* Even though enchantments are made to cast instantly, they are still queued and cannot be cast while moving, knocked down etc.
* Unlike Flash enchantments, this skill does not cause enchantments to bypass aftercast delay.

The counter does not reset if the signet is recast before the original duration ends.
7e4ba34f642daaf329173f6826367cdf40f27f40.text:
* 此技能將影響以施法者為目標的有針對性的結界以及所有非目標結界法術（包括全隊範圍的結界，例如 神賜之盾）。
** 與 治癒秘法 和訂單建立技能完美結合。
** 考慮使用此徽記立即施放永恆光環，以在戰鬥中復活盟友。
* 即使結界是立即施放的，它們仍然會排隊並且無法在移動、擊倒等情況下施放。
* 與閃光結界不同，此技能不會導致結界繞過施法後延遲。

如果在原始持續時間結束之前重新鑄造圖章，計數器不會重置。
7e4ba34f642daaf329173f6826367cdf40f27f40.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* Using with Vital Boon or Faithful Intervention can provide a large healing boost.
* Can be combined with Pious Renewal to create quickly recharging skill chain for healing and managing energy.
As long as the user is under the effects of a Dervish enchantment when attempting to activate this skill, Signet of Pious Light will recharge in 5 seconds, regardless of other effects.
96c29d423ae4c265340bce771ce8026d70351b27.text:

只要使用者在嘗試啟動此技能時處於 神喚使 結界的效果下，無論其他效果如何，虔誠之光的 紋章 都會在 5 秒內重新充電。

08a66602a7624cac435cac2fdb6e89dc9cf87b2b.source:
* You lose exactly 8 energy from the -4 pips over 6 seconds.
* If the signet is renewed before it ends, the caster will gain energy for each time the skill was activated.
* This skill will provide more total energy gain per second than Ether Signet.
* Signet of Recall is particularly useful:
**When encountering heavy energy denial, e.g. from a Mursaat Tower (the energy degeneration from Signet of Recall will have no effect since your energy has already been depleted).
**When you already have Ether Signet on your skill bar and need even more energy without having to use skills that require energy. 
**When you are facing many short battles (since Signet of Recall can be used right before the battle, during which time the energy degeneration is not disadvantageous).
**When energy hiding, you will not lose any energy from this skill while your current energy is 0.
08a66602a7624cac435cac2fdb6e89dc9cf87b2b.text:
* 您在 6 秒內從 -4 點中損失了確切的 8 能量。
* 如果印章在結束前被更新，施法者每次啟動技能都會獲得能量。
* 此技能每秒提供的總能量增益比 精神紋章 更多。
* 紋章 或 回歸 特別好：
**當遇到嚴重的能量拒絕時，例如來自 馬賽特 塔（紋章 或 回歸 的能量衰減不會產生任何影響，因為您的能量已經耗盡）。
**當您的技能欄上已經有 精神紋章 並且需要更多能量而無需使用需要能量的技能。 
**當你面對很多短時間的戰鬥時（因為紋章或回歸可以在戰鬥前使用，在此期間能量衰退並不不利）。
**當能量隱藏時，當你目前的能量為0時，你不會因為該技能而損失任何能量。
08a66602a7624cac435cac2fdb6e89dc9cf87b2b.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f7ffb856a09335406eb701247da961e657be3900.source: * Heroes use this skill as a general heal and do not make active attempts to achieve the conditional heal.
f7ffb856a09335406eb701247da961e657be3900.text: * 英雄使用此技能作為一般治療，並且不會主動嘗試實現有條件治療。

1a238100a4d354891e0395be10b5d17a1c5954da.source:
*This skill removes a hex and then removes a condition.
*Since it has no energy cost and needs an enchanted target, this skill is useful for bonders, as well as any Protection Prayers monk builds that need passive energy management.
*Useful for self-removal of hex spells that trigger on casting a spell, such as Shame, Mark of Subversion or Backfire, since they can be removed without triggering their effect.
1a238100a4d354891e0395be10b5d17a1c5954da.text:
*此技能會移除一個六角形，然後移除一個條件。
*由於它沒有能量消耗並且需要一個附魔目標，因此該技能對於繫結者以及任何需要被動能量管理的 防護祈禱 僧侶構建非常有用。
*對於施放咒語時觸發的十六進位咒語的自我移除很有用，例如羞愧、破壞印記或魔力反噬，因為它們可以在不觸發其效果的情況下被移除。
1a238100a4d354891e0395be10b5d17a1c5954da.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

aa7328eab7a8a07d193f327d023eaa8fb938d86a.source:
* This skill summons a Spirit of Anger, a Spirit of Hate and a Spirit of Suffering. These spirits use the Pain attack skill.
* This skill triggers effects of skills like Boon of Creation, Spirit's Gift and Explosive Growth on all three spirits.
* Combines with Feast of Souls for a cheap powerful party heal.
* Combines well with Shaman's Insignia for +15 armor rating.
aa7328eab7a8a07d193f327d023eaa8fb938d86a.text:
* 此技能召喚憤怒之靈、仇恨之靈和苦難之靈。這些精靈使用苦痛攻擊技能。
* 此技能對所有三個靈魂觸發創物者恩賜、生靈天賦和爆發增長等技能的效果。
* 與 生靈饗宴 結合使用，可提供廉價且強大的派對治療效果。
* 與薩滿的 徽記 完美結合，獲得 +15 護甲等級。
aa7328eab7a8a07d193f327d023eaa8fb938d86a.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

3a6bdada08a88ce313158fe92a67f0c793d29e01.source:
* The main difference of this skill compared to its related elite counterparts is the fact that it is a signet. Offering of Spirit is a spell which has a faster activation time, grants more energy, and has a shorter recharge (especially if using weapons providing HCT and HSR), on top of that it also ensures energy gain even when not within earshot of a spirit. Spirit Channeling can return much more energy but is an enchantment and requires investment in Spawning Power.
* Spirit Siphon in particular, but also Signet of Creation and Boon of Creation (both in Spawning Power) are good, non-elite alternatives if your build uses several spirits.
3a6bdada08a88ce313158fe92a67f0c793d29e01.text:
* 此技能與相關菁英技能的主要區別在於它是印章。 生靈奉獻 是一個具有更快啟用時間、提供更多能量且充電時間更短的法術（特別是使用提供 HCT 和 HSR 的武器時），最重要的是，即使不在靈魂的聽力範圍內，它也能確保能量增益。 導引之靈 可以返回更多能量，但它是一種附魔，需要對 召喚 進行投資。
* 尤其是 靈能吸收，如果您的構建使用多種烈酒，那麼 創造紋章 和 創物者恩賜（均在 召喚 中）都是不錯的非精英替代品。
3a6bdada08a88ce313158fe92a67f0c793d29e01.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

5d629637fbe1705790607c28259d043a6024e4c3.source:
*Useful for running as the Health boost cannot be removed unless the user plans to attack.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
*When used for running, consider temporarily switching to an armor piece with a rune of superior strength before activating this signet.
*Can be used in conjunction with Illusionary Weaponry because Signet of Stamina won't end when you swing your weapon.
*Can be used by a mesmer to good effect with Symbolic Celerity.
5d629637fbe1705790607c28259d043a6024e4c3.text:
*對於跑步很有用，因為除非使用者規劃攻擊，否則 體力 增強無法被刪除。
* 沒有持續時間（這是少數無需維護即可無限期持續的技能之一）。
*用於奔跑時，請考慮在啟動此印章之前暫時切換到具有超強度符文的盔甲。
*可以與 幻象武器 一起使用，因為當您揮動武器時 耐力紋章 不會結束。
*幻術師可以與 迅捷標誌 一起使用，效果良好。
5d629637fbe1705790607c28259d043a6024e4c3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

f126906e62eaa8f383d9c7322d69ca2d2e996efa.source:
* This skill loses charges depending on the number of foes struck, not the number of swings. For example, if Signet of Strength had 5 charges (Strength attribute of 4) and a Warrior using it used Cyclone Axe against five foes, all five charges of Signet of Strength would be expended in a single swing.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
f126906e62eaa8f383d9c7322d69ca2d2e996efa.text:
* 此技能損失的能量取決於擊中敵人的數量，而不是揮動的次數。例如，如果 力量紋章 具有 5 費用（4 的 力量 屬性），並且使用它的 戰士 使用 旋風斧 對抗五個敵人，則 力量紋章 的所有五個費用將在一次揮動中消耗掉。
* 沒有持續時間（這是少數無需維護即可無限期持續的技能之一）。
f126906e62eaa8f383d9c7322d69ca2d2e996efa.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0e6bc3df421dcbb86c87eb216bd4aacf243568c3.source:
* Bleeding will be applied first when using a skill; this means it will trigger the conditional effects of skills such as Oppressive Gaze, Vile Miasma, and Necrosis.
* Works well with Angorodon's Gaze and Ulcerous Lungs.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
Even though it has no activation time, this signet (similar to Dolyak Signet) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an action.
After being resurrected, if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.
0e6bc3df421dcbb86c87eb216bd4aacf243568c3.text:
* 使用技能時會先套用流血；這表示它將觸發沉重的凝視、惡劣毒氣和壞死等技能的條件效果。
* 與 安哥羅頓 的 Gaze 和 肺臟腐蝕 搭配得很好。
* 沒有持續時間（這是少數無需維護即可無限期持續的技能之一）。
儘管沒有啟動時間，但該圖章（類似於 石犛牛紋章）在被擊倒或執行動作時無法使用。
復活後，如果玩家在站立動畫中間使用該技能，他們將不會開始流血。
0e6bc3df421dcbb86c87eb216bd4aacf243568c3.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

*Simple Thievery will only recharge normally if no skill was copied. If a skill was copied, Simple Thievery is disabled for 10 seconds after the copy effect ends.

460798111adec342b137f3f8d64bcf6f395d95e0.text:
*簡易竊取只有在沒有複製技能的情況下才會正常儲值。如果技能被複製，則複製效果結束後，簡易竊取 會在 10 秒內停用。
*如果阻止該技能打斷該技能，則該技能不會停用並成為該技能的複製版本。

For example, if an assassin uses Death's Charge on an elementalist enchanted with Sliver Armor, the assassin will take damage from Sliver Armor before being healed by Death's Charge.
ad3fab8bebddc74e984e64142410a77446dc5d33.text: * 傷害 在法術施展後、法術效果發生前直接發出。例如，如果刺客對被 裂片護甲 附魔的元素使使用 索命，則刺客將受到 裂片護甲 的傷害，然後被 索命 治療。

17306c745384335c67bd2d43afaebb1c81ea3bce.source:
* If you interrupt with this skill (while target is Dazed for example), the interrupt occurs first, then the bonus damage is applied, even if the target was using a skill.
* Consider using along with shutdown methods, such as interrupts, to give yourself a window of time in which to hit.

*Using Shadow Sanctuary while under this chant will not make you lose blindness. This is because you are blinded after this skill's effect is activated.

*Synergy with Wearying Spear.
Re-application does not reset the number of uses remaining until the original application would have ended. It appears to count any skill uses against both applications, and the chant will end if the number of uses remaining from the original application reaches 0.

*與 衰竭之矛 協同作用。
重新申請不會重置剩餘的使用次數，直到原始申請結束為止。它似乎會計算兩個應用程式的任何技能使用情況，如果原始應用程式剩餘的使用次數達到 0，則吟唱將結束。

* This skill will still deal damage if an enchantment or hex is renewed, whether by being recast or by reapplying itself (such as with Critical Defenses, Lyssa's Aura, Kinetic Armor, or Recurring Insecurity).
* Damage occurs when the enemy gains the effect of an enchantment or hex. Accordingly:
** Using an enchantment spell on an enemy will not trigger Soul Barbs damage.
** Spells that only count as hexes under certain conditions, such as Lightning Strike or Ash Blast, will not trigger Soul Barbs damage unless their condition is met.
8897a1f8dfe3e581601a644566d27c7df6b881a4.text:
* 如果結界或妖術被更新，無論是透過重鑄或重新應用（例如使用 致命防禦、麗莎靈氣、魔動護甲 或 危險迴圈），此技能仍會造成傷害。
* 傷害 當敵人獲得結界或妖術效果時發生。因此：
** 對敵人使用結界法術不會觸發 靈魂荊棘 傷害。
** 在某些條件下僅算十六進位的法術（例如 閃電衝擊 或 塵暴）不會觸發 靈魂荊棘 傷害，除非滿足其條件。

* Damage caused by this skill is applied before the healing takes effect. This is important for healing skills targeting yourself as it is possible to die from using such skills when having low health.
* This skill affects only skills that directly heal. It does not affect Divine Favor healing, health gain due to life stealing or Vigorous Spirit's effect, the additional healing due to Divine Boon, health regeneration and similar effects.
** This skill will only damage foes of the caster, therefore skills such as Healing Ring which heal foes who are hexed by this, will not trigger the damage back to your ally or yourself.
9f2ebbef0e39aa8aa99ac7aafb58cdcde61b83bc.text:
* 此技能造成的傷害在治療生效前應用。這對於針對自己的治療技能很重要，因為在生命值較低時使用此類技能可能會導致死亡。
* 此技能僅影響直接治療的技能。它不會影響 神恩 治療、因生命竊取或 精力充沛 效果而獲得的生命值、由於 神之恩賜 導致的額外治療、健康再生和類似效果。
** 此技能只會對施法者的敵人造成傷害，因此諸如 治療光環 之類的治癒被該技能施咒的敵人的技能不會將傷害觸發回你的盟友或你自己。

5969de753889a949b36a25d4fc37ba31faf99f40.source:
* The Burning duration is applied every second and matches the amount of Overcast removed.
** Under all attribute ranks, Burning is continuous for the purpose of skills like Fragility and Contagion (unless the condition is removed, in which case it will be reapplied the next second).
* Combine with Frigid Armor to prevent the burning on the user.
* Can be used to counteract the overcast building effects of Over the Limit or Iron Mist.
* Although not stated in the skill description, the enchantment automatically ends when the user has no overcast.
* Unlike the PvE-only elite skills, the descriptions fail to mention that this is a PvE skill.
* At low Energy Storage ranks, Purifying Veil prevents burning on the user entirely. Recovery is, as noted on the skill's own page, a reduction in duration and requires more than 50% reduction to reduce a 1 second duration burn to a value that is rounded to 0.
The animation of the Burning condition does not occur the first time the skill is used in an explorable area.
5969de753889a949b36a25d4fc37ba31faf99f40.text:
* 燃燒持續時間每秒應用一次，並與移除的陰暗量相符。
** 在所有屬性等級下，對於 脆弱 和 病症蔓延 等技能來說，燃燒是連續的（除非條件被移除，在這種情況下，它將在下一秒重新應用）。
* 與冰凍護甲結合使用可防止灼傷使用者。
* 可用來抵銷 Over the Limit 或 鐵之迷霧 的陰天建築效果。
* 雖然技能說明中沒有說明，但當使用者沒有陰氣時，結界會自動結束。
* 與僅限PvE的精英技能不同，描述中沒有提及這是PvE技能。
* 當 能量儲存 等級較低時，淨化面紗可以完全防止使用者被灼傷。如同技能本身頁面所述，痊癒 是持續時間的減少，並且需要比 50% 減少更多的時間才能將 1 第二個持續時間燃燒減少到四捨五入到 0 的值。
第一次在可探索區域使用此技能時，不會出現燃燒狀態的動畫。
5969de753889a949b36a25d4fc37ba31faf99f40.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

04a4b7d7f8a206d6f292b9288b424b7fedb3cb18.source:
* Usually combined with Dark Aura for AoE armor-ignoring damage.
** Live Vicariously can help offset the health loss of Dark Aura.
* The health sacrifice occurs for each hit rather than for each attack, so skills such as Cyclone Axe or Whirlwind Attack can trigger the health sacrifice multiple times, while skills such as Vigorous Spirit will trigger once, and Illusionary Weaponry will not trigger it at all.
** Blood Bond can help offset the health sacrifice.
** This can lead to a spike when combined with Dark Aura.
* The health sacrifice occurs even if the attack misses or is blocked.
* The concise description is correct: the damage is armor-ignoring bonus damage.

The health sacrifice does not appear on the damage monitor.
04a4b7d7f8a206d6f292b9288b424b7fedb3cb18.text:
* 通常與 暗黑靈氣 結合使用，以產生 範圍性 護甲忽略傷害。
** 生命代理 可以幫助抵銷 暗黑靈氣 造成的健康損失。
* 生命犧牲是針對每次擊中而非每次攻擊，因此諸如 旋風斧 或 旋風 Attack 之類的技能可以多次觸發生命犧牲，而諸如 精力充沛 之類的技能只會觸發一次，而 幻象武器 則根本不會觸發。
** 血之連結 可以幫助抵消健康犧牲。
** 與 暗黑靈氣 結合使用時，可能會導致峰值。
* 即使攻擊未命中或被阻擋，也會造成生命值犧牲。

健康犧牲不會出現在傷害監視器上。

*閃電之矛和閃電標槍是僅有的兩個使用這種線形效果區域的技能。

* The count is refreshed when recast.
* Contrary to the description, Spirit Bond will heal whenever an ally would take a damage packet above 50, even if it is reduced to 50 or below by other means, such as Protective Spirit or Shield of Absorption.
** Spirit Bond and Protective Spirit make the basis for the "600" monk in the 600/smite team used for farming.
* This skill can be used to mitigate the downside of skills that cause double damage (such as Frenzied Defense) or armor reduction on their user. 
* Spirit Bond will trigger its healing before the damage is registered.
Contrary to the descriptions, Spirit Bond will only end prematurely if it triggers ten times.

7b3ba53acf3936b5c95ac547c05d5b0b4e157b05.text:

* 與描述相反，每當盟友受到高於 50 的傷害包時，精神連結 就會得到治療，即使透過其他方式（例如 精神守護 或 吸收盾）將其降低到 50 或更低。
** 精神連結 和 精神守護 是用於耕作的 600/smite 團隊中「600」武僧的基礎。
* 此技能可用於減輕造成雙倍傷害（例如 狂暴防禦）或降低使用者護甲的技能的負面影響。

儘管會造成治療，觸發技能治療不會導致 災禍治癒 或 靈魂束縛 造成傷害。

7869e0f31c1b3254cc2ea1db69b3e04a69c37b70.source:
* Spirits have four pips of energy regeneration; they regain their maximum energy (30 energy) in about 23 seconds.
** In Hard mode, enemy spirits have 41 energy, making them a better source.
** Spirits do not use energy to attack, so Spirit Siphon will not reduce their effectiveness.
* When used on multiple spirits, this skill allows for better energy returns over Offering of Spirit or Signet of Spirits (PvP).
* This skill always targets the spirit closest to the caster. If two or more spirits are equal distance, the target is chosen at random.
** There is no effect unless the closest spirit is within casting range; however, the skill will activate (and waste energy) with spirits outside of casting range or without spirits at all.
7869e0f31c1b3254cc2ea1db69b3e04a69c37b70.text:
* 精神有四點能量再生；它們在大約 23 秒內恢復最大能量（30 能量）。
** 在 困難模式 中，敵方靈魂擁有 41 能量，使它們成為更好的來源。
** 靈魂不會使用能量進行攻擊，因此 靈能吸收 不會降低其效果。
* 當對多個靈魂使用時，此技能可以比 生靈奉獻 或 縛靈紋章 (PvP) 提供更好的能量回報。
* 此技能總是以距離施法者最近的靈魂為目標。如果兩個或多個靈魂距離相等，則隨機選擇目標。
** 除非最近的靈魂在施法範圍內，否則沒有效果；然而，當靈魂超出施法範圍或根本沒有靈魂時，該技能將啟用（並浪費能量）。

c7c45991fb38e32acb6f4e3b84a0b186dc54d60a.source:
* This skill works on both allied and enemy spirits.
** Allied spirits that are good candidates for this spell are Bloodsong and Vampirism (since they heal themselves with their attacks), along with Destruction and Life (since they effect upon death).
** The range of the spell is casting range, making it useful even in the remote vicinity of a spirit.
Can be cast while targeting a spirit, in which case the spirit will lose health and no one will be healed.
c7c45991fb38e32acb6f4e3b84a0b186dc54d60a.text:
* 此技能對我方和敵人的靈魂都有效。
** 適合此法術的友軍精魂有血歌和吸血鬼（因為它們透過攻擊來治癒自己），以及 毀滅 和 生命（因為它們在死亡時生效）。

可以在瞄準靈魂時施放，在這種情況下，靈魂會失去生命值，並且沒有人會被治癒。

** Using Animate Shambling Horror will trigger this skill two times eventually: once when the Shambling Horror is animated, and then once again when it dies and a Jagged Horror is spawned.
** Jagged Horrors created via Jagged Bones will trigger this skill.
* The healing occurs before any effect that can happen due to a spirit's death when renewing it ; therefore the condition "below 90% Health" of Lacerate and Edge of Extinction will be checked after the healing, but the bleeding from Lacerate will not be removed if applied.
b77e855b49e8e7e6267c2d59dc6f08bbc83578b3.text:

** 使用 操縱骸骨爪牙、巫妖靈氣 或 縛靈紋章 時建立的每個生物都會同時觸發此技能。
** 使用 操縱爬行骸骨 最終會觸發該技能兩次：一次是在蹣跚恐怖生物動畫時觸發，另一次是在它死亡並生成鋸齒恐怖生物時觸發。
** 透過 鋸齒骸骨 建立的鋸齒恐怖將觸發此技能。
* 在更新靈魂時，治療會發生在因靈魂死亡而可能發生的任何效果之前；因此，癒合後會檢查撕裂和滅絕之地的「低於90% 體力」的情況，但如果應用撕裂的出血，則不會被消除。

* Spoil Victor or alternatively Spiteful Spirit can be used for solo farming. 
** Spoil Victor is especially effective for characters with low health, typically 55hp, as the character will almost always have low health and meet the requirement.
* This skill will trigger when a healer casts a healing spell on an ally with less health; however, self-targeting a healing spell will not cause health loss. Resurrecting an ally with a spell will also trigger Spoil Victor.
5951b794e8b2c1735682d44a75067dd6602edcb1.text:

* 勝者的掠奪 或 惡靈附身 可用於單獨耕種。 
** 勝者的掠奪 對於生命值較低的角色尤其有效，通常是 55hp，因為角色幾乎總是具有較低的生命值並滿足要求。

* Effective against Assassins who use Critical Strikes to manage their energy.
* As with any doublecast skill, NPCs will use this skill as soon as there is an enemy within the spell's area of effect range of an ally.
* Foes suffer two damage packets if the caster is targeted.
* If a foe is targeted when Stone Sheath is cast, then the enchantment will automatically target the ally nearest to the foe.
7593b7ca3a1309077b62365be4aa84faab32cde7.text:

* 與任何雙施技能一樣，只要盟友的法術效果範圍內有敵人，NPC 就會使用該技能。

78092e450d5e37af077f7e387622a9265e752363.source:
This also converts chaos, dark, holy and spirit attacks damage types into earth damage.[Source claim needs verification]
This skill does not convert damage but instead forces the damage type of all dealt damage to be earth damage. For example when applying Winter on top of stone striker, physical damage is not converted into earth damage, since winter has no effect on it - it still considers the damage to be of physical type. This is irrespective of which damage converting skill is used first.
* While under this effect, outgoing attacks do not benefit from Conjure spells and (if melee) do benefit from Ebon Dust Aura.
** This is the case even when conflicting damage type conversions are in effect, regardless of the order they are applied. Most other skills (such as Dust Cloak and Grenth's Fingers) use the most recently applied effect for this purpose instead.
* Good synergy with Mantra of Earth or Storm Chaser.
* Consider using with Geomancer Insignia, Earthbound Insignia and a shield or focus item with a "Like a Rolling Stone" inscription.
78092e450d5e37af077f7e387622a9265e752363.text:
這也將混沌、黑暗、神聖和精神攻擊傷害型別轉換為大地傷害。 [來源宣告需要驗證]
此技能不會轉換傷害，而是強制所有造成的傷害的傷害型別為土屬性傷害。例如，當在石頭前鋒上應用 寒冬 時，物理傷害不會轉換為地球傷害，因為冬天對其沒有影響 - 它仍然認為傷害是物理型別的。這與首先使用哪種傷害轉換技能無關。
*在此效果下，傳出攻擊不會從召喚法術中受益，並且（如果是近戰）從 烏塵靈氣 中受益。
** 即使衝突的傷害型別轉換生效，情況也是如此，無論它們的應用順序如何。大多數其他技能（例如 塵土掩蔽 和 古蘭斯之指）都會使用最近應用的效果來實現此目的。
* 與 大地頌歌 或 追風者 具有良好的協同作用。
* 考慮與風水師 徽記、Earthbound 徽記 以及帶有“Like a Rolling Stone”銘文的盾牌或焦點物品一起使用。
78092e450d5e37af077f7e387622a9265e752363.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* This skill reduces all types of damage, including armor-ignoring damage.
* This is a popular damage reduction skill for farming, sometimes coupled with Protective Spirit (cast before Stoneflesh Aura) with less than 330 health, to ensure losing no health at all. This build is known as the 330Hp, similarly to the 600 and 55 Monk build.
* When removed with a damaging removal skill, such as Shatter Enchantment, the damage from the removal will still be reduced.
* This skill can be particularly effective against Assassins, as many of their builds deal much of their damage through critical hits and rely on them for energy management.
This enchantment does not actually make you immune to critical hits, but prevents extra damage from them. As such, effects that may result from them, such as knock down, or the re-applying effect of Critical Agility and Critical Defenses will still apply. However, the damage-nullified critical hit will not trigger the energy gain of Critical Strikes.
35b46095ff6cdc57d7d3b0e56e1d3fd06e0a7f3e.text:
* 此技能可以減少所有型別的傷害，包括無視護甲的傷害。
* 這是一種流行的農業減傷技能，有時與生命值低於 330 的 精神守護（在 石體靈氣 之前施放）結合使用，以確保完全不損失生命值。此版本稱為 330Hp，類似 600 和 55 僧侶 版本。
* 當使用具有破壞性的移除技能（例如 加持粉碎）移除時，移除造成的傷害仍會減少。
* 這項技能對刺客特別有效，因為他們的許多建築物通過重擊造成大部分傷害，並依賴他們進行能量管理。
這個結界其實並不能讓你免疫重擊，但可以防止它們造成額外傷害。因此，它們可能產生的效果，例如擊倒或 薄暮之速 和 致命防禦 的重新應用效果仍然適用。然而，傷害無效的致命一擊不會觸發 致命攻擊 的能量增益。

5ee59b1dbb7c36192c29039b7edc5b5098335ebd.source:
* Combat stats at level 20 (rank 5 or above): 
** It will normally do three attacks between Stoning with one cast every 6 seconds. However, it benefits from its staff's chance for half recharge time of spells 20% of the time. On these occasions it will complete its second normal attack at 2.625 seconds before casting Stoning again (see Activation Time and Attack speed). 
** Its normal attacks deal between 16 and 46 earth damage on targets with 60 armor, and can benefit from weapon spells.
** It has 15 in Earth Magic.
** It has enough energy to use stoning 10 times during its lifespan, and will use it 9-10 times depending on the staff's recharge effect. As such, using a skill that reduces recharge time, like Ebon Battle Standard of Wisdom, will not have any noticable effect unless combined with a skill that grants energy. 
* When the summon dies, it leaves a non-exploitable corpse. 
* The summoned Naga is not infused against Spectral Agony.
* Its Stoning works best if one or more members of the party inflict Weakness on targets. However, it will not always cast the spell on weakened foes.
* It is considered a non-spirit ally.

The description is misleading: you can have one active Asura Summon per player.
5ee59b1dbb7c36192c29039b7edc5b5098335ebd.text:
* 20 等級的戰鬥統計資料（等級 5 或以上）：
** 它通常會在 石箭 之間進行 3 次攻擊，每 6 秒施放一次。然而，它受益於其員工有機會獲得當時 20% 法術充能時間的一半。在這些情況下，它會在 2.625 秒內完成第二次普通攻擊，然後再次施放 石箭（請參閱 施展時間 和攻擊速度）。 
** 它的普通攻擊對具有 60 護甲的目標造成 16 和 46 之間的土系傷害，並且可以從武器法術中受益。
** 地系魔法 中有 15。
** 它有足夠的能量在其生命週期內使用石擊10次，並且根據法杖的充能效果將使用9-10次。因此，使用減少充能時間的技能，例如 智慧者 的 黑檀 戰旗，除非與賦予能量的技能結合使用，否則不會產生任何明顯的效果。 
* 當召喚物死亡時，它會留下一具不可利用的屍體。 
* 召喚的 納迦 並未註入對抗幽靈痛苦的能力。

* 它被認為是非精神盟友。

這個描述具有誤導性：每個玩家可以擁有一個有效的 阿蘇拉 召喚。

6ff2c70132ec671fcf6ef0b8d90964a2b6de3c39.source:
* After reaching the first allegiance rank, Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, level 20 characters may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
* The skill icon for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
* This skill shadow steps all spirits you control in compass range to your location, thus has a greater range than Draw Spirit.
* This skill shares most of the quirks of other shadow steps:
** If the caster is standing on or below a bridge, the spirits may move to either side of the bridge; this is consistent with the game's inability to understand three dimensions.
** If a spirit is targeted by an area damage over time spell, the area of effect sometimes moves with the spirit.
** Unlike other shadow steps, this will not cancel any skills the spirits were activating when stepping.
* If there are more than one spirit of the same type within compass range, the nearest shadow steps to your location and others are destroyed.
* Since Summon Spirits' range is about radar range and the limitation of duplicate allied spirits is about 3/5 of radar range, you can make tactical use of two sets of spirits as follows: When you come within radar range of the next anticipated battle location set up your 1st set of spirits and then move to that location. When your binding rituals recharge, set up a 2nd set of spirits and draw the opponents to them and use them as meat shield. When all or most of the 2nd set have died, cast Summon Spirits to draw the 1st set to the battle, even if the binding rituals have not yet recharged.
6ff2c70132ec671fcf6ef0b8d90964a2b6de3c39.text:
* 達到第一個效忠等級、庫茲柯/勒克森 支持者、20 等級角色後，可以從 庫茲柯理事 或 勒克森 拾荒者學習此技能，以用於 3,000 陣營值。
* 庫茲柯 版本的技能圖示位於頂部，勒克森 版本的技能圖示位於底部。
* 此技能影子將羅盤範圍內你控制的所有靈魂移動到你的位置，因此比靈之牽引有更大的範圍。
* 此技能與其他暗影步有大部分共同點：
** 如果施法者站在橋上或橋下，靈魂可能會移動到橋的兩側；這與遊戲無法理解三個維度的情況是一致的。
** 如果一個精魂成為區域持續傷害法術的目標，則效果範圍有時會隨著該精魂一起移動。
** 與其他暗影步不同，這不會取消靈魂在邁步時啟用的任何技能。
* 如果羅盤範圍內有多個相同型別的精魂，則距離您所在位置最近的暗影步和其他暗影步將被摧毀。
* 由於召喚精靈的範圍與雷達範圍有關，而重複盟友精靈的限制約為雷達範圍的 3/5，因此您可以如下戰術使用兩組精靈：當您進入下一個預期戰鬥位置的雷達範圍內時，設定您的 1st 組精靈，然後移動到該位置。當你的繫結儀式充能時，請設定一組 2nd 的靈魂並將對手吸引到它們身邊並將它們用作肉盾。當全部或大部分 2st 套裝死亡時，施放召喚靈魂以將 1st 套裝吸引到戰鬥中，即使繫結儀式尚未充能。

* The health gain at 12 Restoration Magic equals a health regeneration of 10.5 pips (21 pips within earshot of a spirit) and 13 pips at 16 Restoration Magic (26 pips within earshot of a spirit).

Contrary to the concise description, this skill's conditional effect causes health gain and not healing.

52abe293b1667bd7deeef32a937891c6d17e8afc.source:
* This skill triggers when the target fails to hit. Blocking with a skill, dodging a ranged attack, or even using the terrain to avoid being hit by a ranged attack will trigger the energy gain.
* Great synergy with other effects that further increase the chance to miss, notably the Blind condition, and to a lesser extent the hexes Blurred Vision, Calculated Risk, Price of Failure and Reckless Haste.
* Combine with Distortion for good blocking and energy management.
* As with blocking, "missed" hexes combine multiplicatively and not additively. Thus, a foe hexed with both Reckless Haste and Spirit of Failure has a 62.5% chance to miss with attacks.
52abe293b1667bd7deeef32a937891c6d17e8afc.text:
* 此技能在目標未擊中時觸發。使用技能格擋、躲避遠端攻擊、甚至利用地形來躲避遠端攻擊都會觸發能量增益。
* 與其他效果的巨大協同作用，進一步增加錯過的機會，特別是盲狀態，以及較小程度的十六進位 模糊視線、計算風險、失敗的代價 和 失心瘋。
* 與 迴避頌歌 結合使用，可實現良好的阻塞和能源管理。
* 與阻塞一樣，「錯過」的六角形是乘法而不是加法結合。因此，同時使用 失心瘋 和 失誤心靈 施咒的敵人有 62.5% 機會錯過攻擊。
52abe293b1667bd7deeef32a937891c6d17e8afc.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* This skill has a distinguishable animation during the 3 seconds before it takes effect, which makes it easy for players to avoid the damage.
* This spell will not fail if your target dies mid-cast.
b5ea6ddc1540bf485ab2e0599647154153ae3c77.text:

* 此技能在生效前的3秒內有可區分的動畫，方便玩家躲避傷害。
* 如果你的目標在施法過程中死亡，這個法術不會失敗。

624cbffbe4dcf32739a9b314befb71bb77b707c8.source:
* Foes in PvE will attack whenever they get the chance, making this skill a very potent way to deplete foes of their energy, provided they don't spam spells or other non-attack skills.
** In case they have a tendency to spam spells or other non-attack skills, disabling those or using Backfire (in case of spells) can be a reliable way to force them into attacking. 
** This allows to trigger Mind Wrack much more easily.
* Could be combined with Famine to cause damage.
624cbffbe4dcf32739a9b314befb71bb77b707c8.text:
* PvE中的敵人一有機會就會攻擊，這使得該技能成為消耗敵人能量的非常有效的方法，前提是他們不傳送垃圾法術或其他非攻擊技能。
** 如果他們有垃圾法術或其他非攻擊技能的傾向，停用這些技能或使用 魔力反噬（如果是法術）可能是迫使他們攻擊的可靠方法。 
** 這樣可以更輕鬆地觸發 心靈破壞。
* 可能與 飢荒 結合使用造成損壞。
624cbffbe4dcf32739a9b314befb71bb77b707c8.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

778069af66173e4599822e8d95c25582ddd0ab3f.source:
* The damage redirected to the user is calculated after the pet's armor, but before other damage reduction (by skills like Call of Protection). If you use this skill and you're taking too much damage, consider +armor rating skills for your pet rather than +damage reduction.
* If Balthazar's Spirit is also on the user, the energy gain triggers each time the pet takes damage.
* Being a shout, you can't end it if you're taking too much damage.
* The damage dealt to the user is typeless.
Upon reconnecting from a disconnect when having this skill active it will appear as a maintained enchantment. (See the discussion page for more information and screenshots.)
778069af66173e4599822e8d95c25582ddd0ab3f.text:
* 重定向到使用者的傷害是在寵物護甲之後計算的，但在其他傷害減免之前（透過 守護呼喊 等技能）計算。如果您使用此技能並且受到太多傷害，請考慮為您的寵物提供+護甲等級技能，而不是+傷害減少。
* 如果使用者身上也有 巴薩澤的精神，每次寵物受到傷害時都會觸發能量增益。
* 作為一個喊叫，如果你受到太多傷害，你就無法結束它。
* 對使用者造成的傷害是無型別的。
當啟動此技能時，從斷開連線重新連線後，它將顯示為維持的結界。 （有關更多資訊和螢幕截圖，請參閱討論頁面。）

8e76bb0bc63398447aee4a87de8e5dd31a60e286.source:
* This skill will remove existing Disease when applied, although this is not stated in its description. This is similar to other skills that provide immunity to a condition, except for Frigid Armor.
* Heroes will maintain this on themselves in combat, but will not recast it to enchant other allies.
Although this is a PBAoE skill with an effect centered around the caster, it still needs an allied target and you will run towards that target if not in cast range. Similar to Hex Eater Signet, the target won't be affected if it is not in range.
Because it is a targeted enchantment spell, it will always trigger Shame and Mark of Subversion. If standing in a Well of the Profane, you will be able to cast this enchantment if you pick any ally in cast range that is not inside the well.
8e76bb0bc63398447aee4a87de8e5dd31a60e286.text:
* 該技能在應用時將消除現有的疾病，儘管其描述中沒有說明。這與提供對某種狀況免疫的其他技能類似（冰凍護甲 除外）。
* 英雄會在戰鬥中將其保留在自己身上，但不會重鑄它來迷惑其他盟友。
雖然這是一個 PBAoE 技能，效果以施法者為中心，但它仍然需要一個盟友目標，如果不在施法範圍內，你就會跑向該目標。與 噬咒紋章 類似，如果目標不在範圍內，則不會受到影響。
因為它是一個有針對性的結界法術，所以它總是會觸發 羞愧 和 破壞印記。如果站在 褻瀆之池 中，如果您選擇施法範圍內不在井內的任何盟友，您將能夠施放此結界。

ab80a2c7ab6252a951ac60e93b67d431e7c81d1d.source:
* As with all life stealing, this skill can only heal you for the amount of health that the target has left. As such, be sure you target a minion with plenty of health if you need the healing effect.
* Can be combined with Death Nova, although Putrid Flesh may be preferred in that regard.
* The health of minions follows the formula health=level*20+80, so the life stealing is a guaranteed kill on minions with level equal to your level of Death Magic+1, unless the minion's health has been increased by Spawning Power. 
** Assuming a caster both summons the minion and steals health from it, and stays at the same Death Magic rank while doing so, the minion is guaranteed to die if it was a jagged horror or a bone minion. Any other minion (except Star Servant or Flesh Golem) will die if the caster is at rank 7 or less in Death Magic, and be left with maximum 20 health at higher ranks. Flesh Golems will lose around 70% of their health.
*** Can be used with Jagged Bones as a steady source of jagged horrors.
*** Using Aura of the Lich will spawn a bone horror and then increase the Death Magic rank by 1, effectively allowing to kill the summoned bone horror from full health at any Death Magic rank.
ab80a2c7ab6252a951ac60e93b67d431e7c81d1d.text:
* 就像所有生命竊取一樣，此技能只能治療你目標剩餘的生命值。因此，如果您需要治療效果，請確保您的目標是生命值充足的小兵。
* 可與 死亡新星 結合使用，儘管在這方面 惡臭肉體 可能是首選。
* 小兵的生命值遵循公式 health=level*20+80，因此生命竊取對於等級等於 死亡魔法+1 等級的小兵來說是有保證的，除非小兵的生命值已增加 召喚。 
** 假設施法者召喚該小兵並從中竊取生命值，並且在此過程中保持相同的 死亡魔法 等級，則如果該小兵是鋸齒狀恐怖物或骨頭小兵，則該小兵肯定會死亡。如果施法者在 死亡魔法 中的等級為 7 或更低，則任何其他隨從（星僕或 鮮血高崙 除外）都會死亡，並在更高等級時保留最大 20 生命值。血肉傀儡將失去大約 70% 的生命值。
*** 可與 鋸齒骸骨 一起使用，作為鋸齒狀恐怖的穩定來源。
*** 使用 巫妖靈氣 將產生骨頭恐怖，然後將 死亡魔法 等級提高 1，有效地允許在任何 死亡魔法 等級下以完全健康狀態殺死召喚的骨頭恐怖。
ab80a2c7ab6252a951ac60e93b67d431e7c81d1d.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

* Technobabble interrupt targets casting spells, an inherent effect of applying the Dazed condition.
* To Daze a boss, cast it on an adjacent foe.
** This skill will apply Dazed if the target is a boss-like foe, such as the Apocrypha or the Undead Lich. 

Exception: this skill will not daze Murakai, Lady of the Night, a boss-like foe.

Technobabble's damage respects armor, even though it deals untyped damage.
0c4784f5c2495941c47d09cd49f549e26a95323b.text:
* Technobabble 中斷目標施放法術，這是應用 暈眩 條件的固有效果。
* 若要迷惑 Boss，請將其施放於相鄰的敵人身上。
** 如果目標是類似 Boss 的敵人，例如 Apocrypha 或 不死系 巫妖，則該技能將套用 暈眩。 

例外：此技能不會使 夜之女 幕蘭凱（一個類似 Boss 的敵人）暈眩。

技術巴布的傷害與護甲有關，儘管它會造成無型別傷害。

c97fd5790b8cf6be88b96db6c1c9ce274ffa16a9.source:
* When you activate this skill, all Upkeep Enchantments you maintain will be removed.
* For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use Totem of Man as it is recharging.
* When the blessing ends, you get your original skill bar back and Ursan Blessing starts recharging.
* Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying bundles.
* Several effects do not end upon activating this skill: 
** Air of Superiority is not lost upon using this skill. Since it has a 10% chance on killing an enemy to instantly recharge Totem of Man, it may allow you to transform back into Human form before the 30 seconds.
** Troll Unguent and Protector's Defense are also kept when this skill is activated.
** Even though Signet of Stamina does not end upon activation, you will not gain any additional Maximum Health.
** Together as One and Never Rampage Alone are also kept.
{{research needed|Which effects do the Norn elite forms remove and which ones do they leave?}}
*Synergizes well with Binding Rituals; the spirits will keep attacking even when your normal skills are disabled, and the spirits' attacks are affected by Ursan Roar. 

Although it is classified as a Form, the caster does not change appearance.
If you obtain a new skill (as a quest reward) you may equip it in any of the free slots and use it. After turning back to human form, you keep the skill but cannot use it until you swap it with another skill.
c97fd5790b8cf6be88b96db6c1c9ce274ffa16a9.text:
* 當您啟動此技能時，您所維護的所有維持結界都將被移除。
* 在最初的 30 秒內，無法使用人類圖騰，因為它正在充電。
* 當祝福結束時，你會恢復原來的技能欄，Ursan 祝福開始充電。
* 由於此祝福和所有相關技能不需要使用武器，因此可以在攜帶包裹時使用。
* 有些效果不會在啟動該技能後結束：
** 使用此技能後，隨機效果列表 不會遺失。由於它有 10% 機率殺死敵人以立即充能人類圖騰，因此它可能會讓您在 30 秒之前變回 人類 型態。
** 此技能啟動時，巨魔藥膏 和 保護者態勢 也會保留。
** 即使 耐力紋章 不會在啟動時結束，您也不會獲得任何額外的最大 體力。
** 合而為一和永不獨行橫衝直撞也被保留。

雖然被歸類為形態，但施法者的外觀不會改變。
如果您獲得新技能（作為任務獎勵），您可以將其裝備在任何免費插槽中並使用它。變回人類 型態 後，您會保留該技能，但無法使用它，直到您將其交換為其他技能。
