* This is the only skill that affects all hostile minions, making it a powerful counter to minion masters.
* Cover this enchantment to avoid its untimely removal.
* The minions become bound to you only at the moment you cast the enchantment. This enchantment is not a persistent 'aura' effect that constantly binds minions close to you.

Recasting Verata's Aura starts a new timer; it does not reset the original one (as would be the case with other enchantments). The minions covered by the original Aura will become masterless as scheduled; any created between the two castings will be covered by the second enchantment. Consider bringing self enchantment removal skills such as Contemplation of Purity, and only renew the enchantment near its end.
4757ce5fbbb8132704e4f7ed3114b4d094b51196.text:
* 這是唯一能影響所有敵對小兵的技能，使其成為對抗小兵大師的強大武器。

* 只有在你施放結界的那一刻，小兵才會與你繫結。這種結界並不是一種持久的「光環」效果，可以不斷地將小兵束縛在你身邊。

重鑄 芙瑞達的靈氣 啟動一個新的計時器；它不會重置原始結界（與其他結界的情況一樣）。被原始光環覆蓋的小兵將如期變成無主狀態；兩次鑄造之間產生的任何東西都將被第二個結界覆蓋。考慮攜帶自我結界移除技能，例如純淨的冥想，並且僅在結界接近結束時才更新結界。

* Although it only allows you to disconnect one minion or to take control of one, its quick recharge and low energy cost is good for taking small groups of minions or taking masterless undead.
* Good synergy with Malign Intervention.
* Although it is possible to take control of a minion, it is not possible to take control of effects on that minion. For example, Death Nova will damage the enemies of whoever cast it and not the present controller of the minion. Similarly, Dwayna's Sorrow will heal the party of the caster. The exception to this is Jagged Bones, which will create a minion under the control of whoever controls the minion when it dies.

* 可用於「欺騙」NPC AI 避開您的角色，因為最大生命值最低的角色會先攻擊 NPC。

*For the first 30 seconds, it's impossible to use Totem of Man as it is recharging.
*When you activate this skill, all Upkeep Enchantments you maintain will be removed.
*When the blessing ends, you get your original skill bar back and Volfen Blessing starts recharging.
*Good synergy with Quickening Zephyr, especially at higher Norn ranks, because Volfen Bloodlust can be maintained indefinitely.
*Since this blessing and all associated skills do not require a weapon to be used, they can be used while carrying bundles.
*Synergizes well with Binding Rituals; the spirits will keep attacking even when your normal skills are disabled, and the spirits' attacks are affected by Volfen Bloodlust.

f12507e6073aa942f845c8875578a97235f04c83.text:
*在最初的 30 秒內，無法使用人類圖騰，因為它正在充電。
*當您啟動此技能時，您所維護的所有維持結界都將被移除。
*當祝福結束時，您將恢復原來的技能欄，並且Volfen 祝福開始充電。
*與活力微風有良好的協同作用，特別是在較高的諾恩等級時，因為沃爾芬嗜血可以無限期地維持。
*由於此祝福和所有相關技能不需要使用武器，因此可以在攜帶包裹時使用。
*與束縛儀式很好地協同作用；即使你的普通技能失效，精靈也會繼續攻擊，並且精靈的攻擊會受到沃爾芬嗜血的影響。

* Synergizes well with attack skills that can cause multiple attacks with a scythe (Eremite's Attack, Twin Moon Sweep, and Whirlwind Attack) and with hex spells that deal damage whenever the hexed foe takes physical damage (Barbs and Mark of Pain).
** When Eremite's Attack or Whirlwind Attack is used, this skill will trigger for each adjacent foe hit.
* Because this triggers on attack, you don't actually have to hit for the damage to occur.

* This skill creates a Spirit of Vampirism that uses the Vampirism attack skill.
* The attacks used by this spirit steal life, so it does not receive the bonus damage from Signet of Ghostly Might.
* The amount which you are healed will always be the same because Vampirism heals you. The amount of health left on a target only affects how much the spirit is healed by the life stealing, not how much you are healed. Therefore, additional life stealing from Spiritleech Aura does not give additional healing to you.

Contrary to the description, the healing from this skill is gained through life stealing rather than a heal. Therefore, the heal is unaffected by hexes that reduce healing such as Lingering Curse or Defile Flesh, and the spirit will not take damage from healer-punishing hexes such as Scourge Healing or Soul Bind.

The distance of healing is much greater than spirit range and it seems that healing covers all the current location.

The Spirit of Vampirism's attack skill is a monster skill independent of the Sunspear rank. Unlike the progression of other Sunspear skills after the May 17, 2012 update, Vampirism's life stealing continues to follow the progression prior to that update (i.e. maximum effectiveness is reached at Sunspear rank 10 instead of 5) even though the descriptions display 20 life stealing from rank 5 to 9.

與描述相反，該技能的治療是透過生命竊取而不是治療獲得的。因此，治療不會受到減少治療的六角形的影響，例如 強力詛咒 或 肉體敗壞 ，並且靈魂不會受到諸如懲罰治療者的咒語的傷害 災禍治癒 或 靈魂束縛 。

治療的距離遠大於精神範圍，似乎治療涵蓋了目前的所有位置。

* Heroes will use this skill indiscriminately on the foes which cannot be knocked down because of Stun Immunity.

f1d1766934623da2bcda900766f588e13da4c7b1.source:
* The bonus damage begins to apply after the first damage pulse.
* Synergises with Psychic Instability.
* Useful to cover other hexes that punish foes for using skills, such as Diversion or Shame, forcing your target to choose between taking the damage or suffering the covered hex's effect.
** However, this skill does not cover other hexes if the target uses their own hex removal skill, since activation of the hex removal will end Wastrel's Demise, allowing the skill to remove the next hex in the effects monitor.
* This skill is very effective against targets that do not use skills (e.g. minions or pets) or rarely use them (e.g. The Jade Quarry Carrier Juggernauts and Hauler Turtles activate their skill, Carrier Defense, under limited situations); it does the maximum damage against them and adjacent foes.
If the hex is reapplied before it ends, Wastrel's Demise will continue to add up the bonus damage until the first hex would have run out. After that, the bonus damage cycle will start over.
Unlike most area damage over time skills, Wastrel's Demise does not cause AI to scatter.
f1d1766934623da2bcda900766f588e13da4c7b1.text:
* 獎勵傷害在第一個傷害脈衝後開始生效。
* 與 精神失衡 協同作用。
* 用於覆蓋其他懲罰敵人使用技能的六角形，例如 牽制 或 羞愧，迫使您的目標在受到傷害或遭受覆蓋六角形的效果之間進行選擇。
** 但是，如果目標使用自己的十六進位制移除技能，則該技能不會覆蓋其他六角形，因為啟用六角形移除將結束 瓦斯崔之死，從而允許該技能移除效果監視器中的下一個六角形。
* 該技能對於不使用技能（例如小兵或寵物）或很少使用技能的目標非常有效（例如 翡翠礦場 航母主宰和搬運龜在有限情況下啟用其技能“航母防禦”）；它對他們和鄰近的敵人造成最大傷害。
如果在結束之前重新應用十六進位制，瓦斯崔之死 將繼續累積額外傷害，直到第一個十六進位用完。之後，額外傷害迴圈將重新開始。
與大多數隨時間推移造成區域傷害的技能不同，瓦斯崔之死 不會導致 AI 分散。

f99a76ac9daea81482a6e3c18d60376db19cb88c.source:
* The foe must successfully activate a skill for Wastrel's Worry to end early. An interrupted/canceled skill does not count.
* The description is somewhat misleading; if Wastrel's Worry ends early for any reason, the foe does not take damage.
* Casting Wastrel's Worry on a foe already hexed with it has no effect.
* The hex is especially effective on foes that do not use skills (e.g. minions and pets) and those with active hex reduction (e.g. most bosses, Natural Resistance).
* Wastrel's Worry is also useful to force targets to choose how they take damage — from (a) failure to use a skill (this hex) or by using a skill (e.g. Visions of Regret, Empathy, Backfire).
* Heroes preferentially use this on casters.

9630e5d734f4313de17cf6b6efb385d56b40d687.source:
* This skill takes effect as soon as damage is dealt. When triggered by an attack or skill that also applies a condition, that condition will be removed only if it is applied before the damage is dealt.
** Condition-applying attack skills and preparations apply their conditions after the attack damage is dealt; Weapon of Remedy will not remove these conditions.
** Enchantments such as Grenth's Grasp and Double Dragon which add a condition application to subsequent attacks or skills trigger before damage is dealt, allowing Weapon of Remedy to remove their conditions immediately if triggered by the same action.
** Some spells, such as Immolate, deal damage before applying their conditions, whereas others, such as Eruption, apply conditions first. {{research needed|Lots more skills to test, if it's worth doing so. See talk page}}
If used when taking damage from multiple sources from only one attack, Weapon of Remedy will trigger multiple times. For example, if a foe hexed with Barbs takes physical damage, Weapon of Remedy will trigger both for the physical damage and for the Barbs damage.

* This skill creates a Spirit of Winter.
* Mechanically, this skill is vastly different than how Conflagration, Greater Conflagration, Kindle Arrows and elemental bowstrings work:
** Spirit of Winter will not allow you to trigger the requirement of Conjure Frost, as it changes the elemental damage received to cold, rather than change the damage output of an elemental weapon to cold. 
** Conflagration, Greater Conflagration, Kindle Arrows and Elemental bowstrings change the damage type output to fire or other elements, which allows you to trigger conjure spells with them, but not with Winter.
* Because of this, Winter will not stop Conjure Flame from working with Kindle Arrows when under it's effect; it will simply change the final damage caused on the enemy from Fire to Cold Damage.
** Hence winter will not ever activate Conjure Frost on you, but will be able to activate cold damage reception triggers on the enemy such as Spinal Shivers.
* Great synergy with skills like Mantra of Frost or Spinal Shivers.
Unlike Greater Conflagration or Conflagration this skill requires either the attacker or the damage receiver to be inside the spirit area of effect.
05639545e9e21a99b19afa753c1cf7677eea02b4.text:
* 此技能創造出寒冬的精神。
* 從機制上講，該技能與 火靈、高階 火靈、火箭 和元素弓弦的工作方式有很大不同：
** 寒冬 的精神不會讓你觸發 召喚冰霜 的要求，因為它會將受到的元素傷害改為寒冷，而不是將元素武器的傷害輸出改為寒冷。 
** 火靈、進階 火靈、火箭 和 元素生物 弓弦將傷害型別輸出變更為火焰或其他元素，這允許您使用它們觸發召喚法術，但不能使用 寒冬。
* 因此，寒冬 在其作用下不會阻止 召喚火焰 與 火箭 一起工作；它只會將對敵人造成的最終傷害從火傷害改為冷 傷害。
** 因此，冬天永遠不會對你啟動召喚冰霜，但能夠對敵人啟動寒冷傷害接收觸發器，例如刺骨惡寒。
* 與 冰霜頌歌 或 刺骨惡寒 等技能具有良好的協同作用。
與高階 火靈 或 火靈 不同，此技能要求攻擊者或傷害接收者位於精神效果區域內。

eca578ca5e89bda839239ab67082defed4224e12.source:
* Makes it easier to maintain Critical Defenses or Critical Agility.
* Can be used with Critical Eye to further increase the chance of critical hits. The real value to combining these skills is not in the extra damage, but the increased energy return at a mid-level Critical Strikes rank.
* This is the only Assassin skill that increases attack speed in PvP.
eca578ca5e89bda839239ab67082defed4224e12.text:
* 讓維護 致命防禦 或 薄暮之速 變得更容易。
* 可與致命之眼一起使用，進一步增加暴擊機率。組合這些技能的真正價值不在於額外的傷害，而是在於中級 致命攻擊 等級時增加的能量回報。
* 這是唯一可以在 PvP 中提高攻擊速度的 暗殺者 技能。
eca578ca5e89bda839239ab67082defed4224e12.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

fbc611280baaff618c2759de01e483cb735917df.source:
* Only the standard adrenaline gain from making an attack is doubled, not any other effects that generate adrenaline, even if they are part of the attack (such as Enraged Smash or Thrill of Victory).
* Stacks additively with Dark Fury (for a total of 3 adrenaline per hit) or Mark of Fury (2-5 adrenaline per hit depending on rank). Does not stack with "For Great Justice!", Focused Anger, or Infuriating Heat.
* Heroes will cast Weapon of Fury on attacking allies with priority to those with enhanced attack-rating and/or striking multiple foes.
fbc611280baaff618c2759de01e483cb735917df.text:
* 只有透過攻擊獲得的標準腎上腺素才會加倍，任何其他產生腎上腺素的效果不會加倍，即使它們是攻擊的一部分（例如 憤怒猛擊 或 勝利的感動）。
* 與 暗黑憤怒（每次命中總共 3 腎上腺素）或 狂暴印記（每次命中 2-5 腎上腺素，視等級而定）疊加疊加。不能與「為了偉大的正義！」、集聚怒氣 或 怒火 疊加。
* 英雄會對攻擊盟友施放 狂暴武裝，優先於那些攻擊力增強和/或打擊多個敵人的盟友。
fbc611280baaff618c2759de01e483cb735917df.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

This does not occur for Energy Storage, dervish nor monk enchantments. {{{|Video}}}.

a3a4e6697ae330e881c3e20fd143e036997fc2b4.source:
* Unlike Earth Shaker, which knocks down target foe and foes adjacent to the target, this attack hits foes adjacent to the user hence the attack can miss on kiting foes as with Cyclone Axe and Crude Swing.
* Good synergy with "You Are All Weaklings!" and Belly Smash (preceded by an elite knock-down, e.g. Earth Shaker).
* Skills like Withering Aura inflict conditions before Yeti Smash hits.
* In normal and hard mode, the AI will use this skill on a foe even if it is not adjacent to another foe nor suffering from a condition.
a3a4e6697ae330e881c3e20fd143e036997fc2b4.text:
* 不像 震動大地 ，擊倒目標敵人和目標附近的敵人，此攻擊會擊中使用者附近的敵人，因此攻擊可能會錯過風箏敵人 旋風斧 和 狂暴亂舞 。
* 與《你們都是弱者！ 》有良好的協同作用和 腹部猛擊 （之前是精英擊倒，例如 震動大地 ）。
* 諸如凋零光環之類的技能會在先前造成條件 雪人猛擊 命中。
* 在普通和困難模式下，即使敵人不與另一個敵人相鄰或患有某種疾病，AI也會對敵人使用此技能。

35dd602e6ce7d49e42693fba1804b66cb03975a5.source:
* The path shown on the map can be quite difficult due to the 3 closely gathered groups of Margonites and Torment creatures on the other side. Still, it is possible to lure one group away from the others. An alternative would be to take a right turn in front of the bridge and follow the path from there on (staying near the west edge of the path) until one goes around to cross a black bridge that leads directly to the boss. There are small mobs along the way, but this should be remedied with a decent party. This is a longer, but safer way to approach the boss without having to suffer any sort of death penalty.

* This boss does not spawn in the mission. You must enter the zone from the Gate of Fear and then exit to Domain of Pain to reach the boss.
35dd602e6ce7d49e42693fba1804b66cb03975a5.text:
* 地圖上顯示的路徑可能相當困難，因為另一邊的 3 緊密聚集一群瑪貢人和折磨生物。儘管如此，還是有可能吸引一個群體遠離其他群體。另一個選擇是在橋前右轉，然後沿著路徑從那裡開始（靠近路徑的西邊緣），直到繞過一座直接通往老闆的黑橋。沿途有一些小暴民，但這應該透過一個像樣的聚會來解決。這是一種更長但更安全的接近老闆的方法，而不必遭受任何形式的死刑。

* 該 Boss 不會在任務中產生。您必須從恐懼之門進入該區域，然後退出到 苦痛領地(恐懼之門外) 才能到達 Boss。

95d4be6ca1cb6ea96b49258a4d8183b79e77ab04.source: Enter the Domain of Secrets and speak to Kormir. While in this area, your party suffers from Veiled Nightmare (skills cost 40% more Energy to activate). Follow the quest arrow and make your way to Scout Ahtok avoiding over-aggro. Once within radar range, you must rescue him from the attacking Margonites. If he dies, the quest fails. Talking to him will trigger a cinematic. Do not walk into the portal before talking to Ahtok.
95d4be6ca1cb6ea96b49258a4d8183b79e77ab04.text: 進入 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外) 並與 Kormir 交談。在這個區域中，您的隊伍會受到矇蔽 夢魘 的影響（啟動技能需要花費 40% 更多 能量 才能啟動）。按照任務箭頭前往偵察兵阿托克，避免過度仇恨。一旦進入雷達範圍，你必須將他從攻擊的瑪貢尼特手中救出來。如果他死了，任務就會失敗。與他交談會觸發過場動畫。在與阿赫托克交談之前不要走進傳送門。

9867e414411402994d3534ace8424c4035bec353.text: 在此區域中，您的隊伍成員會受到 瘋狂深淵(亞霸頓之門外) 環境影響（導致 -15% 治療）。非隊伍成員（召喚生物、寵物、召喚石 NPC）不受影響。

6b3c62c48434d2571e3a8311971df560a64937ac.source: After exiting the Gate of Secrets to the Domain of Secrets, follow the quest marker west and clear the groups as marked on the map. If you have the quest Escape from the Torment, you might run into the Margonite ambush from that quest along the way.
6b3c62c48434d2571e3a8311971df560a64937ac.text: 離開秘密之門到達 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外) 後，沿著任務標記向西走，清除地圖上標記的隊伍。如果你有來自折磨的任務 脫逃，你可能會在途中遇到該任務的 瑪骨奈 伏擊。

0181e33aae211ddcc27df42f0eacc710e61222a6.source: Leave the Gate of Fear and head south into the swampy area of the Domain of Fear, where you will find the first 2 bound constructs to free. Each construct is accompanied by a mob of Margonites, and there are also patrols of Terrorweb Dryders and hidden creatures to defeat. The final construct is found north on the plain just outside the Gate of Secrets. Particular care should be take here due to the number of patrolling mobs present on the plain.
0181e33aae211ddcc27df42f0eacc710e61222a6.text: 離開恐懼之門，向南進入 恐懼領地(恐懼之門外) 的沼澤區域，在那裡你會發現第一個需要釋放的 2 繫結結構。每個構造體都伴隨著一群瑪貢尼特暴徒，還有恐怖網乾燥者的巡邏隊和隱藏的生物需要被擊敗。最終的建築位於秘密之門外的北部平原上。由於平原上有大量巡邏的怪物，所以這裡應該特別小心。
0181e33aae211ddcc27df42f0eacc710e61222a6.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

db5b9981bec166b8c1b787475fb1f4edc3f98221.text: 鞏固您的遺產。在 爪格林瑪墳墓 中擊敗古物碎片。

9a644cd1bd7f46e05d188e31f87ca355ee214195.source: Fragment of Antiquities is in the very North-West corner of the first level in the map Sepulchre of Dragrimmar. The Sepulchre of Dragrimmar is in north-west corner of Drakkar Lake, not far from Shrine of the Wolf Spirit. In order to be able to reach the Fragment of Antiquities, you need to get the quest The Anvil of Dragrimmar from Outrunner Remlok just outside the entrance to the dungeon, or you won't be able to get past the first room. Do NOT mistake Fragment of Antiquities for Remnant of Antiquities (who is the dungeon's boss). They have similar names, but killing the Remnant will not count towards this quest.
9a644cd1bd7f46e05d188e31f87ca355ee214195.text: 古物碎片位於地圖 爪格林瑪墳墓 第一層的西北角。 爪格林瑪墳墓 位於 卓卡湖 的西北角，距離 狼 精神神社不遠。為了能夠到達古物碎片，你需要從地牢入口處的Outrunner Remlok那裡接任務The Anvil of Dragrimmar，否則你將無法通過第一個房間。不要將古物碎片誤認為 殘餘的斷片（他是地牢的頭目）。他們的名字相似，但殺死殘餘者不會計入此任務。
9a644cd1bd7f46e05d188e31f87ca355ee214195.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

The Fortune Teller is protected by a group of Margonites, and on her death, will re-spawn as the Demonic Fortune Teller, as well as causing a number of torment creatures to spawn.
6a2ce4fbe4c4bfe4e5f2677cd5f398757292d926.text: 進入恐懼領地(恐懼之門外)並依照任務指標找到該區域西北角的算命師。算命師受到一群瑪貢尼特的保護，在她死後，她會以惡魔算命師的身份重生，並導致大量折磨生物生成。

5d77e953b68484d6570379898a86fe9452c1317c.source: Head out into the Domain of Secrets and make your way to Terick situated due west. When you find him, he will make a short taunting speech, turn hostile and attack the party. Upon his defeat, Terick will respawn as the demonic necromancer boss, Razakel. Once Razakel is defeated, return to the Gate of Secrets for your reward.
5d77e953b68484d6570379898a86fe9452c1317c.text: 前往 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外)，前往位於正西的泰裡克 (Terick)。當你找到他時，他會發表簡短的嘲諷言論，變得充滿敵意並攻擊政黨。失敗後，泰裡克將重生為惡魔死靈法師老大拉扎克爾。擊敗拉扎克爾後，返回秘密之門領取獎勵。

655b08dcf5281f296134418ec83378607b2e9df1.source: Your job is to protect Keeper Kauniss on its way to the Atrocity Library in the Domain of Secrets. If the Forgotten dies, the quest fails, and you must re-zone to resume the quest. There are two methods of completion:
655b08dcf5281f296134418ec83378607b2e9df1.text: 你的任務是在 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外) 中保護前往暴行圖書館的守護者考尼斯。如果 被遺忘者 死亡，任務就會失敗，您必須重新區域才能恢復任務。有兩種完成方法：

806550d0c8d66a53acda379dd0a17273aadd0a11.source: If you took this follow up immediately after completing A Flickering Flame (while still in the Domain of Secrets) then the two bosses can be found a short walk south from where you defeated Ignis Cruor.
806550d0c8d66a53acda379dd0a17273aadd0a11.text: 如果您在完成 若隱若現的火焰 後立即進行此後續行動（同時仍在 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外) 中），那麼可以在您擊敗伊格尼斯·克魯爾的地方向南走一小段距離找到這兩個 Boss。
806550d0c8d66a53acda379dd0a17273aadd0a11.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

00e7363fffd91cae1260825503a0a5521328d789.source: Otherwise, you must return to the Gate of Secrets and collect the quest there, then travel west in the Domain of Secrets until you find the two bosses next to each other (one a Warrior the other a Mesmer). Note that these titans spawn next to each other, and do not break down into lesser titans when they die. When you have killed one you can safely move on to the other.
00e7363fffd91cae1260825503a0a5521328d789.text: 否則，你必須回到秘密之門並在那裡收集任務，然後在 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外) 中向西行進，直到你找到彼此相鄰的兩個 Boss（一個是 戰士，另一個是 幻術師）。請注意，這些泰坦彼此相鄰生成，並且在死亡時不會分解為較小的泰坦。當你殺死一個之後，你就可以安全地轉向另一個。
00e7363fffd91cae1260825503a0a5521328d789.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

276145ebc1bd867cc00d4bfe00741163c8c43c11.source: If you do not have the Heart of the Shiverpeaks quest, Budger Blackpowder is available to provide powder kegs for your party. He is located prior to the Cracked Walls on each level.
276145ebc1bd867cc00d4bfe00741163c8c43c11.text: 如果您沒有 席娃山脈之心 任務，巴哲黑火藥 可以為您的隊伍提供火藥桶。他位於每一層的裂牆之前。

Despite the need to save them, the party needs to be careful to avoid aggroing additional patrolling creatures as the team reaches the Forgotten.
e45a9e63b734b586004e89c44e5506df18a7c509.text: 被遺忘者 的最初一組位於 恐懼領地(恐懼之門外) 中秘密之門的東北部（地圖上標記點 1），當您接近時，可能會受到折磨生物的攻擊。儘管需要拯救它們，但當團隊到達 被遺忘者 時，隊伍需要小心避免騷擾其他巡邏生物。

d70108bddca2c1dcac073b8a70703cbeb667b0b1.source: Start from Gate of Fear, which is the only entrance to the Domain of Pain. Thenemi is waiting just outside. From there, follow the quest pointer to the other Oddbodies; you must find each of them before Captain Yithlis will be ready to speak with you. Each Oddbody will follow you as an ally, making the fights easier as you proceed; they do not need to survive to complete the quest.
d70108bddca2c1dcac073b8a70703cbeb667b0b1.text: 從恐懼之門開始，這是通往 苦痛領地(恐懼之門外) 的唯一入口。特內米就在外面等。從那裡，按照任務指標找到其他奇怪的人；你必須先找到他們每個人，然後伊斯里斯隊長才會準備好與你交談。每個奇怪的人都會作為盟友跟隨你，讓你的戰鬥變得更容易；他們不需要生存來完成任務。
d70108bddca2c1dcac073b8a70703cbeb667b0b1.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

e863397cc62d2c626d60e3e4855737ce3bf1153e.source: There are two other quests inside the Domain of Pain (given by the Wandering Soul in the Leech Tunnels), namely a Faded Memory and the follow-up A Fleshy Operation. You can use the Oddbodies to help complete these quests. After picking up Igraine, instead of heading to Captain Yithlis, proceed to perform these quest first and then return to Captain Yithlis to finish "Into the Fire".
e863397cc62d2c626d60e3e4855737ce3bf1153e.text: 苦痛領地(恐懼之門外) 內還有另外兩個任務（由水蛭隧道中的遊魂提供），即「褪色的記憶」和後續的「肉身行動」。您可以使用 Oddbodies 來幫助完成這些任務。接起伊格萊因後，不要前往伊斯利斯船長處，而是先執行這些任務，然後返回伊斯利斯船長處完成「進入火海」。
e863397cc62d2c626d60e3e4855737ce3bf1153e.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

0e5532178533288aa90149e0904f28d877363166.text: 在 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外) 中找到獵人。

5f863f154c486dab161602613476841da4562988.source: The party will need to explore the Domain of Secrets to find the Hunter. Note that in addition to the usual mobs, there will also be Shiro'ken Assassins wandering around as well. The Hunter himself will be accompanied by 3 Shiro'ken Assassins, whom you must kill in order to complete the quest.
5f863f154c486dab161602613476841da4562988.text: 該隊伍需要探索 奧秘領地(奧秘之門外) 才能找到獵人。請注意，除了常見的小怪之外，還會有 白影軍團 刺客四處遊蕩。獵人本人將由 3 白影軍團 刺客陪同，您必須殺死他們才能完成任務。
5f863f154c486dab161602613476841da4562988.provider: Google Translate en → zh-TW; protected terms and quantities; pending review

12ef20c7913240216b54c2e33684c186c3fd8592.source: Carefully follow the Apostate in the Domain of Fear and avoid over-aggro. He sometimes stops and waits for you (he runs quicker as he isn't affected by Cower in Fear). Also, he is not targeted by foes, so you do not have to worry about his safety. Moving near him should make him start running again. Expect a fight when you reach your destination. There will be a Margonite Stalker and 5 Margonite Bowmasters to deal with. The fight should be fairly simple.
12ef20c7913240216b54c2e33684c186c3fd8592.text: 在 恐懼領地(恐懼之門外) 中小心追蹤叛教者並避免過度仇恨。他有時會停下來等你（他跑得更快，因為他不受恐懼畏縮的影響）。而且，他不會成為敵人的目標，所以你不必擔心他的安全。靠近他應該會讓他再次開始奔跑。當你到達目的地時，預計會發生戰鬥。會有 瑪骨奈 潛行者 和 5 瑪骨奈 弓箭手需要處理。戰鬥應該相當簡單。

All party members must have received the reward for Heart of the Shiverpeaks (quest).
It is possible to enter the mission with just one person meeting the requirement, but anyone else will not receive any credit for mission completion.
However, completing the mission does grant all players access to Central Transfer Chamber, making this a popular exploit for players who want Chaos Gloves without having to play through Eye of the North.
e66e5f998b1a1ab9f9cbcdc06d430e94e22b7d74.text:
所有隊伍成員必須已收到 席娃山脈之心（任務）的獎勵。
只有一個人滿足要求即可進入任務，但其他人不會獲得任務完成的任何積分。
然而，完成任務確實可以讓所有玩家進入中央傳送室，這對於那些想要混沌手套而無需玩 極地之眼 的玩家來說很受歡迎。

42cb379b28a229a15c0c4bdc68ba4a3a28130928.source:
* Glyph of Energy only cancels the base overcast cost of the spells, not overcast caused by other sources. 
** Arcane Languor and Iron Mist will still cause overcast on spells. 
** Over the Limit will still generate passive overcast. 
** Equinox and Sheer Exhaustion will not cause overcast. 
* Skills that let Glyph of Energy use its full potential are Maelstrom, Meteor Shower, Earthquake, and its duplicate Dragon's Stomp.
* A cancelled spell will still consume one use of the glyph. 
* Non-spell elemental skills (Lightning Touch, Shock, Glyph of Immolation and Glyph of Swiftness) will take advantage of the bonus and will not count as a use of the glyph. 
* Any elemental attribute raised to at least 9 will trigger the bonus armor from Prismatic Insignia.
* Has no duration (this is one of the few skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep).
42cb379b28a229a15c0c4bdc68ba4a3a28130928.text:
* 能量符號 僅取消法術的基本陰暗成本，而不是其他來源造成的陰暗。 
** 魔法耗盡 和 鐵之迷霧 仍會導致法術陰暗。 
** 超過限制仍會產生被動陰。 
** 晝夜 和 Sheer Exhaustion 不會導致陰天。 
* 讓 能量符號 充分發揮潛力的技能是 水漩渦、隕石雨、地震 及其複製 地龍踩踏。
* 取消的法術仍會消耗該雕文的一次使用。 
* 非法術元素技能（獻祭的 閃電之觸、電擊、符號 的獻祭和 符號 的迅捷）將利用該獎勵，並且不會算作對該雕文的使用。 
* 任何元素屬性提升到至少 9 都會觸發稜柱 徽記 的額外護甲。
* 沒有持續時間（這是少數無需維護即可無限期持續的技能之一）。

(In regards to party healing, this equates to 17.6 health-to-energy ratio, multiplied by # of allies.) That includes non-party members such as allied NPCs (Master Togo, Mhenlo, etc.), minions, animal companions and, in the case of two-party cooperative missions, members of the other party.

* Even at low rank in Water Magic, this skill increases survivability in burning-heavy areas (e.g. Catacombs of Kathandrax), helps prevent conditional Burning from triggering (e.g. from Glyph of Immolation), and prevents burning-dependent effects (e.g. from Searing Flames).

This skill does not remove existing Burning, unlike other skills that grant immunity to a condition (e.g. Tainted Flesh removes Disease).

bb49568117d592840ee7b2bc7fca5a508e3e5b08.source:
Because the recharge reduction of "None Shall Pass!" is applied after percentile reductions such as Quickening Zephyr, the recharge can be reduced below 0. The skill will display as 'recharging' indefinitely but actually can be used again after 10 minutes and 55 seconds, which indicates that Guild Wars uses an unsigned 16 bit integer to store the recharge time in hundredths of a second (216−1 cs = 65,535 cs = 10min 55.35s).

* Useful for kiting melee foes.
bb49568117d592840ee7b2bc7fca5a508e3e5b08.text:
因為《無人能通過！ 》的儲值減少了。在百分位數減少後應用，例如 活力微風 ，儲值可以減少到以下 0 。該技能會顯示為無限期“充電”，但實際上可以在充電後再次使用 10 分鐘和 55 秒，這表明 公會 Wars 使用無符號 16 位元整數，用於儲存以百分之一秒為單位的充電時間（ 216 - 1 CS = 65,535 CS = 10 分分鐘 55.35 s）。

* 對於風箏近戰敵人有用。

*Removes all enchantments any time the well is entered.
*Foes in this well cannot be targeted by enchantment spells that target a foe, like Ice Spear.

Foes in this well lose all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments; however, untargeted enchantments still work, which includes all flash enchantment spells, and spells like Shadow Refuge. These enchantments don’t get stripped simply by being inside the well, but only each time the well is entered. If one manages to gain an enchantment while inside (i.e. Aegis, Orders, etc.), it is not removed. Source.

*此井中的敵人不能被針對敵人的結界法術（例如 冰之矛）作為目標。

此井中的敵人會失去所有結界，並且無法成為進一步結界的目標；然而，非目標結界仍然有效，其中包括所有閃光結界法術，以及像 暗影庇護 這樣的法術。這些結界不會因為進入井內而被剝奪，而是隻有在每次進入井時才會被剝奪。如果一個人在內部成功獲得結界（即 神賜之盾、指令等），則該結界不會被移除。來源。
